novel_info.title: Who Let Him Cultivate?!
novel_info.author: The Whitest Crow
novel_info.summary: The next day.“I stress repeatedly, I am the one who distorted the attitude of the Cultivation World.” Lu Yang Sword Immortal said so angrily during the reporter’s interview. –Reported by the 《Cultivation Daily》for you.

chapters.title: Chapter 1 - 1 Good Day for Trips, not for Cheats
chapters.content:
[The second day of lunar February, a good day for trips.]
The rain was whirring down on the ground, splashing up the aroma of the earth. The lake made no complaints about ripples from the drops, while those pedestrians muttered curses about the rain.
"Hell good for trips huh? Started raining the moment I stepped out." Lu Yang complained as he left his raincoat back at home.
With no experience, the rain during his first long journey suddenly soaked him. He felt like the ground was maliciously trying to consume him—he had to pull his feet out of the mud.
The echoes of hooves from behind drew Lu Yang's attention.
A horse-drawn carriage approached him as he turned around. There was no coachman on the carriage, and the old horse seemed to know the way all by itself.
"What a miraculous horse." Lu Yang praised. The old horse had snake-like scales on its forehead. Evidently, it was a kind of mutated demon beast.
Though he got no clues on its value, he knew the old horse must be precious.
At least he couldn't afford it now.
"This gentleman seems to enjoy strolling in the rain, would you like to come and sit in the carriage?"
A hearty laugh of a man came from inside the carriage. Lu Yang accepted the man's kindness, took his feet out of the mud, and quickly got in the carriage.
"Excuse me, I am Lu Yang." Lu Yang sat cautiously inside, worrying that the rain and dirt on his body would soil the carriage.
"Meng Jingzhou." The owner of the carriage, as expected from his voice, was a profoundly relaxed young man. Obviously an optimistic mind that could strike up a conversation with anyone.
"Brother Lu, here to join the Seek Dao Sect selection?"
"Just trying my luck."
Meng Jingzhou laughed heartily, "Brother Lu, honest is always a good virtue, right? If you were actually just trying your luck, you wouldn't walk towards the Seek Dao Sect in the rain."
Lu Yang got a little embarrassed, "Reallu hard to find one without interest in Seek Dao Sect..."
The Seek Dao Sect, one of the Five Great Immortal Sects in the Central Continent, had countless cultivation masters and was extremely powerful. Today, the Sect was recruiting disciples that drew countless eyes.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were no exception.
Lu Yang had been living in the Central Continent after being orphaned at a young age. He survived on his parents' small heritage and donations from neighbors.
During his years living in the town, he heard from a storyteller about many tales. Immortal flying to the gate of heaven with his sword, the river demon causing a flood that affected five hundred miles, the disciple of the Immortal Sect slaying demons with his flying sword.
A shabby Daoist swindler levitating in public, breaking out of jail, only to be captured again by levitating masters of justice.
That's when he knew, this was not the world he was familiar with, not any era he knew. It was a world of cultivation where personal power could reach amazing heights.
He wished to seek immortality and learn the longevity method of immortals.
The Seek Dao Sect was his first stop to fulfill this desire.
The reason he chose the Seek Dao Sect was simple: there were no other sects close to his house, only the Seek Dao Sect.
With the Seek Dao Sect established here, other sects wouldn't be foolish enough to try and establish their sect nearby.
During their conversation, Lu Yang learnt that Meng Jingzhou came from an influential family of cultivators, his knowledge of cultivation far exceeded that of Lu Yang.
"The requirement for the Seek Dao Sect's acceptance of disciples is for them to be under the age of sixteen. That's the case not just for the Seek Dao Sect, but a common requirement for most sects."
"The path of cultivation is long and difficult, with stages of Qi Refinement, Foundation Establishment, Golden Core, Nascent Soul, Spirit Transformation, Refining the Void, Unification, and Pass Tribulation, all representing a breakthrough in cultivation. Countless people are stuck at each of these stages."
"There are many factors determining success in cultivation, such as luck, wisdom, spirit root... By the way, Brother Lu, do you know what your spirit root is?"
"Although the Seek Dao Sect doesn't set high requirements for spirit root, it wouldn't accept one that is too weak."
Lu Yang frowned, he heard of the term spirit root from the storyteller and did not know what his spirit root was.
"I don't know, what about you, Brother Meng?"
Meng Jingzhou's face turned puzzled, shaking his head in return, "I have tested my spirit root in the family, but the elders did not tell me the result with a worried look on their faces. They just said that my talent was extraordinary and that it wouldn't be a problem for me to join one of the Five Great Immortal Sects and find out when I do so.
I tried asking my parents secretly, but they were even more worried and didn't tell me either."
Lu Yang speculated, "Maybe your spirit root is so extraordinary that it could bring trouble to the Meng Family. Only a giant sect like the Seek Dao Sect could protect you."
"That's what I guessed too." Meng Jingzhou patted Lu Yang on the shoulder. Now he deemed Lu Yang as talented as himself—what a pair of gifted cultivator.
Lu Yang listened to the increasing sound of the rain outside and was glad that Meng Jingzhou had invited him into the carriage.
"Halt!" Meng Jingzhou suddenly shouted. The old horse slowed down and came to a halt.
The carriage was a rare treasure, and Meng Jingzhou could see the world outside from inside the carriage.
Meng Jingzhou noticed a young woman walking in the rain, looking like Lu Yang had before.
"Lady, since you're walking in this direction, you must be heading to the Seek Dao Sect to join the examination. The rain is quite heavy, why not rest your feet in the carriage?"
The woman looked a bit surprised at Meng Jingzhou's offer but decided to accept it after contemplation.
As soon as the woman got on the carriage, Meng Jingzhou and Lu Yang were both stunned.
Meng Jingzhou, who considered himself worldly, had never seen a woman as beautiful as her, and there's no need to mention Lu Yang, the prettiest woman he had ever seen was the young widow who lived next door and sold tofu.

chapters.title: Chapter 2 - 1 Good Day for Trips, not for Cheats
chapters.content:
Of course, Lu Yang was an honorable man and had no indecent thoughts about the young widow.
The woman was like a charming, yet not showy, lotus. Wearing a white robe, she stood tall and delicate, with bright eyes and white teeth, giving off a transcendental vibe.
She also wore a golden bracelet on her right wrist.
"Thank you both,"
The woman's voice was as soothing as a clear spring.
Lu Yang noticed something odd and whispered, "Brother Meng, she's not drenched in the heavy rain. Could she be a monster?"
In fables, monsters often transformed into beautiful women to seduce young, strong men like them.
Lu Yang had been drenched earlier, looking disheveled, but Yun Zhi was completely dry. She didn't appear as if she had just walked in the rain.
Meng Jingzhou didn't dwell on it, "Perhaps she has some rare treasure that repels rain. It's not uncommon in prestigious families."
Meng Jingzhou wasn't worried that Yun Zhi was a monster because they were on Seek Dao Sect's territory. Any monster risking its life to cause trouble here would be elliminated.
"Mistress Yun Zhi, have you come to participate in the Seek Dao Sect examination?"
"Indeed."
Meng Jingzhou warmly suggested, "I happen to have insider information about the Seek Dao Sect exam, acquired at great expense from an Elder. Would you like to hear about it?"
Lu Yang looked at Meng Jingzhou in surprise. Why hadn't he told him about it?
Yun Zhi looked even more surprise, "That would be cheating. If the Seek Dao Sect found out..."
Meng Jingzhou waved his hand, oozing confidence, "This carriage is a magical treasure. Even the most powerful secluded cultivators and ancient creatures cannot probe inside it with their Spiritual Sense."
"I understand. Please tell me the contents of the examination."
Upon hearing this, Lu Yang also attentively listened.
Meng Jingzhou cleared his throat, "The Seek Dao Sect exam consists of three parts. The first one tests your Spirit Root—an inflexible requirement with no tricks or shortcuts possible. The second and third parts are the ones we can strategize for."
"The second part tests your moral character. A carriage is out of control and headed towards five people lying on the roadside. If hit, they will undoubtedly die. There is another person lying not far away. As outsiders, we can manipulate the direction of the carriage. Do we choose to ignore it and let it kill the five people or change course and kill the other person?"
Without hesitation, Lu Yang answered, "Kill the other person."
This puzzled Meng Jingzhou. Ever since he had learnt about the contents of the second part, he couldn't figure out the solution. How could Lu Yang make a decision so swiftly?
If they ignored the situation, they would witness five deaths—an act that might be justifiable but emotionally unbearable. And if they decided to change directions and kill the other person, the individual would undeniably be unlucky. It would also mean they had a hand in causing the death.
Meng Jingzhou voiced his doubts, to which Lu Yang explained, "There isn't enough time to ponder. By the time you come up with a solution, the five people would have already been hit. I assume the Seek Dao Sect wants to test whether you choose to save five people or one person, but rather if you can make quick decisions."
"I've heard from one of the scholars that in a battle among cultivators, the slightest hesitation can lead to death. The second part is not testing your moral character, but whether you're decisive or not. Making a decision in the shortest possible time is the key."
Meng Jingzhou suddenly understood.
"The third part tests your honesty. The Seek Dao Sect has a mirror that can tell if you're lying—if caught in a lie, you're immediately disqualified."
Lu Yang pondered, "This section is easy. Without prior knowledge, it's tempting to tell a lie in order to cover up one's shortcomings. But now that we know in advance, we just have to tell the truth."
Meng Jingzhou nodded in agreement with his thoughts.
The pair discussed for a while, contemplating various possible surprises and strategies. In the end, they felt they had everything covered.
Mistress Yun Zhi showed a hint of a smile, seemingly amused by their thorough plans.
"Thank you for sharing, Young Hero Lu."
"Hmm, has the rain stopped?" Lu Yang realized that there was no sound of falling rain outside the carriage. Intrigued, he leaned out to check.
The path they had traveled still had torrential rain pouring, while their current location was bathed in sunlight, alive with the sound of birds and the scent of flowers. It was as if an unrivaled Sword Qi had divided the world into two halves—yin and yang—that would never intersect.
Looking up, Lu Yang saw numerous exotic beasts and magical artifacts rushing toward a colossal mountain that reached the sky.
The towering mountain was bathed in sunlight, turning a faint gold color. A glorious pattern spread from the mountain, covering the sky and blocking the rain.
This was the entrance to the Seek Dao Sect, protected by an unbreakable array.
Out of respect for the Seek Dao Sect, prodigies, under the guidance of their elders, landed at the foot of the mountain to await the commencement of the examination.
The old horse was already an uncommon mutant demon beast. But compared to those exotic beasts resting at the foot of the mountain, it still fell a little short.
"Ah, this is way grander than our Meng Family's estate," Meng Jingzhou rubbed his hands together, feeling a bit anxious. Thinking about how he would soon become a member of the Seek Dao Sect, he felt more excited than nervous.
Lu Yang remained silent. He had seen this mountain from home. It hadn't seemed significant from afar, but standing at its foot, he realized the sheer enormity of it.
He too, felt nervous. They could figure out the second and third parts, but he didn't know what his Spirit Root was yet. He might not even be able to get past the first hurdle.
About a dozen cultivators were levitating in front, all emanating a strong aura. Lu Yang suspected that if they fully released their aura, probably few could even stand in their presence.
The cultivators didn't say a word, exuding a psychological pressure just by their presence.
Lu Yang heard one of the clan leaders introduce to the younger generations, "Judging by their robes, these are the core disciples of the Seek Dao Sect, disciples of the various Elders, your future seniors."
"Don't be nervous. They're not intentionally pressuring you. It seems they're waiting for the person who will conduct the examination. Once the conductor is here, the examination will begin."
Lu Yang turned his head, wanting to see Yun Zhi's reaction—whether she was excited or anxious.
She couldn't possibly remain indifferent, could she?
"Mistress Yun Zhi, you..."
Just as Lu Yang was about to say something, Yun Zhi began to stride forward. Before each step hit the ground, a white lotus would rise to support her slender frame.
This caused a commotion, and the family leaders broke out in a cold sweat, quickly instructing their juniors to stay quiet.
A path of white lotuses unfolded, cutting across the crowd. Yun Zhi positioned herself amidst the Seek Dao Sect disciples who bowed to her in a sign of respect. Yun Zhi raised her hand then turned around to face the crowd, giving a faint smile.
"I'm sorry to have kept you waiting. I am the Eldest Senior Sister of the Seek Dao Sect and the conductor of this examination."
"I hereby announce that the examination begins now."
With that said, Yun Zhi looked at a stunned Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou with an amused smile.
Indeed, she had come to participate in the Seek Dao Sect examination, but not as an examiner, rather as the examiner.

chapters.title: Chapter 3 - 2: Single Spiritual Root_1
chapters.content:
The only thought Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had right now was: this is it, they're actually discussing how to cheat in front of the examiner.
As if she was unaware of their cheating plan, eldest Senior Sister Yun Zhi glanced once at them and then started organizing the examination, not bothering to look a second time.
It was evident that Yun Zhi commanded great respect among the disciples of the Seek Dao Sect, her orders unquestioningly obeyed.
These disciples of the Seek Dao Sect, each one a powerful figure in the outside world, revered and admired by others, were perceived as prodigies. The esteem in which Yun Zhi was held was clear from the fact that everyone followed her instructions without hesitation or slackness.
"A Spirit Root is the first hurdle on the road to Immortality. Without it, no matter how much resources you're given, you can't cultivate. The first part of this examination will test your Spirit Root. Each of you will step forward one by one. If you lack confidence in your Spirit Root, you're free to leave now."
No one left.
Those who were there for the Seek Dao Sect's examination had an understanding of their own Spirit Root. There were very few like Lu Yang who had dared to try their luck at the Seek Dao Sect, just because it was close to their home.
This was a precautionary measure taken by the Seek Dao Sect to avoid admitting students who don't meet the Spirit Root requirements and plan on cheating their way through the examinations.
Typically, a Spirit Stone is used to test someone's Spirit Root. But these stones are very large and conspicuous; seeing as there was not one in sight, the Seek Dao Sect didn't appear to be planning on using this method.
A disciple of the Seek Dao Sect named Dai Bufan was seated at the front of the room. His method of cultivation was very unique - by letting his Spiritual Energy circulate through an individual's body, he could determine their Spirit Root, cultivation technique, life gate… giving him a marked advantage in battle.
With two fingers on the wrist, similar to an old Chinese doctor checking the pulse, Dai Bufan could accurately determine the person's Spirit Root.
"A Three Spirit Root of metal, water, and fire? Not too bad. You may proceed."
"A Dual Spirit Root of water and fire. Good."
"A Dual Spirit Root of water and wood. Your foundation was once injured, likely due to a severe trauma you suffered when you were twelve. Ordinarily, this should have left sequela, but surprisingly, you got lucky and met a beneficent expert who skilfully healed you and recompleted your foundation."
The man was taken aback, surprised at Dai Bufan's accuracy. "When I was twelve, my mother fell ill and died. My stepmother took control and, fearing that I would threaten her son's status, she schemed against me. I fell into a coma, and when I woke up, I was unscathed. My father told me that a beneficent expert had passed by and saved me, but he didn't leave his name on departing."
Once the man left, another Seek Dao Sect disciple congratulated Dai Bufan on his elevated cultivation. "You deduced all the details, like you had witnesses the events firsthand. Elder Brother Dai, your cultivation is admirable."
Dai Bufan responded nonchalantly, "Oh, it's nothing. That 'beneficient expert' was me. I was in a rush at the time and forgot to leave my name after saving him."
"..."
While speaking, Dai Bufan waved dismissively at the next examinee. "You're 18, beyond the age limit. You may leave."
A cheeky young monk under the guidance of an older monk earnestly greeted Dai Bufan.
Dai Bufan glanced at him and delivered the young monk back to the elderly one, "What is a novice monk from the Suspension Temple doing here? You have a brand left by the temple's abbot in your body. Go, go, go, return to your Suspension Temple."
"Isn't the Suspension Temple one of the Five Great Immortal Sects?" Lu Yang asked Meng Jingzhou in a low voice.
Meng Jingzhou nodded seriously, "The Suspension Temple has the fewest disciples among the Five Great Immortal Sects. At its fewest, there was just the abbot and one disciple, and at its most, there were no more than ten. This little monk hasn't begun cultivating yet, but he's already a disciple of the Suspension Temple, which signifies he has deep Buddhist roots."
He watched as the little novice monk was taken away by the elder monk of the Suspension Temple with a heavy expression, "I thought I would dominate the world of cultivation in the future, but it turns out I do have worthy opponents."
Lu Yang was unsure from where Meng Jingzhou drew his confidence. "You're not even slightly worried that Sister Yun Zhi will kick us out?"
"What's there to worry about? Haven't you seen how it goes in the novels? The major Sects are blind, they slander and frame the young genius, kicking him out of the Sect.
Taking this as an insult, the young lad is filled with motivation to strive for success, experiencing a string of adventures until he eventually soars high in the sky, becoming an existence even a major Sect could only look upon from below... well, no, look upon from above."
After a moment of silence, Lu Yang reminded him, "But Sister Yun Zhi doesn't seem to need to frame us."
"Makes sense."
Then Meng Jingzhou also panicked.
"The breath in your body flows unceasingly. Considering your attire, you don't seem to be from a cultivation-influential family. Could it be that you accidentally consumed a Green Wood Immortal Fruit in your childhood? Go ahead."
"Hmm, there's something interesting about your constitution." Dai Bufan placed his finger on a brawny man with bronze skin, his eyes lit up, "Bloodline of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe, it's been quite a while since I saw it."
The brawny man was tall and sturdy, his head gleaming, his skin reflecting light under the sun. Judging by his appearance, it seems plausible for him to be in his mid-twenties, but Dai Bufan didn't question his age, indicating that he's not yet sixteen.
All Lu Yang could say was 'Well developed indeed'.
The crowd stirred slightly. The Ancient Barbarian Tribe had an overwhelming strength that could move mountains and engulf the sun and the moon, dominating their era before disappearing in the river of Suiyue.
It had been a long time since the bloodline of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe appeared in the Central Continent. Everyone thought that this ancient bloodline had disappeared, but it now simply showed up during the examination of Ask Dao Sect.
Dai Bufan yawned, having checked half of the people. Yet, he hadn't come across a single Spiritual Root. Were they all taken away by other Sects?
Meng Jingzhou confidently stepped forward, Dai Bufan didn't hold much hope. But when his index and middle fingers touched Meng Jingzhou's wrist, his eyes widened instantly, and he jumped to his feet, "It's a Sin..."
Upon hearing Dai Bufan's words, murmurs broke out below. It's a Single Spiritual Root!
What did Single Spiritual Root mean? The bottleneck in each realm for them is much looser than others, destined to become a great Dao Cultivator, who could hold a high position in the court or become an independent powerhouse!
All eyes were glued to Meng Jingzhou, their interest apparently piqued. It was always beneficial to make early connections with such a person!
The elders hurriedly urged the younger generation to build a good relationship with Meng Jingzhou once they entered the Seek Dao Sect.
From the Meng family, with a Single Spiritual Root, and a disciple of the Seek Dao Sect. These three identities combined, guaranteed a position of power in the Seek Dao Sect's future setup, and one's name would be remembered as a Great Cultivator in history!
"Single Body Spiritual Root." Dai Bufan pronounced the complete term of Meng Jingzhou's Spiritual Root, and the scene fell silent.
Meng Jingzhou was extremely angry. What on earth was a Single Body Spiritual Root? Did it mean he had to stay single for his whole life?
"I don't know much, don't categorize me!" Meng Jingzhou flared up, banging on the table with rage.
"Junior Brother Dai, don't make fun of others." A misty voice came. Yun Zhi appeared from a cloud of fog, glaring at Dai Bufan, who sheepishly shrank his neck.
Meng Jingzhou finally calmed down a bit. He knew Dai Bufan must be pulling his leg.
Then Yun Zhi addressed Meng Jingzhou, "But Junior Brother Dai hasn't deceived you either. You indeed have a Single Body Spiritual Root; this is the academic term. But in the Cultivation World, people are more accustomed to its colloquial name, Pure Yang Spiritual Root."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
He finally understood why the old veteran and his parents in the clan didn't tell him about his spiritual root.
So the reason they said he would know when he reached the Five Great Immortal Sects was because they were too embarrassed to tell him!
No wonder his parents asked him whether he wanted a younger brother or sister after he had finished testing his root bone.
Mutated Single Spiritual Root, also known as Pure Yang Spiritual Root, the extremely Yang essence, the nemesis of all ghosts and spirits.
Preserving the Pure Yang body would speed up the cultivation progress significantly, but if the Pure Yang was lost, then the cultivation level would regress swiftly.

chapters.title: Chapter 4 - 3 Clearly an Honest Person_1
chapters.content:
"...Why does the slang name sound more formal than the scientific name?" Lu Yang muttered quietly from behind.
"Because the first Pure Yang Spirit Root elder called his spirit root 'Single Body Spiritual Root'." Yun Zhi's cultivation level was unfathomable. Lu Yang's mutterings were as clear to her as if he were speaking directly into her ear.
Yun Zhi paused, then continued: "In the Cultivation World, there's a custom of respecting the old single body elders."
It seemed that repeating this fact somehow strengthened her point.
Meng Jingzhou passed the first round with ease and was followed by Lu Yang.
"Hmm?! Another Single Spiritual Root?!" Dai Bufan's pupils slightly contracted. Just moments ago, he had complained about not encountering a single one, and now he had found two in a row.
"I'm a Single Spiritual Root?" Lu Yang pointed at himself, feeling his heart pound. He believed he must be hearing things, the corners of his lips curling into a smile involuntarily.
"Yes, you have a mutated Single Spiritual Root, the Sword Spirit Root." Dai Bufan nodded affirmatively. He had never been wrong in identifying Spirit Roots.
A Sword Spirit Root, innately filled with sword energy, invincible and the most aggressive!
Eldest Senior Sister Yun Zhi glanced at Lu Yang in mild surprise. She had casually agreed to travel by carriage, not expecting to find two top-tier cultivation talents in her company.
The onlookers' eyes grew even more eager as they began to consider which young girls would be a suitable match for Lu Yang. They were keen to abduct him and marry him into their respective families as a promising son-in-law.
Unlike Meng Jingzhou, who had the backing of the Meng Family, Lu Yang was obviously a commoner with no support.
Extremely gifted, and without any influences to back him— he was simply the perfect candidate for a political marriage.
The most critical part was that he could get married and have children!
Feeling the peculiar gazes directed at him, Lu Yang quickly moved on to the second round.
Behind Dai Bufan was a bamboo forest, where the second test took place.
"So, what's your Spirit Root?" Meng Jingzhou quickly recovered from the shock of having a Single Body Spiritual Root, eagerly asking Lu Yang.
Having a Single Body Spiritual Root doesn't matter, the path to Immortality is littered with dry bones, women are but seductive skeletons, he did not need a fairy by his side!
On the contrary, Lu Yang, although he was able to pass the first round and assumed there would only be a single cultivation talent like him, he imagined that Lu Yang's talent was at most on a Dual Spiritual Root level.
As a Single Spiritual Root prodigy, he felt the need to show concern for average talents.
"A Sword Spirit Root."
"Damn."
"Hm?" Lu Yang was utterly confused.
Another half day passed and those who were lined up in the back gradually entered the second round. Dai Bufan eliminated those with insufficient Spirit Root qualities.
From the discussions happening at the back, it seemed that several unique individuals had appeared. Before they could inquire about the specific details, Eldest Senior Sister Yun Zhi appeared before them, casually announcing "the second round will now begin", before immediately disappearing, leaving everyone dumbfounded.
A thick fog slowly rose, like smoke, like waves, flowing like water, seemingly veiling everything inside the bamboo forest.
The crowd instinctively tried to struggle, but to no avail, they felt powerless and their consciousness gradually sank.
This was the Illusion Bamboo Grove, integrated into the Grand Protective Array of the sect, it was beyond their resistance.
Yun Zhi easily drew a circle, dispersing the fog and creating a space. The Seek Dao Sect disciples stood behind her.
Dai Bufan chuckled: "Being trapped in the Illusion Bamboo Grove, they will forget their identities, forget about the tests, forget everything and show their true reactions. I wonder how many people will be able to pass the second round."
"I hope more of them can pass, there are several promising talents in this batch. It would be a pity if they were to fail at the second round."
Yun Zhi had still not eliminated Meng Jingzhou and Lu Yang from the test, but that was because Meng Jingzhou's test question was not from this year, but from twenty years ago.
"I wonder which Elder is responsible for selling that."
"Junior Brother Dai, who do you think will pass the second round?"
"Naturally, it's that Ancient Barbarian. The Ancient Barbarians are renowned for their simplicity and sincerity, no doubt about that."
"Those Single Body Spiritual Root and Sword Spiritual Root guys look pretty good too, they look like honest people."
Yun Zhi recalled the scene inside the carriage where Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were discussing how to cheat. She couldn't help but feel that they seemed rather dishonest.
...
"Where am I?" The robust man from the Ancient Barbarian tribe, known as Man Gu, looked around in confusion, forgetting what had just happened.
He was gripping an old axe, standing by a river with shimmering, exquisite light waves.
Man Gu's hand slipped, causing the old axe to fall into the river. Just as Man Gu was about to retrieve it, he saw bubbles emerging from the river. As the bubbles became bigger and more numerous, it turned into a spring creating a fairy-like figure surrounded by three different axes.
"Young man, I am the River Spirit. Which axe did you drop? The old one, the spiritual Open Mountain Axe, or the immortal Open Heaven Axe?"
The spiritual Open Mountain Axe and the immortal Open Heaven Axe were extremely famous in the Central Continent. Even a talentless mortal, if in possession of either of these axes, could rise to great power and prominence in the world.
Man Gu blurted out, "The old axe."
The River Spirit cracked a smile: "You are truly an honest young man. Therefore, all three axes shall be given to you."
Man Gu passed the second round.
"You see, I told you that Man Gu would definitely pass the second round. Let's see how the Single Body Spiritual Root and Sword Spirit Root guys choose." Dai Bufan eagerly continued to observe.
The second round was a test of honesty. The criterion for passing was obtaining all three axes.
The River Spirit was not an illusion. He was born from a river circling the bamboo forest, a spirited creature.
He had made countless incarnations, entering illusions, and testing people.
The River Spirit liked honest people. The only way to pass the second round was to honestly answer the River Spirit's question and be gifted with the three axes.
...
"Hm? How did the axe fall into the river?" Lu Yang was a little puzzled. He felt like an unknown force had compelled him to drop the axe.
The River Spirit reappeared and kindly inquired: "Young man, I am the River Spirit. Which axe did you drop? The old one, the spiritual Open Mountain Axe, or the immortal Open Heaven Axe?"
Lu Yang squatted down, looking from one axe to the next. Then he looked up at the River Spirit as if he was an idiot, with a pitiful expression "Two of these axes are yours, and you don't even know which two they are, and yet you're asking me?"
The River Spirit's smile faltered, he didn't know what to say. He was forced to agree with Lu Yang "Indeed, I don't know which two axes are mine."
Lu Yang looked at him suspiciously: "If I choose an axe, you better not suddenly recover your memory and remember which two axes are yours."
"Absolutely not." The River Spirit vowed.
"Let me see all three axes."
The River Spirit handed all three axes to Lu Yang.
Lu Yang promptly threw all of them back into the river: "Can you ask your question again?"
As if conditioned, the River Spirit asked: "Did you drop the old axe, the spiritual Open Mountain Axe, or the immortal Open Heaven Axe?"
Lu Yang broke into a smile: "I dropped all of them."
The River Spirit: "....."
The River Spirit gritted his teeth: "You are indeed an honest young man, all three axes are yours."

chapters.title: Chapter 5 - 4: Here You Go_1
chapters.content:
""My axe!" Meng Jingzhou shouted in the illusion, wanting to go down and retrieve his axe.
The River Spirit lifted three axes, appearing on the surface of the river.
"Young lad, you…"
Splash——
Before the River Spirit could finish, Meng Jingzhou dove headfirst, leapt into the river with a splash, blowing bubbles that were even larger than him.
What's going on?
The River Spirit was confused. This was the first time he encountered such a situation.
The bubbles gradually decreased in number until they disappeared, the river surface terrifyingly calm, with only the ripples sent out by the River Spirit's aura disturbing the stillness.
"Why is it so quiet, did he drown?" The River Spirit muttered. He wasn't too worried about Meng Jingzhou actually drowning, as this was an illusion, and people could not drown here.
Before the River Spirit could figure out what Meng Jingzhou was trying to do, a sudden change occurred again!
The ripples on the river surface became more frequent. The River Spirit furrowed his brows. He was controlling his power well, this shouldn't have been caused by his own aura.
Then he realized: "It was that kid who just jumped into the river!"
Among the river current were strands of golden aura. The mist on the river surface carried a scent of immortality, as if something terrifying was brewing beneath the river!
The unknown terror stirred the heart!
Three fountains sprung on the river surface, each jet getting taller and taller, sprinkling pale golden water mist, covering the entire river surface, causing the River Spirit to temporarily lose sight of what was happening.
An unknown wind blew away the pale golden mist.
Three silhouettes emerged, all resembling Meng Jingzhou. Yet their aura was markedly different from before, it's not an exaggeration to say it was a complete turnaround.
The River Spirit trembled, this was an instinctive reaction from the depths of his spirit!
Ordinary Meng Jingzhou, Cultivator Great Power Meng Jingzhou, and...Immortal Meng Jingzhou!
This was the fundamental rule of the illusion: when an item falls into the river, it will undergo three transformations: ordinary, spirit, and immortal.
"Hand it over." The three Meng Jingzhou spoke simultaneously, each taking an axe that belonged to them.
With the presence of Immortal Meng Jingzhou, the River Spirit was powerless and allowed himself to be manipulated.
Immortal Meng Jingzhou obtained the Immortal Artifact Open Mountain Axe, Cultivator Great Power Meng Jingzhou took the magic Open Mountain Axe, and Ordinary Meng Jingzhou, taking advantage of the River Spirit's moment of shock, obtained the worn-out axe.
With the three axes in hand, the illusion shattered, and Meng Jingzhou cleared the stage.
Those who passed the second round would fall into a temporary unconscious state, a body's self-protection mechanism.
...
The Seek Dao Sect members looked at Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, who passed the second round, and remained silent for a long time.
What happened to the promised honesty?
Yun Zhi didn't speak, she had a premonition that once these two were admitted into the Seek Dao Sect, it would never know peace again.
Hopefully, her premonition was wrong.
The actual River Spirit appeared, holding a gold and silver axe, and charged towards Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou in a threatening manner.
As the guardian spirit of the Seek Dao Sect, he had never suffered such humiliation before.
"Don't stop me, today I must teach these two bastards a lesson, break their hands and legs, then put them back together!"
Seeing the situation unfold, the disciples in the Seek Dao Sect hurriedly stopped the angered River Spirit.
"Elder River Spirit, you cannot cut them!"
"Elder River Spirit, calm down."
"If something happens to the participants, if this gets out, the reputation of our Seek Dao Sect will be ruined!"
Finally, it was Dai Bufan who stepped forward, stopping the raging River Spirit.
"Elder River Spirit, rest assured. The third test was personally designed by me, Dai Bufan. I will definitely give these two a lesson."
Satisfied by Dai Bufan's solemn assurance, River Spirit finally calmed down.
The third test was considered the grand finale and had two versions: one suggested by Yun Zhi, which was relatively mild, and another by Dai Bufan, which was somewhat cruel. Both were tests of fengxin (one's nature), and after a vote, it was unanimously decided to adopt Yun Zhi's version.
Yun Zhi's version was too mild, even if they could not pass, there would be no punishment. To quell the River Spirit's anger, they had no choice but to go with Dai Bufan's version.
For this, Yun Zhi didn't have any objections.
It was actually a good idea to let these two youngsters experience some hardship.
The second round eliminated a large number of people. Facing the temptation of the three axes, many people succumbed to their inner desires and deceived the River Spirit, claiming that the Open Mountain Axe and Open Mountain Axe were theirs.
Those eliminated departed the illusion, all complaining that the second round of the Seek Dao Sect was too difficult.
However, not everyone complained about the difficulty of the second round. For example, those who passed the second round didn't complain.
...
"The second round was quite simple." Man Gu remarked, "Just tell the truth."
Those waiting for the third round nodded, agreeing with what Man Gu said.
"Wait, we weren't supposed to jump into the river and snatch the axes from the River Spirit?" Meng Jingzhou shouted. Why was everyone else's approach different from his?
Lu Yang gave Meng Jingzhou a look of annoyance, thinking him an idiot: "If the River Spirit were not an illusion, but a real entity, wouldn't you have provoked the River Spirit?"
"You should have been like me, ask for the River Spirit's axes and throw them into the river. That way, all three axes would count as ours."
Meng Jingzhou realized: "So you were the clever one."
The crowd silently watched Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou summarize their experiences, and began to question whether their own methods of clearing the stage were wrong.
Man Gu gently nodded, remembering his father reminding him that the Ancient Barbarian Tribe almost perished due to their arrogance. As a descendant, he must overcome this drawback and be humble in learning from others.
Man Gu felt that he had found his role-models to learn from.
Just as everyone was discussing what the correct method to pass was, Yun Zhi, Dai Bufan and their fellow Seek Dao Sect disciples appeared.
Dai Bufan had a touch of a smirk on his lips. He turned his palm and a small mountain appeared. In the blink of an eye, the mountain grew to a height of a hundred feet.
The crowd exclaimed in surprise, such a display was rare even amongst cultivators.
The mountain was lush with dense forests, no different from a real mountain. There was also a long staircase on one side of the mountain that lead to the top.
"This item is called Wenxin Mountain, a unique item that I had requested the elder to make. On Wenxin Mountain, immortals are considered equal to ordinary beings. Your task is to climb Wenxin Mountain. The higher you climb, the stronger your will."
"Climb to the fiftieth step, and you can pass the round."
Someone asked: "Wouldn't this give Man Gu an advantage?"
Fifteen-year-old Man Gu had the physique of a man in his mid-twenties and was a head taller than the rest. When climbing the mountain, he indeed had an advantage, with his large strides allowing him to take two steps in a single stride.
Dai Bufan laughed: "There is nothing to worry about. Wenxin Mountain will equalize everyone's physical abilities. Regardless of whether one is an ordinary person or a cultivator, on my Wenxin Mountain, all will become ordinary people."
"Is there a time limit?" Another person asked.
"No."
The crowd rejoiced. Without a time limit, didn't it mean that they could keep trying? How could they possibly fail the third round?
Could it be that this third round was just for show?
"Can we use magic artifacts?" They had artifacts bestowed by their clans, which didn't require spiritual energy to use, making them a huge advantage.
Dai Bufan smirked with a touch of schadenfreude: "You can."
That is, if the magic artifacts could still be used.

chapters.title: Chapter 6 - 5 I think Level 3 tests wisdom_1
chapters.content:
When the group arrived at Wenxin Mountain, they didn't feel anything unusual, except for Man Gu, who felt his strength declining noticeably, bringing him closer to the others' level.
The boiling blood of his Ancient Barbarian Tribe lineage within him calmed, no longer providing him with a constant influx of power.
Everyone glanced at each other before turning their gaze towards the strongest among them, Man Gu.
"I'll go first." Seeing that everyone was looking at him, Man Gu volunteered without hesitation, boldly stepping up to be the first one.
First step, second step, third step... tenth step.
Man Gu climbed the first ten steps with ease, but the pressure began to build from the eleventh one. Each step felt like he was carrying a stone slab on his back, growing heavier the higher he climbed.
But it was still within his tolerance level.
He kept climbing.
Man Gu took a few heavy breaths to steady his breathing and proceeded to the twentieth step.
Upon reaching the twentieth step, Man Gu found it increasingly difficult to move. His pace slowed, and each push off the step became more strenuous.
By the twenty-ninth step, Man Gu has broken out in sweat that soaked his clothes. He was thoroughly exhausted and had to stop, panting heavily as he sat on the steps to rest.
"Even sitting down puts pressure on me." Man Gu mumbled to himself, too tired to speak. Shifting from standing to sitting did little to recover his strength, as the draining power took its toll.
Seeing Man Gu struggling, the group realized that the mountain was not easy to climb and their hearts echoed a sense of dread.
Someone spoke up somberly, "I remember hearing our Elder talk about a similar place. This Wenxin Mountain tests the sincerity of those seeking the Dao. The purer a person's heart and the stronger their will, the purer their seeking spirit.
Man Gu, being of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe and known for his straightforwardness, is finding it hard to climb, which likely means it's going to be even harder for us!"
"Will the Heart-Calming Mantra help calm our minds?" someone else suggested a strategy.
The third task only required them to reach the fiftieth step, it didn't stipulate that only the first few who made it would pass the task. They were not in competition at this point.
Everyone nodded in agreement, thinking it was a good idea. Many of them had been taught similar phrases at home to help them cultivate their character.
Lu Yang opened his mouth, he didn't know any Heart-Calming Mantra.
"Would you like me to teach you a Heart-Calming Mantra?" asked Meng Jingzhou.
Lu Yang shook his head: "Not now, I'm thinking of other methods."
Seeing this, Meng Jingzhou didn't force don the Heart-Calming Mantra on Lu Yang.
...
Meng Jingzhou woke from his meditative state feeling a sense of peace he had never felt before.
The Heart-Calming Mantra works!
Meng Jingzhou's meditative state lasted longer than most. By the time he woke up, the others were struggling between the twenty and thirty steps, drenched in sweat. They needed every bit of willpower they could muster to make their next move.
Large drops of sweat trickled down their faces, they didn't even have the energy to wipe them off.
Someone tried a different approach, thinking that the pressure only existed on the steps. They tried to climb from the sides of the mountain to reach the fiftieth step but soon discovered the pressure remained the same, with the entire Wenxin Mountain exerting more pressure the higher one went.
Others attempted to use their magic artifacts, only to find them rendered powerless, regardless of how extraordinary they usually were. Unable to activate them, their magic artifacts became nothing more than scraps of metal.
No wonder Dai Bufan wasn't worried about them using magic artifacts.
Lu Yang was the most noticeable as he lagged far behind everyone else.
He stood barefoot on the tenth step, deep in thought and holding a shoe in his hand. It was unclear as to what he was observing.
"What are you doing? Everyone else has climbed quite a distance." Meng Jingzhou asked curiously.
Lu Yang remained silent, holding a shoe in his hand.
Lu Yang threw the shoe onto the eleventh step: "Try picking it up."
Meng Jingzhou didn't understand Lu Yang's intention, but followed his instruction, soon realizing that the shoe felt heavier than usual. It was as if something was pulling it down.
Understanding dawned upon Meng Jingzhou. He threw the shoe onto the twelfth step and found that the speed of the shoe's fall was the same as it was on the eleventh step, but picking it up was even heavier.
"Did you notice any pattern?"
Meng Jingzhou furrowed his brow, "If an object doesn't make contact with the ground, it won't sense the pressure. Only when an object makes contact with the surface does it experience additional pressure?"
"Exactly." Lu Yang hit his palm with his fist, feeling unusually pleased to find someone with similar thoughts.
Meng Jingzhou thought carefully, his mind working quickly in his calmed state: "The steps are inclined, and there are so many trees here. We can build a '7' shaped ladder. One end of the ladder can be buried in the ground and the other end can reach the fiftieth step."
Lu Yang replied with certainty, "Yes, this third test should be testing our wisdom. This is the standard solution!"
Understanding Lu Yang's thoughts, Meng Jingzhou quickly came up with another question, "How are we going to chop down the trees?"
They didn't have axes or saws. How were they supposed to cut trees and make a ladder?
"Do you have any sharp magic artifacts on you?" Lu Yang had anticipated this question.
He had considered teaming up before, but unfortunately, the others couldn't understand his idea.
Meng Jingzhou took out a dagger, "This was given to me by the tribe's elder for self-defense. It can be mentally controlled and it's as fast as someone at the Golden Core Stage, but it can't fly here on Wenxin Mountain."
"That's fine. As long as it's sharp." Lu Yang smiled. The magic artifact forged by the Meng Family was superbly made; even if it lost its power here, its sharpness still surpassed any common axe or saw.
Perfect for cutting trees.
"Come look, I've designed a blueprint while you were meditating."
Lu Yang led Meng Jingzhou to a soft sandy area where Lu Yang's design blueprint was drawn - it was indeed a '7' shaped ladder.
After briefly discussing, the two set out to work.
As expected, the Meng Family's dagger was sharp. The large trees were like paper before it, and they were quickly reduced to oddly shaped planks by the two of them.
The trees that could grow here on Wenxin Mountain where cultivators had the same strength as ordinary people were naturally the most common kind.
Soon, Meng Jingzhou discovered another problem.
"How can we connect these two planks? Not to mention that we don't have nails, even if we did, we wouldn't be able to join such thick planks together."
"Have you heard of mortise and tenon joints?"
"No."
Lu Yang helplessly received the dagger from Meng Jingzhou and began to cut the planks into mortise and tenon joints while explaining to him about the wisdom of the mundane world.
"This protruding part is called the tenon, and this recessed part is called the mortise. Combined, they form a mortise and tenon joint. The biggest characteristic of a mortise and tenon joint is that even without using nails in an object, it's exceptionally sturdy."
Meng Jingzhou listened carefully. The Meng Family used spiritual energy to refine their artifacts, bypassing the need for mortise and tenon joints.
The group of climbers on the stairs was dripping sweat, gasping for breath, all for the mission of reaching the fiftieth step and being the first to pass the test.
They speculated that being the first to pass might earn them recognition and special attention from the Seek Dao Sect.
Everyone also began to understand why there was no time limit. Climbing was a significant drain on their physical strength. If they stayed for too long, they would be too hungry to stand, let alone climb.
Meanwhile, the pair working at the bottom of the stairs were also drenched in sweat and panting heavily. Having exerted much effort, cut down countless trees, and with numerous trial and error, they finally completed the ladder.
The ladder was oddly shaped, thicker at the bottom and thinner at the top, and also bent at the corner. It looked more like a gigantic number '7' rather than a ladder.
The surrounding area was bare, as if a huge wild boar had taken a bite out of it.
A disciple from the Seek Dao Sect threw a covert glance at Dai Bufan. They remembered how their Senior Brother Dai Bufan loved boasting about his lush Wenxin Mountain.
Dai Bufan's face twitched, his fist unconsciously clenching.

chapters.title: Chapter 7 - 6 Elder Brother Dai, please calm down_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou crouched on the ground, using daggers to dig a hole, burying the bottom of the ladder in the pit. Then they stepped on the ground to firm it up.
Lu Yang kicked the ladder, it remainedn unmoved and instead caused his right foot to numb.
"Good, it's sturdy. I'll go first, and if I succeed, you follow."
"No problem." Meng Jingzhou nodded.
Lu Yang rubbed his hands together, took two steps in one stride, climbing the ladder smoothly. Reaching the corner of the ladder, parallel to the fiftieth step, he muttered a curse.
Lu Yang forced himself to look straight ahead, not looking down, and moved forward like a caterpillar.
The crowd on the steps looked up to see Lu Yang progressively approaching the fiftieth step, their eyes wide open in astonishment.
What they saw was a giant ladder planted in the ground, bending at a ninety-degree angle at its end, the goal was the fiftieth step.
The crowd did see Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou making the ladder, but they didn't think much about it.
They were struggling to reach the fortieth step, concerned about what the two were planning; if it turned out to be nonsense, they didn't have the strength to come back to the fortieth step. Then they would totally fail this trial.
Man Gu, among them, progressed the fastest and had reached the forty-ninth step. But the fiftieth step was as insurmountable as a chasm, he felt like he was carrying a heavy mountain on his back, ready to crush him.
Then he watched with wide eyes as Lu Yang climbed past him, and reached the fiftieth step.
Lu Yang made it through without a hitch, successfully passing the trial.
Meng Jingzhou followed closely and also succeeded.
The first and second place have emerged.
...
At the same time, outside Wenxin Mountain, the disciples of Seek Dao Sect were causing havoc.
"Don't stop me, I must teach these two a lesson today, I promise, I won't beat them to death!" Dai Bufan was so angry that his muscles bulged like a bear that had its honey stolen.
The junior brothers and sisters rushed up to persuade:
"Elder Brother Dai, you mustn't fight!"
"Elder Brother Dai, you need to calm down."
"If anything happens to the ones participating in the trial, it will ruin the reputation of our Seek Dao Sect!"
"Bullying the weak will ruin your reputation, Elder Brother Dai!"
"Elder Brother Dai, don't forget, the third trial is a test of seeking the Dao's heart, you absolutely mustn't impulsively get angry!"
Hearing the last sentence, Dai Bufan calmed down.
Yes, the third trial is a test of seeking the Dao's heart. Such a hot temper was not conducive to future cultivation.
"... Wait, the third trial is for them, not me!"
The disciples of the Seek Dao Sect were in chaos again.
Seeing this, the River Spirit felt somewhat relieved and returned to the river, no longer seeking trouble with the two.
...
Perhaps Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou's successful cooperation and example inspired others. The participating disciples shouted and finally rushed to the fiftieth step.
Man Gu was the first one, followed by people Lu Yang didn't recognize. They were all behind Lu Yang. Lu Yang didn't know what their physical attributes were, and finally, the Dual Spirit Roots who Lu Yang had seen before.
Those who were left tried persistently but could not take a step forward. They wanted to descend the mountain and climb to the fiftieth step using the ladder made by Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou. Unfortunately, they had to endure a huge pressure to go down the mountain. Their bodies were no longer able to go up or down a single step.
"The third trial is over. Those who remain on the mountain are disqualified." Yun Zhi announced coldly, instructing Dai Bufan to bring the people down.
Wenxin Mountain's compulsion to keep people in place exceeded the abilities of ordinary people to remove, even Dai Bufan was incapable. To go to the mountain to fetch people, they must bear the pressure of Wenxin Mountain and climb step by step.
Dai Bufan glared at Lu Yang ferociously before scaling Wenxin Mountain.
He looked relaxed, climbing to the fiftieth step successively.
Those who had just passed the third trial watched as Dai Bufan eased his way up and then considered their own struggles to reach the fiftieth step, feeling a great disparity.
"There's nothing difficult to understand. You're only fourteen or fifteen years old. Even though your families have supported you to start practicing cultivation early, you're shadows on the water, flowers in the mirror, without real experience. You cannot understand what is the Dao, what is immortality."
"Cultivation requires mindfulness. When your cultivation is complete, climbing Wenxin Mountain will be no problem."
In the end, Yun Zhi added as if remembering something, "Congratulations on becoming disciples of the Seek Dao Sect."
Yun Zhi waved her hand, her bracelet jingled, and a mist rose and formed a cloud supporting everyone.
Lu Yang stood on the cloud, watching as the distance to the ground increased. He forced down his saliva, his heart in his throat.
Damn it. Cultivation is really exciting.
Yun Zhi stood on the cloud, speaking to the junior brothers and sisters below cleaning up, "You've worked hard today. After cleaning up, you can go back to your own matters."
The junior brothers and sisters all said in unison, "yes", then they counted one, two, three, dismantling and transporting the ladder made by Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
What is the meaning of placing a ladder on Wenxin Mountain?
Lu Yang on the cloud did not dare open his eyes. However, he heard others all sounding excitedly, praising the scenery. Unable to resist his curiosity, he also opened his eyes and was subsequently stunned by the sight before him, dumbstruck.
A mountain sat in the center of a range, it stood tall and straight, reaching the clouds. The cliffs on its four sides were steep and vertical, resembling an immortal sword. Eight mountains enveloped mysterious atmospheres protecting the center mountain, and layers of mountain ranges enclosed the core nine mountains.
The layers of mountains looked like a blooming lotus, breathtaking!
The mystical fog surrounding the nine mountains added a sense of mystery.
Yun Zhi calmly spoke, "The core of the Seek Dao Sect has nine peaks. The centermost peak is where the sect leader is located, called Sky Gate Mountain, and the other eight peaks belong to the Eight Elders. Each of them has their own specialties, resulting in these eight mountains each having different purposes."
"Besides these mountains, some are trial sites of the sect, some are extensions of the Elder's mountains, some are cultivation grounds for Seek Dao Sect disciples, and some are dangerous areas, where insufficient cultivation could mean death.… This cannot be fully explained in a few words, you can explore gradually later."
"Cultivation seeks fate. During the next month, you can move freely within Seek Dao Sect, visit mountains, go to the Scripture Pavilion, consult Elder Brothers and Elders."
"After a month, you have to choose an Elder to be your master, of course, the prerequisite is that the Elder agrees to take you as a disciple."
Man Gu asked without hesitation, "Can we only choose the Elders? Can we choose the Sect Leader?"
"Yes, but the Sect Leader usually doesn't like teaching disciples, your chances of success are slim."
Hearing Yun Zhi's words, many still wanted to be disciples of the Sect Leader.
The Seek Dao Sect is one of the Five Great Immortal Sects in the Central Continent. Its Sect Leader is superior and undoubtedly powerful, with few opponents in the Cultivation World. Being a disciple of such a high-level person brings countless benefits, both obvious and hidden.
"Later, someone will take you to your respective abodes."
"Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, you two stay behind."

chapters.title: Chapter 8 - 7 Humble Elders_1
chapters.content:
After everyone left, the two of them looked nervously at their feet, worried that Yun Zhi would question them about their attempt to cheat.
After a while, Yun Zhi finally spoke slowly.
"Unexpectedly, both of you passed the test and became disciples of my Seek Dao Sect."
"Both of you ranked high in the three tests, especially the third one where one of you came first and the other came second. Overall, your scores were the best."
"However, this does not mean that you two performed the best in this batch. For example, Man Gu from the Ancient Barbarian Tribe you've met, Tao Yaoye with Feather Transformation Immortal Body who ranked behind you, and Li Haoran with Fire Spirit Root are all geniuses no less exceptional than you."
Meng Jingzhou looked overly pleased with himself, winking at Lu Yang: "Feather Transformation Immortal Body is much rarer than Single Spiritual Root. However, our eldest senior sister's assessment was that he 'ranks behind us', which shows her high regard for us."
Lu Yang resignedly explained: "What the eldest senior sister probably meant was that the person with the Feather Transformation Immortal Body was behind us in line during the first test."
"Although your performance was good, you can't be complacent and arrogant. When you start your true cultivation, you must stay humble and diligent."
At the increasingly stern tone of their eldest senior sister, the two hastily pledged to be diligent and persistent in their future cultivation, vowing not to slack off.
Seeing that they were not just paying lip service, Yun Zhi's face softened a bit: "Since you two have helped me out, I'll give you each an opportunity."
"Meng Jingzhou, you have pure yang Spirit Root, abundant Qi and Blood, and you are the bane of ghosts and spirits. Of the eight Elders, the Third Elder is in deep harmony with this path, you can take him as your mentor."
Overjoyed, Meng Jingzhou quickly thanked her: "Thank you, eldest senior sister."
"Lu Yang, you have Sword Spirit Root, which makes you a natural seedling for swordsmanship. The best in our sect for swordsmanship is our master, who is also the Sect Leader. You should take him as your mentor."
"But sister, you just said that the Sect Leader does not like to instruct disciples..." Lu Yang said softly.
He noticed a difference in emphasis - while her advice to Meng Jingzhou was "you can take him as your mentor", for Lu Yang it was "you should take him as your mentor". The implication was not the same.
"No worries, the matter of acknowledging masters can be decided for him." Yun Zhi's casual tone took Lu Yang aback, as if even if the Sect Leader did not agree, he had to.
"I'm merely making a suggestion. Like all other disciples, you have a month of adjustment period. After a month, you can then decide which master you wish to acknowledge."
Having said this, Yun Zhi then flew towards Sky Gate Mountain, wherein resided the Sect Leader.
...
Sky Gate Mountain, council hall.
A gleaming Water Mirror was suspended in the air. Under a magical spell, the full process of the three trials could be clearly seen from any direction.
The eight figures in the hall expressed varying views about the disciples who passed the tests. They either nodded or shook their heads, praised or scolded. The debate became so heated that it looked as if they were about to come to blows.
Instances like this had happened before. Among the eight figures, several had strong characters and would resort to using magic when words failed them. What was supposed to be a simple evaluation of the younger generation turned into a major test of strength, an eye-opener for the whole Seek Dao Sect.
Considering this, the eight figures present were not in their true forms, so even if they became aggravated, a fight would not ensue.
"This young man, Man Gu, isn't bad; he has a pure lineage from the Ancient Barbarian Tribe and unparalleled brute strength. He's also straightforward, suitable as my successor."
"What a pity that he's too straightforward. The Ancient Barbarian Tribe was extinguished for the same reason. If there's a chance in the future, he should be cultivated with emphasis."
"What do you mean 'suitable as your successor'? It's been a long time since I've found a suitable successor for my art of Refining. Man Gu is focused in his work. It's only right that he becomes my disciple!"
The two elders were so engrossed in their dispute that they… pounded the table conditionally.
The other elders didn't pay attention to these two foolish old men. They continued their review: "Feather Transformation Immortal Body, impervious to all Dharma. Undefiled and unmatched. Ascending to immortality through Feather Transformation, it's been so long since we last saw one.
If you calculate the time, the last Feather Transformation Immortal body appeared when we had just entered the Seek Dao Sect."
"What a pity that the last one with Feather Transformation Immortal Body practiced too hastily. He perished without making a name for himself in the Central Continent, as he was overly eager to achieve perfect embodiment of his Immortal Body."
"Sixth Elder, among us, you are the most familiar with the Immortal Body, maybe this woman is fated to be your student."
"Li Haoran who has Fire Spirit Root and is ideally suited for refinement of pills, is a promising talent, but his temperament is too fiery and he can't calm down. In the third task, he exerted all his energy at the start, in the overzealous ambition to surpass Man Gu. He exhausted all his strength prematurely and fell behind as a result, eventually being the last one to complete the task."
"As for this young man from the Meng family and Lu Yang, one has a Pure Yang Spirit Root and the other a Sword Spirit Root. Each is one-of-a-kind, and their way of passing the test is ingenious and impressive. Good talents like these… Elder Brother, why don't you consider taking them in?"
"Indeed, indeed. You only have one disciple, Dai Bufan, who has already completed his training. There's no need for further instruction. Taking in two more talents now, won't it make a magnificent story when they succeed in the future?"
"Shut up, always avoiding the main point, with the way these two cleared the test, I won't have a peaceful life once I take them in. I just want to retire in peace and be an Elder, so don't make trouble for me!"
"Second Elder, why don't you take them in?"
"Do you want me to take you in first?"
None of the eight elders showed the slightest interest in taking in the two single Spiritual Root geniuses.
Damn it, whoever takes these two in, won't have a peaceful second half of life.
"Eh, look, Yun Zhi is suggesting to these two. One to be taken in by the Sect Leader and the other by the Third Elder?!"
All attention was focused on the Third Elder, who sighed as if resigned to his fate. Yun Zhi's suggestion was not wrong, he was most suitable for cultivating Pure Yang Spirit Root.
Among the eight figures, the Third Elder was the most imposing; a body full of taut muscles and overflowing vitality, he looked like a blazing torch in the dark, the typical Body Cultivator.
It was said that when he was young, his vitality was so overflowing that he could not control it. He would often run to the Spirit Field and chase away the cow demons, plowing the fields himself.
"Speaking of which, hasn't the Sect Leader been in seclusion for nine years now?"
"It seems so."
Everyone remembered that they actually had the position of Sect Leader. It seemed to make little difference whether they had one or not.
"So how should the one with Sword Spirit Root acknowledge his master?"
While they were talking, a beautiful figure flew in on a cloud. As the cloud dissipated, it revealed the figure of the Eldest Senior Sister.
"Yun Zhi pays her respects to all her uncles."
All of them quickly stood up to return the greeting. With the current Sect Leader in seclusion, Yun Zhi was acting on behalf of him, controlling all of the sect, her status was above the eight elders.
"Yun Zhi understands that all of our uncles have their preferred disciples. However, acknowledging a master is a matter of great Causality and can't be forced. I hope that you won't excessively interfere when they are choosing their masters."
The elders naturally understood this concept and laughed: "Of course, of course. However, is the one with Sword Spirit Root being accepted under the Sect Leader a decision made by the Sect Leader or by you…"
Speaking of the Sect Leader, Yun Zhi frowned slightly, she seemed a little unhappy and coldly replied: "Does it make a difference?"
The eight elders fell silent. Indeed, there was no difference.
Joking aside, would the Sect Leader dare to oppose any decisions you make?

chapters.title: Chapter 9 - 8: The Forbidden Book - "Dragon and Phoenix Changes" (Thanks to the lords who gave me a hug and a peaceful life reward)_1
chapters.content:
After Yun Zhi left, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou proceeded to check out their respective abodes like the other disciples.
Before doing so, Lu Yang had escorted Old Horse into the Seek Dao Sect with Meng Jingzhou.
Outside the Seek Dao Sect, Lu Yang saw several new fellow disciples happily informing their families of their acceptance. Whether from small clans or influential cultivation families, having a member accepted into the Seek Dao Sect was a matter worthy of being recorded in family history.
"Why didn't anyone from your family come?" Lu Yang asked, having gathered from Meng Jingzhou's remarks that the Meng Family was a well-established cultivation lineage.
Meng Jingzhou replied with some pride, "I ran away from home!"
Lu Yang: "..."
What's there to be proud of?
Once Meng Jingzhou had led Old Horse back to his abode, Lu Yang went back to his own.
He took out a jade pendant, a gift from a senior brother he had just met. It was a Seek Dao Sect membership badge, which could provide proof of his identity and grant him access to his abode.
The jade pendant, crafted from Spirit-Stone Marrow and inscribed with the name "Lu Yang", had functionalities that could only be used once Lu Yang formally became a cultivator.
Lu Yang placed the jade pendant on the stone wall of his abode's entrance. Emitting a faint blue light, the pendant corresponded to the socket at the entrance. After the socket flashed twice, the stone wall parted, unveiling a lavishly luxurious abode.
As soon as he stepped into the abode, he felt a pleasant warmth surging through his body, as if some miraculous energy was nourishing him.
"Is this the so-called spiritual energy?"
Upon realizing this, Lu Yang was surprised. The density of the spiritual energy in the abode was so high that even an ordinary person like him could sense it, showing it was remarkably unusual.
The abode was sparsely furnished with just a table, a cushion, and a straw mat. Despite the spacious abode, it felt rather empty, making him wonder if the Seek Dao Sect was encouraging disciples to live modestly or allowing them to decorate according to their preferences.
There was a paper on the table with words written on both sides.
The front suggested that disciples unfamiliar with cultivation should first go to the Teaching Peak to learn the basics or head to the Scripture Pavilion to study independently.
The back displayed a simplified map of the Seek Dao Sect, which occupied a hundred thousand miles, truly staggering and beyond Lu Yang's imagination.
The front message provided Lu Yang with a direction for the following month.
Yawning, Lu Yang decided to get some much-needed sleep.
From venturing out in the rain, passing three trials using sincerity and wisdom, gaining attention from Eldest Senior Sister Yun Zhi and Second Senior Brother Dai Bufan, to finally becoming a Seek Dao Sect disciple, the day's events had exhausted him. He was so sleepy that he could barely keep his eyes open.
"The Seek Dao Sect doesn't even provide a pillow..."
Lu Yang mumbled, succumbing to the day's fatigue and promptly falling asleep, regardless of his comfort level.
...
He rose early the next morning. His plan was to first visit the Scripture Pavilion and learn more about the Central Continent.
"Are you new here?" A senior brother at the entrance of the Scripture Pavilion looked up at Lu Yang.
"Yes."
"Since you're new, I will inform you of the Scripture Pavilion's rules. It's simple; there are only three rules."
"First, with your current status, you can only access books on the first floor. Feel free to browse whatever is available there. Second, you can only temporary borrow one book. And last, please take care of the books and refrain from dirtying them. If you do, you must compensate the original price of the damaged book."
"I will remember." Nodding, Lu Yang was granted access by the senior brother without another word.
Inside the Scripture Pavilion, disciples were engrossed in reading, undisturbed even when Lu Yang passed by.
The large pavilion was filled only with scattered footsteps and the rustling of pages.
There was a myriad of books available, ranging from rudimentary comedy scripts to secret cultivation mantras of cultivators, to insights on Qi Refinement and Foundation Establishment. It was all there.
Overwhelmed, Lu Yang didn't know where to start.
"What is this book?"
Chanced upon a dust-coated book hidden in a crevice of the shelf, Lu Yang wiped off the layers of dust to see the title clearly—it was "Dragon and Phoenix Changes".
"What a dominant name!"
Barely controlling his excitement, Lu Yang could sense an overwhelming aura just from the title itself!
In a moment of shock, he heard the cries of the dragon and phoenix and saw their specters emerge before his eyes. They then transformed, recreating the scene of the dragon and phoenix appearing.
Coming to his senses, Lu Yang looked around. The sounds and specters had vanished.
"Was that an illusion?"
Baffled, and yet somewhat exhilarated, Lu Yang carefully opened the first page.
Perhaps this could be his chance of a lifetime!
Unexpectedly, the sharp paper cut his finger, and a few drops of blood fell onto the page.
Seemingly in response, the ancient book started emitting a golden glow, as if something within was trying to break free!
His heart pounded in his chest, the unfolding events completely caught him off guard and were beyond his control. It was unclear if this was a blessing or a curse.
He even felt as though he was being watched by a powerful entity, freezing him on the spot!
The feeling became more apparent, implying that the powerful entity was getting closer.
In the end, the powerful being stood behind Lu Yang, silently observing him. The overwhelming presence caused him to break out in cold sweat.
"You..." Eventually, the powerful entity spoke.
"Yes!" Lu Yang shivered.
"You've dirtied the book."
The powerful entity furrowed his brows. Turning around, Lu Yang discovered it was the senior brother at the Scripture Pavilion's entrance.
The senior brother looked at the bloodstain on the book with disapproval, he had just reminded Lu Yang not to dirty the books, yet he had already spilled blood on one.
The Scripture Pavilion was protected by an array method. If a book was damaged, it would emit a golden glow as a signal to the protector.
"What kind of book is this? I've never seen it before."
The senior brother curiously picked up the book and skimmed through it, his face turned grave, "This... This is actually the forbidden book from the legends!"
Lu Yang felt a surge of joy, he did not expect to find a legendary forbidden book upon his first visit to the Scripture Pavilion. Now he was dying to know what secrets were contained inside.
"Senior Brother, is there a problem with this book?" Lu Yang asked, curious.
The senior brother pondered whether to divulge such important information to a newcomer. After thinking for a while, he decided to tell him the truth.
"This book chronicles the mating process of dragons and phoenixes in great detail. Because of this, it was complained against by both the Dragon and Phoenix tribes, and classified as a forbidden book. I thought all copies had been destroyed, I didn't realize we still had one here, no knowing who had hidden it!"
In other words, it was an adult book.
Lu Yang: "..."
Screw the dragon and phoenix union!
Then, he remembered that the senior brother mentioned if a book was damaged, it had to be compensated.

chapters.title: Chapter 10 - 9 Central Continent_1
chapters.content:
"Should I pay compensation?" Lu Yang asked nervously, his most valuable possession was probably his brain.
"Compensation?" The Senior Brother glanced at the book in his hand and then at Lu Yang, the corner of his eyes twitching fiercely.
According to the regulations, Spirit Stones should indeed be compensated, but the problem is that if this book gets out, the Dragon and Phoenix Tribes would join hands to march from the Demon Territory to the Central Continent, driving right up to Seek Dao Sect.
Even though Seek Dao Sect does not fear the Dragon and Phoenix Tribes, and dragon liver and phoenix marrow taste delicious, a source of nourishment for both Yin and Yang... But they were a reputable sect after all, and having a forbidden book like "Dragon and Phoenix Changes" in the Scripture Pavilion, would eventually tarnish their reputation.
Having thought about it, the Senior Brother discreetly tucked the book into his sleeve, maintaining a calm face.
"Compensation? What book did you damage? I didn't see anything."
Destroying a book in the Scripture Pavilion would be too conspicuous and could trigger the Array Method. It's better to destroy it outside.
Lu Yang instantly understood what was going on—his Senior Brother wanted to keep it for himself.
Thus, nothing happened just now.
Their eyes met, and a smile formed on the corners of their mouths, as if they truly understood each other's intentions.
The forbidden book was a minor incident; Lu Yang had not forgotten his purpose for coming to the Scripture Pavilion.
After searching for quite a while, he finally found the book he wanted that introduced the Central Continent - "Discussion on the Topography of the Continent".
Lu Yang rubbed his hands with excitement and started to read carefully.
"There are human, demon, ghost and other races in the world. The Central Continent is the gathering place for the human race. The greatest force on the continent is the Great Xia Dynasty, the only country in the Central Continent. It represents the orthodoxy of the human race."
"So, even though my home is near Seek Dao Sect, it still falls within the territory of the Great Xia Dynasty."
"To the east of the continent is a vast ocean with scattered islands dotted within. From time to time, ancient demon beasts like the Kun Peng and the primordial Chen appear."
"To the west of the continent is the Golden Buddha Kingdom, a boundless pure land filled with many temples."
"To the south of the continent is the demon territory of the Demon Race. The Dragon and Phoenix Tribes dominate the demon territory. The demons are cruel and bloodthirsty. The Great Xia Dynasty has frequent conflicts with the demon territory, and demons hidden within the Great Xia Dynasty pose a threat to the human race."
"To the north of the continent is the North Pole, where the ice does not melt, and nothing grows. There are few human traces, and other creatures seldom show themselves, only very powerful races live there."
"The Central Continent is the most populous place for humans, and there are also the most cultivators. Some cultivators choose to become officials, while more choose to start their sect or join one. Sects are all over the Central Continent, and the strongest among them are the Five Great Immortal Sects, including the Seek Dao Sect, which are leaders of the Righteous Path."
"The book also says that among the Five Great Immortal Sects, there must be a Great Power at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, or a means to rival a cultivator at that stage...Could it be that the Sect Leader is a Great Power at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage? Or do we have an Elder in Seek Dao Sect who remains hidden from the world?"
Realizing that he may have the good fortune to be under the leadership of a Great Power at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, Lu Yang felt a bit thrilled. He stood up and fetched a cup of water, taking a sip to suppress his excitement before sitting down and continuing to read.
"Demon Path cultivators are bloodthirsty, using the lives of spiritual beings to enhance their own cultivation level. They are even more harmful than the Demon Race. Demon Path cultivators are ultimately not up to the standard, hiding in the dark corners, under the joint suppression of the Great Xia Dynasty and the Five Great Immortal Sects.
They can only operate secretly and dare not show their faces."
Apart from Demon Path cultivators, the book also mentioned something called the Evil Demon, which was very vague. It said that Evil Demons are born without conscience, they are the shadow of the human race, beyond ordinary reasoning, they should be avoided when seen...it was all very profound, and Lu Yang couldn't quite figure out what an Evil Demon was.
"Ordinary people use gold, silver, and copper as currency, while cultivators use lower, middle, and higher-ranked Spirit Stones as currency."
Next, Lu Yang started to learn about the basic knowledge of the Cultivation World, such as the standards for dividing different realms, what kinds of skills are included in cultivation, the types of demon beasts, the levels of cultivation techniques, the history of the Central Continent, etc...
Based on what Lu Yang had heard from the storyteller in the teahouse, it was nowhere near enough for him to stand firm in the Cultivation World.
As Lu Yang looked at the mystical knowledge line by line, he couldn't help but get lost in it, roaming in the sea of knowledge until the evening, feeling hungry in his stomach, he realized that he hadn't eaten all day.
By now, the Senior Brother at the entrance to the Scripture Pavilion had been replaced by Senior Sister.
Lu Yang respectfully asked, "Excuse me, Senior Sister, I just arrived yesterday and I'm still unfamiliar with the Seek Dao Sect. Does our sect have a place to eat?"
The Senior Sister was startled by Lu Yang, she trembled slightly and avoided eye contact. She was very afraid to talk to people.
Generally, everyone was able to abide by the rules of the Scripture Pavilion, so there was no need to remind them, and her nature was well suited to this place.
She didn't dare to look Lu Yang in the eye, and spoke in a low, whispery voice, "So you're a new Junior Brother. The Seek Dao Sect does have a dining hall, but as an older student, I don't recommend you eating there."
Lu Yang was puzzled, "Why is that? Is there a problem with the dining hall?"
"It's on Fifth Elder's peak, Hundred Refinement Peak."
