Lu Yang was taken aback, this name didn't sound like a place to cook: "What is this Hundred Refinement Peak about..."
"Fifth Elder is good at refining, so, of course, Hundred Refinement Peak is for refining. The dining hall is located on Hundred Refinement Peak, and the cooks there are all top-notch refiners, their buns can pierce through mountains, the rice grains can be used as hidden weapons, and the fried dough sticks can even break steel bones."
Lu Yang didn't know where to start, "....why can a cook be a refiner?"
The Senior Sister timidly explained, "Think about it, Junior Brother, the most important thing for a cook is the temperature and timing, and a refiner is best at controlling that. The relationship between the two professions is closer than you think."
Lu Yang nodded earnestly, "It's indeed closer than I imagined."
The Senior Sister looked at Lu Yang's simple attire and hesitated for a moment, "Plus, purchasing weapons, oh, sorry, I meant eating in the dining hall requires spirit stones, and you don't seem to... be wealthy."
The clothing of a typical cultivator was not overly luxurious, but at least it was made from materials like sky silkworm thread and other common spiritual materials, which were impervious to water and fire.
Lu Yang's attire was plain, his clothes mended in spots with numerous patches of cloth that made it clear at first glance he was of ordinary origin.
Embarrassed, Lu Yang gave a wry smile. He indeed had no Spirit Stones.
"There's no need to be embarrassed. There are many disciples from ordinary origins in Seek Dao Sect." The Senior Sister whispered comfortingly.
"There's a way to get food… Um…You could go to Elixir Cauldron Peak and see if there are any discarded fasting elixirs there. You could ask them for some."
"Elixir Cauldron Peak has high standards for elixirs, and when they say 'discarded', it's really just that the quality isn't high enough. There's no need to worry about it being poisonous."
"But at Elixir Cauldron Peak, you must be careful of Seventh Elder, the peak elder, as well as Senior Brother Wu Ming, Senior Brother Wen Da, Senior Sister Qingkong, Junior Brother Long Yan…In short, be careful."
Lu Yang pushed aside his bewilderment and bowed his hand in salute, "My name is Lu Yang, thank you, Senior Sister. May I ask your name?"
"My name is Zhou LuLu."

chapters.title: Chapter 11 - 10: Even the Air Smells Sweet at Elixir Cauldron Peak_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang bid farewell to Zhou LuLu and arrived at Elixir Cauldron Peak. Just as he reached the foot of the mountain, he smelled a strong aroma of medicine.
"As expected of Elixir Cauldron Peak, even the air is full of fragrance. The rumored Cave Heaven and Immortal Mountain Islands couldn't be more so."
Lu Yang couldn't help but to take a few more deep breaths, feeling as if his body was floating, as if he was going to ascend to immortality.
"Junior Brother, don't breathe it in!"
A voice came from a short distance away, seeing Lu Yang taking more deep breaths, the person became more anxious.
"Junior Brother, quickly perform the Turtle Breath Technique. Eh, you seem to be a mortal, then quickly cover your nose. This smell is from poisonous gas I accidentally released while refining medicine..."
This was the last word Lu Yang heard before he fell unconscious.
"What a ghostly place, even the smell is poisonous..." Lu Yang muttered, feeling unsteady, as if the whole world started spinning, then the world went dark and he fell to the ground.
Facts proved that whether or not a smell is pleasant has no correlation to whether it is toxic.
When Lu Yang regained consciousness, he saw a big face in front of him and woke up with a jolt.
The person chuckled awkwardly, "Junior Brother Lu, you're awake, does it still hurt?"
Lu Yang's identity was written on a jade pendant.
Lu Yang blinked his eyes and felt a soreness all over his body, as if he had been rolled into a ball then flattened with a rolling pin.
This was a pill refining room. The smell of medicine was strong, and the temperature was much higher than outside. There was a large refining furnace in the middle of the room surrounded by shelves filled with bundles of herbs and white porcelain bottles, presumably containing successfully refined elixirs.
There were piles of drawings depicting the methods of refining elixirs and caged mice on the floor, unfamiliar people would have a hard time finding where to step.
There was only one bed in the refining room, which was the one Lu Yang was lying on.
"My name is Wu Ming. I'm sorry, Junior Brother. I was lost in my thoughts while refining a pill and lost control of the flame, turning the elixir into poison."
"But you don't need to worry. Although I often turn elixirs into poison by accident, I have never poisoned anyone to death before." Wu Ming said proudly.
...the more you say, the more worried I get.
Lu Yang struggled to sit up, moved his buttocks a bit, leaning against the intersection of the bed and the wall. It felt somewhat better this way.
Lu Yang felt an itch on his head, touched the back of it, remained silent for a moment before asking, "Since I only inhaled the poisonous gas, why is there a bandage on the back of my head?"
Wu Ming explained awkwardly, "I was carrying you and got distracted, causing your head to knock on the ground. But you don't need to worry too much, anyone alive can be cured on my Elixir Cauldron Peak!"
"The elixirs I have on hand are all too potent and not suitable for you to take. During the time you were unconscious, I specially refined some elixirs that even mortals can take." Wu Ming proudly presented Lu Yang with two pills.
The elixirs were golden and had three rings on them. Lu Yang knew these were elixir patterns, indicating that the refined elixir had reached nearly perfect quality.
Lu Yang still dared not eat them.
He just wanted to come to Elixir Cauldron Peak to ask for a few fasting elixirs, but ended up lying in bed with a bandaged head before he even got started.
If he dared to eat anything now, even Yama would probably compliment him for his recklessness.
"It's not poisonous, really." Wu Ming guaranteed again and again.
Seeing that Lu Yang didn't believe him, Wu Ming demonstrated using a mouse.
The mouse seemed to know that its end was near, and squeaked incessantly as Wu Ming picked it up, as if saying goodbye to its wife and children.
The mouse swallowed the elixir and fell down, lifeless. Its wife and children, seeing this, cried mournfully as if they were facing their future.
Lu Yang: "..."
Wu Ming: "..."
"It was an accident, all an accident. The mouse is small and can die from a little bit of poison. It definitely won't be the same for humans. I know where things went wrong, please wait, and I will refine another batch for you."
Lu Yang hurried to divert Wu Ming's attention, "Senior Brother, you said that you are always lost in thought, which leads to distraction. What problem are you thinking about?"
Wu Ming was indeed distracted, and began to sum up his thoughts, "Elixir, elixir, the emphasis is on the word 'medicine'. Naturally, elixirs are able to cure diseases and save people. But fasting elixirs are not meant to be taken by sick people, so why are they also considered elixirs?"
"If you say that fasting elixirs belong to elixirs, then elixirs are not only for curing diseases and saving people, but also for eating."
"If you say that fasting elixirs do not belong to elixirs, then what do fasting elixirs belong to?"
Lu Yang felt that unless he took out his brain and roasted it in a pill furnace for three days and three nights, it would be impossible to come up with this kind of problem.
"Speaking of fasting elixirs, the only thing I can give mortals here is the fasting elixir. We have strawberry, apple, and watermelon flavors. Do you want to try some? They are not poisonous." Wu Ming was offering a handful of colorful beans.
Lu Yang, remembering Yama's eager expectations, did not accept Wu Ming's gift. Several people were practicing refining fasting elixirs at Elixir Cauldron Peak; no matter who was refining them, they'd certainly be safer than the ones Wu Ming made.
"Junior Brother, if you need anything, remember to call me. It's free." Wu Ming enthusiastically bid goodbye when Lu Yang was leaving.
Lu Yang quickly hobbled away.
The next day, the Seventh Elder from the Elixir Cauldron Peak heard about Lu Yang's tragic experience and sent him the real healing elixir for mortals and a gourd of fasting elixirs.
Lu Yang recovered.
...
For the next month, Lu Yang lived a fulfilling life, rotating between the Scripture Pavilion, Teaching Peak, and Abode. Lu Yang eagerly absorbed the cultivation knowledge he had never encountered before, like a traveler in the desert seeing a spring, thirstily drinking it in.
A month later, everyone was granted their wish and became disciples of the various elders. Meng Jingzhou became a disciple of the Third Elder, Man Gu became a disciple of the Fourth Elder, Li Haoran with his Fire Spirit Root became a disciple of the Fifth Elder, and Tao Yaoye with her Feather Transformation Immortal Body became a disciple of the Sixth Elder...
This surprised Lu Yang. He thought that Man Gu would become a disciple of the Third Elder like Meng Jingzhou. The Third Elder was a renowned Body Cultivator in the Cultivation World who no one dared to grapple with. As someone of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe lineage, Man Gu was most suitable to be taught by the Third Elder.
In contrast, the Fourth Elder was a Confucian Cultivator, knowledgeable and not known for his strength. It was unclear why Man Gu chose the Fourth Elder as his master.
The Fifth Elder was adept at refining tools, so it was suitable for Li Haoran with his Fire Spirit Root.
Lu Yang had never met the Sixth Elder, but he heard that she was a breathtakingly beautiful woman, with an Immortal Body similar to Tao Yaoye's.
Man Gu becoming the disciple of the Fourth Elder wasn't the most notable. The most notable was Lu Yang himself, who had become a disciple of the mysterious Sect Leader.
It was said that the Sect Leader had not taken in any disciples for over a hundred years, living a carefree life. The disciples were all talking, wondering why the Sect Leader, who was still in seclusion, had accepted Lu Yang as a disciple.
Under the envious gaze of everyone, Lu Yang was led to Sky Gate Mountain, where the Sect Leader resided, by his Eldest Senior Sister Yun Zhi.

chapters.title: Chapter 12 - 11: Learning from the Master_1
chapters.content:
At the peak of the Sky Gate Mountain, within the Primordial Palace, Lu Yang stood upright, respectfully awaiting the arrival of his master.
The interior of the Primordial Palace was cold and silent, dust-free with wisps of rising smoke calming one's spirit.
Lu Yang noticed that three plaques were enshrined inside the hall, belonging to Daoist Xiantian, Celestial Master Guiyuan, and Vast Sea Daoist Lord respectively.
These three were familiar to Lu Yang, they hold an exceptionally special significance within the Seek Dao Sect:
Twelve hundred thousand years ago, Daoist Xiantian, who emerged from a Taoist temple, established the Seek Dao Sect. At that time, he was just an ordinary cultivator. There were thousands like him in the Central Continent. Therefore, the Seek Dao Sect initially only existed as a minor sect.
A hundred thousand years ago, during the times of great chaos, the Seek Dao Sect produced an extraordinary genius. Although he didn't rank in the top fifty in terms of natural talent for cultivation, he was intelligent, good at making friends, and possessed a hefty dose of righteousness. Moreover, he was blessed with fortune.
He rose during the chaotic era, riding the trend of the times, standing at the forefront of the era, unmatched in his brilliance and cultivation. He was known as Celestial Master Guiyuan.
The Seek Dao Sect flourished under the Celestial Master Guiyuan, and became one of the top sects at that time. On the occasion of the twenty-thousand-year celebration of the Seek Dao Sect, many close friends came to congratulate.
He seized this opportunity, jointly with four other supreme cultivators of that time, to confirm the appellation of the "Five Great Immortal Sects" and gained worldwide recognition.
However, nothing in the world is everlasting and always glorious. Fifty thousand years later, the Seek Dao Sect declined. The elder members were either nearing the end of their lives or died unexpectedly. Few could support the situation, and none of the disciples were promising.
They were at a loss, ironically facing the embarrassing situation where they were rumored to be expelled from the Five Great Immortal Sects.
Perhaps the Seek Dao Sect truly possessed good fortune. One day, an elder member of the Seek Dao Sect was exterminating a demon outdoors when they rescued a child from ruins. They brought the child back to the sect, and thereafter were astounded to discover that the child was a rare cultivating genius.
Conforming to expectations, the child rapidly advanced in cultivation, becoming the most powerful Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivator of the time within a few short years.
That child was known as Vast Sea Daoist Lord, later referred to by the people of the posterity as the revivalist of the Seek Dao Sect. He prolonged the glory of the Seek Dao Sect by fifty thousand years, stretching on until this very day.
"Eldest Senior Sister, where's our master?" Lu Yang turned around. He had been waiting in the hall for a considerable amount time, but no one showed up except Eldest Senior Sister.
"Master is currently in seclusion, cultivating during a crucial period and cannot separate himself. I'm acting on his behalf to accept you as a disciple and instruct you in cultivation."
"Before starting formal cultivation, I'll give you a brief introduction to our sect. There are very few rules set by our master. As long as you don't go too far against morals and ethical standards, causing disaster to both heaven and earth, he won't intervene."
"However, my bottom line is higher than his. What he won't manage, I will."
"Master has four disciples, including you and me. Above you, there's one senior brother and one senior sister. One of them usually stays in the Western Buddha Country, the other in the Southern Demon Realm. They hardly ever come back to the sect, making it challenging to meet them."
"You may have the opportunity to see them when your cultivation has achieved considerable progress and you have had the chance to travel around. For now..." Yun Zhi paused for a moment, taking out three portrait scrolls, arranging them side by side. They were Lu Yang's yet-to-meet master, second senior brother, and third senior sister.
The three people depicted in the portraits were smiling brightly.
The master, with white hair and clear eyes, did not appear as muddled like other old people. He seemed like a free and uninhibited individual who fancied games and worldly life.
The second senior brother had a gentle smile, his dashing facial features sparkling and elegant.
The third senior sister was charming in countless ways, an exceedingly beautiful woman that could bring calamity to a nation.
"Master specifically instructed me that the sect has five of us in total including you. As there are only two of us present at your initiation ceremony, Master has prepared these portraits to represent their presence."
Lu Yang glanced at Eldest Senior Sister and then at the vivid black-and-white portraits around him, which seemed to be watching him. He couldn't help but feel a chill run down his spine.
It was as if the whole sect was destroyed, leaving only him and Eldest Senior Sister.
Three sticks of incense appeared in front of Lu Yang. Yun Zhi handed them over, "These are Message Incense sticks. They can transmit your thoughts. Offering three sticks to the master conveys your gratitude and respect."
The three incense sticks were lit and inserted into the small incense burner in front of the master's portrait, "Under the witness of the Ancestors and with Master above, please accept your disciple's salute."
Now it felt more appropriate than ever.
After finishing the ceremony of becoming a disciple, Lu Yang asked with hesitation, "Eldest Senior Sister, I know it's a bit disrespectful to ask but, our master is really still alive, right?"
Lu Yang was afraid that Yun Zhi would sneer and say something like, "The master has fallen, and the top brass have been keeping it under wraps. I can't keep you around now that you know this secret."
Yun Zhi was utterly confused, not understanding why Lu Yang would ask such a question.
"Obviously, he is alive."
"I've looked at your exam grades from the Teaching Peak. You've memorized the locations of the human body's acupoints and meridians quite accurately, and you can recite and write the basic heart methods. That's quite remarkable. Your enthusiasm for learning deserves praise."
"Now let's start with the formal cultivation."
Upon hearing this, Lu Yang's face showed a look of real excitement and he listened more carefully.
He could finally begin cultivation.
As the official cultivation began, Eldest Senior Sister started, "This is my first time teaching a disciple, and this is your first time being a disciple. Let's bear with each other."
"But don't worry, I've made sufficient preparations for today."
Yun Zhi carefully lined up various small medicine jars, each labelled with the name of an elixir. Lu Yang had heard about some of them:
The White Bone Pill that can bring one back from the brink of life and death.
The Seven-Level Buddha Pill, one of the objects created by the Buddha Country to accumulate merits. Everyone who took the Seven-Level Buddha Pill gave a share of their merit to the Buddha Country.
The Nine Revolutions Reincarnation Pill. There's a saying in the cultivation world that one can exchange nine deaths for a new life with this pill.
With these elixirs, it would be challenging for Lu Yang to die even if he wanted to.
"Body refinement comes before Qi refinement in cultivation. Since you've never experienced body refinement training, we shall start from zero."
Yun Zhi casually broke through the space to take out two big water tanks from her storage space. Listening to the dull sound of the water tanks hitting the ground, Lu Yang's heart sank, sensing a foreboding sign.
"Sword cultivation emphasizes sword intent and arm strength. Therefore, the first step in body refinement is to focus on the training of arm strength. I will demonstrate only once, you observe carefully."
Yun Zhi stepped on the edge of the water tank as if it was flat ground. Then she caught the edge of another water tank with one hand and slightly lifted it. She let go of it before it land and repeated the process with her other hand. She repeated the process smoothly, making the training process pleasing to the eye.
If you don't consider the feelings of your arm, this method indeed can train one's arm strength.
"It's enough once you're able to reach this level."
Having put down the water tank, Yun Zhi spoke lightly.
Lu Yang swallowed fearfully. Even without lifting it, it was clear that the water tank was half his height. If he were to fit into the tank, it was big enough to bury him with sand and soil.
Such a gigantic tank was to be tossed and turned? This seemed like a death wish.
Lu Yang bravely latched on one hand, holding his breath, and made all his moves in one go.
He couldn't lift it.
He exerted force with both hands, then, using all his might, the water tank merely wobbled reluctantly, as if acknowledging Lu Yang's efforts.

chapters.title: Chapter 13 - 12 Lifting Heavily as if Lightly, Lifting Lightly as if Heavily_1
chapters.content:
This water vat alone weighs at least 440 pounds! No matter how much he, Lu Yang, enjoyed playing in the mountains as a child, climbing trees and diving into rivers, hunting birds and catching fish, he could not lift such a heavy vat.
With a casual wave, Yun Zhi drew a talisman on the vat and it became much lighter, just enough for Lu Yang to lift it with one hand.
She took out a puppet to supervise Lu Yang.
"Let's see how it goes after carrying it for a day."
Yun Zhi left behind these indifferent words and disappeared into the clouds. Lu Yang and the puppet stared at each other before he sighed, tied his shirt around his waist, and began the torturous task of carrying the vat.
The puppet supervised him, making him continue to carry the vat after each short rest, exploiting every ounce of his strength.
When his arms were so tired they could not move, the puppet would feed him two Great Restoration Pills. When the pain in his arms was unbearable, the puppet would feed him two more pills. When Lu Yang was too tired and wanted to sleep, the puppet would again feed him two pills...
By the end of the day, Lu Yang was trembling, his arms limp, utterly unable to sense his arms anymore. If he swayed his body to the left, his left arm swung like a pendulum, if he swayed to the right, his right arm swung in the same way, and then he collapsed on the ground with a thud.
As usual, the puppet fed him two Great Restoration Pills. Seeing that Lu Yang showed no reaction, it ended the day's training and arranged a cart to take Lu Yang back, even covering him with a straw mat.
Smelling the delicious aroma of food, Lu Yang started drooling, and his consciousness gradually returned.
Finally able to eat, Lu Yang sighed in relief. If he hadn't been able to eat, he would have thought himself not an apprentice of a cultivation sect, but a criminal whose major crimes could not be pardoned and imprisoned in a dungeon.
As an apprentice of the Sect Leader, he did not need to worry about food. Instead of taking fasting pills every day, Yun Zhi prepared various dishes made from rare ingredients he did not recognize, subtly improving his body.
Lu Yang still couldn't lift his arms, the puppet had to feed him.
After dinner, Yun Zhi made a large pot of body-refining concoction for Lu Yang to bathe in. The smell of spiritual herbs in the air almost made Lu Yang faint.
"Take this." Yun Zhi handed Lu Yang a hollow reed.
"What is this?"
"You need to immerse your whole body in the body-refining concoction when you bathe. Your head will obviously stick out, so when you're ready, dip your head in and breathe through this reed."
Lu Yang felt that it really was just like Eldest Senior Sister to think of everything. Although she was torturing him, it was for his own good.
After Yun Zhi left, Lu Yang stripped naked, bit down on the reed, and jumped into the tub with a splash, instantly releasing a scream that resembled a pig being butchered.
"Eldest Senior Sister, are you bathing with boiling water?"
…
Yun Zhi arrived at the courtyard where a cool breeze blew, dispersing the smell of the medicinal bath lingering on her. She started to consider what else she hadn't thought about.
She grew up in a Cave Heaven occupied by cultivators, and later joined the Seek Dao Sect to focus on cultivation, seldomly interacting with ordinary people, so she knew little about them.
For the sake of teaching Lu Yang, she purposely found many books describing ordinary people's lives. While Lu Yang was learning about cultivation, she was learning about the lives of ordinary people.
However, it was clear that the books describing ordinary people did not include the temperature of their bath water.
Hearing Lu Yang's hoarse screams, Yun Zhi thought for a moment. It was too late to cool the water now, so the only option was...
Yun Zhi took out a bottle of burn ointment from her sleeve and placed it by the door, then knocked on the door.
"Junior Brother, I left the burn ointment at the door, remember to use it."
…
After some time, with the relentless cultivation exercises, the special medicinal baths, and eating spirit beast meat, Lu Yang had transformed from an ordinary person to an outstanding artist skilled at juggling vats.
Lu Yang juggled three vats, each weighing 440 pounds, as easily as if they were sandbags, forming an arc in the air.
At the same time, he was able to walk around the rim of the vat in Eight Diagrams steps as easily as if he was walking on flat ground.
Even when he tipped a vat over and steadied himself on the rolling vat, he was as stable as a mountain and had enough strength left to juggle three more vats!
With this skill alone, he could attract cheers on any street!
"Not bad, your body refinement progress is faster than I expected." Yun Zhi gave a light clap, greatly boosting Lu Yang's confidence.
Though Yun Zhi wasn't often seen, she had been keeping an eye on Lu Yang's progress.
"Can I start cultivating now?" Lu Yang put the vat down and asked excitedly, waiting for the result without breathing hard.
During his body refinement period, Meng Jingzhou came to see him, but the puppet chased him away after a few words.
He heard that those in his cohort like Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu had already started channeling Qi into their bodies, became real cultivators and meditated every day, detached from the world, while he was still stuck in the hard process of body-refinement. This caused him some anxiety, feeling like he was lagging far behind, and the psychological gap was huge.
Yun Zhi didn't answer, pulling out a piece of tofu from her storage space. The tofu was extremely soft, trembling in Yun Zhi's fair hand as if it was a water-filled balloon.
"Turn your palm down and grab it."
Lu Yang didn't think this should be hard and obediently followed her instruction, gripping the tofu. However, his finger slightly moved and the tofu crumbled, dropping to the ground.
Yun Zhi gave Lu Yang another piece of tofu, signaling him to continue.
Lu Yang refused to accept his failure, thinking the first time was an accident and that he shouldn't make the same mistake the second time.
Yet the tofu crumbled again, impossible to hold.
After failing for the third time, Lu Yang realized the problem–his current strength was too great and naturally hard to control. The things around him were all tools for cultivators; if replaced with ordinary items, he would have to eat very carefully to avoid accidentally breaking his chopsticks or his bowl.
Moreover, his strength had grown too quickly, and his mind hadn't caught up with his body yet. His fingers spasming from time to time underscored this issue.
Given these conditions, it was not going to be easy to hold something as soft as tofu.
Yun Zhi didn't give Lu Yang any more tofu. Instead, with her palm down, she held the tofu and shook it casually. The tofu trembled but did not break apart.
Suddenly, Yun Zhi released her hand, and as the tofu fell, she quickly grabbed it once more!
Lu Yang's eyes widened. Catching the falling tofu? How could it be easy?
Under Eldest Senior Sister's control, the soft tofu was as malleable as iron, easily manipulated.
"You have mastered lifting a heavy weight as though it were light, but you are a long way from lifting light weights as though they were heavy."
Lu Yang fell silent, knowing that he still had a long way to go in refining his body. The process of cultivation cannot be rushed. Meng Jingzhou and the others have been trained since childhood, enabling them to start cultivating directly.
Catching up with them would not be easy.
He had nobody to coach him as a child, but now, under Eldest Senior Sister's personal guidance, and supported by the best resources, his progress was amazing. He had no reason not to be satisfied.
Lu Yang remembered what Eldest Senior Sister told him: cultivation is a lifelong process, and temporary advantages or disadvantages didn't matter. What mattered the most was who could persevere until the end.
Lu Yang took a deep breath, realizing that his previous mindset was wrong. He readjusted his mindset by not focusing solely on his cultivation progress.
Then he saw Eldest Senior Sister instruct the puppet to push over a cart full of tofu.

chapters.title: Chapter 14 - 13 Inhale Air into Body_1
chapters.content:
Unlike training strength, where he could consume Spirit Beast meat to boost his power or soak in a medicinal bath to invigorate his physique, training control had to depend solely on himself.
This process required intense focus and care. As Eldest Senior Sister would say, "Find the right feel. Use your body to control your power, not just your mind (Lingtai)."
What Lu Yang had to do was to naturally grab the tofu without conscious effort.
At the end of a day, Lu Yang was soaked with the smell of tofu, his eyes strained nearly to pulleyed due to focusing on the tofu for too long.
Luckily, the puppet was experienced and with a couple of slaps, Lu Yang's eyes returned to normal.
When meal time came, Lu Yang silently looked at the table full of tofu dishes.
Stir-fried tofu, deep-fried tofu, steamed tofu, tofu pudding, tofu cooked in soy milk...
All the ingredients were tofu that Lu Yang had crumbled during the day. According to what he heard, the tofu pudding and the soy milk were kindly donated by a local shop.
Lu Yang silently thanked his ancestors.
Lu Yang knew that until he could fully control his strength, he would not be able to change his diet.
In other words, either he or the tofu certainly wouldn't survive the process.
Tofu in itself is not a common meal. Consuming it over a long term can help Cultivators balance the Five Elements within their bodies, prolong their stamina during battles, and offer countless other benefits.
But no one can bear eating tofu day in and day out.
Having no other choice, Lu Yang buried his head in his meal, contemplating how he could better control his strength the next day.
...
The sleeping Lu Yang felt a glaring white light shining on his face, causing his eyelids to tighten, and his face to twist. Slowly adjusting to the strong light, he tried to open up his eyes.
This was an immaculate space surrounded by a dense mist, only a small area around Lu Yang was clearly visible, and he could not find a light source.
"Where is this?" Lu Yang was somewhat panicked. He had been sleeping in the Seek Dao Sect with countless masters around him, with his Eldest Senior Sister next door. Who could quietly move him to this mysterious space?
Who was friend or foe?
A majestic voice boomed out from the mist, resonating like an ancient echo sweeping across the river of time.
"Young man, this is a space temporarily constructed by me. No one can perceive it," the voice said.
Lu Yang shivered. The owner of the voice possessed an unthinkable level of skill, so he could only hope that they held no malintent towards him.
"I have witnessed the passage of countless epochs, seen numerous Great Powers dominate the world with their Cultivation Levels. Yet in the end, none can escape the erosion of time. Passionate ambitions battling heaven and earth eventually dissolve into sighs drawn at their deathbeds."
"Regardless of their extraordinary talents, I lead a free and easy life, eternally existent." The voice bore traces of weariness, sounding ancient and hoarse, with a faint hint of the desolation of countless years.
The existence of this great being was more than Lu Yang could comprehend.
"Today, I've had a whim and divination revealed that you and I are fated. So I've summoned your soul to this temporary space of inheritance."
"In this space, every resource you would need from the Qi Refinement Stage to the Transcendence Tribulation Stage - techniques, elixirs, secret books, cultivation experiences...you name it, we have it. With every stage you reach, you can unlock a part of my legacy."
Lu Yang took a sigh of relief; it seemed that the speaker was benevolent. He respectfully asked, "Who are you, senior?"
The senior let out three hearty laughs and walked out from the dense mist.
The senior had a clean face and a fair complexion, and his head was square—it was a block of tofu.
The tofu senior approached Lu Yang, speaking faster, "I am the Heavenly Sovereign of Tofu. What you see here is the culmination of my lifelong knowledge. The more tofu you eat, the faster your Cultivation Level will advance. Your foundation will be solid, and challenging those above your level, getting adored left and right, and reaching the peak of the continent will not be a problem..."
Lu Yang woke up with a start, drenched in a cold sweat. He rose from the bed, looking around in pitch darkness interrupted only by an eerie silence. That's when he let out a sigh of relief .
"It was just a dream, thankfully it was a dream."
Lu Yang noticed a chill running down his spine and he shivered, still anxious.
...
Yun Zhi slowly opened her eyes, a blue beam retreating from Lu Yang's room back to her fingertip.
"This should motivate him to cultivate harder," Yun Zhi murmured.
Her Master had once instructed her that pressure, when applied appropriately, could become a driving force and make people strive harder.
Yun Zhi herself was a perfect example. Therefore, she believed in her Master's words and used a dreaming magic skill to apply a slight pressure on Lu Yang.
"I must admit, some of the lines provided by the Eighth Elder were pretty embarrassing, it's a wonder how he managed to say them."
Yun Zhi always sought guidance from others, all the steps and lines in the dream were written by the Eighth Elder, who guaranteed that it would definitely work.
...
After some time passed, Yun Zhi saw Lu Yang easily gripping the tofu, tossing it high into the air, and catching it with ease. He started to use the tofu like a beanbag, tossing it back and forth with the puppet.
The soft tofu felt like a part of his body, controlled at will.
"You've done well, making the heavy feel light. You're done with this stage," she announced.
Lu Yang smiled. He was no longer who he was before. As he constantly practiced gripping tofu, his restless heart also began to calm.
He was able to achieve it without any mantra or incantation.
"What should I train next?"
Lu Yang was no longer concerned about progressing at the same pace as the others. He trusted that Eldest Senior Sister had a purpose for his current training plan.
Yun Zhi allowed a rare smile to spread on her face: "To consolidate your accompaniment in the Chi Refinement stage."
Lu Yang pointed to himself, dumbfounded, "Chi Refinement stage? Me?"
He had no idea when he had entered the Chi Refinement stage. Wasn't it mentioned in the books that there had to be a guide for one to guide the Chi into the body? A guide to cultivating, shutting off one's five senses, and smooth-running one's meridians was meant to facilitate success?
If one lacked natural proficiency, supposed elixirs were to be used as aids.
None of these prerequisites had been met by him so far.
The Master had never instructed him on how to guide Chi into his body, nor had any esoteric cultivation techniques been handed down. He hadn't "closed off" his five senses and turned to a mystical sixth sense, as far as the meridians were concerned, he could hardly recall their arrangement straight.
While members of the Seek Dao Sect didn't need to rely on elixirs to guide Chi into their bodies - all of them were one in a thousand talents. If they needed elixirs to even enter the Qi Refinement stage, they might as well leave Seek Dao Sect.
Lu Yang believed that he would not need the elixirs too, but the question was: how did he make it to the Qi Refinement stage?
"Three mornings ago," the Eldest Senior Sister hinted.
Lu Yang recalled that morning three days ago.
He had woken up early that day, facing the morning sun, with his eyes closed, contemplating how exactly to grasp the tofu.
As he delved deeper into his thoughts, he gradually lost his perception of the outside world. He felt as if he had transformed into an upwardly ascending purified Chi, wandering between heaven and earth. As he sank back into consciousness and returned to his body, he felt as if a lightbulb went off in his head, and a warm current started to flow through his Dantian.
And that's when he first managed to grasp a block of tofu.
Although he remembered that the Eldest Senior Sister was not present during his tofu practice, he realized now that she had been observing him all the while from a place unbeknownst to him.
"So, that feeling was probably the guiding of Chi into the body," Lu Yang muttered to himself, lost in thought.
That feeling was truly unique–like being amidst the clouds, embracing a warmth, a feeling so comfortable that he didn't want to open his eyes.
Before he knew it, he had fulfilled his small wish, guided Chi into his body, and become a Qi Refinement Cultivator.

chapters.title: Chapter 15 - 14 Elder Sister Said It's Right_1
chapters.content:
In the Cultivation World, 99 percent of cultivators are at the Qi Refinement stage, so there is a habit among cultivators to divide the Qi Refinement stage into nine levels, and only afterwards do the realms include three sublevels.
However, for the Seek Dao Sect, it is different. Qi Refinement is simply the threshold for entry, so why bother subdividing it?
The Seek Dao Sect only has the Qi Refinement stage, without any sublevels.
"Do other people also cultivate in this way, guiding the Qi into the body?"
Lu Yang was curious. If everyone else was cultivating in this manner, why was his progress the slowest?
Yun Zhi shook her head, "What you are practicing is the most primitive way of cultivation of the ancient ancestors. They resonated with nature, united heaven and man, guided Spiritual Energy into their bodies, and instantly became cultivators."
The initial cultivation did not require the guidance of predecessors or the existence of cultivation techniques. What was needed was only constant enlightenment and the trial and error of the body itself.
"As for the meridians, during the medicinal bath, your meridians have been completely opened, allowing Spiritual Energy to flow smoothly. Under your state of unity of heaven and man, Spiritual Energy moves according to your feelings. This route is the best for you, superior to any level of cultivation technique."
The Cultivation World tends to categorize cultivation techniques into five levels: Yellow, Mysterious, Earth, Heaven, and Immortal. But for Yun Zhi, there were only two kinds of cultivation techniques — those suitable for her and those unsuitable for her.
"Any cultivation technique was not specifically designed for you when it was first created. There are many techniques suitable for those with the Sword Spirit Root, I even have a box full of them, but none of them are suitable for you."
"Starting today, I am assigning you a long-term task: to create your own cultivation technique."
When Yun Zhi said to create a cultivation technique, she naturally did not mean for Lu Yang to explore on his own. She would guide him, but even so, one can imagine the difficulty of this task.
Creating a cultivation technique was something that only the old veterans in the Cultivation World could do.
Lu Yang twisted his mouth in discomfort, "To create a cultivation technique, those predecessors, their status is high, and they have a thorough understanding of all realms. They are qualified to create cultivation techniques. Me, who just started to guide Qi into my body, to create a cultivation technique is a bit... "
Yun Zhi interrupted Lu Yang's complaint, "Creating a cultivation technique is not as difficult as you might think."
"Do you know that the Seek Dao Sect has a rule? After the Foundation Establishment stage, each disciple must complete the tasks released by the Task Hall to fulfill their duties on the Righteous Path."
Lu Yang nodded, he had heard of it.
Other sects also have similar mechanisms, requiring their disciples to complete tasks because the sects don't tolerate idleness. To prove your worth, you must contribute to the sect.
However, the Five Great Immortal Sects were different: they asked their disciples to release tasks, not to contribute to the sect, but to contribute to the Righteous Path.
The Five Great Immortal Sects leading the Righteous Path was not just empty talk.
"Generally, the tasks require going down the mountain to eliminate demons and expel ghosts, among other things. I don't like the worldly troubles, so I chose another way to complete the tasks."
"What is it?"
"Task Hall has a standing task: to back up a cultivation method not previously recorded by the Seek Dao Sect. This is also considered as completing a task."
"Then, Eldest Senior Sister, you..." Lu Yang has a bold and somewhat ridiculous idea.
"So, in order to... complete the task, I created many cultivation techniques and tricked them into thinking that I found them in the Relic Blessed Cave."
"Unfortunately, I was found out later."
"How were you found out?" Lu Yang asked further.
"Because according to the tasks I reported, I have been all over the Relic Blessed Cave, and I did not know which one to make up next."
"So, you see, creating a cultivation technique is not difficult."
Yun Zhi gave her own experience as an example, with good reasoning, convincing Lu Yang.
Lu Yang opened his mouth, wanting to say "Eldest Senior Sister, I thought you were honest, but I didn't expect you to lie," "Eldest Senior Sister, your intelligence does not match us," and "What you call creating a cultivation technique could be called random concoction on my part."
Lu Yang looked into Yun Zhi's indifferent eyes and all his words were reduced to one sentence.
"Eldest Senior Sister is right."
"Although you have become a cultivator, you are still far from being a qualified sword cultivator. Here's a book for you."
The Eldest Senior Sister handed over an ancient book, which was made from the skin of an unknown demon beast. It was large, thick, and heavy.
"'Monster Field Chronicles'?" Lu Yang opened the ancient book, feeling a sudden chill. Various demon beast images jumped off the pages, and he could even faintly hear the roars of the demon beasts.
This book must be priceless!
Lu Yang pondered as he turned the pages. Swordsmanship requires sword intent. He just started Qi Refinement, so how could he cultivate sword intent?
He had heard that ancient swordsmen gained their initial sword intent in bloody battles with demon beasts, in the struggle between life and death, and while directly coping with the ferocious intent of the demon beasts.
So the answer seemed clear: he had to envision the images of demon beasts, comprehend their ferocity, take the essence and discard the dross, and by incorporating thousands of demon beasts into a single point, he would gain his unique sword intent.
Even though this methodology was challenging, it was perfectly suited for someone with the Sword Spirit Root like himself.
He could also see Eldest Senior Sister's deep expectations for him.
"I understand," Lu Yang said, understanding the implications of Eldest Senior Sister.
Yun Zhi glanced at Lu Yang, she had no idea what he had understood. She gestured, and the puppet brought another cart of tofu.
"As long as you understand."
"To become a sword cultivator, you need precision. Take this Green Peak Sword. The next thing you need to do is to use the tip of the sword to carve the tofu into the shape of a demon beast. The shapes of the demon beasts are all in the book."
Yun Zhi took out a sharp sword from her storage space, its blade glinting coldly. The words "Green Peak" were engraved on the hilt.
Lu Yang: "..."
Tofu again?
Perhaps that nightmare he had was actually a premonition, hinting at his future title as Tofu Celestial?
Damn, he couldn't afford to think like that.
Lu Yang quickly banished this terrifying thought from his mind.
As he took the Green Peak Sword, he felt that it was very lightweight.
In fact, it was not that the Green Peak Sword was too light, but rather the opposite. The Green Peak Sword was definitely not designed for cultivators in the first three levels of Qi Refinement. The sword was too heavy, and they wouldn't be able to lift it.
But Lu Yang was different. After his training, he had developed such strength that even he had no concept of how strong he was. Bluntly speaking, he, as he was now, could easily knock out any cultivator of the first three levels of Qi Refinement with a single punch, no technique needed.
...
Perhaps because he had stepped into the Qi Refinement stage and his innate talent for swordsmanship began to emerge, combined with the control gained from rigorous training, Lu Yang handled the Green Peak Sword with ease.
In just over ten days, Lu Yang was able to carve tofu into the shapes of various demon beasts and into the shapes of himself and Eldest Senior Sister, even the likeness of the nine lotus-shaped peaks of the Seek Dao Sect.
Following the folk entertainers, Lu Yang learned a new skill and made a name for himself in the kitchen.
He had to speed up because he couldn't eat any more tofu.
After Lu Yang completed this stage, the Eldest Senior Sister appeared. After some encouragement, she took out a sesame seed.
"Sword cultivation also requires training in observation. Now I will toss this sesame seed into the tofu scraps, you must find it in the shortest possible time."
Lu Yang fell to his knees, "Eldest Senior Sister, can we find another way?"
The Eldest Senior Sister looked quietly at a begging Lu Yang, with no wave in her eyes.
"Oh."

chapters.title: Chapter 16 - 15 Task Hall_1
chapters.content:
Ever since then, Lu Yang's life had been filled to the brim. In the early morning, he sat at the top of the mountain, with the Five Centers Toward Heaven, bathing in the morning light. In the forenoon, he practiced swordsmanship and nurtured his sword with his heart. Around noon, he rested under a tree for a while. In the afternoon, he emerged energized to spar against puppets and get beaten.
After dinner, he read by the candlelight, completing the assignments Eldest Senior Sister gave him.
After a year in this manner, Lu Yang's cultivation level steadily increased.
...
"Look, isn't that the Sect Leader's fourth disciple, Lu Yang with the Sword Spirit Root?"
In the Task Hall, Lu Yang appeared in a white robe, his eyes vibrant, and a sword strapped to his waist with a red tassel, distinctly eye-catching.
Anyone who looked at him would inevitably offer a compliment to such a promising young hero.
The disciples of Seek Dao Sect mostly knew each other, especially in a place like the Task Hall. Whenever they saw someone unusual, they loved to discuss it for its novelty.
As the first in the entrance examination with the Sword Spirit Root, Lu Yang had encountered the amicable River Spirit and Dai Bufan, was apprenticed to the Sect Leader, and had received personal coaching from Eldest Senior Sister.
With these varying factors together, he shined brightly among the newcomer disciples and gained significant popularity, even surpassing Tao Yaoye, who possessed celestial beauty.
"Is that Lu Yang, the one personally trained by Eldest Senior Sister? Ah, indeed it is."
"I heard he has just become a Foundation Establishment cultivator after a year in the sect."
"He has entered the Foundation Establishment Stage, no wonder he is in the Task Hall. Looks like he is getting ready to take on tasks to temper himself."
As for the curious gazes around him, Lu Yang had grown used to them.
The disciples were correct in their assumptions. Lu Yang had successfully established his foundation seven days ago, took another seven days to stabilize it, and then formally emerged. Following Eldest Senior Sister's instructions, he came out to explore.
In the Task Hall, Lu Yang saw a variety of tasks that left him astounded. From beheading a major demon in a sea of corpses to helping find a lost cat or dog, they ran the full gamut.
Take for example, the task Lu Yang was looking at currently, which was to find a legitimate Dual Cultivation Technique.
Dual Cultivation Techniques fell into two categories: legitimate and indecent. Legitimate Dual Cultivation Techniques needn't be elaborated; they mostly involved mutual assistance between the genders and the balance of Yin and Yang.
The indecent Dual Cultivation Techniques definitely didn't need any elaboration.
The task was posted by a registered Fox Demon at Seek Dao Sect.
Although one of Seek Dao Sect's duties was to eliminate monsters, it didn't kill monsters indiscriminately. For a monster with a clear identity and no intention to harm others, Seek Dao Sect wouldn't subdue it. On the contrary, they would register such monsters and grant them legal identity.
This Fox Demon was an example of that.
Named Su Yan, this fox was an ordinary little fox living in the deep mountains and old forests. She was once trapped by a hunter's snare. Fortunately, a member of the influential family happened to be playing on the mountain and saved her, leaving the hunter's day's efforts in vain.
Later, Su Yan ate a Transfiguration Fruit in a hidden cave, activating the latent bloodline within her body and transforming her into a Fox Demon.
Being a grateful creature, Su Yan changed into a human form to repay the influential disciple.
By that time, the influential disciple had become the head of the family, and though he had seen many women, none was as beautiful as Su Yan.
The two naturally got married.
But then the problem arose.
The Fox Demon was born with the Alluring Charm Body, absorbing Yang Qi uncontrollably. During intercourse, the husband would always be the one losing Yang Qi.
Luckily, Yang Qi could be replenished and was not fatal, but it would simply reduce the frequency of their sexual activities.
Being newlyweds yet having to limit their sexual activities was far from ideal. And when they increased their frequency, the husband began to look exhausted, which could start rumors.
Therefore, Su Yan hoped to practice a legitimate Dual Cultivation Technique to control her Alluring Charm Body.
This task had been posted for a long time and no one had accepted it.
It wasn't because legitimate Dual Cultivation Techniques were particularly scarce, it's just that anyone who completed the task would be known to possess one. Once they were known to have a legitimate technique, people would start speculating whether they also had an indecent Dual Cultivation Technique.
If a fellow disciple asks for the indecent Dual Cultivation Technique, should you admit to having it or not? And would you give it?
How would the Senior Sisters see you?
"This is a good task. I'll take it."
Someone behind Lu Yang said, judging by the voice, it was Meng Jingzhou.
Meng Jingzhou was the most suitable for this task. With the Meng Family's status, they definitely didn't lack Dual Cultivation Techniques. And because of his Pure Yang Spiritual Root, he certainly wouldn't have any indecent Dual Cultivation Techniques.
Even if Meng Jingzhou had indecent Dual Cultivation Techniques, he could only stare helplessly.
Meng Jingzhou had established his foundation before Lu Yang and this was his third task.
"You've also reached the Foundation Establishment Stage?" Meng Jingzhou smiled. Both of them possessed mutant Single Spiritual Root, their cultivation talents were more or less the same. Lu Yang establishing his foundation so much later was quite unexpected.
Thinking back to the torment he had suffered under Senior Sister in this past year, Lu Yang sighed, "I've finally established my foundation."
"Once you have completed the task, let's get together for a good meal. I'll treat." Meng Jingzhou generously took charge. He had plenty of Spirit Stones.
After Meng Jingzhou left, Lu Yang continued to browse the tasks posted on the wall.
"There are suspected traces of Demon Path rituals in the north. It is recommended that Golden Core Stage or above cultivators investigate. The reward is 400 contribution points. If additional information is found, extra rewards will be given."
"Daoist Li Hong at Shanhai Pass has lost his pet and needs someone to search for it."
Lu Yang paused, finding this task to be quite suitable—finding a kitten or a puppy wouldn't pose any danger. Then he read on.
"Lost pet: a Nascent Soul Mid-stage Two-Winged Ferocious Tiger. If found, the task reward is 5,000 contribution points."
Lu Yang shrank his neck. A Nascent Soul Stage demon beast, especially a Two-Winged Ferocious Tiger with ancient bloodline—the very origin of the phrase "adding wings to a tiger"—he didn't even qualify to be this creature's toothpick. Next, next.
"Strange fluctuations of Spiritual Energy are sensed at Kunwu Mountain at the intersection of day and night, suspected to be an undiscovered Cave Heaven. It is suggested that Nascent Soul Late-Stage or above cultivators should investigate. The task reward is 8,000 contribution points. If the Cave Heaven proves valuable, there will be extra rewards."
Another task unrelated to Lu Yang.
If it were in the outside world, one could be regarded as an expert if they could travel across rivers and lakes at the Qi Refinement Stage. At the Foundation Establishment Stage, one could be hailed as a leader and live prosperously for a hundred years in minor regions. Someone at the Golden Core Stage could even declare himself a true person and establish his own sect.
But in Seek Dao Sect, a casual passerby was at least at the Golden Core Stage. A thrown brick could hit a bunch of them... and with average disciples' cultivation levels, they could throw the brick back.
The disciples of Seek Dao Sect were all elites picked from among thousands. Before the recruitment of new disciples like Lu Yang, Seek Dao Sect didn't even have disciples at the Qi Refinement Stage or Foundation Establishment Stage. The disciples' lowest cultivation level was at the Golden Core Stage.
No matter how prominent you were outside, once you returned to Seek Dao Sect, you had to behave modestly.
Thus, there were not many tasks suitable for Foundation Establishment cultivators. Lu Yang went through several in a row, all of which required Golden Core Stage or Nascent Soul Stage cultivation levels.
He also noticed a special long-term task.
"Long-term task: Collect cultivation techniques not yet included in Seek Dao Sect's collection. The reward is determined by the content of the technique."
"Note: Senior Sister Yun Zhi, please do not take this task. The Scripture Pavilion has already set up a Yun Zhi Zone. Yun Zhi can place her completed cultivation techniques directly in this area."

chapters.title: Chapter 17 - 16 Yun Zhi's Talent_1
chapters.content:
A fellow Senior Brother standing beside Lu Yang also noticed this task and chuckled, "Everytime I see this long-term task, I always remember the great achievements of Eldest Senior Sister."
Another one chimed in, "When Eldest Senior Sister was found to have written her own techniques and falsely claimed that she obtained them from the Relic Blessed Cave, it caused quite a commotion."
"I have heard from my master that there is an ancient blessed cave in Lingnan, known as Sishui Cave Heaven. The most valuable treasure in it is a cultivation technique called 'Chaos Awakening Technique', left behind by the master of the cave heaven in his lifetime."
"Eldest Senior Sister once falsely claimed to have found the 'Chaos Awakening Technique' in the Sishui Cave Heaven, asserting that those who train it to completion can transcend the chaos and gain insight into all the truths of the world."
"But not long after Eldest Senior Sister's lie was exposed, someone stumbled upon the deepest part of the Sishui Cave Heaven, retrieving the true 'Chaos Awakening Technique'."
"The result was quite surprising. When the sect compared the two, they found that the technique crafted by the Eldest Senior Sister was easier to practice than the original, and the final results between the two were worlds apart."
"Subsequently, several other manuals of similar rank were found in the Relic Blessed Cave, but none of them were as powerful as the techniques created by the Eldest Senior Sister. Hearing about all this, the Elders fell silent for several days."
Lu Yang: "..."
Lu Yang has never seen Yun Zhi, the Scripture Pavilion. Likely because the techniques crafted by Eldest Senior Sister were too outrageous, they were all stored in the highest layer of Scripture Pavilion, and no one without a special permission was allowed to read them or practice.
They were, in a word, forbidden.
"Eldest Senior Sister has an extraordinary talent and a rare mind, with a deep understanding of the world. It's said that it's good that she holds the position of Acting Sect Leader while the Sect Leader is in seclusion."
"There's also a rumor saying that Eldest Senior Sister usurped the throne, that she locked up the Sect Leader and wants to become the real sect leader. She has the upper hand on the eight grand elders, and no one dares to resist her. Some people even claimed hearing moaning sounds from Sky Gate Mountain at night—that's said to be the sound of the Sect Leader in the dungeon!"
"Hahaha, that's definitely nonsense. It just can't be."
Lu Yang didn't pay them any mind. He hadn't heard any such noises on Sky Gate Mountain, so he continued looking for a task.
Finally, he found a suitable one.
"As reported by the people of Taiping Village, Quhe County, a bird-like Demon Beast has appeared. It can speak human language, but its species is unknown. So far, there have been no records of it harming people or using any demonic powers. Seek Dao Sect is requested to resolve this issue."
Lu Yang thought for a while and decided to take this task.
In his estimation, it was either some kind of demon beast who had mistakenly wandered into human territory or perhaps a demon beast who had inadvertently become enlightened. These kinds of creatures generally didn't have a cultivation level beyond the Foundation Establishment Stage, they weren't particularly aggressive, and they were usually amicable towards humans—perfect for a newbie like him.
Moreover, the rewards offered by the Task Hall confirmed this.
Reward: 30 contribution points.
The minimum reward.
The reward for a mission was determined by the specialists from Seek Dao Sect and double-checked by another person, ensuring minimal mistakes.
The lower the reward, the simpler the task.
Lu Yang walked over to the counter, "Senior Brother, I will take this task to solve the bird-like Demon Beast."
"I will take this task to solve the bird-like Demon Beast." Another voice rang out, almost at the same time as Lu Yang's.
The owner of the voice was a young girl in a pale pink dress. She was pretty with a clear complexion and her radiant beauty was especially enchanting.
With such a sweet face, and a cultivation level similar to Lu Yang's, the girl's identity was obvious.
"Junior Sister Tao Yaoye, what a coincidence." Lu Yang smiled. He had only met Tao Yaoye at the time of admission. He had spent a year on Sky Gate Mountain and rarely met any outsiders.
Lu Yang was the top scorer in the entrance examination, and until new rankings were established, he held the position of Senior Brother.
The truth was, Tao Yaoye choosing this task was not a coincidence. Tasks suitable for people at the Foundation Establishment Stage were scarce. For this generation, there were only a few tasks they could undertake.
"So it's Senior Brother Lu. Congratulations on your Foundation Establishment. There aren't many tasks for those at the Foundation Establishment Stage, so why don't we work together to complete it and split the reward?" Tao Yaoye proposed with a sweet smile. Her curiosity was piqued by Lu Yang, who seldom showed himself.
Lu Yang readily agreed.
The task wasn't all about the rewards, they were more interested in gaining experience.
"Quhe County is quite far from here, shall we take a flying boat?"
...
"Do you know, Junior Sister Tao, we the human race are quite a contradictory species. Often, we fear what we also admire."
"In ancient times, demons and calamities were rampant. The human race, being weaker, was struggling to survive."
"These great demons, relying on the bloodline of their ancestors, their sturdy bodies, and their innate divine abilities, strutted around the barren lands."
"Humans feared the great demons, considering them as natural disasters that were insurmountable. At the same time, they also worshipped them, hoping to possess a level of power similar to them."
"Thus, the ancestors of ancient times created their own cultivation techniques, learned divine abilities from the bloodlines of demon beasts, overcame numerous difficulties and stood at the top of the continent, opening up a new world for the human race and allowing them to survive and thrive."
"And then there's wind, rain, thunder and lightning. The ancient ancestors were certainly afraid of them, but also longed for them. They represent the authority and tremendous power of nature, which is an irresistible natural will."
"Humans longed for them and wanted to obtain the tremendous power and authority of nature. The ancient ancestors questioned the heavens and faced thunderstorms, contemplated amidst wind and rain, and understood the principles that 'man follows earth, earth follows heaven, heaven follows Dao, and Dao follows nature', and discovered a series of laws."
"Have you noticed? This contradictory mentality is a necessary element for humans to become the lords of the continent."
"And then there's the sky. Humans yearn for the sky, hoping to fly freely in the sky like birds, and respect the sky, finding it mysterious and elusive. This feeling of awe is embedded in our bloodlines, and every human has it, some more obvious than others…"
On the flying boat, Lu Yang was impassioned. Whenever he got excited, he jumped up, gesturing with his hands and talking animatedly.
After thinking calmly for a moment, Tao Yaoye interrupted Lu Yang's long discourse.
"So, this is the reason why you are afraid of heights?"
"Yes."
Tao Yaoye: "..."
The two of them sat inside the hull of the flying boat, soaring through the clouds. The bottom of the flying boat was engraved with mass-produced balance array methods crafted by array masters, ensuring those inside wouldn't feel a thing, even in a raging storm.
Right now, the weather was clear with a bright blue sky. It was a great opportunity to sunbathe, meditate, and enjoy the view from the deck. Tao Yaoye suggested that they go and take a walk on the deck, but Lu Yang firmly refused.
Due to Tao Yaoye's strong curiosity, she kept asking over and over. Lu Yang had no choice but to explain, starting with the ancient history as to why he was afraid of heights, citing sources and making wide references. He talked and talked, trying to prove that his fear of heights was a reasonable and ancient psychological condition.
Broadly speaking, he believed it could even contribute to the progression of the human race.
Luckily, Tao Yaoye didn't believe a single word.

chapters.title: Chapter 18 - 17: Have You Ever Heard of the Land Sword Immortal_1
chapters.content:
"Senior Brother Lu, as I recall, you possess a Sword Spirit Root?" Tao Yaoye cast a glance at the ancient sword hanging at Lu Yang's waist, and the callouses in the tiger's jaw formed by swinging his sword hard. The changes that occurred within the span of a short year serve as proof of the hardship of Lu Yang's sword training.
Lu Yang nodded and modestly replied, "I can be barely considered a Sword Cultivator."
Cultivators, depending on their specialties, can be divided into Pill Cultivators, Talisman Cultivators, Array Cultivators. Body Cultivators and Sword Cultivators among others. Among them, Sword Cultivators possess the strongest attacking power. No one wishes to face a Sword Cultivator in a battle of the same realm.
The most famous aspect of Sword Cultivators is their ability to break thousands of laws with one sword. Despite your profound Dao methods, I can break them with a single sword.
Opposite to Sword Cultivators are Dao Cultivators, who break your sword technique with thousands of methods, no matter how profound your sword technique is.
In addition to "one sword breaks thousands of laws", sword techniques like "Sword Opens Heaven's Gate" and "Flying Sword" are all famous techniques among Sword Cultivators.
Dressed in white attire like snow, stepping on a flying sword, surfing the wind and waves, how heroic is this posture?
What do Cultivators seek? Firstly, strength; secondly, attractiveness. Sword Cultivators seamlessly meet these standards, thus countless Cultivators aspire to become Sword Cultivators. Unfortunately, they lack the natural talent for the Sword Dao, and are thus unable to become Sword Cultivators.
"So, Senior Brother Lu, what will you do after you learn to fly with a sword?"
Tao Yaoye never heard of a Sword Cultivator suffering from fear of heights before.
Others cultivate to freely traverse through the sky and the earth. However, Senior Brother Lu probably cultivates to roam freely through the earth instead.
Lu Yang replied earnestly, "It is not necessary for a Sword Immortal to solely fly in the sky, Tao Yaoye junior sister, have you ever heard of a Land Sword Immortal?"
Tao Yaoye was slightly taken aback. Amidst Lu Yang's seriousness, the term "Land Sword Immortal" sounded familiar so she nodded smoothly.
"Who says all Immortals should be high up in the heavens? The term "Immortal", after all, has the character '人' (human) in it. Immortals exist between the sky and the earth, they can reach for the stars and moon in the sky, and enter the nine abysses of the earth, all with utmost freedom."
"The term "Land Sword Immortal" signifies that Sword Immortals can not only exist in the sky, but can also walk on the ground. With a single sword throw, they can decapitate demons and monsters from a thousand miles away!"
"My goal is to become a Sword Immortal like that!"
Just as Tao Yaoye was about to nod along with the atmosphere, her habitual calm made her realize something was wrong, "Wait a minute, I have only ever heard of the Land Immortal. Where did this term, Land Sword Immortal, come from?"
Lu Yang silently stared at Tao Yaoye for three seconds, as if brewing an ancient secret in his chest, and then gently said.
"I made it up."
"..."
His sincere attitude left Tao Yaoye speechless.
Tao Yaoye did not delve further into the topic. After spending three short days together, her impression of Senior Brother Lu had completely changed.
At the first stage, she witnessed Lu Yang detect his Sword Spirit Root. At that time, Lu Yang appeared in her mind as a righteous and unyielding sword, silent yet indomitable.
After the end of the second stage, she heard Lu Yang describe his unique approach to passing the stage. She thought that a Sword Cultivator, with such flexible thinking, might have greater achievements in the future.
At the third stage, when she was almost too exhausted to keep her eyes open on Wenxin Mountain, believing that no one could possibly climb the fifty steps required, she saw Lu Yang successfully reach the fiftieth step and pass the stage. Lu Yang's success gave her the strength and determination to continue up the mountain and pass the stage successfully.
A year later, she met Senior Brother Lu, who had acrophobia and was particularly talkative.
She realized, what 'absence makes the heart grow fonder' means.
"Looking at the time, it should be time to disembark," said Lu Yang.
Lu Yang spread out a large map, upon which the Seek Dao Sect, the Great Xia Dynasty's Imperial City, famous mountains and rivers, important cities, and Cave Heavens and Earthly Blessings are all marked in detail.
This was a map of one-eighth of the Central Continent.
On the map, there was a small red dot that moved slowly. If you were not paying attention, you would think the red dot was stationary.
The small red dot marked the current location of the two.
This was no ordinary map, but a magic artifact necessary for travelling.
Although the map was intricate, Taiping Village was too small to be marked on the map. The map could hardly make out even Quhe County.
The flying ship from the Seek Dao Sect to the Imperial City of the Great Xia Dynasty traversed countless miles. Not to mention Taiping Village, even Quhe County was a miniscule spot at such a distance. The map could hardly hold its name.
The flying ship would not stop at a small place like Quhe County. If it stopped everywhere, the speed of the ship would be greatly reduced, and its efficiency would not be much better than that of a carriage.
This flying ship only stopped at a few large transport hubs such as the Seek Dao Sect, Qingyun City, Tongtian Valley, Fulong Mountain, and the Imperial City.
Lu Yang had heard from Eldest Senior Sister that if you wanted to disembark the flying ship, you just had to jump off.
The corner of Lu Yang's eye twitched at the thought of it.
The flying ship was similar to the airplanes of his previous life, fast and efficient. The biggest difference was in his previous life passengers had to wait patiently for the plane to land before disembarking. In the Cultivation world, passengers could jump off whenever they wanted.
They emphasized freedom and openness.
This was Lu Yang's first time disembarking from a ship, and he was very excited.
This was evident by the shivering of his legs.
This was from a height of ten thousand meters.
"Senior Brother Lu, do you know how to disembark?" Tao Yaoye asked.
"Of course," Lu Yang replied confidently, looking somewhat proud.
At an altitude of ten thousand meters, if he were to simply fall straight down without any skill, even a late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator would impact to a pulp.
Lu Yang had asked Eldest Senior Sister how to disembark, but she did not answer directly. She only said not to refer to books or ask others but to think independently and develop good habits of independent thinking.
So Lu Yang successfully figured out how to disembark and prepare for it.
Not just Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye were preparing to disembark, but also seven or eight strangers.
Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye and the seven or eight strangers stood on the edge of the ship's deck, lining up.
The seven or eight strangers took out standard paper umbrellas.
Tao Yaoye took out her carefully refined red paper umbrella.
Lu Yang took out a parachute.
"Huh?"
Lu Yang felt he didn't seem to fit in with the group. Why were their belongings different from his?
Just as Lu Yang was wondering what they were going to use the umbrellas for, a middle-aged man in black, holding an umbrella, jumped off the ship.
The man in black fell like a shell, his speed increasing rapidly.
He calmly infused Spiritual Energy into the paper umbrella. The lightweight Spiritual Energy was like a thread, like a nimble green snake, entwining itself around the umbrella frame from the umbrella handle.
The paper umbrella seemed to come to life, awakening from its winter sleep, and unfurling itself. The man in black's speed gradually slowed, and he landed safely with a slight sway.
The man in black let go of the umbrella, and the paper umbrella closed, turning into a stream of light. It shuttled through the sea of clouds and returned to the flying ship.
The paper umbrella was not the property of the man in black but temporarily lent to the passengers by the flying ship.
The seven or eight strangers and Tao Yaoye all turned their heads to look at Lu Yang simultaneously, even Tao Yaoye looked puzzled.
They held umbrellas in their hands in preparation for jumping ship, but Lu Yang was carrying a bag. What were they supposed to do?
Lu Yang maintained a calm and unflustered demeanor on the surface, his radiant smile giving no cause for confusion, as if he were not the one who didn't fit in.
Internally, however, he was in turmoil, full of complaints, and didn't know where to begin.
All the complaints could be summed up in one sentence—Eldest Senior Sister, you deceived me!

chapters.title: Chapter 19 - 18: Demon Bird_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang was not fully informed about the Cultivation World, his knowledge prior to joining the Seek Dao Sect came from a Storyteller, and in his first year with the sect, his knowledge on cultivation grew astonishingly fast, but none of the books he read had described how to dismount from a flying ship.
Who would write such a thing in their books.
In terms of everyday knowledge of the Cultivation World, he was still inferior to Tao Yaoye, who grew up in a cultivator's influential family.
Regarding the flying ship, he only knew that it belonged to the Land Money Trade Association, and that disembarking involved jumping from the ship, precisely how was unknown.
Every year, the flying ship could bring in massive wealth, but this was just a minor industry for the Land Money Trade Association.
The Land Money Trade Association was the largest trade association in the Central Continent, with a mysterious force behind it, countless rare treasures, as long as you had enough Spirit Stones, Buddha's relic, Sacred Bones from Demon Territory, Dao Fruits from immortals, which only existed in legends, unseen by anyone, could also be purchased.
If anyone dared to owe a debt to the Land Money Trade Association, or harbored any thoughts of luck, stealing from the association, then the warning for the world was a number of Cultivators who had disappeared without a trace.
There were rumors about a Cultivator with great power, known as the Thief King, who was proficient in the space arts, with the skill of taking others' storage space as easily as reaching into a bag, for him, distance was just a meaningless set of numbers, he could step across millions of mountains and rivers, from the extreme west of the Central Continent to the land of deep winter.
Even the goods of a Cultivator in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage had been stolen by him.
The theft profession had an unwritten rule; never steal from the Land Money Trade Association.
Originally, the Thief King adhered to the rule of the thief's ancestral teachings, without any dealings with the Land Money Trade Association, but as his fame grew, countless well-known grandmasters joined forces to hunt him down, but could not even find a piece of his clothing, he gradually felt that these powerful cultivators were just mediocre, he had already surpassed the thief's ancestor, so there was no need to abide by the rigid ancestral teachings.
He arrogantly proclaimed that he would steal the treasures of the Land Money Trade Association that night.
Everyone thought that either the Thief King would use the profoundness of his space art to silently steal the treasures, or there would be a great battle within the Land Money Trade Association between the Thief King and the powers behind the Association.
No one had expected that nothing happened that night, and from then on, the Thief King disappeared without a trace.
Lu Yang's embarrassment only lasted for a short while, when it was time to jump ship, the strangers didn't have time to continue watching Lu Yang.
Everyone held up their paper umbrellas and jumped down, disembarking one after another.
Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye also made their move.
From high up in the air, several strangers opened their umbrellas, looking small like sesame seeds in the distance, Lu Yang was different, he pulled the cord on his back, his parachute opened with a "pop", looking extraordinarily conspicuous in the high sky.
If it was an ordinary situation, Lu Yang would be very nervous at such a high height.
But now he didn't have the heart to think about that.
It was too embarrassing.
Luckily, everyone was heading in different directions, with only Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye going to Taiping Village.
Upon arriving at the Taiping Village, the two received a warm welcome from the Village Chief, who seemed to have known in advance of their arrival.
"Both of you Cultivators have finally arrived. The way you both descended from the flying ship was truly extraordinary."
Lu Yang opened his mouth, but in the end, didn't ask how they knew when he was arriving.
"My name is Lu Yang, and she is Tao Yaoye, both of us are disciples of the Seek Dao Sect, the task's description of the Demon Bird is not very detailed, I ask for the Village Chief to provide more details."
The Village Chief had initially prepared a welcome feast, where they would first drink several rounds, and after a few drinks, they would give some local specialties and discuss the Demon Bird problem in detail. This is typically how people from above act when they come to do business.
He did not expect the two to be so decisive and efficient, and he was secretly pleased, admiring them for being true disciples of the Immortal Sect.
Tao Yaoye took a look at the Village Chief, he was at the late stage of Qi Refinement, and his cultivation foundation was not solid, his spiritual essence contained a lot of impurities, and had no hope for reaching Foundation Establishment, he was a typical Cultivator and did not stand out.
When it came to the Demon Bird, the Village Chief's face showed distress. Taiping Village was already rarely visited by outsiders and is quite isolated, now the news of the Demon Bird had spread in nearby areas, and even the traveling merchants were unwilling to come here.
He made a report to the Quhe County, but the Quhe County was short on manpower, and given that the Demon Bird did not harm people, they said to wait a while, until they could free up some people to come and deal with the Taiping Village situation.
This wait turned out to be twenty days.
"It was probably about twenty days ago, when Feng the Tailor ran onto the street yelling that a great demon that eats people had come to their home and was very powerful."
"The neighbors were startled when they heard this, a man-eating demon was no small matter, there were only about thirty cultivators in Taiping Village, and I, as the Village Chief, had the highest cultivation level, so Feng the Tailor came to look for me with a group of neighbors."
"Before exorcising the demon, you first need to understand the situation thoroughly, so I asked Feng the Tailor: 'You say the great demon eats people, but who did it eat?'"
Demons who have eaten human beings and those who have not pose vastly different dangers. Humans are the spirits of all things, inherently sentient. Once a demon eats a human, they will become attached to this taste and will eat a second, a third person... wreaking havoc on the whole place.
"Feng the Tailor answered: 'I don't know who the great demon has eaten, but that demon can talk, it must have eaten a human and that's why it can talk.'"
Indeed, among the common people, there was a rumor saying once a demon eats a human, it could start speaking human language, and transform into a person, but these were just fabricated rumors.
Demon Race cultivation is not that simple. To be able to speak, they would need to refine the Cross Bone in their throat, which requires at least the late stage of Qi Refinement.
"Feng the Tailor said the demon was colorful, and he initially thought it was a lost bird from the mountains, and the Demon Bird was sitting behind him watching him sew clothes, not moving at all, then it suddenly started speaking, which scared Feng the Tailor and he immediately ran out of his shop."
"Seeing that Feng the Tailor could not provide any useful information, I asked them to wait at a distance while I secretly approached and saw the Demon Bird."
"The Demon Bird had vibrant, glossy feathers, with a stark red color around its eyes, obviously not an ordinary bird, what ordinary bird would dare to be this flashy?"
"The Demon Bird spoke, asking me 'Who are you, where is Zhang Guanjia?', its tone seemed quite urgent."
"I was puzzled in my heart, Zhang Guanjia was a cultivator in our village, at the third stage of Qi Refinement, pretty average, and I couldn't see how he would have any connection with the Demon Beast."
