"At the time, I tried my best to appear relaxed, presenting no threat, and politely inquired 'May I know what business the Demon King has with Zhang Guanjia?'"
"The Demon Bird did not answer, it flapped its wings and left the tailor shop."
"Since then, the Demon Bird has been flying around Taiping Village, eating the grains in the fields, speaking human language, not eating people, but who wouldn't be afraid when seeing a demon? Therefore, these days, everyone has been living in fear, fearing that the Demon Bird might get violent and devour everyone."
"Have you confronted the Demon Bird, how strong is it?" Lu Yang asked.
The Village Chief shook his head: "That Demon Bird remains in the air all day, appearing and disappearing mysteriously, making it hard to track."
"Moreover, I can't gauge the Demon Bird's cultivation level; indicating at the very least, it's at the same level as me, the seventh stage of Qi Refinement. I was worried that the Demon Bird initially had no intention to harm anyone, but if I rashly confronted it, this could backfire and provoke its anger."
Lu Yang nodded, the Village Chief's actions were indeed reasonable.

chapters.title: Chapter 20 - 19: Demon Bird's True Form! _1
chapters.content:
Tao Yaoye asked, "Since the Demon Bird is looking for Zhang Guanjia, have you tried letting the Demon Bird meet Zhang Guanjia?"
The Village Chief gave a deep sigh, "There's no need for us to let the Demon Bird meet Zhang Guanjia, a few days ago, the Demon Bird came to Zhang Guanjia's house directly and shouted 'monster! monster!', then flew out of the window, heading to some other houses."
"We didn't know what to do when both of you, the immortals, arrived."
Tao Yaoye speculated after a moment of contemplation: "Is Zhang Guanjia a monster? Is the Demon bird warning you to be careful of Zhang Guanjia?"
Among the Demon Race, there were many benevolent creatures that would transform into human form or reveal their true form to warn humans about the impending disaster.
For instance, the great demon Zhuyan. According to folklore, wherever Zhuyan appears, chaos ensues, thus, Zhuyan is considered an ill-omened Demon Beast.
The Immortal Sects knew that the truth was quite the opposite. It wasn't Zhuyan who brought chaos, instead, Zhuyan was predicting the forthcoming disorder, he came from the Demon Territory to the Central Continent to warn the human race; he had nothing but good intentions.
Of course, Zhuyan being misunderstood by the public was his fault too—he was socially anxious, too shy to speak up.
A silent creature from Demon Race, coupled with a ferocious face, made it hard for humans to believe it was an amicable Demon Beast.
Maybe this Demon Bird is the same, coming to warn the people of Taiping Village that Zhang Guanjia is a great demon in disguise.
Upon hearing this, the Village Chief found himself in a tough spot. He didn't want to contradict this beautiful fairy from the Immortal Sect, but he couldn't deny the truth and say that Zhang Guanjia was a demon either.
"Zhang Guanjia grew up in Taiping Village since childhood, the elders can testify for him. He has two younger brothers, Zhang Guanyi and Zhang Guanbing. The brothers are very close-knit. He now runs a private school, teaching children Confucianism and cultivation practices. He's one of the very few teachers in Taiping Village."
"If you say he's a monster, I'm afraid..."
Tao Yaoye disagreed with the Village Chief's viewpoint: "Demons are long-lived. Many immortal beings would often stay at certain places for decades, aging slowly like ordinary people. Once they've seen enough of a place, they'd stage their deaths and, stepping out from their graves, move on to a new location to start anew."
The Village Chief was speechless. He didn't have the experience and knowledge that Tao Yaoye had, so he didn't know how to respond.
Lu Yang gently shook his head, pointing out the loophole in Tao Yaoye's conjecture: "If Zhang Guanjia is a monster, he must be a great demon in disguise. How could a great demon tolerate the ramblings of a small Demon Bird? I'm afraid the Demon Bird would have been killed by Zhang Guanjia before it could even speak."
Tao Yaoye did not rebut; Lu Yang was indeed stating the facts.
Lu Yang stood up, "Having said that, we still need to meet Zhang Guanjia."
The Village Chief quickly led the way: "Please follow me, Immortal Masters."
Along the way, Lu Yang corrected the Village Chief's form of address: "We are all cultivators, aiming to become immortals. Not to mention that both of us are merely at the Foundation Establishment Stage, even the Unification True Monarchs, those who Pass the Tribulation, or the cultivators who are the closest to becoming the immortals, do not have the qualifications to be called 'Immortal Master'."
"You can call us Dao Masters."
The Village Chief smiled awkwardly, not daring to treat Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye as run-of-the-mill Foundation Establishment Stage practitioners; only a small fraction of cultivators can advance to the Golden Core Stage, normal cultivators that is. The disciples of the Seek Dao Sect are undoubtedly destined for the Golden Core Stage; their future achievements were beyond his imagination.
"Isn't it that no one has ever become an immortal, or are just mere legends of immortals?"
Upon hearing this, Lu Yang just smiled, not saying much.
In a short while, the three of them arrived at Zhang Guanjia's residence.
"Old Zhang, there are visitors, open the door."
With a creak, the wooden door opened. Zhang Guanjia, with a woebegone expression, stood behind the door.
"Let me introduce you, these two are disciples of the Seek Dao Sect, they have come to help us get rid of the Demon Bird."
Hearing the words "Seek Dao Sect", Zhang Guanjia's expression changed. He said helplessly, "I am not a monster, you can't just believe whatever the Demon Bird shouts. The Demon Bird also shouts 'grandpa, come play', why don't you send some grandpas to play with the Demon Bird?"
The Village Chief gave an awkward smile: "We are just passing by, and happened to be directed towards your house."
The Village Chief was earnest and diligent, anyone would say he was a good official. After hearing his elaborate explanation, Zhang Guanjia could only relent and welcome the three of them into his house.
Zhang Guanjia's house was a spacious, two-story dwelling, but it felt rather empty being occupied by a single occupant.
Zhang Guanjia was over forty years old and still unmarried.
The conversation inevitably revolved around the Demon Bird. Zhang Guanjia, obviously irritated, said: "I have never seen that Demon Bird before and God only knows why it always calls out my name."
"I have never left Taiping Village in my entire life, the furthest I've ever been to is just Quhe County. How the hell would I know a Demon Bird?"
"Every day, students ask me, 'Teacher, are you a monster?' Some students are even afraid of being eaten by me and submit their homework on time every day!"
"Even my neighbor came to me and said he has a mortal enemy who's a Foundation Establishment cultivator residing in Quhe County, he asked if I could secretly kill the person for him, with negotiable pricing!" Zhang Guanjia was gnashing his teeth while saying this, he would love nothing more than to duel with the Demon Bird and clear his own name.
Being an ordinary human, he was deemed as one of the Demon Race just because the Demon Bird blurted it out, it was simply preposterous!
After what seemed like two hours of conversation, the three of them did not get any useful information, Zhang Guanjia simply complained about how greatly the Demon Bird has affected his life.
Luckily, Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye promptly assured that they would exterminate the demon for the common good, eliminate the Demon Bird, and regain Zhang Guanjia's reputation. Only then did Zhang Guanjia stop complaining satisfactorily.
"The Demon Bird is here again!" Someone started shouting outside the house, running away in fear from the Demon Bird.
Upon hearing the commotion, Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye instantly put aside their casual attitude, equipped their magic artifacts, stepped outside the courtyard, and prepared to battle the Demon Bird.
"Daomasters, please be careful!" The Village Chief told the villagers to keep quiet and stay away from where the Demon Bird appeared.
Lu Yang gripped his sword, ready to split the Demon Bird in two the moment it showed any sign of a threat to humans.
Tao Yaoye took out a red paper umbrella, her life-bound magical treasure, the Thousand Illusion Umbrella. The umbrella opened out, creating a dream-like illusion in which the enemy would become submerged, dying unawares.
Lu Yang subtly signaled that he would scout ahead. Tao Yaoye nodded in response.
The Demon Bird landed on a civilian's house. Like a cat, Lu Yang moved stealthily and silently, gradually closing in on his prey.
Lu Yang was on high alert, his muscles tensed up, ready to unsheath his sword and engage in battle anytime.
He optimistically assessed that the Demon Bird was at the late stage of Qi Refinement, this was the best-case scenario. The worst one being that the Demon Bird was at the late stage of Foundation Establishment as a Demon Beast, it wouldn't be easy to fight, let alone defeat.
Finally, he saw the Demon Bird that had been plaguing Taiping Village for twenty days.
Its deep green feathers were vibrant and glossy, with a large expanse of red from its eye corner to the neck, the red and green contrast was quite striking.
Lu Yang recognized the Demon Bird's background at once. The Demon Bird came from a dense jungle, lived on figs and berries, and was good at mimicking human speech.
It was a parrot.

chapters.title: Chapter 21 - 20 Shang Family_1
chapters.content:
Reality proved that the ones who could talk were not necessarily demon beasts. It could be a parrot.
"What kind of demon bird is this!"
Lu Yang was furious, a suction force appeared in his palm, and he pulled the parrot over in an instant. The parrot didn't even have a chance to react before it was captured.
The Village Chief could have done the same, but he assumed this was some Qi Refinement or Foundation Establishment Stage demon beast, and didn't dare to do so.
"Demon beast! There's a demon beast!" The parrot was tweeting non-stop.
Tao Yaoye heard the commotion and came over to inspect, her feelings mirroring Lu Yang's.
The completion of the mission was a good thing, and not needing to fight was also a good thing. But the problem was, they had traveled all the way from the Seek Dao Sect and had been flying for three days, just to catch a parrot?
How would they write the mission report without making it sound ridiculous?
The people in Taiping Village were not knowledgeable enough to recognize the deep forest bird species, but Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye knew what it was. It was basic knowledge in the Seek Dao Sect.
"The great Daoist is truly impressive, capturing the demon bird effortlessly!" With the news that the parrot had been caught, the Village Chief and others began to compliment Lu Yang, saying he had deep cultivation.
The couple couldn't help but patiently explain to the villagers that this was a very ordinary bird, just not commonly seen in the northern part of the continent.
"This parrot... or the demon bird as you call it, is best at imitating human speech."
"Imitates human speech, imitates human speech." The parrot kept squawking on the side and Lu Yang held its beak, continuing his explanation to the villagers.
"When it called Zhang Guanjia a monster, it wasn't entirely its own idea. It learned to call 'monster' after listening to Feng the Tailor, it happened to repeat it when it saw Zhang Guanjia."
Zhang Guanjia sighed in relief. The disciple from the Seek Dao Sect indeed cleared his name as soon as he arrived.
"Similarly, when it asked 'Who are you, where is Zhang Guanjia?', it doesn't understand the meaning of this sentence. It just heard it somewhere and repeated it without any significance."
"Damn this damn bird, I'll butcher it." Zhang Guanjia was seething with anger at the parrot.
Lu Yang raised his hand to stop Zhang Guanjia: "This place is half a continent away from the rainforest, this bird definitely didn't fly over here itself, someone brought it."
"Matt, aside from someone who is extremely bored and willing to cross half a continent to bring this parrot which has no other use other than being a novelty, only the Land Money Trade Association would do such a thing."
"Is there a Land Money Trade Association here?"
Village Chief shook his head: "The Association would not set up shop in our small, remote place. But there is one in Quhe County, in the busiest area. It's possible that someone bought the parrot there and accidentally lost it."
The idea of the parrot directly escaping from the Land Money Trade Association was impossible.
Lu Yang asked again: "This bird has been circling around Taiping Village for twenty days, not going anywhere else. Maybe its owner is here, do you have any ideas, Village Chief?"
The Village Chief thought for a while, then said, "Everyone in our village knows about the Demon Bird. If anyone is likely not to know, it would be the Shang family on the east side."
"The Shang family rarely leaves their home and doesn't like to socialize with others. It's said that the head of the Shang family is also a Cultivator. He suffered a setback when he was young and lost a lot of his cultivation level. He has lost his heart for cultivation and has since secluded himself."
"The Shang family is also very wealthy, they are the richest people locally. It wouldn't be surprising if they bought the Demon Bird from the Land Money Trade Association."
"If that's the case, we should go and ask the Shang family."
Taiping Village is not big, three of them, along with the bird, arrived at the Shang family's front door shortly.
Soon after a knock at the door, a man with formal clothing and a van dyke beard opened the door.
"It's the Village Chief, how can I inform the master about your visit? And who are these two?" The bearded man asked.
Lu Yang held the parrot's wing, as if he was holding a chicken to be slaughtered during the New Year visit: "We stumbled upon this parrot when we were passing by. After some inquiries, we thought it might belong to the Shang family, so we came here to ask."
The bearded man looked at Tao Yaoye first and was astonished. He had never seen a woman as beautiful as Tao Yaoye before.
Then, he looked at the green parrot and broke into a happy smile: "I see, thank you both. This must be our Miss's parrot. Ever since the parrot was lost, our Miss has been depressed. It's really troubling for us servants."
"Our Miss will be so happy to hear the parrot is found."
The Village Chief whispered: "He's the housekeeper of the Shang family, Mr. Zhang. He is always the one who opens the door whenever I visit."
Mr. Zhang hurried off to report and quickly received a response.
"The master invites the three of you in."
Passing through the entrance screen, through the front yard, from the second door to the corridor, and finally to the main hall, they met the head of the Shang family.
The owner of the Shang family had a stout body, his face full of gloom keeps people at bay, not willing to have too much conversation. But it was evident that he was quite pleased to see the Village Chief.
"Brother Huang, long time no see."
The Village Chief's surname was Huang.
The two bowed to each other.
The head of the Shang family stared at the parrot for a moment, then nodded: "Hmm, it's correct. This is the bird my daughter bought from the Land Money Trade Association in the county. At the time, I thought this damn bird was not worth much money. The Association was asking an exorbitant price. My daughter wouldn't listen, she insisted on buying it, so I had to oblige her."
"Mr. Zhang, you take these two young heroes to meet Xiao Yuan."
"Yes, sir."
Mr. Zhang gestured for them to follow him and signaled the maid to make tea for the master of the Shang family and Village Chief Huang.
On the way, Tao Yaoye casually asked: "How long has Mr. Zhang been with the Shang family?"
Mr. Zhang respectfully answered: "The master saved me on his way to isolation. Since then, I have been serving by the master's side. It's been twenty years since then. Miss was not born yet at that time."
"So, you and Miss Shang should have a pretty good relationship."
"I won't hide from you, I watched Miss grow up, I have no children of my own, I treat Miss as my own daughter. Miss has been depressed a lot lately, it makes me heartbroken as the housekeeper."
Lu Yang suddenly asked: "Were you there when the parrot was lost?"
Mr. Zhang sighed, there was palpable guilt in his tone: "I was absent-minded and didn't notice when the parrot flew away. If I had paid more attention, Miss wouldn't have been so upset. It was my negligence."
Lu Yang just nodded and didn't say anything else.
Mr. Zhang gently knocked three times and calmly said: "Miss, your lost parrot has been found. Two young heroes traveling around brought it."
A voice inside the room responded: "Let them in."
"Yes."
Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye opened the door. Miss Shang was leaning against the window, quietly reading a book. The evening sunlight shone on her hair, as if time stood still. It was a beautiful moment of serenity.
Many young men in Taiping Village had crushes on Miss Shang.
Lu Yang kindly warned: "Reading in the sunlight is not good for your eyes, especially during the sunset. Go turn on a lamp, it's not like your Dad is short on money."

chapters.title: Chapter 22 - 21 Stay Overnight_1
chapters.content:
Miss Shang's eyes twitched as she put down her book to greet the two men, her voice cold. "Thank you for bringing Xiao Lu back. I'm Shang Yuan."
Upon seeing Shang Yuan, the parrot seemed to have found its saviour. It tried to escape from Lu Yang. Lu Yang let go and let the parrot fly around the room.
"You must be careful next time. Luckily, this parrot has been circling around Taiping Village. Otherwise, if it flew elsewhere, you wouldn't have been able to find it," Lu Yang said, warning them with a smile.
Shang Yuan glanced at the two well-dressed men, who clearly appeared like gallant young heroes who had roamed the martial world for a long time.
Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye were dressed just like the Seek Dao Sect recommended in the Task Hall — the kind to pose as young heroes who had spent a long time roaming the martial world, exhibiting chivalry.
Shang Yuan seemed somewhat aloof. It wasn't clear whether this was due to her personality or something else, "Xiao Lu is back. You two can leave now."
Tao Yaoye frowned slightly, not liking Miss Shang's attitude.
Pretending not to hear her dismissive words, Lu Yang said cheerfully: "Let's chat for a bit. The Shang Family has been welcoming us warmly, they might even ask us to stay for the night."
Shang Yuan scoffed: "Just because the Shang Family welcomes you doesn't mean I do. You'd better leave and it would be best if you left Taiping Village."
"There are no demons or monsters in Taiping Village, so why should we leave? You haven't left the Shang Family for a long time, don't you want to hear about the outside world?" Lu Yang asked.
Surprised by Lu Yang's words, Shang Yuan's tone softened: "Where do the two of you come from? I have not left home for almost a month, would you mind sharing with me what you've seen and heard in the martial world?"
"We are from the Seek Dao Sect, one of the Five Great Immortal Sects. We are both at the Foundation Establishment stage. We came to Taiping Village because we heard that a demon bird was causing trouble..."
Lu Yang spoke slowly and clearly. His tone was gentle, making him a good storyteller.
Learning that they were at the Foundation Establishment stage, a hint of joy flashed in Shang Yuan's eyes.
After chatting for a while, Shang Yuan became fascinated by Lu Yang's description of the adventurous life of a cultivator and also wanted to explore vast, magnificent, and mysterious world.
"I want to cultivate, but my father disagrees. He says cultivation is too dangerous. If it weren't for his good luck when exploring an ancient tomb, he would have died in there."
"I have asked him so many times about his adventures, but he refuses to tell me." Shang Yuan replied angrily, she had an interest in strange and unusual stories, but her own father, despite his personal experiences, refused to share with her.
Lu Yang sighed inwardly. It seemed that the head of the Shang family was also a man with a story.
"What is the head of the Shang Family's cultivation level?"
Thinking of her father's smug face, Shang Yuan rolled her eyes: "He claims to have reached the Ninth Level of Qi Training in the past, but after surviving a great disaster, his cultivation dropped significantly to either the fourth or fifth level."
Tao Yaoye said: "That's not too bad, there aren't many cultivators in Taiping Village, and the strongest one, Village Chief Huang, is only at the seventh level of Qi Training. Someone at fourth or fifth level can live comfortably, let alone the head of the Shang family, who has some resources."
Shang Yuan sighed: "But I don't want to be confined to Quhe County forever. I want to roam the martial world and see the vast and extraordinary universe. We are of the same age, yet you are already at the Foundation Establishment stage, and I have not even started my Qi Training."
Just as Tao Yaoye was about to persuade her, Mr. Zhang, the housekeeper, knocked on the door: "Miss, it's time for dinner. And the two young heroes, your host has specifically asked you to stay the night after dinner considering that it's already late."
"The lady and Village Chief Huang are waiting for you."
"Okay, we're coming." Lu Yang responded.
Tao Yaoye wanted to refuse, but was stopped by Lu Yang: "Look, I have been saying that the people of the Shang Family are warm-hearted. They will let us stay the night. Since they are being so kind, why not accept the invitation?"
...
At the dinner table, the head of the Shang Family was seated at the head, chatting eagerly with Village Chief Huang. Everyone else was enjoying their meal as well. Though it couldn't compare with the food of the Seek Dao Sect, it was still delicious.
Mr. Zhang and the maids stood respectfully to the side, attending to everyone.
After a satisfying dinner, Village Chief Huang went home, while Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye stayed in the east wing of the house, with only a wall separating their rooms.
Tao Yaoye didn't really want to sleep here. She was very picky about her bed. Except for the bed in her abode at the Seek Dao Sect which she could fall asleep in immediately, it took her a long time to fall asleep anywhere else.
Tao Yaoye knew this was not a good habit. As a cultivator, it was common to sleep in different places. She had tried to change, but so far, had not succeeded.
"Senior Brother Lu seems to be able to sleep anywhere."
Tao Yaoye muttered to herself. For some reason, she chuckled softly and then yawned.
"I'm going to bed early today. I should have a good sleep..."
Tao Yaoye suddenly reacted, "No! Someone has poisoned me!"
She turned around to pick up the Thousand Illusion Umbrella to set up a barrier, only to find that the spiritual essence in her body was operating hard to mobilize.
She was shocked to discover that someone had administered poison without her noticing. Who could it be?
This is a poison targeted at cultivators. Whoever did this, knowing she was a cultivator, must be a cultivator too.
Apart from the Head of the Shang Family, she couldn't sense any other cultivators in the family.
Was it the Head of the Shang Family?
Or could there be a cultivator whose cultivation level was too high for her to detect?
What about Senior Brother Lu on the other side?
Questions whirled through Tao Yaoye's mind, leaving her no time to ponder. Light footsteps came from outside the room.
When the door was pushed open, housekeeper Zhang stepped in with led-foot strides, an enthusiastic and cruel smile on his face.
"It's you!" Tao Yaoye's eyes widened in disbelief. The sudden realization that it was Housekeeper Zhang left her disheartened.
The fact that Housekeeper Zhang was a cultivator and she didn't notice, confirmed that his cultivation level was higher than hers.
Housekeeper Zhang held a skinning knife in his hand. From a distance of five steps, Tao Yaoye could sense a strong resentment tied to the knife. Countless had died under its blade, the resentment was overwhelming.
The moonlight fell on the blade, it shimmered brightly, startlingly bright.
Housekeeper Zhang licked his lips, looking at a struggling Tao Yaoye as if she was fierce prey already trapped.
"Such lovely skin. I've never seen such fair, wonderfully contoured skin in my life."
"I'm aware that you're from the Seek Dao Sect. Killing you will involve a lot of complications. The Seek Dao Sect's influence overshadows everything. How would a petty person like me dare to provoke the Seek Dao Sect?"
As he spoke, Housekeeper Zhang drooled, wiping it away while continuing, "But your skin is compelling. It tempts me to take the risk. Since you willingly stayed at the Shang Family for dinner, it's a great chance to poison you. If I don't seize the opportunity, I'm simply ignorant."
There was poison in the dinner!
Seeing Tao Yaoye still struggling, Housekeeper Zhang advised, "Don't bother struggling. Even without the poison, you are no match for me. You have just stepped into the Foundation Establishment Stage, but I'm already at the late stage."
Nonetheless, Housekeeper Zhang was cautious. He could not treat a Seek Dao Sect's Foundation Establishment Stage cultivator as an ordinary one!
He only spoke this way to discourage Tao Yaoye from resisting.
The more she resisted, the tighter the skin and flesh bonded, making it harder to flay. That was an experienced judgment.
"Just relax, it will only hurt a bit, and in a quick moment, you won't fear anymore."
He licked the skinning knife and moved closer to Tao Yaoye.
Suddenly, Tao Yaoye sprang up, her spiritual essence flowing freely. Holding onto the Thousand Illusion Umbrella, she fiercely smashed it into Housekeeper Zhang's face.
Housekeeper Zhang had been sure of his victory, so the attack caught him off guard.
"How come you're not poisoned?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 23 - 22 Who says there is no poison for the skin?_1
chapters.content:
After being hit in the face, Mr. Zhang spun around to deflect the attack, but he still couldn't understand. The poison he had given Tao Yaoye was one of his proudest concoctions; many cultivators had died from it. How could it have failed?
Tao Yaoye didn't answer. Once she confirmed that the parrot was indeed Miss Shang's, she became even more alert.
Everyone in the village knew about a talking demon bird flying around. If the Shang Family had simply sent someone to look for it, they would have found the parrot, and none of this would have happened.
The Shang Family's actions were clearly suspicious!
Adding to that was Miss Shang's standoffish attitude. Instead of dismissing them, it felt like she was warning them of danger in the Shang Family and urging them to leave immediately.
A casual voice came from behind, answering Tao Yaoye: "The compulsory course for Seek Dao Sect recruits, 'One Thousand Eight Hundred Types of Common Poisons and Their Antidotes', would you like to take a look?"
The poison that Mr. Zhang prided himself on was a joke in the eyes of Seek Dao Sect. No matter how capable you are at brewing poison, could it be stronger than the poison concocted on Elixir Cauldron Peak?
Mr. Zhang turned around abruptly and saw Lu Yang leaning against the door frame with an ancient sword in his arms, smiling at him.
Mr. Zhang then realized that Tao Yaoye was not the prey, he was.
He asked in a deep voice, "How did you discover me?"
He didn't believe that he had given himself away. The Shang family members were all under his control and no one had leaked any secrets.
While Shang Yuan and Lu Yang were talking in the room, he started eavesdropping instead of extending his spiritual sense due to the fear of being detected. This led him to discover that the two were disciples of the Seek Dao Sect.
But even then, Shang Yuan did not mention his identity.
Mr. Zhang had excellent hearing abilities. Even the slightest drawing or writing couldn't escape his ears.
Lu Yang laughed and asked, "Do you know what the parrot said in the village?"
"What?"
"It said, 'Who are you, where is Zhang Guanjia?'"
"At first, we thought the parrot was looking for Zhang Guanjia, but we later discovered that it was just mindlessly repeating the phrase. That's when I started wondering. Zhang Guanjia is not a wanderer, where did the parrot hear this from?"
"What if the parrot wasn't saying 'Who are you, where is Zhang Guanjia?', but instead 'Who are you, where is Mr. Zhang?'?
Lu Yang imagined a scenario:
Twenty days ago, Miss Shang accidentally discovered that Mr. Zhang had been replaced by someone else. Terrified, she blurted out: "Who are you, where is Mr. Zhang?" She then knocked over the birdcage, causing the parrot to fly away. This was the last sentence the parrot heard. So later on, when faced with Village Chief Huang in the tailor shop, the parrot repeated this sentence.
Perhaps it was due to the parrot's unclear enunciation, or perhaps Village Chief Huang's first thought was of Zhang Guanjia, who he interacted with the most. Either way, the parrot's sentence turned into "Who are you, where is Zhang Guanjia?"
Mr. Zhang was furious. He never anticipated that such a simple-minded parrot would ruin his plans.
If he had known, he would have killed it at the outset!
Mr. Zhang was no novice to survival in the cultivation world. Surrounded by the two, he laughed loudly: "I am at the late stage of Foundation Establishment. If I want to escape, are you capable of stopping me?"
Tao Yaoye was somewhat anxious. If Mr. Zhang managed to escape, the only option would be to report back to the Sect and let her senior brothers and sisters handle the situation. The chances of being able to track him down were slim.
This made Tao Yaoye feel slightly embarrassed. She had successfully completed two missions, yet an unexpected event had occurred on her third.
Lu Yang, however, remained calm, a sight that unnerved Mr. Zhang: "Have you ever thought about this, if you can poison us, can't we poison you too?"
Upon hearing this, Mr. Zhang relaxed and said scornfully: "I thought it was something more serious. Poison, what use does that have against me?"
As he spoke, Mr. Zhang's skin began to sag, separating from his flesh, much like a snake shedding its skin. The shed skin took on a complete human shape, standing in the middle of the room. Its hollow facial features stared at Tao Yaoye, giving one the chills. The skinless body, however, collapsed to the ground with a thud.
A Skin-Peeling Ghost.
Tao Yaoye's expression was serious as she realized why Mr. Zhang had said that poison was useless against him.
Poison usually targeted the body - more precisely, the internal organs, muscles, and meridians. Mr. Zhang was a Skin-Peeling Ghost, his true form was only skin. Who would think of poisoning the skin?
And who had ever heard of poison designed specifically for the skin? At least Mr. Zhang never had.
But Lu Yang did.
Just as Mr. Zhang was preparing to boast about his abilities, he found to his horror that sores as large as green beans had grown on his feet. His skin started to peel off in layers, and the sores swelled and itched like mad. Scratching them caused them to burst. Having only brushed his feet against the ground a few times, a thick yellow liquid began to ooze out.
"What... what is happening?!" Mr. Zhang exclaimed, a sense of astonishment creeping into his tone.
Mr. Zhang had never encountered such a thing. When had he been poisoned?
"Athlete's foot."
"What?" Mr. Zhang thought he had heard wrong.
"You thought I was just making small talk with you just now? No, I was waiting for your disease to take effect."
"I knew you would come for Tao Yaoye, so I left a poison in this room in advance that would cause athlete's foot!"
Mr. Zhang turned pale.
Tao Yaoye turned dark.
Lu Yang grinned and began to approach Mr. Zhang step by step, causing him to retreat and fall on his behind.
"How... how did you know I was a Skin-Peeling Ghost?!" Only if they had known his true identity in advance could they have poisoned him so specifically!
The key point was, Mr. Zhang had never heard of a Skin-Peeling Ghost contracting athlete's foot before!
His feet were now itching to the point of madness, compelling him to consider amputating them. The disease forced him to expend a significant amount of energy and magical power to suppress the poison, leaving him unable to escape.
Suddenly, his vision blurred and Lu Yang disappeared from sight.
"Impossible!" Mr. Zhang glowed with rage. Lu Yang was only in the early stage of Foundation Establishment. Even if his agility was exceptional, he couldn't evade Mr. Zhang's keen eyes.
"It's an illusion!" He reacted and quickly rolled away to escape.
Unfortunately, it was already too late. A cold light flashed, quick as lightning. A thin line traced from Mr. Zhang's forehead to his pelvis. Lu Yang sheathed his sword, and Mr. Zhang was split into two, his broken interior as flat as mirrors.
"Not bad." Lu Yang gave a thumbs up to Tao Yaoye.
Earlier, Tao Yaoye had used the Thousand Illusion Umbrella, putting Mr. Zhang in an illusory state. The illusion wasn't perfect, Mr. Zhang, who had extensive experience, was able to see through it in a moment's hesitation.
What Lu Yang needed was that fleeting moment of hesitation. He drew his sword, executed a vertical strike, and sheathed his sword in one fluid motion.
The Skin-Peeling Ghost was known for his oddity, not his defense. When faced with a sword cultivator with the strongest attack power, plus hesitating and without the preparation to defend himself, the fight's outcome was decided in one move, with no suspense!
The advantage of the Skin-Peeling Ghost disappeared the moment Lu Yang identified him.
The Skin-Peeling Ghost stared at Lu Yang in disbelief. With his mouth opening and closing, it appeared as if he was asking: How did you recognize my true form?
Tao Yaoye looked at Lu Yang, she also wanted to know the answer.
Lu Yang did not say anything. Instead, he swung his sword once more, slicing the Skin-Peeling Ghost into four pieces. He doused them with Spirit Wine, lit a fire, and burned them to ashes amidst wretched screams.
Who knew what kind of tricks this ghost creature could have up its sleeve? It was better to kill him first and explain later.

chapters.title: Chapter 24 - 23: The Past of the Head of the Shang Family (Alliance Leader Inevitably Rewarded by Book Friends Star)_1
chapters.content:
"How did you know he was a skin-peeling ghost?" Tao Yaoye asked the question that remained unanswered by the late Mr. Zhang.
Lu Yang was cleaning up after the battle, sweeping the ashes of the skin-peeling ghost into a small pile which Tao Yaoye helpfully collected into a dustpan.
"It's quite simple, I recalled what the parrot said. 'Who are you and where is Mr. Zhang?'
"After we met Shang Yuan, she deliberately drove us away, keeping us far from the Shang Family.
"This indicates that the current Mr. Zhang is no longer the person Miss Shang knew and was extremely dangerous.
"There are three possibilities for the replacement of Mr. Zhang's identity."
"First, Mr. Zhang was possessed. But why would such a ghost linger in the Shang Family for so long? Personally, if I had possessed someone, the first thing I would do was to leave Taiping Village and seek a Feng Shui treasure land to continue my cultivation. Moreover, Mr.
Zhang's talent isn't quite remarkable, whoever possessed him would have done better possessing the head of Shang Family," Lu Yang explained, putting himself in the ghost's shoes.
"Second, someone disguised himself as Mr. Zhang. But this doesn't make sense either, the Shang Family doesn't have many valuable assets. Why would someone want to pose as a housekeeper? Does he have a fetish for servitude? Even if the Shang Family had valuable assets, why wouldn't he just rob them directly?
With his late-stage Foundation Establishment level of cultivation, he could do as he pleased in Taiping Village.
"The third possibility is that he is a skin-peeling ghost. These creatures love to collect human skins, disguise themselves as humans and live amongst us."
Skin-peeling ghosts were once human, but became ghosts upon death; a form of ghost cultivators. Most types of ghost cultivators suffer from some sort of psychological disorder.
For example, skin-peeling ghosts detest being unveiled. They strive to convince themselves that they are human, speaking and acting like one. When they grow tired of one identity, they change to a new one, repeating this cycle."
Lu Yang's reasoning was sound and convincing, Tao Yaoye was impressed, and she couldn't help but admire his clear-headedness, quite far from the nervous Senior Brother Lu she had seen on the flying boat.
Despite possessing the same knowledge as Lu Yang, Tao Yaoye found herself unable to think as deeply as he did in such a short time. It was a difference of cognitive agility.
"Sweep up the ashes, they are the proof of our completed mission," said Lu Yang as he took out a small white porcelain jar to contain the ashes of the skin-peeling ghost.
The encounter with the skin-peeling ghost was an extension of the main quest, and killing it would certainly yield a greater reward than finding the parrot.
Outside, the sound of footsteps approached the gate, stopping abruptly as if several people had just woken up from a dreadful dream and didn't dare to enter the room.
The identities of the people outside were not difficult to guess. Lu Yang laughed heartily, "Head of the Shang Family, you can come in now. I've slain the skin-peeling ghost. It's safe here."
With a loud creak, the door was pushed open by the head of the Shang Family. Behind him stood his wife and daughter, as well as the maidservants and manservants, a total of twelve people, all presenting expressions of relief after a narrow escape.
"Many thanks to you, sages, for eliminating the skin-peeling ghost, and saving the lives of our twelve members of the Shang Family!" The head of the Shang Family knelt down, with the others following suit.
The unpredictable skin-peeling ghost could have killed them all once tired of its housekeeper persona!
"You're too kind, Head of the Shang Family. As disciples of the Seek Dao Sect, it's our duty to slay demons and uphold righteousness," Lu Yang replied, slightly taken aback by the dramatic display while quickly helping everyone to their feet.
"Please forgive us, esteemed sages, for the ghost's elusive nature and unpredictable actions. We had no idea where it came from."
"Ever since it started impersonating Mr. Zhang, the ghost wouldn't allow us to leave the Shang Family. No one was allowed to reveal its secret, anyone who dared to do so would meet their doom!"
At this point, Shang Yuan, standing to one side, couldn't hide her guilt. As a gentle lady of a prestigious family, all the coldhearted actions she had taken while in her boudoir were merely intended to keep Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye distant from danger.
Shang Zhongtian, the head of the Shang Family, continued with a sincere tone, "Alas, I am just a retired man living in the countryside, all my wealth as a cultivator has been converted into gold and gems, which would be useless to you as a reward.
If you need anything, even if I have to sell my estate, I will do my utmost to fulfill it." This was not mere politeness, but a genuine offer to express his gratitude for their lifesaving aid.
In the eyes of the disciples of the Seek Dao Sect, his wealth was nearly worthless.
However, Lu Yang did have a request.
"I heard that you experienced a life-threatening horror during a tomb raid, which led you to wash your hands of the Cultivation World. May I know what exactly happened back then?"
Tao Yaoye looked at Shang Zhongtian with keen interest. Tomb raiding, life and death, great horror, severance from the world; all these sounded like an intriguing story, possibly even holding grand opportunities. She always enjoyed exploring unknown and mysterious places.
Although Lu Yang wasn't as excited about exploring the unknown as Tao Yaoye, he was interested in hearing stories of strange events.
The head of the Shang Family's eye twitched involuntarily. To be honest, he had no desire to recall that terrifying past, however, he couldn't refuse to answer their question as they had saved his life.
He dispersed the crowd, especially Shang Yuan who tried to stay covertly, leaving only Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye behind.
"You cannot repeat what I am about to tell you today."
Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye nodded in agreement.
Confirmed with their response, the head of the Shang Family began telling the story of what happened twenty years ago.
"Thirty years ago, I, Shang Zhongtian, was quite well-known as a tomb raider in the Qi Refinement Stage. Even if others detested me, I was quite notorious," The Head of the Shang Family reminisced his glorious past with a prideful tone and hands on his hips.
Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye were a bit puzzled, unclear as to why Shang Zhongtian seemed so pleased with his infamy.
What they didn't know was that it was quite a competitive business between tomb raiders. Being notorious meant having exceptional skills.
"When I raided tombs, I was always cautious. I never touched big or ancient tombs. All of us in the trade know that big tombs have ghosts, and ancient ones have immortals."
The 'ghosts' referred to here were not merely skin-peeling ghosts of the Foundation Establishment Stage, but the more powerful entities among ghosts.
"Qi Refinement cultivators are poor. Their valuable belongings are passed onto the next generation. So, their graves don't contain anything worth looting."
"Foundation Establishment and Golden Core Stage cultivators possess considerable assets. After death, they would habitually leave some of their wealth for their descendants and use the rest as funerary goods. That small portion alone could make me quite a fortune."
"Unfortunately, who could always remain dry if frequently walking by the river? There was one time when I was excavating a Golden Core tomb and found out, to my surprise, that it was a grave within a grave. The Golden Core grave was the accompaniment to the main grave, which belonged to a Nascent Soul Stage cultivator!"
"According to the rules of our profession, one should not dig graves of cultivators significantly higher than their own level. However, I was so thrilled at the time. I was at the peak of Qi Refinement, and even considered that if I ran, I would be as fast as a Foundation Establishment cultivator.
Since tomb raiding didn't involve battling, I could count myself as a Foundation Establishment cultivator by rounding up, so I thought there was nothing dangerous in digging up a Nascent Soul Stage grave that had just fallen into my lap."
"So, after offering incense to our ancestors for their blessings, I began digging the Nascent Soul Stage grave."

chapters.title: Chapter 25 - 24 Great Terror_1
chapters.content:
Shang Zhongtian spoke in a low voice, "I treaded carefully along the cold and dry tunnel, lit on both sides by fist-sized Night Pearls that had been glowing for who knows how many years. Their dim blue light only illuminated figures without revealing any facial features. I felt a lingering sensation of being watched, and it made my hair stand on end.
But when I turned around, there was nothing to be found. I merely thought it was some illusion."
"I followed the light through the rugged passage to the main tomb."
"The scale of the main tomb was breathtaking. For a moment, I forgot that this was a dark and terrifying tomb."
Shang Zhongtian paused, eyes closed, as though he was recounting the minute details of the scene he observed. After he finished recalling, he slowly started, "I have never seen a tomb of this magnitude. The ceiling was so high that it appeared like the dome of the sky. Under the dome, numerous clay soldiers wielding sharp copper spears were faithfully guarding the tomb.
The spectacular funerary objects were arrayed in the Eight Diagrams formation. All of them which mysteriously embodied the general laws of nature."
"The ancient corpse that had been dead for centuries was still emanating terrifying waves of energy from the coffin that made my heart palpitate. It was as if the Old Freak of the Nascent Soul Stage hadn't died and was merely sleeping, on the verge of awakening."
"Indecision isn't in my nature, I made an immediate decision, and took half of the funerary objects. Just as I was about to leave, the sound of footsteps echoed in the bare tomb, sending a chill down my spine."
"What happened next was something horrifying that I had never experienced in my years of entering the profession."
At this point, both Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye leaned forward, eager to hear the rest of the story.
Shang Zhongtian displayed an expression of extreme anguish, his voice trembling, "I encountered the descendants of that Nascent Soul Stage individual who came to worship their ancestor!"
"What?" Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye heard clearly but hadn't registered in.
"These people brought offerings and magic artifacts to pay tribute to their ancestors—praying for their family's longevity, the constant emergence of talented individuals, and successful careers in life. Along the way of their visit, they noticed my presence in the tomb and apprehended me. It was so horrible at that moment, even recalling it now sends cold sweats down my forehead."
"... I think their reaction was pretty normal", Lu Yang spoke the truth—considering you were not killed on the spot means they exercised good restraint."
"So this is your so-called great terror?" Tao Yaoye asked.
Shang Zhongtian scratched his head, not understanding their reaction, "Exactly, meeting the descendants of the tomb's owner while robbing a tomb; could anything be more terrifying than that?"
"And then?"
"Then, I got a good beating which caused my realm to fall from the peak Qi Refinement to mid-stage Qi Refinement. I was thrown into jail and the government made me compensate with all the stolen items. After being incarcerated for ten years, I decided to turn over a new leaf and start a new life, away from all these troubles."
"To be honest."
"I can't show face in my field anymore."
"..."
Shang Zhongtian's sincerity left both Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye at a loss on what to say.
After Shang Zhongtian personally took care of the burial of Mr. Zhang's skinless body, he invited Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye to stay an extra night before leaving. But Tao Yaoye declined the offer.
If it were not for the plan to draw out the Skin-Peeling Ghost, Tao Yaoye would have never chosen to stay overnight. Traveling at night posed no difficulties for two individuals at the Foundation Establishment Stage.
Before leaving, Lu Yang went back to find Shang Yuan and gently pet the parrot's head.
If the people of Taiping Village hadn't mistaken the parrot for a Demon Beast, he wouldn't have had the opportunity to handle the Skin-Peeling Ghost in the Shang Family's home.
"This parrot isn't bad, it might really be a Demon Beast, you should cultivate it well."
Shang Yuan was startled and quickly inquired about the reason.
"The strength of a Demon Beast in the Early Stage is quite uncertain; it's not easy to differentiate it from a wild beast—I couldn't make out a thing."
"But Xiao Lu didn't go far after leaving your house. Instead, it kept flying around Taiping Village. It knew your home was in danger yet didn't approach. It could have been a coincidence, or it might be a precursor to developing its intelligence. It's hard to say."
Lu Yang just smiled, not saying anything more.
Shang Zhongtian felt he hadn't been a good host. After all, they had saved twelve lives in the Shang Family. But all he could offer in return was to share the story of his retirement.
"These are my experiences of tomb raiding. If you don't mind, you can have them. It might come in handy one day." Shang Zhongtian took a blue book out from his breast and handed it over.
Lu Yang accepted politely. After that, they bid their farewell.
On their way back, Lu Yang asked, "Do you want this book on tomb raiding experiences?"
Tao Yaoye shook her head; she has no interest in tomb raiding, so she doesn't need such a book.
Lu Yang also felt it was of no use, but still kept it.
"Why didn't you tell me when you were poisoning my room?" Tao Yaoye still held a grudge about this matter.
Lucky for her, as a Feather Transformation Immortal body, she was highly resistant to all poisons, otherwise, wouldn't she have ended up with athlete's foot like Mr. Zhang?
Is it appropriate for a beautiful girl to catch an athlete's foot?
Lu Yang shrugged. Of course, he had released the poison after confirming that the poison would not harm Tao Yaoye: "I did tell you."
"When?"
"During dinner, with my eyes."
"Oh, so you weren't asking me to pass your dish?"
"I'm not that superficial."
The two of them successfully returned to the Seek Dao Sect, coincidentally, Meng Jingzhou had also just completed his task and was complaining to the Senior Brother who assigned the task.
"Junior Brother Meng Jingzhou, your task was pretty straightforward, how did it end with a complaint from the Fox Demon about your attitude and unwillingness to cooperate?" The Senior Brother was somewhat puzzled. They were just offering a book of Dual Cultivation Techniques, what attitude problem could there be?
"Senior Brother, I am telling you, there's something suspicious about that Fox Demon. I was just going there to provide Dual Cultivation Techniques, but she demanded to 'inspect the goods' and insisted that we practise the Dual Cultivation Techniques together to test their authenticity."
An angry Meng Jingzhou said, "If it wasn't for the fact that I have a pure yang body and couldn't break my virginity, I would have practised the Dual Cultivation Techniques with her!"
It was unclear whether he was angry at the fact that his pure yang body had deprived him of an extraordinary encounter, or whether he was offended by the Fox Demon undermining his commitment to the path of cultivation.
Seeing the task-assigning Senior Brother looking helpless, Lu Yang stepped forward to help out: "Senior Brother, we have completed the task of dealing with the Demon Beast."
Lu Yang went into detail about how the people of Taiping Village had mistaken a parrot for a talking Demon Beast, how he and Tao Yaoye had lured out the Skin-Peeling Ghost and subsequently dealt with it.
In the end, Lu Yang handed over the ashes of the Skin-Peeling Ghost to the Senior Brother.
"To have executed the task so successfully on the first attempt is quite impressive." The Senior Brother looked at Lu Yang with newfound respect. When he had assigned this task, he had thought it to be quite straightforward and had not expected the additional complications.
Hearing how Lu Yang had employed the poison tactically and how he dealt with the Skin-Peeling Ghost swiftly, raised his admiration to another level. If the ghost hadn't been poisoned, subduing it would have been a challenge, and it might even have slipped away.
Most importantly, this junior brother was carrying a poison that could infect someone with athlete's foot. The senior brother, considering this, subtly moved his seat farther away.
"Both of you have exceeded the task requirements, hence your original contribution points are quadrupled. You'll receive 120 contribution points, and Junior Sister Tao Yaoye, who played a supportive role, will receive 90 contribution points."
Tao Yaoye had no objections. In this task, Lu Yang played a vital role while she was merely bait.

chapters.title: Chapter 26 - 25: The Bizarre Exchange List_1
chapters.content:
The contribution points are a type of currency circulated within the Seek Dao Sect. They are used for buying goods within the sect, eating in the dining hall, and for transactions among disciples.
Moreover, the special rewards available in the Task Hall also required contribution points.
For example, the highly coveted but unaffordable "One-day experience as the Sect Leader of Seek Dao Sect".
As the name suggests, upon redeeming this reward, you can be the Sect Leader for a day, hold meetings with the Elders, handle sect affairs, be recognized as the sect leader, commanding respect and authority, and enjoy the privileges of the highest leadership among the Five Great Immortal Sects...
The benefits are many, but unfortunately, the contribution points required are too high, and so far, no one has been able to redeem it.
It is said that several Senior Brothers were planning to pool funds to exchange for this reward, but they fell into a dispute over "who should stand as Sect Leader", ending up in a big fight. Eventually, they were all taken to Elixir Cauldron Peak for treatment, attracting a crowd.
Now, these Senior Brothers have been doing long-term tasks outside the sect and have not returned to the Seek Dao Sect for quite some time.
Take "Medicine King Spirit Liquid" for example. The description states that it is a valuable elixir specially refined by the high-ranking members of the Seek Dao Sect and is unique. It can be taken internally or applied externally. It strengthens the body, boosts vital energy, solidifies the divine soul, and consolidates cultivation.
Despite its high cost in contribution points, it is still a popular product among the Senior Brothers and Sisters due to its benefits.
Having a sip during a battle ensures the restoration of energy and magic power and accelerates wound healing. Those who have used it have been full of praise.
For example, the "Accidental Insurance for Flying Ships", which can be purchased for just one contribution point.
"Wait a moment, why is there Accident Insurance for Flying Ships?" Lu Yang felt that this term was somewhat ominous.
The Senior Brother responsible for task issuance said matter-of-factly, "It's quite normal. There isn't any transportation which is 100% safe. Even the flying ships operated by the Land Money Trade Association can encounter accidents, like colliding with a Great Power, landing gear failure, the captain going on strike for a pay rise... these are all common accidents.
Fortunately, none has resulted in fatalities so far, so it's nothing unusual."
"When the chairman of Land Money Trade Association found out that accidents frequently occur on flying ships, he felt it was quite a risk. So, he proposed that passengers pay a small amount of money to be pooled together. In case an accident occurs, the association draws a huge amount of money from this pool to compensate the passengers."
"In this way, if nothing happens to the ship, passengers only pay a little insignificant amount of money. If an accident does occur and disrupts the passengers' plans, they'll be compensated."
"The chairman named this model 'Risk Coverage', simply referred to as 'Insurance', and aggressively promoted it in other businesses."
"However, you need not worry. Our Seek Dao Sect will always take good care of its disciples. When it comes to insurance, we've always been very generous. In fact, we've already purchased various types of insurance for you when you joined the sect, including Accident Insurance for Flying Ships. Insurance sold in the reward column serves to increase the compensation amount."
With a look of "our sect is of the Righteous Path, unlike those sects of the Demon Path who live from day to day, we will ensure that all necessary insurance is provided", the Senior Brother seemed quite reliable.
"Our Cultivation World is really developing rapidly, even having things like insurance."
Lu Yang's mouth twitched. In his memory, in the past world, insurance was a product of marine transportation. He didn't expect it to be a product of flying ship transportation in the Cultivation World.
He felt that this was ill-fated and better to buy other items.
In the Cultivation World, it's necessary to be somewhat superstitious.
As if hearing Lu Yang's inner voice, the Senior Brother went on to say, "However, a Great Power who studied causality proposed that buying insurance might establish a causal relationship with risks, thereby increasing chances of risks."
"The trade association staunchly denied this possibility. Both sides debated for a long time, but no formal conclusion was reached."
"This topic is very research-worthy in the Cultivation World. If the conclusion of the research is that a causal relationship exists, you will be favored by the Great Power who proposed it. If the conclusion is that no causal relationship exists, then the Land Money Trade Association will favor you. It's a sure-win situation."
Lu Yang thought to himself that, if his research concluded that there was a causal relationship, the trade association would probably want to butcher him.
"One contribution point can be exchanged for one hundred low-grade spirit stones, and one hundred and twenty low-grade spirit stones can be exchanged for one contribution point."
"Blood Drinking Flying Sword, two thousand contribution points. The longer it's soaked in blood, the greater it's power. Judging from the description, it doesn't seem much like a weapon of the Righteous Path, does it?"
The Senior Brother explained, "It doesn't necessarily have to be soaked in human blood. Pig blood, cow blood, duck blood are all acceptable. I heard a few days ago that the shop owners who sell Sichuan Hot Pot came up to the mountain and complained. They were questioning which rascal secretly soaked their Blood Drinking Flying Sword in their duck blood?"
"After several investigations, the culprit was found. The punishment given by the hot pot shop owner was to make him drink a pot of red oily soup base. The scene was quite something. I reckon he wouldn't want to eat hot pot again in this lifetime." The Senior Brother made several clicking sounds, his expression quite subtle, hinting at whatever he might have seen.
Lu Yang continued to browse, "A bottle of Fasting Pill of any flavor, one contribution point."
"Ancestral Secret Barbecue Recipe, one hundred contribution points."
"Treasure Sword Floating Array, twenty-five contribution points. This array can be inscribed on weapons, hung at the back, and used anytime due to the lack of constraints from the scabbard. It also includes protective arrays, which can protect the sword under the weather."
After pondering it over, Lu Yang felt this array set was quite handy. He went ahead and made the purchase.
This array was a semi-hidden array etched in the air. When it fell on the ancient sword, it evaporated like a drop of water in the air, disappearing entirely. The ancient sword simply hovered quietly behind Lu Yang, which was very cool.
As Lu Yang turned around, the ancient sword moved along with him without any lag or delay.
"What a good item."
"Ten Bulls Strength Pill? One hundred contribution points, one thousand contribution points, ten thousand contribution points? The masterwork of Master Refiner Wu Ming. After taking this pill, one can obtain the strength of ten bulls, capable of sweeping thousands of troops. Usable from the Foundation Establishment Stage to the Nascent Soul Stage."
Lu Yang thought that if it were not for the half-poisoned Wu Ming, the price would definitely be higher.
However, from the description, this pill was no doubt a treasure. It was extremely effective in battle and worth trying out.
"Junior Sister Tao, I'm sorry for the inconvenience, but do you use contribution points to buy things? I would like to borrow five contribution points. I will return them after I complete my next task."
Contribution points can be transferred among members.
Junior Sister Tao needed a lot of contribution points to buy things, so lending five more or less doesn't make much difference to her.
"Sure."
Lu Yang briskly bought a Ten Bulls Strength Pill.
The task-issuing Senior Brother passed a small porcelain bottle to Lu Yang. Inside the bottle was a golden-colored pill that shimmered slightly under the sunlight, signaling obvious quality.
"I promised earlier that we would celebrate properly when you establish your foundation. I've made a reservation at the Hundred Fragrance Building. Let's go, let's have a meal. I guarantee everything will be to your taste," laughed Meng Jingzhou, who also enthusiastically invited Junior Sister Tao.
"Junior Sister Tao, would you like to join us?"
As Meng Jingzhou came in second when they joined the sect, he was a Senior Brother to Junior Sister Tao.
Even though Lu Yang has acrophobia, is a serial liar, and even placed a poison in her room without informing her, Junior Sister Tao still considered him a friend since they had completed tasks together.
"Okay, I'll go."

chapters.title: Chapter 27 - 26: The Origin of the Meng Family_1
chapters.content:
Seek Dao Sect operated many businesses which provided various entertainment services for its cultivators. Cultivation wasn't practicing in seclusion to death, and an uninteresting life would not lead to immortality, hence the entertainment businesses were vital.
For instance, the aforementioned Sichuan Hot Pot and the Hundred Fragrance Building which the trio were heading to.
Lu Yang had heard that Seek Dao Sect used to not operate in this manner. Previously, cultivation was cultivation, indulging in these miscellaneous things could hamper one's devotion to seeking the Dao.
But once the older Sect Leader and Elders retired, and the new Sect Leader and his eight Elders took control, Seek Dao Sect took on a whole new life, encouraging their members to strike a balance between training and leisure.
In their words, if these things could affect one's devotion to seeking the Dao, then they're not fit to become immortals.
Lu Yang felt that the current Seek Dao Sect had lost its proper discipline. When he became one of the high-ranking members of the Sect, he would definitely reform it.
The Hundred Fragrance Building was bustling with patrons, many Seek Dao Sect disciples liked to gather here to eat and share their experiences and revelations from their tasks or training.
At the very least, the food here was more palatable than in the canteen.
"Waiter, I made a reservation for table number nine, three sets of bowl and chopsticks."
"Alright, please take your seats."
They were seated on the second floor, the appetizing aroma from other tables whiffed by, stimulating their appetites while making them salivate.
Lu Yang kept his eyes on the waiter for quite some time until the waiter disappeared at the stairs. He realized he couldn't see through the waiter's cultivation level.
Both Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye were looking around curiously.
Lu Yang usually had his meals on Sky Gate Mountain, while Tao Yaoye knew how to cook, so they didn't have to come here.
Meng Jingzhou, familiar with such places, said, "Never been here before, right? Let me tell you, there are lots of delicious dishes here that you can't imagine. Just take a look at the menu."
Lu Yang opened the menu, the first page immediately grabbed his attention.
The first page didn't contain any dishes, but a clear notice: "We only serve finished dishes, we do not sell raw ingredients. Please understand."
The actual menu started from the second page, where all the dishes had two prices: "Contribution Points" and "Spirit Stones".
"Steamed Lightning Tribulation Liquid, the essence of lightning left after a cultivator passes their tribulation. It greatly aids in understanding the Dao of lightning."
"Braised Ice Abyss Mammoth, the Ice Abyss Mammoth which lives in the extreme north is the dominant species there. A grown Ice Abyss Mammoth can shatter glaciers with a stomp and face down avalanches without falling."
"Tomato scrambled eggs. We offer a variety of eggs including common chicken eggs, Eight Treasures Chicken Eggs, and Golden Wing Roc Eggs."
Looking at the prices, Lu Yang couldn't help but gasp. Clearly, these dishes weren't meant for cultivators at the Foundation Establishment stage like them, who couldn't afford it.
However, there were also things that he could afford, such as Stir-fried fasting pills, and so on.
Seeing Lu Yang's furrowed brows, Tao Yaoye assumed he was apprehensive about the prices and couldn't help asking, "What's wrong? Are you having a problem?"
"Look, fasting means consuming the spiritual energy of heaven and earth instead of food. Taking fasting pills would allow you to fast."
"Right." Tao Yaoye nodded.
"Well, wouldn't you say if you eat stir-fried fasting pills, would it count as eating or fasting?"
Tao Yaoye and Meng Jingzhou were taken aback at once. At first, they regarded this question as absurd, but after thinking it over, they found the question profoundly intriguing.
They called over the waiter and asked him, but even the waiter, who had worked there a long time, was stumped and had no answer.
Was it because the dishes were slow to arrive and they were bored?
"The prices here are quite steep. Do you have enough contribution points?" Lu Yang didn't dwell on the matter of stir-fry fasting pills, but instead was worried whether they had enough money to cover their meal.
Meng Jingzhou had only done three missions in total, he wouldn't have earned many points.
Inviting Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye for a feast and then having all three of them wash the dishes seemed like a scenario within Meng Jingzhou's tastes.
"Why use contribution points? Of course, we use spirit stones." Meng Jingzhou replied with a voice full of arrogance.
Tao Yaoye looked at Lu Yang in surprise, unsure why he would be concerned about someone from the Meng Family lacking money. "Haven't you heard of the Meng Family?" she asked.
Lu Yang was confused, "Is Meng Jingzhou's Meng Family very famous?"
The Central Continent was expansive and there were many families bearing the name of Meng. Lu Yang had no way of knowing which Meng Family Meng Jingzhou was from.
Even though he had known Meng Jingzhou for a long time, Meng Jingzhou had never talked about his family.
When Meng Jingzhou had come to Seek Dao Sect to participate in the trial, he didn't bring any senior relatives along. Lu Yang thought that his family had declined and was relying on Meng Jingzhou, who had the Single Body Spiritual Root, to revitalize the family.
"The most famous one."
Lu Yang was flabbergasted, realizing which Meng Family Meng Jingzhou was from.
There were many Meng Families, but if one had to say which was the most famous, it would definitely be the Meng Family from Imperial City.
"Is it...the Imperial City Meng Family that fought side by side with the ancestors of Emperor Xia to establish the Great Xia dynasty?!"
The news truly shocked Lu Yang. The Meng Family from Imperial City had a significant origin. A hundred thousand years ago, the world was in chaos and it was often said that heroes emerged during such times. The ancestors of the Meng Family and Emperor Xia rose to the challenge and battled across the land. Their feats gave rise to a legendary story that was still widely known today.
The story could be heard from the storytellers in teahouses and seen performed on stage, its popularity never declined.
A hundred thousand years ago, the previous dynasty was plagued with internal strife and external threats, leading to its eventual fragmentation and the start of a chaotic era. The Demon Barbarians and Sea Beasts left their territories, wanting to share the bountiful Central Continent.
The ancestors of the Meng Family rose from their homeland in the east. They went on military expeditions east and west, fought battles across countless miles, forced the Demon Barbarians to flee back to Demon Territory and the Sea Beasts to retreat to the East Sea. All beltway heroes and villains bowed their heads in submission.
The ancestors of the Meng Family led their troops for a thousand years, conquering half the Central Continent, becoming one of the only two overlords.
The other overlord was the ancestor of Emperor Xia, who had also conquered the other half.
Like the ancestor of the Meng Family, the ancestor of Emperor Xia expelled Demon Barbarians and Sea Beasts, putting an end to the chaotic world, ruling over half of Central Continent. It was hard to determine whose achievement was greater.
Everyone at that time believed these two overlords either each controlled half of Central Continent or would start a huge battle for control of the entire continent.
All manner of strategists began making speculations, analyzing who had the advantage and how the underdog could upset the situation with weaker strength.
Unexpectedly, the ancestors of both the Meng Family and Emperor Xia believed that the continent had been in chaos for a thousand years which resulted in countless suffering and bloodshed, resembling the landscape of the underworld. If the war continued, it would not be known how many more years of chaos and deaths would follow.
Their fight across the continent was to restore peace and not for the imperial throne.
Therefore, the ancestors of the Meng Family and Emperor Xia gave up their armies and fought as cultivators in the vast starry sky. That battle cracked the sky and the earth, blocked the light of the sun and the moon, made stars fall, and eventually, the ancestor of Emperor Xia, who was more skilled, emerged the victor.
The ancestor of the Meng Family lost the bet and gracefully stepped down.
Then, the ancestor of Emperor Xia publicly declared that as long as the Great Xia existed for one day, the Meng Family would never perish.
And so it was. After the establishment of the Great Xia, the Meng Family settled in the Imperial City and did not face any repression.

chapters.title: Chapter 28 - 27 Breakthrough in Hundred Fragrance Building_1
chapters.content:
The royal family and the Meng Family have a close relationship, often linked by marriage.
Geniuses from the Meng Family continually emerge. Just when the world believes that the Meng Family's foundation has been exhausted and its descendants lack the strength to uphold the family's reputation, a genius springs into existence, lifting the heavy responsibility of the Meng Family and continuing its immortal legend.
Therefore, it is rumored that the Meng Family has tied its luck to the fortune of the Great Xia Dynasty. As long as the Great Xia Dynasty exists, the Meng Family will not perish.
"It's not that exaggerated." Meng Jingzhou laughed heartily and said modestly, "I didn't expect you to guess that I am the emerging genius of the Meng Family."
"... No, we don't think you're a genius." What Lu Yang said was true. If a whimsical person like Meng Jingzhou were to shoulder the burden of the Meng Family, the family's legends would likely come to an end.
If we're talking about geniuses, Lu Yang, the future leader of the Seek Dao Sect, is far more deserving of the title.
The two complimented themselves and belittled each other, completely forgetting Tao Yaoye who had the Feather Transformation Immortal Body, a talent that surpassed both the Single Body Spiritual Root and the Sword Spirit Root.
Luckily, they didn't dwell on this topic for long. An immense wave of untamed energy spread upward from the lower floors of the building, shaking the entire Hundred Fragrance Building.
If the Hundred Fragrance Building wasn't so sturdy, this wave of energy would have been enough to flatten a row of houses!
Lu Yang and his two companions felt as if their heads had been struck with a heavy hammer. Their minds went blank and their internal organs felt as if they were being squeezed by a colossal hand. The discomfort was unbearable.
The cultivation levels of the people around them were higher than Lu Yang and his two friends. Some were even at the Golden Core Stage, so they were feeling a bit better, but not by much.
"Is this… someone breaking through to the Nascent Soul Stage?!" A senior sister at the Nascent Soul Stage was unaffected. She let out a small cry of surprise, sensing a trace of the untamed energy in the wave of energy.
The dishes at the Hundred Fragrance Building are not just delightful in taste. A simple dish can enhance cultivation levels, or spur your techniques to circulate several cycles naturally. If reasonably assorted, the food can stimulate each other's effects, leading to even greater results.
"I heard that during a meal at the Hundred Fragrance Building, one could break through a major realm. I thought it was just a rumor, but it seems to be true!
"I just wonder which lucky junior brother or sister was able to break through here."
Usually, when people break through, they isolate themselves and protect their law. They seek tranquility, and the bustling atmosphere in the Hundred Fragrance Building, filled with distractions, is unfavorable for breakthroughs.
Breaking through in this kind of environment shows just how much the food in the Hundred Fragrance Building can help in elevating one's cultivation level!
The waiter gently pushed it away, and the pressure of the Nascent Soul Stage immediately disappeared. People were catching their breath and then looked at the waiter in surprise.
In their eyes, the waiter was only at the Golden Core Stage, but the ability he just demonstrated obviously went beyond the Golden Core Stage.
The waiter's cultivation level was a disguise.
Someone whispered to his companion, "Speaking of which, I heard from an elder that when the Hundred Fragrance Building first opened a thousand years ago, he was already a waiter here. A thousand years have passed, and he's still a waiter here, and his appearance hasn't changed a bit."
It's normal for cultivators not to change in appearance, but being unchanged for a thousand years is very rare.
The waiter seemed to not hear the whispers and apologized with a look on his face: "I'm sorry, but there might've been a customer who was too excited during their breakthrough and forgot to restrain their momentum. Please understand."
A senior brother who had just entered the Golden Core Stage savored the residual air of the breakthrough and brightened up. "This breath reveals a trace of wildness. It's as if the ancient dragon race has reappeared. I'm sure it was a body cultivating senior brother who broke through. We should hurry and comprehend this breath; it could be very helpful in improving our physical bodies!"
"Absolutely, this rare opportunity is a blessing for us. We should seize it." His companions agreed and started meditating together.
Five people were sitting in the Five Centers Toward Heaven position. They slightly floated in the air, didn't say a word, and felt very comfortable with the cool air flowing from all directions.
Even if they were not body cultivators, cultivators valued the physical body very much. When the magical power is sufficient but the body can't keep up, it's easy to be attacked and killed in one blow or be killed instantly by losing the chance of entanglement and feather when confronting close combat.
Therefore, the Seek Dao Sect put great emphasis on the physical fitness of disciples.
In the ranks of demon beasts, the ancient dragon race was known for controlling the wind and rain with their profound divine abilities and their unparalleled physical self. They were one of the top clans, ruling over the Demon Territory.
If even a bit of ancient dragon aura could be comprehended, it would greatly benefit the physical body, and if one could comprehend some divine abilities of the dragon race and use them as his own, it would be an extremely desirable opportunity!
It was an unusual sight to see five Golden Core cultivators sitting in meditation around hot dishes instead of eating.
This sensitivity to opportunities made Lu Yang very impressed.
"Should we try to comprehend it too?" Tao Yaoye proposed.
Lu Yang was surprised, "Can you sense the ancient dragon aura that our senior brothers are talking about?"
"There's no harm in trying."
Just as Lu Yang and his two friends were considering whether to also meditate and comprehend this ancient dragon aura, the sound of hurried ascension came from the staircase.
A green-skinned wild boar with tusks appeared, its eyes filled with panic and rage, giving off an intense sense of danger.
What a vicious and terrifying demon race! Its realm surpassed most of the people present!
Furthermore, the wild boar's breath was unstable, as if it had just broken through!
The waiter frowned, a small vortex rising in his hand. Just as he was considering whether to step in, a radiant knife light emerged. The sharp knife light was like silk thread, bringing with it an intense aura. With one slash, the wild boar was beheaded, its head tumbling far away to land at Lu Yang's feet.
The boar's head stared at Lu Yang, its eyes refusing to close in death.
The scene that should have been bloody didn't contain a drop of blood. The incredibly hot knife aura instantly cooked the part of the boar that had been beheaded, releasing a tantalizing aroma of roasted meat.
It's only now that the owner of the knife appeared on the scene - a chef that can be seen anywhere. He was wearing a tall hat and a specially designed work apron, holding a butcher's knife, his face lined with wrinkles. When he laughed, he looked like a ruthless bandit who was about to rob a ticket.
"My apologies for startling everyone. I was about to slaughter this Dragon Descendant Wild Boar. Probably due to my strong killing intent, the creature sensed a life-and-death crisis and activated the trace of ancient dragon blood within it, breaking through to the Nascent Soul Stage."
"This was our restaurant's mistake, it will not happen again next time. Please forgive us!"
With a smirk on his face, the chef held his butcher's knife sincerely. Everyone had no choice but to forgive him even if they didn't want to.
The chef picked up the boar's head from Lu Yang's feet and dragged the body away, which eased the pressure everyone was sensing.
Five junior brothers at the Golden Core stage felt somewhat awkward. They were unsure whether to continue their meditation and comprehension attempts.
One of them slam his hand on the table, "Damn it, give us a pot of Boar-Kill dish, made with just that boar!"
The price for Nascent Soul Stage pork is outrageous, let alone a wild boar with the bloodline of the ancient dragon race. Eating this dish could cost them so much that they would deserve a slap when they wake up.
Even if they deserve a slap, they have to eat it. They are determined today. If they don't eat this Nascent Soul Stage wild boar, their urge wouldn't be settled and it could even cause internal injuries caused by holding back their anger.
The waiter rested the towel on his shoulder, put on a smile, and shouted, "Got it! Five more Boar-Kill dishes for our customers!"

chapters.title: Chapter 29 - 28 Heard that you eat tofu every day recently?_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang and the other two quietly withdrew their gazes, trying to make themselves less noticeable.
Seeing the murderous look on the five Senior Brothers' faces, it seemed they were ready to kill to silence the matter.
"Speaking of which, would you like to guess what goodies I ordered for you? They are certainly all your favorites," Meng Jingzhou said softly, afraid to draw the attention of the five Senior Brothers who were devouring their dishes.
Lu Yang was utterly perplexed. How would Meng Jingzhou know what he liked to eat?
"How do you know what Senior Brother Lu likes to eat?" Tao Yaoye asked in an even lower voice.
