Meng Jingzhou gave a thumbs up, revealing a dazzling smile with eight teeth standing out, "I specifically asked Eldest Senior Sister."
Lu Yang immediately had a bad feeling about this.
"Here comes the Stewed Tofu!"
"Freshly made Tofu Pudding!"
"Scallion Tossed Tofu."
"Mapo Tofu."
The waiter announced the dishes and brought them over, laying out an entire banquet of tofu dishes that mesmerized Lu Yang. Even Tao Yaoye, who wasn't particularly fond of tofu, was tempted to have a full meal after smelling the aroma.
With every dish called out, Lu Yang's face turned a shade paler.
Meng Jingzhou was rather self-satisfied, "Eldest Senior Sister said that you haven't eaten anything but tofu for a while, having it for every meal, even dreaming about 'Tofu Supreme'."
"So I figured you must really like tofu."
"Don't feel too touched. My family told me that when you invite someone for a meal, you should find out what they like. It shows sincerity. I don't always agree with my family's views, but this one, I do believe in."
"I came to the Hundred Fragrance Building to order this tofu feast specifically for you. Don't underestimate these dishes. They seem ordinary, but they are all made from top-quality soybeans, served with high-quality spiritual herbs that have been aged for years. Even the water used is pure water melted from the essence of the icy northern lands…"
Lu Yang's face suddenly turned paler than the tofu itself.
What on earth did you find out about my preferences!
...
After the guests left the Hundred Fragrance Building, bellies full and satisfied, the waiter quickly cleaned up the tables and chairs, putting everything back in its place. Then, he remembered Lu Yang's question.
If you've taken a fasting pill, does it count as eating or fasting?
This seemingly simple question was actually a philosophical riddle. The more he thought about it, the more profound it seemed.
The new disciples being recruited this year seem to possess high comprehension skills. They're sure to achieve great things in the future!
"Hey, cook, I have a question for you," the waiter came into the kitchen, proposing the question to the butcher.
The kitchen was scorching, with waves of heat rolling over. For someone at the Qi Refinement stage, even a slight accident could result in severe burns or even death, leaving nothing but a skeleton behind.
To cook spiritual plants and heavenly delicacies, ordinary fire is not sufficient. At a minimum, flames refined by a late-stage Golden Core cultivator are required, and such flames are naturally terrifyingly powerful.
The waiter, however, was oblivious to the terrifying heat in the kitchen. He casually fanned himself with the towel on his shoulder, and the high temperature disappeared instantly, replaced by a sense of coolness.
"What's up? Want to learn how to butcher pigs?"
The waiter glared, "Why would I learn that? I've come up with a philosophical question related to cooking. Let's see how you answer it."
The cook, who was busy cleaning the stove, laughed, tossed his brush aside, and crossed his legs, "Go on, ask."
"If you take a fasting pill, does that count as having a meal or fasting?"
The cook smirked, was ready to answer without thinking, then found himself speechless.
Right, does it count as having a meal or fasting?
The cook looked at the waiter suspiciously, "That doesn't seem right. Your intelligence is well known. How could you come up with such a question with your IQ?"
The waiter shouted angrily, "Watch how you talk, butcher!"
"So, was the question your idea?"
"No."
After discussing it, the two agreed it was premature to use their brains to ponder this question, so they decided to put it forward to the house mistress.
Aroma of the tea was swirling in the air, forming rows of cryptic characters, profound and mysterious. The house mistress was pouring and warming the tea… Her movements were graceful and fluid, pleasant to the eye.
The house mistress was a noble and elegant lady with a fair and rejuvenating complexion, and a faint star pattern on her forehead.
She looked helplessly at the waiter and the cook, thinking they clearly had too little work to do if they had time to contemplate such trivial matters.
"Don't let the name 'fasting pill' deceive you. Its function is not to fast, but to slowly dissolve the food that's been refined into a pill in your stomach. This is how it provides sustenance over a long period of time."
"A fasting pill is essentially food."
"Understand?"
The cook pondered, "I see. So, the Pill Masters who refine fasting pills are actually my peers."
The waiter sneered, tauntingly said, "Don't flatter yourself. At best, you're peers with the juniors who stoke the fire."
The cook was furious, picked up his butcher's knife, and lunged at the waiter.
But, the waiter was hardly a pushover. He whipped the towel from his shoulder harshly, which rattled with the sound of metal collision before transforming into a large white iron rod in an instant.
One of them brandishing the knife and the other wielding a stick, the two started wrestling, resembling thugs in a street brawl. Seeing the spectacle, the house mistress couldn't help but sigh. If only these two weren't so affordable, they wouldn't be working here in the first place.
The house mistress simply blew a breath infused with the tea's fragrance, which engulfed both of them, momentarily losing their senses. By the time they regained their bearings, they found themselves on the ground floor.
The mistress's voice echoed in their ears, sounding mildly annoyed, "You can fight downstairs. If you damage anything, it'll get deducted from your wages."
...
Lu Yang wasn't aware of the events that unfolded within the Hundred Fragrance Building after they left. When he arrived back at Sky Gate Mountain after his Foundation Establishment Feast, his face was as pale as if he had been dead for three days.
Eldest Senior Sister, dressed in an indigo dress with a simple Daoist ornament in her hair, was sitting cross-legged hovering three feet above the ground, absorbed in her meditation. She was like a transcendental fairy, untouched by the burdens of the human realm.
As Yun Zhi slowly opened her eyes, she seemed to hold a thousand worlds within them, sparkling like the night sky. Dismissing it as a hallucination, Lu Yang rubbed his eyes. When he looked again, Yun Zhi was merely observing him with a calm expression, the dazzling spectacle in her eyes nowhere to be seen.
An illusion?
"Why is your face so pale?" she asked.
Lu Yang begrudgingly replied, "You know exactly why! Meng Jingzhou used the fact you told him that I lived mainly on tofu for a period once as the reason to invite me to an all-tofu banquet to celebrate my Foundation Establishment."
Lu Yang suspected that his dear eldest senior sister had a hand in this prank.
"When Meng Jingzhou asked me what you usually ate the most, I remembered that you ate several jars of tofu when you were practicing your skills. I simply told him the truth. Is there a problem with that?"
"What about 'Tofu Supreme'..."
Before Lu Yang could finish his sentence, Yun Zhi addressed him in her usual monotone voice, "You shouted 'Tofu Supreme' while dreaming about receiving a legacy. I merely reported it."
Lu Yang silently looked into Yun Zhi's eyes, which were devoid of desire and seemingly innocent. He reluctantly admitted defeat.
He always suspected that his eldest senior sister was messing with him, but he had no evidence to prove it.

chapters.title: Chapter 30 - 29 Theories on the Ancient Great Era_1
chapters.content:
"I've looked at your mission report. You did quite well using your wisdom to eliminate a Painted Skin Demon."
Lu Yang was elated by this rare praise from his Eldest Senior Sister. His journey to Taiping Village had indeed been worthwhile.
After giving a brief comment, Yun Zhi's face turned somber with the implications of the Painted Skin Demon.
"In the past century, with the advent of the Great Era, various dormant forces are showing signs of action and phantoms roam the world. The Great Xia Dynasty may appear calm but it's unknowingly harboring countless disasters. The dynasty is too proud to seek help from the Five Great Immortal Sects," Yun Zhi said with a sigh, her words not really intended for Lu Yang.
Lu Yang caught hold of a word in her speech, "The Great Era?"
He had never heard of this term and it was not mentioned in any of his books.
Yun Zhi spoke, her voice seeming distant, "A century ago, the Supreme Elder of the Heavenly Strategy Sect walked out from among the dead, spread his blood over the clear river and prophesied something unknown."
The Heavenly Strategy Sect boasted of their ability to calculate anything, understand everything, and abide by the natural justice and causality. They were the ones who questioned the insurance policy of the Land Money Trade Association.
"The Supreme Elder then publicly declared that the Great Era has come, and will restore the glorious peak of ancient cultivation."
"Usually, the Five Great Immortal Sects would consider it a good harvest if they could recruit a Single Spirit Root in a batch. But in your batch, there is an Ancient Barbarian Tribe member, three Single Spirit Roots, and an Immortal Body that's even rarer than a Single Spirit Root.
I have heard that other Immortal Sects in the past century have also recruited geniuses comparable to Single Spirit Roots. This gives a glimpse into the glorious Great Era."
Yun Zhi rarely smiled, but a faint smirk tugged at her lips, seemingly sarcastic, "The so-called glorious Great Era was in fact tumultuous beyond imagination. A chaotic era is a troubled one with various forces and interests intertwined, and demons scheming against each other. Countless innocent lives were lost before a great power in cultivation emerged.
The peace and stability of today pales in comparison."
Lu Yang thought Eldest Senior Sister's laugh was cold.
Lu Yang had read about the Great Era in books. During the Great Era, might was right and only the victor had the last say. Humanity was merely one of the many factions, not yet the dominant power they are today.
Demons roamed the world and titans clashed. Geniuses swept across the world, cementing their legacy with blood and bones. There was decisive killing, and countless great cultivators became legends and goals for other cultivators. It was enticing, making one wish they were born in that era to showcase their talent.
Only in such troubled times do heroes and exceptional individuals have the opportunity to rise and demonstrate their might.
But seeing his Eldest Senior Sister's expression, Lu Yang realized that while the Great Era was a blessing for geniuses, it was a living nightmare for common people.
Death was unpredictable and survival was uncertain. Small clashes among the nobles could result in their people becoming slaves and prisoners, enslaved and slaughtered with no security or peace.
The Great Era described in the books was filled with epic upheavals because the authors themselves were high-level cultivators, who yearned for such a scene.
If one viewed the Great Era from the perspective of a common person, the picture would differ completely.
Lu Yang realized that after he became a cultivator, he seemed to have forgotten his past as a mortal.
That shouldn't be.
Yun Zhi did not dwell on this topic further as it was too early for Lu Yang, "Do you have any other questions?"
"Well, Eldest Senior Sister, do you have any speed travel spells here?"
"Of course, I do. But, what do you need these spells for?"
The Seek Dao Sect and the Land Money Trade Association had an agreement that all traveling expenses of Seek Dao's disciples would go on the Sect's tab, therefore, Lu Yang could travel by airship without spending a single Spirit Stone. Why else would he need travel spells?
Scratching his head, Lu Yang shyly replied, "Nothing much, I just want to learn it and save money for our Sect."
Yun Zhi didn't doubt him, "Since you are being thoughtful, I, as your Senior Sister, wouldn't spoil your enthusiasm. You're only at the Foundation Establishment stage now, so there are not many spells you can use."
Lu Yang chuckled and rubbed his hands, "Even a few would do."
"I've kept an eye on your cultivation over the past year, and you've lived up to your Sword Spirit Root's name. Here, I can teach you a flying sword spell that would allow you to ride on a flying sword and travel anywhere."
"I also have a shifting spell that hones your Spiritual Sense and allows it to transfer your body anywhere. Though its speed isn't as fast as the flying sword spell, it doesn't consume as much energy and improving Spiritual Sense helps in future battles."
"There is also the option of Transformation Art. Once mastered, you can turn into a bird and soar freely in the sky."
"Junior Brother, which one do you choose?" Yun Zhi casually mentioned a few spells for Lu Yang to choose from.
"... Uh, are there any spells that don't involve flying?"
Yun Zhi, intrigued, looks at Lu Yang's blushing face, "Oh, why do you want to learn travel spells that don't involve flying?"
Lu Yang fumbled for words and was unable to answer.
Yun Zhi did not press on, "There are indeed spells that don't involve flying, but they require a high understanding of the Dao and demand a certain level of magical power. You might be starting a bit early."
"That's okay, I'll give it a try. If it doesn't work out, then so be it."
"This spell is called Shrinking Ground Into Inches, it's very difficult to cultivate. Here are the cultivation incantations. After you memorize them, I will formally teach you."
Yun Zhi raised her hand and created a spatial rift, from where she took out a golden sheet of paper, neatly covered with elegant handwriting.
Lu Yang carefully accepted the golden paper, clearly valuable. It would be serious if he accidentally tore it.
After Lu Yang left, Yun Zhi closed her eyes and continued her cultivation. As a sinister wind blew in, an ancient and resentful voice echoed in her ears. It was chilling, as though falling into an ice pit.
"My dear disciple, how much longer are you going to keep your master here?"
The voice seemed to come directly from the Nine Nether Hell, spine-chilling and terrifying!
"Your master didn't guide you many times, yet you've reached your current level of cultivation. Your master takes pride in your achievements."
"An old saying goes, if you are a teacher for a day, you are a father for life. You can't simply ignore your master's teachings and imprison him here."
"The Seek Dao Sect hasn't had a Sect Leader for ten years. As you exercise the authority of the Sect Leader on behalf of your master, are you not afraid of gossip affecting your bright image as Eldest Senior Sister?"
"You've accepted a disciple on your master's behalf, even if he is a swordsmanship prodigy, it's not something your master would punish you for."
"But at least release your master so that he can meet his disciple in person. Real people are here but he only worships the painting of your master, wouldn't it be a laughing matter if this gets out?"
The voice contained a certain charm, touching the heartstrings, making one unknowingly want to believe it, to break the seal and release the owner of the voice.
Yun Zhi continued her meditation, ignoring it completely.
Seeing Yun Zhi unmoved, the aged voice transformed into a long sigh, disappearing completely as if it had never existed.
Yun Zhi sat in Five Centers Toward Heaven posture, everything as before.

chapters.title: Chapter 31 - 30: Shrinking Ground Into Inches_1
chapters.content:
Three days later.
Clad in tight-fitting attire, Lu Yang stood erect, a satisfied grin on his face, pride visible from having memorized the golden scroll.
"Recite it for me."
"A thousand miles in existence, present before the eyes, released and relaxed…" Lu Yang started reciting smoothly, without an iota of interruption, indicating that he had memorized the content by heart.
Yun Zhi nodded in approval. The mantra was quite profound, reduced to its essential meaning word by word. Reciting it called for great mental power, and the fact that Lu Yang could memorize to this extent testified to the hard work he had put in.
"This mantra is an introduction. Recite it in your heart when you are not proficient with the spell in the early stage. It will assist you in successfully casting the spell. Once you can skillfully use Shrinking Ground Into Inches in your later stage, this mantra will be of no use."
"Shrinking Ground Into Inches is a space spell and you are on the early side to practice it. However, since you are a disciple under the mentor, and he learned this spell at your cultivation level, maybe you can too."
"The most important thing about cultivating space spells is safety. Once the space is misplaced, you will end up with your body separated from your head or split at the waist. Therefore, there is an unwritten rule in the cultivation world that when cultivating space spells, you must have a senior who is proficient in spatial matters to guide you."
Yun Zhi turned unusually serious, and seeing her this way, Lu Yang also put away his laughter, paying full attention to Yun Zhi's lecture.
"The principle of the Shrinking Ground Into Inches spell is to shrink the ground to the size of square inches. The spell caster casually steps over, traversing endless distances, and arrives at another place. The more skilled you are, the larger the area of the ground you can shrink, and the longer the distance you can cross.
When you achieve the grand success, even the vast Central Continent can't stop your pace."
"What you need to pay attention to is that practicing the spell needs enlightenment. You have never touched on spatial spells, so you have to be mentally prepared for success or failure."
"One should not get overjoyed or overly disappointed while cultivating,"
Yun Zhi imparts her cultivation experience to Lu Yang through her words and deeds.
Lu Yang nodded. He found the Eldest Senior Sister to be the most qualified to say these words as he had yet seen her have extreme emotional fluctuations.
He felt somewhat lacking in this respect.
Initially, when Lu Yang saw that the Eldest Senior Sister had only one expression, he thought she was emotionless. After spending some time together, he realized that she did have emotional fluctuations, only that they were too trivial.
Lu Yang could now discern how the Eldest Senior Sister was feeling from her subtle facial changes with a certain level of probability.
Like now… well, he couldn't discern it.
"I'll demonstrate it to you now."
Yun Zhi, not knowing what Lu Yang was thinking, threw a red flag onto a hill across from them. Before Lu Yang could get a clear look, she stepped forward lightly. Suddenly, she disappeared and then reappeared, holding the red flag in her hand.
"Once you succeed, practice it a few times, and you'll be as proficient as me."
Lu Yang remained rooted to the spot, blinking once, and then again.
What had just happened?
In Lu Yang's eyes, it seemed as if Yun Zhi had thrown the red flag and then effortlessly picked it back up. He was not even certain if the flag had landed on the mountain as he saw no signs of her using magic.
Unusually, Yun Zhi frowned a bit. When her master taught her, he demonstrated it in the same way and she learned it in one go.
Fearing that Lu Yang might not understand, Yun Zhi demonstrated it one more time.
Thus, throwing the flag, walking, coming back, all went smoothly and without understanding.
"..."
Indeed, there are times when the Eldest Senior Sister cannot be relied on too; learning is indeed something one has to accomplish by oneself.
Lu Yang met Eldest Senior Sister's gaze, aware of her emotional state this time.
She was expecting him to succeed.
But Eldest Senior Sister, you must understand that with your level of teaching, no one can learn.
Lu Yang sighed secretly. He couldn't rely on the Eldest Senior Sister anymore; he had to implement the spell based on his own understanding of Shrinking Ground into Inches.
"A thousand miles in existence, present before the eyes, released and relaxed…" Lu Yang closed his eyes while casting the spell, pinching out the spell while chanting.
"Shrinking Ground into Inches!" Lu Yang bellowed, and his body disappeared instantly. The surrounding scenery changed, being engulfed in darkness, as if he had fallen into an alternate space.
Lu Yang was delighted. He had succeeded on his first try.
He was indeed a genius!
Lu Yang remembered what his Senior Sister had said. The principle of Shrinking Ground Into Inches is to twist and fold space. Spell casters walk in an alternate space, which is a straight line, and can reach their destination in the shortest time possible through it.
Lu Yang was about to let out a hearty laugh when he discovered that the black substance around him was pouring into his mouth, and his body was trapped by it, making it impossible to move. Furthermore, it seemed that there was no air in the alternate space, making it extremely difficult for him to breathe.
After a brief but calm contemplation, he recognized a fact:
He was shrunk into the earth.
Now, Lu Yang had good news and bad news.
The good news was he had learned half of Shrinking Ground Into Inches - shrinking the ground.
The bad news was he had only learned half of it.
Standing on the ground, Yun Zhi didn't know what to say. She watched Lu Yang cast the spell and then shrink into the ground, mastering Earth Escape Skill.
Why did a space spell shift to an elemental spell?
Being the Eldest Senior Sister of the Seek Dao Sect and the eldest disciple of the Sect Leader, Yun Zhi's cultivation level and talent for cultivation ranked first among all the disciples of Seek Dao Sect. She could craft formula easily, master spells at a glance, possessed unparalleled understanding, rare throughout ancient times, and all other geniuses paled in comparative elimination to her.
She was truly terrifying.
Yet even she could not comprehend Lu Yang's casting principle.
These were clearly two unrelated spells.
With a muffled sound, Lu Yang performed Shrinking Ground Into Inches again, his head sticking out of the ground like a mole. This arouses the urge to hammer it down or step on it.
Lu Yang cleared his throat trying to defuse the awkwardness.
No matter how thick-skinned Lu Yang was, he could not tolerate such an embarrassing situation.
Yun Zhi pulled Lu Yang out of the ground emotionlessly, shaking off a pile of mud.
Like pulling out a radish.
"It was an accident just now. Let me try again."
Lu Yang felt he was close to figuring out the trick.
"A thousand miles in existence, present before the eyes, released and relaxed…" Lu Yang started configuring the spell again, chanting even faster than the previous time.
"Shrinking Ground into Inches!" Lu Yang yelled, and a change occurred again.
Yun Zhi was tall, but still half a head shorter than Lu Yang. In the past, Lu Yang could see the top of Eldest Senior Sister's head, but now it had changed.
Yun Zhi's body gradually became taller and Lu Yang changed from looking down, to looking straight, and then looking up, till he was finally craning his neck to look up.
From Lu Yang's angle, he could not even see Eldest Senior Sister's face.
Yun Zhi had become a giant holding up the sky, with her head touching the heavens and feet stepping on the ground.
"No, I've become smaller!"
Lu Yang shouted, seeing a rock that was half a person high on the ground, realizing where the problem was.
Three-inch-tall Lu Yang was hopping around on the ground, and even his voice had become much softer than before.
He had learned a new spell – Shrinking Into Inches.
Lu Yang's talent in spells was also terrifying. Geniuses like Yun Zhi could only learn Shrinking Ground Into Inches, but Lu Yang had learned both Shrinking Ground and Shrinking Into Inches!
Yun Zhi crouched down to observe Lu Yang, her eyebrows slightly furrowed, apparently not understanding what went wrong.

chapters.title: Chapter 32 - 31 Learning for Practical Use_1
chapters.content:
Yun Zhi pinched Lu Yang's collar with two fingers, shook it in front of her eyes, but still couldn't understand the principle, so she let him go.
Lu Yang was equally puzzled as well. He followed the chant and method taught by the Eldest Senior Sister, but why did the magic he casted turned out to be completely different?
"This doesn't make sense."
"I'll demonstrate for you again." Yun Zhi was a very responsible teacher. Though her teaching skills were generally mediocre, she was patient.
Yun Zhi took out a sandglass, placed it upside down on the ground, then guided Lu Yang's shoulder and they both initiated space teleportation together.
Lu Yang only felt a flicker in front of his eyes, and arrived in a strange space with colorful flowing lights on both sides.
On impulse, Lu Yang wanted to touch the flowing lights, but Yun Zhi stopped him.
"These are bizarre visions formed by twisted space. Not to mention you, even a Cultivator in the Divinity Transformation Stage would be torn to pieces and their soul would scatter."
Lu Yang instantly retracted his hand in fright.
They stepped out of the space and saw a giant white snake winding around mountains, swallowing the sun and moon, refining the essence of heaven and earth. Its snake's eyes were vivid, and both of them happened to land in the python's mouth, and slipped into its stomach accordingly.
Just as the gastric juice was about to fall, Yun Zhi stepped again and returned to the alternative space.
Following Yun Zhi's steps, Lu Yang saw all sorts of strange and bizarre sights; a sea made of magma, a cultivator undergoing Thunder Tribulation, a silent swordsman carrying a heavy wide blade…
These were places and things that Lu Yang had never seen or heard of before. It was hard for him to imagine such strange people and scenes existed in the world.
Eventually, they returned to their starting point, and Lu Yang was exhausted and still in shock.
"The places I just took you to are actually all within the Seek Dao Sect. You will have the opportunity to explore it yourself in the future."
The Seek Dao Sect was overwhelmingly vast, and the areas outside its nine core mountains were still unknown to Lu Yang.
"Can you try casting the spells again?"
Yun Zhi thought it might make a difference now.
Meeting Yun Zhi's eager gaze, Lu Yang bravely tried to cast the spell again.
After a day's practice with Yun Zhi, Lu Yang finally learned how to perceive the underground environment and how not to be stepped on after shrinking.
He had not succeeded in 'Shrinking Ground Into Inches" even once, but he succeeded in shrinking and adjusting inches every single time, and it became more and more skilled each time.
By the end, he didn't even need the chants anymore, a single thought was enough to cast a spell, as if he had been immersed in this path for months or years.
Lu Yang's original intention of learning 'Shrinking Ground Into Inches' was to use this magic skill for traveling. Now that he had learned the magic of "shrinking" for traveling, it was just as he originally intended.
It's just that the way he did it was hard to explain, and the speed was a bit slower.
Seeing Lu Yang changing his sizes at will, burrowing in and out of the soil, and playing happily, Yun Zhi casually asked, "Junior Brother, I heard that you have trouble taking on tasks at the Task Hall?"
"Yeah, most of the tasks can only be completed by those who are at the Golden Core Stage or above. There are very few tasks suitable for me." Lu Yang was thinking about camping at the Task Hall for a few days to see if he could snag a suitable task.
"It's quite a coincidence. A few days ago, at a meeting with the elders, someone mentioned that there were a few issues with the herb garden. They'd posted a task at the Task Hall, but no one had taken it. I think you might be a good fit. – you might want to check out the herb garden."
Lu Yang knew that ever since his master's retreat, the Eldest Senior Sister had been presiding over the meetings on behalf of the master.
"What task?" Lu Yang was curious. His special skills were not outstanding in the Seek Dao Sect, so what kind of task would be suitable for him, let alone he knew nothing about the garden of medicinal herbs?
He hadn't even fully learned how to identify medicinal herbs yet.
"You'll know when you get there." Yun Zhi didn't answer.
...
In Lu Yang's view, Seek Dao Sect itself was like a mini Cultivation World. Without leaving, one could find someone to help refine pills, weapons and arrange formations. For the most part, it seemed to be self-sufficient.
Refining pills requires spiritual herbs. Seek Dao Sect has a great demand for refining pills and can't always rely on external purchases.
To solve the problem of spiritual herbs, Seek Dao Sect had set up a large herb garden for planting medicinal herbs, and the Task Hall also published tasks to help cultivate medicinal herbs.
Cultivating medicinal herbs requires professional knowledge and Lu Yang knew nothing about this. He still couldn't even distinguish what medicinal herbs and spirit beasts he was eating for meals, let alone grow medicinal herbs.
From far away, Lu Yang could smell the fragrance of the herb garden. Unlike the scent from the Elixir Cauldron Peak, which might be poisonous, this was pure medicinal aroma. Mortals would extend their lifespan and avoid disasters and diseases after a long exposure.
At the entrance of the herb garden was a man, Uncle Ba, lying down. He put a straw fan on his face and was comfortably lounging on a rocking chair.
"Uncle, is this the herb garden?"
Uncle Ba lazily opened his eyelids and glanced at Lu Yang: "Who are you?"
"Lu Yang."
"I didn't ask what your name was, I asked about your status."
"I'm the fourth disciple of the Sect Leader, Yun Zhi's Junior Brother."
On hearing the first part, Uncle Ba didn't think much as the Sect Leader had disappeared for more than a decade, undermining his relevance. However, after hearing that he was Yun Zhi's Junior Brother, Uncle Ba instantly sobered up.
Being a disciple of the Sect Leader meant being Yun Zhi's Junior Brother!
Uncle Ba abruptly got up, appearing more nimble than Lu Yang.
It's reasonable, in the Cultivation World, one couldn't judge the other's capability and age by appearance. When the old and the young stand together, it's hard to figure out who's who.
Nobody in the Cultivation World advocates respecting the old or loving the young. After all, it's possible that the old and the children may be more formidable than you.
"So you're Yun Zhi's referral, why didn't you say so earlier." Uncle Ba coalesced with Lu Yang in a brotherly manner.
"You can call me Old Ba. As for the herb garden, I call the shots."
Lu Yang suspected that Uncle Ba was taking advantage of him, but there was no proof.
"What did Yun Zhi send you here to do, to pick herbs? How many years do you need, one thousand or two thousand?"
Seeing Uncle Ba's behavior, Lu Yang spontaneously thought of the meals Elder Sister had cooked for him. Did she get the one thousand or two thousand-year-old herbs from this garden?
A thousand-year-old herb wasn't common cabbage. Even for the Seek Dao Sect, it was quite valuable.
No, it can't be. Elder Sister is a very thrifty person, she wouldn't waste precious herbs on her own dishes.
Lu Yang politely asked: "Elder Sister said that the herb garden posted a task a few days ago, but no one took it. What is the task?"
Uncle Ba realized: "So it was this task. Do you know how to cultivate herbs?"
"No idea at all." Lu Yang confessed.
"Let me give you a brief explanation. It's quite intricate to cultivate herbs. One step is to loosen the soil. It helps the roots of the herbs absorb the spiritual energy from the soil and complete the interaction with the spiritual energy in the air."
"The task of loosening the soil has always been carried out by a pair of Silver Ring King Worms."
"Recently, there were some issues in their home, nobody was working, so I posted a task to get the herb garden soil loosened. This requires one of the Five Elements Technique - the Earth Escape technique. There are quite a few who know Earth Escape, but they all think it is inconvenient and are unwilling to undertake it. It just happens that Yun Zhi sent you here."
"So what I need to do is..."
"Act like an earthworm, burrow into the soil, and loosen the soil of the herb garden."
Lu Yang: "…"
Lu Yang suspected that his Elder Sister was playing a prank on him, but he still had no proof.

chapters.title: Chapter 33 - 32 Ginseng Baby_1
chapters.content:
Objectively speaking, toiling in the medicinal garden is indeed a fine strategy. By practicing the magic skill of "Earth Shrinking", one could also learn about herbs and make up for one's lack of knowledge in this area. It's a win-win situation.
Eldest Senior Sister is considering my best interests.
Eldest Senior Sister is considering my best interests.
Eldest Senior Sister is considering my best interests.
Lu Yang hypnotized himself to accept the task of taking the earthworms' place in burrowing into the ground. As he thought about it, something occurred to him—earthworms should be of indeterminate sex.
"Why do earthworms have spouses?"
Uncle Ba explained: "Earthworms in the mortal world don't differentiate between male and female, but that's indicative of lowly creatures. No offense meant. Intelligent earthworms that can transform do have distinct sexes. In particular, the Silver Ring King Worm is the king among earthworms and deeply suppresses all others in kinship."
"I see. Please continue."
Uncle Ba continued: "With the Silver Ring King Worm couple, loosening the soil was no problem. But because of a careless comment I made one day, I asked the worm queen, people say that if an earthworm is split in two they can still survive, so what if she split herself in two? Could she not then alternate work days with her other half?"
"She was moved by my words and on the spot, she cut herself open, creating two separate beings."
"Each one as identical as the other, like twin sisters, no, more like a clone technique. I watched as one being turned into two and could not tell who was the original."
"Thankfully, they could distinguish between each other."
"However, when the husband came back and saw two wives, he was utterly stupefied. Both women then asked him who he preferred."
"The husband was quite straightforward, not attempting to mask his words, directly stating that he liked both."
"Then, the domestic dispute erupted, with their triangle creating a series of love-hate entanglements. Even to this day, they no longer work due to this." Uncle Ba appeared to feel a great deal of remorse.
Lu Yang: "..."
Damn, they're insane.
"So, what exactly should I do?" After sighing, Lu Yang quickly composed himself, gradually adapting to the mentality of a cultivator.
These are all minor matters.
Uncle Ba stroked his white beard and smiled, "You go in and someone will guide you. But let me remind you, you are only allowed in the medicinal garden to loosen the soil. If dare you steal any herbs, Discipline Peak will hold you accountable!"
Discipline Peak, the mountain range administered by the Grand Elder. It's renowned for its strict impartiality and does not make exceptions.
Lu Yang thanked Uncle Ba and entered the medicinal garden.
Upon entering, Lu Yang smelled an aroma that was several tens of times stronger than before.
The smell could not possibly vary so much in such a short distance.
Lu Yang immediately realized that the medicinal garden was under the protection of not just Uncle Ba, but also a full array method to keep outsiders from entering.
This array method locked the aura of the medicinal garden, and due of the profuse scent of the herbs, leakage could not be completely avoided.
Even this faint scent could greatly enhance a mortal's lifespan, so one can only imagine the extraordinary benefits of the aroma within the medicinal garden!
Apart from the herbal scent, the most significant thing was the dense spiritual energy. Lu Yang suspected that the dew on the surface of the medicinal leaves was not water but droplets of condensed spiritual energy, each a match for a lower quality spirit stone!
Wherever Lu Yang looked, a variety of flowers and herbs that he had never seen or heard of spread out before him.
Plants organized neatly by species in separate zones, created a dazzling assortment that left Lu Yang bewildered.
He didn't dare take a step, fearing he might step on a valuable plant.
Lu Yang bent down and examined several medicinal plants. Finally, he found one he was familiar with. It was a plant with three leaves, its veins clear, looking as if it had been made from condensed ice, releasing a slight chill.
"Ice Soul Grass, I remember this herb helps in the cultivation of ice-related magical skills by increasing the speed of spiritual energy absorption."
Each stalk of Ice Soul Grass stood a great distance from the next, likely to prevent the chill each emitted from freezing everything in its vicinity.
Lu Yang remembered his encounter with a puppet. The puppet had thoroughly beaten him and then applied Ice Soul Grass on his injuries. The memory was still fresh in his mind.
He didn't recognize any other plants.
"Oi, who are you?" A not-so-polite voice came, and Lu Yang reflexively turned his head but couldn't see anyone.
"Who's speaking?"
"Oi, look down!" the voice reminded him.
Lu Yang looked down to see a ginseng baby, three inches tall, hopping around his feet. It seemed dissatisfied that Lu Yang had taken too long to notice, whilst having to raise its voice to get its attention.
"You're so stupid, why didn't you look down? Why do I even have to remind you!"
The ginseng baby had sturdy little legs and was chubby, running around Lu Yang. Its two roots acted as arms swinging up and down as it ran. Its body was covered in patterns, forming a face which was as expressive as a human's.
"Young man, who are you?" The ginseng baby asked with an old man's attitude.
A ginseng of refined spirit is no doubt extremely old. Lu Yang, therefore, didn't dare to be rude and respectfully replied "Your humble servant Lu Yang at your service, my duty is to loosen the soil in the medicinal garden."
"So you're just here for soil-loosening." The ginseng baby breathed a sigh of relief, fearing it was another hateful human come to pick them.
All the herbs in the garden were its proteges.
"Since you're approved by Little Ba, it seems I have not seen a stranger besides Little Ba and that female demon for quite a few days."
For the ginseng baby, even the elderly Uncle Ba was just a young junior.
What's the use of high cultivation level? The herbs win in terms of longevity.
It looked down on everyone in the Seek Dao Sect.
Lu Yang knew that the medicinal garden had rules. The herbs in the garden were very precious. If anyone wanted to take a herb, they had to ask the guard to pick it. No one but the guard is allowed to enter the garden.
If Lu Yang didn't have this task, he wouldn't be able to enter the garden.
Lu Yang didn't know who the female demon the ginseng baby mentioned was. Perhaps it was another gardener?
The ginseng baby put its roots on its hip, complaining "Why are you humans so tall?"
Lu Yang too felt it was tiring to speak to someone while bending down, so he promptly used the magic skill "Inch," shrinking to the same three-inch height as the ginseng baby.
"Hey, this youngster has the makings of a good cultivator, far better than Little Ba." The ginseng baby was first surprised and then pleased. It was rare to see a human who was the same height as it, since it always felt displeased having to look up at humans.
The ginseng baby had no neck, its head and body were a single unit.
"From now on in this garden, you can hang around with me!" The ginseng baby said magnanimously, patting Lu Yang's shoulder with its roots as a mark of acceptance.
"I have some chores to do. You can follow me. After I'm done, I will introduce you to the other King Herbs."
Herbs that have become spirits are called King Herbs, the most valuable herbs.
Even a very powerful Sect might not have one. If a King Herb is acquired, it could be enshrined like an ancestor.
Listening to the ginseng baby, it seems that the medicinal garden also contains many others like it.
Lu Yang secretly marveled at how terrifying the foundation of the Seek Dao Sect was.

chapters.title: Chapter 34 - 33: Medicine Garden_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang closely followed the Ginseng Child, using a curious gaze to observe the lush herbs that surrounded them.
Sunlight slipped through the gaps in the leaves, casting speckled light onto Lu Yang's body.
Due to his reduced size, in Lu Yang's eyes, the herbs appeared as trees blocking the sunlight, towering over him.
Soon, Lu Yang and the Ginseng Child came across a rapid stream. It contained a natural, nourishing spirituality that was used to irrigate the herbs. The herbs in turn, purified a part of it, and it flowed back into the stream, thereby creating mutual benefits.
"This is the river protected by the River Spirit," the Ginseng Child explained.
Surrounding the Seek Dao Sect was a stream that sometimes flowed rapidly and sometimes slowly. Its source was an infinite, timeless spring.
This spring had a long history, even before the establishment of the Seek Dao Sect. It had been blessed by Heaven and Earth and acquired a hint of spiritual light.
For inanimate objects, the greatest fortune is to acquire spirituality, and this hint of spiritual light was of utmost importance.
If one could turn the spiritual light into one's own, they would become darlings of Heaven and Earth.
If the spiritual light was scattered into the universe, it could take countless Suiyue (years) of tribulation before a hint of spiritual light could be produced again.
Inanimate objects were subject to change with the environment, and could potentially break apart and dissolve in the battles of cultivators, extinguishing any hope of acquiring spirituality.
The chances of spiritual light dissipating were far greater than that of it becoming one's own.
Luckily, predecessors of the Seek Dao Sect discovered this phenomenon while passing this area. They used a magic skill to lock this hint of spiritual light within the spring, for it to conceive true spirituality.
The Spirit of the Spring, grateful for the favor shown by the predecessors of the Seek Dao Sect, voluntarily chose to protect the Sect.
This stream wove in and out of various parts of the Sect, protecting its peripheries, and serving as a source of life within.
The Spirit of the Spring was also referred to as the River Spirit.
From the perspective of an ordinary person, the stream in front of Lu Yang and the Ginseng Child was barely two yards wide with a gentle flow. Calling it a stream was an overstatement.
After shrinking, the stream seemed extraordinarily thrilling.
A piece of wood was laid over the stream as a bridge. From the looks of it, it seemed like the bridge was built in advance by the cultivators when they passed by.
As Lu Yang crossed the stream, he had the strange feeling that the speed of the stream seemed to be increasing, as if... it was excited to see him?
Lu Yang wasn't quite sure.
He also saw a magnificent wall not far away, built with gray bricks, each brick larger than his own body.
Upon closer inspection, he realized it was a wall of the medicinal garden.
The Ginseng Child dug a few times at the base of the wall, revealing several transparent stones. It seemed as if something was drawn out of them, leaving behind empty, transparent glass pieces.
The Ginseng Child extended its roots, flexibly linking these transparent pieces together, much like a tentacle.
"What is this…" Lu Yang furrowed his brows, feeling that these pieces seemed familiar.
"I remember these things are referred to as Spirit Stones by your race."
Lu Yang had an epiphany. No wonder they looked familiar, these were Spirit Stones with their spiritual essence dried up. It was just that he had never seen ones of such good quality before.
"Do you like these things? Little Ba often buries these stones near the wall base, and when empty, he instructs me to collect them and he takes them away all at once."
Lu Yang understood, planting herbs required massive amounts of spiritual energy. The medicinal garden's spiritual energy was not infinite, so the Seek Dao Sect buried Spirit Stones in the garden to provide refined spiritual energy.
No wonder he felt the spiritual energy was so dense the moment he stepped into the medicinal garden. It turns out it was "grown" using Spirit Stones.
The Spirit Stones used in the medicinal garden must be of a high grade, perhaps even the extremely rare Top-grade Spirit Stones.
The Ginseng Child tied the Spirit Stones together with its roots and led the way. Lu Yang followed step by step.
The Ginseng Child was chatting with Lu Yang while walking.
"Beneath our feet, there's a large formation, called the Eternal Verdant Formation that covers the medicinal garden. It helps our herbs to grow healthily, and these transparent stones are a part of the Array Method."
Lu Yang had heard of the Eternal Verdant Formation. It was a top-tier formation used in cultivating spiritual herbs. It was costly and used a massive amount of Spirit Stones per year.
"By the way, I heard Little Ba said that our Seek Dao Sect is quite poor. To nurture us, they are running out of resources. He mentioned something about a game involving the kicking of a ball, where a bunch of people fought brutally, all for the sake of getting a ball. Is this true?"
Lu Yang dared not reply. Uncle Ba might appear good-natured, but when it came to deceiving the Medicine Kings, his conscience was completely undisrupted.
"This is the Illusion Breaking Immortal Wood. It has the ability to break illusions and peep into reality. It is indeed the nemesis of illusions. If you fall under an illusion, tightly hold this wood and it can dispel the illusion."
Following the direction of the Ginseng Child's gaze, Lu Yang saw a cactus.
"That is the Bursting Sun Flower, one of the essential materials used in cultivating the Violent Sun Dharma Body. Apart from its role in cultivating the Dharma Body, adding it to any fire attribute elixir can enhance a hint of Violent Sun true intent, which is highly beneficial for cultivators with a fire attribute Spirit Root."
"The highest grade of the Bursting Sun Flower is nine cycles. A nine-cycles Bursting Sun Flower can be useful even to those in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. All the flowers here have six, seven, or eight cycles."
"Over there is the Enlightenment Forest. The leaves, when brewed in water, provide Enlightenment power. The wood is often used to craft fine magic artifacts. I heard that it is extremely sought after in the outside world, fetching sky-high prices. Every autumn, Little Ba picks a large number of Enlightenment leaves for you to consume."
Lu Yang had read much about the Enlightenment Tree in books, often described with fancy words as a celestial seed and divine tree. The swift rise of the Human race in ancient times was said to be closely related to the Enlightenment Tree.
However, this was his first time seeing a real Enlightenment Tree.
To Lu Yang, who was now three inches tall, the Enlightenment Tree that was several dozen meters high resembled the legendary Firmament Tree said to reach the heavens. As he looked up at it, he felt a dizzying sensation as if the Dao was resounding in his ears.
"I heard Little Ba saying that low-level cultivators should avoid taking Enlightenment leaves. For a low-level cultivator, the Dao heart and the foundation are both somewhat deficient. Taking it prematurely, like encouraging the growth of a plant by pulling it upward, would not be beneficial for future cultivation and enlightenment."
"This is akin to the principle why we herbs cannot receive too much fertilization in our childhood."
"The older the tree, the better is the power of Enlightenment in its leaves. The oldest tree in the Enlightenment forest is even older than me. It's a Medicine King too, and you'll see him later."
"This is Acacia Grass, one of the main ingredients in making the Acacia Moon Pill. Under the time of the hanging full moon, if two people in different locations simultaneously took the Acacia Moon Pill, their hearts and minds could connect, allowing a conversation that crossed time and space."
"Legend has it that in ancient times, there was a pair of lovers. The man came from a large clan and was the son of a Clan Leader, while the girl was born into humble circumstances, from a slave lineage. The man met the girl while he was out hunting. They were love at first sight and pledged eternal love."
"Unfortunately, as the son of a Clan Leader from a large clan, he did not have the privilege to choose his spouse, much less to marry a slave as his wife. Forced by the expectations of the clan, he was arranged to marry the daughter of another Clan Leader. The marriage was a match of equivalent social status, strengthening the relationship between the two large clans."
"However, the man rebelled, and on his wedding day, he secretly left his clan to elope with the girl."
"The old veterans of the clan discovered this and were furious. They sent experts to hunt them down. The girl was killed, and she died in the man's arms. The man, struck with grief and outrage, committed suicide, and their blood fused with a wild grass plant. The grass, even its roots, turned red, and hence, it became Acacia Grass."
Lu Yang, engrossed in the story, subconsciously asked, "How touching, did this really happen?"
"It's fake, someone made it up to inflate the price of the Acacia Grass. I was just beside them when they fabricated the story."
"..."

chapters.title: Chapter 35 - 34 Little Medicinal Kings (Thanks to book friend thoridal for the alliance leader reward)_1
chapters.content:
"When I first traveled across the Central Continent, I made a name for myself. If it hadn't been for someone touting my Yang invigorating effect, forcing me to seek refuge in the Seek Dao Sect, I would still be traveling around."
"The person who traveled with me built a considerable reputation among your human race, called Master Old Moon. When he brought me to the Seek Dao Sect, he said he would mention me in his book, ensuring that the world would remember me."
Master Old Moon was a famous traveler of the Central Continent. He enjoyed travelling and exploring, leaving his footprints in the Central Continent, Demon Territory, Buddha Country... His legends are scattered everywhere.
Legend has it that he served as a historian in the Great Xia Dynasty, meticulously recording Emperor Xia's romantic adventures among the common people and his numerous illegitimate children.
He was kidnapped by the princess of the Long Clan in the Demon Territory and managed to escape during a forced marriage, being pursued all the way to the Buddha Country.
In Buddha Country, he posed as a monk and used the phrase "the Buddha said it is indescribable" whenever he encountered a logical flaw or an unanswerable question. This phrase later became widely circulated in the Buddha Country.
Master Old Moon wrote his experiences into books, which were quite popular in the Cultivation World.
Although there aren't any explicit records about Master Old Moon's cultivation level, Lu Yang believed it must be high — if it were low, he would have been killed long ago.
Little Ginseng is an excellent teacher. Many stories it shared are from its firsthand experiences. Some medicinal herbs in the medicine garden were even discovered during its travels with Scholar Shuiyue. Lu Yang was listening with keen interest.
The man and ginseng arrived at a tiny hut made from flora. The closer they got to the hut, the better they could feel the nearly tangible life force within, startling Lu Yang.
Something's not right!" Lu Yang held his chest, his body uncontrollably trembling.
Thump, thump, thump… Lu Yang's heartbeat became faster and faster, as though countless little insects were buzzing next to his ear.
Upon careful listening, a chill ran down Lu Yang's spine. Those were not the sounds of insects at all, but countless voices speaking inside him!
The voices were crying out about being trapped in his body, longing to escape, to escape…
Little Ginseng was the first to notice something amiss with Lu Yang, exclaiming loudly, "Hey hey hey, there's an outsider here! You guys be careful and draw back some of your life force, quick!"
Lu Yang used his cultivation skill to quell the turbulent blood within him, and the voices gradually vanished.
Lu Yang knelt on the ground, gasping for air, every recollection from before was not an illusion, something really was inside his body, but what was it?!
Little Ginseng placed down the Spirit Stone and rushed over to Lu Yang, his tone filled with regret.
"Sorry about that, I didn't realize you hadn't reached the Nascent Soul Stage."
Unlike the human race, the progress of the Little Medicinal Kings is not defined by their cultivation level but by their age. Little Ginseng couldn't judge Lu Yang's cultivation level, but it found him agreeable.
"What was that just now?" A startled Lu Yang asked, feeling as though he had just walked a round in the Nine Nether Underworld.
"Little Ba and the major demon's cultivation levels among your human race are too high. It made me neglect the impact our life force would have on you."
"Our life force is too vigorous. It's vigorous enough to give every one of your organs its own will, becoming a new entity. Only when you've cultivated to the Nascent Soul Stage, completely opening your acupoints and your body is without leaks, you won't be affected by our life force anymore."
Hearing Little Ginseng's commotion, countless three-inch-tall medicinal herbs hopped around Lu Yang.
"Ginseng King, is this a human? Why is he so tiny?"
"What do you mean, tiny? He's clearly as tall as us, are you suggesting you're tiny too!"
"It must be some magic skill! Human skills are astounding, changing from big to small is nothing strange. I've seen skills which can change men into women and humans into demons."
"His cultivation level doesn't seem very high, hasn't reached pregnancy stage yet?"
"What pregnancy stage, Kirin King, your memory is failing you. It's called the Nascent Soul Stage!"
"He seems unable to stand steadily. Let's carry him into the house."
The Little Medicinal Kings small talks roamed around quietly, buzzing uncomfortably.
They lifted Lu Yang above their heads and carried him into the hut made from plants.
The Enlightenment Tree King stood outside, scratching its trunk. Its leaves rustling, it was too tall to enter the small hut.
Only when inside the hut did Lu Yang realize it was not built from flora, but from ancient woods. Influenced by the Little Medicinal Kings' life force, the woods bloomed with fresh leaves and flowers, covering their original appearance.
Lu Yang felt much better. He slowly got up and identified these Medicinal Kings.
Ironically, he didn't recognize any.
"Human, what's your name?" Asked a little grass with three tender leaves. It was entirely silver, dotted with stardust on its leaf surface, resembling a miniature universe."
"Younger generation's name is Lu Yang, may I know the elder is...?" Lu Yang asked politely. In terms of age, the Little Medicinal Kings weren't just his seniors, but the seniors of everyone in the Seek Dao Sect.
"It's Trifoliate Star Herb. We all call it Star King." Another Little Medicinal King spoke fast. It was a seven-colour flower, its petals corresponding with the five colours of the five elements. Its flower center was divided into black and white. Within the black was a patch of white, and within the white was a patch of black, creating an image similar to the Tai Chi symbol.
It looked like a water-ink painting, extremely beautiful, making one unable to help but lose themselves in it.
"I'm Time Termination Flower, you can call me End King. Everyone says I'm the most beautiful flower. I think people are just jealous of my charm and want to kill me with flattery. Being a humble Medicinal King myself, I think I'm just the second-most beautiful flower in the world…" Time Termination Flower gabbled on non-stop.
Lu Yang stared at Time Termination Flower for two seconds. His pupils gradually dilated as he could hardly believe his eyes. Although he did not recognize Time Termination Flower's appearance, he had heard of its notorious name.
"The Time Termination Flower, is that the flower that rumoured to bloom in its most beautiful state only when the world ends and all creatures die, making time standstill?!"
No wonder Lu Yang was so shocked. According to the ancient records, the blooming of the Time Termination Flower signified the end of the world, essentially a reshuffling of the entire world.
However, as far as history goes, no such world-changing event had ever happened!
Time Termination Flower scratched its nectar with an annoyed look: "Some people do say that, but I remember blooming peacefully and everyone was happy. There was no disaster, so probably the story about my bloom is a rumor."
Just as Lu Yang was about to ask something else, another Little Medicinal King started speaking.
"Lu Yang, what brings you to the medicine garden? Did Little Ba instruct you to pick some herbs?" A little green kirin asked, exquisite as a jade sculpture, certainly otherworldly.
Lu Yang jolted in surprise: "Kirin?!"
A kirin is a mysterious, legendary creature. There might not even be one or two in the whole world, making them even rarer than those in the Transcendence Tribulation Stage. Only brief records in ancient books could hint at their existence. Was there really one in the Seek Dao Sect?
The depths of the Seek Dao Sect were far beyond Lu Yang's imagination.
Little Ginseng explained: "It's the Kirin Immortality Medicine. Its current form is its magic incarnation. Your cultivation level is not sufficient yet. Once you reach the Divinity Transformation Stage and cultivate the Heavenly Eye, you'll be able to see its true form."

chapters.title: Chapter 36 - 35 Female Major Demon_1
chapters.content:
Kirin Immortality Medicine. The moment Lu Yang heard these five words, he was instantly shaken. With the Kirin no longer in existence, the Kirin Immortality Medicine is also nearly extinct. From ancient times to the present day, very few of it exists, extremely scarce. Throughout history, there are very few records of Kirin Immortality Medicine.
Some people even say that there is only one Kirin Immortality Medicine in the world.
The Kirin Immortality Medicine reincarnates.
An ancient sage once speculated that there were actually no Kirin in the world; that the Kirin was merely a figment of people's imagination. The sightings of Kirin recorded in history were believed by him to be sightings of the Kirin Immortality Medicine.
Without opening their Heavenly Eye, people could easily mistake the Kirin Immortality Medicine as a Kirin, just as Lu Yang is now.
"Uncle Ba sent me here to loosen the soil," he said.
"Oh, so you're here to aerate the soil. Can you use the magic skills of the five elements?" The Little Medicinal Kings seemed pleased to hear this.
Finally, someone's here to work.
Lu Yang looked troubled: "I can't say I'm really good at it, I learned it by accident. I'm not sure if it counts as the magic skills of the five elements, but I am definitely capable of digging."
Lu Yang felt that what he was displaying was a space magic skill. Its manifestation just happens to resemble the magic skills of the five elements.
"Whether it counts as magic skills of five elements is not important, being able to dig is all that matters," the Time Termination Flower said, nonchalantly.
Ever since the earthworm couple took a vacation, they would often hear complaints from the herbal plants about the soil being too hard to grow in and not breathable. They wished they could pull out their roots for a breath of fresh air and get some sun. This left the Little Medicinal Kings in a quandary.
But now, this problem could be solved.
Very few people know the existence of the Medicinal Kings. Even Lu Yang himself didn't recognize any before. The potency of the Little Medicinal Kings goes against heaven's will. If they appeared in the outer world, they would surely drive the Great Powers of cultivation crazy.
No, on second thought, there is one he recognizes.
Lu Yang recognized the sunflower held by Time Termination Flower — its petals opening and closing, the black shell falling off, and the jade-white seed becoming nourishment for the Medicinal King — it was eating sunflower seeds.
And it had thrown the shells all over the ground.
He wondered if this counted as a form of cannibalism.
"Oh, this is a sunflower," the Time Termination Flower noticed Lu Yang's gaze and introduced.
Lu Yang thought to himself, I know.
The Medicinal Kings weren't very large. Rather than saying it was eating the seeds, it seemed more like it was gnawing at them while holding on to them. It was clear that the Time Termination Flower was enjoying it.
"End King, you're littering again. How many times have I told you, we are plants, not humans. We shouldn't be eating sunflower seeds like them. The shells are edible too!" Kirin Immortality Medicine bellowed with rage, scolding Time Termination Flower for recklessly imitating the human race.
The Time Termination Flower, being its nonchalant self, retorted: "I grew these sunflowers. I can eat them however I want. What's it to you? Pfft."
This undoubtedly incited the wrath of Kirin Immortality Medicine as it pounced towards Time Termination Flower in resentment. The two Little Medicinal Kings started fighting without exchanging any words. One on top of the other, neither of them actually inflicting any harm.
Ginseng King and the Three-Leafed Star Grass were no strangers to their odd behaviors, they hollered at Lu Yang to demonstrate how to tunnel into the earth.
"Don't mind them, once they're tired, they'll stop fighting," they chimed.
Coming out of the wooden hut, Lu Yang spotted an enormous tree. Its robust roots looked as thick as legs, nothing short of invigorating. The dense leaves rustled with the wind.
"Enlightenment Tree?"
Lu Yang was quite surprised. Even when he returned to his normal size, the Enlightenment Tree could still be deemed as towering over the sky, being too grand for several dozen people to hug together, let alone his current height of three inches.
The Enlightenment Tree had Dao rhythms flowing around it. The rustling of its leaves sounded like the Dao Sound. It was as if the universe's greatest Dao culminated within this tree's body, granting it substance. The Enlightenment Tree was mysterious and solemn, not to be violated lightly.
"This is the Enlightenment Tree that I have told you about. We call it the Tree King. Its talent in Dao arts is matchless," it declared.
How gifted would an Enlightenment Tree be if it became sentient, considering its leaves alone could aid people in achieving enlightenment? Lu Yang could hardly imagine.
The Medicinal Kings may seem frail, but each of them possesses divine abilities and should not be taken lightly.
Without any survival tricks, they would not have lived till this day based purely on the mercy of the Human race.
The huge tree laughed and bantered, "Ginseng King, you rascal, you're killing me with compliments again. If I'm the ultimate talent, then what would that female demon be?"
"Who is this female demon?" Judging from the Little Medicinal Kings' tone, this didn't seem to be a pleasant person.
"Aside from Little Ba, only the female demon could come to the medicinal garden. The female demon is extremely powerful. None of us could match her. She picks whatever she wants and there's no herb that can stop her!"
"She broke off several of my old ginseng roots. The pain had me lying in bed recuperating for days," Ginseng King angrily denounced the ruthless acts of the female demon.
"She even plucked several stars off the surface of my leaves. Look, aren't these few stars dimmer than the rest? I have no idea how long it'll take for them to grow back!"
Around the Little Medicinal Kings, the female demon's atrocities were beyond listing, crying out for vengeance.
"What angers me more is that she said she's going to use these things to take a bath. Can you imagine, she's actually bathing with parts of our bodies. How perverted is that!"
"Also, I heard from Little Ba, this female demon holds a high position in your Seek Dao Sect. Her name is Yun Zhi," said one of them.
Lu Yang was silent...
He found himself not surprised at all with this revelation. Was it a problem with Eldest Senior Sister or a problem with him?
Lu Yang laughed awkwardly, unsure of what to say: "Um, about that, I think the Eldest Senior Sister that you mentioned... I think I know her. She's my Eldest Senior Sister."
The Enlightenment Tree King burst out laughing and didn't take it to heart: "It's no big deal. Isn't every disciple of the Seek Dao Sect calling her Eldest Senior Sister? Do you think by saying you're her Junior Brother, we are going to be angry with you? You're underestimating us, the Medicinal Kings. We've survived for countless years, how could we mind a tiny member of the Human race?"
Seeing the rational response from the Enlightenment Tree King, Lu Yang was relieved, "That's great. It seems like it doesn't matter whether I'm her Junior Brother, since we're both disciples of the same master."
The laughter of Enlightenment Tree King came to an abrupt halt, even the breeze brushing past his face stopped, and the rustling leaves were silent.
Ginseng King waved his hard-earned roots around while a menacing smile crept upon its calm demeanor.
The stars on the surface of the Three-Leafed Star Grass turned, reminding one of a erupting volcano, ready to take its revenge.
The air was instantly filled with murderous intent.
Lu Yang calmly explained, "Hold on, don't be hasty! Do you think just because I'm Yun Zhi's Junior Brother that I'm automatically on her side?"
Ginseng King looked suspiciously at Lu Yang, slowing its root-waving motion, "Isn't that the case?"
The Enlightenment Tree King along with Three-Leafed Star Grass also held their attacks for the moment.
"You are absolutely mistaken!" Lu Yang strongly declared, his hands clenched tightly into fists, showing a painful expression as if recalling some unbearable events from the past.
"The thought of that female demon's conduct is simply infuriating! Not to mention the suffering you guys have faced. I myself am a victim of her cruelty as well!"
"On the surface, my future might seem bright and promising, but who could I possibly share my sufferings with?"

chapters.title: Chapter 37 - 36 - Not a Single Worry-Free One_1
chapters.content:
"Eldest Senior Sister appears calm on the surface, but her mood swings unpredictably. The only thing is, she doesn't show it on her face. There's a saying, 'Keeping company with the king is like keeping company with a tiger.' Well, accompanying her is like taming an old tiger!"
"She's indeed a rarely seen beauty, perhaps the most beautiful woman I've ever seen. But as the saying goes, you can know a person's face but not her heart. Can you imagine, she makes me eat large quantities of beasts' limbs and the corpses of spiritual herbs every meal? In the dead of night, she even makes me soak in water filled with herbal corpses, claiming it can strengthen my body!"
"Once I wanted to learn a space-related divine ability for convenience in future travels, but she taught me how to shrink instead, holding me in the palm of her hand, toying with me between her applause!"
Lu Yang insightfully slanders Yun Zhi's various abuses, quickly winning the sympathy of the Little Medicinal Kings.
The Ginseng Doll couldn't help but propose: "If that's the case, let's partner together. You work from the inside, we shall assist from the outside, and we can rebel against this major demon right now!"
Lu Yang was startled and hurriedly dissuaded them: "By no means! We need to plan this out in the long term. Eldest Senior Sister is the top disciple of Seek Dao Sect, her cultivation level is unfathomable. We might be overpowered if we just rely on the few of us."
He analyzed calmly: "For caution's sake, let's wait until I cultivate to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, this way, our odds of success will be greater. Then, we could act together to counterattack Eldest Senior Sister and succeed in one fell swoop!"
"At that time, you can take revenge for all the grudges you hold, wouldn't that be nice?"
The Little Medicinal Kings felt that as expected of a human, they think thoroughly: "I originally thought your intelligence was slightly inferior to ours. I didn't expect that you would come up with such a detailed plan. It seems like your intelligence is matching mine!"
With a shared enemy, Lu Yang and the Little Medicinal Kings quickly bonded, screaming and yelling their plans to attack the major demoness.
With the addition of Lu Yang, the Little Medicinal Kings literally added wings to a tiger, and victory seemed as if it was within arm's reach, a piece of cake!
At the entrance of the medicinal garden, Uncle Ba sighed deeply as he watched Lu Yang's inspiring plans unfold through the water mirror.
Yun Zhi specifically reminded him to keep an eye on Lu Yang's movements and prevent any accidents from happening in the medicinal garden. If anything unexpected happens, he should inform her immediately.
Given the current situation, would it count as an accident?
If he does tell Yun Zhi now, even if it's not an accident, it might end up causing one.
"Why can't youngsters these days have better peace of mind?"
...
"After all the talk so far, I haven't shown you the magic skills I can perform." Lu Yang warmed up his body and cast the "Shrinking Ground Into Inches" magic skill. He took a position like a diver and jumped directly into the ground.
The Enlightenment Tree King and Yun Zhi had a similar reaction, they were amazed. It had been alive for so long but had never seen such magic skills before.
On the surface, it seems to be a space-related magic skill like "Shrinking Ground Into Inches", but when it comes to practicality, it also seems to be an elemental magic skill.
To be able to perform a never-before-seen magic skill at such a young age, he's really a genius in magic skills.
Now Lu Yang performs "Shrinking Ground Into Inches" proficiently. He can do freestyle, breaststroke, butterfly, and backstroke swimming. Looking at him occasionally drilling out of the ground and smoothly drilling back, it is really easy to get the misconception that the ground is water.
The Kirin Immortality Medicine and the Time Termination Flower have finished their fight. The Ginseng Doll and the Three-Leafed Star Grass narrated Lu Yang's tragic encounter under the claws of the major demoness, which resonated with them, stirring them up.
"Finally, we, the Medicinal Kings, have got an undercover in the human race!"
The little Medicinal Kings sat on the trunk of the Enlightenment Tree King, applauding one by one, thinking that Lu Yang is very powerful.
Lu Yang let out a strange cry, sprang up high with his legs, spread his arms out in a cross shape, rotated 360 degrees in the air, and with a grunt, he planted himself face-first into the ground — he had turned dizzy in mid-air.
Failed to be cool.
The little Medicinal Kings hurriedly scrambled to lift Lu Yang up.
This kind of injury to a cultivator at the Foundation Establishment Stage is just a superficial wound which will soon heal.
Seeing Lu Yang performing the "Shrinking Ground Into Inches" magic skill, they bring out the medicinal garden map and let Lu Yang dig according to the sequence.
"The roots of these herbs are very deep, they can stretch to three meters in the soil layer, so you have to be careful not to touch their roots, lest we misunderstand you. My suggestion is that it's best to dig the soil between three to five meters underground, this is the safety zone."
"The roots of the herbs in other areas are between half a meter to two meters, so you can dig below two meters."
Lu Yang was curious: "What will happen if the roots are touched?"
The Ginseng Doll seriously said: "We will think you have a foot fetish."
"???"
The Time Termination Flower interrupted: "Your human race has many perverts who love to peel and eat the 'feet' of our plants with alcohol, saying it's delicious and a great accompaniment for alcohol, hence they even cultivate them on a large scale."
"What plant are you referring to?"
"Peanuts."
Lu Yang couldn't quite follow the thinking of the little Medicinal Kings.
Luckily, he didn't dwell too much on this issue and started to dig according to the route provided by the Ginseng Doll.
The Ginseng Doll found it amusing to watch a human dig, so he ran to Lu Yang's back and closely followed him.
The little Medicinal Kings naturally have the ability to tunnel underground, but their method of merging with the ground is quite different from Lu Yang's way of squeezing through the ground.
The ground where Lu Yang had gone through was loose, which was just right for the little Medicinal Kings.
Watching the Little Medicinal Kings enjoying themselves, the Enlightenment Tree King sighed. Trees can't tunnel underground.
It looked at the sun in the sky again, felt annoyed by the intense heat, and sighed again: "Why did I grow so tall? I don't even have a shade."
The Enlightenment Tree King felt the world was full of malice toward it.
After playing behind Lu Yang's rear for a whole day, the little Medicinal Kings were all frolicking on their way back, chuckling and laughing: "Let's prepare some hot water for a bath!"
The Enlightenment Tree King had already prepared a wooden barrel full of water, fetched from the stream used for watering the herbs.
A beam of light emerged from the belly of the Kirin Immortality Medicine, slowly moved upwards, and finally shifted to its mouth, where it sprayed out the Kirin True Fire.
The Kirin Immortality Medicine looked like a real Kirin; no wonder ancient people insisted they saw a Kirin when they saw it.
With the extremely high temperature of the Kirin True Fire, the water in the blink of an eye was boiling and bubbling.
The little Medicinal Kings jumped into the tub one by one, closed their eyes, and floated on the water's surface.
Lu Yang felt a sense of familiarity from the scene, as if he had seen a similar sight somewhere in the kitchen.
He remembered now, this is called Medicinal Food.
But it was the first time he had seen the ingredients voluntarily jumping into the pot.
In a short while, the smell of herbs filled the air, Lu Yang took a deep breath, instantly feeling energetic, and his cultivation level felt like it was about to grow.
"It's really worthy of being a Medicinal King, the medicinal power is incredibly strong."
Lu Yang looked at the frolicking little Medicinal Kings in the water, showing a wry smile.
He remembered his Eldest Senior Sister saying, immortality is a poison, a pain that non-humans can't endure, only those with extraordinary characters can bear the pain of eternal life.
The little Medicinal Kings had witnessed countless historical events through the endless passing of time. Those historical famous figures and events have all vanished, only the little Medicinal Kings are still alive.
Perhaps only with a childlike character, the little Medicinal Kings are able to live for such a long time without collapsing.
It's just too easy to be deceived.

chapters.title: Chapter 38 - 37 Medicine King Spirit Liquid_1
chapters.content:
Under the dazzling night sky, the majestic form of the Enlightenment Tree King was obstructing the moonlight. The Little Medicinal Kings were playing joyfully in the water, even Lu Yang joined in, everyone was getting along very well, as if the time had come to a standstill.
After the Little Medicinal Kings finished their refreshing bath, they were sprawled all over the ground, on top of the wooden hut; fast asleep.
The Enlightenment Tree King was not idle, during the time the Little Medicinal Kings were sleeping, he collected the wooden tub and water which puzzled Lu Yang.
"What are you doing?"
"Oh, this is something that Little Ba wanted. He said the bathwater was valuable, and the disciples of the Seek Dao Sect like to use it," the Enlightenment Tree King casually explained.
The Enlightenment Tree King moved its branches, like shrugging its shoulders, indicating a slight helplessness towards the behaviors of the human race.
As a plant, it found it hard to understand several strange behaviors of the human race. For instance, it knew that humans very much liked to use its hair, which was actually leaves, for tea infusion, or use its skin, the bark, for cooking, stating that it enhances the flavor, something resembling the bark of the Cinnamomum cassia.
"Oh, that's right; Little Ba even gave the bathwater a nice name, calling it Medicine King Spirit Liquid. It seems like you humans are so cultured; your naming abilities are way superior to ours."
"Medicine King Spirit Liquid?"
Lu Yang subconsciously repeated the name under his breath; he felt like he had heard this name somewhere before. Then he swiftly remembered where he had come across this term.
Wasn't this the highly sought-after Medicine King Spirit Liquid listed on the reward points exchange board!
The Medicine King Spirit Liquid listed in the board was introduced as a precious liquid specifically refined by the high ranking leaders of the Seek Dao Sect, so this was how it was specifically refined!
Lu Yang began to question all the weird and bizarre items listed on the board. They seemed alright based on their descriptions, but that didn't mean there were no issues!
...
In the following days, Lu Yang was laboriously drilling into the earth and listening to the Little Medicinal Kings chatter non-stop about herb knowledge. Life was fulfilling.
"I remember there is an Eight Treasure Lotus field ahead. They are tender and pink, very beautiful. Do you want to drill and have a look?" The Ginseng Baby said from behind Lu Yang.
"... Shouldn't lotuses grow in a pond?"
"Yes." The Ginseng Baby nodded matter-of-factly.
"So if I drilled over there, wouldn't I just land right in the pool?"
The Ginseng Baby seemed to understand immediately, "Aha. You make a good point."
"..."
Following the directions given by the Ginseng Baby, Lu Yang emerged from the earth and not far from there was the magnificent Eight Treasure Lotus. The morning dews cling to the tips of its petals, falling and hitting the water surface, creating ripples.
The Eight Treasure Lotus has beneficial properties of cooling the body, removing dampness, detoxifying, and nourishing the heart, often used in pill refining.
"I just really want to know why it's called the 'Eight Treasure' Lotus." Lu Yang said, recalling the information he read from a book.
Among the Pill Masters, this was an undecipherable mystery. Numerous Pill Masters had written books, cited scriptures and doctrines, suggesting various theories.
For example, one theory suggests that, because the Eight Treasure Lotus has eight effects, it is thus named Eight Treasure. Another says that the name came from the Supreme Eight Diagrams, others said that Eight Treasure refers to the eight meridians of the human body, consuming more Eight Treasure Lotus can unblock all eight meridians... There are many different theories.
Lu Yang was more inclined to believe the first conjecture, that there are eight effects, regardless of other claims, the first one seemed more reasonable at least.
