"Ah, you're talking about this? I know." The Ginseng Baby spoke.
"You know?"
The Ginseng Baby held its waist with a tendril, and spoke confidently: "Yes, the Eight Treasure Lotus was discovered by Master Old Moon. At that time, both of us happened to have stumbled upon a secret and undiscovered realm. Fortunately, our cultivation levels were profound, and the secret realm posed no danger to us."
"We enjoyed ourselves in the secret realm, when we got tired, we would rest on the spot, eating and sleeping, just for fun."
"During a meal, Master Old Moon noticed a patch of pink lotuses that he had never seen before. I asked what he would like to name these lotuses. He looked at the Eight Treasure Porridge in his hand and casually suggested naming it the "Eight Treasure Lotus."
"Later on, he took a few of the lotus plants, propagated them in the outside world, creating the scale that we see today."
Lu Yang: "...."
This was not the first time he'd heard a story about Master Old Moon; each time the stories concluded with unexpected outcomes.
The other Little Medicinal Kings had traveled to many mountains and rivers and experienced many things, but none of them were as exciting as the adventures the Ginseng Baby had.
Through interacting with the Little Medicinal Kings, they slowly accepted Lu Yang. Even when Lu Yang returned to his original form, the Little Medicinal Kings did not reject him. Instead, they found his larger form to be interesting.
A month went by unnoticed, during which Uncle Ba took away the empty Spirit Stones and the bathing water of the Little Medicinal Kings, and brought a large number of top-grade Spirit Stones for the Little Medicinal Kings to bury in the original place.
Uncle Ba would occasionally pick a large number of herbs to supply Elixir Cauldron Peak.
...
"Originally, Master Old Moon wasn't known as Master Old Moon, his surname was Hu, which means scribble, so he calls himself the Scribbler. His handwriting wasn't that great, and there was one time when he wrote his own name in a sloppy way, and people read it as Old Moon, rather than Hu.
He was quite indifferent about it, so he just went along with Old Moon." The Ginseng Baby, as usual, was babbling about Master Old Moon's shameful past in Lu Yang's ear.
At that moment, Uncle Ba sent a message to Lu Yang.
"Lu Yang, come out for a bit."
When he arrived at the entrance of the medicinal field, he saw a loving couple. The husband was confident and radiant, while the wife was dependent and sweet. However, their clothing was unconventional, in Lu Yang's view.
They were wearing clothes that looked like swimming rings, incredibly bulky, like they could float even if they fell into the sea.
This was the dressing habit of their race.
"Who are these two?"
"Let me introduce them, these few are your seniors, the Silver Ring King Worms." Uncle Ba explained.
Lu Yang finally understood. It seemed that the couple had resolved their differences and were reunited, so he didn't need to continue his digging.
They managed to resolve their emotional dispute within just a month, quite quickly. He thought it would take at least forty to fifty episodes of a drama, where in the end the female lead would lose her memory, and the male lead would help her regain her memory, leading to a happily ever after.
"His name is Lu Yang, you must have heard about him, the Sect Leader's fourth disciple, personally nurtured by Yun Zhi."
"Nice to meet you, seniors." Lu Yang gave a formal salute, which startled the Silver Ring King Worms. They quickly helped Lu Yang up, refusing to accept his salute.
"You're junior brother under Yun Zhi's guidance. You can call me Li Yin or Little Li, this is my wife, Little Li."
The younger brother of the female demon, who would dare to regard him as junior? Lu Yang didn't know what kind of image his eldest senior sister had in the minds of others.
"How did you manage to resolve the conflict?"
"What difficulty could there be?" A voice came from below the ground.
A couple emerged from the ground; they looked identical to the Silver Ring King Worms.
"Since my wife can split herself into two and become twins, naturally, I can do the same and create a brother." Little Li stated proudly.
The second Little Li couple was very affectionate as well.
Uncle Ba nodded in satisfaction; this idea was his.
He was a man of responsibility. If there was a problem, he would solve it.

chapters.title: Chapter 39 - 38 Farewell Scene is Quite Touching_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang chewed over it for ages, completely at a loss on how to judge this method that challenged moral ethics and thought patterns.
"It's good that the matter was resolved."
This was all he managed to blurt out after a long pondering.
Uncle Ba also thought resolving the situation was a good thing, not to mention that the method was his own idea in the first place.
Uncle Ba patted Lu Yang's shoulder: "The Little Medicinal Kings are all quite mischievous. You've had a tough time these days, show me your jade pendant."
Lu Yang did as he was asked, and Uncle Ba tapped on his jade pendant: "The three hundred contribution points from the task reward are now in your pendant."
Effort yields rewards, hard work was not in vain. Three hundred contribution points were a fortune for Lu Yang.
Then Lu Yang thought, three hundred contribution points seemed a lot, but it seemed that it couldn't even afford the foot bath water of the Little Medicinal Kings.
The exchange list clearly stated that the Medicine King Spirit Liquid comes in both regular and luxury editions.
According to Lu Yang's understanding, the regular version was the Little Medicinal Kings' foot bath water, and the luxury version was the bath water.
"Say your goodbyes to the Little Medicinal Kings. Chances to enter the medicinal garden are rare, you probably won't have the chance to come back in the future..."
Uncle Ba's words trailed off in the middle, as he suddenly remembered that as long as Yun Zhi allowed Lu Yang to come, he had to obediently let him pass without the guts to block him.
"Ahem, anyhow, go say your farewells."
Lu Yang merely responded with an "oh", feeling like Uncle Ba had left something unsaid.
Knowing that Lu Yang was leaving, the Little Medicinal Kings were somewhat reluctant to let him go.
"We're all friends here, take my old ginseng roots with you, oh, they're too valuable, I can't bear to part with them."
"As for my old ginseng skin... it's too painful, never mind. I don't really have anything valuable here, so I'll just bid you farewell verbally." The ginseng doll bid farewell to Lu Yang.
It didn't give anything when it bid farewell to Master Old Moon either.
"We're all cultivators. A month isn't a long time, so there's no need to make a big deal about leaving, right?" The Three-Leafed Star Grass subtly expressed its reluctance through its words.
"My vine body and leaves possess too much vitality, if you take them, your body might mutate. It's safer if I don't give it to you." In their time together, Lu Yang learned that the root of the Kirin Immortality Medicine was a green vine.
The Kirin Immortality Medicine was telling the truth, during this month of interaction, the Little Medicinal Kings suppressed their life force, fearing that Lu Yang would accidentally receive it.
If they were to give a part of their bodies to Lu Yang, they would inevitably have to apply dozens of seals. Lu Yang would be afraid to use it even if he received it.
"After saying goodbye, aren't you going to give us some gifts?" The Time Termination Flower on the contrary, asked Lu Yang for a gift.
Lu Yang, moved by the atmosphere, his eyes brimming with hot tears: "After some time, I'll definitely have Eldest Senior Sister come to visit everyone."
The Little Medicinal Kings quickly kicked Lu Yang out.
The farewell scene was quite pressing.
...
Not comparing with the Medicine King Spirit Liquid, these three hundred contribution points were a huge sum for Lu Yang, who was only at the Foundation Establishment Stage.
He was eager to try, to use them at the Task Hall to purchase some good stuff.
It couldn't always be Eldest Senior Sister giving him things, he wanted to earn his own money through hard work.
"Ah, I was just saying I wanted to go to the Sky Gate Mountain to find you, but I didn't expect to meet you here." Meng Jingzhou was a little surprised to see Lu Yang coming out of the medicinal garden, but he quickly figured out that Yun Zhi was his beloved senior sister, so it was not surprising.
Next to Meng Jingzhou was a man in a scholar's gown, a robust figure with a refined and elegant demeanor.
The scholar in the gown saluted: "Brother Lu, it's been a while, it appears this is our first official meeting."
"Man Gu, when you were chosen to be the disciple of Fourth Elder, it was beyond everyone's expectations."
After returning the salute, Lu Yang smiled, "Did you come here to find me for something?"
"Can't I find you if I have nothing to do?" Meng Jingzhou feigned anger.
"Come, let's have some tea and have a good chat." Meng Jingzhou led Man Gu and Lu Yang to a tea house.
The Meng Family rule was to discuss matters preferably over a meal. That way, if the discussion went well, the Meng Family would treat, and if it didn't, everyone would split the bill.
"Gentlemen, what would you like to drink? We have all types of tea here in our teahouse." The waiter deftly asked.
Lu Yang also could not figure out the waiter's cultivation level.
Lu Yang quietly asked, "Brother Man Gu, can you tell the waiter's cultivation level?"
Man Gu quietly replied, "As far as I know, we new recruits are the weakest in the entire sect, even the chickens on the mountain have a higher cultivation level than us."
Meng Jingzhou ordered a very famous tea. "Let's have a pot of milk tea, please."
The waiter suspected for a second that Meng Jingzhou was causing trouble on purpose.
"Oops, I misspoke, I meant a basin of milk tea, I remember it being a specialty of the far north." Seeing the waiter's displeased expression, Meng Jingzhou quickly gestured, signaling that he had no ill intentions.
Only then did the waiter understand that Meng Jingzhou wanted freshly-made salty milk tea.
In no time, the waiter brought a steaming iron coal basin, filled with fried rice, butter, beef jerky, and milk films, and soon thereafter a pot of milk tea.
Lu Yang and Man Gu looked at each other in bewilderment, unsure of what to do, leaving it all to Meng Jingzhou.
Meng Jingzhou first slowly roasted the contents of the pot until the fried rice turned yellow, giving a crunchy feeling. Then, he poured all the milk tea from the pot into the basin with a 'drip, drip, drip' sound.
When the milk tea met the red-hot iron pot, there was a sizzling sound, and the fragrance of the milk tea spread out, lingering around the nostrils.
Lu Yang took a sip, smacked his lips, it was salty, the taste was very peculiar, but it was quite delicious.
Man Gu took a sip, then gulped down a whole bowl.
"Do you have any tasks right now?" Meng Jingzhou asked.
Lu Yang shook his head. He had just completed Uncle Ba's medicinal garden task, and hadn't found the next task yet.
"There aren't many tasks suitable for us. The tasks in the Task Hall are not enough for us to complete. I find it strange, if they're not enough for us, were they enough for the previous senior brothers and sisters?"
"So I asked the senior brothers and sisters about it and found out the inside story."
"What did they say?"
"Not only completing the tasks posted in the Task Hall counts as completing a task, but if you find and complete a task yourself, you can also earn contribution points. You just have to report the results of the completed task to the sect, and after the sect verifies and ensures the results, they will give you a corresponding reward."
"Do you know where the tasks in the Task Hall come from?"
"Where do they come from?"
"There are three possibilities. One is based on the 'Righteous Mutual Aid Agreement' between the Five Great Immortal Sects and the Great Xia Dynasty. The Great Xia Dynasty, for tasks involving the need for cultivators but lacking manpower, would ask for help from us. However, this rarely happens."
"Although we all belong to the human race on the Righteous Path, the dignified Dynasty of a hundred thousand years asking for help from a sect is somewhat embarrassing."
"The second is when someone asks the Five Great Immortal Sects for help, hoping that we could uphold justice for them. However, the premise is that the Great Xia Dynasty does not intervene, like your parrot-catching task."
"The third is when our Seek Dao Sect finds clues during our travels outside. These are then posted as tasks in the Task Hall and the sect prepares corresponding rewards."
"The third case is our hope."

chapters.title: Chapter 40 - 39: Do you know that the Seek Dao Sect is a Righteous Sect, Junior Brother?"_1
chapters.content:
"Of course, not everything can be considered a task, there is a prerequisite for these three types of tasks; that is, to defend the Righteous Path."
"Coincidentally, Brother Man Gu found a task suitable for us. It was too challenging for him to accomplish alone, so he called us for help."
Without saying much, Man Gu nodded in acknowledgment, exhibiting the humility of a true gentleman.
"When will we depart?" Lu Yang asked.
"How about early tomorrow morning?" Meng Jingzhou suggested.
This was just what Lu Yang wanted. He planned to go to the Task Hall to exchange some items before setting off. Having a pile of contribution points in hand always made him restless.
...
"The chilled gourd, the water inside cools quickly making it incredibly refreshing. It's an excellent choice for those who prefer cold water. Three contribution points."
"Multi-functional pocket knife, includes an ear pick, nail clipper, marker pen, compass, and other functions. It's a necessity for outdoor outings. Ten contribution points."
"The Pagoda Dragon Blood Saber, formerly a magic artifact of a Demon Path cultivator. Activated by dragon's blood to stimulate its bloodthirsty nature, its ferociousness is suppressed by Buddhist teaching. It cuts through flesh and bone as if they were sacks of flour.
The Demon Path aura of this saber has been thoroughly eradicated and its viciousness completely suppressed, but its sharpness has slightly declined. The selling price is three hundred contribution points."
"A fragment of the 'Moksha Mind Method', a cultivation method left by a monk after self-immolation. It is suspected to be his original creation, the authenticity of the original version is unverifiable. This fragment can calm the restless heart, facilitating quick concentration. The selling price is one thousand five hundred contribution points."
Lu Yang looked at several things in succession, none of which he felt drawn to, so he asked the Senior Brother on duty.
"Senior Brother, I need to venture out tomorrow for training and am looking to buy some defensive tools. Can you make any recommendations?"
The Senior Brother was tall and burly, with a gruff appearance that could stop a crying child at a glance. He looked like the typical object of eradication for a chivalrous hero.
After taking a look at Lu Yang, this senior brother, realizing that he was a new recruit, finally saw himself as an elder brother, which somewhat softened his demeanor.
After so many years, he was finally no longer at the bottom of the disciples.
"How much are you planning to spend in terms of contribution points and spirit stones?"
"Three hundred contribution points. No spirit stones."
"You can call me Senior Brother Li Dan. You are in the early stage of Foundation Establishment, so the things you can use are not of a high grade and therefore won't demand too many contribution points."
With an appearance that seemed ferocious, Li Dan was actually quite warm-hearted.
Senior Brother Li Dan skillfully scrolled through the exchange list, introducing various protective tools: "Hundred Wars Heart Protecting Mirror, to be worn on one's chest. It can withstand a full-force attack from a peak-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator. Only needs two hundred contribution points."
Just as Lu Yang was considering whether to buy one for self-preservation, he heard a timid voice say, "Lu... Junior Brother Lu, actually, you don't need to buy the Heart Protecting Mirror here. The sesame seed cakes from the food court can also withstand a full-force attack from a peak-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator and it's even cheaper."
The voice gradually faded, becoming almost as quiet as the buzzing of a mosquito. If Lu Yang had not already reached the Foundation Establishment Stage, with his heightened five senses, he wouldn't have been able to hear it clearly.
"Senior Sister Zhou LuLu?" Lu Yang was surprised. He did not expect to see Senior Sister Zhou LuLu there.
When he first joined the Seek Dao Sect, he spent a month in the Scripture Pavilion. Whenever he had doubts, he would ask Senior Sister Zhou LuLu. However, he hadn't seen her since Yun Zhi had him confined for Cultivation on Sky Gate Mountain a year ago.
"Senior Sister." Li Dan, being only one cycle older than Lu Yang, had to call Zhou LuLu Senior Sister.
"Yeah... it's me." Zhou LuLu spoke nervously. She had just completed a task and had come to exchange her rewards, just as she happened to bump into Lu Yang.
"You... carry on looking. I... I just wanted to give a small suggestion. I didn't mean anything else." Confronted with the two men's gaze, Zhou LuLu backed away to make herself less conspicuous. She would exchange her rewards after Lu Yang finished making his exchanges.
They both then ignored Zhou LuLu.
"This is a Mountain Striking Hammer. Upon striking, it creates a distracting vibration, disrupting the rhythm of an opponent's array or talisman drawing. It has a certain counteractive effect against both Array Cultivators and Talisman Cultivators.
However, cultivators proficient in array methods and talismans tend to have firm determination and can maintain their calm in a crisis, adjusting their rhythm when encountering interference. Therefore, the impact of the Mountain Striking Hammer would be significantly reduced. It costs two hundred and seventy contribution points."
Lu Yang nodded. This was also a good thing. He might just encounter Array Cultivators and Talisman Cultivators as opponents.
Except for those who had been immersed in this array method and talisman for decades, the Mountain Striking Hammer would be effective.
Senior Sister Zhou LuLu quietly muttered again, "The fried dough sticks from the food court have even better effects."
Both of them pretended not to hear.
"Senior Brother Li, do we have any small tools here for sneak attacks?"
Li Dan solemnly responded, "Junior Brother, do you know that the Seek Dao Sect is a famous Righteous Sect?"
"So?"
"You should ask this question more discreetly."
Lu Yang complied with an 'Oh'.
Li Dan then held down the exchange list and swiped down hard. The descriptions of various goods rolled up rapidly. Finding the right timing, he pressed down on the list and continued to explain: "This is the Jade Fragment Needle. It's as thin as a cattle hair and when infused with Spiritual Energy, it becomes incomparably sharp.
It can pierce through the Barrier Door, but it's difficult to get the hang of, requiring much practice, and its price is steep."
"This is the Mysterious Space Nail. In the face of a strong enemy, when they're caught off guard, you can grab a handful and throw them towards the opponent's seven orifices, achieving unexpected results. It's easy to handle and the price is also suitable."
Lu Yang nodded. This thing was really not expensive and could even be described as extremely cost-effective.
"The rice from the food court is more effective than this." Senior Sister Zhou LuLu reminded from aside.
Brother Li Dan could no longer tolerate Senior Sister Zhou LuLu's murmuring. He turned abruptly, startling Zhou LuLu.
Zhou LuLu lowered her head and didn't dare to look straight at Li Dan, whose face was full of coarse lines. She didn't mean to make trouble, but the food from the food court was genuinely effective. She wanted to recommend it directly to Lu Yang, but was too embarrassed.
Seeing Zhou LuLu like this, Li Dan realized that she meant no harm, and his tone involuntarily softened: "Senior Sister Zhou, I understand that you're from Hundred Refinement Peak, but you can't just attract business for Hundred Refinement Peak and mislead our new Junior Brother!"
"Also, Junior Brother Lu, think about it; apart from being delicious, cost-effective, sturdy, multifunctional (can be used as both a weapon and a meal), what other benefits do the food court's cuisine offer?"
Lu Yang: "..."
Aren't these benefits plentiful enough?
After giving it some thought, Li Dan realized that apart from being unsuitable for combat due to its shape, the food court's food indeed had no flaws.
"Why don't you, Senior Sister Zhou, take Junior Brother Lu for a tour of the food court?"
Zhou LuLu's eyes lit up and she immediately pulled Lu Yang to the food court.
Lu Yang found that Senior Sister Zhou was terrifyingly strong. He couldn't break free from her grip and also had no idea what realm Senior Sister Zhou was in.
"Senior Sister Zhou, are you from Hundred Refinement Peak?"
Hundred Refinement Peak, under the control of the Fifth Elder, carries out both refining and food court duties, which, most of the time, are one and the same.
Zhou LuLu responded, "Yes, I am a disciple of Hundred Refinement Peak."
"But I often see you reading books in the Scripture Pavilion, and none of them seem to be about refining?"
Lu Yang was somewhat puzzled. Shouldn't the disciples of Hundred Refinement Peak be studying refining?

chapters.title: Chapter 41 - 40: Cafeteria_1
chapters.content:
Zhou LuLu lamented, "I love reading and want to study under Fourth Elder, who specializes in Confucian Cultivation, but my father insists that I choose Hundred Refinement Peak. He says Fourth Elder got stupid from reading too much and he doesn't want me to learn from him."
Your father is…?"
"Fifth Elder, Zhou Xin."
Instantly, Lu Yang closed his mouth. Hundred Refinement Peak was her family's place, of course, her father wanted her to choose home.
The main peak of Hundred Refinement Peak was a towering red mountain top, bursting like a volcano, lighting up the sky.
Perhaps it was due to extensive refinement activities, or Hundred Refinement Peak was just naturally warm, its temperature was slightly higher than other places.
Right now, it was early spring, but Hundred Refinement Peak felt more like summer.
Lu Yang felt a prickling sensation on his skin, as if something was trying to burrow into his body. Spontaneously, he cycled his energy, forming a thin, cicada wing-like protective layer around his body.
Zhou LuLu explained in a low voice, "Junior Brother, what you've sensed is the aura of Earth and Metal. Hundred Refinement Peak refines countless magic artifacts, the aura permeates the air but does no harm to cultivators. You'll get used to it."
"Though Junior Brother, your reaction is quite fast, rarely have I seen someone react like you."
Lu Yang laughed and said, "My cultivation technique is very useful."
Lu Yang heard the clanging of hammers hitting iron, picturing a senior brother pounding a block of refined iron with a giant hammer in his mind, sparks flying and steel being formed.
Looking in the direction of the sound, he realizes it was coming from the cafeteria.
"Hmm…"
Lu Yang felt that this wasn't too bad.
He could get used to it.
The entrance to the cafeteria was bustling with people coming and going, talking and laughing, bragging about their food as if they were showing off their broadsword, acting chivalrous.
They looked like students picking up food from the cafeteria after class, but at the same time they resembled swordsmen who had just walked out of a weapon shop.
"Is Li Haoran here?" Lu Yang remembered that Li Haoran, the fire spirit root, had become a disciple of Fifth Elder. In theory, his cultivation level shouldn't be too different from his own. He wondered how far along Li Haoran had actually progressed.
Zhou LuLu shook her head and said, "Junior Brother Li is still in seclusion. He isn't qualified to sell food in the cafeteria yet. My father reckons Junior Brother Li has a good foundation and suggested that he should soak in lava for a longer time to foster better growth."
"People say that Junior Brother Li was screaming on the first day when he was thrown into the lava. But after that, there wasn't any noise so he must have gotten used to it."
"... Is there a chance that he's not used to it but has actually been boiled?"
"Huh?"
Lu Yang realized, while he thought bathing in hot water was unbearable enough, others have it even worse. Eldest Senior Sister was, in fact, very kind to him.
It was a slight pity that he didn't get to meet Li Haoran, otherwise they could have shared their bathing experiences.
Zhou LuLu arrived at the bustling cafeteria. Her enthusiasm dissolved into thin air as she visibly lost courage. She took two quiet steps back and said hurriedly, " Junior Brother Lu, the cafeteria serves good quality and inexpensive food, go buy some yourself."
With those words, Zhou LuLu disappeared in a blink, leaving no trace behind. Lu Yang was left dumbfounded at her sudden disappearance.
Lu Yang sighed, realizing he would have to take care of himself.
"Braised fish bones! Freshly made braised fish bones here! A great choice for either sawing down trees or hacking down your enemies, comes highly recommended!"
"Sesame seed cakes! Freshly baked meat sesame seed cakes! Try hitting or kicking this sesame seed cake and you can't damage it!"
"Attention everyone! You have to see our noodles which are harder than steel! Great for binding stuff up, once it's tied down, there's no escaping! Buy now and get a free knot-tying tutorial!"
The cafeteria felt more like a bustling marketplace as vendors hawked their food products with much fervor. The only difference was that this marketplace was even louder — the vendors were cultivators, they could raise their voices incredibly high.
Lu Yang saw a senior brother holding a braised fish bone. The fish bones were sharp like blades, just a light scrape and it would feel like being bitten by a ferocious shark, the wound would be deep.
The vendor who sold the braised fish bones enthusiastically recommended, "Junior Brother, would you like a fish bone? This was a demon fish from Turquoise Pond. It had the strength of a Foundation Establishment peak when it was alive. Its bones are now extremely hard. I had to refine for quite a while to get so many bones. They can be used as weapons in a fight or eaten when you're hungry."
With that, he chomped down on a fish bone to demonstrate its edibility.
Lu Yang wondered how he had developed such teeth.
After looking at the very useful fish bone, Lu Yang took a peek at the price.
Well, he couldn't afford it.
Sensing Lu Yang's apologetic smile, the vendor didn't press further and moved on to promote them to others.
Lu Yang then saw another senior brother pick up a fried dough stick straight from the boiling oil vat, shaking off the excess oil.
"Junior Brother, do you want one? We have ones that can be used during the Foundation Establishment stage, and also ones for the Golden Core stage. The one for the Foundation Establishment stage costs just 150 contribution points."
Indeed, compared to the Mountain Shaking Hammer on the exchange board, which costs 270 contribution points, the fried dough stick which costs only 150 contribution points, is almost half the price.
"This fried dough stick doesn't only have the advantage of being hard. It contains triple hidden forces. When you strike with it, the forces combine and explode, producing an astounding power that can take the enemy by surprise."
"And if you get hungry and want to eat it, it has a pretty long shelf life."
Afterward, the senior brother selling the fried dough stick took a bite. The triple hidden forces exploded in his mouth, causing his cheeks to puff out, but nothing else happened.
"Senior Brother, I'm new here and there are some things I don't understand. Why can this fried dough stick be used as both a weapon and food? And can it truly be bitten?"
Sensing that Lu Yang was at the Foundation Establishment stage, the senior brother realized Lu Yang was new and it was normal for him to have questions.
"Eating it is a method to exercise and prove the results of your Body Refinement."
"Authentic Body Refinement involves refining your internal organs and muscles and bones, as well as externally refining your skin and orifices. Only then can you be considered a true Body Cultivator. Moreover, it should involve the refining of teeth."
"I heard that some Body Cultivators, specialize in refining the skin and muscles. When they unleash their aggressive clashing force, even mountains tremble. So, other people invented a method to fight these impenetrable Body Cultivators."
"What method?"
"They use magic skills, like Big and Small Ruyi, to shrink their bodies for internal attacks. These Body Cultivators didn't refine their internal organs, so they are very vulnerable to these attacks."
"These people can't be considered true Body Cultivators, they could be called amateur Body Cultivators."
The senior brother's teeth clanked against each other, making the sound of clashing metal.
Since they refined a lot, they were half Body Cultivators as well. Their bodies couldn't compare to legitimate Body Cultivators, but at least they had gone through the refining process both internally and externally.
"Ordinary Cultivators use magic artifacts as weapons, but a Body Cultivator's body itself is the strongest weapon. So, eating things like fried dough sticks is nothing big."
Lu Yang then understood, the food served in the cafeteria is highly functional, serving two purposes. They can be sold as weapons to non-Body Cultivators like himself or as food for Body Cultivators.
"Meng Jingzhou is an acolyte of Third Elder, a bona fide Body Cultivator. He should be able to chew it."
Thinking this, Lu Yang bought a fried dough stick. He swung it around a bit, and it had a nice weight to it.

chapters.title: Chapter 42 - 41: Departure _1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang arrived at the sesame seed cake stall again.
The seller making the sesame cakes was a Senior Sister adept in refining techniques. From leavening the dough, relaxing it, kneading it, to shaping it, her skills were honed to perfection.
She meticulously rolled the dough into numerous tiny balls and, harnessing strength from her fingers, wrists, arms, down to her torso, fashioned them into round cakes.
Her precise motions followed some inherent principle. It was more than simple kneading; it was like a form of exercise to coordinate her body movements.
Laying the uncooked pancake base on her anvil, she strikingly hammered it with a heavy iron mallet. The loud clanging echoes intertwined with the sprinkling of sparks against the ground, burning small holes into its surface.
The pancake base was exposed to extreme heat, followed by sudden cooling in water that bubbled fiercely then cooled into a delectable sesame cake.
Witnessing the entire process, Lu Yang was thoroughly impressed. Indeed, the Hundred Refinement Peak ingeniously married gastronomy with the art of refining.
"I'll take a sesame cake," he said.
The cafeteria was indeed offering the items at a steal. He eyed several items that were essentially works of art. Had he more contribution points to spare, he would have bought them all.
...
The next morning, as agreed, Lu Yang rendezvoused with the others at the entrance gate of the Seek Dao Sect.
"We were waiting for you," Meng Jingzhou waved as he spotted Lu Yang. Behind him stood a horse carriage, the same one that had brought them to the Seek Dao Sect. Also accompanying them was the same old horse.
The only switch was that instead of Eldest Senior Sister Yun Zhi, Man Gu was accompanying them.
Man Gu, an avid student, was studying while waiting. He was wrapped in a voluminous scholar's robe that enveloped his muscular frame, giving him the appearance of a well-built scholar.
"We're not using the flying boats?" Lu Yang had prepared himself to board one. Even though his Shrinking Ground Into Inches was reliable, he knew it couldn't stand up to the speed of a flying boat.
He had put studying 'Shrinking Ground Into Inches' on hold focusing solely on mastering Shrinking Ground and Inches.
Meng Jingzhou patted the carriage beside him proudly, "This carriage of mine is a rare treasure. It is encapsulated by the Array Method and even though we would feel like the carriage is moving at a normal pace, outside observers would only see us move as swiftly as a flying boat."
Meng's explanation made sense. Considering Meng Jingzhou's family home was in the Imperial City, it wouldn't have been feasible to reach the Seek Dao Sect with a horse, step by step, which could take more than a year.
The carriage must have used Array Method to speed up during the initial part of the journey. It must have slowed down only when reaching the vicinity of the Seek Dao Sect as a sign of respect.
The carriage Lu Yang saw initially was already reduced to a slower speed.
As the trio boarded the carriage, the interior was as roomy as ever. It was only today that Lu Yang began to fathom the immense value of this carriage.
"So, where are we heading, and what exactly is our mission?" asked Lu Yang curiously.
"Oh, I didn't tell you? We're going to a place called Qinghuai County. It would be best if Man Gu explains it to you in detail since he found the mission in the first place."
Man Gu inserted a bookmark, shut his book, and started explaining at his leisurely pace.
"I heard about it on one of my previous missions, from a passenger on a flying boat. He was a merchant leader who knew many things that common humans did not. He relayed a tale that was circulated among the traders. It seems quite plausible."
"The area between Qinghuai County and Yanjiang County is engulfed by vast rolling mountains. Merchants who wished to cross over needed guidance from local hunters."
"A terrifying existence has emerged within these forests and compelled the hunters to abandon their livelihoods…"
…
As night enveloped them, heavy rain began pouring. Patches of trees blockaded the moonlight, the rolling thunder echoed in their ears as puddles of mud formed on the ground, revealing no stable ground to step on.
About seven or eight people, with ropes tied around their waists, were connected in a single line to prevent anyone from slipping off the mountain face unintentionally.
The furious rainstorm bombarded them relentlessly. Even if someone fell and screamed for help, they would barely be audible.
Clad in raincoats, walking sticks in hand, and carrying baskets on their backs, they tread carefully with each step, cautious of any sinkholes on the unstable ground.
The freezing rain left their faces messy and muddy. When they looked up, the dense curtain of falling rain obscured their line of sight. Their only option was to follow the lead of the most senior hunter.
"Be careful with your footing— the rain can make the mountain path very slippery!"
"Don't stop even if you're tired. You need to push on. We are almost there. If you stop now, it will be tough to summon the energy to continue!"
"I…I can't go on... Help me! I'm slipping!"
One of them lost his footing, unable to find leverage, and began to slide towards the edge of the pathway.
The traders sensed something off from the tension at the tail end of the rope. They realised that someone had fallen behind and hurriedly ceased their movements, trying frantically to pull him up.
"Ah Yue, hold onto the rope tight. We have to pull in sync!"
"I can't..." Ah Yue was dangling off the face of the cliff, a sisal rope was tied around his waist to prevent him from falling.
He was both tired and famished, unable to muster any strength to climb back with the help of the rope.
The senior hunter had years of experience under his belt. He calmly coordinated the group while also assisting in pulling up the rope.
"Some of you hold onto that giant tree. We must prevent the rest of the group from sliding off!"
"The others should wrap the rope around your wrists. On my count of one, two, three, everyone pull at once!"
"One, two, three, pull!"
"One, two, three, pull!"
After a painstaking struggle, they finally hoisted Ah Yue back onto the path. The group was left staggering from exhaustion.
However, the senior hunter did not relax. He calmly examined Ah Yue asking, "Ah Yue, how exactly did you slide off? Did you feel a push?"
Ah Yue shook his head blankly, unable to comprehend why the senior hunter asked such a question. He had, of course, slipped off on his own. Could there be someone who wished him harm?
"Old Sun, what do you mean by this?" the merchant leader, Qi Wu, inquired. He faintly felt that something was amiss from the hunter's questions.
Old Sun shook his head and pointed ahead to a derelict temple, "Let's press on. We'll talk when we reach the Mountain God Temple."
The pouring rain was no time for discussion, Qi Wu nodded and encouraged everyone to push onto the Mountain God Temple for some shelter.
Once they arrived at the Mountain God Temple, they disregarded their appearances, took off their raincoats, flopped onto the ground, panting heavily for breath. They quickly checked their baskets to ensure that the rain hadn't damaged their goods. Otherwise, the journey would be in vain.
"Thank goodness. Luckily Qi Wu had the foresight to wrap the goods in waterproof cloth."
The Mountain God Temple wasn't much, but it was spacious. The dusty, time-worn statues of three Mountain Gods sat enthroned in the center. The surroundings were laden with dirt and droppings, and the signs bearing the names of the gods were missing. Gifts sacrificed to the gods were eaten by the animals long ago.
Both the temple doors were missing, and the windows were shattered, allowing the cold wind to rush in.
However, none of this mattered to the group; every spot with cover was a good spot.
Qi Wu fetched some goods from his bag to offer to the three Mountain Gods in gratitude for conferring them shelter from the rain.
The three Mountain Gods were sculpted out of clay. Their craftsmanship was not particularly distinguished, but each had its unique distinguishing features. The central god held a gentleman's sword and emanated an aura of righteousness. The one on its left, draped in a scholar's robe, held a book and was on the literature side.
The right side one drawn in a martial arts position, portrayed a sense of pure masculinity, ranked and positioned systematically.
"May the Mountain Gods bless our journey," said Qi Wu.
Qi Wu always had the feeling that the three Mountain Gods had supernatural spirits and were alive in some way.

chapters.title: Chapter 43 - 42 Legends Often Differ from Facts_1
chapters.content:
After offering his tribute to the mountain god, Qi Wu hastily gathers with others.
Completely drenched, everyone shivers in the cold wind.
"We'll get sick if this keeps up."
The old hunter goes to a corner, pulls out a handful of firewood, and grins with his big smile, "We hunters sometimes shelter from the rain here, so I left some firewood in advance for today."
Qi Wu is overjoyed: "Thank you so much."
The old hunter didn't mind: "It's nothing, living in the mountains is about helping each other. When the rain stops tomorrow, we'll just collect some more firewood to replace it."
Everyone swiftly piles up the firewood on the burned imprint on the ground. Qi Wu takes out a fire talisman, lights a stick, puts the stick into the firewood, blows gently, and fans it. The firewood is slowly ignited.
All eyes focus on the gradually rising flames, feeling the warmth of the fire, someone breathed a sigh of relief.
"Finally, we survived."
"Big Brother Qi, would you like a yellow rice cake or a white one?"
"One of each?"
One of them starts distributing the dry food. After everyone gets theirs, they toast the food by the fire.
Once the food smells good, Ah Yue takes out a jar of pickles, letting everyone spread it on their bread, and bite into the salty and fragrant flavor.
"Ah Yue's pickle-making skills are quite good. I say, Ah Yue, you should open a pickle shop instead of following us merchants."
Ah Yue just smiles, saying nothing.
Recalling the previous incident, Qi Wu asks, "Old Sun, why did you ask earlier if Ah Yue was pushed down by someone?"
It is Qi Wu and his group's first time going up the mountain. They want to cross the mountain range to sell goods on the other side of Qinghuai County. After a long search, they finally found a local old hunter to guide them.
The old hunter looks serious: "Have you heard of a ghoul?"
Qi Wu and the others look serious, they've traveled far and wide and naturally know something about ghouls. One of them even exclaims loudly: "Are you talking about the ghoul serving a tiger demon?"
The old hunter nods and says softly, "This mountain is called Song Mountain. About ten years ago, a hunter who came to hunt disappeared, leaving only a shoe. People then started saying, a tiger demon came to the mountain and ate that hunter."
"At first, no one wanted to believe it. They thought they had been living here for generations, how could there possibly be a tiger demon?"
"But as time went by, someone said they saw a colorful tiger during hunting, and it was at least four meters long. The tiger pounced on the hunting dog with one leap. The hunter ran away at the sight of it. Fortunately, the tiger didn't chase after him!"
"People discovered people were disappearing from time to time, so they reported the situation to the Qinghuai County government office. They said since Song Mountain is close to Yanjiang County, and since we only sell our game to Yanjiang County, they should be responsible."
"When it got to Yanjiang County, the officials said that Song Mountain belongs to Qinghuai County, they should be responsible."
"After a few rounds of this, each side sent two cultivators to search for the tiger demon on Song Mountain. After ten days of searching, they couldn't even find a single tiger hair. The cultivators thought we were fooling them and wasted their time. We tried to explain that maybe the tiger demon was deliberately hiding from them, but the two cultivators didn't listen and left."
"We went to the government office again, but they ignored us."
"We had no way out, so most people left Song Mountain to find new means of livelihood. Only a few of us old folks stayed, we can't do anything but hunting."
"Later on, we discovered that during the hunts, we would encounter those missing travelers. They would appear and disappear out of blue, sometimes pushing you."
"Sometimes, when I would lead people into the mountain, those travelers would pretend to bump into us and ask to join. How could I agree? I hurriedly lead the group away."
"The older generation used to say that there's something called a ghoul in this world. When a tiger demon kills a person, the person becomes a ghoul, helping the tiger demon to find prey, and lure people into a trap to turn them into new ghouls."
"But, dealing with ghouls isn't difficult, as long as you refuse their requests, they won't harm you."
All of this suddenly made sense to Qi Wu. He had been wondering why such a large forest had so few hunters. Now he understood why it took him so long to find only a few clusters of hunters living together.
It's all due to the tiger demon.
Seeing Ah Yue still looking apprehensive, Qi Wu asks: "Ah Yue, ask whatever you want to ask."
Ah Yue felt like his question was embarrassing to ask but since the Boss said so, he dropped his reserve.
"I just have one question, do these ghouls have female ghosts? Are they pretty? Do they seduce men? Do they suck men's Yang Qi? Could it be possible for me to have a forbidden love with her, hiding from the tiger demon, traveling around?"
With each question Ah Yue asks, a question mark appears over everyone's head, including the old hunter.
Seeing everyone else's reactions, Ah Yue scratches his head shyly: "I read storybooks where it's written like this, beautiful female ghosts, unresolved affection between humans and ghosts, and the likes."
Qi Wu remains silent for a while, then pats Ah Yue on the shoulder: "You should read fewer books."
Then, Qi Wu asks: "Then why didn't you report this matter to the Five Great Immortal Sects? The Five Great Immortal Sects defend the Righteous Path, they would never stand by and do nothing."
"The Five Great Immortal Sects?" The old hunter looks blank, never having heard of this term.
"That is, the Seek Dao Sect, the Suspension Temple, and other three Righteous Sects. They are the five most powerful sects in the whole continent."
"Seems like I've heard of it." The old hunter says uncertainly, unsure of where he heard it, maybe in a teahouse at the foot of a mountain, or from some traveler, or when he was younger, or when he got older.
He can't remember clearly.
In fact, ordinary people know very little about cultivators; they just listen out of curiosity.
Moreover, stories passed down orally often get distorted, rendering them far from the truth, hence unreliable.
For example, Qi Wu had heard that the reason the Seek Dao Sect was named that was because the path of immortality is vast and unknown, so "dao" (path) was used to signify searching for one's path. To cultivate is to cultivate the heart. One needs to constantly ask oneself about the type of path they seek, whether it is the Righteous Path or the Demon Path, and not to lose one's original intention.
Once Qi Wu met a disciple from the Seek Dao Sect named Dai Bufan. He asked him why their sect was named thus. He still remembers Dai Bufan's answer very clearly.
"Oh, you're asking about this? Let me tell you about our founding ancestor, Daoist Xiantian of the Seek Dao Sect. He spent a huge amount of money to ask someone from the Heavenly Strategy Sect to calculate a prime location. They found an immortality land that brought together the Feng-Shui from eight directions.
They said that if the sect wanted to flourish, it needed to be established at a specific time and place."
"But it turned out that our founding ancestor was directionally challenged. Even though he had all the signs, he still lost his way. He had to ask for directions from an old farmer, and only then did he locate the sect's location in time."
"In gratitude to the old farmer, the founding ancestor named the sect Seek Dao Sect."

chapters.title: Chapter 44 - 43 Your Mountain God Grandfather_1
chapters.content:
"So you say, this Seek Dao Sect is very powerful?" the old hunter asked.
"It's not Seek Daoers Sect, it is Seek Dao Sect." Qi Wu corrected the old hunter's pronunciation.
"When we go to Qinghuai County tomorrow, let's write a letter to the Five Great Immortal Sects, and ask them to help." Qi Wu had asked Dai Bufan about the procedure when he met him.
At that time, he was still feeling that officials with no cultivation level looked down on everything. He hadn't expected that disciples of the Immortal Sects, far from worldly troubles, would be even more down-to-earth.
However, Qi Wu did not know Dai Bufan's position in the Seek Dao Sect, he just thought he was an ordinary disciple of the Immortal Sect.
If he truly knew Dai Bufan's identity and cultivation level, he would probably feel more than just admiration.
The old hunter was overjoyed, and hurriedly thanked Qi Wu and others, saying that if they really could solve the Tiger Demon problem, he wouldn't even demand travel expenses, but Qi Wu quickly declined.
It's not that they didn't want to save money, but rather they didn't know if the old hunter was just being polite or really meant what he said.
"I'm sorry, I was caught in the rain while traveling, can I stay here for the night?"
A beautiful figure broke through the rain curtain. She was dressed in a blue-green dress, and her face showed a hint of sadness, which made people instinctively want to grant her request.
Everyone turned their heads to look at Ah Yue. He had mentioned a female ghost and now one had truly arrived. Does this kid have a magic mouth?
"No!" Qi Wu immediately refused the young girl in blue.
In such a remote place, it was suspicious for such a beautiful girl to appear. The old hunter's words couldn't stop him from doubting.
What's more, the girl in blue was dry!
Outside, the rain was heavy, like a divine shower, how could she possibly be dry?
The girl in blue was slightly annoyed, thinking that these people seemed educated but their words were rude.
"All of you are unreasonable. Not to mention that this Mountain God Temple has no owner, you are all just here to avoid the rain. It's raining heavily outside, are you going to let me keep using my magic skills to block the rain?!"
"Magic skill, are you a cultivator?" Qi Wu spoke cautiously. Most cultivators were gentle to ordinary people, but if they annoyed them, there's no telling what they might do.
He started to waver.
The old hunter, however, was firm. Based on his many years of living in the mountains, he thought that there was something wrong with this girl in blue, but he was much more polite: "If you're a cultivator, and a woman at that, it doesn't look good to see you living in the same temple as eight of us men."
"Like this, there is a mountain path to the north. Halfway up the mountain, there is a wooden house which us hunters temporarily set up. For someone of your level, it's just a few steps away."
The old hunter wasn't lying. There indeed was a wooden house there, but it couldn't accommodate so many people, so he had brought Qi Wu and the others to the Mountain God Temple to take shelter from the rain.
The girl in blue thought it over and felt that the old hunter made sense. She was a woman after all. Although she was not formal, why would she want to stay in this temple full of drafts when there was a better option?
After the girl in blue left, everyone breathed a sigh of relief, fearing that the girl in blue would transform into a ferocious tiger and eat them.
"Alright, everyone sleep. We need to get up early tomorrow for the journey. I really don't want to come to this ghostly place a second time." Qi Wu yawned, his eyelids heavy with exhaustion.
Qi Wu wanted to sleep with his head facing inwards, but feeling something was off with the statue of the Mountain God, he dared not get too close, so he let everyone sleep with their heads facing the entrance.
After arranging the night watch shifts, everyone fell asleep.
After everyone fell asleep, the eyes of the Mountain God statue moved, casting a gaze downwards on them.
Nobody noticed.
...
Ah Yue yawned. His eyes were blurry, seeming like he would fall asleep any second. He and another man were responsible for the first night watch shift.
"I'm so sleepy, I really want to sleep."
"Hang in there. You heard how unsafe this mountain is..."
"Yeah, I can't sleep, I'm still waiting for the female ghost to attack me at night."
"You're average looking. Haven't you read that female ghosts prefer handsome men? They should come for me."
"Female ghosts like scholars, how many books have you read? Female ghosts like people like me who are well-read."
The two started a whispering argument about the nonexistent female ghost, getting more energized the more they talked.
A sudden deep roar broke the silence, the thundering rain not able to block out this roar. The two shuddered, getting the chills.
Just as they questioned whether they were hallucinating, another deep roar could be heard, this time closer!
"It's the Tiger Demon!" The two looked at each other, seeing the fear in each other's eyes.
"Everyone, wake up, there's a monster!" Ah Yue cried out in panic.
Everyone was jolted awake from their dreams, clutching their weapons tightly, staring hard at the temple entrance, sweating heavily and their legs trembling.
The roar subsided, replaced by heavy breathing, allowing them to imagine the monster's immense size.
A shadow appeared in the rain curtain, the shadow getting bigger and bigger, causing everyone's hearts to flutter in fear.
A huge tiger head broke through the rain curtain and entered the Mountain God Temple, making everyone break out in a cold sweat—it was a four-meter-long tiger!
The Tiger Demon stood up on its hind legs!
"Old Sun, what do we do now?" Qi Wu asked in a whisper. This Tiger Demon was not something they could defeat with their wooden sticks.
In an unexpected twist, the old hunter walked straight towards the Tiger Demon and bowed: "Please, Tiger Lord, enjoy your meal."
"Hmm, well done." The Tiger Demon spoke with a human voice, its cultivation level unknown.
Qi Wu was furious, wishing he could tear the old hunter apart with his bare hands.
The girl in blue wasn't a ghoul, it was the old hunter who had been by their side all along!
The Tiger Demon showed a human-like smile, and scoffed, "Originally, I didn't want to eat you. After all, there are too many of you. If all of you die, it might draw the attention of the outside world. However, you guys actually want to inform the Five Great Immortal Sects of my existence, so I cannot let any of you live!"
While speaking, the Tiger Demon pinned down the old hunter with a paw, "And you, you always can't help but speak too much. Always spinning tales, making me clean up after you. Do you want me to kill you again?"
The old hunter pleaded for mercy, promising he would not do it again.
The Tiger Demon grunted, "Chasing the female cultivator away counts as a merit for you, so your merits and demerits offset each other, I won't punish you this time!"
The Tiger Demon didn't play with its prey. It approached Qi Wu, sturdying him carefully. A sound like an old man clearing his throat emitted from its throat, "You are the smartest one here. If you are willing to serve me, I can turn you into a ghoul. Neither dead nor alive."
At this time, Qi Wu was not afraid anymore. He pointed at the old hunter and laughed, "To go around harming others like him? I'd rather die! I spit on you!"
"Not willing to drink the toast, then drink a forfeit!" The Tiger Demon had never been insulted like this before and was instantly filled with unprecedented rage. Waves of energy spread out, shaking the roof of the temple, making it seem as though it would collapse.
The Tiger Demon no longer reasoned, opening its mouth wide and pouncing at everyone. Qi Wu closed his eyes, awaiting the moment of his death.
At that moment, a gentleman's sword appeared between the Tiger Demon and Qi Wu. The sword shone brightly, as dazzling as the morning sun, leaving a cut on the Tiger Demon's cheek.
"Who?!" The Tiger Demon roared in anger.
"Your Mountain God Grandpa!"

chapters.title: Chapter 45 - 44 The Gentleman Conceals Tools Within Himself_1
chapters.content:
Qi Wu and the others watched in disbelief: the clay Mountain God statue had come to life and was wielding a sword to vanquish the demon!
"The Mountain God has manifested!" Ah Yue said, dumbfounded.
"No, someone is hiding inside the Mountain God statue!" Qi Wu responded the quickest.
Indeed, as the sword-wielding Mountain God fought the Tiger Demon, chunks of clay fell to the ground, revealing the face of the person hidden inside.
It was Lu Yang.
"Damn it! I've been waiting for five days, and finally, you've arrived! It was worth staying in a statue for five days, take my sword!" Lu Yang cursed menacingly, kicking out.
As someone who enjoyed patrols, it had been a great torment for him to stay as still as a statue for five days to avoid the Tiger Demon's detection.
Before anyone else could react, the Civil and Martial Mountain God statues also came to life: "Lu Yang, let us lend you a hand!"
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu emerged from the statues, displaying their Divine Abilities and jointly defeating the Tiger Demon.
...
Five days earlier, three unexpected guests had arrived at the Mountain God Temple. They took fasting pills, hollowed out the Mountain God statues, and slipped inside.
The Mountain God statue was several times larger than ordinary people - there was plenty of room for a person inside.
"Are you sure this will work?" Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu looked doubtfully at Lu Yang.
"Given the information provided by Brother Man Gu, our only option is to wait for the Tiger Demon to come... let's get in first."
Man Gu pondered, was this the embodiment of the adage 'A gentleman carries his knowledge within him'?
"Yes, yes! That's right! Indeed, one must not only read a lot of books but also travel many miles." Man Gu rejoiced. He had never understood the meaning before, but after just one mission with Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, he had made such progress.
His master was right, learning well starts with finding the right subjects to study!
The trio each chose a statue, entered, and maintained the same pose as the statutes while leaving their eyes exposed.
"Hey, can you hear me?" Lu Yang spoke in his mind using the Mental Force Technique.
Mental Force Technique was a skill the three of them had just learned during their journey. It allowed them to communicate at a very close distance without needing to use spiritual essence but solely depend on their thoughts. It was easy to master and could be used after mentally rehearsing it a little.
"Yes, we can hear you," Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu responded.
"Is the carriage okay?" Meng Jingzhou was worried about his own carriage and old horse.
They had entrusted their carriage to a hotel in Yanjiang County to avoid the Tiger Demon detecting their whereabouts.
"We know too little about the Tiger Demon. What we now know for sure is that the Tiger Demon's realm lies between the initial stage of Foundation Establishment and Golden Core. It is cunning and careful, fearing that hurting cultivators would bring trouble, so it only eats humans and not cultivators. If there are cultivators searching the mountains, it hides in a place where no one can find it."
"In other words, it avoids conflicts with cultivators at all costs."
The Tiger Demon has been lurking in Song Mountain for so long without being discovered by cultivators because it maintains peace without causing any trouble.
"So, we need to hide and wait for the Tiger Demon to come, and eliminate it in one fell swoop!"
"Members of the Tiger Demon race are especially sensitive to spiritual essence, so we must not use any during the waiting period."
Bearing this in mind, they chose to use the Mental Force Technique, which didn't require the use of spiritual essence.
Five days later.
"Well, we've been waiting for so many days, and finally someone's here."
"Looks like a businessman?"
"Wait, why is there an old hunter here? Didn't they say that all the hunters had left Song Mountain because of the Tiger Demon?"
They had thoroughly investigated Song Mountain, and the locals said that all the hunters had left the mountain and that no one had heard from any hunter selling skins for a long time.
Ghoul!
The three of them communicated via mental force and instantly reached the same conclusion: this wasn't an old hunter leading the way, it was a Ghoul leading people to their death!
They were initially skeptical about the Tiger Demon, but seeing the Ghoul now verified that there undoubtedly was a Tiger Demon on this mountain!
"Did you hear what the old hunter said? He and the other hunters live together. It was the leader of the business team who found the old hunter there. I don't think it was a lie."
"It's highly probable that the other hunters are also Ghouls. Pretending to be normal people, they deceive travelers together, making their story convincing and avoiding any suspicions that they may be Ghouls!"
"Should we take out the Ghoul now?" Meng Jingzhou was eager to act.
Lu Yang advised Meng Jingzhou to hold his horses, analyzing, "Let's not beat the grass and startle the snake. Did you hear that Qi Wu said he wanted to seek help from the Five Great Immortal Sects? Given the cautious nature of the Tiger Demon, it will definitely want to get rid of them.
Let's wait, as soon as the Tiger Demon shows up, I will strike, you two cover me, and simultaneously ensure that the traders get away from here."
"Okay."
"Hmm, did you guys hear the footsteps outside the temple? It's probably not the Tiger Demon."
Hearing Qi Wu and the old hunter trying to drive away the girl in the green robe, Man Gu couldn't help but murmur: "How foolish, with this female cultivator here, the Tiger Demon won't come and kill people. If it kills her, the sect behind the female cultivator will seek revenge. If it doesn't kill her, the cultivator will return with her sect to find it. Either way, it's a dead end.
The only way out is to send the female cultivator away."
"You see, I was right, the ghoul sent her away."
Lu Yang was more level-headed: "On the contrary, if the female cultivator is here, the Tiger Demon won't appear. How long do we have to wait?"
Meng Jingzhou exclaimed softly: "Did you guys notice the jade pendant around the girl in the green robe's waist?"
"What's wrong with the jade pendant?" Lu Yang and Man Gu knew that many jade pendants symbolize identity, but they didn't know much about the specific symbols represented.
"That's the jade token of the Laurel Fairy Palace."
The Laurel Fairy Palace, one of the Five Great Immortal Sects.
Beneath the central continent and the extreme north, there is a range of snow-capped mountains stretching from east to west. There is perpetual snowfall, rare sunny days, and the mountains are known as the highest peaks in the central continent, close to the moon.
Within the snow mountains, there is an exquisite fairy palace, the Laurel Fairy Palace.
"She must be at the Foundation Establishment Stage. When we start fighting the Tiger Demon, we should make as much noise as possible to catch her attention and see if she is willing to lend us a hand."
The opponent was definitely not at the Golden Core Stage. A Golden Core Stage cultivator from an Immortal Sect would have seen through the old hunter being a Ghoul at a glance and wouldn't have been deceived.
After a while longer, the three watched wide-eyes as Qi Wu and the others fell asleep, sleeping soundly, making them feel sleepy as well.
Man Gu recited sage's quotes, using his willpower to ward off the sleepiness: "The sage said I should reflect on myself three times a day, Are you sleepy? I am not sleepy. Are you sleepy? I am not sleepy. Are you sleepy? I am not sleepy...
"
"Stop reciting, you're making me sleepy even though I'm not originally," Meng Jingzhou told Man Gu to recite silently, as he couldn't help but yawn.
"But I am reciting silently now," Man Gu replied using the Mental Force Technique.
"Listen closely!" Lu Yang ignored the banter between the two and forced himself to keep his attention, listening for any abnormal noise outside.
"There's the sound of something stepping on the weeds...The Tiger Demon is here!"
Reminded by Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu stopped the chatter, immediately alerted, and prepared for battle.
"Finally, this beast arrived!"
Lu Yang stopped concealing his aura, shuddered, and shattered the Mountain God statue. He lifted the Green Peak Sword, with its radiance lighting up the whole temple.

chapters.title: Chapter 46 - 45 Don't Underestimate the Fried Dough Stick as a Weapon_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang, sword in hand, grappled with Qi Wu's neck and tossed him backwards, shouting, "There is a door behind. Run quickly!"
In the blink of an eye, Qi Wu was thrown three to four meters away. It seemed like he would fall to the ground, but an invisible force arose from underneath him, lifting his body and making him land securely on the ground.
"Thank you for rescuing, Immortal!"
As soon as he finished speaking, he promptly led Ah Yue and the others to run outside, without any hesitation whatsoever.
They couldn't make sense of Lu Yang and Tiger Demon's Cultivation Level, but only knew that when cultivators battle, regardless of victory or defeat, it would inevitably affect the surroundings. Their mortal bodies, if merely grazed in the fight, would either end up confined to bed or buried in the earth for the latter half of their lives.
The Tiger Demon's fur stood on end, the "king" character on its head faintly glowing. Desiring to tear Lu Yang to shreds, its attacks became even more fierce.
"I'll aid you!"
Voices echoed from two other mountain god statues. One held scriptures in hand, looking sophisticated and scholarly, another emitted a brilliant light from his body, seeming like an enlightened monk with an Immeasurable Golden Body!
Man Gu, feeling that the scriptures in his hand were too light, put them away and took out two "Great Xia Dictionaries" from his chest.
"Feels good in hand."
Man Gu had been educated since childhood that his people, the Barbarian tribe, were a race of warriors. Weapons can be of any form; anything could become your weapon. Use whatever comes handy.
Presently, the most handy items were the books.
"Knowledge is power!"
Holding two dictionaries like two bricks, he slammed them towards the forehead of the Tiger Demon. The Tiger Demon froze for a moment, having never encountered such a weapon.
Meng Jingzhou didn't need any weapons. His body was the strongest weapon. Turning into a golden statue, he charged towards the Tiger Demon. The ghoul behind the Tiger Demon screamed miserably, its body sizzling and starting to smoke.
The pure Yang Spirit Root had a miraculous effect against ghosts!
The Ghoul cried out in terror, no longer obeying the Tiger Demon's orders. It ran away from the temple and vanished in the rain.
The Tiger Demon had never been as enraged as it was today.
Just because it didn't want to have a conflict with cultivators doesn't mean it was afraid of them. It could easily tear these ignorant children to shreds and flee elsewhere. Who would be able to find it there?
Such a pity to abandon Song Mountain, this auspicious place.
Upon thinking about it, the Tiger Demon no longer held back. The tiger tail swept towards Lu Yang with a howling sound. If Lu Yang continued to attack, he would undoubtedly end up with severe injuries!
Lu Yang made a decisive move, sheathed his sword, and retreated. The tiger tail slammed into the ground, causing the entire temple to shake.
The trio looked solemn: "Already condensed the illusion of a Golden Core!"
Compressing a Golden Core requires a cultivator first to condense an illusionary Golden Core. The Golden Core becomes real from the illusionary, and only then is one officially entering the Golden Core Stage.
The Tiger Demon presently in front of them was obviously forming a golden core, its strength was extraordinary!
"I am a Half Step Golden Core Great Power. You Foundation Establishment kids dare to injure me!"
"Half Step Golden Core?" Lu Yang turned to Meng Jingzhou. He had never heard Eldest Senior Sister mention this term before.
A decent man, Meng Jingzhou explained: "It means he hasn't formed a golden core yet, but always feels he is superior and can't be compared with those at the Foundation Establishment stage. He's vainly attempting to reach the Golden Core Stage, but the ones already in the Golden Core Stage ignore him. It's quite pitiful."
The kind-hearted Man Gu added, "Brother Lu, it's normal that you don't know. The senior brothers and sisters in the sect all sneered at this term. Form the golden core from illusion? Only the vulgar would do that. They formed the golden core directly."
The honest Lu Yang looked at the Tiger Demon pityingly, "Indeed pitiful."
The Tiger Demon grew increasingly furious, its eyes bloodshot. The cultivation level that it took pride in was belittled by these three youngsters to almost nothing.
The most crucial point was that it was truly what they thought!
At least pretend!
The Tiger Demon released a formidable pressure, trying to suppress the three of them first.
Unexpectedly, none of the three were affected. Both Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou couldn't help but laugh: "We have endured the pressure from a Nascent Soul Stage Great Demon with Ancient Dragon's Blood, how could we be influenced by you?"
Man Gu went without saying. The blood of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe made him fearless of any intimidation. The barbarian tribe was clad in fearlessness in ancient times and was notorious for their tyranny.
They especially embodied savagery.
The Tiger Demon gave up mimicking the human race's two-legged stand, and put down his forelimbs, crawling on the ground. His chin was right next to the floor, and his tiger eyes were intently watching the trio.
Boom——
The Tiger Demon pushed hard with its hind legs and fiercely attacked towards the trio like a cannonball. Lu Yang held his Green Peak Sword across his chest and barely blocked the Tiger Demon's sharp claws.
Lu Yang retreated in a rotational motion to offset the force of the Tiger Demon.
Unlike the previous Skin-Peeling Ghost, the ghost's strength lies in its eerie nature. It was not good at attacking inherently and could be easily defeated once its true identity was revealed. But the Tiger Demon was different.
The Demon Race was known for their physical strength. Even the Tiger Demon's cultivation level was nearly an entire level higher than the other three. The fact that Lu Yang could resist the strike with his sword without getting hurt was no easy feat.
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu attacked from left and right in a pincer maneuver. The Tiger Demon's blood was tinged with shimmering runes, transforming into a gust of wind, flying above the two, ferociously scratching at them.
Clouds follow dragons, wind follows tigers. The Tiger Demon was innately capable of controlling wind magic skills, it was a bloodline-based instinctive magic!
Meng Jingzhou couldn't find leverage mid-air, and squared off against the Tiger Demon's palm. Man Gu used his dictionary to shield his chest, half of which was shredded by the Tiger Demon.
Lu Yang took advantage of the opportunity and struck with his sword, utterly relentless. His sword seemed like a bolt of lightning, reaching the Tiger Demon in a blink of an eye, launching several strikes. Unfortunately, the Tiger Demon's skin was too thick, and Lu Yang's sword couldn't pierce it.
The Tiger Demon was about to laugh out loud, mocking Lu Yang for overestimating his abilities, unable to even break its defenses. However, suddenly, its body exploded with several strands of sword qi, making it vomit blood profusely.
The location of the explosion was exactly where Lu Yang had aimed his strike!
Hidden force sword qi!
Lu Yang did not need to pierce through the opponent, all he needed to do was input sword qi into the opponent's body!
This was the weakness of the Demon Race compared to Body Cultivators; the Demon Race's physical strength was only skin-deep, their internal organs and blood were terribly fragile!
The Tiger Demon pulled back, not wanting to go toe-to-toe with Lu Yang's sword anymore.
Unexpectedly, Lu Yang was relentless. His right hand raised to the avoided strike of the Tiger Demon, his left hand reached for a fried dough stick, and whacked it at the Tiger Demon's head!
The Tiger Demon could have avoided it, but it saw Lu Yang using a fried dough stick, and it let down its guard, mockingly thinking that Lu Yang was really a child, and now he is desperate enough to use anything to fight.
Then it was hit and dazed.
What kind of fried dough stick was this?!
Meng Jingzhou transformed into a mountain, taking the opportunity of the few seconds when the tiger demon was dazed, he aimed at its waist and rammed into it. The Tiger Demon seemed wise and experienced, but in reality, was full of openings.
It was a believer in the no-war principle, would rather run than fight, and seldom sparred with others during its training period.
The Tiger Demon was unsteady from the impact, Man Gu made his move, aiming a punch at its eyeball. The Tiger Demon hurriedly turned its face, and the punch hit its cheek instead, tearing off a piece of skin and fur.
The Tiger Demon instinctively wagged its tail, hitting Man Gu who, going along with the direction of the tail, staggered but didn't get much hurt.
Lu Yang launched several sword strikes in the blink of an eye and added a few more with the fried dough stick, forcing the Tiger Demon to continuously retreat.
After some rounds of combat, the trio seemed to have the upper hand.
The Tiger Demon realized that despite their young age, and relatively low cultivation level, the trio displayed profound skills suggesting they must have had a great power backing them. It began to think of retreating.
But the three of them did not intend to let the Tiger Demon escape. If the Tiger Demon was let loose today, one couldn't tell how many people would fall victim to it tomorrow.
They must not let it escape!
"Don't push your luck!"
The Tiger Demon roared in anger, visibly infuriated. The trio sensed an air of desperation about the Tiger Demon and immediately became guarded.
The Tiger Demon's eyes bulged and turned towards the outside of the temple, roaring with its secret weapon, "Wife, someone is trying to kill me!"

chapters.title: Chapter 47 - 46: Ten Bulls Strength Pill!_1
chapters.content:
Before the three of them could react, they heard the sound of collapse from trees in the rain, as if something was rushing towards them.
Boom——
The massive object in the rain didn't slow down, it directly knocked down a wall of the Mountain God Temple, putting it at risk of collapsing at any moment!
A slightly smaller dazzling tiger than the Tiger Demon stood in front of them, although its size was smaller, it gave off a more vicious impression!
There were a pair of tigers, male and female, in the mountain!
This was a situation that no one had anticipated.
The records about the demon beasts of Song Mountain were scarce, it wasn't even sure if there were any members of the Demon Race hiding here, let alone two of them.
"Wife, let's team up," the male Tiger Demon said. The female Tiger Demon, only slightly weaker than it, was at the late stage of Foundation Establishment. They believed they had the upper hand against the three humans.
"Useless." The female Tiger Demon muttered in a low voice, leaving the male Tiger Demon feeling embarrassed.
When the two demons attacked simultaneously, the three men felt their pressure considerable increased.
"Attack the one with the sword, he is the most formidable," the male Tiger Demon roared.
Meng Jingzhou immediately expressed his dissatisfaction, marching to the forefront to assert his presence, "What do you mean, am I not as good as him?"
"I thought you demons had some discrimination, didn't expect you to not only be afraid of your wife but also fail to judge the strength and weakness of your enemy. You're a disgrace to all demons! See my Golden Body, so solid and formidable, with unbeatable defense among those of the same level, do you think you can break my defense..."
The male Tiger Demon went silent for a moment: "Attack the one who is glowing gold, he is the most talkative one."
The two tigers put in their effort and directly slapped Meng Jingzhou flying into the wall, forming a "big" word shape.
The two tiger demons frowned, feeling that the sensation of hitting the human seemed unusual.
There was a broken sesame seed cake revealed at Meng Jingzhou's chest. If it was pieced together into a complete shape, it seemed to be missing a quarter - that was the part eaten by Meng Jingzhou.
To be honest, it tasted quite good.
Just as Meng Jingzhou was about to retaliate, a slender figure in green dress rushed into the temple, clasping the hunter's neck and chanting a death curse, thereby eliminating the deadly hunter.
It was the young girl in the green dress who had wanted to take shelter from the rain before.
The maiden in the green dress looked surprised at the confronting sides, and the disoriented Meng Jingzhou embedded in the wall.
She heard the sounds of fighting coming from this direction and hurried over to assess the situation, coincidentally encountering the exposed old hunter.
Without a second thought, she grabbed the old hunter and ran this way, hardly expecting it to be this lively here.
Bait once caught, can bait a tiger.
Looking at the Tiger Demon and Ghoul, she could easily guess what had happened.
"Seek Dao Sect, Lu Yang." Lu Yang quickly introduced his identity.
"Laurel Fairy Palace, Lan Ting." The maiden in green looked at Lu Yang, introduced her name and quickly adjusted her mindset to join the fight.
As they both belong to the Five Great Immortal Sects, they needed to help each-other.
Lan Ting's hand made a spell, a flexible white silk ribbon coiled around her arm and floated behind her. Her movements were light, like a fairy dancing in the moonlight, a sight to behold.
"Superficial!" the female Tiger Demon scorned Lan Ting's moves and intended to tear this hypocritical human to shreds.
Lan Ting did not respond. With a light tap of her foot, she pointed her two fingers joined together towards the female Tiger Demon, the white silk ribbon tightened into a sword aiming straight at its forehead.
The female Tiger Demon immediately regretted her action, although she ridiculed, "it's just an early stage of Foundation Establishment."
Even so, the female Tiger Demon wouldn't dare to be careless. Products of major sects of the Human Race were formidable, a slight negligence could possibly lead to their death.
Even though Lan Ting couldn't defeat the female Tiger Demon, she could at least hold her off temporarily.
Meanwhile, the other side again presented a scene of three versus the male Tiger Demon from the Seek Dao Sect.
Lu Yang's swordsmanship was extraordinarily tricky, leaving the Tiger Demon in a state of unguardedness.
Man Gu took Meng Jingzhou off the wall and struck the Tiger Demon, forcing it to retreat repeatedly.
Meng Jingzhou... he had no objections to being used as a weapon.
Seeing this, the Tiger Demon had its "king" character on its forehead shined brighter. The blood of Qiongqi, a ferocious beast hidden within, was stirred. Its fangs and claws grew longer, and its aura became even more ferocious.
"What luck, it actually has Qiongqi bloodline." Lu Yang was somewhat speechless, did this monster have so many hidden cards?
Was it their bad luck, or were the Demon Races all so talented?
Lu Yang couldn't help but recall Eldest Senior Sister mentioning the arrival of the Great Era.
With the arrival of the Great Era, all kinds of demons, monsters, and ghosts would appear, competing for the Central Continent.
Although the Tiger Demon wasn't powerful enough to participate in the struggles of the Great Era, its appearance was still a negligible manifestation of the Great Era's arrival.
After activating the Qiongqi bloodline, the Tiger Demon completely lost its sanity, fighting on instinct. Its eyes were bloodshot, fighting crazily and ferociously with significantly improved combat skills.
The Barbarian Tribe's blood inside Man Gu was also stimulated and began to awaken, causing the force of his attacks with Meng Jingzhou to become even more powerful.
"We can't drag this out any longer." Lu Yang thought to himself. Who knows if this Tiger Demon could pull out any more hidden cards, better to swiftly resolve everything.
#Thinking this, Lu Yang turned his palm and took out a golden elixir pill.
It was the Ten Bulls Strength Pill he had exchanged for after completing the Skin-Peeling Ghost mission in the Task Hall.
If you took this pill, you would gain the strength of ten bulls!
