Though those people from the Elixir Cauldron Peak were sketchy in refining both poison and pills, they never compromised on the effectiveness of elixir.
This pill held a leading position among all explosive-type potency pills!
With his swordsmanship cultivation, and the power of ten bulls, he dared to fight the Tiger Demon, even if it had a hint of Qiongqi bloodline. Even if it were a pure-blooded Qiongqi, he would dare to fight it.
Seizing the opportunity while Man Gu and Meng Jingzhou cooperatively held off the Tiger Demon, Lu Yang hesitated no more and swallowed the pill.
It was hot, so hot!
After swallowing the pill, it felt as if he swallowed a ball of flame, his stomach was scorching hot.
Lu Yang closed his eyes, sensing a scorching heat in his Dantian. Power gushed from within him continuously, forming lines that appeared on the surface of his body.
Man Gu noticed the change in Lu Yang. At this moment Lu Yang had red lines outlined on his body surface and looked very much like the fierce Barbarian warriors Man Gu had read about in books.
"So strong!" Even a simpleton like Man Gu could sense the power surging out from Lu Yang's body.
This force was undoubtedly the existence of invincibility at the Foundation Establishment Stage.
The Tiger Demon tried to obstruct Lu Yang's transformation, but was blocked by Man Gu and Meng Jingzhou who joined forces.
Lu Yang opened his eyes, a hint of confusion flashing within. The power had definitely erupted, but it seemed to have all erupted out of his body, leaving not much inside of him.
The red lines spread from Lu Yang's body to the ground, forming a strange circular pattern.
Dense smoke rose from the ground, obscuring the view.
The smoke came and went quickly. After the smoke dissipated, ten water buffaloes appeared in front of everyone.
These ten water buffaloes were astonishingly at the Foundation Establishment Stage cultivation!
Lu Yang: "?"
Tiger Demon: "?"
All the people present were stunned by this sudden change, not sure what had happened.
"Screw your Ten Bulls Strength Pill!"
This was not a pill to enhance one's strength at all, it was a pill with a built-in summoning array!
These ten water buffaloes seemed to know why Lu Yang summoned them, scraping their hooves on the ground. With red eyes and a moo, they charged at the Tiger Demon all at once!

chapters.title: Chapter 48 - 47 Breaking The Code _1
chapters.content:
Elixir Cauldron Peak.
"The most crucial thing for us Pill Masters is to learn how to break through our cognitive limitations. Not all elixirs are for enhancing the power of the user. For instance, this Ten Bulls Strength Pill I concocted," Wu Ming spoke confidently at the Alchemy School, explaining the principles of pill refining in an easy-to-understand manner.
The disciples below were swiftly taking notes. These precious theories of pill refining are hard to come by in the outside world.
Outside world Pill Masters respect inheritance. The saying that if a master teaches his disciple all his knowledge, he might starve. So, learning the principles of refining pills outside world is fraught with challenges.
Elixir Cauldron Peak is different. They could not wait to teach everything they know to the new Junior Brothers and Sisters.
The outside world's Pill Masters value tradition, maintaining that ancestral methods must not be altered. Therefore, it can be challenging for the outside world to comprehend Elixir Cauldron Peak's alchemical philosophy.
When Wu Ming saw the Junior Brothers and Sisters listening intently, he felt very satisfied.
The Seek Dao Sect not only recruited Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, Man Gu, Tao Yaoye, Li Haoran, among others. Their extraordinary talents overshadowed the other new disciples, making people subconsciously overlook them.
Apart from these five, there were many other disciples with Dual Spirit Roots or Three Spirit Roots, or possessed unique skills. They were the cores of the future Seek Dao Sect.
Those who are attending the class are disciples who chose to join the Elixir Cauldron Peak.
They had studied at Elixir Cauldron Peak for over a year and were still exploring the path of refining pills.
"Many cultivators have a habit of taking a pill during a battle, which allows them to unleash a burst of strength several times their own. This sudden burst of strength may catch the enemy off guard and secure a victory."
"Victory is indeed good, but this practice can cause several times the strength to rush through the meridians. The meridians can only handle so much, and reckless pressure can cause significant damage to the meridians. In serious cases, it can harm the foundation and be detrimental to cultivation."
"Our duty as Pill Masters is healing and saving lives, so we must strive to prevent such situations."
"Therefore, after painstaking research and visiting a friend who excels at summoning arrays, I finally developed this Ten Bulls Strength Pill."
"The elixir contains a miniature summoning array. After consumption, it uses the consumer's body as a medium to summon ten buffalos to assist in combat."
"Senior Brother Wu, where do the ten buffalos get summoned from?" A cute Junior Sister who was attentively listening asked.
Wu Ming smiled and responded, "They are summoned from the Spirit Field."
The food from the cafeteria and restaurants mostly comes from Seek Dao Sect's own Spirit Field.
Growing such high-quality crops like rice requires high standards for soil, fertilizer, and farming methods.
The ones working hard on the Spirit Field are the Green-eyed Buffalos. The Green-eyed Buffalos are incredibly strong and have cultivators at various stages, ranging from Qi Refinement to Nascent Soul Stage. There's even an old Buffalo King at the Spirit Transformation stage, which is terrifying.
With youthful enthusiasm, Third Elder once pushed the buffalos aside and worked the Spirit Field himself for a night. The buffalos mentioned here refers to the Green-eyed Buffalo tribe.
Wu Ming then contacted the Green-eyed Buffalo tribe to see if they could be summoned during a fight. The Green-eyed Buffalos agreed happily.
"As Pill Masters, you must be like me, having imaginative thinking. Stand in the consumers' shoes, ponder why they need to take the elixir, whether there are any side effects, whether there is a better solution."
Wu Ming compiled his work on the Ten Bulls Strength Pill into a paper and submitted it to a authoritative publication in the Pill world, "Elixir Fire". The person in charge of "Elixir Fire" was shocked by Wu Ming's innovative thinking and subsequently forwarded it to an authoritative publication on the summoning world.
It has been successfully published now.
Wu Ming also understood that his ideas were too progressive and the cultivators needed some time to adjust. He set the price of the Foundation Establishment Stage Ten Bulls Strength Pill very low, requiring only one hundred contribution points.
Keep in mind, even the fried dough stick sold in the cafeteria goes for one hundred and fifty contribution points.
Wu Ming also clearly marked on the exchange list the effect of the pill, "After consumption, it can grant the strength equivalent to ten buffalos". His consideration is thorough.
...
Lu Yang was deep in thought.
If you say this elixir is a scam, it can indeed give the power of ten bulls to its users. Everything stated in the introduction and effects is correct, no gimmicks.
But to say this elixir is genuine, something seems odd.
Where exactly is the problem?
He couldn't figure it out.
The ten Foundation Establishment Stage buffalos were plump and robust, their collective rush towards the tiger demon projected an overwhelming presence.
Facing these bullocks, let alone the tiger demon being at Half Step Golden Core Stage, even if it was at the Golden Core Stage, it would not dare to take a head-on collision with this group of buffalos.
No matter how famed the tiger demon was for its strength, it couldn't match the physical power of a bull demon.
Yet, there it stood: even with all the inconsistencies of Elixir Cauldron Peak, its efficacy in creating these summoned bulls remained unquestionable, and these ten summoned bullocks could absolutely defeat the tiger demon.
Observing this, Man Gu and Meng Jingzhou unwittingly started to calm down.
The battle was decided — the tiger demon could not alter the outcome.
The tiger demon's eyes bulged, its fur bristled, seemingly aware that it couldn't overcome the ten buffalos.
In that case, why not drag someone else down with it?
Just then, a thunderous collapse resounded; the Mountain God Temple collapsed.
The Mountain God Temple, which was already on the verge of falling, toppled when struck by the ten buffalos.
Dust intertwined with heavy rain obstructed their view in an instant.
The tiger demon seized the opportunity, putting all its strength into a mighty leap, evading the attack of the buffalos while hurling itself at Lu Yang with the force of a charging thunderbolt!
This human, had to die!
The buffalos, with their cumbersome bodies and no aptitude for leaping, could not react to this sudden change of events.
Startled, Man Gu and Meng Jingzhou cried out — they had let their guard down and it was too late to save Lu Yang now.
The crowd was thrown into a frantic chaos. Yet, Lu Yang remained composed.
He had anticipated that the tiger demon would fight till its last breath, even if it meant mutual destruction.
A beast driven into a corner was the most dangerous!
Without dodging or blinking, Lu Yang employed the magic skill "Shrinking Inch," causing himself along with his sword to shrink down in size.
The tiger demon ended up striking air. Lu Yang positioned himself directly under the tiger demon, restored his size, channeled the azure spiritual energy through the blade which culminated at its tip.
"Break!"
Lu Yang invoked the "Breaking Character Technique". His Green Peak Sword, now sharper than ever, pierced through the thick hide of the tiger demon with a squelching sound, slicing through its abdomen. The gore-streaked blade protruded out of the tiger demon's back.
This was a sword technique he had learned at Sky Gate Mountain. Among all the sword techniques, this was the strongest. But it used up the bulk of his spiritual essence and was certainly not something to employ lightly.
In the previous exchanges, Lu Yang had discerned the weakness of the tiger demon. Amongst the entire body of the tiger demon, the defensive ability at the center of its abdomen was the weakest.
Lu Yang unleashed his Sword Qi, thread-like azure Sword Qi exploded within the tiger demon's body, as though countless long needles were piercing through it.
Inside the tiger demon, there was a snap, crackle, and pop, much like the sound of firecrackers. This continued along its spine, shooting straight up into its skull.
The tiger demon bled from every orifice before crashing to the ground.
Exhausted and panting heavily, Lu Yang leaned against the wall, signaling Man Gu and Meng Jingzhou to assist Lan Ting in the demon elimination.
Upon seeing her partner slain, the ferocity of the she-tiger intensified. She was intent on fighting to the death. Nearly unable to withstand the frenzy of the cornered beast, Lan Ting almost lost control.
Before Man Gu and Meng Jingzhou could join the new fight, the buffalo demons turned their attention towards the she-tiger.
Caught off guard, the she-tiger was trampled and mangled by the charging buffalos.
The fight was over.
Lan Ting opened her mouth, recalling the various odd rumors her Senior Sisters had shared about the Seek Dao Sect. Now, the previously skeptical her believed them to be seventy percent true.

chapters.title: Chapter 49 - 48 Nest_1
chapters.content:
The ten water buffaloes, seeing the battle end and that they were no longer needed, disappeared into thin air, returning to the Spirit Field.
"How are you, can you stand?" Man Gu asked with concern. Lu Yang's decisive, deep-blue sword stroke, which had determined the outcome of the battle, had impressed him profoundly.
Although he and Meng Jingzhou had helped and injured the Tiger Demon, Man Gu suspected that even without their help in injuring the Tiger Demon, Lu Yang's sword would still have been able to slay the creature.
Lu Yang consumed a packet of Qi Recovery Powder, and his breathing quickly returned to normal while his energy steadily increased. The speed of this was something that a few measly Qi Recovery Powders could not achieve.
"I should've bought a Qi Recovery Pill instead, this Recovery Powder is so dry." Lu Yang mumbled and then activated his Water Condensation Spell, causing a small blob of water to appear at his fingertip. The water blob extended into a pillar two fingers wide, which he directed into his mouth.
"Did you just use 'Big and Small Ruyi?'" Meng Jingzhou asked in surprise when he saw Lu Yang turn small and then suddenly expand again. The move seemed very familiar to him, almost like the magic skill 'Big and Small Ruyi' that an uncle from his clan would use.
As far as he knew, this magic skill was extremely hard to master and had a very high threshold. It wasn't possible to successfully learn it without reaching the Golden Core Stage.
"Something similar. What I used is the magic skill 'Becoming Inch'," Lu Yang replied.
"'Becoming Inch'?" Meng Jingzhou was filled with confusion. As a member of the Meng Family, he had heard of all sorts of magic skills. But this so-called "Becoming Inch" was unfamiliar to him.
Was it a magic skill invented by Eldest Senior Sister Yun Zhi?
This explanation seemed to make sense.
"Lady Lan Ting gives greetings to the three illustrious cultivators here." Lan Ting approached with grace.
"All three of us are disciples of the Seek Dao Sect. This is Meng Jingzhou, and this is Man Gu," Lu Yang introduced. Earlier on, the situation had been too pressing, so he had only introduced himself.
"Ah, so these are Daoist Meng and Daoist Man." Lan Ting, ever the poised lady, addressed everyone very politely. She hadn't even asked Qi Wu and the others to leave the Mountain God Temple earlier when they were seeking shelter from the rain, and now she was just as courteous.
"We're grateful to Daoist Lan Ting for your help. Without you, dealing with two Tiger Demons at once would have been quite troublesome. We might have even failed our mission," Lu Yang thanked her.
Of course, he was mainly being polite as they actually still had some hidden cards left to play.
"So, this was your mission." Lan Ting didn't elaborate further. She had also come down the mountain to complete a secret mission.
She was new to this place and unfamiliar with the terrain. She didn't come down the mountain in daylight and encountered a rainy night instead. She tried to find a place to stay and unexpectedly became involved in all this trouble.
"I dabble in the art of rune divination, and both these Tiger Demon's skins look quite nice. Would you mind giving these to me?" Lan Ting asked.
"Of course, you can have them," Lu Yang responded warmly, "If there's anything else you need, Daoist Lan Ting, feel free to take it."
The tiger skins were very valuable, but compared to the help that Lan Ting had provided, it wasn't even worth mentioning.
Lan Ting shook her head, not asking for anything else.
Having lived in the wilderness with his parents since he was a child, Man Gu was very adept at skinning. His two fingers were sharper than a butcher's knife. In just a few cuts, he had skinned the two Tiger Demons completely.
After receiving the Tiger skins, Lan Ting politely said goodbye to the three of them and disappeared into the depths of the forest.
Her Senior Sisters had told her not to get too close to people from the Seek Dao Sect too rashly, lest they become influenced by them.
"Jingzhou, do you want the Tiger bones and the tiger penis?"
Meng Jingzhou was all confusion: "What do I need Tiger bones and tiger penis for?"
Lu Yang mischievously replied: "For male enhancement."
"Get lost!"
His Pure Yang Spirit Root was already strong enough. If he got any more Yang energy, would his body even be able to take it?
"Keep these two Tiger Demons—it's crucial evidence for the completion of our mission." Lu Yang took out his identity jade pendant, wiped it with his thumb and the bodies of the two Tiger Demons were taken into the pendant.
The jade pendant could also function as a storage ring.
"Let's go, that mother Tiger Demon made quite the ruckus when she came. She knocked down quite a few trees, so we can just follow her tracks in reverse to find their lair," Lu Yang proposed.
The two Tiger Demons had been in Song Mountain for many years. They must have a lair.
The heavy rain didn't affect the three of them—any rain spell could conveniently repel the rain.
Following the trail of fallen trees and shattered rocks, they quickly found the Tiger Demons' lair.
It was a cavern about three meters high, pitch-dark inside, with nothing visible.
"Does anyone have a torch?" Man Gu asked. He couldn't see anything inside the cave, and he was wary there might be traps.
He had read in books that these mysterious caves were the best places for setting traps, like stepping on a brick only to be shot by arrows from both sides, or suddenly releasing a puff of poisonous gas to asphyxiate intruders. Or worse, rolling boulders that could crush people.
"Who puts so many traps in their home? Are they afraid they have it too easy when they go home?" scoffed Lu Yang, finding Man Gu's runaway imagination a bit ridiculous.
Even so, having torches did bring about an atmosphere of adventure. Outside the cave, the rain was pouring heavily, and inside, the three of them held up torches, discovering treasures. Just imagining the scenario was thrilling.
"Who walks around carrying a torch?" Meng Jingzhou teased. They were cultivators and they had Fire Control Technique to use. Why would they need torches?
"You need to broaden your perspective," Lu Yang replied as he took out a fried dough stick. With a spark of fire, he lit it and the whole stick started burning. It seemed like it could burn for a long time.
Lu Yang held the burning fried dough stick, seemingly unafraid of getting burnt, looking quite smug.
The canteen's food really came in handy. Apart from eating and fighting, they could even serve as torches.
Man Gu had an epiphany, realizing that there was indeed a lot to learn from Lu Yang.
Lu Yang led the way, holding the ignited fried dough stick, followed closely by Man Gu and Meng Jingzhou.
There weren't any traps, like Man Gu had imagined.
What they found was simply a creature's lair.
There were rarities and treasures from traveling merchants, collections of classics from scholars, martial arts techniques from warriors...
These items didn't need to be turned over to the Sect. They counted as spoils of their victory.
"Jewelry and antique... " Among the three of them, Meng Jingzhou had the most knowledge, and was thus responsible for determining the origins of these items.
"A teacup from a hundred years ago, worth only a few coins." To cultivators, a hundred years was like a fleeting moment, incredibly short. Any random item in their homes could have a history of hundreds of years.
Antiques were the least valuable items in the Cultivation World, and only mundane folk coveted them.
"A rusty iron sword. What were the Tiger Demons keeping it for, to sharpen their teeth?" Meng Jingzhou shook his head.
Lu Yang thought to himself, don't look down on a rusty sword. Just one slash can give you tetanus, believe it or not?
"'Pictographic Fist?' Isn't that a folk martial art technique that mimics animals?" Meng Jingzhou flipped through a few pages, uninterested, and tossed it to Lu Yang.
Lu Yang, however, was quite interested and planned to learn it when he had the time.
"'Words of the Saint'…" Meng Jingzhou sneered. "What use is 'Words of the Saint' to these two beasts? Are they any less beastly by having it?"
"Words of the Saint" was a starter book for Confucian Cultivators. It recorded the teachings of the Saints. Man Gu knew every word of it by heart, and he had a deep understanding of its contents.
Man Gu kept "Words of the Saint" not because the book was valuable, but because of its unique status. It had to be kept properly.
This was out of respect for the Saints.
"Hmm? There's a letter in here. Is it written for the Tiger Demon?"

chapters.title: Chapter 50 - 49 Demonic Sect_1
chapters.content:
"Who would write a letter to a tiger demon, isn't this tiger demon always hiding from cultivators, not letting them know its whereabouts?"
The three of them couldn't figure it out. With the cautious attitude of the tiger demon, there shouldn't be anyone from the outside mountain knowing of its existence.
"Nian Nian, what is written in the letter?"
Meng Jingzhou cleared his throat and read in an emotional voice: "Brother Tiger, it has been a while since we last met. How have you been?"
"Brother Tiger is cautious and reluctant to show his presence, preventing the righteous path cultivators from being aware of his existence while only attacking ordinary humans. I greatly admire such a cautious way of practice, yet such a method of cultivation is still considered slow. The Great Era is upon us, with numerous heroes ready to compete. Everyone's eyes are set on the Central Continent.
Brother Tiger, haven't you also seized this opportunity to leave your hometown, leave the Qiongqi lineage behind, and sneak into Song Mountain from the Demon Territory?"
"Carefully cautious... Don't squeeze me, you two! Won't I read it to you?" Lu Yang and Man Gu, trapping Meng Jingzhou in the middle, started directly reading the letter's content.
"You're reading too slow."
"I will read faster; you two move away."
Meng Jingzhou pushed the two away and continued reading: "Being carefully cautious is not wrong at all. However, in this awakening Great Era, being bold can help seize opportunities. Go for broke, purify your bloodline, transform into a pure-blooded Qiongqi to stand your ground in this Great Era."
"This humble one dares to suggest that Brother Tiger and his mate could join us in Yanjiang Rudder, regarding cultivators as our prey, to plot great things together!"
"Inside the letter is a token given by this humble one. Brother Tiger can directly take this humble one's token to Yanjiang Rudder to look for this humble one. I can vouch for Brother Tiger to become a manager directly."
"Little brother Qin Yuanhao sends his regards."
The letter was not long, but it revealed a lot of information.
Lu Yang analysed: "The letter mentions that the tiger demon doesn't let the righteous path cultivators know about it. This doesn't align with usual speech habits. Usually, they do not directly address 'righteous path cultivators', unless the writer of the letter is standing against the righteous path cultivators. Is this Qin Yuanhao a cultivator of the demonic path?"
This could also explain why there was a cultivator who knew about the tiger demon but didn't report it.
In the Central Continent, the righteous path holds absolute dominance. The race of demons, devils, and ghouls are natural allies. Taking the tiger demon as an example, it doesn't act directly but makes the ghouls trick humans into coming to it.
The tiger demon has a Qiongqi bloodline and is a definite golden core stage cultivator. It would be reasonable for a cultivator of the demonic path to try to win him over.
"So, is Yanjiang Rudder a base for the demonic sect?"
Meng Jingzhou nodded: "The demonic sect loves to use geographic names as their bases. We just don't know which of the demonic sects this Yanjiang Rudder is associated with."
Just like how the righteous path cultivators have the Five Great Immortal Sects, cultivators of the demonic path also have their own factions, known as the Four Great Devil Sects.
The demonic sect is an organized religion rather than a sect, with the biggest difference being whether or not they believe in a powerful existence.
The beliefs of the Four Great Devil Sects are distinct. Some say that the beliefs of the Four Great Devil Sects represent four different immortals, while others believe that the four beliefs of the demonic sect are merely four manifestations of a single immortal. There are various interpretations.
Very little information is publicly available about the demonic sect. Their whereabouts are elusive. Despite several joint searches by the Great Xia Dynasty and the Five Great Immortal Sects, they have been unable to find the main base of the demonic sect.
Whenever the righteous path cultivators eradicate a major demonic sect base, members of the demonic sect will appear like bamboo shoots after the rain, endless and hard to kill off completely.
Though the demonic sect is touted as mysterious, sneaky, ruthless and cruel, it's really because the righteous path is too powerful. This causes the demonic sect to dare not show themselves openly and can only secretly scheme.
If the demonic sect's lair could be found, there would be no need for the Five Great Immortal Sects to step in. The soldiers dispatched by the Great Xia Dynasty with the right command could turn the demonic sect upside down within five days and completely root out their base in a month.
This is the confidence of the righteous path.
Ultimately, the demonic path can never come to the fore.
Lu Yang shook the envelope and took out a bone token. There was a particular kind of True Qi imprinted on it. It was a method left by the demonic sect member named Qin Yuanhao, which outsiders couldn't replicate.
Man Gu asked: "Can we join the demonic sect using this token?"
Finding the demonic sect's nest is a great merit, definitely worth more than wiping out two tiger demons.
Lu Yang shook his head: "No, we can't. If we join Yanjiang Rudder with his token, Qin Yuanhao will definitely find out."
"Moreover, we don't know the location of Yanjiang Rudder. How can we join?"
"Then what should we do?" Man Gu asked.
"Since it is called Yanjiang Rudder, it should be in Yanjiang County. We can go to Yanjiang County to inquire if there is someone named Qin Yuanhao, then follow him to find Yanjiang Rudder. He ranks himself as a little brother in front of the tiger demon, his cultivation level shouldn't be higher than that of the tiger demon. We can kill him.
That way, we can directly use the token and say we are old friends of Qin Yuanhao, here to join him, but we didn't expect him to be dead."
"Good plan." Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu's eyes lit up.
"Let's rummage a bit more, see if we can find more valuable things." Lu Yang excitedly urged Meng Jingzhou to work.
Meng Jingzhou found a fresh red herb, the size of a palm with a somewhat demonically captivating aura.
"Blue Blood Grass, why is it with red veins?" Meng Jingzhou was puzzled. The primary function of Blue Blood Grass is detoxification, its veins are blue-green, similar to rivers flowing on land. So, why was this one red?
Lu Yang squatted down for recognition, then said: "You forgot, the Blue Blood Grass's primary function for the human race is to serve as a main ingredient for anti-toxin pills. For the Demon Race, it's not the same."
"The Blue Blood Grass facilitates purifying the bloodline, and it's possible that the tiger demon has been nourishing this Blue Blood Grass by watering it with its blood for a long time. This makes the Blue Blood Grass adaptable to its Qiongqi bloodline. Based on its current growth, it would fully mature in a few months.
After the tiger demon consumes it, the Qiongqi bloodline would be purified, thereby facilitating its golden core formation."
The "blood" in the name Blue Blood Grass came for this reason.
Lu Yang learnt about the knowledge of Blue Blood Grass from the Little Medicinal Kings.
"This Blue Blood Grass can no longer be used to make detoxification pills. It can only be consumed by a member of the Demon Race for bloodline purification." Lu Yang stated.
"In that case, you guys should keep it. You can sell it on the market hold by the sect on the 15th of every month. It should fetch a good price." Meng Jingzhou passed the medicinal herb to Lu Yang and Man Gu.
There are quite a few people in the sect who raise demon beasts. The medicine that can enhance the bloodline seriously has a market in The Seek Dao Sect.
Lu Yang and Man Gu passed it back and forth between themselves, but in the end, Man Gu didn't shy away from Lu Yang and accepted the Blue Blood Grass.
Meng Jingzhou reminded Man Gu: "Don't eat this Blue Blood Grass. The Ancient Barbarian Tribe is a branch of the human race. The Blue Blood Grass has no effect on your bloodline."
Man Gu regretfully uttered a sound of acknowledgement.
Legend has it that the Ancient Barbarian Tribe originated from a romantic marriage proposal. During the ancient times when the human race still lived dispersedly in tribes, the strongest person in the tribe was considered a warrior.
One day, two tribes met. A male warrior from one tribe took a fancy to a female warrior from the other tribe and proposed to her, "Little lady, give me a smile. If it pleases me, I'll marry you."
The female warrior grinned and lifted a stone to swing back. The two began to wrestle, and in the end, the female warrior had the upper hand. She dragged the male warrior into her house, and they didn't sleep all night.
Ten months later, the first Barbarian warrior was born.

chapters.title: Chapter 51 - 50: What Did the Saint Say?_1
chapters.content:
Meng Jingzhou flipped open a tiger skin. The tiger skin was ancient, seeming to have a history of over a hundred years. However, it was well-preserved, its dense, tiny characters all clearly legible. Lu Yang and Man Gu curiously stretched their necks to look, but they didn't recognize the script.
"This is demon text, the internal script of the Demon race," Meng Jingzhou explained. As it happened, he could read it.
The Fox Clan was innately lascivious and such traits manifested in their written language. They often penned indecent books. If anyone engaged in certain indescribable acts with these books, the author could harvest a shred of Yang Qi.
As a result, most of the questionable literature commonly circulated in the markets of Central Continent was authored by the Fox Clan. Despite the authorities' frequent campaigns—propagating their dangers and periodically arranging for book burnings—these books persisted, proliferating on the black market.
Younger, Meng Jingzhou was quite infatuated with these books, though at the time, he didn't know what these indescribable things were. He just thought the books were interesting.
He learned demon text specifically to read them in the original.
"You're so eager to learn?" Lu Yang and Man Gu were surprised. Cultivation could enhance one's memory, making language learning not too time-consuming.
However, the astonishing thing was that Meng Jingzhou learned the demon text before he began cultivating.
Meng Jingzhou had no desire to explain and merely stated that he had some interest in the culture of the Demon Race.
Man Gu was convinced that Brother Meng was as admirable as ever—studying hard without boasting, with humble behavior and noble character. He was worth learning from.
"What is written on the tiger skin?"
"Let me see...ghost objects... Yin avoids Yang...It's about using the ghost servant technique," Meng Jingzhou said.
Meng Jingzhou quickly skim-read it. After making some rough calculations in his mind, he quickly inferred the function of the manual.
"The old hunter must have been created using this method."
"The creation of ghost objects also has requirements. The Cultivation Level must differ by two major realms, except in the case of ordinary people—those above the Qi Refinement Level can refine the souls of ordinary people."
The ghost servant technique is somewhat useless. Ghouls can only be made from individuals at least two realms below the user. Even after refining a ghost servant, what - would you send them to fight the enemy?
Take the earlier battle with the Tiger Demon for instance. If a ghost servant had appeared, its effect would likely have been less than that of cannon fodder. It would have posed no real threat.
"Do you want me to translate everything? This doesn't seem to have any race restrictions, so it can be practiced by the human race. However, it appears that Tiger Demons have the best results," Meng Jingzhou said.
Man Gu was about to say it would be pointless to learn this, but heard Lu Yang analyzing, "Since we're joining a demonic sect, we can't be without any Demon Path techniques. This ghost servant technique perfectly suits our front. There are already prepared ghouls in the hunter's residence. Translate the ghost servant technique written on this tiger skin, and we, three, will learn it together."
The original plan was to eliminate the remaining ghouls, but now the situation had changed. It wasn't too late to banish the souls after using the ghouls.
According to the Tiger Demon, the ghouls offered themselves after death, turned evil, and caused harm to travelers.
They all deserved to die.
"Alright," Meng Jingzhou agreed without hesitating. He spread paper and ground some ink. His brush moved like dragons and snakes. He quickly wrote down the ghost servant technique.
"I won't cultivate this technique. I have Pure Yang Spirit Root. To a ghost, I'm like the sun to snow—it will quickly dissipate. I can't practice this Pure Yin-based magic skill."
Lu Yang and Man Gu didn't say anything further and began practicing together.
Before long, a sinister wind rose in the cave, accompanied by the faint wailing of ghostly apparitions. It brought with it an endless chill that cut to the marrow.
Lu Yang felt lighter. His feet left the ground, and he was floating in mid-air, like a ghost.
His mind was more awake than ever. Every sense heightened. He could pick up any minute detail around him. He felt like Meng Jingzhou was a fiercely burning fire, unbearably blazing!
"Hmm? What's happening?" Lu Yang was puzzled. He looked down and discovered that his body was seated as usual on the ground.
"No, it's not that I've learned to fly, it's that my soul has left my body!"
Seeing something wrong with Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou exclaimed in horror, "Only those who are at the Nascent Soul Stage can have their Yin Soul out of the Body and roam thousands of miles. How could your soul have left your body now?"
"Hurry back! You're only at the Foundation Establishment Stage and haven't yet cultivated to the Soul phase. Souls are easily damaged. Once they're damaged, they're hard to repair!"
Lu Yang also realized the problem. He recited the charm for controlling his ghost servant, restoring his soul to normal.
"How did you do that?" Meng Jingzhou had never heard of anyone at the Foundation Establishment Stage daring enough to let their Yin Soul leave the body.
There was simply no such magic skill.
Lu Yang was equally puzzled: "I just practiced according to the ghost controlling technique you wrote. I completely understood it and found no problem, so I tried it and ended up like this."
Meng Jingzhou looked at Lu Yang with a strange expression, "Are you saying that you are treating your own soul as a ghost servant and controlling yourself?"
He had never heard of this kind of practice. However, based on the current situation, it was the only explanation.
Lu Yang thought for a while but could not come up with any other possibilities.
Lu Yang asked Meng Jingzhou to move farther away from him and tried it several times. The result was always the same - his Yin Soul left his body."
"What is up with my talent in magic skills?"
Both of them were at a loss and had no choice but to wait for Man Gu to wake up and ask if his situation was the same as Lu Yang's.
When Man Gu woke up and saw Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou looking at him expectantly, he was baffled.
"Did you learn the ghost controlling technique?"
"I have some insights and should be able to control eight ordinary souls."
"Can you control yourself and make your Yin Soul leave the body?" Lu Yang looked at Man Gu expectantly, hoping Man Gu would affirm it. This could prove he hadn't deviated in his cultivation.
Man Gu looked even more confused: "How is this possible? The magic skill is for controlling ghost servants, can it also be used to treat one's own soul as a ghost servant?"
Meng Jingzhou glanced at Lu Yang and narrated how Lu Yang had learned the technique, which greatly impressed Man Gu.
Brother Lu was quick-witted, had extremely high talent in magic skills, and was unparalleled. Brother Meng was talented and knowledgeable.
On this journey, he had learned many things that were just like what the sage had said.
How did the sage put it?
Ah right, the sage said: "Among three people walking, I will find a teacher."
"We should go find the Ghoul." Since there wasn't anything of value worth looting in the cave, Meng Jingzhou called for everyone to leave.
"You guys go first. I'll catch up after taking care of some things." Lu Yang told Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu to leave first.
Without thinking too much about it, Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu left the tiger cave.
After making sure they were gone, Lu Yang's smile faded, his face gradually becoming calm.
He walked deeper into the cave and discovered bones piled up like a small mountain. He sighed lightly.
"So it's here."
When Lu Yang saw various items, he guessed that the Tiger Demon would never throw the bones outside after eating humans. That would easily expose it. The safest thing would be to leave the remains in the cave.
Reality proved his guess.
These poor people, from different places, who passed by Song Mountain for various reasons and ended up being tricked and eaten, their final resting place was this small cave.
Lu Yang said nothing more. His Green Peak Sword could cut through steel like it was mud, easily slicing a large piece of rock off the cave wall.
He flattened the rock, silently recited a death prayer for these pathetic people, and erected a gravestone. He stood silent for a moment, apparently lost in thought, then turned and left.
"Sorry for the wait, let's go." Lu Yang called to his two companions to leave this unpleasant place.

chapters.title: Chapter 52 - 51: Forgot to Point Something_1
chapters.content:
When Qi Wu first found the old hunter, there were several households nearby that appeared normal, but were all transformed into ghouls.
After the Tiger Demon was subdued, the ghouls were, for a time, in disarray; some proposed to descend the mountain, while others opted to continue hiding in the mountains. Their course of action was up for debate.
As they were arguing, three people appeared and captured them all. As Meng Jingzhou exuded a trace of pure yang energy, the ghouls cried out in agony on the ground.
"There's no need to keep so many, two are enough to impersonate a Cultivator from the Demon Path," Lu Yang said coldly. There was no need for sympathy for these ghouls who served the Tiger Demon.
If they had not agreed to the Tiger Demon's demands, they wouldn't have become ghouls.
They deserved to die.
Lu Yang tried but found that he could not command the ghouls. He could only let his Yin Soul out of his body.
"Man Gu, it's up to you."
Man Gu said nothing, sparing two of the ghouls who had disguised themselves as travelers and wiping out the rest clean and neat.
Using the hunter's ghouls would easily tip off the demonic sect; they would guess that it was the result of killing the Tiger Demon. It would be much less risky to use the ghouls disguised as travelers.
"Absorb." Man Gu absorbed the ghouls, one male and one female, into his body.
This was also part of the skill to Expel Ghosts—capturing ghosts into the body and summoning them for battle when necessary.
On their way to Yanjiang County, the three encountered Qi Wu and his men, who were still lost in the woods.
It was still raining, and Qi Wu and his men did not know the way; naturally, they could not find the way down the mountain.
"Our saviors!" On seeing Lu Yang and his companions, Qi Wu and his men were extremely excited, as if they had found a lifeline.
"Our gratitude to our saviors, we will never forget it for the rest of our lives!"
"The mountain god has shown its compassion!"
"The favor of saving our lives, will never be forgotten!"
They thanked the three profusely and sincerely.
Seeing the people they had rescued and hearing their heartfelt words of gratitude, the gloom in Lu Yang's heart gradually dissipated. He no longer thought about the skeleton in the cave.
"Us Cultivators should walk the Righteous Path, there is no need for thanks," Meng Jingzhou declared his position seriously. Saving people was a matter of course, not something he did for gratitude.
Man Gu observed Meng Jingzhou, whose face was full of righteousness, and felt that he was indeed a role model in staying calm under circumstances. He himself could not have done that.
Lu Yang knew without looking at Meng Jingzhou that this grandson of his was pretending. He was certain that Meng Jingzhou had been overjoyed from the outset and was even perhaps ecstatic about it.
Why did he think so? Because right now, Lu Yang was looking very righteous himself.
When they delivered the merchants to Yanjiang County, the sky was just beginning to brighten. The heavy rain that had been falling all night finally stopped and a faint rainbow hung in the sky.
"Did we forget something?" Meng Jingzhou felt as if he had forgotten something.
"We didn't forget anything, did we?" Lu Yang counted the number of people; it was three people and three minds, so nothing was left behind.
"Just felt like we missed something, never mind; let's not ponder over it."
...
Within Qinghuai County, in the backyard of an inn, a carriage was parked. The old horse was leisurely eating the feed left by Meng Jingzhou.
When is the young master of Meng Family gonna find me? The feed is only good for a few days. Didn't he promise to finish the task in five or six days?
The old horse was a mutated demon beast, so it couldn't eat normal feed like an ordinary horse. Its food was the spiritual essence feed that Meng Jingzhou had carefully prepared and bought at a high price.
The old horse snorted and clicked its teeth, feeling bored. It glanced and noticed a small white mare in the neighboring stable.
...
After the three men entered the city, they casually selected a teahouse, ordered a pot of tea and some snacks, and pondered their next steps.
"Yanjiang County is so vast, how are we going to find this Qin Yuanhao? Ask for help from the local government office?" Man Gu asked, frowning.
Yanjiang County is not a large county for cultivation, and its population ranks behind other counties. It is barely noticeable on the map, and only detailed maps even show it. However, Yanjiang County still has a population of two million. Looking for one person is like finding a needle in a haystack; it's not easy at all.
Lu Yang waved his hand: "That's not appropriate. We don't know how long the demonic sect has been hiding here. The assortment of forces involved is complex and could potentially include local government support."
Man Gu didn't understand Lu Yang's point: "Isn't the demonic sect subjected to universal condemnation? Why would a government office help them?"
Meng Jingzhou, who was most familiar with the matter, responded without waiting for Lu Yang's reply: "Just because everyone condemns them, the Great Xia Dynasty added 'number of demons executed' to their performance evaluations for local officials. The more demons they exterminate, and the higher their cultivation levels, the better their performance is judged."
"Think about it; the demonic sect could easily strike an agreement with the County Magistrate, routinely providing demons for execution in exchange for protection of their location."
The facts Meng Jingzhou spoke were not made up—they were recounted directly by his relatives in the government.
Those relatives said that although Emperor Xia had executed batch after batch, some still slipped through the net.
Some in the court proposed eliminating this performance indicator but were thwarted by the Prime Minister. As long as the indicator remains, the majority of officials work diligently to exterminate the demons, with a minority colluding with the demonic sect.
If the indicator were removed, it would be hard to guarantee how many officials would still take the trouble to search for the traces of the demonic sect.
All in all, the existence of this performance indicator is, on balance, beneficial.
The facts Meng Jingzhou relayed gave Man Gu a feeling of having his knowledge overturned—this was something he had never before considered.
"Even though the likelihood of the County Magistrate and the demonic sect collaborating is slim, we need to be prepared for the worst-case scenario," Lu Yang said.
"Assuming that the County Magistrate and the demonic sect are in cahoots, if we reveal our intentions to the County Magistrate, he will definitely hand Qin Yuanhao over to us to prevent his own exposure. However, once the entire Yanjiang Rudder receives news of this, they would hide themselves, making us lose our chance to infiltrate the demonic sect.
This is a classic case of losing the main chance for the sake of a minor gain; it's inclined to be inappropriate."
"The current plan is for us to keep our identities hidden and search for Qin Yuanhao first. If we can't find him, then we can seek help from the Government Office."
Man Gu nodded, feeling that the two were making sense.
"But, how do we draw out Qin Yuanhao?" Many ideas flashed through Man Gu's mind, but none seemed to be good ones. They all had major drawbacks.
Posting flyers and notices was out of the question—it would draw too much attention.
Gathering information in black markets? If Qin Yuanhao found out that people were trying to find out about him, he would go into hiding. It's likely that he would even rally forces from the demonic sect to suppress them, which would place them in a passive position. That plan wouldn't work.
Man Gu was curious to know what plan Brother Lu and Brother Meng had come up with.
Early on the journey down the mountain, Lu Yang had thought of a plan. He chuckled and said, "Do you know, unlike us from the Righteous Sect, those who drift in the society outside value face that much."
"Especially the people in the demonic sect, they take face as their status; a loss of face stings more than being killed."
"So what we need to do is to widely propagate that Qin Yuanhao is a kind person who does good deeds every day without attending to proper duties. Once the rumor that he is a good person has circulated throughout the whole Yanjiang County, and everyone in the demonic sect thinks of him as such, he will find it intolerable and jump out!"
"That will be our opportunity!"
Meng Jingzhou simply summed it up: "In other words, concoct and spread rumors."
Conveniently, Meng Jingzhou was a natural at this, excelling at causing a scene.
Man Gu realized all at once that this was indeed a great plan. If they can't find Qin Yuanhao, they can directly compel him to come out.
But what did it mean by: unlike us from the Righteous Sect, those who drift in the world outside value their face?

chapters.title: Chapter 53 - 52: Who Should be Praised as a Good Person! (Thanks to the gluttonous reader for the Overlord reward)_1
chapters.content:
Inside the small tavern, a drinker was talking loudly, attracting quite a bit of attention.
"Have you heard? Our county has produced a righteous hero named Qin Yuanhao, his deeds are even admired by the people of the Five Great Immortal Sects!" Lu Yang's eyes lit up, the corners of his mouth curling into a grin. He looked incredibly eager to share what seemed to be interesting gossip.
"Really? How come I've never heard of this man in Yanjiang County before?"
"I somewhat remember this name, doesn't seem like a good person."
"Quit the chatter, let the young man speak, what's the story with Qin Yuanhao?"
Lu Yang paused before continuing, "This Qin Yuanhao is quite skilled, with the cultivation level of the Foundation Establishment Stage. He's generous and has many friends. Those who know him prefer to call him 'big brother'."
Upon hearing that Qin Yuanhao had reached the Foundation Establishment Stage, the drinkers' eyes lit up. This was certainly news to them.
In the past, the gossip they shared about legendary martial artists and their thrilling exploits always sounded incredible and generated much excitement. However, when everyone calmed down, they realized these martial artists weren't as powerful as they seemed.
The general consensus was that top-level martial artists could only reach the eighth or ninth level of Qi Refinement, which was the limit.
Now that they've heard about someone at the Foundation Establishment Stage, they needed to pay attention. After all, it was a piece of gossip worth bragging about later on.
"So one day, Qin Yuanhao and a very close friend went to an auction. The friend took a liking to a treasure and asked Qin Yuanhao for a few thousand low-grade Spirit Stones. Qin Yuanhao, laughing heartily, said with our friendship, it's crude to talk about money. He handed over 8,000 low-grade Spirit Stones and said there was no need to pay him back. His friend was deeply touched."
"8,000 low-grade Spirit Stones?!" Meng Jingzhou, who happened to be passing by, was astonished. "Spirit Stones are the hard currency in the Cultivation World. 8,000 low-grade Spirit Stones would be enough to buy a grand mansion and a stunningly beautiful servant in the county's center!"
With Meng Jingzhou's explanation, the drunkards understood what 8,000 Spirit Stones truly represented.
This so-called Qin Yuanhao seemed incredibly generous. He just gave away 8,000 Spirit Stones!
"After the friend won the auction for the treasure, he was targeted by another cultivator from the Demon Path who also wanted the treasure. Unfortunately, the friend staunchly resisted letting go of the treasure and was killed by the Demon Path cultivator who took the treasure. Qin Yuanhao attempted to pursue, but the Demon Path cultivator had already fled."
At this point in the story, Lu Yang cleared his throat. Seeing this, the drinkers quickly offered to buy him a drink.
Lu Yang accepted a cup of grain alcohol, took a sip to clear his throat, and continued the tale.
"Before his friend died, he entrusted his wife and daughter to Qin Yuanhao. With tears in his eyes, Qin Yuanhao promised to take care of them."
"The wife and daughter were extremely beautiful. The wife graceful and charming with age-resisting abilities, and the daughter cute and lively. Despite their beauty, Qin Yuanhao remained unmoved."
"With no one to rely on, the mother and daughter thought Qin Yuanhao was a man they could depend on and tried to seduce him. However, Qin Yuanhao explained that the technique he was cultivating required him to remain a virgin."
"Qin Yuanhao kept his promise, and cared for the mother and daughter without crossing any lines. Eventually, he found a good man for them to depend on."
"Who would have thought such righteous heroes existed in this world! He is wealthy but not greedy, sees beauty but does not lust!" Meng Jingzhou's admiration drew agreement from the surrounding crowd.
"Qin Yuanhao is indeed a great man."
"It's a pity I don't know him. Otherwise, I'd definitely borrow some Spirit Stones!"
"Who said heroes can't resist the charms of a beauty? Qin Yuanhao just did, didn't he?"
In the corner, Man Gu was watching the humorous Lu Yang and the supportive Meng Jingzhou, admiring their ability to weave a story on the spot without a script.
When will he have such a talent?
The drinkers loved to show off, especially details that other people didn't know about.
They had been drinking quite a bit while listening to Lu Yang's story, forgetting some details. These were discovered when they began to brag after getting drunk.
Having already told half the story, they couldn't simply say they forgot the rest. They couldn't stand the embarrassment, so they began making up the rest based on their own imagination.
Each person forgot different parts, leading to a variety of rumors about Qin Yuanhao.
...
"Have you heard about that Qin Yuanhao, the great philanthropist?"
"Are you referring to the Qin Yuanhao who secretly discovered a Spirit Stone mine, instantly became the wealthiest cultivator in the area, and lends money without asking for repayment?"
"Probably, but I heard something different. I heard he's not interested in women, and instead prefers men."
"Yes, exactly! I heard that he is cultivating Virgin Power and likes young boys the most!"
"Is that really true? Isn't Virgin Power cultivated by consuming young chicken?"
"You all are mistaken! I heard that Qin Yuanhao accidentally came upon a legendary Immortal Artifact called the Karmic Ledger. After dripping his own blood on it, he became its rightful owner. The more good deeds he performs, the more Karmic Merit he accumulates, which he can then exchange for treasures, Immortal Artifacts, or even increase his cultivation level!"
"I also heard that he is destined to be the master of Nine Nether, controlling life, death, and Karmic Merit. Don't be fooled by his current lower power level. He's biding his time and secretly accumulating strength. Once he gets the opportunity, he will ascend like a dragon flying into the sky, becoming an immortal!"
"He endured humiliation and joined a demonic sect, with the intention of infiltrating the higher ranks, overthrowing the demonic sect and taking it as his own merit!"
"Considering the demonic sect as his own property, what a strong ambition!"
...
Regular meeting of the Yanjiang Rudder in the demonic sect.
The major demons were lined up in two rows with reverence. The Rudder Master was sitting in a chair carved out of a single piece of red agate, representing his authority. The chair featured dragon and tiger carvings, symbols of his power.
The chair was a gift from Qin Yuanhao to him.
Qin Yuanhao was in a foul mood, his color was off and the corners of his mouth twitched occasionally, revealing his beast-like teeth.
His peers didn't mind his state. Everyone was almost equal in cultivation level and status. His anger wouldn't affect them.
Such was the nature of people in the demonic sect. They didn't care about others' fortunes or tragedies as long it didn't involve them.
It's no surprise that Qin Yuanhao wasn't in a good mood. Before the meeting, he had been asked:
"Could I borrow some Spirit Stones? It doesn't matter if I can't pay you back. After all, you have a Spirit Stones mine."
"Do you know any identical twins or a mother-daughter duo? Introduce me to them."
"I'm sorry. I shouldn't have taken you to the pub to listen to tunes before. You must have really suffered as a result?"
"Big Brother Qin, I will follow you from now on. Possessing a Karmic Ledger doesn't matter. It's you that I truly admire."
"Generous and not lustful, Qin Yuanhao, you are really a disgrace to our demonic sect. You aren't an undercover agent from the righteous path, are you?"
Qin Yuanhao clenched his fist secretly. He had a mind to beat those people to a pulp and feed them to the dogs!
He, a self-proclaimed bad guy, how could he have become a good guy?!
Who was calling him a good guy?

chapters.title: Chapter 54 - 53: Demonic Sect Expansion_1
chapters.content:
In the darkness, more than a dozen pairs of eyes gleamed with a strange light, reminiscent of venomous snakes lurking in a cave. These pairs of eyes were intently focused on the Rudder Master, silently waiting for him to speak.
Finally, the languidly seated Rudder Master began speaking. His voice was hoarse, as if he hadn't spoken in decades, and each word was heavy with significance.
"Why aren't the lights on?"
A demonic sect Manager politely replied, "Rudder Master, you've forgotten. Last meeting, you mentioned about the atmosphere in the higher level meetings and said our Yanjiang Rudder lacked that typical demonic sect ambiance."
"On second thought, it's true. Our Yanjiang Rudder is, unfortunately, the most inferior among all subbranches, perhaps for this very reason."
"It's often mentioned in tales that our demonic sect prefers hatching our plots in the dark. I specifically ordered the staff not to light the lamps."
"And wouldn't you know, the lack of lights does seem to lend a certain atmosphere to mischief."
This Manager apparently had a very clear understanding of his role, fully aware that the demonic sect wasn't exactly a force for good.
The Rudder Master fell silent for a long time, wondering if the Manager was subtly hinting at leaving the sect? Or implying that the allowance for Yanjiang Rudder hadn't been increased in a long time? Or suggesting that the demonic sect should start providing insurance for its members?
He probably isn't thinking of leaving the sect.
The person in question was quite diligent in his deeds of wrongdoing and didn't discriminate between friends and foes. He caused harm outside and within the sect, he was a true villain.
It wasn't about raising the allowance either.
Allowance within the demonic sect was linked to the local finances, it was three times that of local officials and was already quite high. Yanjiang County was a remote and small county, and the allowance for Yanjiang Rudder couldn't possibly be equivalent to that of the headquarters.
And it certainly wasn't about insurance. Most members of the demonic sect had no heirs. Buying insurance would be useless, as there would be no one to claim it.
Moreover, the Land Money Trade Association wouldn't sell insurance to the demonic sect. If they did, the sect was confident that they could make the association compensate them to the point of bankruptcy.
"Let's start with the lights."
"Yes, sir."
The Manager blew gently, lighting the lamp wick. Immediately, the entire hall was illuminated.
The Rudder Master spoke again, "Most of you have probably heard the rumors about Qin Yuanhao, I suggest we stop spreading them and avoid becoming a laughing stock."
"Everyone is well aware of Yuanhao's conduct. He's a villain, guilty of all sorts of offenses. If the government catches him, the least he'd face is execution. This alone is evidence enough that his nature aligns with our sectarian principles."
"The rumours suggesting Yuanhao is on the Righteous Path are absurd. Those who join the demonic sect typically do so after being tested by the Master."
"The Master's evaluation of him was 'demon nature to the bone.' The Master's judgment cannot be wrong."
Qin Yuanhao bowed respectfully, "The Rudder Master speaks wisely."
Qin Yuanhao felt slightly reassured, resolving to deal with the source of the rumors as soon as he returned.
The Rudder Master did not address Yuanhao's issue any further, having already indulged him because of the provided chairs.
"The reason for summoning you all here today is a mission from the headquarters."
After a slight pause, the Rudder Master continued, "The headquarters demands each branch to recruit new disciples for the demonic sect."
Qin Yuanhao and the rest of them were taken aback, they hadn't expected this. The demonic sect hadn't conducted large-scale recruitment for thirty years, with the recent additions coming through personal recommendations.
For instance, Qin Yuanhao had once tried to recruit the Tiger Demon, but to his regret, the Tiger Demon steadfastly guarded the Song Mountain and refused to join the demonic sect.
"You should all be aware of the opinions of the Great Era. Geniuses have risen in the past century, and even renowned masters have been defeated by unknown youngsters. Numerous previously undiscovered Relic Blessed Caves have reappeared in the world during this era filled with both opportunities and challenges."
"The Five Great Immortal Sects, Superb Sects, First-Grade Sects all have talented recruits, and the once rare Dual Spirit Roots is now commonplace. If these young talents are allowed to fully mature, we might as well concede this Great Era."
"If we want to compete, the time is now!"
"Capturing the right opportunity, one can transform into a dragon during rain and rise to roam the nine heavens, becoming an immortal free spirit!"
"But such opportunities aren't easily obtained. The damn Great Xia Dynasty and Five Great Immortal Sects have increased their attacks on us, causing many of our kind to perish."
"To secure a place in this Great Era, we must expand the followers of our demonic sect. This is a consensus reached by the Four Great Devil Sects."
"What we need you to do is spread the news that our demonic sect is recruiting, and strive to gather the cultivators in Yanjiang County and neighboring counties who are on the Demon Path, or those interested in joining our demonic sect."
Some voiced their concern: "Won't such large-scale recruitment give the Righteous Path an opportunity to infiltrate our demonic sect?"
Not just him, many others present also had this question in mind.
The demonic sect has always been cautious. If more undercover agents from the Righteous Path appear, the sect will be in an extremely precarious situation."
The Rudder Master shook his head: "The recruitment this time is organized by our Master with his unparalleled Great Divine Skill. His trials are impossible for anyone from the Righteous Path to pass."
The skepticism subsided, replaced by endless fervor.
For the disciples of the demonic sect, the Master is a seemingly omnipotent figure, the sky of the demonic sect. He will undoubtedly lead our Eternity Sect to glory!"
...
After the meeting, Qin Yuanhao immediately leveraged his connections to find out who was trying to frame him.
Through various channels, he eventually traced the source back to a small tavern.
"That customer was about eight feet tall and eight feet wide, with a face full of freckles and a robust body, looking like he could eat three kids in one meal," the tavern owner gestured, having a strong impression of Lu Yang.
Based on the description, Qin Yuanhao quickly sketched a picture that looked nothing like the real Lu Yang.
Originally, it was after disguising themselves that Lu Yang and his companions entered the tavern to spread rumors.
Qin Yuanhao's expression was cold. How dare someone spread rumors about him, so conspicuous and still daring to spread rumors. Did they take him for an easy target?
It was already late at night. The Great Xia Dynasty had no curfews, and Qin Yuanhao was eating grilled food on the street with his lackeys: pork skewers, beef skewers, roast lamb leg, grilled chicken feet, grilled chicken legs, grilled pork skin, grilled tendons, grilled beef hooves, river prawns, tender grilled kidneys, grilled leeks, grilled potatoes, grilled eggplants, grilled tofu...
The charred skewers were tender and full of flavor, endlessly delicious. They were smeared with a secret sauce that gleamed darkly with oil. Once heated by the charcoal fire, the aroma was overwhelming.
The pork skewers were grilled over a big fire, fat but not greasy, with a strong meaty flavor.
The lamb legs were smoked and then roasted, evenly heated and perfectly crispy.
The chicken feet were first stewed then roasted and had a rich flavor and texture with skin and crispy bones.
Chicken legs were roasted raw, with precise control over the heat. The moisture and fat weren't allowed to evaporate too much, achieving a balance between the skin, meat, tendons, and bones.
Potatoes were stewed and roasted with smoky steam, served with a secret soy sauce, crispy outside, and tender inside.
Their faces were covered in grease as they ate.
After they had eaten and drunk their fill, Qin Yuanhao arrogantly commanded his lackeys: "You guys, go, search the whole city for these people. Don't return until you find them!"
"Yes, big brother!" His lackeys agreed, and they scattered in different directions.
After Qin Yuanhao finished eating, he was content and temporarily stopped thinking about the people who spread the annoying rumors. At the same time, he was oblivious to Lu Yang who was lurking beneath him.
Very few people pay attention to what's under their feet, and Qin Yuanhao was no exception.

chapters.title: Chapter 55 - 54 Naming the Shop_1
chapters.content:
After finding out the target location, Lu Yang and the other two convened and analyzed:
"Judging from Qin Yuanhao's walking posture and breathing rate, he should be at the late stage of Foundation Establishment Cultivation Level."
"The place he lives is just a regular residence, it's not big, and doesn't look like he has any servants. He appears to be living alone."
"We should stay nearby to observe him for a while. Firstly, to study his habits so as we won't appear completely ignorant if questioned after infiltrating the demonic sect. Secondly, to follow him to see if we can find the Yanjiang Rudder's location."
Man Gu from the Barbarian tribe was confused: "Qin Yuanhao has so many followers, why don't we follow them to find the location of Yanjiang Rudder?"
Meng Jingzhou dismissed the idea, he knew more about the demonic sect than the others: "Those people don't have any cultivation levels. They are undoubtedly Qin Yuanhao's followers, but not members of the demonic sect. The sect is not as easy to join as you think, it is debatable whether those people even know that Qin Yuanhao is a member."
"But where can we hide to observe him? There are no inns nearby, just a few tea house and taverns. We can have tea in the tea house during the day, but what about the night?"
The demonic sect prefer to move at night.
Lu Yang was also at a loss, but then his eyes lit up when he saw a tea-tavern for rent in his peripheral view.
"The location of this tea-tavern is ideal. We can observe Qin Yuanhao from the second floor. We can rent this place and observe his movements under the pretense of running a business!"
Meng Jingzhou nodded, then asked: "What kind of business should we start?"
"Although the business is a facade, it must be convincing. I'm not good at brewing tea, so we definitely won't continue running a tea house. I have an elder in my family who is proficient in verbal talents, and I have learnt how to entertain by speaking, learning, and singing during the time I spent with him."
Showing a professional attitude, Meng Jingzhou suggested: "I propose to open a comedy club, where I can perform stand-up comedy."
Lu Yang admired the versatile Meng Jingzhou: "However, stand-up comedy would only be lively during the day and there won't be many people at night. The best approach would be to choose a business that operates at night, such as an entertainment venue, where people can drink, make merry and have lots of fun. This way, we can observe Qin Yuanhao from the second floor without him noticing us."
Meng Jingzhou's face blushed at this point, he was somewhat hesitant but more excited: "A business that opens at night, you mean to open a..."
Lu Yang nodded: "Yes, I'm talking about opening a barbecue shop."
Meng Jingzhou: "... yes, that's exactly what I was thinking."
Lu Yang had thought it through, barbecuing is simple and easy to learn, even if they mess up a few times in the beginning, they should be able to get the hang of it.
"Leave the barbecue to me." Man Gu was fully confident, and even took out a piece of paper labeled "ancestral barbecue secret recipe" from his pocket to prove his abilities.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were very familiar with this secret recipe. It was the ancestral barbecue secret recipe that needed to be exchanged for a hundred contribution points!
Man Gu laughed heartily: "I used to often roast wild animals for myself when I was home, like black bear, wild boar, rabbit and so on. I noticed that there were lots of food options in the Seek Dao Sect, but hardly any barbecue shops, so I put out the ancestral barbecue secret recipe."
At that time, Lu Yang was puzzled about who would hang a barbecue secret recipe on the exchange board. Now he realized it was Man Gu who had put it up!
"Did anyone buy it?" Meng Jingzhou was curious.
Man Gu said honestly: "One of the Senior Brothers told me that after buying the barbecue secret recipe, he used it to win the heart of a Senior Sister during an outdoor mission."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
I shouldn't have asked.
Man Gu gave a slight smile, saying, "And there's another good thing about opening a barbecue shop."
"What is it?"
Man Gu summoned two ghouls, "I don't have to do it myself. I can just let these two ghouls do the barbecuing in the kitchen. Plus, I won't have to pay them, making it very convenient."
And like this, they even saved the money on hiring an errand boy. It was a plan that maintained their secret and also saved money.
Man Gu had been following Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou for so long, so he had picked up some things along the way.
Lu Yang firmly denied that Man Gu had learnt from him.
Man Gu spent the entire night researching the secret recipe. His home being the wild, the original barbecue recipe required many ingredients unique to the untamed wilderness. Man Gu needed to research which ingredients could be substituted.
"By the way, do you guys eat roasted worms, or roasted cow eyes?" Man Gu suddenly asked.
Both Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou shook their heads unanimously, advising Man Gu to roast something more within the realms of general peoples' tastes.
Man Gu grunted in agreement, thought for a moment, and came to the conclusion that firstly, he was a normal person, and secondly, since he could accept these dishes, so could other normal people.
Case closed.
Man Gu decided to keep dishes like roasted worms and roasted cow's eyes on the menu, among other local specialties, hoping that the people of Yanjiang County would like them.
Early the next morning, Meng Jingzhou surprised everyone with his financial power and bought the entire tea house.
"Wait, wasn't we supposed to rent it?" Meng Jingzhou moved so fast that Lu Yang hadn't even had time to react before the tea-tavern belonged to them.
Lu Yang was astounded, he looked at Meng Jingzhou incredulously. Their task was just for a few months, was he planning on running it forever?
Meng Jingzhou defended himself: "I never use things that are not mine. I always buy if I have the option to, rather than rent! If anything, I'll just sell it when the mission is over."
Seeing how prompt Meng Jingzhou was with his payments, the previous owner swiftly packed up and left.
After the previous owner left, a very serious matter laid before the three of them — what to name their barbecue shop.
"I suggest calling it Meng Xiaoer's Barbecue Shop." Meng Jingzhou proposed.
Lu Yang snorted at Meng Jingzhou, expressing his disdain: "Your name is too common. I suggest we call it Strong Wine Barbecue Shop. Eat, drink, then go fight a tiger on the mountain, very fitting."
Both Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu shook their heads in unison, not finding it fitting at all.
Man Gu, unusually, proposed a different name: "The name Strong Wine Barbecue Shop is too long, we should adopt our tribe's style and call it Hahaha Barbecue Shop, or Heeheehee Barbecue Shop."
Lu Yang had heard of the naming style of the wild barbarian tribe, and thought this way of naming was quite advanced even in the progressive Seek Dao Sect: Hehehe Weapon Shop, Hohoho Tavern, Aahhahah Brothel...
"How about calling it Transcendance Tribulation Stage Barbecue Shop?"
"We could call it Ascension Barbecue Shop."
"I think Light Boat Barbecue Shop would work."
"Who would give such a lofty name to a barbecue shop?"
They couldn't agree on a name after much debate, and finally had to admit one thing - none of them knew how to name a shop.
"Forget it, let's each write a name on a piece of paper, put them all into a bowl, and pick one randomly. That's the name we'll go with." Lu Yang proposed this solution and got approval from both of his partners.
Considering that Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou might play tricks, they decided to let Man Gu be the one to draw the papers.
Man Gu shuffled the slips of paper in his cupped hands, and released two of them by opening his thumb.
He opened one paper and it read "Try again".
Man Gu, quite confused, opened the other slip of paper, it read "Thanks for visiting".
Man Gu: "???"
Man Gu was unable to comprehend the situation. He was supposed to be naming the shop, not running a lottery... right?

chapters.title: Chapter 56 - 55 Flourishing Business_1
chapters.content:
He glanced at Lu Yang, then at Meng Jingzhou, and slowly asked: "Did you guys come up with those names?"
Lu Yang nodded: "I came up with 'Second Round BBQ Shop'."
Meng Jingzhou also nodded: "I came up with 'Thank You for Your Patronage BBQ Shop'."
Man Gu thought the name Sheep Sheep Sheep BBQ Shop he came up with was rather ordinary.
Man Gu was the first one to open up a shop named after Lu Yang, according to the rules, the barbecue shop is now called "Second Round."
"By the way, do any of you know how to conceal your energy?" Lu Yang asked.
While on the streets, Lu Yang noticed the breathing patterns of many people, their different affinities towards spiritual energy suggested they were cultivators, but he couldn't determine their cultivation level when he scanned them with his spiritual sense.
One or two people having higher cultivation levels than himself was reasonable, but everyone having a higher cultivation level was clearly impossible.
Yanjiang County is different from Taiping Village. There are many cultivators, but not so many that everyone has reached the Foundation Establishment Stage.
After a bit of thought, Lu Yang understood that the level of a cultivator's cultivation determines their status. To wander the martial world without being bullied, you either need to have exceptional cultivation or be able to hide your cultivation level, so as not to make others act rashly.
For them to go out without concealing anything was like telling everyone that they were novices.
If they wanted to infiltrate a demonic sect, they had to pose as experienced martial artists.
"I have one, it's something we used when hunting back home." Man Gu pulled out a rolled-up sheepskin scroll from his bosom.
"The animals in the wilderness are very cunning, they run away at the slightest rustle of leaves. To be successful in hunting, you must hide your presence and lay in ambush in advance."
The barbarian tribe that Man Gu belonged to was a large tribe in the wilderness, and Man Gu had the highest bloodline status in the tribe.
Not only the Qi Refinement and Foundation Establishment Stages tribesmen of the barbarian tribe go hunting, even those in the Golden Core Stage who could fast went out hunting.
For the barbarian tribe, the game was not just for satisfying their appetite, but also provided them with heaven and earth treasures.
"However, you can't move while using my scroll. If you move, the effect will be ruined."
The bigger the restriction, the greater the effect. When it comes to the ability to hide, the concealment effect recorded on the sheepskin scroll can rank in the top three.
"I have a common concealment spell here. Only those who are one rank higher than you can see your cultivation level." Meng Jingzhou took out a bamboo scroll from an amulet around his neck. Despite its age, it still gave off a faint bamboo fragrance.
The quality of the bamboo could tell how extraordinary the magic spell recorded on the bamboo scroll was.
There were many magic skills and divine abilities stored in Meng Jingzhou's amulet, which he brought from home. There were so many that he hadn't had time to learn them all.
Lu Yang looked at Meng Jingzhou strangely: "Weren't you a runaway? How did you get all these good things?"
"My sister sneaked them to me."
"Alright."
The trio began to study the concealment spells. They were all gifted individuals, and to them, this little spell was easy to master. They pretty much had it down in a little over half an hour, with practice being the only thing left to do afterwards.
With hands clasped in a martial salute, Lu Yang was deeply grateful: "Once I learn new spells, I will certainly teach you guys!"
Despite the casual manner in which Man Gu and Meng Jingzhou brought it up, even if they didn't mention it, Lu Yang knew that these two concealment spells were incredibly rare. The trust the two of them had towards him was clearly seen.
Meng Jingzhou let out a hearty laugh and told Lu Yang not to worry about it. Man Gu also said something similar.
...
"Huh, didn't this used to be a tea house? Now it's changed into a barbecue shop?" Under the evening sky, two travelling martial artists discovered that the original tea house was gone, replaced by a BBQ shop with an interesting name.
"Second Round BBQ Shop, such a savory smell."
Travelling martial artist A sniffed, the fragrance of the barbecue hit his nostrils, it was irresistible, it made drool run from his mouth.
"Should we eat here?"
"Let's go, let's go in."
Agreeing in an instant, the two men entered the barbecue shop.
As soon as they entered the shop, they were blown away by the bustling atmosphere. Guests were enthusiastically eating, drinking merrily, and having a good time. The noise was loud enough to rock the roof. A muscular man was running in and out with skewers in hand, presumably a waiter of the restaurant.
Such a robust waiter, is he there to prevent customers from dining and dashing?
"How did a new shop become so popular?"
The two men were a bit excited, a shop so popular must have a reason for it, they must try it out.
The two men were lucky, there was only one vacant table left.
They settled down at the table, and another waiter named Lu Yang took out a small notebook, his face wearing the standard smile of someone in the service industry: "Hello, what can I get for you today?"
"Two jugs of wine, a plate of boiled peanuts, thirty mutton skewers, thirty beef skewers, two portions of roasted potatoes... all medium spicy, we can't eat too spicy food."
As Lu Yang was jotting this down, he transmitted a message to Man Gu: "Could you maybe adjust your recipe? The barbecue is too delicious, it attracts so many people, how are we supposed to keep an eye on Qin Yuanhao?"
Lu Yang had not expected that Man Gu's secret recipe would be so effective. On the first night there were several customers, on the second day there were several tables, on the third day the tables were filled up, and now it was the fourth day. After the two martial artists took the last table, people were queuing outside.
Lu Yang was worried that by the fifth day, there would be people trying to reserve tables or share tables with others. By the thirtieth day, they could open a chain store in the neighboring county. One year later, they could open two hundred chain stores in the northern part of the Central Continent. Three years later, they would become popular all over the Central Continent.
Five years later, they would be listed on the stock market... if there was such a concept here.
Was there a problem with Man Gu's recipe? He didn't add any banned substances to the sauce, did he?
That was a joke. Both Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had tasted the food Man Gu grilled, it didn't contain any banned substances, it was indeed delicious. However, they hadn't expected it to attract so many people.
Later, Lu Yang realized that he had become accustomed to fine food at Sky Gate Mountain, so his taste buds were sophisticated. If Man Gu's barbecue recipe was capable making him, who was used to fine dining, say that it was delicious, it truly had something unique.
In short, they absolutely could not let the shop become any more popular.
"It seems quite busy downstairs, do you need my help?" Meng Jingzhou's lazy voice rang in their ears.
Right now, Meng Jingzhou was the only one on the second floor keeping an eye on Qin Yuanhao.
