"You just stay on the second floor and watch Qin Yuanhao, don't come down and make trouble!" Lu Yang warned, there was more to Meng Jingzhou coming downstairs than just being a waiter.
Based on his understanding of Meng Jingzhou, the man could crack jokes even while serving food, delivering a stand-up comedy show in the process.
Meng Jingzhou yawned widely, making one feel drowsy: "But it's really boring up there on the second floor. Qin Yuanhao has absolutely no intention of leaving his house these last four days. All he does is meditate, with absolutely no entertainment or life."
"I think it would be better if we disguised ourselves as wandering performers. I can perform a stand-up comedy at Qin Yuanhao's house, you can perform a jar-lifting act, while Man Gu can take advantage of the distraction to install an Eavesdropping Talisman or something."
Neither Lu Yang nor Man Gu paid any attention to Meng Jingzhou.
The best way to deal with incessant talkers was to ignore them.
Seeing that no one was paying him any attention, Meng Jingzhou had to change the subject: "Man Gu, are you sure you don't want to make the skewers taste worse?"
Man Gu had his own conviction: "Our family has been a barbecue family for eighteen generations, all of whom knew how to barbecue. I can't tarnish the reputation of the barbecue barbarian tribe!"

chapters.title: Chapter 57 - 56: As a Younger Brother, One Must Strictly Execute the Big Brother's Orders_1
chapters.content:
That's a fact, barbecue is the primary cooking method of the Barbarian tribe.
A blazing fire lit in Man Gu's pupils, his fighting spirit rose high.
Lu Yang:"..."
Why is he igniting his fighting spirit here? We've come to infiltrate the demonic sect, not to open a branch for his restaurant!
Lu Yang sighed. If Man Gu didn't want to compromise on quality, they could only raise the price.
"Honored guests, what kind of liquor would you like?"
The two martial heroes were bold and declared: "The stronger the better! I'm known in the martial world as the man who can't get drunk after a thousand cups!"
The other also shouted: "I, in the martial world, am known as the man who never falls even after ten thousand cups!"
Lu Yang thought to himself: Stop boasting, you two. Could you withstand two jars of pure alcohol?
In the end, Lu Yang served them two jars of Baijiu, hoping their alcohol tolerance was as good as their boast.
Lu Yang was at the door greeting customers, yelling: "Please take a number and line up, no cutting in line. We have prepared free tea and snacks. Please be patient. A table will be available soon!"
"Also, there are no discounts for introducing new customers to our restaurant, so don't bring anymore!"
Lu Yang didn't know whether that would work, but he shouted a few times anyway. He couldn't really start a restaurant chain.
Customers queuing were restless, and problems kept popping up.
"Can we make a reservation in advance?"
"Can you deliver?"
"Can we book the whole place?"
Among the queueing customers, apart from martial heroes, there were also rich cultivators.
"Reservations are acceptable, we can deliver if it's not far, but we'll charge an extra service fee. Booking the whole place is also fine."
Lu Yang really hoped someone would book the whole place; that would make things easier.
"Attention, Qin Yuanhao has left his house." Lu Yang and Man Gu received the notification from Meng Jingzhou at the same time. Lu Yang felt a sense of relief.
"I'll follow him, you come down and replace me. Man Gu, keep an eye on him, don't make a mess!" Thanks to his magic skills, Lu Yang excelled in combat and tracking.
Lu Yang couldn't just shrink into the ground in plain sight, so he went to the backyard where there were only two ghouls.
The two ghouls were busy barbecuing, sweating profusely, their movements swift, so fast that ghostly shadows appeared, as if they wished they had eight hands to work with.
They must've never experienced such fulfilling and bustling lives when they were alive.
By the way, the two ghouls were wearing the clothes they had worn as merchants when they were alive. To avoid a drunk customer barging into the backyard and discovering the ghouls wearing clothes that didn't fit their roles, the trio spent a long time discussing how to change the clothes of the ghouls.
From Taoist rituals, monks' chanting, reading through scriptures, to investigating legends, they were all exhausted in the end.
Fortunately, Lu Yang discovered the simplest method — burning the clothes for the ghouls.
The two ghouls were so busy they didn't notice Lu Yang's arrival. He easily shrank into the ground and stealthily tracked Qin Yuanhao.
Meng Jingzhou quickly changed outfits, replaced Lu Yang and, while preparing mutton kebabs, said: "The mutton kebabs are ready, enjoy your meal, sir."
"About these mutton kebabs, their origin is quite special. Let me tell you about it. Once upon a time, there was a golden light in the northern plains and a baby was born..."
...
Qin Yuanhao walked in the shadows, camouflaging as if he had merged with the night. Even the passerby didn't notice his presence.
"A skill related to shadows or darkness?" Lu Yang observed secretly, trying to gather as much information as possible.
To create his own skills, he had read extensively and knew about all kinds of skills.
Lu Yang continued trailing Qin Yuanhao.
Qin Yuanhao stepped on the muddy path and arrived in a winding alley, emitting a sour smell that even Lu Yang, who was underground, could smell.
Hearing the increasingly fast footsteps of Qin Yuanhao, Lu Yang knew his mood wasn't very good.
Qin Yuanhao frowned, disliking the place; he face was sullen as he kicked open a door, startling the little brother sleeping inside.
"You are still in the mood to sleep!"
The young man scrambled to his feet, trembling, not knowing why their big brother was angry.
They worked diligently and never dared to slack off. They worked all day, and even sleeping at night was a mistake?
On the contrary, their big brother mostly slept during the day and didn't get up until night. Their schedules were far more regular than his.
Qin Yuanhao kicked the little brother against the wall and growled: "Why is no one reporting to me these days? Where is the person you are supposed to find?"
The young man felt a heavy hammer hit his chest, he said pitifully: "Big Brother, you said if we can't find the person, don't come to see you."
"We can't find the person you said to find, we don't dare to see you. How could it be wrong to listen to your words?"
The young man defended himself. Whatever his brother said, he did exactly that. Even when doing so made his brother dissatisfied, it was really hard to serve.
Qin Yuanhao: "..."
He actually felt that the young man made a lot of sense, but he just wanted to hit someone. What to do?
"If you don't see me, can't you write a letter!"
"But you also said important things must be reported in person."
"Didn't I also say that special circumstances require special treatment!" Qin Yuanhao yelled.
"You did say that special circumstances require special treatment, but you also said what constitutes a special situation requires our internal discussion, and finally you decide."
"Did you guys discuss it?"
"We discussed it two days ago and unanimously agreed that this is a special situation that requires your decision."
"Then why didn't I see you guys asking me to decide!"
"You said that important things must be reported in person, we can't find the person who is spreading rumors, we can't see you."
Qin Yuanhao: "..."
Am I going to get stuck here today?
Qin Yuanhao took a few deep breaths, repeatedly telling himself not to kill. These little brothers, although inflexible, were loyal to him and strictly followed his orders without any deviation.
Killing the little brother would chill the hearts of the ones below.
Moreover, he didn't have many trusted subordinates in the first place, and if he killed any more, there would be none left.
"So, how's the search for this person going? If you can't find the person, there should at least be some clues?" Qin Yuanhao stared at the little brother; if he dared to say they didn't find any leads, he wouldn't let him live to see another day.
Thinking I wouldn't dare to kill!
The young man mumbled that there wasn't any clues, but seeing the murderous look in big brother's eyes, he quickly added: "Big brother, as you know, the person you're looking for is very distinctive and would attract attention as soon as he shows up on the street. Four days have passed, our brothers' feet are blistering from running around and still we found nothing."
"Nothing else to say, just for the condition of being eight feet wide and eight feet long, we inquired and found only one person matching that description, but he doesn't have any moles on his face, doesn't eat children, and his appearance is quite pleasant."
"Who is it?" Qin Yuanhao thought to himself, don't worry if appearances aren't the same for now, just kill one who has a similar body type first, to scare the monkey using the chicken, so that the people behind the scenes won't look down on him.
"It's the mascot from the tofu shop on Front Street."
"I'll slaughter you!"

chapters.title: Chapter 58 - 57 Harvest_1
chapters.content:
The Land Money Trade Association's business philosophy was quite advanced, and in order to expand its fame, they came up with the concept of a "brand mascot". They enlisted the designer Xuan Daozi, and after three rounds of drafts, they finally settled on the initial design as the mascot.
The initial draft was a chubby little pig holding a coin in its hand, with an exceedingly delightful appearance.
After the Land Money Trade Association adopted the brand mascot, their fame truly expanded and the results were remarkable. Many other businesses followed suit and created their own mascots after hearing about this.
The tofu shop on Front Street in Yanjiang County was one of them.
Qin Yuanhao didn't kill his little brother. After calming down, he thought about it and concluded that his brother was a reliable worker who never made mistakes. If he couldn't find someone, then that person truly couldn't be found.
They couldn't possibly suspect that the tofu store's mascot had come out to stir up trouble.
"If such a distinctive figure can't be found, it must be my fellow members of the demonic sect trying to frame me!" Qin Yuanhao coldly laughed. He didn't need to guess that this was deliberate, but he didn't know who was behind it.
This kind of thing was not uncommon in the demonic sect; Qin Yuanhao himself had done things to harm his companions in the past.
After such a long time, all clues had been lost. Qin Yuanhao could only swallow this bitter pill for now, and slowly figure out who to settle the score with later.
"Since we can't find him, let's stop searching."
Qin Yuanhao took out a stack of papers and several pieces of silver from his pocket and threw them to his little brother.
This was also one of the reasons why he didn't kill his little brother. The Rudder Master's tasks always needed someone to execute them. If he killed someone, where would he find a replacement?
"First thing tomorrow morning, gather your brothers and spread these papers in the black market of the nearby eight counties. This silver is your monthly allowance and travel expenses. Understand?"
"I, I understand." The little brother was startled by Qin Yuanhao's final bellow.
"Louder."
"I understand!" The little brother straightened his back and yelled again, his neck reddening.
The woman next door angrily said, loud enough for everyone to hear through the wall, "Do you know what time it is, why are you shouting?"
The voice of the woman next door was even louder than the little brother's.
A hint of murderous intent flashed in the corner of Qin Yuanhao's eye.
"Big Brother, the neighbour is a Cultivator at the Foundation Establishment Stage, who came here to live in seclusion." The little brother quickly chimed in. Many Cultivators liked to play around in the mortal world, and it's possible that even the street-side skewer seller could be a Cultivator.
Qin Yuanhao grunted coldly and left without saying much.
The little brother yawned, thinking that the Big Brother had finally left, and he quickly fell asleep.
He had to get up early for work tomorrow.
The little brother often received odd tasks assigned by Qin Yuanhao. For the sake of keeping secrets, Qin Yuanhao didn't tell them anything, merely telling them to follow orders.
This time was no different.
After the little brother fell soundly asleep, Lu Yang crawled out from the soil, took three pieces of paper, and followed Qin Yuanhao.
Qin Yuanhao had come out just to find his little brother. After giving him instructions, he returned.
When Qin Yuanhao passed by the "Try Again" barbecue shop, he paused for a moment.
"I only secluded myself for four days, and a new barbecue shop is opened? And it's so popular?"
Qin Yuanhao considered having a meal there. It didn't matter to him if there were many people. After all, it was already kind of him not to demand they kneel and welcome him when he, a cultivator at the Foundation Establishment Stage, came to dine at such a small place. And yet, they expected him to queue?
In the end, Qin Yuanhao dismissed this idea. Barbecue was a dish better enjoyed in groups, eating it alone was less fun.
"Maybe another time."
Qin Yuanhao returned home.
Lu Yang went back to the barbecue shop to help. Upon his return, he saw Meng Jingzhou performing a stand-up comedy routine. The customers were all applauding and asking for more.
Lu Yang took a deep breath, you two are really determined to grow this barbecue shop.
Meng Jingzhou, feeling the intensity of Lu Yang's gaze, quickly closed his mouth, and honestly began acting as a server again, ignoring the customers' calls for more.
After a busy period, the customers gradually left and the barbecue shop finally became quiet.
Two ghouls were busy cleaning the grills and cutlery, counting the day's food consumption, and estimating the amount of food needed for tomorrow. The three of them sat on the second floor, discussing the day's earnings.
"How much did we earn today?" Meng Jingzhou rubbed his hands excitedly. Starting a business from scratch gave him a strong sense of accomplishment.
"Who told you this is about earnings!" Lu Yang slammed the table and glared, "Have you forgotten what we came here to do?"
"Open a franchise?" Man Gu was still considering growing the family business.
Lu Yang ignored these two clowns and took out three pieces of paper, recounting the situation of his surveillance that night.
"A blank paper?"
Meng Jingzhou examined the paper back and forth, finding nothing noteworthy.
Lu Yang also didn't know how to use this paper: "Qin Yuanhao wants people to spread these papers in the black market, there must be information on the paper, but I don't know how to read it."
"Is it a unique communication method among the Demon Path?"
Meng Jingzhou nodded, agreeing with Lu Yang's guess: "That's likely. These covert guys always like to come up with some secret codes."
"This is a paper meant for all cultivators of the Demon Path, and all of them should be able to understand it. If we, at the Foundation Establishment Stage, can't see the writing on the paper, the Qi Refinement Stage Demon Path cultivators definitely won't be able to."
"So the problem is not with the secret code, but with the paper."
Lu Yang thought for a moment, then toasted the paper over the charcoal fire.
"What are you doing?" Man Gu asked, puzzled.
While meticulously toasting the paper, Lu Yang casually said, "I read in a book that if you write on paper with sugar water and let it dry, there will be no visible text. You need high temperature to evaporate the water from the sugar, revealing text that's a light-brown color."
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu found this point of knowledge quite interesting.
After about five minutes of toasting, nothing appeared on the paper, so Lu Yang had to abandon this method.
Lu Yang then summoned a small ball of water in his palm, and burst it suddenly. The water droplets splashed onto the paper.
"What is this for?"
Lu Yang explained: "Substances like shower gel and detergent have a high water absorption. If you use these special liquids to write, nothing will be visible after the paper dries. But if you sprinkle water on the paper, you can see the text by exploiting the different rates of water absorption."
Though the Central Continent seemed ancient, it was far from being so. The existence of magic skills had produced many objects not of the ancient world, either intentionally or coincidentally.
For example, the shower gel and detergent mentioned by Lu Yang.
Unfortunately, the paper still revealed nothing.
Lu Yang did not get disheartened. He pondered for a moment before coming up with a new method.
"Since this is a communication method among the Demon Path, perhaps the clue can be revealed through a method commonly used by the Demon Path?"
Lu Yang bit his thumb and a few drops of blood fell onto the paper. Like they had a life of their own, the drops began moving around the paper.
"Indeed, this follows the method used by the Demon Path to consecrate paper. It cannot be judged by common logic." Lu Yang breathed a sigh of relief, pleased that he was finally successful.
It seemed like there were invisible grooves on the paper. When the blood passed over these grooves, it filled them, forming words.
"On the first of April, the Yanjiang Rudder of the Eternity Sect is recruiting members. The specific location will be announced the day before the recruitment."

chapters.title: Chapter 59 - 58: That's Not How You Do Imitation Fist_1
chapters.content:
(Change the previous line's timeframe from one hour to one day)
The Eternity Sect, one of the Four Great Devil Sects.
"The Eternity Sect, if I remember correctly, they believe in the Immortal Eternity who is rumored to live forever, never dying. By being a faithful follower of the Eternity Sect, one can avoid the Three Disasters and Five Tribulations that come with Cultivation, extending one's life," Meng Jingzhou recalled the information about the Eternity Sect.
These are basic facts that one could find out with a little diligence, though how much of it is actually true, that I cannot guarantee.
"The Eternity Sect is recruiting, which is an excellent opportunity for us. The crowd will be diverse, the threshold will be a lot lower, and the identity checks should be more lenient," Lu Yang perked up as he heard the news. This was good news indeed.
He had been worrying because none of them had practiced orthodox demonic cultivation methods, wondering if they would manage to infiltrate the sect under the guise of driving away the ghost servants. Then Qin Yuanhao brings such good news; what a lucky star he was!
"So, do we still kill Qin Yuanhao?" Man Gu asked, seeming to think there wasn't a need for murder anymore.
"He is a menace anyway. If we can kill him, we should. But we won't be using his ID card," Lu Yang answered. Whether or not they could infiltrate the demonic sect, Qin Yuanhao was still doomed.
To reach the late stage of Foundation Establishment in demonic sects, one must have taken several lives. It's impossible otherwise.
Don't take Qin Yuanhao sparing his little brother for mercy, it was just because he still had some use for him.
If his little brother were to lose an arm or a leg, becoming physically impaired, he would in turn be useless to Qin Yuanhao and would no doubt be killed.
"Why can't we use his ID card?"
Lu Yang called two ghouls to grill some skewers and explained while eating, "The relationships among members of the demonic sects aren't as good as we imagined. If we frame Qin Yuanhao, and he investigates, he'd conclude that someone in the sect has a grudge against him."
"If we use Qin Yuanhao's ID card to enter the sect, we'll be metaphorically stamped with his mark. This could lead to us facing difficulties every step of the way and thus put us at a disadvantage."
Understanding dawned on Man Gu.
"However, the demonic sect is indeed cautious. To prevent their base location from being exposed, they only make it public on the last day. I suppose they are afraid of us from the Righteous Path discovering their location and wiping them out?" Lu Yang chuckled.
"Continue to tail Qin Yuanhao. See if we can locate Yanjiang Rudder base through him, so we can make preparations."
"It's getting late. Those who need to cultivate should cultivate, those who need to rest should rest. You're dismissed."
...
The next morning, Lu Yang let out a yawn, got dressed, and joined everyone for breakfast. Man Gu had made beef offal soup.
At this time, Man Gu had returned from the market with a cart full of whole pigs, cows, and sheep.
The beef soup was cooked with marrow bones. A pinch of salt serving as a base, along with other condiments. After the beef offal simmered for a while, a steaming bowl of beef offal soup was ready.
"Put more tripe!" Lu Yang called out.
"Okay!"
After a delicious breakfast, everyone went about their own business.
Today was Man Gu's turn to keep watch. He headed upstairs immediately after breakfast with plans to sit there all day.
Meng Jingzhou was the restless type. Like a frisky rabbit, he had run off somewhere to cause some mischief.
The two ghouls were left in the house to pluck the sheep, cut vegetables, thread skewers. After four days, they had become experts at these tasks. They would start threading skewers in the morning until the evening. Just in time for the opening, they would go to the backyard, light the charcoal in the stove, and roast skewers all night long.
Working from dawn till dusk, their lives were incredibly fulfilling.
Lu Yang also had tasks of his own. He took out "Pictographic Fist," hoping to at least reach the beginner's level. He'd never practiced any martial arts before and was a little uncertain if he would succeed.
"There's always a first time."
Lu Yang set up a simple sound-isolating formation in the backyard. This way he couldn't hear the outside world, and likewise, his voice couldn't be heard outside.
He sat cross-legged and carefully browsed the book: "Pictographic Fist is a martial art that imitates different animal templates and expressions, as well as mimics human combat and lifestyle. It contains the Tiger Fist, Monkey Fist, Eagle Claw Fist, and Snake Fist, but this book only includes the Tiger Fist."
"The Tiger Fist emphasizes imitating the tiger's appearance and techniques, infusing them with reasoning and blending it with the meaning of the fist."
"The Tiger Fist routine is short, concise, and compact. It mainly consists of small footwork and step techniques, primarily the Three-Seven Steps."
"To master Tiger Fist, it is best to have the experience of observing and fighting a tiger. This allows for a deeper understanding of the tiger's fighting figure, enhancing the imitation."
The most challenging step of the Tiger Fist for Lu Yang seemed simple enough, given his past experience of battling and defeating a Tiger Demon.
Slowly, Lu Yang closed his eyes.
Roaring, pouncing, ripping... The Tiger Demon's actions during the attack emerged in his mind as though it just occurred.
Although Lu Yang had killed the Tiger Demon, he had to admit that the beast was a formidable enemy with traits worth studying.
Of course, he did not need to learn to call out for his wife to help since he wouldn't be able to do it yet.
The figures of a tiger and Lu Yang gradually overlapped in his mind, blending into one. The human figure had acquired the tiger's skills.
Lu Yang visualized the actions of the Tiger Fist in his mind repeatedly. Initially awkward movements became more and more agile, almost as if he had been possessed by a tiger, roaring in his mind.
This was a feat only those at the Foundation Establishment Stage could accomplish. It required an extremely high Spiritual Sense, something mortal warriors could not achieve.
Lu Yang opened his eyes, a fierce light flashing in them. It was almost as if there was a tiger hidden within.
He leaped up from his seated position, landing steadily on the ground. He took a stance, exhaled loudly, bellowed intensely, and attacked ferociously.
The two ghouls threading skewers inside the house jumped when they heard Lu Yang's vigorous punches; they thought the Tiger Demon had come back to life.
They tiptoed to the door and peeked outside at Lu Yang. Feeling relief when they realized it wasn't the Tiger Demon, they returned to their tasks.
Lu Yang finished his set of punches and kicks feeling energetic all over, as if he had boundless strength to release.
Taking advantage of the sensation, he performed several more sets. Each set flowed more smoothly than the last, and every movement was powerful.
Regardless of how much of it he used in a real fight, for now, even a master of Tiger Fist wouldn't find flaws in his movements.
"No, I can still improve."
Lu Yang began to move faster, his mind was as calm as a ripple-less lake, reflecting everything clearly, like a brass mirror.
This peculiar state of mind revealed an understanding of the martial art itself in every movement.
Punching, kicking... As his understanding deepened, an image of the Tiger Demon faintly appeared behind Lu Yang.
"Roar—"
With Lu Yang's understanding reaching its peak, all his enlightenment converged in this earth-shattering tiger's roar.
"Huh? Why am I lying on the ground?" Lu Yang came to his senses, puzzlingly finding himself lying on the ground. He tried to stand up but found his legs were weak. After several wobbly attempts, he was still unable to stand up.
"What's going on?" Lu Yang was baffled. Could something have gone wrong while practicing the punches?
Feeling uncertain, Lu Yang questioned his martial talent. He had felt he was doing just fine, so where did the problem lie?
Lu Yang felt a bad premonition, he used both hands and feet to crawl toward the water trough.
Upon seeing his reflection, Lu Yang finally understood his condition.
He had transformed into a tiger.
The Tiger Fist was mastered. Congratulations were in order.
"Lu Yang, guess what I saw in the streets today. A tofu shop has an interesting mascot."
Meng Jingzhou returned from his leisurely stroll, heard that Lu Yang was in the backyard practicing martial arts, and wanted to see his progress.
Then he saw a tiger demon looking into a water trough like a mirror.
"Damn it, a monster!"

chapters.title: Chapter 60 - 59 Lu's Imitation Fist_1
chapters.content:
"Damn it, a monster!" Meng Jingzhou exclaimed, swinging his arm as if to strike.
His reaction was not surprising. The backyard was supposed to be Lu Yang's practice ground, but now Lu Yang had vanished and a tiger had appeared, which easily gave rise to the idea that a Tiger Demon had resurrected and eaten Lu Yang.
The Tiger Demon spoke human words, in the same voice as Lu Yang's: "Demon your grandpa, it's me!"
"It even has Lu Yang's voice!" Meng Jingzhou was shocked.
The man-tiger duel took place in the mid-air. The tiger's voice startled Meng Jingzhou so much that he didn't react, allowing Lu Yang to claw him down to the ground.
Lu Yang snorted contemptuously. There was no trace of a fight in the courtyard. How could it be possible that the Tiger Demon ate him? Meng Jingzhou, this grandchild, obviously knew it was him but played dumb.
Meng Jingzhou clicked his tongue. Lu Yang didn't really hit him just now, and it was only a minor pain for his thick-skinned self.
He got up and dusted off the dirt on his clothes, looking dubiously at Lu Yang. "What's going on with you? Weren't you trying to comprehend the Imitation Fist? Why did you start learning the Transformation Technique?"
"Wait a moment, let me figure out how to transform back." The Tiger Demon Lu Yang wanted to scratch the back of his head in frustration, but then he realized that his forepaws couldn't reach. Sitting down and using his hind paws to scratch...forget it, he thought better of it. That would ruin his image.
Tiger Demon Lu Yang gritted his teeth, never expecting his martial arts practice to create such a complicated situation.
Now he thought about it, only his swordsmanship was relatively normal.
Should he say he was worthy of being a Sword Spirit Root?
Meng Jingzhou sprinted upstairs to call down Man Gu.
"What is it? I'm keeping an eye on Qin Yuanhao."
"I have something interesting to show you."
Man Gu was puzzled as he got pulled by Meng Jingzhou into the backyard and saw the familiar Tiger Demon.
"Monster, give me back Brother Lu's life!"
Man Gu roared and struck out. He didn't get it, this was for real.
Seeing this, Meng Jingzhou hurriedly hugged Man Gu's waist and urged the barbarian brother to stay calm. "Don't hit him, this is Lu Yang."
The two Ghouls, which had been threading skewers in the hall, heard the commotion in the backyard and curiously sneaked over to check. They were so frightened that their souls almost flew away.
The Tiger Demon had truly resurrected this time!
Tiger Demon Lu Yang rolled his eyes. He had no interest in dealing with this bunch and concentrated on exploring how to exit the Tiger Demon state.
He closed his eyes and chanted three times to return to his original state.
When Lu Yang opened his eyes, he had returned to his usual self.
After such chaos, the three could finally sit down and think about what had just happened. The two ghouls let out a sigh of relief and continued threading skewers.
The business would definitely be better than it was yesterday. They needed to thread more skewers.
"This is what happened. I was practicing the Imitation Fist just now..." Lu Yang explained slowly.
When Man Gu heard Lu Yang say that he was practicing the Imitation Fist, he felt his worldview was under attack. Without thinking, he blurted out, "Are you learning Imitation Fist or Transformation Fist?"
The sage was right. It's important to travel, as books don't cover everything. He needed to spend more time with Brother Lu and Brother Meng.
His horizons have been broadened.
Meng Jingzhou's reaction wasn't much better than Man Gu's, his eyes on Lu Yang held a strange light.
He thought you were practicing magic skills, but you're telling him you were boxing?
Who on earth can achieve such results through martial arts?
Originally, Meng Jingzhou thought Lu Yang had achieved a weird result by cultivating the Expel Ghost Technique a few days ago and ended up with the Yang Spirit Out-of-body. He never thought there could be something even more bizarre.
Lu Yang defended confidently, sharing his unique insights into the Imitation Fist: "Think about it, isn't the essence of Imitation Fist the imitation of animals, like the Tiger Fist, Monkey Fist, Crane Fist and the like, imitating tigers, monkeys, and cranes, right?"
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu nodded.
Lu Yang continued, "Right, the better the imitation, the better the result, the greater the power, right?"
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu nodded again.
"I'm most familiar with the Tiger Fist since I have come into contact with the Tiger Demon. The Tiger Fist is the easiest to start with and the easiest to imitate, right?"
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu continued to nod.
Lu Yang said again, "I held this idea during boxing, and then I became a tiger while boxing. It is quite reasonable, right?"
Meng Jingzhou was about to nod, but he stopped his head abruptly, "For ghosts' sake, the gap is too big!"
Man Gu, however, continued nodding dumbly.
Lu Yang shrugged. He was the most helpless one. He was practicing as per the boxing manual, just adding a little personal insight: "Why don't you guys try? Maybe you can learn the Transformation Technique this way?"
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu's eyes were filled with excitement. It would be the best outcome to learn Transformation Technique by boxing.
Although Transformation Technique was mostly used by cultivators who stole things, it's not a loss to learn one more. Who knows when it might come in handy?
With the guidance of Lu Yang, a master of martial arts, the two quickly mastered the Tiger Fist, their boxing full of rigor and power.
However, they couldn't learn the critical transformation technique in any way.
While the two were practicing boxing, Lu Yang also wasn't idle. Watching their movements, an idea sprung up in his mind.
Imitation Fist is a simulated boxing method, but why should it be limited to imitating animals? Why not imitate people?
This idea was like a wild horse that had broken its reins and couldn't be reined in.
To imitate using the Imitation Fist, one needs to be very familiar with the things being imitated.
Lu Yang looked at the two people who were practicing boxing attentively. His eyes lit up. Weren't they the perfect examples?
He had grasped the core essence of the Imitation Fist. It was time to innovate.
"To progress, we must abandon the old and bring forth the new!"
Lu Yang meant what he said.
He closed his eyes again, reviewed Man Gu's movements in his mind, and his body began to move.
Man Gu, who was boxing, looked at Lu Yang's movements and felt it looked familiar, but he couldn't remember where he had seen it before.
"Isn't that me?" Man Gu quickly realized, puzzled at what Lu Yang was doing.
Once again, Lu Yang immersed himself in the profound comprehension, and his body gradually changed, amazingly, he really became like Man Gu!
"Haha, success. I knew my speculation was right." Lu Yang, with Man Gu's face, laughed merrily, which was somewhat discordant.
Man Gu: "!!!"
What just happened? He turned into him in a blink of an eye?
Why didn't it match his impression of the Imitation Fist? Can the Imitation Fist imitate a person too?
"Brother Man Gu, you can laugh like this too...Damn it, which one is the real Man Gu?" Meng Jingzhou, who was boxing, heard a different laughter. He instinctively felt something was amiss, turned his head, and saw two Man Gu's.
"No, the new Man Gu is Lu Yang in disguise!"
Meng Jingzhou looked up and down at Lu Yang, he definitely looked like Man Gu, but his expression and demeanor were way off.
You could tell at a glance that Man Gu was an honest and simple person, while the Man Gu that Lu Yang transformed into looked like a scoundrel.
He had already given up on learning the Imitation Fist. If initially, he still wanted to learn the Imitation Fist to transform, but now seeing Lu Yang in this state, he knew he definitely wouldn't be able to learn.
This was completely unrelated to the Imitation Fist.
Once Lu Yang had mastered the technique, he smoothly switched from Man Gu to Meng Jingzhou.
"Aren't you practicing the Transformation Technique?"
"This is Lu's Imitation Fist."
Lu Yang held his hands behind his back, looked up at the sky at a 45-degree angle, completely embodying the demeanor of a martial arts expert.
(Don't ask why Lu Yang still has clothes on when he transform from a Tiger Demon to a human form, this is a proper novel)

chapters.title: Chapter 61 - 60: Constable and Thief_1
chapters.content:
"My Lu Clan's Imitation Fist is profound and immeasurable, it's not something those with a Single Body Spiritual Root like you can fully comprehend."
"As the saying goes, the sky is nine layers high and the earth is nine layers deep, Lu Clan's Imitation Fist also has nine levels."
"Right now, I am almost at the first realm. Once I have cultivated to the more advanced stages, I can gain the power, magic skills and even cultivation level of the objects I imitate. In the future, if I can practice to the ninth heaven, I could become a Great Power in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage just with one thought, and even suppressing the Eldest Senior Sister wouldn't be a problem!"
Lu Yang spoke proudly, convincing Man Gu who considered it as true. Man Gu quietly asked Meng Jingzhou, "Is what Brother Lu saying true?"
Meng Jingzhou rolled his eyes, "True, my foot! It's obviously made-up garbage. If you really want to hear it, I can make up eight different versions for you."
Man Gu uttered a sound of realization, thinking that the ability of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou to fabricate lies so easily was quite impressive.
A few days passed since Lu Yang gave the Imitation Fist its new meaning, the number of customers increased day by day. Some of them even gave spirit stones as tips when they were pleased.
"Didn't we raise the price? Why are there still so many people?" Lu Yang grumbled. The largest restaurant in Yanjiang County even made an offer yesterday to buy their recipe.
Only he complained, Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu were quite happy.
Today, Man Gu went upstairs to supervise Qin Yuanhao, while Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou went downstairs to play the part of the restaurant's servers.
Meng Jingzhou, while forcefully resisting the urge to crack jokes, shared via voice transmission, "I heard that a few days ago a table of cultivators praised our food saying it was better than what a Spirit Chef they knew made."
"And just like that, the word spread. Now, many cultivators know about our restaurant."
Despite the Seek Dao Sect having many Spirit Chefs, in actuality, it's a very niche type of cultivator. In Yanjiang County, you could count them all on one hand, and most of them are at the Qi Refinement stage, with only one at the Foundation Establishment Stage.
Spirit Chefs focus on the cycle of the five elements producing food that's not just delicious but can also enhance one's cultivation level, bringing unity to both benefits.
Man Gu's skewers can certainly not improve cultivation level, but they excel in deliciousness. The cultivators in Yanjiang County reasoned that if they couldn't improve their cultivation level through eating Spirit Chef's food, then why couldn't they eat skewers that tasted even better?
Being ten times more expensive than the usual skewers was considered good value for money in the eyes of the cultivators.
"We've gained some fame among the upper-middle class of Yanjiang County. Many affluent commoners also follow suit and come to our restaurant. It seems like they use dining at our place as a symbol of status. Our business paradigm is about to expand throughout the whole continent soon, are you excited?"
"I'm excited, my ass." Lu Yang rolled his eyes and welcomed the new customers.
"Boss, the first floor is all filled up, can't we go to the second floor?" A customer saw the lights turned on in the second floor and thought it was a great spot.
"The second floor is under renovation and is not open to customers. We apologize for the inconvenience." Even though he had no intention of expanding the barbecue shop, Lu Yang diligently put on his server role and didn't slack off in his work.
The customers had no choice but to obediently go to the back of the line.
"Haha, it's finally our turn, boss! I've brought my brothers here again!"
Several officers dressed in black uniforms arrived at the barbecue shop. Their waist cards and long knives hanging from their waists, indicative of their statuses, were quite intimidating.
Those standing behind them didn't want to get too close, instinctively afraid.
"Welcome, Guard Captain Wei, good to see you guys again."
Lu Yang smiled as if he were familiar with these men.
The group were constables of Yanjiang County, led by someone surnamed Wei who had a bushy beard and spoke with great force. Known by the nickname Poker Face Constable, he was a high-level cultivator at the Foundation Establishment Stage. Neither common thugs nor members of the demonic sect wanted to cross paths with them. They were afraid of being targeted and inviting unnecessary trouble.
The constables behind him were no ordinary people, either. The least advanced among them was at the Qi Refinement sixth layer.
You can't be a constable in the world of cultivation without having some level of cultivation.
This was Guard Captain Wei's fourth time here. After a few visits and exchanges, he had become quite familiar with Lu Yang.
At first, some people tried to use their status and cultivation level to cut the queue, but after learning that Guard Captain Wei often dined here late at night, they no longer dared to behave arrogantly.
"We just finished our job and shift, so I brought my brothers here for skewers. Can't lie, your skewers are so good they're hard to forget." Guard Captain Wei was salivating, just thinking about the kebabs at this place.
"Officers also have it tough, having to work night shifts every other day." Lu Yang sighed as he led them to a private room.
Once in the room, Guard Captain Wei and his men took off their coats.
"Oh, it's annoying. For some reason, lately, a lot of cultivators have been flooding into Yanjiang County. They don't seem to be up to any good, causing quite a strain on law and order."
"The County Magistrate has time and again stressed on maintaining peace. Without a choice, I had to patrol more often. Whenever the patrol ends, we come here to treat ourselves."
Seeing Lu Yang busy, Guard Captain Wei didn't say much and started ordering.
"Same set as last time?" Lu Yang asked. The previous three times, Wei had ordered the same skewers.
"This time, let's try something fresh. I wanted to try this last time but was stopped by my brothers. Give us ten roasted eyes skewers, ten roasted silkworm pupa skewers, and ten centipede skewers." After giving his order, Wei urged Lu Yang to hurry and told his brothers before they had a chance to react.
The brothers wailed, those things didn't sound edible at all.
"Look at how pampered you all are. One day I will take you for a half-month field task and won't let you take fasting pills. We shall see what you eat then!"
After the booze and skewers arrived, Guard Captain Wei and his men ate with relish.
As they got joyful, a few brothers started blowing off the steam, grumbling and cursing.
"Damn it, those thieves who've been stealing everywhere recently are just too slippery, leaving no trace of the crime."
"It must be the work of cultivators. Even an old hand could not work as cleanly."
"I think it's those out-of-town cultivators."
"When we catch these bastards, I'll whip them a hundred or so times and then lock them in the water cell."
Despite the thieves running rampant, and unable to catch anyone, Weiss lost face: "The County Magistrate ordered me to crack this case within a month. If he's so capable, why doesn't he do it himself? Today those thieves robbed both Rich Man Li and Rich Man Lv. And with Li being the County Magistrate's relative, he is surely going to pressure me tomorrow."
In the next room.
A guest, who looked like a big brother, placed today's loot on the table: "We did a good job today. As usual, I will take forty percent, the rest will be equally divided among the brothers."
The brothers are ecstatic, today's harvest was particularly plentiful: "Beforehand, I heard how intimidating Guard Captain Wei was, even known as Poker Face Constable, but now he can't even catch our farts!"
"That's too heartbreaking to say. At least he manages to catch farts."
"This Li and Lv are really rich. Particularly this 'Ma' guy, not high in cultivation level but has a lot of good stuff."
"Come on, let's eat and drink to our hearts' content today. It's on me. Nobody is allowed to sober up; we are going to be completely wasted!"
The thieves were carousing. One of them had to make a restroom trip but accidentally walked into the room of the officers upon returning.
"Um—Big brother, how come you've changed your looks and even look uglier?"
"Where the hell did this drunk come from? Go away." One of the constables growled impatiently. They were worried about where to catch people and didn't want a drunk here causing a ruckus.
The guy who made a mistake angrily tried to start a fight but wasn't a match for the officers and was thrown out in no time.
The officers noticed that the man had some cultivation, but didn't care much and continued their drinking and grumbling.
Feeling aggrieved, the man went back to his boss to complain.
The thieves, drunk as lords, heard that one of their brothers had been bullied, and the booze fired their temper. The big brother, who was particularly gallant, banged the table, and arrogantly declared, "Nice, dare to bully me, tell the guys next door to come here if they have the balls. Whoever doesn't come is a wuss!"

chapters.title: Chapter 62 - 61: Such Proactive Performance is Rare_1
chapters.content:
"Who dares to bully my brother!" the thief Boss exclaimed fiercely. He beckoned to his bro to fetch the person so they could teach him a lesson. If he, as the boss, couldn't restore their honor after his bro got bullied, how could he uphold his reputation in the future?
Seeing his boss back him up, the thief felt a surge of courage. He kicked the neighboring door open, yelling, "My Boss said he can't let it slide. He wants to talk to you, and anyone who doesn't show up is a coward!"
The constables were taken aback. They'd been in the business for years and had never seen anyone dare to provoke them so audaciously.
Guard Captain Wei shook his head and laughed. As the most experienced one, he had seen all sorts of characters. These were just a bunch of brash blokes picking a fight. Such minor cases, which practically fell into their laps, were bound to happen in a lifetime of constabulary work.
"Who's afraid? Let's go!"
The thieves were rubbing their hands together, ready to show their rivals what they were made of. They were newcomers, and before joining the demonic sect, they couldn't just make their name by stealing things. It was time to make a grand entrance!
Then the thieves saw a group of constables, carrying government-issued sabers and waist cards indicating their identities, bustling in.
The constables were taken aback at the sight of the heap of gold, silver, jewelry, rare medicinal herbs, and spirit crystals on the table.
Why did these look so familiar, like someone had reported them stolen not long ago?
The constables: "...."
Guard Captain Wei: "...."
The thieves: "...."
"Do you believe me if I say I found these on the street?"
Guard Captain Wei had never seen such a thing. These criminals were walking right into their trap.
The delinquent, oblivious to what was unfolding, was still egging his boss on.
"Boss, teach them a lesson!"
As he was yelling, he also threw out a threat: "Do you see my big brother's sparse hair? For every person he kills, he pulls out one hair! People on the streets call him Mr. Trouble!"
"Do you see this guy with the eye patch? This is my second brother. He lost his eye in a fight with a powerful figure at the late stage of Foundation Establishment. That guy didn't fare well either, his two eyes were both blinded by my second brother! People on the streets call him Desperate ErLang!"
"Do you see my third brother's leg? He got that when he was surrounded by over a hundred royal guards while stealing from the palace. He escaped at the cost of his leg! People call him Flying on the Grass!"
The Boss, Old Two, and Old Three simultaneously kicked the junior thief flat on his face. This youngster talked too much.
"So you were saying anyone who didn't show up was a coward?" Guard Captain Wei clenched his teeth into a sinister grin. It was because of these guys he had been stuck with night shifts.
"I'm the coward, I'm the coward." The thief Boss trembled with fear.
The thieves didn't dare to fight back. Seeing the entrance blocked by the constables, they crashed through the wall and ran away. Their gang spilled into the main hall with a great noise.
The group's strength resided in speed rather than head-on fighting ability. Not to mention none of them had reached the Foundation Establishment Stage, and the Boss was only at the Ninth Level of Qi Training.
"You go through the main door, the rest, follow me through the back!" The thief Boss ordered his men to scatter and run.
Lu Yang noticed the commotion and quickly figured out the situation, finding it somewhat amusing.
"A thief and the constables separated by a single wall, and the thief provokes the constables?"
"Wait, they're trying to escape from the backyard. What if the Ghoul is discovered by the constables?"
Lu Yang quickly realized the problem. If Ghoul was captured, who would take care of the barbecues? How could he continue running his barbecue joint or keep an eye on Qin Yuanhao?
Thief Boss _ seeing Lu Yang block the backdoor as if he'd been scared silly _ reached out to toss Lu Yang aside urgently.
Lu Yang was holding a bowl of noodle soup. Seeing the intimidating Boss storming towards him, his hands trembled and the noodle soup spilled out.
The thief Boss didn't anticipate this and reflexively erected a shield of spiritual energy to block the noodle soup.
However, this tiny distraction was enough for Guard Captain Wei to bring out a bundle of iron chains. Like a slithering snake, the chains coiled around the thief Boss.
"Go, get all the rest! Our dinner tonight is well earned." Guard Captain Wei's mood instantly improved. He felt refreshed and the world seemed brighter.
The gang of thieves, which had been a nuisance for many days, had finally been captured. What a streak of good luck indeed.
Guard Captain Wei clapped Lu Yang on the shoulder, chuckling, "If it wasn't for you blocking just now, this kid would have gotten away for sure!"
"Heroic actions deserve praise. Just wait, I'll send you a banner of honor tomorrow!"
Lu Yang quickly waved his hand, saying it was unnecessary, but Guard Captain Wei was insistent on sending one.
The constable and the thieves had caused a huge commotion just now, damaging the wall and turning the whole hall into a chaotic mess filled with dust and debris.
The patrons had no choice but to leave early. They felt it was not a loss though, as witnessing the capture of a thief by a constable was quite thrilling.
"This barbecue restaurant is really something. Even sitting down at a table, the constables can catch criminals."
"It's worth coming, you can't see this exciting drama even with money."
"This place must be an epicenter of good fortune. The business gets booming in such a short period of time. The delicious food alone can't justify it. It must have something to do with good luck."
"We all saw it today. The fact that the constable could capture a person here proves my point."
"I need to come here more often and see if I can also get lucky."
"Makes sense, let's come together next time."
Listening to the fading discussions of people, Lu Yang felt pessimistic about the future of the barbecue restaurant. It seemed destined to expand significantly.
"When I bring over the banner of honor tomorrow, I'll also include the funds for the wall repair!" Guard Captain Wei waved at Lu Yang and left those words behind before escorting the unfortunate thieves away.
Lu Yang stood at the door, sighing a little, and suddenly noticed Qin Yuanhao leaving his residence again.
"Brother Lu, Qin Yuanhao has left his house again." Man Gu relayed from the second floor, he was very dedicated to his job, not caring about the happenings downstairs and closely watching Qin Yuanhao's movements.
"I see, you and Meng Jingzhou fix the broken wall together. I'll go follow Qin Yuanhao."
"Sure."
Lu Yang used his short-distance teleportation skill to catch up with Qin Yuanhao again.
Meng Jingzhou sighed from behind, "Lu Yang's talent for magic is really strong. I have studied with him for a long time, but I haven't learned anything."
"And, I somehow feel that the mantra he taught me has something to do with space magic, is it my imagination?"
Meng Jingzhou didn't ponder over this question too much. Describing Lu Yang's magic talent as "outrageous" wasn't overstating. Hoping to learn magic from him was purely daydreaming.
If he, being a Single Body Spiritual Root, couldn't achieve it, then it would be even more impossible for others.
...
Lu Yang followed Qin Yuanhao for a long distance, and didn't hear what Meng Jingzhou said. He observed that this time, Qin Yuanhao held himself in an imposing manner, humming a cheerful tune, as if he was off to accomplish some significant task.
Qin Yuanhao arrived at a large house and didn't knock on the door. Instead, he cast a spell in front of the door.
Soon, a skinny and tall man came out who asked, "Is it that day?"
"It is indeed today."
"I've been preparing for today for a whole half a month."
"Who isn't, I'm desperate to make a move, I've been stifled these days! After we succeed this time, you must help me make some good publicity. Let's see who dares to look down on me!" Qin Yuanhao revealed a cruel smile as he spoke.
"Absolutely, absolutely," the tall and skinny man bore an infamous reputation for being a gossip in Yanjiang Rudder.
The two men had a conversation which outsiders wouldn't understand, their laughter was somewhat cold.
Lu Yang grew alert, unsure about what the pair was plotting.
The two men walked into a bustling district, where one brightly decorated building stood out among others.
Qin Yuanhao and the tall skinny man walked in, greeted with warm hospitality.
Lu Yang looked up at the sign of the place—it was a brothel.

chapters.title: Chapter 63 - 62: Position of the Base_1
chapters.content:
Ten minutes later, Qin Yuanhao and the tall, thin man left the brothel with expressionless faces, completely lacking the excitement they had before entering the brothel.
Lu Yang scratched his temples. They left so quickly?
At the door, the madam handed Qin Yuanhao and the tall, thin man each a note. The two men opened them, read them, and then destroyed them.
"Brother Qin, the Rudder Master needs me for something and wants me to go to the sub-rudder. I will leave first."
"Hmm, the Rudder Master also asked me to do something, so let's part ways here. Don't forget to publicize that I went to the brothel."
"No problem."
The two men split up outside the brothel. Lu Yang's heart stirred and he decided to follow the thin, tall man.
The thin, tall man and Qin Yuanhao were evenly matched in their cultivation levels and did not notice Lu Yang hiding underground.
The pedestrians and buildings around them gradually dwindled until they came to a desolate wilderness. The thin, tall man seemed very familiar with the place and walked leisurely up the twisty mountain path. After about fifteen minutes, he stopped in front of a rock wall.
The place was located at the border of Yanjiang County and another county. Theoretically, it belonged to Yanjiang County. But due to historical factors, both parties had reason to claim jurisdiction.
Because both had reason, neither party managed the area.
After all, there was no valuable commodity here, thus there was no need to dispute the territory.
He knocked on the rock wall three long times and once short. As he chanted, the wall began to ripple like water.
The thin, tall man took a step and disappeared into the wall.
Lu Yang heard his chant, "Immortal Eternity, rise from the dead, pierce the clouds, eternal in the world".
"Could this be a Blessed Cave?" Lu Yang's eyes gleamed with surprise.
A Blessed Cave is a space opened by a cultivator who is highly skilled in space magic. The higher their cultivation level, the more complete the space they can open.
Generally speaking, cultivators at the Divinity Transformation Stage can open their own spaces.
Some cultivators prefer to use their Blessed Caves as a dwelling place, living a solitary life, while others turn them into tombs, also living solitary lives.
There have been countless cultivators at the Divinity Transformation Stage throughout history, let alone the Refining the Void, Unification, and Pass Tribulation stages above it.
Cultivators may pass away, but their Blessed Caves remain. This has resulted in numerous Relic Blessed Caves scattered across the Central Continent. Most cultivators do not disclose the locations and methods to open their Caves before their death, leaving others to rely on luck when searching for them.
Nobody knows how many Blessed Caves remain undiscovered.
The Eldest Senior Sister said that as the Great Era approaches, more and more Blessed Caves are being discovered, providing many people with opportunities to suddenly rise to prominence.
This Blessed Cave should be one left by an ancestor and discovered and utilized by the demonic sect.
Lu Yang did not rashly follow. Instead, he chose quietness, staying underground, waiting for the tall, thin man to come out.
Lu Yang felt uneasy about this. After all, this was Yanjiang Rudder, a stronghold of the demonic sect. Who knows how many experts were in there? Just hiding in the ground wasn't covert enough.
With this thought, Lu Yang moved to a position where he could just see the entrance to the stronghold. He made himself small using the "inch shrink" technique, and hid using the stealth technique provided by Man Gu's barbarian tribe.
After about an hour, a man wearing a mask came out of the stone wall, followed by the thin, tall man.
From appearances, the masked man held a higher rank than the thin, tall man.
"Hmm?" The masked man noticed something was off and released his Spiritual Sense to scan the surroundings, even including underground.
"Come out, I've already found you. Don't think you're hiding so well. If you come out now, I might spare your life!" The masked man said indifferently.
"Still not coming out? Don't think that the Rudder Master is a soft-hearted person. I'll count to three, and if you still don't come out, don't blame me for not giving you a chance!"
"Three!"
"Two!"
"One!"
"Die!"
The Rudder Master condensed a burst of power in his palm and struck it in one direction, creating a loud rumbling sound.
"Rudder Master, what happened?" the tall, thin man asked respectfully.
The Rudder Master shook his head: "I just felt like someone was watching me. I tried to frighten them, but got no response. Maybe it was just my imagination."
Cold sweat broke out on Lu Yang's forehead. He just had the impulse to jump out of the soil and confront the Rudder Master in order to gain a glimmer of hope for survival.
Luckily, his strong willpower suppressed this urge. He believed that the Barbarian stealth technique would not reveal his identity.
Lu Yang sensed the Rudder Master's Spiritual Sense scanning over him, but he believed that the Rudder Master took him for a stone and didn't take any notice.
If the Rudder Master had really found him, he wouldn't have bothered counting down and would have attacked directly.
"Luckily the Barbarian stealth technique is brilliant. As long as I don't move, I won't be discovered," Lu Yang thought to himself, "This Rudder Master must be at the Golden Core Stage."
"How is the preparation for the selection in ten days?"
"Everything is ready. All we have to do is wait for the peers to come here in ten days. After passing the selection, they will join us."
"Excellent. I hope we can recruit several gifted individuals from the Demon Path this time. That way, the headquarters will start paying attention to Yanjiang Rudder."
The two man talked as they walked and soon disappeared from Lu Yang's field of view. Lu Yang remained motionless, fearing that any movement could expose him.
"A cultivator at Golden Core Stage is indeed not simple."
Lu Yang waited for another half hour. He worried that the Rudder Master was so suspicious that he might suddenly return.
Half an hour later, the Rudder Master did not reappear.
"He's gone."
Lu Yang tunneled away from the scene.
This had been a fruitful visit. He had not only discovered the location of Yanjiang Rudder but also confirmed that the selection venue was here.
...
"Tell me, Mr. Trouble, what's the deal with your hair? I heard you pull out a strand of hair every time you kill someone?" Guard Captain Wei, with his legs crossed, asked. The thieves were lined up, sitting scared on the other side.
"No, no, it's just that being the boss is hard. My men cause trouble everywhere. My hair fell out because of stress."
"How about you, Desperate ErLang? I heard you had a fight with a cultivator at the late stage of Foundation Establishment. You blinded both his eyes, and he blinded one of yours?"
"My, my eye is fine. I wear the eyepatch because it looks imposing. When you're living by the sword, you need a story to tell."
"And you, Flying on the Grass, I heard you were caught stealing in the palace. You're looking at a life sentence, at worst, execution by being cut into pieces."
The Third Brother of Thieves quickly refuted, "That's a misunderstanding, Officer. I was beaten and had a leg broken by my creditor because I couldn't pay my debts."
Guard Captain Wei yawned. He thought each of them carried a serious case on their backs. Who would have thought they were all so trivial?
"Captain Brother, I confess. I confess. I robbed sixteen houses..."
Guard Captain Wei waved his hand, "Let's not rush. Firstly, tell me, why did you guys all rush to Yanjiang County?"
"Well..." The thief's boss was hesitant, weighing the pros and cons of telling.
Guard Captain Wei pointed to the torture room behind, "Did you see the torture instruments in the room? If you guys don't confess, we'll have to use those to help you."
Seeing the blackened blood on the torture instruments, which looked particularly horrifying, the thieves swallowed hard and rushed to confess.
"I admit..."
The thieves had just uttered two words when they suddenly fell silent.
If anyone came behind them, they would find a cow hair-like needle lodged in their necks, the needle tipped with extreme poison!
"Assassins!"
Guard Captain Wei, being the most experienced constable, immediately realized what was happening. He rushed out, searching for the assassin.
But, was there anyone out there?
Inside the interrogation room, the shadow moved as if alive, apparently chuckling a few times before disappearing.

chapters.title: Chapter 64 - 63: Be careful, the other party is very strange_1
chapters.content:
"Guard Captain Wei, up so early. Sorry, no grilled skewers at this hour." Lu Yang teased at the doorway with a smile.
It was still morning when Guard Captain Wei, along with two constables and a flamboyant banner, arrived at the barbecue shop.
"Ah, didn't we agree on the banner? So, here I'm delivering it to you."
Guard Captain Wei flapped the banner on the main street, intentionally displaying it. Emblazoned on the banner were the words "Be brave for justice, uphold righteousness".
Expectedly, this act drew a considerable crowd.
The two constables hung the banner on the wall directly opposite to the front door of the lobby, making it highly visible.
Originally, there were two ghouls skewering in the lobby, but Lu Yang had them move to the backyard earlier to avoid being seen.
Lu Yang brought over three cups of tea and casually asked, "What did you find out from those dimwit thieves yesterday? Why would these outsiders take the risk to provoke the famous Poker Face Constable?"
"Oh, don't even mention it. Couldn't get a single word out of them," Guard Captain Wei picked up his tea and downed it in a gulp.
A cultivator at Foundation Establishment Stage can withstand scalding water.
"Why's that?"
"The dimwits had weak wills. They began to talk as soon as they got scared, but just as they were about to divulge why a group of cultivators came to Yanjiang County, unknown assassins killed them. They had cow hair poison needles stuck in their neck and died instantly. The room was sealed, but we don't know how the assassins got in."
"At that moment, I instinctively went outside to look for the assassins, but found nothing. Later on, I realized that the killers must have mastered a magic skill related to shadows. They must have hidden in the shadows beforehand. As soon as we started questioning, they struck, and slipped away through shadows when I ran out."
"If I had blocked the door at that time, we could've caught the assassin. I regret that my anger at the moment stopped me from thinking about it," Guard Captain Wei finished and angrily drunk both his tea and the constables'.
The two constables gaped at Guard Captain Wei. They hadn't even had a sip yet.
Grinning, Lu Yang saw off the sulky Guard Captain Wei and the two unlucky constables who didn't even get to quench their thirst.
Meng Jingzhou spoke through voice transmission, "As per yesterday's plan, should we kill Qin Yuanhao?"
After returning last night, Lu Yang had shared what he found. Since they now knew the location of Yanjiang Rudder, Qin Yuanhao seemed no longer necessary to be kept alive.
The three made a plan to ambush Qin Yuanhao overnight.
To be specific, it was Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou who discussed while Man Gu merely listened.
"No rush, I have a new idea. Let's prepare a bit more."
…
A figure in a black robe lightly knocked on the door of Qin Yuanhao's house. No one answered for a long while.
The figure in black just waited.
Finally, the front door opened, but there was no one in sight, as if it had opened by itself.
The wide-open gate resembled a demonic maw ready to devour unsuspecting souls.
Unhurriedly, the figure in black entered the mansion. The moment he stepped in, the door slammed shut and bolted, locking him inside.
The figure in black took out a bone token and spoke loudly, "Is Senior Qin Yuanhao home? I am here on behalf of my master to pay a visit."
"I was wondering who it could be. Turns out it's a ghoul under Brother Tiger."
The voice came from behind the ghoul. Qin Yuanhao appeared abruptly. The ghoul didn't notice where Qin had approached from, as if he had manifested out of thin air.
"What brings you here?"
"My master has been thinking for some time and believes in your words that it's good to have strong backing. He wishes to join Yanjiang Rudder. However, he is still somewhat apprehensive and would like to meet you on Song Mountain."
Qin Yuanhao looked at the ghoul with amusement, "Oh, I thought Brother Tiger had no intention to join Yanjiang Rudder since he hasn't replied for so long."
The ghoul laughed obsequiously, "Our master takes more time to ponder."
Qin Yuanhao's face hardened. He grabbed the ghoul's throat, "Dare to trick me? Tell me, who sent you? Considering Brother Tiger's nature, how could he voluntarily join Yanjiang Rudder!"
The ghoul was panic-stricken and finally admitted that someone indeed sent him.
Qin Yuanhao strengthened his grip, causing the ghoul to weaken and finally telling the truth.
"A few days ago, some short-sighted cultivators ventured into Song Mountain. They accidentally discovered my master's whereabouts and he killed them. When collecting their clothes, it was found that their sect was extraordinary, having a great power in the Golden Core Stage among their elders."
"My master was scared that a Golden Core Stage cultivator might come looking for him. He remembered Senior Qin's invitation, hence, after persuading the lady master, decided to join the Yanjiang Rudder. He sent me to invite you over to discuss the specifics."
Having gotten the answer he wanted, Qin Yuanhao casually tossed the ghoul aside: "That sounds more reasonable."
Qin Yuanhao no longer doubted the ghoul and followed him to Song Mountain.
"Senior Qin, our master is waiting for you just ahead." The ghoul said respectfully, "Our master doesn't like eavesdropping, please proceed."
Qin Yuanhao ignored the ghoul and walked on alone.
The forest was dense and quiet, as if untouched by humans for a long time. The chirping of birds in the distance added a sense of tranquility.
A four-meter-long Tiger Demon sat cross-legged ahead, and there were two cups of tea on the stone table as if expecting a guest.
Qin Yuanhao unconsciously relaxed his guard and quickened his pace.
Suddenly, his magic skill automatically operated, forming a thin film on his body to block an unexpected attack, leaving only a faint line of blood on his neck.
"It's a trap!"
Qin Yuanhao, with his vast experience, quickly retreated and noticed an almost invisible thread at the height of his neck.
"This noodle is really useful, almost beheaded him."
A gloating voice sounded from a tree on Qin Yuanhao's right and it belonged to Meng Jingzhou.
What Qin Yuanhao had seen was not a thread, but the dragon whisker noodle that Lu Yang had bought from the canteen.
As per the Senior Brother who sold the noodles, this hanging noodle was virtually lethal and perfect for laying traps.
Had Qin Yuanhao's magic skill not been special with automatic defense, he would have already been beheaded.
"You dare to ambush me!" Qin Yuanhao angrily stared at the Tiger Demon. This was not about discussing joining the Yanjiang Rudder at all. It was a trap from the start!
However, the Tiger Demon had already disappeared. The ground beneath Qin Yuanhao was soft and the Green Peak Sword aimed straight for his crotch.
Luckily, Qin Yuanhao reacted swiftly. His right knee collided with the Green Peak Sword, changing its direction and protecting his vital part.
Seeing the situation unfavourable, he turned and ran.
He was unprepared, whereas the others were well-prepared. How could he fight in such a situation?
"It must be people of the Demon Path!" Qin Yuanhao was certain. That move was too nasty. Which Righteous Path fighter would make such a move?
Man Gu, who had been waiting behind him for a long time, swung a tree towards him. Qin Yuanhao was thrown far away.
"Hmm, why didn't I feel that?" Man Gu looked puzzled. He clearly hit the target, but it felt as if he had hit a piece of paper.
Qin Yuanhao flew a good distance but appeared uninjured.
"Be careful, his magic skill is very strange!" Man Gu warned loudly.
"A few juniors trying to deal with me? You're a hundred years too early!" Qin Yuanhao laughed heartily. As long as his magical skill's true use could not be discovered, nobody could catch him.
Nonchalantly, Lu Yang jumped into mid-air. Using his jade pendant, he said to Qin Yuanhao, "Take!"
Qin Yuanhao was stunned. He did not understand what had happened. The jade pendant looked like some kind of storage ring, but a storage ring couldn't hold him.
Qin Yuanhao noticed Lu Yang and the others watching him with strange eyes.
He slowly looked down to find himself naked; his clothes were gone.
Qin Yuanhao's clothes were stored in the jade pendant and he stood in the air shivering with only his underwear on.
"Damn it, you guys are the weird ones!"

chapters.title: Chapter 65 - 64 Shadow_1
chapters.content:
With a guilty conscience, Lu Yang only took all of Qin Yuanhao's clothes, but left his underwear to cover his modesty.
...
Storage rings, a type of magic artifact widely circulated among cultivators.
The Land Money Trade Association has conducted several polls on the "most popular magic artifact," and the storage ring was voted number one.
Whether traveling abroad, touring the mainland, hiding treasures and private funds, it is a must-have magic artifact at home.
Also, storage rings are cheap, and Qi Refinement cultivators can afford them, but the space is much smaller.
Every year, many Qi Refinement cultivators buy storage rings. The Land Money Trade Association makes a fortune, making it a major source of revenue.
The Land Money Trade Association also releases an upgraded version of the storage ring each year - the main changes are aesthetic improvements, with no changes in internal space.
The first magic artifact that most people use as cultivators is the storage ring, which holds a lot of sentimental value.
Whether it's the Righteous Path or the Demon Path, they all use storage rings, and Qin Yuanhao is no exception.
The above is Qin Yuanhao's impression of the storage ring.
He has lived for decades and never heard of anyone using storage rings to collect enemy clothes!
Is this reasonable?
Actually, it is. Storage rings cannot collect things with spirituality, such as living creatures, ghosts, and spirit treasures. Clearly, Qin Yuanhao's clothes do not fall into this category.
Luckily, Qin Yuanhao, as a dignified Demon Path cultivator, had long abandoned his pride. Even in his underwear, he could still fight!
Then he saw Meng Jingzhou pulling out the Recording Orb.
"Damn it, which teaching did you come from? What deep hatred do I have with you!" Qin Yuanhao decided that the three of Lu Yang were from three other sects.
Even if Lu Yang and the others say they are from the Righteous Path now, Qin Yuanhao doesn't believe them.
He just couldn't understand why, even though he had made enemies, he always kept things in proportion and never made mortal enemies.
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu also looked at Lu Yang strangely, as if they hadn't expected Lu Yang to come up with such a special attack.
"There's no need for chivalry when dealing with the sinister and crooked, let's go together!" Lu Yang called out to the two.
The three of them attacking together can even kill a Half-Step Golden Core Tiger Demon, let alone Qin Yuanhao who is at the late stage of Foundation Establishment.
They had thought about fighting Qin Yuanhao one-on-one. As geniuses, they were confident in fighting beyond their level.
However, for the sake of caution, it would be wise for the three of them to make a move together.
Qin Yuanhao cast aside his shame and fought fiercely with the three.
The Sword Qi was like water, splashing like splashed ink, soaring majestically. Qin Yuanhao kept retreating, not daring to face his enemy head-on!
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu threw out four punches together, like mountains falling, hammering Qin Yuanhao's chest and making him cough up blood!
Qin Yuanhao flipped his palm and three Cow Hair Poison Needles appeared on his fingertips, stabbing into the chests of the three.
But who would have thought that the three of them would look like nothing had happened, their swords and fists showing no sign of weakening and were even getting stronger with the fight.
Lu Yang had already guessed that the opponent might use poison and had taken an antidote pill in advance.
Strictly speaking, an antidote pill should not be called an antidote pill, but rather a poison removal pill.
The principle of the antidote pill is to package the poison before it can take effect and excrete it out of the body with sweat.
Since the poison never took effect from the start, how can it be said to have been detoxified?
Qin Yuanhao secretly knew he was in trouble. The opponent was too prepared and his sinister methods couldn't be played out or even if they were, they weren't as cunning as the opponents.
Meng Jingzhou's muscles bulged, his veins popped, and Qin Yuanhao's fist grew larger in his eyes, so fast that he couldn't react.
Something strange happened again. Meng Jingzhou's punch was powerful and heavy. If a late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator took a punch, they wouldn't die but would be crippled, but Qin Yuanhao was not affected at all.
Qin Yuanhao let out a strange laugh, saying that these people couldn't deal with him!
After the fight, Lu Yang finally discovered the truth about Qin Yuanhao's technique. He swung his sword, the light leaping, and the Sword Qi was like a rainbow, invincible.
The sword wasn't cutting anywhere else, it was heading straight for Qin Yuanhao's shadow!
"Damn it!" Qin Yuanhao yelped in pain.
"Sure enough, you were the one who killed the bandit gang last night, your weakness is your shadow!"
Lu Yang thought of Qin Yuanhao coming out of the brothel and receiving the command from the Rudder Master to act, which must have been to kill the bandit gang.
With his greatest reliance exposed, Qin Yuanhao no longer wanted to fight. His body disappeared, while his shadow moved rapidly on the ground.
Even if he can't beat them, he has complete confidence in running away. No matter how sharp your sword is, can it kill a shadow?
"You three juniors, I'll remember you. You can wait for my endless revenge. Hahahaha..." Qin Yuanhao, feeling he has the upper hand, couldn't stop laughing.
Suddenly, a dazzling white light shone on the shadow, causing Qin Yuanhao to let out a heart-wrenching cry. This was equivalent to tearing off a piece of flesh from his body.
Light Concentration Array, a simple array method that absorbs and emits light. It's easy to get started, but it's also quite ordinary. However, used here, the effect is excellent.
With no choice, Qin Yuanhao's body sprang out from the shadow, blocking the white light, and the gaps in the shadow disappeared.
The injury healed.
"So, you came prepared, so what? Do you honestly believe that a measly Light Concentration Array can hurt me?"
Qin Yuanhao scoffed, "Don't you know the stronger the light, the stronger the shadow?"
Lu Yang, unhurried, threw out more Light Concentration Arrays, mocking, "Have you ever heard of a Shadowless Lamp?"
Qin Yuanhao hesitated for a moment. He didn't know what a Shadowless Lamp was, but he had a bad feeling about this when he heard Lu Yang say it.
Lu Yang didn't have the leisure to explain the principle in the middle of a battle. More than a dozen white lights hit Qin Yuanhao's body, and the shadow made a sound. No matter whether Qin Yuanhao revealed his body to block the light, or retreated into the shadow, he couldn't stop this process.
The shadow lightened until, in the end, it was so faint that it couldn't be distinguished with the naked eye.
The principle of the Shadowless Lamp is not to make the shadow disappear, but to make the shadow so light that it is almost non-existent.
Qin Yuanhao roared and climbed out of the nearly invisible shadow. His true body could no longer hide in the shadow.
The Sword Qi fell from the sky like a rainbow, catching people off guard and piercing through Qin Yuanhao's body.
Lu Yang had been waiting for this moment.
"That was close, he almost got away." Seeing that Qin Yuanhao was dead, Meng Jingzhou breathed a sigh of relief. If he had run away, all the preparations these days would have been wasted.
Meng Jingzhou thought they were well prepared, and Qin Yuanhao couldn't escape even if he had wings. Who would have thought that his technique had something to do with shadows, making it incredibly hard to trap him.
Meng Jingzhou, laughing, nudged Lu Yang on the shoulder, "Lucky we decided to make that Light Concentration Array before we left."
"It was all luck. I merely suspected that his technique had something to do with the shadow and had no solid evidence."
"But let's not celebrate too soon. We can celebrate after we've disposed of the body."
At Lu Yang's suggestion, the three of them burned Qin Yuanhao's body into an unrecognizable dry corpse, threw it into the Tiger Demon's cave, and then sealed the entrance of the cave.
With that, unless someone deliberately searched the mountain, no one could find this place.

chapters.title: Chapter 66 - 65: Examiner_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang held Qin Yuanhao's storage ring, shaking his head regretfully after a few attempts.
"What a pity, only Qin Yuanhao can open this storage ring. It's useless to us, forcibly opening it will only release the space inside the ring, then it'll be hard to find again."
"Let's go to his house, maybe we will find something useful." Lu Yang called the two to leave.
The ghoul that tricked Qin Yuanhao to come followed behind. Man Gu thought the ghoul did a good job, and decided to reward him with two mutton kebabs - theoretically, if the mutton kebab is grilled to char, the ghoul can eat it.
As for whether the ghoul eats the well-roasted mutton kebab or the charred mutton kebab, it needs to be proven by practice.
Qin Yuanhao's house is devoid of many decorations, it feels really empty with a single person living in it, not very lively.
The three arrived at the training room, besides a jade statue, there were only two bookshelves filled with many secret cultivation methods.
The face of the jade statue was blurred, and it was dressed in a long robe, making it impossible to distinguish between man and woman.
