"This should be the faith of the Eternity Sect, the Immortal Eternity." Meng Jingzhou walked around the statue twice, the material of the statue was far superior to ordinary ones, but its semblance was far inferior.
Who doesn't want their statues to look lifelike?
"'Diving Spell,' 'Introduction to Array Method,' 'Interpreting Sword Moves'... These are quite common cultivation methods, you can find them on the first floor of our Scripture Pavilion." Lu Yang's hand slid over the book spine; he loved this feeling.
"'Common Ways to Please Your Boss,' 'Heart of People,' 'Playing Mind Games,' what a mess."
Lu Yang casually picked up a book titled 'Common Ways to Please Your Boss'. The corners of the book were all curled, showing that Qin Yuanhao had flipped through it many times.
"Method one: Become the boss's family member. Depending on your age and ability, you can aim to be the boss, or the boss's child."
Qin Yuanhao noted on the side: The Rudder Master never removes the mask, identity unknown, gender unknown, cannot approach, cannot marry.
"Method two: Present treasures. High-profile treasures will make the person presenting them appear high-profile, which is not likable. It's recommended to give the boss low-profile yet expensive gifts."
Qin Yuanhao noted on the side: Lent money to the Rudder Master to buy a jade chair, hope it works.
"Method three: Develop interests. Pay close attention to the boss's interests and cultivate the same interests."
Qin Yuanhao noted on the side: The Rudder Master likes fishing. I went fishing with the Rudder Master by the river, I caught more fish than the Rudder Master, hope the Rudder Master doesn't envy my talent.
"Method four…"
"Method five…"
Qin Yuanhao really put a lot of effort into pleasing the Rudder Master, but the results are not great.
"It seems it's not easy to get along within the demonic sects either." Lu Yang said with a somewhat amused tone.
However, thanks to the notes made by Qin Yuanhao, Lu Yang gained a rough understanding of the Rudder Master and the various Managers.
"From the bottom to the top of the Yanjiang Rudder, the ranks are divided into ordinary disciples, Managers, and Rudder Master. The ordinary disciples are numerous, ranging from Qi Refinement to Foundation Establishment Stage, it's hard for the ordinary disciples to access the secrets of the Eternity Sect."
"Only those at the Foundation Establishment Stage can become Managers via exams. There are twelve Managers in the entire Yanjiang Rudder, now that Qin Yuanhao is dead, only eleven remain."
"The identity of the Rudder Master is unknown, Golden Core Stage Cultivator, exact cultivation level unknown, likes fishing."
Besides that, they also found a scattering of Spirit Stones and a few magic skills that didn't seem like those practiced by righteous practitioners, such as hypnosis and so on. That's not worth mentioning.
"Let's go, we have to prepare for the demonic sect test in nine days."
...
On the boundary of Yanjiang County, a countless number of silent cultivators iweaved through the thick forests. The patchy rays of light shone on their emotionless faces, giving them an eerie look.
Each cultivator kept a considerable distance from each other, vigilant of everyone else, ready to strike at any signs of weakness, in a bid to eliminate competition.
They were all individuals from the Demon Path who had found out about the testing location through various sources, and rushed towards Yanjiang Rudder ahead of time.
With the crackdown by the Righteous Path, the survival space for these individuals continually shrunk. To garner more resources, it was necessary to join a larger organization, and Yanjiang Rudder was their prime target.
In the past, one had to bribe a manager for a recommendation to join the demonic sect.
This time was different; everyone had a chance. It was an unprecedented once-in-thirty-years golden opportunity to join the demonic sect.
An hour before the testing started, the individuals from the Demon Path had mostly arrived.
"Quick, look! Is that Chi Xulong? The one that massacred an entire family overnight, sparing not even a rat, and boldly walked away under everyone's watchful eye!"
A muscular man held an unidentified demon beast's leg bone, looked like a savage, his skin bronze, muscles protruding, both arms covered in scars, as he revealed his wolf-like teeth.
Chi Xulong had a high reputation among the Demon Path's cultivators for his arrogant and domineering actions, surviving countless bouts of killing, with tales of him even leveling up during fights, truly a man who becomes stronger the more he fights, undying in all battles.
"Chi Xulong, never thought I'd see you here," a scholarly man with a fair complexion teased Chi Xulong while shaking a paper fan.
Chi Xulong snorted coldly, "Heh, Shen Jinyi, you're a teacher. Why'd you leave your academy to come here? There's no one here in need of your teaching!"
"What?! Is he Shen Jinyi, who specializes in teaching people how to murder efficiently through his academy?!" Hearing Chi Xulong call the scholarly man Shen Jinyi, someone exclaimed and distanced themselves a bit more.
Shen Jinyi indeed was a teacher, but he taught not the classics of Confucian Cultivators, but the efficient methods of covert assassinations.
He had trained countless assassins and was a dreaded figure among the Demon Path's cultivators.
Despite Shen Jinyi's laissez-faire appearance, in reality, if anyone dared to anger him, they would die without knowing how!
"Assassins? Nothing more than a bunch of cowards who dare not show their faces." A swordsman, carrying a broadsword as tall as a man, cornered his mouth into a cold smile, not giving any regard to the assassin Shen Jinyi.
Just as Shen Jinyi was about to retort, he saw the swordsman's face and swallowed his words, only muttering the name 'One Foot Red' through gritted teeth.
'What's your grandpa's name?' One Foot Red mocks Shen Jinyi's murderous gaze, spits disdainfully.
Some from Demon Path's cultivators widened their eyes, the people who had arrived were notorious: "That's One Foot Red, the man who will draw blood within one foot! Rumor says he is invincible in hand-to-hand combat, and even Half Step Golden Core experts don't dare confront him directly."
Besides these three, several other well-known criminals had also arrived. They were on the government office's wanted list, but no one dared to touch them, fearing revenge.
These criminals gathered together, and others with lower cultivation levels, stood far away, not even daring to talk loudly.
Suddenly, the arrival of three men grabbed everyone's attention. One man in the center carried a sword, the man on his left seemed to be a Confucian Cultivator holding a classic book, and the man on his right bore a bright smile, looking like a madman.
The three men were silent, staring straight ahead, ignoring all the Demon Path cultivators, their aura tremendously powerful.
"Who's that? Do you recognize him?"
"No, I don't, but they seem to be pretty important."
The trio walked straight through the crowd to the front, talking of something related to an "Immortal Eternity," then proceeded to open the stone wall. It looked as if they were bringing out tables and chairs from the other side of the stone wall, but actually, they were taking them out of a jade pendant.
Chi Xulong and others speculated, "Being able to open the stone wall, they seem to be from the demonic sect."
After settling down, the man carrying the sword cleared his throat, drawing everyone's attention.
He spoke loudly, "I am Lu Yang, and these two are Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu. We three are the judges for this selection process. The selection for the Eternity Sect will begin now. Line up and report your personal information."

chapters.title: Chapter 67 - 66: It is not suggested for those with inflexible minds to join the demonic sect_1
chapters.content:
The examiner is in command, whether you're Chi Xulong or Guo Jianglong, you'll need to properly stand in line.
If you upset the examiner, are you even thinking about joining the demonic sect?
Don't look at how they are thriving outside. No matter how well you are doing, could you ever be as strong as the demonic sect?
The demonic sect is made up of the master with unfathomable cultivation levels, as well as its disciples who hold great power. They only have themselves and their highest cultivation level is only in the late stage of the foundation establishment.
The three examiners looked unfamiliar, and no one in the crowd had seen them before. However, it is understandable, as the demonic sect is even more mysterious than the individual demon cultivators. It rarely shows itself, so it's perfectly normal for no one to have ever seen them before.
Although the notification was moved up by one hour, no one had any doubts.
This should be one of the tests from the demonic sect. Those who arrive early show dedication to the demonic sect, and those who arrive just on time are not worthy of joining the demonic sect.
Lu Yang propped his leg up, took out a pen and paper, pointing at the first person asked, "Tell me why you want to join the demonic sect. What can you bring to us once you join? What are your plans for yourself? What are your expectations for the allowance?"
"Uh?" The first person was dumbfounded. He was stumped by a series of questions from the get-go. Are these the entrance exam questions for the demonic sect?
Shouldn't it be asking about cultivation levels and techniques, or asking about the bad things that they have done?
Seeing the first person standing tongue-tied, Lu Yang impatiently waved his hand, "Uh, what? You're stuttering in the face of our questions. After you get caught by the government in the future, won't you just spill all the secrets of the demonic sect?"
"You're eliminated, go!"
The second person was the leader of a small gang, who'd been in and out of prison multiple times. He had also reclaimed his gang and wife from his subordinates after getting out of prison, making him a leader with rich experience.
"My name is Niu Mang, the gang leader of the Azure Dragon Gang. I chose to join the demonic sect because I want a good promising future. I share a lot in common with the doctrines of the demonic sect, and I am confident that I can fit in well with the sect. Once I join the demonic sect, I will dutifully commit bad deeds, grow and strengthen the sect to reach more glorified heights!"
"My plan for myself is to do whatever the sect needs me to do without any complaints, because only when the sect is strong can I be strong too!"
"The demonic sect has given me a foothold, how can I still ask for an allowance from the sect? I should be making tributes to the sect!"
Niu Mang got excited as he spoke, even punching into the air, expressing that he will definitely overcome all obstacles and greet a bright future.
He spoke very fluently, as this is how he educated his Azure Dragon gang.
"You are eliminated, leave!"
"Why?" Niu Mang was unconvinced. He felt that his answers were perfect.
Lu Yang scolded harshly, feeling that Niu Mang did not deserve to be a part of the demon cultivators, "What is the demon path? The demon path is about being selfish and egotistical. You serve the demonic sect without seeking returns. How can you be a demon cultivator? As a member of the demonic sect, you should always be thinking about seizing power and rebelling.
What's a demonic sect without internal fights?"
"Besides, didn't you say it yourself? You would do whatever the demonic sect needs you to do. Now, the demonic sect needs to eliminate you, so scram!"
Niu Mang walked away, dejected. The other candidates, after listening, felt enlightened. So this is the philosophy of the demonic sect. It really is worthy of being an examiner because their understanding of the demon path is just too deep.
"Next person." Meng Jingzhou called.
"My name is Chi Xulong, and I'm at the Foundation Establishment Stage." Chi Xulong emphasized his cultivation level, hoping the examiners would take him seriously.
"All right, what bad deeds have you done?"
When asked this question, Chixu had a lot to say, "I was carried away and raised by wolves when I was young. When I was ten, I killed the wolf who abducted me with a bone knife and came down the mountain to live. In the mountains, I took whatever I wanted, and this habit followed me to the city. If I needed something, I just robbed it.
Then the constables started to chase me, and so I continued to rob people on the run. I run really fast so nobody can catch me. I also occasionally kid-take hostages and kill a few people who get in my way."
Chi Xulong was very proud when he told his story. He'd committed so many bad deeds; how could he not qualify to join the demonic sect?
Meng Jingzhou shook his head, "The righteous path is currently very strong, and we on the demon path must act discreetly. Your way of doing things is too ostentatious, and sooner or later you'll get caught. Look at you, so many people know you, then look at the three of us, who knows us? That's the difference!"
"This is not about hiding your face. Rather, it's wisdom to bide your time with a plan and keep a low profile in the market!"
Man Gu curiously looked at Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou. Why did it seem that Brother Lu and Brother Meng were very familiar with the demon path?
After listening to them, Chi Xulong had a moment of enlightenment. Thinking that he had oversimplified the demon path, he voluntarily left.
"My name is Shen Jinyi." Shen Jinyi introduced himself with a smile. After several rounds of questioning, he felt that he finally understood the rules of the other party.
When Man Gu saw that Shen was dressed like a scholar, like himself, a Confucian cultivator, he happily asked a question he had always wondered about, and even the Fourth Elder couldn't answer, "If 'mum' and 'mother' mean the same thing, can I call a 'maiden' 'maiden mother'?"
Shen Jinyi was baffled for a good while. With his forty years of life experience, he didn't know what to say.
He thought that the seemingly simple and discreet examiner on his left hadn't talked all this time and was unremarkable. He didn't expect him to baffle him with the very first question.
Shen Jinyi didn't directly say that he didn't know, but instead said, "I am a killer, not a Confucian cultivator."
"A killer? Have you studied criminal law?" Lu Yang asked with interest.
"I have a modest understanding." Shen Jinyi humbly replied. In truth, he knew a great deal about criminal law, since becoming a killer involved learning how to evade it.
"Then I ask you, according to the criminal law, the definition of intentional homicide is 'a person who deliberately deprives another person of life shall be punished for intentional homicide'."
"Does suicide count as intentional homicide?"
Shen Jinyi was hit with the second baffling question.
Seeing that Shen Jinyi couldn't answer, Lu Yang shook his head in disappointment, "You can't even answer a question in the area you're most expert in. Go home."
Shen Jinyi suffered the biggest setback of his life in just five minutes.
Was this a question a normal person could ask?
"Could it be that only those whose thoughts are different from normal people can join the demonic sect?"
...
This demonic sect entrance exam was a significant affair, so the Rudder Master decided to personally preside over it for peace of mind.
The Rudder Master made a point of arriving half an hour early to prepare in advance.
On his way to the test site, the Rudder Master noticed quite a few fierce-looking people leaving one after another, mumbling things like "The interview was tough", "It's hard to join the demonic sect", "This is the real truth of demon path", "I'll try again in thirty years," and so on. They seemed to have undergone a baptism of enlightenment.
The Rudder Master was deep in thought.
If he hadn't arrived yet, then who was presiding over the exam?
Then, he saw Lu Yang and his two companions, commanding the scene with great ease.

chapters.title: Chapter 68 - 67: We all Think for the Good of the Demonic Sect_1
chapters.content:
The Rudder Master, as the highest Cultivator within the rudder, had received systematic training at the headquarters, learning the true essence of the Demon Path. What kind of situation hadn't he seen before?
This was a situation he had genuinely never seen before.
If the Manager had prepared everything in advance out of consideration for him, he could understand and would even feel comforted.
But what on earth were these three up to? Where did they pop up from?
The Rudder Master figured out the issue, his gaze cold enough to kill. These three were imposters posing as examiners to eliminate their competitors beforehand.
"What a great tactic!" The Rudder Master spoke through gritted teeth.
While continuing their charade of being examiners, Lu Yang put his legs up on the table: "If you're not going to bribe us, then how do you expect to pass the examination? Next."
The next person, respectful and dutiful, took out a Spirit Stone as a token of respect for the three supposed examiners. Meng Jingzhou accepted it but felt it was a bit stingy, so he asked, "Do you have any experience joining the demonic sect?"
"None."
"Oh, sorry, we don't accept individuals with no experience. You may leave now."
"..." The poor examinee felt that the only thing missing was a sign on the fake examiners that read, "We are not hiring."
The Rudder Master appeared behind the three like a ghost, cold air billowing from between his teeth, a full display of his Golden Core Stage aura. With one slap, he sent the three of them flying into the wall: "You three have some nerve, posing as examiners here!"
If he had arrived a bit later, all the candidates would have been gone!
Lu Yang peeled himself off the wall and hurriedly said, "Sir, it's a misunderstanding! We are sincerely considering the interests of the demonic sect!"
The Rudder Master, amused by their audacity, asked, "Well, why don't you tell me how you've been considering the interests of the demonic sect?"
"Sir, a Cultivator of the Demon Path should always be suspicious and ask more questions. No one should be too easily trusted. Look at these people here, they simply believed we were the examiners without a single doubt."
"To be so easily deceived, doesn't that mean they can easily be tricked by others? If a clever person from the Righteous Path decided to trick them, they'd likely believe every single one."
"Moreover, only Cultivators from the Righteous Path would believe everything they hear so readily. I even suspect that among these people, there are moles from the Righteous Path. Sir, you must thoroughly investigate their identities, we can't let Cultivators from the Righteous Path infiltrate us!"
As he spoke, Lu Yang gave a suspicious glance at the crowd, as though he was sure that there were spies among them.
Lu Yang spoke so convincingly and sincerely, it was as if he were genuinely considering the interests of the Rudder Master.
This slightly softened the Rudder Master's expression.
What Meng Jingzhou said was even more earnest than Lu Yang, it sounded like his sincere thoughts:"Furthermore, Cultivators of the Demon Path are selfish and only think about themselves. With so many people coming to take part in the trial, we naturally have to find ways to reduce our competition!"
"If they are less skillful and easily fooled, whom can they blame but themselves? They can only blame themselves for not being experienced enough at trickery!"
The Rudder Master's eyebrows unfurled, he felt like this was their true sentiments.
Right, Cultivators of the Demon Path should be lawless, leave no stone unturned. Back when he joined the demonic sect, he used every trick in the book to gain the favor of the higher-ups and achieve his current position.
These three were indeed more skillful than he was back in the day, surpassing the master.
What Man Gu said was the most straightforward, stating, "We sincerely want to join the demonic sect, and promise that we won't do anything good!"
The Rudder Master nodded subtly, thinking that this trio might also gain favor from the higher-ups, which would elevate the status of Yanjiang Rudder.
The crowd glared fiercely at the trio. They were all well-known rogues, rascals, and swindlers in the world, but none were as shameless as these three, who tricked people so ruthlessly!
If the Rudder Master wasn't present, they would have swarmed up to tear these damn bastards apart!
The Rudder Master didn't care about the thoughts of the people below, a bunch of mediocrities. How could they compare to these three in terms of value?
"What is your Cultivation Level?"
Lu Yang respectfully answered, "We're all in the Early Stage of Foundation Establishment. We three brothers are from out of town. A month ago, we came to Yanjiang County and heard that the demonic sect was recruiting. So, we decided to give it a try. Seeing so many competitors, we had to resort to this tactic."
"You did well." The Rudder Master's satisfaction with the three grew. These were promising seeds, essentially his achievements.
With just a casual wave of his hand earlier, any ordinary cultivator in the Early Stage of Foundation Establishment would have been injured. But these three didn't seem hurt at all, which showed their exceptional abilities.
If these three show promise during the trial, promoting them to the position of Manager wouldn't be out of the question.
Those who got eliminated by Lu Yang gradually returned, dragged back by the Rudder Master on his return.
Those who had been eliminated harbored more hatred towards Lu Yang than the others. Lu Yang felt that if he killed them all at that moment, they might instantly turn into vengeful spirits.
The Rudder Master reopened the stone wall, saying to everyone, "All of you, enter."
Behind the stone wall was a vast and dark space. Gigantic rocks floated in mid-air, connected by chains, making quite a spectacle.
Lu Yang's suspicions were confirmed; Yanjiang Rudder was inside a Cave Heaven.
The Rudder Master's attitude toward the three was clearly different from the others: "You three thought very well, wanting to elbow your competitors out of the way. You did a commendable job, but you were wrong from the beginning. Pushing these people out, or even if only you three were to take part in the trial, doesn't necessarily mean you'd pass."
"What do you mean?" The three of them were puzzled.
The Rudder Master behind the mask just smiled and didn't answer, stepping onto the floating stone and leading everyone to the largest floating stone.
It was a flat platform with intricate and exquisite patterns carved into the ground. Four ancient stone pillars stood at the cardinal directions, with eleven Managers draped in black robes each overseeing their posts at the platform's edges.
"Please take a seat randomly and relax."
After everyone did as instructed, the Rudder Master came to the center of the platform. In the middle hovered a piece of emerald-green stone inscribed with dense, mysterious symbols.
The Rudder Master channeled spiritual energy into the stone, activating the Array Method beneath him. The Array Method began to rotate, expand, duplicate and increase, spreading throughout the entire platform instantly.
The platform seemed like an awakening ancient beast, taking everyone to an unknown space with its mysterious power born out of an ancient era.
In the immaculate space, shadowy figures stood around, looking confused and uncertain about what had just happened.
Whenever Lu Yang saw such a white space, he couldn't help but suspect that a "Tofu Heaven Sovereign" might suddenly appear amongst the crowd.
Lu Yang noticed that Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu were not beside him; he was surrounded by strangers.
"Brother, where are you from?" Lu Yang asked with an air of familiarity, however, his enthusiasm seemed a bit too much for the other person.
The man felt it would be rude to remain silent, so he answered, "From Huangyue City."
Lu Yang proceeded to ask several more people only to realize they all hailed from different bases of the demonic sect, and had all been transported here via the giant array method.
Lu Yang gradually understood the Rudder Master's implied meaning. The selection this time was not confined to individual bases, but organized by the headquarters. All of the independent cultivators from the Demon Path were presented to participate in the selection at the same time.
"This feels like a Yin Soul out of the Body, yet also different." Lu Yang murmured. He believed that the platform had not transported their true forms, but rather something akin to their consciousness.
"It's intriguing. I wonder if Eldest Senior Sister could..." Lu Yang abruptly halted his thoughts. If this was indeed a state of consciousness, perhaps the Eternity Sect had a way to detect his thoughts.
Better to be cautious.
Suddenly, the whole space dimmed, and a glowing silhouette appeared in the air.
All they heard was a tranquil voice saying, "I am the Vice-Master of the Eternity Sect, I've set up three trials for all of you to take. Those who pass all three trials may join our sect."

chapters.title: Chapter 69 - 68 Correct Way to Clear the Level_1
chapters.content:
The crowd was stirred up, surprised that the Eternity Sect was taking this selection process so severely that even the deputy sect leader showed up.
The deputy leaders of the Four Great Devil Sects were notable figures in the entire Central Continent and seeing one of them is a rarity.
Lu Yang didn't feel much about it, they were just on par with the elders of Seek Dao Sect, it's not like he hasn't seen them before.
"Your current forms are merely a representation of your consciousness, your actual bodies remain where they are. After the formal trial, your cultivation levels and memories will disappear, putting everyone on the same starting line."
The sect head places great emphasis on this trial. In the great era, the most important thing is talent!
If they possess the single spiritual root, a natural immortal body, or innate demonic seeds, then they would have a chance to compete against the Righteous Path!
For this reason, he had the deputy sect leader meticulously design three trials to select the real geniuses!
To prevent cheating, the sect's secret methods were employed to erased everyone's cultivation levels and memories. Only then can their true abilities be reflected.
"The first trial officially begins, and the requirement for passing the trial is to defeat the army of the Liang Kingdom."
After the deputy sect leader finished speaking, the crowd felt dizzy, unable to distinguish directions. When they regained their senses, they couldn't remember anything.
...
"Where am I?" Man Gu felt lightheaded when he recovered from the disorientation.
His hair was disheveled, he held a broken sword in his hand, and his armor was smeared with blood.
Man Gu took a few steps and almost stumbled. His guard quickly steadied him, "General, get on the horse quickly, now is not the time to talk about honor, the army of Liang Kingdom is about to catch up!"
During his escape on horseback, memories related to the trial gradually flooded into Man Gu's mind.
"There are two countries here, Liang Kingdom and Jin State, both are mortal enemies, striving to defeat each other. Jin State is less powerful than Liang Kingdom, and I am now the general of Jin State, commanding the entire Jin state army."
"I was careless this time, fell for the enemy's trap, I need to pull myself together, make a comeback, and defeat Liang Kingdom!"
Man Gu forgot that this was a trial, he only remembered that he was Jin State's undefeated general. He must defeat Liang Kingdom and protect his own country.
In addition to background memories, his combat experience also flooded into his mind. Now, Man Gu had completely become the undefeated general of Jin State.
Unfortunately, despite Man Gu's rich experience, the general of Liang Kingdom was equally experienced. In their confrontations, Man Gu suffered numerous defeats.
Man Gu had a high reputation in the army. The soldiers trusted Man Gu, they believed that setbacks were temporary and that General Man Gu would surely lead them to victory.
Man Gu failed again. Despite his honesty and combat experience, he couldn't apply it effectively in practice and continually fell into the traps set by the general of Liang Kingdom.
"Huff, huff, huff..." Man Gu fled in disgrace to a mountain cave. This defeat was disastrous. Ditching his helmet and armor was the greatest humiliation of his life.
The bleakness of the wind and rain outside accentuated his desolation.
Man Gu thought about the soldiers' trust in him, about the blows from his repeated failures. He looked down at the broken sword in his hand, wishing he could end his life there and then!
Death would absolve him of everything, regardless of failures, or Jin State, none of it would matter anymore!
Suddenly, a spider caught his attention.
The spider looked peculiar, something Man Gu had never seen before.
The spider was spinning its web. The wind and rain from outside the cave blew in, breaking the web several times.
Each time the web was broken, the spider would start over, showing no signs of despondence.
Watching the spider fail over and over again, and yet continuously try, Man Gu saw himself in the spider!
"You will succeed!" Man Gu stared at the spider, hope gradually welling up in his eyes.
If the spider was so persistent, as a human, wasn't his will even stronger than that of the spider?
Finally, after countless failures, the spider had successfully spun its web.
Man Gu jumped up, his fighting spirit reignited. If the spider could succeed, so could he!
A fierce fire was set ablaze in Man Gu's heart, ready to rally his forces and counter-attack Liang Kingdom!
"Huh?"
Man Gu inadvertently glanced at the spider, intending to thank it for its encouragement. However, to his surprise, a mantis suddenly appeared and killed the spider.
Man Gu's first instinct was to crush the mantis out of anger, but then he realized that the spider's situation was very similar to his own. After success, it let down its guard, forgetting the hidden dangers.
A thought dawned upon him: "Yes, determination is indeed important, but strategy is also imperative. Striking when the enemy is off guard, brings the element of surprise!"
In the end, Man Gu deceived Liang Kingdom with minor victories and launched a surprise attack with his hidden forces. In one fell swoop, he crushed the main forces of Liang Kingdom's army and achieved a complete victory.
Man Gu passed the trial.
...
At the headquarters of the Eternity Sect, the serene water reflected everyone's performance during the first trial. The deputy sect leader observed their performance and provided evaluations.
"So, any good prospects?" The space distorted, and the sect master appeared. "This first trial you created wasn't easy to pass. In the face of continuous failure, one not only has to understand persistence from the spider but also the principle of taking advantage of unpreparedness from the mantis."
The deputy sect leader shook his head: "It's essential. The Righteous Path is suppressing us, the evil sects continue to fail, and some people within our sect are already thinking of backing down. Our experiences are very similar to Jin State, and I want to use this trial to select dedicated followers with firm determination, cultivate talents, and fight against the Righteous Path!"
"To fight against the Righteous Path, we can't rely solely on determination, we also need tactics. If one does not learn how to spar with the spider and mantis, how can they achieve victory?"
The sect master nodded: "Correct, your words are very well put, and it is why I let you initiate this selection. The exemplary followers selected from this process will be cultivated as a priority. They will be our reserve force to counter the Righteous Path!"
The deputy sect leader pointed to one of the scenes and said: "I have my eye on this Man Gu, his method of passing the trial aligned perfectly with my intention. This person has great future potential!"
The sect master glanced at Man Gu and found him pleasing to the eye. He said: " Let's continue watching the others' performances."
The sect master and deputy sect leader stood together, after a while the sect master suddenly asked: "Do you think there is a possibility that there could be other ways to pass the trial?"
The deputy sect leader quickly dismissed the idea, speaking emphatically: "Absolutely not!"
"The first trial was a fragment I cut out from history. Liang Kingdom and Jin State were just a corner of the chaotic world a hundred thousand years ago. At that time, there were not as many cultivators as now, Liang Kingdom and Jin State had even fewer cultivators. On this basis, I elaborated and ensured the maximum authenticity."
For the Eternity Sect to extricate this segment from history, a large amount of resources was devoted, a sight that made the deputy sect leader ache.
"The general of Jin State in history realized enlightenment in the cave, and defeated the army of the Liang Kingdom!"
"This was a miracle in the first place, I don't believe there are other ways!"
The sect master nodded. He thought the same way, only raised the question earlier because he found the silence awkward and wanted to find something to chat about.
Then, they saw how Meng Jingzhou and Lu Yang passed the trial.

chapters.title: Chapter 70 - 69 Wrong Way to Clear the Level_1
chapters.content:
The Jin State's army had suffered too many failures, causing even someone like Meng Jingzhou to fall into despair, feeling it impossible to achieve victory.
"Can I really win?" Meng Jingzhou sat in a cave and questioned his heart, finding the answer bitter and hard to voice.
"Hmm, a spider?" Meng Jingzhou noticed a spider spinning a web.
The spider's continuous attempts despite numerous failures left a deep impression on him.
"If a spider keeps battling after each defeat, can't I do better than a spider?"
Meng Jingzhou felt greatly inspired, gathering his morale to fight the Liang Kingdom once again!
"Liang's army is stronger, but the gap is not insurmountable. How can I give up after just a few setbacks? If I do, what will become of Jin State behind me?"
"I believe we can win this time, as long as we strategize correctly!" Meng Jingzhou clenched his fists tightly, his heart already filled with a plan.
After a few failures, he had familiarized himself with the tactics of the general of the Liang Kingdom. Believing that the Liang general's confidence had grown due to his victories, he planned to pretend to be beaten, make a hasty retreat and lure the Liang's army into a canyon, then surround them.
This time, he would definitely catch them off guard and meet the expectations of the people of Jin State!
"Thank you for your guidance." Meng Jingzhou thanked the spider with a fist salute. Without the inspiration from the spider, he would have been utterly crushed, eliminating all hope of victory.
There were many insects in the cave. To show his gratitude, Meng Jingzhou caught an insect and put it next to the spider.
However, the spider seemed to not understand Meng Jingzhou's intentions and mistook him for an enemy, biting him.
"A venomous spider..."
Meng Jingzhou felt dizzy and passed out.
After an unknown period of time, maybe a few minutes or a dozen minutes but not too long, Meng Jingzhou awoke feeling stronger than ever.
"What's happening to me?"
Meng Jingzhou felt a transformation occurring within his body. His eyesight, hearing, and senses were all improving, and his body was more flexible than ever before, as if he were reborn.
The ring and pinky fingers on his right hand moved unconsciously, and a white thread shot out from his wrist.
"!!!"
"What the hell is this?"
The white thread stuck to the wall; Meng Jingzhou tugged at it and realized it was extremely tough.
"Is this like a spider's silk?"
Meng Jingzhou put his hands on the wall and was surprised to find that his hands could stick to it, making it easy to scale walls.
"I remember I was bitten by the spider... Wait, where is the spider?" By the time Meng Jingzhou had located the spider, it had been killed by a mantis.
Meng Jingzhou stepped on the mantis, avenging the spider's death.
He inherited the spider's will, reorganized the army, and prepared for another battle with the army of the Liang Kingdom.
On the night before the decisive battle, wearing a suit for night activities and relying on his newly acquired strength, he carried out a solo beheading mission, killing the general of the Liang Kingdom.
The Liang general was dumbfounded. As fellow generals, shouldn't they have faced off on the battlefield for a final battle? Why did Meng Jingzhou directly aim for the ultimate goal—killing the general?
The Liang general had cultivator bodyguards, but they weren't as nimble as Meng Jingzhou. Meng Jingzhou successfully killed the Liang general.
The Liang general was a tactical genius rarely seen in military circles. After his death, the Liang army found themselves without a leader. Meng Jingzhou led the Jin army to crush the Liang's forces.
Meng Jingzhou passed the test.
...
At the Eternity Sect's headquarters, the Master and Deputy Master looked at Meng Jingzhou's method of passing the test and were silent for a long time.
The second method of passing the test had indeed emerged.
The Master rubbed his eyebrows: "What's the deal with this spider? How can a bite grant someone the powers of a spider?"
"Could it be that if I bit a spider, the spider would mutate?"
The Deputy Master was stunned too. He pondered for a while, as if thinking about something. He then took out a book from his storage ring and pointed to a section of text, saying, "Found it. According to ancient records, there was a special kind of spider in the Central Continent. It had the same strength as an average spider and never bit humans. However, anyone who was bitten by it would mutate."
"This type of spider became extinct tens of thousands of years ago."
The Deputy Master logically analyzed: "The war between the Jin State and Liang Kingdom took place a hundred thousand years ago. We perfectly recreated the scenario at that time. So theoretically, it's possible for this unique spider to appear in the cave."
The Master nodded, "It seems this Meng Jingzhou not only has persistence and an active mind, but also good luck."
Luck is something elusive, probably only the legendary 'Technique of Observation' can actually evaluate how much luck a person has.
But it can be somewhat reflected from other aspects. For instance, Meng Jingzhou, among so many people going through this test, was the only one bitten by the spider and mutated, which shows that his fortune is extraordinary.
Those with exceptional luck have a smooth cultivation path and can achieve great success in the future.
"Let's see if there is a third way to pass the test."
...
Lu Yang observed the spider that was tirelessly building and failing its web, falling into deep thought.
"Spiders can catch prey with their webs, so why did the plan to catch a rabbit fail? Isn't it the same strategy to stay in one place and wait for the prey? What's the difference?"
"Is it because insects are brainless and just blunder into the web, while rabbits are clever and avoid trees?"
"If insects are brainless, that means spiders are too. So is the spider's incessant attempts after countless failures a manifestation of willpower or just a fool's persistence?"
"Even a rabbit knows not to run into a tree, so why do some people not turn back until they hit a wall?"
Lu Yang let his thoughts wander, contemplating deeply over these questions.
After experiencing failure, he wasn't discouraged. He was merely sheltering in the cave from the rain while pondering strategies to defeat the enemy.
Now, upon observing the spider building its web, he thinks about seemingly profound questions that, in actuality, hold no real importance.
Suddenly, a mantis appeared, launching a surprise attack on the unsuspecting spider. Despite the spider putting up a strong resistance using its web, the agile and fierce mantis killed it after a few rounds.
Witnessing this process, Lu Yang thoughtfully stood up and recalled the mantis's movements.
He mimicked the mantis's adept use of its two flexible forelimbs and its nimble leaps in executing the movements.
"Imagine myself as a mantis..." Lu Yang muttered to himself, feeling as though he had naturally inherited a similar skillset.
Lu Yang, like a human-shaped mantis, was a mixture of firmness and flexibility, brave and swift. Any opponent would fall under his fists.
The historically recorded general of the Jin State's cultivation level was at the mid-stage of Qi Refinement, a stage which Lu Yang had also inherited.
Upon reaching a certain level, he transformed himself directly into a giant mantis. A swift attack from his forelimbs was powerful enough to tear down the cave.
Lu Yang sighed in awe, "So this is the legendary Mantis Fist of the martial arts world? Its power is tremendous, but it's too complex for ordinary people to learn."
Lu Yang simplified the Mantis Fist, making it simple and easy to learn. He widely promoted it in his army, significantly enhancing the Jin army's combat power and making them superior to the Liang's forces. They didn't need a strategic plan and went all the way head-on.
Lu Yang passed the test.
...
"Who would pass the test like this!" The Deputy Master yelled in anger.

chapters.title: Chapter 71 - 70: The 2nd Test (Thanks to book friend 'Tianqiong Yunhai' for the reward, add more for 'Calm Life' Alliance Chief)
chapters.content:
"Who's practicing Mantis Fist like that?!" The vice-master goggled, familiar with the Mantis Fist—a boxing style emulating the praying mantis.
It was meant to imitate a mantis, not turn into one!
He had scrutinized the standards of this test multiple times, even asking a few clever higher-ups in the sect to confirm that there could be no other solution besides the answer he had provided.
Yet now, two answers outside the standard had appeared. He couldn't accept this!
The Master, however, seemed more receptive, "Think of it this way. He only observed a mantis for a while before gaining insight into the Mantis Fist. Even historical generals from Jin State didn't possess such martial talent. This speaks volumes about Lu Yang's exceptional martial talent.
He eventually reached the advanced realm of entering the Dao through martial skills, turning his martial arts into a magic skill. He's a talent that is hard to come by!"
The vice-master paused, then turned to the earnest-looking master and asked, "Are you serious?"
In his heart, the Master thought that he was just making stuff up. In fact, he also didn't understand how Lu Yang had transformed from a human into a mantis. But as the Master, he couldn't show ignorance in front of his subordinates.
Nodding, he reaffirmed, "Of course, I am serious."
After the Master's explanation, the vice-master felt a little better. Since the participants were rare talents, it made sense that they would fortuitously discover alternative solutions.
He could accept that begrudgingly.
"All who passed have done so. Let's bring the first test to an end." said the vice-master. Tens of thousands of images on the water screen recorded everyone's performance.
Only a few people gained perseverance from the spiders and even fewer derived strategy from the mantis. Most were depressed in the cave, becoming deserters, killed in tumults by soldiers from Liang Kingdom. They died nameless and unknown, with the soldiers unaware they had once been ambitious.
"Begin the second test."
...
"The second test requires you to convince the examiner to genuinely want to keep you."
Everyone had these words embedded in their minds. They forgot everything else, focusing only on thinking of ways to pass the second test.
Yan Wangsun felt a little dizzy. He had no recollection of the previous events. All he vaguely remembered was a somewhat familiar person asking him where he is from. He told them he is from Huangyue City.
"I'm Yan Wangsun. I'm applying for a position at the Land Money Trade Association which requires passing an interview. The rules of the interview forbid disclosing the questions to others." Yan Wangsun gathered up all the facts he knew.
Even without the rules, Yan Wangsun wouldn't disclose the interview questions to anyone else. It only benefits others at his own expense.
Yan Wangsun realized he was sitting in the first position, next to him was a man in scholar's robes.
"I'm Man Gu, what's your name?"
Yan Wangsun didn't answer because the examiner was calling his name.
Upon entering the room, Yan Wangsun noticed a piece of paper on the floor. He casually threw it into the trash bin before preparing for his interview.
The examiner was chubby, his clothes straining against his bulk, always wearing a warm smile: "Yan Wangsun, isn't it? Can you go to the market and see if anyone is selling potatoes?"
Yan Wangsun obediently left. After having a look around the market, he reported back saying there was a shop selling potatoes.
The chubby examiner then asked: "How many potatoes are there?"
Left with no other choice, Yan Wangsun made a second trip, reporting back, "There are eighty catties worth of potatoes."
"What's the price?"
Yan Wangsun cursed in his heart that the chubby examiner should have asked everything at once. On his third trip, he got the price, "Three Wen per catty."
"How is the quality of the potatoes? Is it worth the price?"
Disguising his annoyance, Yan Wangsun went out for the fourth time to examine the potatoes. "The potato quality is average, worth about three to four Wen. It's not overpriced."
The chubby examiner cheerily proclaimed, "You've been eliminated."
"On what grounds!" Yan Wangsun was furious. He had been led around four times by the chubby examiner, hustling each time. It was half a day's work of running about. Now he was telling him he had failed?
Was he being toyed with?
The chubby examiner shrugged, "You took four trips for a trivial matter about potatoes. How can I trust you with responsibilities?"
"Well, why didn't you ask all the questions at once!"
The examiner shook his head, "You're the one who didn't handle it thoroughly. How can you blame me for not asking all at once? Young man, in work, you need to learn to anticipate your superiors' intentions."
"Pah, do you think you are an emperor, asking for anticipation?"
The examiner didn't get upset, "Even though you failed, you can still stay."
Yan Wangsun looked skeptically at the chubby examiner, afraid he was going to be played with again, "Really?"
"Do you remember the piece of paper you picked up at the entrance? I intentionally left it there to see who would pick it up."
Yan Wangsun was elated, thinking that this was a test of his responsibility and observational skills.
"We happen to need someone in charge of cleanliness. You can stay and be responsible for cleaning."
Yan Wangsun: "....."
Yan Wangsun wanted to curse, but he didn't say anything. Regardless, being able to stay meant he had passed the test, which was a good thing.
"Next!" The chubby examiner shouted.
Man Gu walked into the room. Yan Wangsun watched him with disdain, feeling that the man would definitely be toyed with by the examiner, just like himself.
"Go see if there are any potatoes for sale in the market." The chubby examiner asked the same question.
Man Gu acknowledged him and left. He returned after over ten minutes.
"There's an old man pushing a cart in the marketplace, selling potatoes. He has eighty catties of potatoes, priced at three Wen per catty. The quality of the potatoes matches the price. The old man also said that if you buy a lot of potatoes, the price can be reduced by ten percent..."
Man Gu's answer was incredibly detailed, covering even points the chubby examiner hadn't considered. Standing to one side, Yan Wangsun was stunned.
Despite Man Gu's bulky size, he was actually rather sensitive and considerate. He excelled in learning from others, especially Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
Looking at his current situation, there still seemed to be a long way to go until graduation.
"Congratulations, you have been selected."
...
"See, I told you so, Man Gu's a good seedling." The vice-master watched Man Gu pass the test again, and felt quite pleased. It proved that his approach to the test had been correct.
Others ran back and forth twice to answer all four questions from the examiner, which barely qualified.
Only Man Gu perfectly aligned with his thought process.
The master nodded, "It seems that the second test is examining thoroughness in carrying out tasks and the ability to consider things from the superior's perspective."
Members of the Demon Path have to handle matters meticulously to avoid leaving any loose ends that the Righteous Path can exploit.
Besides, you can only demonstrate your potential for promotion if you can take your superiors' needs into account. Senior members would then consider promoting you.
These were the considerations the vice-master had in mind when designing the second test.
"This time, there surely won't be any other solution." The vice-master pleasedly laughed.
Without uttering a word, the master turned his gaze towards the two individuals who had performed exceptionally in the first round.
His intuition told him there might be another solution.

chapters.title: Chapter 72 - 71 Sincerity (Thanks to the generous donation from the alliance of Brother Stay-at-home) _1
chapters.content:
"So the second challenge is to make the examiner sincerely want to keep me?" Meng Jingzhou repeated the condition of passing the challenge in his mind.
"What a strange test. Sounds like it wouldn't be too difficult."
"But where am I?" Meng Jingzhou was sitting in a row of seats, with four people in front and five behind him. He was right in the middle of this group of ten.
"Oh, so I'm participating in a job interview." The scenario given to him by the Eternity Sect popped into his mind.
Meng Jingzhou looked at the immaculate wall opposite and his right hand moved unconsciously, bending his middle and ring fingers.
Nothing happened.
"Huh? Why would I do such a strange action?" Meng Jingzhou was perplexed, as this was an unfamiliar habit to him.
"Never mind, I should focus on the interview."
Meng Jingzhou noticed the first person rush into the room where the examiner was, then rush back out. This sequence repeated three or four times.
Meng Jingzhou enthusiastically called out, "Hey man, why are you running so much? Is the examiner testing your running speed? If so, I suggest that you change your shoes. The quality of shoes can greatly affect your speed. Also, your running posture. You should squat down, hands on the ground, and arch your body.
Trust me, I have experience ..."
The fellow looked at Meng Jingzhou as if he were an idiot, ignored him, and continued to examine the quality of the potatoes.
The rules clearly state candidates cannot disclose the questions to each other.
The first, second, third, fourth, every person ran back and forth eagerly. None of them passed the challenge. Regardless of whether or not they passed, after the interview, they were immediately dismissed. The subsequent candidates had no way to determine whether passing involved more or fewer rounds.
"Next, Meng Jingzhou!" The stout examiner called out from inside.
"Here I am." Meng Jingzhou entered the room with a confident gait.
The examiner asked with his usual friendly smile, "Meng Jingzhou, could you go to the market and check if anyone is selling potatoes there? "
Meng Jingzhou remained motionless.
The examiner, assuming that his question might not have been clear, repeated it word for word.
This time Meng Jingzhou responded, "Why?"
"Why, what?" The examiner couldn't keep up with Meng Jingzhou's line of thought.
"I'm asking why I should go to the market to check if anyone is selling potatoes. Do you know what we're doing right now?"
"We're having an interview, aren't we?" The examiner blurted out, thinking this was obvious.
"Exactly. You said it yourself, this is an interview, not your delivery service. Besides, didn't you ask the previous four candidates the same thing? "
"You've asked the same question four times and you're still not satisfied? Want to go for a fifth?"
The examiner patiently explained, "This is part of the test."
Meng Jingzhou obediently went to the market and returned, "Yes, there are potatoes for sale."
"How many potatoes are there?"
Thinking he didn't know the answer, Meng Jingzhou stood up, prepared to leave. The examiner sneered inwardly, 'With this chatty kid's constant running around, the moment he comes back again, I'll declare him a failure.'
But when Meng Jingzhou opened the door, he found an old man standing there. He asked the old man: "How many potatoes do you have on your cart?"
The old man replied: "Eighty pounds."
Meng Jingzhou turned back, "He says he has eighty pounds of potatoes. Are you also interested in how much it costs per pound?"
The examiner was taken aback, not able to ask 'how much is it per pound', since the old man could immediately answer.
So why bother asking anything else?
"How did you manage to bring the potato seller here?!" the examiner yelled in anger. How was he supposed to conduct the remainder of the exam?
Meng Jingzhou shrugged: "I asked him if several people had run over to inspect his potatoes. The old man complained that a few had run over to glance at his potatoes and then ran back. Again, they ran over to ask how many pounds of potatoes he had and ran back. They even came back to ask the price per pound, only asking, never buying."
"I asked him if he wanted to meet the prime culprit who kept asking but never buying. He said he would like to, so I brought him along."
The examiner was speechless. He had never encountered such a situation before and wasn't sure how to proceed.
Annoyed by Meng Jingzhou's disrespect, the examiner shouted, "You fail for not being able to guess my..."
Before he could finish, Meng Jingzhou kicked him: "To hell with your intentions, you fat-faced git!"
With that, Meng Jingzhou bolted out of the room.
The examiner angrily slammed his palm on the table, shattering it. "Stop right there!"
The examiner sincerely wanted to keep Meng Jingzhou, hence, Meng Jingzhou passed the challenge.
...
The Deputy Master rubbed his temples in agony. What a peculiar way of passing the challenge!
He had required the examiners to genuinely want to keep the applicants to prevent any from taking shortcuts or bribing the examiners.
He felt like he had thought this through, but didn't anticipate such an unconventional way to pass the challenge.
It's not just that the examiner genuinely wanted to keep Meng Jingzhou, he genuinely wished to tear Meng Jingzhou apart.
What on earth was the thought process of this young man? Or was it him who was in the wrong?
"Immortal Eternity, please grant me an answer." The Deputy Master muttered a prayer to Immortal Eternity, hoping for a response.
The Master interrupted his Deputy's prayer, "If only Immortal Eternity could hear you."
The Deputy Master didn't find the Master's words disrespectful, knowing that the Master was the most devout disciple in Eternity Sect, he sighed: "We've tried so many times and failed. We still haven't managed to resurrect Immortal Eternity. If we could, who cares about the Great Xia Dynasty or the Righteous Path? None of them could hold a candle to Immortal Eternity!"
"Only with a blood sacrifice, can we resurrect Immortal Eternity."
The two of them did not further discuss this topic, the Deputy Master asked: "What do you think of this Meng Jingzhou?"
The Master pondered: "He's unlike any ordinary person. Truly a talented individual."
The Master thought to himself, 'Good thing I didn't agree with the Deputy, saying for sure there wouldn't be any other ways to pass, or where would I put my Master face.'
"This kid counts as a talent?"
"Of course, I think the Eternity Sect needs such out-of-the-box thinkers."
"Look at the Seek Dao Sect from the Righteous Path, the reason why they have been able to exist for so long, is mainly because they possess wisdom beyond normal comprehension."
The Deputy Master's mouth twitched. He thought to himself that only the Master could describe madness in such a refined manner.
The Master continued: "Perhaps this individual named Meng Jingzhou might turn out to be a mainstay or even a pillar for our Eternity Sect."
"Speaking of Meng Jingzhou, there was this young man who stood out in the first challenge, I think his name is Lu Yang. How did he perform?"
...
"Have the examiner sincerely keep me?"
Lu Yang pondered, "That's not difficult; just give the examiner a kick. Better yet, spit at him. It'll piss him off for sure. They'll want to keep me and even express the desire to see me dead."
"However, this method is too crude. Only a boor like Meng Jingzhou would use it. I'm a civilized person, I can't stoop to his level."

chapters.title: Chapter 73 - 72: The Three Heroes of the Demonic Sect (Thanks to the two book-friends, Small-chested Loli and Immortal Qitian for their tips) _1
chapters.content:
Among the ten interviewees, Lu Yang was the sixth. He noticed that the candidates before him would run out as soon as they entered the examiner's room, sprint out at one hundred meters per second, then run back again, repeating this back-and-forth process several times.
"What kind of weird test is this?"
Lu Yang is the restless type. The rules state that candidates are not allowed to ask about the interview content, but it doesn't say he can't go outside to take a look.
He asked a demon cultivator next to him who was meditating with his eyes closed, "Do you want to go outside and take a look?"
The demon cultivator glanced contemptuously at Lu Yang and sneered, without saying anything.
Demon cultivators acting collectively? He must be trying to trick me. No way, I'm not going.
Seeing the man's silence, Lu Yang felt pity for him.
He's quite handsome, but it's a shame he's deaf. I wonder what he will do during the interview if he can't hear what the examiner says?
Since no one was responding, Lu Yang went outside.
Outside was a bustling market with vendors selling fruits, eggs, pork... Any commonly seen food could be found here. The sellers either had a stall or pushed a small cart while hawking their goods.
"Get me an apple," Lu Yang bought an apple, rubbed it clean and started eating. While munching, he observed the interviewees' behaviors.
The third one happened to run outside looking for potatoes. As soon as he found some, he immediately ran back to report it to the examiner.
Less than three minutes later, he again came out to ask the potato seller how much a pound of potatoes costs and how many pounds he had in total.
Another three minutes passed, the same third person ran out to inspect the quality of the potatoes.
The same happened for the fourth person; the only difference was that he ran four times, proving he was not as mentally agile as the third person.
Eating his apple, Lu Yang pondered deeply.
...
"Next, Fang Hao," the chubby examiner called out.
Fang Hao was the same person Lu Yang asked to go outside with earlier.
"Here!" To everyone's surprise, Fang Hao wasn't mute.
"Go to the market and see if there are any potatoes for sale," The chubby examiner repeated his trick.
Fang Hao hurriedly ran out and didn't return for quite a while, which puzzled the examiner.
Just when the examiner was about to lose patience, Fang Hao rushed back in and said, "There are no potatoes for sale in the market."
"How many pounds of potatoes... Wait, what did you say? There are no potatoes?"
Fang Hao didn't understand why the examiner was so shocked. He nodded and said, "Yes, I checked twice and I'm sure there are no potatoes for sale."
"That's impossible!" The examiner felt like he was being fooled, so he hurriedly ran out with Fang Hao following behind.
As soon as the examiner stepped outside, he saw Lu Yang pushing a cart full of potatoes with a sign saying "Potatoes not for sale."
The old man who was supposed to be the potato vendor was happily counting his money on the side.
As soon as Lu Yang saw the examiner, he started running with the potatoes. The examiner was furious - the potatoes were running away with the rest of the interview pending.
"Stop right there!"
Lu Yang passed the test.
...
"This is outrageous!" The vice headmaster exploded in rage. His rampant and terrifying aura spread out, shaking the entire hall. The water in the pool rippled, obscuring the view of the scene.
The test he had so meticulously designed was full of loopholes because of these two troublemakers. It was utterly humiliating!
The headmaster calmly suppressed the vice headmaster's aura. It wasn't easy to build such a magnificent hall in a place where it wouldn't easily be discovered. It would certainly become a joke if it was found out by the righteous path just because of this.
The headmaster advised, "Don't be so quick to anger. They just forgot everything, only remembering to do whatever they can to pass the test. We are the demonic sect, advocating for immortality through killing. Can we really kill someone over something like this?"
"Besides, these two took an unconventional approach. They are rare talents. The Eternity Sect hasn't made any major breakthroughs since its establishment. I think these two could be our hope."
The vice headmaster thought that there was no hope for the Eternity Sect.
The headmaster excitedly said, "Speaking of which, this Man Gu, as well as Meng Jingzhou and Lu Yang, they're all from Yanjiang County, right?"
"Who would have thought that such a small place could produce three talents? Calling them the 'Three Sages of the Demonic Sect' wouldn't be an overstatement. With them, our sect would be like a tiger with wings!"
The vice headmaster muttered under his breath, "Like a tiger with wings, isn't that a Qiongqi? Even a Qiongqi couldn't defeat the righteous path."
The headmaster glared at him, "Showing off your education, huh? Shut up."
The vice headmaster obediently shut his mouth.
...
Yanjiang Rudder.
Eleven managers are using all their strength to maintain a large array. Nearly a hundred scatter demon cultivators are standing still, with their two eyes blank and empty of thought. Their minds are taking over their bodies to undertake the test.
Maintaining the large array is a boring process. While replenishing their qi with the Qi Recovery Pill, the managers started to chat, "Qin Yuanhao's been missing for so long, he must be dead."
"Definitely. But I don't know how he died. I said it long ago; the kid is always scheming here and there, thinking he has everything under control, but one day he would upset his enemies who would get him during the dark night."
"Qin Yuanhao's body hasn't been found yet."
"Was it his enemy who killed him?"
"What else could it be? Could it be a benefactor looking to repay his kindness by killing him? People like us never have benefactors."
"Didn't I hear that Qin Yuanhao was at a brothel with Big Mouth Wang the night before he died?"
The managers chuckled quietly, their laughter rising and falling.
Just as Qin Yuanhao had hoped, Big Mouth Wang was going around spreading the story about their night at the brothel, boasting about how they never tire, creating havoc inside and out of the brothel.
Then, Qin Yuanhao died.
So, the rumor that Qin Yuanhao died due to excessive indulgence started spreading around Yanjiang Rudder.
If Qin Yuanhao knew about all this from beyond the grave, he could finally rest in peace.
"I wonder how many of this group will pass the test."
Although many people participate in the initiation ceremony, it's good if even one out of ten can pass the test and join the sect successfully.
As managers, they too had gone through similar tests. They knew how difficult it was.
The vice headmaster personally overseeing the tests this time, it would certainly be one of the most difficult tests ever conducted!
"Only the Rudder Master knows the result." The eleven of them looked towards the Rudder Master who was meditating.
He was using the array to enter the mysterious space created by the Eternity Sect. All the Rudder Masters of the sub-sect could watch their respective sect's performance in the mysterious space.
The excellent performance of the three, Lu Yang, made Rudder Master's face bloom like a chrysanthemum with joy.
However, he was wearing a mask, so no one could see how happy he was.
He murmured excitedly to himself, "If these three can successfully pass and get highly praised by the superiors, the annual performance of Yanjiang Rudder will definitely be in the first rank. And if I could enhance my cultivation level, I might get transferred to a wealthier area as the Rudder Master next year, or even get directly promoted to a Head of Hall!"
After the three tests, the vice headmaster or headmaster would give a score to the outstanding new members. For example, Qin Yuanhao's score was "Rooted in Demonism."
The Rudder Master believed that the score of Lu Yang's group would definitely be higher than Qin Yuanhao's.
Just by looking at them, it's clear they are no good!

chapters.title: Chapter 74 - 73: Righteous Path Undercover_1
chapters.content:
"Eh? We're back again?" Lu Yang opened his eyes to find himself back in the mysterious white space.
There were many familiar faces around him: Meng Jingzhou, Man Gu, Chi Xulong, Shen Jinyi and so on.
Only ten people from Yanjiang Rudder had successfully passed the first two trials, and Lu Yang knew only half of them - he hadn't had enough time to trick the remaining half into revealing their personal information.
Memories of the previous levels gradually returned: the Mantis Fist in the first level, and pushing the potato cart in the second...
It seems the trials of the Eternity Sect aren't so difficult," Lu Yang felt that his approach was pretty standard - anyone with a brain could do it.
"I had the same thought," Meng Jingzhou agreed, "The first trial just required being bitten by a spider, the second involved punching a fat man."
Lu Yang looked at Meng Jingzhou in slight surprise. "Hmm? How come our method of passing the trials isn't the same?"
Meng Jingzhou confidently shrugged, "That's obvious, isn't it? My method must be the standard one. You probably passed by dumb luck."
Lu Yang scoffed at Meng Jingzhou's confidence: "Ridiculous. The first trial saw me master the Mantis Fist, reflecting my Martial Dao proficiency; what did your first trial reflect? That you're lucky? Do you think the Eternity Sect recruits based on luck? It's clear that my method was the standard one!"
"I advise you to face reality."
Man Gu listened from the side as the two stubbornly argued. He silently recalled his methods.
In the first trial, he had learned perseverance from the spider, strategy from the mantis, and in the second trial, empathy and thorough consideration from the task.
"In that case, my method seems rather common. It looks like Brother Lu and Brother Meng's methods are the correct ones. It's just hard to tell who is the most correct," Man Gu mumbled to himself, smiling as he felt he had learned something new.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou argued for a long time, but weren't able to reach a consensus. Eventually, it was the onlooker Man Gu, who had the clearest mind and was able to end their argument.
"Could it be possible that both of your methods are correct?" he suggested, "The way of the Demon Path allows you to do as you wish. There may not be a right answer. Or perhaps, any method that allows you to pass is considered the correct answer."
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou looked at Man Gu in surprise, thinking that what he said made a lot of sense.
"I never knew the trials of the demonic sect were so broad." Lu Yang remarked in admiration, and Meng Jingzhou nodded in agreement.
"Anyway, why are we back here after only passing two trials? What about the third trial?" The trio finally recalled the matter at hand.
The figure of the deputy Master appeared in the sky once again, holding a ball the size of a palm. There was a slit in the middle of the ball.
With a step into the air, the mysterious white space suddenly transformed. Centered on him, buildings surged out like a tidal wave. City walls, palaces, courtyards, lofts, towering mountains, rivers that spanned the whole city, busy pedestrians, hawkers, cultivators moving mountains and seas... it was like a bustling cultivator city.
The deputy master then divided everyone by their sect, scattering them across the city. The ten members of Yanjiang Rudder were seated in a small building with a view of the outside.
A voice devoid of emotion sounded in everyone's ears: "Congratulations on passing the first two trials. Now, the third trial will begin."
"This is a simulated city, and soon I will release your true nature. Your true nature will make you believe this world is real and drive you to commit acts you genuinely wish to."
"The more destructive you are, the higher our evaluation of you will be. The time limit is one day and one night."
The deputy Master then raised the ball in his hand, opening a slit to reveal a black pupil.
It wasn't a ball, but an enormous eyeball!
The giant eye opened, and a bizarre purple light enveloped the whole city.
...
The deputy Master's consciousness returned to their headquarters, still holding the giant eye.
"Indeed, only an Immortal Treasure could have forged this Immortal Eye. Nothing is more complex than the human heart. Only an Immortal Treasure can release one's true nature and tease out the darkest side of a person."
The deputy Master returned the Immortal Eye to the Master, somewhat reluctant because it's rare to have the chance to use an Immortal Treasure.
Theoretically, he doesn't have the authority to use the Immortal Eye. This time, in order to start the third trial, the Master temporarily lent it to him.
The Master said, "This third trial is crucial. It will determine whether any cultivators from the Righteous Path can infiltrate the Demon Path."
"The Immortal Eye can release people's true nature. Righteous Path cultivators are normally kind-hearted and will not cause too much destruction. Under the cover of the Immortal Eye's light, those Righteous Path cultivators can't even bring themselves to commit acts like murder and arson!"
"Moreover, when incompatible actions occur, Righteous Path cultivators will take action to stop it. In this way, we can screen out those Righteous Path cultivators who might have mixed in!"
The first prerequisite for becoming a member of the Eternity Sect is that you cannot be a Righteous Path infiltrator.
The deputy Master laughed, "Furthermore, this Immortal Eye can determine the level of destructiveness based on the cultivators' cultivation level. With this Immortal Eye, the two of us just need to wait for the result."
...
Squish-
A pedestrian's heart was pierced by a sword. Onlookers screamed and fled. The rogue cultivator from the Demon Path stood behind, laughing wildly. As he laughed, he swung his weapon at others, killing mercilessly, and leaving corpses everywhere.
"Refreshing, refreshing!" The rogue Demon Path cultivator had never killed so joyfully before. In high spirits, he was releasing his true nature: "Today, with your corpses, I shall establish my foundation in the Eternity Sect!"
He intended to seize this opportunity to kill to his heart's content!
"Stop!" A spear suddenly intervened, parrying the rogue cultivator's sword.
The rogue Demon Path cultivator saw who it was and paused, "Who do we have here, isn't this Fang Hao? Always putting on a cold front, I thought you were a thoroughgoing evildoer of the Demon Path. Turns out you're from the Righteous Path."
Fang Hao was doing his best to keep his emotions in check, reminding himself that this was a critical moment. He must not reveal his Righteous Path identity, or all his previous efforts would be in vain. But under the cover of the Immortal Eye's purple light, any disguise was futile.
He couldn't bear to see the Demon Path cultivator's wanton killing. He wanted to do everything he could to prevent it!
He couldn't resist this overwhelming urge that welled up in his heart!
Fang Hao engaged the Demon Path cultivator, their sword and spear clashed resulting in an evenly matched fight.
...
"Sure enough, there's a Righteous Path infiltrator!" The deputy Master said angrily. If it weren't for this third trial, this Fang Hao would have already joined the Eternity Sect!
The Master's eyes were icy, "Without me having to say, you should know what to do."
The deputy Master nodded, "I will order the Huangyue Helm Master to kill him."
"Kill him? Hell no, inform the Huangyue Helm Master ASAP, our location has been exposed. Run!"
"Huh?" The deputy Master was dumbfounded.
The Master explained with some frustration, "What do you mean 'Huh'? If Fang Hao could infiltrate our trials, then the Righteous Path must already know the location of Huangyue Helm. Shouldn't we let them pack up and run?"
"What about this Fang Hao?"
"We can't kill him. The Righteous Path must have Fang Hao's Soul Lamp. If Fang Hao is killed, the Righteous Path will know that the undercover operation has failed and will storm our headquarters. How would Huangyue Helm then have time to escape?"
"Oh."

chapters.title: Chapter 75 - 74: The Ultimate Move of Imitation Fist (Thanks to the book friend Big River Dad for the reward) _1
chapters.content:
"This might be a bit tricky." Lu Yang clicked his tongue, sensing something was off.
The other members of the Yanjiang Rudder had already left, hastily off to commit misdeeds, leaving only the three of them behind.
If not for self-restraints, the three of them could trigger an upheaval in Flying Immortal City.
Unfortunately, their nature wouldn't allow it. They were here to infiltrate the demonic sect, where there were many genuine cultivators of the Demon Path.
"No wonder we've never heard of anyone infiltrating the Eternity Sect. There really is a test like this." Meng Jingzhou felt particularly troubled as well.
"What's the meanest thing you've ever wanted to do?" Lu Yang asked.
Meng Jingzhou thought for a long time before hesitantly saying, "Does going to a brothel count?"
He had been banned from visiting such places by his clan since childhood. Those uncles who had been to the brothel had said it was a terrifying place, not suitable for children.
Having seen the pitiful state of those uncles kneeling and scrubbing clothes when they returned home, Meng Jingzhou indeed thought that the brothel was a dreadful place.
Now as a single... no, a cultivator with Pure Yang Spirit Root, he was even less allowed to go.
For Meng Jingzhou, doing something rebellious like visiting a brothel was the worst misdeed imaginable.
Man Gu, on the other hand, couldn't even think of anything.
"Forget it, we still have a day. Let's go to a brothel and relax." Lu Yang suggested. He already had a plan, jokingly thinking, could this rule really confine him?
Considering there was still plenty of time, it wasn't necessary to act immediately. Since it was a rare opportunity, why not fulfill Meng Jingzhou's desire first?
Meng Jingzhou's eyes lit up. Right, this wasn't his true form, so it wouldn't hurt to visit once.
"Let's go, let's go." Meng Jingzhou urged the others to join him.
He would feel guilty going to such a place alone.
The two couldn't resist Meng Jingzhou's persistence, so they had no choice but to accompany him.
The brothel was located in a very conspicuous place, and the three easily found it.
The gaudily dressed ladies at the entrance were using handkerchiefs to solicit customers. A little hook with their little hand, and the souls of passersby were reeled in.
Once they got to the entrance of the brothel, Man Gu chickened out and started retreating, "I'm a scholar, this is not a place for a scholar."
"The sage says beautiful women are skeletons, their beauty and allure will be transformed into white bone. I cannot make such a mistake."
The two tried persuading him for a long time but to no avail, and had to give up.
Lu Yang was quite loyal, "Since you don't want to go to the brothel, let me go on your behalf."
Man Gu breathed a sigh of relief, thinking Brother Lu was dependable.
Then he watched, wide-eyed, as Lu Yang performed a set of Imitation Fist, morphing into his likeness.
Man Gu: "!!!"
Lu Yang gave a pat to the stunned Man Gu, signalling him to relax: "I'll go."
Man Gu quickly grabbed his doppelganger, "You can't go! Even if you go, you can't transform into me!"
"I am doing this for your own good, it's a pity that you can't go." Lu Yang spoke sincerely.
Man Gu stood his ground.
"Don't be shy." Lu Yang persuaded.
Actually, Lu Yang was also nervous. He had never been to such a place before. What if something went wrong? He would be the laughingstock of Meng Jingzhou for the rest of his life. It was only natural for Lu Yang to want to transform into Man Gu, so if he screwed up, he wouldn't be the one embarrassed.
Of course, he couldn't reveal such thoughts.
As the three of them were bickering heatedly, a loud rumbling sound came from the brothel, followed by a woman's scream and a man's wild laughter.
The three people abruptly turned their heads, only to find a dozen or so cultivators wreaking havoc in the brothel, with innocent women clutched in their arms.
These cultivators didn't even bother to hide their cultivation levels. They were all at the Foundation Establishment Stage, and the aura of two or three of them was even on par with the Tiger Demon they had encountered earlier!
These people were all cultivators who had come to participate in the test.
"Bastards!" The three of them boiled with anger, itching to stop these men.
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu wanted to step in, but Lu Yang held them back.
"Don't rush in so hastily. We are only three people, we can't possibly beat them."
"Then what do you suggest we do?" Meng Jingzhou asked anxiously.
Lu Yang waved his hand, "I have a way to temporarily enhance my combat power. You two, wait for me."
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu were curious. They didn't have any Ten Bulls Strength Pills on them. Could it be that Lu Yang knew a secret method to temporarily upgrade his cultivation level?
They saw Lu Yang take a deep breath. His movements became gentle, his eyes went from lively to detached, and his face expressionless, exuding a frosty aura.
Meng Jingzhou squinted his eyes and then widened them in surprise.
These movements were strikingly similar to those of Eldest Senior Sister Yun Zhi!
Lu Yang was performing the Lu Clan's Imitation Fist, transforming into the look of the Eldest Senior Sister.
He had jokingly said before that Lu Clan's Imitation Fist had nine stages. Once one reaches the ninth stage, one could transform into a Great Power of the Transcendence Tribulation Stage in the blink of an eye.
He said this because he found that when he transformed into Man Gu, his physical strength was stronger than his actual self.
The Lu Clan's Imitation Fist could obtain a portion of the physical strength of the person it impersonated!
Certainly, this strength had a limit, it couldn't increase indefinitely. But this was already quite powerful.
Lu Yang wanted to transform into the Eldest Senior Sister to see how much strength he could gain, and whether he could defeat those men!
Eldest Senior Sister, I'm sorry.
A breathtakingly beautiful woman appeared. The woman radiated charm, and her brows were laced with a timeless frost.
