Upon seeing this beautiful woman, Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu instinctively held their breaths, their legs shaking.
Lu Yang had successfully transformed into the Eldest Senior Sister!
Lu Yang felt a surge of incredible power descending from the heavens, pouring into his body!
...
Seek Dao Sect, Sky Gate Mountain.
Yun Zhi was seated cross-legged at the peak of the mountain. Her eyes were open, gazing at the sky as if she could see the boundless starry sea in the far distance.
Her aura was perfectly concealed. To anyone, she would just seem like an ordinary person.
Yet, an ordinary person wouldn't be levitating at the peak of a mountain, not to mention having a starry galaxy in their eyes.
"Hmm? Who borrowed my power?" Yun Zhi retracted her gaze, sensing a split of her power being separated from her body and flying towards the endless distance.
"I must see who dares to have such audacity!"
Yun Zhi had never encountered such a bold thief before!
She broke her normal appearance, and let her aura surge out, piercing through the clouds, fully displaying the demeanor of the Eldest Senior Sister of the Seek Dao Sect!
Yun Zhi's divine soul departed from her body, transforming into a brilliant streak of light, following that split of power leaving her body.
...
"Cough!" Lu Yang couldn't withstand even a shred of the Eldest Sister's power and reverted to his original appearance.
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu also exhaled in relief. Lu Yang in the form of the Eldest Sister was too imposing.
Crack——
A crisp sound came from above their heads.
Regardless of whether it was the lawless demonic cultivators who were pillaging and committing atrocities, or the three who were about to take action, everyone stopped what they were doing and gaped at the scene above them.
The previously boundless space now had a crack, as if something had collided with it.
Crack, crack, crack...
The crack spread like a dried riverbed, increasing in size. Then with a loud swish, the crack transformed into a void, as if the sky had sprung a large hole.
A stunning figure appeared in the void, frowning slightly.
"This aura... is it from the demonic sect?"

chapters.title: Chapter 76 - 75: Run for your life!_1
chapters.content:
In the headquarters of the Eternity Sect, a bronze ancient tripod was filled with rolling white mist and the consciousness of all the solitary cultivators of the Demon Path resided in the tripod.
An Immortal Eye opened, projecting a screen of light that displayed a ranking list.
The Master and Deputy Master were attentively observing the excellent performance of the cultivators who held the top ranks.
"Take this person hailing from Kunlun City, for example. He recites the death mantra before killing, which gives it a heightened sense of ceremony."
"I've heard that he was a temple monk who advocated the slaughter of living beings for attaining Nirvana, secretly killing many unnoticed. The abbot had intended to execute him once he came to know about it. Seeing his actions exposed, this man smashed a Buddha statue and escaped early. He has joined our Eternity Sect to see if the Immortal Eternities would back his claim."
"The young fellow from Quhe County is also quite innovative, using relatives against each other. He can manipulate children to kill their fathers and grandchildren to slay their grandfathers, and then turn their bodies into puppets after death."
"Oh, here's an interesting one who shattered a load-bearing wall, causing a building collapse and killing many."
The two leaders enthusiastically evaluated the cultivators who were ranked high. Those who managed to rank in the top tiers were all of a ruthless disposition and had a high probability of being promoted to the upper ranks in the future.
"What about the three lads who performed exceptionally in the first two trials?"
They took a while to find Lu Yang and the others on the screen and noticed they were discussing whether to visit a brothel.
The Deputy Master was quite dissatisfied with their rankings: "They're ranked so low. Could they be spies from the Righteous Path and won't do any evil?"
The Master shook his head wisely, "We shouldn't think that way. I see that this guy, Lu Yang, is quite a thoughtful person. He must have a plan to make a big splash. Remember, one doesn't need to rush to be evil. Long-term planning is the optimal choice."
Seeing that Lu Yang made no move, they shifted the screen back to the top to check what the first ranker had done.
"The first rank holder is a poison user. He poisoned a well, killing an entire street of people in one go. He also poisoned cows, driving them mad, and making them rampage in the streets, killing many. Very good, poison should indeed be used this way."
"What is this strange method? He bought an entire block of shops and then fired all the staff."
"This one below is similar. After buying the shops, he makes the staff work overtime but does not pay them. Does this count as evil?"
The Deputy Master felt as if he was falling behind the times.
Suddenly, an extremely domineering Divine Soul descended from the heavens, breaking the various Array Methods laid by the sect, and went straight for the bronze ancient tripod, which was reeking of chaotic breath.
The bronze ancient tripod seemed unable to bear such a violent shock, and a tiny crack appeared on the surface.
"Not good, my tripod!" The Master cried out.
The bronze ancient tripod, known as the Mountain and River Tripod, could accommodate all things and was his Life-bound Magical Treasure refined over half his lifetime, being only a step away from becoming an Immortal Treasure.
"A Divine Soul has descended! A great power of the Righteous Path has discovered this place!" said the Master incredulously. What exactly had happened? How was it that they had been discovered by a great power of the Righteous Path in the blink of an eye?
"This aura... Is it Yun Zhi of the Seek Dao Sect?" The Master recognized the familiar aura and the terrible events associated with it sent shivers down his spine.
The Deputy Master had a fierce expression. He pulled out his weapon, prepared to execute Yun Zhi: "Yun Zhi? She's merely a disciple of the Seek Dao Sect. At best, we are getting one person. If we all gang up on her, surely we can take her down?"
Yun Zhi rarely acted in the Central Continent, so her reputation wasn't prominent. The name recognition of the Sect Leader, the eight Elders, and even Dai Bufan from the Seek Dao Sect far exceeded hers.
However, just because she wasn't famous didn't mean she was weak. Anyone who had seen her in action felt that their understanding of cultivation had been overturned!
As it so happened, the Master had seen Yun Zhi in action: picking stars and grabbing the moon, reversing Yin and Yang, and casually suppressing strong enemies. It truly made him feel like his three-thousand-year cultivation journey had been a waste.
The Master kicked the Deputy Master away. Was this the time to fight to the death? "You haven't seen her in action. You have no idea how terrifying she is. Listen to me and run immediately. Even the Immortal Eternities can't save you if you don't escape now!"
He had been able to become the Master of the Eternity Sect not solely due to the most devout belief he held in Immortal Eternities or because he held the highest Cultivation Level, but more importantly, due to being sufficiently cautious. He knew when to fight to the death, when to run for his life, and when to admit death.
Fighting Yun Zhi head-on wasn't called fighting to the death, it was courting death!
The Master cast a series of ancient and profound imprints on the Mountain and River Tripod to prevent Yun Zhi from breaking out of it.
The Deputy Master had never seen the Master in such a frantic state before, which made him realize the seriousness of the situation. He sent a message to all the higher-ups, issuing an order of life and death: escape immediately to the alternate headquarters.
In anticipation of sneak attacks from the Righteous Path, the Eternity Sect had prepared a detailed plan and escape routes, even carrying out numerous drills. The higher-ups were quite familiar with this process.
In the blink of an eye, the higher-ups of the Eternity Sect had disappeared without a trace.
The Master employed the Three-headed Six-Armed Great Divine Power, with two hands casting imprints to reinforce the seal on the Mountain and River Tripod, and the other four helping the consciousness of everyone else return to their original places within the tripod.
The cracks on the Mountain and River Tripod became more numerous. The sealing process was not fast enough to keep up with the rate at which the cracks appeared.
Seeing that everyone had successfully escaped, the Master let out a sigh of relief, severed his connection with the Mountain and River Tripod, and coughed up a mouthful of Essence Blood, the result of backlash from his Life-bound Magical Treasure.
His aura plummeted rapidly and his complexion turned deathly pale.
Caring for nothing else, the Master turned and ran!
Boom——
The Mountain and River Tripod exploded, shaking the entire headquarters.
Yun Zhi stepped out from the wreckage of the Mountain and River Tripod, her expression emotionless, appearing as a majestic, unsullied ancient War Goddess.
She bent down and detected the Essence Blood left by the Master with her fingertips. After performing a brief divination, a chilling light flashed through her eyes.
"In that direction."
A burning white light condensed in her hands, emanating an intense radiance, akin to an divine light of judgment meant to eradicate all evil.
The divine light thunderbolt shot towards the Master with a whoosh. The Master didn't expect to be found by Yun Zhi even like this. He tried to dodge but it was too late, resulting in an eruption of blood from his shoulder.
"Golden Cicada shedding skin!" The Master had no shortage of life-saving techniques either.
By the time Yun Zhi caught up, she only found the Master's remnant body.
...
The Master stumbled back to the alternate headquarters, stuffing elixirs into his mouth as if they were free, urgently trying to save his own life. Cutting off his connection with the Mountain and River Tripod and casting the Golden Cicada Shedding Skin secret technique had taken a huge toll on him. It would now take hundreds of years of peaceful cultivation to recover fully.
All these could still be managed, but the most critical issue was the Mountain and River Tripod!
That was a treasure tripod refined by the collective power of the entire sect, with the consumed ingredients equating to ten years of tax revenue from the Great Xia Dynasty!
Such a precious treasure had now fallen into the hands of the Seek Dao Sect!
"How are you feeling?" asked the Deputy Master, filled with concern. He had just witnessed Yun Zhi in action and was filled with lingering fear. Had he been in the Master's place, he would have been perished long ago. Only the Master, with his immense capabilities, was left standing.
"I won't die." said the Master, also feeling lingering fear. "Fortunately, we had a contingency plan and prepared a hiding place in advance. We severed all forms of causality, ensuring Yun Zhi couldn't find us. Otherwise, the Four Great Devil Sects would have had to change their name to the Three Great Demon Sects."
"Now that the Mountain and River Tripod has been shattered, let's consider the third test over. Let's see who's at the top of the list now."
The Immortal Eye projected a light screen that displayed a name above all else.
Ranked first, Lu Yang.
"Huh?"

chapters.title: Chapter 77 - 76 Evaluation_1
chapters.content:
"Who exactly borrowed my power?" Yun Zhi was puzzled. The Eternity Sect had fled in disarray, leaving no one behind, only leaving behind the Mountain and River Tripod, which could be sold to a First Class Sect.
Now he couldn't find out who had borrowed his power.
There was a type of magic skill called "God Descent Technique" in magic arts that could borrow power with the other party's consent. However, this technique was on the verge of being lost and was very difficult to learn. Yun Zhi hadn't seen this kind of magic skill in a long time.
And who could borrow his power without his consent? Yun Zhi felt that the person who borrowed his power seemed not to have any ill intentions, so he instinctively did not stop his power from leaking.
Yun Zhi probably could guess who it was.
"But where did he learn the God Descent Technique from?"
Yun Zhi didn't recall teaching Lu Yang a similar magic skill.
...
The first place, Lu Yang.
"Huh? The first place has changed?" The vice-Master was bewildered; they had been busy escaping and hadn't noticed what Lu Yang did.
The Mountain and River Tripod was broken and couldn't replay the event.
"But the Immortal Eye is never wrong. These three people are the most destructive!" The Master said confidently. He couldn't figure out what Lu Yang had done. The previous first-place contestant had killed hundreds of people in a short period of time and posed a threat to thousands more, whose lives were hanging by a thread.
It was truly unbelievable that Lu Yang could surpass this person and rank first.
But there was no need to guess. The Immortal Eye was a treasure of the Immortals, higher grade than the Mountain and River Tripod, and would absolutely not make a mistake.
Indeed, Lu Yang had summoned Yun Zhi, destroyed the Mountain and River Tripod and the headquarters of the Eternity Sect. The destruction he caused to the Eternity Sect could be ranked in the top three in history.
In terms of the damage done to the Master, he could be ranked first.
The Master said proudly, forgetting about his pain, "Look, I told you before, this Lu Yang is very wise. Although he may be behind in the rankings for a while, if you take your eyes off him for a moment, he can stir up a big commotion. Here you go, he has come first."
"Don't underestimate Meng Jingzhou and your favorite, Man Gu, just because they are average. If they had enough time, they would certainly mix up to the second or third."
The vice-Master conceded defeat. The Master was truly the Master. Not only was he cautious in his actions, but he also had a keen eye. No wonder he was just the vice-Master, and the others were genuine.
"What is your evaluation of Lu Yang?"
After thinking for a moment, the Master said, "In the first test, Lu Yang demonstrated his martial talents by choosing unconventional tactics with his sword, it's very rare in the world to enter the Dao through martial arts.
In the second test, he meticulously observed and figured out the pattern, purchasing all the potatoes, preventing subsequent candidates from being tested, showing his huge destructive nature. This trait was even more prominent in the third test, it wouldn't be an overstatement to say he was a natural-born seed of demon."
The vice-Master was amazed. He had known the master for so long, but had never heard anyone receive such high praise.
"What about Meng Jingzhou?"
"Meng Jingzhou got his power from being bitten by a spider in the first test, which shows his luck, hence in this Great Era, he's like a Dao seed created by destiny.
In the second test, he meticulously researched the examination questions, thought about the problems from multiple perspectives, seemingly arrogant and domineering, but in fact, each step was a win, the plan was well executed, and ultimately he broke through the psychological defense of the examiner, successfully passing the examination."
"Unfortunately, in the third test, he did not show his strengths before it ended, falling slightly behind Lu Yang. He's like a reincarnation of Dao and demon."
The evaluation as the reincarnation of Dao and demon is also extremely rare. Among the younger generation, there are few who can get such evaluation from the Master. It seems that this Meng Jingzhou has a limitless future.
"What about Man Gu?"
"In the first test, he showed comprehension, persistency, and strategy. In the second test, he thought through the problem very thoroughly, but in the third test, he didn't have much initiative. In previous tests, he was among the outstanding performers. Unfortunately, with peerless talents like them, I can only give him an evaluation of a demon in his heart."
According to past experience, with the demon in the heart, as long as they don't fall, they can become high-ranking officials of the Eternity Sect.
"Should we transfer them to the headquarters for careful cultivation?" the vice-Master asked.
The Master shook his head and shared his experience, "There's no need to rush. They should start from the grassroots first, they need at least two years of grassroots experience. Trust me, grassroots experience is very helpful for their future growth. That's how I made my way up."
"And I have another plan. Lu Yang, with his unconventional thoughts and destructive power, could, when he matures, possibly infiltrate into a Righteous Path Sect, such as the Seek Dao Sect."
The vice-Master chuckled, thinking the Master was overestimating them. While they could infiltrate other sects, it was too difficult to infiltrate the Seek Dao Sect. Even the thoughts of the Seek Dao Sect disciples were hard to follow, much less to infiltrate and blend in. They wouldn't last long before being exposed.
Infiltrating the Seek Dao Sect? Easier said than done.
"I'm going to heal myself." After the Master finished speaking, he went to the secret room to recover.
The vice-Master had no intention of plotting and usurping power from the start. Today was an example. Of course, if he killed the Master, he could climb a step higher, but what about afterward? When the Righteous Path came attacking, could he make the right judgment?
If he made a wrong judgment, he would definitely die under the technique of the Righteous Path. By then, regretting usurping the Master's position would be too late.
...
Yanjiang Rudder.
"A total of ten people passed the test, and three of them received the evaluation of a natural-born seed of demon, the reincarnation of Dao and demon, and a demon in the heart?!" The Rudder Master was overjoyed upon receiving the message sent by the Master, his eyebrows raised in delight.
This was better than his best predictions! The chance for promotion was within sight!
The scattered Demon Path cultivators who didn't pass the first and second tests were thrown into different areas by the eleven Managers during their unconscious period. When they woke up, they would forget the location of Yanjiang Rudder, and regard their previous experience as a dream.
The most secure method would be to kill them, thus ensuring that the location of Yanjiang Rudder would absolutely not be exposed. However, the Eternity Sect did not do this in view of the overall situation.
These scattered Demon Path cultivators caused havoc, which could attract the attention of the Righteous Path. Amid various confusing information, the Righteous Path couldn't discern which was caused by the scattered Demon Path cultivators and which was done by the demonic sect, which could confuse their judgment.
Lu Yang and the other two slowly woke up. They had experienced too much just now, and their minds were a bit muddled.
The last scene they saw before they passed out was… the Eldest Senior Sister descending from the sky?!
Lu Yang broke out in a cold sweat, the Eldest Senior Sister didn't see him transforming into her, did she? If she saw it, she would definitely flay him alive.
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu also remembered what had happened, Lu Yang's Imitation Fist had summoned the real Eldest Senior Sister.
Lu Yang warned the two with his eyes not to leak out the news, the two quickly nodded in understanding.
The Rudder Master suppressed his joy and said in as calm a voice as possible, "From today onwards, you ten are members of my Eternity Sect."
"Normally, we should hold the initiation ceremony first, but the three rounds of tests today have drained everyone's energy, myself included. It would be disrespectful to the Immortal Eternity to hold the ceremony in this state. Come back here tomorrow for the official initiation ceremony."
Lu Yang could tell that when mentioning Immortal Eternity, the tone of the Rudder Master, as well as the expressions of the eleven Managers, all changed slightly.
This indicated that their belief in Immortal Eternity was not a pretense, but a firm belief in the existence of Immortal Eternity.
"No wonder it is called a 'sect'." Lu Yang thought.
The Rudder Master continued, "However, it wouldn't be appropriate not to celebrate the joining of new members today. So, let's go out and have a meal."
"I heard that a new barbecue shop called 'Once More' has opened in the province. It tastes good and has received favorable reviews. Let's gather there in a moment. It's my treat."
Lu Yang: "..."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Man Gu: "..."
So, no rest, huh?

chapters.title: Chapter 78 - 77 - Shop's owner, come out!_1
chapters.content:
"So tired, I really don't want to work." The three of them yawned in unison, their eyes struggling to stay open.
What a rotten idea the Rudder Master had to come eat here.
They were on their way back to the barbecue restaurant, having managed to infiltrate the enemy's ranks after a day of witty contest, and now all they want is to eat a big meal and have a good sleep.
The Eternity Sect managed to focus everyone's thoughts on the Mountain and River Tripod, a process that resulted in great exhaustion.
"Thank goodness I had the ghoul prepare the skewers before we left so we can start business right away once we get back," Man Gu said with some relief.
Upon arriving at the entrance of the barbecue shop, Lu Yang recognized a familiar face.
"Guard Captain Wei? What are you doing here? Anything important?"
Guard Captain Wei had been knocking at the restaurant door for quite some time, no one answered, he thought no one was there.
In fact, the restaurant was indeed empty, save for the two hardworking ghouls who were too scared to open the door when they heard Guard Captain Wei knocking.
Just as Guard Captain Wei was about to give up, Lu Yang showed up.
Guard Captain Wei was overjoyed: "Mr. Little Lu, you're finally back."
Lu Yang nodded, and came up with a quick excuse: "We saw that the weather was good this morning, so we all agreed that it's a perfect day for an outing. We just came back from a little wander."
"So, are you open for business today?"
Lu Yang thought for a while, figuring that Rudder Master and his gang of about twenty people were on their way, so they could be counted as open for business: "Yes."
Guard Captain Wei said in as gentle a tone as possible: "Mr. Little Lu, here's the thing, your barbecue restaurant is quite famous around here. I often bring some of my brothers here, don't I?"
"I know you love running the barbecue shop and have no interest in expanding or being publicized."
Lu Yang nodded.
Guard Captain Wei lamented, "My brothers seemed to overshare about how good your food was after eating, and now, everyone else is drooling over your food. They said they'll come over to eat after today's shift ends, and the brothers who are on the night shift at the yamen asked for some food to be brought back to them."
Lu Yang looked at Guard Captain Wei's expression and thought, surely it wasn't just your brothers spreading the word, you did it too, didn't you?
"So?"
"Well, there are quite a few constables in Yanjiang County, nearly enough to fill all the tables. The head constable is coming too, so I was wondering if we could book the entire restaurant tonight, just for us."
Lu Yang finally understood and pretended to be hesitant: "But I have a few friends coming over tonight, I'm afraid..."
Guard Captain Wei hastened to assure him: "No problem, no problem. A few more people won't matter, it'll be livelier with more people."
Guard Captain Wei had already assured his colleagues beforehand that they'd certainly have a meal here; it would be embarrassing if it turned out to be untrue.
Lu Yang agreed: "Alright, let us prepare, and we'll open in an hour."
Having received a definite response, Guard Captain Wei happily left.
...
When it was almost the time agreed by the Rudder Master, various groups of people gathered at the entrance of the barbecue shop from all directions, including the Rudder Master, eleven managers, and seven new members.
Chi Xulong and Shen Jinyi even brought several jars of wine.
"I was worried that the wine in this small restaurant wouldn't be strong enough, so I brought a few jars of thirty-year-old spirit wine." Chi Xulong and Shen Jinyi said.
The spirit wine was very strong, even those at the Foundation Establishment Stage would not be able to dissolve it.
The other five new members also had intentions of bringing wine to show respect, but being at the Qi Refinement stage, they couldn't offer anything of value.
The Rudder Master had changed his mask to one that revealed the lower half of his face, in order to eat.
Lu Yang and the other two came out of the barbecue shop, inviting everyone inside: "Please come in, everything is ready. We originally had the whole place booked tonight. It took much begging and pleading before the people who reserved it agreed to leave us a table."
The Rudder Master nodded, initially he was worried that Lu Yang and the others would be unruly and disobey orders, and thought about teaching them a lesson. Now it seems these three were cooperative enough to reserve seats in advance.
"No more standing, let's go in." The Rudder Master beckoned the others.
The barbecue restaurant was empty. The Rudder Master naturally sat at the largest table in the middle, befitting his status.
Lu Yang cautiously reminded him, "Master, this table has been reserved."
Before the Rudder Master could say anything, Chi Xulong interjected, "Let them move aside. How dare they try to compete with us for seats?"
Seeing that the Rudder Master did not object, Lu Yang said no more.
Everyone sat down and Man Gu handed out the menu, "What would you like to eat?"
Shen Jinyi handed the menu to the Rudder Master, "Master, please."
The Rudder Master waved his hand, "Order whatever you like."
"Since you are hosting, naturally you should order."
"No need, order as you please."
Everyone at the table went in circles refusing to order, and in the end, the menu returned to Man Gu. He snorted, finding these people to be quite bothersome even when ordering skewers.
Man Gu didn't have the habit of refusing. After making his selections, he took the menu to the backyard and had two ghouls start grilling.
Soon, Man Gu returned with plates of tantalizingly fragrant skewers. Everyone could tell they were delicious just by the smell.
"Come, come, the skewers are here. Pour the drinks!" the Rudder Master exclaimed, signaling everyone to pour drinks.
Meng Jingzhou laughed, "There's no need for alcohol. I prefer tea and don't like drinks."
The Rudder Master chuckled, "Little Meng, when you're in our world, you need to drink. You'll get used to it after a few rounds."
Meng Jingzhou continued to refuse.
The Rudder Master didn't want to lose face. He frowned slightly, and Chi Xulong seized the opportunity to chastise, "What's the matter with you? The Rudder Master offers you a drink and you refuse, not giving him face?"
Meng Jingzhou smirked, "What does having a drink have to do with saving face? If the Rudder Master insists on me drinking, isn't he not giving me face?"
Chi Xulong was about to retort when he was interrupted by the Rudder Master.
Knowing Meng Jingzhou's vast potential, the Rudder Master didn't want any quarrels.
Only the Rudder Master knew the Master's evaluation of Lu Yang and the others. Even they didn't know.
"There aren't many formalities for a welcome meal. Let me introduce myself first. My surname is Chu, and you can call me Master Chu."
Once the Rudder Master finished, everyone made their introductions. While it was said to be an introduction, it was merely the announcing of their own names, revealing nothing more.
Trust is rare among demonic sects, they try to conceal as much about themselves as possible.
Like no quarrel had happened, everyone enjoyed their meal.
"These skewers are surprisingly good." After having several skewers, Chi Xulong was pleasantly surprised. They were the best skewers he'd ever eaten.
He was tempted and quietly asked the Rudder Master, "Should we coerce the restaurant owner into revealing the recipe? Even if we sell these skewers for Spirit Stones, they would still be popular. We can make a fortune!"
The Rudder Master was also tempted. He'd done plenty of killing for profit and extortion before and didn't mind one more.
Lu Yang asked, "What if the owner doesn't agree to give the recipe?"
An icy glint flashed in Chi Xulong's eyes, and he smirked, "Then he has to choose between his life and the recipe!"
He slammed the table, ready to make trouble, and shouted, "Where is the owner! Come out! We have food here but the owner hasn't shown up, don't you know the rules!"
Then, Guard Captain Wei's voice followed from outside the door, "Hahaha, where's the owner, I've brought my brothers here."
A group of constables swarmed in, including the head constable at the Golden Core Stage, circling the Rudder Master's table.

chapters.title: Chapter 79 - 78: Righteous and Evil are One Family_1
chapters.content:
The constables dispersed and took their seats. Guard Captain Wei wasn't exaggerating when he said a lot of people would be coming; the tables were almost full.
Rudder Master sat in the middle, surrounded by constables. The atmosphere was very congenial; it was as if the righteous and the demonic were one and the same family.
Chi Xulong was so scared that he immediately lowered his head. Despite the reputation he had built outside for being arrogant, he always disguised himself or avoided revealing his face when he was up to mischief. Whenever he encountered people from the government office, he would stay as far away as possible.
Now that he couldn't hide, he could only choose to put his head in the sand.
"Guard Captain Wei, I'm here." Lu Yang got up and greeted Guard Captain Wei with a smile.
Chi Xulong's eyes widened in disbelief as he looked at Lu Yang, so it was you who is the boss all along!
"You guys have already started eating." Guard Captain Wei looked a bit embarrassed.
"No problem, what are you guys having?"
Guard Captain Wei waved his hand, "With so many people here, let's not be picky. Bring out anything you have."
"Alright." Lu Yang agreed, figuring that this was what Guard Captain Wei had in mind.
The constables at Rudder Master's table could smell the delicious food, and they instinctively swallowed.
It was dinner time and they were already hungry. The smell of the food made them even hungrier.
Fortunately, Lu Yang was prepared. Even before Guard Captain Wei and the others arrived, he had the Ghoul turn up the heat and start grilling some of the food. As soon as the people arrived, he served the food straight away.
Soon, Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu bought up plate after plate of grilled skewers, to fill up Guard Captain Wei and the others' stomachs.
Guard Captain Wei didn't say anything, but he was grateful to Lu Yang in his heart. Otherwise, waiting for so long while smelling the tantalizing aroma would surely invite complaints from his colleagues.
"Let me introduce, our Chief Constable, Fang Qingyun!"
Fang Qingyun politely shook hands with Lu Yang. Being a cultivator in the Golden Core stage, he could tell that Lu Yang was a cultivator.
Not only could he tell that Lu Yang was a cultivator, but Fang Qingyun also noticed that everyone at Rudder Master's table were cultivators too.
He didn't say anything, since many cultivators run businesses. As long as one does not violate the law, what does it have to do with him?
There is no law against running a barbecue restaurant.
Even if his table was occupied, as a Chief Constable, he could not abuse his power. If word gets out, it wouldn't look good.
After Lu Yang sat down laughing, Chi Xulong whisperingly cursed and accused him to the Rudder master, "You despicable jerk, why didn't you say the constables were coming?!"
Lu Yang responded with a sense of wronged: "I just wanted you guys to establish a good relationship with the constables. You should seize this opportunity."
Lu Yang pointed to the framed banner on the wall: "See that? This is the banner that Guard Captain Wei gave to me."
He casually fabricated a story: "Before I joined the organization, I staged a good position and built up relations with the government office. This way, no matter what I do, the government office will never suspect me. And on top of that, I can even steal some information whenever they come here for a drink."
Rudder Master Chu nodded. Lu Yang's explanation was well reasoned and aligned with the Master's evaluation of him.
The Master said that these three guys might appear to mess around, but they actually have deeper intentions. Their actions should not simply be taken at face value.
Just by proactively establishing a relationship with the government, one displays a boldness and imagination that surpasses most people in the sect!
"Come on, drink."
After eating a few skewers to fill their stomachs, Guard Captain Wei and the others started drinking.
With more and more skewers going down, the constables started to liven up, drinking round after round in high spirits; it was very lively.
In stark contrast to the lively surroundings, Rudder Master's table in the center was extremely cautious, as if they were afraid their cover would be blown if someone drank too much.
By the end, they even switched from wine to tea.
Seeing that Rudder Master's table wasn't lively, Guard Captain Wei felt guilty, perhaps it was due to his arrival. He decided to pick up his wine cup and head over.
"Come on, come on, don't mind us. Once we're off duty we're just common folk. We come to a barbecue shop just like everyone else - to eat, drink and be merry!"
"Come on, let's drink a round!" Guard Captain Wei said to Chi Xulong.
Chi Xulong carefully raised his tea cup. Seeing this, Guard Captain Wei looked displeased. He scowled and said: "What's this about drinking tea? Aren't you showing a lack of respect? Bring the wine!"
Chi Xulong had no choice, but to swallow his pride and down the thirty-year-old Spirit Wine he had brought himself, in a single gulp.
Seeing Guard Captain Wei drink round for round, the other constables, clearly well liquored up, followed suit, thoroughly enjoying their drinks with the Rudder Master at his table.
No one looked to drink with Lu Yang and his crew. The boss couldn't possibly take more alcohol.
The strength of the thirty-year-old Spirit Wine was more than one could process at the Foundation Establishment Stage; Chi Xulong and his team were all quite tipsy.
Seeing that everyone was well drunk, the Rudder Master excused himself and left.
With the big boss gone, under the influence of alcohol, people started to loosen up. Chi Xulong and Shen Jinyi, arm in arm, were determined to unite and make a name for themselves in the Eternity Sect.
"The biggest weakness with you, Chi Xulong, is that you're too impulsive and outspoken. You should rein yourself in a bit!" Shen Jinyi advised Chi Xulong.
Chi Xulong was displeased. He was naturally free-spirited and didn't like to be criticized, "Oh, please! So, I'm outspoken and impulsive. You'd prefer I shrink back like a frightened turtle? Too afraid to make a move and just hide behind an army of students to do my bidding?"
"You're skulking around like some scared woman!"
Shen Jinyi erupted in anger, "Chi Xulong, don't take my kindness for granted! I'm trying to look out for you, don't you dare turn on me!"
Chi Xulong was even more furious, "Who are you calling a dog!"
With that, he landed a punch on Shen Jinyi's face.
Shen Jinyi was someone who wouldn't take it lying down; if he swallowed his pride now, the impulsive Chi Xulong would inevitably push him further.
Shen Jinyi picked up his wine cup and threw it at Chi Xulong. Despite being drunk, Chi Xulong's reaction was still sharp, he dodged and the wine ended up on Bai Zifang's face, who was enjoying the spectacle.
Bai Zifang was not someone easy to get along with either, he retorted in kind, splashing wine all over Shen Jinyi and even smashing a plate on his face.
The three of them tumbled around in a brawl. The others tried to intervene, but ended up getting caught in the crossfire, making them seethe with anger.
"We're trying to prevent you guys from making fools of yourselves, if you don't appreciate it at least don't hit back!"
"Blowhard!"
The Spirit Wine was so strong, and everyone was a bit off their heads. They didn't care if it was a crowd of constables around, everyone started throwing punches.
Crash...
Someone had knocked over the table, and everything ended up on the table next to them.
The constables had never seen such audacious cultivators starting a brawl in public.
Even they were right there. If they had been absent, who knows what could have ensued.
Public brawling among cultivators was an extremely serious offence—it could easily result in harm to the onlooking crowds. Harsh punishment was necessary!
Seeing the chaos, the chief constable, Fang Qingyun, released his imposing aura, immediately subduing the unruly members of the demonic sect.
"Take them away, let them sober up in the jail!" he commanded.
At this, the demonic sect members snapped out of their haze. Realizing what had happened, they broke out in a cold sweat.
So many people had come this time that the two Ghouls were so busy managing, they even started creating illusions. Seeing this, Man Gu kicked into action. Meanwhile, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were bustling back and forth between the backyard and the hall, serving grilled skewers at an astonishing rate.
Lu Yang pulled back the door curtain and apologized, "I'm sorry everyone, we're all out of grilled... what's going on here?"
Lu Yang saw that the usually arrogant sect members were being uncharacteristically quiet, with the constables coldly eying them.
Guard Captain Wei murmured: "Apologies, Mr. Little Lu. Your friends were fighting in public. Chief constable dislikes cultivators behaving this way. The disruption was too noticeable, people around were starting to take notice. Punishment is unavoidable."
Lu Yang, "..."
In fairness, Lu Yang's attempt to mix the sect members and the constables at one table was, admittedly, an attempt to stir things up, but he'd definitely not expected them to be audacious enough to start a fight in front of constables.
Meng Jingzhou scoffed, "I told you, didn't I? We shouldn't have been drinking. Nothing good ever comes out of it."
...
On the day of the welcome party, Chi Xulong and the others were detained for ten days for public brawling.
Upon hearing this, Master Chu was in a daze for quite some time.

chapters.title: Chapter 80 - 79: Immortal Eternity_1
chapters.content:
Fortunately, Chi Xulong and his group were seasoned veterans, they wouldn't leak any information about the demonic sect while imprisoned, else Master Chu would have to consider keeping them silent permanently.
Master Chu sent a message for Lu Yang and the two others to come to Yanjiang Rudder for the official initiation ceremony.
As for those fools, they would have a good ten days in the dungeon to cool their heads.
Master Chu, lounging lazily on his jade throne, looked up at the trio and complimented, "Your barbecue restaurant is a great idea, keep it up. It's a channel for us to establish contact with the officers."
Master Chu dismissed the attendants, who were all beginner members of the sect. They hadn't been tested, they weren't qualified to know the inner secrets of the sect.
"Let's go, I'll show you the Immortal Eternity."
Master Chu led the three to another floating stone. The buildings on the floating stone were clearly from another time, they had collapsed under the ravages of Suiyue. The place felt weighted with history.
Even someone as educated as Meng Jingzhou couldn't determine the age of these buildings.
These were certainly not buildings from the hundred thousand years of Great Xia!
Meng Jingzhou was quietly shocked. These buildings must have at least a hundred thousand years of history!
"Could it be from the Great Yu dynasty?"
According to history, the last emperor of the Great Yu dynasty was infamous for his debauchery, which led to the fragmentation of the dynasty and chaos throughout the lands. The ancestors of the Meng family and Emperor Xia rose to power and dominated the Central Continent.
The Seek Dao Sect was established 120,000 years ago, during the time of the Great Yu dynasty. Yet, the dynasty was at its peak and no one could challenge its status.
At the end of the buildings stood a roughly four meters tall statue. It was exactly like the one seen in Qin Yuanhao's house, with blurred facial features and a robe that made it impossible to distinguish its gender. This was Immortal Eternity.
Master Chu held up three lit incense sticks, bowing to the Immortal Eternity, then turned to the trio and said, "Meditate for an hour to clear your minds."
The scent of these incense sticks was not ordinary, and the fluttery heart slowly calmed down as they smelled it.
Clearing the mind represented a fundamental skill for the three. Seeing them settle quickly, Master Chu nodded in approval.
Even with the help of the Treasure Incense, this was a quick speed of calming down. Most cultivators from the Demon Path are restless and do not cultivate their minds. These three were indeed rare.
It seems they had received some kind of opportunity somewhere.
If he knew about this opportunity in the past, Master Chu would spare no effort to make it his. But these three were different, they were the focus of the Master's attention, and he didn't dare to do anything.
An hour later, the three woke up and followed Master Chu's instructions to pay homage to Immortal Eternity.
After the complex rituals, they officially became followers of the Eternity Sect.
Master Chu said with his hands behind his back, "Before joining our sect, you probably only knew of us as Eternity Sect, worshipping the Immortal Eternity and the promise of extended life. But you likely know very little about Immortal Eternity."
The three nodded. They basically knew nothing about the Immortal Eternity, this was the only Immortal they've ever heard of.
Master Chu spoke reverently, "The existence of Immortal Eternity is taboo. He has lived as long as heaven and earth have existed, witnessing all the ups and downs of the world. Even if his physical body is destroyed and his immortal soul corrupts, so long as someone still remembers him, he can resurrect on the spot, eternal and undying!"
Lu Yang and the others were taken aback, unsure of how much of what Master Chu said was true and how much was a lie.
As long as someone remembers the existence of Immortal Eternity, he is undying and indestructible. Such a thing has never been heard of even in myth!
Such a miraculous existence. It's not inappropriate to call it an "Immortal".
Master Chu continued, "He achieved immortality in ancient times, knowing secrets from all ages. The power he controls is beyond what we ordinary mortals can challenge."
"With the arrival of the Great Era, the ancient creatures buried deep within the wilderness are slowly crawling out from their coffins. To survive in this era, we must resurrect Immortal Eternity to protect us!"
Lu Yang hesitated a moment before asking, "How do we resurrect Immortal Eternity?"
"He became immortal through war and killing. He loves slaughter. We must stir up a bloody catastrophe in this world, pleasing Immortal Eternity with the death of millions of humans. That's the first step. The next steps are not for your kind to know."
"Millions of humans dying?!" Meng Jingzhou was shocked. How many deaths would that amount to? Corpses strewn across the field would be an understatement!
"A lot? Not at all." Master Chu shook his head. Most people would react similarly upon hearing that number. But think about it calmly, the Central Continent is vast and the number seems large, but if you average it out, it's only one death per few thousand people.
"Do you know how many people die each year from the hardships of life? From suicide caused by unbearable pressures? From illness? From malpractice by quacks? How many unclaimed bodies does the Great Xia dynasty find each year?"
Master Chu sneered, "Do you know? Of course, you don't. Because the Great Xia dynasty dares not reveal the true data!"
"If we don't resurrect Immortal Eternity, who will protect the vast Central Continent? When the old monsters start to awaken, there will be far more deaths."
"Is the Great Era really that terrifying?" Lu Yang's heart was chilled.
Without a word, Master Chu motioned for the three to follow him.
Master Chu circled around the statue of Immortal Eternity, traversed through a field of ruins, saying as he walked, "These remains have come down from ancient times and deteriorated over time. Ten thousand years ago, our founding patriarch accidentally discovered this place and learned of the existence of Immortal Eternity."
"Immortal Eternity's existence is too ancient, the world has forgotten the Immortal who once protected it. Our founding patriarch brought Immortal Eternity back into the world!"
"The patriarch made a copy of the ruins to keep at each stronghold. This place is one of them and has a history of ten thousand years."
Meng Jingzhou thought, so this is a copy of ancient ruins. No wonder he couldn't tell. Very few things from ancient times have been preserved to this day.
Master Chu stopped in front of a stone wall, "Here. This depicts an ancient ritual scene."
The first thing that caught their eye was the figure of Immortal Eternity, with open arms, on the stone wall. Within the arms of Immortal Eternity held countless orbs of different sizes. Some orbs were surrounded by ring-like objects, the purpose of which was uncertain.
There were small human figures kneeling on each orb, offering gifts to Immortal Eternity.
"What are these orbs, and why are people standing on them?" Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu were confused and baffled.
Lu Yang's pupils shrank slightly at the sight of the mural. These orbs look a lot like the planets from his previous life. The rings around the planets are made of asteroid dust.
Master Chu slowly explained, "These are called planets. In ancient times there was no Central Continent. Every race lived on planets."
"At the end of ancient times, an unknown entity refined all the planets into today's Central Continent!"
Upon hearing this, all three were shocked!

chapters.title: Chapter 81 - 80: Stars and Continent_1
chapters.content:
Master Chu's words startled all three of them, especially Lu Yang, who thought of many other things.
When they first entered the Seek Dao Sect, they were given a general map of the Sect, which was marked with an area of one hundred thousand miles in diameter. The concept of such a vast area was equivalent to ten earth planets mashed together— it was so gigantic!
Keeping in mind the descriptions of the Refining the Void and Unification Stages from the ancient texts, only such colossal areas could possibly accommodate the grandeur of their magical prowess.
There were many forbidden areas in their Sect. These places were mostly used by strong cultivators for magical duels. Those with insufficient cultivation levels would perish if they so much as grazed the boundaries of those areas.
When they first joined, the Eldest Senior Sister had mentioned, "The Sect is too vast to detail in just a few words. You can gradually explore it over time." It wasn't because she was too lazy to explain, but the Seek Dao Sect was indeed massive and required gradual exploration.
Thinking about this, the Seek Dao Sect could possibly be the result of merging several planets!
The area occupied by the Seek Dao Sect was but a small corner of the Central Continent, and it was hard to imagine just how enormous the Central Continent truly was!
Master Chu continued, "In ancient times, there were thousands, if not millions, of life-bearing stars, even more. The exact number is impossible to ascertain now."
"In ancient times, cultivators who reached the Divinity Transformation Stage no longer needed magic artifacts. They could fly from one star to another. The entire universe was littered with damaged stars, the result of cultivators fighting each other!"
"The prosperity of the ancient times was truly awe-inspiring. So many legends and powerful cultivators were borne during that time."
"The measure of a cultivator's power was the number of planets one blast could destroy, and their influence was judged by how many life-bearing planets were under their rule."
"During the height of the ancient world's prosperity, a formidable entity emerged. He refined all the stars in the sky into a whole continent. Whether the planets had life or not, none could escape his grasp."
"The Central Continent is teeming with life as it was formed by life-bearing stars — it is the best place for cultivation!"
"The vast ocean east of the Central Continent was once a water-covered star."
"The Golden Buddha Kingdom to the west of the Central Continent was once an uninhabitable desolate star."
"The same goes for the Southern Demon Realm and the areas in the extreme north."
Master Chu's words shook the understanding of the world, as perceived by Lu Yang and the other two. They could not have imagined that the land beneath their feet was a refined star!
This was beyond their imagination!
"Who had refined the stars?" Lu Yang asked.
Master Chu shook his head. It wasn't that Lu Yang's status wasn't enough, but that he truly did not know. "The true form is impossible to verify, but it can be affirmed that that entity was definitely an Immortal!"
This power, utterly transcending the mortal world, was something not achievable by those in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage!
"Why that entity chose to refine stars into continents and what method he used remains a mystery."
Master Chu continued, "One thing for sure is that the method used by that being was extremely brutal, devoid of mercy. Who knows how many people living on the stars survived his tampering? Even ordinary cultivators would find it hard to survive."
"Whoever survived either had high cultivation levels or, more likely, good luck!"
"At that time, the rising geniuses and great powers resisted, but they were all turned into blood mists by that entity and sent into reincarnation."
"Fortunately, at the time, the Immortal Eternity took action and saved the majority of the human race, preventing them from extinction."
"The prosperous Great Era perished and collapsed, and for a long time, no geniuses emerged."
"The location of that being is unknown, but he definitely didn't die. With the arrival of the next Great Era, who knows if that being will show up. If he goes on a killing spree then, who could stop him?"
"Only the Immortal Eternity!"
"So, for the sake of everyone and ourselves, we must resurrect the Immortal Eternity!"
"Only a small number of people would die in the resurrection of the Immortal Eternity. However, if we don't resurrect the Immortal Eternity, perhaps the whole human race will be obliterated!"
"It's a shame that those from the Righteous Path, who believe they hold moral high ground, don't realize that we of the Eternity Sect are also dedicating ourselves for the human race!"
Master Chu's words were firm and definite, and determination shone in his eyes.
From a moral standpoint, they were killing to save lives, while personally, they had justifiable reasons for the killings, assuaging their guilt.
The reason why the Eternity Sect only recruited those from the Demon Path was that this kind of explanation aligned best with their mentality.
Lu Yang felt a chill in his heart. Just listening to Master Chu's speech, he felt as though he could go mad blindly worshiping Immortal Eternity, praying for the world's salvation.
Not everything Master Chu said necessarily represented the truth or at least not the whole truth. Lu Yang didn't believe that the Seek Dao Sect knew nothing about the events of the ancient past, and he didn't believe that the Eldest Senior Sister was entirely unprepared for this.
Meng Jingzhou asked, "If that's the case, why not cooperate with the Righteous Path? Wouldn't it be easier to achieve success if everyone worked together?"
Master Chu sneered, "Who can guarantee that the being who refined the stars was not hiding among those in the Righteous Path?"
"The founder of our Sect, after thorough investigation, believed that the one who refined the stars is somewhere in the Righteous Path, either in the Five Great Immortal Sects or in the Great Xia Dynasty."
"Isn't the reason why the Righteous Path promotes order to encourage more people to cultivate and make the Central Continent more prosperous?"
"But what comes after prosperity? Don't forget the painful experiences at the end of the ancient times."
"Maybe that being likes to harvest life, and when life is flourishing again, he will take action!"
What Master Chu said represented the mainstream thought in the Eternity Sect.
Master Chu added, "The stars above us seem to hang on the horizon, but if your cultivation reaches a certain level and you fly into the universe to see, you would find that most of them are merely remnants of the ancient times. There might be some real existing stars that have slipped through the net, but certainly not many."
Master Chu said all this to inspire their sincere belief in the Immortal Eternity. Looking at their amazed faces, it seemed like he had no reason to worry.
"Alright, I understand that this information may come as quite a shock to you. Take some time to process it."
"Also, the three of you showed good performance in the three trials. The Sect is in need of efficient people now, and most are currently resting in their cells. As you all are at the Foundation Establishment Stage, you qualify for the role of Managers. After some thought, I decided to promote you to the manager positions."
Master Chu handed over three tokens to them, symbolizing their roles as Eternity Sect Managers.
In reality, Master Chu had intended for Lu Yang and the others to become Managers all along. The whole chain of events prior to this was only meant for those who had reached the position of Managers to know.
Master Chu suggested, "On another note, feel free to visit your fellow disciples when you have the time. I heard that the food in the prison isn't that great, so perhaps bringing them some would help establish bonds."
People on the Demon Path do protect their interests, but they are also known to make clear distinctions between gratitude and grudges. Those below were constantly plotting against each other, making his role as a Rudder Master difficult.
However, what Master Chu really worried about was not that his subordinates would play tricks on Lu Yang and the others. He was worried about his subordinates being killed by them.
Lu Yang responded with a beaming smile, "We're all Sect brothers. We'll definitely unite and work together towards resurrecting the Immortal Eternity. You can rest assured, Master Chu."
For some reason, Master Chu felt even more uneasy after hearing this.

chapters.title: Chapter 82 - 81: Stone Hidden Weapon_1
chapters.content:
"Master Chu, you didn't pay the bill after dinner last time. Do you plan on paying now or later?" Man Gu asked before leaving.
Lu Yang quickly stopped Man Gu, "Hold your tongue! We are on the Demon Path, it's only natural for us to dine and dash. Do you think Master Chu is the type of person to pay for his meal like some kind of saint?"
Meng Jingzhou also chimed in, "Exactly. Master Chu only said he would treat us to dinner, not that he would pay. How can you not tell the difference?"
Master Chu: "..."
He had to admit that when it came to ribbing others, these three were unmatched.
Suppressing the urge to murder them, he threw a gold ingot at Man Gu, "Keep the change and get lost!"
A confused look fell upon Man Gu's face. He was simply asking for money, but there was something off about Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou's tone. It seemed like they were speaking up for him, but also on Master Chu's side.
By the time the trio left, it was deep into the night. Lu Yang gazed at the magnificent starry sky above and pondered.
"Who would've expected all the stars in the sky to be fake? I certainly didn't see this coming."
Meng Jingzhou rubbed his head, "I don't see why it's so surprising. Since I was a child, my grandpa would always tell me that if I wanted something, he would get it for me. Even the stars in the sky. When I was seven or eight, I pointed to one star and said, 'I want that one.'"
"My grandpa went off into space, and when he returned, he handed me a speck of light the size of a fingernail, saying it was a star. Coincidentally, there was one star less in the sky."
"I told my grandpa that stars should be really big, even bigger than our house, not so small. But he just smiled mysteriously and told me that stars are really this small."
"What happened then?" Lu Yang asked with curious interest.
"What happened next? Well, people from the Ministry of Punishments came. They were high-ranking officers who accused my grandpa of stealing natural resources. They asked him to return the star, and he did. Then a star reappeared in the vacant spot in the night sky."
"I remember something was off back then, but I couldn't figure out what. I forgot about it over time, and it wasn't until today that I realized what I held in my hand back then really was a star."
"It's truly befitting of the Meng family. Your experiences from childhood are undoubtedly different from ours." Lu Yang shook his head, thinking about what he was doing when he was a child.
He remembered. When he was a child, he was reminiscing about crossing into another world and studying ancient poetry like "High up on a hundred-foot tower, one can pluck the stars in the sky. But one dares not speak loudly for fear of frightening the people in the sky."
When he was a kid, he could only pluck stars from poetry, while Meng Jingzhou could really pluck stars. That was the difference.
Recently, Lu Yang had even considered writing a novel to make some money, something like "The Wandering Earth". But if he based it on this world, it wouldn't be a planet engine pushing the Earth, but a Great Power cultivator doing the pushing.
The trio stopped pondering over stars and continents. These things were too far beyond their reach. With their cultivation level, they couldn't even move a large rock, let alone the stars.
"Let's rest early. Tomorrow, we will visit our imprisoned sect brothers."
Yawning, all three knew that they could substitute sleep with meditation once they reached the Foundation Establishment Stage. The effect was the same, but they preferred sleeping.
Meditation? They would worry about that when they reached the Golden Core Stage.
...
Early in the morning, Lu Yang sought out Guard Captain Wei. After explaining his intention, Captain Wei happily issued a pass for Lu Yang to visit the jail.
As soon as he entered the jail, Lu Yang felt as if his spiritual essence was imprisoned. He couldn't mobilize any of it, and his body became sluggish.
"Is this the Forbidden Spirit Array that Wei mentioned?" Lu Yang was amazed. He didn't expect the Forbidden Spirit Array to be as formidable as Wei had described.
When Captain Wei gave Lu Yang the pass, he had mentioned to be aware of the jail's Forbidden Spirit Array, which was specifically designed against cultivators. Inside this array, a cultivator's cultivation level would be restricted and they would not be able to use any magic skill. This was to prevent cultivators from breaking out or escaping prison.
The Forbidden Spirit Array in the jail was of a high caliber. Even Golden Core Stage cultivators would be restricted, no exceptions.
Lu Yang timed his visit perfectly with the shift change of the jail guards.
The day shift jail guard was yawning so hard that tears came out of his eyes. He was in a daze, looking as if he had just woken up.
The night shift jail guard was about to go off duty, and was in a good mood. He joked, "Old Zhou, aren't you usually the most energetic? Why are you so drowsy today? Did you do something naughty last night that made you lose sleep?"
Old Zhou yawned greatly, "I don't know what's going on lately, but I've been unable to wake up. My wife is the same. When I came to work, I even washed my face, but I'm still tired."
The night shift jail guard laughed, "You must've done something last night and lost sleep. Look at me, I'm not tired at all."
Old Zhou snorted, "You're a cultivator, not like us ordinary folks."
The night shift guard shrugged, unimpressed, "I'm only at the Qi Refinement first level. It's uncertain whether I will ever be able to reach the second level in this lifetime. What kind of cultivator does that make me?"
According to the jail rules, the day shift jail guards were ordinary people, while the night shift guards were cultivators at Qi Refinement first level. The cultivators at Qi Refinement first level could ensure that they weren't drowsy or negligent during their shift.
Cultivators disliked being suppressed by the Forbidden Spirit Array and treated like ordinary people, but the jail couldn't be guarded by just a first level Qi Refinement jail guard. Hence, expert cultivators were arranged to guard outside the jail.
After the shift change, Lu Yang took his pass to Old Zhou.
Old Zhou took a look at Lu Yang, did a body search, and let him in when he found nothing more than a lunch box.
...
Chi Xulong was a well-known figure among the scattered cultivators of the Demon Path. He believed he could achieve great things and establish his own territory after joining the demonic sect.
Now, being trapped in jail couldn't dampen his aspirations.
Since he was in jail, he would become the top dog! The first obstacle in his way was his inability to intimidate others.
He was locked in a cage that even Foundation Establishment Stage cultivators couldn't break, and without a weapon in hand. The person locked in the cell next to him kept either insulting or mocking him, much to Chi Xulong's annoyance.
At this time, his cellmate Shen Jinyi came up with a solution. He put pebbles in his mouth and spat them out, making the pebbles fly out like bullets with a terrifying force. You could imagine what would happen if they hit someone.
As an assassin, Shen Jinyi was good at using various objects as hidden weapons.
"We're partners in adversity. We need to cooperate sincerely and overcome this together!" Shen Jinyi said nobly, "Once you learn this skill, you'll be invincible in this prison, and we can rule it together!"
Chi Xulong was greatly inspired and began training to launch pebbles as hidden weapons from his mouth day and night.
Unfortunately, Chi Xulong was not talented enough. Despite his brute force, he couldn't get a grasp of the skill.
"You have to do it like this. Hold your breath in your mouth and spit out the pebble quickly!" Shen Jinyi was demonstrating and patiently teaching Chi Xulong.
"I know, isn't it just spitting it out like this?" Chi Xulong said impatiently.
"No, no, you're only puckering your mouth a little. Do it like this,"
"Like this?"
Standing outside the cell, Lu Yang observed Chi Xulong and Shen Jinyi as they puckered their mouths at each other. He wondered whether he should remind them that their actions might be misunderstood by others.
But first, he decided to record this with the Recording Orb.

chapters.title: Chapter 83 - 82: Reporting the Facts_1
chapters.content:
"Long time no see, I came to bring you food," said Lu Yang, in an amiable manner, a trait perfected by working in a barbecue shop.
After over a month of practice, Lu Yang's fake smile had reached a level of realism that even Meng Jingzhou applauded him for his genuine seeming cheerfulness.
Chi Xulong, with an annoyed expression, heard Lu Yang's voice and abruptly turned his head. His eyes revealed a fierce look. "Would I be in such a rut if it weren't for you bringing the constable over for a meal?"
"Why are you here?" Chi Xulong asked gruffly. This brat had tricked him into thinking he was an examiner the moment they met. He had even set him up during their meal a few days ago. He was nothing but a cunning troublemaker! Adding to this, his faux amiable appearance further underscored his ulterior motives.
Compared to a ruthless murderer like himself, Chi Xulong thought that Lu Yang was even worse!
Lu Yan didn't have any desire to mock Chi Xulong in jail. They all have to help each other out in the future. There's no need to spoil their relationship, this was also the intention of the Rudder Master.
However, Lu Yan misheard Chi Xulong's question as an inquiry about his promotion to the Manager position: "What? How did you know that I was promoted to Manager? But don't get too excited. As long as you perform well, you can become a Manager too."
Unexpectedly, Chi Xulong seemed to be fairly knowledgeable even in jail.
Lu Yang then proudly displayed his Waist Card engraved prominently with the title "Manager", infuriating Chi Xulong to the point where he was ready to breathe fire."The Gods must be blind!"
Lu Yang then comforted him, "Don't be upset, the Master asked me to pass on a message to you."
Chi Xulong calmed down upon hearing that it was a message from Master Chu. He assumed that the Master regarded him highly and especially sent a message for him,"What did the old man say?"
"He said that you'd better get along well with me."
Taken aback by this, Chi Xulong was livid. The Master seemed to be favouring this kid, "Over my dead body will I ever get along with you!"
Seeing that Chi Xulong actually defied the Master's order, Lu Yang sighed, left some food and walked out.
The other convicts smelled the delicious food, causing them to drool. The prison didn't serve food this good.
To the other convicts, Lu Yang was very kind. He encouraged them to reflect on their deeds while in prison and contribute to the Central Continent's progress after their release. His words were filled with concern.
Obviously, they were not sentenced for a decade or more.
After leaving the prison, Lu Yang truthfully reported the situation to Master Chu,"I went to the prison with food for Chi Xulong. I mentioned that there must have been some misunderstanding and we all belong to the same group. In the future, we will inevitably work together. By maintaining good relations, it would be conducive to future work.
I also emphasized that this was Master's idea and mentioned that he could also become a Manager if he behaves well."
"But who would have expected Chi Xulong to get furious and curse? He said who would turn a blind eye to me being a Manager. He would rather die than develop a good relationship with me. I can't remember the exact words, but the general meaning was like this."
Master Chu's gaze suddenly turned cold,"Who did he say was blind?!"
Lu Yang quickly bowed, keeping his eyes fixed on Master Chu. He nervously replied,"The person he insulted has a high status. This is very disrespectful, I dare not say it."
Master Chu seemed to have already figured out the answer, "Alright, that's enough. I know, go back."
Lu Yang sighed, thinking that Chi Xulong couldn't keep his mouth shut. He blurted out anything that came to his mind,"Please, Master, don't hold what I said against me or think I got it wrong."
Master Chu impatiently waved his hand. He had enough of this.
After Lu Yang left, Master Chu knocked on his jade chair and coldly chuckled,"A good one, Chi Xulong. How dare he say that I am blind!"
...
During the day, Meng Jingzhou wandered around as usual, Man Gu was exercising in the backyard, Ghoul was threading beads in the main hall, and Lu Yang was washing clothes.
Lu Yang's clothes were ordinary and couldn't maintain cleanliness on their own.
"Damn, why can't I learn the Cleaning Clothes Spell," Lu Yang grumbled, vigorously scrubbing his clothes, "Once I have enough money, I must buy clothes that don't require washing."
He had previously asked Meng Jingzhou to teach him the Cleaning Clothes Spell. Although Meng Jingzhou was no expert, he had a book titled, "Small Magic Skills for Daily Life", which his sister had sneaked into his bag when he left home.
The book mentioned a spell called the Cleaning Clothes Spell.
The Cleaning Clothes Spell, as its name implies, can make clothes clean, and is easy to learn.
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu were the first to master it. With a burst of refreshing Spiritual Energy from the skies, their dirty clothes turned as white as new in no time.
Both of them were pleased as they often dirtied their clothes while working at the barbecue shop.
With Meng Jingzhou's stature, he had access to clothes specially made for him. Not needing to be cleaned, they were automatically kept clean. But the quality of these clothes was too high, revealing his heavy background, thus not conducive to his covert operation in the demonic sect.
It was widely known that Lu Yang was gifted in magic. He too, picked up the spell, but his results were a bit unexpected.
After casting the Cleaning Clothes Spell, with a twist in the air, a new set of clothes appeared out of nowhere.
At that moment, Lu Yang remained silent for a while, wanting to curse but not knowing where to even begin.
In terms of order this was the first spatial spell that Lu Yang had learned, and it was of great significance.
In terms of innovation, it was a breakthrough in the Cleaning Clothes Spell– it was like creating a whole new spatial spell.
In terms of logic, it defied logic.
Looking at the clothes tagged with "For So-and-so", Lu Yang understood that they probably belonged to a tailor's shop crafted for a specific customer, who didn't get the chance to collect them because they were summoned by his spatial spell.
"Why did the Cleaning Clothes Spell I cast summon a new set of clothes? What happens if I cast the Body Cleaning Spell?" Lu Yang exclaimed angrily, thinking the gods were jealous of his magical talent and were deliberately restricting it.
Of course, these clothes couldn't be worn. They belonged to someone else and Lu Yang didn't even know who they belonged to, let alone return them.
Meng Jingzhou generously offered to cast the actual Cleaning Clothes Spell to wash Lu Yang's clothes. Despite several trials, he failed.
The Cleaning Clothes Spell could only clean clothes worn by the spell caster. Lu Yang obviously couldn't take off his clothes to let Meng Jingzhou wear and clean them, only to hand them back afterwards.
Perhaps, he just had to resign himself to the arduous task of laundering clothes normally.
Finishing the washing, Lu Yang attempted to hang the clothes out of the window. Unexpectedly, the clothes pole slipped and was about to hit a passerby below.
"Watch out!"
Surprisingly, the passerby nimbly sidestepped to avoid the clothes pole.
Lu Yang hastily descended the stairs only to discover that the passerby was Lan Ting from the Laurel Fairy Palace, who had previously aided him in Song Mountain.
It had been over a month, what was she still doing around here? He was perplexed.
Lan Ting lowered her head and silently stared at the fallen clothes pole. Her eyebrows knit in contemplation, as though pondering over something.
Curiously, Lu Yang asked,"What are you thinking about?"
Almost instantaneously Lan Ting responded, "I was wondering why the clothes pole fell to the ground instead of going up into the sky. Could there be an invisible force pulling all things in the world downwards?"
Lu Yang was left speechless."...

chapters.title: Chapter 84 - 83 The Secret Mission of Lan Ting_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang teased from the sideline, "This invisible force is everywhere, is it called gravity?"
Upon hearing the familiar voice, Lan Ting looked up and saw Lu Yang. "Oh, it's you," she said.
"Let's talk inside," Lu Yang worried that Lan Ting would reveal their true identities.
With Lan Ting's extremely beautiful appearance, standing at the door was bound to draw attention, making it easy for prying ears to overhear their conversation.
As soon as Lan Ting entered, she saw the ghoul diligently skewering meat and realized it was the ghost of the tiger demon left behind.
Seeing Lu Yang and Lan Ting walk in, the two ghouls silently picked up their meat-filled bowl and skewering sticks, and continued skewering at the table in the corner.
Observing their skillful actions, Lan Ting even thought that the ghouls had done this type of work when they were alive.
Man Gu, who was in the backyard, heard the commotion and stopped his cultivation to come to the hall.
Meng Jingzhou, who had ended a day of wandering, entered the door and exclaimed, "Did you hear? Yanjiang County has its own festival called the Spring Festival, which is half a month away, featuring spring outings and enjoying nature, with a grand poetry and music event at night, making it incredibly lively. People from the nearby counties will all come over."
"The locals in Yanjiang County even get a three-day vacation."
"I also heard that every year, the brothels raise their prices for those days, making a fortune. Should we seize the opportunity and hold a big promotion, for example, to celebrate the two-month anniversary of our restaurant opening?"
Meng Jingzhou proved that he wasn't just out playing, he was also gathering information, although this information wasn't very useful to the three of them.
Man Gu's eyes lit up and he was about to talk, but then he saw Lu Yang's emotionless gaze and shut his mouth silently.
Meng Jingzhou noticed Lan Ting and was surprised, "I remember you, are you Lan Ting from the Laurel Fairy Palace?"
They have been here for more than a month to open a barbecue restaurant, oh no, for infiltrating into the demonic sect, while Lan Ting is here for what?
"Indeed, that's me," Lan Ting said softly.
Lan Ting also found the three of them interesting. She had stayed in Yanjiang County for over a month and had heard about the famous barbecue restaurant, but she was naturally fond of tranquility and disliked noisy places, so she never came over.
Today, as she happened to pass by, she realized that this barbecue restaurant was run by people she knew, and they were even disciples of the Immortal Sects.
It seems that these three really made a big accomplishment in Yanjiang County.
Could it be that besides eliminating monsters and demons, the mission of the Seek Dao Sect also includes running a business and making money? Considering the reputation of the Seek Dao Sect, it's not impossible.
Lan Ting heard her senior sisters saying that in the Seek Dao Sect's contribution point exchange rewards, there was a "Sect Leader's One-Day Tour", an award that the other four Immortal Sects didn't have.
"You've been in Yanjiang County for this long without leaving, are you on a mission? If you need any help, feel free to ask. We know some constables in Yanjiang County, and we even have connections in the jail," said Lu Yang warmly.
Being from the Five Great Immortal Sects, they should help each other.
Nowadays, Lu Yang and his team could cover the sky with just one hand in Yanjiang County. On the surface, they were enthusiastic citizens who helped Guard Captain Wei catch criminals, and constables often gathered here for meals. In secret, they were seeds of the Demon Path who were valued by the Rudder Master of Yanjiang Rudder. Their true identities were core disciples of the Seek Dao Sect.
Who could compete with them when it comes to their background?
Lan Ting went silent. She was here on a secret mission and shouldn't come into contact with outsiders. Otherwise, after helping Lu Yang defeat the tiger, she wouldn't have just asked symbolically for two tiger skins and left.
Now, more than a month had passed, and there was no progress. She was anxious.
The three before her eyes were an opportunity, perhaps they could help her!
Lan Ting was silent for a moment, took a couple of deep breaths to stabilize her breathing, and said seriously to the three of them, "I am on a secret mission. Please do not divulge what I am going to tell you today, since it may jeopardize my safety! Please do not be too shocked after you hear it!"
Seeing Lan Ting being so serious, the three of them straightened their backs.
"I have to infiltrate the Eternity Sect as an undercover agent!"
Their eyes all blinked simultaneously, as if they had misheard.
Lan Ting continued, "This is reliable information obtained by our Laurel Fairy Palace through special channels, revealing that the Four Great Devil Sects all plan to recruit believers on a large scale. The Yaoyang Sect has finished recruiting while the other three are in the process."
"There is a sub-branch of the Eternity Sect in Yanjiang County, called Yanjiang Rudder. The Rudder Master is mysterious, whose identity isn't clear, and even the surname is unknown to anyone."
"Among all the branches of the Eternity Sect, Yanjiang Rudder is one of the lower-ranking ones. The general cultivation level of its members is relatively low, making it suitable for a Foundation Establishment Stage disciple like me to infiltrate. If planned properly, there's even a chance to mix into the upper ranks of Yanjiang Rudder."
"My senior sisters have very high cultivation levels and are too noticeable. Moreover, they are well-known in the outside world, which is not conducive to infiltration. After some discussion, this task fell onto me."
The "fame" that Lan Ting mentioned about her senior sisters referred to their extraordinary beauty which had previously appeared in some banned books to satisfy some men's fantasies.
Lan Ting sighed, "However, I have been in Yanjiang County for over a month and haven't found the location of Yanjiang Rudder yet. I don't even know if the testing period is over yet, I hope it's not too late!"
Lan Ting looked at the trio with a hopeful look in her eyes, especially at the very reliable Lu Yang, hoping that they could provide some help.
Silently, all three of them pulled out the waist card given by the Rudder Master. The word "manager" was particularly noticeable.
"Sorry, we're already part of the Eternity Sect," they said.
Lan Ting: "!!!?"
"Oh, don't panic. What we mean is that we have successfully infiltrated the Eternity Sect," Lu Yang added.
Lan Ting relaxed, thinking the three had defected, but it turned out to be just an infiltration...wait, that's not right either.
"How did you manage to get into the Eternity Sect?"
Lu Yang felt a bit awkward. How should he explain this? They simply took part in a regular test and successfully passed.
Meng Jingzhou proudly said, "We performed exceptionally well in the sect disciples' selection, so the Eternity Sect thought we were very suitable for the demonic sect, and chose us."
Man Gu didn't understand what Meng Jingzhou was proud of.
Lu Yang, in a simple language, narrated how they had found Qin Yuanhao's letter in the tiger demon's lair, located Qin Yuanhao according to the letter, and then learned about the recruitment of disciples and the location of Yanjiang Rudder.
Lan Ting was full of regrets. If she had just followed Lu Yang's actions at the beginning, she wouldn't have wasted more than a month. She didn't even find the entrance to Yanjiang Rudder, while others had already made a way into the high ranks of Yanjiang Rudder.
"You should be able to recruit ordinary disciples like Qin Yuanhao, right? Can you recruit me?" she asked.
