Lu Yang shook his head, "Ordinary disciples cannot access Eternity Sect's confidential information. You must go through the test organized by Eternity Sect's headquarters. To be honest, I don't think you can pass the test, and there's a very high chance of exposing your identity."
Lan Ting looked down in disappointment. However, Lu Yang continued, "On the other hand, we can create a new identity for you, claiming that you are my distant relative or something and come here to seek shelter. On the surface, you work at the barbecue restaurant. When we are on a mission, you can help from the side, which can be considered as completing a part of the mission."
"Really?" Lan Ting didn't expect such good news.
Man Gu hadn't expected that the barbecue restaurant was finally getting a new staff member.
Lu Yang nodded, "Of course. As a Foundation Establishment Stage cultivator, you possess considerable combat power, which would be a great help to us. But you are too conspicuous, so you need to disguise yourself. By the way, do you know the Transformation Technique? If not, I can teach you."

chapters.title: Chapter 85 - 84 Front Street Tofu Shop_1
chapters.content:
Upon seeing Lu Yang perform his Imitation Fist, only to appear like Man Gu, Lan Ting silently took out a yellow charm paper.
She might as well draw a Transforming Talisman herself.
True to form, the Immortal Sect, famous for its imagination and magic skills, used a martial technique to emulate a Transformation Technique. This showcased deep comprehension of magic skills, a feat only possible through profound understanding.
It was evident that Lu Yang's understanding of magic skills had reached a point where he saw beyond the realm of technique, delving directly into the source of it all.
Among those of the same rank, Lan Ting believed no one matched Lu Yang's proficiency in magic skills.
Lu Yang then remembered -- Lan Ting had previously taken the tiger skin to make talismans, it seemed she had considerable attainments in the field of runes.
Lan Ting pointed to her own eyes, "My eyes are a bit unique. They are extremely sensitive to patterns, capable of discerning the core of inscriptions and the Array Eye of the Array Method. I have a natural knack for creating talismans and drawing arrays.
"However, my energy is limited. I mainly focus on making talismans. I only dabble in the Array Method."
Though Lan Ting spoke modestly, in reality, this was an extraordinary gift. This talent was destined to allow her to go far in the fields of runes and array method, inspiring envy among many masters of runes and arrays.
Soon, Lan Ting had drawn a Transformation Talisman. She pasted it on herself, and her stunning beauty instantly turned ordinary. It was quite magical.
In this way, the barbecue shop welcomed a new employee.
...
Two days after Lan Ting joined the barbecue shop, it was as busy as ever. With the addition of the new employee, the workload of the three of them was considerably lightened.
Lu Yang noticed Man Gu seemed unhappy. As he served dishes to the customers, he used his Spiritual Sense to ask, "What happened? You don't seem to be very happy?"
Man Gu nodded, "Brother Lu, have you noticed that the number of customers in our barbecue shop has decreased in the past few days? I've calculated the revenue of these past days, it's indeed the case."
Lu Yang was taken aback, he had not noticed this: "Is it because of Lan Ting?"
Having a female employee should only improve business.
"No, it started to decrease before Lan Ting arrived. I haven't figured out why it's happening. I don't know where we went wrong." Man Gu had been pondering this problem.
Lu Yang did not mind, he preferred if the barbecue shop was less busy: "Well you keep thinking about it, I'm off to deliver food."
A month ago, at Meng Jingzhou's suggestion, the barbecue shop added a home delivery service. During the day, a box is placed at the door. Anyone who wants to order takeout just writes what they want, the delivery time, and the address on a piece of paper, and throws it into the box. In the evening, the three of them take turns delivering.
Today, it was Lu Yang's turn.
Lu Yang hadn't been out at night for the past few days. This time, stepping out, he found that the number of pedestrians on the street had decreased from before.
Perhaps this is why the customer flow of the barbecue shop declined, Lu Yang thought.
"Let me see where I'm delivering this time... to the tofu shop on Front Street?"
...
Wen Xiangyu had heard some time ago that a very popular barbecue shop had opened in the vicinity. She really wanted to try whether it was as delicious as the rumours implied, but ever since her husband passed away, she inherited his tofu shop. As such, she seldom went out at night.
Not to boast, but she vaguely knew that with her fair skin and beautiful looks, she attracted many admirers. Going out alone was inherently dangerous.
Lately, she heard that the barbecue shop provided a delivery service. She wrote down what she wanted on a piece of paper and dropped it into the box outside the barbecue shop.
She had been very sleepy these past few days, today being even worse. She could hardly stay awake before the skewers arrived, so she went to bed early.
The barbecue shop delivery person should be able to wake her up.
...
Luk Zhi was a thief who had caused a lot of headaches for the constables lately. He would typically sneak into people's houses at night, steal their possessions while they were fast asleep, and quickly evacuate, leaving very few clues. When the constables questioned the neighbours for information, the answers they got were that everyone slept too deeply to notice anything outside.
This time, he targeted the tofu shop on Front Street. The tofu shop owner was a renowned beautiful widow. The tofu she made was famous far and wide, making a fortune these past years and becoming the envy of the stores around her.
With his agile body, Luk Zhi easily climbed onto the roof like a monkey and silently twisted open a second-floor window.
"She should be asleep."
Luk Zhi was quite confident. He had obtained a yellow charm by chance that tasks everyone within fifty meters into a sound sleep. This method never failed him.
Luk Zhi crept with bated breath and saw the beautiful woman lying on the bed. A triumphant smile crossed his face.
Then he turned to rummage through the cupboard looking for valuables. Based on his experience, women tended to keep their belongings over here.
"Nothing?" Luk Zhi frowned, glancing back at the tofu shop's owner.
If it wasn't here, it should be under the bed.
He cautiously crouched down, peered under the bed, and his heart skipped a beat.
There was a face under the bed!
"A ghost!"
...
Zheng Shouhe was a rapist who had been causing headaches for the constables recently. He often hid under the beds of single women well in advance, and when the women were sleeping, he would crawl out and violate them.
However, there were times when he would encounter women having affairs, in which case he could only stay hidden under the bed and wait.
This time, he targeted the tofu shop on Front Street. The tofu shop's owner was a well-known beautiful widow who had enchanted many.
Zheng Shouhe, like before, hid under the bed early on, waiting for nightfall to have his way with the owner of the tofu shop.
"So sleepy." Zheng Shouhe had never been as sleepy as he was today. Usually, the longer he waited, the more energetic he felt, but today, for some reason, he felt sleepy.
His eyelids were drooping, and he tried to open his eyes several times but couldn't resist the sleepiness. Soon, he fell asleep.
A scream woke him up. It seemed someone was shouting 'ghost' or something.
Zheng Shouhe eyes snapped open. He saw Luk Zhi under the bed, staring at him in horror. Instantly, he acted. One hand shot out and covered Luk Zhi's mouth, while the other hand reached behind his waist, pulled out a dagger, and pushed it against Luk Zhi's neck.
Zheng Shouhe then saw Wen Xiangyu curled up on the bed, quivering with fear.
Obviously, Luk Zhi's scream had awakened Wen Xiangyu too.
"You too! What an unlucky day!"
Zheng Shouhe growled while fetching a rope to tie Luk Zhi up. Deciding to have his way with Wen Xiangyu first, he planned to kill them both afterwards.
At that moment, a knock came from downstairs.
"Is anyone there? I have your food delivery."
Zheng Shouhe clicked his tongue irritably. He had terrible luck today. He secured Luk Zhi and made Wen Xiangyu come downstairs with him.
Zheng Shouhe threatened Wen Xiangyu with the dagger and whispered, "Make the guy outside go away!"
Everyone in Yanjiang County knew the beautiful widow who owned the tofu shop lived alone. If he asked the person outside to leave, and that person heard a male voice, they would definitely become suspicious.
"You can leave it at the door. I'll pick it up later." Wen Xiangyu said nervously.
"No can do. You haven't paid me yet." Responded the person at the door.
Zheng Shouhe's face turned fierce, "You're really asking for it!"

chapters.title: Chapter 86 - 85 Reverse Life Talisman (Inevitable update for the Alliance Master Star)_1
chapters.content:
"Open the door for him!" Zheng Shouhe's hand was tightly clutching a dagger, pressed against Wen Xiangyu's back.
Wen Xiangyu had no choice but to open the door.
Opening the door revealed a handsome face, belonging to Lu Yang.
Wen Xiangyu desperately signaled to Lu Yang with her eyes, telling him to run, but Lu Yang gave no indication of seeing it. Instead, he donned a professional facade, a forced smile, "Your kebabs."
Zheng Shouhe too, put on a professional facade, it was all too easy to lure this seemingly honest youth in, "Young man, please come in and sit. Let me get your money."
Lu Yang, seemingly oblivious, walked in, looking around at the pitch-dark room, he chuckled, "Not even a candle lit, it's a bit early to be asleep, don't you think?"
Seeing Lu Yang naively walking in, Wen Xiangyu was on edge, she steeled herself, attempting to push Lu Yang out.
Zheng Shouhe immediately saw through Wen Xiangyu's intentions, but it was too late - he chuckled coldly, threw Wen Xiangyu behind him, and lunged at Lu Yang with the dagger in the dark.
Zheng Shouhe, who had long been accustomed to the dark, saw his chance, knowing that Lu Yang would need some time to adjust from the streetlight to this darkness!
It seemed that bloodshed was inevitable tonight!
Lu Yang kicked Zheng Shouhe, sending him flying four or five meters away.
Trying to reason scientifically with a Cultivator.
Zheng Shouhe wasn't expecting Lu Yang's kick - it was too heavy, too profound, as if a giant rock had slammed into his chest. Seeing stars, a few of his ribs had broken, he spat out a mouthful of blood!
Realising he was in for a tough time, Zheng Shouhe decided that he needed to use a hostage if he was to survive!
Zheng Shouhe suppressed the pain in his chest with sheer will power, and reached for Wen Xiangyu's wrist.
"If you make another move, I'll kill her!" Zheng Shouhe viciously threatened.
The figure in Zheng Shouhe's arms chuckled, "Who are you going to kill?"
Zheng Shouhe looked down, horrified to see that what he was holding wasn't Wen Xiangyu, but Lu Yang!
A single slap from Lu Yang sent Zheng Shouhe flying, with another swift move, he snatched the dagger away from him, and disarmed Zheng Shouhe's limbs.
"What rotten luck - Even making a delivery could cause so much trouble."
Lu Yang took a deep breath, lit a candle, and brought some dim light back into the room.
Wen Xiangyu didn't expect things to change so quickly, the waiter from the kebab shop had seemed like a divine entity, subduing the fierce criminal in a blink of an eye.
"Are you okay?" Lu Yang helped Wen Xiangyu up from the spot where she'd sat frozen.
"No... no problems," she managed.
"Good to hear. Now how about paying for those kebabs," Lu Yang said politely.
"Ah? Oh... oh," Wen Xiangyu suddenly remembered that Lu Yang was here to deliver the kebabs and had incidentally saved her.
After giving Lu Yang the money, Wen Xiangyu felt a surge of residual fear, she wanted to say something to alleviate her fear, "Are... are you a cultivator?"
"Yes."
"Cultivators also run businesses?"
"For a living," Lu Yang replied.
Lying on the ground in anguish, Zheng Shouhe regretted deeply. What rotten luck, he'd so happened to run into a cultivator. Were cultivators nowadays relegated to making deliveries to make a living?
Seeing Wen Xiangyu, who seemed like she'd survived a calamity, Lu Yang chuckled, "I'll accompany you to report this to the authorities."
"Thank you," Wen Xiangyu remembered about the thief upstairs, "Oh, there's also another person upstairs, probably his accomplice."
As soon as Wen Xiangyu had woken up, she'd seen Zheng Shouhe and Luk Zhi and had assumed they were in cahoots, the only difference being that they'd turned against each other because of her beauty.
Lu Yang went upstairs to find Luk Zhi tied up securely, he too assumed Luk Zhi was an accomplice of Zheng Shouhe's, "So they're working as a group."
Luk Zhi protested, "Don't make baseless accusations! I have nothing to do with that person – he's a kidnapper, I'm a thief, both of us are subject to different penalties under the law!"
Lu Yang had a good laugh, "You have quite the understanding of penal law."
"We've got to look up the laws before we pull a job to see how many years we're potentially facing," Luk Zhi said, demonstrating just how seasoned of a thief he was.
"Then let's go, let's see how many years you will face."
Upon hearing they were heading to the city office, Luk Zhi was so frightened he pleaded, "No, wait, we can talk about this. We're all trying to make a living here, why be so harsh? Look, I have something valuable for you, how about I give it to you and you let me go?"
Lu Yang regarded Luk Zhi, seeing that he was only a mortal, "What's this valuable thing?"
"A piece of yellow paper that can make people fall asleep, with this paper, you can make anyone sleep and do whatever you want to them!"
Lu Yang thought about the recent anomalies and grimaced, realizing it was not a simple matter, he coldly asked, "Where is this thing?"
Luk Zhi, of course, wasn't a fool; he wasn't just going to answer, "You've got to promise to let me go first!"
Lu Yang solemnly swore, "I, Chi Xulong, swear to the heavens, if I don't let you go, may thunder strike me down!"
Luk Zhi was overjoyed, "The yellow paper is in the corner outside the first floor."
Clearly, Luk Zhi wasn't very intelligent either.
Lu Yang jumped down from the second floor, circled around the first floor, and sure enough, he found a piece of yellow paper.
The yellow paper had symbols that Lu Yang couldn't understand, it seemed to be some kind of charm.
He pocketed the charm responsibly, and went back upstairs, "Where did you get this from?"
"Just under the Big Stone Bridge. One time when I was escaping on a boat, I looked up and saw this yellow paper stuck under the bridge."
Lu Yang nodded, went downstairs, reattached Zheng Shouhe's limbs and escorted the two to the city office with Wen Xiangyu trailing behind timidly.
"Hey! You lied!" Luk Zhi started yelling.
Lu Yang gave a cold smile, Chi Xulong was the one to be struck down by lightning, not him.
It so happened that it was Guard Captain Wei's shift tonight. Seeing Lu Yang escorting two criminals to the city office, he had a "Not you again" feeling.
After hearing the criminals' stories, Guard Captain Wei stopped joking around and sat up straight. Zheng Shouhe had homicide on his record and was a serious criminal, Lu Yang had done a great service.
"This is the yellow paper that Luk Zhi mentioned," Lu Yang handed the paper over to Guard Captain Wei, having already memorised the symbols on it.
Accepting the yellow paper, Guard Captain Wei began to realize the magnitude of the problem.
He'd heard of some people feeling sleepy during the day, though he hadn't experienced it himself, he didn't think much of it. Now, it seemed it was the result of intentional mischief!
The current Yanjiang County had God knows how many of these yellow papers hidden away!
But Guard Captain Wei wasn't sure what the symbols on the yellow paper meant either, he'd have to wait till daylight when the chief comes on duty to ask him.
"Thanks again, I'll send a pennant your way tomorrow," Guard Captain Wei said to Lu Yang and Wen Xiangyu after finishing their statements, then waved to say goodbye.
Before leaving, Lu Yang made a quick detour to the prison and found Chi Xulong, "I have a brother named Zheng Shouhe who will be staying here for a while. I would appreciate it if you could look after him."
Chi Xulong chuckled coldly, so you need my help now. Watch over him? With my supreme Spitting Stone Skill, I'll show him what's what!
After escorting Wen Xiangyu back to the tofu shop, Lu Yang firmly declined the tofu offer from Wen Xiangyu.
After all that, the kebab shop had already closed for the day. When Lu Yang returned, he found the two ghouls washing the dishes.
Lu Yang showed the symbols from the yellow paper to Lan Ting, "Take a look at these symbols, do they effect people by making them fall asleep?"
After carefully inspecting them, Lan Ting looked surprised, "Where did you find this? This is a Reverse Life Talisman. This talisman absorbs a person's lifespan. The person being drained will appear listless and sleepy."
"These symbols only affect mortal humans, they won't have any effect whatsoever on cultivators."

chapters.title: Chapter 87 - 86: The Undercover in the Government Office (Thanks to Zuo Yong Homeland You Bao Kong Da-jiang Xian Gu Yue for the reward of the League Leader) _1
chapters.content:
"Many people are now showing signs of excessive sleepiness, could it be that the Reverse Life Talisman has started absorbing ordinary people's lifespan?"
Lan Ting shook her head, "Not so fast, the lifespan is the foundation of life, and is not easily shaken. According to your description, people have only begun to feel sleepy recently. This is merely the prelude, it will be at least half a month before they start absorbing lifespan."
"The process of formally absorbing lifespan is long and hardly noticeable."
"But there is a way to forcibly activate the Reverse Life Talisman."
"What way!" Lu Yang asked.
Lan Ting said seriously, "Using the Reverse Life Talisman as a node, to layout a Reverse Life Array, and using human blood as a guide. There is no need to wait for half a month, it can activate the great array and enhance one's cultivation using ordinary people's lifespan!"
In fact, the Reverse Life Talisman and the Reverse Life Array are rather obscure knowledge with records only in a few books, and because the Reverse Life Talisman belongs to nefarious practices, the books recording it are listed as forbidden books. Even those scholars who are proficient in the Array Method might have only heard of the Reverse Life Talisman and not recognize its pattern.
Only Lan Ting, who was born in the Laurel Fairy Palace, has the privilege to access these forbidden books.
She always claimed to have only superficial knowledge of Array Method, but the depth of knowledge she shows now is beyond such a modest assessment.
Lan Ting continued, "However, the person who wrote the Reverse Life Talisman probably won't lay out the Reverse Life Array. Prior to the activation of the Reverse Life Array, there are no sleepy signs, it's more disguised. But it's also possible that the Reverse Life Array is being set up and it's not yet complete."
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu on the side listened and also realized the problem. Now the people of the entire Yanjiang County are feeling sleepy, it indicates that the Reverse Life Talisman is hidden in various places in Yanjiang County!
Those who work in secret have big plans!
"After the Reverse Life Array is activated, to what realm can the cultivator be promoted to?"
Lan Ting shook her head, "It's hard to say, it depends on how much lifespan the array will absorb. It can't be determined yet."
"Let's go, let's go to the Great Stone Bridge, there might be more over there!" Lu Yang led the three.
On the west side of Yanjiang County, there is a large river called the Hidden Dragon River. The flow of the Hidden Dragon River's section through Yanjiang County is gentle, and many people like to play here. It is a major attraction of Yanjiang County, and the name "Yanjiang" of Yanjiang County comes from here.
The "Great Stone Bridge" mentioned by Luk Zhi, who failed in his burglary attempt, is located here.
At this time, it was late at night, and there was no one in the sky above the Hidden Dragon River. The four people found the Great Stone Bridge together, turned it upside down, and did not find a new Reverse Life Talisman.
"As expected, the enemy is not foolish enough to place two Reverse Life Talismans in one place."
...
Early the next morning, Guard Captain Wei found the Chief Guard, Fang Qingyun.
"Little Wei, what brought you to me?"
"Master, have you noticed that recently the people of Yanjiang County have been going to bed early and getting up late?"
Fang Qingyun nodded, "That's true. I think it may be because the cost of living in Yanjiang County has risen, but incomes have not. This puts a lot of pressure on the people's lives, leading them to work hard during the day and sleep in the afternoon."
Guard Captain Wei rubbed his brow in anguish and carefully worded his next speech: "Master, I know you are very eager for a promotion and have been reading social economic books recently for future advancement. But have you ever thought that you are simply not suited for this kind of development?"
"Just speak straight, Wei!"
"...Well, yesterday night a good Samaritan caught a burglar. According to the thief's confession, he accidentally got a talisman that causes drowsiness. Roughly, it can make people within a radius of fifty meters feel sleepy."
Guard Captain Wei took out the talisman from a box with a seal on it.
The seal has a sealing effect, he found that the sleepiness talisman had no effect on him but was very effective on ordinary people, and the people who were on the night duty with him have fallen asleep.
He had no choice but to lock the talisman in the box.
"Do you recognize this thing?"
Fang Qingyun examined it for a moment and shook his head to indicate his unfamiliarity: "Perhaps County Lord Li will recognize it."
When the two of them found County Lord Li, he was busy with official duties.
Both of them admired County Lord Li immensely. As a Golden Core Stage cultivator, he had been in Yanjiang County for twenty years.
Yanjiang County had not changed at all in these two decades, but whenever superiors came to inspect Yanjiang County or when County Lord Li went to report to the superiors, Yanjiang County would always show its best side, as if Yanjiang County had experienced great changes over these twenty years.
"County Lord Li, I have something to report!" said Fang Qingyun.
County Lord Li put down his writing brush and gestured for the two to sit down and speak.
Guard Captain Wei reported the events of last night truthfully and took out the talisman paper, asking County Lord Li to review it.
County Lord Li squinted his eyes, gave a soft 'uh-oh' as if he remembered something, fell into deep thought, and after a few minutes said, "If my memory serves me right, this is a Reverse Life Talisman?"
"Thirty years ago, I was in charge of cracking down on the Demon Path in Poyang County. While exchanging experiences with colleagues from other counties, one of them introduced this kind of talisman, called the Reverse Life Talisman, which can absorb lifespan, convert it into cultivation, and is undoubtedly a method of the Demon Path."
County Lord Li said solemnly, "The Spring Festival is imminent, and a large number of people from other counties will come to visit, including both ordinary people and cultivators. The Spring Festival is our Yanjiang County's most prominent selling point, and we can't afford any mistakes.
You must catch these practitioners of the Demon Path who are posting these talismans before the start of the Spring Festival!"
"These practitioners of the Demon Path are absolutely lawless, not even putting the government in their eyes!"
"Chief Fang, you must take this matter to heart. Once the Reverse Life Talisman takes effect, it will be endless trouble!"
Then County Lord Li's tone changed, "Of course, if you catch the culprit, it would be a great credit. I will report it to my superiors. If possible, it would be best if you could have a breakthrough in your cultivation. Then your promotion would be a sure thing."
"Yes!"
"If there's nothing else, you can leave now. I have a meeting to attend later."
...
On the second day, Lu Yang and the others wanted to continue finding the locations of the Reverse Life Talismans based on the clues they had, but before they could leave, the Rudder Master Chu sent someone to call Lu Yang over.
Lu Yang didn't understand why the Rudder Master Chu only called him, so he was quietly alert and felt that something was strange.
The Rudder Master Chu was sitting in a jade chair, with his palm supporting his head and wearing a mask, his voice hoarse, "I heard you caught a thief last night and found a yellow talisman that puts people to sleep?"
Lu Yang respectfully said, "Yes, I suspect the yellow talisman to be our way of the Demon Path. I want to find the person who wrote it, slay them, and learn how to draw this kind of talisman!"
Rudder Master Chu waved his hand, "Although it is necessary to maintain a good relationship with the government, this time is different. The government will make a concerted effort to investigate this incident, with the involvement of a Golden Core Stage cultivator, everything will soon come to light. You must not get involved anymore to avoid exposing your identity and dragging yourself into it."
"It's just a talisman that makes people sleepy, it's not worth the risk."
Lu Yang was shocked. Rudder Master Chu found out about last night's events this morning, and it also knew that a Golden Core cultivator will take action, something even he didn't know about.
Yanjiang Rudder had planted a mole in the government!

chapters.title: Chapter 88 - 87 Learning the Invisibility Talisman_1
chapters.content:
When they first entered Yanjiang County, Man Gu suggested alerting the local government about the Yanjiang Rudder situation and cooperate in finding Qin Yuanhao, which was vetoed by Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou on the grounds that the government could not be trusted.
Looking at it now, their concerns were not without reason.
Yanjiang Rudder had planted a mole within the government and this person was high-ranking!
Master Chu spoke unhurriedly, "Lu Yang, among the upper echelons of Yanjiang Rudder, you are the one I value the most. After the Spring Festival, a person from above will conduct an inspection on Yanjiang Rudder. This inspection will be unlike any before, this time with you, Meng Jingzhou, and Man Gu - three demon path seeds, the assessment from above will greatly increase my standing."
"I have a high chance of promotion, leaving the position of the Rudder Master vacant."
"Traditionally, the new Rudder Master is selected from among the higher-ups in this Rudder. Although you're relatively new here, considering the Master's evaluation of you, it is possible that you may be chosen by the higher-ups as the new Rudder Master."
"Your competitors are currently locked up in the jail and will only be released three days later. Such foolish actions will naturally cause their evaluations from the higher-ups to decrease."
"The Spring Festival is a major festival for the nearby counties and has a significant impact. If you manage to cause some incident during this festival, it will raise your standing in the eyes of those above." Master Chu subtly hinted to Lu Yang.
…
Lu Yang relayed Master Chu's words to Meng Jingzhou and others. Both Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu felt fortunate about their previous choice to slander Qin Yuanhao instead of seeking help from the officials.
Otherwise, their bustling barbecue shop wouldn't exist.
Lu Yang wondered if their focus was slightly off.
"I just don't know who Master Chu planted as a mole in the government." The four of them were in a quandary, not knowing who within the government had the authority to know about the Yellow Talisman.
"No worries, when you become the Rudder Master, you will find out who the mole is. Master Chu values you so much that he will definitely tell you before he leaves!" Meng Jingzhou laughed heartily, unexpectedly impressed by how quickly Lu Yang was getting promoted.
If Lu Yang got promoted, wouldn't he and Man Gu have free rein to cause a havoc in Yanjiang County?
It felt good to have someone backing them up.
While the four of them were in heated discussion, Guard Captain Wei knocked on the door from outside.
"Mr. Little Lu, I've come to deliver a banner of honor to you again."
Lu Yang opened the door and warmly welcomed Guard Captain Wei in.
"Oh, everyone is here. It's lively," Guard Captain Wei remarked casually.
"We were just discussing the case from yesterday."
Hearing Lu Yang's comment, Guard Captain Wei earnestly warned, "Mr. Little Lu, you must keep yesterday's case strictly confidential and not discuss it with anyone else."
"I know that all of you are no ordinary people, but cultivators experiencing life here, often acting bravely for a righteous cause."
"However, this time is different. This has to do with ruthless and menacing demon path cultivators. A slight mishap could lead to a lethal danger, so you absolutely must not seek out the origin of the talisman."
Lu Yang couldn't help laughing. The Demon Path warned him not to get involved in this matter, the Righteous Path also warned him not to get involved in this matter.
"Stop laughing, this is a serious matter!" Guard Captain Wei thought Lu Yang was not taking this seriously.
Lu Yang put on a serious face and promised that he would not interfere in this matter anymore. Guard Captain Wei was finally at ease and left.
"Have some tea before you leave."
Guard Captain Wei waved his hand, "No, my superior is hurrying me. I still need to take people to find the other talismans."
After Guard Captain Wei's departure, the four of them worried that the government officials might not have enough manpower and weren't necessarily able to catch the person behind the scenes.
If things went awry, who knew how many people's lifespan would be secretly taken away.
As Lu Yang fell deep in thought, he said, "We've already learned the method of hiding our presence. However, just using this method might not necessarily be safe."
He looked at Lan Ting, who was learning how to skewer the meat with the Ghouls, and got an idea.
"Fellow Daoist Lan Ting, I have a favor to ask."
Lan Ting smiled, "We are all disciples of the Immortal Sect and work together to kill demons and dispel evils. Right now, I am under your command, so there's no need to be so formal. Just call me Lan Ting."
Lu Yang agreed readily, "Lan Ting, can you teach us how to use the Invisibility Talisman?"
Lan Ting understood Lu Yang's intentions, "You mean to use the Invisibility Talisman to hide and secretly assist Guard Captain Wei?"
Lu Yang nodded.
"Of course, there's no problem. The Invisibility Talisman isn't a difficult rune. As long as your talent isn't too bad, you can learn it in half a day."
When Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu heard that they could learn a new skill, and it wasn't taught by Lu Yang, they were very excited.
"Have any of you three learned about talismans?"
The three of them shook their heads in unison.
Lan Ting wasn't surprised, "Then let's start from scratch."
Lan Ting was also excited. This was her first time teaching someone else. While she was at the Laurel Fairy Palace, it was always her Senior Sisters teaching her. Now, it was finally her turn to be a teacher.
"The essence of a talisman is the physical manifestation of a magic skill on paper. The three of you come from the Seek Dao Sect, so your talents in magic skills shouldn't be too shabby, and learning should be easy."
"...The Talisman Core is the soul of a Talisman Order. Whether a talisman can fully exert its effects largely depends on the presence of a Talisman Core within it... "
"...The most commonly used pattern in talismans is cloud patterns, designed to imitate the varying shape of clouds in the sky, inspired from nature..."
"Specifically for the Invisibility Talisman, we use the 'Protective Aura' as the Talisman Core and a cloud pattern that represents elusiveness."
Lan Ting's fingertip touched a bit of clear water, and with a few strokes, she drew an Invisibility Talisman on the table. She sucked it up with her palm, and the Invisibility Talisman left the table and attached itself to her palm.
Lan Ting slapped it on herself and vanished under the captivated stares of the three men.
A few breaths later, Lan Ting appeared, smiling faintly, "This is the most basic Invisibility Talisman. It can only hide the body optically. You should be able to detect my location through details like breathing and heartbeat."
The three nodded. Even if it was just that, it was quite impressive.
"You three should give it a try."
After half a day of learning, the three of them had a preliminary understanding of talismans and began to try to write the Invisibility Talisman, as they were not yet able to use water as a talisman.
Meng Jingzhou had practiced calligraphy for many years, and his handwriting was excellent. His right hand wielding the brush was extremely steady.
He circulated the spiritual essence to the tip of the brush, quickly completing an Invisibility Talisman that was 80% similar to what Lan Ting drew.
After a few more tries, his version was almost indistinguishable from Lan Ting's.
Meng Jingzhou put it on himself, smiling happily as he truly became invisible.
Man Gu's talent was somewhat lacking in this area and he wasn't controlling the spiritual essence precisely, so it took him dozens of attempts to succeed once. As he tried more, his success rate gradually improved.
Lan Ting secretly praised, the students from the Seek Dao Sect were indeed gifted in creating talismans.
What about Lu Yang?
Lan Ting looked towards Lu Yang.
Lu Yang also quickly drew an Invisibility Talisman and succeeded on the first try, he showed an extremely terrifying talent.
Lu Yang attached the Invisibility Talisman to himself and his entire person disappeared.
However, only the person disappeared, the clothes remained.
It was like he turned into a ghost.
"What the hell!" Incredibly, the clothes started to speak.
Thinking that he was invisible anyway, Lu Yang decided to take off his clothes.
Then he despaired to find out that the Invisibility Talisman could still be seen.
What kind of invisibility was this!
Nearly frustrated, he almost tore off the Invisibility Talisman.
Luckily, his rationality kicked in and prevented him from doing so.

chapters.title: Chapter 89 - 88 Lan Ting's Growth_1
chapters.content:
Lan Ting had deep doubts about her teaching ability. She'd heard that Lu Yang entered the Seek Dao Sect with the highest rank, and his talent for magic skills is undoubtedly top-notch.
For instance, his previous display of Imitation Fist was proof of this. It was a magical talent that transformed the mundane into something extraordinary.
Why did he turn out like this under her instruction?
Did she teach him wrongly?
That shouldn't be the case. Senior Sister taught her this way, and she taught Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu in the same way, and there was no issue.
Could it be that she had underestimated Lu Yang's magic skill talent? Was a special teaching method needed for this kind of genius who surpasses the ordinary?
While doubting herself, she also felt guilty.
Lu Yang was diligently studying his talisman, completely oblivious to the fact that a talisman genius was falling into self-doubt because she couldn't teach him: "Do you think there's a talisman that can make other talismans invisible? Then my Invisibility Talisman would disappear."
Meng Jingzhou pondered for a moment before saying: "It's hard for me to imagine why someone would study such a talisman that you mentioned."
Feeling dejected, Lu Yang dressed up and continued practicing the Invisibility Talisman, but the result was the same as before. What should have turned invisible did, and what shouldn't have remained visible.
On the other hand, Man Gu's drawing was becoming better over time, which gave Lan Ting a sense of achievement.
Meng Jingzhou mockingly laughed at Lu Yang: "Ha ha, give it up, you can't possibly draw a proper Invisibility Talisman."
Enraged, Lu Yang gripped the Invisibility Talisman between his fingers and slapped it onto Meng Jingzhou's forehead: "Heh, demon, take this!"
Meng Jingzhou's body disappeared, leaving only his clothes.
Not wanting to appear weak, he too took out an Invisibility Talisman and hit Lu Yang with it: "Daoist, don't think you're the only one who can draw talismans!"
An Invisibility Talisman was also slapped onto Lu Yang's forehead, making him and his clothes completely disappear.
The two were attacking each other using the Invisibility Talismans, a playful exchange that was totally harmless.
Man Gu was sandwiched between the two, focusing on his talisman drawings, not at all disturbed by their antics.
"It's done." Man Gu lifted up a pile of successfully drawn Invisibility Talismans contentedly. After continuous practice, his success rate in drawing Invisibility Talismans was almost perfect.
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu successfully learned it on their own.
Lu Yang successfully learned it with the Invisibility Talisman drawn by Lan Ting.
"Oh, right, Lan Ting, do you know how to prepare the Reverse Life Array?" Lu Yang asked. He was considering whether the hidden person was truly preparing the Reverse Life Array using the Reverse Life Talisman and had not completed it.
If that really was the case, after finding a dozen or so Reverse Life Talismans, according to the position of the Reverse Life Talismans, it would be easy to calculate the positions of other talismans.
Lan Ting nodded, then used her own spiritual essence as a line, sketching out an extremely detailed Array Method in the air with thousands of nodes: "The Reverse Life Array is large in scale and has many nodes. If there are only a few hidden people, considering they need to paste the talismans in hidden locations, they can't finish setting it up in a short time."
"Got it. In that case, could you watch the shop? The three of us will go out for a bit and see if we can provide some help," said Lu Yang.
"Eh? Me, watching the shop?" Lan Ting was a bit insecure. At the Laurel Fairy Palace, she always followed her Senior Sister's arrangements and didn't have much decision-making power. Now she had to manage such a large shop alone, she was quite apprehensive.
"It's okay, nothing will happen. If anything comes up, just make a decision yourself." Lu Yang didn't think there was any issue and left soon after speaking.
After Lu Yang and the others left, Lan Ting felt uneasy thinking about temporarily taking over such a large shop.
"Let me set up a Gathering Spirit Array," said Lan Ting to herself, finding something to occupy herself.
The Gathering Spirit Array is a basic array method for cultivation. She noticed that there wasn't a Gathering Spirit Array in the grill shop and had no idea how Lu Yang and the others practiced their cultivations.
"Since everyone lives on the second floor, I'll set it up there."
The Gathering Spirit Array is the most basic array method, and Lan Ting set it up deftly. She took out a Spirit Stone from her Identity Jade and arranged it step by step according to what she learned during the class.
"Let's set up a Calming Array as well, which allows one to quickly enter a state of cultivation."
"And a Soundproof Array, to make it quieter."
Lan Ting was meticulous in her work. Considering the effectiveness of the Gathering Spirit Array might attract the attention of other cultivators, she also set up an array method to isolate the ripples of spiritual energy.
"This way, it should be foolproof." Lan Ting was satisfied with her carefulness.
"Hello, is anyone here?" A voice came from downstairs, startling Lan Ting. It sounded like a woman.
Lan Ting went downstairs and saw a fair-skinned woman standing at the door, hesitating about whether to step in.
"Hello, may I ask if you are..."
"I run a tofu shop on Front Street. My name is Wen Xiangyu. Is Mr. Little Lu around?" Wen Xiangyu's voice was gentle, making people feel a bit tingly.
"He went out. Is there something you need?" Lan Ting recalled that Lu Yang had mentioned her briefly when explaining how to find the Reverse Life Talisman.
"Well, with the Spring Festival approaching, I was thinking of co-hosting an event with your grill shop."
Lan Ting invited Wen Xiangyu in and served her tea: "What kind of event?"
"Not to boast, but my tofu shop has many customers on normal days, and during the Spring Festival, there are even more."
"I was thinking, could we have an event where those who buy tofu from my shop can get a 10% discount at your grill shop, and vice versa?"
"We can also have a lucky draw and masks and stuff."
"Masks?"
Wen Xiangyu took out a few masks. The masks were square and looked white and tender, just like a piece of tofu.
"These are masks made based on the mascot of my tofu shop, and they sell really well."
Lan Ting thought it over and felt that Wen Xiangyu's suggestions were good. They would be beneficial for the grill shop's business, especially considering that Lu Yang had said it would be up to her to take decisions while he was away. So, she agreed to the proposal.
Seeing that Lan Ting agreed to her proposal, Wen Xiangyu was very happy. The two women started discussing various details about the event, from the rewards of the lucky draw to the theory of gravity.
"There's an invisible force that attracts everything in the world. Lu Yang agrees with my views and has named this force gravity..."
"But while Lu Yang believes this invisible force is naturally occurring, I believe someone has set up a huge array method to attract us."
"Ah, right, you're unfamiliar with array methods. Let me tell you, array methods are very interesting. This book 'True Understanding of Array Methods' explains array methods in a simple and understandable way..."
When Wen Xiangyu came, she was grateful to Lu Yang, but when she left, her mind was full of the principles of array methods.
After seeing off Wen Xiangyu, Lan Ting noticed the Ghoul skewering in the corner, and a thought popped into her head.
Lu Yang's thoughts were unpredictable, and to teach him well, did she need to adopt his way of thinking?
For instance, could she design an automatic grilling array method based on the Suspension Formation, Gathering Fire Array, and other array methods?
Eh, that seems like a really good idea.

chapters.title: Chapter 90 - 89: It's Not Recommended for Demon Path Cultivators to Eat at a Barbecue Restaurant_1
chapters.content:
At this time, Lu Yang was unaware that Lan Ting had secured a major deal. He was using an Invisibility Talisman and concealment techniques to follow the officer in search of Reverse Life Talismans.
The three of them split up into different directions, aiming to locate as many Reverse Life Talismans as possible.
It was clear that the government office took the Reverse Life Talismans very seriously, practically leaving no stone unturned in Yanjiang County.
First, the officials identified the areas where ordinary people often felt tired and drowsy, and then designated areas for search.
Guard Captain Wei, Fang Qingyun, even multiplied himself into two clones. He, along with his true form and two clones, expanded their Spiritual Sense to lead a large team searching for talismans.
Fang Qingyun's cultivation level was too high, so Lu Yang and his companions did not dare follow him.
Before long, the officer found a Reverse Life Talisman. Lu Yang, hidden in the shadows, silently noted down the location.
By dusk, the trio regrouped and pulled out a map of Yanjiang County, marking the locations of the Reverse Life Talismans.
"One under the Great Stone Bridge, one in the rouge shop on Front Street, one in a pawn shop … These are the six Reverse Life Talisman locations that we've found so far."
"We can't be sure these are laid out in accordance with the Reverse Life Array based just on this information. Let's see what we can find tomorrow."
When they returned to the barbecue restaurant, they saw Lan Ting wearing a tofu mask, intently improving the Automatic Skewer Formation.
The skewers were suspended mid-air, subjected to high heat.
Two ghouls knelt on the ground, sniveling profusely in gratitude to Lan Ting for his kindness in rescuing them from endless grilling.
Lu Yang was puzzled. What had happened while they were gone for less than an afternoon?
"Where did you get this mask?"
Lan Ting said with a hint of pride: "Oh, it was brought by the tofu shop owner you saved last night. She also said she wants to collaborate with our barbecue shop during the Spring Festival."
"This is an event plan we decided together."
"When I was working yesterday, I found that with only two ghouls grilling, the efficiency was too low, so some customers were impatient. Therefore, I designed this Automatic Skewer Formation which greatly increased efficiency."
"This Automatic Skewer Formation is an innovative and unprecedented Array Method. After returning to the Fairy Palace, I can use it to exchange for contribution points."
"This Array Method is quite simple, and may even be promoted on a large scale in the future."
Just like the Seek Dao Sect, the Laurel Fairy Palace also has similar long-term tasks.
Lu Yang: "…"
It seems that the rapid development of the barbecue shop is unstoppable.
Meng Jingzhou, giggling, took the tofu mask: "This tofu mask looks great. Lu Yang, look, it matches you perfectly. You look exactly like it."
Lu Yang glanced at the square tofu mask, rolled his eyes, chose not to stoop to Meng's level, and accepted the mask.
Lan Ting added: "I've also laid out a Gathering Spirit Array and a Sound-isolation Array on the second floor for convenient cultivation."
This was the only good news Lu Yang had heard since he entered the shop: "That's too generous of you. Setting up Array Methods must have consumed many Spirit Stones. Calculate how much you used, and we three will pay for it."
Lan Ting waved his hand: "It only takes a few Spirit Stones, merely pocket change."
Meng Jingzhou suddenly looked up, warningly gazing at Lan Ting. For the first time, he had met his match in showing off wealth.
The arrival of Lan Ting made life much more comfortable for the three of them, allowing them to focus on searching for the talismans during the day.
After ten days, Lu Yang and his companions found the locations of more than two hundred talismans, exactly matching the nodes of the Reverse Life Array.
After finding a pattern, they went looking at other potential node locations and indeed found Reverse Life Talismans.
"What should we do? Should we tell Guard Captain Wei?" Meng Jingzhou asked.
Lu Yang was a bit torn. If they informed Guard Captain Wei about the locations of the Reverse Life Talismans, his superior would definitely know that someone was secretly helping them. If Master Chu heard the news, they might become suspects.
But if they didn't inform them, the Reverse Life Talismans scattered all over Yanjiang County would undoubtedly be a risk.
"Hey, bring us two hundred mutton kebabs and two hundred beef kebabs!" a hearty voice rang out, even the ghouls in the backyard could hear it clearly.
Normally, the volume of this voice would scare them stiff.
But now, with the Automatic Skewer Formation, their workload decreases significantly. Not just two hundred mutton and beef kebabs, bring even two hundred pork kebabs and I won't break a sweat!
"Also add two hundred pork kebabs!" the hearty voice continued, seemingly the owner is quite loaded.
Lu Yang squinted, recognizing the owner of the voice: "It's Yizhang Hong who participated in the Cult member selection, the two people behind him are also at the Foundation Establishment Stage like Yizhang Hong.
The three did not pass the selection.
"Will we be recognized?" Man Gu asked, they had tricked Yizhang Hong by pretending to be examiners.
Lu Yang shook his head: "No, the Rudder Master has said that for the secrecy of the sub-palace, those who did not pass the selection had their memories washed by the headquarters, they don't remember the selection."
Yizhang Hong, seeing that no one was serving him, shouted loudly: "Hello? Is anyone there?"
"Coming, coming, what would you like to order?" Lu Yang rushed out.
Yizhang Hong was quite brusque: "Two hundred skewers each of pork, beef and mutton, just bring the rest, I heard the food here was good, if it's not, watch me smash your shop!"
Obviously, he did not recognize Lu Yang, if he did, he would have smashed the shop directly.
Lu Yang greeted with a smile, nodding and bowing: "Rest assured, our kebabs are so good you'll want to eat them for a lifetime."
Yizhang Hong snorted coldly, ignoring Lu Yang.
The two companions of Yizhang Hong squinted, not bothering to talk to Lu Yang.
Lu Yang sent Meng Jingzhou a message: "Notify Guard Captain Wei, tell him there are three Foundation Establishment Stage Demon Cultivators here, ask him to bring people to arrest them."
These group of Demon Cultivators are murderous, according to the penal code they'll be executed several times over, Lu Yang won't show mercy.
Let you see how the Demon Path deals —— report!
Meng Jingzhou paused, responding: "But we don't have proof, how would they know they are Foundation Establishment Stage Demon Cultivators? Would Guard Captain Wei believe it?"
Lu Yang smirked: "What's not to believe? Just say we noticed they have suspicious talismans that could make people faint."
Meng Jingzhou understood Lu Yang's intention, they had few Reverse Life Talismans on hand, perfect for framing.
"Alright, I'll be right back." Meng Jingzhou ran off.
Guard Captain Wei was shocked when he heard that there were three Foundation Establishment Stage Demon Cultivators potentially holding Reverse Life Talismans. This was no small matter, he immediately reported to Fang Qingyun.
Fang Qingyun did not hesitate and led a large team to round up the three.
Regardless of whether or not they possessed Reverse Life Talismans, just the presence of three Foundation Establishment Stage Demon Cultivators warranted such a formation.
Fang Qingyun came to the barbecue shop, released the pressure of the Golden Core Stage, immobilizing Yizhang Hong and the others. He waved his hand and ordered gravely: "Take them down and search them!"
Yizhang Hong and the others had no idea what was happening as several Foundation Establishment Stage constables pinned them to the ground.
What's going on? Is eating kebabs illegal in your Yanjiang County?
Then, Guard Captain Wei found a large number of Reverse Life Talismans on Yizhang Hong, far more than those that Lu Yang had planted to frame him.
"It was indeed you who set up the Reverse Life Array!" Fang Qingyun stared daggers at Yizhang Hong, it was all his fault he hadn't been able to rest for days.
Lu Yang: "..."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Really, could you not have been more cooperative?
Yizhang Hong and the others were still confused, they'd done everything flawlessly, leaving no trace, why would the constables come to arrest them?
What went wrong?

chapters.title: Chapter 91 - 90 Interrogation Record_1
chapters.content:
"Name?"
"Yizhang Hong."
"Be honest, what's your real name!"
"Zhang Xiaohong."
Inside the interrogation room, the dim oil lamp flickered, casting a gloomy darkness. Fang Qingyun sneer with his arms crossed at the recently captured suspect, while Guard Captain Wei stared into Yizhang Hong's eyes, throwing one question after another. A Constable sat nearby hastily writing down the interrogation content.
"Gender?"
"Male."
"Cultivation Level?"
"Foundation Establishment Stage at Completion at its peak."
Guard Captain Wei snorted, "Note him down as Foundation Establishment Stage. Ignore whatever he said afterwards. Zhang Xiaohong, let me tell you, if you think our handling of this case affects the fairness of the trial, you can apply for a recusal, which is to have somebody else process it. Do you want to apply for a recusal?"
"I'm applying..."
Guard Captain Wei gave a low grunt, his voice dragging out, pitch ascending at the end.
Zhang Xiaohong quickly said, "No, no, no, I won't apply for recusal."
"Tell us, why were you brought in?"
"For eating skewers without paying?"
Fang Qingyun impatiently said, "Stop questioning him, just execute him here and now. We'll say he resisted arrest fiercely, chose death over surrender, and died from taking poison."
This was definitely something Fang Qingyun could do. Yizhang Hong, who was handcuffed, hurriedly said, "I'll tell you. I'll tell you. It was about ten days ago when I woke up from the bottom of a cliff. I must have accidentally slipped while passing by the mountain to the west of Yanjiang County. When I woke up, I found a cave, probably a cultivator's dwelling.
The cave had been abandoned for a long time. I tiptoed in, and only found an old book where I didn't see anything valuable."
"That book was taken by you when you searched me."
"It recorded some obscure talismans and their associated array methods, such as the Reverse Life Talisman and the Reverse Life Array. According to the book, the Reverse Life Talisman can turn lifespan into my cultivation level. I was stuck at a bottleneck and thought this might be a chance to breakthrough to the Golden Core Stage and live freely.
Moreover, this method of breakthrough can also increase lifespan. It's too enticing."
Fang Qingyun angrily said, "I consulted the County Magistrate, and according to the scale of your setup, forget about breaking through from the Foundation Establishment Stage to the Golden Core Stage, it's more than enough even to go from the Golden Core stage to the Nascent Soul Stage!"
Yizhang Hong thought to himself that he also knew it was wasteful, but he didn't know any other methods.
Of course, he couldn't voice these thoughts. He ignored Fang Qingyun's scolding and continued, "I'm a Talisman Cultivator, so I quickly learned the Reverse Life Talisman. Setting up the Reverse Life Array was not difficult, as it simply required arranging the Reverse Life Talisman into the shape of the array."
"The effects of the Reverse Life Talisman cannot be sensed by cultivators. Against ordinary people, the only effect is drowsiness, which is easily overlooked. Moreover, once the array is set up, even the effect of drowsiness is no longer present."
"The only problem is that the Reverse Life Array requires so many talismans to set up that one person cannot complete it in a short time. I happened to meet two companions, who are the other two people you arrested."
"Oddly enough, those two men were not from Yanjiang County and happened to appear here. They couldn't remember what brought them to Yanjiang County."
"We hit it off instantly and decided to break through the Foundation Establishment Stage together."
"We are careful and leave no traces. While you were busy looking for the Reverse Life Talisman, we stopped our actions. Feeling that this place was becoming increasingly unsafe, we planned to leave Yanjiang County. We heard about a famous barbecue shop here and wanted to try it out. But you guys arrived before the skewers were done grilling."
A puzzled expression spread across Yizhang Hong's face, unable to figure out where they made a mistake. Guard Captain Wei, of course, would not mention that it was the fervent shop owner who reported them.
After the interrogation ended, Guard Captain Wei asked him to sign his name: "Write your name at the bottom of each page. And on the last page write: 'I have read the above record, and it matches what I said'."
"Press your fingerprints at all places where you sign."
...
The next day, as usual, Guard Captain Wei brought a banner of honor.
He was considering whether he should set up an office right in the barbecue shop and live there, considering the arrest efficiency here was higher than his daily patrol, right? At this rate, he would soon become the Chief Constable.
"Mr. Little Lu, your barbecue shop has a good vibe. Such a prosperous place!"
Lu Yang smiled politely, "Whether the place is prosperous or not is secondary, the key is the excellence of the people."
"Recently, the office has been too busy. Once it's not so busy, I'll apply to the higher-ups, see if I can get a plaque of 'Excellent Shop' for your store."
"That would be great. Here's some hot water I just boiled, drink it while it's warm."
Lu Yang poured a cup of hot water warmly, "Are you still so busy after catching the man?"
"Well, although we have caught the man and found the place he confessed, an abandoned cave, probably a place where some Demon Path fugitive had once hidden. When we remove the Reverse Life Talisman according to the place they confessed to, this case will be closed."
"The problem is that the Spring Festival is here and by the looks of it, the number of people coming could be twenty percent more than last year. I wanted to take a break, but the Chief Constable did not approve. He said I need to patrol more during the Spring Festival."
"You can come and rest at our place when you're tired from patrolling. Our shop will be open as usual during the Spring Festival."
After seeing off Guard Captain Wei, Meng Jingzhou breathed a sigh of relief, "Finally, it's over. It was tense these past few days, searching for the Reverse Life Talisman every day. It's probable that this Yizhang Hong saw us working so hard and decided to give himself up."
Man Gu hesitated for a while. He thought Yizhang Hong probably didn't think that way.
Lu Yang noticed Lan Ting keeps gesturing something and curiously asked, "What are you doing?"
Without looking up, Lan Ting said, "I am trying to study an Automatic Skewer Formation where bamboo sticks automatically string up the meat pieces."
Lu Yang picked up a bamboo stick, pinched it between two fingers, and swung it back and forth thoughtfully.
Suddenly, he tossed a few pieces of meat into the air. With force on his fingers, he threw out the bamboo stick.
Unfortunately, the bamboo stick only brushed past the meat pieces and didn't skewer them.
Man Gu didn't understand what Lu Yang was doing, thinking that Brother Lu was playing a new kind of game. Meng Jingzhou's eyes lit up when he realized what was happening.
"Are you trying to practice the use of hidden weapons by skewering meat with a bamboo stick?"
Lu Yang smiled and didn't answer, which was equivalent to an affirmation.
Meng Jingzhou quickly joined the practice, studying how to exert precise force in order to skewer the moving pieces of meat in the air.
Man Gu hesitated, "This... is not something the Righteous Path would do, right?"
Lu Yang said earnestly. "That's where you're wrong. Haven't you heard the saying 'Stubbornly persevere, root deeply embedded in craggy rocks. Thousands of grinds and strikes still robust, firm against winds from all directions'?"
"Bamboo is tenacious, elegant and indifferent, it represents a humble gentleman. Using bamboo as a weapon, how could it be a hidden weapon?"
"This is a weapon only for gentlemen."
Man Gu finally understood, feeling an epiphany, "I see, then I'll join too."
Lan Ting was focusing on studying the Array Method. Several bamboo sticks suspended in the air, and with a swoosh, a bamboo stick was stuck straight on the wall, the tail end still vibrating.
If the target was a person, they would have died.
"The power is a bit too much." Lan Ting scratched her head, frustrated. She had already tried to reduce the power as much as possible.
"If the Automatic Skewer Formation isn't working, might as well increase the power to the maximum."
Two ghouls watched the chaotic scene shivering in fear.

chapters.title: Chapter 92 - 91: After the Sun Goes Out, Comes the Moon_1
chapters.content:
During the period when no Gathering Spirit Array was set up in the Lan Ting, the three of them practiced separately, consolidating and improving their Foundation Establishment Stage cultivation. After the second floor was equipped with the Gathering Spirit Array, the four of them practiced together, exchanging their cultivation experiences and gaining many insights in their spare time.
For instance, Lu Yang learned that Man Gu would not recite "Words of the Saint" while standing in a horse-riding stance, believing it to be disrespectful; however, Man Gu would assume such a stance while reciting "Words of the Saint".
For instance, Man Gu learned that in order to train his spiritual power, Meng Jingzhou often spent the day in a brothel, merely listening to music and doing nothing else. This drew admiration.
For instance, Meng Jingzhou learned that Lu Yang cleans the food stuck in his teeth, using Cow Hair Sword Qi, representing a new method of practice.
For instance, Lan Ting learned that the Central Continent was once refined by the stars.
"How could this be?" Lan Ting was dazed, astonished by this revelation, which resolved some of her questions.
"What kind of questions?"
Lan Ting pondered and said, "You all would know too, there are two implications in the name of our Laurel Fairy Palace. One is because the palace is filled with laurel trees, and the other is because the palace believes the moon holds some special significance."
The Laurel Fairy Palace was built at the top of a snowy mountain to get closer to the moon, reflecting the significance of the moon for the palace.
"When I first joined Laurel Fairy Palace, I asked my master why the moon had special significance, and what about the sun and other stars? Can't we draw power from those stars, like from the Big Dipper?"
"My master told me that the moon and sun were originally one entity. As for the other stars, she just smiled knowingly without elaborating."
"Yet, whenever my master didn't understand something, she used to smile in the same manner, so I didn't take much notice."
"After hearing your discussion, I now think that she probably knew the truth about the stars."
Lu Yang frowned, "The moon and the sun are one entity?"
Lan Ting nodded, "Originally, I didn't understand what this meant, until one day when two senior sisters were conversing, and one of them mentioned, 'The moon comes after the sun extinguishes'."
"The moon comes after the sun extinguishes?" Lu Yang was surprised. This was an explanation he had never heard before.
Does it mean that all the stars in the sky are illusions, and only the sun and the moon truly exist, and both constitute a dual-system?
The burning entity during the day is the sun and at night it extinguishes and becomes the moon?
The sun's energy is incredibly terrifying. It is believed by some that the sun is the source of all life. Many people still use the sun for cultivation, either through contemplation or comprehension.
If the sun turns into the moon after it gets extinguished, where does all that energy go? It would be an enormous force!
Does the sun at night retract its power, keep it within, and transform into the moon?
Thinking out loud, Lu Yang mumbled, "Why didn't the Ancient Nameless One refine the entire universe but left out the sun alone?"
Without the sun, the world would drown in darkness, with lives decaying. As per other's narration, the Ancient Nameless One viewed human lives as having no more worth than that of weeds. Would he keep the sun out of kindness?
Suddenly, Meng Jingzhou asked, "Do you know about the Yaoyang Sect?"
"You mean one of the Four Great Devil Sects, the Yaoyang Sect?" Lu Yang knew very little about it.
"Yes, the Yaoyang Sect believes in the sun, thinking it possesses mysterious powers. They believe when the sun awakes, everything will perish. They even advocate self-destruction before the sun rejuvenates, claiming they will go to paradise."
Meng Jingzhou said, "I mean no offense to the Fairy Palace, but if the sun and the moon are one entity, then the perspective of the Yaoyang Sect and that of the Fairy Palace seem to have something in common. They both believe in the extraordinary existence and horrifying power of the sun and moon."
Lan Ting shook her head, not considering Meng Jingzhou's words as disrespectful. In the palace, such viewpoints existed too, even more radical ones than that.
Meng Jingzhou guessed, "Perhaps the Ancient Nameless One is hiding within the sun. The sun has been suspended in the sky since ancient times and nobody has suspected it, it's a blind spot in our thinking."
Lu Yang put forward another guess, "Or perhaps the sun contains a tremendous power, so great that even the Ancient Nameless One dared not touch."
No matter which possibility was correct, the sun and the moon were definitely not as peaceful as they appeared.
"Forget about it, let's not think about it anymore. We better enjoy the Spring Festival. It's not every day we get to celebrate." Meng Jingzhou gave up thinking and invited everyone to relax.
Instead of pondering here, it's better to ask the elderly in their families when they return home.
Those old fellows definitely knew more than they did.
Like how they knew he possessed the Single Body Spirit Root but didn't tell him about it, only saying that he would know what his spirit root was once he came to the Seek Dao Sect.
As the Spring Festival was approaching, the atmosphere became more festive. Various stores started organizing activities, ready to welcome the surge in customers. The barbecue shops also started preheating. A promotion was running where patrons receive a tofu mask with every grilled skewer purchased, which was very popular among children.
On the streets, colorful little flags could be seen everywhere. This was a tradition in Yanjiang County, funded by the government office, under the pretext of imitating the colors of spring to welcome the arrival of spring.
County Lord Li specifically instructed the flag planting to be speedy so as not to disturb the daily lives of the residents. He even mobilized many people for this purpose.
In fact, the speed of planting flags would not affect life in any significant way. It was merely a show by County Lord Li for the residents.
"Once these little flags are hoisted, it indeed provides a festive atmosphere." Meng Jingzhou laughed, pointing out that even the barbecue shop at the front door was inserting a small red flag.
"Look here, rare books for sale!" A street-side old man with yellow teeth was advertising his wares, piquing the four's interest.
"What kind of books are you selling?"
"Martial arts secret scriptures, out-of-print cultivation methods, you name it!" said the yellow teeth old man with a laugh.
Meng Jingzhou flicked through the books casually and suddenly found a martial arts secret bible. "Lu Yang, look at this book, it's completely suitable for you. If you're willing to practice it, I promise you can achieve the highest level."
Lu Yang took a look at the cover: The Toad Skill.
"Get lost!"
Soon enough, Lu Yang also found a martial arts secret bible and suggested Meng Jingzhou practice it. "This book feels like it is tailor-made for you. If you're willing to practice it, even ascending to become a martial immortal may not be impossible."
Meng Jingzhou looked at the cover, Sunflower Treasure Book.
The two men looked at each other and chuckled, kindly buying the books for each other.
Man Gu, seeing the first page of the Sunflower Treasure Book, which stated, "To practice this skill, self-castration is needed", lapsed into thought, "Does this mean women can't practice this martial art?"
Lan Ting did not hear the mutual taunt between Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, she was engrossed in a serialized novel.
The novel narrated the life of a courtesan who wanted to buy out her contract and pursue true love, entrusting her life to a scholar. However, the scholar was weak and selfish. Although he genuinely loved the courtesan, he was too shy to marry her. Coaxed by his friends, he eventually betrayed the courtesan, which led to the tragic end of the courtesan jumping into a river.
Lan Ting was moved to tears, feeling pity for the courtesan.
Watching Lan Ting engrossed in the story, Lu Yang also stretched his neck and read along. He found the story to be very vivid and touching.
Peeking over, he saw the title of the book.
"Dream of the Brothel"
Lu Yang: "..."
He found the book title to have a strangely raw appeal.

chapters.title: Chapter 93 - 92: Cultivators' Market_1
chapters.content:
The four of them all bought books to their liking, with Man Gu buying a copy of "Great Xia's Unofficial History" due to his interest in history.
Many of the stories recorded in the book, even Meng Jingzhou, who knew the inside story, found quite wild.
No matter what, all four were satisfied.
As they continued walking, the four noticed fewer and fewer ordinary people around them with more and more cultivators appearing, as if some mysterious force was separating ordinary people from cultivators.
Lan Ting sent a voice transmission to the other three: "There is a type of array method established around here that instinctively drives ordinary people away while cultivators remain unaffected."
Meng Jingzhou suddenly understood, remembering the news he obtained during casual strolls: "It's a market that opens once a month. This should be due to the arrival of the Spring Festival, so it opened early."
The Spring Festival attracted not just ordinary people, but also cultivators.
This was a proper market, not the kind of black market where murder and robbery often occur. They could even see constables patrolling there.
That being said, many in the market chose to hide their identities through means such as wearing masks and black robes.
This was very common, as some cultivators concealed themselves among ordinary people. If they revealed their true identities here, wouldn't they be exposing themselves?
Like Lu Yang and his companions.
The four used different methods to hide their identities: Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu chose to wear black robes, believing that it created the right atmosphere, Meng Jingzhou even laughed a few times.
Lan Ting removed the Transforming Talisman, revealing her incredibly beautiful face; she had used her real face when she was searching for clues about the demonic sect in Yanjiang County.
Lu Yang discussed with Meng Jingzhou: "Why don't I perform an Imitation Fist transformation and turn myself to look like you?"
The response he got was Meng Jingzhou slapping a tofu mask on Lu Yang's face.
Lu Yang wore the tofu mask.
The inside of the market had a strong aura of cultivation. A massive protective barrier enveloped the entire market, emanating a soft light that contrasted against the atmosphere outside.
There were cultivators who hadn't been seen for a long time casually drinking in roadside bars, discussing recent events; cultivators and traders argued over the prices of goods, trying to earn a few spirit stones from each other; the government office set up a competition stage where cultivators wanting to compete could freely fight.
"Take a look, come and see! Our ancestral secret pill refining method produces the Pill of Great Power. Swallow one and your strength will be unparalleled!"
Lu Yang found it interesting. He followed the voice and discovered that it was coming from a medical institution.
It seemed that this medical institution was run by cultivators. The person hawking was either an apprentice or a Pill Master.
"How many spirit stones for one pill?"
The Pill Master's apprentice said, "Ten spirit stones for one pill, buy three get one free, buy five get two free."
The price was not high, suggesting that the elixir was intended for users with a cultivation level equivalent to the Qi Refinement stage, not the Foundation Establishment stage like Lu Yang.
Lu Yang wanted to buy a couple as a souvenir since this was the first time he'd seen someone outside the Seek Dao Sect refining pills. "What's the effect?"
"It can temporarily enhance your strength, but you will enter a state of weakness for half a day after the effect wears off."
Lu Yang purchased a pill and was about to leave when he saw a constable enter. Lu Yang remembered him; his surname was Sun, and he was a lackey of Guard Captain Wei.
"I received a report here claiming that your Pill of Great Power involves false advertising."
The Pill Master's apprentice was taken aback. False advertising?
Constable Sun explained seriously, "According to the law, when advertising a product, you can't use words like 'greatest' and 'unlimited'."
"After our investigation, we found that your Pill of Great Power is suitable for cultivators below the third level of Qi Refinement, and it doesn't have an 'unparalleled strength' effect. We hope you can correct this after this warning."
The Pill Master's apprentice nodded obediently. After Lu Yang left, he heard a voice coming from the medical institution:
"Take a look, come and see! Our ancestral secret pill refining method produces the Pill of Great Power. Swallow one and your strength will be... limited!"
Lu Yang suddenly realised that even the most common problem of false advertising in the pill-making business didn't exist with his Senior Brother Wu Ming's Ten Bulls Strength Pill.
Having seen many things before, Meng Jingzhou, who even had a fairly reputable Pill Master at home, didn't have much interest in common items.
"What is this?"
Meng Jingzhou picked up a small object from the stall - two wooden sticks glued together – "Is this for making pancake fruit? They sell these in the market too?"
The stall owner was a middle-aged man with a full, shaggy beard, his face serious as he sat there at ease, only begrudgingly opening his eyes when Meng Jingzhou started to speak. At first glance, he had the demeanor of a master craftsman.
"This object is called the Flying Stick. Place it on top of your head, stimulate it with spiritual essence and it can immediately ascend to the sky. It can be activated by those at the seventh level of Qi Refinement."
Meng Jingzhou was surprised, even such a small market truly hid dragons and crouching tigers, possessing such a master of refining.
Without special means, cultivators at the Golden Core Stage are the only ones who can fly in the air. If there are special means, one can fly using a sword from the Foundation Establishment Stage, or Lu Yang can also fly by transforming into a crane using the Imitation Fist.
In either ordinary or special cases, the minimum requirement for cultivation is the Foundation Establishment Stage.
Meng Jingzhou had never heard of anyone being able to fly at the seventh level of Qi Refinement.
Cultivators at the seventh level of Qi Refinement had sparse spiritual essence, making it difficult to drive flying magic artifacts.
"I see you don't believe it, no worries, let me show you." The middle-aged man with the shaggy beard confidently took out a wooden puppet.
He tied the Flying Stick to the wooden puppet, a flux of spiritual essence appearing from his fingertip and flying towards the Flying Stick.
The Flying Stick began rotating slowly, like waking up from a deep slumber, then gradually picked up speed until it was spinning so fast only the afterimage could be seen.
With the Flying Stick, the wooden puppet ascended together into the sky, apparently without any issues.
If one had to identify a problem, it would be that when the Flying Stick was rotating, it caused the wooden puppet to rotate as well, the puppet rotating at high speed, centred on its head, in synchronization with the Flying Stick's frequency!
If it was a person underneath the Flying Stick, their brains would be completely mixed up from the spinning.
"You see, I told you our puppet quality is good. It doesn't fall apart even after spinning that fast. I'm not bragging, this puppet can even fight against someone at the Foundation Establishment Stage, and the price is fair - fixed at 800!"
"Get out of here!" Meng Jingzhou finally understood. The other party was actually using the name of the Flying Stick as a cover to sell puppets!
Apparently, the market was full of trickery and deceit. Sincere individuals like Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were becoming rather rare.
Lu Yang and his companions decided to have a look at the area belonging to the Land Money Trade Association. The place was more regularized and didn't have the issues they had encountered earlier.
"Sirs, would you like to have your fortunes told?"
A voice sounded beside the four. Lu Yang turned to look and saw a fortune-teller with a bagua (Eight Diagrams) flag behind him saying "It's better to predict people than to predict heaven and earth". It appeared that he had scarce business as there was no one else around.
Seeing that Lu Yang and his companions had noticed him, the fortune-teller added: "No divination, no charge, want to give it a try?"
Lu Yang noticed that on his table were a bagua plate, dice, the four treasures of the study, nine copper coins, a crystal ball...
All things possibly used in divination were laid out.
Is it reliable?
And why is there a crystal ball?

chapters.title: Chapter 94 - 93 Divination_1
chapters.content:
The fortune-telling master was about the same age as Lu Yang. Noticing Lu Yang's gaze, he explained with a hint of complaint, "There's nothing I can do. People nowadays aren't too keen on fortune-telling. They always talk about destiny is in their hands, not at the mercy of fate. It's hard to make a living."
"Some like Eight Diagrams for fortune-telling, so I have an Eight Diagrams board ready."
"Some want to predict their luck in gambling, so I have prepared a dice."
"Some believe in the accuracy of character prediction, so I have the Four Treasures of the Study ready."
"Some feel that tossing a coin is the most accurate, so I have nine coins ready."
"Then there is this crystal ball, a recent trend from the East Sea. People love to predict their fortune with it, so I learned this skill in the East Sea."
"Furthermore, this crystal ball can not only tell fortunes but also secretly play videos. One tool, two sources of income."
"So, want to give it a go? No charge if it's inaccurate." The fortune-telling master enthusiastically marketed himself.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou looked suspiciously at the fortune-telling master, feeling cautious, as if he had figured out something about them.
Man Gu, who was having his fortune told for the first time, found it amusing: "Can you tell my fortune as well?"
The fortune-telling master smiled slightly: "Of course, please tell me which method you would like to use, and what you would like to know?"
Man Gu thought for a moment and felt that as a Confucian cultivator, he should go for character prediction. "Predict mine based on a character I write. Can you predict whether I'll become a great scholar?"
"Please," said the fortune-telling master proficiently, setting the Four Treasures of the Study and inviting Man Gu to write.
Man Gu swiftly wrote a character.
The fortune-telling master knocked on it and let out a sigh. "This character of yours..."
"What's wrong with it?" Man Gu hurriedly asked.
"Your handwriting is ugly. What character is this?"
"Scholar."
"..." The fortune-telling master composed himself and analyzed, "Scholar, meaning gentle, the designation of a technician. It comprises of the characters 'man' and 'need.'
