"Your body is strong, seemingly unbreakable, but you have a soft heart. You lack assertiveness and tend to mimic what you learn."
"Let's look at the character 'need.' It has 'rain' on top and 'and' at the bottom."
"'Need' signifies that you will be needed by others in the future."
"The character 'man' stands alone, meaning you could not only become a great scholar but also a great scholar in a new form."
Hearing that he could become a great scholar, Man Gu was overjoyed.
His level of Confucianism was one of the lowest under the guidance of the Fourth Elder. Even though the Fourth Elder didn't mind and advocated equal education for all, saying that Man Gu hadn't had his enlightenment yet, but once he did, he could make great strides. His potential was immeasurable.
Man Gu had always lacked self-confidence. But, as the fortune-telling master explained it, he said that Man Gu could become a great scholar, which restored his self-confidence.
He knew he still had potential!
"By the way, there's one more thing."
"What?"
"Work on your handwriting when you go back."
"Okay."
"Do you need a handwriting workbook? I just happen to have one. Get one. You have to spend money on your journey to becoming a great scholar."
Man Gu agreed with him and bought a workbook.
After seeing Man Gu finish his fortune-telling, Lan Ting thought it was pretty interesting and also wanted to give it a shot. She sat down and asked, "I would like to know whether my future achievements will be higher in Array Method or Talisman? Use the crystal ball to predict."
She had been studying the Array Method recently and found that she was more interested in it than the Talisman.
Lan Ting was considering whether to change her research focus.
The fortune-telling master held up the crystal ball and aimed at Lan Ting, rubbing his hands back and forth while chanting, "Heavenly spirits, earthly spirits, come forth in the crystal ball! Heavenly spirits, earthly spirits, reveal yourself in the crystal ball!"
Seeing the result displayed in the crystal ball, the fortune-telling master was shocked: "Uh, in the future, you've combined the Array Method and the Talisman into one?"
The divination master looked at Lan Ting with a strange gaze. This was an unusual train of thought. This female cultivator was beautiful beyond compare, yet why was her thinking vastly different from ordinary people?
Lan Ting tilted her head and gave it some thought. Feeling that what the divination master said might be plausible, she hesitantly handed over the money.
It was Meng Jingzhou's turn, and his brow rose slightly: "You wouldn't happen to be a disciple of the Heavenly Strategy Sect, would you?"
The Heavenly Strategy Sect, the number one sect in divination throughout the Central Continent, once accurately predicted the time of the re-emergence of an ancient great era.
The Heavenly Strategy Sect emphasizes causality, so common identity concealment techniques are essentially useless in their presence.
A disciple of the Heavenly Strategy Sect only needs to take one look to discern a person's identity and origins.
Perhaps this divination master had figured out that the four of them hailed from the Seek Dao Sect and the Laurel Fairy Palace.
"Haha, you must be mistaken, junior brother. I'm just a wanderer, just an idle person. How could I ever be a disciple of the Heavenly Strategy Sect?"
Meng Jingzhou fell silent for a moment, then took a blood pact scroll from his identity jade pendant. "Three hundred years ago, the Supreme Elder of the Heavenly Strategy Sect borrowed a huge amount of top-grade spirit stones from our Meng family. Later, when he couldn't pay it back, he hidden himself in his abode and claimed to be in seclusion."
"When our Meng family went to your Heavenly Strategy Sect to collect the debt, your sect leader made a blood pact promising to repay it, and stipulating that any direct descendants of the Meng family, upon encountering a disciple of the Heavenly Strategy Sect, could demand repayment according to the blood pact."
"Do you want to test the power of this blood pact?"
Lu Yang had heard that the Meng family was owed money by people all over the world, it seemed this wasn't a rumor.
The divination master fell to his knees with a thud, hugging Meng Jingzhou's thigh and wailing: "Brother Meng, show some mercy so that we can still meet in the future!"
"Our Heavenly Strategy Sect is so poor that we can't even support our disciples, so they sent us out to fend for ourselves. If I, Luo Bo, had money, how could I stoop so low as to trick and deceive people here!"
"I have to pay a fee to set up my stall here. I can't even afford that!"
Luo Bo, the divination master, pleaded poverty: "Look at my mandarin jacket, patched and repaired, worn for several years without the money to buy a new one!"
Meng Jingzhou rolled his eyes, the mandarin jacket was obviously refined, and quite valuable.
"I didn't expect you to pay back the money, just get up." Meng Jingzhou forcibly pulled his thigh away, "Just give us two free divinations, and I won't cause you any trouble. Remember, no cheating!"
"Hahaha, no problem."
"Come on, check my fate. What will my future achievements be like?" Lu Yang spread his hands, letting Luo Bo read his palm.
Luo Bo laughed, feeling very confident in his area of expertise: "This is a common question. Let me see."
Who would have expected that Luo Bo would widen his eyes, rise in disbelief, and stagger backward until he hit the wall.
"Your fate, what's going on, it's so hazy. In the future, you will have a causality connection with several immortals!"
Luo Bo discovered that despite the causality connections with several immortals, Lu Yang still seemed as free as a bird, as if he wasn't impacted at all.
But the most terrifying thing wasn't even that.
The scariest part was that Luo Bo also discovered that Lu Yang would be a major disaster in the Cultivation World in the future, spreading the influence of the Seek Dao Sect throughout the entire Cultivation World!
The practices of the Seek Dao Sect are already outrageous, but if the entire Cultivation World is infiltrated by the Seek Dao Sect, how could anyone live!
Absolutely cannot be entangled in the causality of such a person!
Inwardly bemoaning his fate, Luo Bo saw the four of them coming from the Five Great Immortal Sects, like four fat sheep ready to be scammed for money. However, he never expected to stumble across an individual like Lu Yang, who he absolutely couldn't have any dealings with!
Wait, to spread such bad practices across the Cultivation World, there was one more person, not just Lu Yang.
The other person was…
Luo Bo turned to look at his major debtor, Meng Jingzhou.
Run away!
Without saying another word, Luo Bo activated his escape technique. Not bothering to clean up his table, he took off running: "I- I- I didn't see any of you today!"
He was afraid that if he lingered a bit more, he would lost his life there.
Before the four of them could even react, Luo Bo had already fled.
Lu Yang blamed Meng Jingzhou: "It must have been your demand for repayment that scared him off."

chapters.title: Chapter 95 - 94: Could This Book Be the One That is Allegedly Concealing..._1
chapters.content:
Confronted with Lu Yang's practiced framing, Meng Jingzhou retorted disdainfully, "What do you mean 'I scared them off'? Didn't you hear them say that you'll be entangled with an Immortal in causality."
"Perhaps you've done something that angers both humans and gods, making the Immortal joint forces to suppress you!"
Lu Yang waved his hand, "Impossible, I always know what I'm doing. I would never do something so outrageous. Luo Bo must be making up an excuse."
The two were quick to lay blame on each other, refusing to admit it was their own problem.
Man Gu opens his mouth, wanting to suggest if it's potentially both of their faults, but in the end, he didn't say it.
After a few days of interaction, Lan Ting gradually became familiar with Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou's speaking style. Listening to their arguments, he simply brushed it off.
"Look, there's the Land Money Trade Association ahead, let's go and have a look!"
At the entrance of the Land Money Trade Association, there was a chubby piglet with a coin in his hand, the classic mascot of the association.
Lu Yang had long heard of the Land Money Trade Association's reputation and wanted to take a look.
The interior decoration of the association was understated, exuding taste everywhere, entirely different from those associations that flaunt their wealth after sudden riches.
The Land Money Trade Association didn't need to show off, its name alone said it all.
In Central Continent, no one doesn't know the name of the top association under the heaven.
The array of merchandise within the association left Man Gu dazzled. There were elixirs carefully refined by masters, spirit treasures painstakingly forged by craftsmen, heavenly and earthly treasures dug from perilous places, talismans, and array methods evolving from simplicity to complexity...
Looking at the marked prices, Man Gu felt like a destitute who couldn't afford anything.
Man Gu noticed Meng Jingzhou and Lan Ting having a casual look around, strolling leisurely, unworried about prices - this he could understand.
But he was surprised to see that Brother Lu, who was worth about the same as him, also seemed unconcerned about prices.
Man Gu quietly asked, "Brother Lu, the things here are so expensive, I can't afford them."
Of course, Man Gu couldn't possibly not afford anything, he was referring to those impressive items suitable for Foundation Establishment Stage that he couldn't afford.
Lu Yang looked at Man Gu in surprise, "Buy? Why would you buy anything here? Look at these elixirs and magic artifacts, they might seem fancy and expensive, but actually, they're just ornaments. In terms of practicality, can they compare to the Sect's products?"
Man Gu nodded, that was true, in terms of value for money, the Sect's fried dough stick was cheap, substantial and chewy. More than a month had passed, and the fried dough stick that Brother Lu gave to Brother Meng was still only half-eaten.
"And besides, as for not having money, wouldn't we go earn some? With our status, we could make money from any purchase. Watch this, I'll show you."
Having said that, Lu Yang approached a nearby server, "Excuse me, do you accept magic skills here?"
The server politely replied, "Yes, sir, we do. However, we only collect the ones not available in the association. We have most of the common magic skills here. Would you like to sell a magic skill?"
Lu Yang nodded, "I have a transformation technique here that allows an attack during transformation. It's my family's exclusive secret."
The server was quite surprised. He had worked here for ten years and never heard of such a transformation technique.
"This way, please. There is an auction going on today, and our appraisal master Yang Xuanling is present. We can ask him to appraise the value of your transformation technique."
The four of them were lead to a room. Inside, a bespectacled old man engrossed in reading. His appearance suggested a knowledgeable and worldly person – presumably, this was Yang Xuanling.
The server whispered a few words in Yang Xuanling's ear.
"Oh? There is such a magic skill? I understand. You may go."
"Yes, sir." The server respectfully retreated from the room.
"You fellows, I heard you've got Transformation Technique, which allows a simultaneous attack?"
"Yes." Lu Yang took out his "Lu's Imitation Fist."
Yang Xuanling paused for a moment, " ... If my eyes are not deceiving me, doesn't that book say 'Imitation Fist'?"
Lu Yang stepped forward, crossed off the words "Imitation Fist" on the cover, and wrote "Transformation Technique."
"Now it is 'Transformation Technique.'
Yang Xuanling has met his first person who named things on a whim. After a long time in this line, he indeed met all kinds of people.
Yang Xuanling slowly turned the pages, analyzing each word and sentence, his voice brimming with anger, "This is nothing more than the Imitation Fist!"
"How is that possible?" Lu Yang seemed quite surprised, "This is clearly a Transformation Technique, watch me demonstrate it for you!"
Lu Yang performed a set of Imitation Fist techniques on the spot, transforming from Man Gu into Meng Jingzhou, then into a Tiger Demon. His display was majestic and powerful, appearing quite impressive.
Yang Xuanling stared at him for a long time with wide eyes, completely unable to understand how Lu Yang was transforming.
What was performed was indeed the Imitation Fist, the process was exactly the same as what was written in the book, and the opponent had not stealthily used any other magic skills.
How much should it be priced at?
Yang Xuanling stroked his beard, a look of complete comprehension on his face: "Your Transformation Technique is quite interesting, it would be a waste to sell it as a regular item. How about taking this Transformation Technique to be auctioned? There is an auction happening soon."
"Okay."
At the auction site, Lu Yang ran into an old acquaintance.
It was Chi Xulong, who had cultivated the Spitting Stone Skill.
Chi Xulong did not disguise himself, constantly flaunting as per his introduction, not liking disguises.
Given his Cultivation Level, he would be well known throughout Yanjiang County, no need for disguise indeed.
A person dressed in a black robe sat next to Chi Xulong, and Lu Yang guessed that it was Shen Jinyi, the assassin.
Lu Yang took the initiative to sit next to Chi Xulong. Chi Xulong sneered with disdain at the sight of the juvenile tofu mask on Lu Yang's face.
For some reason, he felt very angry when he saw Lu Yang.
The well-dressed auctioneer stepped onto the stage. He looked professionally trained, his voice loud and clear without the use of his Cultivation Level, and everyone in the venue could hear him clearly.
"Good afternoon, everyone, thank you for coming. Without further ado, let's get started."
"The first item for auction today is three Foundation Establishment Elixirs."
As soon as these words were spoken, the entire venue buzzed with excitement. No one expected such a heavyweight item to be up for auction first.
Most of the people participating in the auction were in the middle and late stages of their Qi Refinement, the early Qi Refinement stage wouldn't participate knowing their financial limitations.
Even cultivators at the Foundation Establishment Stage were tempted. Who didn't have a junior at the Qi Refinement stage back home?
Only Lu Yang didn't.
He thought about it and realized that among the people he knew, his Cultivation Level was the lowest.
When the ancient ancestors first paved the way for cultivation, they naturally didn't rely on external help and built their own foundations. But it had a significant risk, countless people died during the Foundation Establishment process.
Later, someone came up with a Foundation Establishment Elixir that could increase the efficiency of Foundation Establishment; it not only improves the success rate but also ensures that there are no hidden dangers or setbacks in cultivation after a failed attempt.
Even Lan Ting, a disciple of Fairy Palace, had also used the Foundation Establishment Elixir during her Foundation Establishment.
She asked via voice transmission: "Did you use the Foundation Establishment Elixir during your Foundation Establishment?"
Lu Yang shook his head and responded: "Our understanding of the use of elixirs is relatively advanced. During the Foundation Establishment, we directly ingest the raw materials of the Foundation Establishment Elixir, use our body as a cauldron to refine the raw materials, and allow the medicinal effects to thoroughly dissolve in the meridians."
"Through research, it was found that this method has the highest efficiency in absorbing the medicinal effects."
"To arrive at this conclusion, the Seventh Elder of Elixir Cauldron Peak went through foundation establishment a hundred times during his youth. The data is absolutely reliable."
"Back then, the Seventh Elder even won the title of 'Strongest Foundation Establishment Stage'. However, because the foundation was too solid, the process of forming the golden core was exceptionally painful, almost like having gallstones."
Lan Ting: "..."
As the two spoke, the three Foundation Establishment Elixirs were already auctioned off.
"The next item up for auction is a book on the Transformation Technique." The auctioneer took out the book that Lu Yang had just put up for auction.
Lu Yang exclaimed softly, and spoke in a voice just loud enough for Chi Xulong to hear: "Could this be the book that is rumored to hide..."
Chi Xulong, who originally didn't take much interest in the book, suddenly became keen.

chapters.title: Chapter 96 - 95: How Could There Possibly Be a Righteous Path Mole in the Eternity Sect!_1
chapters.content:
There was a wave of sighs from below the stage. While the Transformation Technique is difficult to cultivate, it's rather common and evidently has no auction value.
Only a handful of individuals were not sighing, such as Lu Yang and Chi Xulong.
The auctioneer continued to introduce, "This book is not your normal Transformation Technique – it even allows for attacks during the transformation process. If used during combat, I believe the technique could catch your enemies off guard."
Only then did people start showing some interest, albeit limited. After all, who uses a Transformation Technique during combat?
The auctioneer reminded, "Bear in mind, this magic skill is extremely difficult to cultivate. Even Master Yang Xuanling has said that while this book seems ordinary, it's far from the simplicity that it presents at surface level."
Lu Yang murmured just loud enough for Chi Xulong to hear, "Just as I thought, this book is uncannily similar to the one described in the legends."
Sitting next to him, Meng Jingzhou heard Lu Yang muttering to himself and hissed out in a low, urgent voice, "Shut up! Can you go around broadcasting those remarks? When will you fix this habit of talking to yourself!"
Scared by Meng Jingzhou's words, Lu Yang shut up, staring intently at the Transformation Technique being exhibited on the stage.
Chi Xulong watched Lu Yang from the corner of his eye, his guesses beginning to solidify.
"Starting bid, one hundred Spirit Stones!"
The price was much lower than the standard Transformation Technique. It appears even the merchant's guild was unsure about the pricing of this Imitation Fist.
"One hundred and ten!" Someone quickly placed a bid, a small amount of Spirit Stones wasn't much, and it was worth it to own something unique.
"One hundred and twenty!" Chi Xulong called out nonchalantly, as if just making a casual remark.
"One hundred and forty!"
"One hundred and eighty!"
"Two hundred!"
The price of the Imitation Fist skyrocketed rapidly.
"Eight hundred!" Lu Yang shouted.
Meng Jingzhou promptly restrained Lu Yang's hand, "Why are you shouting so high? Are you trying to draw people's attention or what?"
"I'm just afraid someone else will buy it," he replied.
Eight hundred Spirit Stones wasn't a significant amount, but that was for a Cultivator at the Foundation Establishment Stage; a Cultivator at the Qi Refinement Stage can't casually afford eight hundred Spirit Stones.
"One thousand!"
A voice rang out next to Lu Yang. Looking surprised, Lu Yang turned towards Chi Xulong, unable to comprehend why he would compete with him for the Transformation Technique.
It's merely an appealingly unique magic skill at first glance!
Could he have realized something as well?
But how could he have figured it out?
An inward curse slipped out from Lu Yang's lips. Could Chi Xulong have overheard him mumbling to himself earlier?
Lu Yang said to Chi Xulong in a low voice, "Fellow Cultivator, this magic skill appears to be a long-lost technique from my family. Could you let me have it? You will be generously rewarded after the auction ends."
Chi Xulong coldly laughed. Long lost indeed. Who would believe you? There must be ancient secrets hidden within this magic skill!
Shen Jinyi, sitting nearby, wanted to intervene but seeing the determined attitude Chi Xulong displayed, he chose not to say anything.
Seeing sweet talk wasn't working, Lu Yang made another bid, "One thousand and two hundred low-grade Spirit Stones!"
"Two thousand," Chi Xulong countered, without batting an eye. Seeing Lu Yang being so compliant, he speculated that the latter hadn't reached the Foundation Establishment Stage.
Lu Yang wagered all he had, "Two thousand and three hundred low-grade Spirit Stones!"
"Three thousand," Chi Xulong still showed disinterest.
Lu Yang asked Meng Jingzhou to lend him some money, "Borrow me a thousand Spirit Stones. I'll be certain to return them next year!"
"Okay." Meng Jingzhou agreed readily.
"Three thousand and three hundred low-grade Spirit Stones!"
"Four thousand!"
Lu Yang continued borrowing money, but he ultimately couldn't compete with Chi Xulong's deep pockets.
In the end, Chi Xulong successfully bid on the Transformation Technique for a terrifying eight thousand Spirit Stones. Lu Yang, teary-eyed, profited from an advance of eight thousand Spirit Stones. The outcome was mutually beneficial, bringing joy to both parties.
After the auction, as Lu Yang and his party were about to leave, stepping outside the market area and reaching the foot of the barren mountains, they were cornered by Chi Xulong and Shen Jinyi.
"What... What do you want!"
Chi Xulong hooked his lips in a cruel smile, "What do I want? Kid, don't play dumb. No one has ever managed to trick me!"
Chi Xulong pulled out the Transformation Technique, releasing the energy signature of the Foundation Establishment Stage, "Tell me, what's the ancient secret hidden inside this book?"
"If you cooperate, I can spare your lives. But if you dare to lie, don't blame me for being ruthless!"
Chi Xulong had no intention of letting the four of them go, knowing that fewer people who knew the ancient secret, the better. Also, Lan Ting's extraordinarily beautiful appearance - surely he would want to toy with her before he killed her!
To Chi Xulong, these four people couldn't even afford a few thousand spirit stones, so they must be in the Qi Refinement stage.
Those in the Qi Refinement stage have no chance of resistance against him!
Lu Yang sighed, remembering how Rudder Master Chu had hinted to him to stir up trouble during the Spring Festival. Could it be that Master Chu had already anticipated today's situation and suggested to him to kill Chi Xulong and Shen Jinyi?
Master Chu is truly inscrutable in his plans!
Lu Yang removed his mask, revealing his true face, "Chi Xulong, there is no need for such tension between us."
As he spoke, he sneaked out the Recording Orb.
"Lu Yang! You deserve to die!" Chi Xulong was furious, instantly realizing that Lu Yang was just toying with him.
The auction was just a show played for his own benefit!
"There must be some misunderstanding between us; certainly, it's caused by some mischief-maker. What do you say we go to Rudder Master Chu and clear the air? Even if you don't believe me, you should trust Master Chu, right?"
He wasn't angry until Master Chu was mentioned, Chi Xulong was furious, "How dare you mention Master Chu? Have you no shame?"
"Master Chu must have been deceived by you, that's why he let you be the Manager. Who is the troublemaker? It's you!"
"How could I be the troublemaker? Don't slander me!" Lu Yang vehemently defended himself.
Chi Xulong sneered, "Don't think I don't know about your damned deeds!"
"You act decent in front of Master Chu. Since you have joined the sect, everything you've done is all about screwing us over. I suspect you're a mole from the Righteous Path!"
Of course, Chi Xulong was saying this out of anger. If he genuinely thought that Lu Yang was a mole from the Righteous Path, he would have secretly been monitoring Lu Yang for evidence.
Lu Yang heaved a sigh, tucked away the Recording Orb, drew out his Green Peak Sword, and regrettably stated, "It seems there's only one way to settle this between us - a battle."
Both Chi Xulong and Shen Jinyi responded with disdainful smiles and readied their weapons.
Meng Jingzhou, Man Gu, and Lan Ting too, prepared themselves for battle.
The battle began.
...
Lu Yang brought news of Chi Xulong and Shen Jinyi's deaths to Master Chu.
No matter how strong Chi Xulong and Shen Jinyi were, it was impossible for them to survive against four disciples of the Immortal Sect. This was a battle where they were completely crushed. Their grisly deaths made Lan Ting lose her appetite.
As he pulled out the Recording Orb, Lu Yang explained to Master Chu: "You know Chi Xulong's temper. He would kill someone at the slightest disagreement. I was worried something like this might happen, so I recorded everything beforehand. This way, he couldn't come here claiming innocence, accusing me of bullying him."
"It seems like he isn't going to be coming here after all."
"Something must have gone wrong with the Recording Orb; the recording is quite fragmented. But, it should give you a general idea of what happened. Please have a look."
Sitting in his jade chair, Rudder Master Chu picked up the Recording Orb and watched the recorded scene.
"Chi Xulong, there's no need for such tension between us." Lu Yang tried to mitigate the situation.
"Lu Yang! You deserve to die!" Clearly, Chi Xulong didn't appreciate his efforts.
"There must be some misunderstanding between us; certainly, it's caused by some mischief-maker. What do you say we go to Rudder Master Chu and clear the air? Even if you don't believe me, you should trust Master Chu, right?"
"Master Chu...Where do you get the nerve!"
"Master Chu…. let you..become the Manager… You are the mischief-maker!"
"…How could I be the mischief-maker? Don't speak nonsense!" Lu Yang firmly defended himself.
"Don't think I don't know …what… good things you've done!"
"…Master Chu… acts like a perfect gentleman… everything you've done since joining is screwing us over… I think…you're a mole from the Righteous Path!"
The recording ended there, leaving Master Chu gritting his teeth in anger.
With righteous indignation, Lu Yang commented, "Master, you've been good to me. We, of the Demon Path, know the value of loyalty, the fury of not being recognized, and the power of gratitude. Seeing Chi Xulong falsely accusing and framing you, with Shen Jinyi standing by doing nothing, I was enraged and decided, with Meng Jingzhou and others, to kill him!"
"It was not suitable to record during the fight, so I put away the Recording Orb."
Of course, Lu Yang wouldn't let Master Chu know his style of combat.
Rudder Master Chu loudly praised him, barely containing his anger towards Chi Xulong: "Well done! Those two beasts, Chi Xulong and Shen Jinyi, deserved to die!"
Master Chu knew that Chi Xulong was dissatisfied with him. Considering Chi Xulong was talented, he had once summoned him for guidance. At that time, Chi Xulong even pledged his loyalty, promising to do better than Lu Yang.
Now it seems that Chi Xulong still held resentment against him, even spouting nonsense about him being a mole from the Righteous Path.
How could the Eternity Sect have a mole from the Righteous Path!
"Lu Yang, you have eliminated two serious threats for our sect. Well done! When the Inspector comes, I will certainly put in a good word for you!"

chapters.title: Chapter 97 - 96 Long Vacation_1
chapters.content:
"Also, I've received a message from the Inspector. He mentioned that he's heard of the Spring Festival and has adjusted his itinerary to arrive during it in Yanjiang County. You should be mentally prepared and not show any doubts in front of the Inspector."
Previously, the Inspector had planned to visit Yanjiang County after the Spring Festival.
"Yes."
When Lu Yang was leaving the branch, he met Wang He, Bai Zifang and other managers coming towards him.
Wang He and the others gave a brief nod as greeting, recognizing Lu Yang as the new favorite in front of Master Chu, who they wouldn't dare offend.
Having worked at the branch for decades, Wang He and his colleagues knew some things; they speculated that Master Chu appointed Lu Yang and his two comrades directly because of their high evaluations during the initiation test, especially Lu Yang, who might have received the highest evaluation among them.
In a low voice, Wang He said, "Master Chu has always been opportunistic, seeing potential profit in everything. He probably identified Lu Yang's potential for success and thought it wise to establish a good relationship with him before he made it big, which would make it easier when they get promoted in the future."
They knew that Master Chu's greatest ambition was promotion, to be a leader in a more economically prosperous area. Thus, he paid special attention to the impending arrival of the Inspector.
"Maybe our presence here is also related to the Inspector."
"But, Master Chu is still one step away from promotion, right? Has he reached the Nascent Soul Stage yet?"
A promotion in the sect does not only rely on faith in the Immortal Eternity but also places importance on cultivation level.
"Who knows? He might have already reached it and just didn't tell us. He always does things without explaining to us, so we don't know the purpose of his actions."
Master Chu's style reflects the nature of the entire demonic sect, filled with mistrust. Although Master Chu appears to trust Lu Yang, the reality is different. He has never disclosed any information about himself to Lu Yang.
Lu Yang knew very little about Master Chu.
...
The Spring Festival duly arrived, and the customer flow in the barbecue restaurant reached its peak. Numerous merchants from out of town had noticed the business potential of the barbecue restaurant and proposed to Lu Yang that they open a branch, with Lu Yang supplying the recipes and them providing the funds.
Without exception, they were all sent away by an unsmiling Lu Yang.
There were also cultivators who tried to dine and dash, but upon seeing the three banners hanging on the wall, they swallowed their impractical thought and paid honestly.
With the assistance of the automated barbecue matrix, the two ghouls had more time to thread the skewers, so the barbecue restaurant could handle more customers than usual.
"Another round of barbecue... Yes, this one, my aunt told me that this barbecue restaurant is very delicious, you must try it if you come to Yanjiang County!"
"Look, this restaurant even has promotions now. If you spend in this restaurant, you can get a voucher for a 10% discount in the tofu shop on Front Street."
"For every silver spent, you can spin the lucky wheel once. The spins can accumulate, no cap to it. The prizes are limited on a first-come-first-served basis."
"Let's go and try."
The two agreed and lined up at the end of the queue, unaware of how long they would have to wait to eat.
At the entrance of the barbecue restaurant, Meng Jingzhou was busy with the lucky wheel, thoroughly enjoying himself.
The wheel had the words "another spin", "third prize", "second prize", "first prize", and "special prize".
"Congratulations to this guest for winning the second prize, a 40% discount on their purchase! Let's congratulate him!" Meng Jingzhou clapped enthusiastically, looking even more delighted than the prize winner.
"The first prize, we have a winner of the first prize, this guest's entire bill is on the house!"
"The special prize, someone actually won the special prize!"
The guest did not expect to win the special prize and happily asked, "What's the special prize?"
Meng Jingzhou held the guest's hand, enthusiastically saying, "Congratulations! You've won a chance to experience being a waiter in our shop! Normally, customers would have to pay for the chance to experience the joy of working in our shop, but you're fortunate enough that you don't have to pay a dime!"
"Considering the smoky and unpleasant environment in the kitchen, our professional staff would help bring the skewers out for you, so you don't have to go into the kitchen!" Meng Jingzhou made it seem as if this was a thoughtful decision on their part.
The guest asked, "… Can I get the first prize instead?"
"No."
The guest declined the special prize.
Up to this point, Meng Jingzhou has yet to convince anyone to accept the special prize, but he greatly enjoyed the process of tricking people.
In the barbecue restaurant, Lu Yang was bustling around with a tray, weaving through customers in the shop. His steps were light, movements agile, and his lower body remained extremely stable. The tray didn't tilt, the skewers didn't sway, and he didn't bump into any customers. He moved around as though he was treading on thin ice.
After more than a month of working as a waiter, his level of agility had greatly improved.
"Chief Ma, Chief Chi, how's the food?" Lu Yang asked, smiling at two customers who were officials in the county and frequently came to their restaurant for barbecue and drinks.
"As delicious as ever. To be honest, Mr. Little Lu, with your skills, having your restaurant here is a waste. You should open your business in a larger county. I bet you'd earn much more!"
"Don't talk nonesense. Haven't you heard Mr. Little Lu doesn't even want to open branches? He's obviously running this restaurant because he enjoys it, not because he wants to get rich."
Lu Yang could only respond with a smile, "I hope you both have a good time during the Spring Festival."
Both of them were obviously drunk, their faces flushed and smiling incoherently. Chief Ma grumbled, "Speaking of the Spring Festival, it annoys me. The holiday used to last seven days, a long vacation. Now, I don't know whose idea it was, but they shortened it to three days!"
"What can you do in three days? They even have the audacity to call it a 'little long vacation'. What nonsense! If you put 'little' in front of 'long vacation', does it still count as a long vacation!"
"I hope the person who came up with this term lives a 'little' long life!"
Chief Chi quickly covered Chief Ma's mouth, "You shouldn't talk like that. You arrived late, so it's understandable if you didn't know. This was County Lord Li's idea!"
Chief Ma snorted, "So it was him. He doesn't have much ability, but he sure has a lot of ideas!"
Chief Chi was slightly more informed, "Quiet down. We can't speak ill of County Lord Li now. I heard that he's found his way and has captured three wicked demon cultivators in the county. This is a huge merit, and he's about to be promoted. The current Head Capture Official, Fang Qingyun, is to replace his position!"
Chief Ma sneered, indifferent to Li's opinion of him since Li wouldn't care about his opinion either, "The other day one of my colleagues complained to me, saying that Lord Li was giving absurd orders, demanding his staff work overtime until dawn, insisting they must plant loads of little flags overnight, with no errors in positioning. He even acted as the supervisor himself, putting on airs.
He may not need sleep being at the Golden Core Stage, but others do. Many of them fell asleep while working!"
Lu Yang poured them more drinks, "I'll go tend to the other customers now."
"Off you go, Mr. Little Lu, you don't need to bother about us."
On the first night of the Spring Festival, the exhaustion took a toll, leaving the four people and two ghouls sprawled out.
Just before falling asleep, Man Gu contemplated, "I think ghouls don't need sleep. Should we have them work at night too?"

chapters.title: Chapter 98 - 97 What was He Carving on the Boat? (Thanks to Book Friends Kuí xiū bá guì for the Alliance Leader Reward) _1
chapters.content:
Lan Ting was initially accustomed to meditating at night instead of sleeping, but since joining the barbecue shop, he had formed a good habit of sleeping at night.
When the four of them woke up, they felt comfortable all over, and their spirits were completely lifted, all thanks to the Array Method set up by Lan Ting.
"Let's go and play. I haven't had enough fun!" Meng Jingzhou was the most vigorous, waking Lu Yang up from bed like one would drive a pig.
Lu Yang kicked Meng Jingzhou before unwillingly getting up.
Man Gu went to the market early to purchase supplies, always the first to get up.
Man Gu made a pot of noodle soup, added four eggs, dripped a few drops of sesame oil, and the fragrance spread throughout the hall.
Lu Yang liked vinegar, he added a small spoonful to his bowl of noodle soup. The four of them finished their meals, feeling refreshed and ready for fun.
Though the four of them left quite early, there were already numerous tourists roaming the streets. Lu Yang heard that all the lodges had been booked up, so many people opted for homestays.
The people's faces were brimming with joyous smiles, children wore tofu masks similar to Lu Yang's, holding windmills in their hands, jumping around energetically. Parents held their children's hands tightly, fearing they might get lost.
"This is as lively as a temple fair."
"Did you hear? Someone brought a gigantic creature from the southern part of the mainland. It's by the river, let's go and see!" someone excitedly said to his companion.
Upon hearing this, Meng Jingzhou, unable to suppress his curiosity, led the three to the river to see the gigantic creature.
The four of them arrived at the familiar large stone bridge, only this time they stood on top of it. Small flags were inserted all along both sides of the bridge.
Upon seeing the gigantic creature, Meng Jingzhou was somewhat disappointed: "I thought it would be something more exciting. Turns out it's just an elephant."
By the Hidden Dragon River, this place was originally a gathering spot for tourists every year. Now, someone brought an elephant from the southern part of the mainland to show off, attracting even more curious onlookers.
Undoubtedly, Lu Yang had seen an elephant before. Meng Jingzhou and Lan Ting, who came from influential families, had seen more exotic objects since childhood than Lu Yang could ever imagine. Man Gu, who lived in the wilderness, had even hunted elephants.
Ordinary people didn't have the experiences of Lu Yang and the others and were very interested in the huge elephant.
The tourists exclaimed, "Is it a demon beast? It's so big, and it has such a long nose and tusks?"
The owner of the elephant was a Foundation Establishment Stage cultivator. He explained, "It indeed is a demon beast. It's hard to evaluate the realm of a demon beast, but it roughly equates to the sixth level of Qi Refinement. However, size has nothing to do with being a demon beast. This type of creature is called an elephant and they all grow this big after maturity."
The tourists continued to ask, "How heavy is this huge creature?"
The elephant's owner laughed dumbfoundedly. Who would know? There weren't any scales big enough for measuring it.
Another tourist suggested, "This place is right next to the river. You can put the elephant on a large boat, mark where the boat touches the water, then load the boat with rocks or other stuff until the mark touches the water again. Weigh the rocks, and we'll know the elephant's weight."
The elephant's owner, curious to know how much his spiritual pet weighed, happily agreed.
At the owner's command, the elephant was shepherded onto the boat. The elephant was too heavy, even for the boat in the shallow water. Therefore, the owner rowed the boat to the middle of the river. He pulled out a small knife and made a mark where the boat touched the water.
Lan Ting pondered, "A body in a fluid experiences an upward force called buoyancy, equal to the weight of the fluid displaced by the object."
Just as the owner was about to row back, the elephant looked up by chance and saw Man Gu, which scared it badly.
Demon beasts are highly sensitive to aura. Man Gu, as a member of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe, lived in the wilderness and hunted elephants regularly. The ferocious killing intent blended into his bloodstream. Although the elephant didn't understand the meaning, it trembled at the sight of Man Gu. This reaction came from the suppression of their bloodline.
The frightened elephant suddenly fell into the water with a splash, sinking to the bottom.
The people on the shore cried out in horror, urging the elephant's owner to save it immediately. However, the elephant's owner calmly made a mark where the elephant fell into the water and said, "Note this place. This is where the elephant fell."
The people on the shore were confused. The owner didn't explain either, instead pointing out the mark as they almost reached the shore and explained, "My elephant fell here, and it's still here!"
The crowd laughed heartily, thinking he was joking. Unexpectedly, they saw a whirlpool formed on the river surface, and the elephant flew out from beneath it, fanning its large ears and flickering its eyes.
A southern mainland speciality product, giant flying elephants.
Observing the scene, Man Gu furrowed his brows. Suddenly his face lit up with realization and he smacked his palm, exclaiming, "I remember now, this is a common saying I learned in class: 'mark the boat for the elephant!'"
He had just gained a deep understanding of the saying.
Lu Yang: "..."
What on earth had he been learning in class?
Meng Jingzhou laughed and said, "I remember us finding the first Reverse Life Talisman under that bridge. We were so scared when we first learned about this thing, luckily we reported it."
Lu Yang was about to play along with Meng Jingzhou's joke when he noticed the small flags in front of him. He pulled out a flag and started examining it closely against the sunlight, his face serious.
"What's wrong?" Meng Jingzhou noticed the change in Lu Yang's demeanor. He had been waiting for Lu Yang to respond in jest but instead found Lu Yang acting differently.
Lu Yang fixed a grave look on his face, pointing to the faint pattern on the flag, "Look at this pattern. What does it look like to you?"
"The Reverse Life Talisman?!" Lan Ting was the first to react as she was quite familiar with the pattern.
Meng Jingzhou's eyes widened. The pattern on the flag was very faint, hardly visible without being held up to the sunlight. Even if it was visible, tourists would probably assume it was part of the Spring Festival decoration. How many people would recognize the Reverse Life Talisman's pattern?
"Don't panic. The Reverse Life Array might not have been formed yet!" Meng Jingzhou told himself to stay calm.
Lu Yang analyzed with a calm demeanor, "That's impossible. Don't forget, these are not just one or two flags. They're all over Yanjiang County!"
A flag containing the Reverse Life Talisman pattern was hidden amongst the ordinary ones. Who could have imagined?!
Lu Yang continued, "In other words, the Reverse Life Array has been completed. They laid it all out in front of everyone, but no one noticed!"
"Then why hasn't the Reverse Life Array been activated?" Meng Jingzhou thought of the conditions to activate the Reverse Life Array. Apart from setting up the array with the Reverse Life Talisman, it also required a blood sacrifice.
The people bold enough to lay out the Reverse Life Array could easily kill, so what were they waiting for?
Lu Yang responded grimly, "They are waiting for more people. The number of people here for the Spring Festival is not enough yet. People are still flocking to Yanjiang County!"
The Reverse Life Array would rob ordinary people of their lifespans, turning it into cultivation power for the one who set up the array. The more people robbed, the more cultivation power they would gain!
Meng Jingzhou also remembered, "According to customs, people will gather in the streets to sing and celebrate on the second night of the Spring Festival. They'll also gather by the river for feasts and song contests!"
Today was the second day of the Spring Festival.

chapters.title: Chapter 99 - 98: Guaranteed Plan_1
chapters.content:
Seeing more and more people gathering on the Great Stone Bridge, Lu Yang suggested leaving the area and moving to somewhere less crowded.
The group arrived at a tranquil forest. Lu Yang produced the map of Yanjiang County, indicating the nodes of the Reverse Life Array they had predicted before, "The node positions of the Reverse Life Array should remain the same as before. But, before that, I want to confirm one thing.
Lan Ting, your mention of 'sacrificing with blood' – does that mean killing people at the node, or using a cultivator's essence blood as a sacrifice to activate the Array?"
Lan Ting didn't understand Lu Yang's meaning, "Both methods can be used, but usually, the former is preferred. Killing commoners is easier, using too much essence blood can impact cultivation level and be harmful to future cultivation."
Lu Yang seemed to understand something, "In that case, those who arrange the Array Method should opt for the second method."
The others were puzzled. The one who would set up the Array Method was definitely a demon cultivator and for them, killing is certainly more convenient than using essence blood.
"Who do you think has such audacity to hide the Reverse Life Array in a small banner and set it up overnight, cloaking their actions under the cover of night so even if anyone was suspicious, they wouldn't be discovered?"
Meng Jingzhou responded quickly, "Someone from the government, and in a position of power!"
Lu Yang nodded, "Exactly, to be more precise, the County Magistrate!"
"What!"
The words shocked Man Gu and Lan Ting, leaving them pale. Only Meng Jingzhou seemed to have anticipated it and was less affected.
He had mentioned earlier that it was not unusual for the government and the demonic sect to collude.
"Last night I overheard some people from the government office. Apparently, County Lord Li personally supervised the placement of the small banners and insisted that their positioning can't be flawed."
"Is such a matter worth the personal involvement of the County Magistrate? It is really far-fetched to justify this activity as 'being dedicated to civic affairs'."
"This only provides evidence that County Lord Li has installed the Reverse Life Array that covers the entire county using those small banners!"
Finally grasping the situation, Man Gu lamented at how dark the world had become, "This means that the undercover agent embedded by the branch rudder in Yanjiang County was County Lord Li himself. Considering his cultivation and status, it should be more precise to say that they have a collaboration?"
Lu Yang shook his head, "Not undercover, not a partner either. I suspect that Rudder Master Chu and County Lord Li are the same person!"
"I have no concrete evidence, only two suspicions."
"Firstly, Rudder Master Chu always meets us at night. I have asked other Managers about it and they claimed that the other branches don't operate this way."
"Secondly, both Rudder Master Chu and County Lord Li are due for a promotion and the timings are almost identical."
Man Gu gasped in shock. The world was grimmer than he thought if Rudder Master Chu and County Lord Li were the same person. Were they playing both sides of the Righteous Path and the Demon Path?
"Of course, they might be two different people. These are just my suspicions. But regardless of the situation, the method to activate the Reverse Life Array wouldn't be killing commoners!"
Man Gu still didn't get it, so Meng Jingzhou explained, "County Lord Li is up for a promotion. If a serious homicide happened during the Spring Festival, he could kiss his promotion goodbye. Even if he has connections up high, they can't blatantly support his promotion."
"Besides, with his status as the County Magistrate, it is no hard task to get essence blood from cultivators. He just needs to find a few cultivators in prison."
Lan Ting still caught in doubts, "The Reverse Life Array set up by County Lord Li and Yizhanghong, is it a coincidence or a connection?"
"I deem, it's highly related." After getting through the identity of Rudder Master Chu and County Lord Li, Lu Yang had a different perspective on many matters.
"Let's not speak of the political merits County Lord Li reaped from the capture of the three Demon Cultivators at the Foundation Establishment Stage. Without the existence of the branch rudder, a small county only has so many Demon Cultivators at the Foundation Establishment Stage. This is pretty much like eradicating the heads of the demonic cultivators in a county."
"After the Reverse Life Array is activated, it may not seem detectable, but over time, it will inevitably be noticed."
"If it weren't for Yizhanghong, the government would vigorously trace the culprit. By then, both Yanjiang Rudder and County Lord Li risk exposure."
"County Lord Li made a smart move of arranging Yizhanghong."
"With Yizhanghong setting up the Reverse Life Array ahead of time, even if County Lord Li starts the Reverse Life Array and reduces the lifespan of the common people, the government would only have their eyes on Yizhanghong."
Man Gu was shocked, "But Yizhanghong did not successfully set it up."
Lu Yang scoffed, "Failure is just a claim by Yizhanghong. It's highly possible that the array was activated but because of his misoperation, it only reduced lifespan while failing to augment his own cultivation. After all, it is an unfamiliar Array Method - anything could happen."
Man Gu still could not understand, "But his two companions could confirm its failure."
"Companions? Where does a Demon Cultivator get companions? They all use each other. It is in logic for Yizhanghong to hide the truth from the two of them."
"With a ready-made suspect right in front, who wouldn't suspect Yizhanghong?"
"And, with all his crimes, he is certain to receive the death sentence. Perhaps, by the time the government discovers the activation of the Reverse Life Array, Yizhanghong would have been executed."
"With Yizhanghong as a scapegoat, who would suspect County Lord Li?"
Meng Jingzhou and Lan Ting frequently nodded, agreeing with Lu Yang's points.
Lu Yang asked again, "Also, are there seven nodes that need the blood sacrifice?"
Lan Ting looked at Lu Yang in surprise and nodded, not understanding how Lu Yang knew about it. Didn't he say he didn't know Array Methods?
"Yesterday, when I left, I ran into seven Managers. Rudder Master Chu had summoned them for some task. I guess they were assigned to hold the essence blood and wait for the right time at the array nodes."
"In that case, explain more about the Reverse Life Array."
Lan Ting did not refuse, circling seven locations on the map of Yanjiang County, "These seven locations are key nodes for activation and they are located near the scenic spots of Yanjiang County. The Array Eye is on… the waist of Song Mountain!"
Of course, a secluded place would be chosen to break through using the Reverse Life Array.
"We should first remove some of the Reverse Life Talismans to hinder the activation of the Array Method. However, this is most likely to attract the attention of Rudder Master Chu. Instead of waiting for him to knock on our door, it's better for us to ambush him first." Lu Yang suggested.
The reason why Lu Yang did not mention their combat methods in the Recording Orb was exactly because he anticipated a possible battle with Rudder Master Chu.
All three of them felt uneasy. It would be a life-and-death struggle, and Rudder Master Chu was a formidable opponent being in the late stage of Golden Core.
"Can we report this? Tell Fang Qingyun about it." Man Gu suggested.
Lu Yang shook his head, "Once Fang Qingyun finds out about the array on the small banners, he will definitely suspect County Lord Li. If County Lord Li is caught, our identities as demonic sect disciples will also be exposed."
Lan Ting hesitated, "Just the four of us against a Golden Core late-stage practitioner, it might be hard to defeat the opponent."
However, Lu Yang was confident, "Fear not. Let's prepare thoroughly. If really rendered helpless, I still have a backup plan."
"What is it?"
"Eldest Sister's Form Boxing!"
Upon hearing this, the complexion of Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu changed dramatically. Lan Ting noticed their reactions but didn't understand, "What is Eldest Sister's Form Boxing?"
"It's the ultimate move of Lu's Form Boxing!" Lu Yang said confidently.
Lan Ting, half understanding, nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 100 - 99: The Most Powerful Weapon of the Chamber of Commerce_1
chapters.content:
Fang Qingyun, bored out of his mind, yawned. The grand event of the Spring Festival was less than an hour away, and thankfully, they had finished all the preparatory work ahead of time, and everything had been arranged properly, there had been no accidents so far in the Spring Festival.
During the day, Fang Qingyun had heard that a large elephant had fallen into the water and then flew out of it. He sent people to warn them that flying without permission within the county was too dangerous, and any demon beasts entering the city without registering needed to duly register their presence.
Such minor incidents had occupied Fang Qingyun for the entire day.
"I hope nothing happens tonight, hope there won't be anyone starting a bonfire leading to a forest fire, hope there won't be any stampede incidents because of theaters, hope there will not be any street fights because of jealousy..."
Fang Qingyun went on and on, listing out incidents that had happened in previous years.
"Qingyun, I'll leave first." County Lord Li bid farewell to Fang Qingyun before leaving.
"Take care." Fang Qingyun was even more respectful to County Lord Li than usual. He had heard that no leaders were appointed from above this time, and he was able to replace County Lord Li's position, thank to the kind words from County Lord Li.
Such a favor should not be forgotten.
Ordinarily, County Lord Li wouldn't need to be here during the Spring Festival. But his presence would showcase his hard work, which would create a good impression when the word got out.
County Lord Li always cared about his reputation. He found that complimenting people was a much easier path to promotion than doing the actual work.
Promotions also had requirements for realm, which was an unspoken rule in the bureaucracy.
"Soon, once I advance to the Nascent Soul Stage today, regardless of whether it is the identity of the County Magistrate or the Rudder Master, everything will change." Thinking about this, County Lord Li's steps became even lighter.
He walked into a small alley, changed his face, and put on a mask. Even if someone were to take off the mask, they would assume it was his actual face and would not suspect that it was in fact County Lord Li.
Walking along the line of righteousness and evil required caution.
With his talent, he really shouldn't have been able to cultivate to the late stage of the Golden Core. His current achievements were thanks to his ability to mingle in both righteous and evil paths and to utilize resources that were beyond the imagination of ordinary people.
In recent years, he realized he had reached a bottleneck, and it was impossible for him to reach the Nascent Soul Stage through normal methods. To take a step further in both status and realm, he thought of the Reverse Life Array.
"It's strange, the inspector should have arrived in Yanjiang County before noon today, why he hasn't come yet?"
County Lord Li, no, after putting on the mask, he became Master Chu. Master Chu was somewhat dissatisfied with the inspector's tardiness. He had specifically told the inspector to arrive before noon today, and he had a surprise in store for him.
The so-called surprise was to activate the Reverse Life Array with the inspector, and simultaneously enhance the realms of both of them.
"Did something unexpected happen? I purposely waited until the time when most people were present to activate the grand array, well, if he's not coming, I will advance the realm by myself."
Off the beaten track of Song Mountain, trees were thriving, and the mountain paths were created by step-by-step footprints of travelers. Those who came to play during the Spring Festival would not come to such a place in Song Mountain for fun.
Master Chu, hiding his aura, headed towards Song Mountain. The further he walked, the less people there were, until there was no one at the foot of Song Mountain.
Eventually, he stopped in a flat area. The branches around were hanging with talismans different from the usual Reverse Life Talismans, which served as array eyes.
He sat cross-legged, adjusting his state, quietly waiting for the moment of the array's activation. He had sent six managers to carry out the essence blood sacrificial task. According to the calculation, the time was just right now!
"Reverse Life Array, rise!" Master Chu lifted his hands to the sky to activate the Array Method.
Centered on him, the silent power of the array spread outwards, stopping at a certain place.
"Someone pulled out the flag!" Master Chu was stunned for a moment, then quickly realized what had happened.
This was not an accidental removal of one or two flags. The other party definitely knew something about the Reverse Life Array, or they couldn't have been so precise!
"Who is it? Someone from the government office? No, it's not possible, I would have known about any actions from the government office."
"An unknown traveler? Or is it... Lu Yang who has seen the Reverse Life Array!"
Lu Yang behaved differently from common people, it was possible for him to do something like this!
Master Chu's eyes grew colder, this was tantamount to searing off his own way forward, worse than being killed!
"Eh, is that the person you think I am in your heart, Master Chu?" Lu Yang's laissez-faire voice sounded nearby.
"Lu Yang!" Master Chu boiled with anger when he saw Lu Yang, "Don't think that I can't kill you just because the Master appreciates you. It's too common for a Demon Cultivator to die unexpectedly. You gave me such a reason!"
Lu Yang thought for a while and said seriously: "Didn't you say that you wanted me to stir things up during Spring Festival? I thought that the biggest thing I could do was to take down the County Magistrate. Isn't it a coincidence, that after following the County Magistrate for several days, we found out that you are the county magistrate?"
"I thought I should follow through with it and take you down. Isn't this also in line with the tradition of our demonic sect of rebelling from the bottom to the top?" Lu Yang said with a grin.
"You're courting death!" Master Chu boiled with rage.
"Of course not, I still want to live forever."
"A mere cultivator at the Foundation Establishment stage dares to talk big here. Die!" Master Chu struck out angrily with one palm. His palm wind was horrifying, capable of causing destruction, causing all the trees it struck to be pulverized!
Lu Yang escaped this strike by shrinking the earth beneath him, but when Master Chu stomped his right foot down, the whole earth was overturned, causing Lu Yang to be thrown out as well.
Lu Yang was shocked. This was a late-stage Golden Core cultivator, who had just sent him flying with a single kick.
"Tsk, he's tough to deal with."
Master Chu, like a thunderclap, rushed towards Lu Yang at a flying speed, with a fist as fast as the wind, ready to pound Lu Yang into a pulp.
The Green Peak Sword was horizontally placed in front of Lu Yang, with the sword blade standing vertically. As long as Master Chu dared to strike down, the Green Peak Sword could shave off his fist bone!
Master Chu immediately withdrew his fist, kicked with his foot, and Lu Yang, who had anticipated this, kicked out as well, both feet collided and Lu Yang was sent flying out!
Master Chu attacked once again, but found that his spiritual power was as if chained, and he could not summon it at all.
"A Forbidden Spirit Array with the same effect as a large cell, you really do understand Array Method!" Master Chu glared at Lu Yang, even though he couldn't use his spiritual power, but with his physical defense, Lu Yang couldn't hurt him at all!
The Forbidden Spirit Array was temporarily set up by Lan Ting, and Lu Yang's goal was to lure Master Chu here.
Lu Yang smiled, waved goodbye to Master Chu.
Master Chu looked around and noticed nothing unusual, when suddenly, he looked up and saw a flying boat suspended overhead.
A flying boat that Meng Jingzhou had just bought from the business association.
Now it was night, and the shadows on Song Mountain made it hard to see anything. Otherwise, Master Chu would have noticed that he was in the shadows already.
The sky above the Forbidden Spirit Array also had no spiritual force. The flying boat lost power and plummeted. Meng Jingzhou, with a parachute on his back, jumped out.
The flying boat was too large, and Master Chu couldn't use the spiritual force, so his speed was limited and he couldn't dodge. Lu Yang calculated the distance and hid far away.
Like a meteor, the flying boat dropped from the low altitude, crashing towards Master Chu!
Boom!
The flying boat fell, lifting up endless dust, making a thunderous noise. The whole Song Mountain felt the tremor.
There seemed to be explosives in the flying boat. At the moment of falling, the explosives were detonated, and a fire rose to the sky, deafening!
Lu Yang gave Meng Jingzhou a thumbs-up: "It's good to have money, buy a flying boat whenever you want!"
Meng Jingzhou also gave a thumbs-up: "If there were more than one flying boat in the merchant's possession, I would have bought a few more!"
None of the magic artifacts in the business association's possession could match a crashing flying boat.
Fang Qingyun, who was basking in the peacefulness of time, saw a flying boat falling and was so frightened that he nearly had a heart attack.
"Are you messing with me?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 101 - 101 Is This a Surprise? (Ask for Monthly Tickets)_1
chapters.content:
The airship crashed to the ground, dust and smoke filling the air. The mask of Master Chu shattered, revealing his true face under the façade of Transformation Technique. It was County Lord Li!
His left arm was bleeding, dangling by his side. It was certainly crippled.
As Meng Jingzhou landed, he muttered discontently, "If only there were another airship."
Master Chu took a deep breath, ready to say something when a sudden fit of coughing overcame him. Blood streaked across the corner of his eyes. "The smoke is poisonous!"
Master Chu swiftly held his breath, rage filled his heart. It was just like the tyrants, first using the Forbidden Spirit Array to trap him, then hurling an airship at him. The airship filled with explosives for mountain demolition, and the smoke after the explosion was poisonous too.
Both of you are like damned sows, one trap after another!
Master Chu originally suspected Lu Yang was a mole from the Righteous Path, but on seeing his actions to destroy the Reverse Life Array, he deemed it a lapse in judgment by their Master. But now, this chain of traps made him disbelieve even if Lu Yang claimed to be a mole.
The crash of the airship disabled the Forbidden Spirit Array, allowing Master Chu to regain his spiritual essence, but he had to use part of it to suppress the poison that had seeped into his body.
Normally, he would be able to expel the poison in a few breaths, but Lu Yang and his partner did not give him this luxury of time.
Meng Jingzhou began to channel his magic skill, his skin turned brass-colored as he charged forward like a tiger descending a mountain, a roar echoing through the woods.
"Shocking Heaven Six Forms!"
This was the unique skill of the Third Elder. Meng Jingzhou was only familiar with the bare basics of this technique.
His Qi and Blood surged, unleashing a flurry of punches each stronger than the last. The waves of energy created by his punches all aimed at Master Chu's face.
Despite his injuries, Master Chu was at the late stage of the Golden Core cultivation. With just one arm, he could block Meng Jingzhou's two fists.
Lu Yang, like an assassin, appeared silently behind Master Chu holding his Green Peak Sword. Master Chu reacted with amazing reflexes, kicking backward to send Lu Yang flying.
Man Gu appeared in the direction Lu Yang was sent flying. He grabbed Lu Yang by the ankles, spun around, and threw him back into the fray.
Lu Yang was like a sharp sword propelled through the air, his Green Peak Sword cutting through the wind as it aimed for Master Chu's neck!
Master Chu parried Meng Jingzhou with his palm and swiftly turned around. With a powerful shift of his elbow and knee, he intercepted Lu Yang's Green Peak Sword.
An ancient bloodline of the Barbarian tribe was activated, turning Man Gu larger by a size. His muscles rippled, his stature dominating like a rampaging elephant. He charged with the force of a mountain landslide!
Master Chu scoffed. How strong could they be compared to him, a late-stage Golden Core cultivator?
Just as Man Gu was about to collide with Master Chu, he swiftly flipped his hands and hurled several sharp bamboo sticks at Master Chu's eyes.
Master Chu swiftly dodged by closing his eyes and turning his head.
Another set of bamboo sticks appeared behind him. Master Chu, hearing the noise, activated his Golden Core, forming a golden shield on his skin to block the bamboo attack.
He glanced back, realizing the bamboo sticks weren't thrown by a person but propelled by the Automatic Skewer Formation.
The formation was a creation of Lan Ting at full power.
Lu Yang had Lan Ting assist secretly, thus double pressuring Master Chu both mentally and physically.
"All of you shall die," Master Chu declared, retrieving a crimson flag from his Storage Ring. It looked as if it had been soaked in blood, radiating malefic energy. With the appearance of the crimson flag, the surrounding temperature dropped a few degrees.
Master Chu spat out a mouthful of blood, the crimson flag became even more eerie as it absorbed its master's blood. Lu Yang and his partners could vaguely hear the wailing sounds of spirits!
"Can't you use some proper weapon? Always utilizing such uncanny stuff!" Lu Yang spat out a clot of blood. His sword light danced like a dragon returning to the sea as he activated a magic skill to move underground. He tunneled rapidly forward and suddenly emerged from beneath Master Chu!
Master Chu staggered back. The clashing of the flag and sword rang out. Lu Yang performed a dazzling display of sword movements that were both swift and slow, fluid in motion.
The Shocking Heaven Six Forms appeared again. Meng Jingzhou rushed to the aid, his punches causing the earth to tremble. His strikes landed on the flagpole, nearly breaking Master Chu's stance.
A gigantic tree descended from the sky, and Man Gu roared with rage. He held on to the massive tree trunk and smashed it towards Master Chu!
"Fire Dragon Talisman!" A soft reproof resounded through the forest, and Lan Ting quickly used blood as ink to draw a talisman.
The fiery red Dragon danced savagely with its fangs and claws in the scorching air, diluting the peculiar atmosphere created by the crimson flag.
"There's a fourth man too!" Master Chu roared, gritting his teeth angrily. Lu Yang truly came well-prepared.
"Calm the Winds!" Master Chu clenched the flagpole tightly, slammed it into the ground, and roared. Shockwave and air were oscillating, knocking down the three men and dispersing the Fire Dragon!
Master Chu had gone mad, his eyes ablaze with fury. If he hadn't been hit with the flying boat from the outset, and hadn't used his spiritual essence to suppress the potent poison, he wouldn't be on such the defensive!
He leaped up abruptly, jabbing the flagpole at Man Gu who was lying on the ground. Man Gu scrambled to dodge, but he was too late. The flagpole pierced right through his scapula despite his efforts to move.
Blood trickled from Man Gu's teeth, but he didn't cry out in pain!
The Ancient Barbarian Tribe did not fear pain or death!
Master Chu mercilessly sought to give an additional kick at Man Gu's head. Just then, Meng Jingzhou took the opportunity to throw a magic instrument, shouting angrily. The magic instrument exploded, and Master Chu, standing on one leg, was sent flying, leaving Man Gu unharmed despite being stabbed to the ground.
Meng Jingzhou had a multitude of treasures at his disposal, but all of them were of such high tiers that they couldn't be activated or detonated.
Master Chu kicked a huge rock to pieces, rebounded with the force, pulled out the flag in his path, and prepared to sweep it at Meng Jingzhou.
The Green Peak Sword appeared right in front of Master Chu without deviating's path, shifting the massive flag aside. Lu Yang engaged Master Chu in a fight again.
Lu Yang was adept at casting spells, every time Master Chu attempted to hit him, he would shrink to dodge the assault, incensing Master Chu.
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu rallied and launched another attack. Lan Ting swiftly drew talismans with both hands. The fire and water dragons rose to the sky, intertwining and attacking Master Chu.
Master Chu could no longer bear this humiliation. He planted his flagpole into the ground, and the flag fluttered in the wind like waves in the ocean. The eerie howling from the flag confounded the mind.
"Ghost Chaos!"
The ghostly noise had an indescribable sorcery, it froze all four spots, making them feel ghost-entwined and immobilized.
Meng Jingzhou's heart tensed, wanting to cry out and tell everyone that it was an illusion, but not only was he immobilized but he also couldn't speak.
Master Chu laughed heartily, his trump card. He didn't want to use it, as it might belittle him, but he was pushed to the brink by these four youngsters. Ignoring pretenses, he decided to kill them to redeem his honor!
"Break."
The Green Peak Sword descended from the sky, swift as a lightning bolt. Master Chu hadn't recovered before his skull had been pierced through.
Master Chu looked at Lu Yang incredulously. Seeing Lu Yang's clear eyes and the mocking smile on his lips, he realized that Lu Yang was entirely unaffected by the illusion!
"How... how can you still move... impossible..." Master Chu collapsed, blood flowing from all seven bodily apertures.
Lu Yang added another sword strike to his Dantian, breaking Master Chu's golden core, only then ensuring his death.
Lu Yang had no interest in telling a dead man that he had created this technique, the "Mind Seeing Method," under the guidance of his Eldest Senior Sister. It could keep one's mind vigilant and see the essence of things.
He was only in the early stages of cultivation and couldn't yet see the essence of things, but the method proved enough to resist the illusions and dreams cast by cultivators at higher stages.
The Inspector had been delayed by miscellaneous chores, and had just arrived from County Li. As he crossed over Song Mountain and stood at the perimeter of the battlefield, he saw Lu Yang piercing Master Chu dead with his sword.
Recalling Master Chu's words, "I've got a surprise for you," "The newly recruited Lu Yang is a rare talent. He will shine at the Spring Festival," he pondered.
"... So this is the surprise Chu was talking about?"
The Inspector, in his hundred years of life, had encountered such a surprise for the first time.
(Extra update for alliance leader Thoridal)

chapters.title: Chapter 102 - 101: Talking Nonsense Comes Naturally, Part 1
chapters.content:
Tang Yuansheng, male, 102 years old, Nascent Soul Stage Cultivation Level, currently holding the position of Inspector in the Eternity Sect.
Upon receiving a message from Master Chu instructing him to come earlier, he decided to advance his schedule and first went to Qinghuai County, which was separated from Yanjiang County by just one mountain.
"Once I cross this mountain, I'll reach the location Little Chu mentioned."
"Huh?" Suddenly, Tang Yuansheng sensed a peculiar aura fluctuation, "What kind of aura is this?"
He followed his perception and arrived at a stable in a posthouse. There inside, an old horse with dragon scales on its forehead was huddled with a brown mare, their bond seemingly deep.
A stable boy hauled in a bundle of selected grass feed and placed it in the manger. The old horse glanced disdainfully at the feed, not intending to eat at all.
Seeing this, the stable boy muttered under his breath, "Has it already found a new companion so quickly after the white mare left?"
The old horse seemed to understand human speech, glared at the boy, who, afraid to provoke this unusual beast, hurriedly ran away.
The premium feed the old horse's owner left behind had long been finished. After the premium feed was consumed, there was no sign of the horse's owner. The posthouse's proprietor guessed whether some mishap had occurred, or if the owner had died given that his destination was Song Mountain.
Afterwards, the boy was ordered to feed the horse regular feed. If the owner did not show up, the horse would be sold to repay the cost of the feed.
The old horse, however, scorned the feed from the posthouse and did not eat a single mouthful. This went on for a month.
The proprietor of the posthouse grew apprehensive. This horse was not just a peculiar beast with scales, but a high-level demon beast that had reached the fasting realm!
Tang Yuansheng was overjoyed when he saw the old horse; it was unexpectedly a rare dragon horse! The only uncertainty was the richness of its genetic purity.
"If I hadn't incidentally been to the vast Eastern Sea, I wouldn't have recognized it." Tang Yuansheng grew extremely excited; this was a pleasant surprise.
A dragon horse, such a rarity, happened to be here in a remote small county stable. Certainly, the dragon horse's owner was not aware of its valuable nature. The dragon horse had yet to awaken, hence its existence here remained unnoticed.
"Being a Great Power at the Nascent Soul Stage, I have yet to find a suitable mount. This must be a fortunate opportunity bestowed upon me by the Immortal Eternity in seeing my sincerity!"
Tang Yuansheng prayed to the Immortal Eternity momentarily then leaped into the stable.
The old horse glanced at Tang Yuansheng but didn't pay him any mind. It continued to be affectionate with the small brown mare.
"Poor dragon horse, oblivious of its noble status, in love with a mortal horse. Come with me. I'll show you your greatness."
Tang Yuansheng extended his golden hand intending to lead out the old horse. The old horse kicked back, breaking Tang Yuansheng's hand. He felt a constriction in his chest and spat out a mouthful of blood, his strength instantly weakened.
With a look of terror, he glanced at the old horse, all trace of his previous excitement gone, replaced by endless fear, and he turned to flee.
A Great Power residing incognito must be here, keeping the dragon horse as a common horse in the stable!
His previous actions undoubtedly would not deceive the incognito Great Power. He needed to flee, hoping the other party might spare his life for his ignorance!
The old horse growled a low rumble, showing off its strength to the little mare.
After running for a while and not seeing any Great Power capturing him, Tang Yuansheng knew the individual did not particularly mind his actions.
"Ah!" He spat out another mouthful of blood, randomly found a secluded spot, and settled down cross-legged to meditate, taking an elixir to heal his injuries.
That kick from the horse had greatly depleted his vitality.
When he opened his eyes again, he heard a thunderous sound from the other side of the mountain, as if a massive object had fallen.
"Is it already night?" Tang Yuansheng found the sky was already dark, somewhat surprised, not expecting that he had spent an entire day recovering from his wounds.
Having recovered somewhat from his injuries, able to defend himself, he crossed Song Mountain and arrived at where the flying ship fell, saw Rudder Master Chu was stabbed by Lu Yang and no longer breathing.
"...This is the surprise Little Chu was talking about?"
It's hard to say whether he's happy or not, but Tang Yuansheng was undoubtedly shocked.
Before coming here, the higher-ups of the Eternity Sect told him to keep an eye on Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, and Man Gu, and even supplied him with their portraits.
Now, he has no choice but to pay attention to them.
"Who are you!" Lu Yang held his sword, vigilantly watching Tang Yuansheng.
Tang Yuansheng looked at Lu Yang with a bemused smile: "Lu Yang, you dare to point your sword at me? I am Tang Yuansheng, the inspector of the Eternity Sect."
Upon learning the identity of Tang Yuansheng, Lu Yang signaled behind his back, telling Lan Ting to leave quickly. Lan Ting's presence would be hard to explain to Tang Yuansheng.
"So, you are Inspector Tang." Lu Yang became somewhat polite, but he still looked at Tang Yuansheng suspiciously, clearly not fully believing the other party's identity.
Tang Yuansheng didn't bother explaining to Lu Yang, and instead, asked, "Why did you kill Li Shouyi?"
Li Shouyi, the county magistrate of Yanjiang, Master Chu's real name, Tang Yuansheng was accustomed to calling him Little Chu.
Lu Yang said solemnly: "Because he almost exposed his identity as a member of the Eternity Sect!"
"Oh?" Tang Yuansheng looked at Lu Yang with interest, waiting to see what kind of explanation he would give.
Suddenly, there was a commotion from the foot of the mountain. It was Fang Qingyun leading a large group of people to investigate the crash site of the flying ship. There were even doctors in the group responsible for the rescue.
"Let's leave first!" Tang Yuansheng was still in a seriously injured state and didn't want to face the government officials. With a wave of his sleeve, he took Lu Yang and the others and fled.
Tang Yuansheng, familiar with the area, led the three of them into the Yanjiang Rudder. This was the safest place in Yanjiang County.
"Now tell me, how did Li Shouyi expose his identity when he is known for being meticulous?"
Lu Yang divulged everything about the Reverse Life Array, and added, "Master Chu... no, County Lord Li's plan cannot said to be careless. First, he made Yizhanghong the scapegoat, and then he secretly set up the Reverse Life Array. As long as he destroyed the small flag afterwards, there would be no traces left."
Tang Yuansheng nodded, Li Shouyi was always cautious in his actions, using the extremely obscure Reverse Life Array, this plan was faultless.
"But an accident still happened. The three of us opened a barbecue restaurant in this place, which is the best place to gather local information. We noticed a disciple of the Laurel Fairy Palace passing by accidentally. She seemed to be proficient in array methods and discerned the Reverse Life Talisman on the small flag!"
"We can't touch a disciple of the Five Great Immortal Sects. We feared that if anything happened to County Lord Li, it would involve the entire Eternity Sect. We advised him to hide promptly, but he insisted that it was a crucial time and he had to use the Reverse Life Array to ascend to the Nascent Soul Stage and couldn't hide.
We had no choice but to kill him before Great Xia captured him, eliminating future trouble!"
"You noticed the officials earlier, right? The person leading them is the Chief Catcher Fang Qingyun. What could they be doing with so many people, if not to stop the Reverse Life Array from activating and capture County Lord Li!"
Tang Yuansheng nodded, thinking that Lu Yang and the others had done the right thing. The fact that a disciple from the Laurel Fairy Palace was in Yanjiang County could be investigated, and there was no way to deceive people about it. Moreover, Li Shouyi indeed attached great importance to ascending to the Nascent Soul Stage.
