Ordinary Rudder Masters are at the Golden Core Stage. Yanjiang County is a small county, so its Rudder Master can only be at the Golden Core Stage. Li Shouyi wanted to be transferred to a developed cultivation area as Rudder Master, so he had to ascend to the Nascent Soul Stage now.
The reason was the same for the county magistrate. Promotion would be extremely difficult without reaching a certain realm.
Man Gu looked at Lu Yang, startled. The plan didn't include meeting Tang Yuansheng after killing Master Chu, let alone having a reason for the killing. How did Brother Lu come up with this on the spot?
Meng Jingzhou quietly gave Lu Yang a thumbs-up. The reason Lu Yang had come up with was not much different from the one he had hastily fabricated.

chapters.title: Chapter 103 - 102 Your mission is to infiltrate the Seek Dao Sect_1
chapters.content:
"Since Li Shouyi is already dead, his promotion is no longer considered."
"The government office might suspect demonic sect activities based on his identity and keep the people here obedient for a while."
Tang Yunsheng swiftly made a decision; he was also raised from rank to rank and was decisive in his actions.
"As for the three of you, take out your bone cards."
The three men handed over the bone cards with the word "Manager". Tang Yunsheng went to the statue of the Immortal Eternity, paid his respects to the Immortal Eternity by kneeling three times, his hand emitted golden light as he quickly muttered some words that were indistinct.
He swiped over the three bone cards and the characters for "Manager" changed to "Rudder Master".
Tang Yunsheng, as an Inspector, was authorized by the higher-ups and could make arrangements for the promotions and demotions of the Rudder Master and those below.
Making Lu Yang and his group Rudder Masters was not Tang Yunsheng's intention, but that of the higher-ups. As for which level of higher-ups, Tang Yunsheng was not clear. He heard it was the decision of the Deputy Master or even higher. He was just executing the orders.
"Which county are we supposed to serve as Rudder Masters?" Meng Jingzhou seemed eager to flex his muscles.
Tang Yunsheng shook his head: "What are you thinking? You are only at the initial stage of Foundation Establishment and if you were the Rudder Master, can you command respect from the people below? The place like Yanjiang Rudder would not accept you."
"A Rudder Master will be parachuted into Yanjiang County. This is not your concern anymore."
"Then our Rudder Master status..."
"Your promotion to Rudder Masters was not my decision, but that of the higher-ups. They have elevated you to the level of Rudder Master without assigning duties, but they are giving you only ranks. In this way, you will gain many rights exclusive to Rudder Masters and will be less shackled."
"The higher-ups have entrusted you with a covert operation, and no one else can be told about it besides the four of us!"
The three of Lu Yang stood upright, eagerly awaiting.
Tang Yunsheng whispered: "The higher-ups have given you a year to find a way to infiltrate the Seek Dao Sect, I'm your contact!"
The pupils of the three men shrank slightly, taken aback by the task.
Tang Yunsheng waved his hand: "I know this mission is extremely difficult. Among the Five Great Immortal Sects, Suspension Temple has very few people making it inconvenient to plant agents. Seek Dao Sect's thinking is too free, making it difficult to infiltrate and if you do, you will be exposed due to not fitting in."
"The three of you have a high degree of compatibility with the Seek Dao Sect, and maybe you can successfully infiltrate the Seek Dao Sect."
"It's not necessary for you to become disciples of the Seek Dao Sect. According to intelligence analysis, there are abundant entertainment industries within the Seek Dao Sect, and they recruit every year. You can use this opportunity to infiltrate the Seek Dao Sect!"
"Of course, what I'm saying is just one method. The sect will not interfere, you can be creative and find other ways. The deadline is one year. If you cannot complete the task within a year, the higher-ups will assign you a new task!"
Seeing the confident expressions of Lu Yang and his friends, Tang Yunsheng shook his head and laughed. They didn't realize how difficult it was to infiltrate the Seek Dao Sect. Many people had already lost their lives in the Seek Dao Sect.
He took out three talismans and gave them to the trio: "There are many dangers within the Seek Dao Sect. These are Teleportation Talismans. If the mission fails, use these talismans to escape immediately!"
These three were rare talents within the Eternity Sect, especially Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou. The Master naturally wanted to fully protect them.
Dangerous situation within the Seek Dao Sect? Meng Jingzhou thought returning to the Seek Dao Sect was like coming home, where was the danger? The only possible danger was the Eldest Senior Sister.
"Did Little Chu ever tell you how to resurrect the Immortal Eternity?"
Lu Yang shook his head: "Master Chu only told us the first step, which was to please the Immortal Eternity by killing. As for the second step, he said that our positions were too low and according to the regulations, it could not be disclosed."
Tang Yunsheng said: "Now that you all are Rudder Masters, you are qualified to know how to resurrect the Immortal Eternity. This is also the duty of all Rudder Masters, come, let me demonstrate it to you."
Tang Yunsheng knelt in front of the Immortal Eternity, raised his hands high, and cried out loudly, "Immortal Eternity, Miao Muzhen above, your most devoted follower is sincerely calling you here, please descend your Immortal Mark and protect the human race!"
After saying that, he knocked his head on the ground three times then stood up. The ceremony was completed.
The three men were confused. That's it?
Man Gu was even muttering to himself, why does the name of Immortal Eternity sound like a Barbarian's?
Tang Yunsheng said: "You must faithfully call the Immortal Eternity as I just did, but you can't say 'Miao Muzhen'."
"Why is that?"
"Because 'Miao Muzhen' is not the real name of the Immortal Eternity."
The trio was even more puzzled, if it's not the real name, then why say it?
Tang Yunsheng explained: "To resurrect the Immortal Eternity, we must utter his title and his Immortal name. The first step of killing to please the Immortal Eternity means that the Immortal Eternity will guide us to speak his Immortal name in the dark when he's pleased."
"We have learned from the ruins that his title is Immortal Eternity, but his Immortal name is not recorded in the ruins. Before the Immortal Eternity descends his Immortal Mark to hint us, our Eternity Sect can only try again and again."
"Out of respect for the Immortal Eternity, the time interval for calling the Immortal name has to be a month!"
Tang Yunsheng took out a battered copy of "Great Xia Dictionary": "The majority of names have been tried. Recently, I suspect that the Immortal Eternity is a Barbarian, and I'm trying with Barbarian names."
The Ancient Barbarian Tribe was once a key force in protecting the Human race, which also aligned with the identity of the Immortal Eternity.
Tang Yunsheng took out three thick notebooks and gave them to the three men. On the cover was written "Notebooks of Already Called Immortal's Names (120th Edition)".
The number of Immortal names recorded was so large that Lu Yang suspected that the Eternity Sect had tried all the names they could think of.
"We compile a "Notebook of Already Called Immortal's Names" every few decades to avoid repetition. This is the latest compilation, all of you should look at it and try a call. Just don't repeat what's on the notebook."
Lu Yang cried out: "Immortal Eternity Archimedes is above, your most devout follower is sincerely calling upon you here, please descend your Immortal Mark and protect the human race!"
Meng Jingzhou cried out: "Immortal Eternity Li Goudan is above…"
Man Gu cried out: "Immortal Eternity Yelu Sa-la-de is above…"
Apparently, very few names were left for Immortal Eternity.
After the three men called, the Immortal Eternity did not descend his Immortal Mark to resurrect himself.
"Alright, I've already relayed the mission that was given to me by the higher-ups for you, you gather your things and find a way on your own to infiltrate Seek Dao Sect."
"Yes."
Back at the barbecue restaurant, Lan Ting was already waiting for the three in the lobby. Lu Yang and Lan Ting discussed and gave a simple account of what happened afterward, as well as the task given to them by Tang Yunsheng. The look in Lan Ting's eyes was strange as she looked at the trio.
The Eternity Sect is doomed sooner or later.
"Since you are leaving, it's time for me to return to Fairy Palace to debrief on the mission. I had a great time in these past ten days, thank you three for your help. Although I did not join the demonic sect, helping you kill the Rudder Master counts as a major merit and I could earn quite a few contribution points." Lan Ting smiled sweetly as she said her reluctant farewell.
The term 'Fate' is indeed wondrous. Initially, she helped Lu Yang kill the tiger just because they were both from the Immortal Sect. She even had the task of infiltrating the demonic sect then, who would have thought that in the end, she, the one with the task, didn't join the demonic sect, but Lu Yang and his group who initially didn't even know about the demonic sect had joined the demonic sect.
Now, Tang Yunsheng is still in the county and if there's too much contact between them, Tang Yunsheng might discover it and that would cause unnecessary trouble.
"We'll meet again if fate allows, on the long road of life!"
"Goodbye!"
"Take care!"
After bidding Lan Ting farewell, the three started to pack up their things. Meng Jingzhou suddenly remembered, "What about our horses?"

chapters.title: Chapter 104 - 103 It seems like I got the name of the Immortal right..._1
chapters.content:
Old Horse was lucky that he was found before he made any lifelong commitments to the brown female horse. Meng Jingzhou paid the fees and took away Old Horse and his carriage.
"No, no, no, You don't have to pay this much for a stable stay," the stable boy pushed back.
"Don't you want the feed money? I assume you want it," Meng Jingzhou was confused. Old Horse had already finished the high-quality feed brought for him, and Meng Jingzhou thought Old Horse had gotten so hungry that he had started eating the ordinary feed.
The stable boy shook his head: "Your horse didn't eat anything."
"Huh?" Meng Jingzhou was in the dark. He stroked Old Horse's mane and asked, "Have you been fasting?"
Old Horse snorted but didn't answer.
How could a horse talk?
Meng Jingzhou menacingly threatened: "If you don't answer, there will be no more feed for you!"
After a long standoff between man and horse, Old Horse still didn't answer, and Meng Jingzhou conceded defeat, guessing what was happening.
He wondered how he managed to run away from home so smoothly back then. Even his sister knew he was going to run away. The rest of the family must have known, and none of them stopped him. They didn't seem worried about any mishaps at all.
Eliminating the possibility that he wasn't their biological child, the only explanation could be that they knew he was safe.
The answer was now clear as day. The horse pulling the cart was his best protection.
Meng Jingzhou wondered about Old Horse's cultivation level and his capability to protect him, it must be quite high.
Meng Jingzhou complained: "If you are so powerful, why didn't you stop Eldest Senior Sister from getting in the carriage back then?"
Meng Jingzhou still remembered how foolish he was, thinking Eldest Senior Sister was a fellow examinee, allowing her to get in the carriage, and telling her he had obtained the exact exam questions for the entrance examination to the sect.
It was truly shameful and disgraceful.
If Old Horse had stopped Eldest Senior Sister, wouldn't it have avoided the whole issue?
Old Horse gave Meng Jingzhou a sidelong glance, as if looking at an idiot.
…
Before leaving, Lu Yang greeted Guard Captain Wei, who was not surprised by the departure of the trio.
No cultivator would truly run a barbecue shop for a lifetime, they were only interested in the novelty of it. Once the novelty wore off, they would stop.
"What a pity, I'll never be able to taste such delicious barbecue again," Guard Captain Wei sighed, "I was hoping to catch more criminals in your barbecue shop and get promoted to a Chief Guard's position."
Guard Captain Wei estimated that capturing three more demon cultivators would see him promoted to Chief Guard.
"It's good that you're leaving, Yanjiang County might have some disturbances soon."
"What do you mean?"
Guard Captain Wei said in a low voice: "You mustn't tell anyone about this."
"I understand."
Lu Yang was certainly trustworthy: "You know County Lord Li, right? Now there are rumors that County Lord Li has colluded with a demon cultivator to get a promotion. It's unclear whether it's a lone demon cultivator or someone from a demonic sect, but the person's cultivation level must be high, otherwise, he wouldn't be qualified to collaborate with County Lord Li."
"County Lord Li's corpse was found on Song Mountain, Chief Guard Fang suspects that a conflict of interest arose between the demon cultivator and County Lord Li. The fact that County Lord Li is dead and the demon cultivator is still alive indicates that the demon cultivator's cultivation level is higher than County Lord Li's.
And County Lord Li was merely a step away from the Nascent Soul Stage, so you can imagine how high the demon cultivator's cultivation level must be!"
Lu Yang shrank back his neck: "What a cruel demon cultivator!"
"That's why I'm saying it's a good thing you guys are leaving. Yanjiang County may seem peaceful, but who knows where a demon cultivator might be hiding, maybe right beside us!"
Lu Yang agreed wholeheartedly: "Indeed."
…
Man Gu bid farewell to the barbecue shop grudgingly. The glory of the Barbarian tribe's barbecue would not be further glorified by his generation.
The two ghouls were jubilant, celebrating that they didn't have to barbecue day and night anymore.
...
Before parting, Tang Yunsheng gave a farewell to the three men, admonishing them that infiltrating the Seek Dao Sect would be fraught with difficulty, and urged them to tread with caution.
Lu Yang assured him, "Rest easy, we will definitely fulfill our duty to our organization. We will infiltrate the Seek Dao Sect, steal their secrets, and glorify our Eternity Sect."
On the carriage, Old Horse was not rushing or slacking off in driving; though it seemed slow, the strides were in fact quite large, which involved profound knowledge of space.
Inside the carriage, the three began to chat about Immortal Eternity.
"Look, the notebook also has our names: Immortal Eternity Lu Yang, Immortal Eternity Meng Jingzhou, Immortal Eternity Man Gu," Lu Yang chuckled. It was quite amusing to see their own names in the notes of the demonic sect.
He could find the names of all the people he knew, indicating the dedication of the demonic sect in resurrecting Immortal Eternity.
"What do you think Immortal Eternity was originally named, Mendeleev? Socrates?"
Meng Jingzhou grinned, "Perhaps it was something lowly like Dog Egg or Dog Shit, too embarrassed to say it aloud, so he hid it instead, only referring to him by his title."
"It could potentially be a name from our Barbarian tribe."
The three lacked any trace of reverence for Immortal Eternity, leaving Tang Yuansheng's reminder to guess the immortal's name at intervals, completely ignored.
"All of you should be careful, what if we accidentally guess Immortal Eternity's actual name?" Lu Yang warned. Whether Immortal Eternity was friend or foe was still undecided; the claim that Immortal Eternity bestowed protection upon the human race was solely from the mouth of the Eternity Sect and hence could not be fully trusted.
"How about this, from now on, let's refer to 'Immortal Eternity' as 'Fairy Eternity', that way even if we accidentally say the correct name, Immortal Eternity won't be resurrected," Lu Yang suggested.
"Lu Yang makes a good point, I agree," Meng Jingzhou voted in favor, raising his hand.
Man Gu thought that Brother Lu was right to be meticulous.
After traveling for a while in the carriage, the three felt hungry and decided to disembark under a small grove to eat.
The small grove blocked the annoying sunlight, creating a quiet atmosphere. Faint birdsong could be heard from afar, making people relax involuntarily.
Meng Jingzhou laid out the tablecloth, Lu Yang took out the pots and pans and the talisman for lighting the fire, and Man Gu summoned the ghouls.
The two ghouls just got unemployed for half a day, and were summoned out by Man Gu to go back to their old job, skillfully starting a barbecue.
Meng Jingzhou pulled out a cookbook and a bunch of bottles and jars, pushing them all to the two ghouls, "Stop making barbecue, let's change the taste, you two, make the dishes according to this menu."
Lu Yang and Man Gu looked sideways, wondering why was he carrying a cookbook?
The two ghouls could not but start from scratch, beginning with the simplest fried eggs.
If you don't work hard in your lifetime, you have to study diligently after death.
The three of them showed no intention of taking fasting pills. Why take those when they could have tasty food?
"Tang Yunsheng guessed that Fairy Eternity is from your Barbarian tribe, did the Barbarian tribe have such a legend in ancient times?" Lu Yang asked.
Man Gu shook his head, "I heard from my elders that the ancient Barbarian tribe fought against the heavens and the earth, and battled immortals, but I have never heard of our tribe giving birth to an immortal."
"It's peculiar that those ruins, which recorded the greatness of Fairy Eternity, didn't include her name."
Meng Jingzhou analyzed logically, "Think about it, during ancient times, everyone had grand titles and names. Before they fought, they announced their names. If Fairy Eternity came forward and said 'I'm Immortal Eternity Li Dog Egg', rather, 'I'm Fairy Eternity Li Dog Egg', she would have already lost half of her momentum in the battle!"
"Fairy Eternity must have deleted this part of her shameful past!"
Lu Yang chimed in, laughing, "Or maybe the name was too cute, without any deterrent power, like 'Fairy Eternity Yellow Bean' or something."
As if the seven words "Fairy Eternity Yellow Bean" touched some sort of cosmic mechanism, the world changed. An incomprehensible force circled above the three, shaping into a faint human-like silhouette.
The initially relaxed Old Horse became instantly alert, positioning himself protectively in front of Meng Jingzhou and maintaining a fixed gaze at the force above.
The three swallowed hard.
It seemed like they had stirred up a hornet's nest.

chapters.title: Chapter 105 - 104 Still Relying on Eldest Senior Sister_1
chapters.content:
"What the hell!" The three of them stared at each other, not knowing what to do next.
"How reliable is the Eternity Sect, didn't they say it was Immortal Eternity? Why does calling Fairy Eternity also work!" Lu Yang chastised the Eternity Sect for its unpredictability. They can't even clarify whether their faith is in Immortal Eternity or Fairy Eternity, what kind of religion are you!
"Stop the nonsense and let's run!" Meng Jingzhou shouted, now wasn't the time for complaints.
The figure in the sky was as unstable as a dream mirage. She felt the causality relationship with Lu Yang, realizing that he had called out her real name, and turned into a stream of light, entering Lu Yang's body.
"Just reached the Foundation Establishment Stage, such a weak existence." The figure arrived in Lu Yang's spiritual space, which was yet to be expanded by Lu Yang and was only a small area.
As the figure entered the spiritual space, Lu Yang also arrived here.
The surroundings of the spiritual space were pitch black, as if there were invisible walls standing there, and only a small area in the middle had a bright light, where Lu Yang and the figure were standing.
Lu Yang looked at the figure warily. "Who are you!"
The figure laughed lightly, observing Lu Yang's reaction with interest. Her voice was pleasant, but to Lu Yang, it sounded like a sentence from hell. "Heh, you've already called out my name and still don't know who I am?"
Lu Yang, who had been harboring a glimmer of hope, felt his heart sink. The worst-case scenario had occurred. He hadn't expected the other party to be the deity of the Eternity Sect.
The other party was an immortal, a real, resurrected immortal!
The ability to resurrect simply by recalling her name represented a terrifying existence!
"What are you going to do?"
The figure disdainfully refused to answer Lu Yang's question, instead asking, "What year is it tonight, and who is in control of the world?"
"Now it's the era of the Great Xia Dynasty, and the highest ruler of the human race is Emperor Xia. Ten thousand years ago, it was the Great Yu Dynasty. The Great Yu Dynasty lasted for a hundred thousand years, and I don't know about the dynasties before that."
"Emperor Xia? Great Xia? Great Yu? Unheard-of dynasties." The figure shook her head, then asked, "How long have I been dead?"
This question was beyond Lu Yang's knowledge: "From what I know, you are an Immortal from the ancient times, who saved the human race when the Nameless One turned the stars into continents."
Lu Yang hinted at her past heroic act of saving the human race, hoping she, being a righteous immortal, would refrain from doing anything unbecoming towards him, a junior.
"Nameless One? Stars turning into continents? Protecting the human race? What kind of nonsense is this?" The figure was confused and didn't understand what Lu Yang was talking about.
Lu Yang almost cursed out loud. He knew the Eternity Sect was not trustworthy. Was there a single piece of the Eternity Sect's information that was true? How could she be completely oblivious to these events?
The figure realized that her era had long passed, so long ago that the human race had entirely forgotten about her, her immortal name. Had anyone in the world remembered her title and immortal name, she would have resurrected long ago, not being unaware of what the Great Yu Dynasty or the Great Xia Dynasty were.
Nevertheless, since the world has forgotten her name, she would take over this boy's body, and let the name of Fairy Eternity "Yellow Bean" resonate in the world once again.
Fairy Eternity looked at Lu Yang, her eyes filled with a touch of approval and amusement.
Lu Yang had a bad feeling when he heard Fairy Eternity scoff, "I see your cultivation level is low, and you've just reached the Foundation Establishment stage, but your Spirit Root is excellent, and you have a good foundation, so I will possess you and show you the flourishing world."
Possess!
Things were developing in a direction Lu Yang least wanted to see.
Lu Yang refused to be possessed like this, putting up a stance and confronting Fairy Eternity, throwing a set of punches like a woman would.
"Don't think you're amazing just because you're an immortal!"
Fairy Eternity scoffed, what could these soft punches do?
She had already surveyed the surroundings; two ghost figures, two Foundation Establishment Stage cultivators, and a Dragon horse, none of them could hinder her from possessing!
If Meng Jingzhou or Man Gu were here, they would surely recognize that Lu Yang was striking with the ultimate move of the Imitation Fist, the Eldest Sister's Form Boxing.
...
At the Seek Dao Sect, Yun Zhi was in the grand meeting hall, discussing various matters of the Sect with eight elders.
"I believe we should allocate more Spirit Stones to our Elixir Cauldron Peak. We are on the verge of a major breakthrough in the Path of Elixir. At this historic moment, no amount of Spirit Stone is too much!"
"Giving the Spirit Stone to your Elixir Cauldron Peak is no better than giving it to our medicinal garden, it's high time to change the base Array Method, the herbs would grow stronger!"
The Elders voiced their opinions on which side should be allotted the Spirit Stone, each refusing to yield, Yun Zhi was about to speak, when the eight Elders saw Yun Zhi was about to speak, they stopped talking.
Suddenly, Yun Zhi's body paused, that feeling from last time came again, was it Lu Yang borrowing his power?
A trace of power appeared at Yun Zhi's fingertips, should she give it him?
Last time Lu Yang could easily borrow power from Yun Zhi, that was because Yun Zhi wasn't prepared, but this time Yun Zhi was prepared and did not allow any power to spill out.
Yun Zhi thought for a moment, withdrew her power, and decided to go see what Lu Yang was doing for herself.
"You Elders continue the discussion, I will be right back."
Yun Zhi's Divine Soul left her body, leisurely roamed the heavens and earth, leaving the Elders looking at each other.
The Divine Soul flew into the air, leaped deeply, then raced at an incredible speed to its destination, entering Lu Yang's body.
Just as she entered Lu Yang's body, she heard Fairy Eternity snicker: "Just give up resisting and let me possess you."
Yun Zhi at first glance could tell that Fairy Eternity was indeed an Immortal Soul, although weak, it was still a complete Immortal Soul.
"How dare you make a move on my Junior Brother?" Yun Zhi reached out her delicate hand and struck at Fairy Eternity.
"Who is it!" Fairy Eternity was taken aback, she did not feel the arrival of the other party at all. Although this had something to do with her just being revived and her Immortal Soul being weak, it was still surprising.
Fairy Eternity felt somewhat reassured, during her time of death, the human race had managed to birth such geniuses.
"Ask Dao Sect, Yun Zhi."
Fairy Eternity wanted to block Yun Zhi's hand, but found it impossible to resist the other's seemingly weak but profound and indescribable move, as if it embodied all the principles of magic skills.
"Wait, wait, we may have a misunderstanding, it was just a joke with the junior!" Fairy Eternity's face changed drastically, she did all she could to block this move, the power of the opponent was far beyond her expectations.
Cloud Zhi just ignored what Fairy Eternity was saying and without hesitation, she slapped down, suppressing Fairy Eternity.
Fairy Eternity was furious and resisted forcefully: "Don't push it, girl, don't think that I, Immortal Fairy, am afraid of you!"
"You must not insult an Immortal!"
Seeing that Fairy Eternity still wanted to resist, Yun Zhi frowned and threw Lu Yang out of the spiritual world. It was not convenient for her to make a move with Lu Yang here.
"Huff..." Finally, Lu Yang left the spiritual world and returned to reality. He exhaled, feeling lucky to have survived.
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu saw Lu Yang regain his senses and quickly stepped forward to ask what happened.
Just now, Lu Yang had been staring blankly ahead with lifeless eyes. Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu were so flustered that they didn't know what to do. Later, a fairy soul that looked like Elder Sister descended from the sky and entered Lu Yang's body.
"I don't know." Lu Yang shook his head. It wasn't that he didn't have faith in his Eldest Sister, but the other party was an Immortal, and from the ancient era at that. The Eldest Sister once said that there were no Immortals in the world, which meant she must not be an Immortal.
When the two people fought, Lu Yang didn't know who would win or who would lose.
"If Elder Sister is there, there should be no problem." When Meng Jingzhou said this, he also didn't know, he knew that Elder Sister was very strong, but exactly how strong, he didn't know.
"Alright, come in." Soon Lu Yang heard Elder Sister's voice inside his body, the voice was as cold as ever.
Lu Yang returned to the spiritual space again, seeing the high and mighty Fairy Eternity beaten quite miserably, trying hard to explain to Elder Sister that she was a good person.
"I just barely revived, wanted to play a joke with the junior, I am a woman, why would I possess a male cultivator, I, Yellow Bean, am a person with a reputation, I will not do such a disgraceful thing."
"Besides, I'm an Immortal Soul. A body at the Foundation Establishment Stage can't withstand my power."
Elder Sister quietly looked at Fairy Eternity Yellow Bean and after an unknown period of time, she finally responded.
"Oh."
She seemed to believe Fairy Eternity's explanation.

chapters.title: Chapter 106 - 105: The Unlucky Fairy Eternity_1
chapters.content:
"Your real name is Yellow Bean?" Lu Yang asked skeptically.
Fairy Eternity put on a serious face: "You mere mortal, you cannot address me by my immortal name. You must call me Fairy Eternity!"
"So Fairy Eternity, your real name is Yellow Bean?"
Fairy Eternity turned red: "My parents gave me this name. I can't just change it."
Yun Zhi interrupted their pointless conversation: "Tell me, what have you been up to? You've only been gone for two months, and you've already got yourself entangled with an immortal."
Fairy Eternity corrected Yun Zhi: "Watch your words, I'm not the one who courted him. You make me sound like a desperate person!"
The only response Fairy Eternity received was Yun Zhi's cold stare. Realizing that she had just resurrected and was weak, Fairy Eternity didn't want to make an enemy unnecessarily.
However, she was a renowned immortal who once commanded respect in ancient times. She had to maintain some dignity and make it clear that she was not to be trifled with.
"As you wish."
Lu Yang glanced at the unusually compliant Fairy Eternity, then faced Eldest Senior Sister's cold gaze, and honestly recounted his adventures during the past month.
"I didn't do much really. Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu found me, saying that there was a Tiger Demon causing trouble in the mountains of Yanjiang County. Killing it would earn us contribution points. We decided it was a profitable task and went for it."
"We killed the Tiger Demon easily. When we were inventorying, we found out that the demon was linked to a demonic sect. We followed the lead, hoping to wipe out some cultists to help the people."
"Later, we heard that the demonic sect was recruiting. We decided to give it a shot and surprisingly we all got in."
"Once we joined, the local head of the demonic sect took us under his wing and appointed us as managers."
"Although we were in the Demon Path, our hearts were with the Righteous Path. While in the demonic sect, we discovered that the local leader had secretly set up a Reverse Life Array to break through the Golden Core Stage. After a heroic battle, we managed to kill him."
"Coincidentally, the higher-ups in the demonic sect came to inspect us. They found the three of us promising and promoted us to Rudder Masters. They even sent us back to the Seek Dao Sect as undercover agents."
Fairy Eternity laughed, "Such a silly demonic sect, they even sent you guys back to spy. What's the name of the sect? I need to tease them if I meet them."
"Eternity Sect, they worship you," Lu Yang said.
Fairy Eternity's smile froze on her face.
Lu Yang continued: "The Eternity Sect told us that during the time when the Ancient Nameless One was refining the stars into the mainland, Immortal Eternity saved the human race. As long as we chant the name of Immortal Eternity, the immortal can be resurrected and save the human race once again."
"On the way back, the three of us got bored and started guessing Immortal Eternity's real name. We were afraid that if we accidentally resurrected the immortal, we wouldn't be able to face the consequences, so we changed Immortal Eternity's gender and started calling her Fairy Eternity. And then, as you see, Eldest Senior Sister, I summoned her."
Yun Zhi nodded, "Your experiences are rich indeed. Successfully infiltrating the Eternity Sect and being promoted to Rudder Masters is quite a commendable feat. The demonic sects' selection methods have their merits, since they can distinguish between good and evil. It wasn't easy for you to enter the Eternity Sect."
"I've also heard about the Eternity Sect's attempt to resurrect Immortal Eternity but didn't know the specifics. I didn't expect you to accidentally succeed."
Yun Zhi turned her gaze to the perplexed Fairy Eternity: "What about you? Anything you want to say?"
Fairy Eternity shook her head: "I've never heard of the Eternity Sect, nor do I know who the Ancient Nameless One is who refined the stars, nor do I remember saving the human race."
"The era I was in was known as The Age of Heaven's Will, indicating that I had the favor of heaven and was destined for greatness. I was born a human and achieved the Dao Fruit during the Age of Heaven's Will, becoming an immortal. Because of the unique ability of the Dao Fruit, I was named Fairy Eternity."
Yun Zhi casually explained, "The Age of Heaven's Will is what we refer to as the ancient times."
Fairy Eternity continued: "Beyond myself, there were four others who became immortals at that time. Later, someone unknown attacked me from behind and killed me outright, so I died thoroughly."
"Just as the Eternity Sect said, as long as someone calls out our title and our immortal name, I can be resurrected. I just don't know why I was inaccurately referred to as Immortal Eternity, which delayed my resurrection until now. Even now, I don't know how long I've been dead."
Fairy Eternity also felt wronged. She had just resurrected and wanted to show off in front of the juniors to scare them into obedience. But the guy just called over his Eldest Senior Sister. This wasn't all; the Eldest Senior Sister was so formidable, she instantly suppressed her.
Who was she supposed to talk to about this?
Why did she run into such a powerful person just after resurrecting?
After listening, Yun Zhi analyzed: "It's not necessarily inaccurate. Someone might have wanted to resurrect you but didn't want to create a causality with you. So, they used the Eternity Sect to call out your title and immortal name and intentionally referred to you as 'Immortal Eternity'.
Once the Eternity Sect tried all the names and realized something was wrong, they would suspect that they remembered the title incorrectly. Then, it would be the Eternity Sect reviving you, creating causality with you, and not related to the person behind the scenes."
Those with higher cultivation levels value causality more, believing that everything is manipulated by causality.
At this point, Yun Zhi frowned slightly. Now, it was not the Eternity Sect and Fairy Eternity who had created causality, but Lu Yang who had unwittingly taken on this enormous causality.
"As for how long you've been dead," Yun Zhi paused and asked, "don't you know who refined the stars?"
It was still in a light tone, but Lu Yang sensed a hint of seriousness. This indicated that Eldest Senior Sister attached great importance to this question.
Fairy Eternity shook her head in confusion: "I don't know what's going on. When I was alive, we all lived on the stars. Has someone refined the stars into continents?"
Yun Zhi nodded, "Before the Great Xia Dynasty was the Great Yu Dynasty and before that was the Great Qian Dynasty. The Age of Heaven's Will or the ancient times that you refer to, was before that."
"Both Great Qian and Great Yu lasted for 100,000 years before being replaced. The Great Xia has also lasted for 100,000 years. Some people say this is a curse from the ancient times, that each dynasty can only exist for 100,000 years. After those 100,000 years, the dynasty collapses, and a new star rises to establish a new dynasty on the ruins."
"At the end of the ancient times, an immortal refined the stars into a continent. The whole world has since taken on a new appearance and become what we now know as the Central Continent."
"In other words, you've been dead for at least 300,000 years."
Fairy Eternity was surprised: "So long? If I had known, I would have deposited my Spirit Stones in a bank. Can you imagine how much interest that would be?"
Lu Yang: "..."
Fairy, aren't you focusing on the wrong point?

chapters.title: Chapter 107 - 106: Triumphant Return_1
chapters.content:
"How did you use my power?" Yun Zhi looked at Lu Yang with some confusion. She knew that given his experiences, he had no right to access the profound and difficult God Descent Technique.
"Uhh... I just somehow gained a technique called Imitation Fist."
"When I was training, I thought to myself, the Imitation Fist is a technique that emulates objects and gains their advantages. So why limit myself to mimicking animals? People can be mimicked too."
"Among the people I know, Elder Sister, you're the strongest, so I mimic you and gain your power."
Yun Zhi: "…"
She has been proficient in magic skills since she was a child and is considered a magic prodigy. She can learn any magic skill with just one look and correct its defect to make it perfect. She even extrapolated many long-lost magic skills, such as the God Descent Technique.
But she's never seen a situation like Lu Yang's.
"Even if I was to give you a bit of my power, it would be too much for you to handle right now. You should avoid using this kind of martial arts skill casually."
Lu Yang understood Eldest Senior Sister's meaning: Solve problems by yourself, and don't summon me casually unless necessary.
"And you, leave Lu Yang's body."
Fairy Eternity, in a rare show of determination, shook her head in refusal: "I can't separate from him."
"Huh?" Yun Zhi's voice rose by a pitch, and seeing that the situation was getting out of hand, Fairy Eternity quickly elaborated.
"I just revived, and my Divine Soul is fragile. I need a body to stay in. Lu Yang shouted my name and revived me, creating a special causality between us that forces me to stay within his body. When this special causality disappears and my Divine Soul is strong enough, I can leave his spiritual space."
Lu Yang contemplated: "Like carrying a baby for ten months?"
Fairy Eternity indignantly refuted: "Can't you use a more appropriate analogy!"
Lu yang shrugged. He lacked imagination and could not think of a better example.
"I can shatter your Divine Soul directly and revive you," the Eldest Senior Sister's eyes fell on Fairy Eternity, and she felt a heavy pressure on her.
"That won't work. The knowledge of my name came from Lu Yang. Essentially, it was still Lu Yang who revived me. Your approach won't work."
Yun Zhi was silent for a moment. She then held up her single hand to control a technique, casting a golden imprint. The imprint was branded in Lu Yang's spiritual space where it faded and disappeared.
"What is….."
"This is a Divine Soul Imprint that I created. If you take any actions that are harmful to him, this imprint will be activated and shatter your Divine Soul. When that happens, hope that some fool will call your name correctly again in three hundred thousand years," her warning was obvious.
Fairy Eternity shivered.
"You actually don't need to be so cautious about me. After my Divine Soul is restored, I can directly reconstitute my Immortal body without needing to possess anyone anyway. Moreover, I need to sleep to recover my strength, and I don't know when I will wake up."
She yawned.
"Immortals can get tired too?" Lu Yang was surprised.
Fairy Eternity yawned again and again: "It's all due to our fight earlier, which consumed most of my strength…"
As she spoke, Fairy Eternity's eyelids began to droop, and she fell asleep: "Good night, don't wake me up until the end of the world."
Once Yun Zhi made sure Fairy Eternity was really asleep, she left the Spiritual Space and appeared in the world as a Divine Soul.
"Eldest Senior Sister, you've worked hard!" Meng Jingzhou greeted her with unprecedented politeness.
"Hello, Eldest Senior Sister." Man Gu was as honest and straightforward as ever. Even though he had never done anything wrong, for some reason, he felt afraid when he saw Eldest Senior Sister.
"Don't tell anyone about the revival of Fairy Eternity."
"Yes!" The two said in unison.
Old Horse also echoed.
"And, stop messing around on the way and hurry back to the Seek Dao Sect!" Yun Zhi left these words, transformed her Divine Soul into a stream of light, and went back to the Seek Dao Sect to continue her meeting.
The three quickly packed up their playful attitudes, got on the horse-drawn carriage and left.
"Huh? How are we moving so fast?" Meng Jingzhou could see the scenery outside the carriage through the window. He noticed that the landscape was whizzing by at a speed ten times faster than before!
The old horse, previously slow and deliberate, was suddenly galloping at an incredibly fast speed, using spatial magic to traverse space. This speed was so fast that they arrived at the Seek Dao Sect in a fraction of the time they expected.
The old horse knew that Yun Zhi's last sentence, "hurry back to Seek Dao Sect," was not directed at them three, but at him.
"Ha ha, the Seek Dao Sect, I'm back!" Meng Jingzhou laughed with his arms wide-open, giving off a triumphant feeling.
Their mission to pretend to be a part of the demonic sect and act as villains, all to earn contribution points and show off their achievements, was finally at an end. So, the first thing they did upon returning to the sect was to exchange the contribution points at the Task Hall.
They walked into the Task Hall with heads held high, disregarding everything else, strutting around like three crabs fresh out of water.
Inside the Task Hall, missions collected from various places were posted all over the walls. Senior Brothers and Sisters were all searching for suitable tasks.
Lu Yang noticed that the task to find a Nascent Soul Stage Two-winged Fierce Tiger was still on the wall–it seems Master Li Hong from Shanhai Pass has yet to locate his beloved pet.
The task related to the possible discovery of a Cave Heaven on Kunwu Mountain was taken down, presumably because it had been fully explored.
There were new tasks, such as some places where the traces of Nascent Soul Stage Demon Cultivators were found and personnel were needed to eliminate them. Some places discovered ancient ruins and needed teams to explore them. There were also places where two Great Powers were divorcing and mediators were needed, and so on.
Seeing the three's interesting way of walking, the Senior Brother on duty at the front desk teased: "Have you three disciples saved the world?"
Lu Yang modestly replied: "Almost. We've completed a secret mission and need to report to the Grand Elder."
The expression of the Senior Brother at the front desk changed. A completed secret mission was a matter of great importance, beyond his capability to handle, and nobody dared to joke about it: "The Grand Elder is having a meeting in the Council Hall. Elder Brother Dai is in charge of the Task Hall in his stead. Why don't you report to him?"
The meeting in the Council Hall had been going on for half a day and has not ended yet.
The Task Hall was located on Reward and Punishment Peak, the mountain presided over by the Grand Elder. In the Grand Elder's absence, everything on the Reward and Punishment Peak was managed by Dai Bufan.
"Please inform Elder Brother for us."
Dai Bufan was a bit confused when he heard the message from the Junior Brother. He didn't remember assigning a secret mission to Lu Yang and his friends. Could it be arranged by the Master? But it didn't make sense because the Master would tell him everything.
Suppressing his doubts, he said: "Let them in."
"Yes, Sir."
The three were invited into the core area of the Task Hall, where Dai Bufan was lying back in his chair, reading files. These were reports from all over, which contained information that could lead to potential tasks.
Dai Bufan put down the files, picked up his tea cup. The tea had been brewed with freshly plucked Enlightenment tea: "Speak up, what have you guys been up to?"
Man Gu, showing off his communication skills, said succinctly, "We joined the demonic sect."
"What!"
Meng Jingzhou glared at Man Gu, then explained to Dai Bufan, "Ignore Man Gu, we just joined the demonic sect."

chapters.title: Chapter 108 - 107: The Weapons Used by the Confucian Cultivator_1
chapters.content:
Finally, it was Lu Yang who stepped up, explaining the situation in just a few sentences.
If it hadn't been for Lu Yang's quick explanation, Dai Bufan would have driven you two out, as you are harmful to our Seek Dao Sect!
Look at what you've done to this honest Man Gu! He even admits being a member of the demonic sect.
"So, you have joined the Eternity Sect and even reached the position of the Rudder Master?" Dai Bufan reevaluated the three of them. A Rudder Master is a mid-level member of the demonic sect, privy to many secrets; even the specific process of reviving the Immortal Eternity is clear to them.
The Four Great Devil Sects always keep their secret work well. Dai Bufan has always wanted to know how Immortal Eternity was revived.
Lu Yang thought to himself that not only was the process clear, but Fairy Eternity was also currently sleeping soundly in his spiritual world.
Speaking of which, since Fairy Eternity incarnates within me, why should I be a Rudder Master? They should appoint me as the sect master.
"Good, you have done a great job!" Dai Bufan slapped his thigh. It's tough to trace the whereabouts of the demonic sect, and they are prepared everywhere for the Righteous Path. He always struggled to get firsthand information and wanted to plant moles within the demonic sect but always failed.
It was beyond his expectation that the trio of Lu Yang brought him surprising news.
"That Tang Yunsheng expects you to infiltrate our sect as undercover agents from the Eternity Sect, right? Then follow his instruction. In half a month, the Seek Dao Sect will recruit a group of new service personnel to expand our internal entertainment industry. I will include your three names in the selected list," Dai Bufan decided promptly.
"As for Yanjiang Rudder... Do you have a list of members from Yanjiang Rudder?"
"Yes." Lu Yang took out the prepared list and handed it to Dai Bufan.
Dai Bufan looked at Lu Yang with deep meaning. Although this kid is shrewd, he is clever enough to realize what Dai Bufan plans to do, hence prepared in advance.
"When you contact Tang Yunsheng again, disguise yourselves well and try to get as much information about the Eternity Sect as possible."
"Being undercover agents in the Eternity Sect is your mission. Unlike others, you don't need to complete three tasks every year."
"As for your contribution points, the highest reward for a Foundation Establishment Stage task is 1,000 points. You eliminated two Tiger demons and four members of the demonic sect, including a late-stage Golden Core, and successfully prevented the Reverse Life Array's activation, which is a huge contribution."
"Two Foundation Establishment Stage Tiger demons and three Foundation Establishment Stage members of the demonic sect, that's 750 points."
"Killing Master Chu and preventing the Reverse Life Array, that's 1,000 points."
"Infiltrating the demonic sect to become the Rudder Master is 1,000 points."
"Meng Jingzhou, Man Gu, you both earn 2,750 points."
"Lu Yang, you performed exceptionally well in this process. On the base of 2,750 points, I will grant an additional 250, bringing it to 3,000 points."
The trio were overwhelmed with joy, stunned by the number of points they received. With so many points, they could afford many items on the exchange list and this will be enough to splurge for a while.
"If you get any more intelligence about the Eternity Sect, you will also be rewarded with points."
After giving some reminders about confidentiality, Dai Bufan allowed the trio to leave.
After leaving, Lu Yang ran into a familiar face in the Task Hall, Elder Brother Li Dan who had once recommended weapons to Lu Yang. Standing next to the fierce-looking Brother Li Dan was a petite Senior Sister.
"Brother Li Dan." Lu Yang and Man Gu said in unison.
Lu Yang and Man Gu looked at each other in surprise, not expecting that they both knew Brother Li Dan.
Man Gu introduced: "This is Brother Li Dan who bought the barbecue recipe for a hundred contribution points."
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou finally understood. They remembered that Man Gu had mentioned that a senior brother bought his barbecue recipe and even won the heart of a senior sister with it.
"Hello," Brother Li Dan greeted with a smile, looking even more ferocious.
Dai Bufan used his Spiritual Sense to call over the chatty Li Dan: "Junior Brother Li Dan, Junior Sister Dingxiang, come here for a moment. There's a task that suits you."
"Elder Brother Dai has asked the two of us to go ahead." Li Dan and Dingxiang hurriedly left.
Dai Bufan handed over a list of Yanjiang Rudder members to the two: "This is a list of demonic sect members I got through special channels. It only contains names, no specific addresses. I want you two to go to Yanjiang County, find everyone on this list and eliminate them all at once. Let no one slip through the net."
"Yes!" The two were thrilled, they had been worrying about which task to take on when Elder Brother Dai assigned them this one.
"Pack up and get going."
"Yes!"
"Wait, one more thing." Before leaving, the two were stopped by Dai Bufan, "Don't open a barbecue shop while you're covertly operating in Yanjiang County."
"Ah? Oh."
...
"What are you looking to buy?" Lu Yang asked Man Gu.
"I want a weapon suitable for a Confucian Cultivator, can't keep using Brother Meng as a weapon every time."
Meng Jingzhou felt somewhat offended.
"What about this fan? The phrases of poems on the surface, slightly waving it can generate a wind blade, and concealed in between the folds are soul-breaking needles. They could be discreetly shot out along with the wind blade. " Lu Yang saw an interesting weapon.
"Seems too refined, do they have anything more powerful?"
"What about this Black Sand Iron Hammer? It's made of black sand iron. It weighs a ton, has an embedded array method to make it heavier when swung down and lighter when lifted, making it easy to swing. It can shatter a hill if struck hard enough, no Foundation Establishment Stage Cultivator dares to directly withstand a hit from this. Seven hundred and eighty contribution points."
Man Gu was slightly tempted, he thought it fit his fighting style, but he still refused.
"That's still not what I'm looking for. I need a weapon for a Confucian Cultivator."
Lu Yang didn't give up. He scrolled to the bottom of the list, where he found something good.
"Sleep Talisman, composed of recitations from the 'Words of the Saint', effectively promotes sleep. One contribution point."
"If we stick this talisman on the hammer, the 'Words of the Saint' will play automatically during battle. Wouldn't this hammer then be a weapon for a Confucian Cultivator?"
Man Gu's eyes lit up, agreeing that Brother Lu had a flexible mind. Why hadn't he thought of this perfect solution before?
"I'll take it!"
With seven hundred and eighty-one contribution points, Man Gu obtained his beloved weapon.
Man Gu swirled his big hammer around. With the 'Words of the Saint' attached to the hammer handle, it was obvious at a glance that he was a Confucian Cultivator.
Meng Jingzhou was not in need of any particular weapons. He bought several carts of high-quality grass feed to reward his old horse.
Lu Yang purchased some items that might come in handy during a fight: White Bone Regenerate Pill. If a chunk of flesh was cut off during a fight, the consumption of this pill could regenerate it instantly, rejuvenating energy.
Gold Light Curse, in a fighting situation, it could form a protective layer of golden light that could block multiple attacks, offering full-body protection. It is more effective than the sesame seed cake served in the cafeteria.
Lu Yang thought the Gold Light Curse was a good item, and bought ten of it all at once.
Clothes that auto-clean themselves. No need to cast the Cleaning Clothes Spell for these clothes to remain clean as new, making them the perfect outfit to wear while eating Sichuan Hot Pot.
Moreover, these clothes had undergone a refining process and did not need to worry about being carried away by the enemy with a Storage Ring.
Lu Yang planned ahead, fearing that the enemy might be just as imaginative as himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 109 - 108: Removing this talisman will let the master out_1
chapters.content:
When Lu Yang returned to Sky Gate Mountain, his Eldest Senior Sister was still absent, with only the puppets guarding the house.
"The meeting is going on for this long? Is there a discussion about the distribution of Spirit Stones?"
In Lu Yang's experience, only in such a case would a meeting be extended this long. The elders always had eccentric ideas that were constrained by a lack of Spirit Stones. Upon encountering an opportunity to gain these stones, they would fight relentlessly for it.
As he was thinking about this, he saw eight streaks of light flying out of the main hall. Eight elders exited the hall and his Eldest Senior Sister leisurely walked out, indicating the meeting had concluded.
"You're back?"
"I just got back."
Yun Zhi, scanning Lu Yang with her Spiritual Sense and confirming that Yellow Bean was still sleeping in the spirit world, spoke, "There are still many mysteries about Fairy Eternity, ones that even she herself might not know. I will visit some friends and see if I can gain any insight. You should practice diligently here at Sky Gate Mountain, and strive for your mid-stage Foundation Establishment."
"Yes."
Without uttering another word, Yun Zhi flew into the sky, her silhouette blurring, and disappeared in an unknown direction.
After Yun Zhi left, Lu Yang looked at the puppet, who had once accompanied him during his cultivation, eager to spar. The puppet quickly had him beaten and defeated.
Unable to beat even a puppet, Lu Yang was overwhelmed with a sense of defeat, and he started practicing meditation earnestly.
Since his eldest senior sister was busy dealing with his matters, he couldn't afford to be lazy either.
"Apprentice, has my apprentice returned?"
A voice, eerie as a specter, reached Lu Yang's ears. Covering his ears subconsciously didn't stop the voice. It had an inexplicable enticing power.
"Who is this!" Lu Yang was vigilant as he looked around. He didn't recall having a master. It had always been his Eldest Senior Sister who taught him.
Wait a second, he did have a Master.
"Lu Yang is back. I am your master, Daoist Buyu."
The current Sect Leader of the Seek Dao Sect, Daoist Buyu, had disappeared for a decade.
The Sect Leader had disappeared for ten years, and yet the sect continued to function smoothly. They even recruited a new batch of disciples. The sect felt no different whether the sect leader was present or absent.
"Master?!"
Lu Yang was shocked. Upon becoming a disciple under Daoist Buyu's guidance, he had never met his master in a year. His Eldest Senior Sister always mentioned that the Master was in seclusion and therefore could not meet him. Could it be that his master had finally completed his seclusion?
"It's me. Even though you have never seen me, I have been paying attention to you all along. I'm very pleased that you were able to channel qi into your body and successfully establish your foundation," said the voice, full of vicissitudes, sounding like a kindly grandfather.
"Master, where are you? You can't come out because you're in seclusion?" Lu Yang felt something was amiss. If his master could see him, and talk to him, then why hadn't he heard anything in the past year?
The voice sighed deeply, full of unspoken bitterness, "Ah, it's a long story. I have been in Sky Gate Mountain all along, but I am temporarily unable to leave my current location. There are some things that can't be explained in a few words. You just need to follow the path I tell you, and you will be able to see me."
Despite having doubts, Lu Yang didn't feel any danger. This was Sky Gate Mountain, and the person was his own master.
Most importantly, his eldest senior sister had never warned him about this issue.
If there were any dangers, his eldest senior sister would've warned him long ago.
"First, find the pine forest halfway up the mountain. In the pine forest, there's a three hundred meter tall ancient pine, the largest one in the whole forest."
Lu Yang easily found the ancient pine that Daoist Buyu spoke of. He remembered that the puppet once picked pine nuts from here to make masquerade for him, which tasted very delicious.
"Lightly tap on the ancient pine three times, wait for three seconds, then tap three more times."
Lu Yang did as told, and suddenly the space beside the ancient pine distorted. An area appeared as if a piece of camouflage cloth was flying up, revealing the reality.
A large area of pine trees on the eastern side of the ancient pine vanished, replaced by a dark abode. At the entrance of the abode, there was a golden talisman that was very eye-catching. The voice of Daoist Buyu seemed to come from this abode.
Lu Yang tentatively called out, "Master?"
"Ah, my good disciple. We finally meet." An elderly man with an immortal bearing walked out of the abode, a duster hanging on his arm. He seemed somewhat moved when he saw Lu Yang. Was this his youngest disciple?
Daoist Buyu stopped at the entrance, not taking another step forward.
"What happened with you Master? Are you trapped here? When my Eldest Senior Sister comes back, I will ask her to rescue you!" Lu Yang said urgently.
"No No No." Daoist Buyu quickly stopped Lu Yang. If it wasn't for the fact that Yun Zhi had left Sky Gate Mountain, he wouldn't have dared to call Lu Yang over.
"Don't tell your Eldest Senior Sister that we met."
"Why is that?"
Daoist Buyu looked up at the ceiling of the cave, his gaze complicated, "People live for fame and fortune. As the sect leader of the Five Great Immortal Sects, I have immense power, prompting many to want my position."
"I can understand. Back in the day in order to take this seat, I also went through many bloody battles and stood out amongst my peers."
"I thought that once I became the sect leader everything would be settled. However, I never thought that I would be betrayed by the one closest to me." As he said this, Daoist Buyu looked as though it pained him to remember the past, but he had no choice but to recall it.
"Your Eldest Senior Sister is extremely talented, and the position of the sect leader would have definitely become hers once I retired. But she couldn't wait until the day of my retirement, and broke our agreement. She trapped me here, and assumed the role of Acting Sect Leader, taking charge of all the affairs of the sect."
"How has the development of the sect been in these ten years? Did your Eldest Senior Sister follow my plan?"
Lu Yang was startled. He heard from his Senior brothers and sisters that the sect had prospered tremendously over these ten years, and it was vibrant with life. Most of the credit went to the Eldest Senior Sister. Could it be that all of this was in Master's plan?
Lu Yang relayed everything he had heard truthfully, earning a somewhat gratified response from Daoist Buyu, "Xiao Yun has done well. She also managed the sect well, even in my absence. It's just a pity…"
"What's a pity?"
"It's a pity because it wasn't me managing it personally. If it were me, there would have been a better management strategy."
"So, can you come out?"
Daoist Buyu sighed bitterly. He tried to walk out of the abode, but as soon as he took a step forward, countless purple lightning bolts erupted from the entrance of the abode. These lightning bolts engulfed Daoist Buyu, frightening him into retreating and using his duster to put out the flames on his body.
"You see, I can't come out."
"Then, how can I save you?"
"There is a golden talisman written by Xiao Yun at the entrance of the abode. As long as you take it off, I can come out."
Lu Yang looked at Daoist Buyu suspiciously, "Is it that simple?"
"Yes, it's that simple. Xiao Yun said that if anyone takes off the talisman, it means that I am not destined to be imprisoned here. It conforms with destiny, so I should naturally be let out."
Lu Yang looked closely and saw not the usual strange patterns on the golden talisman, but only seven large characters left by his Eldest Senior Sister:
Let's see who dares to remove it.

chapters.title: Chapter 110 - 109: The Past of Daoist Buyu_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang backed off a couple of steps silently, making it clear that he had no intention of removing the talisman. This way, even if Eldest Senior Sister were to fall from the sky, he could deny any association.
The phrase of not staying under a crumbling wall probably applies to this situation.
The talisman left by Eldest Senior Sister did not have any fluctuation of spiritual essence. It wasn't dangerous to remove it, but Lu Yang dared not to do it.
Only if he was tired of living would he peel that talisman off.
Master, it's not that your disciple isn't filial, but he only has one life. Plus, there's an immortal in his Spiritual Space. If Eldest Senior Sister beats me to death, it'd be a two-for-one deal, not worth it.
Seeing Lu Yang being hesitant, raising his hand and then putting it down, Daoist Buyu could guess his concerns.
Lu Yang wasn't the first to react this way. He wasn't surprised and chuckled, "It's normal if you don't know much about me. You can ask other elders about me. You'll have a better understanding, and you'll know that I'm not lying."
"Just don't tell them about Xiao Yun imprisoning me. Xiao Yun has been managing the Seek Dao Sect for ten years, not all elders may side with me."
Lu Yang felt that his master had a point. He only knew his master as Daoist Buyu but never really understood what kind of person he was. Perhaps this was an opportunity. Thinking like this, he left the pine forest.
After Lu Yang left, Daoist Buyu scratched his head. He'd asked several people to remove the talisman, but none wanted to do it.
"What's on the talisman that scares them so much?" He craned his neck to see, but couldn't make out what the talisman looked like.
Lu Yang returned to the Task Hall again, only to be told that the Grand Elder was out and not in the sect. Lu Yang, feeling helpless, went to the Teaching Peak where the Second Elder resided.
The Teaching Peak was responsible for teaching basic cultivation knowledge. Lu Yang had crammed there for a month when he first joined the Seek Dao Sect, but he had never seen the Second Elder.
"Senior Brother, is the Second Elder here?" Lu Yang asked the disciple who was on duty at Teaching Peak.
The Senior Brother looked at Lu Yang with odd eyes, "You're looking for Second Elder? You should go to the medicine garden. The one laying at the entrance is him."
Lu Yang was stunned, not expecting that Uncle Ba who instructed him to dig soil was the Second Elder.
He thanked the Senior Brother and went to the medicine garden where he indeed found Uncle Ba.
"Hmm? You want to come dig soil again?" Uncle Ba asked with a smile.
"No, I just wanted to ask about my master."
"Ah, Old Nine, of course I know." The moment Uncle Ba mentioned this, he perked up.
"Old Nine?"
"Yep, from the Grand Elder you know, to the Eighth Elder, and then to your master Daoist Buyu, we were all taught by the same master. Your master is the youngest and was the last to join our sect. He's ranked ninth."
"Old Nine is a real chatterbox, he blabs non-stop all day. Have you ever seen 'Introduction to Crosstalk' on the first floor of Scripture Pavilion? That was donated by Old Nine."
Lu Yang nodded, he remembered clearly. He was stunned for a while when he saw 'Introduction to Crosstalk' in the Scripture Pavilion, thinking he had entered the wrong place.
"Later, our master got tired of hearing Old Nine talk all the time, so he gave him the name Daoist Buyu, hoping that he would talk less."
Lu Yang: "Did it work?"
"Nope. Old Nine said 'one should not speak of strange prodigies and violence, so as long as he doesn't speak about such things, he's fine', and then just kept on talking. His damn mouth really needs to be sewn shut."
"But Old Nine's cultivation talent is the strongest among us nine. Of course, he can't compare to Yun Zhi. I reckon Yun Zhi's talent is quite rare throughout time."
"After our master went into seclusion, the nine of us decided who would become the Sect Leader. The eight of us unanimously agreed that Old Nine should take the position. With his eloquence, Old Nine would definitely do a good job. He flatly refused, so we said that whoever has the most strength becomes the Sect Leader, and he agreed."
"So, the eight of us ganged up on him and beat him up to force him to become the Sect Leader."
Lu Yang then remembered his master mentioning about the "tough battle".
That wasn't wrong.
"The eight of us indeed have good judgment. Old Nine has great management skills. He managed the sect in an orderly manner and dusted off the gloomy atmosphere from before. This might be related to his personality."
"And then, for some reason, Yun Zhi suddenly appeared, announcing that she was taking charge of the sect. We thought that the future would belong to the young people anyway. It would be good for her to take over early, so why not."
"As for where Old Nine went, we didn't pay it any mind. After all, we are all nearly two thousand years old with minds sharper than youngsters. No matter where he hops around, he can't get lost, can he?"
From the perspective of Uncle Ba, a great power cultivator, ten years was not a long time.
After bidding farewell to Uncle Ba, Lu Yang arrived at the Body Refinement Peak and found the Third Elder.
Meng Jingzhou was at the Body Refinement Peak. With his help, Lu Yang quickly located the Third Elder.
The Third Elder was playing chess in the field with the progenitor of the Green-eyed Buffalos.
The Third Elder was a short and stocky man, and Lu Yang couldn't relate him to being a top body cultivator.
Lu Yang knew that the Third Elder concealed a terrifying power within him. For him, moving mountains and sea was just a piece of cake.
His creation, the "Shocking Heaven Six Forms", was highly sought-after by all body cultivators. Countless people dreamt of getting a chance to learn even a little bit of it. Not many could achieve the privilege of being his disciple.
Lu Yang also tried to look for the ten buffalos that he had once summoned in the field, only to find that all buffalos looked alike, indistinguishable from each other.
"You're asking about Old Nine? Haha, glad you asked me! Old Nine was picked up by me on the mountain and I raised him!" The Third Elder claimed as if it was Lu Yang's fortune to have asked him.
Meng Jingzhou quietly reminded him from the side, "Master, it's 'brought up', not 'raised up'."
The Third Elder waved him off impatiently, "It's all the same, don't always be nitpicking like Old Four."
"Old Nine is famously smart, he was the first among us nine to master the magic skill Big and Small Ruyi."
"Big and Small Ruyi is a magic skill that enlarges or shrinks the body. Old Nine wondered, could he modify it to make only parts of the body grow bigger or smaller? Not too big; growing an inch or two is enough. It would be easy to handle and require less magical energy. This would definitely be very popular among men and women.
Men would change their lower body, and women would change their upper body."
"Working on this idea, he indeed figured it out." The Third Elder slapped his thigh in admiration of Daoist Buyu's genius idea.
"He then wrote a new magic skill book called 'Wish Granting Technique: Local Version'. Once it was out, people went crazy to buy it. He earned so many spirit stones at that time that even when we dropped spirit stones on the ground while dining out and ordering the most expensive dishes, we didn't bother picking them up."
"Unfortunately, the good times didn't last long. The Great Xia Dynasty soon put a stop to this magic skill and banned its sale."
"Why?"
"They said it's obscene."
Lu Yang: "...They're not wrong."

chapters.title: Chapter 111 - 110: Ancient Language Translation_1
chapters.content:
It was obvious that the Third Elder had a high opinion of Daoist Buyu, probably because the Third Elder admired whatever he himself lacked.
After saying goodbye to the Third Elder, Lu Yang made his way to Junzi Peak.
Junzi Peak was the territory of the Fourth Elder, a place of serene beauty that enjoyed perennial summer-like weather. Pavilion and streams could be seen everywhere, with verdant, upright bamboo all around. It was clearly an ideal locale for literati to linger and compose poetry. Lu Yang wouldn't even be surprised if the bamboo suddenly recited scholarly wisdom.
Having seen all kinds of peculiar things in the Seek Dao Sect, Lu Yang's psychological fortitude had grown to an impressive degree.
Lu Yang saw black and white pandas frolicking about in the mountain. There were Senior Brothers drinking and having fun, calligraphy brush in hand, splashing ink into paintings. No sooner had they finished painting than they immersed themselves into their creations, joined by the painted characters and reveling inside the painting with absolute delight.
A panda even nudged Lu Yang, almost causing him to topple over. It wanted to play with Lu Yang, who was swamped with things to do. He had a tough time wiggling out of the panda's playfulness which only let him go after he promised it treats. Before Lu Yang departed, the panda gifted him a half-eaten bamboo stalk.
"Hello, Senior Brother. Do you know where the Fourth Elder is?" Lu Yang asked, holding the half-eaten bamboo stalk and standing in front of the painting. The Brother who painted had an exceptionally high level of expertise, capable of creating realistic-looking ink characters, which was utterly terrifying.
Upon hearing Lu Yang's call, the Paintbrush-wielding Senior Brother extended half of his body from the painting, "Who are you?"
"My name is Lu Yang."
Once he heard Lu Yang's name, the painting Senior Brother exclaimed. "Oh, I know you. You're the new guy, Lu Yang, Yun Zhi's disciple."
"...actually, Eldest Senior Sister stood in on behalf of my master to recruit me. I am Daoist Buyu's disciple." Lu Yang corrected his Senior Brother's mistake.
"My name is Ji Hongwen. I started in the Seek Dao Sect in the same period as Eldest Senior Sister, and I am the top disciple of the Fourth Elder." This Senior Brother didn't put on airs and didn't look down on Lu Yang because of his low cultivation level.
"Greetings, Senior Brother Ji." Lu Yang was surprised as he didn't expect Ji Hongwen was also of the same cohort as the Eldest Senior Sister.
He only knew that Dai Bufan belonged to the same group as the Eldest Senior Sister, he was the oldest among all the disciples, his cultivation level wasn't far from that of the Elders, and he handled matters in a way that reassured the Grand Elder. He had high prestige among disciples, and now Lu Yang was unexpectedly meeting another one.
Following this logic, it wouldn't be surprising if Senior Brother Ji's cultivation level was also quite high.
People who would be considered bigwigs in the outside world were commonplace in the Seek Dao Sect.
"Do you want to meet the Grandmaster? Follow me. He's probably teaching his students." Ji Hongwen floated out from the painting entirely, made a hooking gesture with his finger and another person materialized from the painting.
Only then did Lu Yang notice that the painting didn't just contain Ji Hongwen, but also an incredibly beautiful woman.
The woman looked as if she had walked straight out from a picturesque southern shire, her cheecks ruling a faint blush. She possessed an innate grace, her smile blooming like a flower, her eyes brimming with emotion. Her appearance was stunningly exquisite, and she was donned in daringly revealing clothes - even pure-hearted young men like Lu Yang couldn't help feeling their faces burn.
"Haha, do you find her attractive? I painted her myself. Would you like one as well? She can even keep you company at night." Ji Hongwen joked which Lu Yang quickly refused with shaking his head.
He needed to preserve his vital energies.
The incredibly beautiful woman lovingly gazed at Ji Hongwen, her arm entwined with his.
What Lu Yang did not know was that more people aimed at learning this trick from Ji Hongwen than those who aspired to learn the Third Elder's "Shocking Heaven Six Forms".
Under Ji Hongwen's lead, Lu Yang arrived at a private school hidden in the depths of the bamboo forest. Inside the private school, the Fourth Elder, serving as a teacher, a hopeless Man Gu, and several other students were attentively emersed in their lessons.
The Fourth Elder was explaining the meaning of ancient texts. "…Looking southwest across the pool, the Draco constellation's twisted snake-like pattern is clearly visible, turning on and off. The bank alternates like dog teeth, its source is unknown... Now, Man Gu, you translate the meaning of 'The bank alternates like dog teeth, its source is unknown'."
Man Gu, head bowed, thought hard, and then replied with certainty, "Two dogs are fighting by the bank, and no one knows why."
The Fourth Elder silently closed the ancient book, rolled his sleeves up and took out a ruler.
As he was about to hit the back of Man Gu's hand with it, he remembered the sage's teachings - to educate without discrimination and teach according to each student's ability.
He saw Man Gu's diligent efforts in learning which made him realize that Man Gu was a good kid, this translation error should be an anomaly. If I ask him a simpler question that he can answer correctly, I wouldn't have to hit him and it would save face.
"What does the saying 'Kings, generals, and ministers, is there anyone among you with pedigree?' mean?"
According to historical records, around ten thousand years ago when the Great Yu dynasty was fragmenting, the nobles of the Great Yu dynasty stepped forward, waving their banner high, intent on reunifying the fragmented territories and restoring the rule of the Great Yu dynasty.
People believed strongly in the concept of bloodline, considering the bloodline of the Great Yu dynasty as inherently noble. This ideology of the nobles captured the hearts of many.
However, the ancestors of Emperor Xia, who had suffered greatly under the nobles, knew of their deep-rooted corruption. They lived decadent lives, oblivious to the hardships of the common people and the difficulties of cultivation. They were wrongfully lavished with heaven-sent treasures from a young age, causing their cultivation levels to increase drastically.
Even if such people were to establish a new Great Yu dynasty, it would soon decay.
The wise ancestors of Emperor Xia stood up and yelled, "Kings, generals, and ministers, is there anyone among you with pedigree?", which went down in history as a famous quote and passed down through generations.
Even Man Gu, who hails from the Barbarian tribe, was familiar with this quote, deeply admiring the courage of the ancestors of Emperor Xia.
"This quote means, 'Emperors, generals, ministers, do any of you have the guts?'"
Roaring laughter filled the room.
No longer hesitant, the Fourth Elder picked up the ruler and began hitting Man Gu's hands, making him grimace in pain.
Man Gu was utterly perplexed. Hadn't the ancestors of Emperor Xia defied the nobles and ministers to their faces? Didn't that require a great deal of courage?
So, the quote didn't mean this?
Lu Yang, who was standing at the doorway and eavesdropping, silently paid his respects to Man Gu for three seconds.
Seeing this scene, Ji Hongwen couldn't help chuckling, "I have no idea what goes on in the head of our Junior Brother Man Gu. He is a member of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe but instead of learning the excellent techniques of the Third Elder, he chose to become a disciple of the Fourth Elder. This whole year, he's been punished many times."
"But I found that after he returned from this assignment, he seems to have become sharper. Do you know why?"
Lu Yang shook his head. He had no idea.
"By the way, did I imagine it, or is there some kind of pattern to the way the Fourth Elder hits hands? To distract from Ji Hongwen's suspicious gaze, Lu Yang hurriedly changed the topic.
Ji Hongwen looked at Lu Yang with slight surprise, "You're not wrong. Actually, this is a method to stimulate the bloodline, but it's quite painful and few can endure it. The Grandmaster is using this method to activate Junior Brother Man Gu's Ancient Barbarian Tribe bloodline. But remember, don't tell Man Gu anything about this."
Lu Yang nodded.
"Once the Grandmaster finishes teaching, you can talk to him."
With that, Ji Hongwen, hand in hand with the astonishingly beautiful woman, departed.
Class time always seemed to drag on endlessly. After the Fourth Elder lectured for about fifteen minutes, it felt like several hours had passed to Lu Yang.
Finally, the Fourth Elder finished teaching, and came across the ever-inquisitive Lu Yang.
"You want to know who the irreverent, troublesome, and ill-intended Old Nine is?"
Lu Yang: "..."
Thank you, I think I already know what kind of person my master is.

chapters.title: Chapter 112 - 111: Do You Really Expect to Be Let Out Like This?_1
chapters.content:
The Fourth Elder was typically dressed as a Confucian cultivator, immaculate in his white robe, holding a paper fan. He was steady when he moved, gentle to all, considerate in his conduct, treating all disciples equally: "You need to steer clear of Old Nine. Fortunately, his recent disappearance has spared you his trouble."
"You must value the opportunity to learn from Yun Zhi. Learning from Old Nine is a dead end."
"The sage once said that a gentleman has five virtues - benevolence, righteousness, propriety, wisdom, and truthfulness. Old Nine has none of these. He has committed all manner of deceptions and wrongdoings. I even have lost count of how many times I had to bail him out of prison."
"Do you know about the ultimate swordsmanship technique of your master?"
Lu Yang answered, "The Eldest Senior Sister once mentioned it. It is 'One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand'. When fully utilizing it, a single sword can evolve into millions, like storm clouds over the city, covering the sky. It strikes down enemies with piercing eyes. After killing the enemy, ten thousand swords return to one without a drop of blood on them."
When he heard the Eldest Senior Sister's description at the time, Lu Yang yearned for it, feeling that this was the true essence of the elegant and unrestrained sword cultivator.
The Fourth Elder nodded, "Correct, 'One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand'. Old Nine, as a Sword Spirit Root, is indeed a rare swordsmanship genius. There are only a handful of sword cultivators in the world who can reach his realm."
Lu Yang felt curious as he always sensed an indescribable tone in the Fourth Elder's language — something resembling grudging resentment, humiliating association, and disappointment that steel has yet to become hard?
Perhaps that was the feeling.
Then he heard the Fourth Elder continue, "Once, when Old Nine cast his sword technique, 'One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand', he sold those ten thousand evolved swords to the Land Money Trade Association. After receiving the money, he recast 'All Swords Return to One'. But for my intervention and a lot of explanations that mollified the Association's owner, your master would now be in prison!"
Lu Yang: "..."
It seems his master truly deserved his imprisonment.
