"Also, have you heard about the spell 'Wish Granting Technique: Local Version'?"
"I just heard about it from the Third Elder."
"The existence of this magical skill must not be spread. The younger disciples now don't know about it. But if you go back a hundred years, the newly joined disciples were all clamoring to learn this skill and become apprentices under Old Nine."
"Fortunately, Yun Zhi, the Martial Nephew, took the overall situation into account, destroyed the copies of this magical skill, and left the original in the upper layer of the Scripture Pavilion with intentional avoidance. That's why there are no disciples clamoring to learn this magic skill now."
The Fourth Elder had a deeply pained look: "The world is going downhill."
Lu Yang didn't have the heart to tell Fourth Elder that he was actually interested in learning that magic skill himself.
Sorry, I reflect.
The Fourth Elder's tone slightly softened: "However, Old Nine has some good points as well. At least after he became the Sect Leader, our Seek Dao Sect has become much stronger as a whole than before. Of course, this isn't entirely his merit, we eight have made significant contributions."
Lu Yang failed to understand whether the Fourth Elder was praising his master or himself.
"By the way, why do you suddenly care about what kind of person Old Nine is?"
Lu Yang laughed it off: "Nothing, nothing. I've just been curious since I haven't met him since becoming his apprentice."
"Curiosity is a good thing, but don't waste it on Old Nine."
After asking three people, Lu Yang finally had a rough idea of what kind of person his master was.
And he expects to be released?
...
The Heavenly Strategy Sect was located on the eastern side of the continent, occupying a vast area. From the air, you would see that it was shaped like an inverted Eight Diagrams, a truly marvel.
The Heavenly Strategy Sect was tranquil, with few people, like a hermit sect hidden deep within the mountains. It was quiet yet ominous.
The most significant reason for the sect's quietness was that they sent their disciples off to repay debts, leaving only a few people in the vast sect.
It was a strategy to cut costs and refine one's heart amidst hustle and bustle—a win-win situation.
A shout broke the tranquility of the Heavenly Strategy Sect.
"Master, master, I am back!" After Luo Bo ran into the sect, he directly went to find his master.
The Sect Leader of the Heavenly Strategy Sect heard his disciple calling and came out of his Abode: "Good boy, why are you back so soon? Have you thought of a way to repay the debts?"
Luo Bo was panting: "Not yet. When I was traveling, someone asked me to predict their future, and I ran into a tricky character. I wanted to come back and warn the sect to be on guard."
"Sit down and tell it slowly."
Luo Bo caught his breath before saying: "I was traveling in Yanjiang County. I was penniless at the time, so I thought I'd make a few casual predictions to scam some unlucky fools."
"By chance, I met three disciples from Seek Dao Sect and one from Laurel Fairy Palace. They were all prime targets."
"I wasn't planning on taking it seriously, just going through the motions. But what I didn't expect was that one of them was extraordinarily unusual."
"The man's name is Lu Yang. His cultivation isn't high since he's just started, but his future is incredibly terrifying."
The Sect Leader of the Heavenly Strategy Sect was interested: "You mean we invest in him in advance, so he will help us repay our debts when he becomes successful?"
Luo Bo quickly extinguished his master's terrifying idea: "No no no, I see that Lu Yang's future is destined to have causality entangled with several Immortals."
"Entangled with the causality of several Immortals?!" The Sect Leader of the Heavenly Strategy Sect lost his voice. Normally, entanglement with one Immortal alone could lead to a swift destruction. Would this Lu Yang, who will have major causality with several Immortals, survive?
What they of the Heavenly Strategy Sect were most averse to, was any association with those having major causality. The heavier the causality, the more difficult the cultivation, and the more they struggle to break free, the tighter the causality would bind them.
"That's not all. I found out that Lu Yang will spread the malaize of Seek Dao Sect throughout the Cultivation World."
The Sect Leader of the Heavenly Strategy Sect took a sharp intake of breath, why didn't you say this earlier? Compared to this, what does the causality with Immortals matter?
Having causality with Immortals showed that he had a promising future, spreading Seek Dao Sect's perverse practices meant he had a brain problem!
"All in all, we should avoid having anything to do with Seek Dao Sect as much as possible, especially that Lu Yang, the farther away we stay, the better!"
Suddenly, the complexion of the Heavenly Strategy Sect's Sect Leader changed.
"What's wrong, Master?"
"There's a barbaric and aggressive energy heading our way. I suspect it bears ill intent! Initiate the main defense array first!"
With decisive action, the Sect Leader of the Heavenly Strategy Sect activated the sect's primary defense array.
The array nodes lit up, like stars in the night sky, forming the shape of the Eight Diagrams.
A massive Eight Diagrams covered the sect. Indomitable, complicated, and hard to find an exit. Those who fall into the array spend lifetimes unable to unravel its mystery. Countless Great Powers at the Unification realm had returned empty-handed, and some with impure intentions even died within the array!
The protective power of the Heavenly Strategy Sect's protection array was apparent!
The incoming individual did not hesitate even in the face of the complex array, displaying a cocky arrogance.
Faced with the complex array, the comer extended a hand, and the array shattered.
Only then did the Sect Leader of the Heavenly Strategy Sect get a good look at the comer. A graceful figure, godlike and inviolable.
"Yun Zhi of Seek Dao Sect pays respects to the Grand Elder of the Heavenly Strategy Sect. I humbly ask for an audience."
The face of the Sect Leader of the Heavenly Strategy Sect turned pale. Speak of the Seek Dao Sect, and it appears.

chapters.title: Chapter 113 - 112: The Reason Daoist Buyu was Imprisoned_1
chapters.content:
Ignoring the identity of the Five Great Immortal Sects, Seek Dao Sect, is also a notorious existence in the cultivation world. Like parents warning their children not to play with bad kids, the elders often advise their disciples not to associate with Seek Dao Sect.
However, there are always some stubborn disciples who insist on engaging with Seek Dao Sect, causing great distress.
Such as Lan Ting.
Fortunately, the higher-ups in the cultivation world know that Seek Dao Sect is not beyond saving. Since the disappearance of the previous sect leader, the new sect leader, Yun Zhi, has made noticeable improvements in Seek Dao Sect - mainly in the sense that Seek Dao Sect only brings disaster upon itself, not others.
If you view Seek Dao Sect as a mental hospital, then Yun Zhi would be the director, one of the few "normal" people.
It is much better to have Yun Zhi knocking on your door than anyone else.
A hearty voice came from underneath the grounds of the Heavenly Strategy Sect, and in the blink of an eye, there was an old figure standing in front of Yun Zhi.
"Master Daoyan," Yun Zhi greeted with a bow.
Master Daoyan, the Supreme Elder of the Heavenly Strategy Sect, is an ancient figurine in the cultivation world; very few people have lived longer than him. He is low-key and has never revealed his true cultivation level.
"What is the purpose of your visit, Fellow Daoist?" Master Daoyan respectfully addressed Yun Zhi, considering absolute no room for slackening.
"I have some questions about the immortals."
"Please, proceed."
"Please, proceed."
Master Daoyan invited Yun Zhi into a private room within the sect and poured her some tea.
"What aspects of the immortals would you like to ask about?"
"How much do you know about Immortal Eternity?"
Master Daoyan showed a troubled expression and chuckled bitterly: "Immortal Eternity? You do ask some challenging questions. Immortal Eternity is the most mysterious of the five ancient immortals. If it weren't for the firm belief of the Eternity Sect that they had found his remains, and that there were records of Immortal Eternity within those, I wouldn't have even known about his existence."
"Even if there are ruins, it doesn't necessarily mean they are genuine. I still have reservations about the existence of Immortal Eternity."
"How so?"
"A relic discovered over ten thousand years ago, while ancient to us now, does not mean it's authentic, does it?"
"I heard the ruins are from the era of Great Qian, but so what? We are in a new era now, tens of thousands of years removed from the ancient times."
"It's entirely plausible that someone during the time of Great Qian concocted an incomprehensible relic, and then after dozens or hundreds of thousands of years, someone happens upon it and because of its 'ancient' status, assumes the record of it to be true."
"If there truly were an Immortal Eternity, then why is there no other evidence aside from this relic to confirm it?"
"Several holes from the era of Great Qian have been unearthed, so why haven't we encountered any records of Immortal Eternity?"
Yun Zhi nodded in agreement. Master Daoyan had a point: "I have recently located the headquarters of Eternity Sect. Unfortunately, they escaped before I could capture anyone. However, I did manage to find some information from the files they left behind."
In reality, Yun Zhi hadn't obtained any information from the headquarters. For safety reasons, she didn't want to reveal any details about Lu Yang.
"I am keen to hear the details."
"According to the Eternity Sect, the Dao fruit of Immortal Eternity could be described as 'immortal'. As long as someone recites the name and immortal moniker of Immortal Eternity, he can be resurrected."
Master Daoyan's pupils shrank slightly, greatly taken aback. This type of attribute was incredible, practically impossible to kill.
"Every immortal's Dao fruit has different characteristics, this is definitely the truth."
After expressing these sentiments, Master Daoyan added, "However, this is solely the opinion of the Eternity Sect. I maintain my viewpoint that this is a fabrication of an Immortal."
"The method is similar to how the Great Xia Dynasty became immortal through state destiny. Some hidden manipulator concocted a non-existent immortal, using the faith in the Eternity Sect to slowly manifest the image of Immortal Eternity. When the power of faith accumulates to a certain degree, Immortal Eternity will appear from nothingness."
Yun Zhi did not refute him; she simply listened quietly to Master Daoyan's theory. Since Immortal Eternity had already resurrected, it was definitely not immortal fabrication. However, the idea of immortal fabrication had its merits, as it is possible that the other three demonic sects are creating immortals.
After thanking Master Daoyan, Yun Zhi took her leave.
The leader of Heavenly Strategy Sect went to talk to Master Daoyan, recalling the scene where she had effortlessly torn the Array Method apart, he was still shaken, "Master, just how strong is Yun Zhi? Has she become an immortal?"
"Don't ask, I don't know anything."
...
Yun Zhi had visited many people, and Master Daoyan was the last one. After finishing her business, she went straight back to Seek Dao Sect.
At this time, Lu Yang returned to Sky Gate Mountain to find his master.
"So, what did the senior brothers have to say? Did they all say that under my leadership, Seek Dao Sect is becoming more prosperous?"
Daoist Buyu was brimming with pride, his contribution to the development of Seek Dao Sect was undeniably significant.
Lu Yang looked at his master with a complex expression: "Indeed, your contribution is significant, but everyone prefers Eldest Senior Sister to manage the sect."
Daoist Buyu slumped, his face a picture of utter desolation: "So it is indeed the case? Fine, let her be the sect leader then. The new generation replacing the old is only natural."
"As disciples fighting for power and imprisoning their masters, the news would tarnish the reputation of Seek Dao Sect when it gets out."
"If you let me go, I'll disappear and never bring up the sect leadership again, and I will never return to Seek Dao Sect. What do you say?" Daoist Buyu proposed.
Lu Yang hesitated, thinking Daoist Buyu had a reasonable point. His master did not seem like a power-hungry person. Just as he was contemplating whether or not to release his master, a cold voice rang out from above.
"Master, you really want to go out?"
Upon hearing the voice, Daoist Buyu's face changed dramatically.
Lu Yang looked up, pleasantly surprised to see his Eldest Senior Sister had returned, "Eldest Senior Sister!"
Yun Zhi responded with a faint acknowledgment, descending gently without a speck of dust on her.
"Master, you would deceive Junior Brother to get out?"
Yun Zhi's words, although delivered without fire, echoed like an about-to-erupt volcano in Daoist Buyu's ears, exuding an overwhelming sense of dread.
Deceive? Lu Yang was taken aback; were all the things the master had told him lies?
What then, was the truth?
Lu Yang's mind raced, quickly arriving at a highly likely possibility. The master had suffered a qi deviation, and Eldest Senior Sister, in her righteous indignation, had imprisoned him here. Considering it was not proper to air one's dirty laundry in public, she had not revealed that the master had suffered a qi deviation to the elders.
In the absence of Eldest Senior Sister, the master relayed a message to Lu Yang, using flattery and crafty words to get him to unlock the seal, intending to cause havoc in the world?
That was close, very close. Luckily, Eldest Senior Sister arrived in time.
Then he heard Eldest Senior Sister continued to speak.
"Look at the other sect leaders, they are all diligent in their spiritual cultivation. But look at you, idling all day. Have you completed the daily cultivation exercises I set for you? Have you broken through to the next realm?"
"You've accomplished nothing, and yet you want to go out and play?"
Daoist Buyu stammered, unable to utter a word.
Lu Yang: "..."
What the hell was I just thinking? How could such a clichéd plot happen in the Seek Dao Sect?

chapters.title: Chapter 114 - 113 Lu Yang's Three Questions_1
chapters.content:
"Well, you can't exactly put it that way. Cultivation is all about balancing work and leisure. They say stillness inspires movement - if you stay in one place for too long, you need to go out and walk around."
"Think about it, Xiao Yun, isn't the purpose of cultivation to achieve immortality, live freely and happily? If someone always isolates themselves to meditate and cultivate, wouldn't cultivation be just like serving a prison sentence? It's completely backward," Daoist Buyu said earnestly.
As someone who's a frequent guest in the prison, he, like no other, has the right to speak on this topic.
"Moreover, doesn't cultivation also divides into Worldly Cultivation and hermit cultivation? I'm the typical individual who practices Worldly Cultivation; only by immersing myself in the hustle and bustle can I comprehend the path of Immortality and make breakthroughs!"
Lu Yang was somewhat familiar with this argument. For instance, the cultivators who served in the government of the Great Xia Dynasty practiced Worldly Cultivation, while the cultivators of the Five Great Immortal Sects leaned more towards hermit cultivation. Nevertheless, very few cultivators practiced hermit cultivation as purely as Eldest Senior Sister.
No matter how eloquently Daoist Buyu spoke, Yun Zhi remained unmoved, not even batting an eyelid.
"Master, when you taught me, you said that stress catalyzes movement, and that I should seize every moment to cultivate diligently. To plan a day, pay attention to the morning, afternoon, and evening; to plan a year, focus on spring, summer, autumn, and winter."
Yun Zhi did exactly as Daoist Buyu had taught, cultivating earnestly from dawn to dusk.
Being an unprecedented genius, coupled with her diligent cultivation, Yun Zhi made speedy progress. When the Immortal Sect conference was convened, Yun Zhi outshone everyone else, taking the first place.
As usual, the five sect leaders of the Immortal Sect would critique the champion's shortcomings. Some sect leaders, fearing the champion might become arrogant, would challenge them to a battle.
Then, Yun Zhi would defeat all five sect leaders, leaving them in total disarray.
By the next Immortal Sect conference, while the disciples were fighting hard on the stage, Yun Zhi would be sitting among the sect leaders, giving comments and she was right in the middle.
Daoist Buyu thought to himself, this is not what I intended for you to increase your cultivation level, become the sect leader in my stead, so I can sneak out to play, right?
Of course, these thoughts of Daoist Buyu would never be uttered aloud.
Yun Zhi didn't hold any resentment towards cultivation. On the contrary, she enjoyed the process. During cultivation, she felt an unprecedented tranquility in the world. She felt as though she was merging with the world and could distinctly sense herself growing stronger.
After finishing her cultivation, she would feel refreshed and invigorated. Why would she refuse to do it?
"Fine, if you want to go out, then you can go..." Yun Zhi said indifferently, her tone slightly easing.
Daoist Buyu rejoiced, thinking that all his sweet talk wasn't in vain. Would Xiao Yun finally let him out?
"Rely on your own abilities." Yun Zhi added the second half of her sentence and then turned to leave.
Daoist Buyu opened his mouth, stunned, not knowing what to say. If he could get out on his own, he would have left ages ago!
"Lu Yang, you..."
Daoist Buyu tried to call Lu Yang to plead for him, but Lu Yang gave him a look that said, 'Master, you're on your own,' and hurried to catch up with Eldest Senior Sister.
On one side was the omnipotent Senior Sister who repressed the Seek Dao Sect, and on the other was his repressed Master. It wasn't hard to choose a side.
"My apprentice, don't go! Just help me remove the talisman and I'll teach you the One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand technique. With thousands of swords suspended in mid-air, the dazzling sword tips pointing downwards, you'll gain the advantage even before the battle begins!"
"Could it defeat Senior Sister?" Lu Yang ran back. As a sword practitioner, who wouldn't want to learn some jaw-dropping sword techniques?
Power wasn't important; what mattered was how cool it looked!
Daoist Buyu shook his head and seeing this, Lu Yang was about to leave again.
In a hurry, Daoist Buyu said, "I can also impart you the 'Sword Path Truth'. This will deepen your understanding of swordsmanship. Having reached the peak of swordsmanship, you can break all techniques with a single sword, and no one would dare to take your sword blow. You will be invincible at the same level!"
"Could it defeat Senior Sister?"
Again, Daoist Buyu shook his head, and seeing this, Lu Yang was about to leave.
In desperation, Daoist Buyu hurriedly said, "I can also pass on the 'Four Extreme Sword Array' to you. When the sword array is formed, it reaches to the sky, cutting off life forces, and can wipe out everything in its path!"
"Could it defeat Senior Sister?"
Finally, Daoist Buyu got angry, "You rebellious disciple, if I could beat her, would I be stuck here?!"
Lu Yang thought what his Master said made sense, so he chose to stand with Eldest Senior Sister.
...
"Senior Sister, there's another issue I came across during this mission," Lu Yang said.
"What is it?"
"I noticed that the Five Great Immortal Sects aren't well-known. Many people are unaware of our existence. When it comes to issues involving evil spirits, they can only rely on the government. If the government doesn't take action, they have to endure it helplessly."
In the Great Xia Dynasty, manpower was limited, and due to self-esteem, they often didn't ask for assistance from the Five Great Immortal Sects, causing the common people to suffer in the meantime.
Lu Yang had noticed this issue during his time in Song Mountain. Though the old hunter was pretending to be a ghoul, his ignorance of the Seek Dao Sect was real.
During his time in Yanjiang County, Lu Yang casually asked around and found out that commoners had very limited knowledge about higher matters and were unaware of the Five Great Immortal Sects.
Yun Zhi was quite surprised. She had never considered this issue before, or rather nobody in the Five Great Immortal Sects had noticed it.
She attended the Immortal Sect meetings every year, but no one ever brought up this issue.
"That's actually a serious issue. Should we compile information about the Seek Dao Sect and spread it among the populace?"
Lu Yang presented his solution as if he was offering a treasure, "Writing a book is indeed a great way to disseminate information. But as far as I know, the literary rate among commoners is not high, and not many can afford books. Perhaps converting the Seek Dao Sect's story into a form of storytelling would also be a good idea."
"Storytelling?" Yun Zhi had a limited understanding of this field. Daoist Buyu was an expert, considering he once donated the 'Encyclopedia of Crosstalk' to the Scripture Pavilion.
"Yes, storytelling. Before I joined Seek Dao Sect, all I knew about cultivation came from storytellers."
"Currently, the content of the storytelling market is inconsistent, full of contradictions, and the depictions of cultivation are shallow and flawed. This misleads people into having wrong perceptions of cultivation."
"If we turn the Seek Dao Sect's story into a storytelling script, it'll definitely be popular!" Lu Yang got excited and clenched his fists.
"The stories of the Seek Dao Sect aren't that extraordinary. Could they really attract people?" Eldest Senior Sister still had doubts.
Lu Yang thought if their stories from the Seek Dao Sect aren't considered extraordinary, then how outrageous must the rest of the Cultivation World be?
Senior Sister, you're so focused on cultivation that you're lacking general knowledge. You probably don't know what people outside think of our Seek Dao Sect.
Lu Yang assumed that given Senior Sister's cultivation level, others from the different Immortal Sects wouldn't dare to upset her by criticizing the Seek Dao Sect in front of her.
"No worries at all!" Lu Yang assured confidently.
"Who could be suitable for writing a storytelling script to promote the Seek Dao Sect?" Yun Zhi furrowed her brows, thinking about the problem.
"I nominate someone who would surely be up to the task!"
"Who?"
"Master."

chapters.title: Chapter 115 - 114: Eldest Senior Sister, Have I Learned It?_1
chapters.content:
When Daoist Buyu learned that he had the opportunity to be released, he was so eager that he almost kneeled down to ask Lu Yang to become his master. Lu Yang was so frightened that he quickly said that it was not necessary.
Upon discussing his ideas with Daoist Buyu, the Daoist agreed that Lu Yang made a lot of sense.
"Indeed, we have overlooked the role of publicity. Mortals know too little about cultivation, the Five Great Immortal Sects, and the other sects."
Daoist Buyu stroked his beard in thought, "Writing a narrative about the Seek Dao Sect, this is indeed a technical task, let me ponder about it."
"Our Seek Dao Sect has a history of 120,000 years, which can be divided into three stages: the founding by Daoist Xiantian, the recognition as one of the Five Great Immortal Sects by Celestial Master Guiyuan, and the revival by Vast Sea Daoist Lord. Each stage has countless stories worth telling, the creation story of Daoist Xiantian alone has a lot of interesting details."
Lu Yang thought to himself that Daoist Buyu truly deserved to be the master. He managed to glamorize Daoist Xiantian's wandering experience into a noble journey exploring the world. This skill alone was worth learning from him.
"Of course, we can't ignore the recent developments, they're the main focus. For example, regarding me, it can't be said that I was simply brought back by Old Three. Instead, it should be changed to a tale of a naturally born hero who came into the world holding a sword with the symbol 'kill' on it...ahem, I'm just joking, we won't really say it that way."
Confronted with Eldest Senior Sister's icy gaze, Daoist Buyu quickly retracted, "I will surely provide precise descriptions, without any falsehood!"
Daoist Buyu negotiatively said, "Dear disciple, could you please release me first? In order to write this tale of how the Seek Dao Sect defeats demons and supports the Righteous Path, it's crucial to consult your eight uncles who were the main actors of these events. It will surely enrich the content."
Yun Zhi, felt his argument was reasonable this time, and prepared to release her master.
Then Yun Zhi promptly left. Daoist Buyu became anxious and shouted, "Dear disciple, you haven't released your master yet!"
Without looking back, Yun Zhi replied, "If you meditate in your abode for three days, the barrier will naturally fade away."
Lu Yang thought to himself, 'So, despite being confined for ten years, the master couldn't meditate consistently for three days. No wonder Eldest Senior Sister is reluctant to release him.'
Lu Yang trotted quickly to catch up with Eldest Senior Sister, earnestly saying, "Eldest Senior Sister, I'd like to learn a magic skill that I can use with my mouth."
"Why is that?"
"I found out that during battles, my feet can evade and attack, my hands can hold the sword and deploy hidden weapons, but my mouth is the only part that is not being used."
"Just imagine, while we're at a deadlock with our enemies, weapons clashing, unable to get the upper hand, suddenly deploying a magic skill using my mouth to catch them off guard, that would surely secure our victory!"
Yun Zhi couldn't comprehend Lu Yang's reasoning of being "at a deadlock with an enemy," because her battles were always a sweeping victory. But if Lu Yang was willing to learn, she had no reason to stop him.
"I have a technique that allows you to spew golden energy from your mouth after mastering it, which can easily cut through anything. It requires Golden Spirit Root as the body affinity, while your Sword Spirit Root can also manage, but it requires stored energy accumulation. During the accumulation period, you can't make any other movements."
Lu Yang shook his head, "Too restrictive. It might be useful for ambushes, but rarely useful in open combat."
"How about the Samadhi True Fire? You store up energy in your abdomen and then spew out the Samadhi True Fire from top to bottom. It can't be extinguished unless doused with magical water. Yet, it's difficult to master. It could take several months of practice, and you've never learned any Five Elements Magic Skill before, so I don't know about your natural talent in this aspect."
Suddenly, Yun Zhi became silent as she remembered that the first Five Elements Magic Skill Lu Yang learned was Shrinking Earth.
Lu Yang was thrilled. It was the famous Samadhi True Fire! Of course he would seize the opportunity to learn it, and if he failed, at least he would have no regrets.
"I want to learn Samadhi True Fire."
Seeing that Lu Yang made his choice, Yun Zhi didn't stop him and led Lu Yang to the place where he first started his cultivations.
Over here, Lu Yang lifted the jar to catch tofu, successfully guiding the spiritual essence into his body, which held great sentimental value for him.
Yun Zhi calmly explained, "The so-called Samadhi True Fire, which consists of divine, pure, and human fire, is similar to the categorization system of the River Spirit's axe."
"The heart represents the ruling fire or divine fire, also known as the Greater Obscurity; the kidney represents the ministerial fire or essence fire, also known as the Middle Obscurity; the bladder, which is the sea of qi below the navel, represents the earthly fire, also known as the Lesser Obscurity."
"When using the Samadhi True Fire, you should focus on your heart, kidneys, and bladder."
"I have already told you, you must keep the water in your kidneys full at all times. The reason lies right here. The human body consists of five elements, and most Five Elements Magic Skills rely on the five organs of the human body, which makes keeping your kidneys full exceedingly important."
"I'll demonstrate it for you, watch closely."
Yun Zhi aimed at a large tree. She opened her mouth and spewed out Samadhi True Fire. The large tree which was about an arm's length thick was instantly turned into ashes. Lu Yang didn't even have time to react!
This was the result of Yun Zhi trying her best to reduce the flame's power. If she harnessed her full power, even the existence of Sky Gate Mountain might be doubtful.
"Have you learned it?"
Hesitating, Lu Yang knew that Eldest Senior Sister's teaching methods were always mysteriously unpredictable, and the key lay in one's perception. "Let me give it a try."
He had created the "Mind Seeing Method", which allowed him to see things more clearly. Therefore, he was determined to learn the magic skill taught by Eldest Senior Sister.
It was time to show off the power of his self-created method!
Lu Yang channeled his inner spiritual essence, focused it on his heart, kidneys, and bladder, and forcefully spewed it out, his saliva shot three meters away!
"Samadhi True Fire!" Lu Yang was not discouraged, he shouted loudly again, and his saliva shot another three meters away!
"Ptui!"
"Ptui!"
Lu Yang continuously attempted the magic skill and ended up with a dry mouth after spitting so much.
Indeed, Samadhi True Fire was difficult to learn.
Seeing how hard Lu Yang was working, Yun Zhi handed him a gourd. Lu Yang took a sip and found it unbelievably sweet, just like a fine wine.
"What is this water? It's so sweet!"
"Sugar water."
Lu Yang: "..."
Could sugar water be anything but sweet?
Honing his perseverance, Lu Yang kept trying from noon till evening. Eventually, he gradually grasped the knack of it.
"This time it definitely will succeed. Samadhi True Fire, spew!" Lu Yang summoned all his strength, gathered his full spiritual essence, cycled his major and minor energy channels, and spewed out fiercely. A blazing fire burst from his mouth, burning the tree and making it crackle with sound!
"I did it!" Lu Yang beamed with joy, realizing that he indeed had a knack for learning magic skills. He had mastered the skill that was supposed to take several months in just an afternoon.
Yun Zhi, who had been watching from the side, felt something was not right about the fire. Ignoring the high temperature, she walked up and pinched a bit between her fingers and tasted it.
"Sweet?"
Why would a flame have a taste?
"Try it again."
Lu Yang still didn't understand, but he spewed out the true fire again. Yun Zhi tasted it once more, "Salty?"
"Try it one more time."
Upon tasting again, Yun Zhi said, "Spicy?"
After multiple attempts, Yun Zhi found that the fire Lu Yang spewed out was very powerful, but had a unique taste. If it wasn't sweet, it was salty, or it was spicy.
With a cheerful spirit, Lu Yang ran over and asked, "Eldest Senior Sister, did I master it?"
Yun Zhi looked at Lu Yang with a strange expression, "Yes, you have, but what you've mastered is the Three-flavored True Fire."
"Three-flavored True Fire?"

chapters.title: Chapter 116 - 115: Not Using Talent for Barbecue_1
chapters.content:
"Three-flavored True Fire?" Lu Yang was puzzled, thinking to himself that Eldest Senior Sister could not even distinguish between "三昧" (Samadhi) and "三味" (three flavors). The two characters may look similar, but they are pronounced entirely differently.
Immediately, Lu Yang remembered that Eldest Senior Sister's literacy level was probably higher than his own.
Lu Yang forced a calm laugh and said, "Ha ha ha, Eldest Senior Sister you're joking, right? You taught me Samadhi True Fire; how could I learn Three-flavored True Fire?"
"Impossible, just impossible."
Yun Zhi didn't explain but signaled to the puppet to fetch a piece of Demon Beast Meat from the kitchen.
With an unexposed method, Yun Zhi made the Demon Beast Meat hover and spin in the air: "Roast it with True Fire."
Lu Yang exuded True Fire from his mouth, the sizzling Demon Beast Meat began to exude oil. A delicious aroma quickly wafted out, causing Lu Yang to swallow his saliva.
Although Lu Yang's True Fire was not as powerful as the one demonstrated by Yun Zhi, it was much more vigorous than ordinary flames, and it didn't take long for the Demon Beast Meat to be roasted.
"Try it yourself." Yun Zhi said.
Lu Yang used his finger as a blade, sliced a small piece, and put it in his mouth. The delicious taste was rather toothsome.
This piece of Demon Beast Meat didn't have any seasoning, yet it gave Lu Yang the feeling of having salt for flavor, sugar for freshness, and peppers for a fragrant twist.
Indeed, it was Three-flavored True Fire.
"There must be a problem somewhere." Lu Yang seriously analyzed. He indeed followed every step taught by Eldest Senior Sister and practiced under the demonstration of a Great Power like her. There was no way he could have messed up.
"Let me try again. I'll surely succeed!"
Yun Zhi nodded, "It's great that you have the will. So tonight's dinner is on you. It will consolidate what you've learned today."
Having said that, Yun Zhi turned around and went back to the Abode to meditate, quietly waiting for Lu Yang's meal.
"No, wait, I didn't mean that…" Lu Yang felt that Eldest Senior Sister misunderstood his determination, but alas, she was already out of sight, leaving only the puppet now accompanying Lu Yang.
Lu Yang sighed and called the puppet into the kitchen.
This was Lu Yang's first time in the Sky Gate Mountain's kitchen. Usually, it was the puppet who did the cooking; Lu Yang had never cooked before.
Exhausted from daily practice, he had no energy left to cook.
As expected of Eldest Senior Sister's exclusive kitchen—it was bigger than the stadium of his past life. Binfuls of neatly arranged ingredients and several-meter-high Judi Oxen bodies were seen everywhere. The formidable appearances of the Oxen only gave a hint of how powerful they must have been when alive.
Pity these Oxen didn't see her coming in the Central Continent, killing them with a single blow. They didn't even realize they were dead.
Lu Yang has basic cooking skills, but those are limited to ordinary ingredients. The ingredients placed before him were none that he could recognize.
"Now, what should I cook? I wonder what Eldest Senior Sister likes to eat? She seems to be eating everything and nothing in particular each meal."
"The master likes grilled food the most." A sudden voice came, startling Lu Yang.
Lu Yang turned his head and saw it was the puppet talking.
The puppet was wooden and shaped like a woman, except its face wasn't sculpted. It had been with Lu Yang since his first day of practice, but he never knew it could talk?!
"Why are you looking at me?" The puppet spoke again, assuring Lu Yang this was not a hallucination.
"You can talk? Howcome I've never heard you speak before?"
"Why should I talk to a fool?"
"You..." Lu Yang was lost for words. If it weren't for him being no match for it, he would have dismantled this damned puppet.
"You said Eldest Senior Sister likes barbecue? How is it that I've never seen her eat it?" Lu Yang suspiciously looked at the puppet.
He knew of a magic skill called puppetry and masters who specialized in it were named puppeteers, and that the Yanshi Sect was even composed entirely of puppeteers among the First-Grade sects.
What he didn't know, however, was the limit of puppetry—could they be this astute?
Please say at least this puppet belongs to Eldest Senior Sister?
"The master doesn't have the habit of revealing her personal preferences to others." The puppet responded to Lu Yang with an air of disdain.
"See that Kui Ox on your right? Chop off its thigh. The master likes to eat that part."
"I'll take your word for it this time." Lu Yang didn't think the puppet had a reason to tease him.
He took out his Green Peak Sword and swung it at the thigh of the Kui Ox. The body of the Kui Ox began to glow, propelling Lu Yang backward and landing him straight into a pile of flour, covering him in white.
"Cough, Cough, What cultivation level was this ox at when it was alive?" Lu Yang was certain this ox had an astoundingly high cultivation level when it was alive, making it invulnerable even after death.
The puppet didn't answer and instead smashed the golden protective light around the Kui Ox's body: "Try again."
"Slash!" Lu Yang unleashed the slash character, causing minor external damage.
The power of Slash was inferior to Break, but it had a wider range and could be used multiple times.
"Slash!"
"Slash!"
Lu Yang used the Slash three times consecutively, depleting his spiritual essence. The puppet timely fed him a Great Recovery Pill.
"Slash!"
"Slash!"
"Slash!"
Great Recovery Pill.
This pattern continued - Slash, Slash, Slash, Great Recovery Pill - until enough was cut off for a meal.
Having just prepared the food, Lu Yang was breathless. He spread himself on the ground, while the puppet kept giving him the Great Recovery Pill.
This scenario seemed eerily familiar to Lu Yang.
Though it was better left unsaid, the Great Recovery Pill indeed worked. After taking it, Lu Yang was full of vim and vigor again, and he continued with the cooking.
"Use your Sword Qi to shred the meat tendons," suggested the puppet at one side.
The tip of the Green Peak Sword pierced into the Kui Ox's flesh, releasing Sword Qi. To Lu Yang, the Qi felt like a stone sinking into the ocean, unable to create even the slightest ripple.
"Keep going, keep going. You're the best," encouraged the puppet, but its tone was so monotonous that Lu Yang didn't feel motivated at all.
Lu Yang fumed, "Can't you be a bit more passionate?"
The puppet willingly obliged, "Lu Yang, although your cultivation level is quite low and you tend to learn things in your unique way, lose to me, but you have been trying really hard. Keep going!"
Lu Yang gritted his teeth, continuously escalating the power of releasing Sword Qi. Finally, the Sword Qi successfully entered the Kui Ox's flesh, gradually cutting off the tendons.
After finishing this full process, Lu Yang was exhausted and in no mood to argue with the puppet.
When it was time for roasting the meat, Lu Yang gulped down Great Recovery Pills while using Three-flavored True Fire to cook. The fragrance of meat soon wafted out of the kitchen.
"What a tantalizing smell, what's cooking here?" Asked Uncle Ba, who walked into the kitchen in search of the source of the aroma and noticed Lu Yang roasting something.
"Uncle Ba, what brought you here?" Lu Yang asked in surprise.
Uncle Ba smiled and pulled out a can of tea leaves, "I just got this Enlightenment Tea and thought I'd bring it to Yun Zhi. I came here following this wonderful scent. I see you're roasting Kui Ox. It must've been quite a task for you with your current cultivation level, huh?"
Lu Yang chuckled embarrassingly in response.
"Hey, you had been inquiring about Old Nine earlier. Did you find any information about his whereabouts?"
Given his master was due to come out of seclusion soon, Lu Yang saw no harm in telling Uncle Ba about his master's retreat in the pine forest.
Upon hearing the news, Uncle Ba's eyes lit up. "As they say, every rogue has his day. That damned Old Nine has been confined by Yun Zhi!"
Putting down his Enlightenment Tea, he got up to leave, "I have to go now. Have some urgent matters to attend."
"I need to tell our junior brothers about this immediately. Let us all watch Old Nine together!"

chapters.title: Chapter 117 - 116: Sharing Difficulties_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang was fully concentrating on roasting the Kui Ox, a task that required his wisdom, determination, and luck. No room was left for any carelessness, so he had temporarily overlooked Uncle Ba's schadenfreude expression.
Finally, the roasted Kui Ox was ready, its delicious aroma pervaded the kitchen for three days without any root of dissipation. The Three-flavored True Fire, created by Lu Yang, really had some advantages.
There were only a hundred and eight kinds of true fire in the world. Lu Yang, with his talent, managed to add one more. Such flames were indeed extraordinary!
If Lu Yang wanted, he could even start up a continental chain of BBQ restaurants! Establishing a BBQ Sect wasn't out of the question, either!
This was an opportunity that many Man Gu couldn't even dream of attaining!
However, Lu Yang was indifferent to fame and wealth and had no plans in this regard.
Lu Yang placed the roasted Kui Ox on a plate and garnished it with roasted potatoes, carrots and cauliflower, preparing to serve it. The puppet looked at Lu Yang unexpectedly, marveling at his thoroughness.
Just as Lu Yang was about to leave the kitchen, he noticed a large chunk of meat missing from the Kui Ox, revealing well-defined White Bone.
Lu Yang recalled the White Bone Regenerate Pill he had just swapped for.
"What would happen if I fed the Kui Ox the White Bone Regenerate Pill? Would a chunk of meat grow back?" thought Lu Yang. If successful, this could spell a tremendous business opportunity!
Acting on his thought, Lu Yang pried open the mouth of the Kui Ox and forced down the elixir pill.
A miraculous scene unfolded. A trace of golden light emanated from the Kui Ox corpse's wound. The roasted Kui Ox slowly floated, reverted to its raw state, and moved to the wound, fitting in seamlessly.
Lu Yang: "..."
Was this scientifically possible?
Did the meat I spent so much time roasting just revert back to its raw state?!
Even the puppet couldn't hold back its laughter and snickered quietly.
Left with no choice, Lu Yang had to start over again.
Luckily, he had learned from his first attempt, so the second time around was much faster. Also, Lu Yang discovered his proficiency in 'Cut', Sword Qi, and Three-flavored True Fire had increased as well.
Lu Yang pondered, could this be what Eldest Senior Sister meant by growing through cooking?
Right. Among the cultivators, a group known as Spirit Chefs cultivate through cooking. His practice shared similarities with that of a Spirit Chef.
"Eldest Senior Sister has been too kind to me!" Lu Yang was deeply touched.
...
Eldest Senior Sister was cultivating in the Five Centers Toward Heaven pose in front of the dining table. Various visions manifested around her; large stars falling, all things rejuvenating, Thunder Tribulation transforming – it was as if all the fantastic scenes in the world were concentrated here.
Noticing Lu Yang's arrival, she slowly opened her eyes. All the visions instantly retreated back into her body, as if nothing had happened.
"Roasted Kui Ox?" Yun Zhi glanced at the dinner Lu Yang had painstakingly prepared. Without saying much, she gestured for him to join her.
Lu Yang sat at the dining table with a straight posture, nervously waiting for his Eldest Senior Sister to eat first.
Yun Zhi cut a slice, opened her mouth slightly, and tasted it lightly: "Not bad."
Only then did Lu Yang let his guarded heart relax.
Yun Zhi opened a storage space and handed Lu Yang a bottle of elixir. Lu Yang saw the words "Stomach Boosting Digestion Pill" on the bottle.
"This is an elixir made by Elixir Cauldron Peak. It aids digestion and absorption of food. Your tolerance to the spiritual energy contained in the roasted Kui Ox is still low, so eat slowly. Use the elixir as a supplement, and gradually absorb it."
As it turned out, Elixir Cauldron Peak has been established since the founding of the Seek Dao Sect. Their elixirs have always been very effective.
Lu Yang took a small bite and chewed lightly. The Kui Ox meat was gel-like, slid down to his stomach, and filled him up. The abundant spiritual energy surged rapidly to his cranial apertures. The fatigue from roasting the Kui Ox instantly vanished, and his whole body was rejuvenated.
Lu Yang's eyes brightened. He hurriedly took an elixir and sat in meditation to cultivate, feeling the waves of spiritual energy tides within his body.
The demon beast that could be slain by Yun Zhi naturally had a very high cultivation level.
Yun Zhi gracefully nibbled on the barbecue, slowly savoring the taste. There were now fewer things that could promote her cultivation level.
...
The seven elders were gathered in the pine forest of Sky Gate Mountain. Except for the Grand Elder and Yun Zhi, all high-ranking members of the Seek Dao Sect were present.
Even the elusive Sect Leader was there.
"You tell me how Old Nine, a fine gentleman, just had to get into trouble."
"Life is unpredictable, who can foresee the future?"
The seven elders discussed heatedly, making Daoist Buyu, who was meditating, want to duel in anger.
"I shouldn't get angry, I shouldn't get angry. I need to meditate for three days without breaking concentration," Daoist Buyu repeatedly reminded himself not to lose his temper.
The seven elders reveled in his misfortune. Old Nine had always made fun of them every day. Now they had a chance to mock him, naturally they had to take advantage of this opportunity, as it might not occur again in a lifetime!
"In my opinion, Old Nine is just being petty. Having a talented disciple is a good thing! How did it upset him to the point of a brain clot?"
"Nonsense, this is clearly a vegetative state!"
Unable to contain his anger anymore, Daoist Buyu roared, "Don't push it too far."
Who was the one who revealed his secret?!
Xiao Yun? No, I wouldn't stand a chance against her.
It must have been Lu Yang!
"Old Nine, you too have seen this day!" Uncle Ba gleefully laughed.
Uncle Ba had liked all kinds of plants and flowers in his youth. Back then, Daoist Buyu had told him about a method of cultivation involving immersing oneself in the earth, leaving only the head out, to perceive the spiritual energy of the earth and enhance cultivation.
Uncle Ba still felt embarrassed thinking about his foolish self at that time!
A lifelong disgrace!
"Taste my sword strike!" Daoist Buyu activated the Four Ultimate Sword Formation, attacking everyone. The seven elders instantly adopted defensive postures as thunder roared at the entrance of the abode, blocking the attack from the sword formation.
The seven elders sighed with relief. Yun Zhi's defense was still trustworthy.
"Haha, Old Nine, your swordsmanship has regressed, hasn't it? Your sword couldn't even leave a small cave, but if it were me, it would have come out long ago!" Uncle Ba laughed brazenly.
Daoist Buyu sneered, "If you have the guts, blast the cave open."
"Hmph, just a mere cave. What's so difficult about opening it!" Uncle Ba threw out a palm strike that made a big noise, hitting the entrance of the abode and got shattered by the thunder.
"Unexpected! Let's try again!" Uncle Ba, not deterred, tried again, but his attack was still dissolved by the thunder.
A cold sweat dripped from his forehead: "I have calculated the location of the Array Eye, but I have limited offensive means. I ask you to lend me a hand!"
The other six elders readily agreed.
All seven elders launched their attacks at the same time, attacking the Array Eye Uncle Ba had pointed out. Lightning and thunder flashed everywhere, filling the pine forest with chaos and rosiness. It was terrifying.
However, the seal on the abode seemed provoked and emitted a strong suction force, as if it could absorb everything in the world. Seeing this, the seven elders tried to run away with various means, but they couldn't resist the suction force and were sucked into the abode.
The seven elders: "..."
Daoist Buyu was deeply moved. Was this the true brotherly bond, sharing the blessings and facing challenges together?
...
Yun Zhi, who was eating, suddenly stopped. She noticed that the seal she had left for her master had been activated.
People in the Seek Dao Sect have various strange thoughts. Yun Zhi was worried that someone would forcefully break the seal, so she set it up so that if anyone forcefully broke it, not only would the seal revert but it would also suck that person into the abode and seal them too.
"There shouldn't be such people, right?" She mumbled, not completely sure.

chapters.title: Chapter 118 - 117 I am the Inner Demon_1
chapters.content:
Yun Zhi always felt that what she was worried about would happen.
After all, this is the Seek Dao Sect, anything can happen here.
Lu Yang entered a mysterious state where he felt every acupoint of his body brimming with spiritual energy, merging his circulation within with the spiritual energy outside. In every breath, the exchange of spiritual energy was completed.
His heart was more peaceful than it ever had been. He was assiduously cultivating the advantages brought by the Kui Ox, able to acutely feel his own body getting stronger.
"Let's see what's best." Yun Zhi glanced at Lu Yang, who was in the middle of cultivation, and didn't disturb him. She headed alone towards the pine forest, leaving the puppet to protect Lu Yang.
It was deep into the night, with only Yun Zhi and Lu Yang at Sky Gate Mountain. The place had an extraordinary tranquility with Yun Zhi walking among the mountains, like an immortal traversing the clouds.
Then Yun Zhi saw her noisy master and the elders trapped inside the abode.
Their voices could be heard from a great distance.
Yun Zhi sighed. Things that were meant to happen would always happen.
She entered the abode, contemplating whether she should let them out.
...
Inside the abode, the upper echelons of the Seek Dao Sect were assembled.
"I knew all my fellow senior brothers and sisters have kind hearts, they can't bear to see me alone in here, so they've specially come to keep me company." Daoist Buyu was very grateful, but he couldn't quite hide the upturn of his lips.
"Especially Old Two, on the surface he's trying to crack the array method, but he's actually just lonely, managed to pull everyone here to accompany me!"
Uncle Ba immediately felt the malicious gazes from his junior brothers and sisters, the pressure was enormous.
He maintained his calm and said: "Everyone, don't panic. This is just one of Junior Niece Yun Zhi's seals. It's not her personally. As long as we all work together, we can overcome this difficulty and break the seal!"
"Think about the 'Nine Sons of Seek Dao Sect' back then, think about all of us who hold high positions now. What difficulty can beat us?"
When they were young, they made names for themselves by fighting demons and monsters and made a resounding reputation in the Central Continent. "The Nine Sons of Seek Dao Sect" was the name they went by during that time.
In the narrow abode, the Nine Sons of Seek Dao Sect once again formed a united front.
"Old Nine, what should we do to leave this place?" Uncle Ba glared at Daoist Buyu. He had come to watch the show, only to become the show himself.
Daoist Buyu chuckled, thinking how could they leave easily when they had gone through so much trouble to accompany him?
He seriously said: "I won't be scared to be laughed at when I say this, Xiao Yun's cultivation level has long surpassed mine. She set up this seal to encourage me to practice diligently and break through my own limits."
"Therefore, to break the seal, we must break our own limits and surpass ourselves!"
The crowd realized the seriousness of the issue. It's easier said than done to surpass oneself.
Daoist Buyu already had ideas about how things would turn out: Firstly, everyone would step forward one by one to try to break the seal, but after being repelled, they would become despondent. At this moment, he would say that he had some insights, and he needed to meditate for three days.
After these three days, he would pretend to be in high spirits and execute a dazzling sword technique to break the seal, leaving his senior brothers and sisters astonished.
Perfect plan!
"If that's the case, then as the second elder brother, I'll step forward and try it first!" As the Grand Elder is not around, Uncle Ba who is the eldest in line, needs to set an example.
The others looked at Uncle Ba with anticipation. Uncle Ba felt that he probably wouldn't be able to break the seal and it would be very embarrassing. So he turned his head and said: "You should all move back a bit. I have a unique skill that I can't use in front of people."
Everyone obediently retreated to a deeper part of the cave where they couldn't see the entrance.
Seeing everyone moved away, Uncle Ba took a deep breath. He shook out a few seeds from his sleeve. Accompanying Uncle Ba's muttered spell, the seeds instantly turned into a robust vine which slammed into the abode's entrance. The vine was faintly glowing with bursts of thunder that were earth-shattering.
This was the very rare Purple Thunder Vine, which according to legend, was born from the thunder tribulation, and had the imprint of heaven and earth. It had the same might as the thunder tribulation.
After a round of deafening explosions, there was no change to the entrance of the cave. The seal hadn't moved at all.
"Huh?"
Through the thick smoke, Uncle Ba saw a beautiful silhouette which caused him to furrow his eyebrows.
When the smoke cleared, it revealed Yun Zhi's figure.
Uncle Ba, with his wealth of experience, instantly understood what was happening in front of him.
The figure must be his inner demon. Hadn't Old Nine mentioned it? In order to undo the seal, one must surpass oneself. To achieve that, one needs to defeat the inner demon.
"I thought I had let go, thinking that it's a good thing for the younger generation to be stronger. I didn't expect that I still haven't moved on!" Uncle Ba was full of fighting spirit.
With that thought, Uncle Ba didn't hesitate any longer, he exerted his full strength to attack Yun Zhi.
Yun Zhi initially wanted to come in to see what the elders were doing and consider whether to let them out. Who would have thought that the moment she approached the entrance, she'd be bombarded by Uncle Ba's fierce attack.
With no other choice, Yun Zhi retaliated. She extended her slender jade hand, the bell on her wrist jingling. With one palm, she sent Uncle Ba flying.
Uncle Ba was sent flying far away and was caught by the Third Elder and others.
"Second elder brother, what's going on?"
Uncle Ba coughed twice, a hint of shock in his eyes. He weakly raised one hand and pointed towards the entrance, stammering: "Be careful, Old Nine didn't lie to us. Niece Yun Zhi is extraordinarily gifted and has set up an inner demon seal. If we want to break the seal, we must resolve our inner demons!"
Daoist Buyu thought to himself in bewilderment, inner demon? What inner demon?
The Third Elder didn't believe in bad luck and stepped forward to give it a try. He met Yun Zhi again. He wasn't good at using his brain anyway so naturally, he would believe whatever Uncle Ba said.
At the Immortal Sect tournament, when Yun Zhi defeated the five sect leaders, she became an inner demon to the older generation. They wondered what they had done with their thousand years of cultivation. The Third Elder was no exception.
Seeing Yun Zhi, the Third Elder also took up a combat stance and went straight into a fight. Like the second elder, he was sent flying with a single palm.
"What an impressive inner demon!"
The Fourth Elder, Fifth Elder... Eighth Elder, all the elders took turns to try but were defeated by Yun Zhi.
Daoist Buyu walked puzzled to the entrance and seeing Yun Zhi, he finally realized, this wasn't an inner demon, it was clearly Xiao Yun herself guarding the entrance!
"Xiao Yun?" Daoist Buyu called out tentatively.
With an expressionless face, Yun Zhi responded: "I am the inner demon."
Without giving her master time to respond, she sent him flying with one palm, then turned and left the abode.
If they want to regard her as an inner demon and attack on sight, do they want to leave? They better stay put and meditate for three days.
...
Lu Yang slowly opened his eyes, sensing a warm flow in his body. He felt he was only one step away from breakthrough.
Yun Zhi was already back in her original position. Lu Yang saw Yun Zhi sitting opposite him, and he couldn't help feeling that Eldest Senior Sister seemed a little happy. He didn't know if it was an illusion.
"Eldest Senior Sister, is there something to be happy about?"
"No." Yun Zhi responded in her usual indifferent manner.

chapters.title: Chapter 119 - 118: The Awakening of Fairy Eternity_1
chapters.content:
"Did Dai Bufan give you some contribution points for your undercover mission?" Yun Zhi asked after dinner.
"Yes, quite a few." Lu Yang replied, beaming. Among his peers, he had the most contribution points.
"In three days, the sect will hold a market where most of the people will participate. If you're interested, you can go and check it out. You might encounter something you like."
Lu Yang nodded. He had already heard about the internal object swap within the sect, which took the form of a market. Previously, Yun Zhi had been insistent on him focusing on cultivation, hence not allowing him to attend.
Now that Lu Yang had established his foundation and made some progress in cultivation, he needed not interfere more than necessary.
Every three months, the Seek Dao Sect would host a market where items would be bartered, brought by contribution points, and it included everything from food to entertainment.
The sect's disciples would travel all around to complete their tasks, always encountering some local special products or novel items. Some decide to use them for themselves while others would take them to the market to exchange for items they needed.
"Also, Master is currently meditating. Don't go to him recently." Yun Zhi cautioned.
Lu Yang didn't understand why she said that, but since he hadn't planned to visit his Master and his Master would definitely appear in three days, he approved with "Oh". Regardless, following Senior Sister's instructions could never go wrong.
…
Three days later, as expected, the market took place. The Seek Dao Sect set up a fighting ring where disciples could freely duel.
The fighting ring was made from a special rock, indestructible. It was also enveloped in an Array Method to ensure that the effects of the fights would not impact the observers.
At this moment, two Senior Brothers at the Golden Core stage were fighting in the ring. Their golden cores were full and flawless, completely natural, making it a superior golden core that many in the outside world yearned for.
"Moon Slashing Chop!" A Golden Core stage Senior Brother shouted. His wide blade, like half a moon being driven by brute force, vertically chop down, causing Lu Yang's eyes to twitch.
If Master Chu had had the strength of this Senior Brother back then, their danger would have been great.
The other Golden Core stage Senior Brother would not be outdone. His body radiated a golden glow and converted a thin layer of it to cover his body: "Buddhist Golden Body!"
The other Senior Brother, who had learned the Buddhist Golden Body and had apparently perfected it, managed to bear the strike head-on.
Both employed their sword skills and magic skills so fabulously, and ease of changing skills got Lu Yang's undivided attention. He had a rare opportunity to wtiness a battle between top Golden Core stage powers.
In fact, Lu Yang had seen fights at even higher level before- the cultivation Great Powers battling against Immortals.
Unfortunately, Eldest Senior Sister was too aggressive and recently awakened Fairy Eternity was incapable of resisting, making it a one-sided fight and Lu Yang couldn't learn anything from it.
"Fairy Eternity really can't be depended on." Lu Yang sighed. If he could learn one or half of Eldest Senior Sister's skills, wouldn't he be invincible among his peers?
"Wait, it seems like Eldest Senior Sister taught me Shrinking Ground Into Inches and Samadhi True Fire."
"Kid, I advise you to watch your mouth! What do you mean 'I can't be depended on'!" A woman's voice sounded in Lu Yang's mind.
"Senior, you've woken up?" Lu Yang was surprised. Fairy Eternity had been asleep for several days, and she had finally awoken?
"The way you say 'Senior' is quite pleasant." Fairy Eternity spoke in a relaxed way, making Lu Yang felt as though she was stretching.
"Let me tell you, right now I'm far from my full strength and need to slowly recover. Yun Zhi can only beat me now because of this. Once I get my strength back, she won't even be able to defeat me with one hand." Fairy Eternity spoke fiercely; she had enjoyed a high reputation in ancient times. How could she not beat a youngster?
Having thought it over, Lu Yang felt like Fairy Eternity made a solid point, "I'll make sure to convey this to Eldest Senior Sister."
"Wait, let's not be hasty, we can talk things out." Fairy Eternity's tone softened instantly.
Lu Yang: "...Senior, are you reliable or not?"
He was supposed to be invincible having the essence of an ancient fairy in his body. Fortunes should have flowed to him constantly while he easily levelled up as if he was drinking water. No one at the same level could stand against him; even if he exceeded his own level, everything was still under his control.
However, Fairy Eternity's displayed such a feeling of unreliability that holding onto Eldest Senior Sister's thigh seemed much better.
"Humph. You think I'm who? I am Fairy Eternity Yellow Bean!"
"Why do I remember you referring to yourself as 'this seat' before?" Lu Yang still remembered the time when Fairy Eternity acted high and mighty.
Fairy Eternity paused and then said: "This seat is Fairy Eternity Yellow Bean... no wait, referring to oneself as 'this seat' is too awkward."
Fairy Eternity explained: "Mainly, I heard other people say that calling oneself 'this seat' seems very powerful. Having just awoken, my mind was not clear, so I wanted to see what it felt like. Now I find it too awkward and better to refer to myself as 'me'."
Lu Yang curiously asked, "Who did you hear this from?"
"From those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage or Immortals. It's very rare for those who've reached the highest realm of cultivation to resort to fighting. How can they know who is strong and who is weak without fighting? So someone started to speak in a very arrogant way to intimidate others."
"Everyone found this way of speaking very good, and sentences likes 'This seat has been born in response to the heavens', 'Whoever doesn't heed this fairy will be beheaded', 'How dare you, a mere mortal, defy a fairy' and 'This seat holds powerful forces in my body, do not force this seat to break the seal' started being used."
"I'm trying to remember who started it… ah right, it was Yingtian Immortal!"
"I felt the way they spoke was interesting at that time, so I had put down everything they said into a booklet called "Quotes of the Immortals". I have no idea where that book is now."
Lu Yang: "..."
He felt that he found the reason why Fairy Eternity had been backstabbed by others.
"Let me show you some of the skills of an Immortal, lest you think I've just muddled my way through." Fairy Eternity felt the need to display her actual strength to make Lu Yang perceive her in a high light and show respect for her.
"Let me gain control of your body and experience the feeling of defeating someone of a higher level.".
This was Seek Dao Sect's territory, Lu Yang wasn't afraid that Fairy Eternity would seize the opportunity to possess him, so he voluntarily relinquished control of his body.
At this moment, the fighting ring was empty. Fairy Eternity, controlling Lu's body, went up to the stage, and addressed the crowd: "Esteemed friends and brave warriors, I've had some insights into my cultivation today. Is there any fellow Golden Core Stage Early Junior here I can spar and learn from?"
"It's common among the geniuses of the ancient times to challenge everyone publicly and etch their legendary name with their fists, laying a strong foundation for their invincible future. Let me show you today. Learn well!" Fairy Eternity commented to Lu Yang.
"I'm in!" A bald Senior Brother jumped onto the stage, his whole body radiating a merit-golden light.
Fairy Eternity drew a sharp breath, and recognized the monk: he had a top quality golden core, a blessing merit, his body protected by an Arhat and had made small progress in the Immeasurable Golden Body. She was going to pit her head against that?
"Let's... let's switch."
The bald Senior Brother didn't take offence, he just hopped off the stage cheerfully whilst another Confucian cultivator Senior Brother hopped on.
The Confucian cultivator Senior Brother was dressed in grey robes, and held a bamboo book in his hand, wearing a composed smile.
Fairy Eternity froze again; he naturally had a Confucian temperament, was blessed by a Great Power, with a heavenly constitution in his mouth and held a treasure. How was she supposed to fight this?
"Let's switch again!" Fairy Eternity gritted her teeth and said.
"I'll go." As the Confucian cultivator Senior Brother yielded the stage, a homely and chubby Senior Brother hopped on.
At a glance, Fairy Eternity noticed the elder brother's golden core was ripe and of top quality. He was also protected by a good fortune merit, and a body of pure bloodline. His cultivation method was top tier, and it had absolutely no flaw.
Only then did Fairy Eternity realized she could not beat any of the Golden Core Stage cultivators present.

chapters.title: Chapter 120 - 119: Let You Witness the Vision of an Immortal!_1
chapters.content:
Fairy Eternity had great plans. Lu Yang, personally mentored by the Eldest Senior Sister, was exceptionally talented from the ancient times and battled against higher-level opponents with ease. She intended to use this opportunity to show off on the stage.
She discovered that Lu Yang could indeed fight at a higher level in ancient times, but that didn't mean he could do the same at the Seek Dao Sect.
What Fairy Eternity didn't know was that, as one of the Five Great Immortal Sects, the Seek Dao Sect was best known for its intricate magic spells and unparalleled creativity.
The Seek Dao Sect stood tall for twelve thousand years, not merely because of luck, but also due to its power.
By the time of the Nine Sons of the Seek Dao Sect, each son showcased their talents, each contributing to an increase in the power of the sect.
For instance, the Seventh Elder who governed over Elixir Cauldron Peak had made a hundred Foundation Establishment attempts in his youth, laying a solid foundation for future Seek Dao Sect disciples. Lu Yang also benefited from this.
The Seventh Elder suggested during the consummation period of his Foundation Establishment stage that there was no rule saying one could only possess a single Golden Core. Why not have Dual Golden Cores or Triple Golden Cores?
He began to deduct the appearance of Dual Golden Cores and Triple Golden Cores. It was relatively easy to calculate the Dual Golden Cores, since the two Golden Cores would attract and rotate around each other, following a rule. However, when it came to Triple Golden Cores, the Seventh Elder started to struggle.
The trajectory of the Triple Golden Cores was like chaotic fog, with no discernible pattern.
The Seventh Elder did not give up though. He enlisted the help of his master's Spiritual Sense to calculate the Eighteenth Step of Heavenly Elements formula and solved the problem.
However, the calculation demands for the rotation of Triple Golden Cores was too large for an individual in the Golden Core Stage to handle, so the idea of Triple Golden Cores ended without much fanfare.
Although unsuccessful, the new algorithm created during the decomposition process greatly helped the Seventh Elder.
After generations of research by the Seek Dao Sect, they had developed an extremely profound understanding of Golden Core formation. Establishing a good foundation during the early stages, following the process, forming a top-quality Golden Core was not difficult.
Any random disciple from the Seek Dao Sect striving in the outside world would be considered a prodigy. Although they couldn't claim to be invincible against others of the same stage, defeating ninety-nine percent of individuals of the same level wouldn't be a problem.
In the Spiritual Space, Lu Yang silently gazed at Fairy Eternity.
I understand the logic, but why is it that when Fairy Eternity is useless, I'm the one who ends up embarrassed?
Fairy Eternity committed a blunder before her time.
"Give me back my body!", Lu Yang regretted letting Fairy Eternity control his body.
Fairy Eternity decided to educate Lu Yang: "Young one, the path of cultivation is not all about fighting and killing. Isn't it right that power doesn't represent everything? Of course, it isn't. Cultivation implies insight, a test of discernment. The market of the Seek Dao Sect is full of treasures. Let me demonstrate to you what the discernment of an ancient immortal is like!"
Lu Yang chose to trust her once more.
"Come have a look, a Glaze Blue and White Vase retrieved from Relic Blessed Cave, an extremely rare magic artifact."
"Crouching Dragon Jade Pillow, a rare item from the south, which enables you to cultivate in your dreams. It's a really good item!"
"Small Rejuvenation Pill, ten contribution points each, buy three and get one free! The more you buy, the more you get, purchase a hundred and get a pill formula for free!"
"Renting out myself, a Golden Core Stage cultivator. I can accompany you on tasks, I can endure hardships, and I'm willing to work, a hundred and twenty contribution points a day!"
The Seek Dao Sect's marketplace held everything from selling Cave Heavens to treasures, to even selling themselves—everything one could possibly need.
Fairy Eternity, controlling Lu Yang's body knelt down, subconsciously smoothing down the back of her bum before she realized that Lu Yang wasn't wearing a skirt.
Lu Yang silently ridiculed her, expressing his novelty at the idea: I'm a man, why would I wear a skirt?
"How much are you selling this Glaze Blue and White Vase for?"
Fairy Eternity desired a vase. Inside the vase was a wilted flower, of an indistinguishable species. It was impossible to tell how long it had been since it died.
"Eight hundred and eighty-eight contribution points."
"That's expensive!"
"Young disciple, don't show off your wealth. This Glaze Blue and White Vase is a good treasure that I found in the Cave Heaven of a Divinity Transformation Stage cultivator. Look at this excellent craftsmanship, look at this durable material. It's absolutely worth it." The senior brother picked up the Glaze Blue and White Vase and threw it onto the ground. There wasn't a single chip on the vase.
"Apart from durability, does it have other qualities? Could it be the only advantage of this magic artifact is its durability?"
The senior brother was slightly embarrassed. This vase had been in his possession for quite a while, but he hadn't found its practical use. The selling point he advertises is merely its durability.
"I'll take it for a hundred contribution points and use it as a decoration."
"Your haggling is too harsh, disciple. I can go as low as seven hundred, but no further."
Fairy Eternity turned around and walked away.
"No need to rush off, four hundred. That's the lowest I can go!"
"Two hundred."
The senior brother gritted his teeth. The vase had been on display for quite a while without a buyer and he couldn't miss this opportunity with a potential buyer today.
"Deal!"
Fairy Eternity boasted to Lu Yang: "Did you see that? That's my discernment!"
Lu Yang was curious: "Does this vase hold some secret?"
Fairy Eternity cryptically shook her head: "The vase is indeed only known for its durability, but the secret isn't in the vase, it's in this wilted flower!"
"This flower contains a cultivation method, I'll decipher it for you!"
Fairy Eternity went to a corner of the marketplace, muttering ancient language to herself that seemed to be an old scripture. As she read, the wilted flower miraculously revived and bloomed. As the flower bloomed, characters began to float out of the painting.
Fairy Eternity, with an expected look, carefully interpreted the scripture and quickly came up with a result.
"This scripture is a cultivation method that can be practiced until the Refining the Void Stage. It's called 'Glaze Bone Refinement Technique'. The cultivation method consists of three stages: Unformable Bone, Vajra Bone, and Glaze Bone when completely cultivated. This is a fragment, only the Unformable Bone stage remains, which is from Qi Refinement Stage to Golden Core Stage."
"If you have the chance to enter a relic, you might find the latter half of the scripture!"
Fairy Eternity looked triumphant. A fragment of a cultivation method to Refining the Void Stage, could cause small and medium clans to perish in ancient times, countless people would go crazy for such cultivation.
Lu Yang remained silent for a while, then quietly recited a part of the scripture. Fairy Eternity was shocked, it was the end of the 'Glaze Bone Refinement Technique' fragment.
"I haven't translated it for you, how did you know? Can you understand the meaning of the characters?"
Lu Yang sighed and explain: "The Seek Dao Sect already retrieved this complete scripture from the relics long ago. I studied this scripture as a reference when I was researching cultivation techniques."
"My Eldest Senior Sister even revised several of the scripture's flaws, continued to write about the cultivation method, and deduced that the stage after Glaze Bone was the Indestructible Bone stage. Now, the 'Glaze Bone Refinement Technique' can be cultivated until peak Unification Stage."
"If you're interested, I can take you to see it. It's on the first floor of the Scripture Pavilion. It's free; you can look at it as you like."
Fairy Eternity: "..."
Why would your Seek Dao Sect put such a valuable scripture on the first floor of the Scripture Pavilion?
Lu Yang also had a question; he wanted to know if he could get a refund on those two hundred contribution points.

chapters.title: Chapter 121 - 120 - Ancient Oddities_1
chapters.content:
On the balance, Fairy Eternity's judgement was indeed sharp; this time was just an exception. If it were any other treasures, it wouldn't be wrong to consider it a fortunate encounter.
But Fairy Eternity didn't see it that way. This was her shame. As an Immortal, she fell flat on her face in front of a junior twice.
Don't I have any dignity as Yellow Bean?!
"Fairy, if you are free, then go back to sleep," suggested Lu Yang.
"Kid, don't assume this fairy only got this bit of ability!" Fairy Eternity rebelled and worked hard to prove herself useful.
"This fairy was among the top powers in ancient times, owning countless treasures during her lifetime. For instance, I buried numerous treasures, including Immortal treasures, at North Star. I still remember the exact location. If you can find it, establishing your sect and bestowing favors will be a piece of cake."
"But didn't the Ancient Nameless One refine all the stars? Where should I find North Star?"
Fairy Eternity contemplated for a moment before continuing, "This fairy can also guide your cultivation, which will lead to more accomplished results, exceed the progress of your peers, and your cultivation will be more stable and flawless."
"Thank you, Eldest Senior Sister can guide me."
"Does that girl have as much broad knowledge as I? The guidance I offer is definitely more comprehensive. She isn't capable of covering every aspect, there are holes everywhere. To use your foundation establishment as an example, your foundation establishment is... is quite perfect indeed."
"..."
Fairy Eternity confessed that, from her critical perspective, Lu Yang's foundation establishment could be called perfect, not a single problem could be found.
"The-The other thing is, as a female, I have meticulous thoughts and can help you pursue the girl you like!"
Lu Yang noticed Fairy Eternity was out of ideas, she simply abandoned her Immortal identity.
"No need, Eldest Senior Sister told me that cultivating should maintain abundant kidney essence."
"Superficial!" Fairy Eternity scoffed at the Eldest Senior Sister's viewpoint, "Have you not heard of a man from ancient times who, night after night, indulged in carnal pleasures with a hundred concubines, and his cultivation advanced by leaps and bounds because he practiced the Love-making Technique?"
"Do you want this cultivation technique? I have a few copies here, they suit you."
Lu Yang asked calmly, "First, tell me what happened to that guy who had a harem."
"He was violently torn apart by his concubines… However, that's not the point. The main point is how rapidly his cultivation improved!"
"His life was lost rapidly as well."
"I, the Fairy, have seen many magic skills, and can teach you how to counter them, such as the Great Divine Skill of Verbal Spell. Whatever he said could come true, it's the epitome of causality magic skills!"
"When I was in the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, I encountered an enemy who could use the Verbal Spell. He was my formidable rival, truly fearsome, and was blessed by heaven and earth. Everything he said could become reality. He was omnipotent."
"However, despite his strength, he ultimately couldn't defeat me!"
Lu Yang was shocked. The Verbal Spell seemed extremely hard to deal with, yet Fairy Eternity was able to defeat such an enemy. That was horrifying.
Then again, although Fairy Eternity was a bit unreliable, the ancient times were chaotic, there were competitions among geniuses, great powers fought to the death, and only five ascended to Immortality in the end. Fairy Eternity emerged as the victor in such circumstances that proved her exceptional talent.
"How did you defeat him?"
"I ambushed him at that time. It was probably good that he was too well protected by the Verbal Spell, and hadn't been hit much. He shouted, 'I'm dying of pain,' and then he died."
Lu Yang: "..."
What kind of waste is this?
"Unfortunately, the lineage of the Verbal Spell was severed upon his death."
Seeing Lu Yang struck with shock, Fairy Eternity's confidence greatly increased, "In addition to countering magic skills, I can also teach you skills. Ever heard of the Great Divine Skill Shrinking Ground into Inches? This is a rare spatial magic skill, even in the ancient times, it was barely learned at the Golden Core Stage. But under my guidance, you can learn it now."
"Shrinking Ground Into Inches?" Lu Yang was secretly delighted. Eldest Senior Sister shortened a lot of things during the teaching process. This time, with an Immortal teaching, there wouldn't be any problems.
Fairy Eternity noticed Lu Yang's interest in this Divine Ability and patiently taught, explaining each step of the magic skill clearly. Lu Yang pulled out his notebook and was nodding and taking notes like a diligent student.
After a while, Fairy Eternity looked at Lu Yang who was crawling around and shrinking his size in the dirt. She sank into deep self-doubt about her teaching skills.
Is there anything Fairy Eternity hasn't seen before?
She hadn't seen this before.
The good news was, Lu Yang's comprehension of the two magic skills Shrinking Ground and Into Inches was growing deeper. He could now shrink from the original three inches to one inch, and the speed of his casting also increased noticeably.
