"I can do more than just that spatial magic skill!" Fairy Eternity fully demonstrated the vast reserve of magic skills a fairy should possess.
"What is it?"
"Heaven and Earth in an Inch! The counterpart of Shrinking Ground into Inches!"
"When you master Heaven and Earth in an Inch, even the farthest distance will appear close. You only need to take one step to reach your destination!" Heaven and Earth in an Inch was a more difficult magic skill to master than Shrinking Ground into Inches. Initially, Fairy Eternity worried that Lu Yang wouldn't be able to learn it and would lose his confidence, so she didn't plan to teach it.
Now, she only worried that Lu Yang wouldn't learn it incorrectly!
"Heaven and Earth in an Inch is a skill that requires a high understanding of spatial comprehension. It is hard to learn this skill without establishing a foundation with other spatial skills. Do you have the confidence to learn it?"
Lu Yang thought and felt that he had learned the Cleaning Clothes Spell, which could summon clean clothes, a typical space magic skill.
So, Lu Yang nodded, and Fairy Eternity started to teach.
"When learning Heaven and Earth in an Inch, the process is basically the same as Shrinking Ground into Inches. First, you need to recite the spell words. Listen carefully..." Fairy Eternity recited a piece of obscure old language which was difficult to memorize.
But, at this point, Lu Yang had already created a Spiritual Space, and his spiritual sense was strong. In a short while, he memorized the old saying.
Fairy Eternity could see that Lu Yang was very talented in learning magic skills.
"Next, you have to have a map in your mind, and visualize yourself in a certain location on the map while reciting the charm."
"When your thought, spirit, and energy fuse together, you can teleport yourself to the destination with a thought."
Fairy Eternity warned, "But you must remember, the teleportation distance is related to your cultivation level, and as this is your first attempt, it is not wise to choose a distance that's too far."
Lu Yang, following Fairy Eternity's instruction, carefully tried it out. He simultaneously chanted the incantation and visualized Sky Gate Mountain in his mind. He then shouted, "Heaven and Earth in an Inch!"
And nothing happened.
Fairy Eternity continued to say, "Take a step! The meaning of Heaven and Earth in an Inch is that your destination is right within reach, just a step away, so you need to take one step!"
Only by stepping out would he know if he had succeeded.
Lu Yang took a step. The scenery under his feet changed. Both he and Fairy Eternity were overjoyed momentarily thinking he had succeeded!
"Wait, look at your feet!" Fairy Eternity shouted.
Looking down, Lu Yang broke into a cold sweat. Beneath him was a vast abyss, bottomless!
He turned his head to look behind him and noticed that there was a cliff behind him.
So, the function of Heaven and Earth in an Inch was to make him stand on the edge of the world?!
Lu Yang had no time to complain, his feet had nothing underneath, and he was hovering in the air.
He flipped his feet twice before falling into the abyss.

chapters.title: Chapter 122 - 121: Tomb_1
chapters.content:
"Heaven and Earth in an Inch", a widely known yet unmastered space spell, was close to the essence of spatial spells, and can only be learned by those who greatly enlighten or have a great opportunity.
Once mastered, one is free and easy, and no place in the vast world is beyond their reach.
"So you were thinking of landing on a cliff edge, how unique," Fairy Eternity marveled, impressed by the young man she had possessed, who had quickly mastered the difficult "Heaven and Earth in an Inch" spell.
"Unique, my foot! I thought of Sky Gate Mountain, not this place!" Lu Yang yelled, only human to be upset about unexpectedly appearing in midair above a cliff.
The most important thing was he was in free fall!
If he actually hit the ground, being flattened into an unrecognizable mass of flesh would be the least of his worries.
Fairy Eternity's face changed drastically at his words. If anything untoward happened to Lu Yang, the young girl would undoubtedly smash Fairy Eternity's spirit into a thousand pieces!
"Hurry, hurry, quickly let me take control of your body. I'll save you!"
In such a critical moment, Lu Yang could not pin his hopes on the unreliable Fairy Eternity. He was falling faster, and had to figure out a way to land safely.
Lu Yang took a deep breath, trying to calm himself. He couldn't see anything but darkness below, so there was no issue of being afraid of heights.
"Heaven and Earth in an Inch!"
Lu Yang prayed the newly learned spell could teleport him back, that would be the best outcome.
Lu Yang, who was in mid-fall, vanished and reappeared in the air above the cliff.
Lu Yang: "..."
It seemed he wasn't going back for the time being, it's okay, he had a second plan.
"Shrink!"
Lu Yang only shrinks his body, his clothes remain the same size. He grabbed the corners of his clothes, making himself a makeshift parachute, only then did he start to slow down.
"Phew—" Lu Yang breathed a sigh of relief.
Cliffs rose steeply on both sides, Lu Yang was swaying in the middle, his heart trembled with uncertainty, not knowing what awaited him.
"Look, the cliff ahead is protruding out, like a platform. Land there!" Fairy Eternity yelled.
"Where? I can't see it," Lu Yang frowned.
"It's on the left, on your left. I saw it before you because my spiritual sense has a longer range than yours!"
Lu Yang followed Fairy Eternity's instructions and landed on a platform.
Only when he finally stepped down did Lu Yang fully relax. He was scared out of his wits just now.
"Was the spell you used just now really 'Heaven and Earth in an Inch'?" Fairy Eternity looked at Lu Yang doubtfully. She had performed it many times, but had never encountered such a situation.
"That... should be... right?" Even Lu Yang wasn't sure. Right now, he had a sense of his own aptitude for casting spells. He knew that he couldn't blame everything on Eldest Senior Sister for teaching him the wrong way.
He himself also bore part of the responsibility.
"At least it's a proper spatial spell, and one that can teleport you out." Lu Yang consoled himself.
Moreover, the "Heaven and Earth in an Inch" that Lu Yang practiced has an advantage.
Cultivators of spatial spells fear opponents who also cultivate space spells the most. The opponent would calculate where you would teleport to and follow you relentlessly, which is very troublesome.
Lu Yang didn't need to worry about this. After all, even he didn't know where he would teleport himself to.
"So, where exactly are we?" Lu Yang looked up at the sky. The cliffs were steep, and all he could see was a slit of blue sky. He couldn't tell where he was.
He wondered how far away he was from the Seek Dao Sect, or whether this place was still in the Central Continent?
"It doesn't matter." Fairy Eternity encouraged Lu Yang, "As long as this fairy is here to ensure your safety, nothing will go wrong!"
Lu Yang felt it was better to rely on himself than depend on this fairy. At least he knows his own abilities clearly, unlike the fairy.
"Let's go inside and see. It seems to be a cave dwelling," Fairy Eternity proposed.
"Alright."
As soon as Lu Yang walked into the cave, he heard a "boom" behind him, it was the sound of two stone doors closing.
He didn't know what material the stone door was made of. Lu Yang gritted his teeth and used all his might without moving the doors an inch.
"Don't waste your energy," Fairy Eternity said with a serious expression. "This door was made by a great power. You, a cultivator at the Foundation Establishment Stage, can't budge it."
With the stone door closed, the originally dark cave was completely obscured.
Just as Lu Yang was about to use Three-flavored True Fire to provide some light, a faint light suddenly lit up on both sides.
"Night pearl?" Along the long corridor of the cavern on both sides were rows of glowing stones.
Lu Yang had heard of this method of arranging night pearls before, but where?
"Well, we have to press on."
Only Lu Yang's footsteps echoed through the empty corridor, giving it an eerie and strange atmosphere.
Lu Yang reached the end of the corridor. There stood two rows of majestic soldier figurines, each holding a magic instrument. They seemed to be guarding a stone tablet that reads: "Eternal Rest for the Departed".
Lu Yang finally realized where that sense of familiarity came from. This place was a grave!
"Eternal Rest for the Departed" was a common epitaph in human tombs.
Lu Yang was taken aback, never having expected to walk into a tomb.
"This... this is a grave?!" Fairy Eternity tried to sound composed, but Lu Yang heard a tremor and unease in her voice.
"It seems so," Lu Yang nodded solemnly, feeling he had gotten caught up in big trouble.
"Oh." Fairy Eternity swallowed hard, clearly nervous.
Looking at her, an absurd thought occurred to Lu Yang, "Fairy, you're not afraid of ghosts, are you?"
"Wh... who would be scared of such things? I am a proper immortal," Fairy Eternity's voice trembled.
"But you're shaking."
"Cold."
"Do you remember what you're called?"
"Fairy Eternity."
"With that title, you would be a significant figure in the tomb robbery field, like a Zombie Ancestor. What are you afraid of?"
Reflecting on the fairy who had previously vowed to protect him, Lu Yang felt that not believing in her lies was the best decision he made.
"There's no need to be scared. I just happen to have a book about tombs," Lu Yang pulled out a book named "Tomb Raiding Insights" from his Identity Jade. It was a gift given by Shang Zhongtian, the head of the Shang Family, as a thank you for killing the Skin-Peeling Ghost.
"I didn't expect it to be useful here."
"Ah, you have such a good thing." Fairy Eternity's eyes brightened. Fear of graves and ghosts comes from the unknown. With this book, their fear would diminish significantly.
"Open it and see what's written inside. Does it describe what kind of tomb this is?" Fairy Eternity urged.
Lu Yang had not read the book after he received it. It's not too late to read it now.
He opened the first page and began to read aloud:
"According to Article 532 of the Great Xia Criminal Law, any person or Qi Refinement cultivators who illegally excavate historical, artistic, or cultivation value tombs will be sentenced to not less than three years but not more than ten years in prison and also fined. If the circumstances are relatively minor, the sentence is not more than three years in prison with a fine."
"Foundation Establishment cultivators committing this crime would receive a doubled sentence compared to a Qi Refinement cultivator."
Lu Yang felt that this book seemed a bit unreliable.

chapters.title: Chapter 123 - 122: Appraisal of Magic Instrument_1
chapters.content:
"What on earth?" Fairy Eternity wore a confused expression, not knowing what the term "penal law" was all about.
In the ancient times, bloodline clans were at the hub, gathered in the form of tribes, and were subjected to "family laws" or "clan laws" for disciplinary matters.
Or they might gather in the form of sects and apply the "sect rules" to punish their disciples.
Back then, there was no concept of a state and hence, the idea of codified laws did not exist.
However, Fairy Eternity was not a stickler for the old ways. From the content, she could guess what penal laws were all about.
She, however, pondered over why the first page of Tomb Raiding Insights was filled with penal law content?
Lu Yang coughed twice, implying that everything was under control.
"Fairy, do not be puzzled, books of our age follow this style. It is always essential to understand the punishment before committing a crime."
Fairy Eternity looked at Lu Yang skeptically, but refrained from further questioning.
The second page was the index, very formal indeed. The book introduces various topics from zombie types, coffin specifications, tomb specifications, to common mechanisms.
Shang Zhongtian, an infamous Tomb Raider, indeed wrote some practical stuff, precisely what Lu Yang needed.
"Let me check the two rows of soldier statues...here it is. Sculptures of soldiers created from mud and wood are typically arranged in tombs as burial goods. Be aware, if you encounter these soldier statues at the entrance of the tomb, run away immediately - they might come to life!"
Lu Yang looked rigidly at the tall soldier statue which began to glow green from its eyes and reach out its hand towards him.
"I knew it, nothing good ever happens!"
Luckily, Lu Yang is agile, having worked in a barbecue place, he barely evaded the statue's attack.
More soldier statues came to life. Lu Yang wanted to retreat, but his escape route was blocked. He had no option but to run into the deeper part of the cave.
Looking back, Lu Yang saw the statues, their eyes emitting green light, fixated on him, but they didn't move further. It appeared their mobility was restricted within a specific range.
Deeper inside the cave was not a confined tunnel, but a wide-open space. The light was dim, and he could only make out blurry outlines.
Drip...drip...drip...
An intermittent dripping sound echoed from somewhere making the atmosphere even more tenser. Fairy Eternity, curled up, hoped and prayed that Lu Yang could overcome this ordeal and find an exit.
The enormous tomb, with only the sound of dripping water and Lu Yang's heartbeat, was terrifying, raising goosebumps.
Lu Yang was scared too. He firmly sealed his pores, preventing his hair from standing on end.
He lowered his gaze to the book, brushing up on tomb knowledge, "Zombies - a common creature encountered when tomb raiding. Divided into Purple Corpse, White Zombie, Green Zombie, Haired Zombie, Flying Zombie, Wandering Corpse, Lurking Zombie, and a Dry Corpse.
The Purple Corpse corresponds to Qi Refinement Stage, White Zombie corresponds to Foundation Establishment Stage, Green Zombie to Golden Core Stage...and so on."
"Zombies, inherently dark, are rendered inert only by the ultra-masculine True Fire."
Just as Lu Yang was engrossed in his reading, a hand tapped on his shoulder which he casually swatted, "Fairy, weren't you scared? How come you still have the mood to play a prank?"
Fairy Eternity whispered, as though she had disturbed something, "....how can I tap your shoulder from inside your Consciousness World?"
It dawned on Lu Yang; he quickly turned around. Behind him was a group of purple zombies, and the one who had tapped his shoulders was a White Zombie!
"Purple Corpse and White Zombie!"
Remembering what he had read in Tomb Raiding Insights, Lu Yang summoned the Three-flavored True Fire, burning the zombies.
True enough, zombies were afraid of True Fire and dared not take a step further when faced with a wall of true fire.
"Is this...True Fire? You can use True Fire?!" Fairy Eternity exclaimed in surprise. She had never heard of a cultivator at the Foundation Establishment Stage possessing True Fire.
"Moreover, the nature of the flames...they resemble the Samadhi True Fire!"
Lu Yang kept silent; instead, he wore a mysterious smile. Preserving his cool made him look extremely badass.
Having an ancient fairy gasp at his unique abilities was indeed pleasing.
If he were to spit out that "this is the authentic Three-flavored True Fire," wouldn't the puzzle be revealed to all?
Anyway, it was still a form of True Fire, pretty similar.
Lu Yang spit out the Three-flavored True Fire once again, which hovered over his shoulder. This allowed him to perceive his surroundings and intimidate the lurking zombies.
"Finding the exit in a tomb chamber requires expertise like holding the Eight-Diagram Disk, using motionless seals, while chanting the incantation 'Finding dragon, assigning gold, wrapping the mountain, every layer of wrap indicates obstacles' to find the exit."
Lu Yang pondered; he had neither the Eight-Diagram Disk nor did he know any motionless seals.
He took a small stick from his Identity Jade and sticking it into the ground, he started praying, "May the Eldest Senior Sister bless me, may the Eldest Senior Sister bless me."
The stick pointed towards the northeast direction.
Lu Yang was a cautious man; he was used to double-checking his math problems. Now being in such a dangerous situation, he had to be even more cautious.
He stuck the stick again into the ground, chanting, "May the Eldest Senior Sister bless me." The stick once again pointed towards the northeast.
He was sure now, the exit was in the northeast direction.
An answer after double-checking couldn't be wrong.
"Is this a tomb chamber?" Following the stick's hint, Lu Yang found a chamber, although he wasn't sure if it was the main or secondary one.
"Let's see the book... the main difference between the main and secondary chambers can be determined based on the local Feng Shui. It needs to be divined with the Eight Diagram Disk and turtle shells. The specific method is as follows... "
While reading this, Lu Yang was confused. The methods mentioned in the book were useless to him.
"This is the main chamber," affirmed Fairy Eternity.
"How do you know?" Lu Yang was surprised that Fairy Eternity was finally proving useful.
"There were two characters 'main chamber' written at the entrance of the chamber."
Lu Yang peered out of the door; indeed, the tomb had thoughtfully marked 'main chamber.'
Was this for the zombies to read?
"Look, there are plenty of burial goods in the chamber, all of them treasures!" shouted Fairy Eternity.
Lu Yang buried his gaze and indeed, his vision was filled with dazzling treasures. It seemed the deceased was affluent when alive, although he wondered why they chose this particular place for the tomb.
"Huh? Is the book glowing?" Lu Yang exclaimed while looking at Tomb Raiding Insights, "Has this book been refined?"
The light from the book pointed towards a jade burial object. The light scanned the jade up and down, seemingly appraising its value.
Lu Yang froze, his heart throbbing. Could it be that the patriarch of the Shang Family handed him a fantastic appraisal magic instrument?
Soon, the book's glow enveloped the jade burial object, and six big characters emerged on the light beam:
"Five years of fixed-term imprisonment."
The glow changed, enveloping another burial item, a sturdy bronze short sword. The words in the light beam changed again:
"Seven years of fixed-term imprisonment."
Lu Yang: "..."
What on earth is this book that the patriarch of the Shang Family has given me?
Fairy Eternity clicked her tongue in admiration. Is this a trendy book of the current times? Indeed enlightening.

chapters.title: Chapter 124 - 123 Tomb Owner_1
chapters.content:
Just when the screen was about to display "Life imprisonment", Lu Yang slammed shut his copy of Tomb Raiding Tips, causing the screen blinking with the prison term to disappear.
This time around, Lu Yang couldn't use "It's a characteristic of the era" as an excuse to explain. The function of this book was simply outrageous, and even more unbelievably, it's outrageousness came with a tinge of reasonableness which made it even more unreasonable.
Luckily, Fairy Eternity's interest came and went quickly. She soon became attracted to the burial items. The ancient era was too far distant from the present, and the specifications and styles of burial items had undergone changes.
For example, in the ancient era, people believed they would go to Nine Nether after death. To maintain their prestige in the Nine Nether as they did in life, they needed to use humans as burial objects. When later generations opened the tombs of great powers from the ancient era, they often saw numerous human bones as burial objects.
Nowadays, people have become civilized and have replaced human figures with terracotta soldiers.
This reminded Fairy Eternity of something: "I remember that Yingtian Immortal was originally a burial object of some old fellow. Luckily, Yingtian Immortal was fortunate. He used the technique of feigning death to deceive the old fellow and to be brought alive into the tomb."
"After entering the tomb, he lifted his feigned death spell. He harvested recklessly in the tomb, obtaining a large number of herbs and magic artifacts. The old fellow firmly believed that he would be reincarnated, so he stored several rare and precious earthly treasures which could improve one's constitution in the tomb. All these wound up benefitting Yingtian Immortal."
"Taking the opportunity to cleanse his marrow, change his fate, and improve his constitution, he then escaped from the tomb. Afterwards, he had a series of fortunate encounters, his foundations became stronger, his reputation gradually rose, and among the young generation, he showed his mettle. He became one of the protagonists of the Great Era and barely became qualified to be my opponent."
Originally, Lu Yang thought Yingtian Immortal was a highly powerful existence. After hearing that Yingtian Immortal was barely qualified to be Fairy Eternity's opponent, he promptly elevated him to the same level as Fairy Eternity.
"Are there ranks among immortals? Such as Immortal, heavenly immortal, and so on?" Lu Yang asked.
Fairy Eternity knew that Lu Yang had misunderstood and explained, "The title of Yingtian Immortal is Yingtian. His status is that of an immortal, so we address him as Yingtian Immortal."
"Yingtian Immortal believes that he was born in accordance with heaven, complies with the mandate of heaven, and is the protagonist of heaven and earth. He possesses great Momentum. Thus, he self-proclaimed his title as Yingtian."
"Immortality has no levels. Everyone's Dao Fruit is different, it's challenging to rank them. How can there be classes?"
The words of Fairy Eternity let Lu Yang come to understand something - Fairy Eternity might be somewhat useful after all.
It's a pity that the Central Continent doesn't test history, or Lu Yang could also score full marks.
Or maybe, Lu Yang's performance was not up to scratch. The examiner would say that all his answers were wrong. After his years of research, the examiner was sure how the ancient era should have been. People around would mock Lu Yang's ignorance and dare to question the examiner's answers. How presumptuous he was!
At this juncture, Lu Yang would reveal his identity as the host of Fairy Eternity and humiliate the examiner in front of everyone. Complete silence would ensue and no one would dare to question Lu Yang's views on the ancient era.
The thought of it felt satisfying.
Lu Yang had even thought of the scene where he would display his arrogance, but he just didn't have a place to show it off.
Fairy Eternity did not try to elaborate on ancient events. Instead, she became fascinated with the various burial objects.
Lu Yang remained vigilant and continued to learn about tomb raiding. "As a tomb raider, one must stay vigilant at all times. Even if you have found the main room and located the burial objects, you cannot let your guard down. Some tomb owners greatly despise being disturbed and would set cruel traps in the main room. You must be careful..."
"Young man, walk forward and have a look. Are these things from your era? They seem interesting." Fairy Eternity excitedly urged Lu Yang, seemingly having spotted something.
Lu Yang took a step forward and felt as if he had stepped on something that seemed to be a sinking slab of stone.
In an instant, Lu Yang's forehead was covered in cold sweat. He realized that he had stepped on a trap. What would it be, a poisonous needle shooting up from the ground, or a volley of arrows shooting out of the wall?
There was no time for Lu Yang to mull over it. He relied on his instincts to leap backward, trying to dodge the hidden weapons.
When the mechanism was triggered, the Night Pearl above him suddenly burst out with a brightness akin to a small sun. The entire main room was brightly lit, its previous dark and terrifying atmosphere completely gone.
Lu Yang waited for a while but nothing else happened. His eye twitched: "So, it was just turning on the light?"
"What does 'turning on the light' mean?" Fairy Eternity, not having heard the term before, asked.
"Nothing much."
Lu Yang felt more and more that this tomb was emitting an air of baffling strangeness. He could understand why it was built into the cliff - it was a way to deter robbers. But when you emblazon "Main Room" at the entrance and you could still turn on the lights inside the room, wouldn't that be going overboard?
Would this be a normal feature of a grave?
At the very least, it was not mentioned in Tomb Raiding Tips.
However, Tomb Raiding Tips did have a warning: The more it goes against common sense, the more dangerous it is.
"There's no need to worry, with this immortal here, nothing unexpected will happen!" After the light was turned on, Fairy Eternity's courage clearly increased, and she was speaking with newfound confidence.
The Night Pearl lit up the tomb like daylight. Even if ghosts popped out, Fairy Eternity would dare to go over and slap them a couple of times to let them know who the real ghost was!
I, a prestigious immortal, am afraid of ghosts?
"That book to your left seems interesting, take a look." she pointed out.
Lu Yang picked up the book on his left and softly read out the title: "'Tomb Robbing Notes'?"
"Move your thumb, there's another word under it." Fairy Eternity added.
Lu Yang moved his thumb to reveal the full title: "'Anti-Tomb Robbing Notes'
Lu Yang: "..."
He cautiously packed up his copy of 'Tomb Raiding Tips', afraid that putting the two books together might trigger some strange reaction.
Flipping through the pages, Lu Yang found that, as its title suggested, it was full of ways to reasonably set up a tomb that tomb robbers would not visit. It even had countermeasures for common tomb raiding methods. It was pro-level.
As the saying goes, "As high as the demons may rise, the Dao rises higher." It's a rule of nature.
Lu Yang felt that if he learned both 'Tomb Raiding Tips' and 'Anti-Tomb Robbing Notes', there wouldn't be a tomb in the world that he couldn't rob.
He lifted his eyes from the book, his interest piqued by the tombstone on his right. From the inscription on the tombstone, he should be able to discern the identity of the tomb owner.
He was curious to see who had constructed such a fantastical tomb.
Lu Yang tilted his head to read the inscription on the stone tablet. His hair stood on end, a chill running down his spine. He jumped backward in fright.
The tablet read: "Here lies Qin Jiunian."
"Who's Qin Jiunian, and why are you so startled?" Fairy Eternity was puzzled.
Lu Yang's voice trembled: "Qin Jiunian... he's the current Grand Elder of Seek Dao Sect!"
Could it be a case of people having the same name, or had the Grand Elder met his end? If the Grand Elder had fallen, then who was the one moving around in Seek Dao Sect? An impersonator? And what was their purpose?
"The Grand Elder is known for his secretive ways, always letting Senior Brother Dai Bufan preside over the Task Hall in his stead. Could it be that he was worried about being discovered, and deliberately limited his interactions with others?"
Question after question surged up, the answers remaining elusive for the time being.
Just then, the coffin shook. It seemed as though something was attempting to break free and emerge!

chapters.title: Chapter 125 - 124 Grand Elder_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang was greatly shocked, his heart pounding fiercely. The coffin in the main chamber was a stone one, engraved with intricate and primitive patterns of the sun, moon, stars, and floral elements, of which era it was cast was unknown. Judging by its grandeur, it undoubtedly entombed an important figure!
The Grand Elder of Seek Dao Sect fit the criteria of an "important figure" perfectly.
"Is the Grand Elder of Seek Dao Sect really buried inside?!" Lu Yang felt as if facing a formidable enemy, pondering whether he had inadvertently activated some mechanism causing the elder to resurrect, or if Fairy Eternity's Dao Fruit had breathed life into the corpse, or was there some other unknown reason?
As the coffin lid slowly rose, an elderly man with a long beard sat up from the coffin. Lu Yang's pupils contracted at the sight, it was indeed the Grand Elder of the Seek Dao Sect!
The Grand Elder had once visited Sky Gate Mountain to consult Eldest Senior Sister about some matters, and Lu Yang had seen him then.
Lu Yang was contemplating whether to perform Eldest Sister's Form Boxing to summon her, or use Heaven and Earth in an Inch again to teleport himself into the air above the cliff.
The Grand Elder's voice was full of vicissitudes, eyes filled with bewilderment as he looked at Lu Yang: "Lu Yang? How did you end up here?"
Caught off guard, Lu Yang speculated that the Seek Dao Sect had an imposter Grand Elder, and the man in front of him was the real one. As he had only met the fake one, how could this elder recognize him?
"Grand Elder, do you know me?" Lu Yang asked carefully.
Fairy Eternity pouted within the spiritual space; Lu Yang had never shown her this level of respect.
She was an immortal! Yet this lad, Lu Yang, lacked reverence for her!
The Grand Elder expressed bewilderment at Lu Yang's question: "Of course, I know you. Aren't you Lu Yang, Old Nine's disciple, the one with the Sword Spirit Root? I watched you through the Water Mirror when you participated in the entrance test for Seek Dao Sect."
"However, I want to ask you, what are you doing here disturbing my sleep?"
"Sleep... Sleep?" Lu Yang was dumbfounded. Who sleeps in a coffin under ordinary circumstances?
The Grand Elder let out a big yawn, tears glistening in the corners of his eyes, looking freshly awakened: "I was just taking a brief nap because I was so weary from building a tomb. Ah, I am getting old. I wouldn't have felt this tired in the past. One can't resist aging, you know. Speaking of which, I am already three thousand years old."
"Building a tomb?" Lu Yang's eyes widened. He knew that cultivators could sense when the end of their life was approaching and would therefore prepare their will, make arrangements for their passing, and build their tomb.
Thinking of the Grand Elder's contributions to the Seek Dao Sect, Lu Yang felt heavy-hearted: "Are you about to... about to..."
He found himself unable to complete his sentence, no matter how hard he tried.
The Grand Elder nodded: "Yes, indeed. I need to think about what to do after retirement. Dai Bufan says that I can still live for another five thousand years after retirement. I should find myself some hobbies. After giving it some thought, I found that building tombs is a good choice, given that it's something I'll eventually need."
Lu Yang: "..."
Only now did he realize due to the unexpected circumstances that had interrupted his connected thought process: those in the Unification realm could live at least eight thousand years. Someone like the Grand Elder, with profound cultivation levels, would definitely live longer.
Can I get my sympathy back?!
"You're building your tomb so early?" Lu Yang commented, thinking the elder's hobby was rather unusual.
"What's wrong with that? I heard that in some places, ordinary people borrow a large sum of money from the bank to buy a house, and they spend their whole life working hard to repay it."
"If ordinary people can toil their entire life for a house, naturally, I can labor in the second half of my life for a tomb."
Rendered speechless by the Grand Elder's reasoning, Lu Yang could say nothing.
"I didn't just build this tomb. There are other tombs I've already finished in different places. This place is just a prototype, and I haven't even prepared the zombies yet. So I filled it with some Haired Zombies for atmosphere."
"By the way, I specifically chose to build a tomb on a cliff of our Seek Dao Sect. How did you find your way here?"
Lu Yang remained silent, not very keen on recalling the process.
So, this place is still within the Seek Dao Sect. It seems that he wasn't teleported very far.
Fairy Eternity said languidly: "Of course, you can't teleport very far. The teleportation distance is closely related to your Realm. You are just at the Foundation Establishment Stage. How far do you think you can go? Do you really think you can reach the sky?"
The Grand Elder was unaware of Fairy Eternity's existence.
"So, is it because of this that you are frequently not in the Task Hall?"
"I entrusted the affairs to Little Dai and started living my retirement life ahead of time."
It sounded reasonable.
Seeing that Lu Yang didn't wish to elaborate on how he ended up at the tomb, the Grand Elder asked: "Do you need me to take you back?"
Lu Yang nodded hastily; this was something he could only wish for.
The Grand Elder got out of the coffin, tapped Lu Yang, and Lu Yang found himself enveloped by a large bubble. The Grand Elder flew out of the tomb with his hands behind him, and Lu Yang, inside bubble, followed him.
With speed as swift as thunder, the Grand Elder left the cliff in a blink of an eye and Lu Yang finally understood why he was enveloped in a bubble; his body wouldn't be able to withstand the Grand Elder's speed.
Departing from the cliff, before his eyes, lay an endless grassland. Lush and green, with sheep grazing on tender grass and various wild demon beasts around. The terrifying emanations from the demon beasts made Lu Yang's heart palpitate.
This must be the dangerous place Eldest Senior Sister had mentioned when he entered the Sect: "there exist some perilous places, where those with insufficient cultivation levels would perish."
Given his cultivation level, there was no way he could safely fall off the cliff... why did that sound so strange?
The Grand Elder flew, carrying Lu Yang along. Because they were moving so fast, Lu Yang couldn't see the scenery below and hence he didn't feel afraid of the height.
During the flight, Lu Yang was a bit apprehensive. Given the Grand Elder's flying speed, they'd been flying for some time now and still hadn't arrived at Sky Gate Mountain. How far had he been teleported?
Just as Lu Yang was lost in thought, the Grand Elder stopped. Lu Yang discovered that they had already reached Sky Gate Mountain.
Having helped Lu Yang descend, the Grand Elder left.
The Grand Elder had encountered a difficult problem while sleeping in his coffin and wanted to ask his junior brothers for their opinions.
He went to the medicine garden, the Second Elder wasn't there. He went to the Body Refinement Peak, the Third Elder wasn't there. He also went to Junzi Peak, and even the Fourth Elder was not there.
"Where are they?" The Grand Elder was puzzled. He didn't recall the second, third, and fourth Elders as ones who liked to run around. They were usually easy to locate. But today, he couldn't find any of them.
Ji Hongwen, the oldest disciple of the Fourth Elder, seeing the Grand Elder looking for his master, said: "I think the master has found the whereabouts of the Sect Leader and has gone to Sky Gate Mountain with the Second Elder."
"Old Nine's whereabouts? Sky Gate Mountain?" The Grand Elder never imagined he would have to return to Sky Gate Mountain so soon.
When he reached Sky Gate Mountain, he asked Lu Yang if he knew the whereabouts of Daoist Buyu, and Lu Yang pointed him in the right direction. He managed to find Daoist Buyu and six of his junior brothers and a junior sister, who were all having a hot pot gathering in the pine forest.
Seeing the Grand Elder standing outside the Abode, Daoist Buyu enthusiastically waved: "We brothers haven't had a gathering in a long time. Just as we were about to have hot pot together, there you are, eldest brother."
"Eldest Brother, come in quickly. We're just waiting for you."
The Grand Elder looked at Daoist Buyu, full of warmth, with suspicion.

chapters.title: Chapter 126 - 125 Gather all Nine Sons of Seek Dao Sect_1
chapters.content:
In the Grand Elder's impression, if Daoist Buyu was this enthusiastic, it certainly meant that there was some kind of scheme.
He became cautious.
The Grand Elder believed Daoist Buyu had a reason to harm him, Daoist Buyu was taken to the mountain by Old Three when he was still a baby, becoming the youngest disciple. As no one from the master to the senior brothers and sisters took care of the baby, he gradually figured it out on his own.
The Grand Elder was proficient in the Dream Spell. When Daoist Buyu was still a child and restless, unable to sleep, he would use the Dream Spell to lull Daoist Buyu into a deep sleep.
When Daoist Buyu grew up to the point of cultivation, he was always sleepy during his training. The Grand Elder would use the Dream Spell to scare him awake. Perhaps because he was too terrified, to this day Daoist Buyu still has a psychological shadow.
Seeing the Grand Elder cautious, the seven Elders also called out together, "Eldest Senior Brother, come in quickly, we are just missing you for our hot pot."
We can't be the only ones to suffer, today no matter what, we must gather all nine members of the Seek Dao Sect!
Eight people at the entrance of the Abode were smiling and welcoming the Grand Elder, but they did not dare to cross the threshold. To outsiders, this scene looked extremely strange.
In the Grand Elder's impression, the seven Junior Brothers and Sisters have never been so enthusiastic.
Two thousand years of experience had made him extremely seasoned, he quickly made a judgement - this was an illusion!
He abruptly bit his tongue.
The Grand Elder tried to break the illusion by shedding blood from his tongue, but nothing changed.
Could it not be an illusion?
He remembered that Lu Yang said that Old Nine had been sealed in the Abode by Yun Zhi but the question was, how were Old Two to Old Eight sealed?
"How were you sealed?"
Eighth Elder explained seriously: "Eldest Senior Brother, it happened like this, when we heard that Old Nine had been sealed by Yun Zhi, we immediately came to investigate. Old Nine said that the seal can't trap the clever ones, and we seven thought we were clever and will not be trapped by the seal, so we went in one after another to try, and as you can see, we ended up like this."
Grand Elder raised an eyebrow: "Is it that magical? Let me try."
The Grand elder walked in the Abode, everyone cheered.
What Eighth Elder said wasn't wrong, who would voluntarily allow themselves to be sealed if they were clever people?
As of now, all the nine members of the Seek Dao Sect are trapped, good news indeed.
The nine of them sat around the hot pot, the entire Abode was filled with steam, like an Immortal Realm filled with the scent of hot pot.
The ingredients for the hot pot were all provided by Third Elder. As a Body Cultivator, he needed to frequently eat heavenly treasures and Demon Beast meat to replenish his body's consumption.
When the Grand Elder finally understood the reason of why they were all in this situation, his face turned black.
So you eight were trapped in here, not thinking about asking for help, just thinking about how to pull others in with you?
Uncle Ba stepped forward: "Of course we wanted to get out, but Old Nine said that the only way to do so was to defeat our Inner Demons, but... the Inner Demons are too strong, none of us were able to defeat them."
"So we joined forces and thought of some other solutions."
"Like Old Three, he suggested digging a tunnel with a spoon."
"Like Old Four, he suggested shouting for help and calling Martial nephew Yun Zhi over."
"Like Old Five, he suggested refining the spoon into a magic artifact and then digging a tunnel."
"Like Old Six, she..."
The Grand Elder interrupted the planned escape of the nine members of the Seek Dao Sect: "How come I heard Lu Yang say that you just had to meditate honestly for three days, and the seal would be lifted. He also said that he told Old Nine three days ago, and the seal should have been lifted by now."
The Grand Elder was not a fool, he was confident that he didn't walk in here because he was deceived, but because he knew the real way to leave.
Eight cold glances broodingly focused on Daoist Buyu.
Daoist Buyu calmly said: "I have made a lot of contributions to the Sect, before you make a move, can you allow me to write a suicide note first?"
...
Lu Yang, who was meditating, felt the Sky Gate Mountain tremble a bit. He was surprised and didn't know what had happened.
Is there someone daring enough to make a move on Sky Gate Mountain?
Fortunately, the Sky Gate Mountain only shook for a moment and then returned to its usual calmness, so Lu Yang didn't think much of it. He entered the isolation Array Method left by the Eldest Senior Sister, adjusted his breath, and concentrated on breaking through to the early stage of Foundation Establishment.
Eldest Senior Sister was not there to guard him, breaking through to the mid-stage of Foundation Establishment was a matter of course for Lu Yang, there would be no accidents, and there was no need for a protector.
A moment later, he had reached the peak of his energy levels, his Lingtai was clear and bright. He ran the "Mind Seeing Method", drawing in the Spiritual Energy from his surroundings, as an enormous amount of Spiritual Energy continuously cleansed his body.
Ordinary people, when breaking through Foundation Establishment, would use the opportunity to cleanse their marrow, renew their body, and patch up the scars left by cultivation and fighting.
But for Lu Yang, there was no need for this step at all!
He had completed thorough marrow cleansing during the Qi Refinement period, there were no more impurities to exclude!
After Foundation Establishment, Lu Yang's path of cultivation would keep his body pure at all times, regardless of what he ate or absorbed, it would leave the essence and exclude the dross.
The "Mind Seeing Method" didn't just clear the mind, but also the body!
After reaching the Foundation Establishment Stage, a vortex of liquefied spiritual essence would form at the Dantian area of the cultivator.
A raging heat pulsated from within Lu Yang's Dantian. When he looked inward, he could clearly sense the increasingly strong vortex in his Dantian, which engorged the External Spiritual Energy and released an even purer Spiritual Energy that suited him.
He ran the Great Heavenly Cycle, as the refined Spiritual Energy was circulating within his body, strengthening every part of it, leaving no detail overlooked.
The vortex spun faster and faster, the Spiritual Energy flowed throughout his body at an inconceivable speed, and finally, it felt like a barrier was forcefully broken through by the Spiritual Energy.
Lu Yang opened his eyes, their gaze bright and clear.
Mid-stage of Foundation Establishment, achieved.
The marionette outside the Array Method, seeing that Lu Yang had successfully advanced to the mid-stage of Foundation Establishment, and that his realm was stable and had no hidden danger, got up and left.
"There is still one thing left undone." Lu Yang remembered a sentence from the "Foundation Establishment Manual".
The "Foundation Establishment Manual" was a cultivation guide left by Seventh Elder that has been supplemented by various Senior Brothers and Sisters, which clear listed the various issues that one would likely encounter at the Foundation Establishment Stage, with nothing omitted.
Lu Yang gathered Spiritual Energy in his right hand, gently slapped his lower right abdomen, and forcefully spat out a piece of meat. The piece of meat was bloody, appearing to be part of Lu Yang's body.
Lu Yang unleashed a Sword Qi, smashing the piece of meat into tiny fragments.
"What is this?" Fairy Eternity, watching Lu Yang's progress in her mind, was afraid to speak for fear of distracting him and disrupting the promotion process. Now that the promotion to the mid-stage of Foundation Establishment was successful, she finally felt free to speak.
She was dead bored.
Lu Yang explained earnestly, "I don't know if Fairy has heard the saying that you shouldn't undertake vigorous exercise after meals. Vigorous exercise can cause severe stomach pain, and in severe cases, one might roll on the ground in agony, break out in sweat, which seriously affects cultivation."
"Our Senior Brothers and Sisters of the Seek Dao Sect, after research, found out that by cutting off a small piece of unneeded flesh during the mid-stage of Foundation Establishment, one can avoid this situation and move freely after meals."
"So you just now were..."
"Removing the appendix."
Fairy Eternity, "..."
She was a bit behind in understanding the thought processes of today's cultivators.

chapters.title: Chapter 127 - 126: The Green Peak Sword's Small Ornament_1
chapters.content:
Since Fairy Eternity's revival, she has undergone one setback after another. First, she attempted to intimidate Lu Yang, only to be beaten up by Yun Zhi. After that, her efforts to prove her usefulness by trying to control Lu Yang's cross-tier combat ended in a lecture.
Now, she realizes that sticking to past experiences doesn't work. Modern cultivators' way of thinking is much more active than it was in ancient times, and they collaborate to accumulate experiences across various realms of cultivation.
In ancient times, such a thing would be unthinkable. There would be open confrontations and hidden schemes among Senior Brothers, vying for resources. There was no way that sects or tribes would unconditionally open up their cultivation experiences.
Oh, there was an exception - the Ancient Barbarian Tribe. They did enjoy discussing their cultivation experiences within the tribe.
Lu Yang stretched his body, rising to perform a set of radio calisthenics, flexing his muscles. The sound of his cracking joints brought him an inexplicable comfort.
"Where are you going?"
"To Hundred Refinement Peak, to order a weapon."
Arriving at Hundred Refinement Peak, Lu Yang saw the cafeteria was as bustling as always.
Fairy Eternity was surprised. "Huh, the food in Seek Dao Sect is pretty good, with so many disciples coming to buy."
Lu Yang nodded, "The quality of the meals is indeed good."
However, his purpose was not the cafeteria, but Hundred Refinement Hall located halfway up the mountain.
The cafeteria sells commonly-used weapons—good ones, but not necessarily suited to everyone.
So, Hundred Refinement Hall was established where master weapon smiths take up residence, specializing in selling custom-made weapons.
"You are... Senior Brother Lu Yang?" A surprised voice at the entrance of Hundred Refinement Hall called out to Lu Yang.
Lu Yang recognized the speaker, "You are Li Haoran, from the same batch as me!"
In Lu Yang's batch, there were three people with Single Spiritual Roots: Lu Yang with his Sword Spirit Root, Meng Jingzhou with Single Body Spiritual Root, and Li Haoran with Fire Spirit Root.
"I heard from Senior Sister Zhou LuLu over a month ago that you were taking a bath in lava. Finally got out?"
Speaking of bathing in lava, Li Haoran's face was gloomy, as though recalling some unpleasant experiences.
"Finally met the criteria set by the master, managed to swim in lava, learned to eat Fire Lizards raw and successfully established my foundation. I just got out. I was planning to go find my master and ask what arrangements he had next, but Senior Sister Zhou LuLu said she hadn't seen him in three days, so I have no idea where he went."
Lu Yang wondered if Fifth Elder and his master were very close, accompanying his master in meditation?
"After Foundation Establishment, you need to head to the Task Hall to receive sect tasks."
Li Haoran nodded; he had heard the Senior Brothers mention this.
"Do you know the way? I can accompany you." Since Li Haoran addressed him as Senior Brother, Lu Yang felt obliged to fulfill his responsibilities as such.
"Then, thank you, Senior Brother."
On their way to the Task Hall, Lu Yang learned about Li Haoran's background. Both his parents were cultivators with cultivation levels only at the Foundation Establishment Stage. They were overjoyed to learn that Li Haoran had Fire Spirit Root and spoiled him accordingly.
This led to Li Haoran's arrogance and hot temper.
For example, during the climb up Wenxin Mountain, Li Haoran lacked resolve; many with lesser qualifications ascended to the fiftieth step before him. It was only at the end that he finally succeeded.
Lu Yang guessed that Elder Zhou Xin saw Li Haoran's flaws and deliberately let him soak in lava for a year to temper his resolve. And it seemed to have worked.
At the Task Hall, the two of them searched but didn't find any tasks suitable for Li Haoran.
"By the way, can you forge weapons?"
"Of course, master said I'm already at the top refining level of the Foundation Establishment Stage." Fire Spirit Root is best for refining, and Li Haoran had studied weapon refining in lava for a year.
"How about this? I post a weapon refining task, you accept it, and we both reach our goals." Lu Yang had thought this through; the Weapon Masters of Hundred Refinement Hall were at least of Golden Core Stage and charged high prices, but he didn't need such high-level masters to make his weapon.
"Senior Brother Lu, you don't have to go easy on me. I can come back to the Task Hall in a few days."
Lu Yang shook his head, "I am not going easy on you. I just need a weapon forged, and you are the most suitable candidate."
"Most suitable?" Li Haoran felt overwhelmed.
Lu Yang nodded, "Yes, you're the cheapest."
Li Haoran: "..."
The two returned to Li Haoran's weapon refinement room. Lu Yang took out the Green Peak Sword, making Li Haoran jump in surprise. The Green Peak Sword was fantastically high grade— not something an amateur like him at the Foundation Establishment Stage could modify.
"No, no, no, Brother Lu, you better find someone else. I am limited in skill and can't refine this kind of sword."
Lu Yang knew he had misunderstood and laughed, "You misunderstood. I don't want to forge this sword; I want to put some small decorative pieces on its exterior."
Li Haoran was relieved, this was much simpler. "Do you have some blueprints?"
"They're here."
Lu Yang was well prepared and pulled out blueprints, four meters long and wide, that didn't look like "small pieces" at all.
Seeing the content, Li Haoran's expression became more weird. Although the creation seemed odd, it actually wasn't difficult to forge. The only problem was that they had never seen something like it before and had to make multiple attempts to get it right.
"I'm planning to learn the flying sword technique. As a sword cultivator, how can I not use a sword? But when flying around, without any traffic rules, it's genuinely dangerous. For safety, I designed this blueprint."
"When I'm utilizing the flying sword technique, I plan to sit in a steel shell, with the flying sword attached beneath it, serving as a propellant."
"The steel shell will be equipped with seats for sitting. Install two rows of seats, and once I've got a hang of the flying sword technique, I can even take other people flying."
"This thing is the steering wheel, which can adjust the direction."
"And windows. Although mortals have difficulty using sand to forge glass, it shouldn't be a problem for cultivators, right?"
"There should also be brakes, but since I power the flying sword, there's no need to install brakes. I can just brake with my feet…"
"By the way, this big iron shell needs to be easy to install and dismantle, otherwise it'll be inconvenient during battle."
Lu Yang detailed the purpose and forging requirements of the small decorative pieces, leaving both Fairy Eternity and Li Haoran with a sense of having their horizons broadened.
"It's not that I'm afraid of heights; it's just that flying alone is too lonely. I want to bring some people along." Lu Yang repeatedly emphasized that he was not afraid of heights. "Can you do it?"
Li Haoran thought a little; although the things on the blueprint were peculiar, they were not difficult to forge. The most significant hindrance was his unfamiliarity with the items, requiring multiple attempts to get it right. "I can."
"That's good. These are Mysterious Thunder Irons which can be used as forging material."
"And this mask, can you forge it to be harder so it can't be damaged easily?" Lu Yang pulled out a tofu mask. He needed a disguise for future outings.
"We'll say about twenty contribution points for the price?" Lu Yang proposed the price.
Twenty contribution points, translating to two thousand Spirit Stones, was by no means a low price.
Li Haoran accepted the task.

chapters.title: Chapter 128 - 127: Sword Flight_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang stayed in the Hundred Refinement Peak for three days, all the while discussing with Li Haoran about how to better refine the flying sword pendants.
"It needs to be as light as possible, otherwise it won't fly, or it'll fly too slowly."
"What do you think about installing an ejection chair, you know, it would automatically eject upwards in case of danger, making an escape?"
"Attach the sword on the head? No, no, no, this is a proper flying sword technique, have you ever seen a swordsman who hoists their flying sword on their head?"
With diligent efforts, after three days, the pendant was finally refined.
"Shall we name it?" Li Haoran proposed that Lu Yang give the pendant a name.
"It's shaped like a carriage, and it can fly in the sky, how about calling it Flying Car?" Lu Yang gave it a rather simple name.
"Senior Brother Lu, would you like to give it a try?" Li Haoran, who felt accomplished having completed the pendant, wanted to see how Lu Yang would fare in the sky.
Lu Yang nodded, feeling a bit excited. He sat in the car, holding onto the steering wheel, hesitated for a moment.
"What's the matter?" Li Haoran asked.
Lu Yang scratched his head: "I just remembered, I haven't learned how to use the flying sword technique yet."
Li Haoran: "..."
I was excited about creating it all this while, and you can't even fly?
"Don't worry, don't worry, I'll learn now." Lu Yang was calm and composed, asking Fairy Eternity to teach him the flying sword technique.
The flying sword technique is a compulsory magic skill for sword practitioners, it's quite common and Fairy Eternity naturally knows this basic trick.
Truth be told, Fairy Eternity didn't really want to teach Lu Yang the flying sword technique, fearing that if he learned it incorrectly, her reputation could be ruined.
"The so-called flying sword technique is using the sword as a carrier, carrying the spiritual sense. The stronger the spiritual sense, the higher the degree of fit with the sword, and the faster the flying sword will be..."
Fairy Eternity was far better at teaching than the Eldest Senior Sister, explaining things in a clear and understandable way. It didn't take long for Lu Yang to learn the flying sword technique.
The Green Peak Sword floated in the air, moving freely, Lu Yang felt that even if a giant elephant stepped on the Green Peak Sword, it could still fly smoothly.
Lu Yang's talent in swordsmanship is indisputable.
Lu Yang realized that this must be the effect of the Sword Spirit Root, ensuring that he can learn swordsmanship and the sword technique perfectly.
There was a groove underneath the Flying Car where the Green Peak Sword could snugly fit and it wouldn't fall off, it was exceptionally stable.
Lu Yang climbed back into the car, gripped the steering wheel, and started applying the flying sword technique. Surprisingly, the Flying Car really started to ascend under the influence of the Green Peak Sword!
The Flying Car slowly hovered at first, not because the Green Peak Sword was flying slowly, but because Lu Yang was still getting used to this entirely new way of flying.
When the Flying Car hovered high in the sky, Lu Yang had gradually mastered the flying skills. The flight speed was getting faster and faster, flying in "8" shapes. By the end of the practice, he was even able to make sharp turns, it was simply unimaginable!
With a body in the Mid-stage Foundation Establishment, problems like lack of oxygen and pressure did not affect Lu Yang at all.
"Haha, the day has finally come when I, Lu Yang, can fly with the help of the sword!" Lu Yang laughed heartily, he knew it, there is always a solution to any difficulty.
Who said I'm afraid of flying?
Fairy Eternity found this experience quite refreshing.
On the Hundred Refinement Peak, countless people looked up in awe at Lu Yang flying in the sky.
The Flying Car, a highly advanced mode of transportation, even in the progressive thinking, self-proclaimed trend-leading Hundred Refinement Peak, is a revolutionary means of transportation.
"Look, what's that?!" The younger brothers and sisters who entered the sect at the same time as Lu Yang were amazed at the flying metal box in the sky.
"I saw this while asking Senior Brother Li Haoran a question yesterday. It's a magic artifact refined for Senior Brother Lu!"
"Senior Brother Lu? The one who entered the sect at the same time as us, possessing the Sword Spirit Root, ranked first in terms of achievement, and successfully became a disciple of the Sect Leader, that Senior Brother Lu Yang?" One of the junior brothers widened his eyes in admiration for Lu Yang.
If they hadn't had direct contact with Lu Yang, they would be shocked by his achievements, considering him to be a safe, steady, and reliable senior brother.
Of course, there are also those who have not changed their initial impression of Lu Yang despite having constant contact with him, for instance, Man Gu.
"Right, it's him! According to Senior Brother Li, this is Senior Brother Lu's flying sword technique!"
"So awesome, this is completely different from the flying sword techniques I've seen before, it provides a strange sense of security! There's absolutely no need for insurance!"
In the insurance types proposed by the Land Money Trade Association, there was one for flight insurance, which could be broken down into the flight damage insurance, third party liability insurance, and so on.
"Senior Brother Lu, who is of the same age as us, has already been able to create his own unique flying sword technique! This is the gap!"
"It's a pity that I'm not a swordsman. Otherwise, I would definitely learn this flying sword technique no matter what!"
Lu Yang had a good time flying around in the sky before landing, his face expressing the feeling of still wanting more.
After stepping out of the car, Lu Yang noticed that Li Haoran was standing off to one side respectfully, and somewhere along the way, the Fifth Elder, Zhou Xin, had arrived.
"Fifth Elder." Lu Yang respectfully bowed.
"Haha, so you're Lu Yang, I heard everything from Haoran, your idea is very good, it may even become a mainstream mode of transportation in the future."
"Fifth Elder, you flatter me."
"Those who know me well are aware that I'm not one to praise people easily. This Flying Car of yours can bring you quite a bit of profit."
"Profit?" Lu Yang was puzzled.
The Fifth Elder turned his head to Li Haoran and said: "Since you also just exited your cultivation period, you should familiarize yourself with the main operations of our Hundred Refinement Peak. We often produce never-before-seen items here. To protect our rights and intrests, we regularly apply for patent registration at the government office."
"The same applies to Elixir Cauldron Peak. This is the main source of income for Hundred Refinement Peak and Elixir Cauldron Peak."
"In a few days, a few of your senior brothers will be heading down the mountain to register, you should prepare Lu Yang's invention ideas and accompany them."
The Fifth Elder then addressed Lu Yang, "You have great talent and your mind is bright, you were born to fit in our Seek Dao Sect. Study well under Yun Zhi, the sect will be yours in the future. Try to avoid that bastard Old Nine."
Lu Yang cautiously pulled his neck back, thinking that he should stand up for his teacher when the Fifth Elder insults him. But learning Fairy Eternity's approach of "when you can't beat them, join them" doesn't seem like a bad idea.
Fairy Eternity frowned, she felt that Lu Yang was contemplating something quite rude, but she had no evidence.
"How is my master now?"
Fifth Elder gave a cold sneer, saying nothing.
...
Sky Gate Mountain, in the pine forest.
The seal of the Abode was finally removed, the Grand Elder to the Eighth Elder had long left, leaving only Daoist Buyu who didn't want to leave.
Daoist Buyu was tied up like a bug, squirming on the ground, with a yellow paper stuck on his forehead, and armed with a sock stuffed into his mouth, he was making squeaky sounds.
The rope was a one-of-a-kind treasure, Daoist Buyu couldn't break free using brute force, while the yellow paper could seal magic powers, leaving Daoist Buyu unable to use magic.
As for when Daoist Buyu would be able to wiggle free, it would depend on his luck.
This was the punishment for Daoist Buyu's beating the drum and gong while the eight of them were meditating and trying to break the seal.

chapters.title: Chapter 129 - 128: The Secret Meeting of the Five Great Immortal Sects_1
chapters.content:
On a certain peak of Seek Dao Sect, the decision-makers of the Five Great Immortal Sects had gathered.
This peak was utterly mysterious, only known to the upper echelons of Seek Dao Sect.
The four decision-makers sat quietly, waiting for the organizer of this meeting to speak.
Knowing everyone was present, Yun Zhi emerged from her profund reflection. She opened her eyes, and within them, countless worlds, endless time and space lay as mysteries. The other four were slightly startled meeting Yun Zhi's gaze.
They were shocked. They hadn't seen Yun Zhi in many years. Even back then, she had an unfathomable depth about her. But now, that sense was even more pronounced.
The Seek Dao Sect was exceptionally fortunate to have her as a member.
And she was the disciple of that old rascal, Daoist Buyu.
But Yun Zhi's profound cultivation level was a good thing for them. The Great Era was coming—an era abundant in divine revelations and rife with turmoil incited by the demonic sect. The great powers who had slept for hundreds of thousands of years were awakening, and the rumoured immortals were gradually making their presence known.
They could imagine, those great powers and immortals would not simply adhere to the current rules. Instead, they would redefine law and order according to their wills, a disaster proceeding for both mortals and cultivators alike.
Already, some latent cultivators of great power had awakened and were stirring up trouble in the Central Continent. However, before they could fully come into their own, they were jointly killed by the Five Great Immortal Sects.
Not all immortals were as carefree and content as Fairy Eternity.
Just look at the Ancient Nameless One that transformed stars into continents. He was a tough nut to crack.
Given these circumstances, the stronger the Five Great Immortal Sects, the better they could resist the impending catastrophe.
Yun Zhi spoke calmly, "The reason I summoned everyone here today is that I've come across some intelligence from the demonic sect which I wish to share with you all."
The four decision-makers tensed up. No wonder Yun Zhi did not employ conventional methods like message transmission. Instead, she had brought them here to this secret peak of the Seek Dao Sect.
The secrecy of this peak was maintained by efforts from generations of Seek Dao Sect venerables, and Yun Zhi's modifications, which could shield him from fate and causality, ensuring complete confidentiality.
Though the demonic sect was not strong, they had faith in the immortals and had gained many immortal treasures and methods from them. These treasures and methods were hard to defend against, and they needed to be handled with care.
"As you may know, over a month ago, I raided the Eternity Sect headquarters and came across certain intelligence. Two pieces of information are worth noting: one, a method to resurrect the Immortal Eternity, and two, information relating to a 'mole'."
The four decision-makers sat up straighter. Reviving an immortal was serious news.
Though they had heard that Yun Zhi had annihilated the Eternity Sect's stronghold, they hadn't known how she managed to find it.
"The Dao Fruit of Immortal Eternity is unique. Even when he is utterly destroyed, his spirit shattered, he can be resurrected, whether someone intentionally or unintentionally remembers his title and immortal name!"
The four decision-makers' hearts jolted. Indeed, none of the immortal's Dao Fruits could be taken lightly. All those they had encountered before were related to enhancing combat power. This was the first time they had encountered a Dao Fruit purely meant for survival.
"The intelligence also mentioned that the Eternity Sect has planted moles in the Laurel Fairy Palace, the Prison Suppressing Sect, and the Five Elements Sect."
In truth, this intelligence wasn't taken from the Eternity Sect headquarters. It was obtained by Lu Yang from the Inspector, Tang Yunsheng.
When Tang Yunsheng assigned Lu Yang and the others with the mole mission, he mentioned that aside from the Suspension Temple, which had few disciples, and the Seek Dao Sect, which was full of oddballs, all the other three sects had moles present.
The Five Great Immortal Sects included: The Seek Dao Sect, known for its profound Dao and erratic thoughts, which the other four sects warned their juniors to stay away from.
The merciful Suspension Temple, which had the fewest disciples yet profound strength.
The Laurel Fairy Palace, who thought the moon hid secrets. They cultivated with the help of the moon and grew laurel trees.
The Prison Suppressing Sect, dedicated to suppressing all evils.
And the Five Elements Sect with its doctrine of Unitary Five Elements and a thorough understanding of the principles of the Five Elements.
The other four sects saw themselves as incompatible with the Seek Dao Sect.
The Seek Dao Sect considered the other four sects incompatible with them.
But aside from the incompatibility, the Five Great Immortal Sects had a good relationship.
"So the meeting was for the mole matter." Palace Master Luo of the Laurel Fairy Palace wasn't surprised since she was Lan Ting's master, and Lan Ting had informed her of some matters.
The presiding master of the Suspension Temple didn't say much. Their Suspension Temple didn't have any moles from the demonic sect. This was partly because they had fewer members and partly due to their divergent beliefs.
Those from the demonic sect who recite scriptures and observe religious precepts all day would definitely cause a crisis in their faith if they stayed there for too long, and would easily expose themselves.
"I never expected that even though our Prison Suppressing Sect advocates suppressing all heresies, the Eternity Sect secretly infiltrated our sect. I will carry out a thorough investigation when I return!" Sect Leader of the Prison Suppressing Sect was furious but didn't overact considering the occasion.
"Since there are moles, there must be spies from not just the Eternity Sect. There could be spies from other demonic sects hiding among us, and we need to conduct a thorough search." The Sect Leader of Five Elements Sect had ice-cold eyes. The demonic sect really had the gall, daring to disregard their Five Elements Sect.
"So, how shall we investigate the moles?" Palace Master Luo from the Laurel Fairy Palace asked.
"Doesn't the Eternity Sect worship the Immortal Eternity? How about we have our disciples yell 'Immortal Eternity is a bastard' in unison?" The Sect Leader of the Five Elements Sect suggested.
The others nodded, thinking it was a good idea.
Sect Leader of the Prison Suppressing Sect said, "There's another way, we all certainly have a list of suspects. We can let those on this list say 'Our master uttered the Immortal Eternity's name, and the Immortal Eternity has already resurrected. The Master has asked all believers to gather at the headquarters.'"
The Righteous Path didn't know about the way to resurrect the Immortal Eternity. When the moles from Eternity Sect hear this, they are highly likely to assume the person who said it is a follower of the Eternity Sect.
Yun Zhi shook her head: "That will only alert the enemy. Not only is there a mole from the Eternity Sect on the list but also from other sects. If the other three sects hear you saying this, they'll know you're checking for moles."
Sect Leader of the Prison Suppressing Sect thought Yun Zhi made sense and didn't suggest any further.
"By the way, isn't the Seek Dao Sect free of moles? Could you share some of your insights, Yun Zhi?" the Sect Leader of the Five Elements Sect said, gaining the approval of the other three.
Yun Zhi rarely frowned - she was stumped by the question. She didn't even know why the Seek Dao Sect not only had no moles from the demonic sect but was able to plant moles within the demonic sect.
"Perhaps it's because the disciples of my Seek Dao Sect are simple-minded. Members of the demonic sect, on the other hand, have complex thoughts and cannot mimic the way my disciples of the Seek Dao Sect think."
The group came up with many cunning ways to search for moles, among which the master of the Suspension Temple was the most ruthless. If these methods were made public, the world's perception of them would drastically change.
At the end of the secret meeting, everyone left the mountain peak. Three of them left the Seek Dao Sect while the Palace Master of the Laurel Fairy Palace remained.
"Palace Master Luo, is there anything else you need?" Yun Zhi asked, referring to the Palace Master of the Laurel Fairy Palace, named Luo Hongxia.
Luo Hongxia summoned a reluctant Lan Ting: "Does your Seek Dao Sect have a disciple named Lu Yang? I have matters to discuss with him. My Lan Ting, such a good child, has been led astray by him. He needs to compensate for this!"
Yun Zhi calmly suggested: "How about we let the two become a Daoist couple?"
Luo Hongxia's expression stiffened.

chapters.title: Chapter 130 - 129 Daoist Buyu Escapes Trouble_1
chapters.content:
Luo Hongxia left in a hurry.
Originally, Luo Hongxia planned to seize the opportunity of the meeting to ask for an explanation from the Seek Dao Sect, at the very least to secure a promise that they would keep their distance from Lan Ting.
But now, not to mention the promise, if she leaves a moment too late, her little disciple might get embroiled in it.
Within a cloud of mist, Lan Ting complained: "Master, I've told you I'm fine. You insisted on dragging me to the Seek Dao Sect, what will Lu Yang think of me if he finds out!"
"You come back and devote yourself to developing an Automatic Skewer Formation, trying to imitate others' appearance by practicing the Imitation Fist, yet you say you're fine?"
"I've told you long ago to stay away from the Seek Dao Sect. I'm speaking from experience!"
"Back in the day when I went down the mountain to gain experience, I encountered a disciple of the Seek Dao Sect. We worked together to exorcise a ghost. After reaching our destination, we stayed in an inn for a few days. The ghost was audacious enough to hide under the Seek Dao Sect disciple's bed for three whole days."
"Eventually, the disciple noticed the problem and dragged the ghost out from under the bed, demanding it to pay half of the room rent for three days."
"Is that how common folks think?"
"Who was this person?" Lan Ting asked.
"The Sect Leader of the Seek Dao Sect, Daoist Buyu."
Luo Hongxia sneered, continuing: "Another time, we came across a grisly murder scene where a dozen children were brutally killed, their bodies dismembered and limbs scattered all over the ground. A little girl with a dazed expression was the only survivor. We stayed by her side to ensure her safety."
"After a while, the local authorities arrived, saying that after assembling the bodies, every body lacked a piece, and the missing pieces could form another little girl."
"At that moment, I felt a chill shooting up my spine. The little girl broke into a creepy smile and laughter, which was particularly unsettling. Daoist Buyu just tapped her head, asking her what's so funny when we're having a serious discussion."
"The little girl was completely stupefied."
Lan Ting: "..."
...
Out of concern for his master, Lu Yang once again came to the pine forest on Sky Gate Mountain, only to find Daoist Buyu, who was distinctly tied up.
"Is performance art a trend within our Seek Dao Sect now?" Lu Yang wondered.
Daoist Buyu writhes vigorously, his mouth muttering something, as if he was crying for help.
Lu Yang removed the yellow talisman from Daoist Buyu's forehead, which allowed Buyu to recover his magical powers, untie the ropes, spit out the sock in his mouth, and successfully escape the bind.
Daoist Buyu, with tears in his eyes, exclaimed, "Brother, from now on let's be independent. You call me master, I'll call you master!"
Lu Yang thought it would be better to tie Daoist Buyu up again.
Stepping out of his abode, Daoist Buyu stretched out his arms towards the sunlight, embracing nature: "Ten years! I'm finally out after ten years!"
Then he thought about it, feeling the atmosphere wasn't quite enough, so he manipulated the weather to make it rain over a small area above him.
The pouring rain soon soaked him to the skin, but he once again stretched out his arms, embracing freedom: "Ahhh! After ten years, I'm finally out!"
Perfect.
Having achieved the desired effect, Daoist Buyu dispersed the rain clouds, and turned to Lu Yang, "I'm planning on going down the mountain to do some storytelling. Would you like to come with me?"
Daoist Buyu hasn't forgotten his mission.
Lu Yang was somewhat tempted but shook his head, "No can do. My identity is sensitive. If I'm recognized by the followers of the Eternity Sect, it'd be disastrous."
Daoist Buyu laughed heartily, "What's the difficulty in that?"
Daoist Buyu wave his hand over Lu Yang's face, subtly changing Lu Yang's appearance to be completely different from before.
"Is it because you've been doing bad things and are worried about being recognized by your enemies? I understand, I'm experienced in this area. Rest assured, nobody in Unification Stage can see through my disguise!"
Lu Yang didn't really want to know where Daoist Buyu's expertise came from, but this way, he could indeed go out without worrying about their safety.
"Can I bring a friend along?"
"Of course."
Lu Yang called over Meng Jingzhou, who was going 'huff and puff' practicing boxing to keep fit.
"Going out for fun?"
"Is it safe?"
"We have a big shot leading us, guaranteed safety."
"Let's go."
After a concise Q&A, Meng Jingzhou prepared to go out with Lu Yang without even asking where they were going or what they would be doing.
Could there be a shortage of fun when following Lu Yang?
"Who is this guy?" Meng Jingzhou whispered, not recognizing Daoist Buyu.
"My master, Daoist Buyu." Lu Yang proudly introduced him.
Daoist Buyu recognized Meng Jingzhou, he stroked his white beard in a kindly manner, "Ah, the lad from the Meng Family, I heard Old Meng talking about you. I even attended your full-moon celebration."
"You knew my grandfather?" Meng Jingzhou was somewhat surprised; his grandfather had never mentioned this to him.
Daoist Buyu was amused by this question, "Your grandfather and I have known each other for over a thousand years."
Once Meng Jingzhou's appearance was changed by Daoist Buyu, he asked, "How do we set off, I have a carriage."
Lu Yang waved his hand: "No need for that, I've learned a new Flying Sword Technique, which allows for sword travel."
"But only one person can stand on a sword, what about the two of us?" Meng Jingzhou raised an eyebrow.
Lu Yang proudly took out an oddly-shaped Flying Car from his Identity Jade, "You can treat this as a sword sheath, just a bit oversized."
"With me operating the Flying Sword Technique, the Flying Car can take to the skies, carrying up to five people!"
Meng Jingzhou walked around the Flying Car for a couple of rounds, knocking on the shell and hearing a good echo. His eyes gleaming: "What a good treasure, did you invent it?"
"Naturally."
Daoist Buyu also nodded repeatedly. His disciple was indeed remarkably accomplished in swordsmanship and would certainly be no less than him in due time!
With a thrill of excitement, Lu Yang took the controls of the Flying Car, Meng Jingzhou sat on the passenger side, while Daoist Buyu sat in the back. All three fastened their seat belts, feeling quite novel.
"Take off!"
With a cry from the Green Peak Sword, the Flying Car soared into the sky, going among the clouds.
"Master, where to?"
Daoist Buyu pointed ahead: "To the south, it's bustling there with lots of transportation hubs, great for me to do my storytelling!"
The Flying Car headed south. When it passed other flying boats, the passengers were all amazed by the presence of the car.
Daoist Buyu tapped on the back seat, to open up an invisible shuttle-shaped barrier to reduce air resistance, then also conjured up the Flying Sword Technique to help propel the Flying Car forward.
Lu Yang felt his master's assistance, filling him with confidence. The speed of the Flying Car increased another notch.
With the master on board, it was bound to be extremely safe!
...
When Yun Zhi came to check on her master, the abode was empty, with only a golden rope, a yellow talismanic paper, and a sock that belonged to who-knows-who were left behind.
Back in her own abode, there was a small note left by Lu Yang at the door:
I'm going out with my master for a while, don't worry about me.
Yun Zhi grew even more worried.
Her master... can't even distinguish east from west.
...
Above a small town in the west, the Flying Car malfunctioned and plummeted straight down.

chapters.title: Chapter 131 - 130 【Rules】_1
chapters.content:
"What's happening?" The rapid descent of the flying car greatly surprised Meng Jingzhou.
Cold sweat broke out on Lu Yang's forehead as he desperately churned the Flying Sword Technique. The flying car continued to fall and he lost control of the Green Peak Sword, unable to sense its existence.
"Here, we cannot operate our spiritual essence, all magic skills are ineffective!" Daoist Buyu announced solemnly.
"What?!"
Having seen much of the world, Daoist Buyu could roughly guess what had happened—if they really had encountered this situation, it was a major stroke of bad luck for the three of them.
However, now was not the time for such discussions. The most urgent task was to save Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
He rose, threw open the roof of the car, grabbed Lu Yang with one hand and Meng Jingzhou with the other, pinned them to his waist and jumped down.
Although they could not use spiritual essence here, their physical bodies were not limited. As Daoist Buyu, a Great Power of the Unification Stage, jumped from such a high altitude, he would not be injured at all.
Lu Yang attempted several times to open his eyes and assess the situation, but the strong wind during their fall forced him and Meng Jingzhou to keep their eyes closed.
Just when the three of them were about to hit the ground, Daoist Buyu let go, gently holding them back, he landed first, creating a large crater in the ground. After him, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou landed, caught by Daoist Buyu, all within less than a second.
If Daoist Buyu had crash-landed while still holding the two of them, he himself would have been unscathed, but Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou could not have survived that impact—they would have been seriously injured, if not killed.
"Huff, huff, huff!" Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were deeply shaken. This journey had truly been unusual, they had crashed right after setting off.
