"Where are we?" Lu Yang frowned. He found himself in a small town which seemed quite ordinary and couldn't understand why they couldn't operate their spiritual essence here.
"Why isn't anyone coming out?" Lu Yang noticed something else odd. It had just become 9 p.m., and the sound of the flying car's crash was very loud. Why hadn't anyone come out to investigate?
Could it be that there were no living people in the town and it was a ghost town?
No, that couldn't be. Both the private residences and the inn had candles lit and one could see shadows moving behind the paper windows, there certainly were people here.
What was going on?
Lu Yang felt there was something strangely eerie about this place.
He looked at Meng Jingzhou, who shook his head, indicating he also didn't understand what was happening.
Daoist Buyu walked over to the wreckage of the flying car, pulled the Green Peak Sword from under it. The Green Peak Sword was a gift to Lu Yang from Yun Zhi, of superior quality and unscathed by such a crash.
"Here, use it for self-defense." Daoist Buyu handed the Green Peak Sword to Lu Yang, his demeanor clouded and serious, a stark contrast to his earlier joviality.
The suppression of spiritual energy in this place was extremely severe. Even Daoist Buyu couldn't mobilize his spiritual essence.
Suddenly, all three of them found a piece of paper in their hands. There were densely packed words on both sides of the paper.
[Buyi Town Rules]
[Rule One: There is no spiritual energy in the town, and spiritual essence cannot be used.]
[Rule Two: From 9 p.m. to 7 a.m., a closed door residence or a closed inn room is absolutely safe. All other places are dangerous.]
[Rule Three: Must leave the residence or inn by 9 a.m. and cannot return to the residence or the inn before 7 p.m.]
[Rule Four: Must fall asleep before midnight.]
[Rule Five: Do not stay in a Grade-A room.]
[Rule Six: If you hear knocking on the door or window inside the residence or inn, do not open the door or window, no matter what the person outside says.]
[Rule Seven: In the town, there are only floral dogs and white dogs, no black dogs. If you see a black dog, run away immediately.]
[Rule Eight: The private school has been abandoned for many years, there are no private school teachers in the town. Only the barking of dogs can be heard from the private school, not the sound of reading.]
[Rule Nine: The man in grey clothes is the private school teacher. If you meet him, pretend you cannot hear anything he says.]
[Rule Ten: Do not make eye contact with the private school teacher. If you make eye contact with him, you will turn into a black dog.]
[Rule Eleven: All food in the town is provided for free. You can help yourself, but do not eat the meat buns.]
[Rule Twelve: Be wary of government officials. The man in the black clothes is a government official. If you encounter a government official, run away immediately. Regardless of what they call out, do not turn back.]
[Rule Thirteen: If you feel like you are being followed, be certain it's just an illusion. Don't show any unease or irritation.]
[Rule Fourteen: A human body post-death is called a corpse. It's normal for corpses to move.]
[Rule Fifteen: If you have any question inside the inn, ask the innkeeper. If you have any question outside, ask the medicine shop owner, but do not talk to them.]
[Rule Sixteen: After entering a black door, do not speak and do not eat anything inside.]
[Rule Seventeen: Don't easily believe what a stranger says, however what a person wearing white clothes says is always the truth.]
[Article Eighteen: There are monsters that eat humans in the Ancestral Hall]
[Article Nineteen: The Ancestral Hall is safe]
[Article Twenty: The locals of this town cannot reveal anything about this town to outsiders]
[Article Twenty-One: Leaving the town or killing the mayor dispenses with the need to comply with the rules of Buyi Town]
The white paper on which these rules were written disappeared into thin air after Lu Yang finished reading.
"What is this?" Lu Yang felt absurd, the rules conveying a sense of ominousness.
"A trick manufactured by a Unification-stage cultivator!" the Daoist Buyu declared solemnly. Seeing these twenty-one rules, he was finally confident in his guess.
There was a strong presence indicating Unification-stage cultivators, and from the pressure he felt on himself, there were more than one Unification-stage cultivators!
"Little disciple and Little Meng, have either of you heard the saying 'the Great Era is coming'?"
Both nodded, but still didn't quite understand. The concept of the arrival of the Great Era is too broad, and they didn't know what it specifically referred to.
"The arrival of the Great Era manifests in many ways, one of which being the awakening of powerful beings from other eras from their sleep!"
"Now, with the vivid spiritual consciousness and active Daoist charm, it is easier to practice Enlightenment. Some even say that you can become an Immortal!"
"The Great Power flourished in the Great Qian era and the Great Yu era, but due to their own enlightenment, they could not break through further. Thus, they imagined the method of slumber, using Spirit-Stone Marrow as a carrier to seal themselves into a state of suspended animation. When the Daoist charm became active, they woke up from their sleep."
"After their consciousness awakened, but before their bodies fully awakened, they would use all methods to protect themselves from exposure."
"Defining an area, setting rules, detaining those who come, all these are just one of the methods."
"Do you know the difference between Refining the Void stage and Unification stage?"
Both shook their heads. These were still very remote for them.
"The difference between Refining the Void stage and Unification stage is whether they have grasped the[rule]."
"Rule?" Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou unknowingly repeated this word.
"Unification stage cultivators can modify the actual rules within a certain range based on their own will, but the modified rules should not be too contrary to common sense. For example, they can't dictate, 'I am invincible and immortal within this area'."
"The tests you encountered when joining the sect, like the River Spirit Test and Wenxin Mountain Test, are all examples of these rules."
"Unification stage cultivators have weak control over the rules. They must set multiple rules to limit the actions of people within the rule."
"Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivators and Immortals have different degrees of control over the rules. The latter is more exaggerated. After achieving Immortality and condensing the Dao Fruit, the symbol of rules, their power covers the whole world."
Lu Yang recalled the Dao Fruit of Fairy Eternity - as long as someone recited her honorific title and Immortal name, she could resurrect."
From the results, Fairy Eternity, this individual, is immortal.
But on a global scale, this meant that Fairy Eternity could directly resurrect, violating the world's common sense, crossing time, space, soul, physical body and other various restrictions. It's truly terrifying!
Lu Yang shared his guess with Fairy Eternity. Fairy Eternity nodded, affirming Lu Yang's thought. "You're young, but your brain works quite fast."
Lu Yang didn't have the mood to handle the taunt from Fairy Eternity. He listened to Daoist Buyu continue to speak, "Judging from the rules, only this small town is under their control. The range of rules that Unification-stage cultivators hold is not so small. The other person is afraid of being discovered by an Immortal of the Great Xia Dynasty!"
"A rule that can even restrain me indicates that there are more than one Unification-stage cultivators."
Daoist Buyu revealed a ruthless look, his gaze sharp as a sword: "The Five Great Immortal Sects and the Great Xia Dynasty have together eliminated many awakening Unification-stage cultivators. It seems that today I need to get rid of a few more!"
He swung his whisk, and the threads as thin as cow hair released million strands of Sword Qi.
Swordsmanship is Daoist Buyu's foundation. He has studied it his whole life. He doesn't need to use spiritual essence to conjure Sword Qi!
The Sword Qi slammed into the barrier of the town. The barrier couldn't withstand the Sword Qi and a gap was blasted open.
In the gap, four figures were waiting for Daoist Buyu. As expected, there was definitely more than one Unification-stage cultivator!
The rules they set up, they also have to adhere to. Inside the town, they cannot utilize their spiritual essence. They plan to deal with Daoist Buyu outside the town.
"Kill him!"
Daoist Buyu laughed loudly, strode forward, stepped out of the town, releasing the peak pressure of Unification stage to fight against the four Unification-stage cultivators!
"Just you bunch of wastes think you can kill me?"
Before leaving, he left a message for Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou: "This battle may last for several days. You two must stay alive in the town!"
The gap healed, Daoist Buyu disappeared outside the town.

chapters.title: Chapter 132 - 131: A Dangerous Night (Request for Monthly Ticket)_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou realised that, despite Daoist Buyu's show of bravado, this fight was far from being easily won.
The best course of action would have been for Daoist Buyu to flee with them, but he had not opted for that, signaling his lack of confidence in protecting them both from the newly awakened ancient Unification stage creature.
Lu Yang performed Eldest Sister's Form Boxing, trying to summon his Eldest Sister, only to find that he could not utilize the spiritual essence, and was even unable to transform.
Form Boxing indeed was an art of magic skill.
Meng Jingzhou tested his current power level. "Although we can't use magic ability, the strength of our bodies hasn't significantly changed," he reported.
It was a piece of good news.
"What time is it now?"
Lu Yang recalled the second rule which mentioned that 'from 9 p.m. to 9 a.m., the thatched cottages and inn rooms with doors shut are absolutely safe, everywhere else is dangerous.'
From 9 p.m. to 9 a.m. was considered the danger period.
"The streets are deserted since it's after 9 p.m. now, people must have gone home. We need to find a place to take shelter, or get to an inn!"
There were several lit straw houses nearby. Meng Jingzhou knocked politely on a door, saying, "Fellow villager, we are cultivators who have unintentionally trespassed this place. Could you please open the door and let us stay the night? We will compensate you greatly; you may pick any golden spirit stone you like!"
Meng Jingzhou tried a few houses in a row, but not a single door opened.
Lu Yang stopped him. "Don't waste your energy. Have you forgotten the fifth rule? Never open the door if you hear someone knocking? Not only us, but there must be commoners living in Buyi Town as well, they also need to abide by the rules."
[Nineteenth Rule: the villagers cannot reveal anything about the town to outsiders.] This indicated that Buyi Town had a native population.
Just as Meng Jingzhou was about to speak, Lu Yang signaled him to be quiet.
From somewhere not far away came the heavy sounds of footsteps. The heavy, irregular breathing suggested the creature was massive, and the pattern of the footfalls indicated it moved on four legs, or even more. Lu Yang had no idea what creature it could be.
Lu Yang could even see the shadow of the creature hovering around the corner.
"Run!" Lu Yang whispered, and he and Meng Jingzhou hastily fled.
Before understanding an opponent's realm and abilities, it wasn't wise to confront it.
As the two ran in the direction opposite to the creature, they successfully lost it as it hadn't noticed them.
Pausing to listen for any surrounding movements and verifying that the creature was not close, they cautiously walked down the street until they found an inn.
The inn was brightly lit, with a man in white leisurely dozing off on the counter, and two merchants were discussing which room to take.
"Finally found an inn, I'm dead tired. Let's take two Grade-A rooms." the Merchant slammed a silver coin onto the counter.
His companion promptly stopped him, "Did you forget what was said on that piece of paper? Do not stay in Grade-A rooms!"
"You actually believe what's written on that paper?"
"Better safe than sorry," countered the companion, picking up the silver piece. Glancing at the piece of paper, he nervously thought about how confounding this town was and resolutely decided to leave by morning.
With an appeasing smile, he addressed the man in white. "We would like two Third Grade rooms, please."
The man dressed in white took the silver without giving any change, promptly handed them three keys. "Only one room per group is allowed; you have been given all three keys to Third Grade Room No. 3."
The merchant frowned at this. Indeed, this inn was pricey; a Third Grade room shouldn't cost this much.
Lu Yang warned the two. "You all must abide by the rules written on the paper."
Recalling the rule which warned against trusting strangers too easily, the merchant couldn't discern Lu Yang's intention and hurriedly went upstairs.
Meng Jingzhou was about to ask for a Third Grade room for themselves when Lu Yang grabbed a pen and paper from the counter and pulled Meng Jingzhou behind him.
Meng Jingzhou then remembered the 15th rule [Inquire about anything regarding the inn with the innkeeper, and anything outside the inn with the medicine shop owner, but do not speak to them]]
Lu Yang wrote on the paper: Are you the owner of this inn?
The owner wrote back: Yes.
Lu Yang placed a silver coin on the counter and wrote: I want to rent a Third Grade room where no one has died.
The owner handed over three keys, each labeled, 'Third Grade Room No. 4'.
The two glanced at each other and proceeded to the second floor, where they noticed eight black-doored rooms, but only the doors marked 'Third Grade Room No. 3' and 'Third Grade Room No. 4' were brown.
The room with the Number 3 was for the merchants, while the room with Number 4 was for them.
Entering their room, they sat down on the bed and finally relaxed, noticing that their heartbeats were racing.
"Wasn't this discussed with you at home?" asked Lu Yang.
"Not at all. I did not even realize that cultivators in the Unification stage had the ability to manipulate reality and set rules. I see the elders in our family who are at this stage, they spend their days bird-watching, gardening, fishing, and scolding people on the streets, they hardly seem capable of this!" Meng Jingzhou exclaimed.
Lu Yang agreed. He hadn't perceived the elders of the Seek Dao Sect to be so powerful either.
However, if it was said Eldest Sister was capable of such ability, he would believe it.
At least, the magnitude seems to match the ability.
There were footsteps, light and sure, they belonged to a person.
From across the hallway came a knock on the door, a gentle voice humbly asking, "Honorable guest, have you retired for the night yet? The innkeeper accidentally gave all three keys to you and I cannot access the room. I have freshly prepared dinner here, which is complimentary. Could you please open the door so I could serve it to you?"
The occupant of Room 3 was no fool, sensing something was off and choosing to abide by the rules, did not respond to the plea.
The person upon receiving no response, knocked increasingly harder to the point where the entire hallway echoed with the sounds.
"Honorable guest, open the door!"
"Open the door!"
"Do you hear me asking you to open the door!"
"Believe me, I will break this door down!"
Shedding their disguise, the knocker pounded on the door with increasing ferocity. Thankfully, the door was of superior quality and wasn't smashed open.
Seeing as the merchants weren't falling for the trick, the knocker reverted to their gentle tone: "Alright then, I will leave the food at the door."
Still, the merchants gave no response.
The imposter employed the same trick, knocking on Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou's door, starting with gentle knocking and gradually increasing in volume, unveiling their true intention
Again, no one fell for the trick.
Footsteps echoed and then stopped. The trickster was gone.
"Something isn't right; those footsteps were too brief. It doesn't sound as if they went downstairs or upstairs; they are still on the second floor!" a chill ran down Lu Yang's spine.
A scene came to mind: The trickster clings to the walls with their hands, hiding at the top, waiting for the merchants to let their guard down, surreptitiously opening the door to collect the food, and then would swoop down on them...
Whether the merchants concluded the same way or whether they were simply cautious, there weren't any indications of their opening the door.
"Let's get some rest," yawned Meng Jingzhou. The rules stated that they must be asleep by midnight, equivalent to 11 pm.
He took a blanket from the cupboard, spread it on the floor and offered to sleep on the lower bunk.
Then he blew off the candles, the room was pitch black, the meager moonlight outside seeped through the paper window, illuminating the room.
Meng Jingzhou looked out the window, his heart stopped.
A dark figure appeared outside the window, swaying side to side, as if clinging onto the window ledge, craning its neck to glimpse inside.
The concern was this was the second floor... how tall was the creature?!
"Check if the windows are bolted!" Lu Yang shouted suddenly, remembering the rule about not opening the windows!
Upon entry, they had only thought about locking the door and had completely forgotten about the windows; they had no idea whether the windows were merely closed or bolted!
The pair moved quickly, noticing the windows indeed were unbolted, they quickly bolted them just before the creature began knocking on the windows.
Peering through the window to see the person-shaped shadow outside made their hearts beat loudly.
The two of them survived their first night, narrowly missing danger.
(A special addition in return for Lord 氵贪吃's support).

chapters.title: Chapter 133 - 132: Crisis-laden_1
chapters.content:
The two woke up, the sky was already dawning, and it was still some time before 9 a.m.
"I was terrified yesterday!" Remembering the experience from the night before, Meng Jingzhou's heart was still racing.
Lu Yang seemed more calm: "First understand the rules, and you won't be afraid once you understand them."
Meng Jingzhou nodded.
The two of them compared the twenty-one rules to ensure there were no memory deviations, only then did they feel relieved.
"What time is it now?"
At this moment, the sound of a gong echoed from the outside, the watchman was beating the gong while loudly shouting: "9 a.m."
The two of them hurriedly went downstairs.
On the first floor, two merchants were fuming at the boss holding a horse saddle: "Yesterday we left our horse in the backyard stable, how come today there is only a saddle left!"
Lu Yang recalled the huge beast he encountered last night, maybe it was the one that had eaten the horse.
No whinny of horses was heard last night, it means the horse didn't even have a chance to resist, it was such a terrifying beast.
Disregarding the merchants, the two ran out of the inn.
Fairy Eternity reminded them, "These two merchants have a very heavy aura of death, they are complex, they are not simple merchants."
Lu Yang nodded, showing that he remembered.
There was a wave of fragrant smell coming from the street. The restaurant was open, steam was wafting from hot dishes, causing the mouth to salivate. But strangely, the restaurant was empty. One of the steamed basket was labeled, it said "Meat Bun."
The people of Buyi Town, dressed in brown coarse linen clothes, have already gotten used to it. They came to grab breakfast, sat down, and started eating, keeping their distance from the meat buns.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou also followed suit, grabbed three sesame seed cakes and a bowl of soy milk, eating deliciously.
Lu Yang noticed that people were eating very quickly. Some were eating while walking, looking very hurried.
There was a commotion on the side of the street, a group of people hurriedly fleeing. The people who were dining also didn't care about their meal, they directly fled.
"We should run too!" Lu Yang said, picking up his sesame seed cake and started running.
They ran to the end of the other side of the street and turned to see what had just happened.
A group of people dressed in black were approaching, there were about a few dozen of them, each with a knife around their waist.
"Hey you, stop!" A man in black clothes shouted at a fleeing person, who subconsciously turned his head, his neck twisted a full 360 degrees, slumping.
The men in black laughed upon seeing this. They sat by the entrance of the restaurant, opened the steamed basket, picked up the meat bun and started eating, their mouths greasy.
The person who had died, lifted his head, twisted it back, back to normal, as if he had forgotten what had just happened, and slowly left the scene.
"They're the government office yamen, it is said in the rules that we cannot eat meat buns, but the yamen can, which means that the rules they need to follow are not the same as us," Lu Yang analyzed in a low voice.
"Among the many types of breakfast, all the yamen chose to eat meat buns, which implies they can only eat meat buns."
"Also, the rule says we must not turn our heads, it seems that turning our heads will snap our neck!"
The two looked at each other, decided to leave, to get as far away from the yamen as possible.
"At the beginning of man, the nature is good. The nature is similar, the habit becomes remote..." As they passed the private school, the loud sound of reading came. The voice was mature, as if a group of adults were reciting the "Three-Character Sutras."
However, Lu Yang remembered that the rules mentioned, [The private school has been deserted for many years, there is no private school teacher in the town, only the barking of dogs can be heard in the private school, not the sound of reading.]
This was absolutely irrational.
The two quickly left, but were stopped by a man in a grey gown: "The two of you look unfamiliar, could it be that you came from elsewhere?"
[Rule No. 9: The person in a grey gown is the private school teacher. If you encounter the private school teacher, no matter what he says, you must pretend you didn't hear it. ]
[Rule No. 10: You can't make eye contact with the private school teacher. If you make eye contact with the private school teacher, you will turn into a black dog.]
Both quickly responded by lowering their heads and walking forward, not looking into the eyes of the private school teacher, nor listening to what the private school teacher said.
The private school teacher being persistent, said next to them: "You both are dressed rather well, you must have a decent Cultivation Level. Could it be that you also believe in the rules written on the white paper?"
"Not all the rules on the white paper are true, some of them are deceptive."
"In fact, the person who set the rules here had no malicious intention, only wanted to protect themselves, which led to this desperate move. The person was informed that you both arrived, and specifically asked me to help you."
"I have a way to leave the town, but the price is that you will lose your memory in this town."
"As long as the two of you recite the 'Three-Character Sutras' in the private school for three days, you can leave the town! I am not deceiving you, you can hear the voices in the private school, just yesterday someone left the town with my assistance."
The private school teacher suddenly ran in front of them, bent down and looked directly at Lu Yang.
Lu Yang closed his eyes and walked forward. Before he closed his eyes, he saw the lower half of the man's face didn't have any skin, revealing red muscles, very eerie.
Seeing that the two were ignoring him and kept their heads down, the teacher from the private school had no choice but to give up; he shouted behind them: "This is your only chance to leave the town; you're going to regret it if you don't accept my help."
Fairy Eternity said in the Spiritual Space: "Lu Yang, don't believe him, only a part of what he said is true."
"A part?" Lu Yang was somewhat surprised; he thought everything the man said was a lie.
"He does indeed have a method to leave the town, but it's not as a human being, but in the form of a 'black dog'. I saw him release a few black dogs yesterday."
"Before meeting you two, someone made eye contact with him. After making eye contact, that person developed a splitting headache, eyes filled with bloodshot streaks, arms gradually growing black fur before going into the private school."
Lu Yang felt a chill up his spine, the abilities of the private school teacher were very tricky and not easy to deal with.
"Go to the tailor shop." Lu Yang had some thoughts and needed to verify them.
The two had been around Buyi Town's tailor shops, none of them sold black, white, or gray clothes, and there was no corresponding fabric available.
While strolling around the town, the two came across a question: "Where is the Ancestral Hall?"
It was said in the rules that the Ancestral Hall is safe, but there are also monsters in the Ancestral Hall. Such a contradictory statement, this place must not be simple.
But the two went around and did not find the location of the Ancestral Hall.
By this time, it was getting late, approaching from 9 p.m. to 11 p.m., and the two had to return to the inn.
"Welcome back, distinguished guests. Please, our inn is very safe, you don't need to be so nervous. I will protect your safety." At the inn's entrance, the cheerful little errand boy welcomed the two. The errand boy didn't have any whites in his eyes, his irises were pure black, like he could see what ordinary people couldn't.
The two broke out in goosebumps. This voice was exactly the same as the one that knocked on the door in the corridor last night!
It was him last night!
"Little errand boy, it's not time yet, go back to your room!" The innkeeper drove the errand boy away.
The errand boy stared at the innkeeper. The two were locked in a stare for a while before he reluctantly left.
Lu Yang noticed that the errand boy went up to the third floor, which was the Grade-A rooms.

chapters.title: Chapter 134 - 133: The Movement of the Corpse is a Normal Phenomenon_1
chapters.content:
Just as that arrived back in their room, they happened to encounter two peddlers. The arrogant peddlers from yesterday had become uncharacteristically friendly today, even inviting them over to sit down. Unwilling to interact with them more than necessary, Lu Yang declined.
Upon refusal, the peddlers weren't upset and closed their room door.
The sound of the gong rang out again - the watchman announced, "It's the time from 9 p.m. to 11 p.m."
Clop, clop, clop - the orderly footsteps once again echoed from the corridor as the eerily black-eyed inn servant prowled around.
The inn servant knocked lightly on the door across from them, "Dear guests, are you there? Could you please open the door?"
Just when the two of them expected it to play out like the night before, the peddlers insisting on not opening the door and the knocking growing louder till it was deafening —
Creak —
The door across from them was opened.
The action surprised one of the peddlers, "You, what are you doing! Why did you open the door!"
"Shut it quickly, shut it quickly!"
"If you want to die, don't drag me down with you!"
"Why won't the door shut!"
There were two peddlers, but only one spoke from start to finish. The other didn't make a sound the whole time, which was very strange.
"You, don't come over, Ahhh —"
A heartrending scream came from across the hall, and then there was silence.
"What happened? The peddlers aren't fools, why would they open the door?" Meng Jingzhou felt a chill in his heart.
Lu Yang fell into thought for a moment and imagined a possibility, "Do you remember the man we saw being killed by the officer this morning? He came back to life and looked no different from the living."
"It's stated in the rules that 'Moving corpses are a common phenomenon,' but the rules did not mention the revival of corpses!"
"Was the man who came back to life this morning really himself?"
Meng Jingzhou widened his eyes, "You mean... One of the salesmen is already dead? But their partner didn't notice?"
Lu Yang nodded, "Right, that's what I mean!"
A chill tingled through Meng Jingzhou's scalp. Though they'd seen lots of people on the street today, he'd thought not many had been harmed. But now, it seemed as if there were likely quite a few Living Dead wandering around during the day!
The violent knocking began again, but this time it was on their door.
"Help, save me! The inn servant wants to kill me!"
"Open the door, open the door quickly!"
"Please, have mercy and save me. Gold, Spirit Stones, the location of the Relic Blessed Cave — I can give them all to you!"
"Don't kill me —"
With that, there came the sound of a dull thud as an axe entered flesh, striking bone. Accompanied by the trader's scream of pain.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou looked at each other, both deciding not to open the door. The screams of the two peddlers had just silenced, and despite the newfound pleas for help, something seemed wrong, eerie and strange.
And what's more, Fairy Eternity had informed him that the two traders were anything but kindly souls. There was no need to aid them.
Once the peddler's voice had disappeared, the inn servant's gentle knocking started once again: "Dear guests, are you there? Can you please open the door?"
"Dear guests, are you there? Can you please open the door?"
"I said open the door!"
"Open the damn door for me!"
Just like yesterday, the knocking grew louder until the whole inn could hear it.
Either the door was well-made, or there were rules restricting it - the inn servant did not manage to break down the door.
Lu Yang heard the inn servant's footsteps going upstairs, presumably heading straight to the suite.
No monsters went past the window tonight, and they passed the night in peace.
When they left the inn at 9 a.m. the next day, Lu Yang noticed that the door of the room across the hall had turned black. The two merchants emerged from the room laughing and joking, bidding Lu Yang a jovial hello.
"Rule Sixteen: Upon entering a black door, do not speak or eat anything inside."
Lu Yang's gaze hardened: the peddlers no longer had to follow the normal rules.
Meng Jingzhou couldn't help but ask, "Who was the one calling for help last night?"
The peddlers seemed quite puzzled — their expressions not feigned, "Help? Who needed help?"
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou left hurriedly, unsure of the peddlers' situation and unwilling to speak anymore.
During the day time, they secretly followed the officers, and found out that they only ate once a day - a meat bun.
Meng Jingzhou once stole a meat bun, opened it up, and in addition to the meat, found what appeared to be fingernails and hair.
After the officers had eaten, they would walk the streets, herding people along like ducks. Some unlucky people would accidentally turn their head, be killed on the spot, and resurrected immediately after death.
"Did you notice? The officers walk all around the small town but they never go to the private school!"
Lu Yang spread out the map. He had drawn it when they were walking around the small town yesterday. The map marked the crash site, the inn, the private school, the tailor's shop, the potion shop, and the government office.
The quality of the drawing on the map was of a questionable standard, the good news was that at least he could understand what he had drawn.
"It seems the rules they're following aren't the same! It's not one-size-fits-all!" laughed Meng Jingzhou. This was good news depending on how they used it.
As they walked on the main street, they noticed through a paper window that there were people in the thatched huts.
According to the rules, "You can't return to the thatched hut or the inn before the time of 5 p.m. to 7 p.m." So, who could be inside the thatched huts?
"There seem to be many more rules about this town that we don't know about."
Different identities have to abide by different rules. Lu Yang wondered if the Unification period ancients had too much free time on their hands.
"Fairy, can you see what's happening outside? How is my master doing?"
Fairy Eternity was amazed, "Your master has a deep understanding of swordsmanship. He can even hold his own against four opponents."
Lu Yang nodded. If that's the case, he could rest assured.
The two returned to the inn, and Lu Yang wrote a line on a piece of paper and handed it to the innkeeper: Are you from the outside?
Meng Jingzhou watched from the side, understanding Lu Yang's intention. The rules stated that locals could not disclose the town's affairs to outsiders, yet the innkeeper could. This meant that the innkeeper was not a local.
The innkeeper didn't expect Lu Yang to ask such a question but wrote the word "yes."
Lu Yang wrote: Normal person or cultivator?
The innkeeper responded: Ninth Level of Qi Training.
Lu Yang wrote: How did you become the innkeeper?
The innkeeper wrote: I can't say.
Lu Yang wrote: Do you have to observe different rules from us? What are the specific rules?
The innkeeper responded: I follow the "Rules of Buyi Town Inn." I can't tell you the specific rules.
Lu Yang then wrote: Do you want to leave?
The innkeeper's hand shook slightly: Yes.
Lu Yang handed over his Identity Jade: We're both disciples of the Seek Dao Sect. We arrived here by mistake and also want to leave.
Peering at the jade identity of the Seek Dao Sect disciple, the innkeeper was even more excited. With a trembling hand, he wrote: What do you need?
Lu Yang wrote: Take off your white clothes.
Unprepared for this demand, the innkeeper initially wore a puzzled expression.
The rules he adhered to stated "Within the boundaries of the rules, accommodate customers' requests as far as possible, except for those that contradict morality and ethics," there was no mention of not allowed to take off clothes.
The innkeeper took off his white clothes and handed them to Lu Yang.
Lu Yang put away the clothes and went back to the room with Meng Jingzhou.
"After knocking on our door for two days, tonight — it's our turn." Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou shared a cold laugh.

chapters.title: Chapter 135 - 134: Change of Position (Third update request for monthly ticket)_1
chapters.content:
The time between 9 p.m. and 11 p.m. arrived, leaving only Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou as guests in the entire guesthouse.
The waiter came down from the third floor with an axe in his hand. Blood was dripping from the axe, still not coagulated, and anyone's guess whose blood it was.
A smirk danced at the corners of his mouth. Despite unknowingly entering Buyi Town and being forced to abide by its rules, he saw this as an opportunity— an opportunity to let his true nature run wild.
He had lost track of how long he had been in Buyi Town or head count of people he had murdered.
The luck of these two was indeed remarkable. The town was riddled with traps, yet they hadn't fallen into any and were still alive. No previous groups of guests had enjoyed a similar good fortune. Being strangers to the town, unfamiliar with the roads and reluctant to abide by the rules, they were quickly wiped out.
There were ten third-grade rooms, nine of which had turned black— proof of their last occupant's ill fate. This was not even counting the naive folks who dared to stay on the third floor in Grade-A rooms.
The beginners luck of these two newcomers was about to run out.
He had decided to knock on doors all night until morning. Even if he didn't kill them, he would torment them.
"It's strange—the lights were on in third-grade Room 4 the day before yesterday. Why is it off today?"
The waiter quickly figured it out and scoffed, "They thought that I would spare them if they kept the lights off. How naive!"
Adjusting his tone, he gently knocked on the wooden door,"Dear guests, please open the door. There may be a misunderstanding between us."
He paused and then said in an even more steady and reliable voice, "Dear guests, please open the door. There may be a misunderstanding between us."
As always, there was no reply.
Suddenly, a hand appeared out of nowhere, grabbing his ankle.
"Who's that?"
He looked down sharply and saw that a hand had come out of a dog hole under the wall of third-grade Room 4, clutching his ankle tightly.
The hand was incredibly strong— once it pulled, he was knocked over.
Clang——
The waiter fell to the ground and the axe slipped away.
He scrabbled desperately on the ground, trying to free himself, but the strength of the hand far exceeded his expectations, making escape impossible.
No one had ever been able to get hold of him like that.
He was going to die!
The thought was absurd to him! However, how could that be? He was the hunter, and guests were the prey!
"No, it's possible," the waiter remembered the second rule.
"Between the hours of 9 p.m. and around 7 a.m., the closed thatched huts and guesthouse rooms are absolutely safe. All other places are dangerous."
Third-grade Room 4 was still closed, ensuring absolute safety for the guests. If he was pulled into the room, his fate would be tragic!
His fingers clawing the floor, the waiter tried to crawl away. Like a prey half swallowed by a python trying to escape death, he screamed, "Help! Help! Save me!"
His cries were heartfelt.
Unfortunately, no one came to his rescue.
There was no rule in "Buyi Town Guesthouse Rules" about rescuing the waiter.
As most of his body got pulled into the room, he desperately braced his hands against both sides of the walls and thrust hard, finally freeing himself.
The waiter abandoned his axe and hobbled back to the Grade-A room.
"Did we actually let him escape?" Meng Jingzhou was a bit frustrated. The brute was surprisingly strong. He had shattered the waiter's ankle but still couldn't hold him.
The two of them had decided that today, they were going to get rid of the annoying waiter who kept knocking on their door every night.
They didn't need to ask around to know that they, leaders of the demonic sect, had never been treated like this before?!
After observing for two days, they understood the rules of the guesthouse and quickly devised a plan.
Lu Yang first used the Green Peak Sword to dig a hole under the wall based on the waiter's size.
Utilizing the rule "Rooms with closed doors are safe", they made sure to pull the waiter into their room without being harmed by him, holding the upper hand in the process.
"A lively prey makes the hunt interesting!" Lu Yang smirked cruelly, the sinister sound echoing through the room.
Two figures stepped out of third-grade Room 4, one with a sword, the other bare-handed— the latter picked up the fallen axe.
The blade of the sword scraped the floor, producing an irregular sizzling sound. Blood dripped from the axe, creating a rhythmic ticking sound.
The two figures wandered the guesthouse, armed with blood-stained weapons.
The second floor... No one was there. So he must be on the third floor.
The third floor had four rooms, all Grade-A rooms.
The figure with the sword politely knocked on the door, 'We heard there's free dinner here. We're hungry and want to eat. Could you please open the door?'
Seeing no response from Grade-A Room 1, Lu Yang became impatient, banging on the door, "Open up! We want to eat! What kind of service is this!"
'There seems to be a misunderstanding between us. Could you open the door so we can talk it over?'
'Open the door! Open it now! If you do not open the door, I will break it down!'
The loud knocking echoed through the entire guesthouse.
Lu Yang kicked open the door of Grade-A Room 1. It was empty. He tried to enter but was stopped by an unseen force.
"Rule Five: Do not enter Grade-A rooms."
The waiter was hiding in one of the rooms, trembling at the commotion from next door.
"No, don't be afraid. The rules say 'Do not enter Grade-A rooms', they can't get in. They can't get in," the waiter kept mumbling to himself, though he wasn't convinced.
Lu Yang kicked open Grade-A Rooms 2 and 3 as well, but found no trace of the waiter.
"Then it must be Grade-A Room 4!"
Without a second thought, Lu Yang kicked open the door and found the waiter huddled up in the darkness.
'Come out, and I'll spare you!' Meng Jingzhou threatened menacingly.
Seeing Meng Jingzhou bluffing, the waiter let out a sardonic laugh, relieved. 'Ha! Ha! So you have to abide by the rules too!'
He had absolute control over who could enter the Grade-A room, and in there, he had the upper hand, meaning he was untouchable.
As the waiter was deciding whether or not to drag them into the room, Lu Yang calmly took out a wooden plaque. The waiter's face turned pale at the sight of it.
It read: Third-grade Room 4.
Anticipating the scenario, Lu Yang had tried to switch the door plaque of third-grade Room 3 with that of third-grade Room 4. The black door turned brown, indicating that it had become "third-grade Room 4."
It worked.
Lu Yang replaced the plaque of Grade-A Room 4 with that of third-grade Room 4. The barrier disappeared, allowing direct entry.
One man with a sword, the other with an axe, both with horrific smiles on their faces.
In the eyes of the terrified waiter, they walked into the room and thoughtfully closed the door behind them.
Now, this place was third-grade Room 4— absolutely safe for them.
Lu Yang kicked the waiter around, breaking his arms and legs to prevent him from escaping.
Meng Jingzhou slapped him twice as interest for scaring people.
Afterwards, they dressed him in white clothes.
'Speak. What do you know?'
"Rule Seventeen: Don't trust strangers easily. People in white tell the truth."
(Added for the alliance leader Tianqiong Yunhai)

chapters.title: Chapter 136 - 135: Medicine Shop_1
chapters.content:
"How many people in the inn pose a danger?" Lu Yang first determined the source of threat in the inn, whether it was just the waiter alone.
Dressed in white clothes, the trembling waiter extended two fingers and stuttered, "Two... two."
"Who?"
"Both of you."
Meng Jingzhou stepped forward and kicked him: "Behave!"
The waiter was helpless, he couldn't lie in his white uniform, you two are the most dangerous in the inn.
Lu Yang readjusted the question: "For ordinary people, how many dangers are there in the inn?"
"Just me." The waiter answered truthfully.
"Who is stronger, you or the innkeeper?"
"I'm stronger, but we follow different rules. He has a natural suppression over me."
"Is your power the same in the Grade-A room as in other places?"
"No, based on the rules, my power is greater in the Grade-A room."
"Are there others like you who have different powers in different places?"
"Yes, for example, the things in the thatched cottage during the day. They are very powerful in the thatched cottage and can move freely between them. But when they leave the thatched cottage, their power becomes indistinguishable from ordinary people, and they lose the ability to teleport. However, I don't know what exactly those things are."
"Anyone else, like the black-clothed officers and gray-clothed private school teachers? Do they have a power boost?"
"No, but they were originally cultivators, much stronger than ordinary people."
"What is the relationship between the officer and the private school teacher?"
"I guess their relationship is not good, there may be competition. For example, like me and the officer, we need to kill a certain number of people before we can leave the town. I'm not sure about the specific situation on the private school teacher's side, but their requirements are probably the same."
"Do you know where the mayor is?"
"I heard the mayor is in the government office, I've never seen him come out."
"How would you kill the mayor?"
"I don't know."
"What are the mayor's powers and abilities?"
"I don't know."
"Where is the Ancestral Hall?"
"You can't find the Ancestral Hall during the day. It only appears from 9 p.m. to 11 p.m." The waiter answered every question, acting quite honestly.
What the waiter has disclosed, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou have speculated. There's not much difference from what the waiter said.
The two had nothing else to ask. Lu Yang acted, removed the waiter's white clothes, stabbed him through his body with a sword, and killed him.
As the Rudder Master of the demonic sect, how could he leave any chance for others when completing tasks.
"Fortunately you took it off in advance, otherwise the white clothing would be dirty." Meng Jingzhou stretched a yawn: "Finally, we can sleep in peace."
Lu Yang felt the same. Tonight they won a good haul and didn't have to put up with the annoying knocking on the door anymore.
The two searched the waiter's body and found the inn's rules. However, they had already figured out the rules of the inn, so this was of no use.
"Our rules disappeared after we read them once. If it weren't for our good memory, we would have forgotten. They can keep the rules and ensure that they don't make a mistake. It seems the waiters are treated differently from us."
At 9 a.m. on the third day, the two were awakened by the sound of the watchman's gong. They yawned and felt that the sleep was refreshing.
The innkeeper heard the waiter's cry for help last night and various commotions, so he decided to check the waiter's situation upstairs in the morning.
When he saw the waiter's tragic death, he was silent for a long time.
Are these two really on the Righteous Path?
When they left the inn, Lu Yang left a note for the innkeeper: The effect of the white clothing is good, borrow us for two more days.
What Lu Yang didn't notice was that the innkeeper was looking at the two with a hint of fear in his eyes.
And this note, why does it sound like those overbearing demon cultivators who owe money and don't repay?
A feeling of "The stuff is good, borrow it for this old man to use, I'll give it back when I'm tired of playing."
"An illusion, right?"
Obviously, the innkeeper knew very little about the Seek Dao Sect.
For these bottom-level cultivators, their understanding of the huge Seek Dao Sect mainly comes from rumors.
And rumors are unreliable most of the time.
After leaving the inn, the two found a medicine shop. There was a gray-clothed apprentice in the shop.
The apprentice saw the customers and warmly greeted them, "What do you need, sirs? Did you hear the barking of the dog? Or did you encounter a black dog?"
"If you heard the dog barking, I have the right medicine here."
The apprentice brought a pot of bubbling red potion: "This is ground Cinnabar Grass, boiled for ten hours. After drinking this, you will get drowsy temporarily. After you have a sleep, the impact of the dog barking will disappear."
"If you encounter a black dog, you should follow me right away. Otherwise, you will be assimilated by the black dog soon."
"There's a well in the back yard of the medicine shop. You need to draw the water yourself. As long as you drink the water you draw up, you won't be assimilated by the black dog."
Meng Jingzhou wanted to ask to see the owner, but was stopped by Lu Yang.
Meng Jingzhou understood Lu Yang's meaning, there was no need to explain to the apprentice. He's a stranger, his words are most likely false.
The two sat leisurely, ignoring how anxious the apprentice was or how concerned he was for them, they kept silent.
After about an hour, the apprentice went into the back yard, and the white-clothed shopkeeper appeared.
"Is there any difficulty you encountered or any questions?" The shopkeeper is an old man, his face kindly and easily trustworthy when discussing problems.
The two still remembered the rules. It was mentioned in the rules that they should not talk to the shopkeeper.
Lu Yang handed the shopkeeper a note: We heard the barking of a dog, how should we deal with it?
"You need two Liang (a Chinese weight unit) of Tongming Grass, moisten it with saliva, crush it and use the grit to plug your ears. A quarter of an hour later, the effect will vanish."
Lu Yang wrote again: Give us four Liang of Tongming Grass. Also, what if we see a black dog?
"It will be troublesome if you see a black dog. Those who encounter a black dog will involuntarily bark like a dog. Once they start barking, they will be assimilated by the black dog."
"There is a way, that is to use a needle and thread to sew your mouth shut, leaving no gaps. After half an hour, you will not be assimilated by the black dog."
Lu Yang listened carefully, and then wrote: How can we leave the town?
"To leave the town, ah, it's even more troublesome. I even think it's impossible."
"There is an Ancestral Hall in the town. In the hall, there is a half-naked Buddha statue with its eyes covered. Smash the statue and there will appear a passage to the outside world. The passage is swept by a Protective Aura that disintegrates bones. The Aura enters from the seven apertures and leaves, in the process, the body dissolves, leaving only a skeleton, the body dies and the way is lost.
No one can resist it."
"This is the only way to leave the town."
The two's hearts sank. Such rules were clearly meant to make it impossible for people to leave.
It also makes sense. The ancient Unification cultivators who hid here would never want to reveal this place.

chapters.title: Chapter 137 - 136: Can't Pass the Level?_1
chapters.content:
The medicine shop owner continued leisurely, "The Array Method here was devised by several Unification stage cultivators. It set certain rules. There are doors of life and death in the Array Method. As Heaven always leaves a way out, there must be a way to survive in the rules established here."
"However, those Unification stage cultivators didn't really want people to leave, so they set up such a seemingly crucial yet trifling rule."
"It's beneficial, and it also follows the principle of Heaven always leaving a way out."
Suppressing his urge to curse, Lu Yang continued to write: how can we kill the mayor?
The medicine shop owner said, "It's impossible. The mayor is immortal. How can you kill him?"
Meng Jingzhou clenched his fists, mentally cursing the Unification stage cultivators who set the rules.
It's no different than not setting up the twenty-first rule at all! What's the difference between doing this and not doing anything?!
Lu Yang's expression was also not very good, but he remained calm, knowing that swearing wouldn't solve the problem. He continued to write: where is the mayor?
The medicine shop owner laughed lightly, "Do you guys really want to kill the mayor? Unfortunately, I don't know where he is. But you can ask the officers, after all, they are closest to the mayor. As for whether they would tell you, it's not my concern."
Before leaving, the medicine shop owner called out again, "If you guys really want to leave, let me remind you, the mayor knows about anything that happens in the town. It's his ability, so be careful."
Just as Meng Jingzhou wanted to thank him courteously, he remembered that he couldn't speak to the medicine shop owner and could only nod to show that he understood.
Lu Yang was indifferent from beginning to end.
"Do you think this medicine shop owner is telling the truth?" Meng Jingzhou asked quietly.
Lu Yang didn't answer. When they were a distance away from the medicine shop, he said with a cold laugh, "Limited by the rules, what he said is certainly true, but it doesn't necessarily mean he's on our side."
"Do you know the biggest difference between him and the innkeeper?"
"What is it?"
"The medicine shop owner made every effort to make us speak."
Meng Jingzhou was taken aback. He realized that when they were communicating with the innkeeper, they were using text, but when they were communicating with the medicine shop owner, they were writing all along while the medicine shop owner was speaking.
If one side was talking while the other side was not careful, they would respond with their voice.
"Sly old fox." Meng Jingzhou muttered, then felt something was wrong, "If he wanted to harm us, then why did he remind us that the mayor knows everything that happens in the town?"
Without any hesitation, Lu Yang said, "He saw that we're trying to get out of here and couldn't stop us, so he gave us one more important piece of information, indicating that the mayor is invincible."
"This could potentially result in two outcomes: either give up leaving or fall into a disarray, leading to self-destruction."
Meng Jingzhou clicked his tongue, finding it difficult, "Now the most troublesome thing is that the mayor knows what we've been up to. Even if we come up with a way to leave, the mayor could stop us!"
How could they sneak out right under the mayor's nose?
Lu Yang pondered for a moment, then had a flash of inspiration, he came up with a plan.
He took out a piece of paper and wrote: using text to communicate might reduce the mayor's attention on us.
Meng Jingzhou nodded.
Lu Yang continued to write: Remember the jade tokens our sect gave us? Each one is a symbol of one's identity. Once a jade token shattered, the sect would send people to check. The jade is too hard for us to crush, but we can throw it towards the exit. The protective aura there would shatter it.
Meng Jingzhou's eyes lit up. He thought about it and found it to be a good plan.
Meng Jingzhou also wrote: how should we deal with the mayor then?
Lu Yang wrote: we must understand the mayor's ways of functioning first, starting with the officer.
The two of them drafted a detailed plan on paper. Afterwards, they burned the paper they used to write on until nothing was left and pretended as if nothing happened.
As Lu Yang walked, he approached the private school. The usual sound of reading could still be heard. Fairy Eternity had said, though, that it was actually the sound of dogs barking. Under the effect of the rules, it turned into the sound of reading.
If anyone couldn't resist their curiosity and wanted to enter the private school, the sound of reading would turn into the sound of dogs barking, and something bad would happen.
The school master came to Lu Yang and kept persuading him to enter the private school, but Lu Yang kept his head down, pretending that he didn't hear.
The school master was like a waterfall of words, talking incessantly, "My friend, we meet again. You came alone, so it seems you had a fallout with your companion. That indicates you still believe in what I say in your heart. Don't trust what the rules say. The rules are mostly false and few are true, you can't tell the difference..."
Just as the school master was trying to surprise Lu Yang by bending down and making eye contact, suddenly, everything turned black and he didn't know what happened.
The school master had all his attention on Lu Yang, and Meng Jingzhou sneaked behind him and put a sack over his head.
The two were ready to exact their revenge. They had been scared enough by the school master last time, this time they had no fear of his stares. They had to take revenge!
Demonic sect members are emotional beings. They must take their revenge, and this is evident in Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
"Attack!"
The two kicked and punched, showing no mercy to the school master.
The school master had never experienced such a thing. He was crying out in pain, "Stop, stop!"
"Rule number nine: Ignore the man in the ash-gray robe, the school master, no matter what he says."
Both were kind-hearted and would stop if the other party pleaded, but due to the rule, they had to pretend not to hear whatever the school master said.
They had no choice but to continue beating him.
Finally, they took a breather. They felt relieved after the beating. Before leaving, Meng Jingzhou even spat, "Pah, scum, don't let me bump into you again."
The two returned to the inn arm in arm. The school master managed to get rid of the sack and saw their retreating figures. His eyes were filled with murderous intent.
"Don't let me see you guys again!"
On the fourth day at 9 a.m., they went down to the restaurant on the first floor. This was the only place in the town that served meat buns.
"Rule number eleven: All food in the town is freely available and you can take as much as you want, but you can't eat meat buns."
Considering that the meat buns are free, they decided to take away all the meat buns even if they couldn't eat them. They used the same sack they had used to cover the school master the day before.
When the officers, who always wore black clothes, arrived at the restaurant like usual, they found all the meat buns were gone.
"Who did this!" The officers were furious.
According to "The Officers' Rules of Buyi Town", they could only eat meat buns each day. Now that there were no meat buns, what were they going to eat?!
"Boss, see those two guys? Don't they have our meat buns on their back?" One of the officers had a sensitive nose and smelt something.
Seeing the officers staring at them, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou realized that they had been found out and hurriedly fled.
The officers were only skeptical before, but now they were certain, "It's definitely them, go after them!"
The townsfolk noticed that the usually quiet town was particularly noisy that day.
"You two bastards, get back here!"
While running, Lu Yang replied, "Can't do that. Rule number twelve says 'If you encounter government officials, run away immediately.' We're just following the rules, don't make it hard for us."
The head officer was furious, "There's nothing in the bloody rules that says you can take away the meat buns!"
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou ran so fast that the officers couldn't catch up to them.

chapters.title: Chapter 138 - 137: The Manipulated Yamen Runners (Thanks to the Friend Many Elephants for the Alliance Leader Reward)
chapters.content:
According to research conducted by Elixir Cauldron Peak, over-consumption of meat buns can cause nutritional imbalance and impair physical development. In an attempt to improve the diets of their bailiffs, the kind-hearted Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou decided to take action.
In the morning, the hardworking Master Lu and Master Meng decided to pack up all the meat buns, forcing the bailiffs to eat vegetables for balanced nutrition. They also encouraged the bailiffs to exercise frequently, particularly by running.
The bailiffs willingly accepted the advice of the two experts, pledging to follow their lead, catch up to them soon and thank them in person.
The two experts didn't just talk the talk, they also walked the walk-literally-by taking to the tracks to demonstrate their healthy lifestyle theories.
Greatly moved, the bailiffs also joined in, running for the whole morning to improve their fitness.
Feeling that the experts' advice was spot on, the bailiffs willingly promoted them. Before long, everyone in the town had heard their shouts.
"Hold on, you two!"
"You bloody jerks, I promise I won't kill you!"
"What do you have against meat buns!"
Enraged, the bailiffs were hot on the heels of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
Fearing to be caught, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou sprinted ahead, leaving a cloud of dust behind them.
While running, Lu Yang said, "Rules never deceive, you see how dangerous these bailiffs are, chasing us for no reason at all. We can't let them catch up."
Meng Jingzhou agreed, "Exactly, we are lucky to be in the Foundation Establishment Stage, otherwise we would've been caught long ago."
The bailiffs attempted to cut them off, but the two were already familiar with the town layout and easily evaded them.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou led the bailiffs on a chase all day till dusk. Towards the end, the bailiffs were clearly exhausted, gasping for breath and their steps faltering.
At around 9 p.m., they returned to the inn with their meat buns. The bailiffs glared at them, they left unwillingly to their government office.
As per the "Buyi Town Bailiff Rules", they had to stay in the government office from 9 p.m. to 3 a.m.
To their regret, because they had prepared a surprise for the bailiffs at the inn. What a pity.
By 9 a.m. the next day, the usually lethargic bailiffs arrived on the dot at the restaurant.
Usually, they arrived 15 minutes late to scare the crowd gathered there. If they were lucky, they'd even manage to wring a few necks.
But that morning, for want of meat buns, they abandoned this habit.
Having failed to eat any meat buns after running all day, they were so hungry that they rushed in and gobbled up their food before Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou could interfere.
Halfway through their meal, they spotted Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou leisurely emerging from the inn.
"You dare to show your face!" Recalling yesterday's fiasco, the bailiffs were filled with rage, vowing to capture them.
Lu Yang, unperturbed, replied, "I would advise you not to chase us, or you'll meet with a terrible end."
"Who do you think you're scaring!" The head bailiff clearly didn't believe Lu Yang, considering his threat to be empty words.
There are only twenty-one rules in Buyi Town. There's no way Lu Yang's prediction could come true.
"Charge!"
Seeing that their warning wasn't heeded, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou sighed and bolted.
Before long, the bailiffs collapsed onto the ground, clutching their stomachs, "My belly hurts!"
Like a chain reaction, one by one, the bailiffs screamed in pain, even the chief bailiff couldn't bear it, curling up on the floor, unable to stand.
"The meat buns are poisonous…" The chief bailiff glared at Lu Yang, certain that they had poisoned them.
Lu Yang sauntered over and said, "I warned you not to chase us. But you didn't listen, and look where it landed you."
"Where did you get the poison!" The chief bailiff couldn't comprehend. The pharmacist would never provide poison to Lu Yang; how did he get it?
Lu Yang squatted down, patted the chief bailiff's head, and said kindly, "Remember, don't indulge in intense activities after a meal, or it could lead to appendicitis."
"Read more. Don't assume everything is poison. We're from a Righteous Sect, why would we use poison?"
As one of the Five Great Immortal Sects, the Seek Dao Sect always acted uprightly, never resorting to such disgraceful tactics as poisoning.
At least, none of their surviving enemies had experienced being poisoned by the Seek Dao Sect.
Meanwhile, the bailiffs writhed in abdominal pain. Those that were unaffected stood in fear of Lu Yang, daring not move. Thus, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou calmly made their escape under the watchful gazes of the bailiffs.
What they didn't notice were the horrified looks from the townsfolk who watched them on the roadside.
"Thank goodness they're following general regulations. If they wore black cloaks and became bailiffs, would we even stand a chance?"
"Exactly. They claimed to be from a Righteous Sect, but who knows, they may be undercover agents from some demonic sect infiltrated into the Righteous Path!"
The townsfolk of Buyi Town were relieved that Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were on their side. Otherwise, they were afraid they wouldn't last three days.
By 9 a.m. the next day, the bailiffs became clever. They grabbed meat buns but didn't eat them. Instead, they clustered around the entrance of the inn.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou anticipated this and escaped through the inn's second-floor window.
"Chase them! Don't let them escape!" After repressing their anger for two whole days, recalling yesterday's painful experience further fueled their rage, making them long to tear them to pieces.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou escaped more efficiently than before. What the bailiffs didn't realize was that they had run right into the territory of a private school.
The private school's master saw Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou and gritted his teeth in anger, summoning his students who were studying in the school.
However, his students could hardly be called human anymore. They were covered in black fur, had elongated mouths, and some were so severely affected they crawled on the ground, looking almost like black dogs.
"Catch them!" the schoolmaster commanded.
The bailiffs were outraged. How dare they try to steal their catch!
The schoolmaster tried to catch Lu Yang's eye, but Lu Yang was prepared and swiftly whipped out a brassy mirror, blocking his face.
"Take a good look at your wretched face!"
Seeing his own skinless face and blood-red eyes reflected in the mirror, the schoolmaster let out a scream, rapidly retreated to his academy, sealing his mouth shut.
Without the schoolmaster's command, his students, or rather, the black dogmen, resorted to their last orders and grappled with the bailiffs.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, amidst the chaos, took the opportunity to grab a bailiff, intending to remove his uniform. However, they found it impossible to strip him off.
They resorted to searching the bailiff to retrieve the "Buyi Town Bailiff Rules".
Just like the inn's waiter, to prevent forgetting the rules, the bailiffs always carried a copy of the rules with them.
Now that they had their desired item, they retreated hastily.
As for the bailiffs, they decided to respect their wish. If they wanted to fight, then so be it.

chapters.title: Chapter 139 - 138 Calculations (Thanks to book friend BuiBuibui for the reward of Alliance Leader)_1
chapters.content:
Outside Buyi Town, five Unification stage Great Powers were engaged in battle, which had been ongoing for five days now.
Four ancient Unification stage warriors controlled the domain, preventing the residual waves of the battle from leaking out. Daoist Buyu unleashed his field of attack with fierce intensity.
"Damn, why did we have to meet the most difficult Sword Cultivator!" one of the Unification stage warriors complained. Historically, Sword Cultivators were always the toughest opponents. The first Unification stage warrior they encountered from the current era was a Sword Cultivator, whose luck seemed to have reached a complete low point.
Among them, four were in the late stage or peak of Unification. It was hard to deny the strength of their alliance; their seamless coordination was unmatched in the Unification stage. Yet, against Daoist Buyu, they gained no advantage. Even a slight miscalculation could lead to a fatal risk.
This was partly because they were upholding the rules of Buyi Town and had not fully awakened from their long slumber. Despite that, it was evidence of the terrifying power of Daoist Buyi.
"Even in our era, there were no such Unification stage Sword Cultivators!" Another Unification stage Great Power spat out a mouthful of Essence Blood. His momentum had been fluctuating, having been wounded by a sword. He needed to concentrate on healing.
"Thankfully, we have the advantage of numbers. He is only one person. A prolonged battle is in our favor. If we drag this on for ten more days, I refuse to believe he can maintain such vigor and vitality!"
"Is Buyi Town okay? If someone exploits the rules and finds a legitimate way to leave, then we will face the backlash."
The rule breaking method of Daoist Buyi using Sword Qi was clearly not "legitimate."
"What's there to fear? Old Five is the mayor. Even though he Possesses someone, those young ones can't handle him."
"True." Thinking about Old Five in Buyi Town, the four of them put their worries aside and slowly battled Daoist Buyi.
Hearing this, Daoist Buyu was concerned for Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
"I told them to stay in Buyi Town. They should listen, right?"
Thinking about Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou in Buyi Town, Daoist Buyu believed they were good and obedient children. He continued his gradual battle with the four.
Xiao Yun would certainly be worried about Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou being taken away by him. If it took too long, she would come looking for him.
"One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand!" Daoist Buyu roared, as if intending to unleash his full power for swift decisiveness, which scared the four of them.
One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand was a famous move during ancient times. They naturally knew about it.
Daoist Buyu raised his hand, and golden Sword Qi shone like the sun. With a flicker of the sword, ten thousand swords appeared, all with tangible forms, making it impossible to distinguish the real from the false.
As the myriad of swords descended, it was like a storm, unfathomable in its power.
"Be careful. He's making a last-ditch effort!" One of them reminded the others.
Daoist Buyu changed his sword technique again, "Unification of Man and Sword!"
His figure completely disappeared, merging with the sword.
With tens of thousands of swords present, the four of them had no idea which sword Daoist Buyu had unified with. They couldn't even find him.
The four of them were so frustrated that they wanted to vomit blood. They had never heard of such a time-consuming method!
"You call yourself a Sword Cultivator!"
...
[Buyi Town Government Official Rules]
[Rule One: Those in black clothing are government officials. Once put on, it cannot be taken off]
[Rule Two: You can call upon anyone at will. The person's neck will be twisted if called upon]
[Rule Three: There are only fifty officials and one mayor in the government office. If you see others, ignore them]
[Rule Four: Between 9 p.m. and 11 p.m., you must stay in the government office]
[Rule Five: Your only food is meat buns. If you don't eat for three days, you will die]
[Rule Six: The mayor only has one head and two arms]
[Rule Seven: If you feel dizzy, have blurred vision, or grow black hair on your arms, and it doesn't recover within an hour, you may ignore rule four and head to the Ancestral Hall immediately]
[Rule Eight: You won't see the mayor between 9 p.m. and 11 p.m. If you do, firmly believe it is an illusion]
[Rule Nine: If you have broken the necks of 100 people, you can choose to stay or leave Buyi Town. After leaving, all memories of Buyi Town will be lost]
[Rule Ten: Without violating the above rules, you must comply with the mayor's orders]
[Rule Eleven: In the center of the town, there is a 300-year-old pagoda tree. During 9 p.m. to 11 p.m., it transforms into the Ancestral Hall]
"We finally know the location of the Ancestral Hall." Meng Jingzhou laughed. They were initially planning to stir up some trouble to find out the location of the Ancestral Hall. Now, it felt like they were lucky, an unexpected joy.
Lu Yang, on the other hand, paid attention to another matter. After all, they had gone through a lot of trouble to learn the rules related to Buyi Town's government officials to discover the whereabouts of the mayor.
"It's a bit tricky. The rules state, 'you must stay in the government office between 9 p.m. and 11 p.m.,' and 'you will not see the mayor during this time, if you do, believe it to be an illusion.' which indicates that the mayor is not in the government office between 9 p.m. and 11 p.m."
If they are unaware of the whereabouts of the mayor, they may encounter the mayor while going to the Ancestral Hall.
"We shouldn't face the mayor lightly. The mayor's abilities should not be limited to one, and we're also not sure how strong he is."
"We should try to avoid him."
All of a sudden, as if he had uncovered something, Lu Yang said, "Did you notice? Between 9 p.m. and 11 p.m., the mayor is not in the government office. During this period, the thatched hut and the inn are safe. There is only danger left on the streets."
"What is on the streets? Only monsters! It is highly possible that the mayor is the monster!"
Meng Jingzhou frowned, "But look, the rules also say 'the mayor only has one head and two arms' Does the monster look like that?"
Lu Yang nodded, "Do you remember the shadow outside our window on our first night? It was two stories high, and the upper body was like a human, which does not conflict with the description in the rule."
"The rules don't describe what the lower body looks like!"
Meng Jingzhou made a decision, "In the period from 9 p.m. to 11 p.m., we won't return to the inn. We will stand by the big pagoda tree, and as soon as it turns into the Ancestral Hall, we rush in, break the Buddha statue, throw the jade pendant in, and then split up to quickly return to the inn."
If they split up, should one of them encounter the monster, the other would still be safe. This way, at least one of them would be safeguarded.
"The monster may not dare to attack us. Our lives are connected to the Soul Lamp. Once we die, the Soul Lamp extinguishes and members from our Sects will come. These Unification stage warriors will inevitably die!" Lu Yang seemed to be speaking to Meng Jingzhou, but in fact, he was addressing the all-knowing mayor.
Both of them headed to the big pagoda tree in the center of the town, as time ticked away.
As 9 p.m. approached, accompanied by the town crier's shout and the gong's sound, the space where the big pagoda tree was began to distort gradually, and it turned into an old, wooden Ancestral Hall. An inscription outside read, "Buyi Town Ancestral Hall Rules."
Both were incredibly nervous and subconsciously reached for the jade pendant on their waists. Their expressions dramatically changed.
"The jade pendant is gone!" Both shouted in unison.
At this moment, a muffled voice came from inside the Ancestral Hall, "Hehe, you two ignorant children. If you can find the paper with 'Buyi Town Government Official Rules' while creating chaos, then why can't I order the government officials to steal your jade pendants during the chaos?"
Rule Ten of the Buyi Town Government Official Rules: [Without violating the above rules, you must obey the mayor's commands]

chapters.title: Chapter 140 - 139 Who is the Hunter?_1
chapters.content:
"Damn it, it's not that simple after all!" said Lu Yang, frowning deeply.
The town head or monster was in the Ancestral Hall, and their situation had become extremely perilous.
"What should we do?" Meng Jingzhou's complexion was grave as his mind raced to work out a strategy.
Out of the corner of his eye, Lu Yang caught sight of the rules posted at the entrance of the Ancestral Hall.
[Buyi Town Ancestral Hall Rules]
[Rule 1: If you are wearing black or white clothes, and feel dizzy, or have black hair growing on your arm, please enter the Ancestral Hall, worship the Buddha statue, and drink the water in front of it.]
[Rule 2: The Buddha statue in the Ancestral Hall cannot be damaged.]
[Rule 3: There is a man-eating monster in the Ancestral Hall.]
[Rule 4: The Ancestral Hall is safe.]
"Into the Ancestral Hall!" Lu Yang decisively entered the Ancestral Hall.
At first glance, the third and fourth rules of the Ancestral Hall contradict each other, suggesting that one of them must be false. Instead, they both hold a consistent interpretation based on Lu Yang's understanding of the rules after several days: the Ancestral Hall does house a monster, but the monster cannot eat people in the Ancestral Hall.
So entering the Ancestral Hall was indeed the safest option!
The pair ran into the Ancestral Hall, where they finally got a look at the true form of the town head - a monster they had never seen before.
The town head was half-human, half-beast, standing as tall as a two-story building. His upper body was similar to that of a man except for a third eye in the middle of his forehead and his mouth, which was split to his ears like a Python.
The lower body of the town head resembled an enormous horse, but no horse had eight human-like legs.
Lu Yang also noticed a thick tail behind the town head. His tail gently touched the ground, kicking up dust, but it was too dim in the Ancestral Hall to make out the tail of what breed of the Demon Race.
There were no customary ancestoral tablets positioned in the Ancestral Hall; instead, the center of the hall housed a half-naked Buddha statue with its eyes covered. It was both seductive and bizarre.
Three bowls of clear water were placed in front of the Buddha statue, which according to the first rule of Ancestral Hall, could presumably cure the black dog transformation.
The town head looked up at the two men who had just barged in, somewhat surprised. "It seems I was right to handle you myself, given how quickly you made your decision. You two are indeed not ordinary."
"Thanks for personally stepping in, Mr. Town head. But you may as well go back," Meng Jingzhou talked back as usual.
The town head didn't say anything more. He noticed Lu Yang's group as soon as their flying car crashed. However, as Daoist Buyu was the highest level cultivator and he had left town, and these two were youngsters with low-level cultivation, the town head didn't pay them much attention.
It was only after they cleverly resolved the issue with the innkeeper using the rules that the town head began to take them seriously. He realized that they seemed to be very adept at using the rules, which made them a threat.
The town head wanted to deal with them, but these two were not easily fooled. So, he decided to play along with their trap.
Being the town head, he was privy to everything that happened in Buyi Town, and the two men couldn't hide their escape plan by writing it on paper from his three eyes.
Such geniuses often have a flaw of overconfidence, assuming that no one can outwit them. The town head exploited this mindset, allowing them to come up with an escape plan, and even let them play around with the constables. In the end, he stole the jade pendant, thwarting their plan and intended to deal with them in the Ancestral Hall.
These two were very cautious, never venturing out of the inn at night. Forcing the town head to deliberately expose a flaw to lure them out of their hole.
Now, it was time to close the net!
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou looked disturbed. Being intelligent, they immediately understood that they had fallen into the town head's trap.
They were too careless!
The town head stopped the chit-chat, his tail moved like lighting, sending Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou flying before they even had a chance to react. They slammed into the wall.
Fortunately, due to the rule that [the Ancestral Hall is safe], they remained unharmed. Otherwise, just that one blow would have been enough to kill them both!
The two felt their hearts sink. The disparity in strength and speed between them and the town head was enormous, and there was no way to make up for it. Not to mention the town head was immortal. Even if he could die, they would not be able to harm him.
The town head knew that he couldn't kill them in the Ancestral Hall, so his plan was to push them out!
Outside the Ancestral Hall, he was unstoppable!
The town head rushed at the pair with his massive body. Seeing the danger, they quickly slapped each other's palms, knocking each other and rolling away to avoid the town head's attack without having to discuss the strategy to do so.
"So, you do have some skills." The town head sneered, unimpressed. This minor trick could only work once on him.
"Get behind him!" Lu Yang shouted. The town head's massive size made it difficult for him to turn around in the confined space of the Ancestral Hall.
As the town head turned, Meng Jingzhou raised the Buddha statue and smashed it towards him.
[In the Ancestral Hall, the Buddha statue cannot be damaged.]
A Buddha statue that cannot be damaged made the best weapon!
"That's all?" The town head didn't move an inch despite facing a Buddha statue carved out of massive rocks.
He punched at the pair. His blow was so powerful that it broke the sound barrier and whipped up a storm in the confined Ancestral Hall. It was an incredible feat of strength!
As the fifth man in the Unification, he didn't become the town head for fun. His body failed him during hibernation, essentially rendering him physically dead.
