He woke up with only his soul remaining. To compete for opportunities in the Great Era, he possessed the town head and modified his body using an ancient cultvation technique to appear as he currently does.
Although the form may appear grotesque and strange, as a cultivator strength triumphed over everything else. This form was his strongest state, and he was certain that he would make a mark in the Great Era!
HIs speeding fist was deific. Lu Yang was immediately lifted off his feet, he countered with an ordinary Tiger Fist, imitating a tiger to adjust his body in the air and gently landed on the ground, thus managing to lessen most of the impact.
Meng Jingzhou was tightly holding onto the Buddha statue, the impact sent him along with the Buddha statue flying out of the Ancestral Hall.
"Don't let the Buddha statue fall to the ground! If it breaks, you'll die!" Lu Yang warned loudly.
Meng Jingzhou also realized the danger. The Buddha statue he was holding onto was not a pathway to the outside world, but a ticking time bomb!
With a booming voice, Meng Jingzhou's muscles bulged, his skin turned crimson, and he stomped his feet hard, exerting his full strength with both arms to steady his body and the Buddha statue. That's how he managed to stop the Buddha statue from falling and breaking.
"Get back to the Ancestral Hall!" yelled Lu Yang. They were both outside the Ancestral Hall right now, one hit from the town head and they'd be dead!
"You want to come in?" The town head sneered. The door of the Ancestral Hall was as tall as two levels of a building, and he took up the entire doorway. As long as he was there, there was no way these two could enter the Ancestral Hall!
"All or nothing!" Lu Yang charged at the town head. His footwork was light, and he might have a chance of slipping under the town head's body.
The town head was well aware of Lu Yang's intentions, thus stepped forward with both front legs, attempting to trample this annoying brat.
But then, Lu Yang abruptly altered his footwork, darting sideways, leaving the town head to stomp on nothing.
"Finally managed to lure you out," Lu Yang said with a sly smile.
The town head felt a sense of foreboding at seeing Lu Yang's smile. He jerked his head upwards, only to see Meng Jingzhou once again lift the Buddha statue and throw it at him!
As the Buddha statue shattered, the Chaos channel to the outside world opened beneath the town head's feet. The destructive aura of the channel swept over the town head, felt as if thousands of knives were slicing his skin, carving his flesh away, and the agonizing pain penetrated to the bone, making the town head scream in pain.
The town head tried desperately to escape, but he was trapped by the Chaos channel and couldn't get out.
When designing the channel, the ancient Unifications set a rule that those who step into the channel are bound to die. Nobody could escape!
Those who attempted to break the Buddha statue to escape the town were walking the path of certain death!
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou exchanged cold smiles: "Those who enter the channel are doomed, and you are immortal. Now I am curious to see whose rule is stronger, the channel's or yours!"
From the very beginning, the two of them had no intention of seeking help from the Seek Dao Sect using the jade pendant.
The jade pendant was nothing but a diversion.

chapters.title: Chapter 141 - 140: Discussing Possession In Front Of Me, Yellow Bean?_1
chapters.content:
Rule number twenty-one of Buyi Town: [One need not adhere to the rules of Buyi Town if they leave the town or kill the Rudder Master]
When the owner of the medicine shop explained the implication of Rule number twenty-one to Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, they were both reminded of the same idea.
Since they couldn't leave the town or kill the rudder master, which of them would have the upper hand if the two were put into competition?
If the answer is unknown, then they might as well try.
Either way, whether the Rudder Master leaves the town or if they kill him, it would be beneficial for them.
If the Rudder Master leaves the town, then Buyi town becomes theirs. They could find another way to leave, such as using the private school teacher as a leverage.
Moreover, both of them didn't believe that the Rudder Master leaving Buyi town wouldn't shake it up a bit.
If they could kill the Rudder Master, then that would be even better. The two of them would be able to surpass him directly.
However, it's not as easy as one may think to make the Rudder Master enter the departure passageway.
They didn't know the location of the Ancestral Hall nor the identity of the Rudder Master.
No matter, they would stir up the waters of Buyi Town, then the Rudder Master would have to make a move.
Those who set the rules wouldn't tolerate someone trying to break them as it would be akin to a direct slap to their face, pointing out the loopholes in their rules.
And so, the two of them chose to cause widespread disruption in Buyi Town using the rules.
Lu Yang started by throwing a smoke bomb, concocting the functionality of the jade pendant, deliberately communicating through paper, giving off the vibe that this was an unorthodox method that should be kept a secret.
Knowing that nothing that happened in the Little Town could escape the eyes of the Rudder Master, would Lu Yang dare to speak out or write down the method to overcome him?
The Rudder Master laughs at Lu Yang and the company's arrogance, but fails to realize that he is also part of the arrogant gang. He was surprisingly fooled by Lu Yang and focused all his attention on the jade pendant.
Afterwards, the two of them played tricks on the county officials three times, telling the Rudder Master that his people were no match for them.
The people under his command posed no threat, and the Rudder Master had no choice but to personally resolve their trickeries.
The Rudder Master believed that by stealing the jade pendant, everything would be fine. He waited in the ancestral hall for the two of them to walk into the trap, only to realize that the two of them never intended to use the jade pendant. They just wanted the Rudder Master to appear in the Ancestral Hall.
As for how Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou discussed, such a simple trick didn't require any deliberation.
What kind of demonic sect Rudder Master would he be if he didn't have many tricks up his sleeve?
...
Fast forward to the present time, at the entrance of the Ancestral Hall, the Rudder Master is deeply trapped in the bone-dissolving protective aura. The rule of Immortality and the "must die" rule are competing against each other. His body is constantly lost and restored, and the pain makes him wish he could kill himself on the spot.
"What on earth is this thing?" Lu Yang observed the Rudder Master, and claimed he had never seen such a monster.
"This is Beastification!" Fairy Eternity explained within Lu Yang's mind.
"Beastification?" Lu Yang rifled through his stored knowledge on Cultivation within his mind but found no corresponding term.
It must be a cultivation method from ancient times, which has now been lost.
Fairy Eternity continued: "This cultivation method was popular during the ancient times. By using the Human Race's body to devour the Demon Race's, they could take advantage of both the human and the demon's strengths—it was incredibly powerful. However, this cultivation method also had significant drawbacks, mainly the inability to achieve immortality."
"One needs a pure body to achieve immortality. This kind of body, which is something of a cross between human and demon, can't form the Dao Fruit critical for ascension. As a result, eventually, no one practiced this method anymore."
"You mean to say this opponent is somebody from ancient times?" Lu Yang was puzzled.
"Not likely. People in ancient times all knew about the disadvantages of this kind of cultivation method. More likely, it's somebody from later generations who have gotten their hands on this method and only know about its advantages, not the drawbacks."
"It's perfectly normal to think that the older and more lost something is, the better it must be. But old things aren't necessarily powerful, and if something is lost, there's always a reason. Maybe no one was able to cultivate it, or maybe no one wanted to. You have to look at things objectively." Fairy Eternity shrugged, this kind of thing was very common in ancient times.
Like a youth who accidentally enters an ancient relic and obtains an ancient cultivation method. They might think they'll be invincible, but they don't realize that it's precisely because the method is too old that it's incomplete. Once they reach the nascent soul stage, the path is entirely cut off.
Who knows how many generations of cultivation methods have been changed, and how many people have died, before a complete path was formed—from the initial stage of qi introduction to becoming immortal.
Having been around for a long time, Fairy Eternity could easily reveal many pieces of knowledge no one knew about these days.
The Rudder Master glared at Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, knowing that he was definitely not a fool. He knew he had fallen into a trap and immediately understood the calculations made by the two.
Unfortunately, it was too late.
Eventually, the rule of Immortality was no match for the "Must Die" rule, and the Rudder Master's body disappeared.
The outcome was as predicted by Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou. Daoist Buyu had initially said that rules couldn't be too defying, such as the "Absolutely Invincible, Absolutely Immortal" type.
The Rudder Master's "Will Not Die" rule wouldn't be too absolute.
"Death? I, True Master Faxian, am indestructible, with a soul that never perishes. How could I capsize here!" A black soul jumped out of the Rudder Master's body, it was different from the Rudder Master's appearance.
The Rudder Master was the host for True Master Faxian to possess, not his true form.
Theoretically, since the Rudder Master's physical body is dead, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou have passed the checkpoint. But True Master Faxian couldn't stand this humiliation. As a high-ranking Great Power in the Unification Stage who had lived for thousands of years, he had outsmarted countless opponents. Yet he was tricked by two people in the Foundation Establishment Stage.
He couldn't bear it any longer!
Even if he had to break the rules today and risk damage to his soul, he had to kill these two kids.
"Hmmm, you still have the Sword Spirit Root?" Without the constraints of a physical body, True Master Faxian was more sensitive. He detected that one of the two was a Single Body Spiritual Root and the other was a Sword Spirit Root. They both had top-notch roots, both of which were hundreds of times stronger than the Rudder Master.
The Sword Spirit Root was the strongest in terms of attack capabilities. If there were a body of the Sword Spirit Root, combined with his "Defeating Immortals Secret Technique", he would inevitably surpass his previous self, break through the limitations and possibly reach the Transcendence Tribulation Stage!
And with his "Defeating Immortals Secret Technique", even at the peak of the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, he could defeat immortals. He would be invincible. Even when the Great Era comes, who would have the capability to handle him?
"It seems that this is an opportunity given to me by the heavens!" True Master Faxian laughed heartily. He couldn't believe such a large harvest was at hand. It was like there was light at the end of the tunnel.
He regarded Lu Yang's body as something he could easily obtain. What kind of waves could the Foundation Establishment Stage stir up in front of the Unification Stage?
He transformed into a cloud of grey mist, entered Lu Yang's spiritual space, and prepared to possess Lu Yang.
Lu Yang stared in disbelief at True Master Faxian, a look of horror written all over his face: "You... You're at the Unification Stage, yet you don't even respect your own rules. And you wish to possess me?!"
True Master Faxian sneered coldly, looking down on Lu Yang with disdain. Ultimately, he was just a child, not understanding the true nature of the world: "I will let you in on a principle before you die, to ease your passing."
"Whoever is stronger is right; this principle has stood unchallenged since the beginning of time. If you're not qualified enough to annoy a Unification Stage cultivator, then you should be well-behaved and realize your place!"
Lu Yang sighed: "Let's all play by the rules and compete fairly. Since you're willing to play by the rules, don't blame me for flipping the table!"
He made a sidestep, revealing the person behind him. He made a gesture of surrender: "Fairy, it's up to you now."
Then True Master Faxian saw Fairy Eternity, who was sitting with her legs crossed in front of him.
Fairy Eternity looked arrogantly at True Master Faxian. A trace of a faint smile appeared on her lips, as if she were mocking or looking down on him: "Young man, you're brave to talk about possession in front of me."
"Hmmm?"
True Master Faxian was left perplexed. Why were there two people in the spiritual world, and why did the other person refer to themselves as an Immortal?
Unexplainably, he had a feeling of impending disaster.

chapters.title: Chapter 142 - 141: The Might of the Immortal_1
chapters.content:
Inside the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity lifted her jade foot, glanced at True Master Faxian without care, her eyes slightly closed, her expression lazy. She stretched out her delicate fingers, admiring them without giving True Master Faxian any attention.
"Who are you?!" True Master Faxian shouted, he was confused at heart. There should only be Lu Yang in this Spiritual Space, how could there be two people, it defied common sense!
Moreover, he had just attempted to explore the realm of this lazy woman, but he found that he could not see through.
This means that the opponent is at least equivalent to his realm.
Why would they choose to stay in the Spiritual Space of a cultivator at the Foundation Establishment Stage?
Fairy Eternity yawned and ignored True Master Faxian's words.
True Master Faxian was furious, as cultivators at the Unification Stage, he should not be subjected to such humiliation.
Since the opponent didn't even show interest in conversation, we'll know the real strength by a showdown!
True Master Faxian, with his spirit, condensed the Bull Demon Emperor Blade. He stood on his feet, like two circling flood dragons, rooted in place, the power underneath him transmitting upwards, his spiritual body making a crackling sound, like opening the gates of power, releasing all his strength!
He gathered all his strength into the Emperor Blade, the blade's light was overwhelming, hurting the eyes!
An overwhelming image of the Bull Demon Emperor filled the entire Spiritual Space. The Bull Demon's eyes were red, muscles bulging, its strength seemed infinite, indeed one of the famed beasts from ancient times!
The Emperor Blade slashed down, like the gathered strength of the mountains and seas heading towards Fairy Eternity. This power was so large, it gave a sense of being able to destroy everything in the world.
This was True Master Faxian's famed secret technique, with the power to destroy any obstacles in his path!
"Bull Demon Emperor Blade!"
The image of the Bull Demon also moved, attempting to trample over Fairy Eternity. True Master Faxian wanted to use all his power to crush her, to show her the gap between them and what it meant to respect the strong!
In response to True Master Faxian's full-strength attack, Fairy Eternity didn't even raise her eyebrows, but lightly spit out two words.
"Shut up."
The two words 'shut up' were said casually without any earthly fire, but they were as heavy as countless mountains, pressing down on True Master Faxian.
True Master Faxian only felt an inexplicable divine force descend from the sky, pressing down on him, leaving no room for resistance.
Under the pressure of 'shut up', the image of the Bull Demon vanished, the blade made from his spirit crumbled, all the anomalies disappeared into the smoke.
With a thud, True Master Faxian knelt on the ground, unable to lift a finger.
True Master Faxian was greatly shocked, her strength far exceeded his comprehension, this was definitely not a force that could be grasped at the Unification Stage!
Was it Transcendance Tribulation, or even higher... True Master Faxian dared not think further.
He remembered very clearly, she had just referred to herself as a 'fairy'.
There was an insurmountable gap between the Unification Stage and the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, impossible to cross by any means. The difference between the two realms was like cloud and mud, leaving True Master Faxian unable to resist.
The gap at a further realm, completely exceeded his imagination.
"Senior, there may be some misunderstandings between us..." True Master Faxian put on an ingratiating smile and tried to explain to Fairy Eternity.
Being able to reach the Unification Stage in ancient times naturally implies the ability to adapt.
Fairy Eternity finally raised her eyelids, looked at True Master Faxian kneeling on the ground. Her brows knitted slightly.
"Who allows you to look straight at me?"
Another divine force descended, pressing True Master Faxian's head and causing him to completely lose the heart to resist.
True Master Faxian was filled with bitterness. He thought that Lu Yang was a reward from heaven to him, but when the time to possess him came, he found out that heaven had made him a reward to Lu Yang.
Why does the Spiritual Space of a cultivator at the Foundation Establishment Stage have such a powerful existence?
"Now, I allow you to explain what happened." Fairy Eternity opened her mouth lightly.
True Master Faxian didn't dare to conceal anything, he knew that some people had the ability to discern truth from lies. He didn't dare to gamble whether the big person in front of him had this ability or not.
"I call myself True Master Faxian, there are four other Unification Stage cultivators outside Buyi Town. We five are from the same generation of the Great Yu dynasty. Due to our limited talent, we are stuck at the Unification Stage without any progress, the Transcendence Tribulation is a target we can only dream of."
"At that time, we heard a rumor, this rumor is unknown where it came from, the rumor said that now the spirits are not active, the Spiritual Energy is in a dormant period, it is very difficult to cultivate.
But after more than a hundred thousand years, the Spiritual Energy will gradually awake, reappearing the ancient times of prosperity, by that time, various opportunities will emerge and it will not be impossible to become Immortal."
"Some people say the rumor came from the palace, some say the Imperial Teacher calculated it, and others say it was an inspiration obtained by observing the sun. There was every kind of saying."
"We five discussed it together and felt that since we can't become Transcendent now, instead of living freely in the Great Yu, why not seal ourselves with Spirit-Stone Marrow and quietly wait for the world to become active again."
"Even if the rumor is false, we won't lose out. Five Unification Stage cultivators, at any time, in any place, are a force to be reckoned with."
"We five awakened from beneath Buyi Town and were surprised to find that the stagnant bottleneck had loosened. The current era is indeed better for cultivation than in our time."
"We still have some time before we are fully awake, and we don't want to be discovered by cultivators of this era, so we jointly constructed the rules of Buyi Town, while we restored our powers, we collected information."
"I was the most unlucky, the Spirit-Stone Marrow that sealed me had a problem, my body died as time passed. The Spirit-Stone Marrow only sealed my soul."
"After I woke up, I possessed the person with the best aptitude nearby. My body was fragile and prone to accidents. To protect myself, we five decided that it would be best for me to become the mayor of Buyi Town.".
"And so, I became an immortal being, devouring mortals and wild beasts alike, accelerating my cultivation and quickly learning the "Defeating Immortals Secret Technique."
True Master Faxian confessed to everything truthfully on the ground, he did not dare to raise his head, and he could not see Fairy Eternity's small actions.
Fairy Eternity winked at Lu Yang, her jade foot excitedly tapping. The meaning was to show him that she also had reliable moments, and he should respect her more in the future.
Ever since Fairy Eternity resurrected, she has been on the losing end. First suppressed by the Eldest Senior Sister, later failed in showing her advantages to Lu Yang, this time she finally found an opportunity to show off, how could she not put on a good show?
Lu Yang sighed silently, Fairy, with this attitude, how can I believe you are reliable?
Fairy Eternity felt that Lu Yang's gaze towards her did not seem very respectful. She pursed her lips and ignored Lu Yang.
Clearly, she had shown herself to be very reliable.

chapters.title: Chapter 143 - 142: Successfully Leaving Buyi Town_1
chapters.content:
"Defeating Immortals Secret Technique?" Fairy Eternity narrowed her eyes, she had never heard of such a arrogantly named secret technique before.
Immortality represents the pinnacle of the cultivation path, impossible to challenge across levels. If an Immortal could be slain in reverse, what would be the point of becoming an Immortal?
"Ye-yes." True Master Faxian replied nervously, offering the "Defeating Immortals Secret Technique", from which his Taoist name is derived from.
"When I was young, I accidentally entered a Secret Realm, left behind by an ancient Great Power. It was filled with countless natural treasures and it was through these that I cultivated to the Unification stage."
True Master Faxian continued, "The most precious item in the Secret Realm was the "Defeating Immortals Secret Technique". According to the description in the book, an Immortal is the king of all beings and possesses unparalleled power. To defeat an Immortal, one must find a different path.
The book suggests that one can accumulate the strengths of all beings, if someone possesses the transformative abilities of the Kun Peng, the power to control water of the Long Clan, the ability to control fire of the Phoenix Tribe, and the wisdom of the human race... if they possess all these strengths, they would be able to slay an Immortal with mortal power!"
Fairy Eternity flipped through the secret technique and tossed it to Lu Yang, "What is this nonsense? They made it sound so impressive, but it turns out to be a Beastification cultivation method."
Fairy Eternity had just mentioned Beastification, a practice with a mottled bloodline that could not achieve immortality, which was abandoned in ancient times.
As for the power to slay Immortals mentioned in the secret technique, Fairy Eternity was even more dismissive.
If it really was as powerful as they bragged, would it have been abandoned?
"So you're implying that everything written in here is fake?" Lu Yang flipped through the content, but it was too complex for him to understand in a short time.
Fairy Eternity scratched her chin, "I reckon that the creator of the Beastification Cultivation Method wasn't satisfied with it being abandoned. But in ancient times, everyone knew what this cultivation method was about, it was totally unreliable and no one would fall for it."
"So they simply changed the cover of the Beastification Cultivation Method, added a few lines of preface, changed the name, and threw it into the Cave Heaven. After a long time, when the number of people who knew about the Beastification Cultivation Method dwindled, some idiot would find it, believe what was written in it, thus spreading the Beastification Cultivation Method."
Fairy Eternity said scornfully, "Anyone can brag, I even claimed that I could beat that lass Yun Zhi."
Lu Yang suspected that Fairy Eternity was intentionally messing with him.
She continued to educate Lu Yang, "Don't assume that everything written in an ancient book is true. In our time, forgery was rampant, and there were more fake items than real ones."
"At that time, we even invented a whole Heavenly Court system, upon becoming an Immortal you ascend to the Immortal World, which has Human Immortals, Earth Immortals, Sky Immortals and so on, there are even the Five Direction Emperors. If you ever come across it, don't believe in it, it's all just made up for fun."
Lu Yang: "..."
Authenticating the events of ancient times was already difficult enough, yet they also forged records?
Lu Yang felt somewhat sorry for the old cultivators who were fond of verifying ancient times. They spent a lot of energy to research what happened in the ancient times and were awed by the grandeur suggested in their forged information, thinking that there were hierarchies above immortals, cultivation had no end, and compared to the ancient times, the present was far behind.
However, in reality, it all turned out to be just made-up.
Could the hearts of the old cultivators withstand such disappointment?
Luckily, until now, Lu Yang had never heard of the Heavenly Court System. Perhaps it had disappeared in the river of time, fortunately not misleading future generations.
The trembling True Master Faxian kneeled on the ground. While listening to Fairy Eternity's elaboration, he seemed to have learnt something astonishing.
The stories of the ancient times were so readily available to her, plus she referred to herself as "this immortal", all this indicated that there was no longer a need to doubt his own luck.
What about this Foundation Establishment Stage little guy? Despite his low realm, he could communicate equally with an ancient immortal. Could he be an ancient immortal himself?
Has he reincarnated or just taken possession of another's body?
True Master Faxian wished he could slap himself twice, regretting the name he chose. Of all possible names, he chose "Slaying Immortal" and blindly rushed into the Spiritual Space.
Was he seeking death?
True Master Faxian carefully moved backward, feeling less pressure, indicating that Fairy Eternity was not focusing on him. He planned to seize the opportunity while the two were chatting, to leave the Spiritual Space and escape.
Then he found that the Spiritual Space was so solid, it felt like a coffin, and there was no way to escape.
Fairy Eternity sneered, Lu Yang's Spiritual Space was equivalent to her home, could one come and go as they pleased in an Immortal's home?
"Want to leave? Then leave your life behind."
Fairy Eternity was disgusted with True Master Faxian's cultivation methods. In the beginning of the rule implementation, many people perished under the rule system. Look at the body of the town chief, it was the result of killing hundreds if not thousands of people.
As an Immortal belonging to the human race, Fairy Eternity wouldn't dare say she was great, nor that she had protected many humans. But she could claim that she had never caused harm to humans.
He must be killed.
Fairy Eternity extended a finger, True Master Faxian tried desperately to move his body, wanting to avoid the finger. But no matter how he moved, there was no escape.
This was an inescapable attack!
With a touch to his forehead, True Master Faxian's soul disintegrated.
...
"This person is difficult to deal with!" Outside of Buyi Town, four Unification Stage cultivators were finding it challenging to deal with Daoist Buyu.
They barely managed to identify the sword that Daoist Buyu had merged with amongst thousands of swords, intending to have a fair fight, only for Daoist Buyu to once again use the "One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand" and merge with his sword.
Can this technique be used repeatedly?!
"If you don't show up, we'll go to Buyi Town and kill those two kids!" cried an Unification Stage cultivator angrily. This was not a threat, they were capable of committing such an act.
Suddenly, thousands of swords formed into a large sphere, with their tips pointing inward, encircling the four men.
Thousands of swords then simultaneously attacked the four men, who didn't expect Daoist Buyu to suddenly exert his power and took a heavy hit.
Daoist Buyu revealed his true form, holding his Life-bound Sword and gazing intently at the four men, "I dare anyone to hurt them!"
The four men felt a chill in their hearts as they met Daoist Buyu's gaze. To confront a Supreme in Swordsmanship in a life and death struggle, at least two of them would have to fall.
One of them chuckled coldly, "You're bluffing. The town chief of Buyi Town is our companion. Do you think those juniors will be safe just because they strictly follow the rules?"
"What if our companion takes those juniors hostage, I'm intrigued to see your course of action. Will you dare to risk the lives of the juniors and kill us, or will you put down your sword and willingly die by our hands?"
Daoist Buyu clenched his teeth and gripped his sword tightly. If things were really as the opponent described, he would need to risk his lifespan and realm to kill the four men before anything happened!
As the two sides stood in a standoff, a teleportation array appeared outside Buyi Town. The four Unification Stage cultivators were about to provoke Daoist Buyu, stating that the two juniors had been captured by them, only to abruptly change color and cough up a mouthful of blood.
"How could this happen? Someone managed to leave Buyi Town using the rules?!"
If someone left Buyi Town, they would be backlashed.
The teleportation array vanished, and Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou successfully left Buyi Town. Lu Yang, holding the town chief's head, waved cheerfully to the people in the sky, his provocative intention not at all hidden.
"Puff-" The four Unification Stage cultivators coughed up blood again.

chapters.title: Chapter 144 - 143: Lu Yang, who is currently in a Fantasy Stage (Thanks to Shen Ying Lei Ming for the alliance reward)_1
chapters.content:
Including Daoist Buyu, no one expected Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou to successfully leave the small town.
There's an Unification stage cultivator in Buyi Town, not to mention the town's open and hidden rules that are too complex for ordinary people to understand.
Surviving in Buyi Town, let alone leaving, is a challenge in itself.
How did they manage to accomplish this?
Daoist Buyu didn't think too much about it. When the other four Unification cultivators coughed up blood and their momentum weakened, he seized the opportunity to strike with sudden force.
A deep blue Sword Qi enveloped him, lightly fluctuating like a pond of clear water. The Sword Qi, agile as a snake, drew a beautiful arc in the air, sending two heads flying.
Fairy Eternity sighed, "Your master is impressive; his skills are comparable to the peak sword cultivators of our era. With a single sword stroke, he's severed their physical bodies and souls, killing two Unification cultivators completely."
Lu Yang was amazed. Facing four alone, he'd killed two unawares. His master certainly lived up to his reputation.
The first appearances of Fairy Eternity and Daoist Buyu had been too disastrous: one being suppressed, and the other trapped in his abode for ten years. As a result, Lu Yang had subconsciously overlooked their identities.
One is an Immortal from ancient times. One of the five individuals who became Immortals during the chaotic ancient era. They were the strongest five individuals.
The other is the Sect Leader of one of the Five Great Immortal Sects. Even the current emperor would treat him with the highest etiquette. He is the youngest among the Seek Dao Sect's nine sons, started cultivation the latest, yet possesses the highest battle strength.
Any regular cultivator associated with these two would have an untroubled and successful life. But Lu Yang didn't feel that way at all.
"Is it really because of Eldest Senior Sister?" Lu Yang felt he'd found the root of the matter.
These two had struggled during their debut because of Eldest Senior Sister.
Now that Eldest Senior Sister is not around, they finally have a chance to show their abilities.
Daoist Buyu is gathering strength around his sword, looking radiant, preparing to strike again.
The other two sensed the danger, and without even grabbing their companions' bodies, they turned and ran.
Daoist Buyu did not pursue them. Though he could strike again, the two had gone on guard. They might withstand the attack, and if they did, their counterattack, though nothing to him personally, would be too much for Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou to bear.
"Are you two alright?" Daoist Buyu hurried to check on them and found they were unhurt, having apparently fared well these past few days in Buyi Town.
"We're fine." They waved, soaking in the spiritual energy, feeling a sense of awe, leaving Buyi Town and regaining feeling of harnessing spiritual essence felt great.
Not being able to use magic skills in Buyi Town had considerably limited their talents.
"That's good, that's good," Daoist Buyu sighed in relief, "just that the two got away."
"Speaking of which, isn't there also an Unification cultivator in Buyi Town? How did you handle them?" Daoist Buyu looked at Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou with curiosity, wondering if Xiao Yun had given Lu Yang a life-saving tool or the Meng Family had given Meng Jingzhou one.
Feeling that Daoist Buyu was trustworthy, Lu Yang explained, "Actually, there's an ancient Immortal sealed inside me who guides my cultivation and boosts my strength at critical moments, even to the point of slaying Unification cultivators."
Daoist Buyu looked at Lu Yang with pity, touched his head, thought about his age, and finally understood.
That made sense; a sixteen or seventeen-year-old was in a phase of fantasy.
When he was sixteen, he too had imagined having an ancient beast sealed within him; when people angered him, the seal would loosen, and the energy of the beast would leak out, hurting innocent people. He needed to maintain a cold attitude to ensure the beast remained sealed.
After all, didn't everyone go through this phase?
An ancient Immortal? He had lived for two thousand years and had never seen an ancient Immortal. Lu Yang was so lucky to not only meet an ancient Immortal but also to have one inside his body?
It must have been the life-saving measure Xiao Yun had left Lu Yang with.
"Is this ancient Immortal you mentioned an old man or a beauty?" Daoist Buyu asked.
Remembering the appearance of Fairy Eternity, Lu Yang found she was comparable to the Eldest Senior Sister in terms of beauty when she was calm, so he said, "A beauty."
As Daoist Buyu expected, the Immortal adolescents of his age fantasize about is either an old man or a beauty—it certainly wouldn't be a boy, a middle-aged man, or an old lady.
He looked at Buyi Town, still shrouded in rules, paused for a moment, and said, "Let's first visit the nearby government office and leave them the follow-up affairs."
The citizens in Buyi Town were too numerous. Despite his superior cultivation, when dealing with things that couldn't be solved with cultivation alone, he preferred to leave it to the professionals.
The issue at Buyi Town involved five ancient Unification cultivators, which exceeded the handling capacity of a County Magistrate. Thus, Daoist Buyu needed to find the Governor responsible for this province.
The Great Xia Dynasty divided the Central Continent into seventeen areas, commonly known as the seventeen states. Under each state were counties and townships.
Since Daoist Buyu was unfamiliar with the road, he enquired about the situation at the nearest county. He discovered they were located in the Qingzhou of the west part of the Central Continent.
"Wait, why are we in the west of the continent?" Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou suspiciously looked at Daoist Buyu. Weren't they supposed to fly south from the Seek Dao Sect?
Daoist Buyu just grinned, didn't explain much and told them to follow him.
After enquiring all the way and determining their location, the three finally found the Qingzhou Governor.
On hearing that the Seek Dao Sect Leader was paying a visit, the Qingzhou Governor instantly dropped all his tasks to greet Daoist Buyu personally.
As the Qingzhou Governor, he managed countless resources and was highly respected and flattered. But in terms of position and cultivation level, he was far inferior to Daoist Buyu.
Daoist Buyu didn't exchange pleasantries. He stated the situation of Buyi Town directly. On the details, he let Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou add to it.
On hearing about the incident in Buyi Town, the Qingzhou Governor broke out in cold sweat. Five ancient Unification cultivators had awakened. It was a good thing that the incident was discovered and handled in time by the Seek Dao Sect's Sect Leader.
If those five completely recovered and hid somewhere in the dynasty, they could wipe out several counties at any time, which would result in countless deaths.
The Qingzhou Governor made a decision right away to mobilize the local Spirit Transformation and Unification level officials. He wrote letters to the garrison in Qingzhou and the court, alerting them about the resurrection and escape of two ancient Unification cultivators and to stay vigilant.
As for reporting to the court and requesting a commendation for the Seek Dao Sect, he had no time for that now. He needed to resolve affairs concerning the citizens of Buyi Town first.
Lu Yang noticed that the Qingzhou Governor did not mobilize the cultivators at the Refining the Void stage.
Daoist Buyu explained, "The Refining the Void stage is distinct. The strength of cultivators at this stage can be unpredictable: highs could reach the peak of the Unification stage, and lows could drop to the Qi Refinement stage. Therefore, such cultivators tend to stay in a stable place and rarely act."
"And no one would ever lightly provoke a cultivator in the Refining the Void stage. After all, you wouldn't know what Realm they'd reach at the next moment."

chapters.title: Chapter 145 - 144 So you were all cautious when I was there?_1
chapters.content:
The Qingzhou governor led the local officials of Qingzhou, marching towards Buyi Town in a grand array. He slammed his official seal down, demolishing the rules enveloping the small town into nebulous shards, gradually breaking down.
This was not his own power, rather it was the authority bestowed upon him by the Great Xia dynasty. It allowed him to tap into a small portion of worldly power.
The group of cultivators was quite used to dealing with this kind of situation. With them taking action, things like not being able to confront the private schoolteacher, or that there was danger lurking in the straw-thatched huts in daylight, were all made rather laughable.
They apprehended the private school teacher, dragged out the wraith hiding in the straw-thatched hut, investigated how many were moving corpses and how many were living beings, studied whether the man transformed into a black dog could be restored... everything was being carried out in neat order.
Fairy Eternity had never seen such a scene, as the concept of a nation did not exist in the ancient times. The system built around clans did not have such a clear division of roles and orderly organization.
According to Daoist Buyu's claim, this power was just the strength of one dynasty. If it were combined with the might of the Five Great Immortal Sects, it would be able to roll over the ancient cultivators without hindrance.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou found the inn-owner, who was rescued. Seeing them, the inn-owner broke into tears of joy. He never expected that they could actually solve the problem, and in such a short period of time.
He truly regretted ever doubting whether Lu Yang's duo were demon cultivators.
The Qingzhou officials also found out that the owner of the medicine shop was a puppet of the town mayor, with numerous pieces of evidence proving the harm he had inflicted on others. Restricted by the rules, the owner of the medicine shop appeared to be telling the truth while in reality, he was hiding crucial information, and it had led to the harm of many innocent people.
The medicine shop apprentices, private school teacher, bailiff, and the bun-shop owner... all these people were put under arrest, their fates to be decided after the truth was unraveled.
The Qingzhou governor drafted a report on the spot to inform the imperial court about the trio's actions. Still, Daoist Buyu stopped him, asked him to omit the names of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou from the report, ensuring their rewards and commendations were kept intact.
Daoist Buyu treated these two talented juniors to a meal in the busiest tavern in Qingzhou.
"Haha, at last, it's all over!"
"Even though our travel plans hit a small bump, it's just a minor matter. After we have had our fill, I will take you guys to experience the hustle and bustle of the mainland down south."
"This time, while your Eldest Senior Sister is absent, the three of us will let loose. Relax, I will take responsibility if anything happens!"
Daoist Buyu laughed heartily. There was nothing left for him to deal with as the government officials were handling the rest. After managing to break free, it was only right for him to let himself go a little.
"Oh? Is that so? Have you guys been holding back because of me?"
The icy voice that came next abruptly cut off Daoist Buyu's laughter.
Only then did Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou realize that the bustling tavern had quieted down. Their table was the only one where sounds of laughter could be heard from. Now that the three of them had all fallen silent, the tavern was so quiet that one could even hear a pin drop.
As it turned out, the customers in the tavern had noticed quite some time ago that a stunningly beautiful woman had arrived. The moment she appeared, she had attracted everyone's attention, leaving them awestruck by her beauty and aura. Instinctively, they all shut their mouths, not even daring to breathe too loudly for fear of being noticed.
The woman chose a table and sat down, quietly watching Daoist Buyu and his students as they reveled in their joy.
No one could see that there were two soul bodies bound to the two chains in the woman's hands.
Finally, the woman spoke and that's when Daoist Buyu and his students noticed her.
"Ah, it's Xiao Yun. Come, come, join us," Daoist Buyu managed to squeeze out a chuckle.
"Hello, Eldest Senior Sister," Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou greeted respectfully.
Daoist Buyu looked at the chains Xiao Yun had in her hands somewhat with surprise, recognizing that the ones being bound were the fleeing Unification realm cultivators.
"Xiao Yun, when did you join us?"
"Since the first time you wielded 'One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand'," Xiao Yun replied.
Daoist Buyu started to sweat profusely. That happened a day ago, no wonder Xiao Yun managed to track down these two.
After pondering for a moment, he found relief in the fact that he had not spoken ill of Xiao Yun in the past day.
The two captured Unification realm cultivators were terrified as they watched Xiao Yun. They wondered in horror at what level her unique method of casually warping their souls out be. They had once again run into such a terrifying person. Where was the promised uprising of the ancient era with opportunities lying everywhere? Instead of opportunities, only danger seemed to lurk everywhere.
"Initially, I was only concerned that you would lose your way and misguide them, but little did I expect that you guys were having so much fun in my absence," said Xiao Yun, in a casual tone that made the trio shudder.
Meng Jingzhou reacted the fastest, pointing at Lu Yang, "It's all his fault, I didn't want to come here initially, but he dragged me along!"
Lu Yang immediately pointed at Daoist Buyu, "It's all master's fault. He wanted to fulfill his obligations as a master, so he brought me here to see the world!"
Daoist Buyu pointed at Meng Jingzhou, "It was his grandfather! His grandfather asked me to take care of his grandson. That's the only reason I took them out!"
Daoist Buyu's extensive experience told him that the wisest thing to do was to put the blame on someone who was not present.
Xiao Yun's cold gaze swept over them, "Master, you can continue to spread the brilliant deeds of the Seeking Dao Sect. As for Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, you both will come back with me."
Xiao Yun was afraid that Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou might pick up her master's misbehaviors.
Before heading back with the two, she spoke to Daoist Buyu, "On your way, let the governor of Qingzhou know that the criminals have been caught. There's no need to be so anxious."
Xiao Yun planned to bring back the two captured Unification realm cultivators, hoping to extract useful information from them.
On their way back, Lu Yang sought to curry favor with his Eldest Senior Sister by demonstrating his merit - after all, hadn't he just taken down a Unification realm cultivator? Perhaps this could earn him some contribution points.
Xiao Yun seemed puzzled, "Wasn't it Yellow Bean who killed the Unification realm cultivator?"
Upon hearing that, Fairy Eternity didn't pay mind to the fact that Yun Zhi had called her by her name, instead excitedly asking, "Does that mean I can get contribution points?"
"But you are not from the Seeking Dao Sect, so of course not."
Fairy Eternity didn't hesitate, quickly saying, "Then I'll join the Seeking Dao Sect."
Lu Yang stared at Fairy Eternity in surprise. How could she just join like that? What about the dignity of being an immortal?
Yun Zhi nodded, "It's perfectly acceptable for an immortal to join the Seeking Dao Sect. I can permit you to become the first guest elder of the Seeking Dao Sect. Only I will know of your identity. In return, you'll get the contribution points from this time, as well as treatment similar to that of an elder. If you agree to these conditions, then you may join."
"I join," Fairy Eternity was quite fond of the atmosphere of the Seeking Dao Sect, which was similar to her own personality. These kinds of places were few and far between.
Yun Zhi mentioned another thing, speaking to Lu Yang, "A few days ago, the leader of the Laurel Fairy Palace came to me, saying that they want you to marry Lan Ting."
"You seem to be at the age appropriate for marriage discussions. Our Seeking Dao Sect is a good match to Laurel Fairy Palace, so I agreed for you both to be Dao companions. But, then something happened. The leader of Laurel Fairy Palace changed her mind. Do you have any clue about this? Did they feel that you were not good enough?"
Lu Yang was utterly perplexed by these words.

chapters.title: Chapter 146 - 145 The Strongest Among the Five Great Immortal Sects_1
chapters.content:
Meng Jingzhou patted Lu Yang's shoulder and said, "You've finally become so excellent that people are coming to propose marriage."
Lu Yang looked at Meng Jingzhou: "Finally?"
Meng Jingzhou proudly said: "Ever since I was young, I've had the royal family, powerful ministers, and members of righteous sects coming to propose to me. They offered their daughters to me as my fiancées as if I were their own son. Even my parents and clan elders strongly disagreed. Otherwise, how could I possibly…"
Lu Yang chimed in: "Be, what, impotent now?"
Meng Jingzhou retorted angrily: "Be a charming young master!"
The two wrestled together, both using the Tiger Fist technique. The sounds of their fight echoed amongst the clouds. Yun Zhi, who was flying the cloud, ignored them.
Lu Yang transformed into a Tiger Demon, overpowered Meng Jingzhou with one claw strike, forcing him to beg for mercy.
In the end, Meng Jingzhou's Tiger Fist was no match for Lu Yang's real tiger.
After the fight, Lu Yang still couldn't understand. Has the quality he demonstrated in Yanjiang County reached the level where people are coming to propose marriage?
And why do the elements of "proposal", "girl's regret", and "possessing a powerful soul" sound so familiar?
…
The Great Xia Dynasty, Imperial City, Imperial Palace.
Seated high in the hall was a dignified man dressed in dark robes adorned with gold designs. He was grave and stern. Ministers hailed the Emperor, and the atmosphere was solemn and serious.
"My beloved ministers, please rise."
"Thank you, Your Majesty."
Emperor Xia glanced at the ministers and brought out a newly received report, "I have just received a memorial from the Qingzhou Governor, stating that in a place called Buyi Town in Qingzhou, five ancient unification stage cultivators have resurrected and formed a realm.
The Sect Leader of Seek Dao Sect happened to pass by and killed three of the unification stage cultivators with his two apprentices."
At these words, the ministers breathed a sigh of relief. The resurrection of the five unification stage cultivators was no small matter. Luckily, Daoist Buyu encountered them. If it had been any other unification stage cultivator, they would have fallen in Buyi Town directly.
Although Daoist Buyu's reputation wasn't stellar, and many had been fooled by him when they were young, his strength was undoubtedly top-notch amongst unification stage cultivators.
"However, two of the unification stage cultivators managed to escape, both at the peak of the unification stage." Emperor Xia reminded his ministers that this is the crux of the matter.
Emperor Xia did not expect them to observe the rules. The methods of ancient cultivation were very crude and brutal. These resurrected cultivators aimed to seize the opportunities of the Great Era by any means necessary. The Great Xia Dynasty had already learned painful lessons regarding such behavior.
The ministers whispered to each other. If the two unification stage cultivators show up, there is nothing to fear. There are plenty of people in the court who can deal with them. However, if these two hide and plot something in secret, it becomes much more troublesome. Especially if they collude with members of the demonic sect.
"These ancient unification stage cultivators!" Emperor Xia was troubled. With spiritual power growing increasingly active, more and more ancient cultivators are resurrecting.
These unification stage cultivators are a major problem. If left unchecked, they could bring about massive disasters, causing countless casualties amongst the population.
The good news is that, to date, no transcendence tribulation stage cultivators have resurrected.
According to the intelligence gathered so far, those who have resurrected early are at the initial stages of unification. The later ones tend to have higher cultivation levels. The ones resurrected in Buyi Town consist of four peak unification stage cultivators and one late-stage unification cultivator.
It's foreseeable that transcendence tribulation stage cultivators will start to resurrect soon. When they do and the troubles with the Eastern Ocean, Western Buddha Country, Southern Demon Realm, the northernmost land, and the Four Great Devil Sects all explode simultaneously, the rule of the Great Xia Dynasty will inevitably waver.
By then, it's feared that the prophecy warning every dynasty only has a tenure for a hundred thousand years will come true.
"All for the sake of becoming immortals!" A chill flashed through Emperor Xia's eyes. He was privy to many secrets, knowing full well that behind all the chaos, someone was manipulating events to bring forth more Dao Fruits of immortality.
Emperor Xia suspected that it was the work of the Ancient Nameless One, one of the five immortals of antiquity.
"Is becoming immortal so important?" Emperor Xia felt a surge of anger within him, although he did not show it outwardly.
If the person behind all this really thought that the Great Xia Dynasty is a mere piece to be moved freely across the chessboard, they would be greatly mistaken.
Emperor Xia put aside the matter of the Ancient Nameless One and refocused on the two unification stage cultivators that had escaped.
Just then, the Chief Eunuch received a memorial. Seeing the source, he promptly handed it over to Emperor Xia.
After reading it, Emperor Xia's face brightened, "Good, very good!"
The ministers were puzzled, wondering what was written in the memorial that made the Emperor so happy.
"We no longer need to worry about the two unification stage cultivators! Yun Zhi from the Seek Dao Sect has already captured them!"
"Yun Zhi?" Some uninformed ministers were confused about who Yun Zhi is. Among the eight elders in the Seek Dao Sect, they did not recall anyone named Yun Zhi.
Well-informed senior ministers were aware of Yun Zhi's identity and the terror she invoked. To them, Yun Zhi capturing two unification stage cultivators was no surprise.
"The Demon Territory has sent a messenger…" Emperor Xia and his ministers began discussing other matters.
After the morning court, Emperor Xia returned to the Yangxin Hall to review the new memorials.
"Your Majesty, Duke Jingyansong of the Qin nation has something to report," the Chief Eunuch spoke quietly.
Without lifting his head, Emperor Xia responded: "Let him in."
When Duke Qin entered the Yangxin Hall, he saw Emperor Xia busy reviewing memorials. He respectfully stood there without speaking. After the Emperor had finished revising the most important memorials, he finally spoke.
"Duke Qin, what brings you here?" Emperor Xia looked solemn as he gazed at Duke Qin. Any weak-willed person would dare not meet his eyes.
"Your Majesty, I believe we must be wary of the Seek Dao Sect. Yun Zhi from the Seek Dao Sect defeated the leaders of the Five Great Immortal Sects when she was still a disciple, creating an unprecedented record. Since then, she has been low-profile and seldom acts. However, every time she does, it never fails to shock everyone.
Over these hundreds of years, her cultivation level must have reached a terrifying level.
I fear her existence could shake the foundation of our dynasty. After all, the Seek Dao Sect was established during the era of Great Yu. They survived through the 'split of the land' and the 'establishment of the Great Xia'. They might harbor ambitions to replace us.
This is not just my personal opinion. On my way to the court, I heard a waiter singing, 'When Seek Dao flourishes, the world is at peace.'"
Emperor Xia frowned. Seeing this, Duke Qin knew that the Emperor had begun suspecting the Seek Dao Sect, and he said no more. He excused himself and left.
Emperor Xia called over the Chief Eunuch, "Go and investigate who Duke Qin has met recently. Pay special attention to his interactions with instances from the Demon Territory."
"Yes."
Emperor Xia sneered in his mind. It seemed that not everyone in the court was on the Great Xia's side.
"Creating a rift between me and the Seek Dao Sect is a clever plan."
After Emperor Xia ascended the throne, he visited the Five Great Immortal Sects. While visiting the Seek Dao Sect, he met Yun Zhi and was astounded by her. He felt that she was unfathomable; even the spies he sent couldn't fathom Yun Zhi's profoundness.
So he went directly to his ancestors in the forbidden area of the royal palace to ask if they knew about a female cultivator from the Seek Dao Sect named Yun Zhi.
His ancestor fell silent for a long time before answering with just one sentence: "The most powerful amongst the Five Great Immortal Sects."
Emperor Xia wasn't quite satisfied. He further inquired, "How does she compare to you, ancestor?"
"Don't ask anymore."
Emperor Xia was kicked out by his ancestor, who appeared greatly irritated.

chapters.title: Chapter 147 - 146: The Heart of a Child_1
chapters.content:
Ever since then, Emperor Xia learned the hard way, antagonizing the Seek Dao Sect only to confirm the "Hundred-Thousand-Year Curse."
Those people in the shadows, they only saw Yun Zhi as greatly talented and extraordinarily strong, but they didn't have the slightest idea of what Yun Zhi's "strength" truly meant.
If they knew how formidable Yun Zhi is, they would realize how foolish this scheme of driving a wedge between them was.
…
"Eldest Senior Sister, where are we heading to?" Lu Yang asked, noticing that after arriving at the Seek Dao Sect, she continued flying past Sky Gate Mountain without stopping.
Lu Yang had never set foot here before. Below them were vast mountains and marshes, the great draught, and the yellow desert.
"Captive Peak."
Both Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou hadn't heard of this place before.
The Eldest Senior Sister flew over these areas, descending on a gloomy peak. The mountain was entwined by massive chains, which bound to four mountains in each direction. Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou felt chills going down their spines, sensing this was not a good place.
Lu Yang had learned a bit about Array Methods, which emphasizes "unimpeded flow". At a minimum, at least one direction should be connected to the outside world to maintain life energy. Yet, Captive Peak was encircled by mountains on all sides, shutting off any trace of life. The tight cluster of clouds draped over and sealed this region completely.
Captive Peak was a place to imprison and interrogate criminals.
The three of them landed. Yun Zhi opened the Array Method's entrance and headed downwards to about five kilometers below, carrying two Unification-stage souls with her.
Prisoners were held beneath Captive Peak.
Upon arriving at Captive Peak, both Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had a feeling of returning to Buyi Town, powerless to mobilize Spiritual Energy. It was not the Forbidden Spirit Array causing this, but a different kind of "Rule".
They noticed almost a hundred cages here, most of them empty. Only a handful held inhabitants.
To be more accurate, what was being held were not people, but souls. These souls, under the suppression of the "Rule", were spiritless and disheartened.
Some souls, seeing Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, began drooling, wishing they could rush forward and devour them, but they piped down at the sight of the Eldest Senior Sister.
Lu Yang felt that the number of people imprisoned here was too few. More people were held in the dungeons of Yanjiang County.
"All those held here are from the ancient Unification phase. Be careful," Yun Zhi warned.
The two of them shuddered suddenly, no longer thinking the place was underpopulated.
Holy smokes, more than a dozen Unification tier individuals were actually kept here?
"Eldest Senior Sister, aren't you afraid they will escape?" Lu Yang asked in a low voice.
"Escape? You think too little of me, young man." A childish voice responded. Lu Yang turned at the sound and saw a white-haired child, just about waist-high to him.
"Grandmaster."
Much to their surprise, the white-haired child turned out to be Daoist Buyu's master.
"Grandmaster," both cried out in surprise.
"Hehe, do you think I'm too small?"
"No, no."
The white-haired child spoke with an air of authority, "You two are still too young, not worldly enough to understand my state. This is a way of cultivation."
Lu Yang quickly recalled a legendary quotation, "The ancients say, 'Stay true to your constant virtue and return to the state of an infant'. The masses are bustling about as if feasting on a sacrificial ox, or ascending the terrace in spring, I alone appear uncommitted and dejected, like an infant before it can smile."
"Many great cultivators strive their entire lives to pursue the innocuous mind of an infant. But the intentional desire itself is hardly an infant-like thought. How can they truly achieve the mind state of an infant?"
"Could it be, Grandmaster, that you've returned to the stage of an 'infant' and have reached the stage of natural truth, the unison of heaven and man, with an infant's heart?" Lu Yang asked.
Meng Jingzhou was also surprised. The infant's heart has always been a fable. No one in Meng Family's older generation could reach this state of mind. Who would have thought the Seek Dao Sect would have one?
The white-haired child smiled and nodded without uttering a word, showing a teachable expression.
Yun Zhi looked puzzled, "But that's not what I heard."
"Master once said that when you were young, you were a playboy, spending all your time in brothels, neglecting your cultivation. Then, you had a sudden realization and determined to engage in cultivation. To stay your course, you froze your body at the age of six forever, so you wouldn't have to worry about leaking your Yang Qi."
Lu Yang: "..."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Strictly speaking, this was indeed a mode of cultivation.
They realized that cultivators, once reaching a certain realm, could control their appearance. So why did some cultivators choose to maintain the appearance of a juvenile or an old man? Could it be for the same reason as the Grandmaster's?
No, no, no, they quickly emptied their minds, not daring to ponder further on this matter.
"Anyway, with me here, not a single Unification phase person imprisoned here can escape!" The white-haired child forcefully changed the topic, "Miss Yun, you caught two more?"
"Yes, I need to interrogate them."
"Why not search their souls directly?" the white-haired child suggested.
Yun Zhi shook her head, "Soul searching will damage their minds. The souls of the Unification phase are prime materials for forging magic artifacts. A mindless soul greatly reduces the artifact's effects."
The two Unification phase souls shivered. Weren't the Seek Dao Sect supposed to be a Righteous Sect? This was not what they'd pictured at all!
Yun Zhi looked at the two Unification stages in confusion, not comprehending their fear, "You've caused so many people to die in fear, isn't it normal for you to experience the same treatment now?"
Do not do unto others what you would not want others to do onto you, Yun Zhi had thought these two had long understood this principle.
Yun Zhi and the white-haired child each took a Unification phase soul and threw them into the cages. Lu Yang followed Yun Zhi and Meng Jingzhou followed the white-haired child.
Yun Zhi deployed a series of intensive tortures right from the start, employing all kinds of torture tools designed for souls. The prisoner cried out in pain continuously. Lu Yang's eyes twitched as he watched, he didn't expect the Eldest Senior Sister to be so ruthless.
Wait a minute, it seemed like when he started his cultivation, the Eldest Senior Sister did exactly the same?
Could it be that the Eldest Senior Sister had applied the experience of torture interrogation to his cultivation training?
Fairy Eternity shivered each time she saw the Eldest Senior Sister using a torture device. She felt that joining the Seek Dao Sect was indeed a wise decision.
The Seek Dao Sect wouldn't be so cruel to their own people, right?
"Strange, why has he not confessed anything yet?" Yun Zhi was puzzled. Her grandmaster had told her that following this procedure, the criminal would surely confess everything.
Lu Yang whispered aside, "Eldest Senior Sister, you haven't asked anything yet."
Yun Zhi exclaimed in realization, picked up the first torture tool, and prepared to start the whole process again. The fright made the captive quickly refrain, "No no no, I confess, I confess everything."
"What era are you from?"
"The era of Great Yu, 40,000 years ago."
"Have you heard of Immortal Eternity or Fairy Eternity?"
"No, never."
"Really? Still lying?"
The man was nearly in tears from Yun Zhi's cold expression, "It's true, I've never heard of them. In our era, we'd only heard that the Western Buddha Country and the Southern Demon Realm had immortals. There were rumors of immortals in the Eastern Ocean and the extreme north, but I don't even know a single immortal's name."
"If you are looking for an 'Immortal Eternity', you can try the extreme north. Maybe an immortal is frozen there, that counts as 'Eternity'."
Fairy Eternity was so angry she wanted to roll up her sleeves and start a fight right there.

chapters.title: Chapter 148 - 147 The Five Immortals of the Ancients_1
chapters.content:
Fairy Eternity bristled with anger, "Eternity" was the title she was proud of, how could it be belittled by a mere Unification stage cultivator.
"I will freeze you in the Ten-thousand-year Ice Marrow, then fry you in oil!" Fairy Eternity threatened fiercely.
Did they really think that immortals are easy to bully?
That guy named True Master Faxian was killed with just one poke of my finger. I don't believe that you could withstand my finger poke!
"Calm down, calm down." Inside his Spiritual Space, Lu Yang held Fairy Eternity back, making her roll back her sleeve.
The one at the Unification stage was called True Master Sanli. The tasks he assigned were almost the same as those of True Master Faxian, the only valuable thing was the location of a Cave Heaven.
"The Cave Heaven is there, where I hid all my wealth. If you don't believe me, you can go and see for yourself to know that I am telling the truth."
"But the Cave Heaven has rules I set up, which only allow those below the Foundation Establishment stage to enter. However, those at the Foundation Establishment stage are absolutely unable to gain control over that Cave Heaven. As long as you swear not to refine me, I'll give that Cave Heaven to you!" True Master Sanli threatened.
Yun Zhi didn't agree, nor showed any intentions to do so.
Even though the Seek Dao Sect refines soul fragments, and while the atmosphere is unrighteous and they even accepted Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, it is still a Righteous Sect, it still has principles, and it can't lie.
Yun Zhi then led Lu Yang out of the cell, and as they left, they ran into her Grandmaster and Meng Jingzhou, who had also just finished their questionings.
Yun Zhi and her Grandmaster cross-examined their respective testimonies, which were largely consistent. The only difference was that the Grandmaster's Unification stage individual knew of an Immortal known as Yingtian Immortal.
"Yingtian Immortal is in the Vast Eastern Sea, but he doesn't know the exact location."
Yun Zhi nodded; this was not new information. After capturing so many ancient Unification stage cultivators, in addition to studies of ancient texts, they already knew that Yingtian Immortal, one of the Five Immortals of the Ancients, was in the East Sea.
"Yingtian Immortal?" This was not the first time Lu Yang had heard this name, Fairy Eternity had mentioned it a few times.
According to Fairy Eternity, Yingtian Immortal was an immortal whose strength was comparable to hers.
Considering Fairy Eternity's strength and personality, Lu Yang temporarily didn't have an accurate understanding of Yingtian Immortal.
"Yingtian Immortal is in the East Sea? Let's go, take me to find him. With my reputation, you'll eat well, drink spicy, and get whatever you want!" In the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity said excitedly, making Lu Yang count chickens before they hatched.
Lu Yang reminded: "Don't forget how you died. So far, we don't know who killed you. Besides you, there were four immortals, certainly one of them did it. Aren't you afraid it was Yingtian Immortal?"
Fairy Eternity calmed down after being doused with cold water by Lu Yang, and said with hesitation, "It... should not be him. Yingtian Immortal is a pretty decent person, doesn't seem to have any bad intentions…"
"Who do you think among the four immortals is most likely to kill you?"
Fairy Eternity remained silent. She didn't think anyone would kill her, as they always seemed to be peaceable and polite to her.
But she had to admit that her death was indeed tied to one of the Four Immortals.
"Who do you think could mold the stars in the sky into a continent?" Lu Yang asked. He thought this was a clue that could narrow down the range of the Ancient Nameless One.
Fairy Eternity didn't understand Lu Yang's meaning: "All five of us can do it."
Lu Yang: "...Damn it?!"
Wow, you're this powerful, Fairy? Was my previous attitude towards you too casual?
Lu Yang finally realized that being an Immortal was not just about a realm. The word "Immortal" represents the lifelong pursuit of a cultivator, it implies reaching the pinnacle of cultivation, wielding infinite power, covering the sky with a single hand. Turning stars into a continent is but a trifle!
Fairy Eternity did not have much opportunity to demonstrate her power because she was still recovering!
At this time, Yun Zhi said to Lu Yang: "The ancient immortals are Yingtian Immortal, Qilin Immortal, Time Immortal, and Immortal Jiuchong."
To most people, the immortals were high above, unfathomable, and even their existence was uncertain. For instance, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou only knew about the existence of the Immortal Eternity through the Eternity Sect.
However, in Yun Zhi's position, she knew much more than the average person. The names of the Four Immortals were no secret to her.
"The exact locations of the four immortals are still unknown. But what can be determined is that Yingtian Immortal is in the Vast Eastern Sea, Qilin Immortal is in the Southern Demon Realm, and the whereabouts of Time Immortal and Immortal Jiuchong are unknown."
Lu Yang noted one of the names of the immortals and shook: "Qilin?"
He remembered the Little Medicinal Kings in the medicinal field, one of which was the Kirin Immortality Medicine.
Legend says that Qilins do not exist in reality, and what the ancients saw as Qilins were actually Kirin Immortality Medicine.
Since the other party is called "Qilin Immortal," does it imply that the other party's real body is a Qilin?
Seeing Lu Yang's interest, Fairy Eternity explained: "The real name of Qilin Immortal is Shihe."
"His original form is indeed a Qilin. According to him, he is a unique existence in the world, an extraordinary creature born from gathering the world's luck. Anyway, there was only one Qilin in my era. I don't know much about this era, but there probably won't appear a second Qilin."
In fact, before Fairy Eternity appeared, Yun Zhi always believed that there were only four immortals in ancient times. To be precise, everyone thought so.
The oldest Unification stage cultivator imprisoned on Captive Peak can be traced back to the Great Qian era, more than 200,000 years ago. According to him, there were only four immortals in ancient times.
Not only the prisoners of Captive Peak, but also the ancient books record that there were four immortals in ancient times, namely Yingtian Immortal, Qilin Immortal, Time Immortal, and Immortal Jiuchong.
Before the Eternity Sect appeared, there weren't any records of Fairy Eternity in history!
After the emergence of the Eternity Sect, some cultivators believed that they fabricated an immortal out of thin air, and that the immortal didn't exist in ancient times.
"I was very famous in ancient times, and even those at Transcendance Tribulation stage would tremble when they saw me. How come there's no record of me now?" Fairy Eternity was very angry after finding out this news.
The person who killed her knew the characteristics of her Dao Fruit and deliberately erased her existence from history.
"That's not right. According to the naming convention of the Four Immortals of the Ancients, you should be called Eternity Immortal." Lu Yang said.
"It was Yingtian Immortal who suggested that. He said that three characters have more weight, and everyone should have a three-character immortal name. He even suggested that I be called 'Eternity Immortal'."
"I didn't want to be called 'Eternity Immortal', it's not pleasant to hear, and it doesn't distinguish between genders. It makes me seem like a man, which is nowhere near as nice as Fairy Eternity."
Lu Yang thought that Yellow Bean was even more pleasant, but he couldn't say that, or else Fairy Eternity would surely bristle.
After ensuring that the two prisoners were locked up, the Eldest Senior Sister greeted her Grandmaster and then left Captive Peak with Lu Yang.
"Eldest Senior Sister, are you planning to go to the Relic Blessed Cave that True Master Sanli mentioned?" Lu Yang noticed that Eldest Senior Sister didn't seem to intend to return to Sky Gate Mountain and instead flew right out of the Seek Dao Sect.
The cloud that Yun Zhi was controlling was large and blocked the view below; hence, Lu Yang didn't feel acrophobic.
Yun Zhi nodded.
It was worth inspecting the life's wealth of a Unification stage cultivator.

chapters.title: Chapter 149 - 148: Three Stand Cave Heaven_1
chapters.content:
"What is this 'Relic Blessed Cave'?" Meng Jingzhou wasn't there during the rigorous interrogation.
Lu Yang explained, "The one we interrogated is called True Master Sanli. He left a Cave Heaven behind. The rule is only those at the Foundation Establishment Stage or below can enter, and his lifetime of treasure is stored inside."
"The lifetime wealth of someone at the Unification Stage?" Meng Jingzhou drew in a sharp breath. Lu Yang had no concept of the magnitude of this wealth, but Meng Jingzhou did. He knew how astonishing the wealth of an Unification Stage cultivator could be. Looking at the wealth of the elders in his home, he knew it was a treasure that couldn't be exhausted in a lifetime.
He had always been envious since childhood.
If they could acquire it, or even a small portion of it, they would be set for life.
Even a colossal establishment like the Seek Dao Sect couldn't neglect the wealth of an Unification Stage cultivator!
"And it only allows Foundation Establishment Stage cultivators to enter. Hehe, isn't this giving us an opportunity?" Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou shared knowing smiles. Secret realms with such limit on cultivation levels were perfect for them.
The Eldest Senior Sister brought them here, which clearly indicated that she considered their talents and wanted both of them to enter the Relic Blessed Cave.
The cloud they flew on moved so swiftly that to someone looking up from the ground, it would appear as if the cloud whizzed across the sky in the blink of an eye, so fast that it seemed almost like an illusion.
Soon, the three of them arrived at the location mentioned by True Master Sanli.
The geographic divisions during the Great Yu era were different from the present. By today's terms, True Master Sanli's Relic Blessed Cave was located underneath the sixteenth tree from the top of Big Wave Mountain in Huayun County on the eastern side of Ji State.
Yun Zhi touched the tree trunk, felt the space fluctuating, and confirmed that there was indeed a Cave Heaven here.
The Cave Heaven was well concealed and hard to detect. Even someone as powerful as Yun Zhi had to be extremely close to discern whether it existed.
True Master Sanli's Cave Heaven had not yet been discovered by anyone else.
Yun Zhi lightly knocked on the trunk with the back of her index and middle fingers. Along with the distortion that followed, a pitch-black hole appeared before the three of them.
The entrance was a swirling black vortex, the black space inside continuously rotating. Runes flashed within the space, indicating that someone had cast a rule over it. It was a Cave Heaven that was owned, and not easily infiltrated.
The entry rule of this Cave Heaven was that one had to be under twenty years old and at the Foundation Establishment Stage to enter.
Just as Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were under the impression that the Eldest Senior Sister was about to ask them to enter, they saw her seize both edges of the black vortex with her hands, forcibly tear open a large hole. At this moment, all rules disintegrated, none of them could restrain the Eldest Senior Sister.
Lu Yang: "..."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Wasn't this supposed to be their moment of glory? Why didn't it feel like what they had imagined?
Did they seem a bit redundant being here? Why did the Eldest Senior Sister bring them here?
When Lu Yang voiced these questions, Yun Zhi tilted her head thoughtfully and said, "Didn't you two come up immediately when we left Captive Peak? I didn't ask you to come with me."
Alright, now they really felt superfluous.
Inside the spiritual space, Fairy Eternity burst into hearty laughter.
The three of them entered the Relic Blessed Cave. They saw a vast grassland filled with elephants munching on leaves leisurely, lions chasing antelopes, and large beasts prowling ambiguously within a dense rainforest on one side.
Lu Yang keenly felt his cultivation being suppressed. He could only exhibit the strength of the late stage of Qi Refinement.
Then, cloud formations spelled out a striking warning in front of the trio.
[This place is dangerous, leave swiftly.]
[This place is dangerous, leave swiftly.]
[This place is dangerous, leave swiftly.]
[If you insist on entering, please remember the rules of Three Stand Cave Heaven, they could save your life.]
[First Rule: Everyone's cultivation level will be suppressed to the ninth level of the Qi Refinement Stage.]
[Second Rule: Unable to communicate with the outer world.]
[Third Rule: Three Stand Cave Heaven only has a grassland and no rainforest. If you see a rainforest, do not enter.]
[Fourth Rule: Lions are kind. If a lion is pursuing you, do not run. It just wants to play.]
[Fifth Rule: Antelopes are a kind of Demon Beast that walk upright. They have spiral horns on their heads. It is normal for antelopes to laugh, do not be scared.]
[Sixth Rule: There are no elephants on the grassland. If you see an elephant, seek shelter from the lion. The lion will protect you.]
[Seventh Rule: If you accidentally venture into the rainforest, do not panic. Keeping calm is a prerequisite for survival in the rainforest.]
[Eighth Rule: The gorillas in the rainforest are humans in disguise. Therefore, it's normal for them to talk. However, gorillas will not initiate conversation.]
[Ninth Rule: Do not drink the water from the rainforest.]
[Tenth Rule: If you encounter a Foundation Establishment Stage Demon Beast, mimic the gorilla's cries. The Demon Beast will leave on its own.]
[Eleventh Rule: All the above rules are true.]
Then, Lu Yang saw several lines written in blood on the ground below them. The bloodstains were messy, as if written hastily in panic:
[Hurry up and run, this place is dangerous!]
[There's been a change here!]
[Note! These are the real rules of Three Stand Cave Heaven!]
[Three Stand Cave Heaven has both a grassland and a rainforest. The rainforest is safer than the grassland!]
[Lions are at the Golden Core Stage and eat humans on sight!]
[Antelope do not walk upright. If you hear an antelope laughing, leave swiftly!]
[Elephants will protect you!]
[Stay calm in the rainforest!]
[Do not initiate conversation with gorillas, or you will turn into one!]
[If you feel strange changes in your body, hurry and drink the water from the rainforest. It will save your life!]
[Do not mimic gorilla cries; it will attract Golden Core Stage Demon Beasts!]
[The rules of Three Stand Cave Heaven are all false...]
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou became cold with fear upon seeing the bloodstains.
The message was left unfinished, with the last word "is", drawn out into a long bloody streak. It looked as if someone had tried to crawl out of the Cave Heaven desperately but was caught by an unseen and terrifying creature and dragged back in, leaving behind a conspicuous trail of blood.
Both of them felt their scalps tingle. What was inside this Cave Heaven?
"There's a big problem with these rules; they contradict each other at every turn. Are the first set of rules correct, or is the latter set?"
"Based on our experience in Buyi Town, are the first set of rules considered formal, and therefore correct?"
"Not necessarily. There's nothing to indicate that the more formal set of rules are the correct ones. The latter set, although they appear hastily scribed, could also represent a form of rule."
