The two men were at a loss. They were currently only at the ninth level of Qi Refinement Stage. This place was teeming with Foundation Establishment and Golden Core Stage demon beasts, with whom they could not contend. Their only chance was to outsmart them. But there were two different sets of rules, and they couldn't tell which one was true.
If they made the wrong choice, they would be doomed beyond redemption!
"Don't panic. There must be a solution. One rule says that lions are friendly, and the other says they eat humans. One says elephants are killers, and the other insists they can protect us. We could draw the lion and the elephant together and see who would protect us, that way we could determine which rules are the real ones…"
"Is it possible that both sets of rules are half true and half false that they are made to trick people?"
"This is getting a little complicated."
Just as the pair were racking their brains, trying to devise a survival strategy, they saw Yun Zhi raise her arm, revealing her fair wrist, and she gently let out a palm strike.
It was clearly not a palm strike at the Qi Refinement stage. The surge of the palm carried a terrifying power, making the lions, antelopes, elephants, and gorillas scamper for their lives.
It didn't matter whether they were predators or protectors, faced with this palm, they all had the same option: run.
Her palm strike cut a path through the grassland and rainforest, opening a straight path to the end point.
How could the rules here restrain Yun Zhi?

chapters.title: Chapter 150 - 149 Ancient Transcendance Tribulation Stage_1
chapters.content:
"No, the [rules] here are flawed," Yun Zhi frowned, noting that something was amiss as soon as she made her move.
The rule of this place should've been shattered by her palm, but the reality painted a different picture. Even though it seemed scattered on the surface, the underlying implications persisted. This shouldn't be the case, even if her palm was held back.
"There are two types of [rules] here." Yun Zhi figured out what was wrong. The initial rule written in the clouds is the first, which later transformed, giving rise to the second rule written in blood.
A contradiction between the two rules has caused total chaos in the entire Cave Heaven!
Someone intentionally caused chaos within the Cave Heaven, making it possible to enter but impossible to leave!
Furthermore, being an external rule, the fact that the second rule could compete against the original rule indicates that the one who set it is stronger than the master of the Cave Heaven!
True Master Sanli, who was at the peak of the Unification stage.
"Hehe, who disturbed my sleep?"
The sound of ice cracking echoed, followed by a powerful, almost dominating aura that emanated from the endpoint. Like a king above the heavens, it was indifferent and ruthless, looking upon the world condescendingly.
A burst of light tore through the sky, and the intimidating aura made one's heart palpitate.
The aura grew increasingly powerful, with the momentum to sweep across everything.
"Early stage of Pass Tribulation." Fairy Eternity quickly deduced the realm of the opponent.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou's expressions changed dramatically. A foe at the early stage of passing tribulation was the strongest enemy they had encountered. Why was such a Great Power in slumber in the Unification stage Cave Heaven?!
Fairy Eternity, with her vast knowledge and experience, quickly came up with a plausible explanation.
"It's understandable. Cave Heavens are excellent places to hide. Awakening in a Cave Heaven allows one to gradually regain their strength, but the drawback is that they cannot immediately perceive changes in the outside world. Perhaps this Transcendence Tribulation stage would still be asleep even after the Great Era battle is over."
"So he came up with a clever solution. True Master Sanli would wake up, and after waking, he would definitely return to the Cave Heaven. Once he noticed the changes in the [rules], he would take action, and by then, he would be awakened by True Master Sanli's movements."
"This Transcendent Tribulation stage being set the new rule in the Cave Heaven, which is to kill anyone who stumbles into this place mistakenly so that his sleep won't be interrupted."
Lu Yang was breaking out in cold sweat, as he hadn't expected things to be so complicated.
"Hey what are you afraid of, with me here, can easily kick this early stage of Passing Tribulation to his death", Yellow Bean shamelessly boasted, knowing Yun Zhi was here and it was not her turn to act.
"I am Blood Demon Venerable. Who are you? State your name." Blood Demon Venerable looked indifferently at Eldest Senior Sister, who could easily break the rules, guessing she must be at least at the early stage of Passing Tribulation.
But so what? He was confident that even if he faced someone in the mid-stage of Passing Tribulation, he would not fall behind.
"Blood Demon Venerable?!" Meng Jingzhou exclaimed in a low voice.
"Do you know him?" Lu Yang asked.
"Yes." There weren't many at the Passing Tribulation stage, and each of them had the qualification to be recorded in history. Hence, Meng Jingzhou had heard of the Blood Demon Venerable. When he was young and couldn't sleep, his mother often scared him with the tale of the Blood Demon Venerable.
"Blood Demon Venerable is a demon cultivator, a mass murderer. It's said he wrote the names of cities on pieces of paper, crumpled them into balls, and whichever he picked, he used people from that city for cultivation. His cultivation path was littered with dry bones!"
"He also supported an Emperor Yu, became the Imperial Teacher himself, and wielded great power within the Great Yu dynasty. He disappeared later. Some said that he died under Thunder Tribulation because of his numerous misdeeds. As it turns out, he hid here!"
"Seek Dao Sect, Yun Zhi."
Seeing Yun Zhi unmoved, Blood Demon felt puzzled. Had his fame not been carried on to this era?
No matter, he would have to cause a massacre, letting the world remember his name once again.
The stages of Passing Tribulation and Unification are not the same. They can quickly revert to their peak states once they awake.
A gigantic bloody figure roared, standing tall between heaven and earth. As the bloody giant, he transformed the [rule] into an ax and swung it effortlessly. The space trembled as if the entire Cave Heaven couldn't withstand his power!
Yun Zhi held up one hand in front of her chest, emitting a limitless golden light. She resembled an Buddha stepping out from a mural— supremely sacred and inviolable.
With a push of her palm, myriads of golden lights pierced through the darkness, hurtling towards the blood-coloured giant.
The blood-coloured giant used the pair of axes as a shield. The axes, formed by rules, began to dissolve gradually amidst the countless golden beams of light. The giant's sturdy exoskeleton also started to melt away alongside the axes.
The Blood Demon Venerable paled with shock: "It's not right, you're not at the early stage of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage!"
He tore apart the space and attempted to flee. Competing with someone at the mid-stage of Transcendance Tribulation might not yield a clear winner considering their close abilities. It wasn't worth it to provoke such an enemy over personal matters.— not a wise move.
Upon ripping open the space, he would be randomly transported anywhere in the world, a place the enemy wouldn't be able to locate.
Just as the Blood Demon Venerable was about to let out a bout of laughter and utter some threats, he saw an endless, dazzling golden light in front of him. Within that golden light, a beautiful silhouette gracefully approached.
Her walking pace seemed unhurried, but in reality, she moved extremely fast. In the blink of an eye, she had already appeared in front of the Blood Demon Venerable.
"No, you're not at the mid-stage of Transcendance Tribulation at all. Even late-stage transcendents don't have abilities like yours! You're at the peak of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, or even beyond…"
"You know too much," Yun Zhi coldly responded, pulling and twisting with both hands to extract the soul of the Blood Demon Venerable.
The physical body of a Cultivator at Transcendance Tribulation Stage is a prized material for refining. It should not be casually destroyed.
Yun Zhi pulled out a jade bottle and, imprisoning the Blood Demon Venerable's soul inside, prepared to take it back to the sect for a prolonged period of torture.
The whole process was relaxed and effortless. The atmosphere of Cave Heaven was tranquil, as if nothing had happened.
The lion and the antelope danced together, maintaining harmony as they strove to show their good behaviour as Demon Beasts. The elephant lied on the ground, legs pointing to the sky, playing dead.
"It seems that the ancient cultivators at Transcendance Tribulation Stage might be hiding in a Cave Heaven." Yun Zhi mused thoughtfully. It was something she hadn't considered before, but she had to share this information with the other four Immortal Sects and the Great Xia Dynasty once she left the Cave Heaven.
"Let's go." Leaving behind those breezy words, Yun Zhi took light steps and moved towards the destination.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou exchanged a glance before jogging to catch up with her.
There weren't any dangers on the way—at least as far as Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou could see.
However, from the Demon Beasts' perspective, it was a completely different scenario—a terrifying great demon emitting a chilling frosty aura was bringing her two attendants along, roaming arrogantly in the Cave Heaven, posing an extreme danger.
As the trio arrived at their destination, they found several large golden treasure chests placed along with piles of Spirit Stones. Top-grade Spirit Stones were even found in larger quantity than high-grade ones, and the sight was mouth-watering.
This treasure contained not only the hoard of True Master Sanli but also some of the Blood Demon Venerable's belongings.
As Yun Zhi opened the golden treasure chests, they found various natural resources and instructional manuals of cultivation techniques. Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were dazzled. Even with Meng Jingzhou's experience, he could hardly identify the origins of such resources at that moment.
Yun Zhi could easily distinguish the names and uses of these things: "Dragon Transforming Grass, if a Flood Dragon ingests it and refines it internally, it can increase the success rate of the dragon transformation process by 30%."
Transforming into a dragon is the dream of every Flood Dragon. It is not hard to imagine how valuable this item is.
"Bodhi Fruit can enhance wisdom upon ingestion, but the consequence is permanent hair loss."
"Red Sun Diamond Sand is an essential ingredient for forging high-level fire-attributed magic artifacts."
"Glass Sky Pure Water, applying it all over the body can keep the physical body immortal for a hundred thousand years."
"Inner Core of Unification Stage Demon Beast..."
"Dragon tendon at Unification Stage..."
"Passion Powder..."
There were quite a lot of treasures related to the 'Unification' Stage.

chapters.title: Chapter 151 - 150: This Grandson of Yingtian Immortal_1
chapters.content:
It's a pity that due to improper storage, some of the Heavenly and Earthly Treasures had lost their medicinal properties and became mundane, while the value of others had greatly diminished due to the changes of time.
For example, Passion Powder had already expired, and in another case, two thousand years ago the Long Clan had discovered a stable method of cultivation for the Dragon Transforming Grass, causing its price to plummet drastically.
"They have archaeological value and symbolic meaning, and could be sold to the Long Clan Museum," Yun Zhi murmured. Wild Dragon Transforming Grass that was well preserved was rare. She had been to the Long Clan's Museum, and there were none on display there.
"These pieces of junk... When I was still alive, I would not pay them any attention even if they fell to the ground," Yellow Bean scoffed, telling Lu Yang, "Wait till you find my treasure trove, then you'll see what REAL treasures are like!"
Lu Yang rolled his eyes, pretending not to hear Fairy Eternity's words and continued to sift through the treasures with his Eldest Senior Sister.
Fairy Eternity stomped her feet in frustration. In ancient times, countless cultivators would go bankrupt for a chance to see her and hear her speak. Her words were considered divine, and could benefit one for a lifetime!
This kid really doesn't know what's good for him. I'll ignore him!
Suddenly, Lu Yang flicked over a beautifully packaged thick book. The book was soft to the touch, clearly not something ordinary.
Perhaps because of the extraordinary nature of this thick book, the Blood Demon Venerable had specifically noted the origins of the book next to it.
Lu Yang read aloud, "This Immortal Method was obtained from a street stall at the black market. According to the stall owner, the origins, material, and contents of this item are unknown, but it was certain that this item has a long history and was sealed by a powerful Array Method, dating back to ancient times."
"I laughed at the stall owner's ignorance, for he did not know what treasures he was holding onto. I tried my best to open my Heavenly Eye, and saw under the seal a signature position with the character 'Immortal'. This is more than an ancient item, it's an item from the Four Immortals of the Ancients. An Immortal had written it. It might be one of the legendary Immortal Methods!"
"What a pity, what a pity. The ancient seal was so strong that I could not open it in my lifetime."
"Immortal Method!" Lu Yang exclaimed in awe, his heart thumping heavily. He hadn't imagined that the legends of Immortal Methods were hidden here. What a huge opportunity!
And it's such a thick book. Either the Immortal Methods it records are extremely complex, or it has recorded several varieties of Immortal Methods. Regardless of which possibility it is, it's extremely valuable!
He attempted to flip open the book, but just like what True Master Sanli had left in the message, he was unable to open it.
"Hmm? This looks familiar." Fairy Eternity had strong willpower and ignored Lu Yang for a full twenty seconds.
"Have you seen it before, Fairy? Can you remove the seal?" Lu Yang asked.
"Of course. This small seal can be removed with a snap of my fingers."
Following the method Fairy Eternity taught him, Lu Yang carefully injected spiritual essence into it. The seal was truly removed.
Suppressing his excitement, Lu Yang opened the ancient book. The author's name was written on the bottom right corner of the book - Yingtian Immortal.
As expected, an Immortal wrote this book. Lu Yang was ecstatic. Yingtian Immortal must be a reliable Immortal. Aren't the Five Immortals of the Ancients as reliable as Fairy Eternity? Could the ancient times not be completely doomed?
On raising his eyes, he saw the title of the book - "Culinary Bible"
"Huh?"
Lu Yang flipped through a few more pages and discovered that the content was in line with the title, and it talked about how to cook various Demon Beasts.
What the hell! So much for the Immortal Method!
Ying Tian, you're so unreliable!
Why would you even seal up something like this? Are you worried that humans will eat the Demon Beasts into extinction?
Fairy Eternity noticed something was off and questioned, "That's odd. I was the one who wrote this book after tasting countless Demon Beasts and gathering the cooking experience into a book. It's one of my proudest creations. How has it now become Yingtian Immortal's?"
Fairy Eternity gritted her teeth in anger, "Did that bastard Yingtian Immortal take my credit while I was dead?"
"So it was you who wrote this, that makes more sense." Lu Yang suddenly understood.
"What did you say?" Fairy Eternity had a threatening look.
"Oh, nothing. I was just saying that Yingtian Immortal seems to have too much time on his hands to write his name on this kind of book."
Fairy Eternity felt that Lu Yang was disrespecting her, "You're underestimating my work. If you could learn everything in this book, you would become a renowned Spirit Chef at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage. If this was public, there would be a scramble for it, and it would be sold for a high price!"
"When I used to cook for the other four people, they felt that they didn't deserve to eat my cooking and kept coming up with various excuses not to come over!"
"Is it because your cooking was just too bad?"
"Nonsense! My cooking emits a golden light, how could it possibly be bad!"
The squabbling between the Fairy and Lu Yang ended up back on the topic of Yingtian Immortal. After half a day of discussion, they still hadn't reached a conclusion. Lu Yang told his Eldest Senior Sister about the matter, but Yun Zhi only furrowed her brows and didn't say anything.
Over on Meng Jingzhou's side, he had found some cultivation techniques. Some had already been lost while others had been refined. All in all, there was quite a harvest.
Whilst rifling through the treasures, Yun Zhi expression shifted in surprise: "Is this the cultivation experience of a Pure Immortal Body practitioner?"
Yun Zhi looked surprised. She hadn't expected to find a Pure Immortal Body cultivation experience here, especially one from a practitioner at the Unifying Initial Stage.
Immortal Body cultivation experiences are rare, and one suitable for the Seek Dao Sect is even rarer.
Lu Yang asked in his Spiritual Space: "Fairy, were there Immortal Bodies in your time? Could they become Immortals?"
As far as Lu Yang was aware, there were twenty different types of Immortal Bodies in the world. These were even rarer than single spiritual roots. Each Immortal Body, once cultivated to the Unifying Stage, naturally forms a "rule", which is formidable and mysterious, making it unpredictable.
Lu Yang heard that there were two Immortal Bodies within his Sect: Tao Yaoye and her Master, the Sixth Elder. Tao Yaoye had a Feather Transformation Immortal Body and the Sixth Elder had a Pure Immortal Body.
At this point, Yellow Bean was still engulfed by fury at the thought of the shameless Yingtian Immortal taking credit for her work. But, Yellow Bean was magnanimous and quickly switched her attention to the matter Lu Yang had brought up.
"Immortal Bodies? We had them back then. The history of Immortal Bodies is much longer than you think."
"Immortal Bodies date back to the most ancient times, when humanity still didn't know how to cultivate and had to explore for themselves. Foundation Establishment, Nascent Soul, and Spirit Transformation were all due to the special properties of Immortal Bodies over time."
"As for those among Immortal Bodies who became Immortals, I only know one, Immortal Jiuchong. He was a formidable adversary, and was on par with me in terms of strength!" Fairy Eternity looked serious when she mentioned Jiuchong. She acknowledged his strength.
"Immortal Jiuchong was the first among us to become an Immortal. According to him, his ability to become an Immortal had a lot to do with his Immortal Body!"
Lu Yang then secretly asked, "Is Eldest Sister an Immortal Body? What is her level of cultivation?"
Fairy Eternity chuckled, "What do you think?"
Lu Yang's face turned black. How am I supposed to guess?
"Lu Yang, after you return to the Sect, give this cultivation experience to the Sixth Elder. It suits her the best."
"Yes."
The three returned to the Seek Dao Sect with generous rewards.
Yun Zhi went to Captive Peak to interrogate the Blood Demon Venerable, Meng Jingzhou returned to the Body Refinement Peak to practice, and Lu Yang went to the Sixth Elder's residence in Dust Free Peak to deliver the cultivation experience.

chapters.title: Chapter 152 - 151: Sixth Elder (Seeking for Monthly Tickets)_1
chapters.content:
Dust Free Peak, where the Sixth Elder, Feng Ya, resides.
Like Laurel Fairy Palace, Dust Free Peak only recruits female disciples. It's brimming with beauties, but the most gorgeous among them is the Sixth Elder.
It is known that the Sixth Elder is a dear friend of the palace master of Laurel Fairy Palace.
Lu Yang has heard his senior brothers mention Elder Six countless times, advising him not to lose composure if he ever runs into her, as she is a woman of breathtaking beauty.
"Lu Yang? What brings you here?" At the foot of Dust Free Peak, Lu Yang runs into Tao Yaoye.
Tao Yaoye is tall and radiant, standing out amongst the crowd.
Lu Yang takes out a book, "Eldest Senior Sister told me to give this book to the Sixth Elder."
"My master is out, so you'll need to wait for about half an hour or so. Would you like to come in and sit down?" Tao Yaoye invites him.
Lu Yang shows a slightly eager yet awkward expression: "Is that appropriate? After all, I'm a man..."
"Oh, it's fine, it's fine. Among everyone at Dust Free Peak, our cultivation levels are the lowest. We will be fine."
Lu Yang silently watches Tao Yaoye, she looks so pure and innocent that it's as if she doesn't know the extent of the damage those words have caused to Lu Yang's pride.
Lu Yang sighs as he follows Tao Yaoye forward. Tao Yaoye turns around with a sly smile playing on her lips.
"Oh, by the way, I owe you five contribution points, let me pay you back now." When Lu Yang bought the Ten Bulls Strength Pill, he was short of five contribution points, so he borrowed them from Tao Yaoye.
The Ten Bulls Strength Pill has proven quite useful, and aided Lu Yang significantly.
"Oh, you remembered. I totally forgot." Tao Yaoye chuckles.
The Fairy Eternity wonders, "Don't I also have a lot of contribution points?" Now that she is an honored guest of Seek Dao Sect and has killed a unified cultivator, Yun Zhi has awarded her many contribution points.
"Lu Yang, Lu Yang, I want to redeem my points."
Fairy Eternity complains incessantly until Lu Yang finally relents, "After we leave Dust Free Peak, I'll take you to the contribution exchange board. You can buy whatever you want."
"That's more like it." Fairy Eternity nods satisfactorily, thinking that Lu Yang has potential.
"You have to be careful over there, you absolutely can't go." Tao Yaoye points at a pond, warning Lu Yang.
The pond is shrouded in mist, making it difficult to see what is inside, but the pleasing sound of laughter, like the tinkling of bells, can be heard from there.
"The senior sisters like to bathe there. A few years ago, a senior brother, relying on his advanced teleportation skills, sneaked into Dust Free Peak wanting to peep on the sisters, but all we heard were his screams of pain."
"Where is that senior brother now?"
"Well, since he was skilled at teleportation, he has disappeared without a trace."
"..."
My God, Dust Free Peak is perilous.
Lu Yang is relieved to know that he's a gentleman.
Tao Yaoye brings Lu Yang to her usual training spot: "Want to spar?"
"Alright." Lu Yang gladly agrees, pulling out his Green Peak Sword. Fairy Eternity suddenly remembers Lu Yang has the Sword Spirit Root, which means, in theory, he should wield a sword. She has yet to see him use one since her revival.
"Senior Brother Lu, be careful. I've learned some new techniques in the past two months." Tao Yaoye opens up her red paper umbrella.
With a twist of her wrist and a slight looseness in her palm, the red paper umbrella begins to spin. Petals of peach blossoms fall like rain, blocking Lu Yang's line of sight.
The sword light pierces the sky, its whistling sound as it sweeps through the air attempts to dispel the falling petals.
Behind Lu Yang, the petals gradually form a human silhouette. Tao Yaoye's umbrella closes as she launches a sideways attack.
Lu Yang, as if foreseeing Tao Yaoye's move, positions his sword behind his back, blocking the strike. The red paper umbrella, made of an unknown material, withstands the clash with the Green Peak Sword without a scratch.
The sword light bursts again. Tao Yaoye didn't expect Lu Yang's sword maneuver to be this fast.
"Character Gesture!" Lu Yang's eyes narrow in concentration as he mercilessly lunges at Tao Yaoye's chest.
Tao Yaoye chuckles lightly, stepping back as the tip of her umbrella collides with the sword's tip. She tries to throw off Lu Yang's sword technique, but his hand remains steady, relentlessly pursuing Tao Yaoye.
Within the falling peach blossom rain, Green Peak Sword clashes with the red paper umbrella. Their shadows swiftly pass each other, disappearing in an instant.
Both parties find it hard to land a killing blow, awaiting the perfect opportunity.
Suddenly, Lu Yang's eyes light up as he finds a flaw in Tao Yaoye's defense. Green Peak Sword slides through the raining petals like a fish, pressing against Tao Yaoye's throat.
"I forfeit." Tao Yaoye helplessly raises her hands in surrender.
Lu Yang changes his move again, thrusting towards a vacant spot. The real Tao Yaoye is dumbfounded, staring at the bright sword tip aimed at her forehead. All along, what appeared before him was just an illusion created by her.
This time, Tao Yaoye sincerely admits defeat. The peach blossom rain disappears, along with the illusory Tao Yaoye. Everything was just an illusion.
"How did you figure out where the real me was?" Tao Yaoye isn't overly upset about losing, she's used to learning from the experiences of past battles.
"The technique I practise is called the 'Mind Seeing Method', it can break illusions. It's your nemesis."
"Mind Seeing Method? I've never heard of it."
"I came up with it." Lu Yang says with pride, after all, being able to write your own technique is no simple feat.
Before Tao Yaoye can say anything in response, she lifts her head and sees a red mist flying above them.
"The master has returned."
Tao Yaoye leads Lu Yang to the Sixth Elder's abode. As the senior brothers had described, the Sixth Elder is truly beautiful. Unlike the Eldest Senior Sister's cold beauty, the Sixth Elder has a warm smile, like a considerate elder sister, giving people a sense of warmth.
Heave - Heave - Heave -
Suddenly, Lu Yang struggles to breathe. It's as if the surrounding oxygen has disappeared. Despite his best efforts to inhale the non-existent oxygen, he finds his attempts futile.
"Yaoye, didn't you tell him about me?"
Tao Yaoye slaps her forehead, "I forgot."
She quickly pulls Lu Yang away from the Sixth Elder to a safer distance. Lu Yang feels like a fish that has been returned to water, desperately trying to fill his lungs with as much air as he could.
Heave - Heave - "What's going on?"
With an apologetic smile, Tao Yaoye says, "I'm sorry, I forgot to mention. My master is a Pure Immortal Body, untainted by dust, and she naturally repels the surrounding air, which she can't control. So people close to her may feel like they are suffocating. Just hold your breath, and it'll be fine."
Lu Yang: "..."
No wonder everyone says that the Sixth Elder is a woman that literally takes your breath away.
Could everyone in the Seek Dao Sect be this straightforward and blunt with their words, not bothering to use figurative language, but only telling the literal truth?
Holding his breath, Lu Yang approaches the Sixth Elder once more.
For someone at the Foundation Establishment Stage, as long as they are prepared, not breathing for a while won't matter. But once they reach the Golden Core Stage, they can circulate energy within their own body and won't need to breathe at all.
"Lu Yang pays respects to Sixth Elder." Lu Yang bows respectfully, "Master has spoken highly of you and insists he sees you as a beloved sister."
On the flying car, Daoist Buyu told Lu Yang about his relationship with the Sixth Elder, in such moving terms that both Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were quite touched.
The Sixth Elder scoffs, "Really, I always thought of him as a dear grandson."
Lu Yang freezes, considering whether he should just mention Eldest Senior Sister instead of his master the next time he's out. His master's habit of acting disgracefully and attracting hostility... maybe it's better not to bring him up.
(An extra chapter for Alliance Leader, Flat-Chested Lolita!)

chapters.title: Chapter 153 - 152: 'Tree-Planting Sutra' _1
chapters.content:
"This is an ancient book that the Eldest Senior Sister asked me to give to you." Lu Yang was no longer discussing the matter of his master and pulled out the understanding regarding the cultivation of Pure Immortal Body.
Sixth Elder looked at the ancient book in surprise: "Xiao Yun is really thoughtful, she managed to find such a gem."
Understandings regarding the cultivation of Immortal Bodies are not common, even less so for those identical to his own.
Sixth Elder was laughing happily, as if he had purchased a book to his liking, and wanted to read it as soon as he got home.
"Chi Qianqian's Cultivation Diary"
"First Year of Cultivation: Master told me that I am a rare Pure Immortal Body selected from thousands, my cultivation speed far surpassing my peers. It's great news. I have to cultivate diligently..."
"Second Year of Cultivation: My cultivation speed is really fast. While others are only at the Ninth Level of Qi Training, I have already entered the Foundation Establishment. The characteristics of the Pure Immortal Body are gradually revealing themselves. I can't disappoint my master's expectations. I need to keep working hard..."
"Third Year of Cultivation: Advancing to the next stage is faster than drinking water. I have entered the Golden Core Stage, and it's a first-grade Pure Golden Core, untainted by a single speck of dust. Master says there is no end to cultivation and I cannot slack off. I must keep striving..."
"Seventh Year of Cultivation: Nascent Soul Stage..."
Sixth Elder kept flipping pages. The book chronicled the life experience of Chi Qianqian, a cultivator from Great Yu, which was extremely magnificent and thrilling. The Sixth Elder was engrossed in it. Finally, he turned to the last page, his heart shaking.
The previous page only talked about reaching the peak of the Refining the Void Stage, so surely the next page would touch upon the Unification Stage. But why is there only one page on the Unification Stage? Could it be that something unexpected happened?
Sixth Elder suppressed the unease in his heart and turned to the last page.
"600th Year of Cultivation: Finally reached the Unification Stage. Anyway, I can't reach the Pass Tribulation Stage, so let's celebrate!"
The diary ends.
Sixth Elder: "..."
He rubbed his brows, thinking about what the devil he had read.
It's not that it's useless, the cultivation process from the Foundation Establishment Stage to the Refining the Void Stage is detailed, and it does have some reference value for him.
"Thank Xiao Yun for her good intentions on my behalf. As Xiao Yun is responsible for the Seek Dao Sect, even if I wanted to return her favor, there is nothing here that she would find worthy. I once heard from Xiao Yun that your magic skill talent is unique and you have the ability to establish your own sect.
How about this, I'll give you a magic skill book?" As Sixth Elder spoke with a gentle smile, he passed his message to Lu Yang using his spiritual sense.
Sixth Elder's surroundings had become a void where only spiritual senses could transmit information.
Lu Yang agreed.
"But my attack methods rely on the power of an Immortal Body, I have no suitable skills for you." Sixth Elder was deep in thought. What sort of magic skill should he give to Lu Yang?
"That's right, I'll give you the 'Tree-Planting Sutra'."
"Tree-Planting Sutra?" Lu Yang looked strange. The name sounded so average. What was he supposed to do after learning it? Plant trees across barren hills to promote the green development of the Cultivation World?
Or did it mean that if he planted enough trees, Eldest Senior Sister would award him a medal, dubbing him an "Environmental Guardian"?
Sixth Elder understood what Lu Yang was thinking: "Don't underestimate this magic skill based on its name. Numerous cultivators cultivating spiritual plants are desperate to possess it, and if you master it, you can accelerate the growth of spiritual plants and even large sects will flatter you."
"Just look at your second senior brother. The reason he can manage the medicinal garden is that he cultivates the 'Tree-Planting Sutra' the best in our sect."
When Lu Yang thought about it, it made sense. If you were good at this magic skill, you wouldn't have to worry about food and drink for a lifetime. Every large sect had its own planting field and they would fight over you.
Sixth Elder added: "You can also cultivate this skill during your leisure time. It can help calm your mind and nourish your character."
"Yaoye is very good at the 'Tree-Planting Sutra'. If you have any difficulties, you can ask her for help."
Lu Yang accepted the magic skill and thanked Sixth Elder. He then left Sixth Elder's abode accompanied by Tao Yaoye.
After they left, both could breathe normally again.
"It's early in the day; you should study at my place. I can teach you." Tao Yaoye suggested.
Lu Yang agreed.
The 'Tree-Planting Sutra', a high-level wood-based magic skill that uses one's spiritual essence to promote the growth of spiritual plants, is notorious for its difficulty whether in initiation, minor accomplishment or major accomplishment.
To initiate the 'Tree-Planting Sutra', one must attune their mind to a stillness akin to an ancient well, enter a state similar to the melding of heaven and man, feel, understand and conform to the growth laws of the spiritual plants, enabling them to grow quickly and naturally.
"For the first cultivation, using ordinary seeds is most suitable. Our spiritual essence can easily transform seeds into trees. Rumored cultivation geniuses could even make a tree grow, bloom and bear fruit all in one go during their first cultivation."
"The willow tree is known for its human-like characteristics and is the most suitable for the cultivation of the Tree-Planting Sutra. This is a willow seed. Senior Brother Lu, take it, close your eyes and see if you can resonate with the willow seed." Tao Yaoye handed a willow seed to Lu Yang.
Lu Yang, combining the instructions in the 'Tree-Planting Sutra' with Tao Yaoye's cultivation understanding, started to feel it out with his heart.
A gentle breeze blew on his face, sweeping across the lawn. The intensity of the sunlight was not too strong, making one feel extremely comfortable.
Lu Yang began to clear his mind gradually. He felt like he was floating between heaven and earth, slightly managing to grasp the life pattern of the willow seed.
Tao Yaoye sensed something unusual about Lu Yang and looked surprised. It took her three days to achieve this step when she first practiced, and her sense of feel was even praised by her Master as one of the best in history.
Yet Lu Yang achieved it in only half an hour!
"I had heard long ago that Senior Brother Lu's skill in the Tao was exceptional, even more brilliant than his swordsmanship."
But Tao Yaoye didn't expect Lu Yang's skills in the Tao to be this impressive.
"No wonder he is personally instructed by the Eldest Senior Sister - with such talent, probably no one else could teach him."
Fairy Eternity, who heard Tao Yaoye's muttering, nodded in agreement. That was true. Even she, the immortal, couldn't instruct him.
At this point, Lu Yang had a new interpretation of the 'Tree-Planting Sutra'. He put the willow seed on the ground and pointed at it, using his spiritual essence as the growth driver for the willow seed.
"Grow!" Lu Yang shouted.
After a long while, nothing happened.
Tao Yaoye gently reminded him from the side: "Er... Senior Brother Lu, when people plant trees, they usually choose to bury the seeds in the soil."
"That makes sense."
Lu Yang picked up the willow seed, ran the skill "Earth Escape", and swooshed into the soil.
Tao Yaoye opened her eyes wide, surprised that Senior Brother Lu even knew the 'Earth Escape' from the 'Five Elements Escape Method'?
'Earth Escape' is the most convenient of the 'Five Elements Escape Method'. Whether it is for attack, evasion, or concealment, it is an excellent choice.
Tao Yaoye wanted to learn 'Earth Escape', but found it too difficult. She never managed to learn it and eventually gave up.
"But why do I feel that Senior Brother Lu's 'Earth Escape' method is not quite the same as the one I was learning?"
As Tao Yaoye murmured to herself, she saw a willow tree soar out of the ground.
"He succeeded on his first attempt?!" Tao Yaoye exclaimed. It had taken her four wasted willow seeds before she managed to succeed.
"Huh?" Tao Yaoye rubbed her eyes, thinking she was seeing things.
A willow tree sprang from the ground, with two Lu Yangs hanging from both ends of the tree.
Lu Yang hung listlessly on the willow tree, swaying slowly. Now where did he go wrong? Why did he plant a willow seed and end up growing two of himself on the tree?

chapters.title: Chapter 154 - 153: Vegetable Man_1
chapters.content:
Legend has it that at the beginning of the Great Yu Dynasty, there was a genius with a natural affinity for magic skills. He could rapidly learn any magic skill, his talent was near fairy-like.
This genius grew at a pace beyond anyone's imagination, traversing realms that other cultivators spend their entire lives pursuing at an unprecedented speed, eventually becoming a Pass-Tribulation Stage cultivator named Manifold Daoist Lord.
According to ancient texts, the Manifold Daoist Lord learned the Tree Growing Spell as a youngster. It took him just half an hour to master the magic skills that others would need several days or even months to learn.
The Manifold Daoist Lord sowed a willow tree seed, and it took root upon hitting the ground, grew into a robust tree, blossomed, and bore fruit. The tale became a point of admiration, its fame endured throughout the ages, and to this day, this story is still being told.
Tao Yaoye compared the Manifold Daoist Lord with Lu Yang and felt that Lu Yang was still superior.
In just half an hour Lu Yang achieved Enlightenment, used the Earth Escape technique to grow a tree, the willow tree quickly matured, bloomed, and bore two Lu Yangs.
"Senior Brother Lu is still more impressive."
There were two people on the willow tree, both of them were Lu Yang.
One Lu Yang was the original, and the other Lu Yang was wearing clothes made of woven willow leaves. The tree had no leaves left - all were given to Lu Yang's clone to make clothing.
"Where have I gone wrong in my practice?" Lu Yang persevered in identifying the problem.
The result was the same as before, he couldn't find the cause.
"Lu Yang, you've become a plant-human!" Fairy Eternity shouted in schadenfreude.
"Shut up," Lu Yang retorted gloomily, "Forget it, let's get down first."
Lu Yang moved around a bit, it didn't affect anything. He cut off the willow branch at the back of his neck and landed on the ground with a grunt.
He looked at his other self, tried to control the other party with his spiritual power, and surprisingly, the other party's finger really moved a bit.
Under Lu Yang's control, the plant-human also cut off the willow branch on the back of his neck, successfully landing on the ground.
The two Lu Yangs detached from the willow tree, which quickly wilted and shrunk back into a seed. The willow seed, however, had completely lost its vitality and could no longer grow.
Lu Yang attempted to control his clone. Initially, he was unfamiliar with it, but as he gradually got the hang of it, he was able to multi-task - controlling the clone while moving by himself.
"Heh heh, you owe this to me!" Fairy Eternity took credit.
"You can control the other clone because you have opened up your spiritual space, and your spiritual power is much stronger than during the Foundation Establishment Stage. Think about it, how did you initially create your spiritual space?"
Lu Yang thought for a moment, then earnestly replied, "It was because Fairy, you wanted to possess me. You forcibly entered my body, leading to the creation of my Spiritual Space."
Fairy Eternity's face darkened, stressing, "I was pretending, I've told you I was pretending!"
Lu Yang felt that given Fairy Eternity's intellect, she indeed must have been pretending.
Continuing to explore his clone, Lu Yang found that the clone could only move within a range of twenty meters. Once it exceeded twenty meters, he could no longer sense the clone's existence.
Twenty meters was indeed Lu Yang's spiritual power range.
Within the twenty meters, only the control within ten meters was precise. From ten to twenty meters, the strength of control would decrease with increasing distance.
Lu Yang's clone also wasn't sturdy enough, just like the willow wood.
"Is it not sturdy because the willow wood is of common quality?"
Lu Yang wanted to try a real spiritual plant, but he hadn't collected any tree seeds before and had no suitable materials on hand.
"Senior Brother Lu, try this peach tree seed, it's not ordinary, right?" Seeing Lu Yang's predicament, Tao Yaoye kindly handed him a seed.
Tao Yaoye watched Lu Yang intently, brimming with excitement. She liked exploring new things and unsolved mysteries, and currently, the most intriguing mystery for her was Lu Yang.
"This is too much. How much merit should it cost, I'll buy." Since becoming a spy for the demonic sect, Lu Yang had gained so much merit that he hadn't spent it all yet.
"No need, this is a peach tree seed from the Dust Free Peak. It's free."
Lu Yang remembered Tao Yaoye's kindness and began an attempt to plant a peach tree.
After burying the peach seed in the soil and operating the Tree Growing Spell, nothing happened.
"Is it necessary to use the Earth Escape skill?" Lu Yang wondered, remembering using it when planting the willow tree seed.
"Shrink the Land."
Lu Yang shrunk into the soil and activated the Tree Growing Spell. It was really effective.
A strong peach tree broke through the soil in front of Tao Yaoye, bearing two Lu Yangs on its branches - one real Lu Yang and another in the form of a Plant-Person Lu Yang, both have cheeks rubbed with pink blush.
Lu Yang's eyes twitched once: "How come this peach tree comes with coloration?"
"Nevermind, as long it's successful."
Lu Yang controlled his plant-person self movable, he was overjoyed. He could feel a distinct change in the strength of Plant-Person Lu Yang's body, roughly equivalent to seventy or eighty percent of his own strength.
This was already quite remarkable.
Think about it, in battle, using the Tree Growing Spell to produce two of self, and the newly appeared self have seventy to eighty percent power, plus seamless collaboration with oneself, the combat power would surge immediately, catching the enemy off guard.
Tao Yaoye also noticed this, admiring Senior Brother Lu.
The Manifold Daoist Lord is considered as a genius, but he only managed to practice the Tree Growing Spell strictly following the steps of his predecessors, without any innovative development. Look at Senior Brother Lu, he has skillfully transformed into an offensive magic skill, and it's highly powerful too!
At this moment, the Sixth Elder in the sky silently watched Lu Yang, then turned around and left.
Originally, if Lu Yang had any inquiries that Tao Yaoye could not answer, she could come down to explain, fulfilling her duty as an elder.
Now, after seeing this, she decided to leave the explaining task to Xiao Yun, and she wouldn't meddle unnecessarily.
"Xiao Yun said Lu Yang has the potential to establish his own sect."
The Sixth Elder was skeptical about this.
It's undoubtedly true that he possesses high talent, but creating a new sect, can disciples learn it?
Lu Yang, engrossed in his cultivation, became increasingly adept at using the Plant-Person function. Tao Yaoye observed from the side and gained a deeper knowledge of the Tree Growing Spell.
Obviously, this was in relation to the normal Tree Growing Spell.
As evening fell, Lu Yang felt uncomfortable staying at Dust Free Peak. After bidding goodbye to Tao Yaoye, he headed to the Task Hall to exchange some items. He couldn't keep using Tao Yaole's seeds, he had to buy some for his own use.
Fairy Eternity raised both hands in agreement. She could finally do a big clearance sale.
After Lu Yang left, Tao Yaoye's expression changed. She felt a strange pressure that made her feel suffocated.
Danger!
She helplessly turned her head and sent a voice transmission to her master: "Master, could you let me know in advance before you come over? It's not easy for me to hold my breath every time."
The Sixth Elder stood behind Tao Yaoye with an innocent look on her face.
"I forgot you're not in the Golden Core stage." The Sixth Elder subconsciously thought all her disciples were at the Golden Core stage.
Tao Yaoye: "..."
Was this retribution?
I made fun of Senior Brother Lu's low cultivation level in the morning, and it's my turn in the evening.
The Sixth Elder didn't forget why she came: "Do you have feelings for Lu Yang?"
Tao Yaoye's cheeks reddened quickly. Although she was usually carefree, when it came to this topic, whether she liked it or not, she didn't want to discuss it with her master: "Master, what are you talking about? My interaction with Senior Brother Lu is normal."
The Sixth Elder continued transmitting: "Some days ago, Luo Hongxia kept asking me about what kind of person Lu Yang is. I suspect she wants to introduce her excellent disciple Lan Ting to Lu Yang after hearing about how outstanding he is. If you have feelings for him, be careful."
The Sixth Elder was quite sure of her guess, feeling that it must be correct.
Luo Hongxia, the Palace Master of Laurel Fairy Palace.
Tao Yaoye didn't say anything.
To outsiders, the long silence between the master and disciple was an odd scene.
Of course, from another perspective, it could be interpreted that the master and disciple understood each other without words.

chapters.title: Chapter 155 - 154: Yellow Bean Shopping_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang arrived at the Task Hall late in the night, finding the vast hall occupied by only a handful of people.
From Lu Yang's understanding, his Senior Brother and Sisters lived a disciplined rhythm of life. They would complete tasks during the day, slaying demons and defending the Righteous Path, but would either revel or meditate restfully at night.
Of course, their kind of revelry wasn't understood in a mundane sense. They would immerse in their merriment while drinking and dueling each other, not letting the need for rest or cultivation be compromised.
That's why the Task Hall was nearly empty at this time.
Lu Yang scrolled through the exchange column, selecting magic tree seeds with good ranks and reasonable prices.
"Holly Tree, Pomegranate Tree, Apple Tree…"
Lu Yang catalogued the seeds. Although they were of good quality and decent prices, none of them were particularly striking.
"Do you really need to worry about the price? You can spend my contribution points as much as you want!" Fairy Eternity was as generous as usual. She had checked her contribution points just now, compared the price list, and felt her points more than enough to look down on this Seek Dao Sect.
Lu Yang didn't have a habit of depending on others, nor would he feel comfortable taking advantage of a fool.
Fairy Eternity glared at Lu Yang, pouting. She could vaguely sense some of his thoughts being in this Spiritual Space.
A moment ago, Lu Yang had disrespected an immortal!
Lu Yang continued to choose seeds: "Coconut Tree, Durian Tree… Oh, the Bodhi Tree. The Bodhi Tree seed isn't bad!"
The Bodhi tree holds special significance in Buddhism, featuring in many legends. Lu Yang felt it was fitting for his genius status.
"You're the one, Bodhi Tree seed."
Lu Yang bought ten Bodhi Tree seeds.
When it was Fairy Eternity's turn, she looked at the dazzling array of exchange items; her eyes were bright, and she didn't know what to purchase.
"How about buying some natural treasures that can restore strength?"
If Fairy Eternity could return to her ancient state, Lu Yang would have a significant backing. With the support of his Eldest Senior Sister and Fairy Eternity, wouldn't this Cultivation World be at Lu Yang's command?
Fairy Eternity disdainfully said: "What are you saying? I am an Immortal, the pinnacle of cultivators. How many natural treasures in the world are qualified to be used by me?"
The implication was that there was nothing in the exchange list that could help restore her power.
"Then how about buying two Elixir of Eternal Youth?"
"Leaving aside the fact that I, Fairy Eternity, am eternal without blemishes or impurities and will not age, I am only sixteen years old. Why do I need to retain my youth?"
Lu Yang thought to himself, Fairy, aren't you overdoing it with the boasting? Even if you say you are six years old and just developed early, I would believe it.
Lu Yang stopped suggesting: "Pick whatever you want."
"This Blind Box isn't bad. It only costs two hundred contribution points and there's a chance of getting rare cultivation techniques, magic skills, rare and ancient natural treasures, and a series of valuable items!"
Lu Yang's eyes twitched. Who came up with this thing?
He wanted to persuade her not to, but seeing how excited Fairy Eternity was, he knew he probably couldn't dissuade her.
"Lu Yang, lend me your body a little. I want to buy fifty Blind Boxes!"
Fairy Eternity only had a soul and couldn't purchase directly, she needed to temporarily use Lu Yang's body.
Lu Yang sighed, letting Fairy Eternity take control of his body.
Ten thousand contribution points spent in an instant, not even blinking twice! The reward contribution points accumulated by Lu Yang and the two others combined for sneaking into the demonic sect were only eight thousand five hundred points.
With fifty Blind Boxes in her hands, Eternity Fairy shakily made her way to a corner of the hall, sitting down to slowly unbox.
In reality, she could use her divine sense to scan through them, but she felt that would take away the surprise. It was more fun to unbox them one by one.
"Teddy bear, puppy, lollipops, a big iron pot… What are these things? Where are the promised valuable treasures?"
FAiry Eternity felt like she had been tricked.
Lu Yang knew this was going to be the result.
The unknown lies in whether Fairy Eternity is lucky, or the one who came up with the Blind Box had a conscience. Either way, she really got something good.
"Soul Returning Pill, when on the verge of death, one's soul leaves the body. Once this pill is taken, the soul can be called back, thereby saving one's life."
A life-saving elixir, but not very useful for either Lu Yang or Fairy Eternity.
Even if Lu Yang were on the verge of death, his soul wanting to leave his body, Fairy Eternity could grab his ankle and pull him back.
As for Fairy Eternity, the possibility of her being on the verge of death didn't exist at all.
"We can consider this a gain, put it away."
Fairy Eternity instinctively wanted to receive it into Lu Yang's identity jade pendant. However, the identity jade pendant could identify souls, and Fairy Eternity couldn't use it.
Fairy Eternity could forcibly open it, but it wasn't necessary. When she returned the body back to Lu Yang, she could have him put it away himself.
"Body Dissolution Powder, sprinkle this powder on the corpse, and the corpse will turn into dense water. Wash it away with water, and the person will be wiped off the face of the earth."
"Note: It can only destroy the corpses of Golden Core Stage and below."
Lu Yang's eyes twitched, repeatedly reminding himself that the Seek Dao Sect is a righteous sect, and the Body Dissolution Powder is used to defeat enemies and eliminate hidden dangers. It's a last resort.
"Landscape Contemplation Map, contemplating this map can expand the Spiritual Space, improve Spiritual Power."
"Author, Ji Hongwen."
Ji Hongwen is a disciple of Fourth Elder, a Confucian cultivator skilled in Art Dao, and belongs to the same generation as the Eldest Senior Sister and Dai Bufan.
Lu Yang's eyes brightened. This was a good item. His current spiritual power had reached the limit of the Foundation Establishment Stage. If he tried to improve further, he would damage his Spiritual Space. Once he reached the late stage of the Foundation Establishment, he could further enhance his spiritual power.
Fairy Eternity sneered and pat her chest using Lu Yang's body: "Why bother contemplating this? It's inefficient and not useful. Once you reach the late Foundation Establishment Stage, you can contemplate me directly. I'm a genuine fairy. The effect will surely be better than this unknown contemplation map!"
"Seal Lips Pill, once taken, under severe torture, not falling for honey traps, you absolutely will not confess!"
"Automatic Writing Formation, if you're punished by an elder to copy scriptures, using this Array Method can mimic the handwriting, helping you to copy!"
Lu Yang sighed: "It seems our Senior Brother and Sisters have invented this Formation to save themselves some trouble."
"Not right!" Fairy Eternity found something strange, "The Automatic Writing Formation has a hidden catch. Once used, it will be discovered by the elders!"
Lu Yang: "..."
Good lord, could it be that the Seek Dao Sect's elders invented this thing and placed it here to trap people?
He knew it. While these elders might seem eccentric normally, once they started scheming, every one of them was capable!
After opening all the Blind Boxes, overall, the ten thousand contribution points were poorly spent. But Fairy Eternity didn't care. She liked the initial teddy bear and puppy, planning to simulate them in Spiritual Space later.
In the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity could simulate anything.
"What interesting item should I buy now..." Fairy Eternity was quite spendthrift with her contribution points, wanting to spend them all at once.
Eternity Fairy's choice fell on three exchange coupons. "It's you, let's get three!" which perfectly covered the remaining contribution points.
Lu Yang sensed trouble. What voucher could be so expensive? He examined the three exchange coupons closely, and the text in them said:
'Spend a day with the Sect Leader of Seek Dao Sect Experience'.

chapters.title: Chapter 156 - 155: Isn't This Unfortunate?_1
chapters.content:
"One-Day Sect Leader Experiential Tour" voucher for the Seek Dao Sect, the most expensive prize on the exchange list. So far, no disciple has had enough contribution points to redeem this.
Five senior brothers raised funds together for the redemption, and even had a fight over who would be the sect leader during their discussion. After being injured and hospitalized on Elixir Cauldron Peak and feeling incredibly embarrassed, they all left for long term missions outside the sect and have not returned since.
Of course, a disciple such as Dai Bufan could redeem the voucher given his points, but due to his special status as the manager of the Task Hall on behalf of the Grand Elder, he is not allowed to redeem it.
"Fairy, perhaps you might want to consider a different prize?" advised Lu Yang.
Fairy Eternity frowned at him: "What, do you think I'm unworthy of being the Sect Leader when that Daoist Buyu can?"
"Let me tell you, back in the ancient times, I was a force to be reckoned with, and countless tribes looked up to me as their faith. Managing a mere Seek Dao Sect shouldn't be challenging for me."
"No, what I meant is currently, our Eldest Senior Sister is managing the Seek Dao Sect. If you are considering being the Sect Leader for three days, you would need to get her consent."
"Can I refuse now? No, what I meant was, why should I be afraid of a little girl?" Fairy Eternity instinctively chickened out for a moment but then regained her confidence due to her immortal pride.
Fairy Eternity, controlling Lu Yang's body, turned back towards Sky Gate Mountain.
Upon reaching Sky Gate Mountain, Lu Yang kindly reminded her, "Eldest Senior Sister is in the other direction. This way leads back to my abode."
Fairy Eternity frowned, "I can't believe you're her junior brother. You're not considerate at all. The young lady works hard all day, it's late now, we shouldn't disturb her. We'll talk tomorrow!"
Lu Yang thought to himself that the Eldest Senior Sister transcends the three realms and is unaffected by the Five Elements; does she even have the concept of day and night?
...
"Mis.... Eldest Senior Sister, I wish to be Sect Leader for three days, would you permit it?" Fairy Eternity submitted the application she had been working on all night long.
Yun Zhi was busy handling sect affairs and exuded an aura of busy alertness. From one look, she could tell that Fairy Eternity was temporarily borrowing Lu Yang's body.
"Senior, you are one of the Five Immortals of the Ancients and hold the highest seniority in the Cultivation World. It would be unseemly for you to call me Eldest Senior Sister; Yun Zhi would suffice," she calmly replied.
After carefully observing and confirming that Yun Zhi was not saying this out of anger, Fairy Eternity spoke, "Yun Zhi, I wish to be Sect Leader for three days. I've used up all my contribution points to redeem this voucher. The Seek Dao Sect prides itself on its integrity. You should not..."
"You may," interrupted Yun Zhi.
"Really?" Fairy Eternity had planned to force Yun Zhi's hand with the rules, but it seemed unnecessary.
"Yes, of course. The rules state so, and naturally, I will uphold them. Otherwise, how can I maintain my credibility? When do you wish to be the Sect Leader?"
"Starting from tomorrow then."
"Alright," Yun Zhi replied calmly as always. However, Lu Yang noticed a slight smirk on Eldest Senior Sister's face.
Something seems off!
Yun Zhi handed over the task she was handling to Fairy Eternity, "Well then, senior, I'll have to trouble you with the welcoming arrangements for the Five Elements Sect."
The Five Elements Sect is one of the Five Great Immortal Sects.
"Fiv...Five Elements Sect?"
Fairy Eternity looked down at the paper Yun Zhi had given her. It was an invitation from the Five Elements Sect, stating that they would visit the Seek Dao Sect for a personnel exchange in three days. The visiting personnel list was attached.
Underneath was another piece of paper with a hospitality plan Yun Zhi had started writing, but only the title had been penned.
Lu Yang knew about the tradition of mutual visits between the Five Great Immortal Sects. Although officially termed as a 'visit', it was essentially a competition between disciples to see who were more superior. While the rewards were secondary, the primary intention was to preserve the prestige of the victorious sect.
The reason Yun Zhi rescued Lu Yang from Daoist Buyu was also to give Lu Yang, a rising star, the opportunity to compete with the excellent disciples of the Five Elements Sect and broaden his horizons.
Yellow Bean was dumbfounded. She had thought that being the Sect Leader of the Seek Dao Sect, which usually didn't deal with significant affairs, for three days would merely allow her to have some fun. She had not expected a visit from a brother sect.
Yellow Bean felt like backing out; she had never handled such a grand event. In the ancient times, the most she had encountered was gathering the other four immortals for some fun and frolic.
However, an immortal has their pride, and they must stick to their words!
Being the Sect Leader is not a big deal. Who can't do that?
"If anything goes wrong, it's Lu Yang who will lose face!"
"Hey, hey, hey, Fairy you've spoken your thoughts aloud!" Lu Yang snapped.
Immediately after, Lu Yang thought of another problem: "Eldest Senior Sister, if the Fairy's existence needs to be kept a secret, how do we explain to the outside world why I am the Sect Leader, where did all these contribution points come from?"
"Why wouldn't they? You found our master who has been missing for ten years, that's a great achievement."
The tone of Yun Zhi was the same as always, Lu Yang wasn't sure if this was Eldest Senior Sister's sincere words or if she was being sarcastic.
In any case, Fairy Eternity really became the Acting Sect Leader, starting from tomorrow, for a duration of three days, coinciding with the arrival of the Five Elements Sect on the third day.
Fairy Eternity returned her body to Lu Yang, who felt a warm sensation around his waist.
What's happening?
It was the Rudder Master's token, the token flashed three times, signifying that the contact person, Tang Yunsheng was looking for him.
The meeting spot was already decided when they infiltrated Seek Dao Sect.
"Oh, can I meet my believers now?" Fairy Eternity happily said.
Lu Yang informed the Eldest Senior Sister about it, and her response was simple: "Go and meet, I'll be watching."
Lu Yang felt relieved.
At the entrance of the Seek Dao Sect, he encountered Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu. It seems that Tang Yunsheng called all three of them.
"Should we head straight there?" Meng Jingzhou asked, wanting to know Lu Yang's thoughts on this matter.
Lu Yang held his fists up and shook them over his head: "The Eldest Senior Sister is nearby."
"Then there's no problem."
There are many towns near Seek Dao Sect, and Tang Yunsheng chose one of them as the meeting point.
Tang Yunsheng, dressed in a black robe, appeared mysterious, yet remarkably conspicuous in the small town, as though he feared others wouldn't realize he wanted to hide his identity.
A few passersby even considered reporting him to the Seek Dao Sect, he was too suspicious.
Tang Yunsheng looked satisfactorily at the trio: "Your names are on the Seek Dao Sect's list of invited businesses, saying you three opened a barbecue shop in the sect. You finally infiltrated the Seek Dao Sect, well done!"
No need to ask, this was a fake list arranged by Dai Bufan.
"Finally, there's a mole from my Eternity Sect in Seek Dao Sect!" Tang Yunsheng was quite moved, as if he had accomplished a lifelong wish.
"Even the Master didn't expect things to progress so smoothly!"
Then Tang Yunsheng, sighing, said, "It's just a pity that things in the other three Immortal Sects aren't so good."
"What's wrong with the other three Immortal Sects?" Lu Yang, acting as the Eternity Sect Master, asked.
"I don't know how it happened, those three sects became vigilant and caught all my Eternity Sect spies. They used the name of Immortal Eternity, which was very malicious and caught us off guard! The other three demonic sects didn't fare so well either, with many of their spies missing."
"What should we do?" Lu Yang was somewhat anxious, with so many people from the Eternity Sect being captured, he, as the master, was also responsible.
"It's okay, one always needs to look forward, a temporary failure means nothing."
Tang Yunsheng cheered up: "A spy from Five Elements Sect sent a last message saying that the sect is planning to visit Seek Dao Sect in three days, this presents an opportunity for us!"
"The master said he sensed that Immortal Eternity is awakening. The rise of our Eternity Sect is at hand, we can take this opportunity, make some trouble in this exchange competition, and let the Five Great Immortal Sects know we're not easy to bully!"
"With you three acting as insiders, this plan is sure to work!"
Lu Yang and the other two nodded.
In the spiritual space, Fairy Eternity nodded.
The Eldest Senior Sister, lurking in the shadows, also nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 157 - 156 Cautious Man Gu_1
chapters.content:
When the Righteous Path and the Demon Path reach a unanimous decision, all obstacles from the past will become the driving force of the present.
The actual controller and organizer of the Seek Dao Sect have both agreed to Tang Yunsheng's proposal.
There's no way the plan will fail.
"What should we do then? Contact the other three demonic sects, present our most valuable Immortal Treasures, start a rebellion, take down the stronghold of Seek Dao Sect, capture the eight elders, control the whole Seek Dao Sect, and consequently bring down the Four Great Immortal Sects and the Great Xia Dynasty, thus unifying the Central Continent.
Then we plot against the other three demonic sects, unify the Four Great Devil Sects into one, establishing the Eternity Sect. In the grand scheme of things, we seize all the advantages and ascend to immortality, freely enjoying our time?" Lu Yang enthusiastically suggested.
As the master of the Eternity Sect, it is essential for Lu Yang to have a broad vision, plan carefully, and map out a promising future for the Eternity Sect.
"Hello, aren't you just our Rudder Master?" Fairy Eternity complained in the Spiritual Space.
"Well, you can't put it that way. Fairy, think about it. If you had to choose between me and the Eternity Sect Master, who would you pick as the Master?"
"I'd choose you." Fairy Eternity didn't hesitate, of course, she would choose someone she recognized as the Master.
"You see, being the source of faith, you have already marked me as the Master. That proves I am the qualified Master, and the current Master is a fake."
Fairy Eternity nodded her head, thinking that Lu Yang made a lot of sense: "You're right, I hereby crown you the Master of the Eternity Sect!"
Tang Yunsheng was taken aback by Lu Yang's grand plan. This guy had daring plans: "No, no, no. It's not that exaggerated. Our Eternity Sect isn't planning that far ahead, and for this operation, we work independently."
Lu Yang looked disappointed, the Eternity Sect lacked ambition.
"Then what are we going to do inside the Seek Dao Sect?" Meng Jingzhou asked.
Tang Yunsheng pondered for a moment: "We don't know the process of the Seek Dao Sect hosting the Five Elements Sect yet, but I can roughly guess the steps. There must be a welcoming ceremony first, with the common practices being speeches from the sect leaders, program performances, feasting, and drinking..."
Fairy Eternity eagerly noted down, having been troubled about how to plan the reception, now someone was giving her the solution.
Good believer, I crown you Vice Master.
Vice Master Tang Yunsheng continued: "Then it's the competition. Both sides will send out their elite disciples to compete, determining the rules, range, and prizes."
"Finally, the closing ceremony. This is our opportunity. After the welcoming ceremony and the competition of the elite disciples, people would feel exhausted and unconsciously lower their guard.
That's the time for those hiding in the dark to strike together, making a fool of the Seek Dao Sect and telling the Righteous Path how formidable our Eternity Sect is, to uphold the prestige of the Immortal Eternity!"
Lu Yang was shocked: "From what I know, the eight elders of the Seek Dao Sect are either in the late stage of Unification or at the peak of Unification. They rarely meet equals at the same Cultivation Level, not to mention there are great powers from Five Elements Sect. How can we still succeed in the attack, is the Master going to take action?!"
Tang Yunsheng shook his head: "The Master, who is in command of everything, will not act. The organizer and executor of this plan are two Vice Masters and five high-ranking officials. They will use the Immortal Treasure, Dream Pillow, to pull everyone into a dream world. By then, we will be in control of the dream world and can manipulate them at will!"
The Eternity Sect has one Master and three Vice Masters.
In fact, Tang Yunsheng heard that the Master was severely injured and healing from it, incapable of dealing with other matters. He did not know about the plot to ambush the Seek Dao Sect, but there was no need to mention such morale-damaging information to these three people.
Thinking of this, Tang Yunsheng displayed a chilly smile. In the dream world, it would be up to them whether the Seek Dao Sect and Five Elements Sect would live or die!
Even if they can't harm the elders and those with high Cultivation Levels, it's more than enough to slaughter a bunch of potential elite disciples!
"Dream Pillow? Isn't that the pillow I use for sleeping?" Fairy Eternity was surprised. Those believers really admired her; they even kept her belongings.
Lu Yang was more surprised than Fairy Eternity: "Immortals need to sleep?"
Fairy Eternity was aggrieved: "Why can't immortals sleep? Anyway, I've already reached the peak of my cultivation. I can't accumulate any more magic power from meditation. Can't I just enjoy myself?"
Surprisingly, Lu Yang thought that Fairy Eternity made a lot of sense.
Meng Jingzhou asked again: "How are the Vice Masters and other high-ranking officials going to enter the Seek Dao Sect?"
Tang Yunsheng already had a plan in mind: "You can give a shout to the person in charge, saying that the barbeque business is too busy during the exchange between the two sects, and you need to hire a few outsiders temporarily. I've checked it out; this kind of thing happens often during exchange activities. It is usually agreed upon."
"The Vice Masters will carry a talisman that can temporarily hide their Cultivation Levels, enough to deceive the Seek Dao Sect!"
The three of them, including Lu Yang, nodded their heads. The Eternity Sect had thought it through well. At this point, Man Gu thought of a very meticulous problem: "Do the Vice Masters know how to grill?"
Tang Yunsheng was stunned; this was a problem he hadn't considered, but he couldn't show it in front of these three. He calmly nodded and said:
"Correct, you are very thoughtful. However, the Vice Masters have extraordinary abilities. They can do anything from grilling to cooking, washing dishes and plates. There's no need for you to worry."
The four of them discussed some more details, mostly about what could happen during the exchange meeting. Fairy Eternity kept nodding her head, having a rough idea of how to organize the event.
After seeing off Lu Yang and his crew and watching them leave, Tang Yunsheng turned to depart. He ran for two to three hours before arriving at a secret stronghold.
"Young Tang, back already? How did you explain everything?" A young man asked with a smile; he appeared to be young, but he was actually old enough to be Tang Yunsheng's ancestor.
"Replying to Vice Master Liu, I've already explained everything. It seems that those three are doing quite well in the Seek Dao Sect. They have obtained a lot of useful information, but that one named Man Gu noticed a small oversight."
"What?" Vice Master Liu frowned. They had spent a whole night fleshing out this plan, it should be flawless.
Tang Yunsheng said carefully, observing the other's reaction: "Apparently, you and the others don't know how to grill."
Vice Master Liu flew into a rage, emitting a terrifying aura: "Nonsense, we hold high positions. You are not suggesting that we should actually grill, are you?!"
Tang Yunsheng advised: "But think about it. Our stronghold in the Seek Dao Sect is a barbeque shop, and we are entering under the guise of helpers. If we don't know how to grill, we may expose ourselves!"
Vice Master Liu calmed down, thinking that Tang Yunsheng made some sense. He muttered: "Go buy some meat, bamboo skewers, charcoal fire and other barbeque supplies, then hire a grilling master. We'll learn."
"Yes."
After Tang Yunsheng left, Vice Master Liu let out a cruel cold smile: "I heard that the barbeque shop they opened in Yanjiang County is doing great. Hehe, I don't want to learn, but when I get serious, how hard can barbecuing be?"

chapters.title: Chapter 158 - 157: How did the Five Elements Sect lose last time?_1
chapters.content:
Upon returning to the Seek Dao Sect from Tang Yunsheng's, Eldest Senior Sister didn't say a word, probably thinking it unnecessary to bother herself with such matters, leaving everything to Fairy Eternity and Lu Yang.
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu also didn't ask too much, thinking that with Eldest Senior Sister backing them up, nothing would go wrong.
After returning to the Seek Dao Sect, Fairy Eternity focused on planning the reception process.
"The Sect Leader's speech at the welcoming ceremony... So troublesome. Lu Yang, can you write it? If you help this fairy write it, this fairy will teach you an immortal method." Fairy Eternity was feeling frustrated and sought the assistance of the reliable Lu Yang.
Lu Yang chuckled, "I'd consider it if you taught me your entire culinary art."
"What are you saying, you brat? What's wrong with this fairy's cooking!"
Lu Yang didn't respond, but simply rolled his eyes, making his stance clear.
Fairy Eternity had no choice but to scratch her head and write the speech herself. She finally managed to produce a couple of sentences after half a day: "Welcome the Five Elements Sect, everyone feel free to mingle."
Lu Yang: "... Fine, I'll help you write it."
"Really?" Fairy Eternity, hearing Lu Yang's promise to help her, was overjoyed. She handed over the responsibility of writing the speech to Lu Yang, focusing her attention on the reception menu.
Lu Yang had no choice but to help, otherwise, he would be the one to lose face.
"This is the first time this fairy is organizing a large-scale event, it has to be grand. To express my seriousness about this event, I will personally cook!" Fairy Eternity was brimming with excitement, wanting to show the world that the culinary skills of her, Yellow Bean, were on par with a Spirit Chef at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage!
Lu Yang simply wished that she wouldn't be on par with a poison cultivator at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage.
Fairy Eternity also devised a plan to deal with the Eternity Sect. "As followers of this fairy, it is one thing for them not to help me, but they dare to cause trouble. They won't escape!"
The two were busy all day and finally drafted the event plan, inviting Eldest Senior Sister to review it.
After Eldest Senior Sister had reviewed it, she didn't offer any opinions, only commenting that it was acceptable: "From today onwards, you are the Acting Sect Master of Seek Dao Sect. I have already informed the eight elders. They have said that they will cooperate with Lu Yang."
The elders were unknown to the existence of Fairy Eternity.
Lu Yang convened a meeting with the eight elders to discuss the process of the welcoming ceremony.
"Am I the Sect Leader or is she the Sect Leader?" Lu Yang felt he was doing a fair amount of work.
"What's there to be discontented about? Without this fairy, could you have exchanged for a one-day experience as the Sect Leader of the Seek Dao Sect? This is the good fortune, no, fairy fortune that this fairy has generously bestowed upon you!" Fairy Eternity felt that Lu Yang was being ungrateful.
"In the ancient times, everyone wanted to be the leader. The Yingtian Immortal and the others each controlled at least tens of thousands of Life Stars, not including mining stars, gravity stars, death stars, and other stars with various uses! In order to occupy more stars, they fought fiercely, which I had to mediate several times!"
"Then how many Life Stars do you control?"
"One."
"...Why do you have so few?"
"I'm not good at managing people. If it wasn't for Yingtian Immortal and the others saying that an immortal cannot be without a territory, as it would be too embarrassing to say out loud, who forcefully gave me one, I would reluctantly take one."
"After they gave it to me, I found a cultivator with good management skills, let him manage that star, and occasionally go to the mortal world to see how it is managed."
"Then what were you doing after you became immortal?"
"Shopping, visiting, cooking, and sleeping."
"Are you a human or a fish spirit?"
Fairy Eternity was displeased: "Have you ever seen such a beautiful fish spirit!"
"Now I have."
"I also often secretly followed the four of them, observing their movements and activities."
Lu Yang thought to himself that it finally felt like something out of the ancient times. Was it to ambush them and reduce the number of immortals?
"What's the plan?"
"To avoid meeting them directly, for example, when I attend auctions, someone who drops their name irresponsibly, proclaiming they're the son of a certain clan leader, bragging about competing with them being discrediting to their clan, that's when I step up and reveal my Immortal identity, scaring them into shaking like a leaf."
"Or it could be a conflict between two clans, I step up as the mediator. But both sides don't recognize me, dismissively say 'Who do you think you are?'. Then, I unleash my Immortal aura, it has a great effect, and both sides invite me to their clans as a guest."
"Or it could be someone who offends me, I slap them away. They bring their strong support, the support brings armies to encircle me. Then their ancestors recognize my identity, exclaim 'Yo..You are Fairy Eternity' and immediately kneel down to ask for my forgiveness."
"From my experience, the effect is best when I am the only Immortal present."
Lu Yang's eye twitched. Life after becoming an Immortal seemed quite vibrant for a fairy. She could hardly be called an idler.
While the two were in conversation, eight elders began to come in one after another. Lu Yang paid special attention to the Eighth Elder the first time he saw him.
"We pay respect to Acting Sect Master." The eight elders bowed and said.
"Come, let me chair the meeting!" Fairy Eternity nudged Lu Yang to the side and took over.
Her term as Sect Leader just to get a kick out of it now!
"My beloved subjects, you may rise."
Lu Yang held his face, feeling regretful over shouting Fairy Eternity's real name.
Initially, he thought Fairy Eternity was his golden ticket. Now he realized her main functions were to divulge some ancient shameful histories and embarrass him.
The eight elders were somewhat uncomfortable with Lu Yang's state. But considering Lu Yang was Daoist Buyu's disciple, it explained everything.
"Acting Sect Master, let me pour you some water." A cold and familiar voice came from behind Lu Yang frightened Fairy Eternity into breaking into a cold sweat.
The Eldest Senior Sister held the teapot, pouring water for Fairy Eternity. Her posture was impeccable, which made people sigh at Yun Zhi's perfection in everything she does.
As Yun Zhi leaned to pour the water, she coldly glanced at Fairy Eternity who hastily nodded showing that she will behave well without causing any mischief.
The two communicated without the need for spiritual sense, all through just eye contact.
With Fairy Eternity behaving, she cleared her throat, saying, "You all should know that people from the Five Elements Sect will be visiting our Seek Dao Sect the day after tomorrow. The reason for calling this meeting is to discuss this issue. What are your thoughts?"
The Grand Elder was calmest, "Those coming do not mean well."
"Why do you say so?"
"The Five Elements Sect has already visited us once and according to the usual rules, we should be visiting them back this time. Their breach in rules, and coming at us again only implies one thing, they are trying to redeem themselves by defeating us on their 'away game'!"
Fairy Eternity had not anticipated such a rationale, "So according to the elders, what should we do?"
Second Elder mimicked slitting his throat, "Intercept them on the road, put a bag over their heads, give them a beatdown, and send them packing! Trust me, I have experience, I handle things cleanly. There won't be even a trace left behind."
The other elders nodded, agreeing with the Second Elder's proposal.
"I've held grudges against Five Elements Sect for some time. After losing to us last time, they claimed that our Seek Dao Sect doesn't belong among the Five Elements. What nerve!"
"Let's get at them, let them know the power of our Seek Dao Sect!"
