"Ever since Old Qiu took over as Sect Leader, he's been different. I think he's forgotten about his youthful times when he provoked those under our Dao Sect."
Fairy Eternity was curious, "How did the Five Elements Sect lose last time?"
Eighth Elder said, "Oh, it's simple. The last time they came over, they suggested a competition among disciples, where the elders were not allowed to lend a hand, with their best disciple squaring up against ours."
"Then what happened?"
"Then, Xiao Yun took action."
Fairy Eternity turned her head sharply, looking at the expressionless Eldest Senior Sister. She'd almost forgotten that she was considered a 'disciple' too.
The Grand Elder sighed, "Probably Xiao Yun was too strong, making Old Qiu forget that she isn't part of our generation but rather Old Nine's disciple."

chapters.title: Chapter 159 - 158: The Golden Finger of Fairy Eternity_1
chapters.content:
Fairy Eternity feels that the Five Elements Sect's loss was unjust as she knows Yun Zhi's caliber very well.
Once her power is fully restored, Yun Zhi is eligible to be her contender, and perhaps they might even score a tie, with both victory and defeat being plausible.
If Yun Zhi were sent to face the Five Elements Sect, wouldn't he have dominated utterly? It would be a wonder if the Five Elements Sect accepted such defeat.
Lu Yang thought to himself, with both Yingtian Immortal and Immortal Jiuchong as worthy contenders, given your powers, how did you die in the first place?
Fairy Eternity, engrossed in the feeling of becoming a Sect Leader, didn't notice Lu Yang's expression in her spiritual space.
Taking up the responsibility to soothe everyone's emotions, she speculated: "Since all Five Great Immortal Sects are considered as close as limbs, I think there's no need for us to treat the Five Elements Sect this way."
Second Elder scoffed, "Indeed, we are the hand, and the Five Elements Sect is the foot. The hand and foot do not intersect, so how can there be sentiments?"
Discreetly, Fairy Eternity asked the Sixth Elder Feng Ya, "Does the Second Elder have a grudge against the Five Elements Sect?"
Given that the Sixth Elder was attending as an illusion, there were no issues with communicating through thoughts.
After some deliberation, the Sixth Elder found it inappropriate to hide the truth from the acting Sect Leader. "When the Second Brother was young, he fell in love with a woman named Shangguan Yu. Although he confessed his feelings, Shangguan Yu turned him down directly."
Second Brother happened to discover that Shangguan Yu and Qiu Jin'an were sharing intimate conversations, as if they were planning to get married."
Qiu Jin'an is now the Sect Leader of the Five Elements Sect.
Since then, the Second Elder held a grudge against the Five Elements Sect."
Fairy Eternity furrowed her brow, realizing that such matters were indeed difficult to handle.
She cleared her throat and said, "After all, we are the hosts and the Five Elements Sect our guests. The essential courtesies and process for treating the Five Elements Sect must be maintained."
"I have devised a simple event program, which requires the cooperation of all the elders."
"The welcoming ceremony will be held at the Martial Arts Plaza. It's big enough to hold the crowd and is near our mountain peaks."
The central region of the Seek Dao Sect comprises nine mountain peaks, with one for the Sect Leader and eight for the Elders. Arranged like a lotus flower, the heart of the circle is the most lively area with taverns, bookshops, fashion outlets, and other large stores for disciples to relax. There are also trial sites, like the puppet field, for disciples to train their physical skills.
But the largest among them is the Martial Arts Plaza.
The Martial Arts Plaza most commonly serves as a place for disciples to compete. The entire stage is sturdily crafted and intricate, making it resistant to devastation. Ensconced in an array method, even severe collisions won't damage it. Even if it's managed to get damaged, it can automatically repair itself. The array method also ensures that the disciples' combat won't affect bystanders.
"Fourth Elder, you've always been meticulous and have a certain understanding of array methods. Could you check the array method of the Martial Arts Plaza for any loopholes or vacant areas, and to make sure it can withstand continuous high-intensity collisions? "
"Sure."
"Once the two sides have finished their speeches, it should be noon. It's a perfect time to strengthen bonds over a meal. As it happens, I recently got a hold of an immortal's scroll. It contains unique recipes which I plan to demonstrate in public during the visit of the Five Elements Sect."
Fairy Eternity immediately volunteered to take care of the cooking.
"The competition part follows next. The preliminary plan is to categorize it into four sections, namely the Foundation Establishment Stage, Golden Core Stage, Nascent Soul Stage, and Divinity Transformation Stage."
The categories proposed by Fairy Eternity seem fair and will prevent an overpowering contestant like Yun Zhi from dominating the event.
"Grand Elder, with the Five Elements Sect's visit, there's expected to be a surge in customers to the tavern and other places which may lead to a hike in prices. At that time, please make sure to deploy patrols to prevent such incidents."
"There will also be disciples who enjoy gambling and they would most likely seize this opportunity to run underground casinos. Grand Elder, please take note of this and take appropriate actions, including closing these casinos or imposing strict penalties if necessary."
"Third Elder, there might be conflicts due to the large number of people moving around during the exchange event. It'd be great if you could assign some disciples to maintain order at the venue."
"Fifth Elder, could you refine the four-sided displays that can broadcast the competitions held at the Martial Arts Plaza live, so everyone can watch?"
All the Elders agreed with Fairy Eternity's well-thought-out and careful arrangements.
Fairy Eternity proceeded with her mission systematically, which was thanks to her whole night of hard work—primarily in persuading Lu Yang to lend a helping hand.
With no other choice, Lu Yang became the temporary supporting brain for the Acting Sect Leader, providing strategic guidance.
Lu Yang, being the magical trump card of Yellow Bean, is always available to help during crucial times.
Fairy Eternity continued assigning tasks: "Seventh Elder, you should refine some more elixirs, mainly those that can save lives, heal wounds, and neutralize poison."
The Seventh Elder hesitated for a moment and then agreed, "Sure, but the disciples usually have control over their power and won't seriously harm each other during friendly sparring. So, this kind of elixir might not come in handy."
Fairy Eternity thought for a moment, and then asked Lu Yang in her spiritual space, "Why do you want him to refine these elixirs?"
"Fear of food poisoning."
Upon hearing this, Fairy Eternity exclaimed, suddenly realized what she just said, and then plunged into silence.
After coming to her senses in the spiritual space, Fairy Eternity glared at Lu Yang. Lu Yang could only respond by shrugging his shoulders innocently.
Once the exchange with the disciples is over, according to the plan, the Eternity Sect will launch a sneak attack on us, Fairy Eternity finally stated.
The Elders all blanked out for a moment. What did she mean by 'according to the plan, the Eternity Sect will attack'? Who made this plan?
Fairy Eternity seriously said, "We have a deep mole planted in the Eternity Sect that holds a high position and has access to some of their plans."
Lu Yang sneered to himself, as the mole had developed deep roots indeed.
"According to reliable information, this time the Eternity Sect will dispatch two Deputy Masters and five top-notch elites."
The Deputy Masters of the Eternity Sect are at the Unification level. However, without immortal treasures, they wouldn't be capable of causing a ruckus in the Seek Dao Sect.
The Unification level of the Seek Dao Sect naturally isn't restricted to the Sect Leader and eight Elders.
'Nine sons of the Seek Dao Sect' refers to the nine most outstanding figures among their generation, it doesn't mean that there were only nine in that generation.
Rest of them might be out executing tasks, guarding treasures somewhere within the Seek Dao Sect, or are semi-retired, revealing themselves only on rare occasions.
"At that time, I will arrange for someone to monitor the Eternity Sect. If anyone yells 'Attack', we all act together, capture the people from the Eternity Sect, and don't be too hard on them—we want to capture them alive as much as possible," Fairy Eternity concluded.
...
After the meeting ended, the Elders began to act according to the tasks assigned to them.
Lu Yang brought the event plan and left the Seek Dao Sect, once again finding Tang Yunsheng.
"Inspector Tang, I've brought the event plan of the Seek Dao Sect. All the information enclosed here is publicly available and won't be hard to decipher."
Tang Yunsheng was elated, but a bit puzzled after reading the event plan.
"How are the details almost similar to the event plan I imagined?"
"That shows your calculations were accurate!"
Tang Yunsheng didn't give it much thought as he took it for a coincidence.
Lu Yang continued, "I think we should have a signal for when we act. For instance, when the Deputy Master shouts 'Attack', we all act together and catch the Seek Dao Sect off guard!"
Tang Yunsheng nodded, agreeing with Lu Yang's suggestion.

chapters.title: Chapter 160 - 159: Finally Found the One Who Sold Fake Questions_1
chapters.content:
Upon returning to the Seek Dao Sect, Fairy Eternity takes control of Lu Yang's body and starts handling sect affairs.
There are various things that need to be handled daily in the Seek Dao Sect, but due to the fact that matters related to Five Elements Sect's visit were so important, they were made a priority. Now that those tasks have been delegated, it's time to address regular issues.
Fairy Eternity, sitting in the position of Sect Leader, delights in her role: "Let's see what needs my decision today."
"The Great Xia dynasty strongly condemns the Seek Dao Sect's habit of randomly building graves. The Grand Elder of the sect repeatedly built graves in areas outside the sect's jurisdiction, disrupting the dynasty's archaeological work."
The letter also includes the detailed account of how an old farmer accidently discovered a grave. After the dynasty sent personnel to investigate and deemed the style of the tomb to be from the era of the Great Yu dynasty, built by someone at the Unification stage of cultivation.
With the continuation of the archaeological work, the contents of the tomb have refreshed public perception of the Great Yu dynasty's burial customs. It's an important finding.
After a long period of excavation, the Great Xia finally unearthed the tomb, only to discover the Grand Elder, who was sleeping in the coffin.
After all their hard work, it turned out that the tomb was built inappropriately by the Grand Elder, and even done in the style of the Great Yu dynasty era, leaving the Great Xia dynasty nearly livid.
"The earthworm couple in the medicine garden has split into two segments, considering themselves as four separate individuals now. They don't wish to stick to their old relationship and want to simultaneously marry. The male side has a main husband and a secondary husband, and the female side has a main wife and a secondary wife. The four of them wish to host a grand wedding in the medicine garden?"
"Hiss——"
Fairly Eternity leans back slightly, is the current generation of earthworms this flamboyant?
The ancient generation of earthworms never did such things.
Fairy Eternity momentarily puts aside the earthworm's issue, reading other documents, "The Green-eyed Buffalos propose the creation of a pill named 'Power of the Third Elder'. In times of danger, it can be used to summon the Third Elder for assistance."
Next one.
"Joint proposal by sect disciples to restrict the Third Elder's activities: every mountain has an owner, for the sake of exercising, mountains shouldn't be moved around."
Lu Yang had heard about this: the Third Elder enjoys moving mountains. The issue is, the Third Elder doesn't remember where the peaks were originally and thus doesn't restore them after moving. Many disciples had their homes disappear when they returned from missions.
"Huh, Elixir Cauldron Peak claims to have found a method to communicate over long distances," Fairy Eternity exclaims, holding the document like a treasure.
Fairy Eternity hadn't expected Elixir Cauldron Peak to be so creative. In ancient times, only the Great Power cultivators had ways to communicate, ignoring distance. Has Elixir Cauldron Peak found a way to generalize this method?
Elixir Cauldron Peak had explained their plan.
"First, refine two Acacia Moon Pills."
Lu Yang remembered when the ginseng baby briefly introduced the acacia flower; the pill allows two lovers to contact each other regardless of time and space.
"Then refine two Deadfast Pills. These pills can make two individuals fall in love. As long as both consume a Deadfast Pill and an Acacia Moon Pill, they can establish distant contact."
"When the communication ends, Elixir Cauldron Peak has initially developed a potion called 'Oblivion Water'. After consuming it, the effects of the Deadfast Pill can be removed."
Fairy Eternity: "..."
Lu Yang: "...weirdo."
Lu Yang believes there is a reason why the world of refining pills doesn't acknowledge Elixir Cauldron Peak's position. With their reckless research methods, it would be a surprise if they had been acknowledged!
Fairy Eternity makes a general reply to these issues: "Read."
"...What about replying?" Lu Yang comments.
"I just don't know how to solve them." Fairy Eternity admits with a difficult look. She was never good at solving problems, let alone issues related to the Seek Dao Sect.
She has her own way: "You see, these issues aren't urgent. Once the deadline passes in three days, it'll be Yun Zhi's turn to face these problems, then it won't be my concern anymore."
Lu Yang finds Fairy Eternity's words somewhat reasonable, "Fairy, did you forget something?"
"What?"
"Eldest Senior Sister has been standing behind us the entire time."
Fairy Eternity breaks into cold sweat, only now remembering that Yun Zhi has been present all along, just silently oblivious.
She feels a pair of chilly eyes on her, but she doesn't dare to turn around.
"Sect Leader, Meng Jingzhou wishes to report something at the door," speaks the owner of the icy gaze suddenly, displaying no signs of emotions.
Fairy Eternity jolts, but thinking about her status as Sect Leader, she composed herself and says, "Let him in."
Meng Jingzhou storms in dragging along the Eighth Elder.
Seeing this, Lu Yang reverts the control of his body and greets teasingly: "Oh, it's Little Meng."
Lu Yang warmly says: "Little Meng, don't be scared. Tell me about any problems or troubles you're facing. As an elder, it's my responsibility to assist younger generations."
Meng Jingzhou's eyelid twitches. He thinks to himself, 'Lu Yang, you're growing guts. Wait till I get my Sect Leader Experience Voucher.'
Meng Jingzhou learned that Lu Yang got his Sect Leader Experience Voucher because he found Daoist Buyu, who had been missing for ten years.
If that's the case, he can seal Daoist Buyu away to prevent him from causing chaos in the outside world.
By reducing one major calamity in the Cultivation World, he should be able to earn a considerable amount of contribution points.
However, considering the situation at hand, it isn't the time to compete with Lu Yang.
"I want to report Eighth Elder." Meng Jingzhou stated his intention righteously.
The Eighth Elder defended himself, believing Meng Jingzhou misunderstood him, "Worthy nephew, this is all a misunderstanding. I didn't know it was you."
"What happened to the Eighth Elder?" Lu Yang isn't very familiar with him.
"Do you remember when we first met, I mentioned that I bought the real exam questions of the Seek Dao Sect's trial?"
Lu Yang nodded. He remembered clearly. At first, in the carriage, Meng Jingzhou didn't mention that he had the real questions. But later, when Eldest Senior Sister also boarded the carriage, Meng Jingzhou abandoned their friendship, seeking his own doom by revealing he had the real questions.
The two of them even discussed how to pass the test in front of the Eldest Senior Sister. Luckily, the Eldest Senior Sister didn't hold it against them.
Later, it was revealed that what Meng Jingzhou had were indeed the real questions, just that they were from 20 years ago.
Meng Jingzhou pointed at the Eighth Elder, "It was him. He assured me confidently that those were the real questions, deceiving me out of a lot of Spirit Stones!"
In an instant, the Eldest Senior Sister, Lu Yang, and Meng Jingzhou all eyes were on the Eighth Elder.
Yun Zhi, knowing the Eighth Elder's character, had long suspected he was the culprit, but never had any proof.
The Eighth Elder nonchalantly answered, "Those weren't just any words. Didn't I sell you the real exam questions?"
"Do you know how many people wanted to buy the real exam questions from me 20 years ago? I didn't sell them to anyone!"

chapters.title: Chapter 161 - 160: Fairy Eternity's Verbal Spell_1
chapters.content:
"Twenty years old exam questions, aren't they still exam questions? Youngsters, don't limit your thinking this way," he said.
"You've never heard that the older something is, the higher its value? When Old Nine and I were tomb raiding, we chose the oldest items. We even found a treasure from the early era of Great Qian, owned by a gigantic monster of Transcendance Tribulation Stage."
Yun Zhi was familiar with this story. She had heard from her master that he and the Eighth Elder found an early-era treasure of Great Qian that could hold the water of three rivers and five lakes. The priceless item led to a fight between them.
Later, they discovered that the item was the bedpan of a Transcendance Tribulation Stage monster.
The Eighth Elder continued, "You should ask around, the examination questions for Seek Dao Sect are priceless. I agreed to sell you the real questions and yet you're still picky."
"Do you know the risk I took selling you these questions? I did this all for the financial gain of the Seek Dao Sect."
The Eighth Elder stated assertively, causing Lu Yang to nodd repeatedly. "The Eighth Elder's words make sense; therefore, I guess your decline should get delayed by twenty years."
The Eighth Elder was agitated, "That simply cannot be."
"The Eighth Elder, don't be in a rush. I am not denying your benefits, just delaying it by twenty years. Is that not still a decline?"
"Or are you suggesting that the Eighth Elder feels the sect is in trouble and is voluntarily giving up his decline? If the Eighth Elder's thinkings are so noble, I would proudly publicize your commendations and encourage everyone to learn from the Eighth Elder's spirit."
At this point, Yun Zhi spoke up, "Eighth Elder, considering your friendship with my Master, as long as you return the Spirit Stones you deceived Meng Jingzhou of, this issue can be resolved."
With no choice, the Eighth Elder reluctantly gave back the Spirit Stones.
Meng Jingzhou was overjoyed at regaining his Spirit Stones, however Yun Zhi then said, "Meng Jingzhou, you're also at fault for purchasing the exam questions. As long as you submit the money used to purchase the questions to the sect, this issue can be closed."
Meng Jingzhou was shocked, he thought that Eldest Senior Sister was on his side.
Helpless, Meng Jingzhou submitted the Spirit Stones, which were still warm, to the sect.
"Wait, wait, what about Lu Yang? The boy even discussed with me on the carriage how to handle the examination. This is proof of his sinister intentions!" Meng Jingzhou intended to drag Lu Yang down with him.
Lu Yang sneered, "You can report me to the Sect Leader! Considering the Leader is absent, you can report to the Acting Sect Leader."
"I believe the Acting Sect Leader is a just person who wouldn't favor anyone."
"Damn it…"
Meng Jingzhou glared at Lu Yang, thinking to himself that he would deal with him once he became the Sect Leader.
After the Eighth Elder and Meng Jingzhou left, Fairy Eternity regained control of Lu Yang's body.
Fairy Eternity looked at the matters that needed to be handled and felt that being a Sect Leader was difficult.
"How do the Heavenly Immortal individuals handle such issues with the same level of ability as me? How do they control those planets?"
Yun Zhi sighed lightly and advised, "As you can assign tasks to the Elders, the Sect Leader also has the right to command disciples. You can assign the reviewing tasks to experienced disciples."
"Oh, right." Fairy Eternity realized this and assigned Lu Yang to handle these tasks.
Lu Yang took a deep breath. "No matter how you think about it, isn't Eldest Senior Sister subtly suggesting that she should handle these matters?"
After a series of events, the reliable Eldest Senior Sister ended up dealing with the chaotic tasks.
Lu Yang sometimes felt the Seek Dao Sect was lucky to have an Eldest Senior Sister, otherwise it would collapse sooner or later.
"I wonder how the outside world evaluates the Seek Dao Sect."
Fairy Eternity's hands were behind her back as she looked at the martial arts field that was under maintenance and nodded frequently, looking just like a leader inspecting a local area.
Near the martial arts field, there were many small arenas for the disciples to compete in.
The Seek Dao Sect had a strong focus on actual combat training to prevent disciples from being bullied when they went out.
Lu Yang found the thoughts of the Sect's higher-ups too extravagant.
At this point, two Golden Core Stage brothers were fighting in the arena. Their Golden Cores were full and radiant, showing they had reached the peak of Golden Core Stage.
Lu Yang recognized these two people. The Golden Core Stage brother was named Luo Hai. He refined the White Day Ocean Pill, a top-tier Golden Core. He used water element magic skills exceptionally and had killed several Nascent Soul Stage Demon Path cultivators. In the talent-filled Seek Dao Sect, he was noticeable.
The Golden Core Stage sister was named Yi Jing, from the influential Yi Family of the Imperial City. Although not as renowned as Meng Jingzhou's family, they were famous in the Central Continent. Sister Yi Jing was remarkably experienced. She compared the Yi family's ancestral skills with various skills in the Scripture Pavilion and revised her skills to better suit her.
These two were no ordinary people; their fight attracted many spectators, hoping to learn and help their future cultivation.
Fairy Eternity strutted over, attracting some attention. To outsiders, Lu Yang was the first disciple to redeem the Sect Leader Coupon, which was very inspiring.
More people focused on the fighting pair on stage and didn't notice Fairy Eternity's arrival.
"Watch me demonstrate what it means to fight beyond your level!" Fairy Eternity said to Lu Yang, leading him to have an ill feeling.
"Wait, what are you doing..."
Before Lu Yang could complete his sentence, Fairy Eternity took control of Lu Yang's body and leaped onto the arena.
The two in the arena were curious about Fairy Eternity's intentions and wondered what their newly appointed acting Sect Leader was up to.
"I challenge both of you."
Luo Hai and Yi Jing paused momentarily, followed by surprise. An uproar ensued from below the arena. Lu Yang was only at mid-stage Foundation Establishment, how could he challenge two peak Golden Core fighters?
However, since Lu Yang wanted to challenge, Luo Hai and Yi Jing wouldn't refuse.
The two stood opposite Fairy Eternity, "Junior Brother, you go first."
Fairy Eternity wore a faint smile, "In the name of the Acting Sect Leader, I command you to jump off the stage."
Lu Yang: "..."
Luo Hai: "..."
Yi Jing: "..."
A group of brothers and sisters below: "..."
Is this how you use the powers of an Acting Sect Leader?
They had to comply with the Acting Sect Leader's words. The two didn't hesitate and jumped off the stage, forfeiting the match.
Fairy Eternity's actions piqued the interest of many brothers and sisters.
"Senior Brother Ma, go and see. I heard that Junior Brother Lu Yang has refined the Verbal Spell and defeated several Golden Core disciples. He also claimed that he intends to challenge the Nascent Soul Stage."
"Really?" Senior Brother Ma revealed an interested expression.
Ma Tianyang, at the peak of the Nascent Soul Stage, was a member of the Refining Mountain and was good at using fire and forging weapons. Once during a fight with a Divinity Transformation Stage cultivator, he fought while refining; he used continuous Spirit Treasures to defeat the Divinity Transformation Stage cultivator.
"Let's go and see."
The disciple who instigated Ma Tianyang wore a successful smile.
As soon as Ma Tianyang approached the arena, he heard Fairy Eternity declaring loudly, "Hahaha, I'm already invincible in the Golden Core Stage. Come on, a Nascent Soul stage."
As soon as Ma Tianyang heard these words, he jumped onto the stage and then witnessed Fairy Eternity's "Verbal Spell".
On this day, Fairy Eternity fought stick classes above hers. With a mid-stage Foundation Establishment cultivation level, she defeated Golden Core, Nascent Soul, and Divinity Transformation Stage cultivators. Her fame exploded.
On this day, Lu Yang wished he could bury himself in the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 162 - 161: Visit from the Five Elements Sect_1
chapters.content:
The flying boat of the Land Money Trade Association weaved through the clouds. The passengers basked in the sun on its deck, savoring the moment of tranquility.
Suddenly, a massive shadow cast over them.
Surprised, they looked up, only to find an extraordinarily large flying boat looming above.
Their own flying boat was already considered massive, but in comparison to this one, it looked like an infant.
The boat was adorned with multicolored gems of dazzling brilliance, clearly no ordinary gems.
"Whose flying boat is this?" The people whispered amongst themselves.
One observant person pointed out, "Look at its emblem. It's the Five Elements Sect's flying boat!"
"The Five Elements Sect?"
People had only heard of the name, Five Elements Sect, and seldom saw them traveling, especially in such grandeur.
"Could it be that an extraordinary demon has emerged, and the old veterans of the Five Elements Sect are summoned to eradicate it?"
In the Cultivation World, the reputation of the Five Elements Sect surpasses that of the Seek Dao Sect by more than a notch.
"Look at the direction it's heading. It's heading towards the Seek Dao Sect?"
"So, is it going to remove the demon, or is it visiting the Seek Dao Sect?"
...
"Our purpose for this journey is to annihilate the monsters of the Seek Dao Sect and make them aware of the strength of our Five Elements Sect!"
On the Five Elements Sect's flying boat, Sect Leader Qiu Jin'an encouraged everyone, "Last time, it was my mistake. I forgot that Yun Zhi was Daoist Buyu's apprentice, eligible to compete, so our Five Elements Sect lost a minor fight!"
"But this time, it's different. I learned that little Daoist Buyu has gone missing, and Yun Zhi has officially become the Acting Sect Master, and can be considered as my peer. He will no longer participate in the trials meant for apprentices!"
"This is an opportunity! Without Yun Zhi's threat, the Seek Dao Sect is of no concern!"
"Our diligent cultivation was for today's victory, for the honor of the Five Elements Sect!"
Qiu Jin'an was determined that no matter what happened, he must redeem the Sect's honor. To flaunt before the Seek Dao Sect, he even brought out the most luxurious flying boat of the Sect.
Onboard, each gifted apprentice, carefully selected by the Five Elements Sect, listened to Qiu Jin'an's inspiring speech. Fires of battle ignited in their eyes.
They were all skilled in their special ways and had unique understandings of the Five Elements magic. Their rivals were few and far between.
They had always been advised by their elders to avoid interactions with Seek Dao Sect members during missions. The people of Seek Dao Sect were notoriously challenging and didn't follow conventional rules.
Every youth has a rebellious streak, and finally, they got an opportunity to confront the Seek Dao Sect. They vowed to shine brightly and let the Seek Dao Sect acknowledge what real talent was.
A few of them had participated in a previous exchange event, but only Yun Zhi demonstrated his capabilities then, not reflecting the entire strength of the Seek Dao Sect. They knew very little about the Seek Dao Sect and saw this as an opportunity to display their talents.
A bright-eyed young girl, filled with determination, looked at Qiu Jin'an and firmly exclaimed, "For the honor of the Five Elements Sect!"
Her words were like a stone thrown into a tranquil lake, creating ripple after ripple, evoking a response from the Five Elements Sect's disciples.
"For the honor of the Five Elements Sect!"
"For the honor of the Five Elements Sect!"
Qiu Jin'an looked at the girl, his expression drastically changing, "How did you get here? Your name was not on the visitor list!
The girl pretended to be affronted, "Why can't I come? It's such a rare opportunity to visit the Seek Dao Sect, and you didn't even include me in such a fun event!"
"You should describe visiting the Seek Dao Sect as dangerous, not fun!" Qiu Jin'an corrected her interpretation.
Some of the younger disciples didn't recognize the girl and prospectively asked their senior brothers, "Who is she?"
"All we know is that her name is Shangguan Yu, her identity is unclear. She has been around Sect Leader Qiu before I joined the Five Elements Sect. There are rumors that she was favored by the previous Sect Leader and is his illegitimate daughter. As Qiu Jin'an's half-sister, he seems to turn a blind eye to her actions."
They were already close to the Seek Dao Sect. Qiu Jin'an could hardly send Shangguan Yu back. Moreover, she would most likely not listen to him.
Rather than losing face publicly, he decided to back down.
As they spoke, the flying boat reached the entrance of the Seek Dao Sect and docked nearby.
In front of the Seek Dao Sect, Acting Sect Master Fairy Eternity and eight Elders had already prepared banners to welcome the Five Elements Sect's visit.
Qiu Jin'an led his team off the boat, the corner of his lips curling into a mysterious smile. He observed the activities of the Seek Dao Sect.
They must have never seen such a luxurious flying boat before.
The Grand Elder approached Qiu Jin'an, intending to shake his hand. Just as Qiu Jin'an was about to respond, the Grand Elder demanded, "Docking fee."
The Grand Elder was not extending his hand for a handshake, but to collect a fee.
When a visit between the Five Great Immortal Sects occurs, the leader typically conjures smoky clouds or celestial clouds to transport them. These creations dissipate upon reaching their destination, making things quite convenient. Rarely does anyone, like Qiu Jin'an, travel via a flying boat.
For such a large flying boat to dock at the Seek Dao Sect, a fee was definitely required. After all, this was not a free parking or docking area.
Qiu Jin'an argued, "I am visiting on behalf of the Five Elements Sect."
The Grand Elder pondered for a moment, agreeing that Qiu Jin'an had a point, "Then we can give a 20% discount."
Qiu Jin'an took a deep breath, deciding that he would not quarrel with these lunatics from the Seek Dao Sect.
Because of the substantial size of Qiu Jin'an's flying boat, the docking fee was dozens of times more than that for an ordinary boat. It pained Qiu Jin'an greatly to pay such an amount.
But thinking of the imminent victory against the Seek Dao Sect, he let go of such minor details.
Soon, Qiu Jin'an saw the members of the Seek Dao Sect and the banner they had put up.
They had put significant effort into welcoming the Five Elements Sect. The banner was personally written by an immortal; there couldn't possibly be another like it in the world.
Although Yellow Bean seemed rather unconventional, the calligraphy on the banner was stunning, full of vitality and energy.
The banner carried a simple message: "Welcome, Five Elements Sect." However, the characters were not in the modern script.
Qiu Jin'an squinted, recognizing the ancient text. Was the Seek Dao Sect flaunting their cultural heritage?
Laughable! Were they not aware that I once obsessed over the ancient era and have considerable knowledge of its culture?
Qiu Jin'an chuckled as he recited a string of awkward and difficult-to-understand words. This was the language of the ancient era, something very few people understood.
Although traces of the ancient script can still be found, its pronunciations are nearly impossible to understand. Text can be passed down through generations, but their pronunciations cannot.
The sounds he had accidentally discovered from a ruin were based on the placement of objects and text that had been passed down, arguably a site where the ancients worshipped celestial beings and deities who enjoyed the process.
The sound was broad and ancient. It was, presumably, an acknowledgment from a celestial being to the priests after enjoying the worship. Qiu Jin'an thought it was highly appropriate for the current situation.
This could also explain why the sound had been preserved—it was the voice of a celestial being.
Lu Yang quietly asked Fairy Eternity, "What did Sect Leader Qiu say?"
Fairy Eternity looked a bit blank and said, "His accent is too heavy. I could not fully understand, but I think he said 'Oh great Immortal, please accept the humble offerings of your servants.'"
"Does this mean he has recognized my true identity?"
Fairy Eternity was slightly glad—finally someone was aware of her true identity as a celestial being, and their attitude was very humble, much better than Yun Zhi and Lu Yang.
She was considering making him the Vice Master of the Eternity Sect.
Qiu Jin'an noted their bewildered expressions, and satisfied, he nodded to himself, 'You all can't understand what I'm saying, can you?'

chapters.title: Chapter 163 - 162: Yingtian Immortal Volume 1
chapters.content:
Once upon a time, Fairy Eternity, as one of the Five Immortals of the Ancients, had a celestial reputation that resonated across the universe, and her existence was universally acknowledged.
The ancient people, Demon Race and others would often build altars to offer precious treasures and sacrificial offerings to worship Fairy Eternity, hoping to win her pity.
There were even tribes who looked upon her as their totem and guardian deity, holding grand sacrificial events year after year. For a time, Fairy Eternity's glory was unparalleled.
Unfortunately, since her resurrection, everything had changed. Now she was destitute and only worshipped by a single sect whose members were not the sharpest tools in the shed, they didn't even know her real name, and kept getting her gender wrong.
Residing within Lu Yang's body, she was occasionally intimidated by a little girl named Yun Zhi, and frequently ridiculed by Lu Yang himself. Life was truly hard.
Even immortals, let alone those who were at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, shouldn't be treated like this.
Finally, someone had opened their Heavenly Eye, recognizing her identity and even begging her to accept a huge flying boat as tribute.
Just look at the gems embedded in the ship's walls and its massive size! This is how an Immortal should be treated!
In the spiritual space, Lu Yang glanced at Fairy Eternity, thinking to himself, 'You look like you've enjoyed being sect leader these past couple of days. Killing a cultivator at the Divinity Transformation Stage while only at the Foundation Establishment Stage is unprecedented. Any genius would feel ashamed faced with such victory. It's fair to say that you have set a historical record.'
"Since you came bearing such a large gift, let's proceed." Fairy Eternity laughed, reaching out to Qiu Jin'an to retrieve the magic artifact controlling the flying boat, speaking in the ancient language.
"What are you doing?" Qiu Jin'an looked at Lu Yang who was grinning foolishly, feeling confused. He didn't understand what Fairy Eternity was saying, he only knew a single sentence in the ancient language.
Qiu Jin'an scrutinized Lu Yang. From his positioning, Lu Yang seemed to be an important figure, occupying the sect leader's seat.
But most importantly... was he acting a bit sissy?
"Didn't you just say 'Great immortal, please accept your humble servant's gift'? Isn't the gift the flying boat?" Fairy Eternity was also a bit confused. Could he go back on his word now? Did this vice-leader still want to continue his position?
This time Fairy Eternity spoke in Mandarin. Qiu Jin'an understood, his eyelid twitched as he finally realized the true meaning of what he had said in the ancient language.
Unexpectedly, he had met a cultivator fluent in the ancient language.
"Do you really understand the ancient civilization?" Qiu Jin'an looked doubtfully at Fairy Eternity.
Fairy Eternity thought for a moment then blurted out the truth: "I understand it better than you do."
Qiu Jin'an chuckled out of anger: "Young man, just because you have read a couple of books, don't think you understand the ancient civilizations. Let me test you!"
"Do you know that in the ancient times there was a concept of 'Heavenly Court' which divided immortals into several ranks? Do you know what they were?"
Recently, Qiu Jin'an came across an ancient book while exploring some ruins. It was written by an immortal and described the flourishing ancient times, particularly mentioning the concept of "Heavenly Court."
"Are you referring to human immortals, earth immortals, sky immortals, golden immortals, Dharma golden immortals, Hongmeng immortals of the first system conceived by Ying Tian or human immortals, earth immortals, immortal kings, immortal emperors of the second system conceived by Qilin Immortal?"
"The system I devised included first-level immortals, second-level immortals, third-level immortals, fourth-level immortals, fifth-level immortals."
Fairy Eternity scratched her head. They had developed several disciple ranking systems back then and no one knew which one Qiu Jin'an had found.
Qiu Jin'an retorted angrily, "Don't speak nonsense, it was written by an immortal, how could it just be 'concocted'?!"
Fairy Eternity was puzzled, but then had a sudden realization, "Didn't anyone say that immortals must always tell the truth? Ah, I get it now, the system you found must be the one Ying Tian put together. It's the most comprehensive one and quite intimidating."
"Let me tell you, Ying Tian's words can never be trusted. They are all lies. Even before he became immortal, he used to trick me all the time, and I would beat him like one would beat a disobedient grandchild."
Qiu Jin'an paused, feeling that Fairy Eternity was speaking nonsense. However, it was indeed Ying Tian who was credited in the ancient book that he found: "Have you read that book?"
Fairy Eternity nodded: "Of course. Besides Ying Tian, does the book also mention an Immortal named Huo Metal?"
Lu Yang had a sudden premonition of having a stroke. Was he just imagining things?
"If you don't believe me, bring out the book. I'll tell you how to distinguish between the true and the fake."
Qiu Jin'an doubtfully took out the ancient book. The name of the book was quite impressive; it was called "Imprisoning Heaven."
He pointed to the cover and said: "Look, it is clearly written, 'Composed by Ying Tian Immortal'; it was written by Ying Tian Immortal."
Fairy Eternity shook her head: "Didn't you notice the tiny blank space between the characters for 'heaven' and 'immortal'?"
"What do you mean?"
"You have read it wrong, you are reading it as 'Ying Tian Immortal, Composed,' but it should actually be 'Ying Tian, Immortal Composed'. So, this book was written by someone named 'Ying Tian', not Ying Tian Immortal."
The Grand Elder and others, when they saw Qiu Jin'an being put in his place, couldn't help but chuckle.
"Hahahaha, I have always been telling you Jin'an, you should quit showing off with your limited knowledge." Although the Grand Elder and others were laughing subtly, Shangguan Yu directly laughed out loud from behind Qiu Jin'an, showing no regard for Qiu Jin'an's feelings.
With an apologetic tone, Shangguan Yu said to the members of the Seek Dao Sect: "I'm sorry, you all know how Jin'an is, thick-skinned and hardheaded, refusing to admit his mistakes. He didn't know the original meaning of the ancient language, which caused this misunderstanding. I apologize for the inconvenience."
"Please accept these gifts."
The disciples from the Five Elements Sect began unloading magic artifacts, ore, elixirs, cultivation methods, etc. from the ship, each of which could be the highlight or even the grand finale of an auction due to their high value.
The most precious was the Five Elements Ores, a special product of the Five Elements Sect. The ores were divided into five types based on the five elements – gold, wood, water, fire, and earth. Each color represented the extremes of the corresponding attributes. These were the kind of materials that refiners could only dream of.
The Fifth Elder, Old Zhou, saw the ores. His gaze was like a wolf spotting its prey in the middle of the night, his eyes glowing green with greed.
It was customary for the Five Great Immortal Sects to bring gifts when attending each other's events.
For example, the Laurel Fairy Palace would often give laurel branches and moon essence as gifts.
The Suspension Temple gave Buddhist sutras and consecrated Buddhist treasures as gifts.
The Prison Suppressing Sect gave tamed demons and goblins as gifts.
The Seek Dao Sect was a bit unique or rather casual, especially when Daoist Buyu was around.
For instance, they once gifted the Laurel Fairy Palace with a high-level body refinement method. Once the method was mastered, the body would become as durable as steel and iron, unmovable and able to overpower anything. This enraged the members of the Laurel Fairy Palace to the point where they wanted to fight.
What kind of disciple would a female cultivator who mastered it look like?
And they gifted the Suspension Temple with the long-lost Silent Zen cultivation method. Daoist Buyu even claimed that he had successfully practiced it and that it worked remarkably well.
The temple host chuckled sarcastically at the time, thinking to himself 'If you, this damned beast could practice it successfully, would you still be called 'Silent'?
Even though Daoist Buyu repeatedly assured him that it was a genuine method, the temple host still practiced it doubtingly once.
Afterwards, he realized that every time he opened his mouth, his breath smelled of garlic, and everyone around him would plead with him to shut up.
The explanation given by Daoist Buyu was, "Isn't Silent Zen all about making people wish you'd shut up?"
The host was so angry that he manifested the Immovable Ming King to suppress this damned beast, Daoist Buyu.

chapters.title: Chapter 164 - 163: Your Seek Dao Sect is Bullying Too Much!_1
chapters.content:
After Yun Zhi became the Acting Sect Master, she followed tradition by visiting the Four Great Immortal Sects and brought a special gift - she told everyone that Daoist Buyu had gone into seclusion, and that she was now in charge of the Seek Dao Sect.
When the Four Great Immortal Sects heard this news, they were overjoyed, knowing they wouldn't have to deal with the mad Daoist any longer.
Moreover, with Yun Zhi as the Acting Sect Master, it implied that she would not participate in the disciples' activities.
The Five Great Immortal Sects held non-scheduled activities for their disciples, allowing them to explore the Relic Blessed Cave. However, since Yun Zhi's grand appearance, these activities had become pointless, causing great embarrassment for the other Four Great Immortal Sects - it seemed more worthwhile to simply give the rewards directly to Yun Zhi, and in turn, save time.
Upon seeing the captivating Shangguan Yu, the Second Elder's eyes were fixated on her.
Even though Shangguan Yu had once rejected him, he still couldn't forget the pure and beautiful Shangguan Yu.
Noticing the Second Elder staring intently at Shangguan Yu, Qiu Jin'an stepped in between, blocking the elder's view with a grim expression: "When will the competition start?"
The Grand Elder responded: "According to the plan, we will start with the opening ceremony, followed by a meal, and then the competition."
Surprisingly organized, Qiu Jin'an thought, Yun Zhi's arrangement was far better than that chaotic Daoist Buyu's.
During his last visit to the Seek Dao Sect, Daoist Buyu had greeted him with a hug around the neck, suggesting, 'Brother, let's go, I'll take you to the brothel, my treat.'
Qiu Jin'an immediately shoved Daoist Buyu aside.
This wasn't something to be said outright! Shangguan Yu was watching him!
Hmm? Where's the young man who understands ancient civilization?"
Qiu Jin'an wanted to discuss some ancient secrets with Lu Yang, such as how the last Great Power, who had completed Verbal Spell, died, or whether the Yingtian Immortal was born on a particularly splendid day, hence his name...
The Grand Elder explained: "He's off to cook."
"Oh." Qiu Jin'an didn't think much of it.
On the podium, the disciples of the Seek Dao Sect and the Five Elements Sect stood together, listening to the speeches of the higher-ups.
Soon, they all fell asleep.
Grand Elder read from a script prepared by Lu Yang: "In order to implement the policy of the Five Great Immortal Sects joining hands, to promote friendly exchanges between the Seek Dao Sect and the Five Elements Sect, to deeply understand the bond between the Five Great Immortal Sects, to lay a solid foundation, to achieve win-win results, I would like to discuss five points revolving around the theme of this exchange."
"First, implementing the policy of the Five Great Immortal Sects joining hands is required by history and present day. With the coming of the Great Era, ancient cultivators are coming back to life. Faced with the grave situation and unpredictable challenges in the Central Continent, the Five Great Immortal Sects should, and must, unite…"
Qiu Jin'an was then taken aback, he had expected some differences from the previous speech, but these differences still surprised him.
The previous time, Daoist Buyu had only said two sentences: Welcome Five Elements Sect, feel free to interact.
When it was Qiu Jin'an's turn to speak, he cleared his throat and announced: "In this sunny season when all things are reviving, the Five Elements Sect is honored to visit the Seek Dao Sect. Witnessing the most advanced thoughts and theories in the Cultivation World, we have gained a lot of insight…"
After the two rounds of speeches, scattered applause echoed from below the stage. As the Eighth Elder said, it was as never-ending as "incessant urination".
On stage, the leaders of both sides shook hands.
"Sect Leader Qiu, please give us your guidance in this exchange activity."
"Grand Elder, you're too kind. We ask for your leniency from the Seek Dao Sect."
Both Grand Elder and Qiu Jin'an wore kind smiles on their faces, completely hiding their spiritual sense conversation from others.
"Qiu Jin'an, return to your Five Elements Sect. We of Seek Dao Sect don't welcome you. Look at your hypocritical appearance. Have you forgotten how we, the nine sons of Seek Dao Sect, beat you up?"
"Nine of you against me alone, your Seek Dao Sect has no dignity. You think I'm eager to come to your Sect? A gathering of monsters and fiends, just wait and see me exorcise you demons, and spread the news of my victory throughout the Cultivation World!"
In reality, they were smiling sincerely at each other.
"Sect Leader Qiu, shall we go for a meal?"
"Haha, I've heard that the food at Seek Dao Sect is second to none, and today I should feast my eyes."
As the group walked to the dining hall, Qiu Jin'an saw disciples using fried dough sticks to hammer nails, sparking a dazzling display of sparks.
He saw disciples toss flatbreads into the air, which instantly enlarged, blocking out the sun.
He saw disciples making egg soup, in a silver pot that became pitch black in an instant and gradually melted away the contents into a drop of green liquid.
In some way, his eyes were certainly opened.
Is Seek Dao Sect going to make me eat this stuff?
Qiu Jin'an was nervous, feeling that he didn't deserve this punishment.
Eventually, the group arrived at an extremely luxurious restaurant, filled with mouthwatering smells. The dishes before Qiu Jin'an were full of color, aroma, and taste.
"It looks like I wrongly blamed the Seek Dao Sect." Qiu Jin'an breathed a sigh of relief.
Fairy Eternity, wearing a white apron and a high hat, looked quite professional.
She introduced the dishes one by one: "Stewed tofu. Prepared from the top-notch spine meat of an Ice Zone Elephant, the tofu is made from the morning dew condensed on the medicinal herbs from our garden. I combined the two ingredients using an ancient secret method and achieved an astonishing effect."
Fairy Eternity wanted to see the customer's reactions: "Would you like a taste?"
Qiu Jin'an lifted the lid from the plate, and a golden light shot skyward, almost blinding him. Simultaneously, the sounds of celestial music filled his ears.
Qiu Jin'an turned his head and saw a group of people playing music nearby.
"What is this all about?"
"It's a performance, to create some ambience," Fairy Eternity explained.
Without giving it another thought, Qiu Jin'an picked up the chopsticks, snagged a piece of tofu, and was just about to put it in his mouth when he saw smoke sizzle from where chopstick and tofu made contact, quickly melting away.
With a plop, the tofu fell back onto the plate.
Qiu Jin'an blinked his eyes, wondering if he was hallucinating.
Fairy Eternity reminded him from the side: "You better eat quickly before the stewed tofu burns a hole through the plate and table."
Qiu Jin'an suppressed the urge to flip the table and decided to try another dish.
He lifted the lid off a small teacup revealing a creamy white fish soup with two strands of green leafy vegetables floating on top, making it look even more delicious.
Fairy Eternity explained: "Our sect's Taihu lake has a kind of fish called 'Emerald Water Fish', a rare species from ancient times. Once out of the water, it must be cooked immediately. If allowed to sit for more than three hours, it will rot. I captured one from the lake at dawn and cooked it with great care, preserving as much freshness and liveliness as possible in the dish.
Why don't you give it a try?"
Then Qiu Jin'an saw a small green fish swimming in the soup, occasionally leaping out before plunging back in, causing ripples on the surface. A drop of soup even splashed onto his face.
"...Is this fish a bit too lively?"
Qiu Jin'an once again suppressed the urge to flip the table.
Fairy Eternity said: "The fish you see isn't alive. It's a replica I crafted using the skeleton of the Emerald Water Fish with some ancient technique. Just poke it with your spoon, and it will disintegrate."
Qiu Jin'an carefully poked the fish with his spoon, and sure enough, it disintegrated into the soup, enhancing the richness of the white soup.
It turns out I misunderstood her, Qiu Jin'an thought.
He took a small sip and immediately spat it out: "It's so salty! How much salt did you put?!"
Fairy Eternity thought seriously: "About twenty seconds."
Qiu Jin'an slammed his hands on the table, stood up abruptly, and roared: "You Seek Dao Sect have really gone too far!"

chapters.title: Chapter 165 - 164: Call Out Your Best Disciple, Seek Dao Sect!_1
chapters.content:
"Your Seek Dao Sect is really oppressive!" Qiu Jin'an roared, angrily flipping the table over. The food spilled on the floor, sizzling as it corroded the wood. Observers' eyes twitched at the sight.
His public image had always been that of a suave gentleman who could happily converse with common folks and cultivators alike without discrimination, and indeed he was such a person.
Qiu Jin'an felt that the Seek Dao Sect was his arch-enemy, easily able to provoke his emotions.
In a certain sense, the treatment Qiu Jin'an received from Seek Dao Sect was extremely respectful, comparable to that of the Four Immortals of the Ancients.
After all, only the Four Immortals of the Ancients were qualified to taste Yellow Bean's culinary skills.
In his spiritual space, Lu Yang felt a shiver down his spine upon seeing this. It made perfect sense for the Four Immortals of the Ancients not to eat the food you cooked.
When Fairy Eternity was cooking, she blocked Lu Yang's view under pretense of "this is an ancient secret, you can't steal it".
At that time Lu Yang had a bad premonition, and now it comes to fruition.
This was only the first two dishes. Fairy Eternity had a total of eight dishes, and Lu Yang dared not to imagine what kind of monstrous scene might come next.
But that was not the most important point. The key was that everything Fairy Eternity did was under his name. To outsiders, he was the one who cooked!
Two days ago and yesterday, he abused the power of the acting sect master and challenged beyond his level wantonly. It has already caused a wave of resentment. And now, a new wave of resentment was coming.
What did I do to deserve all this? I chanted Fairy Eternity's true name and resurrected her.
Lu Yang felt that the causality of resurrecting an immortal was as heavy as a mount, he could hardly bear it.
There was a reason why the mastermind didn't want to resurrect Fairy Eternity personally!
Seeing Qiu Jin'an's rage, the Grand Elder and others secretly breathed a sigh of relief, communicating with each other through transmitting messages silently.
"It's good that our Seek Dao Sect respected the etiquette and let the Five Elements Sect eat first, otherwise it would have been a disaster for us."
"Little Lu is really considerate. He has no hatred towards the Five Elements Sect, but as soon as he heard that the Five Elements Sect had a conflict with us, he took action immediately, giving Qiu Jin'an a lesson. Good boy!"
On the side of the Five Elements Sect, they were also lamenting: "I used to despise the tradition of respecting etiquette and deemed it obsolete, but now I see that the ancients have their wisdom. Elders should eat first."
"They let us eat after the elders have finished and confirmed it's not poisonous. This is the wisdom of the ancients!"
"Our sect leader has set an example of risking his life to test for poison. This spirit is worth learning."
"We've heard from our sect leader before that both the elixirs and poison concocted by the Seek Dao Sect are unparalleled. Today, we've seen it."
"Usually people would poison the food, but this is cooking in poison."
While Qiu Jin'an was dining, the second elder showed concern for Shangguan Yu: "Fairy Yu, it's been a long time, you're still so beautiful."
Shangguan Yu looked at the second elder calmly: "Little Ba, there's no chance between us, it's not suitable, you should really give up."
The second elder was somewhat anxious: "Is it because I have some shortcomings? I can change!"
Shangguan Yu just shook her head without saying anything, but moved a little further away from the second elder.
"We all have been fasting. There's really no need to eat this meal, it's all formalities. Why not let the disciples compete against each other directly?" Qiu Jin'an didn't bother with the pleasantries and stated the purpose of this trip.
The Grand Elder answered, "Indeed, we planned to divide the competition into four stages: Foundation Establishment Stage, Golden Core Stage, Nascent Soul Stage, and Spirit Transformation Stage."
Qiu Jin'an scoffed, thinking that indeed, the Seek Dao Sect planned to arrange competitions based on cultivation levels, thus avoiding Yun Zhi's participation.
He waved his hand and said, "I only have one requirement, let your most outstanding disciple from Seek Dao Sect compete against our most outstanding disciple, a single battle will determine the victory, how about that?"
The Grand Elder hesitated, afraid the infamous scene of Yun Zhi ruthlessly defeating the Five Elements Sect would be repeated. "This isn't a good idea, everything has been planned. What if you lose terribly? It won't look good for our reputation."
They must not provoke Qiu Jin'an to the point of something disastrous happening, especially not at the Seek Dao Sect.
Seeing the Grand Elder's reaction, Qiu Jin'an's belief in his decision strengthened. "Reputation? Cultivators rely on strength to determine the victor. If one loses, they lose. If one wins, they win. Who cares about the reputation!"
Qiu Jin'an beckoned, signaling his leading disciple to step forward.
"This is my oldest disciple, Lin Shaoyou, the most outstanding pupil of our Five Elements Sect. He possesses a single wood spiritual root and has an Initial Fusion Stage Cultivation level. Typically, Wood Elemental cultivators with single spiritual roots are skilled in healing and injury treatment, and not adept at combat, but he's different!"
"Shaoyou has epitomized the philosophy of our Five Elements Sect, regarding the mutual generation and overcoming of the five elements. He's able to generate fire from wood, produce earth from fire and nurture metal from earth. He has mastered fire and metal dual-element spells - Six-C Divine Fire and Mad Demon Golden Body.
He even combined these two spells into a Forbidden Spell, causing significant damage!"
"Shaoyou has perfectly balanced the continuous sense of the Wood Spiritual Root with potent attack spells. Despite having only an Initial Fusion Stage cultivation level, his actual combat power is much higher. Just a few days ago, he triumphed over an Elder of a First Class Sect who was in the late stage of the Unification."
Lin Shaoyou, dressed like a refined scholar, bore a content smile and carried a dignified aura, giving off the impression of effortless capability.
Indeed, among his peers, he found almost none that could challenge him. His sights have moved to the previous generation, even the one before that.
"Is my opponent Dai Bufan or Ji Hongwen?"
In his opinion, within his generation in the Seek Dao Sect, only these two earned the qualification to compete against him.
During his last encounter with Yun Zhi, many of his techniques were not fully unleashed. This time, he was set on displaying his full power, aiming to win honor for his master!
"That would be me."
A voice, serene yet with a hint of indifference, sent a chilling sensation through the air.
Yun Zhi, who had been silent since the beginning, stepped forward, causing Qiu Jin'an and his leading disciple's hearts to skip a beat.
Qiu Jin'an gave a forced smirk. "Don't try to scare me. I have done my research. Yun Zhi is the Acting Sect Master and is not allowed to partake in the fight. Your best pupil can either be Dai Bufan or Ji Hongwen!"
Yun Zhi produced a document, clearly stating that Lu Yang was the Acting Sect Master for three days. She pointed at Lu Yang and announced, "Here is the current Acting Sect Master, and I am now just an ordinary disciple of the Seek Dao Sect."
Fairy Eternity chimed in buoyantly, "Exactly, I'm the current Acting Sect Master!"
"You must be joking! How can someone at the Foundation Establishment Stage serve as the Acting Sect Master!" Qiu Jin'an furiously retorted.
The Grand Elder shook his head. "That's where you're wrong. The current Sect Master Lu is a genius among geniuses. Despite only being at the Foundation Establishment Stage, he is capable of challenging higher stages and has managed to defeat opponents at the Golden Core Stage, Nascent Soul Stage, and Divinity Transformation Stage!"
Upon hearing this, every gaze in the Five Elements Sect turned towards Fairy Eternity.
A cultivator at the Foundation Establishment Stage defeating someone at the Divinity Transformation Stage, even with external help, would be equivalent to utter fantasy. Even myths wouldn't dare to spin such a tall tale!
The Seek Dao Sect, despite its poor reputation, had never lied. Particularly with matters of such gravity, Qiu Jin'an's face turned serious. He hadn't expected such a shocking prodigy to emerge from the Seek Dao Sect.
Compared to Lu Yang, any geniuses in history seemed to lose their shine!
The Seek Dao Sect was indeed formidable. They had anticipated his move and prepared in advance, arranging for Yun Zhi to fight.
Qiu Jin'an started to feel like he's caught in a dilemma. He had talked a big game. If he didn't fight, wouldn't that make him lose face?
As Qiu Jin'an was wavering, Lin Shaoyou stepped forward, deeply improving Qiu Jin'an's impression of him.
True to his title as the leading disciple, he had the courage to step forward at this critical moment, facing the pressure exerted by Yun Zhi head-on.
Lin Shaoyou took a deep breath, adjusting his breathing and mindset. He stared right at Yun Zhi and declared resolutely,
"If that's the case, then I will renounce my role as a disciple of the Five Elements Sect!"

chapters.title: Chapter 166 - 165 Test of Fairy Eternity_1
chapters.content:
Lin Shaoyou said earnestly, "I think the Seek Dao Sect is a good place to go. The brothers in the Seek Dao Sect get along harmoniously without any barriers, making me aspire to join. I wish to join the Seek Dao Sect!"
Almost being choked by Lin Shaoyou's words, Qiu Jin'an nervously pointed at Lin Shaoyou, barely managing to get out a word.
"Unfilial disciple!"
Lin Shaoyou turned to Qiu Jin'an and said, "Master, didn't you just say that as a cultivator, one shouldn't care about face?"
"Get back here!" Qiu Jin'an roared furiously.
"Oh."
Lin Shaoyou obediently stood behind Qiu Jin'an, the two exchanging glances.
"Master, how was my performance?"
"A little overdone, you still need more practice."
Qiu Jin'an coughed, gradually calming down: "Since Shaoyou doesn't want to compete, as his elders, we can't drag him there, right?"
Lin Shaoyou's proposal not to contend with Yun Zhi provided Qiu Jin'an with a reasonable explanation, allowing the Seek Dao Sect's plans to proceed as intended.
He now had a legitimate reason and wouldn't lose face.
As the oldest disciple, Lin Shaoyou often had experience taking bullets for his master.
This time, Qiu Jin'an planned to sweep through the Seek Dao Sect hierarchy from top to bottom. He brought along disciples from the Foundation Establishment Stage to the Divinity Transformation Stage for this trip - they were all the cream of the crop, confident in their invincibility at the same realm.
"Stay away from her, Ba the Second!" Noticed that the second elder was still pestering, Qiu Jin'an grabbed Shangguan Yu's hand, pulling her over and protecting her.
"Jin'an, Little Ba means no harm."
Qiu Jin'an glared: "That's even more problematic!"
Without further ado, Qiu Jin'an pulled Shangguan Yu along, arrived at the martial arts arena with his disciples, arranged the order of their appearances, and then returned to the grandstand.
The disciples of the Seek Dao Sect gathered around the martial arts arena, each of them wearing a smile. They were all here for the spectacle. Lu Yang didn't expect the Seek Dao Sect to have that many disciples.
The tavern inside the Seek Dao Sect spotted a business opportunity and sold viewing spots or peddled fruits and refreshments. It wouldn't be an exaggeration to say they were making a fortune.
In the grandstands, Fairy Eternity and Qiu Jin'an snid side by side, with Yun Zhi, the Grand Elder, Shangguan Yu, Lin Shaoyou and others sitting on both sides.
Inside the spiritual space, Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity were discussing a matter of life and death.
"Fairy, have you ever thought about being killed off by elder sister and then revived a few hundred thousand years later?"
"Huh? Why are you so cruel to me?!" Fairy Eternity was very surprised; she didn't think she did anything wrong.
"Wait, you're not angry with me because I didn't teach you the ancient cooking skills, are you? I must tell you, this is something that can't be taught lightly."
"We are not in a master-disciple relationship, imparting knowledge is a very serious matter, it can't be done casually!"
Lu Yang thought to himself: Fairy, where do you get the nerve to think your cooking skills are good? Is it because the Four Immortals of the Ancients weren't poisoned to death by you?
He pretended to be full of sorrow: "Fairy, think about it, since you became the Acting Sect Master, how much hatred have you drawn against me? Even if I were as tough as iron, I couldn't withstand it all!"
Lu Yang would guarantee that those Golden Core, Nascent Soul, and Spirit Transformation Stage senior brothers and sisters, who were challenged by Fairy Eternity, would come to teach him a lesson with their weapons once today passed.
Fairy Eternity only then realized that her playful manner had caused Lu Yang a great deal of trouble, but she was reluctant to admit her mistakes: "How could it be called attracting hatred? It's an immortal's test for you, and once you pass my test, you will get my inheritance."
Lu Yang would be interested if it were the inheritance of Yingtian Immortal, but he doubted whether his intelligence would decline after learning Fairy Eternity's inheritance.
"This is an immortal's inheritance, countless people wish to obtain it."
"What's in your inheritance?" Lu Yang looked at Fairy Eternity suspiciously.
"There are many. Be it 'Shrinking Ground Into Inches' or 'Heaven and Earth in an Inch' and other space-related skills, you have already learned them."
"Other than that, I can teach you magic skills related to time!"
Lu Yang was intrigued, magic skills related to time were the most precious. The Scripture Pavilion of the Seek Dao Sect had very few, Fairy Eternity indeed had some stuff.
"This magic skill is called 'Playing Dead Technique'. When implemented, it allows you to look like a dead person, inside and out. You can even adjust the time, controlling the rate of decay of the body, ensuring that no one can tell!"
"When facing enemies that you cannot defeat, playing dead will do!" Fairy Eternity seemed to be rather experienced, it was unknown how many times she had faked her death.
Lu Yang worried that he was being brainwashed by Fairy Eternity; he even found her reliable.
"Also, the Diving Spell, allows you to freely enter lakes and oceans!"
Lu Yang's interest perked up again. Many great powers had fallen, their corpses and relics sinking into lakes and the sea, turning these bodies of water into natural treasures. If he could go down, he might make a fortune.
"But remember to use the Diving Spell quickly, there is a time limit."
"What time limit?"
"My Diving Spell is very comprehensive. It doesn't just repel the water around you, but also the water inside your body. If you use the Diving Spell for too long, you might dehydrate to death."
Lu Yang: "…..Just let your inheritance gather dust…"
"Hey, why are you like this?!" Fairy Eternity stomped her foot in frustration.
In the outside world, Qiu Jin'an turned his head, interrupting their conversation, and asked Fairy Eternity: "Sect Master Lu seems to know a lot about the things of the ancient times, I have some questions, may I ask Sect Master Lu?"
Qiu Jin'an did not belittle Lu Yang because of his age. Since the other party was the Acting Sect Master, he would treat Lu Yang with the same respect as he would an equal.
Fairy Eternity thought that Qiu Jin'an's attitude was not bad: "Sure, but after I answer your questions, you have to tell me where you got the book of Yingtian Immortal from."
Lu Yang understood Fairy Eternity's intentions. A book from the Yingtian Immortal implied that it came from an ancient ruin. She wanted to search there for clues about herself and the Ancients.
"Alright." Qiu Jin'an agreed.
"I heard that there was a divine being in ancient times who could survive even without his head, using his own breasts as eyes and belly button as a mouth."
"There was indeed someone like that."
"I want to know, did he wear clothes?" Qiu Jin'an was very interested in these ancient legends.
Fairy Eternity thought about it and said, "Normally, he didn't wear any, going around shirtless. However, this did cause him some troubles."
"For example, some large tribes are very particular about appearances. Those who are not appropriately dressed are not allowed to enter. He walked around shirtless like a wild man, not allowed to enter. But if he wore clothes, he would look like a bandit, also not allowed to enter. Thus, he was caught between a rock and a hard place."
"Later, he got smarter and installed a fake head on himself. With clothes on, other people couldn't recognize him. However, one day, he put his head on backwards. The people around him were frightened, thinking his neck was broken and he turned into a zombie wandering the streets."

chapters.title: Chapter 167 - 166 Commentary on the Match_1
chapters.content:
"I heard that Yingtian Immortal was named Yingtian because he was borne by the heavens. Is that true?"
Fairy Eternity waved her hand dismissively: "Nah, it's just bluster. Yingtian Immortal was born into a humble tribe. In ancient times, birthright was highly valued. Even when Yingtian showcased his talent at a young age, there were those who sneered behind his back, saying his birth wasn't remarkable enough and he was destined to fall from grace."
"So, Yingtian concocted this story about being born from the heavens. It does sound pretty convincing."
"When Qilin Immortal heard about Yingtian's claims, he was outraged. You see, the Kirin is a celestial being, also considered a heavenly son, so he felt threatened by Yingtian."
"The two of them even fought over this issue. Qilin Immortal accused Yingtian of being born c-section style, stating that his birth was far from smooth and suggesting that the heavens never wanted to give birth to him."
"Yingtian Immortal shot back at Qilin Immortal calling him an uncouth creature raised without a mother. In a way, Yingtian was speaking the truth."
Lu Yang made a weird face, "Wait, aren't immortals supposed to be dignified characters? Why do they sound like local thugs when you talk about them?"
"Their fight was so intense that it ended in a draw. I had to step in and mediate, suggesting that they stop the bickering and join me for a meal instead. Considering my reputation, they took heed and stopped fighting."
"Seems like their brawl brought them closer, they decided to become sworn brothers after the fight."
Qiu Jin'an chose to ignore the self-praising part. He felt that this was nonsense and asked, "So, they became sworn brothers?"
"Nope, instead they started arguing over who should be the elder brother and ended up fighting again."
Qiu Jin'an: "...."
He had heard long ago that during the ancient times Yingtian Immortal and Qilin Immortal were at odds, frequently engaging in epic battles.
The reasons for these battles were varied according to the different accounts, but the dominant view was that there were philosophical differences between the two regarding major issues of the Immortal Dao, originating from abstract theories that undeniably influenced everything. The conflicts were irreconcilable.
Historical records noted that the two of them unleashed their full power in their cosmic battles, completely obliterating certain realms where even stars and spiritual energy vanished. '
So they fought over issues like this?
It appears to be quite different from the grandeur of the ancient times that I had imagined, doesn't it?
In the stands, the two sect leaders were exchanging ancient knowledge while on the tournament ground, the disciples from both sides had begun their intense face-offs.
…...
The first to take the stage was Seek Dao Sect's contestant- Meng Jingzhou, competing against Five Elements Sect's contestant- Du Xueyi.
This contestant Du Xueyi was no ordinary player. As per the insiders from Five Elements Sect, Du Xueyi possessed the rare Golden Spirit Root, had gone through rigorous training, making him tough as steel. He had also mastered the Rushing Thunder Fist, his fists were indestructible, swift as the wind and fall heavy like rain.
Meng Jingzhou was a formidable player too. As per Lu Yang, who preferred to remain anonymous, Meng Jingzhou possessed the rarely seen Single Body Spiritual Root. Despite frequenting brothels, he remained uncorrupted. We have to admire his indomitable spirit.
Interestingly, Meng Jingzhou was also a Body Cultivator under the tutelage of the infamous Body Cultivation Great Power Third Elder in the Cultivation World. Let's see what kind of exciting performance these two athletes can deliver today, let's wait and see."
The two contestants were already positioned on the stage, staring at each other intently, one arrogant, the other lascivious. Contestant Du Xueyi seemed a bit uncomfortable with the lascivious gaze of his opponent, putting him on the back foot."
From the very first round, Meng Jingzhou took the lead with his shameless gusto!
The match is about to begin and Meng Jingzhou is approaching the referee. What is he up to?
He has pulled out a premium Spirit Stone. He's actually brazenly bribing the referee right in public view!
The referee declines Meng Jingzhou's bribe and issues him a yellow card as a warning!
Meng Jingzhou seems to have misunderstood the referee's action, thinking the referee wanted to exchange the yellow card for his Spirit Stone.
The referee retaliated! The referee confronted Meng Jingzhou!
Apparently, the referee must have realized that he shouldn't have acted against a contestant. He gave himself a red card and disqualified himself.
This match is truly unpredictable – the match hasn't even started and we're already on to our second referee!
Meng Jingzhou, not discouraged by his defeat, decided to try his luck and attempted to bribe Du Xueyi instead.
Du Xueyi, obviously unprepared for such an approach, appeared flustered. Thankfully, Qiu Jin'an's presence of mind helped him snap out of it, and he promptly refused Meng Jingzhou's outrageous offer.
The new referee, seemingly more experienced, once again issued a yellow card to warning to Meng Jingzhou.
Finally, Meng Jingzhou conceded and got down to the business of competing in earnest.
As soon as the match commenced, Du Xueyi sprang into action, launching a barrage of punches like a violent storm, resulting in echoing thunderous sounds which forced Meng Jingzhou on the defensive, causing him to retreat while protecting his head."
Meng Jingzhou, you're getting what you deserve... sorry about that, the commentator got a little personal. Please bear with us."
While it appears Meng Jingzhou was at a disadvantage, he hardly seemed to suffer any injuries. In contrast, Du Xueyi was panting heavily after his onslaught of Rushing Thunder Fists.
Meng Jingzhou seized Du Xueyi's moment of weakness to retaliate fiercely, and unleashed the Third Elder's famed technique—Shocking Heaven Six Forms, gaining the upper hand!
Du Xueyi appeared to be taken aback by Meng Jingzhou's fierce counterattack and lost the initiative, forced to adopt a defensive stance!
Meng Jingzhou attacked like a tiger descending a mountain, his fists and palms landed heavily and delivered an overwhelming blow, splashing Du Xueyi's blood!
Du Xueyi bore the pain, taking a heavy punch from Meng Jingzhou before stepping back to recover.
Meng Jingzhou, not relenting, struck Du Xueyi fiercely as he drew near, but Du Xueyi seemed to be slowly adapting to Meng Jingzhou's combat style, locking fists and feet with him causing sharp, jarring sounds!
The exchange of blows between the two was intense, leading to a stalemate, no one able to gain the upper hand.
Meng Jingzhou was the first to break the deadlock, he lunged forward half a step and struck Du Xueyi's head with his own!
An unexpected move! Could it be Meng Jingzhou had been practicing Iron Head...wait, that doesn't seem to be the case!
The one that struck Du Xueyi's head wasn't Meng Jingzhou's actual head, but his hair!
Would you believe it? Meng Jingzhou, as a Body Refinement practitioner, had strengthened his hair to such an extent that it had become as hard as his body! And hair doesn't have pain receptors!
What a brilliant move! It's simply marvel worthy!
Du Xueyi was stunned by the blow to his head, retreating while holding his head, fulfilling Meng Jingzhou's intention!
Meng Jingzhou seized the opportunity, grabbed hold of Du Xueyi's clothing, and threw Du Xueyi out of the ring!
Meng Jingzhou has won the match!
Fairy Eternity, announced with a sound-amplifying array: "I declare that in the first round of the Foundation Establishment group match, Meng Jingzhou is victorious."
After the announcement, Fairy Eternity asked Lu Yang in a spiritual space:
"What was all that stuff you were just blabbering on about?"

chapters.title: Chapter 168 - 167 Confucian Cultivator vs Confucian Cultivator_1
chapters.content:
"Du Xueyi still lacks combat experience. A loss should serve as a lesson," Qiu Jin'an shook his head, seemingly unconcerned about the unfavorable start.
In his heart, Lu Yang thought, stop putting up a front Sect Leader Qiu, you've already crushed a teacup out of anger and still act all nonchalant about it.
Allowing Meng Jingzhou to fight in the first round was Lu Yang's idea. He wanted Meng Jingzhou to show the Five Elements Sect what they were up against.
Fairy Eternity hesitated before speaking, "Sect Leader Qiu, I think Meng Jingzhou's use of his cultivated hair to smash into the opponent's head can't simply be described as a lack of combat experience."
At least in the ancient times, Fairy Eternity had never seen such an outrageous method of Body Refinement.
Could this be the new-age Body Refinement Cultivator?
Qiu Jin'an was silenced by the blunt Fairy Eternity and lost for words.
Can I have someone else sit by my side?
Qiu Jin'an tried to maintain an aloof demeanor and said, "I merely let Du Xueyi lead off to warm up the crowd. The next one to appear won't be an easy target."
On the battle platform appeared a refined Confucian Cultivator wearing a ceremonial headdress, with a paper fan in his hand. Dressed in a pale turquoise robe, he walked with an unhurried calm.
"This is our Sect's most outstanding Confucian Cultivator during the Foundation Establishment Stage, Fang Hao."
Qiu Jin'an spoke with ceremony, but all the members of the Five Elements Sect knew all too well that Fang Hao was actually on par with Du Xueyi.
"What a coincidence, ours is also a Confucian Cultivator!"
On the other side of the platform, Man Gu, carrying a large hammer, arrived late. Originally, Man Gu wanted to bring Meng Jingzhou with him, but the referee disallowed it, claiming Meng Jingzhou was not a weapon. Thus, Man Gu had to resort to his newly exchanged Black Sand Iron Hammer.
A Talisman was attached to the handle of the hammer, able to recite the complete "Words of the Saint."
"The Saint said: To learn and exercise at proper times, isn't it a pleasure? ... "
Man Gu step by step approached Fang Hao, his face grim. The sound of the "Words of the Saint" echoed across the entire battle platform. He looked like a villainous brute who had just slaughtered a family of twenty-eight— even sparing no rat — who now recites a death mantra. He seemed oddly out of place.
