As the match began, Man Gu swung his Black Sand Iron Hammer at Fang Hao. Fang Hao swiftly sidestepped, avoiding the attack with grace.
Man Gu leveraged his wrist strength to abruptly change the trajectory of the hammer, sweeping it towards Fang Hao.
Fang Hao hadn't expected Man Gu to be so wild. Unable to evade the hammer, he swung his paper fan to block the attack. The fan shattered, and he was swept away.
The paper fan was a magic artifact, capable of blocking a fatal attack, so Fang Hao was not injured.
He collected himself, realizing that this was a tricky opponent.
A miniature whirlwind encircled Fang Hao. As it disappeared, an invisible but very real force field enveloped him.
"Haoran's Upright Qi?" Fairy Eternity exclaimed. This was the first time she had seen Haoran's Upright Qi after her resurrection.
Fang Hao was an orthodox Confucian Cultivator, and the invisible force was Haoran's Upright Qi.
"In the ancient times, Confucian Cultivators and Haoran's Upright Qi existed too?" Lu Yang asked.
"Of course they did.The author of 'Words of the Saint' appeared far earlier than you might have imagined."
"Did Sage Kong then attain immortality?"
"Don't know."
"Don't know?"
"Saint is not a stage of cultivation, but denotes a state of mind that embodies 'benevolence'. Spending a lifetime inculcating 'benevolence' is the realm of a Saint."
"The meaning of 'benevolence' is vast. Even if I explained it to you day and night for three days straight, I would not finish it. Of course, even I do not have the understanding to expound it for such a length."
Clearly, Fairy Eternity had an acute understanding of her own intellectual capacities.
Using Haoran's Upright Qi as ink, Fang Hao wrote in the air— Gentleman, stop. Passage prohibited.
Upon seeing the writing, Man Gu involuntarily halted his stride, his body completely out of control.
This was an extremely rare magic skill amongst Confucian cultivators - the Unity of Knowledge and Action Skill. This skill compels the target to act in accordance with the written command, achieving unity in knowledge and action.
Obviously, this skill wasn't without limitations; judicious as Fang Hao was, he could only apply the Unity of Knowledge and Action Skill on others within the same realm. Those of a higher realm were naturally immune to it.
Now, to use it against Man Gu seemed perfect.
Fang Hao wrote once again— Do not do unto others what you do not wish done unto you.
By using this quote, if Man Gu wanted to hit Fang Hao, he would first have to hit himself.
Expecting Man Gu to stop after the first command disappeared, he simply swung his hammer toward Fang Hao, frightening him greatly.
"How did you break free from my control!"
"Control?" Man Gu did not quite understand Fang Hao's words. "Doesn't this sentence just mean that I shouldn't do to others what I wouldn't want done to myself? It isn't restricting my freedom, is it?"
Fang Hao was so frustrated he nearly spat out blood. The prerequisite of knowing the Unity of Knowledge and Action Skill was understanding the meaning of the phrase, after all, the target was simply a barbarian!
Fang Hao was grazed by a swing of Man Gu's hammer, causing his blood to flow. He quickly retreated, evading Man Gu's hammer, and once again wrote— If you want to attack me, you must first attack yourself.
Even though the effect of written vernacular was far less than that of the ancient text, there was no time for these considerations.
Man Gu, wielding his hammer, continued to swing at Fang Hao, unfazed by any control.
Unbelievable! Are you just a primitive man who can't even read? Fang Hao thought.
It wasn't until Man Gu, with a jump and a swing aimed at Fang Hao's head, that Fang Hao noticed—Man Gu was fighting with his eyes shut!
After training with Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou for a month, Man Gu had become very nimble. After their two previous encounters, he realized that as long as he didn't look at the words Fang Hao wrote, he wouldn't fall for his tricks.
With this logic in mind, he decided to shut his eyes!
As Man Gu's hammer descended, the referee stepped in and deflected the attack.
If this hit had connected, Fang Hao may have ended up never being able to wield his brush to write again.
"Second round, Man Gu wins."
Qiu Jin'an's expression darkened. However, he'd been bullied by the nine sons of Seek Dao Sect since he was a child; he was used to sporting sour looks.
Fairy Eternity remarked, "As expected of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe, a race born for battle. They're even capable of fighting with their eyes shut."
"Do you know a lot about the Ancient Barbarian Tribe?" Lu Yang asked.
Fairy Eternity answered confidently, "Of course, it's accurate to say I was their teacher once."
"As you know, the members of the barbarian tribe aren't particularly bright. They happened to hear about my brilliant wisdom and outstanding intelligence, even amongst the immortals, and invited me to teach at the Barbarian Tribe."
"Teaching the Barbarian Tribe was hard work. They forgot everything they learnt. What they learnt during the day they forgot by night. Fortunately I, with my remarkable perseverance and patience, finally learnt what it meant to give up."
"I later changed my strategy and directly instilled my wisdom into their minds and bloodlines, so that even if I didn't teach them, their intelligence would still reach a level second only to mine!"
Lu Yang sucked in a breath, wondering if he should share this with Man Gu.
Suddenly, Lu Yang realized something: as a member of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe, Man Gu had never heard of Fairy Eternity.
"Was the Barbarian Tribe's heritage incomplete, or did someone deliberately erase Fairy Eternity's existence?"
The world forgetting an immortal, how elaborate was that?

chapters.title: Chapter 169 - 168: Lu Yang Goes to Battle (Additional Updates Requesting Monthly Tickets)_1
chapters.content:
"Next up, Li Haoran from the Seek Dao Sect versus Long Xiang from the Five Elements Sect."
"So Li Haoran is a Fire Spirit Root?" Qiu Jin'an suddenly asked.
"Yes, what's up?"
"Interesting. Long Xiang from our sect is a Water Spirit Root. This time, it's fire against water."
In the martial arts arena, Li Haoran and Long Xiang exchanged bows.
"May I learn from you."
"I am unworthy."
The two remained silent, saying no more.
The moment the match began, Long Xiang lunged forward. It was like a dragon soaring above the sea, giving off waves of terror. Holding two ice-blades, chilled air emitted from his weapons, making the temperature drop across the entire martial arts field."
"Dragon Strike!"
Long Xiang shouted, confronting Li Haoran's fist firmly.
Lu Yang raised his eyebrows; Li Haoran is not a Body Cultivator. Why would he fight barehanded without using any weapons? Even Man Gu knew to fight with a weapon.
Unaware of Li Haoran's strength, Long Xiang perceived no issue and hurled an attack towards him.
A thick circle of fire sprang up around Li Haoran. He pointed at Long Xiang and said, "Go." The circle of fire instantly surrounded Long Xiang.
"Rise, Tidal Wave!"
Long Xiang cast his magic, which caused a phantom of tidal waves to form behind him, and the spectators in the audience faintly heard the sound of surging waves.
The phantom of the waves weakened the fire circle. Observing this, Li Haoran briskly strolled towards him and launched a flurry of crimson punches at Long Xiang's body.
Lava churning under Li Haoran's feet was the result of soaking in a magma pool for a full year.
As the lava met the tidal waves, a thick fog obscured the field due to the eruptions caused by the collision of the phantom waves. The fog made discovering their figures difficult; only the sounds of the collisions between Li Haoran and Long Xiang could be heard.
Li Haoran's punches were astonishing, completely unlike anything those who knew him had seen before. Long Xiang, not adept at close combat, was hit multiple times as he struggled to counter.
Luckily, the force of Li Haoran's attacks wasn't too great, so the blows didn't cause too much damage.
Long Xiang raised his hand to gather the dense fog into a water pillar, which crashed onto Li Haoran.
Unable to dodge, Li Haoran was hit by the water pillar and became soaked.
When Li Haoran clashed with Long Xiang again, Long Xiang had clearly gained the upper hand. For some reason, Li Haoran had become sluggish.
Li Haoran furrowed his brows when he realized the issue.
Long Xiang burst out laughing: "Brother Li, you're clever to realize my trap so soon, but it's too late. You're soaked from the water pillar. I can control the weight of the water, causing you to carry a heavy burden. You can't move freely as before, you've lost!"
Unexpectedly, Li Haoran revealed a slight smile: "Is that so? I beg to differ."
Long Xiang attempted to strike but found he couldn't move.
"What have you done!" Long Xiang's eyes widened in utter confusion, having no idea what had happened.
Flames erupted around Li Haoran, evaporating the water vapor. He leisurely walked up to Long Xiang, saying, "Your clothes have been melted by me."
Long Xiang finally realized that Li Haoran's numerous punches weren't for attacking, but for melting his clothes. He had turned his garment into a metal bucket and trapped him, Long Xiang, inside like prey with no escape.
Are all your fighting methods from Seek Dao Sect so strange!
Is this even a strategy a human would conceive of?!
Li Haoran further explained: "I heard from my senior brother, Lu Yang, that during a battle, you can use a storage ring to take away an opponent's clothes. That made me think, if you're able to take away an opponent's clothes, why not melt them as well? It appears my idea is correct."
Shocked Qiu Jin'an looked at Lu Yang, wondering how he could come up with such a shameless fight strategy.
"Oh right, this is after all, the Seek Dao Sect. It makes sense now."
With three wins in three fights, the victory of the Foundation Establishment Group was now a foregone conclusion.
However, since this competition is an exchange match, the matches had to continue even though the winner was already decided.
The fourth match was Tao Yaoye. The rarity of the Feather Transformation Immortal Body above the Single Spiritual Root was terrifying, and in terms of one-on-one fights, she was even stronger than Li Haoran.
Yet to everyone's surprise, Tao Yaoye lost.
The one who defeated Tao Yaoye was a young man in a white robe, his cultivation level was at the mid-stage of Foundation Establishment and he was one year older than Tao Yaoye.
Tao Yaoye was currently in the early stage of Foundation Establishment, and in terms of magical power and combat experience, she was slightly inferior to the young man in the white robe.
"Next." The young man in the white robe said indifferently. He didn't step down and chose to continue fighting.
The disciple that Qiu Jin'an chose to fight fifth saw the young man in white robe behaving so dominantly, he knew that he was always like this and didn't say anything, voluntarily giving up his qualification to participate.
Tao Yaoye felt somewhat unwilling. She had always been first from childhood and had never lost. The opponent's magic skills were so refined that she lost without even revealing the advantages of her Feather Transformation Immortal Body.
Someone patted Tao Yaoye's shoulder from behind.
Seeing that person, tears whirled in Tao Yaoye's eyes: "Senior Brother, I lost."
The person wiped the tears from Tao Yaoye's eyes and comforted: "Your cultivation level is insufficient, your experience is lacking, and moreover, you are younger than him by one year. And, Eldest Senior Sister once told me that Feather Transformation Immortal Body has no significant advantages in the early stage."
"Since you regard me as your Senior Brother, I shall win him for you."
...
Seeing that they finally won a match, Qiu Jin'an introduced with a smile, "This is my junior disciple Bai Ming, also my most capable disciple. He has mastered three of the Five Elements magic skills and the fire attribute magic skill can even produce True Fire. In the Sect's grand competition, he swept through the Foundation Establishment Stage to become the leader."
The Five Elements magic skills are extremely difficult to cultivate, and there's conflict between the magic skills. If one is not careful, one's cultivation level will completely be wasted, Bai Ming mastering three types of attribute magic skills in the Foundation Establishment Stage was an extreme rarity.
Bai Ming's appearance gave Qiu Jin'an confidence: "Whoever is sent, it doesn't matter."
Despite having lost three matches, the overwhelming situation brought by Bai Ming made Qiu Jin'an unable to suppress his grin.
"Who will your sect send to participate in the next match?"
"Me."
Fairy Eternity answered for Lu Yang.
On the arena, a figure slowly walked forward, with steady strides, neither fast nor slow, it was Lu Yang.
But this Lu Yang was bald and had a compassionate face, it greatly contrasted with the usual image Lu Yang gave off.
Bai Ming broke his indifferent expression, his face filled with disbelief, like he had seen a ghost.
He of course recognized Lu Yang, the acting sect master of Seek Dao Sect, who was sitting on the grandstand. So who was the one standing in front of him?!
"A clone!" Qiu Jin'an, being so observant, could see at a glance that the Lu Yang standing on the stage was a clone.
But that's more impossible, Lu Yang is just in the Foundation Establishment Stage, how could he possibly have a clone?
In his knowledge, no magic skill or method could accomplish this!
"To be precise, a clone of the Bodhi Tree." Fairy Eternity added.
Lu Yang used the "Tree-Planting Sutra" to plant himself, and two people grew out from the Bodhi tree, one was the real him and the other was a bald clone.
"A clone from the Seventy-Two Divine Skills?!" Qiu Jin'an was horrified, other than Yun Zhi, how could any other Foundation Establishment cultivators possibly learn this magic skill?
"No, wrong, it's a wooden clone!" Waves of shock surged in Qiu Jin'an's heart. There had never been such a magic skill before, this was the creation of a new magic skill!
Who did it?!
Was it Yun Zhi, or...
Qiu Jin'an shifted his gaze to Lu Yang, his eyes twitched. He had heard from the people of Seek Dao Sect before that Lu Yang challenged a higher rank, and he thought Lu Yang had used some underhanded means.
If this magic skill was truly created by him, then there might be no false pretenses in the challenge of higher rank!
(Additional chapter for the big houseplant master)

chapters.title: Chapter 170 - 169: Duel of Five Elements Magic Skills_1
chapters.content:
"Seek Dao Sect, Lu Yang."
"Five Elements Sect, Bai Ming."
Bai Ming became highly alert upon noticing his master's expression on the grandstand, yet he did not stop the match.
This indicated that Lu Yang was defying conventional norms, but he had not broken any rules or cheated.
This was truly terrifying.
Swoosh—
The sound of a long spear slicing the air marked the start of the battle.
Bai Ming held a silver long spear that shimmered brilliantly in the sunlight.
He was the first to attack. Lu Yang calmly responded, side-stepping to the right. His Green Peak Sword slid past the spear shaft, causing sparks to fly.
The Green Peak Sword continued its trajectory along the spear shaft towards Bai Ming's hands. By a shake of his wrist, Bai Ming made the spear vibrate and pushed the attack of Green Peak Sword away.
The sword light is like rain, turning into a river and surging downwards. The long spear was fierce and powerful, fearless of Lu Yang's swordsmanship, choosing to meet force with force.
As the sword and spear crossed, victory hung in the balance, a dazzling exchange that left the Five Elements Sect disciples astonished. They had never seen anyone of the same level match Bai Ming in a weapon-based battle.
"Draw?" Meng Jingzhou sneered upon hearing that. From the beginning, Lu Yang had been using basic sword moves in response. His basic sword moves were simply too fluently linked together, which the Foundation Establishment disciples of the Five Elements Sect simply failed to notice.
Meng Jingzhou knew best the power of Lu Yang's swordsmanship. Up to this point, Lu Yang had not even used his swordsmanship techniques.
Lu Yang seldom used his sword, but this didn't imply that his swordsmanship was weak. As a Sword Spirit Root, how could he not be proficient in swordsmanship?
Tao Yaoye had her eyes fixed on Lu Yang in the battlefield, wondering about something else.
She remembered distinctly that when Lu Yang was learning the "Tree-Planting Sutra," the distance between him and the plant man clone was only twenty meters.
However, the distance between Lu Yang on the grandstand and on the martial grounds was clearly far more than twenty meters.
Tao Yaoye was unaware that after defeating the Tiger Demon, Lu Yang learned a magic spell for controlling a ghost servant. But once he mastered it, the spell turned into the Soul out of Body Technique.
After obtaining his Bodhi Tree clone, Lu Yang used the Soul out of Body Technique to enter the plant man's body, eliminating any worries about the distance between his original body and the clone.
In other words, Lu Yang's soul was now on the battlefield while his body on the grandstand had come under complete control of Fairy Eternity.
On the martial grounds, Lu Yang seized the opportunity and somersaulted mid-air. His right leg raised, every ounce of his strength concentrated on his foot as it sandwiched the spearhead of the silver long spear. Bai Ming wanted to pull out his spear, but Lu Yang's body weighed on it like a mountain.
The Green Peak Sword traced a curve in the air, breaking the sound barrier and aiming straight at Bai Ming!
A gasp of astonishment arose from below the stage. Then, a Five Elements Sect disciple quickly responded, "Don't panic. Don't forget that Bai Ming's strength lies in his Five Elements magic. His spear technique only serves as a distraction!"
Bai Ming let go of the long spear and retreated quickly. He made a hand seal, and a giant earthen snake started to roll over the ground, emerging from the earth.
The martial grounds weren't paved with bricks but with a special kind of yellow soil that was solidified using the Array Method.
"It's the Earth Dragon from the Five Elements magic!" exclaimed Long Xiang of the Five Elements Sect.
The dragon shape held a special meaning in the Cultivation World. At this stage, Bai Ming could only turn earth into a snake, not a dragon. Even so, summoning an Earthen Snake so effortlessly was not something an ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivator could do!
Lu Yang, seeming not to care, softly uttered two words as he passed through the Earth Dragon.
"Shrink Ground."
Bai Ming's pupils contracted. What kind of spell was this? Was it Five Elements magic?
He hadn't expected Lu Yang to know Five Elements magic, and what's more, it was the extremely difficult to learn Earth Escape Technique!
Even he had merely scratched the surface and hadn't truly mastered the Earth Escape Technique!
Could it be that the opponent's talent for magic was even greater than his own?!
It couldn't be! He had the same Five Elements Immortal Body as the founder of the Five Elements Sect, so he inherently understood the logic of Five Elements magic!
Qiu Jin'an felt a chill upon seeing this: "That's wrong, it's not the Earth Escape Technique!"
There was no one who understood the methods and implementation of Five Elements magic as well as he did. Yet the magic that Lu Yang was using did not match any spell that he knew of in his mind.
Another entirely new magic skill?!
"How was this created?" Qiu Jin'an turned to ask Fairy Eternity.
Fairy Eternity replied with a blank expression, "I learned it while studying the Shrinking Ground Into Inches technique."
"What?"
Qiu Jin'an did not understand. How much were these two magic skills related?
The situation changed again on the field. Bai Ming went from defense to offense. Holding a talisman imprint, the Aura of Gold Intimidation converged.
Dozens of small knives flew out from his bosom, allowing him to manipulate them freely.
"It's the Command Gold Technique!" Fang Hao from the Five Elements Sect shouted out the name of the magic skill.
The Command Gold Technique allows one to manipulate all metallic materials. If refined to high proficiency, it can even manipulate the enemy's magic artifacts, which is terrible indeed.
The current Bai Ming could only manipulate his own magic artifacts. It was similar to the Item Commanding Technique, but more focused on combat.
Dozens of small knives were like deadly weapons, coming from all directions and aimed at Lu Yang's vital parts.
When confronted with unavoidable attacks, Lu Yang pulled out the Gold Light Curse, placed it on his body, and a bright and strong light emitted from his body to form a protective golden aura.
This was the Gold Light Curse that he bought when Dai Bufan had rewarded him with 3000 contribution points after he came back to Seek Dao Sect from Yanjiang County.
The small knives collided with Lu Yang's body and were directly repelled.
Bai Ming scoffed, "Ha, it's just an incantation. It's limited by its number and time. You are just using a secondary spell, how many times can you block it?"
After hearing this, Lu Yang removed the Gold Light Curse.
Bai Ming continued to scoff, "Giving up resistance, huh..."
Lu Yang took out the Gold Light Curse again, his body bursting with golden light. He repeatedly took it off and put it back on, and the alternating light was so intense that it almost blinded Bai Ming's eyes.
Bai Ming had never thought that the Gold Light Curse could be used this way.
He had never encountered this situation before. His eyelids instinctively wanted to close, but he realized that if he closed them now, he would definitely be attacked by Lu Yang. He struggled against his instinct, half closing his eyes.
Just as he was struggling against his instinct, Lu Yang used the Earth Escape Technique. He sprang from under Bai Ming's foot, and with a charged punch hit Bai Ming's chin, knocking out a tooth!
"Golden Crow Flame!" Bai Ming used his strongest attack, aiming for a decisive victory.
The red gold flame ran wild, and a faint cry of the golden crow rang out from the flame. The flame burned fiercely, and the temperature of the entire martial arts arena rose by dozens of degrees in an instant, which everyone in the audience could feel.
The one with the strongest reaction to the Golden Crow Flame was Long Xiang, who had the Water Spirit Root. Since ancient times, water and fire have been incompatible. The appearance of the Golden Crow Flame gave him a feeling of suffocation, and the circulation of spiritual energy in his body slowed down a bit.
"So this is the Golden Crow Flame that establishes Senior Brother Bai as the number one in the Foundation Establishment Stage. It's really strong!"
"I heard Sect Leader say that Senior Brother Bai's Golden Crow Flame is transforming into a higher level skill called the Sun True Fire. When Senior Brother Bai forms a golden core, the Golden Crow Flame will successfully metamorphose into Sun True Fire. To have True Fire at the beginning of the Golden Core Stage is really terrifying!"
Long Xiang turned his head and saw that Li Haoran, who has the Fire Spirit Root, did not worry about Lu Yang at all, and was quite surprised. As a fire spirit root holder, he should be the most aware of the terribleness of the Golden Crow Flame.
"Aren't you worried about Lu Yang?"
Li Haoran smiled slightly and answered unexpectedly: "Senior Brother Lu once commissioned me to refine a Flying Car. We worked together for three days and finally succeeded."
"And during the refining process, Senior Brother Lu was in charge of providing the flame. Do you know what kind of fire that was?"
"What kind of fire?"
"Samadhi True Fire."
On the martial arts arena, Bai Ming, who held the victory in his hands, suddenly felt restless. However, the Golden Crow Flame blocked his view, and he could not see Lu Yang's movements.
Suddenly, his expression changed.
He could feel from Lu Yang's direction, a fiercer and more domineering flame coming.
That feeling...it was true fire!

chapters.title: Chapter 171 - 170 Diving Spell_1
chapters.content:
"Great Void Elixir Scripture" is the most prestigious and universally accepted classic in the Cultivation World.
The "Great Void Elixir Scripture" stated in its opening dialogue what the superior method of refining pills is: "Use the great void as the cauldron, the Taiji as the furnace, purity as the foundation of the pill, inaction as the Dantian, life and character as the mercury, and the five internal organs as the fire."
This is where the Samadhi True Fire comes from, and as such, it is often revered as the treasure for refining pills by Pill Masters.
The Samadhi True Fire can refine heavenly and earthly treasures and likewise, in a certain sense, cultivators are also considered heavenly and earthly treasures, so you can imagine the consequence if it encounters cultivators.
Lu Yang's Three Flavored True Fire is derived from the Samadhi True Fire, though it is somewhat less potent, but it is not to be trifled with.
On the Dueling Plaza, Lu Yang's Three Flavored True Fire is in full swing, turning into a fire dragon, biting the Golden Crow and tearing apart the Golden Crow flame.
Bai Ming couldn't believe the scene before his eyes. Could someone really learn True Fire at the Foundation Establishment Stage, not to mention the renowned Samadhi True Fire?
This was something he, who has been adored and praised since childhood, found hard to accept.
On the spectators' platform, Qiu Jin'an was initially beating his thigh excitedly as he watched his excellent disciple Bai Ming conjure the Golden Crow flame with great splendour. But his laughter was cut short when he saw Lu Yang conjure the True Fire.
"Is this Samadhi True Fire? No, it is very close to Samadhi True Fire!"
Qiu Jin'an searched through all the True Fires he knew, but none of them matched this one.
A chilling thought emerged in his mind: could this be a flame not included in the 108 known True Fires?
Was it unrecorded and undiscovered before, or was it just created by someone?
"Sect Master Lu, what kind of True Fire is this?"
Fairy Eternity spoke lightly, "It's nothing, just a type of fire used for roasting skewers. Sect Master Qiu doesn't need to make a fuss over it."
Fairy Eternity's attitude further affirmed Qiu Jin'an's speculation, which made him take a sharp breath inwardly.
How could this Sect Master Lu be so powerful and not only master the three magic skills of wood, earth, and fire, just like Bai Ming, but also create a new magic skill on top of that?
Creation of magic skill is totally fine, but creating a True Fire?
Bai Ming was burned by the Three Flavored True Fire, then punched in the chest by the advancing Lu Yang and was sent flying with a volatile combination of sweet, salty and spicy flavours, his breath weak, and barely clinging to life.
In the process of being thrown backwards, he realized he had lost the battle and had no power to turn the tides.
Should he admit defeat with grace? Or persist and wait for the announcement of the match results?
Scenes flashed through Bai Ming's mind—
When he was a child, he was taken to the mountain by his master, nurtured by his senior brothers and sisters, assiduously reading books, persistently working out, and during his Cultivation periods, his master went stern, chiding him and making him refine his attitude and posture. After the cultivation session, his master would rub medicine on his wounds and encourage him to persevere.
He was soaked in sweat through his meticulous practice, unremitting his efforts, understanding the magic skills, enduring the harsh seasons and loneliness, accumulating and releasing his energy for quick growth, progressing from Qi Refinement to Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment without a single defeat.
Bai Ming closed his eyes, contemplating his various encounters with Lu Yang during the battle, he felt as if something inside of him was sprouting.
He landed smoothly, clasped his hands together and stood on one foot, his energy growing stronger.
Bai Ming opened his eyes radiating power beyond his own.
"He broke through to the late stage of Foundation Establishment?" Qiu Jin'an was overjoyed to see the breakthrough of his disciple.
Bai Ming remained in the mid-stage of Foundation Establishment for a few months, so it was truly time for him to breakthrough. But he did not expect it to happen at that moment.
The teachings in the Five Elements Sect turned heads, what a dramatic turn of events.
Lu Yang was not sure how to react. He was just about to win, but then this opponent has a breakthrough in the middle of the battle?!
Isn't this the sort of thing that's supposed to happen to me?
"Well, let's continue." Lu Yang lifted his Green Peak Sword. He hadn't used his real power yet, neither the 'Zhan' or the 'Po' magical formula was activated yet.
There's no need for the Imitation Fist. That'll be too much. Lu Yang wouldn't be that heartless.
"Lu Yang, Lu Yang, swap me in!" Fairy Eternity called out to Lu Yang, itching to see Lu Yang in action and also wanting a piece of the action herself.
Fairy Eternity was in a spirit state, without a twenty-meter limit, so as long as Lu Yang agreed, she could split a clone for Lu Yang at any time.
Lu Yang was a bit suspicious. Could he really depend on Fairy Eternity?
Fairy Eternity stood with her hands on her hips, pointing at Lu Yang: "I am the Sect Leader. You need to listen to me!"
Lu Yang gave in helplessly. Fine, she brought out the Acting Sect Leader card. If it looked like she was losing, he would just reclaim the control.
Fairy Eternity contentedly took control of the bald-headed clone of Lu Yang, raising her right hand and pointing a finger. She looked a little flirtatious.
Bai Ming looked at Lu Yang peculiarly. If the Lu Yang just now resembled a monk, then now he looked like... a nun?
Could it be a split personality?
Bai Ming heard a saying in the Cultivation World, "If not a demon, then not alive." There were countless practitioners in history who went mad from training. Those who could make a name for themselves in history were undoubtedly powerful.
"Could it be that Lu Yang's strength is because of a split personality?" Bai Ming felt more convinced the more he thought about it.
Fairy Eternity slowly raised her fingers. An Immortal Method coiled around her fingertips, and she softly chanted, "Diving Spell."
An invisible barrier spread out, with Fairy Eternity at the center, rejecting all the water vapor within the radius.
The battlefield was already not very humid due to the clash of two fires. Now, there wasn't even a drop of water around Fairy Eternity!
But that wasn't the scariest part. The scariest part was that Bai Ming's body also contained water, and it was rapidly leaving his body!
Lu Yang's body also contained water. However, as the caster, the speed at which the water was drawn from his body was much slower than Bai Ming's!
Bai Ming looked in horror at his body that was gradually drying up. He didn't know what to do, he had no way to stop this magic skill. This was beyond his comprehension.
The Diving Spell showed no signs when it was cast. To outsiders, it seemed like nothing had happened. Only the person who experienced it personally knew how terrifying this magic skill was!
"We admit defeat!" Qiu Jin'an personally stepped forward, stopping the water from leaking out of Bai Ming and gave him an Elixir to replenish his body.
He deeply glanced at Lu Yang. As expected of someone who could become the Acting Sect Leader. Proficient in four of the Five Elements magic skills and also knew a water attribute magic skill. Plus it was one of the forbidden Great Divine Skills recorded in ancient scriptures!
Lu Yang's eyes widened. This was Fairy Eternity's Diving Spell? Was it really this terrifying?
Fairy Eternity chuckled: "It's so-so. It's a shame your current realm is too low, and your senior brothers and sisters are full of Golden Core, not letting out any vapor and locking it within their bodies. This move is useless against them. Once you also reach the Golden Core Stage, and when I use your body to cast this move, none of them would stand a chance against me!"
"Can you teach me?" Lu Yang rubbed his hands, wanting to learn this move.
Fairy Eternity turned her head. "You belittled my inheritance, no teaching!"
"Please teach me, Fairy sister."
"No teaching! When I say no, I mean no!"
...
When Qiu Jin'an returned to the stands, he found that Sect Leader Lu was gone and Yun Zhi was sitting next to him.
Although I did say I wanted someone else to sit next to me, I didn't mean Yun Zhi.
Qiu Jin'an felt the temperature around him drop several degrees.
"Miss Yun Zhi, where did Sect Leader Lu go?" Qiu Jin'an tried to strike up a conversation, otherwise the atmosphere would be too cold.
"There are a few guests who are good at barbecuing outside the mountain gate, he went to invite them in."
"Huh?"

chapters.title: Chapter 172 - 171: This Journey is Blessed by Immortal Eternity (Thanks to the Dark Lord for the Patronage)_1
chapters.content:
Outside the mountain gate of the Seek Dao Sect, eight plainly dressed men were gathered, discussing matters.
"The Five Elements Sect, those wealthy dogs, have no place to spend all their spirit stones. They construct such gigantic airships and stuff it with useless designs!
If we had so many spirit stones, we could achieve many of our plans!" One of the high-ranking members of the Eternity Sect ogled the airship parked outside the gate of the Seek Dao Sect with a covetous eye, harboring thoughts of stealing.
The Vice Sect Leader Liu chastised him for his lack of sophistication: "Calm down! Look at you, behaving as if you've never seen luxury before. If our mission goes as planned here and we put the Seek Dao Sect to sleep, we can freely plunder, and there's no doubt we can afford such an airship."
Another high-ranking member of the Eternity Sect expressed some concern about the future: "But can we succeed this time? We've never infiltrated the Seek Dao Sect before!"
The Seek Dao Sect was, to them, nothing short of a lion's den.
"Please rest assured, my lords. Our mole within the Seek Dao sect has provided us with the event schedule and the map of the area where the Seek Dao Sect conducts their battle exercises. We will surely be safe this time!" Tang Yunsheng spoke up. Despite being an inspector, in this place, he was the one with the lowest position level and realm.
"Yes, Little Tang is right," another vice sect leader spoke. His name was Gao Zhenglai, and he was at the initial stage of the Unification.
"Furthermore, we are all followers of the Immortal Eternity. The Immortal Eternity symbolizes wisdom, strength, and luck. Under the blessing of the Immortal Eternity, our mission is bound to succeed!"
"Blessings of the Immortal Eternity!"
"Blessings of the Immortal Eternity!"
The eight of them chanted in a hushed whisper, frightened that someone might hear them.
"Dear sirs, sorry to keep you waiting." Lu Yang came forward to receive his subordinates. His current public identity was the acting sect leader of the Seek Dao Sect, while secretly, he was the master of the Eternity Sect, playing both sides of the field.
"Let me introduce to you, this is our excellent follower who successfully infiltrated the Seek Dao Sect, Rudder Master Lu Yang." Tang Yunsheng introduced, then whispered, "Where are the other two?"
Just one person to greet the leader when he has arrived?
Lu Yang explained, "Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu are busy grilling kebabs, they can't leave."
Tang Yunsheng went on to introduce the seven high-ranking members of the Eternity Sect, including vice sect leaders Liu and Gao, as well as the five guest elders.
Tang Yunsheng was assigned to handle the liaison work. Given his nascent soul stage cultivation level, he would not be able to make a splash in the Seek Dao Sect and there was no need to bring him along.
Lu Yang warned his seven subordinates, "The Seek Dao Sect is a dangerous lion's den to us, the Eternity Sect. I implore you to follow my instructions. Once something goes wrong, we are all doomed!"
The seven frowned, instinctively repulsed by the idea of following orders from someone at the foundation establishment stage. However, considering that even visitors in a mental hospital have to follow the guide's commands to avoid being attacked by the patients, they accepted it.
"Lead the way."
The disciple at the gate didn't stop the acting-sect leader from leading people into the sect, and let them pass straight away.
Vice Sect Leader Liu was astonished, "We've just entered the Seek Dao Sect so easily?"
Lu Yang explained with a smile, "The disciples of the Seek Dao Sect often come to our place for kebabs, so we've become quite familiar. They don't usually give me trouble."
Vice Sect Leader Liu patted Lu Yang on the shoulder, "I didn't expect you to get along so well with the Seek Dao Sect's people, something many cultivators could never do even if they went crazy. Well done. It's a pity your realm is too low, or else I would promote you!"
Lu Yang thought to himself, how much higher can I be promoted? If I get promoted again, I will become the patriarch.
"Hmm? Wait, what is a patriarch? Isn't it just the founder of a sect? Considering that I have revived Fairy Eternity and given the Eternity Sect a sense of faith, I am acting as the patriarch!"
Lu Yang felt it was reasonable and justified for him to be the patriarch. Moreover, he wouldn't have to fight for the position with the fake master of the Eternity Sect.
The hierarchical order within the Eternity Sect had become clear: Fairy Eternity was at the top, followed by Patriarch Lu Yang, and then the master, vice-master, and other insignificant figures.
Considering that Fairy Eternity is currently a guest elder of the Seek Dao Sect and the acting sect master for three days, it wouldn't be inappropriate to consider the Eternity Sect as a branch of the Seek Dao Sect.
Vice Sect Leader Liu and others looked around curiously as they entered the inner part of the Seek Dao Sect, but they didn't dare to release their spiritual sense, observing only with their eyes.
As they quietly traipsed along, they were completely terrified, fearing that any signs of their identity would be discovered by someone from the Seek Dao Sect. Fortunately, the worrisome situation had already occurred, and it was too late to fear now.
At the Competitive Martial Arts Square, the first match of the Golden Core group began. Brother Luo Hai, representing Seek Dao Sect, who had once been challenged by Fairy Eternity, was participating.
Brother Luo Hai excelled in water attribute magic skills, and so did his opponent. The two fought, colliding water waves, creating endless tide sounds. The spectacle of their battle did not seem to be at the Golden Core Stage realm at all.
"Here we are; this is our base!" Lu Yang arrived at a barbeque shop, and a large sign outside read "Come Again".
This was a shop arranged by Dai Bufan that had always been managed by others. During the exchange activity, it was temporarily given to Lu Yang and the other two for use.
Man Gu was grilling skewers skillfully over the fire. The spacious shop was largely empty.
At this time, other shops were also just opening.
The competition between the Seek Dao Sect and the Five Elements Sect had four major groups. Only one major group, the Foundation Establishment Stage group, had started. The other three major groups had longer fighting times, with commendable tactics and strategies, and were more entertaining. This was truly the most attractive part of the exchange conference.
Therefore, all the shops chose to open for business at this time.
"Vice Sect Leader..." Man Gu put down his work and wanted to salute, but was stopped by Vice Sect Leader Liu.
"We are in the dragon's den; let's keep things simple."
"Yes, please have a seat," Man Gu gestured for them to sit down.
"Where is Meng Jingzhou?" Lu Yang looked around but didn't find him.
"Oh, Brother Meng said he was going to check out other shops, figuring out how their business is, and whether we need to devise any countermeasures."
Lu Yang frowned, just about to chastise Meng Jingzhou for not taking his responsibilities seriously. The fate of the Eternity Sect hung in the balance, how could they be distracted by trivial matters?
Vice Sect Leader Liu stopped Lu Yang: "Eh, don't be angry. As the saying goes, if you're putting on a show, you must perform it completely. Little Meng's behavior is consistent with that of a BBQ shop worker. You should understand."
Vice Sect Leader Liu continued: "However, it's inevitably difficult to work short-staffed. Little Man, go and bring Meng Jingzhou back. The three of you know the Seek Dao Sect the best. Let's discuss together what to do next."
"Yes!" Man Gu ran out of the barbecue shop.
Before leaving, Man Gu said, "By the way, Brother Lu, someone had pre-ordered our skewers. I'm almost done grilling them. Remember to deliver them."
"Okay."
Lu Yang took over Man Gu's work, continued grilling skewers on the grill. His movements were smooth and skilled, looking just like a veteran staff who had been at it for thirty years.
Vice Sect Leader Liu nodded. Lu Yang's movements were standard, not much different from what he himself had learned.
After grilling, Lu Yang said, "Distinguished guests, please wait a moment, I'll deliver the food."
"Hold on, where are you going? I will send someone else to deliver it instead." Vice Sect Leader Liu stopped Lu Yang; if Lu Yang left, there would only be the seven of them left in the barbecue shop.
Lu Yang pointed to the stand in the distance: "It was ordered by some VIPs in the stand."
Vice Sect Leader Liu was lost for words. The stand was occupied by the top-ranking members of the Seek Dao Sect and the Five Elements Sect. They were all at the Unification stage. If they went over to deliver food, they would likely get their identities exposed.
"Go, go, go quickly and come back quickly!" Vice Sect Leader Liu waved his hand.
Lu Yang hustled out of the shop with the food box.
Not long after Lu Yang left, a pure and beautiful young girl noticed their shop.
"Huh, 'Come Again' BBQ shop, what an interesting name. You guys, let's give their business a try, order twenty mutton skewers, and if they taste good, we'll order more!"
It was Shangguan Yu.

chapters.title: Chapter 173 - 172: The Dedicated High-Level Executives of the Eternity Sect_1
chapters.content:
"Mutton Kebabs?" Vice Sect Leader Liu frowned, they were here to show their colors to the Seek Dao Sect, not to really work.
"Hey, don't you guys do business when it comes your way?" Shangguan Yu was a bit puzzled, was the Seek Dao Sect's shop also like this, open for business but not doing any?
Second Elder, who was following behind Shangguan Yu, looked at Vice Sect Leader Liu and his group suspiciously and said, "You guys look unfamiliar, I haven't seen you in the Seek Dao Sect, could it be that you are..."
Vice Sect Leader Liu recognized the Second Elder Ba Yan at a glance, this was a high-level figure of the Seek Dao Sect, a man of actual power, at the peak of the Unification stage, if such a person grows suspicious, it's highly likely that they'll be exposed.
He put on a smiling face and let the other six people get up to serve the customers, "The store manager is away on business, we were rushed over to help temporarily. Sir, you want twenty mutton kebabs, right? Please wait, they'll be ready soon."
Being a part of the demonic sect, a cruel cold smile hanging at the corner of the mouth was an essential skill, but the ability to switch smiles casually was also a necessary skill of the demonic sect.
Vice Sect Leader Liu rolled up his sleeves, tied on the black and white apron hanging on the wall, and took out twenty-five mutton kebabs from the basin, "You are our first customer today, I'll give you an extra five kebabs."
A few flies, lured by the smell of meat, flew over and were shooed away by Vice Sect Leader Liu.
The Second Elder was still a bit suspicious, "Your shop isn't very clean…"
Vice Sect Leader Liu quickly said, "Old Gao, bring out the Array Method!"
Vice Sect Leader Gao took out a set of Array Method from the Storage Ring, laid it on the ground, and the flies immediately fled from the barbecue shop.
Those who started businesses in the Seek Dao Sect were not ordinary people, and the use of the Storage Ring and Array Method will not cause suspicion.
Vice Sect Leader Liu chuckled and explained, "It's absolutely clean, this is the insect repelling Array Method that we brought from outside."
Vice Sect Leader Liu was always meticulous in his work.
With one hand he turned and shook the mutton kebabs, while with the other hand he rubbed his fingers, the barbecue seasoning fell, falling on the mutton kebabs. The aroma of mutton was stimulated by the charcoal fire, it smelled tantalizingly delicious.
The proficiency of Vice Sect Leader Liu was in no way inferior to that of Lu Yang.
The seven of them had specifically found the best local barbecue master, and had studied hard for three days, all for this moment!
"Do you eat spicy?"
Shangguan Yu thought for a moment, she wasn't very good at eating spicy food, but felt that something was missing without it: "Just a little bit spicy."
"Alright." Vice Sect Leader Liu continued to roast the skewers while hawking his wares.
"Come and see, the fresh and tender grassland lamb, freshly slaughtered, full of meat and tendons, the meat is fragrant and the tendons are tough, it's unforgettable!"
This was what the ordinary barbecue master had shouted when they were learning from him, and he had told them that the louder they shouted, the more customers they would attract.
Perhaps it was because he had heard the ordinary barbecue master shout so much, that Vice Sect Leader Liu became sentimental and shouted it out himself.
As expected, it was effective, and disciples from the Seek Dao Sect were gradually gathering around.
"Here, your kebabs are ready." Vice Sect Leader Liu handed the mutton kebabs to Shangguan Yu.
"How much?"
Vice Sect Leader Liu didn't know how much to charge, he glanced at the price list hanging on the wall and jumped in surprise.
Were the prices at the Seek Dao Sect so high?
What Vice Sect Leader Liu didn't know was, the prices at the Seek Dao Sect were not usually high, it was just that they had gone up temporarily because of an event.
Shangguan Yu slightly opened her mouth and took a bite, the meat was fragrant and full of juice. Once in her mouth, Shangguan Yu couldn't even tell if it was saliva or juice.
"Delicious, delicious, I'll have another fifty skewers! And two roasted pig trotters."
The biggest benefit of cultivators eating is that no matter how much they eat, they never feel full. As long as they want to eat, they can eat as much as they want and enjoy the feast to their heart's content.
Of course, this characteristic was not given a chance to manifest at the banquet prepared by Fairy Eternity.
Seeing the way Shangguan Yu was eating, saliva was dropping from the mouths of the people around, and they followed suit, clamoring for skewers.
Vice Sect Leader Gao called from inside, "There's space inside, there's space, don't crowd outside, you can come in to order!"
The five Elders were busy greeting the customers.
On the martial arts arena, the first round of the Golden Core group was over, there was still time before the start of the second round, many disciples chose to eat while watching the battle. This included not only those from the Seek Dao Sect, but also from the Five Elements Sect.
They noticed a barbecue shop that was unusually different, and very busy.
"Let's go and take a look."
As more and more disciples came to eat skewers, Vice Sect Leader Liu felt a sense of confidence rising naturally.
"I said it from the start, regardless of how successful Lu Yang and his friends' barbecue shop in Yanjiang County might seem, that's only because I haven't intervened. If I were to intervene, what chance would Lu Yang have?"
"Old Gao, there are too many orders, I can't keep up, lend a hand!"
"Alright!"
Unexpectedly, Vice Sect Leader Gao's barbecue skill matched the Vice Sect Leader Liu's!!
...
On the stands, Lu Yang brought skewers for Eldest Senior Sister, greeted with Qiu Jin'an's surprised eyes.
Why did Sect Master Lu have to resort to selling skewers?
It hasn't been long, what happened during this time?
Qiu Jin'an was puzzled.
"How's the preparation?"
"There are only seven customers left in the store. According to the plan, disciples will order food, it should go without a hitch."
"Got it, go back."
...
When Lu Yang returned, he took a glance at the martial arts square, the second round of the competition had begun. Representing the Seek Dao Sect was Senior Sister Yi Jing who was similarly challenged by Fairy Eternity.
Lu Yang noticed the Senior Brothers and Sisters watching the match, holding many skewers, he was a bit surprised. Even Bai Ming, who had just lost a match, was holding a bunch, eating heartily.
What's going on?
When Lu Yang returned, Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu had already returned to the barbecue shop, helping Vice Sect Leaders with the barbecue.
The people secretly arranged to buy skewers couldn't line up, they held up their hands helplessly when they saw Lu Yang.
The Second Elder was eating skewers by the roadside, his mouth greasy. He greeted Lu Yang, "Where did you find these cooks? Their skewer-cooking skills are top-notch."
Shangguan Yu, standing next to him, also expressed his desire to visit the Seek Dao Sect more often.
Lu Yang: "..."
"Excuse me, excuse me." Lu Yang shouted, trying to get in and see what was happening.
The person being squeezed frowned, "Stop pushing, don't you know how to queue?"
"I'm a staff member!"
The person who was squeezed spotted Lu Yang, twitched the corners of his mouth, and let him pass.
He suddenly remembered the admonition from his master that the demonic sect might infiltrate the exchange venue and Lu Yang planned to trap them all.
Could the people in this barbecue shop be from the demonic sect?
He stared at the two Vice Sect Leaders grilling skewers for a while and felt he might have misunderstood.
The elders of the Seek Dao Sect had greeted everyone, mentioning not to panic if they saw Lu Yang where he was not supposed to be, just pretend not to know him.
Vice Sect Leader Liu was overjoyed to see Lu Yang return, "Little Lu is back, perfect, you can maintain order, have everyone line up."
Lu Yang: "..."
Do you still remember why you're here?
The initial plan was to find a few customers to keep them busy, but he didn't expect that they would actually make the barbecue shop so successful.
Lu Yang noticed Man Gu's genuinely happy smile and Meng Jingzhou's nostalgic expression for Yanjiang County, his heart was filled with words he didn't know from where to start.
Fairy Eternity nodded in satisfaction, "As expected of my followers, they have impressive self-sustaining abilities. But the standard of these skewers could improve."
"Lu Yang, let me control your body and show you what an Immortal-level skewer looks like. Take some notes."
Fairy Eternity was excited and disregarding the rule of "not easily passing on the technique", she wanted to show her skills.
Hearing this, Lu Yang was startled and hurriedly stopped Fairy Eternity.
"Please don't add to the chaos!"

chapters.title: Chapter 174 - 173: This thing seems to make more money than working in the Eternity Sect_1
chapters.content:
As night fell, the cultivators started longing for a lovely and relaxing meal.
Just a street away from the martial arts plaza, there was an inconspicuous little shop that beckoned with its heavenly aroma. The cultivators seemed to have a collective consensus in choosing "Another Round Barbecue Shop."
Just as the name of the barbecue shop suggested, customers who tried it once wanted to come by again to satiate their ever-hungry stomachs.
Customers came here for the barbecue's signature dish - Barbarian Tribe's special lamb, a recipe passed down for hundreds of thousands of years, still as refreshing as ever from ancient times to now.
The barbecue recipe was freshly prepared on the same day, with a great understanding of the ancestors' tradition in seasoning the meat. The various skewers of the Seek Dao Sect had subtle differences in their taste due to this special sauce.
Master Liu, who also served as the Vice Sect Leader of the Eternity Sect, held a different view. According to him, the best ingredients needed only the simplest ways of cooking; for skewers, the most important things were heat control and heart.
Master Liu treated every skewering session as a battlefield, throwing his heart and soul into it. Although the orders piled up like mountains, he remained calm, meticulously controlling the heat and immersing himself in his world.
Eating was just like fighting, an ancient and immutable truth. For a barbecue shop to succeed, naturally, it couldn't do without the cooperation of the staff.
The staff at "Another Round Barbecue Shop" were all temporary workers who had never come across this sort of thing before. However, they seemed to be born for this. When serving the guests, they seemed to have an unspoken understanding of each other, cooperating with perfect timing as if they were born brothers.
Still, there was no perfect shop in the world. No matter how harmoniously they cooperated, there always were people who were absent-minded and inattentive.
"Little Lu, what's the matter with you? Can you concentrate on your work?" Vice Sect Leader Gao, who was also acting as the Eternity Sect's leader, scolded Lu Yang for not putting his heart into his work.
Lu Yang: "..."
Did I become the sect leader of the Eternity Sect too hastily? I see no future in the Eternity Sect. It's better to just be an honest disciple of the Seek Dao Sect.
"Are you thinking of leaving the sect?" Fairy Eternity glared at Lu Yang with an unpleasant expression. It took some guts to talk about leaving the sect in front of your faith.
"Fairy, do you have any issues? If it's nothing, then go back to sleep."
"Of course, I have something to tell you. You need to talk to Little Gao that he's not cooking the kebabs right. They're too tender. The fire should be a bit bigger. There should be a slight burnt smell, which makes it more delicious."
"Move fast; this is an Immortal's command." Fairy Eternity urged.
In the ancient times, people valued whatever she said, treating it as Immortal Enlightenment, and people would analyze its meaning from all angles.
Now, she didn't enjoy this treatment. Lu Yang acted like he was deaf when she spoke.
Man Gu from the Barbarian Tribe secretly found Lu Yang, his face filled with worry. "Brother Lu, we can't go on like this."
Lu Yang was delighted, thinking that someone had finally realized the problem.
"We haven't prepared so many skewers; at this rate, we'll sell out very soon!"
"..." Lu Yang began to doubt whether it was Man Gu or himself who had a problem.
"What? Are there not many skewers left?" One of the high-ranking members of the Eternity Sect changed colour upon hearing this. This was a serious matter.
This high-ranking member, named Jiang Yitian, was in charge of collecting money.
"Then hurry up and buy some more outside!"
Man Gu shook his head: "The skewers are pre-marinated. The meat we buy now may not be guaranteed in terms of quality. And there's not enough time for marinating."
As a member of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe, Man Gu couldn't damage the reputation of his family's barbecue brand.
"Maintaining high standards, aren't you!" Fairy Eternity praised. She had had the barbecue of the Barbarian Tribe in ancient times. The taste was indeed unique, but there was a lack of attention to nutritional balance.
Fairy Eternity always paid attention to nutritional balance when she cooked. She gave constructive suggestions to the Barbarian Tribe, but they didn't listen and stuck to their guns.
When the Nascent Soul group's competition on the martial arts plaza drew to a close, the skewers were completely sold out.
Everyone began to tally up their gains for the day.
"Damn it, aren't we here to stir things up in the Seek Dao Sect? What the hell are you people doing, playing house?" Vice Sect Leader Liu reproached. He realized he had been engrossed in barbecue and missed the main task. But he couldn't admit his mistake in public.
Sure enough, being the vice sect leader of a demonic sect, he was born to commit evil deeds. He was quite adept at putting the blame on others.
Vice Sect Leader Gao also rebuked everyone: "Where are your stances? You're not fully committed to the task. Do you think this is fair to Immortal Eternity?"
Everyone was thinking that it was you two who were the most involved just now.
Jiang Yitian, who was in charge of invoicing earlier, thought for a moment, then said seriously: "Is it too late for us to switch careers and open a barbecue shop?"
Another high-ranking member rebuked: "What on earth do you mean, open a barbecue shop? Are you going to give up your faith in Immortal Eternity?"
"But opening a barbecue shop in the Seek Dao Sect does make a lot of money."
The high-ranking member said with disdain: "How much could it possibly make?"
"It's equal to a month's worth of offerings."
The high-ranking member thought for a moment: "Running a barbecue shop while worshiping the statue of Immortal Eternity doesn't seem to contradict our teachings."
Vice Sect Leader Liu reproached this high-ranking member's uncertainty: "That's nonsense! We who are loyal believers of Immortal Eternity, how can we have such thoughts..."
"It's equal to a month's worship from all of us combined."
"It's our sect's fortune to have someone like you thinking like that!"
Vice Sect Leader Liu immediately changed his tune and began planning for the future: "We can open a chain of stores, spread across the entire continent. This will not only solve the employment problem of our believers, but also make money. By then, we will be the biggest taxpayers in the Great Xia Dynasty!"
Vice Sect Leader Gao was outraged: "Have you ever thought that the prices elsewhere wouldn't be as outrageous as in Seek Dao Sect? Can the consumption level on holidays be the same as normal days? You only look at the immediate profits, without considering the long term! The most important thing is, once we start a chain, who could guarantee that all believers can barbecue at our level!"
"Prepare to head out. Let's go to the martial arts plaza!"
Lu Yang sighed in secret. The original plan was to use the customers to hold them back, giving this group of people a chance. Unfortunately, the skewers sold out too fast and couldn't hold on until the event ended.
"To make the Dream Pillow work to its fullest, we need a specific position. Little Lu, you three lead us to the martial arts plaza for location scouting. Once the time is right, activate the Immortal Treasure immediately. By then, you'll be the heroes!"
Lu Yang, with his chest hanging down and serious expression, looked like a brave martyr. "We don't want the credit; we are ready to dedicate ourselves to the Eternity Sect with no second thought!"
"Good, I knew I didn't judge wrong!" Vice Sect Leader Liu greatly appreciated Lu Yang. He really was worthy of being the sect leader's special attention.
The sect leader of the Eternity Sect led his subordinates to the martial arts plaza and dispersed to their positions.
Vice Sect Leader Liu watched the battle on the martial arts plaza, nodding approvingly. The disciples of the Five Great Immortal Sects were indeed commendable; their battle strategy was impeccable.
He said to the illustrious sect leader: "Little Lu, watch these battles carefully; they'll be very helpful for you."

chapters.title: Chapter 175 - 174: Take Action! _1
chapters.content:
The fifth match of the Nascent Soul Group was nearing its conclusion. It was against Ma Tianyang, who had once been challenged by Fairy Eternity.
Vice Sect Leader Liu commented, "Ma Tianyang, who is at the late stage of the Nascent Soul level, is matched against a disciple from the Five Elements Sect at the peak of the Nascent Soul stage. Both are from the Immortal Sect and have similar resources. At this point, the external skills won't help much. Instead, the difference in cultivation levels will matter.
Even a small gap could decide the outcome. Ma Tianyang is on the brink of defeat."
As Vice Sect Leader Liu stated, Ma Tianyang was gradually losing ground. His opponent was getting stronger and bolder, aiming to defeat him in one go.
Ma Tianyang was a talisman cultivator. The various talismans he drew were top-tier commodities, so prized that small clans would regard them as invaluable heirlooms, capable of delivering a fatal blow in a critical situation to save the family.
Unfortunately for Ma Tianyang, his opponent was a cultivator who could commander thunder. Loud and terribly fast, every thundering strike deftly disrupted Ma Tianyang's talisman drawing rhythm, denying him the advantage of a talisman cultivator.
Just when the opponent thought the outcome was fixed and pressed his advantage, Ma Tianyang gave a mighty push with both palms. Countless dimly flashing talisman patterns assembled into an imposing mountain, suppressing the opponent.
His opponent was under the weight of the mountain, unable to mobilize even a fraction of his spiritual essence. His defeat came in a daze, "A Mountain-Sealing Talisman! This talisman can't be stored on paper. It must be drawn on the spot. But even you need five minutes to draw it. Where did you find that time?"
Ma Tianyang sneered, "I've been drawing it all along. You just didn't notice."
"How could that be? Where did you draw it?"
Ma Tianyang pointed to his body, "Blood vessels."
"While I was fighting with you, I kept adjusting the position of my blood vessels."
"I@#￥%..."
The Field Array of the Martial Arts Platform was comprehensive and user-friendly, including an automatic profanity filter, replacing any foul language with beeping noises for the spectators.
His opponent thought that after observing the ways of the Seek Dao Sect for so long, he was close to mastering them. He hadn't expected to be so far off the mark.
Vice Sect Leader Liu's eyes twitched. He hadn't expected Ma Tianyang to pull such a trick and had overlooked it.
Blood contained spiritual essence, and adjusting the position of the blood vessels to create talisman patterns was feasible, even ingenious, without any loss of spiritual essence.
But seriously, who would think of drawing talisman patterns using blood vessels?
Vice Sect Leader Liu said nonchalantly, schooling Lu Yang, "Don't learn this style of fighting. Tying knots in your blood vessels can cause blood clots."
Lu Yang felt Vice Sect Leader Liu was overthinking. He heard that Senior Brother Ma Tianyang could even undo dead knots in blood vessels.
After the Nascent Soul Group ended, it was on to the final group, the Spirit Transformation Group.
This was the highest-level showdown of the exchange event. It was a rare opportunity to witness a duel between two cultivators at the Spirit Transformation stage, with incredible benefits!
Representing the Seek Dao Sect in the Spirit Transformation Group was a senior from Elixir Cauldron Peak named Lu Wang, whom Lu Yang had not met before.
People around them whispered, "It's Senior Brother Lu, we haven't seen him in a long time."
"I heard that during his Golden Core formation, he failed three times. He wasn't satisfied with his First-grade Golden Core."
"Why is that?"
"He insists that a Golden Core is a type of elixir and that without elixir patterns and an elixir fragrance, it's worthless. Hence, he constantly attempted to form a Golden Core that had the fragrance."
"Did he succeed?"
"He did. Senior Brother Lu did succeed in forming a Golden Core with fragrance."
"What's so special about that Golden Core?"
"It smells particularly fragrant."
"…"
Lu Yang asked his subordinate, "Little Liu, who do you think will win?"
"Um?" Vice Sect Leader Liu thought he had heard wrong. What did this kid just call him?
Lu Yang explained casually, "Your portrayal in public is as my temporarily hired employee, and I am your boss. We need to keep up the act. If I show too much respect, it will seem fake. Our plan is on the verge of execution, we can't slip up now!"
Vice Sect Leader Liu nodded, accepting Lu Yang's point.
"Lu Wang has quite a reputation in the Spirit Transformation stage, and few are willing to face him. He practices a dual cultivation method of elixirs and poisons, with his poisons being stronger. Unfortunately for Lu Wang, he encountered an opponent who counters him."
"I've heard of his opponent, who has lived in the Five Poisons Pit since childhood and has developed immunity to all kinds of poisons. Against such an opponent, Lu Wang's skills are ineffective."
On the Martial Arts Platform, Lu Wang was matches against a disciple from the Five Elements Sect. Initially, Lu Wang tried testing his opponent with Bone-Corrosive Toxic Smoke, but as Vice Sect Leader Liu said, the opponent was not afraid at all, and the smoke had no effect on him.
"This is going to be tough," Lu Wang found this challenging.
His opponent sneered, "Lu Wang, just admit defeat. You'd win against anyone else but against me, you're destined to lose!"
The fight at the Spirit Transformation stage was not limited to the ground. The combatants flew, burrowed, and had their rounds of victory and defeat. Lu Wang was at a disadvantage since his opponent was stronger.
Lu Wang took out an elixir for strength enhancement, which was allowed in the competition.
Just as he was about to consume it, his opponent snatched it away and swallowed it.
The opponent sneered, "You want to use an elixir? You'd have to get the chance to do so!"
As soon as the elixir entered his stomach, the opponent felt his strength draining rapidly.
"What's happening!" The opponent was shocked. This wasn't supposed to happen.
Lu Wang punched him flying, "That's the Ten-elephants Strength Pill. It gives the consumer the strength of ten elephants."
"But it's meant for cultivators at the Foundation Establishment stage. In other words, you can only unleash the equivalent strength of ten Foundation Establishment stage elephants."
"You &%*#..."
"You should be content. It's a favor that I didn't give you a libido-enhancing version of the Ten-elephants Strength Pill." Lu Wang threw his opponent off the platform.
Following the Spirit Transformation Group, Vice Sect Leader Liu didn't predict a single of the four subsequent matches correctly.
It wasn't that Vice Sect Leader Liu lacked insight. But the Spirit Transformation stage fighters from the Seek Dao Sect were too unpredictable.
Vice Sect Leader Liu took deep breaths to compose himself. It was nearly time to act, and he couldn't allow his frustration to affect his mood.
He noticed everyone had taken their positions to form the "Dream Pillow Array" to maximize the effects of the Dream Pillow.
According to Fairy Eternity's introduction, it was a sleep array she often used. It worked wonders.
Vice Sect Leader Liu heard the members of the Seek Dao Sect begin the closing remark, "The friendly exchange between the Seek Dao Sect and the Five Elements Sect has officially ended. We're glad to have shared this wonderful time with everyone…"
Everyone's attention was on the podium. It was the perfect time to act!
Vice Sect Leader Liu raised his hand and bellowed, "Attack!"
The Seek Dao Sect disciples hidden around heard the command and appeared to lunge at the top brass of the Eternity Sect.
They remembered Lu Yang saying that someone would give the order to attack. They were to act as soon as they heard it.
Before, they had guessed who would give the order.
The mystery was now solved.
The disciples of the Seek Dao Sect saluted Vice Sect Leader Liu, who was still somewhat baffled, considering him a hero.
So Vice Sect Leader Liu was also one of our undercover agents, who had successfully risen to the position of Vice Sect Leader.

chapters.title: Chapter 176 - 175: Tofu Supreme! _1
chapters.content:
The higher-ups of the Eternity Sect were completely dumbfounded when a group of people suddenly emerged from the crowd and swooped them up in potato sacks, right after they had collectively recited the grand ancient words.
The higher-ups of the Eternity Sect were baffled; bagged, bound, and taken hostage was already disconcerting enough, but why was the Seek Dao Sect so proficient with this tactic?
Weren't they a righteous sect?
The Eternity Sect higher-ups had been chanting in an ancient language, paired with the Immortal Treasure Dream Pillow; the content of their words was profound, beyond the comprehension of ordinary people. Until now, no one had been able to break its mystery.
The Eternity Sect surmised that it was an ancient Immortal Art that drove the Immortal Treasures, while others suggested it was an ancient speech to awaken the Immortal Treasures.
Regardless, it could be confirmed that the Dream Pillow paired with the ancient words was an unparalleled weapon of the same level.
The Master of the Eternity Sect speculated that the Immortal Eternity was well-versed in the rules of dream Immortal Dao. The phrase "Many dreams over thousands of autumns, which year is tonight?" was a poetic description by cultivators of the ancient times, referring to the Immortal Eternity.
Upon verification, the Master of the Eternity Sect also discovered that the Qilin Immortal had once expressed the desire to keep the Immortal Eternity in eternal slumber.
"This implies that, despite the Five Immortals of the Ancients being equally formidable, the Qilin Immortal must have feared the Immortal Eternity and did not wish for them to awaken!" The Master of the Eternity Sect thus declared.
Vice Sect Leader Liu shook his head, breaking off his thoughts. He realized that the Seek Dao Sect had been prepared in advance, they were turtles in a jar, ensnared in a trap.
Who's the traitor?!
Vice Sect Leader Liu suddenly realized Lu Yang, who was by his side earlier, was nowhere to be seen. He abruptly looked up to see Lu Yang standing on the podium, speaking.
It seemed that Lu Yang noticed Vice Sect Leader Liu looking at him, he glanced at him, flashed a breezy smile, then continued, "After this exchange, everyone must..."
"It's you!" Vice Sect Leader Liu was boiling over with rage. He never would have believed that Lu Yang was a traitor.
Did the Seek Dao Sect turn Lu Yang?
No, if he could stand on the podium, it means he was a part of the Seek Dao Sect all along! Could he be a high-ranking member?!
"Ha, devious Lu Yang, do you think you've won!"
Vice Sect Leader Liu expressed a desperate and crazed look, pulling out the Immortal Treasure Dream Pillow from his storage ring.
"Let me show you the power of Immortal Treasures. Even if I am alone, I can master this treasure!"
After spewing out a mouthful of essence blood on the Dream Pillow, a surreal green glow emanated from it. The glow, akin to ripples, spread out into the surroundings.
Everything that came into contact with the green ripples, friend or foe, fell into a deep sleep.
Whether they were disciples of the Seek Dao Sect, the Five Elements Sect, or even the high-ranking members of the captured Eternity Sect, they all swayed and fell to the ground, producing gradually louder snores after being swept across by the green ripples.
The snoring continued on and on.
The martial arts arena was supposed to be the bustling heart of the Seek Dao Sect, but now it was eerily silent, with only the sound of snoring echoing throughout.
Even the Sect elders on the grandstand couldn't resist the power of the Dream Pillow and were drawn into a dream state.
Vice Sect Leader Liu was visibly weakened, but he didn't care and laughed madly.
"Ha ha ha, what can the Seek Dao Sect or Five Elements Sect do? This will teach you to underestimate the Eternity Sect!"
Full of murderous intent, Vice Sect Leader Liu saw this as an opportunity to decimate the disciples of the Seek Dao Sect.
"I have to be quick. Once the Transcendence Tribulation Stage members of the Seek Dao Sect notice the commotion here, they're bound to come. Even though I possess an Immortal Treasure and have made a blood sacrifice, I might not be able to withstand the power of a Great Power at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage," Vice Sect Leader Liu muttered to himself.
Those at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage were hidden in the deepest part of Sect, guarding secrets, seeking the Dao, or secluded from worldly matters, and very rarely took action.
As far as he knew, among the Five Great Immortal Sects, only the Abbot of the Suspension Temple was at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage. The remaining four Sect Masters were in the Unification Stage.
The Abbot of the Suspension Temple was from the previous generation. No one from their generation had reached the Transcendence Tribulation Stage.
As long as no one from the Transcendence Tribulation Stage showed up, with his Immortal Treasure, he was the most powerful amongst them!
"How dare you plot murder under my watch?"
A mocking voice tinged with cold indifference interrupted Vice Sect Leader Liu's reverie.
Recognizing the voice, Vice Sect Leader Liu's head jolted up in surprise only to discover that Lu Yang was not asleep!
"How is this possible!"
Swiftly, his surprise turned into sheer terror.
Lu Yang's lack of sleep indicated that he's a Great Power at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage!
Everything added up. How Lu Yang, seemingly at Foundation Establishment Stage, could have a higher position in the Seek Dao Sect.
The only explanation was that Lu Yang's cultivation level was far above his!
"Who the hell are you!" Vice Sect Leader Liu demanded sharply. Being at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, Lu Yang must be a famed Great Power, yet he could not match Lu Yang to any of the ones he knew of.
Lu Yang stood on the podium, his hands clasped behind him and his robe billowing like a banished Immortal Sword.
With a flick of his robe he launched himself downward.
"I, am the Lord of Tofu!"
Now past midnight, bathed under the moonlight, he appeared as a noticeable streak in the darkness. As if he was nature's favorite, garnering the attention of all.
Lu Yang released his energy, those bathed in the moonlight could feel a force far stronger than Unification stage emanating from him. Vice Sect Leader Liu couldn't help but bow in awe.
"From beginning to end, I strike."
Ripping the dark clouds apart with a gleaming sword, the ethereal blue Immortal Sword, descended like divine punishment, carrying the wrath of the Gods and the indifference of the Immortals to chastise all evildoers.
Facing a sword of such unimaginable power, Vice Sect Leader Liu hadn't even the energy to retaliate. He felt his body freeze in place, unable to move.
All he could do was lift his head, eyes widening in shock, watching as the blue Immortal Sword fell towards him.
The Immortal Sword pierced through Vice Sect Leader Liu's head.
"The sword is an ominous object, I do not wish to kill."
Lord of Tofu had a cold look on his face as he turned and walked away, leaving an eternal silhouette behind.
...
In reality, the crowd gathered around, watching Vice Sect Leader Liu lay on the floor twitching in his sleep. They were curious about the dream Lu Yang had concocted for him.
In actuality, Lu Yang had been standing by Vice Sect Leader Liu all along. The figure speaking on the podium was the Grand Elder.
Once Vice Sect Leader Liu noticed that Lu Yang wasn't there beside him, he had already entered the dream state.
With Yun Zhi's understanding of how to use the Dream Pillow, an item belonging to Fairy Eternity, she activated the Dream Pillow from inside her storage ring directly, sinking Vice Sect Leader Liu into deep slumber and allowing Lu Yang to weave him a dream.
As for the other high ranking members, including Vice Sect Leader Gao, they were actually bagged and captured.
"It's clearly my pillow, why don't I get to use it!" Fairy Eternity also wanted to join in the fun but was blocked by Lu Yang.
"I'll help you explore it for you. Over thirty thousand years have passed, maybe it has already gone bad." Lu Yang took the dream-weaving ability for granted.
"By the way, did you use to need someone to sing in the past when using the Dream Pillow?" Lu Yang thought about the grandiose spectacle of the high-ranking members of the Eternity Sect chanting some ancient language as if they were offering sacrifices to some great entity.
"What were these people singing, anyway?"
Fairy Eternity thought for a moment before saying, "It's a lullaby that I played with a doll when I was about to sleep. The lyrics are like, 'Sleep, sleep, my dear little baby...'
The gusto with which the high-ranking members of the Eternity Sect sang was completely at odds with the actual lullaby, and it took her a moment to realize what they were singing.
Lu Yang:"..."

chapters.title: Chapter 177 - 176: Shangguan Yu_1
chapters.content:
"Eh, so this is the high-ranking member of the Eternity Sect that you guys captured."
A voice suddenly emerged from behind Lu Yang, startling him. He turned around and saw junior Sister Shangguan Yu.
"Why would he give up a successful barbecue shop and instead choose to join a demonic sect?" Shangguan Yu, shaking her head and savoring her skewer, seemed to pity these individuals.
"Anyway, you guys from the Seek Dao Sect did a great job capturing someone so significant. It has been years since you caught someone this influential. I hope you can extract some useful information from him."
Shangguan Yu patted Lu Yang on the shoulder, laughing: "I think you're a natural fit for the Seek Dao Sect. Keep up the good work, I believe in you. Perhaps you might even surpass Daoist Buyu!"
Yun Zhi interjected: "Of course he can surpass Master."
Shangguan Yu scratched her head. Actually, she had been implying that Lu Yang's creativity could surpass Daoist Buyu. Had Xiao Yun misunderstood something?
Well, never mind. Too tiring to explain.
Just as Lu Yang was about to say something, Shangguan Yu disappeared into thin air as if utilizing some sort of method.
...
Up in the stands, the Grand Elder was maintaining order: "Everyone, stay calm. It's just a few Unification Stage demonic sect disciples armed with Immortal Treasures trying to ambush us. It's not a big deal."
The Grand Elder wore an expression that said, "This happens all the time in our Seek Dao Sect", "You guys from the Five Elements Sect haven't experienced this yet, huh?" "These people can't even cause a ripple here."
Qiu Jin'an was sure that this guy was flaunting it in front of him.
A Unification Stage demonic disciple launching a surprise attack with Immortal Treasures would cause the Five Elements Sect to go on full alert. Meanwhile, the Seek Dao Sect still had the mood to flirt around.
These guys really do have prominent guts.
"From the Eternity Sect?" Qiu Jin'an recalled that Yun Zhi knew about some secrets of the Eternity Sect, so she must hold special clues.
A Unification Stage member would undoubtedly hold a high position in the Eternity Sect. The Seek Dao Sect has landed a big fish this time.
Qiu Jin'an looked on with envy. If they dig a little deeper into this big fish, they would undoubtedly discover many valuable things.
Why do they always encounter such good luck?
"Indeed." The Grand Elder replied in a sophisticated tone.
