Qiu Jin'an suppressed his urge to strike the Grand Elder and bargained: "The Five Great Immortal Sects share a common enemy. If you guys manage to extract some information, don't forget to share it with us."
The Grand Elder nonchalantly replied: "Sure, as long as you admit that the Five Elements Sect is inferior to the Seek Dao Sect and become our little brother, we'll share any information with you."
"Feng Zhengxian, don't go too far! Among the nine disciples of the Seek Dao Sect, only Daoist Buyu is the one I can't defeat!"
Qiu Jin'an slammed the table, stretching and causing his bones to creak.
The Grand Elder gave a cold laugh, snapped his fingers, and the Elders from two to eight appeared behind him lined up like a peacock spreading its feathers.
Qiu Jin'an felt an oppressive aura suffocating him. The Sixth Elder was here.
The Grand Elder let out a smug smile, but before he could say anything, he found himself unable to speak.
With no other choice, he sent a message to the Sixth Elder: "Sixth Junior Sister, when will you be able to control your Immortal body?"
Sixth Elder rolled her eyes: "Be content. Among the recorded Pure Immortal Bodies in history, mine has the best control. The previous Pure Immortal Body, Qi Qianqian, repelled spiritual energy around her after she reached the Unification Stage, making her give up cultivation.
Apparently, an Immortal body has its drawbacks.
With the Sixth Elder's intervention, the Grand Elder no longer felt like ridiculing Qiu Jin'an.
The Sixth Elder tactfully left, considering the closing ceremony hadn't finished yet. As long as she stayed, the Grand Elder and Qiu Jin'an wouldn't even be able to read the closing speech.
The disciples of the Five Elements Sect had lost horribly to the Seek Dao Sect, with few victories.
The disciples of the Five Elements Sect weren't just sheltered people; they had suffered many hardships and had a plethora of experience and insight in battle. But, the unusual tactics of the Seek Dao Sect still caught them by surprise, rendering their previous experiences useless.
The matches that the Seek Dao Sect lost were due to the sect's disciples occasionally displaying abnormal behavior.
For instance, in one Golden Core Stage match, a disciple of the Seek Dao Sect started fiercely, contradicting his usual persona. Just as the disciple from the Five Elements Sect was about to lose, the Seek Dao Sect's disciple suddenly collapsed from exhaustion.
With his dying breath, he said to the referee: "It was a do-or-die battle... I ingested a poison pill before the match... it will take effect in five minutes... and I will only take the antidote after I leave the stage... If I can't defeat my opponent in five minutes... I will undoubtedly die...
I... I can't hold on... I really want to win one match..."
The referee watched as the man was nearing his end; he didn't have the antidote on him, so he quickly took out two of the same poison pills to prolong his life for ten more minutes. He then found the antidote from outside the ring and saved his life.
After the two of them read the closing speech in a halfhearted manner, they said their reluctant goodbyes. It was clear from their interaction that the relationship between the Five Great Immortal Sects was deep – completely unlike the rumors that the Seek Dao Sect was alienating the other four Immortal Sects.
"Ha-ha, Sect Leader Qiu, you should visit our Seek Dao Sect more often."
"Definitely, definitely. If there's a chance, I'll certainly come to the Seek Dao Sect again to broaden my horizons."
At the same time, they both secretly cursed: "Finally, I don't have to see this old guy anymore."
The Second Elder was genuinely concerned about Shangguan Yu: "If you're ever bullied in the Five Elements Sect, come and find me. I've watched Qiu Jin'an grow up since he was little. He may look honest, but he's actually quite cunning. Don't let him deceive you!"
Shangguan Yu laughed and said that Qiu Jin'an dared not deceive her.
The Second Elder felt heartache, saying that it was precisely because she was too innocent that Qiu Jin'an deceived her.
Qiu Jin'an stood between them, his face so dark that it looked like it could drip water: "Ba the Second, I've told you before, stay away from her!"
The Second Elder was nonchalant: "Don't try to scare me. Everyone knows that Shangguan Yu is your half-sister with the same father. I've made inquiries. Your father only has one son; you don't have any sisters."
"We've known each other since childhood, who doesn't know whom? You don't even have a fiance, and Shangguan Yu is not related to you in any way. What right do you have to stop me?"
Qiu Jin'an was furious: "She's my mother!"
The Second Elder responded defensively: "Even if she's your mother...what? What did you say?"
Instinctually, the Second Elder began to fight back, but halfway through, he noticed something was amiss.
How did they go from discussing girlfriends to talking about mothers?
The Grand Elder, along with the others, quietly took a few steps back. Probably because they had been beaten so many times when they were younger, they felt a natural fear and a desire to avoid the older generation.
The disciples of the Five Elements Sect reacted even more strongly. One of the Five Elements Sect's five big mysteries had finally been solved.
"No wonder people in the Cultivation World say you can't judge age by appearance. It seems to be true!"
"I remember someone once came to propose marriage, but the Sect Leader kicked them out with a stern face. At the time, I thought he was just being overprotective of his sister. I never realized the truth was like this."
Qiu Jin'an turned his head towards Shangguan Yu, who was watching the spectacle, despair and helplessness permeating his tone: "Mom, you too. You can't just hide your identity on purpose just to look younger, do you know how many misunderstandings it's caused?"
Shangguan Yu felt her son was unfilial: "How am I trying to look younger? Am I not just eighteen years old? Besides, what's wrong with pretending to be your sister? Your father even agreed!"
"My dad's tomb is taller than me! Did he appear in your dreams?"

chapters.title: Chapter 178 - 177: Dream Pillow_1
chapters.content:
"The grass on my dad's grave is taller than I am!"
"You're not that short," Shangguan Yu murmured.
After learning Shangguan Yu's identity, Uncle Ba's eyes lit up and patted Qiu Jin'an on the shoulder, "From now on, you can call me Old Ba."
"Get lost!" Qiu Jin'an shook off Uncle Ba's hand. Seek Dao Sect indeed wasn't a place for him to stay for long, he had vented a lifetime of anger on the sect.
"Qiu, I think Seek Dao Sect is quite fun. It's rare for us to visit, why don't we stay a few more days?" Shangguan Yu suggested.
Qiu Jin'an took Shangguan Yu, turned around without looking back, and left by boat.
Shangguan Yu kept talking incessantly, "I've been educating you since you were young. Don't lose your temper, stay cool when dealing with things, and be calm. Look at you, you're a grown-up now, but you're still quick to anger even as a Sect Leader. It's not good..."
Qiu Jin'an kept sullenly silent without responding.
Shangguan Yu wiped her tears, "My son has grown up, he's starting to be disobedient."
Out of helplessness, Qiu Jin'an responded, "Mom, can you stop acting like a child?"
"What's wrong with being a child? Your father liked me this way."
"I..." Qiu Jin'an stammered at a loss for words, unsure of how his father ended up falling for his mother in the first place.
On the flying boat, Qiu Jin'an assigned the task, "Everyone, write a two-thousand words reflection on this visit to Seek Dao Sect. It must include introspection, self-reflection, and the next steps. Hand it to me tomorrow!"
At once, protesting cries filled the air.
...
At the entrance gate of Seek Dao Sect, Uncle Ba waved goodbye to the flying boat in relaxed contentment, "What do you think, do I have a chance with Shangguan Yu?"
The Grand Elder looked Uncle Ba up and down dismissively, "Even I'm more handsome than you, yet you dare to chase after her?"
The Third Elder sighed sagely, "Second Brother, I don't mind you switching the generation, but I'm afraid Master won't agree to it. He is suppressing Captive Peak, perhaps he won't need your help."
The elders strictly adhered to a tradition of kicking a man when he is down, each convincing Uncle Ba to not be too desperate.
"Get lost!" Uncle Ba roared in anger. What kind of brothers are these? They couldn't say a single nice word.
"Let's go, let's go have a look at the high-ranking members of Eternity Sect we've captured." said Grand Elder, stating the important matter that needed to be handled urgently.
The disciples at Seek Dao Sect were gathered around the high-ranking members of Eternity Sect at the Martial Arts Square, pointing and gawking at them like they were rare creatures.
This time we were not able to capture all of the Eternity Sect members who infiltrated the Seek Dao Sect; two Rudder Masters and a sect patriarch are still at large, disguising as disciples of Seek Dao Sect.
Lu Yang held the Dream Pillow, looking it over from left to right, fascinated.
This was his first time seeing immortal treasures.
The Dream Pillow was a porcelain pillow-shaped artifact, the porcelain was turquoise in color, and an open green lotus was painted on it with colored glaze.
"Is this the Dream Pillow that Little Lu talked about?" The Grand Elder and others came over, very interested in the immortal treasure.
"Here, let me study it," the Grand Elder took the Dream Pillow. His special expertise was in dreams, so he was very interested in this kind of item that could force people to sleep.
The Grand Elder tried to input a thread of spiritual essence to activate the immortal treasure, but the spiritual essence sank like a stone in the sea. The Dream Pillow showed no response.
"This is interesting," said the Grand Elder, now more curious about how to operate the Dream Pillow.
Yun Zhi wanted to share how to use it with the Grand Elder, but seeing his excitement, she ultimately kept mum.
Let the Grand Elder figure it out on his own.
Despite using various methods, Grand Elder failed to activate the Dream Pillow, and he was a bit frustrated.
"How do you use this thing?"
Vice Sect Leader Gao, the prisoner at the foot of the stage, laughed when he saw this, "Stupid, this is a treasure of our sect. How could mundane people like you be qualified to use this item?"
While the Grand Elder was still studying, Vice Sect Leader Gao was laughing at him. The five high-ranking members of Eternity Sect would occasionally let out strange, mocking laughter.
Finally, the Grand Elder could no longer bear it. He picked up the porcelain pillow and heavily hit Vice Sect Leader Gao on the head with it, causing him to instantly fall asleep.
"So that's how you use immortal treasures." the Grand Elder mused, now knowing how to use the Dream Pillow.
Yun Zhi could no longer contain herself and reminded him, "Grand Elder, if you form a green lotus on the back of the pillow with spiritual essence just like the one in the front, you will be able to activate the pillow."
"So that's how it is."
Grand Elder formed a green lotus on the back of the pillow with spiritual essence and then hit another high-ranking member of Eternity Sect on the head, causing the person to immediately fall asleep.
"It's actually quite handy."
Grand Elder returned the pillow to Lu Yang, and Lu Yang tried using it as Eldest Senior Sister directed. However, it didn't react at all.
Fairy Eternity scoffed, "Do you really think you can activate my treasure with your Foundation Establishment Stage cultivation?"
Unsure of what to do, Lu Yang handed the pillow over to his Eldest Senior Sister for her to deal with.
Yun Zhi orderly formed an imprint with one hand. The imprint slowly seeped into the Dream Pillow, and after it disappeared, she handed the pillow to the Grand Elder.
"Grand Elder, you're the best in our Sect at using dream arts. This item can be the most effective in your hands. I have left an imprint on the pillow, so even if someone else steals it, I can track it down."
The Grand Elder was both surprised and delighted. He thanked Yun Zhi profusely. This was an extremely precious immortal treasure. Having it would significantly boost his combat ability.
He was already the most formidable in the Unification Stage. With this immortal treasure, he would become an invincible existence in the Unification Realm. Daoist Buyu would have to be careful, lest he fall for his traps!
Yun Zhi then recited an ancient phrase, asking the Grand Elder to remember it. She said that if he recited this phrase when using the Dream Pillow, it would increase the latter's power.
The Grand Elder, out of curiosity, asked Yun Zhi if she knew the meaning of this ancient phrase.
Yun Zhi made a weird face and told the Grand Elder it would be better if he didn't know the meaning of the phrase.
"Why is your pillow named Dream Pillow?" Lu Yang asked Fairy Eternity.
"Is it because, when you were cooking rice porridge, you lied on the pillow and fell asleep, living out your life in the dream. When you woke up, the porridge was still not cooked? I remember a certain legend was like this."
Fairy Eternity nodded, "Your guess is pretty close."
"That was when the pillow had just been refined, and I invited Ying Tian Immortal and others over for a meal. The main dish was rice porridge. At the time, I was thinking about other things, and the rice porridge got overcooked and started to bubble up and looked as if it was going to spill out."
"This is when I remembered something Jiuchong Immortal said. When doing experiments, if the liquid starts to boil, throw a few broken porcelain pieces in, and it won't boil over."
"I didn't have any broken porcelain on hand, only the porcelain pillow. So I threw the pillow into the rice porridge. When I scooped it out, the pillow was covered with rice porridge. Hence, it was named Dream Pillow."
Lu Yang: "..."
Does this have anything to do with what I guessed?
"Then, after you threw it in, did the porridge spill over?" Lu Yang was concerned about the aftermath.
"It didn't."
Just as Lu Yang was about to compliment that this method was reliable, Fairy Eternity continued, "I used too much force and broke the pot."
Fairy Eternity looked a little scared, "Thankfully Ying Tian Immortal and the others stood me up. Otherwise, if there was no staple food for the meal, I would have been so embarrassed."
It's said that immortals can avoid disasters, and it seems the saying held true.

chapters.title: Chapter 179 - 178 The Immortal Named Yellow Bean_1
chapters.content:
"Go to Captive Peak and see if we can find out the location of the Eternity Sect's headquarters." Yun Zhi beckoned, causing the Eternity Sect members to lose control of their bodies, floating in mid-air, following her from behind.
After pondering for a moment, Yun Zhi called Lu Yang as well: "Come over as well, we might need you."
It hasn't been long since Lu Yang's last visit to Captive Peak, and now he was back again.
Captive Peak was monotonous and oppressive, just as always.
In the cell, Lu Yang saw the ancient Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator from Three Stand Cave Heaven - the Blood Demon Venerable.
The current Blood Demon Venerable had only his spirit left, no longer as relentless and defiant as he was upon first meeting – hearing the footsteps of Eldest Senior Sister, he shrank to a corner of the cell, shivering with terror.
The Eldest Senior Sister walked straight past him, not even sparing him a glance.
The white-haired child, pretending to be aged, welcomed the arrival of Yun Zhi and Lu Yang: "Little Yun has come again. Who'd she bring this time?"
At this point, Lu Yang already knew that the previous Sect Leader, the white-haired child, was called Tang Shengyi.
"Two vice sect leaders of the Eternity Sect, five high supervising members."
"Goodness, all these heavyweights you've captured. Have you raided the Eternity Sect's nest?" Tang Shengyi was somewhat shocked, his disciple truly had some remarkable skills.
"They all walked into their own traps."
Vice Sect Leader Liu and Vice Sect Leader Gao both roused at this time, and upon hearing what Yun Zhi said, they started hurling curses.
"Sneaky Seek Dao Sect, you clearly deceived me into coming here."
"Such great lengths all of you went to, placing a Transcendance Tribulation Stage infiltrator in the Eternity Sect, winning our trust!"
Clearly, Vice Sect Leader Liu hadn't entirely woken up yet.
Vice Sect Leader Gao whispered a reminder: "Wake up. What nonsense about an infiltrator?"
Vice Sect Leader Liu was slightly confused: "Isn't it Lu Yang?"
Yun Zhi silently watched Lu Yang, also wanting to know what kind of dream Lu Yang had spun for Vice Sect Leader Liu.
Lu Yang coughed awkwardly, feeling too embarrassed to recount the dream, changing the subject: "Hurry up and question them. What tools will you need – chilli water, tiger bench, or a water-soaked whip?"
The two vice sect leaders, both having spent hundreds if not thousands of years amidst the demonic sect, were ruthless and heartless. Ordinary interrogation methods scarcely made them blink an eye.
"Ha, young man, do you think we'll spill our sect's secrets just because you use these methods? Impossible!"
"The Righteous Path is ignorant and unknowing, and yet you're trying to prevent us from resurrecting the Immortal Eternity. When the ancient era returns, if the Immortal Eternity does not awaken, who will protect us?"
"Subduing demons and eliminating monsters, it sounds good, but you don't realize that it is precisely your actions that are endangering the future of the human race!"
The two vice sect leaders were taking turns to mock the ignorance of the Righteous Path.
"We don't need to complicate things yet." Yun Zhi stopped Lu Yang.
After asking the white-haired child to leave, she said to Lu Yang: "Fairy, come out and meet your believers."
Behind Lu Yang, a fairy appeared, looking like a mirage. With her bare feet exposed, bright eyes, and white teeth, her dress floating in the air, the fairy radiated elegance and refinement.
"Are you two my believers?"
Fairy Eternity had a cold expression, her gaze as placid as an ancient well, looking at the two vice sect leaders as if they were mere insects.
In Central Continent, those at the Unification stage were weighty figures, considered ancestors in the sects, major officers in the dynasties, and mysterious legends in the Jianghu (pugilistic world). However, when it comes to an Immortal, Unification stage cultivators are simply not on the same level.
"Who are you!"
The two vice sect leaders demanded an answer, trying to mask their panic with loud voices.
They didn't know why, but upon seeing the Fairy, they felt an impulse to worship her.
Fairy Eternity laughed nonchalantly and said: "I am Fairy Eternity."
"Fairy Eternity?" Upon hearing Fairy Eternity's claim, the two vice sect leaders felt an unsettling unease.
How does this title resemble Immortal Eternity so much? Is it a coincidence?
Fairy Eternity continued: "You have been deceived, there has never been an Immortal Eternity. It is only me, Fairy Eternity."
"Someone fears my resurrection, and wants to conceal my existence with the laughable title of 'Immortal Eternity'. How ignorant, it's laughable."
"There is no shortage of fools in the world who believe in the rumors spread by people behind the scenes."
"Fortunately, Seek Dao Sect carries the mandate of heaven, and people blessed with great destiny have taken on the cause and effect of my resurrection, invoking my true name, and resurrecting me."
The two Vice Sect Leaders felt a chill at the heart. This paragraph revealed too much information.
What does it mean that there has never been an Immortal Eternity? What does it mean to fear Fairy Eternity? Moreover, the so-called Seek Dao Sect carrying the mandate of heaven and the people with great destiny... it's frightening to think about.
"So, we're not actually venerating Immortal Eternity, we're venerating you?" Vice Sect Leader Liu raised his head and looked at the sacred Fairy Eternity, feeling uncertain and uneasy in his heart.
"Correct. You've been deceived. I am not a person who likes blood and murder. The rumors that I enjoy killing are baseless and ridiculous."
Fairy Eternity instructed: "To realize one's mistake and correct it is the best virtue. Now, if you tell this cultivator called Yun Zhi the location of the Eternity Sect headquarters, there is still a chance to rectify the mistakes."
Vice Sect Leader Gao suddenly asked: "Fairy, can you tell us your true immortal name?"
Fairy Eternity nodded, speaking her true name in a calm tone: "My immortal name is Yellow Bean."
The expressions of the two Vice Sect Leaders suddenly became excited: "I knew it! You are a fraudster sent by the Seek Dao Sect! How could a respected fairy have such a name? It's obviously made up on the spot!"
"Got you, didn't I? Yellow Bean? Does your family make tofu?"
Fairy Eternity radiated a chilling aura.
If there was a Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator present, they could distinguish that this was a breath surpassing the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, identifying Fairy Eternity's identity.
Unfortunately, the two Vice Sect Leaders were in the Unification stage. They failed to recognize how great this presence was. They only knew that the aura had surpassed the Unification Stage, but they did not recognize the unique aura of an Immortal.
Yun Zhi slowly persuaded Fairy Eternity not to be angry: "Elder Fairy, there is no need to be angry. If they don't recognize you, I will have to resort to some means to make them reveal the location of the Eternity Sect."
Only then did Fairy Eternity's expression improve, and she returned into Lu Yang's body.
Yun Zhi then said to Lu Yang: "My methods will be more cruel than last time. You are still young, so it's better not to watch."
Hearing Eldest Senior Sister's admonishment, Lu Yang shivered and obediently left Captive Peak.
On the way back, Lu Yang kindly comforted the sulking Fairy Eternity, complimenting that her name was actually quite nice and cute.
"Really?" Fairy Eternity appeared somewhat pleased, it was rare for her to receive compliments about her name.
"Really, really!" Lu Yang nodded repeatedly.
Lu Yang looked up at the moon and thought about something: "Speaking of which, I don't know what time it is now, is it tomorrow yet?"
Just as Lu Yang was wondering, there was laughter in the distance.
"Junior Brother Lu has asked a great question, how timely, it just passed midnight, it's now the second day!"
In other words, Fairy Eternity is no longer the Acting Sect Master now.
Senior Brother Ma Tianyang sneered: "Junior Brother Lu, did you enjoy the past three days as Acting Sect Master? I've heard that you have the potential for celestial greatness, capable of challenging above your level, I'd like to teach you a lesson."
Senior Brother Ma Tianyang grabbed Lu Yang up to the platform like picking up a chick.
When they heard Lu Yang was here, more and more Senior Brothers and Sisters began rushing this way. Lu Yang's legs began to shake even more.
"Fairy, you have to take responsibility for this!" In the spiritual space, Lu Yang looked angrily at Fairy Eternity.
I just comforted her earlier, comforted my ass! She should be comforting me!
Fairy Eternity guiltily turned her head away.
"Well...this is also part of the trial."

chapters.title: Chapter 180 - 179: Ancient Great Divine Skill - Spill Beans into Soldiers_1
chapters.content:
Immortals, as the pinnacle of the cultivation system, are often associated with words like invincible, peak, and unparalleled.
The legacy of the immortals is considered a treasure in the Central Continent, and countless people seek the immortal's legacy, searching for traces of immortals and gaining half-hearted information about immortals.
To obtain the legacy of an immortal, one must face immense difficulties, growing stronger with each battle, and being invincible against challengers of the same level is the most basic condition.
On top of this, one has to pass the trials of the immortals, satisfying their various unreasonable demands.
Lu Yang had a deep understanding of this.
On the battlefield, Lu Yang was challenged by his senior brothers and sisters one after another. In his spiritual space, Lu Yang chased after Fairy Eternity, making her responsible.
"Yellow Bean, you stay right there! They are looking for you, so why am I the one getting hit!"
"I've said it before, it's an immortal's test. I promise, as long as you survive tonight, I'll teach you a supreme divine skill!"
"Learning a supreme divine skill from you is worse than learning from Eldest Senior Sister. You stay put, I'll show you a mortal's test today!"
"You're disrespecting an immortal!"
Fairy Eternity took off running, refusing to let Lu Yang catch up under any circumstances.
In reality, all the experts were preparing for a wheel war against Lu Yang, the pride of heaven who could challenge higher-level opponents, repeatedly overwhelming Lu Yang.
Lu Yang explained calmly, "Senior brothers and sisters, I think there might be some misunderstanding between us. Actually, I have another powerful spirit in my body. Everything I did as the acting sect leader was her controlling my body."
The senior brothers and sisters sneered, not believing Lu Yang's nonsense. Were they supposed to believe he was suffering from a split personality now? Too late!
Although the senior brothers and sisters were here for revenge, they did not just rush up all at once. They were all well-mannered, and rushing up all at once was barbaric. They were cultured; they queued up.
There was a long line formed by the crowd below the stage.
"Whoever is upfront, hurry up. There are so many people waiting behind!"
As the strongest amongst the Five Great Immortal Sects, the Seek Dao Sect's strength was unquestionable. Each of its disciples was a genius or prodigy. These people trained to the Golden Core Stage or above, each with their own unique insights into battle style, spiritual essence circulation, and the order of releasing magic skills.
Battling these individuals would rapidly increase one's combat experience. In this way, no matter the future opponent or their combat style, one could deal with it effortlessly. Even the disciples of the Five Elements Sect could verify this after trading blows with Seek Dao Sect disciples—it greatly improved their abilities.
Outside, countless people desired to exchange experiences with Seek Dao Sect disciples and envied Lu Yang for having such an experience.
But Lu Yang made it clear that he had no desire to be envied.
The intense combat made Meng Jingzhou clap for joy from the stands.
Despite this, Lu Yang had to admit that fighting with his senior brothers and sisters provided considerable help, both in terms of combat experience and his own realm.
After every battle, the senior brothers and sisters would use their unique skills to defeat Lu Yang and then lodge various valuable elixirs like the Golden Foundation Pill and Breeze Reviving Pill into his mouth as if they were worthless.
These elixirs helped him quickly recover from his injuries, consolidate his foundation, and face the next round in top form.
In the process of repeated battles and taking elixirs, Lu Yang's realm was steadily improving, which was worthy of celebration.
He felt that he was just a thought away from breaking through to the mid-stage of foundation establishment.
Moreover, his skills like the Three Flavored True Fire, Shrinking Land, Reduced Inches, and Tree Growing Spells became more proficient in the showdowns with his senior brothers and sisters, finding loopholes, and finding solutions.
Probably this was called having great fortune in the face of life and death, where Lu Yang's potential was even further cruelly squeezed out.
For instance, Lu Yang could vomit Three Flavored True Fire, burning the opponent's insides without damaging their exterior, therefore further enhancing his fire control ability.
He could freely adjust the degree of spiciness to mild, medium, extra spicy, and explosive.
He could also freely adjust the saltiness, ranging from light, normal, a bit salty, and extremely salty. However, there was still a wide gap from the saltiness level Fairy Eternity reached.
For instance, Lu Yang found during the battle that he could combine the Shrinking Land, Reduced Inches, and Tree Growing Spells to first shrink the land, then reduce inches, and finally use the Tree Growing Spell to grow three mini Lu Yangs on the tree.
However, Lu Yang's current spiritual strength was weak and could not simultaneously control three versions of himself.
"Huh, a ginseng fruit?" The one fighting with Lu Yang was Senior Sister Yi Jing. She looked in surprise at the bald, mini Lu Yang shaking on the Bodhi tree, finding it adorable.
"Could this be the origin of the legendary Ginseng fruit?" A senior brother murmured. The Ginseng fruit had always been a legend, never really seen.
A senior brother thought the other was being too imaginative: "The mastery of a skill at Lu Yang's level is unparalleled. Even if the ginseng fruit is rare, it is not as rare as Lu Yang."
Another senior brother said, "I also don't think the ginseng fruit came out this way. I read in a folk history book about the genesis of the ginseng fruit. Legend has it that in ancient times, ginseng was rare, and a swindler claimed to have some. When people asked where he had found the ginseng, he said it grew on trees. And thus the name Ginseng Fruit came about."
"...Your folk history is pretty wild."
"Did the book mention who the swindler was?"
"It said his name was Ying Tian Immortal."
In the spiritual space, Fairy Eternity ran too fast and was an entire lap ahead of Lu Yang, but eventually, Lu Yang caught her by the wrist.
"Finally caught you!" Lu Yang smiled gently, looking like a gracious loser.
In reality, Lu Yang halted the hand of his senior brother on the verge of a strike.
The Spirit Transformation Stage senior brother stopped his attack, wanting to see what Lu Yang was about to do.
Among the opponents that Fairy Eternity challenged with her power, there was also this Spirit Transformation Stage Senior Brother Wu. He was here for revenge, had been queueing for half a day, and finally, it was his turn.
Lu Yang took a deep breath and slowly said, "Senior Brother Wu, I advise you not to push people too far. If you really push me, I won't hesitate to act!"
Senior Brother Wu was not intimidated by Lu Yang and laughed, "What if I do press you? Could it be you still have a fourth coupon for Acting Sect Master Experience?"
Senior Brother Wu did not believe Lu Yang had any more. If he had, he would have used it by now. Why would he wait till now?
"I don't have a Sect Leader Experience Voucher, but I have an ancient Great Divine Skill that can defeat all enemies. As a fellow disciple of the Seek Dao Sect, I don't want to commit a massacre within the sect!"
Senior Brother Wu didn't believe Lu Yang possessed such divine skills, gave up any further chatter, and immediately attacked.
Seeing that persuasion did not work, Lu Yang had no choice but to apply the skill he had just learned.
"See my ancient Great Divine Skill—Spill Beans into Soldiers!"
In his spiritual space, Lu Yang forcibly handed over control to Yellow Bean.
Spill Beans into Soldiers was to allow Fairy Eternity to fight instead of Lu Yang!
This tactic was not to be trifled with. An immortal's possession of a body allowed for invincibility. Even in ancient times, this was considered a formidable, forbidden spell!
Fairy Eternity looked at the rushing Senior Brother Wu in despair; how was she supposed to fight a Spirit Transformation Realm opponent?
"Lu Yang, you have no reverence for immortals!"
Lu Yang sneered, reverence? That's something I'll consider if I survive the night!

chapters.title: Chapter 181 - 180: Junior Brother Lu, Do You Have Any Unfulfilled Wishes?_1
chapters.content:
Being an Immortal, Fairy Eternity had managed to survive the brutal and savage ancient times, successfully becoming an immortal and making it to the ranks of the Five Immortals. Apart from having exceptional luck, she also had a myriad of aces up her sleeve.
A chilly edge revealed itself in Fairy Eternity's eyes. Her opponent's cultivation level was too high, and normal methods were certainly inadequate. As such, she couldn't blame her for being merciless.
She directly employed a forbidden spell concerning time - the Playing Dead Technique!
With a thud, Fairy Eternity fell to the ground as if lifeless. Motionless, without a pulse, heartbeat or discernible soul.
Senior Brother Wu was scared out of his wits. He hadn't even made a move, and she was already dead?
"Maybe we should bury her?" someone suggested from the crowd.
"Indeed, her funeral should be grand." Senior Brother Wu nodded. Sect Leader Lu Yang's contributions during his tenure were evident to everyone.
Fairy Eternity hurriedly rose, scaring the wits out of Senior Brother Wu. He quickly fumbled for a Yellow Talisman and stuck it on Lu Yang's forehead.
"Who would have thought Brother Lu has become a zombie. Is there an unfulfilled wish you have?"
Senior Brother Wu recited a chant for crossing over: "Dust to dust, earth to earth, everything is past now. Brother Lu, speak your wish, and your brothers will fulfill it for you."
Fairy Eternity faintly spoke: "My wish is to defeat Yun Zhi."
Senior Brother Wu's expression subtly changed and stuck another Yellow Talisman on Lu Yang's mouth: "Brother Lu, do you have any other unfulfilled desires?"
Fairy Eternity was unable to speak.
Senior Brother Wu sighed with relief: "It seems there's nothing."
The crowd burst into wails, they lifted Lu Yang's still warm body and buried him in the grove of Sky Gate Mountain, leaving out only his head.
Then they left Sky Gate Mountain, rushing to the Task Hall to complete tasks, accumulate contribution points, and exchange them for a chance to be the Acting Sect Leader.
In the three days since Fairy Eternity became the Acting Sect Leader, she had been extraordinarily active and had piqued everyone's interest in experiencing being an Acting Sect Leader.
"Being a Sect Leader seems like fun."
"I have some ideas that can only be realized by becoming the Sect Leader."
Full of motivation, everyone headed to the Task Hall to accept tasks, shocking Dai Bufan.
He had never seen everyone so enthusiastic before, as if they were rushing to buy discounted goods.
In the end, the quest wall was barren. All the tasks had been taken, which made Dai Bufan's eyes twitch.
Dai Bufan sighed with relief when he got to the bottom of it. If that was the reason, he didn't have to worry about everyone being lively for the moment.
Exchanging for the Acting Sect Leader Experience coupon would require more than just completing one or two tasks.
Unless someone else like Fairy Eternity managed to kill a Demon Cultivator in the Unification stage.
"That's good, there has been a trend of increased tasks in recent days, which can just meet their demands."
Since yesterday, there had been an increase in ordinary individuals from the Great Xia Dynasty requesting help from the Seek Dao Sect.
Dai Bufan noticed the changes, kept an eye on it, and found that all those who came for help were from the same place.
Upon careful inquiry, he found out that these people had heard the tales told by wandering story-tellers of the "Legend of the Dao Sect", and learned about the Seek Dao Sect, a place dedicated to punishing the wicked and upholding the good.
Dai Bufan pondered and figured out the underlying reason: "It seems that the impact of Eldest Senior Sister's plan of promoting the Sect through storytelling is beginning to show."
However, Dai Bufan had also heard of some strange occurrences. For instance, some ordinary individuals who came to the Sect for help wanted to meet the legendary Daoist Buyu from the story "Legend of the Dao Sect," the one who had dramatically turned around the waning state of the Seek Dao Sect and taken it to the forefront of the Five Great Immortal Sects.
Besides the name, Dai Bufan couldn't find any connection between the Sect Leader and the legendary Daoist Buyu.
The power balance among the Five Great Immortal Sects was difficult to determine, as none could guarantee who might be hiding some old monster in their ranks. Judging their strength based on obvious battle forces was meaningless.
The Seek Dao Sect had indeed been in decline, but that was several generations ago and had nothing to do with the current or previous generation. When Daoist Buyu took over the Sect, the Seek Dao Sect had already shed its declining state.
However, the emergence of Yun Zhi had disrupted the balance between the Five Great Immortal Sects.
Even the old monsters hidden in the forbidden land of the Great Xia imperial palace knew that they were no match for Yun Zhi in single combat, not to mention the old monsters of the Five Great Immortal Sects.
In their prime, these old monsters were renowned as powerful figures who held the reins of their era and stirred wind and rain. Now they live in seclusion, their names unknown.
The fact that none of them could defeat a young girl was admittedly embarrassing to disclose, so the details of Yun Zhi's real strength were not clearly shared, only hinted at to the current generation to know their place.
Although the people of this era may not know the exact strength of Yun Zhi, they remember the teachings of the old monsters - never provoke Yun Zhi. Among them, Emperor Xia did it best.
"Considering that Brother Lu tricked the upper echelons of the demonic sect to come here for a total wipeout this time, how much contribution points would be appropriate?"
"Although the key step was completed by Eldest Senior Sister, the merits of Lu Yang and the others were not small either." Dai Bufan was somewhat troubled.
"Never mind, I won't think about it. Let Eldest Senior Sister make the decision." Dai Bufan shrugged off the matter.
...
In the grove on Sky Gate Mountain, Lu Yang's head appeared, giving his surroundings a quick scan. The control of his body had returned to him now.
"Earth Escape."
With a swish, Lu Yang burrowed out from the ground.
Knowing that Lu Yang knew the Earth Escape technique, his senior brothers and sisters had intentionally spared him. If they had used the 'Point Ground Into Steel' technique, Lu Yang would really have been in trouble.
"Congratulations, congratulations, you've successfully passed this Immortal's test." Fairy Eternity clapped enthusiastically.
In all seriousness, she analyzed, "You've gained a lot this time, not only increasing your battle experience, but also visibly enhancing your various magic skills, even your cultivation level is nearing the late Foundation Establishment stage. I can guarantee, at your age, you are the strongest!"
Lu Yang stayed silent, looking at her with a haunted gaze.
"Ahem, don't look at this immortal like that," Fairy Eternity coughed awkwardly.
"I told you before, as long as you pass this test, I will give you part of my heritage. You should be pleased with yourself. In the ancient times, you wouldn't have the chance to learn this Immortal's methods unless you became my disciple."
Lu Yang skeptically looked at Fairy Eternity: "Did you have disciples in ancient times?"
"No."
"…" Fortunately, she didn't, otherwise wouldn't she just ruin them?
Fairy Eternity, unaware of what Lu Yang was thinking, continued to speak, "This time, the skill I will impart to you is of great origin. This was a spell the Time Immortal asked to learn from me after he became a Daoist, involving time and future."
"Although I am not as gifted in temporal magic as Time Immortal, I have a basic understanding of it, which is more than enough to teach you!"
"What spell?"
"Foreseeing the future!"
Lu Yang gasped, he hadn't expected to have the chance to learn this renowned spell, which couldn't be considered a regular spell anymore, but an Immortal Technique.
Was the Fairy finally acting as a cheat code?
Taking a beating this time seemed to have been worthwhile.

chapters.title: Chapter 182 - 181: Not Family, No Entry_1
chapters.content:
For the Time Immortal, what Lu Yang knew of was merely his title, with the rest being a mystery. However, he could still conjecture a bit.
Just as Fairy Eternity has "Eternity" as her prefix, her characteristic being immortality, it could be inferred by the same token that Time Immortal's characteristic is related to "time."
The magic skill passed down to Fairy Eternity from Time Immortal, and then from her to himself, was tantamount to acquiring blessings from two immortals—a testament to the strength of this particular magic skill!
Furthermore, time-related magic skills are the rarest among all, surpassing those related to space and causality in terms of scarcity.
"Why would Time Immortal teach you this magic skill?" Lu Yang asked. It couldn't be that you tricked him into telling you while he was delirious, could it?
The more Lu Yang thought about it, the more plausible it seemed.
Fairy Eternity feigned anger, "Why, isn't it normal that Time Immortal begged me to learn the magic skill, owing to my charm and personality?"
You must have tricked him into it when he was off his guard.
"What's the real story, then?"
"Once I complained to Time Immortal that I'd painstakingly prepared all this nutritious food to invite you guys, but no one ever came over, wasting all the food. I asked if he could teach me a magic skill that would allow me to anticipate people's actions so I could prepare meals accordingly."
"Time Immortal seemed somewhat unwilling. I guessed it was because he felt that if I learned this kind of skill, he would lose his job. Fair enough."
"Out of consideration, I didn't push him further."
"Then, what happened?"
"Well, you know I'm a gentle, considerate, generous, and refined fairy," Fairy Eternity said, using adjectives that didn't seem to apply to her at all.
"Being the considerate person I am, I acknowledged that you guys have many planets to take care of and wouldn't necessarily have time to come over for meals."
"So, I offered to provide delivery service. I would do all the cooking and deliver one meal at a time to your tables. This way, the food I prepared would not go to waste, and you guys could save time."
"Probably realizing that my time was also precious and shouldn't be wasted on such trifles, Time Immortal then offered to teach me the skill of 'Forecasting the Future,' which would allow me to anticipate who would come and who wouldn't."
"I told him that magic skill sounded tough, and I'd rather keep delivering the food. Time Immortal, however, insisted that the skill was very easy to learn."
"Seeing his enthusiasm, I reluctantly agreed to learn it."
"Did you manage to learn it?"
With a look of pride, Fairy Eternity nodded, "Who do you think I am? I'm the grand Fairy! Could it be that I couldn't learn a certain magic skill? I can predict events three days in the future with no deviations!"
Lu Yang regarded her with newfound respect. Being able to foresee events three days in the future was indeed worthy of one of the Five Immortals of the Ancients.
"Let me demonstrate for you!"
As she spoke, Fairy Eternity's spirit floated out of her body. A gentle wind blew, stirring her light cyan dress, making her seem as if she had stepped out of a painting.
Fairy Eternity raised her right hand, mumbling in the ancient and hard-to-understand language of the Ancients. Along with her incantation, countless golden runes emerged, dispersed in all directions, disappearing into the void. When her incantation reached a crescendo, the golden runes returned and gathered in her eyes.
Fairy Eternity's eyes glowed with golden brilliance.
"I can see..."
"What do you see, fairy?"
"I can see that from tonight to tomorrow, it will turn from intermediate rain to clear weather, fifteen to nineteen degrees, with southeast wind..."
Lu Yang: "???"
Fairy Eternity continued, "I can also find out that the day after tomorrow, it will turn from sunny to cloudy, seventeen to twenty-four degrees..."
Seeing Fairy Eternity continue to present weather forecasts for the day after tomorrow, Lu Yang hurriedly interrupted.
"Wait a minute. Is that all you've learned about future forecasting?"
Wouldn't Time Immortal worry about tarnishing his reputation if he knew his disciple had learned it this way?
Fairy Eternity spoke to Lu Yang with deep earnestness, "Your perception is too narrow. Is predicting what you've done or what I've done the only definition of forecasting the future?"
"I, too, once had the same doubts as you. Time Immortal told me with great emphasis that weather forecasting is part of predicting the future."
"It can even be said that weather forecasting is even more difficult than predicting people's actions."
"What does weather represent? It represents the changes in the heavens and earth. Between Heaven, Earth, and Man, Man is the last, while Heaven and Earth come first. Predicting the changes in heaven and earth is undoubtedly more difficult than predicting human behavior."
"My prediction of the weather is just proof that I have mastered the skill! Ordinary people, even if they want to do what I do, wouldn't be able to!"
Fairy Eternity relayed again what Time Immortal had said to her to Lu Yang, feeling extremely pleased inside. The feeling of teaching students—no, being a teacher—was pretty great.
Lu Yang suspected that Fairy Eternity had been tricked by Time Immortal, but he dared not question Time Immortal since he was no match for him.
"Can you predict anything else?"
"Only the weather."
Lu Yang was more convinced that Fairy Eternity had been tricked by Time Immortal, but he was no match for Time Immortal.
The ancient times were so cruel. The immortals didn't have the basic human decency not to trick fools. So outrageous!
"Is your weather forecast reliable? Seek Dao Sect has spring all year round with rare rainfall," Lu Yang asked skeptically, doubting the success rate of the magic skill.
"My weather forecast is never wrong!"
"So, you're teaching me to predict the weather?" Lu Yang gave a twitching look from the corner of his eyes, retracting his initial thoughts.
This golden finger is indeed useless.
"What I learned is the highest realm of predicting the future, forecasting the weather, while what I'm going to teach you is the normal predicting of the future. Although your magic talent is good, it's not up to par with mine, and you're only at the Foundation Establishment stage. How could you possibly learn from me?"
Lu Yang was not quite sure what Fairy Eternity was proud of.
"So, you are teaching me normal future forecasting, and you learned weather forecasting yourself?"
"Correct."
Lu Yang felt that this was a classic case of different people having different pathways.
It would be normal for Fairy Eternity, his Nascent Soul, to possess some traits similar to his.
"Are you going to learn?"
"Yes!"
"If you want to learn, then you must start with the basics - the language of the Ancients. There is a substantial difference between the ancient languages and the current language, and you won't be able to learn it in a short time. So for the sake of gaining quick results, you can simply learn the ancient language used during the casting of the Forecasting the Future skill."
Fairy Eternity paused, and repeated the ancient language she had used earlier.
"What does that line mean?" Lu Yang asked out of curiosity.
Fairy Eternity translated, "The sentence I said just now translates to, 'O divine Spirits of the sky and earth, you tortoise grandson Time Immortal, make your presence known!'"
Lu Yang instinctively stepped back two places, fearing that Time Immortal might appear out of nowhere and squash him with a finger.
Lu Yang felt that learning magic skills from Fairy Eternity could even threaten basic survival. Eldest Senior Sister was more reliable.
"Repeat after me."
"Hmm, just to be safe, I want to verify - is it absolutely necessary to pronounce 'tortoise grandson'?"
"Actually, that's just an auxiliary word, you can say it or not,"

chapters.title: Chapter 183 - 182: Knowing the Future_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang felt that Fairy Eternity's inability to predict the future was primarily due to the lack of serious teachings from Time Immortal.
Lu Yang was learning the ancient language from Fairy Eternity, and the unfamiliar vocabulary was jumping out one after another.
After a few recitations, Lu Yang was able to fluently speak the sentence.
"By the way, to resurrect you, Fairy, wouldn't it still work whether I used the ancient language or the current language to pronounce your name?" asked Lu Yang, recalling that he spoke the present language when he resurrected Fairy Eternity.
"To think, my Dao Fruit is called 'Eternity' and with it, I endure through the ages. How can I be bound by the distinctions of language? But Yingtian Immortal and the others do not know this," Fairy Eternity giggled, sounding quite "mischievous" as she shared this little secret with Lu Yang.
"Don't go telling anyone about this. I only told you because you resurrected me and let me reside in your body for such a long time!" Fairy Eternity warned.
"Absolutely!" Lu Yang patted his chest and promised.
Lu Yang started to earnestly learn how to predict the future. He sat cross-legged, quietly pondering this renowned magic skill and Divine Ability told in ancient legends.
Lu Yang hardly sought guidance from Fairy Eternity, for fear that she might lead him astray. But still, he had to ask when he encountered something he couldn't understand.
Fairy Eternity watched as Lu Yang gradually touched on the core of predicting the future and secretly marveled. This indicated that Lu Yang was not far from mastering it.
She claimed that Lu Yang's gift for magic skills was inferior to hers because she was too shy to admit that Lu Yang's talent surpassed hers.
She could not learn time magic skills during her Foundation Establishment Stage.
For a mid-stage Foundation Establishment stage cultivator, who had mastered Heaven and Earth in an Inch, a spatial magic skill, and was about to learn a time magic skill like predicting the future, calling Lu Yang a genius would not be an exaggeration.
Fairy Eternity quickly brushed this off. After all, she wasn't very skilled in magic skills. So, why compare her weak point with Lu Yang's strength?
Lu Yang solemnly recited the ancient language. With his middle and index fingers together, he bellowed, "Predict the future!"
"Did it work?" Fairy Eternity was surprised. He learned so quickly.
Golden runes appeared around Lu Yang, dissolving into the void. About three minutes later, the golden runes escaped the void and returned to Lu Yang's body.
Lu Yang's eyes glowed brightly, much like gold; he had successfully seen the future!
"I see... myself two minutes ago?!"
Seeing the picture of himself from two minutes ago, Lu Yang was dumbfounded. He was lifting his arm, waiting for the golden runes' feedback, looking rather silly.
The corner of his eye twitched. Theoretically, he had mastered predicting the future, able to foresee events one minute after casting the spell.
But in reality, he had to wait three minutes to know the result.
"What's the use of this?" Lu Yang complained.
Lu Yang figured it's probably because he hadn't perfected his skills yet.
"Let's practice again."
Lu Yang reflected on his actions to identify potential mistakes, fill in the gaps, and tried again.
After casting the magic skill and waiting for three minutes, he saw the events one and a half minutes after casting the spell.
"... I guess that's some progress." Lu Yang comforted himself and cheered up.
"You can do it!" Fairy Eternity also encouraged him from the side.
"Let's go again!"
After the Five Elements Sect left, his Senior Brothers and Sisters took turns fighting with Lu Yang until dawn and then buried him in the small woods of Sky Gate Mountain.
Lu Yang passed Fairy's test and started to practice diligently from dawn.
Time passed from morning to evening. The sun turned to the moon. The moonlight poured over the Seek Dao Sect like a tide, casting a mysterious veil over it.
The heaven rewarded the diligent. After continuously practicing, finding and solving the issues he encountered, the length of the future he could predict was getting longer and closer to the three-minute mark.
Suddenly, Lu Yang felt a thunderous explosion in his mind like something had been unlocked, and he stepped over the three-minute mark, successfully predicting the future.
Lu Yang's eyes shone brilliantly, like two glowing candles in the night, extremely noticeable.
"What did you see?" an excited Fairy Eternity asked.
Lu Yang had a strange expression: "I saw a scene. Eldest Senior Sister was leaving Captive Peak. I ran to her and said I wanted to learn from my master, how to lay around, do nothing but eat and play all day, refusing to cultivate or do anything useful. Eldest Senior Sister smiled faintly, held me in her arms and patted my back, saying that she would support me in the future."
"Really?" Fairy Eternity was shocked. What a strange future.
"It feels real!" Lu Yang was also puzzled.
"Why do I feel there's something strange about this?" Fairy Eternity pondered before suggesting, "Time Immortal once said that the future couldn't be changed. Since you saw it, it's certain to happen."
"The only way to verify the truth is to test it!"
Lu Yang felt that Fairy Eternity made a valid point and rushed towards Captive Peak.
Right then, Yun Zhi had just come out from Captive Peak, leaving traces of blood on her fists. Although she still wore a poker face, anyone familiar with her knew that she was in a good mood.
She had successfully obtained a vast amount of information about the Eternity Sect from the two deputies, including the location of the Eternity Sect's headquarters.
Upon seeing the excited Lu Yang ran towards her, Yun Zhi asked, "Junior Brother, what's the matter?"
Lu Yang answered with a brilliant smile, "I definitely need to learn from master, being idler, spending all day eating or playing without cultivating or doing anything productive,"
Rumble-- Crack--
Unexpectedly, the otherwise clear sky abruptly became overcast, filled with lightning and thunder, and heavy rain began to pour.
"Oh, it's raining. I knew it would rain tonight!" Fairy Eternity felt proud. Her weather forecast was incredibly accurate.
Lu Yang noticed that once he finished speaking, Eldest Senior Sister went from expressionless to a faint smile. But combined with the thundering sky and his own intuition, this smile was pressuring Lu Yang greatly.
It was a matter of life and death!
Swallowing a mouthful of saliva, Lu Yang hurried back into his Spiritual Space, secretly asking, "Fairy, will emotional changes due to a high cultivation level manipulate the weather?"
"Yes."
Lu Yang finally understood why it was raining in the usually dry Seek Dao Sect.
He just provoked Eldest Senior Sister!
"Your weather forecast is so accurate, Fairy Eternity!" Lu Yang gritted his teeth.
In reality, Yun Zhi gently patted Lu Yang's shoulder, asking in a soft voice, "Junior brother, have you been pushing yourself so hard with cultivation that you started talking nonsense?"
Lu Yang shuddered, automatically shaking his head. Realizing his mistake, he hastily started nodding like a pecking chicken, unable to voice a single word.
He finally figured out what spell he had concocted.
Predicting the Future—foreseeing things that will never happen.

chapters.title: Chapter 184 - 183: The Strongest Ghoul _1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang innocently narrated the entire course of events and brought out Fairy Eternity to testify, which finally convinced Yun Zhi that Lu Yang had been conducting an experiment just now.
The thunderstorm dissipated, and the rain abruptly stopped. Moonlight broke through the dark clouds, and the Seek Dao Sect once again returned to clear skies.
The disciples of Seek Dao Sect were unclear about what had happened. The rain hadn't been falling for long, so why did it stop?
When it rained at the Seek Dao Sect, it was usually caused by an Elder escalating spiritual essence into the rainwater. The combined entities then fell together, irrigating the Seek Dao Sect and increasing the concentration of Spiritual Energy in the Sect.
"What did I say? From tonight to tomorrow, it will be sunny after the clouds. Look, how accurate." Fairy Eternity showed off her ability to predict the weather.
"....."Lu Yang chose to remain silent.
Lu Yang noticed some familiar figures trailing behind his Eldest Senior Sister, notably Vice Sect Leader Liu and the other six high-ranking members of the Eternity Sect.
The seven of them looked utterly dispirited, their eyes carrying a vague sense of horror when looking at the Eldest Senior Sister.
"Huh, they're all in spirit form." Fairy Eternity was somewhat surprised.
"Eldest Senior Sister, what are you going to…" Lu Yang was confused.
Yun Zhi explained casually, "I've noticed they have a knack for grilling skewers and are quite popular among the Junior Brothers and Sisters. Instead of leaving them locked up in Captive Peak, it's better to put their special skills to good use at a barbecue restaurant."
"I will turn the seven of them into Ghouls."
Naturally, the money earned by Vice Sect Leader Liu and his group would have to be turned over to the Eldest Senior Sister, dime for dime.
There are many ancient Unification-era souls suppressed inside Captive Peak, so there is no lack of raw materials for refining magic artifacts for now.
Lu Yang was stupefied. Why did this technique feel so familiar?
Moreover, turning someone into a Ghoul at the Unification level... Isn't that the limit to what a ghoul could become?
By turning them into ghouls, there's no need to worry about them turning against the Seek Dao Sect and causing a ruckus. If they harbored any malicious intent to harm others, they would die on the spot.
The Eldest Senior Sister, accompanied by Vice Sect Leader Liu and the others, returned to the "Try again" barbecue shop and asked them to live in peace and calmly run their business.
Vice Sect Leader Liu and his group quickly nodded in agreement, vowing to carry on barbecuing with dedication, refraining from using inferior products or overcharging customers, and serving every customer with the utmost professionalism and warmth.
Only then did the Eldest Senior Sister leave in satisfaction, asking Lu Yang to return to Sky Gate Mountain with her.
The "Try Again" barbecue shop opened smoothly, and many businesses came forward to congratulate the new store on its opening.
Initially, Vice Sect Leader Liu and his group were disdainful. Even if they were now in spirit form and had become ghouls, they were still Unification-level powers, figures commanding respect in the outside world. They did not want to converse with these businesses, feeling it beneath their dignity.
However, as they scanned with their Spiritual Sense, they began to sweat. Just by casually scanning, they had identified several inscrutable cultivators.
For example, the beautiful owner of the Hundred Fragrance Building, the keeper of the tea shop, and so on.
This meant that these individuals were also at the Unification level!
If there were cultivators of such great power hiding among common people, it would be alright. But for such a practice to be followed in the Seek Dao Sect too?
Vice Sect Leader Liu also noticed quite a few cultivators at the Refining the Void stage. The cultivation levels of those at the Refining the Void stage varied greatly, and at their peak, they could even exhibit Unification-level battle power.
As long as they did not make a move, it would be impossible for anyone to determine whether their current strength was high or low, making them incredibly intimidating.
"The hidden power of the Seek Dao Sect is too frightening..." they communicated secretly.
Going by this calculation, how many Unification-level cultivators could there be in the Seek Dao Sect?
"Who knows, maybe it's not just the Seek Dao Sect. Among the Five Great Immortal Sects, it's hard to distinguish who's superior or inferior. The other Four Great Immortal Sects may be stronger or not weaker than the Seek Dao Sect." Even though he was communicating through Spiritual Sense, Vice Sect Leader Gao also lowered his voice, as if he was afraid of being discovered.
"This is just a portion of the Seek Dao Sect."
They finally realized the huge gap between the Four Great Devil Sects and the Five Great Immortal Sects. They weren't even in the same league. No wonder they would hide or run whenever they encountered someone from the Five Great Immortal Sects.
If they didn't hide or escape, they would end up like them—either turned into ghouls or refined into top-level magic artifacts.
Vice Sect Leader Liu and his group had a strange feeling of déjà vu.
"Doesn't this method seem eerily similar to ours?"
...
Upon returning to Sky Gate Mountain, Yun Zhi left her physical body at the Abode, and her Divine Soul left her body.
"Eldest Senior Sister, you..."
Prior to Lu Yang finishing his sentence, he saw his Eldest Senior Sister's Divine Soul fly directly into his Spiritual Space, giving both Fairy Eternity and Lu Yang quite the scare.
"You—you—you scared me to death!" Initially, Fairy Eternity was lounging lazily in a soft chair, her jade legs crossed and eyes slightly droopy, she was thoroughly enjoying herself.
The sudden appearance of the Eldest Senior Sister scared her to the extent that she quickly stood up.
Eldest Senior Sister ignored Fairy Eternity's reaction and spoke to Lu Yang: "I know the location of the headquarters of the Eternity Sect, but if I go there rashly, I may startle the snake in the grass like I did last time, and the people might have fled by the time I arrive."
"This time, I'll first hide in your Spiritual Space. If you follow my instructions, you can get into the headquarters of the Eternity Sect and ensure that all the enemies are captured without any leaks."
Lu Yang felt like he could now play Fight the Landlord in his Spiritual Space.
He understood his Eldest Senior Sister's concerns, and this was indeed a good solution.
"What should I do?"
"First, go find Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu."
...
The Eternity Sect headquarters, in the Master's secret chamber.
Two rows of bookshelves stood on both sides, holding various precious elixirs, secret methods, techniques, etc.
Most of the elixir bottles were empty, the elixirs having been swallowed by the Master of the Eternity Sect for healing purposes.
At the end of the bookshelves stood a life-sized statue of an Immortal Eternity. It was impossible to distinguish its gender.
In the darkness, the Master of the Eternity Sect slowly opened his eyes, emerging from his meditative state.
He moved his limbs a little and sensed the still sluggish spiritual essence in his body, giving a bitter smile.
During the Sect entrance test, the sudden appearance of Yun Zhi from the Seek Dao Sect gave him such a powerful hit that he still hadn't fully recovered from it.
"Looking at this, could I really need to meditate for a hundred years?" The Master of the Eternity Sect felt somewhat worried about his future.
If he could fully recover his power only after a hundred years, then who would lead the Eternity Sect in the meantime?
Among the three vice-sect leaders of the Eternity Sect, Liu and Gao had their eyes on his position, while only Jin, the vice-sect leader responsible for organizing the entrance test, had not yet shown any desire for this position.
The Master turned his gaze towards the statue of Immortal Eternity, an expectant look in his eyes. He had a vague feeling that Immortal Eternity was starting to wake up.
He lit three incense sticks, placed them on the incense burner, and knelt down with hands joined in prayer, worshiping the Immortal Eternity idol three times.
"Great Immortal Eternity Sha Meless, please save your devout followers and save this world!"
"Who is calling this immortal?" An ancient and benevolent voice echoed throughout the secret chamber.
The Master raised his head, his eyes revealing frenzy and joy. His body trembled slightly, his fingers were shivering, and he was so excited he couldn't control his body.
Before his eyes, the statue's eyes emitted a strange red glow, and the incense smoke enveloped the statue, forming a cloud of smoke.
The smoke changed shape, gradually transforming into a benevolent old man.

chapters.title: Chapter 185 - 184: Immortal Eternity_1
chapters.content:
The Master had not expected that the Immortal Eternity would truly appear.
He indeed sensed the resurrection of the Immortal Eternity, but he did not expect that the Immortal would reveal himself so quickly. It was a completely unexpected delight.
The Master excitedly introduced himself, "Congratulations Immortal on awakening from the river of history. My name is Xie Bingzhi, I'm the Master of the Eternity Sect. The current era is three hundred thousand years from the era you know. Oh, you might not know about the Eternity Sect. We are one of the Four Great Devil Sects, aiming to awaken you from your slumber..."
The Immortal Eternity quietly listened to the endless introduction by the Master. He only chuckled twice after the Master had finished speaking, slowly saying, "Child, don't get worked up. Everything you just said, I already knew."
The Master cooled down, realizing that he had overstepped and acted improperly, "The Immortal knows everything."
The Immortal Eternity shook his head, "Don't exaggerate; who dares to claim they know everything? Even individuals like Ying Tian or Kirin can't be considered omniscient, let alone myself who has been removed from the world for three hundred thousand years. With the constant changes in the world, who could have foreseen what would happen today?"
A drop of golden liquid appeared out of nowhere in the Immortal Eternity's hand. With a flick, it landed in the Master's hands.
The Master could feel the terrifying life force contained within it.
"You have been hurt by a strong adversary and would need a hundred years to heal entirely. This drop of Eternity Liquid can help you speed up your healing process."
"Is, is this the legendary 'Eternal' Dao Fruit?" The Master's hands trembled, he was experiencing the power of an immortal for the first time.
The Immortal Eternity kindly smiled, "The Immortal Dao Fruit rarely comes out. It's just a little dew from the 'Eternal' Dao Fruit."
The Master immediately took it. As soon as the golden liquid entered his mouth, it transformed into a peculiar energy, filling every inch all over his body.
The Master could clearly feel that his injuries were healing at a faster rate.
He had heard that the Immortal Dao Fruit is the foundation of every Immortal, hardly revealed to anyone. The Immortal Eternity, who had saved the human race, was so generous, allowing him to glimpse a bit of the power of the Immortal Dao Fruit.
"I already know why you summoned me. The struggle between geniuses and the goal of becoming Immortal are timeless topics..."
The Immortal Eternity raised his hands in a relaxed manner, his eyes slightly closed, and filled with a hint of turbidity, as though he was recalling ancient events. He turned it into a deep sigh, shaking his head, refrained from commenting too much about the past.
He muttered, "Does the human race need my salvation once again...?"
The Master eagerly responded, "Immortal, the Great Era of Antiquity has returned. Cultivators from everywhere are awakening. If a war erupts, only your intervention can save the human race!"
"Well then, maybe saving the human race is my mission, so why not save it once more?"
The master was about to say something, but he was interrupted by the Immortal Eternity raising his hand, "However, now I only have my soul left, and my Dao Fruit is not perfect yet. I can only temporarily reside inside this statue. I can't protect you like I did at the end of the ancient times. If I want to return to my peak state, I need a body as a vessel."
"May I offer mine?" The Master offered willingly.
The Immortal Eternity shook his head, "Your body is already permanently formed, moreover, you have taken many wrong paths in your cultivation. It's hard to turn back. Opportunities to condense your Dao Fruit are slim."
"I heard that Yun Zhi from the Seek Dao Sect is renowned as the strongest among the Five Great Immortal Sects. Could her body serve as a suitable vessel?" The Master suggested again.
Immortal Eternity shook his head, "Heh, the strongest among the Five Great Immortal Sects? As far as I know, the Five Great Immortal Sects are only five sects with some foundations on the Central Continent. Apart from these, they aren't even on par with the Great Xia Dynasty that rules over the Central Continent."
"Under such circumstances, how strong can the strongest person from the Five Great Immortal Sects be to let me ascend once more?"
The Master promptly lowered his head in admission of his mistake.
"There's still time before the true outbreak of conflict in the Great Era. I have enough time to reach my peak state once again. I need a body that has just started cultivating. If I can use that body as a vessel, I can return to the realm of immortality. If I'm lucky, I might even surpass individuals like Ying Tian and Kirin to become the leader among the Five Immortals of the Ancients."
"When the time comes, and I choose to protect the human race, the risk of falling will greatly diminish."
"The Immortal understands."
"You go and gather all believers who are in the Qi Refinement stage and the Foundation Establishment stage. I will personally select who is qualified to be possessed by me."
"Yes."
"Immortal, I want to ask you a question."
"Child, ask."
"Who exactly turned the stars in the sky into continents?"
It was said that the Immortal Eternity witnessed this event that ended the ancient era.
The Immortal Eternity closed his eyes and shook his head, "Your cultivation level is too low, this is not something you should know."
The Master was somewhat disappointed, but he also admitted that he was far inferior compared to mortals.
Before leaving, the Master hesitated before asking, "Your name seems... Not like an ordinary name?"
What the Master really wanted to say was that he was running out of ideas for names and randomly fabricated the name "Sha Meless." Why would the Immortal have such a strange name?
The Immortal Eternity didn't say anything with a dark expression.
The Master realized that he asked the wrong question and excused himself.
...
After the Master left the secret room, he immediately summoned the three Vice-Masters and elders. However, only Vice Leader Jin arrived. He found out that both Vice Sect Leader Liu and Vice Sect Leader Gao had gone to the Seek Dao Sect with their Immortal treasures, risking their lives.
"They don't even care about their lives in the struggles for power?!" The Master clenched his teeth in frustration, guessing what these two fools were thinking. They simply wanted to establish a reputation within the Seek Dao Sect to vie for the position of master.
But why did you have to go to the Seek Dao Sect of all places?
Can you come back alive after entering?
"How long has it been since the Five Elements Sect visited the Seek Dao Sect?"
"Just half a day, we haven't received any updates."
The Master took a deep breath, "Don't wait for any news, they must have been caught by the Seek Dao Sect. Maybe the Seek Dao Sect already knows the location of our headquarters!"
"There's only one thing we can do now."
"Surrender?"
The Master was furious, "Surrender my ass! Have you ever seen a devil sect surrender to the righteous sect?"
"So going by this, are we making history?"
The Master resisted the urge to strangle this elder, saying, "Hurry and move our base to the fifth backup base!"
"Oh."
To prevent the location of the headquarters and backup bases from being revealed in case the upper echelons were captured, each Vice-Master was only aware of one backup base.
For example, Vice Sect Leader Liu knew the location of the third backup base, and Vice Sect Leader Gao knew the location of the fourth backup base.
It's been only two months since we moved from the second base to the third base, and it's all because of the Seek Dao Sect.
The Eternity Sect wasted no time in packing their belongings and heading for the fifth backup base.
The Master peeked into the secret room, "Immortal, should I move you, or can you move by yourself?"
Immortal Eternity: "..."
What's going on with this feeling of imminent danger?

chapters.title: Chapter 186 - 185: Eldest Senior Sister's Plan_1
chapters.content:
"Eldest Senior Sister, is this your plan?"
"Certainly."
"Vice Sect Leaders Liu and Gao only know about backup bases number three and four. The Eternity Sect will surely relocate to backup base five, whose location is currently unknown."
"So, the three of you need to deceive Tang Yunsheng. Earn his trust using the reason I provided. He will lead you to the former base. The Eternity Sect must have left their people there in hurry, to guide those who didn't receive the news to the new backup base."
"Your arrival with Tang Yunsheng will definitely attract the attention of the Eternity Sect. They will be suspicious of you and likely assume you have been captured by the Seek Dao Sect and are now working against them."
"But Tang Yunsheng is different. They know that he has always been lurking outside the Seek Dao Sect and will not be captured by it. He is trustworthy. If he leads you to the former base, the Eternity Sect will accept you, telling you the real location of the base."
"The final objective of the plan is to gain the trust of the Eternity Sect."
Fairy Eternity, listening on the side, kept nodding her head in agreement. She thought the idea was good.
...
Tang Yunsheng, hidden near the Seek Dao Sect's agreed meeting spot, anxiously awaited news from the Vice Sect Leader.
He watched as the Seek Dao Sect saw off the Five Elements Sect, but still saw no sign of the Vice Sect Leader. He was secretly dismayed.
"It's over, Vice Sect Leaders Liu and Gao have definitely been caught by the damned Seek Dao Sect!"
Tang Yunsheng waited a complete day before seeing the three people, including Lu Yang, fleeing in panic.
"Why is it only you three? Where are Vice Sect Leaders Liu and Gao?" Tang Yunsheng shook Lu Yang's shoulder.
Lu Yang's eyes were lost. When he heard Tang Yunsheng's question, his eyes welled up, his lips trembled, and he burst into tears.
"Vice Sect Leader Liu ... they failed! When Vice Sect Leader Liu produced the Immortal Treasures, intending to use his special powers, we didn't expect that there would be hidden masters in the Seek Dao Sect who could resist the power of the treasures. They fought Vice Sect Leader Liu!"
Meng Jingzhou, thinking of the horrible scene, also burst into tears: "Vice Sect Leader Liu and the others didn't surrender. They were killed by the damnable Seek Dao Sect!"
Man Gu was just crying, barely able to speak—he forgot his lines.
The three of them cried uncontrollably, clearly moved by real emotion.
"What!" Tang Yunsheng sat down on the ground, his face incredulous.
Both Vice Sect Leaders and five high-ranking officials fell at the Seek Dao Sect, how would he explain this upon his return?!
"Wait, why are the three of you okay?" Tang Yunsheng noticed an issue. The Vice Sect Leaders and the high-ranking officials had entered the Seek Dao Sect through their barbecue shop. The Sect would surely suspect them.
Lu Yang managed to calm down: "Vice Sect Leader Liu left an imprint in our minds, disguising us as puppets controlled by the Vice Sect Leader's powerful spiritual power. That's why the Seek Dao Sect let us go."
"Then you three should continue to hide in the Seek Dao Sect."
These are three valuable moles.
Lu Yang shook his head. "We have such a history, even if it's not our fault, people wouldn't accept us. Our business has hit rock bottom and there are pointing fingers everywhere. The Seek Dao Sect is no longer a place for us."
Tang Yunsheng patted Lu Yang's shoulder: "You three have had it hard."
Lu Yang's emotions were real, a trace of hatred flashed in his eyes as he continued: "Sacrificing for the Eternity Sect is nothing. But I can't let traitors go unpunished!"
"Traitors?"
Meng Jingzhou nodded forcefully, with a look of hatred and ferocity in his eyes: "How could they have failed with such a perfect plan and us conspiring from within the Seek Dao Sect? There must have been a traitor!"
"Just before Vice Sect Leader Liu fell, he secretly transmitted the identity of the traitor to us. He asked us to make it back to the Eternity Sect safely and expose the traitor!"
Tang Yunsheng's face turned grave: "Who is the traitor?"
This was no trivial matter. The assault on the Seek Dao Sect was a secret operation. Only a few people within the Sect knew about it, all of whom held high ranks and power. Any suspicion could lead to big problems!
Lu Yang revealed the identity of the traitor: "The third Vice Sect Leader, Vice Leader Jin!"
"It was him!" Tang Yunsheng's voice rose several degrees. He thought about it and found it made sense.
With only three Vice Sect Leaders and two gone, the position of Master would eventually fall to the last man standing.
Everything made perfect sense.
"Let's go. We must immediately report this matter to the Master!" Tang Yunsheng realized the severity of the issue. There was no time to lose, they had to set off immediately.
Now, these three individuals weren't moles anymore, but witnesses.
Tang Yunsheng led the trio onto a flying boat, heading south. They disembarked at a large metropolitan city and continued to a wilderness about three hundred miles from the city.
"Inspector Tang, is the headquarters here?" Lu Yang looked around for something resembling a Relic Blessed Cave. Was the former base located here?
A cruel smirk appeared on Tang Yunsheng's face: "You three ignorant fools, still wanting to go to the headquarters? Maybe before we get there we've already been assassinated by people sent by Vice Leader Jin!"
"Who can assure that this isn't the Master's intention? Maybe the Master, for the sake of the stability of the Eternity Sect, pinches his nose and admits to Vice Leader Jin's plan, and have us taken out."
"If we went to the headquarters, our fates would be uncertain and we'd be falling right into the trap!"
"I don't want to mix up in this high-rank struggle. Whoever gets involved is doomed to die."
"Now the safest thing is to kill you three little bastards and escape to a deserted place!"
Tang Yunsheng was very rational. Expose the mole? What does it have to do with him? As a demon cultivator, saving his own life is always the priority!
He could find a desolate place, kill the three of them and dispose of their bodies. Then he would not be connected to the Eternity Sect anymore!
He was at the Nascent Soul stage, killing these three Foundation Establishment Stage brats would be a piece of cake!
Lu Yang: "..."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Man Gu: "..."
This deviated quite a bit from the Eldest Senior Sister's plan. There was a problem at the second step.
Indeed, they had gained Tang Yunsheng's trust, but this didn't mean he was willing to take them to the Eternity Sect.
"What should we do, Eldest Senior Sister?" Lu Yang asked, via the spiritual space, was there a higher strategy?
Yun Zhi looked as aloof as ever. However, faced with Lu Yang's inquiry, her gaze fluctuated slightly before resting back on him. She spoke calmly.
