"It doesn't matter, everything is going according to plan."
The change in the Eldest Senior Sister's gaze was small, but Lu Yang, who had lived with her for a long time, was sensitive to such changes.
This was an obvious sign of uneasiness.
Lu Yang suddenly remembered some past events. For instance, when he was initially body refining, Eldest Senior Sister would bathe him with boiling water. Also, how she always made him practice with tofu, and how she regarded the requirements of the Laurel Fairy Palace as a marriage proposal.
Eldest Senior Sister is out of touch with worldly affairs.
She seems to have everything under control, acting composed and flawless. This illusion is solely because her facial expression remains the same from start to finish.

chapters.title: Chapter 187 - 186 Everything is Going According to Plan_1
chapters.content:
Fairy Eternity was furious, Tang Yunsheng, who was supposed to be her follower, didn't even have the most basic loyalty!
She fondly remembered the ancient times when she, as a powerful ruler, would have an entire planet of people devoted to her. They considered it an honor to be her followers and worshiped her words as gospel.
Lu Yang scoffed inwardly. This was the result of their worship of an imaginary perfect Immortal. If the Eternity Sect knew what the real Fairy Eternity was like, he had no doubt they'd all disband the very next day, loyalty be damned.
At the very least, Lu Yang, their founder, was contemplating resignation every day.
Not to mention the ordinary followers.
Wait a minute, why not change their approach and have Fairy Eternity resign instead? And have the entire Eternity Sect switch to a completely different belief?
The more Lu Yang thought about it, the more he liked this idea.
While Lu Yang was lost in his thoughts, he remained calm, knowing he was safe as long as Eldest Senior Sister was there.
The real issue now was how to deal with Tang Yunsheng.
To kill him would hinder their future operations; to spare him would mean their end. Quite the predicament.
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu didn't seem to be worried either. Before coming, Lu Yang told them that everything was within Eldest Senior Sister's plan, and nothing would go wrong.
Isn't "Eldest Senior Sister" more reliable than anything else?
Tang Yunsheng raised his hand, drawing out a broad cleaver from his storage space, wrapped in the souls of Fierce Ghosts. Seeing that Lu Yang and the others did not move, he assumed that they had lost the will to resist.
This was a normal response to absolute disparity in power.
Cultivators who resigned themselves to their fate like Lu Yang were exactly the type that Tang Yunsheng was all too familiar with.
Kill!
Tang Yunsheng exuded a bone-chilling aura. Just one look at him and you could tell he was a notorious major demon who had killed countless people.
With a malicious grin, he launched himself into the air, full of murderous intent, intending to eradicate Lu Yang and his allies with a single strike.
Just then, space in front of a large rock distorted, and the Master of the Eternity Sect, yawning lazily, stepped out from their backup base number five.
He decided to take a break, allowing others to sort things out inside the base.
He looked up to see Tang Yunsheng raising his bloody cleaver, leaping up high with the intent of killing the three on the ground, who were motionless, as if they were struck dumb with fear.
Master: "..."
Tang Yunsheng: "..."
The Master was full of questions. What on earth was going on?
"Tang Yunsheng, what the hell are you doing?!" The Master realized that now was not the time for questioning; he shouted and reached out, roughly grabbing Tang Yunsheng, whose bones creaked in his grasp.
"Wait, Master, I can explain..." Tang Yunsheng was panicked. Just his luck that he picked a desolate spot to execute his plan, and the Master sprung out of nowhere.
The Master didn't care for Tang Yunsheng's explanations; he forcefully scanned Tang Yunsheng's Spiritual Space with his Spiritual Sense, damaging Tang Yunsheng's consciousness and learning his memories in the process.
The Master wasn't exactly a benevolent character and was no stranger to harassment and violation of others' Spiritual Spaces.
Finally, the Master understood the whole situation.
The trio of Lu Yang had barely managed to infiltrate the Seek Dao Sect successfully, but their mission was fully compromised due to the actions of Liu Gao's two vice leaders.
To make matters worse, after Liu and Gao's failure, they informed them that Vice Leader Jin was a traitor. Faithful to the Eternity Sect, Lu Yang and his two companions came to the headquarters to report this, only to have Tang Yunsheng planning to kill them to keep them quiet.
"You bastard!" The Master squeezed Tang Yunsheng to death, furious. If it hadn't been for his accidental appearance, these three promising cultivators of the Demon Path who were dedicated to Eternity Sect would have died here!
In truth, Tang Yunsheng had already become a fool after his Spiritual Space was searched and violated. He was no different from a dead body.
"You three have suffered a lot," the Master consoled them. This was the first time he had met Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, and Man Gu.
Excellent men, the pillars of the demonic sect in the future, his most trusted subordinates.
Lu Yang: "..."
Lu Yang had heard Tang Yunsheng's dying exclamation of "Master". So, the man standing before him was the Master of Eternity Sect?
He just emerged from backup base number five?
Had they gained the Master's trust?
A string of questions arose in Lu Yang's mind.
Did they skip some steps? Why did they achieve their goal so soon?
In the Spiritual Space, Eldest Senior Sister remained undisturbed. She looked detached from the world as she said, "Everything is as planned."
Fairy Eternity looked at Eldest Senior Sister in admiration. This young lady was incredibly calculating and astute, something she could never achieve.
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu also believed that this was all part of Eldest Senior Sister's plan. They couldn't help but feel that Eldest Senior Sister was truly formidable - nothing seems to escape her calculation.
With Eldest Senior Sister present, they felt at ease.
Only Lu Yang held a strange expression, suspecting that these were all coincidences.
However, considering Eldest Senior Sister's capabilities, he deduced that even the coincidences were part of the plan.
Yes, Eldest Senior Sister's plans are flawless.
Originally, the Master considered Lu Yang and the others talented with great potential, ideal for Immortal Eternity to Possess, but he worried about them dying in the Seek Dao Sect. If they survived, they might be turned against the Eternity Sect by Seek Dao Sect, and couldn't be invited to participate in the testing.
Now that he had witnessed everything and had Tang Yunsheng's memories as assurance, all his doubts vanished.
"As for the matters concerning Vice Leader Jin, I hope that only the four of us will know about this," the Master believed that the claim that Jin was a traitor was concocted by Liu and Gao to bite back just before their deaths.
Fairy Eternity nodded.
Eldest Senior Sister nodded.
Fairy Eternity stopped nodding midway, frowning: "This man is weird, why do I sense a familiar aura from him?"
This aura was faint, and to discern it required a delicate feeling: "It feels like the Eternity Dao Fruit, but not quite. It's strange."
After hearing Fairy Eternity's whisper, Yun Zhi raised an eyebrow, thinking that the truth of Eternity Sect might be different from her imagination.
The Master personally led Lu Yang and the others into backup base number five.
At last, Lu Yang and his team arrived at the headquarters of the Eternity Sect. But the scene before them differed from their expectation.
They envisaged the Eternity Sect headquarters to give off a menacing aura, with a sense of terrifying atmosphere as though old major demons were lurking in the shadows, device secret plans.
But in reality, the members of the Eternity Sect were buzzing about, carrying bricks, sawing trees, constructing houses, and building altars. The place was a hive of activity.
The Master casually mentioned, "In order to avoid the Seek Dao Sect and remain safe, our Sect has recently relocated. Although everything has been moved here, it still needs some sorting out and construction."
"Your timing is perfect. We're about to hold an internal selection. Soon, a large group of cultivators at the Foundation Establishment Stage and Qi Refinement Stage will arrive here to compete. The best among you will gain the favor of Immortal Eternity."
"Alright, that's all for now. For the time being, you three can stay here. You will be notified when the selection begins. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have some matters to attend to."
With that said, the Master hastily left.
The Eternity Sect had run out of backup bases. He needed to choose three more, just in case.
He didn't rise to the position of Master solely relying on his cultivation level. Caution also played a vital role.

chapters.title: Chapter 188 - 187 Considerate Master_1
chapters.content:
Inside the spiritual space, two peerless beauties sat shoulder to shoulder. Each was unique in her grace, creating a pleasing spectacle.
Yun Zhi held a book, sitting quietly. She looked well-read, serene in her lack of worldly attachments.
Fairy Eternity, however, sprawled lazily, yawning in boredom - a picture of someone disconnected from the world.
"Kid, at our level, do you still need to read books page by page? Why not just scan them with Spiritual Sense and know everything right away?" Fairy Eternity, completely oblivious to her image, asked while yawning.
Lu Yang, observing from the sidelines, shook his head. Such a beautiful fairy, only if she were a bit sober.
Smiling, Yun Zhi shook her head, "Senior, there's something you may not understand. The greatest joy of reading a book is turning its pages one by one, never knowing what surprise the next page has in store. If we scan it using our Spiritual Sense, wouldn't the joy disappear?"
Fairy Eternity gave it some thought and felt it made sense, "So, what book are you reading?"
"'How to Be a Good Big Sister'."
"Quite a unique name."
"Yeah, I wrote it."
"..."
Lu Yang, not wanting to stir trouble but still unable to resist asking, said, "Eldest Senior Sister, aren't you bothered by Fairy calling you a kid?"
Fairy Eternity shot Lu Yang an angry look; was this something suitable for him, a teacher, to ask?
Yun Zhi gently nodded, her movements almost indiscernible, "Senior is right. Regardless of her having lived three hundred thousand years before us or considering her actual age, her calling me a kid is not wrong."
Perhaps a fool's courage allowed Fairy Eternity to muster her resolve, she contested, "Whoa whoa whoa. I can't let that slide. I'm only sixteen!"
Lu Yang chimed in, "Fairy, are you talking about your IQ or brain development?"
Fury erupted across Fairy Eternity's face as she challenged Lu Yang to a duel. He responded in kind but retreated to hide behind Eldest Senior Sister.
"If you're brave, come out!"
"If you're brave, come here!"
The two refused to back down.
While Fairy Eternity and Lu Yang bickered, Eldest Senior Sister quietly read her book.
Halfway through their quarrel, Lu Yang suddenly remembered, "Eldest Senior Sister, don't you need to go astral and explore the headquarters?"
Given their low cultivation levels, Lu Yang and the others dared not roam around the headquarters. But Eldest Senior Sister could leave her body and remain undetected by anyone.
In reality, all three of them were obediently cultivating and hadn't left.
Rolling her eyes, Fairy Eternity said, "Her? She's already gone astral. You're only seeing her clone that she left behind."
If not for the fact that it was only a clone left, Fairy Eternity wouldn't dare speak about Yun Zhi this way.
Lu Yang, "...Truly, no one can detect her."
That even meant himself.
...
The Eternity Sect had many powerful cultivators, each a dragon or phoenix among humans. Yet no one noticed a divine soul quietly observing everything inside the headquarters.
Yun Zhi, with her unfathomable cultivation, could easily come and go as she pleased within the Eternity Sect's headquarters.
She discovered that the Sect had meticulously laid out twenty-five exits in the headquarters. If a problem arose, the members could escape through these exits, making it difficult to capture everyone.
However, Yun Zhi had located all twenty-five exits and used her divine soul to lock on to them. The moment she made her move, nobody could escape through these exits. It would be like catching turtles in a jar.
She noticed the desolate Cave Heaven where the headquarters was situated. It should have been left from the Great Yu era and was accidentally discovered by the Eternity Sect.
Yun Zhi flew deeper into the headquarters and noticed a secret room at its deepest part. The room was heavily guarded with Array Methods to ensure no one could slip in unnoticed.
Except for Yun Zhi.
Upon entering, Yun Zhi saw the Master worshipping a statue of Immortal Eternity. From the statue, a thick cloud of smoke slowly emerged, gradually forming the figure of an old man.
"Hmm?" Yun Zhi frowned.
Neither the Master nor Immortal Eternity detected Yun Zhi, who had perfectly concealed her presence.
"Immortal, I have a question that I don't understand. I need your guidance."
"Child, ask."
"The ancient books say you relish blood and murder. We have killed many to please you."
"The souls of the dead are one of the sources of my power."
With a troubled expression, the Master said, "To help you regain your peak, we don't mind killing. But lately, it's getting difficult. The Righteous Path has been increasing its scrutiny, making it hard for our members to live."
"A few days ago, I even organized a criminal law quiz and held a talk about excluding illegal evidence. It was an effort to improve our members' understanding of law and control over it. This can help them leave less evidence if they commit a crime, and even defend themselves in case they get caught by learning criminal law."
Fairy Eternity scratched her chin, "You want me to organize a law lecture?"
"No. I noticed our members have poor learning skills and they aren't interested in learning criminal law. To enhance their enthusiasm, you could change your statue to one that holds a book of law. We can even publicize that you, Immortal, are a keen learner of law."
Immortal Eternity: "...Do you have anything else?"
"Yes, I wanted to ask if your power truly comes from killing humans. Possibly, we could kill other creatures. To be frank, my family used to run a slaughterhouse. Even though we aren't in that business now, we're familiar with the process. What do you think about transforming Eternity Sect into Eternity Slaughterhouse? This way we can go legal and ensure the members' safety."
"We also have three excellent barbeque chefs in the sect. Later on, we can open a chain of BBQ restaurants, connected to the slaughterhouse, forming a whole supply chain. It's a win-win situation!"
Seeing Immortal Eternity was about to say something, the Master continued, "Are you worried about tax issues? You can rest assured. I was targeted for evading a ton of taxes, which left me no choice but to turn to the Demon Path. I'm an expert when it comes to taxes!"
Quoting this, the Master was full of confidence, and his eyes shone brightly.
Immortal Eternity: "...Can I leave if there's nothing else?"
"Yes, there's one small matter."
The Master respectfully pulled out a few sheets of paper.
"What is this?"
"It's an evacuation drill plan. We've moved the headquarters, and members aren't familiar with the escape routes. We plan to conduct a large-scale drill soon where we assume that the Righteous Path is attacking and run immediately. Do you want to participate, Immortal?"
After a long silence, Immortal Eternity contemplated if he should come down and let the Master take his place as the idol.
"No, I can appear on my own statue at any time. The Righteous Path can't catch me. Also, please organize the test as soon as possible, so I can possess a body, start cultivating and return to my peak sooner."
"Oh."
...
"Hmm? She's back." Within the spiritual space, Fairy Eternity suddenly said. However, Lu Yang sensed nothing.
From Fairy Eternity's perspective, a golden light flew in from the outside and merged with Yun Zhi here.
Being an Immortal, Fairy had real skills.
Eldest Senior Sister put down her book. Her expression differed from before, her eyebrows creased, indicating she'd discovered something.
Looking at Fairy Eternity, she hesitated, "Senior, you've been tricked."
"What?"

chapters.title: Chapter 189 - 188: Exercise_1
chapters.content:
Eldest Senior Sister shared what she saw in the secret chamber, which greatly infuriated Fairy Eternity.
"Which son of a bitch dares to impersonate me? Don't they know that in ancient times, I was invincible and everyone had to walk around me!"
Fairy Eternity has the right to be proud. After all, cultivators who acquired the Verbal Spell are considered peerless among their equal, yet they died in her hands.
"I sensed a familiar presence on the Master, could it be from the person who impersonated me?"
The more Fairy Eternity thought about it, the angrier she became, shouting to go out and confront the Immortal Eternity, to expose his true face!
Yun Zhi stopped Fairy Eternity, "Senior, don't be impulsive. The person who claims to be Immortal Eternity can freely appear in the statues. If we let him escape, it will be difficult to catch him later."
"Then what do you suggest...?"
"When the Master and Immortal Eternity were talking, they mentioned a selection process. It's supposedly to select talents, but it's actually to select bodies for Immortal Eternity to possess. As long as we make Lu Yang the target, the Immortal Eternity will fall into our trap and he won't be able to escape."
Fairy Eternity was taken aback, "You've really thought this through, girl!"
"Hmm?" Yun Zhi raised an eyebrow.
Seeing that the whimsical fairy was about to anger Eldest Senior Sister, Lu Yang quickly made his exit.
Eldest Senior Sister wouldn't fuss over her title when she was in a dispirited state, but now that her spirit was intact, who knows.
Fairy, you better pray for yourself.
"But what is the real situation with Immortal Eternity?"
Lu Yang didn't expect that there would really be an Immortal Eternity. Was the fifth Immortal of the ancient times the Immortal Eternity or Fairy Eternity?
Emotionally, Lu Yang leaned towards the latter. In terms of pressure, Lu Yang leaned towards the former.
"Or was there a sixth Immortal in ancient times?"
Lu Yang opened his eyes, disengaging from his practice, and sensed his current realm.
"I should be at the Consummation realm of the Mid-stage Foundation Establishment Stage, just a half step away from the Late-stage Foundation Establishment."
"What are you saying?" Meng Jingzhou quipped from the side after disconnecting from his practice.
Man Gu contemplated, "Dividing the realm very meticulously might be one of the reasons for Brother Lu's strength, right?"
Meng Jingzhou quickly stopped Man Gu, "Don't speculate wildly, Lu Yang is just being quirky, you can't join him in that."
"You three, get ready for the practice exercise!" A cultist reminded the three at the door.
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu were confused. Practice exercise? What practice exercise?
The sound-amplifying array placed at various locations resonated, "Attention everyone, the Righteous Path is about to attack, attention everyone, the Righteous Path is about to attack!"
There were also some cultists outside, building tension by screaming, "The Righteous Path is here, we're finished!"
"Run quickly!"
"We'd rather die than surrender!"
"Let's fight with them!"
"Hahaha, you dogs of the Righteous Path, don't think you can catch me!"
"Bless us, Immortal Eternity!"
Then there was the sound of hurried escape.
Lu Yang: "...You guys are really into this."
Lu Yang quickly explained the situation of the exercise to Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu, and they finally realized what was happening.
The three of them hurriedly ran out of the room, shouting as they fled, "Not good, the forces of the Great Xia Dynasty and the Five Great Immortal Sects have invaded!"
The people in front of them glared at the three, "Stop shouting nonsense. If the people from Great Xia and the Five Great Immortal Sects are here, it's time to change it to a surrender exercise!"
It was clear that the Eternity Sect had a very fine classification of exercise types.
On the way to escape, Lu Yang saw a cultist competently packing things into a storage ring. The skilled movements were heartbreaking.
Some were crying bitterly, expressing their willingness to share the same fate as their headquarters.
Others took advantage of the chaos to steal stuff, making a fortune.
"Hey, what are you doing!" A cultist spotted a thief.
Without looking back, the thief replied, "It's a drill, right? The more real it is, the better. These are all possibilities!"
"Catch the thief!"
The Eternity Sect was in chaos, the drill was extremely realistic.
Lu Yang and his companions left with the rest of the sect members, heading towards an exit.
After emerging from the exit, they didn't know how far they had gone, but they ended up in a completely unfamiliar place.
Vice Leader Jin, who was the last one to leave the safe passage, sabotaged the exit and eliminated the causality, making it impossible for the righteous path to trace them. He did it all in one go, showing his frequent practice.
The sect members all applauded, happy about the successful conclusion of the rehearsal.
Only Man Gu had a doubt:
"How are we supposed to get back?"
The whole place suddenly fell silent.
Yeah, why did they cut off the passage this time when they usually didn't in rehearsals?
With the passage cut off and the causality eliminated, how could they return the same way? There was no doorway!
Vice Leader Jin was somewhat embarrassed. He got too absorbed in the rehearsal and acted as if the righteous path was genuinely approaching.
But as the Vice Leader, he quickly thought of a remedy.
"Everybody, don't panic. I have a flying boat in my storage ring that should accommodate us all. We'll fly back on that."
There were many experts inside the headquarters. Everyone, except a few like Lu Yang, could fly.
However, a large group of cultivators flying in the sky could easily draw the attention of the Great Xia Dynasty. A few constables from the dynasty could come to check, ask to stop, show their badges, and then find out that the flyers were indeed big shots on the wanted lists, all of them – at least – lifers.
That would be truly hilarious.
It's better to board the flying boat and pretend to be lower-level cultivators renting a boat for travel – a common occurrence that wouldn't raise suspicions.
Vice Leader Jin took out a somewhat outdated flying boat from his storage ring. It was deliberate. This kind of style wouldn't attract official attention.
Everyone was an old hand at this and understood Vice Leader Jin's intention. They all sat on the flying boat, hiding their cultivation level and appeared as Qi Refinement cultivators to outsiders. The Lu Yang trio turned out to be the cultivators with the highest cultivation level as they were at the Foundation Establishment Stage.
Vice Leader Jin comforted everyone on the flying boat, "Actually, it's not a big problem. According to the speed of our boat, we will return almost the same time when the Foundation Establishment and Qi Refinement geniuses from our various branches arrive. The timing is just perfect."
...
The flying boat was floating leisurely in the sky, blissfully unaware of the impending danger.
Not far from the flying boat, three mysterious men in grey robes were hovering.
"What about this flying boat?"
"It's not from the Land Money Trade Association or other big trade associations. It looks very old; it must be a rented one."
"There are many people, but their cultivation levels are mediocre, just three at the Foundation Establishment Stage. We might as well kill them; maybe someone is hiding something valuable."
"Shall we rob them?"
"Let's do it!"
The three men in grey robes turned into streaks of light and quickly approached the flying boat. They formed an array trapping the boat.
"Don't move. This is a robbery!" one of them, bearing two scars on his face, looked brutal and reckless.
"You must have heard of the cruelty of us Hu Brothers. Hand over your valuables, and we promise not to kill!" another man stuck out his long tongue, licking his pointed blade – he was somewhat perverse.
"If you refuse to hand them over, don't blame us for being ruthless!" The third one was making ghastly noises, like a ghost crying, rather creepy.
"Don't think we dare not kill! We've killed more people than you've ever met!"
They unleashed terrifying auras to intimidate everyone.
Each of these three was at the early stage of the Nascent Soul Stage.
Generally, as soon as they release their auras, the other party would give up resistance, hand over the valuables, and beg them to spare their lives.
Whether to spare them or not would then depend on their mood.
But then, the Hu Brothers saw that the passengers on the flying boat weren't scared at all. Instead, they all started giving out weird smiles.
The passengers started to reveal their cultivation levels one by one: Nascent Soul Stage, Spirit Transformation Stage, Refining the Void Stage...
The Hu Brothers, feeling the aura that was beyond their comprehension, swallowed nervously.
It was over. It seemed like they had messed up.
Vice Leader Jin rose, and casually asked, "Did I hear right? You've killed more people than we've ever met?"

chapters.title: Chapter 190 - 189: A Figure of Great Reputation_1
chapters.content:
"What are you guys up to?" The Hu Brothers stammered with quaking fear.
Vice Leader Jin wore a standard cold sneer: "Do you know who we are?"
"No, we don't."
"Not even aware of us, you deserve to die!"
The Hu Brothers quickly responded: "No no no, we do know you guys."
"Since you know our identity, we can't let you live!"
The brothers were on the verge of crying, unsure whether they should know their identity or not.
Vice Leader Jin no longer toyed with the Hu Brothers, he casually killed them.
The brothers were just a minor hiccup on the journey.
After their flying boat traveled a while longer, several strong auras enveloped the boat, ranging from half-step Divinity Transformation Stage to early Divinity Transformation Stage.
"The Hu Brothers were supposed to report to us at a designated point, but they failed to do so. You were the only ones passing by during that time. Did you kill my minions?" The older of the Hu Brothers sought revenge.
Lu Yang pondered: "So this is what they call 'After hitting the little ones, the older ones come'?"
Lu Yang had heard of such legends before. A young hero fights against a local bully, who then summons his father. Once the father is defeated, the grandfather appears. Once the grandfather is beaten, the great-grandfather shows up. An endless cycle of relatives ensues.
Lu Yang was deeply moved by this relentless spirit.
Needless to say, the older brother of the Hu Brothers was also casually killed by Vice Leader Jin.
Again, the flying boat traveled for a while and more formidable auras enveloped the boat than before.
"You are the ones who killed..."
Vice Leader Jin interrupted: "... aren't you guys ever going to stop?"
As a great power at the unification stage, he couldn't tolerate repeated provocations. He decided to take decisive action, directly assaulting the bandit lair and wiping them out.
...
When the flying boat returned to headquarters, Vice Leader Jin held a brocade flag with a look of complete despair on his face.
The brocade flag was official, so no one suspected that Vice Leader Jin was with the demonic sect—who would expect a demonic sect to remove a menace for the people?
When the followers learned of this, they murmured among themselves, expressing unprecedented respect for Vice Leader Jin.
"As expected of the Vice Leader, even earning the commendation from the Righteous Path, truly a man with reach in both worlds!"
"Indeed, I heard that before joining the demonic sect, Vice Leader Jin was quite the figure in the Righteous Path!"
When Lu Yang heard this, he was quite surprised. He quickly inquired, "He has such a background? What did the Vice Leader do in his years in the Righteous Path?"
"He was a night watchman."
"..."
"So, Vice Leader Jin could control the timing when he was in the Righteous Path, right?" It took a while for Lu Yang to come up with this question.
The follower chatting with Lu Yang gave him a surprised look: "Well, we've never considered this angle!"
This believer ran to Vice Leader Jin and shared Lu Yang's speculation, which cheered Vice Leader Jin up. He found Lu Yang and praised him for his open-minded thinking.
"Good idea! From now on when people ask, I'll say I was quite the figure in the Righteous Path, and I controlled the time of an entire city's people."
The most important thing in the Demon Path is to tell the truth and make yourself seem as powerful as possible.
Although Lu Yang had caused trouble during his own initiation test, that was the past. The more Vice Leader Jin saw of Lu Yang now, the more he liked him.
Due to the delay en route, the Foundation Establishment Stage and Qi Refinement talents had mostly arrived, with Lu Yang's group among the last to arrive.
Lu Yang ignored the Qi Refinement talents as they posed no threat; he focused on the Foundation Establishment Stage talents.
Through introductions from bystanders, he became familiar with some of the most famous Foundation Establishment Stage talents.
"See that monk dressed in a monk's robe, hair and beard in disarray, holding a golden bowl? He's called the Drunken Meat Monk. It's said he initially had a chance to enter one of the Five Great Immortal Sects, the Suspension Temple, but he resolutely gave up the opportunity. He made an enormous vow to find his own way to enlightenment!"
"Also, the guy brandishing the sword over there, could it be the rumored Knife Devil Gu Zha? The story goes that his demonic blade is extremely eerie. The moment it was forged, it suspended itself in the air, killing the blacksmith. The several owners of the demonic blade were all killed by it, including those at Divinity Transformation Stage. Gu Zha is the only one who's been using it all this time!"
"The most fierce is Yan Fei. Everyone says he's a genius personally groomed by the Master. He specializes in drawing talismans and he's even trapped several Golden Core Stage cultivators with his talismans. He toyed with them, manipulated them and finally killed them. His methods are extremely cruel!"
It goes without saying, all three talents are at the late stage of Foundation Establishment.
Lu Yang messaged the other two: "Let's keep our distance for now and act like we don't know each other. We're still unclear about the nature of the test, let's see if teaming up would be beneficial."
Only the Master and several other top-level individuals were familiar with the deep-rooted demonic nature of Lu Yang and his group. None of the Foundation Establishment talents had heard of them.
The Master appeared in the air, hands clasped behind his back, his expression indifferent as he announced the competition rules.
Everyone discovered that a marking had appeared on their hand with a "one" in the middle without realizing when it had appeared.
"For this test, you are free to fight each other to the death. Whoever you kill, you will gain the digits on their marking."
"The one with the most digits on their marking will be the final victor, and will receive the blessing of the Immortal Eternity."
Everyone had a crazed look in their eyes. Aside from Lu Yang's group—the fake believers—everyone else were true devotees of the Immortal Eternity. To receive the blessing of the Immortal Eternity was the greatest reward in the Eternity Sect.
"Foundation Establishment Stage and Qi Refinement Stage will be grouped separately. Each group will have one winner. The duration of the test is two days."
Lu Yang thought it was just like the demonic sect to make their tests life-or-death challenges. He wondered if they were not afraid of killing all the participants in one fell swoop, leaving no one to succeed them.
The Master waved his sleeve, and without room to resist, everyone disappeared from their original location and appeared in a dense forest.
"This is a woodland from the era of Great Yu, filled with various heavenly treasures and earthly riches. You can fight each other or search for these treasures and use them to break through."
"Remember, the Immortal Eternity is watching you." The Master gave everyone a pointer, but only Lu Yang understood his true meaning.
"The competition starts now."
After announcing the start of the competition, the Master respectfully asked the Immortal Eternity why he chose this method to select the one to possess. Wouldn't it be more convenient to select directly based on aptitude?
The Immortal Eternity smilingly responded: "Child, what do you think is the key to becoming the strongest? Single Spiritual Roots? Immortal Bodies? None of these are important."
"Even if someone has defective spiritual roots, as long as I am willing, they can become Immortals after being possessed and reaching the Transcendence Tribulation Stage."
"The most important thing is the level of compatibility with me."
"One's potential is best reflected in a life or death situation. What I need is for them to fully display themselves, so I can observe and choose who will be the most compatible lucky one."
The Master asked again: "What are the characteristics of the most compatible one?"
"The one who pleases me the most."
"So, do you like me?"
"You are the one I dislike the most."
"But I am your most devoted follower!" The Master protested.

chapters.title: Chapter 191 - 190: Great Opportunity! _1
chapters.content:
Blood-curdling battles could be seen everywhere in the dense forest. Again and again, they sent shivers down people's spines.
The actions of the Demon Path were ruthless and their schemes were endless. Everyone was going all out, fully expressing their own talents and instincts.
The Monk of Wine and Meat, Knife Devil Guzha, and Yan Fei were undoubtedly the hot favorites. Besides these three, there were many others who, while unremarkable in ordinary times, stood out in this test.
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu's performances were notably striking. Quite a few people had fallen at their hands, either pierced by iron fists or smashed by huge hammers.
The fame of these two was rising, and more and more competitors were coming to know these two ruthless figures, not wanting to run into them.
Their fists and hammers were smeared with blood. They exuded a sinister aura from head to toe, their eyes were blood-red, giving off the impression of ruthless killers.
Man Gu's blood lineage of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe was further aroused. In the ancient times, wars were constant. The Ancient Barbarian Tribe, being one of the most powerful tribes at that time, went through countless blood battles and oppression... as well as sorcery from Yellow Bean.
"These two have never been mentioned before. Where did they come from? Looking at their strength, they are comparable to the Monk of Wine and Meat. Look, even the Monk of Wine and Meat doesn't want to confront them and stays active in other areas!"
"Probably they have obtained some inheritance or they are the seeds secretly cultivated by the Elders!"
"It's just not known who is superior between these two." Discussions about Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu were going on both inside and outside the venue.
Meng Jingzhou's iron fists were invincible, exploding a Foundation Establishment mid-stage competitor with one punch. The opponent was somewhat of a famous figure.
Meng Jingzhou was now at the mid-stage of Foundation Establishment. As a disciple of the Seek Dao Sect, and the direct line of the Meng Family, once he left the Seek Dao Sect, he was invincible among those of the same level.
Words of the Saint were sounding around Man Gu. He didn't blink an eye, smashing one person after another with his hammer, giving him a freakish look like a maniac.
Finally, the two crossed paths, their eyes filled with rebellious unyieldingness, neither willing to submit to the other.
Man Gu raised his hammer and bellowed, "State your name!"
"Meng Jingzhou! Who are you?"
"Man Gu."
Both men were people of few words. They didn't talk much and started fighting directly.
Both of them were the cream of the crop in the Foundation Establishment Stage and the top seed candidates. The moment they engaged, the whole ground shook. As the remnants of the battle hit the trees, they snapped in half, crumbling instantly.
Other competitors watched not far away, hoping that these two would both end up hurt, allowing them to take advantage.
The number of imprints in these two's hands was very high. Whoever could kill them could seize their imprints.
That was a wealth that tempted everyone!
The Monk of Wine and Meat and Knife Devil Guzha observed in secret, their hearts filled with shock.
"The threat of these two is no less than Yan Fei's!"
"Very powerful! But they are still inferior to me. I still have some tricks up my sleeve. I have seen through these two."
"I didn't expect to encounter such strong opponents in addition to Yan Fei and the Monk of Wine and Meat. What an assembly of hidden talents!"
"Just right! The Demon Blade is thirsty. The blood of those weaklings cannot satiate the Demon Blade. The blood of these two peerless geniuses is just what the Demon Blade craves!"
"Ha, ha, ha! This battle is invigorating! It's been a long time since I've had worthy opponents for a fight!" Meng Jingzhou burst out laughing.
Man Gu was equally excited. The blood of his Ancient Barbarian Tribe was boiling and burning within him.
During their fight, another ancient tree fell. After the ancient tree broke down, a Bodhi tree appeared in front of the two of them.
On the Bodhi tree, three baby figures swayed in the wind. The Bodhi tree had the effect of pacifying the heart and gathering spirit, making this scene very sacred.
Meng Jingzhou was shocked, "Is it a ginseng fruit tree!?"
"Ginseng fruit?" Man Gu was equally shocked.
With a sacred treasure before them, both men decided to cease their fight.
"Is this the rumored ginseng fruit tree?" Man Gu was skeptical.
Meng Jingzhou nodded, "No doubt, look at these three chubby babies growing on the tree. Isn't this the legendary ginseng fruit?"
Man Gu continued asking, "But how can ginseng fruit grow on a Bodhi tree?"
Meng Jingzhou took on a you-lack-experience look, "You don't know, the ginseng fruit is rare, you can't find a ginseng fruit tree in the world? This is because there is no ginseng fruit tree in the first place!"
"Ginseng fruit is spawned from the harmony of the rhythms of heaven and earth and only appears on other trees. When a tree gathers the essence of heaven and earth, ginseng fruit naturally grows."
"Among the many trees, the Bodhi tree is the most mystical and the most suitable tree for the growth of ginseng fruit!"
Man Gu finally understood, he had not expected this layer of meaning.
Ginseng fruit was before them; that was a major opportunity. There was no need for the two to fight anymore. Even if it was one fruit per person, there would still be one left.
Originally, not many people recognized the ginseng fruit. But after listening to Meng Jingzhou's reasoned analysis, they felt this was indeed ginseng fruit.
They remembered what the Master had said that there was a major opportunity in this dense forest.
Could it be these three ginseng fruits?
"Charge!"
The hidden crowd rushed out, vying to pick a ginseng fruit!
Knife Devil Guzha threw a cow hair needle. Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu sensed the hidden weapon and leapt backward to dodge this strike.
The two of them were now some distance away from the ginseng fruit, giving the others a chance.
Even if the competitors included Meng Jingzhou and the Monk of Wine and Meat, they had to take a gamble at this point.
If one could get a ginseng fruit, from then on, the path of cultivation would be smooth.
It was worth risking one's life!
Knife Devil Guzha was the first to grab one. He didn't hesitate, picking and running.
"Is this the ginseng fruit? It feels like meat, no wonder it's called ginseng fruit!"
Everyone else regretted and chased after him, but Knife Devil Guzha had a better pace. Here in the dense forest, it wasn't long before he left everyone behind.
Only by refining could it truly belong to oneself. Adhering to this principle, Knife Devil Guzha took a bite.
It didn't work.
"Could it be that the ginseng fruit feels like meat, but it becomes incredibly hard once you want to eat it."
As he pondered how to ingest the ginseng fruit, his expression suddenly changed.
"Not good, it's poisonous!"
He showed a look of disbelief, the surface of the ginseng fruit was highly poisonous!
Who did this? This is ginseng fruit after all! This manner of using poison is simply a waste of precious resources!
At this point, the ginseng fruit opened its mouth and said, "Hasn't anyone ever told you not to randomly eat wild fruit by the wayside?"
While Knife Devil Guzha wore a face of regret, the ginseng fruit began to move.
Lu Yang, three inches tall, stretched lazily. After playing the role of a ginseng fruit for so long, he was glad to finally move.
This was a new technique he had realized — size reduction, distance shortening, and operating the Tree-Planting Sutra.
This way, three mini Lu Yangs would grow on the Bodhi tree. After a bit of propaganda by Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu, his disguise was complete, turning him into a ginseng fruit.
He also applied a layer of highly toxic substance to his body.
Anyone who could grab the would certainly have a high cultivation level, so he was sure that poison would always work.
"And you call yourselves of the Demon Path? You are so easy to cheat." Lu Yang shook his head in disgust and killed Guzha.
The standards of the Demon Path in this generation were just too low. The three of them on the Righteous Path were even able to play tricks on the Demon Path.

chapters.title: Chapter 192 - 191: Demon Sword_1
chapters.content:
The mark in Lu Yang's palm read "one". Gu Zha's mark read "eighty-seven". After Lu Yang killed Gu Zha, his mark changed to "eighty-eight".
"So this is that notorious demonic saber? All previous owners were killed by it, with Gu Zha being the temporary exception?"
It was clear that Gu Zha had no sense of morality. He carelessly tossed things about, and it was Lu Yang who retrieved them.
The demonic saber was dark red. The hilt appeared to be made from the horn of some giant Demon Beast, and a deep red gem, looking like an eye, was embedded where the hilt and blade connected.
Apart from its odd shape, Lu Yang couldn't find anything particularly special about it.
"Well, this saber is quite interesting, with Flood Dragon's horn as the hilt, refined steel as the blade, and the dark red gem is actually the eye of a Demon Beast named 'Fei'."
Fei, a powerful Demon Beast that lived in the wilderness, had a body like a bull, a white head, a single eye, and a snake-like tail.
Fairy Eternity finally began to play her role as the golden finger, introducing to Lu Yang the extraordinary aspect of the saber.
"The materials of this saber are excellent. If forged correctly, it can develop Spirituality. However, the skill of the forger was not good enough, creating only a shell without imbuing the saber with Spirituality."
"Even as a shell, it's still a rare magic artifact."
"The saber inherently craves Spirituality. Thus, it is bloodthirsty and inclined to kill. The more it kills, the more likely it is to develop Spirituality."
"How do I become its master?"
"It can recognize its owner based on a drop of blood," Fairy Eternity advised. "However, I would not suggest you do that. This saber is insatiably greedy. After you become its owner, the more blood you feed it, the more it will want to devour you. But if you don't feed it blood, it will still try to devour you."
In ancient times, there were also magic artifacts with similar characteristics. Fairy Eternity had seen many self-proclaimed geniuses who thought they were special and could tame such artifacts. Looking at the results, only a few were successful.
"I see." Lu Yang finally understood why several previous masters of the demonic saber were killed by it. The demonic saber, in essence, did not want its owner to live. "But it's indeed an interesting saber."
"The reason why Gu Zha was not devoured by the demonic saber was just because he hadn't held it long enough for it to fight back."
Lu Yang asked again: "If the demonic saber develops Spirituality, what will its quality be like?"
Fairy Eternity disdainfully replied: "It's hardly worth serving as my footstool."
Lu Yang acknowledged her response, it seemed the quality of the demonic saber was not good.
The Eldest Senior Sister did not utter a word all this time, quietly reading her book.
She believed that with their abilities, winning the competition should not be difficult for the three of them.
During their conversation, the mark on Lu Yang's palm changed again, from "eighty-eight", it bounced twice and turned into "one hundred and thirty-one".
The monk was targeted and couldn't get a Ginseng Fruit. The two somewhat famous participants at the Foundation Establishment Stage who got the fruits were poisoned to death, without exception.
The other two Ginseng Fruits were also poisoned. But now they were too far away for Lu Yang to feel the status of his clone in the Ginseng Fruits.
Lu Yang dismissed his Clone state, returning to his original height.
He put the demonic saber into his Storage Ring and started looking for his next target.
He had prepared the Storage Ring prior to this, considering he couldn't be blatantly using the Seek Dao Sect's Identity Jade as a Storage Ring in the Eternity Sect's territory.
"Hmm? Whose blood is this?" Lu Yang noticed a few fresh drops of blood not far away. It seemed like someone injured had been here, leaving these traces while escaping.
"Let's follow it."
After being injured, one's fighting capability would naturally drop. This presented an easy score.
As expected, as Lu Yang closed the distance with the injured person, the bloodstains became more apparent, going from a few drops to a large stain. It was clear that the person was seriously injured.
Finally, Lu Yang found the injured person—it was the monk!
At this moment, the monk opened his hand, gripping a person's neck. With a snap, the person's neck was broken.
"Another one swallowed the bait." The monk showed a cruel smile.
During the Ginseng Fruit fight, he acted as if he were overwhelmed and injured, running away. His act attracted several participants, who were all killed by him in turn.
"What can I do? I'm infamous. If I didn't do this, I wouldn't find anyone." The monk explained through laughter.
As one of the top three seed-selected candidates, others would run away from him immediately, he naturally would not get a chance to fight.
It's better to show some weakness and lure the fish onto the hook.
The drunken monk gave a light click of surprise, "You look familiar, but it doesn't matter who you are. Meeting me is clearly your bad luck!"
He found Lu Yang familiar because the Ginseng Fruit and Lu Yang looked almost like father and son. However, the drunken monk made no connection at the time.
Grasping his fist, muscles strained, the bleeding wound quickly healed. Then he pulled out a golden bowl aiming to catch Lu Yang.
In silence, Lu Yang took out a demonic knife from his storage ring, squatting on the ground, he touched the blood left by the drunken monk.
The demonic knife instantly recognised the drunken monk as its master.
The demonic knife floating in the air, made a hissing sound, stabbing toward the drunken monk.
Perhaps it was because the demonic knife had never seen such a generous master and it wanted to give him a warm hug - with its knife edge.
The drunken monk was shocked and horrified - where did the demonic knife come from and why was it stabbing at him?
The golden bowl, which had followed the drunken monk for a long time, was pierced in that instant, putting the drunken monk into a difficult fight.
Lu Yang tutted, "With this level of skill, doesn't look like you could grab the attention of the Suspension Temple."
The Suspension Temple, being the one with the least number of people among the Five Great Immortal Sects, would only recruit gifted disciples. With the drunken monk's talents, he could barely become a handyman of the Suspension Temple.
"The Suspension Temple claims that everyone has the chance to enter. I naturally had the opportunity to enter the Suspension Temple, it's just that I gave up that opportunity!" The drunken monk spoke in the midst of his battle.
"...You sure know how to give yourself some gold."
The drunken monk was useless, couldn't beat the demonic knife, and his heart was pierced by the demonic knife in an instant.
The demonic knife had lost its master again.
"What a pity, its master passed away immediately after recognizing it."
Lu Yang picked up the demonic knife and continued on his way.
"Blood Floods Yellow Spring!" Someone targeted Lu Yang for a sneak attack!
A bloody ocean surged toward Lu Yang, carrying the scent of blood, identifying its contents on one sniff.
Lu Yang calmly took out the demonic knife again. As a Sword Spirit Root, he naturally loved swords, and grasping the sword technique was not difficult.
He used the newly created sword technique.
"Recognizing Owner Saber Technique!"
The demonic knife slashed at the bloody ocean, like a shark attracted by the scent of blood, shining with a strange red light, again killing the person who had tried to ambush Lu Yang.
"Surging Blood Palm!"
"Recognizing Owner Saber Technique!"
"Bloody Skull!"
"Recognizing Owner Saber Technique!"
As expected of a demonic sect, the magic skills they learned were either related to fierce ghosts and skeletons, or to fresh blood and lost souls, which were very suitable for the demonic knife to choose a master.
Lu Yang, relying on the single technique "Recognizing Owner Saber Technique", became unbeaten throughout the land.
Unfortunately, every master of the demonic knife was curse-stricken, none lived beyond three seconds before they were backlashed.
Lu Yang shook his head regretfully. He just wanted to find a master for the demonic knife. Why was that so difficult?
"Such a good magic artifact, none of you are fortunate enough to deserve it."
More and more people became aware of Lu Yang's existence. Rumours spread that Lu Yang had become the master of the demonic knife, recklessly killing people, being even more ruthless than Gu Zha.
Some had also noticed Lu Yang's resemblance to the Ginseng Fruit and, associating it with the poisoned people, speculated the Ginseng Fruit was a scam.
In the dense forest, after the demonic knife as usual killed a master, Lu Yang ran into Meng Jingzhou.
Meng Jingzhou glared at Lu Yang, grinding his teeth.
"Great job at masquerading as the Ginseng Fruit and fooling everyone!"

chapters.title: Chapter 193 - 192: Heavenly Desolate Immortal Method_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang has such a formidable reputation, it isn't just the newcomers wishing to make their mark in this competition who are in his shadows, even the fame of Yan Fei, the successor of the Sect Master, is eclipsed by him.
He pretended to be a ginseng fruit, fooling everyone. Subsequently, wielding his Demon Sword, he struck fear into everyone's hearts. No one knew how many digits the number in his palm held, but it was definitely certain that it was a terrifying number.
Meng Jingzhou is truly capable, unafraid of Lu Yang's formidable reputation.
"Heh, I hear your Demon Sword kills at first sight of blood. If that's true, I just need to avoid getting hurt."
Lu Yang raised an eyebrow, "You talk big, state your name!"
"Meng Jingzhou!"
"Ah, so it's you. I've heard of your matchless prowess at Foundation Establishment Stage and your impeccable body refining skills that leave many body cultivators in awe!"
Meng Jingzhou snorted coldly, "You're not too bad yourself, Lu Yang, the Sea of Blood Sword Demon. Your fearsome name is enough to hush a child's crying. Everyone says your strength surpasses that of Yan Fei, is this true or false?"
"Try and find out!"
"Then let's try!"
The battle between the two potential winners drew not only the attention of the hidden competitive participants but also the higher-ups of the Eternity Sect who were curious to know, out of the two, who would turn out to be superior?
Would it be the crafty and cunning Lu Yang or the upright Meng Jingzhou?
The Master and Vice Leader were secretly twitching. If they hadn't known beforehand that these two were in cahoots, they would have actually believed that the two were strangers.
They indeed play their parts convincingly.
Finally, the Vice Leader Jin had to concede that the Master had a keen eye — and it's no wonder that one was said to be a natural demon, and the other was said to be akin to a demon reincarnate.
If someone were to say that these two were moles put by the Righteous Path, he wouldn't believe it.
Oh right, there was also Man Gu.
Yan Fei, who was hidden among the trees, watched the two do battle, preparing himself as if he were about to face a great enemy. Both of these individuals could be his rivals — more threatening than the dead Monk of Wine and Meat and Gu Zha.
Lu Yang wielded his sword like a sabre, making his sabre techniques unstoppable. Meng Jingzhou's body refining skills were impeccable, leaving no room for defects. The minute they made a move, they could even challenge those at the Golden Core Stage.
The participants watched with bated breath, deeming the two to be monsters.
In the end, Lu Yang had the upper hand and defeated Meng Jingzhou.
Knowing he was outmatched, Meng Jingzhou retreated before he could get hurt. Everyone sighed in disappointment — if Meng Jingzhou had been injured, they could have all attacked him at once.
By killing Gu Zha and the Monk of Wine and Meat, and defeating Meng Jingzhou, Lu Yang's fame reached its peak, unrivaled by anyone else.
Lu Yang once again demonstrated his sabre skills, killing countless contestants. Even Man Gu, who never knew what fear was, fled far away from Lu Yang upon seeing him, refusing to engage him in a direct confrontation.
Just when everyone assumed Lu Yang would emerge as the most powerful competitor, Meng Jingzhou returned to the fight.
Meng Jingzhou appeared vibrant and unfazed by his previous defeat.
"Lu Yang, let's battle again!"
Lu Yang sneered, "You incompetent warrior, do you still dare to mention fighting to me? Die!"
As he swung his Demon Sword down with massive force, intending to split Meng Jingzhou into two, the crowd gasped— this was an all-out attack from the start!
Last time Meng Jingzhou lost because of this move!
Just when the crowd thought that one attack would settle the match, Meng Jingzhou went against his usual manner and blocked the blow.
Lu Yang realized Meng Jingzhou was different, he put away his arrogant demeanor and fought with all his strength.
The power of Meng Jingzhou surged compared to last time, and he fought toe to toe with Lu Yang.
"Huff...huff... seems like you've encountered an extraordinary opportunity!" Lu Yang suddenly came to a realization— Meng Jingzhou had grown stronger and there was only this one explanation.
This fight gave Meng Jingzhou great confidence, "Not bad, I've just entered the door and my strength has already surged. It's worthy of being Six Unions…"
Realizing he'd made a slip of the tongue, Meng Jingzhou quickly shut his mouth.
Listening to Meng Jingzhou's incomplete sentence, Man Gu fell into deep thought, murmuring to himself, "Six Unions? Could it be, the legendary 'The Immortal Skill of Six Unions and Eight Wastes'?!"
Everyone quickly pressed Man Gu for information about the technique, but instead of answering, Man Gu fled.
"'The Immortal Skill of Six Unions and Eight Wastes,' could it be the legacy of Immortal Eternity?" Everyone whispered among themselves. The idea was hard to resist when the word 'Immortal' was in the technique.
The fight between Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou ended in a draw. Both of them knew they wouldn't be able to determine a winner if the fight continued, so in silent agreement, they departed.
After disappearing for a full day, Meng Jingzhou reappeared with an even more powerful aura than before.
He went straight for Lu Yang, who was wearing his cloak.
To everyone's surprise, Meng Jingzhou's strength had surged again, allowing him to defeat Lu Yang!
The Heavenly Desolate Immortal Method was truly fearsome!
"Die!" Meng Jingzhou shouted, his palm piercing through Lu Yang's chest.
Blood gushed from Lu Yang's mouth, his life-force draining quickly.
As tough as Lu Yang was, he wouldn't die instantly, but his death was now a foregone conclusion, and nothing could change it.
"Haha, well-done, Meng Jingzhou. You managed to gain the biggest opportunity!"
Lu Yang's face twisted into a contortion of bitterness, likely unwilling to die like this.
He took out an old book from his bosom, and at the sight of it, Meng Jingzhou's pupils constricted.
"How can the Immortal Method be with you? You stole the Immortal Method while we were fighting!"
There was an uproar among the crowd. Lu Yang had stolen the Immortal Method during the fight. What kind of trick was this? Was it the legendary art of the empty-handed thief?
Immediately after, everyone's mind started racing. The Immortal Method was in the dying Lu Yang's hands, didn't it mean that anyone could possibly obtain the Immortal Method?
As blood gushed from his mouth, Lu Yang laughed, "It's just a pity that I was fated to steal the Immortal Method but had no chance to cultivate it."
"If that's the case, then I'll reveal the Immortal Method and see what advantages you, Meng Jingzhou, still hold!"
Lu Yang tossed out the Immortal Method, using the blood as words, he formed the full content of the Immortal Method in mid-air!
An enormous opportunity was handed to them!
Meng Jingzhou was furious and quickly scattered the blood characters, preventing the Immortal Method from spreading.
But it was too late, everyone were cultivators at the Foundation Establishment Stage and had photographic memory. One glance is all it took for them to remember the entire content.
Lu Yang laughed heartily and drew his last breath.
Meng Jingzhou was livid, but there was nothing he could do.
Everyone dispersed, trying to find a safe place to cultivate the Immortal Method.
"Why am I not getting stronger after cultivating the technique?" Someone wondered. Didn't Meng Jingzhou become much stronger after using it?
"Did I cultivate it wrong?"
Hidden in the dense forest, Lu Yang and the other two gathered together, closing their eyes and sensing everyone's location.
This was not an Immortal Method at all, but rather a tracking technique. As long as someone cultivated it, Lu Yang and the others could discern their locations.
Now, everyone had hidden separately, making it the perfect opportunity to strike them one by one!
The three of them moved together, killing each contestant they encountered from the nearest to the farthest, and the number of their imprints escalated rapidly.
Yan Fei, who had not started cultivating yet, felt something was amiss, so he found Lu Yang's lifeless body, uncovered the hood, and it turned out to be the bald-headed Lu Yang.
An avatar of the Bodhi tree!
Everything was a hoax!
He quickly judged, "Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou are in cahoots!"
"There's no such thing as 'The Immortal Skill of Six Unions and Eight Wastes.' Man Gu is also with them!"
…
In the distance, the Sect Master, who saw everything, wore an odd expression.
Even he, as the head of the Demon Path, thought that these three were deceitful.
…
Inside the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity saw that the Eldest Senior Sister was lost in thought and asked curiously, "What are you thinking about?"
Yun Zhi sighed, "I'm wondering, are these three really not going to get beaten to death?"
Yun Zhi wasn't worried about whether Lu Yang and the others could win the championship. What she was concerned about now was whether they would get beaten to death before the championship ended.

chapters.title: Chapter 194 - 193: Unification!_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang spent several months on the first floor of the Scripture Pavilion in order to devise his own method of cultivation, casting aside the "Encyclopedia of Crosstalk" he found an array of impressive cultivation methods and magic skills that widened his horizons.
For instance, a skill that once mastered, would allow one to track the location of another. It was developed by a couple who were both cultivators, intended for monitoring each other's whereabouts.
Then, the husband discovered that his wife frequently visited the brothel, and the wife found out that her husband often did the same.
Aside from this method, Lu Yang also saw a method for sleeping with open eyes, very useful during lectures.
There was a method that could make oneself extremely ugly, Lu Yang couldn't figure out the usefulness of this one.
A method for hibernation that emulates animals. Eat once, sleep for a quarter. Lu Yang also couldn't figure out the purpose of this one.
Later, Lu Yang understood. These were methods develoed by his Senior Brothers and Sisters for racking up contribution points.
Handing over a method with no duplicates to the Task Hall would earn you contribution points. Eldest Senior Sister once did this task on her own, forcing the Task Hall to create a dedicated column for her. There was no need to repeatedly hand in methods, just write it out and place it in the Scripture Pavilion. She could use contribution points freely.
The other Senior Brothers and Sisters didn't have Eldest Senior Sister's talent, but they wanted contribution points, resulting in many seemingly impressive but essentially useless methods in the Scripture Pavilion.
Lu Yang wondered whether he would be hung up and beaten by Eldest Senior Sister if he also wrote such methods.
Oh, probably Eldest Senior Sister wouldn't need to lift a finger, the puppet could do it for her.
"The Immortal Skill of Six Unions and Eight Wastes?" Fairy Eternity recalled something when she heard the name Lu Yang made up.
"The name seems similar to Immortal Jiuchong's method!"
"Immortal Jiuchong?" Lu Yang repeated. Fairy Eternity seldom mentioned about Immortal Jiuchong.
From Fairy Eternity, he knew that Immortal Jiuchong was an Immortal body, and also the first among the Five Immortals of the Ancients to become an Immortal.
"What's the name of his method?" Lu Yang wondered.
Eldest Senior Sister also showed a rare interest, put down her book, and listened to Fairy Eternity's answer.
"Immortal Jiuchong wrote the method himself, he named it 'The Immortal Skill of Chaotic One Energy, Two Instruments, Four Images, Six Unions, Eight Desolations, Nine Lands, Ten Heavens, and Only I am Supreme'."
"I usually refer to his method as 'Digital Immortal Skill', sometimes people also call it 'Four Six Immortal Skill', 'Eighty Immortal Skill' or anything they find convenient. Anyway, even Jiuchong can't remember the full name of his own method."
Lu Yang: "..."
Does Immortal Jiuchong have some sort of obsession with numbers?
Eldest Senior Sister also seemed at a loss. Originally, she had hoped to infer the opponent's strengths and weaknesses from the naming of the method.
Now it seems she had been overly optimistic.
While listening to ancient oddities in the Spiritual Space, Lu Yang roamed about killing people with Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu.
Just then, they heard Yan Fei's shout.
"Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, and Man Gu are together!"
Yan Fei did it deliberately. The pressure from the trio was too great. Even though he was strong, he couldn't beat these three strong and cunning bastards.
He must gather everyone's strength to take down these three.
Only then would he have a chance to win!
"Exposed so soon?" Meng Jingzhou thought the exposure would be later. He hadn't had enough fun yet.
The three of them opened their palms to check the numbers on their imprints. The one with the least, Man Gu, had 350. Needless to mention Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, they were simply matchless demons, killing like mowing grass.
"What should we do, fight or run?" Man Gu asked.
"Run, of course. With our score, the top three spots must be ours. We just wait for it to end." Meng Jingzhou said, without the slightest sense of honor as a direct descendant of the Meng family. He felt no guilt for suggesting to "run away".
This had all been the result of being chased like ducks by their father for being naughty when they were young.
"They are here!" Someone stepped out of their abode and saw the three of them together.
These three are indeed together!
They even managed to keep up their act from the start of the competition. If it weren't for Yan Fei's suspicion, no one would have found out.
It's an utter disgrace. As cultivators on the Demon Path, they were always the ones deceiving others. When did it become others' turn to deceive them?
And they were deceived round and round!
If they didn't kill these three to vent their anger, their future cultivation would be impeded!
"Run~" Meng Jingzhou shouted joyously, spearheading the escape, with Lu Yang and Man Gu following suit.
"Catch them up!"
"They are here!"
"Kill them!"
Demon cultivators rarely work together, let alone mobilize large-scale Foundation Establishment Stage cultivators, this is unprecedented.
They were united, determined to capture these three!
The high-ranking members of the Eternity Sect watched this scene, amazed, for even they did not have such a compelling appeal.
The Master privately agreed, these three were tailor-made to infiltrate the Seek Dao Sect undercover. He felt it a pity that his two deputies, Liu Gao, were incompetent, letting such important chess pieces leave the Seek Dao Sect.
"If we're really chased down, you'll act as bait," Lu Yang said to Meng Jingzhou.
"Why should I? This whole scheme was your idea, you do it!"
"I thought of the idea, you added the details, you are more important than me, you go!"
"The idea is more important than the details, you go."
Both were mutually conceding, each suggesting the other as bait, while Man Gu was unable to get a word in on the side.
He was just a performer.
"I've caught up with them!" A tracker with exquisite footwork was almost touching the hem of Lu Yang's robe.
At this moment, an unseen attack hit him. He didn't have time to dodge and was sent flying, a large chunk of his chest caving in.
As he closed his eyes, he saw that his previous position was empty, with only a talisman fluttering.
"What's this?"
The talisman fluttered, seemingly conscious, and sent all the opponents approaching them flying.
Someone finally saw what the talisman was.
"It's an Invisibility Talisman! These three have helpers!"
This Invisibility Talisman was painted by Lu Yang. Its effects were powerful, and none of the sensitive ones at the scene had felt anyone turning invisible.
The shouting person soon realized something was wrong. Whose Invisibility Talisman only makes the body invisible, leaving the talisman out in the open?
Lu Yang shouted to the Invisibility Talisman: "Yan Fei, kill them quick!"
"Yan Fei is in league with them too?!" Everyone was shocked. Was Yan Fei pretending to discover the plot of the three, was this part of the trap?
Yan Fei, who had been watching the tigers fight all along, had been annoyed to the point of crooking his nose. He was eighty feet away from the scene, and the person with the Invisibility Talisman was definitely not him!
"I get it, the one with the Invisibility Talisman is your avatar!" Yan Fei remembered Lu Yang had a Wooden Avatar trick.
Someone fast and nimble had taken off the Invisibility Talisman, revealing the person in hiding.
Bald-headed Lu Yang, the Bodhi Tree avatar!
Lu Yang's Invisibility Talisman could only hide the body, not clothing, and the Wooden Avatar was covered with tree leaves, which were part of the avatar.
In other words, the wooden avatar was naked.
This was perfectly suited to Lu Yang's Invisibility Talisman!
The Bodhi tree avatar, decked in leafy attire, was like a savage. Lu Yang controlled the avatar to explode, releasing poisonous gas.
Yan Fei was well prepared for this, calling a north wind to disperse the poison gas.
"Kill!"
Lu Yang and his companions were surrounded entirely, with countless hidden weapons and weapons thrown, aiming to make them hedgehogs. Some even directly attacked, intending to kill the trio.
The attack was relentless, impossible to resist!
Lu Yang sighed, "At this point, we can only unify."
The three looked at each other, setting a certain kind of determination, they wanted to fight as one!
"Unification?" Although Yan Fei didn't know how they intended to unify, he had a bad feeling.
"Don't underestimate them, they will unify!" Yan Fei roared, warning everyone.
Even the high-ranking members of the Eternity Sect were puzzled, they had never heard of cultivators being able to unify?
Man Gu shouted loudly with his muscles bulging. His left hand grabbed Meng Jingzhou's ankle, and his right hand grabbed Lu Yang's ankle.
Meng Jingzhou used his magic skill, and his body radiated a faint golden light, exceptionally hard.
Lu Yang clapped his hands together, reaching over his head and wrapped himself in Sword Qi.
The three unified!
Yan Fei: "...?"

chapters.title: Chapter 195 - 194: Child, What Is Your Wish?_1
chapters.content:
Not to mention that Yan Fei was confused, even the high-level members of the Eternity Sect were also stunned.
Is this the popular fighting style of the younger generation? Are they unable to keep up with the times?
Man Gu swung Meng Jingzhou and Lu Yang in circles, repelling all hidden weapons and attacks.
"Strange tactics, everyone, attack!" Yan Fei shouted, taking the lead with others following suit, swarming forward.
Even if it takes a great number of people, they would overwhelm them!
"Unification Secret Technique——Giant Windmill!"
The three of them shouted together, and Man Gu, holding the two, spun rapidly.
Now Man Gu held the sturdiest blunt weapon and the sharpest cutting tool. He could attack and defend as he wished!
Most importantly, the blunt weapon and cutting tool could hit people on their own, they were highly intelligent.
Meng Jingzhou used the Shocking Heaven Six Forms, swinging his fists, leaving opponents bruised and battered, with bones broken and flesh torn.
Lu Yang used his hands as swords, casting Sword Qi, invoking the Single Character Sword Technique, as if wielding a towering sword, ruthlessly reaping enemies' lives.
This simple yet effective cooperation consisted of Man Gu spinning, Meng Jingzhou swinging his fists, and Lu Yang waving his palms. Each of them did their own thing without affecting the others.
Yan Fei's soft armor was torn open after being hit by Lu Yang's Sword Qi.
If it weren't for the soft armor, he would have already been bleeding!
The Unification technique, which seemed absurd, was actually very powerful.
Man Gu transformed into an ancient Demon God, wielding the Yin and Yang, killing in and out of the crowd. Other players were either smashed to death by Meng Jingzhou's head or chopped by Lu Yang's Sword Qi.
Having suffered badly, Yan Fei dared not fight in close quarters.
Other people, seeing this, were also planning to run away. Revenge was great, but one had to be alive to do it.
However, there are two issues. First, all the kills had to be credited to Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
The second problem was that it was very easy to get dizzy.
"Urgh—" The three of them felt nauseous.
Despite the training, the training duration was too short and the high-intensity spinning exceeded their tolerance.
While feeling nauseous, Lu Yang comforted the other two, "I heard that our dizziness is caused by weird human body reactions. Once we reach the Golden Core Stage and can control our organs, we can use this technique repeatedly!"
"Urgh—is that true?" Meng Jingzhou doubted Lu Yang's words.
"In theory, yes, we will try when we reach the Golden Core Stage."
When the crowd saw their poor condition, they rushed up again.
The trio changed their strategy. When someone attacked, Man grabbed onto Meng Jingzhou's ankle, Lu Yang grabbed Meng Jingzhou's neck, and the two used Meng Jingzhou as a shield to block the attack.
Upon seeing the success of this technique, Lu Yang and Man Gu pursued and attacked with Meng Jingzhou as their shield.
"Hey hey hey, you two have gone too far, this wasn't part of the plan!" Meng Jingzhou yelled. Even though he was physically strong, it was still painful to absorb the attacks.
The two put Meng Jingzhou down.
When several people attacked from the same direction, Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu each hoisted up one of Lu Yang's thighs. Lu Yang took out his magic saber, together they faced several opponents. Similar to the way a snake hisses, their attacks were both fast and ruthless, keeping the upper hand.
Suddenly, Lu Yang's eyes narrowed, and with a spring in his step, he left abruptly, rushing towards Yan Fei.
It was this brat who kept messing with us!
"Ignorant!" Yan Fei was not afraid of Lu Yang, fully aware that he would be no match for the three of them attacking simultaneously, but now Lu Yang was alone, and trying to kill him?
Yan Fei pulled out his jade flute, his Life-bound Magical Treasure capable of launching sonic attacks.
Hu——
Yan Fei blew his jade flute, aiming to kill Lu Yang.
Lu Yang's body sank, disappearing into the ground and evading the attack. The tree behind him was cut in half. The cut was smooth, one could only imagine the kind of wound this attack would inflict if it hit a person.
"Earth Escape Technique!" Yan Fei was taken aback. He didn't expect Lu Yang to know this extremely difficult Five Elements Magic Skill.
"Where will he appear?!"
Yan Fei quickly turned around, guessing that Lu Yang would attack from behind.
Unexpectedly, the ground under his feet cracked, a Bodhi tree erupted from the soil, with two Lu Yang clones perched in its branches.
Lu Yang and his clone simultaneously left the Bodhi tree. The clone unleashed Tiger Fist, transforming into a gorgeous tiger, pouncing on Yan Fei. Lu Yang, holding his magic saber, horizontally slashed at Yan Fei.
At this kind of distance, he could freely control his clone.
The Tiger Demon Lu Yang was fierce beyond comparison. Lu Yang's blade swept disdainfully, and in close combat, Yan Fei simply had no time to blow his jade flute!
"Grow bigger!" The jade flute grew to eyebrow height, waving in Yan Fei's hand, blocking the attacks from Lu Yang and his clone.
The jade staff spun extremely fast, making a whistling sound.
Lu Yang swiftly tilted his head, avoiding the invisible sonic attack.
This was another way to use the jade flute!
"Interesting idea!" Lu Yang sneered, but unfortunately, he was already prepared, and this move posed no threat to him.
This move was considered a child's play in the Seek Dao Sect, nothing more than a display. It was only someone like Yan Fei, who lacked experience, who would consider such a thing as a method of attack.
Moreover, in the face of absolute power, did he, Yan Fei, still think he could create a ripple?
Outside the Seek Dao Sect, Lu Yang was confident that he was invincible during the Foundation Establishment Stage, let alone two of him?
Lu Yang used magic blade to execute swordsmanship.
The Tiger Demon roared, spit out human language.
"Slash Mantra!"
"Tiger Descending the Mountain!"
The two attacked from different directions, tearing Yan Fei to shreds.
The magic blade recognized its new master instantly and devoured him instantly, making Yan Fei the shortest-lived master.
...
Vice Leader Jin saw this scene and asked the Master, "Didn't you say Yan Fei was your successor? Aren't you going to intervene?"
The Master scoffed, "Successor? That's just a role Yan Fei cast for himself. Through various hints, he makes people think he's my heir, thereby gaining various benefits."
"Aren't you going to penalize him?"
"Why should I? If he has real skills, what if I admit that he is my disciple? If he doesn't, then like today, if he dies, he dies."
Yan Fei was not yet outstanding enough to warrant the Master's serious attention.
"Have you chosen the person who is privileged to be the one you will possess?" the Master respectfully asked the Immortal Eternity.
The Immortal Eternity had already made a choice, "Lu Yang."
"This person is ruthless and cunning, with exceptional talent and roots, barely qualified to be the subject of my possession."
That being said, Immortal Eternity actually considered Lu Yang as the perfect candidate for possession.
The Master was somewhat reluctant. Lu Yang was the most suitable demon cultivator he had seen since becoming Master, but unfortunately, he had now been chosen by the Immortal Eternity.
However, being chosen by the Immortal Eternity was his honor, it was a profitable deal to exchange one Lu Yang for the Immortal Eternity to regain his peak.
"Bring him to the secret room."
"Yes."
The Master stood in the air, releasing a pressure: "The competition is over. Lu Yang has the highest Palm Imprint, ranking first, and is fortunate to receive the blessings of the Immortal Eternity!"
Lu Yang's excellence was clear to everyone, despite this, the other participants were disappointed since they just missed the blessings of the Immortal Eternity.
"Lu Yang, come with me." The Master beckoned, causing Lu Yang to take flight and brought him to the entrance of the secret room.
The Master cautioned Lu Yang, "The blessings of the Immortal are of great importance. Enter the secret room, and you will understand what I mean."
"Yes."
Lu Yang had a smile on his face that didn't seem forced, which made the Master nod in secret.
Indeed, he was a devoted believer of the Immortal Eternity.
Lu Yang walked into the secret room and found that the Eternity Sect was extremely poor. The secret room was pitch black, and there wasn't even a light.
Suddenly, three sticks of incense were lit under the statue of the Immortal Eternity. The smoke from the incense sticks rose slowly to form the figure of a kind old man.
"Child, come here." The kind old man beckoned to Lu Yang.
Seeing the kind old man, Lu Yang was very excited, "You, you are..."
The kind old man nodded with a smile, "Yes, just as you guessed."
"Are you really the Spirit of the Statue?"
Immortal Eternity: "..."
"Child, I am the Immortal Eternity. If you have any wishes, you can tell me, and I will help you fulfill them."

chapters.title: Chapter 196 - 195 The Fledgling Shape of Eternity Dao Fruit_1
chapters.content:
"Are, are you really an Immortal, an Immortal Eternity?" Lu Yang trembled all over, his hands fluttering aimlessly, his lips couldn't stop curling up, extremely excited.
"Child, don't be so excited, this Immortal is right here," The Immortal Eternity said, her face warm, "You are the first place in this competition. The Qi Refinement group performed well, but not as good as you. You truly deserve the first place."
"As a reward, this Immortal will grant you a wish."
"A wish? Are there any restrictions?"
"Just state it, this Immortal can do anything."
"I wish for the world to be at peace forever."
