"Choose another one?" The Immortal Eternity tentatively said, admitting that her previous statement was a bit exaggerated.
In order to possess Lu Yang, she had to obliterate his soul, but his soul was rooted in his physical body. Even if extracted, its roots would remain, causing the possession to be incomplete and detrimental to future cultivation.
The best way was to fulfill his wish, so that the roots of the soul would fall off and she could complete the possession perfectly.
She thought that Lu Yang was only at the Foundation Establishment Stage and an independent cultivator at that, so what could his wish possibly be? At most, he would want an Immortal Treasure, she could give him that because she could take it back after possessing him.
"I wish that everyone can become an Immortal."
"..."
This wish was even more absurd than the previous one.
"I hope that productivity can be greatly developed so that people can obtain resources without labor and freely choose what they like to do."
"...Choose another one."
Are you here to join the demonic sect or planning to overthrow the Great Xia dynasty to establish a new one?
Lu Yang looked at the Immortal Eternity with some disappointment. This Immortal was not really capable, she couldn't grant any of his three wishes.
The Immortal Eternity was provoked by Lu Yang's look, but she knew that this matter could not be rushed.
"Child, your wishes are all related to the world, don't you have any personal wishes?" The Immortal Eternity guided patiently. As long as Lu Yang answered that he wanted to become an immortal, she would have a reason to possess him.
Becoming an immortal with your body also counts as fulfilling your wish!
"Yes, I wish to cultivate to the realm where I can create the world and reshape the universe."
"..."
Could you make your wish a little bit smaller?
If I had that capability, would I still be here trying to sweet talk you?
Seeing that the Immortal Eternity was incapable, Lu Yang had to settle for the second best.
"I have an Eldest Senior Sister whose cultivation level is extraordinary. I wish I could defeat her."
"Hahaha, this is a trifling matter. I could easily suppress her." The Immortal Eternity burst into laughter. Finally, there's a simple wish.
It's just a senior sister in the Foundation Establishment Stage, how high can her cultivation level be? He, as the magnificent Immortal Eternity, could suppress such a little girl easily, couldn't he?
"Once I take possession of your body, I will suppress that little girl for you!"
"Possess?!" Lu Yang's pupils shrank. He did not expect that the promised blessing from the Immortal had turned into possession.
He turned around and ran, trying to escape from this hellhole.
"Give up. If you can escape right before my eyes, where should I put my face!"
Lu Yang felt the dreadful pressure from the Immortal Eternity, as heavy as a mountain, and despair surged in his heart.
Would the outcome change if he hadn't won?
Would the outcome change if he hadn't made a wish?
Would the outcome change if he hadn't joined the Eternity Sect?
Panic, regret, fear... all kinds of emotions surged into his heart, but it was too late.
Seeing Lu Yang's expression, the Immortal Eternity couldn't help sneering, transformed back into thick smoke, and flew into Lu Yang's spiritual space.
Then she received a slap on her face.
Slap—
The crisp sound of a slap resounded, and the Immortal Eternity was sent flying by a slap.
"So it was you, this bastard, who was impersonating this fairy?" A certain unruly woman set upon Immortal Eternity punching and kicking.
If an outsider who didn't know the situation saw this, it would seem like a depraved young girl beating up a centenarian.
"Let me tell you, back in ancient times, even Ying Tian and the other three didn't dare to act like this. Who do you think you are!"
"Impersonating this fairy, did you kneel down and worship, did you give any offerings, did this fairy nod in approval?"
"Who is this person!" Immortal Eternity was a bit stunned, he didn't even understand what had just happened when he was already slapped by someone.
Why are there other people in this spiritual space? Is everyone lining up to possess this boy?
"You don't even recognize me grandaunt, and you have the audacity to wander around outside?" Fairy Eternity had long been displeased with him. Parading around with the title of "Eternity" and swindling people, while she, the genuine one, was either looked down upon by Lu Yang or bullied by Yun Zhi. It was absolutely miserable.
Finally waiting for the Immortal Eternity to come in, she would be able to give him a thorough beating!
She had never seen what Immortal Eternity looked like before; he was not a person she recognized.
"Fairy Fist Technique," Fairy Eternity made up a name, her girly fists rained down. Each hit struck the Immortal Eternity.
Although the fighting style seemed random, it was actually exquisitely profound. Each strike was inscrutable.
Immortal Eternity felt each strike hitting his weak points. Although he was in a soul state, he felt like he was about to spit out blood and kneel. He felt that his soul was about to dissolve into nothingness.
Where did this monster come from?
"This is too much!" The Immortal Eternity was furious. He held the Eternity Dao Fruit. Ever since he was revived, he had been worshipped by the Eternity Sect. He was granted whatever he wanted and everything was going smooth for him. When had he ever suffered such humiliation?
"Immortal for eternity!"
The Immortal Eternity roared in anger. A golden glow appeared in the palm of his hand. The glow was so brilliant that it was hard to open the eyes.
This golden light was neither material nor soul, but something beyond.
It held some strange power that led people to feel as if it could demolish anything, and any attack that hit him would be nullified.
"Eternity Dao Fruit's embryonic form?" Fairy Eternity was surprised, finally realizing where the faint familiar aura on the master came from.
This guy who was impersonating her indeed had some skills.
"You've got a good eye, woman. This object is the Eternity Dao Fruit, before which, I the immortal, forever unchanging, forever young, forever invincible. I'm the one and only immortal throughout eternity. All kinds of fate are reduced to nothingness, all attacks turned into nothingness. Your attack can't harm me at all!"
With the Dao Fruit, the Immortal Eternity became confident.
Yellow Bean let out a sneer: "It's just a clumsy imitation of me. What's there to be proud of?"
"Fairy Fist Technique!"
Yellow Bean swung her fists about again, breaking the barrier that the Immortal Eternity took great pride in with a single punch. Her fists didn't lose any force and landed square on his face.
"The embryonic form of this Dao Fruit is indeed interesting." Fairy Eternity conveniently took the embryonic form of the Dao Fruit, and the golden substance appeared in her hands. She observed it with great interest.
In the golden substance, countless inscriptions and rules appeared and disappeared, as if explaining the meaning of eternity.
Lu Yang, curious, tried to take a look, but was pushed away by Fairy Eternity: "Off you go, you're not in the realm yet to look at these things."
"You, what have you done?!" Immortal Eternity panicked. Originally, there was a close relationship between the Eternity Dao Fruit's embryonic form and him, even stricter than the integration of the soul. By logic, no power should be able to separate it.
But now, he couldn't feel the connection with the Dao Fruit's embryonic form!
He completely lost control of the Dao Fruit's embryonic form!
Who was she! How did she manage to do this?!
"Showing off your Dao fruit in front of this fairy, it's like showing off your skills in front of an expert." Fairy Eternity laughed smugly.
And then, another ethereal voice came, resonating in the Immortal Eternity's ears.
"I heard you want to suppress me?"
Only then did Immortal Eternity notice that besides Lu Yang and the mysterious woman who took his Dao fruit, there was a third person in the Spiritual Space!
Just how many people are there in this Spiritual Space?!
Do you have to wait in line for possession nowadays?

chapters.title: Chapter 197 - 196 Why are there so many people in your Spiritual Space!_1
chapters.content:
If in one's spiritual space there were two souls, an original one and a stronger one, it could be explained that the stronger soul temporarily has no intention of Possessing.
But when there is already a third soul in your spiritual space, isn't that a bit over the top? Does a spiritual space need to be that lively?
Now, with her added, there were four souls in the spiritual space.
Immortal Eternity, with his limited exposure, had never heard of anyone having four souls in their spiritual space.
Yun Zhi closed her book and quietly watched Immortal Eternity.
Following the idea of respecting the old and loving the young, she had allowed Fairy Eternity to make the first move.
Now, it was her turn.
"Even without the Dao Fruit, this Immortal is still invincible!"
Immortal Eternity snapped out of his apathy, regained his confidence, and engaged in a duel once again.
"Demonize the world!"
Boundless black Demonic Air gushed out of Immortal Eternity, countless major demons surged in the Demonic Air, carrying horrifying screams, engulfing the entire spiritual space, advancing towards Yun Zhi.
Yun Zhi did not even glance at it, raising her jade arm, the golden bell tied to her right wrist jingled.
Her voice was icy, just like a fairy in the silent moon palace.
"Cloud Falling Palm."
As a palm was launched, white clouds emerged from behind Yun Zhi as if an ocean was surging, engulfing the black Demonic Air. Suddenly, the white clouds transformed into sky-filling waves that flushed over Immortal Eternity.
Immortal Eternity felt like a mere stone in front of the vast rivers, insignificant without any ability to resist.
"Netherworld Undying Flame!"
"Eighteen Golden Bell Covers!"
Red-black flames ignited from Immortal Eternity's chest, rapidly spreading to form a layer of membrane on his body. Eighteen golden Bells descended and covered Immortal Eternity, one upon another, trying to block the attack. The waves surged, ruthlessly assaulting Immortal Eternity.
One after another, the eighteen layers of the golden bell cover shattered, and as the red-black flame-formed membrane collided with the seawater, it was evaporated. Immortal Eternity, bearing the leftover energy of the attack, was thrown to the edge of the spiritual space.
Yun Zhi rose from the chair, stepping lightly. With each step, a lotus bloomed, and she approached Immortal Eternity.
"Stop! Stop! I order you to stop!!" Immortal Eternity shouted loudly. His confidence was shattered by the previous attack.
"Rock-shattering Titanium Hand!" A huge hand made of fog dropped from the sky. This strike could shatter mountains, crack the earth, and destroy precious treasures. It had a long-established reputation in the Cultivation World.
Yun Zhi raised her hand and gently waved it, and the immense foggy hand dissipated.
"Defeat Tribulation Immortal Body!" Immortal Eternity displayed his magic spell.
If it were in the outside world, the magic spell body would be thousands of feet tall, standing tall and erect, picking up the stars was nothing difficult. Any attack would feel ticklish on the magic spell body, not harmful at all. However, the attack of the magic spell body could destroy everything and was unstoppable.
Due to the limitation of the spiritual space, Defeat Tribulation Immortal Body was not fully displayed, but the power of the magic spell remained undiminished.
"Die!" Immortal Eternity gritted his teeth, wanting to smash Yun Zhi.
Without even lifting her head, Yun Zhi simply swiped her hand a couple of times, and the terrifying magic spell body was annihilated.
"Falling Red Lotus!"
"Reverse Five Elements Kill Array!"
"Slayer Buddha Fist!"
"Daoist Control Talisman!"
Immortal Eternity did not hold back anymore, doing his utmost, using palm methods, fist methods, array methods, talismans... various attacking methods were employed continuously, showing profound skills, as if having been earnestly studied for hundreds or thousands of years.
If a common cultivator saw these attacks, they would have long since lost their nerves. However, in front of Yun Zhi, these attacks were not enough.
Lu Yang's spiritual space seemed to have turned into her domain. As long as she lightly waved her hand, similar to shooing away flies, all attacks disappeared.
"Nowhere near the level of an Immortal." Yun Zhi evaluated Immortal Eternity's series of attacks, implying not just their lack of power, but also their lack of perspective.
The same attack, if Fairy Eternity had used it, it would've had a better effect.
"Have you learned the ancient attacking techniques?" Yun Zhi observed that although Immortal Eternity used many different magic spells, without exception, they were all techniques prevalent today. All were trackable, and none were lost ancient techniques.
This was very strange.
During ancient times, many traditions were lost after the great destruction. Most of the attack methods today were found by later generations.
If Immortal Eternity was an ancient Immortal, he should be like Fairy Eternity, capable of displaying lost ancient supreme techniques, like the embarrassing playing dead technique, and the Diving spell that strips away all water.
Yun Zhi did not suppress Immortal Eternity right way, she just wanted to see what kind of attack Immortal Eternity could perform.
"Who, who are you exactly!" The degree of Immortal Eternity's fear surpassed even being robbed of his Dao Fruit. This was simply unreasonably powerful.
Just who were these people in this boy's spiritual space? The former, with unpredictable methods, had taken away his Dao Fruit, while the latter, with superb cultivation level and limitlessly powerful magic skills!
"Didn't you say you wanted to suppress me for Lu Yang?"
"You... you are Lu Yang's Eldest Senior Sister?!" Immortal Eternity raised his voice by an octave, his eyes wide open. He completely forgot his current situation and couldn't help but curse Lu Yang shamelessly in his heart.
Just what sort of a ridiculous wish did this boy propose? One more outrageous than the other. He originally thought defeating Lu Yang's Eldest Senior Sister to be easy, so he agreed to enter and Possess.
But now it seems--
It should be the other way around!
Lu Yang's Eldest Senior Sister could suppress him easily!
It's a huge trap.
Immortal Eternity finally understood. Lu Yang was not his believer at all. He disguised himself as bait and fooled him for so long just to trick him into coming here.
It was ludicrous that he had thought he could possess a perfect shell.
Could the opponent be the Righteous Path's undercover agent lying low in the Eternity Sect?
However, Lu Yang's performance in the competition did not seem like an act.
Immortal Eternity suddenly realized and understood everything - Lu Yang was sent by the other three demonic sects!
Everything made sense now.
"Stop hitting, I surrender! I'll tell you all you want to know. Just spare me my life!" Immortal Eternity knelt on the ground to beg for mercy, his mental shift happening surprisingly fast.
"Speak, who are you exactly! Why are you impersonating me!" Fairy Eternity stopped observing the Dao Fruit and rushed over, with Lu Yang following behind her, Yun Zhi was silently listening on one side.
The three of them wanted to know the answer to this question.
"I am..."
Immortal Eternity dragged the pronunciation, drawing the attention of the three. He erupted with full force from his body and turned to run. He wanted to break the barrier of the Spiritual Space and escape this hellish place!
Thud—
As expected, he crashed solidly against the barrier, completely unable to break through.
Yun Zhi had anticipated this and strengthened the intensity of Lu Yang's spiritual space beforehand.
This trick of Immortal Eternity's had been used many times in front of Yun Zhi by Daoist Buyu before. It was useless.
"Still not behaving, Fairy Fist!" Yellow Bean clenched her little fists and rained punches on Immortal Eternity's face like raindrops.
"Don't hit the face, don't hit the face, I'll confess everything now!"
Immortal Eternity saw clearly that surrendering early was the best policy, as any tricks were ineffective against his opponents' rich experience.
"Speak, what's your name!" Yellow Bean posed triumphantly.
"I have no shame."
"Hmm? You have self-awareness?"

chapters.title: Chapter 198 - 197: Leniency for Those Who Confess_1
chapters.content:
"No, I meant, my name is Sha Meless, the 'Sha' stands for fabric, and 'Meless' stands for lack of shame." The Immortal Eternity became submissive, answering every question with a good attitude.
Fairy Eternity frowned, "Why such an odd name?"
Lu Yang thought to himself, who are you to judge others' names?
Immortal Eternity sighed, "I didn't want it either. But explaining it would take a while."
"Take your time." Fairy Eternity produced a small stool, sitting on it, and propped her head up with a palm, ready to listen to Immortal Eternity's elaborate explanation.
Yun Zhi and Lu Yang, too, listened attentively.
Speaking truthfully, Immortal Eternity said, "I am unaware of the origin of my conscious or how I was born. A long time ago, my first consciousness emerged, faint and blurry, barely aware of my existence, like looking at flowers through mist, everything was unclear."
"I felt an unknown force constantly converging onto me, making me stronger bit by bit, but my consciousness remained vague and indistinguishable."
"I also felt a surge of memories filling up my consciousness, but at that time, I didn't have the capacity to think. I merely accepted the memories and was unable to organize or process the massive influx of information."
"As my consciousness gradually grew stronger, I faintly heard the name 'Immortal Eternity' whispered."
"I heard the term 'Immortal Eternity' in my memories, but I couldn't interpret my memories, and didn't know what 'Immortal Eternity' meant."
"I don't know how much time had passed, perhaps hundreds or even thousands of years, but at one point my consciousness suddenly became clear, as if I was a drowned person who was rescued and had my perception of the external world restored."
"The first phrase I heard when my consciousness became clear was -- 'Great Immortal Eternity, Sha Meless, please save your devoted followers and save this world.'"
"'Sha Meless' became my name although I originally had none. It was the Master who called me 'Sha Meless' that I got this name."
"Once I had a name, I was finally able to process those tremendous past memories and understood the meanings those memories conveyed."
"Looking through my memories, I saw someone accidentally discovering a Secret Realm, getting lost within, and learning about an ancient Immortal who protected the human race named Immortal Eternity. This Immortal possessed the Eternity Dao Fruit and could resurrect from death. Following his escape from the Secret Realm, this man formed the Eternity Sect intending to resurrect Immortal Eternity."
"The Eternity Sect grew stronger, drawing in more and more worshippers. They slaughtered to please Immortal Eternity, chanting the name of the Immortal Eternity, hoping for his resurrection."
"By then, I comprehended. I was the Immortal Eternity resurrected by the Eternity Sect. As long as someone genuinely believed in me and prayed or worshipped me, I would gain their memory."
"The Master prayed to me, I appeared in the visible realm through a statue, responding to the Master's wishes."
"I have the Master's memory. What the Master knows, I do too. I saw he was severely wounded, needing a hundred years of quiet recuperation. Considering he was my strongest and most devout believer, I treated him."
"Once I got my name, I felt I held a lump of golden radiance. Combining it with my memory, I guessed this was Eternity Dao Fruit."
"I used part of the Eternity Dao Fruit's Power to heal the Master."
"But I am not sure whether I am indeed the Immortal Eternity. My earliest memory was from the first believer, chaotic memories from over ten thousand years ago, without a shred of ancient memory."
"For instance, when the Master asked who refined the stars, I cannot answer his question. However, I couldn't say that I don't know, thus I told him that the matter was too profound for him to understand."
"I was unsure how the believers would react if they knew my situation. So, for now, I could only pretend to be awoken from the ancient era."
"Since I am always in a soul state, this cannot be a long-term solution. So, I told the Master that I need to possess a body to return to my peak and save the world."
"The Master believed my words. He assembled all Qi Refinement and Foundation Establishment practitioners and organized a competition. I would select a suitable body to possess from the participants."
"And you chose me?" asked Lu Yang.
The Immortal Eternity nodded helplessly. Yes, I had made a poor choice. I chose you and got a good beating. Any other choice and I would have succeeded in possessing a body.
If only I had chosen someone else, I would have succeeded in possessing.
Immortal Eternity clarified things that settled certain questions like why he didn't know ancient techniques, why he needed to possess a body, and why his name was Sha Meless.
However, some puzzles were so profound that even he could not explain.
For instance, who exactly was he? Where did he come from? How did the Eternity Dao Fruit appear?
With a hopeful gaze, Lu Yang looked at his Eldest Senior Sister and Fairy Eternity. It was time for the wise elders to step in.
Fairy Eternity furrowed her brows, seemingly deep in thought, not looking very reliable.
From start to finish, Eldest Senior Sister quietly listened to Immortal Eternity's experiences, distinguishing whether they were true or fabricated.
Eldest Senior Sister believed his experiences to be authentic to a large extent.
Noticing Lu Yang's gaze, she understood her Junior Brother still had many questions and expected answers from her, so she said, "The Grand Elder of Heavenly Strategy Sect, Master Daoyan, once hypothesized that there was no Immortal Eternity or Eternity Dao Fruit in this world initially, and the Eternity Sect was essentially trying to create an immortal."
Lu Yang secretly nodded his head. The more experienced ones indeed were reliable.
Immortal Eternity looked up at Yun Zhi's words. Who was this Daoyan, daring to doubt the existence of my Dao Fruit? Don't you know how much effort I put into forming this Dao Fruit? Even Yingtian Immortal and the others were envious!
Lu Yang suggested Fairy Eternity to listen to Eldest Senior Sister first, and settle scores with Daoyan later.
Yun Zhi continued, "Where the soul comes from and where it goes is a mystery the Cultivation World has not been able to solve until now. Master Daoyan believes that human willpower can create a soul, provided the willpower is abundant and strong enough."
"Of course, this is a hypothesis and doesn't explain how the first soul was born. But your situation aligns with this hypothesis."
"Since its inception to the present, the Eternity Sect has lasted for over 14,000 years. During these 14,000 years, there would've been at least a million followers praying to an nonexistent Immortal Eternity. Given such a long duration, and a vast amount of willpower, it's entirely possible to conjure a soul, which is you, Immortal Eternity."
"But your appearance might have had another condition - slaying."
"Have you ever thought about where those resentful demonic auras that you were able to wield, originate from?"
"Humans are the most superior beings, the favoured children of heaven and earth. They are born with 'spirituality'. The practice of Demon Cultivators is to strip the 'spirituality' from humans through slaughter, which then becomes their power."
"Believers of the Eternity Sect slew countless beings to please you, thus causing extensive karmic debts. The power obtained from slaughtering became your power, the power of Transcendance Tribulation Stage."

chapters.title: Chapter 199 - 198 The Man Behind the Scenes_1
chapters.content:
The gap between immortals and mortals is like a chasm, not something achievable solely through sheer will. The immortal Eternity is not yet a true immortal and is currently in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
Although he lacks a physical body and only possesses a soul, he's not a typical Transcendance Tribulation Stage practitioner. However, with the immature Eternity Dao Fruit he possesses, he compensates for his lack of combat power.
If one in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage encounters Immortal Eternity in the spiritual space, they would be at a disadvantage.
Yet, Immortal Eternity has met with the true Fairy Eternity.
The power of the immature Dao Fruit couldn't manifest before the true Dao Fruit.
After being taught a lesson, Immortal Eternity comprehends that he may not be a true immortal, but rather an imitation of Fairy Eternity.
"As for the origin of the Dao Fruit, elder, what's your thought?", Yun Zhi posed this question to Fairy Eternity.
Fairy Eternity had been thinking about this query all along. She took out the bundle of golden light, "My initial judgement was not wrong; we could reluctantly label this entity as the Eternity Dao Fruit, but it is far from maturity, it is in its nascent form."
"The emergence of the Dao Fruit should follow the same principle as this young man's appearance, both depend on the will."
Lu Yang curiously asked, "Can Dao Fruits be manifested through will? Wouldn't that make becoming an immortal quite simple?"
Fairy Eternity shook her head, correcting Lu Yang's misconception, "it's not a Dao Fruit but an immature Dao Fruit. Regardless of the fact that this Dao Fruit is a product of over ten thousand years of accumulation by the Eternity Sect, the method of producing an immature Dao Fruit solely through will has serious limitations."
A Dao Fruit serves as a symbol of becoming immortal and is able to alter the world rules. Its actual concept far exceeds Lu Yang's knowledge, it's not something he currently has control over.
"The immature Dao Fruit and the Dao Fruit are worlds apart. As long as I wish, I can conceive as many immature Eternity Dao Fruits as I want, but there will forever be only one Eternity Dao Fruit, and it's mine."
Having said that, Fairy Eternity reveals a confident smile, believing that her Eternity Dao Fruit is the strongest, superior to the Dao Fruits of Yingtian Immortal and the others.
As for immature Dao Fruits, she views them as utterly worthless.
"But immature Dao Fruits have the potential to replace Dao Fruits."
Yun Zhi's statement doused Fairy Eternity with cold water. Fairy Eternity understood Yun Zhi's implication and instantly cooled down.
"What's going on?" Lu Yang asked.
Only Fairy Eternity and Yun Zhi had a clear understanding of the Dao Fruit. Lu Yang and Immortal Eternity were completely clueless.
Immortal Eternity can't even differentiate between a Dao Fruit and an immature Dao Fruit. If it wasn't for this explanation, he wouldn't have known how he had obtained his own immature Dao Fruit.
Yun Zhi explained, "An immature Dao Fruit is a raw embryo, rather crude with an unstable internal structure. If the immature Dao Fruit gradually matures, it becomes increasingly closer to the actual Dao Fruit."
"And for a specific type of Dao Fruit, there can only be one. For an immature Dao Fruit to fully mature, the existent mature Dao Fruit has to be discarded and replaced."
Lu Yang was surprised, "So you are saying your Dao Fruit could potentially be replaced by the immature Eternity Dao Fruit?"
Lu Yang was worried about Fairy Eternity; although she wasn't that reliable and couldn't be of help, she consistently caused trouble. Nonetheless, Lu Yang always hoped she could continue having the Dao Fruit and wouldn't be replaced by someone else.
Yun Zhi shook her head, her expression was grave, "As the one holding the supreme authority in the 'Eternity' lineage, no one can challenge her in 'Eternity'. Even an immature Dao Fruit nearing maturity couldn't."
"An immature Dao Fruit replacing a Dao Fruit only occurs in one situation - the Dao Fruit is masterless and the immature Dao Fruit has a master."
Lu Yang sighed with relief, "That's good then, Fairy Eternity is still alive, no one can replace her."
"But she was not supposed to be alive."
Lu Yang was stunned by the Eldest Senior Sister's remark.
Indeed, had it not been for his accidental utterance of Fairy Eternity's true name, she probably wouldn't have been able to revive until the end of the Great Era's dispute.
Perhaps, as the Eldest Senior Sister suggested, without him, it would've taken another three hundred thousand years for someone to inadvertently speak the true name of Fairy Eternity.
No, had Fairy Eternity not been revived and Immortal Eternity was able to mature the immature Eternity Dao Fruit, he could replace the original Eternity Dao Fruit.
By the time of the Great Era's dispute, Immortal Eternity leading the Eternity Sect would emerge and spread their name. By then, who would dare to use the same casual attitude to shout out the four-letter word "Fairy Eternity".
By then, Fairy Eternity possibly could never revive and be truly dead.
Fairy Eternity had also thought about this and was horrified.
Yun Zhi quickly sorted out her thoughts, "In the era of antiquity, Fairy Eternity was ambushed and killed, causing the Eternity Dao Fruit to become masterless, it turned into an item without an owner."
"The person behind the scenes publicized the concept of Eternity Dao Fruit, created a non-existent Immortal Eternity, allowing the Eternity Sect's followers to believe, visualize, and resurrect Immortal Eternity. However, Immortal Eternity was oblivious to this; he was desperately trying to mature the immature Dao Fruit."
"When the time is right, the person behind the scenes would make a move, seize the Eternity Dao Fruit, and claim it as theirs."
"The only thing currently unclear is whether the person behind the scenes wants to seize the Eternity Dao Fruit when it matures or when it's about to mature, or perhaps... He's already here?"
As she spoke, Yun Zhi's voice was frosty as the icy wind of millennia, concealed with a murderous intent that made Lu Yang shiver.
Yun Zhi and Fairy Eternity both released their spiritual senses together, scanning every inch of their surroundings, intending to expose the person behind the scenes.
Suddenly, a corner of the chamber resonated, a pitch-black figure slowly emerged. He applauded rhythmically, admiring Yun Zhi's exceptionality.
Lu Yang stared at the shadowy figure. It was clear the person was present, but when scanned by his spiritual sense, there was nothing.
Lu Yang thought the individual felt like a bottomless black hole, possessing immense ambitions, able to swallow all, instigating chills.
Yun Zhi and Fairy Eternity stood in front of Lu Yang, cautiously eyeing the newcomer.
"No wonder you're considered the strongest among the Five Great Immortal Sects. In terms of threat to me, the Central Continent has a few, and you pose the biggest one!"
"Initially, I was here to observe if an immature Eternity Dao Fruit had truly been formed. Unexpectedly, merely observing for a few days rewarded me with such great gains."
The black figure directed his gaze towards Fairy Eternity, despite his features being unobservable, Lu Yang felt he was smiling.
"How unexpected that you, Fairy Eternity, actually revived. The biggest variable undeniably took me by surprise."
"Since you've revived, the plan of replacing the Dao Fruit with the immature Eternity Dao Fruit has been voided. It's a shame for the Eternity Sect's fourteen thousand years of preparation, all effort wasted." The dark figure shook his head in regret, unclear whether he was lamenting for the Eternity Sect or his own schemes.
"Ying Tian, Kirin, Suiyue, Jiuchong, who are you?! Skulking in the shadows, show your true face!" Fairy Eternity retorted sternly. This person wanted to entirely erase her existence, it was a feud that couldn't be resolved!
There had to be a resolution between her and the shadowy figure!
The figure laughed and shook his head, "Were there really only five immortals in your era? Was Immortal Jiuchong truly the first immortal?"
"Fairy, there are too many uncertainties, how can you determine that I'm one of the four people?"
"Playing tricks!" Fairy Eternity grinding her teeth in anger.
Yun Zhi remained silent and straightforwardly attacked with all her might.
The figure's expression tightened, "Sure enough, your strength is far beyond what you've shown on the surface. Even if I had my body manifest here, I would probably struggle hard to defeat you."
"After the age of antiquity, there's someone like you, truly an extraordinary creation of this world."
The figure admitted his inferiority and decisively self-destructed.

chapters.title: Chapter 200 - 199: Who Could It Be?_1
chapters.content:
The Black Shadow knew that he was no match for Yun Zhi, the gap between them was too wide, and his chances of escaping successfully were extremely slim.
Rather than expose himself, it would be better to self-destruct as soon as possible to preserve the safety of his main body.
If Yun Zhi were to find his hideout, both the war of this Great Era and his main body would be out of the picture.
Damn it, why are there such people in the Central Continent?!
Could it be that the fortunes of heaven and earth are all concentrated in the Central Continent?!
And why would Fairy Eternity resurrect?
Besides them, who else knows about the existence of Fairy Eternity, let alone her name?
How exactly did Fairy Eternity resurrect?
Only by uttering her honorific and true name would she resurrect, so who said it?!
As described, the Eternity Dao Fruit indeed defies all time, even if it perishes entirely, it can resurrect.
As the Black Shadow prepared to self-explode, an array of questions flooded his mind, none of which he could answer.
His self-destruction was silent; his body turned into dust, that in turn turned into Spiritual Energy, returning to the realm between heaven and earth.
"He escaped?" Lu Yang asked in confusion, unable to comprehend the Black Shadow's techniques.
Yun Zhi shook her head gently, her eyes reflecting regret and coldness: "No, he killed himself."
"Will his main body know about the situation here? About Fairy Eternity?" Lu Yang thought back to the words that the Black Shadow uttered before he self-destructed, "It's a pity that my main body doesn't know about the situation here."
Was he trying to play tricks or was that really the case?
Yun Zhi's words defied Lu Yang's thoughts: "His main body won't know about this, nor would his clone dare to let it know."
"If his clone could let his main body know about his situation, then I could find the main body through the connection between the clone and the main body."
Lu Yang simply couldn't understand Eldest Senior Sister's tactics.
"However..." Yun Zhi's eyes revealed some confusion, as though pondering over a problem.
"However, what?"
"The Black Shadow felt very familiar. I may have plotted against him in the past."
Both Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity were taken aback.
Continuing on, Yun Zhi explained: "This was probably from a hundred years ago. I accidentally noticed an Immortal showing up on the Central Continent. I asked him to reveal his identity but he refused my request. As a result, we ended up fighting."
"He probably didn't anticipate my strength. As soon as we crossed hands, he was immediately on the back foot. I pursued eminently and managed to injure him. Seeing no good outcome in continuing the fight, he feigned an attack on the town below. While I was protecting the town, he managed to escape. By the time I wanted to pursue him, he was nowhere to be found."
"That person, always concealing himself within a chaotic mist and using very common techniques, was hard to trace. He was very much like the Black Shadow we encountered today."
Yun Zhi believed that the Black Shadow she encountered today was the same person as the one from a hundred years ago.
Lu Yang contemplated. If Eldest Senior Sister's guess was right, the Black Shadow's words "As I thought, your strength is far greater than what you show to the outside world" was pretense, feigning ignorance of Eldest Senior Sister's strength - all lies.
The more Lu Yang thought about it, the more it seemed likely. If he didn't know about Eldest Senior Sister's strength, why would his first reaction be to self-destruct rather than escape? This didn't make sense.
From the beginning to the end, the Black Shadow hardly said a few words and most of them were probably false.
Sneaky old thing.
Immortal Eternity was left feeling relieved. Even though the two fairies didn't hold back when hitting him, some even hitting quite hard, at least they didn't kill him.
If he fell into the hands of the Black Shadow, aside from having his Dao Fruit being taken away, there was a high chance he would be killed to prevent any loose ends.
"Fairy, can you guess who he might be?" asked Lu Yang.
Immortal Eternity frowned, hesitating: "The Immortal Jiuchong excels at utilizing clones, but if the other three wanted to imitate him, they could."
"Is it possible that, apart from you five, there are other immortals as well?" Lu Yang continued.
Once Lu Yang asked this, even Immortal Eternity became uncertain.
Could it be that Immortal Jiuchong isn't the first Immortal after all?
"How did you guys determine that Immortal Jiuchong was the first Immortal then?"
Immortal Eternity remembered, "When Immortal Jiuchong became an Immortal, a divine light burst forth and divine music played throughout the heavens and earth. A flurry of colorful rain descended from the heavens, bringing blessings and cheers, and bestowing benefits upon all beings on earth. However, when the four of us became Immortals later on, these phenomena weren't present."
Lu Yang was taken aback: "So, this is the special privilege of the first to become an Immortal?"
Yun Zhi nodded. She had seen records about Immortal Jiuchong's ascension in ancient texts, which aligned with Immortal Eternity's words; or rather, Immortal Eternity, as one of the people involved, described everything more meticulously.
The first to become an Immortal truly is extraordinary.
Immortal Eternity shook her head: "No, later when we five were dining together, Immortal Jiuchong drank excessively and confessed that all the strange occurrences at that time were created by him secretly. He depleted a lot of heavenly treasures."
Lu Yang: "..."
Yun Zhi: "..."
Why is it that every time they listen to Immortal Eternity recount ancient peculiar events, their understanding of things gets overturned?
Lu Yang even felt that the ancient times Immortal Eternity talked about, was not in the same style as the Black Shadow.
...
In a mysterious place, a silhouetted figure sat on a throne piled up by bones.
He opened his immortal eyes, releasing boundless divine light that pierced through a corner of the heaven and earth.
The moment the divine light flashed, the whole ground filled with dead bodies and bones illuminated under the divine light, appearing especially eerie.
The black figure rose slowly, moving his body and knitting his brows: "Why is this chair so uncomfortable?"
"Whose idea was it to make a chair out of bone piles? There isn't even a cushion."
The black figure shook his head, deciding to find another place to sleep.
Suddenly, the black figure sensed an anomaly and hummed.
"Sir, what's wrong?" a servant asked carefully.
"The clone I sent to the Eternity Sect has gone missing?"
This black figure could always sense the connection with his clone and determine its location.
Just now, the clone lost contact with him completely, which meant the clone was wiped out by someone.
This clone, which had consumed countless efforts, was just gone like that, and he felt heartbroken about it.
"What? Sir's clone has gone missing?!" The servant was shocked, his expression clearly genuine.
Sir was an Immortal, and a clone of an Immortal was sufficient to dominate the world. How could it disappear in the Central Continent?
The black figure contemplated: "Who could have done this?"
The first person he ruled out was Immortal Eternity. A soul created by the power of thought could only do so much. There was no way he could quietly kill his clone.
On the Central Continent, there were only a handful of people capable of killing his clone.
He didn't go there personally but sent a clone to investigate the situation because he was worried about being discovered by several individuals on the Central Continent.
He didn't want to reveal his identity yet.
He had tampered with the clone. Even if it was captured, this would absolutely not divulge his identity. Instead, it might even mislead others based on the disinformation given by the clone and cast suspicion upon other Immortals.
One should be careful throughout their life.
Otherwise, they would end up careless and heartless like Immortal Eternity and probably get killed one day.
"Was it that fellow in the palace? Was it Yun Zhi from the Seek Dao Sect? Or someone else?"
His clone was actually hidden in the Eternity Sect. Those who may have had contact with his clone would only be the Great Xia Dynasty, who was always committed to combating demonic sects, and the Five Great Immortal Sects who deal with suppressing demons and exorcising evil.

chapters.title: Chapter 201 - 200: I'm Still a Baby!_1
chapters.content:
"That guy in the palace rarely ever takes action and he stays in the forbidden area. It's unlikely that it's him."
"Could it be Yun Zhi from the Seek Dao Sect?"
"That's not right either. My clone is hidden next to the Immortal Eternity and the Eternity Sect is always careful and cautious. How could anyone sneak into their headquarters?"
"Could it be that the Immortal Eternity has awakened his conscience, turned from evil to good, and voluntarily surrendered to the Great Xia Dynasty or the Sect Leader of Seek Dao Sect, to seek leniency?"
The black figure felt particularly frustrated when thinking of those few people from the Central Continent.
Since the end of ancient times, he began to plot and plan. Everything was well planned, and there should not have been any problems.
The eras of Great Qian and Great Yu did not exceed his plans. He declared that there would be opportunities to become an Immortal in future generations, letting people sleep and wake up during the Great Era's conflict, to create chaos.
But during the Great Xia Dynasty, one after another, people who were not part of his plan appeared, and even Immortals emerged.
Once someone becomes an Immortal, they are no longer chess pieces, but chess players who share the same position as him. This forced him to revise his plan several times.
"Especially that Yun Zhi, so young with extraordinary talent."
"Sir, who is this Yun Zhi..." The servant tried to recall the influential figures of the Central Continent, including the Great Powers who could influence the destiny of the continent, but none of them was called Yun Zhi.
It's rare for his Master to praise someone with such warmth. Just how amazing is this Yun Zhi to warrant such acclaim?
The shadow guy chuckled coldly: "She's just a little girl from the Seek Dao Sect. A hundred years ago, when I went to the Central Continent, she came to greet me personally and eagerly asked where I came from. I didn't feel like bothering with her, and she didn't say much either."
"After that, I saw she had some abilities, so I exchanged a few moves with her and gave her some guidance. After our spar, I wanted to leave, but she kept pursuing me, asking for more guidance. But I figured our interactions should be as plain as water, no need to force anything. It would be best if we just let our acquaintance end here; too much guidance might influence her path."
"I used my escape technique and left directly, not willing to have too much entanglement with her."
"Sir, you are the top cultivator in all of history." The servant sang praises, drawing a hearty laugh from the shadow guy.
The servant was relieved to be following his Master in this Great Era's struggle. A slight slip could plunge you into an irreversible situation. It was safer to follow his Master.
His Master's cultivation topped the world; calculating the affairs of the Great Era, he would surely take advantage of the Great Era's struggle. Just following behind him and feasting on leftovers would be enough for a lifetime of comfort. If luck permitted, he might even have a chance to become an Immortal.
The shadow guy thought of his spar with Yun Zhi from a hundred years ago and felt embarrassed.
Of course, he couldn't tell his underlings that he was beaten severely by the young girl and had to make a disgraceful escape.
He had lived for countless years, and being defeated by a child and forced to run away was a disgrace.
These words can't be disclosed to his subordinates. That would damage his reputation.
The shadow guy recalled the incident from a hundred years ago when he wanted to just take a look at the Eternity Sect to see how far he was from forming the Dao Fruit. But he was spotted by Yun Zhi before he even got close to the Eternity Sect's headquarters and this ignited a great battle.
Thinking of Yun Zhi's power, the shadow guy considered her as the number one person in the Central Continent and the biggest obstacle in this Great Era's struggle.
Hence, since then, he has sent only clones to the Central Continent to avoid being caught.
"Could the Great Xia Dynasty be blessed with destiny?"
The concept of destiny is elusive. To become an Immortal, besides having talent and strength, luck is needed as well.
For instance, the guy who learned Verbal Spells and was at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage back then could also have become an Immortal. But his luck was bad, he met Yellow Bean and ended up dying in the middle of his journey.
The shadow guy pondered for a long time and still couldn't come up with an answer. He simply gave up thinking about it.
"Nevermind, there's no use thinking about it. Since my clone has been killed, it probably indicates that the formation of the Eternity Dao Fruit has been discovered by someone. The people in the Central Continent will be on high alert for Immortals sneaking into the continent. If discovered, it will cause unnecessary trouble, so I'll stop going to the Central Continent for now.
When the Eternity Dao Fruit is close to maturity, I'll take action to pluck it!"
"If I can get the Eternity Dao Fruit, in the Great Era's struggle, I will surely have the upper hand!"
"It's really a pity about Fairy Eternity. She is destined not to be revived. She has the Eternity Dao Fruit, so if she doesn't die, no one can get the Eternity Dao Fruit."
"Back in that time, who would've expected that she would be the one to bear the Eternity Dao Fruit, that is truly something to be envied..."
The shadow figure gradually disappeared into the distance, his voice faded and he left the area, leaving behind only dry bones on the ground.
...
"What do we do about the Eternity Sect?"
Lu Yang asked, having achieved this mission's objective to locate the Eternity Sect's headquarters, arrest the Immortal Eternity, and even manage to force a clone of the enemy behind the scenes to self-destruct.
The only remaining question now is—what to do with the Eternity Sect?
If they hastily deal with the Eternity Sect, would it stir up the enemy and make them realize something is off?
Can they use the Eternity Sect to lure out the enemy behind the scenes?
Yun Zhi looked at Lu Yang in surprise, not understanding why he would ask this.
"Of course, reporting it."
"What?"
"So many people, our Seek Dao Sect wouldn't be able to manage it all. Let's leave it for the Great Xia Dynasty to handle."
Lu Yang was about to blurt out, "Since when did our Seek Dao Sect start using these kinds of legitimate methods?"
In Lu Yang's memory, weren't trials by torture, bribery, infiltrating demonic sects, and emerging as the top in demonic sect competitions all things the Seek Dao Sect did?
Oh right, half of those actions were his own doings.
"When should we report it?" Lu Yang seemed eager to try, finding a sense of fulfillment in bringing down such a large base.
Yun Zhi thought for a while: "Four days ago?"
"What?"
Yun Zhi explained: "Right after we entered the headquarters four days ago, I let my Divine Soul leave my body and went to the Great Xia Dynasty to report it. I didn't make a move immediately because I wanted to wait until everyone from the Foundation Establishment Stage and Qi Refinement Stage had arrived before closing the net."
"Of course, catching the Immortal Eternity was an unexpected gain, beyond my expectations."
The Immortal Eternity felt that he really had too much free time. Why would he dare to attempt a possession when everything was fine? As long as he didn't come out voluntarily, even if the entire Eternity Sect was destroyed, the Great Xia Dynasty wouldn't be able to find him.
Yun Zhi turned her gaze to the Immortal Eternity: "As for you..."
The Immortal Eternity hurriedly said: "I failed to possess someone, which can be compared to an unsuccessful murder attempt. I shouldn't be sentenced to death for that!"
"I've always followed the law and never committed a crime—you can see even the statue is reading the criminal law."
Lu Yang did take a look. Indeed, the statue of the Immortal Eternity was holding the criminal law.
The Sect Leader acted fast, having already changed the Immortal Eternity's statue to hold the criminal law, encouraging the followers to learn about legal matters.
"Moreover, my soul was complete only from the moment I got my name. And only five days have passed from the moment I received my name to now. I'm just five days old, still a baby. According to the Great Xia criminal law, I am considered a minor with no criminal responsibility, thus not subjected to criminal punishment."
"I'm still a baby, so I beg of you to show mercy and let me go!"
Lu Yang stared at the Immortal Eternity's face, aged to the point of falling into the grave, thinking the naming wasn't done wrong at all.
You even dared to say such shameless words?

chapters.title: Chapter 202 - 201: Exercises All Have Purpose_1
chapters.content:
The Immortal Eternity was grateful to possess the memories of all his believers, especially those who were proficient in criminal laws, represented by the master.
How helpful!
His case was peculiar. In the world of cultivation, children generally matured early. The Great Xia's law set the age of criminal responsibility rather low. Regardless of how low it was, a five-day old infant could not be held accountable for a crime.
He had truly been born just five days ago, but upon birth, he had inherited great power and knowledge.
At present, Great Xia's law did not stipulate how to deal with someone like him.
Generally, in the absence of explicit legal provisions, the principles of criminal law would be considered. Based on the principle of protecting minors, he was not criminally responsible.
Even if he were assumed responsible, an unsuccessful possession would not result in a death sentence.
The righteous sects surely believed in law and order. Unlike the demonic sects, they wouldn't simply kill and dispose of bodies to keep them quiet.
Fairy Eternity furrowed her brows as she found some truth in what Immortal Eternity was saying. However, something felt amiss about it, though she couldn't pinpoint why.
Fairy Eternity had little knowledge of current laws.
Lu Yang pondered, murmuring, "You make a fair point. However, as long as we eliminate you here without anyone knowing, I don't think the criminal law would apply to us?"
Great Xia couldn't govern what it was unaware of.
"Oh~ You can do that, Lu Yang? You're so smart!" Fairy Eternity praised Lu Yang. He truly was deserving of his title of the sect's founder; his mind was agile.
Immortal Eternity: "!!!"
Was this something the righteous path should be suggesting?!
Upon learning that Lu Yang was a member of the Seek Dao Sect, Immortal Eternity had assumed that his various actions during the Foundation Establishment Stage competition were deliberate performances.
Now, it seemed that this was simply him acting naturally!
Yun Zhi had different methods of dealing with Immortal Eternity: "Each of the Five Great Immortal Sects has the right to enforce the law. In theory, we can handle you in the Seek Dao Sect. You have the memories of all your followers and can assist the Seek Dao Sect. As long as you confess honestly, we can imprison you in the Seek Dao Sect."
The moment Immortal Eternity heard that he would not be killed, he was overjoyed. See, this was the righteous path!
As for being imprisoned, that was a minor issue.
"However, if you lie in your confession, we will directly probe your soul."
Immortal Eternity quickly pledged that he would be loyal to the Seek Dao Sect, answer any questions, reform, and start anew.
He even swore to the real immortal - Yellow Bean.
"Senior, please return the Eternity Dao Fruit embryo to him."
Fairy Eternity understood Yun Zhi's intentions. She nodded slightly and placed the Eternity Dao Fruit embryo back into Immortal Eternity's soul.
Upon sensing the return of the Eternity Dao Fruit embryo, Immortal Eternity felt his strength gradually returning, and the pain from being hit earlier also diminished.
People were generally good in this world; they even returned his Dao Fruit!
Yun Zhi spoke again, "Senior, as the controller of the Eternity line, you can control those who possess the Eternity Dao Fruit embryo. With you here, we can control Immortal Eternity."
Immortal Eternity: "..."
Is the position of the Dao Fruit embryo really that low?
This was knowledge that neither Lu Yang nor Immortal Eternity knew of.
When Lu Yang left the secret room, Great Xia had already sprung into action.
After receiving the information from the Eldest Senior Sister, Great Xia took it very seriously. They had someone deliver the information to Emperor Xia, who was shocked when he saw the contents.
They actually found the headquarters of a demonic sect, and the demonic sect was completely unaware!
This was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity!
The Four Great Devil Sects caused endless trouble. Emperor Xia couldn't miss the opportunity to uproot one of them.
He immediately ordered to mobilise the army and work with the Seek Dao Sect to capture every single member of the Eternity Sect!
Great Xia dispatched forces to seal off all exits. A dozen Unification Stage experts led the battle, ordering their subordinates to arrest everyone.
In this do-or-die moment, the Eternity Sect displayed great discipline—they dropped their weapons and surrendered voluntarily.
"We surrender!"
All the efforts had a payoff; even the seemingly useless surrender training played a crucial role at this time.
Great Xia dared to arrest them because they were well-prepared. The dozen Unification Stage experts were just the surface. Surely, a Transcendance Tribulation Stage power was lurking in the background.
Under such circumstances, no member of the Eternity Sect could escape.
Rather than resisting, it was better to surrender obediently. With good luck, they might survive.
"Lu Yang, how dare you betray the Eternity Sect!" Seeing Lu Yang, the master wished to tear him to shreds.
Unfortunately, he was currently sealed off. His mana was frozen, his cultivation lost, rendering him immobile.
He still didn't know that Lu Yang was a spy sent by the Seek Dao Sect.
"Master, that's where you went wrong. It's our tradition in the demonic sect to usurp power! How can someone who fails to thoroughly understand the meaning of the Demon Path lead the Eternity Sect?", Lu Yang explained to the master.
The two Unification Stage cultivators who held the master twitched at the corners of their eyes. He indeed belonged to the Seek Dao Sect, effortlessly masquerading as a member of the demonic sect.
A figure stepped through a distortion in space, arriving in front of Lu Yang. The figure was slender, a handsome young man who greeted Lu Yang, "I am Ming Ge. I hope Friend Yun Zhi will come out to meet me."
Yun Zhi emerged from Lu Yang's spiritual world, returning the greeting, "Ming Sir."
Ming Ge quickly said, "I dare not be called Sir in the presence of Daoist Yun Zhi."
Ming Ge was a Transcendance Tribulation Stage expert under Great Xia, responsible for the current operation.
Despite his youthful appearance, Ming Ge was older than Daoist Buyu.
As a Transcendance Tribulation Stage expert, he knew far more than the average person—like Yun Zhi's strength, for example.
Ming Ge knew that even if Great Xia didn't act, Yun Zhi alone could completely apprehend the entire Eternity Sect.
Regardless of the contribution to the operation or her strength, Ming Ge dared not to boast in front of Yun Zhi.
Just as Ming Ge was about to say something, a subordinate came to report.
"Reporting to Sir, we caught two Eternity Sect disciples. Even though their cultivation is only at the Foundation Establishment Stage, they have reached the position of Rudder Master. They appear to be demonic seeds carefully nurtured by the upper ranks of the Eternity Sect. However, the two insist that they are spies sent by a righteous sect and are not real disciples of the Eternity Sect."
"We also received a piece of information stating that the Eternity Sect just held a Foundation Establishment Stage competition. These two achieved the second and third place respectively. With such results, it's hard for people to believe that they are members of the righteous sect."
Lu Yang: "..."
Why am I not considered a member of the righteous sect!
Ming Ge held his brow in agony and sighed, "Does one of them go by the name Meng Jingzhou? He is the young master of the Meng family, and I have attended his one-month banquet. Both of them are spies from the Seek Dao Sect."
"Since Meng Jingzhou is both a member of the Meng family and the Seek Dao Sect, it is normal for him to thrive in the Eternity Sect. Let them go."
"Yes."

chapters.title: Chapter 203 - 202: Two months into the Eternity Sect, the sect is destroyed (Thanks to EwE for the reward)"_1
chapters.content:
When the Master saw that Yun Zhi was emanating from Lu Yang's body, his heart sunk.
Originally, he was wondering if the Immortal Eternity had successfully possessed Lu Yang, and all his previous actions were just an act.
Now it seemed that the Immortal Eternity was probably finished as well.
"So, you, Meng Jingzhou, and Man Gu are all from the Seek Dao Sect!" The master was an intelligent person and quickly figured out what had happened.
It was not him who had sent Lu Yang and the others to infiltrate the Seek Dao Sect. Instead, it was the Seek Dao Sect that had sent Lu Yang and the others to infiltrate the Eternity Sect!
The despicable Seek Dao Sect!
He glared at Lu Yang intently. As a Righteous Path, they disguised themselves as Demon Path, and their words and actions were flawless.
What deep scheming!
Ming Ge waved his hand, signaling for the Master to be taken away.
"Thanks to Yun Zhi for providing the intelligence for this operation. Otherwise, we wouldn't know when we could finally capture the Eternity Sect. After I return, I will propose to the monarch to reward Yun Zhi."
"This was a trifling matter. It was you who bore the brunt of the operation. I didn't contribute much, so please forget about the reward." Yun Zhi spoke indifferently.
She then added, "There's no need to report to Emperor Xia either. I'll go see him later."
Seeing Yun Zhi's resolute attitude, Ming Ge didn't insist. He bid everyone farewell, "Now is the time to act swiftly and capture the entire sect. We must strive to locate the branches as soon as possible and try to catch all members of the Eternity Sect. Time is of the essence. If the branch members have time to react, that would be bad. I'll take my leave first!"
After Ming Ge hurriedly said these words, he left to continue dealing with the Eternity Sect, Yun Zhi didn't say much else.
Yun Zhi took out the Immortal Eternity again, which made him quite nervous, thinking that Yun Zhi was going back on her word.
"You're an important witness. Follow me to meet Emperor Xia and the leaders of the other four Great Immortal Sects."
The easiest way to explain the situation of the Eternity Sect is to take the Immortal Eternity along.
Immortal Eternity heaved a sigh of relief. So, it wasn't a case of refining him into a magic artifact.
He had just heard Lu Yang mention in the spiritual space that the Seek Dao Sect had a tradition of refining powerful souls into magic artifacts.
This didn't sound like the Righteous Path at all.
The Immortal Eternity began to doubt the reliability of his followers' memories. Wasn't it said that the Five Great Immortal Sects were united in defending the Righteous Path?
"You, Meng Jingzhou, and Man Gu should go back first. Dai Bufan is waiting for you outside." Yun Zhi said this and then carried off the Immortal Eternity as if he was no more than a chick.
Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, and Man Gu met up. Meng Jingzhou said with a giddy giggle, "Finally, we've dealt with the Eternity Sect. This is another big contribution."
Man Gu hesitated before saying, "Did we act too quickly? We just joined the Eternity Sect less than two months ago, and now it's already been eradicated by us."
The Eternity Sect has been around for fourteen thousand years. It's a huge disaster. How is it that when Brother Lu and Brother Meng joined, the Eternity Sect was taken down all at once?
Even if we are defending the Righteous Path, isn't this efficiency a bit too high?
Lu Yang said in a serious tone, "Man Gu, you need to understand one thing. Was it us who destroyed the Eternity Sect? No, of course not!"
"Everything that happened today is due to the Eternity Sect's own evil deeds. We've only made minor contributions."
Meng Jingzhou nodded vigorously. The Eternity Sect should never have recruited them. What did that have to do with them?
Man Gu suddenly understood, "I see."
The three of them chatted and laughed as they left the sect's headquarters. As expected, Dai Bufan was waiting for them outside.
"You guys are out? Well done!" Dai Bufan spoke cheerfully, giving each of them a pat on the shoulder. He was clearly very pleased.
With one less demonic sect around, it was equivalent to having one less major threat. This would undoubtedly make his life a lot easier.
Dai Bufan casually picked a leaf from a tree. Through some unknown means, the leaf grew to the size of a small boat.
"Get in."
Using the green leaf as a vessel, Dai Bufan brought the three of them back to the Seek Dao Sect.
Lu Yang looked down tremulously, feeling as though he might fall at any moment. Seeing this, Dai Bufan laughed heartily: "Lu Yang, so you're afraid of heights. How will you be a swordsman with this?"
...
Back at the Task Hall, Dai Bufan and the trio calculated their rewards for this mission.
"Eldest Senior Sister told me before she left that although the maximum reward points for a Foundation Establishment Stage mission is one thousand, in this case, your contributions in eradicating the Eternity Sect are significant. Each of you will receive an exceptional reward."
"Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu, you two will receive two thousand contribution points each."
"Lu Yang, you made the greatest contribution in the competition against the Eternity Sect, so you will receive two thousand five hundred contribution points."
With a considerable number of contribution points from last time, and now gaining these many, the three were elated.
At the Foundation Establishment Stage, they had the most contribution points among all!
"Elder Brother Dai, can this sword be exchanged for contribution points?"
Lu Yang pulled out a demonic sword and asked Dai Bufan to appraise it.
Dai Bufan examined the demonic sword, lightly flicked it to gauge its resonance, and opined, "It's indeed a rare and excellent sword. You sure you don't want to keep it for yourself?"
"Oh, right, you have the Green Peak Sword given by Eldest Senior Sister; you won't need this demonic sword."
"The material of this sword is good, but the refining method is poor. Also, the excessive killings have deposited karmic sin and contaminated blood on it, ruining the original properties of the material. I'll value it at one thousand seven hundred contribution points."
After tallying up their respective contribution points, they decided to call it a day. The trio was unimaginably exhausted mentally and physically from the excursion.
"Let's go back and get some sleep. We can exchange the rewards tomorrow," Meng Jingzhou suggested, yawning excessively and almost unable to keep his eyes open.
Man Gu was similarly fatigued, almost collapsing and falling asleep on the spot.
Lu Yang wasn't in great shape either. The battles all happened in the Spiritual Space, taking a huge toll on his mental strength.
However, his lack of focus now had another reason.
"Why don't I have any contribution points! It must be because that Yun Zhi was scared I would become Sect Leader again!"
"Why don't I have any congratulatory points! It must be because that Yun Zhi was scared I would become Sect Leader again!"
While Fairy Eternity was clamoring in the Spiritual Space,
"Fairy, can you please be quiet? I'm going to sleep now," Lu Yang mumbled sleepily after reaching his Abode.
Fairy Eternity obediently stayed quiet in the Spiritual Space, not uttering a word.
...
After the three left, Dai Bufan held the demonic sword, contemplating what to do with it.
"Let it be. I'll put it in the storage for now and consult Fifth Elder later."
Dai Bufan casually held the demonic sword, putting it into the corner of the storage room.
The storage room was dark, barely showing various magic artifacts. The demonic sword, emanating an ominous aura, was conspicuous.
No matter where the demonic sword was, it was supremely domineering, flashing a dark red glow, proclaiming itself the boss of the storage room and threatening to sever anyone who disobeyed!
A precious lamp hovered in the air, emanating the aura of a superior magic artifact, enveloping the demonic sword.
Then came the Jade Ruyi, shedding a green light, encapsulating the demonic sword.
A paper fan opened with a swish, gently fanning the air.
A sickle, writing brush, gourd, chessboard... various magic artifacts seemed to come alive, surrounding the demonic sword.
The demonic sword trembled, voluntarily retracting its ominous aura, appearing harmless.
Where is this place? It's so scary.

chapters.title: Chapter 204 - 203: Paradox in the Late Stage of Foundation Establishment (Thanks to book friend O Qi An O for the donation)"_1
chapters.content:
After a night, Lu Yang stepped out of his abode and yawned long and leisurely. He appeared revived, his radiance renascent, brimming with energy.
"Hmm——"
"I'm alive!" Lu Yang stretched, feeling a surge of strength throughout his body.
A good night's rest had indeed proved beneficial.
Lu Yang reflected on the annihilation of the Eternity Sect, which seemed as though it had only taken place yesterday; the memory was fresh in his mind.
Lu Yang noticed that Fairy Eternity was sound asleep in his spiritual space. Elegantly serene in her slumber, with unmatched beauty, her body's curves gracefully undulating, she perfectly embodied the world's impression of a "fairy".
Fairy Eternity could easily mesmerize those who did not know her when she stayed silent.
A rare tranquility.
"But does a spiritual body need sleep?"
Lu Yang thought about the Dream Pillow that Fairy Eternity used, attributing her need for sleep to a mere "hobby".
Feeling the hazy dawn sunlight, the spiritual essence within his body involuntarily accelerated its circulation, as if a new power was surging within him.
"I'm nearing the late stage of Foundation Establishment."
Lu Yang muttered to himself, then sat cross-legged on the spot, in the 'Five Centers Toward Heaven' posture, silently operating the "Mind Seeing Method".
The spiritual essence within his body circulated at an increasing speed along the path outlined by the method of cultivation, continually washing over his body, strengthening every part of him.
Lu Yang tried to use this opportune moment to enhance his hair but found it in vain.
"I wonder how Meng Jingzhou trained his hair."
Lu Yang remembered how Meng Jingzhou, during his battle with the Five Elements Sect, had used his hair to hit his opponents to great effect.
Casting off his stray thoughts, he settled down, attuning his body with nature. The heavenly and earthly spiritual energy continuously poured into his body. He exhaled fields of spiritual energy, nurturing the heavens and earth in return.
In this process, his realm continually progressed upwards.
"Hmm? What are you up to? Cultivating?" Fairy Eternity woke up, rubbing her eyes, disoriented.
She sensed Lu Yang's realm advancing but felt something was off.
"No, I'm progressing." Lu Yang explained soberly.
"I'm now half a step into the late Foundation Establishment Stage."
"Oh, so are you close to the late stage of Foundation Establishment?"
"I'm nearly there, but I have a question."
"What is it?"
"Now that I'm 'half a step' into the late Foundation Establishment Stage, if I take 'half of this half step', wouldn't I be closer to the late stage?"
"Yes."
"And if I take 'half of that half step', wouldn't I be even closer?"
"Correct."
"So if I keep taking 'half of my previous step', wouldn't I be continually drawing closer to the late stage?"
Fairy Eternity nodded in confusion.
"I keep advancing but never seem to reach the late Foundation Establishment Stage. Could this be implying that the late stage is an elusive realm that no one actually reaches?"
Frustration wrinkled Fairy Eternity's forehead; she thought for a moment, decided she was probably still half asleep, and decided to retreat into slumber.
At a tilt of her head, she fell back to sleep.
With Fairy Eternity asleep, Lu Yang was left alone, grappling with his philosophical quandary.
What is the answer to this problem? Is my continuous progression between realms pointless? Could it be that the late Foundation Establishment Stage does not exist at all?
The puppet hiding in the dark couldn't bear to watch any longer. It tiptoed behind Lu Yang and kicked him.
Lu Yang relaxed his muscles, inadvertently taking another half step.
Late Foundation Establishment Stage!
"Who kicked me!"
Lu Yang turned sharply, but the puppet had already scurried away.
Even though the puppet had fled, Lu Yang could still guess who the culprit was.
Aside from Lu Yang, all that was left on Sky Gate Mountain were the active puppets.
"Forget it, I won't stoop to its level. I'll go to the Task Hall to exchange my rewards," Lu Yang reasoned that even if he could find the puppet, he wouldn't be able to overcome it. He didn't want for his first action after leveling up to be a beating.
Ominous.
Lu Yang waited for a while at the entrance of the Task Hall before Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu finally showed up.
They were both exhausted, having slept non-stop since last night.
As usual, Meng Jingzhou went to the Task Hall to buy high-quality hay in specific proportions to feed Old horse.
"Ice Making Talismans are so cheap, give me twenty!"
Lu Yang looked at Meng Jingzhou in surprise, "What do you need so many low-grade Ice Making Talismans for?"
These Ice Making Talismans were only capable of dealing with late stage Qi Refinement, they were pretty much filler on the list.
"Heh heh, you wouldn't understand. Now that summer is here, do you know what's most important in summer? It's staying cool!"
Man Gu was confused, "But don't our abodes have cooling array methods, isn't that enough?"
Meng Jingzhou wagged his index finger, "Here, let me demonstrate."
Meng Jingzhou pulled out a wooden barrel from his Identity Jade, filled it with cold water, and with a splash, jumped in, only his head sticking out.
He took out an Ice Making Talisman, and instantly, all the water in the barrel turned into ice, with him frozen inside.
"Refreshing!" Meng Jingzhou shouted, his whole body frozen into an icicle, with only his head mobile. This sensation was absolutely invigorating.
This could only be done by a Cultivator; ordinary people would have long contracted an illness from the cold.
With gleaming eyes, Lu Yang pulled Meng Jingzhou, still frozen in ice, out of the barrel and pushed him, causing him to roll around the Task Hall.
This kind of performance was quite rare even in the advanced Seek Dao Sect, attracting the attention of many Senior Brothers and Sisters.
"Lu Yang you son of a…!" Meng Jingzhou yelled, feeling completely disoriented.
While pushing the ice block, Lu Yang explained, "This you wouldn't understand. The biggest problem in our Unification is that we rotate too much and our bodies can't handle it, right? We can use this method to train and adapt to the spinning in advance."
Man Gu nodded approvingly on the side, praising Lu Yang's ingenuity. He had thought Lu Yang was just messing with Brother Meng.
Meng Jingzhou had a different opinion, "Anyone can theorize, Lu Yang, if you're so confident, let's switch places, and let me push you!"
"You froze first, so we'll train you first!" Lu Yang was not falling for it.
A juvenile provocation.
Finally, a Senior Brother on duty at the Task Hall halted Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou with a sour face.
Only then did the two stop messing around and went to exchange their rewards.
"I'll take one Ten Bulls Strength Pill." Seeing that there was a Golden Core Stage version of the Ten Bulls Strength Pill on the list for 1,500 contribution points, Lu Yang bought it without a second thought.
This price was a steal.
"Hmm? Golden Core Realm Experience Voucher, what's this?" Meng Jingzhou found something strange whose description was also quite vague.
Meng Jingzhou speculated, "Could it allow a Foundation Establishment Stage Cultivator to temporarily enter the Golden Core Stage and experience what it's like to be at Golden Core?"
He heard that some Cultivation Great Powers liked to let their disciples get a feel for higher stages in advance, to aid in their cultivation.
"Buy one and try it, there's no loss." Lu Yang encouraged Meng Jingzhou to buy one.
Meng Jingzhou thought so too, besides, it was not expensive, so he bought one.
He went to the counter and found the Senior Brother on duty.
"Senior Brother, I want to use this experience voucher."
After the Senior Brother confirmed that it was authentic, he nodded, "You can use it now."
Meng Jingzhou asked out of curiosity, "Senior Brother, what's this experience voucher for?"
As the Senior Brother contacted someone, he casually answered, "It allows you to experience the strength of a Golden Core Stage Cultivator."
Meng Jingzhou had a bad feeling about this. He was about to say something when someone patted him on the shoulder.
When Meng Jingzhou turned around, it was a Golden Core Stage Senior Brother with a shaved head and a kind look. He gave a toothy grin and said,
"Junior Brother, I heard you want to experience the strength of a Golden Core Stage Cultivator? Come, let's go out to the stage and have a sparring match."
Meng Jingzhou: "…"
Lu Yang, you set me up!

chapters.title: Chapter 205 - 204: Defend the Righteous Path (Thanks to Book Friend Ling Cage Bird for the league leader's reward)_1
chapters.content:
Soon after Meng Jingzhou was dragged away struggling, screams could be heard.
Lu Yang and Man Gu were focused on selecting their rewards.
"Man Gu, what do you want to buy?"
"I want to buy a writing manual. My master says my writing is not good and I need to practice more."
Man Gu was attracted by a writing manual on the exchange list.
"Thunderbolt Manual, Ha! What a domineering name! I'll take it!"
Lu Yang wanted to advise Man Gu to think more carefully, but before he could speak, Man Gu had already bought it.
The cover of the Thunderbolt Manual was a huge lightning bolt. The first page contained the user instructions.
"Let me see the instructions... When writing with a brush on the manual, once it goes beyond the edge, the manual will burst with powerful thunderbolts. Please use with caution."
"Attention: Please do not soak this manual in water, as there is a risk of electric leakage."
Man Gu: "..."
Is writing so dangerous now?
Man Gu didn't buy anything else. He wanted to use his remaining contribution points to go to the Refining Peak in order to strengthen his iron hammer.
Fighting while automatically reciting the "Words of the Saint" was not enough to fully display his identity as a Confucian Cultivator. Man Gu wanted to inscribe the "Words of the Saint" on his iron hammer and add two more corners to it, making sure that every strike punches a hole.
Perfect.
...
At the palace.
The Chief Eunuch had served Emperor Xia for over forty years. He thought he knew the ruler of the Great Xia Dynasty very well, but what came next completely shattered his understanding.
Emperor Xia, sitting on the imperial chair, saw Yun Zhi slowly approaching and actively stood up to welcome her with a smile on his face.
"Daoist Yun Zhi has arrived, please sit down."
Emperor Xia surprisingly prepared a chair for Yun Zhi. He then took his seat next to her, not returning to his Imperial chair.
"Bring the fruits that were just tribute from the south for Daoist Yun Zhi to taste."
A young eunuch quickly came over with a plate of fruit, which contained a variety of fruits, some resembling lychees and some resembling bananas...
Yun Zhi peeled a fruit that looked like a lychee. Inside was a golden pulp that contained astonishing natural treasures. Just eating one could improve a cultivator from the late stage of Qi Refinement all the way to the mid-stage of Foundation Establishment.
"The taste is not bad." Yun Zhi politely sampled and praised it. This delighted Emperor Xia.
"Quickly bring a box for Daoist Yun Zhi to take away!"
Even the Chief Eunuch, with his inherent ability to keep a straight face, looked slightly taken aback at this sight.
He had never seen the emperor treat anyone so cordially.
Yun Zhi stopped Emperor Xia's behavior. "Your Majesty doesn't have to be like this, just say what you want."
Emperor Xia ordered everyone to leave, leaving only him and Yun Zhi.
Rubbing his hands together in excitement, Emperor Xia asked, "I've heard that your cultivation level, Daoist Yun Zhi, seems to be much higher than that of our family's ancestor?"
Yun Zhi slowly shook her head. "It's just a small difference. Please don't exaggerate, Your Majesty."
Emperor Xia said, "Our ancestor has been feeling very superior lately, thinking he's invincible. This mindset is not conducive to cultivation. So I was thinking of finding someone to teach him a lesson. I thought about it, and I think you, Daoist Yun Zhi, are the most suitable."
Yun Zhi: "... Does Your Majesty have any grudges against your ancestor?"
To Yun Zhi's knowledge, Emperor Xia's Ancestor was not that kind of person.
Emperor Xia chuckled, "Daoist Yun Zhi, you really have a sense of humor. I've been tormented by my ancestor since I was a child. How could I possibly bear any grudges against him?"
Yun Zhi: "..."
"Alright, alright. What I said was just a joke. Please don't take it seriously." Emperor Xia's laughter subsided as he said this.
