Yun Zhi wanted to say that His Majesty didn't look like he was joking, but she decided it would be better not to say anything that could damage their relationship.
Yun Zhi was well aware of this simple formality.
"On your call, Daoist Yun Zhi summoned the Four Great Immortal Sects to the Great Xia Dynasty. I presume you've made a significant discovery while eradicating the Eternity Sect?"
"Yes." Yun Zhi simply nodded in response and didn't say anything else.
Seeing Yun Zhi remain silent, Emperor Xia thought she must have her reservations and said: "Daoist Yun Zhi, are you worried that the information will be leaked here? You don't have to worry about that. This place is protected by an Immortal-level array set up by our ancestor. Even an immortal would not be able to secretly eavesdrop."
"Or, are you implying that this information is too sensitive to be spoken of directly and must be expressed through gestures instead?"
Emperor Xia contemplated the meaning hidden in Yun Zhi's silence. Was she subtly indicating that the enemy was everywhere? Was silence the best method to handle the enemy? Was Daoist Buyu the key to resolving the issue?
Yun Zhi hesitated a moment before saying: "I just didn't want to repeat the same words with Your Majesty and then with the masters of the Four Great Immortal Sects."
Emperor Xia: "..."
The masters of the Four Great Immortal Sects soon arrived at the palace, including Qiu Jin'an from the Five Elements Sect, who had only parted ways with the others a short while ago.
Qiu Jin'an had not expected the Seek Dao Sect to act so quickly. In less than five days, the Eternity Sect had been eradicated, and even the breeding grounds established by the Eternity Sect's Master were sealed.
"Daoist Yun Zhi, nice to see you again." Qiu Jin'an greeted her with a bow.
"The Seek Dao Sect did a splendid job! One of the Four Great Devil Sects has been eradicated directly! I wonder what reaction the remaining three devil sects will have when they hear this news. They must be terrified!" The Sect Leader of the Prison Suppressing Sect laughed heartily. There was no news more exhilarating than this.
He decided that once he returned to his sect, everyone would have a five-day holiday to celebrate.
"So it is." The Abbot of the Suspension Temple, holding his Buddhist beads, was sparing with his words, but his expression showed he was pleased.
Luo Hongxia, the Palace Master of the Laurel Fairy Palace, dared not speak to Yun Zhi for fear that Yun Zhi might bring up the marriage proposal between Lu Yang and Lan Ting.
Through this operation, the Four Great Immortal Sects changed their initial judgement of the Seek Dao Sect.
The former evaluation was: "The Four Great Immortal Sects defend the Righteous Path; the Seek Dao Sect shakes the Righteous Path."
Now, the assessment had changed to: "The Five Great Immortal Sects defend the Righteous Path."
Yun Zhi was not aware of their internal thoughts and went straight to the point.
"This time, I have convened you all here to share some information that we obtained from the Eternity Sect - information the Eternity Sect's own master did not know."
"Let me start with the conclusion."
"The existence of the Four Devil Sects may overturn our previous understanding. We used to think that the existence of the devil sects was simply the result of demon cultivators banding together, posing less of a threat than the upcoming Great Era."
"Now, I wish to correct my own view. I believe that the mastermind behind the Four Great Devil Sects is an ancient immortal. The purpose of their existence is to condense the Dao Fruit's embryonic form. At the appropriate time, this ancient immortal will take the Dao Fruit's embryonic form and convert it into his own power."
Upon hearing this, the five people were all stunned.
They were all of astonishing backgrounds, privy to many secrets associated with immortals, including matters about the Dao Fruit and its embryonic state.
Emperor Xia asked urgently: "Do you have evidence?"
The existence of the four devil sects was all to condense the Dao Fruit, and the ancient immortal took the Dao Fruit.
This meant that one immortal could have two Dao Fruits!
This was a terrifying prospect!
"Of course, I have a witness."
Yun Zhi snapped her fingers, and an old immortal appeared from another space."
"This is the Eternity Sect's belief, the Immortal Eternity."
"Nice to meet you elders, please call me Little Face."

chapters.title: Chapter 206 - 205: The Three Great Demon Sects (Thanks to book friend Lu Weilou for the Silver League reward)_1
chapters.content:
The emergence of the Immortal Eternity quickly caught everyone's attention.
"Little Face?"
Although Immortal Eternity was only five days old, his face appeared as if he only had five days of lifespan left. In no way could it be linked to the name "Little Face".
"Are all immortals this modest?" Qiu Jin'an looked at Immortal Eternity's respectful and ingratiating manner, finding it somewhat strange.
Qiu Jin'an looked at Yun Zhi, attributing the change in Immortal Eternity's attitude to the stern warning he had received from her.
"Looking at his cultivation level, he doesn't seem to be an Immortal?" Among the present company, aside from Yun Zhi, the Abbot of the Suspension Temple had the highest cultivation level.
The Abbot of the Suspension Temple used the Heavenly Eye Technique, examining Immortal Eternity from head to toe, discovering that his cultivation level hadn't reached that of an Immortal and was at most on par with his own, if not slightly inferior.
Emperor Xia hesitated as he looked at Immortal Eternity, feeling he saw something familiar about him.
"Is this... the power of incense and belief?"
The foundation of Great Xia and the power of incense and belief were similar concepts. According to Emperor Xia, this was called "the will of the people".
Therefore, Emperor Xia had the clearest understanding of Immortal Eternity's origin. Other sect leaders also noticed some clues but none saw as clearly as Emperor Xia did.
"Could it be that he was born from the thoughts of the believers of the Eternity Sect?"
Yun Zhi nodded: "Correct, and it's not just his birth. His nascent Dao Fruit was born in the same manner too."
"He has a nascent Dao Fruit?!" Upon hearing this, everyone was shocked.
To Fairy Eternity, nascent Dao Fruit seemed like an almost worthless piece of junk - not good enough to be considered. That's because she herself was an Immortal and a holder of the Eternity Dao Fruit.
What was a Dao Fruit? It was nearly equivalent to an Immortal - a supreme treasure.
As an incomplete form of a Dao Fruit, a nascent Dao Fruit's value was just a notch below that of the supreme treasure. If taken back to ancient times, it would be enough to incite wars capable of destroying stars.
The dazzling nascent Dao Fruit appeared before everyone, with the high rule of "Eternity" inside it continuously flashing and being destroyed.
The high rule of Eternity was too profound; if the will was not strong or the realm was not enough, one glance would affect the mind and impact the path of cultivation in the future.
This was exactly why Fairy Eternity did not allow Lu Yang to view the nascent Dao Fruit.
The cultivation level of everyone present was at least at the unbeatable level in the Unification Realm. They all had their own path, so they wouldn't lose their minds due to the high rule of Eternity.
"This is the nascent Eternity Dao Fruit."
"Eternity Dao Fruit?" The people present knew nothing about the existence of Fairy Eternity.
From an outsider's perspective, the existence of Fairy Eternity was a forbidden ultimate secret of the ancients. Hidden in the dust of history, unknowable, untraceable, if Fairy Eternity's existence were revealed, a shocking event that would shake all ages would occur.
However, neither Lu Yang nor Fairy Eternity had any concept of it.
Yun Zhi had no intention of revealing the matter of Fairy Eternity. Even though the people present were reliable and trustworthy, and she was not worried about eavesdroppers here, if the Four Immortals of the Ancients wanted, and they used extreme means like soul searching on the people present, Fairy Eternity's secret would no longer be safe.
Yun Zhi was not sure what the reaction of the Four Immortals of the Ancients would be after knowing that Fairy Eternity had been resurrected.
She explained calmly: "As I speculate, Eternity Dao fruit, as the name suggests, allows one to attain immortality."
"What is the difference between immortality and the everlasting life of an immortal?" asked Emperor Xia.
According to him, once one becomes an immortal, one transcends lifespan limitations, won't die of old age, and it is in the true sense, everlasting.
During the last meeting of the Five Great Immortal Sects, Yun Zhi explained the method of resurrecting Immortal Eternity, and the Five Great Immortal Sects understood the meaning of Eternity.
However, Emperor Xia was not invited to that meeting.
Yun Zhi said: "Immortals are everlasting but can still die in battle or be killed by others, and can't be resurrected. But an immortal who holds an Eternity Dao fruit, as long as someone utters their title and real name, can resurrect the Immortal on the spot, achieving true undying immortality."
"In other words, as long as someone is aware of an Immortal's existence, the Immortal will not die."
"If someone accidentally stumbles upon their title and real name, the Immortal can also be resurrected."
Emperor Xia's pupils abruptly contracted. It was no wonder that a Dao Fruit could change the rules of the world. This function was indeed unreasonably dominant.
"This nascent Eternity Dao Fruit was also born from the belief of the followers. Although it is not as mature as a real Dao fruit, given enough time, it might also mature."
The Sect Leader of the Prison Suppressing Sect frowned: "Does this mean that the Yaoyang Sect, Nine Nether Sect, and Ruthless Sect might also have similar nascent Dao Fruits?"
The Yaoyang Sect, Nine Nether Sect, and Ruthless Sect are the other three of the Three Great Demon Sects.
The Yaoyang Sect believes that the sun is the supreme existence, the beginning and end of all things, containing the power to create and end everything. Even the ubiquitous Spiritual Energy emanates from the sun.
The Nine Nether Sect believes that after a person dies, their soul goes to a place called Nine Nether where their sins are cleansed, and they are reincarnated, coming back to the human world.
The Ruthless Sect is the most special. Although all its members are from the human race, the mainstream of the Cultivation World refers to them as "Evil Demons" and doesn't regard them as part of the human race.
The Ruthless Sect believes that feelings are shackles that the heavens have put on living beings, limiting their potential. They advocate for living beings to free themselves from these shackles and embrace freedom in order to fully tap into their potential.
Members of the Ruthless Sect are people who have freed themselves from these shackles. They are heartless people who stop at nothing to achieve their goals.
According to the captives of the Ruthless Sect, when they broke free from the shackles of emotions, they felt a lightness in their body and the whole world seemed to become open and vast to them.
Loved ones, friends, lovers... none of these became factors limiting their cultivation anymore. Instead, they became materials for their cultivation practice.
"The possibility of the remaining three Demon Sects having nascent Dao Fruits is just my guess. It may not be true."
Yun Zhi couldn't guarantee that her conjecture was accurate. For instance, during the previous discussion with Master Daoyan from the Heavenly Strategy Sect about the purpose of the Eternity Sect, Master Daoyan's conjecture was closer to the truth, while Yun Zhi's was somewhat off the mark.
"In any case, the Eternity Sect has been eradicated. Luckily the problem was exposed in time, giving us a new understanding of the other three Demon Sects," Emperor Xia concluded.
Then, Emperor Xia proposed a series of measures to strengthen the countermeasures against the Demon Sects, which had the sect leaders of the Five Great Immortal Sects nodding in agreement incessantly.
Emperor Xia was most adept at this.
Before the meeting ended, Yun Zhi mentioned something else.
"After your majesty interrogates the Eternity Sect's Master and Deputy Master, and all information has been gathered, can you hand these two over to the Seek Dao Sect for handling?"
Emperor Xia paused before nodding in agreement. Strictly speaking, the entire Eternity Sect was Yun Zhi's spoils of war. She just didn't claim it and gave it to Great Xia. Of course, she could ask for it back whenever she wanted.
"May I ask, what do you intend to do with these two, Yun Zhi?"
"The Sect is in need of a slaughterhouse."
"Excuse me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 207 - 206: Draw the Ground into a Prison (Thanks to Book Friend Ling Cage Bird for the league leader's reward)_1
chapters.content:
Emperor Xia bid farewell to the heads of the Five Great Immortal Sects and was called by his ancestor to the forbidden area where he had important matters to discuss.
"Ancestor, what is it?" Emperor Xia arrived at the forbidden area and respectfully saluted his ancestor.
After waiting for a long half-day, Emperor Xia did not receive a response from his ancestor, so he cautiously raised his head.
As he looked up and saw the sardonic smile on his ancestor's face, he retreated a few steps subconsciously.
"I heard you were encouraging Yun Zhi earlier to give me a lesson?"
Emperor Xia was shocked. The palace was enveloped in an Immortal Array, and only he and Yun Zhi were present. How did his ancestor know?!
"Nonsense, the Immortal Array was set up by me. Of course, I can listen to whatever I want!"
"Darn kid, I must not have hit you enough when you were little!" His ancestor reached out a large hand and dragged Emperor Xia into the forbidden area.
"Ancestor, please be gentle. I was raised under your watchful eye. Hurting me is like hurting yourself!"
"Don't worry, my heart is as solid as steel!"
Soon, mournful cries came from the forbidden area.
No wonder there were rumors in the palace of an immortal omen suppressed within the forbidden area, its agonized wails echoing out whenever subjected to the Array Method.
Of course, some eunuchs and maidservants speculated that it might be Emperor Xia crying out. However, such speculation was highly disrespectful and not widely spread.
Even if it was spread around, people would most likely treat it as a false rumour.
…
"Brother Lu, would you like to learn a new magic skill? Senior Brother Ji Hongwen is offering to teach." Lu Yang was practising his sword arts in a neat white outfit when Man Gu approached him, accompanied by Meng Jingzhou.
"I too was invited by Man Gu," explained Meng Jingzhou, smiling. Who wouldn't be happy to learn an additional magic skill?
"Why would Senior Brother Ji Hongwen suddenly want to teach us magic skills?" asked Lu Yang, puzzled.
Ji Hongwen is the head disciple of the Confucian Fourth Elder, an expert in painting and is on par with Elder Dai Bufan in terms of cultivation level.
"Ah, like this," Man Gu explained, "I think the way Confucian Cultivators fight should be more elegant. My way of fighting with a large hammer isn't a proper Confucian method, so I wanted to learn some elegant skills."
Lu Yang stared at Man Gu in amazement and awe.
Could it be that Man Gu was challenging the curse set by Fairy Eternity on the Barbarian tribe? This was something to be celebrated!
"Moreover, I sent my hammer to Li Haoran for upgrades and can't practice my hammer methods for a while, so I might as well do something else."
"Then I approached Senior Brother Ji and asked if he could teach me a few Confucian magic skills. He said he could, so I asked if you two could also join, and he agreed. Here I am, coming to find you and Brother Meng."
Lu Yang nodded in appreciation: "Thank you."
Man Gu immediately responded, "Brother Lu, there's no need for that. From following you and Brother Meng, I've learned many teachings. This is just me taking advantage of the situation, asking Senior Brother Ji to teach you while teaching me."
Meng Jingzhou slapped Man Gu on the shoulder: "That's called 'going with the flow'."
"Brother Meng is indeed knowledgeable."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
The three arrived at a bamboo grove where Senior Brother Ji Hongwen was taking a nap in a gazebo. The moment they stepped into the grove, he woke up.
Lu Yang shook his head, this sleep quality was far inferior to Fairy Eternity's.
Even now, Fairy Eternity was still asleep, sleeping very soundly indeed.
"You're here?" Senior Brother Ji greeted them with a smile.
"Greetings, Senior Brother Ji!" The trio saluted and spoke in unison.
Senior Brother Ji put on a serious expression: "Man Gu asked me to teach him a Confucian magic skill, and I see no problem with it. However, learning these skills is notoriously difficult and you may not manage to master them. You three are all geniuses, and I hope that even if you fail to learn, you will not be disheartened."
Man Gu looked at Lu Yang confidently: "Brother Lu's talent in magic far surpasses mine, he'll definitely be able to learn it!"
Senior Brother Ji shook his head and smiled, thinking that Man Gu had exaggerated his words.
Other than Eldest Senior Sister, who could guarantee they can definitely learn when they study magic skills?
"The magic skill I'm going to teach you is called 'Draw the Ground into a Prison.'"
"You all should have heard of this magic skill. All you need to do is draw a circle on the ground, and your opponent can be confined within it. Combine this with a fierce offensive, they have nowhere to run and must endure your attack!"
Their eyes brightened. They hadn't expected this magic skill, known as Draw the Ground into a Prison, to be so well-known.
Simply drawing a circle to confine the opponent was incredibly elegant, a truly first-rate Immortal Technique!
"Let me show you."
Senior Brother Ji extended a finger, using his hand as a brush, he lightly drew a circle around Lu Yang and the others. They found themselves blocked by an invisible barrier, unable to leave.
Man Gu and Meng Jingzhou tried to burst through the barrier using brute strength, but to no avail.
Lu Yang wanted to use a technique to escape underground, but he was solidly knocked to the ground and also failed.
"Haha, that's Draw the Ground into a Prison." Senior Brother Ji casually erased the circle.
"To master Draw the Ground into a Prison, you must first be able to draw a circle freehand, and secondly, memorize the incantation."
Senior Brother Ji asked the three to draw circles. The circles they drew were crooked and meandering, like circles made by a few caterpillars.
"Look at what you've drawn, it's like an egg." Meng Jingzhou mocked Lu Yang.
Lu Yang glanced at Meng Jingzhou's drawing: "Yours is worse than mine, it's like a tea egg."
"Tea eggs are worth more than your egg."
"They're more trouble to make."
The point of their argument gradually veered away from the drawing.
"Practice more, it's not hard for a cultivator to control their body to draw." Senior Brother Ji instructed the three, and Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou finally stopped their pointless squabble.
Sure enough, as Senior Brother Ji said, as long as they consciously controlled their bodies, they could draw circles freehand very quickly.
"Next, I'll teach you an incantation. Listen carefully, not only do you need to remember the words, but also the tones of each word!"
"The power cannot enter, the argument cannot counter..."
The three listened carefully, trying hard to remember each word and its tone. After a few stumbles and falls, they finally memorized it all.
"In the end, the most difficult part is to utterly comprehend the incantation. The natural circulation of the spiritual essence within your body can cast the spell successfully!"
Ji Hongwen warned the three that they could not afford to slack off when learning to Draw the Ground into a Prison.
Man Gu silently recited the mantra, trying to cast Draw the Ground into a Prison. He circled himself round and round, but never succeeded.
Meng Jingzhou was a bit better than Man Gu, probably because he was more insightful. After many attempts, a few circles occasionally formed an invisible cage. But the success rate was too low, it could certainly not be used in actual combat.
"Don't worry if you can't get it yet. When I was learning this magic skill, I was at the Golden Core stage. Even then, I still needed five days to master it." Ji Hongwen, fearful of demoralizing them, did not tell them he had actually learned it in two days.
"Let's see how Lu Yang is doing?"
At the moment, Lu Yang's eyes were closed, and the mantra repeated itself in his mind over and over. He imagined himself to be the creator of the spell, picturing the mindset he would have when creating it.
Lu Yang opened his eyes, which shone brightly.
"I've got it!" Lu Yang's voice was full of confidence, both composed and unrestrained, like a master with fifty years of martial arts training, defeating a strong enemy with ease on the arena.
Lu Yang's voice caught the attention of Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu, who stopped their practice to observe Lu Yang's progress.
Could Lu Yang actually succeed in one go?
Even Man Gu, who was immensely impressed by Lu Yang's talent for magic skills, did not think that Lu Yang could be successful.
At least practice a few more times.
Following Senior Brother Ji's method, Lu Yang extended his forefinger and drew a perfect circle around himself.
"Draw the Ground into a Prison!"
Then, Lu Yang noticed a change in the scenery around him.
Dark and lifeless, completely silent, he was trapped by pillars, with heavy soil overhead.
This was dungeon.
Lu Yang: "....So what I've learned is how to 'draw a dungeon'?"

chapters.title: Chapter 208 - 207 Senior Brother Ji: I know where the problem lies (Thanks to book friend Mubai Jin Jade for the alliance leader reward)_1
chapters.content:
Just as Lu Yang was pondering how to escape his self-made prison, Fairy Eternity woke from her slumber.
Seeing Lu Yang trapped in a cell, she cheered up, "Lu Yang, have you finally landed yourself in trouble and getting the punishment you deserve?"
Lu Yang: ".... Can't you wish me so something good for once?"
"Alright then, I wish you a successful sentence reduction."
Lu Yang took a deep breath and reluctantly explained, "I'm actually practicing magic skills, I just encountered a minor setback."
"What kind of magic skill are you practicing?" Fairy Eternity was curious. What kind of magic could imprison oneself in a cell?
"Draw the Ground into a Prison."
"I see."
As they were talking, a large hand suddenly appeared and pulled Lu Yang out of the ground. It was Ji Hongwen.
Senior Brother Ji had been watching as Lu Yang buried himself in the ground, constructing a cell with mud.
Senior Brother Ji was utterly confused. Did the magic I taught have anything in common with the magic you learnt, lad?
Oh, they have the same name.
That's even more ridiculous!
Meeting Senior Brother Ji's perplexed gaze, Lu Yang innocently blinked his eyes.
"Senior Brother Ji, can my 'Draw the Ground into a Prison' spell be saved?"
Senior Brother Ji calmly nodded, "The Saint advocates equal teaching for all. As long as the method is right, there's no student that can't be taught. I can definitely teach you!"
Lu Yang was overjoyed. See, Senior Brother Ji was the reliable one.
"Show me your results again. This time, draw a circle around me. Let's see what's wrong."
"Okay."
Lu Yang recalled his state just now when he was casting the spell, and drew a circle around Senior Brother Ji with his hand.
The circle was perfect and followed the principles of a round shape.
Then Senior Brother Ji felt a sudden heaviness in his body and found himself in a dungeon.
Senior Brother Ji: "..."
He blinked in bewilderment, failing to understand what had just happened.
As a Unification-stage cultivator, he could easily resist being imprisoned if he wanted to. However, in doing so, he wouldn't be able to understand how Lu Yang learned the spell incorrectly.
Senior Brother Ji often teaches on behalf of the Fourth Elder, making him somewhat of a teacher.
As a teacher, he should be able to teach his students.
Before he can effectively teach the students, he needs to fully understand them.
Senior Brother Ji tapped on the dirt pillars and found that the dungeon was sturdy enough to hold a mid-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator. It could be considered a method of combat.
However, he still didn't understand where Lu Yang went wrong.
Senior Brother Ji broke out of the cell: "Try it again."
Lu Yang once again used his hand as a pointer and put Senior Brother Ji back into the cell.
Senior Brother Ji kept burrowing in and out of the ground like a mole. After dozens of times, just as Lu Yang was about to perform the spell again, Senior Brother Ji halted him.
"I know where the problem is." Senior Brother Ji nodded solemnly, his eyes deep.
Lu Yang was overjoyed and eagerly asked Senior Brother Ji what was wrong.
"The problem is that I shouldn't be teaching you."
"Huh?"
Senior Brother Ji sighed in his heart. It wasn't that he wasn't upholding the Saint's idea, it was that he was incapable of understanding Lu Yang.
He even suspected that it wasn't that he couldn't teach Lu Yang, but even the Saint himself would fail to do so.
"Man Gu, Jingzhou, the two of you remember to practice more."
"Yes."
After practicing for so long, Meng Jingzhou gradually grasped the trick of 'Draw the Ground into a Prison', significantly improving his success rate. As for Man Gu, was still drawing circles without entrapping anyone.
Having said that, Senior Brother Ji drifted away, leaving behind the trio of circle-drawers.
"It's over, Senior Brother Ji gave up on you." Meng Jingzhou chuckled at Lu Yang.
"Draw the Ground into a Prison!" Furious and embarrassed, Lu Yang quickly drew a circle around Meng Jingzhou who let out a cry as he was imprisoned.
Breaking out of the prison, Meng Jingzhou started fighting back by trapping Lu Yang in a circle: "Draw the Ground into a Prison!"
"Draw the Ground into a Prison!"
"Draw the Ground into a Prison!"
"Draw the Ground into a Prison!"
"Draw the Ground into a Prison!"
"Damned beast, you've caused boundless murder and countless aggrieved souls. Watch as I suppress you in a dungeon forever!"
"Bare-headed monk, it's yet to be seen who'll suppress who today. I'd like to see whether you can escape from the circle this demon lord has drawn!"
"Take this!"
"Take this!"
The two of them practiced the newly-learned spell in real combat, visibly improving their proficiency.
Only Man Gu was single-minded, repeatedly drawing circles on the spot.
They battled till the end, running out of mana power and calling a mutual truce.
Both of them sat on the ground panting heavily. While fighting, they had been shouting their spells until their throats went dry. They formed a water ball in the air using the last of their magic and drank heartily.
"Senior Brother Man, I've finally found you." A figure walked into the bamboo forest, reaching Man Gu.
"Li Haoran?" Lu Yang recognized the newcomer.
"So Junior Brother Lu and Senior Brother Meng are also here." Li Haoran greeted.
"Senior Brother Man, I've modified the big hammer you entrusted me to. It's ready now."
"So soon, quick, quick, quick, let me see." Hearing about the upgraded version of his weapon, Man Gu was impatient and excited.
Without saying more, Li Haoran took out a giant iron hammer, as tall as a person, from his Identity Jade.
The hammerhead section of the giant iron hammer looked like a huge red agate, which gave a heavy impression. In the sunlight, it shimmered brightly. The handle was changed to pure white, matching Man Gu's white Confucian robe perfectly.
"Not bad, not bad." Man Gu weighed the hammer, swinging it a couple of times, the sound of the wind indicated its weight. He was very satisfied.
The crucial function of playing "Words of the Saint" during battle was also retained by Li Haoran.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou wore strange expressions: "Junior Brother Li, are you sure this is an iron hammer?"
"Yes." Li Haoran confidently nodded.
Meng Jingzhou complained, "Yes, my foot! This isn't an iron hammer at all, but a jumbo lollipop. Man Gu was even licking the hammerhead just now!"
Li Haoran explained his reason for the modification. "Originally, Senior Brother Man suggested adding protrusions at both ends of the hammer. Considering that he is a Confucian cultivator, I proposed to him, saying that swinging around a heavy iron hammer is ungraceful behavior and contradicts people's impressions of Confucian cultivators."
"Yet Senior Brother Man likes to fight with an iron hammer. So, I came up with a compromise - turn the hammer into a jumbo lollipop. It's more popular. During battle, it can be a weapon, during leisure hours, it can be a snack. Carrying a giant iron hammer on the street can even attract children, thereby increasing its popularity with the public. It's a win-win!"
Indeed, no weapon could be more popular than a giant lollipop.
Lu Yang: "..."
It's over, I actually think that what Li Haoran said makes some sense. Have I been influenced by Fairy Eternity?
Man Gu added, "Moreover, the lollipops made by Junior Brother Li are 20% cheaper than those in the cafeteria."
Only then did Lu Yang remember that the cafeteria business was also a product of the Refining Peak. You Li Haoran wouldn't be trying to set up a lollipop shop in the cafeteria, are you?
"It's not a matter of being cheaper or not... never mind, as long as you're happy." Lu Yang, too tired to complain, gave up.
"Hmm?" Lu Yang heard someone messaging him.
"What is it?"
"Eldest Senior Sister is back. She wants me to return to Sky Gate Mountain."

chapters.title: Chapter 209 - 208: The Eternity Sect's Immortal Treasures (thanks to book friend Zhi Zui Jin Mi for the alliance leader reward)_1
chapters.content:
"Eldest Senior Sister, you're back?" Hearing his Eldest Senior Sister call, Lu Yang eagerly returned to Sky Gate Mountain.
His Eldest Senior Sister still had her usual cold demeanor, "Mmm, I went to the palace to discuss some matters. I just returned and heard that you've reached the late stage of Foundation Establishment."
Lu Yang thought to himself that it must have been a puppet who informed his Senior Sister.
His Senior Sister scanned him with her gaze, as if seeing right through him, "Now that you've reached this stage in Foundation Establishment, you should start planning for the next step: forming a golden core."
"The step of forming a golden core is crucial for cultivators. In ancient times, before the advent of flying boats, because the Golden Core stage allows cultivators to fly freely in the sky, some regard it as the watershed between the mortal and the immortal. Others refer to it as the 'Way of Golden Core', revealing the importance of this realm."
"If you produce a first-grade golden core, then breaking the core to reach Nascent Soul stage will be a natural progression."
"Of course, as a Sword Spirit Root, your talents are out of the ordinary. Therefore, producing a first-grade Golden Core will not be difficult for you. What you should consider is what type of first-grade Golden Core you want to form."
"Our sect's disciples have countless types of Golden Cores recorded in the Scripture Pavilion, you can browse through them there to gain some inspiration."
"Understood."
"Also, take this. It will be helpful for you." Before leaving, his Senior Sister produced a small medicine bottle from her pocket.
"What's this?" Lu Yang wondered to himself if it was an elixir that could ensure his golden core's formation being first-grade or an elixir that could prevent damaging his Spirit Root if he fails in forming his golden core?
As expected of his Senior Sister, she could even get her hands on such a great thing.
"Eyedrops. Use a couple of drops if you read too much."
"..."
"Thank you for your concern, Senior Sister."
"Could the elder come out for a moment?" his Senior Sister called out Fairy Eternity.
"What is it?" Fairy Eternity was somewhat nervous, quickly racking her brain to determine if she'd done anything wrong.
Recently she'd been very well-behaved, she couldn't have caused any trouble for Lu Yang, could she have? At most, she'd been sleeping while he was cultivating.
His Senior Sister pulled out a large collection of Immortal Treasures. Each one was unique and emitted a halo of immortality energy, clearly not ordinary items.
"These are Immortal Treasures seized from the Eternity Sect, is there anything the elder wishes to have?" His Senior Sister intended to return things to their rightful owner.
Fairy Eternity glanced over the items and pouted, "Nothing I want."
"Elder, what is this?" His Senior Sister picked up a bamboo needle. Among the Immortal Treasures, there were many items that she wasn't familiar with, having spent a long time researching with the scholars of the Great Xia Dynasty without coming to any conclusions, she decided to ask the original owner.
This needle was king among hidden weapons. It was easily controlled by one's will, had a high speed, and could break through defenses.
"A toothpick."
"What about this?" His Senior Sister picked up an iron rod. After her inspection, she found that it was coated with a powerful poison, with traces of a lost ancient poison that was only recorded in ancient texts, and an unidentifiable medicine.
The scholars of the Great Xia Dynasty had concluded that it must have been an ancient immortal's stirring rod used in poison refinement, and it took on its current form after long-term exposure to various poisons.
"Chopsticks."
"What about this?" His Senior Sister opened the lid of a porcelain jar, and a cloying scent filled the air. The jar was filled with black liquid that seemed to seethe with countless souls.
"Oh oh, this is the vinegar that I brewed. I can't believe the Eternity Sect was still storing this good stuff. Can I have it back?"
His Senior Sister contemplated for a moment, deciding to refuse Fairy Eternity's request out of safety considerations.
"You don't keep your word!" Fairy Eternity put her hands on her hips and admonished his Senior Sister.
His Senior Sister turned a deaf ear.
"What is this used for?" His Senior Sister pointed at a cloth that was nine feet long and nine feet wide.
According to the high echelons of the Eternity Sect, the cloth contained spatial powers and could wrap up anything. Even if a person were to stand on it, they would be unable to leave the boundary of the cloth no matter how much they tried.
"It's a bedsheet. After my refinement, it replaces the mattress. When I sleep, I can roll around on the bed without falling off."
"I don't have a physical body now, so this thing isn't of much use to me, you guys can keep it."
"What about this one?" Eldest Senior Sister took out a round plate.
This round dish was incredibly firm and indestructible. Some scholars speculated that it was a shield from the ancient times, albeit a bit small. They also theorized that if activated correctly, it could appear above the enemy's head and immobilize them.
"It's a dinner plate I custom-made," Fairy Eternity complained, "Our dining plates back then were of poor quality, they used to leak, so I specially crafted a set for myself."
After asking around, Lu Yang found that the so-called immortal treasures of the Eternity Sect were actually Fairy Eternity's everyday items.
It wouldn't be wrong to say that these were indeed items that belonged to an immortal being, all possessing magical properties. For instance, the barrel that could contain thousands of miles of rivers and streams was her swimming pool. The Dream Pillow, even today, was venerated as a treasure by the Grand Elder.
...
"Skewers! Freshly grilled skewers, so smooth and tender!"
"Unique recipe, guaranteed to be addictive!"
"After one skewer, you'll lust for two, and after two, you'll crave ten——"
In the commercial area of the Seek Dao Sect, loud calls echoed through the streets. The appetizing aroma of barbecue lingered in the air and attracted many passers-by.
As nightfall approached, the disciples of the Seek Dao Sect who had been busy all day chose to rest, shop, and exchange cultivation experiences here.
Just as the slogans promised, the skewers from "Try One More" barbecue shop had their unique secrets, making many disciples return to feast the following evening.
Some suspected the store of lacing their food with addictive substances. However, after verification by the Seventh Elder of Elixir Cauldron Peak, it was confirmed that the skewers were just incredibly delicious, and there was no poisoning involved.
Three hooded individuals stood motionless in front of the barbecue store, seemingly lost in a daze. The bustling scene before them seemed distant and unreachable, and the faces of the passing customers became a blur.
One of the hooded individuals removed their hood, gazed at the lively barbecue store, and sighed deeply:
"Little Liu, Little Gao, are you two still alive?"
Hearing the familiar voice, Master Liu and Master Gao froze, thinking they were hearing things.
They looked up at the source of the voice, their faces filled with disbelief.
"Master?!"
"And me." The second hooded figure lifted his hood, revealing himself to be Vice Leader Jin.
At this moment, the highest-ranked members of the Eternity Sect, one Master and three Vice Leaders, had assembled here.
They used to be major figures, commanding one of the Four Great Devil Sects' absolute power. But now, they could only gather around a barbecue stall.
The Sect Master never blamed the downfall of the Eternity Sect on Vice Leaders Liu Gao, knowing fully well that the real culprit who invited the wolf into the room was himself, not others.
"You guys take a seat first, we'll pack up after completing a few more orders."
A long queue still lingered in front of the store. Master Liu and Master Gao asked the people behind not to queue anymore, announcing that they would close the stall after finishing five more orders.
The Sect Master noticed the waiter, who was a sect elder, cleaning up the tables and picking up skewers. Sighing silently, he shook his head, unable to describe the feelings inside.
After Masters Liu and Gao finished their last order and announced the end of business, they closed the shop and started reminiscing with the Sect Master.
"How did you guys end up here?"
Very few knew about the fall of the Eternity Sect, Masters Liu and Gao worked here as ordinary barbecue stall owners and were oblivious to the outside world.
"Well, it's a long story——" The Sect Master sighed deeply, his voice filled with countless regrets.
He detailed how Lu Yang and his accomplices infiltrated the Eternity Sect's headquarters, and how the Eternity Sect was subsequently besieged by the Great Xia Dynasty.
The devastating news about the fall of the Eternity Sect struck heavily, leaving everyone in silence. Master Liu soon admitted the reality of the sect's downfall and quickly regained his spirits.
"It's a good thing you guys came along. Currently, various factions have emerged within the Seek Dao Sect, presenting an opportune time for us to take action. We were just worried about being short-staffed, and here you guys are!" Master Liu gazed eagerly at the Sect Master and Vice Leader Jin.
The Sect Master's eyes lit up.

chapters.title: Chapter 210 - 209: The Three Giants of Seek Dao Sect (Thanks to the alliance leader tipped by the book friend Rampage Boss)_1
chapters.content:
The Sect Master had assumed that their downfall was irreversible, that they were doomed to live a mediocre life within the Seek Dao Sect. Unexpectedly, in Vice Sect Leader Liu, he found new hope!
It seems the Seek Dao Sect is not as united as he thought. There are open conflicts and hidden rivalries within. And what are they, the Demon Path, best at, if not sowing discord?
"Speak. How many factions are there within the Seek Dao Sect?" The Sect Master asked in a hurry.
Master Liu opened a barrier and set up several Array Methods capable of preventing sound leakage and spying via Spiritual Sense.
Seeing Vice Sect Leader Liu's thorough preparations, the Sect Master felt a bit embarrassed. In his haste, he had neglected to take measures to prevent information leakage.
The five Elders of the Eternity Sect hesitated, unsure of whether or not they should continue to listen. This seemed like a top-secret meeting that people of their level shouldn't eavesdrop on.
The Sect Master gestured them over. They were the remaining strength of the Eternity Sect, thus rightfully entitled to the discussion.
Seeing everyone has taken their seats, Master Liu lowered his voice and said, "Currently, there are three factions we can contact. These three factions are headed by the three biggest powers within the Seek Dao Sect, with all the disciples unable to evade their control.
Each of these three powers has several Unification Stage figures in command, including some major figures at the late stage of Unification!"
The Sect Master nodded. It was not surprising that the three major powers within the Seek Dao Sect had late-stage Unification figures. "Are there any Transcendence Tribulation Stage powers?"
Master Liu shook his head: "Not yet discovered. Such old monsters seldom reveal their stance. They are likely not part of the three major powers!"
Vice Sect Leader Jin sighed in relief: "Good, no Transcendence Tribulation Stage. With our means, maneuvering among the three big powers isn't difficult. What's their relationship? Is there room for manoeuvre?"
Master Liu agreed with Vice Sect Leader Jin's idea. The threat from the Transcendence Tribulation Stage was too great. In the face of absolute strength, any scheme was useless. He continued, "Don't be fooled by my daily roasting on the street. I always pay attention to the conversation among the Seek Dao Sect's disciples.
I can deduce the relationship among the three major powers from complicated information."
Master Liu placed three bowls on the table to represent the three major powers.
"The three major powers are the century-old Hundred Fragrance Building, the stir-fried dishes mainstay Street Food Union, and the diversified Hot Pot Alliance."
"The Hundred Fragrance Building has been on the commercial street for the longest time. As far as I know, some disciples have been eating there since they joined the sect. They still enjoy their food after reaching the Unification Stage. Not only is the taste excellent, but it also holds sentimental value for them. It's the most influential of the three major powers!"
Master Liu flipped a large bowl upside down to represent the Hundred Fragrance Building.
"The Street Food Union is not just one shop; it's a collection of several stores serving primarily stir-fry, all of them different in flavor, attracting disciples from all corners of Seek Dao Sect. It is the second-largest of the three powers."
Master Liu flipped a medium bowl upside down to represent the Street Food Union.
"Then there is the Hot Pot Alliance, the largest hot pot restaurant on the commercial street. Many hot pot restaurants have it backing them. It's like a giant black hand unseen, manipulating the rise and fall, as well as the menu of the commercial street's hot pot restaurants. But compared to stir-fry, hot pot lacks variety, so business is not as good as the Street Food Union's.
It's ranked last among the three."
Master Liu flipped a small bowl upside down to represent the Hot Pot Alliance.
"The dishes at the Hundred Fragrance Building are high-end, some even equivalent to top-grade medicinal dishes that significantly improve one's Cultivation Level. Only the wealthy and powerful are patrons there. Hence, the Hundred Fragrance Building stands aloof, disdainful of the competition with the other two major powers."
"In the competition between the Street Food Union and the Hot Pot Alliance, the latter lacks depth and falls behind."
"Although our barbecue shop is just starting, it has a booming business. Given time, it will not lose to the three major powers; its potential is immense. I believe we can form an alliance with the Hot Pot Alliance to confront the Street Food Union!"
Master Gao chimed in: "Also, from a geographical perspective, the Hot Pot Alliance is very close to us, only half a street away, which aligns with the military concept of making distant friends and attacking those nearby!"
Master Gao, well-versed in military strategy, was the barbecue shop's think tank.
"Above the three big powers, there is another superior power, which is the cafeteria!"
"Whether it is in terms of background, customer flow, or consumption level, the cafeteria stands far above the three powers!"
"The good news is, the disciples of Seek Dao Sect are buying weapons, not food, at the cafeteria. According to their functional positioning, they do not intersect with us, so there is no need to worry about future conflicts with the cafeteria."
After the detailed and clear analysis from Master Liu and Master Gao, the Master and Vice Leader Jin had a rough grasp of the current situation.
Despite the initial difficulties, as long as it is run properly, it could potentially become the fourth giant!
Suddenly, Master Gao seemed worried: "In theory, we may be able to form an alliance with the Hot Pot Alliance, but after all, they are well-established giants, they may not be willing to cooperate with our barbecue shop with shallow foundations."
Master Gao is preparing to discuss with the Hot Pot Alliance tomorrow, but he has already prepared for rejection.
Seeing Master Gao worried, the Master showed a faint smile, and he took out a piece of paper representing the will of the high-up Seek Dao Sect, and placed it in front of everyone.
"Can you divine what this is?"
Upon seeing the text on the paper, the pupils of Master Liu, Master Gao, and the five high-level members of the Eternity Sect contracted.
One of the high-level members of Eternity Sect exclaimed in a lose of words: "This… this is the business license of a ranch!"
With confidence in his smile, The Master said: "Yes, this is our qualification to forge an alliance with the Hot Pot Alliance!"
"Be it barbecue shops or hot pot restaurants, the most needed is of course fresh ingredients. If given a chance, we could breed some precious Demon Beasts to supply the Hundred Fragrance Building. In this way, we will be connected with the Hundred Fragrance Building!"
Everyone gasped. Not bad for a Master, well prepared in advance.
"But the surprises don't stop here." The Master beckoned, and the third man in the black cloak revealed his true face.
From the beginning, the third man in the black cloak remained silent, just listening. Now, he removed his hood, revealing an old but kind face.
"Believers, we meet for the first time, you can call me Immortal Eternity."
"Immortal Eternity!!" Everyone was genuinely shocked. They never thought that Immortal Eternity would be resurrected!
With the Master as the guarantor, everyone did not doubt the identity of Immortal Eternity.
Most importantly, they could sense an indescribable bond between them and Immortal Eternity. This connection could not be faked.
"Our regards to Immortal Eternity!" Master Liu and Master Gao led in kneeling.
"Our regards to Immortal Eternity!" The five high-level members of the Eternity Sect also knelt and paid their respects.
"Stand." Immortal Eternity spoke calmly, "I have reached an agreement with the Seek Dao Sect. As long as I do not leave the Seek Dao Sect, I can move freely!"
"After much consideration, I felt this place suits me best."
"Having listened to you talk on and on earlier, I am somewhat disappointed." In Immortal Eternity's eyes was a look of discontent.
"You are all in the Unification stage, do you plan to spend your lives running a barbecue shop and ranch within the Seek Dao Sect? Are you content with this!"
"Please enlighten us!" The Master and the others thought back to the days when they were all high-ranking individuals who made the earth shake. Now, when they are given the opportunity to become one of the top forces, they are proud. They felt deep shame.
"Is Seek Dao Sect the only goal you have? If you are going to start, aim for chain stores all over the Central Continent!"
"If you're going to do it, make it the biggest, make it the best!"

chapters.title: Chapter 211 - 210: The Strongest Golden Core (Thanks to reader Little Bud for the Alliance Leader reward)_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang, heeding the advice of his eldest senior sister, obediently went to the Scripture Pavilion.
At the entrance of the Scripture Pavilion, he bumped into Senior Sister Zhou Lulu whom he hadn't seen since she took him to the cafeteria to buy weapons.
"Senior Sister Zhou Lulu, long time no see."
Engrossed in her book, Zhou Lulu looked up upon hearing Lu Yang's voice and laughed, "It's Junior Brother Lu, it's you who haven't seen me in a while. When you were the sect leader a few days ago, who hadn't seen you?"
Lu Yang laughed awkwardly, not knowing what to say.
He couldn't very well tell her that it wasn't actually him who wanted to be sect leader, but the sixteen-year-old fairy inside him.
"You haven't visited the Scripture Pavilion for two or three months. Are you looking for a particular book?"
"I want to find a book about how to form a golden core."
Zhou Lulu had a sudden realization, "Oh right, you're in the late stage of foundation establishment now, it's time for you to consider forming a golden core."
"How did Senior Sister Zhou form a golden core?"
Senior Sister Zhou recalled her past experience, saying, "It was a rainy day. I was reading under the eave, and before I knew it, the words in the book started to jump off the pages and enter my mind. The words traveled from my mind, passed through my internal organs, and arrived at my Dantian.
From there, my spiritual essence transformed from mist into liquid, became a trickling stream, and merged with the words to form a golden core."
"Senior Sister Zhou, you're so gifted!" praised Lu Yang. He had heard that among those with exceptional talents, the formation of a golden core was a natural process that did not require much focus. Some geniuses even managed to accomplish it while taking a nap.
For example, Huang Dudu, a famous genius from ancient times, had formed his golden core during a nap.
Zhou Lulu waved her hands in embarrassment, "Junior Brother Lu, you shouldn't say that. In our sect, there are many senior brothers and sisters with greater talents than mine. They experienced a lot of difficulties when forming their golden cores. We shouldn't judge talents solely based on how easily one forms a golden core."
"I heard that Senior Brothers Dai Bufan and Ji Hongwen had to make a lot of preparations and received the sect's assistance to successfully form their golden cores."
"You can find the book you need on the easternmost bookshelf on the first floor of the Scripture Pavilion."
Lu Yang thanked Senior Sister Zhou and walked into the Scripture Pavilion. However, he was a little perplexed. The Scripture Pavilion is rather large, with countless bookshelves against its walls. Whenever he needed to find a book in the past, Senior Sister Zhou would always tell him the exact row and column. So why was she so vague today?
Lu Yang soon discovered the reason.
The entire east wall of the Scripture Pavilion was lined with books about golden core formation experiences—some were external while the majority were the accumulated wisdom of the Seek Dao Sect over hundreds of thousands of years.
Books from a hundred thousand years ago were not displayed here—they were reproductions.
"Fairy, do you have any suggestions for forming a golden core?" Lu Yang decided to ask Fairy Eternity, who claimed to be one of the Five Immortals of the Ancients.
"In ancient times, I once saw a golden core that was acclaimed as the strongest First-Grade Golden Core. Even my golden core pales in comparison."
"There's such a golden core?" Lu Yang was surprised. Fairy Eternity is usually quite stubborn, never admitting that she's the least accomplished among the Five Immortals. It's unexpected that she would willingly admit her inferiority this time.
Moreover, different golden cores have different focuses. How can one be deemed the best?
"Before anyone managed to become an immortal in ancient times, there was intense competition among the geniuses. They competed in terms of techniques, resources, talents... During that era, I was undoubtedly the best. Immortals like Yingtian and Jiuchong were inferior to me, and I beat them till they fled in disarray."
"At that time, there was a genius who was extremely lucky in love. When he was forming his golden core, he was accompanied by seven beloved women, who were renowned talents, witches, and saintesses of the time. The man and his seven beloved women formed their golden cores together, each achieving a First-Grade Golden Core.
The man's golden core was the main force, and the seven women's golden cores served as secondary forces, forming a Seven-Star Arc position. In battle, that genius could convert the women's golden cores for his own use, boosting his combat power by at least sevenfold."
"This is the strongest golden core I know."
"Thank you, that's not helpful at all." Lu Yang rolled his eyes. He just treated it as listening to a story from Fairy Eternity. Where was he supposed to find seven beloved women?
I mean, is he supposed to gather the Seven Dwarfs or something?
"I also heard of another extremely powerful golden core, but I'm not sure how much truth there is to it since it happened before my time."
"During ancient times, there was a couple who were cultivators. Nothing was out of the ordinary when the wife formed her golden core—it was just a regular First-Grade Golden Core. However, as days went by, her golden core grew increasingly larger, and she appeared pregnant."
"The wife was 'pregnant' for three years until the golden core left her body automatically, shattered, and transformed into a Nascent Soul outside of her body."
"What happened next?"
"The wife then realized that it wasn't a Nascent Soul, it was her son."
"... Fairy, if you're fine, just go back to sleep."
"All these are the secrets of the ancients, which I don't usually tell people!" Fairy Eternity was quite displeased with Lu Yang's indifference.
She, the proclaimed head of the ancient immortals, the keeper of the Eternity Dao Fruit, was telling him information of an exorbitant value! He should be grateful!
Considering Fairy's unreliability, a consistent theme throughout his impression of her, Lu Yang decided not to take any shortcuts and began to diligently read the golden core formation experiences written by Elder Brother Disciples and former sect members.
"Single Golden Elixir, First-Grade Golden Elixir. The golden core is like a great sun, upright and unyielding. Settling in the center of the Dantian, it governs all directions, guards against evil spirits and prevents them from approaching. If it comes into contact with a female's charm, the golden core will be destroyed and the person will perish."
Lu Yang was quite lucky; merely flipping through a few pages of a book he randomly picked up, he found information relevant to Meng Jingzhou's golden core.
Lu Yang closed the book, noticing the cover read, "Comprehension on forming Golden Elixir —Authored by Daoist Shen Du".
Daoist Shen Du was the elder from the Cultivation World who named the Single Body Spiritual Root. This elder cultivator lived during the early period of the Great Yu dynasty. It's unclear whether he passed away from natural causes or buried himself, planning to resurrect when the Great Era arrived.
As Lu Yang continued reading, he realized that despite being marketed as a guide to golden core formation, the book read more like a litany of Daoist Shen Du's complaints.
"Damn you, Single Body Spiritual Root! Why do I have such an unprecedented spiritual root?"
"Am I being punished for sins I committed in my past life, or is it because I had too many wives in my previous life, and this is somehow creating balance?"
"Isn't cultivating all about having a wives and concubines? Why am I the only one who's different! What's the point of cultivating then!"
Lu Yang silently closed the book, put it back in its place, and acted as if nothing happened before moving on to the next book.
"Oh, this is the guide to golden core formation by Eldest Senior Sister?" Lu Yang felt like he had found a treasure. The thick book recorded the golden core formation methods and experiences of his senior brothers and sisters.
Naturally, the Eldest Senior Sister's experience was listed first.
He tried to contain his excitement as he read on, only to find his Eldest Senior Sister's words:
"My method of forming a golden core holds no reference value. Please do not imitate. Those who learn from me will die, those who mimic me will die. To prevent people from imitating my golden core formation process in the future, I will not disclose my method."

chapters.title: Chapter 212 - 211: The Method of Forming the Golden Core of Senior Brothers (Thanks to the book friend Shengxin Wujie for the reward of the Alliance Leader)_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang naturally turned the page on Eldest Senior Sister, looking at how other senior brothers and sisters formed their golden cores.
Given Lu Yang's understanding of Eldest Senior Sister, the method she used to form the golden core was not replicable.
Lu Yang heard that Eldest Senior Sister had pushed each realm to its limit, and when she shattered her core to reach nascent soul stage, it induced thunder tribulation as a punishment, which was very terrifying.
You must know that only when breaking through the Nascent Soul Stage to reach the Divinity Transformation Stage would one attract thunder tribulation. For thunder tribulation to occur at the Nascent Soul Stage was unprecedented!
A senior brother, attempting to mimic the method of Eldest Senior Sister, wished to form a nascent soul that would attract heavenly tribulation. He expended countless efforts, continuously reinforcing his foundation with strength from the Golden Core Stage, finally managing to break the core and reach nascent soul stage, attracting thunder.
Somewhat unexpectedly, the senior brother's nascent soul actively resisted, withstanding the power of the thunder tribulation and breaking it apart.
A nascent soul that could actively resist was something that even Eldest Senior Sister's nascent soul couldn't achieve. This was akin to having an additional powerful clone, and his battle strength surged.
Just when everyone thought they were witnessing the creation of new history, that senior brother's nascent soul, without uttering a word, beat the senior brother until he was down and out, and despite fiercely resisting, that senior brother was still defeated.
Even though that senior brother had already reached the Nascent Soul Stage, he was unable to defeat his own nascent soul.
In a sense, history was indeed created.
Daoist Buyu tried to help that senior brother control the nascent soul, but after several fruitless attempts, he could only shatter the nascent soul, advising the senior brother to use other methods to break the core to reach nascent, taking the normal path and avoid going around in circles.
This matter was too humiliating, so only those within the Seek Dao Sect knew about it.
As for the real name of that senior brother, it was known to few.
However, Lu Yang heard from Meng Jingzhou through small talk that the senior brother who lost face was Daoist Buyu's second disciple, his own Second Senior Brother.
This Senior Brother was currently training in the Western Golden Buddha Kingdom. Lu Yang hadn't had a chance to meet him yet. He'd only seen a black and white portrait of him in the main hall of Sky Gate Mountain.
Sometimes, when praying that Second Senior Brother's training was going smoothly, Lu Yang would light a stick of incense as a wish for him.
Lu Yang was fair in his treatment; he would also light a stick of incense for the Third Senior Sister casually.
"Let me look at Senior Brother Dai Bufan's golden core. The Water-wishful Golden Core, a first-grade golden core. It's clear and refreshing, spiritual but not cold. Gold and blue intertwine in the Dantian, and it self-circulates, self-practices, turning our spiritual essence into waves that diffuse inside our body, ensuring that our spiritual essence is always in its peak state."
"Cultivation method: Drink water everyday till the point of water intoxication, and then soak in a lake for ten days without emerging from the water. Imagine oneself as a fish, swimming freely in the lake, changing shape as wanted. At last, use the Dantian as a storage ring.
Use the power of space to store the water of a whole lake in your stomach, merge it with your own spiritual essence and compress it into a golden core."
"Cautions: Do not get lost in the imagination of being a fish, lest you bite the hook once you see the bait."
"Prior to storing a whole lake of water in your stomach, please give advance notice to avoid being arrested, just like what happened to me."
"Water intoxication is normal, please prepare corresponding elixirs before drinking water."
Seeing those three cautions, Lu Yang found it hard to imagine what Dai Bufan had encountered.
"Eh, it's a water-attributed golden core," Fairy Eternity's voice rang through the room.
Lu Yang was quite surprised: "Fairy, you're still awake?"
"I'll sleep when I'm tired of playing," Fairy Eternity brushed him off. "Speaking of water-attributed golden cores, I recall having had two opponents with them. Both of their cores were first-grade, but there were few opponents who could match them in the golden core stage. If they formed an alliance, they would be invincible."
"The golden core of one of them was Three Rivers and Five Lakes Pill. He could summon the power of multiple rivers and lakes, call forth water from these bodies. The other's golden core was the Endless Sea Pill, which could arouse the power of the ocean, invoking tremendous seawater."
"Which of these two types of golden cores is stronger, the Endless Sea Pill?" Lu Yang was curious. After all, how could the power of rivers compare with the ocean?
Fairy Eternity shook her head: "The power of rivers can't compare with the ocean, but you can't release all the power of the golden core all at once, there will be a limit. The maximum power of these two types of golden cores is almost the same, you can't say which one is stronger."
Lu Yang was even more curious. Both of these golden cores were water-attribute first-grade cores. They didn't sound too different in function, and their power seemed not too different either.
"Then what exactly is the difference between these two types of golden cores?"
"Of course, one releases freshwater and the other releases salt water," Fairy Eternity naturally answered, with a look like 'You really are stupid, Lu Yang.'
Lu Yang: "..."
You ancient cultivators had too much time on your hands, didn't you, to differentiate between freshwater golden cores and salt water golden cores.
"Although these two individuals were quite strong, they were no match for my Diving Spell," Fairy Eternity tried to speak lightly, showing that kind of confidence as if enemies turned to ashes easily in her hands, but seeing her lips curling up, Lu Yang knew how pleased she was.
Lu Yang was moved inwardly, a fairy was indeed a fairy. Although she often behaved unreliably, when he thought about it, there were numerous geniuses in ancient times, shining brightly like stars, it was the most prosperous era for cultivation.
Moreover, the competition in ancient times was brutal. Under such circumstances, Fairy Eternity was able to become one of the five immortals of the ancient times. She must have overcome many seemingly insurmountable enemies on her way to immortality. How could such a person be weak?
Golden cores are ranked from one to nine: one is the strongest, nine is the weakest. First-grade golden cores are extremely rare, like finding gold in the sand.
Even in a cultivation sect like the Seek Dao Sect, where every disciple could be considered a genius in the outside world, it could only guarantee that everyone had a upper third-grade golden core, only a minority had first-grade golden cores.
This in itself illustrated the formidable strength of the first-grade golden core.
Taking on two first-grade golden cores together, one doesn't need to say how invincible that is, yet they were broken by her with a single move. This kind of record is absolutely terrifying.
"By the way, Fairy, what was your cultivation level at that time?"
"Nascent Soul Stage."
"... I knew it."
"What did you say?"
"Nothing."
Lu Yang continued to read. After Dai Bufan, the next was Ji Hongwen.
"Four Seasons Green Bamboo Pill, a first-grade golden core. The Elixir Pattern it contains is a bamboo forest. The four seasons revolve, and the color of the green bamboo does not change, always green. It is calming, steadfast, tenacious, and gentle, just like a gentleman.
"Cultivation method: When a bamboo first sprouts, the buds are only an inch long, yet they already have nodes and leaves. Therefore, one must have a complete bamboo in his mind before practicing. Once you're deeply familiar with it, you can start eating bamboo and drinking bamboo soup. Get close to nature, experience nature. Noting but the color green should fill your view.
Only then can you form the golden core."
"Warning: Those who can't paint well should not form this golden core."
"Beware of the attacks from pandas when experiencing nature in the bamboo forest. They might think you are stealing their food."
"This golden core forming method applies only to green bamboo. Please don't extrapolate to other vegetation like cacti, Emperor Flowers, and so on."
It is evident that Senior Brother Dai Bufan and Ji Hongwen had some extraordinary experiences during their golden core formation.

chapters.title: Chapter 213 - 212 Step by Step (Thanks to reader 'Calm Life' for the leader's reward) _1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang continued flipping through, noticing that his senior brothers and sisters' methods of forming the golden core seemed extremely self-indulgent, with no signs of the "no regrets for the golden core" approach.
"Maybe they figure that they'd regret it if they just followed the traditional process?" Lu Yang had a rough idea about what they were thinking.
This was indeed in line with Seek Dao Sect's way of thinking.
Lu Yang himself strongly opposed this way of thinking. He felt that the future Seek Dao Sect needed ambitious people like him to lead it and rectify its practices, to steer the sect back on the right path!
The methods of forming the golden core used by his senior brothers and sisters were all over the place.
For example, one senior brother got inspiration from ancient texts. He found that many ancient powerful beings were born differently, with unusual features like a double pupil, rainbow-colored eyebrows, and three eyes. He decided to place his golden core at the center of his forehead, making it look like he had a third eye.
This looked very spiritual, especially when the golden core shone, and could really stun people.
"You're talking about being born differently? Eh, that's all nonsense, all additions made later on. The competition among geniuses back then was so fierce. Without any unique characteristics or peculiar legends, they wouldn't have been able to stand out." Fairy Eternity scoffed at such deceptive advertising.
"But there truly were some born differently. Like a child with wings being born to two humans, it caused a sensation at the time. Later on, it was discovered that this child's father had been cuckolded. The child's real father was from the Feather Tribe. That caused an even bigger sensation."
"Oh, Fairy, what was your most famous characteristic at the time?"
"My beauty."
"I'm not bragging, but the saintesses and witches at that time, each and every one of them was less beautiful than me! If there was a ranking for the top ten beauties in ancient times, I would have gotten first place!"
Lu Yang decided to take Fairy's word for it.
Lu Yang also read about a senior brother who observed the night sky for a long time and became enlightened. He found that all the stars in the sky were not as powerful as the sun. So, he formed a Sun Core that could utilize solar energy for fighting. During the day, the golden core was extremely powerful, but it would become weak at night.
Luckily, the Seek Dao Sect had a wide variety of techniques, covering all fields. There was a technique for storing solar energy that compensated for that senior brother's weakness.
Lu Yang went through all the records of his senior brothers and sisters forming golden cores, but he didn't feel that any of it could be used as reference for himself.
But there were some gains.
Lu Yang figured out the specific process for forming the golden core. The most basic condition, without a doubt, was to have one's magic power reach consummation, to reach the peak of the late stage of the Foundation Establishment.
To form the golden core, one also needed enlightenment. Some people proactively sought enlightenment, such as Senior Brother Dai Bufan seeking water and Senior Brother Ji Hongwen seeking bamboo. Others let things take their natural course, like Senior Sister Zhou LuLu.
There was no superiority or inferiority between these two methods. It all depended on personal choice.
So far, Lu Yang hadn't figured out which method he wanted to choose.
"This one should be about my master's generation's methods of forming the golden core."
Lu Yang opened the first page, and the name Daoist Buyu was written clearly. It described his master's enlightenment at the time of successfully forming the golden core.
"Haha, I cultivated a Sword Core, one of the best golden cores. Those who come after me, don't be jealous. Of course, if you are, there's nothing I can do about it. It's all due to my diligent cultivation. Cultivation is not something that can be half-hearted or half-baked. You need to be like me, down-to-earth, step by step."
"However, no one can imitate my enlightenment. As you all know, my natural talent for swordsmanship is known to all. I can easily learn a predecessor's sword moves. Look at Eldest Senior Brother and Second Senior Brother, they're working themselves to death to form the golden core. I think it's not that hard!"
"Eh, Eldest Senior Brother and them have such poor talents."
The next section included comments from eight elders on Daoist Buyu: "Step by step, Old Nine's words are reasonable."
As Lu Yang continued flipping, he came across a page where Daoist Buyu accidentally fell and left marks on the ground. There were eight footprints.
"Sword Core..."
The Sword Core was exclusive to the Sword Spirit Root. As long as Lu Yang wished, forming a Sword Core wouldn't be difficult. It was possible that, like Daoist Buyu, he might suddenly gain enlightenment in a dream, and everything would fall into place seamlessly.
"Should I form the Sword Core?"
Lu Yang shook his head. He had just reached the late stage of the Foundation Establishment. There was still time, and there was no need to rush his decision. He could take his time.
"Do you have any recommendations, Fairy? Apart from the Harem Golden Core."
"Hehe, of course, it's the pill that I formed, the Invincible Elixir. It's the second most powerful golden core."
"How do you form it?" Lu Yang hadn't heard of such a golden core. The name was pretty straightforward.
"You fight continuously with cultivators, not afraid of challenges. After winning a hundred battles, you'll develop an unmatched spirit. You use this spirit to guide the flow of spiritual essence, and solidify it into a pill!"
"I created this golden core. I named it the Invincible Elixir."
"Ordinary people, I don't tell them how to form this pill! Now you know the benefits of hanging out with me, right?" Fairy Eternity looked pleased, hoping to win a look of admiration from Lu Yang.
"Just in case, let me ask in advance: when you say winning a hundred battles, do you mean fighting people of the same level or those of a lower level?"
"Of course, those of a lower level!"
Fairy Eternity's golden core was very powerful, so Lu Yang decided to let that go in one ear and out the other.
Lu Yang spent three entire days in the Scripture Pavilion. His eyes were dry, and his mind was no longer clear. Luckily, he had the eye drops provided by Eldest Senior Sister. A couple of drops made both his eyes and brain feel a lot better.
"Forming the golden core really is something that requires careful consideration." Lu Yang rubbed his temples in pain. He had read so many methods of forming the golden core that he now didn't know which type to form.
"Time for a change of scenery."
Lu Yang felt stiff all over.
He greeted Zhou LuLu, who was standing at the door, and left the Scripture Pavilion.
Lu Yang stood in the sunlight at the entrance to the Scripture Pavilion, stretching lazily and moving his body around. The stiffness finally started to fade away.
"Senior Brother Lu, so you're here! I've finally found you." A slightly excited voice rang out.
"It's Haoran."
The one who approached was none other than Li Haoran, whom he had met just a few days ago.
"See, I told you he was here." Meng Jingzhou was following lazily behind Li Haoran.
"What's up?"
Li Haoran was a bit coy. He found this matter somewhat embarrassing, but he couldn't avoid it, "My parents sent a letter yesterday, saying my fiancée has returned and asked me to go meet her. I haven't met my fiancée yet, and I'm a bit nervous. So, I thought somebody should accompany me."
"I initially wanted to ask you, Senior Brother Meng, and Senior Brother Man. But Senior Brother Man is busy studying magic skills at the moment, so he couldn't get away. Now I've only managed to find Senior Brother Meng."
"Senior Brother Lu, do you have time?"
After thinking for a moment, Lu Yang responded. He didn't have anything pressing to do at the moment. Accompanying Li Haoran home wouldn't be a problem. Switching the environment could even help him come up with an idea for forming the golden core.
"Sure, when do we leave?"
"Can we leave first thing tomorrow morning?"
"Okay."

chapters.title: Chapter 214 - 213 Art Processing (Thanks to union leader Fan Ren a for the reward)
chapters.content:
The next morning, the three of them gathered at the agreed location.
Li Haoran was the earliest to arrive, seeming a bit nervous.
With Old Horse there, Lu Yang didn't need to be anxious about riding the flying ship.
"Who would have thought, you sly guy, you have a fiancée?" Meng Jingzhou teased Li Haoran, making subtle jokes about him.
Being the eldest legitimate son of the Meng Family, people from the royal palace began to pay visits even before he was born, hoping to build connections with Meng Jingzhou and the Meng Family.
After Meng Jingzhou was born, the number of people proposing marriage overwhelmed the doorway.
"Had I not devoted myself to cultivation, I would have been quite the catch within the royal palace," lamented Meng Jingzhou.
Li Haoran comforted him, "As the saying goes, when one gains something, they inevitably lose something else. Even though you lost the chance to live as a privileged noble in the royal city, what you gained is the Pure Yang Spiritual Root that many people dream of."
Lu Yang also encouraged him from the side, "Exactly, cherish this opportunity to mingle with female cultivators. Once you form the Single Golden Elixir, it will automatically repel women, and you won't even have the chance to speak to them."
Meng Jingzhou was infuriated, "Shameless! Stop messing with my Dao-heart! I've never heard of such a feature of the Single Golden Elixir!"
Lu Yang replied calmly, "This is an ancient secret that I don't tell many people!"
Meng Jingzhou eyed Lu Yang suspiciously. Considering that Lu Yang possessed the spirit of a terrifying ancient True Immortal inside him, it wasn't strange for him to be privy to some ancient secrets.
"Wait, the Single Body Spiritual Root first appeared in the Great Yu dynasty. There was no such thing during ancient times! You're just tricking me!" Meng Jingzhou realized quickly, "Take this, my Turtle-styled Fist attacks!"
The two began a feisty duel in the confined space, only to be finally dissuaded by Li Haoran.
"Junior Brother Li, what is your fiancée's background?" Lu Yang recalled Li Haoran's past. As his parents were ordinary cultivators of the Foundation Establishment Stage with no special talent, Li Haoran's Fire Spirit Root had been merely a fortunate accident, the same as his own.
Speaking of his fiancée, Li Haoran grimaced, "I really don't know."
"You don't know?" Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were surprised who wouldn't know the identity of their own fiancée.
"According to my parents, when they were adventuring outside, they encountered life-threatening danger. Coincidentally, an influential figure passed by and saved them. Since my mother already been pregnant with me for about three months, that person suggested that they forge a marital bond due to the fortunate encounter, thus deciding my matrimonial fate."
"After that, the influential figure left, never to seen again."
"Being capable of soaring in the sky, that individual must have been at least at the Golden Core Stage, but his precise cultivation level is a mystery."
"My parents don't know anything about him, not even his name, his surname, his origin, or his destination."
"...your fiancée was arranged quite carelessly."
"Tell me about it." Li Haoran responded with a helpless smile.
"The main issue was that my parents felt they were only at the Foundation Establishment Stage, and what would such an influential figure gain from them. Even if I had some talent, it would only amount to the potential to reach the Golden Core Stage at most. As you can see, I ended up with the Fire Spirit Root."
If a cultivator with a single spiritual root does not die prematurely, he is destined to become extremely successful in Cultivation. These cultivators possess talent that all influential families attempt to pull towards their side.
For example, when Lu Yang was tested and found to possess the Sword Spirit Root, many longstanding influential families were tempted, hoping to marry their daughters to him.
However, Lu Yang eventually became Daoist Buyu's disciple and stayed at Sky Gate Mountain. As such, those influential families lost their opportunity to propose.
"Could it be that the influential figure foresaw that you have the Fire Spirit Root?" Meng Jingzhou was puzzled, "That can't be right, I haven't heard of such a magic skill."
If there was such a magic skill, the Meng Family would have acquired it much earlier and wouldn't have waited until Meng Jingzhou turned four to test his spiritual root.
"Strange."
"Let's not worry about it. Once we meet your fiancée, everything will be clear." The three of them thought about it and didn't arrive at a conclusion, so they simply gave up on pondering it any further.
Old Horse pulled the cart the entire day before they arrived at Li Haoran's house.
Li Haoran's home was in Luofeng County. It's said that a pure-blooded phoenix had died there, blessing all living beings, thus naming the place Luofeng County.
