"The ambiance is better than Yanjiang County!" Peeking his head out of the carriage, Lu Yang saw the magnificent city walls, the bustling traffic, and felt those barely perceptible gazes fall onto him, indicating the extraordinary power of Luofeng County.
"Halt, get down from the carriage for inspection," the city gate guards stopped the carriage.
The three of them confidently presented the tokens from Seek Dao Sect for inspection.
"So it turns out you are Daoists from Dao Sect, please enter."
Seeing that the three of them were from Seek Dao Sect, the guard immediately showed due respect. No matter what the internal affairs of Seek Dao Sect were like, the disciples were all outstanding individuals with great achievements.
As one of the Five Great Immortal Sects, Seek Dao Sect naturally held a lot of power that local government offices would be wary of.
The most troublesome and terrifying power was the right to enforce the law. If the Immortal Sects found out about any illegal activities or collusion with the Demon Path in the local government, they had the right to execute before reporting.
However, the Five Great Immortal Sects would give face to the Great Xia dynasty and allow it to handle these matters itself, unless the situations were urgent or there was no other choice, the Five Great Immortal Sects would only resort to this last measure.
After revealing their affiliation with Seek Dao Sect, those barely perceivable gazes on the three of them disappeared. Those were guards hiding in the shadows, preventing thieves from infiltrating Luofeng County to create trouble.
As for the Seek Dao Sect rebels, that was beyond their job scope.
"Our home is over here," Li Haoran pointed out the route for Old Horse.
Along the way, the trio heard a storyteller's voice in a teahouse, narrating the "Legend of the Dao Sect".
"...Speaking of Daoist Buyu, a man of high moral standing and integrity, he went to prison multiple times to experience the hardships of life. Eating and living with the convicts, talking to them compassionately, he cared why they ended up in this state…"
"Sometimes, Daoist Buyu would learn about places infested by demons from the convicts, and he would go there to exorcise the evil."
"Today's story begins with Daoist Buyu getting information from the prison…"
"...Daoist Buyu learned from a convict that there was something eerie about An Family Manor. Those who left the manor would be in a state of confusion and disorientation. Even so, they still longed to return..."
"...Daoist Buyu saw through the plot of the An family's master and fought valiantly within, terrifying the demons into pleading for mercy so they would never cause harm again…"
Lu Yang looked strange, thinking that his master was a little too exaggerated in his artistry, "From what I remember, wasn't An Family Manor a facade for a brothel run by a group of energy-absorbing Sly Foxes, disguised as a village to avoid paying taxes? Weren't they finally exposed by the Great Xia's tax loophole investigation, resulting in the Manor being sealed off?"
Li Haoran was taken aback, "There was such a thing? But since the Sect Master made up this story, he must have his reasons. Maybe he played a significant role on the inside!"
"He was a customer, who was locked up for fifteen days."

chapters.title: Chapter 215 - 214: Divorce! (Thanks to the alliance leader, Bookfriend Xingqing Buyu, for the reward)_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang began to contemplate whether or not to tell Eldest Senior Sister about the lies and fabrications of their master.
If he told Eldest Senior Sister, their master would certainly be disciplined, but if he didn't, Eldest Senior Sister might view him as complicit in their master's wrongdoing.
"On one side is my master, and on the other side is Eldest Senior Sister. It's a tough decision," Lu Yang sighed deeply, feeling like he was stuck in a sticky situation, damned if he did and damned if he didn't.
He pulled out a copper coin, deciding to let fate make the choice.
With a flick of his finger, the copper coin spun briskly in the air, emitting a ringing sound. The three men kept their eyes on the coin as it went up and came down.
Clang.
The coin landed face up.
"It seems that heaven wants to doom my master."
"Senior Brother Lu, let's try again," Li Haoran suggested. He had heard Elder Zhou Xin complain about how unreliable Daoist Buyu was while they were soaking in lava.
But all in all, a Sect Leader was still a Sect Leader.
Lu Yang nodded. He actually didn't want to snitch, so he flicked the copper coin in the air again.
The coin landed face down.
Li Haoran sighed, it seemed that the Sect Leader was spared, for now.
Lu Yang gave a resigned sigh to the side, "It seems that heaven wants to doom my master."
"Wait, Senior Brother Lu, how come both heads and tails mean telling Eldest Senior Sister? How exactly do we not tell her about this?"
"Well, that would be if the coin landed on its edge."
Seeing Li Haoran's confused face, Meng Jingzhou explained, "Think about it, there are two possibilities when a coin lands, right? It can land flat or on its edge."
"Right."
"So, Lu Yang has a fifty percent chance of not telling Elatest Senior Sister about this matter. The odds are already quite high."
Lu Yang seemed to resonate deeply with Meng Jingzhou's logic.
Li Haoran's eyes twitched, "Senior Brother Lu, if you want to get my master in trouble, just say it. No need to go through such a process."
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou found themselves missing Man Gu. If it had been Man Gu earlier, she would have believed them without a hitch.
Amidst their conversation, they arrived at Li Haoran's old house.
The old horse stopped, and Li Haoran got off first, "My senior brothers, this is my home. Although it's a bit run-down, it holds my childhood memories. I remember climbing trees in front of the door when I was a kid."
"...Junior Brother Li, I think 'a bit run-down' is an understatement for your house."
Li Haoran turned his head and saw his family's ancient house being demolished.
"Where's my house?!"
He had only been away for just over a year. How could his house be gone?
"Hey, aren't you the boy from the Li family? I heard you've made it big, joined the Seek Dao Sect?" an old man recognized Li Haoran.
"Uncle Zhang, where is my house?" Li Haoran asked as soon as he saw a familiar face.
"Hmm? Didn't your parents tell you? To celebrate you becoming a disciple of the Seek Dao Sect, they sold the old house and moved. They moved to Chunyuan Street."
"...So, they really did this to celebrate me joining the Seek Dao Sect?" Li Haoran covered his face, feeling a bit helpless.
Following Uncle Zhang's directions, the three finally found Li Haoran's real home.
Before they entered, Lu Yang quietly asked Meng Jingzhou, "Did you prepare any gifts for Uncle and Auntie?"
"I've had them ready for a while. I have a lot of nice things in my Identity Jade. What about you?"
"Before I came, I went to the Task Hall and exchanged some elixirs and treasured materials."
After their exchange, they got out of the carriage with ease.
Before Li Haoran could knock on the door, he heard the voice of an unfamiliar woman from inside.
"I absolutely will not agree to this marriage proposal!"
"A betrothal made when you were children? Was that agreed by me?"
"Don't even think about me accepting this marriage proposal!"
Then came the voice of Li Haoran's father, "We had already agreed upon this marriage..."
Listening to the sounds of quarreling, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou exchanged glances, sensing that things were not going smoothly.
Li Haoran frowned, pushed open the door, and deliberately announced loudly, "Mom, Dad, I'm home!"
When the door was pushed open, a couple stood in the courtyard, looking bewildered, as if the situation had caught them off guard. They were Li Haoran's parents.
Arguing with Li Haoran was a beautiful young girl who seemed to be around Li Haoran's age.
Behind the girl stood a stunning woman cultivator who somewhat resembled the girl. It was unclear if she was the girl's sister or mother.
"Haoran is back?" Li Haoran's parents were overjoyed to see Haoran's return home.
"Mom and Dad, let me introduce you. These are my two senior brothers at the Seek Dao Sect, Lu Yang, and Meng Jingzhou."
"Greetings, Uncle and Auntie." Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou greeted them with warm smiles and took out the gifts they had prepared.
"There's no need for gifts."
"They're just some random things we picked up on the way, nothing expensive."
After some back and forth, Li Haoran's parents finally accepted the gifts.
"So, you're Li Haoran?" The girl scrutinized Li Haoran with a frown. Admittedly, Li Haoran was quite handsome, but she seemed to find him displeasing no matter how she looked.
"And who are you?" Li Haoran snapped back at the girl.
Fearing the conflict might escalate, Li Haoran's parents quickly introduced, "This is Qin Yanyan, and this is her mother Su Yiren. Su Yiren was the one who saved us."
In the spiritual space, Fairy Eternity let out a soft gasp, "This Su Yiren is not ordinary, she's in the unification phase."
There were quite a few extraordinary individuals in the Central Continent. Many cultivators who reached the unification stage were unknown to Lu Yang.
Even Meng Jingzhou, who was born into the influential Meng Family, couldn't recognize all those who reached the unification stage.
"Unification phase?" Lu Yang was surprised. Was Junior Brother Li really that valuable? A unification phase cultivator not only saved Li Haoran's parents but also arranged a marriage?
Lu Yang couldn't see anything special about Li Haoran other than his Fire Spirit Root.
Li Haoran wasn't a genius who suddenly turned into a waste, nor did he act strangely or say strange things.
Fairy Eternity teased, "You're pretty valuable too, you know. That Yun Zhi girl personally arranged a marriage for you and Lan Ting. If you were successful, you would have a group of unification stage cultivators behind you."
Lu Yang rolled his eyes and ignored Fairy Eternity's jab.
Qin Yanyan assessed Li Haoran, "I heard you're from the Seek Dao Sect and ranked fifth in strength in your class. How embarrassing, to rank fifth despite having a Fire Spirit Root."
Li Haoran considered the top four ranks: One had a Sword Spirit Root and was personally trained by Eldest Senior Sister. Another was a Single Body Spiritual Root born from the largest influential family, the Meng family.
The third was a Feather Transformation Immortal Body even rarer than a Single Spiritual Root, and the fourth was the last of the ancient barbarian tribe, an inheritor of the tribe's luck. Ranking fifth didn't seem to be so humiliating.
Man Gu was the last descendant of the ancient barbarian tribe, and per an old saying, the final person of a race could converge all the luck of that race.
Wouldn't it be strange if he could surpass the top four?
"Let me give you some advice: cancel the engagement so we can part ways peacefully, and meet happily in the martial world in the future. If you refuse..." At this point, Qin Yanyan revealed a cold smile, the implication clear.
"What if I refuse?"
Qin Yanyan continued to smile coldly. She hadn't determined how she would threaten Li Haoran if he refused.

chapters.title: Chapter 216 - 215: Marriage by Fingertip (Thanks to book friend Little Reindeer for the reward of the Alliance Leader)_1
chapters.content:
"If you refuse, you won't step out this door today!"
"This is my house."
"Then I'll use the force behind me, making it impossible for you to move an inch!"
"I'm a disciple of the Seek Dao Sect."
"Then I'll accuse you in the Seek Dao Sect of forcing an innocent woman into debauchery!"
"Spreading rumors could get you imprisoned."
"Then the two you brought with you today are in danger!"
"Be my guest, one of them is the fourth disciple of our Sect Leader, and the other is the eldest son of the Meng Family."
"Then I will..."
Li Haoran's parents didn't expect Qin Yanyan to fight back so boldly. Despite their status as elders in the family, their Cultivation Level was the lowest among those present.
Su Yiren grabbed Qin Yanyan's shoulder from behind, trying to calm her down: "Yanyan, I know that you are having a hard time accepting the marriage arrangement right now. Why don't you give Haoran a chance? Maybe you..."
"There is no maybe!" Qin Yanyan threw off Su Yiren's hand, her fury flaring like a small lioness.
"Mom, did you get my consent before arranging this marriage?!"
"You weren't even born then."
"But you didn't inform me about it even after I was born, only telling me a few days ago!" Qin Yanyan recalled the shock she felt a few days ago when her gentle and soft-spoken mother suddenly informed her about the arranged marriage. It had hit her like a bolt out of the blue.
You could have at least told me earlier!
That way, I wouldn't be caught off guard and not know how to retaliate.
Su Yiren was speechless. Seeing her mother like this, Qin Yanyan's anger escalated: "In any case, I do not agree to this marriage!"
Qin Yanyan pointed at Li Haoran: "I'm leaving you some dignity. Call off the marriage now and we can consider the matter closed!"
Li Haoran was also angered. If they had discussed it calmly and she didn't want to fulfil the marriage proposal, then breaking it off would be acceptable. But her high-handed, lawless attitude was too much: "Just because you say we should break it off, we break it off?"
He enunciated each word: "I'll tell you this, I will never break off this marriage in my lifetime!"
Upon hearing this, Qin Yanyan was instantly incensed.
"Today, whether you want to break off this marriage arrangement or not, I will make you break it off! Sky Light Talisman!"
Qin Yanyan pulled out a talisman, which transformed into a beam of white light and sped towards Li Haoran.
Li Haoran donned his fist guards and with a punch, sent the beam of light flying.
"Let's get out of the way." Lu Yang called everyone to retreat a bit further.
"Shouldn't we stop them?" Li Haoran's parents and Su Yiren were all worried about the fighting parties.
"They are both angry. Let them fight it out and vent their anger." Lu Yang said with a smile.
Su Yiren felt that Lu Yang made sense, and cast a spell to protect the Li's new house from getting damaged in the fight.
Both Li Haoran and Qin Yanyan noticed Su Yiren's gesture, and thus, they unleashed their full powers and fought in earnest.
Li Haoran took out a long lance from his storage space. This was his best-refined weapon. The lance sparks as it scratched the ground.
Qin Yanyan, unknowingly, had many talismans in her hand. She aimed at Li Haoran and launched one: "Dawn Talisman!"
Li Haoran took a step forward, lifted the lance, and the Dawn Talisman was cut off before it could unleash its power.
"Break!"
The lance moved like a swimming dragon in battle. Every move he made was exuding dominance. The speed at which he handled his weapon exceeded the speed of sound. The breaking sound occurred, and the spearhead was less than three inches from Qin Yanyan.
Qin Yanyan's pupils contracted. She wouldn't be able to dodge this strike: "Vajra Talisman!"
With a swift jerk of her head to the right, the spear tip grazed her shoulder, making a metallic impact sound.
Qin Yanyan bit her finger, drew a symbol in the air with her blood as a medium, and a large hammer appeared above Li Haoran's head.
"Smash!"
Li Haoran had no choice but to raise his lance and resist. The hammer's force was too hefty that it numbed Li Haoran's hands and he dropped his lance.
"Drawing symbols in mid-air, what a strong talent for talisman crafting!" Watching Qin Yanyan use talisman after talisman like it cost nothing, Lu Yang initially assumed those were given by her family. Based on the talent she exhibited, these talismans were probably her own work.
"Now that you're weaponless, how will you fight!" Qin Yanyan activated the Speed Talisman and turned into a flash of lightning. She leaned forward and rushed towards Li Haoran.
Li Haoran said nothing but swung out his fists. He was not the kind of cultivator who preferred fighting with a weapon. His true strength lay in Refining!
Qin Yanyan drew out three Vajra Talismans, intending to block Li Haoran's punch, only to have her barrier, formed by the Vajra Talismans, refined by Li Haoran on the spot. He ripped apart the barrier and kicked Qin Yanyan away.
Qin Yanyan seized the opportunity to grab Li Haoran's ankle and slammed it towards the ground.
She used the Power Enhancement Talisman to temporarily strengthen her body. Though her body would ache for a while afterward, she didn't care about that now!
Li Haoran smoothly placed both hands on the ground to change his landing posture and performed a move called rabbit kicking hawk, kicking her back.
Qin Yanyan was no ordinary person either. Most Talisman Masters specialize in long-range attacks and would lose if engaged in close combat, but she was an exception, having practiced close combat techniques.
Both began to engage in close combat, going blow for blow, without showing any mercy.
Suddenly, Li Haoran feigned a move, then swiftly smashed his head against Qin Yanyan's. Qin Yanyan, caught off guard by this abrupt strike, felt dizzy and fell to the ground with a thud.
"Enhanced hair?!" Lu Yang was stunned. This scene seemed all too familiar. In the exchange meeting with the Five Elements Sect, Meng Jingzhou had used this shameless move to defeat his opponent.
Meng Jingzhou was even more shocked. Refining one's hair was the unique skill of the Third Elder, and the training conditions were extremely rigorous. Where and how did Li Haoran learn it?
Noticing both their faces, Li Haoran smiled and took off his wig.
If one can refine their body to the level of hair, then refining a wig naturally follows.
"Seeing Senior Brother Meng use that move to defeat his opponent was quite enlightening, but I'm not a Body Refinement Practitioner. I can't refine my hair. So, I shaved my head and created a wig. Looking at it today, it seems to work quite well."
Lu Yang: "..."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
You're pretty brutal to yourself.
Qin Yanyan laid on the ground, looking at Li Haoran shamelessly wear a wig, overcome with a mix of anger and sadness. She felt like crying but held back her tears.
"You've won. Go ahead and marry my mom! I won't stand in your way! Do whatever you want! But I will never call you dad!"
Li Haoran: "!!!"
Before he could even enjoy his victory, he was dumbfounded by her heavy proclamation.
"Marrying..." Li Haoran murmured, before screeching, "Your mom?!"
Turning to his parents and a blushing Su Yiren, Li Haoran said: "Mom, wasn't it agreed that this was to be a betrothal?"
Li Haoran's mother avoided his gaze, unable to look at her son directly: "Yes, that's right. Su Yiren pointed to my belly back then, saying that she wanted to marry you."
"Is that how a pre-birth betrothal is interpreted?!"
"Hand me some sunflower seeds." Lu Yang snatched half of the seeds from Meng Jingzhou's hand, and the two began cracking them open like squirrels.
Lu Yang pondered: "A woman marrying younger than her, what do they call it again?"
(Extra chapter for the Terrific Immortal, Banner Lord Qi Tian)
(And also kindly asking for monthly votes)

chapters.title: Chapter 217 - 216: Li Haoran: Is it too late to call off the wedding now?_1
chapters.content:
When Lu Yang found out who Li Haoran's fiancée was, his mind inexplicably filled with numerous mythological stories.
The Cowherd and Weaver Girl, Third Holy Mother and Liu Yanchang, Fairy Match...
There were many examples in history that proved a marriage between a mortal and a fairy is the quickest way to ascend to heaven, and the success rate is extremely high.
Liu Yanchang was an exception, but that was due to the issue of Third Holy Mother's brother Yang Jian, or perhaps the regulations of the Heavenly Court. However, Su Yiren didn't seem to have a brother at the Tribulation Stage, and there were no Heavenly Laws in ancient times.
The conclusion was very clear.
"Junior Brother Li is going to enjoy good fortune in the future. This shortcuts many years of detours, causing others to envy." Lu Yang marveled. He and Meng Jingzhou felt that their trip here was worthwhile.
Worth it.
"Right, what did Junior Brother Li call us over here for in the first place?" Lu Yang had forgotten the initial purpose of their visit here.
Meng Jingzhou munched on a handful of melon seeds, tossed them all into his mouth, and thoroughly enjoyed their taste. He pondered: "I think he said he was afraid of being too nervous when he met his fiancée and asked us to boost his spirits."
"Oh, Junior Brother Li does not look very nervous. He should not need our help." Observing Li Haoran's distraught expression, Lu Yang didn't think it had anything to do with being nervous.
"Is there any more melon seeds, we've run out." Lu Yang's hands were full of melon seed shells.
Meng Jingzhou pulled out a bag of melon seeds: "Yes, but they're raw."
"It's okay, I can burn them, what flavor would you like?"
"Make it a bit salty."
"Sure thing."
Lu spat out the Three Flavored True Fire and controlled the flames' temperature to roast the melon seeds.
Li Haoran, at this time, had no idea that his two reliable senior brothers had completely abandoned him. He was preoccupied with other concerns.
Li Haoran was currently listening to how his mother had arranged his betrothal.
"Wasn't your father and I saved by Yiren back then? At that time, Yiren noticed that I was pregnant, and asked me if we could arrange a marriage for you."
"I thought at the time, the girl was pretty and her cultivation was high, getting engaged to her would be a great honor for us, Yiren was willing, and we were happy too."
"Wait, mother, didn't you consider the age gap?" Li Haoran listened in utter astonishment. He had never heard of anyone arranging a marriage in this manner.
Li Haoran's mother looked at him as if he were ungrateful: "How did I teach you when you were young? You shouldn't be restrained by worldly conventions. For cultivators, is age a problem? Of course not."
"Look at the spouses of powerful cultivators at the Unification stage now, their age difference could be hundreds or thousands of years, is that an issue?"
Li Haoran's mother counted for Li Haoran, who was at a loss. There were numerous examples of large age gaps among couples, yet their relationships remained harmonious.
"Besides, those at the Tribulation stage have even wider age gaps."
Li Haoran painfully rubbed his temples, the reason for these theories that were instilled in him since childhood were now clear to him.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou nodded in agreement. What Li Haoran's mother said held some truth, after all in the Cultivation World, as long as there was love, an age difference was not a problem.
Furthermore, it wasn't the case that the younger partner would hope for the older partner to die in order to inherit their wealth — no one really knew who would live longer.
Lu Yang once heard of an old cultivator who wanted to experience a love story in his twilight years. Many women married the old cultivator with impure motives, only to fall before him, while the old cultivator lived on healthily.
Let's put it another way, were Su Yiren and Li Haoran really 3000 years apart in age? Not necessarily. Perhaps Su Yiren was talented and reached the Unification Stage very early on.
There was a real-life example right here: Fairy Eternity became an immortal at the tender age of sixteen. Compared to Lu Yang, who was still at the Foundation Establishment Stage at sixteen, it was quite embarrassing.
As such, as long as one party underreported their age, the age difference between the two parties was not large.
Li Haoran's mother continued: "At that time, we didn't know how high Yiren's cultivation was. We thought she was either in the Golden Core Stage or Nascent Soul Stage, no matter what stage she was in, she was definitely above our level."
"Afterwards, when we tested your Spirit Root, we found that you were a very rare Fire Spirit Root. Your future prospects were boundless, and no doubt, above the Nascent Soul Stage. If you two got married, Yiren wouldn't be at a disadvantage."
Li Haoran's parents did not regret their decision because of Li Haoran's talent. After all, they were saved by their fiancée, and the marriage had already been agreed upon, they couldn't renege on it.
"We initially wanted to remind you that when your cultivation improved, you could help Yiren.
It was only a few days ago when Yiren brought her daughter over that we realized she was at the Unification Stage, greatly exceeding our expectations. You need to hurry and cultivate, and not lag behind Yiren."
"It's just that Yanyan was a bit too reactive, she objected to this marriage, and repeatedly proposed to tear the engagement apart, you know the rest."
Li Haoran: "..."
No wonder Qin Yanyan reacted so strongly. If you lived for a dozen years, and suddenly your mother said she was getting married and you were going to get a new dad, who could bear that?
Putting himself in her shoes, Li Haoran estimated he would have reacted the same way.
Li Haoran seriously said to Qin Yanyan: "I think you have a point, we now advocate free love, this marriage that violates personal wishes should be annulled."
Su Yiren silently took out the Recording Orb, which was playing back the heroic declarations Li Haoran yelled during his battle with Qin Yanyan.
"Let me tell you, I will never annul this marriage in my lifetime!"
"Let me tell you, I will never annul this marriage in my lifetime!"
"Let me tell you, I will never annul this marriage in my lifetime!"
Su Yiren didn't say a word. Her actions spoke louder than words.
"Stop, stop, stop playing." Li Haoran pleaded, he wanted to find a hole in the ground to hide in.
Why didn't I learn how to shrink space from Senior Brother Lu?
If I had known this would happen, I wouldn't have come home. Wouldn't it have been good to just stay at the Seek Dao Sect to cultivate and refine objects?
I'm too young to be kept. How will my peers think of me?
Li Haoran looked at Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, only to see the two snacking on melon seeds, clearly not intending to help at all.
Li Haoran silently watched Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou. They were so uncomfortable under Li Haoran's staring that they had no choice but to step in and seek justice.
"The biggest problem with this situation is Senior Su. Senior Su, why did you arrange this marriage with Junior Brother Li?"
All eyes were on Su Yiren, causing her to blush. Su Yiren was a very shy person, the more people there were, the less she wanted to speak. But things had come to this point and she had no choice but to explain why things had escalated to this point using as few words as possible:
"Actually, Li Haoran is the reincarnation of my husband."
"Yanyan, Li Haoran is truly the reincarnation of your father."
Lu Yang: "..."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
It's over, why is this getting more and more complicated? Is it too late to make a clean break now?
Inside the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity was intrigued. Being with Lu Yang, she could encounter many interesting things.

chapters.title: Chapter 218 - 217 Qin Haoran_1
chapters.content:
At this time, everyone was no longer standing in the courtyard. Li Haoran's parents, along with everyone else, moved to the guest living room. As the youngest one present, Qin Yanyan served tea and poured water for everyone.
By age, Qin Yanyan's age was similar to Li Haoran's, Lu Yang's, and Meng Jingzhou's.
But birth order was in place here.
"My husband in Li Haoran's past life, his name was Qin Haoran, a cultivator at the peak of the Unification stage,"
Su Yiren revealed a name no one had heard before.
Everyone present had different expressions, Li Haoran's parents didn't expect their son to have such an origin.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou looked like they wanted to listen to the gossip, but felt like it was a hassle.
Although Qin Yanyan didn't accept Li Haoran's identity, she also wanted to listen to her mother talk about her father. Her mother seldom mentioned her father.
Li Haoran was expressionless, he had given up resistance, thinking about how things would develop.
Perhaps because she had held it in her heart for too long, or perhaps because she had fallen into memories, or for some other reason altogether, Su Yiren's speech became smoother as she talked.
"My meeting with Qin Haoran was five hundred years ago when I was living in seclusion in the mountains. I was a hermit cultivator then, only coming down from the mountain every ten years to pay taxes," she began.
"One day while I was meditating in the mountains, a bloody figure smashed through the barrier I had set up and fell headlong into the ground. When he saw me approaching, he instinctively tried to gather his strength to protect himself, but his injuries were too severe for him to use magic. He soon fell unconscious."
"I found him pitiful and saved him. It took him a month to regain consciousness."
"When he woke up he was very guarded, but when he realized I had been taking care of him for a month, he lowered his guard and thanked me for saving his life."
Su Yiren instinctively left out some details, like when Qin Haoran's injuries were internal, but she wrapped all over his body in white cloth and plaster, making him look like a mummy just woke up.
Or the fact that without Su Yiren's care, Qin Haoran could have woken up two weeks earlier.
These were all irrelevant details, and it made no difference whether they were spoken or not.
"He told me his name was Qin Haoran, a cultivator at the Unification stage. A month earlier, he was attacked by an enemy and, though he managed to kill his attackers, he sustained very grave injuries. Also, he apologized for damaging the barrier I had set."
"I noticed that he wasn't lying. Even though he had woken up, he could only use a tiny fragment of his magic powers, his body was extremely wounded, with all his meridians severed, it was a terrible situation."
"He originally wanted to leave, but I was worried that he would encounter danger again. So, I told him he could stay."
"He stayed in the mountain for recuperation, and over time, we developed feelings for each other and got married."
"Our wedding was very low-key. We only invited the spirits of the mountains and those friends who had a good relationship with us."
"After his injuries healed, he was busy day after day. When I asked him what he was doing, and if he needed any help, he said that what he was doing was dangerous, and it was safest if I didn't know anything."
"Trusting him, I didn't press further."
"In the span of five hundred years, Haoran gradually rose from the late Unification phase to the peak of the Unification phase. He was only one step away from the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. He said that he had always been pure and desireless before, thinking that was the best state for cultivation. It was only after he met me and married me that he realized his previous thoughts were wrong."
"During our time together, his solid barrier loosened, and his cultivation level improved consistently."
"I asked him why my cultivation did not improve. He said it might be due to my lack of innate talent for cultivation."
"It's extremely difficult for high-level cultivators to have offspring. We struggled for five hundred years before we finally conceived Yanyan."
"Afterward, he said he had reached the threshold of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, and was only one Heavenly Tribulation away. He wanted to fight for a future for our daughter and me."
"Passing the tribulation is too high risk. I wanted to persuade him not to, but he said his identity was too special. If he did not become a Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator, he could only live in obscurity and we would never see the light of day. Only by achieving the Transcendance Tribulation Stage could he change this situation."
"Unfortunately, the Heavenly Tribulation was too terrifying. Despite numerous preparations, he couldn't withstand the final Thunder Tribulation and fell from the sky."
"Crying, I caught him to save him by wildly stuffing various top-grade elixirs in his mouth. But he said he knew his condition best and knew he could not possibly survive."
"He told me not to worry. He has practiced a certain kind of skill that allows him to reincarnate continuously with higher aptitude in each life. Qin Haoran was his eighth reincarnation."
"Originally, he wanted to tell his subordinates about his reincarnation so they could help take care of his next life and ensure their successful growth. However, he later felt that his subordinates couldn't be trusted, so he asked me to take care of his next life."
"He told me the secret method to find his next life. Following the method, I found Yanyan's Aunt who was pregnant."
"When Yanyan's aunt and uncle encountered danger, I saved them. Afterwards, I established an engagement with Haoran, who was in her belly, hoping to continue our previous connection."
Li Haoran looked puzzled. "Didn't you suspect that this was a lie Qin Haoran made up before his death?"
Su Yiren shook her head lightly. "I did have doubts, but your talent is irrefutable. During the Spirit Root test when you were six years old, I was hiding in the dark. I personally witnessed the result of the test indicating that you were a Fire Spirit Root."
"No matter how good Haoran was, he couldn't just pick a random person and determine that they were a Single Spiritual Root."
"What if Qin Haoran had a way to predict others' talents?" Li Haoran was still reluctant to give up.
Su Yiren said with a smile, "I know you still don't entirely believe what I've said. Time will prove everything. Haoran said that as his next life's cultivation level increases, his next life will gain some fragments of his previous life's memory."
"But you don't have to worry that these fragments will interfere with your personality, you are still you."
When it came to the high-minded topic of reincarnation, Lu Yang turned to Fairy Eternity whom he knew had insight into many ancient mysteries.
"Fairy, is there really such a thing as reincarnation?"
"From the time preceding the ancient times, there was talk of reincarnation. In that era, there were many geniuses. There would always be people saying that a person of exceptional talent was the reincarnation of so-and-so, and there were also people saying that our successful Immortal ascensions were the reincarnations of so-and-so."
"Since the ascensions of us five, we have joined forces to reveal the mysteries of the world. We found that there was no such thing as reincarnation in the world, and these rumors were just figments of people's imaginations."
"Does that mean Qin Haoran was really lying?" Lu Yang was surprised as he really thought that Li Haoran was the reincarnation of Qin Haoran.
Fairy Eternity shook her head. "I only said that there was no reincarnation in the ancient times, not that there isn't any now."
"What do you mean?" Lu Yang was even more confused.
"You have to understand, the appearance of each Dao Fruit signifies the birth of a new rule in the world. What if, during my absence, someone condensed the 'Reincarnation' Dao Fruit?"
"In that case, wouldn't the theory of reincarnation become real?"

chapters.title: Chapter 219 - 218: The Mystery of the Dao Fruit_1
chapters.content:
Upon hearing this, Lu Yang was startled. While experiencing the [Buyi Town Rule], he had heard Daoist Buyu talk about the subject of [Rules].
In the early stages of Unification, one begins to control the rules. During the Pass Tribulation stage, one masters a broader range of rules. Immortals, through the power of the Dao Fruit, control the rules of the entire world.
However, he had never imagined that the Dao Fruit could even create the [Reincarnation] rule.
If an immortal truly created the Reincarnation rule, would the immortal also be able to create other rules?
How much of what seems commonplace now did not exist in ancient times and was later created?
Why did the Ancient Nameless One refine the stars into continents? What was the goal? Was it the manifestation of a certain rule, or was it to create a particular rule?
Lu Yang looked up at the bright sun in the sky. In his previous life, the sun being the moon was impossible.
The sun, seen by people as the source of life and power, could also be the manifestation of a certain rule.
Lu Yang threw all these questions at Fairy Eternity. Evidently unable to handle such complex, unresolvable questions, she was left dizzy.
"In any case, from what I've seen and heard since my resurrection, there is not much difference from the ancient times. At most, the stars being refined into continents, and the sun, could be considered some changes."
"Since you asked about the Dao Fruit, I'll take this opportunity to explain it."
"However, for you, the Immortal Dao Fruit is too far off. Knowing too much now would not be beneficial for your future cultivation. I can only tell you a bit. If it were Yun Zhi, that little girl, I could tell her a lot about the Dao Fruit... Oh, it seems like she doesn't need me to provide this kind of information."
Fairy Eternity raised two fingers and began explaining to Lu Yang about the Dao Fruit: "The Dao Fruit can be divided into two types based on the different rules they control."
"The first kind is the Time Dao Fruit of the Time Immortal, which controls the rule of time. The rule of time objectively exists and is inherent. The role of the Time Dao Fruit is to master this existing rule and alter it according to one's intentions. As for how much it can be changed, only the Time Immortal knows."
"The second kind is my Eternity Dao Fruit, which controls the rule of immortality. The rule of immortality is a rule I created. Before this, it never existed. The rule of immortality only affects me... no, that's not right... Sha Meless is also one.
So the rule of immortality affects both Sha Meless and me, but it doesn't impact him as much as me."
"Sha Meless's Eternity Dao Fruit naissance only allows him to appear on any statue, it's the shallowest manifestation of the immortality rule, mainly for escaping. If he dies, he can't resurrect."
"But I am different." When speaking of herself, Fairy Eternity grinned in great confidence.
"As long as my name is pronounced, regardless of the time, location, or language form, I can resurrect! This ability is something even the four of them, including Ying Tian Immortal, are envious of!"
"Unfortunately, they don't have enough ability to coalesce an Eternity Dao Fruit." Fairy Eternity was proud of herself. As the self-proclaimed leader of the Five Immortals of the Ancients, she naturally had her reasons.
Lu Yang suspected that Fairy Eternity had an epiphany at the brink of death after eating the food she cooked, and realised the true meaning of immortality, thereby forming the Eternity Dao Fruit. However, after forming the Dao Fruit, she automatically erased her unpleasant memories.
"There's also Ying Tian Immortal, whose Dao Fruit created a new rule, namely the [Tribulation] rule."
"The Tribulation rule?"
"The most common manifestation is the Pass Thunder Tribulation. You see, from forming the Nascent Soul to Spirit Transformation, from Spirit Transformation to Refining the Void, all require the Pass Thunder Tribulation. This is a situation that only exists for you now. In ancient times, cultivators did not need to Pass Thunder Tribulation."
"Ying Tian Immortal felt that people's cultivation was just blindly pursuing power and cultivation speed, overlooking the mood/mindset, losing the original meaning of cultivation. So he formed [Tribulation] Dao Fruit to add a trial to cultivators."
"As it turns out, Ying Tian Immortal's decision was correct. With the emergence of Thunder Tribulation, cultivators have begun to value their state of mind, striving to deal with Thunder Tribulation, preventing random occurrences of cultivation madness."
"The Tribulation Dao Fruit is a typical case of pushing the rule towards the whole world, adding an additional rule to all."
"So, you understand now, right? If I die and someone becomes immortal, and coalesces a [Reincarnation] Dao Fruit, it's just like my situation, and that of Ying Tian Immortal's, creating a rule out of thin air."
"I just don't know whether this [Reincarnation Rule] affects only specific individuals or everyone."
Fairy Eternity further explained: "If it affects specific individuals, generally speaking, the holder of the nascent Reincarnation Dao Fruit can continuously reincarnate and achieve an alternate form of eternal life."
"If it affects everyone, it means everyone has a past life. You, Meng Jingzhou, Man Gu, Tao Yaoye, and others are no exception. However, I think this possibility is small."
"Why?" Lu Yang asked.
"Think about it, if everyone is reincarnating, doesn't that mean the total number of souls in the world is fixed?"
Lu Yang nodded.
"Then have you ever thought about how souls appeared in ancient times, that is, when there was no reincarnation rule?"
Lu Yang was taken aback; he had never thought about this issue before.
Fairy Eternity continued: "In ancient times, a fetus gestating in the womb would automatically draw in the essence of heaven and earth. This essence, formless, massless, sensationless and undetectable, would gather together and form a soul."
"The birth of souls has always been a mystery. After the five of us became immortals, we divined together and discovered a previously unknown substance in the world called essence. This essence is the source of the soul."
"The creation of the soul can be considered a rule, which we will tentatively call the soul rule."
"If the reincarnation rule affected everyone, then it would inevitably conflict with the soul rule. The conflict between the created rule and the original rule is unavoidable, which is a taboo when coalescing a Dao Fruit."
"Unless the Immortal controlling the Reincarnation Dao Fruit is stupid, this wouldn't happen."
Hearing Fairy Eternity's explanation, Lu Yang raised a question: "Fairy, can your Eternity rule cover everyone?"
If the Eternity rule could cover everyone, it would mean that everyone would be immortal.
This was a great temptation that people could not resist.
Fairy Eternity denied Lu Yang's idea: "At the time when I had just coalesced the Eternity Dao Fruit, I had this idea. I thought that everyone was struggling to improve their realm, scrambling for resources, and that we all just wanted to become immortal and live forever. Isn't that right?"
"If I let everyone live forever, wouldn't the world be peaceful then?"
"When I shared this idea with Ying Tian Immortal and the others, their reaction was strong, they jointly prevented me from moving forward with it, telling me I couldn't think like that."

chapters.title: Chapter 220 - 219: The Second-in-Command of the Immortal Lineage_1
chapters.content:
"There are mainly two reasons why they are stopping me."
"The first reason is that everyone occupies resources; not only for survival but also for a better life."
"If everyone lived forever, occupying a massive amount of resources, life would become extremely difficult for the newborns. They would need to battle against the old monsters or beg for some resources from them. As a result, life becomes harder for each generation. They would be born not to enjoy, but to suffer. Over time, the world will become lifeless."
"The second reason is that the lifespan of every creature is limited, it can be seen as a rule. If everyone becomes immortal, it will conflict with the rule of lifespan, which would shake the foundation of the Eternity Dao Fruit."
"Although I think they are not as smart as me, these two points make sense, so I accepted them."
"However, Lu Yang, rest assured. Although I can't make everyone immortal, I can give you a nascent Eternity Dao Fruit, so your immortality won't be a problem."
Fairy Eternity generously said, "So, would you like to join my line of Eternity? Trust me, you'll have a luxurious life, everything you want will be at your disposal."
"From then on, you will be the second-in-command of my line of Eternity!"
"I have a question: How many people are there in the line of Eternity?"
"Three people: me, you, and Sha Meless. Your status is even higher than Sha Meless, and being immortal...well, you can appreciate the value of the position", Fairy Eternity laughed.
Every one of the Five Immortals of the Ancients had their disciples and followers. While not many, none of them only had one disciple.
Fairy Eternity was an exception.
There was actually only Fairy Eternity in the line of Eternity. Sha Meless was forced to transfer to Fairy Eternity's side, tricked by someone unknown.
And Lu Yang was just recruited by Fairy Eternity.
Lu Yang was silent for a few seconds, then resolutely shook his head: "I will rely on my own effort."
"Well, that's boring." Fairy Eternity pouted, somewhat disappointed with Lu Yang's choice.
She genuinely wanted to give Lu Yang a nascent Eternity Dao Fruit and have him follow her.
A countless number of people tried to be accepted into Fairy Eternity's line during the ancient times, but all were rejected by Fairy Eternity. As for those who harbored ulterior motives, Fairy Eternity didn't even bother with them.
From the ancient times till now, Lu Yang was the most to her taste out of all the cultivators she had seen. This was the first time she invited someone to join her line on her initiative.
Yet, she was refused.
"Can Immortal Fairy see that Li Haoran possesses the Dao Fruit of Reincarnation? Or maybe a nascent Dao Fruit of Reincarnation?" This was Lu Yang's primary concern at this point.
Fairy Eternity shook her head: "I can't perceive that, it's tricky."
"Alright."
...
Lu Yang's conversation with Fairy Eternity seemed to have taken a long time. However, it was much faster in Spiritual Space than in reality.
In reality, Li Haoran was still insisting that he has no relation to Qin Haoran.
Just imagine it. If he accepted being Qin Haoran's reincarnation, what would happen?
He would have a heavenly beautiful wife who was at the Unification Stage.
He would have a lively and lovely daughter.
He would have a constant flow of resources including spirit stones, elixirs, weapons, and all kinds of valuable materials.
He would even have a protector at the Unification Stage.
...Seems like there's nothing wrong with acknowledging being Qin Haoran's reincarnation?
Wait a minute. He needed to consider the drawbacks of this action.
Li Haoran pondered for a long while, and he felt like there weren't any disadvantages.
"Bewitching woman! You're ruining my Dao heart! My goal is to become a cultivator as talented as Senior Brother Lu. I won't rely on external support, but on my talent and abilities to cultivate to the highest realm!"
Look at Senior Brother Lu, who was of the same age, yet he had become the Acting Sect Leader. As for himself, he could only rely on others.
"I guess that's it for today. We've been troubled for a whole day. Let's all rest for now." Li Haoran's parents, noticing the discussion wouldn't be concluded anytime soon, decided to drop the topic for the time being.
"We have plenty of guest rooms at home. You and Little Meng came such a long way from Seek Dao Sect. Stay in Luofeng County for a few more days."
"Yanyan and Su Yiren, you don't need to stay in the inn anymore. Just stay here."
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou didn't decline the good intentions of Li Haoran's parents. Under the persuasion of Su Yiren, Qin Yanyan also agreed to live there.
After a long day of discussion, it was finally dinner time. Without mentioning Qin Haoran, everyone got along well.
"Oh, we have talked for so long, and dinner still isn't ready!" Li Haoran's mother was somewhat flustered.
Lu Yang stopped her: "Please let us handle the cooking, Meng Jingzhou and I are renowned for our cooking skills in the Seek Dao Sect!"
Li Haoran's mother was a little hesitant, but Li Haoran, who was aware of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou's skills, persuaded her to let them cook.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou smoothly took out several items from their jade identity cards, such as a barbecue grill, a brush, a fan, skewers, meat, seasonings...and most importantly, the Automatic Skewer Formation.
This was the recent achievement of Masters Liu and Gao, responding to Fairy Eternity's call towards bringing their barbecue restaurant even beyond Seek Dao Sect, to reach across the whole continent.
What's the most essential thing about a chain of restaurants? Of course, it's standardization and uniformization.
The starting point of standardization and uniformization was this Automatic Skewer Formation.
Qin Yanyan, watching from the side, couldn't help but twitch her mouth. She had heard that the disciples from Seek Dao Sect were multi-talented, but she thought it referred to numerous kind of cultivation talents.
Why does it even include barbecuing?
Upon listening to Li Haoran's introductions, these two are disciples with exceptional status, one being the personal disciple of the Sect Leader and the other being the heir of the Meng Family. So, are they all so down-to-earth in their actions?
"Real Fire?!" Qin Yanyan exclaimed upon seeing Lu Yang spewing True Fire.
The difficulty of cultivating True Fire, a kind of flame even Golden Core Stage cultivators have difficulty mastering, is as tough as scaling the heavens.
Li Haoran snorted disdainfully: "Even worse, it's the Samadhi True Fire, one of the highest-ranking kinds of True Fire!"
"Do you know who Senior Brother Lu and Senior Brother Meng are? They are the top two students of our generation!"
Qin Yanyan's eyes widen in surprise. She had heard before that Li Haoran ranked fifth in his generation and thought it was due to his lack of ability.
After fighting with him, she had to admit that even without his wig, she wouldn't be able to defeat Li Haoran.
During that time, she wondered, Li Haoran was capable but still just fifth, what kind of monsters were the top four?
She now knew.
Li Haoran's mother was surprised to discover that Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were in fact the top two students of Li Haoran's generation, which explains why she liked them so much.
"Look at Lu Yang, Haoran. He surely gets up before the sunrise to practice every day, unlike you, wasting your days without studying or practicing diligently. I bet you would sleep until the sun shines on your bottom whenever I'm not around. If only you were half as hardworking as Lu Yang!"
Li Haoran couldn't help but feel resentful. If he knew, he wouldn't have brought Senior Brother Lu and Senior Brother Meng here.
Plus, what dedication were Senior Brother Lu and Senior Brother Meng showing? They were all the same age, they all knew about each other's habits, and everyone had similar routines.

chapters.title: Chapter 221 - 220: Cloudy and Sunny Days_1
chapters.content:
As the founders of the "One More Time" Barbecue Shop, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou's cooking skills were naturally not lacking.
This was evident back in Yanjiang County, and Lu Yang had only improved since acquiring the Three Flavored True Fire, taking his skills to another level.
Among those in the Foundation Establishment Stage, Lu Yang boasted that no one could match him in barbecuing skills.
Lu Yang gave the skewers a shake, with the cumin and chili powder tumbling among the pieces of meat. The fire imparted an irresistible aroma, causing even Qin Yanyan, usually fond of light flavours, to salivate.
"Come, it's ready!"
Lu Yang placed two large handfuls of skewers into the grill pan, the thud echoing with a satisfying weight.
Meanwhile, Meng Jingzhou wasn't idle either. Barbecuing potatoes, chives, and tofu; the delightful aroma emitted was no less appealing than Lu Yang's.
"Delicious!" Li Haoran's parents sang praises from the bottom of their hearts. As expected of their star pupils, their cooking skills were as advanced as their cultivation, far surpassing Li Haoran's own.
"I want one too!" Li Haoran had often heard tales of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou's legendary skewers, yet had never had the opportunity to try them for himself.
This was the barbecue that had once been savored to the point of causing the Eternity Sect's downfall.
"Delicious!" Li Haoran's eyes lit up. This was the best skewer he had ever eaten.
Qin Yanyan and Su Yiren both nibbled politely, but as the atmosphere gradually grew livelier, their inhibitions loosened.
Everyone was full and satisfied, their faces reflecting their contentment. Seeing everyone enjoy the meal made Fairy Eternity's mouth water.
However, being in a spirit form, she lacked the sense of taste and couldn't eat anything.
"Lu Yang, I want to use your body so I can have a taste too," she negotiated with Lu Yang.
Lu Yang didn't mind and graciously handed over control of his body.
Fairy Eternity happily took over Lu Yang's body, dining with an unbridled enthusiasm.
"Haha, Senior Brother Lu, you sure have loosened up!" Li Haoran laughed. Lu Yang had been rather more elegant when dining before, but just now, it was as if he had become another person entirely, gulping down skewers and bamboo juice.
Lu Yang sighed in resignation. This lack of restraint from Fairy Eternity did not befit her stature.
"Yingtian Immortal and the others have often advised me to speak as little as possible in the presence of outsiders. They said it took much effort to improve the public perception of immortals, and they don't want me messing up their hard work."
"But aren't there no outsiders here?" Fairy Eternity insisted, not regarding Lu Yang as an outsider.
"But the problem is that it's my body you're using!" Lu Yang argued.
"Oh, come on. What's yours and mine between us?" Fairy Eternity asked generously, "When we find my inheritance, I will share half of it with you."
Lu Yang remembered Fairy Eternity mentioning that she had buried some treasures in the North Star, which contained all her precious items.
Knowing Fairy Eternity, there probably wasn't anything worthwhile there.
"If worst comes to worst, I could teach you a few immortality-level cooking techniques," Fairy Eternity offered, treating herself as a worthy mentor.
Lu Yang rolled his eyes in response but said nothing.
Setting aside this minor episode that only they knew about, everyone thoroughly enjoyed their meal.
Li Haoran's parents arranged rooms for Lu Yang and the other guests.
After washing up, Lu Yang took out a pillow, half his height, from his Identity Jade. This was his hugging pillow. Lu Yang liked to sleep while hugging something.
With over a decade of experience sleeping, he could sleep well anywhere and wasn't choosy about the location.
The next morning, Lu Yang woke up to find his pillow kicked to the foot of the bed, looking somewhat pitiful.
"This little girl named Su Yiren is thoughtful," Fairy Eternity suddenly commented.
"What do you mean?"
"She set up an Array Method in the courtyard while you were sleeping. It has no use for you, but for Li Haoran's parents, it can help them cultivate unconsciously, infusing them with spiritual essence and increasing their cultivation level. Although this process could take a long time, and there's no visible difference at the moment, Li Haoran's parents won't notice anything."
Lu Yang stepped out of the room and stretched. The weather was good; overcast and cool.
He preferred overcast days over sunny ones.
He saw Li Haoran practicing martial arts in the courtyard.
"Junior Brother Li, you're so diligent even when you're home?" Lu Yang was surprised. He thought he had woken up early, but it seemed Li Haoran was already up and practicing.
He didn't remember him being this diligent back at the Seek Dao Sect.
Li Haoran turned serious and spoke to Lu Yang through spiritual communication: "Senior Brother Lu, you may not know. Although my parents were happy to see me home yesterday and welcomed me, based on my experience, once the excitement of the first day is over, they will reprimand me for eating and sleeping all day, saying that I'm living too idly."
"I thought it better to act before they'd get the chance to scold me. So, I put on a show of being diligent, at least for the morning. It's not like they can stop me from going out during the day."
Lu Yang understood, surprised that it was so well-thought-out.
What Li Haoran hadn't revealed was that if Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou hadn't come, his parents might have continued to spoil him for a few more days. But with their arrival, his pampering phase was sure to be cut short!
"Haoran, why are you up so early?" Li Haoran's mother noticed him practicing early in the morning with Lu Yang standing beside him, and she was overjoyed.
She assumed Lu Yang had influenced Haoran to practice together.
Li Haoran: "..."
He resisted the urge to remind his mother that the achievement of being the fifth-ranking disciple in his class at the Seek Dao Sect was no small feat.
With his aptitude, whether in a first-class or superior sect, he would have certainly secured first place in his class. Even at Seek Dao Sect, he could have ranked in the top three among the previous batches.
Sadly, his batch was full of prodigies.
During breakfast, Su Yiren quietly ate her food without mentioning her setting up the Array Method in the yard the previous night. It seemed like she didn't want people to know about it.
Had it not been for Fairy Eternity, Lu Yang would have never known.
"Let's go, I'll take you guys to the county for a stroll!" Li Haoran invited Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, but he then thought better of it and also invited Qin Yanyan and Su Yiren.
"I'm only inviting you because you're our guests. Don't overthink it," Li Haoran said to Su Yiren.
Despite his words, Su Yiren still smiled joyfully.
Just as they were preparing to leave, the overcast sky darkened even more. The clouds thicken rapidly, and they could faintly hear the sound of thunder in the distance.
"It's going to rain heavily," Li Haoran said, looking up at the sky with a hint of regret. Luofeng County was known for its frequent rainfall. Judging from the weather, a heavy rain was imminent. "It seems we can't go today."
Upon hearing this, Su Yiren pointed a palm at the sky. The heavens instantly cleared of sliding dark clouds, revealing a bright, sunny sky.
With a genial smile, Su Yiren said as if nothing happened, "The sky is clear now; let's go."
Li Haoran: "..."

chapters.title: Chapter 222 - 221 Phoenix Blood Stone_1
chapters.content:
In the street, a group of men and women attracted many passersby to turn their heads around, especially the two women, one tall and one short, each with their unique charm. They seemed to display the best aspect of every age, provoking people's imaginations.
The most enviable thing was the ordinary-looking man in the middle of the three men, whose cultivation level was merely at Foundation Establishment Stage, yet the extraordinarily beautiful woman was clinging onto his arm.
Li Haoran kept a straight face. Despite Su Yiren appearing tender and feeble, she was, in essence, an expert in the Unification Stage. If she intended to hold onto him, he simply couldn't break free.
Keeping his calm, he turned his head and met Su Yiren's gaze: "I know you're eager to walk around with me, but can you control your power? This is the third time you've broken my arm."
Li Haoran swung his arm to indicate that his injury was severe.
Su Yiren quickly took out a healing elixir from her storage ring and began resetting Li Haoran's bones.
Given Su Yiren's realm, such loss of control should not happen. Li Haoran could only attribute it to her being so ecstatic at being with him that she lost control of her strength.
"You didn't even cry out when your bone broke?" Qin Yanyan looked astonished at Li Haoran. Was this man incapable of feeling pain?
Li Haoran chuckled and said: "Ever since I soaked in magma for a year, I can't remember what pain feels like."
Recalling the time when he was thrown into magma by his master right after joining the sect, Li Haoran felt that he was lucky to be alive.
"Mag... magma? For a whole year?" Qin Yanyan's eyes bulged in shock. Was this man still human?
With a melancholic tone, Li Haoran said: "When I was thrown into the magma, I screamed until my lungs tore, the agony was unbearable. I screamed until my voice was gone, but the pain remained."
"My master didn't allow anyone to help me. He wanted me to endure through it on my own. At that time, seeing my suffering, Senior Sister Zhou LuLu couldn't bear it and secretly brought me a cup of tea brewed from heavenly treasures while our master was away. She said it would alleviate my condition."
As Qin Yanyan imagined herself being immersed in magma, she shivered. Upon hearing this, she couldn't help but ask, "Was it to help you adapt to the magma quickly?"
"It was tea brewed with Hundred-Year Arhat Fruit. Sister Zhou LuLu saw that I had lost my voice from all the screaming, so she wanted me to soothe my throat."
Qin Yanyan: "..."
Ever since Lu Yang heard that Li Haoran had soaked in magma for a year due to Fifth Elder Zhou Xin's arrangement, he didn't feel his Eldest Senior Sister's act of washing him with boiling water was much of a big deal.
That being said, if Li Haoran didn't have the Fire Spirit Root, Elder Zhou Xin wouldn't dare to submerge him in magma. This was a cultivation technique exclusive to those with Fire Spirit Root.
Each Single Spiritual Root from the five elements had dedicated cultivation methods. For instance, those with Fire Spirit Root soaked in magma or were burned by fire, enabling them to comprehend magic skills or abilities related to fire. Like, Li Haoran understood the art of Refining Pacemaking.
Those with Earth Spirit Root were buried in the soil to comprehend the Earth Escape Technique.
Those with Water Spirit Root were thrown into water to comprehend the Water Control Technique.
However, there were exceptions.
For example, Lu Yang had heard that Elder Brother Dai Bufan had the Water Spirit Root. The Grand Elder tossed Dai Bufan into a pond, stopping him from breathing, in the hope that in the brink of life and death, Brother Dai could comprehend the Water Control Technique or the magic technique to breathe underwater.
But things didn't go as planned--Brother Dai comprehended spatial magic and drank up all the water in the pond.
"Dear niece, see something you like? Your uncle will buy it for you." Meng Jingzhou teased Qin Yanyan. He might lack many things, but he certainly didn't lack money.
Upon hearing Meng Jingzhou calling her "niece", Qin Yanyan stomped her foot in annoyance, but she couldn't do anything about it.
"What is this?" Hoping to divert attention, Qin Yanyan casually pointed at a stone that someone was selling by the road.
The stone was blood-red, radiant and seemingly formed naturally. It reflected a heart-pulling glow under the sunlight.
"Oh, this is a Phoenix Blood Stone, a specialty of our Luofeng County."
"Phoenix Blood Stone?" Su Yiren was the only one among those present who had heard of such a stone before.
Li Haoran said, "You all must have heard the origin of our Luofeng County. It was said that a long, long time ago, a pureblood phoenix soars freely between the heavens and the earth. But it grew too old to fly and chose a place to rest. It wanted to sleep for a while, and then, it never woke up again."
"The body of the old phoenix turned into the hills of the earth." Li Haoran pointed at the mountain range that vaguely semi-encircled Luofeng County in the distance, "Look at these mountains, don't they look like a phoenix when joined together?"
"The feathers of the old phoenix turned into trees, which is why there are many red-colored plants on these hills."
"The phoenix's blood stained the stones red, and these stones are the Phoenix Blood Stones that we see now."
Lu Yang thought to himself, "Is this a phoenix or Pangu?"
"When I first heard this story as a child, I thought it was a legend. But when I came to the Seek Dao Sect and learned about refining tools from the master, I realized that the Phoenix Blood Stones in my hometown really are stained red by the blood of a Phoenix. They are superior refining materials."
"Phoenix..." The term brought back some memories for Fairy Eternity.
"In the past, not only the Kirin, but also the Dragon and Phoenix Tribes had potential immortals. They carefully nurtured two talented geniuses from the Demon Race, who had unparalleled talent and were strongly supported by the Dragon and Phoenix Tribes. Their chances of becoming immortals were quite high."
"In contrast, despite being hailed as the favored child of Heaven and Earth, the Kirin was essentially grassroots without backing. Many demons did not see him in a good light."
"Kirin faced many formidable enemies, none were his match. He defeated many enemies that were impossible to overcome. The Demon Race was on the rise rapidly. Both the philosophies of Kirin and the geniuses from the Dragon and Phoenix Tribes aimed to become immortals, signalling a fierce battle that could not be avoided."
"Kirin, being a large-scale fortune, fought against two and won the battle against the geniuses of the Dragon and Phoenix Tribes, thus attaining Dao Fruit and becoming the Qilin Immortal."
"Did the Kirin Immortal kill the talents of the Dragon and Phoenix Tribes?" Fairy Eternity's tone was calm, but Lu Yang heard cruelty in her words.
Indeed, becoming immortal is not a game. The winner takes everything, the loser has nothing and may even lose their life.
"No, they got married."
"What?"
"The Demon Race admires strength. After the talents of the Dragon and Phoenix Tribes lost to Kirin Immortal they fell in love with him. In the end, the three of them got married. I originally wanted to attend the Kirin Immortal's wedding, but he said I was too beautiful and would steal their thunder, so they didn't let me go."
"What a pity, I was expecting to show Kirin Immortal something at the wedding."
"What did you plan to do at the Kirin Immortal's wedding?"
"Cook, of course. Let me tell you, of the four of them, none could do housework or tell the five grains apart. I'm the only one who can cook." Fairy Eternity looked disgusted, thinking the four of them were too disgraceful.
Lu Yang felt it was understandable that the Kirin Immortal did not invite Fairy Eternity.
A wedding would definitely require inviting a bunch of people. If Fairy Eternity were to cook, there would inevitably be a shortage of antidotes.
"Later, I thought as a friend, I should at least give a gift for the wedding. So, I gave them an Immortal Fruit with a blessing for them and thoughtfully wrote 'For the most beautiful demon race'."
"I heard that my gift caused quite a stir, probably because they had never seen such a precious present."
After a few seconds of silence, Lu Yang asked, "How many Immortal Fruits did you give them at that time?"
"Just one."
Lu Yang let out a long sigh: "You just love causing trouble."
"What? Why?"

chapters.title: Chapter 223 - 222: Ancient Black Hand Yellow Bean_1
chapters.content:
"Fairy, you should have offered two Immortal Fruits back then?" Lu Yang could probably imagine the storm that this Immortal Fruit had stirred up.
The longer Lu Yang interacted with Fairy Eternity, the less he understood why anyone would want her dead—there were too many reasons, and he didn't know which one to choose.
"I've said it before, the fruit is to be given to 'the most beautiful' of the Demon Race, 'most' can only be one, don't you know?" Fairy Eternity seriously enlightened Lu Yang on basic grammar.
After a long silence, Lu Yang said, "...You make a good point."
"Right." Fairy Eternity put her hands on her hips and enjoyed her triumph.
"So, who did you give the Immortal Fruit to?"
"After the fact, I heard from Time Immortal that there was a dispute over the ownership of the Immortal Fruit at the wedding scene between the Dragon and Phoenix Tribes' supreme geniuses, and they wanted to settle it with a magical duel."
"Speaking of which, Qilin Immortal is indeed stingy. He has Immortal Fruits himself, why couldn't he just give each of his wives one so they wouldn't have to fight over it?"
Fairy Eternity shook her head, in comparison to Qilin Immortal, she was fairly generous, being able to offer an Immortal Fruit as a gift.
"What happened then?"
"Later, Qilin Immortal said that duel at the wedding was ultimately inelegant and proposed a different sort of competition. Conveniently, three other Immortals were present at the event, he suggested Ying Tian Immortal, Immortal Jiuchong and Time Immortal judge the contest, removing himself from the panel of judges, to prevent a tie in the scores."
"Look, if Qilin Immortal had invited me before, wouldn't we Immortals become five judges? Moreover, you know me, I'm impartial and fair, and I can be the lone judge."
"Even though they were worried about my beauty overshadowing Dragon and Phoenix geniuses, I could wear a veil!" As the first of the top ten beauties of the ancient times, Fairy Eternity was very confident in her looks.
Lu Yang thought to himself, Fairy you should be more conscious. Obviously, Qilin Immortal didn't want to be a judge and diplomatically excused himself.
"What was the contest between the Geniuses of the Dragon and Phoenix Tribe?"
"Cooking."
Fairy Eternity shook her head regrettably: "The four of them, including Qilin Immortal, didn't know that I had taught the Geniuses of the Dragon and Phoenix Tribes cooking. Although there was no formal master-disciple relationship, they were indeed my disciples. They didn't master the skills perfectly and just managed to grasp one or two tenths of my cooking skills.
Even so, it's hard to find rivals among those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage."
"During the competition, as they were both students of the same master, neither could break the other's move. Naturally, the dishes they made were hard to differentiate in terms of quality."
"Time Immortal told me when they tasted the dishes made by the geniuses of Dragon and Phoenix Tribes, they were amazed. It felt as if they contained the power of time, allowing them to quickly review their lives. "
"Modestly, I say that I taught them, but they only learned the basics from me."
"Time Immortal was silent for a moment before admitting that they beat up Qilin Immortal prematurely. Qilin Immortal was not the instigator. When I asked him what he meant, he didn't say."
Lu Yang showed his respect to Fairy Eternity with a formal bow.
If anyone didn't understand Fairy Eternity's personality, they would mistake her for a scheming villain just from listening to this story. Without even being present, she managed to instigate a fight between the Dragon and Phoenix Tribes' geniuses with a single Immortal Fruit, causing the Four Immortals of the Ancients to turn against each other, and putting Qilin Immortal in an immoral position.
She even secretly taught the geniuses of the Dragon and Phoenix Tribes some skills, and lurked in the shadows waiting for the right moment.
This kind of wisdom can only be described as unfathomable. Anyone would feel cold and tremble in fear when they face such deeply schemed creatures.
However, Lu Yang knew Fairy Eternity very well, so he decided to use another term to describe Fairy Eternity's wisdom—
It was wisdom disguised as great foolishness.
...
"You should know that the Dragon and Phoenix Tribes are the most conceited races among the Demon Race. Their blood is extraordinarily precious, and it's extremely difficult for the Human race to obtain it. Therefore, Phoenix Blood Stone becomes extremely critical."
"Phoenix Blood Stone is not only a special product of Luofeng County, but also our pillar industry. The volume of Spirit Stones obtained from selling Phoenix Blood Stones every year is enormous!"
"Phoenix Blood Stone is not only a good material for Refining, but also an unexpected benefit for long-term wear as an ornament."
"I've heard from my dad that Luofeng County has been mining Phoenix Blood Stones for 4,000 years. The veins are not yet exhausted, and Phoenix Blood Stones continue to be mined."
As Li Haoran introduced his hometown's economy, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou kept nodding as though they were inspecting leaders.
"How many Spirit Stones does this Phoenix Blood Stone cost?" Meng Jingzhou selected in the shop, thinking this thing was fun, so he bought a few to play with.
"Three hundred Spirit Stones."
"And this one?"
"Four hundred fifty Spirit Stones."
Meng Jingzhou shook his head, this cheap Phoenix Blood Stone was unfit for his status.
"Bring out the best Phoenix Blood Stones you have here, I'm not short of money." Meng Jingzhou behaved like a young lord.
The shop owner's eyes lit up upon hearing this, thinking he had met a big customer.
Looking left and right, noticing that only Meng Jingzhou and his group were in the shop, he led them to the backyard. He carefully took out a fine wooden box from the shelf and opened it. In the box lay a dazzling, blood-red stone the size of a goose egg. It looked like something that was dyed red at the moment of the death of the mythical Old Phoenix.
Even Qin Yanyan could feel the extraordinary aura of this Phoenix Blood Stone.
The shop owner whispered, "A while ago, there was a mine collapse, this is the last Phoenix Blood Stone that was poached from the mine. It took me a lot of effort to get it. The asking price is five hundred thousand Spirit Stones."
Meng Jingzhou nodded, that seemed about right: "Give me ten."
The difference between five hundred thousand Spirit Stones and five million Spirit Stones was like a drizzle to Young Master Meng, insignificant.
The shop owner made a bitter face: "Sir, it's not that I don't want to sell more, but this is the only Phoenix Blood Stone I have."
"Alright then, I'll take this one." The shop owner was overjoyed. Actually, his asking price was a bit high, leaving room for bargaining. He didn't expect Meng Jingzhou to buy it without bargaining.
The shop owner even gave away several Phoenix Blood Stones of decent quality. However, compared to Meng Jingzhou's stone, they were vastly inferior.
Meng Jingzhou knew he could bargain, but he was always too lazy to do so when shopping. It was too much trouble.
He asked the shop owner to drill a hole in the Phoenix Blood Stone and string it up.
When Meng Jingzhou wore it around his neck, he felt quite good about himself.
He thought everyone was shopping, so he couldn't be the only one buying a Phoenix Blood Stone. He went through several shops wanting to buy one of similar quality for each of his fellow travellers, but unfortunately, after some comparisons, they didn't match up to his Phoenix Blood Stone.
"There's so much money, but there's nothing to spend it on."
Li Haoran advised, "Senior Brother Meng, give it up. The Phoenix Blood Stone contains the power of Phoenixes, which doesn't do much for us, and even for Refining, I do not yet have the ability to refine such high-quality Phoenix Blood Stones. Even if we buy them, we won't be able to use them."
"Alright then." Hearing Li Haoran say this, Meng Jingzhou could only give up.
"By the way, what's the use of wearing the Phoenix Blood Stone for a long time?" Meng Jingzhou asked, pointing to the Phoenix Blood Stone on his chest.
"Yang Invigorating."

chapters.title: Chapter 224 - 223 - That Thing_1
chapters.content:
With a history of a hundred thousand years, the Meng Family is a top-ranking family in the Central Continent, very well-cultured. Meng Jingzhou, as the eldest legitimate son of the Meng Family, was eloquent and wouldn't feel discontented with Li Haoran over trivial matters.
Looking at Li Haoran, Meng Jingzhou said mysteriously, "Could you tell me about Yang Invigorating things earlier next time?"
Li Haoran replied with an 'oh' sound, as if recalling something, and said, "Master told me that soaking in lava for a long time can also invigorate yang. That was one of my motivations to persist, and it proved to be quite effective."
"... Can we skip the conversation about Yang Invigorating?"
"Alright then."
By the time Lu Yang and his group returned to Li's house, Li Haoran's mother had already prepared a lavish dinner for everyone.
They couldn't expect Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, their two guests, to cook every day.
Meng Jingzhou bought a mountain of stuff - basically, if he had never seen something before, he bought it.
He didn't care whether these things were useful or not, he bought them because they were intriguing.
Of course, Meng Jingzhou didn't buy things that offended his intelligence, such as something that claimed to be four thousand years old, from the same era as the Old Phoenix, a witness to the full process of the Old Phoenix's fall, filled with pure natural Spiritual Energy.
Lu Yang bought a finely crafted phoenix pendant, tied it with his Identity Jade, and wore it around his waist.
Qin Yanyan bought a box of bamboo juice. She had tried the Luofeng County's local bamboo juice while enjoying barbecue last night and found it quite nice.
Su Yiren did not buy anything. As a Unification cultivator, nothing in Luofeng County was worth her money, unless it was the corpse of the Old Phoenix.
"Mom, you know how to cook?" Li Haoran was stunned looking at the table full of dishes. From his memory, his mother was not capable of making so many delicious dishes.
Li Haoran's mother laughed, "I just learned it. You have been away and I had nothing to do, so I thought I might as well learn something."
Li Haoran's father interrupted, "She just learned how to buy dishes from the old restaurant."
Li Haoran's mother gave his father a stern look.
Li Haoran, "..."
The skills of the old restaurant were excellent, a rare hundred-year-old shop in Lu Yang's previous life, but commonplace in the Central Continent.
However, a hundred years was not enough to be called an old shop. To be called an old shop, it should be at least five hundred years old.
The old restaurant was a thousand-year-old shop. The waitstaff would have changed time and again, but the shop owner had not changed for a thousand years, ensuring that the taste would never lost.
The oldest thing in the old restaurant was neither the recipe nor the furniture but the shop owner himself.
Oh, what, you said when you were a kid, the taste was not like this? The food you ate when you were a kid was made by me!
After dinner, Lu Yang asked Su Yiren about how to form the golden core.
"Form golden core?" Su Yiren was surprised that Lu Yang would ask her about this. Wasn't Li Haoran said that he was the fourth disciple of the Sect Leader of Seek Dao Sect? Why didn't he ask the Sect Leader directly?
The Sect Leader of the Seek Dao Sect had a higher status than her, and they were both at the Unification stage.
In front of others, Lu Yang could not say that his master was an old frivolous fool who spends their time storytelling every day, with only little time actually spent teaching him.
"My master is preoccupied with affairs of the world and doesn't have time for me."
"I see." Su Yiren nodded, believing Lu Yang's explanation.
Meng Jingzhou, sitting next to them, rolled his eyes.
Meng Jingzhou and Li Haoran were also in the room, listening to Su Yiren explain how to form the golden core.
Li Haoran was only at the early stage of Foundation Establishment now, but it didn't matter. He would eventually be able to use the knowledge of Golden Core.
"In my opinion, forming the golden core is all about opportunity. I'm not particularly talented. My biggest hope was to form a second-grade golden core, which was already the best-case scenario I could imagine."
