"To form a second-grade golden core, I tried everything I could to comprehend, submerge myself in forests, fighting demon beasts, sitting on boulders while being bombarded by waterfalls, observing the various forms of human life to understand the world's essence... Despite all of these efforts, none of them succeeded."
"One day, after I finished cultivating, I lay on the edge of a cliff, staring at the starry sky, feeling extraordinarily absurd."
"It was at that moment, an inexplicable realization surged in my heart, and I leveraged this opportunity to absorb energy and form my golden core—fully colored, a first-grade golden core."
"When I wasn't actively pursuing it, I had a realization. I've discussed this with several fellow practitioners, and two of them have had similar experiences."
Lu Yang gained some understanding and thanked Su Yiren.
...
In the dead of night, Lu Yang opened his eyes, though he was unsure of the time.
"Awake? I was just about to call you." Fairy Eternity spoke as if not surprised by Lu Yang's awakening.
Lu Yang frowned; in his sleep, he sensed someone stealthily breaking into Li Haoran's home.
What could be their purpose?
"Two individuals, at mid-stage of Golden Core Stage." Fairy Eternity informed him about the situation of the two people.
Lu Yang puzzled, Li Haoran's parents were only at Foundation Establishment Stage and they were not wealthy. What could possibly attract someone of the Golden Core Stage to Li Haoran's house?
Could it be the Phoenix Blood Stone that Meng Jingzhou bought?
Lu Yang did not worry about their safety. Even if Su Yiren did not intervene, he and Meng Jingzhou could easily handle these uninvited guests.
"Master Lu, Master Meng, are you awake?" Su Yiren's voice echoed in the minds of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
Li Haoran and Qin Yanyan were relatively inexperienced, lacking the heightened alertness of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
"Just woke up." Both Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou responded simultaneously. "Senior Su, what's the situation now?"
Su Yiren shook her head, "I don't know much. I know only that two people at the mid-stage of Golden Core Stage have infiltrated the house stealthily. I don't know their objective, but my intuition tells me someone else is behind them. I want to capture them, but I am afraid of stirring up the snake in the grass."
"No worries, Senior Su, all you need is to back us up." Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou quickly came up with a plan.
Under Su Yiren's curious gaze, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou skillfully changed into nightclothes and quietly left the room.
The two Golden Core Stage cultivators seemed to be searching for something but did not dare to use their Spiritual Sense for fear of being detected.
They heard that a genius from the Seek Dao Sect resides in the house and did not want to expose themselves unless absolutely necessary.
They thought their actions were concealed but were already being observed by several people.
The pair suddenly became alert, sensing danger approaching. They quickly dodged, barely evading the attacks of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
"Didn't expect you to avoid that. Quite talented, aren't you?" Lu Yang sneered and conveyed his thoughts through his Spiritual Sense.
"Who are you! What are you doing in Li's house!" The two Golden Core Stage cultivators responded.
"Heh, don't play dumb. Since we've met in Li's house, what else could it be about? Of course, we're after that thing!" Meng Jingzhou laughed dismissively, mocking their foolish question. "As for who we are, who else do you think would know about this?"
The two Golden Core Stage cultivators looked stunned, "How do you know!"
"There are no walls without ears in the world. What secrets can be kept forever? No matter how much you try to hide, we'll uncover it." Lu Yang chuckled, "Did you think you were the only ones interested in that object?"
"Dammit, how did the Mo Family find out about the Phoenix Blood Stone!" The two Golden Core Stage cultivators quickly deduced the identities of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
It must be that rival Mo Family!
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou exchanged a glance—it did all stem from bringing back the Phoenix Blood Stone.
Once the pair of Golden Core Stage cultivators realized their cover was blown, they briefly engaged in combat before making a hasty retreat.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou chased them relentlessly, but failed to catch up with the pair, leaving them somewhat frustrated.
When the two Golden Core cultivators managed to shake off Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, they swiftly returned to report the situation.
"Let's go, Senior Su, if we follow them, we'll find out who is behind all this," Lu Yang said, quickening his pace, stealthily pursuing the two Golden Core Stage cultivators.
Su Yiren exhibited a peculiar expression. 'How come you two are so skilled at this sort of thing?'

chapters.title: Chapter 225 - 234: These Few Spirit Stones May Not Be Enough_1
chapters.content:
Two Golden Core Stage cultivators were maneuvering through Luofeng County city. It was clear that they had the route memorized as they deftly avoided the patrol routes of other cultivators scheduled for the night watch.
At this moment, Su Yiren woke Li Haoran up. After listening to his fiancée briefly explaining the ins and outs of the situation, his expression was somewhat strange.
"Senior Brother Meng is finally drawing unwanted attention for flaunting his wealth?"
"What do you mean flaunting? Can't I tell people that I have money?" Meng Jingzhou widened his eyes. When he was the young master of the Meng Family at the Imperial City, who dared to set their sights on his possessions?
As Su Yiren quietly led the trio in pursuit of the two Golden Core Stage cultivators, jumping from one rooftop to another, out of the corner of his eye, Lu Yang noticed a few silhouettes doing the same thing in the distance.
"Is Luofeng County this lively even at night?"
Lu Yang initially wanted to chase after them and investigate, but he saw the two Golden Core Stage cultivators enter a high-walled compound. Therefore, he decided to prioritize the matter at hand first.
"I remember this is... the County Magistrate's mansion?" Li Haoran was somewhat hesitant, doubting if his memory was faulty.
The Phoenix Blood Stone worth fifty-five Spirit Stones was indeed precious, but it wasn't so valuable as to catch the interest of a County Magistrate.
Unless the Phoenix Blood Stone Senior Brother Meng bought contained some hidden secrets.
The high-walled compound was protected by an Array Method – to advance without knowing the method would alert the people inside.
Su Yiren effortlessly bypassed the Array Method and successfully led the three men into the compound.
"Master, we've returned." The two Golden Core Stage cultivators respectfully addressed the middle-aged man standing with his hands behind his back.
Li Haoran had never met the County Magistrate. He didn't know if this middle-aged man was the County Magistrate or perhaps a steward.
The middle-aged man let out a casual grunt, "Did you get the item?"
Both of them were somewhat embarrassed, "Something unexpected happened. We were worried about causing a commotion, so we didn't continue to steal that item."
"Unexpected?"
"Yes, we encountered other people at Li Haoran's house who were also there to steal the item. Although they didn't reveal their identities, I suspect they were sent by the Mo Family."
"What happened? Give me the details."
The two described the situation truthfully. However, the master became furious upon hearing their account, "Hmph, you were tricked! The people you encountered were not from the Mo Family, but disciples of the Seek Dao Sect!"
"If I'm not mistaken, they're currently eavesdropping from above the rooftop!"
"Now that I've said this much, you might as well come out. Let's have a frank discussion."
Li Haoran was alarmed and about to reveal himself, only to be held back by Lu Yang.
Lu Yang shook his head and said nothing.
After the master had waited for quite some time with no one appearing: "It seems those you encountered really are from the Mo Family. It appears the Mo Family is also aware of the existence of that item."
He had just tried to bluff them.
Yesterday, he received a report from his subordinates that three Seek Dao Sect disciples at the Foundation Establishment Stage had arrived in Luofeng County, one of which was a local. However, he didn't pay much attention to it.
But to his surprise, this afternoon he got a report from his subordinates that one of the Seek Dao Sect disciples had purchased an extremely rare Phoenix Blood Stone and was looking for similar Phoenix Blood Stones in other shops.
After hearing his subordinates describe what the Phoenix Blood Stone looked like, he was startled and suspected that it was the problematic Phoenix Blood Stone.
It absolutely couldn't fall into the hands of the Seek Dao Sect. If they discovered anything suspicious, it would spell disaster.
Therefore, he sent two of his men to steal the Phoenix Blood Stone. However, they ran into the Mo Family.
The Mo Family was the leading family in Luofeng County, and held a grudge against him, the County Magistrate. They were always trying to catch him red-handed.
"Tsk, I wonder how that thing got out there. Did you ask at the shop where they sold the item?"
"The man is already not there. We heard from the employees that after the shop owner made a large sum of money, he took his wife and children on a holiday. They won't be back for a while, and now there are only a few workers left to look after the place."
"How enviable."
"Ah, master, what did you just say?"
"Nothing."
The County Magistrate thought to himself that after he finished this task, he would take his wife and children somewhere else for a change of scenery.
"What did they say about the mine? When will the work be finished? We can't keep using a mine collapse as an excuse to stop the miners from digging."
The excuse of a mine collapse could only be used to stall for a while because, in the Cultivation World, they could get a few cultivators with higher realms to directly dig out a new mine.
Taking the County Magistrate himself as an example, if he took action, he could dig through a mine within half a day. However, now he was claiming that his cultivation had encountered a hiccup and that he wouldn't be able to take action for half a month.
"They've said they need three more days."
"Tell them to speed things up but to also be discreet. We absolutely can't let outsiders know about this. This matter not only concerns us, but also the interests of the Phoenix Tribe!"
"Yes, sir!"
Upon hearing this, Lu Yang and the others were stunned. From what the County Magistrate said, had he colluded with the Phoenix Tribe?
With the arrival of the Great Era, the Central Continent's tensions intensified with various other forces, both openly and secretly. This included conflicts between the Central Continent and the Demon Race.
Within the Demon Race, some wanted to go to war with the Great Xia Dynasty, while some wanted to reconcile with the Great Xia Dynasty to face the crisis of the Great Era together. Hence, the Demon Race was split between the war faction and peace faction.
"It's unclear whether the Dragon Clan and the Phoenix Tribe belong to which faction."
Lu Yang had heard that the Demon Race had sent many spies to infiltrate the Central Continent, intending to cause internal chaos.
"Also, you know how they should be dealt with after completing this task, right?"
At this point, the County Magistrate exhibited a look of reluctance, as if he was torn between his conscience and the need to act.
The two Golden Core Stage cultivators were momentarily stunned, then a murderous intent shone in their eyes.
"You mean... these few days should be considered overtime for them, and they should be compensated with three times their usual pay?"
"Yes."
The County Magistrate turned back and was taken aback at the expressions of the two Golden Core Stage cultivators.
"Why are you giving me looks like that?"
The two Golden Core Stage cultivators responded in a somewhat resentful tone, "Master, you've never mentioned giving us overtime pay when we work night shifts, just like tonight."
Even if Golden Core Stage cultivators don't need sleep, you can't make us work through the day and night!
Our wives are still waiting in bed!
Why do others get paid extra for working overtime, while they get nothing?
"...I'll give you guys overtime pay."
"Master, what should we do about the Phoenix Blood Stone?"
"Hmph, since we can't do it secretly, we'll do it openly. Tomorrow, pretend to be businessmen. Say that the Phoenix Blood Stone is very rare and offer a high price to buy it!"
"How much?"
"One million Spirit Stones!" The County magistrate was adamant. He simply refused to believe that they wouldn't be tempted by a quick profit of five hundred thousand Spirit Stones!
The two Golden Core Stage cultivators looked hesitant.
"What is it, speak up."
"Master, that Seek Dao Sect disciple may not need this amount of Spirit Stones."
"Then, offer one million and five hundred thousand Spirit Stones!" The County magistrate was ruthless. He simply refused to believe that two million Spirit Stones wouldn't be enough for them to let go.
"It still might not be enough."
"Two million!"
"That's still not enough."
The County Magistrate fumed, "You tell me, just how much Spirit Stones do they need to let go! I refuse to believe that a Foundation Establishment Stage cultivator, no matter who they are, won't be swayed by two million Spirit Stones!"
"We heard that he's the eldest son of the Meng Family."
'Meng Family' and 'eldest son' combined together implied immeasurable power and wealth, which no one dared to provoke.
As the first influential family from the Central Continent, the Meng Family's fame reached far and wide.
Upon hearing this, the County Magistrate's anger intensified. He showed no fear of Meng Jingzhou's status, "So what if he's the eldest son of the Meng Family? If it comes to that, I'll go steal it myself tomorrow night!"

chapters.title: Chapter 226 - 235 Travel Together_1
chapters.content:
The County Magistrate was reluctant to make a big deal out of things. If a problem can be solved using spirit stones, he would try his best to solve it with spirit stones.
As the County Magistrate of Luofeng County, mining is his main source of income, and the amount of spirit stones he possesses can be described as vast.
He simply did not believe that a Foundation Establishment Stage cultivator from the Seek Dao Sect could rival his wealth.
Now he knew: He had overestimated himself. He was no match for the eldest son of the Meng Family in terms of wealth.
It would be more economical to steal by himself.
"Do you think 10 million spirit stones would tempt the eldest son of the Meng Family?"
The two Golden Core cultivators hesitated before shaking their heads. "No."
"Fine. For this transaction, I will offer 10 million spirit stones." The County Magistrate was trying to raise his bid.
On the roof, Lu Yang turned to Meng Jingzhou and asked, "Would you sell it for 10 million spirit stones?"
Meng Jingzhou rolled his eyes. "I'd sell it for 500,000 spirit stones. Why would I hold onto this Yang Invigorating thing?"
"To build up willpower?"
"Piss off."
...
Meanwhile, at the Mo Family...
"Head of the Mo Family, a report came from a merchant in the mining shop below. They said that a group of people came to the shop today with a particularly unique Phoenix Blood Stone, asking if there were similar Phoenix Blood Stones."
"From the description, it seems very similar to the Phoenix Blood Stone that we have been searching for."
"Oh? Really?" The Head of the Mo Family's eyes lit up. He didn't expect they would finally find this kind of Phoenix Blood Stone.
There's a saying that goes: "businesses don't fight with the authorities". Although the Mo Family was wealthy and powerful, they were still lacking when facing the County Magistrate.
If they could obtain this Phoenix Blood Stone, it would be as if they had a hold over the County Magistrate, no longer fearing him in the future.
"I plan to take action tonight and steal the Phoenix Blood Stone".
"Tonight? Tell me, who bought the Phoenix Blood Stone? What's their identity and cultivation level? What will you do if the person is at the Divinity Transformation Stage?"
The subordinate stuttered and could not answer, understanding it was a mistake to be overly eager to impress the family head.
The head of the Mo Family scoffed: "You cannot be careless with this matter. Tomorrow morning, find out who obtained the Phoenix Blood Stone. If there are no surprises, I will personally steal it tomorrow night!"
"You'll take action personally?" The subordinate was taken aback. Was this matter worthy of the family head's personal involvement?
"Of course. This is evidence that can be used to threaten the County Magistrate. It's worth taking action personally." The head of the Mo Family showed a hint of an excited smile.
The struggle with the County Magistrate was about to turn into an offensive.
...
"What exactly is different about this stone?" Once back at Li Haoran's home, Meng Jingzhou took out the Phoenix Blood Stone to study it closely and identified a problem.
"Could Senior Su see anything wrong?"
Su Yiren shook her head: "I don't know much about Phoenix Blood Stones. Perhaps only cultivators who specialize in refining could tell what's different about this Phoenix Blood Stone."
Everyone's eyes turned to Li Haoran.
Li Haoran twitched his mouth: "I think you guys are overestimating me. It would be more suitable for my master."
"Fairy Eternity, can you see anything?" Lu Yang asked Fairy Eternity for help.
Fairy Eternity frowned: "It smells like fresh blood, and I don't like it."
"Fresh blood? Is it very fresh?" Lu Yang had a bad feeling.
Could this Phoenix Blood Stone be a clue left by a dead person?
"Speaking of it, Fairy, is there really a phoenix that has died here in Luofeng County?"
Fairy Eternity nodded: "Yes, there is one, but it's not roosting around here as Li Haoran said. It's right under our feet."
Fairy Eternity pointed downward: "Under the entire Luofeng County, there is the body of a Unification Stage phoenix."
"What should we do?" asked Li Haoran, who did not expect that his return home to visit his parents would attract the attention of the County Magistrate, who is personally taking action.
Luofeng County is a large county, and its County Magistrate has a Divinity Transformation cultivation level.
"Should we just catch him?" Su Yiren, as the cultivator with the highest cultivation level in the group, was the first to speak. Her idea was simple: just capture the problematic person.
After some thinking, Lu Yang said, "We don't have any evidence to take action directly. When we are outside, we represent the Seek Dao Sect, so we can't abuse their policing powers. We'll wait for a rabbit to pass by. We'll wait for the County Magistrate to come and steal things tomorrow evening. First, we'll record it all in the Recording Orb. Then we'll ask Senior Su to take action.
With both thief and stolen goods, we'll catch them red-handed!"
"At that time, he'd have to admit it whether he wants to or not!"
"Very well." Su Yiren agreed.
Lu Yang reminded everyone: "Additionally, just the few of us should know about this matter. Junior Brother Li, you wouldn't want your parents to interfere with this matter, would you?""
Li Haoran nodded, a little bit of resignation in his tone, as if recalling something: "Based on what I know about the two of them, it would be best if they don't know about this."
"I'll also keep it a secret from Yanyan." Su Yiren said.
Li Haoran muttered: "Fortunately, Senior Su is here. Otherwise, I really wouldn't know what to do tomorrow night."
Meng Jingzhou laughed: "What's there to worry about? We have Lu Yang. He's a mid-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator who beat a Divinity Transformation cultivator. With him here, what's there to fear from the County Magistrate?"
Su Yiren had intended to correct Li Haoran's way of addressing her, but she was shocked by the information Meng Jingzhou revealed instead.
Mid-stage Foundation Establishment defeating Divinity Transformation stage - what kind of unprecedented genius was this?
Was imparting Golden Core experiences to him a waste of effort?
"Piss off!" Lu Yang glared at Meng Jingzhou, knowing he was retaliating for the mocking earlier.
Driven by curiosity, Su kept asking for the specifics of the battle. Understanding that the process of power-leaping was embarrassing, Lu Yang refused to tell Su Yiren, warning Meng Jingzhou and Li Haoran through his gaze that no one was allowed to tell!
When daylight came, everyone behaved as if nothing had happened the night before. They ate, drank, and played as usual.
Lu Yang took the time to inquire if any cultivators had disappeared or died recently, and the answer was none.
With the sun's light diminishing, and night falling, the darkness of night deepened.
A figure merged with the night, stealthily sneaking into Li Haoran's home.
The County Magistrate was fully prepared, wearing a nightwalker suit, mask, and clothes that could hide his aura and footsteps. His voice changed, the fluctuation of his spiritual essence changed, even his own wife wouldn't recognize him.
"Didn't I miss anything?" This was the County Magistrate's first time doing something like this, and he felt a bit nervous. But thinking about how his action was worth 10 million spirit stones, he was no longer nervous.
He opened his Spiritual Sense and found the Phoenix Blood Stone placed beside Meng Jingzhou's bed. Meng Jingzhou was sleeping soundly, completely unaware.
Meng Jingzhou was very upset as he had originally wanted to watch the drama unfold. However, it wouldn't make sense if he didn't sleep here, so he could only pretend to sleep while listening to Lu Yang's live commentary.
"Found it!"
The County Magistrate was about to dive deeper when he saw another figure vault over the wall. It was the Head of the Mo Family.
The Head of the Mo Family was dressed exactly like the County Magistrate, hiding himself well. No one could recognize him.
Both parties were astonished. They had not expected to encounter another person doing the same thing. Was this place such a hot spot?
No, I'm the County Magistrate/the Head, who is only temporarily acting as a thief.

chapters.title: Chapter 227 - 226 The Third Dark Shadow_1
chapters.content:
The head of the Mo family had already investigated the origin of the Phoenix Blood Stone buyer. It was a rather tricky situation, the buyer was a Foundation Establishment Stage disciple of the Seek Dao Sect. He estimated that this person was new to wealth. The buyer had come together with two others, who were also from the Seek Dao Sect.
The Foundation Establishment Stage meant nothing to him. However, the words - the Seek Dao Sect - altered the situation entirely.
The higher the cultivation level, the more secrets one came to know, and the more one would realize the terror of the Seek Dao Sect.
That's why he needed to handle this matter personally.
He didn't believe that a Divinity Transformation Stage cultivator intending to steal something could be discovered by three Foundation Establishment Stage disciples from the Seek Dao Sect?
However, he was not the only one planning to steal something tonight.
Petty thief, how dare you try to lay your hands on something I've set my sights on?
"Leave immediately!" Both the County Magistrate and the head of the Mo family simultaneously directed a targeted oppressive pressure at their competition. Any ordinary thief encountering the pressure of such a level would get so scared they would end up completely paralyzed on the spot.
The County Magistrate revealed a hint of a cold smirk. He guessed that perhaps, after yesterday failed attempt, the Mo Family did not give up and sent people again tonight.
What good would that do? If they encounter him, they can only blame their bad luck!
Their equally powerful oppressive forces silently collided with each other, causing both men to furrow their brows.
"Hmm?"
Both of them noticed that the other's oppressive force was extraordinary, far from ordinary!
"Old Shee!"
"Old Mo!"
They both recognized each other's identities, followed by a silence lasting more than ten seconds.
In the entirety of Luofeng County, there were only two people at the Spirit Transformation stage, them. They were easy to recognize.
Both of them considered themselves persons of status and disdained engaging in petty theft. Meeting here was quite embarrassing.
They couldn't possibly say they were out for some moon bathing.
"What a coincidence, you're here too?"
"Yes, quite the coincidence."
Then came another long and awkward silence.
The County Magistrate decided to seize the initiative, getting a head start. Using his Spiritual Sense for transmission, he uttered somberly, "I had calculated that petty thieves would attempt a theft tonight. I was waiting for them here as patiently as a cat for a rat. As expected, I didn't wait in vain. Old Mo, I suggest you surrender without any resistance!"
The County Magistrate produced an iron chain from somewhere and then threw it towards the Head of the Mo Family.
"Ha! You think I'm blind? Look at what you're wearing! You dare to say you're here hunting rodents?"
The head of the Mo family clearly wasn't buying it. This bastard was dressed all in black, just like himself. Who was he trying to fool?
He took out a weapon to fight.
Both of them were worried about being discovered. Unspoken agreement had them avoid using their magical powers, thus making the battle as silent as possible.
Both of them had struggled against each other for decades and were very familiar with each other's tactics. After a dozen rounds of fruitless confrontation, they both stopped.
"This will not lead to a result. You came here for the Phoenix Blood Stone, right? Let's rely on our own abilities to steal it. Whoever gets it owns it." The County Magistrate suggested.
"Good, that's settled then." The head of the Mo family agreed readily.
The County Magistrate sneered inwardly. Even if the other party obtained the Phoenix Blood Stone, he would find a way to snatch it back. It was a matter of his future prospects. Who would care about keeping promises?
Funnily enough, the head of the Mo family was thinking the same thing.
Meanwhile, Lu Yang was recording everything using a Recording Orb.
Both had already used their Spiritual Senses to locate the Phoenix Blood Stone, and while they were preparing to head to Meng Jingzhou's room together, another shadow entered over the wall.
"Another one?" Not only were the County Magistrate and the head of the Mo family puzzled, but even Lu Yang, Su Yiren, and Li Haoran, who were observing from the dark, were surprised.
"Does your house have a lot of attraction?" Lu Yang looked at Li Haoran.
Li Haoran rolled his eyes, not wanting to talk. It's not my house that's attractive, it's clearly the Phoenix Blood Stone that Senior Brother Meng bought.
Lu Yang remembered the shadows he saw out of the corner of his eye last night while tailing two Golden Core Stage cultivators.
Could it be that the shadow from last night is the same as the third shadow tonight?
"The third shadow is also at the Divinity Transformation Stage." Su Yiren reminded Lu Yang, making him more alert.
Who was the third shadow? What was his purpose?
"What, tonight there isn't just the County Magistrate but also the head of the Mo family and a third Spirit Transformation Stage cultivator?" Meng Jingzhou couldn't see the situation from his place and was itching with curiosity as he listened to their conversation.
It seemed like he wanted to see what was happening outside.
...
The third shadow wasn't surprised to see the County Magistrate and the head of the Mo family. He nodded, "Good attitude, you're fifteen minutes earlier than our agreed-upon time. Let's go."
The County Magistrate and the head of the Mo family glanced at each other. They couldn't see through the cultivation level of the shadow.
A Divinity Transformation Stage? But where did the third Divinity Transformation Stage come from in Luofeng County?
It seemed that they had been mistaken for someone else by the person. They decided to go along with it, so they followed the third shadow's steps.
"Sir, I've heard that this house is inhabited by a disciple of the Seek Dao Sect. Is our action safe?" The County Magistrate asked as he followed behind.
The third shadow didn't think much about it, "Just a Foundation Establishment Stage disciple. What could possibly go wrong? Everything is ready now; we're just short of a top-quality Phoenix Blood Stone."
"The best-quality Phoenix Blood Stone is in the hands of the Foundation Establishment disciple of Seek Dao Sect."
"Once we succeed, all of us will be promoted. An endeavor that is about to succeed, how could you be so diffident and indecisive at this moment? Hurry up and follow!"
Turns out, the third shadow's objective was also the Phoenix Blood Stone that Meng Jingzhou had bought.
"What on earth is this Phoenix Blood Stone you bought? It's like a magnet for those at the Spirit Transformation Stage." Lu Yang sighed. He told you not to show off, but now everyone knows you have a top-quality Phoenix Blood Stone.
"Who knows... Had I known it would cause so much trouble, I would have thrown it in the trash." Meng Jingzhou also complained.
The three Spirit Transformation Stage intruders converged in Meng Jingzhou's guest room.
"Phoenix Blood Stone!" The eyes of the County Magistrate lit up when he saw the Phoenix Blood Stone next to Meng Jingzhou. It was indeed like his speculation - it was the Phoenix Blood Stone that should absolutely not end up in the market.
The Head of the Mo family noticed the County Magistrate's reaction and knew that he had not guessed wrong.
The third shadow's eyes gleam. Although he had never seen a top-quality Phoenix Blood Stone, the quality of this stone was definitely not inferior, it should suffice for their purposes.
"By the way, sir, what do we need this Phoenix Blood Stone for?" The County Magistrate asked casually.
Perhaps because the target was right in front of his eyes, the third shadow inadvertently loosened up, replying carelessly: "Of course, it's for refining that Phoenix beneath our feet into a Corpse Puppet, and stirring up the whole of Luofeng County, reinforcing the might of our Nine Nether Sect.
Now that all preparations are complete, we are just short of a top-quality Phoenix Blood Stone as the core."
"You're from the Nine Nether Sect?!" The head of Mo family exclaimed.
"Isn't that obvious? If we're not from the Nine Nether Sect, we could only be from the Eternity Sect... wait a minute, who are you two?" The third shadow realized that these two were not his subordinates.
All three intruders, exposed in the house, faced each other like enemies, each ready to fight at a moment's notice.
"Since you've been discovered, I cannot leave you alive!" The third shadow attacked decisively, revealing his Divinity Transformation Stage peak cultivation level. He wanted to take this opportunity to kill the other two.
Both, the County Magistrate and the head of the Mo Family, were not easy to deal with. As Spirit Transformation Stage cultivators themselves, they thought, you want to kill us instantly? We'll see who kills who!
At the same time, the space solidified, and none of the three was able to move, as if time had stopped.
Modify rules, it was the Unification Stage ability.
Su Yiren took action.

chapters.title: Chapter 228 - 227: Su Yiren Takes Action (Thanks to Book Friend Xi Tang for the Reward)"_1
chapters.content:
"Is there someone else?!" The County Magistrate, the Head of the Mo Family, and the followers of the Nine Nether Sect were all startled. They prided themselves on controlling everything from the shadows, as if they were the ones manipulating the chess pieces. How had they now become the ones being controlled?
Who was in the shadows?
They tried various means.
The County Magistrate attempted to mobilize the chains hidden on his back, but no matter how hard he struggled, the chains were as if nailed into the space behind him, not moving at all.
The Head of the Mo Family's arms were tattooed with eighteen types of weapons. These were actually eighteen types of weapons he had personally crafted. In the past, these weapons were invincible, but now, they all fell silent, not a single one could be mobilized.
The follower of the Nine Nether Sect tried to call out the ghostly shadows hiding in his body, but the ghostly shadows were as if they encountered a terrifying thing, hiding in his body, shivering.
The three of them realized that the person who took action was no ordinary person. This kind of ability to disregard reality and casually change local rules... was it the Unification Stage?!
Do all disciples of the Seek Dao Sect who go out have such luxury, with even a Unification Stage Great Power accompanying them?
The County Magistrate and the Head of the Mo Family regretted in their hearts. All they did was steal a Phoenix Blood Stone, why did it cause so many problems, involving both the Nine Nether Sect and the Unification Stage?
Seeing Su Yiren finally take action, Meng Jingzhou was frightened and quickly stood up, running away, seeking Su Yiren for protection.
He was the only one in the room who could still move.
Lu Yang whispered to Li Haoran, "If she forces you, you seem to have no ability to resist, you should just accept her."
"In that case, she could only have my body, not my heart!" Li Haoran replied earnestly, but he was also nervous in his heart.
Su Yiren was gentle and generous, like a caring older sister. It didn't seem so bad to yield to her.
Su Yiren pushed open the door, looking at the three men she had frozen in place. Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, and Li Haoran followed behind Su Yiren, feeling extremely secure.
"I didn't expect this County Magistrate Shi, not only are you colluding with the Phoenix Tribe, but also with the Nine Nether Sect, your sins are great and evil, I've recorded all these on a Recording Orb!" Lu Yang started with a false accusation.
"Hey, hey, hey, you can't just say things like this." The County Magistrate's face changed.
"Ah right, he is indeed colluding with the Phoenix Tribe and the Nine Nether Sect, I can testify." The Head of the Mo Family didn't hesitate to kick a man while he's down the moment he saw an opportunity.
"Let me introduce myself, I'm Lu Yang, a disciple of the Seek Dao Sect."
"Meng Jingzhou, disciple of the Seek Dao Sect."
"Li Haoran, disciple of the Seek Dao Sect."
Su Yiren didn't say anything. She's easy to talk to in front of Li Haoran, but not in front of strangers.
"I originally intended to see what secrets this Phoenix Blood Stone has, but I didn't expect to hook a big fish."
Lu Yang removed the face mask of the Nine Nether Sect follower. The man looked mundane.
"You just mentioned, you want to refine the phoenix into a Corpse Puppet. Crap about it and I might spare your life." This was no small matter, with the corpse of a Unification Stage Phoenix right under their feet. The catastrophe would be unimaginable if the Corpse Puppet phoenix even flipped its body, let alone reviving it, to Luofeng County.
The County Magistrate's face was also very ugly. If the Nine Nether Sect succeeded, his position would be threatened.
The follower of the Nine Nether Sect laughed loudly, "Discovered by you, and still able to spare my life?"
"Senior Su, search his soul." As the Nine Nether Sect follower had no intention of speaking, Lu Yang directly requested Su Yiren to make a move.
Su Yiren stepped forward, pressing her hand on the follower of the Nine Nether Sect's forehead, her eyebrows furrowed, "He is not human, he's a corpse!"
Only to see the eyes of the Nine Nether Sect follower lose their glow, his body decayed rapidly, leaving only a pile of white bones.
This was a common tactic utilized by the Nine Nether Sect, animating a corpse to act as a puppet, while the real body controlled it from the shadows. Once discovered, the connection with the corpse would be severed and the corpse would decay rapidly. There would be no clues left; very hard to capture. However, not many people present knew much about the Nine Nether Sect.
"Trying to escape?"
Su Yiren took action again, using her Unification Stage ability to envelop the entire Luofeng County in a barrier, not allowing insects to enter nor birds to leave. She was determined to find the person from the Nine Nether Sect.
There was a range limit to controlling a corpse. It would be impossible for the Nine Nether Sect person to flee outside of Luofeng County.
If she let a person two realms lower than her to escape, it would be too humiliating.
It wouldn't matter if she lost face, but losing face in front of Li Haoran was unacceptable!
She extended her Spiritual Sense, scanning every inch of Luofeng County.
Normally, an independent Unification cultivator scanning a city with their Spiritual Sense would be considered a provocation towards the Great Xia Dynasty. However, under the circumstances, no one would blame Su Yiren for doing so.
"Found them!"
Quite quickly, Su Yiren located a few suspicious cultivators with her Spiritual Sense. Unbeknownst to them, they carried a type of prohibition on their bodies that killed them the moment they were detected by Su Yiren.
"This is brutal, isn't it?"
The County Magistrate's face turned ashen, he said, "I've heard that the Nine Nether Sect believes in reincarnation, and death is not to be feared for them. Hence, many of their followers are desperados, making them very dangerous."
Su Yiren's Spiritual Sense detected Array Methods hidden in the wells of several influential households. The arrays were intricately linked, forming a large, comprehensive net which was most likely designed to refine the Phoenix.
"Something's not right. The dead believers of the Nine Nether Sect weren't at the Divinity Transformation Stage. The real mastermind is yet to be found!" Su Yiren quickly realized that the dead weren't the real string-pullers.
"It's under us, in the Phoenix's corpse!" Lu Yang was the first to come up with this. The old Phoenix was at the Unification stage while it was alive; the body of a Unification cultivator could block the Spiritual Sense of someone at the same stage.
Su Yiren also thought of this, but she didn't act.
"Senior Su, what's wrong?" Lu Yang was puzzled. Is digging not a simple task for a Unification stage cultivator? She doesn't even have a small digging magic skill?
"Yeah, Senior Su, please hurry down. If the Nine Nether Sect manages to refine the Phoenix, Luofeng County will be in grave danger," Li Haoran also urged.
Su Yiren thought for a moment and said, "My methods... might not be what you think."
She took a deep breath, calming herself. At this point, she couldn't pretend to be a delicate lady anymore.
She clenched her fist, and smashed the ground, creating a man-wide hole. Then, she jumped into it, burrowing underground.
Lu Yang and the other two were left wide-eyed and swallowing hard; Senior Su's ways seemed... quite different from her frail appearance.
They suddenly remembered a previously overlooked question.
"What aspect of cultivation is she proficient in?"
Meng Jingzhou, looking at the large hole, seemed more familiar with this method. Isn't this similar to what his master uses?
The three exchanged glances, a ridiculous notion crossing their minds. "Could Su Yiren... be a Body Cultivator?"
Underneath, a Phoenix with bright red feathers lay in silence as if just recently dead. All at once, the array laid by the leftover priests of Nine Nether Sect activated. Green lights, akin to jade, began to glow in the Phoenix's eyes, surrounded by the incandescent True Flame, turning the entire underground into a hollow cavity.
"Since you all have found me, we might as well fight till our last breath!" the voice of a follower from the Nine Nether Sect came from the Phoenix, sounding hoarse and mad.
The words were easier said than done, inside he was filled with regret.
The plan to secretly place the Array Method, steal a Phoenix Blood Stone, resurrect the Phoenix, overturn Luofeng County, was perfect. It was simple and easy, without any flaws, and no one would've discovered it.
Who would've known a Phoenix Blood Stone was closely guarded by a Unification stage cultivator.
Is this Phoenix Blood Stone really that valuable?
"Though I couldn't fully resurrect the Phoenix due to this sudden event, it's still more than enough to overturn Luofeng County!" The follower of the Nine Nether Sect had no time to care about all that anymore.
"I know you're at the Unification stage, but what of it? Are you an Array Cultivator or a Talisman Cultivator? It doesn't matter now. Before you can completely stop the Phoenix, I would've destroyed Luofeng County several times over!"
The Phoenix, wrapped in the True Flame, screamed in the hollow cavity below ground, its wings unfurled, carrying an incredible amount of destructive power, as if reborn from the flame.
Just as the follower of the Nine Nether Sect was about to control the Phoenix and soar into the sky, he found that no matter what, the Phoenix couldn't fly.
"What's going on?"
He used his Spiritual Sense to survey the surroundings, only to find that Su Yiren was holding onto the Phoenix's beak, and no matter how much the Phoenix flapped its wings, it couldn't lift off the ground.
"Flight?" A faint smirk appeared on Su Yiren's delicate face. Holding the Phoenix's beak in one hand, she slammed it down, harshly slamming it to the ground.
When the Head of the Mo Family and the County Magistrate lead Lu Yang and the two others down through the opened pit, they witnessed Su Yiren throwing down the Phoenix—a sight full of surreal beauty and violence.
Unable to help himself, Li Haoran swallowed hard. If he were to marry her, would he even live?

chapters.title: Chapter 229 - 228 Phoenix True Flame_1
chapters.content:
At first, Li Haoran was resistant to Su Yiren. As a strong man himself, how could he depend on her for sustenance? He wanted to be independent like Senior Brother Lu.
Later, he found Su Yiren to be beautiful, kind, gentle, and nurturing, inspiring a desire to be pampered by her.
Now, he saw Su Yiren's every move filled with power, even the Phoenix was beaten to the point it could hardly rise again. He realized his physical stature was far from matching that of the Phoenix. For safety reasons, he decided to keep a distance from her.
This was what they call, sticking to your principles.
Li Haoran's legs trembled, extinguishing the budding idea of relying on her.
He had the will but lacked the physical strength.
A broken arm from a street fight was one thing, but if their relationship advanced, he shuddered to imagine the destruction his body would face.
It seemed that Lu Yang understood Li Haoran's mental state, and he patted his shoulder, "Everything has its pros and cons."
Not just Li Haoran, even the County Magistrate and the Head of the Mo Family felt a shudder in their hearts when they saw Su Yiren's terrifying fighting methods.
This elder, who looked fragile and vulnerable, had transformed into an entirely different person once the fight started.
They had come underground to see if any help was needed. But now, they were wondering if they stepped in to help; Su Yiren might throw a punch their way too.
"Is this elder from Seek Dao Sect a Body Cultivator?"
They both thought that Su Yiren was some Elder from Seek Dao Sect.
"Senior Su is not our Elder from Seek Dao Sect; she is his fiancee," Meng Jingzhou introduced Li Haoran, the outstanding youth of Luofeng County, with great solemnity.
The County Magistrate and the Head of the Mo Family showed respect.
While the group above was engaged in lively chatter, the situation for the followers of the Nine Nether Sect below was not good.
The plot to use the Phoenix's body, destroy Luofeng County, and ignite conflict between the human race and Phoenix tribe had been in the making for several years. After consulting historical records, exploring ancient ruins, and consulting with his seniors, he finally found a way to use the body of a Phoenix.
The Phoenix tribe had a good relationship with the human race. If he could use the situation to create a conflict and turn it into a war, countless casualties would feed into the cycle of Reincarnation.
Just one step away!
He was just one step away!
How did a Unification stage cultivator just appear out of nowhere?
"Even if you are in the Unification stage, it won't work!" The Nine Nether Sect's follower yelled, completely losing his mind.
Controlling such a grand corpse was a test of his cultivation level and spiritual power.
Normally, there would be other followers of the Nine Nether Sect to help share the pressure of controlling the corpse, but they had already been killed by Su Yiren.
The Old Phoenix erupted into raging flames, causing even the space to show signs of distortion. On the outskirts, the likes of Lu Yang could feel the heat waves coming in waves.
The County Magistrate had no choice but to produce a string of golden bells from his Storage Ring to protect everyone.
As Su Yiren stepped on the Phoenix's back, it plunged downwards, but the flames showed no signs of weakening.
The True Flame of the Phoenix could melt everything, including the earth. This underground cavity had been burned out by its flame. If allowed to spread, the entire Luofeng County would be engulfed in a sea of flames!
The Phoenix's True Flame, the Golden Dragon's True Flame—these were famed flames on par with the Samadhi True Fire.
"The Phoenix's True Flame is still as tough to handle as ever when it's unleashed," Fairy Eternity commented from the Spiritual Space as she watched the battle. It reminded her of the geniuses from the Phoenix Tribe she had once mentored.
The dragon and phoenix geniuses naturally had access to their tribe's unique skills. Their mastery of the flames was unparalleled and suited to cooking.
"Is there any way to restrain it?" Lu Yan anxiously asked. If there wasn't, he would have had no choice but to summon his Eldest Senior Sister.
"A Phoenix has a unique acupuncture point in the middle of its neck. It is the source of the Phoenix True Flame. If that point is struck, it can't spit out flames anymore." Fairy Eternity didn't miss a beat at this critical moment and provided a solution.
Upon hearing this, Lu Yang quickly relayed the message to Su Yiren. She turned around in surprise to look at Lu Yang, but didn't think much about it. She assumed that the disciples of Seek Dao Sect had a broad knowledge base and might have learned this in a class.
After all, his master was the Sect Leader of Seek Dao Sect.
Su Yiren aimed at the spot pointed out by Lu Yang and charged over. The Phoenix True Flame surged towards her as if it had gone mad. She clenched her right hand into a fist at her waist, suddenly exerting force, and struck a punch. It completely distorted the space in front of her, stopping the Phoenix True Flame from approaching her.
"Die!"
Su Yiren threw another punch, creating a sound just like muffled thunder, striking the neck of the Old Phoenix. The Phoenix True Flame seemed to lose its source and gradually faded away.
"What's going on?!" The followers of the Nine Nether Sect were horrified. The Phoenix True Flame was known to melt anything it met and was indestructible. How could it just disappear?
The secret of the Phoenix Tribe that Fairy Eternity told Lu Yang was known by very few within the tribe, let alone the followers of the Nine Nether Sect.
With the Phoenix True Flame gone, the Old Phoenix was no longer a threat. The followers of the Nine Nether Sect tried to break free with a desperate momentum, but they were immobilized by Su Yiren's strikes.
Su Yiren was also furious. After pretending to be a gentle and quiet lady for several days to leave a good impression on Li Haoran, her efforts were ruined.
Damn the Nine Nether Sect!
Die! Die! Die!
Watching Su Yiren's earth-shaking fists, one punch after another, Li Haoran's eyes couldn't help twitching.
If those punches were directed at him, he figured even his soul wouldn't be spared.
In the end, Su Yiren struck a punch that was both rigid and fierce. The sound traversed the ground, audible throughout Luofeng County, which indicated the end of this battle.
She tore open a crack in the dead Phoenix's body, pulled out the follower of the Nine Nether Sect, and directly searched his mind, then frowned.
In the recent battle, This follower had used spiritual sense far beyond his capacity, which caused his mind to be in a mess.
In other words, this follower had gone mad.
"What bad luck." Su Yiren snapped the follower's neck, sending him straight to the Nine Nether.
The underground cavity left by the battle was a bit difficult to deal with, Su Yiren temporarily used the power of laws to stabilize the upper space. As for the rest, she would leave it to the Great Xia dynasty to handle.
After all, she wasn't good at such things.
"Thank you for your help, Senior. Without you, Luofeng County would probably have been unable to escape this disaster." The County Magistrate expressed his gratitude earnestly.
"Don't rush to thank me. Let us first discuss this Phoenix Blood Stone. What is the story behind it?"
"Senior, this Phoenix Blood Stone really isn't anything special. I just thought it was interesting..." It was clear that the County Magistrate didn't want to tell them the truth.
Lu Yang took out a Recording Orb: "This has evidence of the County Magistrate breaking into someone's home and stealing their property. It also shows that he conspired with the Nine Nether Sect."
"Wait a minute, breaking and entering and theft I can accept, but when did I ever conspire with the Nine Nether Sect?"
Lu Yang played the Recording Orb. In it, followers of the Nine Nether Sect were shown climbing over a wall and the County Magistrate and the Head of the Mo Family following behind them. They all headed towards Meng Jingzhou's guest room.
The image stopped there.
"Where are the parts that show us uncovering the motives of the Nine Nether Sect and preparing for the battle?" The County Magistrate and the Head of the Mo Family grew anxious.
With an expressionless face, Lu Yang replied, "The Recording Orb is broken. It doesn't show anything beyond that."
"If the County Magistrate is willing to explain the reasons, maybe I will find a way to fix the Recording Orb."
"Those rumors about the disciples of the Seek Dao Sect are well deserved!" The County Magistrate gritted his teeth as he spoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 230 - 229: The Origin of the Phoenix Blood Stone_1
chapters.content:
The County Magistrate watched Lu Yang grit his teeth in frustration but was helpless to act.
He was truly reluctant to divulge this matter, but his current circumstances forced his hand.
The Head of the Mo Family put on a smug expression, taking pleasure in others' misfortune.
The County Magistrate sighed deeply, "Please, everyone, come with me."
Everyone followed the County Magistrate to the ground level, heading directly for the mine.
"The mine collapse was false news for the public. The actual situation within is something else."
The County Magistrate, familiar with the area, guided everyone into the narrower parts of the mine, pressed a hidden mechanism in the wall, and with a rumbling sound, a stone door opened, leading into the heart of the mine.
This was an internal passage known to only a few, secretly rigged with an Array Method that evades detection by one's Spiritual Sense. If one were to scan the area with their Spiritual Sense, they would have been tricked by this scene.
The Head of the Mo Family became serious because this was exactly as his intelligence had revealed - a secret passage was indeed present.
The deeper they ventured into the passage, the stronger the pungent smell of blood became, as if a massacre had occurred ahead, with corpses piled high and blood draining away.
When Lu Yang emerged from the cave to an open area, the nauseating stench of blood was overwhelming.
Fortunately, Lu Yang quickly adjusted to the smell and took in the scene before him.
In the center of the open area was a large pit filled with blood-red water. Countless stones rose from the bloody pond, their vibrant hues identical to the quality of the Phoenix Blood Stone Meng Jingzhou had purchased.
A few individuals hovered around the edge of the pit, pouring blood into the bloody pond from time to time.
"What...what is this...?"
The County Magistrate explained reluctantly, "This is the ongoing production process of the Phoenix Blood Stones."
"The Phoenix Blood Stones are fake?" Meng Jingzhou was shocked. Had he spent half a million on a sham?
Li Haoran shook his head, "No, the blood in the pit is real phoenix blood. I have seen my master use it during Refining, though the quality my master used is higher than what's present here."
"Sir County Magistrate, who are these people?" a red-eyed young man walked forward, his neck adorned with red feathers.
He frowned at the County Magistrate, clearly dissatisfied with the fact that outsiders had been brought in.
The County Magistrate sighed, "I had no choice. If I hadn't brought them here, I would bear the brunt of the consequences."
The red-eyed young man was about to lose his temper. Bringing outsiders meant exposure, and how was he supposed to explain this back home to the Clan Leader?
"These individuals are from the Seek Dao Sect. This individual here is my grandson, the Head of the Mo family."
"Get lost!"
"Seek Dao Sect?" The red-eyed youth looked at Lu Yang and others in surprise, his expressions rapidly changing, as if recalling something unpleasant, his arrogant demeanor diminished significantly.
"What's your relation to Yun Zhi?"
"She's my Eldest Senior Sister."
"And Gan Tian?"
"She's my Third Senior Sister," Lu Yang replied.
His unseen Third Senior Sister was named Gan Tian, and she was currently probing into the Demon Territory.
"So it turns out that fellow Daoists from the Seek Dao Sect are here for an inspection. Please, allow me to guide the way." The red-eyed young man had a complete change of attitude, putting on a friendly and cordial demeanor.
The County Magistrate twitched at the sight. He had never seen the red-eyed youth behave so courteously before, "Allow me to introduce, this is Jiang Shan, a member of the Phoenix Tribe."
"Elder Jiang Shan, do you know my Eldest Senior Sister and Third Senior Sister..."
"Ah, no need for formalities. Just call me Xiao Jiang from now on." For some reason, Jiang Shan seemed exceptionally affable towards Lu Yang.
"As for Elder Yun Zhi and Elder Gan Tian, they have been very kind to our Phoenix Tribe. They even visited us and exchanged Cultivation experiences. I've also been fortunate to receive guidance from them."
"Of course, if it's possible, and I stress, IF, could you kindly ask your Eldest Senior Sister and Third Senior Sister to refrain from visiting our Phoenix Tribe? The Long Clan's territory is extensive so they could go there instead."
Lu Yang, "..."
Eldest Senior Sister, Third Senior Sister, what exactly did you two do in the Phoenix Tribe?
Su Yiren was also very curious. This seemed quite different from the alleged snobbish Phoenix Tribe.
"I came here specifically to find out the truth about the Phoenix Blood Stone."
The County Magistrate explained, "This matter actually began four thousand years ago. A phoenix elder breathed its last here, and its blood seeped into the mine, causing the first batch of Phoenix Blood Stone to emerge. Our ancestors stumbled upon it accidentally, and overjoyed, established a camp here, which was the beginning of Luofeng County."
"Around seven hundred years later, mining for Phoenix Blood Stones became increasingly difficult and less bountiful. The then County Magistrate realized that once the Phoenix Blood Stones were depleted, the economic pillar of Luofeng County would crumble, and the entire county would collapse."
"So, he secretly approached the Phoenix Tribe and attempted to purchase some phoenix blood to manufacture a new batch of Phoenix Blood Stones."
"Initially, the Phoenix Tribe refused as they were a proud, pure tribe that did not want to sell their blood."
"Once the County Magistrate showed a record of the income from selling Phoenix Blood Stones over the years and promised to share thirty percent of the profit with them, the Phoenix Tribe's attitude changed drastically."
Everyone turned their gaze to the only representative of the Phoenix Tribe present, Jiang Shan.
Jiang Shan responded righteously, "With so many members in our Phoenix Tribe, how can we not need Spirit Stones for our necessities? If we can earn some extra to supplement our family expenses through our talents, what's wrong with that?"
Lu Yang found that discussing blood selling in such an elegant manner was a first for him.
Lu Yang recalled Li Haoran's words, "The Phoenix Tribe is the most proud among the Demon Race, their blood is invaluable, and for humans to obtain it is akin to a Herculean task."
Yes, a Herculean task indeed.
The County Magistrate sneered at Jiang Shan, "If you guys from the Phoenix Tribe don't feel guilty, then why do you insist on aging the Phoenix Blood Stones? Why is it necessary to make sure no one realizes they're fresh produces?"
Jiang Shan dodged his gaze and didn't dare look the County Magistrate in the eye.
"While the Phoenix Tribe agreed to sell phoenix blood, they insisted that it be kept secret and not let others see it. Hence, the then County Magistrate developed a method to make newly-created Phoenix Blood Stones look ancient."
"Like so."
The County Magistrate randomly picked up a stone from the blood pond and channeled a magic skill. The vibrant Phoenix Blood Stone in his hand became dull and lifeless, appearing as though it had weathered hundreds, if not thousands of years.
"Every few years, Luofeng County would receive a batch of blood from the Phoenix Tribe, soak the stones in it, and make Phoenix Blood Stones."
"This has continued for more than three thousand years, and it's the secret passed from one County Magistrate to the next."
"Later, an accident occurred, and a Phoenix Blood Stone, not yet artificially aged, ended up on the market. After several transactions, it was eventually purchased by Meng Jingzhou, the young master of the Meng Family."
"If an experienced Refiner saw that stone, they would have guessed that all of Luofeng County's Phoenix Blood Stones were freshly made, thereby uncovering the arrangement between Luofeng County and the Phoenix Tribe."
"If this matter were to leak, it wouldn't be good for the reputations of both Luofeng County and the Phoenix Tribe. That's why I've been wanting to recover this Phoenix Blood Stone. As for Mo, his intention was the same as mine."
"However, with things as they are, you've all figured out the truth, so recovering it no longer holds meaning."

chapters.title: Chapter 231 - 230: The Legend of the Phoenix Reborn_1
chapters.content:
If they say that the Phoenix Blood Stone is a counterfeit, that wouldn't be the case, considering the crime scene is right here, with bona fide stones soaking in phoenix blood.
Revealing this fact wouldn't cause any major issue; the only downside would be that it could tarnish the Phoenix Tribe's proud image and have a negative impact on public perception.
Everyone here is well aware of Seek Dao Sect's practices. Although their conduct isn't exactly upright, they are not ones to blabber about something they are aware of.
Therefore, the truth about the Phoenix Blood Stone would, at most, only circulate within the Seek Dao Sect.
All eyes turned back to Jiang Shan, who had no objections to Seek Dao Sect becoming privy to the matter.
"The reputation of Seek Dao Sect is well-known to all. They suppress demons and perform righteous acts, always keeping their promises. I believe none here will divulge this matter."
After all, it wasn't the first time that the Phoenix Tribe had lost face within the Seek Dao Sect. Compared to that time, selling their blood was hardly something to be ashamed of.
Lu Yang and the other two nodded in agreement, considering the incident wasn't exactly a major issue.
Li Haoran, intrigued, pointed to the officer who was crafting Phoenix Blood Stones in the distance and asked, "How does the County Magistrate ensure their secrecy? Does he bribe them with wages?"
There were several officers working here, over ten in total. If any one of them leaked the secret, the truth about the Phoenix Blood Stone would be out.
Who knows if someone with loose lips might inadvertently blab about it?
The County Magistrate shook his head: "They certainly will not expose the secret."
"Why is that?"
"You should be aware that wearing Phoenix Blood Stones over a long time strengthens one's vitality. Ultimately, the merit lies in the phoenix blood."
"If simply wearing the Phoenix Blood Stone can have such an effect, can you guess what the effect would be for those who work in an environment filled with blood fog?"
"If anyone dares to leak the secret, next time we won't let any of them work here."
"Very well."
"By the way, I heard that phoenixes can be reborn from the ashes. Is this true?" Lu Yang inquired, recalling the old phoenix they had encountered not long ago, bathing in True Fire, seeming almost like it was going to resurrect, which incidentally reminded him of the ancient legend.
Jiang Shan nodded solemnly, his expression filled with reverence: "Yes, but this incident is almost considered a legend even within the Phoenix Tribe."
"It is said that during the ancient times, there was an elder in the Phoenix Tribe who had cultivated to a realm that brought him at the threshold of becoming an Immortal. Every gesture and act of his held supreme authority, able to shift the heavens and earth with a single thought.
Even in the long history of the Phoenix Tribe, he was the most powerful, hardly any enemy found in the Demon Race's records could match him."
"This elder had a tremendous battle with the Dragon Tribe's elder. The battle was so fierce that the stars in the sky turned to dust, and the sun was extinguished, leaving the universe in utter silence."
"No one knows the outcome of that battle. One of our phoenix elders, a Great Power who was in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, watched from a distance and saw part of the battle."
"He saw our tribe's elder lying silently in the cosmos, devoid of life's breath, his soul in deep slumber, he was completely dead."
"It was as if her body was a small boat bobbing up and down with the waves. Yet the Dragon Tribe's elder didn't appear to consider the battle concluded. Instead, she stood guard nearby."
"Suddenly, Immortal Fire blazed from our elder's body. She basked in the Immortal Fire, spreading her wings, and let out a roar that resounded through the universe. The Immortal Fire shone brilliantly, even brighter than the sun, and she let out a series of phoenix cries that echoed throughout the universe."
"Not just our Phoenix Tribe, many others in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage were watching this extraordinary battle from a distance. If you ever get the chance to browse the records of other Demon Races, you would find related accounts."
"From then on, the saying that 'A Phoenix can be reborn from the ashes' began, but that was something only our elder could do. People in the tribe speculated that perhaps only by cultivating to the elder's realm could one defy death and resurrect. Hence, as far as the ordinary Phoenix Tribe members are concerned, the saying is almost indistinguishable from a legend."
Jiang Shan's humility aside, he was a pure-blooded phoenix, a rare entity even among the Phoenix Tribe, with noble lineage and high status. Without such standing, he would not have earned the guidance of Third Senior Sister Gan Tian, nor would he have been entrusted with supervising the creation of Phoenix Blood Stones in Luofeng County.
"So it's true that a phoenix can be reborn from the ashes, I thought it was just baseless myth," Su Yiren shared, enlightened. She usually kept herself away from social interactions, let alone conversations with members of the Phoenix Tribe.
The others nodded in agreement, expressing how eye-opening the revelation was: "That venerable Phoenix Tribe elder must have reached the realm of creation mastery, far beyond the capabilities of your average Transcendence Tribulation Stage individual."
"May I ask where this Phoenix Tribe elder is currently?" Lu Yang was more concerned about this question. There was a possibility that he could determine the whereabouts of Qilin Immortal through the Phoenix Tribe elder.
Jiang Shan shook his head: "The Elder has been missing for a long time. Even the eldest members of our tribe don't know her whereabouts."
"Fairy, do you know about the phoenix rebirth from its ashes?" Lu Yang suddenly remembered that he had the Fairy Eternity as his trump card inside his Spiritual Space.
Fairy Eternity was sleeping; Lu Yang woke her up.
Fairy Eternity rubbed her eyes, yawning continuously, barely able to keep her eyes open, muttered confusedly: "What were you asking about?"
"Fairy, do you know about phoenixes being reborn from ashes?" Lu Yang asked again.
Fairy Eternity had just woken up and her memory was somewhat muddled. She tilted her head, pondered for a long while before finally saying, "Yes, there is such a thing."
As expected of the foremost among the Five Immortals of the Ancients, her experience was vast.
The old saying goes, 'In each family, an elder is a treasure', it held true in this moment.
Fairy Eternity yawned again before speaking: "I remember when the Dragon Tribe and Phoenix Tribe geniuses had a fight over a man, and I happened to be watching. Oh dear, they were really going at it, setting papers on fire, pulling each other's hair, drawing circles, and using curses, they had many tricks up their sleeves."
"Wait, what do you mean by setting paper on fire, pulling hair, drawing circles and cursing?" Lu Yang thought these actions didn't seem like two Transcendence Tribulation Stage Great Powers fighting.
"Oh, they were attacking each other with true flames of their respective races, burning Semi-Immortal Talismans, using the other's hair as a medium, setting up Array Methods to curse each other." Fairy Eternity lightly explained.
"...Please continue."
"In any case, they both fought quite fiercely. As the fight escalated, so did the fierceness of their attacks. I thought the Dragon Tribe genius had the upper hand."
"They had fought several times before, with the Dragon Tribe genius winning 60% of the time. So her victory in this round was expected."
"Just when I thought it was about to have a clear outcome, the Phoenix Tribe genius demonstrated the unique art she had learned from me - the Playing Dead Technique. She laid on the ground pretending to be dead, her life force subsiding, indistinguishable from a real corpse."
"The Dragon Tribe genius found herself in a dilemma, facing this situation for the first time. If she claimed victory, it wouldn't feel rewarding. If she admitted defeat, it would've been absurd. However, she couldn't hit an apparently dead person as it would tarnish her reputation."
"At that moment, she had a brainwave and came up with a solution - burning down the Phoenix Tribe genius."
"The Phoenix Tribe genius was in excruciating pain from the burning and let out a loud cry. She popped right up, screaming so adamantly that the entire universe could hear it."
"Somehow along the way, this incident was mistaken as the Phoenix bathing in fire and being reborn. I'm uncertain who spread the rumor around, seriously no sense of morality."
Fairy Eternity shook her head, somewhat dissatisfied with the Phoenix Tribe genius: "She hasn't quite gotten hang of the Playing Dead Technique. If it were me, I would have continued playing dead."
"Luckily no one knew that I was the one who taught the Playing Dead Technique. She was so poor at it that I'm too embarrassed to admit that I taught her. What a disgrace."
Lu Yang: "..."
You're the disgraceful one, aren't you, Fairy?

chapters.title: Chapter 232 - 231: Li Haoran's Past Life_1
chapters.content:
Out of respects for the elders of the Phoenix Tribe, as well as the world's beautiful fantasies of phoenixes, Lu Yang felt that there was no need to disclose the ancient secrets he had just learned.
Lu Yang felt that he had undertaken too many matters. After all, he was just at the Foundation Establishment Stage.
By rights, a Foundation Establishment cultivator who knows many ancient secrets should be able to use them to glean various opportunities.
For example, if a certain ancient race lost its inheritance, Lu Yang could casually reveal the location of it, allowing the ancient race to reclaim their heritage, and in return, they would be deeply thankful to him, even offering their holy maiden as his wife.
Or he could enter an ancient secret realm where others risked their lives to overcome challenges, but he, knowing the underlying principles, could casually acquire the final reward, leaving all geniuses dumbfounded.
Otherwise, he could attend an auction where a piece of treasure that everyone overlooked and was about to go unsold, only he knew that it was a precious treasure from the ancient times, and he could buy it at a low price.
However, Lu Yang didn't stumble upon any of such opportunities.
Lu Yang felt that knowing loads of ancient secrets held no value to him, as none of them could be utilized.
Lu Yang pondered over this, wondering where the problem lay.
...
With the Phoenix Blood Stone matter coming to an end after a night of hassle, the most significant achievement had been inadvertently crushing the schemes of the Nine Nether Sect, and also Li Haoran had learned that Su Yiren was a Body Cultivator.
When Li Haoran's parents woke up, they stared at the bottomless pit in the courtyard and fell into deep thought.
Everything was fine before they went to sleep. They were amazed at how a large pit appeared after they woke up.
Su Yiren, worried that the commotion at night would wake up Li Haoran's parents and Qin Yanyan, cast an Array Method that isolated the outside noise.
The encounter between Su Yiren and the Old Phoenix last night was not a quiet affair. Only Li Haoran's family hadn't heard it, but everyone else in Luofeng County did.
The County Magistrate had to publicly declare that he was conducting underground work at night and apologizes for the inconvenience due to the uncontrolled force.
He certainly couldn't say that as the County Magistrate, he was incompetent and his position had been taken advantage of by the Nine Nether Sect. If it weren't for Su Yiren's presence, everyone would have been doomed.
If he admitted to that, he would have to resign from the position of the County Magistrate.
Lu Yang briefly explained the situation of the previous night to his parents, omitting the Phoenix Blood Stone, County Magistrate, Sect Leader Mo, Nine Nether Sect, and Old Phoenix.
In a nutshell, nothing happened the previous night.
Qin Yanyan glared at Lu Yang who was making up stories. The reason her mother intervened which caused such a large hole to form, certainly meant that something significant had occurred the previous night.
However, she didn't ask further in front of Li Haoran's parents and let Lu Yang make up stories.
Li Haoran's parents nodded, seeming not fully understanding. With Lu Yang's assurance that he would fill the pit, they stopped asking about it.
A view into the pitch-black hole would reveal the Old Phoenix lying at the bottom.
According to Jiang Shan, the deceased old phoenix chose this place to be buried. As for the underlying story, he didn't know about it.
"Senior Su, I feel..."
"Call me Yiren." Su Yiren finally took the opportunity to correct Li Haoran's form of address. She maintained a gentle tone that could make any hero fall for it. It was hard for anyone to associate her with the Body Cultivator from the night before.
Although Su Yiren was a Body Cultivator, she was nothing like the Third Elder whose muscular body exuded explosive power. Her body was well proportioned, meeting the public's aesthetic standards, and she was more like a fitness enthusiast from Lu Yang's previous life.
"Yi, Yi, Yiren…" Li Haoran stuttered.
"Yes." Su Yiren chuckled.
"I think we might not..."
Just before the words "incompatible" was uttered, Su Yiren gently placed her forefinger on Li Haoran's lips.
"Haoran, I understand it can be hard for you to accept this truth. We are both cultivators with long life spans. Let's first try to accept each other and slowly adapt. If we truly are incompatible, you can propose to break up then. Okay?"
Li Haoran couldn't muster the courage to refuse and subtly nodded.
Su Yiren smirked and let go of her hand. On the side, Qin Yanyan was stomping her foot in frustration.
Although Su Yiren's finger lightly pressed on Li Haoran's lips, only he knew how powerful that finger was, to the point that he couldn't open his mouth.
However, even if Su Yiren hadn't pressed his lips, he still would have wanted to give it a try with her.
Having achieved her goal for this visit, Su Yiren didn't hang around. She worried that her over-enthusiasm might make Li Haoran uncomfortable. It would be better to keep some distance and give each other some space.
After spending a day with Qin Yanyan, Su Yiren left after dinner. Before she left, she secretly set up various array methods that benefitted Li Haoran's parents and waved goodbye to Li Haoran, saying, "I'll visit you when I have time."
Another day passed, and Li Haoran performed his cultivation practices as usual for his parents, which included practicing punches and meditation.
But while he was cultivating, he noticed that something was wrong. The spiritual essence within his body was overflowing, his fingers and toes involuntarily stretched and curled up. This was a manifestation of an overflow of spiritual energy.
"Is it time to level up? That's right, considering the time, it would be appropriate to advance now." Li Haoran had encountered a similar situation before, during the Qi Refinement stage.
Currently, he was in the early stage of the Foundation Establishment stage. Due to soaking in lava for an extended period, his Foundation Establishment was over a month later than the others, including Lu Yang.
Among the top five of his generation, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had just entered the late stage of Foundation Establishment, Tao Yaoye and Man Gu had been in the mid-stage for a while, and Li Haoran was the slowest to progress.
Now he was finally catching up to their pace.
Li Haoran sent a message asking Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou to become his protectors during this cultivation period.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had woken up early, but were lazing around in bed. On hearing that their good brother was leveling up, they quickly got up and rushed to the courtyard to guard him.
Li Haoran sat cross-legged, took a deep breath, and a small whirlwind formed above his head, absorbing the surrounding spiritual energy. There was a crackling sound inside his body as if he was refining his body through refining, making his blood vessels, meridians, acupoints, and organs more rigid.
His body became bright red, like a piece of hot iron. His sweat evaporated with a sizzling sound as it came into contact with his skin. Fortunately, this change didn't last long. He suppressed a hum, his power surged, and he successfully ascended to the mid-stage of Foundation Establishment after completing a large Zhou Tian cycle.
Upon entering the mid-stage of Foundation Establishment, a surge of memories he had never experienced before appeared in his mind, feeling incredibly familiar, as if he had experienced it personally.
"Hmm?"
He slowly opened his eyes, looking puzzled.
"What's wrong?" Lu Yang asked, concerned. He thought that there might be a hiccup in his cultivation.
"My previous life... seems to have been the master of the Nine Nether Sect."
Li Haoran's tone was full of uncertainty.
"What?"

chapters.title: Chapter 233 - 232: Elder Brother Dai, We Have Captured the Master of the Nine Nether Sect_1
chapters.content:
"Are you sure you were the master of the Nine Nether Sect in your previous life?" Lu Yang looked up and down at Li Haoran, unable to associate him with the master of the Nine Nether Sect.
Li Haoran hesitated: "There is a high probability, didn't Yiren say it? As I elevate my realm, I will regain some fragmented memories and remember things from my past life."
"After I just broke through to the mid-stage of Foundation Establishment, an image flashed in my mind."
"In the image, there was a man dressed in black, likely a subordinate of mine. It was pitch dark around him, making the surroundings unclear."
"My subordinate was holding a few pieces of paper and said, 'Master, this is the annual income and expenditure of our sect in Spirit Stones, please review it.' After I took it over, the first line of the paper was 'Nine Nether Sect's income and expenditure of Spirit Stones.'
"Before I could look at the rest, the image disappeared."
"Being called 'Master' and shown the accounts of the Nine Nether Sect, it's obviously an easy deduction of my past life's identity."
The Nine Nether Sect, one of the Four Great Devil Sects.
Just as no one knows the name of the master of the Eternity Sect, no one knows the name of the master of the Nine Nether Sect.
Now Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou know, it is Qin Haoran.
Lu Yang pondered, based on this, Li Haoran really could be the reincarnation of the master of the Nine Nether Sect.
He looked at Meng Jingzhou, who was also deep in thought: "What do you think?"
Meng Jingzhou looked up, frowning: "The Nine Nether Sect seems a bit poor, they don't even light a lamp."
"..."
Lu Yang did not focus on Meng Jingzhou's odd focus point and analyzed: "If Junior Brother Li was the master of the Nine Nether Sect in his previous life, then some of the things that Senior Su mentioned would match."
"For example, why no one knows about Qin Haoran, who is a late Unification cultivator, he could either be a hermit cultivator like Senior Su, or perhaps he has a special identity that cannot be revealed."
"Another example is why Qin Haoran was chased at the beginning, there are generally two situations, one is obtaining an extremely precious magic artifact and the murderer wants to kill and take the property. The other is that Qin Haoran has a high position and the murderer wants to seize power."
"The first type is unlikely to happen in the Central Continent, in that situation Qin Haoran's response should have been to seek help from the Great Xia Dynasty. As such, the following situation of Qin Haoran rushing into Senior Su's cultivation land would not have happened."
"So the second type is very likely, at that time there was a rebellion within the Nine Nether Sect, someone wanted to seize power and Qin Haoran was seriously injured because he could not resist."
"Qin Haoran never told Senior Su about his identity, saying that the work he does is very dangerous and Senior Su can ensure safety only if he is unaware. The master of the Four Great Devil Sects certainly couldn't tell Senior Su. If Senior Su knew Qin Haoran's identity and the Nine Nether Sect's affairs were exposed, Senior Su would also be severely punished."
"Qin Haoran also said that he had a special identity. If he doesn't break through to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, he would have to remain hidden his entire life.
