If the master of the devil sects becomes a Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator, he can do many things he didn't dare do before."
In fact, Lu Yang had guesses about Qin Haoran's identity for a long time, but without evidence, he couldn't tell Su Yiren that her husband was part of a devil sect and was not a good thing.
Lu Yang looked at Li Haoran and smiled: "Junior Brother Li, do you believe now that you are the reincarnation of Qin Haoran?"
Actually, Lu Yang also suspected that Su Yiren might have fabricated a piece of memory and implanted it into Li Haoran's mind. The possibility is small, but it is there.
However, after confirmation by Fairy Eternity, it was confirmed that this was Li Haoran's own memory and no one tampered with it.
Li Haoran had a downcast look, with this happening, whether he believes it or not, he had to believe it.
Suddenly, he remembered another problem and broke out in a cold sweat: "The Great Xia Dynasty doesn't have a legal system that pursues the past life's responsibilities, right?"
Lu Yang quickly went through the books he had read in his mind and confidently said: "No, the law of the Great Xia Dynasty is based on the principle that once a person dies, their debts are written off. You have reincarnated, the Great Xia Dynasty cannot control you."
Li Haoran breathed a sigh of relief.
"You three got up so early?" Li Haoran's mother saw the three of them cultivating in the yard and smiled.
"Aunt, Haoran just broke through to the mid-stage of Foundation Establishment." Lu Yang replied with a smile.
Both of Li Haoran's parents were at the early stage of Foundation Establishment. Previously, Li Haoran had surpassed his parents in combat power, now he had also surpassed them in the realm, which made Li Haoran's mother very happy.
Li Haoran could not tell his parents about his past life's identity, as this would only cause unnecessary worry.
"Oh, we should celebrate, didn't I say that mixing with Little Lu and Little Meng would help you progress."
Li Haoran: "...Yes, yes, yes."
During the celebratory meal, Li Haoran informed his parents that he would be returning to the sect, which surprised them.
Li Haoran's previous life as the master of the Nine Nether Sect was too big of a deal that three of them alone couldn't handle, they had to report back to the sect as soon as possible.
"You've only been here for a few days and you're leaving already. Have Little Lu and Little Meng had enough fun?"
Lu Yang put down his chopsticks, his lips hinting at an irresistible smile: "Junior Brother Li had a breakthrough, so he needs the senior cultivators of the sect to assist in consolidating his cultivation level. We need to go back as soon as possible."
This was a lie, the Seek Dao Sect always advocated solitary cultivation and does not need senior cultivators to assist in consolidating cultivation level, but Lu Yang's tone was sincere and easily believed.
Upon hearing this, Li Haoran's parents did not persuade the three of them to stay a few more days.
Still pulled by the old horse, the three of them returned to the Seek Dao Sect.
Meng Jingzhou urged the old horse to return to the sect as soon as possible. The old horse nodded slowly, as casual as before, but each step could span hundreds to thousands of miles.
"Junior Brother Li, your identity as the master of the Nine Nether Sect is very can be exploited. When we return to the sect, with proper management, we could make a fortune. After all it's done, we could split it thirty-seventy, how about it?"
"There's such a good thing?"
"Of course, but it might be a bit inconvenient for you, Junior Brother."
In no time, the three of them returned to the Seek Dao Sect and entered the Task Hall.
"Is Elder Brother Dai inside?" Lu Yang asked the brother on duty.
The brother on duty looked up and saw Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou brimming with smiles, and the burlap bag Meng Jingzhou had slung over his shoulder.
"Elder Brother Dai is inside. He has instructed that if you two have anything to look for him, just go straight in. You don't need to report. But, what's in this bag..."
"Spoils of war."
"Oh, then go in." The brother on duty didn't think too much. It certainly wouldn't be anything dangerous.
The two of them carried the bag to Dai Bufan's room. Dai Bufan was still perusing the archives, in search of clues for tasks.
"Why are you two here? What can I do for you?"
Meng Jingzhou preemptively stated, "Great news, Elder Brother Dai. After our relentless efforts, we finally caught the master of the Nine Nether Sect. Just not sure how much contribution points this achievement can earn."
"The master of the Nine Nether Sect?" Dai Bufan suspiciously looked into Meng Jingzhou's eyes. Meng Jingzhou was not lying and in good conscience, met Dai Bufan's eyes.
Dai Bufan then looked at Lu Yang, who likewise met Dai Bufan's gaze without guilt.
Dai Bufan's doubt deepened, he didn't understand what sort of game these two were playing, and was inwardly puzzled.
"Where is the master of the Nine Nether Sect?"
Meng Jingzhou opened the mouth of the burlap bag revealing Li Haoran who was gagged and tied up, he pointed at him and stated proudly: "This is the one!"
Dai Bufan: "..."
Do you two think I'm an idiot?

chapters.title: Chapter 234 - 233: So That's How It Is_1
chapters.content:
Meng Jingzhou, seeing Elder Brother Dai not believe them, began to recount the story with great detail.
"We went out a few days ago and saw a plume of black smoke rising from a mountain stream. Thinking there must be a demon causing chaos in the world, we directly charged towards it. The villain proclaimed himself the Master of the Nine Nether Sect, possessing great powers. Fortunately, we were no ordinary people and had some skills. Through a fierce and deadly fight, we finally captured the villain.
Only when we unmasked him did we discover that the villain was none other than Li Haoran!"
"The Master of the Nine Nether Sect, such a mysterious person, was captured by the two of us. We don't want much, just three Acting Sect Master exchange vouchers each will do."
"... Are you sure you know what you are saying?"
As the oldest apprentice in the sect, Dai Bufan had been alive for nearly a thousand years. He had never felt his intelligence being insulted more than today.
Lu Yang shrugged, untying Li Haoran while saying, "See, I told you Elder Brother Dai wouldn't believe us."
A promise to give Li Haoran 30% of the points was naturally out of the question now.
"Why wouldn't I believe? We really did capture the Master of the Nine Nether Sect," said Meng Jingzhou, believing every word he said was true.
"Alright, what exactly happened?" Dai Bufan knew that although the two were quite amusing, they wouldn't joke about something like this. there must be a reason.
Of course, if these two dared to say they were just here to swindle points, he would have them tied up and left at the door of the Task Hall.
"Ahem, so the story goes like this."
"Initially, Junior Brother Li was feeling a bit nervous about meeting his fiancée, so he asked us for help. We found out that his fiancée is kind-hearted, more advanced in her cultivation than Li Haoran, perfect in all respects, and her only issue was her age."
Dai Bufan was leisurely sipping his tea with his legs crossed, casually inquiring, "An older age isn't a problem. Who is she, and how much older is she? One year or two years?"
"Two thousand years."
"Pff-"
Dai Bufan spat out a mouthful of tea. He thought he was hallucinating. He coughed violently, took a long time to recover, and finally managed to say, "How much? Two thousand years?"
Wasn't that the same age as the Sect Leader's master?
Dai Bufan gave Li Haoran a few more glances, but still couldn't see anything special about him.
"Li Junior Brother's fiancée is named Su Yiren, a Unification Stage Cultivator."
"Oh, Su Yiren. Heard she's a beauty, must be the one cultivating on Tianzhu Mountain." Dai Bufan, who managed all the information of the Seek Dao Sect and had eyes and ears all over the Central Continent, was aware of the Unification Stage Cultivator that others didn't know.
"Su Senior's husband was named Qin Haoran, also a Unification Stage Cultivator. Qin Haoran lost his life while trying to break through to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. Due to the specificity of his cultivation practice, he reincarnated."
Qin Haoran? Dai Bufan went through his memory of Unification Stage Cultivators, but couldn't recall anyone with that name.
"Qin Haoran reincarnated as Junior Brother Li, and to continue their love, Su Senior became Junior Brother Li's fiancée."
"Later, in Luofeng County, we accidentally discovered the trace of the Nine Nether Sect devotees. Su Senior acted, destroyed their plot, and led us to witness the process of making Phoenix Blood Stone."
"You saw the Phoenix Blood Stone made with the blood of a Phoenix in Luofeng County?" Dai Bufan was not surprised.
"Elder Brother Dai, did you know about this?" Lu Yang was taken aback.
Dai Bufan rolled his eyes, "It's not hard to guess. Which family's Unification Stage mining vein could be mined for four thousand years? What do you think, are Phoenixes all blood without flesh?"
"It's just that Phoenix blood isn't easy to find. I worry that pointing out this fact would anger the Phoenix Tribe who would then refuse to sell their blood."
Lu Yang: "... Alright."
"Then Junior Brother Li made a breakthrough and regained fragments of his past life's memory, realizing he was the Master of the Nine Nether Sect in his past life."
After Lu Yang finished speaking, Dai Bufan remained silent, his index finger rhythmically tapping on the table: "Reincarnation, past life, Nine Nether Sect..."
"The Nine Nether Sect believes there is a place in the world called Nine Nether for reincarnation, and Li Haoran happens to be the reincarnated Master of the Nine Nether Sect..."
"Elder Brother Dai, is reincarnation really possible?"
Elder Brother Dai shook his head: "I don't know. However, there are many rumors. For example, in the north there is a divine child who glows with golden light, who was born with knowledge, and has the ability to fly and escape. He is believed by the local people to be the reincarnation of an immortal."
"What's the truth?"
"There was an idiot who didn't cultivate properly and had a Nascent Soul escape."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
"And then there's a young genius in a small sect, exceptionally talented. One day, a Great Power visits the sect and, upon seeing the genius, is taken aback. The genius resembles an old friend of the Great Power in both talent and appearance."
"What happened later?"
"Later, the Great Power discovered that his old friend was faking his death, becoming young again just for the sake of showing off before the smaller sect."
Li Haoran: "..."
"Generally speaking, these reincarnation rumours cannot be trusted, they are either completely without basis, or are used to create hype and spread false information, along with various other strange reasons. Judging from the information I currently have, not a single case involves a true reincarnation."
"The Master of the Nine Nether Sect is related to many things, and I know very little about reincarnation. It's best to leave this matter to Eldest Senior Sister to decide."
"Then we'd better find Eldest Senior Sister..."
Before Lu Yang could finish, a cold voice rang out.
"No need, I'm already here."
The tone was cold, like ice that had existed for thousands of years.
Space distorted, and a beautiful figure walked out from an unknown space, appearing before them. It was Yun Zhi.
Word had already been sent to Yun Zhi during their conversation.
"I never thought Junior Brother Li would be the reincarnation of a Great Power."
"Reincarnations do not exist, they are nonsense. If Junior Brother Li really is the reincarnated Master of the Nine Nether Sect, it can only be due to the Dao Fruit."
Yun Zhi recalled speculation about the purpose of the Four Great Devil Sects: "Could it be that the Nine Nether Sect had formed a rudimentary Dao Fruit of reincarnation a long time ago?"
"Open your heart and think of nothing."
Li Haoran hurriedly purified his mind, keeping it immaculate, thinking of nothing.
Yun Zhi's eyes seemed to contain the countless stars of the sky, utterly beautiful and captivating, encompassing all the mysteries of the world, entrancing everyone who looked into them.
These eyes resembled the legendary eyes that could see through everything, like the Heavenly Eye Technique, one of the six divine abilities of Buddhism. Only Dai Bufan knew that this was a unique method created by Eldest Senior Sister, known only to her in the world.
Li Haoran only felt that all his secrets had been seen through by Eldest Senior Sister, from his growth experiences, his cultivation process, his mental journey...everything was laid bare before her eyes.
Yun Zhi withdrew her gaze, closed her eyes and opened them again, and her eyes returned to normal. Li Haoran breathed a sigh of relief as Eldest Senior Sister's pressure was too strong.
"I see."
She showed an unquestionable confidence, as if she had insight into certain matters.
Lu Yang promptly asked, "Eldest Senior Sister, what did you find out?"
Yun Zhi's tone was flat and cold, saying:
"There are indeed things that I can't figure out."
Lu Yang: "..."
Eldest Senior Sister, is there something wrong with you?

chapters.title: Chapter 235 - 224 Differences Between Li Haoran and Lu Yang_1
chapters.content:
When Yun Zhi said that she couldn't figure it out either, Fairy Eternity breathed a sigh of relief.
"Hehe, I told you this stuff crosses disciplines and no one can understand."
This indicated that her inability to understand Li Haoran's condition was not due to her lacking perceptiveness, but because the reality was just as such.
"I observed that Junior Brother Li's physical state mirrors that of an ordinary person with no traces of the Dao Fruit present."
"So, my body doesn't have a problem?"
Yun Zhi shook her head slightly, "No, this implies that there IS an issue with your body. Your body is no different from that of an ordinary person. Where did these fragments of memory come from?"
"The matter of Dao Fruit involves the laws of the world, and even I can't fully understand or elucidate everything. As for Junior Brother Li's case, we need to think and plan for the long term."
"If Junior Brother Li later obtains more memory fragments, make sure to inform the sect. The more we know, the easier it will be to analyze exactly what happened to you. Plus, this could also serve as an opportunity to learn more about the Nine Nether Sect."
Li Haoran nodded. If he were to receive more memory fragments, he would certainly inform the sect. He would worry otherwise.
For a small Cultivator in the Foundation Establishment Stage who suddenly discovered that he was the Master of one of the Four Great Devil Sects, it was bound to be alarming, regardless of who it was. He needed to find a powerful backup.
Luckily, the Seek Dao Sect he belonged to was the most formidable support in the world.
"I have another question."
"Feel free to ask."
"You have been mentioning Dao Fruit continuously since just now. What exactly is Dao Fruit?"
Only then did Dai Bufan remember that Li Haoran had no clue about what the Dao Fruit was.
Sure enough, the Dao Fruit is the cornerstone of Immortality. How could a cultivator in the Foundation Establishment Stage possibly qualify to know about it?
Why then, did he instinctively think that normal cultivators in the Foundation Establishment Stage should know about the Dao Fruit?
Dai Bufan looked at the other two in the Foundation Establishment Stage among the four— Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
Why did the two of you know about Dao Fruit?
…
Even amongst the secrets of the Dao Fruit, which was at the highest level, ordinary cultivators in the Unification Stage knew very little. Only cultivators in the late stage or peak of the Unification Stage had the qualifications to understand the Dao Fruit. For instance, Su Yiren only had a general understanding of the concept of the Dao Fruit. Even she had less knowledge about it than Lu Yang.
Dai Bufan was an exception. Although he was just in the early stage of the Unification Stage, he was managing the Task Hall, held numerous intelligence sources, and knew much about the Dao Fruit.
Furthermore, his combat power should not be seen as simply being at the initial stage of Unification.
Theoretically, Li Haoran was not qualified to know about the Dao Fruit. However, considering that there might be a rudimentary Dao Fruit hidden in him, it was unacceptable to not inform him about this matter.
Hence, Eldest Senior Sister briefly informed Li Haoran about some knowledge related to the Dao Fruit, and it was then that he realized its significance.
His current situation was not merely related to the Nine Nether Sect, but even more crucially, he was tied to a potential path to immortality.
If this news were to get out, who knows how many people would be tempted. Li Haoran at this moment was like the Monk's meat in his previous life. Regardless of whether he could obtain the Reincarnation Dao Fruit, they would first kidnap Li Haoran.
"Could there also be an immortal behind the Reincarnation Dao Fruit rudiment, just like the Eternity Dao Fruit?" Returning to Sky Gate Mountain, Lu Yang was somewhat worried about Li Haoran's predicament.
If an immortal was to take action and snatch Li Haoran, it would be easy to remove the Reincarnation Dao Fruit or The Reincarnation Dao Fruit rudiment, and Li Haoran wouldn't have the slightest power to resist.
"That's why I suggested to Junior Brother Li earlier that unless it's necessary, he shouldn't leave the Seek Dao Sect. Inside the sect, he is safe."
She spoke in a calm tone, but it revealed absolute confidence.
Yun Zhi did not have the same demands for Lu Yang. Every time Lu Yang left the sect, she not only didn't stop him but also encouraged him. She wanted him to go out and see the world instead of staying cooped up in the Seek Dao Sect.
In fact, Lu Yang was in a more dangerous situation than Li Haoran. Li Haoran merely showed signs of having a Dao Fruit rudiment, while Lu Yang was confirmed to have one who was being hunted down by an immortal in his body, and he had the Eternity Dao Fruit that the Four Immortals of the Ancients coveted.
However, if Lu Yang met with danger, he could implement the ultimate form of the Imitation Fist and summon Eldest Senior Sister.
If Li Haoran was the Monk, then Lu Yang was the Monk who could summon the Buddha himself. The safety quotient of the two was not on the same level at all.
"Eldest Senior Sister mentioned earlier that the appearance of Dao Fruit represents the emergence of a new law in this world. After the Ancients did any Dao Fruit appear that affects the entire world?"
Eldest Senior Sister quietly looked at Lu Yang, her eyes as calm as still water, making Lu Yang feel uneasy. It took him several seconds, or even minutes, perhaps even a lifetime, before he heard the Eldest Senior Sister slowly say.
"Senior, please step out for a while."
"What's the matter?" Fairy Eternity was confused.
"Junior Brother Li is only in the Foundation Establishment Stage. Knowing too many secrets, that only those with great power are qualified to know, might lead to him developing ambitious but unrealistic expectations, which isn't conducive to his future cultivation. When discussing these matters with Junior Brother Li, please consider his cultivation Realm."
"Oh, alright then."
Fairy Eternity actually wanted to say that she had considered Lu Yang's Realm when she was telling them about the Dao Fruit, but she dared not contradict Yun Zhi in person.
Just wait until I recover my power one day! I'll suppress this rascal!
"After the Ancients, indeed there was a Dao Fruit that impacted the entire world, and it's something you are quite familiar with." The Eldest Senior Sister believed it wouldn't hurt to let Lu Yang know this.
"I am familiar with it?" Lu Yang was slightly shocked. Besides the changes in the stars and the continents, what was different now compared to the time of the Ancients?
Not just Lu Yang, even Fairy Eternity failed to think about how the current era was different from the time of the Ancients.
"It's the Great Xia Dynasty." Yun Zhi revealed the answer.
"What about the Great Xia Dynasty?" Lu Yang did not understand.
"The entirety of the Great Xia Dynasty."
Lu Yang's eyes widened in surprise. What did she mean by 'the entirety of the Great Xia Dynasty'?
Despite incessantly probing her for the meaning of her words, Eldest Senior Sister believed that further explanation would go beyond what someone of Lu Yang's Realm should know, thus she refrained from explaining more.
Fairy Eternity seemed to be deep in thought, as though she understood something.
"Junior Brother, have you got any insight about forming your Golden Core?" As Lu Yang's nominal main Elder Sister, but actually his mentor, Yun Zhi often paid attention to his progress in cultivation.
Lu Yang could only shake his head in resignation, "There are too many types of Golden Cores. I really can't decide which one to form. So far, I still haven't figured it out."
However, he could already eliminate Fairy Eternity's Invincible Elixir.
He followed Li Haoran home, originally hoping that seeing different people and things during the journey could give him some insights.
The most profound realization he had after the trip was that living off a woman was really enjoyable.
What, form a 'Living-off-a-woman' Golden Core?
If that got out, it would be rather embarrassing.
"There's no need to worry too much about forming the Golden Core. Let it come naturally."
"By the way, Senior Sister, I saw the experiences of my senior brothers and sisters about core formation in the Scripture Pavilion, but your experiences aren't written there. How did you form your core and what kind of core did you form?"
With the party concerned right here, Lu Yang couldn't help but let his curiosity get the better of him and ask.
Maybe, he was just as outstanding as his Eldest Senior Sister?

chapters.title: Chapter 236 - 225: The Method of Eldest Senior Sister's Golden Core Formation_1
chapters.content:
"You really want to know?"
"Really, really." Lu Yang nodded vigorously, like a chicken pecking at grain.
Yun Zhi weighed the pros and cons of revealing, deciding it wouldn't hurt to satisfy her junior brother's curiosity.
"Alright, since you want to know, I'll tell you. But I must repeat, listen but don't imitate me."
"Definitely won't imitate." Lu Yang promised.
Fairy Eternity was also quite curious about Yun Zhi's process of forming the golden core, wondering if this younger generation's elixir could possibly be superior to her own Invincible Elixir?
"This happened hundreds of years ago..." Yun Zhi drifted into a state of reminiscence.
"Hundreds of years ago?!" blurted out Lu Yang, his tone revealing immense surprise.
Eldest Senior Sister was an exceptional ice beauty in her twenties. Having Lu Yang walking beside her made them look like a pair of siblings. Her treatment of Lu Yang was not that of an elder to a junior, but more of a mature peer. This gave Lu Yang the impression that they were about the same age.
Upon hearing Senior Sister discuss her golden core formation from hundreds of years ago, Lu Yang finally realized that she was the oldest among the disciples. Her real age was much greater than he had imagined.
Just how old is Senior Sister? Hundreds of years old? Could she possibly be near a thousand?
Though the thought process seemed complex, it happened in a flash, as quick as lightning.
These ideas flashed across Lu Yang's mind. He didn't even have time to think before voicing his thoughts aloud.
The moment he voiced them, he felt doomed.
Yun Zhi's gaze slowly landed on Lu Yang's shoulder. For an instant, he felt as if a sharp knife was poised at his neck, teetering on the edge of death. Death was just a thought away.
Fortunately, the feeling was fleeting. Senior Sister retracted her gaze, not bothered by Lu Yang's excessive curiosity, and continued.
"Hundreds of years ago, I reached the Foundation Establishment's late stage, ready to form my golden core."
"At that time, Master saw my potential and believed I could shoulder great responsibilities. He told me some secrets to prepare for the future. One of them was that the Ancient Nameless One had transformed stars into continents. Most of the stars we see today are mere illusions, the real stars lie beneath our feet."
It is commonly accepted among cultivators, that only those reaching the Nascent Soul Stage have the qualification to learn that the stars are false. The public and ordinary cultivators should just accept the peace of the world for what it is.
Otherwise, the public and ordinary cultivators would wonder if there would be a second time the Ancient Nameless One would transform continents into stars, resulting in unnecessary worry. It's better not to tell them.
"I should have told you before that I grew up in a Secret Realm, and only later, left for the Seek Dao Sect."
Lu Yang nodded. Eldest Senior Sister had mentioned that she had lived in the Secret Realm from a young age, interacted only with cultivators and continued to do so upon arriving at the Seek Dao Sect. As a result, she was not familiar with mortal habits, did not know that people couldn't bathe in boiling water.
—— This was what Lu Yang was told by Senior Sister after he bathed in boiling water, his skin red and swollen, while she was applying medicine to his burns.
"There was no night sky in the Secret Realm. When I left to enter the outside world, I saw the twinkling stars under the night sky, and found the sight incredibly beautiful."
"I often lay on the grass counting stars during my free time from cultivation."
"When Master told me that stars had long disappeared from the sky, I didn't show it on my face, but I was disappointed."
"The stars I saw every day were merely phantoms left from 300000 years ago. Once I realized this, I no longer found the night sky beautiful."
"When I was contemplating what kind of Golden Core to form, I read in 'The Discourse on the Golden Core' that 'Gold represents an everlasting and indestructible substance; Core represents something perfect and flawless.'"
Lu Yang had a strange idea, Senior Sister, you wouldn't do something so outrageous, right...?
Only to hear Yun Zhi continue: "At that moment, I thought, isn't the star I yearn for a flawless and indestructible Golden Core?"
"Since there were no stars, why not replace the stars with Golden Cores, to reproduce the magnificent night sky of the ancient times?"
Lu Yang thought to himself, so Senior Sister, you really did think so.
"Within the Golden Core, the First-Grade is the best, so I formed the Golden Core according to the stars in my mind, thus creating a new kind of First-Grade Golden Core, which I called the Brilliant Star Elixir."
"At the start, the technique of forming the golden core was a bit rusty. Later, as the number of cores formed increased, the speed of core formation increased as well."
"During the Golden Core Stage, the main thing I did was continuously form cores, so the number of Golden Cores would match the number of stars in the sky."
Lu Yang gasped, thinking, Senior Sister, you really do dare to think and act.
"It was challenging to replace the stars with Golden Core during the Golden Core Stage, so when I broke through to the Nascent Soul Stage, I broke one of the Golden Cores to form my Nascent Soul, while keeping the other cores inside me."
"Later on, when my cultivation succeeded, I took out the Golden Cores from my body one by one, replacing the phantom stars with real ones."
"Unfortunately, there are too many phantom stars in the night sky. Even though I formed the cores painstakingly, I couldn't match the number. The number of Golden Cores was far less than the phantom stars."
"But having some is better than none. Wasn't the initial hard work aimed at replacing the phantom stars with Golden Cores?"
"So, some of the stars in the sky now... are your Golden Cores?" Lu Yang asked cautiously, out of respect for the unbelievable feats of Senior Sister.
"Only a small part."
"... Even a small part is quite a lot."
Lu Yang didn't know what to say.
Senior Sister wasn't confident about Lu Yang and warned him again: "My method of forming the core is different from others. Don't try to imitate me just because you think it's interesting."
"Absolutely will not imitate."
If earlier, Lu Yang's assurance of not imitating was just perfunctory, now it was his genuine thought.
If one could imitate it, that would be outrageous. One could only imagine the core formation process wasn't as easy as Senior Sister made it sound.
What did she mean by the more cores you form, the faster the speed? Was this in line with common sense?
No wonder Senior Sister wrote in her core formation experience: "My method of core formation has no reference value, please do not imitate. Those who learn from me die, those who resemble me die."
Sometimes, Lu Yang felt that the gap between people was even bigger than the gap between humans and dogs.
We are all cultivating, so how come you are the only one who is so outrageous?
"Fairy, can your Invincible Elixir compare to Senior Sister's?" Lu Yang asked in a whisper.
Fairy Eternity scoffed: "It's just a bunch of Golden Cores. Even if there are more useless cores, they are still garbage. As the second-in-command of the Immortal Lineage, you must remember, we value quality over quantity. This girl has quantity, but my Golden Core is of high quality. There's no comparison."
"Would you dare say this in front of Senior Sister?"
"I wouldn't."
She said it confidently.
"..."
Lu Yang thought he could rely on Senior Sister and Fairy Eternity, his two great backbones, to smooth his cultivation path.
But now it seems that neither of these two backbones can be relied on.
Speaking of which, how old is Senior Sister really?

chapters.title: Chapter 237 - 236: Eldest Senior Sister's Age_1
chapters.content:
"I've said it before, don't try to imitate me," Yun Zhi repeated her warning once more, fearing that Lu Yang might struggle with the comparison and attempt to compete with her.
"Absolutely, absolutely won't imitate!" Lu Yang pledged.
"Alright, I'm going to cultivate now, you continue to select a golden core forming method."
"Yes."
Having understood the specifics of Eldest Senior Sister's golden core formation, Lu Yang abandoned any thought of imitation, not leaving behind even a shred.
Her method of golden core formation was too extraordinary, he was just an ordinary Sword Spirit Root, undistinguished, he didn't have Eldest Senior Sister's kind of genius.
The old nursery rhyme was "Twinkle Twinkle little star". Now should it be changed to "Twinkle Twinkle little golden core"?
Rational, fits well.
With one problem solved, another question surged into his mind - just how old was Eldest Senior Sister?
Exactly how many hundreds of years old?
Lu Yang felt an urge to unearth the truth.
Lu Yang remembered the first round of the sect entry selection was conducted by Elder Brother Dai. As long as one touched him, Elder Brother Dai could tell a person's spirit root and age: "Fairy, do you have any magic skill that can see through a person's age?"
"Yes."
Lu Yang had just absentmindedly asked, thinking it was unthinkable, but it really existed?
Worthy of being a fairy.
"Hehe, this magic of mine is quite something, capable of disregarding the person's cultivation level and seeing their age."
"That powerful?!"
"Of course, don't you know who I am!"
This was a minor magic, or rather, a small trick. Simple to learn, once Lu Yang recited the ancient language and practiced twice, he had learned it.
Lu Yang activated the ancient magic, and it felt as though his vision suddenly widened, as if he had grasped some understanding.
"Let's try it on myself first."
Lu Yang spread his hands and saw the number sixteen in front of him.
Correct, he was currently just sixteen years old.
"Look at Fairy again." Lu Yang utilized the ancient magic to look at the calm and composed Fairy Eternity, and the number sixteen also appeared in front of him.
"Huh?"
Although Fairy Eternity had always boasted about herself being a genius beautiful young girl, who passed away at a young age and was currently only sixteen years old.
Even if Lu Yang used his butt to think, he would know this was all bull.
Turned immortal at sixteen, each epoch is one year, right?
With a puzzled heart, Lu Yang looked at a passing senior brother, he was also displayed as sixteen year old!
"…Fairy, is there a problem with this magic? Why do I see everyone as sixteen years old?" Considering his shameful past, Lu Yang first suspected that he had cultivated incorrectly.
Fairy Eternity spoke confidently: "Don't worry about whether the age you saw is correct or not, just say if you can disregard cultivation level and see the age!"
"…"
Fairy Eternity continued: "In ancient times, everyone liked to use age to determine their seniority, this isn't good. Does that mean if someone is older, they are always correct, and if someone is younger, they are always wrong?"
"In order to change this situation, I specifically created this magic that sees everyone as sixteen years old, but unfortunately my idea was too advanced at that time, people could not accept it."
"Your idea is still very advanced even now."
So how to calculate Eldest Senior Sister's age?
The first method that comes to mind for Lu Yang is to ask which batch of disciples she was.
Seek Dao Sect, or rather, the Five Great Immortal Sects' disciples recruitment have a regular schedule, every three years, never interrupted.
He quickly dismissed this method.
Seek Dao Sect even recruited Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, the entry threshold seeming low, but in reality very outrageously high. The number of disciples recruited in Lu Yang's batch was already considered a lot.
Some people who came for the selection meet the spirit root standards, but do not meet the willpower standards, they couldn't enter Seek Dao Sect, causing instances when Seek Dao Sect simply didn't recruit anyone.
So, Lu Yang couldn't calculate Eldest Senior Sister's age by determining which batch of disciples she was.
"Then just ask Elder Brother Dai? Elder Brother Dai and Eldest Senior Sister were from the same batch, he should definitely know Eldest Senior Sister's age!"
Lu Yang decided to do it immediately, but because the third test for entering the sect was his alone facing Elder Brother Dai he always felt guilty.
Find a helper.
"We're going to Elder Brother Dai to ask about Eldest Senior Sister's age?" Hearing Lu Yang's plan, Meng Jingzhou showed an eager expression.
"We won't be caught by Eldest Sister, right?"
"No, Eldest Senior Sister was cultivating when I left and doesn't have time to pay attention to us."
"Then what are you waiting for, let's go." Meng Jingzhou urged Lu Yang to hurry up and leave.
...
"You guys want to ask about Eldest Senior Sister's age, huh?" Dai Bufan looked at Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou with a weird expression.
"You guys have guts, daring to ask even this kind of secret? Be careful not to attract trouble." Elder Brother Dai kindly warned the two, this matter was a top secret of Seek Dao Sect, the degree of confidentiality was even above that of Dao Fruit intelligence, it must not be disclosed to anyone.
"Do you know what happened to the disciple who last asked this question?"
"Just casually asking." Meng Jingzhou put on a business-like smile that looked very fake.
"Yeah yeah, we both are just concerned about Eldest Senior Sister. We feel that she's working very hard day and night for this sect and it's difficult. Only if we know her age can we give her the right gifts." Lu Yang had a similar smile on his face as Meng Jingzhou.
Dai Bufan rolled his eyes, there were ghosts if he believed these two.
This is a taboo topic, absolutely not to be discussed.
"Aren't you afraid Eldest Senior Sister will learn of this?"
Meng Jingzhou glimmered a smile: "Eldest Senior Sister is currently cultivating and has no spare time to take care of us here, as long as Elder Brother Dai doesn't say anything, Eldest Senior Sister will not know about this!"
Dai Bufan gently shook his head: "Eldest Senior Sister has the ability to see through everything and everywhere, how can she not know this? I advise you from my heart, just stop asking about this, it's very dangerous."
"There won't be any danger." Meng Jingzhou thought this matter was not a big deal.
Hearing this, Dai Bufan said with a smile that wasn't really a smile: "Really? Since that's the case, why not turn around and ask the person in question directly?"
"Huh? What do you mean?"
The two of them felt a grave foreboding, feeling the temperature around them plummet rapidly, as if they were about to be frozen into ice sculptures.
Both men turned stiffly and saw Eldest Senior Sister standing behind them. Standing tall and graceful, emotionless as she looked at Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, not revealing any happiness or anger.
Dai Bufan sighed: "See, I've already told you, don't ask this question, it will bring disaster."
Ever since the two of them found him, Eldest Senior Sister had been standing quietly behind, Dai Bufan was giving frantic hints, but these two were hellbent on courting disaster and couldn't be dragged back.
Maybe they deserved this disaster.
Eldest Senior Sister spoke softly: "Junior Brother."
Lu Yang trembled, hastily answering: "Here!"
"Junior Brother Meng."
"Here!"
"Are you two finding cultivation boring that you care about such a small matter in your free time?"
Eldest Senior Sister's voice was unusually gentle, sounding as if she were concerned about Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou's cultivation progress.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou broke into cold sweats, completely soaking their clothes, trembling, they didn't know what to say.

chapters.title: Chapter 238 - 237 Exile_1
chapters.content:
"Apparently, both of our Junior Brothers find cultivation tedious and lack the motivation to improve their realm. That's why they took interest in such a trivial matter."
"In that case, why don't both of you go to the Central Continent where it borders the Demon Territory for some training?"
"Eldest Senior Sister, this is a bit..."
When Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou attempted to object, their Eldest Senior Sister didn't listen to their pleas. She grabbed the collar of each boy with one hand, as though she was holding two small rabbits, and casually tossed them away.
The two of them only felt the scene in front of their eyes change, and suddenly they were in the sky, flying to the south at a terrifying speed, or rather, tossed towards the south.
The surroundings changed so rapidly that neither of them could calculate their current speed. Whenever they saw a flying ship pass by in a flash, or a Great Power flying by, it still passed in a flash, causing them to wonder about the passengers on the flying ship and the Great Power.
They were both stunned, secretly guessing the cultivation level of these two figures and their astonishing flying speed.
Splash—
The two of them landed, tumbling head over heels, heads on the ground, feet kicking up to the sky, entwined by vines.
"I feel like my body is about to break apart." Lu Yang struggled to stand up, his body aching as if it had been disassembled and reassembled.
"Where are we?" Meng Jingzhou looked around, noticing the dense vegetation and rare plants growing nearby in the exceptionally humid environment.
"Didn't our Eldest Senior Sister say that she was sending us to the Demon Territory for training? This must be the place that borders the Demon Territory."
Lu Yang pointed out the distinctive characteristics of the surroundings: "Look, these are rare plants on the continent, this is the Money Flower, this is the Flowing Cloud Grass, this is the Ten Thousand Green Wood, and this is a Snake Demon whose realm we can't determine… huh?"
Several dark green Snake Demons appeared in their field of vision. They had triangular heads, and were rapidly slithering towards them, hissing and flicking their forked tongues.
"Run quickly!"
Unable to discern the realm of the Snake Demons, they took no chances. They untangled themselves from the vines, tumbled to the ground, and took off running.
These Snake Demons were clearly dangerous. They didn't fear the Foundation Establishment Stage, what they were afraid of was that these demons might not be just of the Foundation Establishment Stage.
"Hey handsome boys, don't run. Come play with us." The Snake Demons spoke human language, seductively inviting the boys with their enticing voice, which was alluring.
"Sisters will make you feel heavenly~"
"Come play~"
The two of them looked back to see the Snake Demons had transformed into human form. They were beautiful, dressed provocatively, and clearly weren't simple creatures.
"No, thank you. You guys aren't beautiful enough." Meng Jingzhou politely refused.
Upon hearing his words, the Snake Demons were stunned before their faces turned livid with anger. They ran faster.
Fortunately, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were quite savvy, and nobody could beat them when it came to fleeing. Their legs were as swift as the wind.
Unfortunately, their luck was bad. Distracted, they fell into a swamp.
Seeing that the Snake Demons were about to catch up, Lu Yang gritted his teeth: "We can't go on like this, let's use the Shrinking Earth escape method."
"What about me?"
"Stay still, Ground Prison!" Lu Yang quickly drew a circle around Meng Jingzhou. Before Meng Jingzhou could react, he found himself in a Ground Prison.
Lu Yang used the Shrinking Earth method, pushing the Ground Prison, and the prisoner Meng Jingzhou fled.
"Can these two spells be used together?"
The Snake Demons behind them were shocked and didn't understand what had just happened. When they expanded their Spiritual Sense to find the two men, they had already escaped the range of their Spiritual Sense and could not be tracked.
"Are we really that intimidating?" The Snake Demons looked at each other. They had thought to use their bodies to make some Spirit Stones from the Human race, but to their surprise, every single person in the Human race was so resolute, they would run at the sight of them.
The weirdest part was that when they offered to entertain them, the men ran even faster.
They were the Blue Sky Green Snake family, known for their 'special services' in the Demon Territory. Now, they wanted to expand their business among the Human race, but so far hadn't even completed one job successfully.
"Should we go to the Human race's brothels to apply for a job instead of coming here for this wild exercise? I heard many sisters do that." Another sister asked.
"Isn't it said that the Human race also likes to play outdoors? And we don't have to pay taxes outdoors."
"I don't understand."
...
On the other side, Lu Yang was still pushing Meng Jingzhou and running like crazy, his legs were moving as swiftly as a fish.
"Is it safe now?"
"We should have escaped by now."
Both of them came out of the ground only to see a huge elephant's foot, stepping towards them. Behind the giant elephant was a herd of elephants with red eyes, and the tusks were more than three meters long. They were not to be trifled with.
Lu Yang quickly pulled himself and Meng Jingzhou back into the ground.
When they popped their heads out again, there was a beast that looked like a tiger or a leopard feasting on a deer carcass.
For a brief moment, the two humans and the beast stared at each other. Then, as the beast roared, the two of them retreated back into the ground and fled once again.
Finally, the two of them successfully crawled out of the ground. They leaned on their walking sticks, clearly having been through yet another ordeal.
"This isn't training, this is to..."
"Meng Jingzhou was cut off by Lu Yang before he could finish.
"Don't say it. This is a waypoint given to us by the Eldest Senior Sister!" Lu Yang was more alert than Meng Jingzhou. He was worried that the Eldest Senior Sister had a way of knowing their circumstances, and frantically signaled Meng Jingzhou with his eyes.
Loading fear that if Meng Jingzhou upset the Eldest Senior Sister, it would lead to more torment for both of them.
Meng Jingzhou quickly reacted and immediately changed his words: "To discover… discover that our realm is unstable. This allows us to strike here, seeking opportunities for breakthrough!"
"Where should we go? We can't stay here forever, can we?" Lu Yang asked, finding survival increasingly difficult, as he walked on the uneven ground.
"Don't worry. As this place is where Central Continent and the Demon Territory connect, there must be large cities! I heard from my family that the Great Xia dynasty has established six cities here to guard against the Demon Race. An uncle of mine is stationed in one of these cities!"
"Huh? What's that on your arm?" Lu Yang noticed a small black bug crawling on Meng Jingzhou's arm. Its head was thick and its tail was thin. They didn't know when it had climbed onto him.
"It's a leech!" Frightened, Meng Jingzhou hastily shook his arm, but the leech was stuck tight, refusing to be dislodged.
"Don't panic, I heard they're afraid of fire. Watch me burn it! Bleh!" Lu Yang spat out Three Flavored True Fire, lightly touched the leech, and it was burnt to death. It loosened its grip and fell off his arm.
Both had their Spiritual Sense on alert, but had only been wary of the large demon beasts. They didn't expect to have to be cautious of bugs in this place as well.
The leech wouldn't have damaged Meng Jingzhou's defenses, but Meng Jingzhou was a pampered sheltered boy who was not accustomed to such a thing.
After crawling out of a beast's den seven times, being surrounded by beasts five times, forced to fight beasts four times, and crawling out from the belly of a beast once, they finally walked out of the dense forest and saw a city built by the Human race.
They were disheveled and limping, with beast drool still stuck to the tips of their hair.
The words "Demon Suppressing Pass" on the city tower radiated with an intimidating aura inducing an inexplicable sense of relief in them.
"God bless the Eldest Senior Sister, we finally made it out!" The two of them folded their palms together to give thanks to the heavens, thankful for the Eldest Senior Sister's mercy.

chapters.title: Chapter 239 - 238 The Differences Between the Barbarian Tribe and the Ancient Barbarian Tribe_1
chapters.content:
This was the most rugged and grandiose city they had ever seen. It was built with massive refined steel and stone, indestructible, emanating a sense of stern slaughter. It stood tall like a stalwart figure, situated at the border between the human race and the Demon Race, suppressing all invading enemies.
The three big characters "Demon Suppressing Pass" were not just for show, they were a rare treasure, capable of differentiating between the human race and the shapeshifted Demon Race. Anyone who wanted to enter the city would have to pass through the rays of this great treasure to prove their innocence, and this was no exception even for Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
"My uncle is stationed at the Lock Demon Gate, seems like we won't be able to meet him." Meng Jingzhou shook his head, somewhat regretful.
"Make way, make way, my brother is wounded, we need a doctor to treat him!" Just as the two of them were about to enter the city, they heard shouting from behind. Two stout men were carrying a palanquin with a leaner individual on it, who was groaning painfully.
The crowd naturally made way. However, when this group was about to run into the Demon Suppressing Pass, the three characters "Demon Suppressing Pass" enveloped the trio. To everyone's surprise, they screamed in unison, smoke started to rise from their bodies, revealing their true forms.
Those two strong men were actually two giant wolves, and the person they were carrying was not a human cultivator, but an uninjured beast.
The assemblage of warriors guarding the entrance of the Demon Suppressing Pass reacted swiftly without a trace of hesitation, promptly took out their spears and axes, and killed the three Demon Beasts!
It was not uncommon for Demon Beasts trying to sneak into the Demon Suppressing Pass. The fate awaiting them was always death!
Upon entering the Demon Suppressing Pass, they saw people selling Demon Beast skin and Inner Cores on the streets, people selling elixirs for wounds claiming it to be twenty percent cheaper than the store's price, and people boasting about their high cultivation levels, offering themselves to be bodyguards.
The people were just like the city: rugged and bold.
The duo found an inn, rested for the night to restore energy, and clarified their current situation.
Lu Yang, pointing at the map, started to analyze the information they had gathered.
"This is the Demon Suppressing Pass, about 200,000 miles away from the Lock Demon Gate where your uncle resides. The dense forest we just entered is the boundary between the Great Xia Dynasty and the Demon Territory, serving as a neutral ground between the two, not in the possession of any specific power."
"We'll need to cross through the dense forest and walk through a thick fog to reach the authentic Demon Territory."
"An incidental piece of information I've gathered from the newspaper seller suggested that this place is a major hub for Demon Beast trade, the Land Money Trade Association's flying boat will make scheduled stops here. There will be one arriving tomorrow at noon. So, do you want to go back?"
Meng Jingzhou was about to say 'Is there even a need to think about it? Of course we should go back.', but he changed his mind mid-sentence.
"Go back? Why should we go back? After the dense forest gave us such a hard time, we need to show these Demon Beasts some manners, otherwise how are we going to show our face in future?"
Lu Yang gave a hearty smile, "What a coincidence, that's exactly what I was thinking."
The two agreed immediately and decided to stay here for a while; they would not go back until they made a name for themselves.
Returning in a state of defeat was not their style.
"It's a pity that the fellow Man Gu didn't come. The bloodline of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe in his body naturally suppresses Demon Beasts." In the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity shook her head regretfully.
Lu Yang suspected that when Eldest Senior Sister was standing behind them, Fairy Eternity had known everything clearly, and she did not warn him because she wanted to make fun of him.
It was a logical suspicion.
Lu Yang was soon distracted by Fairy Eternity's topic, "Really?"
When it came to this matter, Fairy Eternity was exceptionally proud. She put a hand on her hip, implying as if she was controlling everything: "Of course, did you think that I only enhanced the wisdom level for Barbarian tribe and bestowed the wisdom to them? At that time, a minor part of my power was also shared to them!"
"Who do you think I am? Do you know how many ancient Demon Beasts I tasted while creating the 'Culinary Bible'?"
"The Ancient Demon Beasts fear me encoded deep in their blood, although Man Gu has received only a negligible part of my power, he indirectly has the ability to naturally withstand the Demon Beasts."
"The Ancient Barbarian Tribe, powered by my gift, can boast overwhelming superiority among the Demon Race. They can control those who are inferior in their status merely using their bloodline. If they encounter someone who is equal to them, they can easily handle two opponents by themselves."
Just when Lu Yang was about to praise Fairy Eternity for her power, he thought of another question:
"Can this suppressive power be temporarily concealed? Like if the Ancient Barbarian Tribe went hunting, they would hide in the dark, once a beast came near, although they did not see any Barbarian, their instincts would make them afraid of the bloodline of the Barbarian Tribe, scaring them into fleeing?"
Fairy Eternity first calmly fell into silence to think about the issue, followed by bursting into laughter: "Ha-ha-ha, you really do consider things thoroughly! When the Barbarian Tribe has my protection, how could they ever run short of food?"
"Fairy, can you please stop laughing and answer my question?"
"Ha-ha, with my protection, the Barbarian Tribe..."
Lu Yang: "..."
Prior to this, Lu Yang always wondered what was the difference between the Ancient Barbarian Tribe and the present Barbarian Tribe. He asked Man Gu, but even he could not answer. Man Gu only said that Ancient Barbarian Tribe possessed a kind of mysterious power, they had multiple capabilities and it gave them great assistance.
But because this power made the Ancient Barbarian Tribe go against natural laws, it was gradually fading away as years passed by.
As for what exactly this mysterious power was, not even Man Gu knew, even elders of the tribe could not give a definite answer, only referring to it as a gift from heaven.
Now thinking about it, this mysterious power might be the curse made by Fairy Eternity, right?
As for why only Man Gu was left from the Ancient Barbarian Tribe, whether it was natural evolution, survival of the fittest, or because generations had diluted Fairy Eternity's power was still unknown.
"In fact, I was quite popular among the Demon Race."
Lu Yang looked at Fairy Eternity skeptically, wondering if it was true or false. Are the Demon Races out of their minds? They actually like you?
"Why, you don't believe me? Qiongqi Tribe said that the Toad Branch Tribe would warmly welcome me to visit them, whereas, Toad Branch Tribe said the Qiongqi Tribe would warmly welcome me to visit them. I took a stroll in the Demon Race's territory, waves of laughter and cheering were everywhere seeing me off on my departure."
"Truth be told, it's understandable. After all, an Immortal visiting the realms of the Demon Race is equivalent to receiving a blessing from the heavens."
"Now you know, right? For me to reside in your Spiritual Space is such a great blessing. Apart from anything else, the ancient secrets alone that I casually mention here are something that anyone else couldn't possibly know."
"Fairy, have you mentioned a single useful ancient secret?"
Lu Yang felt that he's not blessed to receive this kind of blessing. It would be better to have someone else with high luck to bear it instead
Eldest Senior Sister seems to be a great choice.
Back in reality, Lu Yang sighed deeply: "Poor Man Gu."
Meng Jingzhou was taken by surprise: "What happened to Man Gu?"
How did Man Gu became pitiable while the two of them were suffering in the dense forest?
"Nothing, let's continue discussing what to do next."

chapters.title: Chapter 240 - 239: What Are You Pretending To Be?_1
chapters.content:
"Two bottles of the insect repellent, and give us the most expensive one."
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou visited the Demon Suppressing Pass branch of the Land Money Trade Association to purchase the necessary supplies.
Demon Suppressing Pass is a notable city on the border, with a large amount of goods related to demon beasts sold every day, transported to all parts of the Central Continent. It caters to the needs of people at different realms, resulting in an astonishing amount of spirit stones changing hands.
The insect repellent is a specialty product of the area, specifically made to combat the incessant swarms of insects in the dense forest. When applied to the skin, it gives off a special scent only detectable to insects, keeping them far from the cultivators.
With this solution, there would be no worries about leeches crawling on your body.
"Do you have a large inventory of insect repellent?" Meng Jingzhou suddenly had a query.
The attendant was momentarily taken aback, unsure of what Meng Jingzhou meant, and politely asked, "May I ask, sir, how much insect repellent would you like?"
"Approximately enough to ward off all mosquitoes from the dense forest."
Despite the impeccable training the attendant had received, the corners of his mouth couldn't help but twitch, "I'm afraid, sir, the quantity you're asking for is so substantial that even emptying our main warehouse wouldn't suffice."
Everyone else applies the repellent to their bodies, yet you, sir, plan to sprinkle it throughout the entire forest which would require an astronomical amount.
Meng Jingzhou curled his lips, slightly dissatisfied with the trade association's slogan "any customer needs can be met as long as they have the money." Dismissing it, he said, "Look, it doesn't matter. If it's not available, it's not available."
The dense forest's harsh environment even hosts mosquitoes with Qi Refinement Level strength. It's practically impossible for any Qi Refinement cultivators to emerge from the forest alive.
However, if one could survive the forest during their Qi Refinement stage, they would surely achieve great things in the future.
In fact, many noteworthy Great Cultivators throughout history have chosen to train in the forest during their Qi Refinement period, honing their skills and creating a solid foundation for their subsequent long-term body conditioning due to inner dampness.
"Two bottles of the dampness removal elixir, and we want the most effective one."
"Add some detoxification pills."
"I've heard that some demon beasts carry spring poison. Can I have a couple of spring-poison curing…No, I'm not here to inquire about a brothel. I'm asking for a couple bottles of elixir for spring poison."
"The quality of your poison is… really not up to scratch. Fortunately, I came prepared. Here's a list of herbs with their quantities and weights. We'll use this to concoct our own brew."
Lu Yang was concerned about the quality of poison offered by the Land Money Trade Association. He found it inferior compared to any random poison produced by their Seek Dao Sect.
"Would you like the latest edition of 'Forest Manual'? It records the majority of the demon beasts that appear in the forest, along with the potential dangers you may encounter there."
"Good stuff, we'll take one."
"Would you require a tent? It might come in handy if you need to camp outdoors. Tents are hot-selling items in our association. Moreover, it comes with a complimentary bottle of Golden-Core-stage demon beast urine. Sprinkling it around your tent while you sleep effectively repels low-level demon beasts."
"But it might attract higher-level demon beasts instead. Unsafe. We don't want it."
"A directional teleportation talisman? What's it used for?" Lu Yang noticed an expensive talisman, surprised by the steep price.
In comparison, the Ten Bulls Strength Pill was quite cheap.
"What keen eyes you have, sir. This sure is a lifesaver. If you encounter a life-threatening crisis in the dense forest, activate this talisman and it will teleport you back to the Demon Suppressing Pass immediately. Even if a Nascent Soul stage demon makes a move, it cannot interrupt the teleportation process!"
"Sounds good, we'll take five!" Meng Jingzhou, a big spender, liked to buy whatever he needed without fussing about the price.
The server's face lit up with joy and his attitude became even more enthusiastic. The commission from just five directional teleportation talismans was enough to cover his salary for a month.
These two customers were undoubtedly wealthy patrons. It seemed that he would earn a fair amount of commission today.
These two young masters suddenly appeared out of nowhere. They must be from some influential family or sect's disciples preparing for trials here. This was clearly their first visit.
With this thought in mind, the server kindly reminded them, "Gentlemen, the frontier isn't like your territories. It's wise to keep a low profile when it comes to wealth. Not only are the demon beasts dangerous, but people can also pose a threat. Every day, people disappear in the dense forest, especially recently with the rising number of disappearances.
Although it's attributed to demon beasts, we all know it's not necessarily their doing."
He estimated that these two customers would stay and experience life here for a while, which might lead to further encounters. Naturally, it was essential to win the favor of such prominent customers.
"Although the County Lord has laid down a 'rule' that 'no one is allowed to steal, plunder, or rob' within the city, this rule only applies to Demon Suppressing Pass. Once you leave and enter the dense forest, the concept of rules no longer hold any significance."
This is the benefit of having a Unification-stage cultivator. They can set rules that everyone must abide by in their town to maintain order to the utmost extent.
If not for the scarcity of individuals at the Unification stage, the Great Xia Dynasty would have loved to have them in every city.
"Please, both of you, step into the VIP room."
The attendant bent slightly, gesturing with a "please" pose, only to be declined by Lu Yang.
"No need, we, the mid-stage Foundation Establishment brothers, who'd dare to rob us in these peaceful times?"
Sensing their reluctance, the attendant decided not to insist, and continued to serve them instead.
"What kinds of healing elixirs do you have?"
"Gold Creation Pill, consume one and your injuries can rapidly heal, Hemostatic Pill, if severe bleeding occurs, this pill will quickly stop the bleeding, Qi Recovery Pill, it can greatly speed up the recovery of spiritual essence. From the Buddha Country's Merit-creating series, the White Bone Pill can regenerate flesh on white bones…"
"Two bottles of each."
"Do you have protective magic artifacts? Two of each kind."
After they finished their shopping and checked their items, they found nothing missing: "Settle the bill."
"As VIPs of our Trade Association, you will enjoy a 10% discount on all future purchases."
Meng Jingzhou didn't say much, he simply took out a black token that had the character "Meng" on it.
Upon seeing this token, the attendant's pupils contracted sharply, his hands trembling.
The first lesson he received during his work training was to recognize the special tokens of the Association, each symbolizing different statuses, like royal families, like the Meng Family, all of whom deserve the utmost respect and must not be offended.
Having worked here for over a decade, he had seen members of the Meng Family, but those were from collateral branches. The token with just the "Meng" character meant its bearer was a direct descendant of the Meng family, eligible to hold some power in the future.
Massive background, absolutely massive background.
He laughably offered a 10% discount, a trifling amount the likes of which would probably be scoffed at by them.
"Keep it quiet." Meng Jingzhou said in a mild tone, the joy, however, was blooming in his heart.
Right, right, right, that's the expression he wanted.
Lu Yang looked askance at Meng Jingzhou, and frowned in disdain.
What's the big deal?
The Seek Dao Sect also had such tokens, but they were only eligible for use by the Eldest Senior Sister and Elders.
The attendant took the Token, verified its authenticity, the bill was settled quickly and he topped it off with a pile of complimentary gifts.
"Do both of you have a Storage Ring? I can pack these things right into it."
Lu Yang casually produced the Seek Dao Sect's Identity Jade, where "Lu Yang" was written.
Upon seeing the Identity Jade, the attendant felt another pang in his heart.
Disciples of the Seek Dao Sect, an identity that holds great influence in the Cultivation World.
He had suspected that the two of them were from prominent families or Sects, but never imagined they would be this powerful.
"Keep it quiet." said Lu Yang, his voice calm, but delight was blossoming in his heart.
It's finally my turn now.
Meng Jingzhou looked at Lu Yang askance. What's the big deal?
The two took their purchases and headed towards the forest.
However, what the two didn't notice was that as soon as they left the Trade Association, five shadowy figures began to secretly follow them. Their eyes were fierce, clearly not well-intentioned.

chapters.title: Chapter 241 - 241: 240
chapters.content:
"Did you see how they were buying things at the guild earlier? They didn't even ask about prices, just bought straight away."
Five figures in black robes, their voices hoarse and indistinguishable by gender or age, moved through the dense forest, agile and undetected by Lu Yang or Meng Jingzhou.
"Their complexions are clearly different, and their attire doesn't seem local. They appear like disciples from a particular sect or influential family, trying to gain worldly experience."
Another person sneered, like a snake hidden in the shadows: "To gain worldly experience, they should be shown the cruel reality."
"Did you hear what that pretty boy said earlier? They claim to have a mid-stage Foundation Establishment Cultivation Level. Considering their status, they could contend with those in the late stage."
"So what if they are in the late stage of foundation establishment? All five of us are experienced at this level. No way are we going to be defeated by these two novices."
"Still, caution is always best."
"Do you remember that group of sect disciples we encountered last time? After one successful job, we rested for three months. After this one, we can take another three months off!"
"Not just that, I feel they have more Spirit Stones than we could imagine. They are truly a fat sheep."
"It must be around here, hardly anyone comes to this place."
"Attack!"
Following the order of the leader, the five figures scattered, swiftly encircling the two men.
Their predetermined positions ensured that neither Lu Yang nor Meng Jingzhou could escape in any direction.
Their adept movements clearly indicate their specialization in such maneuvers, which they must've executed countless times.
"Halt!" The leader raised his voice, resonating with a sound wave magic skill capable of shocking one's spirit.
"Who are you?!" Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were obviously terrified. They stood ready in defense, but their gaze revealed their well-hidden fear.
"Newbies, indeed. Wondering aimlessly in the woods without recognizing the name of the Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain." The leading figure lifted his hood, revealing a gaunt face with a hawk-like nose, his eyes cold.
As they spoke, the five released a late-stage Foundation Establishment aura, indicating the futility of any resistance.
"Quite naïve, aren't you? Unable to recognize the nature of our profession, despite the teachings of your prestigious families or sects." Removed his hood, another man joined, his voice terrifying and gloomy, revealing a missing eye.
"Five of us encircled you in the dense forest. What else could it be?"
"Don't tell me you're unaware of your excessive spending at the guild earlier? Quite impressive wealth indeed, you two."
"Tell us, how many Spirit Stones do you have? If the price is right, we could negotiate."
"If you don't have enough Spirit Stones, then prepare to witness the ruthless side of the Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain!" By the end, the voice turned unusually cold, hinting at their latent brutality.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou looked at each other and laughed helplessly, both men shrugging.
Who would've thought that the first enemy they would encounter in the dense forest would be humans, not Demon Beasts.
"Strike! Show them our strength!"
At the command of their leader, the five attacked simultaneously. Their strategy coordinated perfectly, unmatched at the Foundation Establishment Stage, and they were about to capture Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
To their surprise, both of men struck back simultaneously with shocking speed.
"Draw the Ground into a Prison!"
"Draw the Ground into a Prison!"
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou swiftly drew circles, casting the similar magic skill. An invisible barrier around the five appeared, cutting off their escape and dragging them into a prison.
"What kind of power is this!"
"Is this the legendary Draw the Ground into a Prison?"
"Wait, no, we're in a prison, it's a spatial magic!"
"It must be related to the art of drawing, it must be!"
The five began to chatter amongst themselves. Trapped within the prison and the invisible barrier, they were utterly thrown off by the sudden change of events.
"You dare robbery when the Rudder Master himself is present, are you tired of living?" scoffed Meng Jingzhou.
"Robbing the founder of our sect, bold indeed!" jeered Lu Yang.
Meng Jingzhou turned his hipp, "Since when did you promote yourself to founder?!"
Isn't the Eternity Sect going bankrupt due to poor management and bad company? How could someone still get a promotion?
"Who said anything about promoting myself? This was approved by the Immortal." Lu Yang manfully replied.
Meng Jingzhou understood as soon as he remembered that there was an Immortal residing inside Lu Yang.
He couldn't help but envy Lu Yang. Having an Immortal spirit in his body meant that he could seek advice and guidance from the Immortal at any time. What a great opportunity it was!
"Tell me, how many times have you done such robberies? Ever killed anyone?"
"Why waste time talking? They obviously killed before. Just look at them - do they look like they have never taken a life?"
"Just tie them up and hand them over to the government office. Whether to kill them or imprison them, let the authorities decide."
"Wait, wait, wait, young heroes, we seem to have some misunderstandings!" The hawk-nosed Big Brother hurriedly said, "I cannot control how I look, and we are not here for a robbery."
Meng Jingzhou didn't have the slightest belief in the hawk-nosed Big Brother's words, "What misunderstanding? You've been following us since we left the guild, specially hiding outside the scope of our Spiritual Sense, following us to this god-forsaken place, and even encircling us! Isn't this robbery?"
Lu Yang chimed in too, "And about showing us the cruel reality of the world. You mentioned that last time you had faced sect disciples, and about resting for three months after one successful job."
The five were shocked. They had been exposed from the start and didn't realize Lu Yang's Spiritual Sense could cover such an extensive range.
Who nurtured these young kids? They are so sharp-eyed!
What they didn't know was that Lu Yang's Spiritual Sense had long since achieved the equivalent of the Golden Core Stage. He had heard every word of their conversation.
"We are not robbers, really! We are bodyguards, bodyguards!"
"What are you talking about?" Both Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were taken aback.
"We noticed how you two were spending money in the guild without asking about prices. We figured you were members of a wealthy family or sect, gaining life experiences, and might face losses due to unfamiliarity with the place. So we wanted to offer our services as bodyguards!"
"Then what did you guys mean when you said we should see the cruel reality of the world?"
The hawk-nosed Big Brother stuttered, "Since you both seemed wealthy, we thought of charging a bit higher fees. If we earned enough, we could take a few months off after this task."
"And why were you asking us about the number of our Spirit Stones?"
"So that we could set our fees."
"What was that about not speaking kindly if we don't have enough Spirit Stones?"
"If you do not have enough Spirit Stones, we would not warn you about the territory of a Half-Step Golden Core Demon Beast, which your path lies ahead."
"What about when you said, 'Attack'?"
"Seeing how you both shrugged, we thought you were refusing our services as bodyguards. So we planned to lure out the Half Step Golden Core Demon Beast ahead and demonstrate our strength."
A quiet mutter from the side added, "Though looking at both of you, you probably don't need our bodyguard services."
"Then why did you insist on discussing this 'bodyguard' matter in the dense forest?"
"No taxes."
Lu Yang, "..."
So they thought the dense forest was a tax-free zone?

chapters.title: Chapter 242 - 241 Arhat Fist_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had heard that Demon Suppressing Pass was notorious for robberies, with people often getting ambushed in the dense forest after shopping at the merchant's association.
They initially planned to feign a lower cultivation level to lure the bandits.
But instead of attracting bandits, they drew a group of bodyguards from the local area.
"Among bodyguards at the Foundation Establishment Stage, we received the most positive reviews. Our rates are reasonable, our service is thoughtful, and we've established ongoing partnerships with several Half Step Golden Core Stage demon beasts. This greatly facilitates our information gathering and safety measures in the dense forest."
"If your influential families or sects have tasked you with training missions, we also offer three tailored plans to choose from without extra cost."
The hawk-nosed Big Brother was still enthusiastically marketing their bodyguard services.
"How many spirit stones would it cost to hire you?" Meng Jingzhou asked with interest. They needed to gain as much information about the dense forest as possible, and these local snakes would have a lot of information.
No need for bodyguards, but they can serve as tour guides.
The hawk-nosed Big Brother noticed that the two had extraordinary appearances and didn't seem like ordinary folks. He assumed they were influential figures and held up five fingers.
"Five hundred thousand spirit stones? That's not expensive."
The hawk-nosed Big Brother jumped in shock. He meant to say fifty thousand spirit stones and had planned to negotiate down if they thought it was too expensive.
Unexpectedly, this young master raised the price tenfold without even batting an eye.
Meng Jingzhou pulled out two hundred thousand spirit stones, piling them into a small mountain: "I'll give two hundred thousand first. The rest will be settled after the job is done. If I'm satisfied with your service, I'll increase the payment."
"Please take a closer look. Our service is definitely worth the price!" The sight of so many spirit stones had the five men's eyes shining.
They had never encountered such a generous patron before.
"Strange, has anyone else noticed it's getting stuffier and hotter here?" Meng Jingzhou fanned his chest with his shirt, feeling the heat.
"I've felt it too." Lu Yang was also puzzled.
The hawk-nosed Big Brother muttered: "Could it be that there's not enough air in the dungeon because of us seven people?"
The dungeon was underground, it was airtight. With seven people talking, they were quickly running out of oxygen.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou released their spell bindings, and the seven of them returned to the surface.
"Old Turtle, come out, we've settled the terms." The hawk-nosed Big Brother called out.
An Old Turtle the size of a millstone slowly crawled over from not far away, emitting a power that was uncommon for the Foundation Establishment Stage.
Lu Yang guessed that when the Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain mentioned 'hand-to-hand combat with a Half Step Golden Core Stage,' they were referring to this Old Turtle.
You guys have a complete cast, even including a demon beast.
"This is Old Turtle. The lake up ahead is where it claims one-fifth as its territory." The hawk-nosed Big Brother introduced.
The Old Turtle, shaking its head and wagging its tail, said, "Little Eagle, I've told you before that your approach is similar to robbery; it's easy to mislead people. I saw it from afar. These two young masters are geniuses capable of using Draw the Ground into a Prison. They wouldn't need you as bodyguards."
"Was that actually Draw the Ground into a Prison?" The five of them were greatly shocked. They had only made guesses before, not daring to assert their suspicions. The ability could simply be a protective measure from their sects.
After all, the magic skill to Draw the Ground into a Prison was not only a phenomenon in legends; its cultivation difficulty was outrageously high. For someone in the Foundation Establishment Stage to master it was almost impossible.
"Old Turtle has keen eyes. What I used was indeed Draw the Ground into a Prison." Lu Yang quickly admitted, causing Meng Jingzhou to roll his eyes.
"Young masters, might I ask why you entered the dense forest?"
"To challenge demon beasts. We've heard that this place is rampant with demon beasts, including many ancient breeds with incredible strength. We hope to fight these demon beasts and hone ourselves."
The hawk-nosed Big Brother nodded; this was indeed a common reason.
"Might I ask what level of demon beast the two young masters wish to challenge? Is it at the beginning of the late Foundation Establishment Stage or an experienced late Foundation Establishment Stage?"
"Golden Core Stage."
"Golden Core Stage?!" Including the Old Turtle, all five men and one beast shouted in surprise.
"Don't exaggerate, young masters. The gap between the Foundation Establishment Stage and the Golden Core Stage is as vast as a chasm, and it can't be easily crossed. Moreover, both people and demon beasts who have been living in the dense forest for a long time are ruthless fighters; they are not to be underestimated!" Old Turtle advised.
It also knew that these two were big patrons, and good protection wouldn't lack spirit stones.
"Don't even mention the Golden Core Stage. Maybe you can't even defeat me!" The Old Turtle declared calmly. It had been in the Half Step Golden Core Stage for a long time, highly experienced, and its defense was astonishing—so strong that even the Tiger Demon that had absorbed a Ghoul couldn't break it.
"Let's give it a try then." Meng Jingzhou smiled and began to stretch.
Without showing their true strength, these people wouldn't find them a strong Golden Core Stage demon beast to fight, which wouldn't serve as good practice.
The group came to the edge of the little lake, with Old Turtle and Meng Jingzhou standing at opposite ends.
"Begin!" Lu Yang announced the start.
Old Turtle took a deep breath, stirring the inherent cultivation method in its bloodline. A golden imprint vaguely appeared on its tortoise shell, indicating it was the descendant of the ancient Heaven-Climbing Turtle, which was renowned for its defense. It was fortunate to inherit this characteristic from its ancestor.
"If you can't even break my defense, don't even think about..."
"Arhat Fist!"
Meng Jingzhou took a big step forward, with his legs in the shape of a bow and his upper body like an arrow fletching.
With his body taut, he suddenly exerted force, striking the tortoise shell. The golden imprint dispersed and Old Turtle was flung far away.
Like a skipped stone, it bounced several times across the surface of the lake before plunging in.
The Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain watched the scene with their mouths agape.
The Old Turtle was known for its defense. Even combined, they couldn't break its defense. Yet, Meng Jingzhou flipped it over with a single punch?
Four other Half Step Golden Core Stage demon beasts, which also dominated the lake with Old Turtle, watched Old Turtle get tossed away and were greatly shocked.
"Arhat Fist? I've never seen you use it before. Did you learn it recently?" Lu Yang was curious.
"Master said that some of the inspirations for his Shocking Heaven Six Forms came from the Arhat Fist. He wanted me to learn the Arhat Fist as well, saying it would be helpful for cultivating the Shocking Heaven Six Forms."
"I heard that when you reach the ultimate realm of Arhat Fist, you can attain the Fruit of Arhat. You might be able to do it." Lu Yang joked.
"Forget it, even the Fruit of Arhat? You might as well ask me to become a monk."
