"You're not that different from a monk now."
"Buzz off. I'm still thinking about breaking my chastity after attaining immortality. Freedom."
Breaking his state of purity would mean a significant decrease in cultivation speed, but becoming immortal would mean reaching the peak of cultivation and cultivation speed would no longer matter.
"Arhat Fist..." Fairy Eternity, who had been silent for a while, seemed to recall something when she heard the key words.
"Fairy, do you know Arhat Fist too?" Lu Yang actually wanted to learn new boxing techniques, the only one he knew now was Imitation Fist.
Fairy Eternity showed a dismissive expression: "Arhat Fist? What's that? I've never heard of it. I know a higher-level boxing technique. Learn it, and it points directly to the Fruit of Arhat. Do you want to learn?"
"What kind of boxing technique?"
"Arhat Fruit Fist."
Lu Yang: "... Does it have the effect of clearing heat, moisturizing lungs, benefiting the throat, and improving voice?"
"How did you know?" Fairy Eternity was very surprised. Could it be that Lu Yang had practiced it before?

chapters.title: Chapter 243 - 242: Lu Yang, I Want to Go Out and Play_1
chapters.content:
Arhat Fist, one of the supreme martial arts of the Golden Buddha Kingdom, could theoretically reach the state of Arhat by practicing to the extreme. However, Lu Yang had never heard of anyone being able to practice this martial art.
The Arhat Fruit Fist, a martial art created by the immortals, was very close to the state of Arhat judging by its name, differing only by a single character. The effect of practicing it was to cool and moisten the lungs, benefit the throat, and improve one's voice.
If we consider the origins of the martial arts, Arhat Fruit Fist was undoubtedly superior.
However, the problem was that Fairy Eternity created it.
"No need to practice, I can guess what this martial art is for just from its name."
"Hey, hey, hey, what's with that look? The Arhat Fruit Fist was created by this immortal. It's a dignified Immortal-class martial art. That Arhat Fist doesn't even qualify to be compared with my martial art!" Fairy Eternity stamped her foot, feeling that Lu Yang was belittling her.
"It's not that I'm belittling you, it's just that the name of your martial art is unspeakable. It doesn't sound powerful at all."
"What do you know, do you think you learn martial arts just to show off, fight and battle others? No, the most important element of martial arts is health preservation."
Fairy Eternity lectured Lu Yang, correcting his misconceptions: "Isn't cultivation about living better? And what's the most important thing about living? It's the body."
"For this reason, I specifically created the Health Preservation Boxing, with over a thousand variations including the Arhat Fruit Fist that cools and moistens lungs and benefits the throat, the Little Fennel Fist that dissipates cold and relieves pain, regulates the qi, and harmonizes the stomach."
"If you take good care of your body, why wouldn't you become an Arhat?"
"If you can master these thousands of boxing techniques and further integrate them, then you'll learn this Immortal's supreme martial art — the Fairy Fist!"
The Fairy Fist, is the martial art that Fairy Eternity used to beat Immortal Eternity to a pulp. Its power is astounding, sending Immortal Eternity scurrying away in a highly disgraceful manner.
"How about it, want to learn?" Fairy Eternity felt it was the right time to impress Lu Yang, so he would stop presuming that she had scammed her way to being an immortal.
As one of the Five Immortals of the Ancients, how could she be a fraud?
"I don't want to learn at all." Lu Yang refused outright.
Meanwhile, in reality, Old Turtle crawled out of the lake, his head still spinning.
If just one punch possessed such power, if they were to fight seriously, probably not many could withstand their attacks even among those at the Golden Core Stage.
Although the other person hasn't taken action, his combat prowess seems to be on par with this youngster named Meng.
Which power produced such a prodigy?
With this thought, Old Turtle stopped obstructing and agreed to help the two find opponents.
The Old Turtle broke off a tree branch and began to sketch a map in the soft mud. He first drew an irregular oval.
"This is our current location, by the small lake. If you go south for 10 miles from here, there's a black leopard with a white spot on its forehead. It's incredibly fierce and possesses the bloodline of the ancients. Even though its realm is at the early phase of the Golden Core Stage, it can give a mid-stage cultivator a run for his money."
"If you head further south from the black leopard, there's a pack of Moon Shadow Wolves. The wolves generally are in the late stages of the Foundation Establishment Stage, and the Wolf King is at the peak of the early Golden Core Stage. They never act alone. Meeting one Moon Shadow Wolf implies that a large pack is hidden nearby. You must be very careful."
"To the east, there is..."
"To the west, there is..."
As one of the five rulers of the lake, Old Turtle was surprisingly knowledgeable.
"The Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain know the exact locations. They can take you there." Old Turtle still needed to guard the small lake, otherwise, he would be worried that his territory would be completely partitioned by the other four half-step Golden Core Stage creatures within ten days to half a month.
Having a small lake as a territory in the dense forest was quite hard-earned.
"The demon beasts with fixed territories are not difficult to deal with since we know their foundations. What you need to be particularly careful of are the demon beasts that roam the dense forest without a fixed location. These demon beasts are very cunning. They can transform into humans, and they love to ambush and hunt your human race.
I have seen no less than 50 people die under these demon beasts' fangs."
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou thanked Old Turtle and set off with the Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain to the black leopard's territory.
"Lu Yang, Lu Yang, can we discuss something?" Fairy Eternity unusually was ingratiating.
"What is it?"
"How many days are you planning to stay in the dense forest?"
"At least five days, I guess." Lu Yang calculated, fighting various demon beasts, as well as night battles, wouldn't show off the effect of training if the time was too short.
His and Meng Jingzhou's plan was to continuously fight in the dense forest to gain fighting experience and consolidate their cultivation levels. If they could find an opportunity to form a golden core here, that would be even better.
Fairy Eternity counted with her fingers to Lu Yang: "Look, I spend my days in the spiritual space doing nothing but eating and sleeping, and watching you two fight when I'm bored. It's quite boring."
"They say the meaning of life lies in movement. I feel like I should get out and move around, shouldn't I?"
"So Fairy, you want to…"
"Can you create a Bodhi tree clone for me to use?" Fairy Eternity smiled ingratiatingly.
"Of course, if you really don't want to let me use it, I can't help it, but it would be great if you could make a clone for me!"
Seeing Fairy Eternity indecisive yet looking very expectant, Lu Yang couldn't help but laugh.
"What are you laughing at!"
"Nothing, nothing." Lu Yang tried hard to make a very serious face.
"I can create a Bodhi tree clone for you, but you have to be on your best behavior in the dense forest and not cause a big mess. Also, you must return before Meng Jingzhou and I return to the city."
"Definitely no problem!" Fairy Eternity promised earnestly, "I have a broad range of divine sense and can find you at any time."
"That's good."
Back in reality, Lu Yang halted.
"What's wrong?" Meng Jingzhou and the Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain were confused. They thought Lu Yang had sensed some danger.
"Nothing much, I just want to use a clone to wander around other parts of the dense forest."
"A clone?" The Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain looked at each other, only Meng Jingzhou understood something.
Lu Yang held the Bodhi seed, used Earth Escape to retract into the soil, and then used the "Tree Planting Sutra". The Bodhi tree rose from the ground and grew two Lu Yangs.
The two Lu Yangs simultaneously broke free from the Bodhi tree's restriction. The original stayed in place, while Fairy Eternity took control of the clone. As soon as she hit the ground, she took off running. She disappeared as soon as she landed, much like the ginseng fruit in legends.
The Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain watched this scene, their eyes nearly popping out. They hadn't closed their gaping mouths for a long time.
"A... clone?!"
Whether it was during the Foundation Establishment Stage or even the Golden Core Stage, neither of them had heard of anyone who could perform such skill.
"These are just trivial magic skills that aren't worth mentioning." Lu Yang put on a humble expression on purpose, causing the Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain to admire him to the extreme.
"Young Hero Lu, can you control your clone?"
Lu Yang waved his hands: "No need to control, the clone can move on its own."
"Then your clone needs to be careful. I heard that some cultivators like to ambush solitary cultivators. Quite a few people have gone missing."
"There... there shouldn't be any encounters, right?" Thinking of Fairy Eternity's carefree face, Lu Yang felt a bit uneasy.

chapters.title: Chapter 244 - 243: The Adventure of Fairy Eternity (Extra Update, Asking for Monthly Votes)_1
chapters.content:
"Picking and picking mushrooms, found a little mushroom..."
An ancient rhyme echoed in the dense forest. It was soft and pleasing to the ear, light-hearted, suggesting the owner of the singing voice was a lively girl.
However, if anyone were to see the actual person behind the singing voice, they would be quite startled.
The singer was a bald man with dignified features, cloaked in clothes made of leaves. It was hard to imagine such a person singing a nursery rhyme.
Fairy Eternity crouched by the lake, assessing her physical appearance, her eyes turning subtly.
"Although Lu Yang looks rather nice, he is a man after all. Since Lu Yang is not here, why don't I change to my original form?"
Thinking of it, Fairy Eternity did it. It was not easy to come out and play and there was no one around to restrict her. She could do as she pleased.
Her hands joined together, held vertically at her lips, lightly uttering a phrase. It resonated with the surrounding area, causing the space around her to blur and distort.
When the space returned to normal, the person crouching by the lake was no longer the bald-headed Lu Yang, rather, a 16-17-year-old young woman.
The young woman was innocent and exuberant. Her big eyes sparkled, her long hair fell to her waist, wearing a beige dress. Barefooted, she seemed like the young lady of a wealthy household, who had sneakily run away without dressing properly.
"Hehe, I am really adorable." Fairy Eternity looked at her reflection in the lake, amused by her transformation back to her original form.
She sat by the lake, her bare feet kicking in the water, creating ripples.
Small fish were attracted by the ripples on the lake's surface, thinking food had appeared. When they swam closer, they found it was a human playing in the water and swam away disappointed.
Although Fairy Eternity could materialize anything in Lu Yang's spiritual space, it was, after all, a mind-made construct that lacked real sensations. Now, even splashing water felt more enjoyable.
The lake water was cold; having her bare feet soaked in was so refreshing that it made her grin with delight.
She picked up a twig from the lakeside, using her fairy magic power as a fishing line, winding it around the twig to make a basic fishing rod.
"Ahem."
She didn't even bother baiting, she directly cast her line, a complete image of doing as she pleased.
The fairy power making up the fishing line was just a thin thread. Still, it was the power unique to immortals. The line itself was the best bait, not needing any others.
With a sly smile on her face, Fairy Eternity laid down by the lake. Someone knew she had activated a spell to keep her pristine. Despite the mud by the lake, not a single speck of dirt touched her.
If Lu Yang was here, he would have recognized that it was the Cleaning Clothes Spell he aspired for; except, Fairy Eternity's version was more refined and distinguished, in another level. Drawing on this spell exercised almost no energy expenditure.
Before long, a big fish was hooked, tightly biting on to the fishing line.
The big fish wanted to refine the fairy power on the line, but the gap in power was too great; it was unable to do so.
"Got a bite?"
Fairy Eternity sprang up with excitement in her eyes. With a strong flick of her right hand, a fat-headed fish popped out of the water.
"Oh dear, it's a fat-headed fish. It's neither pretty nor tasty and has no nutritional value." Fairy Eternity shook her head in disappointment, patted the fish's face, signaling it to let go, and threw it back into the lake.
"Reborn into a tasty animal in your next life." Fairy Eternity reminded the fat-headed fish. Having been spared once, the fish needed to show some gratitude.
The fish wasn't able to comprehend what she was saying.
After the fat-headed fish left, various aquatic creatures bit the bait — fish, shrimp, crabs, shells, along with many other creatures who only existed after ancient times unbeknownst to Fairy Eternity.
Not recognizing some wasn't an issue, with her rich experiences and culinary skills, she could tell what was edible and what wasn't with one try.
Soon, a pile of aquatic creatures accumulated beside the fairy. She was worried that they might escape, so she mixed lake water with mud to make a clay fence around them.
Suddenly, a dark shadow burst from the lake's surface, covered in spikes; it was like a porcupine, although its spines were much shorter.
This lake was many times larger than the one controlled by Old Turtle, and correspondingly, the one who could control this lake had to possess extraordinary power.
The shadow was the master of the lake, with the cultivation level at the late stage of the Golden Core. It had swallowed countless Humans and members of the Demon Race when they drank from the lake.
When it saw Fairy Eternity, it was overwhelmed by hunger. Even though she seemed to be a just a little girl at the late stage of Foundation Establishment, for some reason, it believed that by eating her, it could immediately break its core to reach Nascent, becoming a Demon Beast in the Nascent Soul Stage.
By that time, it would be able to expand its territory further and become stronger.
Lu Yang was at the late stage of Foundation Establishment, and the Clone of the Bodhi Tree could inherit 80% of his strength. In other words, Fairy Eternity's current Realm was also at the late stage of Foundation Establishment.
Fairy Eternity blinked, and was swallowed by the lake's master.
The master of the lake was not worried that Fairy Eternity would attack it from inside. It possessed a strong corrosive liquid. Anyone swallowed by it would have the power of their attacks eroded by this liquid, posing no threat to it.
"Diving Spell... Never mind, Little Fennel Fist."
Her soft fists hit the stomach wall, making the master of the lake feel like there was a storm raging within it, or even worse. It felt like a tremendous force was stirring its body.
"Wait, let me..."
Before the lake master could finish begging, the force from the Little Fennel Fist tore the lake master into several pieces.
Fairy Eternity held a piece of the lake master's flesh and swam back to the surface of the lake.
Initially, she planned to use the Diving Spell to deal with the lake master. However, she thought that the lake master was a creature she had never seen before and she didn't know how it tasted. If she used the Diving Spell to dry out the lake master, how could she eat it?
So, she changed her mind at the last minute and used the Little Fennel Fist.
The Little Fennel Fist, which regulated Qi and stomach, could nourish the opponent's body when hitting it. However, if the opponent's body was healthy, this Little Fennel Fist would turn into a death curse.
"I'm all wet, so uncomfortable. Diving Spell."
As the words "Diving Spell" fell, the water on and around her quickly receded, and an invisible force lifted her up.
She stood on the lake's surface, her hands behind her back, holding a piece of the lake master's flesh. Humming a tune, she went back to the shore with ease and satisfaction.
"I wonder what the lake master tastes like."
The intuition of the Immortal Cook told her that the taste of the lake master should be good.
"I don't have a pan."
Fairy Eternity scratched her head, there was not even any decent cookware nearby.
But then she saw the lotus leaves on the lake surface and her eyes lit up, "I've got it! I can wrap it in lotus leaves, cover it in mud on the outside, roast it over a fire, and then it's ready to eat!"
She didn't bring any seasoning, so she improvised, using plants that looked like seasonings round lake as real seasonings.
"Eternity Truefire." She spit out a flame, which was unknown to the world and existed independently of the one hundred and eight kinds of True Fire.
The Eternity Truefire was gentle, baking the food. The food was heated from the inside out and quickly exuded a fresh aroma.
Just as Fairy Eternity was about to start eating, a gentle voice sounded behind her.
"Little girl, why are you here all by yourself? This place is dangerous."
Fairy Eternity turned her head, her face filled with confusion and innocence, with a few mud spots on her cheeks from making the Beggar's Fish.
There were four people standing behind her, all at the Golden Core Stage of cultivation. It could be a figment of her imagination, but Fairy Eternity felt they grinned maliciously before their smiles turned into friendly ones.
"Little girl, where are your family members?"
(For the alliance leader, Dad DaChuan, a bonus chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 245 - 244 This Meal is Poisonous..._1
chapters.content:
"Who are you?" Fairy Eternity looked warily at the four, each of their Cultivation Levels higher than hers - all at the Golden Core Stage.
The smile on Lv Chang's face broadened.
The four of them often traversed the dense forest, seemingly fighting Demon Beasts and collecting heavenly treasures like everyone else. However, their true forms were Demon Beasts, secretly killing and looting to steal Storage Rings, which they exchanged for high profits with the humans benefiting from their ill-gotten gains.
They had initially planned to negotiate their next steps with the lake owner, but instead, they stumbled upon a young girl here.
Her Cultivation Level was at the late stage of Foundation Establishment, with an innocent and adorable appearance and disheveled clothes. She was probably some influential family's young miss who had lost her way while training.
This was a common occurrence given the vast forests. After all, the highest possible Realm could not just be the Golden Core Stage.
According to their knowledge, there was an Elephant Tribe Demon in the vicinity, its Cultivation Level at the Nascent Soul Stage, and its strength was terrifying.
Lv Chang had limited exposure and couldn't recognize what Fairy Eternity was wearing, but he was certain that the material was definitely of high value.
A young miss from an influential family training outside was sure to have many valuable items. Even if the family came to investigate, they wouldn't fear - this was a dense forest where life and death were determined by fate. Who could assure that nothing unexpected would happen during training?
At the worst, they could just shift the blame onto the humans themselves - after all, humans often did such deeds anyway.
Moreover, the naive little girl was cooking here; easy prey.
Having pondered all possible scenarios, ensuring there were no risks, Lv Chang finally emerged and warmly concerned himself with Fairy Eternity's background.
"We are cultivators who came to the lake to collect medicinal herbs and didn't expect to meet you here. This place is very dangerous, inhabited by Demon Beasts that are at the Golden Core Stage. Even we dare not linger here too long."
Remembering the Fish King she had casually punched to death just now, Fairy Eternity shook her head and denied, "Dangerous? Not at all."
"That's because you've yet to encounter any. Where are your elders? This place is very dangerous!"
"He went off to challenge a Golden Core Stage Demon Beast. I found it dull, so I ran out… Ah, no, he's not my elder!" Fairy Eternity instinctively followed Lv Chang's words but hastily corrected herself when she realized something was off.
Lu Yang was just a junior to her. She was the senior here.
After exchanging looks, Lv Chang and his comrades were sure this little girl had sneaked away.
"Fish King, are you here?" Lv Chang secretly communicated with the lake owner via his Spiritual Sense, enquiring about the little girl's situation and whether they should team up to rob and kill her.
"Not here?"
Lv Chang called out several times using his Spiritual Sense but did not receive a response from the Fish King.
Did it transform to walk on land and go to other places in search of prey?
If so, the lake owner was simply out of luck, leaving the unplanned fortune to only the four of them.
"Are you looking for the fish?" Fairy Eternity's words startled Lv Chang, how could an outsider sense his Spiritual Sense communication with the lake owner?
"Then let's eat. I've just finished cooking."
The Eternity Truefire turned the branches into ashes and used the remaining heat to warm the Beggar's Fish.
Fairy Eternity scraped off a large chunk of mud from the ashes, knocked off the outer layer of mud, tore open the middle layer of lotus leaves, and a sweet aroma diffused in the air causing Lv Chang and his comrades to take a deep breath.
Living in the wilderness for such a long time, they had never smelled such delicious food.
Was this the depth of a large clan? Even their wilderness food was different from theirs.
"Eat, this is the fish you were looking for." Fairy Eternity's words were seemingly disjointed.
As an Immortal Cook, she was also a chef. What a chef enjoyed the most was having her guests enjoy her food.
Therefore, Fairy Eternity generously shared the Beggar's Fish she had just cooked with the four of them.
The four of them observed the naive young girl and did not suspect that she could be capable of poisoning the fish. Moreover, the Beggar's Fish smelled truly delicious.
They decided to enjoy the meal before finishing off the young girl. They would act a bit more mercifully then.
All four of them found a large rock to sit around and enjoy their food together.
Lv Chang took out chopsticks from his Storage Ring and delicately picked up a piece, but the fish was so tender that it fell apart with just a little pressure. Left with no choice, he adjusted his strength and gently picked up another piece.
The fish melted in the mouth, and it felt like water, without any distinctive taste, it slipped down his throat effortlessly.
Fairy Eternity picked up two small branches from the lake to act as chopsticks.
She carefully picked up a piece of fish and ate it, savoring it with great relish.
"Hmm, delicious."
"That said, why do you Demon Beasts transform into humans?" Fairy Eternity suddenly asked, "Isn't a Demon Beast in its original form more agile in the dense forest?"
The four of them jumped to their feet, glaring down at Fairy Eternity.
"How do you know we are Demon Beasts?!"
"I figured it out quite some time ago."
"Then why didn't you react at all?"
"Why should I have reacted?"
Just as Lv Chang intended to compliment her courage, he felt as if the fish that had slid into his stomach had turned into fire. It was burning inside him, breaking all meridians, leaving him weak and beads of sweat appearing on his forehead.
Thud——
Lv Chang fell to the ground, clutching his stomach and writhing in pain. The other three collapsed too, looking incredulously at the harmless-looking Fairy Eternity.
The four of them revealed their real forms: Lv Chang was a fox, while the other three transformed into a hedgehog, a snake, and a lynx.
Fairy Eternity noticed that the toxicity of the fish meat was not small and that could even corrode Lu Yang's Wooden Avatar. If it continued like this, she would have returned to Lu Yang's side soon.
She stealthily circulated Eternity Dao Fruit, getting rid of the fish's poison.
"What kind of fish is this?! How did you poison it?!" Lv Chang's eyes widened as he tried to distract Fairy Eternity while secretly mobilizing his Cultivation Level to resist the poison.
She had seen through their disguise, pretended to be clueless and even invited them for a meal before poisoning them during the meal.
This girl was crafty!
"It's the Fish King you were looking for. It tried to eat me, but I ate it instead." Fairy Eternity replied innocently, "Weren't you looking for it? It was a bad Demon Beast. Don't look for it any more."
Fairy Eternity wrinkled her little nose, clearly displeased with Fish King's unreasonable behavior.
If this had been ancient times, no Demon Beast would dare to treat her like this. Their behavior was a great disrespect and they should have self-disciplined themselves.
"Isn't Fish King a pufferfish?!" Lv Chang was shocked. The Fish King was the master of this lake, a pufferfish, who was at the peak of Golden Core Stage and was intensely toxic!
More importantly, this young girl was merely at the late stage of Foundation Establishment. How could she possibly defeat Fish King?
"Attack! Kill her! She ate the fish and is fine, she must have the antidote!" Lv Chang and his comrades used their Cultivation Levels to temporarily suppress the pufferfish poison while launching a counterattack.
"And her Storage Ring, let's snatch it together!"
The four of them, all at Golden Core Stage, surrounded the girl at the Foundation Establishment Stage - Lv Chang did not believe this little girl could win, after all.
"So it turns out that you are all as bad as the big fish!" Fairy Eternity was dissatisfied with the attitudes of the four.
She was just planning to detoxify the four of them but had no idea they wanted to kill her instead.

chapters.title: Chapter 246 - 245: One Punch_1
chapters.content:
Fairy Eternity was startled and instinctively slapped down. This instinctive reaction was a legacy of ancient battles, and the way she fought now operated on pure inertia.
Just as Lv Chang was getting up, he felt as if a huge rock had smashed his head and he fell to the ground with a thud.
"You are bad folks, Arhat Fruit Fist." Fairy Eternity recalled some unpleasant memories when she heard they wanted to steal her storage ring and slapped one of them.
Her tender little hand hid massive force. Coupled with her special force application technique, the four early-stage Golden Core Stage Demon Beasts were knocked down once again to spit out black blood without being able to block her slap.
The Demon Beasts had stronger Qi and Blood than the Human race. Now that they had been slapped by Fairy Eternity, their boiling Qi and Blood rapidly cooled. Even the speed of their blood flow slowed down to eventually stop altogether. Their vitality turned into dead silence.
Arhat Fruit Fist, clearing heat and moistening lung.
Add to that the deadly poison of the pufferfish, and the four Demon Beasts breathed their last.
Less than an hour went by, and five Golden Core Stage Demon Beasts lay dead here.
"Even the Qilin Immortal dare not bully me, do you four little monsters think you can?" Fairy Eternity snorted coldly, hands on her hips, feeling very proud as she spoke.
"There were people like you in ancient times, always bullying me, I really hate it, it hasn't changed in three hundred thousand years."
Fairy Eternity muttered to herself as she left, quickly shrugged the matter off, and started humming a lively tune, leaving behind four corpses.
There were people in ancient times who saw her as a woman, beautiful and easy to deceive. Anyone who tried to trick her ended up invariably being seen through by her intelligence and killed.
"Picking mushrooms, picking a tiny mushroom..."
...
"Human bodies are so fragile, they can succumb to poison. If they all could learn my Health Preservation Boxing, turning their bodies into great medicine, wouldn't all poisons be useless then?"
"As for Lu Yang, why didn't he learn it when I kindly taught him? Even if the Yingtian Immortal and his folks begged me, I wouldn't teach them," Fairy Eternity leisurely walked, snapped off a branch, and casually transformed it into a magic artifact. She swung it about in the dense forest like holding a peerless sword.
She emitted a strange power, and no mosquito dared to approach her.
This forest gave her a familiar feeling. She used to dart about in the forest looking for medicinal herbs to increase her realm, or to face the various surprise attacks from those geniuses, long before she had become an immortal.
She was well-known at the time, not just because of her beauty, but more because of her formidable fighting capabilities and her mysterious, unpredictable thoughts.
No one could figure out what she was thinking or what she would do.
But one thing was certain, she was the worst nightmare on everyone's path to becoming an immortal, the biggest obstacle to their aspirations.
At that time, neither Yingtian Immortal nor the Qilin Immortal had gained fame and nobody knew anything about them. Their greatest wish was to defeat the powerful Fairy Eternity, earn a name for themselves with a single battle and get the attention of the world.
However, they never realized this wish.
Hence, Fairy Eternity was extremely good at handling various dangers and challenges. It was impossible to ambush her in the dense forest.
Roar——
Angry roars from a beast not far away fetched Fairy Eternity's interest.
Before she could get closer, she noticed that the ground was shaking, and the source of shaking was getting closer and closer, as if a giant creature was sprinting.
Boom——Boom——
Fairy Eternity hopped onto a giant rock, tip-toed, placed her right hand on her brow and looked ahead: "That is..."
With trees collapsing and smoke billowing, a towering figure, taller than the trees of the forest emerged and its coarse back came into the view.
A maddened elephant was chasing several people. The elephant was entirely white, just like jade, with six long tusks.
Those people were all skilled, all being in the middle and late stages of the Golden Core Stage. However they didn't dare to resist the frenzied colossal elephant and simply ran ahead for their lives.
Fairy Eternity jumped down from the giant rock.
The few people were horrified to see Fairy Eternity. They shouted at her desperately: "That's the elephant king in the early-stage of the Nascent Soul Stage! It's descending from an ancient lineage, the Six-tusked White Elephant. We don't know why, but it has gone mad. Young girl, run quickly!"
The Six-tusked White Elephant, although not as prestigious as the Dragon and Phoenix, Taozhu, or Qiongqi in ancient times, was still a famous Demon Race, ranking just after them. They had produced at least three transcendence tribulation stage great powers.
The people who were being chased by the Six-tusked White Elephant immediately recognized Fairy Eternity's cultivation level as the late stage of Foundation Establishment. Compared to the mad elephant king who was also at the primary stage of the Nascent Soul, they didn't dare to confront it head on. They could well imagine the fate of this little girl if she didn't runaway.
They didn't want to see this young girl die horribly.
The little girl stood still as if she were frightened and didn't move.
One of them suddenly exerted force, trying to drag Fairy Eternity and run away together. To their surprise, Fairy Eternity seemed to merge with the ground.
He was extremely astonished. Even though he was in the late Golden Core Stage, he couldn't move this young girl.
What is going on with this little girl?
The others also tried to move Fairy Eternity, but all failed. The Six-tusked White Elephant was hot on their heels, they dared not delay and had to keep running.
"Naughty elephant, your clan leader swore to me once, not to harm the Human race." Fairy Eternity revealed a secret unknown even to the Six-tusked White Elephant's own clan.
Unfortunately, the white elephant was already in rage and wouldn't listen to anything.
Fairy Eternity sighed, if she did not stop this elephant, those people would definitely be done for.
Pity this body.
She took a deep breath, adopted a posture, clenched her right fist, and placed it at her waist.
"Fairy Fist."
She slowly threw a punch.
…
"Young Master Song Hua, and the other young masters, are you all okay?"
"We noticed some commotion over here just now, could it be that you guys accidentally entered the territory of the Six-tusked White Elephant? That's a place you absolutely shouldn't enter!"
The bodyguards rushed over, panting heavily. These individuals were the young masters of the Song Family from the Imperial City, who came to the Demon Suppressing Pass to gain reputation for a future promotion.
For safety reasons, the Song Family also hired several bodyguards for them.
In the beginning, they were obedient, but later, these individuals found the bodyguards more and more annoying, prohibited from doing this, banned from doing that.
If they didn't do anything, why come to the Demon Suppressing Pass? For a vacation?
So they took advantage of the bodyguards' inattention, and secretly left. They hadn't gone far when they trespassed into the territory of the Six-tusked White Elephant and inexplicably annoyed it.
Seeing Song Hua and the others sitting on the ground, dumbfounded, not knowing what they were looking at.
The bodyguards followed their gaze, and were also stunned, lost in a daze.
There was a terrifying trench as though a fearsome giant had slithered by, knocking down countless giant trees.
At the end of the trench, a white elephant, as big as a small hill, lay on the ground, unconscious.
"What happened?"
Song Hua and others couldn't answer, or didn't know how to describe the scene just now.
A petite girl, sixteen or seventeen years old, in the late stage of Foundation Establishment, facing a raging Nascent Soul Stage giant elephant, with just a punch, toppled the elephant.
That punch seemed to have drained the young girl of all her energy, as she softly fell to the ground, her body becoming one with the earth and disappearing from sight.
…
"So, you're saying there's a Nascent Soul Stage Six-tusked White Elephant nearby?" After a day of battling, Lu Yang was panting heavily, sitting on the ground and resting, listening to the Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain narrate about nearby dangerous Demon Beasts.
"That giant elephant is said to have cultivation at the early Nascent Soul Stage, with a strong territorial awareness. Whoever trespasses its territory can expect to be trampled by it, relentlessly."
"Moreover, it has a temper, facing other beasts at the early Nascent Soul Stage is the same, as long as they dare to enter its territory without a greeting, they will be attacked. Once because of this, it got into a fight with another early Nascent Soul Stage beast. The result was a hard-fought victory for the elephant, while the other beast was killed."
"Hiss——" Meng Jingzhou took a cold breath after hearing this, could it be that ruthless?
"Isn't it? I know the two young heroes have astonishing fighting capabilities, defeating several Golden Core Stage Demon beasts in a row, and doing it effortlessly. Even so, I presume that facing that Six-tusked White Elephant would be no walk in the park."
"Therefore, we absolutely must not approach the territory of the Six-tusked White Elephant." The Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain advised.
"I understand." Lu Yang nodded, he always listens to good advice.
"Lu Yang, I'm back." Fairy Eternity's soul drifted into the spiritual space unnoticed.
"You're back so soon? Not even three days yet." Lu Yang was surprised, knowing Fairy Eternity, he felt she would at least play for three days.
"Um——your wooden avatar is too fragile, I broke it while playing." Fairy Eternity said with a grumble.
"What did you do?"
Fairy Eternity stuck out her tongue, feeling somewhat embarrassed about damaging the wooden avatar: "Not telling you."
If it was Lu Yang's real body fighting, Fairy Eternity was confident she could knock down the elephant with a punch without harming Lu Yang's body.

chapters.title: Chapter 247 - 246: Twin Golden Cores _1
chapters.content:
Within the clear lake water, a beautiful figure was swimming, moving gracefully. Her hands parted the water's surface with their strokes, her grace akin to a fish leaping out of the water in an extreme display of beauty.
The figure lay in the lake, going with the flow, enjoying these moments of leisure.
On the shore, Lu Yang stood with a helpless expression: "Fairy, can you stop swimming here?"
"Swimming is also something you want to control? Splat!" Fairy Eternity pouted, her hands came together, and a column of water sprayed from the gaps in her fingers towards Lu Yang, who easily dodged it.
"I naturally can't control your swimming, but please don't swim in my Spiritual Space, it makes me look like my mind is all water." Lu Yang helplessly remarked, wondering why ever since the Fairy came back, she had been unusually fond of playing with water, even creating a lake in his Spiritual Space.
"Go away, focus on your training, don't bother me." Fairy Eternity ejected Lu Yang out of the Spiritual Space, appearing to act like the owner of the place.
Lu Yang indeed was involved in a process of cultivation training. Now, he was surrounded by three Golden Core Stage wild boars while Meng Jingzhou and the five heroes from Eagle Mountain watched as if it was an entertainment.
The wild boars charged around with incredible strength. Lu Yang tried to dodge their attacks and target them from the side, but the wild boars, well-coordinated as they were, gave him no such opportunity.
Boom–––
Lu Yang was squarely hit by one of the wild boars and flew away, disappearing into a cloud of dust.
"You can do it, wild pig, kill him!" Meng Jingzhou gleefully cheered from the side.
"Is Young Hero Lu okay? I can see that one of the three wild pigs is at the mid-stage of the Golden Core, and the other two are at the top of the initial stage of Golden Core, right?" The Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain were more compassionate and worried about Lu Yang's safety.
"Not to worry, if they can't even defeat him, how can they consider him the number one in their generation? I could do a better job!" Meng Jingzhou dismissed their concerns with a wave of his hand.
The last time Lu Yang had kicked him off a tree to fight, this time it was bound to happen again.
When the three wild pigs wanted to continue their attack, the dust cloud dispersed, but Lu Yang's figure was nowhere to be seen.
Suddenly, the wild pigs became alert, trying to evade, but it was too late. A cold glint of light emerged from the ground, and Lu Yang's three-foot-long Green Peak Sword pierced through a wild pig's abdomen.
The wild pig attempted to resist, but Lu Yang only shook his wrist, changed his sword move, and lightly commanded, "Slash".
He directly split the wild pig in half, into two parts.
With one stroke, a Golden Core Stage Demon Beast was killed.
After several days of training in the dense forest, Lu Yang had dealt with more than a dozen different types of Golden Core Stage Demon Beasts.
His biggest takeaway was that fighting these beasts was entirely different from sparring with his Senior Brothers and Sisters of the Seek Dao Sect - the Golden Core Stage beasts outside the sect were so easy to defeat.
From now on, if he needed a confidence boost, he shouldn't look to the sect, he should come out and find it.
"As I have been saying, you have the ability to challenge those beyond your level. Your previous opponents were just too abnormal!" Fairy Eternity defended herself within the Spiritual Space.
When she had just revived, she wanted to show off her skills through Lu Yang's body to demonstrate to him what a cross-level challenge meant.
However, who could have expected that all those in the Seek Dao Sect were so outrageous? They were high achievers who, even if compared to those talented warriors of ancient times, would still rank at the forefront. She could not defeat them at all.
Luckily, she was later able to challenge and defeat those in the Divinity Transformation Stage with Lu Yang's body, thus reclaiming her dignity due to her exceptional wisdom.
The other two wild pigs saw their big brother dead and started to panic and flee.
"Quick, chase them, we can't let them get away!" Lu Yang reminded Meng Jingzhou.
"I know, do you need to say it?" Meng Jingzhou jumped off the tree, and he and Lu Yang divided the task between them, each chasing after a wild pig.
These three wild pigs were known to wander around and ambush humans. They had killed who knows how many human Cultivators, and Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou certainly couldn't let them go.
The Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain waited in the original place. In just a few minutes, they heard fighting sounds from not far away, the noises came quickly and also disappeared quickly.
By the time the five of them returned to their senses, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were already back, each dragging a wild pig.
"Our dinner tonight is secured."
...
When night fell, the Three Flavored True Fire rose, illuminating the faces of the seven people, causing them to appear reddish. A wild pig was hung over the fire, slowly being roasted. The sizzling oil dripped on the True Fire, causing the flames to leap up high.
"I never thought in our lives we would have a chance to eat food roasted using True Fire. All thanks to Young Hero Lu." The Five Heroes marveled, they were surprised that Lu Yang, despite his young age, had already mastered a True Fire.
Taking advantage of Lu Yang's grilling, the Five Heroes were dissecting the other two wild pigs.
The Inner Core, skin, tusks, and even the bones, all were valuable items that could fetch a handsome price at the Demon Suppressing Pass.
The Inner Core could be used as the primary material for Refining Pills, the skin could be used to forge magic instruments, the tusks could be used as decoration indicating status, and the bones could be used to make broth.
"Everyone, look. This wild pig has Twin Golden Cores!" One of the Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain exclaimed.
"What? Is it really?" Hearing this, the Eagle Nosed Big Brother immediately went over to examine it.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou also took an interest and put down their current tasks.
They had only heard about Twin Golden Cores within the Seek Dao Sect, but they had never heard of anyone outside the sect who could actually grow two Golden Cores.
Displayed on the ground were two Golden Cores, one golden and the other pitch black, seeming to represent two extremes, light and darkness, with a sense of "the Way" contained within them.
The more Lu Yang thought about it, the more extraordinary these two Golden Cores seemed to be. They contained boundless truths.
What a great thing indeed.
" I can't believe that I was able to defeat a Demon Beast with Twin Golden Cores in my life," Lu Yang was moved by his own growth.
Meng Jingzhou also found it extraordinary. He had never heard of anyone having a black Golden Core.
Golden Cores are divided into nine grades. The first grade being the brightest, shining gold, the ninth being the least bright, but also gold.
This wild pig, which didn't look particularly impressive, was able to grow a black Golden Core. Did it have a bloodline of the ancients, or had it encountered some fortune?
This wild pig is a descendant of the ancient Mount Pig. It can carry two mountains on its shoulders. The Mount Pig is all guts and no brains, so its status in the Demon Race is not high," The Elderly Big Brother speculated. Living in a dense forest for a long time, he understood a lot about Demon Beasts.
"So, it must have encountered some kind of fortuitous event?"
Meng Jingzhou speculated, "It is said that there is a rare heavenly treasure in the forest, known as the Twin Lotus. The seeds of the Twin Lotus are one light and one dark. Consuming it can reverse Yin and Yang and change one's constitution."
"Could it be that this wild pig inadvertently found the Twin Lotus and after consuming it, grew these Twin Golden Cores, one black and one white?"
The Old Brother nodded, agreeing with Meng Jingzhou's speculation: "If that is true, this wild pig is indeed very fortunate. There are many people who come to the forest in order to look for the Twin Lotus, but they obtain nothing. Instead, this wild pig managed to consume it."
Everyone's hearts burned with desire. Was there any leftover Twin Lotus where the pig found it? Would it be possible to find clues from its body, follow the vine to get the melon, and locate the Twin Lotus?
"Fairy, do you have any thoughts? Can you figure out the origins of these Twin Golden Cores?" Within the privacy of the Spiritual Space, Lu Yang quietly asked Fairy Eternity.
"The Twin Golden Cores? Isn't that black one a gallstone?"
Fairy Eternity was very puzzled; was it not due to the fact that Mount Pig is all guts that over time it had excreted bile, which accumulated and condensed into a gallstone?
She had often seen this situation in ancient times.
What were these people talking about?
Where did these Twin Golden Cores come from?
Lu Yang: "..."

chapters.title: Chapter 248 - 247 Do You Believe I Say This is an Accident? (Thanks to the book friend who tipped all night) _1
chapters.content:
Under the explanation of Lu Yang, everyone finally understood they've made a big mistake, what they've been studying for a good while as a black Golden Core was not a Golden Core at all.
It was not really their fault. The Mount Pig is full of gall, but gallstones only happen in Golden Core Stage and above. The Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain hadn't had any contact with Golden Core Stage Demon Beasts before, so it was understandable that they didn't know.
The key point is, who would imagine that a Gallstone could emerge in the Golden Core Stage?
"This is very normal." In response to Lu Yang's inquiry, Fairy Eternity stated as a matter of fact, "Ordinary people get ordinary Gallstones, so naturally those in the Golden Core stage get Golden Core stage Gallstones. Totally reasonable."
"You're just lacking experience. You know about viruses, right? Those things that grow inside your body and make you sick. I've even seen cases where a cultivator's Cultivation Level increases and the virus growth increases accordingly. Have you ever seen a Nascent Soul Stage virus cold?" Fairy Eternity proudly flaunted her bizarre knowledge.
Lu Yang shook his head. He hadn't even heard of something like this, let alone seen it.
"In ancient times, the Cultivation Level of viruses grew alongside living beings, causing a lot of trouble. Yingtian Immortal established the Thunder Tribulation partly to help high-level cultivators eliminate viruses during their passing of the Thunder Tribulation," Fairy Eternity revealed another secret.
"Old Three, if you don't have real goods, don't yell around!" The hook-nosed Big Brother chastised Old Three, who was in charge of the dissection.
Old Three was wronged. Just now everyone was eagerly guessing and didn't recognize it as Gallstone, and now they blamed it on him?
Being the Big Brother shouldn't be unreasonable.
While thinking, Old Three conveniently took out the gallbladder of the Mount Pig.
One, two, three, four, five... Saying the Mount Pig is full of gall is not a metaphor, but a description of the facts.
"The Mount Pig certainly has no small amount of gall: it charges at any monster it sees, even the Long Clan and Phoenix Tribe are no exceptions," Fairy Eternity explained based on her own experience.
"Wouldn't that cause general disapproval?"
"No, most people avoid them as much as possible. Think about it. In a fight, demon beasts mainly use their mouths and claws. After defeating a Mount Pig, its splashed gall makes you feel bitter and astringent. Who could bear that?"
"However, based on the characteristics of the Mount Pig, I have created a delicious dish that has received rave reviews."
"What did Fairy create?"
"Bile Stewed Bitter Gourd, it's all about heat-clearing and detoxification."
Lu Yang shivered subconsciously: "This thing is highly appreciated? Who had the opportunity to taste it?"
"Immortal Jiuchong. At that time, he hadn't become immortal yet. He was severely poisoned, and I saved him. Seeing him on the brink of death, I made him a bowl of heat-clearing and detoxifying Bile Stewed Bitter Gourd."
"When he slowly woke up, he drank a mouthful and said 'good', then fell unconscious again."
"Probably due to the poisoning, his body was out of control. When he saw me bringing the food, he was struggling desperately, and when he said 'good', his face was distorted. It was really pitiful."
"... It's quite pitiful indeed."
"Did the poison get detoxified?"
"It did. After he woke up, he vomited for a good half a day, and the poison was all thrown up."
Lu Yang: "..."
Isn't this detoxification method different from what I imagined?
"Enough talking, let's fight." Fairy Eternity said, and once again kicked Lu Yang out of the Spiritual Space.
"Fight?"
Lu Yang muttered for a moment before reacting, and then opened his Spiritual Sense to explore the surroundings.
"There's no one? No, they're underground!"
Lu Yang looked down and saw that the ground was indented, indicating a demon beast was beneath.
"Get ready to fight!" Lu Yang loudly alerted everyone. The demon beast underground gave him a palpitation-like feeling.
Boom——
A worm as thick as a water jar drilled out from the soil. It had four silver rings on it, shining under the moonlight, and opened its huge mouth to immediately swallow two dissected boars.
Thanks to Lu Yang's warning, everyone was able to dodge in time. Before the worm could appear, they swiftly jumped away, evacuating the area.
"What is that?" Meng Jingzhou was taken aback. Could a worm be so powerful?
"It's a Silver Ring King Worm!" Lu Yang recognized the origins of the Demon Beast at a glance.
The pair of, oh, now there are two pairs, Silver Ring King Worms in Uncle Ba's medicinal garden that were responsible for ploughing the soil were the kings among worms.
The pair of worms in the medicinal garden had five silver rings, with the sixth forming, meaning they were at the peak of Spirit Transformation stage.
The worm in front of them had four silver rings, so it should be at the Nascent Soul Stage.
What was even more troublesome was that Lu Yang's much-prided swordsmanship could hardly threaten this worm, and it was likely that cutting it with a sword could result in two worms, making the situation even more complicated.
When the Silver Ring King Worm swallowed the third wild boar that was being roasted on the Three Flavored True Fire and still looked unsatisfied, it turned its gaze towards Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had not yet faced an opponent at the Nascent Soul Stage, the Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain could not help in this situation.
"Shocking Heaven Six Forms!" Meng Jingzhou took the lead, clenching his fists, veins bulging, creating an enormous momentum that seemed to shake heaven and earth.
However, the Silver Ring King Worm had a layer of mucus on its body, and Meng Jingzhou's full-force punch couldn't even break through, completely dissipating his strength.
The Silver Ring King Worm flicked its tail, sending Meng Jingzhou flying, breaking several of his bones.
If it wasn't for him being a Body Cultivator, that one strike would have taken his life.
The gap between the Nascent Soul Stage and the Foundation Establishment Stage is too vast, separated strangley by the Golden Core Stage.
"Break!"
Lu Yang shouted and unleashed the Destroying Formula, sword light like a waterfall, breaking the sound barrier, tearing through the darkness, and carrying the moonlight on the sword, it seemed like a divine killing sword.
This was the strongest move that Lu Yang was capable of.
The Green Peak Sword pierced through the mucus of the Silver Ring King Worm and pierced into its body. The Silver Ring King Worm writhed in pain, trying to crush the human.
It was rolling forcefully, and every time Lu Yang touched the ground, he used an earth shrinking technique, avoiding being smashed on the ground.
Lu Yang wrist exerted force, trying to lift it up, but the Silver Ring King Worm's body was too strong, tensing its body and directly jamming the Green Peak Sword in its body.
"Roar, roar..." The Silver Ring King Worm let out a deep sound, seemingly scoffing at Lu Yang's futile efforts.
Of course, it could talk, but it was too arrogant to communicate with these weak humans.
It suddenly opened its mouth and bit towards Lu Yang, but at the critical moment, Lu Yang drew out his Green Peak Sword and dodged the attack.
Lu Yang's heart sank. The Destroying Formula was his ultimate move can kill a late-stage Golden Core or even a Half-step Nascent Soul stage Demon Beast with a single sword strike, but the sword didn't harm the Silver Ring King Worm at all and even angered it.
More importantly, this strike drained most of his magical power.
"Tsk, Bad news."
On the other side, seeing Lu Yang also out of options, Meng Jingzhou seemed to recall something and retrieved five Directional Teleportation Talismans from his bosom.
But there were seven people present. If he and Lu Yang escaped, the Silver Ring King Worm would never let the Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain go.
"Young heroes, don't worry about us, you guys go!" The eagle-nosed Big Brother saw the Directional Teleportation Talisman in Meng Jingzhou's hand and yelled loudly.
Doing this kind of job, they had long ago dismissed life and death.
What to do! What can we do!
Meng Jingzhou gritted his teeth. Escaping is not his style, but without escape, everyone would die here!
In the end, he closed his eyes, pulled out a Directional Teleportation Talisman, and threw it to Lu Yang, "Lu Yang, catch!"
Lu Yang lunged forward. However, the Silver Ring King Worm chuckled and its immense body blocked between him and Meng Jingzhou, with the Directional Teleportation Talisman under its body.
"Want to escape?" It said for the first time, a frosty sneer full of mockery for Lu Yang's futile efforts.
"Now!" Lu Yang shouted.
"Need you to say that?" Meng Jingzhou's lazy voice sounded from the other side, activating the Directional Teleportation Talisman.
He was waiting for this moment.
An invisible cube of light enveloped the Silver Ring King Worm. It didn't understand what was happening, struggling forcefully, but the light screen was extremely sturdy and couldn't be broken.
When Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou first saw the Silver Ring King Worm, they were reminded of the introduction by the chamber's attendants: "If you encounter a life and death crisis in the dense forest, just activate this teleportation talisman, It will teleport you back to the Demon Suppressing Pass.
No attack from the demon races, including those at the Nascent Soul stage, can interrupt the teleportation process!"
On the contrary, if it can safely teleport people back to the Demon Suppressing Pass, why can't it teleport demon beasts as well?
...
The cubic light screen, with the Silver Ring King Worm inside, turned into a stream of light and flew towards the Demon Suppressing Pass.
The three characters "Demon Suppressing Pass" on the city gate itself stopped the Silver Ring King Worm.
The guards were puzzled when they saw a Nascent Soul stage demon beast suddenly appear. They had been working for over a decade but it was the first time that they have witnessed such a brazen demon beast attacking the Demon Suppressing Pass without even trying to hide its identity.
"How dare you, a wicked creature, take advantage of the darkness to launch a sneak attack on Demon Suppressing Pass!"
A deep voice came from inside the Demon Suppressing Pass: it was a Spirit Transformation cultivator on night duty.
The Silver Ring King Worm watched helplessly as a burly man flew out of the city and towards him, feeling utterly desperate.
"Would you believe me if I told you this was an accident?" the Silver Ring King Worm forced a smile.
The burly man sneered, "Guess if I would?"
He extended his huge hand, and with a slap, he killed the Silver Ring King Worm.

chapters.title: Chapter 249 - 248 Fairy, you should talk less about ancient mysteries. I'm worried I don't have enough lives_1
chapters.content:
"Directional Teleportation Talismans can be used like this?!" The Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain were stunned upon seeing the Silver Ring King Worm being forcefully teleported away.
Especially the despair in the Silver Ring King Worm's eyes; it left a deep impression.
One could easily imagine the fate of this great demon at the Nascent Soul Stage.
A rule had been set in the Demon Suppressing Pass: those below the Unification Stage who approached it would die. This might be a great demon at the Nascent Soul Stage, but against the monstrous Demon Suppressing Pass, there was only one path – death.
"Ah? Isn't this the most obvious use?" Lu Yang was surprised. He had thought that only a demon beast brain would fail to think of this. How could the Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain, who were also humans, not think of it?
Look at Meng Jingzhou who thought of it immediately.
"Are there so many Golden Core and Nascent Soul Stage demon beasts in this forest?" Lu Yang thought about what had been happening these past few days. Along with those that were intentionally seeking them out, many other beasts they randomly stumbled upon were all at the Golden Core Stage.
This evening was even crazier; even a demon beast at the Nascent Soul Stage showed up.
Luckily Meng Jingzhou had a Directional Teleportation Talisman, which allowed him to teleport the Silver Ring King Worm to Demon Suppressing Pass; otherwise Lu Yang would have had to use the Eldest Sister's Form Boxing.
The old man known as the eagle-beaked Big Brother shook his head and said, "Impossible. Regardless of whether they are from the human or demon race, most of those who roam in this forest are at the Foundation Establishment Stage. If it were really like it is now, with several Golden Core Stage demon beasts ambushing at every encounter, no one would dare to come."
Lu Yang thought about it and realized it made sense. The demon beasts coming across their party were the unlucky ones. If it were any other Foundation Establishment Stage group, they would've been dead long ago.
"It must be due to the many demon beasts you two young heroes have killed, attracting their attention." Big Brother speculated.
He sighed inwardly. The five of them, who were in the late Foundation Establishment Stage, found it difficult to fight even their own Level demon beasts. Compared to these two young heroes who took killing early and mid-stage Golden Core beasts as casually as chopping vegetables and melons, the has was too wide.
What a difference!
"I suggest we return to the city when the gates open at dawn tomorrow, and take a good rest, change our clothes, and clean off the smells."
Lu Yang nodded - Big Brother's proposal was reasonable. Over the past few days, all seven of them had their nerves constantly on edge. If they weren't fighting, it was the mental toll of constantly being in combat. The load on their minds was too much.
Although his spiritual power significantly exceeded his peers and shouldn't be depleted so quickly - Meng Jingzhou and the Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain were feeling tired, but he wasn't - who else had a Fairy Eternity mischief constantly in their spiritual space?
Lu Yang had to spare some of his mental power to deal with Fairy Eternity and listen to her recount the bizarre anecdotes of the ancient times.
The strange stories of the ancients included but were not limited to - the jealousy of the dragon and Phoenix geniuses.
The Qilin Immortal fled to a foreign land because of a fire in the harem, earning him the nickname Fire Qilin.
Yingtian Immortal called for Immortals to reduce their interventions to improve their mystique.
Time Immortal ate Fairy Eternity's food and felt like years had passed, realizing relativity. He strongly supported the idea of Fairy Eternity cooking for the others too.
Immortal Jiuchong published a scholarly paper proving himself to be the first Immortal and led archaeological discoveries to prove his legitimacy.
Truth be told, these ancient anecdotes about Immortals were extremely valuable and would have fetched a fortune at auctions.
If those old scholars who studied ancient history heard about them, they might get so excited they would lose sleep. The information included in these stories was vast enough to overthrow the present understanding of the ancient period.
However, Lu Yang was worried that he might wake up one day to find the Four Immortals of the Ancients standing by his side, looking down at him and ominously laughing, "You know too much. Time to die."
He didn't have the Eternity Dao Fruit.
On the upside, by the time Eldest Sister arrived, she might still be able to retrieve his remains.
Lu Yang shared his concerns with Fairy Eternity. She, as usual, heartlessly responded, "Oh, Yingtian Immortal and the others are all good people; they are easy to talk to and wouldn't do anything to you. Look at me, I know so many things and I'm still fine."
Lu Yang quietly looked at Fairy Eternity, who was in her soul form. He wanted to remind the old lady that she had been dead for over three hundred thousand years and had just been revived two months ago.
After several days of fighting, both Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou gained significant battle experience, and they became more skilled in lethal moves.
Their cultivation levels were steadily improving, solidifying their late stage of Foundation Establishment and slowly advancing to the Golden Core Stage.
"Why does it feel like your battle experience is a bit more extensive than mine?" Meng Jingzhou asked in surprise, believing that it wasn't an illusion.
Lu Yang responded emotionlessly, "You'd also improve your combat experiences if our senior brothers and sisters beat you up from night to morning."
Lu Yang recalled his agony while this chap was enjoying the show from below the stage.
Meng Jingzhou contemplated, "Does that movement really have such effect?"
In his life, he had never lagged behind others and didn't want to lose to Lu Yang in terms of combat experience.
The night of rest was not peaceful, they faced a sneak attack from a Golden Core Stage demon beast, which Meng Jingzhou killed in a flurry of punches.
It was a rabbit the size of a domestic pig, with two large buck teeth three or four inches long, and ruby-red eyes that looked like gemstones.
"Do we have so much hostility? They won't even let us rest in the middle of the night!" Meng Jingzhou angrily kicked the rabbit essence after it had distracted him during the fight and managed to nibble on his hair.
Luckily, he had already refined his body down to his hair, so he managed to endure the attack.
The Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain were also puzzled, after all, they had limited knowledge and hadn't seen anyone killing demon beasts so ruthlessly. "That's not right, normally this outer forest region shouldn't have so many Golden Core Stage demon beasts. It doesn't make sense for them to be here."
"Enough, let's discuss this back home." Lu Yang summoned everyone for the return journey, back to Demon Suppressing Pass for rest.
When everyone arrived back at Demon Suppressing Pass, they heard people discussing at the city gate.
"Have you heard? A great demon at the Nascent Soul Stage sneak attacked Demon Suppressing Pass last night but was killed by a slap from a Divinity Transformation Stage expert on night duty."
"Is that real or fake? Was the demon beast drunk? How dare a Nascent Soul creature dare to sneak attack?" a companion inquired in disbelief.
Demon Suppressing Pass, serving as one of the six guard cities set up at the border of the Demon Territory, couldn't be breached without several Unification Stage experts making a move.
However, there were precedents, where a few great demons, drunk, rushed to Demon Suppressing Pass to test their courage. The lucky ones were driven away by Demon Suppressing Pass, while the unlucky ones ended up in a pot the next day, feasted on by the entire city.
"Of course, it's true. Didn't you notice there are more guards on duty today than yesterday? The higher-ups suspect that the Demon Race is preparing for a major move, so they sent out a sacrificial pawn to test our defense capabilities!"
"Is another battle coming?"
"Not likely, it's probably just a probe."
"There's also an unreliable rumor."
"What is it?"
"The story goes that the demon beast was transported here using a Directional Teleportation Talisman."
"Can't be, how could a Directional Teleportation Talisman be used like that?"
"That's why I said the rumor was unreliable."
"So, can we get a good meal today?" The Demon Suppressing Pass often distributed the meat of slain demon beasts at the city gate to everyone.
"I doubt it."
"Why?"
"The creature that died was an earthworm essence, how are you going to eat that?"
Inside the spiritual space, Fairy Eternity asked in surprise, "Huh, don't you guys eat earthworms here?"
"...Fairy, would you like to rethink what you just said?"

chapters.title: Chapter 250 - 249 Twin Lotus (Thanks to book friend ADSlm for the reward)
chapters.content:
Lu Yang tried hard to dissuade Fairy Eternity from showcasing her cooking skills by saying, "Mortals are not worthy to enjoy a fairy's culinary artistry."
"Lu Yang, your mindset is not right. Before great cuisine, everyone is equal. But, I guess we can let it slide for now," Fairy Eternity replied.
"Fairy understands the greater good," Lu Yang praised generously.
He believed that he had saved countless lives and, in his eyes, performed a great act of merit. If becoming immortal through merit was a thing in the Cultivation World, Lu Yang would bet on his chances for it.
The seven of them arrived at the Land Money Trade Association, pulling out various demon beast carcasses from their Identity Jade tokens. These were all spoils of war, causing nearby onlookers to gasp in surprise.
"These… are these all Golden Core stage Demon Beasts?!" The attendant, the same one who had previously attended to Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, could tell at a glance that these demon beasts were all at the Golden Core stage, and all corpses were intact with barely any damage.
This was thanks to Lu Yang's sword technique, aiming for oneshot kills, and Meng Jingzhou's fists that relied on hidden strength to smash the brain case of the Demon Beasts.
Recalling the identities of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, the attendant quickly understood the situation.
One was a disciple of the Seek Dao Sect — needless to say, they possess superior combat capacities and are synonymous with unparalleled power within the same realm.
In fact, all disciples of the Five Great Immortal Sects are deemed invincible among their peers. They would be embarrassed to admit themselves as disciples of the Five Great Immortal Sects if they were not capable of punching above their level.
However, what the attendant did not know was that within the Five Great Immortal Sects, Lu Yang was particularly formidable, having defeated the strongest Foundation Establishment Stage cultivator in the Five Elements Sect.
As for Meng Jingzhou, he came from the main line of the Meng Family. The Meng Family was infamous for stirring up trouble in the Imperial City, and their direct descendants had to be capable; otherwise, they would have been killed off long ago.
The attendant also heard that there had been discussion on creating a "Meng Family Personal Accident Insurance" at the headquarters.
"Do you two not want the inner cores?" The attendant asked, pulling out the inner cores. These were the most valuable parts of Golden Core stage demon beasts and could be used to refine elixirs that improve the chance of forming a golden core. They are very popular among cultivators in the late stage of Foundation Establishment.
Some cultivators at the Half Step Golden Core stage, who were just one inner core-refined elixir away from truly reaching the Golden Core stage.
"It's not important, sell it all," Meng Jingzhou dismissed casually.
It didn't take long for the attendant to appraise the price of these demon beast bodies. Roughly three intact bodies of Mid-stage Golden Core Demon Beasts can buy one Directional Teleportation Talisman; this was the price even after Meng Jingzhou's family discount.
"I'll take five more Directional Teleportation Talismans," Meng Jingzhou, enticed by the deal, purchased another five talismans.
Now, he had nine Directional Teleportation Talismans — enough to deal with nine Nascent Soul stage Demon Beasts. This level of preparation was enough to traverse the dense forest with ease.
"Here, four for you," Meng Jingzhou handed four talismans to Lu Yang.
"Do you have higher-grade teleportation talismans?" Meng Jingzhou asked.
"Higher grade?"
"One that won't be disrupted by attacks from Divinity Transformation Stage Demon Beasts."
"Hold on, let me check." Because of their steep price, very few people bought the Directional Teleportation Talismans, and the attendant wasn't too knowledgeable about them.
"I'm sorry, but we only stock Nascent Soul Grade Directional Teleportation Talismans here. The Divinity Transformation Grade ones are kept in our headquarters. Would you like us to have some sent over?"
"Have your headquarters send three over." Meng Jingzhou always puts safety first.
"Alright."
"Has there been any news of rare treasures appearing in the forest lately?" Lu Yang inquired. The Trade Association provided such a service, claiming that as long as the spirit stones were sufficient, they could find out any information for the client.
Of course, this was merely false advertising. At the very least, they did not know the age of the Eldest Senior Sister.
The attendant invited them into the soundproof room, activated the Array Method, and prevented outer probe.
Important information had to be discussed in private.
"Someone discovered the Twin Lotus," the attendant got straight to the point.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were both taken aback. Just last night they were talking about this rare treasure and now someone has found a trace of it?
"Where?"
The attendant spread out a map, pointing to a lake, "It was found in a lake 110 miles south of Demon Suppressing Pass. There used to be a late-stage Golden Core Fish King in that lake. It was a pufferfish spirit that contained intense poison within its body; very few could survive against it at the same stage. It truly was the undisputed ruler."
"Moreover, the rumors stated that it was allies with four Golden Core Stage Demon Beasts, forming an alliance and causing numerous casualties."
"Three days ago, someone accidentally intruded the Fish King's territory, prepared for their imminent death. However, they were not attacked. Instead, on the lakeside were the corpses of the four Golden Core Stage Demon Beasts, all poisoned to death. The subsequent autopsy confirmed this."
"Additionally, they found the Fish King's body in the lake, completely broken apart."
"We speculate that a conflict arose between Fish King and the four Demon Beasts, perhaps over uneven distribution of spoils, leading to internal strife. The four Demon Beasts were poisoned to death by the Fish King, and the Fish King itself was also beaten to a pulp and met its demise."
"Subsequently, people discovered the Twin Lotus in the lake, which had always been well hidden and guarded by the Fish King."
"The Twin Lotus will bloom in five days, and quite a number of people have already got wind of the news and are preparing to seize it."
"The Twin Lotus, huh…" Both Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had an interested smile on their faces.
They both had not decided on what type of Golden Core to form — Lu Yang didn't want to form a Sword Core, and Meng Jingzhou didn't want to form a Single Golden Elixir. They both needed external objects to inspire them.
Observing the Twin Lotus' bloom could possibly bring enlightenment for Golden Core formation, and there were such cases in the Sect of Seek Dao.
There was a senior brother who happened to observe the blooming of a Twin Lotus while forming his core. Under the moon's reflection, he viewed the lotus, found enlightenment, and formed a Yin Yang Golden Core, which was extremely powerful for outlandish attacks.
Upon activating the Yin Yang Golden Core, ridiculous statements would spew out of his mouth, making it excellent for provoking enmity.
Lu Yang knew that senior brother, it was his second senior brother who was still practicing in the Golden Buddha Kingdom.
Also, there was the Abbot of the Suspension Temple, the only person in the Five Great Immortal Sects at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. He also referenced the Twin Lotus when forming his Golden Core.
The Abbot from the Suspension Temple had a lotus pattern on his Golden Core. As a result, whenever he discoursed or gave lectures, lotus flowers would appear from his mouth with each step he took, producing a special effect that was very impressive.
This was not the same as magic skills, which were external forces. These effects would naturally occur, being all-natural.
This had won the praise of many great powers, showing the effectiveness of the Twin Lotus.
"The lotus seeds are also delicious," Fairy Eternity reminded Lu Yang about another benefit of the Twin Lotus.
She noticed the Twin Lotus when she was killing the Fish King, but at that time, it had not bloomed, and recklessly harvesting it would cause the lotus to lose its spiritual properties.
As an Immortal Cook, or to be precise, the only Immortal Cook in the world, it was natural for her not to waste such a precious resource.
"Lotus seeds can be made into lotus seed soup, which symbolizes many children and blessings. Once you want children, you can cook this for your wife."
"…Lady Fairy, you're thinking too far ahead. I don't even have a fiancée yet."
"Sooner or later you will, this is the blessing of an Immortal!"
Fairy Eternity was brimming with confidence; her blessings have never been proven wrong before.
Lu Yang felt that his life was filled with misfortune.

chapters.title: Chapter 251 - 250 The Sensible Yellow Bean_1
chapters.content:
Leaving the merchant's house, and temporarily bidding the Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain farewell, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou returned to their inn. They asked the waiter to buy some nice dishes from nearby and deliver them to their rooms.
"Make sure there's no tofu," Lu Yang reminded the waiter before heading upstairs.
"The bed is so much comfortable!" Once back in his room, Lu Yang made a flying leap onto the comfortable bed, his face full of bliss.
"Exactly, sleeping is really comforting," Huang Doudou, who had been dead for over 300,000 years, approved immensely of Lu Yang's idea.
Nowadays she just sleeps in the spiritual space. She sleeps more when in a good mood, and less when in a bad one.
It was comforting that her mood was constantly good.
Fairy Eternity waited half a day but got no response from Lu Yang. It was only then she noticed that he had fallen asleep, his mouth slightly open, sleeping very deeply.
Surviving in the dense forest for the past few days had been too tiring. Lu Yang was constantly on guard, taut like a bowstring. The moment he came into a comfortable environment, he completely relaxed.
The situation was pretty the same for Meng Jingzhou; he fell asleep as soon as he hit the bed.
Having been pampered since childhood, he could always get what he wanted. He had never suffered like this in the dense forest before.
"Dear guest, your food has arrived," the waiter knocked lightly on the door.
Fearing to wake Lu Yang up, Fairy Eternity temporarily took over his body to open the door.
"Shush, speak softly, they're sleeping," Fairy Eternity put her index finger to her lips and spoke in a soft voice to the waiter, reminding him not to be too loud.
The waiter handed the food tray to Fairy Eternity and lowered his voice subconsciously, "Yes, sir."
Fairy Eternity took the food tray, closed the door, placed the food on the table, returned Lu Yang's body to the bed, and resumed his previous posture, as if nothing had happened.
"Well, I am so bored, I should sleep too." Fairy Eternity yawned and fell asleep in the spiritual space.
As the waiter reached the top of the stairs, he suddenly remembered what he had seen in the corner of his eye in the room.
"Isn't there only one person in that room? Who was sleeping?"
Mysteriously, he felt a chill on his back, as if someone was watching him, and he instinctively quickened his pace downstairs.
"God bless me, God bless me! I haven't done anything wrong!"
...…
"This is so comfortable!"
Lu Yang woke up from the bed.
"That smells so good."
He saw the table filled with three meat dishes, one vegetable dish, and a soup, and was very surprised.
Where did this food come from?
He did remember asking the waiter to send up meals when going upstairs, but he didn't recall opening the door at all..
"Do I sleepwalk?" Lu Yang scratched his head, thinking that he must be confused due to oversleeping.
The choice of the waiter was reasonably good. All the food he delivered had the local characteristics. The taste was also good and the original materials should have been the demon beasts at Foundation Establishment Stage, which could supplement spiritual essence and restore energy.
Lu Yang originally wanted to ask Fairy Eternity if she wanted to temporarily take over his body and taste some local delicacies of Demon Suppressing Pass. But finding Fairy Eternity still asleep, he didn't call her.
After eating and drinking, Lu Yang was refreshed and felt like a completely different person from last night.
He went to find Meng Jingzhou next door.
"Are you saying that you want me to teach you the Arhat Fist?" Hearing Lu Yang's request, Meng Jingzhou was somewhat surprised.
"I thought about it this morning after waking up. I have established myself in magic skills and swordsmanship. What I lack is a set of boxing to show off. There could be unforeseen circumstances in a battle where boxing might be useful."
"Don't you already know the Imitation Fist?"
"And then summon Eldest Senior Sister?"
Meng Jingzhou did think it was a bit too much. If you fought like this, there's no point in the fight. It's more like a summoning technique.
Moreover, Lu Yang's Imitation Fist is more like a transformation technique than a form of boxer.
"Is that convenient?"
"As far as the master is concerned, there shouldn't be any taboo about it. Although the Arhat Fist is valuable, you can also learn it from Eldest Senior Sister. It's just a difference between learning it from me and learning it from Eldest Senior Sister."
As long as you know the name, you can learn it from Eldest Senior Sister.
If Eldest Senior Sister doesn't know it, she can create a style on the spot based on the name.
"That's great." Thinking of being able to learn a new boxing technique, Lu Yang was eager.
