"Would you rather learn Arhat Fist than learning my Arhat Fruit Fist?" Fairy Eternity stomped her foot in irritation.
The name 'Arhat Fist' sounds so mediocre, nowhere near as nice as the 'Fairy Fist'.
"Once you have mastered the Arhat Fruit Fist, you can continue to learn the Sichuan Pepper Boxing, Star Anise Boxing, Cumin Boxing, and thousands of other boxing techniques. Then you can integrate them to become the Fairy boxing method. By then, you will be invincible."
Faced with the glamorous future painted by Fairy, Lu Yang sighed, "Fairy, if you would just change the name of your boxing, I would learn it."
Before the fight, everyone is either using the Eight Extreme Fist or the Shocking Heaven Six Forms,but when it's his turn, and people ask about his boxing method, he can't just say it's the Fairy Body Technique.
Half of his momentum would be lost before the fight.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou rented an indoor martial arts field and began to learn Arhat Fist.
"I won't tell you about the origins of the Arhat Fist. It's all pointless reading anyway– when you have time, go and read about it in a book." Meng Jingzhou skipped the related content and went straight to the practical teaching.
"The overall routine emphasizes breaking the upper part from the lower and breaking the lower part from the upper, pointing to the right and hitting the left, and dichotomy is stressed, featuring unpredictability and rapid changes. At the same time, the power of energy is used to blow the teeth, and the sound is thunderous. With the help of the sound, the power of energy is promoted, like this."
Meng Jingzhou stood tall with his chest out, both arms hanging naturally, his eyes fixed straight ahead, opening his left foot to the left for half a step and drawing arcs with both hands from the bottom upwards, in an outward direction.
"Ha!"
While Meng Jingzhou displayed the boxing techniques, he was quite like an angry Bodhisattva, majestic as a prison, with a loud voice, faintly showing characteristics of the lion's roar of Buddhism.
"There is no end to the sea of bitterness, but the shore is Just a turnaround!"
"This is the Horse Stance Single Whip!"
"This is the Kicking Punch!"
"This is the Roc's Claw!"
One by one, Meng Jingzhou displayed the techniques of the Arhat Fist, making Lu Yang's blood boil.
When he demonstrated the whole series of movements, revealing the true essence of the Arhat Fist, it seemed as if a real Arhat was standing in front of Lu Yang, exorcising demons and dispelling evil.
Especially when he thought about how the Third Elder's famous skill 'Shocking Heaven Six Forms' came from his comprehension of the Arhat Fist, Lu Yang was even more excited.
Maybe he could also understand other boxing techniques from the Arhat Fist.
"By the way, did the Third Elder ever tell you how he comprehended the 'Shocking Heaven Six Forms' from the Arhat Fist?" Lu Yang asked, thinking that he might be able to borrow some ideas.
"Yes." Meng Jingzhou recalled, "The master said that when he was young, he traveled to Golden Buddha Country and met an old man who was proficient in Arhat Fist. The old man was known as the Demon Suppressing Arhat, and he beat the master as if he was beating a grandson."
"The master was chased around and swiped at like a mouse. In order to avoid being beaten further, he exploded in a desperate situation and created his own boxing technique, the 'Shocking Heaven Six Forms'."
Lu Yang: "..."
The process of creating this boxing technique was different from what he imagined.
"So did the Third Elder win against that person at that time?"
"No, the other person was a level higher than the master."

chapters.title: Chapter 252 - 251 Arhat Fist_1
chapters.content:
"Come, get into a horse stance, assume the correct posture, and start learning Arhat Fist."
Lu Yang emulates Meng Jingzhou's movements, sinks his energy into his Dantian, holds his head high and chest extended, takes a half step to the left with his left foot, and forms an arc with his palms.
"Ha!"
"Your voice isn't loud enough, again!"
"Ha!"
"Louder!"
"Ha!"
Lu Yang's voice gradually increases until it finally reaches Meng Jingzhou's standard.
"My master once told me that shouting during a fight is a way of releasing our limits. The louder the voice, the more real power can be exhibited, even surpassing our usual strength."
"Your arm should stay level with your line of sight when you punch."
"Your fist should be tight, imagine you're holding a stone and squeezing it with all your might, as if you want to shatter it."
These are the teachings from the Third Elder when Meng Jingzhou was learning kung fu, now he's passing them all to Lu Yang.
"Arhat Fist stresses the unity of the upper and lower body, changing the steps according to the hand, integrating both hardness and softness in the force applied. Your movements are too stiff, they need to flow and be smoother!"
Meng Jingzhou one-by-one points out Lu Yang's mistakes and corrects them; all of these are common mistakes when practicing kung fu.
Lu Yang has a decent talent in martial arts. As evident from him mastering the Imitation Fist in less than a day, he then modified it into the Lu Style Imitation Fist in the next half day.
"The sea of bitterness is boundless, turn back and you will find the shore!"
In no time, Lu Yang gets the hang of it. There is even a sense of compassion shown on his face, he looks like a great virtuous person at a glance.
Meng Jingzhou's earnest teachings echo in Lu Yang's ears, "My master once told me that Arhat Fist is a martial art that persuades people to do good. The so-called 'the sea of bitterness is boundless, turn back and you will find the shore', if one can lay down their weapons and choose benevolence after learning this art, then the Arhat Fist can be said to be accomplished."
"What a pity, too many people in this world are ignorant and can't lay down their weapons to wholeheartedly embrace benevolence. Hence, throughout history, only a few people have been able to truly master the Arhat Fist."
Meng Jingzhou places a single hand on his chest, seeming to convey immense wisdom with his demeanor.
"Poor real humor, too many people in the world than I can't put the hands of weapons, a good heart, so they can practice to Arhat boxing, only two or three people in history."
"When learning Arhat Fist, your state of mind is also very important. It's best to imagine yourself as a disciple of Buddhism. I studied Buddhist scriptures for some time when learning Arhat Fist."
"Reciting Buddhist scriptures?" Lu Yang felt as if he was beginning to see the way forward.
Lu Yang doesn't need to learn Buddhist scriptures now. He had read a few Buddhist scriptures like the "Diamond Sutra", "Mingwang Sutra", "Heart Sutra" and the like during his idle time in the Scripture Pavilion. They were quite effective for hypnosis.
He slowly closes his eyes, the exquisite face of Fairy Eternity surfaces in his mind.
Fairy Eternity, wearing a beige pajamas, tilts her head and looks at Lu Yang.
"...Fairy, could you stand by the side of my spiritual space? I'm recalling the Buddhist scriptures."
"Oh."
Once Fairy Eternity was no longer in his sight, Lu Yang started recalling the Buddhist scriptures. The contents of the "Diamond Sutra", the "Mingwang Sutra", and the "Heart Sutra" surfaced before his eyes. Lu Yang contemplated and tried to understand the author's emotions within the scriptures, placing himself in that context.
In reality, Meng Jingzhou watched Lu Yang in surprise.
Lu Yang keeps his eyes tightly shut, his movements slower than at the beginning, as if he were an old man, withered as a piece of wood. However, his every action exudes the benign aura of a revered monk.
"Could it be that this Lu Yang kid is suited for monkhood?" Meng Jingzhou secretly speculated.
As Lu Yang deepened his understanding of the Buddhist scriptures and the Arhat Fist, his movements became even smoother, like the flow of clouds and water, without the slightest pause. It was as if he had practised hundreds or thousands of times, memorizing the movements by heart and transforming them into instinct.
Boom-- boom--
With every punch Lu Yang threw, a sound like the bursting of air could be heard. A faint echo of Buddhist chants lingered in the air, as if a venerable monk were reading scriptures in the void, teaching the world to be kind to others.
Lu Yang practiced arhat boxing with his eyes closed, from dawn until dusk. Seeing that he had little else to teach, Meng Jingzhou squatted at the side, waiting to see when this grandson of his would finally open his eyes.
"Phew--"
After completing a set, Lu Yang regulated his breathing and opened his eyes. His pupils were bright, exuding wisdom.
"Did you master it?" Meng Jingzhou looked at Lu Yang in astonishment. It had taken him whole three days to master it, but did Lu Yang achieve it in a day's work?
Is there no justice in the world?
"I have made some progress." Lu Yang humbly replied.
"Let's try it." Meng Jingzhou was eager to see how well Lu Yang had learned. He did not believe that after practicing for half a month, he could lose to Lu Yang who only started learning a day ago.
"Let's give it a try." Lu Yang was itching for a sparring session to assess his own skills.
Both men stared at each other, assumed their stances simultaneously, and initiated the Arhat Fist, engaging in a pure comparison of skills.
"Black Tiger Dig Heart!"
"Black Tiger Dig Heart!"
"Downward Hammer Punch!"
"Downward Hammer Punch!"
Their fists and feet collided with great force, like thunderbolts exploding in the field, causing the old trees surrounding the field to rustle.
The two of them matched each other in terms of moves and strength, making it tough to determine the outcome.
"Who would've thought...you learned for just one day and you're already as skilled with the Arhat Fist as I am. Maybe one day, you will fully master the Arhat Fist and be successful in persuading people to be good!"
"It's just a fluke." Although Lu Yang speaks this way, his smug expression reveals that he is not being modest at all.
Just as Lu Yang was about to stay humble for a little longer, he unintentionally glanced at the top of Meng Jingzhou's head and his expression slightly changed.
"What's wrong, is there a problem with my head?" Meng Jingzhou was puzzled.
"No, no problem." Lu Yang avoided eye contact, looking as though he had done something wrong.
Meng Jingzhou gave Lu Yang a suspicious look and subconsciously reached for his head.
Wait a minute, has something on my head disappeared?
"Where's my hair?!"
Meng Jingzhou took out a small mirror from his jade pendant and inspected his head for a long time.
His head was as slick as a watermelon, a sparrow would slip if it tried to land on it.
He was bald.
Just like an Arhat.
In the spiritual space, Fairy Eternity was laughing uproariously.
"Lu Yang, explain to me what's going on!" Meng Jingzhou's first reaction was to suspect Lu Yang.
His hair was part of his body refining process, how could it just fall out without reason?
He just noticed, there's hair all over his feet, freshly shed.
"I, I also don't know. Your hair was falling out at an alarming rate while we were sparring. By the time I wanted to alert you, it was already all gone." Lu Yang sounded a bit panicked, he genuinely didn't understand where the problem was.
While saying this, Lu Yang seemed to have realized something and exclaimed: "I understand now."
"What did you understand?"
"Think about it, isn't the purpose of the Arhat Fist to persuade people towards goodness? Evil comes from worries, and Buddhism talks about the Three Thousand Strands of Worry. Without these three thousand strands, there would be no ill intentions, and one can then move on to being good. "
"Furthermore, doesn't your appearance resemble that of an Arhat? It matches perfectly with the Arhat Fist!"
Upon hearing this, Meng Jingzhou sprang at Lu Yang like a hungry tiger pouncing on its prey. "You're the one who looks like an Arhat!"
Lu Yang, feeling guilty, turned and ran. "I've completed the Arhat Fist, you can't hit me!"
"Your technique is not Arhat Fist at all, it's a head-shaving technique! Stand still!"
(Thanks to the book friend 20220115152208435 for the reward of the lordship)

chapters.title: Chapter 253 - 252: Still Saying You're Not a Monk_1
chapters.content:
The four days passed quickly. When the Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain gathered at the city gate as agreed, they looked with surprise at Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
"Young masters, where's your hair?" The elder with the hooked beak blurted out the question when he saw that Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had no hair on their heads.
He regretted the moment he asked, as the expressions of the two young masters visibly darkened when the subject was brought up.
Meng Jingzhou's hair never grew back, and optimistically, it probably would need a few more days.
To apologize, Lu Yang had no choice but to shave his own head to placate Meng Jingzhou's anger.
This whole time, Fairy Eternity never stopped enjoying their plight.
The elder with the hooked beak started to ponder, wondering if the two young masters were disciples of the Buddhist sect and had been wearing wigs the entire time?
The more he thought about it, the more sense it made. The two young masters never revealed their backgrounds and it was quite possible that they were from a Buddhist sect and were reluctant to show off.
Now, to compete for the Twin Lotus, they not only needed strength but intimidating identities as well!
As for killing and eating Demon Beasts, there were certain monks in Buddhism who indulged in meat and alcohol, not many, but there were indeed some.
"Let's go," muttered Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, uninterested in providing any explanations.
Following the map provided by the merchant guild, they quickly arrived at the lake where the Twin Lotus was located.
By now, the area surrounding the lake was packed with people. Most of them were at the Foundation Establishment late stage, followed by those at the Golden Core Stage.
The Twin Lotus had a miraculous effect on forming the golden core, hence attracting a large number of cultivators who needed to form their golden cores.
Its usefulness significantly diminished when one reached the Golden Core Stage, otherwise, just the lake's owner wouldn't be enough to guard the Twin Lotus.
In the middle of the lake, two lotus flowers were about to bloom, their plump pink buds resembled newborn twins. Everyone's gaze was fixed on the lotus flowers.
"This place is full of water, it's going to be inconvenient to fight when we scramble for the lotus," a cultivator at the Foundation Establishment late stage furrowed his eyebrows. He wasn't good at water battles and this would be disadvantageous if his opponents specialized in water magic.
"Drain the water."
So saying, he pulled out his storage ring and started storing the lake water with gusto.
Seeing this, the others considered it a good strategy and followed suit.
The storage ring could only store lifeless things so it was perfect for storing water without affecting the creatures in the lake.
"That's the White Tiger Saint Son from the Quadruple Sect! I heard he mastered a set of ruthless skills. Even though he's only at the mid-stage of Foundation Establishment, he has a fighting chance against those at the half-step to Golden Core Stage!" The elder with the hooked beak had been busy gathering information on who might come to compete for the Twin Lotus.
The White Tiger Saint Son was one of them.
The Quadruple Sect was a renowned First Class Sect famous for its Four Beasts inheritance. Throughout its history, it rarely declined due to its exceptional inheritors.
The Central Continent habitually classified sects into different grades. Those without a cultivator at the Spirit Transformation Stage were considered bottom-tier sects.
Next up were the Third-Grade Sects, boasting several cultivators at the Spirit Transformation Stage.
Second-Grade Sects had several cultivators at the Refining the Void stage.
The First-Grade Sects were home to numerous cultivators at the Unification Stage.
Above them, the Extraordinary Sects, were those with a Great Power who had passed the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
Over the Extraordinary Sects stood the Five Great Immortal Sects.
The public criterion for the Five Great Immortal Sects was the presence of a cultivator who had passed the Transcendance Tribulation Stage and possessed a similar level of strength.
However, the true extent of their strength and resources remained a mystery.
"And that female cultivator, An Ke, the Closed Door Disciple of the Sect Leader of the Clear Moon Sect. Her cultivation level is at the late stage of Foundation Establishment. She's the strongest amongst those at the Foundation Establishment stage in the Clear Moon Sect. Even the Sect Leader once declared that he is not her match at the same level."
Rumors had it that the Laurel Fairy Palace backed the Clear Moon Sect, but this always remained unverified.
"That's Duan Hongchen, Tianwen Sword. He has killed Golden Core Stage Demon Beasts multiple times. People assumed he had formed his golden core, but in reality, he's only half a step into the Golden Core Stage, always on the lookout for the right opportunity for golden core formation!"
The elder with the hooked beak pointed out everyone who was worth noting. Some of them came from various sects and influential families, with exceptional inheritances, while others were local residents of the Demon Suppressing Pass, known for their repute.
In comparison, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were less renowned. They were relatively new in the Demon Suppressing Pass, spending their time in seclusion in the dense forest, and rarely interacting with others. Therefore, few people knew about them.
"Who are those two monks? Disciples of the White Horse Temple? Or the Pagoda Temple?"
Someone noticed Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, the only two bald people in the crowd, standing out among the masses.
The White Tiger Saint Son frowned, "I've visited both the White Horse Temple and the Pagoda Temple with my master before, but I've never seen these two."
"Wild monks? Or are they from some unknown temple?" As a member of the Quadruple Sect, he always deemed sects below the First Grade as insignificant, not worth his attention.
An Ke remained expressionless. She glanced at Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou out of the corner of her eye, compared them to the high-level Foundation Establishment Stage masters in her memory, found no match, and thus paid them no heed.
Tianwen Sword Duan Hongchen dismissed Lu Yang and the others since they were only at the late stage of Foundation Establishment. His real competitors were those Golden Core Stage cultivators hiding within the crowd.
These Golden Core cultivators were here to grab the Twin Lotus for their juniors to form the golden core. They wouldn't fight too hard, and when encountered with life and death situation, they would be the first to retreat.
When Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou heard the crowd speculating that they were monks, their veins bulged in annoyance. You're a monk! Your entire family is full of monks!
"This is all your fault, forcing me to shave my head," Lu Yang vented out at Meng Jingzhou first.
Meng Jingzhou was well-prepared for this: "My fault? Clearly, your Arhat Fist is ridiculously off-track! Just you wait until I write a recommendation letter and send you to the Suspension Temple!"
With Lu Yang's qualifications, he was fit to join the Suspension Temple, or saying that Suspension Temple might ardently welcome him was also possible.
After all, another being with magical skills comparable to the Eldest Senior Sister was nowhere to be found in the whole world.
"Lu Yang, are you considering becoming a monk?" Fairy Eternity asked, clinging on to him warily.
"No, the Seek Dao Sect is my home, and I won't go anywhere else!" Lu Yang made his stance clear, that he would always stay as part of the Seek Dao Sect, living or dead.
"Look, the lotus is about to bloom," someone shouted, capturing everyone's attention.
The Twin Lotus bloomed, releasing a captivating fragrance that provoked a frenzied scramble amongst the crowd.
With a tiger's roar, the White Tiger Saint Son made the first move. A 'king' character slowly emerged on his forehead, his cheeks sprouted white fur, and his pupils turned vertical, transforming him into an old tiger.
"The Twin Lotus is mine, no one should try to snatch it!" He roared and dashed toward it like a gust of wind.
"You think it's yours just because you said so? Arhat Fist!" Meng Jingzhou made his move, unleashing the Arhat Fist. His face showed compassion and mercy for all beings, an expression impossible to wear without at least twenty years as a monk.
The weight of his fist was astounding; it sent the White Tiger Saint Son sprawling into a mud pool.
The White Tiger Saint Son was dazed. This was his first failure in challenging someone above his level.
All his fights had always been challenging a superior level, defeating cultivators at Foundation Establishment late stage effortlessly with his Foundation Establishment mid-stage level. He had never been defeated before.
But he had lost this time.
"I knew they were monks!" An Ke was certain her previous guess was accurate.
"You're the monk!" Meng Jingzhou retorted angrily.
"A bald head, the Arhat Fist, how can you say you're not a monk?"

chapters.title: Chapter 254 - 253 Buddhism Gathering_1
chapters.content:
The Twin Lotus is related to the formation of the golden core, and no one would give it up. Multiple cultivators at the late stage of Foundation Establishment were fighting a chaotic battle.
The Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain knew their limits. They realized they could only use their skills for survival in a dense forest. If they had to confront an enemy head-on, their skills would be inadequate.
Moreover, having witnessed the combat abilities of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, the Five Heroes doubted that anyone could snatch the lotus away from them.
Whoever can defeat an opponent in a higher realm would brag about it as if it were great feat.
But look at these two monks. They could fight across a superior realm, achieving consecutive victories. Such combat power was only heard in rumors. The Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain had never seen such a thing before.
"Could these two be from the Suspension Temple?"
"Can Suspension Temple recruit two people at once?"
"Considering the abilities of these two young heroes, it might be possible."
Meng Jingzhou was ranked second among his peers. One could also say he was second among all the cultivators of the Five Great Immortal Sects. Naturally, his stunning combat power attracted many cultivators to attack him, including those at the Golden Core Stage.
"Lu Yang, quit standing around watching!" Meng Jingzhou took on his opponents with Arhat Fist while calling on Lu Yang to assist him.
"And here I thought you, the great hero Meng, could single-handedly take on all challengers." Lu Yang teased as he prepared to join the battle.
Four cultivators at the late stage of Foundation Establishment attacked Lu Yang. Without looking, Lu Yang sidestepped, easily avoiding the attack. He lightly tapped their bellies with his hands. They felt their stomachs churn and began to vomit violently.
Vomiting sound—
"Stop him!" The crowd realized that Lu Yang was a cultivator not inferior to Meng Jingzhou and a major adversary in the battle for the lotus.
"Shatter Mountain Palm!" Another cultivator attacked Lu Yang. His palms were iron-blue, hardened by a thousand hammers and a hundred forgeings. His skin was tough as iron, resisting even the heat of a furnace.
"Drawing a Jail!" Lu Yang extended his index finger and lightly drew a circle on the ground. The man's body suddenly disappeared into the ground.
It seemed as if an invisible hand had forcefully dragged him down.
This eerie method made everyone shudder. They had no idea how to counter it.
"A disciple of the Dao of Painting?!" someone exclaimed, recognizing Lu Yang's method. It was just like the artists of the Confucian school who could alter the course of the world with a simple stroke of their brush!
Isn't this guy a disciple of Buddhism? How does he know Confucian techniques?
Lu Yang simply smirked and didn't bother to explain. He kept drawing circles. Despite being surrounded and attacked by the crowd, he was as relaxed as if he were alone in the world.
Anyone who neared him was captured and thrown into the jail below ground.
"Taste my blade, Sky Question!" Duan Hongchen secretly took action. The Sky Question blade was gleaming, so bright that others couldn't open their eyes.
"Arhat Fist!" Lu Yang crouched with his right leg, tense with his left. The power flowed through his body, concentrated in his left fist. Forward he thrust, deflecting the swipe from the Sky Question blade and smashing into Duan Hongchen's face.
Duan Hongchen felt as if a mountain was crashing into him head-on, the force was so massive and heavy that no tricks could defend against it.
"Life is full of suffering, but salvation lies within reach!"
Lu Yang attacked continuously, hitting Duan Hongchen. Duan Hongchen felt pain all over his body, as if all of his bones had been disjointed.
Duan Hongchen was thrown back, and his vision turned black.
"Huh? What's this?" The darkness before him wasn't because he was losing consciousness. Something black was blocking his eyes.
"Hair? Whose?" Without thinking, Duan Hongchen touched his head.
So shiny. Whose head was bald?
"Where's my hair?!" It suddenly dawned on Duan Hongchen. Where was the hair he had so carefully combed?
What is the most important thing for a master? To put on a deep façade, giving off an air of mystery.
And of course, a crucial element is hair!
Now that his hair was gone, he lost half of his mysterious appeal.
"Be careful, his Arhat Fist can make you lose your hair!" Duan Hongchen loudly warned the others.
An Ke, who originally wanted to ambush from the dark, turned pale upon hearing these words.
If she didn't get the Twin Lotus, it didn't matter. She could find other ways to form the golden core. But losing her hair would be a disaster!
Run!
Without a second thought, she turned and ran!
"Trying to escape?" Clearly, Lu Yang was not one to let his enemies go easily. He chased her relentlessly.
"Don't chase me. I don't want the Twin Lotus anymore!" An Ke shouted, attempting to show her goodwill.
"Trying to catch me off guard, eh? I'm tired of that trick!" Lu Yang responded, thinking An Ke might play dirty just like he would.
"Stop hurting Fairy An Ke!" Someone, who was captivated by An Ke's beauty, tried to stop Lu Yang, but was punched out of the way by Lu Yang, leaving his hair scattered on the ground.
"Halt, scoundrel!"
"Stop hurting people!"
One after another, people tried to stop Lu Yang, only to be punched away by his Arhat Fist.
"Can you do a buzz cut?" someone asked Lu Yang in a low voice.
Lu Yang nodded. After practicing the Arhat Fist in the martial arts field for four days, he had reaped great benefits and could now craft hairstyles at will.
"Give me one!"
Nicely, Lu Yang made his move, sending the man flying.
The whole place was in chaos. An Ke was running around the lake with Lu Yang close behind. Anyone who got close to Lu Yang was punched twice and became bald.
Luckily, in the end, An Ke's protector showed up, dragged An Ke away, and didn't let Lu Yang hit her.
"Next!" Losing his target, Lu Yang quickly found a new one.
Lu Yang's Arhat Fist was as powerful as the genuine one, and it made people bald. Even an accomplished monk would have to agree that it was a true Buddhist technique.
Whether they wanted it or not, regardless of their cultivation level, everyone was punched by Lu Yang.
Lu Yang was like a lawnmower, leaving nothing hairy wherever he went.
"First, get rid of this guy!" Everyone was furious and no longer focused on grabbing the Twin Lotus. They all aimed at Lu Yang. No one was even bothering with Meng Jingzhou anymore.
The Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain watched this scene by the lake, sweat dripping in fear. They tried their best to minimize their presence, worrying the crowd would take out their anger on them.
Conscience of heaven and earth, they were just guides. They had no connection with Lu Yang.
"Excuse me, what happened here?" A gentle voice suddenly rang out. The Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain were shocked, thinking they were caught.
They looked back and saw a man and a woman. They had no idea when they had arrived.
The man was sturdy, like a member of the Barbarian tribe. The woman was slim, her face a bit young, with her age not seeming to be high.
It was Man Gu and Tao Yaoye.
Not long ago, Eldest Senior Sister had found Man Gu and Tao Yaoye, telling them that Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had excellent performances during their field training. Therefore, they should also learn from them.
So, they took a flying boat and traveled by carriage, finally reaching the Demon Suppressing Pass after twists and turns.
At the Pass, they heard that the Twin Lotus was about to bloom, so they came to see what was happening and join in the excitement.
Unexpectedly, when they arrived, they saw a group of bald-headed people fighting fiercely in a pit, as if it was a Buddhist gathering.
They learned from a bystander that Lu Yang had displayed some sorcery to shave people's heads, igniting their anger, and was being besieged.
"Ah, I see. Eldest Senior Sister must have hoped that we would learn from Brother Lu's courage in bravely facing a group of enemies despite the hardships!" Man Gu had an epiphany.

chapters.title: Chapter 255 - 254: The Unification Battle Method is Flawless Again_1
chapters.content:
"May I ask, fellow daoist, do you know the two bald men over there in the mud pit?" Tao Yaoye politely asked the beak-nosed leader.
At the same time, she was a bit confused, she didn't recall Lu Yang or Meng Jingzhou being bald.
What kind of accident could cause them to go bald?
Tao Yaoye paused for a moment, as if she wouldn't be surprised if any accident happened with these two around.
The Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain thought that Tao Yaoye and Man Gu were here to seek revenge from thousands of miles away, so they quickly shook their heads and said they didn't know.
"We just arrived and don't know these two bald young heroes, just heard that one of them is called Lu Yang who seems to be a Buddhist practitioner skilled in Arhat Fist. Whoever gets hit by his fist will lose their hair."
Tao Yaoye: "..."
When did Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou become Buddhists?
Which Buddhism dares to take these two?
To his knowledge, the abbot of Suspension Temple was yelling every day to suppress Daoist Buyu, the sinner.
Man Gu pondered for a while and understood the deep intentions of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou: "To hide their identities while travelling, Brother Lu and Brother Meng, aware of their flamboyant actions which might involve the Seek Dao Sect, thus both of them shaved their heads, pretending to be Buddhists!"
Man Gu felt that Eldest Senior Sister lived up to her reputation. When she let them come to the Demon Suppressing Pass to learn from Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, she must have predicted the current situation.
Isn't it, they learned quite a lot just upon meeting.
"Do you two know them?" The hook-nosed leader saw Tao Yaoye and Man Gu's unusual expressions and suspected they knew each other.
"My name is Tao Yaoye, this is Man Gu, we, as well as Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou over there in the mud pit, are all disciples of the Seek Dao Sect." Tao Yaoye explained.
"Seek Dao Sect?!" The Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain were shocked, they never expected Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou to have such extraordinary backgrounds.
Thinking about it, two young heroes could easily defeat the successor of a first-grade sect, the force behind them must be much stronger than a first-grade sect.
But coming from the Seek Dao Sect is quite terrifying.
The Seek Dao Sect is often considered one of the Five Great Immortal Sects, with a history of over one hundred and twenty thousand years. even longer existence than the Great Xia Dynasty, its profound foundation is unfathomable and there were rumors that the strength of the Seek Dao Sect surpasses all, it's the leader of the Five Great Immortal Sects!
The strongest sect!
The hook-nosed leader breathed a sigh of relief. As long as the others were not his enemies, everything would be fine.
Then he explained, their group was hired as guides by Meng Jingzhou. Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou came here to rob the Twin Lotus.
"For forming golden core, huh." Tao Yaoye nodded, she and Man Gu were just one step away from the late stage of foundation establishment, also here to look for opportunities in the dense forest to form the golden core.
"Could it be that Senior Brother Lu intends to find the opportunity to form the golden core in the battle, so he provokes the crowd and allowed himself to be surrounded on purpose?" Tao Yaoye skeptically looked at Lu Yang, this was the most probable reason.
Lu Yang is under great pressure now.He came here to rob the Twin Lotus, and using the Arhat Fist was purely for self-defense.
He didn't expect that after the Arhat Fist was finished, he would face the rage of nearly a hundred late-stage foundation establishment cultivators, and more than a dozen Golden Core Stage cultivators.
Meng Jingzhou was greatly moved. Previously, when he asked Lu Yang for help, Lu Yang surprisingly changed his past style, actively attracted hate, and now no one was paying attention to him anymore.
Such loyalty!
Lu Yang calmly explained, "Fellow daoists, I think there might be some misunderstandings between us. I have a friend who is good at refining. Making wigs is not a problem. After this is over, I can take you to meet him..."
"Go to hell!" The crowd didn't listen to Lu Yang's explanation at all and rushed towards him.
Lu Yang's combat power was extraordinary, he could even defeat someone in the late Golden Core Stage, but facing such a number of cultivators, he still felt somewhat inadequate.
Though Lu Yang felt his power was limited, those who besieged him felt he was profoundly powerful. Even though he was only at the late stage of foundation establishment, he could easily handle the siege at his level, could even one in the Golden Core Stage achieve this?
"Shrink the land!"
Lu Yang performed the Earth Escape Skill, in order to escape.
"He's using Earth Escape Skill!" One person in the crowd, proficient in earth attribute laws, broke Lu Yang's skill.
Without saying a word, he attacked the ground, blasted Lu Yang out directly.
Lu Yang was struggling to deal with enemies from all directions, accidentally spotted Tao Yaoye and Man Gu standing by the lake, and felt like he had seen saviors.
"Junior Brother Man, come and save me!" Lu Yang shouted, "Junior Sister Tao, you stand on the shore and help!"
Seeing this, Man Gu jumped into the mud pit and went to rescue Lu Yang.
Meng Jingzhou also broke through countless obstacles and came to Lu Yang's side.
At this moment, the three of Eternity Sect had regrouped, displaying enormous fighting power.
"You all know what to do, right?"
Lu Yang was like facing a formidable enemy, Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu nodded their heads, as if they had a tacit understanding.
"Unification!"
The three shouted at the same time, displaying the unification battle method again.
Only this time, Lu Yang was the main body, lifting Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu.
Upon seeing this, the crowd hesitated for a while.
Had not seen such a way of fighting, huh?
Tao Yaoye watching by the shore paused for a while.
She also had not seen this kind of pose.
Moreover, Senior Brother Lu asked her to help on the shore, but what was she supposed to do?
Lu Yang snorted coldly, a stream of sword qi was transmitted to Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu's body surfaces, they instantly became extremely sharp, like two sharp swords.
"Let them witness our might!" Lu Yang bellowed.
Lu Yang was a Sword Spirit Root, he hadn't used a sword prior to this because he feared that the Green Peak Sword is too strong, might kill people, but now with Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu in his hands, he wasn't afraid anymore.
These two guys were nearly analogous to blunt instruments, just with an added layer of sword qi, wouldn't really kill people.
Lu Yang, after practicing for several months, his double-hand sword skills found a place to display, he swung Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu, spinning around in the mud pit like a top.
Whichever person was contacted directly flew horizontally, even the golden core cultivators hidden in them were not exceptions.
After the fall of Eternity Sect, the three of them returned to Seek Dao Sect and practiced how to spin. This time the spinning time was much longer than when they were at Eternity Sect!
"Keep your distance from them, this move can't sustain for long!" Duan Hongchen, the Heaven Asking Sword, had abundant fighting experience and immediately realized the flaw of this move.
Indeed, the three had undergone grueling training, but once the spin cycle elongated, they would eventually be unable to sustain.
"Senior Brother Lu, I'm about to vomit." Man Gu sent a message to Lu Yang.
"Me too." Said Meng Jingzhou.
"Have faith in Junior Sister Tao." Lu Yang responded calmly.
Tao Yaoye understood Lu Yang's intentions upon seeing this.
She opened her red paper umbrella, pointed two fingers at her lips, quietly read a spell, and opened an illusion barrier.
The illusions that affected people's cognition enveloped this entire mud pit.
What she was best at were illusions.
But her target wasn't the enemy, instead, it was Lu Yang and the others.
Those who were originally dizzy instantly felt a lightness in their body as if they couldn't feel their surroundings, and they were no longer dizzy.
In reality, the three of Lu Yang were still fighting, but now it was Tao Yaoye who was controlling the bodies of the three with illusions and their consciousness was isolated from the outside world! Can't perceive the changes of the body!
There wouldn't be problems with dizziness like this!
At this point, there were no more flaws in the Unification Battle Method!

chapters.title: Chapter 256 - 255 Reliable Tao Yaoye_1
chapters.content:
"Huh, this is a good method!" Meng Jingzhou laughed and relaxed a bit.
After all, right now it was Tao Yaoye controlling their three bodies, and they didn't really have to do anything.
"I thought of this method on the spur of the moment. Don't underestimate the intelligence of Junior Sister Tao. A glance from me and she understood my intention." Lu Yang was quite pleased with himself for coming up with this trick.
At first, Man Gu didn't understand what was going on and tried to resist the illusion, but Lu Yang calmed him down.
"This illusion was created by Junior Sister Tao to prevent us from getting dizzy."
In reality, the fighting style of the trio was extravagant and bold, reflecting the grandeur of ancient generals sweeping through armies.
Tao Yaoye was becoming more and more skilled at controlling the three of them, leaving their opponents dripping wet in defeat.
The Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain exchanged stunned glances after seeing this display.
These were indeed students of the Seek Dao Sect with their unorthodox fighting style unlike ordinary cultivators.
"What kind of strategy is this?!" The crowd inside the pit was terrified.
Throughout history, when three people attacked at the same time, they were often not in tune with each other or not well-coordinated leading to inability to utilize their full strength.
Just like them, they were seven people attacking Lu Yang, but the power they displayed was equivalent to three or four people at most.
In contrast, after the combination of the three of Lu Yang, their combat power increased threefold. The perfect coordination allowed them to fully unleash their strength.
"So, is this the fighting method of Buddhism?!"
The crowd couldn't be blamed for guessing as such. People from Buddhism rarely made a move. Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were clearly Buddhists, and with Man Gu's vicious appearance, it was likely that Buddhism nurtured him as a protector.
"It is rare to witness the fighting style of Buddhism. Today, I finally saw it."
It could be considered as boasting in a way.
Even when their hair is shaved off, it can grow back again, but the fighting style of Buddhism is not easy to come by.
At the edge of the lake, Tao Yaoye was panting from exhaustion. She had to maintain the illusion while figuring out how to coordinate the movements of the three of them to break the blockade.
Probably because Lu Yang had made too many enemies, there was a firm resolution in everyone to not let Lu Yang escape.
"Since the purpose of this trip is the Twin Lotus, isn't it enough to just take the lotus?" Tao Yaoye used the illusion to conceal her own presence, cunningly jumped into the mud pit, and took the Twin Lotus.
"The lotus is gone..." Someone inadvertently glanced back and found out the lotus was no more.
Just as he was about to shout, Tao Yaoye stuck her finger out, gently pressing it on the man's forehead, sending him into a deep illusion.
Seeing that the lotus was already in hand, Tao Yaoye took off running, leaving behind only a fading silhouette.
"The lotus is gone!" Finally, someone noticed the most important thing about this trip - the Twin Lotus had been stolen!
"It was her who took it away!" Someone pointed at the distant Tao Yaoye.
"Chase her!"
More than half of the people went to chase Tao Yaoye, which finally gave Lu Yang and the others some reprieve.
The remaining twenty or so cultivators in the late Foundation Establishment Stage didn't pose much of a threat anymore.
The three of them weren't worried about Tao Yaoye either. Tao Yaoye was skilled in creating illusions, escaping pursuit was an easy task for her. Even Meng Jingzhou wasn't confident that he could completely see through Tao Yaoye's illusion.
Among those in the Foundation Establishment Stage, Tao Yaoye's illusions could be considered the strongest.
Only Lu Yang was not afraid of illusions due to the uniqueness of his cultivation technique.
"Young Hero Lu, Young Hero Meng, Miss Tao told you to wait for her at the Yuanming Inn later." The big brother with the hooked nose ran over to relay the message after seeing Lu Yang and the others defeat the rest of the people in no time.
"Alright, I got it. You've worked hard, Big Brother Eagle."
The Big Brother with the hooked nose quickly waved his hand: "I wouldn't dare say that, we didn't manage to help much this time."
Man Gu added: "The Yuanming Inn is where Junior Sister Tao and I stay when we're in Demon Suppressing Pass."
Among the top five in their cohort, Tao Yaoye was third, and Man Gu was fourth.
Lu Yang laughed: "That's quite a coincidence, the Yuanming Inn is where Meng Jingzhou and I are staying too."
"Let's go back; Junior Sister Tao might get back before us."
...
When they returned to the inn, Tao Yaoye was already there waiting for them, leaning against the wall and yawning from boredom, with a wooden box in her right hand.
"What is up with the three of you dressing like this?" Tao Yaoye looked at the trio, her face filled with curiosity.
Lu Yang and the other two were wearing black hoods, their faces hidden, looking like they were guilty of something.
This type of attire is quite common in Demon Suppressing Pass, but it was unusual for Lu Yang.
Lu Yang sighed: "Isn't it because we ran into cultivators who got their heads shaved by me on our way back? We were afraid they would recognize us, so we disguised ourselves."
"This time, we've completely offended all the late-stage cultivators at the Demon Suppressing Pass."
Tao Yaoye rolled her eyes: "Isn't that what you asked for? Insisting on using the Arhat Fist? And why would the Arhat Fist cause people to lose their hair? Is it designed to transform people into Arhats?"
"It's called encouraging people to be righteous, it's the manifestation of the mastery of the Arhat Fist, and who knew that the Arhat Fist would cause such impressive hair loss?" Lu Yang tried to defend himself.
Tao Yaoye unofficially disregarded Lu Yang's argument, she raised the wooden box she had been carrying: "The Twin Lotus is here, let's go upstairs."
This was a prime sandalwood box, it could shield against Spiritual Sense detection, ensuring the aura of the Twin Lotus was not leaked.
"Bidding farewell to the four of you, young heroes." The Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain saluted and bid farewell to Lu Yang.
"Let's go, Meng Jingzhou and I are also staying at this inn."
"What a coincidence?" Tao Yaoye was surprised, then remembered Meng Jingzhou's status, "Is it because this inn is the most expensive one at the Demon Suppressing Pass?"
"That's right," Meng Jingzhou laughed, he always chose the priciest item and accommodations were no exception.
The four of them headed over to Meng Jingzhou's room.
"Why did you two come to Demon Suppressing Pass as well?" Lu Yang asked curiously.
Did you two also recklessly ask about the age of Senior Sister and got banished here?
"A few days ago, I had some insights while cultivating and wanted to find someone to discuss it with. So, I went to Sky Gate Mountain to find you, but Senior Sister told me you weren't there and that you'd gone to Demon Suppressing Pass with Meng Jingzhou ten days ago."
"Senior Sister said she had been keeping an eye on you two, noticing that your cultivation progress in Demon Suppressing Pass was quite effective. So, she suggested Man Gu and I come here as well."
"At first, we wanted to bring Li Haoran along, but for some reason, Senior Sister said it wasn't safe for Li Haoran to leave the Seek Dao Sect, so he didn't come."
"And that's how the two of us ended up here."
After listening, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou broke into cold sweats. Senior Sister was indeed omniscient and omnipotent, able to discern their actions. It was lucky that they had been careful with their words and actions these past few days, not speaking ill of Senior Sister.
Meng Jingzhou was feeling particularly fortunate.
He remembered when they had just arrived in the dense forest, he said that Senior Sister had banished them to the frontier. It was Lu Yang's timely reminder that made him change his words, so he was able to avoid calamity.
As Tao Yaoye was speaking, she opened the wooden box.
Inside the box, the Twin Lotus lay quietly.
"We went through all that trouble to get the Twin Lotus, how should we divide it up?"
"Lu Yang, I want the Lotus seed! It's delicious!" Fairy Eternity was shouting in the Spiritual Space, pounding the ground to remind Lu Yang.
Lu Yang pretended not to hear the commotion in his Spiritual Space.

chapters.title: Chapter 257 - 256: Mother-child River and Twin River_1
chapters.content:
"Back when I was a ruler over a realm, an entire planet was my territory, mine to command, to benefit the world."
"This Twin Lotus is a new species cultivated by me."
"Really?"
Fairy Eternity kept yammering on within Lu Yang's Spiritual Space. Initially, Lu Yang treated it as background noise, entering one ear and exiting the other, without paying any attention to what she was saying.
But now, Lu Yang was interested.
Lu Yang had always thought that natural treasures existed since ancient times and had remained unchanged.
For example, valuable medicinal materials, like ginseng and glossy ganoderma, or even commonplace plants like dog tails and dandelions that have been known since the beginning of human history.
Being called natural treasures, they were naturally born and nurtured by the earth.
Lu Yang had never heard of any natural treasures being cultivated by individuals of great power in later generations.
But now, he had heard of such a thing.
"Tell me, what happened?" Lu Yang asked eagerly.
Fairy Eternity smiled triumphantly, very pleased with Lu Yang's attitude. This was how immortals should be treated.
"To talk about this, I have to mention my own capabilities."
"That happened after I obtained immortality. As you know, I was quite renowned during ancient times, many people willingly worshipped me."
"At that time, I was approached by a devout female follower who desired a set of twins. Despite the fact that such a thing was not within human control, she applied for my intervention."
"Upon reflection, I realized fulfilling such a wish wouldn't pose any problem, so I set to work." Fairy Eternity was a balanced immortal, she didn't grant every wish.
"Originally, I could have concocted an elixir to help the follower give birth to twins, but then I remembered something Immortal Jiuchong once said."
"Immortal Jiuchong said, 'When one follower makes a wish, ten will want to ask for the same thing.'"
"Childbirth is an eternal desire. It's impossible that only one follower would want twins."
"Even if I created an elixir now, if others request the same from me in the future, what am I supposed to do? Continue to concoct more elixirs? That's too troublesome."
"So I thought of a 'once and for all' solution. Using my highest divine ability, I drew on the spiritual energy of the heavens and the earth, extracted the rhymes of the Dao, altered some rules, used whatever methods you can't understand right now and transformed a river into an immortal artifact."
"Anyone who drinks from this river can nurture two fetuses in their womb."
"I named the river Twin River."
After a moment of silence, Lu Yang asked, "… You wouldn't have whimsically created another river later, called Mother-child River, would you? To make it so that, after drinking the water, a woman could get pregnant and only have girls?"
"No, I didn't..."
Lu Yang breathed a sigh of relief.
"Before I created the Twin River, I had already created the Mother-child River."
Fairy Eternity looked curious, "How did you know about Mother-child River, is it recorded in ancient books?"
"Let's just say I dreamt about it."
Without thinking more about it, Fairy Eternity continued, "Living beings that grow in the river are influenced by the river water, undergoing a deviation, or change from the source of their souls."
"Among these changes, the most obvious was a lotus plant. Originally, it would only bloom a single lotus, but after growing from the Twin River, it would bloom two."
"I found this interesting, so I named this lotus..."
"Twin Lotus?" Anticipating Fairy Eternity's train of thought, Lu Yang blurted out.
"Sister Lotus."
Lu Yang: "..."
"When Yingtian Immortal heard of this, he advised me, saying that calling it Sister Lotus wasn't good, it didn't reflect the sense of an immortal creating a plant. He suggested I change the name to Twin Lotus."
"I liked this name, so I agreed."
"The taste of the seeds of the Sister Lotus was not bad. I often made porridge with them and served it to Yingtian and the others."
Fairy Eternity had previously stated that lotus-seed soup could bless someone with many children and prosperity. She wasn't just talking; this was really a possibility.
"With the end of ancient times, I am not sure where Mother-child River and Twin River have gone. Whether someone transformed them into other Immortal Artifacts or hid them somewhere, I do not know."
The Twin Lotus, a valuable natural treasure that can assist people in forming the First-Grade Golden Core, was usually thought to be naturally born and nurtured by the earth. No one had considered that it was created by an Immortal, and at first, its purpose wasn't even to form the Golden Core, but to make porridge.
"Relying on the Twin Lotus to form a Golden Core is not a real skill. Stick with me, and I will teach you how to form the Invincible Golden Core." Fairy Eternity scoffed at the idea of using the Twin Lotus to form a Golden Core. She thought that the Golden Cores formed this way were far inferior to her own.
Even among First-Grade Golden Cores, there are superior and inferior ones.
Lu Yang rolled his eyes and ignored Fairy Eternity, then returned to discussing how to divide the lotus.
"Since the utility of the Twin Lotus is to form a Golden Core, why don't we all observe the lotuses together, see who gains the insight to golden core formation, and then that person can have the lotuses. What do you think?"
Meng Jingzhou's proposal garnered agreement from the other three.
Meng Jingzhou fetched a flower vase and placed the Twin Lotus into it. The four individuals huddled together, their eyes transfixed on the Twin Lotus.
This scene was a bit eerie, similar to some kind of forbidden ritual conducted by a demonic sect.
Luckily, all four of them were Seek Dao Sect disciples, following the Righteous Path, so there wouldn't be any suspicion.
Lu Yang stared hard at the Twin Lotus, hoping, like his Second Senior Brother, to be able to form a strong Yin-Yang Golden Core.
Meng Jingzhou etched the image of the Twin Lotus in his mind.
After a long period of evolution, the Twin Lotus had the ability to reverse the attributes. Meng Jingzhou tried to use this opportunity to gain insight into the Twin Lotus in hopes of reversing the Yin and Yang, changing his Single Body Spiritual Root into a Harem Spiritual Root.
Tao Yaoye, on the other hand, was thinking about incorporating changes in Yin and Yang within her illusion realm to make it more mysterious. If she could integrate the changes within the illusion realm with the insight of the Golden Core, that would be ideal.
Man Gu focused on the Twin Lotus, thinking about all the descriptions of the lotus, such as "Arising from the filth yet remaining pure, taking a clear ripple but not being carnal," "Infinite green lotus leaves connect to the sky, different red lotus blooms reflect the sun."
Soon, Man Gu thought of another key question: "Can the lotus be eaten? Can it be roasted?"
So, they sat in silence for two full days.
Lu Yang's eyes were dry from staring at the lotus, so he took out the eye drops that Eldest Senior Sister had given him, put in a few drops, and a felt a lot better.
"Did any of you gain any insight?" He asked.
The three of them shook their heads together, they didn't gain anything.
After two days of contemplating and gaining no insights, this suggested that their fate was not tied to the Twin Lotus. Forcing them to form a Golden Core wouldn't work.
"It's not right to just discard it, we went through a lot of trouble to get it. How about we sell it off at the firm and split the Spirit Stones? It's better to cut losses now than keep trying without any results," suggested Tao Yaoye.
"Sounds good." Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu didn't have any objections.
Lu Yang raised his hand and voiced a different request: "I want the lotus seeds. As for the Spirit Stones that will be acquired from the auction, I don't need that. Is that okay?"
In Lu Yang's Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity was causing a ruckus, insisting on having the lotus seeds.
To quell this calamity, Lu Yang could only ask for the lotus seeds.

chapters.title: Chapter 258 - 257: The Demon Suppressing Pass's Expensive Wig _1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang's proposal quickly won the approval of the other three. The most valuable part of the Twin Lotus was the flower; the seeds were not that valuable.
The lotus seeds could not grow new Twin Lotuses. The appearance of the Twin Lotus was random. A regular lotus flower, under certain conditions, could become the Twin Lotus.
In the words of Fairy Eternity, the essence of the twin was hidden in all lotus flowers. The key was how to stimulate the twin essence.
"Then it's decided. Senior Brother Lu will take the seeds, and the three of us will sell the flower and split the spirit stones."
Tao Yaoye took out eight lotus seeds and handed them to Lu Yang.
The seeds had a unique fragrance. Lu Yang unconsciously sniffed and found it fragrant.
...
The servant of the commercial firm always attended to the guests as usual. When three men in black robes raided the firm, it made him wary.
"It's me," One of the men in black said in a low tone.
"Young Master Meng?" The servant remembered the voice belonged to Young Master Meng.
Was he accompanied by disciples of the Seek Dao Sect?
Then who was the third man in black?
Tao Yaoye stood behind the three men in black robes feeling helpless.
All the late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivators at Demon Suppressing Pass had recognized the faces of Lu Yang and his companions. Going out would mean being hunted down.
Out of necessity, they had to disguise themselves.
Tao Yaoye had always been seen from behind, so he wouldn't be recognized and could freely move around.
The servant didn't delve into their disguises. Whatever Meng Jingzhou and the others had done didn't affect their transactions.
He led the four of them into the reception room. Meng Jingzhou brought out the Twin Lotus, which captured the servant's attention. He didn't expect that the much-discussed Twin Lotus had ended up in Meng Jingzhou's hands.
"We want to sell it. How many spirit stones can we get?"
"Forty-thousand spirit stones."
Meng Jingzhou frowned, thinking the price was too low. He had to pay five hundred thousand spirit stones for a Phoenix Blood Stone.
Tao Yaoye nodded, thinking the price was fair. Meng Jingzhou felt the price was low purely because he was too rich and had no concept of spirit stones.
"Young Master Meng, if you think the price is too low, our firm is about to hold an auction. The potential bidders are mainly Foundation Establishment and Golden Core cultivators, which is perfect for auctioning the Twin Lotus. What do you think?"
Meng Jingzhou considered for a moment before saying, "Sure, let's have it auctioned."
It had been a long time since he had been to an auction.
A day later, the four of them arrived at the auction with their tickets.
The firm had released news that the Twin Lotus would be available at the auction, attracting many late-stage Foundation Establishment and half-step Golden Core cultivators. At a glance, all were familiar faces.
The auction host was a rare beauty, calling herself Xiao Yue, who was curvy and eye-catching.
This was a big attraction for the cultivators of the Demon Suppressing Pass, who always lived on the edge of life and death.
The beautiful host warmed up the audience and started with the first auction item.
"The first auction item is different from usual. Throughout the history of Demon Suppressing pass auctions, this is a unique item. Even I, Xiao Yue, was stunned when I saw it."
The beautiful host pulled off the red cloth, revealing the first auction item - a wig.
"This is a wig that Master Guan spent three days and three nights refining. With this wig, you can change your hairstyle as you wish. What's more, this wig promotes hair growth. In other words, as soon as you put it on, your hair will grow back in a few days!"
"This is also a rare magic instrument, with a certain defensive function!"
The emergence of the first auction item instantly brightened the eyes of the crowd below.
They were all shaved bald by Lu Yang. What they need most now is a wig!
A great thing indeed!
The price of wigs in the Demon Suppressing Pass had skyrocketed, and they were all regular wigs far inferior to the one at the auction.
Instead of spending money on an ordinary wig, why not spend a bit more to buy a better one?
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou remained unmoved. They had lost their hair earlier than the others and now had lush hair growing on their heads, they were not bald anymore.
Moreover, it was clear that the refinement level of the wig couldn't compare to Li Haoran's.
"Starting price, five hundred Spirit Stones!"
"Five hundred!"
"Six hundred!"
"Eight hundred!"
"One thousand Spirit Stones!"
The wig was quickly bid up to a thousand Spirit Stones, something unimaginable in the past.
A thousand Spirit Stones for a wig was already its limit.
Suddenly, a voice rang out, pushing the wig's price to a new high.
"One thousand and five hundred Spirit Stones!"
Everyone looked in the direction of the voice. It was Duan Hongchen, the cultivator who was the first to be hit by Lu Yang's Arhat Fist!
Duan Hongchen, a Half Step Golden Core Stage cultivator with considerable wealth, believed that a wig worth one and a half thousand Spirit Stones that allowed him to freely choose his hairstyle was worth it!
"The second auction item is a bottle of elixirs, created by the Master Refiner Wu Ming from the Seek Dao Sect!"
"Senior Brother Wu?" Lu Yang was stunned on hearing this familiar name. He was too familiar with Senior Brother Wu. The Ten Bulls Strength Pill was his creation.
Senior Brother Wu had unique views on both pill refining and poison concocting.
The guests began to discuss excitedly.
"It's from the Seek Dao Sect?"
"Items from the Five Great Immortal Sects are rarely found in the market! It must be something good!"
"I wonder what the effects of the elixir are."
"When was the last time an item from the Five Great Immortal Sects appeared? It was from the Five Elements Sect. I heard that the Seek Dao Sect is even stronger than the Five Elements Sect. This item must be extraordinary!"
Obviously, most grassroots cultivators didn't know much about the Seek Dao Sect.
The beautiful hostess took out a jade bottle containing a few greyish-brown elixirs. Three elixir patterns circled around it, and the fragrance of the elixir was intoxicating. At first glance, it was something extraordinary.
"This is a bottle of fasting elixir."
As soon as this was said, there was disappointment from the audience regarding the second auction item.
The Seek Dao Sect might be powerful, but what difference could it make? Could it possibly refine a fasting elixir with different tastes?
The hostess was not surprised by the audience's reaction, as it was within her expectations.
She smiled slightly and began to explain. "One of the most common methods you use to hunt demon beasts in the dense forest is to poison them. However, demon beasts are naturally sensitive and can discern right from wrong. They will instinctively avoid poison."
"This is when this bottle of fasting elixir comes into play."
"This is not an ordinary fasting elixir. Calling it an elixir is a bit of a stretch, it would be more accurate to call it poison, or rather, it is an elixir, but its effect is similar to poison."
"Its effectiveness is thousands to tens of thousands of times stronger than the common fasting elixir."
"Just think about it, what would happen to the demon beast after eating this fasting elixir? This is equivalent to consuming tens of millions of fasting elixirs, which far exceeds the tolerance of a demon beast and would cause its stomach to burst instantly."
"Or as the saying goes, it ate itself to death."
The audience gasped. They never thought that a fasting elixir could be used in this way.
"I suspect Senior Brother Wu made a mistake in refining the elixir and ended up with a bottle of this stuff. He decided to sell it off to recoup some of the losses," Lu Yang made a reasonable guess.
"It does sound like something Senior Brother Wu would do."
Others were not aware of Wu Ming's background and thought that this was a carefully crafted elixir by Master Wu Ming. With the backing of the Seek Dao Sect, the quality of the elixir was guaranteed.
The fasting elixir that could 'feed one till they explode' was quickly auctioned off for six thousand Spirit Stones per bottle, bought by a cultivator in the Golden Core Stage.
Lu Yang and his three companions were all disciples from the Seek Dao Sect and had seen all sorts of good items. The following few auction items were rather uninteresting and failed to capture their interest.
"This sixth auction item is a piece of red satin. Its age and material are unknown."
The beautiful hostess presented the sixth auction item, a long strip of red satin.
"Huh, this item looks familiar." Fairy Eternity exclaimed.

chapters.title: Chapter 259 - 258 Mysterious Red Satin_1
chapters.content:
"Hmm, this thing looks familiar." Fairy Eternity reacted upon seeing the red satin the auctioneer was showing.
"Fairy, do you know what this is?" Lu Yang asked.
Fairy Eternity scratched her head, struggling to recall the origins of the red satin. Since she was a bit groggy from sleep, she couldn't remember what it was for a moment.
"What was it again? The Covering Sky Fairy Cloth that the Yingtian Immortal used to cover the sun and wrap a whole planet?"
"The cloth woven by Immortal Jiuchong that can turn nothingness into reality at a thought?"
"Or the veil used by Qilin Immortal at his wedding?"
"I can't remember, but this cloth carries the breath of us five immortals, so it must belong to one of us!" Fairy Eternity stated confidently.
Lu Yang's eyes lit up. An unknown piece of cloth with the breath of five immortals must have a significant backstory.
It might perhaps be an ancient immortal artifact.
The pots and pans of the Eternity Sect were all considered Immortal Treasures. Even those of the Unification stage treated these items as treasures. Thus, the status of this Five Immortal Breath Fabric must be even higher!
Fairy Eternity really is useful at critical times!
Someone in the crowd raised doubts: "Daring to auction off a piece of fabric whose age and material are unknown? Are you just trying to fill the auction with random items because you don't have many good ones?"
The auctioneer gave a slight smile, unfazed by the doubt: "This piece of fabric was obtained by a cultivator after slaying a demon beast in a secret forest. Even the most experienced appraisers have been unable to determine the material and age of the fabric."
"This fabric is suspected to be from ancient times, perhaps a possession of an ancient genius. It may have fallen into ownerless oblivion during the Great Era wars."
"The fabric is extremely durable. If a Nascent Soul Stage cultivator were to try to tear it apart fully, not a single damage could be inflicted."
"What about cultivators at the Divinity Transformation Stage?"
The auctioneer truthfully responded: "We haven't tried. The biggest feature of this satin is its completeness. If it were to be damaged by a Divinity Transformation Stage cultivator, the value of the satin would greatly decrease."
"Red satin, starting bid one thousand spirit stones."
The auction house was unsure of the value of the red satin. It was said to be an ancient item, but the satin was too well-preserved, as if it had just been woven, making it hard for people to believe that it was something from 300,000 years ago. Thus, the starting price was set very low.
"One thousand spirit stones."
An Ke from Clear Moon Sect called out, attracted by the beautiful color of the fabric. She wanted to use it to craft clothing, or with some modification, serve as a mantle.
"One thousand two hundred spirit stones," Tao Yaoye called out.
An Ke frowned, not expecting someone to bid against her for the fabric.
She turned her head and saw that the bidder was an even more beautiful female cultivator.
Seems like she has the same goal.
Then she definitely couldn't afford to be generous!
"One thousand five hundred spirit stones!"
"Two thousand." Tao Yaoye's voice was lazy, as if she didn't care who was bidding. No matter who bid, she would raise the price.
"Two thousand two hundred spirit stones!" An Ke increased the bid again.
"Three thousand." Tao Yaoye increased the bid without any hesitation.
An Ke was a beauty and had many followers. Originally, these people would have helped An Ke raise the bid, but when they saw that the other bidder was a stunning beauty, they all tacitly chose not to help An Ke.
"Three thousand one hundred..."
"Four thousand."
An Ke fell silent. She could indeed raise the bid, but there was still the Twin Lotus later. She couldn't possibly spend all her spirit stones on a piece of fabric.
"Four thousand spirit stones once, four thousand spirit stones twice, four thousand spirit stones three times, sold!" The auctioneer's gavel fell, indicating that the red satin now belonged to Tao Yaoye.
"Thank you, Junior Sister, for bidding. I'll return your spirit stones after the auction!" Lu Yang secretly transmitted his voice. It was he who had asked Tao Yaoye to bid.
As a man, if he were to bid for satin, people would suspect that the satin hid some secret, thereby driving up the price.
But if Tao Yaoye were to auction it, people would just think that the beautiful woman liked the fabric and was happy to spend money on it.
"There's no need for thanks between us, Senior Brother. Have you identified the origin of the red satin?" Tao Yaoye asked with a smile, revealing two shallow dimples.
Lu Yang fell silent for a moment, and then truthfully said: "It should be an item from ancient times, with an extraordinary origin. As for what it exactly is, I'm not sure."
Fairy Eternity, tragically, began to show early signs of dementia at only sixteen years old.
The next few auction items didn't capture the four's attention. Only when the auctioneer showed the Twin Lotus did the four sit up straight, curious about how many spirit stones the Twin Lotus could fetch.
As soon as the Twin Lotus appeared, the crowd fell silent instantly, their eyes burning with desire.
For any cultivator in the late stage of Foundation Establishment, the Twin Lotus is a treasure that opens up the future.
With a light smile, the auctioneer introduced: "Twin Lotus, perhaps many of you here had seen it just a few days ago. This is the very one that appeared in the secret forest a few days ago, and I don't need to introduce its effect."
"Starting bid, thirty thousand spirit stones."
The eyes of the audience seemed like they were trying to snatch the Twin Lotus away. There was no need for the auctioneer's introduction at all.
"Thirty-one thousand spirit stones!"
"I am determined to get the Twin Lotus, thirty-two thousand spirit stones!"
"So many stones and you dare to fight for the Twin Lotus, thirty-five thousand spirit stones!" The White Tiger Saint Son of Quadruple Sect sneered at people's tiny incremental bidding.
"Thirty-eight thousand spirit stones!" An Ke refused to back down.
"Forty thousand spirit stones!" Duan Hongchen of Tianwen Dao Sect shouted. He was just a Twin Lotus away from forming his golden core.
"Forty-one thousand spirit stones!"
"Forty-four!"
"Forty-five!"
The price of the Twin Lotus kept rising, making Man Gu unable to conceal his grin.
Eventually, the price of the Twin Lotus settled at forty-nine thousand spirit stones.
"Forty-nine thousand spirit stones once, forty-nine thousand spirit stones twice ..."
Meng Jingzhou mused, using the time the auctioneer was calling the bid, to speak loud enough for the nearby people to hear: "Those two Buddhist disciples who know the Arhat Fist are really hateful. Could this Twin Lotus carry any clues about those two Buddhist disciples?"
"Fifty thousand spirit stones!" The White Tiger Saint Son immediately increased the bid.
He was not in a hurry to use the Twin Lotus, but he vowed to find those two Buddhist disciples!
Fifty thousand spirit stones were a sum that a cultivator at the Foundation Establishment stage, even if he sold all his possessions, couldn't afford. Only a core disciple of a large sect like the White Tiger Saint Son could afford it.
"Fifty-three thousand spirit stones!" An Ke increased her bid again.
The White Tiger Saint Son calmed down. Although he could still raise the bid, doing so would not only offend An Ke, but it would also exceed the value of the Twin Lotus.
With fifty-three thousand spirit stones, An Ke won the Twin Lotus.
After the auction ended, Tao Yaoye handed over the red satin to Lu Yang.
"Fairy, can you now see what this is?" Lu Yang asked quietly, hoping the fairy could reveal the origin of the red satin.
Fairy Eternity pondered for a moment, trying hard to rummage through her memory. She slapped her hand, revealing an expression of sudden realization, and finally remembered the origin of the red satin from an inconspicuous corner of her memory.
"Isn't this the tablecloth from my home!"
"... Fairy, you really do feel at home."
"What do you mean?"
"You really know how to prank your own family."

chapters.title: Chapter 260 - 259: Activation of Ancient Barbarian Tribe Bloodline _1
chapters.content:
The Four Immortals of the Ancients were often invited by Fairy Eternity as guests in her immortal residence, tasting rare delights.
Because of the distinct way Fairy Eternity cooked, she held high standards for both food and utensils.
Chopsticks, eating bowls, tablecloths... were all nearly indestructible despite countless trials, having passed the test of time and reality, making them incredibly valuable.
These utensils inevitably carried the aura of the five immortals.
"This indirectly shows how unrivaled we Five Ancients are. Simply by sitting, items around us absorb our aura, which doesn't dissipate even after three hundred thousand years!" Fairy Eternity boasted and eagerly praised herself.
Or perhaps she was just in good mood seeing the old items.
Lu Yang: "..."
However, upon thinking, it's quite okay, getting an immortal's item for four thousand Spirit Stones—is indeed a bargain.
Plus, the cloth cannot be damaged, an absolute treasure.
"Such a pity, you can't use this cloth." Fairy Eternity regretfully announced, leaving Lu Yang dumbfounded.
"Why?"
"This tablecloth was once refined by me. Even though I died once, the fact that it's refined will not disappear, hence only I can use this tablecloth."
"So, I've spent four thousand Spirit Stones and had Junior Sister Tao bid for it, just to buy a tablecloth for you?"
Fairy Eternity sincerely said, "Second-in-command, I will remember your kindness."
In reality, once Tao Yaoye saw Lu Yang procuring the red satin, she saw his expressions changing from elation to disappointment, filled with hope and then hope crushing, the changes were quite dynamic.
"Senior Brother Lu, what's wrong?"
Lu Yang sighed, "Nothing much, I just feel like a complete fool."
While speaking, he wanted to put the tablecloth in his identity jade pendant.
Failed.
"Fairy, could you please put your tablecloth into my jade pendant?"
"Oh."
The tablecloth belonged to Fairy Eternity and couldn't be directly placed into the identity jade pendant.
After the waiter gave Meng Jingzhou the Spirit Stones for auctioning the Twin Lotus, he handed over three Talismans packed in jade boxes.
Three Divinity Transformation Level Directional Teleportation Talisman, capable to escape from a Divinity Transformation Stage great demon attack, or send the Divinity Transformation Stage great demon to Demon Suppressing Pass, which can be used in multiple ways.
"Let's go. It's time for the training in the enchanted forest." Lu Yang called others.
The four did not forget their purpose for coming to the forest and went directly from the auction to the forest.
This time, the Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain did not accompany them.
Lu Yang and the Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain had discussed that most of the Golden Core, Early-Mid Stage, and Demon Beasts they encountered in the outskirts of the forest posed no challenge to Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
To achieve the real purpose of training, they needed to delve deeper into the forest where the Golden Core Late Stage Demon Beasts gathered.
Due to this, the Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain, who had insufficient Cultivation Levels, couldn't guarantee their safety. As they were active mostly in the outskirts, their knowledge about the deeper parts of the forest was not much, thus their role was insignificant.
"Senior Brother Lu, would fighting Golden Core Late-Stage Demon Beasts rashly be too hasty? Should we not start from the Foundation Establishment late-stage?" Tao Yaoye was somewhat concerned.
She and Man Gu had just reached the Foundation Establishment Late-Stage, and should solidify their basis, starting by fighting those at their own level.
Tao Yaoye's opponents had either been Lu Yang or the strongest Foundation Establishment Stage cultivator from the Five Elements Sect, she has not won any match yet.
Furthermore, as an owner of Feather Transformation Immortal Body, she was supposed to have superior talent than Single Spiritual Root, yet she only ranked third in her batch, making her lack confidence in her combat skills.
Lu Yang smiled, "Junior Sister Tao, have some self-confidence. Not many in the Foundation Establishment Stage can beat you, a contemporary genius. Challenging higher stages isn't as tough as you imagine."
"Don't say that you are up against Foundation Establishment Stage Demon Beasts, even if you face Golden Core Early-Mid Stage, you are sure to win, and in this way, you won't achieve true training experience."
Man Gu had a sudden realization, "I thought Brother Lu was worried about running into those opponents who had their heads shaved by him and causing lots of trouble, hence wanted to go deeper into the forest. I was thinking too superficially!"
Lu Yang: "..."
Stop saying the harsh truth.
Now, the forest periphery has been filled with Lu Yang's enemies, as long as Lu Yang shows his face, it could cause countless people to chase and kill.
"By the way, Junior Sister Tao, can you create an illusion?"
"What kind of illusion?"
Lu Yang, slightly embarrassed, touched his barely growing hair, , "Like, we think our hair is still as it used to be kind of illusion."
Meng Jingzhou was also nodding.
Tao Yaoye: "... okay."
With a slight application of magic, she allowed the four to enter an illusionary realm where the only difference with reality was that Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou grew a great deal of hair.
"I will first find a late-stage Golden Core Demon Beast for Junior Sister to practice on," said Lu Yang. Then, in the spiritual space, he asked Fairy Eternity to expand her divine consciousness to find the nearest late-stage Golden Core Demon Beast.
"Fairy, please help."
"I can help, but first, I want to activate the barbarian bloodline of this young member of the Barbarian tribe," Fairy Eternity rarely saw her own masterpiece and wanted to lend a hand.
The barbarians lack detailed records of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe, otherwise, Man Gu wouldn't be unaware of Fairy Eternity's existence.
At the same time, Man Gu didn't know how to activate the bloodline of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe and he was currently in the exploration phase.
The ancient barbarians of the past would gradually activate their bloodline as their cultivation level increased, but this process was very slow.
With the help of Fairy Eternity, the process to activate the bloodline of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe would be greatly shortened.
"Once he activates the bloodline of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe, this little barbarian will have a dominant advantage when facing Demon Beasts, which will be very helpful to you!"
After some thought, Lu Yang agreed that this made sense.
"Man Gu, I'm going to tell you now how to activate your Ancient Barbarian Tribe bloodline. Prepare yourself."
Although Man Gu did not understand how Brother Lu knew how to activate his bloodline, he trusted that Brother Lu would not deceive him.
"Alright, I am ready."
In the spiritual space, Fairy Eternity uttered a sentence, and in reality, Lu Yang repeated it to Man Gu.
"The Ancient Barbarian Tribe bloodline originates from Fairy Eternity. It's a blessing from the Immortals. You need to spread your arms wide and shout 'Long live Fairy Eternity', three times. Your body will start to become warm, which is an early sign that your bloodline is awakening."
Upon hearing this, Man Gu was taken aback. He hadn't expected that they, the Ancient Barbarian Tribe, had originated from Fairy Eternity.
"Next, you have to sing praises of Fairy Eternity's status, call her the supreme being, the leader among the Five Immortals, incomparable and irreplaceable."
"Repeat this three times."
