"Have you remembered it all?" Lu Yang understood that the awakening ceremony essentially involved flattery of Fairy Eternity.
"Err... what was the first sentence... 'May Fairy Eternity perish forever?'"
"No, it's 'Long live Fairy Eternity!'"
Man Gu opened his arms wide, facing the sky, and shouted loudly:
"Long live Fairy Eternity!"
"Long live Fairy Eternity!"
"Long live Fairy Eternity!"
The earnest outcry startled the birds in the trees into flight.
As the awakening ceremony progressed step by step, Man Gu felt a surge of heat within his body, as if it was on fire.
His skin turned bright red, he grimaced in pain, sweat the size of soybeans trickled down his forehead, and his body felt like it was on the verge of bursting.
"Huff -- huff --" Gradually, Man Gu's bloodline returned to normal and the excruciating pain slowly vanished.
"How do you feel?"
"I feel filled with strength!"
"Then..."
Before Lu Yang could finish saying "okay", the sounds of beasts running could be heard from not far away.
The sound didn't come from a single spot either – it echoed from all around, all targeting their location.
Boom--
The trees fell down, revealing a scale-armored beast with red eyes, staring fiercely at Man Gu.
Boom--
Behind them, another beast appeared, fixing its gaze on Man Gu, as if he was its sworn enemy.
One after another, Golden Core Stage Beasts appeared, encircling the four of them.
The beasts' only target was Man Gu.
"Senior Brother, is this the single late-stage Golden Core Beast you were talking about for me to practice on?" Tao Yaoye asked in a low voice, having never seen such a large setup.
"Fairy, what's happening?!" Lu Yang realized there was an issue with Man Gu's Ancient Barbarian Tribe's bloodline.
"Hmmm, it seems the activation of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe's bloodline wasn't complete. Rather than suppressing the beasts, it has enraged them… But don't worry, everything is within my expectations!"
"Fairy, look me in the eyes and say that again."
Fairy Eternity guiltily averted her gaze: "It's an Immortal's trial."

chapters.title: Chapter 261 - 260 Bloodline Hatred_1
chapters.content:
"I clearly followed the ritual I taught during ancient times; there should be no problems, what's going on?"
Fairy Eternity always corrected her mistakes, sought problems, found solutions, and avoided repeating mistakes in the future.
"Now I understand, the Barbarian Tribe I came to know during ancient times belonged to the first generation. They had a pure lineage and were the primary beneficiaries of my blessings!"
"After three hundred thousand years of inheritance, the proportion of my blessing in the lineage of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe has dwindled. By this generation, it's extremely low."
"So, when the proportion of my blessing was high, it had a suppressive effect on the Demon Beasts. When the proportion was low, the Demon Beasts went for their revenge on me?"
"Such cowards, these beasts, not giving me any regard at all. How on earth does Qilin Immortal manage them?"
The more Fairy Eternity thought about it, the angrier she became, deciding that when she found Qilin Immortal, she would definitely give him a good lesson.
"Fairy, is there a way to put the ancient bloodline of the Barbarian Tribe in Man Gu back to sleep?" Lu Yang had been anticipating the activation of the ancient Barbarian Tribe's bloodline and its subsequent backlash.
After all, it was normal for Fairy Eternity to have enemies given the grievous deeds she had committed while she was alive.
It was just that previously, while Fairy Eternity was alive, she could keep them in check.
Once Fairy Eternity was gone, the enemies would smell blood and come around.
Fairy Eternity mused, "I haven't considered this problem. Let me think... If we shout 'Qilin Immortal is a bastard'... no, that might just provoke hostility."
"Ah, right, we can have Man Gu continuously shout 'May Fairy Eternity live forever'. That would further activate the bloodline and thereby suppress the Demon Beasts!"
Lu Yang thought this plan was quite unreliable.
"Let's fight. It's just six Golden Core Stage Demon Beasts. The four of us can handle that." Lu Yang sighed, declaring the failure of his golden finger and began to formulate a combat plan.
"Meng Jingzhou and I will each handle two of the Golden Core Stage Demon Beasts. Junior Sister Tao and Man Gu, you each deal with one. Yes, you two will take on the two late-stage Golden Core Beasts."
The four of them came to the forest precisely to find opportunities to fight. Having the plan move up a bit didn't pose a big problem.
Tao Yaoye and Man Gu felt immense pressure. Both had never faced a Golden Core Stage Demon Beast before.
Man Gu was under the most pressure and he helplessly said, "Brother Lu, I have no objections to your battle plan, but I have a question."
"What is it?"
"It seems all six Demon Beasts are aiming for me. How am I supposed to fight?"
Lu Yang: "...We three will go first and leave one for you."
...
A giant snake patterned python, about ten meters long, was tightly coiled, sliding swiftly on the ground, trying to envelop Man Gu.
It had never met Man Gu, but the origin of its lineage kept warning it that this person was very dangerous, and it needed to kill him.
Then kill this person!
It's merely a late-stage Foundation Establishment!
It coiled tightly around Man Gu, making his breathing difficult. His face turned blue. Suddenly, the python felt lighter; Man Gu, whom it had enveloped, had vanished.
The python's pupils shrank abruptly, sensing trouble.
It had unconsciously succumbed to an illusion!
"Your opponent is me."
A beautiful shadow stood behind the giant python holding a red paper umbrella, looking like a woman in a painting.
The python turned abruptly and was just about to attack Tao Yaoye when a series of beautiful shadows emerged from behind her, surrounding it.
It had fallen into an illusion again!
...
Lu Yang wielded his sword, step by step edging towards two Demon Beasts. The tip of the sword traced a straight line on the ground.
Suddenly, Lu Yang flipped his sword upwards, sending dust into the eyes of the two Demon Beasts.
The two Demon Beasts opened their Spiritual Sense, looking for Lu Yang.
But they couldn't find Lu Yang at all. In his place, there was a splendid tiger with an exceptional sword in its mouth.
The first move of Lu's Imitation Fist - Tiger Fist!
The two beasts hadn't anticipated this situation, their expressions bewildered.
In the moment of their surprise, the mottled tiger lunged with its sword, aiming to slit their throats!
The two beasts dodged hastily, the Green Peak Sword narrowly missed them, leaving a cut on their formerly proud coats, leaving blood flowing.
However, the beasts quickly acted on their instincts and contracted muscles around the wound, effectively sealing it.
In the Golden Core Stage one could mobilize all parts of their bodies!
This was exactly why Lu Yang had said that the shortcomings of unification combat could only be remedied at the Golden Core Stage.
The tiger was already armed with sharp claws that could scrape flesh and bone off a human. Now, adding the sword in its mouth, its combat power was further enhanced!
It was like adding a sword to a tiger's arsenal.
The two beasts struggled to track the mottled tiger, finding no trace of it.
Where was it?
One of the beasts reacted first, looking down at the ground. Just as its Spiritual Sense was about to spread out to search, it saw the tiger emerging from the ground, thrusting its sword out!
It instantly took one of the beast's front legs!
The two creatures tried to counterattack, only to see the tiger dive back into the dirt.
To Lu Yang, who possessed the ability to warp earth, this wasn't soil but a pool of water!
…
Man Gu's opponent was an armored beast as tall as an adult human. Its scales were finer than those of a fish, appearing like those of a pangolin.
Roaring, the armored beast charged toward Man Gu.
Not one to be outdone, Man Gu bellowed, "May Fairy Eternity bless me," and also charged at the armored creature.
The armored beast had never seen a human from the Human race this brave. Just a late-stage Foundation Establishment nobody but he dared compete with it with physical strength?
Boom——
The collision between a human and a beast made a deafening sound.
Both sides stumbled backwards, unable to keep their balance, only stopping when they crashed into a big tree.
The armored beast treated Man Gu as a formidable opponent. It hadn't expected the human to have such a horrific body, almost at par with it.
As Man Gu gasped heavily, he freely enunciated the name of Fairy Eternity, and his body appeared stronger after each invocation.
"Fair Eternity bless me!"
He yelled, and rushed towards the armored beast once more.
…
Like Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou was facing two mid-stage Golden Core Stage beasts. One was a tiger, which had the bloodline of Luwu, the great ancient demon, the other a lion, related to the ancient nine-headed lion. Both were troublesome.
These two beasts were even more dangerous than the ones Lu Yang was facing.
The two beasts stared menacingly at Meng Jingzhou. The power of their bloodline compelled them to kill Meng Jingzhou as an obstacle, and then kill Man Gu.
This was an inextinguishable hatred that came from their bloodline, which could only be ended in death!
"Tsk, why is my luck so bad?"
Meng Jingzhou murmured quietly, reaching into his chest pocket. That action caused the two beasts to tighten up, fully alert, ready to dodge anything he might pull out, thereby counterattacking.
This was the pride that came from the ancient blood lineage!
Meng Jingzhou swiftly hurled an object that shone ominously towards a hidden direction, not aimed at the two beasts at all.
With sight exceptional even among Golden Core Stage beasts, the Lion Demon quickly identified what was thrown, and charged after it.
The Tiger Demon was left standing still, asking dumbfounded: "Human, what did you just throw?"
"A Top-grade Spirit Stone."
The Tiger Demon immediately turned and ran off chasing after the Lion Demon.
It would seem that bloodline hatred wasn't that important after all.

chapters.title: Chapter 262 - 261: Lu's Imitation Fist - Yellow Bean Fist_1
chapters.content:
"Meng Jingzhou you damned, is this how you fight?!" Lu Yang, in his tiger form, erupted in anger, speaking human language after seeing this.
While I'm here fighting hard, you're just throwing around top-grade Spirit Stones!
Is this even acceptable?!
"Yeah, is this acceptable, how come you don't have a single Spirit Stone?" The two demon beasts Lu Yang was fighting with were also angry.
Lu Yang: "....can you both stop talking, it's just degrading."
The two demon beasts completely ignored him.
They've fought for so long, were close to losing, while the tiger demon and lion demon, who didn't do anything, easily earned top-grade Spirit Stones.
Those are top-grade Spirit Stones! They've lived for such a long time, yet they've never had one before.
Bloodline feud is indeed important, but one must also consider realism.
"Why don't you two go and fight him instead?" Lu Yang was fanning the flames, suggesting that the two demon beasts switch targets.
"Hey hey hey, Lu Yang, you're being unfair!" Meng Jingzhou shouted from a distance, this damn grandson is jealous of my wealth!
"Stop yelling for now, those two demon beasts are coming back!" Lu Yang casually reminded him, causing Meng Jingzhou to pause.
Roar—
A lion's roar resounded, louder than thunder, it exploded beside Meng Jingzhou's ears, making his brain dizzy.
The lion demon and tiger demon had returned, emitting an intimidating atmosphere.
"Why are you back?"
The tiger demon showed a greedy look: "Since you could bring out a top-grade Spirit Stone, you must have a lot more. Hand them all over and I'll spare your life!"
The mane of the lion demon quivered, viewing Meng Jingzhou like a treasure trove, it threatened fiercely: "If not, be prepared for us to capture you, and gobble up all your Spirit Stones!"
Meng Jingzhou furrowed his brows, snorted coldly: "You're too greedy!"
Just because he doesn't want to fight, doesn't mean he's afraid of them.
"You're just two mid-stage golden core demon beasts, not even worthy of being the Meng Family's watchdogs!"
"You're courting death!"
The tiger demon and lion demon were furious, wanting to tear Meng Jingzhou to shreds!
"Shocking Heaven Six Forms!" Meng Jingzhou stopped fooling around, his eyes wide open, like the eyes of an angry god, his aura was inviolable.
Having practiced Arhat Fist continuously, he gained a new understanding of the Shocking Heaven Six Form. Its power surpasses what it was previously!
Meng Jingzhou, like a ghost, had erratic and fast footwork, traveling around the battlefield, his fists swinging violently, striking the two demon beasts.
The tiger demon and lion demon were careless and ended up taking a solid punch, coughing up blood.
They were terrified. They had thought he was just a rich but useless young master since he was splurging money when he first saw them. They had not expected his combat power to be so terrifying!
…
The patterned giant python's eyes were red, completely enraged by Tao Yaoye. Its snake pupils wide open, searching for that annoying figure, intending to swallow this little girl who had been fooling around with it.
Demon beasts were naturally weak in spiritual power. Tao Yaoye, this kind of cultivator who was good at illusions, was their natural enemy.
Until now in the fight, the patterned giant python hasn't even grazed Tao Yaoye's clothing.
Crack—
With a crisp sound, like a mirror breaking, it revealed the truth hidden behind.
"Found you!" The patterned giant python finally broke through the illusion and found Tao Yaoye.
Tao Yaoye seemed to have not expected this sudden change, she just stood there blankly, not knowing what to do.
It opened its giant mouth and swallowed Tao Yaoye, who was showing a face of terror and despair.
Tao Yaoye struggled desperately but still lost to the patterned giant python, gradually being swallowed.
Not far away, Tao Yaoye was holding a red paper umbrella, her figure ghostly, watching as the patterned giant python swallowed its own tail, and she gently shook her head.
It may seem like Tao Yaoye was just fooling around with the python, but only she knew how dangerous it was.
The patterned giant python was a late-stage golden core demon beast, with all Tao Yaoye's strength, she can only make it lost in the illusion.
If Tao Yaoye were not careful enough, it could break through the illusion and return to reality.
She would be in danger if that happened.
"I lack offensive capabilities." Tao Yaoye realized her shortcoming. If she had Lu Yang's offensive abilities, she would have defeated the giant python a long time ago.
Illusions can kill, but only if the opponent is lost deep within them.
Tao Yaoye was confident that she can make any cultivator at the Foundation Establishment Stage to enter deep illusion, but it becomes much harder at the Golden Core stage.
This means she would have trouble killing enemies that are more powerful than her.
As for the Feather Transformation Immortal Body, it focuses more on defense rather than offense.
Right now, all she could do was to trap the giant python.
…
As Man Gu kept calling the name of Fairy Eternity, the long dormant bloodline of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe began to erupt, like a volcanic eruption, unstoppable.
Man Gu's physical body continued to strengthen. At the start of the battle, he was at a disadvantage against the late-stage Golden Core armored Demon Beast. Now, they are on an equal footing.
This is an extremely terrifying phenomenon, a Foundation Establishment Stage body being comparable to a late-stage Golden Core Stage.
Man Gu realized that it may have been common among the Ancient Barbarian Tribe in the ancient times, and this meant that Fairy Eternity's blessings elevated the battle power of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe.
"Fairy Eternity is unparalleled in the world!"
The armored Demon Beast began to harbor thoughts of retreat. It felt threatened by Man Gu, not because of Man Gu's abilities, but because of the fear originating from his bloodline.
The armored Demon Beast's lineage was both fearful and hateful of Man Gu, but previously the hatred outweighed the fear.
But now, the fear gradually outweighed the hatred.
...
Lu Yang transformed into a ferocious tiger, effortlessly dealing with two mid-stage Golden Core Demon Beasts.
Just as Lu Yang prepared to kill the two Demon Beasts in one fell swoop, the abnormal noises alerted him to something amiss.
Wah—
From afar, the cry of a baby drifted over, making Lu Yang's hair stand on end.
This place was full of savage Demon Beasts. How could there be a baby?
The two Demon Beasts locked eyes, fear flashing mutual in their gazes.
"It's coming!"
Lu Yang was confused: "Who?"
The two Demon Beasts didn't respond. The baby's crying sounded closer and closer.
Suddenly, the crying stopped. A primitive aura that made everyone's heart flutter erupted.
"You've been fighting for half a day and you still can't even handle a few humans?"
A cold voice echoed in everyone's ears. Lu Yang transformed back into his human form, holding up the Green Peak Sword to guard.
The source of the voice slowly emerged from the forest, revealing its true form: nine snake heads, a massive body standing over ten meters tall.
Lu Yang exhaled slowly: "Jiuying."
Ancient Demon Beast, Jiuying.
From the appearance, it wasn't a side branch of an Ancient Demon Beast like the Tiger or Lion Demons.
The opponent was a pure-blooded Jiuying.
"You two, follow me and kill the sword-wielding human!" Jiuying commanded, also drawn by the blood of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe. As soon as it arrived at the battlefield, it realized that Lu Yang was considered the strongest among the four. To kill Man Gu, it had to kill Lu Yang first.
The two Demon Beasts, aware of Jiuying's horror, dared not disobey his command.
"Fairy, what is their realm?"
"Late-stage Golden Core, at the peak."
Lu Yang showed a difficult expression.
A late-stage Golden Core pure-blooded Jiuying, together with two mid-stage Golden Core Demon Beasts. With his current abilities, he was no match for them.
The four of them could escape anytime, thanks to Meng Jingzhou's directional teleportation talisman.
The reason they hadn't fled, was due to the unspoken agreement between him and Meng Jingzhou.
Both realized that this was an excellent opportunity for Man Gu and Tao Yaoye to hone their skills. The enemies were just at the threshold of being formidable and overwhelming. It was an opportunity not to be missed.
Lu Yang glanced at Man Gu, who was in the midst of battle with the armored Demon Beast, his Ancient Barbarian Tribe bloodline continuously being activated.
This process should not be interrupted.
Meng Jingzhou and Tao Yaoye were both in the heat of battle and couldn't break away.
In that case, he would have to face Jiuying on his own.
"Hey, hey, hey, you surely can't beat it!" Fairy Eternity was worried for Lu Yang.
"I can. I have a move that, in theory, should work, but I haven't used it yet. I need your help, Fairy."
"Hm?"
In reality, Lu Yang slowly closed his eyes, and his body swayed lazily as if he had fallen asleep.
Jiuying's nine heads sneered in unison: "Sleeping Arhat Fist? It might be of use to me once you reach the Golden Core Stage."
"No, it's not the Sleeping Arhat Fist. It's my self-created technique, the Lu Clan Imitation Fist."
"Lu Clan Imitation Fist?" Jiuying unconsciously repeated the name.
As Lu Yang's movements changed, his form shrank, and his features gradually became more feminine.
"Just bluffing!" One of the Demon Beasts snorted coldly, lunging at Lu Yang.
A delicate fist struck the Demon Beast's face, quick to the extreme. The Demon Beast failed to react in time, and was sent flying by the punch.
Jiuying's expression became solemn, and it fixed its gaze on Lu Yang.
Lu Yang had completely transformed, turning into a petite yet extremely beautiful young girl.
"Lu Clan Imitation Fist—Yellow Bean Fist, please give me your advice!"

chapters.title: Chapter 263 - 262: The Side Effects of Yellow Bean's Punch_1
chapters.content:
Not far away, Meng Jingzhou witnessed the scene, stumbled, and was almost injured by the Lion Demon's sharp claws.
"Damn, Lu Yang, you're really risking it with these transformations!"
When Fairy Eternity had first revived, Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu had seen how she looked.
Farther afield, Man Gu was taken aback, initially thinking that his devout heart had summoned Fairy Eternity and his fighting style became even more fierce.
"Who did Senior Brother Lu transform into?" Only Tao Yaoye, who did not know Fairy Eternity, didn't understand why Senior Brother Lu's gender changed suddenly.
"But it's so cute."
Jiuying had a serious expression, sensing immense danger from Lu Yang; a fatal danger.
"This is impossible!"
Unlike the crisscrossing hybrids in the dense forest, he was a direct line of Jiuying's tribe, the peak of the late Golden Core Stage. In the Demon Race, he was the standout of the Golden Core Stage. How could he feel threatened by someone who was at the late stage of Foundation Establishment?
And it was a lethal threat!
...
Lu Family's Form Boxing, a technique that, while appearing to be boxing, is actually a magic skill inviting a deity's presence.
The objects of imitation for Form Boxing are those who Lu Yang is familiar with and whose power is close to his, such as the Tiger Demon he's fought before, Meng Jingzhou, and Man Gu.
This method of transformation only slightly enhances Lu Yang's battle prowess.
The other type of objects imitated are those far beyond Lu Yang's realm, like the Eldest Senior Sister. Once he becomes her, he can borrow her strength, thereby increasing his overall power.
However, this situation is uncontrollable.
Lu Yang tried to transform into his Eldest Senior Sister before, but the power he borrowed exceeded his capacity, and he was beaten back to his original form by her power.
Lu Yang guessed that if Eldest Senior Sister borrowed a portion of her power to him, perhaps he could utilize her strength.
But Lu Yang didn't have the courage to propose this to his Eldest Senior Sister.
So, Lu Yang generally used Eldest Sister's Form Boxing like a summoning technique.
Pondering how he could harness the power of the formidable through Form Boxing, it suddenly struck him that he possessed an ancient, powerful immortal in his Spiritual Space.
He wondered, if Fairy Eternity willingly shared part of her power, couldn't he grow stronger?
Faced with a malign crisis today, he discussed with Fairy Eternity and immediately performed Yellow Bean Form Boxing.
It truly worked.
Lu Yang stretched his body, feeling lightweight like a feather, reactive and quick like a bolt of lightning, every part of his transformed body being perfect, without a single flaw, fully demonstrating his power.
Moreover, Lu Yang felt a significant enhancement in the power he could use after transforming. It was as though he had undergone a complete makeover.
"Why do I feel that my brain isn't working so well right now?"
Lu Yang hesitated for a moment, feeling that his mind was slower than before. He did not overthink it: "Never mind, as long as I am stronger."
He held up his sword with his right hand, the shining tip pointing at Jiuying, a confident smile on his face.
"Have you thought about how you want to die?"
"Seeking death!"
Jiuying was furious, having never been looked down upon like this before. It howled loudly, with a shrill crying sound like rolling waves, each wave crashing on top of the last.
"Both of you, attack now!"
It ordered two Demon Beasts. The beasts knew the horrors of Jiuying, even resistance would be fatal, they dared not disobey and charged towards Lu Yang simultaneously.
Lu Yang responded calmly, his eyes undeterred, as tranquil as an ancient well.
He took a half-step forward, his toe tapped the ground, slowly drawing an arc. His waist twisted, and with a shake of his right hand, the Green Peak Sword traced a beautiful semi-circle.
"Slash."
The heads of the two Demon Beasts flew five or six meters away, blood spurting out, dying a wrongful death.
Verbal Sword- "Cut Off", the head flies first.
Whoosh—
A snakehead broke through the spray of blood from the necks of the two Demon Beasts, taking advantage of the blind spot in Lu Yang's line of sight, and bit towards Lu Yang.
The snake's head revealed a dagger-like venomous fang, a poison from Jiuying that could turn an entire small lake into a dead zone with just a single drop.
Lu Yang seized the venomous fang with both his hands, unafraid of the toxicity.
The snake's head, realizing it was in trouble, tried desperately to wriggle free from Lu Yang's grasp.
Lu Yang's hands looked delicate and harmless, but they held an immense strength that a Foundation Establishment late-stage practitioner shouldn't possess, firmly pinning down the venomous fang.
No matter how hard Jiuying struggled, it couldn't break free.
Lu Yang spread his arms apart and forcefully pulled out the pair of fangs, causing the snake head to howl in pain.
Lu Yang took advantage of the opportunity and pinned down the snake's head. He gave an upward knee kick, and the snake's head exploded, scattering in all directions!
The other eight snake heads took advantage of Lu Yang's focus on the one head and launched attacks from eight different directions.
No matter how superior his skills were, it was impossible to block eight attacks from eight directions!
"Arhat Fist."
Lu Yang threw a series of punches, his expression compassionate, like a Bodhisattva, brimming with pity, his actions accompanied by the echoes of Buddhist mantras, unsurpassed and supreme.
The so-called eight-headed attack posed no threat under the Arhat Fist.
Not to mention the hair loss prevention benefits that came with the Arhat Fist, it was considered one of the top Buddhist martial arts techniques, unparalleled in power.
After transforming into Fairy Eternity, Lu Yang felt that his understanding of the Arhat Fist had improved.
Jiuying was sent flying as if he had been pounded by eight fists at the same time.
"Nascent Transformation Fire!"
Jiuying used its last resort, the power of its blood, to spew a poisonous fire.
Wherever the Nascent Transformation Fire passed, the grass withered, and nothing would grow for a hundred years.
The Nascent Transformation Fire was extremely toxic. This fire was only second to True Fire. For a Golden Core Stage practitioner to control such a flame was remarkable.
"Three Flavored True Fire."
Lu Yang countered with True Fire, and within seconds, the two groups of flames battled each other, causing crackling noises.
Just in the blink of an eye, the Three Flavored True Fire overwhelmed the Nascent Transformation Fire, swallowing it up entirely.
"This can't be! This can't be!" Jiuying roared like a mad beast. It couldn't tolerate being beaten by a human of the late stage Foundation Establishment.
"What kind of demonic magic is this!"
"I told you, it's Yellow Bean's Fist," Lu Yang replied, a smile of satisfaction on his face, clearly pleased by Jiuying's anger.
Watching from a distance, Meng Jingzhou felt like something was amiss.
"Why does Lu Yang's smile look so simple-minded? Am I looking at it wrong?"
Lu Yang's smile faded, and he focused all his energy into the Green Peak Sword, and slowly swung it down.
"Break!"
Jiuying felt as though it was nailed in place, unable to move as it watched the Green Peak Sword swing down, closer and closer, and the sword's reflection featured prominently in its snake's eyes.
The sword descended, akin to the setting sun, symbolizing the end of all things.
Jiuying was split into two, its Golden Core within its body exploded, and its blood flowed onto the ground.
Fearing the poisonous blood would pollute the forest, Lu Yang used the Three Flavored True Fire again, burning Jiuying's flesh and blood into charcoal.
"It smells so good!"
Lu Yang took a whiff and started to drool.
"No, no, Jiuying is poisonous, I can't eat it!" Lu Yang suddenly realized his mistake and was conscious of his lapse.
"Weird, why did I have such a ridiculous idea?" Lu Yang felt this was not his usual way of thinking.
He tried to think deeply about this problem, but felt it was too troublesome and didn't want to dwell on it.
"Oh, Lu Yang, you're wasting my body. If only you learned my Health Preservation Boxing technique, one punch could have killed Jiuying. Why did you have to go through all this trouble?" Fairy Eternity was jumping around in the Spiritual Space.
"Is that so?" Lu Yang felt there was some sense in what Fairy Eternity said, but also felt that something was off.

chapters.title: Chapter 264 - 263: Ancient Heritage, Not to be Spoken Lightly_1
chapters.content:
With Jiuying's death, Lu Yang and his team seized the momentum, pressing on until the battle was over.
"Barbarian tribe combat technique — One Force Subdues Ten Gatherings!"
Man Gu roared, his left and right fists cracking together, smashing the armored demon beast's head flat.
The patterned python lost its wits in the illusion, swallowing half of its own body in its confusion. By the time it came to its senses, it was too late to turn the tide.
Meng Jingzhou, seeing Lu Yang kill two demon beasts with one strike, felt competitive too. Using the Shocking Heaven Six Forms, he killed the Tiger Demon and Lion Demon outright, not even giving them a chance to escape.
Meng Jingzhou and his team were exhausted, but their faces were filled with triumphant smiles.
No matter what, they had eventually won this battle.
Lu Yang had not used up too much of his strength as he had drawn on the power of Fairy Eternity.
"Release!"
With the end of the battle, there was no further need for him to maintain the appearance of Fairy Eternity.
The moment he returned to his original form, Lu Yang felt his mind become more agile, his thoughts no longer singular.
"What on earth did I just do?!"
Remembering the foolish actions he had taken, Lu Yang broke out in a cold sweat.
"What you just did was pretty good, very much my style!" Fairy Eternity gave Lu Yang a thumbs up, praising him for having the potential of an Immortal.
"That is the biggest problem!"
Reflecting on the course of the battle, Lu Yang's transformation into Fairy Eternity using Yellow Bean's fist brought about a substantial increase in his combat abilities, so much so that it could be described as a surge.
He could guarantee that using Yellow Bean's fist technique would make him unbeatable in the Foundation Establishment Stage, with no one being able to match him.
But the cost was too high.
Grinning foolishly, uttering nonsense... Fortunately, this time he hadn't done anything too outrageous, otherwise, how could he show his face in public?
Lu Yang secretly determined to treat Yellow Bean's fist as a forbidden technique, never to be used unless absolutely necessary.
"Fairy, I can't easily imitate you in the future, it's too dangerous." Lu Yang sighed, realizing that the power was exchanged at the cost of his sanity.
"I don't think it's dangerous though?" Fairy Eternity was confused.
"Man, you're impressive, Lu Yang. You actually killed Jiuying. I never thought your Imitation Fist could be used like that." Meng Jingzhou burst into laughter.
"It's a pity though, I can't learn your Lu Family's Imitation Fist. Otherwise, if I could transform into my father or grandfather and borrow their strength, I wonder who could beat me!" Saying this, Meng Jingzhou wore a regretful expression.
"But there's something I can't figure out."
"What is it?"
"Jiuying was tough to defeat, why didn't we just use a teleportation talisman to send it straight to the Demon Suppressing Pass?" Meng Jingzhou wondered why Lu Yang had fought so valiantly as if he were ready to die with honor. Was that really necessary?
Lu Yang: "..."
It's over, he has begun to be gradually assimilated by Fairy Eternity, his brain wasn't functioning properly.
"Senior Brother Lu, who did you transform into just now?" Tao Yaoye was curious. She had no idea that Senior Brother Lu knew such a cute little girl.
"This is an ancient inheritance, not to be spoken of lightly." Lu Yang responded mysteriously, which technically was not a lie.
The more people that knew about Fairy Eternity, the more dangerous it became.
Until now, they still did not know who had murdered Fairy Eternity, what methods they had used, or their motives.
Those who knew of Fairy Eternity's existence would likely be targeted by the enemy.
Currently, only five people knew about Fairy Eternity: Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, Man Gu, Eldest Senior Sister, and Immortal Eternity.
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu had no choice, they were present when Fairy Eternity was resurrected.
As for Eldest Senior Sister, well, who's to say who would be in danger.
Immortal Eternity couldn't leave the Seek Dao Sect, so he was relatively safe.
"Come on, let's tally up the spoils of war." Meng Jingzhou called everyone to dissect the demon beasts and look for valuable loot.
Meng Jingzhou was not short of treasures or Spirit Stones, what he enjoyed was the process of reaping the rewards.
Jiuying was turned into charred remains by Lu Yang, its demon core split in two and became a waste core, and hence, nothing valuable could be found on it.
The two demon beasts that were decapitated by a single sword were rather ordinary; apart from the demon cores and fur.
The Tiger Demon that Meng Jingzhou killed had many valuable things like tiger bones and tiger penis, both were yang invigorating, unfortunately, they were of no use to Meng Jingzhou himself.
The blood of the Tiger Demon and Lion Demon was rather valuable, a master refiner could refine it and trace it back to its origin, refining a drop of Pure blood of Luwu and Lion.
The gallbladder of the patterned python could be used as antitoxin, fetching a good price.
Tao Yaoye was the poorest among them. Lu Yang and the others had served as undercover agents in the Eternity Sect and had even contributed a little to the downfall of the Eternity Sect.
These tasks gave them contribution points.
In contrast, Tao Yaoye, although she had completed many tasks, none were as crucial as the mission of the Eternity Sect.
Man Gu peeled off the armored demon beast's scales. Their hardness and slipperiness made them excellent material for making armor.
"I'll take them back for Junior Brother Haoran to have a look." Man Gu put the scales into his jade token.
The four quickly packed up. They built a fire and prepared to cook dinner.
From going to the auction in the morning, travelling to the dense forest at noon, and engaging in battle in the afternoon, it had been a busy day. It was time to rest and enjoy themselves.
Moreover, especially after acquiring such great cooking ingredients, it would be a waste not to have a feast.
"Can we eat lion? I heard from my tribe that there's a traditional dish in the Central Plains called lion's head, which I've never tried." Man Gu suggested.
After a moment of silence, Tao Yaoye finally said, "Isn't it possible that the lion's head you're referring to and the one we have now aren't the same thing?"
"Aren't they both called lion's head?"
"...Ah well, lion's head it is then. We're eating lion today."
Everyone cooperated in the division of labor. While Man Gu had never tasted lion, he often dealt with other demon beasts when he was in the Barbarian tribe, and the processes were similar. He took the task of preparing the lion.
Lu Yang cut down a large tree, used the Green Peak Sword to cut it into a three-meter-long stake, and used it to skewer the lion.
Meng Jingzhou set up the large automatic barbecue array and put the barbecue stand in place.
Tao Yaoye went to scavenge for edibles in the area. The fruits would be a good foil to the meaty meal.
The lion, once skinned and gutted by Man Gu, was seasoned with the secret sauce of the Barbarian tribe; skewered by Lu Yang, it was placed on the barbecue stand and the Three Flavored True Fire was lit.
On the large automatic barbecue array, the lion was slowly rotating, skewered on a stake. The Three Flavored True Fire sizzled, making the oil seep out and filling the air with a delicious aroma.
Man Gu stared at the lion, dazing out as if deep in thought.
"Man Gu, what's wrong?" Lu Yang thought Man Gu was homesick.
"I was thinking, the main target of the automatic barbecue array is small skewers. When it comes to roasting whole lambs, whole lions, or other large animals, it struggles, and the heat distribution is uneven. This tests the barbecue master's skills to a great extent."
"So, you want to..." Lu Yang couldn't quite guess what Man Gu was thinking.
"I heard that some sects in the Southern Region are good at controlling corpses. Could we learn this magic skill and use it for roasting?"
"Like controlling a lamb's corpse, letting it roast itself over the fire?"
Lu Yang: "..."
Am I the only sane one left in the Seek Dao Sect?

chapters.title: Chapter 265 - 264: Do You Need to Feign Death After Becoming Immortal?_1
chapters.content:
Upon hearing Man Gu's vision, Lu Yang conjured a vivid picture in his mind:
Under the night sky, in a pitch-black, quiet, lonely forest, the bonfire was the only source of light, crackling away and amplifying the silence of the woods.
An open goat carcass, its entrails removed and mysterious herbs stuffed into its body, was placed on top of the fire. A strange dance was performed around it, appearing like a ritualistic offering to a malevolent deity.
This scene was indeed weird, pushing the boundaries of contemporary human aesthetic appreciation.
"What a great idea! Truly worthy of the Barbarian tribe. Their cognitive style is very much like that of their ancestors!" Fairy Eternity said excitedly, seeing an old friend's reflection in Man Gu.
"True, while those barbarians might look dimwitted, they sure are inventive when it comes to food!"
"Mainly, it's because the Barbarian tribe is highly self-directed and creative. And of course, not to boast, but I contributed a tiny part to that too." Fairy Eternity gestured with her thumb and index finger.
Lu Yang believed Fairy Eternity was being too modest. After all, she was the lady who initiated the progress of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe.
"My lady, do you know any magic to control corpses?"
Fairy Eternity mused, "Does the Playing Dead Technique count? It is a magic sought after by the Dragon and Phoenix Tribes. Practiced conservatively, it can be used up to the Transcendence Tribulation Stage."
"...No, it does not."
"Then I don't."
Lu Yang then thought of another question: "Have you ever used the Playing Dead Technique after becoming a fairy?"
He felt that the Playing Dead Technique might have been Fairy Eternity's survival tactic when she was weak, but after becoming a legendary figure as the leader of the Five Immortals of the Ancients, she probably wouldn't need it.
"Yes, I have."
"Huh? You still play dead even after becoming a fairy?"
This confession made Fairy Eternity blush a little, and she chuckled awkwardly.
"You know I'm not good at handling money. I spent all my spirit stones in a short time and was reduced to poverty."
"I was too embarrassed to ask for spirit stones from my believers since after all, I am their faith."
"What should I do if I don't have any money? I soon came up with an idea."
"I used the Playing Dead Technique to feign my death. The Yingtian Immortal and the other four would come to mourn for me and give me spirit stones. In this way, I was no longer broke."
"I used this trick several times and it worked pretty well."
Lu Yang: "..."
Every aspect of this scenario was problematic to him; he didn't know where to begin criticizing.
"Another thing, could Man Gu's Ancient Barbarian Tribe bloodline be temporarily sealed? We got lucky this time, attracting only Golden Core Stage demon beasts. If the next time we run into a Nascent Soul Stage beast, then we'd be in trouble."
Filled with worry, Lu Yang pondered that if they encountered a Nascent Soul Stage demon beast, Yellow Bean's fists might not hold up, and they would all have to use their Directional Teleportation Talisman to return to the Demon Suppressing Pass.
"No worries, Man Gu doesn't need to seal his bloodline. Didn't you notice at the end of the battle? Man Gu can suppress the Demon Beast with his bloodline."
"This indicates that Man Gu's Ancient Barbarian Tribe Blood can tyrannize demon beasts at the Golden Core Stage and below. The Golden Core Stage demon beasts would flee at the sight of Man Gu, while Nascent Soul Stage demon beasts wouldn't be affected by Man Gu's Ancient Barbarian Tribe blood."
"However, things will be different once Man Gu reaches the Golden Core Stage."
Fairy Eternity analyzed in great detail. As expected of the founder of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe, she was highly competent in her areas of specialty.
Lu Yang heaved a sigh of relief, feeling as if a huge burden had been lifted off his shoulders. Otherwise, he would be standing on pins and needles for the next few months in the forest.
"Would you like to grow your hair longer? I have a solution." Fairy Eternity proposed with a smile.
"What's your solution?"
"I have a set of Ginger Fist methods. Once you learn them, you'll be able to grow lustrous black hair from your bald head!"
Frankly, Lu Yang was tempted, but considering Fairy Eternity's unpredictable nature and the absurdity of this so-called 'Ginger Fist', he couldn't help but doubt.
Something seemed off.
"Forget it. My hair will grow back in about ten days to half a month."
The hair-growing speed of a normal person wouldn't be this quick, but every night, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou stimulated their scalps with spiritual energy to enhance hair growth, which proved to be quite effective.
Presently, the four of them were devouring their freshly roasted lion meat. Man Gu was hugging the lion's head and biting into it.
"The Golden Core Stage lion's meat is indeed tender and juicy."
"Lu Yang's True Fire technique is fantastic. Generally, barbecue tends to char on the outside while remaining raw on the inside. But under Lu Yang's precise control, True Fire burns both the interior and exterior of the meat evenly. He has outdone me in this aspect." Meng Jingzhou evaluated. When it came to using True Fire, he was no match for Lu Yang.
The fact that he hadn't even mastered a single True Fire technique was proof that he was inferior to Lu Yang.
Actually, Single Body Spiritual Roots inherently possessed a True Fire called Pure Yang True Fire, which could vanquish all ghosts and spirits and would be automatically mastered once the cultivator reached the Golden Core Stage.
This was quite a formidable talent, but it didn't seem that impressive compared to Lu Yang's abilities.
Having eaten their fill, the four prepared to rest.
"I suggest that Junior Sister Tao and I keep watch for the first half of the night, and Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu for the second half. What do you all think?"
"Agreed."
Both Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had experience of spending nights in the forest, so they must take turns keeping watch.
If Tao Yaoye and Man Gu were left together and something unexpected happened, like an attack from demon beasts or humans, the two might not be able to respond in time.
The forest was not just fraught with demon beasts but also dangerous humans.
While spending nights in the forest with the Five Heroes of Eagle Mountain, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had encountered human attacks.
Luckily, the attackers were mediocre in their cultivation levels and were swiftly defeated by Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
The night watch started, and Lu Yang noticed that Tao Yaoye had immediately opened up her spiritual sense to scan the surroundings. He reminded her, "Don't keep your Spiritual Sense open all the time, or it will be depleted quickly."
"The night is long, how long do you suppose you can hold out using it like that?"
It wasn't just Tao Yaoye; even Lu Yang, who possessed spiritual sense comparable to those at Golden Core Stage, wouldn't dare to use it so recklessly.
"Then, what should I do?" Tao Yaoye obediently retracted her Spiritual Sense.
"Use your eyes to see and your ears to listen. Engage all your five senses to perceive your surroundings."
"Initially, you might not be accustomed to it, but after a few tries - with your gift - you will easily adapt to this method."
"Once you get a hang of it, it will prove useful in battles."
"Don't rely too much on your Spiritual Sense as one can easily fall into the enemy's trap if they do." Lu Yang advised, passing on the lesson taught to him by Fairy Eternity.
Tao Yaoye nodded and began observing her surroundings as Lu Yang had instructed.
Both of them sat quietly, without uttering a single word to each other.
In the second half of the night, they swapped shifts. Tao Yaoye jumped onto a tree, laid flat on a branch, and fell asleep leisurely.
Seeing this, Lu Yang was reminded of their first Skin Peeling Ghost mission to the Shang Family, where Tao Yaoye complained about the bed being less comfortable than the one in the Seek Dao Sect, making it hard for her to sleep.
"It's not just me who's growing up."

chapters.title: Chapter 266 - 265 New Acquaintances_1
chapters.content:
In the depths of the dense forest, a few weary figures stumbled towards the outskirts of the forest, blood streaming down their bodies.
"Huff, Huff,"
"Damn, isn't it said that Golden Core Stage Demon Beasts are solitary creatures, never acting in groups? Why are there so many Golden Core Stage Demon Beasts here?" Song Hua complained as he ran.
"Who knows? Talk later, run now!"
"This is all your fault! After using up the last Directional Teleportation Talisman, you didn't buy new ones and still dragged us back into the forest!"
"Who knew we'd encounter a situation like this? Ask these two bodyguards, have they ever seen Golden Core Stage Beasts acting collectively?"
"Young masters, can we stop quarreling for now? Our priority is to run to the outskirts of the forest. Once we escape the danger, we can then assign blame." The two bodyguards were drenched in sweat. They knew looking after these young masters would be difficult.
They had run into a Six-tusked White Elephant at the Nascent Soul Stage before and now they somehow angered several Golden Core Stage Demon Beasts.
What rotten luck!
They had been bodyguards for many years and had never encountered such an absurd situation. One of their colleagues had already been killed by the demon beasts chasing them.
Their pursuers included a One-eyed Lone Wolf with a ferocious look and bloodlust in its eyes which had already bitten a bodyguard to death.
The Lone Wolf had red claws, and when it ran, it looked as if it was travelling on clouds and mist, moving at an astonishingly fast speed.
It howled, picking up its speed, charging towards Song Hua and the others.
"Damn it, it's a Red Cloud Wolf. It must have been a former pack leader that was expelled after being defeated by a new leader!" Song Hua cursed.
The One-eyed Lone Wolf, hearing Song Hua's curses, grew colder in its gaze. It leaped high into the air, lunging its teeth towards Song Hua's neck.
Song Hua turned around, looked at the scene, his face turned white as a sheet, a look of imminent death on his face.
Just when he accepted his fate, he heard the sound of a sword whistling by.
Hum—
The sword hum was short but powerful, carrying some indescribable charm. Only a sword master could make such a stroke.
The stroke aimed at the One-eyed Lone Wolf, causing it to turn around in a panic.
The stroke was swift, and the wolf was too slow to react; there was no chance of escape.
It had no choice but to bare its fangs and take the stroke head-on.
The Green Peak Sword clashed against the wolf's fangs, letting out a shrill noise that sent chills down the spine.
The One-eyed Lone Wolf had blood all over its mouth, with only half of its sharp fangs remaining.
Lu Yang made another move, swinging his sword at the One-eyed Lone Wolf.
At the same time, three others engaged the other three demon beasts.
Song Hua and the others were bewildered by the sudden arrival of their rescuers, not knowing whether to help or keep running or to stay put.
They didn't get much time to think. The One-eyed Wolf King's head was sent flying, and it was as dead as it could be.
Lu Yang put away his Green Peak Sword, a few drops of wolf blood splashed on his face.
"Be careful, there's another demon beast in the sky!" Song Hua shouted as a reminder.
Golden Core Stage beasts could fly. Song Hua and others planned to fly away initially, but there was a Demon Bird circling in the sky. Anyone who could fly was destined to be targeted by it.
The Demon Bird noticed Lu Yang's existence, it beat its wings, turning into a volley of meteor arrows charging towards Lu Yang.
Lu Yang had already noticed the presence of the Demon Bird. Without looking up, he casually lifted his Green Peak Sword. His movement was so casual, like a morning stretch. The Demon Bird directly collided with the tip of his sword, its head pierced through.
"Are you okay?" Lu Yang asked with concern.
"Who are you..." Song Hua and others were flabbergasted. Lu Yang's displayed realm was the late Foundation Establishment stage, but how could someone at that stage kill a One-eyed Lone Wolf and a Demon Bird?
"Tch, you're still one step ahead of me." Meng Jingzhou killed a demon beast while speaking, his fists covered in beast's blood.
"Meng Jingzhou?" Song Hua's eyes widened, recognizing Meng Jingzhou.
"You are...the third son of the Song Family, Song Hua?" Meng Jingzhou was a bit uncertain, mainly because the other party looked too disheveled, his face covered in dirt. He seemed like a refugee who had just fled, completely different from the Song Hua he remembered.
Although the Song Family was not as prestigious as the Meng Family, it was a well-known aristocratic family in the Imperial City with excellent living conditions. The last time Meng Jingzhou saw Song Hua, he was dancing merrily on a pleasure boat, dancing better than the courtesans.
"Yes, it's me!" Song Hua didn't expect Meng Jingzhou to be among those who rescued him. He had heard that Meng Jingzhou had gone missing for more than a year.
However, considering the relaxed attitude of the Meng Family, there was doubt about Meng Jingzhou's disappearance.
"He is Meng Jingzhou, the eldest son of the Meng Family?" The people behind Song Hua exclaimed in low voices. They were from the side branches of the Song Family and had never seen Meng Jingzhou.
"How many enemies have you made that you encounter them even here?" Lu Yang asked curiously.
Meng Jingzhou rolled his eyes: "Enemy? Nothing like that. Allow me to introduce, this is Song Hua, the Third Master of the Song family in the Imperial City. He is a bit older than me, and we used to play together in the Imperial City. They must have come to the forest for the same reason we did, to gain experience. Of course, they could also be here to get some glory."
"Nice to meet you, I am Lu Yang of the Seek Dao Sect."
"Seek Dao Sect?!" Song Hua exclaimed, calming down quickly, he thanked him with a fist and palm salute, "So it's a friend from the Seek Dao Sect, no wonder you are so formidable."
In that case, was Meng Jingzhou's disappearance for over a year because he went to the Seek Dao Sect for cultivation?
If so, then it is a big problem. The Meng Family was already a big disaster, and the Seek Dao Sect was an even greater disaster. Meng Jingzhou, with the background of both places, wouldn't he have enemies everywhere in the future?
Meng Jingzhou frowned, "I have a feeling you're thinking something disrespectful."
"No, no."
"We've finished ours as well." Soon, Tao Yaoye and Man Gu had also dealt with their respective demon beasts. Song Hua noticed that they were both at the late Foundation Establishment stage. After defeating the demon beasts, their clothes remained intact.
Lu Yang and the others had been training in the dense forest for two months. During this period, they only returned to the Demon Suppressing Pass three times, spending the rest of the time training in the forest.
Now regular Golden Core Stage Demon Beast poses no threat to them.
"Master Song, tell us, just what did you do to enrage so many Golden Core Stage Demon Beasts?" Meng Jingzhou asked lazily.
Song Hua was not a barbarian like Man Gu, with the bloodline of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe, naturally attracting hostility, angering one or two Golden Core Stage Demon Beasts was one thing, but how could five of them chase them at the same time?
Song Hua and the others could only laugh bitterly: "We honestly don't have any idea, we just went a bit deeper than usual, thinking of killing a few more high-quality Golden Core Stage Demon Beasts to report back."
"But the strangest thing is, there should have been more Golden Core Stage Demon Beasts deeper in the forest, but we walked for a long time without encountering a single one. When we finally did, you saw the situation, five of them appeared all at once, and one bodyguard was even swallowed whole."
"Fortunately, you were there to help. Otherwise, I'm afraid I wouldn't have made it out of the forest alive today." Song Hua felt an afterglow of fear. He decided firmly that once he returned to the Demon Suppressing Pass, he would take a flying boat back to his family.
They had already gained enough from this journey to report back to their family, there was no need to take further risks.
Lu Yang and the others exchanged glances. Something unknown must have happened deep in the forest.

chapters.title: Chapter 267 - 266: Herbal Celestial Grass_1
chapters.content:
Two months of training had given the four of them a sufficient understanding of the dense forest.
The Demon Beasts of the Golden Core Stage generally have a strong sense of pride. Unless confronted with a situation that incites the public outrage of the Demon Beasts, like the Ancient Barbarian Tribe bloodline, they would not act alone.
"It's indeed strange. In theory, my bloodline should exert a suppressive effect on the Demon Beasts, but I didn't feel this in our recent battle," Man Gu reflected upon the anomaly he encountered during the fight.
The Ancient Barbarian Tribe bloodline proved advantageous in the battles against the Demon Beasts. Since his successful bloodline awakening, Man Gu had not encountered such a situation.
Lu Yang furrowed his eyebrows, pondering over the cause.
"Ah--What is this!"
Suddenly, a sharp cry interrupted Lu Yang's thoughts.
"Song Wuguo, what are you screaming at!" Song Hua scolded his companion. Everyone was deep in thought, and your shout just disrupted everyone's train of thought.
"You, you look over there!" Song Wuguo sat on the ground, trembling as he pointed at the dissected Demon Beast.
Originally, he intended to dissect the Inner Core of the Demon Beast to repay the lifesaving grace of Lu Yang and his companions. However, the abnormality of the Inner Core frightened him.
Lu Yang directly walked over and saw an eviscerated lone wolf with an Inner Core at the Dantian position. It was somewhat dull in color, with dense and thin yellow leaves wrapping around the Inner Core. The leaves were interconnected by a white, stringy substance, sticky and slimy.
Lu Yang covered his right arm with his spiritual essence and pulled out this peculiar Inner Core.
"There's nothing unusual about the Inner Core, which means the issue lies with the leaves?"
"Go dissect the other Demon Beasts!"
Everyone moved swiftly to dissect the Demon Beasts, and the results quickly emerged - the Inner Cores of all five Demon Beasts were wrapped within these yellow leaves.
Lu Yang racked his brain, covering all the knowledge he had, but found no correlation to these leaves: "Does anyone recognize these leaves?"
Even the worldly Meng Jingzhou continually shook his head.
Tao Yaoye and Man Gu also shook their heads to indicate their lack of recognition.
Not to mention the people from the Song Family, their knowledge was barely on par with Tao Yaoye and Man Gu. Their skill set was limited to identifying common spiritual plants.
The two bodyguards had lived at the Demon Suppressing Pass all year round and had not seen these leaves either.
"I feel like I've seen this in a book...could it be the Herbal Celestial Grass?" Song Wuguo muttered softly.
"Herbal Celestial Grass?" Everyone turned their heads towards Song Wuguo simultaneously.
Song Wuguo felt immense pressure. He was timid and preferred reading to interacting with people. It was his first time being viewed by so many people.
"Wuguo, do you know the origin of the leaves?"
"I, I just find it familiar. I'm not certain. I saw it in a book from the Great Yu era in the Scripture Pavilion. It was a master refiner's notes, which mentioned a spiritual plant called the Herbal Celestial Grass. The illustration in the book was very similar to this."
"The book mentioned that the Herbal Celestial Grass initially grew like weeds and had a strong ability to disguise itself. It would mimic the appearance of nearby plants."
"When it's about to mature, it devours the Demon Beasts, uses them as nutrients to promote its own growth."
"At the same time, it can parasitize a part of itself within the Demon Beast, controlling every move of the Demon Beast, making it go out and hunt for its food."
"The word 'Herbal' in 'Herbal Celestial Grass' is derived from its parasitic characteristic, meaning 'grazing'."
"You all know the magic skill to manipulate corpses, right? The cultivator who originated this skill was supposedly inspired by the parasitic method of the Herbal Celestial Grass."
"What a wicked plant!" Meng Jingzhou frowned. This Herbal Celestial Grass exuded an aura of wickedness.
"Fairy, have you heard of the Herbal Celestial Grass?" Lu Yang asked Fairy Eternity surreptitiously.
"There are a few minor errors, but overall, it's not far off." Fairy Eternity more or less confirmed the existence of the Herbal Celestial Grass.
Song Wuguo, who was rarely given attention, began to grow more excited as he spoke: "Brother Song Hua, this Herbal Celestial Grass is so rare that even the Unification Great Power hasn't seen it before. It's beneficial for the cultivation of the Unification Stages.
If we bring the Herbal Celestial Grass back to the clan and present it to our great-grandfather, our status in the Song Family will be solidified!"
"If we work it well, you might even become the Clan Leader!"
"Is this thing really that rare?!"
"Indeed, the ancient book I read was by a Unification Stage master refiner. He only saw two strands of Herbal Celestial Grass in his entire life. The book also recorded that the Herbal Celestial Grass Pill, refined from the Herbal Celestial Grass, could enhance a Unification Stage by one small Realm!"
Song Hua's eyes lit up. As expected, it was a valuable item, but he quickly cooled down: "We were nearly hunted by the Herbal Celestial Grass. With our abilities, can we really pluck the Herbal Celestial Grass alive? Better to go back and inform the uncles, and have them take action."
"If we let the uncles take action, how would the merit be calculated. Brother Song Hua, don't worry, we do have a chance to pluck the Herbal Celestial Grass."
"How so?"
"The most number of Demon Beasts a Herbal Celestial Grass can control is ten. These five are of the Golden Core Stage, which indicates that it can only control Golden Core Stage Demon Beasts at most. In other words, it only has five Golden Core Stage Demon Beasts left."
"As long as we have Young Master Meng's help, these five Golden Core Stage Demon Beasts are not to be feared!"
Song Hua thought it through, and it was indeed the case.
Both the Meng Family and Seek Dao Sect cultivators have one common trait, they won't use an Elixir to directly advance their Realm.
Therefore, neither the Meng Family nor Seek Dao Sect would snatch the Herbal Celestial Grass from him.
"Our plan is this: once I've obtained the Herbal Celestial Grass, I will report it to my family and thank the four of you with a substantial gift!"
The Song Family would always keep to their promises.
Song Hua did not conceal his true thoughts; instead, he voiced it out boldly.
If he were to conceal it now, it would only disrupt his relationship with the Meng Family once Meng Jingzhou finds out, bringing about more harm than good.
Meng Jingzhou made a promise on behalf of everyone. They originally intended to pluck out the Herbal Celestial Grass anyway. The threat of Herbal Celestial Grass was too great. If it was allowed to hunt for nutrients unhindered, countless people would fall prey to it.
"We were attacked by the Demon Beasts in this direction, so the Herbal Celestial Grass is probably here!" Song Wuguo recalled the escape route. He remained calm even during the escape, remembering the route.
"Let's move!" Everyone finished their rest and set off in the depths of the forest.
Ten figures moved quickly through the woods, taking turns to extend their Spiritual Sense, searching for clues leading to the Herbal Celestial Grass.
"The ancient book mentioned that the Herbal Celestial Grass likes a dark and damp environment, I hope everyone can keep this in mind while searching," Song Wuguo reminded loudly.
"Understood."
"Found it! It's right in the middle of that swamp!" Song Hua exclaimed, his voice filled with excitement.
"Stay alert! The Demon Beasts controlled by the Herbal Celestial Grass maybe around!" Lu Yang warned everyone through Spiritual Sense.
No sooner had Lu Yang finished speaking than everyone heard the Beast's roar from above their heads.
"Roar--"
Five formidable Demon Beasts appeared above their heads.
"Stick to our previous plan - pair up into teams. I and the Sect Leader of Seek Dao Sect will engage in the main fight, the people from the Song family will be on the flanks, and the two bodyguards will join forces against one!"
"Yes!"
Everyone reacted instantly. Lu Yang picked a Demon Beast to fight, Song Wuguo provided Lu Yang with flank support, and Song Hua provided support for Meng Jingzhou.
Clang--
The Green Peak Sword was unleashed, casting a silver light like the moon in the night sky, bright and inviolable.
The sword light transformed into a sharp killing intent, confronting a Demon Beast.
With peripheral vision, Tao Yaoye watched the Herbal Celestial Grass in the middle of the swamp, experiencing an unmistakable sense of unrest.
She always felt that something was wrong, but she couldn't put her finger on it.

chapters.title: Chapter 268 - 267: Everything I Play With, Nine Parts Truth, One Part Lie_1
chapters.content:
The other five demon beasts controlled by the Herbal Celestial Grass are remarkable. Although they cannot match Jiuying's level, they are top-tier among the late stage Golden Core demon beasts.
Even a cultivator of the same level would find it challenging to face these five demon beasts.
Unfortunately for them, their opponents are disciples of the Seek Dao Sect, the best at the Foundation Establishment Stage.
In the past, Tao Yaoye and Man Gu would have struggled against late stage Golden Core demon beasts, but after continuous trials and tribulations, their strength is no longer what it used to be.
In the words of Lu Yang, they have reached the pinnacle of the late Foundation Establishment Stage.
If Tao Yaoye and Man Gu were so strong, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou who had stepped forward earlier were undoubtedly stronger still. They couldn't only be measured by the Foundation Establishment Stage anymore.
These five late Golden Core demon beasts pose no threat!
Lu Yang's opponent is a four-armed black gorilla, even its pupils are black.
With a sword ringing, a limb from the four-armed black gorilla was cut off, it let out a furious roar.
Roar——
"Stop howling, Arhat Fist!" Lu Yang throws a punch, demonstrating the Arhat Fist. Although his strength is not as great, the effect of the punch is not diminished.
The black gorilla felt a chill on the top of its head. It reached up to find the top of its head bald, completely bare.
What had this human done to it?!
"Well, a bald black gorilla; such a demon beast is unprecedented!" Lu Yang was on high alert. What a cultivator fears the most is the unknown. This black gorilla, unrecorded in mankind's history, must be extremely powerful!
"What?! It's the bald black gorilla from ancient legends!" Meng Jingzhou who was also in battle noticed Lu Yang's opponent, his face change drastically.
"Legend has it that the realm of a bald black gorilla can be measured by the number of hair on its head. One hair represents the Qi Refinement Stage, also known as the one-hair realm. Two hairs- the Foundation Establishment Stage, also known as the two-hair realm. Three hairs represent the Golden Core Stage, also known as the three-hair realm!"
"What stage does this black gorilla belong to?!"
Lu Yang's grim expression was about to drip water: "The bald realm!"
Song Hua: "Could the two of you not stage a drama while we are fighting? I get distracted easily."
"Oh, sorry about that, just a habit."
Song Hua: "..."
Lucky for them, the Meng Family and Seek Dao Sect members are all adept in combat, they could even spare a moment for a joke amidst a battle of different levels. Anyone else would have run cold long ago.
"Lu, save me!" Playing the periphery, Song Wuguo was identified by a demon beast. The beast's tail swept across him, breaking half of his ribs.
Knowing that it was not a match for Lu Yang, the demon beast roared and continued its attack on Song Wuguo.
"Hold on!" Lu Yang fiercely dashed towards the demon beast, blocking it from reaching Song Wuguo.
The Green Peak Sword stood horizontally across his chest, no matter how hard the beast tried, it couldn't move any further.
Just when Lu Yang was about to get serious and dispatch the demon beast once and for all.
Puchi——
A sharp dagger pierced through Lu Yang's chest.
Lu Yang slowly turned his head, disbelief in his eyes as he looked at Song Wuguo: "Why..."
Meng Jingzhou saw the scene; his eyes turned bloodshot: "Lu Yang!"
He wanted to rush over and help Lu Yang, but the demon beasts attacked fiercely, it was impossible for him to escape.
"Song Wuguo, you deserve to die!"
The others felt the same way, but they were blocked by the demon beasts.
Having abandoned his earlier timid demeanor, Song Wuguo shook his head: "The dagger is poisoned, even a cultivator at the Nascent Soul Stage would die. I might as well tell you before you die."
"You are bait."
"You are the strongest of us all. Once I control you, the others pose no threat."
Song Wuguo turned his palm, revealing a seed, and slapped it towards Lu Yang's Dantian.
"This is the seed of Herbal Celestial Grass. Relax, soon you will be the servant of the master."
"No, why can't the seed of Herbal Celestial Grass enter your body!"
Song Wuguo's face changed, realizing something was wrong. He wanted to escape, but saw a chillingly eerie smile on Lu Yang's face.
A mini Lu Yang crawled out from Lu Yang's arms.
The mini Lu Yang grew to full size as soon as it met the wind. It took the Green Peak Sword and slayed the demon beast who was about to attack.
At the same time, the poisoned Lu Yang fell backward and merged with the ground.
"Clone?!" Song Wuguo's eyes widened in disbelief.
For half a month, Lu Yang had been staying small and in his arms, controlling the clone to fight, to train his spiritual sense and improve his proficiency with the clone.
"I've been waiting for half a day, and you've finally made your move," Lu Yang said with a smile.
"How did you discover me!" Song Wuguo was shocked. They had only been in contact for a short while and he believed he was flawless, without any exposure. How was he discovered?
"Song Wuguo, what the hell is going on!" Song Hua, watching this scene, was even more shocked than Song Wuguo. "You've been parasitized, when did this happen!"
Seeing that Lu Yang was safe, everyone breathed a sigh of relief and in high spirits, resolved the other four demon beasts.
Everyone was circling Song Wuguo, filled with rage.
Lu Yang gave a cold laugh, not caring to let Song Wuguo know his behavior was naive.
"When you introduced the Herbal Celestial Grass, you said it controls the demon beasts, using them as nourishment. The demon beasts we've met were all controlled by the Herbal Celestial Grass."
"So the question is why would the Herbal Celestial Grass let the demon beasts kill people if they're its nourishment?"
"The answer is simple because people are also the nourishment of the Herbal Celestial Grass."
"If people are the nourishment of the Herbal Celestial Grass, then can it control the human race as well? The answer is definite."
"So why didn't you clarify this? Is it that the master refiner at the Unification stage had a failing brain, didn't complete his writing? Or were you afraid we'd figure it out, so you deliberately didn't introduce it?"
Lu Yang kicked Song Wuguo over, "Nine truths one fake, these are what I left to play with, to play these in front of me, you underestimated me, didn't you?"
"I didn't expose you all this time, was just waiting for you to lead us to the Herbal Celestial Grass."
The depths of the dense forest were vast, it was hard to find the Herbal Celestial Grass without someone leading.
Song Wuguo planned to deceived Lu Yang and others to go, so Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou planned to use his plot against him.
After hearing Lu Yang's explanation, Tao Yaoye finally understood where the inconsistency was.
Meng Jingzhou wasn't surprised by this. The two previous shouts were all acting.
"Song Wuguo has been parasitized and controlled by the Herbal Celestial Grass, I can't rule out the suspicion on you guys. Please cooperate and return to the Demon Suppressing Pass for inspection," Lu Yang said coldly.
Having a betrayer in the Song family, Song Hua and others knew they were in the wrong and could only obediently return for inspection to prove their innocence.
"Heh, heh, heh," Song Wuguo gave a dry laugh, his voice not human-like, "So what if you found out, do you still want to leave once you've made it here?"
As he spoke, bubbles kept rising from the swamp, like boiling water. Countless muddy figures emerged from beneath the swamp, some from the demon race and some from the human race. Judging by the energy they emitted, they were all at the Golden Core Stage, at least fifty to sixty of them!
Lu Yang suddenly remembered the warning the guild servant gave them when they first met, "People disappear in the dense forest every day, especially recently, more people have disappeared."
"Could it be that this is the reason for the recent disappearance of cultivators?"
"No, wasn't it said that the Herbal Celestial Grass can control a maximum of ten creatures?"
Not to mention the human and demon race that just emerged from the swamp, but just look at the ten demon beasts and one Song Wuguo from before.
That's already eleven!
"Fairy, what's going on?"
Fairy Eternity frowned, "Song Wuguo didn't lie to you, an ordinary Herbal Celestial Grass can control up to ten creatures."
"But what you're facing is not an ordinary Herbal Celestial Grass, or to be precise, not an ordinary Spiritual Plant."
"It has developed a consciousness, just like the Time Immortal, it's a spiritually awakened plant."

chapters.title: Chapter 269 - 268: Long Planned_1
chapters.content:
"The Time Immortal's body is like the Herbal Celestial Grass; they're both spiritual plants that developed intelligence?" Lu Yang was amazed. It was extremely rare for spiritual plants to develop intelligence, even more so for them to reach a state of accomplishment.
In his knowledge, there were two instances where a spiritual plant could develop intelligence. One was living long enough to gradually gain intelligence, similar to the Little Medicinal Kings in the medicinal garden.
The Little Medicinal Kings had lived for at least one hundred thousand years. To picture a spiritual medicine living for one hundred thousand years without being harvested attests to astonishing luck.
The other scenario involved many coincidences, such as living long-term in a top quality spirit stone mine, absorbing spiritual energy day and night, or being exposed to some Heavenly Dao, receiving its grace. Sometimes it was due to a Great Power's enlightenment and so on.
The number of intelligent spiritual plants was scarce, and their understanding among people was limited. Even if the Seek Dao Sect's medicinal garden housed several Little Medicinal Kings, it would still be difficult to research thoroughly.
All spiritual plants varied tremendously in characteristics; the lack of comparative standards made it impossible to study them.
However, one thing could be confirmed; the intelligent spiritual plants' capabilities were hundreds of times higher than those without intelligence.
Take the current Herbal Celestial Grass for example. It controlled at least fifty to sixty Golden Core Stages, and it was uncertain whether there were more hidden.
"If Time Immortal heard you, he wouldn't be pleased. How could the Herbal Celestial Grass be compared to him?"
"Time Immortal's body is a Firmament Tree that stretches from the heavens to the earth. Even without intelligence, it is a celestial tree that is rarely seen throughout the ages. Before it gained intelligence, its branches grew from one planet to another, enormously large."
"After it developed intelligence, it was still weak. Fearing attention from malicious individuals, it snapped off a branch, took on a human appearance and walked the world for cultivation. The results of this cultivation would feedback to the main body."
"At the time of its ascension, its power was overbearing and could not be concealed. There was no longer a need to hide. Only then did people realize that the peerless genius, master of time, was not a human, but a tree."
"Perhaps because the Firmament Tree lived long enough, Time Immortal was especially talented in the aspect of time, using 'Suiyue' as his Dao Fruit to achieve immortality."
Without Fairy Eternity stating this, Lu Yang had indeed thought that Time Immortal had gained the power of time from eating the meals cooked by Fairy Eternity.
Lu Yang didn't listen further to Fairy Eternity's discussion about the ancient secrets. The current circumstances were extremely urgent. As the leader, he needed to make a decision quickly on whether to fight or return to the Demon Suppressing Pass.
Lu Yang sent a message to Meng Jingzhou and the other two: "Prepare the Directional Teleportation Talismans. Take the Song Family with you and return to the Demon Suppressing Pass!"
Lu Yang quickly made a decision. They can't stay in this situation.
Not to even mention about the burden of having the Song Family with them, the sixty Golden Core Stages wrapped in mud alone was more than enough for Lu Yang and the others to handle.
Four cultivators at the late stage of Foundation Establishment defeating sixty Golden Core Stages?
It was an impossible task; the enemy could simply exhaust them to death.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had twelve Directional Teleportation Talismans between them, more than enough to transport everyone.
Removing Song Wuguo, there were still three people from the Song Family remaining. Along with the two bodyguards, there were five from the Song Family camp they needed to save.
Lu Yang, holding the Green Peak Sword, stood at the forefront, eyeing cautiously at the Golden Core Stages emerging from the swamp. He signaled Meng Jingzhou to distribute the Directional Teleportation Talismans quickly before the Herbal Celestial Grass launched their attack.
The two Golden Core Stages covered in mud made their move. Both were from the Human Race. Their faces were plastered with mud, making their features hard to see.
Lu Yang met their blows with his sword, cutting off their arms. Despite the pain, these two relentlessly attacked Lu Yang.
These two were only at the mid-stage Golden Core Stage, but by virtue of a fighting style that disregarded bodily harm, they temporarily held off Lu Yang.
"Don't get tangled up with them! Once the talismans are distributed, run!" Meng Jingzhou transmitted via Spiritual Sense.
"Okay!"
With great effort, Lu Yang swung his sword and repelled the two assailants. Together with everyone else, he took out a Directional Teleportation Talisman.
The Directional Teleportation Talisman automatically ignited, transporting everyone to the Demon Suppressing Pass.
Suddenly, a light laughter echoed, "All of you can escape, except for you, Lu Yang."
Lu Yang's expression changed, sensing trouble.
The source of the voice came from the center of the swamp, it was the Herbal Celestial Grass speaking!
The Herbal Celestial Grass gently swayed. All the spirit stones buried underground quickly depleted of their spiritual energy, turning back into transparent crystals.
The concealed grand array surrounding them was activated, casting spots of light that converged on Lu Yang and interrupted his transmission.
"Lu Yang!"
"Senior Brother Lu!"
"Brother Lu!"
Meng Jingzhou and the two others cried out involuntarily after seeing this scene right before the teleportation.
No one had expected that the Herbal Celestial Grass would specifically target Lu Yang, let alone prepare an array to interrupt his transmission in advance.
Everything changed within an instant; by the time everyone realized something unexpected had occurred, they were already back at Demon Suppressing Pass.
"What should we do?" Song Hua and others were at a loss. Although they had been saved, Lu Yang was still back there, needing rescue.
Without hesitation, Meng Jingzhou rushed towards Demon Suppressing Pass, preparing to disclose his identity and rescue Lu Yang.
...
"I certainly didn't expect to be targeted like this." Lu Yang stared at the Herbal Celestial Grass while the corners of his mouth did not curve upwards into a smile.
The Herbal Celestial Grass spoke again, its voice young, reminiscent of a graceful and elegant young master.
"Lu Yang, I have had my eye on you for two months, you have finally stepped into my trap, how could I let you go?"
Lu Yang felt a chill in his heart. Does that mean the Herbal Celestial Grass was watching him ever since he set foot into the depths of the dense forest?
He remembered the Golden Core Stage cultivators he encountered over the past couple of months, could they have been under the control of the Herbal Celestial Grass?
"Judging from the powers you've demonstrated, you must possess the Sword Spirit Root, right?"
"We spiritual plants have plenty of life-saving measures but not many offensive methods. What I hope for the most is to absorb cultivators with Golden Spirit Root or Sword Spirit Root. It can enhance my offensive abilities. I initially thought I would have no chance of encountering these two types of spirit roots before maturing, but here you are, arriving at my doorstep."
"Of course, that's not the most crucial part; the most vital is your clone technique!"
"Hand over your clone technique; perhaps I might spare your life!"
The Golden Core Stage cultivator, controlled by the Herbal Celestial Grass, observed Lu Yang from afar. Lu Yang's use of the Wooden Avatar made it itch with desire.
Spiritual plants cannot move until a specific age is reached. The Herbal Celestial Grass desires nothing more than the clone technique. It can use this to control the clones and perform tasks it wishes to do.
Additionally, the clone technique used by Lu Yang was one that involved wood, which matches the best with spiritual plants.
It was determined to get this clone technique no matter what!
