For this reason, it meticulously designed the trap, luring Lu Yang step by step. Even though Song Wuguo was exposed, the overall plan remained unaffected.
As long as they reach the swamp, Lu Yang is as good as dead!
"You wouldn't be able to learn it even if I handed it over." Lu Yang shook his head. If he could make a mess of "Tree-Planting Sutra," he didn't believe that Herbal Celestial Grass could do the same.
"Why don't we sit down and have a nice chat? You can return to the sect with me. The sect has a wealth of resources to nurture you, and you won't need to make painstaking efforts to collect nutrients here. It would be beneficial for both of us."
The Herbal Celestial Grass chuckled coldly, "I know what you're trying to do. You just want to stall for time, hoping that your companions will go to Demon Suppressing Pass and bring back help. Do you think I'm unprepared?"
"Mountain Moving Array, activate!"
The leaf surface of the Herbal Celestial Grass rhythmically swayed as the Golden Core Stage cultivators lifted their hands simultaneously to activate another concealed array.
Lu Yang felt the ground beneath him shake, after which it stabilized.
"We have been transported to another location. The high-ups of Demon Suppressing Pass won't be able to locate this place."
"Now, are you ready to provide nourishment for me?"
Lu Yang looked serious, "So, you're pushing me to summon Eldest Senior Sister, is that it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 270 - 269 How Dare You Bully the Second-in-command of My Immortal Sect!?_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang didn't immediately summon Eldest Senior Sister. He didn't even start fighting before he called her. Given her temperament, it was uncertain whether he or Herbal Celestial Grass would be the first to be hit.
At least he needed to kill some Golden Core Stage cultivators first to save face for Eldest Senior Sister.
"Attack!"
At Herbal Celestial Grass's command, both the human and demon race Golden Core Stage creatures set up a roar and launched their attacks together.
These Golden Core Stage cultivators were obscured by mud, and their original appearances couldn't be seen.
One person was wielding a golden wheel, its fast rotation scraping off large chunks of flesh.
Another held a bowl of an unknown era, a bowl with a chip in it, like the kind used by street beggars.
A demon beast spread its wings and rose into the air, uttering a crane's cry.
Lu Yang recalled from his recently purchased "Forest Manual" that there was a late-stage Golden Core white crane deep in the forest, which had a tendency to revert to the mythic power of an ancestral bird and had claimed the lives of several late-stage Golden Core cultivators.
Another demon beast had the appearance of a tiger or leopard, with five tails, horns on its head, and its cries sounded like the knocking of stones.
Lu Yang connected this description with that in the "Forest Manual": "A mid-stage Golden Core ancient demon beast, Zheng."
Another demon beast looked like a horse, with grey-black eyes and no whites, its cry sounding like a human singing.
"A mid-stage Golden Core ancient demon beast, Lushu."
"With so many demon beasts at your disposal, you're still not satisfied and want me?"
Lu Yang laughed, unmoved in the face of encircling enemies, "Such greed will not lead to a long journey on the road of cultivation."
Fairy Eternity had repeatedly warned Lu Yang that cultivators should not be excessively greedy. Greed can offer momentary pleasure, but it won't help one journey far on the path of cultivation.
"No need for the dead to worry." Herbal Celestial Grass didn't take Lu Yang's warning to heart.
During their conversation, a golden wheel was thrown out. As it spun, occasional flashes of lightning sliced a ravine into the ground.
Boom—
The Green Peak Sword appeared out of nowhere, blocking the golden wheel.
Unexpectedly, the golden wheel split into two, circumventing the Green Peak Sword and rushing towards Lu Yang.
Lu Yang continuously retreated as the golden wheel relentlessly pursued him. Regardless of whether he shifted left or right, the golden wheel would track him, nearly grazing him several times.
When Lu Yang used the Green Peak Sword to block again, the golden wheel split into four, maintaining its speed.
"It seems that as long as it clashes with the golden wheel, the number of golden wheels increases, and it can track me as well."
Lu Yang quickly analyzed the characteristics of the golden wheel, finding it to be quite challenging.
"Shorten Space!"
Lu Yang shrank into the ground. The golden wheel hit the ground and could no longer move.
Just when Lu Yang wanted to take a breath and find an opportunity to escape, a beam of light pierced through the thick mud and shone on him.
Lu Yang couldn't move his body, he was immobilized by the beam of light and pulled out of the ground.
Looking up, Lu Yang saw it was the broken bowl.
As Lu Yang was immobilized, countless demon beasts seized the opportunity to pounce on him, trying to tear him to pieces.
"It seems to be a immobilizing magic artifact."
With a thought, Lu Yang called forth Sword Qi that shot up into the sky, sweeping in all directions and overturning the ground, temporarily repelling the surrounding demon beasts.
The Sword Qi morphed again, swooping upwards to strike at the broken bowl.
The Sword Qi soared into the sky, continuously shifting, as if locked in a standoff with the broken bowl. Suddenly, the Sword Qi magnified, becoming dazzlingly brilliant, and it cut a notch in the bowl's base.
Light emitted from the palm of the owner of the broken bowl, continuous strikes were made, with flashes of lightning appearing intermittently. Lu Yang countered with Arhat Fist.
The sound of a crane's cry echoed, emanating from above Lu Yang's head. The white crane dived, its beak sharp as a heavenly sword, aiming to skewer Lu Yang.
"Green Peak Sword, go!"
While clashing palms with the Tavern Keeper, Lu Yang mentally controlled his Green Peak Sword, warding off the attack from above.
Spreading his Spiritual Sense, Lu Yang discovered countless humans and demon beasts ready to strike, preparing to deal him a lethal blow.
These attacks wouldn't kill him, but they were enough to deliver a severe blow.
As the battle intensified, Lu Yang gained some insight. It was as if there was a halo in front of him, obscured by heavy fog and not entirely visible.
Just as Lu Yang was trying to dispel the fog for a clear view, a demon beast attacked.
The beast scraped the ground with its four hooves, using its horn to ram into Lu Yang.
Although Lu Yang countered by severing the beast's horn with his Green Peak Sword, he was injured in the process. His waist was hit by the horn, and blood flowed freely.
Casually, Lu Yang swallowed an elixir, stopping the bleeding.
A Lushu, a type of demon beast, descended from the sky. Its four hooves were like four large millstones, determined to crush Lu Yang to death.
Lu Yang adopted the stance of supporting heaven, clashing forcibly with the Lushu. The Lushu was sent flying by his palms, but Lu Yang was far from unscathed. He felt a sharp pain in both arms, as if they were falling apart.
After continuous attacks, Lu Yang's condition deteriorated. He didn't even have the chance to take an elixir, and the fog between him and the halo thickened.
"How can someone in the late Foundation Establishment stage withstand so many fatal moves from the Golden Core Stage? I really want to taste what you are made of." Herbal Celestial Grass became more impressed with Lu Yang.
The stronger Lu Yang became, the stronger Herbal Celestial Grass would become after devouring him.
Spiritual Plants rarely develop spiritual knowledge. But once they do, they have the potential to reach the heavens!
"Damn it, it's just a broken grass, how dare it bully the second-in-command of the Eternity lineage! Does it really think that Fairy Eternity has no temper?" Fairy Eternity saw Lu Yang injured, and was both anxious and angry.
"Lu Yang, give me a wooden avatar made from Twin Lotus. It will be more effective than the Bodi tree seed!"
At these words, Lu Yang paused slightly, his eyes lit up, and he nodded, retreating into the ground.
"Trying to retreat into the ground again? It's useless!" Herbal Celestial Grass thought that Lu Yang was using the same old trick, trying to escape by shrinking the earth.
Lu Yang quickly took out a Twin Lotus seed and activated the "Tree-Planting Sutra".
A lotus broke out of the ground, on its leaves stood two Lu Yangs—one was Lu Yang's original body, the other a clone made of lotus root.
"Exactly this, exactly this!" Herbal Celestial Grass was thrilled to see Lu Yang execute the Clone technique—it was the skill it long desired for.
"A technique that even I, as a fairy, can't learn, and you, a raggedy grass, also want to learn?" The lotus root Lu Yang chuckled mockingly at Herbal Celestial Grass's arrogance.
Lotus root Lu Yang moved a little, deciding that he preferred his original appearance.
She snapped her fingers like she was undertaking a transformation. The outside turned into tender lotus petals and, as the petals fell one by one, Fairy Eternity's true form was revealed.
The usually smiley girl changed her demeanor. Looking at the dark mass of humans and demon beasts, she scowled, feeling quite unhappy.
"A bunch of filth, touching you will dirty my hands. Lu Yang, hand me my cloth, it can barely be used as a weapon."
The cloth, both strong and rustic, was an excellent weapon that could withstand the test of time.
As Fairy Eternity spoke, she gathered her hair into a knot, so it wouldn't get dirty during the fight.
Lu Yang took out a piece of red ribbon from his Identity Jade and handed it to Fairy Eternity.
Fairy Eternity held the red ribbon, a nostalgic look in her eyes. With a flick of her hand, the ribbon seemed to come alive—it was as red as fire, long as a dragon, and fluttered lightly.
"Go!"
Fairy Eternity seized one end of the red ribbon, throwing it forward. The other end of the ribbon, sharp as an iron whip, divided the beast in two.
"Your ancestors didn't dare to breathe in front of me, yet you dare to harm Lu Yang?"

chapters.title: Chapter 271 - 270: Lu Yang's Changes_1
chapters.content:
Fairy Eternity held a red silk ribbon, she was awe-inspiring, easily harvesting a Golden Core Stage Demon Beast with a single casual strike.
Her brow slightly furrowed, she looked rather cute.
This was the first time Lu Yang saw Fairy Eternity take action. That seemingly casual strike was actually imbued with the mysteries of the world.
In Lu Yang's eyes, that strike demonstrated Fairy Eternity's precise control of power, without wasting even a smidge of it.
You should know, Fairy Eternity was using a clone of Lu Yang, and only had eighty percent of Lu Yang's power.
If it had been Lu Yang himself, he too could have killed the Golden Core Stage Demon Beast with a single strike, but he absolutely couldn't achieve the same finesse as Fairy Eternity, and would waste a lot of power.
Whoosh——
The red silk ribbon was like a Flood Dragon in the sea. Each time it struck, it would take away a Golden Core Stage being.
In just the blink of an eye, two Golden Core Stage Demon Beasts and a Golden Core Stage Cultivator had been bisected by the red silk ribbon.
If there were a Golden Core Stage attacking, Fairy Eternity could control the red silk ribbon to shield herself, any attacks landing on the silk ribbon would leave no trace.
The red silk ribbon was of the same level as the Immortal Treasures obtained by the Eternity Sect. It wouldn't be damaged, even if a Unification Stage were to attack it, let alone a Golden Core Stage.
"Who are you!" Herbal Celestial Grass demanded, seeing Fairy Eternity repeatedly strike, it was shocked and felt a bad premonition.
Just now, it seemed clear that victory was secured and Lu Yang was sure to die. But suddenly, an unknown variable appeared!
It had clearly just seen Lu Yang use a cloning technique to produce another Lu Yang.
But why did the clone undergo such a drastic change in appearance, transforming into a woman? And the woman's tone was astonishingly grand, completely different from the impression Lu Yang gave.
Did this so-called Lu Yang have a dual personality, or was there another reason?
Herbal Celestial Grass was unable to figure out the reason for a moment.
Fairy Eternity sneered, disregarding Herbal Celestial Grass's question: "A mere spirit-possessed weed that is controlling a bunch of things exuding a smell of the dead, you also qualify to ask me who I am?"
"As for creatures like you, I don't know how many I have killed before I became an Immortal!"
"Absolutely outrageous, there are just two of you in the Foundation Establishment Stage. You can come at me together!" Herbal Celestial Grass was angered by Fairy Eternity. The strike of the red silk ribbon did not surpass the Foundation Establishment Stage. This meant its opponent was simply a single Foundation Establishment Stage being multiplied into two.
There are seventy of us at the Golden Core Stage here. Can we not defeat two at the Foundation Establishment stage?
Both the realm and the numbers are right here. There are no clever methods to bridge the gap in between.
Fairy Eternity was not in the slightest bit afraid when facing hordes of Golden Core Stage beings, as if she were accustomed to this scene.
The red silk ribbon flew out with a whoosh and wrapped around the Demon Beast Lushu, who was preparing to attack. Despite Lushu's struggles and wrenching, it couldn't break free from the ribbon's confinement.
Fairy Eternity grasped the other end of the red silk ribbon, harshly slamming Lushu into the ground. The immense impact made the ground slightly tremble.
The other Golden Core Stages launched attacks from the air, from underground, and from every direction. Their goal was clear, to kill the clone of Lu Yang!
Fairy Eternity wielded the red silk ribbon, whirling Lushu about, after a high-speed rotation, the red silk ribbon, like a flail, was powerfully smashed into the group of Golden Core Stages.
Bang—— Bang——
Each of Fairy Eternity's strikes was like cannonballs. Whoever was hit by this strike would suffer severe injuries if not death, with limbs broken. Even for Herbal Celestial Grass to control these beings to get up would be difficult.
However, as the number of Golden Core Stages attacking increased, the movements of the red silk ribbon were greatly constrained, and it could no longer swing freely to harvest enemies at will.
Fairy Eternity immediately changed her battle style, tossing aside Lushu who was already beaten into a lump of flesh, and used the red silk ribbon to wrap around her entire body.
This clone was not as robust as Lu Yang's main body and was not sufficient to support the upcoming high-intensity close combat. The red silk ribbon had to be used to wrap around and protect the entire body.
A Golden Core Stage Body Cultivator charged at the forefront. Fairy Eternity arched her eyebrows and slapped his face.
"Ha!"
With a charming shout, the power behind the slap increased and she swung downwards, directly pinning the Golden Core Stage Body Cultivator to the ground.
"Roar——"
The Demon Beasts and the humans united to attack. Fairy Eternity stepped half-step forward with her left foot and adopted a combative stance.
"Fairy Fist Style!"
The powder fists fell like rain, looking delicate, vut with a terrifying strength, it seemed to give people the illusion that they were not facing fists, but a huge river from the sky, overwhelming and unstoppable.
The Fairy Fist Style was so fast that it caused afterimages. Each punch accurately hit the Dantians of the Golden Core Stages, severing the connection between Herbal Celestial Grass and them.
"If you were all at the late stage of the Golden Core, this body of mine would not be able to cope. It's a pity, you guys are not."
Most of these Golden Core Stages were in the initial or mid-stage of the Golden Core, and those in the late stage of the Golden Core were in the minority.
Lu Yang was captivated by Fairy Eternity's Fist Style. This was the second time he had seen the Fairy Fist Style.
The last time he saw Fairy Fist Style had been when Yellow Bean was beating up Immortal Eternity. Immortal Eternity, as one of the third-ranking leaders in Eternity Sect, was naturally suppressed by Fairy Eternity.
At that time, no matter what technique Yellow Bean used, she could suppress Immortal Eternity and couldn't demonstrate the profundity of the Fairy Fist Style.
But this time it was different. This time, Fairy Eternity was facing an opponent who was a major realm above her. In such a situation, Lu Yang could tell at a glance that this Fairy Fist Style was absolutely an extraordinary one among the martial arts in the world, filled with endless mysteries.
With his current ability, it was difficult for him to comprehend even the surface of this Fist Style.
But that didn't stop Lu Yang from trying to understand it.
"So this is how it is. During battle, I have to take note of power distribution and combat rhythm. The heavier the punch, the better..." Lu Yang was lost in thought, seeing a glimmer of insight.
"Lu Yang, be careful, some Golden Core Stages are heading toward you!"
"I see!"
Lu Yang had anticipated this early on. Over seventy Golden Core Stages would not all attack Fairy Eternity at the same time as their own attacks would collide before they could even reach Fairy Eternity.
Moreover, Herbal Celestial Grass could not possibly control so many cultivators at the same time. It had not matured completely; its limit was to control ten Golden Core Stages. If they were all at the late stage of the Golden Core, the number it could control would drop to eight.
The current situation was that between four to six Golden Core Stages were attacking Fairy Eternity at the same time. The rest of the Golden Core Stages were on standby, ready to replace as soon as anyone was killed or knocked away by Fairy Eternity.
Herbal Celestial Grass's target was clear: it intended to bypass Fairy Eternity and target Lu Yang.
After the previous twist of events, Lu Yang had managed to recover his strength and was not at all afraid of these Golden Core Stages.
Lu Yang poured Sword Qi into the Green Peak Sword, concealing it, no longer as dazzling as before.
"Come!"
Herbal Celestial Grass, controlling the Golden Core Stages, didn't think much of it. But as soon as they clashed, it realized that Lu Yang was completely different from before.
It seemed as if there was no Sword Qi in the Green Peak Sword. But, every time the Green Peak sword clashed with a Golden Core Stage, the Sword Qi would surge, catching Herbal Celestial Grass off guard. And when Herbal Celestial Grass was prepared to forcefully take in the Sword Qi, the Sword Qi would disappear, wasting its energy!
He had actually advanced a whole level in his control of power in such a short time!
Although this control was not yet proficient, it was indeed a control of another level!
This can't continue, we must decide the battle quickly, otherwise, there will be changes!
Lu Yang didn't know that Herbal Celestial Grass had made a decision. He had re-entered that state he was in just now—the one where there was a fog in front of him, with an unclear halo on the opposite side of it.
"Hmm?"
Fairy Eternity noticed Lu Yang's change and blinked her eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 272 - 271: Form Golden Core_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang has now entered a rather mysterious state, feeling that his perception of the outside world has dramatically decreased. He could only sense the attack from the Golden Core Stage being at hand, and the farther areas started to become blurry.
On the contrary, the mist in his Dantian was getting thinner. It seemed as though clearing the mist would reveal what was shimmering behind it.
A tiger-headed and three-bodied monster suddenly rushed at Lu Yang. This was a tiger monster that was accustomed to living in the water. At the late stage of the Golden Core, it could move temporarily on land. Herbal Celestial Grass brought it out from the lake specifically to hunt Lu Yang.
Lu Yang noticed the attack of the tiger monster and lightly breathed out a breath of Three Flavored True Fire, which clung to the Green Peak Sword.
The originally sharp Green Peak Sword, coupled with the Three Flavored True Fire, was even more powerful than before.
The tiger monster roared and charged at Lu Yang. Lu Yang twisted his wrist and lightly shouted, "Break". The Green Peak Sword swiped through and the tiger monster's head fell to Lu Yang's feet, the severed area still giving off an enticing smell of barbecue.
This was the "Break Mantra," the power of which was inferior to the "Break Mantra" that drained half of one's spiritual essence, but it could be used continuously, the individual power being a bit stronger than the "Slice Mantra."
Herbal Celestial Grass tried to control the corpse of the tiger monster to attack again, but Lu Yang had predicted it, urging the "Break" Mantra again and dismantling the tiger monster into pieces.
Another Demon Beast appeared at Lu Yang's feet. It was smaller with three legs and shaped like a turtle, its mouth was full of sand, and it spewed it towards Lu Yang's shadow.
It was a Kuo; it could kill enemies by shooting sand at their shadows.
Lu Yang always had his Spiritual Sense on, and he had noticed Kuo's small movements. He fiercely pumped Sword Qi into the Green Peak Sword, and the Three Flavored True Fire on the sword surged, igniting a raging fire, which instantly changed Lu Yang's shadow.
Lu Yang stabbed back and pierced through Kuo's hard, dark green shell, killing it.
A Ba Snake and a Fat Ghost appeared on both sides of Lu Yang. Both were ancient monsters and had similar snake forms. They attacked together, aiming to entwine and strangle Lu Yang.
Lu Yang used Draw the Ground into a Prison to drag the Ba Snake underground, himself shrinking down as well. It wasn't convenient to use the Green Peak Sword underground, so he covered his hands in True Fire and used Arhat Fist to attack. The fist marks were splendid, and the mud turned into burnt clay.
The Ba Snake didn't even have a chance to react before its Dantian was shattered by the Arhat Fist.
Lu Yang emerged from behind the Fat Ghost, swallowing a Great Recovery Pill to replenish spiritual essence while using the Green Peak Sword to split the Fat Ghost in two.
"I don't believe this, that so many Golden Core Stage creatures can't kill you! You're just at the Foundation Establishment Stage, stop struggling and die!" Herbal Celestial Grass panicked and had to use loud words to cover up its trepidation.
Be it the Tiger Monster or the Ba Snake, these were its reserve servants with massive potential, second only to Lu Yang as nutrients. But now, they were killed by Lu Yang's smooth and fluid moves.
It felt that Lu Yang was becoming stronger step by step, his control of power was becoming more proficient, his movements more nimble and continuous, his battle tactics more ingenious, and he could achieve victory with the smallest cost.
This change had to be stopped!
It shifted its focus from Fairy Eternity to Lu Yang, dispatching more monsters to besiege Lu Yang.
Fairy Eternity noticed Lu Yang's change and a smile appeared involuntarily at the corner of her mouth.
More and more Demon Beasts were attacking Lu Yang, either being killed by him or having their Dantian shattered by the Arhat Fist.
Conversely, Lu Yang's physical condition was getting worse. Continually using Mantras and the Arhat Fist, his spiritual essence was being depleted rapidly. No matter how much Great Recovery Pill he took, it still couldn't catch up with the speed at which his spiritual essence was being depleted.
Moreover, several Golden Core Stage creatures severely wounded Lu Yang. His left arm was fractured, and there were several gashes on his abdomen and back, the deepest of which revealed white bone.
He was covered in blood and staggered as he walked.
At this rate, he would soon die from exhaustion, and Herbal Celestial Grass's wish would be fulfilled.
That should have been good news, but Herbal Celestial Grass couldn't bring itself to feel happy.
It noticed that while Lu Yang's wounds were increasing, his eyes were as bright as the moon, exceptionally noticeable in the dark forest.
"What are you laughing at! What are you laughing at!" Herbal Celestial Grass roared, thinking Lu Yang was mocking it.
Yes, Lu Yang was laughing, and he was laughing very happily.
"Why can't I laugh? A bunch of Golden Core Stage creatures swarm me, but they can't even defeat me at just the late stage of Foundation Establishment. Shouldn't I be happy?"
"Am I too strong, or are these Golden Core Stage individuals too weak?"
Lu Yang struggled towards the Herbal Celestial Grass, nearly tumbling several times due to his severe injuries. Even in such a state, he sent chills of fear through Herbal Celestial Grass.
Herbal Celestial Grass desperately ordered the Demon Beasts to attack Lu Yang, not caring about executing precise commands, insisting on crushing this Human race genius!
Lu Yang didn't even have the strength to hold his sword, using his bare fists to fend off the encroaching Demon Beasts, squeezing out the very last of his strength.
At the same time, the fog in his dantian region was getting lighter.
Or rather, it was not that the dense fog was fading, but that it was being absorbed by the radiance behind it, causing the brilliance to become more substantial.
Lu Yang sensed the situation, figuring out the source of the fog: "Is it the battle experience accumulated from fighting against higher ranks in the dense forest?"
Lu Yang's body was gradually changing – the wounds on his abdomen and back were healing slowly, his severed left arm miraculously grew back, his spirit, vigor, and essence converging like a blazing torch, burning fiercely with more fuel constantly being added, making the flame grow higher and higher.
The fog completely cleared, revealing the true nature of the glowing object - it was a plump, pill-like Golden Core.
This Golden Core was wonderfully extraordinary - its presence indicated dominance. Slightly spinning, it instantly swept away Lu Yang's fatigue.
Lu Yang felt an endless stream of power surge out - this power was so immense, it was beyond what one at the Foundation Establishment stage could possess.
Under the rush of this power, the bottleneck at the Foundation Establishment stage was easily overcome.
Golden Core Stage!
"Yazui, kill it!"
A Demon Beast that stood out among its peers in the Golden Core stage, it was Yazui, a creature born from a dragon and a jackal, with a sword in its mouth, staring angrily at Lu Yang.
This great demon—a formidable threat in the dense forest—was comparable to Jiuying. But now, in front of Lu Yang, it was nothing.
Lu Yang stretched out his forefinger and middle finger. The joined fingers manifested an extremely sharp illusion of a sword.
"Go."
The illusory sword swung down, then disappeared.
Yazui glared angrily at Lu Yang, a very subtle line of blood appeared on top of Yazui's head extending down to its tail.
Lu Yang lightly blew a breath, Yazui was split in two, falling to both sides.
Just this sword illusion alone was more powerful than Lu Yang's strongest word-breaking technique!
"You've broken through to the Golden Core stage!" Herbal Celestial Grass looked at Lu Yang incredulously. The previous shock was nothing compared to this. It had never heard of such a method of breakthrough before.
Lu Yang ignored Herbal Celestial Grass's shock. It no longer posed a threat to him. He was studying the newly formed Golden Core.
"This Golden Core seems to have a lot of mysteries that I haven't discovered yet. There's no record of it in the ancient books. In other words, this Golden Core is unique, it needs a good name… I got it, I'll call it the Primordial Qi Pill!"
Just as Lu Yang had settled on a name for the Golden Core, Fairy Eternity's voice of surprise rang in his ear.
"Isn't this my Invincible Elixir?!"
"Lu Yang, you're a cunning one. You say one thing and mean another. You said you wouldn't form my Golden Core, but you still think my Invincible Elixir is the most suitable for you!"
Fairy Eternity, having dealt with the Demon Beasts surrounding her, jabbed at Lu Yang with her elbow, winking and beaming at him.
Lu Yang: "…What the heck?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 273 - 272: This Immortal is Known for His Combat Power_1
chapters.content:
"You're telling me this is the Invincible Elixir?!" Lu Yang didn't know what expression he should put on.
After rummaging through countless golden core formation materials and tirelessly seeking inspiration, he had formed a unique Golden Core at the most critical moment in a battle.
And now you're telling me this Golden Core is the same as your Invincible Elixir?
"Oh dear, I've already told you, continuously fight, fear no challenges, win every battle, and develop an unbeatable aura. This is the force that guides the circulation of spiritual essence, and helps condense the elixir."
"Stop pretending now. You followed step by step according to what I told you, and successfully formed your Golden Core."
Fairy Eternity thought that Lu Yang was just feeling embarrassed and unwilling to admit that he was mimicking her.
"There's nothing to be ashamed of. Follow me, and I guarantee you'll laugh at the end of time. By that time, when I am back to my heyday, I shall be the first, you the second, and that little girl Yun Zhi, the third!"
Lu Yang couldn't help but recall the unique Golden Core formation experience that Fairy Eternity had shared.
"Fairy, do you remember how you said you formed your Golden Core?"
...
"This is my unique Golden Core, which I have named the Invincible Elixir."
"Normally, I don't tell others how to form it! Now, do you know the benefits of following me?" Fairy Eternity was brimming with pride, hoping to elicit a look of worship from Lu Yang.
"Just to be on the safe side, let me ask in advance. When you said 'win every battle', were you referring to fighting against someone the same level as you, or someone a level below you?"
"Of course it refers to someone a level higher!"
...
"Right, someone a level higher. If I, in the Foundation Establishment Stage, defeated someone in the Golden Core Stage, wouldn't that be a level higher?" Fairy Eternity casually declared, not understanding why Lu Yang seemed so shocked.
Hadn't she already said before that she was renowned for her beauty and fighting prowess before becoming immortal?
If she was known for her fighting prowess, wouldn't fighting across levels be a common occurrence?
Lu Yang: "..."
No wonder Lu Yang hadn't thought about this. Fairy Eternity had never given him any reliable guidance. Plus, she often picked on lower-level cultivators, and took pride in doing so.
Lu Yang had always seen Fairy Eternity as an ancient relic of a shameful past, and hardly took her cultivation advice seriously.
Listening to Fairy Eternity talk about cultivation sounded less useful than asking Eldest Senior Sister.
Although, asking Eldest Senior Sister wasn't necessarily going to get any answers either.
Lu Yang's impression of Fairy Eternity's cultivation method was unreliable.
As for that of Eldest Senior Sister, it was outrageous.
Neither was of any reference value.
"In the late stages after establishing the foundation, I exhibited extraordinary talent, sweeping all geniuses at the same stage. Saints, blessings of heaven, bodies of the great path… none could stand before me. My talent drew the envy of the world."
"The guardians of the geniuses thought that I would certainly be a big problem in the future and wanted to eradicate me. Yet, they were well-respected individuals and were afraid that the act of bullying the weak would damage their reputation. So, they dispatched many late-stage cultivators, hoping they would break through during the battle and enter the Golden Core Stage.
This way, even when I lost, no one could say anything about it."
"Heh, they thought they could defeat me just by that? Even if they advanced to the Golden Core Stage, they were all nothing. None of them could match me!"
"I constantly defeated them, nurturing through battles, and formed an unbeatable aura, successfully forming my golden core!" Fairy Eternity related her story with a casual attitude, as if it were an insignificant feat.
"My Golden Core was something that had never been witnessed, and I was unbeatable, so naturally, the Golden Core had to be named the Invincible Elixir."
"Alright, this body's power has almost been used up by me. I'll leave the rest to you. After this, I'll teach you the use of the Invincible Elixir. Yawn..."
The downside of a clone is that it couldn't replenish spiritual essence like the main body could. Once the spiritual essence was used up, it was gone and couldn't be replenished.
Fairy Eternity let out a stretch, her physical body returned to the earth and her soul back into the Spiritual Space.
After working so hard for so long, she deserved a nice sleep as a reward.
From beginning to end, the Herbal Celestial Grass didn't say a word. If it had been human, it would have been drenched in cold sweat by now.
Though Lu Yang had been speaking to his clone all this while, the Herbal Celestial Grass could sense his Spiritual Sense intensely locked onto it. Any slightest movement from it would be obliterated with a single sword strike from Lu Yang.
"Quick, stop them…"
Before the Herbal Celestial Grass could finish speaking, Lu Yang moved, turning into a bolt of lightning. He knocked back all the Demon Beasts blocking the Herbal Celestial Grass, instantly appearing in front of it.
"Who are you trying to stop?" Lu Yang asked, bending down to grab the Herbal Celestial Grass, his voice icy cold.
After ascending to the Golden Core Stage, not only was his strength greatly enhanced, but his speed had also increased significantly.
Lu Yang didn't give the Herbal Celestial Grass a chance to explain and uprooted it completely.
The roots of the Herbal Celestial Grass spread underneath the entire swamp. When Lu Yang pulled out all its roots, he discovered skeletons tangled in them. There were both Demon Race and Human race skeletons, all of which were its nourishment.
Lu Yang's gaze turned even colder. He removed each of the skeletons, ripped off the root system of the Herbal Celestial Grass, and casually threw it away.
He took the Herbal Celestial Grass and left the swamp. He encountered a Demon Beast fighting with a cultivator, casually killed the beast with a single blow, and asked the cultivator where he was.
Seeing Lu Yang killing the early stage Golden Core Demon Beast with a single strike, the cultivator was greatly shocked. He didn't dare to hide anything and respectfully told Lu Yang the location.
Lu Yang calculated, he was about six hundred miles away from the Demon Suppressing Pass, not very far away.
When Lu Yang returned to Demon Suppressing Pass, he found Meng Jingzhou and the others anxiously waiting at the gate. There was also a young man standing nearby with rosy lips and pearly white teeth, who looked a few years younger than Lu Yang.
"Where did the Herbal Celestial Grass drag Senior Brother Lu to?" Tao Yaoye was incredibly anxious. They had asked for help to find Lu Yang, but when they reached the spot, only a large pit and the swamp were left.
"Don't worry. Lu Yang has a trump card, he'll be fine." Meng Jingzhou said confidently.
Even though he said this, he was still terrified. If Lu Yang had summoned Eldest Senior Sister to deal with the Herbal Celestial Grass, he should've returned to find them by now. If Lu Yang hadn't summoned her, how would he deal with the Herbal Celestial Grass?
"I'm back." The clear voice of Lu Yang rang out, causing everyone to cheer with relief.
"Lu Yang!"
"Senior Brother Lu!"
"Brother Lu!"
Lu Yang, in a clean white robe, with a sword and jade pendant at his waist, and the defeated Herbal Celestial Grass in hand, looked like a young master from a painting, extremely suave.
"How did you get rid of the Herbal Celestial Grass yourself?" Meng Jingzhou noticed the Herbal Celestial Grass in Lu Yang's hand.
"Who do you think I am? A mere Herbal Celestial Grass can be easily uprooted by me."
"He has formed his Golden Core." The young man with rosy lips and pearly white teeth suddenly said, secretly surprised. He had heard of the strangeness of the Herbal Celestial Grass. To be able to deal with it immediately after entering the Golden Core Stage was something he could not do.
"You've formed your Golden Core?" Meng Jingzhou thought he was the first one to form his golden core, but didn't expect Lu Yang to have done it before him.
"And this is…"
"Let me introduce you, this is Governor Zeng of the Demon Suppressing Pass, Zeng Tairan. As soon as I got back to the pass, I asked Governor Zeng to help rescue you."
"I've seen Governor Zeng."
Zeng Tairan waved his hand: "You will surely achieve greater accomplishments than me in the future. There's no need to be overly polite."
"Brother Lu found fortune amidst disaster, successfully forming the golden core. He's the first one in our generation to do so. We should go back and celebrate properly." Man Gu called out.
Lu Yang shook his head: "Let's not rush. There's still one loose end to tie up. May I ask Governor Zeng how many cultivators above the Refining the Void stage are there at Demon Suppressing Pass?"

chapters.title: Chapter 274 - 273 Tidying Up The Tail_1
chapters.content:
As the night fell, after Lu Yang dug up the Herbal Celestial Grass, the Golden Core cultivators were left uncontrolled, lying quietly in the swamp.
If anyone happened to venture here, they would be scared off by the sight of the corpses scattered across the field, suspecting something strange and turning to run away.
A grey figure descended lightly, picking up the useless roots of the Herbal Celestial Grass; their brows furrowed at the disorderly scene.
"Who's responsible for this!"
Fury surged in his heart as his years of preparation were destroyed in an instant. He needed to find an explanation for this.
He was distant in the Demon Territory, but the moment he lost sensations of the Herbal Celestial Grass, he rushed over instantly.
It was a pity that it was already too late. The Herbal Celestial Grass had been plucked away by someone else.
"Rewind!"
He formed complex, ancient seals with both his hands, moving so fast that they produced ghostly afterimages.
This was a Great Divine Skill he mastered, capable of rewinding time and viewing past events.
A light curtain appeared before him, in it, a Golden Core cultivator pulling out the Herbal Celestial Grass by its roots. This was the limit of his retrospection.
"The audacity! An insignificant Golden Core youngster dares to ruin my plans!"
"I'll remember your face!"
His grey shadow grit his teeth in anger, glaring fiercely at Lu Yang, vowing to find Lu Yang wherever he might be, retrieve the Herbal Celestial Grass, and tear Lu Yang into pieces!
"Why remember me? I'm just a small fry," a voice lazily sounded from the side.
"Who's that!" The grey shadow was startled. He was so anxious that he didn't notice another person's presence when the Herbal Celestial Grass disappeared.
"It's you, you even dare to show your face!" The grey shadow's eyes hardened upon seeing Lu Yang. He ruined his plan, plucked the Herbal Celestial Grass, and even dared to show his face. Did he think he was made of clay and wouldn't get angry?
No, wait. He's just a Golden Core cultivator, no matter how anxious he was, there was no way he wouldn't have noticed a Golden Core hiding nearby.
It's a trap!
He abruptly shot into the sky, attempting to escape, only to be covered by a massive net descending from the heavens.
"You who secretly cultivated the Herbal Celestial Grass and harmed living beings, either accept local execution or obediently follow me back for trial!" Governor Zeng slowly appeared from another space, standing next to Lu Yang, his pupils filled with rage.
Ten Refining the Void cultivators controlled the Sky Net, the grey shadow could not escape despite his efforts.
Governor Zeng squinted his eyes slightly. The techniques used by the grey figure were very antiquated, not something of this era's Unification stage cultivators would use.
"It seems we've caught an ancient Unification stage cultivator who's been secretly cultivating the Herbal Celestial Grass to refine pills and elevate his realm."
While the cultivation level of Refining the Void cultivators changes drastically, it doesn't mean they can't take action.
The cultivation levels of these ten Refining the Void cultivators were also changing, but they could ensure that at least two of them remained at the Unification stage.
With Governor Zeng who stayed on the ground added to the mix, they made up three Unification stage cultivators, enough to activate the Sky Net.
The Sky Net was a secret treasure of the Great Xia dynasty's treasury, used as a trump card stationed at the Demon Suppressing Pass to guard against invasion by the Demon Race.
As long as it wasn't an Unification stage elder of the Seek Dao Sect, the Sky Net could suppress anyone.
Obviously, the grey figure was not at the level of the Seek Dao Sect elders, otherwise, he wouldn't need to cultivate the Herbal Celestial Grass.
"Take him away!" Following Governor Zeng's order, ten Refining the Void cultivators dragged the grey figure back to the Demon Suppressing Pass.
"How did you know there's someone behind the Herbal Celestial Grass?" On their way back, Governor Zeng asked curiously.
"Even the Herbal Celestial Grass itself doesn't know it's being cultivated." This was the result Governor Zeng obtained after interrogating the Herbal Celestial Grass.
"It's possible that the person behind it modified its memory."
"There were two reasons for my guess that there's someone behind the Herbal Celestial Grass."
"First, the location of the Herbal Celestial Grass was too perfect. It has the ability to control Golden Core cultivators and happens to be in a dense forest where the most Golden Core Demon Beasts and Golden Core cultivators can be found. It seemed like someone deliberately planted it there to make it easier for it to find food."
"I've considered that, but couldn't it just be a coincidence?"
"That's where the second point comes in. Governor Zeng probably doesn't know this, but in the process of my fight with the Herbal Celestial Grass, it used an Array Method to disrupt my Directional Teleportation Talisman. Directional Teleportation Talisman is made by Nascent Soul Cultivators, and the Herbal Celestial Grass controls Golden Core cultivators.
They wouldn't possibly have learnt the method of disrupting a Directional Teleportation Talisman from Golden Core cultivators."
"Moreover, it used the Mountain Moving Array to shift the location of the swamp. This also isn't an Array Method that Herbal Celestial Grass should be capable of."
"There must be someone who taught Herbal Celestial Grass these skills for self-preservation. That person would also worry about the Herbal Celestial Grass exposing him, so they modified Herbal Celestial Grass's memory."
"Considering the Herbal Celestial Grass can improve a Unification cultivator's realm by an entire level, it confirms that the person behind it is definitely a Unification cultivator."
"That person certainly left a mark on such an important thing as the Herbal Celestial Grass. The moment the mark disappeared, they would inevitably come over. That's why I asked Governor Zeng to ambush them."
Governor Zeng waved it off: "It's not like you asked me to make a move. It's my duty as the governor. I should be the one thanking you. Without you exposing the Herbal Celestial Grass and the person behind it, who knows how long they could remain hidden and how many more people they could harm."
The two conversed and arrived back at the Demon Suppressing Pass.
Governor Zeng decided to interrogate the grey figure overnight and parted ways with Lu Yang.
Lu Yang returned to the inn only to find that Meng Jingzhou and the others had already prepared a feast to celebrate his advancement to the Golden Core Stage.
"Come, come. Let's toast to Lu Yang's promotion to the Golden Core Stage!" The four held up their drinks and downed a full glass together.
"Now that Lu has advanced to the Golden Core Stage, we three must pick up our pace. I have some clue. What about you two?" Meng Jingzhou asked.
"I'm considering forming a Golden Core related to illusions, but I need to do more research on how to execute it." Tao Yaoye said.
"I haven't figured out what kind of Golden Core I want to form yet." Man Gu scratched his head, laughing embarrassingly.
"Don't rush. We have time. At our age, apart from Lu Yang, our cultivation speed is the fastest. There's no need to hurry." Meng Jingzhou advised Man Gu not to be hasty. Man Gu nodded to show that he understood.
"I need to return to the Sect to consolidate my realm. Tomorrow, there will be a flying boat arriving. I won't be joining you in the forest then."
The others understood. Lu Yang was already at the Golden Core Stage. If they continued to hunt the Demon Beasts in the forest with him, they wouldn't feel any sense of danger. The effectiveness of their trials would be greatly reduced.
The next morning, Lu Yang bought some local specialties from the Demon Suppressing Pass, brought along the Herbal Celestial Grass, and bid farewell to Meng Jingzhou and the rest before boarding the flying boat.
Lu Yang didn't choose to fly back to the Seek Dao Sect due to two reasons. Firstly, the distance between the Demon Suppressing Pass and the Seek Dao Sect was too far. His Golden Core spiritual essence storage wouldn't last, and he would need to stop and rest for quite some time, which wasn't worth it.
The second reason was that Lu Yang was afraid of heights.
Of course, the main reason was the first one.
Inside the flying boat's cabin, Lu Yang prepared to study the twinkling Invincible Elixir when he entered his Spiritual Space, and found Fairy Eternity sleeping.
She's developed a nocturnal habit.
"Mm, Lu Yang, did you just arrive?" Sleepily rubbing her eyes, Fairy Eternity greeted Lu Yang drowsily.
Lu Yang originally wanted to ask Fairy Eternity if the Invincible Elixir has any uses, but he stopped himself and changed the topic, "Fairy, do you want to sleep some more?"
"That works." Without even thinking, Fairy Eternity fell back to sleep.
Lu Yang: "..."
I was just being polite.

chapters.title: Chapter 275 - 274: Drifting_1
chapters.content:
Fairy Eternity was still sleeping sweetly and Lu Yang wasn't rude enough to disturb her. He began to study the Invincible Elixir on his own.
The spiritual essence Lu Yang possessed was naturally higher than others at the same level, thanks to consuming tofu. After forming a golden core, his spiritual essence saw a tremendous change.
"At the very least, my spiritual essence has increased tenfold. The rate at which I absorb external spiritual energy has also increased. If I don't use powerful moves like 'Decapitation Word Technique' or 'Destruction Word Technique', I can balance the spiritual essence I use and absorb during regular battles, ultimately saving money on Great Recovery Pills."
During the fight with Herbal Celestial Grass, he swallowed Great Recovery Pills as if they were free, leaving him with only a few pathetic ones. It pained him to even think about it.
"In addition to this, my physical strength, speed, and reaction have exceeded the late stage of Foundation Establishment. I can now confidently challenge body cultivators of my level!" Lu Yang said, brimming with self-confidence.
His physical condition had always been his weak spot - he never stood a chance against body cultivators like Meng Jingzhou, let alone against Confucian cultivators like Man Gu.
Now, he had finally managed to catch up and fill this gap.
Lu Yang was very proud. After all, he had the same type of Golden Core as an Immortal, which ranked second only to the Harem Golden Core in the First-Grade Golden Cores!
The Harem Golden Core was formed by concentrating the strength of a harem onto one person, which is something borrowed, and isn't a single individual's strength.
In the strictest sense, the strength of the Harem Golden Core is the combined strength of a group. If singled out, it would be weaker than the Invincible Elixir.
In the truest sense, his Invincible Elixir was the number one Golden Core!
According to Fairy Eternity, it was even more powerful than the Golden Core of Eldest Senior Sister!
Lu Yang felt invincible like he could defeat anyone.
It could be described as him 'floating'.
"My Spiritual Sense has also increased."
The most evident change was Lu Yang's spiritual space. If it was a single room in a hotel before, now it was equivalent to a spacious house with four bedrooms, two living rooms, and two bathrooms!
Fairy Eternity was the first to notice the change in the spiritual space, and she adapted - enlarging the area of her bed three times before comfortably going to sleep.
Lu Yang released his Spiritual Sense. The entire ship was now within his Spiritual Sense range, which was something impossible before.
Lu Yang noticed something wrong with the flying ship's Suspension Formation. The accompanying Array Repair Master tinkered with it for ages, ultimately ruining the Suspension Formation. Worried about getting caught and losing his annual bonus, the Array Repair Master directly flew to the bottom of the ship, lifting the entire ship to fly.
"...Did I just witness something extraordinary?"
"The distance and number of Clones I can control should have also increased, I just don't know by how much," he pondered.
It wouldn't be good to create a clone on the ship using a flowerpot, as it would look bad.
"I'll test it when I get back."
"I wonder what other functions my Golden Core has," Lu Yang wondered. He had spent half the day studying it but didn't understand anything.
"I'll wait until Fairy Eternity wakes up and ask her directly."
The journey of the flying ship was eventful yet without mishap. At the next stop, the Array Repair Master asked for help, and the Suspension Formation was finally fixed before takeoff.
Several major cities later, the flying ship landed in front of the Seek Dao Sect's gate, and Lu Yang stepped off.
Suddenly, Lu Yang realized his Dantian was empty with no trace of his Golden Core. He didn't know when that had happened.
"Where's my Golden Core?"
Just as Lu Yang was about to enter his Spiritual Space to question Fairy Eternity, he saw her lying on the bed, holding the Invincible Elixir, sleeping sweetly.
Lu Yang was helpless and woke Fairy Eternity: "Fairy, could you please not hold my Golden Core while sleeping? I thought I had lost my Golden Core."
She quickly came up with an excuse using her vast knowledge: "You probably don't know about this, do you know about the Ancient Martial Way?"
Fairy Eternity gently pushed the Invincible Elixir.
Lu Yang nodded: "I remember it to be a type of martial way from the ancient times, right?"
"Yes, this type of martial way doesn't use spiritual energy but merely refines the physical body. Once it is cultivated to the extreme, the body can rival the Nascent Soul Stage!"
"Ancient Martial Arts can be categorized into Explicit Power, Hidden Power, Converted Power, and Holding Elixir."
"So?"
"So now that I am holding your Golden Core, it means you have entered the Holding Elixir realm."
Lu Yang: "..."
Fairy Eternity had a similar habit to Lu Yang, she loved to hold things while sleeping. The invincible elixir, which was an object she hadn't seen for a long time, made her feel more attached. However, she couldn't say this out loud because it would damage her dignity as an immortal.
"Fairy, do you believe that our intelligence is on the same level?"
"How can you be as smart as this Fairy?"
"Fairy, you 've been sleeping for two days now." Lu Yang hinted at Fairy Eternity, asking her to sleep less.
"What do you know? I am sleeping to recover my strength. If I don't recover my strength, how will I defeat that little girl Yun Zhi?"
"If it was in ancient times, I would die and resurrect on the spot, and the power that disappeared would be regained by me."
"Now I have been dead for more than 300,000 years, and the strength in my body at the time of death has long disappeared without a trace. I can only rely on sleep to slowly recover strength."
"So how much have you recovered now?"
"It feels like I have recovered about 10% - 20%. If there is no other way to speed up, I can fully recover after sleeping for another hundred or so years." She said it lightly, but for Fairy Eternity, who was newly sixteen years old, a hundred and so years was just a moment in time.
"How does it feel to have the Invincible Elixir? Don't you feel like you are invincible? The Invincible Elixir will make you indomitable and victorious. It is the first class Golden Core that this fairy is proud of!" Fairy Eternity patted Lu Yang's shoulder as if she saw herself in him rising high and brightening an era.
"So, what should I do exactly?"
Fairy Eternity giggled: "When I first produced the Invincible Elixir, I put a lot of effort into researching what this Golden Core can do. Now with me here, you can skip the research stage and directly know the function of the Invincible Elixir."
"Only by knowing yourself and your enemy can you be undefeated in all battles. The first function of the Invincible Elixir is to see the opponent's flaws, so that you can formulate tactics against the opponent's weaknesses during the battle, thus, won't victory be certain?"
"When I was in the Golden Core Stage, I defeated Yingtian Immortal and Qilin Immortal thanks to this function!"
Lu Yang's heart was pounding, the Invincible Elixir was worthy of being a pill of the immortals, and it was indeed powerful.
"Come on, I'll teach you how to use it."
"Alright!"
The method of using the Invincible Elixir wasn't complicated, but Lu Yang didn't manage to find the way on his own. With Fairy Eternity as a guide, Lu Yang easily mastered the use of the Invincible Elixir.
"Try it on somebody."
As per Fairy Eternity's instructions, Lu Yang set his sights on a Senior Brother. He remembered this Senior Brother; he had joined the line to beat him at the end of the Five Elements Sect exchange meeting.
Indeed, he could not beat him in the past, carrying the black pot on behalf of Fairy Eternity. Now that he had obtained the Invincible Elixir, he must wash away his past shame and prove his strength.
The Invincible Elixir slowly spun, analyzing the Senior Brother's weaknesses. Soon, a line of text appeared in front of Lu Yang.
"You can't defeat him, choose someone else."

chapters.title: Chapter 276 - 275: The Function of Invincible Elixir_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang remained silent for a long while before asking, "Fairy, the functionality isn't what you said it would be, is it?"
"This involves the second function of the Invincible Elixir. It clearly tells you not to fight if you can't beat the opponent."
"Think about it, why do you win sometimes and lose others in a fight? What's the reason for your failure? Isn't it simply that you can't beat the other person!"
"Now, the Invincible Elixir directly tells you that you can't beat the other person, doesn't that prevent your defeat?" Fairy Eternity spoke confidently, her logic was clear, and her argument was sensible.
This time, Lu Yang fell silent even longer, mainly because he actually found what Fairy said to make a lot of sense.
Lu Yang used the Invincible Elixir to assess each of his Senior Brothers and Sisters. The answer was commonplace, he couldn't beat any of them.
"Your Senior Brothers and Sisters are all at least in the late Golden Core stage, they can all fight above their level, and you, a cultivator in the early Golden Core stage, want to beat them? Even if I took control of your body, it would barely suffice." Fairy Eternity advised Lu Yang not to aim too high and asked him to fight Meng Jingzhou when he forms the golden core.
"When you fought Yingtian Immortal and Qilin Immortal, what weaknesses did the Invincible Elixir point out?"
"You're talking about that, the Invincible Elixir told me they were both at the Foundation Establishment stage. It allowed me to be free and unrestrained."
"..."
It wasn't until he got to the business street that Lu Yang regained some of his confidence.
There were not only retired cultivators at the Unification stage in the business street but also Golden Core stage cultivators doing business there.
These Golden Core stage cultivators were formidable, but they seemed less impressive compared to Lu Yang.
"Rou Jia Mo Vendor, early Golden Core level, weak spiritual sense, can be attacked mentally."
"Hundred Fragrance Building waiter, can't beat him, try another one."
"Six-winged Duck, food material, early Golden Core stage, its weakness is fear of flame. You can use Three Flavored True Fire against it, or roast it and let the chef handle it."
"Tea shop owner, can't beat him, try another one."
"Tailor shop owner, mid-Golden Core stage, no weaknesses, can be forcefully defeated."
The essence of the Golden Core was the unity of Lu Yang's spirit, Qi, and his mind. In other words, the Invincible Elixir was a part of Lu Yang's body and could formulate effective tactics based on Lu Yang's cognition. It was as if Lu Yang had an extra brain.
"BBQ shop Master Liu, can't beat him, try another one."
"BBQ shop Master Gao, can't beat him, try another one."
"Huh?" Now, Lu Yang discovered that he had unknowingly arrived at the Eternity Sect's headquarters.
The barbecue shop was busy as always, with the sect master and Immortal Eternity delivering goods. They were moving freshly slaughtered beef and mutton out of their storage ring.
"Lu Yang!" The sect master saw Lu Yang, his eyes complex, three parts conflicted, three parts regretful, and four parts relieved.
Master Liu and Master Gao responded similarly.
Was it not thanks to Lu Yang that the Eternity Sect had met such a fate?
Who could have imagined that this young man, a mere two months into joining the sect, would bring about the downfall of the Eternity Sect!
"Lu Yang? Come, come in and sit!" Seeing Lu Yang, Immortal Eternity showed quite a lot of enthusiasm, his reaction entirely different from that of the sect master and vice-sect master.
He had no choice but to be enthusiastic. Of course, this young man was the source of the Eternity Clan, naturally higher in status.
Not to mention this young man's status, he was in Fairy Eternity and Yun Zhi's good books. Neither identity was something he could afford to offend.
Of course, he had to do his best to please.
"What a pity it's morning now, the meat hasn't been marinated, otherwise, I would have barbecued it for you." Immortal Eternity said regretfully, it could be seen that he genuinely wanted to barbecue for Lu Yang.
The treatment from Immortal Eternity was equivalent to serving him on a silver platter in his past life.
Lu Yang was also a bit uncomfortable. The high-ranking personnel of the Eternity Sect were all here, if it weren't for the fact that the sect master, Master Liu, and Master Gao had all been turned into ghouls by Eldest Senior Sister and couldn't bear any hostility towards disciples of the Seek Dao Sect, Lu Yang felt that he wouldn't leave the BBQ shop alive.
The sect master and the elder of the Seek Dao Sect were contemporaries. They were at the peak of Unification.
"I have other matters to attend to and need to see Eldest Senior Sister, I won't go in." Lu Yang declined, hearing that Lu Yang was going to see Eldest Senior Sister, Immortal Eternity quickly let him go, no longer stopping him.
After Lu Yang left, Immortal Eternity squinted, "Lu Yang has formed a golden core. Did anyone figure out what kind of Golden Core he formed?"
The sect master shook his head, "Judging from the quality, it's a first-grade Golden Core, but I can't discern precisely which kind it is."
"It must be a novel kind of Golden Core. This also fits in with the style of the Seek Dao Sect."
Having stayed with the Seek Dao Sect for this long, the high-ranking personnel of the Eternity Sect were beginning to notice a pattern, such as the fact that the disciples of the Seek Dao Sect never took the conventional path when forming a Golden Core. The Golden Cores they formed were diverse.
"Should we implement the plan targeting Lu Yang?" The Sect Master opened a barrier and quietly asked, as if he was afraid someone might discover.
Immortal Eternity nodded, "Since he's already formed a golden core, then we proceed according to the plan and catch Lu Yang off guard. Remember, you must execute the plan when Yun Zhi isn't around!"
"If Yun Zhi shows up, we must abandon all plans and neither of us will end well!"
"This matter must be kept secret. If we can succeed, then we might have a future!"
Immortal Eternity spoke seriously, "Although we don't necessarily know the type of Lu Yang's Golden Core, it's enough to know that he has formed a Golden Core. We can use this as an opportunity to give him a gift and try to please him as much as possible!"
"Remember, the gift-giving plan mustn't show any flaw, this relates to whether we can open a branch outside of the Seek Dao Sect!"
"We will keep it in mind!"
...
When Lu Yang returned to Sky Gate Mountain, Eldest Senior Sister was still in her usual meditation practice.
As she sensed Lu Yang's arrival, she slowly opened her eyes and observed Lu Yang closely.
"Have you formed the golden core?"
A rare hint of confusion appeared in Eldest Senior Sister's expression, she couldn't recognize the type of Lu Yang's golden core, "What type of golden core did you form?"
Lu Yang honestly admitted, "I formed the same type of golden core as Fairy Eternity, named the Invincible Elixir."
Yun Zhi nodded in approval, "it seems like a type of Golden Core that was lost in the river of history. The name of the Golden Core is certainly fitting with Fairy's style; as for its power, since it's the same type as Fairy's, it should rank in the top three amongst first-grade Golden Cores."
"What's the effect of this Golden Core?"
"It can perceive the opponent's weakness, formulate targeted tactics, and achieve victory."
"Oh?" Eldest Senior Sister became interested, and her tone softened a bit, no longer as icy cold, "If I were your opponent, could your Invincible Elixir discern my weaknesses?"
Upon hearing this, Lu Yang broke out in a cold sweat.
"I, I'll give it a try."
Lu Yang activated the Invincible Elixir to probe for Eldest Senior Sister's weaknesses. As expected, the response of the Invincible Elixir was the same as before: "Can't beat, try another one."
Lu Yang informed Eldest Senior Sister of the result, only to have her continue asking, "What if I definitely want to fight?"
Since the battle was inevitable, the Invincible Elixir quickly gave a follow-up answer:
"Commit suicide now to ensure you maintain an undefeated record."
Lu Yang: ".....Can I reform a Golden Core now?"
They say there are no regrets with a Golden Core. Lu Yang doesn't know what others think, but he's quite regretful.
Screw your goddamn immortal's Golden Core!

chapters.title: Chapter 277 - 276 Unstoppable Momentum_1
chapters.content:
"It's said that there is no regret in Golden Core, how could you regret it?"
Lu Yang heard Immortal Eternity's teachings in his ear: "This is the Invincible Elixir, it can help you become an immortal second only to me in the future. What are you not satisfied with?"
Immortal Eternity stepped directly out of her Spiritual Space and took corporeal form in the real world: "I haven't finished yet, this Golden Core has a third function."
"What is it?"
"Do you know that the most important thing in cultivation is not the talent for cultivation, but the invincible will that never admits defeat?"
"There are so many people who have been smooth sailing in their cultivation journey, and when they encounter a slight setback, they lose their fighting spirit and sink from then on. I've seen too much of this."
"The invincibility I told you about is a form of will. The invincibility you developed in the dense forest and the Invincible Elixir condensed from it is the Pill of Will. The third function of Invincible Elixir, and its main feature, is to stabilize your will!"
"Invincibility is very important. In ancient times there was a saying that 'the brave wins when they meet on a narrow path,' in fighting your enemies, victory often hangs in the balance. When you have invincibility, you can win every battle!"
"Take me as an example, when I was in the Golden Core Stage facing Yingtian Immortal and Kirin Immortal, I fought with everything I had, relying on invincibility, and I defeated them both in one go!"
"... but didn't both of them only just reach Foundation Establishment Stage during that time?"
"What's wrong with Foundation Establishment Stage? Taking a battle lightly would be a grave mistake. Just like a lion uses all its power to swat a rabbit, you should understand this principle!"
"Aren't there plenty of examples of those in Foundation Establishment Stage defeating those in Golden Core Stage? For instance, you, and me - we're both prime examples. Who knows if Yingtian Immortal and Kirin Immortal could also have defeated those in Golden Core Stage?"
"The fairy makes a good point."
Immortal Eternity continued: "And let's take a step back, even if you lose miserably, the Invincible Elixir can make you remain full of self-confidence and believe that you are invincible in the world!"
Lu Yang: "..."
Isn't this inflation?
"Then Fairy, did you ever lose when you were at the Golden Core Stage?"
"Are you joking, will I lose? When I was at the Golden Core Stage, I fought Yingtian Immortal, Kirin Immortal, and Jiuchong Immortal all at once. Who could beat me?"
"What about Time Immortal?"
Immortal Eternity dismissed casually: "Time Immortal is an awakened Firmament Tree, he can't be measured using realms. There's no point in me fighting him."
Yun Zhi, standing by and quietly listening, was not surprised. She already knew that Time Immortal was an awakened Firmament Tree, as it was recorded in the ancient books of the Great Qian Era.
"By the way Eldest Senior Sister, I found a Herbal Celestial Grass with sentience in the forest." Lu Yang fetched the struggling Herbal Celestial Grass from the knapsack.
As Eldest Senior Sister's cold gaze fell on the Herbal Celestial Grass, it felt as though it had fallen into a frigid ice cellar.
"I've heard about it long ago, your ability to notice the people behind the Herbal Celestial Grass is commendable."
Lu Yang was taken aback. From the sound of Eldest Senior Sister's words, could it be that their entire journey through the dense forest practice was under her scrutiny?
"So what about this Herbal Celestial Grass?"
"The maturing process of Herbal Celestial Grass doesn't necessarily involve eating humans. It chose the most aggressive path and should thus receive severe punishment. You should take this grass to Elixir Cauldron Peak, tell Seventh Elder everything about its deeds, he will know how to deal with it."
"After returning from Elixir Cauldron Peak, I want you to find me again. I have something else to tell you."
"Yes."
Lu Yang's curiosity was piqued. He wanted to know what Eldest Senior Sister meant by "something else to tell," but he dared not ask, so he had to head to Elixir Cauldron Peak first.
The first thing Lu Yang did before going to Elixir Cauldron Peak was to hold his breath, complete his self-circulation, and avoid being poisoned by an unknown poison.
Even the Golden Core stage is no match for the poison at Elixir Cauldron Peak.
Luckily, after advancing to the Golden Core stage, one can control the organs to a certain extent, such as changing the positions of the internal organs, and one can also carry out self-circulation within the body, achieving the true meaning of reaching the sky and diving into the ground.
"May I ask where the Seventh Elder is?" Lu Yang found a familiar Elder Brother at Elixir Cauldron Peak, who was probably one of those who had lined up to fight him back then.
"Oh, it's Junior Brother Lu, are you looking for Master? He should be writing in the pill room."
"Writing?"
As the Brother from Elixir Cauldron Peak led Lu Yang along, he explained: "Yes, our Elixir Cauldron Peak's pill refining style isn't mainstream in the refining world, and outsiders are jealous of our talent. So, in order to expand the influence of Elixir Cauldron Peak, Master encourages us to write articles and publish them to the outside world to let them understand the real us."
The vegetation in Elixir Cauldron Peak is lush, the plants provide ample shade, and there are spiritual herbs everywhere. Material for refining Great Recovery Pills and fasting pills are randomly strewn about. If one does not pay attention to their step, they might crush a spiritual herb under their foot.
Although they are not as rare as the herbs in the Medicinal Garden, these spiritual herbs can still fetch a good price if sold in the outside world.
"Here we are, it's here."
Refiners in the outside world enjoy a high status, and they usually prefer luxurious decorations to show off their special status. In contrast, the Seventh Elder's pill room looks simple from the outside, just like a thatched hut.
The environment of the pill room is beyond comparison to a thatched hut.
Lu Yang could feel the strong medicinal power emanating from the pill room. This is greatly beneficial to those at the Nascent Soul Stage and can gradually improve their physical constitution.
After the Brother from Elixir Cauldron Peak left, Lu Yang gently knocked on the door, careful not to disrupt the Seventh Elder's train of thought.
"Come in."
"I've come to see the Seventh Elder." Lu Yang respectfully saluted.
The Seventh Elder had a head full of white hair, but his face was wrinkle-free and youthful, full of life, leading one to wonder if this has anything to do with his long-term pill refining.
"I heard that you're writing an essay, Elder?" Lu Yang was curious about the new academic trends in the pill refining world. It would help him show off when he met pill refiners in the future.
"Yes, I'm researching an ancient pill formula unearthed by the chief refiner of the Great Xia Dynasty. He couldn't solve the mystery of the ancient pill formula, so he offered a public bounty, inviting famous refining masters to analyze it. If the mystery can be solved, it would be a boon for Elixir Cauldron Peak."
"The ancient pill formula was written by an ancient master refiner, and it recorded an elixir that can make people pregnant. However, the elixir was not named. After discussing amongst ourselves, we, the refiners, decided to name it Procreation Elixir."
"But, this formula is so old and incomplete, incomplete."
"I've been trying to replicate it based on the herbs I can still identify from the formula and my own understanding, although all attempts have failed, it has ruled out many possibilities."
"So far, I haven't heard of anyone who has successfully replicated the formula."
"But what I find strange is that the medicinal materials written in the formula are all for beauty and nourishment, and don't have any pregnancy effects. I suspect that the formula is missing some medicinal material that was only available in ancient times but is now extinct."
"Can I have a look?" Lu Yang felt that the Procreation Elixir sounded familiar.
The Seventh Elder took out a copy of the pill formula, which listed many medicinal materials. The pill formula was clipped off.
This is a pill formula written by a refiner named Qinghe, which described the effect of the Procreation Elixir at the beginning: it makes people pregnant when administered with river water.
Lu Yang hesitated for a moment and said, "Is it possible, I mean just may be, that it's not the Procreation Elixir that makes the woman pregnant, but the river water?"

chapters.title: Chapter 278 - 277: Role Model Lu Yang_1
chapters.content:
At first glance of the pill formula, Lu Yang wasn't certain if the "river water" mentioned by Qinghe, the Pill Master, was from the Mother-child River.
Soon, the words of Fairy Eternity in his spiritual space solidified this idea.
"Oh? Qinghe? That little girl is this immortal's most devout believer. She does things to my liking."
...
"River water?"
"I read about it in an ancient book. It said that there was a river in ancient times, and when women drank its water, they could become pregnant."
"Such a miraculous river? Seventh Elder was very surprised, he had never heard of such a river."
Lu Yang thought to himself: How about this, Seventh Elder, have you ever seen a river than can grow sisters?
Guided by Fairy Eternity, Lu Yang's knowledge had already surpassed that of a Unification realm cultivator.
The Seventh Elder was not surprised that Lu Yang knew ancient secrets. It was apparent when Lu Yang served as Acting Sect Leader during the Five Elements Sect's visit. Considering Lu Yang was Yun Zhi's junior brother, it was plausible he knew about the ancient secrets.
"Where does this river water come from? Is it naturally formed?"
Lu Yang hesitated. The water of the Mother-child River was refined by Fairy Eternity, but her existence couldn't be known to others.
"Just say it was refined by Yingtian Immortal. He has already stolen my recipe copyright, it's no big deal to add the Mother-child River!" Fairy Eternity waved her hand, appearing quite generous.
Lu Yang, respecting Fairy Eternity's wishes, said to the Seventh Elder: "It's the river water refined by Yingtian Immortal in ancient times."
"I see, the doing of an immortal is indeed extraordinary. It's normal for them to refine such an amazing river."
Seventh Elder soon believed Lu Yang's words.
"By the way, what brings you here?"
Lu Yang took out the Herbal Celestial Grass and repeated the story: "That's how it happened, Eldest Senior Sister said this grass should be handled by you."
Seventh Elder's eyes lit up: "This is a spiritual grass that has developed a consciousness! That is very rare. Most of these kinds of grass don't harm people and it's not convenient to refine them into elixirs. Finally, I have got hold of one!"
This was the first time Seventh Elder was allowed to use conscious herbs for refining pills and he was overjoyed: "The value of a conscious Herbal Celestial Grass is immeasurable. Tell me what you want, I will satisfy you!"
Lu Yang repeatedly waved his hands: "No need, no need. This Herbal Celestial Grass has harmed countless people, it's enough just to deal with it."
Seeing that Lu Yang didn't want anything, the Seventh Elder made a decision for him: "How can this be? In that case, I'll refine elixirs for you free of charge three times."
His pill refining skills are second to few in the entire Cultivation World. Asking him to refine an elixir once is enough to exhaust the wealth of a Refining Void realm cultivator.
On his way back to Sky Gate Mountain after leaving Elixir Cauldron Peak, Lu Yang encountered a group of more than a dozen people. They were excited to see him.
"Senior Brother Lu, hello!" Their unified greeting startled Lu Yang.
Lu Yang noticed that this group was composed of both men and women who were about his age.
"Are you… Junior Brother Wei Nanfei and Junior Sister Jin Qinqin?" Lu Yang recognized them as disciples who had entered the Seek Dao Sect along with him.
Junior Brother Wei Nanfei was poisoned by his stepmother when he was young. Fortunately, Senior Brother, Dai Bufan, happened to pass by and lend a hand.
Junior Sister Jin Qinqin once ate a fruit in the valley. It was a Green Wood Immortal Fruit, which could make her internal qi circulate endlessly on its own.
He had not seen them before, assuming they had not yet reached the Foundation Establishment stage. They must have recently achieved that stage and hence were allowed to move around.
Using his spiritual sense to scan them, this indeed proved to be the case - these junior brothers and sisters have all established their foundation.
Establishing the foundation at this age was considered prodigious outside. They would be fostered by the Sect Leader of a First Class Sect as the next Sect Leader.Lu Yang and his peers were exceptions. According to the Eldest Senior Sister, their talents were a testament to the advent of the Great Era since the Seek Dao Sect never recruited five disciples with exceptional talents in the same batch.
The juniors looked at Lu Yang with admiration.
Was this the legendary Senior Brother Lu?
They had just established their foundation while Senior Brother Lu had already formed the Golden Core. There was a significant gap in their realms.
They heard that Senior Brother Lu had served as an Acting Sect Leader. This was unprecedented even in the Seek Dao Sect, filled with geniuses.
The disciples involved in the exchange with the Five Elements Sect mentioned that Senior Brother Lu was skilled in the five-element magic, is capable of Samadhi True Fire, Distance Shrinking, and Diving Spell. Moreover, he could create clones, and his sword technique was unparalleled among his peers!
Finding it hard to learn any one of these skills, they dreaded learning all.
They were inspired.
They quietly made up their minds to learn from Senior Brother Lu and catch up with him as soon as possible.
Lu Yang encouraged his juniors and said, "Eldest Senior Sister asked for me, I have to go now."
"Goodbye, Senior Brother Lu!" The juniors enthusiastically sent off Lu Yang with reluctance to part.
Lu Yang smiled throughout his journey. Having junior brothers and sisters was indeed a good feeling.
"Eldest Senior Sister, I'm back."
Eldest Senior Sister was dealing with administrative work such as resolving complaints against Seek Dao Sect. For instance, the Master of the Five Elements Sect strongly condemned the actions of Second Elder harassing his mother.
Also, the Master of the Five Elements Sect's mother hoped that the Second Elder could send some creative gifts the next time.
Then there was Daoist Buyu, who stammered his way into prison, and Yun Zhi was asked to bail him out as his guarantor.
Moreover, someone wanted to hear the sequel to "Legend of Dao Sect" narrated by Daoist Buyu and applied to be jailed next to Daoist Buyu. The Great Xia dynasty wanted Yun Zhi to immediately free Daoist Buyu – now the jail was filled with criminals who came to listen to storytelling.
She gently rubbed her temples, wondering why there were so many issues to handle when the Seek Dao Sect was prospering.
Why couldn't she remember so many problems when the master was the Sect Leader?
Eldest Senior Sister stood up, gesturing for Lu Yang to come over: "Since you're back, come with me."
"Where to?" Lu Yang asked curiously.
"After the destruction of the Eternity Sect, their Master disclosed the location of the sect's origin, which is where the first leader encountered the relics of Immortal Eternity."
"The Great Xia dynasty once dispatched people to investigate, and reports indicate many things likely from ancient times. Due to such a distant era, knowledge of the script, heritage, and ancient languages is limited to the tip of the iceberg. The Great Xia dynasty, faced with these objects from ancient times, hesitated to act arbitrarily, fearing it might damage them."
"When it comes to the ancient times, I know less than Fairy Eternity. This matter is closely related to her. She should go."
