"When the Great Xia dynasty informed me, I originally intended to explore the ruins with you and Fairy Eternity. But, you were undergoing training in the forest, in a critical period of cultivating your Golden Core, so I didn't disturb you."
"Now that you have successfully created your Golden Core, I can rest assured and take you to the ruins."
Eldest Senior Sister said this and walked out of her abode. She beckoned to the sky, and a crack appeared. A cloud descended from the sky and landed in front of her.
"Let's go."

chapters.title: Chapter 279 - 278: The First Generation Master_1
chapters.content:
"The Great Xia officials have named the ruins the Eternity Relics."
"The Eternity Relics are located in a small hill near Falling Goose County. Locals call this hill Waste Mountain, as it has scarce resources and unremarkable scenery, so they seldom visit."
"Preliminary exploration suggests that the relics date back to the late ancient period."
Before heading to the relics, Yun Zhi provides Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity with a brief introduction.
Currently, people's understanding of the ancient period is 70% based on records left by predecessors and 30% from excavating the relics of the Great Qian Dynasty.
Due to the Ancient Nameless One refining the stars, relics from the ancient period are scarce and mostly fragmented, yielding little useful information.
Lu Yang is different, as all his understanding of the ancient period comes from Fairy Eternity.
While hearing Eldest Senior Sister's introduction, Lu Yang's mouth opened up, displaying an appearance of indecision.
"What's the matter?"
"Do we really need to discuss the relics while we're eating hotpot?"
Lu Yang's hotpot was bubbling away in front of him, with plates of beef on the table - according to the restaurant, they were tenderloin, grip, beef shank, sorted beef combo platter... Lu Yang had never thought of subdividing a cow into such meticulous parts.
Across the hotpot, the beautiful female cultivator watched Lu Yang, making him feel substantial pressure.
It was like an execution; he would rather go to the Eternity Relics directly.
The beef hotpot is world-renowned, and all the diners here were attracted by it, but the detached tone of Eldest Senior Sister felt out of place in this restaurant's ambiance. Many people involuntarily glanced over at Lu Yang and Yun Zhi, curious about their identities.
If someone were observant, they would notice that the couple was indeed talking, but no one could hear a word they were saying. This was not simply a basic sound barrier magic skill, but something deeper, almost illusory.
Yun Zhi picked a piece of beef from the pot, dipped it in satay sauce, slightly opened her mouth, and put the meat in. Her manners were so elegant, not like she was eating hotpot, but rather a precious delicacy.
"Beef hotpot is a specialty of Falling Goose County. This is a rare opportunity to try local cuisine, which will enrich your experiences. Your character is free-spirited, destined for a worldly cultivation path. This is also part of the cultivation process."
Yun Zhi paused and continued, "And, we're also celebrating your successful advancement to the Golden Core Stage."
Saying this, Yun Zhi lifted a tea cup and toasted with Lu Yang.
Lu Yang was touched and carefully held up his tea cup.
After the meal, the two left the restaurant; Lu Yang was still savoring the taste. Unsettling as it was, the food was indeed delicious.
Just when Lu Yang wanted to ask where to go next, he felt his collar being grabbed by Eldest Senior Sister.
Eldest Senior Sister took a step forward; space twisted, the scene altered and they seamlessly moved from the front of the restaurant to the desolate Waste Mountain.
"This is what Shrinking Ground Into Inches really is!" said Fairy Eternity, excitedly.
After spending a long time with Lu Yang, she almost forgot that the real Shrinking Ground Into Inches was a space magic, not digging and crawling in the soil.
...
On the Waste Mountain, soldiers set up camp and were on high alert. They were elite royal troops of Great Xia, all of them were cultivators and could form an army soul array to counter enemies.
The Eternity Relics were the birthplace of the Eternity Sect, so it was not something the imperial court could ignore.
"Honored Yun Zhi is present?" An elder general, clad in heavy armor and emanating a sense of determination from his brows, approached; every step he took resulted in a heavy clank from his armor.
The old general had already received news that the Seek Dao Sect would send someone to explore the Eternity Relics.
He controlled this elite army and could fight against someone at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, hence having a considerable status in the court.
However, he dared not show arrogance in front of Yun Zhi.
The reason was simple, he was fortunate to have seen Yun Zhi in action.
At the same time, he wondered if inviting Yun Zhi over meant that the court was planning to explore or to dismantle the Eternity Relics?
Yun Zhi inclined her head, without saying much.
The old general focused his gaze on Lu Yang, a cultivator who had just reached the Golden Core Stage. He didn't understand why Yun Zhi brought him along.
However, the old general didn't inquire. Surely, since Yun Zhi brought him along, he didn't need to worry about it.
Could he stop Yun Zhi?
"This way, please." The old general gestured politely for Yun Zhi to enter the Eternity Relics.
The soldiers watching this scene speculated discreetly. Who was the honored guest who commanded such respect from the general?
The Crown Princess? The Grand Princess? Some Transcendance Tribulation Stage Great Cultivator?
The soldiers were highly disciplined. Even with doubts, they kept their expressions neutral, staying steadfast in their duties and practicing their combat tactics.
The old general led the two to a cave. It was deep and dim, "This is the place. According to the members of the Eternity Sect, over ten thousand years ago, their first Master was inspired by Immortal Eternity in his sleep, ended up coming here, and saw two old men playing chess. One of the immortals was Immortal Eternity, and the other was the Ancient Nameless One."
"After the chess game ended, the first Master was so drawn in by the game that when it finished, the old men and the chess board vanished together. The Master awakened from the dream to find himself in the middle of the mountain, at the entrance to the Eternity Relics."
"However, our investigations revealed that the above experience was fabricated to exaggerate the origin of the Eternity Sect. The only resemblance to the actual situation is that the principal character was indeed the first Master."
"In reality, the first Master was caught logging illegally in the area and selling the wood. After serving fifty years' imprisonment, he revised his criminal history, learned from his past, made proactive improvements, and even learned the Tree Growing Spell. He planted and uprooted trees simultaneously, quickly mastering the spell."
"When he uprooted one ancient tree, he discovered an unfathomably deep cave underneath it. He was taken aback and decided to explore the cave after buying accident insurance."
"That's when he discovered the Eternity Relics, learned of Immortal Eternity, and stumbled upon a few Immortal Treasures. This enlightened him - creating a cult would earn Spirit Stones faster than logging."
"This philosophy is also reflected in our criminal laws: the former attracts capital punishment, while the latter is punishable by imprisonment."
"Establishing the Eternity Sect presented numerous challenges, such as insufficient funding and inadequate personnel."
"Whenever there was a shortage of funds, he took loans, and when there was a manpower shortage, he would recruit from the prison. The first Master overcame various challenges and eventually established the Eternity Sect."
"...How did you guys investigate all this in such detail?" Lu Yang found the first Master's experience to be quite rich, enough to fill an entire book.
The imperial court is impressive, having such detailed investigative capabilities.
"Oh, investigating these details wasn't difficult, considering that he wrote a memoir."
The old general pulled out a book from his bosom, "This one here, I've been reading it like a novel recently. It's quite interesting."
Lu Yang: "..."
You really think highly of yourself, don't you?
To add on, the old general said, "Later, the second Master seized power and killed the first Master, claiming the insurance payout."

chapters.title: Chapter 280 - 279: Speculation that Overturns History_1
chapters.content:
The duty of the old general is to guard the Eternal Relics and prevent outsiders from entering. The only ones allowed to enter the Eternal Relics are Eldest Senior Sister and Lu Yang, along with the immortal ghost within Lu Yang.
Upon entering the Eternal Relics, Lu Yang didn't feel strange.
The Eternity Sect's branch, Yanjiang Rudder, has a secret realm, which is built exactly like the Eternal Relics to enhance a sense of belonging and faith in the Immortal Eternity.
The platforms floating in the air, the ancient buildings on the platforms, everything was all too familiar. Under the test of time, the buildings had collapsed, making it difficult to imagine what they looked like before their collapse.
Eldest Senior Sister snapped her fingers, and the collapsed buildings floated up, assembling into their original form, as if time had reversed.
The architectural style was different from contemporary ones, however, there was absolutely no connection between these buildings and the word "ancient".
The contemporary architecture style originated from the era of Great Qian, evolving over three hundred thousand years, changing with the times.
In the ancient era, it had been more than three hundred thousand years. By the end of the ancient era, the arts, language, and other aspects were very advanced, not less than now. The difference with the present was only in the style.
The main body of the architecture was magnificent, with buildings scattered in an orderly manner. Even the main gates were inlaid with yellow jade, green jade, and red gold, exuding a sense of grandeur.
"Do you recognize these buildings, elder?" Yun Zhi asked.
There were only the three of them within the relics. Fairy Eternity didn't need to hide her whereabouts and came out from the spiritual space.
She examined these buildings carefully, then shook her head lightly: "I don't recognize these buildings. Although I don't understand architectural styles, I always feel that these don't look like the buildings of my time."
Yun Zhi expressed surprise, which was rare: "According to the Great Xia Dynasty's assessment, these relics have been around for three to four hundred thousand years. The Great Xia Dynasty has never made a mistake in time identification."
"Moreover, the style and layout of the buildings here do not match the situation in the early Great Qian era."
"The academic world generally has a notion that, as the Ancient Nameless One refined the stars, the once glorious ancient times were reduced to ashes. Along with it, countless wealth also disappeared."
"Therefore, when the Great Qian Dynasty was just established, it advocated frugality, reducing taxes and rent. If you think about the buildings of the Eternal Relics, while not extravagant, they certainly don't align with thriftiness."
These are not Yun Zhi's words, but what the scholars organized by the court had written in their report to Emperor Xia after investigating the place.
"Then I really don't know." Fairy Eternity honestly said, she was not good at thinking about these issues.
Lu Yang remained silent throughout. He didn't expect to encounter difficulties from the start of the exploration of the relics. Even the era in which the relics are located had not been determined.
Moving forward, there were the murals that Lu Yang was familiar with.
In the murals, an Immortal Eternity with open arms could not be identified as male or female. The Immortal Eternity was holding countless planets in his arms, with a tiny person kneeling on each planet. The tiny people were holding up their tributes to the Immortal Eternity.
Looking back four months, Master Chu of Yanjiang County took Lu Yang and the others into the secret realm, introducing the origins of the Immortal Eternity in front of the mural and revealing the enigma of the Ancient Nameless One refining the planets to Lu Yang.
Times have changed, Lu Yang sighed. It hadn't been long since then, Master Chu, a good man, was gone just like that. The murderer remains at large, unaccountable for his actions.
To the right of the mural, was a long passage which Lu Yang couldn't understand.
"Is this the text from the ancient era?"
Yun Zhi nodded and roughly translated for Lu Yang. The general meaning was that in the ancient times, the Immortal Eternity was protecting the human race. Immortal Eternity fought against the Ancient Nameless One, died from exhaustion, but as long as you call out the name of the Immortal Eternity, he could be revived.
Now it can be confirmed that this part of the history was fabricated. Whether it was Fairy Eternity, Yellow Bean, or Immortal Eternity, Sha Meless, none of them had ever done such a thing.
Fairy Eternity had already fallen before the Ancient Nameless One could refine the stars, and Immortal Eternity had just been born a few months ago.
"So this is actually a relic from the ancient era?" Lu Yang furrowed his brows, feeling that things shouldn't be so simple.
Yun Zhi shook her head: "If it were before, I might have thought so, but after what the elder has said, I feel that the text on the mural might have been intentionally left by the person behind the scenes to mislead us."
Yun Zhi turned to ask Fairy Eternity: "Elder, I have translated most of the text just now. In today's times, people can't fully translate the ancient language, for example, this inscription. The scholars sent by the court, as well as myself, are unable to translate it."
Fairy Eternity looked at this inscription, her eyebrows knitted in silence. Of course, she could understand it, but it was so strange that she thought she had read it wrong.
She read it slowly and deliberately: "May the blessings of Immortal Eternity be upon us, may the Fire Dynasty reign eternal."
Fairy Eternity then asked: "What is the Fire Dynasty?"
Lu Yang was also puzzled, he had never heard of a dynasty called "Fire".
Looking at the timeline, the end of the ancient era was marked by the rise of the Great Qian Dynasty from the ruins. A hundred thousand years later, the Great Yu dynasty replaced Great Qian, another hundred thousand years passed, and then the Great Xia Dynasty replaced Great Yu, lasting till today.
There was no room for a Fire Dynasty.
The Fire Dynasty could not have existed in the ancient era, according to Fairy Eternity,
Lu yang and Fairy Eternity looked at Yun Zhi together, hoping to get an answer.
Yun Zhi's eyebrows furrowed slightly, puzzled by this situation: "I've never heard of a Fire Dynasty either, could it be that there was a Fire Dynasty in the ancient era?"
Lu Yang dismissed this notion: "That's impossible, Fairy told me that the ancient era only had tribes; concepts like 'dynasty' and 'law' didn't exist."
Fairy Eternity nodded.
Lu Yang made a hypothesis: "Could it be possible that the concept of a dynasty was established, and a dynasty was founded, after Fairy's fall?"
Yun Zhi shook her head: "After the elder fell, the Ancient Nameless One quickly refined the mainland, wiping out all those who knew Fairy's true name. These two events couldn't have been too far apart in time. It's not feasible to establish a dynasty within such a short span of time."
Yun Zhi's implication was that Fairy Eternity's fall marked the beginning of the end of the ancient era.
Lu Yang seemed to have an idea, but this guess was terrifying and simply overturned the common knowledge.
"Since we have eliminated all doubts, only two possibilities remain."
"The first possibility is that the mural was created by the puppet master, who fabricated a non-existent 'Fire Dynasty' to cloud our judgment."
"The problem with the first possibility is that creating a fictitious dynasty is too easily discredited, and there is no point in creating it."
"The second possibility is that there was a dynasty in between the ancient era and the Great Qian era, named the Fire Dynasty."
"The Fire Dynasty was the first in history, and it was a legacy of the ancient times, using the ancient language, acquiring the ancient wealth. With the collapse of the Fire Dynasty, the ancient legacy was completely cut off."
"The problem with the second possibility is, why does no one know about the existence of the Fire Dynasty? The birth and collapse of a dynasty, wouldn't there be the slightest of records?"

chapters.title: Chapter 281 - 280: Sacrificing to Fairy Eternity_1
chapters.content:
If the second possibility were true, it would be hard to imagine. The rise and fall of a dynasty was a major event with detailed records.
But today, let alone records, not even names remain.
Who was the founding emperor, how many years did the dynasty exist, how many Cultivators experienced the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, what caused the demise, why there isn't a shred of record... all of these are impossible to know.
The most crucial question is the last one. Perhaps there is a connection with the method of erasing the existence of Fairy Eternity.
"Fairy, are there any anomalies occurring in heaven and earth when an Immortal perishes?"
Fairy Eternity was stunned by this question: "There has never been a case of an Immortal falling in history, who knows if there are any anomalies... Oh no, I'm wrong, I've died."
"I don't know what happens after I die, I guess there's none?"
Fairy Eternity was unsure in her answer.
"There's no anomaly," Yun Zhi answered for Fairy Eternity and this response surprised Lu Yang.
How did Eldest Senior Sister know?
Lu Yang didn't delve into this. If Immortals could perish without anomalies, in other words, no one might be aware of an Immortal's fall.
Why did the Four Immortals of Ancients not resurrect Fairy Eternity?
Did they not want to resurrect her, were unable to resurrect her, or did they flat out not know that Fairy Eternity had perished?
No, even if they didn't know about the Fairy's fall at that time, they should have realized that something had happened to the Fairy in three hundred thousand years and sought to resurrect her.
"Don't think about this problem anymore." Yun Zhi didn't linger in front of the murals, she left straight away and Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity quickly followed.
"The only text in the remains are those on the murals. Since we can't find an answer at this stage, we should wait until we gather enough information to think about it." Yun Zhi reminded Lu Yang not to be too focused on this and trap himself inside this problem.
Lu Yang listened to Yun Zhi's words and nodded, no longer thinking about it.
"This site of ruins has nineteen floating platforms. Although numerous, their layout is more or less the same, all featuring several buildings."
Eldest Senior Sister spread hands, a model of the ruins was constructed in her palms. Eighteen floating platforms were arranged around the largest in the middle, following a certain pattern, as if performing a kind of ritual activity.
The largest platform had multiple buildings that were also arranged in the form of an arch, protecting the altar in the very center.
The place they were heading to was this sacrificial altar.
The more Fairy Eternity looked at the layout, the more familiar it seemed: "This method of worship, doesn't it look like how they worshipped me in ancient times?"
"Like the way they worshipped you?"
Fairy Eternity nodded and mentioned another secret of Immortals: "Yeah, after I became an Immortal, didn't the Yingtian Immortal and others insist on giving me a planet?"
"They said that since I was an Immortal, I needed believers to conveniently display my power and dignity of an Immortal. I said that was troublesome, they said it didn't matter, they could help me design a set of worship procedures."
"The method of worship in these ruins is similar to the one Ying Tian immortal and others designed. They said the number eighteen is special in cultivation. Nine represents the ultimate, and eighteen represents eternal extremes. This worship method symbolizes that I have received eighteen kinds of blessings, making me eternally exist without increase or decrease.
It's the highest specification of worship, none of them four have this."
Lu Yang gasped. Fairy's face value was quite large. The Four Immortals joined hands just to design a set of worship procedures for her and explain the design philosophy to her?
The Four Immortals of the Ancients were really open-minded, not caring at all about Fairy Eternity's constant troubles. Maybe only with such a mentality, could one become an Immortal.
Lu Yang felt the revelations, but also felt something off.
Eldest Senior Sister, who had been silently listening to Fairy Eternity's story, wore a strange expression and said: "But according to the old scholars' research on this method of worship, combined with records from the ancient times, they think that this is an obscure Array Method from ancient times, known as the Eighteen Hells Exorcism Array."
Everything seemed to make sense to Lu Yang now.
After hearing that, Fairy Eternity was grinding her teeth, wishing that she could single-handedly confront the Four Immortals of the Ancients to show them who was truly the strongest Immortal of the ancient times: "Those bastards of Ying Tian Immortal, I've treated them well, yet they dared to treat me this way!"
'I think them treating you this way is already quite accommodating.'
Of course, Lu Yang would never dare to say this out in front of Fairy Eternity; he was afraid of getting hit.
"That's it! They must have been envious of my talent because I had beaten them too many times before they became Immortals and formed the Eternity Dao Fruit when I became an Immortal. They found an opportunity to take revenge on me!" Fairy Eternity quickly found a reason from herself, attributing it to her own strength.
The three of them reached the center of the altar, where a hundred meter high giant Immortal statue was erected, it was the same gender-indistinguishable Immortal Eternity statue that Lu Yang had seen before.
It appeared that this was the original site of the Immortal Eternity statue. The founding Master saw this statue and established the Eternity Sect.
Various rare and invaluable dishes made of heavenly treasures were laid at the feet of the Immortal, the worst ingredient among them was a five-thousand-year-old glossy ganoderma.
Perhaps because the quality of the ingredients was too high, despite the long passage of time, nothing had gone rotten or moldy.
Fairy Eternity made a face of disgust, expressing great dissatisfaction with the Eternity Sect's practices: "They really have no taste, putting food at the foot."
These were the leftovers from when the Eternity Sect hadn't fallen and came here for worship.
The Eternity ruins were crucial for the Eternity Sect. Apart from the prayers every ten years, a series of major events, such as the appointment and dismissal of the Master, the blessing of the Master, the betrayal of the Master, and others all took place here, under the watchful eye of the Immortal Eternity.
"Let's go. According to the submitted reports, the inside of the statue hides a world of its own."
Yun Zhi led the two around to the back of the statue, where there was a hidden door. Mysterious symbols were floating in front of the door, constantly sinking and wavering, sealing the door and making it impossible to open.
Yun Zhi checked the strength of the mysterious symbols, thinking that it could be forcibly opened, but doing so might damage the things inside.
"The founding Master discovered several Immortal Treasures from behind this door. He accidentally opened the door and took a few of them. When he tried to come back for the other treasures, the door was already closed."
"He tried several times but still couldn't open the door. In the end, he had no choice but to take the other Immortal Treasures, leave the ruin, and establish the Eternity Sect."
"The founding Master tried his whole life, but could not open the door, and subsequent Masters also wanted to open the door and take the Immortal Treasures to strengthen the Eternity Sect, but they all ended in failure."
"The old scholars were also helpless and said that this was a seal left by the Immortals and only an Immortal could open it."
"Fairy, do you know the meaning of this symbol and can you open this door?"
With a look of reminiscence on her face, Fairy Eternity said: "It looks just like my kitchen door?"
"You see this symbol, I wrote it, the meaning is 'Kitchen is a private area, no outsiders allowed.'"

chapters.title: Chapter 282 - 281 Fairy's Kitchen _1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang couldn't help but recall the Immortal Treasures held by the Eternity Sect:
The Dream Pillow.
A toothpick.
Poison-tipped chopsticks.
Aged vinegar.
A bedsheet.
A plate.
Indeed, it seems like someone mistakenly entered the kitchen and took some random things.
Needless to say about their power, they deserve to be called Immortal Treasures even though their origin is complicated.
"As a chef, my least favorite thing is for people to disturb me when I'm cooking. You can understand that feeling, right?" Fairy Eternity said to Lu Yang. As a grill master, Lu Yang should share the same sentiment.
In fact, Lu Yang wanted to say that as a roadside grill worker he didn't have a kitchen. But, considering the unpredictable consequences of not agreeing with Fairy Eternity, he reluctantly nodded and said, "Yes."
Fairy Eternity was pleased to find someone who understood her feelings. She then sighed and said, "I didn't expect that even after I locked the door, someone still broke in. That shouldn't have happened."
"Apart from Fairy Eternity, who else can open this door?" Lu Yang suspected that someone behind the scenes had secretly opened the door, allowing the first Master to take away a few treasures which had become the treasures of the Eternity Sect.
"Yingtian Immortal and the others could do it. I was afraid they couldn't wait to eat my food, so I told them how to open the door."
"But they were too courteous; none of them would come in."
Yun Zhi shook his head secretly. The seal set up by Fairy Eternity wasn't difficult to break. Given time any Immortal could figure out the way to open it.
How strong could a kitchen's seal be?
Fairy Eternity did nothing, just stood in front of the door. The mysterious symbols automatically disappeared and the door opened, revealing the real Immortal relic - Fairy Eternity's kitchen.
This should be the first Immortal relic to be opened in history. It's significant.
Fairy Eternity, the only Immortal Cook, has a clean and bright kitchen without any stains. This should be due to the Dust Removal Array.
After entering the kitchen, the door closed, cutting off the light source, and Eternity Light illuminated the kitchen.
"It's so quiet. It feels like it's completely cut off from the outside world."
"Hehe, that's all thanks to my Sound Barrier Array. When I process ingredients, they tend to make a lot of noise. This can disturb the customers, so I set up the Sound Barrier Array and the Spiritual Sense Isolation Array to prevent outsiders from prying."
Lu Yang looked strange, this sounded like a room used for murder.
"Do not touch anything in the kitchen. They are dangerous for you." Yun Zhi, knowing Lu Yang's curiosity, specially warned him to be careful.
Hearing that, Lu Yang quickly drew back his outstretched hand.
These were all things used by the Immortals, any residual energy from any objects could easily shatter him into pieces.
With Yun Zhi present, of course, he could be saved, but after all, this was not an experience worth trying.
Fairy Eternity seemed indifferent and was full of confidence: "Ah, it's okay. With me, the Immortal protecting Lu Yang, what could go wrong?"
Hearing this, Lu Yang's unrest subsided.
"Speaking of Fairy, why are the Dream Pillow and bedsheet in your kitchen?" Lu Yang remembered the two main Immortal Treasures of the Eternity Sect, which should not appear in the kitchen.
Fairy Eternity said naturally: "It's quite normal. I like cooking and sleeping. When I wake up, I explore how to cook, and when I get tired, I lie down and sleep. Under this virtuous cycle, both my cooking skills and sleep quality are improving rapidly."
While saying this, Fairy Eternity made a gesture of flying.
"Jiuchong Immortal advised me not to strive too hard in the kitchen all day long. He said there is no end to cooking skills and told me to take a break and go out."
"Even though others think I'm exhausting myself, I feel very relaxed."
"...Is it possible that Jiuchong Immortal didn't want you to continue researching cooking skills, not because he was worried about you being too tired?"
Eternity Fairy was surprised, "Why? Didn't I let them taste my new dishes first every time I invented them?"
Yun Zhi saw bottles and jars placed in a corner of the kitchen. She casually lifted one of the lids and was almost stunned by the pungent smell, almost thinking she was under attack. She instinctively was about to strike back.
"Senior, what is this?" Yun Zhi asked, pointing to the red liquid in the jade bottle.
"Chili oil, haven't you seen it? I remember there is hot pot in Seek Dao Sect, isn't there?"
Yun Zhi was silent. She knew about chili oil, but this was the first time she had encountered chili oil that was so strong that it made her want to fight back.
What a revelation.
Lu Yang was even more shocked. How could chili oil last for three hundred thousand years?
"This is chili oil I made with countless treasures of heaven and earth and the essence of sun, moon and stars!"
Fairy Eternity knocked on the bottle: "Look at this bottle. I had to find many Refining masters to make this magic artifact that can hold this kind of chili oil."
"Getting back to this chili oil, despite it looking plain and similar to ordinary chili oil, just a few drops in the cooking can lift the dish to another level."
"And this chili oil can also detect lies. I didn't discover this feature while refining it. It seems like an accidental function."
"How come?"
"Qilin Immortal loves spicy food. After finding out about this, I invited him over for dinner and put a few drops of chili oil in the food I specially prepared for him. I didn't put any in the food for Yingtian Immortal and the others."
"After a few bites, Qilin Immortal started waving his hands, saying he actually didn't like spicy food and asked me to make another dish."
"Guys, my cooking skills are widely acclaimed. Even before I became an Immortal, I was extremely popular. Jiuchong Immortal, for example, asked me to cook for him multiple times."
Lu Yang was shocked, thinking that Jiuchong Immortal fully deserved to be the first Immortal, he was very bold. Just in terms of courage, he was far superior to the likes of Yingtian Immortal.
"Really?"
"Sure enough. That was the first time I cooked for Jiuchong Immortal. After eating, his expression changed drastically. He found it incredible and saw great potential in me."
Fairy Eternity spoke lively. This incident gave her great confidence in her cooking skills. It made her more and more obsessed with cooking, reaching an unprecedented height. Every Spirit Chef in history respected her.
Unfortunately, she died early; otherwise, she would have become the founder of the Spirit Chefs and worshipped by many, keeping her spirit lamp lit.
At the gatherings of the Immortals, she often brought up this incident. She particularly thanked Jiuchong Immortal for his support, and when the other Immortals heard about this, they all showed kind smiles to Jiuchong Immortal.
Lu Yang looked puzzled, "Did Jiuchong Immortal really say that?"
Fairy Eternity put her hands on her hips, pouted her lips, and frowned slightly, feeling unsatisfied with Lu Yang's doubt.
"When have I ever lied to you?"
"A few days later, he found me and asked me to cook for him again. He wanted to take it away. When I asked him what he was going to do with it, he avoided the question and said something like, 'a prisoner's mouth is hardened. No sort of torture works, we need to use some unconventional methods.'"

chapters.title: Chapter 283 - 282: The Final Battle before the Four Immortals of the Ancients Attained Enlightenment_1
chapters.content:
"Did the prisoner confess?" Lu Yang asked subconsciously.
Fairy Eternity was baffled by Lu Yang's question: "How would I know if the prisoner confessed? It must be that Immortal Jiuchong was too tired from interrogating the prisoner and needed food to refuel."
"Let's see what ingredients we have left." Fairy Eternity hummed a light tune, wandering around the kitchen, finally stopping before a pool.
"Taiyi Holy Water?" Yun Zhi whispered the origin of the water in the pool. It was not ordinary, but a rare Taiyi Holy Water that had never appeared at auctions.
The Taiyi Holy Water was said to have the ability to purify everything and cleanse the soul. A single drop could pull a Cultivator back from going berserk during practice.
If Yun Zhi's memory served her right, only a few drops of Taiyi Holy Water were left nowadays, scattered among various major forces as foundation and were not to be casually used.
The Seek Dao Sect once had three drops which were all used on the Elders who had gone berserk during Cultivation. Now, the Seek Dao Sect didn't have a single drop of Taiyi Holy Water.
Yet, there was a pool of Taiyi Holy Water here.
The calm surface of the water reflected Fairy Eternity's delicate face.
"Why is there a pool here?" Lu Yang, unfamiliar with Taiyi Holy Water, was merely puzzled as to why a pool would be in a kitchen.
"It's a vegetable washing pool, don't you wash your ingredients before cooking?" Fairy Eternity revealed an expression suggesting 'Lu Yang, you really lack hygiene,' causing Lu Yang's eyelid to twitch.
Taiyi Holy Water could purify everything; using it to wash vegetables could somehow... make sense?
Eldest Senior Sister hesitated a bit, thinking that it indeed befits the ingenuity of an ancient immortal to use such unexpected methods.
Then Fairy Eternity extended her index finger and lightly touched the calm surface of the water, causing ripples to spread.
The water surface parted as though responding to a command from something, revealing the space underneath the water.
There were no water drops or vapour in the underwater space. An odd power isolated the pool and the underwater space. If the entire setting of the pool and the underwater space was seen as a jar, then the pool would be the lid.
The items in the underwater space startled Lu Yang: unidentified meat radiating vibrant life energy, Immortal Fruits that had disappeared from history, spherical stones with unbelievable regular structure, flowers emitting five-coloured radiance... all these items spoke of their extraordinary origin.
But none of these were the main point, the real key was—
"How are these things so well preserved even after three hundred thousand years?!" Lu Yang was shocked. Even if a Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivator lived like a relay race, they would already have died many generations ago after such a long period.
Yun Zhi raised an eyebrow. In her perception, the time in this underwater space was completely static.
First, Fairy Eternity confirmed that her precious items were intact and secretly took a sigh of relief, then proudly declared: "This space was created for me by Time Immortal!"
"He used the power of his Time Dao Fruit to completely freeze the time in this space. Whatever you put inside remains the same when you take it out!"
Lu Yang drew in a sharp breath, freezing local time, the Time Dao Fruit could actually do this?!
"When Time Immortal just became an Immortal and formed his Time Dao Fruit, he couldn't do this. It was with my help that he developed this trick. To thank me, he constructed this time-stilled space for me."
"Does Fairy Eternity also master time-related powers?" Lu Yang recalled the divine abilities related to time that Fairy Eternity possessed.
One was Playing Dead Technique, which allowed her to control her own time and speed up the rotting of her body.
Another was weather forecasting, which accurately predicted future weather.
However, it didn't seem like Fairy Eternity had the ability to guide Time Immortal.
"Time Immortal said that only when facing threats could the power of Dao Fruit be stimulated. Yet there are hardly any 'threats' to immortals."
"So, he asked me to cook for him. He wanted to restrain his own time while eating. After practicing for a few days, he succeeded."
Lu Yang: "..."
"It might be that he recalled the time when I pinned him down and beat him up during his Transcendence Tribulation Stage while eating, which invoked the sense of 'threat'. Immortal Jiuchong taught me that this is called a conditioned response."
"Transcendence Tribulation Stage?" Yun Zhi caught the keyword and remembered a story she had read from an ancient book, "Does Fairy Eternity know about a grand battle the Yingtian Immortal and the other three had experienced before becoming immortals, that is, when they were still in the Transcendence Tribulation stage?"
"The last battle before becoming immortals?" Upon hearing this, Lu Yang was intrigued. This sounded full of storytelling potential, stirring up numerous passionate imaginations.
Yun Zhi lightly nodded and recalled the content from the ancient book: "According to legend, the Four Immortals of the Ancients had a significant decisive battle before achieving immortality."
"Yingtian Immortal, Qilin Immortal, and Immortal Jiuchong, these three Geniuses arrogantly teamed up against Time Immortal. It was said that during the battle, Yingtian Immortal vehemently asked Time Immortal 'Who can become an Immortal!' Faced with Yingtian Immortal's interrogation, Time Immortal didn't dare to answer, putting him at a disadvantage."
"People speculated that among the Four Immortals of the Ancients, Time Immortal was originally a Firmament Tree and had existed for an unknown number of years. It was terrifyingly profound and the most likely to become an Immortal. Yingtian Immortal and the other two teamed up to prevent Time Immortal from becoming the first to achieve Immortality."
At first, Fairy Eternity furrowed her brows, not recalling anything about a final battle before immortality. But as she listened further, she suddenly realized: "Oh, you are talking about this. Well, you asked the right person, I know about this."
"Let me tell you, Time Immortal looked down at everyone before he became an Immortal. At that time, we were both in the Transcendence Tribulation Stage. Time Immortal asked me, out of all the heroes in the world, who can become Immortal?"
"I asked if it could be Yingtian Immortal. He said that Yingtian Immortal values his status too much, which is a burden on his path to Immortality."
"I asked if it could be Qilin Immortal. He said that Qilin Immortal is a crude warrior who relies on his innate luck. His path of Cultivation is too smooth and he would have a hard time passing the test of becoming an Immortal."
"I asked if it could be Immortal Jiuchong. He said that Immortal Jiuchong is average and would have been defeated by other geniuses if not for his Immortal body. Such a person cannot become an Immortal."
"I asked if I could do it. He said that I'm too conspicuous and aggressive. Although I'm pursuing the path of invincibility, too much hardness can easily lead to breaking. He also said that my thinking is too intricate, which is against the way of nature. This puts me at a disadvantage and makes it impossible for me to become an Immortal."
"I asked him who could become an Immortal then. He said that it's a pity that among all the people in the world, only he could become an Immortal, doomed to eternal solitude."
"I got angry at the time, pinned him down and beat him up. Then he humbly said that I could also become an Immortal."
"I was still angry afterwards and felt that one round wasn't enough to vent my anger. But since I had already beaten him up once, it wouldn't be seemly to hit him again. So I told Yingtian Immortal, Qilin Immortal, and Immortal Jiuchong about our conversation."
"Then, the three of them teamed up to give Time Immortal a good lesson."
"Time Immortal wasn't afraid of anyone in a one-versus-one fight. But in a three-on-one, Time Immortal could only take a beating."
"When Yingtian Immortal asked Time Immortal 'Who can become an Immortal,' Time Immortal, knowing that he was in the wrong, did not dare to reply."
Yun Zhi: "..."
So this was the true story behind the legendary final battle before the Ascension of the Four Immortals of the Ancients?
Seeing Eldest Senior Sister's reaction, Lu Yang sneakily thought, you now know the kind of ancient stories I hear every day, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 284 - 283: Great Harvest_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang could confidently say that his understanding of ancient knowledge is on par with those of old scholars who have spent their whole lives studying.
Unlike the old scholars with their hodgepodge of knowledge, the knowledge Lu Yang has mastered is all related to the ancient immortals, something the old scholars covet.
Previously, Lu Yang's understanding of ancient knowledge was zero. He would listen to whatever Fairy Eternity said, accepting it very readily.
However, for someone like Eldest Senior Sister who has her own unique interpretations of ancient times, when listening to Fairy Eternity's stories, it is somewhat hard to accept them.
This is indeed the advantage of ignorance.
Lu Yang no longer wastes time pondering the deviations between legend and truth, he curiously inquires about what is stored in the underwater space.
"What kind of meat is this that emits such vitality?"
Fairy Eternity stroked her chin, trying hard to remember what this piece of meat looked like when it was alive: "It's Bifang's meat... No, it's Chaotic Beast's meat... Wrong again, what was it?"
"Fairy, you don't remember what kind of meat this is? How do you cook?" Lu Yang was quite surprised.
Although Fairy Eternity hails from three hundred thousand years ago, from Fairy Eternity's perspective,
It's like three hundred thousand years ago she was taken down, fell into a deep sleep, and awakened only to be scolded by the Eldest Senior Sister. Livings in her spiritual space for three months.
In other words, from Fairy Eternity's point of view, it's just that she hasn't been to the kitchen for three months, and she's forgotten what kind of meat this is?
"Why do you need to know what kind of meat this is?" Fairy Eternity retorted, leaving Lu Yang speechless.
"Meeting is fate, eating also requires a certain fate. Which piece of meat I choose indicates that piece of meat has a fate with today's meal." Clearly, Fairy Eternity has her own unique insight into cooking.
"What about this fruit?" Lu Yang pointed to a very conspicuous fruit, almost the size of an apple, pure white, with three light rings around the fruit body. The light rings radiated a glow, spread in the air. Due to the stoppage of time, the fading glow also lingered in the air.
"Oh, this is the Eternity Immortal Fruit I planted."
"Eternity Immortal Fruit? What's its effect? Does it grant immortality?" Lu Yang felt this Immortal Fruit was of staggering value when he heard its name.
How many people desire eternal life? When a person dies, everything becomes meaningless, regardless of their power or influence in life.
An Immortal Fruit that can grant eternal life is a temptation that even those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage can hardly resist.
Fairy Eternity nodded solemnly, "The one who consumes this fruit, his corpse will never decay."
Lu Yang: "..."
How does what she said have anything to do with my guess?
"Senior, is this a Green Wood Immortal Fruit?"
Yun Zhi pointed to another dark-green fruit and asked. She thought it looked very much like the Green Wood Immortal Fruit that a disciple named Jin Qinqin had swallowed when she was young.
A Green Wood Immortal Fruit allowed Jin Qinqin to have a constitution comparable to the supreme Dual Spirit Roots.
"Correct, this is the Green Wood Immortal Fruit planted by Time Immortal, I asked him for several. They taste good, I only have this one left now."
"And this stone, what is it? A sharpening stone?" Lu Yang noticed a very regular spherical stone, puzzled as to why a stone is stored in a space originally used for storing food.
Even Eldest Senior Sister frowned. She could sense the strange power contained in this stone, a power that could rival those of the Refining the Void Stage and even the Unification Stage.
But she couldn't identify what this stone was.
"This is a Star Core, the core of a planet, which I dug out from an uninhabited giant planet. You don't recognise it? Oh, right. There are no planets left in the universe now."
"Oh, so this is the Star Core." Eldest Senior Sister had seen it mentioned in ancient books. It stated that it's a good material for refining, and can be used to refine Immortal Treasures.
But why is a Star Core in the kitchen?
"What's this Star Core for?"
"A culinary ingredient, of course."
Lu Yang was shocked: "Can this be eaten?!"
Fairy Eternity waved her hand, feeling that Lu Yang lacked sophistication: "What are you saying, that I cannot eat it if I place it here?"
"Of course, the average person wouldn't be able to handle it. For instance, a newly golden-cored youngster like you, one bite could shatter all your teeth."
"But it's different for immortals. Immortals possess the body of immortals, the toughest among all creatures. The teeth are the hardest substance in the body, wouldn't they be more than capable of crunching down a small star core?"
"Don't you know that the higher the energy contained in the food, the more delicious it is? The star core is the top grade food material in my eyes!"
"In addition, isn't one purpose of eating to replenish energy?"
"Moreover, haven't you heard of the pill formula 'Gold-Stone Powder'? Stones can be used for medicinal purposes, and of course they can be eaten."
Lu Yang felt that Fairy Eternity's explanation made some sense, eating a Star Core for an immortal is probably as simple as snacking on a biscuit, but it still felt bizarre to him.
Could it be that he had misunderstood the Four Immortals of the Ancients all this while? That they chewed happily on stones all day long?
Why did this suddenly give him an impoverished feeling?
"So what about this flower? Is it also a food ingredient?" Lu Yang pointed at a flower shimmering with a five-colored brilliance, frozen in time.
"No, that is a decoration for food presentation. However, it's okay if you want to eat it, it's not bad to taste, rather refreshing." Fairy Eternity knew perfectly well that cooking was about color, aroma, and taste.
This multi-colored, radiant flower was an embodiment of 'Color'.
The three took a stroll around the kitchen, it was definitely an eye-opening experience for Lu Yang and Yun Zhi.
Lu Yang felt that the kitchen was very much in Fairy Eternity's style.
Yun Zhi, on the other hand, was worried about Fairy Eternity living in Lu Yang's spiritual space, wondering if she would lead him astray.
She was worried.
Seeing Fairy Eternity reluctantly leaving the kitchen, Yun Zhi asked, "Fairy, do you feel reluctant to leave the kitchen?"
"Not really, it's just that it's rare to see familiar things, so I can't help but feel nostalgic." Fairy Eternity replied with a shy giggle.
Yun Zhi nodded and said, "No problem, this originally belongs to you anyway. When we get out, I will ask Emperor Xia return your kitchen to you."
Fairy Eternity's eyes sparkled in response, "Really?"
"Absolutely."
The three circled around the Eternity relic once again without discovering anything new and eventually left the relic site.
Fairy Eternity naturally entered Lu Yang's spiritual space.
The Old General had been waiting at the entrance of the relic site. He asked them, "Did you gain anything from your delving into the relics?"
"We benefited greatly, I will report the condition of the relic site to Emperor Xia." Yun Zhi answered in his usual calm demeanor, not particularly sounding like someone who greatly benefited from the delve.
"As long as you gained something." The Old General sent them off.
On their way back, Lu Yang, who had been pondering about the relic site's issues asked, "Senior Sister, how was the Eternity relic site formed?"
Yun Zhi thought for a moment before answering, "I believe that it was created by a secret adversary. Let's assume that the Fire Dynasty really existed and that they worshipped the Immortal Eternity. This explains the origin of the nineteen floating stones in the relic site."
"As for your kitchen, I guess when the Ancient Nameless One refined the stars, it caused your sanctuary to crumble and break into several pieces, with the kitchen being one of them."
"The back-room manipulator refined the Fire Dynasty's worship site into the main body of the Eternity relic, and refined your kitchen into the statue of Eternity Immortal.
This way, the first Master not only learned about the existence of Eternity Immortal and established the Eternity Sect, but also with the covert help of the secret adversary, was able to obtain the Immortal Treasures from your kitchen, ensuring that the Eternity Sect would not die prematurely."
"I see."
Halfway through their journey, Lu Yang realized that Senior Sister had no intention of returning to Seek Dao Sect but instead was leading him further toward Goose County.
"Senior Sister, do we really need to go back to Goose County?"
Senior Sister responded in an indifferent tone, "Our master is currently held in the jail of Goose County. As disciples, it is only right and proper that we pay him a visit."

chapters.title: Chapter 285 - 284: The Mysterious Connection between Daoist Buyu and the Prison Cell_1
chapters.content:
When Lu Yang heard that Daoist Buyu was jailed, he blurted out, "Master is in prison again?"
Wait, why did I use the word "again"?
Yun Zhi sighed slowly and nodded, "I do not really want to acknowledge it, but it is the reality."
"Although I have told Master multiple times 'when you get in trouble in the future, do not expose your disciple'."
"However, we are still a master and disciple, even if Master disgraces himself outside, we should still call him 'Master' when we meet him, we can't pretend not to know him."
"...so was the key point of what you just said about the term 'Master', rather than why he is in prison?"
"Master wrote a letter asking to send someone to get him out of the prison. As usual, it's Fourth Elder's job to bail him out. But since Master just happens to be in Goose County, we could visit him after dealing with the Fairy Eternity remains, and see why he was locked up this time."
"Does Master often go to prison?"
"Not often, just that he spends more time in prison than most jailers."
"..."
"Thanks to his unique experiences, he believes that one should leave something to the world, hence he wrote a book based on his personal experiences, which received support from the government."
Lu Yang was curious, "What did Master write?"
"Two Thousand Years of Prison Environmental Change in the Great Xia Dynasty."
Yun Zhi casually listed examples, "During the Nine-child Era of the Seek Dao Sect, Master was often arrested for hazardous driving while under the influence, driving Flying Swords after drinking. He had to stay in prison for several months each time."
Yun Zhi further explained the current state of the judicial system in the Great Xia Dynasty, "Actually, this is the most common crime committed by cultivators. Not only Flying Swords, but also driving gourds and jade flutes while drunk. Most cultivators do not want to dissolve alcohol with magic after drinking, they just fly in the sky while they are tipsy.
The Great Xia Dynasty has been trying to stop them."
"Master has also pretended to be a fortuneteller, telling the clients that they would be defrauded today, and if they want to avoid it, they should pay money for the disaster removal. When the clients believed Master's words and gave him spirit stones to remove the disaster, Master accepted the spirit stones and said 'See, I told you would be cheated today. Wasn't my calculation accurate?'"
"Then he was put in prison."
There were too many things Daoist Buyu had done, Yun Zhi couldn't mention all of them in a short time, so she randomly picked a few examples to show Lu Yang.
"I wonder if you have heard that Master once developed a magic skill called 'Wish Granting Technique: Local Version'. It is easy to learn."
Lu Yang nodded. It is the magic skill that allowed men to make changes below and women to make changes above. He had heard of it and even wanted to learn it, but he had never got the chance.
"Originally, the government wanted to charge Master with the crime of making, copying, publishing, selling, and spreading obscene materials for profit but then Fourth Elder stepped forward, argued based on reason, saying that this magic skill mastered by Master was a health preservation method and had no obscene meaning.
After a great deal of dispute, the government finally agreed not to charge Master with a crime, but asked Master not to spread this magic skill anymore, and made Master pay the sales tax."
"Fourth Elder is really righteous!" Lu Yang did not expect that Fourth Elder, who usually seemed to disagree with Master, actually stood up for him at a critical moment, saving Master from prison.
Yun Zhi glanced at Lu Yang and said calmly, "That's because Fourth Elder was also involved in the selling. If Master had committed a crime, he would have also been implicated."
"Or rather, if Master had committed a crime, all Nine Sons of the Seek Dao Sect would have gone down together, they would have all been sent to prison for a reunion."
"Anyway, Master earned a lot of money that time, so much so that he was throwing money around like it was dirt, completely disregarding the worth of spirit stones."
"Master once emulated the Grand Elder to visit the brothel. At that time, Master was dressed in gold and silver, looking like a nouveau riche man. The brothel keeper was delighted, thinking he was a big spender. But when Master asked the brothel to issue an invoice, the brothel keeper's face changed, thinking Master was here to make a fuss, so she refused to give him one."
"Master thought this behavior of the brothel was tax evasion, so he sued the brothel to the government office. In the end, the government office confirmed the brothel's tax evasion, and the brothel keeper was jailed. Master was also confirmed to have solicited prostitution, so he was jailed as well."
"When the era of the Nine Sons of the Seek Dao Sect ended, and the Grand Elder retired, and the nine of them took over the power of the Seek Dao Sect, Master still did not behave."
"You should know that the Grand Elder enjoys building tombs. Master accompanied the Grand Elder to go out to build tombs from place to place. During their tomb excavation, they accidentally dug into a real tomb. They were reported as grave robbers to the government office. When the government office sent people to arrest them, they thought they were zombies and almost fought back."
Fairy Eternity was amazed to hear this in the spiritual space, the Seek Dao Sect truly has many exceptional people. Being in Lu Yang's spiritual space was indeed an eye-opener.
Lu Yang: "..."
Lu Yang felt that he had Fairy Eternity on one side, and Daoist Buyu on the other. Under their dual influence, he himself was able to stick to his principles, conducting himself earnestly in both actions and morals which was remarkable.
"But isn't Master in the Unification phase? How was he caught?"
As the Sect Leader of the Seek Dao Sect, he is at the top of the Unification phase and might even be the strongest in the Unification phase. Even if all the people in Goose County were piled up together, they would not be Daoist Buyu's match.
How could he have been caught?
"Master says that being in prison is a part of worldly cultivation."
"So is breaking out of prison part of worldly cultivation?"
Yun Zhi was silent for a while and looked deeply at Lu Yang: "Don't ask Master this question, I'm afraid he might get ideas."
Lu Yang scratched his head, "Okay. I have another question."
"What?"
"Shouldn't we go to visit him in prison? Why are we eating now?"
At this time, Lu Yang and Yun Zhi were sitting in the private room. In front of them were an array of delicious dishes.
After coming back from the Fairy Eternity's ruins, Yun Zhi didn't go straight to the prison. Instead, she took Lu Yang to the best restaurant in Goose County and ordered local special dishes. Lu Yang was watching in shock.
He wanted to ask, but didn't because Master was being held not far from here while we were feasting here. Shouldn't it seem a bit inappropriate to discuss all these things?
Considering that the person sitting across from him was Eldest Senior Sister, he ultimately didn't dare to ask.
Yun Zhi took a bite of the steamed beef meatballs, the meatballs were firm and juice overflowed as she bit in, she was very satisfied.
Yun Zhi put down her chopsticks and explained earnestly, "Junior Brother, you have to understand that Master is our elder, and what elders want to see most is for their juniors to be healthy and growing strong. If we eat and sleep well here, Master will be happy to know about our situation even in prison."
Lu Yang felt that Eldest Senior Sister's words make sense, but something seemed a bit off.
It seemed that his brain didn't work well lately. Was it the aftereffect of playing Yellow Bean Fist?

chapters.title: Chapter 286 - 285: I agree to sentence Old Buyu to death!_1
chapters.content:
Mo Danxin, current Count Magistrate of Goose County.
He is impartial and unbiased in dealing with affairs, earning him the nickname "Justice Mo".
He remains unmoved in the face of bribes and favors from local powers, firmly refusing them.
He treats common people and cultivators equally and doesn't give preferential treatment to cultivators.
Furthermore, he holds the highest level of cultivation in Goose County, at the mid-stage of Spirit Transformation. With the support of the state's destiny, no one can threaten his safety.
He vigorously promotes the tourism industry, developing the unique food culture of Goose County, attracting more and more people to consume there, thus boosting the local economy.
Under his governance, Goose County is thriving.
However, he recently encountered two unforeseen circumstances, feeling they are beyond his abilities.
The first is that the court garrisoned soldiers in Waste Mountain, reportedly due to the presence of a demonic sect base. It's unclear if it's related to the eradicated Eternity Sect or the other three demonic sects.
General Lv, the one commanding the troops, is at the Unification stage of cultivation and commands immense respect in the army. With such a respected veteran stationed, Mo needs not worry as a mere County Magistrate.
The second matter is that a high-status prisoner is being held, ranking only below the Emperor. Daoist Buyu, one of the leaders of the Five Great Immortal Sects, the strongest swordsman in the world, and the strongest below the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, has enemies all over the world.
Fortunately, this big shot is behaving. He stays in the prison without resistence.
If he were to resist, Mo Danxin wouldn't really be able to hold Daoist Buyu.
From a legal standpoint, Mo has jurisdiction, and Daoist Buyu's issue isn't serious, so a few days in jail will suffice.
But Mo Danxin always feels that Daoist Buyu is of too high rank and he should report the handling of Daoist Buyu's affair to the court.
Also, Mo Danxin faces a problem - although Daoist Buyu is imprisoned, he is telling stories in prison and many people came here out of admiration.
For example, for stealing a few ounces of silver, the law requires a five-day stay in prison.
Family members bring food, the prison is warm in winter and cool in summer, and there's a Unification stage Great Power telling stories next door. These five days could be extraordinarily pleasant.
It is unknown who leaked this experience, but many people followed suit. Now, the prison is so packed with inmates that it can't accommodate any more.
Those who don't know might think that Goose County is a dreadful place, with the prison overcrowded.
If this turns into a rumor and reaches the Emperor's ears, all his accomplishments could be tarnished, and he wouldn't be able to explain clearly.
Who'd believe that your prison is overcrowded just because people are eager to listen to stories?
Luckily, after hearing news of this matter, the court gave it serious consideration. The Minister of Justice personally flew to Goose County to deal with the case of Daoist Buyu.
"Sir, the Minister of Justice is almost here." A subordinate whispered a reminder. Upon hearing these words, Mo Danxin quickly changed from his regular attire into his official uniform and went out to meet the guest.
As Mo Danxin stepped out, the Minister of Justice, Xu Xin, descended from the sky. He travelled light without any attendants, reflecting his urgency.
Minister of Justice Xu Xin was tall and mighty, with distinct facial features. His ornate attire displayed his honorable position. He had a profound understanding of law and was deeply trusted by Emperor Xia.
"Master Xu, this matter regarding the Sect Leader of Seek Dao Sect..."
Minister of Justice raised his hand: "I already know what happened, I agree to sentence Old Buyu to death!"
"Ah? But the Sect Leader of Seek Dao Sect..."
"Death penalty!" The Minister of Justice declared categorically.
Seeing the Minister of Justice's attitude, Mo Danxin then recalled a rumor - it is said that any random stone thrown at the officials in the Imperial City would hit an enemy of Daoist Buyu.
There's even a poem: Who in the world doesn't know you?
The poem refers to Daoist Buyu.
"Let's go, let's go, let's go see Old Buyu!" The Minister of Justice briskly took Mo Danxin by the arm and led him to the prison.
Upon hearing that Daoist Buyu was held in Goose County, he even cancelled his dinner date with colleagues and rushed over to witness the event.
The prison was a tumult of voices, as if it held the most vicious criminals, stirring up trouble within.
Upon listening closely, one would discover that someone in the prison was storytelling.
"One day, Qin Jiunian and I, who is the Grand Elder of Seek Dao Sect, were traveling through the Central Continent. We used our Heavenly Eye and discovered a grave with towering Corpse Qi. Upon calculation, I was sure that a Zombie King had been born!"
"We originally wanted to fetch backup from our sect to surround the Zombie King, but alas, the Zombie King noticed us and tried to burrow into the ground to escape!"
"Speak of the time when I took action first, I launched a Flying Immortal From Outer Space attack and broke through multiple seals and depths of the grave. I completely sealed off the Zombie King's escape route. Seeing this, the Zombie King led an enormous army of zombies and attacked Qin Jiunian and me!"
"Who were Qin Jiunian and I? The Sect Leader and Grand Elder of the Seek Dao Sect, and yet this puny Zombie King thought he could defeat us?"
"The Zombie King showed his true form as a Drought Demon, drying up thousands of miles on the ground, connecting with the earth's fire, turning the surface and underground into a sea of fire!"
"I released a sword that caused the heavens and earth to darken. Qin Jiunian cast the Dharma Realm upon the world, with a single finger as massive as a mountain."
The prisoners in the jail were staring at Daoist Buyu without blinking, holding their breath, afraid they might disturb Daoist Buyu.
Daoist Buyu's narrative was so vivid, it made the nonexistent events appear before everyone, making them feel as if they were by the side of the battlefield.
The Minister of Justice looked strange. If his memory served him right, Old Buyu and Grand Elder Qin had been building a tomb, accidentally dug into a real tomb, and were mistaken for tomb raiders.
Was there any such thing as a Zombie King or Drought Demon?
After a few years apart, Old Buyu's skill at concocting tales had improved day by day!
Recalling the many previous times he had been duped by Daoist Buyu, the Minister of Justice gritted his teeth.
You're finally in my hands!
"Old Buyu, you seem to be living the good life!" The Minister of Justice cheerfully looked at Daoist Buyu.
Everyone in the prison cell glared at the Minister of Justice in anger, thinking him extremely rude for disturbing their storytelling.
Looking at Master Xu's luxurious attire and Lord Mo following him, everyone knew that Master Xu was a high-ranking official.
But they didn't know how high-ranking.
Seeing Xu Xin, Daoist Buyu burst into laughter: "Let me introduce you all. This is Master Xu Xin, the current Minister of Justice!"
"Old Buyu, I advise you to be respectful to me. Whether you are locked up for ten days or ten years is up to me!"
In the back, Mo Danxin whispered, "Master Xu, that should be determined by the criminal law."
Master Xu glared back at Mo Danxin, scaring Mo Danxin into lowering his head immediately.
Master Xu then turned his gaze back to Daoist Buyu, resuming his smile.
With a demeanor befitting of an immortal, Daoist Buyu, even in jail, hadn't lost any of his aura: "So, what's it going to be? Shall we have a real fight? If I win, you let me go? If I lose, you can lock me away for as long as you want?"
Upon hearing this, Master Xu banged on the table: "Fine, it's a deal!"
Even though he had been defeated by Daoist Buyu in the Golden Core Stage, Nascent Soul Stage, and Divinity Transformation Stage.
But now, as the esteemed Minister of Justice, having suppressed countless vicious criminals, and considering his cultivation level and practical experience, he was nothing like Daoist Buyu!
Master Xu pulled open the chains locking the prison cell and opened the cell door: "Come out!"
Daoist Buyu gave a faint smile, then said to Mo Danxin: "Lord Mo, you witnessed it, didn't you? I wanted to break out of jail, and Master Xu agreed to my jailbreak plan, even personally opening the jail door for me. I am the principal offender; he is the accessory. You should lock him up as well."
Upon seeing this, Mo Danxin pondered for two seconds, moved forward, and motioned Master Xu with a 'please' gesture.
"The Sect Leader of Seek Dao Sect is making sense, Master Xu, you are blatantly breaking the law in front of me, after you."
Xu Xin: "..."
Old Buyu, even if you're in jail, you're still screwing me over!

chapters.title: Chapter 287 - 286: The Minister of Justice Should Also Go to Prison_1
chapters.content:
Daoist Buyu, whose real name is Ye Wanli, is 2220 years old and currently serves as the Sect Leader of Seek Dao Sect. During his detention, he attempted to escape but stopped himself wilfully, which is deemed as cessation of crime. Moreover, he turned himself in voluntarily, showing signs of confession and repentance. He also reported on other culprits involved.
According to the criminal law, he should be punished less severely, or even be exempted from criminal punishment.
Xu Xin, 2232 years old, is currently the Minister of Justice for the Great Xia Dynasty. During his work in Goose County, he openly conspired with Daoist Buyu for a jailbreak plan, voluntarily opened the jail cell that set Daoists Buyu free. His lawless behavior, in contempt of the law and public jailbreak, caused a terrible social impact and warranted serious punishment.
Mo Danxin silently evaluated Daoist Buyu and the Minister of Justice.
As expected of the Sect Leader of Seek Dao Sect, at the first meeting, he sent one Minister, who is the most proficient in law, to the prison.
"Master Xu, please come in. I will open a trial for this case another day."
According to jurisdiction stipulations, Mo Danxin was qualified to handle this case.
Master Xu could claim to be the person who was most conversant with the laws of the dynasty. He possessed far more understanding of both legal theory and practice than Mo Danxin. However, Old Buyu was too cunning and lured him into opening the cell door. He impulsively complied, oblivious to the underlying scheme.
Typically, releasing a person would cause no stir, but this time it was different. Mo Danxin persisted in nitpicking, and Xu couldn't justify his actions.
Since he was in the wrong, it's best to obediently spend some time behind bars. Just think of it as a life lesson.
Master Xu snorted coldly and walked into the jail cell. He gave the dignified Daoist Buyu a glance and said, "Move aside, this is my spot!"
"It's just spending time in jail, who's afraid?"
There's a saying among us all that every cell is fully occupied except Daoist Buyu's.
Daoist Buyu wasn't bothered. He moved aside, happily welcoming Master Xu to share his cell.
"Master Xu, we will now be brothers who have shared a jail cell. Let's try to coexist peacefully."
"Old Buyu, I think you're courting death!"
Master Xu landed a punch on Daoist Buyu's face, who dodged by moving his head over to the side.
Daoist Buyu was not an easy target; if he didn't retaliate against Xu's assault, his reputation would be tarnished.
He kicked Master Xu's crotch, causing Xu to snap his legs shut, trapping Daoist Buyu's foot in between.
Both showed "perfect" precision when controlling their power, with not a shred of wastage. All the force was directed at the opponent and no excess was detected.
The two mighty powers, at the peak of their Unification stage, began to brawl in the cell, each having their moments of triumph.
The inmates were amazed; they didn't expect to witness a fight between two Unification stage powers that day.
Mo Danxin was silent upon witnessing this scene. Assault inside the prison did not violate the criminal law, and maintaining order inside the prison was the jailers' responsibility – not his.
If he added up the cultivation levels of Daoist Buyu and the Minister of Justice into the average cultivation level of all the inmates, he realized there's a Divinity Transformation Stage average. A new historical high.
"Lord Mo, someone outside is requesting a prison visit," a jailer reported breathlessly to Mo Danxin.
Mo Danxin waved his hand, sounding a bit impatient: "Such trivial matters aren't worth talking to me about. Let them in."
God knows how many people visit the prison every day. They said they were visiting, but they were actually just delivering food. Some who brought food would loiter, squatting at the prison cell entrance to listen to Daoist Buyu's stories.
Mo Danxin assumed it was another one of these cases.
The jailer obeyed Mo Danxin's command and signaled to his companion at the prison entrance to let the visitors in.
"By the way, who are they here to visit?" Mo Danxin asked on a whim.
"The visitors claim to be the first and fourth disciples of the Seek Dao Sect, here to visit their Sect Leader."
When Mo Danxin heard the jailer utter the phrase "the Sect Leader of the Seek Dao Sect's first disciple", he failed to notice the two Unification stage powers in the cell stop fighting, horror flickering in their eyes.
"You invited Yun Zhi over?!" Master Xu, an old official, knew of Yun Zhi's reputation. How might the disciple see him with his master while he's battered him in front of her?
Daoist Buyu also panicked: "Nonsense! I wrote to my sect, asking them to get me out of here, but only the fourth disciple usually comes. Who knew that Yun Zhi would come this time!"
He couldn't explain why he was terrified of Yun Zhi's appearance.
"So the Seek Dao Sect has finally sent someone." Mo Danxin did not recognize Yun Zhi, but decided to be polite. "I'll go and welcome them."
"There's no need, Lord Mo, we're already here." Yun Zhi's aloof voice rang out. Before Mo Danxin could respond, Yun Zhi and Lu Yang were already standing in front of him.
Shrinking Ground into Inches.
"We are here to visit our Master. Where is he?"
Mo Danxin pointed at the neighboring cell.
Following the direction of Mo Danxin's hand, Yun Zhi saw her Master, Daoist Buyu, sitting in the corner and Minister of Justice adjacent him.
She was silent for a long time, struggling to comprehend what has happened.
Did the Sect Leader and the Minister of Justice have a brawl on the street and got arrested by the authorities?
Considering her Master's previous offenses and his relationship with the Minister of Justice, this scenario didn't seem impossible.
"Eldest Senior Sister, who's locked up with our master?" Lu Yang softly asked. He thought Master Xu seemed refined, exuding a presence that could match even Buyu's. Xu must be a significant figure as well.
"The Minister of Justice, Xu Xin."
"Gasp—"
Lu Yang thought to himself, is the legal system of the Great Xia Dynasty so impeccable that even the Minister of Justice could get incarcerated? I need to be careful not to end up in prison like the Master someday.
Lu Yang was resolved to study the law diligently after returning, hoping to avoid any trouble with the law in the future.
Yun Zhi spoke with an aloof tone, looking at her Master with disdain: "It has been a few months since we last met, dear Master. You are as vibrant as ever, surrounded by an eager crowd and accompanied by enemies. It seems you are living quite leisurely here in prison. I, your disciple, can rest assured."
Lu Yang whispered, are you sure you're not doing this intentionally, Eldest Senior Sister? You just dragged me out for a meal, and you even ate more than I did - did you show any concern about the Master's situation?
But it's true. The Master doesn't need to be looked after – the ones who suffer are the people he scams.
Seeing Yun Zhi's attitude that implied she was ready to leave him high and dry, Daoist Buyu hurriedly spoke: "My dear apprentice, you can't abandon me! I'm innocent!"
The Minister of Justice, with ample experience in determining innocence or guilt, suggested: "According to the records from the Great Yu Dynasty, if an innocent man is beheaded, it will snow in June. Since it's currently June, I suggest we behead Old Buyu first and see if it snows!"
"Xu Xin, you son of a bitch! As Minister of Justice, can you act impartially?" Daoist Buyu said angrily.
"I could, but not for you — given you've deceived me so many times."
The fight between two Unification stage practitioners resumed in the small space.
Yun Zhi rubbed her temples in agony. She originally planned to go out to relax. Why can't she ever live in peace?

chapters.title: Chapter 288 - 287: Ancestor of Thief Sect_1
chapters.content:
"Lord Mo, for what reason is my master behind bars this time? Was it for refusing to pay at a brothel, or was he accused of feigning injury in a street corner accident, or did he secretly sell the 'Wish Granting Technique: Local Version' again?"
Master claimed to be wronged, but Yun Zhi was skeptical.
After nearly a thousand years of staying with her master, Yun Zhi knew when to trust him and when not to trust him.
"Eldest Senior Sister, when should we believe Master?" Lu Yang curiously asked.
"When Master is silent."
"And when should we not believe him?"
"When Master talks."
Lu Yang: "…"
Upon hearing this, the Minister of Justice excitedly slapped his thigh; Yun Zhi's words struck a chord with him.
No wonder her Cultivation level was so high, she had an analytical ability that he couldn't match.
If he didn't listen to the nonsense Old Buyu spouted, wouldn't everything be fine?
If he had heard this summary before, he wouldn't be squatting in the same cell as Old Buyu now.
Lord Mo shakes his head, "None of those. Based on our investigation, Daoist Buyu has been in Goose County for over ten days. During these days, he has been well-behaved. In the afternoon, he narrates the 'Legend of the Dao Sect' in tea houses. His sessions are always packed with people, and he concludes each one with 'To be continued in the next session,' leaving many people sighing in anticipation.
At night, he ponders how to proceed with the 'Legend of the Dao Sect,' living a rather fulfilling life."
Lu Yang was astonished. Turns out the stories Master tells are all improvised?
Lu Yang reckons his ability to make stuff up is as good as Meng Jingzhou's, but he wasn't capable of doing what Daoist Buyu did, creating the story the night before and then telling it the next day.
"So you wrote the 'Legend of the Dao Sect'!" Master Xu looked at Daoist Buyu in surprise.
The 'Legend of the Dao Sect' is very popular, even the tea houses in the Imperial City recount the tale, and he had listened to it when he was bored.
What he heard was the story of the nine descendants of the Dao Sect, which contained a lot of embellishments about Daoist Buyu, which greatly displeased him, so he stopped listening.
The other officials in the capital felt the same way. They went to listen out of curiosity, but found it hard to accept after listening, so they didn't listen anymore.
However, the common people enjoyed it very much. Although Daoist Buyu's story was exaggerated to the point of fantasy, it was still a story of cultivation, and the story of a top sect.
The various behaviors of the cultivators depicted in the story, combined with the vibrant narratives, were fascinating and very appealing.
"Do you have any shame, does your story have any relation to you other than the name!" Master Xu glanced at Daoist Buyu with a face full of disdain.
"That's called appropriate beautification." Daoist Buyu said this without the slightest shame.
Lord Mo continued, "Three days ago, the monthly Cultivation Market opened and Daoist Buyu set up a small stall in a corner, selling a method for improving movement speed. He claimed that the 'Ancestor of the Thief Sect,' who was famous for his speed, had practiced this method."
"When people found out they had been tricked, they demanded a refund and argued with him. He denied all accusations, insisting that his method was genuine."
"After a fruitless argument, people reported him. Upon examination, I concluded his method was fake and sentenced him to ten days of administrative detention."
Fairy Eternity, unfamiliar with some terms, knocked on Lu Yang's spiritual space for help, "Lu Yang, who is the ancestor of the Thief Sect?"
As Fairy Eternity's golden finger, Lu Yang did indeed have all the answers, "Regarding the ancestor of the Thief Sect, I have a rough idea. Fairy, you should know that there are over three thousand heterodox sects and one of them is the Thief Sect."
Fairy Eternity nodded, signaling Lu Yang to continue.
"The Thief Sect once had an extraordinary thief whose speed was incomparable, reaching a height that his predecessors could not reach. His speed was unmatched in the world. His existence fundamentally changed the Thief Sect, before and after him. Those in the Thief Sect respectfully called him the Ancestor of the Thief Sect, while the people usually referred to him as Thief Ancestor."
"The speed of the Thief Ancestor was so fast that he could come and go freely even in the royal palace, stealing numerous Spirit Stones and magic artifacts. His boldest move was stealing the palace's gate. The court was furious but had no way to deal with the Thief Ancestor."
