"So what happened to the Thief Ancestor?" the Fairy Eternity was excited. She had never sparred with a cultivator known for his speed. If she ever encountered one, she would definitely have a go.
Lu Yang shook his head, "That's a mystery. Nobody knows what happened to the Thief Ancestor in the end. Some say he achieved freedom from worldly desires, some say he retired from worldly affairs due to disillusionment, and others say that he failed in his attempt to reach the Immortal stage and perished."
Speaking of the Thief Ancestor, Lu Yang couldn't help but think of another character, the second speedster after the Thief Ancestor- the Thief King.
The speed of the Thief King was so fast that he could go wherever he pleased in the world, violating the teachings of the Thief Sect and stealing from the Land Money Trade Association, then vanishing without a trace.
In reality, Daoist Buyu still insisted he was wronged, "Really, if you practice the method I sold, you will absolutely be as fast as the Thief Ancestor, you will be unmatched in the world!"
Yun Zhi was silent for a moment, recalling something and then asked, "Lord Mo, can we see the method my master sold?"
"Of course." Mo Danxin called his subordinate to fetch the confiscated evidence from the yamen office.
Shortly after, his subordinate, out of breath, brought over a thin, very old book that looked like a cultivation method unearthed from a cemetery.
No wonder some cultivators were deceived into buying this book. This book does look intimidating at first glance.
Lord Mo added, "Daoist Buyu sold a total of ten copies of this method. The contents of the ten were all the same, and have all been seized. This is one of them."
Yun Zhi opened the first page, and Lu Yang also leaned over curiously to take a look.
The first page of the ancient book read: To practice this method, first break a leg.
Daoist Buyu spread his hands, "See, I told you. Practice this method and you can be sure to be as unrivaled as the Thief Ancestor!"
Lu Yang: "…"
Master, you really are not wronged at all!
You're still claiming to be wronged? Even a year or two would not be too much!
Lu Yang roughly understood why his master was the strongest beneath the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
If his Cultivation level was slightly weaker, he would have been beaten to death long ago.
Yun Zhi looked a bit odd, "The Thief Ancestor indeed only had one leg, so no one disputed when he claimed his speed was unmatched."
"That is true. I've heard of this too." The Minister of Justice nodded.
A phrase Yun Zhi didn't say was that after looking through this ancient book and doing some rudimentary extrapolation, she found that if one practiced this method, it seemed like they really could achieve the fastest speed of their realm.
So is this really the method that the Thief Ancestor practiced?

chapters.title: Chapter 289 - 288: This is a Humble Abode, Only my Virtue is Fragrant_1
chapters.content:
"So, are you saying that I made a wrong judgement?"
If only Yun Zhi claimed that the goods Daoist Buyu sold were genuine, Mo Danxin would find it implausible.
But with Xu Xin's endorsement, the credibility increases substantially.
Daoist Buyu laughed heartily with delight. Even though his rescuer was not the Fourth Elder but his beloved disciple Yun Zhi, it didn't matter who it was, as long as they were able to rescue him, "No matter, no matter, as long as Lord Mo realizes he was wrong it's fine, I don't need any compensation from the court, I just want to be released."
According to the laws of the dynasty, Mo Danxin represented the court. His wrong judgement of Daoist Buyu was equivalent to the court making a mistake, and the court had to pay compensation.
Mo Danxin shook his head: "It's still impossible. You just attempted to escape from prison, and even though it was halted, you still need to be locked up."
Daoist Buyu: "..."
"Then Master, take care of yourself. I will take Junior Brother home now." Having successfully cleared her master's name, Yun Zhi was able to leave with peace of mind.
"Wait! I haven't been let out yet!" Daoist Buyu quickly called out to stop Yun Zhi.
Yun Zhi cupped her hands, showing a touch of reverence in her words: "Master often says, 'A mountain does not have to be high to be famous, it gains fame if it's home to a fairy. A water doesn't have to be deep to be spiritual, it becomes spiritual if it's home to a dragon.
A house does not have to be fancy to be good, it is good if it's occupied by someone of virtue.' Although the prison conditions are crude, with a person of such noble spirit as master, the environment of the prison is not crude."
Hearing the familiar words, Daoist Buyu's memory travelled back hundreds of years.
Hundreds of years ago, when Daoist Buyu just took Yun Zhi as his disciple, he taught her on Sky Gate Mountain. Back then, Sky Gate Mountain only had Daoist Buyu, and the huge mountain only had one house. When Yun Zhi arrived, she needed a house too, so Daoist Buyu, feeling lazy, randomly built a crude wooden hut.
Facing Yun Zhi's innocent eyes, Daoist Buyu gently patted her head, with a kindly look:
"A mountain does not have to be high to be famous, it gains fame if it's home to a fairy. A water doesn't have to be deep to be spiritual, it becomes spiritual if it's home to a dragon. A house does not have to be fancy to be good; it is good if it's occupied by someone of virtue. The last sentence means that someone with noble character won't mind the crude conditions of the house.
Little Yun is a good kid who won't mind the simplicity of the wooden hut and the magnitude of the mountain, right?"
"Yes!" Little Yun Zhi clenched her fist and nodded vigorously.
...
Now, the consequences are here.
Looking at Yun Zhi, who was leaving decisively, Daoist Buyu's mood slumped.
Shortly after, Lu Yang returned to the large cell at a jog, and reinvigorated Daoist Buyu.
"Good disciple, did Xiao Yun ask you to come?"
Lu Yang nodded.
Daoist Buyu cheered up and said: "Good disciple, I didn't expect you to have formed the golden core, and reached the First-Grade. It's my fault that I didn't educate you well before. Once I get out, I will definitely guide you on your Cultivation!"
Lu Yang scratched his head awkwardly: "Eldest Senior Sister asked me to deliver food."
"...Well, delivering food is also good."
As Lu Yang spoke, he took out a set of meal boxes from the Storage Ring. He hadn't even lifted the lid, but the fragrant aroma was already noticeable, which caused the fasting Daoist Buyu to sniff, recognizing it as the food from the best restaurant in Goose County.
Then Lu Yang placed each meal box in front of the other prison cells, and by the time he got to Daoist Buyu, he had run out.
"What about mine?" Daoist Buyu was dumbfounded. He was drooling at the smell of the food.
Lu Yang honestly said: "Eldest Senior Sister said that bullying often happens in prison. She was worried that you being old and weak would be bullied, so she asked me to order food from Ju Yuan Lou and give it to your cellmates so they won't bully you."
Daoist Buyu: "..."
The Minister of Justice nodded repeatedly from the side. The unstoppable Daoist Buyu finally was restrained by his own disciple.
Well done!
Upon finishing the food delivery, Lu Yang left the large prison and met up with Yun Zhi at the city gate of Goose County.
Yun Zhi summoned a lucky cloud with a gesture to the sky, and the cloud descended to support the two of them.
Strangely, despite Yun Zhi and Lu Yang's conspicuous actions in the public view, with countless passing pedestrians, none of them paid attention here, as if Yun Zhi and Lu Yang didn't exist.
Aboard the lucky cloud, Lu Yang curiously asked, "Eldest Senior Sister, is the technique Master brought out the same one that Daozu cultivated?"
Lu Yang learned from Fairy Eternity that this technique was extraordinary and not something of the mortal world.
Yun Zhi stood on the cloud, looking down at the blue sky. The sunlight shone through the clouds and formed a beam of light penetrating the cloud.
Yun Zhi withdrew her gaze and slowly said: "Considering the relationship between Daozu and Master, it should be the same technique Daozu cultivated."
"The relationship between Daozu and Master?"
"Daozu and Master are friends who forget their age difference. Daozu should have wanted to take a person of destiny as a disciple, and asked Master to release the first quarter of his technique. Whoever can cultivate the first quarter, Daozu would take as disciple."
"So, Daozu has not passed away or fallen, he is still alive?"
"He is doing very well."
...
After Yun Zhi and Lu Yang left, Mo Danxin pondered for a long time and decided that it wasn't good to keep the Minister of Justice locked up here.
It wasn't about fear of offending the Minister of Justice, but the Ministry of Punishments had many affairs that required the Minister of Justice's decision. Even if he were locked up for ten days or half a month, the Ministry of Punishments would be in a mess.
"I remember there should be a law for exoneration... I found it."
Mo Danxin flipped through the penal code and found a clause listing six situations in which criminal responsibility would not be pursued:
One of them basically said that if, after an interpretation by the Ministry of Punishments, it was deemed unnecessary to pursue criminal responsibility, then the suspect won't be prosecuted.
The local government does not have the authority to decide whether to pursue criminal charges, only the Ministry of Punishments does.
Mo Danxin wrote out the situation and had it urgently sent to the Ministry of Punishments.
...
The second in command at the Ministry of Punishments, the Vice Minister, soon received an inquiry from Goose County, stating that there was a local official who knowingly violated the law, openly aiding a criminal in prison break. But considering the importance of this official, they requested exemption from criminal responsibility.
The Vice Minister snorted coldly: "I heard that this Mo Danxin is known as Justice Mo. Seeing him today, he is nothing special. An official who knowingly violates the law should be dealt with even more strictly. Where is the talk of exemption? It's utterly ridiculous!"
"I don't know whether this official has backing in Imperial City, or he has given gifts to Mo Danxin."
"Exemption requires the approval of Master Xu. Even if I agree, Master Xu will not!"
"Let me see which official has such a big face to dare to violate the law knowingly... Master Xu?!"
The Vice Minister rubbed his eyes, reciting the calming mantra three times, and looked again at the statement from Goose County. He wondered if he was still not awake.
"I heard that Master Xu suddenly disappeared on his way to a banquet yesterday, it turned out he was in a rush to go to jail?"
The Vice Minister looked puzzled. According to the penal code, his superior, the Minister of Justice, had to approve the exemption from criminal responsibility.
Master Xu would definitely approve.
But the problem was that Master Xu was the party involved in this case. According to the penal code, he had to abstain from making a decision.

chapters.title: Chapter 290 - 289: Meng Jingzhou Forms the Golden Core_1
chapters.content:
The life of law lies in its execution, and the enforcement of law helps to stabilize the destiny of the Great Xia.
As a result, few dare to violate the laws of Great Xia, especially the most severe criminal law.
Although the law needs to be strictly enforced, there will always be unforeseen events that are punishable by law, but logically shouldn't receive a punishment.
In such cases, the criminal law grants the Ministry of Punishments the power to avoid responsibility, delegating this power to the Minister of Justice.
Theoretically, this power is an easy escape route for the royal family from justice.
In practice however, such situations occur very rarely, due primarily to the supervision power of the Five Great Immortal Sects that prevents the Minister of Justice from acting rashly.
But a circumstance that even the original legislators wouldn't have predicted transpired––the Minister of Justice was thrown in jail.
In the Yangxin Hall, Emperor Xia massaged his painful brow.
Why is it always when the Seek Dao Sect is involved, always something new and perplexing happens?
He received two pieces of news; one was that Yun Zhi's exploration of the Immortal Secret Realm had concluded, revealing a nonexistent Fire Dynasty. This wasn't urgent, he could slowly investigate the matter about the Fire Dynasty.
As for Yun Zhi's request to move the ancient immortal's abode from the Immortal Relic back to the Seek Dao Sect, he agreed.
The second piece of news was that the Minister of Justice was thrown in jail, alongside Daoist Buyu.
If the Minister of Justice dared to directly leave the jail, Daoist Buyu wouldn't hesitate to publicly accuse the Great Xia Dynasty of perverting the law.
If Daoist Buyu dared to directly leave the jail, the Minister of Justice would intercept him, ensuring he couldn't escape.
Stalemate.
"Should I pardon Xu Xin?" Emperor Xia murmured to himself. As the emperor, he naturally has the power of amnesty.
After some thought, he abandoned that idea, instead issuing another order.
"The entire Ministry of Punishments, move to the Goose County for duty."
...
"So, this is why you came to visit me in jail?" Master Xu stared unhappily at several subordinates, looking quite furious.
"The emperor has decreed, we must comply." The vice-minister of the Ministry of Punishment tried to keep a straight face, but the scene was too ridiculous. He and his colleagues could barely contain their laughter.
Daoist Buyu was squatting aside. Naturally, they should greet him. but looking at Master Xu's livid face, they didn't dare to act.
"Master Xu, these are the documents from the last two days. Please review them," the vice-minister respectfully handed over several documents that required Master Xu's attention.
Master Xu grunted: "Leave it here."
Originally, the vice-minister wanted to say something such as "Wait for a few days. As soon as the emperor's amusement runs out, he will pardon you," or "Do you need food and bedding?" But in the end, he didn't utter a word.
After his subordinates left the jail, Master Xu picked up the documents from the floor and reviewed them.
He frowned. He wasn't pleased.
"Nonsense, it took me quite a while to propose this policy, and its feasibility has been trialed successfully in several counties and the results have been good. How could there be a mistake?"
Daoist Buyu glanced at the document and roughly understood the course of events. The document suggested a policy which was useless and had increased the workload of the counties. They suggested simplifying the policy, but this policy was something Xu Xin was proud of––how could he allow someone else to point out its errors?
He chuckled mockingly, in Xu Xin's ears it sounded like ridicule: "Are you some saint, Xu Xin, infallible? If you're so capable, why don't you become the emperor?"
He became even more upset, and gave Daoist Buyu a cold look. Had it been some subordinates of Xu Xin, they would have gone quiet. But Daoist Buyu wasn't scared of Xu Xin at all.
Poor casualty under Golden Core, Nascent Soul, and Spirit Transformation in previous fights.
Daoist Buyu, who has seen and known much, having extensive criminal experience, and his understanding of legal theory is certainly no less than Master Xu's.
"...Have you ever considered legislative interpretation, what the legislators initially intended..."
"...Law is backward-looking, you've forgotten..."
"...Stop taking the theory route, what is the reality..."
Both sides debated intensely without giving in, and even set up a soundproof array method to prevent other prisoners from overhearing their conversation.
Finally, Master Xu's tone wasn't as sharp as before, and the more he spoke, the weaker he became. He had to admit that Daoist Buyu made sense.
"Shut up, let me think!"
Master Xu lowered his head in thought, Old Buyu might be unreliable normally, but he was always serious when it came to these matters.
This was the outcome Emperor Xia desired.
While Xu Xin worked tirelessly for the sake of the nation, trying to fill the gaps in the law, some of his decisions were not suitable after all.
Emperor Xia had no recourse to this. Xu Xin's understanding of the laws of the Great Xia Dynasty were almost unparalleled, which made almost no one qualified enough to debate with him.
Even Emperor Xia couldn't definitively say whether Xu Xin was right or wrong, and only felt that he was somehow inappropriate, but he didn't know how to improve.
Fortunately, Daoist Buyu was well versed in the law with rich life-experiences, making him best suited to debate with Xu Xin.
Emperor Xia took this opportunity to allow the two to debate.
Once Xu Xin recognizes his true objective, he can then be pardoned.
...
When Yun Zhi and Lu Yang returned to the Seek Dao Sect, they ran into Meng Jingzhou who had just returned from the Secret Realm.
He had a moment of clarity in the forest, and as soon as he returned to Demon Suppressing Pass, he formed a golden core. He left Tao Yaoye and Man Gu to continue searching for their own opportunities while he returned to the Seek Dao Sect alone.
As for running into boasting young masters of influential families and being disguised to give a piece of his mind on his way back, it wasn't worth mentioning.
"Haha, who would have thought? I've formed a golden core too!"
Meng Jingzhou began boasting the moment he saw Lu Yang.
Although he didn't know which Golden Core Lu Yang formed, he was confident that his was the strongest, unbeatable by anyone.
"Let me tell you, my golden core is unprecedented. I'm about to break the fate of the Single Body Spiritual Root!"
Meng Jingzhou looked exuberant, not like he had just formed a golden core, but as though he had just become a powerhouse on the Transcendence Tribulation Stage. He was so overbearing that he couldn't even be bothered to take detours.
Lu Yang was very surprised and didn't try to hide it: "You have such ability? Which golden core did you form?"
Meng Jingzhou chuckled and invited Lu Yang to have tea in a teahouse. The two drank tea while he showed off.
"I'm not a Single Body Spiritual Root, as long as I want to form the core, I will naturally be able to form a Single Golden Elixir."
Lu Yang nodded his head. The first Single-Body Spiritual Root, Careful Solitary Daoist's heart of forming Golden core was the same.
"You formed a Single Golden Elixir?"
Meng Jingzhou didn't answer. He placed a tea cup on the table: "This is a person, single!"
He then placed another tea cup: "This is also a person, single!"
He brought the two cups together, producing a clear porcelain collision sound, and then spoke of his long-thought conclusion: "If two singles come together, doesn't that make a couple?"
"So?"
"So I formed two Single Golden Elixirs!"

chapters.title: Chapter 291 - 290: The Art of Equivalent Exchange_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang's body leaned back slightly, seemingly startled by Meng Jingzhou's Golden Core.
Two single golden cores, even Shi Dudao did not dare to have such a thing, it was truly unprecedented.
He organized his words in his heart, expressing gently, "Two single Golden Cores, are you sure it won't make your singleness more intense?"
Meng Jingzhou nonchalantly waved his hand, "You don't understand, it's like when something reaches the extreme, it turns to the other extreme. My golden core has reached the extreme of singleness, now it should turn towards a good direction, become more lucky with women. This was apparent when I was flying back on the flying ship."
"What happened then?"
"While on the flying ship, there was an upstart from a small place bullying others just because he has some spare change. I didn't like it. I flashed my identity as the Young Master of the Meng Family, which scared him so much that he knelt and begged for mercy. At that moment, several decent-looking women gathered around me, attracted by my charm."
"...you've hypnotized yourself quite intensely."
As if he hasn't heard Lu Yang's sarcasm, Meng Jingzhou's eyes were glowing, as if a bright future was right before him, "Anyway, I have broken the curse of being single in every generation of Single Body Spiritual Root and I'm about to start a new life!"
"Eh, this little guy's golden core is interesting." Fairy Eternity's voice rang out at just the right moment, successfully drawing Lu Yang's attention.
"Fairy, what do you mean?" Lu Yang wondered if Meng Jingzhou had indeed broken the curse of Single Body Spiritual Root from previous generations?
"Have you heard of a kind of curse magic skill?" Fairy Eternity asked mysteriously.
Lu Yang shook his head. Besides the curse Fairy Eternity put on the Ancient Barbarian Tribe, he hadn't heard of any curse magic skill.
"This magic skill, although called a curse, is essentially an exchange, or a rule. Some people call it the 'Equivalent Exchange Spell'. Using this type of magic skill, you lose something and gain something else."
"For instance, you, Lu Yang, are very smart, right? So, you can use the Equivalent Exchange Spell, reduce your intelligence to gain unmatched combat power!"
"That's amazing!" Lu Yang was quite astonished.
Fairy Eternity was very pleased with Lu Yang's astonishment: "Hehe, now you know how knowledgeable I am. I presume no one in your era knows this spell, you're the first!"
"Fairy, do you know this spell?" Lu Yang showed great interest in the spell. If he could learn it, wouldn't he be able to exchange whatever he wanted and thus be invincible?
Fairy Eternity shook her head, pouring cold water on Lu Yang: "No one can learn this spell. Or rather, anyone aiming to learn it will never succeed."
Lu Yang was puzzled by this strange logic. So if someone doesn't want to learn the spell, can they master it?
"Yes, the ones who don't want to learn this spell will master it."
Fairy Eternity continued: "The 'Equivalent Exchange Spell' doesn't require learning. When the opportunity comes, one naturally grasps it."
"And the practitioners often don't realize they have used this spell."
"This is like the first person in the Human Race's history to use a spell. They didn't deliberately learn or use it, but due to a combination of various factors, the spell was naturally unleashed."
"I see." Lu Yang was clearly a little disappointed, as he thought he could learn a new spell.
Suddenly, Lu Yang realized something was wrong. The topic had strayed a long way off: "Wait, weren't we discussing Meng Jingzhou's Golden Core? How did we end up discussing the Equivalent Exchange Spell?"
"We haven't deviated. I didn't think about it earlier as it wasn't very obvious. But now that I look at it, this Meng kid has already used the Equivalent Exchange Spell."
"How?"
Fairy Eternity carefully analyzed, unravelling the secret of the Single Body Spiritual Root: "Why is the Single Body Spiritual Root strong? It's because it sacrifices its singleness to gain incredible cultivation talent and strength, which is a bona fide Equivalent Exchange Spell!"
"If a typical Single Body Spiritual Root has a relationship with a woman, the price is losing its pure Yang body and its Cultivation Level will no longer increase. But if it undergoes enhancement by two single Golden Cores as this Meng Kid did, then if he has a relationship with a woman, his Cultivation Level will plummet!"
"This Meng kid strengthened the 'singles' property of his spiritual root, exchanging his resolve with an unbeatable power blindly. Among all Single Body Spiritual Roots in previous generations, he should be the strongest!"
Lu Yang's eyelid twitched in consideration. If Meng Jingzhou knew about this, he would be regretting it deeply. He kindly asked, "Is there a solution?"
"Yes. The Equivalent Exchange Spell cannot manifest in an Immortal. If the Meng kid became an Immortal, it would solve the problem."
"..."
Regardless of whether Meng Jingzhou could become an Immortal, if he could, it would still take a monkey's age to cultivate into one, right?
Dating back to the Great Era, only five immortals emerged. No one knows how many there have been in the past 300,000 years and the Eldest Senior Sister did not tell him.
Reaching Immortality was harder than reaching the sky.
Lu Yang pondered, "So, Meng Jingzhou exchanged the happiness of his lower body for powerful strength for the rest of his life."
Impressive.
"Hmm, why are you looking at me with such eyes?" Meng Jingzhou felt Lu Yang's gaze towards him was strange, hard to describe... was it pity?
Meng Jingzhou stretched lazily, "I've just formed the Golden Core, and haven't had enough fighting in the forest. Watch me go to the arena."
Having formed an unprecedented pair of single Golden Cores, he naturally had to show off a bit.
Before Lu Yang even reacted, Meng Jingzhou settled the bill and left, heading towards the bustling arena not far away.
At this time, the fight on the arena had just ended. Both fighters stepped down, and Meng Jingzhou jumped onto the stage, radiant like a small sun, "Haha, I've just formed the Golden Core. Which senior brother or sister wants to have a match?"
Meng Jingzhou felt that being at the Foundation Establishment Stage before, he couldn't beat his senior brothers and sisters. Now that they were all at the Golden Core Stage, he couldn't still possibly lose, right?
"I'll come." A bald senior brother, who appeared to have partially formed a Golden Body in the Buddhism Sect, jumped onto the arena, smiled kindly, "Senior Brother Meng, please show mercy."
The bald senior brother was named Zheng Jing, whose Cultivation Level was at the late Golden Core Stage, not standing out among the numerous Golden Core Stage senior brothers.
"Haha, Senior Brother, don't hold back. I'm not the same person anymore." Meng Jingzhou laughed heartily.
Soon, Lu Yang used his Wooden Avatar to lift Meng Jingzhou down from the stage with a stretcher.
"A perfectly good person, why insist on inviting death?" Lu Yang sighed, feeling glad he had the Invincible Elixir, which allowed him to know who he could beat and who he couldn't.
Otherwise, he could end up like Meng Jingzhou, being carried off the stage.
If Meng Jingzhou was still in the Foundation Establishment Stage, Senior Brother Zheng wouldn't have been so harsh. Now that Meng Jingzhou had formed his Golden Core and had increased strength and recovery rate, Senior Brother Zheng naturally hit harder.
As Lu Yang was about to carry Meng Jingzhou away, three figures blocked their way.
Lu Yang looked up and recognized these familiar faces: Master Liu and Master Gao from the barbecue shop.
"Please come with us."

chapters.title: Chapter 292 - 291: Don't push your luck, you two!_1
chapters.content:
Meng Jingzhou, seeing the situation, no longer pretended to be ill and moaned loud, he sharply got up from the stretcher.
Master Liu and Master Gao were not clad in their greasy barbecue restaurant uniform and the naive smile they wore when serving customers was not on their faces. They were in formal attire with solemn expressions, reminiscing the glorious days of the Eternity Sect.
The way they looked at Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou gave them chills down their spine, feeling utterly cold.
"Gentlemen, come with us for a while. We need your help with something," they said.
Master Liu and Master Gao had confirmed that after Lu Yang and Yun Zhi returned, Yun Zhi left the Seek Dao Sect for unknown reasons. It was a godsent opportunity to take action against Lu Yang!
If they didn't act now, when would they?
Given the presence of too many people around, it wasn't an ideal place to take action. They needed to bring Meng Jingzhou and Lu Yang to the Eternity Sect's main clubhouse — the BBQ Again restaurant!
Previously, BBQ Again managed to hold its ground as a small shop amidst the crowded market street, surrounded by potential enemies and constantly watched by Great Powers during the Unification Stage. Their situation was precarious.
However, after being guided by the Sect Master and Immortal Eternity along with meticulous planning by high-ranking members of the Eternity Sect, the restaurant grew under a win-at-all-cost strategy and became a stronghold of the Eternity Sect.
Meanwhile, the Seek Dao Sect remained oblivious to the fact that BBQ Again was steadily expanding its influence in the commercial street...
"Let's go," Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou agreed, not willing to back off.
Surrounded by two Unification-stage cultivators, they had no capacity to resist. Even if they didn't want to go, they were left with little choice than to comply or be dragged away. It was better to go willingly.
"This way, please," Master Gao gestured, inviting them to the restaurant.
Once Lu Yang stood at the entrance, he noticed that the room was pitch dark, with faint silhouettes of two people swaying in the darkness.
They stepped into the restaurant while Master Liu and Master Gao stood quietly by the door, like two iron-like statues.
Once they stepped foot into the restaurant, Lu Yang felt as if he was secluded from the outside world. He could neither hear nor see anything from the outside.
What he didn't know was that the Sect Master had laid down an unmatched Array Method in the restaurant that blocked even the Spiritual Sense.
Gradually, a sourceless light filled the restaurant, revealing the true identities of the two shadow figures. One was the Sect Master, and the other was Immortal Eternity—the duo donned in formal suits, seemingly resolute about an important decision.
"Please take your seats," the Sect Master invited them to sit down.
So, what's the matter?" Lu Yang asked coldly, unable to understand the Sect Master's intentions.
However, Lu Yang was not afraid of him, with Immortal Eternity sitting nearby.
As the ruler of the Eternity lineage, Fairy Eternity had full control over Immortal Eternity, the origin of the Eternity Sect. With this relationship, there should be no scenario where the Sect Master could make troublesome waves.
"It's just a small matter. We hope Lu Yang will help us. Given your status in the Seek Dao Sect, it should also be an easy task for you," the Sect Master proposed.
"By the way, as I've heard that both of you have recently formed your Golden Core, I've prepared a small gift accordingly. Please accept it as a token of my goodwill." The Sect Master silently pushed two boxes towards them.
He casually opened the boxes to reveal the contents—an Essence Strengthening Pill worth a fortune. The pill could consolidate their Cultivation Level during the Golden Core Stage and convert the remaining medicinal power into the foundation for future breakthroughs. No trace of medicinal effect was left in the body, ensuring no obstruction for future breakthroughs.
A magic instrument that could protect oneself from a full strike from someone in the Unification stage.
A copy of "Golden Core Stage Cultivation Experience."
Five small vials filled with True Fire, Purified Water, Breath Soil, and other Five Elements matter, which could be refined into a developmental Five Elements Artifact.
Besides these, there also were numerous precious items, none of which an ordinary Golden Core Stage cultivator could afford.
Neither of them accepted the "thin gift". Lu Yang spoke straight, "Sect Master, we are old acquaintances. Let's not beat around the bush. Speak up."
The Sect Master slowly revealed the plan he had been contemplating for a long time: "To put it simply, we aim to absorb rogue cultivators into our sect to expand our territory and increase our influence over the Great Xia dynasty, and to make people reliant on us!"
"Once achieved, we won't disappoint the two of you, and we will provide a generous gift in return!"
"You may not know, but our influence has been quietly spreading throughout the entire commercial street, all unbeknown to the Seek Dao Sect."
Lu Yang raised his eyebrow in response to the Sect Master's words. It was almost as if he was suggesting that everyone in the commercial street was under their control. If he refused, he probably wouldn't be able to leave the street.
However, he still stayed resolute: "What if we don't help you?"
"Refuse to help?" The Sect Master slowly stood up, posing like a god of mountains that had remained silent for a long time but had now awakened, imposing immense pressure on the two men.
The Sect Master squinted at the two, menacingly threatened: "I have been very courteous towards you two, we simply want to branch out BBQ Again to other places. If you ask for a mile after being given an inch, then don't blame me for bending the knee and begging you!"
The Sect Master felt he had made excellent preparations. He allowed Master Liu and Master Gao to dress formally instead of the ordinary restaurant staff uniform to respectfully invite the two over, and to greet them with a smile.
Considering that it was now June, in the scorching summer heat, he had even specifically instructed Master Liu and Master Gao to use a cooling magic skill when they saw Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, so as not to make them feel hot.
For safety's sake and to avoid any eavesdropping from competitors, he had set up an unmatched Array Method to isolate the restaurant from outside interference.
He had cleaned the restaurant from top to bottom, ensuring there was no trace of oil.
He forged two protective magic instruments during his spare time in the butchery.
The experience of the Golden Core Stage cultivation, written by Immortal Eternity himself, was a summary based on all the memories of the Eternity Sect members.
The Five Elements were procured by visiting each commercial street shop-owner one by one, pleading and persuading them to sell the items.
To open a branch in other places was just a matter of speaking the words. Weren't these two satisfied?
The Sect Master was determined that a gentleman could bend and stretch. For the long-term plans of the barbecue restaurant, it was worth begging on his knees if necessary!
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou hastily stopped the Sect Master, confused by the abrupt change: "You want to open more branches for the barbecue restaurant?"
"Yes."
"And you just mentioned about absorbing rogue cultivators?"
"Recruiting waitstaff."
They couldn't leave the Seek Dao Sect to go outside to open branches, so they had to recruit waitstaff.
"What about expanding your operation?"
"Opening the barbecue restaurant outside the Seek Dao Sect."
"Increasing your influence over the Great Xia dynasty?"
"Becoming a significant taxpayer."
"Making people incapable of leaving you?"
"Attracting more customers to our shop."
Meng Jingzhou looked at the Sect Master with suspicion: "You also claimed that your influence has spread throughout the commercial street, and the Seek Dao Sect is completely ignorant about it?"
"We underreported our income and paid lower management fees."
Immortal Eternity added from the side: "Another layer of meaning is that our barbecue restaurant's income within the Seek Dao Sect has already saturated. We need to open branches outside to expand into new markets."
Lu Yang: "....."
Meng Jingzhou: "....."
Did you have to make opening a restaurant branch this complicated?

chapters.title: Chapter 293 - 292: The 2nd Head and 3rd Head_1
chapters.content:
"You didn't just fail to pay the management fee, did you?" Lu Yang squinted his eyes, recalling that the Eldest Senior Sister had demanded that they pay the fee, and turn over all the remaining profit from the barbecue shop.
There was plenty of room to play with this scenario, like the barbecue shop working in collaboration with other shops, where a portion of the other shops' profit went to the barbecue shop without Eldest Senior Sister's knowledge.
They could also use the profits of the barbecue shop to buy assets, without turning them over to Eldest Senior Sister, and then selling the assets whenever they needed Spirit Stones.
Lu Yang, with a bit of thinking, could come up with several ways to dodge the bullet. He didn't believe that the Master couldn't think of any.
The Master was breaking out in a cold sweat. He hadn't expected to accidentally let slip such a crucial piece of information.
"You two could be taking 30% of the barbecue shop's profit."
Lu Yang remained unmoved: "All of it must be handed over to Eldest Senior Sister, down to the last penny. You're already Ghouls, unable to cultivate, so what use is a Spirit Stone to you?"
He was backed by the Eldest Senior Sister and Fairy Eternity. Whatever he needed, Eldest Senior Sister would provide, and Fairy Eternity herself had plenty of contribution points. If he needed to use them, Fairy Eternity would give them to him.
He didn't need to profit from the barbecue shop.
What's more, if he turned over all profits from the barbecue shop to Eldest Senior Sister, who usually didn't bother with the books, wouldn't the profit still end up in his own pocket?
Not to mention Meng Jingzhou, who, as the Young Master of the Meng Family, has always been worried about having too much money.
"If you refuse these terms, I'm reporting your Spirit Stone hoarding to Eldest Senior Sister right now. You can guess how she might react upon hearing this."
The Master broke out in a cold sweat. As a Ghoul, he indeed had little use for Spirit Stones. Accumulating them was just to have a goal in mind.
However, the Eldest Senior Sister of Seek Dao Sect may not buy this explanation.
Lu Yang said slowly: "On the other hand, if you agree to these terms and patch up the loophole, this matter can be put to rest. Eldest Senior Sister will remain in the dark, and I will even persuade her to allow you to expand your business externally."
"Well? Why not consider it?"
The Master stayed silent, pondering the feasibility of Lu Yang's proposal. Ghouls are kind of like spirits, if they don't have a goal or spiritual anchor, they'll live in confusion until they disintegrate and become part of the cosmos.
As higher-ups of the Eternity Sect, their spiritual anchor is the Immortal Eternity, and if the Immortal Eternity orders them to expand the business externally and across the entire Central Continent, they have to fulfill it.
The Master sneaked a glance at the Immortal Eternity and saw him nod slightly. After some internal struggle, he gritted his teeth, making up his mind.
"Alright, I agree to your terms."
"That's more like it."
"By the way, do you know Master Qin Haoran of the Nine Nether Sect?" Lu Yang remembered this person in front of him was not only a butcher of the slaughterhouse but also the Master of Eternity Sect.
"Qin Haoran?" The Master appeared confused, "The Nine Nether Sect's last Master's surname was Qin, but I don't know his name."
Meng Jingzhou was puzzled: "You are both Masters of a demonic sect, but you don't know his name?"
The Master explained helplessly: "Really, the relationship between us, the Four Great Devil Sects, is not as close as you think. We usually only meet and exchange ideas during joint actions and mutual learning. Furthermore, our fundamental doctrines conflict, making it hard for us to stand united."
"For instance, the Nine Nether Sect believes in Reincarnation and the afterlife in Nine Nether, but us in Eternity Sect believe in the Immortal Eternity, who can resurrect, and there's a significant gap in our doctrines."
"Moreover, even within the same sect, it doesn't necessarily mean we understand each other well. Suppose Master Qin has a wife and children, would he tell his disciples? Of course not."
Lu Yang nodded. It made sense. If the Nine Nether Sect knew of Su Yiren's existence, wouldn't there have been any indication in the last decade or so?
Su Yiren's existence was a threat to the Nine Nether Sect. Although Su Yiren didn't know of Qin Haoran's identity or the location of the Nine Nether Sect, would they believe it?
A likely guess was that Qin Haoran was purposefully hiding Su Yiren's presence.
"But I do know a few things about Master Qin. Without using any Immortal Treasures, the overall strength of the Nine Nether Sect is slightly more formidable than ours of the Eternity Sect. Actually, Master Qin has privately complained to me about feeling stressed. Hence, I deduce that his position as Master is less stable than mine, with numerous people under him vying for power."
"The Nine Nether Sect does not worship an Immortal, so they likely don't possess any Immortal Treasures." The Master said it with quite a bit of pride. Among the Four Great Devil Sects, only they worshipped an Immortal and had an Immortal Treasure. It was just a shame they couldn't get their hands on the Immortal Treasures within the Eternity ruins.
Otherwise, the Eternity Sect would be the leading sect amongst the Four Great Devil Sects!
"The Nine Nether Sect believes in the existence of Nine Nether, that those who die would go to Nine Nether, so they are fearless. They have proposed several aggressive plans, like building a city as the entrance to Nine Nether or declaring war on the Great Xia Dynasty, all of which were suppressed by Master Qin."
At this point, both Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou sharply inhaled. To declare war on the Great Xia Dynasty was such an audacious plan that they wondered if a spy had infiltrated the higher ranks of the Nine Nether Sect, intending to eradicate it completely?
Applying this to Lu Yang, it's like him, as the ancestral Master of the Eternity Sect, declaring war on Eldest Senior Sister.
It's as if he'd been possessed by Fairy Eternity.
The Master went on to reveal more about the Nine Nether Sect, and both Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou learned a lot from it.
After the briefing, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou felt that there was no need to stay any longer and got up to leave.
"Let me see you off." The Master, being very polite, bid farewell to Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
"Lu Yang, I have something to discuss with Immortal Eternity. I'll be back soon," said Fairy Eternity.
"Alright."
A figure slowly floated out from behind Lu Yang. It was a beautiful woman in a light yellow dress who appeared noiselessly before the Immortal Eternity. Sensing the strong pressure from the woman, the Immortal Eternity felt as if he was standing against the endpoint of his path.
Fairy Eternity, as the Eternity Dao Fruit, was an existence superior to the nascent Eternity Dao Fruit, which had absolutely no power to resist.
"Fairy." The Immortal Eternity crossed his hands and raised them over his head in a bow to Fairy Eternity.
Fairy Eternity lightly responded, "I have a matter to inform you today since I had the opportunity to meet you."
"Please do, Fairy," he urged.
"From what I have observed, Lu Yang's character and talent meet my requirements. Thus, I've decided that Lu Yang will be the second-in-command of the Eternity Sect lineage, and you will be the third-in-command. From now on, you will treat Lu Yang with the same respect as you do me. Have you got that clear?"
The Immortal Eternity was first startled. Even if Lu Yang had sufficient character and talent, his cultivation realm made him hardly eligible to be a deputy family head. However, as if he had grasped something, he respectfully replied, "Yes."
Fairy Eternity quickly returned to Lu Yang's Spiritual Space.
"What were you up to, Fairy?"
"Not telling."
Fairy Eternity giggled silently. Lu Yang, you don't want to be the deputy head? Well, then I'll have everyone recognize you as such so that even if you deny it, it will be of no use.
How clever I am.

chapters.title: Chapter 294 - 293: The Pain of Li Haoran_1
chapters.content:
In the cafeteria of Refining Mountain, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou found Senior Sister Zhou LuLu - who was both reading a book and making sugar sculptures.
"Senior Sister Zhou, is Junior Brother Li on the mountain?" Lu Yang politely asked.
"Is it Junior Brother Lu and Junior Brother Meng? You have formed your golden core already? That's fast." Zhou LuLu lifted her head, spotted Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou's cultivation realms, showing a flash of surprise in her eyes.
At this age, she was still in the late stage of Foundation Establishment.
"You are looking for Junior Brother Li? He is in his abode."
Simultaneously, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou smiled. They treated Li Haoran like a brother. Naturally, after forming their golden core, they wanted to show off a bit in front of Li Haoran.
Otherwise, what was all the hard work of cultivation for?
"Junior Brother Li should be sleeping."
"Sleeping? I remember Junior Brother Li is not the kind of person who likes to sleep."
"He wasn't before, but ever since he returned from visiting his relatives last time, he has become fond of sleeping. Every time he wakes up, he looks gloomy, as if he's had a nightmare. I asked him if he's been dreaming of something unpleasant, but he doesn't want to talk about it."
"I asked my father about it, he also said not to worry about it."
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou exchanged glances, hardly guessing what was going on - Li Haoran must be dreaming about the memories of his past life.
Qin Haoran was a legitimate leader of a demonic sect and was involved in many horrifying things. Recalling what the Master said about many people coveting Qin Haoran's position, all these factors were likely to cause discomfort for Li Haoran.
The two of them put aside their desires to show off and decided to visit Li Haoran.
However, it wouldn't be right to go empty-handed. Seeing the fun sugar sculptures that Senior Sister Zhou LuLu was making, Lu Yang thought about buying one for Li Haoran.
Before Lu Yang could speak, Zhou LuLu slightly blew some air and the two sugar sculptures seemed to come to life. In midair, carrying their sugar-made weapons, they started clashing with each other.
Lu Yang's eyes twitched at this sight because if his judgment was correct, these two sugar figures had the combat power equivalent to the Golden Core Stage.
If he bought these for Li Haoran, the sugar figures might end up beating him up.
Let's forget it. Let's look for another gift.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou circled around the cafeteria - the fried dough stick that could become big or small could be used as a roof beam, the steamed bun that could be used as a hidden weapon, the sesame seed cake that could be used as a Chest Protector Mirror, the stir-fried sesame for practicing Iron Sand Palm... none were suitable as gifts.
"The cooks in your cafeteria are highly skilled!" The only Immortal Cook highly praised the Refining Mountain's cafeteria.
"I'd rather they were less skilled."
"You're not ambitious!"
Lu Yang turned a deaf ear.
...
In the dark cave, a figure was contorting in agony, as if suffering extreme pain in his dreams, unable to wake up, and enduring this torment in silence.
He suddenly snapped open his eyes, his clothing and quilt drenched in sweat.
The candle was lit, illuminating the entire abode and Li Haoran's face.
Li Haoran looked blankly at his abode; only then did he realize that he was awake.
He recalled his experiences in his dreams - the dark side of the Nine Nether Sect, the unknown pressure Qin Haoran was under. He couldn't help but shudder, muttering, "Damn it, memories from my past life..."
There was no good solution for these sporadic memories from his past life that surfaced, not even from his master, the Fifth Elder who was in charge of Refining Mountain.
Li Haoran quietly recited a mantra, casting the Cleaning Clothes Spell to clean his clothes and the Body Cleaning Spell to clean himself, then he felt slightly better.
"Hmm? Senior Brother Lu and Senior Brother Meng are at the door?" The Array Method inside the abode alerted Li Haoran, and he felt relieved.
He opened the doors of his abode and saw Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou smiling brightly.
"Junior Brother Li, are you awake?" Lu Yang said with a smile, secretly observing Li Haoran's condition.
Li Haoran had dark circles under his eyes, his eyelids were drooping, and he looked dispirited. Excluding the possibility of self-depletion, the only explanation would be the effects of Qin Haoran's memories.
"Please come in." Li Haoran welcomed them warmly.
The two walked into Li Haoran's cave and saw many magic instruments that he had refined displayed inside: there were armors, shields, bronze tripods... If a Golden Core Stage Refining Master saw them, they would surely exclaim that these were extraordinary works.
Li Haoran casually flicked his finger, and the teapot on the table began to move on its own. It sprouted limbs and started running around on the table, filling itself with water, adding tea leaves, covering with a lid, and then sat itself on the stove to heat up.
In no time, it was boiling hot, and the tea began to brew. The teapot tilted to fill the teacups with tea and pushed them in front of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou inadvertently said, "Thank you." Only after saying it did they realize that the teapot was just a lifeless magic artifact - there's no need for thanks.
"We heard that Junior Brother Li isn't getting good rest lately?"
Upon mentioning this topic, Li Haoran looked dispirited and let out a bitter smile: "Senior Brother Lu guessed right. I cannot share with others about being the reincarnation of Qin Haoran, so I can only vent to both of you."
Lu Yang patted Li Haoran's shoulder, an understanding look on his face: "You must have seen many hardships of the Nine Nether Sect in your dreams, and those hardships are causing you great pain."
Li Haoran nodded, relieved to finally have someone who understood him. He was quite excited: "Yes, every time I close my eyes, I see the debt of the Nine Nether Sect!"
"Salaries for the sect members, the cost of aftermath, travel expenses, the cost of building strongholds... all places that need money. The Nine Nether Sect doesn't have any legitimate way to make money so they resort to robbery and murder. Those earn a bit of money cannot measure up to the cost and every day we are losing money, losing money, losing money!"
"Such a large sect as the Nine Nether, they need money for food, clothing, housing, and transportation, but Spirit Stones don't come with the wind. Where do we get the Spirit Stones?"
"The people below know nothing about the situation and are dreaming of building a Nine Nether City on the surface. Let alone whether it will be discovered by the court, does the Nine Nether Sect have the Spirit Stones to build a city?"
"Can you imagine, Qin Haoran sat on the Master's seat every day, dealing with various affairs, then thinking about ways to make money."
"When I dream, I see things from Qin Haoran's perspective, sitting around with him aimlessly, thinking about how to make money."
"Or else, staring at the red numbers with Qin Haoran, trying to find a way out. Now whenever I see numbers, I get a headache!"
"Thank goodness Qin Haoran later met Yiren, who gave him a safe harbor, otherwise, just thinking about Qin Haoran's predicament makes me realize how hard it must have been."
Li Haoran complained miserably while rubbing his temples.
Lu Yang: "..."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
This seems to be different from what we had imagined?
Lu Yang recalled when Qin Haoran and Su Yiren first met. People were trying to kill Qin Haoran, causing serious injuries to him, he bumped into a barrier and fainted in front of Su Yiren, leading to their subsequent encounters.
Lu Yang had previously speculated that the Nine Nether Sect was in chaos, that someone was trying to seize power and launch an attack on Qin Haoran.
But after hearing this, it seemed that wasn't the case.
"Then, the person who was trying to kill Qin Haoran before..."
Li Haoran said expressionlessly:
"A creditor."

chapters.title: Chapter 295 - 294: The Reason Qin Haoran is Being Hunted_1
chapters.content:
Creditor, a term quite familiar to Lu Yang. He had a friend who held this status.
"Why are you looking at me? I didn't borrow any money!" Meng Jingzhou noticed Lu Yang's gaze and exclaimed angrily.
"Do you know which power is the creditor? Is it the Meng Family, the Land Money Trade Association, or some other force?"
In Lu Yang's mind, the two most famous loan powerhouses were the wealthy Meng Family and the globally recognized Land Money Trade Association.
Li Haoran shook his head," I don't know which force it is, the dream fragments I get each time are intermittent. It was only a few days ago, during a dream, that I happened to envision a scene before Qin Haoran was severely injured. Their dialogue revealed that the other party was the creditor, and Qin Haoran had no money."
"But it may not necessarily be Qin Haoran who borrowed the money; it could be the entire Nine Nether Cult that borrowed. The creditor found the manager of the Nine Nether Cult, who is the Master."
"Did the person know that Qin Haoran is the Master of the Nine Nether Cult?" Lu Yang was astounded. How bold was the other party to dare to borrow money from the Nine Nether Cult?
If word got out to the Great Xia Dynasty, even if one managed to escape death, they would still suffer greatly.
Li Haoran shook his head, stroking his chin as he analyzed. Through the repeated torment of Qin Haoran's memories, his knowledge reserve was rapidly increasing.
"They probably didn't know. From the memory fragments I obtained and my understanding of Qin Haoran, the most plausible scenario was Qin Haoran took some of the spirit stones from the treasury of the Nine Nether Cult to establish a small trading company. The members were Qin Haoran and a few dozen people from the Nine Nether Cult."
"Then, through some maneuvers or risky operations that yielded quick profits but hidden dangers, they made the small trading company appear prosperous and thriving."
"The small trading company would borrow money several times, each time repaying the loans promptly."
"In this way, when the lenders assessed this small company, they would think they were credible with good potential for future development."
"The small trading company would propose borrowing a large sum of money to expand their power. The lenders would probably agree."
"After getting the money, the small company could then spend all the spirit stones under the pretext of conducting business. In reality, they would secretly transfer all the spirit stones to the Nine Nether Cult."
"Eventually, the small trading company would declare bankruptcy."
"Since Qin Haoran registered the small trading company as a limited liability company, the company members would not be responsible for its debts. Therefore, the lenders couldn't directly demand debt repayment from Qin Haoran and other top members of the Nine Nether Cult."
Li Haoran concluded, "In this way, Qin Haoran and the Nine Nether Cult managed to borrow money without having to repay it. It's a perfect plan."
After hearing this, Lu Yang felt it made sense for creditors to try to kill Qin Haoran.
Understandable.
"Luckily, Qin Haoran is dead. You won't have to assume his debts." Meng Jingzhou was relieved for Li Haoran, that even if Li Haoran were sold off, it wouldn't be enough to pay off the debt, let alone the interest.
"I hope so." However, Li Haoran didn't feel at ease. This was one of the reasons he couldn't sleep at night.
Legally, he wouldn't be inheriting the debts of his past life. But, it was uncertain whether the creditors would abide by the law.
That damned Qin Haoran, served him right to be dead!
Lu Yang patted Li Haoran on the shoulder,"It's not good to always stay cooped up in the Abode. Why not get out a bit? Have you come up with a way to form a golden core?"
Li Haoran shook his head,"No."
While he had Qin Haoran's method for forming a golden core in his memory, he didn't want to follow Qin Haoran's path.
"That's perfect then. It's about time for you to form a golden core. Go out and change your mood, and maybe you'll find a chance to form a golden core."
"With us two Golden Core Stage Great Powers guarding you, I guarantee this trip will be absolutely safe!" Meng Jingzhou gave a thumbs up. He hadn't forgotten the initial purpose of the trip was to show off that they had completed the golden core formation.
Li Haoran: "...."
Is it that great to form a golden core! I have insights from a Unification peak Great Power's cultivation experience, sooner or later, I'll surpass you two!
Eldest Senior Sister had ordered Li Haoran not to leave the Seek Dao Sect. Otherwise, he would have also gone to the dense forest to seek his golden core opportunity.
Li Haoran could only leave the Seek Dao Sect under one condition, and that was if he was led by Lu Yang.
Being led by Lu Yang was even safer than being led by the Fifth Elder. They wouldn't even be afraid of encountering an Immortal.
"I'll go and inform Master before we leave."
"Let's go."
The trio found the Fifth Elder busy refining tools. The elder held a large hammer, striking the weapon with sparks flying. Each blow seemed to mimic a collision of mountains, the writhing of an earth dragon, causing the earth to shake and mountains to sway.
"It's Haoran huh, what's the matter?" Seeing Lu Yang and the others confronting him, the Fifth Elder stopped his work, shrunk the hammerhead, and knocked it against his stiff back.
"It's like this, Master, I want to go out with Senior Brother Lu and Senior Brother Meng..."
Li Haoran explained his situation briefly. The Fifth Elder nodded frequently. He could understand Li Haoran's difficulties. It was quite bothersome to deal with the various matters of a major sect every day.
Otherwise, they wouldn't have made Daoist Buyu the Sect Leader.
"Fairy Yunzhi said that if you are accompanied by Lu Yang when you go out, there will be no accidents. You all may go."
"Should we inform Eldest Senior Sister?" Li Haoran asked. He felt uneasy about leaving the sect.
"Eldest Senior Sister is out on some business and won't be back anytime soon." Lu Yang said. He was likely the only one in the entire Seek Dao Sect who knew what Eldest Senior Sister was up to.
Emperor Xia had given a response, saying they could relocate the Immortal's Abode. Eldest Senior Sister had gone to move Fairy Eternity's kitchen.
Relocating an Immortal's Abode without damaging the integrity of the Immortal ruins was extremely difficult and required Eldest Senior Sister to do it herself.
Fairy Eternity had been laughing over this for half a day to the point where she couldn't even close her mouth. She said that once the kitchen was moved back, she would show off her skills to Lu Yang.
Lu Yang was so scared he didn't dare to make a sound.
After reporting to the Fifth Elder, when the three were about to board a ship to leave the Seek Dao Sect, Lu Yang suddenly asked,"By the way, where are we going?"
How could they buy the ship tickets without knowing the destination?
The trio looked at each other, realizing they had thought about leaving the Seek Dao Sect but hadn't thought about where to go.
They surely couldn't go to the dense forest again.
"How about this, let's go to the Task Hall and pick a mission? We'll go wherever that mission takes us." Li Haoran suggested, realizing he was short of contribution points.
"Sounds good." Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou nodded their heads, considering this an opportunity to help Li Haoran earn contribution points.
Among the three of them, only Li Haoran was short of contribution points. Lu Yang himself had many contribution points, and could even access Fairy Eternity's contribution points whenever he wanted.
Meng Jingzhou could exchange spirit stones for contribution points.
The three of them went to the Task Hall and Meng Jingzhou found a mission he fancied at first glance.
"Ji State's southern area, Shoutian County. Guhuai Town. Outside the town is an abandoned temple where travelers often stay overnight. It's suspected that a man-eating female ghost with yang qi appears regularly. Once this rumor spread among travelers, they flocked to the temple for the thrill..."
"This one!" Meng Jingzhou smacked his thigh in excitement, finding fate in this mission.
It was a perfect opportunity to test if his Double Single Body Spiritual Roots were effective!
Li Haoran rubbed his chin, finding Guhuai Town incredibly familiar.

chapters.title: Chapter 296 - 295 How Rumors Are Born_1
chapters.content:
There are many strange and bizarre buildings in the Imperial City. Some are created whimsically by the Great Powers, some are the works of those lacking in artistic sense, and others exist as certain symbols.
A bronze ding stands tall in a corner of the Imperial City, towering like a small mountain. Its surface is smooth as a mirror, filled with various intricate details. From a distance, one can appreciate its rustic beauty.
This is the most bustling region of the Imperial City, where every inch of land is worth its weight in gold. Hence, the cost of placing such a bronze ding here in Spirit Stones would be astronomical.
Beyond the few notable forces like the Land Money Trade Association, no one could afford such an outlay.
Many old men with white hair and robes exuding the fragrance of Elixirs walked nonchalantly into the bronze ding, unfazed by anything else.
The passersby who passed by the bronze ding would look at these old men entering the bronze ding with expressions filled with awe and envy.
These people were all famous masters who had made a name for themselves in the path of elixir-making, and many of them had pioneered new techniques in refining pills.
This is the Alchemy Union, representing the highest authority and pinnacle of pill refining. Each year, countless pill formulas are announced to the public to declare their impressive achievements. Apart from the Pill Refiner's Peak of the Seek Dao Sect, it is a sacred place in the minds of all pill masters.
Inside the bronze ding, silent pill masters sat around an exquisite stone table, their faces devoid of any expression.
A figure arrived fashionably late, signaling the start of the meeting.
He was Qingyun Zi, the Chief Pill Master of the Alchemy Union. His superior skills easily made him the undeniable strongest pill master.
All those sitting there were old veterans from the world of pill refining, each possessing unique techniques, but they all recognized Qingyun Zi's status.
Even the usually haughty Seventh Elder admitted that Qingyun Zi was the pill master second only to him.
Qingyun Zi smiled faintly, appearing calm and composed: "As per usual, the purpose of this meeting is to share insights on refining pills, feel free to speak your mind."
"Can we really say anything?" A pill master raised his hand and asked.
"Yes."
The complexion of this pill master changed immediately, he slammed the table and yelled angrily: "Qingyun Zi, you arrived late and are pretending here. We have been sitting here for half a day, just waiting for you!"
It seemed that acknowledging Qingyun Zi's status as a pill master did not mean they could tolerate his tardiness.
"I'm so sorry, I was researching a pill formula just now, and made a major breakthrough. I was so excited that I lost track of time."
"What elixir were you so engrossed in researching?"
Qingyun Zi gave a mysterious smile: "An ancient pill formula, the Procreation Elixir."
"Have you finished refining it?!" Everyone was startled. They all had the formula for the Procreation Elixir, but no matter how they refined it, it could only beautify and rejuvenate the consumers.
Recently, a lot of elixirs for beautifying and rejuvenating have been circulating in the black market. These were the spoilt elixirs they had refined, which were useless except for making the consumers look better.
"Well, not yet. However, I have a clue now. According to my research, the owner of the Procreation Elixir formula is called Qinghe. She seems to have a close connection with an Immortal. Perhaps, the Procreation Elixir is also related to this Immortal!"
"Indeed, if there's a connection with an Immortal, it makes sense." Everyone was initially shocked, then they understood. Presumably, there was an Immortal Fruit among the elixir ingredients, which is why they could not restore it.
"Hmph, I thought there was some major breakthrough. So it was just this?" The Seventh Elder sneered at Qingyun Zi's so-called research after hearing it.
"Who could it be? Turns out it's Wuji Zi from Pill Refining Peak. Do you have any better insights?" As soon as Qingyun Zi saw it was the Seventh Elder, he abandoned his indifferent demeanor, and his words were filled with provocation.
Qingyun Zi and the Seventh Elder locked gazes, their rivalry palpable.
Seeing this, the rest of the people didn't know what to say. Everyone knew the history between these two.
Both of them fell for the same girl when they were young. After a struggle, mainly involving the Seventh Elder pinning Qingyun Zi to the ground and beating him, the girl eventually chose the immensely talented Seventh Elder.
The grudge between the two was thus established.
Since the Seventh Elder often concocts strange elixirs, no one can quite judge his pill refining skills.
However, one thing's for sure. In terms of combat, among those present, not one was a match for the Seventh Elder.
The Seventh Elder casually said, "According to my research, the key to the elixir recipe is not the elixir itself, but the method of consumption."
"Didn't you notice? The method of consumption has been stated at the beginning of the pill formula 'infused with river water, leads to pregnancy'."
"Why specifically mention 'river water'? Isn't using 'water' fine?"
"With this question in mind, I scoured ancient books, queried young scholars who are knowledgeable about the ancient times, and finally found the answer."
"The river water mentioned in the pill formula is not ordinary river water, it is the water of the Mother-child River refined by the Immortal from ancient times!"
"By consuming the water of the Mother-child River, one can become pregnant!"
Upon hearing this, everyone was shocked: "What?!"
"Mother-child River?"
"There's such a miraculous river water?!"
Although the elixirs refined by the Seventh Elder are strange, he has never joked about such matters!
"Which Immortal was it?" Qingyun Zi quickly asked, not caring about his feud with the Seventh Elder.
He had checked all the ancient books, even borrowing a treasured edition from the palace, but he was unable to find the name of that Immortal, as if it was deliberately hidden!
The Seventh Elder nodded solemnly, revealing a secret: "It was Yingtian Immortal."
Qingyun Zi suddenly realized: "So it was him? That explains everything."
"What do you mean?" The others didn't understand why Qingyun Zi said that, they had never heard that Yingtian Immortal had refined Mother-child River!
Qingyun Zi cryptically said: "I found an ancient book at an archaeological site, called the "Culinary Bible". Although I haven't completely deciphered it, I can confirm that this seemingly ordinary cookbook is actually filled with hidden secrets."
The crowd was confused, the title sounded like an ancient cookbook, wasn't it?
"At first glance, like you all, I also thought it was an ancient cookbook, but when I made a few dishes from it, I found out that anyone who ate these dishes ended up in a coma at the very least!"
"This is not a cookbook, but a toxicology book!"
Everyone drew a sharp breath. A toxicology book from ancient times sounded terrifying.
"And the author of this toxicology book is none other than Yingtian Immortal!"
"Pills and poison belong to the same source. If Yingtian Immortal can write this toxicology book, he must be well-versed in the principles of elixirs!"
"I've heard an ancient saying, the strongest master refiner does not seek out medicinal herbs, instead he invents them!"
"The Mother-child River must have been a medicinal ingredient created by Yingtian Immortal!"
"No, maybe the water of the Mother-child River is not a medicinal ingredient at all, but poison!"
"Using the water from the Mother-child River to poison your opponent during a battle. If your opponent becomes pregnant, wouldn't they be unable to fight?" The more Qingyun Zi spoke, the brighter his eyes became. He believed he had unravelled a layer of ancient mystery!
"How many women became pregnant as a result of the water from the Mother-child River refined by Yingtian Immortal?" Everyone marveled at Yingtian Immortal's power.
No wonder he is an Immortal, capable of creating such miraculous things.
After the boy finished pouring water for everyone, he quietly left. With all the master refiners present, they were discussing Immortals, this frightened him and he dared not linger.
As soon as he came out, he was surrounded by his companions.
"How are things, what did they say inside?"
This was a top-tier meeting of master refiners, representing the frontier knowledge of the elixir refining world, even hearing a bit was enough for them to show off about.
The boy was somewhat unsure, as he had been too scared to listen closely.
He tried hard to recall the discussion of the master refiners, hesitantly saying:
"It seems like they were saying that the ancient immortal Yingtian Immortal made countless women pregnant?"
His companions took a sharp breath.
This was an ancient secret.

chapters.title: Chapter 297 - 296 Three Young Scholars_1
chapters.content:
Shoutian County, Guhuai Town, an abandoned temple.
In the southern part of Ji State, a heavy rain was pouring relentlessly. The green grass fields had long been transformed into a muddy swamp by the rain. Emerald leaves stood upright in the rain, flushed by the water until they appeared lifeless.
The sky was a dull grey, seeming to press down oppressively, as though darkness could envelop everything at any moment.
A scholar, hurried in his appearance, donned a straw cloak and hat, hugging a bundle of books wrapped in cloth, sprinting through the pouring rain.
Upon spotting the abandoned temple not far away, his eyes brightened. He held his books tighter and quickened his pace, running toward it.
Huff, huff——
The scholar, panting heavily, quickly shut the temple doors and windows. Despite the temple being decrepit, it was fortunate that it sheltered him from the wind and rain.
He unwrapped his bundle to check if the books had been soaked through. Perhaps due to his diligent protection, they remained dry.
The scholar lit an oil lamp and began reading softly in the dim light.
A charming silhouette suddenly appeared behind the scholar. The figure wore an enchanting smile and playfully tapped the scholar's back.
Upon seeing the figure, the scholar's demeanor changed as though he was entranced, and he began to laugh involuntarily.
After the heavy rain, the exhausted scholar left the abandoned temple.
...
Three figures dressed as scholars were trudging along in the muddy ground, their steps awkward and cumbersome.
"Why is this path so difficult to traverse?" One scholar complained.
Another figure rolled his eyes, "Just bear with it. Don't be ungrateful. Isn't this better than when we were in the dense forest?"
"Fair point."
The third figure explained, "I heard that there was a once-in-a-decade heavy rain yesterday that drenched Guhuai Town completely. The rivers have overflown their banks, and I heard it's going to rain again tonight."
"Geez, this doesn't seem like a good omen."
Lu Yang pointed at the temple and laughed, "Well then, it's fortuitous. There's a temple up ahead. Although it's a bit rundown, the Buddha statue should still be there. You can pay your respects there tonight."
"Let's review the plan. According to our current intelligence, the enemy is very vigilant and won't readily show themselves. Besides, the enemy is a ghost with highly skilled concealment abilities and won't be easily caught."
"The female ghost's power level appears to be at the Foundation Establishment Stage, but her exact realm is unknown."
"If the female ghost shows up, we must ensure that she won't escape before we apprehend her!"
"Our current identities are scholars seeking glory and fame in the Imperial City. We're staying here for one night to lure the female ghost out."
"So far, there's been no report of any murders by the female ghost. When capturing her, do not use deadly force."
"I didn't realize the importance of using a fake name when out and about until I saw my master being thrown into jail. It protects the reputation of the Seek Dao Sect, even in the face of disgrace. Let's double-check each other's names one more time. I'm Lu Yiyang."
"I'm Long Jingzhou."
"I'm Li Hao."
Having discussed and agreed on the plan, the three scholars reigned in their energy to the point where they seemed to be ordinary people and entered the temple.
"This temple is very clean." Meng Jingzhou was surprised. He had expected it to be covered in dust with spider webs in every corner.
The conditions inside the temple were beyond his expectations. It was clean, like someone had cleaned it.
The only disappointment was the broken Buddha statue in the center of the hall, missing its upper body, rendering it impossible to pay respects to.
Li Haoran found dry firewood behind the Buddha statue, likely left behind by the last person who sought shelter here.
He piled the firewood together, found some dry grass, took out a firestone from his bag, and lit the wood pile using the grass as tinder.
Warming his hands by the fire, Li Haoran revealed an utterly comfortable expression, "Huff —— finally, I feel alive."
Lu Yang pulled several steamed buns out of his bag, threaded them onto a wooden skewer, and started to roast them over the fire.
Once the buns turned slightly golden, Lu Yang tore one apart. The aroma mixed with the rising heat hit them in the face.
After circling around the inner temple, Meng Jingzhou returned to the main hall, "In addition to this main hall, there are two other rooms. Perfect for sleeping later, one for each of us."
"Alright."
The three of them gathered by the fire, eating their roasted buns and pickled vegetables, while lamenting the hardship of their journey ahead.
Lu Yang's heart was filled with worries, to the point where he no longer enjoyed the bun in his hand. "I wonder, as we head to the Imperial City, if things will go smoothly. I have heard that the Imperial City is filled with cultivators. It will be incredibly difficult for us ordinary people to make a name for ourselves there."
Meng Jingzhou waved his hand, "The number of cultivators in the Imperial City isn't as exaggerated as you think. It's already impressive if one out of twenty people is a cultivator. It's incredibly tough to become a cultivator. Something like a Spirit Root alone could eliminate ninety-nine percent of people."
Considering that one out of twenty people is a cultivators is already an astronomical proportion, no other major city in the Central Continent could reach this ratio.
"Although we don't possess Spirit Roots, we're knowledgeable and literate. Our understanding of current affairs surpasses that of ordinary people. After we leave Shoutian County and head to the capital to take the examination, it's still possible for us to pass the imperial examination, earn the Emperor's favor, and secure a government post."
Not all high-ranking officials in the Great Xia dynasty were cultivators; a good number were ordinary people.
Pointing at Li Haoran with his bun, Meng Jingzhou said, "Take Brother Li for example. At five, he recited the Thousand Character Classic; at seven, he wrote poetry; at eight, he wrote lyrics; at ten, he wrote articles. His literary talents are amazing, his articles exquisite, so much so that they seem heaven-sent. The teacher raves about him, saying he's the best student he's ever taught."
Li Haoran gave a humble smile, "Brother Long, you exaggerate. The teacher is just trying to motivate me. Unlike you, you've abandoned the family business to seek your future in the Imperial City. Those kinds of confidence and the foundation on which your confidence is based are things Brother Lu and I cannot match."
The three of them complimented each other before taking out their classics. As they read, they were captivated by the beauty of the texts. They wished to one day write an article of this caliber.
Meng Jingzhou yawned, ruthlessly shattering Lu Yang's dream, "Alright, enough daydreaming. Let's sleep. We have to get up early tomorrow."
According to their agreement, each of them went to their respective rooms.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou went to the rooms on either side to rest while Li Haoran stayed in the main hall, sleeping in front of the half Buddha statue.
In the darkness, three specter-like figures gazed at Lu Yang and the others, their eyes emitting a chilling green light.
"Three more people have arrived, and they're teeming with Yang Qi. I really wonder what they taste like..." whispered one figure, dressed in green, giggling.
"Indeed, indeed. It's been a long time since we've seen scholars with such strong Yang Qi. Although scholars acquire an abundance of righteous energy from reading saints' books, the energy trio's energy is rare," commented a figure in red, licking her lips seductively.
The figure in white, who looked younger, quickly cautioned, "Sisters, you must be careful. Don't drain all their Yang Qi at once. We should take a sustainable approach to this."
"If they have a pleasant experience once, they will come back again. Over time, we can absorb more Yang Qi than by draining it all in one go."
"We know, we know. Xiao Qi, you might be the youngest, but you're certainly the most tiresome. We know our limits. If we go too far and attract the attention of the Righteous Path, we'll be the ones in trouble. We understand this."
"We'll split up. We'll go to the rooms on either side, and Xiao Qi, you'll stay here to take care of the one named Li."

chapters.title: Chapter 298 - 297 Li Haoran is Probably Dead_1
chapters.content:
In the side room, Lu Yang, under the light of an oil lamp, was deeply engrossed in reading a book, completely oblivious to the beautiful woman in green that had appeared in the room.
Although Lu Yang appeared to be reading, he was actually communicating with the immortal in his spiritual space.
"Hmm? Lu Yang, you've done all sorts of mischief, been kicked out of the Seek Dao Sect, and now you've ended up in a place like this?" Fairy Eternity giggled, taking pleasure in his misfortune.
"... Fairy, you really don't need to be so imaginative. Also, why do other people sleep in hours, but you sleep in days?"
Fairy Eternity huffed with her hands on her hips, "How can an immortal be the same as a mortal?"
"Yes, yes, yes. You, the Fairy, are extraordinary. So can you go back to sleep now? I have things to do."
"What things?" Fairy Eternity perked up with interest.
Seeing that Fairy Eternity was insistent on hearing the whole story, Lu Yang had no choice but to spill the beans.
"So you're planning to lure the female ghost over and then catch her?"
"Yes."
"That's easy, leave it to me." Fairy Eternity patted her chest confidently, sounding as if the Invincible Elixir had influenced her.
Fairy Eternity, being a spirit herself, was indeed suitable for the current situation.
"Wait, aren't you afraid of ghosts, Fairy?" Lu Yang remembered how scared Fairy Eternity had been of the ghosts that came out of the tomb that the Grand Elder and he had built.
"Why would I be afraid of ghosts when I can see myself... No, I mean, I'm not afraid of ghosts at all!" Fairy Eternity, realizing her own slip of the tongue, quickly corrected herself.
"Alright, but don't do anything inappropriate!" After admonishing, Lu Yang handed control of his body over to Fairy Eternity.
"Sir~~ I'm so lonely, will you keep me company~" The svelte figure in green appeared before Lu Yang, gazing at him with longing in her eyes. Her voice was so gentle and sweet that it could melt bones.
