Little did she know that this was not the same Lu Yang as before.
Lu Yang responded with a wicked smile and threw his arms around the beautiful figure in green.
The woman was taken aback. Lu Yang didn't seem like this kind of person just a while ago in the main hall.
Lu Yang lifted her chin with his index finger and asked flirtatiously, "Lonely beauty, do you need some company from your big sister?"
Lu Yang was affectionately holding the woman, exploring up and down her body: "Not bad, but your figure could use some work compared to mine."
What does she mean her figure can use some work? And why is she calling herself big sister?
This person doesn't look like a man in drag, does she?
The woman was thoroughly creeped out, convinced she had met a pervert.
"Come, sweetheart, time flies. Let's have some fun." Lu Yang grinned mischievously, displaying no signs of good intentions.
The woman attempted to escape, but found his grip terrifyingly strong. Even as a Foundation Establishment cultivator, she could not break free.
"Hehe, trying to run?" Lu Yang lunged at the woman.
Meanwhile, in the spiritual space, the real Lu Yang lunged at Fairy Eternity.
"Yellow Bean you bastard, what are you trying to do with my body!"
"Just playing around, won't get serious." Fairy Eternity turned tail and ran.
"Even then, it's not acceptable. It ruins my image!"
...
Meng Jingzhou feigned sleep, a hint of a smile tugging at his lips, quietly waiting for the ghost lady to arrive.
The female ghost appeared at the side of Meng Jingzhou's bed, dressed in red as if she was a bride.
The female ghost blew a breath towards Meng Jingzhou, causing his expression to become dazed.
"My lord, wake up," the gentle voice of the woman in red echoed in Meng Jingzhou's ear.
Meng Jingzhou woke up in a daze, gazing at the woman in red with some hesitation: "Who are you?"
"My lord, don't you remember me, I am your wife."
Meng Jingzhou's eyes lit up - the Double Single Golden Core was effective! Upon their first meeting, she claimed to be his wife!
He had to remain calm and not be hasty, he needed to keep his composure.
Then he resumed his bewildered expression.
The red-clad female ghost's rosy lips gradually approached Meng Jingzhou, and Meng Jingzhou's heart pounded in excitement.
Thud—
Before the red-clad female ghost's lips could touch Meng Jingzhou, they were blasted away by an invisible energy emanating from him. She fainted, her lips left swollen by the energy, as puffed up as a sausage, entirely devoid of beauty.
Single Golden Elixir, the Golden Elixir is like the sun, upright and unyielding, residing in the center of the Dantian, can shoulder everything in all directions. Evil beings such as demons and ghosts cannot come close.
The effect of the Double Single Golden Core is naturally stronger.
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
The female ghost simply couldn't touch him.
...
In the main hall, Li Haoran lied in front of a half-buddha statue, using all his senses to pay attention to the surrounding movements.
He did not dare to use his powers lightly, fearing that the female ghost might detect him.
It's here!
The graceful figure in white slowly approached Li Haoran, oblivious that she was already detected by Li Haoran.
Whoosh—
The graceful figure in white exhaled a breath of cold air, causing Li Haoran to shiver.
"Who are you?" Li Haoran was taken aback when he saw the white-clad female ghost.
The white-clad female ghost said softly, "Benefactor, don't be alarmed. I am just a powerless lone ghost. I merely need to borrow some of your Yang Qi."
The white-clad female ghost looked pitiable and harmless to everyone and everything.
But Li Haoran didn't believe her ghost words. 'Powerless'? She was solid and clear-minded, and there was faint Qi radiating from her.
Foundation Establishment late stage.
Having such a bad luck, even the ghost I encountered is at the same level as me.
"The little woman will make the benefactor feel comfortable," the white-clad female ghost said in a seductive, whispering voice, causing tingling feelings to arise in the listener.
Li Haoran thought it was strange. Theoretically, there should be a lot of disturbance from Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou catching ghosts on their side. Why is there still no news?
Did something unexpected happen?
Li Haoran decided against debunking the lies of the female ghost directly. Instead, he decided to go along with her plan, seeking to extract some intelligence from her.
"What do ghosts want Yang Qi for? To return to life?"
"Benefactor jokes; how can ghosts return to life? We just collect a bit of Yang Qi for subsistence purposes."
While flirting, the white-clad female ghost climbed onto Li Haoran, both human and ghost looking eye-to-eye.
All of a sudden, the door of the main hall was forcibly pushed open, and a young girl barged in.
"Excuse me, is anyone here? I've used up all of my supplies, can I stay here for the night?"
The girl stood tall, clad in plain clothes, yet carried no bag with her. Although the temple was surrounded by muddy grounds, not a single speck of mud was seen on her shoes.
Li Haoran and the white-clad female ghost turned to look at theunexpectedarrival simultaneously.
The girl was also taken back by the scene before her. This was her first trip outside her house, is the outside world this liberal? Even playing around in this broken temple?
Embarrassed at stumbling upon such a scene, the girl knew that under these circumstances, she should retreat.
Instinctively, she wanted to turn around and leave, but she realized that the man lying on the ground seemed familiar.
The girl walked closer stealthily, confirming that she was not mistaken.
She looked down at Li Haoran from above, asked him with a voice softer than the white-clothed ghost woman, though her smile did not reach her eyes:
"Ex-father, just what are you doing?"
Li Haoran swallowed hard, feeling that his end was near.
The girl was none other than Li Haoran's daughter in his previous life, Qin Yanyan.

chapters.title: Chapter 299 - 298 Ex-Father_1
chapters.content:
"Ex-father," meaning the father from his past life, is a new term unique to Li Haoran.
Yanyan went out to travel the world, seeking opportunities to form the golden core and further comprehend life's mysteries, and striving for breakthroughs in her mental state.
She had only passed a few counties, decided to stay in a dilapidated temple for a night, and met with such a thrilling event.
After being persuaded by her mother for a month, Yanyan was planning to accept this father with no blood relation when she encountered such an incident.
This is not what understanding the world is all about.
"Wait, Yanyan! Let me explain!" Li Haoran was somewhat panicked. In good conscience, he was really here to catch ghosts. He hadn't got any useful information yet when he was caught red-handed by Yanyan.
The Central Continent is so large, how could he be stumbled upon by Yanyan?
Was this the causality entanglement between Father and Daughter?
The female ghost in white robe also sensed something wrong and tried to escape. Li Haoran used his Capture Technique, from solid to void, and from void back to solid. Between the alternation of void and solid, he pinned the female ghost to the ground.
This was a technique that Li Haoran learnt during refining, and now, with a slight adapt, it serves well in catching ghosts.
Pitted against each other, the female ghost posed no match for Li Haoran at the late stage of Foundation Establishment.
"I received a mission from the Sect, and came here with Senior Brother Lu and Senior Brother Meng to catch ghosts!" Li Haoran quickly explained. If Yanyan took this misunderstanding to Su Yiren, he might as well not take over Qin Yuanhao's memory and directly move on to the tenth life.
"Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou?" Upon hearing what her ex-father said, Yanyan remembered these two geniuses from the Seek Dao Sect.
One is the Sect Leader's disciple, and the other is the heir to the Meng family, both more credible than Li Haoran.
"Yes, they are both in the next room, and they'll be able to prove my innocence!" As Li Haoran spoke, he used the Soul Lock Chain with refining abilities to bind the ghost in a white robe to a load-bearing wooden pillar, and then went to find Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
Yanyan followed Li Haoran to search for the two, albeit with doubt and suspicion.
Li Haoran pushed the door open in a rush, speaking fast enough to scare anyone, "Brother Lu, you must prove I am innocent. We are here to catch ghosts, aren't we? Since you haven't sent any signals, the ghost shouldn't have come up here…"
Before he could finish his words, he saw Lu Yang with a strange smile on his face, dragging a ghost in a green robe who was resisting but to no avail, showing a look of despair, being at the mercy of Lu Yang.
This scene doesn't look like the work of a gentleman.
"Senior Brother Lu, you…" Li Haoran stuttered, not expecting Lu Yang to be this kind of person.
Seeing this scene, Yanyan felt Li Haoran was making excuses, which made her furious, "You dare say you are here to catch ghosts?!"
"Let's go and see Senior Brother Meng, I bet he is diligently catching ghosts!" Li Haoran was sure there wouldn't be any issues with Meng Jingzhou. After all, a Single Body Spiritual Root might produce desires, but lacked the physical body to fulfill them.
Then Yanyan saw a female ghost in a red robe unconscious, with Meng Jingzhou squatting beside her carefully observing.
"Date rape?!"
Yanyan was shocked. It seems each ghost-catching method was more thrilling than the other.
By comparison, Li Haoran seemed to be the most conservative player.
Li Haoran: "..."
Why every time he comes out with Senior Brother Lu and Senior Brother Meng, he never gets into anything good? Last time he got an unmarried wife who was two thousand years older and a daughter with no blood relation to him, and he became the former master of one of the Four Great Devil Sects.
When he needed them to prove his innocence this time, the two made such commotions.
"Nonsense, who said I drugged her? Don't you know I'm a Single Body Spiritual Root?" Meng Jingzhou said in rage, turning around to see who was so blind.
"Oh, niece, are you here looking for your father?"
Facing Meng Jingzhou who emanated the aura of the Golden Core realm, Yanyan reminded herself repeatedly that she couldn't win against him.
Meanwhile, Lu Yang finally tamed Fairy Eternity, regained control of his body, and came searching for Li Haoran and Meng Jingzhou with the ghost in green.
After the three of them showed the mission assigned by their sect and Meng Jingzhou revealed his Single Body Spiritual Root status, Qin Yanyan finally believed that they were there to exorcise ghosts, not soliciting prostitutes.
The ghost in green that Lu Yang carried shook in terror. These three were from the Seek Dao Sect, one of the Five Great Immortal Sects.
Everyone gathered in the main hall, where Li Haoran bound the still-shivering ghost in green, and the unconscious ghost in red, next to the ghost in white.
With that, all three female ghosts were now captured.
"So, you're saying that the Seek Dao Sect issued a ghost-capturing mission, and you came to Guhuai Town to complete that sect mission?" Qin Yanyan was mostly convinced by the trio's explanation.
Qin Yanyan still didn't know that her father from her previous life was a reincarnation of the Nine Nether sect.
Li Haoran obtained the memory fragments of Qin Haoran after Su Yiren and Qin Yanyan had left. This event would be difficult to explain to Qin Yanyan.
Li Haoran certainly couldn't tell her that her dad was a demon sect leader in his past life, no good at all.
This would completely shatter their father-daughter relationship.
"What about you? Why did you come to Guhuai Town?"
"My mother told me that I went to your house last time and started a quarrel, acting too impetuously. She said I needed to improve my state of mind. Given that it was about time for me to form my golden core, she suggested I go out, travel, and polish my mind. So, I did."
"Today, during the day, I was in Shoutian County. I spent all my savings strolling around the trading company. There were no free inns in Shoutian County. So, I had to move northward. When I saw the ancient temple here, I thought about staying there overnight. So, I came."
Li Haoran was extremely concerned about Qin Yanyan's travel experience.
In a few more days, Qin Yanyan might have to start performing on the streets to earn a living.
"Fo-four heroes, we are ghosts, but we have never harmed human beings!" The ghost in green pleaded innocence.
They were very careful in absorbing Yang Qi, not causing any trouble, because they feared attracting righteous cultivators.
But in a bad twist of fate, the one they feared the most came. And this time it was the Seek Dao Sect, the strongest among the righteous ones.
It is said that the righteous cultivators loathed demons and ghosts and would kill them on sight.
Did they have a chance to survive in their hands?
"Never harmed humans?" Meng Jingzhou scoffed. "The mission clearly stated that you absorb humans' Yang Qi, causing them to be listless and in a daze all day. Are you telling me all that's a lie?"
The ghost in white was on the verge of tears. "It is really not true. We are very careful while absorbing Yang Qi, only absorbing a small part of it so as not to influence people. Furthermore, our absorption of Yang Qi has been registered with the mayor."
"We also know that absorbing too much will affect humans. Who would come next time if we do so? We understand the principle of not draining the pond to catch all the fish."
"Wait a minute, the mayor knows about this?"
"Not just the mayor, all travelers in town can be witnesses!" The ghost in white swore confidently.
Lu Yang and the other three were baffled by the words of the ghost in white.
"It's true. We didn't cheat you. Just now, the three of us sisters went to every inn to knock on doors, asking if they needed service. We had just completed a round of service and got back when we saw three heroes lying in the temple. The three of you had very abundant Yang Qi, so we thought of absorbing some of your Yang Qi as the conclusion of the evening."
Lu Yang: "???"
You're offering door-to-door service?!
The ghost in white embarrassedly said, "Comprehensive service retains returning customers."
Qin Yanyan was even more shocked than Lu Yang, is this what it's like in the mortal world?

chapters.title: Chapter 300 - 299: Hardworking Female Ghosts_1
chapters.content:
"Let's say the chief knows about this, would you dare to come with us to see the chief?" Li Haoran didn't believe their ghostly banter, hoping to see a shadow of fear on their faces.
Unfortunately, there was none.
Four humans and three ghosts waited in the dilapidated temple all night. As dawn was yet to break and the moon was still emitting a soft glow, transitioning into the sun, they set off to meet the chief.
Guhuai Town was renowned for its locust trees; you could see them everywhere. The oldest, thickest locust tree was so large that not even three Lu Yangs could wrap their arms around it. The white-dressed female ghost, who called herself Xiao Qi, claimed that the tree was a thousand years old, even older than Guhuai Town itself.
Locust trees are believed to have a "Yin" nature; thus, the whole town had a chilling and somewhat murky atmosphere, making it a perfect summer retreat.
Out of all the towns Lu Yang had visited, Guhuai Town was the largest.
Moreover, there was a prosperous aura to Guhuai Town, promising even more growth in the future.
Upon explaining their identities at the mansion, the town's chief hurried out to greet them. The chief appeared rather wealthy and had a constant jovial appearance.
"I never expected a Daoist priest from the Seek Dao Sect to visit us. I apologize for my lack of foresight," the chief apologized immediately, adopting a very humble attitude.
Lu Yang noticed that the chief had reached the late stage of Foundation Establishment in his cultivation.
The chief noticed the three female ghosts trailing behind them. His expression faltered for a moment before quickly regaining his composure. He cordially introduced himself: "My surname is Fan, first name is Guiren. You can simply call me Fan."
"Please come in."
"You are too kind, Chief Fan." Lu Yang took a sip from the tea poured by the chief, nodding slightly. He couldn't discern what kind of tea it was.
"The reason we're here, Chief Fan, you might already know. We're here to understand the origins and movements of these three female ghosts."
"I see." Chief Fan appeared disheartened. Honestly, he didn't want to talk about it, but since a member of Seek Dao Sect asked him, he had no other choice.
"Are you aware of these three ghosts sucking the Yang Qi out of people?" Lu Yang cut to the chase.
"Yes. At first, some travelers who came by reported that there were ghosts in the broken temple outside the town sucking people's Yang Qi. Hearing this, I was taken aback. I immediately went there to investigate."
"When I arrived at the temple, I realized that the three ghosts, Xiao Qi and the others, were not malevolent entities draining humans' Yang Qi but rather benevolent spirits."
"At the time, Guhuai Town was not as bustling as it is today. I wanted to develop a tourism industry to increase the town's income, but a bunch of locust trees alone wasn't enough to attract visitors."
"I then thought of the female ghosts. To avoid mishaps, I verified the laws pertaining to them and found that the laws only prohibit female ghosts from sucking Yang Qi if it harms people or disturbs their normal lives. The laws do not completely forbid female ghosts from sucking Yang Qi."
"Being sucked by ghosts doesn't count as prostitution, meaning the travelers don't have to pay."
"Also, the tax regulations do not mention that ghosts sucking Yang Qi need to pay taxes."
"Considering all these, I decided to use the female ghosts as a selling point to promote Guhuai Town. Surprisingly, the effect was quite good. Many travelers came looking for romantic encounters. I could visibly see the town's revenue increasing, resulting in better local finances and rewards from the county. This also led me to advance smoothly to the late stages of Foundation Establishment."
"The county had plans to promote me, but being a town chief here is more preferable—there's food and drink, Spirit Stones, and it's even better than working in the county. So, I declined."
"Even if I were to accept a promotion to the county, I'd wait until I've reached the Golden Core Stage." Chief Fan had a very clear plan for his own political path.
The three ghosts all nodded in agreement, declaring themselves innocent and presenting themselves as good ghosts.
"Wait a moment. If this is a good thing, then who was the one that asked for our Sect's help, saying that there were female ghosts here?" Meng Jingzhou was puzzled.
Their mission was not discovered by their Sect but was reported by someone else to the Seek Dao Sect.
Competitors?
This industry has competitors?
Chief Fan was also surprised. He thought that the three people were passing by when they came across the ghosts and decided to get rid of them.
So, they were reported instead?
"Does Chief Fan have any clue?"
"Nothing so... May I know what the mission statement says?"
"It says that in Guhuai Town, female ghosts suck men's Yang Qi, causing scholars to lose vitality and become listless."
Chief Fan looked somewhat strange.
"Chief Fan, do you know what happened?"
Chief Fan nodded, "Scholar Zhou has a son, everyone calls him Xiao Zhou. Xiao Zhou's academic level is mediocre. He's failed the scholar examinations several times."
"But Xiao Zhou's mother always thought it was due to Xiao Zhou constantly visiting the female ghosts, which distracted him and caused him to lose focus and be nonchalant about his studies."
"Xiao Zhou's mother came to me, hoping that I would punish the ghosts. But everyone can see Xiao Zhou's academic performance clearly. He's playful by nature and doesn't take studying seriously. It has nothing to do with the female ghosts."
"I ignored her tantrums. After Xiao Zhou's mother left, a few more people came and blamed their children's failure to get official appointments on the female ghosts, which I also rejected."
"I didn't expect them to persist and even report this matter to the Seek Dao Sect."
Chief Fan sighed, "The three ghosts, Xiao Qi included, have tried their utmost to fix this."
The white-dressed female ghost, Xiao Qi, said, "Fearing that this incident would escalate and alert the Righteous Path to our existence, we called the students with poor performance in the town to the temple. We gave them lectures."
"When we were alive, we were all from scholarly families. Teaching them is easy for us."
"There were rewards for good progress, but the students who didn't study well did not receive rewards. Under this incentive mechanism, their grades hastened."
Lu Yang looked up and down at the three female ghosts, not mentioning the red-dressed ghost whose lips were swollen like sausages.
The white-dressed ghost and the green-dressed ghost were beautiful and scantily clad, each beautiful in their own way. Under such circumstances, their male students were still able to study?
Oh, right. If they couldn't study well, they wouldn't receive rewards.
"The students were also willing to learn this way. As an example, yesterday, even though we were in the midst of an unprecedented heavy rain where the day was as dark as night, Xiao Zhou and the others still insisted on coming in the rain to attend our class. They studied till the heavy rain passed, leaving the temple exhausted."
"We never expected that despite our efforts, we would still be reported by their parents." Xiao Qi felt the hardships of life—life is not easy for the living nor the dead.
Lu Yang summarized, "So, you open a private school during the day to give lectures to students, and at night, you wander around the town, absorbing Yang Qi in guesthouses?"
"Yes, that's right."
After hearing this, the three people, including Lu Yang, felt ashamed. Even ghosts were more diligent than they were.
Qin Yanyan was fascinated to hear this. So, are all ghosts like this?
Xiao Qi continued, "Not only that, but we also have to hand over seventy percent of the Yang Qi we absorb. We only keep thirty percent for ourselves."
"Hmm? Who do you hand it over to?" Lu Yang was confused. After all, the court did not require Yang Qi.
"Our superior, whom we all call Lord Mi. Lord Mi once mentioned that Guhuai Town has some treasure left by the former Master, and he asked us to look out for it."

chapters.title: Chapter 301 - 300 Your Father is the Master of the Demonic Sect_1
chapters.content:
Upon hearing Xiao Qi's words, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou couldn't help but turn their heads to look at Li Haoran, their eyes odd.
It seemed that there was a former Sect Master right here.
"Hey, hey, hey, why are you all staring at me!" Li Haoran exclaimed angrily.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou retreated their gazes. Indeed, it was not only the Nine Nether Sect that had former Sect Masters, the Yaoyang Sect and the Ruthless Sect could have one, too.
Besides, Qin Haoran had been so impoverished, reduced to a state where he was hunted down by his creditor; he didn't seem like a man who could possess treasures.
"Who is Lord Mi? Who is the 'previous Sect Master' that Lord Mi mentioned? What is the 'leftover treasure'?" Qin Yanyan asked a string of questions.
In the whole Central Continent, the only factions with the position of "Sect Master" were the Four Great Devil Sects, uh no, the Three Great Demon Sects.
Perhaps this Lord Mi was a member of the Three Great Demon Sects.
Xiao Qi was startled by Qin Yanyan's demeanor, she shook her head saying "I don't know, Lord Mi has unidirectional contact with us. He placed a spiritual restriction in our souls, obliging us to heed his commands. He rarely informs us of anything."
"Every time Lord Mi came to collect Yang Qi, he would ask us if there occurred any strange things in Guhuai Town, or if we discovered any unusual items."
Xiao Qi and her companions were unaware of Lord Mi's true identity.
Chief Fan was also startled. He knew that Xiao Qi and her two companions belonged to Lord Mi's command, but Lord Mi was a member of the Three Great Demon Sects.
If he had known about this, he would never have dared to use Xiao Qi and her companions for publicity purposes.
No matter how much he longed for achievement, he wouldn't dare to associate himself with the Three Great Demon Sects.
It was known that after the Eternity Sect was eradicated, many officials who had worked with the Eternity Sect for their career fell from grace, causing tremors within the political center.
Speaking of which, the Eternity Sect was discovered by the Seek Dao Sect. The Seek Dao Sect was indeed worthy of being one of the Five Great Immortal Sects.
No one knew which big shot within the Seek Dao Sect had discovered the headquarter of the Eternity Sect.
"Fairy, do the three of them have a spiritual restriction in their souls?" As for the knowledge about the soul, Lu Yang was utterly ignorant. He asked Fairy Eternity, who seemed to know everything about it.
"Yes, but the method of placing the restriction was rather crude, just beginner's level. Do you want me to erase it?"
Lu Yang pondered for a moment, then asked, "Can Lord Mi detect it?"
"Are you kidding, do you even know who I am? Even if Lord Mi was here, he would not notice that the restriction he left had been erased!"
"Then I will have to trouble you, Fairy."
Lu Yang informed the three ghost women that Lord Mi was someone from the demonic sect, which instantly frightened them into trembling like sieve, insisting repeatedly that they were good ghosts and had no connections with the demonic sect.
Lu Yang smiled, "Of course I know that the three of you have no connection with the demonic sect. I just worry that under Lord Mi's control, you might do something against your own will. So, I want to erase your restrictions, and hereafter the Seek Dao Sect will supervise your actions to ensure you don't partake in any evil deeds, is that alright?"
The three ghosts didn't dare to disagree and nodded vigorously.
Fairy Eternity secretly intervened to erase the restrictions left by Lord Mi and counterfeit an identical restriction. Anybody below the Unification stage would not be able to spot any crack in it.
The three ghosts felt a sense of relief in their souls, the longstanding restriction on their souls was gone.
Xiao Qi timidly raised her hand and hesitated before asking, "Um, can we go back now? It's almost time for our lesson."
They taught the students every day, punctually and dedicatedly.
"Just right, we've gathered enough information." Everyone prepared to leave.
Before leaving, Lu Yang reminded, "Chief, matters related to the demonic sect are significant. Mayor Fan, please refrain from sharing the news of our visit."
Now that they knew about the traces of the demonic sect here, they had to take certain steps before heading back.
"Naturally." Chief Fan nodded. When it comes to the demonic sect, it's better left to the experts like the Seek Dao Sect to deal with it. He, being an insignificant person, decided not to get involved.
After saying goodbye to Chief Fan, the group of four humans and three ghosts returned to the ruined temple. The three ghosts went to the front hall for the lesson while the four humans discussed their next steps in a side room.
In front of the Mayor, there were certain things that Li Haoran was uncomfortable saying. Now that they were alone, it was no harm in speaking, "Actually, I remember coming to Guhuai Town in my past life to hide something. I shielded it from causality, spiritual sense and all other methods of investigation; I didn't want anyone to find it, it's definitely a treasure."
"There really is a treasure in this place?"
"Is Lord Mi of the Nine Nether Sect for real?"
"Where did you hide the treasure?"
"What is the treasure?"
"You were so poor in your past life, how could you have left a treasure?"
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou voiced different exclamations.
Li Haoran rolled his eyes in annoyance and said, "It's just a fragment of memory, how could I remember it that clearly? But it's true that there is something in Guhuai Town."
"Wait, what are you three talking about?" Qin Yanyan was confused. What treasure? What Nine Nether Sect?
What did this have to do with her ex-father?
The three exchanged glances. Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou could see Li Haoran's helplessness.
"Qin Yanyan and Su Yiren will learn about this thing sooner or later. Instead of being vague, why not tell them now?" Lu Yang persuaded. As Qin Yanyan's uncle, he believed his niece had the right to know the truth.
Meng Jingzhou was of the same opinion.
Li Haoran hesitated for a moment, then decided to reveal the true identity of Qin Haoran to his former daughter.
"Actually, your father Qin Haoran was the former Sect Master of the Nine Nether Sect…"
Li Haoran disclosed everything about the matter. As Qin Yanyan listened, her expression grew increasingly strange. She never thought that her never-seen father would be the Sect Master of a demonic sect and an expert in deceiving, with colossal debt.
After silently listening to the information about her father, Qin Yanyan sighed deeply, then revealed a bitter smile of helplessness. The identity of her father was the Sect Master of a demonic sect, what other reaction could she possibly have? She could only accept it.
In fact, she didn't have any feelings for Qin Haoran. She had lived with Su Yiren since she was a child. "Qin Haoran" was more like a symbol named "father" to her.
"Oh, by the way, since your dad was the Sect Master of the demonic sect, your future political career, military service, and participation in the Sect's entrance exam will be restricted due to political verification." Lu Yang kindly reminded her. He had recently been brushing up on the laws of Great Xia and had achieved something.
Qin Yanyan: "..."
Thank you for reminding me.
Meng Jingzhou also chimed in, "Your parents were married for five hundred years. According to your father's habits, he must have accrued some debt during these five hundred years. But don't worry, your mother didn't know when your father borrowed money, and all the money was used in the construction of the Nine Nether Sect.
According to the law, such debt does not belong to marital debt, your mother doesn't have to repay."
Meng Jingzhou was quite adept at economic laws.
Qin Yanyan: "..."
I also thank you for the reminder.
Qin Yanyan could feel the solicitude from her two uncles.
"Then my father urgently broke through Transcendance Tribulation Stage and talked about fighting for a future for my mother and me…"
Li Haoran solemnly nodded, "In order to increase his borrowing limit."
"And to enhance his ability to withstand late repayments."

chapters.title: Chapter 302 - 301: Reincarnation Body_1
chapters.content:
Qin Yanyan finally understood why her father had always been reluctant to reveal his identity.
Though Qin Haoran was the master of one of the Four Great Devil Sects, a virtual emperor in the dark world with countless ruthless demon cultivators under his control who killed without batting an eye.
This identity was not something that could be boasted about.
Otherwise, when facing an opponent, if that opponent bragged about their identity, claiming they belonged to a top-tier sect and suggesting her to concede immediately.
Qin Yanyan would respond with a wicked smile, stating her father was the master of the demonic sect, and it would be better for them to surrender to avoid being beaten to death by her.
Then before anything else could happen, her opponent would report to the authorities and the Nine Nether Sect would be crushed.
The master of the Nine Nether Sect was the most wanted criminal in the Great Xia Dynasty.
This was essentially trapping oneself.
Backing off a little, if her identity was exposed, and everyone came to know that Qin Yanyan's father was the master of the demonic sect, it would affect Qin Yanyan's political examinations and prospects.
The most important thing was that he had a huge amount of loans and lived a very unstable life with the constant risk of being sought after by creditors.
Perhaps, if Su Yiren knew all of this, she might decide that Qin Haoran was unreliable and file for divorce.
"Are you certain that you have no recollection of where the treasure's hidden?" Meng Jingzhou asked persistently, as it was a treasure inherited from Master Chu, with potentially inestimable value.
Li Haoran furrowed his eyebrows, trying hard to recall the memories of that time.
The fragments of Qin Haoran's memories were not only sparse and intermittent, but also fuzzy in some places, which gave him the feeling of seeing flowers through the fog.
"Let me think... It should be something that happened four hundred years ago... It's related to the locust tree..."
Lu Yang pondered for a moment, and sent messages to the three female ghosts.
In the main hall, the sound of chanting filled the room, giving the dilapidated temple a refreshed atmosphere. The three half-dressed female ghosts strolling around the main hall stirred excitement among the scholars.
"Whoever performs best in this lesson, I will provide additional private tutoring," the green-clothed female ghost whispered captivatingly.
Upon hearing this, the scholar's eyes lit up and they started studying with an unprecedented vigor, chanting, "Isn't it a pleasure to learn and practice from time to time..."
Upon receiving Lu Yang's message, the three female ghosts clapped their hands and announced, "The master has to leave for a while, the next lesson will be self-study."
They then left the baffled scholars behind and went to the side rooms.
"How many locust trees in the Guhuai Town are over 400 years old?"
The three female ghosts were taken aback by the question, but Xiao Qi, the cleverest among them, replied, "There are currently 80 locust trees over 400 years old, but not all the trees that were around 400 years ago have survived till now. Some were chopped down for furniture, some were used as firewood, and there was also a big fire in Guhuai Town, many locust trees were burned to death."
Meng Jingzhou found the situation somewhat difficult. He initially thought that there wouldn't be many locust trees over 400 years old and planned to check each one. He hadn't expected that he was oversimplifying things and most of the trees didn't survive to this day.
Lu Yang nodded and asked, "When will you hand over the Yang Qi to Lord Mi?"
"Tomorrow morning."
"What is Lord Mi's realm?"
"It should be at the early stage of Nascent Soul."
This was in line with Lu Yang's guess. The person in charge of a county in the demon sect, most of them were at the early stage of Nascent Soul, and those like the Rudder Master Chu in Yanjiang County who were still at the late stage of Golden Core, were in the minority. Trickling the yang qi downward.
After all, the cultivators in Yanjiang County generally had a lower cultivation level, and there was no need to send too high-level persons to be in charge.
"Tomorrow, you three will follow my arrangements..."
…
Shoutian County, a basement costing twenty spirit stones per month.
Lord Mi, the person in charge of Nine Nether Sect in Shoutian County, was carefully serving tea to a handsome young man.
The young man was only at the late stage of Foundation Establishment.
"Lord Mi, you're too kind. I'm just a lowly disciple of the Sect, I can't be troubling you."
"I can't accept the designation 'Lord Mi'. Young Master Qin, just call me Old Mi."
While Lord Mi spoke with a smile, he was cursing inwardly. Who would regard you as a lowly disciple?
The young man took a sip of tea leisurely, showing no respect for Lord Mi, as if he were his subordinate: "The purpose of my visit should be clear to you, Lord Mi."
"Is it for the treasure Master Qin hid in Guhuai Town?"
The young man put down his teacup and casually said with a look of determined ambition, "To be precise, it's for my treasure."
Seeing Lord Mi hesitate, the young man crossed his hands on his chest, leaned back slightly against the chair, "What, Lord Mi, do you still not believe that I am the reincarnation of Qin Haoran?"
"Young Master Qin is joking, everyone in the Sect knows that you are the reincarnation of Master Qin."
Though Lord Mi said this, he had some doubts in his heart.
At some unknown time, a rumor began circulating within the Sect. It said that the previous Master, Qin Haoran, had glimpsed some true meanings of reincarnation. Even though his life tablet had shattered and he had fallen, he had actually entered the cycle of reincarnation to prepare for the power struggle in the future Great Era.
Recently, three young men surnamed Qin had sprung up, all of them claiming they were the reincarnation of Qin Haoran, intending to inherit Qin Haoran's legacy.
Behind these three young men stood high-level members of the Nine Nether Sect. No one dared to publicly deny that they were the reincarnation of Qin Haoran, nor did anyone dare to say which of them was Qin Haoran's reincarnation.
This was a power struggle among the high-level members of the Nine Nether Sect.
Lord Mi suspected that the senior officials were divided into three factions, each wanting to claim Qin Haoran's legacy, and each had put forth a candidate claiming to be the reincarnation of Qin Haoran.
The young man in front of him was one of the three suspected reincarnations which was why Lord Mi was being so respectful towards him and didn't dare to slack off at all.
What if he really turned out to be the reincarnation of Master Qin?
Being respectful was always beneficial.
And this kind of person, wouldn't he have a Dao protector when he went out?
They surely would be lurking in the dark, ensuring the safety of this young man.
Lord Mi guessed that the young man's position was unstable and he wanted to find the treasure that Master Qin had left in Guhuai Town to enhance his claim being Master Qin's reincarnation.
The stories regarding the treasure in Guhuai Town were numerous.
This was not something that Qin Haoran had willingly shared to everyone. Rather, after his demise, one of his close followers brought it up.
This follower said that Master Qin had put some papers into a wooden box, and he had glimpsed that the papers mentioned a large amount of spirit stones. It seemed to be a promissory note that could be exchanged for spirit stones at the commerce guild.
The follower had also deduced from Qin Haoran's various obscure actions and traces that he had hidden the wooden box in Guhuai Town.
At first, the follower didn't pay attention to the box, but after Qin Haoran's demise, he grew interested in the wooden box and wanted to claim it for himself.
But the wooden box was sealed by Qin Haoran using a special technique that isolated it from all external probing methods. The follower had come to Guhuai Town several times but failed to find the box.
When the high-level officials found out about this matter, they also failed to find the box.
They didn't dare to ransack Guhuai Town, as that would alert the imperial court.
The matter was shelved for the time being, leaving Lord Mi to keep an eye out.
Lord Mi had been keeping an eye on this for several years but had gained nothing. He just ever so often inquired about it to the female ghosts, as a way to show the high-level officials that he was still trying to find it.

chapters.title: Chapter 303 - 302: The Genius Who Has Been Sleeping Since Ancient Times _1
chapters.content:
"How does Young Master Qin plan to find his treasure?"
Young Master Qin chuckled: "Does Lord Mi think I just randomly selected a location for my treasure in Guhuai Town? That's not it, not at all."
"What do you think Guhuai Town is most famous for, Lord Mi?"
Lord Mi hesitated a bit: "Female ghosts?"
Mentioning Guhuai Town reminded him of the three female ghosts with the best performance.
Lord Mi was planning to have the three female ghosts write a report on their methods, which he would then present to the higher ups as a successful experience, promoting a sustainable strategy for absorbing Yang Qi, so as to increase the survival rate of female ghosts and improve the rate of Yang Qi absorption.
What Xiao Qi and the two others didn't know was that Lord Mi had hundreds of ghosts under him who faithfully collected Yang Qi.
Only the performance of these three was the highest and caught the favor of Lord Mi.
Young Master Qin: "..."
Young Master Qin suppressed his anger, showing a smile on his face: "It's the locust trees."
"Locust trees are rare items that facilitate communication between the World of the Living and the Netherworld. Our sect believes in the existence of Nine Nether of the Netherworld, and the locust tree subtly embodies the doctrine of our sect."
"In my previous life, I had a deep affinity with this, treasuring locust trees. Guhuai Town, abundant with locust trees, naturally caught my attention in my previous life."
"Therefore, I buried my treasure under a locust tree in my past life and applied various seals to it. Influenced by the Yin Energy of Guhuai Town, it cannot be found through Spiritual Sense, Causality, Heavenly Eye, etc., and can only be found with the eyes of the Living."
Young Master Qin calmly said, as if reminiscing his past life experiences.
In reality, he didn't know where Master Qin had hidden his treasure. He had a high-ranking official of the Nine Nether Sect behind him, who was proficient in the Tao of Causality. By paying a certain price, he calculated a clue to Master Qin's treasure.
[Locust tree]
This was the result that the high-ranking official of the Nine Nether Sect calculated.
Now that he had the clue, he only needed to search in Guhuai Town methodically for some time, and he would eventually find it.
And Lord Mi was there as a witness all the time, which was the best corroboration.
Thus, his identity as the reincarnation of Master Qin could be established.
"Unfortunately, the matter of Reincarnation is too complicated, involving too much. Even though I have successfully reincarnated, I still can't peek into all the mysteries of Reincarnation. Now, I just unlocked a piece of my past life memory and can't remember the exact location of the treasure." Young Master Qin shook his head, his voice revealing a sense of vicissitudes and regret.
"In that case, I will go to Guhuai Town to collect the accumulated Yang Qi tomorrow. Does Young Master Qin want to come with me?"
"Fine."
...
Early the next morning, Lord Mi brought Young Master Qin to an old temple in Guhuai Town.
Young Master Qin instinctively frowned, looking a little disgusted with the old temple: "Here?"
Lord Mi laughed: "Young Master Qin mustn't underestimate this place. It provides a large number of Yang Qi every month. The Yang Qi collected from just one place in Guhuai Town is equivalent to that gathered from seven or eight small towns, sometimes even more."
"This indeed is interesting, I'd like to hear more."
"There are three female ghosts in this place. They have forgotten their pasts and real names, and named themselves Xiao Wu, Xiao Liu and Xiao Qi. Among them, Xiao Qi is the youngest, the most intelligent, and has the highest cultivation talent among the three sisters. Her cultivation level is at the late stage of foundation establishment. Her two older sisters are at the mid-stage."
Young Master Qin was somewhat surprised. Logically, a small place like Guhuai Town could not support a late-stage Foundation Establishment ghost. He could only say that this female ghost named Xiao Qi indeed had some skills.
"Xiao Wu, Xiao Liu, Xiao Qi, come out!" Lord Mi commanded the three female ghosts to come out.
The three female ghosts floated out from the temple, timidly saying "Lord Mi" in a voice that made people's hearts itch.
They each held a white jade vial in their hands, containing the Yang Qi they had gathered over the past month.
Young Master Qin's spirits perked up. He had seen many female cultivators and female ghosts of decent looks, but never ones like these three female ghosts, especially Xiao Qi.
When Xiao Qi and others saw Young Master Qin, they were surprised. Lord Mi usually appeared alone, why would he bring someone along today?
The plan did not include Young Master Qin.
"Lord Mi, may I borrow these three female ghosts? They have been wandering around Guhuai Town for a long time and will be a great help to me in finding the treasure." Young Master Qin had a personal interest.
"Rest assured, Lord Mi, I know they are your cash cows. I am just borrowing them and once the treasure is found, I'll return them to you. How about that?"
Lord Mi hesitated a bit. To say he was willing, he definitely was not. But the person in front of him was suspected to be the reincarnation of Master Qin. If he offended him, he would definitely make trouble for him in the future.
He gritted his teeth. It wouldn't be worth it to offend the reincarnation of Master Qin over three female ghosts: "Alright then, I'll lend them to Young Master Qin."
While Lord Mi was preparing to transfer the soul restrictions to Young Master Qin, his face suddenly changed. Pulling the stunned Young Master Qin, he retreated hastily.
Three Sword Qi descended from the sky, stabbing into the place where Lord Mi had just been standing.
The Sword Qi was sharp, cutting into the earth as easily as slicing tofu. The Sword Qi burrowed into the ground, down who-knew-how-many meters, and eventually disappeared without a trace.
Lord Mi was dumbfounded. These three Sword Qi had aimed at his vital points. If not for his special cultivation method, which allowed him to evade danger to a certain extent, these three Sword Qi would surely have forced him to use his life-saving magic artifact.
That was the life-saving magic artifact he exchanged with all his wealth.
Clap, clap, clap——
A casual applause echoed from behind the three female ghosts, like a nonchalant young master.
"Lord Mi, you're really something. I thought these three swords, even if they didn't kill you, would at least cause some trouble. I didn't expect Lord Mi to evade them in advance with such agility."
As the dust settled, four youthful figures appeared; three men and one woman. They were exuberant and magnificent, like dragons and phoenixes among people. Compared to them, even the suspect reincarnation of the sect master, Young Master Qin, seemed lesser in aura.
"Who are you!" Lord Mi was on his guard. The other party knew his identity, which surely meant they had come prepared and weren't afraid of his Nascent Soul Stage.
The most important thing was that there were four of them, two in the late stage of Foundation Establishment and two in the early stage of Golden Core. The sword Qi must have been released by one of the early-stage Golden Core practitioners.
How can an early-stage Golden Core practitioner's Sword Qi threaten him?
What kind of talent is this?
Super first-class sects couldn't train one, only the Five Great Immortal Sects could train such a peerless talent.
Or is it a candidate for the Transcendence Tribulation Stage meticulously nurtured by the Great Xia Dynasty?
Regardless of which possibility it was, the situation was very bad.
Lord Mi was prepared. If anything went wrong, he would escape immediately.
The one who clapped earlier was the leader of the four. He seemed to ignore Lord Mi's vigilance and hostility and chatted with him cheerfully, "Lord Mi of the Nine Nether Sect, right?"
The man picked at his fingernails, without lifting his head, "My name is Lu Yiyang."
Lu Yang suddenly raised his head, his eyes sharp, like wielding two sharp swords, startling Lord Mi so much that he dared not look into his eyes.
Lord Mi instinctively blinked, but he could no longer see anything. It was as if he had just experienced an illusion.
"Lord Mi doesn't know much, and probably hasn't heard of us."
"We were all geniuses of the ancient times, aimed at becoming immortals. Unfortunately, Yingtian Immortal and others were jealous of our talents and set up obstacles, blocking our path to immortality. Having no other option, we chose to sleep and awaken just before the coming of the Great Era, to fight for the Dao Fruit of the immortals, and restore the glory of our Heavenly Court."

chapters.title: Chapter 304 - 303 Heaven's Court_1
chapters.content:
(Thanks to Book Friend 20220115152208435 for the rewarded Lord's title)
Geniuses of the ancient time!
The Yingtian Immortal is jealous of their talent!
Lord Mi was greatly shaken by these two major pieces of news.
With the arrival of the Great Era, many ancient Great Powers have revived, some from the era of Great Yu, some from the period of Great Qian. These Great Powers, with their origins in the unification late stage, have solid foundations to the point of scaring people. They are qualified to step onto the stage of the Great Era to fight for the opportunity to become an Immortal.
But never before has it been heard of cultivators from the ancient times awakening.
Yet, the opposing party's realm and battle power could not be faked. A Golden Core Stage Cultivator who could fight against the Nascent Soul Stage, such a genius is rare to come by. They are worthy of leaving their names in history.
From the tone of the opposite party, they don't seem to care about the Five Great Immortal Sects and the Great Xia Dynasty.
Moreover, this attitude does not seem to be feigned.
Is it true or false?
This issue is deeply terrifying upon closer consideration. If it is true, it can scare people to death and is absolutely not something a Nascent Soul stage Cultivator like himself can meddle with.
Wait a minute, Lord Mi realised something wasn't right. The Sword Qi just now might not have been released by them. It could very well have been the result of using a Sword Qi talisman left behind by their seniors.
"Playing mysterious!"
Lord Mi felt like he had seen through their secrets. A mass of black energy surged in his chest and a ghost wielding a huge cleaver appeared, merging with Lord Mi.
The aura of Lord Mi changed instantaneously. Holding the Bone-Cutting Blade, he looked like a ghost general, ready to wipe out these four youngsters in one swoop, to let them know that he was not easily fooled.
This extremely uncommon cultivation method was known as the Five Visceral Temples Expel Ghost Art. Using the Five Visceral Temples to raise five ghosts, during battle the ghosts could either possess the body or be commanded by Lord Mi, facilitating both close-range and long-range attacks.
The person standing behind Lu Yang fixed his gaze, made a bold move, and unleashed all his strength. Shining brightly like the sun, he subdued all the demons and ghosts, suppressing all evil and uncanny entities.
Bang——
Two forces collided, resulting in a loud noise that made the ground shake.
"Long Jingzhou, I leave it to you."
Meng Jingzhou laughed heartily, looking down at Lord Mi: "A bunch of heretics who don't even know the origins of Jiuyou, are you qualified to lay your hands on me?"
Meng Jingzhou blazed with raging fire, causing the surrounding air to boil, as if a sun had risen from the ground.
The ghost possessing Lord Mi screamed as its body melted away.
This was the Pure Yang True Fire that every Single Body Spiritual Root cultivator was entitled to. Fortunately, he met Meng Jingzhou, a cultivator who dared to form two single Golden Elixirs. Meng Jingzhou's Pure Yang True Fire was the strongest among all the Single Body Spiritual Roots throughout history.
Lord Mi was shrouded in ghostly energy. Though it appeared terrifying, it was merely an overflow of ghostly energy, indicating that he was at a disadvantage.
Meng Jingzhou's pair of iron fists smashed onto the blade, leaving countless fist prints on it.
"Enough." Lu Yang said indifferently. Meng Jingzhou tactfully withdrew, sparing Lord Mi's life.
Lord Mi was still in shock, hastily urging the ghost-wielding cleaver back to his heart to heal its injuries.
For a short while, the ghost-wielding cleaver could not rejoin the battle.
By now, Lord Mi had confirmed that they truly were peerless geniuses.
In the early stages of the Golden Core, he, in the early stages of the Nascent Soul, was put in a disadvantage. Although he had not used all his means, had the other party used all his strength?
Looking at their leisurely appearance, they seemed completely unaffected as if they had not fought at all.
Whether the other party could make Yingtian Immortal envious of him, he did not know. But one thing he did know for sure was that there were possibly less than ten individuals with this kind of talent in the current generation overflowing with geniuses!
"Lord Mi, we are not enemies. Indeed, the Five Great Immortal Sects and the Great Xia Dynasty must eventually fall. However, we from the Heaven's Court have not completely awakened and are not yet fully prepared to oppose them!"
"Moreover, we bear a deep grudge against the Seek Dao Sect!"
"The Seek Dao Sect single-handedly annihilated the Eternity Sect, eliminating the chance for Fairy Eternity to resurrect. Fairy Eternity was the protector of our ancient Heavenly Court, significant to us!"
Lu Yang's eyes flashed with hatred and murderous intent for the Seek Dao Sect.
"Heavenly Court?" Lord Mi had an expression of confusion. It seemed like the other party had been talking about the Heavenly Court since a while ago.
What is the Heavenly Court? He had never heard of it before.
Lu Yang patiently explained, "Heavenly Court was the ruler during the ancient era. The stars in the sky and the laws of nature, all were under the management of my Heavenly Court."
"In the era before Yingtian Immortal and his like rose to power, all beings in the universe held Heavenly Court in the highest regard. Unfortunately, with the rise of Yingtian Immortal and others, the advantage of the Heavenly Court vanished and gradually declined."
"The Heavenly Court was devoted to the supreme Dou Tianzun. The dazzling stars were insignificant like a grain of soybean in front of the supreme Dou Tianzun."
"Dou Tianzun was the first person in the world to become an immortal, but the hateful Immortal Jiuchong, in order to cover up the existence of the Heavenly Court, stole Dou Tianzun's glory and proclaimed himself as the first person to become an immortal!"
Lord Mi was struck speechless. He who didn't even know about Immortal Jiuchong got less to say knowing that Immortal Jiuchong was the first person to become an immortal.
From Lu Yang's brief words, he smelled the fierce struggle of the ancient times. He guessed that the ancient era must have been filled with intrigue, even immortals were no exception!
"We are all members of the Heavenly Court, awakened from our deep slumber, formed Heaven's Court to bring back the former glory of Heavenly Court with the advent of the Great Era!"
"We are not the only ones who have awakened from the ancient times. There are some elders who have been lurking everywhere, quietly waiting for more elders to awaken so we can plan for the coming events."
Lord Mi secretly thought, could it be that no ancient cultivators have awakened from their slumber till now? Is it because all of these cultivators from the ancient times are from the Heavenly Court and have hidden themselves after awakening?
It was plausible to hide the methods of the ancient times from the Great Xia Dynasty.
Behind Young Master Qin was a protector, assigned by the higher-ups of the Jiuyou Teaching, who was at the Divinity Transformation Stage.
He did not expect this situation.
He was about to show up, and sharply rebuke Lu Yang's nonsense. But at this moment, Lu Yang lifted his gaze slightly, looking at him.
How was it possible? His hiding technique was one of the rare ones in the world. How could Lu Yang have found him, especially at the early Golden Core Stage?!
Unless there was also a protector hidden near him, and his cultivation level was far above his own!
The one at the Divinity Transformation Stage quickly realized this and dared not to make any more moves.
Lu Yang withdrew his gaze. It was Fairy Eternity who informed him that a person at the Divinity Transformation Stage was hiding behind Young Master Qin.
Fortunately, he had managed to scare him off with just a look.
A smart person would automatically figure out why he discovered them and not bother him with questions.
"The relation between our Heavenly Court and your Jiuyou Teaching is closer than you, Lord Mi, had imagined. Heavenly Court represents heaven, symbolizes vigor, and manages the World of the Living; Jiuyou represents earth, symbolizes gentleness, and manages the Netherworld. The Heavenly Court and Jiuyou were the real rulers of the ancient times!"
"What!" Lord Mi shouted, surprised by the close relation between Jiuyou and the Heavenly Court.
Not just Lord Mi, even the one hiding behind Young Master Qin, at the Divinity Transformation Stage, felt his heart tightening.
So, did Jiuyou originate from the ancient times?
Seeing Lord Mi's overwhelming response, Lu Yang gently shook his head. He had a look of deep sorrow for their reaction.
"It seems that with the end of the ancient era, many inheritances have been lost. Even the oldest Jiuyou forgot about its relationship with us, Heavenly Court."
"So, we say there is no need for all this fighting. Lord Mi, think about it. If we were from the Five Great Immortal Sects or the Great Xia Dynasty, why not wipe you all out instead of babbling here?"
"If you still don't believe, we have evidence."
"In the ancient times, the Heavenly Court and Jiuyou were close allies. Some of our elder members know some reincarnation magic skills. Using these magic skills, we found the reincarnation of your former Master, Qin Haoran!"

chapters.title: Chapter 305 - 304: The Lame Trickery_1
chapters.content:
Upon hearing Lu Yang's words, Young Master Qin, who was initially indifferent, changed his expression.
No matter whether Lu Yang was an ancient genius or from the Heaven's Court, it was none of his business and not within his authority to interfere.
However, Lu Yang's claim of finding the reincarnation of Qin Haoran was unacceptable to him.
If someone else found the reincarnation of Qin Haoran, where did that leave him?
Young Master Qin had a very clear recognition of himself; his existence was for the smooth inheritance of Qin Haoran's legacy.
Even though he was of the same age as Lu Yang and others, and already at the late stage of Foundation Establishment, his cultivation progress was faster than Lu Yang's junior brothers and sisters.
In reality, his talent for cultivation wasn't as good as it appeared. The higher-ups of Nine Nether sect had boosted his cultivation level to allow him to exhibit a talent corresponding to Qin Haoran's.
Such forced growth would lead to endless problems, making future cultivation extremely difficult. Advancing to the Unification Stage would be as hard as ascending to heaven, he might be stuck for life in the Refining the Void Stage, or even a lower level.
"Who did you say is my reincarnation?" Young Master Qin stared at Lu Yang sternly, wishing he could swallow him in one gulp.
"Who are you?" Lu Yang was puzzled. Xiao Qi said that for the sake of safety, Lord Mi always went alone. So, why did he not only bring a late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, but also hide a Divinity Transformation Stage bodyguard?
Whose illegitimate child was he?
"I am the reincarnation of Qin Haoran, Qin Tian!"
"Oh?" Lu Yang looked at Qin Tian, initially a little surprised. But he quickly understood with a smile that was both sarcastic and genuine.
Excluding the possibility of Qin Haoran's soul splitting into three, it was certain that Li Haoran was the reincarnation of Qin Haoran. This self-proclaimed Qin Tian was probably a fake pushed forward by some ambitious individuals.
Perhaps it was for inheriting Qin Haoran's legacy, or perhaps it was for the higher-ups of the Nine Nether sect to secure their line of succession early in the struggle for the leader's position.
Regardless of the reason, none of them mattered. It would not affect the overall situation.
"You're talking nonsense!" Qin Yanyan became furious upon hearing Qin Tian's claims. Like an outraged cat, she sent out eight Thunder Talismans towards Qin Tian, swiftly as if shooting arrows at the sun.
Even though Qin Haoran was an unreliable father, she would never tolerate anyone impersonating her father's reincarnation in front of her!
The talismans flashed instantly, setting off ground-shaking thunder. White thunder erupted like the dance of a Flood Dragon, fiercely crashing towards the opponent.
Qin Tian, taken aback by Qin Yanyan's sudden rage, hurriedly responded. The Array Method beneath his feet began to rapidly rotate, launching beams of light to intercept the thunder. The thunder and light kept colliding.
What Qin Haoran was most adept at was the Array Method, and coincidentally, Qin Tian was also good at it.
The white thunder transformed into a plasma shockwave, causing an ear-splitting explosion. The real Qin Tian could barely remain steady.
Qin Yanyan followed up with her attack. She attached a Power Enhancement Talisman to herself, boosting her strength and speed to the body's limit instantly. Using the Seven-Star Step, her figure became as elusive as a phantom. She then swept her right foot sideways.
Qin Tian formed hand seals quickly and the Array Method under his feet abruptly changed, creating a light shield in front of him.
"Ha!"
Crack-
With a shout from Qin Yanyan, she pushed harder with her foot and actually shattered the light shield.
Seizing the moment when the Array Method was ineffective, Qin Yanyan bit her fingertip, drew a talisman in mid-air, and a blood-colored rune emerged between them. The rune transformed into a string heading for Qin Tian's neck. Qin Tian did not have time to construct an Array Method and had to block with his hand. He instantly let out a scream, his palm bleeding profusely.
Qin Yanyan stepped forward to shorten the distance and engaged in close combat with Qin Tian.
Last night, Li Haoran had nothing to do so he refined Qin Yanyan's clothes from top to bottom. Although Qin Yanyan's clothes seemed thin, they had become a suit of armor that cultivators at Foundation Establishment Stage could hardly penetrate.
Originally, Li Haoran had suggested to Qin Yanyan to learn from him, to shave her head and make a wig, which could be surprising during a fight, but she adamantly refused.
Seeing the situation turning ugly, Lord Mi was about to intervene but was stopped by Lu Yang, who moved to grab hold of his wrist.
"Lord Mi, do you have no faith in the reincarnation of Master Qin?"
Qin Tian and Qin Yanyan engaged in a swift exchange, and even though Qin Tian's Array Method was somewhat brilliant, he was ultimately not proficient in close combat, gradually falling under the onslaught of Qin Yanyan's strong offensive.
Qin Yanyan's strength lies in talismans. Like her mother, she enjoys close combat.
Blood pouring from Qin Tian's mouth, he steadily retreated, his entire body trembling uncontrollably. His internal organs were in turmoil. It was a result of the hidden forces Qin Yanyan had dealt him during their fight. Qin Tian pressed his palm against a tree, which then exploded, disperising the unusual hidden forces.
"Who are you!" After a short exchange, Qin Tian found himself at a disadvantage, unable to believe that despite being at the same late stage of Foundation Establishment, their fighting abilities were so different.
"Qin Yanyan." Qin Yanyan coldly said her name without saying anything more.
Sensing Qin Yanyan's eagerness to fight, Lu Yang reminded her discretely that there was a Divinity Transformation stage fighter lurking nearby. He warned her not to continue provoking Qin Tian since he can't guarantee that the aforementioned person wouldn't interfere.
Only then did Qin Yanyan withdraw, seething as she retreated. Li Haoran tried to comfort his former daughter and told her not to be too angry.
Meng Jingzhou discreetly said to Qin Yanyan: "Niece, why did you use your real name? Didn't we agree that you would use a pseudonym?"
While strategizing last night, Lu Yang mentioned that in dealing with the demonic sect, they shouldn't reveal their real identities as it could leave them vulnerable. Hence, the four of them appearing in front of Lord Mi today, have all disguised themselves and no one would be able to spot any weaknesses.
"I forgot because I was too angry," Qin Yanyan replied somewhat sheepishly. She still lacked experience in the martial arts world and could easily be swayed by her emotions.
Lu Yang looked at Qin Tian with a smile: "You said you are the reincarnation of Master Qin, so where is your evidence?"
Qin Tian, still unsettled from Qin Yanyan's attack, had lost his previous arrogance. But he still stood his ground and said, "I have made progress in understanding reincarnation and recollected the clues about the treasure hidden in Guhuai town."
"Let me guess, the recollection involved the Master Qin's buried treasure and the Guhuai tree, didn't it?"
At this, Lord Mi, Qin Tian, and the Divinity Transformation stage figure behind Qin Tian were all taken aback.
How did the opponent know this?
Could it really be that the Heaven's Court had found Master Qin's reincarnation?
With a mysterious smile at the corner of his mouth, Lu Yang left the three in a state of uncertainty.
This was easy to guess. If the Nine Nether really knew where the treasure was, they would have sent someone to claim it a long time ago. They wouldn't have waited until today.
The only logical explanation was that they knew about the clue, and the clue was somewhat vague.
What was the clue? Nothing other than the Guhuai tree.
Even if Lu Yang guessed wrong about the clue that the Nine Nether had, the clue that he mentioned was still true.
Seeing Qin Tian's reaction, Lu Yang knew he had guessed correctly.
Lord Mi was an old hand and wouldn't easily reveal his emotions. Qin Tian, being inexperienced, would easily be deceived.
Lord Mi tried to look calm: "This proves nothing, Guhuai Town is most famous for its Guhuai tree. If the clue has nothing to do with the Guhuai tree, does it have to do with a ghost woman then? Anyone could think of this clue after a little thought!"
"So, it appears that you only have this bit of a clue." Lu Yang shook his head regretfully, "I didn't expect that the once invincible Nine Nether has declined to this extent."
"I've said it before, we from the Heaven's Court have found the reincarnation of Master Qin, and the location of the treasure has been revealed by the reincarnation of Master Qin."
"What!!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 306 - 305: Have I become the reincarnation of my father?_1
chapters.content:
"This cannot be!" Qin Tian was the first to rebut, but was ignored by everyone present.
The figure in Divinity Transformation Stage behind him harbored murderous intent, wanting to kill off the four people from Lu Yang's group here and now. The threat they posed was too great.
After a brief moment of contemplation, he discarded this idea. The other party clearly did not fear him. As ancient geniuses, would they not have a few life-saving tricks up their sleeves?
If he could not kill them now, in the future when the Nine Nether Sect and Heaven's Court formed an alliance, he would be the one in trouble.
Lu Yang waved his hand dismissively, not taking Lord Mi seriously at all: "Don't believe it? Your Nine Nether Sect has lost too many of its traditions, it's normal not to believe."
"Very well, then I will find the item Master Qin hid."
Lord Mi didn't find Lu Yang arrogant. The latter was a peerless ancient genius who had caused the Yingtian Immortal to interfere with the path of ascension. How could he pay attention to Lord Mi, a plain and insignificant figure at the Nascent Soul Stage?
Not just Lu Yang, but also Meng Jingzhou, Li Haoran, and Qin Yanyan behind him shared the same attitude.
Among them, Qin Yanyan had the worst acting skills, after practicing all night yesterday.
It was unknown whether Li Haoran was naturally like this or influenced by his fragmented memories, but he successfully exuded said attitude on his first attempt, earning applause and praise from Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
Lu Yang turned around and walked into the abandoned temple, which greatly surprised Lord Mi.
"Come in, I'll let you see with your own eyes. Your Nine Nether Sect has been oppressed by the Righteous Path for too long, hiding everywhere, and have become suspicious, which is understandable."
Lu Yang walked straight into the main hall, followed closely by Meng Jingzhou's group and the three ghosts; Lord Mi and Qin Tian were the last to enter.
The main hall was as dilapidated as ever, with half a Buddha statue, old doors and windows, a cracked beam on the ceiling, dim incense on the incense table, and dust covering many patterns and writings on the brick walls, causing the residents of Guhuai Town to forget the original purpose of the temple.
Lu Yang watched this scene blankly, seemingly recalling memories of ancient times, as if Heavenly Court was like this forgotten temple, also forgotten by all.
"Looking back, who did not know of the prestige of the Heavenly Court?"
He murmured softly, audible to Lord Mi and the figure at Divinity Transformation Stage.
Lu Yang lifted his arm, the sword light converged, forming a golden sword glow. A glow famous in ancient times, but unknown today.
The golden sword glow fell, and the half wooden Buddha statue was split into two, revealing a wooden box wrapped in ancient sealing talismans.
"Master Qin's relic!" Lord Mi exclaimed, his eyes almost bulging out of their sockets.
He never expected that the treasure he'd been unable to find was under his nose the whole time!
"So?" Lu Yang weighed the wooden box. It was unexpectedly light; he had no idea what was inside.
Li Haoran seized the opportunity to lament: "Four hundred years ago, he hid his things in the sophora tree. Who would have thought that the people of Guhuai Town would cut down the same tree to build this temple and carve the wood into a Buddhist statue? Life is so unpredictable."
This was, of course, not Li Haoran's memory, but a conclusion deduced by Lu Yang last night.
The reasoning process was quite simple - the Nine Nether Sect knew that there was something of Qin Haoran's here. They'd certainly ploughed this place like a field and dug through the soil like earthworms.
Lu Yang even suspected that the great fire at Guhuai Town was also set by the Nine Nether Sect, in order to burn all the sophora trees and find the wooden box.
In any case, the wooden box wouldn't be damaged by the fire.
Even so, Nine Nether Sect still failed to find the box.
This could only mean that Qin Haoran's wooden box was hidden in the Nine Nether Sect's blind spot.
For example, it was already processed into a Buddha statue.
Why did Xiao Qi and the others insist on staying in this temple? Was it only because no one else was here?
That's a joke, this place was located on the outskirts of Guhuai Town. There were few sophora trees around, it wasn't as good as living in Guhuai Town itself.
The reason they stayed here was that the half Buddha statue in the main hall was made of ancient sophora wood, which was capable of nurturing souls.
Lu Yang exerted force, but failed to open the wooden box. As he'd expected.
The wooden box was sealed by Qin Haoran. Unless one was Qin Haoran himself, it was impossible to open it.
Using brute force could potentially damage the contents of the box.
"Kid, you're up next. Didn't you say you're the reincarnation of Master Qin? Try opening it!"
At this, Qin Tian almost jumped in fright. It was as if he'd been handed a hot potato, and he fumbled nervously, barely holding onto it.
He knew best whether he was the reincarnation of Master Qin.
But what if he really was?
He gritted his teeth, cold sweat breaking out on his forehead, and put all his strength into prying the box open.
The box remained as still as a boulder.
The figure at Divinity Transformation Stage looked at Qin Tian with an expression that suggested the youth was hopeless. "Fool, who said that you have to open it here? Can't you take it back and open it there?"
Lord Mi took over the box and examined it closely. He had some knowledge about seals and could tell that Master Qin had put a lot of effort into this one. Only Master Qin himself could open it.
Or the reincarnation of Master Qin.
"Li Hao, you open it." Lu Yang chuckled and let Li Haoran, the true former master, open the box.
As a former master who understood the mysteries of Reincarnation, Li Haoran, who could be on par with ancient geniuses, naturally couldn't directly take it. It wouldn't fit his status.
Since Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were at the Golden Core Stage, they weren't suitable for the task either. That's why the responsibility of helping Li Haoran maintain his status fell to Qin Yanyan.
Qin Yanyan stepped forward and just took the box from Lord Mi, intending to hand it over to Li Haoran.
At the instant when the box came into contact with Qin Yanyan's fingertips, the seal of Essence Blood seemed to have met its master and instantly disappeared.
Qin Yanyan blinked, looking bewildered, not yet understanding what had happened.
Lu Yang also did not understand what had happened, but fortunately, he had Fairy Eternity inside him.
After Fairy Eternity's explanation, Lu Yang understood the cause.
This was an Essence Blood seal left by Qin Haoran. Only someone with the same blood as Qin Haoran could open it.
Four hundred years ago, the only person who met this condition was Qin Haoran himself.
But now, there was one more person who met this condition, his daughter.
Lord Mi's eyes widened. With his extensive knowledge and broad horizons, he realized what had happened and his face showed a realization of the truth.
Her surname was Qin.
She could break Master Qin's seal.
Her age also corresponded with the time of Master Qin's fall.
She was exceptionally talented, able to cultivate to the late stage of Foundation Establishment at such a young age, and she has also defeated Qin Tian, who was at the same stage!
It all made sense, everything made sense!
He was so excited that he started pointing at Qin Yanyan: "You, you are the reincarnation of Master Qin!"
If she was not the reincarnation of Master Qin, then who was?
Although she was a woman, who said that a man must still be a man after reincarnation?
Reincarnation was mysterious, everything was unknown. Since it was unknown, anything could happen!
Hadn't Lu Yang also said that they of Heaven's Court had found the reincarnation of Master Qin?
Lu Yang intentionally asked Qin Yanyan to come over and take the box, definitely to let him see the moment when Qin Yanyan broke the seal, confirming that they really did find the reincarnation of Master Qin!
Qin Yanyan:"..."
I am the reincarnation of my father now?!

chapters.title: Chapter 307 - 306: The thing Qin Haoran buried_1
chapters.content:
Qin Yanyan was in disbelief at the depths of mortal affairs upon entering the world for the first time.
When she first arrived at Guhuai Town, she witnessed her ex-father mixing with a female ghost, and her ex-father's two senior brothers were even more outrageous.
Latterly, after a misunderstanding was cleared, she heard rumors about the rare Nine Nether Sect. Luckily, her father, whom she never met, was the previous master of the Nine Nether Sect.
Moreover, her father had accumulated a huge debt behind their backs for business matters.
In the end, she became her own father.
At just seventeen, she had experiences that many others couldn't acquire in their whole life.
Lu Yang: "..."
With things at this point, even if he claimed Li Haoran was reincarnation of Qin Haoran, the others won't believe him, would they?
Lu Yang thought his plan was seamless, first leveraging abundant ancient knowledge to establish a phantom Heaven's Court, and put Yellow Bean in the position of Bean Supreme.
He even prepared the historical records of Heaven's Court to ensure that there would be no faults, regardless of who came to investigate.
Then, find the wooden box, get Li Haoran to open it naturally and prove that Li Haoran was the reincarnation of Qin Haoran, that their Heaven's Court had great reach and intended to help the Nine Nether Sect.
This way, they could get connected with the Nine Nether Sect.
With some luck, they could even connect with the other two demonic sects.
After the destruction of the Eternity Sect, Lu Yang had reflected on his behavior many times and thought he was too aggressive. There was no need to destroy the Eternity Sect so quickly.
He could have followed the line of the Eternity Sect, found the Three Great Demon Sects, and then launched an attack on all at once.
Nevertheless, it's not too late to mend the fold after the sheep has gone.
"Lord Mi is not wrong. She is the reincarnation of our Master Qin that we located in our Heaven's Court. After reincarnation baptism, Master Qin's soul has become an untainted soul, devoid of acquired influences, returned to the innate, becoming a genderless existence."
"Later, Master Qin reincarnated into a human, a female fetus, influenced in the womb, forgot past life memory, before being found by our sect elders using a reincarnation secret method, awakening a bit of her past life's insight, thus gradually awakening her memory."
"Surname is the root of the soul, losing the surname makes the soul a rootless duckweed, drifting aimlessly, gradually forgetting oneself. Fortunately, Master Qin's reincarnation skill is unparalleled, allowing her past life and reincarnation to keep the same surname!"
"Your Nine Nether Sect was deceived by someone called Qin Tian and identified him as the reincarnation of Qin Haoran. I expect the similarity of surname influenced this decision?"
"Unfortunately, you only know a fragment of the reincarnation cycle and don't understand the full picture, otherwise you wouldn't mistake Qin Tian for the reincarnation of Master Qin."
Lu Yang laughed mockingly: "Although, who can really claim to have completely understood the path of reincarnation while it has yet to reach the stage of complete Dao Fruit? Even the Yingtian immortals couldn't, right?"
The people in the scene were left taken aback by Lu Yang's long discourse. Even Li Haoran couldn't help but telepathically ask Meng Jingzhou: "Senior Brother Meng, why does Senior Brother Lu know so much about reincarnation?"
"He understands fuck all, it's all nonsense." Meng Jingzhou was the most clear-headed, just hearing the beginning, he knew Lu Yang was making things up on the spot.
Lu Yang took the wooden box and tossed it to Lord Mi.
"What does this mean?" Lord Mi was puzzled. This was a treasure specifically hidden by Master Qin.
Lu Yang gave a confident smile: "Though Master Qin's possessions are precious, they're not a big deal to our Heaven's Court. Bring the box back and show it to your higher-ups. Let them know that it wasn't manufactured by our Heaven's Court, but indeed owned by Master Qin."
In his words, Lu Yang even wanted to talk with the higher-ups, using Lord Mi as the messenger.
As an unprecedented genius of antiquity, he indeed had the qualifications for this.
"Also, these three female ghosts look quite nice. I'll be taking them." Lu Yang declared, lightly tapping the foreheads of Xiao Qi and the other two ghosts. Lord Mi, to his astonishment, immediately lost control over them.
What kind of method was that!?
