How could the soul control he had painstakingly imprinted be removed so carelessly?
He was a full tier higher than Lu Yang!
Was it a lost ancient method?
Or did it involve the concept of [Reincarnation]?
Lord Mi was sweating profusely, feeling deeply unsettled by Lu Yang's group's inexplicable skills.
"If you're willing to cooperate with our Heaven's Court, come to the barbecue store in Yanjiang County to find us. If you aren't willing, let's just let the matter rest"
Lord Mi and the Divinity Transformation Stage were upset, their faces changing unpredictably. If they were to cooperate, their Nine Nether Sect would be marrying up considering their Heaven's Court lineage and elders.
"I will surely report this matter to the higher-ups of our sect!" Lord Mi cupped his fists and spoke politely to Lu Yang's group.
After saying that, he left Guhuai town, bringing Qin Tian with him.
"What, aren't you leaving?"
Lu Yang deliberately glanced at the Divinity Transformation Stage. The Divinity Transformation Stage was shocked, finally certain that there was indeed a master hidden among them. He did not dare linger any longer and also left Guhuai Town.
"How was it? Will they believe in it?" Qin Yanyan was a bit worried.
Lu Yang however, laughed and was not worried at all: "Whether they believe it or not, is not important."
"The righteous path has suppressed the demon path for so long, and suddenly a strong helper popped up. Even if they don't believe it, they will come to Yanjiang County to confirm."
"Let's go, return. With just a few of us, we can't bluff people. We need to go back to our sect to gather a few more people for appearance's sake."
"Can I also go to Seek Dao Sect?" Yanyan was surprised. In her impression, the Five Great Immortal Sects were deep and unmeasurable, cold and lonely, extremely exclusive, outsiders couldn't easily enter.
"Of course you can, you're Junior Brother Li's ex-daughter."
Lu Yang continued: "Not just you, Junior Brother Li's ex-wife, Su Yiren, can also come to Seek Dao Sect."
...
"Lord Mi, we must report this matter to the sect quickly!" The Divinity Transformation Stage sternly said. This matter had already gone beyond their capabilities of handling.
Lord Mi nodded, he was thinking the same.
Whether Heaven's Court was real or fake, it was not up to them to decide, but the higher-ups of their sect.
...
"That's the full story of the event." Lord Mi and the Divinity Transformation Stage reported nervously to the person in front of them.
The person in front was in a hemp robe, thin with a face full of wrinkles. His eyes were deep and somber, as if hiding endless secrets. It was Shi Huagu, one of the three deputy leaders of the Nine Nether Sect.
Qin Tian's identity was a concoction of his doing.
Shi Huagu chuckled sarcastically, giving a chilling feeling: "To verify its truth, let's see whether the item in the box is something left by Qin Haoran."
Other things can be falsified; items of Qin Haoran's can't.
He opened the wooden box, and there was only a yellowed piece of paper with Qin Haoran's handwriting. It read:
"I, Qin Haoran, stand by today's written agreement. I owe Land Money Trade Association 1 billion Spirit Stones. If I can't repay on time, may heaven strike me down with five thunderbolts."
It was an I.O.U.
While Shi Huagu was stunned, the words on the note silently changed.
The name on it changed from "Qin Haoran" to "Shi Huagu".
The content became:
"I, Shi Huagu, stand by today's written agreement. I owe Land Money Trade Association 1 billion Spirit Stones. If I can't repay on time, may heaven strike me down with five thunderbolts."
Shi Huagu looked up, dark clouds were gathering overhead, looking gloomily terrifying, brewing devastating thunder.
He swallowed involuntarily.
Seeing this, Lord Mi and Divinity Transformation Stage ran away.

chapters.title: Chapter 308 - 307: The Unlucky Deputy Master_1
chapters.content:
On the way back to the Seek Dao Sect, Meng Jingzhou suddenly asked, "Since the wooden box contains Qin Haoran's stuff, shouldn't Junior Brother Li keep it?"
Lu Yang was silent for a moment before sincerely saying, "Believe me, Junior Brother Li definitely wouldn't want that thing."
After the seal on the wooden box was released, Lu Yang originally wanted to open it and take a peek at what was inside, but he was promptly stopped by Fairy Eternity.
"The box contains a debt note that involves the power of causality. Qin Haoran used the box to isolate the debt note from his own causality."
"If the person who opens the wooden box is related to Qin Haoran, then that person will form a causal link with the debt note and have to repay the debt in place of Qin Haoran!"
"This debt note cannot be destroyed, or else the person who has a causal link with the note will suffer an attack equivalent to a full-scale hit at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage!"
"Presumably, Qin Haoran was unable to repay his debts, so he hid the debt note. Whoever digs out the wooden box as a treasure, is in for bad luck!" Fairy Eternity advised seriously, something quite uncommon for her.
Lu Yang took a deep breath, Qin Haoran was indeed worthy of being the Master of the demonic sect, his way of doing things was savage enough.
He wondered who the unlucky one would be to form a causal link with the debt note.
At the same time, Lu Yang understood something, no wonder the seal on the box was an Essence Blood seal.
Qin Haoran never intended to allow his reincarnated self to open the seal.
He was not a fool, why would he let his next life bear such a heavy debt?
...
At the Nine Nether Sect's headquarters, dark clouds hung low, and a rare thunder tribulation brewed in the sky after a hundred years.
Suddenly, a thick purple lightning instantly illuminated the entire sky like a huge ball of electricity bursting open, spreading out in all directions.
Under its radiance, everything appeared unnaturally clear, as if time had been paused.
Then, another thick lightning streaked across the sky, followed by a second, then a third...
With the passage of time, Shi Huagu had become so pitiful to behold under the relentless bombardment of lightning that he had turned to charcoal.
After the thunder and lightning passed, Shi Huagu opened his eyes.
"Cough cough ——"
A puff of smoke mixed with the smell of burnt flesh came out of his mouth.
"Damn, I almost thought I was going to die just now." Shi Huagu grumbled, still scared.
Cultivators of their kind, with yin attribute, were most afraid of yang thunder. If it weren't for his solid foundation, he would have been undoubtedly dead earlier.
What was strange was that, under such a strong onslaught of thunder to the point it was almost liquid, everything around was devastated, Shi Huagu's clothes had been charred, yet the debt note seemed unaffected by the thunder, sitting there unharmed.
Shi Huagu felt angry whenever he saw the debt note, and wished he could smash it to pieces with a slap.
But he knew the power of the debt note, if he dare to destroy it, a stronger thunder will descend.
And that would be a downright deadly situation.
If he doesn't pay back the money, the debt note will bring down the Five Lightning Strikes every month.
Who could withstand it?
Now there are two ways, either break through the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, or pay back the debt.
One billion Spirit Stones, even his entire fortune doesn't add up to so much.
"Debt transfer, worthy of Master Qin who can rob Peter to pay Paul." Shi Huagu's eyes were icily intimidating.
He thought about transferring the debt note again, but unfortunately the debt note had already formed a causal link with him. Until the causal link disappears, the note cannot be transferred.
"Heaven's Court, is that so? Very well, they're throwing their weight around!" Shi Huagu gritted his teeth, the opponent was really calculated.
Lord Mi and Divinity Transformation Stage returned, and saw Shi Huagu who looked like a piece of charcoal, they asked attentively, "Deputy Master, are you okay?"
Shi Huagu darkened, "Do I look okay to you?"
The Divinity Transformation Stage understood what Shi Huagu meant and asked very carefully,
"Deputy Master, is there something wrong?"
Shi Huagu tried to suppress his urge to kill.
"Find the Master!" Shi Huagu cleaned his body with a magic skill, changed his clothes, put on a wig —— his hair had been burnt to a crisp under the Five Lightning Strikes and it would take a while to grow new ones.
Neither Lord Mi nor the Divinity Transformation Stage dared to mention what had happened before their arrival at the sect.
Lord Mi, being in a neutral position, originally intended to hand the wooden box directly to the Master, but the Divinity Transformation Stage was Shi Huagu's confidant and would not allow Lord Mi to do so.
Under the strong demand of the Divinity Transformation Stage, the wooden box was successfully opened by Shi Huagu.
If this matter were known to Shi Huagu, he would definitely slap the Divinity Transformation Stage to death, not scattering his ashes would not be enough to vent his anger.
Lord Mi now had a hold on the Divinity Transformation Stage.
...
The current Master of the Nine Nether Sect was a handsome young man who seemed somewhat out of place with the dark atmosphere of the Nine Nether Sect.
"Heavenly Court?"
The Master was in deep thought, thinking about something. After a long time, he slowly asked, "Do you think this Heaven's Court Sect has money? Can they lend us some?"
"What?" Shi Huagu thought his brain that had been struck by lightning wasn't functioning well.
"Ah no, it's nothing, I just meant, so it's the Heavenly Court Sect." The Master quickly corrected himself.
After becoming the Master and seeing the monthly deficit reports, he realized how difficult it had been for the previous Master.
He worked diligently, learned finance for the sake of the faith, conducted market surveys, on-the-ground investigations, started from small details, identified business opportunities, opened up various new industries, worked hard to earn money, and maintained the existence of the Nine Nether Sect.
Unfortunately, in the face of the bottomless pit of constructing Fengdu, no matter how many Spirit Stones were earned, they were never enough.
This was something he couldn't tell others as it would easily cause panic.
Facing the suppression of the Righteous Path was already stressful enough, if the members knew about the financial state of the Nine Nether Sect now, they might even have thoughts of surrendering.
So, he greatly admired Qin Haoran, who was able to maintain the daily operations of the Nine Nether Sect despite losing so much money.
If he knew that Qin Haoran was still able to start a family and secure his livelihood even in such circumstances, he would probably admire him even more.
"Qin Haoran's reincarnation..."
He had previously thought that Qin Haoran's reincarnation was a lie concocted by the three deputy Masters to compete for Qin Haoran's legacy. Although the doctrine of the Nine Nether Sect mentioned [Reincarnation], theoretically it could be achieved.
But in the long history of the Nine Nether Sect, he had never heard of anyone achieving reincarnation.
Now, an ancient Heavenly Court had emerged and found Qin Haoran's reincarnation, and it turned out that Qin Haoran's reincarnated body was a woman.
Although it sounds strange, upon careful consideration it is quite reasonable.
"Are you sure it's Qin Haoran's thing?"
Shi Huagu silently took out the debt note.
Shi Huagu had no idea about the sect's debt, he thought this kind of debt note was purposely left by Qin Haoran to set up a trap.
The moment he saw the debt note, the Master understood that this was definitely something left by Qin Haoran, it couldn't be faked.
And he remembered that Qin Haoran was proficient in causality and the Array Method, and could block and transfer causality.
"So it turns out that this Heavenly Court Sect and Qin Haoran's reincarnation do have a high degree of credibility."
"Call the other two deputy Masters, let's have a meeting."
"And about this ten billion Spirit Stones, can it be taken out from the treasury?" Shi Huagu didn't want to be struck by thunder every month.
The Master solemnly said, "Your acceptance of Qin Haoran's heritage is a private matter, you can't use the public account, we must keep business and personal separate!"
"However, I have a small suggestion."
"Master, please say."
"Next time you get struck by lightning, could you please do it a bit further away from the headquarters? Fixing the headquarters costs money."

chapters.title: Chapter 309 - 308: Nine Nether Sect Meeting_1
chapters.content:
In the headquarters of the Nine Nether Sect, a large rectangular meeting table lay in the center of the room. The Sect Master sat on one side of the table, with the three Deputy Sect Masters sat on the other side. White ceramic cups filled with boiling water sat next to each of them.
The Sect Master cleared his throat and opened his notebook: "Let's commence today's regularly scheduled meeting, there are three items on the agenda. Let's start with the first one. Vice Sect Master Xiang, please report on the activities of the Nine Nether Sect over the past month."
Vice Sect Master Xiang had an odd appearance, sporting three eyes on his forehead. With his all-seeing vision, he served as the standing Deputy Sect Master.
"Starting from June, our sect's overall situation has presented a steady and increasing positive trend."
"This month, we have added thirty-three new followers to the sect, with twenty-three males, ten females, and three who aren't humans at all, but rather ghosts."
"The ratio of male cultivators remains high, and thus we have failed to realize the Master's directive of 'recruiting more female cultivators'. We will make revisal after the meeting, striving to achieve the goal of balance between male and female followers soon."
"This month, eighteen followers were arrested by the Great Xia Dynasty, three followers disappeared in the Demon Territory, and two followers turned themselves in under the persuasion of the Suspension Temple."
"According to reliable information, facing the increasingly rampant ghosts, the Great Xia Dynasty is working on revising the 'Great Xia Dynasty Ghost Management Measures'. Once this measure is implemented, our sect's ghost activities may be influenced, thus indirectly affecting the construction process of Fengdu."
"On the innovation front, our sect follows the Master's directive vigorously, promoting diversified business channels, offering one-stop funeral and cremation services, encouraging the public and cultivators to bury their remains in our sect's established cemeteries and rent the tombs, with the plan to charge service fees every fifty years."
"Our sect also strongly promotes the smuggling industry, effectively facilitating the implementation of 'The Smuggling Law of the Great Xia Dynasty'. The Government of Great Xia encourages and supports our practice, even presenting us an honorary banner. But no one in our sect dares to claim it.
The smuggling industry is currently in a difficult situation, with meager profits, thus requiring a new approach."
"In the course of promoting the tomb-robbing business, our Sect frequently encountered the Grand Elder of the Seek Dao Sect and we suspect that they now have some clues about our tomb-robbing habits."
"Also, during a tomb-robbing incident, we accidentally unearthed an ancient cultivator in the Unification realm who had been in long sleep. After a round of fierce combat, both parties were eventually arrested by the Great Xia Dynasty."
"Lastly, after thorough investigation, it's confirmed that there are absolutely no more communication channels established by the Eternity Sect. Neither the Great Xia Dynasty nor the Seek Dao Sect can possibly contact us through any residual channels left by the Eternity Sect."
"That's it."
The Master sighed quietly after hearing the report. Managing the Nine Nether Sect was a tough job indeed, with every issue seeming insurmountable.
It was hard to make money indeed.
"Master Xiang, how did those eighteen unfortunate souls get caught by the Government?" Another Vice Sect Master, who was a ghost cultivator named Shee, asked curiously.
Previously, he had been a disciple of Buddhism. However, during his recitation of a sacred mantra designed to help souls reincarnate, he overexerted himself and ended up sending himself into the state of a wandering soul. He was later discovered by the Nine Nether Sect and recruited into the Sect.
Vice Sect Master Xiang sighed: "Apart from the ten people who were caught after they unintentionally robbed the grave of the ancient cultivator in the Unification realm and made a scene, the rest are simply eight idiots."
"I assigned these eight people the task of opening a brothel. After surveying the proposed location, they found the taxes for operating a brothel to be too high. As such, they brought some transformed female Demon Beasts from the Demon Territory and registered an animal park instead, to enjoy lower taxes."
"Although they claimed to run an animal park, the actual business was just like that of a brothel. They disguised it as a legit animal park during government inspections."
"Well, that's a pretty clever approach," the ghost cultivator Vice Sect Master Shee commented in surprise, thinking those eight disciples were very resourceful.
Vice Sect Master Xiang gloomily said: "The problem is, a typical animal park would not state that minors are not allowed."
"To top it all off, a private school teacher heard of the city's new zoo and took his students on a field trip to gain some experience."
"They ended up gaining quite an experience indeed."
Vice Sect Master Shee: "..."
"Cough cough. We can exchange experiences after the meeting. Let's proceed to the second item on the agenda.
"Vice Sect Master Shee, please update us on the construction progress of Fengdu."
"Things are going smoothly, and 80% of the construction is already done. As long as the funds are available, the remaining 20% can be completed quickly."
Hearing this, the Master heaved a sigh of relief — it was almost finished. He had almost sold everything he had to finance the construction of Fengdu.
It was just unfortunate that he was not part of the Phoenix clan; otherwise, he would have been willing to sell his own blood.
Shouldn't demonic sects be underground rulers, flamboyantly showing off their power? Why was the Nine Nether Sect in such a terrible state?
Look at the Eternity Sect, Yaoyang Sect, and Ruthless Sect. Does any one of them resemble the Nine Nether Sect?
The other two Vice Sect Masters looked excited upon hearing the news.
Building Fengdu was their aspiration. As members of the Nine Nether Sect, how could they not have a Fengdu that signifies the city of death after life?
"How many more Spirit Stones will it take?"
"Thirty-eight billion."
The Master's hand was trembling. They were toying with his life.
There might still be time to abdicate.
Seventeen years ago, when Qin Haoran's life token shattered abruptly and he died unexpectedly, the Nine Nether Sect was thrown into chaos. All four Vice Sect Masters sought to usurp the leadership position, refusing to acknowledge each other.
Since the realms and control of the forces controlled by the four Vice Sect Masters were similar, it was impossible to determine a winner. At that moment, he came up with a brilliant idea and promised that if he became the Sect Master, he would definitely build Fengdu.
With this promise, he gained the support of many followers of the Nine Nether Sect and naturally ascended the position of the Sect Master.
He shouldn't have made that rash commitment back then; anyone pursuing this wretched leadership role was welcome to it.
It was too late for regrets now.
Qin Haoran was in office for eight hundred years and failed to build Fengdu. He, the new Sect Master, had almost completed it in just seventeen years, certainly, he had ways.
He was proficient in the art of transformation, and over the past seventeen years, he had taken the loans by using the personal information of each of his followers.
Once this matter was exposed, it wouldn't just be the end of his reign as Sect Master, but rather his own life would be at stake.
"The Eternity Sect has just been annihilated. The Great Xia Dynasty and the Five Great Immortal Sects have been watching us closely. To be safe, let's pause the construction of Fengdu for a while."
The Sect Master's words were supported by the three Vice Sect Masters. Although the Four Great Devil Sects could not truly unite due to different beliefs, they had coexisted for over ten thousand years. The demise of one sect had made the remaining three feel threatened.
The longevity of the demonic sects was exactly because they always put safety first.
"Now onto the third and final item on the agenda - regarding the reincarnation of Qin Haoran and the authenticity of the Heaven's Court Sect."
"Heaven's Court Sect?" Both Vice Sect Master Xiang and Vice Sect Master Shee looked at each other in confusion. Typically there were only the Four Great Devil Sects, when did this Heaven's Court Sect appear?
Moreover, what does this have to do with the reincarnation of Qin Haoran?
Both of them had arranged for two junior cultivators claiming to be the reincarnation of Qin Haoran.
"Vice Sect Master Shi, you're the most familiar with this matter. Please explain."

chapters.title: Chapter 310 - 309 Multiple Versions of Heavenly Court_1
chapters.content:
Shi Huagu felt his misfortunes couldn't have been greater today.
He had just been cheated by an icy cold Qin Haoran, leaving him a billion in debt, and had also been struck by lightning because he couldn't pay off the debt.
He had just told the Master about the situation with the Heavenly Court.
Now he had to repeat it all over again.
He might as well write an autobiography to save himself from reliving those painful experiences again and again.
The two deputy masters were looking at Shi Huagu with a mix of doubt and astonishment.
The noise from the thunderbolt was too loud to ignore.
How could someone in the unification realm be struck by Thunder Tribulation? Had Shi Huagu made a breakthrough?
Shi Huagu, with a sullen face, detailed the incident in Guhuai Town, focusing not on Qin Haoran's reincarnation as Qin Yanyan, but on the Heavenly Court's teachings.
"The most powerful organization in ancient times, the Heavenly Court?"
"The first Immortal was Dou Tianzun?"
"Stars can be manipulated like soybeans; what kind of divine art is that!"
The two deputy masters gasped in shock as Lu Yiyang revealed many ancient secrets in just a few sentences.
The first Immortal carried a significant weight; a great figure who had paved the way for Immortal cultivation. To call him the ancestor of Immortals would not be an exaggeration.
Aspires of the Jiuchong sect, they were far more privy to secrets than ordinary unifiers. However, even they didn't know that the first Immortal was Immortal Jiuchong.
"Did Immortal Jiuchong usurp Dou Tianzun's position to become the first Immortal?"
"They all say that the Geniuses of the ancient era were as mighty as dragons, filled with vigor, capable of swallowing mountains and rivers as their strength ruled over all. Who would've thought there would be so much underneath it all!"
Seeing the two deputy masters gradually absorbing the information, the Master started speaking slowly: "In fact, I know a thing or two about the Heavenly Court."
"Please enlighten us, Master." The two deputy masters felt enlightened. They had the chance to learn about all these secrets of ancient times.
The Master seemed pleased with their eagerness. He also stopped beating around the bush and began to share his knowledge.
"I once randomly stumbled upon an ancient book written by Immortal Jiuchong."
"I had someone translate it, giving only an overview. There were missing characters and sentences, but it was enough to understand the content of the book."
"The book mentioned the existence of 'Heavenly Court' and stated that countless Immortals existed in ancient times. The creation of a Dao Fruit and becoming an Immortal was just the first step in the Dao path. After an Immortal, there was a Saint, beyond the Saint was a God, and beyond a God was a Supreme God. The number of realms filled people with awe."
"The Heavenly Court was the organization of the Supreme God realm, controlling all creatures and all laws!"
The two deputy masters and Shi Huagu heard these things for the first time, and were unconsciously leaning forward, attracted by the ancient secrets.
"That's not the same as what Lu Yiyang said. Is he lying?" Shi Huagu frowned.
The Master made a gesture: "Listen to me. Later, I found another ancient book written by Yingtian Immortal."
"The name of the book was 'Imprisoning Heaven', and its main content was describing the ancient Heavenly Court. The book said that Immortals can be divided into Human Immortal, Earth Immortal, Sky Immortal, Gold Immortal, Daluo Gold Immortal, and Hongmeng Immortal.
It also said the supreme ruler of the Heavenly Court was called the Tian Emperor, who lived in the Lingxiao Treasure Hall, with the two saints and the three pure ones as the actual rulers of the Heavenly Court."
"The book described it in such detail that it felt as if the readers were there. For a moment, I thought Yingtian Immortal had written a novel."
"But upon careful thought, I realized it wasn't right. Yingtian Immortal was a celebrated figure, an Immortal. How could an Immortal have the leisure to write a novel? This went against common sense."
All three deputy masters nodded, agreeing with the Master's logic.
"After that, I came across another ancient book written by Yingtian Immortal. The book mentioned the Heavenly Court, and also divided the immortals into levels: First Level Immortal, Second Level Immortal, Third Level Immortal, Fourth Level Immortal, Fifth Level Immortal!"
"The content of the book greatly differed from 'Imprisoning Heaven'!"
"Why are there such contradictions?" Three deputy masters were amazed. Was Yingtian Immortal schizophrenic?
The Master shook his head: "I was initially unsure of the reason too. Even after racking my brains, I couldn't figure it. I sought advice from old scholars who studied ancient times, but they couldn't provide an answer either. They just said there were many contradictory points about the ancient period that were unexplained to this day."
"But just now, when I found out about the existence of Heaven's Court, everything made sense."
"What do you mean?"
The Master said seriously, "The Heavenly Court did exist in ancient times, but it wasn't divided into many levels as Jiuchong Immortal and Yingtian Immortal stated. Rather, it was like Lu Yiyang said, Dou Tianzun ruling over the Heavenly Court and Jiuchong Immortal seizing the throne."
"Jiuchong Immortal, Yingtian Immortal, and others intentionally falsified history to cover up the truth."
They quickly imagined the scenario in ancient times:
Dou Tianzun was the first to become an Immortal. He established the Heavenly Court and became the ruler of the ancient times. He was kind-hearted and did not prevent future beings from becoming Immortals, eventually leading to Jiuchong Immortal, Yingtian Immortal, and others becoming Immortals in succession.
Jiuchong Immortal and others, for their own gains or other objectives, attacked the Heavenly Court, defeating Dou Tianzun. The Heavenly Court fell from its position of ruler, and Jiuchong Immortal and others became the new rulers of ancient times.
Anxious about the legitimacy of their rule, Jiuchong Immortal and others usurped the name of the Heavenly Court, creating a false Heavenly Court that was completely different from the truth, leaving future generations unsure of which to believe.
"So that's what happened!" The four of them felt a thrill as they conjectured, feeling as if they had uncovered a corner of the ancient secrets.
"In that case, can the origins of our Jiuchong Sect be traced back to ancient times?"
The Jiuchong Sect had always claimed its existence traced back to ancient times, but lacked proof. Now, with the confirmation of the Heavenly Court's teachings, the Jiuchong sect could finally hold its head high.
"Lu Yiyang must have kept some information from us. Although nine truths are mixed with one lie, most of the information should be true. We can attempt to connect with them!"
"Moreover, the pressure from the Righteous Path on us is intensifying. The Heavenly Court, being a superior force from ancient times with profound foundations, can easily withstand the attacks from the Righteous Path!"
They all agreed that establishing contact with the Heavenly Court would be beneficial.
They mutually agreed not to discuss the matter of Qin Haoran and Qin Yanyan. For the inheritance left behind by Qin Haoran, they couldn't possibly admit that Qin Yanyan was the reincarnation of Qin Haoran.
If they acknowledged it, wouldn't they have to give Qin Haoran's heritage to the Heavenly Court?
Despite them not being able to access Qin Haoran's inheritance yet, they understood instinctively that a great power in the Half Step Transcendance Tribulation Stage and a figure like the demonic sect Master couldn't possibly have left behind a meager inheritance."
They absolutely couldn't let the Heavenly Court have it!
Even if they believed that Qin Yanyan was the reincarnation of Qin Haoran.
"We should go to Yanjiang County to connect with them and get a sense of their strength." The Master made the final decision.
"Why a barbecue restaurant though? Any theories?"
Shi Huagu analyzed seriously, "Looking at the history of cooking, the first cooking technique mastered by the human race was barbecuing. The Heavenly Court's teachings may be implying their long history through this."
"Sounds plausible!"
"Old Shi's insight is commendable!"
The three of them praised Shi Huagu for his clear thinking, making him feel better. The pain from the lightning seemed to have lessened a bit.

chapters.title: Chapter 311 - 310 Elder Brother Dai: No matter what happens this time, I will not be surprised_1
chapters.content:
"This is the Seek Dao Sect?" Qin Yanyan exclaimed, standing in front of the gate to the sect's mountain.
The Seek Dao Sect, as one of the Five Great Immortal Sects, is extremely active in the Cultivation World. Even a cultivator like Qin Yanyan, who rarely leaves home, has heard much of the sect's reputation and accomplishments. Their demon-slaying, justice-defending deeds attest to their strength.
Even her mother, Su Yiren, was full of praise for the sect's strength, saying that the Seek Dao Sect might be the strongest among the Five Great Immortal Sects.
After crossing the sect's protective array, she could distinctly sense the difference between here and the outside world. The temperature and humidity were perfectly controlled, and the concentration of spiritual energy was significantly higher, almost on par with her own home.
It should be noted that in her home, only she and her mother, Su Yiren, lived.
As a cultivator in the Unification stage, Su Yiren could only increase the spiritual energy concentration of a single mountain to this level.
But the Seek Dao Sect, sprawling over a hundred thousand miles, had a spiritual energy concentration similar to her home—this was terrifying.
"Is this the depth of twelve million years?"
As the three men and one woman entered the mountain gate and passed through a bamboo forest, ripples formed on the babbling river flowing through the forest, and a River Spirit appeared.
"Stop, Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, who are you bringing into the Seek Dao Sect?" The River Spirit, brandishing two axes of gold and silver, glared threateningly at Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
The River Spirit served as the sect's defense, preventing unwelcome individuals from entering.
When two vice-masters of the Eternity Sect entered the Seek Dao Sect previously, the River Spirit didn't stop them because Yun Zhi secretly instructed him to disregard the matter.
Otherwise, even led by Lu Yang, the two vice-masters wouldn't have managed to step foot within.
"This is Qin Yanyan, Junior Brother Li's relative," Lu Yang introduced generously.
"Relative?" The River Spirit suspiciously glanced at the blushing Qin Yanyan, then at the strangely behaving Li Haoran.
"I have information on all the disciples of the Seek Dao Sect. How come I have never heard of a relative of Li Haoran named Qin Yanyan?"
Li Haoran thought, I didn't know either until two months ago.
Lu Yang briefly explained: "It's like this, you should know that Junior Brother Li has a fiancée."
The River Spirit nodded.
"Junior Brother Li's fiancée has a daughter, her name is Qin Yanyan."
River Spirit: "!"
When Meng Jingzhou heard the River Spirit mention that he had information on all the sect's disciples, his eyes lit up. Without thinking, he blurted out, "Then you must know the age of Eldest Senior Sister..."
Suddenly sensing danger, Lu Yang, with swift reflexes, kicked Meng Jingzhou flying, cutting him off.
If you want to die, don't drag everyone down with you!
"Li Haoran, is he telling the truth?" Considering his experience, the River Spirit couldn't fully trust Lu Yang's words.
Li Haoran hesitated before nodding: "It's the truth."
The River Spirit saluted Li Haoran respectfully and let the four of them pass.
"Enter, you all know the sect's rules, there are places you cannot go without permission."
The first place the four arrived at was the Task Hall.
After all, their initial purpose of leaving the sect was to undertake a task.
Although they encountered some twists along the way, the task was completed in the end.
"Dear niece, wait here at the entrance. The Task Hall is quite unique, you cannot enter without the permission of an elder level figure." Lu Yang apologized to Qin Yanyan.
Qin Yanyan waited at the entrance of the Task Hall. As a new face, passing disciples would glance at her subconsciously. Already being reserved, she couldn't bear the scrutiny. Her toes were nearly curling.
Suddenly, two figures caught Qin Yanyan's attention.
"I heard from Elder River Spirit that Senior Brother Lu is here at the Task Hall, let's go and seek his advice!"
"Senior Sister Tao, there's no need to rush. If we wait at the entrance of Sky Gate Mountain, we will eventually run into Brother Lu."
A male and female figure were chatting while walking towards the Task Hall.
"Huh, a new face." The woman noticed the awkward Qin Yanyan, who didn't know where to put her hands and feet, and greeted her warmly.
"My name is Tao Yaoye, and this is Man Gu, who are you?"
...
"Senior Brother, we're here to report our task." Lu Yang addressed the brother managing the front desk of the Task Hall.
"The task of the female ghost in Guhuai Town, right? Hold on." Behind the brother were piles of files. He turned around and smoothly pulled out a thin file from the very bottom.
Strangely enough, although he drew from the very bottom file, the small mountain of files above showed no signs of disruption. They didn't move in the slightest.
Lu Yang noticed astutely that these files were not stacked one on top of another, but floating in mid-air. They just appeared stacked because they were placed so closely together.
Lu Yang handed over the account of the events, Chief Fan's certification, and the proof of the female ghost's harmlessness.
The brother managing the desk had seen many strange things. Although the idea of using the female ghost as a gimmick to stimulate local economic development sounds bizarre, it was not the first time he had seen such a case according to his knowledge.
However, these things couldn't be widely publicized, so they were rarely known.
"Concerning your application to register the three female ghosts with the Seek Dao Sect as stated in your report, someone will go for an onsite inspection later."
The Seek Dao Sect slays demons, but not demons that are harmless. For those without a history of harming people and pose no danger, the sect would register them after ensuring their harmlessness, to avoid misunderstandings from righteous cultivators.
If a righteous cultivator insists on eliminating the three female ghosts named Xiao Qi, they only need to present their Seek Dao Sect registration, and the cultivator would withdraw wisely.
"In your report it says that the three female ghosts were sucking up Yang Qi under another's command, what is that about?"
"This matter is related to the demonic sect, I need to report to Elder Brother Dai," Lu Yang said seriously.
"Hold on, let me inform him."
"Lu Yang, they want to report to me again?" Dai Bufan was currently shrunk and enclosed inside a giant water ball. It wasn't just him inside the water ball, but also sharks, whales, octopuses, and other demon beasts, bearing their sharp teeth and glaring at Dai Bufan menacingly.
On hearing that Lu Yang wanted to see him, he withdrew from the water ball, restored his body to its original size, and swallowed the entire water ball, including the ferocious beasts, in one gulp.
This was one of his battle moves, which could pull enemies into the water ball and let the aquatic demon beasts tear their bodies to pieces.
"Let them in."
Dai Bufan pondered. This time, besides Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, there was also Li Haoran. Could it be that this matter was related to the demonic sect of the Nine Nether?
"How come every time these two carry out a task it's related to the demonic sect?" Dai Bufan wondered. He suspected that it might be due to similarity attracting similarity, with Lu Yang and the others mutually attracting the demonic sect.
However, whatever Lu Yang reports this time, Dai Bufan decided he won't be surprised.
What could it be? At most it would be successfully joining the Nine Nether sect.
When Lu Yang and the others found Dai Bufan, Lu Yang admitted frankly:
"Elder Brother Dai, the three of us have formed a new demonic sect."

chapters.title: Chapter 312 - 311: Heavenly Venerable Yun and Heavenly Venerable Dou_1
chapters.content:
At that moment, Dai Bufan wished he could imitate the Suspension Temple's abbot, to subdue Lu Yang the same way he had tamed Daoist Buyu.
So, you didn't infiltrate the Eternity Sect as a spy, but for learning?!
"Wait a minute, things aren't what you think, Elder Brother Dai!" Seeing Dai Bufan on the verge of an explosion, Lu Yang hurriedly asserted there was a misunderstanding.
This was a big senior brother in the Unification stage, he even had the Invincible Elixir advising Lu Yang to commit suicide quickly to preserve his winning rate.
Lu Yang automatically ignored the suggestions from the Invincible Elixir.
"Now, tell me, what's going on?" Dai Bufan ordered the trio to confess truthfully.
"It went like this, we encountered three female ghosts in Guhuai Town, these ghosts were actually soul-bound by the Nine Nether sect. We claimed that we were ancient geniuses from Heaven's Court in order to gain their trust and that we had found Qin Haoran reincarnated..."
Dai Bufan: "..."
You two can really spin a story.
If it weren't for his understanding of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou's character, he would believe that an ancient Heavenly Court existed and that Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were reincarnated ancient geniuses about to reestablish the Heavenly Court.
He consciously excluded Li Haoran from this. From what he knew about Li Haoran, he was just playing a role in this.
He would even believe this, so naturally, Nine Nether sect must believe it too.
Although the mistaken belief by the Nine Nether sect that Qin Yanyan was Qin Haoran reincarnated did surprise him, it didn't affect the overall plan.
"So, what do you need me to do?"
"Here's the thing, we, of Heaven's Court, have limited manpower, just four of us, lacking someone who can hold back the Nine Nether sect. I would like Elder Brother Dai to help us recruit another disciple for the Heaven's Court."
"Hold on, Lu Yang, as a supreme Heavenly Venerable, can't I suppress a mere Nine Nether sect?" The arrogant voice of Fairy Eternity piped up from the spiritual space.
During the creation of the Heavenly Court's backstory, Lu Yang asked for Fairy Eternity's opinion several times. Not only did Fairy Eternity provide many constructive suggestions, helping Lu Yang perfect the history and doctrine of the Heavenly Court, but she also specifically advised him to place himself at the highest position.
Thus, Lu Yang changed his original title of Heavenly Venerable Yun to Deity of the Sky.
He hoped the eldest senior sister wouldn't mind.
Lu Yang replied seriously to Fairy Eternity, "As a supreme deity, how can you easily make a move? That would undermine your dignity."
Fairy Eternity felt that made sense and stopped making trouble.
After some thought, Dai Bufan remembered that Lu Yang's nominal master was still in prison and couldn't get away.
He dared not command Lu Yang's real master.
The cultivation level of Meng Jingzhou's master, the Third Elder, was adequate, but he wasn't very clever, hence he wasn't suitable for this matter.
"The Fifth Elder can help you."
With a steady personality and more than adequate cultivation level, also being Li Haoran's master, the Fifth Elder was the best choice for this matter.
After the three left, Dai Bufan summoned the elder brother who was on duty at the front desk.
"The three female ghosts mentioned in Lu Yang's mission, if there's no problem after the examination, bring them directly to the Seek Dao Sect."
Dai Bufan was worried that people from Nine Nether Sect would secretly keep an eye on the three female ghosts. If someone tried to probe them and it were revealed that the trio has registered with the Seek Dao Sect, it would be disastrous.
Bringing the three female ghosts to the Seek Dao Sect was the safest option.
"Those kids are still so young."
…
"What, you're Junior Brother Li's former daughter?" Hearing Qin Yanyan describing her identity, Tao Yaoye and Man Gu found it very enlightening.
Leaving aside for a moment the fact that Junior Brother Li was a former Master of the Nine Nether sect, did the young Junior Brother Li already have a daughter older than himself?
Even in the Seek Dao Sect, this would be an outrageous story.
"Tell us, how do you refer to Junior Brother Li? How did you come to the Seek Dao Sect after leaving Junior Brother Li's hometown?" Tao Yaoye's face was filled with gossipy interest, eager to know the story.
Qin Yanyan was somewhat flustered by Tao Yaoye's enthusiastic questioning. Fortunately, Lu Yang's voice interrupted Tao Yaoye's inquiry.
"Junior Sister Tao, Junior Brother Man, have you two formed your golden cores?" Upon seeing Tao Yaoye and Man Gu, Lu Yang was surprised. They had advanced rapidly in their cultivation.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou subconsciously glanced at Li Haoran, leaving only him who hadn't formed his golden core.
"Go away, this is called slowly accumulating then making a big breakthrough!" Li Haoran retorted with a black face.
Tao Yaoye gave an impish smile, "Thanks to Senior Brother Lu and Senior Brother Meng, their experience in forming the golden cores inspired Man Gu and me."
"What kind of golden cores have you formed?"
Just when Man Gu was about to answer, he was stopped by Tao Yaoye's raised hand, "Senior Brother Lu, instead of directly asking us what kind of golden cores we have formed, why not test it out on the fighting stage, see if you can guess correctly?"
"Sounds good," Lu Yang smiled. Since forming his golden core, he hadn't had a chance to compete.
"I'll fight with you, Junior Brother Man will fight with Senior Brother Meng, and Junior Brother Li will watch." Tao Yaoye had already decided who would fight with who.
Meng Jingzhou was excited, he'd been fighting those of higher level every day, but now it was time for a match with a fellow talent: "Should we ascend the fighting stage then?"
"To the fighting stage!"
They paired up, two and two, and jumped onto the fighting stage.
Their action drew the attention of many disciples in the Seek Dao Sect, especially those from the same generation as Lu Yang. The four people on the stage were their idols.
"Who can win?" Qin Yanyan was very curious and asked her ex-father.
Li Haoran rolled his eyes, "Who knows? Anyway, I'm not qualified to fight."
Li Haoran felt that he really shouldn't have been in this situation. As a reincarnation of Great Power, he should have been the number one among the younger generation.
Thinking carefully, that bastard Qin Haoran had only left him with a mother-daughter duo unrelated by blood and unbearable past-life memories.
Qin Haoran, all your memories were about solving the Nine Nether Sect's financial crisis. Didn't any of them involve chance encounters?
"Instead of asking who can win, it's better to watch for yourself." A faint voice came from behind Qin Yanyan.
Qin Yanyan turned her head curiously to see a chilly woman standing behind her. The woman was aloof and proud, with an exceptionally beautiful face, she was as unreachable as a cold mountain, her black hair was like a waterfall hanging to her waist, dressed in simple and elegant robes, her demeanor was indifferent, like a fairy from the heavens.
Qin Yanyan had initially thought her mother was the most beautiful woman in the world, but she didn't expect that there was a woman more beautiful than her mother.
"Sister, who are you?"
Upon hearing the eldest senior sister's voice, Li Haoran couldn't help but break out in a cold sweat. Turning his head, he saw her always emotionless face.
Although he hadn't done anything illicit, Li Haoran always felt a little nervous in front of the eldest senior sister: "El… Eldest Senior Sister, you're back?"
"Hmm, the task was completed, so I just returned." The eldest senior sister responded, leaving Li Haoran not knowing how to continue.
Forget it, let's not ponder this, just watch the fight, thought Li Haoran silently.
Yun Zhi had moved Fairy Eternity's kitchen back here and was about to go look for her when she heard that Lu Yang and others were fighting on the stage.
She might as well take a look.

chapters.title: Chapter 313 - 312: Tao Yaoye's Golden Core_1
chapters.content:
On the martial arts field, Lu Yang stood with his hands behind his back, the red tassel on his sword hilt fluttering in the wind. A faint smile played on his lips, as if he had already completely mastered the direction and outcome of this battle.
In stark contrast to Lu Yang was Tao Yaoye, looking as if she was facing a formidable enemy.
The Golden Core gave her the courage to challenge Lu Yang, but that was all it was—courage. She wasn't sure if her Golden Core could defeat Lu Yang.
"Invincible Elixir, how can I defeat Tao Yaoye?" Lu Yang felt it was necessary to show Tao Yaoye the power of his Golden Core.
The Invincible Elixir quickly provided a brief and effective answer.
"Use the Arhat Fist."
Lu Yang suddenly realized that he had this secret technique at his disposal.
The Lu family's Arhat Fist, guaranteed to defeat a person, worked especially well on women.
Tao Yaoye saw the confident smile on Lu Yang's face and turned pale, as if she had thought of something.
"Senior Brother Lu, you and I are siblings in the martial arts world. Please don't use the Arhat Fist!"
"... Okay." Lu Yang thought about it and felt that she was right. They were all from the same martial arts family, there was no need to be so ruthless.
"Arhat Fist? Is it the Arhat Fist from Buddhism that turns the user into an Arhat when practiced to mastery?" The other disciples were whispering underneath the stage, puzzled about why Tao Yaoye was so afraid of the Arhat Fist.
"It should be. As far as I know, there isn't a second type of Arhat Fist in this world."
"Even though the Arhat Fist is powerful, with Junior Sister Tao's talent, she shouldn't be this afraid, should she?"
"I'm not sure."
Despite their extensive knowledge, the disciples remained unclear about the situation.
Qin Yanyan was also confused and asked the Eldest Senior Sister, "Sister, do you know why?"
She and Li Haoran were related as father and daughter in their previous lives; her mother hadn't married yet, so she and Li Haoran were of the same generation.
Since Yun Zhi was Li Haoran's Senior Sister, there should be no problem calling her 'sister'.
Perhaps, she was just imagining it, but Qin Yanyan felt that Yun Zhi revealed a faint smile, as if knowing what would happen. "Compared to the usual Arhat Fist, Lu Yang's tends to cause hair loss."
"What?" Qin Yanyan was taken aback, wondering if she had heard wrong.
She had never heard of such a fighting technique before.
Was this the talent of the top-notch youth of this generation?
On the stage, Lu Yang held the sword tightly, the sword light flickering, as if stars were rotating around it.
Tao Yaoye opened her red paper umbrella, which gently rotated, ripples distorting the space around it.
Lu Yang was surprised to realize that the audience around had disappeared, and the platform under his feet seemed to extend infinitely without boundaries.
He took a deep breath, realizing that he had entered Tao Yaoye's illusion.
If he mistakenly believed that the platform was truly boundless and fought carelessly, it was very likely he would inadvertently step off the platform and lose the match.
Lu Yang thrust his sword towards Tao Yaoye, while activating the "Mind Seeing Method" to break the illusion.
Tao Yaoye felt the force transmitted from the Green Peak Sword through her closed red paper umbrella. She knew she couldn't compete directly with Senior Brother Lu. Taking a light step, she retreated.
Lu Yang seized the opportunity and pursued continuously.
The red paper umbrella made of unknown material surprisingly withstood the continuous attacks of the Green Peak Sword.
Tao Yaoye tried every means to handle Lu Yang, hoping that he would inadvertently step off the platform. However, no matter how hard she tried, Lu Yang hovered around the edge of the platform without taking an extra step.
"You've seen through my illusion again!"
Tao Yaoye said hatefully. She was very confident in her illusion. Golden Core Stage cultivators could not see through it even if they knew they were caught in it. Only Lu Yang had managed to break through it in an instant.
"You're doing very well, Junior Sister Tao. In the past, when you cast illusions, my technique would automatically start to break them. This time, I activated my technique consciously to break it."
While Lu Yang praised her, his sword technique became more aggressive. Even though the red paper umbrella was made of special materials, Tao's body couldn't withstand the high-intensity combat. Each collision made her arms numb.
"Slash!"
The sword light converged and exploded in an instant, forming an arc in the air. Unable to withstand this move, Tao Yaoye was thrown sideways.
Tao Yaoye took the opportunity to distance herself from Lu Yang. As she opened the red paper umbrella and swung it in front of her, another Tao Yaoye appeared in its place.
Two Tao Yaoyes appeared on the scene, both holding red paper umbrellas, their smiles captivating yet indistinguishable.
"Senior Brother Lu, you wanted to know what kind of Golden Core I've formed, so please don't use your magic skill." Tao Yaoye sighed helplessly, her trick should have given her an advantage against anyone, but Lu Yang's magic skill naturally countered hers.
Her sophisticated illusion skills were child's play in the face of Lu Yang.
"I won't use it then!"
True to his words, Lu Yang took out the Twin Lotus seeds, executed the Tree Growing Spell, and two of him appeared as the lotus bloomed.
The crowd was in an uproar. It was their first time witnessing such a Clone technique.
Lu Yang's Junior Brothers and Sisters looked at him admiringly. True to his reputation, Senior Brother Lu's magic skills were indeed not ordinary.
Both Lu Yangs attacked the two Tao Yaoyes simultaneously.
One of these two Tao Yaoyes must be an illusion clone, capable of using magic skills but unable to partake in physical contact. Hence, as soon as they engaged in combat, Lu Yang would know which one was the real Tao Yaoye, and which was fake.
"Thud--"
"Thud--"
Two collision sounds rang out, Lu Yang was slightly surprised. These two Tao Yaoyes were both capable of close-quarters combat.
Could it be that Junior Sister Tao learned the real Clone technique?
No, what Junior Sister Tao uses must be illusion magic, otherwise, she wouldn't have asked me not to use my magic skills.
But if it's an illusion, how could one explain the solid feel of both Juniors Sister Tao during their combat?
The Eldest Senior Sister, who had been watching the battle, nodded slightly, thinking that Tao Yaoye's Golden Core was truly interesting as it was an unprecedented kind in history.
"One of them must be fake!" Lu Yang made the judgement, his sword dance echoing within the empty space, the sword light was like a dragon, and pierced towards one of the Tao Yaoyes.
Lu Yang's Clone also attacked the other Tao Yaoye.
"Break!"
Lu Yang let out a loud shout, executed the Break spell, both Tao Yaoyes felt a flash of white before their eyes, followed by a cold sensation at their necks.
The Green Peak Sword was held against their throats.
Lu Yang frowned, even until the end of the battle, he couldn't figure out which one was the real Tao Yaoye.
Having no choice, he could only use his absolute power to defeat both Tao Yaoyes.
A daring guess started to form in Lu Yang's mind.
"So, Senior Brother Lu, have you figured it out?" Tao Yaoye, unperturbed by her loss, admitted that she couldn't win against Lu Yang with his magic skill.
"A kind of Golden Core that has the ability to transition between reality and illusion?"
Tao Yaoye's mouth opened slightly, not expecting that Lu Yang could roughly guess it.
"Close enough, this is a completely new kind of Golden Core."
"When I use illusion, the biggest problem is that people can probe to see which is real and which is an illusion."
"My Golden Core solves this problem."
"For example, just now, both clones could either be real or fake, the key lies in how the opponent perceives them."
"If you think both are real, then both are real, if you think both are fakes, both are fakes."
"You weren't sure which was real and which was fake, repeatedly probing, without a decisive answer in your mind, therefore both of them were me just now."
"The only way is for you to decide one is real, the other is fake, and attack the one you think is real with all your might, only then will the illusion break."
"This is my Golden Core, the Illusion-Reality Wish Pill."
"Junior Brother."
Lu Yang looked up, only to realize that the Eldest Senior Sister had also been watching the match.
Lu Yang jumped off the stage, stood obediently in front of the Eldest Senior Sister, with a flattering smile on his face: "Eldest Senior Sister, you're back."
Qin Yanyan was surprised, it was her first time seeing Lu Yang so tame.

chapters.title: Chapter 314 - 313 Meng Jingzhou's Enlightenment on the Arena_1
chapters.content:
"Not bad, I thought that when you advanced to the Golden Core Stage, your basic swordsmanship wouldn't be able to match your current realm. I initially wanted to remind you, but it seems like my worries were unnecessary."
"All thanks to your good instruction, Eldest Senior Sister."
Lu Yang dared not slacken off in basic training. He recalled when he first started cultivating, his Eldest Senior Sister trained his basics by making tofu during the day and soaking in warm water at night. If he didn't have a good stash of miraculous pills, he wouldn't have even survived.
If the Eldest Senior Sister found out that his basics weren't solid, and repeated that... Lu Yang shuddered at the thought.
No way, not again!
"Xiao Tao, gaining insight into the Yin Yang transformation of the Golden Core from the Twin Lotus and connecting it to illusion is great, but don't forget that you're also a Feather Transformation Immortal Body, don't forget to refine it."
"Yes, Eldest Senior Sister!"
"Alright, you two can review this battle later, for now, let's watch the fight between Little Meng and Man Gu."
"These two have been fighting for so long?" Tao Yaoye was surprised. She and Lu Yang had fought for such a long time, she didn't expect that Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu could fight for even longer.
"Both of them are Body Cultivators, it's not easy to distinguish victory." Lu Yang was not surprised. Meng Jingzhou's Golden Core had extraordinary effects against demons and ghosts, but was ineffective against Man Gu, who was also a Body Cultivator.
Man Gu held a demon beast leg bone, which was his war trophy from the dense forest, taken from a Nascent Soul Stage demon beast that he and Tao Yaoye had defeated together.
As Man Gu swung the demon beast leg bone, howling and shouting, he resembled a wild man. His eyes were filled with madness and savagery.
Lu Yang was puzzled; he had never seen Man Gu in such a state before. Moreover, this manner didn't match Man Gu's personality.
Although Man Gu relied on brute force in fights, he had never been so crazy, as if he were hunting demon beasts in the wilderness.
Meng Jingzhou was startled by Man Gu's behavior, missed the initiative to fight, and was pressured from the start. He spent most of his energy on defense and seldom made attacks.
Although Man Gu's fighting style was wild, upon closer inspection, it seemed to be a refined form of fight which balanced both attack and defense, formed after countless trials and adjustments.
"Huh, this fighting style is familiar. It's the same as those of the barbarians I've met. They swarm up with stones and bones and crush their enemies' skulls!" Fairy Eternity exclaimed excitedly at the familiar sight.
Lu Yang was intrigued, "This is the Ancient Barbarian Tribe's way of fighting? But I heard that the Ancient Barbarian Tribe's fighting style was lost?"
Indeed, the Barbarian's lineage was severely interrupted and precious few records of ancient times remain.
"Have you forgotten? Man Gu's bloodline has been blessed by me. Demon beasts can pass on their Divine Abilities and natural talents through their bloodline, naturally, I can do the same!"
When a demon beast reaches a certain realm, the inheriting force hidden in its bloodline will be unlocked, allowing the beast to learn its inherent Divine Ability.
The "Devouring" of the Gluttonous Tribes and the "Charming" of the Nine-tailed Fox Tribe are examples of this principle.
The purer the bloodline, the earlier the inheriting force will be activated.
"Right, what kind of Golden Core does Man Gu have?" Lu Yang turned to ask Tao Yaoye, surely there was no longer a need for secrecy.
"It seems to be the same as me, a Golden Core that was never seen before. It appears to be called Ancestral Pill, which is able to summon ancestral spirits to assist in battle."
"So powerful?!" was Lu Yang's astonished reaction, "Doesn't this mean that the souls of the Ancient Barbarians still exist?"
Yun Zhi slowly shook her head: "Not as you think. As for souls, only Immortals have the ability to persist for three hundred thousand years."
"Then what about Man Gu?"
"Although the souls of Man Gu's ancestors disintegrated and returned to heaven and earth, since they share the same bloodline as Man Gu, they sensed the existence of the Barbarian Tribe and partly reformed their lost souls from heaven and earth. Following the bloodline of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe, they descended into Man Gu's body.
However, controlling a body in this way is mostly instinctual and lacks intelligence."
Lu Yang recalled Fairy Eternity, while somewhat similar, it was far less against the heavens than Fairy Eternity's method.
"So, Meng Jingzhou's opponent isn't just Man Gu, but the entirety of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe?" Lu Yang felt that Meng's match was going to be tough.
The Ancient Barbarian Tribe were companions to Fairy Eternity, encountering one another as frequently as one does meals, having vast and plentiful combat experience. Where could Meng measure up?
On the stage, Meng Jingzhou was losing ground inch by inch, his Arhat Fist and the Shocking Heaven Six Forms were proving ineffective.
Man Gu's eyes were lifeless, completely taken over by the ancestors of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe, fighting purely on instinct.
In physical strength, Meng Jingzhou had a slight edge over Man Gu, but he couldn't match Man Gu's wealth of experience.
The combat experience of the ancestors of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe added up to several hundred thousand years, how could Meng compete?
Although Man Gu had the upper hand and was continuously pressing Meng Jingzhou, he was unable to truly defeat him in a short time.
"Doesn't Meng Jingzhou seem a bit off?"
Meng Jingzhou felt as if he had fallen into a strange state, within his body, his two single Golden Elixirs sensed Man Gu's Golden Core, as if agitated, they spun out of control, like two small suns heating up his body. His body became clear, his acupoints opened, each one was absorbing and emitting spiritual energy.
As the two Golden Elixirs spun, Meng Jingzhou's mind went blank, and his past experiences flooded into his mind one by one.
His past experiences shrank to the utmost degree, then suddenly exploded out, his mind booming like thunder.
Meng Jingzhou's head swayed a bit, feeling as if the world was clearer than before.
"Did I just achieve enlightenment? Did I realize a set of boxing techniques?"
Meng Jingzhou clenched his fists, a little incredulous.
He had heard that enlightenment was elusive, most cultivators never experienced it in their lifetimes. He had only reached the Golden Core Stage, had he already achieved enlightenment?
And from the looks of it, it seemed that his twin single Golden Elixirs were assisting him in enlightenment?
"I knew it! My single Golden Elixirs are invincible!"
Meng Jingzhou mentally rehearsed the boxing set he had just realized, his expression becoming strange.
"This boxing technique seems to..."
"Hold up!" Meng Jingzhou raised his hand, stopping Man Gu's attack.
"I just realized a set of boxing techniques. If you, the ancestors of the Barbarian Tribe, insist on fighting, don't blame me for using this boxing technique!"
Man Gu stood still, seemingly wanting to hear what Meng Jingzhou would say next.
"The boxing technique I realized involves the power of causality and curse, and also carries the resentment of my single lineage!"
"Whoever is punched by me, will be like me in this lifetime, forever single. This is the Curse of Causality!"
"I named it 'Single Curse Fist'!"
"This should be the inherent ability of the Double Single Golden Core!"
"If you are willing to let Man Gu get punched by this fist, then just keep attacking me!"
The ancestors of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe quickly jumped off the stage through Man Gu's body to concede defeat.
Their instinct alerted them that Meng Jingzhou was telling the truth!

chapters.title: Chapter 315 - 314: The Way of the Fist is also the Law_1
chapters.content:
"He actually self-taught cursed fists? No, should I say curse magic instead?" Even with their extensive knowledge, many senior brothers couldn't help but be surprised.
The path of curses is related to causality. Both causality and time are universally recognized in the Cultivation World as the most difficult divine abilities to comprehend, learn and understand.
Unexpectedly, this Junior Brother Meng, at such a young age, self-taught and understood such a cruel curse magic skill.
"You're actually asking if this is a fist technique or a magic skill, it's clear you weren't paying attention when Elder Sister was teaching!" A cultivator in the Divinity Transformation Stage looked disdainfully at a cultivator in Nascent Soul Stage who had cried out in surprise earlier.
"No discipline at all, how are you planning to advance to the Divinity Transformation Stage in the future?"
The Younger Sister in the Nascent Soul Stage hesitated. She was well-known in the outer world for her knowledge and was renowned and admired as a "talented girl". But in the Seek Dao Sect, these characteristics are useless.
Who dares to call themselves knowledgeable in the Seek Dao Sect?
"Eldest Senior Sister has repeatedly stressed not to distinguish too clearly between fist techniques and magic skills. Fist techniques are 'lee', magic skills are 'lee'. All these arts lead to the same end, if you want a clear distinction, how will you be able to comprehend all arts in the future?"
"It's exactly because many people have this kind of misconception that they'll end up mastering powerful magic skills, which are far more powerful than their opponents, but then, their opponents find opportunities to engage in close combat and they get defeated."
Close combat is what practitioners whose focus is on magic skill fear the most. They dedicate a long time honing their magic skills and neglect their physical strength. Once they're caught in close combat, they wouldn't even get a chance to cast their magic skills, let alone ensure their safety.
The senior brother in Divinity Transformation Stage advised, "So the best state is to use fist techniques to execute magic skills. This way, whether it's a long-distance fight or close combat, there are no cracks. Right?"
The junior sister in the Nascent Soul Stage nodded. Indeed, that's the logic. Though she's energetic, practicing both fists and magic skills without neglecting either, after hearing what the senior brother said, she felt she should really reflect on herself.
"Eldest Senior Sister also praised Lu Yang, saying that he has achieved this point and has shown signs of different paths leading to the same goal. He's much better than you and me."
"Although I don't know to what extent Junior Brother Lu Yang has achieved, if Eldest Senior Sister praises him, he must have made some achievements in this aspect!"
Seniors lining up to challenge Lu Yang is one thing, recognizing Lu Yang's talent is another.
...
Lu Yang, Tao Yaoye, and others were astounded seeing Meng Jingzhou reach enlightenment and comprehend the Sterility Fists technique.
Is there no justice in this fist technique?
The most shocked one is Qin Yanyan.
Before coming to the Seek Dao Sect, she was somewhat proud, thinking that she was only a little slower in cultivation progress than Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou. As long she worked harder, she could catch up.
She's two months older than Li Haoran and has the same cultivation level as him. Li Haoran's talent level can rank in the top ten among the younger generation, and she isn't far off. She is fully qualified to become a disciple of the Five Great Immortal Sects.
It's just that she has Su Yiren as her tutor, so there's no need for her to enter the Five Great Immortal Sects.
She believed that even if she lagged behind top talents like Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou in the younger generation, the gap wouldn't be too big. Just watching from the side, she should be able to learn something.
Now looking at this, it would be a miracle if she could learn this.
No wonder her ex-father, despite having the purest Fire Spirit Root, could only rank fifth in his generation.
It's really hard to get into the top four.
Moreover, the top-ranked ones can make someone bald by using the Arhat Fist technique, and the second-ranked ones can make someone stay single for life using the Single Curse Fist technique. Are these two from the Seek Dao Sect or from the Suspension Temple?
Fairy Eternity, impressed by Meng Jingzhou's fist technique, sighed, "So this is what they mean by 'each new generation surpasses the last, leading trends for hundreds of years.'"
Lu Yang raised his eyebrows; this poem seems to be read like this, but he always felt that using it in this context might not be quite right?
"Does this fist technique have no limits?" Tao Yaoye was puzzled. Man Gu's Ancestral Pill was within the reasonable range, but it didn't keep up with the cultivation level of the ancestors. Could Meng Jingzhou's fist technique ignore cultivation level?
Wouldn't that make anyone who saw the fist technique run away?
Eldest Senior Sister watched Meng Jingzhou on the arena, who was quite smug for a while. She then withdrew her gaze, shook her head gently, and explained to everyone, "It's not as exaggeratively powerful as you imagined."
"Meng Jingzhou is at the Golden Core Stage, so his fist technique can only be used on cultivators at the Golden Core Stage or below. Furthermore, he has to be careful about backlash."
"Backlash?"
"Yes, take Li Haoran as an example. Li Haoran's fiancée is Su Yiren, who is a cultivator at the Unification Stage. So, Li Haoran's marriage fate is tied to Su Yiren. Such a marital fate isn't something that ordinary methods can sever."
"If Meng Jingzhou wants to use the Single Curse Fist on Li Haoran, he'll be backlashed because he isn't as powerful as Li Haoran's marital fate."
"What will happen to Meng Jingzhou after he is backlashed?" Lu Yang was curious. Could it make Meng Jingzhou single as well?
If that's the case, isn't it the same whether there's backlash or not?
Eldest Senior Sister calculated and said, "He might lose his causality with women for a while. Specifically, during this time, he won't be able to interact with any women. He'll avoid women due to various coincidences, or women will avoid him due to various coincidences."
The Single Curse Fist seems to have major restrictions and risks of backlash. But think about it, who, like Li Haoran, has a fiancée in the Unification Stage at such a young age?
Li Haoran, who was listening by the side, was puzzled: "Isn't the biggest backlash of Senior Brother Meng's fist technique being chased after using it?"
Lu Yang: "..."
Thinking about it, Lu Yang agreed. Meng Jingzhou's fist technique can't kill people, so anyone hit by this fist technique would swear to pursue Meng Jingzhou until death.
"Just now, Senior Brother Meng said that his fist technique came with his Golden Core. But I've never heard of a Single Golden Elixir coming with this kind of fist technique, right?" Li Haoran was puzzled. He had looked through many notes on forming the golden core, including descriptions of the Single Body Golden Elixir, in order to form his golden core.
Lu Yang pointed out the flaw in Li Haoran's thinking, "You got one thing wrong. Meng Jingzhou didn't form a Single Golden Elixir, but two unprecedented Single Golden Elixirs."
Li Haoran: "???"
Lu Yang continued, "If predecessors with Single Body Spirit Root didn't realize this set of fist techniques, it shows that their singlehood is not as profound as Meng Jingzhou's."
"Lu Yang, you're slandering me again! This is obviously a manifestation of my extraordinary understanding!" Meng Jingzhou, who had descended from the arena, glared at Lu Yang.
Lu Yang spread his hands as if he didn't say anything before.
Man Gu slowly woke up and looked around blankly at the boisterous environment: "Did I lose?"
He didn't have any memory after asking his ancestors for help.
Lu Yang replied sincerely, "Your ancestors were worried about losing their only descendant, so they conceded."
"Huh?" Man Gu blinked, not understanding what had just happened.
Did Brother Meng have to use such a despicable move as monkey stealing peach to defeat him?
It wasn't that serious.
"Lu Yang, come back with me."
After leaving these words, the Elder Sister went straight back to Sky Gate Mountain.
The Seek Dao Sect disciples who were watching the battle dispersed. Some went back to practice, some went to Scripture Pavilion to read, some went on dates with junior sisters, each with their own duties.
Lu Yang jogged a little and managed to catch up with Elder Sister's pace.
"Eldest Senior Sister, has Fairy's kitchen been moved back?"
"Yes."
In the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity's eyes lit up.

chapters.title: Chapter 316 - 315: Fairy Eternity plots against the Four Immortals of the Ancients, breaking a plan of eternity!_1
chapters.content:
Sky Gate Mountain houses six structures, which are:
Daoist Buyu's Abode, currently abandoned and covered in dust, which everyone is unwilling to clean.
Yun Zhi's humble room.
Lu Yang's Abode.
The kitchen Lu Yang and Yun Zhi use for meals.
The meeting hall.
The Abode where the Sect Leader handles all matters related to Seek Dao Sect, which is currently being used by Yun Zhi.
"Eldest Senior Sister, where is Fairy's kitchen?" Lu Yang looked around but didn't see anything resembling a kitchen behind her.
"Hold on."
Yun Zhi rummaged in her sleeve for a while, and a meticulously-made architectural model appeared in her palm. It was palm-sized, made of a piece of jade stone that bore obvious traces of human carving.
"This is my kitchen!" Fairy Eternity exclaimed excitedly as she ran out from the Spiritual Space.
"This is Fairy's kitchen? Didn't we find it inside the Immortal Eternity's statue?" Lu Yang thought that Eldest Senior Sister had brought the statue of Immortal Eternity.
This time, Fairy Eternity could explain things herself, "My kitchen was never in the statue from the beginning. Obviously, someone used a spatial skill to embed my kitchen into the statue."
"Later, Miss Yun also used a spatial skill to move my kitchen out!"
Fairy Eternity was obviously a bit too triumphant this time and referred to Yun Zhi as "Miss Yun".
The Eldest Senior Sister didn't care about these details and discussed with Fairy Eternity, "Senior, on Sky Gate Mountain, only Lu Yang and I eat meals, so there's no need to have two kitchens. I plan to dismantle our original kitchen and replace it with your kitchen, how does that sound?"
Lu Yang: "!!!"
"Okay." Fairy Eternity readily agreed. A kitchen is for cooking, and her kitchen would definitely be superior to the original one.
Eldest Senior Sister extended her left hand and directed an imprint towards the original kitchen, which then automatically shrank and entered her sleeve.
"Oh, this is Universe within the Sleeve!" There are many ways to shrink objects. Fairy Eternity had just been unsure which one was used, but once she saw the process, she naturally understood Eldest Senior Sister's method.
The Universe within the Sleeve, a spatial technique worthy of being called a Great Divine Skill. Unlike a Storage Ring, the Universe within the Sleeve can not only store items but also living beings. It's equivalent to splitting a small world within the sleeve and is often seen as a symbol of mastery.
After all, when performing the Universe within the Sleeve, you have to start by wearing a wide-sleeved gown.
And wearing wide sleeves is quite disadvantageous in a fight. Only those with absolute confidence in their abilities would wear wide sleeves.
Like Yun Zhi.
And like Fairy Eternity.
"I used to use this frequently. I stored some snacks in my sleeves and pulled them out for a snack when I was bored."
"I could even fit a bed in my sleeves, sleep wherever I wanted. Once when I was passing by a sea, I saw a Kun fish and a Flood Dragon playing freely in the water. I threw a bed onto the sea surface, laid on it, and drifted along the waves, enjoying the sea breeze, it was incredibly comfortable!"
Fairy Eternity looked as if she could endless more to say.
"This Divine Ability is also a good choice for giving surprises."
"Qilin Immortal and his fellows were always too shy to accept my dinner invitations, always standing me up. So, I used to put the ready meals into my sleeve and visit them. They thought I was just visiting casually and would receive me. Once I entered their Abode, I suddenly pulled out the meal, giving them a surprise!"
Lu Yang contemplated the scene for a moment. He found his imagination to be limited as he could not imagine how desperate such a situation would be.
"However, you cannot use this technique too frequently."
"Why?"
Fairy Eternity wrinkled her nose, "It tends to make you smell of food."
Yun Zhi tossed Fairy's kitchen into the air, and it began to grow larger in the wind, eventually reaching the size of Lu Yang's Abode.
Actually, this was not the kitchen's largest state. The kitchen itself was compressed using spatial magic, and the interior space was frighteningly large. Last time, the three of them had only taken a quick look. There were still many places that Lu Yang hadn't visited.
Fairy Eternity's right hand moved quickly, seemingly forming imprints, as she said, "I'll grant you two the privilege of entering my kitchen. Come in whenever you want. You don't need to be shy; we're family."
As soon as she finished speaking, Fairy Eternity propelled an imprint towards Lu Yang. It was a caricature of Fairy Eternity grinning foolishly.
Before Lu Yang could react, the imprint disappeared into his body. Lu Yang felt vaguely as if he had established a connection with Fairy's kitchen. It seemed that he just needed to think about it, and he could enter the kitchen.
Yun Zhi did not stop it and let the Fairy's imprint enter her body.
"Come to think of it, I gave a similar imprint to the Yingtian Immortal and his three companions, allowing them to enter my kitchen freely."
"When my Abode was ready, I invited them over as guests. No matter what, they insisted on just taking a look and that there was no need for me to cook for them."
"Being such a good and kind-hearted person, I felt bad about it. After all, they came all this way, travelling such a great distance."
"They came all this way and not even have a meal before leaving?"
"They insisted on not eating, so I offered to give them the kitchen imprints, allowing them to enter my kitchen whenever they wanted."
"They accepted."
"Yingtian Immortal and the others were quite curious. Whenever they got a new toy, they wanted to try it. So, they used the imprint, opened the kitchen door and entered the kitchen."
"And then?"
Fairy Eternity revealed a devious smile, "I only said that the imprint would allow them to enter my kitchen freely. I didn't say that the imprint would allow them to leave my kitchen freely."
She huffed, "Want to leave after entering the kitchen? They all had to obediently stay and eat!"
"You know how good my cooking is. It's so delicious that you would hate to not even lick the plate clean. The four of them ate to their heart's content and even slept in the kitchen. Fortunately, I had put a bed in the kitchen, or else they would've had to sleep on the floor."
"After they woke up, they bid me farewell one after another and left my Abode."
Lu Yang shuddered as he visualized a scene.
Four youths ventured into an abandoned castle on a dark, windy night. They slowly pushed open the massive doors of the castle, which led to pitch blackness. They couldn't see anything, and even the moonlight was swallowed up by the castle.
Suddenly, the castle doors slammed shut, and human-oil lamps lit up the place. A woman in a red dress floated down from the sky, laughing wickedly, saying, "Since you are here, don't even think of leaving."
The four youths trembled in fear, regretting their decision to explore the castle.
If this story were to be passed down to future generations, it might be titled "Immortal Eternity outwits the Four Immortals of the Ancients single-handedly. A massive victory, leaving the Four Immortals of the Ancients unconscious."
Such terrifying intelligence!
Lu Yang snapped back, "Wait, the imprint you just gave us ..."
Nonchalantly, Fairy Eternity said, "Ah, after they ate a meal, I gave them the imprint that allows free entry and exit. It's same for you two."

chapters.title: Chapter 317 - 316 Lu Yang is gone_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang deeply regretted having the thought of entering the kitchen earlier.
After obtaining the imprint of Fairy Eternity, he felt a connection to the kitchen and could simply enter it with a thought.
And so, with a thought, Lu Yang truly did enter the kitchen.
