Lu Yang attempted to run, forcefully pushing again the door.
However, as a mortal, his low cultivation level made opening the door as impossible as a mayfly shaking a large tree.
Even with his full strength, he couldn't budge the door.
It didn't matter that he was a mortal; even an immortal wouldn't make a difference. Why else could Yingtian Immortal and his group not leave?
And why did they secretly beat up Immortal Jiuchong, who encouraged Fairy Eternity to cook, after they woke up?
Everything had its reasons.
"Junior Brother, why are you running?" Yun Zhi was bewildered.
Fairy Eternity was the only one among the Five Immortals of the Ancients that could cook; she was the unique Immortal Chef. Why wouldn't he treasure this opportunity?
Moreover, the ancient inheritance was cut off, and nobody knew the cooking style of the ancient cultivators; only Fairy Eternity, a living fossil, could replicate the ancient culinary arts.
Last time, when the Five Elements Sect visited, Fairy Eternity worked hard to prepare a large meal, but Yun Zhi hadn't had a chance to taste it before the infuriated Sect Leader overturned the table.
Regarding the matter of adding salt for twenty seconds, it must have been an ancient cooking habit.
The dangerous cooking utensils of the Eternity Sect became so after they were given to the sect and were refined. Originally, the utensils weren't dangerous.
Additionally, this was a rare learning opportunity, and he should treasure it.
An Immortal Cook, regardless of where they went, would always be welcomed. If Lu Yang could learn even a tenth of Fairy Eternity's skills, he could access anywhere in the Central Continent with ease.
Just as Lu Yang was about to explain, Fairy Eternity interrupted him.
"Indeed, why are you running? This is a rare opportunity for me to cook for you. This is a privilege reserved for immortals."
Fairy Eternity furrowed her brow, dissatisfied with Lu Yang's reaction. Then, it seemed as if she had an epiphany.
"Oh, I get it now. You think you're beneath me, and you're feeling guilty about having me cook for you, right?"
"No problem at all. I don't care about these trivial formalities. You've been with me all this time. Do you still not know what kind of person I am?"
"Come on, let me borrow your body to cook, and I'll return it immediately so it doesn't interfere with your meals!"
Fairy Eternity was unable to touch physical objects and needed to borrow Lu Yang's body temporarily.
"Junior Brother, let her borrow it," Eldest Senior Sister said, thinking Fairy Eternity's request was reasonable.
Lu Yang wanted to resist, but upon hearing Eldest Senior Sister's words, he was momentarily stunned.
Seizing the opportunity, Fairy Eternity took over Lu Yang's body, much to her delight.
Lu Yang could only watch helplessly as Fairy Eternity used his body.
"This body isn't strong enough. It can't withstand an explosion, let alone digest high-level dishes," Fairy Eternity commented with slight disdain.
Lu Yang's body was top-tier within the Golden Core Stage, but that was far insufficient for Fairy Eternity.
"Wait, why will there be an explosion while cooking?" Lu Yang was on alert.
Fairy Eternity found Lu Yang's reaction strange: "Isn't it common that the ultimate delight bursts in your mouth when you take a bite?"
Lu Yang: "..."
Eldest Senior Sister silently agreed, taking note of Fairy Eternity's words.
These must be lessons from Fairy Eternity's experiences, and as her successor, she needed to learn earnestly.
"You should study hard this time. I can groom you as my successor," Second-in-command of Eternity Sect told her.
Second-in-command of Eternity Sect replied with utmost fear and apprehension.
"Your body can't make complex dishes. Let me think... Ah! How about scrambled eggs with tomato?" Fairy Eternity rapidly came to a decision after some thought.
Lu Yang breathed a sigh of relief. If only she had said so earlier. Even he could cook that dish. It was so simple that Fairy Eternity couldn't possibly cause any problems.
"What's this pot filled with?" Fairy Eternity inquired, lifting the lid off the pot. A horrid smell immediately assailed their senses.
Within the Spiritual Space, Lu Yang staggered around dizzily before passing out.
"What's in the pot..."
Fairy Eternity was eagerly engrossed in her cooking and didn't notice Lu Yang's odd behavior.
Since she had control over Lu Yang's body, whether Lu Yang was conscious or unconscious would not affect Fairy Eternity's ability to utilize his body.
"Look. When making scrambled eggs, you must stir hard like this." Fairy Eternity was busy teaching her cooking procedures, and Eldest Senior Sister was attentively listening.
"We use the egg to make scrambled eggs with tomato, and the remaining eggshell can be used to make soup; as the saying goes, the pot's original essence retains the original food. This phrase was referring to this concept."
Eldest Senior Sister nodded now and then, finding that the cooking methods from ancient times were very different from the current ones. There was much more for her to learn.
Being the cultivator she was today, apart from her comprehension skills, her good habits of diligence and inquiry were also to be credited.
However, nowadays, there is hardly anything left for her to learn.
...
When Lu Yang finally regained consciousness, he found himself sitting in front of the dinner table. The food prepared by Fairy Eternity was neatly laid in front of him, and across from him sat Eldest Senior Sister, exhibiting an elegant demeanor.
"You're awake? You've been running around in Guhuai Town, controlling the overall situation and even fought with Tao Yaoye without resting. I guess you were just exhausted," Fairy Eternity explained with a tinge of concern, worried that Lu Yang wouldn't understand.
The scrambled eggs with tomato Fairy Eternity cooked were indeed an eye-opener. The red eggs and yellow tomatoes mixed with charming, mouthwatering aromas wafting far. It was enough to make anyone's mouth water.
A homely dish was made to feel extraordinarily stunning by Fairy Eternity.
Regarding the soup made with eggshells placed at the side, Lu Yang automatically ignored it.
A feeling of hunger surged within Lu Yang. He reached out to pick up a piece of tomato and put it in his mouth.
"How is it? Is the egg delicious?" Fairy Eternity looked at Lu Yang full of anticipation.
"Yeah, the egg?" Lu Yang remembered the piece he picked up being red.
"Yes, I added some chili powder in the egg."
Lu Yang: "..."
Fairy, how much chili powder did you add for the eggs to become as red as tomatoes!
His eyes darkened, and the spiciness made him pass out again.
"He fell asleep again... ah! It can't be that he's allergic to spiciness?" Fairy Eternity was deeply worried.
Yun Zhi, who knew that Lu Yang could tolerate spicy food, analysed the situation: "The food likely contained immense spiritual essence which overwhelmed him when he consumed it. However, this can be beneficial, as it could slowly allow him to absorb the spiritual essence within the food and fortify his cultivation."
Chili powder was indeed a rare treasure cherished by Fairy Eternity.
"I see. By the way, how was the food I made?"
Yun Zhi cautiously picked up an egg, chewed slowly and tasted the overwhelming spiciness, the spiritual essence within the chilli stimulating her taste buds. It left a lingering and unforgettable taste.
"Extremely delicious."
"That's good to hear. I was worried my culinary skills had declined."

chapters.title: Chapter 318 - 317: The Fifth Elder's Ingenious Ideas_1
chapters.content:
"It's a pity that Lu Yang didn't learn my Fairy's Boxing Style. Otherwise, he also wouldn't have fallen into unconsciousness." Fairy Eternity found Lu Yang pleasing in all aspects except for his stubbornness in refusing to learn her boxing technique.
"Fairy's Boxing Style?" Yun Zhi gently repeated her words, put down her chopsticks, and looked on with great interest.
"It's also known as the Health Preservation Boxing. Once mastered, it can turn one's body into a medicine. You wouldn't need to take any elixirs for illness or for Cultivation, and all toxins would cease to affect you."
"However, to master Fairy's Boxing, one must first get the hang of over a thousand techniques like Arhat Fruit Fist, Boat-Fruited Sterculia Seed Fist, Ginseng Fist, and so on. Fuse them together, discard the false and preserve the true, remove the impurities and keep the essence. Use your body as a furnace to melt those over a thousand techniques into one. That will be the Fairy's Boxing."
Yun Zhi fell silent for a moment, then got up seriously and asked, "Could you teach me, elder?"
"Naturally, I can."
...
When Lu Yang awoke, he had already left the kitchen.
"Awake now? How do you feel?"
Lu Yang thought, 'I've been knocked out by the spiciness, and you're asking how I feel?'
"My Cultivation Level is..."
Barely having moved, Lu Yang realized his Cultivation Level had somewhat improved. It had risen from the early stages of Golden Core Stage to the mid-stage of Golden Core.
He had not done anything at all.
"Hehe, do you think I merely made a normal plate of tomato scrambled eggs? How could it be, the tomato scrambled eggs I made can increase your Cultivation Level!"
"The reason you think your Cultivation Level has not increased much is that you only took one bite. If you were to finish the entire dish, I guarantee you will advance to the late Golden Core Stage!"
Lu Yang felt that his steady and slow Cultivation was safer.
If he were to follow Fairy Eternity's theory and finish the whole dish, he was afraid he might directly ascend to immortality.
Outside his Abode, Meng Jingzhou shouted at the top of his voice, "Lu Yang, are you awake yet?"
"I'm awake." Lu Yang stepped out of his Abode. The dazzling sunlight made him slightly uncomfortable.
In front of the Abode's door stood Meng Jingzhou, Li Haoran, and Qin Yanyan.
Seeing that Lu Yang had awoken, Meng Jingzhou let out a sigh of relief, "Finally, you're awake now. You've been unconscious for three months!"
Lu Yang was amazed. He didn't expect Fairy Eternity's poison to be so potent.
Li Haoran helplessly stated, "Senior Brother Meng, Senior Brother Lu has only slept for two hours."
"Hey, Junior Brother Li, you shouldn't have... you spoiled my fun. Do you know how hard I tried to trick Lu Yang successfully."
Qin Yanyan quietly observed this scene, wondering if the notable brilliance of geniuses like Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou stemmed from entwining deceit and trickery into their daily lives.
Very likely.
"Let's go, let's go, let's all go find the Fifth Elder together. Once Fifth Elder joins our Heaven's Court, he will be a founding member!"
...
With Li Haoran leading the way, the group soon found the Fifth Elder who was currently refining magic instrument.
The Fifth Elder threw his own Daoist robe into the fire for a fiery test. When the robe turned red-hot, the Fifth Elder emotionlessly reached out his hand to fetch it out of the fire.
The Fifth Elder took a small hammer from his waist and carefully banged the outer part of the robe. Then, he dunked it into the water. A sizzling sound marked the end of the refining process.
The Fifth Elder looked at the newly refined Daoist robe with satisfaction. He casually put it on, only then did he notice Lu Yang and the rest, who were watching from not far away.
"Ah, Little Lu."
"Fifth Elder, are you refining a garment?" Lu Yang was slightly unsure, the process he had witnessed did not look like refining a garment, but rather refining some kind of metal magic instrument.
"I'm trying to combine a garment and a transit tool together."
"Combine them?" Everyone heard this with a puzzling expression on their face; could these two things be related?
"Why aren't they related?"" The Fifth Elder, as a Grandmaster in Refining, unraveled this mystery for everyone.
"The so-called transit tools, whether they're carriages or flying boats, are all tools that facilitate your movement, correct?"
"Carriages, flying boats, flying swords, they all have one thing in common, they all bear our weight."
"If that is the case, then why have we always been ignoring the most common object that bears our weight—clothes?"
Upon thinking, Lu Yang found that this was indeed the case. Clothes, when worn on the body, from another perspective, aren't they enveloping our bodies?
People are carriers for clothes.
"That's why I believe that clothes are the best transit tools. Take a look."
The Fifth Elder maneuvered his spiritual power and the newly refined Daoist robe flew up, taking him along with it.
The Fifth Elder made a turn mid-air, landed steadily, and continued speaking to everyone. "Usually, only individuals at the Golden Core Stage can fly on their own. A special case would be Sword Cultivators, who can fly with swords during the Foundation Establishment Stage."
"So, if Foundation Establishment Stage Sword Cultivators can fly with swords, why can't regular Foundation Establishment Stage Cultivators fly with clothes?"
"Of course, the method I'm currently using to refine clothes is overly complex. It's not something that those at the Foundation Establishment Stage can master yet. Once I refine and simplify the process, register a patent, and promote it in the Cultivation World, won't there be endless wealth flowing into the Refining Peak?" The Fifth Elder said with great enthusiasm.
When there's more money in Refining Peak, they can buy more materials and refine better magic artifacts.
"Fifth Elder, you're brilliant!" Lu Yang sincerely praised, finding it to be highly feasible.
The Seek Dao Sect has endless Spirit Stones, and it relies on talents in refining and pill-making like the Fifth Elder, Seventh Elder, especially in refining, which gained them a good reputation in the Cultivation World.
"Who is that girl?" The Fifth Elder pointed at Qin Yanyan and asked.
"That is the daughter of Junior Brother Li's ex-wife." Lu Yang explained.
The Fifth Elder jumped in shock. When did his apprentice get married?
"It's the daughter of my wife from the previous life!" Li Haoran quickly added an explanation.
"Oh, it's Qin Yanyan, Haoran mentioned you before. So you can be considered my granddaughter."
Qin Yanyan: "....."
She somewhat regretted coming to the Seek Dao Sect as she seems to be of the smallest status here. Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou frequently refer to her as their grandniece, and now she has directly become someone's granddaughter.
Just as Qin Yanyan wanted to say that the past life was past, and this life is the present, not to mix them up, she saw the Fifth Elder take out a magic artifact from his bosom.
"This is our first meeting, so I should give you something. I don't have much of value on me, but I see you are a Talisman Cultivator. Here, take this Talisman Making Brush. There are eighteen common talismans engraved inside. When you run your spiritual power through it, it can instantly complete drawing them. It should be of some help to you."
Qin Yanyan was shocked by the function of the magic Instrument. A Talisman Making Brush is a must-have for a Talisman Cultivator. She has one too, with ten kinds of talismans inside. That brush was made by a renowned refining master at the request of Su Yiren. The refining master said that a Golden Core-level Talisman making brush could at most engrave ten kinds of talismans.
"This... this is too valuable, I can't accept it."
"Take it. It's just a small gadget that I refined during my leisure time. It's not worth much." The Fifth Elder said generously.
Looking at Qin Yanyan, Li Haoran felt a sour feeling. As he recalled, why did the master give a gift on meeting Qin Yanyan for the first time, but threw him into the magma the first time they met?
"Oh, why were you guys looking for me?" The Fifth Elder suddenly recalled that Lu Yang and the others must have come looking for him for a reason.
"This is the thing, we established a sect called Heaven's Court. It has a deep foundation, with the inheritance of ancient immortals, the support of influential families, someone who had once been in the half-step Transcendance Tribulation Stage, and someone who was the first-in-line successor of the Nine Nether Sect.
We would like to invite Fifth Elder to become the Protector of our Heaven's Court."

chapters.title: Chapter 319 - 318: Deceiving the Nine Nether Sect is the Tradition of the Seek Dao Sect_1
chapters.content:
"This Heaven's Court is not widely known, yet its foundations are so profound?" The Fifth Elder inhaled sharply. He had never heard of Heaven's Court before.
Seeing the Fifth Elder taken aback, Lu Yang continued, "Aside from the above-mentioned foundation, Heaven's Court will be expanding its recruitment soon. They already have two candidates. One is born with an Immortal body. It was because of this Immortal body that Immortal Jiuchong, the first immortal of ancient times, was able to achieve Immortality."
"The other enjoys the luck of the entire tribe and has an overwhelming fortune, excelling in both savagery and Confucian cultivation practices!"
"Fifth Elder, what do you think? Would you like to join us?"
"Initially, our Heaven's Court's planned to grow slowly to gain an advantage in the Great Era's competition. However, we have caught the unwanted attention of the Nine Nether Sect. We need a protector to deal with the Nine Nether Sect!"
Lu Yang bowed, solemnly saying, "If the Fifth Elder would extend a helping hand to our Heaven's Court this time, we would be deeply grateful in the future!"
The Fifth Elder was silent for a moment. Just as Lu Yang thought he was about to agree, he heard him slowly ask:
"Has your Heaven's Court registered itself with the Imperial Court?"
Lu Yang paused, "Registered?"
"Yes, the laws of Great Xia state that any established faction must register with the local government. Those that do not register are considered illegal and are strictly targeted."
"The previous Four Great Demon Sects and the current Three Great Demon Sects have not registered."
Lu Yang: "..."
Seeing Lu Yang and others fall silent, the Fifth Elder began to laugh, "All right, just say it, stop beating around the bush. What exactly happened?"
As a well-known disciple of the Seek Dao Sect, the Fifth Elder naturally wasn't easily fooled by Lu Yang.
What does the inheritance of ancient Immortals and the support of influential families refer to if not you guys?
After the downfall of the Eternity Sect, Lu Yang received the inheritance of the Immortal Eternity.
As the eldest son of the Meng Family, Meng Jingzhou's expenditures could be considered as support from influential families.
In his past life, Li Haoran was Qin Haoran, who had reached the Half Step Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
Qin Yanyan's father was Qin Haoran, so naturally, she is the first successor.
With no further option, Lu Yang told the whole story. The Fifth Elder found it fascinating, his eyes shining with interest.
"You guys are quite resourceful, creating an entirely nonexistent Heaven's Court, deceiving the Nine Nether Sect, establishing cooperation, and if you're lucky, could even locate the Yaoyang Sect and the Ruthless Sect."
The Fifth Elder's face held a look of remembrance: "Back then, the nine of us also did something similar."
"What happened?" Lu Yang and the others looked at the Fifth Elder with curiosity.
The Fifth Elder picked up a stone and casually refined it into a chair, instructing Lu Yang and the others to sit down.
The chair looked thin, yet after being refined by the grandmaster of refining, the Fifth Elder, it was sturdy enough to withstand several hits from a Golden Core Stage cultivator.
"This happened around nine hundred years ago. The Eighth Brother pretended to be a low-ranking cultivator and traveled the world, dealing out justice. He happened upon a follower of the Nine Nether Sect. Instead of raising an alarm, he went with his nature and joined in their debauchery, whoring and gambling day and night. Most of the time it was Eighth Brother who paid for these vices.
This quickly won over the trust of the Nine Nether Sect member."
The Eighth Elder. Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou didn't have much interaction with him, but they were left with a deep impression.
After all, the Eighth Elder had dared to sell the admission exam questions to Meng Jingzhou twenty years prior, assuring him they were the real deal.
"What happened next?"
"The Nine Nether Sect member then asked where the Eighth Brother, being a Nascent Soul Stage cultivator, was getting all his Spirit Stones from. The Eighth Brother replied that they discovered a pill formula that could extend lifespan. The improvement might not be significant, but it was enough to drive those cultivators nearing the end of their lifespan into a frenzy."
"The Eighth Brother also said it was inside information from their organization and he wouldn't have told him if they weren't such good buddies."
"However, the Lifespan Extender Pill had a low output, and its demand far exceeded its supply. Therefore, a substantial amount of Spirit Stones was needed to buy the ingredients and increase production."
"The Eighth Brother said their organization was short of funds. He asked if he could borrow some. It wouldn't be a free loan; he assured that the capital would be returned after a year, plus twenty percent interest."
"The member of the Nine Nether Sect was tempted, but still skeptical, and initially only invested tens of thousands of Spirit Stones. After a year, the Eighth Brother returned the capital right on time, along with the twenty percent interest."
"The Nether Sect member continued to test for three years, and each year saw the same results."
"Eventually, this matter was discovered by the member's superior, who also wanted to invest. He asked the Eighth Brother if it was possible. The Eighth Brother said he needed to ask his superiors, then brought out Old Nine, who is your Master."
"Your Master agreed to the investment, and subsequently, the member's superior invested for five years, doubling his assets, much to his delight."
"There is no wall in the world that blocks all winds, and this matter was eventually discovered by the Master of the Nine Nether Sect. The Master didn't inform anyone else but cautiously proposed to observe the pill refining process. Old Eight and Old Nine called us over to fake the pill refining scene, and our oldest brother pretended to be a tester using the pill."
"After the Master's observation, he thought our group of nine was quite trustworthy. He first threw his own Spirit Stones into the mix and made a lot of money."
"Even though he made quite a lot of money, the Master felt it was not enough. He set his sights on the treasury of the Nine Nether Sect. He planned to use the funds from the treasury for investments and return the treasury's Spirit Stones after obtaining the profits a year later, keeping the profits for himself. Wouldn't that be perfect?"
"The Master used a portion of the treasury and made more money. Still unsatisfied, he decided to use almost half of the treasury for investment."
"And then we ran away with the money."
"Don't tell anyone about this. Even your grandmaster doesn't know about this matter," the Fifth Elder reminded them.
Qin Yanyan was puzzled, "The Spirit Stones you returned to the Nine Nether Sect as bonus, come from the Seek Dao Sect, didn't they? How can grandmaster not know about it?"
The Fifth Elder shook his head, "There's no need to use the Seek Dao Sect's money. In the whole process, only the Eighth Brother's Spirit Stones were used, and that was only in the beginning when he was scamming the member."
Qin Yanyan was even more puzzled.
The Fifth Elder had a lot of patience for this disciple, "Think about it, when we handed out the bonus, weren't there other members from the Nine Nether Sect investing in us?"
Qin Yanyan nodded her head.
"So, couldn't we just return money borrowed from new investors to the previous investors?"
Enlightened, Qin Yanyan exclaimed, "Wait a minute. This is a scam, isn't it?"
"I also asked the Eighth Brother the same question. The Eighth Brother said how can it be a scam? We simply failed in the business, the invested capital was lost, which is normal in business."
"If anyone felt wronged, they could report us to the imperial court. We've done nothing wrong, so we have nothing to fear."
"Besides, if there are any crimes to be committed, it's the Master of the Nine Nether Sect misappropriating funds."
Qin Yanyan: "..."
Lu Yang noticed that Li Haoran, standing to one side, looked strangely troubled. "What's wrong?" he asked.
Li Haoran, with a conflicted expression, looked at his Master, "The Master who was scammed was so angry he died from heart failure. Then Qin Haoran took over as Master and found that the Nine Nether Sect's finances had significant issues."
"The Master who died didn't know who had tricked him until his death."

chapters.title: Chapter 320 - 319 Learn to Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth_1
chapters.content:
The wealth accumulated over ten thousand years by the Nine Nether Sect had been emptied out by the ten thousand year swindling of the Seek Dao Sect, causing the death of their Master. They had lost both their wealth and manpower.
After its leader's death, the Nine Nether Sect faded into nothingness in the next nine hundred years.
Survival of the fittest, perhaps this was the harsh reality of the Cultivation World... Oh please.
Lu Yang couldn't help himself from interrupting his own narration.
Isn't aggression and plunder the rule in the brutal world of cultivation? Then why does it look more like financial scamming here?
What happened to the claim of power being supreme?
The mystery surrounding the Nine Nether Sect's downfall thousands of years ago was finally solving today, and Li Haoran didn't quite know what to say.
Although the previous two masters of the sect had no real connection to him, he felt like he should, perhaps, make a statement?
He began to clap.
Good riddance to everyone in the Nine Nether Sect, they deserved their downfall!
Fifth Elder cleared his throat twice: "In any case, I agree to your proposition of becoming the Protector of Heaven's Court."
"According to you, our branch of the Heaven's Court is in a barbecue shop in Yanjiang County, when do we set off?"
"How about we set off tomorrow? The night is full of dreams," Lu Yang suggested.
"Alright."
"Oh, also, remember to disguise yourself, Elder. It would be bad if someone from the Nine Nether Sect recognized you," Lu Yang reminded him. Previously, they'd come into contact with members of the Nine Nether Sect using fake names and appearances.
"Piece of cake. Although my disguising skills aren't as proficient as Old Nine's, I can still handle the folks from the Nine Nether Sect. They might even send someone at the Unification stage this time, who can see through your disguises in one glance."
"Before we set off, let me disguise all four of you."
It seemed the Fifth Elder was quite experienced in this aspect.
After parting ways with the Fifth Elder, Lu Yang didn't forget to expand the members of Heaven's Court. He wanted to invite Tao Yaoye and Man Gu to join Heaven's Court and pretend to be ancient geniuses in Yanjiang County.
Unfortunately, when Lu Yang went to them, he found out that Tao Yaoye and Man Gu were in seclusion.
Senior Sister told Lu Yang that Tao Yaoye and Man Gu were consolidating their Golden Core realms and wouldn't be free for a while.
"By the way, Fairy, could you teach me some magic skills or divine abilities? You know, something ancient-looking that screams 'from the ancient era' at a glance?"
Lu Yang explained, "Think about it, I'm posing as an ancient genius, so if I keep using modern techniques, I might give myself away."
Fairy Eternity gazed silently at Lu Yang, thinking to herself, 'None of your techniques look modern. Is it the Shrinking Ground Into Inches or the Tree Growing Spell?'
However, she was a considerate fairy and didn't voice any discouraging words. "Sure thing."
"I have an ancient Qi Refinement technique here. It allows you to gather the spiritual notes of Heaven and Earth, the morning and evening's radiance, to process and ingest it, resulting in longevity and everlasting youth. The Qi Refinement stage is derived from this ancient technique."
"While Immortal Jiuchong was proving himself to be the first person to become an Immortal, he referenced many ancient texts, one of which mentioned this ancient Qi Refinement technique. Using his Immortal magic he surmised that, when practiced to its fullest, it could refine the nebulous purple Qi, an overwhelmingly powerful force.
However, this is purely theoretical, I've never seen anyone manage to do it."
Lu Yang shook his head: "This won't do. If I don't get a chance to use it in front of people from the Nine Nether Sect, they won't be able to tell that it's an ancient Qi Refinement technique."
"How about the Dragon Transformation Manual? The dragons possess a formidable physical body. By practicing this technique, the practitioner can partially 'transform' into a dragon and gain some of the talents the dragons have, like summoning rain and stirring up the sea."
"Yingtian Immortal had studied the Dragon Transformation Manual. He is so far the highest achiever in this technique, able to transform completely into a dragon. Even the dragons themselves refer to him as 'Ying Dragon'."
Lu Yang's eyes lit up: "Hey, this is good, how do I learn it?"
"Let me think, I think you should initially soak yourself in dragon's blood for three days. Although there is a chance of your body swelling like Yingtian Immortal's, since I will be guiding you, there shouldn't be any issue... Oh right, is there a short supply of dragon's blood in your era?"
In the ancient period, to acquire dragon's blood, one would either force it out of a dragon through strength, kill a stray true dragon, or, like Yingtian Immortal, be recognized by the dragons for their potential, making them willing to invest in you.
"I do have dragon's blood."
Seek Dao Sect was sure to have dragon's blood, but the problem was that they were setting off tomorrow. You couldn't possibly soak in dragon's blood on the way, let alone for three days.
Fairy Eternity had mentioned before that it could lead to the same consequences as Yingtian Immortal's experience.
"Is there anything else?"
"How about the divine ability of the Taotie clan, Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth?"
Lu Yang was startled. The Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth technique of the Taotie clan was well known. He had heard of it from his master before he had begun cultivation.
It was said that this technique was capable of absorbing souls, spiritual energy, the sun, moon, stars, space, and everything in the world!
If he could learn it, that would certainly be a good thing.
"But isn't this the innate divine ability that only the Taotie clan can learn? Can I learn it too?"
As always, Fairy Eternity was full of confidence, patting her chest and saying, "You make it sound like it is difficult. With my guidance, what can't you learn?"
"Then I'll learn this!" Lu Yang made up his mind, eagerly waiting to learn his new skill.
Lu Yang found a spacious area far from the kitchen on Sky Gate Mountain where Fairy Eternity appeared in person to instruct him.
"To learn Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth, the most important thing is to have the desire to devour, it is the key."
"Why are the Taotie clan such gluttons? It's because their desire to devour is innate, uncontrollable!"
"Close your eyes and imagine yourself being very hungry, desiring food."
Lu Yang followed Fairy Eternity's instructions, imagining himself as a mortal with an empty stomach, starving and salivating at the thought of food.
He imagined a plate of delicious food in front of him… For example, tomato scrambled eggs.
Instantly, he no longer felt hungry.
He opened his eyes to see Fairy Eternity watching him with a tilted head.
"What's wrong?" the innocent-looking Fairy asked.
"...Nothing, a minor mistake, let's imagine again."
Lu Yang banished the scrambled egg with tomatoes from his mind, picturing instead a plate of mouthwatering, aromatic dishes:
Beautifully glazed roasted pork knuckles, snails with firm meat and spicy flavors, noodles with hot oil chili…
Lu Yang wiped his mouth. He was genuinely hungry now.
Fairy Eternity's voice floated to his ears at the right moment, "Remember the incantation that I'm reading out. Do not try to memorize it. Instead, understand it. Imagine its meaning on a deeper level."
Then came the ancient and difficult language.
Perhaps because Lu Yang's hunger harmonized with the incantation, even though it was still incomprehensible, he no longer found it abrasive.
From noon until evening, Lu Yang kept his hungry state to comprehend the incantation. Gradually, he felt more and more familiar with the incantation until it almost seemed as if he understood its implication – to eat.
He opened his eyes again, and an urge rose in his heart as he chanted the incantation silently and looked at the ground beneath him.
He wanted to eat earth.
"Wait wait, why do I want to eat the earth?!" Lu Yang suddenly realized something was off.
Fairy Eternity, reclining on the ground, propped up by her arms, said matter-of-factly, "Congratulations, you've mastered the 'Ground-Eater'."

chapters.title: Chapter 321 - 320 History of the Taotie Clan_1
chapters.content:
"Ground-Eater?"
Lu Yang bent over to pick up a piece of mud from the ground, resisting the urge to swallow it, then tossed it back.
Fairy Eternity hopped up from the ground with a laugh, "Yes, Ground-Eater is literally about eating dirt. Is that so hard to understand?"
Fairy Eternity felt that Lu Yang's intellect might be inferior to her own, but understanding this should be quite simple, shouldn't it?
Lu Yang:"..."
So your Ground-Eater is to be taken literally?
Seeing Lu Yang's confused expression, Fairy Eternity sighed slightly, feeling fortunate that she was there in his Spiritual Space to offer him advice. Otherwise, Lu Yang's naive mind could be easily deceived.
She further explained, "Though Taotie is known as one of the four fiends of antiquity, that reputation came later. Initially, they were a miserable lot. They had big appetites but no real ability, always starving, and their weakness prohibited hunting, leading to a vicious cycle."
"The Taotie clan could not fast. Their life was all about eating."
"Desperate with hunger, they would eat anything, even tree bark and leaves. But those weren't filling or nutritious."
"Perhaps their ancestors felt sympathy for them. A genius emerged from the Taotie clan who was talented in cultivation and clever."
"That Taotie creature thought, since eating is inherently necessity, if I can ingest tree bark and leaves, why can't I eat the earth itself?"
"It isolated itself for three days, without drinking a drop of water. It was on the brink of starvations, seeing its past life flash before its eyes. It assumed its end was near but then remembered its clan, its family and its emaciated brothers and sisters, their fervent expectations."
"It felt it could not just fall into oblivion like this, it had to fight back!"
"Finding hope in the shadow of death, it combined all its life-learning instincts through an insatiable will to survive, thus creating a great divine skill — Devour the sky and Swallow the Earth!"
"This divine skill transformed into the power of their bloodline, becoming an innate part of the Taotie's heritage. From then on, every Taotie would automatically acquire this divine skill, vying to consume the earth."
"Wait a minute. I heard that the Taotie clan's Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth could even shatter space. From your description, it doesn't sound like it could do that?" Lu Yang couldn't help but question. This story did not match what he had read in books.
Fairy Eternity glared at Lu Yang, indignant: "Man, you really have no patience. Just listen to the rest of the story!"
"Please continue."
Fairy Eternity, full of smug satisfaction, uttered a satisfied "That's more like it," and continued her story:
"The reason the Taotie clan lived such miserable lives and had generally low cultivation levels was because they had no energy left for cultivation. Once they started to eat their fill, they had surplus energy to cultivate."
"The racial cultivation talent of the Taotie clan could easily rival the top-tier demon beast clans, such as the Dragon Clan, Phoenix Tribe, Kun Peng Clan, Qiongqi Clan, and so on."
"The Taotie clan cultivated rapidly. Another reason for this was that eating dirt really could make one stronger. The better the quality of the earth, the more rapid their cultivation rate. There was even a time when the price of black soil skyrocketed because of their consumption of it."
"The soil in the medicine garden of the Seek Dao Sect is of good quality. You could try it and I guarantee it would boost your cultivation speed!"
"I'll think about it."
Taking advantage of Lu Yang's pretense of consideration, Fairy Eternity continued, "As the Taotie clan's cultivation levels rapidly advanced, they began to make a name for themselves within the demon race. Eventually, they became more than just talented; the overall strength of their race was considered on par with the top tier clans."
"And this paved the way for their reputation as one of the four fiends."
"Later, when the Taotie clan became prosperous, they felt that as a noble clan, constantly eating dirt was a beneath them. So, they modified the skill of Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth to absorb everything, just as you see it now."
Lu Yang fell silent for a moment, then asked, "Fairy, why did you not teach me the version of Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth that came later?"
Fairy Eternity looked at Lu Yang curiously, not understanding his question, "Isn't that what you asked for? You wanted the most ancient skill, especially one that clearly holds an air of antiquity?"
"This skill is genuinely ancient, even for me. I learned about it from ancient books and through the exaggerated storytelling of Qilin Immortal. I'm just relaying what I know to you."
"Let me tell you, this move is almost forgotten. Even the Taotie clan might not have anyone who knows it. If you hadn't begged me, I wouldn't have taught you."
Lu Yang: "..."
Thanks a lot.
"Does this skill only allow for eating dirt?" Lu Yang asked hopefully.
"Of course not."
"Really?" Lu Yang felt delighted thinking that Fairy was reliable after all.
"Try having a bite of dirt and see. It surely will be very dry and hard to swallow. If you drink water, it will turn into mud, which is also hard to swallow and can stick in your throat."
"That's where 'Devour the Sky' comes in, to help swallow the earth. After eating dirt, you can use spiritual essence as water, swallow surrounding spiritual energy to help gulp the earth down. With a gulp, it's all swallowed!"
"...So this is a combo skill?"
"What do you mean? The founder is a genius of the Taotie clan. It's only natural for him to think all the details through, isn't it?"
"Of course, you can also use Devour the Sky separately, to absorb spiritual essence."
"Let me try."
Lu Yang silently recited the method's incantation, opened his mouth, and true enough, a vast amount of spiritual energy flooded in, filling his entire body.
Lu Yang started to cough, feeling choked, "I choked myself up, it feels like I can't breathe. My body instinctively closed my mouth and started to cough."
"You're absorbing spiritual energy too fast. With your current cultivation level, you can't absorb it this quickly."
Lu Yang, taking her advice, circulated his cultivation methods to calm the spiritual energy in his body, he opened his mouth and deliberately slowed down the absorption of spiritual energy.
The spiritual energy tasted as sweet as nectar, which, after being digested in the stomach, spread throughout his body, bringing an indescribable comfort.
"Ah, this feels good~" Lu Yang couldn't help but exclaim.
"Wait, the feeling of absorbing spiritual energy just now, wasn't it the same as using a Gathering Spirit Array?"
"You guessed right, the original Gathering Spirit Array used by our human race was created based on this skill." Fairy Eternity disclosed another ancient secret.
The various arts of cultivation, such as talismans and array methods, were all things the ancient human race imitated from nature, or from demon beasts.
This includes imitating the Taotie clan.
"No wonder... Hold on. Even if I learn this version of Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth, it's useless. Who now would know about the Taotie clan's past and recognize that me eating dirt signifies Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth?"
Lu Yang suddenly realized that while it was true this skill was ancient, if it were too ancient, there would be a problem if nobody recognized it.
He even doubted whether anyone from Fairy Eternity's era would know about these things!
Fairy Eternity hesitated, "So, do you want to learn the current version of Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth?"
Lu Yang nodded vigorously.
Fairy Eternity breathed a sigh of relief, "Then that's easy."
"What do you mean?"
"I don't know how."
Because she didn't know, Lu Yang didn't need to learn it. It was that simple.

chapters.title: Chapter 322 - 321: Fairy Eternity Suppresses Little Medicinal Kings_1
chapters.content:
Seek Dao Sect, medicine garden.
Under the cover of night, Uncle Ba, as always, was guarding the medicine garden. He created a clone, positioned it opposite him, and started playing chess with himself.
"Uncle Ba." A familiar voice echoed beside Uncle Ba's ear.
"Little Lu? What brings you to the garden this late?"
Cultivators don't really abide by day and night, but most disciples rarely visit the medicine garden at night.
Lu Yang, looking a bit embarrassed, spoke, "Do you have any valued or rare..."
"Medicinal ingredients?"
"Mud."
"What do you want mud for?"
"To eat."
Uncle Ba: "...."
He'd heard that Yun Zhi often went against conventional norms and had a tendency to torture people. Was Lu Yang being tortured to this extent now?
"No, I've been cultivating a technique that allows one to eat earth. I thought I might taste some to see what it's like."
Uncle Ba stroked his chin, sizing Lu Yang up and down, "I remember the last time you came to the medicine garden, you practiced a technique to shrink the earth. Now, coming again, you're practicing a technique to eat earth. Are you transmitting the skills of an earthworm?"
Shrinking earth, eating earth ─ these were specialties of the Silver Ring King Worm.
Lu Yang seriously replied: "I have received this from an ancient heritage."
"An ancient earthworm?"
Without delving into this any further - honestly, nothing that the disciples of the Seek Dao Sect did surprised Uncle Ba. He himself had gone through a similar journey. He commented, "Alright, this is not your first time in the garden. The earthworm couple is resting; another earthworm couple is enjoying their honeymoon.
You can go into the garden by yourself to find some soil around the area of Little Medicinal Kings."
Just as Lu Yang was about to enter the medicine garden, Uncle Ba stopped him: "By the way, have you ever been in love?"
"No."
Uncle Ba uttered an acknowledgment and then asked, "Do you know what girls like to hear the most?"
Lu Yang immediately asked Fairy Eternity in his Spiritual Space, "What do you like to hear from others?"
"Praise me for being beautiful and intelligent."
Lu Yang turned back to Uncle Ba and said, "Praise her for being beautiful and intelligent."
Uncle Ba, deep in thought, said: "I see, you can go in now."
...
Returning to the medicine garden after a long absence, Lu Yang made his familiar way over to the dwelling of the Little Medicinal Kings.
Under the giant Enlightenment Tree, the Little Medicinal Kings were holding hands, dancing and singing around a bonfire.
"What a smell, it's so aromatic..."
"Ginseng King, your whiskers are on fire!"
"Help me put it out."
The Little Medicinal Kings swarmed over, stomping and kicking at the ginseng doll. Not before too long, they managed to put out the fire, but not without giving the doll quite a beating.
"Lu Yang, are you here?" The Enlightenment Tree was the first to notice Lu Yang's arrival and greeted him with a cheery holler.
"Is it Lu Yang?"
Hearing the Enlightenment Tree speak, the Little Medicinal Kings also noticed Lu Yang's arrival.
The Little Medicinal Kings were bouncing joyfully around Lu Yang's feet, looking very pleased.
Lu Yang shrank his body and glanced over the Little Medicinal Kings that he hadn't seen in months: Ginseng Baby, Three-Leafed Star Grass, Time Termination Flower, and Kirin Immortality Medicine.
The Little Medicinal Kings were even more delighted to see that Lu Yang was willing to become as tall as them, "So, how is the plan to counterattack the female major demon going?"
The last time they parted, Lu Yang tricked the Little Medicinal Kings by saying he also despised the female major demon Yun Zhi, and wanted to join forces with them to counterattack her.
At that time, Lu Yang didn't know the strength of Eldest Senior Sister, he thought she was just at the peak of Unification, and believed that he could surpass her given a few thousand years of cultivation.
However, now it seems that even if he cultivated for thousands of years, and Fairy Eternity resurrected, they may not be a match for Eldest Senior Sister.
"I knew, Lu Yang, that you also want to teach Miss Yun a lesson!" Fairy Eternity, as if finding like-minded friends, excitedly left the spiritual space.
"Eh, a soul body, human race, who are you?" The Ginseng Baby crossed its arms with great confidence.
He had heard and seen the events of strong souls residing inside human cultivators, those strong souls are at most on the Transcendance Tribulation stage.
What does the Transcendance Tribulation stage count as, could they live without the Little Medicinal Kings?
"Little Medicinal child, show respect to this fairy, do you know who I am!" Fairy Eternity, as the head of the Five Immortals of the Ancients, had seen all kinds of things. Little Medicinal Kings were nothing to her, she could have them whenever she wanted, and there were countless Little Medicinal Kings willing to follow her, but she just didn't bother to nurture them.
Fairy Eternity slightly released her aura, that shocked the Little Medicinal Kings into sitting on their asses, as if the person in front of them has an innate suppression on them.
"You, you, you, who are you!"
The Enlightenment Tree was also greatly shocked, it didn't know who the soul body in front of it was, but instinct made it inexplicably panicked about Fairy Eternity.
Under the panic, there was a hidden desire.
The Little Medicinal Kings could live for a long time, but they could never shake off the bondage of lifespan, one day they would reach the end of their life.
On the other hand, the Eternity Dao Fruit was a symbol of everlasting existence and immortality, the lifelong pursuit of the Little Medicinal Kings, it had a natural suppression on them.
For instance, the Herbal Celestial Grass that put Lu Yang in a tough fight in the secret forest before, Fairy Eternity had wanted to teach it a lesson and released the aura of Eternity to suppress the Herbal Celestial Grass when she saw Lu Yang being bullied. However, she didn't do anything afterwards because Lu Yang entered the enlightened state.
"I was Fairy Eternity, the head of the Five Immortals of the Ancients from three hundred thousand years ago, and I am currently the only guest elder of Seek Dao Sect, invited by Miss Yun herself with utmost respect!"
"I was also the very first immortal in ancient times, who established the Heavenly Court, and was the supreme Heavenly Emperor of the Heavenly Court — Dao Celestial Emperor!"
"Wow, you are so amazing!" The Little Medicinal Kings were shocked by Fairy Eternity's multiple identities, and they looked at Fairy Eternity in awe.
"Hehe, now you know how amazing I am, right?"
"When I have fully recovered my strength, I will lead you to attack Yun Zhi, to let her know who is the strongest!"
The Little Medicinal Kings clapped their hands in approval, thinking that Fairy Eternity was very powerful and self-confident.
"So, Fairy, are you currently recovering your strength inside Lu Yang's body?"
"You are partially correct, not only am I recovering my strength inside Lu Yang's body, but I have also set up various tests to let Lu Yang undergo trials. After the trials, I will regard him as my successor!"
"I let Lu Yang experience the feeling of having power, making him the Sect Leader of Seek Dao Sect for three days, holding all power and being unparalleled. After three days, Lu Yang's senior brothers and sisters were all lining up to see Lu Yang!"
"I guided his cultivation, shared with him about ancient secrets, taught him the great Divine Ability 'Heaven and Earth in an Inch' and 'Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth', made use of his body to challenge higher levels and cultivate his invincible character."
"Lu Yang successfully condensed the Invincible Elixir, the first Golden Core of all time, is due to my guidance!"
The Little Medicinal Kings were dumbfounded, thinking that Lu Yang was really lucky to become the successor of a fairy, and have the fairy share all her knowledge with him.
What a great fortune!
Although they had never heard of the Invincible Elixir, but being titled as the first Golden Core of all time by the fairy, it goes without saying how potent it would be.
Lu Yang opened his mouth, intending to say that Fairy Eternity was talking nonsense, but upon careful thought, it seemed that what Fairy Eternity said was all true.
Who did she learn this from?
Lu Yang cut off Fairy Eternity's self-praise, and said, "We came to the medicinal garden to see if there are any particularly valuable soils here that can be used for cultivation."

chapters.title: Chapter 323 - 322: The Origin of the Kirin Immortality Medicine_1
chapters.content:
"Since when do humans need to use precious soil for cultivation?" The Ginseng Doll was surprised. In its memory, even among cultivators who specifically practiced earth attribute magic skills, none had ever asked them for soil.
The medicinal garden lacked everything, everything but soil. Especially for them, the Little Medicinal Kings, who all used the precious soil that couldn't be bought with a mountain of gold.
"Wait for me." The Ginseng Doll dropped this phrase before quickly running into the wooden house. There was the sound of rummaging before it came out holding four iron shovels.
"The four of us will dig for some rare soil, to see which one Lu Yang will use." It kept one shovel for itself and divided the remaining three shovels amongst the three Little Medicinal Kings.
The four Little Medicinal Kings scattered, disappearing in the blink of an eye, leaving behind only the Enlightenment Tree, Lu Yang, and Fairy Eternity.
The Ginseng Doll was the first to return, its roots cupping a pile of dark, black soil: "Here, this is black soil, do you want it?"
Lu Yang had often heard of this kind of soil. It was a soil that could nourish any spiritual plant to thrive. The lands cultivated by the Green-eyed Buffalo people were made up of this black soil.
"This isn't the black soil you see outside. This is the source of the black soil. It can be used for cultivation, and also for improving the quality of the surrounding soil, turning it into black soil."
"What you see outside is black soil that has been assimilated by the source soil, or you could say what you see are derivatives of the black soil. These derivatives have a limit in terms of cycles and time. After a few uses, they will degrade back to their original soil state. What I have in my hand is the real black soil; it never changes." The Ginseng Doll looked quite pleased.
This was their favorite kind of soil among the Little Medicinal Kings.
"It's that amazing?" Lu Yang grabbed a handful, closed his eyes, and stuffed it into his mouth. He opened his mouth and swallowed the black soil.
The Ginseng Doll and Enlightenment Tree were stunned, staring wide-eyed. They were still pondering how Lu Yang was going to cultivate with the soil; had he just eaten it directly?
"How does it feel? How does it feel?" Fairy Eternity asked hastily.
Lu Yang smacked his lips, savoring the sensation: "Nothing's changed. My cultivation level hasn't increased, the speed of spiritual essence within my body hasn't changed, my strength did not increase, my agility did not improve, my spiritual sense strength hasn't changed."
"Maybe the amount wasn't enough, eat some more?" Fairy Eternity suggested.
Lu Yang thought it made some sense. He quickly consumed all the black soil the Ginseng Doll had brought, even going so far as to complete a full cycle of his cultivation method: "Still no change."
Fairy Eternity pondered carefully before analyzing: "It's possible that the black soil's function is to improve talent, for example allowing someone with Three Spirit Roots to become someone with Dual Spirit Roots, and someone with Dual Spirit Roots to become someone with a Single Spirit Root. You already have a Single Spirit Root, the best possible talent, there's no room left for improvement."
Lu Yang looked suspiciously at Fairy Eternity: "Fairy, have you ever eaten it?"
"What do you mean? How could a top Ancient beauty like me eat soil?"
"Moreover, by the time I mastered this divine ability, I had already become immortal. I was at the peak of cultivation, why would I need to eat soil?"
Lu Yang interrupted Fairy Eternity's boasting: "Hold on a minute, where did this top ten Ancient beauty stuff come from? I've never heard of such a ranking?"
"Am I not the most beautiful woman of ancient times?"
Looking at Fairy Eternity's flawless radiant face, Lu Yang nodded.
"If there's a first, there must be a tenth, correct?"
Lu Yang nodded again.
"Although I don't know who the top ten beauties of ancient times are, since there's a tenth-ranking, there must be a top ten, right?"
"So, you made it up?"
"How can you say that I made it up? I'm just stating something that definitely exists! Besides, it's certain that there are three people in the top ten ancient beauties: the two wives of Qilin Immortal, and my most devoted follower, Qinghe."
"Qilin Immortal?" At this moment, the Kirin Immortality Medicine arrived carrying another type of soil, just in time to hear Fairy Eternity talking about the Qilin Immortal.
"Master Fairy, the Qilin Immortal you mentioned... Does he have anything to do with me?"
Seeing the Kirin Immortality Medicine's anxiety, Lu Yang suddenly recalled the rumor the Ginseng Doll had shared with him. The rumor said there were no Qilins in the world, and that all the Qilin's people had seen were actually Kirin Immortality Medicine.
The Little Medicinal Kings also didn't know whether there was a real Qilin in the world.
Lu Yang once thought the same, until he learned about the existence of the Qilin Immortal from Fairy Eternity, which shattered that lie.
Only then did Lu Yang realize that the knowledge he took for granted, such as the titles of the Four Immortals of the Ancients, was not known by many, even amongst the medical practitioners in the Unification realm. Even the long-lived Little Medicinal Kings didn't know about it.
Could it be that Fairy Eternity was truly my golden finger?
"Qilin Immortal is the only Qilin in the world, and also the only immortal of the Demon Race. As for you, the Kirin Immortality Medicines..."
The Kirin Immortality Medicine asked eagerly: "How did we come into existence?"
"When the blood of the Qilin Immortal dropped on a spiritual plant, the plant was affected by the immortal blood and transformed into a Qilin."
The Kirin Immortality Medicine immediately felt a rise in its status as its medicial stalk stiffened.
Lu Yang was surprised: "Did the Qilin Immortal get injured after attaining immortality? Who was the enemy?"
Was there a terrifying existence that could threaten the ancient immortals in ancient times? Was Fairy Eternity always worried since my cultivation level was too low and didn't tell me, planning to wait until my cultivation level improved before telling me?
Fairy Eternity tries so hard, what a pity it was still discovered by me!
Should I pretend to know nothing, or continue asking?
Fairy Eternity was equally puzzled: "I wasn't present at the time, and I'm not clear about the specifics. It was during Qilin Immortal's wedding. The three of them, Ying Tian and the others, beat up Qilin Immortal and he lost a lot of blood."
"What were they doing on such a joyous occasion? I don't understand them. Is this what they call wedding pranks?"
Lu Yang: "..."
Isn't it because you caused trouble with the immortal fruit at the wedding, instigating a cooking competition between the two top chefs using your dragon and phoenix cooking skills, and made Ying Tian and the others taste test them? Afterward, Ying Tian and the others thought the source of trouble was the Qilin Immortal, so they taught Qilin Immortal a good lesson, right?
So the Kirin Immortality Medicine appeared at that time.
This Kirin Immortality Medicine in the garden is the offspring of that first one.
"A battle between immortals?" The Enlightenment Tree and the Ginseng Doll gasped in shock. They never expected that even during ancient times, immortals could meet with misfortune.
They automatically filled in the gaps in Fairy Eternity's story with their imaginations:
During ancient times, when Qilin Immortal got married, all the demons came to pay their respects. Three immortals, who were at odds with Qilin Immortal, deliberately provoked him on his joyous day. For the sake of his beloved and dignity, Qilin Immortal did not back down and fought back fiercely.
With his supreme immortal power, he stirred up waves and shocked the world, leaving an imprint on the ancient timeline!
This battle defended his unique standing as the sole immortal amongst the Demon Race!
Seeing immortals bleed, one could imagine how fierce the battle was!
A truly fitting Immortal War!
This Fairy Eternity really did not consider them as outsiders, casually revealing a corner of the ancient secrets with just a few words.
They turned to look at Lu Yang.
Being so close to Fairy Eternity, Lu Yang must already know many ancient secrets and heard about numerous cruel ancient struggles!

chapters.title: Chapter 324 - 323: Qilin Immortal, I've remembered you!_1
chapters.content:
"Right, this is the mud I found, Breath Soil." Kirin Immortality Medicine regained its composure after the shock of the immortal battle and remembered why it was here.
"Breath Soil, is it the legendary kind that just needs a small piece to obstruct a river?!" Lu Yang had only seen this precious soil in books. Because of its magical effects, it was known by people as "Immortal Soil".
Fairy Eternity walked around the Breath Soil a few times and recognized its origins: "Oh, this is a good thing made by the Immortal Jiuchong. It swells when it encounters water and is used to control floodwaters."
"Back then, our river channels were a mess, frequently flooding, and the tribes were all settled by the river. This led to massive casualties every time the river flooded, making it difficult to rebuild afterwards."
"The large tribes were okay because they had cultivators who used the Water Control Technique to control the river's direction and prevent dangers to the tribe. But for the medium and small tribes, their cultivators weren't powerful enough to control the massive river."
"Although Immortal Jiuchong was from the Lianshan Clan, the largest Human family, he treated everyone alike, especially the small tribes."
"After becoming an immortal, he sought to solve the problem of floods by refining a type of mud that swells when it meets water, which is this Breath Soil you're holding."
"Oh, right, Lu Yang, you can't eat the Breath Soil." Fairy Eternity reminded him.
"Is there a problem with that?"
Fairy Eternity looked at Lu Yang with a sympathetic gaze: "Breath Soil swells when it meets water, and saliva counts too. If you take a bite of Breath Soil, it will swell up and wrap around you."
"In that case, I'll stay away." Lu Yang quickly distanced himself from the Breath Soil.
After consuming the other two kinds of precious soil brought by the Three-Leafed Star Grass and the Time Termination Flower respectively, Lu Yang didn't notice any effect.
"It's not working."
The effects of the three types of soil couldn't all be bodily enhancements.
"Try another bite?" Fairy Eternity wasn't convinced.
Lu Yang ate all the soil he brought, and there was absolutely no change.
Lu Yang thought he probably hadn't eaten enough, so he had the Little Medicinal Kings continue to find soil for him to eat, but he ate until dawn without sensing any changes.
"Fairy, is this Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth of yours reliable?" Lu Yang suspected that he had been tricked by Fairy Eternity.
"Why wouldn't it be? This was taught to me by Qilin Immortal himself as a great divine ability of the Gluttony!"
Lu Yang instantly had a bad feeling: "Wait, was it Qilin Immortal who taught you?"
"Yes."
"When did he teach you? Was it after his wedding?"
Fairy Eternity asked in surprise: "How did you know?"
"Not long after his wedding ended, Qilin Immortal approached me, asking if I wanted to learn the ancient great divine ability of the Gluttony. I thought there was no harm in trying."
"Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth was not difficult to learn; I mastered it quickly. Afterwards, Qilin Immortal asked me if I wanted to try eating some soil. I retorted, saying that as an immortal, what could eating soil do for me? Hearing this, he left in disappointment."
Lu Yang remained silent for a while before he tentatively asked: "Fairy, did you mention in the book that the gluttonous clan could enhance their cultivation potential by eating soil?"
"No, Qilin Immortal told me that."
Lu Yang: "..."
Lu Yang roughly understood what was going on—Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth was indeed for eating soil, and the Gluttony did indeed rise to prominence from eating soil, but there was absolutely no saying that eating soil could enhance cultivation potential!
It was Qilin Immortal who wanted to take revenge on Fairy Eternity, deliberately teaching her this divine ability and using the "improvement of cultivation potential" as a lure to make Fairy Eternity eat soil.
In this way, Qilin Immortal could spread the fact that Fairy Eternity ate soil around, using it to mock her.
Who would have imagined that Fairy Eternity was so unworldly and didn't fall for it at all!
300,000 years later, the trap, which was set by Qilin Immortal, managed to catch Lu Yang, the unlucky schmuck who ate soil all night.
Qilin Immortal, if you can't trick Fairy Eternity, then you trick me?! I remember you!
...
When everyone arrived at the meeting point, Lu Yang hadn't arrived yet.
Just as they were about to go look for him, Lu Yang walked over with a heavy gait, his face covered in a layer of mud.
Meng Jingzhou was startled by Lu Yang's appearance, "What happened to you? Did you fall in the mud while sleeping?"
Lu Yang brushed it off as if nothing had happened, "Nothing much, just a minor setback when learning divine abilities - a common occurrence on the path of cultivation."
Luckily, as a Golden Core stage cultivator, he doesn't need to sleep; otherwise, Lu Yang would be so exhausted that he could hardly keep his eyes open.
The Fifth Elder also showed concern for Lu Yang, "Really, you're alright?"
"I'm really okay."
"That's good then."
The Fifth Elder pulled out a flying shuttle from his sleeve, tossed it lightly in the air, and it expanded to the size of a commercial flying boat.
The flying shuttle opened, revealing the seats and various sophisticated facilities within.
This was the Fifth Elder's favorite flying magic artifact. As far as cost was concerned, it was much more expensive than a flying boat.
"Get in."
One by one, everyone jumped onto the flying shuttle, and it closed up.
"Everyone's seated and buckled up?" The Fifth Elder stood at the forefront, asking lightly.
Everyone, not quite understanding his meaning, sat obediently in their seats and collectively confirmed that they were secured.
"Good."
With a nod, the Fifth Elder raised his index and middle fingers, activating the flying shuttle.
The shuttle broke the air barrier, creating a sonic boom, and launched at a high speed.
Feeling as though something heavy was charging towards them, everyone felt pushed tightly against their seats, unable to move, including Lu Yang.
No matter how hard Lu Yang gritted his teeth and used all of his strength, he could not break free and was stuck to his seat.
He even attempted to form a shield of spiritual essence around him for protection, but it shattered as soon as it left his body due to the high speed — he couldn't maintain a barrier.
Finally, the pressure disappeared. The four of them sloppily sprawled forward, arms propped on their legs, heads drooping forward to steady themselves.
They were filled with a sense of relief as if they had just escaped from a crisis.
They hadn't even felt this way when facing the Nine Nether cult.
The Fifth Elder paced in front of them, advising, "I intentionally accelerated sharply just now to train your response to sudden situations. Remember this feeling. As cultivators, you must be alert to possible dangers around you at all times."
"Back when I was young, I was always racing flying boats, dealing with law enforcement cultivators flying in unpredictably from all directions. Not once did they manage to seize me."
The four of them watched the Fifth Elder cautiously, thinking that right now, the biggest danger was him!
The flying shuttle's speed was extremely fast. Lu Yang had intended to demonstrate his newly learned "Devour the Sky," but before he could speak, the Fifth Elder announced.
"We're here."
Meng Jingzhou leaned over and spotted Yanjiang County below.
The flying shuttle was now directly above Yanjiang County, completely invisible to the naked eye.
"We descend now."
The four of them looked at each other, unable to find any equipment for landing.
Only cultivators at the Golden Core stage could fly. Li Haoran and Qin Yanyan were not yet at the Golden Core stage, and Lu Yang feared heights.
How could they descend?
The Fifth Elder hit his forehead, "I'll bring you guys down."
With a swipe of the Fifth Elder's sleeve, Lu Yang felt a sudden darkness in front of his eyes. When he forced his eyes open, he found himself lying on the floor of a barbecue shop with Li Haoran on his left and Qin Yanyan on his right.
"What happened? Can Fifth Elder also use the 'Universe within the Sleeve'?" Lu Yang was astonished. Wasn't that a great divine skill that was difficult to cultivate?
Fairy Eternity spoke softly, "No, he just knocked you guys out and carried you here."

chapters.title: Chapter 325 - 324: The Barbecue Store Reopens_1
chapters.content:
After Lu Yang woke up, Li Haoran and Qin Yanyan also awoke in succession. The father-daughter pair looked around, unable to grasp their surroundings.
"Are you all awake?" The Fifth Elder sat on a stool, appearing carefree.
Qin Yanyan recalled the scene before she fainted. With a wave of the Fifth Elder's sleeve, their vision went dark. By the time they regained consciousness, they were already here.
It was just like the legendary Universe within the Sleeve.
"I get it now, you just used the Universe within the Sleeve, didn't you!" Qin Yanyan excitedly exclaimed, not expecting a chance to personally experience this legendary divine ability.
The Elder of the Seek Dao Sect is truly impressive!
The Fifth Elder revealed a faint smile without revealing more.
Li Haoran appeared thoughtful, never having heard of his master knowing the Universe within the Sleeve skill.
Meng Jingzhou, who had been observing all along, raised his eyebrows. He was the only one who hadn't lost consciousness among the four.
After knocking out Lu Yang's trio, the Fifth Elder had explained to Meng Jingzhou, stating that he was worried they might have a fear of heights or lack flying experience. Knocking them out made it more convenient to transport them.
Then the Fifth Elder fetched three sacks and efficiently bagged up the unconscious trio, as if he had done it many times before.
"So, this is the 'Once More' barbecue restaurant you've spoken of?" The Fifth Elder had done his homework before setting off, having asked Dai Bufan for Lu Yang's mission report, which informed him of the events in Yanjiang County.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, seeing the familiar decor, showed expressions of nostalgia.
Time flies, situations change, and the past feels unrecognizable. Years have passed in the blink of an eye. The Eternity Sect has been annihilated, and they hadn't expected to return here.
The Fifth Elder dragged his finger across a table, a thick layer of dust clinging to it. "Three months have passed; it's time for a cleaning."
Just as the Lu Yang's group was preparing to clean, the Fifth Elder waved his hand, saying, "There's no need for all that trouble."
His lips quivered slightly as he muttered an incantation unintelligible to anyone else. He casually formed a spell imprint with his hand.
The imprint fell to the ground, causing space to seemingly tremble and ripple invisibly, in circle after circle.
The dust on the tables, chairs, and floor undulated with the oscillation of space, coming off the objects they were attached to and spreading outward.
Even the dust on Lu Yang's group tremored slightly, leaving their bodies.
When the dust, oil stains, and other dirt had spread to the corners of the room, the Fifth Elder summoned a suction force in his palm. The dirt gathered inward, forming a swirling vortex.
Finally, the dirt formed a small sphere, after which the Fifth Elder clenched his fist, and the sphere vanished without a trace.
The entire barbecue restaurant felt refreshed. Everything appeared new.
"This is the Dust Purification Spell, often used for cleaning. In your leisure time from cultivation, you can practice these practical minor magic skills," the Fifth Elder explained.
"If you ever take a dislike to someone, you can also use the Dust Purification Spell to collect the dust into a ball, and throw it at them."
This was the original intention behind the Fifth Elder's learning of the Dust Purification Spell.
"Let's reopen!"
Lu Yang fetched seasoning, skewers, the Automatic Skewer Array, barbecue grill, and other barbecue ingredients from his Identity Jade, all things left behind when they vacated the shop.
"This Automatic Skewer Array is quite interesting, very creative." After taking a glance at the array, the Fifth Elder immediately understood its function.
Lu Yang thought to himself that the array was the newest achievement of the upper echelons of the Eternity Sect, representing the wisdom of four Unification stage cultivators.
The Fifth Elder inquired, "Do you have an array or magical artifact for automatically grilling skewers?"
Lu Yang shook his head. They had not designed one yet.
"In that case, how about this: I'll design one. But I haven't grilled skewers before and lack experience. I'll need to grill for a couple of days to practice. That way, I'll have a better idea of how to design a magical artifact for automatic grilling."
Crafting magical artifacts not seen before was something the Fifth Elder always enjoyed.
Lu Yang was overjoyed at this; previously he'd been thinking about whether he needed to capture a couple of ghouls, but that seemed unnecessary now.
Lu Yang quickly mixed assorted spices in carefully calculated proportions, soon producing a bright red jar of barbecue sauce, distinctive to the Barbarian tribe.
"I'm going out to buy some raw ingredients," Lu Yang said, allowing the Fifth Elder to familiarize himself with the process.
"Go ahead, go ahead."
As Lu Yang pushed open the door, he drew the surprised gazes of the pedestrians on the main street.
"It's Shopkeeper Lu!"
"What, this is Shopkeeper Lu?"
"Is the barbecue shop reopening?"
"I heard Shopkeeper Lu went out to start his own business. Is this him returning to the barbecue shop after failing?"
"Wasn't it said that Shopkeeper Lu went home to take over the family business, why is he back?"
"There's that story too?"
"Haven't you heard? Shopkeeper Lu got separated from his parents as a child. The barbecue recipe of the shop is a childhood memory of his. One day, a great power came to eat kebabs here. After the meal, he was moved to tears, saying that only someone from his family could have made it. He asked who had made it, and then there was a father-son reunion, after which the barbecue shop closed."
"How come I heard that Shopkeeper Lu has a very wealthy fiancée and was taken away by her?"
The passersby were abuzz with gossip. The 'Once More' barbecue shop was the hottest spot in Yanjiang County, known even in the neighboring counties.
Unfortunately, after the Spring Festival, the barbecue shop closed, leaving people craving for more.
People speculate about Lu Yang's departure endlessly as they missed the barbecue shop.
As for the death of the County Magistrate at that time, no one connected it to the barbecue shop, let alone a barbecue shop decorated with banners of praise.
"Shopkeeper Lu, are you reopening the barbecue shop?"
"Yeah, without your kebabs in the evening, it always feels like something's missing!"
Facing the enthusiastic locals, Lu Yang raised his hand and declared loudly, "Everyone, please quiet down. We've returned specifically to continue running the barbecue shop. So please rest assured on this matter. We plan to reopen the barbecue shop tomorrow!"
"That's great!"
By the time Lu Yang managed to escape the crowd, he was again surrounded at the market. When he returned to the barbecue shop, he was panting heavily, feeling more tired than after a battle.
"I'm back!"
Lu Yang tossed the meat and vegetables onto the Automatic Skewer Array, which automatically cut them into small pieces. The wooden skewers floated in mid-air, piercing the meat and vegetables together in a smooth process.
The Fifth Elder took the skewered food over to the barbecue grill, then turned his head and asked, "Do you guys have a specific flame for barbecuing?"
As a Grandmaster of crafting artifacts who possessed seven types of True Fire, all of his flames were intense, suitable for crafting artifacts but not so for barbecuing.
"I have Three Flavored True Fire!" Lu Yang volunteered, his fire being the most suitable for barbecuing.
"I also have True Fire." Meng Jingzhou stated, a hot flame springing up from his palm.
"Pure Yang True Fire?" The Fifth Elder recognized the origin of the flame in Meng Jingzhou's palm; every single Body Spiritual Root cultivator would automatically grasp this flame upon forming a Single Golden Elixir.
"But your flame is not as useful as Lu Yang's Three Flavored True Fire, right?"
Meng Jingzhou showed a confident smile, "No, my Pure Yang True Fire is the product of a dual Single Body Spiritual Root, and it has effects that the previous Pure Yang True Fire did not."
The Fifth Elder asked curiously, "What is it?"
"It can invigorate Yang."
"Food cooked with Pure Yang True Fire can invigorate Yang!"

chapters.title: Chapter 326 - 325 - The Unquestioned Barbecue Restaurant_1
chapters.content:
The Fifth Elder took a cold breath. Given this effect, it could be claimed that the Pure Yang True Fire ranks first among the 108 types of True Fire.
The functions of the 108 types of True Fire vary. Some fires are weak, unable to even burn mortals, but have significant efficacy in burning spaces; some are powerful but hard to control and are likely to explode; others do not burn the body but only the soul. For these reasons, it is hard to differentiate the various types of True Fire, let alone rank them as first or second.
But if you claim that your True Fire can invigorate Yang...
No one else dares to assert this, the Fifth Elder would cast a vote for Pure Yang True Fire.
"I'll research to see if your Pure Yang True Fire can be stabilized into a Fire Seed."
"Also, I'll research your Three Flavored True Fire."
The Fifth Elder took the True Fires from Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, planning to create Fire Seeds that can burn continuously.
Otherwise, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou would be required to input Spiritual Energy for ignition every time they needed to grill something. At which point, what would be the point of an automated grill?
"The best method would be to combine the two types of fire," The Fifth Elder muttered to himself, shocked at the challenges he'd encountered upon arriving in Yanjiang County.
"Can two types of fire be combined?" Qin Yanyan asked in surprise, having never heard of such a theory before.
Without lifting his head, the Fifth Elder said, "It's possible. In the past, some people have even merged two, three, or even more types of fire and threw it towards the enemy. The power is extraordinary, and it's an effective method for challenging higher levels."
"That's enough. All of you get out, let me research this on my own." The Fifth Elder shooed the four away like they were chicks.
...
Three Cultivators with Great Power descended on Yanjiang County. Concealing their presence, they disguised as travelers passing through.
"Sir, according to the map, this should be Yanjiang County."
"Hmm, let's find a place first."
The three found a private room in a tavern and set up an Array Method to block detection before they felt reassured enough to remove their disguise.
The visitors were none other than the deputy master of the Nine Nether Sect, Shi Huagu and his two subordinates. One of whom was the Divinity Transformation Stage cultivator named Huo Huashen, who brought Qin Haoran's debt note to Shi Huagu.
His parents named him Huo Huashen (Huo Transform into a Deity), in hopes that he can cultivate to the Divinity Transformation Stage.
Shi Huagu opened the curtain of the private room, and from the view of the window, he could see the barbecue restaurant opposite, 'Come Again Barbecues'.
It was night, and the barbecue shop was booming with a long queue lined up at the entrance.
"So many people?" Shi Huagu wondered. Since the barbecue shop was a liaison point of Heaven's Court, shouldn't they keep a low profile?
Is this a reverse strategy, or is it a showcase of the strength of Heaven's Court, demonstrating they're not afraid of the Righteous Path's detection?
He redirected his gaze and scanned his two subordinates.
"Upon our arrival in Yanjiang County, the Master assigned me a task which you all should have guessed - to investigate the depth of Heaven's Court. If there is potential for cooperation, I have the authority to act on behalf of the Master and establish a mutual agreement."
"You are my trusted aides, I trust you to handle this without any leaks."
"Huo Huashen, you were the first to make contact with Heaven's Court."
"Zhou Shan, you are a scholar of ancient history and the person most knowledgeable about it within our Sect."
"Sir, shall we make contact with Heaven's Court now?"
Shi Huagu shook his head: "There's no rush, let's observe for a while. You two investigate the origins of this barbecue shop and see if there's anything suspicious."
"Yes!"
Both subordinates said in unison and then vanished from the private room.
After a while, Shi Huagu walked out of the private room. The waiter brought the bill, "Dear guest, your two friends have left, shall you settle the bill..."
Shi Huagu grimaced. Shouldn't his subordinates have rushed to pay the bill for him?
...
