During the investigation, Huo Huashen asked casually, "Zhou Shan, everyone says that you are the most knowledgeable about ancient history, has there been any progress in the archaeological research on ancient history?"
Zhou Shan nodded: "There has been significant progress, relating to an Immortal."
"What is it?"
Zhou Shan looked mysterious, glanced left and right, saw no one around, and whispered, "The information I received was unofficial, might not be true."
"Don't worry, I have the ability to discern," said Huo Huashen.
"There was an Immortal in ancient times, named Yingtian Immortal. He was a charismatic figure, who left his seed everywhere, impregnating countless women!"
Huo Huashen threw his head back in surprise: "That actually happened?!"
Zhou Shan continued, "According to my analysis, there's an 80 percent likelihood that this information is true. Think about it, he is an Immortal who reached the end of his cultivation and has such a hobby. It makes sense."
Huo Huashen nodded, thinking Zhou Shan's analysis was logical, "No wonder everyone says you are the most familiar with ancient history."
"Not at all, not at all," Zhou Shan responded with a modest smile.
"Enough chitchat, let's complete the task assigned by our superior first."
...
"Sir, according to our investigation, there are indeed some issues with this barbecue shop."
"The owner of 'Come Again Barbecues' is surnamed Lu, and his true name is unknown. The customers like to call him Owner Lu or Mr. Little Lu."
"Four months ago, Owner Lu set up this barbecue shop. With its delicious and tender meat tasting comparable to Spirit Chefs, it quickly gained recognition."
"If it were anyone else, with such booming business, they would have expanded to multiple branches a long time ago. However, this shop has yet to do so."
Shi Huagu nodded: "That's reasonable, after all, this is a base for Heaven's Court. If Heaven's Court is reemerging in the world, they should not be expanding shops blindly. That would be putting the cart before the horse."
"Also, the barbecue shop has a good relationship with the local government office, often helping capture fugitives. For this, the local government office has presented numerous pennants."
"Pretending to be close to the Righteous Path with a fake identity can save a lot of trouble. The cultivators in Yanjiang County are generally of low level, the highest being only at the Golden Core Stage. It's impossible for them to see through the disguise of Heaven's Court."
"We also discovered that all members of the Eternity Sect's Yanjiang Rudder once ate at the barbecue shop."
Shi Huagu lowered his head in thought: "It's possible that Heaven's Court wanted to reach out to the high levels of the Eternity Sect through Yanjiang Rudder, but before they could make contact, they were wiped out by the Seek Dao Sect. What a pity."
"According to our analysis, four months ago, Little Lu's apparent cultivation level was at the initial stage of Foundation Establishment. We don't know if this was his genuine level at that time or if he's recently advanced to the Golden Core Stage."
"That's not important."
"The barbecue shop hasn't opened for three months until recently, half a month ago. They have introduced a new series of products - the Invigorating series. Once launched, it caused a sensation throughout the county."
"According to our investigation of the brothels, there has been a noticeable increase in patrons, suggesting the invigorating effects are real."
"Customers have also reported that the taste of the barbecue shop is even better than it was three months ago."
"It only reopened half a month ago? It seems this is a temporary base. Heaven's Court reopened to give us a chance for contact."
"Not revealing the location of the actual base to us shows their distrust."
"Regardless, since there's nothing suspicious about the barbecue shop, let's go and see how deep the waters run!"

chapters.title: Chapter 327 - 326: Three Visits to the Barbecue Shop_1
chapters.content:
"So, this is the barbecue shop in Yanjiang County that is rumored to be invigorating?"
"Absolutely! Let's hurry and line up. We thought we came early enough, but it seems we still have to join the queue!"
"This place was closed for three months and now it's reopened, doing better business than before. I came here during the Spring Festival and the food is superb!"
"So the entire staff went off for training and now they're back with major progress?"
"Seems so."
"I wonder if we'll get to eat today. I've heard some people waited in line for days without getting their chance."
...
"What a bustling business!" Shi Huagu felt the business's success more profoundly as he stood before the barbecue shop. He hadn't truly appreciated it when he saw from upstairs.
They have many businesses in the Nine Nether sect, but none have such an exaggerated customer flow
The queue starts from the entrance and extends all the way to the next shop, effectively blocking its entrance.
The neighboring shop doesn't mind, because the people waiting in line might drop in to have a meal when they get tired of waiting, which has actually improved their business.
Huo Huashen sent him a message: "I heard that this shop used to provide delivery service. But with the in-store business being so overwhelming, they've cancelled that service."
"Initially, Zhou Shan and I wanted to try the food but we can't get in the queue. We can only inquire about it from nearby customers who have had the food."
Shi Huagu snorted arrogantly, about to barge into the restaurant: "Have we forgotten our status? Do we need to queue?"
Two at the Divinity Transformation Stage and one at the Unification Stage. We are qualified enough to build a second-rate sect ourselves. Even a top-tier sect would treat us respectfully if we visited them.
This is just a barbecue shop, not the headquarters of Heaven's Court.
"Line cutter over here!"
"Hey, you three! Do you have any decency?"
"Such lack of manners!"
The people lined up behind saw the trio walking in, loudly cursing them. Shi Huagu and the three paid no heed. Suddenly, a pretty girl stood in front of them.
"You, stop right there. Don't you know you need to line up?" Qin Yanyan stood at the entrance, anger blazing in her eyes. Everyone else is obeying the rules, why not you?
Qin Yanyan didn't recognize the three of them. Back then, Huo Huashen had kept a low profile, and only Lu Yang had detected his presence.
Just as Shi Huagu was about to fly off the handle, he heard Huo Huashen swiftly communicating, "Master, this is Qin Yanyan, the reincarnation of Master Qin."
"What?" Shi Huagu was taken aback. Even though Qin Haoran, who had been the master of the Nine Nether Sect for nine hundred years, had fallen, he still held prestige within the Sect.
Shi Huagu had a degree of respect for the former master. Considering Qin Haoran's scheming abilities and Cultivation level, he exceeded Shi Huagu in both regards.
"It seems that the Heaven's Court already knows we're here and has intentionally sent Master Qin's reincarnation to obstruct us!"
"Are they implying that we're on their turf now and we must abide by the rules of Heaven's Court?"
"And by stationing the reincarnation of Master Qin here to maintain order, they mean to convey that no matter how highly we regard ourselves, we're just flyweights before them?"
Shi Huagu, with his distinctly clever nature, quickly gleaned the implications.
He dare not offend Heaven's Court. They originated from ancient times, have extensive resources, and at the very least, have a Transcendance Tribulation Stage power. They might even have several and are not someone he, an Unification Stage practitioner, could afford to offend.
"Line up, it is!"
The three high-ranking members of the Nine Nether Sect waited at the end of the queue until late at night. Only four or five people were left before them when Qin Yanyan peeked out from the entrance, "Sorry, we're closing for the day."
Shi Huagu's face turned livid but he refrained from causing a fuss.
"Humph, let's return tomorrow!"
...
The next morning, before the barbecue shop had opened, Shi Huagu, along with two of his subordinates, were already at the entrance.
He refused to believe that he would have to queue during the day.
The doors of the barbecue shop swung open, Guard Captain Wei was seated inside, chatting and laughing with Lu Yang.
"Congratulations, Guard Captain Wei. Or should I say Chief Guard Captain Wei now!" Lu Yang laughed. After the County Magistrate was disposed of, the Chief Guard Captain was promoted to the County Magistrate. Guard Captain Wei then ascended to the position of the Chief Guard Captain, which saved him over a decade of waiting. It was a meteoric rise.
Chief Guard Captain Wei was all smiles, "Oh, please. I may be the Chief Guard Captain, but it's a demanding job. The monthly pay is probably not even close to a single day's earnings of your barbecue shop."
Lu Yang chuckled without replying since it was indeed the case and he wasn't comfortable to admit.
Chief Guard Captain Wei did not dwell on this topic and continued to reminisce, "My promotion to Chief Guard Captain has a lot to do with arresting people at your shop. I remember, Mr. Little Lu, you had a few friends dining at your shop. They started a group fight and were arrested. They were held for a few days.
Later, when the Eternity Sect was annihilated and the member list was released, it turned out that two of the men involved in the brawl were from the Eternity Sect!"
"Little Lu, you have to be more careful with your choice of friends. This is dangerous. They might have marked you and intended to offer you as a sacrifice to the Eternity Sect!"
Lu Yang laughed heartily, assuring him that he would be more cautious in choosing friends in the future.
"Your barbecue shop has been running for more than a half month, but unfortunately, no criminals have walked into their trap here. It would be great if some foolishly approached here. Ideally members of a demonic sect. Then my position as Chief Guard Captain would be secured."
Upon realizing his gaffe, Chief Guard Captain Wei chuckled, "Look at what I'm saying. It almost sounds like I'm cursing your place to attract the demonic sect."
It was then that Chief Guard Captain Wei noticed Shi Huagu and his party standing at the entrance to the shop, he curiously asked, "Are they your friends?"
"Where?" Lu Yang turned his head, only to find Shi Huagu and his men had already disappeared.
"There's no one there?"
"Maybe they were just passing by."
...
"Well played, Heaven's Court," Shi Huagu fumed. "Being chummy with an official who wishes to arrest the members of the demonic sect. Are they trying to show off their power to us?" Shi Huagu had dealt with government officials quite a few times. He knew a Chief Guard Captain would have a token that could summon Cultivation Great Power to help them when meeting an enemy they couldn't deal with.
"Master, what's our next move?"
"Keep queuing tonight!"
...
"We've been staking out here for more than half a month, but why hasn't anyone from the Nine Nether Sect showed up?" Meng Jingzhou was puzzled. He felt that someone from the Nine Nether Sect should have arrived by now.
"Niece, you've been watching the entrance every day. Have you seen anyone who looks like they might be from the Nine Nether Sect?"
Qin Yanyan innocently shook her head. Although occasionally one or two customers tried to barge in, a few words from her had them obediently going back to line up. Surely members of the Nine Nether Sect wouldn't be so obedient?
Lu Yang also found it strange. He thinks anyone knowledgeable about ancient history would believe in the existence of Heaven's Court. He was sure there would be people like that in the Nine Nether Sect.
If they believe in Heaven's Court, then they must send someone over.
"Let's wait a bit longer."
...
At night, Shi Huagu and his companions learned from their mistakes and arrived early. This time they were lucky. There were only about twenty people ahead of them.
After waiting almost half a day, it was finally their turn.
"Three pounds of mutton kebabs!"

chapters.title: Chapter 328 - 327 Supreme Sovereign of Beans Personal Disciple_1
chapters.content:
"Well, you can't deny it, this taste is good!" Shi Huagu was amazed, he tasted thoroughly, savoring a flavor that had been roasted with True Fire.
Could it be that it was roasted with True Fire?
This was the first time Shi Huagu saw a barbecue restaurant using True Fire to roast, definitely a big move.
Thinking that he came to the barbecue restaurant three times before he could finally enter, Shi Huagu was very angry. After eating three pounds of mutton kebabs, he wiped his mouth: "Give me ten skewers of grilled kidneys!"
The surrounding diners all looked at Shi Huagu in astonishment. Original skewers could invigorate Yan, and you ordered ten skewers of kidney, which was the invigorating version, what's the difference between this and taking an aphrodisiac?
Shi Huagu, a figure of such standing, after unification, was a Great Power in the late stage, this level of invigoration to him was negligible.
Huo Huashen and Zhou Shan were eating with mouths full of oil, feeling that it was better to follow Shi Huagu. They didn't have to pay when they went out, and they could eat all kinds of delicious food.
However, when the three of them had eaten their fill, they encountered a problem.
It was still some time before the shop closed, the Heavenly Court's people were busy acting as shop assistants, they didn't have time to pay attention to them. If they leave, they were not really here to eat.
If they don't leave, it's not a solution to sit dry either.
"Hey, do you think these three are sitting here after eating, because they don't have money to pay the bill?" Meng Jingzhou quietly asked.
This was his first encounter with someone trying to dine and dash.
Li Haoran sent a message: "I don't know the two next to him. The one in the middle who eats the most is called Shi Huagu. He used to be the deputy master. I don't know if he has been promoted after Qin Haoran disappeared."
Meng Jingzhou was overjoyed: "Has the Nine Nether Teaching finally sent someone?"
Qin Yanyan didn't dare to speak. It seemed like these three came last night and she kicked them out.
In the backyard, two automatic barbecues were operating at full capacity. After Fifth Elder's design, not only was the skewer automation realized, but the barbecue efficiency was greatly improved.
The grill was shaped like a bookshelf, four levels in total, each level was full of slow rotating skewers, receiving the roast of True Fire, sizzling hot oil.
After Fifth Elder's intensive research, he finally combined the Three Flavored True Fire and Pure Yang True Fire into fire seeds for grilling.
The customer flow of these days also proved the research findings of Fifth Elder.
"Fifth Elder, people from Nine Nether Teaching are here." Lu Yang spoke to the Fifth Elder, who was squatting on the ground studying how to improve the automatic grill.
"Got it."
When the barbecue shop closed, when the last guest left, the barbecue shop finally revealed its true identity - the base of Heaven's Court.
On one table, the forces on both sides were clearly separated. One was represented by Shi Huagu from the Nine Nether Teaching, and the other was represented by Lu Yang from the Heaven's Court.
"It's really not easy to meet your Heaven's Court." Shi Huagu sneered, dissatisfied with the treatment yesterday evening and this morning.
Lu Yang didn't understand the other party's grudge and didn't go along with the conversation: "Presumably this is the famous unifying cultivator of the Nine Nether Teaching, Shi Huagu."
Behind Lu Yang, a man came out, making Shi Huagu, who was originally relaxed, suddenly tense.
He felt a strong threat from the other party.
Fighting alone, he might lose to the other party!
Lu Yang laughed, "Let me introduce, my Heaven's Court has nine Protectors in total, this is the Fifth Protector, Multi-treasure Heavenly King, whose reputation was widely renowned in ancient times. Even the Master praised his unique Refining technique, he is expected to refine an Immortal Artifact, I don't know if Master Shi has ever heard of it?"
No matter whether the other party was a master or a deputy master, it was always correct to call it Master.
Fifth Elder bowed: "Young Master, that's just a joke from Tianzun, don't take it seriously."
Shi Huagu looked at Zhou Shan, Zhou Shan shook his head secretly, indicating that he had not heard of it either. Shi Huagu made a fist salute: "I've met the Multi-treasure fellow. Unfortunately, the matter of the ancients is too long ago for us, and too much has been forgotten, and I have not heard about the reputation of the fellow."
"I don't know why Multi-treasure fellow calls him the Young Master?"
"Shi fellow doesn't know, Lu Yiyang is the personal disciple of Dou Tianzun, and also the only disciple, he is unquestionably the next master of the Heavenly Court."
Shi Huagu was shocked, the disciple of Dou Tianzun, Dou Tianzun was the first cultivator to become an immortal in the ancient times, doesn't this mean this guy named Lu Yang was the Immortal's disciple?
In terms of status, it was probably a notch higher than him, a Unification phase!
In the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity bounced happily: "Lu Yang, I knew you always regarded me as a master!"
Lu Yang: "..."
In reality, Lu Yang heard that Shi Huagu had not heard of the name of Multi-treasure Heavenly King, and he couldn't help sighing: "Yes, the ancients are too far away from today. Even when we just woke up, we also felt that the world had changed, the original stars disappeared, and were refined into the Boundless Continent by people, all the familiar people and things were gone."
Lu Yang's eyes were profound, and there was a touch of loneliness, as if he was recalling the ancient past.
Shi Huagu took the opportunity to ask, "Do you know who refined the stars?"
Lu Yang shook his head: "This happened after our Heaven's Court fell into a deep sleep. We do not know the reason. Our teaching is looking for Yingtian Immortal and others, asking what happened in these more than 300,000 years, I don't know if there is any clue to the Immortal on the side of the Nine Nether Teaching?"
Shi Huagu didn't know where Yingtian Immortal and the other four were, he could only say regretfully that he didn't know.
He gave Zhou Shan a look, signalling Zhou Shan to ask something.
Zhou Shan thought for a while, and asked with a fist salute: "My name is Zhou Shan. I am a little confused when studying ancient history. Can you enlighten me?"
"We will definitely tell you everything we know."
"I have heard that a Great Cultivator in ancient times practiced to the point where the law followed his words, invincible at the same level, but finally disappeared without a trace, I don't know his whereabouts... "
Lu Yang said with a faint smile: "I just heard about the deeds of that senior. He was a strong opponent on Master's path to immortality. In the end, he was no match for Master, and his soul was scattered."
Lu Yang heard Fairy Eternity talk about this incident. Fairy Eternity ambushed the other party, and the other party screamed "it hurts to death", and then the Verbal Spell was activated, and he talked himself to death.
But if he says so, the other party may not believe it.
"Please tell me in detail."
"That senior had learned a Great Divine Ability, Verbal Spell, and the life and death of his opponents was only in an instant, he had never been defeated until he met Master."
"On that day, Master encountered the senior who learned the Verbal Spell, knew that they were strong opponents to each other, and hesitating meant self-destruction, so the two of them started a fierce battle, the Taoist rhyme was surging, the magical power was surging, the universe was silent. Master's skill was unparalleled in the world, it was elusive, and his traces could not be captured.
Seeing that he couldn't defeat Master, he used the Verbal Spell and shouted '... die...', who thought the Verbal Spell had no effect on Master, on the contrary, it was him who was bitten by the Verbal Spell, and his body perished and he fell."
Shi Huagu was shocked. At the time, Dou Tianzun had not become a Immortal, but was already immune to the invincible Verbal Spell?
How powerful is this?
He had been paying attention to Lu Yang's pupils and heartbeat all the time, and all signs indicated that the other party was telling the truth!

chapters.title: Chapter 329 - 328 Not a Single False Word_1
chapters.content:
Shi Huagu has a distinctive secret method that can discern whether someone is telling the truth or lying. With this, he has exposed countless subordinates planted by other deputy masters.
Although this technique can't always correctly determine if someone is telling the truth or lying, it does have an 89% success rate.
This technique demands immense spiritual and physical energy. Even someone as powerful as Shi Huagu can't sustain it constantly, but he has no problem maintaining it during his conversation with Lu Yang.
Moreover, he is an expert at observing people's expressions. He knows that when a person lies, they undergo various subtle changes.
With these two factors combined, almost no one can lie to him.
This is exactly why the master sent him here.
Before cooperating with Heaven's Court, the first thing to confirm is whether the other party really belongs to Heaven's Court.
Lu Yang revealed a confident smile, took a sip of his tea, and said with a hint of pride, "I wonder if Master Shi knows Yingtian Immortal and Qilin Immortal?"
"Of course, I have heard about the honorifics of these two ancient immortals." The Nine Nether also possesses many ancient books detailing the honorifics of the Four Immortals of the Ancients.
"I have heard that nowadays, people like to call certain geniuses 'Young Immortals'. You all consider them unbeatable and invincible, but I am here to tell you that even during the Golden Core Stage, my master had defeated both Yingtian Immortal and Kirin Immortal face-to-face. Despite the ingenious methods of the two Young Immortals, they still couldn't defeat my master!"
"During the Golden Core Stage, my master was considered invincible!"
The representatives from Nine Nether were deeply moved, their pupils shrinking.
To be a Young Immortal means being unbeatable in one's realm, peerless. They had already reached the pinnacle of this stage without further room for advancement.
Two Young Immortals fighting would indeed have to exhaust their spiritual essence and reveal their most potent methods to narrowly determine a victor, because the gap between the two is too minimal.
Amazingly, during the Golden Core Stage, the master single-handedly defeated two Young Immortals, what incredible talent!
Dwarfing all immortals!
No wonder he was the first immortal of ancient times!
Zhou Shan calmed himself and asked, "Has young master Lu ever heard of the final battle between the ancient Dragon and Phoenix Tribes?"
Lu Yang pondered for a moment, asking, "Are you referring to the battle where they used the Phoenix Rebirth technique?"
"No, the Dragon and Phoenix Tribes' prodigies battled numerous times on their journey towards becoming immortals. This series of battles is historically known as the Dragon & Phoenix Wars. The battle you mentioned was the penultimate one. I am talking about the very last battle."
Lu Yang laughed, "I see, I'm not familiar with the terminology used in later generations. Please do elaborate."
Zhou Shan still trembled at the thought of that battle. Just reading the description from the book allowed him to imagine the terrifying scene.
"Records show that there were two demon beasts during ancient times. Both were just a half-step away from becoming immortals, one Dragon and one Phoenix, major foes of Qilin Immortal. Even after Qilin Immortal achieved immortality, the Dragon and Phoenix continued to battle."
"This was the last recorded battle, triggered by an Immortal Fruit of unknown origin."
"Presumably, that Immortal Fruit contained an immense chance of a lifetime, leaving no room for compromise."
"For this Immortal Fruit, the Dragon and Phoenix went into a fierce battle. The terrifying strength released made the world lose its radiance, the space roiled, runes filled the sky, their True Flames collided, causing even stars to shudder."
"At that time, Qilin Immortal, Yingtian Immortal, Immortal Jiuchong, and Time Immortal were present. Yet, even with these four Immortals at the scene, the Dragon & Phoenix war was unstoppable!"
"The Kirin Immortal was the foremost to preside over the law. He did not favor either party, attempting to mediate the conflict, but the Dragon and Phoenix didn't listen and even drove Kirin Immortal away."
"Ultimately, the Dragon & Phoenix War ended in a stalemate, and it remains unknown who obtained that Immortal Fruit."
Inside the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity found the storytelling style familiar: "I remember now. Ying Tian Xian liked to talk this way, saying it enhances an Immortal's prestige!"
Shi Huagu heard this tale for the first time. He could sense the power of this dragon and phoenix from the few spoken words.
No wonder the Dragon and Phoenix Tribes are still so powerful today. Their foundation is truly deep.
Shi Huagu observed Lu Yang and found his expression unaltered. There was even a hint of amusement in his eyes. It shocked him greatly.
Could it be that even a battle of this magnitude seemed "ordinary" to him?
Could the disciples of the Immortals truly be this terrifying?
Lu Yang laughed softly, "So, this battle was called the Final Battle of the Ancient Dragon and Phoenix in subsequent generations."
At the Kirin Immortal's wedding, Fairy sent an Immortal Fruit, stating that it was for the most beautiful person. All the geniuses of the Dragon and Phoenix Tribes wanted this fruit. The Kirin Immortal was in a dilemma and couldn't prevent it. The three Yingtian Immortals tried to mediate and transformed the battle into a cooking contest, with the three of them being the judges.
What the Yingtian Immortals didn't know was that the culinary skills of the Dragon and Phoenix geniuses were inherited from Fairy Eternity...
"I know some secrets about this battle. To put it, it all started with a casual move by the master."
"At that time, the Kirin Immortal held a banquet and invited numerous friends, including countless Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivators and the three Yingtian Immortals. Due to their fear of my master, they did not extend an invitation to him."
"After learning this, the master didn't get angry. Instead, he gifted them an Immortal Fruit with a blessing."
"The magic of the Immortal Fruit blessed by the master is numerous."
"Four Immortals don't need to fight over it; the final competitors for this fruit happen to be that dragon and phoenix."
"This Immortal Fruit is of great significance. Even the mighty Kirin Immortal dared not rashly declare who should receive this Immortal Fruit."
"Therefore, the Dragon and Phoenix had to fight. But since it was the Kirin Immortal's banquet, a martial battle was inappropriate. So they agreed upon a True Flame showdown."
Zhou Shan was surprised. This was what he deliberately left out earlier. According to ancient records: After the Kirin Immortal withdrew from the field, Yingtian Immortal, Immortal Jiuchong, and Time Immortal—the three Immortals—took charge of maintaining justice, suggesting a True Flame showdown.
The process of the True Flame showdown is unknown, but what is known is that, during the showdown, even the three Immortals of Yingtian were injured.
A True Flame showdown!
Everyone knows that the final war between the ancient Dragon and Phoenix started because of an Immortal Fruit, but only a few know that their method of confrontation was a True Flame showdown!
Zhou Shan obtained a rare ancient book. This was recorded in the book, its author was Yingtian Immortal, the content was absolutely real and reliable!
Lu Yang didn't know what Zhou Shan was thinking and continued: "The True Flame showdown contained aspects like the degree of torture on living creatures, the control level of True Flame, the proficiency level of using kitchen utensils, etc."
"In the end, the three Immortals tasted the results of the True Flame showdown, they were subjected to spiritual attacks and their spirits were shaken."
"One Immortal Fruit ultimately made the Kirin Immortal withdraw, the three Yingtian Immortals' spirits were shocked. How terrifying is Master's scheme!" exclaimed Shi Huagu, shocked by the master's scheme.
Absolutely cannot be enemies with him!
Inside the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity frowned slightly. She felt as if Shi Huagu was talking about her and yet not. "Am I really like that?"
Seizing the opportunity, Lu Yang said, "Fairy, your wisdom is profound and unfathomable. Commoners like Shi Huagu are stunned by your wisdom, so they speak recklessly!"
Fairy Eternity nodded in understanding: "That's right, after all, I am very intelligent!"
In reality, Zhou Shan sent a message to Shi Huagu: "Sir, the fact that the other party knows so many ancient secrets, undoubtedly proves that they are from ancient times!"
Shi Huagu nodded: "I think so too."

chapters.title: Chapter 330 - 329: Then the Immortal Business Can Be Accomplished, Nine Nether Can Prosper_1
chapters.content:
"The depth of Heaven's Court is indeed admirable!" Having confirmed that the other party was the ancient Heavenly Court, Shi Huagu no longer maintained a probing demeanor, now was the time to discuss cooperation in earnest.
He believed that with the help of Heaven's Court, the power of the Nine Nether Sect would reach new heights.
"It's embarrassing to admit, despite my attention to detail in discussing these matters, they are the stories my master told me. I wasn't born when those events took place."
Although Lu Yang spoke with apparent shame, the confident expression on his face couldn't be concealed no matter what.
Li Haoran and Qin Yanyan remained cold and silent, like ruthless killers.
Despite their acting skills and numerous practice before setting off, they felt that in this situation, the best approach was to remain silent and pretend to be high-level cultivators.
Fifth Elder felt that Lu Yang, deserving of being the top-ranked of his generation, had an intricate and watertight response to every query. When the Seek Dao Sect's Nine Sons were at Lu's age, they couldn't match Lu's mastery of conversation.
Meng Jingzhou had doubts. He didn't know much about ancient myths and didn't know whether what Lu Yang was saying was true or false, but he always felt that what Lu Yang was saying was true, but not entirely true.
Huo Huashen felt as ignorant as an illiterate person. He didn't understand a word of the conversation between Lu Yang and Zhou Shan, but that was fine. His role here was to add prestige. He didn't need to know these things, as long as he maintained the image of a cold and ruthless top-level cultivator.
"Although Daoist Lu refers to me as the master, I actually hold the position of deputy master in the Nine Nether Sect. On this visit, I have the authority to decide on the cooperation with your sect on behalf of the master."
"The master had two questions for me to convey to your esteemed sect before coming."
"I will answer all that I know."
Shi Huagu said in the tone of the master, "The Nine Nether realm is lost in dust, the Righteous Path ignores the truth and refuses to acknowledge the existence of the Nine Nether. We kill people to send them to the Nine Nether in an attempt to prove its existence, but the Righteous Path labels us the Demon Path. It's utterly detestable!"
"In the ancient times, the Nine Nether and Heavenly Court were equally famous, both spectacular. Today, the Nine Nether suffers humiliation and degradation, which is heart-wrenching."
"The foundation of the Nine Nether Sect is far less than that of the Nine Nether in ancient times. Revitalizing the Nine Nether would be extremely difficult. With the fall of the Eternity Sect, the Four Great Devil Sects have been reduced to three, our situation has become even more challenging."
"However, we still believe in the existence of the Nine Nether and the cycle of reincarnation. Our Nine Nether Sect wishes to regain its former glory and let the Nine Nether reappear in the world as in ancient times. I wonder if your esteemed sect has any method?"
After a moment of contemplation, Lu Yang said, "The Central Continent is a must-contest territory. Currently, this continent is occupied by the Great Xia Dynasty, with the dominance maintained by the Five Great Immortal Sects. Our Heavenly Court's followers have not yet fully awakened, only five of the nine Protectors of Heaven's Court have been resurrected.
Even if the two of us join forces, I am afraid we cannot resist the attack of the Five Great Immortal Sects and the Great Xia Dynasty."
"Therefore, a forcible attack is absolutely impossible."
"I wonder if Master Shi has studied the rise of the Great Xia Dynasty. After I awakened, I wanted to know what happened in the last three hundred thousand years, so I studied history."
"During the end of the Great Yu Dynasty, there was great chaos in the world with heroes rising everywhere. There were countless people who crossed provinces and prefectures. Neither the ancestors of Emperor Xia nor those of the Meng Family were outstanding at the time, so how could they emerge victorious against stronger opponents and become the only two contenders for the throne?"
"Because they captured the advantage of 'timely opportunities' and 'human harmony'."
"What is 'timely opportunity'? The Great Yu Dynasty lacked the power to rule, resulting in upheavals and conflicts, this is a 'timely opportunity'!"
"What is 'human harmony'? Strong individuals and public opinion align, that is 'human harmony'!"
"By contrast, the Great Xia Dynasty is now at its peak, the strongest it has ever been, showing no signs of fatigue."
"Moreover, the Great Xia Dynasty governs well and is favored by public sentiment. It is helped by the various lackeys of the Five Great Immortal Sects who patrol the world. I even suspect that the Great Xia Dynasty has immortals among them!"
"Neither the 'timely opportunity' nor the 'human harmony' are there, hasty action would be a poor choice."
Shi Huagu said indignantly, "Is there really no day for my Nine Nether Sect to rise?"
Lu Yang said calmly, "That's not the case. The principle of being at its peak and then declining is historically inevitable. Although the Great Xia Dynasty seems to be thriving, in reality, it's on the brink of collapse."
"The Great Era is approaching, new immortals will be born in the Great Era, the Demon Territory and the East Sea are eying the Great Xia Dynasty. The strong individuals of the Great Qian and Great Yu eras, who have been dormant, are also gradually awakening. It's possible that we will see the scene of the end of the Great Yu era."
"By then, the Great Xia Dynasty's advantage of 'timely opportunity' will be completely gone!"
"So, before the great upheaval arrives, it is essential to keep a low profile and avoid rashly promoting the Nine Nether, which could lead to unnecessary trouble. The downfall of the Eternity Sect serves as a cautionary tale!"
"Furthermore, considering the human factor, I believe even with some hidden cards, your esteemed sect would find it hard to gain an advantage in the struggles of the Great Era."
"The Nine Nether Sect doesn't have enough strong cultivators. The plan for now is to diligently cultivate, increasing the number of Unification Stage and even Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivators!"
"During this process, the Nine Nether Sect should seek external alliances with the Demon Territory and East Sea and form internal alliances with the Ruthless Sect and the Yaoyang Sect."
"When the struggles of the Great Era arrive, our two sects can act together, then we can achieve immortality, and the Nine Nether can rise."
Shi Huagu found Lu Yang's words stirring, and the future seemed full of glory.
They had been too impatient before, rushing to build Fengdu, rushing to prove the existence of the Nine Nether. Listening to Lu Yang's words now, their previous actions seemed utterly wrong!
The current restraint is for future development. It was laughable that he lived so long and still failed to understand such a principle.
This was the difference in vision. The Heavenly Court ruled the ancients, reading the past and understanding the present. Their rivals were the Four Immortals of the Ancients with endless years like Yingtian Immortal. The Nine Nether Sect was simply not on the same level as them.
Caught in his excitement, Shi Huagu didn't forget the question given by the master before he left, "The master has another question for your esteemed sect."
"Please ask."
"The master asked your sect about your views on the economic development of the Nine Nether Sect?"
Shi Huagu didn't understand why the master asked that. He felt that the economy of the Nine Nether Sect was doing well. When Master Qin was there, he couldn't even meet the regular salary payments on time. The new master, upon taking charge, not only made the salary payments on time but also allocated funds to build Fengdu.
Lu Yang's lips curled into a knowing smile, "It seems that the master of your esteemed sect is a person with a keen eye."
"How so?"
"I just mentioned that the most important thing for your esteemed sect at present is to focus on cultivation. Before cultivating, what do you need? You need a large amount of Spirit Stones!"
"So, before cultivating, you need to make money in Spirit Stones!"
Shi Huagu suddenly realized, he was a bit embarrassed, he didn't expect the other party to understand the master even better than he did.
"So, how to earn Spirit Stones?"
Lu Yang stretched out his index finger, pointed towards the ceiling, and smiled, "Master Shi, how do you think this barbecue restaurant's business is?"
Shi Huagu thought of the long queue outside the door, "It is indeed very good."
"What if I say that we can open such barbecue stores all over the Great Xia Dynasty?"
"What?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 331 - 330: The Master of Our Sect and Yun Zhi of Seek Dao Sect Have Comparable Cultivation Levels_1
chapters.content:
Shi Huagu was greatly shaken, even Huo Huashen, who had always played the role of a silent expert, could not maintain his facade any longer.
Everyone witnessed the thriving business of the barbecue restaurant, the demand exceeding supply, it was almost as quick as robbing money.
Customers were queuing outside until the shop closed, the popularity was evident.
As a Great Power at the Unification Stage, Shi Huagu had tasted all sorts of delicious food on the earth. He had eaten foods far better than skewers, the ingredients of which were so hard to obtain that not even Spirit Stones could guarantee a taste.
Unlike the barbecue shop, where ingredients can be easily bought from the market.
The ingredients were ordinary, yet they could sell for sky-high prices, the profits were more than geometrically overflowing.
The profits of a barbecue restaurant alone would not be enough to mobilize those at the Divinity Transformation Stage or the Unification Stage.
What if the barbecue shop were to be expanded all over the Central Continent?
That profit would be massive, it would tempt anyone.
Of course, there is one more crucial point, he carries a debt of one billion. If he doesn't pay back the money, he'll be struck by lightning every month.
This is just the time when he needs money!
Fortunately, Shi Huagu was mature and stable, he did not seem overly excited. Suppressing his inner excitement, he said, "The business of your sect's barbecue shop is indeed excellent. My Nine Nether Sect does have some industries, but compared to this shop, they are far inferior."
Whether it's smuggling or running a zoo, neither can rival the barbecue shop in terms of windfall profits. This is a profit margin several dozen times larger.
The most critical part is that they are a legitimate business, not afraid of investigation. Unlike their Nine Nether Sect, which barely has any regular industries the only regular industry they have is the funeral industry.
But the funeral industry is also dangerous. Once, a high-ranking member of the Nine Nether Sect, who was skilled at refining corpses, had the ridiculous idea of digging up the customers' buried corpses for refining.
No one knows how, but the customers somehow found out and reported them.
Luckily, the Nine Nether Sect resolutely pushed out this foolish member and severed all ties with him.
"I just don't know how it can be promoted throughout the continent? I've tasted a fair share of barbecued food, none of which compares to what I had today. I suppose your sect must have unique barbecue techniques and recipes, as well as the crucial Yang Invigorating Secret Method. Can these be promoted as well?"
Master Shi's vision is very sharp, he quickly pointed out the difficulties of promoting it throughout the country.
Lu Yang chuckled lightly: "Our barbecue recipe comes from ancient times, so it's normal that Master Shi has not tasted it before."
"Please follow me."
Lu Yang rose to his feet, leading Shi Huagu to the backyard where he showcased the automatic barbecue rack and the Skewer Array Method, leaving Shi Huagu astonished.
No wonder he's the Junior Master of the Heavenly Court, he was really well prepared.
"The automatic barbecue rack was forged by the Guardian Multi-treasure, as for this Skewer Array….." Lu Yang revealed a meaningful smile.
"Where does this Skewer Array come from?"
"This array was forged by several Unification Stage Ghouls under the command of our sect's Master." Lu Yang disclosed a piece of shocking news to Shi Huagu.
Shi Huagu's pupils contracted slightly.
A Unification Stage Ghoul was the highest cultivation level Ghoul known.
Only having one major level higher could refine a Ghoul.
This suggested that the 'Master' Lu Yang was referring to was a Great Power at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage!
So, the Heavenly Court does possess those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage!
"I wonder who the Master of your sect is...."
Instead of answering directly, Lu Yang laughed and said, "I wonder if Master Shi has heard of Yun Zhi from the Seek Dao Sect?"
Shi Huagu had secretly gathered a lot of information about the Five Great Immortal Sects, including Yun Zhi, who surpassed all the other sect masters.
According to his estimation, Yun Zhi of Seek Dao Sect had already cultivated to the late stage of Transcendance Tribulation. At such a young age her Cultivation Level has reached this realm, creating a major obstacle for others to attain Immortality in the Great Era, she is a formidable adversary!
"Our sect's Master has crossed hands with Yun Zhi of Seek Dao Sect, their Cultivation Levels are on par."
"What?!"
Shi Huagu's eyes widened in surprise, the Master of the Heavenly Court Sect really possessed superb Cultivation Level.
Probably only a Cultivator of such level would qualify to be the Sect Master of the Heavenly Court.
Originally, Shi Huagu thought that the Heavenly Court, having numerous sleepers and decaying power, was not as it used to be, but his meeting today completely overturned his previous estimation.
Perhaps the power of Heavenly Court does not surpass the ancient Heavenly Court, but it is definitely stronger than their Nine Nether Sect.
Choosing to make contact with the Heavenly Court was indeed a wise decision!
"Also, this kindling flame, is a new type of True Fire, researched and developed by our sect, not only does it improve the taste of the skewers, but it also has Yang Invigorating effects."
Lu Yang held up a wisp of flame, the integration of the Three Flavored True Fire and the Pure Yang True Fire.
Shi Huagu used his Spiritual Sense to carefully observe the flame, and found this to be a whole new True Fire, not part of the hundred and eight True Fires, but merely a shadow of the Samadhi True Fire and the Pure Yang True Fire.
The Pure Yang True Fire doesn't have Invigorating Effects.
Apparently, the Heavenly Court, seemingly inactive, had been quietly setting up a series of moves, just waiting for the final piece to fall.
Otherwise, how could the Heavenly Court have developed a new kinda of True Fire solely for barbecuing?
"Junior Master, these things should not be shared with outsiders. This was originally our Heavenly Court's tool for expansion and the basis for our intelligence network!" Fifth Elder advised with a frown.
Lu Yang did not approve of Fifth Elder's comments, he countered: "It doesn't matter, during ancient times, there was a strong connection between the Heavenly Court and the Nine Nether Sect, so it is reasonable to assist them in regaining their former glory now, even if the Master and my Mentor were to know about this, they would not blame me."
"Moreover, the Heavenly Court sect has few members, even if all of us are mobilized, how many barbecue restaurants can we open?"
With no more word from the Fifth Elder, since the Junior Master was willing to bear the responsibility, he, as the protector of the Heavenly Court, couldn't say much.
Shi Huagu was very moved, never expecting to have such a rich relative in the Nine Nether Sect.
This Junior Master holds high moral integrity, even risk being scolded by the Master and Bean Tianzun, he is willing to help the Nine Nether Sect.
Lu Yang turned his head, putting on a smiling face, as if there had been no conflict with the Fifth Elder just now, he said: "Master Shi, as you heard, though I am a disciple of Tianzun, on some things, I still cannot make the final decision. However, this does not affect our cooperation."
"I can give the barbeque seasonings and the Array Method of the skewer to your sect for free."
One scan with the Spiritual Sense, he could roughly deduce the principles of the barbecue seasoning and the Skewer Array, so Lu Yang didn't really need to conceal it. He might as well offer the Nine Nether Sect a favor and give it straight to them.
"The automatic barbecue grill and the fire seeds, I can provide them to your sect regularly and in specific quantities, but our Heavenly Court requires 60% of the profit."
The automatic barbecue grill has a prohibition placed by the Fifth Elder, it can't be cracked.
The fire seed needs to be operated by him and Meng Jingzhou.
Afterall, proposing to start a barbecue restaurant was an initiative by the Heavenly Court, they should definitely get a larger share of the profit, which Shi Huagu could assure.
However, considering his status, he couldn't simply agree to Lu Yang's proposal: "You get four, I get six!"
"Our Heavenly Court sect will get 60%." Lu Yang dryly said.
"Let's go fifty-fifty!"
"Our Heavenly Court sect will get 60%."
Lu Yang held firm, giving Shi Huagu no room for negotiation.
Realizing that he had no advantage in this aspect, Shi Huagu gritted his teeth. He didn't negotiate further and accepted the profit-sharing method proposed by Lu Yang.
The two discussed some details and quickly settled on a contract.
"It's a pleasure working with you." Lu Yang said, shaking hands with a beaming smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 332 - 331: Pleasant Cooperation_1
chapters.content:
This was akin to Lu Yang's side providing only the barbecue rack and the kindling flames, letting the Nine Nether Sect run the restaurant, and thereby obtaining sixty percent of the profits.
The Fifth Elder never expected Lu Yang to dare to operate in such a way.
This earned them far more money than when they were young and following Old Nine to sell "Wish Granting Technique: Local Version"!
There always comes a thriving new generation ahead of the old, flourishing ever brighter than its predecessor.
Lu Yang was not afraid that the Nine Nether Sect could break the Elder's prohibition, or replicate the kindling flames and throw them away to operate on their own.
He had already hinted to them that their Heaven's Court had both the Master and the Dao Celestial Venerable. They far surpassed the Nine Nether Sect. Now that they were cooperating with the Nine Nether Sect in such a friendly manner, it was because of the Ancient Nine Nether's face.
If the Nine Nether Sect did not recognize Heaven's Court, Heaven's Court would also turn their faces and not recognize the Nine Nether Sect.
The Nine Nether Sect was seeking their own destruction if they dared to do so.
One of the reasons Lu Yang wanted the Nine Nether Sect to open barbecue chain restaurants was to restrict the movements of the disciples of the Nine Nether Sect.
The current situation didn't allow for the elimination of the Nine Nether Sect, and during this time, one never knew what kind of terrible things the Nine Nether Sect disciples might do.
It would be better to give them something to do rather than let them do evil.
With the task assigned by the Master accomplished and the business cooperation settled, Shi Huagu was greatly pleased.
He believed that before long, he could pay off the billion debt.
Speaking of the billion-dollar bill, Shi Huagu cast a glance at the quiet Qin Yanyan, stood up and laughed, "I suppose this is the reincarnation of Master Qin that your sect found, right?"
Lu Yang also started to smile, "Whether it is or not, hasn't Master Shi already found the answer in his heart?"
Qin Yanyan kept a poker face, not wanting to say a word.
What could she say? Now that the Nine Nether Sect has identified her as the reincarnation of Qin Haoran. Even if she said now that Li Haoran was the reincarnation of Qin Haoran, it is unlikely that the Nine Nether Sect would believe it.
"Surprisingly, Master Qin, who once led the Nine Nether Sect, has reincarnated as a woman. Nothing in the world could be more impermanent than this."
Despite what he said, Shi Huagu still greatly admired Qin Haoran.
Various signs indicated that the other party had succeeded in reincarnation and it seemed to be related to the Dao Fruit of Reincarnation.
The Dao Fruit of Reincarnation, this was the part that Shi Huagu was most interested in.
Why did the three Vice Masters insist on fighting for the inheritance left by Qin Haoran? It was because they suspected that there was a trace related to the Dao Fruit of Reincarnation!
Shi Huagu had already decided that there was no necessity for the cultivator who had originally been pushed out by him to pretend to be the reincarnation of Qin Haoran anymore, as the real reincarnation of Qin Haoran was right in front of him.
When it comes to fighting for the inheritance, Qin Yanyan will be asked to make a move.
The Nine Nether Sect and Heaven's Court have just established a cooperative relationship. Now is not the time to talk about these things.
The Master instructed him to discuss cooperation with Heaven's Court this time. The follow-up matters definitely need him to continue discussing, so there is no need to be anxious for the moment.
"I wonder if fair Qin Yanyan could accompany me back to the Nine Nether Sect? Master Qin managed the Nine Nether Sect for nine hundred years and left many traces. I believe that when Qin Yanyan returns to the Nine Nether Sect and sees familiar scenes and associates them with old feelings, she may be able to recall more."
Qin Yanyan became somewhat flustered. If she were to return to Nine Nether Sect alone, it would be like a lamb entering a tiger's den and the slightest mistake could lead to her end.
Seeing this, Li Haoran took a step forward, half of his body blocking Qin Yanyan, and said calmly, "As far as I know, your sect is not monolithic, right? Let's not talk about the new Master's attitude towards Qin Yanyan, how would those old subordinates view Qin Yanyan? Would they support her as the new Master? Wouldn't this cause chaos within your sect?"
"Moreover, the meaning of reincarnation is to separate from the previous life and have no further connection. This deliberate pursuit of memories from a past life can actually be demeaning."
"As a Vice Master, is your understanding of Nine Nether and Reincarnation only to this extent?"
When it came to knowing the Nine Nether Sect best, it wasn't the serious and outspoken Lu Yang, but Li Haoran.
Li Haoran could barely piece together Qin Haoran's understanding of Reincarnation and the Nine Nether using fragments of previous life memories.
After reincarnation, all causality vanishes. Nine Nether was the place of reincarnation and a place to eliminate causality.
Shi Huagu was not surprised by Li Haoran's deep understanding of reincarnation. It was normal for him to know these things given that he was an ancient genius who often dealt with the Ancient Nine Nether.
He just wanted to try to get Qin Yanyan from Heaven's Court. Since there was no way to do that, he just let it go.
He gave a hearty laugh, "Everything just now was a joke, don't take it seriously, don't take it seriously."
Lu Yang was also laughing, "It's good that it was a joke. I was afraid that your esteemed sect wanted to snatch someone from our Heaven's Court. This is something that even the Yingtian Immortals have never thought of."
Shi Huagu figured out that although Lu Yang's tone was calm, there was some anger in his words, so he didn't dare to continue probing.
"Forget it, it is a good thing that our two sects have reached cooperation. I will let you have this barbecue restaurant. I will give you this jade pendant; if you want to contact me, you only need to crush the jade pendant." Lu Yang said casually, throwing a jade pendant to Shi Huagu.
Lu Yang and his party couldn't possibly stay in the barbecue restaurant always, so it was better to transfer the shop to the Nine Nether Sect.
Whenever they wanted to find the Nine Nether Sect, they could come here at any time.
Shi Huagu knew this was Lu Yang's trust in him, so he didn't dare to slack off. He turned his head and instructed Huo Huashen, "You, take a few trustable people with you, and run this barbecue shop properly!"
In the future, when the chain stores get started, this will be the flagship store, so it's not exaggerated to have a Divinity Transformation Stage sitting in town.
"Yes!"
Huo Huashen thought to himself that he must seize this opportunity to earn Spirit Stones. In case one day the matter of him bringing back a billion in debt is exposed, at least he would have an excuse to make.
Shi Huagu lifted the identification secret method, keeping the secret method on all the time was a great burden on the spirit.
Throughout this conversation, he found that this young Master Lu Yang had not told a single lie, and secretly admired, this is the demeanor of the future Master of Heaven's Court who was honest and straightforward, and disdainful to lie to and try to probe him.
In contrast, he was acting cautiously, using an identification secret method all the time, which made him appear inferior.
In fact, Fairy Eternity had reminded Lu Yang at the beginning that Shi Huagu was using a truth-detection secret method, and asked him if they need to block it.
Lu Yang declined. He thought that this would be too troublesome for Fairy Eternity. He could deceive people with the truth. Was he even afraid that Shi Huagu would detect it?
...
On the way back to Nine Nether Sect, Shi Huagu suddenly thought of a possibility.
"Could it be that the young Master knew about the billion-dollar debt long ago and deliberately gave the debt note to me?"
"He burdened me with the billion-dollar debt and then displayed the prospects of the barbecue shop, forcing me to agree to the business cooperation?"
Shi Huagu broke out in a cold sweat, realizing how deep the Young Master was in his calculative tactics!
Moreover, this was an overt tactic and he had no room to choose.
This is the worthy disciple of Dao Celestial Venerable! The future Master of Heaven's Court!
...
On the way back to the Seek Dao Sect, the flying shuttle was not as fast as when they came. The Fifth Elder curiously asked, "Lu Yang, you analyzed the overall situation, made plans for the Nine Nether Sect, and the subsequent chain barbecue restaurants. You did not tell us, right?"
In the original plan, there was no plan to answer the two questions posed by the Master of the Nine Nether Sect.
"Oh, I just thought of these things on the spot."

chapters.title: Chapter 333 - 332: Daring to say ran the fastest? (thanks to the book friends for the random rewards)
chapters.content:
The shuttle flew at a speed hundreds of times slower than when they came, as, according to the Fifth Elder, it was to let Lu Yang and the others take in the scenery above.
Even so, the shuttle yet flew beyond one flying boat after another, at a speed so astounding that it left Lu Yang and his three companions utterly shell-shocked, precluding them from daring to look at the outside scenery.
"How about we cultivate instead? The duty of a cultivator is cultivation after all," Li Haoran proposed, tremblingly raising his hand.
The Fifth Elder thought for a while and felt these youngsters were quite diligent: "All right, do you want me to activate the Gathering Spirit Array?"
Lu Yang waved his hand confidently: "No need, I have just learnt a Primitive Divine Ability which can gather all the surrounding Spiritual Energy, replacing the need for the Gathering Spirit Array."
The Fifth Elder was quite surprised, not expecting such an ability. Could it have been taught by Yun Zhi?
Lu Yang, brimming with pride, craned his neck and opened his mouth, performing the Primitive Great Divine Skill of the Taotie clan — Sky devouring skill, and endless Spiritual Energy started to gather around him.
The density of the surrounding Spiritual Energy skyrocketed in an instant.
"So there is such a miraculous Divine Ability?" The Fifth Elder, drawing from his wealth of experience, recognized the exceptional nature of this ability, which hardly consumed any spiritual essence. It was much cheaper compared to the Gathering Spirit Array, with almost the same effects and without geographic restrictions, allowing one to cultivate anytime, anywhere!
Although the posture was not too elegant, with the neck tilted back and mouth open, looking like a divine dog howling at the moon.
However, as a cultivator, putting cultivation as a priority, whether it looked elegant or not was secondary.
Meng Jingzhou also recognized the brilliance of this ability and moved forward to ask, "How do you practice this ability? Can you teach me?"
Li Haoran and Qin Yanyan were also eagerly looking at Lu Yang, as they clearly wanted to learn this move as well.
"We can discuss it in peace." Lu Yang was not stingy. After getting Fairy Eternity's permission, he taught them the mental methods and key points of this move.
"We will learn it slowly when we get back, let's cultivate first," said Lu Yang, before opening his mouth to gather Spiritual Energy again.
...
"Stop, don't run away!"
"How dare you disrespect the law within the borders of Great Xia, you still think it's your Great Yu Dynasty!"
"Damn Great Xia, just a bunch of people who seize power through usurpation, do you really have the audacity to act so arrogantly!"
Three rays dashed through the sky. One of them was trying its hardest to lose the pursuit of the other two.
He was a Unification peak cultivator from Great Yu dynasty, who had chosen to sleep while at his peak state, to prepare for the future Great World strife.
Normally, he wouldn't have awakened this early. As per the plan, their Imperial Teacher should wake them one by one.
However, the place where he was resting was found by a few unseeing cultivators, who, ecstatic at having found a massive chance, dug it up and ultimately broke his sleep.
That infuriated him so much that he ended up killing those cultivators.
Who would have thought that his move would alarm the local head constable, only for the latter to witness that he was enraged and therefore got in touch with higher-ups. Consequently, the Imperial City sent two Unification stage cultivators to capture him.
The reason for his capture was the ridiculous charge of intentional homicide.
As a Unification stage cultivator, would killing a few small cultivators matter? It was just an excuse to capture him.
In his opinion, the Great Qian Dynasty was shining bright, and such so-called Great Xia dynasty members must be power usurpers, yet they shamelessly claimed to be orthodox.
Luckily, he was prepared and was able to return to his peak state in a short period.
Moreover, he had a knack for escape techniques, making it quite easy for him to escape these pursuers.
"After I shake you two off, control a small family in secret, and then investigate the Great Xia Dynasty, this shall also pave the way for the Imperial Teacher!"
He felt that there was none like the Imperial Teacher.
Despite the fact that, at that time, the Great Yu Dynasty had powerful influences, was unifying the Central Continent, and was formidable without any rivals with its territory-swallowing momentum, with its influence continuously waxing and waning, it seemed eternal.
However, the Imperial Teacher insisted that there was no such thing as an eternal dynasty. Even the ancients had their end days. And, no matter how strong the Great Yu Empire was, it couldn't be stronger than the ancients who hosted the Four Immortals of the Ancients; the Great Yu Dynasty wouldn't last forever.
Therefore, there was only one way to let the Great Yu Dynasty govern the world anew, and it was to resurge in the era of a new dynasty, keep pushing forward in the Grand World Strife, establish the Great Yu Dynasty once more, and continue the influence of the Great Yu Dynasty!
He shook his head to dispel these thoughts temporarily. The most important task at hand was to get rid of these two people in pursuit.
Two cultivators from Great Xia wore troubled looks on their faces; the opponent's speed was amazingly fast, ranking among the top ten even in the Unification stage. Even if they used Speed Boost Talismans, they are still slightly slower.
A cultivator accidentally caught sight of a shuttle, which seemed very familiar.
"Elder Chu, you pursue him first, I'll find someone to help."
Elder Chu, not understanding the intentions behind it, felt that it was too late to find help. However, believing in his partner's judgment, nodded, "Okay."
...
A cultivator from the Great Xia knocked on the shuttle, the Fifth Elder opened the hatch, and let him in.
As soon as the cultivator from the Great Xia entered, he saw Lu Yang opening his mouth towards the sky, and Meng Jingzhou's three people sitting around Lu Yang in a triangular formation, meditating together. The atmosphere was quite eerie.
Was this the newest cultivation method of Seek Dao Sect?
Nevermind, now isn't the time to think about this. The cultivator from the Great Xia looked at the Fifth Elder standing with his hands behind his back, a smile spreading across his face.
What a great savior.
"Ha ha, Zhou Xin, I knew this shuttle was yours!"
The Fifth Elder turned his head, looked at the other party, visibly cautious, "Yu Qian, my shuttle didn't overspeed, why are you looking for me?"
Seeing a cultivator they do not recognize, who nevertheless knows the Fifth Elder, Lu Yang and the others slowly opened their eyes. They wanted to ascertain the situation.
The Fifth Elder casually introduced: "This is Yu Qian, a constable of the Great Xia Dynasty. In the past when I used to drag race shuttles, he would chase after me every day, issuing tickets to me. After I stopped drag racing shuttles so much, he stopped chasing me."
Lu Yang twitched, realizing that the Fifth Elder was at least at the Spirit Transformation Stage when he used to drag race shuttles. This Yu Qian, a constable and a contemporary of the Fifth Elder, had to be a powerhouse himself, even if he was a constable. He must be an important person like the Head Constable of the Imperial City.
Yu Qian seethed, veins throbbing visibly: "You're talking rubbish! What do you mean by 'you stopped drag racing so much afterward'? You clearly kept doing it since nobody could catch up to you to begin with!"
"Not more than a fortnight ago, I listened to someone complain about you drag racing shuttles again!"
The Fifth Elder's troublesome habit of drag racing shuttles in his youth made Yu Qian and the others go through quite a hassle. And the reason Yu Qian could run so fast now was all owing to his past experience of chasing the Fifth Elder.
"You can't just say anything. When have I drag raced shuttles since I've stopped? Do you have any evidence?"
Yu Qian just wanted to hit someone in frustration. The Fifth Elder would fly so fast that even a Recording Orb would fail to capture the shadows of his shuttle. Where would he find evidence?
"Enough," he decided to change the topic, "quit messing around. Something important is happening right now. Did you see that person who just sped past? He's a cultivator from the Great Yu. Chase him!"
Yu Qian was so aggrieved by the Fifth Elder that he almost forgot the main issue.
"He claims himself to be the fastest person in the Unification stage of the Great Yu era, and we couldn't catch up to him."
The Fifth Elder lifted his eyes to take a glance at the man from Great Yu speeding away, and scoffed: "And with this, he dares to claim that he is the fastest?"
"Everyone, hold on tight!"
The Fifth Elder was preparing to get serious now. Never before had someone dared to challenge his supremacy in the field of open-air flight.
Yu Qian heaved a sigh of relief. When the Fifth Elder was an opponent, he was quite troublesome, but when he was on your side, you couldn't be luckier.

chapters.title: Chapter 334 - 333: You High-Level Cultivators Sure Have a Lot of Tricks (Thanks to Unit Zero - Wild Fire for the Alliance Leader Reward)_1
chapters.content:
"By the way, I'm now part of the Luoshui Guards, not a constable anymore."
"Ah, I thought so. After all, we're not in the Imperial City. It's unusual that it falls on constables to chase down ancient cultivators." Fifth Elder showed no surprise, or rather, his concern now was when he could catch up with the Great Yu cultivator.
"What are the Luoshui Guards?" Lu Yang struggled to communicate with Meng Jingzhou using Spiritual Sense.
He didn't know as much about the official positions in Great Xia as Meng Jingzhou did.
Li Haoran and Qin Yanyan also listened curiously through their Spiritual Senses. In fact, Qin Yanyan had heard her mother talk about it, but Meng Jingzhou certainly knew more.
"The Luoshui Guards are a special organization established by the Great Xia dynasty, specifically tasked with capturing evil cultivators who have committed numerous crimes, such as those from the demonic sect, evil cultivators who bully others with their power, or ancient cultivators who don't follow the rules, and so on."
"Remember what happened at Buyi Town? After we fled with the Sect Leader, we reported the incident at Buyi Town to the court. It was the Luoshui Guards dispatched by the court who handled the aftermath."
"After the Eternity Sect's headquarters were breached, the task of eliminating all of the Eternity Sect's branches was also completed by the Luoshui Guards."
"I have heard of this Commander Yu before. He was one of the top four constables in the Imperial City. It seems that the court saw his high Cultivation Level, rich experience, and crafty tactics, and assigned him to the Luoshui Guards."
"The person in charge within the Luoshui Guards is called Nine Palaces. Given his qualifications and Cultivation Level, he must be one of the Nine Palaces."
"That strong?!"
Qin Yanyan did not expect that the important person who suddenly asked Fifth Elder for help on the flying chariot was in charge of capturing evil cultivators. Needless to say, he must have rich battle experience and be at the top of the Unification Stage in terms of Cultivation Level.
"Oh, that's quite impressive." To Lu Yang, however, it wasn't anything special. As he heard stories of ancient shameful chapters from Fairy Eternity every day, he didn't regard a Cultivator at Unification Stage as something significant.
Li Haoran didn't react as strongly as Qin Yanyan did. After all, as a disciple of the Seek Dao Sect, didn't the elders he deal with on a daily basis excel in the Unification Stage?
The four of them stopped communicating through Spiritual Sense. The speed of the flying chariot was so fast that their Spiritual Senses would dissipate if they pushed it out slightly. They could no longer communicate at all.
Both Fifth Elder and Yu Qian remained calm and were still in the mood to chat.
Yu Qian wasn't in a hurry. If even Fifth Elder couldn't catch up, his efforts would be in vain no matter how hard he tried.
"By the way, show him no mercy when we catch up. He has killed."
"The audacity!" On hearing this, Fifth Elder's temper flared up. He stomped his foot and his body was engulfed in blue flames. The speed of the flying chariot increased by two notches.
The Great Yu cultivator suddenly felt a calamity approaching. Looking back, he saw a flying chariot blazing with blue flames charging straight at him.
"What is this thing?!" His face drastically changed. The flying chariot was unbelievably fast. He would believe it if he was told that a cultivator at Transcendance Tribulation Stage was chasing him.
The flying chariot was too fast. He had no chance to react. The sharp top of the chariot violently hit him in the chest.
The flying chariot, painstakingly refined by Fifth Elder, was a flying magic artifact. It was hard to destroy, and the destructive force it generated when it flew at a speed close to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage was unimaginable.
Boom——Boom——Boom——
After piercing through three large mountains in a row, the flying chariot finally nailed the Great Yu cultivator to the cliff of the fourth mountain peak, with smoke and dust billowing.
The Luoshui Guard trailing behind, the old Chu, was dumbfounded: "This is Zhou Xin's flying chariot!" He just then remembered the origin of the flying chariot.
"Trying to compete with me in speed?" Fifth Elder snorted coldly and jumped down from the flying chariot.
Fifth Elder deliberately held back, choosing not to kill the Great Yu cultivator directly.
The Great Yu cultivator had a gaping hole in his chest, where the point of the flying chariot had struck. He was vomiting blood in big gulps, struggling to use the power of the rules.
"[I establish the following rule here: The mountains here transform into Mountain Gods and serve my purpose...]"
Yu Qian sneered coldly, knocking him out with a single punch.
Using the power of rules right under his nose, did he really think Yu was just twiddling his thumbs?
"So it's Elder Zhou Xin, I wondered why Yu Qian mentioned needing backup." Old Chu arrived to see the Great Yu cultivator already unconscious, tied up with chains by the Fifth Elder and heaved a sigh of relief.
"Chu Dalong!" The Fifth Elder and the Luoshui Guards had collaborated many times and he had practically recognized all of their Unification Stage cultivators.
Old Chu darkened his face: "I've said so many times, I've changed my name to Chu Long."
"It seems that this barbarian holds some unknown secrets of vital importance. We owe you big for capturing him. When I get time, I'll treat you to a drink!" Yu Qian thanked him with a salute.
"Why are you talking about thanks? It's rare to legally race the flying shuttles." The Fifth Elder was particularly thrilled this time, "Next time if you can't catch up with someone, call me. I guarantee I can catch them!"
"This chain blocks his magic power. Consider it a token from me for doing the right thing."
The Luoshui Guards had similar methods, but the outcome certainly wouldn't be as good as what this Grandmaster Refiner, the Fifth Elder, had produced.
The Fifth Elder kindly reminded them, "Right, for safety's sake, since this man possesses some unknown secret, you'd best bring a few more Unification Stage cultivators to suppress him. It would be disastrous if someone managed to snatch him midway."
"Alright, I'll call some people now." Yu Qian nodded, sending out a talisman into the sky. Shortly after, two more Unification Stage cultivators flew over.
These two Unification Stage cultivators seemingly knew the Fifth Elder too. After giving a brief greeting, the four Luoshui Guards escorted the Great Yu cultivator back to the capital.
"Alright, let's head back. Things related to ancient cultivators are not something you can touch yet. It's too dangerous. Wait till you reach the Spirit Transformation stage." The Fifth Elder gestured to the four youngsters, telling them not to overthink.
Before leaving, some figures flew over from afar. They used earth magic to repair the mountain that had been damaged by the flying shuttle.
Rocks and soil hovered in the air, rhythmically filling the gaps in the mountain.
Then they gathered the trees that had been knocked over. Those that were still alive were replanted using the "Tree-Planting Sutra". Those that were broken were replaced with new trees.
"Who are these people?" The four, including Lu Yang, had never seen such a thing.
The Fifth Elder explained, "Oh, they're responsible for the aftermath work on behalf of the imperial court. Your cultivation levels are not high enough yet to cause catastrophic damage. Once your levels are high enough, a simple move can create a hole in a mountain, crack the ground or break a river."
"If this were left unchecked, the landscape would change daily. In a few years, the map of Great Xia would have to be redrawn."
"To prevent this, Great Xia found a group of cultivators who are responsible for repairing the terrain, masters of earth and wood magic."
"The capture this time was official business, so I'm not responsible for the damage caused to the mountain by the flying shuttles. The imperial court is in charge of the aftermath. If it was due to a private dispute, either I need to repair the damaged terrain or I would have to pay in spirit stones to hire others to do it."
"So when a person's level of cultivation reaches a certain stage, in order to avoid trouble, they either fight in the arena or go to heaven to fight."
"Of course, if you're fighting with a cultivator from the demon path, you're not responsible for the damage to the terrain."
"Actually, the regulation of restoring the terrain after fights originated from an incident twenty thousand years ago."
"The governor managing Qingzhou, who was also the leader of the province, thought the city in the neighboring province was extremely prosperous and was considering ways to have Qingzhou be just as prosperous."
"Coincidentally, his cultivation level was quite high, at the Transcendance Tribulation stage. He came up with a great idea and called upon his close friend, who also happened to be at the Transcendance Tribulation stage."
"They fought each other, causing a monumental upheaval that altered the landscape, and under the guise of the fight, moved the thriving city from the neighboring province to within the boundaries of Qingzhou."
"When the imperial court found out about this matter and realized there were no laws regulating such an incident, it was difficult to handle, so they enacted a rule that high-level cultivators must restore the landscape to its original state after a fight."
Lu Yang: "..."
You high-level cultivators sure pull a lot of tricks.

chapters.title: Chapter 335 - 334: Li Haoran Forms the Golden Core_1
chapters.content:
(Thanks to the book friend's million weapons, your belief in the reward of the alliance master)
Lu Yang felt that the Great Xia Dynasty was really struggling, in his view, the legal system was already quite complete, there was nothing that could be added or subtracted, it was enough to handle any situation.
But it's hard to get past the numerous ideas of Cultivators.
It's not a problem if Cultivators have numerous ideas, having many ideas doesn't mean they can be realized, but there are inevitably some extremely resourceful Cultivators among them, who have the ability to realize their ideas.
This leads to the legal system never being able to keep up with their ideas.
Like Qingzhou's Shepherd in the mouth of the Fifth Elder.
It's perfectly normal for a Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator to engage in magical battles, right? It's perfectly normal to move mountains and fill the seas during a battle, right? So, isn't it perfectly normal if I accidentally move the city of the neighboring state to Qingzhou during my battle?
What Lu Yang didn't know was that the nine sons of the Seek Dao Sect had made outstanding contributions to the laws of Great Xia - mostly in making Great Xia realizes their laws weren't perfect and there were many loopholes to exploit.
"Lucky, I am a honest person and never cause trouble for the Great Xia Dynasty." Lu Yang glanced at Meng Jingzhou and Li Haoran, feeling that he had a long way to go.
Why was he practicing so hard to be the first? Wasn't it to set an example for them, to make them obey the rules like him?
"Ex-father, why do you look so bad?" Qin Yanyan noticed Li Haoran's forehead soaked with sweat.
Li Haoran couldn't stop his body from trembling, his momentum fluctuating greatly, at times low as the beginning of Foundation Establishment, and at other times high as the early Golden Core Stage.
He squeezed a few words out of his teeth with difficulty, "I have had some insights and want to form a golden core."
The Fifth Elder appeared in front of Li Haoran, using his Spiritual Sense to scan his Dantian and found that the fog in his Dantian was foggy, indicating the sigh of condensing a Golden Core.
He spoke solemnly: "Haoran, your situation is special. You are the reincarnation of Qin Haoran. Unpredictable things might happen when you form a golden core. The best choice is to return to the Sect to form a golden core, where it's the safest!"
Li Haoran once again struggled to say, "I will try my best, but my instinct is causing my body to start to lose control, I want to form a golden core."
Lu Yang had seen this situation in books. This was the most ideal situation for a Foundation Establishment Cultivator at Consummation. The body would automatically form a golden core, everything would flow naturally, there would be no risk of failure and definitely reach Upper Third Grade upon forming the golden core.
The more times one reincarnated, the better one's talent would be showcased at this moment!
Unfortunately, there were too many uncertainties in Li Haoran's body, everyone was half-understood about the matter of reincarnation, and forming a golden core on the spot was not the best choice.
"Hang in there, Haoran, I'm going to start the flying shuttle!"
The Fifth Elder opened the cabin door, sucked the four of them into the shuttle, and moved forward at full speed.
"Deep breaths, relax your body, deep breaths, yes, inhale, exhale..."
"Junior Brother Li, you have to hold on, you and your golden core will definitely be alright!"
"Elder, operate the flying shuttle a little slower, Junior Brother Li can't hold on!"
"Junior Brother Li, relax, this is not a big deal. As a cultivator, everyone will pass this hurdle, just try a little harder."
On the flying shuttle, two Golden Core Stage Protectors - Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were looking after Li Haoran, encouraging and comforting him, wiping sweat, their care was quite comprehensive.
Qin Yanyan: "..."
People who didn't know better would think that the two of you were taking care of a pregnant woman.
"The mist in the Dantian is condensing, he's about to form a golden core!"
"The prototype of the golden core has emerged!"
