"Keep going, Junior Brother Li, you will surely succeed!"
Qin Yanyan felt it was even more so now.
Li Haoran, with Five Centers Toward Heaven, absorbed the surrounding spiritual energy. All the surrounding spiritual energy was absorbed into his body without a trace. The foggy reaction in his Dantian became more intense, wave after wave of magic power swept across his body – skin, bone marrow, meridians...
The fog in his Dantian kept refining, completely transformed into liquid golden spiritual essence.
The golden spiritual essence compressed again, emitted a bright gleam, the light kept flashing, constantly swallowing the surrounding golden spiritual essence.
In the end, a fulfilling golden elixir was formed.
Li Haoran successfully formed a Golden Core!
"Did I succeed?" Li Haoran asked, unsure.
His Golden Core formation process seemed to go quite smooth, except for the annoying voices of the two Dao protectors in his ears.
"You succeeded." The Fifth Elder stated with certainty after a careful inspection.
"However, it would still be appropriate to have the Sect conduct a final examination."
The Fifth Elder breathed a sigh of relief when he saw that nothing unusual occurred before and after Li Haoran's Golden Core formation.
"Finally, I have reached the Golden Core stage," Li Haoran also exhaled, thinking that Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou would no longer have a reason to flaunt superiority in front of him.
"Exactly what type of Golden Core have you formed?"
Li Haoran smirked, "An unrecorded type of Golden Core, the Regeneration Golden Core!"
"Regeneration Golden Core?!"
Lu Yang thought the name of this Golden Core is grand. A Regeneration Golden Core implies that Li Haoran has understood the essence of reincarnation, capable of keeping his memory and reliving his life to amend past regrets?
If it's really the case, the name of this Golden Core is quite apt.
"Let me demonstrate for you all."
Li Haoran didn't hesitate, he cut off one of his arms, frightening everyone. They all initially thought he had lost his mind.
But then, an astonishing sight occurred. The severed arm's wound squirmed and in the blink of an eye, the chopped off arm regrew.
"Regeneration of severed limbs!" Meng Jingzhou named the phenomenon, a divine magic skill that eunuchs dream of possessing.
Lu Yang:"..."
So this is what the Regeneration Golden Core is about?
However, the ability to regenerate severed limbs is really handy in battles. And judging from Li Haoran's look, regrowing an arm doesn't seem to drain him.
Compared to Meng Jingzhou's Dual Single Golden Core and Man Gu's Ancestral Pill, Li Haoran's Regeneration Golden Core is the most normal Golden Core formed in this generation.
"It's not just a limb that I can regenerate, but also the heart, blood, and even the head. I can grow a new one." Li Haoran introduced his capabilities with great pride. The amputated arm on the ground was still twitching.
"Why did you suddenly decide to form your Golden Core? Did you have some kind of enlightenment?"
Meng Jingzhou recalled the things that happened before the Golden Core formation, it seemed that the cleaner hired by the Court attracted the most attention.
"You also want to do menial jobs in the future?"
Li Haoran rolled his eyes, not knowing how to respond. "Of course not, I can't use earth and wood magic skills. It's just that I regained some of Qin Haoran's memories earlier. Having looked at them, I found the knowledge useful for my Golden Core formation, so I got insight and decided to proceed."
This aroused Meng Jingzhou's curiosity even further: "What did you see in your memories?"
Li Haoran was silent for a long time before he slowly spoke: "He exploited his ability to regenerate, to sell blood."
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou both gasped; he was a ruthless man.
Although his blood was not as precious as phoenix blood, the blood of a cultivator at the Unification stage was still quite valuable.
"Qin Haoran sold his blood many times and got pretty skillful at regenerating. When I received this fragment of memory, I thought limb regeneration could be useful, so I implemented it in my Golden Core formation."
"Who would have thought that Qin Haoran would go to such lengths for the Nine Nether Sect, even resorting to selling blood." The Fifth Elder stroked his beard with admiration.
Lu Yang sneered at the Fifth Elder, thinking wasn't it you guys who plunged the Nine Nether Sect into such dire straits?
Li Haoran's expression turned even stranger: "He sold blood before he became the Sect's Master."
"Then what did he use the money for?"
"To pay for prostitutes."
"A cultivator in the Unification stage didn't have money for prostitutes?"
"He patronized many."

chapters.title: Chapter 336 - 335: This Pill Can Sever Causality! (Thank you, Nautiluses, for the alliance leader's reward)_1
chapters.content:
Although, it's not great to speak about a father's indiscretion in front of his daughter.
When Li Haoran thought about the torment he had suffered from Qin Haoran's memories, he let go of his guilt and started revealing Qin Haoran's dark past.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou discreetly observed Qin Yanyan and found no signs of anger or disappointment on her face.
Qin Yanyan noticing their little act, retorted, "What are you both looking at? Isn't it expected that someone from a demonic sect wouldn't be a saint? Didn't you think I could handle this?"
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou thought about it and felt it made sense.
They never considered themselves to be part of any demonic sect.
Li Haoran spoke, "At that time, before Qin Haoran became the Master, he would spend as much as he had, never saving a dime. His motto was to live life in the moment."
"So, when he had no money, he often sold his body, meaning he sold blood."
"Of course, he was safety-conscious, he would wipe out any personal traces in his blood since there are magic skills that allow spells to be cast through someone's blood, a situation Qin Haoran would want to avoid."
"After the sudden death of the penultimate Master, Qin Haoran felt that the Nine Nether Sect had a lot of money. As a Master, he thought he could spend however he wanted."
"However, after overcoming obstacles and defeating competitors to become the Master, he realized the Nine Nether Sect wasn't as affluent as he thought."
"And it was already too late to step down."
Lu Yang could imagine how hopeless Qin Haoran felt at that time:
He became the Master in high spirits, hoping to rule as he liked, and lead a life of hedonism. But then he found out that the Nine Nether Sect was so poor they couldn't even afford to pay their members' monthly dues, and the people below were oblivious to this. Even if he told them the truth—that the previous master had invested it all—everyone would think Qin Haoran embezzled the money.
The previous Master was swindled? That's impossible, when did it become someone else's turn to scam their Sect? Qin Haoran must be lying!
So, after becoming the Master, Qin Haoran had to change his ways and focus on sincerely developing...or you could say maintaining the Nine Nether Sect."
Lu Yang suspected that the current Master of the Nine Nether Sect had the same mindset: thinking being the Master is a good thing, only to realize it's a pure burden after becoming one, hence the saying "Misfortune comes in a flood."
The current Master can't reveal the true situation, as people would wonder why as soon as he took charge, he was claiming the Nine Nether Sect had no money. Where did all the money go?
Lu Yang had a question, how was the current Master making money? Was he following Qin Haoran's method and borrowing money?
An assertion from Li Haoran interrupted Lu Yang's thoughts, "Of course, Qin Haoran's regenerative abilities isn't just for selling blood but also to sever causality. However, I've just newly formed my Golden Core and can't use this method yet."
"What do you mean?" Lu Yang hadn't thought that regenerative abilities and something as profound as "Causality" could be connected.
Li Haoran explained, "Think about it, with regeneration, can a new arm grow back after it gets chopped off?"
"Yes." Lu Yang nodded.
"Can a new leg grow back after it gets chopped off?"
"Yes." Meng Jingzhou nodded.
"Can a new torso and organs grow back?"
"Yes." Qin Yanyan nodded.
"Can a new head grow back after it gets chopped off?"
"Yes." The Fifth Elder nodded.
Li Haoran smiled slightly and asked, "If the head, torso, and all the limbs grow back, isn't it the same as renewing my entire body?"
"Would I still be the same 'me'?"
"!!!"
"With my whole body renewed, I'm not the same me anymore. Can causality still find me?"
Lu Yang thought to himself, no wonder Qin Haoran could be the Master of the Nine Nether Sect, who would think of this?
"But, since this involves causality, and my realm is not yet stable, when it is, I might be able to achieve this." Li Haoran felt pretty good about his Golden Core. Not only was it helpful in battles, but it also eliminates the effects of causality, living up to the term "rebirth".
As they were talking, the shuttle returned to the Seek Dao Sect. The Fifth Elder took Li Haoran to meet other elders and Yun Zhi to check if there were any problems with forming Li Haoran's Golden Core.
"Junior Brother Lu, Junior Brother Meng, Elder Brother Dai is looking for you." Another Senior Brother informed Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou when he saw them.
The two were surprised, "He's looking for us?"
They hadn't done anything wrong when they went out, had they?
"Niece, you stay at the Hundred Refinement Peak. We will be back soon." Lu Yang asked Qin Yanyan to stay and either cultivate or take a tour around the Seek Dao Sect to learn more about its environment.
It's best to take a walk around the dining hall.
...
The two headed towards the Task Hall.
"Elder Brother Dai, you wanted to see us?"
"We had the Fifth Elder with us on our trip this time and we didn't do anything inappropriate!" Lu Yang clarified his innocence right away.
Dai Bufan breathed a sigh of relief: "That's good. Every time you two go out, you always stir up trouble. I'm afraid one day you might even cause the fall of the demonic sects without me knowing what you did."
Dai Bufan was in charge of collecting the intelligence for the Sect in place of the Grand Elder, and every time Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou came back from a trip, the information they brought always led to a reevaluation of his intelligence.
He feared that one day these two guys, with a high spirit, would report to him saying, "Elder Brother Dai, good news! We've taken care of the Four Great Devil Sects."
Without any details, just a result handed to him, that would make him, the intelligence master, a complete failure.
To prevent such an incident from happening, he felt the need to know what they did every time they went out.
"This time, we made the Nine Nether Sect believe that our Heaven's Court was established by a Great Power from ancient times. We took this opportunity to establish a long-term strategic cooperation with the Nine Nether Sect. We plan to open a barbecue joint together—we provide the technology, they provide the manpower. We get 60% of the profits, they get 40%."
"I estimate that over time, when they figure out the rules of opening a shop, they'll be able to speed up the process. I believe it won't be long until we open a chain of barbecue shops all over the continent."
Dai Bufan highly praised Lu Yang's and Meng Jingzhou's plan, "That's good news. It seems that the Nine Nether Sect will be stable for a while. By the way, what identity did you assign to the Fifth Elder when you invited him?"
Less trouble was always good during turbulent times.
Meng Jingzhou honestly answered, "One of the Nine Protectors of Heaven's Court, the Multi-treasure Heavenly King."
Dai Bufan stretched his neck a bit, "Oh, Multi-treasure Heavenly King, it's a good title, the Fifth Elder will like it... wait a minute, Nine Protectors? Where did these Nine Protectors come from?"
Lu Yang began to count on his fingers, "Eight Elders, and the Master, adding up to nine. We're also planning to invite Eldest Senior Sister to be the Master. Our Heaven's Court claims to the outsiders that it's a major power capable of covering the sky with one hand. Having this kind of configuration doesn't seem excessive, does it?"
"So, you plan to include all the high-ranking members of our Sect in your Heaven's Court?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 337 - 336: The Official Establishment of Heaven's Court (Thanks to the alliance leader reward from book friend anchor An Ran)_1
chapters.content:
"There is such a plan indeed. Think about it, brother Dai. With only Meng Jingzhou and me, the two ancient prodigies of Heaven's Court, won't it seem too empty, too unconvincive to Nine Nether Sect?" Lu Yang explained his rationale for this move.
"Even if we add the Fifth Elder, it is still hard to justify that the dignified Heaven's Court only has one at Unification stage."
"After all, we need to find some high-level cultivators to prop up the structure of Nine Nether Sect. You know I don't know many people in the Cultivation World. After weighing the options, I think our sect's elders are the best suited to that end!"
Meng Jingzhou said: "Furthermore, familiarity breeds deception. In the business of deceiving people, experience is paramount; the elders have fooled Nine Nether Sect once, so it should be no problem to do it again."
Dai Bufan fell silent for a moment, unsure of what to say, mostly because he found what Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou said to make quite some sense.
The Nine Nether Sect aren't fools, after all. There must be more actors, and they need to switch places now and then.
"Alright, if that's the case, then you two tell the elders. If they agree, I won't have anything to say."
Although Dai Bufan replaced the Grand Elder to manage the Task Hall, he was still a disciple after all and had no say over the elders.
However, he still thought the elders would likely be thrilled.
A rare opportunity for a second collective scam against the Nine Nether Sect.
Dai Bufan knew that the last time the Nine Children of the Seek Dao Sect acted collectively, they almost bankrupted the Nine Nether Sect.
The plan of the elders 900 years ago was to swindle all the Nine Nether Sect's money, causing internal friction and making the sect self-destruct.
Who knew the vitality of the Nine Nether Sect would be so tenacious? Even with all their money taken away, they still existed.
...
Sky Gate Mountain, the Great Hall of Deliberation.
The eight elders circled around Li Haoran, watching him as though he were a treasured animal.
They just learned Li Haoran was the reincarnation of the previous Master of Nine Nether Sect.
"So there really is such a thing as reincarnation in this world, and it happened right in our Seek Dao Sect. How miraculous?"
"What's so surprising about that? Our Seek Dao Sect is the land of heroes and every strange thing will happen here."
"I told you long ago, our ancestors made the right choice with this location. The Feng Shui of our Seek Dao Sect is much better than the other four Immortal Sects, I've studied it!"
"Enough, eldest brother. All you've studied is how to select burial sites. I heard several groups of tomb robbers encountered you while you were sleeping in a coffin, and were scared almost to death, thinking you were a reanimated corpse."
"Correction, this is called lying in wait for prey."
"Regeneration Pill, a rounded Golden Core, is no different from a First-Grade Golden Core. It doesn't look like a trump card left by Qin Haoran."
"I didn't see any problem either. By the way, martial nephew Li, do you know what Golden Core Qin Haoran condensed? Perhaps your Golden Core is related to Qin Haoran's Golden Core. He may gradually assimilate you through this method, causing you to become him."
Li Haoran thought seriously, saying: "I do not know what Qin Haoran's Golden Core is called. I only remember a small snippet in which Qin Haoran was holding the Soul Summoning Banner, sacrificing his Golden Core, and with the wailing of a hundred ghosts and a demon beast howling, it was a grand occasion, as if the king of a hundred demons was exiting."
The elders, with their abundant experience, quickly made a judgment about what type of Golden Core this was.
"Based on the description, it seems to be the Ghost-Crying Wolf-Howling Pill. Its great commotion could frighten people, releasing a sonic attack, and when it's missing someone, it could grandly thicken the formation. It has quite a lot of functions."
Li Haoran was curious: "What kind of Golden Core is this?"
"Second-Grade."
"Qin Haoran's Golden Core and Li Haoran's Golden Core have nothing in common. Li Haoran's Golden Core should have no problem."
"Senior Sister Yun Zhi, did you see any issues?"
The previously silent Yun Zhi gently shook her head: "None."
"Then there's no problem." The elders came to a conclusion unanimously.
Just as everyone was about to disperse, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou walked in.
Upon entering the Grand Hall, the two felt a stifling atmosphere – the Sixth Elder with the Pure Immortal Body was there, and everyone had been using Spiritual Sense to communicate.
"Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, you two have something to say?" The Fifth Elder was somewhat puzzled.
Lu Yang used Spiritual Sense to communicate: "This is the situation. In order to deceive the Nine Nether Sect, we specifically established a Heaven's Court..."
Lu Yang briefly described the situation, with Meng Jingzhou occasionally supplementing.
"That's the situation. We are currently understaffed and want to ask the elders to masquerade as Protectors of Heaven's Court."
Silence, a long period of silence.
Just when Lu Yang thought the elders disagreed, the Spiritual Sense communication became rowdy.
"If there is such fun, speak up earlier, speak up and I'll replace Old Five!"
"Haoran is my disciple, so of course it should be me going!"
"Lu Yang really has ideas. Why didn't I think of this before?"
"Protector of Heaven's Court, it sounds more remarkable than an elder of Seek Dao Sect!"
"Count me in, count me in. This business of deceiving the Nine Nether Sect is what I'm best at."
"We, as excorcists, cannot ignore our duty!"
"I missed out on the Disturbing Undying Sect last time, I can't miss the Nine Nether Sect this time!"
The elders exhibited enthusiasm far beyond Lu Yang's imagination for this matter, reminiscent of their youthful days of troubling the human world a thousand years ago.
"I have been dealing with the graveyard for many years, so I will be known as the Dark Ghost Heavenly King."
"I guard the medicinal garden and have deep research into spiritual plants, I shall be called the Hundred Medicine Heavenly King."
"I specialize in body refinement. Even the monks in the Buddha Country who had trained their bodies to be like Vajra are no match for me. I will be known as the Invincible Heavenly King."
"I am a Confucian cultivator, so I'll be known as the Great Scholar Heavenly King."
"Lu Yang, help me come up with a name. I'll be known as the Multi-treasure Heavenly King."
"Let me think, I possess the Pure Immortal Body, I'll be known as the Pure Heavenly King ... Dust-Cleaning Heavenly King ... No, Pure Heavenly King, Dust-Cleaning Heavenly King seems nicer though?"
"I am best at refining pills. In the art of refining pills, controlling fire is of utmost importance. How about being known as the Golden Flame Heavenly King?"
"I was the first to deceive the Nine Nether Sect last time, and here it is again. It must be fate. I shall be known as the Fate-Origin Heavenly King."
"It's a pity that Old Nine is not here for such fun."
"He is currently squatting in jail with the Minister of Justice, he probably can't make it."
"What should Old Nine's Heavenly King be called? Sword-Peddling Heavenly King?"
"Does Sword-Peddling Heavenly King sound right? Have you forgotten about the good old days when Old Nine led us to amass wealth? He should be called the Prosperous Heavenly King!"
"Old Nine is squatting in jail every day, he might as well be called the Imprisoned Heavenly King."
"Can you think of a name that suits the Heaven's Court?"
"How about the Ten Thousand Swords Heavenly King?"
"It doesn't seem quite right either."
The elders discussed their titles with great enthusiasm, all talking at one time. After discussing their own, they started worrying about what Daoist Buyu's title should be.
Taking advantage of the elders discussing, Lu Yang quietly asked Yun Zhi, who had remained quiet throughout, a question. Yun Zhi frowned slightly, as if deciding something significant.
"Big sister, are you considering joining Heaven's Court?"
The position of the Sect Master for Big Sister was incredibly important.
Yun Zhi raised her head, her eyes sparkled slightly: "No, I am considering what title to give master. He has a way with words, how about Talkative Heavenly King?"

chapters.title: Chapter 338 - 337 - I Found A Franchisee For You (Thanks to Reader Banana Protein for the Reward) _1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang felt that his master had good relationships with others. Even when he was imprisoned, there were still so many people concerned about him.
Seven Senior Brothers, one Senior Sister, and his beloved eldest disciple.
In just a few minutes, his master had gained several Heavenly King titles. He truly wished he could deliver this good news to the old man himself.
The old man would probably break out of the prison in his joy, and personally thank his Brothers and Sisters for their care.
He wouldn't thank Yun Zhi though since he couldn't defeat her.
"I think my master should decide what Heavenly King to be called. Eldest Senior Sister, are you the Master of Heaven's Court?"
Yun Zhi thought about it, and asked Lu Yang seriously: "You just said that the Lord of the Heavenly Court is Heavenly Venerable Dou, is this a senior fairy?"
Inside the spiritual space, Fairy Eternity stood with her hands on her hips, looking spirited. Since the Elders were present here, she couldn't show herself and so transmitted the message to Yun Zhi.
"Right, you didn't expect I am the Lord of the Heavenly Court! This Immortal is the first among the Five Immortals of the Ancients, so being a Lord of the Heavenly Court is more than enough!"
"I thought you would give me a title of Heavenly Venerable Yun and let me be the Lord of the Heavenly Court."
Fairy Eternity was so scared that she dared not utter a sound.
Initially, Lu Yang planned to let Eldest Senior Sister be the Lord of the Heavenly Court. After all, she was very reliable in doing things. It was Fairy Eternity who pestered him, which made Lu Yang change the title of Heavenly Venerable Yun to Heavenly Venerable Dou.
He definitely couldn't tell this to Yun Zhi.
"Fine, Master, then. " Yun Zhi agreed readily.
Lu Yang felt relieved. This Master seemed much more reliable than the Lord of the Heavenly Court.
With the Lord of the Ancient Heavenly Court, the Master of Heaven's Court, and the nine Protectors all settled, Lu Yang had reaped quite a bit.
After the Elders disperse, they were still thinking about what Daoist Buyu should be called.
"Old Nine improved the Big and Small Ruyi which are selling well on the market. How about calling him Growth Heavenly King?"
"I like this name, I vote for it."
"I also vote for it."
Eighth Elder recalled with delight about their triumphant deception of the Nine Nether Sect.
"I didn't expect the Nine Nether Sect to be so rich, I was really taken aback when I saw it."
"You're right. With that money, I changed all my magic artifacts; they are all top-notch goods; until now, I am still using the same set!"
"At that time, I boldly bid in the auction. I focused on buying the items at the end of the auction. Once I even bought a mysterious item that even the auction house couldn't identify. By coincidence, I found out it was a map. The map marked a treasure location. I found the place shown on the map and indeed found the treasure!"
"No wonder—we all got about the same amount of Spirit Stones at that time, but you spent more lavishly than us. Turns out you had an unexpected gain!"
"If you do good deeds, good luck will follow."
Lu Yang recalled that he hadn't told the Eternity Sect seniors about his chain store business, so he informed Eldest Senior Sister and headed to the barbecue restaurant on the commercial street.
In the barbecue restaurant, he saw someone he did not expect to see here—Qin Yanyan, who was eating skewers.
"Hey, this is not as delicious as the one I tasted in Yanjiang County, but it's also not bad."
Master Liu and Master Gao had never been so challenged in their professional area before. When they heard what Qin Yanyan said, they put all their efforts into making skewers that would satisfy her palate!
"Niece, why are you here?"
Qin Yanyan, who was enjoying her skewers, lifted her oily mouth and said, "A Sister named Zhou LuLu told me there was a barbecue restaurant in the commercial street, with the same name as the one you guys have in Yanjiang County. I wanted to see if this is the main store and how good it is, so I came over to try."
Upon seeing Lu Yang, Master Liu and Master Gao bowed in salute: "Boss Lu!"
Lu Yang was taken aback; when did he become a boss?
Actually, Master Liu and Master Gao weren't sure why either. They just followed Immortal Eternity's order, and treated Lu Yang as respectfully as they treated him.
After all, Lu Yang was the second-in-command of the Eternity Sect, his position was even higher than Immortal Eternity's.
Lu Yang asked Master Liu to contact the Eternity Sect's Master, still at the slaughterhouse; he had something to tell him.
"They called you boss, did you open this store? Who are these people?" Qin Yanyan asked curiously.
"It could be said that I opened it. Actually, the store in Yanjiang County can be considered the main store, and this is the first branch. Liu and Gao, who are grilling skewers for you, are both former vice masters of the Eternity Sect."
Qin Yanyan was taken aback. She never thought that the people grilling skewers for her held such high positions. In the Seek Dao Sect, would the former vice masters of the Eternity Sect only be allowed to grill skewers?
"In a little while, the person coming is the former Eternity Sect Master, who runs a slaughterhouse in the Seek Dao Sect. He's the main supplier for the barbecue restaurant."
Qin Yanyan was even more shocked. Vice Masters, Masters—the Seek Dao Sect had nearly fully hired the Eternity Sect, making all of them do manual labor.
She looked at Lu Yang with a strange gaze. Why were the former vice masters of the Eternity Sect respectful to you, and you can even call the former master at any time?
Even if the high-level members of the Eternity Sect were prisoners, they wouldn't treat a Golden Core Stage disciple with such a friendly attitude, right?
Could it be that Lu Yang had an exceptionally high position in the Eternity Sect?
Qin Yanyan felt that she had unintentionally discovered a big secret that should not be revealed.
The Master, upon hearing from Lu Yang, rushed over swiftly. Three familiar female ghosts were following him.
"Xiao Wu, Xiao Liu, Xiao Qi, shouldn't you be in Guhuai Town?"
Xiao Qi stepped forward and explained: "True Monarch Dai was worried that the Nine Nether Sect might try to verify the situation with us, so he had us all brought back to the Seek Dao Sect to follow Master Xie."
It took Lu Yang a moment to realize who "True Monarch Dai" referred to in Xiao Qi's mouth; it was Senior Brother Dai Bufan.
Senior Brother Dai Bufan was at the Unification Stage, strong enough to be addressed as "True Monarch".
Though Lu Yang didn't find Dai Bufan remarkable—always flustered and exuberant— in the eyes of the three female ghosts, Dai Bufan was an untouchable Great Power who deserved their utmost respect.
"We usually help Master Xie in the slaughterhouse while absorbing the Yang Qi from the livestock to stabilize our souls."
Knowing that Lu Yang knew these three female ghosts, the Eternity Sect Master specifically brought them along to prove to Lu Yang that he was treating them well.
"Second-in-command!" Immortal Eternity appeared, respectful in his demeanor.
Upon hearing this, the corner of Lu Yang's eyes twitched. He didn't need to guess who had been stirring up trouble behind his back, it was definitely Fairy Eternity.
"Boss Lu, do you have any instructions?" Initially, Lu Yang intended to get even with Fairy Eternity, but the Master's words interrupted his thought process.
"Not really an instruction, just wanted to tell you guys that your plan for expanding the barbecue business got the green light from Eldest Senior Sister."
When the matter of letting the Nine Nether Sect open a barbecue shop was mentioned in the conference hall, Eldest Senior Sister didn't refute it, so it should be considered as being approved.
"That's great!" The higher-ups of the Eternity Sect didn't expect Lu Yang to act so quickly.
"Not just that, I have also found a franchisee for you guys. They are fully responsible for the expansion of the barbecue business and are absolutely reliable."
"There's a franchisee, who is it?" The Master didn't expect Lu Yang to put so much effort into this matter.
"Nine Nether Sect."
"Who?"

chapters.title: Chapter 339 - 338: The Confidence Brought by Invincible Elixir_1
chapters.content:
"Who?"
"The Nine Nether Sect, don't you know them?" Lu Yang was somewhat surprised, not understanding why the high-rank members of the Eternity Sect were so shocked.
Are you all selling skewers here, isn't it quite normal for the Nine Nether Sect to open a chain of stores outside?
They are even at the Unification stage and still startle so easily. Their cultivation of mental state is not sufficient.
In comparison, Senior Brother Dai Bufan is excellent, who remained calm when he heard that the Nine Nether Sect was preparing to open a chain store.
"The Nine Nether Sect asked me if I knew any way to make money, and I said there happened to be a barbecue shop project here, which can definitely make money. They agreed when I asked them to join," Lu Yang briefly explained what had happened.
The Master and others thought they must have heard wrong. The Nine Nether Sect was responsible for expanding a barbecue shop? Does that sound like something they would do?
Although Lu Yang made it sound very simple, the Master and others were not fools and thought that Lu Yang had left out many details.
Regardless of how many details were left out, there was something odd about the fact that the Nine Nether Sect was helping the Seek Dao Sect to open a chain of barbecue shops.
Lu Yang must have lied and deceived the Nine Nether Sect.
But this also doesn't make sense, the Nine Nether Sect's Shi Huagu could identify lies, so no one could lie in front of him.
They couldn't figure it out.
Why bother with such thoughts? They were all ghouls now, without any ambitions. All that mattered was that the barbecue shop could prosper.
It would be a good thing for the Nine Nether Sect to help manage the barbecue shop. Anyone who they could pull into this would be good.
"When we collaborated with the Nine Nether Sect, we provided two extremely important technical supports. As the first branches of the 'Once More Barbecue Shop', you too have the right to receive them."
In the expectant eyes of the high-ranking officials of the Eternity Sect, Lu Yang took out something similar to a bookshelf from the Identity Jade.
"This is an automatic barbecue rack. You put the skewered meat on it, and it barbecues automatically."
Masters Liu and Gao disdained this, feeling that this magic artifact was challenging their status: "Boss Lu, forgive my harsh words, but the food cooked on this barbecue rack lacks a soul. We don't need such a thing."
Lu Yang thought about it and he was right. Both Master Liu and Master Gao were at the late stage of Unification and their control skills for barbecuing were definitely more sophisticated than this magic instrument.
Moreover, the most important thing was that Masters Liu and Gao could only barbecue here. If the automatic barbecue rack replaced them, they would face unemployment.
"And this, Trinary Pure Yang True Fire Species." Lu Yang took out a small jade bottle, opened the bottle cap, and a swaying flame hung in the air, looking mysterious.
The high-rank members of the Eternity Sect didn't have much reaction, but Xiao Qi and the other two female ghosts saw the species of true fire and felt a fear from the bottom of their hearts.
The species of fire contained the pure Yang True Fire of the great power at the Golden Core stage, which was a natural ghost restraint.
Lu Yang smiled and said: "This is a product of the combination of Three Flavored True Fire and Pure Yang True Fire. The Three Flavored True Fire has a miraculous effect on barbecuing and can provide three flavors. The Pure Yang True Fire is different from the one you know. The Pure Yang True Fire I have has an invigorating Yang effect."
"Is there such a magical thing in the world?" Not only the Master, but even the Immortal Eternity showed a somewhat surprised expression.
Immortal Eternity had the memories of all the disciples of the Eternity Sect, even so, he had never heard of the Three Flavored True Fire and the Pure Yang True Fire that could invigorate Yang.
"This Pure Yang True Fire was discovered by a very good friend of mine on the road to the ultimate pursuit. This kind of dedication impresses me greatly."
The Master pondered: "Although the Pure Yang True Fire is good, it seems useless to our Seek Dao Sect, right?"
Everyone in the Seek Dao Sect had a high cultivation level and didn't need to invigorate their Yang. Moreover, there were plenty of Yang invigorating herbs in the sect. For example, Gongshanee Ginseng was known as a Yang-invigorating sacred object by Lu Yang.
Lu Yang thought about it and found it to be true. He put away the Trinary Pure Yang True Fire Species and flipped his palm to release the Three Flavored True Fire.
"This is the species of the Three Flavored True Fire. You can try it and see if it has a miraculous effect on barbecuing."
Master Liu took the fire species with a skeptical attitude, replaced the charcoal, and started to barbecue ten tofu skins taken from the side.
The tofu skins were put on the rack and under Master Liu's skilled flipping, the deliciousness of the tofu skins slowly fermented.
"Have a taste."
When the tofu skin was ready, one for each person, Master Liu took a bite of his own barbecue tofu skin and his eyes widened in surprise.
He had barbecued simple tofu skins countless times and was very familiar with the taste of barbecued tofu skin. He didn't expect that after the triple reinforcement of the Three Flavored True Fire's three flavors, they would give the barbecued tofu a sweet then spicy, mellow taste.
It directly elevated the taste of the barbecue tofu skin to a new level!
This was no longer a gap that could be filled by technology.
How magical!
No wonder Qin Yanyan was always dissatisfied with their skewers. The reason was here.
They had studied skewers for several months, and they were not as thorough as a cultivator at the Golden Core stage.
After this event, they would definitely close up for cultivation and strive for new insights into the way of barbecue!
"Then this fire species is left to you."
Masters Liu and Gao treasured it as a precious gem.
"And niece, did you tell anyone when you left the Hundred Refinement Peak?"
"I guess not."
"Then you'd better go back now. When the Fifth Elder and Junior Brother Li return to the Hundred Refinement Peak and don't find you…"
"Will they be anxious?"
"They will forget they have a person like you."
"..."
"I'm going back now."
Lu Yang gave a stretch, feeling that he had done a good deed.
In fact, if Qin Yanyan disappeared, how could the Fifth Elder and Li Haoran possibly forget her? On the contrary, they would be looking for Qin Yanyan everywhere.
But saying this would make Qin Yanyan feel very mushy, so forget it.
He took his time and leisurely walked towards the Scripture Pavilion.
"What are you going to the Scripture Pavilion for?" In the spiritual space, Fairy Eternity was lying on the bed in a lazy position, her legs straight up, her white and tender toes moving lightly, and then her legs slanted, her whole body fell on the bed.
"If you have any questions, I, the Fairy, can teach you."
"To continue developing the cultivation method. I wrote my own cultivation method, the 'Mind Seeing Method', but I only wrote up to the Foundation Establishment stage due to my limited knowledge at that time.
Now that I'm in the Golden Core stage and my cultivation method can't keep up with my progress, I can only look for inspiration in the Scripture Pavilion and see how to cultivate in the future."
"You're so young and you can write a cultivation method?" Fairy Eternity was shocked. Even writing up to the Foundation Establishment stage was quite amazing.
"How can I do that? After I finished writing it, Eldest Senior Sister changed a part for me."
Fairy Eternity secretly let out a sigh of relief: "I knew it, I couldn't write my own cultivation method during the Foundation Establishment stage, and you could do it. How much did Yun Zhi change for you?"
Lu Yang hesitated for a moment before deciding to tell the truth.
"Just the name of the cultivation method was retained."
Fairy Eternity: "..."
"Then you might as well have Yun Zhi continue to develop the cultivation method for you."
"One has to be independent. How can I rely on Eldest Senior Sister for everything? Maybe this time I write a cultivation method myself and it would get approved by Eldest Senior Sister?" Lu Yang is full of confidence in himself.
Fairy Eternity remained silent, thinking that Lu Yang's confidence might be because of the Invincible Elixir.
There's no need to tell him about such small matters.

chapters.title: Chapter 340 - 339: Ancient Immortal's Technique_1
chapters.content:
Actually, it wasn't that Lu Yang was incapable, but devising a cultivation technique at the Foundation Establishment Stage is truly a tall order. With insufficient experience and knowledge, how could he create a cultivation technique?
Not to mention Lu Yang himself being unable to accomplish this, even Fairy Eternity would find it impossible.
While walking towards the Scripture Pavilion, Lu Yang casually asked, "What cultivation technique did you practice initially, Fairy?"
"The Profound Technique. A very common technique, but quite suitable for me at the time. It was through this technique that I cultivated to the Transcendence Tribulation Stage. When I noticed that this technique had its limits and could not lead one to become an immortal, I had a revelation and deduced the Immortal Technique. I swapped techniques, and subsequently achieved immortality."
"When you reach the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, you'll realize that the limits of every cultivation technique are at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage. After all, the limits of sentient beings lie at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage. Becoming immortal is in defiance of the natural order. Only by breaking the limits can one become immortal, hence previous methodologies cannot be applied.
If one wishes to achieve immortality, they must formulate their own cultivation technique based on personal comprehension and their own distinctive circumstances."
"This was the case for me, as well as for Immortal Jiuchong, Ying Tian Immortal, and the rest of them."
"However, I encountered difficulties when I was writing my technique, and my progress was slower, so I was the last to achieve immortality."
"I thought you would name your technique 'The Invincible Immortal Technique.'" Lu Yang muttered teasingly.
Fairy Eternity waved her hand, acting generously, "Absolutely not. That's Ying Tian Immortal's technique. I can't occupy his spot."
Lu Yang: "..."
Ying Tian Immortal, what's going on with you? Have you been assimilated by Fairy Eternity?
It seemed that compared to Immortal Jiuchong's 'The Immortal Skill of Chaotic One Energy, Two Instruments, Four Images, Six Unions, Eight Desolations, Nine Lands, Ten Heavens, and Only I Am Supreme', and Ying Tian Immortal's 'Invincible Immortal Technique', the technique devised by Fairy Eternity had the most sober title.
Of course, it could also be that Fairy Eternity lacked a sophisticated linguistic culture. In consideration of her Dao Fruit of Eternity, she named her technique 'Immortal Technique.'
"What's Qilin Immortal's technique called?"
"The Even More Invincible Technique."
"Actually, I contemplated that name for myself as well, but Qilin Immortal beat me to it and stole my potential title."
Considering the constant arguments between Qilin Immortal and Ying Tian Immortal over who had a closer relationship with the heavens, his choice of name was somewhat justifiable... Lu Yang tried his best to appease Qilin Immortal.
"What's Time Immortal's technique called?"
"The Everlasting Green Technique."
Lu Yang gasped. As expected of Time Immortal, who was the oldest amongst them. His naming skills were far superior to the other three, including Fairy Eternity.
Fairy Eternity shook her head, "I believe Time Immortal has the worst naming sense. It closely resembles those street level techniques."
"Those in the 'merge with one another' and transcendent stages dwell in 'The Undying and Indestructible Sutra', 'Heaven Derivation Taoist Manual' and 'Five Elements Rotation Technique', with Time Immortal's technique blending in without a trace. Which one of them sounds like an immortal technique?"
Lu Yang thought to himself, as it turned out, they had disparaged the naming skills of Time Immortal due to their own deficient technique-naming abilities.
Wait a minute, Ying Tian Immortal is a face-saving immortal. How could he come up with such a name?
"Does Ying Tian Immortal have other names for his technique?"
"Yes, he calls his own technique the 'Innate Ultimate Immortal Technique' when introducing it to others."
As he discovered the ancient secrets, Lu Yang entered the Scripture Pavilion.
The first thing upon entering the Scripture Pavilion was to seek out the book that contained the experiences of his senior brothers and sisters in the Golden Core Stage.
It was time to input his own Golden Core knowledge.
"Lu Yang, Invincible Elixir, First-Grade Golden Core. Those who follow this guide can understand the strong and the weak, generate invincibility within their hearts, feel that they can conquer any obstacle, win all battles, and become invincible in the world."
Lu Yang originally wanted to trust Fairy Eternity's instigation and add the phrase "This is the supreme Golden Core in the world" but given that Eldest Senior Sister's Golden Core was at the forefront, he decided to not do so.
"Practice Method: Challenge across levels, be undefeated in hundreds of battles, create an invincible momentum, draw upon the momentum, consolidate the Qi of the Dantian, only then can one form the Core."
"Notice 1: Challenging across levels means challenging one level higher, not one level lower."
"Notice 2: This Golden Core may lead to overconfidence."
"Notice 3: The name of the Golden Core is for reference only. The actual combat effect is what really matters."
"Done!" Lu Yang closed the book with satisfaction.
"Let's check out the techniques at the Golden Core Stage," Lu Yang walked towards the second floor.
The first floor had books for the public as well as the Qi Refinement and Foundation Establishment Stages of all major techniques.
The continuation of the techniques and the ones for the Golden Core and Nascent Soul Stages were on the second floor.
"Mortal World Heavenly Technique", live in reality but your heart stays in tranquility. Only by fully experiencing the suffering and desires of the human world can one have a breakthrough and transform the Core into an Infant."
"I never expected to see this technique first."
"Have you seen it before?" Fairy Eternity's era didn't have concepts like worldly cultivation or hermit cultivation.
"Eldest Senior Sister told me about it. Didn't we used to see many old beggars on the streets of Great Xia? A lot of cultivators who practiced this technique will disguise themselves as old beggars and blend in. After all, being a beggar is the most efficient way to experience the suffering in the world."
"Used to? It isn't the same now?" Fairy Eternity saw the key point.
Lu Yang rolled his eyes, "With the development of Great Xia, the increase in grain production, and the establishment of welfare facilities, there are no beggars anymore. Now every old beggar you see on the streets is at the Golden Core Stage."
"I estimate that it won't be long before these Golden Core Stage people will need to find a new way to experience the secular world."
"Eldest Senior Sister said that the court is preparing to open a few mines, and let these Golden Core Stage cultivators work in there."
Fairy Eternity: "..."
"Hundred Flowers Technique". For each stage, collect thirty-three different kinds of rare flowers and when one has reached the Consummation of the Golden Core Stage, combine the ninety-nine kinds of rare flowers into a single bud. When the bud blooms, it will be the time for breaking the Core and reaching Nascent. Many female cultivators like this technique. It's simple to learn, highly aesthetic."
"However, as this technique became popular, a few types of the rare flowers have been picked to near extinction. Only one person had the last few flowers. He held an auction and sold the last few flowers for a sky-high price."
"After some time, he said he still had a few flowers and wanted to hold another auction."
"Then it happened again."
"People later found out that he was the author of this technique. He had collected all the types of flowers in advance. He would release a few every once in a while just to make money."
"Sword Path Truth. This is the technique our master practiced. Like the Qi Refinement and Foundation Establishment Stages, there are no bottlenecks to this technique as long as one continues to observe swordsmanship. It's the most suitable technique for us of the Sword Spirit Root lineage."
"I initially wanted to directly cultivate this technique as well, but unfortunately, only one person in the world can practice this technique. If the master is practicing it, I can't."
Fairy Eternity seemed to be deep in thought. Her observations of Daoist Buyu's grasp of swordsmanship didn't seem like it could stop at the door of the Transcendence Tribulation Stage.

chapters.title: Chapter 341 - 340: The Dilemma of the Fairy Eternity_1
chapters.content:
The number of different cultivation techniques stored in the Seek Dao Sect's Scripture Pavilion surpasses even those in the palace of the Great Xia Dynasty.
Diverse techniques from ancient to recent times, along with those penned by the predecessors of various masters, are housed within the Scripture Pavilion.
Here, Lu Yang even came across the "Pure Yang Method" practiced by Meng Jingzhou.
In comparison to Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou's technique was much simpler. The path ahead had already been paved for him by the Single Body Spiritual Root predecessors. As long as he advanced along this path, the Transcendance Tribulation Stage would ultimately be his destination.
However, Lu Yang was unsure whether Meng Jingzhou could break the lower limit set by the predecessors, and create a double Single Body Spiritual Root. Could the path they laid out for him still be traversed?
"Why is it so thin?" Lu Yang was puzzled. The copy of the "Pure Yang Method" he held outlined the cultivation process for the two major realms of Golden Core and Nascent Soul Stage. Even if the language was refined and meanings implicit, it shouldn't be this thin, should it?
When he opened the technique, there was only one sentence inside:
Keep going, don't break your celibacy, this is just the beginning!
Lu Yang: "..."
Indeed, it wasn't unheard of for a cultivator of the Single Body Spiritual Root to progress to Unification or even Transcendence Tribulation Stage. Compared to these predecessors, a Golden Core Stage was a mere beginning.
"So, as per your Single Body Spiritual Root lineage, you mean to say that as long as one maintains their celibacy, they can continue cultivating, right?"
Lu Yang had heard of a Single Body Spiritual Root predecessor who, having painstakingly cultivated to the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, had celebrated extravagantly. He booked every brothel in Imperial City for an entire month, single-handedly raising the consumption threshold of the city's brothels.
This was truly an act of revengeful spending.
The philosophy of Single Body Spiritual Root differed from Buddhism.
Buddhism emphasized ridding oneself of desires, seeing all beauties as ephemeral as passing clouds. Whereas, a Single Body Spiritual Root cultivator couldn't eradicate such desires; these desires would even grow with one's realm. Faced with this, they had no choice but to restrain and endure. To such an extent that they might even see a skeleton as a beauty.
Lu Yang also found a rather unique technique, the "Sacrifice Body Method". As the name suggested, it involved sacrificing oneself. The method was based on the philosophy that everything originated from nature and ultimately returns to it.
Since they all came from nature, why not return oneself to it?
Practicing this method required sacrificing a part of one's body in exchange for powerful cultivation talent and improvement in realm.
As a result, those practicing this method often turned out to be blind and mute, rendering their bodies deeply marred. Some even ended up with their bodies nearly an empty shell for the sake of sacrifice.
This method was somewhat extreme, yet it hadn't crossed over into the Demon Path.
Lu Yang had a senior brother who practiced this method.
He sacrificed his appendix during Qi Refinement, his fat during Foundation Establishment, his hair during Golden Core Stage, and his eyesight during the Nascent Soul Stage. Currently, he is a nearsighted individual wearing glasses.
"Everything comes from nature and eventually returns to it. Such a familiar argument. Time Immortal said something similar to me. He told me that everything has its time of growth and time of decline, both of which are momentary in the face of nature."
"Only by effectively imitating nature and returning to the original state can one maintain eternal strength."
"The words of Time Immortal resolved a long-standing dilemma of mine, inspiring me to write the 'Immortal Technique' and achieve immortality."
"Fairy, you are so clever, is there a problem that could even stump you?"
Upon hearing Lu Yang's praise, Fairy Eternity was overjoyed. However, she quickly reminded herself to play it cool. Even though she was pleased, she couldn't let a few compliments get to her. So, she restrained her smile and said,
"Even though I am unique and matchless throughout the ages, and even Yingtian Immortal is no match for me, I still encountered difficulties on the path to becoming an immortal."
Lu Yang nodded. Becoming immortal is the focus of cultivators. It was understandable if Fairy Eternity encountered difficulties in that regard. "So, you had difficulty in forming the Dao Fruit?"
"The difficulty was in forming which kind of Dao Fruit."
Lu Yang: "..."
"At that time, I had many choices. I could form the 'Tribulation Dao Fruit' which Yingtian Immortal formed. Or I could understand the intricacy of space and form 'Void Dao Fruit', or the 'Time Dao Fruit' similar to what Time Immortal has, but I wasn't satisfied with these Dao Fruits. I felt that these didn't truly reflect my level."
"Originally, I should have been the first to achieve immortality according to my progress, with Immortal Jiuchong and Time Immortal coming after me. However, when I encountered difficulties in choosing a Dao Fruit, I hesitated about which one to form."
"That delay, was just for a moment, really, just a moment." Fairy Eternity measured it with her thumb and forefinger, emphasizing that it was only a brief period of time.
Lu Yang didn't know how long her "moment" was. Was it a few days or months, or was it a few years?
Given Fairy Eternity's audacity to claim she was only sixteen years old, he had doubts about her perception of time.
"Then Immortal Jiuchong, Time Immortal, Yingtian Immortal, Qilin Immortal, they all became immortals one after another, leaving me behind." As she spoke, Fairy Eternity's nose wrinkled, showing her dissatisfaction with how Immortal Jiuchong and the others acted.
"When the last, Qilin Immortal, became immortal and Time Immortal spoke those words to me, I was greatly enlightened and finally formed the Eternity Dao Fruit that they all envied!"
Fairy Eternity said triumphantly, placing great pride in her Dao Fruit.
To show her gratitude for Time Immortal's enlightenment, she prepared a table of delicious dishes for him. Time Immortal was so moved that he wept bitterly, regretting his past decisions.
Lu Yang pondered. The words Time Immortal spoke contained hidden meanings. However, he was currently too weak to comprehend these secrets.
If the secrets were plainly spoken through someone else's mouth, the intended effect would greatly diminish.
He made a note of Time Immortal's words, and continued to study his skills.
Aside from the common skills available on the market, the Scripture Pavilion also offered some unique variations created by his senior brothers and sisters.
Although his senior brothers and sisters couldn't create new skills, they were still able to innovate based on existing foundations.
For example, the "Great Sun Cultivation Skill" Lu Yang was studying allowed its users to understand the sun and its inherent power. The user could form a "Great Sun Body" that could burn everything. During the day, the power of the Great Sun Body reached its peak, but it would decline when the sun set, and night fell.
A senior sister slightly modified the skill and developed the "Tai Yin Cultivation Skill". It allowed for understanding the moon and forming a "Tai Yin Body", which was as gentle as water and had strong recovery ability.
More importantly, these two skills were compatible. Users could alternate between the Great Sun Body and Tai Yin Body depending on the time of day, utilizing the Great Sun Body during the day and the Tai Yin Body at night.
This was only the first level, which can be practiced during the Golden Core Stage and the Nascent Soul Stage.
Upon reaching the second level, practitioners could simultaneously summon the Great Sun Body and Tai Yin Body, hence known as "Sun and Moon Radiance", doubling the power.
Upon reaching the third level, the Great Sun Body and Tai Yin Body merged into one, forming a new entity "Taiji Dao Transformation", which encompassed the advantages of both and balanced offense and defense.
Lu Yang was attracted to this skill. He found the skill to be terrifyingly potent.
When he was on the first floor of the Scripture Pavilion, he saw a skill called "Sun Viewing Skill". According to its summary, upon reaching the Golden Core Stage, one could learn the follow-up integration skills "Great Sun Cultivation Skill" and "Tai Yin Cultivation Skill" on the second floor.
He didn't expect back then that the follow-up integration skills would be so powerful.
"The senior sister who created this skill is very impressive, who is it?"
Lu Yang looked at the author's name: Yun Zhi.
He looked up, realizing that he had unknowingly arrived in the legendary "Yun Zhi Zone".

chapters.title: Chapter 342 - 341: Spring of Thoughts_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang had long heard of the techniques composed by Eldest Senior Sister, which attracted their own special section in the Seek Dao Sect, dedicated solely to them.
Regrettably, the techniques on the first floor of the Scripture Pavilion were of such a low grade that he'd never had the chance to see them until now.
Today, at last, he did.
"That's what I thought. No matter how gifted a Seek Dao Sect disciple is, they wouldn't be able to compile such techniques easily." Fairy Eternity evidently understood, previously considering the Seek Dao Sect's geniuses ridiculously exaggerated. The "Tai Yin Cultivation Skill" almost matched her own compiled technique.
"On this note, Eldest Senior Sister is also one of us, from the Seek Dao Sect," Lu Yang emphasized.
Even when the best performers, Dai Bufan and Ji Hongwen, were still struggling to catch up with the Elders, their contemporary, the Eldest Senior Sister, had already left the Elders far behind.
That was the difference.
In front of him, the bookshelf was filled with an array of techniques, all modified or directly compiled by Eldest Senior Sister, based on existing foundations.
"Hehe, have you been frightened by the number of techniques Yun Zhi has composed?" A sandy, aged voice resonated near Lu Yang's ear.
Lu Yang turned his head and saw a hunched old man standing beside him, appearing fairly ordinary.
"May I ask who you are...?"
"Just an idle old man enjoying his time as the custodian of the Scripture Pavilion, just call me Old Tao."
Lu Yang dared not really call him Old Tao, but secretly guessed the man was an elder or a grandmaster. Considering the special nature of the Scripture Pavilion, the likelihood was high that he belonged to the level of grandmasters.
"May I know if Elder Tao has any advice for me?"
"It's not exactly advice. Being guided by Yun Zhi, what could an old man like me show you? I just saw you wander here, and it reminded me of Yun Zhi as a child."
"Yun Zhi as a child?" Lu Yang was intrigued, his interest in learning new techniques temporarily suppressed.
Fairy Eternity also jumped out of bed with zeal, eagerly awaiting Elder Tao's stories.
"When Yun Zhi was just brought into the Sect by your master, she was not very tall, probably just this high." Elder Tao measured with his hand at his chest level. He was hunched and rather short, and Yun Zhi at that time only reached up to his chest.
"She was quiet and rather aloof; not sure if that was her natural personality or because of her life in the Secret Realm."
"Yet after entering the Scripture Pavilion, her expressions became noticeably animated."
"The child back then was still too young and had not reached the age of cultivation. Your master had her read casually in the Scripture Pavilion to build a foundation."
"That lass, absolutely engrossed with reading the techniques, furrowing her brow as she did so."
"Seeing her prettiness then, I thought she was cute, so I walked over and asked if there was something she didn't understand. If so, she could ask me. I could explain."
"She looked rather unhappy, pouted her lips and said, 'these techniques were composed in a bad way.' I asked her what was wrong, to which she shook her head like a wind-up toy, saying that she sees it but doesn't understand it. However, she felt that it was wrong."
"These techniques indeed had deficiencies, but they were not something a little girl could perceive."
"I laughed it off, undisturbed by her words. I thought she was finding it hard to comprehend the technique, which led her to stubbornly claim that it was written poorly."
"Who could have thought that in a short while, the lass would grow to heights that now anyone would find hard to reach? In particular, she has her own unique insights into techniques." Elder Tao was feeling nostalgic. Little did he expect that the little girl from that time would cultivate to such great heights.
"Work hard on your cultivation, there might come a day when you will surpass Yun Zhi!" Elder Tao gently patted Lu Yang's shoulder, entrusting him with a significant task.
"Strive hard!"
Lu Yang rose vigorously and began studying the techniques created by Eldest Senior Sister.
"'Heaven Burning and Blood Igniting Art,' a technique secluded in ancient Cave Heaven. Cultivators often enjoy lifespans far surpassing those of mortals, and aim at achieving immortality. However, this technique adopts a contrary approach, breaking through realms by burning lifespans, thus realizing rapid growth in one's cultivation level.
At critical moments, one can also temporarily burn lifespan to boost combat capabilities."
"The Task Hall mandates that each disciple must complete two tasks annually."
"In order to fulfill her duties, Yun Zhi lied about going to ancient Cave Heaven and discovering the 'Heaven Burning and Blood Igniting Art.' In reality, she created this technique. As Yun Zhi knew only limited information, she only knew this was a technique for burning lifespans in exchange for combat power.
In Yun Zhi's version of the technique, she changed the burning of one's own lifespan into the burning of others' lifespans."
"During combat, by forcefully burning the opponent's lifespan, they receive considerable combat capabilities and age quickly, dying before their powerful combat capabilities can come into play."
"'Chaos Sky Scripture', the sect-guarding technique of the Qingming Sect, zealously guarded and never transmitted to outsiders. When cultivated to perfection, one exhales chaotic fog that cannot be dispersed. Neither physical sight nor spiritual senses can survey it. Practitioners of this technique can freely move in the fog and ambush opponents within it."
"Eldest Senior Sister falsely claimed that she went to Qingming Sect and learned their sect-guarding technique, 'Chaos Sky Scripture.' She then turned in her own version of it to the Task Hall. Those who manage to cultivate this technique to perfection can form a chaos domain and suppress all techniques. All laws cease to function in the chaos domain.
Every living being within it will lose all will to resist, and there's a slight chance of cultivating the Chaos Dao Physique."
"Currently, the Qingming Sect has replaced their sect-guarding technique with the version by Eldest Senior Sister."
The more Lu Yang read, the more his scalp tingled. It would be a miracle if he surpassed Eldest Senior Sister.
However, the good news was that these techniques were not written by Yun Zhi during her Golden Core Stage. Lu Yang still has a chance.
Lu Yang stopped pondering the outside world and gradually immersed himself in various techniques - the ones from Eldest Senior Sister, from his Sect's seniors, and from the circulating market…
He began to comprehend the mentality of the technique composers, delving into the purpose of each step, engrossed in his reading and forgetting all else.
After about half a month, Lu Yang awoke from his immersion in various techniques. He suddenly remembered that he came to continue writing techniques.
"Let's start writing!"
Lu Yang scratched the back of his head. He had read so many techniques and was brimming with knowledge, believing he had great potential in the path of techniques. But when he picked up his brush to start writing, he found himself at a loss for words.
"Why do I feel like I've learned everything when reading the techniques?"
Lu Yang started writing with determination while Fairy Eternity watched in silence, without uttering a word.
Speaking now would indeed hinder Lu Yang.
After pondering and deliberating for a long time, he finally hit upon some ideas and began writing his technique.
"Yes, that's just the way it is!"
Hemingway-like, his pen danced over paper. And his ideas flowed from the techniques he had been studying, feeling like he had fully understood and integrated them, and was now innovating on their basis, continuously expressing the abundant ideas from his mind on paper.
"Yes, I should write so!"
Now he only wished he could write faster as his thoughts kept flowing too rapidly to follow.
After two days, the Golden Core Chapter of the "Mind Seeing Method" was completed. He made additional tweaks, refining the technique and honing the accuracy of vocabulary.
"I did it!"
He immediately left the Scripture Pavilion for Sky Gate Mountain to submit the final draft to Eldest Senior Sister.
Having read the work, Eldest Senior Sister nodded slightly, praising:
"Good, only eighty percent of the content requires minor changes this time."

chapters.title: Chapter 343 - 342 Great Progress_1
chapters.content:
When Lu Yang found out that the things he'd painstakingly written were 20% approved by Eldest Senior Sister, he was quite thrilled.
Being affirmed by Eldest Senior Sister, even though only 20%, was a rare and precious accomplishment. It was a good start.
It was a massive improvement from the last time when his work was entirely rejected.
His efforts of scrapping sleep to study intensively in the Scripture Pavilion for nearly a half-month, followed by two and more days of rack-your-brain writings, weren't in vain.
If this time Eldest Senior Sister affirmed 20%, the next time it might be 40%. It won't be long before he could produce a technique on par with Eldest Senior Sister.
The future was bright!
But when Lu Yang was about to modestly express that he still needed to work harder, he heard Eldest Senior Sister continue to say:
"The two portions you quoted were what I wrote, so I won't change them."
Lu Yang: "..."
Eldest Senior Sister, could you please not leave me hanging the next time you speak?
Inside the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity was laughing so hard she was rolling on the bed, even tears came out from her laughter.
Seeing Junior Brother obviously disappointed, Yun Zhi comforted him, saying, "It's very good, at least you can correctly quote my sentences."
Lu Yang didn't feel comforted at all.
Seeing that Junior Brother was still feeling down, Yun Zhi realized that she might not be good at comforting people.
When she emerged victorious against all competitors and became the indisputable champion at the Five Great Immortal Sects competition, to knock her down a peg, the Sect Leaders used the pretext of offering advice to her.
The result was needless to say; the ones who were lectured were the leaders of the Five Great Immortal Sects, whom Yun Zhi soundly defeated.
The leaders, feeling humiliated at being defeated by a junior, looked frustrated.
Seeing their somber moods, Yun Zhi comforted them, saying, "It's just that my realm is a bit higher than yours. If I scaled down to your level, I wouldn't be able to defeat you in one move."
The leaders' faces grew even more gloomy.
Daoist Buyu, seeing the leaders being embarrassed, gloated by the side.
As her master, he naturally knew his excellent disciple's Cultivation Level. She was simply unbeatable. No matter who it was, they'd lose.
The leaders glared at Daoist Buyu. They couldn't defeat the disciple, nor could they beat the master?
They all came forward and ganged up against Daoist Buyu.
In a one-on-one fight, Daoist Buyu feared no one. But who would go for a one-on-one when they could gang up?
The Immortal Sect competition ended with Daoist Buyu battered and bruised.
"Your understanding of cultivation techniques is not yet thorough, so you inevitably mimic other people's methods. But actually, those others' understandings aren't that thorough either. They think they know everything, but they're still in a half-understanding state."
"At the beginning of your cultivation, I already mentioned, 'Mind Seeing Method,' whose theme you came up with, was a great choice."
"Cultivators should not only focus on the realm but also the mindset. Upon reaching the Golden Core Stage, one might encounter the Inner Demon Tribulation, a major hurdle for cultivators."
"Demons are born from the heart, attacking inwardly, making them hard to defend against. Many cultivators are stuck at this stage, their cultivation stagnating."
"Why are there inner demons? Probably because there isn't a clear standard for judgment in their hearts. When faced with a choice, and they chose one side, they keep thinking about the possibilities of the other side."
"If a girlfriend and a mother fall into a river at the same time, and the chooser struggles to decide whom to save, this indicates a lack of clear criteria. If he saves the mother and then the girlfriend drowns, he will regret it. This situation creates material for a heart demon tribulation."
"Cultivating 'Mind Seeing Method' will help you understand your heart, free from the trouble of Inner Demon Tribulation."
Previously, Yun Zhi said Liu Yang's choice of technique was good, but she didn't explain why. Now, seeing Liu Yang's golden core formation, a great figure in the outside world, she revealed this idea to him.
Upon hearing about this topic, Fairy Eternity also began to explain to Lu Yang, putting it bluntly, "In simple terms, all you need is a healthy, positive, and uplifting heart."
"If you have no worries or desires, where would the Inner Demon Tribulation come from?"
Lu Yang silently glanced at Fairy Eternity, thinking that she didn't look like the type to have inner demons.
"I'll revise your technique for you. Once I'm done, I'll let you know." Leaving these words, Eldest Senior Sister turned and walked into her abode.
After Eldest Senior Sister left, the puppet stuck its head out, sizing up Lu Yang from head to toe, shaking its head as if it wasn't satisfied with Lu Yang's cultivation progress.
"Hey, you again!"
The puppet had been a vital part of Lu Yang's cultivation journey. Since the beginning of his cultivation, the puppet had been ordered by Eldest Senior Sister to spur on his cultivation progress. In those days, Lu Yang was tormented by the puppet in the daytime, and at night, he had nightmares about the Mighty Tofu Lord. He led a very miserable life.
In the past, Lu Yang, who was in the Foundation Establishment stage, was helpless against the puppet. However, now he is a Great Power in the Golden Core stage, comparable to the Nascent Soul Stage, considered patriarchs of influential families and worshipped by others in the outside world.
Lu Yang knew that the puppet could talk, but it didn't because it didn't bother speaking to him.
"I am not what I used to be, watch how I defeat you today!"
Lu Yang was full of battle spirit, thinking he was invincible in the world, just a mere puppet, he could easily defeat it with a backhand!
The puppet provocatively gestured Lu Yang to come over.
Just as Lu Yang was preparing to make a move, Invincible Elixir issued a warning.
"This is an opponent you can't defeat. To maintain your winning rate, you can choose to run away or commit suicide."
Lu Yang: "..."
"Fairy, what kind of Invincible Elixir is this? Since I've formed a golden core, I haven't even used it to defeat an opponent once!"
The only victory Lu Yang had since forming a golden core was the fight against Tao Yaoye, in which the Invincible Elixir recommended using Lu's Arhat Fist.
Fairy Eternity shrugged, "You can't blame me for this. Back then, I could defeat anyone at will with the help of Invincible Elixir, either at Foundation Establishment or Golden Core Stage, including Yingtian Immortal. No one could defeat me."
"Not like you, if it's not someone in the Unification stage, then they are your Senior Brothers and Sisters."
Lu Yang felt being in a supreme sect wasn't necessarily a good thing.
If he was in an ordinary sect, when Senior Brothers and Sisters looked down on him, bullied him because of his poor background and laughed at his lack of sect influence, Lu Yang could publicly, with the early stage Golden Core cultivation, defeat Senior Brothers and Sisters of late stage Golden Core.
This would cause a sensation among the sect elders and leaders who would try to make him a core disciple.
However, this couldn't happen in the Seek Dao Sect.
There was something Fairy Eternity did not tell Lu Yang, that the confidence given to him by Invincible Elixir just now, leading him to believe that he could defeat the puppet, was nullified by the warning from Invincible Elixir that he wouldn't defeat the puppet.
The positive and negative effects neutralized each other.
"It's not a big deal." Fairy Eternity muttered to herself.
Seeing that Lu Yang did not accept the challenge, the puppet took the initiative to attack. Lu Yang immediately turned and ran.
If he knew he couldn't win, only a fool would fight.
He didn't know what level the puppet was, but its speed was just a notch higher than Lu Yang's, Lu Yang couldn't outrun the puppet no matter how hard he tried.
Just as Lu Yang was about to give up, Invincible Elixir whirled madly, mobilizing Lu Yang's spiritual essence and speeding him up.
"Wait, this Invincible Elixir is of no use in battle, but how come it's so responsive when I'm trying to escape?"

chapters.title: Chapter 344 - 343 New Usage of Illusion Technique_1
chapters.content:
With the help of Invincible Elixir, Lu Yang managed to escape from the puppet's clutches without a hitch.
The puppet ceased its pursuit the moment Lu Yang stepped out of Sky Gate Mountain, and stood at a distance watching as Lu Yang disappeared into the distance.
"Good thing the puppet can't leave the mountain," Lu Yang let out a breath of relief. He had noticed earlier that the puppet had a limited range of movement and couldn't leave Sky Gate Mountain.
"Senior Brother Lu, why did you run so fast? Is there any danger on Sky Gate Mountain?" Tao Yaoye's voice echoed from behind Lu Yang.
How could there be any danger when the Eldest Senior Sister was on Sky Gate Mountain?
"No... nothing. It's just that I haven't been running for a while. Just stretching my legs," Lu Yang couldn't let her know he had been chased by a puppet. It would be too embarrassing to say it out loud.
"Are you free now? I've had some new ideas about illusions and I wanted to discuss them with you."
Lu Yang thought for a moment. Sure, he had some free time. "Sure, let's go to Dust Free Peak?"
While on their way to Dust Free Peak, Lu Yang casually asked, "Do you have any new ideas on illusions?"
"Yes, it's an idea inspired by the Unification that you, Junior Brother Meng, and Junior Brother Man performed a while ago. If you willingly accepted my illusion, it got me thinking. Can illusions be used in places other than battles?"
"That's an interesting perspective. Go on?"
"The hardest part of casting illusions is to make the opponent succumb to the illusion, why not try it differently? Are there situations where the opponent voluntarily succumbs to the illusion?"
Lu Yang contemplated. He had never thought about this before, but he felt that he had grasped the meaning Junior Sister Tao wanted to express.
He followed Tao Yaoye's line of thought and said, "For people to willingly fall under an illusion, it has to be safe and comfortable."
"Ensuring safety so that it is not used in battle is the most basic guarantee. Making it comfortable is the precondition for the voluntary acceptance of the illusion."
"One characteristic of illusions is that they immerse people in the experience. Suppose they enjoy a treatment that they can't experience in reality, they would willingly succumb."
"So are you suggesting, Junior Sister Tao, to let them see scenes they can't normally see like...?" Lu Yang incredulously looked at Tao Yaoye. He hadn't expected that Tao Yaoye, who looked so young and naive, would come up with something only a man would think of.
Tao Yaoye nodded delightfully, feeling proud that the most quick-witted Senior Brother Lu understood her so quickly.
"Yes, let them see the Cultivators in battle!"
Lu Yang: "..."
I'm sorry. That was my misinterpretation. I need to reflect.
Tao Yaoye said excitedly: "I'm not talking about lower-grade Cultivators in battle; their battles are quite common.
But it's rare to see Golden Core Stage Cultivators fighting, especially as Golden Core Stage Cultivators can fly through the air, their spiritual essence is much more abundant than those at the Foundation Establishment Stage, they can perform countless more magic skills, it's very enjoyable to watch!"
"Ordinary people and low-level cultivators never get the chance to see fights among Golden Core Stage or higher cultivators. But if we use illusions to let them witness these battles, I'm sure they would be more than happy!"
"Of course, I'm not doing this out of charity. It's a paid service."
She's planning to earn money from this.
"What I'm considering now is whether to introduce some storylines into these battles. If the battles just start out of the blue, won't it seem too abrupt? Should I incorporate some plot?"
The two had reached the entrance of Tao Yaoye's Abode on the Dust Free Peak.
Tao Yaoye looked extremely excited, "I'll give you a demonstration. Don't resist."
"Okay."
Tao Yaoye unfolded her red paper umbrella, held it in front of her body, and gently shook it twice in front of Lu Yang. Lu Yang felt dizzy for a moment, and when he regained his consciousness, he found himself in the midst of endless mountains.
He sensed something and looked up to see two human figures standing in the air, both clad in similar clothing, seemingly brothers.
One of them was shedding tears, his voice trembling slightly, "Seniior Brother, tell me, why did you kill our master? Why did you kill your favorite Junior Sister, and other brothers and sisters? Why!"
The other man let out a wild laugh, his body radiating a chilling dark aura, "Hahaha, why? You'll have to ask the Master! Ask yourself!"
"Me?" The younger brother was taken aback, not understanding what his senior brother meant.
"I was the first one to join the Sect, worked tirelessly day in and day out, just so one day I could take over the mantle from the Master. Even when younger brothers and sisters joined later, I didn't care, none of them were as talented as me!"
"But it all changed when you came. The Master wanted to make you the head of the Sect!"
"When I confronted him about it, the Master said I was impatient and short-sighted, and you were the most suitable person to inherit his mantle!"
"I was livid. How could all my efforts over the years be seen as impatience in his eyes! I was so angry that I killed him. The younger sister saw it all and she screamed in terror, attracting other people's attention. To silence them, I had to kill them too!"
"Junior Brother, now that you know everything, you must die too! Your Cultivation Level is way below mine, it is best for you to surrender willingly!"
A golden fog rose from the junior brother, creating an aura that faintly contested the senior brother's.
The senior brother paled with shock, "How is this possible? You're only supposed to be at the early Golden Core Stage. How can you be at the same late stage as I am?"
The junior brother was brimming with coldness. He remembered the scene of dead bodies lying all over when he rushed to the Sect, remembered the Master on his last breath transferring all his skills to him, remembered the younger sister slowly dying in his arms.
The mastermind behind all of these atrocities must die!
The senior brother suddenly realized something, his face twisted with madness, "I understand now! That old man gave all of his skills to you! I knew he was biased towards you!"
Having received the Sect's lineage, the junior brother wielded two magic artifacts. He twitched the scissors in his hands, which turned into two golden Flood Dragons, lunging at the senior brother, snapping their jaws.
A large ghost claw emerged from the senior brother's back, suppressing the two golden Flood Dragons.
The junior brother opened a jade bottle, from which a yellow sandstorm gushed out like a tidal wave, rushing towards the senior brother. The senior brother shouted, took out the wide knife from his waist, waved a knife aura and divided the sandstorm into two.
A fierce battle ensued between the two, magic artifacts, magic skills, and calculations were displayed one after another. It was so dazzling that the viewers could not resist the urge to join in.
