All of a sudden, the scene turned into a landscape painting, then submerged in water, the ink was diluted, and everything disappeared. When Lu Yang came back to his senses, Tao Yaoye was standing in front of him with her red paper umbrella, smiling at him.
"Senior Brother Lu, how was it? How did it feel? I tried adding some plot, is it better than just plain fighting?'
Lu Yang was silent for a while, his mind filled with criticism, not knowing where to start.
Isn't this just like a movie?
A movie with fully immersive technology, no less!
There's no need to mention the battle scenes, it was just like the real thing. The plot was a bit thin, but that didn't matter. This was just the beginning, the plot could always be enriched later.
If this was released in his past life, it would cause a sensation. No special effects could compete with this.
"Great idea."
Lu Yang sighed, believing that once this idea was fleshed out and introduced to the general public, it would definitely make a fortune!

chapters.title: Chapter 345 - 344: Eighth Elder_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang estimated that if Tao Yaoye joined the Nine Nether sect, the Master of Nine Nether sect would likely treat her like a saint or directly make her the Master.
This method of making money is much faster than Qin Haoran's lending, and it wouldn't be an exaggeration to say it was a goldmine.
There's no investment involved, so there's no need to worry about losing any capital.
No need to hire actors, nor to shoot dozens of times, any illusion can be created at will, and needless to say, the special effects, they are as real as it gets.
If you're subjected to an illusion technique during a fight, and you die in the illusion, then you really die. The illusionary world created by an illusion technique is even more real than reality.
There is also no need to worry about the plot. The events that happen in the Cultivation World every day can be used as material and with a little dramatization, it could turn into a movie, and if the plot is too long, it can be turned into a tv series.
Without going too far, Master's storytelling of "Legend of the Dao Sect" could be used as a movie.
"It's a great idea, but there are areas that need improvement."
After some contemplation, Lu Yang pointed out the shortcomings of Tao Yaoye's illusion technique.
"You realized that fighting techniques alone are not enough to attract people. Adding short plots is a good idea, but it's still not enough."
"An interesting plot should give people an exhilarating feeling, leaving a lasting impression after it ends, there should be foreshadowing and plot twists."
"Mmmm." Tao Yaoye kept nodding, Senior Brother was worthy of the name, he caught on fast, and was quick in his thinking.
"Currently, the plot is minor compared to how we are going to cast the illusion."
Tao Yaoye was puzzled and confused: "But I can cast illusions myself."
Lu Yang shook his head: "Of course you can cast it, but you can't be casting illusions everywhere, you'll tire yourself out."
"As you said, if you want to make money this way, you will need to popularize it. To popularize it, you will need a more convenient way of casting illusions."
"For example, talismans."
"If my memory serves me, talismans are the most common carriers of illusion techniques."
Tao Yaoye thought about who she could ask for advice: "When it comes to talismans...
The Sect Leader is skilled in sword techniques, the Grand Elder in dream-making, the second elder in array methods, the third elder in body refinement, the fourth elder in the Confucianism Path, the fifth elder in refining, Master in cultivating immortal bodies, the seventh elder in refining pills, the eighth elder in swindling."
"It seems that none of the elders are skilled in this. Should we ask other senior brothers and sisters for help?"
Lu Yang paused for a second, then couldn't help but ask, "...Is it possible that apart from swindling, the Eighth Elder is also good at talismans?"
Despite the rumors that when Daoist Buyu joined the sect, he was brought up by the Eighth Elder, laying a solid foundation for Daoist Buyu to grow skewed.
Despite the time nine hundred years ago when the Eighth Elder scammed the Nine Nether sect until their treasury was emptied, leading the previous Master to commit suicide.
Despite the real questions that the Eighth Elder sold to Meng Jingzhou twenty years ago.
Despite the Fifth Elder adamantly not letting talisman cultivator Qin Yanyan learn talismans from the Eighth Elder for fear she might learn wrongly.
But it can't be denied that the Eighth Elder is indeed a master of talismans.
"Discuss with the Eighth Elder, but to be on the safe side, it's better to involve the Sixth Elder as well." Lu Yang cautiously suggested, receiving agreement from Tao Yaoye.
...
At the top of the Dust-Free Peak, the breathtakingly beautiful Sixth Elder sat cross-legged. Under the influence of the Pure Immortal Body, the surrounding area became a vacuum zone.
She tried to confine the area of the Immortal Body's influence. She found that the smaller the area, the stronger the repulsion. The best state is to let the realm of the Immortal Body adhere to the body surface, a thin layer. In this way, any attack can be resisted.
However, from the records, none of the past Pure Immortal Bodies have been able to achieve this state.
She sensed someone approaching from a distance, opened her beautiful eyes, and saw Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye.
"What brings you two here?" She asked them through her divine sense.
"Sorry for interrupting Master's cultivation. The thing is, I have some new thoughts on illusion techniques recently..." Tao Yaoye explained in detail about her discussion with Lu Yang.
"The idea is good, and considering Old Eighth's level at talismans, it should be easy for him to do." The Sixth Elder also realized the business opportunity in Tao Yaoye's idea and felt a touch of pride.
Tao Yaoye's idea could make more money than the Ninth Junior Brother's "Wish Granting Technique: Local Version".
Look at that, this is the good disciple I taught!
"Let's go, I'll take you to him." The Sixth Elder raised her hand and an odd energy enveloped Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye, taking them from the top of Dust-Free Peak directly to the nearby Rune Peak.
Rune Peak was the mountain under the Eighth Elder's control.
The three of them landed. It was the first time that Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye visited Rune Peak. They found that there were runes everywhere, even on the leaves there were rune marks, the various plants made forms that looked like talismans.
"Old Eight, come out, I need your help!" The Sixth Elder sent a message to the Eighth Elder.
"Sister is looking for me?" The Eighth Elder walked out of his abode with a surprised expression. In his impression, Sister Six rarely asks for his help.
"Has someone tried to swindle you, sister, and you need me to swindle it back? I'm afraid this may not work out, I haven't left the mountain to fool people for dozens of years."
Lu Yang thought to himself, have you forgotten that you just swindled Meng Jingzhou a year and a half ago?
Tao Yaoye, not knowing of this, thought that the Eighth Elder had retired from swindling.
"However, rest assured, anyone who dares to swindle you, even if I don't leave the mountain, I can send my disciples to swindle him till he doesn't even have his underpants left!"
"I'm not like Ninth Junior Brother, I've been swindling for so many years, and I've never been caught!"
"Same goes for the disciples I've taught. They're all reliable and won't get caught by the officials!" The Eighth Elder assured confidently, highlighting his deep bond as a fellow disciple. When he was younger, he was taken care of by the Sixth Elder.
Lu Yang respected him, who would have thought that the Eighth Elder's swindling skills were so advanced that he was never caught; even Master couldn't match this!
It's well known that Master could trick the Minister of Justice into jail.
It's estimated that Master hasn't been released yet.
Lu Yang had heard from Meng Jingzhou that ever since the Minister of Justice was put into jail in Goose County, the Ministry of Punishments moved their office to Goose County and safety there became unprecedentedly stable, without a single criminal case occurring.
The bad guys weren't stupid, they'd clearly avoid committing a crime under the noses of the Ministry of Punishments.
They weren't Daoist Buyu after all.
However, there were also consequences. Lu Yang heard from Meng Jingzhou that even for officials on leave, would visit the jail cell in Goose County for curiosity's sake.
Under the guise of caring for their colleague.
While suggesting to the County Magistrate of Goose county to sentence Daoist Buyu to death.
The Sixth Elder gave the Eighth Elder a look, having been senior and junior for two thousand years, she knew exactly what kind of person the Eighth Elder was.
"Yes, indeed, you've never been caught. You always surrender yourself, arguing that it can mitigate the punishment."
"And also, don't think I don't know why you don't leave the sect, aren't you waiting for the statute of limitations to pass?"
According to the Great Xia's criminal law, if the time for the statute of limitations for a crime has passed, the criminal will no longer be held accountable for their crimes.

chapters.title: Chapter 346 - 345 - Even the Eldest Senior Sister is no match for me! _1
chapters.content:
"Well, you can't put it that way, I'm just capitalizing on the legal provisions," Eighth Elder declared confidently.
"Besides, I never anticipated that they would rather expose themselves as independent cultivators from the Demon Path than report me to the government office!"
Lu Yang was curious about how Eighth Elder had deceived them, making them disregard their Demon Path identity to report to the government.
Normally, cultivators from the Demon Path fear government offices the most.
Sixth Elder didn't dwell on this issue, "That's enough, I didn't come to discuss who you swindled. I have a task related to talismans and I need your help."
Tao Yaoye looked innocently at Lu Yang, who understood what she meant with her gaze:
See? Can't blame me for viewing Eighth Elder as a fraudster, he admits to being a deceiver the moment we meet.
"Should've said so earlier! I'm an expert in talismans!" Eighth Elder laughed heartily, attesting to his accomplishments in talismans.
"Whether it's offensive or defensive talismans, however many you need, just say the word! All I need to do is make them!"
"Creating talismans of Pass Tribulation level and Semi-Immortal level might be challenging, but I can handle Unification level talismans."
Sixth Elder shook his head, "No need for such high-level talismans. My disciple has an idea for which we need your talisman expertise."
Eighth Elder looked at Tao Yaoye with interest, "Let's hear it?"
Tao Yaoye went on to recount her conversation with Lu Yang.
Eighth Elder listened with sparkling eyes, appreciating Tao Yaoye more and more, "What a novel idea! How about becoming my disciple?"
"You didn't seem to dwell on your Feather Transformation Immortal Body research, I suppose you don't want to develop it. Might as well stop affiliating with your Senior Sister, your illusion technique is perfect for swindling folks with me."
Such individuals with active minds were suited for training under him.
He knew Lu Yang had an agile mind too, but he didn't have the nerve to snatch him from Yun Zhi.
Tao Yaoye almost jumped in fright, she quickly swore to herself that she will delve into Feather Transformation Immortal Body research as soon as she got back, just to avoid the day her Master decides she should train under Eighth Elder.
"That's enough, Sixth Junior Brother. Stop scaring her. Let's talk about talismans. Can you make it?"
Eighth Elder stroked his chin and chuckled, "Senior Sister, it seems you underestimate me! Making such a talisman isn't difficult at all, I could do it easily."
Lu Yang added two more requirements, "It needs to be mass-produced, and it should be inexpensive."
"It should not harm ordinary people."
Superior illusion techniques can confuse ordinary people so much that they struggle to distinguish between illusion and reality even after escaping the illusion.
Eighth Elder looked troubled, "The no-harm rule is simple, mass production though might be tricky."
"I wonder if you understand talismans, they've never been successfully mass-produced. Even the most basic Great Strength Talisman is like this."
"I, along with a few friends who also study talismans, investigated this issue. Our initial idea was to print talismans using engraving methods, like silver banknotes. This way, talisman prices would drop significantly."
Those who could discuss talismans with Eighth Elder undoubtedly had an unparalleled understanding of it.
"Later, we discovered that this method wasn't feasible. When drawing a talisman, each stroke must be filled with the essence of one's spiritual energy. This hurdle alone deters most cultivators who want to become talisman experts. Furthermore, to print talismans using engraving methods requires us to infuse our spiritual essence into the engraving gaps."
"Not to say that no talisman experts can achieve it, but the few that can are far from enough for large-scale production."
"We tried using puppetry to create talismans, but puppets lack the spiritual energy necessary for talisman creation."
"In short, all our attempts were unsuccessful, so the idea was shelved."
"Martial Niece Tao's illusion lasts between half an hour to an hour. This is considered a large-scale illusion which advanced talismans can create but they can't be mass-produced."
Lu Yang fell into deep thought. He didn't know much about talismans before, so he wasn't expecting these difficulties. Suddenly he came up with a solution, "From what I recall, array methods can also induce illusions, right? What if we combine talismans with array methods?"
Eighth Elder nodded in surprise. After calculating, he found that this approach seemed feasible.
"Good idea! By simplifying both the talisman and the array method to Qi Refinement level and then combining them, it can be achieved!"
"After simplification, even Qi Refinement Cultivators could produce Array Method!"
"I'm not proficient in Array Method, so I need to consult with the Second Brother. You guys go back and wait, we'll let you know when we have our conclusion!" The Eighth Elder decided to do so and sped towards the medicinal field.
Just then, Lu Yang heard Eldest Senior Sister's transmission.
"Come back, the method has been transcribed."
Overjoyed, Lu Yang noted Eldest Senior Sister's efficiency in transcription remained consistent. It has been less than half a day, and it's done.
Lu Yang cautiously approached the foot of Sky Gate Mountain, confirming that the puppet wasn't blocking his way before he relievedly ascended the mountain.
All the way up, Lu Yang was wary of a puppet ambush, however, luckily, the journey was smooth, and the puppet didn't cause him any trouble.
Reaching the summit of Sky Gate Mountain, Eldest Senior Sister was quietly sitting at the stone table sipping tea. The puppet obediently poured tea for her, its demeanor was unlike how it treated Lu Yang.
On the stone table, lay a brand-new method book titled 'Mind Seeing Method' - Golden Core Chapter.
"Try practicing it. I've adjusted some parts based on the method you wrote."
Lu Yang was ecstatic, indeed, Eldest Senior Sister deserved her reputation, she was much more reliable than Fairy Eternity. Fairy Eternity constantly urged him to Play Dead Technique, unlike Eldest Senior Sister, who wrote methods for him.
The character of the handwriting reflected the writer, Eldest Senior Sister's handwriting was like her - neat, beautiful, and cold.
Since it was written based on Lu Yang's ideas, he quickly picked it up. After carefully reading it twice, he committed it to memory and initiated circulation.
Lu Yang concentrated on a stream of spiritual energy according to the theory in the method and under his control, let this spiritual energy circulate in his body in a regular manner.
He quickly completed a circulation, which indicates that Lu Yang has mastered the basics of the method.
With pride, Lu Yang remarked, "I'm indeed a rare genius in history. I'm the strongest entity!"
Lu Yang felt that cultivation came naturally to him, no one could match his talents.
His gaze fell on Eldest Senior Sister, who was carefully savoring her tea.
Even Eldest Senior Sister is no match for him!
"Wait, this is wrong!" Lu Yang suddenly reacted, no matter how dull he was, he realized there was a problem.
How reckless was he to arrive at the ludicrous conclusion that "Eldest Senior Sister is no match for me?"
"It's the Invincible Elixir, it gave me invincible confidence, but I've always been able to suppress it logically. The Mind Seeing Method amplifies my confidence from Invincible Elixir, making me feel invincible!"
Lu Yang's body moved uncontrollably towards Eldest Senior Sister despite Invincible Elixir's relentless warnings against this move.
"Please commit suicide immediately to maintain a 100% win rate."
"Please commit suicide immediately to maintain a 100% win rate."
Invincible Elixir incessantly requested Lu Yang to maintain a 100% win rate.
Eldest Senior Sister raised her eyelids, realizing that she forgot this feature of the Invincible Elixir while writing the method.
Fortunately, Lu Yang was no stranger to challenges and reacted quickly in crisis.
"Spill Beans into Soldiers!"
Lu Yang handed over the control of his body to Fairy Eternity, who was observing from the sidelines.
"Eh? Eh??"
Fairy Eternity was taken aback, she was merely an observer and unexpectedly got caught up in the situation.
She controlled Lu Yang's uncontrolled body, attacked Eldest Senior Sister, and was flicked off by Eldest Senior Sister's finger.
Lu Yang successfully maintained his undefeated record.

chapters.title: Chapter 347 - 346 Qingzhou Grand Ceremony_1
chapters.content:
Fairy Eternity was flicked away by Eldest Senior Sister, hanging upside down on a nearby tree bough, her body swaying back and forth.
"Lu Yang, you disrespect Immortals!" Fairy Eternity rebuked angrily, having been struck by an unforeseen disaster for no apparent reason — the epitome of an innocent victim.
When she was ruling supreme in ancient times, who would dare treat her like this?
With a respectful attitude, Lu Yang said, "It's not that I disrespect the Fairy, rather, I just conceived invincible elixir and am not yet familiar with it. Earlier, I was hoping the Fairy could show me how to use it."
"Thanks to the Fairy's demonstration just now, I already know how to use this Invincible Elixir."
"Really?" Fairy Eternity looked suspiciously at Lu Yang, feeling that something was wrong.
"I'm just a mortal, how could I dare to deceive a Fairy?"
"I see."
Fairy Eternity, thinking herself magnanimous, decided not to probe any further.
The puppet hopped up and picked Lu Yang, who was hanging from the tree bough, by the collar. It was as if she's carrying a mischievous cat.
Eldest Senior Sister laid two fingers on Lu Yang's wrist, diagnosing like a physician. With an almost imperceptible nod of her head, she said: "I see. I have considered prematurely. When designing the technique, I forgot the side effect of Invincible Elixir which could make you overconfident.
The training method made you extra confident, causing you to lose the ability for normal thought and physical control."
She stooped to pick up the ritual that had fallen on the ground. The ritual automatically ignited, leaving no trace behind. It was as if it had never existed.
"I'll modify it. Wait a moment."
Eldest Senior Sister sat beside the stone table, tore through the space, and took out a book without any words from the space.
After a moment of thought, she knew how to modify it. Her pen moved swiftly.
It did not take long before a new version of "Mind Seeing Method" - Golden Core Chapter was complete.
"Here, try again."
Lu Yang took the ritual. Just a few words had changed compared to the previous one.
Can that suppress the impulse of the Invincible Elixir?
Lu Yang circulated one complete cycle as before, and then sneakily glanced at his meditating Eldest Senior Sister, and breathed a sigh of relief.
This time, there's no impulse to strike Eldest Senior Sister.
Lu Yang began meditating, feeling the changes brought by the ritual.
The biggest change was a clear mind. The ritual had pointed out his advancement path; all he needed to do was follow the course of the ritual.
His previous training was purely about accumulating mana without any advancement in realm. Now, with the new ritual, the mana accumulated previously came in use, enhancing him from the initial stage of Golden Core to the beginning of Golden Core.
This sounded like a standstill, but there was no substantial change.
The second change dealt with his Spiritual Sense and Spiritual Space – with the range of his Spiritual Sense expanding slightly, and his Spiritual Space also becoming a bit larger. Originally, the bed of Fairy Eternity was against the wall, i.e., the boundary of the Spiritual Space. Now, the bed of the Fairy was about two steps away from the boundary of the Spiritual Space.
Fairy Eternity also realized this. She pushed her bed back against the boundary of the Spiritual Space.
She enjoyed lying on the bed with her back against the wall and her little feet kicking the wall. She found it very comfortable.
"Is Lu Yang there?" Meng Jingzhou called softly from uphill.
Given his carefree nature, he usually shouted when looking for someone.
But this was Sky Gate Mountain, home not only to Lu Yang but also the terrifying Eldest Senior Sister. Even if Meng Jingzhou had eight times the courage, he wouldn't dare to raise his voice on Sky Gate Mountain.
"Eldest Senior Sister, are you here?" When Meng Jingzhou saw Eldest Senior Sister with her eyes closed, leaning against a tree, he bowed slightly.
Eldest Senior Sister uttered a soft "mmm", she had known since the moment Meng Jingzhou set foot on Sky Gate Mountain.
"What do you need me for?"
Meng Jingzhou spoke, holding an air of mystery, "Of course, something nice! Have you heard about the Qingzhou Grand Festival? It's about to begin."
Lacking extensive knowledge about frequent events in the Great Xia Dynasty, Lu Yang wasn't too informed about this: "What's the Qingzhou Grand Festival?"
"It's a festival held for cultivators. Under the lead of Qingzhou government office and several first class sects, it is held annually at the beginning of August. It has various events such as competitions, auctions; it's quite lively. The main purpose is to attract young cultivators to stay in Qingzhou. Therefore, many participants are around our age."
Lu Yang's eyes lit up. He rarely interacted with peers; this was a great opportunity.
"I'm in! By the way, is this the same Qingzhou where, two thousand years ago, the Qingzhou provincial governor moved a neighboring city over there by claiming it was a magical duel, just like what the Fifth Elder mentioned?"
"Yes, that's the Qingzhou."
Eldest Senior Sister, who had been meditating all this time, slowly opened her eyes, revealing a hint of curiosity: "The Fifth Elder told you about the Qingzhou provincial governor?"
"Eldest Senior Sister, you know about this too?"
"Of course, I do. After all, that Qingzhou provincial governor was our Grandmaster."
Lu Yang: "..."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
For some reason, neither of them was surprised by this fact.
Indeed, it was in line with the Seek Dao Sect's style – logical but outrageous.
"Since you know about the Qingzhou provincial governor, it's fine. But don't spread it outside. It'll ruin the reputation of our Seek Dao Sect," warned the Eldest Senior Sister; she deeply cherished the sect's reputation.
However, she did not know what the outside world thought of the Seek Dao Sect.
Meng Jingzhou curiously asked, "Eldest Senior Sister, what happened to that provincial governor later on?"
"Later on, he proceeded to develop Qingzhou systematically. The Qingzhou Grand Festival is his idea; the festival attracts many talented cultivators, and the result is outstanding, thus other provincial governors followed suit. Under his governance, Qingzhou became more and more prosperous. Once his great deeds were accomplished, he retired and returned to the sect."
Lu Yang realized a problem: "Wait a minute, are the people of our Five Great Immortal Sects allowed to become government officials?"
He had assumed that due to the high positions and power of the Five Great Immortal Sects, the Great Xia Kingdom, out of fear, suspicion, etc., would not allow the members of the Five Great Immortal Sects to hold official positions.
"Naturally."
Meng Jingzhou gave Lu Yang an example: "The court is so thirsty for talent. Where are the most talented people? Of course, it's from the Five Great Immortal Sects. The court has even invited Suspension Temple to preside as the government office. As long as the latter agrees, they would be appointed as prime minister, but they simply refuse."
"The court has also invited the Sect Master of the Prison Suppressing Sect, but they refused as well."
"For young talents like us to serve in the government, the court would be more than accepting. But unlike the head of Suspension Temple, if we want to hold a government office, we need to pass the Imperial Examination."
Eldest Senior Sister reminded, "Lu Yang, you are forbidden from participating in the Imperial Examination or hold any public office."
Lu Yang was taken aback: "Why?"
He didn't have the intention to become a government official, but he should at least have the opportunity, right?
"Because of our Master."
Lu Yang instantly understood, given his intelligence, he grasped the connection once it was hinted. The Seek Dao Sect was not considered one of the Five Great Immortal Sects twenty thousand years ago. The sect has evolved today, undoubtedly crowned as the number one Immortal Sect.
The court was apprehensive of Seek Dao Sect becoming overly powerful and did not permit the pupils of Seek Dao Sect, or particularly, direct pupils of the Sect Leader, to hold an official position. This was done in fear of links being formed between court and land, that could shake the rule of the Great Xia Dynasty.
Eldest Senior Sister continued, "Our Master has committed crimes many times, so his students, our Grandmaster, are also not allowed to hold office."

chapters.title: Chapter 348 - 347: Where is My Patent Fee?_1
chapters.content:
Eldest Senior Sister took out a gilded invitation card, and one could tell from the envelope alone that it was of considerable value, "The grand event in Qingzhou includes a competition among the younger generation. The government office of Qingzhou has sent us an invitation, hoping that we from the Seek Dao Sect send a representative to participate.
I planned to discuss this matter with you initially, but now that Junior Brother Meng has raised this up, it saves us a lot of trouble."
"A competition among the younger generation?" Lu Yang was eager to give it a try since he had never competed with his peers apart from those from the Five Elements Sect.
"Then let's go, in my chariot," Meng Jingzhou called out.
"Just the two of us? Aren't Junior Sister Tao and the others coming?"
"I wanted to invite them, but Junior Sister Tao told me she was waiting for the results from the Second and Eighth Elder, I have no idea what those results are. Also, she seems fully engaged in her research on the Feather Transformation Immortal Body, so I didn't invite her again."
"Junior Brother Man has returned to his Barbarian tribe for a visit, and I'm not sure when he's going to come back."
"Junior Brother Li is spending quality time with his family, trying to help our niece form her Golden Core, so he isn't willing to come out."
Meng Jingzhou felt a bit distressed. This was such a great opportunity. There are only fifteen of these large-scale events held each year across the fifteen states of Great Xia. Once they miss this one, they will have to wait for another month. They are missing out.
As someone who likes lively scenes, the more people that go, the better.
After Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had left, Eldest Senior Sister suddenly remembered something and opened the invitation: On the third day of 99,860 of the Great Xia Calendar, as per the rule, the grand event of Qingzhou was to be held. It kindly invites your Sect to send outstanding disciples to participate in the event and give some guidance as judges.
"Junior Brother and Junior Brother Meng wouldn't get up on the stage, right?"
Yun Zhi murmured to herself, feeling like she was worrying over nothing.
Both of them are the first and second-ranked among the younger generation in the Seek Dao Sect, so their strength was unquestionable and higher than the others.
If they get on the stage, it would be too unfair.
...
"When I was at home, I often heard them talking about grand events here and there and how spectacular they were. Just hearing about it made me want to go and see it myself."
"Unfortunately, I hadn't started Cultivation at the time, so I wasn't qualified to watch the grand event."
"The Grand Event of Qingzhou is held for cultivators. To avoid disrupting the normal life of mortals, Qingzhou will set aside a special area outside the city where a Great Cultivator will temporarily construct a city. "
Inside the chariot, Meng Jingzhou was building castles in the air with wild gestures while Lu Yang was impressed.
"In addition to the magical duel, there will be auctions, eyesight appraisals, barter trades, exploration of ruins, appreciation of Golden Cores, etc. The event will provide an array of activities, ensuring every cultivator will gain plenty after attending."
"Not just our younger generation, but middle-aged and high-ranked cultivators will also be there. However, these cultivators have their own communities and won't interfere with us."
More senior cultivators were much older than Lu Yang and his peers. If these seniors were around, the younger generation might feel constrained.
Lu Yang deeply understood this: hosting classmates at home felt very different when the parents were around compared to when they were not.
"We have also held cultivator exchange meetings, but back then everyone had a lot of grudges. A disagreement might end up in threats against your entire family. On the surface, it was an exchange meeting, but more often than not, tribulation cultivators would take actions secretly, killing people for their treasure, making it extremely dangerous."
"So, only the major clans have the right to host a cultivator exchange meeting due to its high safety standards. For example, the Lianshan Clan backing Immortal Jiuchong, the Dragon and Phoenix Tribes, the Four Major Ferocious Clans, and so on."
Fairy Eternity sighed and reminiscing about those times, she thought it was really tough back then.
Lu Yang remembered that Immortal Jiuchong once made Fairy Eternity cook and let the criminals confess. The criminals mentioned here were probably cultivators like those tribulation operating in secret, who had crossed the Lianshan Clan's bottom line.
"Later, when the five of us became immortals, we started hosting exchange meetings irregularly. The meetings we hosted were very safe with no reckless killers. However, I'm not good at organizing such events, so Qinghe took care of it for me."
"Once I suggested, since the exchange meeting was being held at my place, it should take place at some unique locations, like the Mother-child River, Twin River, or places like that. There are mountains and rivers everywhere, what a beautiful view it is. If anyone wants to play in the water, they could go into the river."
"Qinghe firmly refused my suggestion, saying that it was dangerous there."
Lu Yang thought to himself, Fairy, the water in your river is the biggest enemy of family planning, who dares to get in the river?
"Sometimes, Yingtian Immortal would give away some books at the exchange meetings, posing it as unintentional. The books recorded our great achievements."
"When I asked Yingtian Immortal why he did this, he said people would suspect the authenticity of the books given by immortals publicly, but if they seem to have been spread unwittingly by immortals, people would consider them more authentic."
Lu Yang felt that Yingtian Immortal's logic was sound and he learned a lesson.
What Lu Yang didn't know was that the rumor about Yingtian Immortal impregnating countless women was also spread this way.
After traveling slowly for two days, Old horse arrives in Qingzhou, through mountains and rivers.
Upon entering the Qingzhou area, Old horse reined in its ability to travel between spaces. It had been traveling on wilderness trails before, where no one could see it, but that wouldn't work here. This was Qingzhou, a place bustling with people. The power would scare passers.
Meng Jingzhou popped his head out of the chariot, looking at the scenery not far away with a beaming smile, "We're almost there."
Lu Yang also stuck his head out from the other side. The forest was dense, verdant, and lush. Between the mountains, there were buildings made of bluestone arranged in an orderly manner, full of beauty like a painting.
Even though it was temporarily constructed, the structure was exquisite, showing great care and thought.
Many black dots were moving, from one building to another. These were all cultivators.
The arrival of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou in a common-looking chariot didn't draw people's attention.
Swoosh-
A black shadow shot past over their heads. The two looked up and found it to be a flying ship moving at a considerable speed.
The arrival of the flying ship caused an outcry from the pedestrians.
"Look, that's the flying ship of the Thunder Fire Sect. Such a fast speed! I wonder how many Spirit Stones this flying ship is worth. It's said that the Thunder Fire Sect has produced an extraordinary genius in this generation. The people following the flying ship, are they the genius's escorts?"
"Oh, we were wrong. That's the Thunder Fire Sect's ship exceeding the speed limit, and the people behind it are constables."
"What's that strange magic instrument? The logo on the instrument belongs to someone from the Yunmeng Sword Sect!"
"There's a sword under the magic instrument, and a big iron shell on the sword, I've never seen anything like that."
"I know about this; it's called a Flying Car. It's said to be a magic instrument invented by a Swordsmanship genius from the Seek Dao Sect and hasn't become popular yet. The previous way of sword flight could only carry one person, but this Flying Car can carry five."
"It's indeed the Seek Dao Sect. Their novel ideas are far beyond us."
"Who wouldn't agree? I heard that the Seek Dao Sect is showing signs of becoming the head of the Five Great Immortal Sects. The people in their Sect are all geniuses!"
Meng Jingzhou turned to look at Lu Yang, who wore a strange expression on his face.
This flying car was his invention. Later, the Fifth Elder asked Li Haoran to apply for a patent. He had not paid attention to this matter after that and didn't expect that it has already entered mass production?
"Wait a minute, where is my patent fee?"

chapters.title: Chapter 349 - 348: Spending Money to Avert Disaster _1
chapters.content:
Even if only a small group of people were producing flying cars, the patent fees alone would be enough to make Lu Yang very wealthy.
Previously, Lu Yang assumed that the patent was still being reviewed and the flying car had not been mass-produced, so he put the issue of patent fees out of his mind.
But with glaringly obvious flying cars zipping through the skies above him, he couldn't say that the patent hadn't been granted yet.
"Could it be that the Fifth Elder is playing a double game, pocketing my patent fees?"
This thought flashed through his mind, but was quickly dismissed.
The Fifth Elder wouldn't stoop to such petty greed.
"Let it be, I'll ask the Fifth Elder about it when I see him." Lu Yang decided not to dwell on this matter.
Old Horse pulled the carriage, bringing Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou to the foot of the mountain, where a newly built inn stood.
The Qingzhou Festival was always held for seven days, and cultivators couldn't be expected to sleep in the open during this time, as it would be unbecoming of their status.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou arrived relatively early and there were still vacant rooms.
"Two of your best rooms, please!"
"Alright, two Grade-A rooms, sir. Do you also need us to book a room for your horse?"
Meng Jingzhou was surprised, thinking could it be that they have recognized that Old Horse has unfathomable powers, treating him as an equal?
The innkeeper explained with a smile, "Sir, we offer a service to take care of spirit beasts for free. However, due to limited space, the spirit beasts will have to stay in the backyard. Occasionally, some Great Powers bring high-ranking spirit beasts to the Qingzhou Festival. If we put these high-ranking beasts in the backyard, other spirit beasts will be inevitably affected.
If you don't mind your spirit beast being affected, we can take care of it for free."
Meng Jingzhou thought for a moment. He wasn't sure of Old Horse's strength, but given that the family had assigned him as the protector, his realm should be very high. He would be content if Old Horse didn't bully others.
Nevertheless, considering Old Horse's habit of attracting young female horses, it would be prudent to provide him with a room of his own.
"Then please book a room for Old Horse as well."
"Alright then, three Grade-A rooms!"
"Old Horse, please tell me in confidence, what realm are you in? I promise to pretend that I don't know." Meng Jingzhou asked softly.
Old Horse glanced at Meng Jingzhou sideways with disbelief, snorted loudly, unconvinced by Meng Jingzhou's words.
After Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou went upstairs, another group of people came to the inn. However, they were not as flamboyant as Meng Jingzhou.
"Innkeeper, we would like three Grade C rooms."
"I'm sorry, sir, but we don't have Grade C rooms here."
The guest was taken aback, "Are the Grade C rooms sold out?"
He calculated how much money he had, it was barely enough, "Let's get two Grade B rooms then."
They could squeeze into two rooms.
"I'm sorry, sir, but we only have Grade-A rooms left."
"What?"
They were only at the Qi Refinement stage, they couldn't afford such high-end rooms!
"Senior Brother, let's find another inn."
The innkeeper smiled and said, "If I may be blunt, all the other inns only have Grade-A rooms left too."
Their faces turned dark, were they to sleep on the streets on the first day of the festival?
The innkeeper was not surprised by their reaction, "It's not as bad as you might think. Every year, when the festival starts, there is always a mad scramble for the Grade-A rooms, often resulting in fights. So, the Qingzhou government office has instructed us to upgrade all the rooms to Grade-A, but keep the price of the Grade C rooms. The government office will cover the excess."
Rather than allowing cultivators to fight and cause disorder, which could disrupt the order, the Qingzhou government office would rather fork out some extra spirit stones to nip the problem in the bud.
...
Meng Jingzhou had no idea that his Grade-A room was so cheap. He had always been oblivious to such small amounts of money.
"Lu Yang, pack up and come take a stroll. I heard there's a street market on the mountain that sells all sorts of antiques and magic artifacts."
"Sure."
Lu Yang didn't have much to pack. He was weary from his journey, so he took off his clothes. Since he didn't know the Body Cleaning Spell, he used the Array Method in the room to wash up and got dressed in a crisp, cool outfit before heading out.
Old Horse didn't have much to pack either. He was worn out from his journey, too. He set down his saddle, and, unlike Lu Yang, he knew the Body Cleaning Spell and could refresh himself without resorting to the Array Method in the room. He then released his Spiritual Sense to check if there were any mares around.
"Foundation Establishment Elixir, an Elixir Pattern-infused Foundation Establishment Elixir, guaranteed to enable Foundation Establishment, or get a full refund!"
"Demon Beast fur, fur from a Qi Refinement-Complete demon beast, perfect material for making magic artifacts!"
"Barbecued Demon Beast, Qi Refinement-Complete Barbecued Demon Beast, just delivered from next door!"
"'Solidification Skill', 'Cloud Flow Sword Technique', 'Clear Sound Secret Text'... all sorts of magic skills and spells, anything you could want!"
"Most comprehensive Star Chart, the result of two decades' painstaking effort, personally observing the stars at night and drawing the Star Chart, an indispensable tool for practitioners of the star-related magic skills!"
"Phoenix Blood Stone, Yang Invigorating Phoenix Blood Stone, Taiwen Stone, can enhance the quality of swords, Gold Attraction Stone, capable of absorbing gold!"
Hawkers constantly shouted out their wares, bringing life and color to the street.
Upon entering the market, Lu Yang felt a kind of suppression, not of Cultivation Realm, but of Spiritual Sense.
After all, for something like magic skills, a sweep of one's Spiritual Sense would reveal their contents. Why would anyone then buy from the hawkers?
"They even have 'Cloud Flow Sword Technique'?!" Lu Yang was surprised. The Cloud Flow Sword Technique was a rare sword technique created by a True Lord Yun over two thousand years ago, not commonly circulating in the market.
Meng Jingzhou, in this respect, was much more savvy than Lu Yang: "Don't trust the magic skills sold here. A sword technique written by True Lord Yun may be called 'Cloud Flow Sword Technique', but you could scribble a completely random technique and also call it 'Cloud Flow Sword Technique'.
Since the buyer has never seen the true 'Cloud Flow Sword Technique', even if they spot a problem after buying, they can't accuse you of selling fake goods."
"After all, new spells are created every day, duplication of names is quite normal."
Lu Yang suddenly understood. He didn't anticipate such intricate dealings here.
"Do you have a Star Chart?" Lu Yang caught the vendor's comment.
While his own practice had no relation to the stars, he still wanted a copy so that he could guess which ones corresponded to his Eldest Senior Sister's Golden Core.
"This esteemed guest has good taste. This Star Chart was drawn by me, using a telescopic magic instrument. My own magic skill practice involves a high level of visual acuity. I put my heart and soul into creating this Star Chart, and ultimately, my perseverance paid off!"
"Can I have a look at it?"
On hearing his question, the vendor's face grew wary: "No way, I can't see through your Cultivation Realm, even if one can't use their Spiritual Sense here, you might have opened up your Spiritual Space. If you glance at the Star Chart, you could remember all its contents, and then you wouldn't buy it."
Lu Yang couldn't help but laugh. He, of course, had no such intentions.
"How much is it in Spirit Stones? I'll buy it."
"This is the only copy in the world, two thousand Spirit Stones, no bargaining."
Two thousand Spirit Stones was not a steep price for Lu Yang. He was about to make the payment when he heard voices buzzing with excitement behind him.
"Senior brother, look, there's a Star Chart here!"
"What?"
The Senior Brother looked overjoyed. He had a close female junior with a star-related magic skill which required the Star Chart.
To win over his junior sister, the Star Chart was essential.
He thought Lu Yang seemed friendly and probably okay to negotiate with. He kept repeating to himself: Brother, this Star Chart is for a sister that I adore, can you part with it for me?
Brother, this Star Chart is for a sister that I adore, can you part with it for me?
After rehearsing twice in his mind and feeling confident about his tone and choice of words, he suppressed his nerves, clasped his fists, and said to Lu Yang:
"Sister, this Star Chart is for a brother that I admire, could you part with it for me?"
Lu Yang turned around, assured himself of his own gender and the other person's. He quietly retreated two steps in silence.

chapters.title: Chapter 350 - 349: Star Empowerment Method_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang felt that although he might not be considered suave or handsome, he was surely not so ambiguous as to lead people to mistake his gender.
He wanted to say that he was a man, but was afraid to do so, thinking of the other party's admiration for the senior brother.
He wanted to say that he was a woman, but the thought of having to pay such a hefty price to buy the Star Chart made him hesitate.
Anyway, buying it meant guessing Eldest Senior Sister's Golden Core, all in good fun.
It would be better to leave.
After saying this, he wanted to slap himself twice. What nonsense was he spouting!
His two followers were extremely embarrassed. This was his persistent problem. He always ended up saying the wrong things when he got nervous.
The bad news was that he often got nervous.
It was said that the palace master suggested he consider practicing Silent Zen.
"No, what I meant to say was, dear senior brother, the Star Chart is something my admired senior brother uses for cultivation. May I have it from you?"
He thought about it and decided to start by introducing himself to organize his thoughts.
"I am Gu Qisheng, a disciple from Changhong Palace, at the initial stage of Foundation Establishment. I am here to participate in the Grand Contest. Judging by your age, I assume you are also here for the Grand Contest."
Gu Qisheng had not yet turned eighteen, yet he was already at the initial stage of Foundation Establishment. His pace of cultivation was so rapid that it would rank in the top 5 in the history of Changhong Palace.
Although one could change their appearance after reaching an advanced realm of cultivation, Gu Qisheng judged that if the person was a Golden Core or Nascent Soul cultivator, they wouldn't be shopping here. Those old cultivators who had lived long lives and had experienced a lot would have their own purchase channels.
Lu Yang had heard of Changhong Palace, a top-tier sect in Ji State, but he didn't know much more than that.
"Indeed, I am here to participate in the Grand Contest. Perhaps we will meet on the stage. As for this Star Chart, feel free to do as you desire, junior brother." Lu Yang took another step back.
Seeing Lu Yang continue to retreat, Gu Qisheng hurriedly corrected his mistake, saying, "I misspoke earlier and mixed up the titles. Actually, it is one of my senior sisters who needs the Star Chart for her cultivation."
Upon hearing this, both Lu Yang and Mend Jingzhou heaved a sigh of relief. The shock had even caused Meng Jingzhou to almost concoct a singleness curse on the spot.
Lu Yang said with a smile,"I am interested in the Star Chart just out of curiosity. It is not as important as Brother Gu's marital affairs."
Overjoyed, Gu Qisheng pulled out 1,500 Spirit Stones and bought the Star Chart.
The cost of 1,500 was not a small sum for him, but to make his true transmission senior sister pleased, it was worth it!
He enthusiastically opened the Star Chart, only to find that it was covered in blood stains, making it impossible to see anything.
"What is going on!" Gu Qisheng was furious. Had he bought a piece of blood-soaked paper in his painstaking effort to procure the Star Chart?
The vendor calmly explained, "Didn't I mention it earlier? I drew the Star Chart with my heart and soul. It's normal to spit out a few instances of blood during the process."
Lu Yang,"..."
Why were there scams everywhere in this market?
Meng Jingzhou sent a message to Lu Yang, "Most of the items in the market are fakes. One of the challenges in our Meng Family's coming of age ceremony is to buy a genuine item in the market."
"I see, but wait, don't people come of age at sixteen? I don't remember you going back to the Meng Family for the coming of age ceremony?"
The age limit for joining the Seek Dao Sect is sixteen, and Lu Yang had never seen Meng Jingzhou return to the Meng Family.
Meng Jingzhou confidently responded, "I ran away from home. Who has a coming of age ceremony after running away from home!"
Gu Qisheng was still arguing with the vendor,"In that case, why wouldn't you redraw a Star Chart."
"This shows that you don't understand, dear customer. There are huge secrets hidden in the stars. Please inquire around you for the past few hundred years, who has successfully drawn a Star Chart? Even if they finish the drawing, it eventually gets destroyed due to various reasons."
"Moreover, the drawer can't remember the layout of the stars. I have a small part of this Star Chart that hasn't been stained by blood, which is already extremely rare. Selling it to you for 1,500 Spirit Stones is a bargain."
Gu Qisheng naturally didn't believe the vendor's words, but then he thought about the true transmission senior sister who didn't have a Star Chart given her status, which was unusual.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had never heard of such a thing. Nobody observes the stars for leisure, let alone remembering their positions. Lu Yang thought of the Eldest Senior Sister's Golden Core and felt that what the vendor said had some credibility. So he went to the Spiritual Space to wake up Fairy Eternity.
"Ah? You are calling me?" Fairy Eternity woke up sleepily, yawning.
Lu Yang repeated what the vendor had said, sparking Fairy Eternity's interest.
She temporarily borrowed Lu Yang's body, looked into the sky and saw the stars, which were normally obscured by sunlight, during the daytime.
She returned Lu Yang's body.
"So, was it my Eldest Senior Sister who set a barrier that prevents the world from observing which stars are the Eldest Senior Sister's Golden Cores?"
"Whether it was set by Miss Yun, I don't know, but indeed there's a cognitive barrier preventing people from remembering the position of the stars, except when you go to the sky to observe."
Lu Yang pondered and almost concluded that the barrier was indeed set by the Eldest Senior Sister, just not sure what the purpose was.
Was it because she feared that the enemy would discover the location of her Golden Core?
Or did the Eldest Senior Sister want to prevent people from practicing the Star Art?
As stars have been refined into the mainland beneath their feet, the power of the Star Art is not as strong as in ancient times, as the power of the Star Art comes from the stars in the sky.
However, there are still some who insist on the idea that ancient things are superior and want to practice the Star Art.
"You are here in Qingzhou for the Grand Contest? Come, come, let me, an immortal, show you how keen my judgment is!"
Lu Yang regretted waking up Fairy Eternity. Feeling energetic upon waking up, she was bouncing around and not being calm at all.
Lu Yang passed a stall, and the stall owner displayed various kinds of books in front of him. All of them were history-oriented, recording various historical secrets.
"Lu Yang, look at that book, it's called 'Ancient Secrets.' Buy it so I can find out what it's all about!" Fairy Eternity exclaimed excitedly.
"Boss, how much is this book in Spirit Stones?"
"Three thousand Spirit Stones."
Lu Yang frowned, thinking that it was too expensive. The boss then said," Don't find it too expensive. you should know how many unknown fortunes lie hidden in 'Ancient Secrets.' If you are lucky enough to discover a fortune that others haven't found, you could skyrocket your status and be free to roam the world!"
"This is the latest version of my 'Ancient Secrets,' recording the latest research on ancient times by academic circles!"
"Here are three thousand Spirit Stones."
Lu Yang paid and was given the book. Three thousand Spirit Stones was not much for him. Not to mention the patent fee that disappeared mysteriously, just the portion shared by Nine Nether alone was more than enough for him. Three thousand Spirit Stones were just a drop in the ocean.
Meng Jingzhou was also curious about ancient secrets and came over to watch.
The first article in the book read: The ancient immortal Yingtian loved beauties, particularly married women, and had countless offspring with them.
Lu Yang was puzzled and asked in the Spiritual Space, "Is Yingtian really like this?"
Fairy Eternity looked innocent. "Who is spreading the rumors? Yingtian is not that kind of person."

chapters.title: Chapter 351 - 350 Ancient Secrets_1
chapters.content:
Fairy Eternity sighed sadly, feeling this was a sorrow of the era, "In your time, why is everything about spreading rumors, even dares to fabricate rumors about the Immortals?"
Being part of this era, Lu Yang listened to the fairy's teachings and declared he would reflect deeply on this.
"How good was Yingtian Immortal as a person, although he was repeatedly challenged by me before he became immortal, making him quite unlucky, yet he was nonetheless a rare genius of all times, full of glory. It's hard to believe that even after his success and fame, he was harmed by rumours of later generations."
Lu Yang took the opportunity to ask, "Did Yingtian Immortal have a wife and children?"
"Probably not, but he had a very good affinity with women."
"How so?"
"By ordinary standards, Yingtian Immortal was quite handsome, I didn't think so, of course, it might have been because I always ended up beating him black and blue."
"Before he became an immortal, he was often seized by strong female cultivators who admired him, forcing him into relations. It happened more than once or twice, just the times I encountered, there were at least five, and there were more according to others."
"...How envious...err no, I mean how unfortunate."
Lu Yang continued to leaf through "Ancient Secrets", finding mentions of the Four Immortals of the Ancients, but only Yingtian Immortal had a clear title, the other three were represented by pseudonyms such as Demon Immortal or a certain Immortal, and so on.
"Most likely out of the Four Immortals of the Ancients, Yingtian Immortal was the most famous, or the books you can get for three thousand Spirit Stones will not tell you everything."
Considering that Yingtian Immortal created the Thunder Tribulation, Lu Yang had reason to suspect that Yingtian Immortal's name was widely circulated or rather widely scorned among high-level cultivators.
"Look at this, it also mentions the great battle between the ancient Dragon and Phoenix ancestors, and the Phoenix ancestor showing off its ability to be reborn from flames!" Meng Jingzhou pointed at one of the pages, showing some excitement seeing a familiar story.
He heard about it in Luofeng County from the Pure Blood Phoenix Tribe, who spoke more detail than the book, but the general events were not vastly different.
Lu Yang rubbed his temples in pain, feeling that archaeologists really had it rough. Spending so much time verifying facts only to end up with wildly different results from actual events.
"This is about one of the Four Fiends of the Ancient times, a member of the Chaos tribe. When a Chaos tribe member is born, they have no face, their gender is undefined. As adults, they can adjust their gender and appearance at will according to their own desires. During the ancient times, the Chaos tribe established a rule that in the Cultivation World, the strong are revered.
The powerful should submit to the weak, with the powerful being males and the weak females."
"Really?" Lu Yang sought confirmation from Fairy Eternity.
Fairy Eternity affirmed, "That's true."
"The Chaos tribe is indeed as you have heard, they're born in a state of chaos, everything about them is undetermined. They're one of the few species where postnatal decisions can lead to prenatal changes, some even say this is evidence of effect preceding cause."
"The Chaos tribe did have such a rule, that the powerful determine the gender of the weak."
"It wouldn't have been an issue by itself, it just so happened the Chaos tribe at the time spawned an incredible genius. While still inferior to the prodigies of the Dragon and Phoenix tribes, this person was still among the top three strongest in the history of Chaos tribe."
"This person loved having a harem and sought thrills, so he defeated all other Chaos tribe members, turning them into females."
"The members of the Chaos tribe could freely decide their appearances, so all of them became beautiful."
"As a result, the entire Chaos tribe ended up with only him as a male and everyone else female, they almost went extinct."
"It was the intervention of the Qilin Immortal, convincing him to control his desires and urging the Chaos Tribe to modify their rule."
"Later, the Chaos tribe changed their rule to gender self-determination. I'm not sure if their rule has changed now."
Lu Yang: "..."
This information should not be shared with Meng Jingzhou to avoid his jealousy after hearing about it.
"There's also a legend recorded here. In ancient times, a woodcutter entered a cave while cutting wood on a mountain and encountered two Immortals playing chess. The Immortal's level of chess was superior, encompassing the principles of heaven and earth. As soon as their game ended, the woodcutter realized he was already gone for a hundred years."
"Presumably, the story of the first master of the Eternity Sect is adapted from this ancient tale."
Lu Yang said confidently, "If my guess is correct, one of these two ancient Immortals must be Suiyue, the Time Immortal. Only he could let the woodcutter watch chess for a hundred years!"
Fairy Eternity gave a smirk, "Wrong guess. The ones playing the chess were Ying Tian Immortal and Qilin Immortal. Those two terrible chess players."
"I had invited the four of them home for a meal. They all agreed readily. However, Ying Tian Immortal and Qilin Immortal both said that they were playing chess and would come over once the game was decided. I agreed to it."
"I waited and waited for them. In the end, I told Jiuchong Immortal to gather some firewood and he volunteered to go and see what was happening. He never returned after he left."
"During that time, Suiyue also went over to check. After returning, Suiyue told me they were trying to comprehend the Dao through chess and cannot be disturbed. He suggested that we should eat and if they don't eat, the rest of us should starve too."
"I thought his reasoning made sense, so I waited again. And this time I ended up waiting for a hundred years."
"When the hundred years were up, the food had gone cold. There was no way we could eat it then."
Fairy Eternity felt regret. She thought Yingtian Immortal and Qilin Immortal were really lousy. They couldn't even decide on a game of chess after a hundred years.
Lu Yang: "..."
As expected from immortals who had unlimited lifetimes. They could just let a hundred years slip by.
Yingtian Immortal and his two brothers were even harsher characters. They'd rather play chess for a hundred years than attend a dinner.
Even though "Ancient Secrets" was somewhat different from the real ancient era, it was still the result of scholars' investigations, so there was some truth in it. It wasn't just made up out of nowhere.
As for why rumors that Yingtian Immortal had a weakness for beauties had spread, Lu Yang was clueless. Maybe there was an error in the research methodology, or possibly, the information source was incorrect.
As they passed by a street vendor, Lu Yang gave it an extra glance. A golden tower, jade bottle, sealed elixir whose medicinal effect was slowly disappearing, a broken flying sword... were all displayed on the stall.
"Lu Yang, wait! Did you see that flying sword? It's a good item. It was used by Qilin Immortal!" Fairy Eternity excitedly stopped Lu Yang.
The flying sword was broken and far from its original state. If not for Fairy Eternity having seen it a few times, even she wouldn't be sure this was Qilin Immortal's sword.
"What?" Lu Yang's heart raced at the unexpected encounter with a flying sword used by Qilin Immortal in such a place. This was an Immortal Sword!
The golden finger, Fairy Eternity, finally came through.
"Wait, you're not saying it's the sword that Qilin Immortal used during his Foundation Establishment Stage, are you?" Lu Yang warily looked at Fairy Eternity.
Fairy Eternity frowned, feeling that Lu Yang didn't put enough trust in her, "What kind of talk is that? It's definitely not! This is the Immortal Sword that Qilin Immortal used after he became an immortal, which was specifically requested by Yingtian Immortal to be refined with the power of thunder!"
Lu Yang was overjoyed. With Yingtian Immortal refining the sword, and Qilin Immortal using it, it propelled the value of the sword into a straight increase.
Such a lucky find!

chapters.title: Chapter 352 - 351: Picking the Missed Deal _1
chapters.content:
"Boss, how many spirit stones for this bottle?" Lu Yang casually asked as he squatted down.
"Fine taste, sir. This jade bottle was obtained from a secret realm established by a Nascent Soul cultivator. It contains diluted Taiyi True Water. Eighty thousand spirit stones."
Lu Yang's eye twitched. 'Are you robbing people?' The total worth of a Golden Core stage cultivator was only about a hundred thousand spirit stones.
Moreover, Fairy Eternity had already informed him that the Taiyi True Water in it had been diluted by ten thousand times. The power contained in my piss is stronger than it.
In a market, if your brains, knowledge, and eyesight all failed to work, you would easily be deceived.
Luckily, he had Fairy Eternity with him.
"What is the effect of the elixir in this bottle?"
"Cultivators often have difficulty forming golden cores in one go. This bottle contains an elixir that can simulate the process of forming golden cores with a sixty percent similarity to the actual process, greatly increasing the chances of success. One bottle costs thirty thousand spirit stones," the peddler enthusiastically pitched.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou exchanged glances. They were puzzled. Isn't forming golden cores always a one-time success?
Lu Yang shook the elixir bottle and laughed, "You're not being honest, boss. Even it is sealed by a forbidden spell, the effect of the elixir is still dissipating. Thirty thousand per bottle is the price for a full bottle, not for the elixir in this bottle."
The peddler complimented Lu Yang for his sharp eyes with a smile on his face, while secretly startled inside. He had met someone who knew his stuff.
"What about this flying sword? Don't tell me it was used by the master of the secret realm," Lu Yang casually said, his flippant attitude made the peddler uncertain.
The peddler was clueless, but Meng Jingzhou had seen through it. Lu Yang had set such a big stage for it, the flying sword was his goal.
This shabby flying sword, could it be hiding some secret?
"This flying sword is sturdy and has survived a hundred years without decaying. While it may not be able to be paired with a Nascent Soul Stage cultivator, it is definitely one of the close quarters magic artifacts.
This was probably left in the secret realm because it had gone through a big battle and it would have actually been a loss to fix it!" The peddler said adamantly, as if he had personally witnessed a Nascent Soul Stage cultivator wielding the flying sword against enemies.
Lu Yang did not believe the peddler's bullshit, but another question occurred to him. How could an Immortal Sword be worn out? Even after hundreds of thousands of years, it should not be like this.
Unless it really had been through a big battle and the immortal sword was damaged!
Who was the enemy?
"Enough, save these words to deceive others. Don't think that I can't discern. This flying sword is of poor quality and barely useful for a Golden Core stage cultivator. It should be a sword worn by a Foundation Establishment cultivator."
Although the peddler didn't know the origin of the flying sword, he couldn't let Lu Yang make a final judgement.
"This is definitely the sword used by the master of the secret realm when he was at the Golden Core stage, there's no way it was used at the Foundation Establishment stage!"
Lu Yang wore a bored look on his face: "Three thousand spirit stones. The flying sword is already broken, I need to repair it once I get it back."
"At least twenty thousand!"
"Let's go." Lu Yang stood up and was ready to go.
"Hey wait, we can negotiate the price, eighteen thousand spirit stones!"
Lu Yang coldly said: "Five thousand spirit stones."
The peddler gritted his teeth. Whenever he set up his stall in other places, people complained about the sword being too shabby and nobody wanted to buy it. It was not easy to finally find a buyer in the Qingzhou Festival. If they missed this opportunity, who knows when the next one would be: "Five thousand then, we can make friends this way!"
Seeing that Lu Yang got the flying sword as he wished, Meng Jingzhou curiously asked with a telepathic message: "What is the origin of this flying sword?"
"It was used by Ancient Immortal."
Meng Jingzhou gasped in cold air and watched Lu Yang enviously. What a big bargain he has got!
Originally, Lu Yang intended to inquire indirectly about where the peddler got the flying sword. But the moment the peddler opened his mouth saying he got it from a Nascent Soul Realm, he knew he wouldn't find out anything.
Aiming at a high price, merchants always create a background story of the items. In other words, the most probable place where this flying sword could come from was the Nascent Soul Realm.
It probably was picked up randomly by a Nascent Soul cultivator and the origin could no longer be traced.
Lu Yang examined the flying sword. It was badly damaged, but there were no blood stains or notches. The fracture surface was rough, as if someone had broken it by brute force.
The instinct of a Sword Spirit Root told him that this had absolutely been an unrivalled good sword at some point.
"Does Qilin Immortal practice sword cultivation?"
Fairy Eternity shook her head: "No, Qilin Immortal doesn't use swords. Let's go and see if there are any other good items."
"Wait a moment. If Qilin Immortal doesn't use swords, what is this flying sword used for?"
"Eh, didn't I tell you about it? When Qilin Immortal did something wrong, those two cheeky girls, Dragon and Phoenix, would put all the flying swords upright to form a square and make Qilin Immortal kneel on the sword tips."
"Therefore, Qilin Immortal asked Yingtian Immortal to make a bunch of flying swords. They looked sparkly and remarkable, but they were powerless when used. It's similar to kneeling on foam."
"Later, when Dragon and Phoenix found out about this, they got angry and broke all the flying swords. The one in your hand is one of them."
Lu Yang: "..."
So, I spent five thousand spirit stones to bring this thing home?
Lu Yang was thinking about asking Fairy Eternity to help him pick up a bargain, and let Meng Jingzhou experience the joy of picking up a bargain too.
But it seemed like he would give up this idea now, lest he let Fairy Eternity waste Meng Jingzhou's Spirit Stones.
...
"Sir, disciples from Laurel Fairy Palace, Five Elements Sect, and Prison Suppressing Sect have arrived. They are waiting outside." An attendant reported respectfully.
The governor nodded slightly, showing great importance to the people of the Five Great Immortal Sects: "Only three sects, no one from Seek Dao Sect and Suspension Temple are here? Then invite them in."
The Qingzhou Festival was jointly held by the Qingzhou government office and the local First-Class Sects in Qingzhou. If people from the Five Great Immortal Sects came, it would elevate the status of the Qingzhou Festival.
"The old ancestor from Seek Dao Sect who was once the governor here had set a precedent." The governor sighed sentimentally. Regardless of whether the people from the Seek Dao Sect were reliable or not, their free-spirited thinking was unmatched by anyone else.
Exactly, the Qingzhou Festival was initially proposed by Seek Dao Sect.
If the Qingzhou Festival was well-managed, it would be counted as part of the performance report.
The most appealing aspect of the Qingzhou Festival was the interaction between cultivators. However, the fair would be unappealing to the geniuses who could interact within the Five Great Immortal Sects.
Sending people over was a way for them to show their respect to the Qingzhou government office.
"What are you doing standing there? Hurry up and go!" The governor looked at the attendant standing in place with confusion.
"Sir, there's a problem. It seems that the disciples from the immortal sects have no place to stay."
"What about the post station?"
"As per your instructions, sir, to let high rank cultivators feel the enthusiasm of the government office, they all live in the post station."
"What about the inns at the foot of the mountain?"
"They are all full."
"Then build a few houses temporarily."
"There's no place. When planning at that time, we occupied all places to accommodate more people."
The governor faced a difficult moment. It was a good thing for the Five Great Immortal Sects to send people over, but if their hospitality wasn't up to par and they lost face, it would be difficult to invite people from the Five Great Immortal Sects in the future.
"Doesn't the government office have a single house left?" the governor asked unwillingly, hoping the attendant could think of something.
The attendant did actually think of a place: "There is indeed a place that can accommodate people, and it has a huge area, with plenty of empty rooms. It was built by us and you can stay there with just one word from you, sir, no Spirit Stones needed."
The governor's eyes brightened: "Where is it?"
"The prison."

chapters.title: Chapter 353 - 352: Heard that Lu Yang Can Cross Three Major Realms in Battle_1
chapters.content:
The governor took a deep breath, resisting the urge to kick his subordinate.
Did you expect the people from the Seek Dao Sect to stay in jail?
He glared at his subordinate: "Go and invite the disciples of the Immortal Sect. We have several guest rooms available here. Clean them up, and arrange the Gathering Spirit Array where it should be, and place the Heart-nourishing Stones where they should be."
"Yes!"
Soon, three disciples from the Immortal Sect entered the office, two men and a woman, lively and self-confident.
The governor looked at the three disciples of the Immortal Sect and nodded secretly: They really lived up to the name of being from the Immortal Sect, and anyone could tell that they were the cream of the crop.
They were so young and had already formed a Golden Core, a terrifying talent indeed.
The governor saw that the three were just in the form golden core stage. According to the return letter from the Sect, none of them were yet eighteen years old.
Golden Core Stage before the age of eighteen, and all in First-Grade Core Formation. Such a quick cultivation speed was rarely seen in history.
They would probably play major roles in the future Great Era.
"Greetings to Governor, I am Lan Ting from Laurel Fairy Palace." Lan Ting was slender and graceful in her white dress, her eyes sparkling, and her skirt fluttered as she walked.
"I am Bai Ming from Five Elements Sect." Bai Ming was as indifferent as ever.
"Prison Suppressing Sect, Yan Tianzhi." Yan Tianzhi was taciturn.
"I hope you three will do us the honor of commenting on the grand competition tomorrow." The governor smiled, and although the competitors tomorrow were of the same generation, these three, with their extraordinary experiences as disciples of the Immortal Sect, would have an easy time judging the competition.
"We will certainly do our best."
"By the way, have any of you seen anyone from the Seek Dao Sect?"
The three shook their heads. They had each left their respective sects and had not seen anyone from the Seek Dao Sect since they had gathered in Qingzhou.
"That's strange, the Seek Dao Sect replied to my letter saying that they would send two people this time, one named Lu Yang, another named Meng Jingzhou, both of whom are the most outstanding geniuses of their generation. By the time, they should have also arrived." The governor was puzzled and couldn't figure out the reason.
When Lan Ting heard familiar names, she remembered the days when she ran a barbecue restaurant in Yanjiang County. She got a mission from her sect to infiltrate Eternity Sect. However, a time discrepancy occurred, and she missed the recruitment time of the Eternity Sect. Later, she ran into Lu Yang and his two companions and learned that they had successfully joined the Eternity Sect.
In the end, in Yanjiang County, she and Lu Yang's trio teamed up and killed the Rudder Master of the Yanjiang Rudder.
Lu Yang's trio even got noticed by the higher-ups of Eternity Sect and were promoted. She also returned to the sect to report the mission status.
She had been wondering whether to contact Lu Yang to see if she needed to help anywhere and it would be best to bring down another sub-sect.
To her surprise, less than two months had passed since she got the news of the destruction of Eternity Sect.
She was stunned for quite some time when she heard the news, thinking that she had heard some fake news.
It's only been two months!
Although it was publicly announced that the Seek Dao Sect and the court jointly took down Eternity Sect, Lan Ting was certain that Lu Yang had something to do with it!
Later at a meeting at the Seek Dao Sect, the Eldest Senior Sister of the Seek Dao Sect proposed that she get engaged to Lu Yang. Her master immediately grabbed her and left, scared that she might be left behind.
She didn't know why her master was so afraid of the Eldest Senior Sister of the Seek Dao Sect.
"I see..." The governor was worried, but then he was relieved. Since the reply from the Seek Dao Sect said that the two men would come, then they would definitely come. Maybe they were enjoying the grand feast today, and then directly go to the judge's seat tomorrow before the start of the competition.
That would also make sense.
"By the way, Suspending Temple asked me to bring a message to the governor. They originally wanted to send Senior Brother Shi Chan over, but Shi Chan encountered some accidents while spreading Buddhist teachings and couldn't come. Suspended Temple doesn't have many people and is unable to send anyone else."
Shi Chan is a true disciple of the current generation of the Suspension Temple.
"Did he encounter any danger, do I need to send people to help?"
"Well, It's not dangerous, it's just that he's still unable to comprehend the phrase 'laying down the butcher's knife and becoming a Buddha on the spot,' so he joined a slaughterhouse, trying to see if he could become a Buddha the moment he put down his butcher knife."
The governor held back for a long time, not knowing what to say, and finally said: "It's getting late, you three should rest."
After the governor left, Lan Ting suddenly asked, "Senior Brother Bai Ming, your face changed when the governor mentioned Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou. Do you know these two?"
Bai Ming sighed, "More than just knowing, I have also fought him."
"Senior Sister Lan Ting may not know, four months ago, I went to the Seek Dao Sect for an exchange visit and in the Foundation Establishment Stage competition, Lu Yang used the Three Flavored True Fire, Earth Escape Technique, and other Five Elements magic skills one after another. I thought I was unbeatable in using Five Elements magic skills, but Lu Yang had me beaten in every respect."
"When I was about to lose, I had an epiphany at that moment and broke through the bottleneck, advancing to the late stage of Foundation Establishment in the middle of the fight. What I didn't expect was that Lu Yang had never intended to fight me seriously from beginning to end.
Seeing me break through in the middle of the competition, he seemed to have become a different person, his eyes and movements all changed. Before I could make a move, I was defeated by him with a single strike. If it were not for my master's timely action, I would have either died or injured."
The Five Great Immortal Sects had a good relationship, and they all called each other Senior Brother and Senior Sister.
"He is so strong!" Lan Ting was surprised. She knew that Lu Yang had fantastic magic skills, but she didn't expect that Lu Yang could defeat Bai Ming with a single move.
Yan Tianzhi also widened his eyes, showing a shocked expression.
He had fought with Bai Ming, who was proficient in spear skills and Five Elements magic skills, and he was extremely difficult to deal with. But he was defeated with a single move?
According to my master, Lu Yang used an ancient Great Divine Skill that has been lost - the Diving Spell. If you don't have special countermeasures, this technique is unsolvable and can drain the water from your body and dehydrate you." Bai Ming recalled the scene where Lu Yang casually used the Diving Spell, and a chill ran down his spine.
Looking at him using the ancient Great Divine Skill so casually, he was afraid that if he could resist the Diving Spell, there might be other Great Divine Skills waiting for him.
"Not only that, but the Grand Elder of the Seek Dao Sect personally admitted that Lu Yang had challenged across stages."
Yan Tianzhi smiled and didn't care. They were all capable of challenging across stages, but it wasn't something to brag about.
Bai Ming said solemnly, "It was a challenge to skip three realms. When he was at the Foundation establishment stage, he defeated Golden Core, Nascent Soul, and Spirit Transformation!"
Lan Ting and Yan Tianzhi were so shocked that they couldn't speak. Skipping three levels was simply an outlandish tale.
Lan Ting thought about the battle in which she and Lu Yang killed the Rudder Master of Yanjiang Rudder, Lu Yang had always looked like he was handling it with ease. So he had been holding back all this time.
"I suspect that when he was challenging across stages, he relied on conditions like the right time and place, array method, elixirs, and so on." Bai Ming analyzed, otherwise, he couldn't imagine how a person in the Foundation establishment stage could defeat a person in the Divinity Transformation Stage.
Still, being able to fight against opponents three realms above was terrifying.
At least they three couldn't do it.
"It's a pity, we have no idea where these two have gone."
"Maybe they will show up at the competition tomorrow."

chapters.title: Chapter 354 - 353: How did you guys end up on the judge panel?_1
chapters.content:
The grand ceremony in Qingzhou officially kicked off, with the most eye-catching event being the grand competition among the younger generation.
Every year, young cultivators with great potential were featured prominently in the competition, causing those cultivators who had wasted their lives in obscurity to feel shame and sigh deeply.
In fact, the potential of these cultivators has been proven. Aside from those who tragically fell, most of them achieved fame and success, either taking up leadership roles or establishing their own sects.
Not only the Qingzhou government office but numerous sect powers also placed great importance on these young cultivators, hoping to recruit them.
Perhaps because a Great Era was on the horizon, the young cultivators who participated in the grand competition in recent years were increasingly extraordinary, continually setting new records.
