"Quick, look at that one. Isn't that Li Shaoyang from the Wind Stabilizing Sect? I've heard that he's reached Consummation of Qi Refinement. During his travels, he was once ambushed by bandits. But he had a spear that pierced through three bandits who were at the Ninth Level of Qi Training!"
"What? He's so young yet he's already achieved Consummation of Qi Refinement? His level is enough to rank in the top eight!"
Ninth Level of Qi Training was the stage at which one could attempt Foundation Establishment. Those aiming for a successful Foundation Establishment would carefully refine this stage, also referred to as the Consummation of Qi Training by others.
Most of the cultivators observing here were at the Qi Refinement stage, so Consummation of Qi Training was their greatest aim.
The Five Great Immortal Sects did not use this terminology. They didn't even bother to differentiate the levels within the Qi Refinement stage. For them, there was no difference whether one was at the initial stage of Qi training or had reached Consummation of Qi Training.
"Also, look at that strikingly beautiful female cultivator next to him called Qiao Hongye. She's from the No Sleeves Sect, a First class sect. She has also achieved Consummation of Qi Training and possesses both wood and fire Dual Spirit Roots.
In a sect-wide competition held internally by the No Sleeves Sect, several participants had achieved Consummation of Qi Training, but Qiao Hongye took first place in that competition!"
"Achieving Consummation of Qi Training would have been enough to rank in the top eight in previous years, but it's hard to say for this year. I've heard a rumor that several participants who have reached the Foundation Establishment stage will be joining this year!"
"Foundation Establishment stage before the age of eighteen?! And there are several of them?"
His companion spoke mysteriously: "Have you heard of Gu Qisheng from Changhong Palace? He was born at an inauspicious date and has the Profound Yin Body. He experienced a catastrophe at birth and would have died prematurely if it wasn't for the help of the palace master."
"The Profound Yin Body attracts the envy of heaven, making birth a catastrophe. If one can overcome it, they will make smooth progress in Cultivation. But if they can't, they would die halfway."
"Some people saw Gu Qisheng here yesterday. He's already at the early stage of Foundation Establishment."
...
"Hello, we're here to sign up for the competition."
A bailiff was registering names in the distance, quite chilly in demeanor.
Normally, people would register for the competition in advance, but a small portion would just suddenly decide to participate.
The bailiff took a glance at the two amiable-looking individuals. He was unable to discern their Realm, but he didn't pay it much thought, as many people would bring Artifacts to conceal their Cultivation Level when heading out, which was quite common.
He pointed to a stone next to them and said, "This stone is the lowest quality Black Iron Stone. Only those at the late stages of Qi Training can shatter it. Shatter the stone."
The Black Iron Stone in front of them was no different from tofu. A light strike of the palm, and the stone shattered into several pieces.
"It seems like they are at the Foundation Establishment stage. They are indeed hiding their strengths this year."
This is the Year Ring Stone. Place your hand on it, and pour in your spiritual energy."
On the other side of the bailiff, there was a stone that looked like several rings tied together with each one representing a year. It was specifically used in the Cultivation World to test one's age.
The two put their hands on the stone and infused it with spiritual energy. The year rings lit up one by one, finally stopping at the seventeenth circle.
"You are not yet eighteen years old. You can participate in the competition."
"Name?"
"Lu Yang."
"Sect?"
"Seek Dao Sect."
"Huh?" The bailiff suddenly looked up, examining the other party as if seeing a ghost.
Lu Yang felt confused. "Is there a problem?"
The bailiff recalled words from the governor: Encourage participation in the grand competition. The more the merrier. Don't be afraid of those with powerful backgrounds participating in the competition. Instead, fear those with powerful backgrounds not participating.
The governor would probably be happy if two Disciples from the Seek Dao Sect participated.
"No, nothing. You can participate in the grand competition. And you, what's your name?"
"Meng Jingzhou, also from the Seek Dao Sect."
"Here are your numbers. In a quarter hour, we'll start the draw to determine the fight match-ups. Be ready."
"No problem!"
...
"Strange. The first round of the grand competition is about to begin. Why haven't we seen Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou yet?" Lan Ting sat in the judge's seat, somewhat puzzled.
"Perhaps they ran into some unexpected issues on their way, causing a delay." Bai Ming speculated. This was a common occurrence; he often encountered unexpected situations when he was out for experience and training.
"Wait." Yan Tianzhi was as always, sparing with words.
As Lan Ting had just gotten to know Yan Tianzhi and was not familiar with him, Bai Ming told her that Yan Tianzhi was always a man of few words and that hoping he could give remarks was rather unlikely.
Lan Ting could only sigh in helplessness. It looked like the heavy responsibility of giving remarks rested on her.
The spectators below noticed the three people sitting in the judges' stand and began murmuring quietly.
"Who are these three people? They look very young. Can they be judges?"
"Especially that little girl, she is pretty, but I've never seen anyone so beautiful. But she doesn't seem to have much battle experience."
"That's where you're wrong. These three are Disciples of the Immortal Sects and are regarded as favored sons of heaven. I've heard that they are all outstanding among those of the same age within their Sects!"
"More than that, I have someone in my family who works in the government office. He said all three of them are at the Golden Core Stage!"
"Golden Core Stage?!"
"Now you know how big the talent gap is, right?"
Those participating in the competition are only at the Foundation Establishment stage at most. For the Golden Core Stage to give evaluations to those at the Foundation Establishment stage is more than enough.
Having glanced at the information of the cultivators participating in the first round, Lan Ting spoke in a soft tone, "The first competitor is Feng He, a true disciple of the Seven Emotions Sect, a First Class sect. Not long ago, Feng He successfully broke through to the Foundation Establishment stage without relying on a Foundation Establishment Pill.
He relied on the foundations he laid during the Qi Refinement stage. He's now a cultivator at the early stage of Foundation Establishment."
"The Seven Emotions Sect's approach to Cultivation involves expressing insights into the seven emotions and six desires through the path of rhythm and melody. Feng He, who has grasped the true teachings of the Seven Emotions Sect, is skilled in the way of rhythm and melody. When he plays the piece "Distance from Joy," birds pause in flight, and flower buds bloom!"
"Feng He is also a seeded player in this grand competition, so let's look forward to his performance!"
Feng He's mouth curled in a confident smile. With his status at the early stage of Foundation Establishment, he was certain to stand out in this grand competition.
Traveling through the world, one relied either on power or reputation.
This grand competition was the starting point for him to gain a reputation!
"The competitor against Feng He is a cultivator who signed up on the spot. He is... Lu Yang from the Seek Dao Sect?!"
Midway through her announcement, Lan Ting almost lost her composure.
She put down the file in her hand and looked towards the stage. Upon seeing the familiar figure, she made a very peculiar expression.
She turned her head to look at Bai Ming, whose expression mirrored hers.
Seeing Lan Ting and Bai Ming on the stage, Lu Yang first waved at them, then scratched his head in confusion.
What's going on?
Wasn't it said that we were participating in the grand competition? Why are you two sitting in the judges' seats?

chapters.title: Chapter 355 - 354: How to Comment On This?_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang on the stage and Meng Jingzhou down below fell into deep thought simultaneously.
The Eldest Senior Sister said that it was the Qingzhou government office that invited the Seek Dao Sect's disciples to participate in the grand event. The standard was for cultiavtors under the age of 18, and since they both wanted to engage with the younger generation, they signed up for the tournament; their logic was impeccable and they couldn't find any flaw.
But why are Lan Ting, Bai Ming, and an unfamiliar person sitting on the stage?
Are they all over 18-years-old?
When the people below the stage heard that Lu Yang was from the Seek Dao Sect, they gasped in surprise.
They did not expect that people from the Five Great Immortal Sects will participate in this grand event, a circumstance they haven't heard of before.
"But who is Lu Yang? Have any of you heard of him?" The crowd was bewildered. The reputation of the Seek Dao Sect was well-known, but not many people knew Lu Yang.
"I've never heard of him, I only know about his opponent, Feng He."
"Same for me. I heard that Feng He got on the path of immortality by absorbing energy into his body after hearing music, after his Foundation Establishment, he obtained a damaged ancient zither at an auction, which seemed to be an object possessed by a Great Power. A Tribulation Cultivator started to get greedy and attempted to snatch it.
But, a early-stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator and two late-stage Qi Refinement Cultivators were captured by Feng He with the power of the ancient zither."
Lu Yang's name was not as well-known as the hot seed players.
The experiences of all those popular seed players were boosted by the sect behind them. It helped lay down their reputation, they were publicized as having come down the mountain to eliminate pests for the people, killing mountain bandits, evil spirits, and demons, or they were said to be the first place in the sect competition, and were unparalleled in the same realm.
At the worst, they were propagated as born into a miserable life, their parents died early, their life was full of difficulties, they overcame numerous obstacles in their cultivation... Anyway, their publicity was all about attracting attention.
Furthermore, there are others like Lan Ting, Bai Ming, Yan Tianzhi, etc. When they were on sect missions, their actions of stamping out corruption and eliminating evil were not few, even when the local gentry, the town chief, and the County Magistrate saw them, they would be very respectful, fearing that they would use the law enforcement power of the Immortal Sects.
Their deeds were also circulated among the people, and their fame was even greater than the popular seed players.
In contrast, Lu Yang, in the Foundation Establishment Stage, infiltrated the Eternity Sect, killed the Rudder Master of the Yanjiang Rudder simultaneously acting as a County Magistrate, then trapped the deputy master of the Eternity Sect in the Seek Dao Sect, and finally directly wiped out the Eternity Sect, which had a history of 14,000 years.
In the Golden Core Stage, he pretended to be an ancient genius and established Heaven's Court, deceiving the Nine Nether Sect into temporarily giving up their intention to kill, and started a barbecue shop instead.
These matters needed to be kept secret and even if they were told no one would believe it.
"So it's a fellow Daoist from the Seek Dao Sect, come and fight!" Feng He was full of confidence, he revealed a hearty smile, took out an ancient zither which was completely intact from his storage ring which glittered in the sunlight due to the golden strings on it.br>
His Master had someone authenticate it, this ancient zither used to belong to a Cultivator in the Spirit Transformation Stage. It was now back to seventy percent of its original capacity.
Although it cannot exert all its power like it did in the hands of a Spirit Transformation Cultivator, this kind of magic instrument, even if only a little of its power is stimulated, it would be unmatched in the same realm.
Feng He indeed had the capital to be proud, Lu Yang had more than a dozen Junior Brothers and Sisters, who were all in the same generation as him, and were all under the age of 18.
They were also just establishing their foundations, and the fastest ones might be in the mid-stage of Foundation Establishment.
Feng He's talent in cultivation was clearly visible.
Of course, Lu Yang's Junior Brothers and Sisters were raised separately, whereas Feng He was carefully nurtured by his sect, they were not entirely comparable.
Facing a peer who was so confident, Lu Yang did not take it lightly and used the Invincible Elixir.
The Invincible Elixir quickly gave results.
"Just hit however you want."
Ding——
The bell-like sound of the ancient zither echoed in the air, its voice was as strong as a dragon and as fierce as a tiger. Golden light began to vibrate; a strong sound wave was emitted towards Lu Yang. In a flash, the music from the ancient zither was like a white serpent drawing a precise arc in the air; the sound wave carried a fiery breath and power with it, overflowing with murderous aura.
Feng He made the first move, filled the ancient zither with his magic power, and took the lead in the battle.
No matter whether Lu Yang hard-resisted this offensive or attempted to dodge it, Feng He had already calculated his next move.
A fight, it has to be filled with calculations!
"Sound wave incarnation! He's already learned this technique just after his Foundation Establishment?" A Cultivator with extraordinary insight exclaimed. Many Cultivators who researched music spent decades to master this technique, and yet it was mastered by a newcomer like Feng He.
"I heard that Feng He defeated an old Foundation Establishment Cultivator using this method!"
"At that time, the zither was still damaged, and now that it's been repaired, its power will only be stronger!"
"He is using his trump card right at the start!"
"Can Lu Yang from the Seek Dao Sect withstand this move?"
Lu Yang, faced with the sound wave incarnation, did not slack in the slightest, he put in his best effort and swung his right hand sharply downwards, directly breaking off the ghastly sound wave.
He took a step forward and extended his index finger, and the invisible Sword Qi was launched. Feng He could not react to this move. The magic instrument protected him automatically, blocking him from the front.
The Sword Qi was sharp and heavy; it hit the ancient zither, causing shock to Feng He's organs. Feng He, clutching the ancient zither, was thrown off the stage.
The Cultivators below the stage were quiet for a moment, after which they burst into a discussion that made one's scalp tingle.
"Did you see that move just now? Was it Sword Qi? It's my first time seeing Sword Qi!"
"He broke the sound wave with one slap, and defeated Feng He with one move, this Lu Yang is so strong!"
"What realm is he in?!"
Lan Ting on the judges' seat was silent for a long time.
She thought it was a pretty simple task when she accepted the Commission from the State Shepherd. It was nothing more than small fights by Foundation Establishment Cultivators, and evaluating their pros and cons was not difficult.
However, the turn of events at present was something she did not anticipate.
How should she put it? Should she praise Lu Yang for defeating the seed player Feng He with his Golden Core Stage Cultivation Level?
She just couldn't say it.
She could praise Feng He's sound wave attack, as it shows his talent in music, and that he would undoubtedly become a great talent in the future.
However, Feng He's impressive sound wave was dispersed by Lu Yang with a single slap.
She turned to look at Bai Ming and Yan Tianzhi. Bai Ming was silent as if he had temporarily gone blind and could not see the situation on the stage, Yan Tianzhi said a word, "good."
Good? What is good? Is he praising how Lu Yang skillfully executed the Sword Qi? It did not harm Feng He, but knocked him off the field. The control of power has reached the pinnacle.
Just as Lan Ting was puzzled, she heard Yan Tianzhi spit out three more words: "Such shamelessness."
Lan Ting:"..."
It seems that she could not count on these two.
She took a long breath and commented after racking her brains, "Feng He's sound wave attack just now was unexpected, he is worthy of being known as a musical genius. Other seed players, even if they could block it, would have suffered a great loss of vital energy and fall into fatigue."
"Unfortunately, this time Feng He's opponent is Lu Yang. Lu Yang is a sword cultivator, he is dedicated to swordsmanship with no distractions, pursuing the highest level of Swordsmanship. This invisible Sword Qi contains the world in its essence, and its influence demonstrates his accomplishments in Swordsmanship!"
"Of course, all of the above were not the key factors in Lu Yang's victory. The most crucial point is, Lu Yang is at the Golden Core Stage."

chapters.title: Chapter 356 - 355: Overranked Battle, Counterattack Foundation Establishment_1
chapters.content:
"Golden Core Stage?!"
"Calling it monstrous isn't even an exaggeration!"
"This is rare even in history, isn't it?"
"Not just rare. According to historical records, one may not even appear in hundreds of years; a Golden Core stage cultivator under eighteen."
People did not know the ages of Lan Ting and the others.
Actually among the three, Bai Ming was the oldest, just over eighteen years of age, while Lan Ting and Yan Tianzhi were still a few months short of turning eighteen.
The pressure on the contesting cultivators escalated, especially for those seeded players. They were confident, working hard in their Foundation Establishment, thinking that they could certainly defeat many opponents and win the first prize.
They never thought that a Golden Core stage cultivator would participate in this grand event.
What kind of luck is this?
Foundation Establishment stage against Golden Core stage, they were merely swinging their fists in the air.
Among the competing cultivators, only one person revealed an excited smile, whispering to himself, "Golden Core stage, huh? Interesting."
He was dressed in a black cape, and his face couldn't be seen clearly.
He traveled across the continent, happened to pass by Qingzhou, and noticed that this place was hosting a grand event, hence he decided to participate on a whim.
The cultivation level he revealed to others was at the early stage of Foundation Establishment, but his actual cultivation was not like that.
His name was Zhou Fangge, and his real cultivation level was at the late stage of Foundation Establishment.
"I haven't had a chance to fight against a disciple of the Immortal Sect. Although this Lu Yang cultivates faster than me, cultivation level isn't everything in a fight."
"Even if his cultivation speed is fast, it won't be much faster. He should've just formed his golden core."
Zhou Fangge had once defeated a cultivator at the early Golden Core stage. The battle was somewhat difficult, but he eventually won.
"There's no reason I can't try to fight."
"Hehe, Lu Yang, I hope you'll be a fitting whetstone!"
...
"Get ready, it's your turn soon." Lu Yang fist bumped Meng Jingzhou. It was quite interesting to participate in this kind of large-scale exchange activity for the first time.
"They're all at the same age. Maybe some powerful opponents are hidden among them."
Meng Jingzhou laughed, "Are you saying that I didn't do my best in my last fight?"
They always fought cautiously and never slacked off.
On the jury's bench, Lan Ting watched as Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou fist-bumped, her eyelids twitching. She sent Bai Ming a voice transmission, "When it's Meng Jingzhou's turn to fight, you're going to comment."
Seeing the killing glare in Lan Ting's eyes, Bai Ming nodded heavily, forced to accept the task.
...
The fight was ongoing, with exciting spells being cast one after another. As they were facing people of the same age, both sides did not dare to let their guards down. Battle of wits, meticulous scheming, magic techniques hidden in the shadows...
The two sides put their all into the fight, providing a great spectacle for the cultivators in the audience.
Most of the cultivators in the audience were at the Qi Refinement stage, they couldn't have imagined that even at the Qi Refinement stage, such spectacular battles could occur.
Even those sect cultivators responsible for talent scouting repeatedly nodded their heads, deeming this year's event of high quality.
"We're more than halfway through the competition, right? Including the first one who came on stage, we've already seen five Foundation Establishment cultivators. There weren't that many in the previous years."
"No kidding, especially the fifth one who's at mid-stage Foundation Establishment. He would have been a surefire champion in previous years!"
Bai Ming glanced at the list of participants and introduced, "This competing cultivator is from the Ocean Sect, Shang Deshui. He's also a popular seeded cultivator. At the early stages of Foundation Establishment, he excels in water-based magic skills, especially his Water Control Technique, which is commendable."
Talking about the Water Control Technique, Bai Ming's eye twitched involuntarily, recalling how he was defeated in one move by Lu Yang's Diving Spell.
Shang Deshui revealed a confident smile, as being at the early stage of Foundation Establishment could easily dominate the preliminary rounds.
"Shang Deshui's opponent is a cultivator who registered for the competition at the last minute, Meng Jingzhou from Seek Dao Sect."
Meng Jingzhou was full of smiles as he greeted Bai Ming.
"How is there another person from the Seek Dao Sect?" Shang Deshui's smile froze on his face. Wasn't one person enough, and now there were two?
Was the Qingzhou grand gala such a big event that it required two disciples from the Seek Dao Sect to participate?
Keep calm, keep calm, just because they are disciples of the Seek Dao Sect does not mean they are at the Golden Core Stage. Cultivators at the Foundation Establishment Stage who are under eighteen are met once every few hundred years. The opponent at most could be at the late stage of Foundation Establishment. With clever maneuvering, there's a chance of victory.
Shang Deshui encouraged himself and from his sleeve took out a small vial. The vial contained water from the depths of the East Sea that he had spent a hefty price on. It was pure and suitable for implementing water-based magic skills.
"Water Control Technique - Emulate Snake!"
Water vapor surged, waves spilled out, and the deep sea water from East Sea transformed into fine threads and drilled out from the vial. The amount of deep water from East Sea accumulated, shifting shape and forming into a ferocious python.
"Go!"
The python opened its wide bloody mouth, charging towards Meng Jingzhou with the speed of lightning. It seemed like a raging tsunami, howling upon approach. The horrifying aura emitted by the python shocked everyone present.
"Shocking Heaven Six Forms!"
Meng Jingzhou prepared his stance and with one punch, crushed the python. The python exploded, transforming into a downpour of rain. The strength of the punch did not diminish, stopping right in front of Shang Deshui. Unable to withstand the force of the punch, Shang Deshui staggered backward several steps and fell off the platform.
Bai Ming: "..."
For a golden core stage cultivator like you dealing with the Shocking Heaven Six Forms as if you were up against Lu Yang!
Bai Ming gave a serious commentary: "The Water Control Technique's mimicry repertoire is divided into three stages: Emulate Snake, Emulate Lizard, Emulate Dragon. It's usually said that only when one reaches the late stage of Foundation Establishment can one grasp the basics of the Water Control Technique.
For Shang Deshui to apply the Water Control Technique so proficiently in the early stage of Foundation Establishment, emulating a python, truly deserves applause."
"It's evident that Shang Deshui has been diligently practicing off stage, and has a profound understanding of the Dao of Water which is rarely seen at his age. I have only seen this level of comprehension from a few of my junior brothers."
"Victory and defeat on the Cultivation path are predetermined. Hopefully, Shang Deshui won't be shaken by this defeat, and will continue to study the Dao of Water."
"Meng Jingzhou is at the Golden Core stage. Commentary complete."
Below the stage, the crowd was once again in turmoil, filled with admiration for the Seek Dao Sect.
Golden Core Stage, another cultivator under eighteen who has reached the Golden Core Stage.
Is the Seek Dao Sect so powerful?
Geniuses, who are seen only once every several hundred years, have appeared twice in succession!
The first round of preliminaries ended. Apart from the noticeably outstanding Golden Core Stage cultivators Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, the top ten included outstanding Foundation Establishment Stage cultivators. As for the fifty cultivators at the consummation stage of Qi Refinement, they were no longer the center of attention.
Lu Yang was particularly elated in the following battles. His next and following contestants were both at the early stage of Foundation Establishment.
The Invincible Elixir's advice was to deal with them casually.
Lu Yang couldn't help but sigh. It's been a long time since he's encountered such an effortless battle.
Recalling his strenuous battles at the Seek Dao Sect, Lu Yang felt that this kind of competition suited him better.
Fairy Eternity, watching this scene, felt a warm familiarity. It was like returning to the beautiful times of the ancient era, engaging in the thrill of cross-level battles. She clamored to take control of the body and experience it herself.
Out of reluctance, Lu Yang could only cede control of the body to Fairy Eternity in the next battle, letting her have her thrill.
Meng Jingzhou had a similar reaction to Lu Yang. Ever since he joined the Seek Dao Sect, apart from that time with the Five Elements Sect, he didn't even have a decent battle with cultivators of the same age.
Battling with peers was indeed satisfying.
He was even luckier; his opponents in the next two rounds were both at the stage of Consummation of Qi Refinement.
Watching Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, who were still grinning from ear to ear, the trio of Lan Ting pretended not to know them.
The four rounds of competition ended, and the top eight emerged.
Aside from the undisputed Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, there were Zhou Fangge, who had hidden his cultivation level, a cultivator at mid-stage Foundation Establishment, and four early-stage Foundation Establishment cultivators.
According to the competition rules, the top eight would engage in a large-scale chaos chess match to examine the cultivators' ability to respond to random situations and their ability to work together as a team.

chapters.title: Chapter 357 - 356: Invincible Elixir: Never Fought Such a Wealthy Battle_1
chapters.content:
"Six at Foundation Establishment Stage, two at Golden Core Stage, this lineup is..." Cultivators who were lucky enough to reach the quarterfinals showed troubled expressions.
According to the tradition of previous years, the top eight would battle it out on the arena, with rankings to be determined by the sequence of elimination.
So, they had made plans with the help of their sect elders, calculating how to knock out their opponents and stay alive as long as possible.
The strategies included but were not limited to: pretending to collaborate, backstabbing, playing the role of spies, turning their coats when it mattered the most...
Now, none of their plans would work. The only way to win was for the six cultivators in the Foundation Establishment Stage to join forces against Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
Just as the seeded cultivators were pondering their response, a steady voice rang out: "If you follow my command, we might still have a chance of victory."
The cultivators turned to see that among them, the speaker was the only one in the mid-stage of Foundation Establishment.
"Ah, it's Young Master Yan of the Yan Family."
The Yan Family was a large clan in Qingzhou with a history of six thousand years and a lineage that had never been broken. Among them were three elders in the Unification Stage. Even the Governor treated the Yan Family with politeness.
"If Young Master Yan gives the orders, that could work."
Once someone took the lead, the other cultivators also nodded in agreement. Young Master Yan held the strongest cultivation level among them and had the support of the Yan Family, which gave him the highest prestige. Making him the leader was something they all readily accepted.
"Zhou Fangge, what about you?" Young Master Yan turned his gaze to the young man in the black robe.
"I have no objections." Zhou Fangge grinned, "But I have one condition. The five of you deal with Meng Jingzhou, and I'll take care of Lu Yang by myself."
The group was furious, believing Zhou Fangge to be utterly arrogant. "Are you joking? With your mediocre performance thus far, you seriously believe you can defeat Lu Yang all by yourself?!"
In the current situation, the only hope lay in the six of them uniting to tackle Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou. But this one man seemed to be calling for his own death, which infuriated them.
Suddenly, Zhou Fangge revealed his true cultivation level, which changed everyone's expressions. His cultivation level was even more formidable than Young Master Yan's.
"Late stage Foundation Establishment?!"
They hadn't expected him to be late-stage Foundation Establishment; he had concealed that quite well.
If it weren't for Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, this man would pose the greatest threat.
Think about it. In a chaotic eight-person melee, if Zhou Fangge revealed his true cultivation level at the critical moment, who could resist him?
Zhou Fangge had already anticipated their reactions and casually remarked, "Now, am I qualified to face Lu Yang alone?"
"Actually, I could've already formed my golden core, and it would have been an assured upper third-grade level one. However, I restrained myself because I want to form a first-grade golden core."
Young Master Yan frowned, advising, "Forgive my straightforwardness, but even if you were at late-stage Foundation Establishment, your chance of defeating Lu Yang isn't very high."
Zhou Fangge showed a teasing smile, "Actions speak louder than words. If Young Master Yan doesn't believe me, just wait and see."
"All right, the final round is about to begin. Let's head to the stage."
Zhou Fangge laughed heartily and strode onto the stage.
Seeing Zhou Fangge's confidence, Young Master Yan felt reassured. If the other was this certain, then he must have something to rely on. Regardless of what that was, as long as it could defeat Lu Yang, it was enough.
"As you all know, my family, the Yan Family, is most famous for its 'Weapon Encyclopedia', which boasts unparalleled offensive capabilities. I was instructed by my ancester since childhood and understand the 'Weapon Encyclopedia' best. I'll initiate the attack."
"Gu Qisheng, your Profound Yin Body carries three layers of coldness with every attack. Even if I were to face you, I might not have a good outcome, so you and I will attack Meng Jingzhou together."
"Shi Xuan, you excel at Array Methods. Use them to disrupt Meng Jingzhou."
"Yang Xianyi, you are a true successor in the art of Talismans. Depending on the situation, provide us support using talismans."
"Sima He, your Clan is famous for the Sweet Dew Technique. In previous battles, your recovery speed was faster than the speed of your opponents' attacks. Stand at the end of the line and help me and Gu Qisheng recover from our injuries!"
Young Master Yan made arrangements one by one, and swiftly, a small temporary team with clear tasks was formed.
...
"Senior Brother Meng, please provide guidance!" Young Master Yan clenched his fist in determination.
"Senior Brother Meng, please provide guidance!" The other four cultivators chorused.
Meng Jingzhou was a little taken aback. Before the match, he and Lu Yang had agreed to take on three opponents each, so why were there five on his side?
Without giving Meng Jingzhou extra time to think, Young Master Yan brandished a sword in his left hand and an axe in his right. His weapons whirled with astonishing speed, like a dragon darting through clouds and an eagle striking through the sky. Their ferocious and swift movements were impressive to witness.
Gu Qisheng tensed every muscle in his body, the tip of his spear trembled, and with a soft whistle, he thrust it at Meng Jingzhou. True Qi surged wildly, a gust of wind suddenly arose, and the scene was awe-inspiring.
The other three were also not idle. A dazzling array rose beneath Meng Jingzhou's feet which made him feel as if he were sinking in a mire, immobilized.
Paper sparrows, folded from talismans, flew out from Yang Xianyi's sleeve, blocking all possible escape routes for Meng Jingzhou.
Sima He whispered incantations that were then heard by Young Master Yan and Gu Qisheng. Their Lingtai were instantly cleared, their Spiritual Sense temporarily surged, allowing them to cast aside all distractions and focus wholeheartedly on the fight. The weapons in their hands became all the more powerful!
The seamless cooperation of the five cultivators attracted shouts of astonishment from the audience below the stage. The cultivators in the Golden Core Stage who were spectating even showed subtle changes in their expressions, believing this situation to be quite tricky, and fearing they wouldn't be able to retreat unscathed.
For cultivators in the Golden Core Stage, being injured by those at the Foundation Establishment Stage was seen as quite a disgrace.
Lu Yang turned his attention away, looking at Zhou Fangge with a hint of confusion, "Is it just you? Aren't you merely at the late stage of Foundation Establishment?"
Zhou Fangge was taken aback. This was the first time he had ever met someone who could see through his realm since he had begun his cultivation. But he remained unfazed, laughing coldly, "I alone will be enough."
He had previously defeated a novice at the Golden Core Stage without even using his hidden tricks, relying on his solid foundation and skills to win. To face an elite cultivator like Lu Yang, he naturally wouldn't be able to win as easily.
So he decided to use his trump card.
He understood the mentality of cultivators with higher cultivation levels: the higher their cultivation level, the higher their standards. They would only fight with cultivators of the same level and typically looked down upon those with lower levels. When their opponents were of a lower level, they would unconsciously let down their guard. That was the opportunity he was waiting for!
He wanted to show Lu Yang that cultivation level wasn't everything! True strength was the key!
Seeing Zhou Fangge's confidence, Lu Yang assumed he had some astounding methods up his sleeve, so he didn't underestimate him. Taking out his Green Peak Sword from his Identity Jade, he prepared to respond at full strength. Then, he used the Invincible Elixir to find a countermeasure.
The Invincible Elixir sucked in a bit of Lu Yang's spiritual essence and started spinning. It quickly gave an analysis.
"Your opponent is in the late stage of Foundation Establishment, and there's a slight gray tinge in his black pupils which is a characteristic of the Boundless Dao Body type. Boundless Dao Bodies have limitless resources, space without boundaries, their spiritual essence reserves are ten times that of those at the same level, and they excel at long-term battles.
If the battle drags on, it will work against you. They rarely find matches at their own level and often challenge those in the higher levels."
Lu Yang continued, "How should I fight then?"
"Just fight however you like."

chapters.title: Chapter 358 - 357: Courtesy_1
chapters.content:
"What kind of nonsense Golden Core is this? All that talking, but the conclusion remains the same!" Lu Yang said angrily.
"How can you say it's nonsense? I am analyzing the situation for you," Fairy Eternity defended her Golden Core.
After all, she was the creator of the Invincible Elixir, and she wouldn't tolerate Lu Yang slandering it.
Just as Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity were having a heated discussion about the usefulness of the Invincible Elixir, Zhou Fangge seized the opportunity to strike.
"Kill!"
Zhou Fangge pulled out four small flags from his bosom and tossed them into the air. The flags were placed in the four directions of east, south, west, and north, surrounding Lu Yang!
Lu Yang felt a shadow overhead. Looking up, a small mountain had appeared above him, falling at an alarming speed.
"Mountain Shifting Divine Technique!" Lan Ting identified the magic skill used by Zhou Fangge. Even a cultivator at the Golden Core stage would find it difficult to exercise this divine technique. Zhou Fangge, using the four small flags, had performed a divine technique beyond his realm.
Zhou Fangge didn't underestimate his opponent. He immediately used one of his three trump cards, which could immobilize a Golden Core stage cultivator on the spot.
Faced with the rapidly approaching small mountain, Lu Yang countered with an ancient Great Divine Skill.
"Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth!"
Lu Yang opened his mouth wide and swallowed the small mountain, then burped contentedly.
"It's the Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth technique of the Taotie clan!" Bai Ming exclaimed incredulously. This was the foundational skill of the Taotie clan, and he hadn't expected Lu Yang to have learned it.
The difficulty of learning Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth was several levels higher than that of the Mountain Shifting Divine Technique.
It was even rumoured that not even a pure-blooded Taotie could master this bloodline divine skill at the Golden Core stage.
"I knew Lu Yang had more than one ancient Great Divine Skill!"
Yan Tianzhi narrowed his eyes, impressed. As expected of a cultivator who could challenge across levels, he'd even learned Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth technique.
He too knew Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth, but he used a shortcut, not like Lu Yang who learned it due to his own abilities.
Zhou Fangge was unprepared for his carefully planned trump card to be so easily countered.
"You're truly a disciple of the Immortal Sect, but I have already made preparations!"
Zhou Fangge clapped his hands together, and a glaring white light burst forth, emitting a piercing sound that forced everyone below the stage to cover their ears.
A bundle of scorching thunder and lightning accumulated in Zhou Fangge's palms. The reflection of the lightning painted a terrifyingly ominous shadow on his face.
"This is Palm Thunder," recognized Fairy Eternity.
"This is a skill developed by Yingtian Immortal. When I challenged Yingtian Immortal across levels, he used it, but he used it to surprise me by concentrating it at the sole of his foot. Later, this trick was passed down and, for some reason, it shifted to the palm of the hand."
"...Perhaps for aesthetic reasons."
As Lu Yang spoke, the Palm Thunder struck him squarely.
Boom——
The Palm Thunder exploded with terrifying energy, smoke and dust filling the air. The shockwave swept across the entire stage, affecting even Young Master Yan and others who were engaged in combat.
Zhou Fangge was panting heavily. The Palm Thunder was a technique he acquired from a Transcendance Tribulation stage inheritance, and his spiritual essence was ten times greater than that of others at the same level. However, executing the Palm Thunder completely depleted his spiritual essence.
"Even if you're at the early stage of Golden Core, taking this hit would either kill or injure you severely!" Zhou Fangge sneered coldly. This was the price for underestimating him.
"Oh, really? I was wondering why it didn't hurt." The sound of Lu Yang's voice came from within the smoke and dust, making Zhou Fangge shudder.
Just as Zhou Fangge readied himself to counter Lu Yang's attack, Lu Yang appeared behind him, smiling and patting Zhou Fangge's shoulder.
Zhou Fangge instinctively tried to dodge by leaping forward, but Lu Yang's hand was as heavy as a mountain, throwing him off balance.
Zhou Fangge swallowed a Qi Recovery Pill and looked at Lu Yang warily, "You are indeed a disciple of the Immortal Sect, you're unbeatable. I won't hold back now."
The cost of the third trump card, formidable enough to compete against the late stage Golden Core, was substantial. Nevertheless, Zhou Fangge was willing to risk it for victory.
Just as Zhou Fangge braced himself to use his final trump card, he felt a sudden loss of weight, and his surroundings rapidly blurred. It was Lu Yang, who had grabbed the sleeve of his robe and thrown him out of the game.
The warriors including Young Master Yan, who had been brimming with confidence before the battle, watched helplessly as Zhou Fangge was effortlessly defeated by Lu Yang.
Who could expect defeat when they had boasted so boldly about beating Lu Yang, who hadn't even used his full strength or raised his sword?
Following this, they heard disheartening words: "Haha, Old Meng, you're still not finished? You're fighting so slowly. Let me join in!"
Unable to bear the sight, the trio from Lan Ting closed their eyes.
Both Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were formidable enough to compete against those at the initial stage of the Nascent Soul. It was easier for them to fight against a group of Foundation Establishment Stage cultivators than it would be to fight children.
Upon seeing Lu Yang join the battle, the likes of Young Master Yan disregarded their pre-battle assignments and scattered in all directions to flee.
As opposed to fighting stubbornly, they found it was better to compete in a race of who could run fastest or who had the best luck, becoming the last one to leave the battleground. They'd even make do with the third place.
The audience, observing from below the stage, watched Lu Yang and his companion, who were gleefully chasing Young Master Yan and others around like chickens. This made them perceive the two men as anything but good people, leading to a spur of discussions.
"Why do I feel such pity for Young Master Yan and his crew?"
"It's true. Golden Core cultivators are fighting Foundation Establishment cultivators, and they seem so gleeful about it. How shameless!"
"Brother Meng, I am from Yan Family of Qingzhou, we both belong to influential families!" Young Master Yan announced his family background, striving to form a connection. As a member of an influential family, he had already heard a great deal about Meng Jingzhou.
Meng Jingzhou responded gravely, "This is a competition, there is no distinction of high or low, noble or humble. Victory or defeat should not be determined by one's status. If I were to handle you with kid gloves, it would be an insult to the competition. By doing so, you would tarnish the reputation of the Yan Family."
Young Master Yan cautiously questioned, "Wouldn't your participation in this competition being a Golden Core cultivator tarnish the reputation of the Meng Family?"
Of course not, I have run away from home."
Subsequently, Young Master Yan was kicked down.
Upon Gu Qi Sheng's voluntary exit from the battlefield, only Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were left.
"It seems that the determination of the first and second place lies between us." Lu Yang smiled. He had not fully shown his strength before and now he could finally flex his muscles.
Meng Jingzhou was also smiling, with the aura of his Golden Core conspicuously radiating as the pebbles on the ground vibrated, "We haven't fought against each other before. This does seem like an opportunity."
"It seems we are thinking along the same lines." Lu Yang released his aura, matching Meng Jingzhou's.
On the stage, their incredibly intense auras clashed, making the entire arena bubble and seethe like a boiling pot. It was unnerving.
Suddenly, Lu Yang remembered something and raised his head towards the judges' seat, "Just a moment, Lan Ting. I forgot to ask something."
"Go ahead."
"Is there a reward for the first place?"
Lan Ting revealed a sly smile, visible to Lu Yang as well, "Indeed there is."
"What is it?"
"The third place receives a reward of a golden core spirit treasure that can enhance the probability of forming the golden core by 50%, with a 10% chance of reaching First-Grade."
"The second place receives a golden core spirit treasure and the insights on forming the golden core treasured by the governor."
"Regarding the first place, aside from receiving a golden core spirit treasure and insights on golden core formation, the governor mentioned that the cultivators participating in the tournament lack battle experience and the wisdom on forming the golden core. So, we, the three judges, will personally teach the first place how to fight."
Lu Yang blinked his eyes and looked at Lan Ting and the other two judges, who were wearing strange smiles. Feeling a wave of goosebumps, he immediately turned around to jump off the stage.
"Old Meng, take the first place for yourself!"
Meng Jingzhou grabbed Lu Yang and tried to run off the stage himself.
"I've always been unfortunate. My fortune simply can't take being first. You can keep the first place!"

chapters.title: Chapter 359 - 358: Engage in Combat_1
chapters.content:
Boom——Boom——Boom——
On the stage, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were clashing with thunderous explosions. Their steps and movements were so subtle that they could evade attacks with minimal shifts.
Even the Golden Core cultivators in the audience, with the incredible control Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou possessed over their powers, were taken aback. They couldn't believe that these two were just at the beginning of the Golden Core Stage in such an intense battle.
Could this really be the level of control that the Golden Core Stage cultivators possessed?
"You have the Single-body Curse Fist, you can certainly handle three at once!"
"Nonsense, my Single-body Curse Fist only works on males, and after using it their combat power would actually double! You have the Lu Family's Arhat Fist, why are you afraid of just three people."
"Stop kidding, if I use the Arhat Fist, not only Lan Ting, the whole Laurel Fairy Palace won't let me off!"
"Besides, weren't you the one who wanted to be number one? I'll let you have it!"
"No rush, you be the first."
They began fighting for the second place.
In a one-on-one fight, neither of them feared anyone, but if they were to face three opponents at once, unless their brains were replaced by an Invincible Elixir, no one would make such a big gamble.
Lu Yang tried to jump off the stage, but Meng Jingzhou pulled him back by the shoulder. Meng Jingzhou wanted to jump off the stage, but Lu Yang grabbed his wrist and threw him back.
Both of them were so eager to jump off the stage only to be stopped by the other.
After a struggle, they both restrained each other and fell off the stage at the same time.
Bai Ming stood up and applauded: "Tied for first place, let's congratulate them with applause!"
Bai Ming skipped the post-match commentary, holding his Platinum Patterned Long Spear, and jumped straight onto the stage from the judges' seat.
Lan Ting and Yan Tianzhi followed closely.
"Congratulations, Brother Lu Yang, Brother Meng Jingzhou. You've beaten so many genius Foundation Establishment cultivators and won the first place!" Bai Ming said coldly, barely containing a smirk.
"I think there might be some misunderstanding between us, Lan Ting. You know me, I've never bullied the weak!" Lu Yang cried out.
"Charge!" Bai Ming didn't give Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou a chance to speak. He was eager to come to blows since he didn't know when he could have this opportunity again.
As the most talented person in the Five Elements Sect, it was hard for him to find suitable opponents. No one in the same realm could beat him, and it wasn't satisfying to fight those above his realm.
All things considered, the only ones who could be his equal were four other disciples of the Immortal Sects.
He lifted his spear, leaving a white mark on the stage.
Lu Yang raised his sword to fend it off and tipped away the spear point, not daring to be careless.
"Good spear, such a pressure! I never felt this kind of pressure when fighting the Foundation Establishment cultivators on the stage earlier!"
Interest flashed in Lu Yang's eyes. If Bai Ming wished to fight, then they would have a real fight.
The purpose of attending the Qingzhou Fair was to communicate with people of the same age after all.
Bai Ming was enraged by Lu Yang. His spearhead ignited with Sun True Fire, causing the temperature on the stage to skyrocket. Even the audience, protected by the Array Method, could feel the heat wave on the stage.
Lu Yang raised an eyebrow. He remembered that Bai Ming had used the Golden Crow Flame at the Foundation Establishment Stage. It seemed that after advancing to the Golden Core Stage, his Golden Crow Flame also transformed into the Sun True Fire, famous on par with the Pure Yang True Fire.
Of course, in terms of power, it wouldn't match Meng Jingzhou's Pure Yang True Fire, the latter obtained from two Single Golden Elixirs.
No one from the single spiritual root lineage has ever tried such a radical method in the past.
"Break!" Lu Yang shouted softly, the sound of the Green Peak Sword piercing the air reverberated throughout the stage. Those with lower realms felt a sting in their eyes, as though they had been pricked by needles.
"It's Sword Qi!" A Golden Core cultivator in the audience was horrified. He had heard that once Sword Qi reached a certain realm, even looking at it could harm the body.
He had never seen anyone improve their Sword Qi to such a degree before.
Unexpectedly, Lu Yang, who is just at the early Golden Core Stage, has already achieved realm where his Sword Qi can hurt people.
The Sword Qi breaks through the Sun True Fire on the tip of the spear. The True Fire falls on the ground, burning one small pit after another.
When Young Master Yan teamed up to fight Meng Jingzhou just now, there was not even a trace of damage on the stage.
Lu Yang laughed heartily, brimming with high spirit: "Lan Ting, you and Bai Ming, come at me together!"
Lan Ting gave a faint smile: "Then, as Senior Brother Lu Yang said."
The belt of her skirt fluttered like a swimming dragon, swirling around Lu Yang. Suddenly tightening, it aimed to trap Lu Yang.
"Ground-Eater!"
Lu Yang was prepared, drilling into the ground, making the belt snatch at nothing.
"This girl is kind of interesting, she also has an Immortal body, you're in for a fight." The Fairy Eternity was observing the outside world while lying on a bed in the Spiritual Space.
"Lan Ting is also an Immortal body?" Lu Yang thought Lan Ting had a Single Spiritual Root.
"Yes, she's a Primordial Immortal Body. It's said to be the first Immortal Body mastered by the human race. Before the system of cultivation was established, the universal method of cultivation of the human race was Qi Refinement. People who were successful in Qi Refinement were called Qi Refiners."
"However, the Qi Refiners' way of cultivation did not have universality and was gradually phased out by the human race."
"The creator of the Qi Refiners was a Primordial Immortal Body. He pioneered the cultivation of the human race, led humans to resist Demon Beasts and natural disasters. This allowed the human race to secure a foothold in primitive times. Because of this, his Immortal Body was named after the dawn of the Primordial, it was the dawn of the human race."
"How about it? Do you want me to help you?"
"No need, I'll try the Invincible Elixir."
...
Yan Tianzhi quietly walked up to Meng Jingzhou. There was a faint glow flickering on his back and spreading to his neck. Meng Jingzhou only then noticed a tattoo on the guy.
An image of a demon-beast emerged behind him — a creature with the body of a sheep, tiger's teeth, eyes under its armpits, and its cry was like a baby's wailing, annoying and irritating.
"Taotie?" The crowd beneath the stage stirred, not understanding what was happening.
A manager who came to select Sect's seeds recognized the origins of the Taotie, and explained to the surrounding people, "This is the War Pattern of the Prison Suppressing Sect. Starting from the Foundation Establishment Stage, you can tattoo images of demons and ghosts on your body to gain their powers and abilities, advancing one realm can add one type of Demon Beast."
"However, I'm seeing for the first time someone in the Golden Core Stage tattooing the Taotie War Pattern."
"So it's a senior brother from the Prison Suppressing Sect, our elders highly admire the War Pattern method of the Prison Suppressing Sect, I truly see its reputation is well-deserved today!" Meng Jingzhou saluted with a fist.
"Seek Dao Sect, Meng Jingzhou."
"Prison Suppressing Sect, Yan Tianzhi."
Yan Tianzhi opened his mouth, the illusion of the Taotie becoming more and more vivid, as if it was coming to life.
"Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth!"
A hurricane whipped up on the stage, a frightening suction force making it difficult for Meng Jingzhou to stand steady.
"Shocking Heaven Six Forms — Shaking Heaven and Earth!"
Meng Jingzhou responded steadily, the sound of his fist was like muffled thunder, punching the air to form a terrifying shockwave. One wave after another was absorbed by Yan Tianzhi into his abdomen, causing him a wave of sour pain and forcing him to interrupt the Taotie Divine Ability.
Meng Jingzhou was filled with internal strength. The earth shook and the wind howled, it was awe-inspiring. Yan Tianzhi seemed like a human-shaped Taotie, devouring everything in sight.
Their huge fists alternated, each collision sending out a thrilling roar. Sweat slid down their foreheads, and their faces were full of excitement.
They moved so fast they were almost shadow-like. People with weaker sight couldn't even see their figures. Some could see clearer, but their minds couldn't keep up with their fast movements.
"Is this really the combat power of the early Golden Core Stage?" The Golden Core Stage cultivators below the stage couldn't believe it, feeling as if they had wasted their Golden Core cultivation.
"What kind of Golden Core are they... right, isn't there a Golden Core appraisal conference? Call those people over to have a look!"

chapters.title: Chapter 360 - 359: Golden Core Appraisal Conference_1
chapters.content:
In the luxurious courtyard, dazzling flashes of gold were occasionally visible.
As the golden light dissipated, a golden core glistening with mist slowly rotated, as ethereal spiritual energy was drawn from all around.
"I had heard rumors about Daoist Yuan Zhi forming a Moon Embracing Gold Core, a core worthy of being an Upper Third Grade. Now that I've seen it, its reputation is indeed well-deserved," an old man with a white beard declared with a smile, his face creased from his enthusiasm.
"Oh, it's nothing remarkable. It took me a painstaking thirty years to finally form this Third Grade Moon Embracing Gold Core. Given Mr. Kang's knowledge, this core would seem unremarkable," Yuan Zhi modestly replied.
Mr. Kang was a deeply learned scholar passionate about his craft, a renowned academic recognized by the Imperial City Academy. His esteemed reputation in Qingzhou won him the respect of many.
Others quickly interjected: "Daoist Yuan Zhi, you are too modest. The formation of a Fourth or Fifth Grade golden core is already a considerable feat for us, let alone a Third Grade core. Most of us merely wish to successfully break our cores to reach Nascent.
Yet, you possess the potential to break through to Nascent Soul, achieve Spirit Transformation, and possibly even Refining the Void or Unification, a stage that would intimidate even those at Unification, you have limitless potential."
Having a Middle Third Grade golden core could provide one with a slim chance to cultivate to the Spirit Transformation Stage. However, this chance is so slight that they dare not hope for much, being at the Nascent Soul Stage would already be satisfactory.
In contrast, Yuan Zhi, with his Upper Third Grade golden core, was almost guaranteed to break his core and reach Nascent, with the possibility of Spirit Transformation, Refining the Void or even Unification, making his prospects infinitely brighter and his potential far greater than theirs.
Although Yuan Zhi humbly dismissed his achievement, he could not conceal his internal delight. His Upper Third Grade golden core had already surpassed ninety percent of those at the Golden Core Stage. Even though he was still at the early stage of his Golden Core, cultivators at the mid or late stage of their Golden Core would not dare to underestimate him.
Instead, they treated him with utmost courtesy.
The Golden Core Appreciation Conference was being held at the Pleasant Courtyard. Various cores were displayed, each breathtaking enough to elicit exclaims of admiration from the onlookers.
Yuan Zhi's Moon Embracing Gold Core was particularly captivating among the numerous golden cores, especially considering its distinction as a Third Grade golden core.
Just as Yuan Zhi was revelling in his accomplishment, a figure stumbled hurriedly into the courtyard.
"You should quickly go to the arena. It's unusually lively over there!" he exclaimed.
Recognizing the intruder as a Lower Third Grade of the Golden Core Stage cultivator without even the qualification to participate in the Golden Core Appreciation Conference, Yuan Zhi responded with disdain, "What could possibly be so interesting about the arena? It's just a few early-stage Foundation Establishment cultivators competing for first place."
"You're mistaken. The disciples from the Five Great Immortal Sects are there, clashing against one another. All of them are at the Golden Core Stage, and apart from the Suspension Temple, the other Four Great Immortal Sects are all participating!"
"Really?!"
"Disciples from the Immortal Sects are fighting?!" The crowd gasped in surprise, their excitement unmistakably evident given the rarity such an event.
Mr. Kang seemed the most zealous among all, asking impatiently, "Even the Seek Dao Sect's disciples are participating?"
"Indeed. And there are even two of them!"
Without a word, Mr. Kang, displaying a vigor that defied his age, hastened in the direction of the arena.
Witnessing his departure, others quickly followed suit, leaving Yuan Zhi standing bewildered.
"I would love to see what makes these disciples from the Immortal Sects stronger than myself!"
How capable could the disciples from the Immortal Sects be? Didn't they, like him, also possess an Upper Third Grade golden core?
Upon arriving, Yuan Zhi found the place around the arena so congested that it was challenging even to weave through the crowd.
Watching the top disciples from the Immortal Sects fight was a rarity that only occurred every several years. Considering how thrilling this single match was proving to be, the crowd felt their decision to attend the Qingzhou Gathering was well worth it.
Unfortunately, they were unable to clearly see the combat taking place on the arena.
Yuan Zhi had no choice but to use his magic skill discreetly to move to the front of the crowd, where he found his friends from the Golden Core Appreciation Conference.
The attendees of the Golden Core conference were so engrossed in observing the five fighters in the arena that they didn't notice Yuan Zhi's arrival. Their entire focus was fixated on the combatants, afraid they might miss even the slightest detail.
Other than Mr. Kang, among them were a few who had just reached the Golden Core Stage, still in the early stages.
As they watched the five combatants in the arena, an absurd realization dawned upon them. It was as if they hadn't formed their golden cores and were still in the Foundation Establishment Stage.
"How can they have such strength and speed at the Golden Core early stage?!"
Before even considering their combat skills, just the overwhelming power and speed showcased by Lu Yang and the other four fighters were more than enough to suppress them.
Compared to his fellow competitors, Yuan Zhi's ambitious spirit was deflated significantly.
He even doubted if he could last ten moves against any of the five fighters.
Could the difference between two Upper Third Grade Golden Cores be this enormous?
"Mr. Kang, have you managed to identify which golden core each of these disciples from the Immortal Sects possess?" The platform wasn't hosting a Golden Core Appreciation Conference, and the golden cores weren't openly displayed. Hence, the only way to discern the cores was by speculating from the intricate details of the battle.
Unfortunately, due to their limited experience, they could hardly decipher any solid information.
Mr. Kang's eyebrows furrowed as he admitted, "At this point, we can only confirm that they all possess First-Grade Golden Cores, and moreover, they seem to be among the top-ranking ones."
The crowd nodded in agreement. Only this explanation could justify the high combat power demonstrated by the five disciples from the Immortal Sects.
"That one called Meng Jingzhou has an overwhelming Yang Qi energy that's stirring the heavens, like a grand sun that would cause all spirits to retreat in fear. He seems to have either a Sun Golden Core or a Pure Yang Golden Core, but neither of those two cores seem to match his current intensity. Could there possibly be another golden core with even more Yang Qi?"
"That female disciple appears so graceful, as if she was a fairy. She exhales white mist, yielding a distant and lengthy aura with astonishing resilience. She seemingly embodies the dawn, akin to the legendary Primordial Golden Core. Sadly, there are not many accounts of the Primordial Golden Core in history, so I would not dare conclude. These young talents are indeed formidable."
Mr. Kang felt that even if the entire group of scholars from the Imperial City Academy were to arrive and examine in sequence, they still might not be able to discern anything conclusive.
...
In the arena, under the joint assault by Lan Ting and Bai Ming, Lu Yang was gradually being overpowered and pushed into a arduous battle.
"Lu Yang, stop pretending. I know you possess a cloning technique," Bai Ming, noticing Lu Yang showing signs of fatigue, took no chances as he was well aware that Lu Yang's true potential was not what was currently being displayed.
In their previous encounter, the one who had defeated him wasn't Lu Yang's real body, but his clone!
"Seems like I can't fool you," Lu Yang said, looking somewhat troubled. He had originally planned to lure Bai Ming closer before suddenly splitting into two individuals using his Tree-Planting Sutra, catching Bai Ming off guard.
"A cloning technique?" Lan Ting stared curiously at Lu Yang. "As expected of Brother Lu Yang, he has even mastered such a technique. His talent for magic skills is indeed the strongest I've ever seen."
Lu Yang took out the Twin Lotus seed and performed the Tree Growing Spell. As the lotus bloomed, Lu Yang and his lotus clone stood atop a lotus leaf.
"Even if you have a clone, can your spiritual sense allow you to control two bodies simultaneously?" Bai Ming was aware of the deficient nature of the cloning technique. The last time they fought, Lu Yang's real body was seated on the chairman's table, solely focusing on controlling the Wooden Avatar.
However, it was different this time as he needed to manipulate two individuals simultaneously, which demanded a high level of spiritual sense.
"Let's test it out." Lu Yang smiled. It was impossible before, but after forming his Golden Core, his spiritual sense had soared, unmatched by anyone within his realm.
Lu Yang glanced at the Green Peak Sword in his hand, paused for a while, then tossed it to his lotus clone for it to fight Lan Ting.
"I should forge another sword, but that can wait." Lu Yang prepared to face Bai Ming empty-handed.
"It's time to utilize the Invincible Elixir... How shall I defeat these two?"
Soon, the Invincible Elixir provided a response.
"Use the Arhat Fist against Bai Ming."
Lu Yang couldn't help but grin.

chapters.title: Chapter 361 - 360: The Power of the Invincible Elixir (Seeking Monthly Votes)_1
chapters.content:
Aside from the side effect of turning people bald, the Arhat Fist was the supreme fist technique of Buddhism.
Earlier, Lu Yang had been worried about accidentally harming Lan Ting, so he hadn't used it. Now, since Lan Ting was being managed by a clone, he was free to use the Arhat Fist against Bai Ming.
"I'd like to see you multitask!" Bai Ming was sure that Lu Yang couldn't control two bodies simultaneously. His sharp spear pierced forward like a dazzling star in the sky.
Lu Yang calmly watched the tip of the spear, a 'hollow' sound resonating from within his body, similar to Buddha chanting scriptures, liberating all beings.
His fist swung out, booming like thunder, with a momentum like a breaking bamboo. It clashed fiercely with the spear, arousing waves of ink-like ripples in the air.
"Arhat Fist!"
Ding——
The long spear trembled, emitting a metallic echo. His fist lightened and danced around the spear tip, pressing Bai Ming hard.
Bai Ming used his waist strength, tried to pull out his spear, but Lu Yang continued to attack the spear body with Arhat Fist. His spear shook uncontrollably and was hard to hold steady.
Bai Ming secretly exclaimed in his heart. He had been always on guard against Lu Yang's magical skills, but he did not expect that Lu Yang's unarmed combat was also so terrifying.
Seeing the fist about to hit him, Bai Ming's left hand began shaping a hand seal. A howling wind whipped above his head, the wind blade falling like a guillotine from the sky, aiming to split Lu Yang into two halves.
Taking this opportunity, Bai Ming dodged but was still grazed by the Arhat Fist.
"Such a heavy fist!" Bai Ming was shocked, thanking his stars for just escaping. The punch was so powerful and heavy, that even a glancing blow resulted in such injuries. If he took a direct hit, it would be unbearable.
I absolutely cannot be hit again.
Suddenly, a few black hairs fell, causing Bai Ming to pause. Before he could react, more and more black hair began to fall.
Wait, isn't this...
Bai Ming subconsciously touched his head, his face turning pale, "Where is my hair!"
Looking at the hair scattered all over the ground, Bai Ming glared at Lu Yang furiously.
"Unity of Fist and Cultivation, I didn't expect you to combine the fist technique and magic skill so perfectly; it caught me off guard!" Bai Ming forced himself to analyze coldly, not allowing himself to panic.
In the stands, a steady stream of cultivators continued to arrive to watch the fight.
"Hey, who is that bald guy? I thought the Suspension Temple didn't send anyone?"
"I heard something about an Arhat just now. Is this bald guy claiming to be an Arhat?"
"It must be fake, he doesn't even have the ring marks on his head."
Hearing the discussion from the stand, Bai Ming could no longer hold back his anger, "Lu Yang, you pushed me to this, Five Elements Rotating Spear Technique!"
"Five Elements Rotating Spear Technique? He even has learned this spear technique?" Mr. Kang exclaimed.
"What is the 'Five Elements Rotating Spear Technique'?" People around asked.
"This was created by an ancestor of the Five Elements Sect who was proficient in the Five Elements magic skills. It combines the Five Elements magic skills and spear technique, and only those who master them both can learn it. It's astonishing that this disciple of the Five Elements Sect is qualified to learn this spear technique."
"I have always felt that he exhibits the characteristics of the Five Elements Golden Core, but a Golden Core seems to lack this kind of offensive power!"
"Glow Gold!" The long spear, like a dragon, attacked Lu Yang at an incredible speed with overwhelming momentum.
Lu Yang stepped forward, Buddha's voice resonated, and again he used the Arhat Fist to hard-counter the long spear. The violent shockwaves swept across the eight directions.
His fists were like anvils, his aura ascended, and a fierce momentum surged between his fists and palms.
The clash of spear and fist shocked the audience below. Even the Nascent Soul Stage cultivators changed their expressions. They didn't have the confidence to withstand such high-frequency attacks.
"Is he really in the early stage of the Golden Core?"
"I've always heard that the disciples of the Immortal Sect are not to be judged by common sense. Seeing it today really is so!"
"I'm afraid even the ancient geniuses would be comparable."
"Even with the Great Era's emergence of numerous geniuses, I'm afraid it's hard to find a genius that can match them, right?"
This was the first time Bai Ming met a cultivator of the same realm who could resist him after using the Five Elements Rotating Spear Technique.
He gives a cold smile and stabs at the platform with his spear, a Earth Dragon rose from the ground, roaring like a tsunami, rushing towards Lu Yang.
Lu Yang shrinks the ground and sneaks from the bottom toward Bai Ming, who has expanded his spiritual sense and sees Lu Yang's actions clearly. He directs the spear downward.
"It's right here!"
A shocking scene occurred. Bai Ming saw Lu Yang's body suddenly shrink to slip past his spear.
"Big and Small Ruyi?!"
Although he anticipated that Lu Yang would use various divine abilities, the use of Big and Small Ruyi was still out of his expectations. Magic skills are systematic. Learning one magic skill would be helpful in learning similar ones.
In contrast with Lu Yang, Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth, Shrink land, Big and Small Ruyi, every magic skill seemed unrelated and he even had a hair-dropping skill that Bai Ming had never heard of before.
"So what?!"
Bai Ming's eighteen spears were all dodged by Lu Yang. Just when he was about to jab the nineteenth spear, he suddenly felt his body sink and was surrounded by darkness.
When Bai Ming was attacking Lu Yang, he didn't notice the shrunken Lu Yang had circled around him.
Just in time to perform the magic skill. Draw a ground prison.
"Another unidentifiable Earth magic skill!" Bai Ming couldn't tolerate being outdone in his earth magic skills. He used a spell to drill out of the ground, then suffered a heavy punch from Lu Yang.
"Drawing a ground prison!"
Lu Yang trapped Bai Ming in the ground prison once more.
Bai Ming tried to stay alert. Since he couldn't get out directly, he would try to go from elsewhere. He was deeply buried in the earth; gold, wood, water, and fire magic skills were of no assistance, only earth magic skills could be used.
He tried moving to another place, but as soon as he moved half his body, he heard Lu Yang's voice from above.
"Drawing a ground prison."
He was back to his original position.
"Earth Dragon ..." Bai Ming was attempting to summon an Earth Dragon with hand seals.
"Drawing a ground prison."
Bai Ming's body trembled. He disappeared from his original spot and reappeared, his hand seals disrupted.
"This isn't earth magic; it's space magic!" Bai Ming finally realized there was a problem.
"I don't believe it, Earth Dragon …"
"Drawing a ground prison." Lu Yang squatting on the ground drawing circles, using his spiritual sense to monitor Bai Ming. As soon as Bai Ming made any movement, he would disrupt it with 'Drawing a ground prison.'
After trying several times and getting the same result, Bai Ming was at a dead end.
"Fine, I surrender!"
There was no other choice but to surrender. When he rose to the surface and saw Lu Yang's grinning face, he nearly exploded with fury.
"If you hadn't been casting your spells faster than me..."
Bai Ming spoke with gritted teeth. He had been restricted by the speed of his magic casting. His earth magic skills were all large-scale attacks with slower casting speeds.
If he could cast his spells before Lu Yang cast "Drawing a ground prison," he could have escaped and continued the fight; the outcome would have been uncertain then.
Lu Yang didn't comment, vividly recalling the unbeatable elixir strategy given earlier in his mind: Bai Ming's spear technique is the outer layer, and the Five Elements magic skills are the root. When he strikes, he will definitely use the Five Elements magic skills as the base. The Five Elements enhance and restrain one another, combining them increases their power.
It's not suggested to give him any chance.
He suggested that using the Arhat Fist to anger the opponent, having him lose rational and providing a chance to use "Drawing a ground prison," limiting him underground, and forcing him to only use earth magic skills. By taking advantage of your faster casting speed, you can interrupt his casting, forcing him to surrender.
This is the most time and energy-saving plan.
(Added chapters for the alliance master left to support the motherland, right to hold the ancient moon ship immersing themselves in studying the Immortal Art)

chapters.title: Chapter 362 - 361: I Admit Defeat_1
chapters.content:
Frankly speaking, when the Invincible Elixir presented such a detailed strategy, Lu Yang was astounded.
Previously, the Invincible Elixir only had two plans, either to flee or fight blindly, causing Lu Yang to always regard it as a method of detecting cultivation levels.
Unexpectedly, it could indeed come up with a very reliable plan when facing a powerful enemy.
No wonder it's a Golden Core recognized by Fairy Eternity!
"Hehe, now you know how amazing my Invincible Elixir is, right?" Fairy Eternity, for once, got up from the bed and struck a triumphant pose, conjuring a chair, sitting on it, crossing her legs and swinging her feet.
"You should respect me more in the future. I know much more than just this!"
"Massage my shoulders, would you?" Fairy Eternity motioned for Lu Yang to massage her.
Lu Yang felt that as Yun Zhi's junior brother, the one with the highest cultivation level among his peers, the top Golden Core stage swordsman, and also a disciple of the Sect Leader of the Seek Dao Sect, it was quite alright for him to give a massage to a senior Immortal.
"Is this pressure okay?"
"A bit harder, mm~ that's about right." Fairy Eternity is very satisfied with Lu Yang's attitude.
...
When Bai Ming conceded, the audience was shocked. They didn't expect Bai Ming to lose so quickly.
As fellow disciples of the Immortal Sect, and both in the early stage of the Golden Core, the gap between them wasn't supposed to be that big.
"Isn't it said that Bai Ming is proficient in the Five Element magic skills? He just used gold and earth elements, and then he gave up?"
"If he didn't concede, what else could he do, stay in the ground all the time?"
"Bai Ming was wronged. He was restricted before he could show off his skills."
A cultivator with combat experience in the Demon Suppressing Pass was displeased with these remarks, and lectured, "Wronged because he lost? Who would say that on the battlefield? Does the enemy stupidly wait for you to perform all your moves?"
The one who was lectured stammered and couldn't respond.
"Mr. Kang, did you figure out what type of Golden Core Lu Yang has?" A group of folks at the Golden Core stage around the front of the stage were still waiting for Mr. Kang's explanation.
Although with their talent, they wouldn't be able to form a First-Grade Golden Core in their lifetime, it was good to broaden their horizons and they would have something to brag about when they returned.
Despite almost pulling out his white beard over contemplating, Mr. Kang couldn't decipher Lu Yang's Golden Core.
"I couldn't figure out the specific Golden Cores of Bai Ming and Yan Tianzhi, but at least there are some clues that can be followed. Bai Ming's Golden Core has to do with the Five Elements, Yan Tianzhi's Golden Core has to do with suppression, but Lu Yang's... forgive my poor judgment, I truly can't make anything out."
Mr. Kang shook his head. The wide variety of Golden Cores in the Seek Dao Sect was eye-opening, even to him, who had seen countless Golden Cores and was qualified to comment on any cultivator's Golden Core in Qingzhou, he couldn't recognize all of the Seek Dao Sect's Golden Cores.
There is a consensus in Imperial City Academy that if you can recognize one third to half of Seek Dao Sect's Golden Cores, you're a very advanced scholar.
"Perhaps Lu Yang's Golden Core is a kind that has never existed before, and there are no similar Golden Cores."
In the Golden Core Appreciation Conference, only the Primordial Gold Core of Lan Ting and the Pure Yang Golden Core of Meng Jingzhou could be vaguely identified.
Mr. Kang showed courtesy to Meng Jingzhou and changed Single Golden Elixir to Pure Yang Golden Core, which sounds much better.
On the stage, Lan Ting was still in hard combat with Lu Yang's Lotus clone, always distracted.
She saw a glimpse of the fight between Lu Yang and Bai Ming and all of Bai Ming's hair fell off due to an Arhat Fist.
She was afraid that Lu Yang's clone would throw away the Green Peak Sword and give her an Arhat Fist attack too.
"The safest way is not to get close to the clone."
Lan Ting distanced herself from Lu Yang's clone, took out a small box the size of a palm from her Identity Jade.
"What is this?" Lu Yang's clone used Spiritual Sense to check and found a stack of Talismans inside the small box. At the bottom of the box was some sort of Array Method, which seemed very familiar to him.
Lan Ting did not play coy: "After returning to the Fairy Palace, I have been studying the Automatic Skewer Formation day and night. However, my talent in Array Methods is limited, and I can't figure it out. The bamboo sticks always fly out at an amazing speed."
"So, I changed my approach. If bamboo sticks can fly out through the Array, can't Talismans do the same? Based on this idea, I made some modifications to the original Array, downsizing it and replacing the bamboo sticks with Talismans, like this."
Lan Ting aimed at Lu Yang's clone, activated the Array in the wooden box, and a paper Talisman flew out one after another. In mid-air, the Talismans transformed into thunder, fire, or wind blades, all carefully drawn by Lan Ting. Each could seriously injure a Golden Core stage cultivator, making Lu Yang's eyelids twitch.
Boom——
Clack——
Crash——
Each Talisman represented a different kind of attack, and there were no intervals between attacks. They hit Lu Yang's clone one after another, making different sounds.
Lu Yang's clone held the Green Peak Sword horizontally in front of him, his wrist constantly shaking to block the continuous attacks.
As the Talismans exploded, smoke and dust rose up in the arena. After a box of Talismans was used, the smoke and dust dispersed, revealing Lu Yang who was still in decent condition.
"Big Brother Lu Yang, you're really good. What if the attack is doubled?"
Lan Ting said, and took out two wooden boxes full of Talismans, aiming the output ends at Lu Yang's clone.
Just as Lan Ting was about to launch another round of attack, she saw Lu Yang walking over with a big smile: "Bai Ming has already conceded. It's only you left now."
