"He conceded?" Lan Ting was stunned. She was so caught up in launching Talismans that she didn't notice what was happening on Bai Ming's side. It was just a while ago. Did he lose already?
She turned her head to see Bai Ming sitting in the judges' seat, looking unhappy.
She turned her head back to see Lu Yang and his clone. She felt that winning isn't very likely: "Alright, I concede too."
Meng Jingzhou and Yan Tianzhi were fighting fiercely. Yan Tianzhi looked like a real Taotie, devouring everything. He was extremely ferocious.
Meng Jingzhou was even fiercer than him. He opened his mouth and, using the divine ability "Heaven Swallow" he just learned from Lu Yang, immediately vacuumed all the Spiritual Energy on the stage into his mouth.
"Spit!"
The Spiritual Energy was compressed to the extreme in his mouth, forming a spherical shape governed by rules, and stomped towards Yan Tianzhi.
Yan Tianzhi didn't dare to touch the Spiritual Energy ball, he rolled to dodge it. Meng Jingzhou sneered coldly: "I'll see how often you can dodge. Spit! Spit! Spit!"
Three Spiritual Energy balls blocked Yan Tianzhi's route of movement. Yan Tianzhi's eyes focused, and another War Pattern flickered.
"Shield Ghost!"
The ghastly demon king holding a shield emerged behind Yan Tianzhi. The demon king with the shield blocked Yan Tianzhi's face, and the Spiritual Energy balls exploded when they hit the shield.
It was Yan Tianzhi's battle pattern during the Foundation Establishment Stage, Shield Ghost. It possessed no aggressive properties, its only outstanding feature was its defense.
"I don't believe it, spit!"
Spiritual Energy balls flowed continuously from Meng Jingzhou's mouth, and the attack duration depended on how long it took for Meng Jingzhou to spit all his saliva.
Meng Jingzhou was so dry in the mouth from all the spitting, he took a gourd out from his Identity Jade and began to drink water. Once he finished, he said, "Brother, take my advice and concede earlier. It saves both of us trouble. Don't let me beat you until you can't even crawl. What would that look like when the news gets out?"
Yan Tianzhi was furious and said word by word: "I, concede."
Meng Jingzhou was overjoyed, this guy was so straightforward! He jumped off the stage and waited for Lu Yang.
He then heard Yan Tianzhi say the second half of his sentence.
"To, your, uncle!"
Meng Jingzhou: "..."

chapters.title: Chapter 363 - 362: Don't Tell Anyone You're Daoist Buyu's Disciple When You Go Out_1
chapters.content:
Meng Jingzhou held back the urge to punch everyone with the infamous curse of singleship. He had been played once already, but it didn't mean he would curse everyone to remain single forever.
That's unethical.
As Lan Ting conceded, the duel came to an end, leaving the cultivators in the audience longing for more.
Is this the battle between geniuses? It seemed too short.
"I won't dare to say that I'm at the early stage of forming the Golden Core anymore. I feel like I wouldn't even compare to them even if there were ten of me."
"Exactly, when I was forming the golden core, I thought I was a great power in the cultivation world. After watching their fight, I think I'll stay realistic and continue practicing."
Reaching the Golden Core Stage would let the family prosper for five hundred years. For example, in the small Yanjiang County, there were only three people at the Golden Core Stage.
Therefore, they enthusiastically formed the Golden Core and looked forward to interacting with their fellow cultivators at the Golden Core Appraisal Conference. However, their confidence was shattered by the fight between Lu Yang and others.
Mr. Kang, who had anticipated their reaction said, "You shouldn't belittle yourselves. Already, by reaching the Golden Core Stage, you've surpassed 99% of the cultivators. Moreover, you're at the Middle Third Grade Golden Core. Don't deny your achievements due to a single battle."
Yuan Zhi smiled bitterly and said, "We're not denying ourselves. It's just that the gap between us is too large to feel that we've surpassed 99% of the cultivators."
Mr. Kang shook his head, "You shouldn't compare yourselves to the disciples of the Immortal Sects, especially today's five individuals. Geniuses like them emerge only once every several centuries or even millennia. They're born for this era and are likely to gain prominence, or even dictate the course, in the upcoming Great Era!"
Mr. Kang made it very clear that they might be doing well when compared to ordinary cultivators, but this group can be found everywhere on the Central Continent. There was absolutely no comparison between them and the five geniuses, including Lu Yang. So, they'd better stop dwelling on it and stop worrying.
After Young Master Yan, Gu Qiusheng, and others were eliminated, they watched the fights on the stage, their eyes full of enthusiasm.
Everyone was under eighteen yet they not only formed Golden Cores but could also accept challenges from higher levels. On the other hand, they were still struggling to form their Golden Cores. The gap was palpable.
However, they were not discouraged. The huge gap only made them appreciate the incredible strength of Lu Yang and the others. By observing their battle, they recognized their own shortcomings and resolved to continue cultivating once they returned.
...
Lu Yang didn't notice Meng Jingzhou's situation and was surprised to hear that his fight was the first to end.
"How did you lose so quickly?"
With a darkened face, Meng Jingzhou shooed Lu Yang away, "Go away, go away, go away! Don't bring up this topic or I'll curse you with my Singleship's Curse."
Lu Yang wasn't scared of Meng Jingzhou's threat. How could he, being protected by an immortal, fear a simple curse from Meng Jingzhou?
While they were talking, Lan Ting walked over, holding a palm-sized, tri-colored stone in her hand.
"What's this?"
Lan Ting smiled and responded, "Did you forget, Brother Lu Yang? It's the reward for the first place, a Spirit Elixer to form the Golden Core, which could enhance the success rate by 50 %."
Lu Yang had heard of such objects, highly sought after by cultivators at Half-Step Golden Core Stage and the Illusionary Core Stage. They were sold at exorbitant prices that could empty their households.
The Seek Dao Sect had everything but no Spirit Elixer to form the Golden Core.
This was the case in the other Four Great Immortal Sects as well.
All of them were geniuses and wouldn't need any external objects like the Spirit Elixer to help them form the Golden Core.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, the first and second place winners, were supposed to receive two sets of Spirit Elixer and two skill books about how to form the Golden Core.
"Lan Ting, stop joking. Old Meng and I don't need these. Give them to the third and fourth place winners instead."
Lan Ting, laughing, put aside the Spirit Elixer. It was her personal collection that she'd brought out just to tease Lu Yang. The real Spirit Elixers to form the Golden Core had already been delivered to the third and fourth place winners.
Bai Ming and Yan Tianzhi also came up and invited everyone, "It's rare to meet, shall we go somewhere to sit down?"
"Sure!" Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou agreed.
After all, they were all disciples of the Five Great Immortal Sects, and they were bound to interact.
"Some officials from the Governor's Office recommended a few restaurants to us. They're all very famous in the city, running temporary branches here."
Bai Ming led the four to a restaurant. It was a three-story building, temporarily constructed using magic skills. Nonetheless, the decoration gave it the appearance of a thousand-year-old restaurant, showing the details that went into it.
The waiter saw Bai Ming coming in and warmly asked, "Are you here for the vegetarian meal, sir?"
"...I'm here to eat."
"Vegetarian meal?"
Bai Ming angrily responded, "I'm not a monk!"
The waiter recalled a rumor that had been circulating in the world of martial arts. It was about a martial arts skill that used hair as a weapon. Each strand of hair could be used as a deadly weapon, but this skill had a flaw—that hair once used would never grow back, and it was a strand less for each used.
Someone found and mastered this skill, but after a fierce battle, he ended up losing all of his hair. Unable to accept the bald truth, he became a monk. So, some doubted that this skill originated from Buddhism to recruit people.
The waiter looked at Bai Ming with pity in his eyes, seeing yet another poor guy who couldn't accept the loss of his hair.
"Oh right, have this for now." Seeing this scene, Lu Yang pulled out a wig from his pocket and handed it to Bai Ming.
Ever since he learned the Arhat Fist, Lu Yang often kept wigs handy for emergencies. And now, it came in handy.
Looking at the wig handed over by the troublemaker himself, Bai Ming restrained the impulse to shoot and kill Lu Yang and grudgingly put on the wig.
Lu Yang's Arhat Fist wouldn't make the hair fall off permanently, wearing a wig to get through a month would be enough.
"Let me introduce you, this is Yan Tianzhi from the Prison Suppressing Sect. He doesn't talk much." Bai Ming introduced.
Yan Tianzhi nodded without saying a word.
Seems like a man of few words, Lu Yang greeted, "I'm Lu Yang from the Seek Dao Sect, disciple of Daoist Buyu."
"Meng Jingzhou, we've met before."
Yan Tianzhi's eyes enlarged when he heard of Lu Yang's background, "It's you! Master, my, master, dead!"
"My master killed your master?" Lu Yang's first reaction was disbelief. No matter how untrustworthy Daoist Buyu was, he couldn't have done such a thing.
Lan Ting coughed lightly and explained, "Yan Tianzhi stutters. He doesn't talk much. The situation is not as you think."
"Yan Tianzhi's master is the Sect Leader of the Prison Suppressing Sect. When he was young, he didn't get along with Daoist Buyu. When he learned that Daoist Buyu became the Sect Leader of the Seek Dao Sect, he was unhappy, feeling Daoist Buyu didn't deserve the title. He said he would rather live 8000 years less than see Daoist Buyu remain Sect Leader."
Those who have reached the stage of Unification can live up to 8000 years.
"Now the Sect Leader is your Eldest Senior Sister, Yun Zhi. Yan Tianzhi's master who could not go back on his word, set up a tombstone for himself. He buries himself when there's nothing happening and comes out when something pops up. He keeps telling people that he's already dead."
Lu Yang: "..."
He recalled what his Eldest Senior Sister had said once, don't tell anyone you're the disciple of Daoist Buyu when you're outside the Sect, or you'll get yourself into trouble.

chapters.title: Chapter 364 - 363: The Barbecue Shop Has Opened Branches Even Here?_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang couldn't help but recall the excitement he felt when he first became a disciple.
Back then, he knew nothing about the Cultivation World. When he found out that he was a Sword Spirit Root and could become a disciple of the Sect Leader of Seek Dao Sect, he stayed awake excitedly for the entire night.
As time went on and he learned more about the Seek Dao Sect, he realized that his master was a major troublemaker.
Not only did his Master refuse to earnestly cultivate, being punished with confinement by the Eldest Senior Sister, he also had numerous enemies.
When Lu Yang heard that officials in the Imperial City had a tradition of forming alliances, he thought it was determined according to one's hometown, forming private alliances within a township.
But Meng Jingzhou explained that it was determined by whether or not one held a grudge against Daoist Buyu.
Lu Yang could not fathom just how capable his Master was to have provoked so many people.
Did he slap everyone when he took the Imperial Examination?
Lu Yang had hoped that officials in the Imperial City would regard the Five Great Immortal Sects as enemies, they surely wouldn't have a grudge against his master too?
Now it seems he was overly optimistic.
Compared to them, the Eldest Senior Sister was more reliable. She was stunningly beautiful, taught him cultivation, and would lend a hand in times of life-and-death danger.
"By that standard, don't I also qualify as reliable?" Fairy Eternity's face lit up in delight, feeling that Lu Yang was becoming more and more reasonable.
She, one of the top ten beauties of ancient times, was impeccably beautiful, someone who could match Yun Zhi in beauty.
She had also taught Lu Yang magic skills and how to craft the Invincible Elixir, establishing Lu Yang's reputation.
When Lu Yang was being possessed, she stepped in to help and ensured Lu Yan's safety.
All the conditions were met!
Lu Yang gave Fairy Eternity a gloomy look, ignoring the fact that he'd been beaten up by his Senior Brothers and Sisters.
...
Yan Tianzhi felt that his earlier words were ambiguous, making it seem like he and Lu Yang were mortal enemies. After some thought, he decided to express his goodwill and added, "Master, I, and your, sect, Grand Elder, have a very, good relationship. We often, communicate."
"Really?" Lan Ting and Bai Ming were surprised.
Lu Yang looked peculiar, wondering what kind of 'communication' was going on. Were they discussing which coffin was the most comfortable to lay in?
Wanting to explain further but finding it too challenging, Yan Tianzhi decided to show them something while they were waiting for their dishes. He pulled out a roll of paper from his Identity Jade and spread it out on the table.
The paper was covered with rectangles interconnected to form a honeycomb-like pattern.
The more Lu Yang looked at it, the more it resembled the layout of a three-bedroom apartment.
"This is, the coffin, they, designed. They said, it's, comfortable, to sleep in."
"Moreover, you can, carry it, around. If you can't find, a place, to stay, you can, sleep in it."
Lu Yang: "..."
So, Grand Elder, you've handed over the Task Hall affairs to Elder Brother Dai, and you're spending your days designing coffins?
Does Elder Brother Dai know about this?
At that moment, the waiter shouted, "The dishes are ready, could you please make some room?"
Upon hearing this, Yan Tianzhi put away the paper, and delicious dishes were served on the table one after another.
Lu Yang didn't recognize any of the dishes, but from their aroma, they were definitely top-notch.
Bai Ming said, "Please, enjoy. The governor has covered all our food and accommodations during the celebration."
Lu Yang laughed, raising his teacup, "To the governor."
"To the governor."
"To the governor."
Everyone clinked glasses and began to eat.
During the meal, Lan Ting asked, "By the way, there will be a Vision Appraisal Meeting later, are you interested in joining?"
"What is the Vision Appraisal Meeting?"
"It's held by the Land Money Trade Association. They will display various strange and curious items. Whoever can identify the history of the items gets to keep them."
"The items aren't very valuable, it's just for fun."
"Sounds interesting, I'll go." Lu Yang was the first to respond.
"Count me in." Meng Jingzhou was next.
Bai Ming thought for a moment, since the task assigned by the governor was already completed, participating in the activity would be nice.
"I'll go too."
"Go." Yan Tianzhi said succinctly.
All five of them wished to join the Vision Appraisal Meeting for the experience. Their eating speed naturally quickened and not long after, they finished their meals.
As they left the restaurant, Meng Jingzhou nudged Lu Yang's arm, gesturing for him to look in a certain direction.
Following Meng Jingzhou's direction, Lu Yang saw a bustling barbecue shop with a queue that stretched out into the street.
The barbecue shop was named "Try Again BBQ".
A small line written at the lower right corner of the shop sign read: Temporary Branch Store for Qingzhou Celebration.
"Is the demonic sect so quick in setting up shops? They've even set up a shop here?" Meng Jingzhou asked through a voice transmission.
Lu Yang shook his head, "I don't think so. It's been less than a month, it's not possible to set up shops everywhere. We didn't even provide them with enough start-up funds. They are probably here to advertise during the Qingzhou celebration."
Noticing the unusual behavior of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, Bai Ming chuckled, "Do you guys have an interest in this barbecue shop? Lan Ting was not here last night. Tianzhi and I ate here, the shopkeeper claimed their cooking skills were inherited from ancient times, even boasting that they were a three hundred thousand-year-old establishment."
"Whether it's true or not, the taste was indeed top-tier. Their skewers are the best I've ever had."
Yan Tianzhi nodded in agreement with the taste of the BBQ shop.
Lu Yang thought to himself, members of your demonic sect sure know how to bluff, claiming to be a three hundred thousand-year-old establishment. Why don't you claim that your cooking fire has been burning for three hundred thousand years?
However, the fact that their cooking skills were inherited from ancient times was not a lie, since the basic recipe for BBQ was provided by Man Gu.
"Should we go for a meal after the Vision Appraisal Meeting ends?" Bai Ming asked.
"Never mind, we just found the name of this BBQ shop interesting." There was no need for Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou to eat here. Their BBQ was the most authentic.
Lan Ting took notice of the BBQ shop's name. She was one of the second batch of employees at the original BBQ shop, who had been there since the very beginning.
The first batch were ghouls.
With identical names and exceptionally delicious food, was it a coincidence?
Worried that there might be some hidden significance, she sent a voice transmission to Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, "Is this BBQ shop related to you in any way?"
Being so insightful, Lan Ting was impossible to deceive. Lu Yang then confessed, "There's some hidden information. Don't reveal it. You never know, there might be a spy from the demonic sect in your Fairy Palace."
Upon hearing the term 'demonic sect', Lan Ting realized the seriousness of the matter and promised, "Don't worry, I won't tell anyone, even my Master."
Relieved, Lu Yang explained, "With the tireless efforts of Meng Jingzhou and myself, we improved the taste of the skewers. With the completion of the Automatic Skewer Formation and the automatic BBQ rack, we've met the requirements to open a chain store. To prevent the demonic sect from wreaking havoc everywhere, we, the Seek Dao Sect, collaborated with the demonic sect.
We plan to open Try Again BBQ shops all over the continent, currently in the initial stage."
"Of course, the name of Seek Dao Sect wasn't used in the collaboration with the demonic sect."
Lan Ting: "..."
The Eternity Sect had just been extinguished a few months ago, and now you, the Seek Dao Sect, are targeting the demonic sect?
Even though exorcising demons and eliminating evil is the duty of our righteous path, your efficiency is impressively high.
How long do you plan to take to eliminate the demonic sect this time?
One month or two?

chapters.title: Chapter 365 - 364 Vision Appraisal Meeting_1
chapters.content:
There were no cultivation level requirements to participate in the Vision Appraisal Meeting, everyone from the Qi Refinement stage to the Unification stage was welcome.
Still, those in the Unification and Refining the Void stages found little interest in these minor activities.
In the temporary branch of the Land Money Trade Association, four treasures were lined up and surrounded by an Array Method, preventing Spiritual Sense probing, leaving only sight as a means of appraisal.
When Lu Yang and his group arrived, there were already many people gathered around.
Fortunately, distance did not affect judgment, for one in the early Golden Core stage, they could clearly see the details of objects hundreds of metres away.
"A painting, featuring an armoured woman."
"A charred bamboo shoot, with two tender green leaves."
"An insect, could it be some kind of Gu worm?"
"Something that looks like an iron ring worn around the neck, an accessory?"
Lu Yang looked them over but could not discern the origins of these items.
No one present could tell the origins of these items. They were all observing closely, hoping to find some clue.
The person next to Lu Yang raised their hand and asked: "Is the third item a Gu worm?"
The cultivator from the trade association politely replied, "I'm sorry, I cannot answer that question."
After contemplation, the person firmly stated, "The fourth item is a Gu worm, the patterns on its wings resemble a copper coin, it must be a money bug among the Gu worms, which can help its master find treasures!"
"I'm sorry, you guessed wrong."
"Do you recognize these four things?" Lu Yang communicated telepathically with Meng Jingzhou and his group.
"The first painting might be hiding a Painting Spirit, I am not certain." Lan Ting, who was knowledgeable about paintings, commented.
"The bamboo seems familiar, I think I've read about it somewhere, let me check my books." Bai Ming took out an ancient book from his Identity Jade to flip through, one after another.
Yan Tianzhi remained silent, he did not know anything.
Meng Jingzhou stroked his chin: "The fourth item should be a Gu worm, let me try."
Meng Jingzhou raised his hand and asked: "Is the fourth item a Fixation Undead Insect? If you apply this Gu to the person you love, they would gradually fall in love with you."
The cultivator from the trade association was quite taken aback, not expecting someone to guess an item so quickly. He put the small worm in a wooden box and gave it to Meng Jingzhou.
"Congratulations, you guessed correctly, this is a Fixation Undead Insect."
The person next to Lu Yang was well-versed in Gu worms. "Fixation Undead Insect? So this is what a Fixation Undead Insect looks like. I always thought their wings were blood-red, these ones have transparent wings!"
The cultivator from the trade association explained, "This is a variant Fixation Undead Insect, the wing colour has changed to transparent, but its function remains unchanged."
"You could recognize this? Have you seen it before?" Lu Yang communicated telepathically with Meng Jingzhou.
Meng Jingzhou boasted, "No, I've only heard of the Fixation Undead Insect, I didn't even know what it looked like."
"So how did you guess it?"
"Thanks to my careful observation."
"What exactly did you observe?"
"When I set my gaze on the insect, it shuddered with fear. It was clear it was afraid of me. It got me wondering why it was scared. As it turns out, I have a pair of Single Body Spiritual Roots and also know the Curse Fist, naturally counteracting Gu worms especially the Fixation Undead Insect!"
Lu Yang didn't think this was something to be proud of.
"Does the painting depict a woman general guarding a house?"
There is a kind of painting, when hung in a house, that can fend off evil spirits.
"No."
"Is the bamboo a withered Ink Bamboo?"
Ink Bamboo can be ground into powder and mixed with water for use in paintings.
"No."
"Is the iron ring a replica of the Vajra Bracelet?"
"No."
Lu Yang had watched three people raise their hands and guess, all of them were incorrect.
Lan Ting and Bai Ming were still flipping through books, with no idea when they would find the answer.
Lu Yang secretly asked Fairy Eternity, "Fairy, do you recognise these things?"
Fairy Eternity yawned out of boredom, "They're all trivial little playthings."
"The woman in the painting is alive, or rather, capable of change. At midnight every day, the woman in the painting comes alive, changes outfits - today she's in armor, tomorrow it may be a long skirt, the day after a robe, and she could be in pajamas the day after that. She doesn't repeat an outfit for a whole year."
"It has no offensive abilities, it's just for novelty. I too can change clothes daily." Fairy Eternity tried to prove she was better than the painting.
Lu Yang looked up and down at Fairy Eternity, who was disheveled from sleep, with a disgusted face. "You really should change your clothes... what is the black bamboo?"
"Lightning-struck bamboo. If a bamboo gets struck by lightning and is able to revive from withering - withered wood meeting spring - and sprout new leaves, it is called lightning-struck bamboo. Pandas love to eat it. If you hold one in the Demon Territory, you could attract a panda to be your mount."
"I remember there being pandas on Confucius Peak."
"That's just an ordinary panda, it can't eat lightning struck bamboo. I'm talking about pandas with cultivation level, in today's terms, the ancient pandas."
"What about the iron ring? Do you recognize it, Fairy?"
"Oh, it's junk, useless now."
"Junk?"
"Right, junk. Have you heard the phrase, a good chef needs good tableware?"
"I thought it was 'a good chef needs good kitchenware'."
"They're somewhat similar."
"After becoming an Immortal Cook, I found that there was no tableware worthy of me. Plates, bowls, chopsticks, they would all melt upon touching dishes I cooked."
"I asked the Yingtian Immortal to refine a set of tableware for me. He was reluctant at the beginning, but under my persuasion and incentives, he finally agreed to do so."
"The refining process was extremely difficult. He tried using ceramics, metal, wood and other materials, but all failed. This iron ring is a product of one such failure. When I poured my freshly made soup into the plate, it leaked."
Lu Yang: "..."
This was his first time hearing that a chef would need a Immortal to make their tableware.
But it was still made by Yingtian Immortal, surely it should be tougher than the flying sword the Qilin Immortal used to trick his wife?
Lu Yang raised his hand and said, "The iron ring is part of a dining plate."
The cultivators from the Trade Association were greatly surprised. The iron ring was the hardest among all the items to guess correctly, yet he did.
"Congratulations, cultivator, you are correct."
"A dining plate? Are you kidding me, this thing looks exactly like a diamond bracelet!"
"Exactly, if it's not a diamond bracelet, it should be some other weapon, right?"
The cultivator from the Trade Association explained in a calm manner, "This cultivator is correct. The iron ring is indeed part of a dining plate. According to the appraiser's inference, someone had crafted an extremely sturdy iron plate for an unknown reason. Later, the plate was eroded by poison, melted in the middle, leaving just the edge, which forms the current ring."
"As for the type of poison, that remains unknown. No known poison can cause such a degree of damage."
Upon hearing the cultivator from the Trade Association say this, Fairy Eternity stamped her feet in anger, "Blind as a bat! The food I make is nourishing, how dare they describe it as poisoned!"
Lu Yang didn't dare to speak out. What if he said Fairy Eternity's food was poisoned and she insisted on cooking for him again to prove it wasn't?
Lu Yang received the iron ring. Bai Ming and others sent messages, "Nice discernment, to actually figure that out."
"Be careful with the iron ring, there might still be residual poison on it." Lan Ting worried for Lu Yang's safety. Even a small contact with such poison could be deadly.
"Good eye."
Lu Yang responded to each with a smile.
Just as everyone was about to continue with their guessing, there suddenly came a blast from a distance. A strong aura surged forth like a tidal wave, enveloping the entire gathering.
Lu Yang sensed fury and murderous intent from the aura. "Fairy, what's the cultivation level of the people coming?"
"Unification peak, two persons. Seems like they're the ancient cultivators you guys talk about."
Lu Yang narrowed his eyes. This doesn't look good.
Bai Ming was on high alert, "That direction... is it the Secret Realm?"

chapters.title: Chapter 366 - 365: Avoiding Dismissal all Thanks to my High Cultivation Level_1
chapters.content:
The pressure of the Unification peak covered the entire banquet. Most people hadn't even reached the Nascent Soul Stage in their lives and had never experienced such a level of pressure. Countless cultivators' faces turned pale in an instant, their bodies wobbling, unable to stand steady, and they fell to the ground with a thud.
"Lie on the ground, try to increase the contact area with the ground as much as possible!" A government-officed cultivator exclaimed, guiding the people to minimize injuries.
Meng Jingzhou and Bai Ming, along with two others, held Spirit Treasures within them, counteracting the effects of Unification Stage pressure on their bodies.
These are the Spirit Treasures that each disciple of the Immortal Sect should have on hand. Meng Jingzhou held a stone shaped like Body Refinement Peak, Bai Ming held a five-colored disk, Lan Ting held a round moon embroidery, and Yan Tianzhi carried a palm-sized cage... Each of the Five Great Immortal Sects have its unique features.
When a disciple of an Immortal Sect goes out on behalf of the sect, if they kneel on the ground under the pressure of the Unification Stage, it dishonors the sect's reputation.
Lu Yang was supposed to have a stone shaped like Sky Gate Mountain too. Still, with Fairy Eternity around, he wasn't afraid of this level of pressure. Even if the Transcendance Tribulation Stage came, it wouldn't suppress Lu Yang using pressure.
"What's going on? Which Unification Stage isn't cherishing life and daring to take action here?" Meng Jingzhou was taken aback. Generally, battling at the Unification Stage shouldn't involve common people, or all the people of Great Xia would have been long dead.
Battles of the Unification Stage are world-shattering, the ground itself risks collapsing, let alone talk about ordinary people, even those with cultivation can't resist that.
"It's not a Unification Stage cultivator of this era, but one from the ancient times!" Lu Yang learned from Fairy Eternity, the source of the energy was two ancient Unification Stage cultivators, a man and a woman, brimming with hostility.
Bai Ming frowned: "That makes sense."
He pointed to the source of the pressure and said: "That direction has a Secret Realm. Exploring the Secret Realm is part of this banquet. Someone probably explored the Secret Realm and woke up the slumbering ancient cultivators, who became enraged and sought to destroy everything."
This was not the first time that this had occurred. To the ancient cultivators, why should they adhere to today's rules? During their era, those at the Unification Stage had supreme power and were in control of the authority to take lives.
"Such audacity!" A roar of anger came from the horizon. It was the County Magistrate.
In the blink of an eye, the County Magistrate appeared above the crowd's heads. He held up a large seal. A strange energy rose and dispersed the pressure from the ancient Unification Stage cultivators.
"Huh, such a peculiar power." Fairy Eternity was surprised. She had never seen such energy before.
This was also the first time Lu Yang, Lan Ting and the others had seen such energy. Only Meng Jingzhou knew a little about it.
"This is the power of the State Destiny." Meng Jingzhou explained.
"I've heard my family members mention that under the Great Xia Dynasty, there is a magical power. It's the foundation of the Great Xia Dynasty. Each County Magistrate and large county's County Magistrate can mobilize this power temporarily for battles and protection. For this reason, the losses caused by the ancient Unification Stage can always be minimized each time."
"Quite interesting." Fairy Eternity observed and analyzed the power of the State Destiny with her immortal knowledge. The small amount of power the County Magistrate mobilized didn't fascinate her. Still, if the entire Great Xia Dynasty was covered with such power, it would be an extremely terrifying energy, and that would be quite interesting indeed.
"Quite creative, apart from Miss Yun, there are also other strong individuals in this era."
"You're daring to cause trouble under my watch!" The County Magistrate's beard and hair fluttered around, like an angry lion.
The male and female ancient Unification Stage cultivators were not afraid of the County Magistrate. They coldly said, "You're playing the victim. It was clearly your people who woke us and made us wake up early. How did it become us causing the trouble?"
The male cultivator squinted his eyes, somewhat afraid of the County Magistrate and his large seal: "Looking at you, fellow cultivator, with your perfect primordial spirit, you're not inferior to us and you also qualify to fight for the Great Era. You should also know how much our premature awakening has delayed us. Isn't it right for us to kill a few people to vent our anger?"
"Of course not!" Another three people flew in from the horizon. They were all at the Unification Stage.
"Sect Leader Mi, Master Zhang, Dean Hong, you've arrived." The County Magistrate saw these three people, his pressure greatly relieved. If a battle occurs, he might not be able to protect the cultivators attending the banquet below.
"That's the Deputy Sect Leader of Mad Sect, the Deputy Master of Multi-storey Temple, and the Deputy Dean of Baihua Academy. They are all at the Mid-stage of Unification!" After the pressure effect was removed, everyone was able to stand up. A local great cultivator from Qingzhou recognized the identities of these three individuals, which was a great delight.
The Mad Sect, Multi-storey Temple, and Baihua Academy are the local sect forces of Qingzhou, and they are also the organizers of the Qingzhou banquet.
According to the custom, they sent deputy heads to participate in this event as a preventative measure. They were invited to stay at government residences and exchange cultivation experiences, talking happily. Unexpectedly, two ancient cultivators suddenly appeared.
Seeing the opposite party with more people and great momentum, and the County Magistrate could employ an unfathomable energy, the two ancient Unification Stage cultivators would not dare to fight recklessly for fear of accidents: "Humph, in that case, under consideration of the fellow cultivator's prestige, we won't insist on concluding this matter, we withdraw!"
After saying this, the two of them were ready to flee.
"Humph, you want to leave? Stay right here!" If these two people were let go, it would cause endless trouble in the future. The County Magistrate wouldn't just let them leave.
The County Magistrate and the other three positioned themselves in the east, south, west, and north directions and surrounded the two ancient Unification Stage cultivators.
"Aren't you worried about the safety of the people below?" The two ancient Unification Stage cultivators realized that the County Magistrate was different from them, prioritizing the protection of the weak cultivators.
The County Magistrate had already made preparations. The four individuals gave a nod, and used the power of the rules.
They all said at the same time: "We set the rule here: [Anyone below 3000 meters from here will not be affected by the battle]."
The peak where the Qingzhou banquet was held was three thousand meters high.
"Laughable, even if you establish the rules, how are you going to maintain them during the battle? To keep the rules, one of you will inevitably be unable to fight!" The female cultivator mocked, three people were not enough to detain the couple.
"You don't need to worry about that, seniors. I can maintain the rules." A voice came from behind Lu Yang, startling the five of them.
The person who came was dressed in an official robe, looking at the sky with a smile, unperturbed.
"It's you?!" Lan Ting, Bai Ming, and Yan Tianzhi were taken aback.
"You know him? Who is he?" Lu Yang asked in a transmitted voice.
"He is a subordinate of the County Magistrate. Yesterday evening, me and Bai Ming Senior Brother and Yan Tianzhi Senior Brother visited the County Magistrate together, this person welcomed us into the residence and arranged for us to stay."
"I initially thought he was a minor official, but it turns out he's also a Unification Stage cultivator."
Only those at Unification Stage can maintain the rules.
"Very normal, the County Magistrate's office couldn't possibly not have even one Unification Stage cultivator." Meng Jingzhou was not surprised, he was very familiar with how government offices operated.
Lan Ting and the other two didn't know that initially, the other party suggested the three of them stay in prison.
When Fairy Eternity saw that Lu Yang was safe, she relaxed and yawned, "I thought Miss Yun would have to make a move, it seems that won't be necessary."
Lu Yang's eyebrows furrowed tightly, he always felt that things wouldn't be so simple.
Those two Unification Stage cultivators woke up from the Secret Realm, wouldn't the government officiials have thoroughly investigated the Secret Realm? Didn't they find out about these two people?

chapters.title: Chapter 367 - 366: Taishang Sword_1
chapters.content:
High in the sky, six Unification Stage great powers were battling, each displaying their divine abilities. The cultivators below watched in dazzlement. Even Lu Yang and his group watched the battle with undivided attention. After all, combat between Unification Stage powers was an extremely rare sight.
However, there was only one person who was not interested in watching the battle. He was gnashing his teeth and glaring relentlessly at the ancient husband and wife cultivators.
"Damn ancient cultivators, they are everywhere!" Vice Headmaster Shi of the BBQ Restaurant almost wished he could join the battle, beat the ancient wife and husband cultivators, and preferably turn them into a corpse puppet, which could help relieve his anger.
No matter the outcome of this battle, the government office would conduct a meticulous investigation here. For security reasons, the Qingzhou grand ceremony would certainly end hastily.
The Qingzhou grand ceremony was supposed to last for eight days, but it was now about to end after just two days.
He came to Qingzhou for onsite inspection, to see if the BBQ Restaurant had any market here, what was the favorite type of barbecue in Qingzhou and prepare according to local conditions.
Indeed, the BBQ Restaurant was very popular among the people of Qingzhou, with an optimistic future.
He also planned to use the Qingzhou grand ceremony to make the BBQ restaurant famous and open up the Qingzhou market.
Now everything turned out to be only empty talk.
"Ancient cultivators, eh? Just don't let me run into you!"
Whether in terms of cultivation level or fighting power, he was much higher than the three deputy sect leaders. If he joined the battle, it would be a one-sided victory.
Unfortunately, due to his special status, he couldn't participate in the fight.
If his real identity was revealed, he would be doomed.
...
"Daylight usurping!" The male cultivator formed a seal with both his hands, and suddenly, dense clouds filled the sky, obscuring the sunlight. The sky instantly became pitch-black. One couldn't see their hands in front of their faces. In the darkness, one could hear eerie teeth grinding sounds, as if a gigantic creature was chewing on bones.
"Hundred ghost night walk!" Another voice shouted. It was the female cultivator. She exuded an endless stream of black aura. Batch by batch, the dark aura floated in the air, slowly converging into various forms of ghostly shapes.
Ghouls, succubus, knife ghost, headless ghost, corpse driving ghost...
The hundred ghosts were silent, deathly somber, as if an army of the undead was about to overturn the mortal world.
If there were no rules hindering them, the dead aura of the hundred ghosts would turn the entire mountain into a desolate one, with no survivors.
Even those who knew that there would be no impact below were so scared that they were trembling and wanted to flee.
"Let me tell you, don't be afraid, we're under the protection of the Governor. All this is nothing but a small trick that cannot hold up to scrutiny." The Unification Stage cultivator maintaining the rules said to Lu Yang and his group.
They learned through communication that the other party's name was Xia Qun, an early Unification Stage cultivator.
"Besides, the Governor has the State Destiny. It's more than enough to deal with these ancient Unification Stage cultivators who haven't seen the world. I wonder when I'll get a chance to become a Governor."
"You don't have to be cautious with me. I actually have predestined relationships with your Five Great Immortal Sects and can be considered your half Senior Brother."
"Mr. Xia joined the Immortal Sect before?" Lan Ting asked curiously.
"Well, not really. But I did participate in the entrance examination once. You know, the questions were damn difficult, and I was eliminated after the first round. I was almost your Senior Brother, so it is not too much to be regarded as half a Senior Brother, right?"
Lan Ting: "..."
"Initially, I also wanted to go to the Seek Dao Sect to try. On the way, I accidentally participated in the imperial exams and got selected. That's how I started my officialdom career." Xia Qun was quite talkative and made Lu Yang's group feel a lot less tense.
"Indeed, what an evil demon!" The governor raised his great seal, with endless force pouring into his body. His aura rose continuously, which made ancient husband and wife cultivators feel startled. The governor's aura was very close to the Transcendence Tribulation Stage.
The governor's body scattered trickles of light, as if to illuminate the darkness with the first light of dawn. The trickles of light suddenly surged, dispersing the darkness, eliminating all the deathly aura from the hundred ghosts. However, the ghosts were still there, with their weapons, showing their might.
Behind the male cultivator, there was a ghost with a weird figure. It was as large as a mountain, holding a bone club, able to pluck the sun, moon, and stars down.
"Charge!" Under the command of the female cultivator, the army of hundred ghosts advanced towards the Governor's side.
"Leave these people to me, Multi-Storey Temple!" Master Zhang stood in the front, making strange sounds from his nose.
A golden temple appeared over the hundred ghosts, spreading infinite aura, causing the hundred ghost army to wail. Half of them died here.
"Truly worthy of the Multistorey Temple, which frequently deals with ghost problems, the Multi-storey Temple is still very effective against ghosts." Dean Hong laughed, and opened the "Words of the Saint". Each character from the book came alive and charged towards the remaining hundred ghost troops.
"The methods of the scholars are amazing. They summon soldiers with words. What a shame that I, as a crude person, can't learn this method." Sect Leader Mi watched Dean Hong fighting by just moving his fingers with envy.
"If you can't learn it, then you can't learn it." Sect Leader Mi roared, rushing like a madman. His eyes were blurry, and he lost his sanity. He pounced on the female cultivator like a monkey.
The female cultivator countered with a punch, and to her surprise, Sect Leader Mi, who was at mid-stage Unification, was almost as strong as her, a peak Unification Stage cultivator.
"It seems he has temporarily lost his sanity in exchange for power." The female cultivator was not simple either. After a brief battle, she could tell what method Sect Leader Mi was using.
"Nothing to fear!" Combat was not just about power.
"What about adding the two of us?" After they dealt with the hundred ghosts, Master Zhang and Dean Hong rushed up and surrounded the female cultivator.
On the other side of the battlefield, the province governor summoned a Saint of Mountain-Moving, who hurled a mountain toward the ghoul of a male cultivator. The ghoul fought back with its bone club. The mountain was, in fact, a manifestation of the nation's destiny and exploded immediately upon touching the bone club. The explosion sent a blast wave skyward, dispersing the dark clouds above.
The province governor then called upon an Ax-Wielding Saint who swung his great ax toward the male cultivator. The cultivator's face changed as he pulled the ghoul in front of him to block the blow, causing black blood to flow from its chest.
"Hmm, crafting law phases in such an atrocious fashion sure takes some skill." Fairy Eternity ridiculed, sneering at the male cultivator's method.
"Or does it mean he actually likes taking on such an appearance?"
"So, who's winning?" Lu Yang asked quietly.
"Naturally, it would be Great Xia's side. The overall strength of Great Xia surpasses the other side, and with the Destiny of the state aiding them. How could ancient cultivators even compare?"
"Really?" Lu Yang reflected, feeling that something was amiss.
"You forced this upon yourself!" The male cultivator, enraged, pulled out a golden pair of scissors from his bosom. The scissors transformed into a pair of golden dragons that soared in the sky, letting off roars which disrupted the flow of Spiritual Energy on the battlefield.
The appearance of the golden dragons was like dropping a stone into a tranquil lake, causing ripples that spread across the entire body of water.
The Spiritual Energy across the entire Qingzhou region was fluctuating.
"A magic artifact forged by a Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivator!" The province governor had seen such artifacts in the Imperial City, even someone at the Unification Stage needed to expend a significant cost to utilize these artifacts.
"Luckily we sacrificed an entire city worth of people in our slumber. Otherwise, activating the Golden Dragon Scissors would have been rather difficult."
"Go!" The male cultivator commanded the two golden dragons to coil around the ghoul's arms and charged at the province governor.
The governor wielded the Destiny of the State, which transformed into a long sword that was as long as a river. The side of the sword was inscribed with the word "populace" on one side and "mountains and rivers" on the other.
"The Taishang Sword projection! The province governor is staking his life on this!" Xia Qun exclaimed in alarm, "To use the Taishang Sword projection once, the province governor will not be able to engage in sexual intercourse for three months."
"Let me tell you, invoking the Taishang Sword phantom comes at a heavy price, but the effect is absolutely impressive. Unless there's a Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivator, the province governor could potentially slay both these ancient cultivators with just the phantom projection of the Taishang Sword."
The Taishang Sword projection clashed with the golden dragons and the ghoul, their radiance was so brilliant that everyone present had to close their eyes.
"Who won?" Everyone could not discern which side was stronger.
As the smoke cleared, the Taishang Sword projection shattered, the golden dragons disappeared, the Golden Dragon Scissors were broken, the ghoul was cut in half, black blood flowed unstoppably, and the male cultivator was seriously injured, spitting blood.
On the other hand, the province governor looked vibrant, as if nothing had happened.
"The governor won!" The cultivators below cheered. Sect Leader Mi and others sighed in relief. Should the governor have been defeated, it would have been nearly impossible to stop these two ancient cultivators.
Clap——Clap——Clap——
The rhythmic clapping resounded, the sound being faint but overshadowed all other noises. With the third clap, the entire scene felt as quiet as ice.
A figure appeared in the center of the battlefield in red attire, his footsteps echoing in thin air. When examined with Spiritual Sense, no trace of spiritual essence could be detected within his body, he seemed like an ordinary person.
But how could an ordinary person show up here?
The figure in red smiled, slowly speaking, "I've heard that the Destiny of Great Xia is extraordinary. Today, seeing it live truly is remarkable. Able to protect many lives, raises one's Realm and combat power, and can also transform into a sharp phantom sword."
"I couldn't quite decipher what kind of sword this is, but it was able to sever a Transcendence Tribulation Stage artifact with a mere phantom. I reckon its actual self is beyond the Transcendence Tribulation Stage."
"It seems that my careful arrangement of this battle has not been in vain, and I've reaped quite the harvest."
The governor's expression turned grave, as if facing a formidable adversary: "You arranged this?"
He was puzzled. The Secret Realm had been inspected once and deemed safe, without any slumbering ancient cultivators. So, where did these two ancient cultivators come from?
Now it all made sense, someone was behind these two ancient cultivators.
Meng Jingzhou, who was below, was somewhat flustered: "From the grave look on the governor's face, we can tell that the person on the other side is at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage."
If a cultivator at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage starts a massacre here, who could possibly stop him?
"What should we do?" Meng Jingzhou sent a message to Lu Yang.
"It's okay, the other side can't do much." Lu Yang radiated confidence.
"Where does your confidence come from?"
Meng Jingzhou turned his head in surprise.
Only to see a stoic, incredibly beautiful woman standing next to Lu Yang.
Xia Qun, standing to the side, didn't dare to make a sound.
"Eldest Senior Sister?!"
Lu Yang had long thought that something was being plotted behind the scenes, so just in case, he had called Eldest Senior Sister over in advance.

chapters.title: Chapter 368 - 367 - Whose life will you leave here?_1
chapters.content:
"Who?" Yan Tianzhi noticed the woman who appeared next to Lu Yang.
He had been closely observing the battle above the heavens, not paying attention to Lu Yang's situation, and suddenly a person appeared out of nowhere?
Lan Ting and Bai Ming reacted similarly to Yan Tianzhi, they were completely unaware that Lu Yang had used the Imitation Fist to summon the Eldest Senior Sister.
"The Acting Sect Master?" Lan Ting had seen the Eldest Senior Sister while attending a meeting at the Seek Dao Sect with her master, and was even coerced by the Eldest Senior Sister to marry Lu Yang.
Afterward, her master told her that Yun Zhi was the Acting Sect Master of the Seek Dao Sect, and her cultivation level was unfathomable.
Bai Ming, on the other hand, had met Lan Ting at a conference between the Five Elements Sect and the Seek Dao Sect, and he was told by his master that the Eldest Senior Sister of the Seek Dao Sect was the foremost among those of her age in the Immortal Sect and should not be provoked.
Yan Tianzhi didn't know the Eldest Senior Sister. He heard that the Seek Dao Sect had changed its Sect Leader, but he didn't know who became the Sect Leader.
Meng Jingzhou smiled confidently, feeling that the sudden appearance of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator in red wasn't a big deal, so much so that he felt even a battle in the high heavens wouldn't be a problem.
"This is our Eldest Senior Sister, the Acting Sect Leader of the Seek Dao Sect, Yun Zhi," Meng Jingzhou introduced solemnly.
"With her here, this place is absolutely safe!"
Lan Ting and the others did not quite understand.
The Acting Sect Master of the Seek Dao Sect had a cultivation level that was roughly similar to Daoist Buyu's, and perhaps, if guessed daringly, was at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
If the Eldest Senior Sister of the Seek Dao Sect was to fight the Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator in the sky, the aftermath alone would be enough to turn mountains and seas upside down and cause devastation, so how could it be safe?
Yun Zhi disregarded the meanings of the people present, quietly watching the battle high in the heavens, her face expressionless, her thoughts inscrutable.
Lan Ting suddenly noticed that Xia Qun, who had been incessantly talkative, had fallen silent, his body trembling uncontrollably.
"Mr. Xia, are you okay?"
Gulp, Xia Qun swallowed with difficulty, forced out a smile, "I...I'm fine, look how happy I am, the State Governor will be saved."
Yun Zhi turned her head to look at Xia Qun: "Do you know who I am?"
In response to Yun Zhi's inquiry, Xia Qun did not dare to not answer: "I happened to be there when our ancestral progenitor left our ancestral land to personally welcome you."
Xia Qun had no choice but to feel afraid. Who was their ancestral progenitor, after all? There had hardly been any peers over the ages, and he had never heard of the ancestral progenitor leaving the ancestral land.
Who could have thought that on the day he prepared to visit the ancestral progenitor, he would see the ancestral progenitor leave the ancestral land to personally welcome this unbelievably beautiful elder of the Seek Dao Sect.
The importance of this elder from the Seek Dao Sect could be imagined.
Yun Zhi nodded, "Since we are of similar age, there is no need to address me as elder. You can simply call me Daoist Yun Zhi."
Xia Qun nodded in agreement, but he didn't dare to actually call her that.
If their ancestral progenitor were to find out about this, he feared he would have difficulty leaving the Imperial City alive.
Upon hearing this, Lu Yang was taken aback. If he was of a similar age to the Eldest Senior Sister and had Initial Fusion Stage Cultivation, didn't that mean that this Mr. Xia's talent for cultivation was about the same as Senior Brother Dai Bufan's?
Seeing Xia Qun's reaction and considering Xia Qun's talent, Meng Jingzhou was slightly puzzled.
"What are you thinking about?" Lu Yang asked through mental transmission.
"Do you know the royal family's surname?"
"Isn't it Jiang?"
"Yes, it's Jiang, but when the royal family goes out and needs to hide their identity, they usually change their surname to 'Xia'."
"Are you saying that Mr. Xia is from the royal family?"
"It's possible."
...
Up in the sky, the figure in red let out a creepy laugh, rescuing two ancient cultivators, giving them elixirs to restore their strength.
"Master." On seeing the figure in red, the two ancient cultivators put away their arrogance, not daring to be the least bit negligent.
"You both have done well. It was not in vain that I hid you two in this secret realm, so I could have the chance to see the legendary State Destiny and the illusory image of the Taishang Sword."
With the cultivation level of the figure in red, he could deduce many things from just an illusion.
The State Destiny and the Taishang Sword will inevitably become obstacles to the rise of their Great Yu Dynasty.
If the figure in red were to take action himself, the Province Governor would only use the State Destiny to disperse the lower cultivators. He would not mobilize the State Destiny to battle.
A sense of apprehension formed in the Province Governor's heart. The State Destiny concerned the very fundamentals. If the ancient cultivators knew how to use it, they would certainly develop a method to counter it. The State Destiny, which was invincible, would then become limited and its power greatly reduced.
As for the Taishang Sword, he wasn't aware of its true nature. However, if the Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivators valued it highly, it must be of great significance.
"I cannot let you live!"
At this crucial juncture, people like Sect Leader Mi could no longer serve any purpose. The only thing the Province Governor could rely on was the seal in his hand.
He utilized the State Destiny once again. The vast State Destiny turned into the Taishang Sword once again. The Sword Qi surged, its dazzling radiance shining even brighter than the sun, as if it had the power to create a new world.
The figure in red smirked coldly, seeing the Province Governor's efforts as futile. He could temporarily make his body intangible, making him immune to all attacks. His fighting power wasn't particularly strong among cultivators of the same realm, but no one could injure him.
As the illusory image of the Taishang Sword descended, a wound appeared on the chest of the figure in red. His flesh was torn apart, revealing white bone.
"What?!" The figure in red was taken aback. His ability to make himself intangible was part of the rules, and it had never failed before. Much to his surprise, he was wounded by the illusory image of the Taishang Sword and received heavy internal damage.
"No wonder the imperial teacher repeatedly warned me to be cautious of the illusory image of the Taishang Sword. So it has the ability to temporarily erase rules!"
Crack.
A crisp sound echoed, and the figure in red noticed the jade hung around his neck had shattered. It was his life-saving treasure. This meant that the illusory image of the Taishang Sword had already killed him once!
The figure in red, furious, laughed scornfully, "There's no need for us to make a clean break with Great Xia just yet. I initially wanted to spare your life, but you've decided to court death and hurt me. I'll let you be buried here along with the lower cultivators!"
As the figure in red's words fell, he reined in his playful attitude. There was an indescribable silence in the air, making breathing seem difficult.
Exotic flowers bloomed at his feet and in an instant covered the entire sky. He clenched his fists tightly, causing the flowers to wither. A point of light flew out from the withered buds and formed a whip in his hand.
Crack—
He flicked the whip, and space shattered along with it.
The expression of the Province Governor changed drastically. This was a treasure capable of shattering space. Even if he could withstand it, the cultivators below surely wouldn't be able to resist it.
The two ancient cultivators who were closest to the figure in red were shivering with fear. They knew how terrifying this person could be when enraged. His wrath would only be quenched if an entire city fell, hence his nickname, "The Red Calamity."
"All of you will lose your lives here!"
The figure in red roared, and the space was trembling as if about to collapse under the force of the whipping thunder.
The cultivators below felt despair. Their hearts were filled with fear and terror. The destructive power had far exceeded their imaginations.
The figure in red laughed ceaselessly and brandished his whip forcefully.
"Huh?"
He swung his arm to crack the whip, but found his arm immobilized.
"No, it's not just my arm!"
He was horrified to discover that he couldn't move at all.
"Spatial Stasis!"
He was proficient with the whip, and his whip was a treasure capable of tearing apart space, how could he possibly be locked in a spatial stasis by anyone!
When did this happen?
A lady figure appeared in front of him, cold as ice. She opened her mouth slowly. Her cold, beautiful eyes devoid of any emotion.
"Whose life are you going to take here?"

chapters.title: Chapter 369 - 368: Boring_1
chapters.content:
The figure clad in red, known as the Red Plague, was an omen of endless death in the era of Great Yu. Anyone who saw him trembled in fear, praying for a quick death.
He looked down at the pleading crowd and found it immensely exhilarating. He relished this sensation of supreme authority, this dominion over life and death.
But now, it was his turn to feel fear.
The woman before him exerted a pressure even the Imperial Teacher couldn't match. Just who was she?
He had scouted Qingzhou in advance. There was no one at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage here, so how could such a terrifying existence appear?
Even if there was someone at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, they would have needed time to arrive at Qingzhou.
And how had she appeared so silently, so unnoticed?
How had she managed to confine him, a master of spatial manipulation?
Whose force was she from?
A stream of questions flooded his mind relentlessly.
"Wh...who are you?" Only now did he recognize the tremble in his voice. He had, without realizing, cowered in the purest form of fear.
Yun Zhi had no intention of answering the enemy's questions, nor did she consider him worth responding to.
She extended her hand, and the bell around her lustrous wrist jingled.
A splat—
A large area of the Red Plague's chest abruptly caved in. He was flung back, half his teeth knocked out.
His hat and clothes were blown open by the force, revealing an elderly face composed of countless skin grafts.
He felt as if he had been hit by an overwhelming force, like a vast ocean or falling stars, raining down upon the earth. It was an invincible force, impossible to estimate and supremely powerful.
"Run!"
Flying backward turned out to be a blessing in disguise, allowing him to break free from the spatial confinement. Without sparing a thought for the two ancient cultivators who were now completely stupefied, he brandished his whip, tearing through space as he tried to escape into the distance.
As he swung his whip, a crack appeared in the space. Yun Zhi's figure emerged from the other side of the crack, looking expressionlessly at the Red Plague.
"Die!"
Lightning wrapped around the whip as he lashed it toward Yun Zhi, a single strike with enough power to cut a city in two.
Yun Zhi ignored the lightning on the whip, grabbed onto it, and delivered a kick to the Red Plague.
A splat—
The place she kicked turned into a bloody mess. The Red Plague staggered backward, vomiting blood, before collapsing onto the ground.
The provincial governor stared in disbelief. The opponent was at Transcendence Tribulation Stage, yet he appeared like a child in Yun Zhi's hands, causing not a single ripple.
He knew that Yun Zhi was the Acting Sect Master of Seek Dao Sect, and she must have a level of battle prowess that was no less than Daoist Buyu's. But he hadn't expected her battle prowess to be this terrifying.
Down below, Lan Ting, Bai Ming, and Yan Tianzhi were shocked speechless by the scene before them.
They would have expected someone of the level of an Immortal Sect elder to step in when facing someone at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage. Yet it was someone younger than the Sect Leader who stepped up, defeating the enemy in an overwhelmingly dominant manner.
Lan Ting finally understood why her master was reluctant to mention Yun Zhi. Her strength was unimaginably high.
"Wait, if Senior Sister Yun Zhi forces me to marry Lu Yang, what should I do?" Lan Ting mused and felt a flicker of joy in her heart.
Bai Ming felt that he should go back and persuade his master. There was no need to hold such grudges against Seek Dao Sect. They could all be companions in the Immortal Sect, and it wouldn't hurt to sit down and discuss things.
If Seek Dao Sect sat, the Five Elements Sect could stand and talk, too.
But it would be difficult to deal with Seek Dao Sect's Second Elder's interest in his mother, so he thought maybe he would continue to hold a grudge against Seek Dao Sect.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, both acquainted with Yun Zhi's strength, were not surprised by the sight. If someone at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage could turn things around against their Eldest Senior Sister, now that would be strange.
Xia Qun finally understood why her sect's ancestor left to greet this important figure from Seek Dao Sect.
The one who was most frightened was Vice Headmaster Shi.
He knew that Yun Zhi had suppressed the sect leaders of the Four Great Immortal Sects in the showdown between Immortal Sects; however, he hadn't expected her to suppress the Red Plague with such ease.
"The Red Plague must be at the early stage of Transcendence Tribulation. If she could suppress him easily, could it be that Eldest Senior Sister has reached the Semi-Immortal level like the ancestral pioneers of the Dragon and Phoenix clans? She's only this young, what a monster..."
"Wait, the Heavenly King of Heaven's Court fought this monster to a draw?"
He abruptly remembered another thing, which meant that Heaven's Court's power exceeded his estimates!
"The ancient prodigy feared by Immortals, the Nine Heavenly Kings, the Semi-Immortal Master... What else don't we from Nine Nether Sect know?"
"Indeed, what we know is just what Heaven's Court wants us to know. Heaven's Court's power might be even more profound!"
"Choosing not to confront but to cooperate with Heaven's Court was the wisest choice."
"As for the reincarnation of Master Qin... it's better to let her stay in Heaven's Court. After all, she was the former master. Once she regains her memory, she should still have feelings for Nine Nether Sect."
Suddenly, the vice headmaster's face turned pale, and he hurriedly left.
"Damn it, we've reached the one-month deadline again!"
...
The Red Plague coughed up blood, his voice muffled. His eyes were filled with tiny blood vessels, all hinting at madness.
"Hehe, I ran into a Semi-Immortal. Even if I perish, I'll take you down with me!"
The Red Plague went berserk. Countless vibrant red flowers sprouted again at his feet. The blooming flowers signified death.
The flowers exploded one after another with deafening eruptions, shaking the heavens and earth. Fear of the vibrant flowers welled up from the depths of people's souls.
"If you dodge, the explosion from my Mandrake flower will create a deep pit that spans half of this region!"
Yun Zhi did not react, nor did she even lift her eyelids to the Red Plague's threat.
"Boring."
...
A series of explosions echoed through heaven and earth. The resulting smoke obscured all investigation, leaving everyone uncertain about the outcome of the fight.
"That Great Power should be fine, right?" Upon hearing the threat from the Red Plague, the cultivators attending the banquet couldn't help but worry. As powerful as the Great Cultivator who intervened might be, it seemed impossible for her to block such an attack unscathed.
It was beyond their understanding—whether it was the Transcendence Tribulation Stage or the Semi-Immortal.
"She should have other means to block it," ventured a companion, but without much confidence.
"Hopefully."
The other cultivators at the banquet shared similar concerns. The Red Plague had been so overwhelmingly oppressive, exerting a pressure that felt like it could destroy the world.
Just then, while everyone was worrying, Yun Zhi descended from the sky, dragging the Red Plague along with her. She stepped on empty air, proceeding towards Lu Yang.
Lu Yang knew of Eldest Senior Sister's strength, so he didn't worry about her safety from start to finish.
He craned his neck curiously to look at the figure behind Eldest Senior Sister. He couldn't call him the Red Plague anymore. The mysterious red clothing had been blown to bits in the explosion. The figure was charred black beyond recognition, not resembling a human anymore.
"Is he dead?"
Lu Yang wondered if Eldest Senior Sister had been so ruthless as to annihilate even his soul.
Fairy Eternity in his spiritual space pouted. "Only his body is left. His soul has fled."
Yun Zhi's expression remained unchanged.
"I know. I want to know where he would run to."

chapters.title: Chapter 370 - 369: How many Unification Phases are there at your Qingzhou feast?_1
chapters.content:
"Whoosh--whoosh--"
The figure draped in bloody robes gasped heavily. His heart pounded as if it wanted to burst from his chest, stripping him of his formerly calm and arrogant demeanor.
"Damn it, my luck is terrible! I wanted to observe the power of the State Destiny intending to plan for the future, but unexpectedly encountered a Great Power of Semi-Immortal Level intervening. This era truly is not to be underestimated!"
"Fortunately, I was thorough, making dual preparations not only with the Substitution Jade Stone but also this spare corpse!"
"My deliberate self-explosion just now was a diversion. It caught the Semi-Immortal Level Great Power off guard, providing me the chance to escape!"
In the era of Great Yu, this figure draped in bloody robes was known as the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign. His appearance typically signified bloody storms and chaotic times.
At the level of Pass Tribulation, nobody could keep him in check. He operated according to his whims, who could control him?
He originally planned to use this era's opportunity to resurrect the country, to elevate his Cultivation Level to a higher stage, but unexpectedly encountered a supreme power capable of killing him.
"Damn, when have I ever been so desperate!"
The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign looked at his dilapidated body, only at the Unification Stage, and felt deep regret.
He had acted out his self-destruction extremely convincingly to trick the Semi-Immortal Great Power, resulting in major damage to his soul. His soul almost dispersed, and he intentionally left some soul fragments on his exploded corpse.
However, his backup resurrection body was only at the Unification Stage.
Both his soul and body were at Unification Stage. He didn't know how much heavenly treasures he would have to consume to return to his former peak.
Unlike the time of Great Yu, all types of heavenly treasures now belonged to someone. He'd have to go to great lengths to acquire those, and there was the risk of his identity being exposed.
"Now is not the time to consider these difficulties. The immediate priority is to leave this place!"
He was still not completely out of danger. His resurrection was limited by distance, and his revival location was in a room of an inn at the foot of the mountain.
"The surrounding area is on high alert. If I fly out, I will be too conspicuous, and it's easy for someone to discover. Running out is the safest option."
He exited the room and left the inn, his eyes shining when he saw a group of fine horses leisurely grazing in the meadow, unaffected by the pressure released by two Unification Stage practitioners just now.
These horses had shiny coats and were all female. The white horse in the middle seemed a bit old and tired.
Surprisingly, these mares all intentionally or unintentionally rubbed against the old white horse in the middle, revealing a kind of affection.
The old white horse accepted them all.
"A pure-blooded Dragon horse!" The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign's eyes lit up. He did not expect to encounter a pure-blooded Dragon horse here, a rare species that only exist in the Vast Eastern Sea. He always wanted to go to the East Sea to seize one, but there were rumors about the ancient Immortal, Yingtian Immortal, hiding in the East Sea, so he dared not go there.
"The horse's owner must be deliberately disguising this horse as old. Demon Beasts are attracted to the strong, these ordinary horses are naturally attracted to the pure-blooded Dragon horse due to their superior bloodline!"
"Riding a Dragon horse to leave should compensate for some of today's losses. It's perfect for riding away!"
After careful consideration, the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign decided that this was the fastest way to leave this place. He slightly released his pressure, scaring off the group of mares.
Dragon horse's eyes were filled with rage, which made the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign laugh.
"Good Dragon horse, I know you understand human speech. Follow me and I will not treat you poorly!"
With that, he strode towards the Dragon horse.
Dragon horse was also a Demon Beast. It would surely follow him.
Bang--
The Dragon horse kicked back with its rear hooves, dislocating both of Heavenly Calamity Sovereign's arms.
"A Great Demon King at Unification Stage!" The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign was terrified. Why was there another Unification Stage? Why did it not intervene when dealing with the two ancient Unification Stage practitioners just now?
With a Great Demon King as mount, who could its owner be?
"The mount of the Semi-Immortal Great Power!" The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign immediately thought of this possibility. He had made a move against the Semi-Immortal Great Power's mount, so the other party might have already discovered him.
Must escape quickly!
The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign still dared not fly, boldly used his magic power, burrowed into the earth, and crawled forward without releasing his Spiritual Sense for fear of being noticed.
After running for a while, the terrifying pressure of the Semi-Immortal Level that made the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign's heart palpitations never came, making him somewhat relieved.
"It seems she didn't notice me just now."
He poked his head out of the ground, the surroundings were barren, and only one person was meditating. Feeling safe, he emerged from the ground.
"It should be safe here."
When he saw the cultivator meditating nearby, he felt a pang of greed.
They were already far away from the Qingzhou grand event, with a cultivator disappearing, no one would suspect him.
Swallowing a cultivator should at least recover some of his magic power.
He walked straight towards the cultivator, and then heard the cultivator, with his eyes closed, speak coldly, appearing unwelcoming.
"If I were you, I would definitely not come closer to this place."
The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign sneered. Was it sensing his malice, realizing that it couldn't escape, and trying to scare him?
In this era, it seemed that cultivators also liked to bluff, but unfortunately for them, these methods were the ones he had already played with!
"Really? I'd like to see what will happen if I get close!" The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign stepped towards the cultivator.
Vice Headmaster Shi opened his eyes, seeing the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign still approaching him, he shook his head.
The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign had changed his body, and he had not recognized him, but if someone was looking for trouble, he wasn't going to stop them.
Rumble--
An astonishing thunderclap echoed throughout the universe, deafening the sky, making anyone who heard it turn pale.
The thunderbolt was like a huge silver spear descending from the sky, connecting the heavens and the earth, piercing through them.
"What's going on! Where did this Thunder Tribulation come from!" The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign was shocked. How did a Thunder Tribulation appear here?
More importantly, the Thunder Tribulation was aiming at him!
"Damn it, it's you!" The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign glared at Vice Headmaster Shi. The latter was passing the Thunder Tribulation, he was drawn into it and judged by the Thunder Tribulation as an Intruder.
"I warned you not to come closer." Vice Headmaster Shi stated coldly.
"Thunder Tribulation, what should the Sovereign fear!" The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign roared furiously, his robes fluttering, and he exerted his full strength.
"It's you!" Vice Headmaster Shi's face changed, sensing from the aura released by the other party that he was the perpetrator who disrupted the Qingzhou grand event!
He instinctively became tense, but noticing that the other party's vitality was greatly reduced and his Cultivation Level was similar to his own, his fear subsided.
"It was you who destroyed the Qingzhou grand event, causing my shop to shut down!" Vice Headmaster Shi said angrily.
"Huh?" The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign was taken aback. Vice Headmaster Shi's information gave him a shock.
"A cultivator at Unification Stage went to the Qingzhou grand event to set up a shop?"
The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign widened his eyes. Why was there another Unification Stage that did not act?
How many monsters were hidden in the Qingzhou grand event?
"No point in talking! Let's face the Thunder Tribulation together!" Vice Headmaster Shi was at his peak, while the other party was at his last breath. In the face of Thunder Tribulation, the latter would definitely have it worse!
Retribution, serves him right!
Seeing an enemy tends to worsen one's mood, Vice Headmaster Shi did not expect that he would bump into his enemy while sneaking out to pass a tribulation.
If not now, when?
Rumble--
Thunder Tribulation arrived, boundless thunder turned into plasma carrying intense energy, engulfing both of them.

chapters.title: Chapter 371 - 370: Hiding in the Prison Cell Should Be Safe_1
chapters.content:
After the Thunder Tribulation, Heavenly Calamity Sovereign was barely left alive, charred black all over, resembling a corpse to a great extent.
"Damn it! You, at the Unification stage, how come you have encountered such a powerful Thunder Tribulation!"
Vice Headmaster Shi did not answer, but thought to himself, isn't the destructive power of a thunder tribulation worth ten billion Spirit Stones supposed to be great?
With the experience of passing a Thunder Tribulation once before, Vice Headmaster Shi was fully prepared.
Charred black, Vice Headmaster Shi, like a sculpture, made a slight crackling sound, skin split open, and he tore to reveal a new self underneath.
"Entry-level Cicada Moulting Technique?" The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign recognized this technique.
Vice Headmaster Shi gave him a glance without responding, then gulped down an elixir. The sight made the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign green with envy.
The Entry-level Cicada Moulting Technique could only keep his body clean, yet the state of exhaustion after crossing the Thunder Tribulation still needed to be recovered through elixirs.
The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign wanted to steal the elixir, but his physical condition was so terrible that it was a blessing he could even move. Snatching the elixir was beyond his capabilities.
Vice Headmaster Shi chuckled coldly as he absorbed the medicinal effects of the elixir.
"Damn it, you ancient cultivators have ruined the honest business I barely set up. Now that you're in my hands, you're out of luck!"
Vice Headmaster Shi no longer abided by any Divine Ability or magical rules. He vented his anger at the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign by punching and kicking him.
"You rascal, you dare obstruct my path to wealth!"
"Do you really think cultivators of the current era are easy to bully!"
"If I don't beat you to the point where even your mother can't recognize you, I am not surnamed Shi!"
The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign was brutally beaten by Shi, his face bruised and battered, and not a single bone in his body was left intact, with special attention given to his private parts.
Vice Headmaster Shi shook his right hand and dropped a thick iron chain, tying the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign tightly. He hoisted him up as one might haul a pig.'
"No, can't let him take me away!" The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign realized that Vice Headmaster Shi was someone ruthless. To follow him would surely lead to a dead end!
Must run!
He bit his tongue to draw blood, spitting out his Essence Blood, his body turning into green smoke, threw off the iron chain, and tore open a spatial rift to disappear.
"Burning lifespan!" Vice Headmaster Shi was astounded, he did not expect the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign to be so heartless. His iron chain could lock both body and soul. The Sovereign would have failed to escape without burning at least thousands of years of his lifespan.
"You're truly ruthless! After such a burn, how many years can you still live?"
Seeing the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign's means, Vice Headmaster Shi felt helpless: "Let it be, if he has escaped, he has escaped. I can just take revenge on other ancient cultivators."
….
Heavenly Calamity Sovereign was still on the run, now finding it difficult to gain an upper hand in the Great Era dispute.
"The approach was wrong. I ended up encountering that psycho who was enduring the Thunder Tribulation because I was hiding in an uninhabited place. This time, I'll hide in a city!"
He promptly changed tactics and aimed towards the nearest city.
"Goose County, nice name. 'Wild geese flying south, rising again in the east', it perfectly suits my situation!"
To be cautious, he used his Spiritual Sense to probe the situation in Goose County.
"Seems to be a prosperous city, and the County Magistrate is only at the Divinity Transformation Stage, quite suitable for hiding!"
