A faint smile appeared on the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign's face. A prosperous city, a weak magistrate, it was the ideal spot!
Heaven helps me too!
After burning his lifespan, his realm once again dropped, falling to the early Unification stage, nearly losing his Unification Realm status.
Due to the unique feature of the Refining the Void stage, from the Unification Stage you bypass the Refining the Void Stage, dropping directly to the Divinity Transformation Stage.
"Luck is always on my side!"
He sneaked into Goose County, considering where would be the most suitable place for him to hide and recover his realm.
"I can regain my cultivation level by absorbing the energy of others. The absorption process is better undisturbed, so I need to find an utterly dreary place!"
The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign then thought of a fantastic idea.
"To the jail!"
The rights of prisoners are often ignored, and any accidents that happen to them will not cause a stir.
He transformed into a thick smoke and slipped into the jail cell.
Once inside, he heard two people arguing.
"I've told you, the law isn't meant to be used this way, what's wrong with your mind?"
"Nonsense, I was the one who crafted this law, and you're telling me how it should be used?"
"Just because you crafted it, you think you understand it? Yun Zhi was raised by me, I have no clue how strong she is now!"
"Bullshit!"
"You're the one talking bullshit."
Daoist Buyu and the Minister of Justice are arguing, the once polite and easygoing Minister of Justice becomes increasingly irritable.
"Wait a moment." Daoist Buyu raised his hand, noticing something was wrong.
"Who's there!"
"Such a heavy scent of blood!" The Minister of Justice was surprised, he had executed many wicked criminals, but none carried a scent of blood as heavy as the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign.
Demon cultivators fear the strength of the righteous path and have secret methods to conceal their scent of blood, but the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign did not have this concept. In the Great Yu era, whether one had a strong or faint scent of blood was a trivial matter, sometimes even regarded as a symbol of honor.
"Hehe, since the two of you youngsters can sense my presence, then be nourishment for me!" The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign thought he had accidentally revealed his presence just now. However, this was a trivial matter, he had his own ways to control these two!
If he couldn't deal with others, he could at least handle these prisoners, right?
A gloomy and terrifying glow suddenly appeared, the evil energy whirled in the narrow space, generating a black hole-like force. Silent screams echoed in the air, seemingly coming from an endless abyss.
Become my servant!"
The Minister of Justice took action decisively, a large, invisible, golden hand slapped away the dense smoke. The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign fell and rolled to the floor, the gloomy light, evil energy, and silent screams all vanished.
"What nonsense is this, daring to show off these tricks in front of this official!"
The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign fell to the ground, taken aback.
How did he fall over?
"A demon cultivator, seize him!" Daoist Buyu took action, his sword's heart pulsated, thousands of sword qi circulated magnificently, filling the entire space.
The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign couldn't even escape by tearing through space!
Daoist Buyu, who often escaped, knows how to deal with those who often escape.
Only Yun Zhi could restrict him. If it were anyone else, they wouldn't have had a chance.
The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign: "....."
The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign was speechless for a long time, he didn't even know how to express his feelings.
What's happening? Why are such powerful individuals locked up in prison?
They were even more formidable than the lunatic who was undergoing the Thunder Tribulation just now!
There were no restrictions in this jail cell. What were you two doing here, enjoying a jail cell's winter warmth and summer coolness?
"Who is this man?" The Minister of Justice had never seen someone with such a death wish.
"Who knows? He's clearly nothing good, probably some ancient cultivator who's never seen the world before. He was likely injured and came to this cell to recover. Let's capture him; this would count as a significant merit for us. Maybe our sentences will be reduced!" Daoist Buyu excitedly proposed. What joy to achieve merits while in prison.
The Minister of Justice also became excited at Daoist Buyu's words.
Yun Zhi had been following the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign, and upon seeing this situation, she let out a sigh. It seemed impossible to expect the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign to return to his old home now.
She had no choice. The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign was incredibly unlucky. First, he encountered Old Horse, and got kicked by him. Then, he underwent Thunder Tribulation with Vice Headmaster Shi. Finally, he ended up in Goose County's jail cell with her master and the Minister of Justice, only to be captured by these two peak Unification stage individuals.
It was a miracle he survived after all these incidents.
Yun Zhi had never seen someone so unlucky.
She'll have to take him back for intense interrogation.
She appeared in the jail cell, "Master, Minister, it's been a long time."

chapters.title: Chapter 372 - 371: Kind Cultivator, Vice Headmaster Shi_1
chapters.content:
Daoist Buyu and the Minister of Justice were scrutinising the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign from head to toe, when they heard a light, yet familiar voice from behind them. The sudden sound made them both shudder.
"Master and Minister, it's been a long time."
"It's you!" Seeing the figure that caused his downfall, the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign let out a terrified scream, attempting to crawl forward in a panicked frenzy.
Daoist Buyu and the Minister of Justice glanced sideways at the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign, thinking to themselves how his reaction was even more exaggerated than theirs.
Being the intelligent ones they were, they quickly deduced the reason: this man was being pursued by Yun Zhi and, in desperation, fled here hoping to conceal himself using the sinister energy of the prison. However, he had been caught red-handed by the two of them.
"If I'm not mistaken, this man is the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign of the Great Yu Dynasty during its mid-stage. He took advantage of the grand event in Qingzhou, incited two ancient unification stage cultivators to cause a riot, forcing the Governor of Qingzhou to use the State Destiny and the phantom of the Taishang Sword. All of this was to gather information."
"Fortunately, our clever junior brother noticed the abnormalities in those two ancient Unification stage cultivators and promptly notified me, allowing us to capture him."
"If such sensitive information about the State Destiny and the Taishang sword were to be passed on to other ancient cultivators, it would undoubtedly cause us considerable trouble."
"It's strange, where did this unknown unification stage cultivator come from? Turns out he's from the ancient unification period!" The Minister of Justice glared at the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign, gritting his teeth in anger.
Daoist Buyu too stopped his jovial demeanor. The ancient cultivators indeed were one of the many tribulations that Great Xia had to face.
Yun Zhi squinted her eyes. This was the second time she had captured an ancient Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator. Previously, she and the other leaders of the Five Great Immortal Sects, along with Emperor Xia, had come to a consensus that more and more ancient cultivators would awaken as time went by.
It appears now that the Unification Stage cultivators were awakening, and the Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivators would be next to awaken in the future.
But judging from the actions of this ancient Transcendance Tribulation stage cultivator, he seemed to be well aware of the State Destiny and the Taishang Sword. It suggests that he must have awakened quite some time ago.
"It seems that in places unknown to us, many ancient cultivators are hiding." The chill in Yun Zhi's voice betrayed her displeasure. These simple-minded beings became immortals, yet they needed to calculate time, plot various matters, and bring calamity to the world.
The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign's body was shriveled, and his breath faint, as if he could die at any moment. Seeing him in this state, Yun Zhi lightly touched him with her index finger and pulled out his soul.
Bringing the soul back would be far more convenient.
Instead of taking along a crumbling body, it was better to take only the soul.
Yun Zhi held an invisible chain in her right hand. On the other end of the chain was the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign who was tied up.
"Oh right, master and Minister, capturing the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign is a great achievement. I will report this to Emperor Xia." Before leaving, Yun Zhi suddenly added.
Both of them were frozen for a moment before bursting into rejoice. Such recognition would surely grant them their freedom from the prison.
They had thought they would miss their chance to be released.
…
"Where should I go to find ancient cultivators for revenge?" Vice Headmaster Shi pondered. He was a man known to take revenge at the earliest opportunity.
"My friend, you hold a high moral standard, specifically seeking for ancient cultivators. I, for one, admire this!" A hearty laughter sounded, bringing a sense of delight.
Vice Headmaster Shi found the voice a bit familiar. As he turned his head to look, he was slightly taken aback. It was the Governor.
The Governor greeted Vice Headmaster Shi with a respectful bow, his attitude sincere: "I do not know the identity or name of our friend here, who took the opportunity of the Thunder Tribulation to inflict severe damage upon the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign. This is indeed a significant achievement, and I kindly request you to accompany me back to my residence.
There will be considerable rewards for you and afterwards, I will have an audience with the court to grant you a proper medal for your bravery."
Like Yun Zhi, the Governor also closely followed the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign. However, he wasn't as quick as Yun Zhi and didn't witness the entire incident.
When he arrived, Vice Headmaster Shi was dragging the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign to the Thunder Tribulation. The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign had tried to escape multiple times but was always thwarted by Vice Headmaster Shi. Vice Headmaster Shi even took perverse delight in the Sovereign's predicament, always laughing it off.
Right after the Thunder Tribulation, Vice Headmaster Shi tied up the Sovereign, fearing he might run away.
In the Governor's mind, Vice Headmaster Shi was an isolated hermit cultivator, braving the Thunder Tribulation in the wilderness. Seeing the blood-stained and malicious Heavenly Calamity Sovereign, he decided to keep him at bay using the Thunder Tribulation.
Such kindness!
Moved by this, the Governor immediately offered to stay and reward Vice Headmaster Shi.
Vice Headmaster Shi repeatedly shook his head. He dared not follow the Governor. If his identity were to be revealed to the Governor, wouldn't the Governor receive a promotion?
This was not his idea. It was recorded as that on the bounty list.
"Governor, you're too kind. All I did was punish these lawless ancient cultivators. As a chivalrous man, seeking rewards is illogical. Wouldn't that be putting the cart before the horse? I respectfully decline and bid you farewell!"
After saying so, he hastily left, not giving the Governor a chance to insist.
The Governor watched as Vice Headmaster Shi disappeared, sighing deeply from the bottom of his heart: "Truly a great virtuous hermit cultivator."
…
In the grand feast of Qingzhou, the two ancient Unification Stage cultivators had been captured, their cultivation sealed. They were alternately guarded by several Unification Stage cultivators. Soon, the court was to dispatch the Luosui Guards to take away these two ancient unification stage cultivators, pluck their meridians, and imprison them in the Heavenly Prison.
The officials performed their respective duties to uphold the order. With the Governor absent, Xia Qun held the highest position. He sat in government office, directing with order and command. Everything was progressively returning to normalcy.
What they were recovering was not material, but more of a mental shock.
Ancient Unification Stage cultivators, State Destiny, Taishang Sword's phantom, ancient Transcendance Tribulation stage cultivators, and the mysterious great power that could easily suppress Transcendance Tribulation stage... all these were things ordinary cultivators couldn't come in contact with.
And it wasn't just ordinary cultivators. Even people like Lan Ting were stunned, unable to get their bearings.
Lu Yang, on the other hand, was unfazed. What were ancient Transcendance Tribulation stage cultivators? He had the number one fairy from ancient times and one of the top ten beauties in his spiritual space, who often discussed ancient secrets involving Immortals. In comparison to this discussion, the Transcendance Tribulation stage didn't make the cut.
He overheard the passerby talking about what had just happened.
"We're fortunate to have that great power intervene. Otherwise, we would be in danger." A Golden Core Stage cultivator sighed with relief, nearly convinced he was about to die. He now thought how lucky he was to be alive.
His companion agreed, the fear still visible in his eyes, "Indeed, if we continue on this, what does that great power look like? Is it male or female?"
"You forgot what our savior looks like... Yeah, what did that great power look like? Was it a man or a woman?"
Both looked at each other, at a loss.
Passersby on the other side were also discussing the recent battle.
"The Governor is powerful. He single-handedly withstood the Transcendance Tribulation stage magic artifact."
"That's nothing, the Governor nearly killed that ancient Transcendance Tribulation stage cultivator, especially with that sword, it defied the heavens!"
"Sword? What sword?"
"You're so forgetful, what's it called... what was the sword made of?"
"What weapon did the Governor use to defeat the ancient Unification Stage cultivator?"
Both were completely puzzled and quickly forgot about the whole incident.
Lu Yang frowned at the scene, recalling the events in his mind - State Destiny, the phantom of the Taishang Sword, Eldest Senior Sister... he remembered everything clearly.
"Fairy, what's going on here?"

chapters.title: Chapter 373 - 372 Immortal Characteristics_1
chapters.content:
"You need to consult me again, don't you?" Fairy Eternity was ready and eager to answer Lu Yang's questions.
"Ask the juniors of other immortal sects first and see how much they remember." Fairy Eternity guided Lu Yang to find the root cause by himself.
"Lan Ting, do you remember the battle just now?"
Lan Ting rolled her eyes at Lu Yang and thought it was a silly question. "Of course I remember, isn't it about Senior Sister Yun Zhi showing off her divine powers and suppressing the Transcendence Tribulation Stage."
"What about before that?"
"You mean the process of the governor and ancient Unification Stage battle, was it not the governor using..."
Suddenly, Lan Ting got stuck. She felt like the answer was on the tip of her tongue, but she couldn't remember it.
What did the governor use again?
Lu Yang didn't probe deeper. He asked Lan Ting and got roughly the same results. They forgot about the State Destiny and the phantom of the Taishang Sword and he switched to Yan Tianzhi. "Do you still remember Eldest Senior Sister?"
"Yun Zhi, Senior Sister, I remember."
"And the tactics used by the governor?"
Yan Tianzhi blinked, answering succinctly, "I forgot."
"Old Meng, what about you? Is your mind still clear?"
"Nonsense, when has my mind not been clear? Wasn't it that the governor used the State Destiny to summon the Taishang Sword's phantom and fought against the ancient Unification Stage, and then, Eldest Senior Sister suppressed the ancient Transcendence Tribulation Stage?"
Lu Yang appeared thoughtful. The ordinary cultivators forgot about the State Destiny and the Eldest Senior Sister, Lan Ting and the other two forgot about the State Destiny, only he and Meng Jingzhou remembered the whole process of the battle.
"Is the key point the State Destiny? The State Destiny erased everyone's memories. Meng Jingzhou, who was born in the Meng Family, had once struggled with the royal family for supremacy and then had multiple marriage alliances. Old Meng is of the Meng Family, but he also has royal blood, so he could remember the State Destiny?"
"What about Eldest Senior Sister then? She didn't want to be high-profile and erased most people's memories, but didn't erase our five people's memories?" Lu Yang felt like he had found the answer and sought confirmation from Fairy Eternity.
"You're not far off. The State Destiny erased everyone's memories. However, it's not that Miss Yun didn't erase your memories, but that she deliberately retained your memories. Do you understand the difference?"
Lu Yang lowered his head to think and was shocked. "The memory erasure action of Eldest Senior Sister and State Destiny happens automatically!"
"Correct, this is the characteristic of Immortals. It will automatically make the world forget the means of Immortals unless the Immortal deliberately lets the world remember their methods."
"The actions of the State Destiny and Miss Yun can both be classified as 'means of Immortals'."
"The governor in charge of this place will not forget the State Destiny. That person called Xia Qun has royal blood and will not forget the State Destiny. The Meng lad is the same."
Lu Yang suddenly discovered another question, "Wait, you're talking about the means of Immortals, does the Dao Fruit count as the means of Immortals?"
Fairy Eternity was satisfied with Lu Yang's quick deductions. "Your mind is quick. As the most important feature of Immortals, Dao Fruit naturally counts as the means of Immortals."
"Like the Tribulation Dao Fruit of Yingtian Immortal, the Time Dao Fruit of Time Immortal, are typical means of Immortals. Even though Time Immortal writes his ability in his name, the world still can't remember the Time Dao Fruit and doesn't know that Time Immortal's ability is related to time."
This is one of the reasons why Immortals are mysterious.
"Then how can I remember all this?"
Fairy Eternity boasted: "Why ask this? With me covering for you, how can you forget?"
"For you, the second-in-command of Immortal Eternity Lineage, to not know anything about other Immortals would make people laugh at our lineage!"
Only then did Lu Yang realize how precious the knowledge he possessed was.
"Of course, not all Immortals have the ability to make others forget their means, I am an exception to that, otherwise, there wouldn't be the Eternity Sect!"
Fairy Eternity extended two slender, pale fingers.
"Based on this characteristic, Immortals can be divided into two types. One is Immortals who possess the ability to automatically make others forget their methods."
"The other is Immortals like me who don't have that characteristic!"
"In fact, these are two paths, two different choices."
Lu Yang was silent for a long time, then slowly raised his hand, fist to the heart, sincerely said, "Fairy, you are indeed very powerful!"
His serious attitude made Fairy Eternity feel a little overwhelmed. Her cheeks turned slightly red, and she didn't know where to put her hands and feet.
She hugged her arms, her pretty face slightly raised, her mouth pouted out: "Hey, I've said that I'm very impressive, but you don't believe me."
After she finished speaking, she opened her eyes a little and stealthily observed Lu Yang's reaction.
Seeing Lu Yang still bearing that serious expression, she felt even more at a loss.
"I'm going to sleep now. Go away, don't interrupt my sleep!" Fairy Eternity drove Lu Yang out of his Spiritual Space.
...
Although it seemed like the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign had escaped for a long time, the process was very brief. Lu Yang and his group waited at the original place for a little while, and then they saw Eldest Senior Sister return to the Qingzhou grand ceremony with the soul of the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign.
"Eldest Senior Sister, you came back so soon?" Lu Yang was surprised. Wasn't it agreed to follow the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign to find his lair? The speed was too fast.
Yun Zhi: "..."
"The plan has changed."
Yun Zhi was unwilling to explain. How was she supposed to explain? Should she say that the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign made a bad start and hit four Unification Stages head-on and incidentally helped her master and the Minister of Justice reduce their sentence?
"Yun...Senior Sister Yun Zhi." Lan Ting timidly greeted her and dared not look straight at Yun Zhi.
Yun Zhi's majestic posture in the sky was indeed a bit scary. Anyone who saw it would be afraid.
Yun Zhi glanced at Lan Ting and nodded slightly. "I remember you. Your master brought you to propose a marriage to Lu Yang. I agreed. Then your master changed his mind, ran away with you."
Lan Ting was silent for a long time and couldn't link Yun Zhi's words with that experience.
"Senior Sister Yun Zhi."
"Senior Sister."
Bai Ming and Yan Tianzhi were also nervously greeting her. They were even more nervous than when meeting the ancestor of their own sect.
"The governor told me that this year's Qingzhou Grand Ceremony ends here. You are free to arrange your respective journeys." Yun Zhi kindly reminded
She pulled on the chain in her hand: "I need to interrogate this person. I will return to the sect first."
Just as Yun Zhi was about to leave, she remembered something when she saw Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou and turned to ask Lan Ting.
"By the way, how did Junior Brother and Junior Brother Meng perform in the competition during the Qingzhou Grand Ceremony? Did they accurately assess the strengths and weaknesses of the competing cultivators?"
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were startled, breaking into a cold sweat.
As expected, Eldest Senior Sister dispatched them over to be judges, not to participate in the competition.
Lan Ting pondered for a moment, then smiled sweetly: "Senior Brother Lu Yang and Senior Brother Meng Jingzhou are examples of our younger generation, they are talented, and have rich battle experience, their criticisms hit the nail on the head, each word was a gem, the competing cultivators were quite convinced, all said that they would practice hard when they go back."
Eldest Senior Sister nodded: "That's good. I was worried that the two of them would take part in the competition. It's good that they didn't."
When Fairy Eternity heard what Yun Zhi said, she wasn't sleepy anymore. She jumped up from the bed, wanting to expose Lu Yang, but was silenced by Lu Yang covering her mouth.

chapters.title: Chapter 374 - 373: Great Yu Imperial Teacher_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou felt touched when Lan Ting defended them. The gratitude they felt was as intense as they would for reborn parents.
By contrast, Fairy Eternity seemed to enjoy the spectacle, unfazed by the possible consequences. Thankfully, Lu Yang acted swiftly by covering her mouth with his hand, otherwise the outcome might have been disastrous for him.
"Let's go. Let's head back together," Yun Zhi said before flying to the foot of the mountain. Seeing her action, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou bid farewell to the others and hurriedly caught up.
"We'll go ahead first!"
"We will meet again."
"Come and visit us in the Laurel Fairy Palace when you have time."
The five of them bid farewell to each other. Now that the festival was over, they all had their own matters to attend, hence they couldn't always be together.
Once Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou reached the base of the mountain, Yun Zhi lifted the curtain of the carriage and said, "Get in."
Meng Jingzhou looked strangely at the old horse. It appeared very different from what it normally does - dull fur, droopy eyes like it had reached old age and every day was a bonus.
However, the old horse in front of them now was completely different. Shiny hair, spirited - a fine steed that was a rarity in this world.
Yun Zhi held a soul-locking chain in her hand with the other end extending from the carriage, tethering the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign outside the carriage like a balloon. It looked rather comical.
Seeing the old horse, once a haughty great demon, now willingly pulling the carriage, the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign was convinced of his previous guess.
This horse, a great demon that transformed into a dragon horse, must be the mount of a semi-immortal Great Power!
"Don't get ahead of yourselves. The Imperial Teacher will definitely restore Great Yu!" The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign laughed wildly, his expression fierce.
Annoyed by his laughter, Yun Zhi formed an imprint with her hand and sealed his senses, preventing him from making any sound or sensing anything from outside.
"Imperial Teacher? The Imperial Teacher of Great Yu is behind all this?" Lu Yang searched his memory for information about the great teacher once he got into the carriage.
"What is an Imperial Teacher?" Fairy Eternity asked. She had not yet fully understood the knowledge of the current world, much less the extinct system of the Imperial Teacher.
"The Imperial Teacher is a unique system of the Great Yu Dynasty. You could consider the Great Yu Dynasty as a Sect, and the Imperial Teacher is like the Protector of the Sect, ensuring its continued existence."
"The system of Imperial Teacher was established around 200,000 years ago, at the inception of the Great Yu Dynasty. The story goes that the first Imperial Teacher was the teacher of the first Emperor Yu, and it was him who helped establish the Great Yu Dynasty."
"The first Emperor Yu, who managed to overthrow the prior ruling dynasty and unify the Central Continent, was indeed a powerful leader. Unfortunately, none of his descendants were as competent as him - they lacked both the talent for cultivation as well as the vision to govern a country."
"At that point, the first Emperor recalled his old teacher, and established the position of Imperial Teacher, inviting his teacher to take up this position. Thus, the role of the first Imperial Teacher was created."
"Historical records show that the system of the Imperial Teacher did indeed make significant contributions after the death of the first Emperor Yu. The prosperity of the early Great Yu Dynasty could probably be attributed to the Imperial Teacher's success in cultivating a capable Emperor and ruling the country effectively."
"However, this came with a consequence. The Imperial Teacher effectively became the ruler of the Great Yu Dynasty. At the height of their power, they could even replace the Emperor Yu with just a declaration. Despite this leading to the betterment of the Great Yu Dynasty, it's doubtful that any emperor would be willing to serve under an overlord."
"Moreover, while the first Imperial Teacher served the Great Yu Dynasty with utmost dedication, can we say the same for his successors? Did they serve the Great Yu Dynasty, or did they serve their own greed?"
"By the late period of the Dynasty, the Great Yu Dynasty appeared prosperous on the surface but was fraught with danger in reality. The power struggle between the Imperial Teacher and the Emperor Yu intensified. There were instances of assassination, manipulation, use of honey traps, usurpation...one incident leading to another, no one knew what their opponents had planned."
"Flashback to the 'Summit of Flat Top Mountain' that took place 110,000 years ago - tensions came to a head. The Imperial Teacher's party and the Emperor's party had a fallout and a great war broke out at the Flat Top Mountain. At least eight individuals in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage participated in the war, not counting those who fought secretly."
"The Imperial Teacher and the Emperor Yu both suffered defeats leading to a loss in their top fighting resources. The control of the Great Yu Dynasty plummeted, resulting in the eruption of suppressed conflicts and marking the beginning of the Dynasty's downfall."
"Do you remember the ancient Transcendance Tribulation Stage being then captured by Eldest Senior Sister, the Blood Demon Venerable? He was once an Imperial Teacher."
"Blood Demon? Oh, I remember now. There were a few ancient Unification Stage individuals in the Buyi Town Ghost Stories who mentioned to Miss Yun about some treasures they left behind in the Three Stand Cave Heaven for their resurrection, right?"
"Later, Miss Yun ran into the Transcendance Tribulation Stage who was in deep sleep in the Three Stand Cave Heaven. That must be the Blood Demon Venerable you mentioned."
"Yes, I searched about him later. In the late period of the Great Yu Dynasty, the Blood Demon Venerable supported an Emperor Yu and became the Imperial Teacher. He chose to hibernate for the Great Era struggle and was caught by Eldest Senior Sister when he woke up."
"Hmm... if I remember correctly, the Blood Demon Venerable was just at the early stage of Transcendance Tribulation. Was the late period of the Great Yu Dynasty so weak?"
As the leader of the Five Immortals of the Ancients, Fairy Eternity looked down upon all in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, considering them all as trash.
However, the fact that a person at the beginning of the Transcendance Tribulation could become the Imperial Teacher reflected upon the weakness of the Great Yu Dynasty at that time.
Given the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign's admiration of "Imperial Teacher," the "Imperial Teacher" seems to have a high cultivation level.
"The late period of the Great Yu Dynasty was chaotic, with significant wear and tear of the higher-ranked powers. There were not many individuals in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. Plus, those who were stronger than the Blood Demon Venerable were not interested in the position of Imperial Teacher, thus giving him the advantage."
"For example, the first and second Imperial Teachers had advanced cultivation levels. Some speculated that they were at the peak of Transcendance Tribulation, others believed they were at the Semi-Immortal level. But no one knows for certain what their actual level was."
Fairy Eternity responded, "That's not very high, either. Does Great Xia have an Imperial Teacher position? I could reluctantly take it."
Lu Yang thought to himself, if she became an Imperial Teacher, Great Xia would probably get torn apart before the Great Era even arrived.
"Fairy, you must have forgotten, I mentioned before that the Imperial Teacher is a unique system of the Great Yu Dynasty. Great Xia doesn't have such a position."
"Oh, that's a shame." Fairy Eternity regretted the loss of an opportunity where she could demonstrate her abilities.
Just as Lu Yang was about to say something, he heard Eldest Senior Sister say, "We've arrived, get off the carriage."
Lu Yang was taken aback, touched by the fact he was already home.
How long had it been, not even an hour?
Meng Jingzhou glared at the old horse discontentedly. When it was pulling Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou to Qingzhou, it took several days. But when pulling the Eldest Senior Sister, it took less than an hour?
Was it faking its incompetence to such an extent?
"Old horse, tell me honestly, what is your exact realm?" Meng Jingzhou whispered while hugging the old horse's neck.
The old horse snorted without paying him any attention.
Meng Jingzhou was both angry and helpless. He could not beat the old horse.
"I'll go to Captive Peak to see if I can get any information out of him. You two are free to do as you please."
Eldest Senior Sister, holding the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign, flew towards Captive Peak.

chapters.title: Chapter 375 - 374: The Envious Li Haoran_1
chapters.content:
Captive Peak was the place where the Seek Dao Sect specifically detained criminals, most of whom were ancient cultivators who had done evil deeds.
Underneath Captive Peak, cages were divided into tiny cells. These cages held individuals from the Unification Stage in ancient times, who once made the world shake. Yet now, they have become prisoners whose last shred of value was being wrung out of them.
Both the imperial court and the other four Immortal Sects had similar places to prevent these ancient cultivators from causing harm.
In the cages, listless soul bodies leaned against the walls, their eyes dull.
When they detected someone's arrival, their eyes brightened and they revealed fierce expressions, trying to intimidate the newcomer. This was their only amusement in this place.
But when they saw that the visitor was Yun Zhi, their faces changed drastically, they hurriedly hid in the corners, held their breath, shaking with fear. They tried to decrease their presence as much as possible, for fear that Yun Zhi would notice them.
There were many empty cages at Captive Peak, with the phrases "Wild Ruler True Monarch," "Mount Tai True Monarch," "Mysterious Spirit Mad Demon," "True Master Guiji..." written on the top right corner of each cage. In ancient times, these names alone would make people turn pale with fear.
But now, those individuals had been merged into magic instruments by Yun Zhi, refined into Spirit Devices.
If they were to offend Yun Zhi, they would be the next ones to suffer their ill fate.
Yun Zhi broke the seal on the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign. He glanced around the room and quickly realized this was the place specifically designed to imprison them.
He was slightly startled. No wonder he couldn't contact some people who should have revived. They had been here all along.
Great Xia was more difficult to deal with than he had imagined...
Suddenly, he noticed a cage next to him with "Blood Demon Venerable" written in the top right corner.
The Blood Demon Venerable had seen a portrait of the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign and recognized this Great Cultivator who had appeared tens of thousands of years before him.
The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign roared, "Blood Demon, you piece of trash created by good timing, how does a mere beginner of the Pass Tribulation decree have the right to be the Imperial Teacher?!"
They were all in the first stages of Pass Tribulation, but he served under the Imperial Teacher, while the Blood Demon had become the Imperial Teacher. The disparity was too great.
He understood the history of Great Yu after he had hibernated and knew about the existence of the Blood Demon Venerable.
The Blood Demon Venerable selfishly supported a trash emperor for his own gain and used this puppet emperor to decree orders and reap countless benefits. To appease influential families, he implemented measures to strengthen them, actions that expedited Great Yu's demise.
The fall of Great Yu led to many influential families vying for power. The Blood Demon Venerable was the root cause of it all.
He refused to acknowledge this kind of creature as the Imperial Teacher!
The Blood Demon didn't fear him either and let him roar while turning up the corners of his mouth in an icy smile. "Heavenly Calamity elder, that's a bit harsh. The position of the Imperial Teacher was given to me. If I didn't accept it, someone else would have. How can you call that luck?"
"If the Imperial Teacher knew you were here, he would definitely kill you!"
"Then, I'll just wait."
"Miss Yun, did you capture another one?" a childish voice rang from Captive Peak. A white-haired child sized up the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign from head to toe.
The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign was taken aback. He hadn't detected at all how the other party had appeared.
"A soul with missing parts, burning his lifespan, he is quite ruthless towards himself, huh? He used to be at the Pass Tribulation Stage?"
"Yes, he's the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign from the early Pass Tribulation Stage of Great Yu." Yun Zhi answered.
The white-haired child seemed to understand. "Ah, so it's him. He's quite famous."
"In less than half a year, two people from the Pass Tribulation Stage have been captured. It seems that some people can't hold back anymore."
For a change, Yun Zhi hesitated for a moment, not having the heart to speak.
Having never captured a Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator before, it's quite something to have caught two within half a year. It's not necessarily because some people are getting impatient, but more about luck.
Our first clue originated from Buyi Town, the second was a direct encounter by Lu Yang.
The two incidents only have one thing in common - both Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were present.
Considering Lu Yang has also resurrected Fairy Eternity, it's hard to say if somebody in the dark was becoming impatient, or if Lu Yang just happens to have a connection with high-ranking cultivators.
"Grandmaster, I'll resort to using some means on him first."
"Go, go, I hope this time there will be some gains." The white-haired child grinned. He was exceedingly pleased with this talented junior.
The Blood Demon Venerable became active too late, so we essentially got no useful intel from him. However, the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign is different. He is a cultivator from the early days of the Great Yu, active during the reign of the second Imperial Teacher. He must undoubtedly know many things.
"Even though those nine guys, led by their eldest, make fools out of themselves and cause trouble for me, Old Nine has definitely accepted an exceptional disciple." The white-haired child's voice faded in and out, finally disappearing altogether.
What took its place was the anguished scream of the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign.
"You haven't asked any questions yet, why are you hitting him?"
...
When Lu Yang arrived at the Hundred Refinement Peak, he happened to see Li Haoran enjoying quality time halfway up the mountain with his ex-daughter, Qin Yanyan.
Qin Yanyan was still in the late stage of Foundation Establishment and didn't seem to have decided how to form her golden core yet.
Li Haoran enthusiastically greeted him, "Senior Brother Lu, you're back? A few days ago, Senior Brother Meng invited me to some Qingzhou festival, but I was busy and couldn't attend. Did you go to the Qingzhou festival?"
"Indeed I did, Junior Brother Li, you missed out on a lot. The Qingzhou festival was incredibly bustling, I even discovered a flying sword used by an immortal at a street stall, but it was damaged, destroyed by two semi-immortal level Great Powers."
Li Haoran and Qin Yanyan gasped in awe. From this simple description, they could easily imagine how gruesome the battle must have been.
"Then, Old Meng and I took part in the young generation competition. We both personally entered the arena, exposing their cultivation flaws, making them clearly understand the disparity between us. Particularly the first and second place winners, they were grateful beyond words, vowing to redouble their efforts and cultivate diligently when they returned."
"Emphasizing cultivation flaws, huh..." Li Haoran pictured himself sitting on the judging panel, pointing out others' cultivation shortcomings. It felt gratifying just thinking about it.
"Also, representatives from the Laurel Fairy Palace, Five Elements Sect, and Prison Suppressing Sect participated in the competition. Their performance on the judging panel was mediocre, hardly comparable to mine and Old Meng's."
"There were substantial rewards for their guidance, but we two of upright conduct didn't accept those rewards."
"Unfortunately, the festival was interrupted midway because ancient cultivators attacked, two at the unification stage, one at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. The Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator had vast divine powers. His appearance truly induced despair. We all thought we were going to die. Luckily, Eldest Senior Sister arrived in time to save us."
Li Haoran listened enviously. The immortal's flying sword, cultivating guidance, and Eldest Senior Sister's battle against the ancient Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator - each of these instances seemed so eventful.
Such a pity that he couldn't attend because he had to assist Qin Yanyan in forming her golden core.
"Senior Brother Lu, are you here on Hundred Refinement Peak for some business?"
"I'm here to see Fifth Elder, is he around?"
Lu Yang hadn't forgotten about his patent fee for the flying car.
Li Haoran pointed to the cloud enshrouded peak, "There he is, on the peak. Junior Sister Tao went to see the master just recently too. I wonder what's going on."
"I'll take my leave first then, goodbye."
Qin Yanyan, who had just been brought back to her senses from Lu Yang's tale of his thrilling adventure, turned to her ex-father and asked, "Does he encounter this many incidences every time he goes out? This time it was an ancient Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator, the last time it was the Nine Nether Cult?"
"Oh, much more than that, you have no idea. Senior Brother Lu attracts trouble wherever he goes. Before the Nine Nether Cult incident, he also had a run-in with the Eternity Sect. All this transpired just as he was trying to handle a Foundation Establishment Stage tiger demon."

chapters.title: Chapter 376 - 375: Tao Yaoye's New Script _1
chapters.content:
When Lu Yang arrived at the peak of Hundred Refinement Peak, half of the elders from the Seek Dao Sect were gathered there.
Second Elder, Fifth Elder, Eighth Elder, and the projected Sixth Elder.
Fifth Elder assessed the two demon-like figures, Second Elder and Eighth Elder: "You two can invent new things and want me to apply for a patent?"
In his impression, Second elder spent all day guarding the medical garden and had already entered retirement early. If he hadn't recently found a new lease on life, Fifth Elder would have thought he was becoming stale.
As for Old Eight, he had recently been hiding within the sect and not going out, probably because he provoked some trouble outside and was seeking refuge here.
"It's not the two of them. It was Tao Yaoye who came up with the idea. The Second and Eighth elders are responsible for implementing her ideas." The Sixth Elder explained.
Fifth Elder nodded, that seemed more reasonable.
"Martial Niece Tao, what did you invent?" Fifth Elder asked with a friendly attitude. He encouraged his disciples to think creatively, to dare break through mental barriers.
In this regard, he highly rated Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou. Li Haoran's creativity was slightly lacking, and needed more work.
"It's a composition formed by a combination of Array Method and talismans which can allow people to enter illusions... Senior Brother Lu, how did you come here?" Tao Yaoye was introducing when she noticed Lu Yang slowly walking over.
Seeing the lively scenario here, Lu Yang roughly guessed what they were doing and asked with a smile, "Junior Sister Tao, is the illusion creation complete?"
"Thanks to the aid of the Second Elder and the Eighth Elder, the preliminary work is done. I wanted to show Fifth Elder, would you like to give it a try?"
Lu Yang agreed readily, he also wanted to see how Tao Yaoye's film-making was progressing.
Tao Yaoye took out two talismans from her Identity Jade, one for Fifth Elder and one for Lu Yang.
She then unfurled a scroll with an Array Method drawn on it which Lu Yang didn't understand.
"This talisman is designed by Old Eight? And the Array Method drawn by Old Two?" Fifth Elder recognized the source of these items. Regardless of whether it was the talisman or the Array Method, they were both designed quite simply.
"Fifth Elder, senior brother, could you stand on the Array Method? Then rip the talisman from the middle. After tearing it, you'll feel a pull, that's the sign of entering the illusion." This was an illusion constructed for laymen and low-rank cultivators. Tao Yaoye was worried that if they exerted a little force to resist entering the illusion, the talisman would become void.
Lu Yang did as instructed, tore the talisman, and felt a slight tug on his consciousness. He didn't resist, and his consciousness was immediately pulled into another universe.
Boom——
Upon entering the other universe, Lu Yang saw endless lightning, as though this world had only one sound.
In the flashing thunder and lightning, an unmatched figure stood firm in the sky, unfazed by the lightning.
"This seems like the Transcendance Tribulation stage." Fairy Eternity whispered in Lu Yang's ear, startling him.
Lu Yang discreetly glanced at Fifth Elder, who had also entered the illusion with him, and asked in a low voice, "Fairy, why are you here? What if someone finds out?"
Fairy Eternity showed a triumphant smile, "This kind of simple illusion, I can freely enter and leave. As for what you mentioned about being discovered, no one in the world can match my ability to hide, no one can find me!"
Lu Yang felt relieved, and recalled what Fairy Eternity had just said, "Fairy, you said this was the Transcendance Tribulation?"
"Yes, this is the Thunder Tribulation faced when transcending to the Transcendance Tribulation stage. The Ninety-nine Heavenly Thunder Tribulations, designed by Yingtian Immortal. The person who designed this illusion must have witnessed this Thunder Tribulation."
In the face of the rolling thunder, Mitian True Monarch laughed heartily, opting to collide his favorite Swordsmanship head-on. One by one, thunderbolts were sliced by the sword, not a strand of hair was touched.
Gradually, the thunderbolts were endless, and Mitian True Monarch was becoming exhausted. At the last thunderbolt, the swordsmanship shattered and struck Mitian True Monarch's body.
The thunderbolt dissipated, and Mitian True Monarch fell from the sky.
Boom——
Mitian True Monarch crashed headlong into a mountain, creating a huge crater. Just before passing out, he muttered to himself:
"Damn it, I've been cultivating for over two thousand years, just one step away from the Transcendence Tribulation Stage. I lost my footing and my Swordsmanship shattered. My cultivation level has been sealed by heavenly lightning, and I can't mobilize even a fraction of it!"
After an unknown amount of time, a young woman from the nearby mountain village bravely approached the deep crater. Seeing a person, she courageously carried Mitian True Monarch back to her home.
When Mitian True Monarch awoke, he had lost all his memories, not knowing who he was or what cultivation was.
The woman who saved him was called Xiuxiu. Seeing that Mitian True Monarch had lost his memory, she named him Ah Lei.
The people of the mountain felt that Ah Lei was a suspicious person and wanted to drive him away. But Xiuxiu disagreed, stating that Ah Lei could stay there until his memory returned.
Ah Lei and Xiuxiu lived in the mountains, helping Xiuxiu to farm, fish, and hunt. In an attack by a demon beast, Ah Lei exhibited remarkable strength.
"Ah Lei, what is...this?" Xiuxiu was shocked. Ah Lei, who had always behaved like an ordinary person, had just killed a Foundation Establishment Stage wolf demon with one punch.
"I...I don't know what's going on either." Ah Lei was at a loss.
Half a year later, a Demon Cultivator placed a rare treasure in the mountains, ordering his subordinates to capture all the villagers for sacrifice, in order to enhance the quality of the rare treasure. Xiuxiu was among them.
Ah Lei was out, and Xiuxiu was taken away. When Ah Lei returned and found Xiuxiu missing, he frantically searched for her.
Ah Lei found the Demon Cultivator's den, killed several of his demon minions and tried to rescue Xiuxiu. But it was too late. Xiuxiu had been sacrificed, and the rare treasure had been refined, greatly increasing its quality.
The Demon Cultivator laughed madly. With this rare treasure, he feared no pursuit from the Righteous Path and could roam the world freely.
Ah Lei was furious. His anger reopened the seal of the heavenly lightning, reformed his shattered Swordsmanship. The lightning gathered, intending to strike Ah Lei dead. The brilliant Swordsmanship shot into the sky, dispersing the lightning.
He retrieved his original power and memory.
Ah Lei's anger surged like a tide. Endless Swordsmanship covered the hundreds of thousands of mountains. With every step he took, a layer of the seal was broken. Accompanied by endless spiritual energy, his aura burst out like a demon king descending from the heavens, bringing destruction to the world.
"You...seek...death!"
"It...it's you!" The Demon Cultivator was scared into a stupor, recognizing Ah Lei's identity.
Mitian True Monarch, the number one in Swordsmanship, the strongest below the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, is someone no one should mess with!
"No, no, no. With this rare treasure, I am no longer the same!" The Demon Cultivator activated the rare treasure. Fierce wind and earth shaking arose, intending to bury the Mitian True Monarch.
A beam of sword light fell, like divine punishment, splitting the rare treasure and the Demon Cultivator. Both were reduced to ash.
"Xiuxiu, I have avenged you..." Mitian True Monarch murmured, holding Xiuxiu's body and shedding a tear.
The illusion ended.
"How about it, how about it, how's the script this time?" Right after the illusion ended, Tao Yaoye excitedly asked Lu Yang for his opinions. She took Lu Yang's suggestion, designed it elaborately, and added a lot of plots.
The male protagonist's cultivation level was sealed, he lost his memory and lived with the ordinary girl. They fell in love. After the girl was killed, the protagonist's seal was released out of anger, and he killed the culprit behind it all with one strike. The thought of it was intense.
Lu Yang looked conflicted, not sure what to say: "The script is a good script, but why does the male lead always have the face of our master?"
Even though their master's face was elegant and handsome, Lu Yang had known the master for quite some time. Having the master's face on the male lead didn't resonate with him at all.
The Fifth Elder completely agreed.
At the end, which should have been a touching scene, he almost laughed out loud when he saw Old Nine holding Xiuxiu's corpse.

chapters.title: Chapter 377 - 376: The Fragile Immortal Sword_1
chapters.content:
Tao Yaoye felt helpless and shrugged, "There's no other way. When I was creating the illusion, I found a serious problem. The people who I fabricated out of thin air felt unrealistic in appearance."
"Later, my master told me that this is a common problem encountered when creating illusions. Whether it's people made out of thin air or stitching together several familiar people into one, it always feels false."
"So now, I can only use the images of those I am familiar with. I thought about it and asked my master, Second Elder, and Eighth Elder. Finally, we all agreed that the image of the Sect Leader was the most suitable."
"Senior Brother, you're familiar with the Sect Leader and, thus, feel no sense of immersion in seeing him as the main character, but outsiders don't share the same feeling because they don't know the Sect Leader."
Lu Yang: "..."
Alright, your points are valid.
Fifth Elder stated calmly, "Aside from Old Nine's image, the plot is still interesting."
Fifth Elder had never had such a thought before. After experiencing this illusion, he suddenly realized how thrilling it could be to disguise himself as a low-ranking cultivator and reveal his true cultivation level at critical moments.
Fifth Elder saw the immense business potential in Tao Yaoye's invention. It has absolute appeal to ordinary people and low-ranking cultivators, even for mid and high-ranking ones, its attraction is undeniable.
Moreover, it's easy to spread along this illusion technology. Moreover, it can be mass-produced.
Setting up the illusion isn't hard. Tao Yaoye managed to build a framework within half a month. However, if the outside world came to know about this, there would be a risk of piracy.
The challenge of this illusion lies in who thought of it first.
Patents need to be applied for as soon as possible.
"The array method and the talisman work together. Have you come up with a name yet?"
"Not yet. Could you, Senior Brother, help to come up with one?" Tao Yaoye asked Lu Yang for help. Senior Brother Lu always had unique insights.
"Me?" Lu Yang was just enjoying the fun, how did this become his responsibility?
"Let me think. Although the illusion is not real, and even though you immerse yourself upon viewing, you may feel melancholy after it ends. But it's ultimately just a reflection in the water. It's like a dream, nonexistent in reality... How about calling it 'Dream Mirage'?"
"Dream Mirage?" Tao Yaoye's eyes lit up, she silently repeated the name a few times, and the more she said it, the better she thought the name was.
"Alright, let's call it Dream Mirage!"
"Dream Mirage, good name." The Fifth Elder nodded his approval. He had always trusted Lu Yang's naming skills.
The name 'Multi-Treasure Heavenly King' was also given by Lu Yang.
"Martial Niece Tao, do you still have talismans? I need to take them back. How should we go about applying for a patent?"
"I have them, I have them." Tao Yaoye didn't expect the Fifth Elder to agree so readily. She gave all the remaining talismans to Fifth Elder and rolled up the scroll of the array method and handed it over.
After receiving the talismans and the scroll of the array method, the Fifth Elder suddenly remembered something and showed a meaningful smile, "Applying for a patent isn't hard, but have you ever thought about who the patent will belong to, Martial Niece Tao?"
"Who will own the patent?"
Seeing Elder Five's mischievous smile, Tao Yaoye finally realized that she came up with an idea and made the talismans for the illusion, as well as simplified the array method, but all of that was done by the Second and the Eighth Elder.
Technically speaking, they should also own part of the patent.
Are they going to take a large part of the patent, or are they planning to buy all the patents from her?
She heard that some sect elders are keen on seizing the disciples' opportunities, forcing the disciples to swallow their anger.
Uncle Ba jokingly gave Fifth Elder a push, "You've always been sly since you were a kid, you put nearly as much effort into tricking the treasury of the Nine Nether Sect as Old Eight did!"
Sixth Elder gave Fifth Elder a deep look, which scared him into a cold sweat, and he quickly denied it.
"Just making a joke with the little guy. It's better for her to learn from my scare about the hardships of the world rather than be cheated by outsiders, right?"
Uncle Ba said kindly, "Martial Niece Tao, neither Old Eight nor I lack these patents, and we don't have any need to spend spirit stones either. We were just helping you to kill time, the patents are all yours."
Eighth Elder nodded on the side. He never did anything to hurt his sect.
Tao Yaoye was deeply moved. She decided to repay the sect once Dream Mirage earned spirit stones.
After Tao Yaoye and the others left, Lu Yang stayed back, which puzzled the Fifth Elder.
"Martial Nephew Lu, do you have something else?"
"Nothing serious. I just wanted to ask, has my flying car patent made any money yet?"
This made the Fifth Elder even more puzzled, "It did make money. I gave all the spirit stones to Martial Nephew Yun, didn't you receive them?"
After confirming he didn't lose his memory, Lu Yang firmly shook his head.
"That's strange. Why don't you ask Martial Nephew Yun what happened?"
Lu Yang: "..."
He suddenly felt the patent fee wasn't that important.
No, no, no. He shouldn't think like that. These are the spirit stones he deserves. He must clarify this issue with Eldest Senior Sister!
"Fairy, can you handle this for me?"
Fairy Eternity was enjoying the fun, why did it end up having to do with her?
"Huh?"
"You've always been unafraid of Eldest Senior Sister, haven't you, Fairy?"
"Yes, just a mere Miss Yun, who would be afraid of her?" Fairy Eternity stubbornly replied, she couldn't show weakness in front of Lu Yang.
Lu Yang cheered for Fairy Eternity's courage.
"Since we share one body, your matters are mine, and mine are yours, right?"
"Yes."
"Then isn't it appropriate for you to ask Eldest Senior Sister, Fairy?"
"It seems you're right... Ok, don't worry, I'll handle this!" Fairy assured while patting her chest.
"There's one more thing." As Lu Yang said that, he took out an immortal sword from the identity jade that was refined by Yingtian Immortal and used by the Qilin Immortal.
"Can you see if this flying sword can be repaired?" One Green Peak Sword was not enough, and Lu Yang wanted to refine another.
Upon seeing the sword, Fifth Elder's eyes widened, and he stammered, "My God, this is an immortal sword, made by an immortal! Where did you find it?"
"I found it at a stall at the Qingzhou Fair."
Fifth Elder looked at Lu Yang enviously. This boy's luck was extraordinary.
Fifth Elder shook his head: "It would be extremely difficult, if not impossible. This sword was forged by an immortal, and it's indestructible. Even the Heavenly Tribulation can hardly cause it any damage. Just because you see that this sword is broken and that only half of it remains, it doesn't mean that it's fragile. If I'm not mistaken, this must have resulted from a great battle."
Lu Yang nodded. The Dragon and Phoenix geniuses discovered Qilin immortal's deceit and must have been furious, which likely led to a great battle.
Fifth Elder showed a longing look, "The level of such a battle is not something we can participate in. It is only such a high-level battle that can destroy an immortal sword."
You may not believe it when I say this, but do you think this sword is fragile and imagine that I can snap it just by doing this?"
As he said that, Fifth Elder casually attempted to snap the immortal sword.
Snap--
A faint snapping sound echoed as the immortal sword broke into two parts.
Fifth Elder: "..."
How many spirit stones should I pay for the immortal sword? Would selling me be enough to cover it?

chapters.title: Chapter 378 - 377: The Enlightened Monk_1
chapters.content:
The moment the Immortal Sword cracked, Fifth Elder had already planned for the rest of his life.
Zhou Xin, who has diligently cultivated for two thousand years, has finally reached the realm just a step away from Transcendance Tribulation Stage, became the master of Hundred Refinement Peak, holding countless patents in hand, and bringing enormous wealth to Seek Dao Sect every year.
Whether the money he had accumulated all his life was enough to buy an Immortal Sword is uncertain. Immortal Sword is extremely difficult to refine and it is the exclusive weapon of Immortal.
The Immortal Sword is different from the Immortal Treasures of Eternity Sect. The Immortal Treasures of Eternity Sect are, at best, half-finished Immortal artifacts. The Immortal Sword wielded by Lu Yang is a genuine Immortal Artifact, and their power is incomparable.
Legend has it that the moment an Immortal artifact is formed, due to its high quality, it is not tolerated by the world. All kinds of hardships exerted by the world fall on the Immortal Artifact. If unattended, the Immortal Artifact will inevitably collapse.
To protect the Immortal Artifact, the Immortal must confront the mighty forces of the world, and the difficulty is no different from becoming an Immortal, the perils are indescribable.
Having gone through various hardships to finalize, the value of an Immortal artifact is predictable, which is something that he, a mere Unification-stage practitioner, cannot afford.
Optimistically estimating, he should be able to afford an Immortal Artifact by working for a lifetime.
Watching Fifth Elder's agitated expression, Lu Yang coughed in embarrassment.
"Fifth Elder, this Immortal Sword is not as tough as you imagine. After my research, this Immortal Sword seems to be a weapon specially refined by a certain Immortal for overcoming difficulties. It looks like a true Immortal artifact, but it doesn't really have any power."
This Immortal Sword was forged by Yingtian Immortal, the one who governs Thunder Tribulation, specifically for the purpose of deceiving the geniuses of the Dragon and Phoenix clan, both of whom are Semi-Immortal powerhouses.
If it can deceive those two, it can naturally deceive Fifth Elder as well.
"Is that so?" Hearing Lu Yang's explanation, Fifth Elder breathed a sigh of relief.
Then, he began to worry about whether Lu Yang was covering up for himself and began to study carefully.
With Spiritual Sense scanning, forging in the flame, and gold-forging... After a series of tests, Fifth Elder finally understood the structure of the Immortal Sword.
"Which lunatic refined this sword, it nearly scared me to death!"
"First, the fire stone and Spirit Stone are blended to create a sword embryo. Then, using an unknown method, the sword embryo quickly shapes into a spirit sword.
Finally, the Immortal gold dust is brushed onto the spirit sword to make it look as if it had been struck by lightning, which even knowledgeable people like me would mistake for a real Immortal Sword, no, not just me; even if a Transcendence Tribulation Stage practitioner saw it, they would think the same."
"If you don't touch it with your hands and just use your eyes or Spiritual Sense to see, this sword is an Immortal Sword!"
Fifth Elder asked Lu Yang, "You just said this Immortal Sword was used by a certain Immortal to overcome difficulties. What difficulties? Is he short of money and resorts to fraud?"
Lu Yang was silent.
Although the Qilin Immortal cheated me, it's probably not a good idea to expose the Qilin Immortal's lie to his wife.
Lu Yang believed in making one-sided enemies.
And, Fifth Elder, do you know that the "lunatic" you have just insulted is an ancient Immortal who manipulates Heavenly Tribulation?
"You just mentioned you want to refine a sword? Sure, leave it to me!" Fifth Elder looked at the Immortal Sword in his hand, boiling with rage. He vowed to reforge this broken Immortal Sword into another form or he wouldn't be called 'Zhou'!
"This layer of Immortal gold dust is of no use, it's just for pretending to be an Immortal Sword. However, the Fire Stone and Spirit Stone are excellent materials and they are perfect for you."
"What do you mean?"
"You are in the Golden Core Stage now. Given your talent, it is not a problem to reach the Nascent Soul Stage. The Fire Stone and Spirit Stone can just be refined into a Nascent Soul grade Spirit Sword."
With the status of Fifth Elder in the refining world, refining a Nascent Soul grade Spirit Sword is using a sledgehammer to crack a nut. In the past, he always left this kind of thing to his disciples. He only agreed to it to vent his anger.
"So, do you want a Spirit Sword or a magic sword?"
A Spirit Sword is used directly for combat, while a magic sword is used as a medium for magic skills. Both of these belong to the category of sword cultivation. Currently, Lu Yang has only learned how to use the Spirit Sword.
"Spirit Sword."
"Alright."
Fifth Elder brought Lu Yang to his own refining room, and even before stepping into it, Lu Yang could feel the heat wave coming towards him. It was as if this wasn't a refining room, but a spurting volcano.
Fifth Elder offhandedly explained, "Normally at your level, you would not be able to enter here. However, you have mastery over a kind of True Fire which allows you to resist the scorching heat of the refining room."
"I have established a rule here: True Fires will not explode when colliding. Different types of True Fire can cooperate with each other to assist me in refining magic artifacts."
The room is spacious and semi-circular, with small bottles of different colors placed on the walls.
Fifth Elder randomly took a green small bottle from the wall, opened the stopper, and a ball of flame sprang out. The green small bottle turned jade white.
The original bottle was white, but it changed color under the burning of the flame.
"I have traveled around the world and collected eighty-eight of the one hundred and eight kinds of True Fire. The seeds of True Fire are stored in specially made small bottles. Whenever I refine artifacts, I bring them out."
"Later, various other True Fires were collected, which resulted in today's scale."
Lu Yang marveled. Fifth Elder truly deserved his well-established reputation in the world of refining. These collected True Fires alone are to be envied by many refiners.
Fifth Elder continued, "It's a pity that the remaining eight kinds of True Fire are either extremely difficult to collect - high rewards didn't attract any responses - or they are forbidden items that are not allowed to be collected."
"True Fire is considered a forbidden item?"
"For example, Lustful True Fire in True Fire. Just a little spark can make people lustful and unable to stop. If they don't vent it, they will kill themselves by suppression. The government finds this True Fire too dangerous and orders a collection ban."
"Of course, if I wanted to collect it, I could find it. Some secret brothels use this fire, but since this fire is not useful for refining, there is no need to collect it."
In hand, Fifth Elder held the blue flame, saying light-heartedly, "I don't know if you have heard of it, this is the Desireless True Fire which corresponds to Lustful True Fire. It comes from the Golden Buddha Kingdom. Kindling this fire in your heart can make you desireless, clear your soul, and concentrate on the pursuit of Dao."
"When I was young, Old Three and I traveled to the Golden Buddha Kingdom together, intending to find Lustful True Fire in the brothel. Unfortunately, our fate was not good, and we didn't find Lustful True Fire in the brothel. Instead, we met a monk who had attained enlightenment."
"An enlightened monk saw that Old Three and I were deeply devoted, he felt that it was fate, and therefore gave me the Desireless True Fire. That monk also demonstrated Arhat Fist to Old Three. Old Three gained an epiphany and, upon returning, created the Shocking Heaven Six Forms."
Lu Yang: "..."
As far as I remember, wasn't it that Old Three was beaten up by someone using the Arhat Fist in the Golden Buddha Kingdom, and after returning from anyone he refined and created Shocking Heaven Six Forms?
"Wait a minute. Why is the enlightened monk in the brothel?"
Fifth Elder wasn't surprised, he had asked a similar question at that time, and the monk had explained, "Ah, about that point, the monk has already explained."
"He said it's called 'Going Naked into the Brothel, Leaving Impressions in Buddha's Heart'."

chapters.title: Chapter 379 - 378 Dark Moon Sword_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang thought, proving his status as a monk enlightened in the Golden Buddha Kingdom, his words carried Zen wisdom.
Lu Yang became increasingly curious: "Elder, how did you meet this monk?"
"This monk is of a high generation, a master of the 'Ming' character tier. His heart reached the heavens, his Dharma name is Tomorrow, and those who know him call him Master Tomorrow."
"At the time, Master Tomorrow and I were both interested in the same woman. She could not serve two men, so Master Tomorrow and I started competing, mainly to see who had more Spirit Stones. In my youth, I applied for many patents, and I was never afraid of anyone when it came to Spirit Stones."
"When Master Tomorrow realized he couldn't compete with me in terms of Spirit Stones, he asked me to yield, saying that he appreciated my destiny and wanted to give me the True Fire of Detachment. I declined, but the master insisted and forced the True Fire of Detachment on me."
"At that moment, I felt that a beauty was nothing more than a skull with color, so why should I waste my time in a brothel? So, I left the brothel."
"Later, I thought about finding Master Tomorrow to discuss this matter, hoping for a chance to give him a good lesson."
"Unfortunately, Master Tomorrow was well versed in Buddhist teachings and left me speechless. Most importantly, Master Tomorrow's cultivation level was superb, he had reached the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, and Old Three and I couldn't beat him."
Lu Yang: "..."
Did Third Elder's Shocking Heaven Six Forms aim to shake not the heavens, but Master Tomorrow?
"By the way, did you have Buddhism at that time, Fairy?"
"Yes."
Lu Yang was very surprised. According to the Buddhist records, Buddhism has a long history, dating back to ancient times. However, after getting to know Fairy Eternity and learning about the existence of the Five Immortals of the Ancients, he felt that Buddhism was a fabricated history to elevate their value.
If Buddhism existed in ancient times, and there was a Buddha, why hadn't Fairy Eternity ever mentioned Buddha?
Lu Yang doubted if the Five Immortals of the Ancients could compare to Buddha.
"Were there really? Did Buddha exist? Was he an immortal?"
"As far as I remember, within Buddhism there were Buddha, numerous Buddhas floating across the sky, countless Arhats and Bodhisattvas, and a Thirty-three Heavens structure and such, right?"
"Yes, it's recorded in many classics."
Fairy Eternity revealed a cunning smile: "Do you think this setting method is similar to the Heavenly Court?"
"!!!" Lu Yang's face revealed a vastly shocked expression as he thought of a possibility.
Fairy Eternity was pleased with Lu Yang's expression and laughed: "Yes, Buddhism was something created by the five of us together."
That's why Fairy Eternity confidently claimed that her Arhat Fruit Fist was more orthodox than the Arhat Fist.
She was one of the founders of Buddhism, with an extraordinary status and supreme authority. Whoever she deemed orthodox, was orthodox.
Lu Yang took a deep breath. The deception level of the Five Immortals of the Ancients was even more terrifying than he had imagined.
The several Heavenly Court settings you five created did not survive, but the Buddhism setting you created has spread to this day and was even further developed by later generations.
Fifth Elder didn't know that Lu Yang was conversing with Fairy Eternity. Seeing the change in Lu Yang's expression, he found it very strange.
But in the Seek Dao Sect, it wasn't that odd.
In his youth, Old Nine fantasized about having a beast from an ancient time sealed within him and that the beast's breath would destroy all if it leaked out. Hence, Old Nine claimed to have sealed away his feelings and always maintained an indifferent expression.
Sometimes, he would clutch his wrist in pain, saying he could not suppress the beast inside and asking everyone to run.
Now, if anyone mentions this to Old Nine, he becomes agitated and brandishes his sword at people.
Compared to Old Nine who sometimes kneels on the ground and sobs, Lu Yang's facial expression changes are rather normal.
"Perhaps this is the inheritance of the mentor and pupil, the destiny of the Sword Spirit Root." Fifth Elder whispered.
"Ah, Fifth Elder, what did you say about the destiny of the Sword Spirit Root?" Lu Yang snapped back to reality. When he heard Fifth Elder mention the destiny of the Sword Spirit Root, his heart tightened.
Could it be that the Sword Spirit Root has a hidden destiny? For example, every generation of Sword Spirit Root has enemies, but each Sword Spirit Root has failed and lived in regret?
Is the master's indulgence in the game of mortal world an expression of regret and a means to vent?
The more Lu Yang thought about it, the more likely it seemed.
"True Fire of Detachment is the true fire I most frequently use for refining. Artifacts refined with the True Fire of Detachment can keep the owners as calm as possible in battles."
Fifth Elder strongly believed that staying calm was the key to victory.
Fifth Elder raised his hand again, took the true fire from another small bottle: "This is the Six-Ding Divine Fire, the ancestral true fire passed down from generation to generation in Hundred Refinement Peak. It can devour impurities and is most suitable for refining.
Fire Stone and Spirit Stone from the mountaintop in the Immortal Sword need to be purified and separated by the Six-Ding Divine Fire."
He placed the Six-Ding Divine Fire in the center of the refining room, activated the Array Method engraved on the ground and the walls, the temperature in the room rose sharply. Lu Yang had to use the Three Flavored True Fire to protect himself to feel more comfortable.
Fifth Elder ignored the high temperature, his eyes fixed on the Immortal Sword. The flames licked the Immortal Sword, melting and devouring the outermost layer of fairy gold powder.
The Immortal Sword revealed its original appearance, grey and black. It was not at all remarkable, and one would not know it was an Immortal Sword made of two precious and unique rocks.
Under the burning of the Six-Ding Divine Fire, the Immortal Sword melted and split into two clusters of metallic liquid, one red and one black. Both were full of spirituality. Fifth Elder lifted his hammer, striking the metallic liquid forcefully.
With the impact, the metallic liquid burst open in the flames, but it could never escape the enclosure of the Six-Ding Divine Fire.
Fifth Elder raised his left hand, and the floating True Fire of Detachment rushed into the Six-Ding Divine Fire. The two true fires fused, possessing the characteristics of both.
Lu Yang didn't understand the significance of this move. However, if a knowledgeable refiner saw it, it would be enough to overturn his concept of refining.
The two metallic liquids of Fire Stone and Peak Spirit Stone gradually merged into one, forming a shape — a sword embryo.
Fifth Elder took the sword embryo out of the true fire and swiped along both sides of the embryo with two fingers. A magnificent pattern began to emerge clearly. This was the sword pattern, which could reduce the wear and tear on the Spirit Sword and increase its usage period.
Each magic artifact has a specific pattern, but most refiners do not master the engraving method of these patterns. Those who can create one with just a swipe like Fifth Elder are few and far between.
ssssh—
The glowing red sword embryo was gently quenched in water several times until its temperature dropped and its original color, silver-white, was revealed.
Only after attaching the hilt, pommel and other decorations did Fifth Elder declare success.
"Here, give it a try." Fifth Elder tossed the Spirit Sword to Lu Yang.
Lu Yang swung the sword and found it to be very light, as if it was an extension of his arm. Swinging it was instinctive, refreshing and pleasant.
"Break!"
"Chop!"
"Slice!"
Lu Yang performed each sword technique smoothly, without the slightest awkwardness, as if he had been using this sword for a long time.
Once he completed the set of sword techniques, Lu Yang stood with his sword behind his back, his smile unperturbed: "Good sword!"
"Go ahead, name it." Said Fifth Elder with a big grin.
Examining the pattern of his new Spirit Sword, Lu Yang laughed: "The sword is a weapon for killing. The sword body is silver-white, like the silver moon hanging in the sky. Let's call it Dark Moon Sword."
Fifth Elder nodded: "Green Peak Sword, Dark Moon Sword. Green Peak and Dark Moon do match."

chapters.title: Chapter 380 - 379: Mid-Stage Golden Core_1
chapters.content:
"The Dark Moon Sword is potent, good enough for your use in the Golden Core stage. But if you reach the Nascent Soul stage, this sword would not match your strength." The Fifth Elder said with a laugh. The Dark Moon Sword may be a Nascent Soul stage magical artifact, this does not mean it is meant for Lu Yang's use at the Nascent Soul stage.
Lu Yang nodded, indicating he understood. Magic artifacts also have ranking distinctions. If they do not match the cultivation realm, they can become burdens. That's why cultivators prefer growing-type magic artifacts. However, these artifacts are hard to find and costly, and require high-level refining skills, often being sought after but not obtainable.
"What rank is the Green Peak Sword?" Lu Yang thought of the Green Peak Sword he often used, a gift from Eldest Senior Sister in celebration of his successful establishment of the foundation.
"The sword that Martial Nephew Yun gave you is of an undetermined rank." The Fifth Elder shook his head slowly. He had long noticed that Lu Yang's Green Peak Sword was not ordinary.
"Is it a growing-type magic artifact?"
Lu Yang had been using it from the initial stage of Foundation Establishment to the early Golden Core stage, everything had gone smoothly, without experiencing any misalignment between the magical artifact and his cultivation realm. In Lu Yang's mind, growing-type magic artifacts met this criterion.
Moreover, this was a magic artifact given by Eldest Senior Sister. Could anything she passed on be an ordinary sword?
The Fifth Elder corrected Lu Yang's misconception: "No, growing-type magic artifacts are not like that. For a Foundation Establishment level artifact to grow into a Golden Core level artifact, it needs to be upgraded with various Spiritual Iron Divine Mines."
"Let's put it this way, a growing-type magic artifact is like a framework. To improve its quality, you need to constantly fill the framework with materials like Spiritual Iron Divine Mines. Have you ever filled your Green Peak Sword with anything?"
"Also, a growing-type magic artifact upgrades by large cultivation realms. The feel of using a magic artifact in the early Foundation Establishment stage is different from using it in the late stage. Have you ever experienced this?"
As Lu Yang pondered, he realized that this was indeed the case.
"Then, what exactly is my Green Peak Sword...?"
"It's sealed by Martial Nephew Yun. The number of layers of the seal are so many that they are uncountable, which is why I can't determine the rank of the Green Peak Sword."
"For every bit of strength you gain, a layer of the seal will disappear. So no matter what realm you reach, you'll always find the Green Peak Sword easy to handle."
"Martial Nephew Yun put a lot of thought into this for you. This Green Peak Sword, and the seals on it, are priceless treasures."
Lu Yang never expected that Eldest Senior Sister had put so much thought into the Green Peak Sword, he was deeply moved.
"All right, I have to apply for a patent for Peach Martial Niece. I won't chat anymore."
Lu Yang quickly thanked him: "Thank you, Elder, for refining the Dark Moon Sword. You can get back to your work, Elder."
The Fifth Elder waved his hand, took out his shuttle, and disappeared in a flash.
"Fairy Eternity, can you figure out the quality of the Green Peak Sword?" Lu Yang realized that besides relying on the sect's elders, he also had the golden finger Fairy Eternity to help.
Fairy Eternity looked at the Green Peak Sword from different angles and shook her head bluntly: "It's sealed too tightly, can't make it out."
After a moment, Lu Yang understood what Fairy Eternity meant—the multiple layers of seals obstructed discerning its quality.
Lu Yang returned to Sky Gate Mountain, not seeing Eldest Senior Sister's figure. He estimated that she must still be tormenting the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign, not letting him off either because of his tenacity and resistance, or because he simply knew too much and couldn't finish recounting it so quickly.
"It's such a pity. This immortal wanted to ask on your behalf about the patent fees." Fairy Eternity secretly let out a sigh of relief, feeling as if a weight had been lifted off her shoulders.
Lu Yang looked at Fairy Eternity from the corner of his eyes, thinking, 'You are just a step away from writing 'fear' across your face.'
"I will go cultivate." Lu Yang remembered that he was still a cultivator. The duty of a cultivator is to cultivate.
