He was not just a genius, but a hard-working genius!
Fairy Eternity glanced at Lu Yang: "Since forming your golden core, have you seriously cultivated?"
Lu Yang said confidently, countering with an example: "Don't put it that way. Is it that I don't want to cultivate? It's just that I've had too many things to do!"
"Upon returning from the dense forest, I was taken by Eldest Senior Sister to visit the Immortal Heritage site, and also visit Master casually. Then Junior Brother Li was troubled by Qin Haoran's memories, so Old Meng and I took him out to relax. Accidentally, we ran into members of the Nine Nether Sect, and fabricated a relationship between Heaven's Court and the Nine Nether Sect."
"Later, along with the Fifth Elder, we went to the Nine Nether Sect again to make them believe in the existence of Heaven's Court."
"To continue writing the 'Mind Seeing Method', I lived in the Scripture Pavilion for half a month and successfully wrote the Golden Core section."
"Finally, Old Meng and I went to the Qingzhou event and encountered ancient cultivators."
"Only two months have passed since I formed the invincible elixir."
Fairy Eternity: "..."
It seems that's the way it is.
Lu Yang's experiences were so rich that it gave her the illusion of a long time having passed?
Choosing to live in Lu Yang's spiritual space was a good decision. Where else could she encounter so many interesting things?
"Besides, despite having so many things to do, didn't I still find time to cultivate? Have I delayed my cultivation progress?" Lu Yang argued convincingly. It was indeed the truth. He would open his mouth to absorb spiritual energy whenever he had time, and could practice anytime, anywhere. It was very convenient.
Lu Yang sat on a large stone block full of sword marks, closed his eyes to comprehend, and could sense the infinite sword intent contained within.
Listening to Eldest Senior Sister, this stone block was his master's favorite to practice swordsmanship in his youth. Over time, the stone block inevitably absorbed sword intent, which is a rare treasure for sword cultivators and extremely precious.
Sitting on the large stone block he could cultivate, and at the same time comprehend the sword intent, improving his comprehension of swordsmanship. It was a win-win situation.
Lu Yang sat with his "Five Centers Toward Heaven", eyes closed and mouth wide open, throwing his head back to face the sky. Anyone who didn't know better would think he had fallen asleep.
Spiritual energy flowed into his body, expanding his meridians. His Cultivation Level was being uplifted bit by bit. Each bit of advancement brought inexplicable pleasure. No wonder many people were willing to cultivate, spending tens of years in closed-door training — some even centuries — emerging to find the world vastly changed.
Lu Yang, however, wouldn't close up for such a long time. The Seek Dao Sect also didn't advocate for this type of closed-door cultivation. Even the cultivation-loving Eldest Senior Sister only requested to close up for three days under the master's request.
"You know that you can only gain experience, not intelligence, from closed-door training, right?" Fairy Eternity greatly agreed with the philosophy of the Seek Dao Sect, increasingly feeling that her decision to become an honorary elder of the Seek Dao Sect was absolutely correct.
"In the past, this immortal fought all the way through countless famed individuals who fell under this immortal's hand. I grew rapidly through successive battles and victories!"
"You should learn from this immortal, level up through battles, and face the vast world and its numerous living beings. This type of cultivation not only improves your realm but also makes you as clever as this immortal!"
Upon hearing this, Lu Yang felt that he could cultivate more in seclusion.
In the blink of an eye, half a month had passed. Lu Yang, who had been sitting cross-legged on the large stone, slowly opened his eyes, exhaled a breath of fresh air, his eyes glinting like cold steel. His aura explosively expanded and then contracted rapidly, displaying absolute control.
He hooked up the corners of his mouth in a slight smile.
"I'm in the mid-stage of the Golden Core now."

chapters.title: Chapter 381 - 380 Advanced Body Refinement Concepts_1
chapters.content:
The moment Lu Yang successfully advanced to the mid-stage of Golden Core, a multi-colored rainbow appeared above his head. The spiritual energy wandering in the air was like a fish, playfully swimming around as they puffed out bubbles. Unmoved by the wind, the wild grass and tree leaves swayed, making a rustling sound.
Dew formed by the concentrated spiritual energy gathered on the leaves, rolling down to the ground and raising a mist.
A celestial phenomenon occurred, celebrating Lu Yang's successful advancement to the mid-stage of Golden Core.
"Congratulations, congratulations! You've reached the mid-stage Golden Core!" Fairy Eternity clapped her hands eagerly.
With slight helplessness, Lu Yang chimed in, "Fairy, I have advanced to mid-stage Golden Core, not become an immortal. We don't need these celestial phenomena. Please, put them away."
"Oh." Fairy Eternity cancelled the magic that she held in her hand.
The celestial phenomenon disappeared.
Lu Yang didnt expect himself to advance to mid-stage Golden Core so quickly, without any feeling of hitting a bottleneck. It probably had something to do with the food he ate made by Fairy Eternity.
The trials of immortality always proved to be beneficial in some form.
Lu Yang then felt a warmth in his chest. It was a wooden tag with the words "Nine Nether" on it.
The tag slowly revealed a message: "We're out of fire seeds and barbecue grills. Meet me at the main shop."
This was the magic artifact that Vice Headmaster Shi used to communicate with Lu Yang. Each party could only utter one sentence before a long cooling-off period began.
Lu Yang replied with a single word.
"Oh."
Solving the grill issue was easy, Fifth Elder had long ago refined a large batch of automatic grills, they could be used as one wished.
The fire seeds required Meng Jingzhou's cooperation.
"Let's go see what Old Meng is up to."
...
Just as Lu Yang approached Body Refinement Peak, he could feel the astonishing Yang Qi. Even the wandering spirits had to keep a safe distance lest their spirits should get burned.
Lu Yang could hear Third Elder's vigorous voice even standing at the foot of the mountain.
"So called body refinement, is about refining every part of the body, and not allowing any flaw!"
"Remember, our biggest reliance as body cultivators is our strong bodies. If there's a problem with the body, then what advantage do you have to speak of!"
"Recently I noticed some disciples have become lazy in their cultivation, avoiding hair training, and shaving their heads bald. This is self-deception!"
"And some disciples, just focusing on hair cultivation, have neglected training their shadows. Leaving such a huge weakness, what's that for!"
"We body cultivators are not afraid of any challenges or difficulties, but we must also not slack off ourselves!"
Third Elder has rich battle experience, he knew very well that the best defense against an unexpected attack was to strengthen oneself.
Lu Yang: "…"
Does body cultivation also include shadow training?
Are body cultivators in the outside world trained this way?
Lu Yang had heard of some magic skills that could attack through shadows, and if shadows could be trained, that would indeed be a good thing.
But the question was, how does one train their shadows?
"What an innovative body cultivation concept!" Fairy Eternity was quite amazed. Even in the era of active thinking in ancient times, no one promoted such a concept.
"Alright, go practice!" Third Elder waved his hand, dispersing the disciples.
"Senior Brother Zhao Zhao, Master was referring to you, right? Your bald head. You look like a monk!" Meng Jingzhou joked with a smile. Zhao Zhao's head was shiny and bright, looking no different from getting hit by Lu Yang's Arhat Fist.
Zhao Zhao's just rolled his eyes: "It's not that I find hair cultivation troublesome and shaved it off. I did it for deep considerations."
"What considerations?"
"Junior Brother Meng, think about it. If the opponent grabs your hair during a fight, wouldn't that restrict your movement? Hair is a weak point! What's wrong with shaving my hair off to overcome it?"
Lu Yang made a mental note of this, "After I finish with the Arhat Fist, I'll just tell the 'victim' as such. They should understand my good intentions."
Meng Jingzhou shook his head, brainstorming a more effective method: "Wouldn't it be better if you, Senior Brother Zhao, kept your hair short? This way, opponents wouldn't be able to grab it. Plus, your hair would be like a porcupine, functioning as a weapon!"
Brother Zhao's eyes lit up, convinced that Meng Jingzhou made a lot of sense. He patted Meng Jingzhou on the shoulder enthusiastically, causing Meng Jingzhou to wince in pain.
"Good idea, Junior Brother. I'll cut my hair short right away. I'll rummage through the Scripture Pavilion and see if there are any magic skills that could help with hair growth," Zhao declared before running off with an urgency.
"Old Meng, over here!" Lu Yang waved him over.
Meng Jingzhou strode over, "What's up? Are you trying to steal techniques from our Body Refinement Peak again?"
"Hell no, it's just the people from Nine Nether contacting me."
Lu Yang took out the wooden tile, and Meng Jingzhou realized instantly, Nine Nether had opened too many barbecue shops and they were running short of fire seeds and grills.
"Can I borrow some fire?"
"Sure."
Lu Yang took out a bunch of tiny bottles from his Identity Jade. These were special jade bottles from the Hundred Refinement Peak that could store fire seeds.
One spat out the Three Flavored True Fire and the other the Pure Yang True Fire. The two elemental fires combined together to birth the fire seeds, which were then stored in the bottle and sealed. The major task was completed.
The two made two hundred fire seeds in one go, their mouths almost smoking from exhaustion. They had to drink some water to regain their strength.
"These should be enough for Nine Nether for a while."
They made light of the situation while packing up the jade bottles. They then made a trip to the Hundred Refinement Peak to fetch the ready-made automatic grilling stand. Lu Yang wanted to tell Fifth Elder about it, but he was still away getting a patent.
Submitting for a patent was an easy task, but approval was time-consuming. Knowing the value of the Mirage of Dreams, the Fifth Elder remained in the Imperial City waiting for the patent to be cleared before leaving.
The two then set off for Yanjiang County. Their objective was twofold: to deliver the goods to Nine Nether and to collect the profits accrued from running the barbecue shop over time.
After all, their Heaven's Court wasn't running a charity.
"Should we inform Eldest Senior Sister before we head off to Yanjiang County?"
Lu sighed, "I would like to, but Eldest Senior Sister hasn't been out since she went to Captive Peak. She might be considering using a soul searching technique due to the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign's stubborn refusal to divulge anything."
Meng Jingzhou nodded in agreement.
Having reached the Transcendance Tribulation Stage required overcoming countless obstacles to stand on top. It wouldn't be easy to get any information out of them.
Punishment by Eldest Senior Sister might not work either.
…
Captive Peak.
"I was wrong... When I was at the Golden Core Stage, I shouldn't have had designs on Master's wife. But I couldn't help it... She's really beautiful, and I couldn't control myself..."
Like spilling beans, the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign confessed all his wrongdoings in his life.
Half a month had passed.
He confessed everything starting from his childhood when he used to peek at a widow bathing in the village, to selling low-quality elixirs during his Qi Refinement Stage and earning his first Spirit Stone, to killing fellow adventurers in the Secret Realm for treasure during his Foundation Establishment Stage, to lusting after the Master's wife after joining the sect during his Golden Core Stage, and then during his Nascent Soul Stage...
Not a single detail was missed in his confession; no need for Yun Zhi to inquire, he confessed all on his own.
Yun Zhi sat across from him, her legs crossed and face expressionless. She was contemplating whether or not to just use a soul searching technique on Heavenly Calamity Sovereign to save time and energy.
A complete soul from the Transcendance Tribulation Stage could make an extremely high-quality, sentient magic artifact. It would be perfect for Grandmaster's use.
It would be a real waste to destroy so much.
Truly a dilemma.
The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign sneaked a peek at the expressionless Yun Zhi, remembering the torturous techniques she had used at the very beginning. If he still had a physical body, he would have been sweating profusely.
He continued to confess, not daring to hide anything.
"After the Master's wife seduced me into bed..."

chapters.title: Chapter 382 - 381: A Newcomer Joins Heaven's Court_1
chapters.content:
"Do you want to come with me to Yanjiang County?" Lu Yang asked Meng Jingzhou.
Meng Jingzhou was clearly tempted, but he shook his head and refused: "I need to train my shadow, so I won't go out yet."
Meng Jingzhou felt that if Third Elder frisked his coursework and found that he had ignored his cultivation, he would most likely be in trouble.
The road to cultivation was fraught with danger, as this showed.
"Alright then." Lu Yang pursed his lips, feeling a bit bored being by himself.
"Hey, Junior Sister Tao, over here." At the foot of the mountain, Lu Yang saw Tao Yaoye not far away. Judging by her aimless pace, it appeared she had nothing to do.
"Senior Brother Lu, what's up?" Tao Yaoye's lips curled in a faint smile, very easy on the eyes. Her manner exuded beauty, promising that she would become an exceptionally graceful beauty in the future.
"Would you like to join our Heaven's Court?" Lu Yang invited eagerly. As the young master, he needed to recruit more geniuses for the sect.
"You probably have not heard of Heaven's Court. It's currently the top sect in the world..."
"Sure."
"Huh?"
Lu Yang paused, taken aback by Tao Yaoye's quick agreement.
"Have you heard of Heaven's Court?" Lu Yang wondered if Sixth Elder had told Tao Yaoye about it.
"Nope."
"Then why did you agree so quickly?"
Tao Yaoye flashed a sly smile, blinking her eyes: "Would Senior Brother Lu deceive me?"
"Of course not!"
"Well, isn't that settled then? Since joining Heaven's Court is for my benefit, why would I refuse?"
Lu Yang was rendered speechless. He hadn't considered it from this angle.
"So, what exactly is this Heaven's Court?" Tao Yaoye asked curiously.
"It's currently the top sect in the world. Our eight Elders and master are Heavenly Kings of the sect, Eldest Senior Sister is the Master, and I am the young master. We worship the omnipotent Bean Deity!"
Tao Yaoye chose to ignore the unheard-of Bean Deity, understanding why their master had been fretting about his title of Heavenly King recently.
"Aside from us, there's Meng Jingzhou, Li Haoran, and Li Haoran's ex-daughter Qin Yanyan."
Tao Yaoye looked puzzled, thinking the members of Heaven's Court were rather complicated.
Why form Heaven's Court? Was Lu Yang not satisfied with defeating the demonic sect and wished to replace it?
"Well, it started when Meng Jingzhou, Li Haoran, and I set out to catch ghosts..."
Lu Yang narrated the entire story, which left Tao Yaoye astounded.
True to his reputation, Lu Yang was quick-witted enough to devise a way to deceive the Nine Nether sect by creating a fake religion. This was far more proactive than infiltrating the Nine Nether sect as a spy.
"Our Heaven's Court claims to be an ancient court, so we need to have a few geniuses to show for ourselves. Tao, you make a perfect candidate as an ancient genius."
Tao Yaoye felt somewhat pleased, feeling acknowledged by Lu Yang.
"I'm about to meet the higher-ups from the Nine Nether sect. Will you come along?"
"Sure."
...
Yanjiang County, Once More BBQ main branch.
The BBQ business was booming, expanding rapidly. The branches of Once More BBQ had spread to counties surrounding Yanjiang County.
If there were enough grills and fire pits, the BBQ shops would have sprouted everywhere, forming a chain industry.
The Nine Nether sect put a great deal of effort into setting up BBQ shops with the sect leader backing it vigorously. He even proposed to put a hold on their killings for a while; the current objective of the Nine Nether sect was to focus on opening BBQ shops.
This was much safer than using their sect members' identity to borrow money.
The Master was so joyous that he would even laugh during his meditation sessions.
Vice Headmaster Shi was unaware of the sect's near-thousand years of deficit and didn't know why the Master had put their doctrines on hold, insisting that they focus on running the BBQ shop.
It might be that the Master was money-minded or perhaps there was some other reason.
He didn't concern himself with the Master's motives. Running the BBQ shop was his way to deal with the billion-dollar loan.
Even though he was at the Spirit Transformation stage, he wouldn't be able to withstand heavenly tribulation every month. If he failed to withstand it even once, he would be doomed.
He was determined to make the BBQ shop scale up and prosper.
There were two key points to running a shop—having a secret formula and creating a good business environment.
The first point is self-evident; their BBQ shops' success was built on their secret recipe.
There were many ways to achieve the second point, such as building a good relationship with the government office.
However, bribes were risky and untrustworthy. What if the officer who was bribed got caught? Wouldn't their BBQ shop be doomed as well?
Vice Headmaster Shi altered his thinking. What the government needed were stability and order.
Their BBQ shop could help officials in catching criminals and punishing offenders.
Who could be more professional than the demonic sect when it came to crime?
Dealing with current crimes, which were a mere remnant of their past exploits, would be a piece of cake.
Of course, such things shouldn't be done openly. It was better to operate covertly, leading the government to suspect it was their own doing, without any evidence.
This was the best scenario.
In this way, the government office would suspect that the BBQ shop was a covert industry of a righteous power.
Furthermore, the BBQ shop often punished the wicked and maintained stability.
Influenced by two such factors, the government was bound to be inclined to protect the BBQ shop.
The actual outcome validated Vice Headmaster Shi's ideas. The order in Yanjiang County was unprecedentedly stable, the prisons were much emptier, and the government neither carried out periodic inspections nor implied anything.
When it was quiet at night and the main branch had closed for the day, the sect members tidied up the lobby and the backyard. Vice Headmaster Shi was bent over his desk, writing feverishly. He was documenting the lessons learned from running the shop in the past month.
"Master, the people from Heaven's Court have arrived," Huo Huashen reported respectfully. As the manager of the main branch, he was responsible for executing Vice Headmaster Shi's policies.
Three days had passed since the notice was issued, and during that time, Vice Headmaster Shi had been waiting at the main branch.
"Headmaster Shi, it's been a while!" Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye entered. "Your sect seems to be doing quite well; you need new grills and fire pits so soon."
"Oh, not at all. It's just luck." Meeting Lu Yang, Vice Headmaster Shi was anything but arrogant. The man was the young master of Heaven's Court and the personal disciple of the Bean Deity. He couldn't afford to be negligent.
"And who might this be..." Vice Headmaster Shi looked at Tao Yaoye questioningly.
"She is also a member of our Heaven's Court, Tao Yaoye. Her exceptional talent leaves even the Master and the Sect Leader full of praises."
Vice Headmaster Shi looked at her with reverence: "So, you're the genius Tao."
Tao Yaoye kept her composure, but she was inwardly surprised.
She knew that Lu Yang was scheduled to meet the Nine Nether sect, but she hadn't expected that they would be meeting the higher-ups so soon, and that they would be interacting on equal footing.
Was this Lu Yang's usual circle of connections?
Inside the sect, he was interacting with the Elders, while outside, he was dealing with sect leaders, all at the Spirit Transformation stage!
Lu Yang and Vice Headmaster Shi were chatting amicably, seemingly unfazed by each other's daunting statuses.

chapters.title: Chapter 383 - 382: Deep Cooperation_1
chapters.content:
After exchanging pleasantries, Lu Yang handed a storage ring to Vice Headmaster Shi.
"Inside are two hundred seed of fire and two hundred barbecue grills, enough for a while."
Vice Headmaster Shi sent out a strand of spiritual sense and roughly scanned the contents of the storage ring. His heart was delighted. With these items, the number of branches was no longer a problem.
Vice Headmaster Shi pushed a ledger and a storage ring towards Lu Yang.
"This details the operation of the past month, and the part of the profit for your sect."
After counting the spirit stones inside the storage ring, Lu Yang found that it amounted to about one hundred and twenty thousand spirit stones.
This was the net worth of an average cultivator at the Golden Core stage.
Putting on an indifferent appearance, Lu Yang casually handed the storage ring to Tao Yaoye, "Put it in the treasury when you get back."
Tao Yaoye quietly accepted the storage ring without a word, her inner peace disrupted.
One hundred and twenty thousand spirit stones, even more than what a Golden Core stage cultivator would accumulate in a lifetime. She had never seen so many spirit stones before.
Lu Yang sent a message to Tao Yaoye using his spiritual sense, not afraid that Shi Huagu would overhear with Fairy Eternity present.
"Junior Sister Tao, keep calm. Once your patent for Dream Mirage is granted, you'll earn much more than this."
"And don't be intimidated because the other party is at the Unification Stage and is a vice headmaster of the demonic sect. He might even come begging you in the future, after all, your Dream Mirage is the best for advertising."
"Why?"
Tao Yaoye was puzzled. Lu Yang just smiled and chose not to explain further.
Seeing Lu Yang's indifferent attitude, Vice Headmaster Shi thought that perhaps Lu was dissatisfied with the amount of money, which might cause a rift in the relationship between Nine Nether Sect and Heaven's Court. He explained, "The business just started and initial investment was large, so it's hard to make a profit in the early days. Please forgive me, Talent Lu.
I believe that after a couple of years of setting up barbecue shops across the continent, there will be tens of millions of spirit stones flowing into the treasuries of our sects every day!"
Vice Headmaster Shi was not merely wooing Lu Yang with empty promises, this was a calculated result.
Lu Yang waved his hand, "Master Shi misunderstood, I'm not complaining about the small amount of spirit stones. My sect's treasury stores countless ancient treasures, heavenly weapons, immortal fruits and the likes. If we wanted spirit stones, selling a little of those would be a boundless wealth."
"I just want to remind Master Shi that our shared establishment of barbecue shops embodies the friendship between our two sects. We should not be rigidly influenced by spirit stones. How could the bond between our two sects be weighed by spirit stones?"
If it were simply a transaction of spirit stones and running a barbecue shop together, such collaboration would definitely be superficial. What Lu Yang wanted was a deeper collaboration with the Nine Nether Sect.
Vice Headmaster Shi felt greatly ashamed, thinking that despite being at the Unification Stage, his vision was too narrow.
Worthy of being the geniuses of the Ancient Heavenly Court, his vision was not comparable.
Just as Lu Yang felt that he had sufficiently exposed Tao Yaoye to the world and was about to leave, Vice Headmaster Shi hurriedly stopped him.
"Young Master Lu, Talent Tao, please wait."
Tao Yaoye's heartbeat slowed, thinking she was discovered.
"What's the matter?" Lu Yang wondered, what else could there be after delivering the goods and receiving the spirit stones?
At the same time, he sent a message to Tao Yaoye, signaling her not to be nervous.
"I wonder what Young Master Lu's opinion is on ancient cultivators?"
Vice Headmaster Shi suddenly had a thought. He realized that what Lu Yang wanted was not just spirit stones, but deeper cooperation.
Since that's the case, deep cooperation it shall be!
"Ancient cultivators?" Lu Yang chuckled, the pride of being Talent of the Ancients reflected in his eyes along with disdain for ancient cultivators, "Before us of the Heaven's Court, would anyone dare to call themselves an ancient cultivator?"
Only then did Vice Headmaster Shi realize. That's right, whether they were cultivators from Great Yu or Great Qian, they were all juniors in front of Lu Yang.
In terms of antiquity, who could compare with Heaven's Court?
In terms of foundation, who could match the Heavenly Court that governed countless stars in the sky?
Even though the Central Continent is vast, how could it ever compare with endless stars?
In terms of the strength of their era, the ancient times had the widely known Four Immortals of the Ancients, the hidden Immortal Eternities of their time, and Dou Tianzun. In total, six immortals. Whether Great Yu and Great Qian have immortals or not is another matter!
The so-called ancient cultivators just can't compare with Heaven's Court!
What nonsense!
Having heard Lu Yang say so, Vice Headmaster Shi had reassurance in his heart. He indignantly said, "I wonder if Young Master Lu has heard of the Qingzhou banquet half a month ago, where ancient cultivators emerged out of nowhere, disrupting the order of the banquet and causing it to end hurriedly."
Lu Yang nodded, "I heard some things."
"To be honest, I opened a branch store on a whim at the Qingzhou banquet. I hoped to see how well the people of Qingzhou would accept a barbecue shop. But before I could grasp the situation, it was disrupted by the cultivators of the Great Yu dynasty!"
Vice Headmaster Shi was furious when he spoke of this incident. He had just been trying to run a good business without interfering with the affairs of the ancient cultivators, yet those ancient cultivators insisted on causing trouble for no reason.
Do you know how important Qingzhou is? Of the seventeen provinces of the Great Xia dynasty, Qingzhou is strong enough to rank in the top three!
A barbecue shop in Qingzhou, do you know how much money it could make!
He had heard that the strength of Qingzhou used to be mediocre, ranked in the middle or even lower. It was only two thousand years ago that a governor emerged in Qingzhou. This governor not only had high cultivation level, reaching the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, but also had innovative ideas, often doing things that others could not think of. The Qingzhou banquet was his suggestion.
Under this governor's leadership, the strength of Qingzhou increased day by day, breaking into the top three, and at its peak even ranked first!
"There are fifteen barbecue shops that our two sects opened jointly. It's not a big deal if one barbecue shop is ruined. The problem is that if these ancient cultivators can ruin one place once, they can ruin the second time!"
Vice Headmaster Shi indirectly reminded Lu Yang in his words that the barbecue shop that the cultivators of Great Yu destroyed was not the barbecue shop of Nine Nether Sect, but the joint barbecue shop of Nine Nether Sect and Heaven's Court.
Dependent on his ability to pass the Thunder Tribulation, Vice Headmaster Shi could hardly vent his anger even if he hacked the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign to half-death. He had no other choice but to vent his anger on other ancient cultivators when the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign got away.
The barbecue shop was related to his debt of a billion. If he couldn't repay it and was struck dead by the sky thunder, he would have a deep hatred for the ancient cultivators!
An unavenged hatred isn't human!
Lu Yang understood, Vice Headmaster Shi had a grudge against the ancient cultivators, and wished for the help of Heaven's Court.
Of course, he was happy to be involved.
Lu Yang looked at Vice Headmaster Shi with a smile: "Does Master Shi still remember the plan I made for your religion in the barbecue shop last time?"
Vice Headmaster Shi blurted out, his Unification Stage memory being quite strong: "The Nine Nether Sect forms external alliances with the Demon Territory and the East Sea, and internal alliances with the Relentless and Sunflower Sect. When the struggle of the Great Era arrives, if our two sects act together, we will achieve the cultivation, and the Nine Nether can rise!"
"In the plan, did I suggest an alliance with the cultivators of the Great Yu and Great Qian era?"
The eyes of Vice Headmaster Shi lit up. That's right, there was no place for ancient cultivators in the plan!
"Originally this world belonged to my Heavenly Court. If my Heaven's Court cannot tolerate Yingtian Immortal and the others ruling the Ancients, how can we tolerate Great Qian, Great Yu, and Great Xia ruling the continent?"
Vice Headmaster Shi was overjoyed. The attitude of Heaven's Court was even tougher than he had imagined.
With the strong support of Heaven's Court, he wondered how those damned ancient cultivators would cope!
"I would ask your respected sect to join hands with my Nine Nether Sect to deal with the ancient cultivators!" Vice Headmaster Shi, standing up, his gaze burning, hoped to reach a cooperation agreement with Heaven's Court, very sincerely.
Lu Yang stood up leisurely, the corners of his mouth carrying a confident smile, as he shook hands with Vice Headmaster Shi.
"Well then, a pleasant collaboration."

chapters.title: Chapter 384 - 383: The Smell of Blood_1
chapters.content:
"I have some information that may be related to the Great Yu's cultivators." Vice Headmaster Shi considered their increased chance of success against the Great Yu's cultivators, feeling encouraged to further cooperate with Lu Yang.
Lu Yang let out an 'oh' of understanding, relaxing in his chair.
"Care to share?"
"There are two reasons why the Great Yu's cultivators are not accepted by the Great Xia." Vice Headmaster Shi held up two fingers.
"The first point needs no explanation. The Great Yu's believers do not acknowledge the existence of the Great Xia and wish to restore Great Yu's reign, naturally, this causes contention."
"The second point originates from the struggle between the Righteous Path and the Demon Path."
"Historical records indicate that blood sacrifices were frequently occurring in the Great Yu's empire. The Imperial Teacher and Emperor Yu, in their attempts to solidify their power, disregarded these events and appealed to high-powered individuals, such as Heavenly Calamity Sovereign. Why is he called such a name? Because he brings calamity to the people and yet, the Great Yu turned a blind eye.
The reason lies therein."
"The Great Yu deemed the sacrifice of a few cities and the support of a Transcendence Tribulation stage cultivator as a profitable bargain."
Vice Headmaster Shi sneered at the Great Yu's actions. Although their Demonic Sect also committed murders, their actions were driven by faith and the awareness of Nine Nether's existence, a stark contrast to Heavenly Calamity Sovereign's murderous enjoyment.
"If this was in the Ancient Times, Great Yu would have been wiped out by Heaven's Court." said Lu Yang indifferently. Blood sacrifice by a cultivator was rarely seen, even in ancient times.
Before the Five Immortals of the Ancients gained immortality, order in the Ancients was chaotic. Blood sacrifices were not surprising. If they occurred after the Five Immortals gained their immortality, that would mean they were not taken seriously.
This could be inferred from the attitude of Fairy Eternity.
Fairy Eternity was naive, but not foolish. She would not tolerate blood sacrifice.
Therefore, it could be inferred that none of the four friends she made among the Four Immortals of the Ancients would be murderers, else she would not befriend them."
"The newly resurrected Great Yu cultivator is weak. The fastest way to recover is through blood sacrifice or blood feeding. The Great Xia Empire is strict in its rule, and it's difficult for them to openly perform blood sacrifices like 10,000 years ago."
"By using the 'Rules' or other means to secretly conduct blood sacrifices, Great Xia would find it difficult to know."
Lu Yang recalled the events in Buyi Town which was a way used by the Great Yu's cultivator to regain strength.
"Our Nine Nether Sect has eyes throughout the entire continent. We may not match the Great Xia in open affairs, but we know more than the Great Xia in hidden matters!" Vice Headmaster Shi boasted. Their Nine Nether Sect had existed for tens of thousands of years and without information channels, they would have been extinct long ago.
"A few days ago, I received a suspicious piece of information, possibly about a blood sacrifice. It does not seem to have been performed by the Yaoyang Sect or the Ruthless Sect. It's highly possible that the ancient cultivator is involved!"
"Possible blood sacrifice?"
"Yes, possible. It's not confirmed yet."
"What is the specific situation?"
"One of my subordinates reported to me. While passing through a small village named Huai'an Village, in Liang State, he noticed no signs of life in the village from afar. His cultivation method is quite unique and extremely sensitive to the smell of blood, which he detected."
"Even though he was so far away, he could still smell the blood. This indicates a large number of deaths in the village!"
"He feared any rules established by the Unification stage might be present in the village, so he did not dare to approach. He reported right away after realizing the anomaly in the village."
Junior Sister Tao Yaoye was slightly shocked at this story. The situation seemed suspicious.
Lu Yang frowned, "The village is deserted, has the government not taken any action?"
"The stranger part is that the government authorities have completely ignored this village, as if they don't even know the village exists! Or maybe the villagers just disappeared not long ago and the government still hasn't become aware of the situation!"
"Based on my speculation, it is highly probable that an ancient cultivator conducted a blood sacrifice in this small village and used some methods to block people's awareness or possibly the awareness of righteous-path cultivators!"
Lu Yang was rhythmically tapping his fingers on the table. The situation was exceptionally strange, and Vice Headmaster Shi's explanation may not be entirely accurate.
No matter what, he decided to investigate the small village.
Lu Yang wasn't worried about Vice Headmaster Shi luring him there. The strength of Heaven's Court had already been partially displayed. Not even a blow from the Fifth Elder's shuttle could deter him, the Young Master
"Then, let's take a look." Lu Yang prepared to head towards Yue State.
Vice Headmaster Shi was surprised at how decisive Lu Yang was. He had assumed that Young Master Lu would return to find Heavenly King as a protector before investigating Yue State.
Just the two geniuses dared to venture into Yue State, a suspected site of ancient cultivator activity?
Either they had life-saving abilities, or the Heavenly King Protector was already nearby without him detecting.
"Master Shi, would you like to go with us?"
"Of course, I'm coming." Vice Headmaster Shi agreed cheerfully. He was the one who proposed this after all - it wouldn't make sense for him not to go.
His flying boat was moored outside Yanjiang County, and the three people boarded and departed.
Vice Headmaster Shi wanted to talk to Lu Yang about something, but he saw Lu Yang close his eyes in meditation immediately after boarding the flying boat. He appeared reluctant to converse further, causing Shi not to bother him.
Junior Sister Tao didn't speak either. She knew that when Senior Brother Lu closed his eyes, he was afraid of heights and didn't want to look outside.
Three days passed, and the flying boat arrived in Yue State.
Yue State was located on the west side of the Central Continent. Influenced by the climate, it was abundant in grasslands and scarce in forests. To the west was the Golden Buddha Country, filled with floating yellow sand and rarely seen in green.
"We're here."
Vice Headmaster Shi stopped his flying boat in mid-air. After verifying the location in the report, ensuring the small village beneath them was the odd one, he jumped down.
Lu Yang, who was afraid of heights, didn't dare to simply jump off. He was prepared.
"Junior Sister Tao, cast an illusion for me, making me think that the ground is right beneath my feet."
Tao Yaoye covered her mouth to giggle, waved her hand and covered Lu Yang with an illusion. The two of them jumped down.
Golden Core stage cultivators could fly freely.
The three landed approximately a mile away from the village.
Vice Headmaster Shi worried that it would alert the enemy, so he didn't use his spiritual sense to probe the situation in the village.
"It doesn't seem like any rules have been used here." After walking around the village, Vice Headmaster Shi made this judgment. He was very experienced and seldom made mistakes in this aspect.
"Then it's even more strange. Where did all the villagers go?" Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye were also puzzled, it simply didn't make sense.
The three of them tried to enter Huai'an Village and walked into the village without being affected by any rules.
Vice Headmaster Shi sniffed the air and his expression grew serious, "The smell of blood here is stronger than I expected!"
"Is there a smell?" Tao Yaoye also took a sniff but didn't smell anything.
Vice Headmaster Shi explained, "You two are different from me, you cultivate Heaven's Court orthodox methods. The methods the demon-path cultivators practice have more or less to do with blood sacrifices. Only those who practice the demonic path, like me, could sense the anomaly of this place."
Lu Yang asked, "Is the smell of blood strong?"
"Very strong, even if all the villagers of this small village were killed, I'm afraid it wouldn't have this much!"
"This is very likely a sacrificial altar established by an ancient cultivator, where they gathered commoners and cultivators for blood sacrifices!"

chapters.title: Chapter 385 - 384: Ten Thousand Soul Banner_1
chapters.content:
The scent of blood was so strong here that even Vice Headmaster Shi felt uneasy, fearing that there was more than one ancient Unification cultivator.
If he were even more unlucky and encountered a Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator, it would be his turn for misfortune.
He felt a touch of relief, fortunate that he had brought Lu Yang along. Even if he were to be unlucky, could Heaven's Court really allow their junior master to fall here?
"I know very little about the demonic blood sacrifice, so I'll have to trouble Master Shi with the situation in this small village," Lu Yang said earnestly, speaking the truth.
Vice Headmaster Shi didn't dodge the responsibility. He walked to the front door of the most peripheral toilet, pushing it open to reveal emptiness. Bowls and chopsticks were laid out on the table as if the owner of the house was about to eat but suddenly disappeared without a trace, without any signs of struggle or resistance.
Vice Headmaster Shi opened several other house doors, and it was generally the same scene. The traces of life were still present, clearly showing that people had lived here, but for some unknown reason, everyone had vanished.
It was as though someone had stopped Time, moved people away one by one, and then Time began to flow again.
Tao Yaoye felt a chill run through her as she witnessed this scene – it was much like the ghost stories she wraps herself in a quilt to read at night when she was a child.
She carefully gripped onto the corner of Lu Yang's robe, which instantly comforted her quite a bit.
"Can Master Shi figure out what happened here?"
Vice Headmaster Shi analyzed, "As far as I know, there are two ways to accomplish this: spatial imprisonment and stopping Time."
"If it's spatial imprisonment, it's still bearable. A Unification cultivator proficient in spatial magic skills can do this. However, if it were Time stop, it would be terrible. If Time could be stopped, a conservative estimate would be that it's by a Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator!"
"In my memory, there has been no one who could stop Time. Transcendance Tribulation Stage can only theoretically do so!"
Lu Yang nodded, "Time Immortal can do this."
"Time Immortal?" Vice Headmaster Shi was surprised, he had never heard of this Immortal.
Lu Yang nodded, "Time Immortal mastered Time Dao Fruit. In terms of understanding Time, they were the first in ancient times, and no one could compare."
"Is there such a thing?!" Vice Headmaster Shi exclaimed. The way of Time is elusive and difficult to understand, even entry into it is difficult.
He didn't expect that there was an Immortal in ancient times who took Time as a Dao Fruit. The power of this Dao Fruit once realized must be incredibly terrifying!
Tao Yaoye also looked moved, how casually Senior Brother Lu mentioned an Immortal?
Looking at Vice Headmaster Shi's big reaction, what he was saying must be something even the Vice Headmaster of the Nine Nether faction didn't know.
How did Senior Brother know about this?
Has the gap between her and Senior Brother already grown this big?
The shocked expression on Vice Headmaster Shi gradually disappeared. He blinked and turned his head to ask Lu Yang, "What did you say just now? I was a bit absent-minded."
"Nothing." Lu Yang thought Unification cultivators could resist the forgetting characteristic of Immortals, but even Vice Headmaster Shi, a Great Power in the late stage of Unification, couldn't resist the characteristic of Immortals.
"The probability that the opponent mastering the Path of Time is a Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator is low. I am more inclined to believe it is a Unification Stage cultivator who can use spatial imprisonment."
From the moment he set foot in the small village, Lu Yang's brows had been constantly furrowed. So many people had died, and the manner of their deaths was so strange. How terrifying must the murderer be?
Killing people under the eyelids of the court, and no one noticed.
What about other villages if Huai'an Village was like this? How many people did the murderer kill?
Vice Headmaster Shi squatted down, grabbed a handful of mud from the ground. The originally dark brown soil was pinched by him, revealing a dark red color.
Seeing the puzzled faces of Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye, he took the initiative to explain, "Too many people have died here, causing the soil to be stained with the scent of blood! But because of this, I have determined one thing!"
"What is it?"
"The smell of blood here is so strong, but the scent of blood shouldn't be this low. Certainly, someone has transferred the smell of blood elsewhere!"
"I remember that the smell of blood can be used to refine the Ten Thousand Soul Banner, a powerful weapon of the Demon Path right?" Lu Yang recalled the knowledge related to Demon Path.
"Yes, to refine the Soul Summoning Banner, Spirit Summoning Banner, and the Ten Thousand Soul Banner, one cannot do without the scent of blood and resentment."
Vice Headmaster Shi had a confident appearance. He ground the soil into powder, tossed it into the air, and quickly formed a single handprint, casting a black imprint.
The soil powder was concentrated by the black imprint and floated in the air like silk, drifting off into the distance.
"Let's go, follow me. If the scent of blood was refined on the spot, it would be troublesome to find, but since the perpetrator first moved the scent of blood and then refined it, I can find the real refining location based on the residual scent of blood!"
Vice Headmaster Shi took Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye with him and flew off, reaching a mountain area several hundred miles away in one breath.
"The trail ends there!"
Vice Headmaster Shi pointed to a position not far away. The three of them exchanged glances, nodded, and walked over while holding their breaths.
Suddenly, Vice Headmaster Shi and Lu Yang both stopped at the same time, and Lu Yang instinctively grabbed Tao Yaoye who was preparing to move forward.
Tao Yaoye looked ahead, it was lush with trees, filled with the chirping of birds and the fragrance of flowers. She couldn't see any difference from other places.
Vice Headmaster Shi looked at Lu Yang in surprise, not expecting Lu Yang to react as quickly as himself.
"You also realized it? One more step forward and we will be entering a formation!"
Lu Yang nodded, "In ancient times, this was called the Ghost Striking Wall Formation, anyone who stepped into this formation would lose their sense of direction, be confused inside, and finally trapped to death here!"
"It's still called Ghost Striking Wall Formation now."
"There must be secrets hidden here, considering they've set up a Ghost Striking Wall Formation to prevent people from getting in."
"Furthermore, there are multiple Array Methods concealed within the Ghost Striking Wall Formation, blocking any probes from the outside, and those within cannot probe outside."
"Someone must be cultivating inside the formation, unwilling to be disturbed by the outside world!"
"I smell a hint of blood emanating from within the formation!"
"Judging from the way the formation is set, it's not the doing of someone at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage."
"Well, that's good if it's not someone from the Transcendance Tribulation Stage."
The two discuss and analyze the formation, inferring what might be happening inside: an individual at the Unification stage set up the formation in the mountains, refining the smell of blood, and does not wish to be disturbed. This is related to the massacre of Huai'an Village.
Tao Yaoye follows in silence, struggling to keep up with Lu Yang's pace.
Why is it that Senior Brother Lu can communicate so fluently with those at the Unification stage on this matter?
When Tao Yaoye was on missions, she encountered excellent cultivators at the Foundation Establishment and Golden Core Stage. Those people spoke confidently as if they knew everything, but in front of those at the Divinity Transformation Stage, they stuttered and seemed scared. If they encountered those at the stage of Refining the Void or Unification, they could barely utter a word.
They lack so much compared to Senior Brother Lu.
Vice Headmaster Shi smirked. He enjoyed disturbing others' cultivation process, especially if he could drive the ancient cultivators at the Unification stage into the paths of demonic cultivation!
He pulled out an Octagonal Hammer from his Storage Ring, tossed it upward, and the hammer became as sizeable as a small mountain. Each of its corners gleamed with cold light.
The Octagonal Hammer fell, descended like a meteor, intimidating in its momentum.
Crack--
The massive Octagonal Hammer landed as though it struck something, making a crackling sound.
Vice Headmaster Shi rubbed his hands, pressed downward once more, imbuing the Hammer with a new force that shattered the invisible barrier.
Crack-- Crack-- Shatter--
The barrier shattered, and the smell of blood rushed forth.
Tao Yaoye's eyes widened in disbelief at the scene before her. There was no hint of any picturesque scenery.
The trees had withered. Rivers of blood flowed. The earth dyed red. Ghostly figures loomed. A sinister wind howled. A shriveled old man sat in the center with a blood-red banner standing beside him.
"Who are you?" The old man abruptly opened his eyes, blatantly disregarding Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye. He glared at Vice Headmaster Shi, his teeth clenched.
The formation he had set up should not have been discovered. The only weak point was the leaked smell of blood which only an ancient demon could discern.
The ages-old demon had no grudge against him. Why would it destroy his formation!?
"I am your grandfather!" Vice Headmaster Shi laughed heartily, called back his Octagonal Hammer, and lifted it to smash it down.
The shriveled old man grabbed the tattered banner to dodge, muttering incantations while evading.
Vice Headmaster Shi dismissed this with casual indifference. In his other hand was a white bone scythe. He swung and hacked at the old man, realizing that the disruption of his formation had caused backlash for the man. The old man was in terrible condition.
Cornered like a dog!
"Is this the standard you set? You're just disgracing ancient cultivators!"
"Still trying to refine this Ten Thousand Soul Banner? That's just leftovers from my game!"
"Die for your grandpa!"
Vice Headmaster Shi demonstrated his might, driving the withered old man into retreat. The old man didn't even launch a decent counterattack.
Boom--
The Octagonal Hammer and the bone scythe fell simultaneously, smashing the withered old man into the mountain.
"Well, well, well, the younger generation is to be feared indeed!" The old man laughed in fury, walked out of the cave, the banner in his hand shimmering.
Vice Headmaster Shi clicked his tongue, "I was complacent."
"Complacent how?" Tao Yaoye asked.
Vice Headmaster Shi pointed at the withered old man and spat, "I was too absorbed in the fight just now and didn't realize this old man has been refining the Ten Thousand Soul Banner. Now that he's completed it, it's going to be tough to deal with."
The withered old man's face was so dark that it seemed like water could drip from it. The words gratingly made their way out from between clenched teeth, giving an extremely discomforting impression.
"This seat unintentionally came upon a massive amount of blood aura – ideal for refining the Ten Thousand Soul Banner. Today, I'll let you young ones know just how formidable this seat is!"
"Ten Thousand Soul Banner, rise!"
With a howling sinister wind that chilled to the bone all around, countless ghostly figures began to materialize behind the old man. They were massive and seemed to number well beyond ten thousand.
As the old man laughed heartily, the Ten Thousand Soul Banner was fully refined, and the ghostly figures became increasingly distinct.
Lu Yang recognized the figures of these ghosts: pigs, cows, sheep…
"Huh?"
The four present were all momentarily stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 386 - 385: Can't there be some gains from being struck by lightning every month?_1
chapters.content:
A sinister wind swept against the face, and the setting immediately quieted down. Only the wretched howls of various ghosts echoed in the vicinity.
Ha ha ——
Moo ——
Baa ——
Whether it was the dessicated elder or Vice Headmaster Shi, both in the Unification period with thousands of years of experience, had never seen a situation like today's.
Vice Headmaster Shi's expression was not coherent, he just looked serious and said that things had become troublesome, the other side successfully refined the Ten Thousand Soul Banner.
Based on the current situation, even if the other side refined ten Ten Thousand Soul Banners, it possibly won't cause any trouble.
The dried-up old man did not expect to refine such a bunch of stuff. He just happened to pass by a small village and found that the smell of blood in the small village was extraordinarily strong, which was very suitable for refining the Ten Thousand Soul Banner. He swept up the smell of blood and chose a secluded place to refine it immediately.
Faced with a mighty enemy, the Ten Thousand Soul Banner was successfully refined at the last moment. He was about to offer the Ten Thousand Soul Banner with the fresh blood of his enemies, intending to cast a spell to claim a million lives with Fierce Ghosts.
As a result, he summoned this pile of things?
The dried-up old man gritted his teeth, formed hand seals, and drove the Ten Thousand Soul Banner once again.
"Well, whether it's humans or livestock, as long as they can be refined into the Ten Thousand Soul Banner, they're all considered Fierce Ghosts!"
Vice Headmaster Shi saw the dried-up old man continue to use the Ten Thousand Soul Banner and also thought of the same problem.
This Ten Thousand Soul Banner may look funny, but its power is not to be underestimated!
"Charge, devour them!" The dried-up old man laughed crazily and decisively commanded, intending to bury Lu Yang and the other two here!
The pigs, bulls, and sheep scattered in all directions, rushing towards all sides. If it wasn't for the Ten Thousand Soul Banner holding them, they would have run away without a trace long ago.
A few pigs even nudged the dried-up old man and leisurely walked elsewhere.
The dried-up old man: "..."
Vice Headmaster Shi: "..."
"Senior Brother Lu, is this a Unification-level battle?" Tao Yaoye sent a message to Lu Yang. She had less experience and encountered a Unification-level battle for the first time. She didn't understand the way it was fought.
In his heart, Lu Yang said this is my first time encountering such a situation, too.
"Fairy, why don't the livestock refined into the Ten Thousand Soul Banner obey orders?"
In the spiritual space, Fairy Eternity was laughing so hard she was bending over backward, and it took her a long time to recover.
"Hahaha, fool, using livestock to refine the Ten Thousand Soul Banner, why not use bugs to refine it? Hahaha..."
When she finally eased her laughter, she explained to Lu Yang: "The essence of the Ten Thousand Soul Banner is to drive the souls. The souls that can be driven must be intelligent creatures, like humans and demon beasts. The higher the cultivation level of humans and demon beasts before they die, the greater their resentment, and the stronger their power.
"A group of livestock lacks intelligence, how can you expect them to understand orders to attack?"
"But I remember that using the souls of babies can also refine the Ten Thousand Soul Banner? Babies have no intelligence, right?"
"Indeed, baby souls can be used to refine the Ten Thousand Soul Banner. But there's one thing you haven't noticed: Demon Cultivators don't immediately refine baby souls into the Ten Thousand Soul Banner. This process takes several years.
During these years, the baby soul does not change in size, but its mind gradually grows, and when it finally reaches an age where it can understand orders, only then the refining is considered complete."
Before Fairy Eternity became a fairy, she had many dealings with Demon Cultivators. In the chaotic times of the ancient era, Demon Cultivators were everywhere, and her understanding of Demon Cultivators was deeper than that of Vice Headmaster Shi.
Before leaving, she reminded Lu Yang: "In the future, you must study hard and don't be as ignorant as this old man."
Lu Yang got the answer, relayed it to Tao Yaoye, and won her admiring gaze.
Senior Brother Lu is so knowledgeable.
Wait, why does Senior Brother Lu know so much about the Demon Path?
...
The emaciated old man tossed the Ten Thousand Soul Banner aside, pulling out a necklace. Each bead on the necklace was a tiny skull, each with its own unique and fearsome visage.
This was his Life-bound Magical Treasure, the Eighteen Generations Clan Necklace. To forge this necklace, the forger must first marry and have children, multiplying his clan. Once their lineage reaches the eighteenth generation, they take the life of the most outstanding member of each generation, torturing them until they transform into beads.
The bead string is made from the entrails of his wife, stringing together the eighteen beads.
The old man threw the Eighteen Generations Clan Necklace, the necklace broke apart, the skull beads inflated and grew bigger, turning into skeletal skulls floating in the sky, gnashing at Vice Headmaster Shi.
This technique alone would make the majority of Unification Cultivators dare not resist.
"Haha, you're indeed a cruel old geezer, refining your succession of eighteen generations into a Demonic Device. Since all the eighteen successive generations descend from you, it's easy for you to manipulate this necklace!"
The expression on Vice Headmaster Shi's face remained unchanged. He recognized the origin of the necklace, but so what? To become the Vice Headmaster of the demonic sect right under the noses of those on the righteous path required skills beyond what the old man could imagine.
He gripped the Giant Bone Scythe in his hand. The handle of the scythe sprouted barbs that pricked his palms. The scythe absorbed the blood from his palm; a red line emerged in the middle.
Swoosh—
Vice Headmaster Shi swung the Giant Bone Scythe, the brilliance descended from the sky and instantly illuminated the whole peak. Of the eighteen major demons, six were severed.
The old man's complexion changed: "How can this scythe's compatibility be higher than my necklace!"
Vice Headmaster Shi strode forward, fighting the remaining major demons: "Nonsense, to forge this scythe, I pulled out all my bones, nourishing them day and night with my blood, keeping them active even after extraction. Only then could I refine these bones into the scythe!"
"However close the relationship between your eighteen generations and you may be, it can never match the intimacy between me and my own bones!"
"Madman!" the old man cursed. To extract all his bones and refine them into artifacts, this process would take hundreds of years, and was highly susceptible to secret attacks. In case of an accident, at best, his vitality would be greatly weakened; at worst, it could lead to his demise.
"Hehe, thanks to Master Qin's favor for me, I've been well protected during the process!"
The fight between the two was vigorous. The old man's demonic techniques kept emerging, the eighteen major demons constantly regrouping, disrupting Vice Headmaster Shi's offense. Vice Headmaster Shi's figure turned into a series of afterimages, unpredictable; his Giant Bone Scythe was reaping lives, forcing the old man to avoid close combat.
"I define rules here: [Except me, within a radius of five hundred yards, everyone moves slowly!]" The old man used the power of rules to restrict Vice Headmaster Shi's movements.
Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye immediately felt as if they were stuck in a quagmire, hardly able to move.
Vice Headmaster Shi sneered. His Divine Soul went out of his body; although his body was moving slowly, his Soul was unaffected. He changed his weapon and, with his Soul holding a large hammer, smashed towards the old man.
"So, you can set rules? Here, I'm setting a rule: [within a radius of five hundred yards, no one can use Demonic Devices]."
The Eighteen Generations Clan Necklace lost its light, and the eighteen major demons disappeared.
"Just with a Soul, you dare to make a noise in front of me!" The old man went up alone to Vice Headmaster Shi and was knocked over by a blow from his hammer.
He screamed, "How can this be, how can your soul be so powerful!"
The old man was very confident in his own soul, he specialized in soul techniques. But his soul's power was slightly inferior to Vice Headmaster Shi's.
"You get struck by a lightning worth ten billion a month, you'd be like this!"
Vice Headmaster Shi swore. He risked his life to withstand celestial lightning every month; how could he have no gains?

chapters.title: Chapter 387 - 386: I, Protector of Heaven's Court, Dark Ghost Heavenly King! _1
chapters.content:
Upon seeing that Vice Headmaster Shi was suppressing him in every aspect, the withered old man inwardly groaned that he had met with a bad omen. How could this young man be so powerful, totally beyond his expectation?
In the tide of Unification period Demon Path cultivators in the Great Yu Dynasty, he was among the strongest. The only ones who could actually put any pressure on him were the top most major demons who were also on the Unification level.
Damn, what luck! I come out to refine a Ten Thousand Soul Banner, and end up refining a bunch of beasts that don't understand commands. Now, I run into the top most major demon of the Unification level.
The full-scale battle of the Great Era hasn't even completely erupted yet, and I'm already running into this kind of opponent?
If we keep fighting, the loser will be me!
Run!
Not wanting to keep fighting, the withered old man turned and fled.
His rich survival experience told him that being defeated temporarily doesn't mean he'd always be defeated. As long as he continued to cultivate diligently, who would dare to mock his escape today when he took his revenge in the future?
He hadn't intended to target Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye. These two had a solid foundation, but their cultivation level was too low; they were probably the opponent's disciples.
Those who are practicing on Demon Path value themselves most. To them, the act of kidnapping disciples for threatening was nothing less than a joke.
The withered old man left the six major demons to hinder the pursuit, turned himself into a stream of light and fled.
"Damn it, that old bastard is so shameless, he just ran away!" Vice Headmaster Shi cursed irritably. The opponent had no stature of a top master.
Although, if he was in the withered old man's place, he would also make the same choice.
All of a sudden, space undulated like ripples, and a figure appeared silently behind the withered old man. Holding something that looked like a brick, he knocked the withered old man over.
The withered old man staggered and fell from the sky.
"Who?!"
He hastily adopted a defensive stance, but unfortunately he had been hit too hard and the movement was too proficient; he was dizzy and could hardly stand up straight.
Realizing that there was another top master, he prepared to flee again.
The figure with the brick in his hand sneered coldly in a chilling way.
"You want to run from me, the Heavenly King?" The figure looked at the withered old man, who had fallen into a stupor and had no power to resist.
The stupor of the withered old man lasted only for half a second, and he quickly regained his senses.
However, half a second was long enough to do many things for cultivators on the Unification level.
The figure kicked the withered old man over and trampled him underfoot harshly.
When the withered old man tried to use Earth Escape to flee underground, the figure calmly pointed at the ground, and the ground instantly turned as hard as meteoric iron, indestructible. Even when the old man tried to break through by hitting his head against the ground, he couldn't.
"Point Ground Into Steel?!"
Both the withered old man and Vice Headmaster Shi exclaimed in surprise. They recognized this Great Divine Skill that countered Earth Escape. This move was almost lost to the world, and only the Five Great Immortal Sects and ancient cultivators could use it.
The figure looked at the withered old man coldly and pressed harder with his foot, causing the withered old man to scream in pain.
"Who are you?" The withered old man stared intently at the figure that had suddenly appeared.
If it hadn't been for this person appearing suddenly, he would have escaped by now.
But he had no heart to resist, the moves the figure had just shown were a bit stronger than those of Vice Headmaster Shi.
Vice Headmaster Shi also watched the figure with a bit of vigilance. The figure had made a move at the critical moment, implying that he had been following them all the time, but he had not noticed it from beginning to end.
What a deep and unfathomable hiding technique!
The figure's eyes were deep and unfathomable, like an ancient well. He glanced at the withered old man lying on the ground and then at Vice Headmaster Shi. His tone was flat, revealing arrogance and contempt.
"I am Yale of Heaven's Court, the Protector known as Dark Ghost Heavenly King."
Vice Headmaster Shi's face changed slightly. As expected, the figure was the Protector of Heaven's Court.
Also, using "Dark Ghost" as his title, could he be related to the ancient Nine Nether?
The withered old man looked confused, what organization was Heaven's Court?
He had investigated all the major forces today, and hadn't heard of an organization called Heaven's Court.
Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye watched as the Grand Elder stepped on the ancient Unification period demon, despising the vice headmaster of the demonic sect, wildly unrestrained and domineering, barely managing to suppress the urge to make a sarcastic remark.
When Lu Yang was planning to meet with a vice headmaster of a demonic sect, something this dangerous, the Seek Dao Sect naturally had to send someone.
Originally, Lu Yang didn't intend to have anyone follow him. He didn't know where the Grand Elder had heard that he and Tao Yaoye were going to meet Shi Huagu and had volunteered to protect them.
All in the name of protecting the future of the Seek Dao Sect.
Seeing the Grand Elder's behavior, Lu Yang felt that it wasn't really about protecting himself. He was just using it as an excuse to show off.
After Vice Headmaster Shi was sure that the Grand Elder was an ally, he felt relieved. He squatted down and slapped the withered old man a couple of times, and asked sternly.
"Say, why the hell did you kill so many livestock!"
Feeling insulted, the withered old man got angry and felt Vice Headmaster Shi was too humiliating. "Do I look crazy? I'm a Demon Cultivator, not a butcher! If I had known that those bloody odors came from a slaughterhouse, I would have taken the trouble to refine the Ten Thousand Soul Banner?"
Vice Headmaster Shi felt the withered old man had a point, and so he slapped him a couple more times.
"Tell me how the villagers disappeared!"
"What villagers? There was nobody around when I got there!"
The withered old man was puzzled, he wasn't sure why Vice Headmaster Shi had targeted him for no reason.
"That's not right, wasn't it you?"
"It wasn't."
Vice Headmaster Shi saw that the withered old man wasn't lying. They were both demon cultivators, and there was no need to cover up a murder.
"Strange."
...
Seek Dao Sect, Eternity Breeding Ground.
The former master of the Eternity Sect looked at the endless breeding ground. Cattle and sheep leisurely grazed in a peaceful scene, and he sighed softly.
"My lord, what's wrong?" The three female ghosts, Xiao Wu, Xiao Liu, and Xiao Qi, came up with concerns, seeing that their master had sighed.
"I was just remembering the time when I opened a slaughterhouse as the Master."
"You used to run a slaughterhouse?"
"The way you say it... doesn't everyone have a hobby?"
"I've never told you before. Before I joined the Eternity Sect, my family ran a slaughterhouse. Later, I was wanted by the government for tax evasion, but the Eternity Sect saw that I was a talent and recruited me."
"After some time in the Sect, I became the Master."
"After becoming the Master, I always remembered the days of running the slaughterhouse. My subordinates were as stupid as pigs and were constantly annoying me. Since we didn't have many people in the Eternity Sect, and it wasn't easy to find replacements if the subordinates were gone, I bought a lot of puppets and built a small village in the wasteland, which I named Huai'an Village."
"I controlled the puppets and made them pretend to be villagers. I opened a slaughterhouse and slaughtered pigs every day, using it as an outlet for my anger at my subordinates. So, I slaughtered pigs like that for three or four hundred years and gradually became a well-known traditional slaughterhouse in the area."
"Then I was caught and my slaughterhouse was sequestrated. The pigs, cattle, and sheep inside were all sold by the government. The government ordered me to stop all the actions of the puppets, and then the puppets were also taken away by the government."
"Now, Huai'an Village is just an empty shell, leaving only a pile of useless bloody odors. The government doesn't know what to do with it and just lets them sit there."
"Wouldn't the bloody odor be used by the demon cultivators, like refining it into the Ten Thousand Soul Banner or something?" Xiao Qi was worried, they were almost refined into the soul banner.
The master burst into laughter.
"How is that possible? Which dumb Demon Cultivator would use this sort of bloody smell to refine the Ten Thousand Soul Banner."

chapters.title: Chapter 388 - 387: Speaking The Truth After a Meal_1
chapters.content:
"Strange, could there be another Demon Cultivator involved in Huai'an Village?" All those present looked at the withered elder, completely puzzled.
The Grand Elder discreetly gave a cough, transmitting a message to Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye.
"I know a thing or two about what's going on in Huai'an Village. According to the Master of the Eternity Sect, he set up a slaughterhouse in Huai'an Village in Liang State, disguising puppets as villagers."
Dai Bufan has been managing the Task Hall and information in place of his Master. The real manager, however, should be the Grand Elder.
Although the Grand Elder likes to construct his own graves in his spare time, he doesn't ignore everything. Both the Task Hall events and the information in Dai Bufan's grasp are known to him, including the confession of the Master of the Eternity Sect.
Lu Yang: "..."
Tao Yaoye: "..."
Dear Elder, you knew all along about what's going on in Huai'an Village, yet you didn't intervene as we ran about from place to place?
The Grand Elder thought to himself, wasn't I just looking for the most conspicuous way to make an entrance? How could I have made my entrance without you going to Huai'an Village?
The Grand Elder had hoped that Vice Headmaster Shi would attack Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye, and that he could then make a dramatic rescue in the nick of time.
Such a pity, the chance never came.
At least the withered elder is giving face.
The information known by the Grand Elder can't be shared with Vice Headmaster Shi. This is not information that the Heaven's Court should have, it could lead Vice Headmaster Shi to suspect their identities.
"Well then, having this ancient cultivator is a gain, so this trip wasn't in vain," Lu Yang voluntarily says. There's no need to remain in Huai'an Village any longer.
"Master Shi has been very helpful throughout this process. How about the matter of this person be left to you?"
Vice Headmaster Shi can't believe his ears. Clearly, the Dark Ghost Heavenly King captured the withered elder, but he's giving him to himself to handle.
"This... wouldn't that be inappropriate?"
Lu Yang, standing with his hands behind his back, laughed: "What's inappropriate about it? Our two Sects are in cooperation. Let's just call it a welcome gift. You, the Jiuyou Teaching, have more information than we do, and what this ancient cultivator has to say could be more useful to you than to us at the Heaven's Court."
Vice Headmaster Shi nodded inwardly. After all, the Jiuyou Teaching still has information on other ancient cultivators. Combining that with the information from the withered elder, they could gain a better grasp of the actions of the ancient cultivators.
Information on the ancient cultivators is of utmost importance. They might be able to find the ancient cultivators' hidden treasure troves and enrich their wealth.
The Heaven's Court's indifferent attitude towards the ancient cultivators suggests that they don't really care about them.
Just how vast is the influence of the Heaven's Court?
Does Young Master Lu intend to owe the Jiuyou Teaching a favor, or is he trying to display his power?
Vice Headmaster Shi can't understand Lu Yang's attitude. As expected of Young Master of the Heaven's Court– his profound thoughts are indeed unmatched by peers of his age.
Seeing that Vice Headmaster Shi understood the gist, he clasped his hands in a salute and said, "In that case, much thanks."
Grand Elder put away the brick-like object and handed over the withered elder to Vice Headmaster Shi.
"Damn, my good pillow is being used as a pillow!" Fairy Eternity is discontent. She could see clearly that the object in the Grand Elder's hand was her Immortal Treasure, the Dream Pillow.
This was captured by Seek Dao Sect during the invasion by Master Liu and Master Gao, who run the barbecue shop. It can induce forced sleep.
"We'll be leaving now!" Vice Headmaster Shi took out his flying boat, sealed the Cultivation Level of the withered elder, threw him onto the boat, and got underway.
The Grand Elder pulled out a water-ink landscape painting from his sleeve. A waterfall in the painting rushed down for what seemed like forever. There was no sound in the painting, but when Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye saw this, they felt like they heard a sound in their ears.
The Grand Elder smiled, "This is a magic artifact I often use when I travel - it's a High Mountains and Flowing Water Picture. Within the painting is a world, another type of Cave Heaven. Fourth Junior Brother drew this for me."
Tao Yaoye hesitates a bit as she has not seen this kind of magic artifact before. She doesn't know how to use it.
"Do we need to jump in?" Lu Yang recalled, he had seen Ji Hongwen, the Senior Brother of the Fourth Elder, use a similar method before.
"Indeed."
The Grand Elder jumps into the painting. Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye follow suit and jump in as well.
Just as they jump into the painting, there is a roaring sound of a waterfall. The two lift their heads and discover that they are standing next to a waterfall. The waterfall is flowing down from the sky, making countless splashes of water.
The two crouch down and observe the vegetation by the riverside. The grass and trees are lush and dripping with vibrance, with dewdrops on their leaves. They can't tell if it's real or not.
Is this just a painting, or is there another small world within the painting?
Seeing their shocked expressions, the Grand Elder feels very satisfied. He has no intention to give them any explanation, and manipulates the painting to fly towards the Seek Dao Sect.
"Ah, it's painting cultivation. I didn't expect that there would be skilled practitioners amongst painters in this era," Fairy Eternity is slightly astonished. Since ancient times, there have been saints in the Confucianism Path, and many great cultivators studied painting in ancient times.
"Are the plants and streams within the painting real or fake?" Lu Yang asked.
"Fake, but they're very close to the real thing. If the spirit of vegetation were infused into it, they would become real. This skill was very rare even in our time."
"Can Fairy paint?"
Fairy Eternity waved her hand dismissively: "That's a small, poor scholar's trick. I don't have any interest in learning such things."
Remembering something, the Grand Elder turns his head and asks, "Speaking of painting, I once read a record in an ancient book. In ancient times, there were two Immortals, one a Demon Immortal and the other a Wood Immortal. The Demon Immortal was imprisoned in a painting by the Wood Immortal. This led to a great battle between the two Immortals, with Heavenly Lights radiating, shocking the universe.
If it weren't for the ancestors of the Dragon and Phoenix Two Clans stepping in and mediating the battle, who knows how many stars would have been shattered. This is recorded in several ancient books to some extent."
"Lu Yang, you're familiar with ancient history, have you heard of this?"
Lu Yang shakes his head. This is his first time hearing of it.
The Demon Immortal and Wood Immortal, could they be the Qilin Immortal and Time Immortal?
It's time to use the golden finger.
"Fairy, have you heard of this?"
Fairy Eternity thought for a moment, and then suddenly exclaimed: "Now I remember. One time Time Immortal ate my cooking and spoke the truth afterwards, mentioning this incident!"
"You're asking the right person. If you'd asked anyone else, they truly wouldn't know!"
"...Before we go on, why does Time Immortal speak the truth after eating your meal?"
Fairy Eternity was surprised by Lu Yang's question and naturally said: "Isn't this normal? After getting full and sleepy, the Yingtian Immortal and Time Immortal often become drowsy after eating my food. They lie their heads against the table and they start babbling. If you ask them anything at this time, they'll answer, and they won't remember what they've said afterwards."
"Please continue."
Fairy Eternity continued: "I never cared to learn about painting cultivation, but Time Immortal did show a great interest and was quite skilled in it. Even I have trouble distinguishing the authenticity of his works. After all, he derived from the Firmament Tree and stands at the pinnacle of plant spirits. He naturally feels a connection to paper."

chapters.title: Chapter 389 - 388: Battle Between Demon Immortal and Wood Immortal_1
chapters.content:
"There are two essential tools for a painter, one is the immortal paper, and the other is the immortal brush. At that time, he had already attained immortality. Brushes capable of being used by immortals were rare in this world, and even the raw materials for manufacturing such brushes were lacking. Without materials, even the Yingtian Immortal couldn't make one."
"For the immortal paper, he was not so worried, for he could create such paper from wood shavings he took from himself. But the brush, that was difficult."
"The nearest material for the brush was our hair, probably because we all belong to the human race. Our hair couldn't be used to create an immortal brush, so his attention was focused on the Qilin Immortal."
"A clump of fur from the tail of the Qilin Immortal is suitable for making an immortal brush."
"First, he used a Semi-Immortal level brush to produce a 'Hundred Beasts Painting', showcasing a group of gorgeous females in the eyes of demon beasts. He then invited the Qilin Immortal to his home to admire the painting. Seeing that the Qilin Immortal was tempted, he suggested that the Qilin Immortal could go for a try in the painting."
"The Qilin Immortal was overjoyed and unsuspecting. He hailed the Time Immortal as his good friend and soon fell into the trap of the 'Hundred Beasts Painting'."
"Taking advantage of the Qilin Immortal's distraction, Time Immortal sneaked into the painting and shaved off the fur from the Qilin Immortal's tail."
"Just as Time Immortal was about to use his time capability to speed up the growth of the Qilin Immortal's tail fur to cover the theft traces, he was discovered by the Qilin Immortal."
"The Qilin Immortal was furious and began a brawl with the Time Immortal. Immortal Methods were used recklessly. So shocking was the fight that cultivators across several planets saw it. They were astounded. The commotion was so great that it alarmed the geniuses of the Dragon and Phoenix tribes."
"Upon learning about their fight, the geniuses of the Dragon and Phoenix tribes hurried over to ask about the cause."
"Of course, the Qilin Immortal couldn't confess his lascivious intentions that led him to be fooled by the Time Immortal. He indignantly said that he was caught off guard and was imprisoned by Time Immortal in the painting."
