"Time Immortal claimed that he just wanted to test how far he had mastered painting and used the Qilin Immortal as his practice subject, and he asked for forgiveness."
"Qilin Immortal said, 'a good attitude, I forgive you'."
"Time Immortal promised to give a generous gift in return."
"Qilin Immortal replied, 'we are like brothers; no need for such formalities'."
"Time Immortal insisted because it was the right thing to do."
"The geniuses of the Dragon and Phoenix tribes were amazed and curious. They requested to see the painting that trapped Qilin Immortal. Both Qilin Immortal and Time Immortal claimed the painting was destroyed during the fight."
"The geniuses of Dragon and Phoenix tribes didn't give it another thought and accepted their words as truth, though they thought it was a pity."
"Afterwards, Time Immortal gifted the 'Hundred Beasts Painting' to Qilin Immortal. And they were once again as close as brothers."
Lu Yang: "..."
Such a remarkable reconciliation.
Seeing Lu Yang in a daze, the Grand Elder thought he was recalling the story and added one more detail.
"I remember now, an ancient book mentioned that the Wood Immortal painted a 'Hundred Beasts Painting'. He trapped a Demon Immortal in it, and ordered the hundred beasts to attack the Demon Immortal. Do you remember that?"
Lu Yang thought to himself, 'what kind of ancient book is this? It glorifies the story far too much.'"
He thought that the truth of the ancient times was best kept to himself. If this story reached the ears of the geniuses of the Dragon and Phoenix tribes and they ended up beating up the Qilin Immortal again, and if the Qilin Immortal traced it back to him, his life might be in jeopardy."
He shook his head blankly, "I haven't heard of such an event."
"Okay then." The Grand Elder didn't doubt Lu Yang. Lu Yang was still young, and couldn't possibly know everything."
While they were talking, the Grand Elder manipulated the scroll, bringing Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye back to the sect. He himself disappeared.
...
"Old Two, stop sleeping. Do you know what I've been doing?" The Grand Elder woke up Uncle Ba, who was asleep at the entrance of the medicinal garden."
Seeing it was the Grand Elder, Uncle Ba ignored him, turned over, and went back to sleep."
The Grand Elder, of course, wouldn't let Uncle Ba sleep. He told him, "I just met with the Deputy Master of the demonic sect, using the identity of Dark Ghost Heavenly King."
"What?!" Uncle Ba immediately woke up and sat upright. "Tell me what happened."
"Lu Yang wanted to meet with the Deputy Master of the Nine Nether Sect. He was worried about his safety and asked me to support him. He earnestly sought my assistance. Given Lu Yang is the most outstanding disciple in our sect and was begging me like this, I naturally obliged and protected him secretly."
"The Deputy Master of Nine Nether Sect is surnamed Shi. After meeting him, Lu Yang was cool and collected, with me backing him up. He spoke freely and easily, completely intimidating Mr. Shi."
"Mr. Shi revealed his discovery of an ancient cultivator's trace and invited Lu Yang to go there. With me protecting him, Lu Yang felt confident to go anywhere in the world. Therefore, he agreed to go."
"Mr. Shi's information was correct. They indeed found an ancient cultivator there who was extremely malevolent. This cultivator was using a sea of blood to refine a Ten Thousand Soul Banner. As soon as the refinement was complete, countless beasts howled, blackening the sky and deafening the ears. A menacing wind wafted about, causing terror in anyone who saw the spectacle.
Even Lu Yang was scared silly and stood there, having never seen such a spectacle."
Uncle Ba nodded. A Ten Thousand Soul Banner of Unification level was indeed difficult to deal with. Upon completion, it would release countless ghosts to sweep across the world. Those of an equal level would find it difficult to handle, let alone Lu Yang. It was natural for him to be scared."
Moreover, it was a Ten Thousand Soul Banner comprising of demon beast souls. When the souls of demon beasts go mad, they are even fiercer than the souls of the human race. Even the weak ones who only hear the howling sound might suffer from mental confusion!
"Mr. Shi was fighting with the ancient cultivator until they were passionately engaged. Seeing that the enemy was formidable, I stepped in boldly. With an Immortal Treasure in my hand, I disregarded the attacks from the Ten Thousand Soul Banner and captured the cultivator."
"The ancient cultivator saw my high cultivation level and was terrified. He could not accept his defeat. Out of his hysteria, he asked for my identity. I stepped on him, looked down on everyone else, and slowly revealed my name. I told him I am the Protector of Heavenly Court, the Dark Ghost Heavenly King."
Uncle Ba's eyes lit up with excitement. He wished he could have been there for such a thrilling event.
Grand Elder thought, 'I am in charge of Seek Dao Sect's intelligence, of course I knew about Lu Yang's outing before you did.'
"Alright, I have other things to do. I can't chat anymore." The Grand Elder left quickly, leaving behind an envious Uncle Ba.
...
"Old Three, stop farming. Do you know what I've been doing?"
"Old Four, stop reading. Do you know what I've been doing?"
...
After bidding farewell to Lu Yang, Tao Yaoye had witnessed a significant event and realized her shortcomings."
"It seems like there is a long way for me to catch up with Senior Brother Lu!"
"Senior Brother Lu remains calm even in front of those at Unification stage. He can talk about various anecdotes and cultivation philosophies at ease. How does he do it?"
"Senior Brother Lu is experienced, handles matters calmly, and is my role model. I heard that he is particularly good at ancient history, even surpassing the elders. In that case, I'll start by studying ancient history!"
Suddenly, Tao Yaoye felt an overwhelming pressure, enough to take one's breath away.
Turning her head, she saw her master smiling gently at her, sending her a message to ask about her cultivation progress."
"Just back from outside? How is the cultivation of Feather Transformation Immortal Body going?"
Tao Yaoye broke into a cold sweat. In her excitement at the chance to go out with Senior Brother Lu, she had forgotten about her Feather Transformation Immortal Body cultivation.

chapters.title: Chapter 390 - 389 Nine Star Connection_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang returned to Sky Gate Mountain, seated himself atop a giant rock imbued with Sword Qi, and opened his mouth wide, swallowing spiritual energy as he calmed his heart to practice cultivation.
An endless stream of spiritual energy flowed into his body, transforming into pure spiritual essence under the operation of the "Mind Seeing Method" and surging within him.
He slowly extended two fingers, coalescing a ten-foot long green Sword Qi at his fingertips.
"Go!" With a swift forward motion of his finger, the green Sword Qi shot forward, piercing through three trees before disappearing half an inch into the fourth.
These were not ordinary trees, but Qiulong Trees specially planted by Daoist Buyu at Sky Gate Mountain. The trees had thick roots, like dragons, and overlapping bark that resembled dragon scales.
Legend states that there was once a tremendous battle in the Demon Territory involving the Long Clan. Countless True Dragons fell during the battle and their blood stained the lake red. The trees that grew on the bank of the lake were dyed in the blood of the True Dragons and underwent a transformation, acquiring the power of the True Dragons.
This marks the origin of the Qiulong Tree.
Qiulong Trees fetch a high price, and smaller sects would only dare to decorate their entrance with one or two. In contrast, a small forest of Qiulong Trees flourished at Sky Gate Mountain.
Lu Yang opened his eyes. Looking through the three trees he had pierced, he was delighted to see that his Sword Qi managed to penetrate half an inch into the fourth tree.
In the past, his Sword Qi could only pierce through three Qiulong trees, and would run out of force by the fourth, unable to even pierce the bark.
"Days of practice have indeed paid off!" Lu Yang felt he was getting increasingly adept at using Sword Qi. His three-foot green Sword Qi twined around his fingertips as nimble as a snake.
He could even use Sword Qi to clean his ears.
"It's a pity that there is nobody within my realm that can rival my Swordsmanship, engaging in a debate with them would have made an interesting affair." Lu Yang shook his head regretfully.
Although he hadn't sparred in Swordsmanship with people of the same realm, the confidence brought on by the Invincible Elixir led him to believe that he was the best in Swordsmanship among his peers!
Fairy Eternity silently nodded in agreement. This was the essence of invincibility!
Lu Yang demonstrated the same aura that she possessed in her early years, he was indeed destined for greatness!
"Speaking of which, Fairy, since you and the other four created Buddhism, would you know the Buddha Land in Palm?"
"What is Buddha Land in Palm?"
"Fairy, haven't you heard of this Great Divine Skill? It's the supreme spatial Divine Ability of Buddhism, a level above the Heavenly Eye Technique, Heavenly Ear Technique and other six Divine Abilities."
"Buddha Land in Palm, means having a large kingdom within your palm, creating unlimited space. Even if someone possesses a great Divine Ability or is extremely fast, they cannot escape once they fall into the palm. With one palm down, it's as if a kingdom is leaning over, it is invincible."
"Some even say that the Western Golden Buddha Country is, in fact, a manifestation of Buddha Land in Palm."
Fairy Eternity pondered: "I never heard of Buddha Land in Palm before. It should be a magic skill created later, or perhaps a skill from our time that has had its name changed."
"For example, I know of a Divine Ability called Universe in Palm. Within the palm lies creation. The vast galaxies are just toys within the palm, the Sun and Moon are merely two spheres of Yin and Yang, and everything else is insignificant."
"Perhaps Universe in Palm is Buddha Land in Palm, and the younger generations merely changed its name."
"I remember hearing that the Ancient Nameless One molded the vast galaxies into a continent. Perhaps it's this move!"
Thinking of the Ancient Nameless One performing the Universe in Palm move made Lu Yang's scalp tingle. Just how powerful would one have to be to randomly integrate the stars?
Even the celestial calamities seemed insignificant in the face of such power from an Immortal!
"You know, the rotation of the stars follows a certain pattern, oh, right, you've never been to the cosmos, so you've not seen how the stars rotate."
Fairy Eternity narrated with a touch of pride: "I once traveled through space, watching meteorites circle around the stars, smaller stars rotating around the larger ones, and I couldn't help but wonder, could it be that smaller objects rotate around larger objects is the rule of star movement?"
"After observing, guessing, drafting, calculating, and verifying, I finally…"
"In the end, did you, Fairy, calculate the laws of star movement?" Lu Yang interrupted, admitting that at times, the Fairy does showcase her intellect.
"No, Immortal Jiuchong told me that someone had already figured out this law."
Lu Yang: "..."
It makes sense, one does not need to ascend to Immortality to travel to the cosmos. One can do so during the Unification stage or Transcendence Tribulation stage. If someone were determined enough, spending a couple of years observing a star would enable them to figure out the laws.
And it would take even less time if one encountered a master of time magic, maybe just half an hour.
"Back then, our belief in astrology was popular, and one respected astrologer pointed to a certain nebula and said he had calculated that when the nine stars lined up, the star area they were in would fall into massive chaos, causing countless deaths and the destruction of the star area."
"And according to the rotation of the stars, that alignment of the nine stars would occur in just three years!"
"The astrologer was named Shi Cang and he came from the Imperial Shi Clan, which had a far-reaching reputation. Half of his predictions turned out to be accurate."
"As you know, some cultivators believe in destiny, while others do not, so they started discussing how to deal with this calamity."
"Those who believed in destiny agreed with Shi Cang's prediction and felt an urgency to relocate the people living on these stars to other stars which were livable but underpopulated."
"Those who didn't believe in destiny thought it was unnecessary to have billions of living beings move based on one man's words. Such a move would inevitably cause a significant number of deaths, and starting anew on a new star would take countless generations."
"Then, Fairy, do you believe in destiny?"
"After hearing this, I directly shattered one of the deserted stars, so that the alignment of nine stars could never occur!"
Lu Yang silently gave a thumbs-up, admiring Fairy's quick-thinking and audacious actions.
"Although I hadn't become an Immortal at that time, shattering a couple of stars was still quite simple," she added casually.
"After shattering one star, I found an Array Method hidden in its core. This sparked my curiosity, and I went on to find eight other stars. These eight stars also had the same Array Method in their cores."
"Based on my inference, when the nine stars lined up, the Array Methods would resonate with each other and trigger a massive explosion."
"This was done intentionally?!"
Fairy Eternity spat out hatred-filled words: "Yes, it was that bastard Shi Cang! He used the name of astrology to sow chaos and gain enormous benefits. In reality, all the disasters they predicted were set up by them in secret!"
"I was so furious that I killed Shi Cang. The Imperial Shi Clan came forward to apologize and compensate for his actions, but I was indifferent and continued killing. The Imperial Shi Clan tried to block my path to advancing to the Transcendence Tribulation Stage because I refused to give face."
Still fuming, the Fairy continued: "But it was futile, my talent is unique in all of history. When it's time for me to reach the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, I will!"
Lu Yang gave a round of applause.
The tricks and schemes of the ancient times were indeed unimaginable, with stars as the unit of their calculations, just how many people would be affected?
As Lu Yang was contemplating how terrifying the hidden schemes of ancient times were, he heard Fairy Eternity asking him.
"By the way, would you like to learn Universe in Palm? I can teach you."
"Universe in Palm? Me?" Lu Yang looked at his own small palm, feeling that the Fairy was expecting too much from him.

chapters.title: Chapter 391 - 390 Learning Universe in Palm_1
chapters.content:
"This Immortal believes you have a very perceptive understanding of the Dao of Space. Don't you think? Even 'Heaven and Earth in an Inch' is not something that one at your Cultivation Level could comprehend, yet you've managed to learn it anyway?" As the leader of the Five Immortals of the Ancients, Fairy Eternity highly acknowledged Lu Yang's aptitude in Space Magic Skill.
During ancient times, if anyone received compliments from Fairy Eternity, it would mean surpassing endless fortunes and an opportunity to ascend to the heavens in one step.
Lu Yang, however, did not have this realization; for he felt that Fairy Eternity had only brought him tests.
If he were in ancient times, he would have been labelled as "ungrateful".
"Fine then, let's get started."
Lu Yang thought that after practicing for such a long time, he could use the lesson as a break and to loosen up his mind.
"I don't expect you to master 'Universe in Palm' comprehensively. Just grasp the principles of magic skill, this can greatly benefit the implementation of other space magic skills, either in learning or in execution speed."
Fairy Eternity was aware of the difficulties Lu Yang would face learning Universe in Palm, but she wanted to teach him anyway.
If she wanted to teach, who could stop her?
Lu Yang jumped down from the massive rock of Sword Qi and after performing three flips in mid-air with his arms spreading out, he landed smoothly.
Fairy Eternity pulled Lu Yang into the Spiritual Space. In the blink of an eye, she changed his pajamas to the robe that private school master always wear, immediately making him look a bit more intelligent.
"Hehe, this feels right."
"Before I teach you, let me demonstrate it to you first!"
Before Lu Yang had a chance to comprehend what Fairy Eternity was about to do, he sensed that his four-room, two-hall Spiritual Space expanded infinitely, plunging into darkness. The most eye-catching objects in view were a few huge stars in front of him and spots of light in the distance which were farther stars.
In front of Lu Yang, Fairy Eternity raised her hand and pressed down hard!
Lu Yang looked up, his eyes squinted. The universe was too dark to see clearly, he only felt something above his head.
"Huh?"
Lu Yang found that the star above his head suddenly disappeared as if it was blocked by something!
A giant hand emerged from the darkness, it filled all his sight and he couldn't see anything beyond the palm!
The lines on the giant palm were distinctly clear, the patterns of fingerprints looked like star tracks, and the stars in the palm were like grains of sand!
Though Lu Yang had experienced a mountain collapse and the oppressive might of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, all of those experiences were incomparable and insignificant compared to the giant hand!
Feeling suppressed, suffocating, desperate... All these emotions were sprouting and frantically growing in his heart!
"Look carefully, this is 'Universe in the Palm'."
As the giant hand pressed down, Lu Yang's vision clouded over, and his consciousness faded.
When he woke up, half of Fairy Eternity's body was hovering above him. Her sparkling big eyes were closely observing Lv Yang.
"Did I scare you?"
"No, you just crushed me to death."
"Oh, you're right, how do you feel after witnessing the power of Universe in Palm?"
With a lingering fear in his heart, Lu Yang decided to remain respectful to Fairy Eternity in the future to stay safe.
"Can you expand my Spiritual Space?"
Lu Yang remembered that Fairy Eternity had complained about the constraints of his Spiritual Space before since it was too small for her to flexibly display her full ability.
With her hands on her hips, Fairy Eternity pridefully replied: "I can expand it temporarily. I couldn't do it before, but after sleeping every day recently, I've regained some of my strength."
"The so-called 'A flower contains a world, a wood contains a life, a grass contains enlightenment, a leaf contains Buddha, a sand contains paradise, a square contains a pure land, a smile contains worldly affairs, a thought contains serenity.' These microscopic things are indeed worlds."
"Universe in Palm is derived from this concept. The world lies in the palm of the hand, an infinitely vast Great Era!"
Lu Yang seemed to have realized something. He heard that the Buddhism highly valued Space Magic Skill, perhaps it was originated from this kind of concept.
"If you want to practice the Universe in Palm, you have to start with contemplation. Contemplate yourself as the Great Era."
"Simultaneously, you have to contemplate the real Great Era, every detail of the world should appear in your mind, in order to construct a real world inside your mind."
"Combining internal and external aspects, reversing space, infinity in a mustard seed... If you can comprehend the meaning of this sentence, you're almost able to display Universe in Palm."
Fairy Eternity explained the principles of Universe in Palm in detail. When it came to the profound parts, she carefully broke them down into several points, interpreting from various angles, striving for Lu Yang to learn Universe in Palm at that moment.
"Alright, I've said enough. You try it." Fairy Eternity raised her foot and kicked Lu Yang out of the Spiritual Space.
His consciousness returned to reality, Lu Yang steadied his mind, and began to recall what Fairy Eternity had taught him.
"Internal and external combination, that is, to combine the imagined object with reality... The infinite great is the infinitely small, the transformation of big and small is the essence of Space Magic Skill..."
Lu Yang stretched out his palm and observed the palm lines. Perhaps the palm lines did correspond to the star tracks?
He poured his spiritual essence into his eyes, temporarily enhancing his eyesight. He saw the deeper part of the palm lines, which were epithelial cells.
All tissues composed of cells, they were very similar to the human body. Could cells be regarded as alternative beings? There were countless cells in his hand, didn't that mean there were countless beings in his hand?
"Is this the meaning of the saying 'A flower contains a world'?"
Lu Yang frowned and pondered, integrating what he had learned with Fairy Eternity's lessons, gradually figured out Buddhism's concept, or the fundamental principles of Universe in Palm.
"The Fairy has already demonstrated that the Universe is the World, Universe in Palm is the world in the palm, it is the utmost form of Space magic skills, both offensive and defensive..."
Lu Yang muttered to himself, flipping his palm over and over again. Enlightenment dawned in his mind, as if a ray of morning light had pierced through the fog in his heart, unmasking the veil of the legendary Divine Ability!
"So that's how it works..."
Lu Yang stood up, brushed off the dirt on his body, the corner of his mouth curved into a confident smile.
"I've learned it."
Fairy Eternity appeared, she thought Lu Yang had given up and consoled him: "It's okay, even if you didn't manage to learn it, understanding the principles is enough. Once your Cultivation Level rises to a certain extent, you will be able to learn."
"Wait, did you just say 'you've learned it'?" Fairy Eternity stared at Lu Yang in astonishment.
"Universe in Palm requires great power to sustain. I don't have enough spiritual essence to maintain it for a long time, but as an Invincible Elixir, I store five to ten times more spiritual essence than others at the same level. I can barely manage to perform it for an instant!"
Lu Yang closed his eyes, his body turning into a furnace, visualizing the appearance of the world. Ordinary people wouldn't be able to achieve this, but he possessed the memories of his past life. He understood what the universe looked like and had the demonstration of Fairy Eternity as a model. These factors together allowed him to perform Universe in Palm!
Lu Yang spread his palm, his palm as flat as possible, he circulated the spiritual essence inside his body madly and let out a shout.
"Universe in Palm!"
Fairy Eternity observed with curiosity, she saw that there really was a world appearing on Lu Yang's palm, with stars orbiting inside like a universe!
"He has actually managed to perform it... Wait, why do I feel the space in his palm seems so small? The length and width are only about one to two miles, and the stars inside are pitifully small?"
"So how is it? Have I mastered it?" Lu Yang looked proudly at Fairy Eternity.
Fairy Eternity had an odd expression on her face.
If it were said that she performed Universe in Palm, then what Lu Yang performed was... Village in the Palm?

chapters.title: Chapter 392 - 391 Poison Pill is Inseparable from Family_1
chapters.content:
"So, have I successfully mastered it?"
"What you have learned..." Fairy Eternity struggled with her limited vocabulary, finding it difficult to answer Lu Yang's question.
"It seems like Universe in Palm, but the scale is a bit off."
Fairy Eternity gestured with her hands: "It's only the size of a village, you should call this skill Village in the Palm."
Lu Yang glanced at the small space in his palm, indeed, it was not very large.
He disliked the name Village in the Palm and argued: "How can you call it a village? Although the space is small, it is still a universe. Look, there are even stars rotating, it should be called Mini Universe in Palm!"
Fairy Eternity sneered at Lu Yang's argument: "Give me a break, a bunch of sand whirling around is not the same as stars."
She blew a breath toward Lu Yang's palm, causing the star-shaped sand to scatter, disappearing without a trace.
Realizing he couldn't fool her, Lu Yang reluctantly conceded: "Fine, let's call it Village in the Palm, at least it's still a space magic skill."
Lu Yang quickly put aside the issue of naming the skill and began exploring how to cast Village in the Palm.
"If Universe in Palm can squash a whole world, making it impossible to resist, then Village in the Palm should be able to do the same!"
Lu Yang mimicked Fairy Eternity, pressing down with his right hand.
"Village in the Palm!"
Boom!
A huge hand descended from the sky, the size of a village, full of oppressive power, the mental shock more intense than the actual one!
The hand had not yet descended when it began to fade, disappearing out of sight.
"Huff, huff—"
Lu Yang gasped for breath, opening his mouth wide to swallow spiritual energy, like a drowning person desperate for air.
He didn't purposefully disperse Village in the Palm, his own spiritual essence simply couldn't maintain the spell's status.
Just one strike had depleted his spiritual essence.
"This move is too advanced for you currently," Fairy Eternity shook her head. Even a childish Universe in Palm was not something a cultivator in the mid-stage of the Golden Core stage could cast.
But then again, if he could completely cast this move without interruption, none in the Golden Core stage could resist!
Even a genius at the Golden Core stage would have no hope of blocking it!
Lu Yang quickly found a solution: "Perhaps I could swallow elixirs while casting Village in the Palm."
He sat cross-legged, spending half an hour stabilizing his condition, adjusting his mood, and started over.
He took out his gourd of pills, all filled with Great Recovery Pills, something he had been familiar with since childhood.
Lu Yang poured out a Great Recovery Pill from the gourd, held it in his mouth, and cast Village in the Palm again.
Just like before, the palm faded and disappeared before it had fully descended, leaving Lu Yang exhausted on the ground.
"No good, a single Great Recovery Pill is not enough."
Half an hour passed, Lu Yang swallowed three Great Recovery Pills and cast Village in the Palm again.
The giant hand disappeared again halfway through.
"Three pills aren't enough?"
Lu Yang gritted his teeth, wondering how many Great Recovery Pills would be needed for a successful casting.
Five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten...
Finally, Lu Yang concluded—he needed to stuff his mouth full of Great Recovery Pills.
This led to another problem—if he filled his mouth with pills, he couldn't swallow them. If he swallowed them slowly, he wouldn't be able to recover in time.
"That's right, I can ask the Seventh Elder for help!"
The Seventh Elder was the top pill master in the Central Continent, he would surely be able to refine an elixir that could quickly recover spiritual essence!
Moreover, since Lu Yang had gifted the Seventh Elder a Herbal Celestial Grass that possessed spiritual intellect, the elder had volunteered to help Lu Yang refine three batches of elixirs!
No time to waste!
Lu Yang found the Seventh Elder, who was in the process of refining pills. The fragrance of the elixirs filled the air, indicating they were not poisonous.
"Haha, my carefully refined Breakthrough Pill is finally complete!"
The Seventh Elder laughed heartily, the creation of a unique elixir gave him a strong sense of accomplishment.
"Congratulations, Seventh Elder!" Seeing this scene, Lu Yang raised his hand in celebration. He had been standing not far away, not disturbing the Seventh Elder's refining. He only approached after the refining was completed.
"Ah, Lu Yang, it's a pity that you are at the Golden Core stage, otherwise you could have tried my newly refined Breakthrough Pill. This pill is unmatched in its kind!"
Lu Yang hesitated. From the Seventh Elder's words, it seemed that consuming this pill could promote one to the Golden Core stage. As far as Lu Yang knew, such pills had been around for a long time.
Seventh Elder waved his hand: "The pills refined by those common people can never be compared to mine. The Breakthrough Pills they produce are crudely made and devoid of beauty."
Lu Yang cautiously asked", "So, the pill that you crafted…"
"The Breakthrough Pills produced by the outside world merely allow cultivators at the Foundation Establishment Stage to advance to the Golden Core Stage, the effect is too average!"
"The Breakthrough Pills I crafted not only can raise cultivators at the Foundation Establishment Stage to the Golden Core Stage, but can also downgrade cultivators at the Nascent Soul Stage to the Golden Core Stage!"
Lu Yang: "..."
Lu Yang felt there was a reason why the Seventh Elder's reputation outside wasn't very good.
Although it's said that there's no distinction between medicine and poison, pill masters are more or less proficient in the knowledge of poison.
However, it is quite rare to see someone like the Seventh Elder, who has balanced the development of both medicine and poison.
Lu Yang still remembered the first time he came to Elixir Cauldron Peak, when he was fainted by the smell of the elixirs. Under the leadership of the Seventh Elder, each Senior Brother and Sister on Elixir Cauldron Peak was proficient in both, and their skills were not inferior to the mainstream elixir-makers.
Despite refining so-called elixirs, they could not guarantee that their products were absolutely non-toxic, perfectly embodying the principle that there is no distinction between pill and poison.
"Providing that we've met is fate, here's one for you." The Seventh Elder flicked a green-veined pill into Lu Yang's bosom with his middle finger.
"What do you need from me?"
"Well, I just learned a new magic skill. It consumes a lot of mana. When I exhausted all my mana halfway through, I was forced to interrupt the casting. I tried to cast the spell while consuming Great Recovery Pills, but the recovery speed of the Great Recovery Pill couldn't match my mana consumption rate. So, I was hoping you could refine an elixir to help me recover my mana quickly."
"Hmm, there have been similar cases to yours before, it's not difficult to refine an elixir for it. Come, let me check your meridians."
Seventh Elder gripped Lu Yang's wrist and was slightly surprised: "When I was at your level, I didn't have such a vast reservoir of spiritual energy. It doesn't make sense. With your spiritual energy pool, you should be able to cast any spell without exhaustion."
"Oh, it's normal for cultivators to have secrets. For example, Old Nine has an Ancient ferocious beast sealed within him, and when Old Four was young, he used to hide a bunch of erotic paintings under his bed."
Lu Yang felt that these secrets were not limited to cultivators.
"It's not that I don't want to tell you, it's just a bit complicated to explain. I'll show you."
Lu Yang was not afraid to reveal the existence of Fairy Eternity. After all, everyone would assume that Eldest Senior Sister had taught him himself.
Lu Yang went to an open space, slapped his palm down, and a giant palm descended from the sky, blocking out the sun and shrouding the mountain tops. The palm wind was startling and made the green grass lie flat.
The giant hand disappeared in midair.
After witnessing this, the Seventh Elder's pupils slightly contracted, moved. He had never seen such a spell. Judging by the momentum just now, this spell should not be something that a cultivator at Golden Core stage can cast. Lu Yang being able to cast it already went against the norm.
"What a formidable spell, what is its name!?"
Lu Yang replied seriously: "Ancient Lost Technique, inherited by the immortals, great divine ability, Village in the Palm."
The Seventh Elder turned his head in surprise and looked at Lu Yang. Why did the spell's name seem to contradict its prefix?

chapters.title: Chapter 393 - 392: Amazing Power_1
chapters.content:
"Think of it as a magic skill I created myself," Lu Yang did not elaborate, mainly because it's hard to explain.
Seventh Elder did not delve too much into this matter. After observing Lu Yang employ this magic skill once, he figured out the proportions of the elixir that should be mixed for Lu Yang.
He made some calculations, nodded: "Wait for a moment, the elixir will be ready soon."
Seventh Elder took out a scoop, without any thought, he randomly picked out herbs from the medicine cabinet, no weighing needed.
He simply walked around the cabinet once, the scoop was full of medicinal materials, neatly divided into five portions following the order of refining.
Then he stomped his foot, sparks of fire leaped out, merging into a blooming lotus of flames!
"Is this all True Fire?" Lu Yang was taken aback, recalling the wall full of True Fire collected by Fifth Elder.
Lu Yang thought to himself, "Fifth Elder said he collected these True Fires while traveling around, using every resource available. The Seventh Elder must have done the same. Does the Seek Dao Sect have a tradition of its disciples traveling the world?"
Seeing Lu Yang staring blankly, Seventh Elder casually explained, "I robbed these True Fires from Old Five."
Lu Yang: "..."
Seventh Elder started the fire and lit the furnace. Three flames rose and fell under the three-legged furnace, igniting roaring flames. The bottom of the furnace was heated to a glowing red, and from quite a distance, Lu Yang could feel the heat waves transmitted by the three True Fires.
The five portions of medicinal materials were tossed into the furnace as per their medicinal properties. In the blink of an eye, they dissolved into a thick concoction, emitting waves of Elixir Fragrance which felt heavenly when breathed in.
Besides the elixir, there was also a small mass of black liquid. With the continuous addition of medicinal materials, the black liquid gradually grew, changing from black to green, emanating the same Elixir Fragrance.
Seventh Elder clapped his hands together, and with a clanging sound, the door of the furnace closed. Lu Yang could no longer see the changes of the elixir, he could only smell the increasingly rich Elixir Fragrance.
"What a fascinating refining method, even the excess residue in the medicinal materials can be transformed into other elixirs, and the quality isn't low," Fairy Eternity was slightly surprised, among all the Unification Stage people she had met, none of them could perform at Seventh Elder's level.
"Open!"
Seventh Elder shouted, the furnace opened. One by one, the elixirs adorned with Elixir Clouds flew out, falling into the golden plates prepared earlier, making clear, crisp sounds.
"This is a pill formula I created temporarily based on your body characteristics and the way you use your magic skills. I call it the Revitalizing Pill. I'm not sure about its effectiveness, you can try it," Seventh Elder flicked one towards Lu Yang.
Lu Yang walked outside, put a Revitalizing Pill in his mouth, activated his spiritual essence, and cast Village in the Palm.
The sky suddenly darkened, and a giant hand as huge as a village descended from above. His spiritual essence was drained, normally he would fail at this step, but this time it was different, the Revitalizing Pill turned into a warm current, timely replenishing the consumed spiritual essence, allowing the giant hand to continue falling.
Boom——
The giant hand fell heavily, causing a gust of wind, the dust flew up, and Lu Yang himself was almost swept away by the wind!
This was just the backlash!
Lu yang wouldn't dare to imagine the kind of impact one would face standing directly under the palm!
The ground sunk, and the giant hand gradually disappeared, leaving a huge handprint pit on the ground.
The land of the Elixir Cauldron Peak was imbued with spirituality, the recessed part slowly rebounded, restoring its original state.
Lu Yang was exhausted, his mouth was parched and his tongue was scorched, but a smile was brimming over his face.
He had finally completely executed it once. The power of this move was greater than he had imagined.
Seventh Elder was standing by watching, very satisfied with his concocted elixir: "Just as I expected, a single pill contains just enough spiritual essence for you to execute a palm strike. If the spiritual essence was any stronger, your body wouldn't be able handle it."
"The power of this strike, I'm afraid I wouldn't have been able to withstand it even when I was at the Golden Core Stage."
Seventh Elder put the remaining Revitalizing Pills into the gourd and labeled it to avoid confusion with other gourds before tossing it to Lu Yang.
The two green elixir left on the golden plate were picked up by Seventh Elder: "There were some ingredients in the medicinal materials that were unnecessary, I turned them into these two elixirs. If you consume them, they will cause you to have a severe stomachache and dissolve your soul for seven days, do you want them?"
Lu Yang shook his head forcefully, fearing it would be too late to refuse.
He returned to Sky Gate Mountain, and counted the number of Revitalizing Pills.
"Seven pills, plus the one I just ate, that makes eight in total. This is a good thing, I can rely on them to execute Village in the Palm!"
"Actually, Village in the Palm is more than just an attack skill," Fairy Eternity reminded him.
"How so?"
"Village in the Palm is a spatial magic skill, containing an actual village. It can be used for storage and for carrying people."
The Universe in Palm does not only refer to the palm being able to grow as big as the world, it literally contains a world within, with infinite space.
"Really?" Lu Yang was surprised. Storing objects was not a problem, any Storage Ring could do it. However, carrying people was difficult, it required special Storage Rings, generally only needed by cultivators who tamed Demon Beasts.
"Let's test its storage function first."
Lu Yang pulled out the Green Peak Sword and Dark Moon Sword from his Identity Jade, with a slight pull from his hand, the two priceless swords disappeared.
Lu Yang spread his hands, space was formed on its own in the palm of his hand. The two precious swords shrank to almost invisible size, stored in his palm.
"To store items, I need to continuously execute Village in the Palm, but this method consumes very little. Even without taking the Great Recovery Pill, I can continuously execute it for a quarter of an hour!" Lu Yang felt the speed of spiritual essence consumption, it was slower than he had thought.
Lu Yang wandered around Sky Gate Mountain. When he saw a big stone, he sucked it up. When he saw a branch, he sucked it up. When he saw a fruit, he sucked it up.
All the items he touched were sucked into his palm, and he was having a lot of fun.
"How am I supposed to experiment with its carrying people function?"
Lu Yang looked around. Sky Gate Mountain has everything but people.
He can't possibly go down the mountain and randomly pick a Senior Brother or Senior Sister to suck up.
"I've got it!"
Lu Yang descended the mountain, heading towards the Hundred Fragrance Building, and purchased a duck from the back kitchen.
"Let's try sucking up a duck."
Lu Yang Sucked at the duck, after it pecked his finger, it disappeared and entered the spatial palm.
Watching the duck hopping around in his palm, Lu Yang contemplated: "If a duck can be stored, it means a person can also be stored... wait, can it store me?"
Lu Yang stared at his palm, eager to try, unable to suppress the impulse to experiment.
"The path to immortality is difficult. We, as cultivators, should dare to try new things. We can't flinch!"
Fairy Eternity was about to stop him, but Lu Yang had already slapped himself on the forehead.
...
Yun Zhi left Captive Peak after hearing about the life of Heavenly Calamity Sovereign.
She had been out for over half a month, she didn't know whether Junior Brother Lu had been practicing diligently.
The Great Era was about to arrive, and various forces were ready to make their move. The most urgent task was to quickly improve their cultivation level.
Junior Brother Lu was sensible and obedient, knowing the priority of urgency, so he must be practicing diligently.
When she returned to Sky Gate Mountain, she saw that Lu Yang had completely disappeared, leaving only half an arm.
The severed part of the arm was being swallowed by the palm. The palm wanted to continue swallowing the arm, but because of the structure of the body, it could not succeed.
The palm and the arm, connected into a circle, was spinning at high speed in the air.
Yun Zhi: "?"
What kind of cultivation method was this?

chapters.title: Chapter 394 - 393 Lu Yang's Patent Fee_1
chapters.content:
Yun Zhi, as the most knowledgeable about the Way and Its Laws in this era, owes not only to her extraordinary talent in this respect but also to her intensive reading of classics in the Scripture Pavilion and her deep understanding of various doctrines.
Theoretically, even if she couldn't use a magic skill, she should have heard about it.
Yun Zhi watch Lu Yang's still spinning arm in silence, recalling what she has seen and heard, she could not fathom which magic skill her junior brother was practicing.
She exhaled lightly, stepped forward, grabbed Lu Yang's wrist, and pulled him out from the midst of his spinning.
"Huff-Huff-Huukh-"
After Lu Yang emerged, he swayed dizzily. Everyone seemed to be shifting, round and round the room spun, his mind all muddled, he was unable to maintain his balance and leaned on the Qiulong Tree trunk, retching.
Golden Core Stage cultivators can avoid the dizziness brought on by rotation by adjusting their organs, but that requires training. Not like Lu Yang, who started spinning wildly without even a moment to adjust.
"Creating a space in your palm, are you learning a Divine Ability similar to Buddha Land in Palm?" Yun Zhi caught a hint.
Lu Yang closed his eyes, steadied his body, and rested his forehead against the tree, finally feeling a bit better.
"Yes, it's Universe in Palm which Fairy Eternity taught me. I've only learned the basics."
Thinking of Lu Yang's ability to learn, Yun Zhi had a rough guess of what had just happened.
Mid-stage of the Golden Core Stage, not bad at all. It seemed his junior brother had been practicing diligently in her absence.
Whoo—
Yun Zhi gently blew a breath towards Lu Yang. Just like a spring breeze sweeping across his face, Lu Yang instantly felt his mind clear and return to normal.
"Eldest Senior Sister, you're back?"
"Mhm."
Lu Yang glared at Fairy Eternity, who was enjoying the spectacle in the Spiritual Space. He looked at Eldest Senior Sister, who no sooner arrives than helping him get out of the dizziness, then looked at her, the longer he's been spinning, the more enjoyment she had!
Fairy Eternity turned her head away guiltily.
At first, she wanted to stop Lu Yang, but as she watched him spinning, she found it quite amusing and couldn't look away.
"Go ask about my patent fees!" Lu Yang wasn't going to let Fairy Eternity go easily. He actively allowed Fairy Eternity to possess him.
Fairy Eternity wanted to struggle a little, but Lu Yang was so resolute. Reluctantly, she possessed him.
"Miss Yun, did you finish questioning the Transcendence Tribulation Stage practitioner from the Great Yu?" Fairy Eternity plucked up her courage to speak; she decided to adopt a roundabout strategy.
"I did, and there were some gains. The person standing behind him was the second Imperial Teacher of the Great Yu Dynasty. His exact Cultivation Level is unclear, but the second Imperial Teacher had assigned him to investigate the power and purpose of State Destiny of the Great Xia Dynasty. Only then did he send two ancient Unification Stage and the Governor of Qingzhou for a confrontation."
"Had it not been for Junior Brother urging me to come over, he would have been successful."
The implementation of the Imperial Teacher system in the dynasty of Great Yu was one of the root causes leading to the demise of Great Yu. Undeniably though, at the time when Great Yu was first established, the Imperial Teacher system proved to be crucial. More so, the first two Imperial Teachers, both prodigious talents, were able to stabilize the dynasty, thus strengthening Great Yu."
The first two Imperial Teachers hold crucial roles in the Great Yu Dynasty, and through word of mouth, they have almost reached a godlike status.
"It's a pity that the second Imperial Teacher maintains only one-line contact with him, so he isn't clear about the whereabouts of the second Imperial Teacher."
"As for how many Great Yu's Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivators have awakened, he is also uncertain. However, based on the tasks assigned to him by the second Imperial Teacher, he inferred that there should be at least one other Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivator that was awakened in Great Yu, apart from him."
"He has quite a bit of information about the Unification Stage of Great Yu, which has been handed over to Junior Brother Dai and the Luoshui Guards of the Great Xia to handle. But these Unification Stage practitioners from Great Yu are very cautious, possibly alert to the situation of the Qingzhou grand ceremony, already fled. Exactly how many can be caught now depends on luck."
"According to his statement, the most dangerous person under him is the Tomb Bone True Monarch. Although his cultivation is ordinary, he possesses a broken Ten Thousand Soul Banner. The Ten Thousand Soul Banner was originally intact, but he failed to keep it safe during his slumber.
The Ten Thousand Soul Banner gradually decayed over the long Suiyue, and fierce ghosts escaped from the banner, plaguing the world."
"During the thirty thousand years history of the Great Xia, 'ghost troubles' occurred once in Liang State. Fierce Ghosts ran rampant, making life miserable for the people, leaving no one daring to go out at night. As a result, the entire Liang State was haunted, the Imperial Court had to dispatch a large number of personnel to suppress the ghost troubles.
Regrettably, the Imperial Court then was unaware of the message of the ancient cultivators' awakening. They did not consider this aspect, and the cause of the ghost troubles remained uninvestigated."
"That ghost trouble should have been caused by the Tomb Bone True Monarch's Ten Thousand Soul Banner. The timeline is roughly accurate."
"Tomb Bone True Monarch is currently repairing the Ten Thousand Soul Banner. He needs a massive amount of bloody aura and vengeful spirits to complete the repair."
"To obtain a massive bloody aura and vengeful spirits, killing is inevitable."
"If he is repairing the Ten Thousand Soul Banner, it means he's found a place that generates bloody aura and vengeful spirits, yet we have not received any information."
"If we cannot find him as soon as possible, by the time the Ten Thousand Soul Banner is repaired, even if we can catch him, it will be too late. He will make a last-ditch effort and ruin the Ten Thousand Soul Banner. The fierce ghosts will come out of the banner and wreak havoc across an entire state."
By the end of the conversation, Yun Zhi's tone had an unusual touch of heaviness.
Lu Yang: "..."
Fairy Eternity: "..."
Why does this Tomb Bone True Monarch sound so familiar?
Fairy Eternity hesitated a moment before asking, "What does this Tomb Bone True Monarch look like?"
The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign had already handed over the likenesses of his subordinates. Yun Zhi snapped her fingers and a wisp of smoke billowed out, slowly forming into an old face that Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity found highly recognizable.
A thin and shriveled old man, who looked like he hadn't had a decent meal in days, wielded a broken banner.
"It really is him!" exclaimed Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity in unison.
"You know him?" Yun Zhi was puzzled. Tomb Bone True Monarch was a cultivator from Great Yu, who had always hidden in the dark. The specific state he was hiding in had not yet been confirmed. How could these two have seen him?
Fairy Eternity put on an air of profound insight, as if she were some strategist of far-sighted wisdom. She made pressing gestures with her hand, as if calculating something, but looking more like someone in the throes of a manic episode.
"I calculated that there was a demon cultivating in Liang State, so I ordered my subordinate Dark Ghost Heavenly King to join forces with the Nine Nether Sect to suppress the demons and find this monster. Once captured, I gave it to the Nine Nether Sect as a symbol of friendship between our two sects!"
Yun Zhi has roughly translated this as Grand Elder and Vice Headmaster Shi, unaware of the situation, had already captured Tomb Bone True Monarch, with Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity as mere spectators.
The exact process didn't matter, just catching him was enough.
Yun Zhi saluted, "Fairy Eternity's planning is incredible."
Fairy Eternity was pleased with herself, she glanced provocatively at Lu Yang.
"There is one more trivial matter concerning Lu Yang. I would like to ask you," she said.
"Please go ahead, senior."
"Lu Yang applied for a patent for flying cars, and Fifth Elder Xiao Wu said that the patent fee had been handed over to you. Why haven't you given the patent fee to Lu Yang?" Fairy Eternity was not the least bit polite to the headmaster of Heaven's Court Sect, as she was the ruler of the Heavenly Court.
It seemed Yun Zhi had thought up of something, her tone was calm.
"So, it's about that."
"Why haven't I given it to Lu Yang?"
"I forgot."

chapters.title: Chapter 395 - 394: The Treasury of Seek Dao Sect_1
chapters.content:
Yun Zhi had indeed forgotten about the patent fee. The Seek Dao Sect had two main sources of income; one was the patent fee from Hundred Refinement Peak, and the other was the elixir fee from Elixir Cauldron Peak. Both combined could support almost half of the sect's operation.
Each month, the Fifth Elder and the Seventh Elder had to pay a portion of the spirit stones they collected to her, Acting Sect Master Yun Zhi, notably, the Fifth Elder paid several types of patent fees, among which were those that belonged to Lu Yang.
Yun Zhi had overlooked this oblivious.
She flipped through the account book and found Lu Yang's patent fees.
"There are two months' worth of patent fees for the flying car, a total of 110,000 spirit stones."
The flying car, being a recent invention, had yet to gain popularity. The initial patent fee wasn't considerable.
"Let's go to the treasury to retrieve it."
Lu Yang's patent fee had been confiscated, hence it was necessary to withdraw it from the public account.
"The treasury?"
Both Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity were surprised, they didn't expect the Seek Dao Sect to have a treasury.
But on second thought, even a rather poor place like the Nine Nether Sect had a treasury, so it made sense for the Seek Dao Sect to have one. If not, where would the sect store their funds?
It's just that Lu Yang had never been exposed to it before.
"Is it far?"
"It's located on Sky Gate Mountain."
Yun Zhi walked down a winding pathway, then through a pine forest. This place had once been used for imprisoning Daoist Buyu. Walking around 200 meters from the pine forest, they finally arrived.
"It's here."
Under Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity's gazes, Yun Zhi gently tapped on a stone wall. The stone wall turned into cracks and suddenly shattered, scattering around.
"This is it."
Lu Yang was surprised. He hadn't expected the treasury to be located at Sky Gate Mountain, more surprisingly, alertly, the treasury that was supposed to be the root of the sect and ordinarily being guarded by an elder, and protected by an array method for safety, didn't have even a door guard at the Seek Dao Sect's treasury?
Even if the Seek Dao Sect was protected by a big protective array and not afraid of external enemies, wouldn't they be afraid of insiders sneaking into the treasury?
The Eldest Senior Sister wasn't staying on Sky Gate Mountain all the time either, she also had her occasions to go out.
Fairy Eternity chuckled, "Who said there's no guard?"
"Who is it?"
Fairy Eternity laughed mischievously and scrupulously did not respond to any questions from Lu Yang.
Both of them, sharing one body, entered the treasury amidst their bantering and closed their mouths.
In the treasury, there were all sorts of treasures that Lu Yang had never seen before; some were heaven and earth treasures, and others were refined artifacts. The functionality and grade of these items were unclear.
Fairy Eternity recognized all of them.
"The landscape painting contains the entire land. It's the work of a great painter and serves to stabilize the kingdom. It is also known for being ancient and terming with the state destiny. It possibly belongs to the glorious Great Yu Dynasty."
"Can you see the red-colored small tripod? It was forged from Blood Stripe Iron, which can be found in extremely harmful environments such as the deep sea, glacier origin, and the deepest part of a star nucleus… a natural creation. Some people even say the bloody pattern on the iron is the blood of the god, which is overexaggerated. Blood Stripe Iron is rare worldwide and generally used for offense.
Even the size of a fingernail could cause a battle among the adepts at the Unification stage, not to mention such a huge piece."
"Look at this fruit, despite its transparent and jade-like appearances, it is indeed a fruit named Qingming Jade Fruit. One such fruit can turn a mixed five-element spirit root into the pure single spirit root, and it is up to you to decide what spirit root it will be."
"Essence of ocean soul named ocean soul crystal…"
"Shield forged from Xuanhuang Qi…"
"These are all great stuff." Fairy Eternity seemed slightly surprised as the treasures stored in the treasury were beyond her expectations.
A stockpile only second to Immortals.
Despite being the head of the Five Immortals of the Ancients, she was the poorest among them. With fewer planets and smaller territories resulting in fewer tributes, sometimes she even had to play dead to cheat for money.
Even then, she was richer than Seek Dao Sect!
Apart from the Five Immortals in ancient times, there were numerous individuals who managed to reach the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. These individuals established large and small forces of their own. The cache of the Seek Dao Sect was comparable to the largest force existing among those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage!
Lu Yang spoke with a hint of pride, "The Seek Dao Sect has been standing tall for 120,000 years, having been guided by Daoist Xiantian, the sect founder; Celestial Master Guiyuan, the pioneer of the concept of Immortal Sects; Vast Sea Daoist Lord, the revitalizer of the sect; it's not surprising we have these treasures!"
Fairy Eternity thought for a moment and accepted the claim.
After hearing Lu Yang's prideful beat, Yun Zhi reminded, "Our Seek Dao Sect wasn't this rich before. Vast Sea Daoist Lord had his reign 50,000 years ago, the wealth from his reign wouldn't last till now, and there was also a period of recession in the sect about two or three thousand years ago. To keep the sect operating normally, we consumed quite a number of treasures.
Most of the treasures you see now were tricked from the Nine Nether Sect about 900 years ago."
Lu Yang: "..."
This was merely the outer ring of the treasury. Yun Zhi guided the two deeper into the treasury. The further they went in, the more valuable the treasures appeared.
When they reached about halfway into the treasury, Yun Zhi stopped. On either side were two mountains piled up with top-grade spirit stones.
Yun Zhi dug out ten high-grade spirit stones from the mountains of top-grade spirit stones. The valuable high-grade spirit stones seemed insignificant among the mountains of top-grade spirit stones as if they were impurities.
Ten high-grade spirit stones were equivalent in market value to 100,000 low-grade spirit stones.
However, that was the market price. In actual transactions, exchanging low-grade spirit stones for high-grade spirit stones would have an excess cost. Roughly ten high-grade spirit stones could convert into 110,000 low-grade spirit stones.
The control over Lu Yang's body was now in the hands of Fairy Eternity. As Yun Zhi handed over the high-grade spirit stones, she noticed that Fairy Eternity was staring blankly into the depths of the treasury.
She realized that she had underestimated the Seek Dao Sect's resources. It could possibly be more valuable than her personal treasure trove!
If the outer ring of the treasury was filled with materials and weapons for those at the Unification stage and the Transcendance Tribulation stage, then the two mountains of the top-grade spirit stones marked a clear dividing line.
The inner part of the treasury was filled with semi-immortal level magic artifacts, talismans, and heaven and earth treasures that could be used by those at the semi-immortal level!
At the furthest depths of the treasury, there was a faint glow. It wasn't clear what it was, but Fairy Eternity couldn't determine what it was. But from its aura, it seemed like an unformed Dao fruit never seen before. No, this aura was stronger than that of a Dao fruit...
"Fairy? Fairy?" Lu Yang called out twice before Fairy Eternity came back to her senses.
"What happened?" he asked curiously.
"Nothing, I was just thinking that your sect's resources barely match my title of being the number one for tens of thousands of years!" Fairy Eternity held her head high, full of confidence.
Leaving the treasury, Fairy Eternity handed the control over Lu Yang's body back to him and he instantly turned pale.
"Damn, I was constantly using the Village in the Palm skill!"
Despite the fact that maintaining the Village in the Palm skill did not consume much spiritual essence, it couldn't even support being used for a prolonged period.
He quickly canceled the skill and emptied the items in his palm, stones, branches, a duck quacking...
Looking at the duck that was flapping its wings and flying around, Lu Yang fell silent.
Having Fairy Eternity on Sky Gate Mountain was troublesome enough; he couldn't possibly adopt a duck now, could he?
...
When night fell, the smell of roast duck filled the air.
After a struggle, Lu Yang first won the battle against the duck, then against Fairy Eternity and finally earned the right to cook.
He brought the roasted duck that he had prepared to Yun Zhi, who had been patiently waiting for a while.

chapters.title: Chapter 396 - 395: The Enemy Infiltrating Seek Dao Sect!_1
chapters.content:
Fairy Eternity is the premier immortal cook of all times, her dishes can be considered as heavenly delicacies, and widely acclaimed.
Lu Yang, as the second-in-command of the immortals, was fortunate not to have received the inheritance of an immortal; he started from scratch and figured out his own unique way of cooking.
The duck he roasted could be called Lu Roast Duck.
The Lu Roast Duck was golden-brown, its aroma tantalizing. The skin was crispy, the meat tender. The bone and the meat were a light yellow color. One bite and the juices would flow out, the flavor was thick and beautiful, leaving a lingering aroma in your mouth.
The senior sister and junior brother enjoyed the delicious roast duck, chewing slowly and savoring each mouthful. Lu Yang was so engrossed that he acted as if he hadn't heard Fairy Eternity's request.
"Let me taste it!"
"Let me try it, just one bite, one bite only."
Fairy Eternity, seeing Lu Yang enjoying the roast duck with a blissful look on his face, wanted to try it as well. However, Lu Yang was unmoved and totally ignored her request, causing her to stomp her foot in frustration.
...
Night fell, and a figure quietly appeared at the entrance of the Seek Dao Sect.
The dark figure stepped forward boldly, the two disciples on guard at the entrance seemed to not see him and allowed the dark figure to infiltrate.
He passed through the entrance, arrived at the bamboo forest, knowing that the territory was guarded by the River Spirit, dared not to take it lightly. He held his breath, cautiously entered the Seek Dao Sect.
The dark figure seemed very familiar with Seek Dao Sect, knowing where the guards were stationed, and how not to be discovered by them.
He trod in mysterious footsteps, carefully bypassing the River Spirit's surveillance and passed through the bamboo forest, entering the inner part of the Seek Dao Sect.
"Humph, Seek Dao Sect is nothing great!" The dark figure sneered, his eyes cold, looking down on Seek Dao Sect.
After he passed through the bamboo forest, a dense fog rose above the babbling brook, the vapor took the shape of the River Spirit, silently watching the dark figure's retreating figure without uttering a word.
Behind the bamboo forest was the mountain where the Task Hall was located, which could be considered the entrance of the inner gate of Seek Dao Sect.
The dark figure cast a wary glance at the Task Hall, becoming more cautious, daring not to slack off at all.
"This infiltration into Seek Dao Sect is to steal the secret magic skills of Seek Dao Sect, a secret operation, not to be discovered by anyone!"
"The main person in charge of the Task Hall now is Dai Bufan. Given Dai Bufan's cultivation level, he has no hope of detecting my presence. After all, his cultivation level is insufficient, and he is inexperienced, far inferior to his master Qin Jiunian."
"What I fear is that old fellow Qin Jiunian might also be there. Although he is annoying, his cultivation level is indeed high and he might be able to detect me!"
"He should not be there. That old fellow is fond of building tombs and is often not at the Task Hall."
The dark figure, with fear and trepidation, passed through the mountain where the Task Hall was located without anyone stopping him.
"Lucky, that old bastard Qin Jiunian wasn't around."
After passing the Task Hall, the dark figure boldly moved around the interior of Seek Dao Sect. He was very confident in his stealthy skills which would even go unnoticed by the elders!
Indeed, he was walking around as if he were invisible. Even when he walked shoulder to shoulder with disciples of the Spirit Transformation Stage and the Refining the Void Stage, they did not notice him!
Even when he was strolling in the shopping street, nobody noticed him.
There were many old monsters in the shopping street who were at the Unification Stage, but they could not detect the dark figure. This was a testament to how profound and advanced his cultivation level was!
"Body Refinement Peak, here it is, the eldest son of Meng Family is here!"
The dark figure sneered in a low voice, boldly climbed onto the Body Refinement Peak.
"The third elder brother of Seek Dao Sect is all muscle and no brains. I'd have a hard time dealing with him head-on, but when it comes to stealth skills, he can't hold a candle to me!"
The dark figure passed through the Spirit Field, saw the Green-eyed Buffalos toiling away, a flicker of envy flashed through his eyes. The Green-eyed Buffalos were the best suited for farming. His force had a large Spirit Field, but they didn't have the help of the Green-eyed Buffalos.
"I remember that the third elder brother of Seek Dao Sect saved the life of a Green-eyed Buffalo on his travels to the Demon Territory when he was young. To repay the favor, that buffalo brought its entire family to settle down at Seek Dao Sect. It's hard to replicate such a scenario."
"This place...no, this place...no..."
The dark figure only knew that the eldest son of the Meng Family was in the Body Refinement Peak, but did not know his exact location, so he had to search one abode after another.
"Found it! It's here!"
Sessing the sleeping Old Horse, the dark figure confirmed that this was the abode of the eldest son of the Meng Family, a victorious smile played on his lips.
"The Meng Family has made generous arrangements, using a Great Demon as its eldest son's guardian. It is even greater than the treatment accorded to a Transcendence Tribulation Stage kin."
The dark figure admired inwardly, bypassed Old Horse and infiltrated into the Meng Family's eldest son's abode.
Meng Jingzhou was in deep meditation, with Five Centers Toward Heaven, honing his shadow, completely unaware of the arrival of the dark figure.
"Young Meng, wake up."
Meng Jingzhou heard a voice in his ear, very surprised. He had sealed the entrance well and had Old Horse guarding the entrance, how could anyone get in?!
"Who are you!" Meng Jingzhou glared at the dark figure warily, feeling that his life was hanging by a thread, as if facing a great enemy. The other party was certainly not from Seek Dao Sect!
No one knew about the infiltration into Seek Dao Sect, not even his own master could do this. How high must the other's cultivation level be?!
Who was the other?
Was the other the enemy of Seek Dao Sect who wanted to strangle him, the second generation figure?
Was the other an enemy of the Meng Family, trying to threaten the Meng Family through him?
Or maybe the other was an enemy to both the Meng Family and the Seek Dao Sect, wanting to kidnap him and disrupt the relationship between the Meng Family and Seek Dao Sect?
Meng Jingzhou, with his quick wit, quickly came up with three possibilities, getting closer to the truth and roughly guessing the background and purpose of the dark figure!
"Who I am, you need not know."
The dark figure's eyes became focused, staring at the eldest son of Meng family, his tone wavering, "Let me ask you something, did you create a set of punches named Singleness Curse Punch that once hit by the punch, the person will remain single throughout his life?"
Meng Jingzhou wore a strange expression on his face. He was ready to be kidnapped, but why was the other party asking about this first?
It didn't seem like an enemy of Meng Family and Seek Dao Sect?
"I did create Singleness Curse Punch, but are you sure you have no grudges with Seek Dao Sect?" Meng Jingzhou asked carefully, not sure about the origins of the dark figure. At the same time, he was trying to delay as much as possible, hoping that Old Horse would notice the abnormalities here.
The dark figure sneered, thinking that Meng Jingzhou's question was ridiculous, "I am an enemy of Seek Dao Sect, and our enmity is irreconcilable!"
The dark figure removed his disguise, revealing a familiar face to Meng Jingzhou.
He said fiercely, as if he had a deep-seated hatred for Seek Dao Sect, "How to practice Singleness Curse Punch, teach me quickly. Once I have learned it, I will punch Ba the Second, that bastard twice!"
"That bastard Ba the Second, don't know where he learned it, but he always praises my mom for being smart and beautiful!"
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Come on, you dignified Sect Leader of the Five Elements Sect, you're not really like this, are you?

chapters.title: Chapter 397 - 396: Look at the Fist!_1
chapters.content:
Qiu Jin'an, the helmsman of one of the Five Great Immortal Sects, the Sect Leader of the Five Elements Sect and the de facto power holder of the Central Continent, had the authority to mobilize the entire Five Elements Sect with a single command and could significantly influence world affairs!
The Five Elements Sect adhered to the philosophy of the five elements. Any magic technique related to the five elements could be found within the Sect. Besides these, the Sect maintained a reserve of other magic skills. The scale of their Scripture Pavilion could rival that of a royal family.
Meng Jingzhou greatly respected such a person, who was willing to swallow humiliation and bear a heavy burden to protect his lineage, secretly infiltrated enemy's camp, and shamelessly sought magic skills from the enemy disciples.
Meng Jingzhou pondered, recalling how his boxing technique got leaked.
It seems that he casually mentioned it to Yan Tianzhi, Bai Ming and others at the Qingzhou grand event. Probably Bai Ming had not seen such a boxing method before and asked his master, Qiu Jin'an about it.
As soon as Qiu Jin'an heard of it, he came over.
Everything was explained now.
Being the Sect Leader of the Five Elements Sect, Qiu Jin'an's cultivation level did not need to be mentioned. Even if he fought against Elders alone, it might not necessarily be his match. He effortlessly broke into the Seek Dao Sect, even if Old Horse's cultivation level was high, it could not exceed that of the Sect Leader.
Meng Jingzhou's face contorted with emotion as there were two pieces of news, one good and one bad.
The good news was that his personal safety had been secured.
The bad news was that he couldn't teach the Single Curse Fist.
"Sect Leader Qiu, it's not that I refuse to teach you, but I really don't know how to teach this thing. The Single Curse Fist is the fist technique of my Single Body Spiritual Root lineage, filled with strong resentment. I only came to understand this technique because I am a Double Single Golden Core," explained Meng Jingzhou.
Qiu Jin'an silently looked at Meng Jingzhou. As expected of the eldest son of the Meng Family and disciple of the Seek Dao Sect - so fearless. For the first time, he heard about achieving Double Single Golden Core.
Such a do-or-die attitude is commendable.
He pondered for a moment and said, "Is that so? Try showcasing it once for me to observe."
Meng Jingzhou dared not go against Qiu Jin'an's intent. His two Single Golden Cores started to revolve, forming a cyclone at the Dantian region. The cyclone then transported spiritual essence from the Dantian to all parts of his body.
"Ha! Huuh!"
Meng Jingzhou was full of commanding force when he demonstrated his moves and, regardless of its curse effect, the power of the fist prints alone was enough to prevail at the Golden Core Stage!
He even keenly noticed the curse power contained within the fist prints, which indeed could curse one to remain single forever.
"A natural Buddha seed," he murmured.
He felt that if Meng Jingzhou were to join Buddhism, he probably would be regarded as a Bodhisattva.
Although it's generally considered that the Single Body Spiritual Root is not suitable for Buddhism because it passively remains single, Little Meng was different - he actively remained single. You could tell by the fact that he worked hard to achieve Double Single Golden Cores.
After demonstrating his technique, Meng Jingzhou silently waited for Qiu Jin'an's critique.
Qiu Jin'an was slightly embarrassed, for Meng Jingzhou was not lying. The core of this boxing method relies on the Single Golden Elixir, only those with a Single Body Spiritual Root were capable of learning it.
"Shall I attempt to mimic the Single Golden Elixir?"
Qiu Jin'an contemplated on the idea. Single Body Spiritual Root was a variant of the Golden Spiritual Root, and as a master of the power of the Five Elements, he found it not difficult to mimic the Single Body Spiritual Root and Single Golden Elixir using the power of the Five Elements.
However, the reputation of the Single Body Spiritual Root was well-known, and he dared not easily mimic it.
What if he couldn't revert back after the mimicking? No, it's too risky - he had to find another way.
"Shall I let Little Meng punch Ba the Second?"
"No, the cultivation level of Little Meng is too low, the curse effect of his boxing technique would be useless on Ba the Second."
"Got it, I can borrow his body to perform the boxing technique. In this way, I don't need to worry about Little Meng's cultivation level. It's equivalent to me performing the boxing technique!"
Qiu Jin'an thought this was a good idea and began discussing it with Meng Jingzhou.
"Young Master Meng, would you mind if I borrow your body for a while? If we succeed, I will pass my cultivation insights to you, and teach you one of the exclusive magic skills from the Five Elements Sect. Full teaching until proficiency is guaranteed!"
Meng Jingzhou's eyes lit up. The Five Elements magic skills from the Five Elements Sect were well celebrated throughout the Cultivation World. Meng Jingzhou had heard that even his Meng Family had offered a great sum of money in exchange for one, but were refused by the Five Elements Sect.
"Fine!" Meng Jingzhou agreed.
Even if he didn't agree, it would be futile. In front of an Immortal Sect Leader at this level, even if he refused, they could forcefully control him.
Concerning seniority and stepfather, Meng Jingzhou believed that Sect Leader Qiu was capable of doing anything.
Uncle Ba, I am sorry. Karma has its cause and debt its debtor; although I support sunset love, my cultivation level is too low to stop Sect Leader Qiu.
Seeing Meng Jingzhou agree, Qiu Jin'an turned into a beam of spiritual essence and entered his body.
"You do it again."
Meng Jingzhou executed another round of Single Body Curse Fist. With Qiu Jin'an's support, Meng Jingzhou was able to use the Single Body Curse Fist that was effective even against the Unification Stage!
Qiu Jin'an revealed a cool smile, Ba the Second, let's see what you can do this time!
"Shall we go now?"
"Wait, going at this late hour is too conspicuous and will arouse Ba the Second's suspicion. It's better to go during the day."
Having been opponents for over a thousand years, Qiu Jin'an was very familiar with Uncle Ba's character.
Qiu Jin'an's stealth technique was learnt during his clashes with the nine sons of Seek Dao Sect. In their youth, the nine sons used all their methods and frequently launched surprise attacks.
To counter this, Qiu Jin'an devoted himself to the study of stealth techniques and finally made a breakthrough.
His stealth technique was on par with Daoist Buyu's!
It was still a long time before dawn. While waiting, Meng Jingzhou continued to meditate and cultivate. Seeing this, Qiu Jin'an earnestly gave him guidance.
"I'm aware that your master managed to refine his body into the shadow, which is quite impressive. However, it also has its drawbacks. Listen to me, when refining the shadow, avoid these few issues... these are flaws even your master isn't aware of."
In terms of experience, Qiu Jin'an was unquestionably top of the line. With just a few words, he solved many problems that had been troubling Meng Jingzhou for days, leading to an instant enlightenment.
Meng Jingzhou cultivated all the way till dawn. Seeing that it was about time, Qiu Jin'an urged Meng Jingzhou to leave the abode.
At that time, Uncle Ba was lounging at the doorway of the medicinal garden, imagining a splendid future.
"The method taught by Lu Yang really works! Girls like to be praised as being smart and good-looking, and Yu'er is no exception!"
A smile lingered on Uncle Ba's lips. He might look old, but given the lifespan of a cultivator in the Unification stage, he was equivalent to an ordinary person in their middle years, not really old.
"Little Meng, what brings you here?"
Seeing Meng Jingzhou, Uncle Ba casually asked with a grin. He was in high spirits and didn't notice anything strange about Meng Jingzhou.
"I have something to discuss with you."
"What is it?" Uncle Ba asked curiously.
"I want you to be my stepfather!" Meng Jingzhou roared, his aura soaring.
"What! Who are you!"
"It's too late for you to react now!"
Uncle Ba sensed danger and tried to control Meng Jingzhou, but he was blocked by a force around Meng Jingzhou.
Meng Jingzhou unveiled a triumphant smile. He launched the Single Body Curse Fist.
The Single Body Curse Fist squarely hit Uncle Ba.
Uncle Ba blinked, and felt nothing.
To Meng Jingzhou and Qiu Jin'an, it seemed as if they were punching a bundle of red threads, their fists failing to penetrate it. Instead, the red threads wrapped around the two of them layer by layer!
"What's going on?!" Qiu Jin'an was shocked. This was not the outcome he had anticipated!
Meng Jingzhou turned pale. "It's over, Uncle Ba's marriage bond is something even you, Sect Leader Qiu, can't suppress. We have been backfired!"

chapters.title: Chapter 398 - 397: Lively Night_1
chapters.content:
"What do you mean I can't suppress the marital fate on Ba the Second! And what is this backlash?!"
Qiu Jin'an felt a bad premonition as if there was some secret about this boxing technique that he wasn't aware of.
Meng Jingzhou felt like he was in deep trouble, so he explained, "Let's take me as an example. I can cast the Single Curse Fist on a Golden Core Stage cultivator or even a Nascent Soul Stage cultivator under the right circumstances, but I can't do this to a cultivator in the Divinity Transformation Stage. Why is that? Because cultivators in the Divinity Transformation Stage are stronger than me.
I can't beat them, nor can I suppress them."
"Moreover, if I use the technique on a Golden Core Stage cultivator, but their love connection is with someone in the Divinity Transformation Stage, I still can't use it. This would be equivalent to me using my technique on a cultivator in the Divinity Transformation Stage!"
Meng Jingzhou thought of Li Haoran, whose other love connection was Su Yiren, a cultivator with Great Power. If he used his technique on Li Haoran, Li wouldn't be affected, but Meng himself would face a backlash!
Qiu Jin'an stared blankly and retorted, "Rubbish! As the Sect Leader of the Immortal Sect, how could I fail to suppress a person like Ba the Second!"
Meng Jingzhou remained silent. Seeing the look on Meng's face, Qiu Jin'an felt as if he had been doused with cold water. He understood Meng's intention—while he could suppress Ba the Second, he couldn't suppress the other person connected to him through the marital fate.
Qiu Jin'an, who was no stranger to risks, repressed his present unease, forced himself to calm down, and asked, "So what is this backlash?"
"The backlash will result in one losing their connection with females for a certain period in the future. They won't be able to interact with any woman, and under various coincidences, they will be distanced from females. It might also happen that in some circumstances, females will distance themselves from him."
"You should know about the compass, right? Two poles repel each other."
Qiu Jin'an was taken aback. This backlash effect seemed too harsh.
"Has this backlash happened to you?"
"No."
"Then how can you confirm the genuineness of the backlash effect?"
"Eldest Senior Sister said."
Qiu Jin'an's final glimmer of hope was extinguished.
Uncle Ba's experience in the martial world wasn't much less than that of Qiu Jin'an's. Though Ba spent most of his time living a quasi-retired life at the entrance of the medicinal garden nowadays, back in the day, he had made a big name for himself in the martial world.
Having quickly understood Meng Jingzhou's situation, he said, "The Five Elements Rotating Spirit Possession Technique from the Five Elements Sect? The only one who could use this technique with martial nephew Meng against me must be Qiu Jin'an!"
He used to think that Shangguan Yu, who spent most of his time with Qiu Jin'an, was not very fond of Qiu. Now he found Qiu more agreeable than ever.
"Little Qiu, why carry such resentment against me? I misunderstood you in the past. Now that the misunderstanding between us has been cleared, we should maintain harmony."
