"Moreover, as the Sect Leader of the Five Elements Sect representing the ideals of the Five Elements Sect, treating me this way could easily give outsiders the impression that our Seek Dao Sect and your Five Elements Sect are in a bad relationship."
Uncle Ba appeared to be a benevolent old father reconciling with a rebellious son.
"Ba the Second, go to hell!"
Enraged, Qiu Jin'an ejected himself out of Meng Jingzhou's body, tossed him to the side, rolled up his sleeves, and began to fight.
Ba the Second brought his hands together, rotating them in opposite directions for half a circle, and from under his feet grew numerous dark vines. These vines could absorb the spiritual essence of cultivators. As a cultivator got entangled, their spiritual essence would disappear rapidly, leaving them weak and unable to resist.
"Wood Element Enemy Trapping Formation?"
Qiu Jin'an recognized the technique being used on him instantly and sneered. He had been ambushed by this formation technique since childhood. How could he let Ba the Second succeed this time?
"Come on!"
Radiating blinding light, he flashed a five-colored luminous spiral in his palm so dazzling that others had to look away. When Meng Jingzhou restored his vision, he saw Sect Leader Qiu, holding a five-colored luminous spiral, lightly sweeping it around. The dark vines, as if having been bitten back, lost their vitality, slumped, and died.
"Five-Colored Bright Wheel!"
Ba the Second found himself in a tricky situation. He was proficient in wood attributes and array techniques, but how could he match Qiu Jin'an's accomplishment in the Five Elements technique? This was like chopping off one of his arms.
Qiu Jin'an had become the Sect Leader of the Immortal Sects by relying on absolute power!
"Ba the Second, take this!"
The Five-Colored Bright Wheel rotated rapidly, striking towards Ba the Second, who transformed his two arms into robust tree branches to hold back the wheel, causing sparks to fly.
"Qiu Jin'an, you dared to secretly sneak into our Seek Dao Sect and abduct my apprentice!" The voice of the Third Elder echoed loudly, resembling the roars of a Buddhist Lion, shaking the heavens and the earth, and could be heard clearly on all nine peaks of the Seek Dao Sect.
Upon hearing the Third Elder's voice, numerous disciples looked excited, knowing that there was going to be a show.
"Give me twenty skewers to go!"
"I'll take thirty beef skewers with extra chili, also to go!"
The disciples, holding various snacks, rushed to the medicinal garden.
Lu Yang was in the Five Centers Toward Heaven position, with his two swords, Green Peak and Dark Moon, floating on either side of him like the righteous protectors of divinities, safeguarding their master.
Having exited the closure, his eyes were filled with confusion: "What happened? Has someone invaded the Seek Dao Sect?"
Lu Yang wondered who would be so bold as to cause a ruckus in the Seek Dao Sect. Could it be a drunkard?
"Wait, the fact that someone dares to sneak into the Seek Dao Sect means they have a trump card on hand. Maybe they want to launch an attack from within and outside to break the Sect's defenses all at once!" Lu Yang quickly realized that things were definitely not as simple as they seemed. To make things worse, Eldest Senior Sister was not at the Sect.
"Is this a crisis of Sect extermination?!"
Lu Yang envisioned a scene in his mind: The Seek Dao Sect being breached, disciples being displaced, him leading the few remaining disciples, using fake identities to survive, preserving the last spark of the Seek Dao Sect. Above their cover would be the bombardment of enemy magic skills, and they would be living precariously…
He took hold of the Green Peak Sword and came down from the mountain. Seeing his Senior Brothers and Sisters passing by with their food, he stopped.
"Maybe, I should grab something to eat too."
The Third Elder stood in the high sky with an air of righteousness, looking down at Qiu Jin'an and Ba the Second.
With the arrival of the Third Elder, the other elders in the Sect also flew out one after another – the Fourth Elder, the Seventh Elder, the Eighth Elder…
"What's going on? Why has Qiu Jin'an come?" The Seventh Elder couldn't figure it out. He had been studying pill formulas and was called out by the Third Elder's shout.
"These two have been quarreling since childhood. It's not the first time, so why make a fuss?" The Fourth Elder sneered and said nonchalantly.
"Whom should we help?" The Seventh Elder looked at Ba the Second and Qiu Jin'an, who were fiercely fighting below, caught in a dilemma.
Normally, they should be helping Second Martial Brother to fight the outsider Qiu Jin'an. But seeing as the Second Martial Brother was shamelessly courting Shangguan Yu right now, he deserved a bit of a beating as well.
Kudos to the Third Elder for making the decision.
He said in a solemn voice, "Since we don't know whom to side with, let's just beat up both!"
"Great idea!" The four elders reached an agreement instantaneously. They unleashed their magic power and charged down.
Qiu Jin'an's expression changed. The other party had the advantage of numbers. If he dragged this out, there wouldn't be a good result. It was better to retreat first!
Ba the Second's expression changed too. There was something fishy about the attitude of these four martial nephews. It didn't seem like they were targeting Qiu Jin'an.
At the entrance of the Seek Dao Sect, deep within the bamboo forest, the River Spirit was watching the brightly lit depths of the Seek Dao Sect, wearing a look of anticipation for the spectacle unfolding.

chapters.title: Chapter 399 - 398: Causality Backlash_1
chapters.content:
"Shocking Heaven Six Forms!"
"Stunning Gods with the stroke of a brush!"
"Prairie Fire!"
"Listening Thunder Talisman!"
A tremendous amount of magical energy hovered in the sky, stopping all the disciples who had rushed to watch the battle in their tracks. They all looked up to witness four elders each displaying their marvelous magic skills, and they were in awe.
"The elders have made their move!"
"This is the elders' magic! How powerful!"
"We are still far behind. Even if sometimes I can elevate myself to the peak of Unification, I still can't cast magic of this caliber!" A senior brother from the Refining the Void stage exclaimed with admiration.
Tao Yaoye watched attentively, trying to imprint these moves into her memory.
These were all materials that could be directly used in Dream Mirage.
"No, when using them in Dream Mirage, I should modify them. I can't reveal the elders' secrets to outsiders!" Tao Yaoye became extra careful.
Boom——
The four spells coalesced into one mass, aimed straight at Qiu Jin'an and Uncle Ba.
Qiu Jin'an shattered the Five-Colored Bright Wheel, allowing the Five-Colored Divine Light to break free from its confinement and cover his head to withstand the bombardment.
"Hey, hey, hey, are you aiming at Qiu Jin'an or not!" Uncle Ba, covered in dust and grit, looked as though he had just gone through a Thunder Tribulation.
"Sorry, second senior brother, the magic didn't take aim!" The Seventh Elder apologized vaguely.
Uncle Ba burst into anger. "You're talking nonsense, you're about to burst into laughter!"
The Seventh Elder turned a deaf ear and continued to cast his spells downwards.
Seeing that things were turning for the worst, Qiu Jin'an had the Five-Colored Divine Light explode in the air and took the opportunity to flee.
Seeing that Qiu Jin'an had successfully escaped the battlefield, the River Spirit sighed, still wishing for more action, and retreated back into the river.
"This kid from the Five Elements Sect is okay in every way, but he lacks the will to persevere."
Seeing Qiu Jin'an flee for his life, the Third Elder grimly threatened, "Old Qiu, next time you won't be so..."
The threat got stuck midway, his mouth open but no sound coming out.
He turned his head to see, and sure enough, it was the Sixth Elder.
"Junior sister, could you not interrupt me when I'm speaking next time?"
The Sixth Elder's beauty was breathtaking; whenever she appeared, no one dared to speak.
Seeing the Sixth Elder's frosty face, the Third Elder instantly shut up.
She had just woken up from the Third Elder's loud voice, and she was already out of patience.
The Sixth Elder sent a message to her senior brothers, her tone ill-tempered: "Done making a ruckus? If you're done, I'm going back to sleep."
She felt that her senior brothers didn't have a single peaceful day. Couldn't they learn from Laurel Fairy Palace and behave themselves for a change?
…
Qiu Jin'an rushed back to the Five Elements Sect at full speed. He had escaped from the Seek Dao Sect, but the backlash from the Single Body Curse Fist had yet to be resolved and he needed help to deal with it by requesting for help.
"After dealing with my backlash, I will help the Meng Family's lad to resolve his."
Qiu Jin'an parted the clouds to see a mountain range running from north to south lying in front of him. Here was the Five Elements Mountain Range, the foundation of the Five Elements Sect.
An array of five different colors wrapped around the mountain range, as though many stars were guarding it.
Upon closer inspection, it was not the colorful earth surrounding the mountain range, but the colorful earth pushing against each other. The part pushed out formed the Five Elements Mountain Range.
According to records, the colorful earth originated from five different ancient planets. The Ancient Nameless One refined the stars into the earth, with five different attribute stars forming the continent, colliding together.
…
"Lu Yang, are you here? I need your help!" After the battle, Meng Jingzhou climbed Sky Gate Mountain overnight to seek Lu Yang's aid.
"I'm here."
Lu Yang's voice echoed from behind Meng Jingzhou, his hands holding a dozen barbecued skewers, savoring the delicious flavor, he had just returned to Sky Gate Mountain.
"What just happened? Why did Sect Leader Qiu come over?" Lu Yang kindly shared half of his skewers with Meng Jingzhou.
All from our own production.
Meng Jingzhou sighed, his tone filled with resentment: "Sect Leader Qiu sneaked up on me late at night, asking if I knew the Single Body Curse Fist. When I said yes, he controlled my body and wanted to give Uncle Ba a few punches."
Lu Yang thought of Uncle Ba's sunset romance. A few days ago, when he went to the medicinal garden to eat dirt, Uncle Ba had asked what girls liked most. Fairy Eternity said girls liked to be praised as smart and pretty, so he relayed it verbatim.
"Did Sect Leader Qiu succeed?"
Meng Jingzhou had an expression like he was constipated: "No, he got backlash."
"...my condolences."
Lu Yang thought of the belated arrival of Sixth Elder. The elder and Sect Leader Qiu didn't meet each other, which was probably the effect of backlash.
Lu Yang patted Meng Jingzhou's shoulder, hoping he would take it easy and accept the reality. What does it matter if you sever ties with women and never see them again? Being a single spiritual root, what's there to fear?
Meng Jingzhou raged: "Condolences, my ass! What's wrong with me being a single spiritual root? Even eunuchs can go to brothels, now I can't even qualify for that!"
"Wasn't it said that the backlash will fade after a period of time?" Lu Yang was curious.
"The problem is no one knows how long 'a period of time' actually is! Without Eldest Senior Sister around, I can only rely on her for help."
"Oh, Eldest Senior Sister has gone out on a task and has been gone for several days."
"Where did she go?"
"Do I look like the type who would dare to ask where the Eldest Senior Sister is heading?"
"Good point."
"Wait, is it possible that I can't see Eldest Senior Sister also because of the backlash?"
Upon Lu Yang's consideration, it was indeed a possibility. He asked Fairy Eternity if it was part of the backlash, because causality was elusive and difficult to fathom.
Fairy Eternity looked at Lu Yang as if he were an idiot.
"I am right in front of young Meng. Did you see me get backlash? Although Meng's backlash level isn't low, it's just a pipe dream for it to affect me."
"Then, Fairy, can you help Old Meng crack the backlash?"
Fairy Eternity deliberated for a moment before she came up with a solution: "I never really understood causality, but there is still a way."
"Please tell us, Fairy."
"Young Meng himself can perform the Single Body Curse Fist on himself. As the premise of the effect of the technique is that young Meng could suppress the opponent, who now happens to be himself. In this way, the effect of the Single Body Curse Fist would become chaotic, thus possibly breaking through the backlash!"
Lu Yang: "..."
"Fairy, are you sure that Old Meng wouldn't end up remaining single for his entire life if he punched himself?"
"Oh, come on. Is there anything risk-free in this world? Everything poses some risks."
Lu Yang thought he better not tell Old Meng about the Fairy's solution, as it would only add insult to injury.
"Eldest Senior Sister is not here; should we consult the other Elders?" Counting Seek Dao Sect's members, with Eldest Senior Sister absent and Fairy being unreliable, the most dependable ones left were the Elders.
All are cunning and top-notch Unification stage practitioners, they should have a solution.
"That sounds good." Meng Jingzhou could not come up with any other solutions for the time being.
Lu Yang told Meng Jingzhou to wait on Sky Gate Mountain while he went to invite the Elders.
Once all the Elders were gathered, Meng Jingzhou started practicing some technique, but it went wrong. He screamed in pain and rolled around, eventually disappearing as he tumbled headlong into a ravine.
"This shouldn't be happening. I very clearly told Old Meng to wait here. Where could he have gone?" Lu Yang was baffled. Despite all the Elders kindly helping in the search, none could find Meng Jingzhou.
Suddenly, as if realizing something, Lu Yang focused his gaze on the Sixth Elder.
"Sixth Elder, could you perhaps go back, please?"
Sixth Elder also understood the reason, glanced around with an odd expression, nodded and left.
Once Sixth Elder left, Meng Jingzhou stopped feeling the pain. He climbed out of the ravine, branch stuck in his hair, looking extremely distressed and was finally found by everyone.
Lu Yang sighed quietly. Looking at things, the causality backlash was severe. It seemed that Old Meng wouldn't get to see any woman for quite some time.

chapters.title: Chapter 400 - 399: Elder's Consultation_1
chapters.content:
Sky Gate Mountain, Elder's Council.
Five elders circled Meng Jingzhou, marveling at his situation.
"Martial Nephew Meng has an interesting curse."
"No kidding, I've lived for over two thousand years and this is the first time I've come across such a strange curse, even during my time in Wild State I didn't encounter anything like this."
"This curse isn't really useful to Martial Nephew Meng, anyways, since he's Single Body Spiritual Root, and this curse will automatically dissipate after a period of time."
"Don't worry Little Meng, you were wronged by Qiu Jin'an, I will definitely help you recover from this setback!"
"Good disciple, how are you feeling right now?"
"Witchcraft and curses originate from Wild State, Old Four, you are the only one among us who has been to Wild State and learned about curses, what do you think?"
Four elders, Meng Jingzhou, and Lu Yang all turned their heads to look at the Fourth Elder, who was idly fanning himself with a feather fan."
Lu Yang recalled the information about Wild State.
Wild State is located on the west side of the Central Continent, adjacent to Liang State and Western Buddha Country. The area is prevalent with Witchcraft and Corpse Driving techniques. The people are rough and bold, holding onto ancient traditions. It is also the hometown of the Man Gu.
Fourth Elder showed a troubled expression: "After I was cursed, I did study some curse arts for a while; for example, I can see that only by breaking his Golden Core to reach Nascent and becoming a Nascent Soul could Meng Jingzhou possibly untangle the causality backlash. However, that's purely a possibility.
If even reaching the Nascent Soul stage couldn't untangle it, then he would have to wait until he reaches the Spirit Transformation Stage. The moment he breaks through to the Spirit Transformation Stage, the curse would surely be untangled."
Upon hearing this, Meng Jingzhou turned pale.
If it was only reaching the Nascent Soul stage that would still be manageable, but the Spirit Transformation Stage... How many years would it take him to cultivate to that point?
"I can dispel some simple curses, the ones involving relatively shallow factors. For example, a few of you are cursed on a daily basis, all of which I have dispelled. But the level of curse on Martial Nephew Meng is too high, beyond my cultivation level to dispel."
"If I could reach the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, I would be confident in handling this."
Uncle Ba rolled his eyes: "You reaching the Transcendance Tribulation Stage? Get in line. Is your Cultivation progression faster than elder brother's or Old Nine's?"
Fourth Elder shrugged: "In that case, I have no other solutions. Wait, can we ask Master for help?"
Seventh Elder didn't think it was a good idea: "Although Master is in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, he doesn't know anything about curses. Besides, he's currently suppressing Captive Peak and can't be distracted."
"Disciple, why don't you direct the Single Curse fist sequence at Elder Two again? Maybe two rounds of backlash can cancel each other out?"
Meng Jingzhou shook his head quickly. This was a joke. Was that called a backlash cancellation? It would be a backlash accumulation!
"Actually, Martial Nephew Meng, there's no need to worry too much. Your curse isn't as severe as you think," Fourth Elder comforted him.
"Could the Fourth Elder explain further?"
"The causality backlash affects both you and Qiu Jin'an, so it's divided in half. You bear half, and Qiu Jin'an bears half. Dealing with only half the causality backlash is easier than dealing with the full backlash."
Meng Jingzhou's eyes lit up: "Does that mean Fourth Elder has a solution?"
"Well, not exactly."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
"I have heard that Martial Nephew Li can regenerate his limbs. He uses the method of replacing all parts of the body to evade causality. Can this method be used on Martial Nephew Meng? For instance, can Seventh Elder concoct a medicament for limb regeneration and feed this to my disciple?"
Third Elder was referring to Li Haoran's Regeneration Golden Core.
"The medicament for limb regeneration is indeed easy to concoct. It's simply a matter of begging the Little Medicinal Kings for some root hairs. But the question is, would this method really work?"
Fourth Elder outrightly disapproved of the method: "While Li's Regeneration Golden Core can indeed evade causality, the level of causality backlash in Meng is too high, it wouldn't work."
Uncle Ba suggested another method: "The Heavenly Strategy Sect is proficient in the art of causality. The location of our Seek Dao Sect was determined by the ancestors consulting the Heavenly Strategy Sect. They predicted that we would prosper for 120,000 years. They reasoned this out with such precision, their mastery of causality is unparalleled.
The causality backlash should be within their capacity to handle, shouldn't we try consulting them?"
Eighth Elder shook his head: "As far as I remember, Heavenly Strategy Sect, which originates from the ancient Imperial Shi Clan, is proficient in the art of causality. They can perform divination and fortune-telling, but they believe that causality cannot be eliminated, only transferred from one form to another. Therefore, they rarely interfere with the mortal world.
Excessive intervention in the mundane world leads to causality attaching to themselves, thereby losing their power of divination."
"I have also heard of this. I also heard that the Shi clan did not have a good reputation in ancient times. They often used the power of divination to plot for wealth and harm lives, disturbing the order of the world and seizing the opportunity to break through."
"Later, the Shi clan offended an unknown Great Power, who severely damaged the Shi clan. The Shi clan never recovered after this hit. The Shi clan wished to retaliate, but that Great Power ascended to immortality. Fearful of drawing the attention of this ancient Immortal, the Shi clan commanded a clanwide seclusion, ordering all clansmen to stay away from mundane affairs.
Inflicting mundane causality will attract great terror."
"The Heavenly Strategy Sect inherited the Shi clan after this calamity and became a recluse sect."
"Asking the Heavenly Strategy Sect for help would probably result in changing Martial Nephew Meng's inability to see women to an inability to see men."
"How about casting another curse on Martial Nephew Meng, a curse causing him to be bombarded with romantic troubles every day? Wouldn't the two kinds of curses counteract each other then?"
"It seems like a potential solution, who knows how to cast curses? Old Four, can you?"
Fourth Elder rolled his eyes, thinking that his Brothers were expecting too much from him, "I don't know how. I learnt how to break curses, not how to curse people. If I knew how to cast a romantic troubles curse, I would have cursed myself first."
"Why would a dignified Confucian cultivator like you want to get involved with this romantic troubles curse stuff?"
"To emulate gentlemen of old, maintaining unadulterated thoughts amidst temptation, tempering a gentleman's disposition."
"This is the same excuse given by all gentlemen who go to brothels."
"They're copying me."
"Does anybody know the Descending Head Technique practiced in the vast ocean of the East Sea? It's somewhat similar to a curse, it might be a possible solution."
"Old Eight, you've been to the East Sea, haven't you? Have you learnt it?"
"No, I was being chased by the Sea Clan the entire time, I didn't have the time to learn the Descending Head Technique."
The Elders were having a meeting to discuss the curse on Meng Jingzhou while Lu Yang continued to seek help from the ancient Immortal in his Spiritual Space.
Logically speaking, with an ancient Immortal as his trump card, and that being likely one of the strongest among ancient Immortals, the ancient Immortal should have a solution to any difficulty he encounters.
"Fairy, do you have any other solutions?"
"Yes."
"What is it?"
"As the saying goes, 'when the body dies, the way ends; without life there is no causality.' As long as you die once, causality naturally disappears," Fairy Eternity cheerfully proposed her thoroughly thought-out plan.
Lu Yang felt that given Meng Jingzhou's intelligence, he most likely wouldn't agree with this approach.
Fairy Eternity was dissatisfied with Lu Yang's attitude. She often used this method to avoid causality, and it had been effective every time.
The more Meng Jingzhou listened to the Elders' discussions, the more he felt that their methods were unreliable. It's better for him to help himself: "How about I take a trip to Wild State? Maybe I can find a solution there?"
"That sounds like a feasible solution."

chapters.title: Chapter 401 - 400: Time Immortal Ensures Safety_1
chapters.content:
"It might be best to visit the Wild State, there should be a solution there," the Third Elder nodded, impressed by his disciple's quick thinking.
"I'll accompany you," Lu Yang, who'd been diligently cultivating on Sky Gate Mountain for a while. He felt he needed a change of scenery, worried that he was growing too stagnated.
The Fourth Elder kindly suggested, "If you are going to the Wild State, you could seek help from the Corpse Chasing Sect. They have a good relationship with our Seek Dao Sect. There's a string of friendships between the successive sect leaders, so even if you request to learn their corpse chasing techniques, they won't refuse."
Being a prominent first-grade power in the Wild State, having their help would undoubtedly make things much smoother.
He had received the help from the Corpse Chasing Sect when he was traveling in the Wild State.
The Fourth Elder promptly drafted a letter of recommendation, folded it neatly, put it in an envelope and handed it to Meng Jingzhou.
Having received the envelope, Meng Jingzhou reacted, then froze, "Just Lu Yang and me? Aren't you coming with us, master?"
You were all so enthusiastically finding a solution for me just now, and though none of them were useful, it showed that you were all concerned about me. So how could it be that only Lu Yang and I are supposed to go to the Wild State?
The Third Elder waved his hand dismissively: "No, it would be too embarrassing if word got out."
Taking Meng Jingzhou around the Wild State in search of a curse cure would be no different than taking him around seeking treatment for impotence.
If word got out, how could they ever show their faces in the jianghu again?
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Lu Yang: "..."
Fairy Eternity, on the other hand, was full of confidence about their journey to the Wild State, "What are you two so scared of? With me here, what could possibly go wrong?"
The elder consultation concluded, deciding the patient, Meng Jingzhou, would need to help himself.
Meng Jingzhou sighed deeply and returned to his abode to pack his belongings.
As expected, he didn't encounter his Senior Sisters along the way.
Lu Yang also started packing his things.
"The Witch Undead Insects and the Corpse Chasing are unique to the Wild State, along with ubiquitous graves and a variety of toxic threats."
"We need to redeem some antidote pills from the Task Hall."
"Many people in the Wild State can cast curses. I've never encountered anyone skilled in curse techniques before, we will be at a huge disadvantage if we encounter it for the first time, should we buy some items that can counteract curses?"
"What are you worrying about curses for? I've got you covered!" Fairy Eternity thudded her chest, putting on quite a show of bravado. As the leader of the Five Immortals of the Ancients, there wasn't a curse in the world that could affect her.
Lu Yang glanced at Fairy Eternity. That's true; the world's biggest curse was right here with them. What else did he have to fear?
Removing the possibility of being cursed, their trip to the Wild State would be much easier.
"You've got it good, you've got me, you don't have to worry about curses. Back when I wasn't yet an immortal, I got into battles frequently, competing for a chance at immortality. Those opponents were all known as geniuses, somewhat formidable, having some fame in their tribes and locally. But once they faced me, those 'geniuses' stood no chance!"
"Those guys weren't even worthy of being called geniuses. Once I defeated them, they lost their spirit. Look at Yingtian Immortal and Kirin Immortal, they're constantly getting beaten by me, but they never lose heart."
"When they realised they couldn't beat me outright, they turned to underhanded tactics. They cursed me, placing lethal curses on me."
"Lucky for me, my talent is unparalleled, I survived them all."
Lu Yang remembered then, curses originated from ancient times. Ancient curses were far more vicious and terrifying than they are now. Yet the Fairy managed to withstand them, attaining immortality. It showed how strong she truly was.
He marvelled inwardly. Fairy Eternity truly was remarkable. Though she often joked around, her reputation in ancient times had been earned through genuine struggle and combat.
"The worst were some of the Saint girls from the holy lands. They were not as strong as me, yet envious of my beauty. They feared that the men they liked would fall for me, so they cursed me, wishing for my face to be wrecked."
Fairy Eternity huffed and pouted.
It was clear that even after all the years that had passed, she was still unhappy about their behavior.
"Though I was quite famous before I reached immortalhood, with superior cultivation, beauty and wisdom, I had no backing. I was often excluded, even openly mocked for my brillance, said no matter how strong I was, I would never become an immortal without a background."
"They bullied me because I had no background? Then I became my own backing!" Fairy Eternity laughed triumphantly. She had been annoyed back then, but now she found her opponents only childish.
"You're really something, Fairy."
"I know, right?"
Lu Yang quickly packed his things, made sure he brought everything he could think of, and then went to the Task Hall to redeem many things they might need.
"We definitely need to buy antidotes, and these herbs can be made into antidotes at crucial moments."
Lu Yang had studied basic knowledge about poisons on Elixir Cauldron Peak, which was a compulsory course for Seek Dao Sect's disciples. So, the common poisons had no effect on him.
When you are out in the world, harbor no ill-will towards others, but always be on guard. This is the motto of the Five Elements Sect.
Later, Daoist Buyu and the eight Elders felt that Qiu Jin'an's words were reasonable, so they took this motto to teach their disciples, letting the disciples guard against others.
"Let's also grab some books about the Wild State, such as 'People and Culture of Wild State', 'Legends of Corpse Chasing' and 'Crisis of Witch Insects'..."
"We might encounter battles, so we need to buy talismans for battles, Soul Returning Pills... That should cover everything."
After buying all the items, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou met up at the entrance of the sect.
Meng Jingzhou had arrived earlier and was already waiting in the carriage.
"You took too long."
"No need to rush, it's not like going early will get us back sooner."
Lu Yang climbed into the carriage, and the two checked their belongings to ensure nothing was left behind before setting off.
On the way, Fairy Eternity, bored, commented, "It would be nice if we could find the Time Immortal. His Firmament Tree embodiment can bless people. Picking a leaf or snapping a branch could potentially resolve the causality backlash trouble of junior Meng."
"The Firmament Tree has this use? Why have I never heard of it?" Lu Yang was puzzled. However, given how sparse ancient books are on the description of Firmament Trees, it was understandable there were things he didn't know.
"You know about the New Year, right? It's a day where the old shifts to the new, a day to shake off bad luck and gain good luck for the coming year. That's what New Year is. This concept of celebrating New Year was created by him."
"During the New Year, isn't there a tradition of stepping over branches? Essentially, what we should be stepping over are Firmament Tree branches. The only reason we use ordinary branches is that people in later generations couldn't find the Firmament Tree branches."
"Come to think of it, at first, I didn't know that the Firmament Tree had the ability to bless others. It was Kirin Immortal and the others who told me."
"Kirin Immortal and the others said that the Time Immortal could potentially predict when I would invite them for a meal, or when I would drop by their abodes. Such information would allow them to prepare beforehand, which they considered a huge blessing."
Lu Yang nodded, fully agreeing with Kirin Immortal and the others, "The Time Immortal does indeed have the ability to bestow blessings."

chapters.title: Chapter 402 - 401 Black Shop_1
chapters.content:
The carriage trudged along slowly on the official road. The road had not been maintained for many years, and it had grown bumpy and uneven. However, Old horse made light work of the uneven road, moving so smoothly that the two passengers in the carriage felt not the slightest bit of bumpiness.
"We are in Wild State now." Lu Yang unfolded the map. On the map was a shiny mark representing their location, which was a magic artifact that could roughly show where they were. It was an essential artifact for travel.
"It's getting dark. Let's look for a place to rest nearby." Meng Jingzhou didn't see the need to hurry along the road now that it was nearing nightfall and they were in the Wild State.
"Hey, look, there's an inn here. We can stay there!" Meng Jingzhou spotted an inn not far off. The signboard was hanging precariously, and the name of the inn was hardly visible. The quality of the inn seemed questionable.
Lu Yang looked at the inn suspiciously. It was eerie, as if a gust of wind could easily blow it down.
"We'll have to make do. It's better than spending the night in the carriage," Lu Yang comforted himself.
Two men and a horse arrived at the entrance of the inn. The doors were wide open, revealing utter darkness within. There was no one in sight, and the place appeared to have been abandoned for a long time.
Only then did the two men make out the name of the inn—Qingming Inn.
"That's not a very auspicious name, huh. Is this place out of business or still operating?" Muttered Meng Jingzhou before stepping in and bellowing, "Is anyone there? We'd like to stay the night!"
There was no response.
Meng Jingzhou shouted again: "Anyone there? We want to stay the night!"
There came a thump from the counter, as though a body had just fallen onto the ground. The sound was dreadfully muffled.
"Who's that making a racket? Don't you understand the basic manners of staying at an inn?" A man wearing a white paper hat grumbled as he crawled out from behind the counter, glaring at Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
"We'd like to stay the night. Give us two of the best rooms!" Meng Jingzhou had a rule of only staying in the best places wherever he went.
"Both of you are here to stay?" The man in the paper hat looked at them incredulously, stretching his neck to look behind them and finding no one following them.
"Get lost, stop causing trouble. This is not a place for you. Go find somewhere else to stay," The man in the paper hat shooed them away impatiently.
Meng Jingzhou was stumped. He had stayed in many inns before, but this was the first time he had been refused accommodation.
"Your inn is fully booked?"
"We still have half of the rooms vacant."
"Then why won't you let us stay?"
The man in the white paper hat, noting that the two men genuinely didn't understand the situation, was about to explain, but then there was a commotion upstairs.
Thump——Thump——Thump——
There was a rhythmic, unvarying pattern of footsteps from upstairs that was enough to make one's heart race.
A cultivator in a daoist robe descended from the second floor, followed by a group of individuals shrouded in black cloth. Silent and eerie, they appeared particularly frightful in the pitch black of the night.
The mere number of people covered in black cloth made Lu Yang and the others doubt if there were adequate rooms upstairs to accommodate so many people, especially since the man in the white paper hat had mentioned they still had a handful of vacant rooms.
Could it be that more than a dozen people were staying in the same room?
How would they fit? Were they supposed to sleep while leaning against the wall?
"Buddy, I'm checking out. This is the worst Qingming Inn I've ever stayed in." The cultivator in the daoist robe tossed a string of copper coins to the man with the paper hat. The coins were an unfamiliar design to the two of them. There was also faint fluctuation of magical power coming from the coins as if they had a special purpose.
The man with the paper hat chuckled and did not respond; he was more than content as long as he got paid.
Lu Yang was puzzled. It was already nightfall, so why would they check out at this hour?
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were taken aback when they got a clear view of the people enveloped in black cloth.
The eyes of the people wrapped in black cloth were dull, and some of them had mud and grass in their mouths and noses. Some of them were disfigured, as if struck by something. Some others looked withered and old, reduced to skin and bones.
"Drowned, cause of death blunt force, natural death... These are all corpses!"
"Corpse-driving technique?!"
No wonder they checked out as soon as it got dark. Rest during the day and drive corpses at night, just as the books had described.
The two of them didn't expect to encounter the famed corpse-driving technique as soon as they entered the Wild State.
After the man in the paper hat pocketed the copper coins, he glanced at them: "This is an inn for corpses, offering lodging for corpse-drivers. The rooms are all for the dead. If you don't mind, you can stay here."
The two of them twitched at the corners of their eyes. Staying in a room meant for the dead was somewhat disconcerting.
"That man just now, was he able to use the corpse-driving technique? Is he from the Corpse Chasing Sect?" Lu Yang asked. If he was from the Corpse Chasing Sect, they could have a chat with him.
The man in the white paper hat shook his head: "You two are not locals, are you? I always wondered why Qingming Inn became a chain brand in the Wild State, why did the living come to know about our inn and stay here."
"We are from Yunzhou."
The man in the paper hat seemed to understand: "Ah, the big central state. No wonder. I've heard that you even have Seek Dao Sect, one of the Five Great Immortal Sects. Due to this, Yunzhou is also incredibly prosperous, with well-developed transportation, thriving economy, and countless powerful figures."
He corrected them: "Not only the Corpse Chasing Sect, but many freelance cultivators in the countryside are also able to use the corpse-driving technique. It's just that they aren't as solemn as the Corpse Chasing Sect. In our Wild State, no matter if they are freelance corpse-drivers or disciples of the Corpse Chasing Sect, they are all collectively referred to as corpse-drivers.
Their transactions also aren't done in Spirit Stones but in the form of Big Copper Magic Coins."
The man in the paper hat waved a string of copper coins in his hand: "Like this."
After thanking the man in the paper hat, they decided to find another inn.
As they left Qingming Inn, Lu Yang noticed a sign lying face down at the inn's entrance. Wanting to help, he picked it up for them.
On the sign were the words: Due to a change in business strategy, this branch has moved 20 miles east of Baiquan Town. We apologize for any inconveniences caused.
The date of the notice was five years ago.
"What?!"
They both snapped their heads up, staring at Qingming Inn in shock, as a chill crept up their spines.
The real Qingming Inn had relocated, so who did they just see?
They rushed back into the compound, but it was empty. The man in the white paper hat was nowhere to be seen.
"Was that man a human or a ghost?"
They were horrified. From start to finish, they hadn't sensed anything unusual about the man with the paper hat. Even when facing Meng Jingzhou, who had a pure Yang body, the man in the white paper hat had no reaction at all. How high could his cultivation level be? Was he the King of Ghosts?
"Go!"
On a decisive command, a group of cultivators dressed as constables emerged from all directions, rushing into the inn.
"Damn it, he got away!"
The man leading the group had a thick, bushy beard all over his face. He was displeased at not finding the man with the paper hat inside the inn.
"Sir, may I ask what's going on?" Lu Yang asked politely.
Seeing that Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had just exited from the inn, the bearded constable knew they weren't suspicious subjects. He explained,
"This Qingming Inn has been abandoned for five years, but during these years, there have been people who claimed to have stayed here. They thought it was haunted and reported to us. After our secret investigations and matching testimonies, we finally knew what was going on."
"A man wearing a white paper hat was pretending to be the innkeeper and acting as if this place was still in operation, letting corpse-drivers in and earning money through this."
"As the corpses don't mind where they stay and can withstand rough conditions, the corpse-drivers tolerated this for a while. However, one of them couldn't stand the unbearable condition of the Qingming Inn anymore and lodged a complaint with the headquarters of Qingming Inn. The headquarters were taken aback as this branch had already closed down. That was when they discovered the case."
"When we figured out the truth, we decided to lay low and wait for the man in the paper hat to appear. But unfortunately, he managed to escape!"
Lu Yang: "..."
Even this kind of thing is possible in the Wild State to make money?

chapters.title: Chapter 403 - 402: The man with the white paper hat _1
chapters.content:
"Are you two from out of town?" The bearded constable noticed Lu Yang was unfamiliar with Wild State and kindly inquired.
"Be careful if you encounter someone wearing a white paper hat in the future. This bastard commits crimes everywhere; he's cunning as hell!"
"How so?" The two were puzzled.
The bearded constable angrily said: "We've been after this grandchild wearing a white paper hat for a long time now and have yet to catch him. We don't know where he came from, but he has been active in Wild State for several years."
"Pick any place in Wild State, and he's committed crimes there. This time, he impersonated the owner of Qingming Inn. Last time, he incited his accomplices to steal, and then captured them for the reward when they were wanted. What's even more hateful is that none of us noticed that it was him collecting the reward!"
"The time before last, he pretended to be a dead body, sold himself to a corpse-driver, and when the corpse-driver was about to process him, he realized the corpse was moving. He almost scared the corpse-driver sick."
"Even after the man with the white paper hat had left, the corpse-driver was still in shock as he thought he'd encountered a reanimated corpse. He recited protective charms for several days before he finally realized he'd been deceived!"
"There was also a time when a Barbarian tribe reported that someone was smuggling at the edge of the wasteland. It was him too!"
"That jerk will do anything for money! If we could catch him, we could reduce our annual working days by five!"
The bearded constable got angrier as he spoke of the man in the white paper hat. If the perpetrator was standing in front of him right now, the constable would have swallowed him alive.
Catching the man in the white paper hat is not only his wish but the collective wish of all of Wild State.
"There's something else unusual about him, though. Several times, he seemed to appear in two places at the same time. It was as if there were two of him. We don't know if he has a twin or what."
"And this time, we surrounded the inn, and you were at the entrance. Did anyone notice him leaving?"
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou nodded. With their cultivation levels, they were able to sense the movements of ordinary cultivators. Even a habitual thief could not escape their detection.
The fact that the man in the white paper hat could escape under such circumstances suggested he had exceptional means or a cultivation level beyond everyone's expectations.
"Fairy Eternity, did you notice when the man in the white paper hat fled?"
Fairy Eternity rolled her eyes, feeling that Lu Yang had underestimated her.
"He ran westward. But don't expect the constables to catch him. Even if you two join, it would be a waste of your efforts. His escape technique is unusual."
"Even if you do catch him, it would merely be a clone. Nothing important."
Lu Yang was taken aback. If Fairy Eternity could make this kind of judgment, it meant that the man in the white paper hat was even more difficult to deal with than he thought.
The bearded constable directed his fellow constables to seal off the scene, hoping to find some clues.
"Don't forget to put up the seal!" he shouted.
"Big Brother, does putting up the seal really help? He always tears it off," a cautious, bearded underling asked.
Given the blatant disregard the man in the white paper hat showed towards authority, putting up a seal wouldn't stop him from tearing it down and resuming business.
The bearded constable gave him a stern look: "Just put it up when I say so. If he tears the seal, it will only increase the severity of his crimes!"
"We must take our leave now." Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou said goodbye to the bearded constable.
Before leaving, Lu Yang kindly suggested: "I sensed when the man in the white paper hat fled. He headed west."
The bearded constable looked at Lu Yang in surprise but did not say anything.
"The people and land of the Wild State are extraordinary. Perhaps we really could find a way to break my curse here." Meng Jingzhou sighed, feeling that he should get out more often. Just after entering Wild State, they had encountered such strange things.
"After all this commotion, we still haven't found a place to stay." Lu Yang reminded Meng Jingzhou to focus on the matter at hand.
Meng Jingzhou patted the back of his horse, "Old horse, can you find us a village to rest in?"
The old horse swished its tail, took a bite of the fresh grass by the roadside, and dutifully headed toward the nearest village.
In a short while, the old horse brought the two of them to the nearest village. There was a large stone at the entrance of the village inscribed with the words "Firmstone Village".
"Why is it so quiet?"
They descended from the cart, intending to seek lodging for the night, and noticed that every household in the village had their doors closed, with their oil lamps lit, but silent. Naturally, there wasn't a single person on the village road.
In Lu Yang's memory, in the absence of any entertainment, people from the village should have their doors open at this time, chatting with their neighbors.
"It's like they're scared of something. Strange." Lu Yang furrowed his brows.
Meng Jingzhou picked the house with the largest yard and knocked on the door: "Fellow villagers, we'd like to lodge for the night."
Bang—Creak—
Two sounds echoed as an old man opened the door, revealing only half of his face, warily watching Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
"Who are you?"
Meng Jingzhou gave a down-to-earth smile he had practiced running his barbecue shop: "We are travelers passing through, and night has fallen. We were hoping to lodge for the night if possible. Of course, we are willing to pay."
The old man impatiently waved them away: "Go away, Firmstone Village doesn't welcome outsiders. You should leave now, or you might get eaten by corpses!"
"Eaten by corpses? Are there corpses here? We are cultivators. We can help you get rid of them."
Upon hearing this, the old man grumbled even more: "We don't need your help, just go away!"
Immediately after saying this, the old man slammed the door shut.
"Hey, this old man is unreasonable!" Meng Jingzhou felt the old man was neurotic. He offered to solve the problem out of kindness, only to be driven away.
"Or is it because they have women in the house, and you're not allowed in?" Lu Yang teased with a naughty smile.
"Get lost." Meng Jingzhou waved Lu Yang away like swatting a fly.
Undeterred, Meng Jingzhou knocked on several other doors, but the responses were either to chase them away or not to answer the door at all.
"Nobody seems hospitable at all." Meng Jingzhou grumbled.
"So, what now? On to another village?"
Meng Jingzhou did not want to move again: "Too much trouble. I noticed a place by the village gate earlier, I'm not sure if it's a temple or an ancestral hall, but it was quite clean. It might still be in use. We can make do there for the night."
"Fine by me." Lu Yang didn't wish to travel back and forth either. They had just been refused by the Qingming Inn and now were also rejected in Firmstone Village. Who knows if the next village would refuse them too?
Rather than taking all this trouble, they thought it would be better to huddle down somewhere for the night and investigate the reason in the daytime.
They arrived at the ancestral hall, lit the oil lamps with the Three Flavored True Fire, and instantly brightened the place.
"It's rather clean."
They respectively bowed to the ancestral tablets: "Apologies to the ancestors, but we'll be staying here for the night."
At the tail-end of the village, the graveyard.
Stones wobbled, the ground of the graveyard slackened, as if something below was stirring.
A withered claw sprouted from the soil.
Then, like bamboo shoots sprouting after the rain, numerous dried claws broke through the earth, too many to count...

chapters.title: Chapter 404 - 404: 403
chapters.content:
Ancestral Hall.
"It seems like the villagers come to the Ancestral Hall quite frequently, look at the amount of food in front of the spirit positions,"
Meng Jingzhou was somewhat surprised. The Ancestral Hall was clean and shiny, with food like steamed buns and pickled vegetables placed in front of the spirit positions, simple but genuine.
"Indeed, this food is still hot."
Lu Yang noticed the warmth of the steamed buns as if they had just been freshly steamed.
"Looking at this makes me hungry, let's eat something."
Meng Jingzhou took out the prepared food from his Identity Jade. This was the food he bought from the market street, consuming it can greatly improve cultivation levels.
Such is the beauty of being a Spirit Chef.
Upon seeing this food, Lu Yang was reminded of the Immortal Cook living in his spiritual space. Eating the meals she prepared would be even more beneficial to his cultivation level.
Thinking of this, Lu Yang felt a heavy mood.
Lu Yang generated a thread of Three Flavored True Fire with a flick of his hand, he didn't need things like twigs. Just this sliver of spiritual essence would keep the True Fire burning for quite some time.
Both of them placed the food on top of the Three Flavored True Fire to grill it. The already delicious food became even more enticing.
"Speaking of Eldest Senior Sister being absent, can't we just use your Lu's Imitation Fist to summon her?" Meng Jingzhou had a sudden inspiration. Thinking of the most convenient solution, the Eldest Senior Sister would not be affected by causality backlash.
Lu Yang gave Meng Jingzhou a glare, it's easy for you to come up with such ideas when you are not the one summoning the Eldest Senior Sister.
"When I summoned Eldest Sister last time, we were in a life-or-death situation. What you're going through is just a trivial causality backlash, if we were to summon Eldest Sister and she found out about this, do you think she will solve your causality backlash first or deal with you first?"
The thought of the Eldest Senior Sister being summoned by Lu Yang, and then coldly focusing on him like he was a dead man after finding out the details of the situation, sent chills down Meng Jingzhou's spine.
"In that case, let's forget about it. We should solve the causality backlash ourselves."
Lu Yang proceeded to explain: "Moreover, Eldest Sister is constantly busy. What she has to do is far more important. What if I disturb her and cause a misstep or delay in her tasks?"
This was also why Lu Yang would not simply summon the Eldest Senior Sister. While it's true that difficulties could be solved by asking for her help, doing so would not help train and improve him, and since Eldest Sister's cultivation level is high and her tasks are quite important, she should not be disrupted casually.
Unless faced with life-or-death difficulties, Lu Yang would not ask the Eldest Sister for help.
"It's a shame that the Grand Elder is not around. With his experience, he might have been able to offer an alternative solution."
Although Meng Jingzhou was not sure where the Grand Elder went, he could guess that he probably went to build a cemetery.
Given the Grand Elder's frequent creation of cemeteries, and the way he filled them with zombies, Meng Jingzhou found it hard to believe there was no business transaction going on between the Grand Elder and Corpse Chasing Sect.
The Grand Elder, with his high cultivation level and rich experience, might know how to deal with this situation, or could tell them who to look for in Wild State.
"You know, Wild State has had a corpse-chasing tradition since ancient times. A hundred thousand years ago, when the Great Yu Empire collapsed into chaos, people from all over took up arms to rebel against the Empire. Massacres happened everywhere, blood flowed like rivers, corpses were everywhere. Many of the bodies turned into zombies, which led to a large number of corpse-drivers.
A group of them banded together to form a sect, which is now the Corpse Chasing Sect," Meng Jingzhou said, pointing at a passage in "The Culture of Wild State".
"That makes the tradition quite old then," Lu Yang exclaimed. A hundred thousand years ago was indeed a very long time ago to him. Seek Dao Sect was one of the oldest sects, and its history was only over a hundred and twenty thousand years old.
"The tradition of corpse chasing is older than you imagine it to be," Fairy Eternity chimed in at the right moment.
"So corpse-chasing has existed since ancient times?"
Fairy Eternity smacked her lips and recalled the intense times: "Sort of. But back then, everyone's methods of driving bodies were unique, and the magic skills used to manipulate bodies didn't have a collective name like they do now, being called 'corpse chasing'."
"Remember that idiot who speaks spells? He was formidable, and with his mere voice, he could drive bodies. Whenever he encountered a powerful enemy, he would hide in a cemetery and shout. The corpses in the cemetery would come out in succession, quite terrifying really, he was one of the most formidable opponents I have ever encountered."
Anyone referred to as an idiot by Fairy Eternity must really have been an idiot.
Lu Yang remembered this idiot. He could speak spells, which made him extremely difficult to deal with. He had a notorious reputation in ancient times and was one of the most likely to ascend to immortality. There were even legends about him in later generations. And yet, he was ambushed by Fairy Eternity, who caused him to scream "I'm dying!", after which he actually died.
"And then there's that one who cultivated the Harem Golden Core. By sheer coincidence, he nurtured a beautiful female zombie, who, after much intimacy, developed feelings and was promoted to the level of a Drought Demon. It was as if she had truly been resurrected, becoming one of his harem."
Lu Yang also had an impression of this person who cultivated the Harem Golden Core. He had numerous beautiful women in his harem, and with their collective assistance, he cultivated using the Love-making Technique and rapidly progressed in his cultivation. But he failed to manage the relationships within his harem ended up being dismembered by his concubines.
Honestly, disregarding the final outcome, this experience of a genius who cultivated a Harem Golden Core was quite enviable.
"Fairy, do you control corpses?"
"Indeed, I used the top-notch corpse-chasing technique!"
"You can?" Lu Yang was surprised, but looked excited. The Fairy was indeed impressive, knowing all kinds of magic skill, and the top-most ones at that.
It must be even higher level than Corpse Chasing Sect's corpse chasing.
"Do you want to learn the playing dead technique?"
"I want to...Wait, the playing dead technique?" Lu Yang reacted instantly.
"Yes, didn't I first play dead and then come back to life? Isn't that the top-notch corpse-chasing technique?"
Lu Yang fell silent. For the dead to come back to life is indeed the top-level corpse chasing technique, but he felt that something was off.
Lu Yang remembered something and asked: "Besides your playing dead technique, are there any other corpse-chasing techniques that can revive the dead?"
"Not sure."
"Not sure?"
"In theory, yes, but I have yet to come across a corpse-chasing technique that can compare to my playing dead technique."
"We five discussed this topic while eating. A top-notch corpse-chasing technique should be able to revive the dead, but if the original soul is gone and a new soul is formed in the old body, can it really be called resurrection?"
Lu Yang thought to himself that the discussion must have probably been due to Ying Tian and the rest worrying that they might suddenly die after eating her food.
"Wait, something is approaching!" Lu Yang stopped discussing and exited from the spiritual space.
He sensed something nearby drawing closer. Judging from the noise it made, there were quite a lot of them!
Almost at the same moment, Meng Jingzhou reacted too and got ready to face the incoming threats.
Boom—
The door of the Ancestral Hall was pushed open from the outside. In front of them was a group of desiccated bodies; at a glance, there were nearly a hundred!
Both of them expanded their spiritual senses and found that the group of desiccated bodies had surrounded the Ancestral Hall making it impossible to escape!
"Why are there living corpses everywhere in Wild State?"

chapters.title: Chapter 405 - 404 The people of Wild State have a very advanced concept _1
chapters.content:
While sleeping overnight, they encountered two groups of living corpses.
These living corpses held farm tools such as shovels and rakes, apparently stolen from the villagers. These tools transformed into weapons at this moment, making them extremely dangerous.
"True or not, this is certainly Wild State. You can't encounter this kind of situation anywhere else. Truly an eye-opener." Lu Yang joked with a smile at the corner of his mouth. He took out his Green Peak Sword and looked relaxed. The sword's glow shone brilliantly under the candlelight.
Although there was a large number of living corpses possessing weapons and surrounding the Ancestral Hall, the two of them, as esteemed figures of the Golden Core Stage, could establish minor influential families and establish sects, surely wouldn't be trapped by such rural living corpses.
"No wonder the villagers didn't let us stay. They were afraid of danger, weren't they? They even spoke of being eaten by corpses. Did they mean this situation?"
Despite the villagers' unfriendly attitude towards him, Meng Jingzhou wasn't vengeful. Helping the village deal with trouble was no big deal.
"Look, there are women among the corpses!" Lu Yang pointed to one particular female corpse with disheveled hair and called out in surprise.
Meng Jingzhou was confused, "Isn't it normal for corpses to be both male and female? Who distinguishes corpses by gender?"
"What I mean is, aren't you currently unable to see women due to the backlash of Causality? Now you can face a female corpse, which means your Causality backlash only targets living human beings. Corpse, Demon Race, and so on, are not included. If you can't solve the problem in Wild State, you can stay in the Demon Territory for a while, until you reach the Spirit Transformation Stage."
"Forget it. I don't believe that Eldest Senior Sister will never come!" Meng Jingzhou angrily replied, stepping forward to meet the living corpses.
"Exploding Punch!" Meng Jingzhou clenched his fists and aimed them at the living corpse.
Bang——
The living corpse was blown to pieces. The living corpses rushing into the Ancestral Hall were hit by this punch, opening a pathway.
"Huh, their bodies are so hard," Meng Jingzhou praised. He had assumed that these corpses were just common wild corpses with fragile bodies that could easily be blown apart by the exploding punch.
"Fairy, are these living corpses infectious?" Initially, Lu Yang wanted to stop Meng Jingzhou, confirming if there was any danger before taking action. However, it seemed a bit late now.
"What do you mean by infectious?" Fairy Eternity was puzzled by Lu Yang's question.
"Like, if a living person is bitten, they also turn into a living corpse."
Fairy Eternity looked at Lu Yang as if he's an idiot, not understanding why he would think this way, "Of course not. On the contrary, I have never heard of such a thing. Why would you think that?"
"Just a thought."
Assured that there would be no infection, Lu Yang finally felt relieved to enter the fray.
After starting the fight, Lu Yang also discovered that these living corpses were surprisingly hard, definitely cultivated by a master
"And you guys thought you could eat us? Dream on!" The two laughed, tossing all the living corpses out of the Ancestral Hall.
In the eyes of the living corpses, they had surrounded Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, but in the eyes of these two, they were the ones that had surrounded the corpses.
"None of you can escape. Today, we two brothers will eradicate you for the people!"
Just as the two were about to unleash a deadly attack to clear these living corpses, they heard an old voice calling out from a distance.
"Both of you, please show mercy. They mean no harm!"
The person who came was the old man who had initially refused to let them stay.
"The talk about them eating humans was just to scare you. They actually wanted to eat the offerings in the Ancestral Hall, and that just so happened to coincide with your visit!"
On hearing this, both of them were dumbfounded, and upon thinking about it, it did seem that the living corpses had no intentions of attacking them from the beginning.
The two decided to tentatively cease their attacks, only to find out that the living corpses indeed didn't attack them, instead, they bypassed the two and headed into the Ancestral Hall.
After all the living corpses had entered the Ancestral Hall, the two approached the old man to ask about what happened.
The old man sighed and said, "I'm the village head of Firmstone Village. The matter about the living corpses may be hard for you to believe, so let's just watch for now."
They saw the living corpses pouring into the Ancestral Hall, circling around the steaming hot buns. In no time, the buns turned ice-cold and lost all their heat, at which point the living corpses ceased their actions.
When they left the Ancestral Hall, they saw the living corpses holding shovels, rakes, and plows, marching out of Firmstone Village in neat and ordered step.
The three of them followed the living corpses, who didn't go too far before stopping in the fields with their tools in hand, ready to till the land.
Some of them were diving into the river with poles, tirelessly watering the fields.
Others who didn't have tools squatted on the ground, pulling out weeds and removing pests.
The living corpses had a clear division of labor and seemed as diligent as old farmers.
After completing their tasks, the living corpses took their tools and walked from the fields to the entrance of the village, from the entrance of the village to the burial ground at the end, dug pits with their tools, and buried themselves.
Lu Yang: "..."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Both of them painfully rubbed their temples, feeling as if they were hallucinating.
"Do all of you in Wild State use living corpses for farming?"
This was far more advanced than any other states. Even their Seek Dao Sect couldn't compare.
In their Seek Dao Sect, it was the Green-eyed Buffalos and Third Elder who did the farming.
The Village Chief of Firmstone Village explained helplessly, "It's not what you think. We're just ordinary people. How could we afford to keep so many living corpses?"
"Actually, we don't know where this group of living corpses came from either. One day, on a casual night, as we were sitting under a tree at the entrance of the village, we saw these living corpses approaching. Initially, we were all very scared and thought the living corpses were going to attack us."
"But after interacting with them, we found that they had no intention of harming us. It's probably because they ran out of energy and stopped moving in our village."
"Although our village doesn't have a corpse-driver, I followed one when I was young and learned a bit from him. So I tried steaming buns to feed these living corpses."
"This method really works. The living corpses started moving again. That was when someone suggested if we could let the living corpses till the fields. I thought it was a good idea, so I drove these living corpses to work, asking them to cultivate."
"And so, we rest during the day and steam a pot of buns in the evening, placing them in the Ancestral Hall. When it gets dark, the living corpses come out from the graveyard, absorb the Yang Qi from the buns, and start farming. Since everyone is still afraid of living corpses, all the families close their doors at night."
"After they finish farming, the living corpses automatically bury themselves, and the cycle repeats the next night."
"Bizarre, but ever since the living corpses took over our farming duties, life has become much easier, and we get to spare time for other things."
"Why did you refuse to let us stay then?"
The Village Chief confessed honestly, "We were afraid that you would discover these ownerless living corpses and report them to the government office. If they found the owner, wouldn't we be back to farming ourselves?"
"We initially wanted to scare you away. But who would have thought that not only did you not leave, you even stayed at the Ancestral Hall. Seeing how things would unravel regardless, instead of having you injured by the living corpses, I figure it's better that I explain."

chapters.title: Chapter 406 - 405: Unusual Living Corpse_1
chapters.content:
After hearing the village chief's story, the two men had a eureka moment: "No wonder these living corpses are so hardy, unlike any ordinary person could refine. So they were lost."
"Are lost living corpses a common occurrence?"
The village chief shook his head: "How could it be? I've lived eighty years and this is the first time I've seen ownerless living corpses. I've only heard people mention it before."
"May I ask, what are the reasons for a living corpse to become ownerless?"
"I've heard people say there are only two reasons. Either the owner is dead, so the living corpse loses control and wanders aimlessly day after day, or the owner willingly releases control of the living corpse. Otherwise, it is because the living corpses revolt and eat their owner."
"Judging from the living corpses in our village, they're not bloodthirsty and don't seem to fit the third scenario."
"Is there a way to find the master of the living corpses?"
Upon hearing Lu Yang ask this, the village chief showed a conflicted expression on his face, his eyebrows furrowed deeply, then he sighed.
"There is."
"Each corpse-driver leaves a unique imprint on the living corpses they control to claim ownership. The living corpses in our village all have the same imprint on their right wrists, like this."
The village chief squatted on the ground and drew three interlocking circles with his finger. In the center of the circles, he wrote the character for "ghost".
"If the owner of the living corpses is still alive, they would have the same pattern on their right wrist."
"Although I only reached the peak of the second layer of Qi Refinement and my cultivation level is limited, in my youth, I studied under a brilliant corpse-driver master. My master reached the peak of the sixth layer of Qi Refinement!"
"During my time learning from my master, I learned to recognize the patterns of corpse-drivers in surrounding counties, none of them had this style. As for corpse-drivers from other places, I have never seen."
This was also one of the reasons why the village chief didn't report the incident. The living corpses were not left by any local corpse-drivers, so even if he reported it to the government office, they wouldn't be able to find the owner of the living corpses.
"Elder, have you heard of the Corpse Chasing Sect?"
The village chief laughed. "How can I not know about the Corpse Chasing Sect? Thirty years ago, I was fortunate enough to get a distant glimpse of a disciple from the Corpse Chasing Sect. He was truly a distinguished young talent, far beyond someone like me who struggles even to understand the basics of corpse-driving."
"Do you know the location of the Corpse Chasing Sect?"
"That's quite far."
The chief pointed west. "The Corpse Chasing Sect is located at the very center of our Wild State. From here if you keep going west, it's about eighty million miles."
Meng Jingzhou nodded. "It seems we still have a few more days of travel."
Having the old horse made the eighty million miles not seem very far. He remembered when he first left home, traveling from the Imperial City to the Seek Dao Sect, the journey was not much more than eighty million miles, and only took a few days.
Whether they traveled fast or slow depended on the mood of the old horse.
At first, Meng Jingzhou thought they were traveling fast because the carriage had a spatial array method that could freely traverse space and shorten the distance. He later found out that while the carriage was indeed a treasure, the real reason they traveled so fast was due to the old horse.
"Now that we know about the existence of these living corpses, could you allow us brothers to stay overnight?"
"Alright, since my wife has passed away and our children have moved to live in the county, hosting you two would only require adding two more quilts."
The two rested and adjusted in Firmstone Village for one night. The next day, they bid farewell to the village chief and set off on their journey.
"You two were quite lucky last night." Fairy Eternity stretched lazily, contorting her body to stretch her muscles and bones.
Although the concept of muscles and bones doesn't apply to a spirit form, old habits still persist even after death.
"Lucky?"
"Yeah, the group of living corpses you encountered last night were carefully refined by a great cultivator. They're just unattended, and combined with their lack of Yang Qi, they don't have much energy to move. They can only maintain basic activities daily through large buns, otherwise, you two wouldn't have been able to beat them."
"If I'm not mistaken, the group of living corpses acting together could be a match for one at the Unification stage."
"Unification stage!" Lu Yang was astonished. He knew that the living corpses they encountered last night were formidable, but he didn't expect them to be able to compete with those at the Unification stage.
Even if Lu Yang didn't understand the art of refining living corpses, he knew that refining living corpses of this level must be done by a cultivator at the Unification stage.
These living corpses were a battle tool of a Unification stage corpse-driver. How could they be left behind carelessly?
Did a corpse-driver at the Unification stage die?
The thought of this sent chills down Lu Yang's spine.
Nowadays, people rarely fight fiercely to the death. Unification stage cultivators rarely kill each other openly. Let alone, Unification stage cultivators are incredibly strong with many methods to protect their lives.
Unless there was a huge gap in strength, like between his master Daoist Buyu, the Grand Elder, Qiu Jin'an and an average Unification stage cultivator, it would be very difficult for a Unification stage cultivator to kill another one at the same stage.
Meng Jingzhou saw Lu Yang's changing expression and couldn't help but ask curiously: "What's wrong?"
"You should still remember that I have Fairy Eternity within me."
Meng Jingzhou was there watching when Fairy Eternity resurrected.
Meng Jingzhou blinked his eyes, clapped his hands, and showed a newly-awakened-expression.
"Ah~ I remember now, you have an ancient immortal within you. What did the immortal say?"
"...Wait a minute, let's put aside what the immortal said for now. Why do you look as if you just remembered it?"
"You can't blame me for this."
Meng Jingzhou scratched his head in embarrassment and started counting on his fingers.
"In my imagination, a person with an ancient immortal within them should be constantly blessed with extraordinary luck, armed with ancient incomplete magic artifacts as weapons, possess a variety of astonishing secrets, familiar with many kinds of cultivation methods, unbeatable amongst their peers, often making stunning remarks, having insights beyond their level, being embraced by beautiful women, and when they go to secret realms, it's like going home and so on."
"From what I've observed, you don't really fit these characteristics. The only one that fits is being unbeatable amongst your peers, but this doesn't really stand out much within our Seek Dao Sect."
"Oh right, you do know about the ancient secrets that can only bluff the Nine Nether Cult."
Lu Yang: "..."
Yes, I also want to know the reason.
"What did the immortal say?"
"She said that the group of living corpses we encountered last night match up to the Unification stage in combat power."
Meng Jingzhou's pupils constrict slightly, clearly having the same worry as Lu Yang.
How could living corpses of this level randomly appear outside?
Something must have happened that people don't know about!
"Let's find a big city and ask around, see if there have been any battles, or if a cultivator in the Unification stage has fallen. Surely, something of this level won't occur without leaving any traces."
Lu Yang nodded, he had the same thoughts.
"By the way, since you have an ancient immortal within you, can you help me ask her if she knows a way to solve my backlash of causality?" Meng Jingzhou looked expectantly at Lu Yang. Yes, without the help of Eldest Senior Sister, there is still the help of an ancient immortal.
Ancient immortals with celestial abilities should be able to solve a small backlash of causality easily, right?
"I've asked."
"What did she say?"
"She told you to go die."
"?"

chapters.title: Chapter 407 - 406: Meng Jingzhou's Immortal Tribulation_1
chapters.content:
Spiritual Space.
With his mortal body, Lu Yang was helping Meng Jingzhou resist the tribulations of an Immortal, which was incredibly moving and virtuous.
"Watch how I set straight this boy from the Meng Family, who seems not to care if I exist or not!" Fairy Eternity was like a bristling little yellow cat, baring her claws and teeth, ready to cause trouble for Meng Jingzhou.
"Fairy, Fairy, Old Meng is just an ordinary mortal, speaking without thinking. There's no need for you to lose your temper over him." Lu Yang was desperately holding onto Fairy Eternity's arm, not daring to let her rush out.
Fairy Eternity angrily asked, "You tell me, have I not been kind to him, considering his methods for his sake? Isn't that a great act on my part? How dare he malign me like this?"
"Fairy, you're a magnanimous person, Old Meng is young and doesn't know better. Please let it go this time."
Fairy Eternity angrily sat back down, her small feet swinging back and forth.
"Tell me, which of the characteristics mentioned by the Meng boy does not match with me?"
"Old Meng said that those who have an ancient immortal in them would have continual fortuitous encounters?"
"Didn't I help you to become the Acting Sect Master, controlling the vast Seek Dao Sect, even Miss Yun has to listen to your orders! You even welcomed the Five Elements Sect!"
What about using incomplete ancient magical artifacts as weapons?"
"Isn't your Dark Moon Sword that? A flying sword of Immortal, personally refined by Yingtian Immortal with great care. The Qilin Immortal treasures it and used it with utmost caution, yet it was ultimately broken by the girls from the Dragon and Phoenix clans."
"What about possessing various shocking secrets?"
"Ancient secrets, aren't all the stories I've told you secrets? Can you hear them from other places?"
Lu Yang pondered for a moment and found it to be true. If the stories told by the fairy were made public, the image that Yingtian Immortal painstakingly maintained would be ruined overnight. That could indeed be called a shocking secret.
"There is also being familiar with many ways of cultivation?"
"Haven't I been demonstrating daily how to cultivate by sleeping? Plus, there's the ancient Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth method, which can accelerate your cultivation speed."
"Unrivalled amongst his peers?"
When mentioned this, Fairy Eternity looked even more proud, she suddenly stood up on the bed, looking down at Lu Yang from above.
"Have you forgotten about the Invincible Elixir I taught you? It makes you unrivalled at the same level, undefeated in every battle? Only I could have taught you that, not Yingtian Immortal, or Qilin Immortal, or anyone else!"
"Also, when you were the Acting Sect Master, you had only Foundation Establishment Stage cultivation level, but managed to defeat Golden Core, Nascent Soul, and Spirit Transformation Realm masters. Could you have done that without my help?"
"So, regularly making astonishing remarks, possessing knowledge that is not expected at this level?"
Fairy Eternity ended excitedly, moving from standing on the bed to sitting on it, her grievances towards Meng Jingzhou long vanished.
"At such a young age, you know so many secrets of the immortals, and the ancient world, you're well-read even when compared to those at the Unification Stage, does that not count?"
"And being thrown into the arms of beautiful women?"
Fairy Eternity showed an unusual expression of difficulty, and hissed.
"It may be a bit difficult with throngs of beauties, but you are surrounded by a lot of pretty girls, like Miss Yun, your junior sister Tao Yaoye, that girl from Laurel Fairy Palace, what's her name? Oh, right, it's Lan-ting."
"... but all the girls you mentioned, I've known since before you were resurrected."
"How about me giving you a hug?"
Looking at Fairy Eternity's exquisite face, one of the top ten beauties from the ancient times, Lu Yang coldly refused.
He was not sturdy enough to withstand Fairy Eternity, the source of the curse.
"And familiar with the secret realms as if returning home?"
"This one is a bit tricky. The secret realms I know of, I estimate they are all gone now ... wait, you've been to the Immortal Secret Realm, my kitchen is even there!"
Lu Yang: "......"
Old Meng was right about everything. I don't feel like someone who has an ancient immortal within me. That I survived until now is purely due to my tough life.
When my master was young, he would say there's an ancient fierce beast sealed within him. That sounds more plausible than my situation.
After calming down the flustered Fairy Eternity, Lu Yang finally left the Spiritual Space.
"Remember, you owe me a life."
"?"
Meng Jingzhou had never taken Lu Yang's quirks to heart, not today, not ever.
"Old horse, take us to the nearest city. We need to gather information." Meng Jingzhou patted the old horse.
The old horse walked at a leisurely pace, seemingly aware of where the city was located.
Along the secluded mountain path, suddenly a heavy rain began to pour down without warning, as if intended to wash the whole world clean.
Boom——
A large noise came from above, as if something extremely heavy was tumbling down.
The two lifted the curtain of the carriage and looked up. Behind the curtain of rain, the mountain began to shake violently, and dirt and rocks scattered in every direction. It was as if a ferocious beast was raging in the tumult, rushing madly down the mountain. Countless trees, washed down by the mudslides, slumped and rolled down the mountain together.
"It's a mudslide!"
Boom——
The earth and stones rushed down like an army of the dead, charging toward the two in the carriage.
Fortunately, the old horse was powerful in cultivation, and the carriage was a magic artifact. This natural disaster of the mortal world did not pose a threat to the carriage.
After the mudslide, the two checked the situation.
"The path is blocked on both sides."
Meng Jingzhou frowned slightly, the carriage was fine, but the paths in front and behind were blocked by mud and rocks, so they couldn't go anywhere.
