If the old horse utilized his powers, they could leave.
Looking at the old horse's leisurely demeanor, it seemed like an ordinary horse, not at all intending to make a move.
Feeling somewhat helpless, Meng Jingzhou could also understand; the old horse was there to protect his safety, not to be his servant and do everything for him.
If he did everything, how could Meng Jingzhou gain experience?
"Let's clear the obstacles."
Both of them got out of the carriage and wrapped themselves with spiritual essence, ensuring their bodies and clothes weren't wet from the rain.
They both used their powers to clear the debris.
"Exploding Punch!"
Meng Jingzhou used the Exploding Punch again. The Exploding Punch doesn't have a lot of power, but its impact is great and suitable for dealing with cultivators weaker than himself.
Boom——
The mud and stones in front slightly trembled. Seeing this, Meng Jingzhou mustered up his strength and consecutively launched the Exploding Punch, opening up a path through the debris with his fists.
Lu Yang was not to be outdone either, he activated a spell, his eyes concentrating, and opened his mouth slightly.
"Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth!"
With a sudden inhalation from Lu Yang, the mud and stones behind him were drawn in by a massive force and swallowed entirely by him!
Meng Jingzhou was astounded, thinking how powerful this technique was. So much mud and rocks were gone in an instant!
Truly a unique skill of the Taotie clan, being able to devour anything!
"Want to learn?" Lu Yang grinned mischievously. Meng Jingzhou instinctively felt there was a catch.
Just as they were about to converse, they heard another loud rumble from above.
Meng Jingzhou was furious: "Here comes another mudslide, are they never going to end!?"
Lu Yang looked at Meng Jingzhou in silence, as if understanding the reason, and considered himself to be a curse to Meng.
"We are supposed to go to a city, there will definitely be women in the city. You have Causality backlash on you. Under the influence of Causality, you definitely can't get to the city. I am simply being implicated by you."
"Then what do we do?" Lu Yang's explanation gave Meng Jingzhou an understanding of the situation.
"You stay here, I'll go by myself."

chapters.title: Chapter 408 - 407: Information on the Wild State_1
chapters.content:
After leaving Meng Jingzhou, indeed, my luck improved substantially.
On the way to a nearby city, Lu Yang bravely fought off mountain bandits, rescuing two young ladies from wealthy families. After bidding farewell to the grateful ladies, he refused the offer to marry into their family with grand gestures of righteousness, and then, he departed gracefully.
Subsequently, he assisted during a robbery attempt - the transporter's daughter was deeply touched. This was her first time in charge of a transport and she felt mortified by the incident. If not for Lu Yang's timely aid, the operation would have failed, severely tarnishing their business reputation. Impressed by Lu Yang's abilities, she invited him to join their business as the chief protector.
As expected, Lu Yang refused.
Lastly, Lu Yang witnessed a young maiden setting up a tournament ring in the tradition of martial trials for a spouse. She declared that whoever defeated her would be her husband.
Upon witnessing this, Lu Yang picked up his pace and quickly left.
"I have long heard that the women of Wild State are valiant and often wander freely. Today, I have finally witnessed it."
The people of Wild State are bold, and the women there are no different. Unlike the common women in the Central Plains who stay within their boudoirs, the women of Wild State are akin to men in their actions.
Meng Jingzhou had always been with him before, so Lu Yang did not have a chance to see this.
"What a pity. Old Meng has missed out on this scene." Lu Yang felt a sense of schadenfreude on behalf of Meng Jingzhou.
"But it's true that the law and order in Wild State is bad. There aren't this many bandits and hijackers in other places."
After passing the beautiful landscape, Lu Yang successfully arrived at a nearby city. The city was built entirely from massive bricks and stones, rugged and unrestrained, similar to the style of the Demon Suppressing Pass, yet unique in its own ways.
"Far Mountain City."
Lu Yang looked up, softly reciting the name of the city, before striding through the city gate.
The Land Money Trade Association deals in selling information. The quickest way to understand local conditions is to buy a report from them.
However, the association does not dare to sell certain pieces of intel - like those of the Five Great Immortal Sects. Especially information related to the Seek Dao Sect is never sold.
Yun Zhi's victory over her peers during the Grand Contest of the Five Great Immortal Sects, as well as her defeat of the various Sect Leaders, is information not for sale by the association.
Lu Yang discovered that very few people knew about Eldest Senior Sister. Unless one had a special informant, they were unaware even of Yun Zhi's name; those who knew of her existence simply considered her a disciple of the Seek Dao Sect. There was nothing exceptional about her that would catch other people's attention.
Lu Yang guessed it was due to Eldest Senior Sister rarely taking action and the Association's reluctance to sell related information.
As for information about the other four Immortal Sects, the Association would sell some in varying amounts.
For example, the number of people in Suspension Temple reached a new high, exceeding twelve people in total.
Also, in order to comprehend the essence of Buddhist teachings, the Abbot of the Suspension Temple began practicing Silent Zen. Now, he only resorts to violence and not words.
The Association selectively sells government-related information.
For instance, information about Daoist Buyu and the Minister of Justice being locked in the same prison cell, and that all offices in the Ministry of Punishments had been temporarily relocated, was not sold by the Association.
When Lu Yang arrived at the Association, he bought the most detailed report on Wild State. The first piece of intel shocked him.
"The governor's daughter of Wild State is holding a birthday banquet. The governor has sent out invitations, inviting all forces to send representatives to present their blessings and gifts. At the banquet, all aspiring young talents of the different forces vie for a smile from the governor's daughter, showcasing their talents to the best of their abilities.
Presently, the governor of Wild State is suspected of corruption, all forces are suspected of bribery, arrests have been made."
The Association thoughtfully added relevant legal provisions and cases to serve as a warning.
"The newly-appointed governor of Wild State gave a speech entitled 'Rectifying the Unhealthy Tendencies in Wild State', calling on all officials in Wild State to study it."
"The Barbarian Tribe's coming-of-age ceremony was held as scheduled. The young tribesman, Man Gu, survived seven days in the wilderness and hunted nearly a hundred Golden Core Stage Demon Beasts, taking the championship."
"Turns out, this young fellow Man Gu was partaking in the Barbarian Tribe's coming-of-age ritual when he said he was going home to visit family." Lu Yang suddenly realized – for a while, he hadn't seen Man Gu and had been wondering why it was taking him so long to visit his family.
He had heard of the Barbarian Tribe's coming-of-age ceremony, where those about to come of age are thrown into the most dangerous wilderness. Surviving seven days there is seen as passing the coming-of-age ceremony. If they manage to hunt Demon Beasts in the wilderness, they receive higher levels of appraisal.
The rankings of the ceremony are determined by the quantity and quality of the Demon Beasts hunted.
"So, the Barbarian Tribe still carries on with this tradition." Fairy Eternity was slightly surprised. This was a tradition she had left for the Ancient Barbarian Tribe when she took them under her wing. She hadn't expected it to still exist.
"The big contest of the Corpse Chasing Sect ended. The winner, Huang Ming, just turned eighteen and is at the early Golden Core Stage of cultivation. He has been accepted by the Sect Leader of the Corpse Chasing Sect as his sole disciple. The second-place Zhao Po also just turned eighteen and is at the early stage of Golden Core."
Lu Yang lingered over this piece of information for a few more seconds. Being at the initial stage of Golden Core at just eighteen, this was indeed an extraordinary talent. Even within the Five Great Immortal Sects, such rapid cultivation was rare, second only to him and Meng Jingzhou.
"Two geniuses; the Great Era is nearing." Lu Yang sighed. Both of them would qualify as stepping stones for Fairy Eternity's rise in the primeval grand era.
"Seven Emotions Valley has developed a new type of curse. Whoever is cursed with it will hear the buzzing of mosquitoes in their ears whenever they sleep or retreat for cultivation. Covering their ears will not help, making the cursed individual prone to irritation."
"Seven Emotions Valley, I remember it's one of the First-Class Sects in Wild State, proficient in curses." Lu Yang murmured. He didn't know much about Seven Emotions Valley.
"A man in a white hat (real name unknown, true identity unknown), the price on his head is one million Spirit Stones. The man split into two and pretended to have captured himself. Receiving the reward, he left unquestioned. Now, the official reward of Wild State has been increased to two million Spirit Stones."
"The new up-and-comer in the barbecue industry, 'Grill It Again', has now set up shop in Wild State. Currently, they own thirty branches in Wild State and business is booming. According to the store, they love barbecuing and want to spread the flavor of barbecue throughout all of Wild State, planning to open more stores."
"Corpse-driver's Home, Clear Bright Chain of Inns... Why are there advertisements?" Lu Yang was slightly annoyed. He paid money for buying information, so why were there advertisements mixed in with the intel?
In fact, 'Grill It Again' was also an advertisement, but since Lu Yang profited sixty percent from it, he didn't mind.
"Why aren't there any reports of Unification Stage battles?"
Lu Yang wasn't dazzled by the diverse information of Wild State; he still remembered the reason why he bought the intel - to look for clues regarding the Living Corpse group from Firmstone Village.
"Oh, I found it. There really was a record of Unification Stage figures clashing, which happened two months ago."
"Let's see what happened... Two Unification True Monarchs ended their relationship and were applying for divorce, fighting over the custody of their child."
Lu Yang: "..."
Lu Yang rubbed his temples in agony, wondering if the idea of the Living Corpse horde getting lost and straying was possible.

chapters.title: Chapter 409 - 408: Quick Pass Through Classic Plot_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang felt that the Wild State truly lived up to its name. Just the fierce customs alone would have him, a foreigner, learn for a while.
"It seems that even the Land Money Trade Association does not have any information about Unification-stage combats."
The Fairy said that the Yang Qi stored by the Living Corpse could sustain activity for up to two months, so Lu Yang collected all the information about what happened in the Wild State over the past two months. Apart from couples arguing, there was no more information about Unification-stage combats.
"Did it happen in secret and even the information network of the Trade Association failed to discover it? Or did this group of Living Corpses lose their way?"
If he hadn't seen the information about the Wild State, Lu Yang would have suspected the former, but now that he had read the information, he suspected the latter.
"Whatever, let's just deal with Old Meng's problem for now."
"From the information, the Seven Emotions Valley specializes in Cursing Techniques. Why not go to Seven Emotions Valley?"
"Do you know where Seven Emotions Valley is?" Lu Yang asked the people of the Trade Association.
Lu Yang had just splurged on the most detailed information. Naturally, the Trade Association was willing to give him a piece of information for free. Besides, this could hardly be considered information. With a certain Cultivation Level, everyone knew the location of the Seven Emotions Valley.
The Trade Association directly gave Lu Yang a map and marked the location of Seven Emotions Valley on it.
As he left the Trade Association, Lu Yang heard a scream.
He followed the sound and found a young tyrant forcibly abducting a local woman on the street. Several bootlickers cheered, and the young tyrant seemed to have considerable power locally. The onlooking crowd dared to be angry but didn't dare to speak out. The young tyrant laughed wildly, with the woman crying bitterly.
"Not over yet?"
Lu Yang sighed. He felt that his luck in love affairs was absurdly prosperous.
No, could it be that because he had saved Meng Jingzhou from the Fairy, he had gathered immense merit, and this luck in love affairs was a reward?
No matter what, he had to deal with the matter at hand first.
"Stop."
Lu Yang said softly. His voice was not loud, but very conspicuous in this context, so everyone heard it.
He didn't care about the surprised gazes of the passers-by and quickly approached the young tyrant, helping the woman up.
"You've got guts, are you from outside? Do you know who I am...?"
Before the young tyrant could finish, Lu Yang didn't blink, just slapped him directly.
The young tyrant was around the same age as Lu Yang and had a strong cultivation level, with the Qi Refinement Consummation realm.
Seeing their master getting slapped, the bootlickers took out various weapons and rushed up, but Lu Yang, annoyed, casually waved his hand which caused a gust of wind that blew all of the bootlickers away.
These bootlickers had strong cultivations, with Foundation Establishment Stage cultivations.
The onlookers were shocked that Lu Yang dared to strike the young tyrant.
"I've never seen this person before, is he from outside?"
"He must be from outside. Who dares to provoke the Gu family in Far Mountain City, especially when the other party is the young master of the Gu family!"
"Although he vented some anger for us, this man will probably have a hard time leaving Far Mountain City."
"Even servants with Foundation Establishment Stage cultivations are easily defeated. Who exactly is this young hero?"
"Golden Core Stage! It must be Golden Core Stage!"
The woman looked at Lu Yang with affection, "My savior."
The woman was beautiful and could be described as a beauty. Lu Yang noticed the color of admiration in her eyes and wondered if her next sentence would be that she had no way to repay him except to give herself.
"The Gu family is great and rich, commanding Far Mountain City. Although your cultivation level is unparalleled, you will still face danger when dealing with the Gu family. You should run as fast as you can."
"Haha, want to run? You dare to hit my son, and you still expect to leave Far Mountain City!"
A furious laughter came. Most of Far Mountain City could hear it. A middle-aged cultivator, brimming with anger, arrived, glaring at Lu Yang with a gnashing of teeth.
"You...!"
Lu Yang didn't give him a chance to say a second sentence, casually firing a Sword Light and pinning the newcomer to the wall.
After hitting him, Lu Yang turned around and asked, "Is this the patriarch of the Gu family?"
The woman nodded rigidly. She didn't expect Lu Yang to be so decisive and powerful, subduing the late-stage Golden Core patriarch of the Gu family with one move.
"The patriarch of the Gu family is indeed scary, but his father is even scarier..."
Before the woman could finish, a second roar came from afar.
"How dare you bully my son and grandson...!"
Following the Invincible Elixir's prompt, Lu Yang took out the Green Peak Sword and cast the 'Beheading' technique. The man barely got his words out when Lu Yang nailed him to the wall next to the Gu family patriarch.
Nascent Soul Initial Stage, it was enough to make Lu Yang use his sword.
"Does the Gu family have anyone else?" Lu Yang continued to ask.
The woman was stunned for a long time before she came to her senses and continued to nod rigidly, "Yes, the Gu family has an Elder at the Divinity Transformation Stage."
Looking at Lu Yang's unchanging expression, the woman couldn't help but raise Lu Yang's cultivation level a few more notches in her heart.
While the woman was stunned, the patriarch of the Gu family secretly contacted his ancestor and asked him to take action.
"Young man, you've got guts, you dare to bully my Gu family. Even if my Gu family is at fault, it should be for me to discipline, there's no need for..."
Lu Yang didn't say a word and took out the Identity Jade hanging from his waist.
"There's no need for the friend to make a move, Gu will thank the friend for teaching these unworthy descendants on behalf of me!"
The ancestor of the Gu family saw the jade and abruptly stopped, coming down from the sky, thanking Lu Yang with a fist and a bow.
Indeed, Lu Yang couldn't beat the Divinity Transformation Elder, but did he really need to fight? In front of the colossal Seek Dao Sect, a Divinity Transformation Elder was nothing.
No need for an Elder to make a move, a random Senior Brother or Senior Sister could help Lu Yang regain face.
The reputation of the Five Great Immortal Sects was enough to make these minor influential family cultivators revere them.
Lu Yang wasn't afraid to fight with the young or meet with the old.
"Did you all hear what the ancestor of Gu family said just now, 'Seek Dao Sect', the legendary Seek Dao Sect?"
"It's the Seek Dao Sect from the storytelling in 'Legend of the Dao Sect'!"
"The top of the Five Great Immortal Sects!"
The passersby gasped with surprise, expressing their exclamation. They didn't think that Lu Yang had such an extraordinary origin.
The woman was also extremely shocked looking at Lu Yang, her affection deepened.
"Gratitude is unnecessary. Please make sure to manage your offspring properly. Be careful that your offspring do not bring you catastrophic trouble. Don't you know that we of the Seek Dao Sect are worried that the tasks posted in the Task Hall won't be enough?" Lu Yang said loudly. Not only for the Gu family ancestor to hear, but the surrounding people as well.
The ancestor of the Gu family could not miss the implied meaning in Lu Yang's words and was even sweating coldly.
He smiled and said, "I will. I will. Thank you for your reminder. After this, I will keep a close watch on my descendants. If this happens again, even skinning and bone scraping punishment will be in order!"
The woman thanked Lu Yang with a bow, "In order to repay you, I could... "
"...repay you in the next life by being your cattle and horse." Lu Yang promptly interrupted her.
Under the scrutiny of the crowd, he left Far Mountain City and returned the way he came.
"I hope I don't encounter this kind of thing on the way back."
He felt that along this way, he didn't get much useful information, but a lot had happened.
"May the Immortality bless... No, it's unreliable to have the Immortality bless. It's better for me to count on my own luck."

chapters.title: Chapter 410 - 409: When Three Walk Together, Each Has Ulterior Motives_1
chapters.content:
Perhaps because Lu Yang's luck in love affairs had finally been exhausted, he didn't encounter any wealthy daughters being intercepted or knight-errant women being robbed during their journey, let alone any martial arts recruitment for a spouse.
Recruitment for marriage by martial arts was the most problematic. The only option was to avoid them. If Lu Yang were to participate, he would not willing to lose his Invincible Elixir if he lost, but winning would unknowingly land him with an unknown wife.
No matter how one considered it, it was not worth it.
"Huh, it's clear weather?"
Lu Yang, on his way back to his carriage, saw the clear sky in the mountainous area. The rain had finally stopped.
"It's probably because Old Meng has given up on going to the city."
Lu Yang saw four figures in the distance, which was right on his path back.
He approached quickly, seeing clearly that these four figures were not four people, but three cultivators and a living corpse.
The arguing voices travelled with the wind, reaching Lu Yang's ears.
"We've tried to pass here several times, and each time we were intercepted by unexpected incidents. This is a warning! There is great horror ahead, we can't go any closer!" A handsome cultivator was arguing passionately, restraining his companions from advancing further.
"Brother Ye, these are just coincidences; in such a big world, coincidences are also possible. I've never heard of such a form of warning before?" Another, with bronze skin and short hair, appeared casual. He turned his head to ask the third companion.
"Brother Zhao, you've travelled around and seen a lot. Have you encountered such situations before?"
Brother Zhao, who was called, had a fair complexion, even whiter than ordinary people, and seemed to be unhealthy.
Brother Zhao furrowed his eyebrows, seemingly recalling something about the matter, but couldn't remember it no matter how hard he tried.
Lu Yang silently circumvented the three men and continued to move forward.
"Hey hey hey, you can't pass through there, Brother!" the youth with short hair called out to Lu Yang.
"Can't pass through?"
"There seems to be something sneaky ahead, we've encountered accidents time and again that stop us from advancing."
The handsome youth continued, "Brother Wenren is right. For example, I was just about to move forward when a mistake occurred in the operation of my martial arts. I had to meditate on the spot for almost an hour to adjust."
"After functioning normally, we ran into a lost elderly man and took him home."
"When we returned here, we found we had left something at the old man's house and had to run back to get it."
"When we came back once again, several giant rocks rolled down from a distance and blocked our way. Only when we three moved the boulders out of the way did we realize something was wrong. There seemed to be an invisible force blocking the way."
Brother Zhao suddenly seemed to realize something: "I remember now."
"You remember what?" the other two asked eagerly.
"I heard my elders say this kind of situation happens when a Great Power wants to have a debate or battle in a particular location, they would set up an Array Method to drive people away in advance. Others then can't continue to approach and can only bypass the place. However, this situation is rare since it's troublesome to restore the original appearance after battling in the mountains.
It's more common to battle on plain fields or in the sky."
"There should be experts battling ahead. Didn't we also see just now? There are dark clouds and thunderstorms ahead, which means some experts are using the power of heaven and earth to battle!" Brother Zhao spoke more seriously, feeling that his analysis was logical.
The handsome youth and the short-haired youth knew of Brother Zhao's extraordinary background and nodded in agreement with his analysis.
"It's better to avoid the battles of Great Powers. Since we can't pass through the mountains, we have to detour."
Lu Yang stared at the three men for a while, then suddenly asked, "Which one of you three is disguised as a man?"
Upon hearing this, the handsome youth, known as Brother Ye, showed a fluctuating expression. He was forced to yield under Lu Yang's determined gaze, "How did you find out?"
"Ye Brother, you...?" The other two looked at the handsome youth in surprise.
Brother Ye, or rather Miss Ye as she should be called now, laughed bitterly. She removed a jade pendant from around her neck, smoothed her Adam's apple, and her originally handsome appearance transformed into a charming one. Her big, watery eyes were revealed, her hair lengthened to waist-length, and her chest turned plump.
Seeing Brother Ye transform from male to female, the other two companions were even more shocked.
The three of them haven't known each other very long, having met each other when they were wandering in the martial arts world. They felt that they needed support when venturing into the world, and since they got along well, they travelled together.
Who would have thought that after going through so much together, Brother Ye turned out to be a woman?!
"No wonder Brother Ye, you never took a bath with us and always asked for separate accommodation when we stayed at the inn. You blushed when we told dirty jokes and asked us to stop!"
"Wait, so the woman I saw bathing in the lake that night... was also you!"
Brother Wenren made connections to certain incidents. During a camping night in the wild, he had gone by the lakeside. Under the moonlight, he saw a woman with a graceful figure bathing in the lake, like a fairy in the water. Unfortunately, due to certain circumstances, he hadn't been able to see the fairy's face clearly.
When he mentioned this incident to his companions the next day, Brother Ye had laughed and said he was half-asleep and had mistaken something else for a fairy.
"I lied, I am actually from the Ye family in Liang State." Miss Ye said ashamedly. She had disguised herself as a man, traveled from Liang State to Wild State, and made friends with these two companions.
The Ye family of Liang State is a well-known influential family there, having produced both high-ranking officials and Great Cultivators in the past.
"This is a jade pendant that I begged from my mother. She said that she had travelled around disguised as a man before. She met my father in this disguise, and no one had ever seen through it thanks to this pendant. I can't understand how this Brother saw through it today."
Lu Yang responded with a smile, too embarrassed to admit that it was actually Meng Jingzhou who had identified the disguise.
His smile, to Miss Ye, appeared as a mysterious one.
Miss Ye sighed internally, acknowledging how unfathomable the people in the martial arts world are. One could just bump into a passerby on the road who could see through their disguise.
Since her identity had been exposed, Miss Ye stopped worrying about it and turned to face Brother Wenren, her eyes full of affection.
"Brother Wenren, I like you. Do you remember when we came across a Tribulation Cultivator, and you took a hit for me and saved me from him? From then on, I fell in love with you!"
Brother Wenren was somewhat at a loss as his good friend Brother Ye suddenly confessed love for him.
Fortunately, he quickly regained his composure, heaved a sigh, and took off his thumb ring.
His body changed, his arms became slender, his short hair lengthened to shoulder length, and his chest inflated, becoming full and round.
Only his skin tone remained the same, still a healthy bronze color.
"I'm sorry, I'm also disguised as a man."
"Do you remember after I blocked that hit for you, I refused your offer to treat my wound, and asked to be left alone to recover? This is the reason."
Miss Ye: "..."
Heartbreak comes fast.
Lu Yang, Miss Ye, and Miss Wenren all turned their heads to look at the sickly-looking Brother Zhao at the same time, clearly saying, "Your turn."
Brother Zhao was suddenly furious: "I'm a man!"
So, out of the three of them travelling together, he was the only honest one!

chapters.title: Chapter 411 - 410: Are you Lu Yang, who dares to even hit the judges?_1
chapters.content:
Brother Zhao is an experienced Jianghu wanderer, and it is the first time for Miss Ye and Miss Wenren to venture out into the Jianghu. However, he had been adventuring for two or three years, and he was rich in experience.
During the journey, with his abundant experience, he had taken the role of the elder brother among the three.
But he could never have imagined that among the three brothers, he turned out to be the only male!
How can he face the world after this revelation?
Lu Yang gently patted Brother Zhao's shoulder to comfort him.
Yet, Zhao didn't feel comforted at all.
His living corpse was much better, it would never deceive him.
Miss Ye's eyes reddened as she reluctantly looked at everyone, "I left home with the consent of my family, but they required me to keep my identity as a female a secret. Once it was revealed, I would have to return immediately."
Originally, even if her identity was exposed, she thought that it was worth it if it meant confessing her feelings to Brother Wenren. If Brother Wenren accepted her confession, she could make Brother Wenren a member of the Ye family, and they could live a life of wealth.
But now, it seems that she had thought too optimistically.
Not only did she reveal her identity, making it mandatory for her to return home according to her family's rules, but her confession also ended in failure, as it was flatly rejected.
Her cheeks burned red. Even if her family did not ask her to go home, she would be too embarrassed to stay here.
Miss Wenren of the Wenren family also showed a similar expression, struggling to bid farewell to everyone, her tone low: "I am a member of the Wenren influential family of Liang State. The situation is similar to Miss Ye. My elders said that my ring is a high-quality spirit treasure, and it can't possibly be detected unless I reveal my identity.
Now that I have revealed my identity, I don't have any other choice but to return home."
When Lu Yang said, "Which one of you three dressed as a man," her face also changed greatly. She thought Lu Yang had seen through her disguise. She was about to take off her ring, remove her disguise, and confess to Brother Ye when Ye confessed first.
The result was more or less the same.
The Wenren influential family of Liang State, Lu Yang had heard a little bit about this family. The Wenren family was a clan that evolved from the barbarian tribe, changed their surname from Man to Wenren, and moved to Liang State.
If a person goes to the western regions, they would find many people there with bronze-colored skin.
When considered, Miss Wenren just might have some connection to Man Gu.
"You're a member of the Wenren family?"
Miss Ye was surprised. As both were influential families from Liang State, she naturally had heard of the Wenren family.
"Yes, my name is Wenren Hui."
"Should we go home together? It will be nice to have some company."
"Sure."
"Do you want me to escort you two?" Despite being deceived, Brother Zhao, as the leader, still showed his magnanimity.
"No, no." The two women quickly declined. They had deceived him all the way, they were both too embarrassed to trouble Brother Zhao any further.
After bidding farewell to the two women, only Lu Yang and Brother Zhao were left, along with a reactionless living corpse.
"By the way, I didn't get a chance to introduce myself earlier. My name is Lu Yang, from the Seek Dao Sect." Lu Yang, having recovered from the shock of the two women's disguises, remembered that he has not introduced himself yet.
Brother Zhao's eyes widened in disbelief. He never expected that the other party had such a significant background. No wonder he could see through the disguises of the two women that he himself could not see through: "You're from the Seek Dao Sect?!"
"Wait, Lu Yang? The one who showed his prowess at the Qingzhou ceremony, defeated all the contestants, winning first place, even beating the judges!"
Brother Zhao was taken aback. Among the young generation of the cultivation world, who hasn't heard of Lu Yang's name? People from the Five Great Immortal Sects were always in the public eye. Additionally, Lu Yang's audacious act of contesting against Golden Core Stage cultivators during Foundation Establishment Stage and beating up the judges made it hard for him not to be noticed.
Lu Yang had been cultivating non-stop recently, and had not left the Seek Dao Sect. Otherwise, he would have discovered earlier that the outside world had been discussing him and Meng Jingzhou.
"Wait a moment, what do you mean by 'I even dared to hit the judges'…Well, it's not exactly wrong."
Why did the news of him challenging a genius of the same Immortal Sect turn into him beating up the judges?
Who started this rumor? It's made-up so ingeniously!
"Brother Lu might not have heard of me. I am Zhao Po of the Corpse Chasing Sect."
Zhao Po said humbly, although he was quite outstanding among the younger generation, when compared with Lu Yang, he fell a bit short.
"I have just heard about you, as the runner-up of the Corpse Chasing Sect."
Lu Yang recalled the seemingly useless information he bought from the Commerce Association: The grand comparison of the Corpse Chasing Sect had ended. The winner was named Huang Ming, just turned 18, at the early stage of Golden Core cultivation level, who was accepted as the direct disciple of the Sect Leader of Corpse Chasing Sect.
The runner-up was named Zhao Po, also 18, with Golden Core early-stage cultivation level.
"It's the runner-up of the grand comparison of the sect." Zhao Po corrected Lu Yang's words.
"It's more or less the same. Let's go, my friend, Meng Jingzhou, is ahead. You must have heard of him." Lu Yang smiled. He had not expected to meet someone from the Corpse Chasing Sect here, which would save him a lot of trouble.
Zhao Po's eyes lit up. He also did not expect that the stranger he ran into on the roadside turned out to be the current talk of the town, Lu Yang, and behind him was another hot topic, Meng Jingzhou.
Although as soon as Lu Yang appeared, his small crew disassembled instantly.
"Isn't there a duel among the great powers, can we go over there?"
"What duel, it's Old Meng who is cursed. All women will stay away from him, that's why you couldn't move forward!" Lu Yang laughed bitterly from the irony.
Zhao Po was clearly shaken by this curse: "Is there such a curse? Was it from the Seven Emotions Valley? That's not right. Would Seven Emotions Valley dare to curse people from the Seek Dao Sect?"
"It's a little more complicated to explain, we came to the Wild State to solve this problem."
The two arrived at the location of the carriage. At this point, the sky had cleared after the rain, Meng Jingzhou had cleared the road blocked by the mudslide, and he was now enjoying a barbecue.
"Haha Old Meng, I'm back. I've gone through a lot along the way. What, you ask me what happened? Well, let me explain it properly!" Lu Yang didn't even wait for Meng Jingzhou to ask before he started recounting his journey.
"Listen, you really missed out by not being there. After leaving, I first encountered two young maidens being kidnapped. I heroically rescued them, and they wanted to repay me with their bodies. Then I encountered a female knight escorting a heist, and again came to the rescue. She was very grateful and hinted that I could go to the escort agency to marry her.
Then, I came across a martial competition for marriage. Surprisingly, the young girl participating was quite pretty."
"When I reached the nearby city, I encountered a wicked boy who was harassing a woman in public. I couldn't bear it and stepped in immediately. Then, I ended up defeating every member of their family, making them submit. The woman being harassed said that she was so indebted that she also offered me her body."
"The experiences along the way were so diverse, right, Old Meng?" Lu Yang shook his head, appearing as if he hadn't had enough.
Meng Jingzhou's eyes were turning red with jealousy.
Zhao Po stayed silent on the side, contemplating whether he should intervene, or sit on the sidelines in case a fight broke out.
Having heard that both of these people were at the Golden Core early stage, and considering that he himself was also at the Golden Core early stage, if a fight did really happen, he is likely to be able to mediate, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 412 - 411: It seems that the power of Seven Emotions Valley is not mediocre_1
chapters.content:
"Why haven't I encountered these sorts of things!" Meng Jingzhou regretted, feeling like he missed a golden opportunity.
I despise you, Lu Yang, for robbing me of it, a grudge that cannot be resolved!
"It's all destiny, just accept it." Lu Yang consoled.
"Get lost!" Meng Jingzhou snapped, wondering why all the good things happened to Lu Yang.
Neither Lu Yang nor Meng Jingzhou had any intention of fighting, all of Zhao Po's worries were for nothing.
"Who's this person you brought back?" Meng Jingzhou asked, pointing his lips at Zhao Po.
Fearing that Lu Yang would mock him again, Zhao Po hastily introduced himself: "I am Zhao Po, runner-up in the Corpse Chasing Sect competition, at the early stage of the Golden Core."
Meng Jingzhou was surprised, Zhao Po seemed similar in age and at most just a year older, but such talents could only rank second in Corpse Chasing Sect?
If Zhao Po came to their Seek Dao Sect, he could achieve the sixth place.
"You're only the second in the Corpse Chasing Sect with your skills?"
On this topic, Zhao Po smiled bitterly: "I hate to admit it, but Senior Brother Huang Ming is indeed slightly better than me, especially in terms of combat awareness. In that battle, I used all my tricks, but Senior Brother Huang Ming was still unfazed, he was always prepared."
"Senior Brother Huang Ming has always been more outstanding than me, every time we complete a mission, he always takes the lead. When others are still looking for clues, he has already killed the hidden enemies."
"Senior Brother Huang Ming has no parents since he was a child, he's an orphan with a solitary personality, unwilling to interact with others."
Zhao Po shook his head in regret, he wanted to share cultivation insights with Senior Brother Huang Ming for mutual progress, but alas, Huang Ming didn't like to talk much even to him who ranked second.
"Senior Brother Huang Ming has taken the Sect Leader as his master, it will be even harder to see him in the future."
"Is he that strong?" Lu Yang's evaluation of Huang Ming went up a notch. He thought that Huang Ming and Zhao Po were on the same level, but from what Zhao Po said, it seemed they were far apart in strength?
"Not to mention me, I heard that Senior Brother Meng is cursed and can't be near women?"
Meng Jingzhou hesitated for a moment: "It seems I couldn't be close to women even before I was cursed."
Zhao Po consoled: "Don't be disheartened, Senior Brother Meng. A sage once said, 'To become a great tool, one must first suffer his mind, his muscles and bones, his body skin, empty his body, and act against his will. Therefore, he motivates his heart to endure his nature, and aids what he cannot do.'
Meng Jingzhou laughed, the more he looked at Zhao Po the more he liked him: "Good, a genius from the Corpse Chasing Sect sure knows how to speak. I'll consider you my friend. If you ever find yourself in trouble in the Imperial City, just mention my name, Meng Jingzhou!"
Zhao Po: "..."
He had a feeling that something was not quite right in the last sentence. Did he mishear it?
"To be precise, my curse prevents me from getting close to women. I heard that many cultivators in the Wild State are skilled in curse arts, and the Corpse Chasing Sect is a major sect there. I plan to ask your sect for possible solutions."
Zhao Po thought for a moment and earnestly said, "In that case, I would recommend you to visit the Seven Emotions Valley instead."
"Seven Emotions Valley?" Like Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou's understanding of the Seven Emotions Valley was restricted to knowing that such a sect existed.
"Our Corpse Chasing Sect is indeed proficient in the orthodox corpse-driving technique, but when it comes to curses, we are far less accomplished than the Seven Emotions Valley. In our Wild State, whenever someone is cursed, the first suspicion usually falls on the people of the Seven Emotions Valley."
"But the Seven Emotions Valley is in a semi-concealed state, so people from other places know very little about it."
Lu Yang nodded, confirming his thoughts: "It seems that the strength of the Seven Emotions Valley is extraordinary and can be compared with your Corpse Chasing Sect."
Zhao Po was amazed. How did Senior Brother Lu know this? Even he only learned it from the Elder after he became second in the sect competition and got promoted.
"A sect of lesser strength might have been annihilated long ago."
Zhao Po admitted that Lu Yang was quite right.
"Let's go to the Seven Emotions Valley then. It's close by anyway." Lu Yang looked at the map. By Old Horse's speed, they could reach in less than half a day.
"It's here." Lu Yang pointed to the location on the map and Old Horse snorted in response.
Zhao Po was very surprised. To him, Old Horse is just an ordinary horse. How could it understand human feelings so well?
Perhaps this involved the secrets of the two senior brothers, so he didn't ask further.
He's not someone who likes asking too many questions. It's normal for a cultivator to have secrets. For example, during the journey, he felt that something was off about Brother Ye and Brother Wenren. But he didn't question them and ended up witnessing the scene where the two disguised as men, fell in love with each other and took advantage of the unsuspecting.
The trio rode on the horse cart while Zhao Po had the living corpse squat on top to observe the surroundings and deter petty thieves.
Corpse-drivers hold a high status in the Wild State. Those who die away from their hometown need corpse-drivers to drive their corpses back home for peace. Bandits and aggressive robbers, upon seeing a living corpse here and realizing there's a corpse-driver on the cart, would voluntarily abandon their target.
On the horse cart, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou asked several questions about the corpse-driving technique.
"I've been wondering for a long time, living corpses do not have consciousness and essentially are just objects, so why not transport them in storage rings instead of having to stay in inns?"
"In practice, living corpses indeed can be considered objects and can be put in storage rings. But as corpse-drivers, we believe that they are alive, just existing in a state that cultivators cannot perceive. Since they are alive, we should treat them as living beings. We eat, sleep and travel together. When asking them to fight, we use the word 'please'."
Zhao Po smiled bitterly, "It's because our corpse-drivers have a unique view of life and death that there are rumors out there saying that the founder of Nine Nether Sect was from our Corpse Chasing Sect."
Zhao Po explained various things about corpse-drivers to the others, giving a much more authentic account than others.
In less than half a day, the trio and the living corpse arrived at the Seven Emotions Valley smoothly.
"I have a friend in Seven Emotions Valley who is an official disciple and very good at breaking curses. When I was cursed, I went to my friend. Your curse, Senior Brother Meng, as long as it's below the Nascent Soul level, my friend can handle it. It can be a bit uncertain at the Divinity Transformation level. But even if he can't break it, he can at least alleviate it."
Meng Jingzhou hesitated for a moment, then said, "Conservatively estimated, it's at a half-step Pass Tribulation level."
After all, he shared the curse with Sect Leader Qiu, reducing its power.
Zhao Po leaned slightly backwards in surprise and respect.
When he had troubles outside, he usually clashed with seniors in the Golden Core stage, and rarely met Nascent Soul stage enemies. He never encountered Divinity Transformation stage even once.
Should I say, the peerless genius of the Seek Dao Sect, even the curse you're afflicted with is at half-step Pass Tribulation level?
What did you do to be cursed at this level?
Even if you slapped the Valley Master of Seven Emotions Valley twice, you shouldn't receive such a high-level curse.
Lu Yang thought to himself, that's just the start, the enemies we two brothers deal with are all at the Unification stage at the very least. We don't even bother with anyone below that level.

chapters.title: Chapter 413 - 412: The Foolish Old Man Moves Mountains to Fill the Sea and Create Land_1
chapters.content:
"The Seven Emotions Valley should be right ahead. Let's stop here for now and ask someone in the Valley to keep an eye on Old Meng."
Lu Yang feared that if they kept going, various unexpected incidents might happen to impede their journey.
He had no desire to experience another landslide like the one he'd suffered by using the Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth technique.
Meng Jingzhou knew that Lu Yang was right, however annoyed he might be. He ordered the two men to get off, staying where he was to keep Old Horse company.
After they traversed two or three miles, they reached a canyon it seemed as if it had been split open by a mighty sword from the heavens. The sides of the canyon were steep and smooth, with no protrusions or indentations whatsoever. If one claimed this to be the work of natural forces, one had to acknowledge the supernatural power of such forces.
Seeing Lu Yang's attention focused on the canyon, Zhao Po explained, "The Seven Emotions Valley wasn't always called that. It used to be the Seven Emotions Sect. One of the past sect leaders thought that with all the Sects and Schools scattered across the Central Continent, it was way too generic and hard to stand out.
So, they invited a master of Swordsmanship to split a plain into two with a single stroke, turning it into a canyon. The Sect then took advantage of this situation and renamed itself as the Seven Emotions Valley and even underwent a formal name change registration process."
"I see, that's quite an approach. I've learned something new and impressive. They knew about formal registration processes..."
Before Lu Yang could finish, he realized something, "Hold on, isn't it mandatory to restore things back to their original state after the act of cultivators? The case of Seven Emotions Valley needs approvals, right?"
"Yes, indeed. Hence, till now, the Seven Emotions Valley stands as an unauthorized structure."
Lu Yang thought – that is the first time I've heard of a canyon being considered an unauthorized structure. Quite a unique feature of the cultivation world indeed.
In the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity muttered, "Your Great Xia is pretty strict about this matter. It was much freer in the ancient times, without all these bothersome rules and regulations. We could change the terrain as per our wishes."
"I remember a family residing in the mountains for generations. The way out was blocked by two huge mountains, making commuting very inconvenient. They had to take a long detour to get to the outside world."
"The kid of that family saw this and decided to move the two mountains blocking the path from the front of their house. People ridiculed him, stating that he was too young and weak to even lift a stone, let alone moving two mountains."
"The kid then said, 'Even if I can't right now, there's always the future. I can progress to the Qi Refinement Stage. If that is not enough, I'll advance to the Foundation Establishment Stage. If that's still not strong enough, then to the Golden Core Stage, the Nascent Soul Stage, and so on. The stages of cultivation are never-ending. One day, I'll surely reach the level where I can move mountains.'
"The kid went out to learn under a mentor. When he returned, he was no longer a boy, but an old man. The people who knew him called him the stubborn old man. The level of cultivation skill he had brought back from his training was earth-shaking. He moved the two mountains, Taihang and Wangwu, from the front of his house and dumped them into the sea."
"Since then, the stubborn old man began helping other families living in the mountains move their mountains and dump them into the sea."
"Due to his willingness to help others, often moving mountains for others, the seas were gradually filled up with mountains over time."
"The story of the stubborn old man moving mountains and reclaiming land from the sea turned into a proverb – stubborn old man fills the sea, indicating the need to be unyielding in practice to overcome hardships."
With a painful squeeze on his temples, Lu Yang felt as if his memory was becoming muddled.
Before the immortal could finish her story, Fairy Eternity continued, "You should be aware that sea water never disappears, it simply relocates. The old man filled up the sea, and the water overflowed from the sea, causing a great flood."
"Thankfully, at that time, Immortal Jiuchong had already created the Breath Soil, which was an expanding soil. He used it to block the flood and prevent it from spreading. This act was known among the people as Immortals controlling water."
Lu Yang returned to his senses and realized that there were quite a few people in Seven Emotions Valley, all of them standing in a queue. When would their turn come if they queued too?
"What's happening here? Have all these people been cursed by the Seven Emotions Valley?"
Is the curse of Seven Emotions Valley airborne and that's why there are so many victims?
"No, not really. More than half of the people queuing have been cursed by others and have come to the Seven Emotions Valley for help. To train their disciples in breaking curses, the Valley assigns some disciples to sit at the entrance for consultation and to break curses on the spot."
"Don't be alarmed by the numbers. Most of the cases are minor curses, like toothaches or gout."
"But standing in line wouldn't help our cause, since the disciples who provide on-site consultations usually find it hard to even break simple Foundation Establishment stage curses. For the curse on Senior Brother Meng, the Valley Master has to intervene."
Suddenly, someone among those queueing up approached Lu Yang, "Young brothers, are you here at Seven Emotions Valley to break a curse? I can give you my spot. You just have to say that we're relatives. All it takes is five hundred spirit stones. Deal or no deal?"
Following the direction of the voice, Lu Yang saw the man offering him the chance to bypass the queue, causing his eyelids to twitch uncontrollably.
It was the guy who'd impersonated the owner at the Qingming Inn!
His very presence at the Seven Emotions Valley meant he was exceedingly sure of himself, convinced he could escape even if he was discovered.
Walking straight towards him with a smile, Lu Yang asked, "Do you remember me?"
The man in the paper cap examined Lu Yang's face for a moment before saying, "Ah, yes. You're the customer who stayed at my inn!"
Lu Yang thought, wasn't that originally someone else's inn? How on earth did it become yours?
With a puzzled look, the man in the paper cap asked, "What happened to the brother who was with you before, and that old horse?"
A chill ran down Lu Yang's spine. Did the man in the paper cap mention Old Horse because he'd seen something unusual?
"Fairy, what's the Cultivation Level of this cap-wearing man?"
"Hard to say. This is just one of his clones. It's impossible to discern his actual Cultivation Level. But he seems to be practicing some sort of Clone technique, dividing himself into millions of parts for the purpose of cultivating his Spiritual Power."
"Just my luck. Let's go."
Leaving the man in the paper cap behind, Lu Yang headed off. Considering that the man had a dragon horse for a mount, he must have had a complex background. Although he wasn't highly cultivated himself, he had a solid foundation. That scared people.
And then there was another person he hadn't seen yet, but the Living Corpse accompanying him had been created using the Corpse Chasing Sect's method, which implied that he was associated with the Corpse Chasing Sect.
Lu Yang, being an obscure figure, and Zhao Po, a disciple from the Corpse Chasing Sect, could both easily bring him trouble, so it was better to just leave this place.
The man in the paper cap vanished in front of Lu Yang, casting some kind of hidden runic spell. Lu Yang still couldn't make sense of how he'd vanished.
"Is that guy from the wanted posters – the one in the paper cap?" Zhao Po asked, recognizing him.
"You've heard of him, too?"
"Yes, we heard about him when we were traveling. My siblings and I even considered capturing him to claim the reward. We could never find him, though."
Initially, Zhao Po thought of capturing the man, but noticing Lu Yang's serious expression, he realized that the man was far from being easy prey and held back.

chapters.title: Chapter 414 - 413: The Business of Seven Emotions Valley_1
chapters.content:
The man in the white hat fled, Lu Yang and Zhao Po knew he was not someone they could catch, so they didn't dwell on it.
Zhao Po pulled out a small gong and tapped it lightly, producing a pleasing sound.
"This is how my friend and I communicate. If she's in the valley, she should come out to meet us soon."
Before long, a graceful woman emerged from the Seven Emotions Valley. A glint of recognition flashed in her eyes when she saw Zhao Po, but she hid her delight well, and asked in a slightly disdainful tone, "What curse have you gotten into this time?"
Unfazed by her tone, Zhao Po introduced, "This is my newly acquainted friend, Lu Yang from Seek Dao Sect, he needs Valley Master's help for something."
"This is Luo Yu, a true disciple of Seven Emotions Valley. Her master is Valley Master."
"Lu Yang?!" Luo Yu was startled upon hearing Lu Yang's name, "Are you the Lu Yang who won first prize at the Qingzhou festival and still felt unsatisfied so you even fought the judges?"
Lu Yang felt his many strengths didn't necessitate this sort of reputation.
"I have a friend who was afflicted by an unspeakable curse and it's extremely difficult to break. I would like to ask the Valley Master for help."
Luo Yu cast a somewhat sympathetic look at Lu Yang, yet another "friend" claiming to be cursed.
"Master will be out soon, but whether she will be willing to help you lift the curse is uncertain. Please come in first."
"It's not me, it's my friend." Lu Yang corrected.
"I understand"
The two followed Luo Yu and entered through the Array Method entrance into the Seven Emotions Valley.
"By the way, does your Seek Dao Sect have someone named Master Xie?" Luo Yu suddenly asked.
"Yes, Master Xie is our Fourth Elder, is there any issue?"
The Fourth Elder seldom left the outside world, and his name wasn't widely known.
"There's a problem. When Master was young, she had a crush on a man named Master Xie. They met by chance, and she immediately fell for him. They often sat and talked together, discussing all sorts of things with joy. Master even taught him the technique of breaking curses, as proof of her feelings.
Unfortunately, Master Xie did not reciprocate her feelings, left her and Wild State, and returned to Seek Dao Sect."
"Judging from Master's frequent mentioning of Master Xie, she has not let him go. As for whether it's love or resentment born from love, I'm not certain."
Lu Yang was sweating bullets after hearing this.
No wonder the Seven Emotions Valley, known as the best Sect in Wild State specializing in curse techniques, wasn't recommended by the Fourth Elder to the duo. Instead, they were recommended to the Corpse Chasing Sect. So, this was the reason.
Having already entered the Seven Emotions Valley, it would be awkward to leave now.
Hopefully, the Valley Master will be magnanimous and won't hold a grudge against a minor disciple from the Seek Dao Sect.
Lu Yang felt he had paid a hefty price for Meng Jingzhou's curse. Even a father couldn't do more.
"Do friends usually like to act as elders for each other?" Fairy Eternity, seemingly recalling something, asked Lu Yang.
"It's not everyone, just some of them."
"I see."
"Did Fairy think of something?"
Fairy Eternity nodded and gave a sincere smile, "The first time I cooked for Qilin Immortal, he called me 'Mom'. It turns out he saw me as a friend. It seems that sharing meals can promote relationships."
Fairy Eternity looked lovely when she laughed, much more pleasing to the eye than the cold Eldest Senior Sister, but Lu Yang was not fooled by her sincere smile.
"Can you explain what happened in detail?"
"After I fought against Yingtian Immortal and Qilin Immortal in an rank-challenge, I felt bad and invited them to a meal. Initially, they were very suspicious of me and even thought that I wanted to poison them, but after seeing that my cooking process went smoothly, and having found no sign of poison, then they finally relaxed and started eating."
"After taking a bite, Qilin Immortal yelled 'Mom' and then fainted, probably from his body's inability to handle the replenishment."
"Yingtian Immortal also fainted."
"Qilin Immortal is a being born from the combined luck of heaven and earth, he has no parents, so he must be visualizing me as his mother." Fairy Eternity shook her head slightly, feeling that Qilin Immortal was also pitiful.
Lu Yang thought that what Qilin Immortal wanted to yell was probably "Damn it's poisonous" but after pronouncing only one word he fell unconscious, his words misunderstood by Fairy Eternity.
It is hard for later generations to judge the strength of the junior immortals, but Lu Yang had his own ways.
Considering that Qilin Immortal was able to utter one word, while Yingtian Immortal couldn't utter a single word, Qilin Immortal should be superior in cultivation level.
Meanwhile, in reality, they walked through the Seven Emotions Valley, where Lu Yang observed a number of people seeking help to break curses - difficult ones that disciples stationed at the entrance couldn't solve.
"Curse Master, every night when I meditate, I hear the sound of mosquitoes buzzing in my ears, and my body itches irritatingly. I've heard that you've researched a new type of curse that works like this, have I been inflicted with it?"
"My good friend, our Seven Emotions Valley did research such curse, but in my opinion, you show no signs of being cursed at all. And actually, your exposed skin has mosquito bites—it's probably just real mosquitoes near you."
"I don't believe it, you must have cursed me."
The disciple of Seven Emotions Valley sighed lightly. The curse was costly to create, who would waste it on someone with your low level of cultivation?
"Very well, take this, place it beside you when you're meditating, and you will not be cursed anymore."
"What is it?"
"Mosquito coil, three hundred spirit stones each."
…
"Curse Master, from childhood to adulthood, no female cultivators have liked me. Every time I confess to them, they reject me, without exception. My peers are already married, and I don't even have a girlfriend, have I been cursed?"
"Friend, your situation is not because of a curse. Your personal charm is undeniable, you only lack spirit stones. Our Seven Emotions Valley provides loan service, do you want to borrow spirit stones from us? The annual interest rate is only twenty percent?"
…
"Curse Master, recently, after killing someone, images of the victim's bloody state at the point of death keep appearing in my mind. He screams that he will curse me to never have peace. Now, I even have nightmares. In my dreams, the victim, covered in blood, crawls towards me asking for his life to be avenged, scaring me so much that I dare not sleep."
"Recently, I've been having chills running down my spine, as though someone is following me, but when I turn around, there is nothing."
"When I'm in closed-door cultivation, I occasionally hear eerie laughter, jeering at my discomposure. I scramble to escape, but the laughter keeps echoing in my ears."
"Sometimes, a red figure appears before my eyes, and when I rub my eyes and look carefully, the red figure disappears."
"Am I cursed?"
The disciple of the Seven Emotions Valley noticed the black lines on his forehead, the swollen dark circles under his eyes, and the terrified look in his eyes. He nodded, finally encountering a real curse victim, "You are indeed cursed, and it's an extremely difficult vengeance curse to break."
"Is there a solution?"
"Naturally, there's no curse that our Seven Emotions Valley can't break. But this curse is too tough, I can't handle it, please wait for me to call my Senior Brother."
Shortly after, the disciple of the Seven Emotions Valley called his Senior Brother and pointed to him, saying: "Senior Brother, this is the murderer, I can't beat him, let's take him to the government office!"

chapters.title: Chapter 415 - 414: I'm not sure if they like me or not? (Seeking monthly tickets at month-end)_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang withdrew his gaze, amazed at the wide range of services offered by Seven Emotions Valley. Besides lifting curses, they also sold mosquito coils, provided loans, hunted criminals - all wonderfully diverse and interesting to him.
Luo Yu explained beside him: "There's no other way. Usually, people can't distinguish whether they're having a problem or being cursed. So they all flood in here, claiming they have been cursed, imploring us to help."
"We felt bad for them, coming such a long way and not getting their issues resolved. So, we decided to help in different ways."
"Like this loan service, for example - it's a recent addition."
"Some time ago, a man came to us. He said he was short on cash and wanted to apply for a loan at a trading company, but every company he went to told him that he had an outstanding loan, and he couldn't borrow more until he made the repayments. He wondered if he had been cursed, such as sleepwalking himself to the trading companies and applying for loans."
"We checked multiple times and were sure he wasn't cursed. In the end, we consulted the law and found that an interest rate above thirty-six percent per annum is considered usury. With no choice left, we had him borrow from us, imposing an interest rate of thirty-six percent per annum."
"That's how our loan service started."
Lu Yang: "..."
What a solution born of necessity.
"Not just ordinary people, even those a little familiar with curses can hardly differentiate. Zhao Po is a perfect example of this. He's a disciple of the Corpse Chasing Sect, at the early stage of Golden Core, but often cannot distinguish between curses and normal phenomena."
At this point, Luo Yu glanced at Zhao Po, who sheepishly chuckled.
Amused by this, Lu Yang sent a telepathic message to Zhao Po: "Does Junior Sister Luo like you?"
"Definitely not. You only think that because you don't know what she did to me."
"Once, after leaving Seven Emotions Valley, I found myself disquieted. I kept thinking about Luo Yu. I lost my appetites and couldn't sleep, tossing and turning all night. I went to her and described my symptoms and asked her if she'd cursed me."
"She said 'yes'."
"When I was describing to her what happened, she blushed, and when she admitted to the curse, she stomped her foot. I guess she was angry because I saw through her curse," said Zhao Po with conviction.
"I treated her as a friend, but she treated me like this. I asked her to break the curse, but she refused!"
"Are you sure she doesn't like you?"
Zhao Po waved his hand, a radiant smile revealing deep-seated confidence: "What're you saying? I've been travelling the Jianghu for two to three years. I'm a seasoned figure. Wouldn't I know whether someone likes me or not?"
In the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity was nodding vigorously: "Such a detestable girl, cursing this fool. Truly, you can never know a person!"
Lu Yang: "..."
Both of your responses aren't making me confident about my judgment.
"How did you meet Junior Sister Luo?"
"It was about a year ago when I had just completed my Foundation Establishment. I heard about a large snake haunting a cold pond and causing local disturbances. I went to exterminate it. Coincidentally enough, Luo Yu also went to find the snake, but she was hunting for its gall bladder to use as a medium for her curses."
"We hit it off immediately, deciding to join forces. After a fierce battle, we managed to kill the snake."
"The snake's belly was full of poisonous fog - the love poison. After the snake died, its body swelled and exploded, spreading the love poison all over us."
"Thankfully, I was prepared and had Luo Yu and myself take detoxifying pills beforehand. This saved us from the danger."
The trio and a corpse strolled down a long corridor to the Valley Master's retreat, which was sealed by a stone door.
"According to past experience, the master should have finished her retreat."
"What experience? Is the Valley Master's retreat time fixed?"
"Not really. It's just that every time the master says she's in a retreat, she's actually lazing around in her cave, avoiding sect affairs. So we just go directly to her for whatever we need, without worrying if she's in a retreat."
Luo Yu knocked on the stone door.
"Master, we have guests."
A faint voice came from behind the door: "I am in retreat."
"They're from the Seek Dao Sect."
As soon as the words were out, a gust of sweet fragrance filled the air as a veiled woman appeared before them.
Even though she wore a veil, it didn't obscure her face at all. Lu Yang could see the Valley Master's face through the veil. She was stunningly beautiful.
"Master, you're not in retreat anymore?" Luo Yu giggled into her hand.
"I've ended it."
The Valley Master was adorned in white, elegant and mature. She gave off a serene aura. She examined Zhao Po and Lu Yang, instantly brushing Zhao Po aside.
"I can't tell what type of Golden Core you have formed. So you're a disciple of the Seek Dao Sect?"
Lu Yang bowed respectfully: "Greetings, Valley Master. My name is Lu Yang of Seek Dao Sect, disciple of Daoist Buyu."
"Oh, so you're that old thief Buyu's disciple. You're much more pleasing to the eye than he is. You may call me Lord Shuang. Did Master Xie send you to find me?"
Lu Yang felt a dangerous vibe underlying the words despite her composed tone, he said cautiously, "I was actually en route to the Corpse Chasing Sect. Seven Emotions Valley is famous, so I decided to pay a visit to the Valley Master."
"Corpse Chasing Sect, what do you need them for? Did old Buyu die and you're planning to make him a Living Corpse?"
"I have a friend who is under a particularly intricate curse. The Fourth Elder suggested we go to the Corpse Chasing Sect to resolve the issue."
"Bring it over here." Lord Shuang suddenly reached out and said.
"What?" Lu Yang was taken aback.
"If Master Xie sent you to the Corpse Chasing Sect, he must've written a recommendation letter to validate your identity. The letter must also describe your friend's curse. Let me take a look."
Lu Yang took out the letter that the Fourth Elder had given him from his Identity Jade and handed it over with both hands.
With a flick of her thought, the letter floated in the air and automatically unwrapped itself.
She read the letter silently, muttering with a fascinated expression, "A curse caused by backlash from Causality... Interesting."
As she continued reading, her eyebrows furrowed, her face turned stern, and she seemed upset. With a cold huff, she flung the letter to the ground.
Sensing trouble, Lu Yang secretly glanced at the letter—truth be told, the Fourth Elder, being a Confucian Cultivator, had quite beautiful handwriting, neat and imposing.
The content of the letter was plain; it served to verify his and Meng Jingzhou's identity to the Corpse Chasing Sect and described how Meng Jingzhou was cursed.
However, the last sentence was problematic.
It read: "Remember, never ever suggest to Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou to seek help at Seven Emotions Valley. If they must, do not seek that major demon, Shuang Feiyan!"
Lu Yang: "..."
Is it still possible for me to leave Seven Emotions Valley alive today?

chapters.title: Chapter 416 - 415: The Past of the Fourth Elder and the Valley Master of Seven Emotions Valley_1
chapters.content:
Shuang Feiyan, Valley Master of the Seven Emotions Valley, a top-tier curse master, and one of the most fearsome figures in Wild State.
She possesses an array of peculiar curse techniques that are omnipresent and irresistible. Anyone who provokes her must be prepared to bear all sorts of curses.
A few hundred years ago, a sect insulted Shuang Feiyan in secret. Once she found out, the genders of all the sect members switched, which took half a year to get back to normal.
Even now that sect has remained the laughingstock of Wild State.
Lu Yang did not know about Shuang Feiyan's exploits, but he could guess that it wouldn't be wise to provoke a curse master of such rank.
While he possessed knowledge of the shameful pasts of the ancient immortals and was destined for greatness in the future, he definitely did not need to face the wrath of a top-tier curse master now.
Who could handle that?
"Don't worry, I'm here. I promise no curse can harm you!" The source of the curse assured him in his spiritual space.
Lu Yang became even more terrified.
Zhao Po was also looking particularly nervous. Unlike Lu Yang, he was well aware of what Lord Shuang had done. Her existence alone was enough to make one's heart chill. Even though the Corpse Chasing Sect and Seven Emotions Valley had good relations, it was still up to Lord Shuang's mood whether that kinship would be effective.
Fortunately, Lord Shuang didn't plan on trifling with the juniors. Her face changed several times, finally, she sighed heavily.
"When I first met Shanren, you were about the same age as you are now."
"One day, Shanren was passing by Cang Mountain when he heard a cry for help. It was bandits causing trouble. He stepped in and rescued the people. That's when we first met."
Lu Yang nodded secretly, a typical heroic rescue, Fourth Elder was quite lucky.
"As the leader of the bandits, I was impressed by Shanren's grace and demeanor. I could tell at a glance that he was from a prominent sect or influential family, so I captured him to be my camp's husband."
Lu Yang: "..."
Something seems to be off.
"As a bandit, I only rob the rich to help the poor. I don't steal from the poor."
"I realized there were too many bandits in Wild State to eradicate completely. So I thought why not become a bandit myself, gradually expand my power, and drive the other bandits out. If that happened, wouldn't there be no real bandits left?"
"Anyway, once I had Shanren captive, I wanted to marry him, but he chose death over submission. I had no choice but to give up for the time being."
Lu Yang thought to himself that he had heard of the tradition of bride kidnapping in Wild State and he was indeed witnessing it today.
"I didn't entirely give up on Shanren. His cultivation level was not weaker than mine. I was only able to capture him through surprise. To prevent him from escaping, I put a curse on him."
"Shanren knew he wouldn't be able to lift the curse immediately, so he stayed obediently by my side. I shared my carefully crafted plans to combat banditry with him. After pondering for a while, he thought it sound and joined me in robbing the rich to help the poor. We made quite a name for ourselves, known in the martial world as the 'Male and Female Bandit Duo!'"
"Of course, during this time, Shanren also tried to escape and break the curse, but he failed."
"I love Shanren's persistent character."
Lu Yang figured that the foundation of Fourth Elder's curse-lifting skill must have been laid during that period. No wonder Fourth Elder could only lift curses and not lay them. Turns out he was the one cursed initially.
"Cang Mountain is a good place. Some young, famous cultivators were captured by Shanren and me, such as the current Sect Leader of the Corpse Chasing Sect and the Clan Leader of the Barbarian Tribe. We explained our plan to them, they also thought our approach was a good solution, swore a blood oath, joined our bandit gang, and addressed me as 'Big Sister!'"
"With the support of these three, our bandit power in Cang Mountain rapidly expanded. All other bandits around surrendered to us. I gave the defeated bandits two choices: either be processed into living corpses, or be cursed by me. Wisely, they all chose the latter and became my subordinates."
"We further expanded our power this way, and we controlled several peaks."
"Eventually, we controlled nearly half of the forces in Wild State. Those who were involved in the underworld would definitely know our reputation as the 'Four Dragons of Cang Mountain.'"
"The most powerful bandit leader at that time was called Mountain Suppression Tiger. Seeing our rapid expansion, he took the initiative to attack us, hoping to stop our momentum while we were still not fully developed."
"Mountain Suppression Tiger was in the late stage of Nascent Soul. None of us could beat him one-on-one, but the four of us together could defeat him!"
"After being defeated, Mountain Suppression Tiger fled in panic, leaving harsh words behind. He claimed there was a Unification stage rogue cultivator backing him up, and to offend him was equivalent to offending this Great Power in the Unification stage. He told us to just wait for death. I can't remember the exact words, but that was essentially the threat."
"We figured that there was no way we could beat a cultivator in the Unification stage. We had no choice but to call for the help of our seniors."
"When the Unification stage rogue cultivator appeared, ready to flex his muscles in front of us, the then Valley Master of Seven Emotions Valley, Grand Elder of the Corpse Chasing Sect, and the Grand Elder of the Barbarian Tribe all showed up."
"He was so scared he turned to flee, but how could he possibly outrun our seniors? He was only in the early stage of Unification and our seniors were in the late stages. Besides, our seniors had already set a trap, just waiting for him to walk right in."
Lu Yang imagined the scene and felt hopeless. He was merely at the early stage of Unification, and only helping his subordinates to deal with hostile forces. Who would've imagined that one after another big shot would show up behind the enemy?
"That rogue cultivator had astounding escape methods. Knowing very well that he would be as good as dead if we caught him, he burned his essence blood as a price for escaping from our trap."
"Then, a child stood in his way. It was your grandmaster, the then Sect Leader of Seek Dao Sect. He was the most powerful among the seniors. Once he made his move, the rogue cultivator couldn't escape even if he burnt up all his life force."
"Since then, we dominated all the bandit forces in Wild State, and were later confined by our seniors in their respective forces."
"Shanren was supposed to be confined as well, but your grandmaster mentioned that there was no room in Seclusion Cliff, so he placed Shanren and I in Seven Emotions Valley's confinement room."
Lu Yang had heard of Seclusion Cliff, which was used by the Seek Dao Sect for solitary confinement, but he had always been a good boy and was never punished, so he didn't need to go to such a place.
Originally, the Eldest Senior Sister wanted to confine their master, who didn't cultivate properly, in Seclusion Cliff, but their master's cultivation level was too high and he often visited Seclusion Cliff, so being there made no difference. Hence, their master was confined at the entrance of their home.
"Then, who was confined in Seclusion Cliff?"
"Your master and his seven senior brothers and sisters. It seems that your master led his seven senior brothers and sisters to cause a ruckus in Imperial City. They taught the noble disciples such a good lesson, it would be best if you didn't mention in Imperial City that you are Daoist Buyu's disciple."
Lu Yang: "..."
Why is it that in other households, elders back me up, but in mine, elders cause me trouble?

chapters.title: Chapter 417 - 416: Lord Shuang: The Curse is Invalid to Me _1
chapters.content:
The title of "Ninth Son of Seek Dao Sect" Lu Yang had heard it before, and this title meant that the identity of a Seek Dao Sect disciple was a double-edged sword. When encountering relatively weak individuals, such as those in the Spirit Transformation Stage or the Refining the Void Stage, it could intimidate them.
But if the other party was a high-level lord of the Unification stage with a position in a major power, it could almost be confirmed that he had a causal entanglement with the Ninth Son of the Seek Dao Sect, and there was an eighty percent chance that they held a grudge against him.
If he were to go to the Imperial City, that 80% likelihood would probably turn into 100%.
Returning to the Imperial City would be safe for Meng Jingzhou, at least he would have the Meng Family's support.
As for himself, his master was Daoist Buyu, and his good friend is Meng Jingzhou. With these two identities, what difference does it make whether he goes to the Imperial City or to the gates of hell?
The Imperial City, as the center of Central Continent, has been the place of accumulation for the Great Xia Dynasty for hundreds of thousands of years. It is the strongest city of cultivation in the current world.
Not only do people from Central Continent want to go to the Imperial City to admire the sights, but also those from the Demon Territory, Golden Buddha Kingdom, and the Sea Clan wish to go to the Imperial City.
Only Lu Yang does not want to go.
Lu Yang seemed to have remembered something, and he started counting on his fingers, "Why do I feel like I have so many enemies? The Four Immortals of the Ancients know my shameful past and are sure not to let me off. In today's era, my master has made enemies everywhere, and now they are all held against me.
This way, wouldn't all the great powers from ancient to modern times have a grudge against me?!"
"It's strange, I have entered the strongest sect of the present time and become the youngest disciple of the Sect Leader. I have within me the strongest immortals of ancient times. In theory, I should be the kind to kill gods when I come upon them, and kill Buddhas when I encounter them. I should be loved by many and enjoying blessings that are supposed to be enjoyed by many others.
In the end, why has it only brought me negative consequences?"
Lu Yang felt thankful that he had a rigid enough destiny to withstand so many dangers.
"After being shut in confinement, Master suppressed the spiritual essence of me and the Mountain Man, and locked us in two separate cells. We could only see each other through a small iron window on the wall."
"We sat in the confinement room and discussed the Dao. I explained the principles of the curse arts and he explained the sayings of the saints, and we mutually promoted each another while improving ourselves."
Lu Yang wondered in his heart, were these two really not talking nonsense?
Lord Shuang's tone was gentle, and Lu Yang, knowing that troubles come from one's mouth, did not cause trouble for himself.
Finally, Lord Shuang sighed slowly, "In the end, the Mountain Man still didn't accept my love. After I entered the Unification stage, I secluded myself and researched on a curse that would make the Mountain Man fall head over heels in love with me. It's a pity that the Mountain Man never came to see me."
Lu Yang shivered, he had long heard that reading too many books of the saints could help avoid trouble and seek benefits. This saying was indeed true.
"Never mind, I am anyway connected to your Seek Dao Sect, so let me help you."
Lu Yang hadn't even gotten the chance to be happy for Meng Jingzhou, when he heard Lord Shuang continue, "However, looking at the situation described in the Mountain Man's letter, the level of your companion's curse is very high and exceeds my range of treatment.
