Moreover, it belongs to the retribution of causality and does not completely count as a curse art."
"Can't we look for other people to help us?"
"Not really necessary, since you are already here in Seven Emotions Valley, we can't just let you leave without doing anything. If word were to get out, how can we maintain our claim of being proficient in curse arts? Although I can't remove the curse, I can alleviate some part of it."
"For example?"
"For example, I can change your companion's curse from not being able to touch women, to women feeling disgusted whenever they touch him."
Lu Yang: "..."
Why does it feel worse?
"So what do you think, should we proceed with this?"
"Let me ask him what he thinks first." said Lu Yang. He wasn't Meng Jingzhou, he couldn't make the decision for him.
"That sounds reasonable, then I will go ask him myself."
Lu Yang put on a hesitant expression, which caused Lord Shuang to ask, "What's the matter?"
"Old Meng's curse is that he cannot approach any female, and you, Valley Master, are..."
Lord Shuang smiled, "What do you take me for? Even though he is cursed, I am the top curse artist and am immune to all curses. His curse can't possibly affect me, so let's go together."
Lord Shuang told Luo Yu and Zhao Po to stay put, she and Lu Yang would go and come back.
Lord Shuang led Lu Yang out of Seven Emotions Valley, following the direction mentioned by Lu Yang to find Meng Jingzhou.
When the two of them reached Meng Jingzhou's location, they found that only a circle remained where Meng Jingzhou and Old Horse had disappeared.
"What is this circle?" asked Lord Shuang, puzzled.
"I drew it. I was afraid that Old Meng would wander off, so I made a circle right here and asked him not to leave this area. I have no idea where he went now."
Lord Shuang understood a little about causality art. She calculated quickly and pointed in a direction, "He should be in that direction, let's go look."
The two went to search for Meng Jingzhou again. They flew for quite a long time following the calculated direction but did not find even a trace of Meng Jingzhou.
"It's strange. With my flying speed, I should have caught up with him very quickly."
Lord Shuang calculated again and came to a different conclusion, "So that's how it is. He changed his direction halfway, he's over there."
"Let's go."
The two continued to fly quickly according to the calculated location. They repeatedly tried to locate Meng Jingzhou, but were unsuccessful.
Just when Lord Shuang was about to recalculate the whereabouts of Meng Jingzhou, Lu Yang said with an understanding look, "How about you give me a location, and I'll go look for Old Meng myself?"
If they continued on, they would leave the Wild State.
Lord Shuang was a little embarrassed: "That sounds good, he's in the west."
Lu Yang headed west alone and found Meng Jingzhou collapsed on the ground in a desolate forest, and Old Horse leisurely drinking spring water on the side.
"Are you okay?"
With a feeble voice, Meng Jingzhou said, "Do I look like I am okay?"
He angrily said, "Just now, I don't know what happened, but a tornado appeared and I was right in the middle of it. The tornado lifted me up and off I went flying, with Old Horse following leisurely behind!"
"When the tornado subsided, an out-of-control living corpse appeared and started chasing me. Seeing the high cultivation level of the living corpse in life, I knew I couldn't beat it, so I ran as fast as I could. I was nearly exhausted to death. Luckily my spiritual essence was abundant and I exhausted all the energy of the living corpse. Old Horse was just watching, not helping at all!"
"I had no time to catch my breath, nor take a Great Recovery Pill, when I saw that there were two individuals at the Spirit Transformation stage fighting in the sky. Their fight covered a large area and could have easily affected me. Fortunately, I'm a body cultivator, so without using any spiritual essence, I am very fast.
I continued to run west until I got here and finally had the chance to catch my breath. Then you came."
"What a streak of bad luck... By the way, I've run so far, how did you find me?"
Lu Yang was embarrassed to mention that it was because of Lord Shuang who flew with him all the way from behind, chasing after Meng Jingzhou.
"I found some help at Seven Emotions Valley who can alleviate your curse to a certain degree."
"How so?"
"Do you like women looking at you with a face full of disgust?"
"?"

chapters.title: Chapter 418 - 417 Who under the heavens doesn't hold a grudge against your master?_1
chapters.content:
"Do you enjoy being looked at with a face full of disgust by women?"
Meng Jingzhou suspected that Lu Yang might have some serious illness.
Ever since they entered Wild State, he felt that Lu Yang's condition was getting worse.
"The thing is, I've found Lord Shuang of Seven Emotions Valley, who is acquainted with the Fourth Elder, and she is willing to help you counteract the causality backlash. However, her ability is limited, and she can only resolve some, not all of it."
While searching for Meng Jingzhou, Lu Yang also considered whether the problem could be fully resolved if the former Valley Master, or some powerful figures of Seven Emotions Valley, could take action.
The response he got from Lord Shuang was, "Do you think everyone older than me has reached the Transcendance Tribulation Stage?"
"Lord Shuang can change the impact of the causality backlash from 'cannot see women' to 'all women you see will dislike you'. How to completely resolve it at later stage, you will have to find a solution yourself."
Meng Jingzhou made a funny face, "How do I feel these two outcomes are about the same?"
"How can you say they are the same, previously you couldn't even enter the gate of a brothel, but now you can."
"Thank you, next time find a more appropriate metaphor."
Meng Jingzhou squatted down, stroking his chin in thought. If he could dissuade part of the curse, he no longer needed to hide in the mountains each day, return to listen to Lu Yang flaunting his luck in love affairs, he could enter the city, travel anywhere without restrictions, and not worry about disasters falling from the sky that would cause him to go on the run.
"Alright, let's trouble Lord Shuang then, um, how should I speak to Lord Shuang?"
Lu Yang sighed. Since Lord Shuang couldn't see Meng Jingzhou, and he couldn't count on old horse, so he had to be the messenger himself.
He resigns himself to return following the original route and finds Lord Shuang resting in meditation under a tree.
"Did you find your companion?"
"Yes, and he's willing to accept your treatment."
Lord Shuang nodded, but then she contemplated another issue, frowning slightly.
"Is there something troubling you?"
"His curse is unusually difficult to dispel, even partial dispelling presents a great challenge. I need to observe his specific condition to determine which method to use."
"But you and Old Meng can't meet now, can you?"
"Yes, that's the crux of the issue."
Having lived for over two thousand years, with experience far beyond Lu Yang's, Lord Shuang quickly thought of a solution.
"I've got an idea. I can use Diagnosing by Hanging Thread."
"However, there are many plants here which interfere with the diagnosis. Thus, you should bring your companion to the entrance of the Seven Emotions Valley, where there is no obstruction."
Having said that, Lord Shuang left by herself to Seven Emotions Valley to prepare the magic artifact for Diagnosing by Hanging Thread.
Once again, Lu Yang returned to where Meng Jingzhou was in the barren mountain and asked old horse to take them to Seven Emotions Valley.
This time, old horse didn't slow down, but used a space magic skill and quickly took the two of them back.
By this time, all those who came to Seven Emotions Valley to lift curses had already dispersed, and the disciples who had set up clinics also returned to the valley. Meng Jingzhou smoothly returned to Seven Emotions Valley.
Lu Yang entered Seven Emotions Valley and obtained the magic artifact for Diagnosing by Hanging Thread from Lord Shuang.
Diagnosing by Hanging Thread, an ancient diagnosis method originating from the Great Qian Dynasty. When a consort of Emperor Qian was ill and required a physician for diagnosis, it was unacceptable for another man to touch the Emperor's woman.
The imperial physicians of Great Qian then came up with a solution. They coiled one end of a thread around the consort's wrist, keeping the other end in the control of the physician. The doctor would then diagnose the illness by combining numerous factors such as the sensation and pulse transmitted by the thread, spiritual essence, and his own extensive medical skill.
The more proficient physicians were skilled in the techniques of stealth, sneaking in under the veil of night to clandestinely treat the consort, without anyone being the wiser.
"I understand the principle, but why did you tie me up so tightly? I thought we only needed to coil the thread around the wrist in Diagnosing by Hanging Thread?"
Meng Jingzhou was furious. His entire body was entwined in white thread, only his mouth had not been gagged yet.
"Just shut up."
Lu Yang gagged him too.
"There's no other way, your causality backlash isn't ordinary. To successfully make a diagnosis, one thread isn't enough. Binding your whole body allows for a better diagnosis. Bear with it. It's what Lord Shuang suggested."
Defeated, Meng Jingzhou obediently waited for Lord Shuang's diagnosis.
Lu Yang enter Seven Emotions Valley, found Lord Shuang holding a bunch of threads, meditating with closed eyes, contemplating a solution.
Lu Yang held his breath, not daring to interrupt Lord Shuang's diagnosis.
"Double Single Golden Core, you have some guts."
"You can tell he has a Single Golden Elixir?" Lu Yang was amazed. This was the first time someone outside the Seek Dao Sect had recognized Meng Jingzhou's Golden Core.
"When I was young, I met a person with a Single Body Spiritual Root who had quite high talent. However, it was not as good as your companion."
"This bloodline trait, and his surname is Meng, so he's a young man from the Meng Family." Lord Shuang laughed, recalling some events from her youth.
"This causality backlash is interesting, it is more serious than the mountain man described, but luckily it did not exceed my expectations."
Lord Shuang had an idea in her mind and had figured out how to dispel part of the causality backlash.
"Have you studied the principle of curses?"
"No."
"Curses have both a soul and physical dual attribute. To dispel a curse, you must start with the physical and soul layer treatment."
"These are the skin of a toad, the dried body of a centipede, five poisonous insect powder...you need to feed these to your companion according to the order I have arranged for you, remember, eat them raw. This can resolve the physical curse. Then use this set of seven star silver needles to bleed him. After the wound heals, bleed him again, repeat this cycle three times.
The seven star silver needles have the ability to connect to the soul and can resolve the soul curse."
"Remember everything I explained to you?"
"Let me confirm once again, are you sure the skin of a toad and others need to be eaten raw?"
"They can be eaten after being boiled as well. Eating them raw just has a higher effect."
"Higher absorption rate?"
"Higher time efficiency. You can save time spent on boiling."
"Okay, I've remembered." Lu Yang turned to leave, but was called back by Lord Shuang.
"Wait a moment, I want to confirm something with you again."
"Yes?"
"Is Old Buyu really still alive? I know some sect leaders like to keep their deaths a secret, fearing that it would have too great an impact. If Old Buyu is really gone, tell me, I'll personally take you to the Corpse Chasing Sect to learn how to make Living Corpses."
"Do you bear a grudge against my Master?"
Lord Shuang scoffed repeatedly, "Who in this world doesn't bear a grudge against your Master?"
"When your master was imprisoned in a jail cell, I went to visit him with the mountain man. When your master saw me, he said he was immune to curses, that no curse could harm him. If I didn't believe that, I could try it. Of course, I didn't believe him, so I cast several curses on him. Then your master was granted medical bail."
Lu Yang: " ... "
"Later, when the incident took place, the officers prosecuted your master and me for escaping from prison."
" ... My Master is still alive. He was still in jail some time ago, but I don't know if he has been released now."
"That's a pity."

chapters.title: Chapter 419 - 418: What happened to the curse that was supposed to have no effect on you?_1
chapters.content:
"By the way, I also have a question for the Valley Master."
"Please proceed."
"When Old Meng's curse turned into making women repel him, do you think the curse will affect you?"
Lord Shuang wore a displeased expression, as she felt that her authority was being questioned by Lu Yang. "I have never encountered Mend Jingzhou's curse before, which resulted in a mistake and I let him wander for a while. But now, after diagnosing through the Hanging Thread method, I fully understand his curse condition.
After following my treatment plan, the curse has reduced to a level that it can no longer affect me."
Lu Yang was relieved. That's good.
...
"Master Shuang said that you will need to consume toad's skin, dried centipedes, and five poisonous bug powder... preferably raw since it will be more effective."
Lu Yang instructed Meng Jingzhou on behalf of the Valley Master.
Watching the strange medicinal herbs, Meng Jingzhou turned pale. Were these things even edible for humans?
"Are you sure the raw method is more effective?"
"These are not my words. They're from Lord Shuang."
With no other choice, Meng Jingzhou, struggling to suppress his gag reflex, painstakingly consumed all the ingredients. Even though they were all dead substances, they felt alive once they had entered his belly, stirring it as if a storm was raging inside.
Zhao Po watched silently from the side, contemplating whether this is how the two prodigies of Seek Dao Sect fought - by outwitting each other.
"We also need to perform bloodletting with needles." Lu Yang took out the seven-star silver needle that Lord Shuang lent to him. The needle must have been a formidable magic artifact. Lu Yang easily penetrated Meng Jingzhou's defenses with the needle without even needing to channel his spiritual essence.
It is important to remember that Meng Jingzhou is a Body Cultivator with astonishing defensive capabilities. Lu Yang doubted that he could break it in a short period of time.
"Hiss— Can't you warn me before stabbing me with a needle!" Meng Jingzhou hissed in pain, his face twisted in agony. It had been a long time since he last felt such intense pain.
If a professional doctor administered the needle, it could be inserted painlessly, and the patient wouldn't even notice anything.
Unfortunately, Lu Yang wasn't a real physician, let alone a professional one.
"Do you know how to use needles, Fairy?" Lu Yang suddenly remembered that he had a theoretically advantageous helper in his Spiritual Space.
"Know how to draw blood? That, I'm familiar with. The gamey taste of Demon Beast meat is because they didn't get rid of all the blood properly. With my method, I guarantee that not a drop of blood will remain."
Lu Yang decided that Meng Jingzhou didn't need to pay such a high price for this.
Upon pulling out the silver needle, blood flowed out of Meng Jingzhou's wound like a fountain. The wound seemed to have a self-healing restraint. Meng Jingzhou's prideful, self-healing powers had no effect whatsoever; he could only slowly wait for the wound to heal itself.
The flowing blood dropped to the ground. This was the blood of a Golden Core Great Cultivator, containing extremely precious spiritual essence. Moreover, being from the bloodline of a Double Single Golden Core cultivator, it was pure and hearty. Its effectiveness was even greater than many Henyang medicines'.
Various insects seemed to sense the viability of this blood and came over to suck up Meng Jingzhou's blood. After feeding, they felt full of energy.
However, the one thing these insects didn't know was that from that moment on, they would never encounter a female insect again.
However, at this point, nobody knew this. Not Lu Yang, not Meng Jingzhou, and not the insects themselves.
As the wound healed, Lu Yang would inject the needle, pull out the needle, let the blood flow, and then heal. After doing this cycle thrice, Meng Jingzhou felt that the uneasiness in his heart had lightened a bit, making him joyful.
"It really works!"
Although it didn't completely dissolve, even a partial dissolution was progress. This was a huge step forward.
Coming to the Wild State was indeed the right choice, much more reliable than the Elder diagnosing him.
As Lord Shuang calculated the timing, feeling that it was about right, she exited the Seven Emotions Valley, finally meeting Meng Jingzhou.
"So you are the Mend Family's lad?"
The moment Meng Jingzhou saw Lord Shuang, he knew that the slight relief he felt in his heart was not an illusion. A part of his curse had indeed been dissolved.
"Responding to the Valley Master, I am Meng Jingzhou of the Mend Family, a disciple of the Seek Dao Sect."
Lord Shuang huffed coldly: "Just as I thought, Mend Family members."
Lu Yang had a bad feeling about this and quickly stepped forward to ask: "Thank you for treating my companion, Lord Shuang. What should we do next to fully cure Old Meng's curse?"
Lord Shuang appeared displeased: "I shouldn't have treated him just now. Old Buyu tricked me, and you Mend Family people are no better. Just get lost!"
Lu Yang: "..."
What happened to the curse having no effect on you?
Can't you be more consistent, Valley Master?
There was no room for arguments at this point. Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had no choice but to leave the Seven Emotions Valley for now.
Back in their horse-drawn carriage, it was Zhao Po who broke the silence first: "Why don't we go to our Corpse Chasing Sect first? Our Elders and Sect Leader are familiar with the Wild State and know a lot of top curse masters and strange talents; maybe they can help."
"I guess that's our only option."
...
On their journey of three men, one corpse, and a horse, they heard a commotion near a city as they approached for rest.
"Gentlemen, my name is Qing Luo, the newly appointed Sect Leader of the Cloud Platform Sect. According to our sect's rules, if a woman becomes a Sect Leader, she must select a husband through a trial of combat."
"Therefore, I have set up a ring here, allowing anyone to challenge me. Any man who can defeat me can become my husband!"
Qing Luo was around 28 years old, pure, and gorgeous. Her eyes were pure and big and she carried an innocent beauty. Her determination captured people's hearts.
Qing Luo had announced her decision to choose a husband through a combat trial well in advance, so most people in the vicinity were already aware of this. Many had come to win her hand in marriage.
However, not everyone knew about it, like Lu Yang and his companions.
"Cloud Platform Sect? I have never heard of this sect before, Brother Zhao, have you?"
After some deep thought, Zhao Po finally dredged up some information about the Cloud Platform Sect from his memory.
"The Cloud Platform Sect is quite a small sect, among the low-tier ones. Their influence is limited to just one city, or maybe even less. The highest level of cultivation in their sect may only be the Golden Core Stage.
The Cloud Platform Sect is most famous for its rule that if a female becomes a Sect Leader, she should choose a stronger male as her husband, like the situation we are witnessing now."
There are countless minor sects like the Cloud Platform Sect in Great Xia.
Do not think that because Lu Yang frequently came in contact with people at the Golden Core and Nascent Soul stages, with his enemies being at the Unification stage and above, and befriending people at the Immortal stage, this was a common occurrence.
That's because Lu Yang is a disciple of the Seek Dao Sect and his exposure was extremely high.
The Seek Dao Sect was considered the best among the Five Great Immortal Sects, gathering the extreme talents from across the continent. Any random disciple could make a big name for themselves on the Central Continent.
In reality, the majority of Cultivators would find it hard to even establish their Foundation during their lifetime, with the Golden Core stage being an almost unreachable goal. This is the reason why there are Golden Core influential families and Golden Core sects.
Seeing Qing Luo, Meng Jingzhou's eyes lit up. He seemed to be interested and felt that his luck in love affairs was coming.

chapters.title: Chapter 420 - 419: Cannot Violate the Ancestral Teachings _1
chapters.content:
"None of you go on stage, Lu Yang, you've had a vast range of experiences, it's time for my luck to turn!" Meng Jingzhou stopped Lu Yang and Zhao Po, who had no plans to go on stage in the first place.
Before Meng Jingzhou could take the stage, another person beat him to it. He was a middle-aged man, collected and wise, with a long beard, a picture of refined elegance.
The long-bearded man was well-known locally, and people in the crowd recognized him, "It's Mr. Xiang from Tenglong Academy. He has educated countless scholars in his academy, even mentoring one to become a distinguished scholar. His students are spread all over Wild State, including the Imperial City!".
"Not just that, he is a bona fide Confucian Cultivator. One of his graduated students said that he had already reached the early stage of the Golden Core five years ago. It's unknown if he has broken through now. Numerous prestigious families with Golden Core cultivation would like their offspring to be apprenticed to him, offering generous gifts as tribute, but he refuses all!"
"What, he reached the Golden Core early stage five years ago? How can we compete then? How could Fairy Qing Luo possibly beat him?"
In the world of cultivators, the term "Fairy" is often used to praise the beauty, talent, and power of female cultivators. After all, in public perception, there are no women amongst the immortals, and the term Fairy is not used casually.
Lu Yang never used the term "Fairy" to praise others. Not because he was cautious with his words, but he didn't think it was a compliment...
"Don't panic, Fairy Qing Luo is undoubtedly talented. She's only eighteen and already in the late stage of Foundation Establishment - the youngest among all the past sect leaders of Cloud Platform Sect. Even if she faces someone in the early stage of the Golden Core phase, she could give a good fight!"
"That's great... wait a minute, does that mean we have no chance at all?"
Mr. Xiang stood on the stage, a genteel smile dancing on his lips, "Sect Master Qing, please come forth."
Qing Luo sighed leisurely, "Mr. Xiang, didn't you read the rules? Competing cultivators must be under twenty years old. You're in your forties; even if I were to choose a spouse, I would prefer someone closer to my age."
Mr. Xiang, taking a hit, was immediately inspired to write a poem, "Before my birth, you were born. At your birth, I was old. We are destined to be apart."
"Indeed, so could you please leave the stage? I've only paid for the venue for one day, and time is limited."
Mr. Xiang left the stage, dispirited.
The subsequent cultivators who ascended the stage were more promising - all twenty-year-old talents, including those disguised as men.
"This girl named Qing Luo has quite a solid foundation. Despite having flaws, given her environment and lack of guidance, achieving this standard of Foundation Establishment is quite remarkable - either she had an extraordinary encounter, or she's a genius."
"She is quite impressive. Even in our Corpse Chasing Sect, she would be selected as a true inheritance disciple, competing for a top-eight or even top-four spot in the Sect's competition."
Lu Yang and Zhao Po quietly discussed Qing Luo's talent.
"Why not try to recruit her into your Corpse Chasing Sect? A talent like her is wasted in such a small place," Lu Yang laughed.
"Depends on the individual's choice. I could try but it may not work. I have seen many who are unwilling to abandon their own sect, claiming it's their home that took them in and raised them, and they can't abandon it."
"Also, because of our cultivation method in Corpse Chasing Sect, the faces of our members are whiter than ghost, like they have been dead for days. Some cultivators refuse to join us for this reason and choose other First Class Sects instead," Zhao Po pointed to his face, which was paler than a woman's. Whether legitimate corpse-drivers or not, they all looked alike.
Lu Yang nodded, agreeing with him. When he first met Zhao Po, he mistook him for a living corpse.
As they conversed, Qing Luo, demonstrating a solid foundation, easily defeated challenger after challenger with her masterful use of the Cloud Control Technique.
Finally, it was Meng Jingzhou's turn.
Meng Jingzhou revealed a confident smile, steadily walking onto the stage. His mere presence was enough to create an intense pressure.
"I am the disciple of Seek Dao Sect, Meng Jingzhou!"
At his words, the crowd's pupils contracted, prompting a wave of murmurs and restless chatter.
"Seek Dao Sect? The leading sect among the Five Great Immortal Sects?!"
"I heard that anyone who comes out from there is a peerless genius. Even those who run restaurants there could gain great reputation outside!"
"Why does the name Meng Jingzhou sound so familiar?"
"Isn't he the one from the Qingzhou grand ceremony?"
Upon hearing Meng Jingzhou's name, Lu Yang's face changed drastically, "You mean the Meng Jingzhou who had already formed the golden core, but still participated in the competition for the prize of Golden Core comprehension?"
"I heard he simply enjoys bullying those of a lower realm."
"Didn't he go to disrupt the Qingzhou grand ceremony?"
"No, he doesn't have any grudges with Qingzhou, he just wanted to challenge the judges."
Lu Yang added, "He didn't manage to beat the judges, and voluntarily jumped off the stage and forfeited."
There was a lot of speculation among the crowd, everyone was hearing something different, but none were far from the truth.
Qing Luo's face turned peculiar, she looked at Meng Jingzhou with clear disdain.
Clearly, she too had heard of Meng Jingzhou's reputation.
After the Qingzhou grand ceremony, the story of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou swept across the Central Continent like a whirlwind and was widely circulated among low-rank cultivators.
However, because of the vast range of the rumors, some information got skewed.
On hearing the whispering, Meng Jingzhou looked vexed. This was how his reputation got ruined.
"As a cultivator, I must have a steadfast heart. The opinions of others are like passing clouds to me. But why do I feel like I heard a familiar voice among all the whispers?"
"Nevermind, I'll think about it later. Let's win first!"
Meng Jingzhou gestured an 'after you', allowing Qing Luo to make the first move.
Since Meng Jingzhou met the contest rules, Qing Luo couldn't say much and took the lead. She manipulated auspicious clouds into forming various weapons which she aimed explosively at Meng Jingzhou.
This move alone had taken down many challengers.
"What a mastery of Cloud Control Technique!" Meng Jingzhou's eyes shone, readying his fist to meet the weapon onslaught.
"Exploding Punch!"
On collision with his punches, the eighteen weapons instantly dissociated into gentle billowing white clouds.
Qing Luo was formidable, but unluckily, she met Meng Jingzhou.
Even if Qing Luo was at the Golden Core Stage, she still wouldn't be a match for Meng Jingzhou.
It took only three punches from Meng Jingzhou to force out all Qing Luo's trump cards and press her into admitting defeat.
"I concede," she said.
Accepting her defeat gracefully, she bit her lip and said to Meng Jingzhou, "According to our sect's rules, whoever defeats me becomes my husband."
Meng Jingzhou's eyes sparkled, "In that case..."
Qing Luo made a firm decision that would shape her life trajectory.
"Going by that, I guess I'll have to abolish that rule!"

chapters.title: Chapter 421 - 420: Meng Jingzhou's Luck in Love Affairs_1
chapters.content:
Underneath the arena, Lu Yang was bent over with laughter, tears streaming down his face.
Zhao Po wanted to laugh as well, but he didn't think it would be right to laugh at Meng Jingzhou, so he tried hard to stifle his laughter.
Meng Jingzhou's face darkened. The people had abandoned even their ancestral teachings, what else could he say?
With the abandonment of the ancestral teachings, unbound by the previous rules, Qing Luo felt like she was seeing a more spacious world. She promptly left the arena and went back home.
Meng Jingzhou jumped off the arena, glaring fiercely at Lu Yang, who was still laughing, and Zhao Po, who was struggling to suppress his smile.
The three of them, a corpse and a horse, entered the city. Perhaps Meng Jingzhou's luck in love affairs had been suppressed for too long, and it exploded all at once, unstoppable.
First, they encountered a young woman who wanted to sell herself to afford her father's funeral. Dressed in mourning clothes, her beauty could still be seen. She said she was willing to sell herself in order to bury her father, even if it meant being a slave or a concubine. Seeing Meng Jingzhou, she timidly called him "young master," which made his heart flutter.
Although this woman had no cultivation level and had missed the golden time for cultivation, Fairy Eternity recognized her uniqueness at a glance.
"This is interesting, this young girl who is selling herself has a very rare Broken Delusion Dao Body. It seems frail now, but it is actually the Broken Delusion Dao Body gathering strength. After another six months to a year, her Dao Body will be fully awakened, and she will soar to the skies. She'll quickly catch up with the cultivation speed of her peers."
"If a perceptive old fellow comes to recruit her, takes her away for a few years, this little girl's achievements would be even greater."
There are nine major Immortal Bodies in the world, Tao Yaoye's Feather Transformation Immortal Body and the Sixth Elder's Pure Immortal Body are among them.
In addition to the nine major Immortal Bodies, there are also the widely known Thirty-Six Dao Bodies. Although Dao Bodies rank lower than Immortal Bodies, they are still considered geniuses who can claim a seat in the world's disputes in the Great Era. They are capable of being the capable assistants or right-hand men to geniuses like Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
Meng Jingzhou didn't know the story or constitution behind the young lady who wanted to sell herself. He simply thought she was pitiful and pretty, so he bought her.
Then he was duped.
The lady took the spirit stone saying she was going to bury her father, but then she never returned.
When the three reported it to the authorities, they were told that the girl was a habitual offender. They would file a case for investigation, but it was unlikely to be solved as the girl was hard to catch.
...
"My beautiful lady, please yield to this young master. I'll let you enjoy endless wealth and honor!" A lewd laugh came, signifying none other than a bad guy.
Meng Jingzhou was excited. He was familiar with this plot since Lu Yang had bragged to him about similar encounters, making him envious for a long time.
"Stop! Daring to forcibly seize a good woman in front of me!" Meng Jingzhou stood in the forefront, full of righteousness and ready to defend the weak.
After beating the entire family of the wicked young master, even the ancestors came out crying to him about their misfortune. They promised not to offend again in the future.
The beautiful woman was so grateful to Meng Jingzhou she declared, "I must repay your kindness in my next life, even if it means becoming your servant!"
Then she ran off, not wanting to stay with Meng Jingzhou for another second.
...
The three were about to check into an inn when they heard a dispute.
"Lu'er, do you still not understand my feelings for you? I really like you. Why don't you accept my feelings? Is there something wrong with me?" A rich young man in luxurious clothes and gloomy countenance stubbornly pursued a woman in a light green dress.
The woman called Lu'er could no longer stand the man's pursuit. Seeing that Meng Jingzhou and his companions were exceptional, her eyes lit up.
"I really can't accept your feelings. I already have someone I like!"
The gloomy young man obviously didn't believe it. He shook his head, saying, "Lu'er, don't fool me, it's not true."
Meng Jingzhou knew his luck in love affairs was coming. Lu'er pointed at Meng Jingzhou and said, "It's him, the one I like is him. We are already betrothed!"
Meng Jingzhou thought that his luck in love affairs had finally arrived, and even boasted about it to Lu Yang and Zhao Po.
Lu Yang advised Meng Jingzhou not to rush into things and analyzed the situation for him.
"That gloomy prince is obviously a tough guy, seems like a local bully, and is clearly not to be trifled with. He wants to take Lu'er for himself, but Lu'er doesn't like him, so she's looking for a human shield."
"You might not be afraid of local bullies like him, but Lu'er doesn't know that."
"You and Lu'er have only just met and she knows nothing about your identity. She doesn't know how strong you are, and she doesn't know whether your background can compete with the gloomy prince. To resist the prince's pursuit, she shoved you onto the front lines, and you will have to bear all the pressure."
"Do you think Lu'er will actually like you in such a situation?"
...
The three checked in at an inn. That very night, a woman in black broke through Meng Jingzhou's window. She was wearing a veil, revealing cat-like eyes shining like green gemstones.
Her eyes were filled with a lustful spring, panting heavily as if she was poisoned. She required pure yang energy to detoxify her, otherwise, she was in danger of body explosion and death.
There were only she and Meng Jingzhou in the room; hence only one solution was left.
The woman in black glanced at Meng Jingzhou with disgust, took out a detoxification pill from her Storage Ring, and took it. The best kinds of detoxification worked their magic, and then she hurriedly left.
In her line of work, all precautions had to be taken beforehand.
Meng Jingzhou did not even get a chance to speak during the whole process.
...
After resting for a night, the three were prepared to set off. As soon as they checked out of the inn, a pretty wealthy young lady sought out Meng Jingzhou for help as if he was her savior.
"Hello, are you from out of town?"
"Yes."
The young rich lady sighed in relief: "That's great, my mother won't know you then. You see, my mother has been pushing me to get married. I don't want to get married so I lied to her, telling her that I have a boyfriend. I managed to fool her so far, but I can't avoid it today. She insists on meeting my boyfriend. Could you pretend to be my boyfriend?
I will pay!"
Meng Jingzhou agreed happily.
"What's going on?" Zhao Po was surprised.
"Who knows?" Lu Yang shrugged, not too concerned.
The meeting with the parents went smoothly. Meng Jingzhou was put forward as the best candidate for the son-in-law, given his family background, character, cultivation level, and sect. But the young rich lady's mother just wouldn't agree. No matter how she looked at Meng Jingzhou, he didn't seem good enough.
In the end, Meng Jingzhou was driven away and the rich lady was told not to have any contact with him.
Afterward, the rich lady secretly sought Meng Jingzhou to explain: "I'm sorry. When I first met you, I found you quite annoying. My mother and I are quite similar, so she should have similar feelings. She would definitely disagree with you being my boyfriend, so she won't push me to get married".
"Here is the agreed reward; we better not meet each other again."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Damn it, this fucking curse is not that much better than before!
Along the way, Meng Jingzhou's luck in love affairs was endless. By the end of the journey, he had used up all his luck in love affairs, and the three of them finally arrived at the Corpse Chasing Sect without any trouble.

chapters.title: Chapter 422 - 421: Man Gu Who Loves to Learn (Extra chapter, Looking for Monthly Tickets)_1
chapters.content:
Wild State's main city is called Hanshui City, the most important and prosperous city in the Wild State. The Corpse Chasing Sect is located in the Yin Corpse Mountain Range outside Hanshui City, where the Yin Energy is the strongest, making it the most suitable place for nurturing corpses.
All the Corpse-drivers regard the Yin Corpse Mountain Range, where the Corpse Chasing Sect is located, as sacred ground.
Stepping into the territory of the Corpse Chasing Sect, although it is clearly a sunny day, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou cannot feel any warmth; instead, they feel a chill of Yin coldness.
Zhao Po shows a comfortable expression, seemingly enjoying the environment here.
Fairy Eternity is not surprised by this: "Not only Corpse-drivers, anyone who cultivates Yin Attribute Technique would feel comfortable here. Moreover, there won't be any thunder when it rains here, so it's very safe."
The so-called Yin Attribute Technique refers to practices related to ghosts, souls, corpses, etc. The Nine Nether Sect practices this type of Yin Attribute Technique.
Cultivators who practice Yin Attribute Technique are most afraid of thunder, as lightning represents the utmost Yang and rigid, and it restrains Yin Attribute Cultivators the most.
Among the twenty-four solar terms, there is one called "Awakening of Insects", which describes the intimidating effect of thunder on Yin objects.
"Senior Brother Zhao Po, you're back!"
Seeing Zhao Po return, two gatekeeper disciples quickly saluted.
They each also had a Living Corpse standing guard with them.
As the second person among the younger generation disciples, Zhao Po is an idol-like figure among these disciples.
Unlike the first person, Huang Ming, Zhao Po is willing to help others. Many people have received his assistance, making him very popular in the Corpse Chasing Sect.
"Senior Brother Zhao, who are these two... "
"They are friends of Dao from the Seek Dao Sect, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, here to visit our Corpse Chasing Sect."
The two gatekeeper disciples were shocked: "The Seek Dao Sect again?!"
"Again?"
"Senior Brother Zhao may not know, during the time you were out, another friend from the Seek Dao Sect visited our Sect. He was a barbarian, and he came here to learn corpse-driving techniques."
"Is his name Man Gu?" Lu Yang couldn't help but ask.
"Yes, that's his name."
"Why would Man Gu learn corpse-driving techniques? Isn't he a Confucian Cultivator?" Meng Jingzhou didn't understand.
"Who knows."
The two gatekeeper disciples notified their Sect, and the Sect Manager came out personally to welcome the two visitors.
"Could the Manager please inform the Sect Leader that we two are here to visit him?"
The Manager showed a troubled expression: "The Sect Leader is in a crucial moment of cultivation. After accepting Huang Ming as his disciple, he has been in closed-door cultivation and cannot meet anyone."
"I see, no problem. We can visit the elders of your Sect."
Anyway, they came here to find a solution for Meng Jingzhou, so it doesn't matter who they ask.
"Then I'll lead you two there myself, as my master is the Grand Elder." Zhao Po laughed.
After the Sect's competition ended, Huang Ming was taken as a disciple by the Sect Leader, and he was taken as a disciple by the Grand Elder; in terms of actual status, he is a bit higher than the Manager.
"In that case, we'll have to trouble Martial Nephew Zhao Po."
"Nothing of the sort, Uncle Mo."
The four of them with a corpse and a horse smoothly entered the Corpse Chasing Sect, arranged for Old horse, and went to find the Grand Elder of the Corpse Chasing Sect.
"What a delicious smell." Zhao Po's nose twitched, capturing a savory fragrance he had never smelled before.
"It does smell quite good, and it's familiar." Meng Jingzhou's nose twitched as well, catching the familiar smell of barbecue.
"It must be Man Gu." Lu Yang smiled.
Only the three of them, the Eternity Sect's higher-ups, and the Nine Nether Sect followers can barbecue with this flavor.
That is to say, aside from the demonic sect, only the three of them know how to do it.
"Come on, let's meet." Meng Jingzhou disregarded his own curse.
The three of them followed the scent to find Man Gu, or to put it more accurately, they had only to look for where the crowd was, not sniff out the aroma.
The disciples of the Corpse Chasing Sect had gathered together, doing something unknown but the fragrant smell was coming from the center of the crowd.
"Make way, make way." The three of them squeezed into the front row of the crowd and saw Man Gu.
Man Gu was sitting cross-legged on the ground, mumbling some incantations.
Two sheep carcasses danced atop the fire, applying seasoning to each other. The aroma of seasoned sheep meat perfectly integrated with the fire, creating a mouth-watering scent.
The two sheep carcasses were roasted until they had an appealing color, tempting everyone around them.
"Partition!" Man Gu shouted, and the two sheep carcasses voluntarily broke down into smaller pieces, each person got a piece.
The disciples of the Corpse Chasing Sect had been waiting for this moment, savouring the food with continuous praise.
"I have never tasted such delicious roasted whole sheep. Look at this skin, it's crispy and aromatic. And this meat, the juice fills up your mouth with the first bite."
"Not just that, the roasted whole sheeps I have tasted before were unevenly heated, some parts were overcooked, some parts were undercooked. But look at this one roasted by our friend Man Gu, it's so flavorful, even the bones have tasted."
"That's why the Seek Dao Sect is so resourceful. Why didn't we think of using corpse-driving skills for roasting? The result is fantastic."
"That's why they get to join the Seek Dao Sect and we can't. Their level of thinking is different."
"It's not just about the level of thinking. Man Gu's talent is also high. Look at us, we took three to five years to learn corpse-driving, while our friend Man Gu got the basics in just half a month."
"His dedication to learning is stronger than ours."
Man Gu responded with extreme modesty: "You are all flattering me too much. My little skill compared to my two senior brothers, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, is like a small sorcerer before a great wizard. Especially, if Brother Lu Yang could learn corpse-driving, combined with the Three-flavored True Fire, the taste of this roasted whole sheep would reach another level!"
Everyone was left wondering just how much tastier it could get.
Lu Yang: "..."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
No wonder Man Gu, you sneaky guy, came to learn the corpse-driving skill. You still remember the conversation in the dense forest, don't you?
When Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, Tao Yaoye, and Man Gu were training in the dense forest, they killed many demon beasts. At that time, Man Gu noticed the problem of uneven heat when roasting the whole demon beast, and proposed using corpse-driving for roasting.
Even the powerful support of ancient Barbarian tribes - Fairy Eternity - highly praised this method.
"Man Gu is doing great with his learning. He can not only make the sheep corpse stand on the fire for roasting, it even decomposes automatically."
The two of them knew from Zhao Po that decomposition of a living corpse was a very difficult fighting technique to master.
"Man Gu, long time no see!"
The two of them greeted him, unable to hide their smiles.
Hearing the familiar voices, Man Gu suddenly looked up, his eyes light up at the sight of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
"Brother Lu, Brother Meng, what are you guys doing here?"
"Old Meng has done so many bad things that he got what he deserves." Lu Yang smirked.
"Bad things?" Man Gu was puzzled. In his impression, both Brother Lu and Brother Meng were his role models and great people. How could they do bad things?
"Old Meng got cursed and now he is very unpopular with women."
Man Gu suddenly realized that Meng must have deliberately gotten cursed to show his commitment to cultivation by developing the full potential his Single Body Spiritual Root, demonstrating his resolve to practice.
In the time that he had been learning the corpse-driving skill, Brother Lu and Brother Meng must have been competing against each other, practicing diligently.
On the other hand, he was self-satisfied once he learned a little bit of corpse-driving, and it didn't even elevate his cultivation level. Compared with Brother Meng, he was merely wasting time.
He felt deeply ashamed.

chapters.title: Chapter 423 - 422: Man Gu: Is Heaven's Court Still Recruiting People_1
chapters.content:
"So you mean to say, Brother Meng, you've been subjected to karmic backlash, causing women to unconsciously despise you, and so you came to the Wild State to find a solution?" Man Gu had an enlightening moment after hearing the stories from Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
Well, it truly is Brother Meng. He encounters high-end problems like this. How many Golden Core Stage cultivators could experience karmic backlash?
The roast whole lamb was completely eaten, and the three brothers were catching up at a place slightly far away from the disciples of the Corpse Chasing Sect.
"And what about you, how did you come to the Corpse Chasing Sect? Did you come by yourself?"
"Didn't I go home to participate in the tribe's coming-of-age ceremony? After the ceremony, I proposed that I wanted to come to the Corpse Chasing Sect to learn corpse chasing techniques, which would be useful for barbecuing. The clan leader sent me over and took the opportunity to visit Master Ru.
However, Master Ru was in closed-door cultivation, so the clan leader didn't disturb him and left me at the Corpse Chasing Sect before returning."
The Sect Leader of the Corpse Chasing Sect, Lu Baqian, was at the late stage of Unification.
"Originally, I was thinking of sparring with Huang Ming from the Corpse Chasing Sect, but he seems to have gone out on a mission and hasn't returned yet."
"I've heard that the coming-of-age ceremony of the Barbarian tribe is very dangerous, requiring one to fight against a Golden Core Stage Demon Beast." As the current Eldest Senior Brother, Lu Yang was very concerned about the safety of Junior Brother Man.
Man Gu showed a simple-hearted smile, scratching the back of his head and saying, "It's not particularly dangerous. After all, when we three were at the initial Foundation Establishment stage, we infiltrated the demonic sect, and during the late Foundation Establishment stage, we went into the dense forest and fought Golden Core Stage Demon Beasts."
Indeed, compared to those two incidents, it was as safe for Man Gu to kill a Golden Core Stage Demon Beast with his Golden Core Stage cultivation level, as it was to return to the Seek Dao Sect.
At this time, Zhao Po came over: "My master usually spends most of his time cultivating, and he happens to be free now."
"Then let's go." Meng Jingzhou smiled, feeling that luck was gradually leaning toward him. But immediately, he became alert and asked, "Is your master male or female?"
"Male."
"Great."
Man Gu didn't need to learn the corpse chasing techniques anymore. His requirements for mastering the corpse chasing techniques weren't high, as long as he could barbecue, he was willing to follow Meng Jingzhou to find the Grand Elder.
Man Gu said cheerfully, "Seeing you guys reminded me of something fun. A barbecue restaurant called 'Again!' has opened in Hanshui City. It shares our name, but theirs is a chain restaurant, claiming to inherit a secret ancient recipe."
"Originally, I wanted to try it, but I never had the time." Man Gu shook his head regretfully.
Lu Yang: "..."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
"Actually, the restaurant you saw is somewhat related to us." Lu Yang secretly informed Man Gu, this matter couldn't be discussed in front of Zhao Po, as it might lead him to misunderstand that they were from the demonic sect.
"I never had the chance to tell you before you went home, but during this period, Old Meng and I made contact with the people from the Nine Nether..."
After hearing everything, Man Gu was left dumbfounded for a long time, unable to react.
Just during the time he went home, Brother Lu and Brother Meng had established Heaven's Court and had even pulled in Eldest Senior Sister, the Sect Leader, Elders, and Tao Yaoye, making the Nine Nether open barbecue chain restaurants.
He hadn't been at home for very long, not even two months.
No wonder Brother Lu and Brother Meng were incredible.
"Don't worry, you're a technical investor, and you get 10% of the profits from the barbecue restaurant."
After all, the recipe the barbecue restaurant used was a traditional one passed down from Man Gu's family.
Man Gu didn't really care about the profits. After all, he was the only one left of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe. The whole tribe regarded him as a cash cow, so he wasn't short of Spirit Stones, and he just didn't have much use for them in his usual routines.
"Is Heaven's Court still recruiting?" Man Gu proactively asked to join the two role models.
"Yes, of course, we need geniuses like you in Heaven's Court!" Lu Yang laughed. Even if Man Gu didn't actively mention it, he had intended to bring up the subject.
The top five in Lu Yang's same batch had all joined Heaven's Court.
The group arrived at the deepest part of the Corpse Chasing Sect, and the atmosphere became increasingly chilly.
An old man was sitting in the opulent and vacant hall. His pupils were cold, devoid of any emotions.
"Master, these are the wayfarers from the Seek Dao Sect that I mentioned to you, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou. You should've met Daoist Man Gu already."
"We have met, Grand Elder!" Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou bowed in respect, paying their respects as the younger generation.
"Enough, there's no need for such formalities between us. Both you, Daoist Buyu's disciple, and the Meng family boy have ties with me." The old man chuckled. His aged eyes regained their warmth.
"My surname is Ge. You can just call me Elder Ge."
"This is the letter Fourth Elder wrote for you." Lu Yang handed over the letter Fourth Elder had written as an introduction to the Corpse Chasing Sect.
"It's been a long time since I've seen a letter from Master Xie. His calligraphy is pleasing to the eye and invaluable. Just this letter alone has the qualifications to be auctioned...hmph, have any of you opened this letter?" Elder Ge looked displeased, feeling these youngsters lacked respect. How could a letter between elders be casually opened?
"It wasn't us who opened it, it was Lord Shuang who opened it." Lu Yang explained helplessly.
"Female demon?" Upon hearing the name 'Lord Shuang', Elder Ge's hand shivered. He hurriedly used his Spiritual Sense to scan the letter repeatedly, fearing that Shuang Feiyan had cursed him through it.
This had happened before.
"Fortunately, fortunately. The letter is safe... What happened, tell me slowly."
"Fourth Elder asked us to come to the Wild State to seek a cure for the curse, suggesting that we first ask for a solution from your sect. It's our first time in the Wild State, and we're unfamiliar with this place. We heard that the Seven Emotions Valley's curse technique is extraordinary, so we decided to go there first..."
The corner of Elder Ge's eye kept twitching. These unseasoned calves aren't afraid of the tiger. Being Daoist Buyu's disciple and holding Master Xie's introduction letter, you went to find Shuang Feiyan. This is as if you wanted to die.
Especially at the end of the introduction letter, Master Xie referred to Shuang Feiyan as the 'female demon.' This was a private nickname, and no one dared to say it to her face.
That this cub could stand perfectly fine in front of him showed that his luck was extraordinary.
"Old Lu can solve this curse issue, but you'll have to wait. Old Lu is currently in closed-door cultivation, attempting to break through to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. Once he is successful, your curse won't be a problem anymore."
"Breaking through to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage?!" Everyone was shocked at the same time.
Master Ru and Daoist Buyu, as well as the various elders of the Seek Dao Sect, were of similar age, or one could say, elders and leaders of various forces belonged to similar generations. They secretly competed to see who could breakthrough to Transcendance Tribulation Stage first, but they hadn't expected Master Ru to take the first step.
Lu Yang was the first to react. He stepped forward, made a fist salute and actively said, "Do we need to inform our elders about this matter, to celebrate for Master Ru together?"
The Seek Dao Sect and the Corpse Chasing Sect had a good relationship. In both aspects of emotion and principle, Master Ru's breakthrough to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage was a joyous occasion, and the Seek Dao Sect should send someone to congratulate them.
His and Meng Jingzhou's status were not enough to represent the Seek Dao Sect in offering congratulations.
Elder Ge waved his hands: "No, right before Old Lu went into seclusion, he specifically told me not to tell anyone about his breakthrough to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. He wanted to surprise others. I've told you this matter, so you shouldn't tell anyone else about it."

chapters.title: Chapter 424 - 423: Ghost Disaster_1
chapters.content:
"Old Lu should break through in about three to five days, so you can wait."
"Recently, Hanshui City has been plagued by several ghost disasters. If you have nothing to do these days, you can go to catch ghosts near Hanshui City. You can also earn contribution points by swapping them for the certificate I'll write for you." Elder Gai laughed, caring for the three juniors Lu Yang.
"Ghost disasters?" Lu Yang was puzzled. Hanshui City was presided over by a governor and assisted by the Corpse Chasing Sect. No ghost disaster would dare to rise.
Elder Gai sighed, "The previous governor was reported and taken away by someone, along with a group of officials. There has been a shuffle in the Wild State's officialdom."
"At this time, many ghost disasters suddenly appeared in Hanshui City. Even rules are difficult to completely prohibit them. It is likely that a Unification Stage is fighting in secret."
"The newly appointed governor could barely stand before he was confronted with this situation, which was not handled properly, and the ghost disasters remained unchecked."
"The Nine Nether Sect is best at expelling ghosts. The governor suspects that the Nine Nether Sect is causing trouble in secret, but there has been no result from the strict investigation."
"Our Corpse Chasing Sect, as a well-known major Sect in the Wild State, naturally bears the responsibility, encouraging our disciples to solve the ghost disasters. The level of ghost disasters is not high and should be manageable for you."
"Of course, you can also choose to study corpse-chasing in our Sect. It's up to you."
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou exchanged glances, seeing the confusion in each other's eyes.
Why would the Nine Nether Sect cause trouble in secret? They are busy running a barbecue shop, where do they get the time to do this? Is it because the barbecue shop is not making enough money?
No matter who created the ghost disasters, as disciples of the Seek Dao Sect, they need to deal with it.
After bidding farewell to Elder Gai, the voice of Fairy Eternity echoed in Lu Yang's mind.
"The old guy just now wasn't a living person, but a living corpse. It's a very clever craftsmanship."
"Who?" Lu Yang thought he had heard wrong.
"That old guy just now."
Lu Yang mulled over, quickly thinking of the most plausible explanation, cold sweat breaking out: Elder Gai is dead, unknown to anyone, someone has refined Elder Gai's corpse to create the illusion that Elder Gai is still alive.
"Brother Zhao, I feel there's something odd about Elder Gai." Lu Yang said tentatively.
Zhao Po gave a thumbs up: "Brother Lu has good eyesight. You could even notice that. The person you saw wasn't my master, but a living corpse my master crafted."
"How did this happen?" Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu grew interested.
Zhao Po laughed as he explained, not evading at all: "We, as corpse-drivers, have been in contact with Corpse Qi and death Qi for many years, causing disharmony in our bodies, an excess of Yin and lack of Yang, resulting in physical weakness. We can't even compare with ordinary cultivators, let alone body cultivators like Brother Meng."
"A corpse-driver's cultivation is all reflected in the living corpses they craft. All Divinity Transformation Stage corpse-drivers no longer show their true selves for safety reasons, but let the living corpses they have crafted replace them instead."
"Not only my master but all the elders in the Sect also use crafted living corpses to replace themselves when interacting with the outer world. No one knows where their true forms are."
Most corpse-drivers are introverted due to their long-term interactions with corpses, and Zhao Po is one of the rare extroverts.
"So that's how it is." Lu Yang suddenly understood that he had been overthinking.
"Next, do you want to go to our academy for learning, or shall I accept a task for us to solve the ghost disasters together?"
Lu Yang hooked a faint smile at the corner of his mouth, speaking seriously: "Of course, we should go solve the ghost disasters. Old Meng has a Single Body Spiritual Root, achieved dual Single Golden Elixirs, and possesses a full yang body causing all ghosts to flee on sight!"
"With Old Meng taking action, solving ghost disasters will be a breeze!"
Even though Lu Yang rarely praised himself, and everything he said was true, Meng Jingzhou just couldn't get happy.
You are the one with Single Body Spiritual Root, your whole family has Single Body Spiritual Roots!
Sometimes Meng Jingzhou really wanted to hit Lu Yang with a Punch of Single Body Curse, but he didn't dare.
Intuition told him that if he used the Punch of Single Body Curse on Lu Yang, the counter attack from Causality would be more severe than now, and then it would truly be irredeemable.
Just wait and see, Lu Yang. I'll hit you with a punch after I become immortal!
"So, does that mean we can take any task for the Golden Core Stage?" Zhao Po thought, the four of them going out in the Golden Core Stage could sweep ghost disaster tasks.
Lu Yang waved his hand broadly: "Be bold, we can even take tasks for the Nascent Soul Stage."
Zhao Po was shocked for a moment, but soon caught on. The four of them working together should have no problem dealing with Nascent Soul Stage ghosts.
"Okay, then I will look for a task for the Nascent Soul Stage. You three just wait a little bit."
While Zhao Po was accepting a task, Lu Yang was free, so he pulled out the Nine Qui Order, connected with Vice Headmaster Shi and sent a message.
"Our Heaven's Court sect has a Heavenly King in Hanshui City of the Wild State. It was found that out that there are ghost disasters here. The governor suspects it's your doing. Did you do it?"
He waited for a while, and the Nine Qui Order didn't respond. Lu Yang was preparing to put it away, thinking that Vice Headmaster Shi was busy and hadn't seen the Nine Qui Order. Suddenly the Nine Qui Order became hot, and a long message appeared on the surface.
Lu Yang was speechless: "Turns out it wasn't that Vice Headmaster Shi didn't see it, he was just busy writing a lot."
The reply from Vice Headmaster Shi was:
"This is pure slander. Those bastards from the imperial court are blaming us again. Every time something unclear happens, they say it's our demonic sect doing it. We are too busy making money to have such leisure time! We agree with what Young Master Lu said about 'Dine & Defense'. We should focus on cultivation and increase the number of Unification Stage and Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
Most of our Nine Nether Sect's activities are semi-stagnant, and everyone in the Sect is busy making money by opening chain stores. This is a decision made by the Master."
...
In the Nine Nether Sect division, Vice Headmaster Shi was irritated when he saw Lu Yang's question.
"We barely have enough time to make money, so where would we have time to cause trouble with ghosts? What benefits could we get from it? The imperial court has falsely accused us more than once or twice. They always blame our demonic sect for things they can't clear up. We're too busy to do such things!"
As he replied to Lu Yang, he cursed out loud. If this causes Heaven's Court to misunderstand and think that the Nine Nether Sect is acting recklessly despite the overall situation, it will be difficult to cooperate deeply in the future.
After replying, he felt it necessary to explain something to Lu Yang, but found that the Nine Qui Order could not be used.
"It needs to cool down for five days, what a drag."
Vice Headmaster Shi looked at the ceiling while leaning back in his chair, then smacked his forehead: "Hey, why am I worrying about this? The Master is in Wild State, isn't he?"
He took out another Nine Qui Order, told the Master about what Lu Yang had said, and waited for the Master's instructions on how to handle it.
The Master replied quickly, with just one line.
"I am in Hanshui City."

chapters.title: Chapter 425 - 424 Lu Yang: It's My Turn to Take Action_1
chapters.content:
"There is a small village southeast of Hanshui City called Baishui Village. There was a couple who lived there, the husband's name was Liu San. One day, he awoke to find an unusual silence, his wife who usually woke him was nowhere to be found."
"Liu San called out for his wife in their home, but receiving no response, he started searching. Eventually, he found his wife drowned in a basin."
"The coroner found no signs of struggle at the time of his wife's death. It was as if she had willingly drowned herself in the basin. Greatly puzzled, the authorities were alerted. After a thorough investigation, the government office deemed it to be the work of a drowned ghost."
"A drowned ghost is a mournful spirit formed from someone who died from drowning and encountered strong yin energy at the moment of their death. These spirits cause havoc among the living."
"Drowned ghosts usually inhabit rivers, lakes, and oceans. Coincidentally, there is a cold pool close to Baishui Village. The water in the pool is so cold that it will make anyone who drinks it regularly sick. It's filled with a strong yin energy, which is a perfect dwelling place for drowned ghosts."
"A Senior Brother in the late part of Golden Core stage happened to pass by when he was returning to Sect. After hearing about this incident, he went to investigate the cold pool and commanded a living corpse into the water to capture the drowned ghost."
"However, that drowned ghost was extremely powerful, at least in the Half-step Nascent Soul stage, and possibly even in the Nascent Soul's early stage."
"The ghost issue in Hanshui City is too frequent, the government office and the Sect are short-handed and unable to find extra manpower to handle this drowned ghost."
"So, would you like to accept this task?"
Zhao Po received a task and briefly summarised it to Lu Yang and the others.
Meng Jingzhou felt the drowned ghost was of no challenge: "It sounds straightforward; do we have anything more challenging?"
"There's a female ghost getting engaged in the spirit marriage..."
"Just the drowned ghost then." Meng Jingzhou hurriedly interrupted Zhao Po's words.
It must be a joke; with his current situation, either the female ghost would dislike him so much that she would not show up, or she would want to kill him at a glance.
"Fine, let's get started." Before departing, Zhao Po handed each of the three a soul dispersing talisman.
"What type of talisman is this?"
"Soul Dispersing Charm. This was made specially by our Sect. All disciples who are assigned to resolve ghost disasters receive one. We found it hard to exterminate ghosts completely. Even when a fierce ghost is knocked down and weakened, it's challenging to kill without the right methods.
This talisman was made overnight in collaboration with the government office's talisman masters and ghost catching daoists."
The disciples of the Corpse Chasing Sect are all corpse-drivers, they cultivate Yin Attribute techniques, and their skills are akin to fierce ghosts. They can defeat fierce ghosts, but it's difficult for them to kill."
"Once we have defeated the drowned ghost, we can use this talisman to deal with it!"
"Your Sect really thinks of everything." Lu Yang laughed and placed the Soul Dispersing Charm safely away. But in reality, it wasn't necessary for them."
With Meng Jingzhou, the absolute killer of ghosts, on their side, they could burn fierce ghosts to death.
Both Pure Yang True Fire and Three Flavored True Fire could counter fierce ghosts.
The cold pool was on the other side of Corpse Chasing Sect, separated by the entire Hanshui City. The group left the Corpse Chasing Sect, passed directly through Hanshui City, and passed by the barbecue shop that was still in its trial operation period."
Hanshui City was just as bustling as ever. People were coming and going, and the ghost disaster hadn't had much impact on the city's prosperity."
On one hand, Hanshui City was crowded and filled with Yang Qi, so ghosts didn't dare to step in and cause chaos."
On the other hand, even if people went home, it wasn't necessarily safer. A door wouldn't stop a mischievous ghost. On the contrary, crowded public places were safer."
The group of four and a corpse followed the instructions given in the task and reached the cold pool after passing through Baishui Village."
Standing by the pool, the four could feel the chill that the pool emanated."
The pool was surrounded by mountains on three sides, never exposed to sunlight, and full of lush vegetation, especially the old locust trees, were eye-catching."
Under several factors, the pool water had become icy cold."
The pool water was clear, but you couldn't see the bottom, so they were unable to determine the location of the drowned ghost."
"That's strange, why isn't there a single fish?" Meng Jingzhou was puzzled. According to logic, there should be plenty of fish in such a place; it wouldn't be surprising if there were catches weighing more than a hundred kilos."
But the reality was, there wasn't a single fish in the pool, not even fry."
"Did the ghost eat them? Can ghosts eat fish?"
Lu Yang pushed the problem-centered Meng Jingzhou aside and squatted on the ground to observe the pool: "Don't bother about whether it eats fish or not, just ask after we've caught it. The current problem is how to get down there; who among us is good at swimming and can lure the fierce ghost out?"
The four individuals looked at each other; Lu Yang was a Sword Spirit Root, Meng Jingzhou was a Single Body Spiritual Root, Man Gu was of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe, and Zhao Po was a corpse-driver, none of them were skilled swimmers.
"I'll take care of it, I'll send the living corpse down!"
Zhao Po lit up three sticks of incense and offered three bows to the living corpse, which inhaled the scent of the incense. Its pale skin gained a bit of flush and its empty gaze turned a tad livelier.
The living corpse jumped into the icy lake. The once undisturbed water began to ripple — it was evident that the living corpse had found the drowned ghost and was now fighting it.
The strength of a ghost lies in the fear it instills in the living and the vulnerability of the spirit - both of which had no effect on the living corpse.
Zhao Po broke out into a cold sweat, his teeth chattering. He was able to synchronically perceive the living corpse's sensations, feeling the pressing power of the fierce ghost before the living corpse.
"Brother Zhao?" Lu Yang asked, concerned.
"The information was incorrect; the drowned ghost is not in the half-step nascent soul or nascent soul initial stage but in the nascent soul mid-stage!"
"The living corpse also saw a woman's body down there, probably the woman who drowned in Baishui Village!"
"The living corpse is luring the drowned ghost out now, get ready!" Zhao Po yelled.
Upon hearing this, Lu Yang and his two companions quickly adopted combat stances, ready to launch a fierce attack as soon as the drowned ghost surfaced.
Boom —
The surface of the water exploded, a figure leaped out.
"Three Flavored True Fire!"
"Pure Yang True Fire!"
"Dominant Barbarian King Punch!"
The three attacked simultaneously, their strikes almost striking the figure before Zhao Po hastily yelled out to stop.
"Stop, stop, stop — that's not the drowned ghost, it's my living corpse!"
The three quickly changed the direction of their attacks, striking the rocky cliff instead, causing large stones to roll down and a loud rumbling noise.
Zhao Po's eye twitched as he observed the extraordinary power of their attacks, which was far from comparable to someone at the Golden Core stage.
"Where is the drowned ghost?" Lu Yang asked, bewildered.
Zhao Po showed a bashful smile: "I called out too loudly when I asked you to prepare earlier, the drowned ghost heard it and retreated, knowing it was an ambush."
"That makes things difficult. Since it knows there's an ambush, it definitely won't fall for our trap." Man Gu frowned, uncertain of what to do.
"What if we use the storage ring to drain the water?" Meng Jingzhou suggested.
Zhao Po shook his head, "No, the icy lake has already become the drowned ghost's territory, the storage ring cannot withdraw occupied objects."
Lu Yang smiled confidently: "Leave this to me. You will witness the effect of an ultimate technique I've been laboriously practicing for a long time!"
"You've learned some aberrant skill again?" Meng Jingzhou asked curiously.
"This divine ability is quite well-known; you'll know once you see it!" Lu Yang replied with feigned profoundness, arousing Meng Jingzhou's curiosity even more.
"Show me."
Lu Yang paced by the lake, using his magical power to create a wind below his robe. His robe fluttered, giving off faerie vibes.
"This message is for the ghost lurking below, if you refuse to come out now, then don't blame me for what I do!"
The lake remained calm.
Lu Yang already predicted the ghost wouldn't respond. He flipped his palm and pressed it against the water and then lifted it sharply. The water formed a whirlpool leading into his palm, revealing the drowned ghost at the bottom of the lake.
Turning around, Lu Yang waved his sleeve with a flourish: "Guess what this is, the outcome of my intense training..."
Seeing this scene, Zhao Po was speechless, stuttering, "This, this is the proverbial Universe within the Sleeve!"
With a flick of his sleeve, the lake water was drawn into his sleeve and vanished. What else could it be, if not the Universe within the Sleeve?
"...Yes, this is exactly what it is, the Universe within the Sleeve!"

chapters.title: Chapter 426 - 425: Excellent Effects of Arhat Fist_1
chapters.content:
Before Zhao Po could recover from his shock, the four of them felt a vast and chilling spiritual essence rising from the bottom of the pool.
A fierce ghost, wrapped in waterweeds and dripping wet, flew out, its cold eyes filled with a trace of fear as it looked at Lu Yang.
"Excellent, a child mastering the Universe within the Sleeve! The Great Xia Dynasty truly is full of incredibly talented geniuses!" The drowned ghost stared fixedly at Lu Yang with a deathly expression, considering him to be the biggest threat.
There was no fluctuation from a magic artifact, indicating it must be a space-related magic skill. To absorb an entire pond of water with his sleeve, it could only be the Universe within the Sleeve!
To master such a difficult magic skill at the Golden Core Stage, what an extraordinary genius!
Lu Yang squinted his eyes and demanded, "Oh, so you're not a local Fierce Ghost from Great Xia? Where do you come from and why did you appear in Hanshui City!"
The drowned ghost sneered coldly, ignoring Lu Yang's question. "Why should I tell you everything?"
These youngsters may have talents for magic skills, but with a whole realm of difference between them, why would they think they can beat him?
They have no idea about the strength of their opponents.
Having said that, the drowned ghost decided to flee.
Why engage in combat when he could run away?
"Trying to run? Take this punch!"
Meng Jingzhou was the first to take action, unleashing his Arhat Fist. The resonance of Buddha's sound reverberated, and the Pure Yang True Fire covered the surface of his fist, constantly surging on and off.
"So hot!" The drowned ghost didn't expect Meng Jingzhou to be this quick. Caught off guard, he was directly hit by the attack. The combination of Buddhist techniques and Pure Yang True Fire, both of which are excellent counters to fierce ghosts, was too much for him to resist!
"A Golden Core stage cultivator displaying the combat power of Nascent Soul Stage, plus this move... you're not from Corpse Chasing Sect!" The drowned ghost's underestimation led to him losing the first move.
"It seems I'll have to eliminate you brats if I want to get away today!" The drowned ghost gritted its teeth, wanting to avoid unnecessary trouble.
"Hmm, after drowning a mortal in a basin, do you still think you can escape?"
"Dammit, what does it have to do with you if I drown a mortal? The cultivators of Great Xia are such a nuisance!" The drowned ghost started cursing badly. The water area was his domain but it had been seized by Lu Yang. He did not want to fight under current circumstances.
If he can't escape now, then fight!
"As Deep As Abyss!"
A dark abyss spread out from beneath the drowned ghost, thick and sticky like blood, it spread rapidly to the four of them.
The bone-chilling cold spread from their feet to their heads, it took considerable effort to even move their bodies. Worse yet, after being touched by the dark water, breathing became difficult, as if they were suffocating.
Golden Core Stage cultivators can have internal circulation in their bodies, not needing to breathe and shouldn't feel suffocation, yet here they were suffocating in the dark water.
Lu Yang's index and middle finger came together, and he shouted, "Break!"
The dark water retreated and the group snapped back to reality.
What they had experienced was not actually happening but instead, an illusion, a favorite tactic of the drowned ghost. Lu Yang's abilities just happened to be the perfect counter to illusions!
The moment illusion broke, endless water grass wrapped around the group. This was the very thing that had caused the drowned ghost's death and was now his power.
"Sweep!" The Green Peak Sword stabbed towards the ground. Endless Sword Qi spread across the ground, cutting off the roots of the water grass.
"Let's do this together—Sword Decree!"
"Arhat Fist!"
"Dominant Barbarian King Punch!"
The three of them attacked the Drowning Ghost at once. The ghost barely moved but instantly appeared behind Man Gu with a stalk of water plant wrapped around Man Gu's neck.
This kid seems naive and simple, should be the easiest to deal with.
Man Gu didn't even pay attention to what was happening behind him. He snapped his head back hard, causing the Drowning Ghost to loosen the water plant in its hand.
The three geniuses and the ghost fought again. Zhao Po was at a loss as to how to help.
The battle in front of him had escalated beyond his level, and was now more appropriate for cultivators at the Nascent Soul Stage.
"I thought we were all at the Golden Core Stage?" Zhao Po felt like he had been bamboozled.
"Arhat Fist!" Lu Yang also used the Arhat Fist in conjunction with the Three Flavored True Fire.
The Drowning Ghost had already prepared for this and managed to dodge most of Lu Yang's attacks. However, the combination of Lu Yang's Arhat Fist with the underground movement was hard to defend against. One of his punches hit the Drowning Ghost's shoulder.
Ignoring the pain caused by the True Fire and blows, the Drowning Ghost became aware of a more frightful situation.
"My hair!"
The Drowning Ghost's hair, which was soaked in water and had a unique style, started to fall out from the impact of the Arhat Fist.
"Hmm, seems like it works on ghosts too." Lu Yang was also surprised. He simply tried to counter the ghost using Buddhist techniques and didn't expect it to lose hair.
"Eighteen Continuous Strokes!" Man Gu took out a huge hammer and frantically hammered the Drowning Ghost while reciting a saint's sayings.
"Are you a Confucian Cultivator?!" The ghost's expression changed abruptly as it felt the righteousness radiating from the hammer.
After studying Confucian classics for a long time, Man Gu developed a righteous aura. Although his progress was slow, his attitude was commendable, hence he acquired this aura of righteousness.
The yin energy that pervaded the pond started to dissipate under the relentless attacks of the three men. If they kept it up, they might disperse all of the yin energy in the area!
The Drowning Ghost was enraged. This was his haven, and these guys dared to ruin it. He cried in anger, "You guys… stop it… don't force me… I surrender."
If it was a one-on-one fight, Lu Yang would use the Invincible Elixir to speed up the fight. But in a three-versus-one situation, they didn't need the elixir at all.
The Drowning Ghost was sprawled on the ground, utterly desperate.
Arhat Fist, True Fire, Righteous Aura… The Drowning Ghost wondered if he had picked a bad day to go out. There were only a few techniques that could counter fierce ghosts, and he had run into all of them.
Having lost home field advantage, facing techniques specifically to counter ghosts, and pitched against geniuses who could fight above their level, there was no way he could win.
"We won already?" Zhao Po and the Living Corpse approached. The battle had started and ended so quickly that they hadn't kept up with the rhythm.
Zhao Po was talented, but compared to the geniuses, he was a bit less experienced.
Although he had roamed the world and experienced many things, he fell short when compared to the reckless trio who frequently challenged stronger opponents.
Lu Yang took out a Soul Dispersing Charm, which scared the Drowning Ghost into retreating.
"Wait, wait, my crimes aren't that grave."
Lu Yang was undeterred, "You've drowned people; how can you say your crimes aren't grave?"
"It's fake, all fake! The person isn't dead, look at the bottom of the pond, they're alive!" The Drowning Ghost cried out in desperation.
Lu Yang leaned over to look, sure enough, there was a living woman at the bottom of the pond. It seemed that the Living Corpse was mistaken earlier since he immediately assumed she was dead.
Lu Yang used his spiritual essence to form a large hand, lifting the woman up and placing her next to the Drowning Ghost.
"Explain what's going on."

chapters.title: Chapter 427 - 426 What Does A Ghost Need Money For?_1
chapters.content:
"Which ghoul are you from, are you from the Nine Nether Sect?" Zhao Po pretended to be stern, interrogating the Drowned Ghost.
The Drowned Ghost shook its head emphatically, stressing its lack of malice: "I came here purely by accident, really."
