"I was originally a fisherman from the East Sea, and after I drowned, I became a vengeful spirit. As it happened, my corpse encountered a sinister wind stone, and I became a Drowned Ghost."
"The East Sea is boundless, teeming with life, and full of schools of fish, so I secretly absorbed the Yang Qi of various sea tribes, gradually advancing my cultivation level. From being a Drowned Ghost who couldn't bear sunlight, I ascended to the Qi Refinement Stage Drowned Ghost, gaining the power to protect myself."
"Once I was able to defend myself, I relaxed and roamed the East Sea. I became bolder, scaring people whenever I surfaced, and tried to reach parts of the East Sea I had never dared to go before. As soon as I left the safe waters, I encountered a Fish King that weighed over a hundred pounds, who was about to swallow me with one gulp."
"Seeing that I was in danger, I hastily returned to the safe waters, deciding never to leave them again!"
"While in the safe-zone, I slowly cultivated, devouring the Yang Qi of schools of fish, sometimes even stealing offerings from the fishermen."
"We fishermen have the habit of worshiping the East Sea. Having drowned, it's clear that worshiping the East Sea can't guarantee safety, so I dared to eat offerings without reservations."
"Later, I didn't know what stage I had cultivated to. I just kept cultivating in seclusion, not bothering with anyone. One day, I met a cultivator who wanted to capture me for cultivation. I easily drove him away, obtaining his storage ring and some cultivation techniques. After studying the techniques, I realized that I had reached the late stage of Foundation Establishment.
By that time, I had been dead for two hundred years."
"Knowing the direction of my cultivation, I continued to cultivate. After another eight hundred years, I finally cultivated to the Mid-stage of Nascent Soul. During this period, I never once left the safe waters."
"I had originally planned to leave the safe waters only after reaching the Spirit Transformation Stage. Unexpectedly, someone ambushed me. One slap knocked me unconscious, and when I woke up, I was in this pool."
Lu Yang interrupted the Drowned Ghost's testimony: "So, you're saying you have no idea who brought you here?"
"I don't know."
"Did that person have any distinguishing characteristics?"
"Stronger than me."
"... Continue."
"After several days, I finally figured out what was happening. It turns out that this is near Hanshui City in the Wild State of the Great Xia Dynasty, the westernmost part of the Central Continent. It's countless miles away from the East Sea."
"Given my situation, I can't use a flying ship or anything, so I have to stay here."
"When I was investigating the surroundings, I met a couple in Baishui village. The man is called Liu San, and the woman is Huang Zao. This is her." The Drowned Ghost pointed at the unconscious woman next to him.
"At first, the couple was very scared of me. But after they saw that I meant no harm, they became more courageous and asked if I could fabricate the guise of Huang Zao drowning, helping them defraud the insurance, and they would give me a portion of the compensation."
"At that time, I was penniless and in desperate need of money, so I agreed."
"With my abilities, it was very easy to create the illusion of Huang Zao drowning. The coroner couldn't tell the truth, and after receiving the compensation, Huang Zao was supposedly buried, but in reality, she was hidden with me."
"The couple planned to leave Baishui village and live in another city once the fuss died down."
"But what I didn't expect was, it's currently the time of the strict crackdown on malevolent spirits. The government and some sect called the Corpse Chasing Sect are collaborating to specially hunt me down."
"I didn't want to make a big deal out of it, so I ran whenever I saw people. If I couldn't run, I'd scare them away. A few days ago, I just scared away a Golden Core cultivator, and now, four Golden Core cultivators have arrived!"
The Drowned Ghost looked wronged, as for a bit of compensation, he had nearly lost his life over it.
The four of them wouldn't just listen to the Drowned Ghost's words, so Lu Yang asked: "How did Huang Zao fall into a coma?"
"I knocked her out. Letting her live freely in the water consumes too much magical power. It's better to knock her out directly and envelop her in a shell. It saves energy."
"Wake her up."
"Alright."
The Drowned Ghost dared not disobey. With a light spell, he flicked a point of light with his index finger and woke Huang Zao.
Huang Zao was dazed and didn't know what was happening. She saw four individuals and a corpse surrounding her, feeling an intense pressure.
Huang Zao, having never encountered such a situation, answered all questions posed to her, confirming her and her husband's intentions to defraud insurance and collude with the Drowned Ghost to scam the insurance company's compensation money.
"That's not right. What would a ghost need money for?" Meng Jingzhou squinted, sharply spotting a logical flaw in the Drowned Ghost's account.
Ghosts emit too much Yin Energy, which naturally makes humans uncomfortable. Ghosts are too conspicuous, even entering a city would be a great challenge, requiring much effort to disguise, let alone buying things on the street.
As for going to an association, it would be even more impossible. Associations are filled with cultivators who can see through a ghost's disguise in an instant.
Moreover, how much money could the insurance compensation of mortals amount to? At most, it would add up to just a few spirit stones. A Nascent Soul Mid-stage Drowned Ghost, a being that could command the winds and clouds in the East Sea, what would it need this money for?
Look at the three bewitching ghosts, Xiao Wu, Xiao Liu and Xiao Qi, who provide door-to-door service at night. After a hard night's work, they don't ask for money.
"Good nerve, you even dare to deceive us!" Meng Jingzhou flared up in anger, staring fiercely at the Drowned Ghost.
"Truly not, even as a ghost, there are places where I need to use money!" The Drowned Ghost cried out in grievance and hastily explained.
"Look, I was a fisherman, drowned in the sea, and have always lived in the sea. I'm a sea water ghost. Now I'm in this cold pool, and although there's enough Yin energy, it's fresh water after all, and I'm not used to living here."
"I asked Liu San and his wife, after they cheated the compensation money, to use the money to buy salt and pour it into the pool. That way, the pool water would change from fresh water to salt water."
Lu Yang: "..."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Man Gu: "..."
Zhao Po: "..."
They heard for the first time that water ghosts were divided into sea water ghosts and fresh water ghosts.
Lu Yang sneaked a whisper to Zhao Po: "There are many ghosts in your Wild State, have you ever heard that water ghosts are divided into sea water ghosts and fresh water ghosts?"
"Our Wild State is separated from the East Sea by an entire continent. This is the first time I've seen a ghost from the East Sea." Zhao Po felt that his knowledge was insufficient.
Man Gu took it all in stride, even feeling a sense of pride.
Following Brother Lu and Brother Meng, no matter where they go, he can always gain new insights.
Fairy Eternity rolled around on the bed, her little feet flip-flopping, mocking Lu Yang for his limited thinking: "You're inexperienced, aren't you? Have you forgotten the two first-grade Golden Cores I've told you about? One is called the Three Rivers and Five Lakes Pill, and the other is called the Endless Sea Pill.
The biggest difference between them is that one uses salt water and the other uses fresh water!"
"Sir, didn't you use your Universe within the Sleeve to suck away the water in the pool? You can confirm it with just a taste!" The Drowned Ghost was still trying to find evidence to prove he was telling the truth.
With a dark face, Lu Yang asked, "Where did all the fish in the pond go?"
"They all died from the salt."

chapters.title: Chapter 428 - 427: The Powerful Huang Ming_1
chapters.content:
After discerning the truth of the matter, Lu Yang with his two junior brothers remained on the scene while Zhao Po set off with the living corpse to Baishui Village, catching Liu San, who was just about to flee.
In the Wild State, corpse-drivers held a unique position, and Zhao Po, belonging to a long line of corpse-drivers, was the most suitable choice for the capture as it sparked the least controversy and doubt.
"Hey hey hey, what are you planning to do?"
Lu Yang flashed an innocent eight-tooth grin: "We're taking you to the local government's yamen."
"I have told you that I didn't kill anyone!"
"Who said that only murderers get punished? Even insurance scammers are criminals too. Plus, you turned the pond into a saltwater pit, killing all the fish. No one would say it's unjust if I add environmental destruction to your charges!"
"Does even Great Xia prosecute ghosts?"
Lu Yang wore a self-satisfied grin. "Not just ghosts. Even if the Sect Leader of Seek Dao Sect and the Minister of Justice commit a crime, they'd still be thrown into jail!"
Zhao Po was shocked. He had never heard of such a thing.
Don't the Five Great Immortal Sects have the right to act autonomously in the area of law enforcement, how could they still be arrested?
The Minister of Justice understands the law deeper than anyone, yet he broke it himself?
Is this some secret knowledge that only disciples of the Immortal Sects are privy to?
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu were also caught off guard, looking at Lu Yang in astonishment. They did not know about this either.
As for those who did know, besides Emperor Xia, the entire Ministry of Punishments, and the Eldest Senior Sister, the only other person was Lu Yang.
"Prosecute? Junior Brother Zhao Po, is this how you have been completing your missions from the Sect?"
A chilly voice rang out from above, revealing Huang Ming floating arrogantly in the air with a living corpse veiled in a black robe hovering next to him.
"Senior Brother Huang Ming?" At a glance, Zhao Po recognized Huang Ming, the one who had defeated him and claimed the title of number one within the sect.
Huang Ming and his corpse landed slowly, looking at Zhao Po with a displeased expression. "The sect's mission was to eradicate the ghosts completely. Why did you choose to spare this one? If you cannot bear to kill, then allow me to do it for you!"
He whipped out a Soul Dispersing Charm, intending to cast it onto the drowned ghost.
Zhao Po reacted even faster. He lunged, standing protectively in front of the drowned ghost, forcing Huang Ming to stay his hand. "Senior Brother Huang, ghosts can be good or evil. This drowned ghost has done no particular harm, and its crimes do not deserve death!"
"Ridiculous, I care not for the personality of the ghost. All I know is the Sect's instructions demand the elimination of all ghost issues!"
Huang Ming squinted. "Zhao Po, are you determined to stand in my way?"
As a conflict arose between the two, Lu Yang stepped in between. "Dear Fellow Daoist, we're all brothers in our respective sects. There's no need for animosity, right?"
Huang Ming remained unmoved. "And you are?"
"I am Lu Yang from the Seek Dao Sect."
After a cold snort, Huang Ming said, "Oh, so it's you, the Seek Dao Sect disciple who defeated a stronger opponent at the Qingzhou ceremony. So now, does the Seek Dao Sect feel entitled to meddle in the Corpse Chasing Sect's internal affairs?"
"For an outsider to interfere when I'm giving my junior brother some advice is simply bold!"
Upon hearing Huang Ming's words, Man Gu was about to lose his temper but was held back by Meng Jingzhou.
Meng Jingzhou had a feeling Huang Ming held quite some hostility towards them.
Lu Yang's expression remained calm, still maintaining his usual pleasant demeanor.
"The drowned ghost is our captive, and naturally, we determine how to deal with it. On the contrary, your sudden appearance to steal the fruits of our labor is a tad discourteous, isn't it?"
"Ha, it took four of you all at the Golden Core Stage to capture a Mid-stage Nascent Soul ghost. Such an achievement yet you are bold enough to boast. If it were me, I alone would have sufficed! People call you the number one among your generation, but from my point, you're nothing special."
Unfazed, Lu Yang maintained his smile. "Hmm, is that so? It seems that you're pretty confident in your abilities."
"We will see."
Before his words could finish, Lu Yang launched into the Arhat Fist, aiming a punch straight at Huang Ming.
Clang——
The living corpse was faster. Like a tower of iron, its arms crossed and blocked Lu Yang's punch.
Lu Yang was slightly taken aback. Though he hadn't used full power in his Arhat Fist, it was beyond the capacity of a cultivator in the early Golden Core Stage to withstand.
The living corpse roared, its body swelling as it lunged to grab Lu Yang.
Lu Yang didn't dare to collide directly with the living corpse. He stamped his right foot on the ground, and with a whoosh his body melted away into the earth, only to reappear behind Huang Ming!
Rather than fighting with the living corpse, it would be better to directly confront the corpse's master!
"Arhat Fist!"
"Yellow Spring Palm!"
As if anticipating Lu Yang's next move, Huang Ming concentrated power into his palm, turning around to throw a palm strike.
When fist met palm, ripples spread out from the point of impact. Neither of them could withstand the power of that strike, both retreating simultaneously. The force of the fist and the palm strike churned wildly within their bodies. Choosing the same tactic, the two of them slapped backwards, their respective forces pouring out.
Lu Yang narrowed his eyes, his face breaking into a grin full of interest. This was the first time he'd encountered an opponent with this much combat experience.
"How is this possible!" Zhao Po stared incredulously at the scene, finding it hard to believe. Corpse drivers were always below average. He had seen Brother Lu's fighting technique himself, and yet the Senior Brother Huang Ming was able to exchange blows with him.
"You're not at the beginning of the Golden Core stage, are you? You must be at mid-stage of Golden Core?" Lu Yang laughed, recalling what Zhao had said earlier, that both he and Huang Ming were at the beginning of the Golden Core stage.
"What makes you think that?"
"I used all my strength for that punch. If a beginner Golden Core can withstand it, my cultivation is in vain."
Huang Ming snorted coldly, refusing to comment.
He hadn't expected Lu Yang to be so thorny, or rather, such a handful.
"My hair!"
Huang Ming was about to strike again when he noticed strands of his hair falling like snow.
"Unity of Fist and Cultivation?!" Huang quickly realized, never expecting to see this achieve at the Golden Core stage.
He didn't care about the hair, only about Lu Yang's talent.
"What is Unity of Fist and Cultivation?" Zhao Po looked confused, having never heard of this concept.
Meng Jingzhou, with furrowed brows and his gaze focused on Huang Ming, didn't respond.
Putting fighting experience aside, this person named Huang Ming doesn't seem like someone brought up by Corpse Chasing Sect, and that includes even his recent admission as Master Ru's disciple.
Where did he get this knowledge?
Bang——
The two engaged in battle again, their match surpassed anything this realm should be capable of. Lu Yang attacked with Three Flavored True Fire and Huang Ming countered with True Fire of Ding Mau, increasing the temperature instantly, forcing the spectating ghost to retreat.
"The True Fire of Six-C and Six-A!" Zhao Po exclaimed in shock. Out of the hundred and eight types of True Fire, twelve of them belong to a category known as Six-C and Six-A True Fire. The True Fire of Ding Mau is one of them!
Whether it's the Yellow Spring Palm that can match Brother Lu, or the True Fire of Ding Mau, Huang Ming never used these in the sect contest.
Zhao Po knew that Huang Ming didn't use his full power in the sect contest, but he had assumed that it was because the living corpse had a hidden trump card - it never occurred to him that it might be Huang Ming himself that held the secrets.
Lu Yang became increasingly curious about Huang Ming's history. The gap between the first and second of the Corpse Chasing Sect was rather huge.
He had never met outsiders who could fight him to this extent, other than those from the Five Great Immortal Sects.
The battle between the two became more intense. They deployed all kinds of divine abilities and tactics. Their fists and palms clashed violently, accompanied by thunderous sounds, strike after strike, with no clear winner in sight.
Gradually, the tide of the battle began to turn. Lu Yang's foundation was more solid, his rhythm steady. In a battle of attrition, no one in the same realm could possibly outmatch Lu Yang!
Huang Ming was livid. Ever since he started his path, he had never lost a single battle. He didn't expect to taste defeat today.
This was simply unacceptable!
Huang Ming's eyes fiercely blazed like those of a tiger. A ferocious, invisible wave of spiritual power, like an arrow, rushed towards Lu Yang!
Lu Yang's spiritual power was incredibly strong. Not to mention that within his spiritual space, he had Fairy Eternity to rely upon. He was not afraid of anyone trying to fight him on the spiritual power front, not even someone in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage!
A small shield materialized at Lu Yang's forehead, blocking Huang Ming's attack.
Fairy Eternity suddenly realized: "I got it, he is not your peer. He is a great cultivator who has disbanded his cultivation and started over!"

chapters.title: Chapter 429 - 428: Start Over after Disbanding Cultivation_1
chapters.content:
"Start over after disbanding cultivation?" Lu Yang heard this term for the first time, although its literal meaning was quite easy to understand.
"Yes, many cultivators had no guidance at the beginning of their cultivation, and their training process was not smooth, with shaky foundations. This is not a big problem at low realms, at most they will be challenged by someone like you with a solid foundation.
But when they reach a high realm, the problem becomes significant, it's very easy to encounter stagnant cultivation progress, and after hundreds or even thousands of years, there's no progress at all."
"By then, cultivators will face a choice—Starting over after disbanding cultivation."
Fairy Eternity spoke eloquently; no one could surpass her knowledge of cultivation.
"Dissipating a lifetime's cultivation level, it's similar to reincarnation, carrying memories with it, becoming a baby, starting over. With previous cultivation memories, this round of cultivation can take fewer detours, knowing how to solidify the foundation. Opportunities missed in the past due to high cultivation levels or old age will not be missed again.
Outsiders can't tell if he is reincarnated or not, not even through bone age testing or anything else."
"However, starting over after disbanding cultivation faces three problems. First, it requires a certain cultivation level; it must be during the Unification period, which is the prime stage. At the prime stage, the …, ensuring that the true spirit won't extinguish after disbanding cultivation.
If disbanding of cultivation is done at an old age, the … will disperse, resulting in failure and shattering of souls, beyond the point of rescue."
"Secondly, after starting over, you will be like a newborn baby, without any self-preservation skills, even eating and crawling could be a problem. Once you gradually grow and pass the infant stage, the Cultivation World is not safe. You never know if you'll encounter any enemies during your growth, which might result in untimely death."
"The third is that the foundation after restarting cannot be guaranteed. For example, if your foundation was Dual Spirit Roots before disbanding, you could end up having Three Four Spirit Roots after disbanding. In such cases, even if you have cultivation experience, it would be difficult to return to your previous level."
Lu Yang nodded, starting over after disbanding cultivation sounded very similar to Li Haoran's situation, but there were also differences. At the very least, Li Haoran was a completely new individual, and his talents in his next life would certainly be stronger than the previous one. Both had their advantages and disadvantages.
No wonder Huang Ming was so hard to deal with, this was equivalent to fighting with a Great Power who started at the Unification stage and suppressed himself to the same realm as Lu Yang.
"By the way, among the Five Immortals of the Ancients, did anyone start over after disbanding their cultivation?"
"No." Fairy Eternity counted with her fingers for Lu Yang, "I originated from a small tribe, Yingtian Immortal was a refugee, Immortal Jiuchong was the first heir of the Lianshan Clan, Qilin Immortal was born and raised naturally, and Time Immortal was the incarnation of the Firmament Tree."
"Can Fairy tell who Huang Ming reincarnated from before?"
Fairy Eternity shook her head: "I can't tell. If he hadn't just used a spiritual attack that didn't belong to this realm, I wouldn't have been able to judge that he has reincarnated."
Lu Yang was pondering. Did the Corpse Chasing Sect know that Huang Ming was reincarnated? Why did Huang Ming choose to cultivate in the Corpse Chasing Sect? This kind of talent is enough to enter the Five Great Immortal Sects. Is he afraid of something, or does the Corpse Chasing Sect have some special features?
"Forget it, don't think too much about it for now." Lu Yang showed an excited smile, drew out his Green Peak Sword, this was his first time encountering a reincarnated opponent, it was time to get serious.
Huang Ming was scrutinizing Lu Yang with a solemn expression, treating him as a formidable opponent, not daring to let his guard down.
As a cultivator who had disbanded his cultivation and started over, he could not tolerate losing to a junior cultivator. That's why he used the Spiritual Arrow Feather out of normal conventions.
The Spiritual Arrow Feather is absolutely undefendable for Golden Core Mid-stage cultivators, even for those who primarily cultivate spiritual power at the Golden Core Mid-stage!
How did the opponent manage to do it? Could it be that he, like Huang Ming, restarted after disbanding his cultivation?
Huang Ming had no idea that as early as when Lu Yang resurrected Fairy Eternity at the Foundation Establishment stage, Fairy Eternity forcibly had Lu Yang create a spiritual space. This made his spiritual strength significantly stronger than his peers. With the subsequent relentless efforts of Fairy Eternity in the spiritual space, the area and toughness of the spiritual space kept growing.
In terms of spiritual strength, nobody in the Golden Core stage could compare with Lu Yang.
"Slash!" Lu Yang shouted out loud. The unity of …, the Sword Qi was like a resilient horse whip, extremely ferocious. The sword blade danced a swift arc in the air, slashing towards Huang Ming.
Zhao Po, who was observing the battle, had his hairs on end. Even from a side view of this sword strike, he could feel its terror. Was this really a sword technique that could be used at the Golden Core Mid-stage?
The spectating Ghost Drowner was also quite shocked. Only now did he realize that Lu Yang had held back in their battle just now. Otherwise, with this attack alone, he would have been seriously injured and defeated!
This sword strike was too fast and harsh for Huang Ming to dodge. If he insisted on resisting it, he would undoubtedly lose. Huang Ming gritted his teeth, teleported and disappeared from the spot. In his place was the Living Corpse.
He quickly exchanged positions with the Living Corpse!
"Corpse shifter?!" Zhao Po was taken aback, he didn't expect Brother Huang Ming to have learned such a secret technique. Normally, only those in the Nascent Soul Stage could learn it.
Huang Ming was panting heavily, taking a Qi Recovery Pill to recover his spiritual essence. He forcefully used the secret technique, draining all the remaining spiritual essence in an instant.
The Living Corpse took the sword blow, splitting into two. The cut ends grew countless red threads that interlinked, and the Living Corpse recovered as before.
Huang Ming no longer held back, controlling the Living Corpse to attack Lu Yang together.
The drawback of a Corpse-driver lies in their physical body, they can only control the Living Corpse to fight. But Huang Ming had a strong physical body and vigorous spiritual power. He could both control the Living Corpse and fight at the same time, making up for all the shortcomings of a Corpse-driver.
His fighting power skyrocketed!
Zhao Po watched this scene in a daze. Huang Ming's various techniques completely overturned his understanding. So, the gap between him and Huang Ming was this big?
"Ha, now it gets interesting." Lu Yang was fighting one against two, with no intention of retreating, like a war god, getting stronger as he fought.
"No wonder you can become a disciple of the Seek Dao Sect, you do have some skills, but that's all!" Huang Ming's eyes were wolfish, revealing ferocity and determination.
"With your talent, you are unrivaled amongst your peers, you probably haven't tasted the bitterness of defeat, right? Today, let me teach you that bitterness!" Huang Ming revealed a mocking smile.
"Blooming Beyond Flowers, reshaping the world!"
This was his last and strongest trump card. If he were to lose again, he shouldn't be wasting time talking about gaining a say in the future Great Era after disbanding cultivation. It would be better to end his life earlier.
The enchanting red Beyond Flowers bloomed, and Huang Ming along with the Living Corpse's eyes turned red. Their momentum soared, their nails extended, like a beast's sharp claws, extremely fierce. Under this momentum's influence, the ground shook as if the earth dragon was turning over, causing the mountains and the earth to tremble!
"You're two against one, I'd like to see how you win!" Huang Ming was confident of victory, his facial expression somewhat distorted.
"This is indeed difficult to continue with." Murmured Lu Yang. He retracted into the ground, took out the Twin Lotus seed, and cast the "Tree-Planting Sutra".
Under Huang Ming's slightly stunned gaze, in the midst of the Beyond Flowers blooming, a lotus flower blossomed. Two Lu Yangs appeared simultaneously, one holding the Green Peak Sword and the other holding the Dark Moon Sword.
Lu Yang revealed a leisurely smile at the corner of his mouth.
"Now it's a two on two."

chapters.title: Chapter 430 - 429: Huang Ming's Identity_1
chapters.content:
Huang Ming, a Great Power in the Unification stage, had chosen to Start Over after Disbanding Cultivation. In over two thousand years of traversing the Cultivation World, this was the first time seeing a Cultivator at the Golden Core Stage who could use Clone Magic Spells.
Moreover, it was performed in such a fashion.
Before Huang Ming could comprehend what was happening, the two swords Green Peak and Dark Moon, like two Flood Dragons adventuring in the East Sea, arrived flaring with bloodshed and roars.
Lu Yang was uncertain whether the Living Corpse could still resurrect after being severed again. Instead of taking chances on an uncertain matter, it was better to directly attack Huang Ming.
He didn't believe that Huang Ming could also regenerate like the Living Corpse.
In a hurry, Huang Ming manipulated the Living Corpse to attack. Lu Yang let his clone, wielding the Dark Moon Sword, block Living Corpse's attack and contested against Huang Ming himself.
Both sides were once again in a stalemate, but Huang Ming quickly discovered his disadvantage.
Lu Yang's spiritual power was even stronger than his own. The precision in controlling the clone was higher. In the battle between the Living Corpse and the clone, the Living Corpse was losing ground.
If the clone were to win, then he would be facing a two-versus-one situation.
Huang Ming was alarmed by Lu Yang's chuckling that echoed by his ear, sending a cold shiver down his spine.
"Do you not even understand that one cannot be distracted during a battle? Break!"
Lu Yang cast a "Break" spell. The Sword Qi shot up into the sky and gushed out, its radiant sword light intertwined like a curtain.
A scarlet light curtain stood in front of Huang Ming. It was his strongest defensive move. However, before the fully-empowered "Break" spell, the scarlet light curtain only lasted a brief moment before it was shattered.
Thwack—
Huang Ming wanted to perform the Corpse Swap spell again but was too slow. His right shoulder was pierced through.
Huang Ming was seriously injured and needed to rest for at least half a month to recover.
In the midst of the battle, Huang Ming had consumed a Qi Recovery Pill. However, near the end, he still faced a shortage of spiritual essence.
In contrast, Lu Yang hadn't consumed any Elixir to restore his spiritual essence from start to finish. This was not just due to the potency of the Invincible Elixir, but it was also because of a diet of tofu during the initial cultivation.
Long-term consumption of tofu can regulate the Five Elements balance in a Cultivator, providing greater endurance during battles.
"I admit defeat!" Huang Ming clenched his teeth in vexation, acknowledging his defeat, and consumed an Elixir to heal his injuries.
Lu Yang sheathed his sword. He was as animated and friendly as if he hadn't just wounded Huang Ming.
"What made you decide to Start Over after Disbanding Cultivation?"
Huang Ming sighed, "I was too hurried when I was young and neglected my basics. I was caught in the Mid-stage of Unification, and I just couldn't breakthrough. Coincidently, I saw this as a good opportunity to Start Over after Disbanding Cultivation, so I got reincarnated."
Lu Yang wondered, "Then why didn't you join the Five Great Immortal Sects? The resources at the Immortal Sects are more abundant than those of the Corpse Chasing Sect, right?"
"Entering the Immortal Sect isn't easy. There are so many accomplished Cultivators there. And who knows, someone might just find out about our real identity. Speaking of which, you must have courage. Not only did you manage to infiltrate an Immortal Sect, but you also made such a high profile."
Huang Ming, thinking of Lu Yang's phenomenal Spiritual Power, believed he might also be a Cultivator who had chosen to recover after disbanding cultivation.
He asked further, "Your Clone Magic Spells are unique. I have never heard of it before, and I don't remember any historical records of it either. Presumably, the lineage was discontinued and the skill lost. Are you a Cultivator from the Great Qian Era?"
"No, I didn't Start Over after Disbanding Cultivation."
"Don't bluff! How could you defeat me if you didn't Start Over after Disbanding Cultivation? Let me share some inside info with you. I am Radix Honorable from the Great Yu Dynasty. What's your name? I might have heard about you."
Lu Yang didn't respond, but silently looked at Huang Ming.
It seemed Huang Ming had understood something.
Huang Ming: "..."
Lu Yang: "..."
"You are a Cultivator from the Great Yu Dynasty!"
"You are really a disciple of the Seek Dao Sect!"
Both voices intertwined together.
Lu Yang had thought that Huang Ming was an elder from the Corpse Chasing Sect who had Chosen to Start Over after Disbanding Cultivation. His tone had been quite casual, but he never expected that Huang Ming was a Cultivator from the Great Yu Dynasty.
Huang Ming was even more shocked than Lu Yang. The combat power displayed by Lu Yang was actually cultivated step by step without starting over after disbanding his cultivation. Even the Imperial Teacher wouldn't be able to achieve this at this realm!
Are the geniuses of the Great Era really this terrifying?!
Meng Jingzhou realized the gravity of the problem, Huang Ming was actually a cultivator of Great Yu.
This was Man Gu and Zhao Po's first meeting with ancient cultivators, and their reactions were relatively subdued compared to those of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
Huang Ming quickly responded, his tone stern, eyes clouded with grimness, and not a trace of a smile: "Very well, you are indeed a genius from the Great Era, capable of putting me in such a desperate state!"
"In that case, I can't let you live!"
"I originally planned to have a chat with you, and kill everyone who overheard our conversation. Now it seems you must die too!"
Huang Ming no longer concealed his killing intent, and summoned his companions using a secret method.
"Fellow Daoist Mong, kill them all!"
"Lu Yang, be careful, there's a Unification stage cultivator coming!"
As soon as Fairy Eternity's warning finished, an overwhelming pressure descended on them like a towering mountain.
A middle-aged man with streaks of white hair appeared in the sky. Ignoring Lu Yang and the others, he looked down at Huang Ming, with a trace of mockery on his face.
"Fellow Daoist Huang, you look quite miserable."
"You would be, too, if you were in my position!" Huang Ming yelled angrily. This Lu Yang's talent was horrifying. Even he, having restarted his cultivation after reaching Unification stage, was no match for him.
If they allowed him to grow, then what?
They had to get rid of him as soon as possible!
"Sure, sure." The ancient cultivator called Fellow Daoist Mong laughed. These were just a few Golden Core Stage cultivators, he could exterminate them with the flick of a finger.
"It's... it's him!" The drowned ghost instinctively shouted, recognizing the familiar presence.
"It was him who knocked me unconscious and took me here from the East Sea!"
Fellow Daoist Mong glanced down, saw it was the drowned ghost, and chuckled quietly.
"So it's that drowned ghost from the East Sea."
Lu Yang was shocked. This meant the ghost disaster in Hanshui City was created by Fellow Daoist Mong. He captured ghosts from different places and threw them into Hanshui City, but he didn't know what they wanted to do!
Fellow Daoist Mong no longer paid attention to the drowned ghost. A Nascent Soul Stage specter wasn't worth his attention: "I'll help you kill these people and fake the crime scene. We'll just say you died fighting this drowned ghost. That way you can stay in the Corpse Chasing Sect. In exchange, you have to tell me about one of your treasure locations."
Huang Ming clenched his teeth, anger swirling in his chest but leaving his lips unvoiced. This was a barefaced robbery, but he was completely helpless.
"Deal!"
"Ha-ha, then thanks in advance for Fellow Daoist Huang's gift!"
Pleased to get what he wanted, Fellow Daoist Mong didn't hold back anymore and started to look at Lu Yang and the others as if they were already dead.
"You young fellows, I am kind-hearted. I will let you choose your own way of death, would you like to be dismembered or become a Human Pill? Or perhaps die in a ghost possession?"
Lu Yang and others were sweating profusely. Their backs were soaked, notably Zhao Po who had never encountered such a situation.
"What death would you choose?"
An abrupt interruption broke the atmosphere.
"Who!" Fellow Daoist Mong was startled, not noticing when this person had arrived.
Boom—
Fellow Daoist Mong was hit by the Five-Colored Bright Wheel, falling from the sky, spitting blood, horror flashed in his eyes.
He could tell from this blow alone that the difference in power between them was vast.
The newcomer was dressed in blue, hands behind his back, his tone indifferent. The Five-Colored Bright Wheel was behind his head, making him look divine.
"Five Elements Sect Leader, Qiu Jin'an."

chapters.title: Chapter 431 - 430 Using Five Elements Magic Skill in Front of Me?_1
chapters.content:
"Qiu Jin'an? One of the sect leaders of the so-called Five Great Immortal Sects of Great Xia?"
Fellow Daoist Mong got up from the ground, not being too seriously injured. He sneered at Qiu Jin'an's identity. The fact that he was hit by Qiu Jin'an was purely because Qiu Jin'an surprised him with an attack.
If they truly fought, the outcome would still be uncertain.
He hailed from the most prosperous era of the Great Yu Dynasty, which was no less splendid compared to today's Great Xia. He was among the top-tier Unification cultivators of that era. In terms of status, he was no worse off than Qiu Jin'an.
He, who was capable of sleeping for hundreds of thousands of years and executing plans during the Great Era, naturally had his unique merits.
Although Great Xia has many strong cultivators today, after a long period of hundreds of thousands of years, many cultivation methods and magic skills have been lost.
He was in possession of these cultivation methods and magic skills.
On the one hand, one has mastery over lost cultivation methods and magic skills, while the other does not. It is not difficult to judge who is stronger and who is weaker.
"Sect Leader Qiu?!"
Lu Yang and the others were ecstatic, the arrogant and ignorant cultivator from Great Yu did not understand the power of Qiu Jin'an, but how could they not know?
This was Sect Leader Qiu, who had been engaged in mutual competition since childhood with the nine disciples of the Seek Dao Sect!
As the person with the most profound understanding of the five elements magic spells in the world today, even the Minister of Justice would probably not be able to defeat Qiu Jin'an!
Apart from Daoist Buyu, the first Unification cultivator, no one else dared to claim that they could surely defeat Qiu Jin'an!
"Qiu Jin'an!" Zhao Po was surprised and felt relieved. The reputation of the Five Great Immortal Sects reverberated throughout the Great Xia Dynasty, much stronger than their Corpse Chasing Sect.
Zhao Po quietly observed Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, finding out that although they were both surprised and delighted, their reactions were much smaller than his.
He suddenly remembered Meng Jingzhou's curse, a curse of Half Step towards the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. He did not know who had provoked him.
Previously, he found it strange that Meng Jingzhou, who was only at the Golden Core Stage, could provoke such enemies, but now he probably understood a bit.
They had only just come into contact for a few days, and they had encountered an ancient Unification cultivator.
Man Gu was also someone who had seen big scenes. He had participated in the entire process of the Eternity Sect's destruction, a scene much larger than the current one.
The drowned ghost was almost scared to death again. The situation had completely exceeded his understanding. It was about Unification cultivators from the era of Great Yu, the sect master of the Five Great Immortal Sects, all of whom were important people who he, as a small water ghost, could not reach.
As for Huang Zao, who lied about insurance, he had already fainted in fright.
As well as his joy, Lu Yang thought of another problem: "Hold on, why would Sect Leader Qiu be here, and appear so conveniently?"
"It's very simple, he was following behind you." Fairy Eternity said naturally. However secretive Qiu Jin'an's stealth skills, they could not compare with Fairy Eternity.
"Following us? Since when?"
"Since you and Meng Jingzhou wanted to enter the city but were caught in a mudslide."
"Wasn't that from the very start?"
"Not exactly the beginning, but rather when you first entered the black shop." Fairy Eternity took pains to correct Lu Yang's faulty logic.
Fellow Daoist Mong was not afraid of Qiu Jin'an's presence, and even wanted to take action.
"Youngster of Great Xia, let me show you the power of ancient magic spells... Big Sun Hanging in the Sky!"
The shadow of the bronze tree slowly emerged behind Fellow Daoist Mong, two great suns vaguely visible, containing endless light and heat. Just by looking at it, it feels like it is melting, the Golden Crow spreading its wings and screaming, located right in the center of the Big Sun.
Qiu Jin'an casually raised a light barrier to protect Lu Yang and the others.
This was a Unification cultivator's trump card, even a scrape of it would be too much for Lu Yang and the others to bear.
Qiu Jin'an contemplated, seeming to have seen a description of this move in ancient books, recalling it leisurely.
"It is said that in ancient times, ten Golden Crows lived on the Fusang tree, each day one Golden Crow would go out to patrol the world. Suddenly one day, all ten Golden Crows flew out together, bringing disaster to the world. An ancient god drew his bow and shot down nine suns."
"During the Great Yu era, someone modeled after this ancient tale, found a piece of Fusang tree trunk, combined it with True Fire of the Golden Crow, creating a Divine Ability known as 'Ten Suns Patrolling the Sky', raising the power of True Fire of Golden Crow to another level."
"He instantly rose to become a Grandmaster of Fire Dao, founding the Heavenly Fire Sect, causing his name to resound throughout the world. After his disappearance, the 'Ten Suns Patrolling the Sky' vanished, and the Heavenly Fire Sect struggled for eight thousand years before it was located by enemies and destroyed."
"According to the records, this person was known as True Lord Mong Tian."
With his identity revealed by Qiu Jin'an, True Lord Mong Tian didn't panic, instead a cold smile curled up from the corner of his mouth: "You're quite knowledgeable, even though I can only use 'Two Suns Patrolling the Sky', once I successfully Pass the Tribulation, I'll be able to use 'Five Suns Patrolling the Sky'.
When I reach the Consummation of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, I'll be able to use 'Ten Suns Patrolling the Sky', recreating the scene of ancient times! It's a shame my cultivation level is limited and can't keep up with the pace of deducing this, but it's more than enough to deal with a junior like you!"
"I establish the rule here, [I can use Three Suns Patrolling the Sky]!"
On the Fusang tree, the third sun rose!
This was afterall near Hanshui City, any large commotion would inevitably attract the attention of the city's powerful experts. A swift victory was needed, hence True Lord Mong Tian bypassed the process of building up an attack, right from the beginning he used his strongest technique!
Unification cultivators are unable to freely set rules, otherwise True Lord Mong Tian would have directly used 'Ten Suns Patrolling the Sky'.
During a fight between Unification cultivators, the rules they establish can generally be divided into two categories. One type strengthens themselves, while the other binds the opponent.
The strength of rules that bolster oneself depends on the limit of the Unification cultivator, and is a way of unleashing potential.
Rules that bind the opponent are limited to equal turns. If you can confine the opponent once, the opponent can confine you once as well. The method of restraint is unlimited, so if you aren't careful, it can flip against you.
For example, during the battle between the Unification cultivator from the Great Yu Dynasty who used creatures to refine a Soul Summoning Banner and the Vice Headmaster Shi, the rule set by the Unification cultivator from the Great Yu Dynasty was:
[Disregarding me, within a radius of five hundred feet, all shall move slowly].
The rule set by Vice Headmaster Shi was:
[Within a radius of five hundred feet, no one may use Demonic Devices].
This demonstrates equal turns.
Three suns hanging high, the Golden Crow screaming, the blazing suns truly seem to be recreating the disaster of ancient times.
"Go!"
True Lord Mong Tian lifted his hand and pointed two fingers towards Qiu Jin'an and the others behind him.
If Qiu Jin'an dodged, the people behind him would surely die!
He was confident that Qiu Jin'an would not dodge!
"Ah——" Facing the three suns, Qiu Jin'an let out a long sigh.
Qiu Jin'an stepped forward, the Five-Colored Bright Wheel on his back emitted various colors, transforming into Five-Colored Divine Light. Everything pertaining to the five elements was under the control of the Divine Light.
Whoosh——
Under the wash of the Five-Colored Divine Light, the three suns gradually melted.
"So, the 'Ten Suns Patrolling the Sky' described as a natural disaster is just that powerful."
"How is this possible!"
True Lord Mong Tian couldn't believe his eyes. His strongest attack was resolved so easily?
The opponent didn't even set down any [rules]!
Before True Lord Mong Tian could understand what was happening, he saw Qiu Jin'an's body sway, and with his foot, he pinned True Lord Mong Tian to the ground. This foot was as heavy as a hundred thousand mountains pressing True Lord Mong Tian upside down and unable to stand!
Qiu Jin'an calmly looked at True Lord Mong Tian: "I have never seen anyone dare to use the five elements magic spells in front of me, not even those nine guys from the Seek Dao Sect."

chapters.title: Chapter 432 - 431: Solving the Problem of Causality Backlash_1
chapters.content:
Mong Tian, the True Lord, did not expect to lose so swiftly in his own eyes. Apart from the Ten-Day Celestial Spell, he mastered various secret magic skills, the Ten-Day Celestial Spell being the most powerful of them all.
Yet, before he could unleash them, his three solar wheels disappeared into thin air as Qiu Jin'an swept them away with his Five-Colored Divine Light. The valley quickly returned to its initial cool, dark state.
Qiu Jin'an wasted no words—he reached out to grab Mong Tian's head, intending to probe his mind directly and discover their plans.
Noticing the situation taking a bad turn, Mong Tian hastily cast a life-saving magic skill, ignoring the impact it would have on him.
Thump, thump, thump—
His heart pounded fiercely, filled with vitality, a far cry from the defeated state he was in.
The temperature around his heart surged, melting the protective robe on his chest and revealing his chest.
Only then did Qiu Jin'an notice that a dead Golden Crow occupied the spot where his heart was supposed to be!
The Golden Crow carried a deadly arrow wound. Qiu Jin'an suspected that it was the Golden Crow shot by ancient divine beings!
No wonder Mong Tian could understand the Ten-Day Celestial Spell!
He must have found the Golden Crow's body somewhere and replaced his heart with it!
Suddenly, the Golden Crow's eyes shot open, its feathers fast spreading to cover Mong Tian's entire body.
"Oh no, he's trying to escape!"
Qiu Jin'an stomped down fiercely, intending to nail Mong Tian in place. But when he acted, he found that Mong Tian's entire body had morphed into Golden Crow's feathers—he had caught nothing but thin air.
Thump—
Mong Tian exploded, and the Golden Crow's feathers scattered in all directions. Qiu Jin'an started chanting, creating a gust of wind to blow away the feathers. In the meantime, Mong Tian and Huang Ming had vanished without a trace, leaving behind only a Broussonetia branch.
"They got away!"
Mong Tian's escape magic was something Qiu Jin'an hadn't encountered before, putting his reaction a beat behind.
...
Gasp, pant—
Heavily injured Mong Tian and Huang Ming, disguising themselves as normal folk, concealed themselves within Hanshui City, merging in with the crowd.
"Damn it, how is that Qiu Jin'an so strong?!"
Mong Tian was overcome by relief, having survived a close shave—had he acted a second later, he would have had his soul searched by Qiu Jin'an and died at his hands.
Even though he had lost his Broussonetia branch and would no longer be able to use the Ten-Day Celestial Spell, and his foundation was even shaken—he would need a transcendence artifact to repair it...
Compared to staying alive, these were trifling matters.
"You owe me for the loss of that Broussonetia branch," Mong Tian glared at Huang Ming with fierce eyes.
If it weren't for the fact that this little brat Huang Ming still had some hidden treasures, he wouldn't have even bothered saving Huang.
"Look, I'll give you two more treasure locations. That should make up for your losses," Huang Ming offered reluctantly. He had a total of four treasure locations. They were his hope for a rapid rise in power in the future. Initially, offering one spot didn't impact him too much. But now that he had to promise three locations, he would need to hustle to find cultivation treasures in the future!
Just how much time would that cost him?
But he had no choice—him being merely at the Golden Core Stage, even an injured Mong Tian was not someone he could handle.
"What do we do now? Where do we go?" Huang Ming asked with a gloomy expression, not in the best of moods.
"In our current state, we cannot participate in the subsequent plans in Hanshui City. Do you see the mansion not far from here? The owner of the house worships a wooden carving for good luck—an artifact, actually, that I left behind. I have total control over the family. No one will find us if we hide there," explained Mong Tian.
"Alright."
Both men suppressed their urge to sprint to the nearby mansion, carefully controlling their steps to prevent any missteps from revealing their secret.
"Are you two leaving already?"
A sudden voice made both men jump.
They look up to find a man wearing a white paper hat standing in front of them. The busy crowd around them paid no heed to this man.
"Who are you!"
The man in the paper hat sneered, sending a shudder down their spines.
"You monks from Great Yu go around capturing ghosts everywhere and releasing them in Hanshui City, putting all the blame on our Jiuyou Teaching. Even the Heaven's Court suspects us. You still dare to ask who I am after ruining the friendly relations between our sects?"
"Jiuyou Teaching, run!"
"Think you can run?"
Three more men in paper hats appeared, surrounding the two of them.
Among the Four Great Devil Sects, the Jiuyou Teaching has survived all these years mainly because they are unparallelled when it comes to escaping.
"You monks from Great Yu also interfered with our business. Our Vice-Headmaster Shi is quite unhappy about it. Let's settle all our old and new scores together."
The men in paper hats captured the two and vanished on the spot.
...
"What a pity, they both got away," sighed Qiu Jin'an. Even if they had managed to catch one of them, they would have gotten significant useful intelligence.
"Sect Leader Qiu, what brings you here?" inquired Lu Yang respectfully.
"Isn't this Acting Sect Master? It's been a long time," greeted Qiu Jin'an with a sardonic smile.
"Is Brother Lu still acting as the Sect Master of Seek Dao Sect?"
When the Five Elements Sect had come to exchange views with the Seek Dao Sect, they had lost miserably. This happened while Fairy Eternity was serving as the acting Sect Master for three days.
When both sides were negotiating how to conduct the competition, Qiu Jin'an had boldly proposed that his senior disciple fight against the strongest among Seek Dao Sect's disciples.
It was then that Yun Zhi had come forward, stating that she was no longer the acting Sect Master.
In Qiu Jin'an's opinion, it was Lu Yang who was serving as the acting Sect Master.
Startled, Zhao Po gained surprising insights from Sect Leader Qiu's words—Brother Lu used to be the acting Sect Master of Seek Dao Sect?
Given this, not only was Brother Lu the strongest amongst the young generation, he also held the highest position!
The gap was astonishing considering they were of the same age group.
"I passed the position onto Eldest Senior Sister," Lu Yang replied honestly, catching Qiu Jin'an off guard.
"Alright, let's not dwell on this. I came here to tell the young chap from the Meng family that I have found a solution to break the curse," Qiu Jin'an brought a sprout of hope.
Meng Jingzhou's eyes sparkled, "Really?"
"Am I one to joke about such matters? I have confirmed it across various sources—it's a foolproof method."
"Have you ever heard of the force of State Destiny?" Qiu Jin'an spoke mysteriously.
Meng Jingzhou blurted out, "The force of State Destiny known to Immortals?"
Qiu Jin'an was surprised. He had wanted to put on a grand show, flaunting his knowledge in front of the youngsters. After all, they would forget everything once he finished speaking. However, Meng Jingzhou knew about it.
In fact, he shouldn't have been aware of the force of State Destiny. However, as the Sect Leader of an Immortal Sect, he often participated in discussions about State Destiny. The court had given each Sect Leader of an Immortal Sect a treasure that allowed them to remember the existence of the force of State Destiny.
"Yes, that's it. The force of State Destiny. Every governor and county magistrate of Great Xia is protected by it—making them invulnerable to harm. Do you know what it means?"
Lu Yang was quick to grasp Qiu Jin'an's thoughts, "It implies that the State Destiny can eliminate the backlash of Causality!"
"Yes, it can eliminate the backlash of Causality. It's an Immortal Dao tactic. All you need to do is cleanse yourself with the force of State Destiny—everything will be good after!"
Meng Jingzhou was overjoyed. This method was much more reliable than waiting for the Corpse Chasing Sect Leader to breakthrough to the Transcendence Tribulation Stage and then act.

chapters.title: Chapter 433 - 433: 432
chapters.content:
"I came across this information after extensive verification. The power of State Destiny operates at very high levels that you haven't reached. You need to know only that the power of State Destiny can erase causal backlash!" Qiu Jin'an cautioned all of them. Their cultivation levels were too low, and they weren't qualified to know these mysteries yet.
This is information you gain only when you reach the Transcendence Tribulation stage. If he weren't the head of the Immortal Sect, he wouldn't be aware of the existence of the power of State Destiny.
Lu Yang agreed wholeheartedly, "Indeed, The power of State Destiny is possessed by the immortals on the imperial side and has relevance with the Dao Fruit; it's one of the means of immortals. The protected ones of State Destiny can purge all poison, prevent diseases, and can produce enormous power instantaneously. It also has the characteristic of forgetting.
The Imperial Teacher of the Great Yu dynasty is also very wary of the power of State Destiny, he dare not offend."
Qiu Jin'an was slightly startled. Why did it seem like Lu Yang knew more than he did?
Is this the basic knowledge that the Golden Core stage cultivators should have?
Thinking back to his Golden Core stage, he only knew that the Ancient Nameless One had refined the Starland Continent. As for the concepts of immortals and Dao Fruit, he was utterly unfamiliar. Occasionally he would venture into the Secret Realm, a place left behind by the Nascent Soul and Spirit Transformation cultivators, which can only be entered when someone reached the Golden Core stage.
The power of State Destiny has a forgetful effect, and Lu Yang was not affected because he possessed the treasures given to him by the imperial court. Yet, how did he not forget?
Qiu Jin'an pondered for a moment without delving into it. There were countless matters within the Seek Dao Sect that he couldn't figure out; Lu Yang's issue was just one of them.
For example, he had been wondering how the nine troublemakers of the Ask Dao Sect ended up together in the vast world of cultivation.
Perhaps, it could only be explained by like attracting like.
"After learning this information, I went to the Seek Dao Sect to find you. The old rascals in the Seek Dao Sect told me you had gone to the Corpse Chasing Sect in the Wild State, so I rushed over immediately to inform you and ran into the Unification stage cultivator from Great Yu attacking you."
Qiu Jin'an expressed a 'lucky I arrived in time' facial expression.
Lu Yang glanced at Qiu Jin'an. It was not a matter of 'luckily arrived', the Fairy had informed him, and this old man had been tailing and watching the excitement all the way.
The battle between Qiu Jin'an and Mong Tian caused a great commotion, and the city's officers from Hanshui City quickly rushed over.
From the battles, the Hanshui city officers deduced that the cultivation levels of the opponents were not low. The highest cultivation level among the officers who rushed from the city was at the Unification stage.
"It turns out to be Fellow Daoist Qiu." The officers from Hanshui City recognized Qiu Jin'an and greeted him respectfully with cupped fists.
As imperial officers, recognizing the heads of the Five Great Immortal Sects was a basic form of courtesy.
After all, these five sect leaders had both supervisory and law enforcement powers and wielded considerable authority.
It had even happened once before that Daoist Buyu violated the law, and the officials saw that Daoist Buyu had a significant background. They planned to abuse their power for personal gain. Unexpectedly, Daoist Buyu was displeased and directly alerted Emperor Xia, thus leading to the punishment of that officer.
Daoist Buyu also ended up in jail for his crime.
After this incident, both government and non-government officials were shocked. No official dared to commit such abuses anymore, at least not in the face of the Five Great Immortal Sects.
As for Daoist Buyu, he had set a precedent by having himself jailed.
"You are..." Qiu Jin'an didn't recognize the man in front of him.
"I am the Sima of Wild State, An Ping."
"Ah, it turns out to be Lord An." Although they had never met before, Qiu Jin'an still managed to show an 'ah, so it's you' face, pretending that he had just remembered.
"When I was in the city, I saw this place emitting raging fire and the Big Sun Hanging in the Sky. I don't know what happened here. Could Fellow Daoist Qiu tell me about it?"
"Just now, I encountered a Unification stage cultivator from Great Yu. After confronting him, the adversary was defeated and fled frantically."
"From the information disclosed by the opponent, the current disaster caused by ghosts in the city is his doing. I just don't know if he has any accomplices."
Lord An's expression became stern. This matter was not trivial. The current ghost disaster was a matter of utmost importance. They had always suspected that the Nine Nethers Cult was behind it. Now, it seems that it was the work of a cultivator from the Great Yu dynasty!
"Could Fellow Daoist Qiu have a detailed conversation with the governor?"
Qiu Jin'an laughed, "I happen to have something to discuss with the governor."
"That's great, but who are these people?"
"These three are disciples of the Seek Dao Sect. The one leading them is the young disciple of Old Buyu."
Hearing Lu Yang's identity, Lord An's face turned utterly solemn.
He was a rising star. When Daoist Buyu was active, he hadn't been born yet, and he essentially grew up listening to the legends of Daoist Buyu. He was well aware of how unfortunate it was to become Daoist Buyu's disciple.
"This one is a disciple of the Corpse Chasing Sect. This drowned ghost and the unconscious mortal lady are involved in insurance fraud. I was just about to hand them over to you for handling, they have an accomplice, Liu San from the Baishui village."
Without needing for Lord An to give an order, his subordinates already had the drowned ghost and the unconscious Huang Zao in custody. Someone was also rushing to Baishui village to arrest Liu San.
They no longer needed the intervention of Lu Yang and the others in the subsequent events.
"Wait for me for a moment."
Before leaving, Lu Yang said this and then, under everyone's doubtful gaze, reached into the dried-up cold lake. Saltwater continuously gushed out from his sleeve and filled up the cold lake.
The water drawn from the cold lake had been stored in the Village in the Palm.
Lord An was utterly astounded. Lu Yang was so young, yet he had already learnt the Universe within the Sleeve?
Seeing Lord An's astonished expression, Qiu Jin'an laughed heartily, "Surprising, isn't it? Just now, Lu Yang fought a Unification cultivator from Great Yu who had disbanded his cultivation and started over, and won with ease. His combat potential is sufficient to declare him the number one person among the young generation."
Although his own disciple could also defeat that Unification cultivator from the Great Yu dynasty who had disbanded his cultivation to start over, she definitely couldn't do it as easily as Lu Yang did.
During the battle, Qiu Jin'an observed Lu Yang. He noticed that Lu Yang did not use his Golden Core throughout the battle. Qiu Jin'an also suspected that Lu Yang had more powerful methods which he hadn't deployed.
At Lu Yang's age, he was certainly not as powerful as Lu Yang.
Truly worthy of being a disciple taught by Yun Zhi.
"So strong?!" Lord An was once again shocked. He hadn't expected that Qiu Jin'an would give such a high evaluation.
Given Qiu Jin'an's experience and knowledge, his judgment could not be wrong. There was also no need for him to exaggerate since Lu Yang was a disciple of the Seek Dao Sect, not the Five Elements Sect.
The Seek Dao Sect was still continuously producing talents.
Zhao Po secretly acknowledged that it was so indeed. He had noticed Lu Yang's ferocious demeanor during the fight and had a faint suspicion that Lu Yang could be the leader among the young generation. However, due to his lack of experience, he didn't rush to a conclusion.
"Did you hear that? I am the leader among the younger generation!" Lu Yang boasted triumphantly, like a victorious peacock, showing off in front of Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu.
"Brother Lu is so impressive!" Man Gu applauded sincerely.
Meng Jingzhou sneered, Lu Yang's tail was almost lifting to the sky, "What do you count as the leader of the young generation, the Eldest Senior Sister is the real one."
Lu Yang couldn't help but laugh, "You're just jealous of me, Eldest Senior Sister is not a part of the younger generation..."
Seeing Meng Jingzhou's playful and dangerous gaze, Lu Yang suddenly realized that something was wrong with what he had just said and stopped promptly, glaring at Meng Jingzhou.
Meng Jingzhou was looking in every direction, pretending that he was not the one who dug the pit.
...
Under the guidance of Lord An, the group met the newly appointed Governor of Wild State without any surprises.

chapters.title: Chapter 434 - 433: I am a Disciple of Seek Dao Sect's Yun Zhi_1
chapters.content:
The Governor's mansion was located in the very center of Hanshui City, a node of power in the Wild State. The mansion had seven entrances and seven exits, and was protected inside and out by defensive array methods.
This place served not only as the residence of the Governor but also as his office. When Lu Yang was shuttling through the mansion, he saw a lot of officials with a hustling look, flying around carrying documents, very busy.
This was not figurative speed, but literal flight.
Before meeting the Governor of the Wild State, Lord An had reported the situation to the Governor. Once the Governor met Qiu Jin'an and the others, he greeted them warmly with a handshake.
As Lord An had to go arrange a city-wide search for the real Master Mong Tian, he excused himself first.
"Fellow Daoist Qiu, I've long heard of your great name! My surname is Lv, my given name is Ke, but people all call me Old Lv." Governor Lv was a chatty person, and despite being kept busy around the clock by the recent ghost disaster, he was still full of vigor and showed no signs of fatigue.
"It's a pleasure to meet you, Governor Lv," Qiu Jin'an smiled, not addressing him as Old Lv.
The last person who was so familiar with him was the Ninth Son of the Seek Dao Sect, a memorable individual.
Qiu Jin'an's father was the previous Sect Leader of the Five Elements Sect. He once accompanied his father to visit the Seek Dao Sect in his youth and met the fervent Ninth Son of Seek Dao Sect.
He was young and naive at the time and didn't realize the cunning nature of the Ninth Son of the Seek Dao Sect. Sixth Elder Feng Ya was the only exception, an anomaly among the Ninth Sons of the Seek Dao Sect. However, she was never absent from any mischief.
Therefore, he was always wary of overly familiar people.
"The former Governor, without any reason, decided to host a birthday banquet for his daughter and invite a lot of people. Inviting people was fine, but he also asked them to bring a ton of gifts, without prior notice to the court. Now, he's been demoted and put in jail. A few officials and notable figures from several major Sects in the Wild State are also now behind bars," Governor Lv grumbled.
This was one of the reasons they were currently so busy. They were short of manpower, had temporary replacements in key positions, and faced difficulties coordinating. They even had to rely on the Corpse Chasing Sect, which was nearest, to help deal with the ghost problem.
"The long-absent Old Xu, ah, the Minister of Justice, has also finally ended his leave and is working on their case."
The Minister of Justice publicly announced that he was taking a leave of absence due to the sudden death of an old friend and needed to bid him a final farewell.
"This has made His Majesty distrust the officials of the Wild State. He brought me, a man in charge of financial affairs, over to fill in, forcing me to leave the Imperial City and rush to the Wild State."
"Right, I have been talking all the way and haven't asked yet, who are these young fellows?" Governor Lv snapped back to reality when he noticed Lu Yang and the others.
"These three are disciples of the Seek Dao Sect, they are my junior brothers. I've been helping them with their cultivation. This is Zhao Po, a disciple of the Grand Elder of the Corpse Chasing Sect. He also witnessed the entire course of the fight just now."
Upon hearing that Governor Lv was an official from the Imperial City, Qiu Jin'an did not mention that Lu Yang was a disciple of Daoist Buyu.
"Solid foundation, full Golden Core, all outstanding youngsters," Governor Lv nodded in approval, "Please tell me about the battle just now, Fellow Daoist Qiu."
This was the most pressing matter at hand.
Qiu Jin'an detailed the process of how Lu Yang encountered Huang Ming, defeated Huang Ming, Master Mong Tian making a move, and him defeating Master Mong Tian.
"So, you're suggesting that Master Mong Tian has been capturing fierce ghosts from various places and throwing them into our Hanshui City?" Governor Lv was furious, having finally found the culprit behind today's disaster.
No wonder there were so many fierce ghosts. It felt like he had captured all the ghosts in Great Xia and didn't even spare those in the East Sea!
He'd never get them all cleared out at this rate!
"The ghost problem in Hanshui City could not have been done by one person alone. I suspect he has accomplices," Qiu Jin'an suggested.
"They must have taken advantage of my recent appointment and the fact I can't yet fully wield the power of State Destiny!" Governor Lv had not known about the power of State Destiny before. It was only recently, upon his appointment by Emperor Xia, that he was informed.
"Also, keep in mind the one who started over after disbanding cultivation, that Huang Ming. In the past, we only focused on the ancient cultivators in the Unification phase and overlooked the possibility that some of them might start over after disbanding cultivation."
Governor Lv sighed, "Knowing this is useless, as starting over after disbanding cultivation is like a rebirth. It's very hard to trace their origins."
"Forget it, I will report the matter of starting over after disbanding cultivation to the court later. The top priority now is to deal with the ghost problem."
"Before, I thought the ghost problem was caused by the Nine Nether Sect, as they have quite a few ghosts themselves. Now that it's confirmed to be the work of the cultivators from Great Yu, the matter is serious. The cultivators from Great Yu don't raise ghosts. They have gone to great lengths to capture fierce ghosts from various places and throw them into Hanshui City.
The purpose should not be as simple as just causing trouble. There must be other motives!"
Governor Lv's face was grim; he wished he could tear those cultivators of Great Yu to shreds.
"May I ask, could they possibly be setting up an array?" Lu Yang raised his hand and timidly proposed the question.
"Array method?" Governor Lv and Qiu Jin'an both looked surprised, chewing over this word as if it had sparked some sort of realization.
Back when Lu Yang was in Yanjiang County, the then Rudder Master of Yanjiang Rudder, who also served as the County Magistrate, set up an array method throughout the county in an attempt to absorb the lifespan of the entire county to enhance his cultivation.
Considering this precedent, Lu Yang raised the question.
"It could indeed be possible that they are setting up an array method!" Governor Lv slapped his thigh. He had been so busy these past few days that he hadn't thought of this.
He moved towards a giant sand table, clapped his hands lightly, and the sand trembled. The waves rose and fell like desert waves, finally taking shape and forming a miniature of Hanshui City.
He took out a set of small flags from his pocket and threw them onto the sand table. The place where the flags fell indicated where the ghost disasters had occurred.
The type and level of ghosts were still marked on each flag.
"Hiss, looking at it this way, it really does look like an array," Governor Lv joyfully discovered that Lu Yang's guess was likely correct.
"No wonder you are a disciple of the Seek Dao Sect, a prominent student of a famous teacher! May I ask, which elder of the Seek Dao Sect is your master, young friend?"
Lu Yang, "..."
Before telling the truth, Lu Yang wanted to know how big a grudge Governor Lv had against his master.
"My master is Yun Zhi from the Seek Dao Sect."
Lu Yang respected his master and didn't dare to mention her given name while outside the sect.
Meng Jingzhou disdainfully watched Lu Yang. What a shameless act.
"Yun Zhi? The name sounds familiar." Governor Lv thought for a moment, but he hadn't heard of an Elder Yun Zhi in the Seek Dao Sect.
"My master seldom leaves our sect, so few people know about her."
"I see."
Governor Lv didn't try to remember who Yun Zhi was. He ordered his men to bring the city's array master to figure out what kind of array the Great Yu cultivator had set up in the city, as he and Qiu Jin'an weren't good at array methods.
Soon enough some elderly men with white beards were brought in. They stood by the sand table, observing and deducing.
Fortunately, all of these array masters were male cultivators.
Joints efforts of these array masters soon yielded preliminary results. After hearing their initial conclusions, Governor Lv said to Qiu Jin'an, "Youngster Lu was right in guessing. The Great Yu cultivator is indeed setting up an array, but the one they are establishing is a kind that has been lost. It will take some time to deduce its purpose and how to break it. Let's wait for the moment."
Seeing that the timing was right, Qiu Jin'an respectfully said, "Since we have some free time at hand, could the Governor allow me and this young fellow to use the power of State Destiny together?"

chapters.title: Chapter 435 - 434 Causality Backlash Disappears_1
chapters.content:
"Utilize the power of the State Destiny?" Governor Lv was taken aback upon hearing this.
"Is that not permissible?"
"No, no, no, it is certainly permissible."
The Five Great Immortal Sects and the imperial court share a righteous alliance, and there isn't any substantive superior-subordinate relationship between them.
A hundred thousand years ago, the founding master of the Seek Dao Sect, Celestial Master Guiyuan, along with four others, established the Five Great Immortal Sects. They made an alliance with Great Xia which included the enforcement of laws, supervisory rights, and tax exemptions among others.
Furthermore, the sect leader of the Immortal Sect is allowed to use the power of the State Destiny.
Sect Leader Qiu, who was aware of the contents of the alliance agreement, made this request.
Governor Lv was unaware of the contents of the alliance agreement, but before he took up his position as governor of the Wild State, Emperor Xia personally trained him in an emergency, informing him that the sect leader of the Immortal Sect can utilize the power of the State Destiny.
Reflecting on the power of the State Destiny, it seems Sect Leader Qiu is more familiar with it.
"Given Sect Leader Qiu's unrivaled cultivation level, I wonder what kind of problem he encountered that led him to be cursed?" Governor Lv asked curiously.
Sect Leader Qiu sighed and vehemently stated, "It's a long story, it was a mere coincidence that I happened to encounter this Meng Family boy. We were thrust into a perilous situation and ventured deep into the demon cave, driven by the intention to cleanse the evil and restore peace and prosperity to the world.
However, the demon cave turned out to be a stronghold of the demon path, teeming with masters and I struggled to gain the upper hand in the battles."
"Not to mention that two fists cannot contend against four hands, my strength was limited, and the demon path had a powerful influence, they cursed both me and the Meng Family boy during the battles!"
"So that was it, the cultivators on the demon path are truly despicable!" Governor Lv gained a sudden insight and voiced his indignation on behalf of Sect Leader Qiu.
"Sect Leader Qiu, would you mind letting us know which of The Three Great Demon Sects you went to?"
Sect Leader Qiu shook his head, not wishing to dwell onto the details. Governor Lv tactfully refrained from asking further.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had strange expressions on their faces but remained silent.
"Sect Leader Qiu, you are awesome, venturing solo into a demon sect!" Man Gu cupped his fists in admiration, the thought of Sect Leader Qiu ridding the demon cave single-handedly was indeed very impressive!
When Sect Leader Qiu infiltrated the Seek Dao Sect, Man Gu was in the wilderness participating in a rite of passage to adulthood, oblivious to the circumstances back then.
"Utilizing the power of the State Destiny is possible, it's just that I have only just begun to familiarize myself with it, and am not very adept at handling it yet."
"No matter, it does not require a complicated process, simply using the power of the State Destiny to cleanse both of us will suffice."
"All right then." Governor Lv agreed readily.
The power of State Destiny is a major secret. Governor Lv only allowed the unfortunate duo of Sect Leader Qiu and Meng Jingzhou to accompany him. Lu Yang, Man Gu, and Zhao Po waited at the original location.
After a series of events, the three of them were somewhat exhausted. Initially, they were supposed to assist in dealing with a drowned ghost, but subsequently, the situation spiraled out of control. Having to start over after disbanding cultivation, the unification of Great Yu intervening, and then Sect Leader Qiu stepping in to save the day,
"I would never have imagined, Senior Brother Huang Ming actually started over after disbanding his cultivation at the Unification stage!" Zhao Po expressed his bitter smile. He had always wanted to share cultivation experiences with Huang Ming, but Huang Ming was aloof and indifferent towards him.
At first, Zhao Po did not understand why, but now it was abundantly clear, they were not on the same path after all.
"Judging by Huang Ming's skills, he was highly skilled in the Corpse Chasing Arts even before he disbanded his cultivation." Lu Yang analyzed, stating that this might have been the reason why Huang Ming chose the Corpse Chasing Sect.
This wasn't unusual, the history of the Corpse Chasing Arts could be traced back to ancient times, it was perfectly normal for Great Yu cultivators to master it.
"We do not know how many ancient cultivators have started over after disbanding cultivation, Huang Ming rebuilt his cultivation to the Golden Core Stage, but that certainly does not mean that the other ancient cultivators have also re-cultivated to the Golden Core Stage!" declared Lu Yang seriously.
This differed from the demon sects; the demon sects had low-rank cultivators to infiltrate, unlike the ancient cultivators who start anew at the Unification stage to an unknown upper limit, making them even more challenging to handle.
"Just started over after disbanding cultivation, yet none of them have attained immortality. Disgraceful," Fairy Eternity, being an immortal herself, had utter contempt for these resurgent cultivators.
"Hmm, what are you looking at, Fairy?" Lu Yang noticed that Fairy Eternity was lying on the bed, her eyes fixed unwaveringly at something.
The figures on the screen were very familiar; they were Governor Lv, Sect Leader Qiu, and Meng Jingzhou who had just left.
"I have never seen how the power of State Destiny is used before, I want to see."
"Move over, let me look as well." Lu Yang too was curious and wanted to see, so he asked Fairy Eternity to make some space and he leaned next to her to look.
The place that controlled the power of the State Destiny was heavily fortified. The power of the State Destiny itself could also prevent prying eyes. Even those at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage wouldn't be able to breach it. However, these defenses were ineffective in front of Fairy Eternity, the foremost among the Five Immortals from ancient times.
If it were an immortal on the court's side in control of the power of State Destiny, then Fairy Eternity might have had a challenge, but otherwise, nobody could prevent Fairy Eternity from spying on the power of State Destiny.
In the light screen, Governor Lv led the two into a stone secret chamber.
The secret chamber was airtight, without a single gap. It didn't appear to be constructed from an assembly of stones, rather carved out from a single massive stone.
In the secret chamber, there was a small pool that was empty, void of anything. In the middle, there was a square indent. Governor Lv held the Seal of Wild State and stamped it onto the indent.
Suddenly, a material that resembled both light and water appeared. It filled up the indent in strands and patches.
"So this is the power of State Destiny."
Seeing Lu Yang still somewhat confused, Fairy Eternity explained: "The power of State Destiny has been present in every inch of Great Xia all along, existing in an imperceptible and indetectable manner. The Seal of Wild State is the key that can transform the power of the State Destiny from an indetectable state to a detectable state."
"The Seal of Wild State is a formidable treasure that recognizes its master. Only Governor Lv can wield this treasure."
"About the power of State Destiny, it is possibly not very strong because it's only the State Destiny of one state. If the State Destiny of all seventeen states converged, then its might would be considerable. It seems the immortal from Great Xia's court does have some abilities."
"Of course, it's only some abilities, still far from my level."
Elsewhere, Meng Jingzhou got his first close look at the power of the State Destiny, feeling hope was within his grasp for resolving the backlash on Causality.
"Should we just jump in directly?"
Sect Leader Qiu prevented Meng Jingzhou's suicidal impulse: "If you were at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, jumping in may offer a slim chance of survival."
Admitting to his Golden Dan Dignity, Meng Jingzhou felt he was still some distance from reaching the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, and decided not to jump in just yet.
A flow of State Destiny, as thick as an arm, shot out. It was Governor Lv who was manipulating it.
