Governor Lv awkwardly controlled the power of the State Destiny, gradually diminishing its corrosive properties. He pointed with two fingers at Sect Leader Qiu and Meng Jingzhou, uttered a command and the power of the State Destiny began to cleanse them.
"This feels so good!" Meng Jingzhou exclaimed in surprise. This was even more comfortable than when he first came in contact with spiritual essence.
A pinkish fog drifted out and was quickly absorbed, melted, and disappeared into nothingness by the power of the State Destiny.
The curse that had been weighing on his mind for so long had disappeared, Sect Leader Qiu also felt extremely relieved.
"Ho――that feels good!"
"The curse has finally disappeared. Let's celebrate at a brothel. Brother Lv, where is the best brothel in Hanshui City?"
Governor Lv: "..."
Is it appropriate to ask me this question?
"There used to be a zoo, it was the best brothel, but it is currently closed for refurbishment."

chapters.title: Chapter 436 - 435 Innate Eight Diagrams and Postnatal Eight Diagrams_1
chapters.content:
"Do these ghosts' positions embody the Innate Eight Diagrams, arranged based on core position of 'Kun'?"
"The Innate Eight Diagrams encompass all the phenomena of the world, using ghosts to represent all manners of scenes. Look here, this position is a ghost of drowning, which died in the water, hence it represents water. This position is a wronged ghost, buried in the ground, hence it represents earth. This position is a seductive ghost, a manifestation of lustful fire, hence it represents fire.
This position is the Skin-Peeling Ghost... Ah, this one may just be filling a quota."
"No, I believe this grand formation hints at the Postnatal Eight Diagrams. It should be arranged according to the principles of the Postnatal Eight Diagrams, with the Array Eye at the 'Zhen' position."
"What kind of Array Method did you all learn? Are the array setup nodes solely exclusive to ghosts? Can't buildings serve as array points?"
"Look at Hanshui City. On one side is the Yin Corpse Mountain Range, the symbol of extreme Yin, owned by the Corpse Chasing Sect. On the other side is the bustling area of the brothel, crowded with people, symbolizing extreme Yang. Centered around the State Governor Mansion, the Yin and Yang are balanced, contributing to the city's prosperity.
This was the original intention when founding Hanshui City."
"Now, someone has placed Fierce Ghosts in Hanshui City, breaking the balance of Yin and Yang. Can't you understand such a simple principle?"
"Bullshit theory. The rumor about the balance of Yin and Yang in Hanshui City has been circulating for tens of thousands of years, and there are still believers!"
"It's not about my belief, I call this rational analysis!"
"What kind of rational analysis is this? We are all cultivators, the strong are respected, the capable should prove their strength!"
The Array Method masters were bickering incessantly, their disagreement escalating to a point where they were on the brink of fighting.
Lu Yang wanted to step forward to stop it, but his voice carried little weight and could not stop these old scholars.
There's actually a way to stop these old scholars from bickering: just say he is Daoist Buyu's apprentice. Lu Yang believed the focus of these old scholars would shift from the array to himself.
However, this method carries too much risk, and even Fairy Eternity would have a hard time protecting him.
Though, even if the risk weren't high, Fairy Eternity still might not be able to protect him.
"Gentlemen... How is it going with the study of the Array Method?" Governor Lv came out of his stone chamber and headed straight here to check on the progress of the masters.
Qiu Jin'an and Meng Jingzhou wore expressions of relief, seemingly feeling lighter.
"Don't worry, as I promised you, I will teach you one of our sect's secret techniques once all this is over." Qiu Jin'an reassured Meng Jingzhou, echoing a promise made during a confrontation with Uncle Ba.
He was a man of his word.
"So it's over?" Lu Yang asked, pretending that he didn't already know the outcome so as not to expose his spying.
"Is Brother Meng's curse lifted?" Man Gu was genuinely concerned about Meng Jingzhou, and Zhao Po, trailing behind, was also very interested in Meng Jingzhou's condition.
"It's over, it's over. After so much time, it's finally done. I'm free again!"
"If you had followed my advice and committed suicide once, the curse would have been lifted long ago." Fairy Eternity mumbled, complaining that the curse-lifting efficiency was far too low.
"How was Brother Meng's curse lifted again?" Man Gu suddenly asked, looking a bit confused as if he had just forgotten what had just happened.
Zhao Po was in the same boat.
It seemed that the characteristic of an Immortal was taking effect.
Meng Jingzhou chuckled but did not reply.
Otherwise, he might have to repeat himself every time Man Gu asked, which could lead to an endless loop.
"It's a pity that Eldest Senior Sister isn't here. Otherwise, we wouldn't have to make this trip to Wild State." Meng Jingzhou missed the days when Eldest Senior Sister was around.
Qiu Jin'an was surprised and didn't understand why Meng Jingzhou had this question: "You mean Yun Zhi? She's at the Seek Dao Sect. I saw her when I went to ask where you two were."
"When did Eldest Senior Sister return to the sect?"
"The second day after you two set off for Wild State."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Lu Yang: "..."
"What are you so anxious to come to Wild State for!" Lu Yang was the first to argue, wanting to gain the upper hand.
"What do you mean I was in a rush to come to Wild State? How would I know Eldest Senior Sister would return so quickly? Instead, it's you. You always follow Eldest Senior Sister everywhere. How come you don't even know where Sister went?" Meng Jingzhou skillfully shifted the blame onto Lu Yang.
"Who dares to inquire about Eldest Senior Sister's whereabouts, do you dare?"
"I don't dare!" Meng Jingzhou was brimming with righteousness.
"If you two are asking about what Yun Zhi went to do, I do know about that." Qiu Jin'an said.
"She went to process the prison release procedures for Old Buyu."
Meng Jingzhou: "....."
Lu Yang: "....."
"The Sect Leader got into trouble and was imprisoned again?" Man Gu was surprised.
Governor Lv was listening to the opinions of the Array Method masters.
"Trust me, the principle behind this formation is definitely the Innate Eight Diagrams!"
"What Innate Eight Diagrams, it's obviously the Postnatal Eight Diagrams!"
Having overheard their conversation, Qiu Jin'an sighed, finding it somewhat vexing: "It's the same old conflict between the Innate and Postnatal Eight Diagrams. Such a headache."
"Innate Eight Diagrams and Postnatal Eight Diagrams conflict?" Lu Yang and the others had never heard of this debate before.
"This involves the profound theories of the Array Method. It's normal that you haven't heard of it."
"The Innate Eight Diagrams and the Postnatal Eight Diagrams originated from ancient times. It's said that it's what an ancient immortal acquired from observing celestial phenomena and examining the geography, hence it aligns with the laws of heaven and earth."
"This ancient immortal proposed the theory of the Eight Diagrams, but too much of the ancient civilization was lost and what remained and passed down to now are only the Innate and Postnatal Eight Diagrams. Hence, both parties often quarrel about which is the authentic lineage."
"If we could complete the Eight Diagrams theory, this dispute between Innate and Postnatal would cease."
"Ah, the Eight Diagrams theory, I know about this." Fairy Eternity once again displayed her abundant experience. Many of the grand events and legends from the ancient times, she had experienced personally, or was the one pulling the strings behind the scenes.
"You know?"
"The way you put it... what don't I know? The birth of this Eight Diagrams theory is closely related to me."
"This theory was proposed by you, Fairy?" Lu Yang was amazed, immediately thinking of Fairy Eternity as much more intelligent.
Fairy Eternity shook her head, without the slight arrogance: "Oh no, not that much. This theory was reasoned by Time Immortal, and while he reasoned it out, I merely waved the flag and spurred him on, to give him confidence."
Lu Yang thought to himself, "Was there also a penalty? If Time Immortal couldn't deduce it within the specified time, would he become your meal?"
Fairy Eternity didn't realize that Lu Yang was making fun of her, and continued to recall her past: "He counted stars, crouched on the ground watching dirt, and then after he calculated for a while, figured out a theory."
"According to him, this Eight Diagrams theory comprehends all phenomena in the world. It can serves as the foundation for the Array Method. When an array is setup using this theory, it's puzzling and profound. To peers who try to deduce methods to break this array, it's very challenging. It truly is top-notch theory!"
"The complete Eight Diagrams theory is divided into four parts: Innate Eight Diagrams, Today's Eight Diagrams, Tomorrow's Eight Diagrams, and Postnatal Eight Diagrams. How this theory was transmitted, we don't know, now only the Innate Eight Diagrams and Postnatal Eight Diagrams are left."

chapters.title: Chapter 437 - 436 Three Possibilities_1
chapters.content:
"Time Immortal doesn't have a good sense of naming, he made up the name for Innate Eight Diagrams, and I made up the names for the latter three. Doesn't the names I gave sound better?"
Fairy Eternity's contributions to Eight Diagrams theory not only manifested in her avid support, but she also participated in the crucial phase of naming.
Lu Yang reluctantly nodded, "Indeed... the last three Eight Diagrams names are easier to grasp."
"The Eight Diagrams theory is the orthodox time magic skill. It's not an exaggeration to say it encompasses everything in the world. Innate Eight Diagrams observes the past, Today's Eight Diagrams controls the present, Tomorrow's Eight Diagrams predicts the future. These three represent the past, present, and future as a whole."
"Postnatal Eight Diagrams represents the unpredictable distant future. The prediction is merely a possibility, the hardest one to grasp. Even Time Immortal wouldn't say that he could predict what will happen in the distant future. There are too many variables."
"Setting up Array Method using Eight Diagrams theory means planning with time as the dimension, so cultivators of the same level will find it very hard to decipher."
After Fairy Eternity's explanation, Lu Yang felt that the Eight Diagrams theory had regained its credibility again.
"No wonder the array masters endlessly argued about Innate and Postnatal Eight Diagrams without conclusion. It turns out they haven't even grasped the basics yet." Lu Yang unintentionally solved a problem that had troubled the array community for three hundred thousand years.
Without discussing how to use Innate Eight Diagrams and Postnatal Eight Diagrams, they didn't even take the right direction in the first place. This is the theory of time magic skill.
If Lu Yang were to publish his research findings, it would inevitably shock the array community, and even Uncle Ba, who is proficient in array methods, would have to serve Lu Yang tea and water.
Time magic is obscure and hard to understand, it is the hardest magic skill to learn in the world. Even the gifted Fairy Eternity only learned how to forecast the weather.
And Lu Yang who is as gifted, only learned how to "predict what won't happen in the future".
At this time, all the array masters were still debating what kind of array was set up in Hanshui City and the theoretical basis of the array.
"Enough, stop arguing!"
Governor Lv shouted angrily, finally intimidating these few array masters.
If they were allowed to continue arguing, even if the Great Yu's cultivators launched their array method, they still wouldn't reach a conclusion.
"Master Fang, you are an Innate Eight Diagrams master. According to your theory, what is the purpose of the array set up by the cultivator of Great Yu, and how should it be broken?"
Master Fang, looking like a scholar with three strands of white beard looking quite imposing, replied in a composed manner, "I haven't figured out the purpose of the array in the city yet."
"The way to break it relies on the Array Eye, from what I've seen, the Array Eye is located in Hundred Flowers Wine Factory. The urgent matter is to block Hundred Flowers Wine Factory, if there are Fierce Ghosts in the wine house, we can confirm my guess!"
Governor Lv turned to another array master, "Master Miao, you are a Postnatal array master, what do you think is the purpose of the array set up by the Great Yu cultivator, and how should it be broken?"
"The array in Hanshui City can counteract the Postnatal, reversing Yin and Yang, but I don't know what it's reversing. The way to break the array also relies on the Array Eye, what I find strange is that the Array Eye is located at the entrance of the Corpse Chasing Sect.
There should be a Fierce Ghost acting as the Array Eye, perhaps it has the ability to hide, hidden under the eyes of the Corpse Chasing Sect!"
Master Miao didn't know, but Governor Lu knew, with a traitor like Huang Ming in the Corpse Chasing Sect, planting a Fierce Ghost as the Array Eye isn't a difficult thing.
"Master Ren, what about you, you said it's neither Postnatal array nor Innate array, but the cultivator of Great Yu is reversing Yin and Yang?"
"Exactly, Yin and Yang are out of balance, and thousands of ghosts are marching. The city is in chaos, but I don't know what Great Yu cultivator is trying to do. The best strategy for now is to speed up the removal of Fierce Ghosts."
Governor Lu contemplated, Master Ren didn't know what would happen when the city was in chaos, but he did - Hanshui City is the core of the Wild State. With Hanshui City in chaos, people will live in fear, which would impact the state destiny of the whole Wild State.
"Do other masters have different ideas?" Governor Lv looked at the other array masters who hadn't spoken yet.
The array masters shook their heads, their views were also these three.
Seeing no other possibilities, Governor Lv quickly made a decision and began to delegate tasks to everyone, "Solving the theories of Innate and Postnatal is not difficult, Sect Leader Qiu, please go to Hundred Flowers Wine Factory to investigate and see if there's anything unusual in the wine house."
If the Hundred Flowers Wine Factory is the Array Eye, there must be a powerful Fierce Ghost equivalent to the power of the Great Ghost King, extremely dangerous.
Governor Lv was glad of Qiu Jin'an's arrival in Hanshui City, for it was a great help.
The Array Eye, a dangerous place, is most secure to be approached by a team of three or five Unification cultivators. But currently, they could not spare so many Unification cultivators to the wine house, thankfully Qiu Jin'an alone counted as three to five Unification cultivators.
"Okay, I will go right now." Qiu Jin'an accepted, remaining composed.
He didn't even feel that there would be any danger if Hundred Flowers Wine Factory turned out to be the Array Eye."
"As for the matter of Corpse Chasing Sect, with Master Ru in retreat, let Elder Gai conduct a strict investigation of the Corpse Chasing Sect!"
Governor Lu sent a follower to inform him to hurry to the Corpse Chasing Sect and explain the situation.
With Master Ru in retreat, Elder Gai is the acting Sect Leader.
Governor Lu didn't let Zhao Po send the message, since Zhao Po's cultivation level was too low, and he moved too slowly, at this moment, swift action was needed.
Then, he called over An Ping, the Sima Officer of the Wild State, "Old An, we can't just let the disciples of the Corpse Chasing Sect do the work, you need to increase manpower and conduct a carpet search, you must solve the ghost problem in Hanshui City as quickly as possible!"
"Yes!"
As soon as everything was arranged, Governor Lv heaved a sigh of relief and felt more at ease.
Governor Lv didn't forget to make arrangements for Lu Yang and his party, "Now Hanshui City is not safe, you stay at my house for the time being. Once the situation is over, I will ask Sect Leader Qiu to send you back."
Lu Yang and his party proposed to go out and help defeat the ghosts, but Governor Lv felt they were of special status and it wouldn't be good to explain to Seek Dao Sect if anything happened to them, so, he resolutely disagreed. With no choice, Lu Yang and his party had to stay at Governor Lv's house.
...
"What, you're saying Huang Ming is a cultivator of Great Yu who started over after disbanding cultivation!" When Elder Gai got news of this, veins bulged and he raged.
The back mountain of the Corpse Chasing Sect was shaking, for that was the location of his true form.
Huang Ming is a spy of Great Yu, and he audaciously became the number one winner in the Sect's contest. This was a disgrace to the Corpse Chasing Sect and would be ridiculed if it got out!
"Governor Lv is giving us a chance to make amends by letting the sect do a self-examination. We must conduct a thorough investigation!"
Elder Gai called out the other three elders, informed them of the matter, and their reaction was similar to Elder Gai's. They all decided to thoroughly investigate the Corpse Chasing Sect from top to bottom to see if Huang Ming had left any other surprises.
...
"Oh, I can't get in contact with Mong Tian and Huang Ming now, I sense someone fighting outside the city at the Unification level, has Mong Tian been exposed and is fighting with cultivators of Great Xia and has been caught by Great Xia?"
"In that case, our plan will be exposed soon. Since that's the case, I can only strike first."
Inside the secret chamber, a figure slowly rose, a confident smile curling at the corner of his mouth.
And from him, emanated a powerful aura that not even a Unification cultivator at his peak could possess.

chapters.title: Chapter 438 - 438: 437
chapters.content:
Hundred Flowers Tavern.
Hundred Flowers Tavern, located on the west side of Hanshui City, is among the top twenty taverns in the city. The tavern is famous for its unique wine, crafted from over 150 varieties of seasonal flowers. Owing to changing seasons, the taste of the Hundred Flowers Wine varies throughout the year.
Qiu Jin'an entered the bustling Hundred Flowers Tavern, which was to the brim with patrons. The waiters were spinning like tops, rushing back and forth between the lobby and the kitchen.
After some time, Qiu Jin'an finally found a vacant spot in a corner.
"Excuse me, is this seat taken?" he asked.
Sitting across from him was a rotund patron who was enjoying his meal profusely, his forehead gleaming with sweat.
The patron looked up at Qiu Jin'an and said with a stranger's indifference, "No one, you can sit."
"Unexpected, I must say, that there are so many people here even before dining time," Qiu Jin'an made conversation with the patron as he waited for a waiter to come.
The patron, not much for conversation, concentrated on his meal and responded to Qiu Jin'an absentmindedly.
The waiter brought over the menu, and after browsing through it casually, Qiu Jin'an returned it. "A bowl of rice, five plates of your signature dishes, five plates of your most expensive dishes, and a pot of the Hundred Years Hundred Flowers Wine."
"Very well, sir, please wait a moment," responded the waiter.
It wasn't long before a bowl of rice and ten alluring dishes were served to him, accompanied by a pot of the aged, fragrant Hundred Flowers Wine. It made the patron sitting across him drool with envy.
"If there's nothing else you need, I will take my leave, sir," the waiter said.
However, Qiu Jin'an dispatched him a retort. "I, a living human, won't be eating a dead man's food."
The waiter looked confused, not understanding what Qiu Jin'an was talking about.
Qiu Jin'an snapped his fingers as the sound of faint cracks filled the air, as if someone were stepping on a newly frozen surface of a lake. As the ice cracked, the true face of the lake was revealed.
Looking at the lobby again, the bustling tavern and its patrons were gone.
Each patron had their heads lowered, with small figures, roughly a meter tall, prancing on their necks.
The round patron sitting across Qiu Jin'an had an exaggerated belly, making him look like a ball.
The waiter was skinny as a rail, so thin that a gust of wind could blow him away.
The dishes laid out in front of Qiu Jin'an were not enticing at all. They were filled with maggots and raw meat still twitching on the plate.
The only thing that remained unchanged was the rice. However, it now had three chopsticks sticking out of it.
Qiu Jin'an's smile widened. "Trying to confront me with just two kings of ghosts, the Bloated Ghost and the Starving Ghost, along with their lackeys? How quaint."
The rotund patron and slim waiter dropped their pretense and showed their wicked grins.
A small figure quietly climbed onto Qiu Jin'an's neck...
...
The Corpse Chasing Sect.
Four cultivators, garbed in ancient clothing, appeared collectively at the gates of the Corpse Chasing Sect. They ignored the sect's disciples, each moving quickly in a different direction towards four locations in the Yin Corpse Mountain Range.
Boom——
Boom——
Boom——
Boom——
Battles broke out simultaneously at four locations.
"Damn it, that good-for-nothing Huang Ming must have secretly figured out our location!" Elder Gai said furiously. They hadn't even yet begun to search the Corpse Chasing Sect before they found themselves under attack.
The four elders of the Corpse Chasing Sect were caught off guard. Fortunately, they reacted quickly enough to summon their Living Corpses.
One of the anciently garbed cultivators sneered, "So, you are a sect that accidentally obtained our legacy; you actually dare to oppose us?"
"You're from the Witch Corpse Sect!" exclaimed Elder Gai. Recognizing their clothing and the way they spoke, his pupils contracted.
The Corpse Chasing Sect's founder owes the creation of this sect to a stroke of luck where he rushed into a Secret Realm by accident, survived three life-or-death crises, and obtained a complete Corpse Chasing Technique.
This legacy originates from a group known as the Witch Corpse Sect during the Great Yu dynasty. According to the classification by the Great Xia, the Witch Corpse Sect was a Superb Sect, with a Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivator as its stalwart.
The Witch Corpse Sect fell during the early wars of Great Xia's founding, leaving behind only a legacy that was obtained by the founder of the Corpse Chasing Sect.
One of the anciently garbed cultivators rubbed his ring, summoning dust-covered Living Corpses whose seals had been broken. These corpses, redolent of antiquity and death, crossed a span of over a hundred thousand years to wage battle with the present generation.
Four, eight, sixteen, twenty... a total of twenty Living Corpses appeared, besieging Elder Gai and the others!
"Let's see, you young ones, how much of our abilities you've managed to learn," he remarked.
...
A majestic figure stood in the sky above Hanshui City, right above the State Governor Mansion.
This man was like a king, standing tall on his feet, displaying a sense of dominance and aggression with his every movement.
His presence was so powerful that the people of Hanshui City couldn't help but look up at the sky. Seeing the magnificent man, who seemed as imposing as the sun, stirred an inexplicable panic in their hearts.
"After all the preparation, the plan has been revealed. Why can't Huang Ming and Mong Tian, who are good for nothing, accomplish anything substantial?"
The king-like figure's eyes flashed with murderous intent. If he had been able to get in touch with those two, he wouldn't have to expose himself this early.
A little later, just a little more, and the plan would have been flawless, once the Great Array had been activated.
"Oh well, there's no such thing as a perfect plan in this world."
"The Heavenly Calamity Sovereign has failed and fallen into Qingzhou, reportedly apprehended by an unexpected master."
"Over the past few days, I've already investigated Hanshui City. No one here poses a threat to me."
"To be on the safe side, I'll establish a rule here. For one day, no information could be transmitted out of Hanshui City."
Adding a time limit could enhance the enforcement of the rule.
Lu Yang looked up at the royal-like figure in the sky and felt overwhelmed.
At the first warning from Fairy Eternity, he tried to call on his Eldest Senior Sister using the Imitation Fist to borrow her power, but he was a step too late. A new rule had been established in the area by the king-like figure, making it impossible for him to contact her.
"Aren't supposed to be very few people at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage? Why do I keep encountering them? The City Governor even said that this place is the safest, but why do I feel this is the most dangerous?"
"Could it be because I'm the young Master of Heaven's Court, and they're all eager to see me?"
"Hey, since you're already a young Master, shouldn't I get a position as well in Heaven's Court?"
"How about becoming the bootlicker of the young Master?"
"Sod off."
Old horse sensed the Transcendence Tribulation Stage pressure emanating from the sky, contemplating whether it was time for it to retire.
Meng Jingzhou's father had asked him to be Meng Jingzhou's protector, and it had thought the task was quite simple. Thus, it agreed without hesitation.
However, upon recalling how it first recruited Yun Zhi to the Seek Dao Sect then revived Fairy Eternity at the Yanjiang Rudder, getting involved with an ancient Transcendence Tribulation cultivator in Qingzhou, and now encountering another one here in Wild State, it felt it had taken on too much.
Men Gu had always had faith in Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou. He believed that nothing would go wrong as long as the two senior brothers were around, hence he looked quite calm.
Zhao Po was the most fretful among the four. They had just had an encounter with Mong Tian, a union-stage practitioner of the Great Yu in the morning, and now in the afternoon, they had another encounter with a Transcendence Tribulation Stage practitioner from Great Yu.
What kind of luck was this?
Of late, he felt that his luck had been very bad. But when did it start to turn bad?

chapters.title: Chapter 439 - 438: Ranked Second in the Cultivation Level among Successive Generations of Emperor Yu!_1
chapters.content:
The moment the emperor-like figure appeared, cultivators of the Great Yu who were hidden in the shadows all made their move. Fierce ghosts roamed and chaos ensued, occupying all the cultivators who intended to rush to the State Governor Mansion.
The emperor-like figure stood above the State Governor Mansion, casting gaze like a dragon, exuding a hint of menace.
He opened his palm, the sky turned dark, and a gigantic palm descending, the size of half the city, encapsulating multiple dimensions within it. The space within the palm twisted, conjuring a tumultuous surge of spiritual essence.
If this palm were to land, Hanshui City would undoubtedly turn into a death zone!
"How dare you!"
Governor Lv roared vehemently, akin to thunder resonating, making ripples visible to the naked eye in the space around him.
"Disperse!"
Governor Lv overturned his palms as though supporting the sky. Like a giant standing tall between heaven and earth, he held up the emperor-like figure's gigantic palm!
Bang—
The collision of two forces, like thunder from above entangling with fire from below, unleashed endless energy!
The emperor-like figure drew back his palm, and the injury on his palm healed at a unhurried pace, seemingly surprised.
"Oh, from what I know, you who are just of the Unification stage, yet you can withstand my Universe in Palm. It seems the power of State Destiny has greatly enhanced you."
"Who are you!" Resisting this palm strike, Governor Lv felt his organs trembling non-stop. If it were not for the protection of State Destiny power, he would either be dead or severely injured from this strike.
He felt a sense of ill omen, as though the opponent had everything planned out.
Theoretically speaking, under the enhancement of State Destiny power, he could reach the early stage of Transcendance Tribulation. But it would require familiarity with the power, and he had only recently taken up his post so he was not yet familiar with the State Destiny power.
"I am Wu Youdao."
"Wu Youdao?!"
Lu Yang was slightly surprised. He hadn't expected this person. Ever since he learned that the cultivators of Great Yu were restless, he had taken the opportunity to study the history of the Great Yu dynasty in detail, especially the history of the two Imperial Teacher reigns. Wu Youdao wasn't mentioned much in the records, but left a deep impression on Lu Yang.
"Who is Wu Youdao?" Compared to him, Fairy Eternity seemed uneducated.
"The fifth Emperor Yu had seven sons. Wu Youdao was the eldest. Legend has it that auspicious clouds descended from the sky when he was born, taking the form of dragon and tiger, symbolizing the making of an emperor. He achieved great success on the path of Cultivation.
At sixteen, he established his Foundation Establishment, formed his Golden Core in six months, and it was a orthodox Dragon and Tiger Golden Core among First-Grade Golden Cores!"
"His cultivation speed was too fast, leaving his peers far behind. Later, he disappeared and focused on cultivation."
"When the fifth Emperor Yu was deathly ill and nearing his end, his six sons struggled for the throne. They wanted to become the sixth Emperor Yu."
"Wu Youdao then appeared. The six sons understood that their older brother was the most likely candidate for the sixth Emperor Yu. They decided to defeat Wu Youdao first before battling for the throne. Yet, Wu Youdao swept all six brothers away with a single palm strike, leaving their fragmented bodies scattered on the ground."
"Wu Youdao stepped over the bodies of his brothers to ascend the throne and disinterestedly claimed it was tedious. He became the sixth Emperor Yu. He quickly disappeared, passing the throne to one of his brothers. His reign was the shortest among all the Yu Emperors."
"Later, based on this strike, some speculated that Wu Youdao had already reached the Transcendance Tribulation stage at that time. If the speculation holds true, then Wu Youdao's talent would rank second amongst all the Yu Emperors!"
"Who was first?"
"Of course, it was the founding first Emperor Yu."
"So, this Wu Youdao is quite formidable then?" Fairy Eternity nodded, not saying anything more.
She got the feeling that this Wu Youdao was pretty average. His use of Universe in Palm was only at a dabbler's level.
"So it is Wu Youdao, the legendary born emperor!" Governor Lv had naturally heard of Wu Youdao's reputation. As a Transcendance Tribulation stage cultivator with a legendary history, his name will forever be etched in history.
"Hand over the State Destiny and I could spare your life. I always keep my word." said Wu Youdao arrogantly, not taking Governor Lv seriously.
How could the strength of an early stage Transcendance Tribulation equivalent be enough to compare to the actual stage of Transcendance Tribulation?
In Wu Youdao's eyes, Governor Lv was just a sturdy tank at the early stage of Transcendance Tribulation. With slow depletion, he was bound to be worn down eventually.
"Historical records say you suffered from hemorrhoids, and your posterior ached when you sat on the throne, and that's why you had the shortest reign amongst the Yu Emperors. It appears that history did record it accurately." Governor Lv was also not one to hold his tongue.
"You're courting death!" Wu Youdao's expression turned cold, no one had ever talked to him like that before.
Whoo—
He flicked his sleeve, and two clusters of five-colored qi materialized above him. The qi gradually took shape, forming a gigantic azure dragon with five claws and a ferocious white tiger as large as mountains. They stood guard on his left and right.
This sight was terrifying, causing the citizens of Hanshui City to shiver in fear, their hearts in their throats.
"Five-color Dragon and Tiger Qi, that's the legendary Emperor's presence!"
"How can we fight against this?"
"We have to believe in Governor Lv. He must have a way!"
Though people spoke words of encouragement, they were uncertain whether Governor Lv could truly triumph over Wu Youdao.
"Kill him and obtain the power of State Destiny!"
As the dragon and tiger attacked, Governor Lv showed no fear. If he were to flee now, the millions of citizens of Hanshui City would become slaves to Wu Youdao.
"Mountain Seal!"
Governor Lv took out the seal of Wild State and slammed it hard downwards. A giant "荒" character appeared in the sky, transforming into a huge warrior holding a weapon in his hand, blocking the attack of Dragon and Tiger Qi.
This was the Mountain Guard, a form of the State Destiny, named Mountain Seal, but in fact, it was used to guard the nation. In terms of adaptability, it was much stronger than Governor Lv.
"You've been underestimated. You actually have such tactics!" Wu Youdao put away his playful heart. He didn't have information on the Mountain Guard. If he continued to fight this way, he wouldn't know what other tricks State Destiny would employ. If he carelessly broke this death trap, all his efforts in Hanshui City would be wasted!
"The State Destiny power will surely allow my Dragon and Tiger Qi to transform. Die!"
Wu Youdao struck with his palm, which contained the Universe in Palm. It was like a great world within his palm. The entire space buzzed and resonated as if finding a common frequency.
Governor Lv felt like he was stuck in mud, unable to move due to an inexplicable force pulling him in.
Pu—
Governor Lv took a hard blow. A bloody hole appeared in his chest as a result of the palm reaching through, causing him to continuously cough up blood. Some of the faint-hearted down below covered their eyes in horror.
His eyes dimmed as his life force rapidly drained away.
Just when Wu Youdao wanted to unleash another palm strike, Governor Lv's dull eyes suddenly brightened, and the wound in his chest healed rapidly. Wu Youdao was a step too slow in retracting his hand causing it to fuse together with Governor Lv's chest!
Governor Lv's eyes flickered with madness. He could not compete with Wu Youdao, who had been at the Transcendance Tribulation stage for a long time, in terms of Vibrating Dharma. The only thing he could compete with Wu Youdao on was physical body strength.
State Destiny power was continuous and could repair the injured body unceasingly.
Trading injuries for injuries, he would fight until Wu Youdao was worn down!
"Lunatic!" Wu Youdao cursed. He had plenty of combat experience, but he had never seen a fighting style as crazy as Governor Lv's.
"Come on again, you delusional waste!" Governor Lv laughed loudly, his mouth full of blood-stained teeth.

chapters.title: Chapter 440 - 440: 439
chapters.content:
Lord An activated the great formation the moment Governor Lv and Wu Youdao crossed hands. A semi-spherical barrier, like an upside-down bowl over Hanshui City, ensured that the shockwaves from Governor Lv and Wu Youdao's battle would not affect Hanshui City.
Their clash in mid-air over Hanshui City hit like a thunderbolt, causing a deafening noise. Their fists and feet collided, releasing blinding rosy light. The average man couldn't bear to watch the fight directly. Even those of lower cultivation levels felt a heat in their chests as if a resonance had been triggered just by seeing the process of the battle.
Wu Youdao dared not use the Universe in Palm skill to pierce through Governor Lv again, lest his other hand should become amalgamated with Governor Lv's body too.
Now, with one of his arms merged with Governor Lv's chest, Wu Youdao's movements were drastically constrained. Squad Governor Lv's astonishing healing speed had unexpectedly gained the upper hand in the battle!
"Damn it, get off me!" Wu Youdao wasn't dominating the fight and could never figure out how Governor Lv could come up with such an outrageous method.
A punch from Wu Youdao hit Governor Lv in the face. Governor Lv's head tilted, then with a force from his neck, pushed it slowly back into place.
"This move was originally meant for that old thief Buyu, but you got the advantage first!" Madness glittered in Governor Lv's eyes.
"Old thief Buyu, could it be Daoist Buyu?!" Evidently, Wu Youdao had heard of this name before.
"Rumor has it that Daoist Buyu has enemies all over the world. Could it be that Daoist Buyu wants to strengthen the combat power of Great Xia cultivators by making enemies?" Wu Youdao pondered. As an emperor, his thoughts were clear and he thought deeper than others.
"The Seek Dao Sect is indeed the biggest obstacle to the restoration of my Great Yu empire!" Wu Youdao recalled the warnings of the imperial teacher about the Seek Dao Sect; they were formidable enemies.
Luckily, so far, he hadn't encountered anyone from the Seek Dao Sect.
"State Governor Lv is impressive indeed. He could win if the fight goes on like this." Lu Yang's eyes shone brightly. He was astonished at how reliable Governor Lv could be and was relieved he hadn't revealed his sect.
Looking at the brutal way Governor Lv was fighting, it was clear he held a deep grudge against his master.
"He can't win. This kind of fighting method only works because Wu Youdao hasn't seen it before and can't react in time. Once Wu Youdao gets the hang of it, the young Lv will be put on the defensive." Fairy Eternity, with her intelligence and countless experiences in big and small fights, saw through the shortcomings of this fighting method at a glance.
The only way to victory was to restrain Wu Youdao, catch him off-guard, and kill him with absolute power. However, it was a pity that Governor Lv didn't possess absolute power.
As Fairy Eternity predicted, after Wu Youdao received several beatings, he thought of a solution in the shortest possible time.
He transformed his left hand into a heavenly blade and swung it at Governor Lv, who managed to dodge it.
But Wu Youdao's real target wasn't Governor Lv, it was his own right arm!
Shash——
The heavenly blade chopped down, his right arm was severed, and blood gushed out like a river, sprinkling over Hanshui City. Once it landed on the transparent barrier, it produced a corrosive sizzling sound that struck terror into the hearts of the people. If the barrier couldn't resist it and the Tribulation Transcending Stage blood spilled onto the ground, it would undoubtedly cause a catastrophe.
Fortunately, the transparent barrier was strong enough. Even after the corrosiveness of the blood was used up, the barrier still held.
Wu Youdao's severed arm quickly healed itself.
"Heavenly pleasing sound!"
Now free, Wu Youdao opened his mouth and issued a shrill sound that contained bewitching magic. It sounded like thousands of whispering voices. No matter how Governor Lv tried to block his ears and close off his five senses, he could still hear a voice near his ear.
"Daluo Triple Strength!"
Wu Youdao seized the opportunity to throw a punch. His fist exploded with dazzling brilliance, like the fierce sun.
"Even if a monk has cultivated the Golden Body, my punch would shatter his ability!" Wu Youdao laughed heartily.
Governor Lv, distracted by the heavenly sounds, failed to detect the outside world's movements and got squarely punched.
Thump——
Spitting blood incessantly, Governor Lv's State Destiny power worked swiftly to heal the wound. However, this punch contained three layers of force. The first layer injured Governor Lv severely, while the second and third force layers obstructed the healing process.
"Still not dead, here's another punch!" Wu Youdao's face showed a greedy expression as if the State Destiny's force was within his reach.
"The Emperor of Great Yu is really impressive."
A steady laugh echoed forth, and a Five-Colored Bright Wheel abruptly manifested itself, appearing in front of Governor Lv.
Wu Youdao's punch was immensely powerful, the Five-Colored Bright Wheel barely lasted two breaths before it.
Craackkk——
The Bright Wheel shattered, and Governor Lv vanished without a trace.
"Over here!" Wu Youdao turned his head and saw Governor Lv, who was being held by Qiu Jin'an.
"Are you alright?"
"I'm still not dead yet."
"So, it's you, Sect Leader of the Immortal Sect, you should be at the Hundred Flowers Wine House now!" Wu Youdao watched Qiu Jin'an coldly. He kept his two strongest ghosts in the Hundred Flowers Wine House.
...
Hundred Flowers Wine House.
A massive ghost object lay on the ground, its body hollowed out. Three chopsticks had pulverized its three souls. A bowl of rice was forcibly stuffed in its mouth and countless little ghosts with their necks twisted off laid headless, spread all over the hall.
...
"You mean the Bloated Ghost and the Starved Ghost? They're just average at best. It would have been somewhat interesting if they cannibalized each other to form a new ghost, but otherwise, it's nothing special."
"As for those minor ghosts that can lock onto the three souls and seven spirits just by riding on one's neck, those are leftovers from the Seek Dao Sect."
The Bloated Ghost and the Starved Ghost are ghosts with really good compatibility. The Bloated Ghost engorged to death in its past life and continues to indefinitely eat after its death. The Starved Ghost starved to death in its past life and is eternally unsatisfied despite eating nonstop. The two ghosts can cannibalize each other and merge to form a ghost known as a Taotie Ghost.
The average cultivator who encounters a Taotie Ghost is sure to meet their end.
"Thinking to deal with me using a Bloated Ghost and a Starved Ghost is rather belittling."
Wu Youdao's eyes narrowed. An unknown number of Unification Stage cultivators had been devoured by the Bloated Ghost and Starved Ghost. There's even quite a few instances of late stage Unification cultivators being devoured by them. These are not ghosts that a Unification Stage cultivator should be able to handle.
This war capability of Qiu Jin'an is still beyond his expectations.
"You block the damage and I'll attack, Okay?" Qiu Jin'an conveyed his voice.
"Okay." In military might, Governor Lv is no match for Qiu Jin'an.
"Lord, we're here!" a number of other Unification Stage cultivators appeared, coming to bolster the forces.
They had been previously tied up fighting off the ghosts that surfaced in the city. When Qiu Jin'an arrived, he helped them out. This allowed them to lend their support here.
"You lot go down and help your colleagues deal with the ghosts and maintain order in the city!" Governor Lv waved off their offer. This battle couldn't possibly be decided by the arrival of a few average Unification Stage cultivators. Even he, as a cultivator at the peak of the Unification Stage, would die at the mere sight of such, without the support of State Destiny's power.
Now only a peak Unification Stage elite like Qiu Jin'an could lend a hand.
But problem is, a Sect Leader of the Five Great Immortal Sects at the Unification Stage, where could one find such a person at whim?
Wu Youdao attempted to employ his old tactics to control Qiu Jin'an: "Celestial melody pleasu…."
Qiu Jin'an's combat experience far surpassed that of Governor Lv. A fire lotus emanating intent to destroy appeared in his palm.
"Lotus Fire!"
Boom——
The destructive energy erupted, and a colossal red lotus bloomed across the skies above Hanshui City. Each petal possessed the power to shatter Cave Heaven. With twenty-eight petals blooming, one can only imagine the immensity of the destructive energy released. Even with a barrier in place, Lu Yang could sense the surge of hot waves coming through.
The dust and smoke cleared, revealing a battered Wu Youdao. His clothes were torn and disheveled, his body severely burned, his skin wrinkled, and his head bald and shiny. He had lost his usual calm disposition and superior attitude.
"I originally meant to use this move against the Seek Dao Sect. It's a pity it's been used on you first."
Qiu Jin'an shook his head slowly as a lotus flower began to form again in his palm.

chapters.title: Chapter 441 - 440 - Am I Qualified Now? _1
chapters.content:
Red lotuses bloomed one after another over Hanshui City, their immense power causing Lu Yang's heart to leap with relief, grateful that Sect Leader Qiu bore grudges clearly and did not transfer his resentment towards his father onto the next generation.
Five Lotus Fire blasts plummeted down, and Qiu Jin'an's spiritual essence was drained to the ground. Governor Lv wielded the power of the State Destiny, rapidly replenishing Qiu Jin'an's spiritual essence.
In just the blink of an eye, the spiritual essence was restored to its maximum capacity.
With the power of State Destiny, neither injuries nor depletion of spiritual essence were concerns anymore.
In Emperor Xia's words, whoever possesses the power of the State Destiny would be the least afraid of protracted battles.
Qiu Jin'an was not surprised, as this was not his first experience battling alongside a person who wielded the power of the State Destiny.
"Good, very good!" Wu Youdao, his whole body covered in bruises, was bursting with murderous aura, which made all the people of Hanshui City feel as if they had fallen into an ice cave, with an involuntary shudder.
This was not an attack technique, but rather the result of Wu Youdao's emotional turmoil impacting those around him due to his extraordinary strength.
"You think you can deal with me with a mere Lotus Fire?" Wu Youdao's body started emitting white mist, and as it enveloped him, his injuries quickly began to heal.
Qiu Jin'an hadn't expected to complete the challenge of surpassing realms with a mere Lotus Fire, especially when bridging the gap between the Unification and Transcendance Tribulation Stages, but the effect it had was less than he had anticipated.
Lu Yang was puzzled, not understanding why the Lotus Fire had so little effect on Wu Youdao: "The Lotus Fire is a Buddhist fire used to purge the evil deeds of people. A mere trace of it should ignite and burn fiercely, unless he has never committed any evil acts."
Man Gu and Zhao Po were equally perplexed.
Meng Jingzhou could explain this, "Have you noticed the Five-color Dragon and Tiger Qi around Wu Youdao? Those are the symbols of an emperor, and how can the actions of an emperor be classified as good or evil?"
Qiu Jin'an and Governor Lv also recognized this and changed their battle tactics.
However, Wu Youdao did not give them time to react and took the initiative to attack, summoning countless chains to materialize behind him.
"Pagoda Hell Palm!"
The chains, like a prison, were dark as ink and seemed to be made from mysterious metal substances or condensed by great spiritual power—its existence was extremely peculiar.
"At the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, one can refine substances not existent in this world. These chains must have been refined by Wu Youdao!" Qiu Jin'an shone with a Five-Colored Divine Light. Under the light's illumination, the "metal" in the chains quickly dissolved, revealing only shapes condensed by great spiritual power.
Qiu Jin'an's words reminded Lu Yang of the Mother-child and Twin Rivers created by Fairy Eternity.
Immortals at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage could refine substances not existent in this world, and fairies would be even more adept at this.
The chains were no longer a threat, but Wu Youdao's palm strike still carried an unstoppable force, making it impossible to dodge.
Qiu Jin'an did not show fear. Five miniature glaze colored flames appeared on the tips of his fingers. He changed his fist to a palm, and the five flames merged, emitting just hints of the fire between his fingers, enough to cause space distortions.
"Glaze Pure Fire!"
The collision between the fire and the Pagoda Hell Palm created a deadlock, like a dragon and tiger in combat. Gradually, Qiu Jin'an was unable to sustain the fiery confrontation with his realm of cultivation. The Glaze Pure Fire began to falter.
"I'm here too!" Governor Lv exerted his spiritual essence into Qiu Jin'an's palm. The constant infusion bolstered the Glaze Pure Fire with new strength.
"Daluo Triple Strength!" Wu Youdao withdrew his strength abruptly, delivering another palm strike. The three layers of immense Daluo strength overpowered one layer after another, shattered the Glaze Pure Fire, and hit Qiu Jin'an's chest.
Qiu Jin'an quickly pressed his acupoints to temporarily contain the three layers of strength that were wreaking havoc within his body.
"Three Thousand Weak Water!"
Qiu Jin'an spat out the Three Thousand Weak Water, a cosmic volume of weak water which endlessly gushed forth, submerging Wu Youdao. Wu Youdao tried to break free from the constraints of the weak water, but weak water is the lightest substance in the world offering no buoyancy to even the smallest feather. Even someone as powerful as Wu Youdao found it hard to escape.
"Breath Soil!"
Qiu Jin'an took out a piece of Breath Soil, a legendary Immortal Soil that had been used by an immortal. Each use depleted a bit, but now was not the time to be frugal.
The Breath Soil expanded rapidly upon contact with water and swallowed Wu Youdao whole as it multiplied upon exposure to the weak water.
Pfft—
Only then did Qiu Jin'an cough out several mouthfuls of blood, the result of the immense force from the Daluo Triple Strength. Had he coughed up blood earlier, Wu Youdao would have seized the opportunity to launch a counterattack, leaving him with no chance of winning.
Governor Lv rushed over to heal Qiu Jin'an's injuries and shared some of the impact of the Daluo Triple Strength.
Crack——
Weak Water and Breath Soil could not trap Wu Youdao for long. He charged towards Qiu Jin'an, fueled by anger.
He realized the most difficult one to deal with at the moment was Qiu Jin'an, even placing Governor Lv behind.
"Five-Colored Divine Light!"
Qiu Jin'an gave it his all, using the Five-Colored Divine Light consecutively, throwing out one item related to the five elements after another. The base of the True Fire he used alone had more than thirty different types!
Wu Youdao also stopped hiding his skills, putting his killer techniques into motion.
"Sky-shocking Finger!"
Though called a finger, it held the strength of the world. This was the power of the Universe in Palm concentrated at the fingertip. The fingermark was broad enough to accommodate four horses running side by side!
"Three Flowers Gather at the Top and Five Energies Return to the Origin"
Qiu Jin'an refined essence into qi, refined qi into spirit, refined spirit into emptiness, finally gathering it at the top, invulnerable to a myriad of disasters. The five elements of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth all returned to their origins and returned to the Yellow Court, reaching the ultimate state of perfection, bringing about a state of wonder that was beyond description.
"Tang Valley Water! Fusang Wood! Golden Crow True Fire!"
Qiu Jin'an took out three treasures, recreating the birth scene of the ten suns, in terms of power, trumping even Mong Tian Monarch's "Ten Sun Tours"!
"Fusang Wood, so it ended up in your hands!"
The two initiated a fierce battle, both forgoing defenses. They attacked each other at full force, trading damage for damage.
Even Governor Lv couldn't keep up with the changes in their battle techniques, only constantly healing Qiu Jin'an.
Thump——
Qiu Jin'an was kicked away, countless ribs broken. Even his soul was damaged, wavering.
"Very good, being able to exchange blows with me at the Unification Stage, this is a first for me!" Wu Youdao was somewhat more superior than Qiu Jin'an. Despite his physical injuries, they did not affect his origin, so his soul was unharmed.
"Can you still fight?" While healing Qiu Jin'an, Governor Lv asked through a secret voice transmission.
"Damn it, I'm running out of attacking techniques!" At this stage, Qiu Jin'an was also getting desperate and cursed, "If there was one more person at the Unification Stage like me, or like Old Buyu, we could win!"
"And where do we find that?" Governor Lv widened his eyes in disbelief. If it were just a matter of numbers, that could be discussed. But clearly, this was not a situation that could be solved by having a few more at the Unification Stage.
Wu Youdao laughed loudly, unbothered by their conversation: "I've checked all the people in Hanshui City. There isn't anyone like you've described."
"Oh, have you checked me?"
A strange voice came from below, alerting all three engaged in battle.
"Who's talking?"
A man wearing a white paper hat slowly emerged from the house where the Sacrificing Ghost ceremony took place, step by step ascending into the sky.
With a single glance, Wu Youdao saw through the man with the white paper hat's Realm and scoffed at his delusions of grandeur: "Just with your early Unification Stage, you think you're qualified to join our battle?"
The man with the white paper hat did not respond. At the same time, hundreds of people left their houses in the city and headed towards the street. The street was already deserted so these hundreds of people were hard to miss.
Fierce Ghosts saw them and pounced on them maliciously, intending to kill, but were effortlessly killed by one of their people.
This group of hundreds had different appearances and identities. Some were thieves, charlatans, bookkeepers, tavern waiters, even barbecue stand employees.
As the man in the white paper hat ascended step by step into the sky, these hundreds of people started to soar, one after another, merging into the man in the white paper hat.
The man's Cultivation Level rapidly increased, like a torrential river flowing upstream, the speed of ascension was startling.
Early Unification Stage, Mid Unification Stage, Late Unification Stage... Half step to Transcendence Tribulation Stage!
Standing opposite to Wu Youdao, he casually questioned:
"Am I qualified now?"

chapters.title: Chapter 442 - 441: The Reversal of the Situation_1
chapters.content:
"Fairy, are you saying that this person has risen from the early stages of Unification to the Half Step to Transcendance Tribulation Stage?" Lu Yang asked in surprise, not quite understanding the situation.
The Half Step to Transcendance Tribulation Stage is not a realm, but a symbol of combat power. Cultivators whose power exceeds that of the ordinary Unification Stage but have not yet reached the Transcendance Tribulation Stage are referred to as the Half Step to Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
"Haven't I told you? This is a method of cultivation that tempers the Divine Soul. It entails transforming into millions of different forms, experiencing life, comprehending the mundane world, ultimately unifying all experiences, returning to their peak state, or even achieving something even higher."
"This person's method of cultivation is quite similar to that of Mr. Shi."
After considering for a moment, Lu Yang realized that Fairy Eternity was referring to Vice Headmaster Shi from the Jiuyou Teaching.
"Is he from the Jiuyou Teaching?"
"More than that, judging by the rule that the higher one's Cultivation Level the higher one's position, he's likely someone like a Master."
Lu Yang was incredulous and mostly confused.
"Is the Jiuyou Teaching so poor that its Master has to take up menial jobs himself?"
...
The man in the white paper hat sighed: "Now that all of my Clones have returned, all of these identities can no longer be used. How many Spirit Stones will this loss cost me?"
"It can't be helped. Who asked you ancient cultivators to hold a grudge against us?"
He worked hard to make money because he feared that the followers of the Teaching would find out about their immense debt, a debt which had been used for the construction of the Jiuyou Teaching and the distribution of allowance.
Even if he reached the Transcendence Tribulation Stage in the future, there would still be a chance he wouldn't survive should these things be exposed.
While he is still alive, he needs to work hard to fill the gap.
The more he earns, the greater the chance he will survive.
Vice Headmaster Shi considered the kebab shop a lifesaver and so did the man in the white paper hat.
"Who are you!" Wu Youdao shouted.
In front of the Righteous Path, of course, the man in the white paper hat couldn't openly admit he was from the Jiuyou Teaching.
All he could do was give a cold laugh.
To everyone else, this was a symbol of mystery, even if his identity as the Master of Jiuyou Teaching was indeed mysterious enough.
"There's no point in talking more. Monk of Great Yu, let's settle old and new grudges together!"
The man in the white paper hat knew well the principle that the more one talks, the more mistakes one might make. Without saying another word, he rushed toward Wu Youdao.
"You dare to take action against me!"
"Mortar Hell - Great Millstone!"
A vast iceberg formed above Wu Youdao's head, half the size of Hanshui City. It was like an eternal sheet of black ice, getting colder till it seemed to reach the extreme limit.
A massive inferno blazed beneath Wu Youdao, boundless like a prairie fire but more intense!
The ice mountain and the blazing fire seemed like a millstone, trapping Wu Youdao in the middle, unable to move.
"You dare to use such a trifling method against me?"
"Here I come too!" Qiu Jin'an made a move, rapidly casting a Five Elements spell with both hands.
The coldness of the eternal black ice intensified, even space and time seemed to condense. The massive inferno took on a black hue - these were the Dark Ghost Fire, specifically used for burning souls.
Wu Youdao's complexion changed - the combined attack from the two was strong enough to threaten his life!
Crackle - Crackle -
The sounds of bones being crushed echoed and blood of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage flowed out, unable to be frozen or burnt, seeping from the edge of the millstone.
"Universe in Palm!"
Wu Youdao roared in rage, unleashing a furious blow. The explosive blow shattered the Mortar Hell's Great Millstone!
"Form the Three Powers Formation!"
Qiu Jin'an commanded, the appearance of the man in the white paper hat gave him confidence.
"I control the power of the Five Elements, I take the position of Heaven!"
"You've casted the Mortar Hell, you take the position of Earth!"
"Governor Lv, as the official parents of the people, you take the position of Man!"
The Three Powers Formation is widely recognized. It was born in the ancient times but rarely had the chance to be successfully set up due to its incredibly high requirements on fate and Cultivation Level, the conditions are too harsh.
The three didn't say much, and according to their own fate, they stood at their respective positions in the Three Powers Formation.
Once the Three Powers Formation was set up, the three of them instantly felt as if they had become part of a whole, their strength increased further, and their Divine Souls became even more consolidated!
"Daluo Triple Strength!"
Wu Youdao swung his fist, the imprint of which gleamed brightly. The space cracked wherever the radiating light from his fist passed, sealing off all possible escape routes.
His fist neared from a distance, and hit the stomach of the man in the white hat. The triple force passed between the three men. The weakest force was taken by him, the second by Qiu Jin'an, and the strongest third force was borne by Governor Lv, reducing the power of the punch to its maximum degree!
Under the reinforcement of the Three Powers Formation, the transmission of State Destiny was even quicker. The three men recovered instantly, as if they had never been hit by the punch!
"Kill!"
The three men invoked the Three Powers Formation, launching their strongest attack, and renewed their fight with Wu Youdao.
Their bodies were repeatedly blown up, and again and again healed. What were fatal wounds for low-rank Cultivators were merely scratches to them, consuming some of their spiritual essence.
"Huff—huff—"
Wu Youdao was gasping fiercely. In the last exchange of blows, he had been blown up more times than the opposing side, and his consumption of spiritual essence was massive- even the elixirs couldn't help replenish it.
He tried to flee from the battleground, but he was surrounded by the three men, unable to break through their blockade.
"Damn it!"
"Five-Colored Divine Light!"
"Mortar Hell!"
"Mountain Guard!"
The three men launched their major attacks. The Five-color dragon and Tiger Qi dissipated, unable to take shape. Wu Youdao took the three successive strikes head-on, his body was horribly damaged, and recovery proved slow.
Seeing this, the people of Hanshui city cheered in unison. The dark cloud that had formed in their hearts when Wu Youdao first appeared gradually dissipated.
"Enough watching, come out and help!" Wu Youdao roared angrily.
A decrepit yet gloomy voice sounded, and the stumbling old man leaning on his staff suddenly appeared on the battlefield.
"Your Majesty, this doesn't seem like your style, needing to ask for help?"
"Cang Lei, this isn't a call for help, it is I's command!" Wu Youdao glared angrily at the old man.
"It's almost the same." The one called Cang Lei laughed heartily, revealing a mouth with barely any teeth left.
"Cang Lei... could it be the Honourable Cang Lei!" Governor Lv muttered, looked startled at Qiu Jin'an and the man in the white hat for confirmation. He saw the same astonishment in their eyes.
The three men, all of whom had heard of the venerable Cang Lei, felt their hearts thump. This was a Great Power at the beginning of the Transcendance Tribulation stage who was skilled in thunder techniques.
Another Transcendance Tribulation stage.
It was so taxing to fight one, how worse would it be to fight two?!
"Hehe, best surrender now. Our only aim is to obtain the State Destiny." The Honourable Cang Lei laughed hoarsely, the thunder patterns on his staff flickering. It seemed as if a bolt of lightning would fall should Governor Lv dare to disagree.
None of the three men responded, plunging the scene into an eerie silence.
Crack—
Suddenly, a bolt of lightning sounded, breaking the silence.
The Honourable Cang Lei was taken aback; he hadn't launched an attack yet.
Governor Lv's eyes lit up, looking in the direction of the thunder. "It's Master Ru, he is on the verge of breaking through to the Transcendance Tribulation stage!"
...
Corpse Chasing Sect.
Elder Gai spat on the hydra-headed bodies of the Witch Corpse Sect.
"Piss off, what a joke, challenging us with this level of ability, aren't you keeping up with the times?"
"You, that's not corpse-chasing techniques..." the last living man of the Witch Corpse Sect was stuttering, pointing at Elder Gai with a dim flame of life.
He couldn't believe what he had just seen. Even though he was clearly alive, his body had been refined by Elder Gai, turning him into an actual living corpse, with no control over himself.
Besides that, there were all sorts of strange magic skills.
In the face of Elder Gai and the other three, the ancient corpse-chasing technique that the Witch Corpse sect took pride in had no advantage.
"What do you mean not corpse-chasing technique? This is the improved technique given by Seek Dao Sect!" Elder Gai puffed out his chest, clearly proud.
"Everyone rest and recover, and then we'll head to the city to help." Elder Gai called out to the others. Their previous battle had consumed quite a bit of energy.
Crack—
The sound of thunder roared, right above them, startling the four Elders as they looked up.
Elder Gai was the first to react finding the news delightful.
"The Sect Leader is about to break through!"

chapters.title: Chapter 443 - 443: 442
chapters.content:
BOOM——
A startling thunderclap drew everyone's attention. The Yin Corpse Mountain range, where the Corpse Chasing Sect is located, has been without thunder since ancient times because of its heavy Yin Energy.
But today, clouds roared across the Yin Corpse Mountain range, interwoven with flashes of lightning, completely covered by blinding white thunderbolts. It looked as if the world was at its beginning, teeming with burgeoning life.
"All disciples of the Corpse Chasing Sect, retreat!" Elder Gai commanded the disciples to evacuate the Corpse Chasing Sect. Sect Master Ru's breakthrough speed was even faster than predicted, making the Corpse Chasing Sect very dangerous as the probability of getting hit by the Thunder Tribulation was extremely high.
The Thunder Tribulation during the transcendence stage is not something these disciples could resist. Even a slight touch could be deadly!
The three people on Governor Lv's side, and the two people on Wu Youdao's side, instinctively halted their actions.
In the vicinity of such high-level Thunder Tribulations, one should avoid any energy fluctuations. Otherwise, the Thunder Tribulation could mistake you for someone trying to interfere and target you.
The three people on Governor Lv's side quickly took this chance to restore their bodies, preparing for the next fight.
They felt relieved. With Sect Master Ru's participation, the balance of victory was restored. Their fight with the monks of Great Yu remained uncertain!
Zhao Po was extremely excited. It had been nine thousand... no, ten thousand years since the Corpse Chasing Sect had a cultivator passing the Tribulation Stage. They had fallen from a superior sect to a First Class Sect. But today, a cultivator attempting to pass the Tribulation Stage had finally appeared. Would they regain the title of high-class sect?
This is the difference between the Five Great Immortal Sects and the superior sects. The condition for the superior sects is to have a cultivator who has passed the Tribulation Period. Every cultivator will inevitably fall. When this happens, the superior sect is downgraded to a First Class Sect.
In contrast, even on their decline, when the Five Great Immortal Sects have experienced several generations without producing a cultivator who has passed the Tribulation Stage, the Immortal Sects still retain techniques comparable to that stage, hence not losing their title.
The Seek Dao Sect went through this situation five thousand years ago. It experienced a break, with no one passing the Tribulation stage for two thousand years. This embarrassing situation ended with the emergence of the predecessor of the Sect, the Vast Sea Daoist Lord.
During these two thousand years, the Seek Dao Sect remained among the Five Great Immortal Sects.
As the thunder continued to rumble in the sky, only a few occasional bolts of lightning struck. They would shake the earth, but they were just the prelude.
Crack——
The dark clouds billowed, cast downwards as the white bolts of lightning shimmered. The full force of the Thunder Tribulation erupted, covering the Corpse Chasing Sect, gradually dissipating the ten thousand years of Yin Energy from the Yin Corpse Mountain range.
A long howl emerged, faintly countering the Thunder Tribulation. A Daoist, dressed in a robe, broke out of the enclosure, flying towards the sky, and deploying various magic artifacts to prepare for battle. It was obvious he was well-prepared.
"So this is what the Thunder Tribulation is like." Lu Yang marveled. He had heard a long ago about cultivators having to endure the Thunder Tribulation. Today was his first time witnessing it, particularly one representing a breakthrough to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. Its might was incomparable.
Despite the Hanshui City being half as far away, he could still feel the tremble of the heavens and earth. This was indicative of how powerful the Thunder Tribulation looming over the Corpse Chasing Sect was.
"This Thunder Tribulation is just average," Fairy Eternity quipped, unconvinced by the perceived might of the Thunder Tribulation.
As far as she is concerned, she could have crossed it by yawning; she wouldn't have needed so much preparation.
"Is there a theory about the Thunder Tribulation?" Being remembered by Lu Yang, when it came to Thunder Tribulation, Fairy Eternity was the expert.
After all, the current Thunder Tribulation originated from the Tribulation Dao Fruit of Yingtian Immortal.
"The Thunder Tribulation created by Yingtian Immortal was made to train cultivators; it was not meant to kill them intentionally. The stronger the Thunder Tribulation, the stronger the potential it implies. Look at this Thunder Tribulation, it might seem pretty formidable, but its real power is average if you face it directly."
"This kind of Thunder Tribulation is called the White Emperor Dragon Tribulation, and in the Thunder Tribulation, it is one of the weakest."
The white Thunder Tribulation turned into an Imperial Dragon. The dragon's whiskers fluttered, its scale wafted, and it bared its claws as if imbued by a real dragon, exhibiting intelligence!
The white dragon roared, clashing with Sect Master Ru, directly piercing through his physical body. The wound revealed grim white bones, filled with an aura of death!
"Is Sect Master Ru going to die?!" Lu Yang was taken by surprise. Did Sect Master Ru fail so quickly?
"No, this is a living corpse. His real body is hiding underneath. It's quite clever to know that the first wave of Thunder Tribulation would be too strong to withstand, so he uses the living corpse to take the blow," Fairy Eternity immediately saw through Sect Master Ru's trick.
As Fairy Eternity had predicted, the living corpse was struck into pieces, and the actual Sect Master Ru emerged from the ground ready to face the Thunder Tribulation.
After the first round of attacks, the power of the white dragon had decreased significantly.
Boom!
The white dragon attacked once more, causing immense pain to Sect Master Ru who screeched in agony. White electric traces were left on his body, scorching his flesh and spirit.
In a hurry, he took out a jade bottle from his bosom and swallowed a piece of Elixir. Just as he took one piece to recover, the remaining Elixir and the bottle disappeared in the vast Thunder Tribulation.
The unstoppable white dragon crushed the void, causing Sect Master Ru to go through a gruelling tribulation.
The Heavenly Tribulation dissipated and the pressure was suddenly reduced. The restless spiritual essence gradually calmed down.
Sect Master Ru's body was charred like a piece of charcoal, dropping to the ground with a clang.
"Has he failed?" The hearts of all the people in the city sank. Everyone was talking, creating a commotion.
If Sect Master Ru failed the Tribulation, then there would be no one to oppose the monks of Great Yu.
"Quickly look, the sect master's body twitched a bit!"
Thump thump thump——
Powerful heartbeats echoed, signalling the healing of the internal injuries and the disappearance of the hidden wounds.
Subsequently, a cracking sound can be heard as Sect Master Ru's body began to peel off. A layer of charred skin fell off, revealing new, translucent skin beneath, making him look much younger.
"The Thunder Tribulation contains life force. The lightning has baptized Sect Master Ru's body. His physical strength must be several times, even ten times stronger than before!" Elder Gai said excitedly, recalling the historical records of the Corpse Chasing Sect's predecessors breaking through the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
Sect Master Ru suddenly opened his eyes, his eyes sparking like lightning, piercing through the clouds.
He stood up straight, full of vitality, completely different from his previous disheveled resistance amidst the Thunder Tribulation. His entire person was renewed, bursting with confidence.
He apparently had crossed the Thunder Tribulation, becoming a cultivator at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage!
Everyone in the city cheered. Whether it was the three people on Lv's side or the civilians in the city, seeing Sect Master Ru successfully cross the Tribulation reassured them.
Only Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, who had remained silent during the cheers, stared intently at Sect Master Ru's right wrist. They recalled the pattern they had seen on the wrist of an uncontrolled living corpse, which they encountered during their overnight stay in Wild State.
It was three interconnected rings with the character "ghost" in the middle!
At that time, the village head had explained that there were two reasons for a living corpse to lose its master. Either the master has died, and the living corpse, losing control, would wander aimlessly. Or the master would voluntarily relinquish control over the living corpse. Otherwise, it was due to the living corpse rebelling and eating its master.
A living corpse could resist the Thunder Tribulation, so Sect Master Ru would certainly not have voluntarily relinquished control.
Sect Master Ru was still here, so he wasn't eaten by the living corpse either.
So, the only remaining explanation was that Sect Master Ru had already died — his living corpse had walked to Firmstone Village and was found by the village chief.
If Sect Master Ru has already died, then who is controlling his body now?!
Both Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou looked at each other, instantly thinking of a possibility.
"A Great Yu Monk in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage has possessed Sect Master Ru!"

chapters.title: Chapter 444 - 443 - Fairy Eternity Takes Action_1
chapters.content:
The one who possessed Master Ru was Great Yu Transcendance Tribulation Stage, with this everything makes sense now.
No records of Unification Stage Cultivators fighting with each other, Transcendance Tribulation Stage can easily possess Unification Stage!
Why was Master Ru so ordinary, yet he was the first among his peers to break through to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, he was possessed by Great Yu Transcendance Tribulation Stage, which is like re-entering the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. The process is naturally easy!
All these are evidences, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou do not have concrete proof, but they also cannot think of other possibilities!
As Governor Lv and others were about to congratulate Corpse Chasing Sect, they heard Master Ru laughing loudly, a laughter full of wanton recklessness, completely different from his past demeanour.
"Finally, finally back at Transcendance Tribulation Stage!"
"No, you're not Lu Baqian, who are you!" Governor Lv reacted instantly, demanding sharply with a sense of foreboding.
Wu Youdao and Honourable Cang Lei congratulated "Master Ru".
"Congratulations Master Wu Ji for successfully transcending tribulation."
Upon hearing this, Elder Gai's pupils contracted, disbelief spread across his face: "Wu Ji? Honourable Wu Ji? The Honourable Wu Ji of the Witch Corpse Sect!"
The Witch Corpse Sect's assessment as outstanding Sect is due to the Honourable Wu Ji, which is transcendent tribulation!
Elder Gai was puzzled during the just-concluded battle. Historical records indicated that Honourable Wu Ji's whereabouts were unknown and he should've fallen into dormancy, awaiting awakening in the Great Era.
If that was the case, why was only Witch Corpse Sect's Unification Stage fighting? Where was Honourable Wu Ji?
Now everything was clear, Wu Ji had been under his watch all along!
The Great Yu side now has three Transcendance Tribulation Stage combatants, which further escalates the pressure on Qiu Jin'an who is already in a difficult situation.
The man with the white paper hat was gritting his teeth as he stared at Wu Ji, who was occupying Master Ru's body.
Huang Ming and Mong Tian had already briefed him about this, which was one of the reasons he had resolved to contend with Great Yu's Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
Due to the different perspective of life and death held by Corpse-drivers, there are rumors circulating that the founder of Nine Nether Sect originated from the Corpse Chasing Sect.
These were false rumors, but one fact was not wrong – the Corpse-driver's perspective of life and death was very similar to Nine Nether Sect's, which lead to Nine Nether Sect harboring favorable impressions of Corpse-drivers.
For Wu Ji, who possessed Master Ru, the Nine Nether Sect Master was naturally driven to fury.
His initial plan was to cooperate with Qiu Jin'an and quickly eliminate Wu Youdao before Wu Ji returned to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
Unfortunately, things did not go as planned; he didn't expect Cang Lei to be on the Great Yu side, nor did he expect Wu Ji to ascend prematurely.
Seeing that his side was fully assembled, Wu Youdao revealed his true, ruthless, and greedy nature.
"Governor Lv, I have given you a chance to hand over the State Destiny, since you didn't, I have to do it myself!"
As soon as the word "it" fell, three Transcendance Tribulation Stages attacked and hit Governor Lv simultaneously. The spiritual essence across Hanshui City turned wild. This one attack felt like the world's end, it directly inflicted Governor Lv into a half-dead state. Fortunately, State Destiny saved his life, otherwise, this one blow would have ended him on the spot.
With a thud, Governor Lv collapsed to the ground, falling next to Lu Yang in the mansion.
Lu Yang's eyelid twitched, things had turned extremely grave – the Great Yu side actually had three Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivators, the disparity in strength was far too great.
"Worthy of the State Destiny, it won't die so easily. I'm even more eager for the State Destiny now, I wonder to what extent my Dragon-Tiger Qi will be transformed."
Propping his body up with great difficulty, Governor Lv snorted coldly, ready to face death: "Do you think that if you kill me, the State Destiny power will be yours? How ridiculous! Even if I die, the State Destiny power will return to its original place, you won't get a single bit of it!"
"Is that so?" Wu Ji revealed a wicked smile, he pulled out a very familiar talisman, "Guess why I wanted to possess this body?"
"Soul Dispersing Charm!" Governor Lv recognized the talisman, he had a bad feeling. This was a charm created overnight by the government office and Corpse Chasing Sect to deal with ghost calamities. Wu Ji held the primary charm which was specially marked with the imprint of the Wild State to increase its power.
Why was he pulling out this charm now!
Wu Ji raised the charm, countless points of lights lit up in Hanshui City, all the places where the Soul Dispersing Charm was used.
"Array, arise!"
The talismans in the hands of Honourable Wu Ji burned, the lights in the city became more and more dazzling, connecting together into a massive array. Governor Lv felt the power of State Destiny being stripped away bit by bit from his body, becoming ownerless.
"I spent so much effort possessing this body, all for this moment!" Honourable Wu Ji laughed unrestrainedly, his ugly laughter could be heard throughout Hanshui City.
"When the previous governor stepped down, other forces were not trusted by the court; as the newly appointed governor, the only one you could trust was our Corpse Chasing Sect. When the city was plagued by ghosts, only our Corpse Chasing Sect could solve the problem!"
"The Soul Dispersing Charm was jointly crafted by our Corpse Chasing Sect and your government office. The charm naturally carries your intentions, and with the imprint of the Great Seal of Wild State, it reinforced these intentions even more."
"I used Fierce Ghosts as the anchor point, allowing my disciples to use the charms to expel the ghosts. Once the talisman combined with the Corpse Qi, they become the nodes of the Array Method."
