All the Array Method masters guessed incorrectly. The array in Hanshui City is not laid out with fierce ghosts as nodes, nor is it intended to disrupt the balance of yin and yang. Instead, it relies on the Soul Dispersing Charm as its basis.
But the Array Method masters had no idea about the existence of the Soul Dispersing Charm, nobody paid any attention to the problem with those talismans.
"The talisman, the ghost expulsion, are all done by your government office. Hence, the Array Method is also yours. It's as if your government office deliberately gave up the power of State Destiny!" Honourable Wu Ji revealed a mocking smile. The conditions to make the State Destiny turn into an ownerless entity were extremely strict – the government office had to voluntarily give it up.
That was why he orchestrated all these events, all for the purpose of obtaining the power of State Destiny!
Feeling the control over the State Destiny slipping away bit by bit, becoming an ownerless object, Governor Lv suddenly felt powerless. If a more experienced governor had been in his position, such a fatal mistake wouldn't have been made.
"We cannot allow them to obtain the power of State Destiny!" Qiu Jin'an and the Master of Nine Nether Sect quickly made their move.
But how can they match up to three Transcendance Tribulation Stage performers?
"Daluo Triple Strength!"
"Heaven Punishment Thunderbolt!"
"Corpse Qi Mileage!"
The three Transcendance Tribulation Stage performers attacked simultaneously, and Qiu Jin'an and the Master of the Nine Nether Sect were sent flying out, coughing up blood incessantly.
A substance that seemed like light and water streamed out from Governor Lv's body, becoming strands and pieces floating in the air.
Seeing the coveted power of State Destiny, Wu Youdao reached out his hand, used Universe in Palm, and pressed towards Governor Lv.
Lu Yang and the others were right next to Governor Lv.
"The power of State Destiny belongs to me!"
"This fairy also thinks that the power of State Destiny is quite good, how about first letting this fairy use it?"
A frivolous and cheerful voice rang out suddenly and echoed between heaven and earth. Its source was unknown.
A figure suddenly appeared between Governor Lv and the giant hand. A delicate hand reached out and absorbed the power of State Destiny.
"You dare to say you're using Universe in Palm with just that?"
The woman sneered, raising her hand and repelling Wu Youdao's giant hand. Wu Youdao gripped his wrist tightly, his hand trembled incessantly, and there was a touch of panic in his eyes.
The woman was covered with the power of State Destiny, her face not visible. She had an attractive figure, barefoot. Like a fairy descending to the world, sacred and inviolable, worthy of awe and respect.
"Who are you!"
Wu Youdao stared hard at the mysterious woman. She felt as unfathomable as an abyss.
The blow that had sent his hand flying just now did not exceed the realm of the early stage of Transcendance Tribulation. Yet, her control and utilization of power were way above his!
How is that possible?
The mysterious woman looked at Wu Youdao disdainfully, lazily opened her mouth, revealing her title:
"This fairy is the Supreme Heavenly Master of Heaven's Court, the Soybean Master."

chapters.title: Chapter 445 - 444: The Supreme Heavenly Lord of Heaven's Court! _1
chapters.content:
"Heaven's Court? Heavenly Honorable Dou?"
Wu Youdao looked at the sacred goddess in front of him with disbelief and unease welled up in his heart.
He had permitted Governor Lv to act, confident in his victory even if Qiu Jin'an and the man in the white paper hat intervened. In the face of absolute power, these people could not overturn his dominance.
But now, he felt things spiraling out of control.
He had never felt this way before in his life.
"What is Heaven's Court? Who is Heavenly Honorable Dou?" Both the Honorable Cang Lei and Wu Ji glanced at each other, panic evident in their eyes.
The reason for their visit was the power of the State Destiny. When Wu Youdao attempted to seize the power of the State Destiny, they had been aware of every movement around them.
One could say that no detail, however small, could escape their watchful gaze.
Yet, even under their scrutiny, this female had appeared, and they had no idea how.
How was this possible?
The two searched through their knowledge, but found no information, from ancient times to the present, matching "Heaven's Court, Heavenly Honorable Dou".
The closest comparison they could find was the Four Great Devil Sects of today: the Eternity Sect, Jiuyou Teaching, Yaoyang Sect, and Ruthless Sect.
"There seems to be a record of Heaven's Court in ancient scriptures!" Wu Ji's voice trembled as fear spread in his heart.
"An ancient organization?!" Honorable Cang Lei murmured, shocked. He firmly believed that older meant mightier. As someone who had lived for more than a hundred thousand years, he looked down upon the present Great Xia, thinking the monks of Great Yu were the strongest.
But now the Heavenly Honorable Dou who had appeared seemed to come from the ancient times.
Moreover, honouring the character "Dou" suggested that she was extremely proficient in combat!
"Hold on, didn't she refer to herself as 'this immortal'?" Honorable Cang Lei suddenly remembered a vital piece of information that had been overlooked from the beginning.
"Is she an Immortal?!"
Never had they predicted that there would be an Immortal hidden in Hanshui City!
An Immortal honouring the character "Dou" in her title would likely be quite formidable among the Immortals!
...
"Heaven's Court's Supreme Heavenly Honorable?" Initially, the man in the white paper hat was puzzled when he saw Fairy Eternity appear, not sure who she was.
Now that Fairy Eternity had revealed her identity, he was struck with realization.
He recalled the message Vice Headmaster Shi sent him, saying Heaven's Court's people came to Hanshui City and were dissatisfied hearing about Ghost suffering from a calamity suspected to be caused by Jiuyou Teaching. Fortunately, Vice Headmaster Shi was worried that this incident would affect the cooperation between the two sects, so he had already explained things clearly.
At the thought of it, the man in the white paper hat felt a cold shudder. The so-called people of Heaven's Court might be this Supreme Heavenly Honorable standing in front of him right now.
"It's a good thing that things have been explained clearly."
The Supreme Heavenly Honorable was a legendary figure: the first immortal of the ancients and an existence even the Four Immortals of the Ancients feared!
"Do you know who she is?" Noticing a change in the man in the white paper hat's expression, Qiu Jin'an quietly asked.
"She is a person of unspeakable importance." The man in the white paper hat neither dared nor wished to discuss the Supreme Heavenly Honorable any further.
Qiu Jin'an began to speak but then stopped, words sitting on the tip of his tongue, but he said nothing.
...
"Governor Lu, are you alright?"
Incidentally, while everyone else was captivated by the appearance of Fairy Eternity, who was bathing in the power of the State Destiny, only Lu Yang was paying attention to Governor Lv, who was still coughing up blood.
"Cough, cough. I'm okay." Governor Lv struggled to his feet and pulled out a few elixirs from his Storage Ring, then swallowed them to heal his injuries.
Only then did Lu Yang lift his gaze to the focus of the spectacle in the sky. A small smile spread across his face, remembering the last thing Fairy Eternity had said before marching into battle.
"This immortal has promised you safety in the Wild State."
...
"Hmph, an immortal? She is nothing but a bluffer!" Wu Youdao calmed himself down. If she was truly an immortal, he would have died from her first strike.
Fairy Eternity merely chuckled and sneered at Wu Youdao, "How ignorant. Only a small piece of this immortal's consciousness is present here. The power of the State Destiny looked interesting, which is why I borrowed it. Can't you young people even understand such a simple thing?"
Despite his title as the second strongest in the successive Emperors, Wu Youdao would not be easily scared.
"The power of State Destiny can only elevate you to the early stage of the Pass Tribulation, just like the three of us. Do you think you can defeat three opponents at once?"
The Honorable Cang Lei and Wu Ji finally realized that, while she could be an immortal, her true body was not here. What was left was a consciousness controlling the power of State Destiny.
If her power was still at the early stage of Pass Tribulation, she presented no threat to them.
Equally matched in the early stage of the Pass Tribulation, who could be weaker than whom?
Fairy Eternity spoke again, her tone indifferent. "If Ying Tian, Kirin, and Jiuchong were at the early stage of the Pass Tribulation, they would indeed pose some threat to this immortal. As for you three waste...."
She shook her head gently, not saying anything more.
In Fairy Eternity's eyes, the so-called second strongest of the successive Emperors was nothing. After all, he was not the second strongest figure in the entire history of the Great Yu dynasty.
Seeing Fairy Eternity's attitude, Wu Youdao was enraged and bellowed, "Universe in Palm!"
Despite the bright daylight, the whole of Hanshui City was suddenly shrouded in darkness. The citizens instinctively looked up, their bodies trembling.
A colossal hand veiled Hanshui city. With the people's limited eyesight, they couldn't discern how big the hand was, only feeling like it blocked everything, including the sky.
Qiu Jin'an and the man in the white paper hat, however, saw more details. The giant hand held an entire universe within it, including countless Cave Heavens. Its weight was immeasurable. If it came down, the whole Hanshui City would be destroyed, reduced to dust.
Despite facing this terrifying hand, Fairy Eternity didn't even flinch.
"This immortal has told you, that thing of yours is not worthy of the title 'Universe in Palm'. Today, this immortal will let you see what a true 'Universe in Palm' is."
Wu Youdao's heart skipped a beat, and he looked up, utterly shocked.
Everyone was at the bottom, unable to see what was happening above the giant hand seal. Only Wu Youdao could see clearly.
A massive column emerged from the thick clouds, located directly above the giant hand. The end of the column still hadn't fully cleared out of the clouds.
But was it really a column? It was clearly a finger!
A finger even more enormous than the giant hand!
"It's only bigger, I refuse to believe your finger can beat my palm!" Wu Youdao roared in anger, frantically channeling his spiritual essence. The giant hand flipped over, its palm facing skyward. This simple movement caused a violent wind to sweep across Hanshui City.
Wu Youdao's giant hand displayed one Cave Heaven after another, decorated with exotic flowers and rare herbs, as well as various precious treasures, too numerous to count.
Each Cave Heaven was both a miniature world and a treasure house!
Fairy Eternity lightly regarded the frenzied Wu Youdao and gently pressed down with her fingertip.
Her fingertip contained infinite cosmic stars, which shattered and reassembled in cycles, bursting forth with tremendous energy time and again.
The fingertip collided with the giant hand. Wu Youdao's giant hand didn't last long before it was punctured by the finger.
Boom!
What also burst open was the "Rule" that Wu Youdao had established - "No information can leave Hanshui City within one day".
The rule that managed to survive through Wu Ji's tribulation was punctured by Fairy Eternity's finger!
The whole world fell silent.
Fairy Eternity withdrew her hand and looked at the heavily injured Wu Youdao, who was coughing up blood due to the backlash of the rule. Her tone remained nonchalant.
"This, is the true 'Universe in Palm'."

chapters.title: Chapter 446 - 445 Sweep_1
chapters.content:
The world fell into deathly silence, both the sides of Great Xia and Great Yu were left in awe by Fairy Eternity's move.
Everyone could see that the application of Universe in Palm by Wu Youdao was a desperate ploy, the ultimate move, and the last resort.
However, such a massive move was easily dissolved by the opponent, even the regulations binding Hanshui City were shattered.
To what horrendous extent had the opponent mastered power, magic skills, and the [Regulations]?!
When a lower realm cultivator gains the power of a higher realm, they often fail to utilize the full potential due to limitations in thought, perspective and other aspects. Added to this, the usage of State Destiny's power is an immortal method, which is difficult to comprehend even for transcendence tribulation stage cultivators.
This was the reason why Governor Lv remained in a passive state throughout the combat.
In contrast, Fairy Eternity, after exchanging blows multiple times with cultivators of the same realm during her transcendence tribulation stage, was extremely familiar with the level of power one should have at that stage. After she became immortal, her vision improved further, and she could even guide the combat of the transcendence tribulation stage.
There was nobody else in the world who could exploit the benefits of State Destiny's power more than her.
"Are you okay?" Honourable Wu Ji stepped forward to heal Wu Youdao's injuries, delivering an extremely precious Semi-Immortal Great Pill. Not to mention, the concoction of this elixir demanded a specific cultivation level of the maker, the ingredients required for concoction were also scarce. After a successful concoction, the next one would be hard to come by.
With a formidable enemy present, there was no room for thought.
Wu Youdao played a key role in the revival of Great Yu. In the Imperial Teacher's plan, Wu Youdao was meant to ascend the throne after Great Yu was restored. Thus, they couldn't afford to lose him here.
The Semi-Immortal Great Pill was useful. After taking one, the damage inflicted by the counterattack of the regulations became insignificant, and his pierced palm began to slowly heal. However, the healing rate was much slower than expected, indicating the impact of Fairy Eternity's move.
"Let's attack together!" Wu Youdao had to admit, the opponent was not someone he could defeat alone.
"Everyone, stop holding back. The commotion here is colossal, we need to conclude the fight quickly before the other powerful entities of Great Xia arrive!"
The power of State Destiny was in sight; Wu Youdao insisted on seizing it no matter what!
Returning empty-handed would entail enormous losses.
Generally, in a transcendence tribulation stage battle, the competitors compare the degrees of regulation usage. However, the three of them had already grasped that the opponent might be a real immortal.
Fiddling with regulations in front of an immortal would mean not even knowing how they died!
Better fight with magic skills!
Honourable Cang Lei and Honourable Wu Ji were aware of the formidable enemy they were facing; bypassing the minor sparring session, they resorted to their final cards upfront.
"Glowing Thunder, heed my command!"
Honourable Cang Lei, named with "Thunder," was skilled in Thunder skills!
In that instant, the dome of the sky seemed to collapse, with silver snakes dancing wildly, like countless dragons transforming, galloping in the sky.
The massive sound shook Hanshui City. If it weren't for the protection of the Array Method, everyone's eardrums would have been shattered!
The regulations had just broken, and people outside the city had no clue about what had happened. They saw the dense black light over Hanshui City, thunderbolts pouring downwards like rain, making the civilians tremble, unable to stand. They collapsed onto the ground due to fright.
The power of the thunderstorm was equivalent to, or even stronger than the previous Thunder Tribulation!
After all, the Thunder Tribulation signified danger and the threat of death, whereas Honourable Cang Lei's move didn't indicate a trace of respite and carried the danger of death in every sense!
The intertwining thunderbolts formed a cage, trapping Fairy Eternity within.
When the cage shrinks to the extreme, one can imagine how the person inside would be struck by thunderbolts!
In the face of all this, Fairy Eternity remained unmoved. She spoke softly in a voice only the three from Great Yu could hear.
"The world's tribulation originates from the Tribulation Dao Fruit of Yingtian Immortal, with the thunder tribulation as the most common form. Even Yingtian Immortal doesn't dare to attack me with thunder magic, how could your poor imitation possibly succeed?"
Shock registered on Honourable Cang Lei's face. The message conveyed through Fairy Eternity's words revealed many ancient secrets!
A complacent smile emerged on Fairy Eternity's lips. However, under the veil of State Destiny's power, no one could see her face, let alone her expression.
She stretched out a delicate finger towards the sky, and her lips moved slightly, uttering a few words. The terrifying thunder cage vanished instantly. The sky was clear as if nothing had happened.
Only Honourable Cang Lei, being the closest, heard what she said, which made him tremble uncontrollably.
What she said was: "Decree, Disperse."
The decree is a command from a superior to a subordinate. Her simple words made his proud imitation of the Thunder Tribulation dissipate, suggesting only one thing -
Her status was above that of the Thunder Tribulation; the Thunder Tribulation didn't dare to attack her!
How could this be possible?!
Honourable Cang Lei had never heard of such a thing, but now there was only this explanation!
He was horrified from the bottom of his heart. The opponent was his natural enemy!
"Sacrifice my Fist!" Honourable Wu Ji stepped forward. Each step he took in the air rippled. He began deploying his fist technique.
This was his strongest move which was synonymous with his title.
Honourable Wu Ji's fist technique was domineering. The golden light was sharp; its divine light was dazzling. A grayish fog appeared behind him, which was the Corpse Qi he had accumulated. It served as nourishment for his fist technique, "Sacrifice my Fist".
"Fairy Fist Technique."
Fairy Eternity waved her soft fists. It appeared gentle but contained profound Dao Principles, engendering endless wonders.
The Fairy Fist Technique was an amalgamation of over ten thousand fist techniques including the Arhat Fruit Fist, Forsythia Fist, Heavenly Mallow Seed Fist etc. Among these, some techniques could dissipate Corpse Qi, like the detoxifying Arhat Fruit Fist and Forsythia Fist etc.
In front of Fairy Fist Technique, Corpse Qi dissipated automatically. Deprived of nourishment, "Sacrifice my Fist" was like rootless duckweed, almost powerless.
Honourable Wu Ji was shocked. Since learning his fist techniques, he had never encountered a situation like this. Before he could react, Fairy Fist Technique took aim at his face.
The punches landed heavily on Honourable Wu Ji's face, causing it to swell and blacken.
"Daluo Triple Strength!"
"Cang Lei Body Refinement!"
"Fist of Earth Sacrifice!"
The combined attack of the three from Great Yu was formidable and grave, like world-ending calamity. Fairy Eternity turned into a martial Dao immortal, combating the trio single-handedly. Despite the intimidating thunder and unbeatable fist techniques, she overpowered all, demonstrating a stunning combat power. The trio was forced to retreat continuously, becoming a disorganized group.
For the most exceptional talents, the world's evaluation only vouches for their potential to become immortals.
But Fairy Eternity was a true immortal; any praise fell short in describing her.
Fairy Eternity was at ease despite the ongoing combat, effortlessly dissolving any attack.
Secret magic skills held by Wu Youdao and the others were seen by Fairy Eternity in ancient times, which enabled her to tackle them effortlessly.
She knew every move employed by her opponents, and her skills were superior; she even knew the moves her opponents didn't.
Fairy Eternity shook her head; these three didn't even have the qualifications to compete for immortality in ancient times, they were too weak.
Without the qualifications to compete for immortality, they were also unqualified to be her opponents.
"None of them are worthy, they all fall short compared to Yingtian Immortal and the others."

chapters.title: Chapter 447 - 446 Deadlock Battle!_1
chapters.content:
Fairy Eternity, unmatched in combat, exhibited no signs of fatigue even against the three opponents; on the contrary, the more she battled, the stronger she seemed, instilling terror in them.
In the face of her Cultivation Level, the mountains seemed as feeble as blocks of tofu. Wu Youdao and the other two, their faces having collided with several mountain ranges, demonstrated a state of unyieldingness that barely faltered.
Fairy Eternity reappeared behind them with an even faster pace, threw a series of punches, and sent them flying once again.
Like rag dolls, they were bounced off in all directions, not even having the luxury to stabilize their bodies.
"Space Defense!" Wu Youdao was the first to stabilize his body, setting up a multi-layered space defense in the face of the onrushing Fairy Eternity - a protection magic artifact passed down through generations of Emperor Yu.
These defense layers, varying in size and difficult to penetrate, are loaded with lethal traps; whoever falls into them is doomed, and exiting them alive would mean a narrow escape from death!
Fairy Eternity glanced at the space defenses blocking her path, lightly advanced, and effortlessly passed through them all - a swift kick landed on Wu Youdao's face.
Her foot broke his neck instantly!
"How is this possible!" Wu Youdao exclaimed in shock, even if Fairy Eternity had a masterly knowledge of spatial magic skills, she would never be able to traverse these layers of space.
These layers of varied sizes were devised to prevent anyone from casting spatial magic skills to cross them.
"She just simultaneously cast Shrinking Ground Into Inches and Heaven and Earth in an Inch!" Honourable Cang Lei, with his sharp perception, recognized Fairy Eternity's tactics.
He had, however, never heard of anyone who could cast these two top-grade spatial skills simultaneously!
Not to mention the chilling panic that Wu Youdao and his allies felt at her onslaught - even the spectators, Qiu Jin'an and the man in the white hat, were taken aback.
A display of such control while fighting against three opponents of equal caliber easily made Fairy Eternity an immortal.
"No wonder she is coined Dou of the Stars," the man in the white hat murmured. The strength Fairy Eternity demonstrated was even more formidable than the impression the name conveys.
Qiu Jin'an looked at the man in the white hat, puzzled: "Dou of the Stars? Not the combat Heavenly Honorable Dou?"
"Dou as in 'beans'." clarified the man in the white hat, without revealing anything more.
...
Fairy Eternity stretched leisurely. Having spent most of her time in the spiritual space, this was a good opportunity for her to stretch her muscles.
"I've had enough fun, it's time to wrap this up."
She fired three consecutive punches, embedding her understanding of spatial magic within them. These punches were inescapable; characters took the blows and could no longer support themselves. They fell from the sky, much like torn sacks.
"Cough, cough..."
Wu Youdao coughed up fresh dark blood, his eyes filled with blood strands. Since his birth, he has been blessed with the Dragon and Tiger Dual Spirit and had led a life of ease. His extraordinary talent for Cultivation ensured everyone hailed him as a future great achiever - the practice of cultivation as simple as drinking water for him; he had never encountered a bottleneck in his practice.
The only real challenge came in reaching the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, but that was it.
He smoothly became the sixth Emperor Yu; his siblings didn't even qualify to compete with him.
After becoming an emperor, he realized the difficulties in Transcendence Tribulation Stage's cultivation and struggled to find the ease he had enjoyed before. But his ambitions stretched far beyond the Transcendence Tribulation Stage.
He wanted to become an Immortal.
To reach that goal, he participated in the Imperial Teacher's plan, fell into a long sleep, woke up after a hundred and eighty thousand years to vie for the opportunity to become an Immortal.
Prior to becoming immortal, he had set his eyes on the power of State Destiny; a metamorphic product of the Dragon and Tiger Dual Spirit that held immense value for him and could come in handy in future battles for becoming an Immortal.
While the Imperial Teacher wanted to decipher the State Destiny's power, he wanted to possess it, thus the HanShui City project was conceived.
"As the ruler of Great Yu, retreat is not an option!" Wu Youdao spat out a mouthful of dark blood, took another Semi-Immortal grade Great Pill, and his spirits soared once again. The Dragon and Tiger Dual Spirit, akin to a pair of civil and military officials, stood beside him!
Honourable Cang Lei, lodged in the mountain gorge, looked even older as he puffed and panted for breath. Despite using most of his energy reserves to block Fairy Eternity's punches, he still failed to stop her.
All he could manage under the might of her punches was to spare his life.
Honourable Cang Lei slowly closed his eyes, reminiscing about his life.
When he was born, the country was still managed under the help of the first Imperial Teacher, he himself was born into a mid-tier influential family. His family's ancestor was only a Cultivator in the Spirit Transformation Stage and due to his lowly birth, he was ignored in the family and suffered humiliation.
Once, while he was up the mountains collecting herbs, he accidentally stumbled into a Secret Realm where he inherited the lineage of lightning magic spells.
After receiving his inheritance, his predicament had only slightly improved. He had the inheritance, but lacked the resources.
In order to obtain resources, he fought desperately, went through bloody battles, elevated himself, joined many forces, overcame countless impossible opponents, and finally achieved success and glory, trampling the family who looked down on him under his feet.
Due to his reckless fighting when he was young and the incomplete inheritance of the Thunder Law he received, he consumed a lot of his lifespan, causing him to have a shorter lifespan than other cultivators at the Pass Tribulation stage.
To extend his lifespan, he chose to fall into slumber, intending to abandon the chance to become an Immortal in other people's struggles for immortality, and instead strive for the spiritual objects that prolong life.
He didn't care who would be the emperor, and who could become an Immortal. His participation in the opportunity at Hanshui City was merely because the Imperial Teacher promised to help him fight for the longevity spiritual objects.
He never expected to encounter a powerful enemy and face the risk of death.
Should he surrender?
As Honourable Cang Lei gradually lost consciousness, remembrances of his hurried life flashed in his mind: fighting for the Foundation Establishment spiritual object, defeating his eldest cousin, joining the Assassin organization to comprehend the Golden Core, fighting and defeating three cultivators of the same stage in a row for successfully achieving the break core to reach Nascent, until he was out of strength…
No!
Honourable Cang Lei abruptly opened his eyes. His entire life had been a relentless battle; opportunities were fought for, were killed for!
So what if he was naturally restrained by powers? Certainly, he could still win!
"Kill!"
Looking at this familiar yet unfamiliar Yin Corpse Mountain Range, Honourable Wu Ji couldn't help but sigh. He was the descendant of the legendary hermit Witch Clan. For stealing the clan's secret technique, he was expelled from the clan after being stripped of his cultivation level and memory of the resurrection technique.
Fortunately, he hadn't completely forgotten everything. Fragments of the resurrection technique occasionally flashed in his mind. Relying on these fragments, he traveled through various tombs, cultivating using the surrounding environment, regaining his cultivation levels, and recalling the complete resurrection technique.
To improve his realm, he caused a sizable wave of zombie attacks in Great Yu. The court captured him, but they didn't execute him. Instead, they saw his talent and decided to cultivate it ambitiously.
Under the court's nurturing, his cultivation level gradually surpassed his peers and advanced to the Pass Tribulation stage.
The first thing he did after breaking through to the Pass Tribulation stage was to attack the Witch Clan. He annihilated them to the last, obtaining a wealth of inheritance.
The court provided him with the cultivation level for revenge, so he undoubtedly had to repay the court with his life. This was duty!
"His Majesty cannot die here, I'll risk everything!"
A raging fire ignited in their eyes, ready to fight to death.
"Dragon Tiger Spirit, fight with me!"
Wu Youdao stomped on the Dragon Spirit under his feet, transforming the Tiger Spirit into an image tattooed on his back. The roaring of tigers echoed, his eyes changed: the left showed the dragon's eye, the right the tiger's. His body emitted an aura of wilderness.
"Forge with Cang Lei's power, hammered a thousand times!"
The hearty Cang Lei struck Honourable Cang Lei, resulting in a thunder pattern on his forehead. Eeach of his hair strands stood up, lightning flashing at their tips. His body became young again, restoring the appearance of a strong man in his prime.
He was burning his lifespan to regain his prime physical state!
"If even old Cang Lei is burning lifespan, I can't lag behind. Witch Clan Secret Technique - Sacrificial Fist to Heaven!"
Honourable Wu Ji went berserk. No longer holding back, he roared to the heavens. An astonishing force descended from the sky, flowing into his body. Every cell in his body was glowing, filled to the brim with power!
"Let's go together!"
All three of them struck at the same time, launching an all-out attack, using their strongest moves to pin Fairy Eternity down right there!
"Be careful!" Qiu Jin'an warned aloud. Even he felt extremely dangerous from their desperate moves even just watching distantly from the sidelines, a cold sweat breaking on his forehead!
The man in the white paper cap swallowed, worried whether Fairy Eternity could withstand this deadly attack!
Bang bang bang——
Fairy Eternity used her Fairy Fist style, dealing every man a punch, directly reducing all three of them into a weakened state.
All three collapsed to the ground, convulsing.
"What nonsense, scared this Fairy out of her wits. I thought you all had some form of powerful moves," she said.

chapters.title: Chapter 448 - 447 The End of the Battle_1
chapters.content:
Wu Youdao and the other two finally understood, the person before their eyes was an opponent they could not defeat. Not to mention defeat, from the start of the fight to now, it was impossible for them to even injure her.
Heaven's Court's Supreme Heavenly Leader, extremely terrifying.
"Run!"
The three had already recognizied the truth, since they could not defeat her, then they'd escape and wait for another chance!
The speed of a physical body was far slower than the speed of the spirit. All three were experienced fighters; they made the correct choice the first time — separate their souls from their bodies and escape!
"Fortunately, our opponent is just a thought from an immortal, she can't chase all three of us at the same time, and the power of the State Destiny is not convenient to move. If she wants to chase us, she must abandon the power of the State Destiny. If she abandons the power of the State Destiny, her power will decrease. Even if she catches up, she won't be able to defeat us!"
The three were relieved and turned into beams of light to escape.
…
Fairy Eternity watched as the three of them left, and then withdrew her gaze.
When Governor Lv arrived at the scene after the battle was over, the only things left on the spot were three corpses and the masterless power of the State Destiny.
Seeing this, he quickly used the Wild State Seal to retrieve the power of the State Destiny.
Qiu Jin'an turned his head and bowed quickly: "I just want to thank my fellow cultivator for his help, but I haven't had time to ask where you are from?"
There was no one next to Qiu Jin'an, the man in the white paper cap had long since fled.
"What a good skill to flee. Has he gone, or has he escaped?" Qiu Jin'an muttered to himself with narrowed eyes. The tactics the man had used during the fight had made him wonder.
But after all, the man had come to their aid, so it wouldn't be appropriate to fall out with him on the spot.
Elder Gai and the others also hurried back to the Corpse Chasing Sect. Seeing the corpse of the Sect Leader, they howled and cried, tears falling like rain.
"Sect Leader, you died so miserably!"
"We will definitely avenge you!"
The disciples' eyes were also red, and they cried together. For a while, the whole Corpse Chasing Sect was filled with a sad atmosphere.
Lu Yang and others also rushed to the Corpse Chasing Sect, seeing the three corpses of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. They then saw the sect members of the Corpse Chasing Sect crying sorrowfully, their fists clenched, veins throbbing in anger.
Elder Gai, as the Grand Elder, now had to take on the duties of the Sect Leader in the leader's absence. He turned around and comforted the mourners, "Old Lu was a cheerful and optimistic person when he was alive. If he has a spirit in the sky, he would not want to see you like this. Everyone, smile to send him off one last time."
"Old Lu, rest assured, we will inherit your last wish and strengthen the Corpse Chasing Sect!"
Elder Gai chuckled softly, mourning for Lu Baqian.
"Elder Gai, you bastard, I'm dead and you're making them laugh!"
Master Ru's upper body rose stiffly, he glared at Elder Gai.
This sudden change took everyone on the scene by surprise. Governor Lv, sensing danger, thought that Master Lu had resurrected and once again mobilized the power of the State Destiny.
"You batshit bastard! Don't think I didn't know that you're still alive!" Elder Gai laughed and cursed.
"What the hell is going on?" Governor Lv, not understanding the situation, saw Elder Gai's reaction and seemed not to be surprised by Master Lu's resurrection.
Master Lu explained, "This man must be the newly appointed Governor. I guess this is our first formal meeting. I'm Lu Baqian, the leader of Corpse Chasing Sect."
Governor Lv courteously responded, but still did not understand what was going on.
"Governor Lv may not know, but our Corpse Chasing Sect and Seek Dao Sect have always had a friendly relationship. Although there's the exception of Daoist Buyu, but on the whole, our two sects have a good relationship."
"Corpse Chasing Sect has a tradition. To show a friendly relationship, the high-ranking officials of Corpse Chasing Sect will make two Soul Lamps. One is kept in the Corpse Chasing Sect, the other is kept in Seek Dao Sect, in case something like today happens."
Qiu Jin'an nodded in understanding, he had heard of this, so he had never doubted that something was wrong with the high-level officials of the Corpse Chasing Sect.
It's a habit of sects with friendly relationships. Their Five Elements Sect also has Soul Lamps of high-ranking officials from other sects.
Lu Baqian continued, "It's just that I didn't expect that the ancient cultivators would have some methods that we haven't mastered, that could possess my body without destroying my spirit."
"After that Wu Ji took over my body, he feared that the Seek Dao Sect would notice, so he dared not extinguish my spirit. He just completely severed my soul from my body, sealed my spirit, and that's how I was lucky enough to survive till now."
"At the same time, he could not obtain my memory. If he frequently communicated with Elder Gai and the others, he would expose himself. After he possessed me, he always announced to the outside world that he was in closed-door cultivation, only revealing himself once when making the Soul Dispersing Charm."
Master Lu felt a chill, if not for Wu Ji being afraid of the Seek Dao Sect, he would have really died.
"So now you are a Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator?" Governor Lv remembered another thing.
"A disaster that turned into a blessing, not completely. My body is at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, but when transcending the Tribulation, Wu Ji did it for me. My spirit realm is still the same as before. Now it is half a Transcendance Tribulation Stage, and it won't be complete until my spirit realm improves in the future."
"But anyway, I am the first one in my generation to break through the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, right?" Master Lu looked at Qiu Jin'an, thinking that he now had the highest realm in his generation.
"Do you have no shame?" Qiu Jin'an looked with disgust at Master Lu. No wonder he could get along well with the Seek Dao Sect.
"Don't care about shame, just say that I went through life and death, survived, and became a Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator." Master Lu was unabashed, without any hints of embarrassment.
Qiu Jin'an was tongue-tied, what Lu Baqian said seemed to be true after all.
Just as Lu Yang was watching the dispute between the Unification and Transcendance Tribulation stage cultivators with great interest, Fairy Eternity returned to the Spiritual Space.
"Phew, this fairy is exhausted. How was it? Was this fairy cool just now?" Fairy Eternity held up a thumbs-up, the corners of her mouth turned upwards revealing a bright smile.
"Very cool, Fairy is reliable ... But I want to ask you about these three people behind you...?" Lu Yang focused his eyes on the three people behind Fairy Eternity.
There stood three spirits who were very familiar. They had just met: Wu Youdao, Honourable Cang Lei, and Honourable Wu Ji.
The three Transcendance Tribulation stage cultivators were ashen. They never thought that the controller of the power of the State Destiny was not a strand of Immortal thought, but a complete Immortal Divine Soul.
In front of the Divine Soul of an Immortal, they had no chance to escape!
What happened to it only being a thought of an Immortal?
"These three are spoils of war. As a guest official of the Seek Dao Sect, it's justified for me to capture a few people for the sect and exchange them for contribution points, right?" Fairy Eternity counted on her fingers, her mind ticking over rapidly with intricate plans.
Previously, she captured an ancient Unification Stage cultivator and redeemed three days of Sect Leader experience voucher. How many good things could be exchanged for capturing three Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivators this time?
Lu Yang's face darkened, it reminded him of not so sweet memories.
The three Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivators listened to the conversation between the two, their hearts were shocked. So strong a fairy was in fact just a guest cultivator of the Seek Dao Sect. How deep is the talent pool of Seek Dao Sect?
The Imperial Teacher underestimated the fighting power of the Seek Dao Sect!
But why is this Supreme Heavenly Leader's behavior now completely different from during the battle?
Lu Yang was also curious and asked the same question as the three Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivators.
Fairy Eternity then revealed another ancient secret.
"The Yingtian Immortal once said, maintaining prestige to outsiders is a necessary skill for fairies."

chapters.title: Chapter 449 - 448 Grand Elder: What haven't I seen in this world?_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang's spiritual space was very vibrant, housing five individuals who were all world-class powerhouses: an ancient Immortal, three Transcendance Tribulation Stage Great Cultivators, and a Golden Dan Dignity.
Lu Yang felt that the number of people in his spiritual space was too many, was it not?
Moreover, this so-called spiritual space of his, decorated by Fairy Eternity, appeared pink and tender, nothing like a spiritual space belonging to the grand men.
At present, Fairy Eternity, as the mistress of the spiritual space, was lecturing the three prisoners.
"You three sit tight, behave yourselves. This place is my territory and the lad named Lu Yang is the second-in-command of the Eternity lineage. Treat him as you would treat me. Did you get it?!"
Fairy Eternity stood with her hands on her hips, pointing and directing like a spoiled young lady.
Wu Youdao and the other two, as transcendence tribulation stages, often enjoyed endless wealth and honour. Their food, clothing, housing and transportation all belonged to the topmost quality. Especially Wu Youdao, who was the sixth Emperor Yu, and was the second strongest among all past Emperor Yus. During his time as Emperor Yu, he stood at the pinnacle of the power pyramid.
Nothing like his current state where he was confined within a narrow spiritual space, kneeling on the ground, and being lectured.
The three exchanged glances, the bitterness apparent in their eyes.
Even Wu Youdao had lost his former arrogance.
They were no match, and there was nothing they could do about it.
After all, they were just in transcendence tribulation stage, having chosen to awaken at this time point after sleeping for 180,000 years with the purpose of becoming immortals,
if you contrast them with Fairy Eternity, who had long become an Immortal, the gap between them was utterly immeasurable.
Also, who was this supreme revered one?
The three racked their brains yet couldn't match Fairy Eternity with any of the Four Immortals of the Ancients.
Lu Yang confidently exited his spiritual space. With Fairy Eternity there, the three Transcendence Tribulation stages couldn't create any disturbance within the spiritual space.
Even at the same realm, a single person could suppress three individuals, not to mention the fact that she was now in a higher realm.
In the outside world, Sect Leader Lu was still alive and well, much to everyone's delight. Qiu Jin'an and Governor Lv were still regretting that they didn't catch Wu Youdao and the others. They were completely unaware that the three were currently imprisoned in Lu Yang's mind.
"It's a pity about Wu Youdao and the other two. If we could have caught them, it surely would have been a great achievement."
"Don't be dissatisfied. The State Destiny is safe, and Hanshui City unscathed. This is already a fortunate outcome."
Lu Yang once pondered why Fairy Eternity would not directly capture the three to give to Qiu Jin'an when instead, she went through the trouble of pretending to let them escape, then captured them back into the spiritual space.
There could possibly be three reasons. One could be that the capabilities of Qiu Jin'an and the others were limited and might not necessarily be able to restrain Wu Youdao's three transcendence tribulation stages.
Second is that it might expose the identity of Fairy Eternity.
Thirdly, why let the good things flow to others? Giving it to Governor Lv and Qiu Jin'an might not be as beneficial as giving it to the Seek Dao Sect, at the same time it could also earn some contributions points.
Considering Fairy Eternity's personality, she might have only considered the third point.
Qiu Jin'an noticed Meng Jingzhou in the crowd and beckoned him over. "As I mentioned before when I borrowed your body, I would teach you a Five Elements magic skill in exchange. Once you've got time, come to the Five Elements Sect to learn."
Initially, Qiu Jin'an planned to borrow Meng Jingzhou's body, to give Ba the Second a punch and then take Meng Jingzhou with him in order to fulfill the promise. However, unexpected events occurred so fast with the causality backlash, the trip to the Wild State and the chaos caused by the Great Yu cultivators. It wasn't until now that things finally settled down.
Now the great battle is over, but there are still many things that need to be finished, such as dealing with the lingering ghosts in the city, checking if there are other Great Yu cultivators hiding in the city, calming the public's emotions and so on. Qiu Jin'an needs to stay here temporarily to help Governor Lv handle them.
During the previous battle, Fairy Eternity had revealed her astounding power, destroying the Yin Corpse Mountain Range. The Corpse Chasing Sect's headquarters was gone, and the Yin energy that had accumulated for tens of thousands of years had also completely vanished.
However, with Lu Baqian, a mere dabbler in the tribulation stage, the Corpse Chasing Sect would quickly recover its previous glory.
In terms of language logic, half-step tribulation stage and dabbler in the tribulation stage actually have the same meaning.
Once Meng Jingzhou's causality backlash was lifted and the purpose of their trip to the Wild State was achieved, Lu Yang and the other two bid farewell to Zhao Po, got on their carriage and returned to the Seek Dao Sect.
Before Lu Yang left, a Great Power arrived at Hanshui City. He was followed by a large contingent of troops, gallant and strict commanders who flew in the sky, all at the Golden Core Stage. These were the troops stationed at the border of Great Xia and Golden Buddha Kingdom. After the {rule} was broken, the old general at the tribulation stage immediately sensed something unusual about Hanshui City.
He mobilized his troops and rushed to Hanshui City. But he was still a step too late. Fairy Eternity had already quietly handled the situation.
"Earlier there were too many people and I didn't dare to ask, but was it the Eternity Fairy in your body who launched that attack?" Meng Jingzhou finally couldn't hold back his curiosity. After holding it in for so long, he finally asked.
Meng Jingzhou, Man Gu, and old horse witnessed firsthand how Lu Yang brought Fairy Eternity back to life.
There was no one else around.
"She did it."
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu gasped in surprise. They personally saw how Fairy Eternity, with the initial power of passing the Tribulation, beat Wu Youdao and his companions like they were nothing.
Unrivaled at the same level indeed.
Meng Jingzhou never expected Fairy Eternity's fighting strength to be so formidable. He looked at Lu Yang with envy. With an Immortal guiding him internally, it's no wonder Lu Yang's combat strength is so terrifying. It must be the result of the Immortal's instructions.
"Not only did she defeat those three Great Yu cultivators, the Fairy also captured their souls and stored them in my brain!" Lu Yang pointed to his own head.
Just as Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu were about to gasp again, their bodies swayed and they staggered.
The carriage which had been running steadily suddenly started shaking violently.
Meng Jingzhou sticks his head out, only to see the old horse acting abnormally. Using its space magic skill, it dashed rapidly as if it couldn't wait to reach the Seek Dao Sect.
The old horse had to hurry. It was afraid carrying not only three Golden Core Stage youths but also the souls of three Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivators. Shouldn't they rush back?
Running as fast as the old horse could carry them, the three of them returned to the Seek Dao Sect in the shortest time. The old horse then heaved a sigh of relief, feeling safe at last.
"You two go ahead, and I will proceed to the Task Hall first. I need to report this matter to Elder Brother Dai." Lu Yang said goodbye to Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu before heading to the Task Hall.
Upon arriving at the Task Hall, Lu Yang politely inquired the Senior Sister at the reception desk.
He recognized this Senior Sister; she was one who was ever in the queue against him.
"Senior Sister Tang, is Elder Brother Dai around? I have gained something during my recent outing and I wish to report it to Elder Brother Dai."
"Elder Brother Dai is not here, but the Grand Elder happens to be around. You can also share your gains with him."
Then Lu Yang remembered, Elder Brother Dai was temporarily replacing the Grand Elder in overseeing the Task Hall. The person in charge of the Task Hall was actually the Grand Elder.
"Alright."
"Before Elder Brother Dai left, he mentioned that Senior Brother Lu could directly proceed in case he has any issues."
Lu Yang nodded, thanked Senior Sister Tang, and went deep into the Task Hall, a place he was familiar with.
...
The Grand Elder finally returned to the Task Hall after a long time, sorting out all kinds of intelligence relationships, assessing task levels and danger, and judging future trends.
"Ah, Little Dai doesn't know to appreciate my old self." The Grand Elder lamented while rubbing the corners of his eyes, lying back in his chair to rest.
"Grand Elder, are you there?" A knock on the door was heard from Lu Yang.
"Oh, it's Lu Yang. Come on in." The Grand Elder straightened up, paying attention to his personal image.
He remembered Dai Bufan's instructions before leaving.
'Master, be careful with Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou when you're monitoring the Task Hall. If they report something to you, it's sure to be a big deal. Don't be surprised then.'
The Grand Elder chuckled at this, unconcerned. He knew about what Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were doing: infiltrating the Eternity Sect, dealing with the Eternity Sect, establishing the Heavenly Court, and deceiving the Nine Nether Sect.
Little Dai was still too young and hadn't seen much of the world yet. He was already surprised by these matters.
He was a top cultivator close to the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, the strongest below that stage. He had seen all kinds of events and could handle any big incident.
"Lu Yang, I heard from the others that you went to the Wild State. And now you're back. What happened?" The Grand Elder leisurely sipped his tea, appearing indifferent.
"Well, I captured the souls of three Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivators in the Wild State. They're now confined in my brain."
"Pff---"

chapters.title: Chapter 450 - 449, If the Eldest Senior Sister is so strong, how powerful must Lu Yang's master be?_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang wiped the tea from his face, looking innocently at the Grand Elder, "Grand Elder, what's wrong with you?"
The Grand Elder looked at Lu Yang as though he were seeing a ghost, wondering if his hearing had become poor due to his old age.
Having lived for over two thousand years and being the eldest brother of the Nine Sons of the Seek Dao Sect, as well as a Half Step Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivator, this was the first time he'd encountered this situation.
To his knowledge, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had only gone to Wild State, perhaps accompanied by the Great Demon King Dragon Horse at most.
Not to mention such a lineup, even if it was ten times stronger, it wouldn't be possible to capture the spirits of three cultivators at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage.
"Who did you catch?"
"Wu Youdao, Venerable Thunder, Venerable Wu Ji." Lu Yang enumerated to the Grand Elder with his fingers.
The Grand Elder drew in a breath of tea. These three individuals were all famous Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivators under the Great Yu Dynasty, especially Wu Youdao, born with features of imperial dragons and tigers, always praised by Great Yu's historians.
"Old horse ran too fast, we arrived first, I think you haven't heard the news yet, Grand Elder. This trip to Wild State was extremely dangerous, we almost lost our lives there, really treacherous."
The Grand Elder gave a sideways glance to Lu Yang. By 'extremely treacherous', do you mean you managed to capture all three of them?
"First tell me clearly how you managed to capture these three Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivators?"
Lu Yang spoke with a mysterious air, "Grand Elder, there's no outsider here, we're both from Heaven's Court, I won't hide it from you. We, in Heaven's Court, have a big shot, the Supreme Sky Lord of the Ancient Heavenly Court, Bean Sky Lord!"
"I captured these three Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivators, all thanks to the intervention of Bean Sky Lord!"
The Grand Elder looked stunned for a moment, then revealed an understanding smile.
It seemed that Fairy Yun Zhi had made her move.
Although Martial Nephew Yun's position in the Heaven's Court is that of a Master, it does not prevent her from having multiple identities.
For example, she is not only the Eldest Senior Sister among the disciples, but also the Acting Sect Leader.
"Alright, alright. Since it's Martial Nephew Yun's matter, you go talk to her about it."
The Grand Elder threw Lu Yang out of the Task Hall.
Lu Yang shook his head helplessly and said to Fairy Eternity, "See, I told you, this matter will definitely need Senior Sister's intervention. You wanted to skip Senior Sister and directly exchange contribution points at the Task Hall; that's impossible."
"Alright." Fairy Eternity drooped her head in low spirits.
Just as Qiu Jin'an had mentioned, the Eldest Senior Sister had already completed the procedures for releasing their master from prison and has returned to the sect.
When Lu Yang returned to Sky Gate Mountain, the Eldest Senior Sister was still in her usual ethereal posture, sitting cross-legged on the peak of the mountain, her eyes containing countless stars, inscrutable.
Just by looking from a distance, one could feel an immense pressure.
When Wu Youdao and the other two saw this scene, their scalp tingled. Lu Yang couldn't understand the significance of the scene, but they, being Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivators, knew what it meant.
Because they knew, they felt fear from the bottom of their hearts.
In the times of Great Yu, the stars in the sky were all remaining images left from ancient times; the real stars were almost nonexistent.
Because of this, when Wu Youdao and the others woke from their sleep, they quickly noticed something unusual in the starry sky.
The originally residual stars were silently filled by someone, and there was no record of it.
What kind of mighty power was that?
And what realm was needed to achieve such a thing?
They had always wanted to know who was responsible for the stars in the sky shining brightly again, and now they finally knew.
They would rather not have known.
"Senior Sister, I'm back," said Lu Yang, seeming to be very honest in front of his Senior Sister.
"He's calling that immortal... Senior Sister?" Venerable Thunder exclaimed incredulously, losing his composure.
The other two had somewhat similar reactions. This woman is actually Lu Yang's Senior Sister?
Then how strong should Lu Yang's master be?
Seek Dao Sect seems truly terrifying.
"You're back?" The Senior Sister stood up, a star flashed within her icy eyes, disappearing instantly as if it had never been there, and she calmly looked at Lu Yang.
"What's the situation with the three Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivators within you?" The Senior Sister casually swept a glance, noticing that Lu Yang's Spiritual Space was bustling with activity.
"Alright, all of you, come out." Fairy Eternity pulled all three out.
The three Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivators were not much different from chicks in Fairy Eternity's hands.
"The cultivation foundation is quite average, unlikely to become immortals. Tell me why is that?"
Currently, the Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivators were all acquainted by the Senior Sister, even visited personally for teaching. She didn't recognize these three men, obviously they were cultivators from ancient times.
To the Senior Sister, the bases of these three were average and unlikely to become immortals.
Lu Yang appropriately glossed over his luck in love affairs and only told how he had gone to the Corpse Chasing Sect and discovered a ghost in Hanshui City. He encountered Huang Ming — a cultivator at the Unification stage from the Great Yu era who had to Start Over after Disbanding Cultivation — when he went to kill these ghosts. He was then attacked by Mong Tian and was saved by Qiu Jin'an.
"Mong Tian and Huang Ming ran away, I couldn't catch them yet. Wu Youdao made his presence with an expression of wanting to execute the plan ahead of time as though the information has been leaked."
Wu Youdao: "..."
So it wasn't you who caught Mong Tian and Huang Ming!
Venerable Thunder and Wu Ji looked at Wu Youdao resentfully — why did you have to jump out in such a hurry?
Their original plan was to wait for Wu Ji to succeed in Pass Tribulation, activate the great formation, and seize the power of State Destiny.
Although according to the original plan, the result would still have been Fairy Eternity using the power of State Destiny to give them all a good beating.
Lu Yang continued to talk about the battle between Wu Youdao's party and Governor Lv's party. He emphasized the fact that Master Ru was possessed and the man with a white paper hat who came to help was suspected to be the Master of Nine Nether Sect.
"Possessed Master Ru?" The Senior Sister's eyes narrowed slightly, causing ripples in the air. The soul of Wu Ji trembled as if being watched by an extremely terrifying existence and unable to escape.
When the Senior Sister went to the Corpse Chasing Sect for learning exchange, she primarily sought Master Ru's advice on the art of controlling corpses.
"Master Ru's Soul Lamp hasn't extinguished. It seems he kept this in mind and did not completely possess. However, it's still unforgivable."
The Senior Sister stepped forward, indifferently placing her hand on Wu Ji's head. Wu Ji screamed in agony, chilling one to the bone. It was as if his soul was forcibly torn apart, his consciousness rapidly dissipating.
"Why can't I see you guys anymore? Why can't I see you?" Wu Ji's vision turned black, staggered with his hands reaching out blindly, he could not see anything.
"Wu Ji, you..." Venerable Thunder wanted to speak but stopped, intending to say it wasn't them who disappeared, but Wu Ji who had lost the ability to perceive the outside world.
"Is anyone speaking? Speak louder, I can't hear." Wu Ji lost his hearing.
As Wu Ji's consciousness dissipated, his mouth mumbled incomprehensible words and he fell to the ground.
His soul was cleansed completely and from then on, there would never be a person named Wu Ji on this earth.
"Use it as a Spirit Device." The Senior Sister threw Wu Ji aside and looked at the trembling Wu Youdao and Venerable Thunder.
To make a Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivator into a Spirit Device, even a Transcendence Level magic artifact may not necessarily have a spirit as powerful.
The soul of a cultivator being refined into a Spirit Device is just a step away from soul destruction in its severity.
"If you two have anything to hide, you will also be refined into Spirit Devices."

chapters.title: Chapter 451 - 450: Great Yu's Plan_1
chapters.content:
Wu Youdao gritted his teeth, struggling in his heart. He, the lofty sixth Emperor Yu, the one destined to vanquish Great Xia and restore the glory of Great Yu, should not have let out a word only due to a threat!
Having seen and caused bloodshed as an emperor, he was not to be frightened by a mere spirit device!
Just as Wu Youdao was about to speak his mind, he heard Lu Yang, lost in thought, say: "They often say history is written by victors. Seek Dao Sect has always been on friendly terms with the imperial court. We can negotiate with the scribes and add some artistic flourishes to your narrative."
"If you cooperate, we will write that you chose to die rather than surrender. Despite brutal tortures, you did not leak a single piece of intelligence, a most noble spirit."
"Even Emperor Xia would then commend you as a wise ruler, possessing the qualities of an Immortal. Unfortunately, you were born in the wrong era. Had you continued ruling in Great Yu, you could have brought it to an even greater prosperity. Your talents are no less than your ancestor, the First Emperor Yu."
"On the contrary, if you refuse to speak, we will write that you wept bitterly after being captured, begging for your life. You would admit the legitimacy of Great Xia and concede that the Great Yu dynasty is inferior to Great Xia. Moreover, we would portray you as having led a leisurely life in Seek Dao Sect, enjoying fine wines and foods every day."
"I will confess everything."
Upon hearing these words, Wu Youdao promptly said in cold sweat.
Having failed and been captured, he could no longer control his own fate, let alone becoming an Immortal. The only remaining thing he cared for now was his reputation. According to Lu Yang, it would be even more unbearable than the dispersal of his soul. He would be laughed at and despised, infamous for eternity.
Wu Youdao glared hatefully at Lu Yang, who simply ignored him without feeling any guilt.
Elder Sister frowned at Lu Yang, it was beyond her expectation that such a method was available. She had planned to torture the confessors with old methods.
Elder Sister lifted her jade hand, and the golden bell on her wrist jingled, raising a curtain of light that separated Wu Youdao and Venerable Thunder, preparing for separate interrogations.
"What's your plan in the Wild State?"
"The Imperial Teacher and I...I mean, he told me the State Destiny power of Great Xia was the key to obstructing their rise. He needed to fully understand the influence of the State Destiny on Great Xia to devise a plan to steal the State Destiny power of Wild State.
After the research was completed, we would use the State Destiny power to nurture my Dragon-Tiger Vitality, which would significantly enhance my chance of becoming an Immortal in the future."
"How is Great Yu planning to rise up?"
"Only the first Imperial Teacher knows the whole picture of our rise-up plan. The second Imperial Teacher and I knew only part of it. However, ever since I woke up, I've never met the legendary first Imperial Teacher; only the second Imperial Teacher and I have been plotting together."
The first Imperial Teacher had disappeared before the birth of Wu Youdao. For Wu Youdao, the first Imperial Teacher was like an entity of legends.
"The plan that the Imperial Teacher and I have devised is to ally ourselves with the Demon Territory, Sea Clan and the demonic sect. When the Great Era truly arrived, we would coordinate an internal and external attack on Great Xia to seize power. Then, I would crown myself as Emperor Yu."
Fairy Eternity felt a sense of déjà vu from the first half of the plan Wu Youdao had divulged, as if she had heard it before.
Lu Yang fell into contemplation. Wu Youdao's plan was rather roughly made, more like a general idea. It seemed that the real plan was formulated by the two Imperial Teachers.
According to historical records, during the early stage of Great Yu, Emperor Yu and his Imperial Teacher were closely allied. The Imperial Teacher was blessed with the talent to govern the world, provided strategic advice for Emperor Yu, and Emperor Yu was open to changes. Their strengths were complementary and together, they brought prosperity to the Great Yu dynasty.
Not all Emperors Yu were necessarily talented rulers, like Wu Youdao, who had a high cultivation level but lacked the skills to govern a nation.
"Who will be the Emperor Yu after you?"
The first Emperor Yu was the strongest person in Great Yu dynasty. According to historical records, he fought in all corners of the land and finally overthrew Great Qian, unifying the world and establishing the Great Yu dynasty. He reigned for three thousand years, but due to long-term warfare, his concealed internal injuries finally broke out and he died of his illnesses.
Lu Yang remained skeptical about this narrative. Thoroughly in contact with the powerhouses, as the strongest of the Great Yu dynasty, how could the first Emperor Yu have died so simply?
"My ancestor is really dead. When I took over as Emperor Yu, I even offered sacrifice to his body." Wu Youdao stated with determination. If the first Emperor Yu was not dead, he would not have agreed to the plan of the Imperial Teacher.
With the first Emperor Yu still alive, it would be impossible for him to become the new Emperor Yu and get the opportunity to become an Immortal.
"How many of you are currently revived and what is their cultivation level?"
"In total, there are thirty-two Unification-stage practitioners and seven are at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage."
Lu Yang frowned, this number was considerably higher than what Heavenly Calamity Sovereign had confessed, who had only mentioned two practitioners at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
It seems that Heavenly Calamity Sovereign, who had reached the early stage of Transcendance Tribulation, held an insignificant role in the plan of the Great Yu dynasty.
If someone at the early stage of Transcendance Tribulation was considered insignificant, the power of Great Yu, hidden in the darkness, must be rather terrifying.
"What are the specific realms of the seven at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage?"
"There are three at the early stage of Transcendance Tribulation, two at the mid-stage, and two at the late stage. The latter four are still in slumber, and I don't know if there are other practitioners at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage."
Lu Yang reflected upon those he had met from Great Yu dynasty who were at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage: Heavenly Calamity Sovereign, Venerable Thunder, and Wu Ji - just the three he had learned from early Transcendance Tribulation stage practitioners.
"Where are the four practitioners at the mid and later stages of Transcendance Tribulation hibernating?"
"Only the Imperial Teacher knows, I do not."
"What are the realms of the two Imperial Teachers?"
"Nobody knows the realm of the first Imperial Teacher. I'd asked several practitioners who had met him, some said he was only a half-step away from becoming an Immortal, while others claimed that he had already achieved the Dao Fruit and advanced to the Immortal Realm. The second Imperial Teacher is a Semi-Immortal level practitioner."
When Wu Youdao mentioned the first Imperial Teacher's advancement to the Immortal Realm, admiration shone in his eyes.
Lu Yang, however, was a lot calmer. When talking about Immortals, all he could think of was Fairy Eternity and the four unfortunate souls.
He had no admiration whatsoever for Immortals.
The so-called "Semi-Immortal-level Practitioner" was a Transcendance Tribulation-stage cultivator with the rudimentary form of Dao Fruit.
Lu Yang only knew one Semi-Immortal-level cultivator, the third master of the Immortal Eternity lineage, Immortal Eternity himself.
"If your plan for Wild State is successful, what will the next step be?"
"Those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage will take action and use the 'rule' to envelop a city in Ji State, in an attempt to turn its inhabitants into subjects of Great Yu using this rule."
"Which city?"
"We will select randomly."
Elder Sister repeated her question to Venerable Thunder, who had far less information than Wu Youdao. However, as corroborating evidence, it was already sufficient.
Elder Sister felt it was necessary to share the information provided by Wu Youdao with the imperial court and the other Four Great Immortal Sects, especially regarding the matter in Ji State. They had to be fully prepared.
She bound Wu Ji, who had been thoroughly refined, with chains, and handed one end of the chain to Lu Yang.
"I will take these two to Captive Peak and then head to the Imperial City. You give Wu Ji's soul to Fifth Elder."
As Fairy Eternity watched Elder Sister's retreating figure, she snapped back to reality,
"Oh, I forgot about the contribution!"

chapters.title: Chapter 452 - 451: The Master of the Nine Nether Sect, Mu Baiyi_1
chapters.content:
The Eldest Senior Sister arrived at Captive Peak, and the child Grandmaster was stunned at seeing two souls at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
How much time has passed, and there are again two souls at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage?
Calculate the time, capture four Transcendance Tribulation Stage souls a year, and in a few years, he would not be able to suppress Captive Peak.
His strength was not weak, but he couldn't withstand the imprisonment of so many Transcendance Tribulation Stage souls, no one could suppress it.
"It's actually three. One was refined into a Spirit Device by me. These three were all encountered by Junior Brother when he went out."
Child Grandmaster twitched, his disciple was more troublesome than Buyu.
This is just the Golden Core Stage, how can he cope in the future?
"I can't live in peace even after retirement." The child Grandmaster sighed, he retired early, leaving the burden to Daoist Buyu and the other nine, he was too tired.
There were quite a few outstanding talents in the Seek Dao Sect of that generation, and the nine most outstanding people were known as the Nine Sons of the Seek Dao Sect, considered as the hope of the sect.
Surprisingly, these nine people were all his disciples.
When he was the Sect Leader, he had to clean up the mess these guys made every day.
Thanks to him, he had got to know the high levels of the Cultivation World.
He cultivated hard to reach the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, just to teach these little bastards a lesson.
Otherwise, as a master, seeing these little bastards making troubles, he couldn't overcome them, wouldn't he be suffocated?
"I knew it from the beginning, I would have swapped with Junior Brother, he would come to Captive Peak, and I would be in Scripture Pavilion."
The child Grandmaster sighed while locked Wu Youdao and Venerable Thunder.
...
Lu Yang swaggered around the Seek Dao Sect with Wu Ji's soul in his hand, looking very provocative.
Luckily, he reached Hundred Refinement Peak without being beaten up.
He saw Li Haoran confronting Qin Yanyan.
Qin Yanyan's body turned into a puff of white smoke, ethereal and elusive. The smoke hid the talismans which could stealthily strike at Li Haoran.
Li Haoran was not a passive defender, he took off his wig and spun it wildly to scatter the white smoke.
The father and daughter were at a standstill.
"Pill of Mist and White Cloud?" Lu Yang recognized Qin Yanyan's Golden Core. It was a first-grade Golden Core.
This kind of Golden Core allowed cultivators to turn into mist, formless, excellent for both combat defenses and escape.
No wonder Li Haoran spent so much time cultivating with his ex-daughter.
"You have successfully formed the core, congratulations." Lu Yang laughed, and the father and daughter also noticed Lu Yang's arrival and stopped their magic duel.
"Senior Brother Lu, why are you here?" Li Haoran didn't know about Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou's trip to Wild State. He felt a bit uncomfortable as he hadn't seen the two for a month.
Being backfired by causality was not a glorious thing, Meng Jingzhou would naturally keep it a secret.
Seek Dao Sect disciples only knew that Qiu Jin'an ambushed the sect, but they were all unaware of the cause and effect.
"Oh, Old Meng and I went to Wild state and captured a soul at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. Eldest Senior Sister asked me to deliver it to Fifth Elder." Lu Yang casually lifted the chain in his hand, speaking as carelessly as if he had brought back some souvenirs for his neighbors after a trip.
Even father and daughter who were almost accustomed to Lu Yang's luck didn't know how they should react.
Was a Transcendance Tribulation Stage Soul something like cabbage that he could come across anytime, anywhere?
"Master is at the top of the mountain refining." Li Haoran pointed out the way for Lu Yang.
"Alright, I'll go and be back. There's also something I want to ask you about."
Li Haoran was confused.
Lu Yang arrived at the peak and saw the Fifth Elder staring pensively at a pot, his brow furrowed as he looked troubled.
"Fifth Elder, what are you doing?"
"Our Heaven's Court relies on the Automatic Skewer Formation and our cooperation with the Nine Nether Sect, right? I was wondering if we could refine a magic artifact that can automatically stir-fry vegetables."
"Have you succeeded?"
"Not quite successful. I've encountered many problems. For instance, this pot has too much attacking power. I really don't know what the problem is... forget it. What brought you here...
a Transcendance Tribulation Stage soul?!"
The Fifth Elder snapped out of his stupor and turned to the soul of the Wu Ji in Lu Yang's hands. His eyes lit up, more excited than seeing his wife. He rubbed his hands and grinned, his smile stretching from ear to ear.
"Eldest Senior Sister asked me to give it to you. She said it can be used as a Spirit Device."
"I knew it!" The Fifth Elder took the chain, treasuring it like a prized possession.
With the soul of a Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator, he had the confidence to refine a Transcendance Tribulation Stage magic artifact. It was a precious experience and this process would greatly help improve his refining skills.
The Fifth Elder tossed aside his automatic stir-frying pot. Given the opportunity to refine a Transcendance Tribulation Stage magic artifact, who would bother with an automatic stir-frying pot?
After saying goodbye to the Fifth Elder, who was already lost in his thoughts, Lu Yang went down the mountain and found Li Haoran, explaining his purpose.
"I encountered a person from the Nine Nether Sect in the Wild State. Do you recognize him?"
Lu Yang used his magic power to create the illusion of a man with a white paper hat.
"Mu Baiyi?"
"Is this man called Mu Baiyi?"
"Undoubtedly, it's Mu Baiyi. In Qin Haoran's memory, he's one of the top four vice-leaders of the Nine Nether Sect, and the youngest among them."
"Now he is the head of the Nine Nether Sect."
If Lu Yang was unsure about whether Mu Baiyi was the leader before, after the battle in Hanshui City, judging from the power that Mu Baiyi demonstrated, he definitely was the head of the sect.
"He became the head of the sect?"
Li Haoran was slightly surprised. Comparing the qualifications and cultivation level, Mu Baiyi wasn't exceptional. Shi Huagu had a higher chance of becoming the head of the sect than Mu Baiyi.
"He must have made some promises, like building Fengdu or something." Li Haoran speculated. Mu Baiyi had no advantage in all aspects. The only possibility was that he promised to build Fengdu after becoming the head, so the neutral faction would lean toward him.
"That's not right either. The Nine Nether Sect is so poor, and Qin Haoran is constantly chased by creditors. Where would they get the money to build Fengdu?"
Li Haoran was utterly baffled.
"Mu Baiyi excels at the Art of Transformation and Clone technique. He can change into any man or woman, old or young. Mu Baiyi said that when he was young and studying in the sect, his fellow brothers didn't like to go to the lecture hall. They preferred to cultivate on their own.
But since the lecture hall elder often makes check-calls, his brothers would ask Mu Baiyi to holler for them which earned him spirit stones."
"Mu Baiyi agreed to it because he came from a poor background and lacked spirit stones."
"Mu Baiyi took his tasks seriously, so he wouldn't be discovered, he learnt the Arts of Transformation and Clone. He used these two magic skills when he hollered for his brothers."
"Then why didn't he continue studying in the sect and instead joined the Nine Nether sect?" Lu Yang was curious, "Was he discovered doing proxy check-calls and got expelled from the sect?"
Who would leave a sect to join a demonic one?
"That's not the case, the sect was dissolved later."
"Dissolved?" Lu Yang was even more puzzled. Why would they just dissolve the sect out of the blue?
"The sect was unique. There were plenty of disciples attending the lecture hall regularly, and the rate of check-calls was one hundred percent. But the end-of-term evaluation was pitifully bad, except for Mu Baiyi who stood out."
"The sect felt that they couldn't teach effectively, which led to them not wanting to lead the disciples astray, which resulted in the sect dissolving."
Lu Yang: "..."

chapters.title: Chapter 453 - 453: 452 This Heaven's Court could very likely be the new demonic sect!_1
chapters.content:
Great Xia Imperial Palace.
Emperor Xia dismissed his eunuchs and palace maids for a meeting with the Five Great Immortal Sects.
In the vast palace, only six people remained, making the space feel empty.
"Fellow Daoist Yun, it's been a while."
"You flatter me."
"Fellow Daoist Qiu, I heard that you were involved in the whole affair at Hanshui City?"
"I was fortunate enough to survive."
After they all made their courteous exchanges, only the abbot of the Suspension Temple remained silent, busy practicing his Silent Zen.
Seeing that everyone had assembled, Emperor Xia laid out the topic for the day: "You all must be aware of the situation concerning Hanshui City. If it hadn't been for the unforeseen intervention of a certain individual, Great Yu likely would have secured the State Destiny."
Originally, Yun Zhi had intended to call for a meeting of the Righteous Path. However, upon hearing the news about Hanshui City, Emperor Xia preemptively summoned the five cultivators to the palace.
In the end, the result was the same.
Emperor Xia looked frustrated. Losing the State Destiny was a matter of immense concern. His ancestors likely would need to step in to recover it, which would disrupt all future plans.
"Old Qiu. You were at Hanshui City, so you saw it all. Describe what happened," commanded the Sect Leader of the Prison Suppressing Sect. A burly man, there were hints of tattoos on his neck, wrists, and ankles. These were indications that his body was inscribed with War Patterns - a sign of mastery in the art of War Pattern cultivation.
Qiu Jin'an had already addressed the aftermath at Hanshui City, and so had come to the palace to discuss it further.
"My presence in Hanshui City was purely accidental. I was cursed by an evildoer and needed the power of State Destiny to break it, so I traveled to the nearest place—Hanshui City—to seek assistance."
"At the time, Hanshui City was haunted by disasters, which were caused by a cultivator from Great Yu, although no one could tell at the time."
"Subsequently, Wu Youdao appeared and used the power of the Transcendance Tribulation stage to seal off the information about Hanshui City, creating havoc inside the city walls."
"Wu Youdao, you mean the sixth Emperor Yu?" A woman, the Palace Master Luo Hongxia from the Laurel Fairy Palace, interrupted Qiu Jin'an's recounting.
"Yes, he is the one. He has the look of an emperor, and utilized Dragon and Tiger Qi in combat. He was very difficult to deal with. Only by teaming up with Governor Lv, were we able to hold him off."
"While we were engaged in a stalemate, a man wearing a white paper hat appeared. His combat power was not much different from mine."
"On par with you?" The Sect Leader of Prison Suppressing Sect was slightly surprised. He knew Qiu Jin'an's strength and understood that anyone on par with Qiu Jin'an could not be a nobody.
"Even though the stranger did not reveal his identity, his style of combat resembled that of someone from the Nine Nether Sect. The only person in Nine Nether who could match me, could only be their Master!"
