"Afterwards, I investigated him and found he had been committing various offences throughout Wild State during the last few years. He used a Clone Technique to commit his crimes, hiding his true cultivation level, which led the government offices of Wild State to underestimate him."
"When the three of us were about to defeat Wu Youdao, Venerable Thunder appeared. To add to our despair, the Corpse Chasing Sect Leader had been possessed by Wu Ji, putting Hanshui City at risk from the threat of three powerful cultivators at the Transcendance Tribulation stage."
"Wu Ji even used the Corpse Chasing Sect Leader's identity and the Great Seal of Wild State to temporarily strip Governor Lv of his control over the State Destiny."
"Just as I was preparing to defy them at the risk of my own life, a mysterious female cultivator appeared. Her true form and strength were unknown, but she claimed herself to be the Supreme Celestial Master of Heaven's Court, Dou Tianzun, whom, with the power of the unclaimed State Destiny, was able to stand against the three of them and crush Wu Youdao's trio!"
"Regrettably, Wu Youdao's trio managed to escape."
Although he had already heard about the situation from Governor Lv, Emperor Xia was still astonished as he listened to Qiu Jin'an's recounting.
The woman who could overpower three opponents at once suggested that Dou Tianzun's real power level was far beyond that of Wu Youdao's trio. It had to be at least Semi-Immortal!
"What exactly is this Heaven's Court? Why have I never heard of such a power?" The Prison Suppressing Sect Leader asked the question everyone had on their minds.
All present racked their brains but could only recall an ancient text mentioning the "Heavenly Court". However, the account of the "Heavenly Court" is so varied that scholars have always had difficulty agreeing on its existence.
What was the relationship between the ancient Heavenly Court and Heaven's Court?
"I've never heard of it before either. But from the reactions of the Wu Youdao trio, it's safe to say they've never heard of it either."
"However, judging from the reaction of the Nine Nether sect's Master, who was next to me, it seems he knows about the existence of Heaven's Court."
"He was quite shocked when he saw Dou Tianzun, but more than that, he was overjoyed. He even told me that Dou Tianzun was an important figure who should not be mentioned by name, someone who could manipulate the stars as though they were mere beans."
"Manipulate the stars, so Dou Tianzun is a figure from antiquity?" Emperor Xia rapped on the table with his knuckles.
All those present were high-level figures in the world of cultivation; there were few secrets they weren't privy to. They all knew that the stars in the sky had disappeared, replaced by Yun Zhi's Golden Core.
Put simply, no one could manipulate the stars as they would with beans in the current world of cultivation. Dou Tianzun had to be a figure from antiquity.
After the cultivators of the Great Yu and Great Qian Dynasties have surfaced, even more ancient cultivators have begun to reveal themselves, and they're all powerful figures from antiquity.
However, it's not known which powerful figure from antiquity this could be. Even though the history of the ancient times is littered with gaps, it won't miss a cultivator of such caliber!
"More and more forces have been drawn into this grand struggle," mused the Sect Leader of the Prison Suppressing Sect.
Qiu Jin'an nodded, "That's exactly what I was thinking. I suspect there is some connection between this Heaven's Court and the ancient Heavenly Court. Although there are many versions of the ancient Heavenly Court, one thing is consistent across all of them - the Heavenly Court ruled in the ancient times!"
As a scholar well versed in ancient knowledge, he made a bold hypothesis and elaborated carefully, "Further extrapolation suggests that the aim of Heaven's Court may be to restore the rule of the ancient Heavenly Court. This explains why Dou Tianzun targeted Wu Youdao - their interests clashed."
Luo Hongxia continued with Qiu Jin'an's analysis, "The fact that the Nine Nether sect's Master and Dou Tianzun know each other implies some connection between the two sects!"
The Prison Suppressing Sect Leader picked up the thread analyzing Heaven's Court, "With a figure like Dou Tianzun, Heaven's Court must be incredibly powerful. Yet we know nothing about them, which suggests that they've been operating in the shadows. Until now, they finally made their appearance and proclaimed their existence to the world with overwhelming power!"
The abbot of the Suspension Temple also wished to speak, but his practice of Silent Zen rendered him speechless. So, Emperor Xia articulated the conclusion for him:
"It's highly likely that Heaven's Court represents a new demonic sect. After the Eternity Sect fell, there were only three of the Four Great Devil Sects remaining. If we now add Heaven's Court, we still have Four Great Devil Sects!"
Everyone nodded in agreement, acknowledging Emperor Xia's conclusion.
At this moment, Qiu Jin'an turned his attention to Yun Zhi, who had not spoken throughout the discussion. He asked, "Fellow Daoist Yun, you are the highest-level cultivator among us, and your knowledge is vast. What are your thoughts on Heaven's Court?"
Yun Zhi swept her gaze over everyone and calmly announced, "I am the Master of Heaven's Court."
"!!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 454 - 453: The members of Heaven's Court are all of the Righteous Path, how could they be of the demonic sect?_1
chapters.content:
"You are the Master of Heaven's Court?!" Qiu Jin'an jumped to his feet, eyes widening in disbelief, his voice raising by several octaves.
Others had a similar reaction, even the host of Suspension Temple seemed unsettled, fearing that a smirk at the corner of Yun Zhi's mouth meant treachery. They were afraid she would say something like "This concerns the million-year plan of Heaven's Court, there could be no mistakes," while eliminating all five of them.
A ripple of confusion spread across Yun Zhi's calm eyes.
You asked my opinion about Heaven's Court, and I offered my honesty, why the excessive reactions?
Seeing their strong reactions, Yun Zhi felt the need to explain: "Friends, don't be alarmed, Heaven's Court is an internal organization of the Seek Dao Sect, it is safe and trustworthy. It was suggested by my junior brother Lu Yang, the intent was to infiltrate the Nine Nether Sect."
"Lu Yang?"" Qiu Jin'an and Luo Hongxia were aware of who Lu Yang was, but Emperor Xia, the host of Suspension Temple, and the Sect Leader of Prison Suppressing Sect were unfamiliar with the name.
Lu Yang was undeniably gifted, even when facing cultivators who had previously disbanded their cultivation and started over, he remained calm and victorious. But due to his low cultivation level, he wasn't in the radar of these eminent personalities.
Of course, if he stood out as an ancient history scholar, he would certainly be famous.
Although Lu Yang was credited with the feat of obliterating the Eternity Sect, no one believed that a mere Foundation Establishment Stage cultivator like him had any role in it, seeing as Yun Zhi had also taken part in the battle.
"Lu Yang is the latest disciple of my master, my junior brother. He is extremely talented in magic skills and cultivation, he played a crucial role in the elimination of the Eternity Sect."
Everyone was surprised. For Yun Zhi to praise his magic skills and using an extreme compliment, how terrifying must Lu Yang's talent in magic skills be?
What did Fellow Daoist Yun say? She said Lu Yang played an extraordinary role in the elimination of the Eternity Sect. Could it mean that Lu Yang was indeed the key factor leading to the Eternity Sect's destruction?
What was Lu Yang's cultivation level then, and how did he manage to do that?
Qiu Jin'an also confirmed Lu Yang's talent, saying, "I have met Lu Yang before, he is indeed a rare genius, and his domestic ideas are out of the ordinary. He has once defeated a Great Yu Unification stage cultivator who had started over after disbanding cultivation in a same-realm battle."
"Defeat a Great Yu Unification stage cultivator who started over after disbanding cultivation?!" Luo Hongxia covered her mouth in surprise. They all showed exceptional talent when they were young, but achieving this would still be challenging.
"That's not all, during the exchange between the Five Elements Sect and the Seek Dao Sect, it was mentioned that Lu Yang is exceptionally powerful. With a cultivation level at the Foundation Establishment Stage, he fought above his level and managed to defeat cultivators of the Golden Core, Nascent Soul, and Spirit Transformation phases!" Qiu Jin'an declared excitingly.
This news was even more shocking than defeating a cultivator who started over after disbanding cultivation.
"Fellow Daoist Yun, is it true?"
Yun Zhi hesitated uncommonly before finally nodding, further increasing the astonishment among the crowd.
Yun Zhi felt the topic had been derailed and needed to be brought back: "I am the Master of Heaven's Court. There are nine Heavenly Kings as protectors, including the Grand Elder to the Eighth Elder, and our Master who is unaware of his inclusion in Heaven's Court."
"Additionally, there are Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, Tao Yaoye, Man Gu, and Li Haoran, the five new disciples of the Seek Dao Sect."
Avoiding any mention of Fairy Eternity, Yun Zhi continued: "You have some misunderstanding about Heaven's Court. As the Seek Dao Sect follows the Righteous Path, all members of Heaven's Court, all of whom are part of the upper echelons and seeds from the Seek Dao Sect, can't possibly be from demonic sects, can they?"
Said in Yun Zhi's most reasonable tone, since all Heaven's Court members are Righteous Path cultivators, Heaven's Court naturally belongs to the Righteous Path powers as well.
The five's eyes twitched. They were cornered due to their status and generation and not in a place to contradict Yun Zhi.
"And this Dou Celestial Being..."
Qiu Jin'an stopped mid-sentence, recalling what the Master of the Nine Nether Sect had said: Dou Celestial Being controls the stars like beans.
The celestial stars are Yun Zhi's golden cores, in that case, Yun Zhi would naturally be able to manipulate the stars!
Furthermore, the battle achievement of being invincible in the same realm and fighting three alone, Yun Zhi could totally pull it off by using the power of the State Destiny!
And Lu Yang was Yun Zhi's junior brother, and Yun Zhi protected him whenever he left the sect.
Everything lines up! It all lines up!
Everyone present was quick-witted and it didn't take them long to realize, Dou Celestial Being was Yun Zhi.
Although Yun Zhi did not provide a direct answer, they tacitly understood, and it did not matter that she didn't confirm it.
"Heaven's Court has already gained the trust of Nine Nether Sect, so I request everyone to refrain from acting against Nine Nether Sect for the time being, lest we spook them."
"Very well," came the smiling agreement from the others. Now that they knew Heaven's Court comprised their own people, the situation had become much easier to handle.
"Heaven's Court and the Nine Nether Sect have reached preliminary co-operation, with Heaven's Court providing technology and the Nine Nether Sect providing manpower and resources. Together, we have started a barbecue restaurant and it is just beginning to take off. The more followers at the barbecue restaurant, the less likely the Nine Nether Sect will do evil.
Therefore, I hope the imperial court can develop some favorable policies for the catering industry to covertly assist the barbecue shop's development."
Emperor Xia pondered. Boosting the catering industry would encourage tax payments and benefit the people, it was a good move.
"This can be done."
"That's good, there's one more thing. I obtained some intelligence from Wu Youdao and his companions while they were in the Seek Dao Sect."
Everyone had an understanding look; of course, Yun Zhi was in Hanshui City, how could she let Wu Youdao and his companions slip away?
Yun Zhi reiterated the intelligence given by Wu Youdao, and everyone turned solemn.
"As I suspected, Great Yu has dared to scheme for the State Destiny. They must have an Immortal's strength." Upon hearing about the realms of the two Imperial Teachers, Emperor Xia was not surprised. He merely snorted coldly.
Great Yu's target was to replace Great Xia. Knowing the State Destiny was created by an Immortal and still daring to have such ambitions proved that Great Yu also had an Immortal!
"Great Yu's next target is Ji State, which is in Central Plain, populated with many cities. It may be challenging for the imperial court forces to conduct a thorough search. Therefore, I request the Immortal Sects to lend a hand."
To discover traces of Great Yu, at least Unification stage cultivators were needed. The imperial court had quite a number of Unification stage cultivators, but could not allocate all of them to Ji State as other areas also required Unification stage cultivators to guard.
Moreover, the overall quality of the Immortal Sects' Unification stage was better than the imperial court. If they encountered Great Yu's cultivators, they would have ample time to react and send a message.
"Considering the stability of Great Xia, the Five Elements Sect won't just sit by and do nothing."
"The same goes for the Prison Suppressing Sect."
Apart from the host of Suspension Temple, the immortals all expressed their support in succession.
The host of Suspension Temple could only nod continuously, signalling that they had the same stance.
He was somewhat troubled, the Silent Zen was indeed hard to practice, he had the urge to speak several times but managed to resist.
It was easier dealing with Daoist Buyu, all he needed to do was act, without speaking a word.

chapters.title: Chapter 455 - 454: Emperor Xia's Lifespan_1
chapters.content:
The Emperor Xia felt quite satisfied that the issues in Ji State received support from the Five Great Immortal Sects.
Then, he mentioned another matter: "You all must have heard that the Corpse Chasing Sect Leader was initially planned to be possessed. However, the Corpse Chasing Sect Leader's Soul Lamp was placed in the Seek Dao Sect. Out of fear of being detected by the Seek Dao Sect, the cultivators from the Great Yu did not complete the possession and spared his soul."
"Indeed, when I was dealing with the aftermath in Hanshui City, that bastard Lu Baqian was lucky enough to survive the catastrophe. Relying on his Transcendance Tribulation stage body, he would show off in front of me all the time. Very indecent indeed!" Qiu Jin'an huffed coldly.
Emperor Xia acted as if he didn't hear what Qiu Jin'an said: "Then can we learn from this experience and place the soul lamps of other sects in the Five Great Immortal Sects and the government office as a form of protection?"
"As Fellow Daoist Yun just mentioned, at least there are still four cultivators of the Transcendance Tribulation stage in Great Yu. When a unification stage takes possession of another one in the unification stage, a battle will certainly occur. While we would be able to sense this, it would be too easy for a Transcendance Tribulation stage to take possession of a Unification stage.
They could succeed in an instant without making a sound."
"If incidents like the ones involving Master Ru occur again, having the soul lamp system could deter the cultivators of the Great Yu from acting recklessly and preserve some soul remnants of the possessed."
"This plan is feasible." Yun Zhi nodded, being the first to agree with the Emperor Xia's proposal.
She had thought of a similar method on her way here and planned to bring it up during the meeting, but the Emperor Xia beat her to it.
"I think it's also fine."
"The Prison Suppressing Sect finds it feasible."
The head of the Suspension Temple did not say anything, which was an implicit agreement.
Seeing that everyone had arrived at a consensus, Emperor Xia continued: "After the meeting, I will order someone to prepare a list and give it to all of you, and notify the sects named on the list."
The sects of the Great Xia operate under a registration system. As long as you report to the government office with the basic information about the sect like the number of people, scale, address, and the Sect Leader, etc, the registration would be deemed successful without any need for review or approval.
If there are future changes such as the Sect Leader, they would still need to report to the government office.
With the existence of this system, the Great Xia has a clear understanding of the number and location of sects, and the officials could quickly prepare the list according to the Emperor Xia's orders.
After discussing the important matters, the five people walked out of the grand hall with laughter and smiles. The atmosphere was harmonious as they were escorted out by the head of the Suspension Temple.
The eunuchs and court ladies were all standing respectfully outside the grand hall, prepared to bid farewell to the heads of the Five Immortal Sects.
"Cough, cough-" Emperor Xia, who was discussing Daoist Buyu with Qiu Jin'an, suddenly started coughing. He covered his mouth and nose with his hand, imprinting a few spots of blood in his palm. A strand of white hair appeared on his forehead, which was especially striking among his dense black hair.
"Your Majesty!" The Chief Eunuch, seeing this, was so scared that he almost lost his soul. He quickly stepped forward to support Emperor Xia in three stepping movements.
"Summon the Imperial physician, quickly summon the Imperial Physician!" The other eunuchs and court ladies were in a flurry of actions, apparently frightened.
"What happened to you?" Qiu Jin'an frowned, holding onto Emperor Xia's wrist, his facial expression changing slightly.
"Why is your body so weak!"
Logically, this should not have happened. The governor has the protection of state destiny, immunity to toxins, and immunity to diseases. As the Emperor of Great Xia, who has supreme control over the State Destiny, his body should not have any problems at all.
The Emperor Xia waved his hand with a bitter smile, unwilling to discuss more. The head of the Suspension Temple muttered a prayer silently in his heart, not speaking a word.
Yun Zhi, who was the highest in cultivation level, immediately saw the situation of the Emperor Xia: "His lifespan is dried up."
"Lifespan dried up?" Luo Hongxia was taken aback, not expecting this sudden problem of lifespan depletion to occur with the Emperor Xia.
The Emperor Xia looked up at Yun Zhi, equally surprised. He was always protected by the power of the State's Destiny, no one should have been able to discern his condition. He never expected that Yun Zhi would immediately identify the problem.
Knowing that the matter couldn't be concealed, he had no choice but to admit: "After all, I am only at the Divinity Transformation stage."
Among the six of them, Yun Zhi was the highest in cultivation level, while the Emperor Xia was the lowest.
Whether one becomes an emperor or not has no direct correlation with one's cultivation level. After all, even if the emperor's cultivation level is higher, he cannot suppress the whole world all by himself.
"But that's not right either. You're only a thousand years old. Those at the Divinity Transformation stage can live between one thousand five hundred to two thousand years." The Prison Suppressing Sect Leader frowned in confusion.
With the present day Great Xia facing internal and external threats, if Emperor Xia's health were to fail, especially due to lifespan issues, it would certainly lead to political instability. All sorts of demons and monsters would appear, and this would not be a good thing.
"When I was the crown prince, I suffered a serious illness, and my life hung by a thread. In order to cure the illness, I took many precious medicinal materials, including two strains of Medicinal King's root and leaves. It's unfortunate that my body was weak and could not absorb the nutrients at that time. Even though my life was saved, it took a toll on my lifespan."
Everyone had heard about this matter, and the eunuchs and court ladies who had worked in the palace for years were aware of it.
"Our sect has a few Minor Medicinal Kings which are great for extending lifespan, such as the Longevity Big Cudrania and the Eternal Stone." Qiu Jin'an said. Emperor Xia absolutely cannot have problems at this time.
The Longevity Big Cudrania, with eight thousand years as its spring and eight thousand years as its autumn, is a rare and exceptional herb for extending lifespan.
The Eternal Stone is a type of stone that grows every year, albeit very slowly and barely noticeable to the naked eye. After ten thousand years, it grows only one circle larger. By scraping off some stone dust, it can become a treasure for extending life, even tempting for those in the unification stage.
Emperor Xia, hearing what Qiu Jin'an said, had sparkles in his eyes, which immediately dimmed. He gently shook his head, saying: "It's useless. I have eaten too much of these heavenly and earth treasures in the past. The Imperial Physician said that my body has developed drug resistance, and none of the Minor Medicinal Kings can help."
Lifespan issues are fatal, and even the power of state destiny is difficult to compensate for. Unless one can ascend to immortality, with endless lifespan, only then is there a solution.
"How long can you live?"
"About ten years." He knows his own body the best.
Everyone was silent. For cultivators, ten years passes in the blink of an eye, it is indeed too short.
Is it possible that Emperor Xia will close his eyes just as he sees the curtain of the Great Era being lifted?
Since his ascension to the throne, Emperor Xia has been conscientious and industrious for the sake of the country and the people. The national strength of Great Xia has been increasing day by day, the power of the state destiny is becoming more substantial. He is an uncommonly wise and enlightened monarch who can rank in the top three in the history of Great Xia.
Could it be that the heavens are jealous of such talent, and want him to die at this critical time, before he can even see the true Great Era?
This isn't fair.
But even if it's not fair, what can anyone do about it?
Prison Suppressing Sect leader couldn't help but say: "There is still a lot of time. I'll return and discuss it with the other elders. The world is so vast, there certainly are other solutions."
He simply didn't believe it. Isn't it possible to extend Emperor Xia's lifespan by a few decades or a hundred years?
The five leaders of the Immortal Sects leave the Imperial City and fly back to their respective sects to find a solution, each of them sighing silently in their hearts..
"Speaking of which, the crown prince hasn't been established yet, right? It's going to be a bloody battle."
"Great Yu, Great Qian, the Demon Territory, the East Sea, internal issues, and external problems, and now his lifespan is exhausted. It truly is a troubled autumn."
After everyone leaves, Emperor Xia rejects the offer of help and goes to the ancestral land of the palace, hoping that the ancestors will have a solution.

chapters.title: Chapter 456 - 455: The Fourth Master of the Immortal Lineage_1
chapters.content:
Seek Dao Sect, Hundred Refinement Peak.
Li Haoran was still reminiscing about his past life with Mu Baiyi.
As the new generation's deputy sect leader, Mu Baiyi was young and vigorous, and Qin Haoran greatly valued him.
"Mu Baiyi is a poor child. He came from a poor family, and after he became a cultivator and joined a sect, he initially wanted to earn money. However, he didn't earn much, and his sect closed down first."
"Later, he saw that the Nine Nether Sect provided good monthly supplies, so he joined it."
"According to him, he originally wanted to join the Eternity Sect, given that the benefits for Eternity Sect followers were triple that of local officials."
"Then why didn't he join?" Qin Yanyan interjected.
"He couldn't find the entrance to the Eternity Sect because it's too concealed. The Nine Nether Sect was much easier to find; if you find an ordinary ghost, there's a one-in-ten chance it belongs to the Nine Nether Sect, and through them, you can find the Nine Nether Sect."
"Of course, that was a while ago. Later, Qin Haoran realized that this method was too risky and it was easy to get caught by the Righteous Path, so he imitated the Eternity Sect style, making the Nine Nether Sect also somewhat difficult to find."
"Qin Haoran and Mu Baiyi had a fairly good relationship, he helped Qin Haoran a lot during the time at Nine Nether Sect."
"Once, Qin Haoran heard that running a bank could make a lot of money, so he wanted to establish one. But he was afraid that no one would deposit money and he'd be laughed at, so he had Mu Baiyi disguise himself and deposit money on the opening day."
"It's just running a ploy, a common business strategy." Thanks to Qin Haoran's memories, Li Haoran now had an extensive understanding of underhanded business strategies.
"So, did the bank become established?"
"No, Qin Haoran forgot to apply for government approval before opening the bank, so both he and Mu Baiyi were arrested for illegally raising funds from the public."
"We explained that no one deposited money, and that it was all a hoax staged by us."
"Did the government let you go?"
"No, the government officials said this constituted both illegal fund-raising and fraud, and intended to add both charges together."
Lu Yang: "..."
Qin Yanyan: "..."
"During the time they were in the large prison, they both made headway simultaneously, deeply studying all kinds of law. Finally, when their sentences were fully served, they returned home having become scholars." According to Li Haoran, he has not fully gotten Qin Haoran's memory, or else he would currently be a great scholar of the law.
"Fortunately, Qin Haoran was proactive and foresaw such a disaster. He arranged everything before going to prison and did not expose the church's deficit."
This shows that Qin Haoran is a man of outstanding foresight.
Li Haoran still wanted to continue talking about the glorious history of the Nine Nether Sect, when a cold figure appeared behind him.
"Eldest Senior Sister."
"Hello, Eldest Senior Sister." Qin Yanyan, as a member of Heaven's Court, was torn between calling Yun Zhi 'Sect Master' or 'Eldest Senior Sister'. After some mental struggle, she decided to follow the herd.
"Eldest Senior Sister, I was just confirming with Junior Brother Li. The person wearing the white hat in Hanshui City is the Sect Master of the Nine Nether Sect, called Mu Baiyi."
"Mu Baiyi, the Sect Master of Nine Nether Sect? Understood. You guys did well. Junior Brother, come with me and let's return."
Lu Yang obediently stood by his Eldest Senior Sister's side and followed her back to Sky Gate Mountain.
"Eldest Senior Sister, is there something you wish to discuss with me?"
"Not with you, but with Fairy senior."
"With me?" Upon hearing this, Fairy Eternity bounced up from the bed and cheerfully emerged from the Spiritual Space.
"Tell me, what do you need from me?" Fairy Eternity rarely had Yun Zhi seek her help. Feeling rejuvenated and lively, she appeared to be ten years younger.
She was now only six years old.
"Emperor Xia's lifespan has issues. He only has about ten years left. The Little Medicinal Kings have no solution for him, do you have any idea, Fairy senior?"
Lu Yang was startled by this news. Everyone in the outside world said that Emperor Xia was in the prime of his life, carrying out great plans, and Great Xia has a promising future. How could he suddenly be on the brink of death?
Fairy Eternity, full of excitement and readiness, blurt out: "When are we staging the revolt?"
She believed that the Seek Dao Sect was set to reach great heights and had the potential to compete for the world's throne. When the time was ripe, they would gather support from all over the world and they were bound to succeed!
Didn't Lu Yang tell the Nine Nether Sect to follow this strategy?!
With her and Yun Zhi, two absolute powerhouses, wouldn't they conquer the throne if they wanted to?
"...not a revolt, Fairy senior. Do you have a way to prolong the lifespan?"
Fairy Eternity's Dao Fruit feature was immortality; even if she died, chanting her title and name would bring her back to life. Even the Little Medicinal Kings envied this ability, let alone other cultivators.
In Yun Zhi's impression, Fairy Eternity was the most likely to solve Emperor Xia's problem.
"Give him the immature Eternity Dao Fruit, and let him become the fourth-in-command of the immortal line?"
Everything had an order, and the last to arrive naturally would be at the end.
The Immortal Line was strong and powerful. The first elder was the head of the Five Immortals of the Ancients, the second elder was the Jindan Ancestor, the third was the Semi-Immortal, and the fourth was the reigning emperor."
Lu Yang suddenly felt that his position as the second-in-command of the Immortal Line was of great importance.
"The imperial ancestral land would definitely not agree." Yun Zhi shook her head.
A seemingly well and good Emperor Xia turning into the fourth elder of the Immortal Line, Yun Zhi could imagine that after this matter became reality, the person at the imperial ancestral land might be so infuriated that they would want to compete against Fairy Eternity one-on-one."
Moreover, this would expose the existence of Fairy Eternity.
Yun Zhi wanted a method that everyone could see.
"If the Little Medicinal Kings are useless, then it's the Immortal Fruit... My Immortal Fruit can only maintain the preservation of the body. It's only useful after someone's death."
"Neither Qilin Immortal's nor Yingtian Immortal's Immortal Fruits have the ability to prolong life or increase lifespan."
"Right, does he have any children? Find water from the Mother-child River, it could leave him a descendant."
"He has nine sons and seven daughters."
"He's so fertile, is he breeding piglets?" muttered Fairy Eternity. Even after drinking the water of the Mother-child River and the Twin River, Emperor Xia was more fertile than she.
The Immortal Qilin and the Dragon and Phoenix species' geniuses had tried for many years, but had not given birth to a single Qilin yet.
The higher one's cultivation level, the harder it is to leave offspring."
"Right." Fairy Eternity suddenly shouted, remembering a clue, "There's a Spirit Root in the world, it's a peach tree, naturally nurtured by heaven and earth, and not a part of the natural treasures. The peaches it bears have the effect of prolonging life!"
"The five of us have eaten peaches from that tree. They were very tasty and juicy."
"Where is this Spirit Root?" This was the first time the Eldest Senior Sister had heard of such a Spirit Root, and there was no record of it in the ancient books either.
"I don't know, the peach tree grew legs, and after we picked its peaches, it ran away."
Eldest Senior Sister nodded. This was a clue, albeit a difficult one to follow. She instructed Lu Yang to continue his cultivation while she sought advice from other Elders."
After Eldest Senior Sister left, Lu Yang thought for a while, then turned towards the Scripture Pavilion."
"What are you going to do?"
"I vaguely remember seeing a magic skill related to longevity in the Scripture Pavilion. It was buried at the very bottom, so very few people should have learned it. Maybe it could be useful."

chapters.title: Chapter 457 - 456 "Eternity Technique"_1
chapters.content:
The Scripture Pavilion was where Lu Yang spent the most of his time, apart from the Sky Gate Mountain.
Most people's techniques and methods were passed down from their ancestors, but Lu Yang created his own.
To develop his technique, he resided in the Scripture Pavilion, studied various books, incorporated the strengths of various schools of thought, and finally wrote the shocking and unconventional technique — "Mind Seeing Method".
In the process of studying, he vaguely remembered a magic skill related to longevity.
At that time, he did not pay much attention, only glanced through it briefly.
He was then in the Golden Core Stage, full of energy, robust in Qi and Blood, so the issue of lifespan was still a long way off.
"Fairy, do you have a technique or method for longevity? As an Immortal, even if you do not practice it, you should know a few techniques and methods for longevity, right?"
Fairy Eternity made a sound of "um" in her throat, thinking seriously.
"I don't have any for longevity, but I do know some magic skills for boosting battle strength by burning lifespan. I used them several times before achieving immortality."
Lu Yang surmised that the situations in which Fairy Eternity had to resort to burning her lifespan must have been extremely critical. Seeing that she seemed indifferent about it, he chose not to pry further into what happened then.
"What about after becoming immortal?"
"After becoming immortal, there is no need, because, think about it, a Semi-Immortal definitely cannot win against an Immortal. The only rivals of an Immortal are other Immortals. And since Immortals have infinite lifespans, it makes no difference whether they burn their lifespan or not during a fight."
Upon reflection, Lu Yang found this to be true.
The primary measures in an Immortal's fight should be their Dao Fruits.
"Although burning lifespan is useless, self-destruction is quite powerful."
Fairy Eternity chuckled, stating that when an Immortal self-destructs, the power would be strong enough to sweep across an entire galaxy or even further, which indicated how terrifying it was.
And her Dao Fruit was most suitable for self-destruction.
If the Yingtian Immortals self-destructed once, that was it for them. But she was different. She could revive immediately after self-destruction and continue to self-destruct without even catching her breath. Unless someone yelled "stop," she would not desist.
Lu Yang looked at Fairy Eternity with a strange expression. This was the first time he had heard of consecutive self-destruction.
The Eternity Dao Fruit was indeed terrifying. If it were used in this way, who wouldn't be afraid?
Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity arrived at the Scripture Pavilion. The caretaker for the day was Senior Sister Zhou LuLu.
The scene where Senior Sister Zhou was reading with her long, black hair falling down, accentuating her beautiful face, was like a picturesque scene, giving off a sense of a peaceful time.
If Fairy Eternity could learn a bit of Zhou LuLu's demeanor, it would significantly enhance her standing in Lu Yang's heart.
"Senior Sister Zhou, long time no see," greeted Lu Yang with a smile. When he first joined the Seek Dao Sect, Zhou had helped him a lot.
When he first joined the sect, he was knocked out by the smell of elixirs used by a senior brother, and then Senior Sister gave him a hot-water bath and made him carry water and pinch tofu all day long to hone his techniques.
Compared to that, Zhou's advice on which books to read for a quick grasp of the basics, which books were essential for traveling outside, and that the weapons in the cafeteria were cheaper than those in the Task Hall seemed particularly precious.
Zhou LuLu, deeply engrossed in her book, was startled by Lu Yang's greeting. She instinctively used the book to cover half of her face, averting her gaze.
"Oh, it's Junior Brother Lu."
Watching Zhou, Lu Yang felt a bit helpless, fearing that his voice might frighten her.
Sister Zhou is the daughter of Fifth Elder Zhou Xin, whose cultivation level is at the Nascent Soul Stage, extraordinarily strong. During the exchange with the Five Elements Sect, she was the main force at the Nascent Soul Stage. The cultivators from Five Elements Sect were beaten miserably.
If he were to fight Zhou, he would be the one getting beaten. It's just that Zhou is too timid and afraid to speak.
Considering her personality, using the Invincible Elixir might not be ineffective in defeating Zhou.
Lu Yang noticed that Zhou was reading a book called "108 Hammer Techniques", which seemed incompatible with her image but perfectly suited her status.
"Are you here to study in the Scripture Pavilion?" Zhou mustered the courage to ask, looking for ways to assist him.
"I'm looking for a magic skill, something related to prolonging lifespan." Lu Yang did not elaborate further, aware that the issue of Emperor Xia's lifespan could have far-reaching implications and the fewer people knew about it, the better.
"A skill for extending lifespan ... let me think, is it the 'Evergreen Technique', which allows one to transform into a tree, root in the earth, and watch the world change?"
"Or is it the 'Turtle Longevity Method', which by imitating the behavior of turtles, extends one's lifespan?"
"Neither of those," Lu Yang found these unfamiliar and not matching the skill from his memory.
"Then I have no clue." Zhou LuLu shook her head lightly. She had also not read all the books in the Scripture Pavilion.
There were vast volumes of books in the Scripture Pavilion, and it was likely that only Elder Tao, who had retired, had read them all.
Lu Yang thanked Zhou before heading deeper into the Scripture Pavilion.
Zhou LuLu kept her eyes on Lu Yang's retreating back. Seeing that he didn't look back, she finally gained the courage to continue reading, quickly losing herself in her world.
Many senior brothers and sisters chose to study in the Scripture Pavilion, researching techniques and methods, and adapting them to better suit their styles.
However, some were stubborn and insisted on learning techniques unsuitable for them.
Lu Yang heard about a fellow brother who loved money and borrowed a book called "Alchemy" from the Scripture Pavilion years ago.
That fellow brother was a hard worker and studied diligently. He poked at stones every day, meditated, nourished his body and mind, learned principles of magic skills, sought advice widely, and never slacked off.
Eventually, after seasons rotated, due to his relentless efforts, he mastered 'One-Finger Zen'.
Once completed, one finger could break a mountain, shatter the earth, and if pointed at a person, would leave a bloody hole. It was terrifying and could be used as an ultimate card in battle.
No wonder that brother couldn't learn Alchemy. The principle of Alchemy involves the disassembly and reorganization of internal material structure. It is extremely difficult and not something ordinary people could master.
Even if they couldn't learn it, there were other ways. A senior sister once showed the feat of squeezing a stone into a diamond. There were no fluctuations of magic power; it was all due to her immense gripping strength. This was widely discussed with interest in the Seek Dao Sect.
Passing the studying senior brothers and sisters, Lu Yang went to a corner of the Scripture Pavilion as per his memory and began to search for a book.
The books were covered with a layer of dust, indicating that they hadn't been cleaned for a long time.
The Scripture Pavilion was too large, and there were too many books. Some books remained forgotten, which was normal.
For example, Lu Yang found the banned book "Dragon and Phoenix Changes" when he visited the Scripture Pavilion for the first time.
"I remember it was here."
"Found it!"
Lu Yang's eyes lit up as he pulled up a book from a crevice. The title of the book was simple and majestic.
"Eternity Technique."
"I knew I didn't remember it wrong." Lu Yang was somewhat excited. The Scripture Pavilion was indeed an excellent treasure trove, even containing the legendary skill.
"There's actually such a technique?" Fairy Eternity exclaimed with awe. This was indeed a valuable item.
Although she couldn't use it, Lu Yang would need it in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 458 - 457: How Many Sect Leader One Day Experience Coupons Can This Immortal Exchange For?_1
chapters.content:
Having earned the approval of Fairy Eternity verifies that this magic skill is genuinely valuable – a rare item indeed.
Lu Yang successfully borrowed "Eternity Technique", and returned to Sky Gate Mountain to study. He reached his usual training spot and started reading Eternity Technique, taking in each word and sentence with grave seriousness.
"The elder, continuous and unending. The living, ceaselessly reproducing..."
The Eternity Technique begins by defining the word "eternity" and warns those studying the skill that if it falls into the hands of deceitful cultivators, it could cause trouble and become a self-inflicted disaster.
Lu Yang thought about it. Seeing as he manages himself with integrity, he doesn't consider himself a deceitful cultivator, so he begins to learn the skill with enthusiasm and confidence.
Lu Yang took two breaths, exhaled twice, relaxed his mind, and easily slipped into a meditative state, giving his unabated attention to learning the skill.
Perhaps Lu Yang truly possesses a natural talent in learning magic skills, or perhaps this skill is easy to learn. Either way, as Lu Yang learned while reading, he surprisingly grasped the basics very quickly.
"It's so easy to cultivate?" Lu Yang wondered, realizing he must indeed have a deep connection with eternity.
"But how do I demonstrate that I have mastered it?" Lu Yang found himself in a quandary. He can't wait for his theoretically assigned lifespan to see if he's near death by then.
The cost of this proof seemed simply too high.
"Never mind, let's just try it out first. Perhaps there will be other sensations."
Lu Yang decided to act on this thought and silently started practicing Eternity Technique. Soon, he felt an itch on his scalp.
A spot Lu Yang couldn't see was causing his hair to grow at a rapid pace.
Lu Yang subconsciously touched his head and exclaimed, "My hair has grown so long!"
Why would Eternity Technique affect the hair?
"In Buddhism, the hair is referred to as 'Three Thousand Strands of Worry'. Could it be that the writer of the magic formula is trying to tell me that eternal life is lonely and ultimately filled with worry? Loneliness accompanies the seeker of eternity throughout life. Is it possible that eternal life is a curse, thus implying not to seek it?"
Lu Yang's thought process was clear. He tried to speculate on the probable intention of the writer of the magic skill, resulting in him gaining profound insight.
Fairy Eternity couldn't resist giving a hint: "Why not look at the last page of the book, on the backside?"
"What do you mean? There's writing on the back?"
Lu Yang flipped to the back of the last page as Fairy Eternity suggested.
He found the last page displaying a message: This magic skill causes extraordinary hair growth. It's specifically designed to combat baldness, and it should never be used on Buddhists as it can provoke havoc.
Lu Yang: "...."
"'Hair growth' and you wrote 'Eternity', what's the deal with that?"
Is this some kind of abbreviation?
Who wrote this magic skill?
Lu Yang angrily closed the book and saw the author's name on the cover: Tang Shengyi.
Tang Shengyi, the master of the nine disciples of the Seek Dao Sect, and Lu Yang's grandmaster, who is currently retired.
Lu Yang calmed down, his anger subsiding significantly, "Grandmaster, is this how you name things... wait, Fairy, did you already know about this skill?"
"Yes, while you were reading in the Scripture Pavilion, I was too. I used my immortal perceptions to read, and I've read this book."
"Then why did you say this magic skill was suitable for me, and that I would need it in the future?"
"Isn't your Eternity Technique very compatible with your Arhat Fist?"
Lu Yang: "...."
So Fairy's brain only works at times like this, huh?
Alright then, may Emperor Xia have good fortune. I've done my best.
Just as Lu Yang was preparing to bicker with Fairy Eternity, the Eldest Senior Sister returned to Sky Gate Mountain from her visit with the Elders.
The Eldest Senior Sister looked at Lu Yang with a hint of confusion. She didn't recall Lu Yang's hair being so long when she left?
After seeing the Eternity Technique in Lu Yang's hand, Eldest Senior Sister understood.
"Eldest Senior Sister, have you found a way to extend Emperor Xia's lifespan?"
The Eldest Senior Sister shook her head, "Only the clues from Fairy Eternity about the Spirit Root seem plausible. The Elders' methods are a bit..."
Without even hearing her finish, in light of his firm impression of the Elders, Lu Yang could roughly imagine their suggestions.
Possibly even proposing something like "Transform Emperor Xia into a living corpse and pretend he's still alive".
"Miss Yun, surely you remember that I just did you a favor and secured three Transcendence Tribulation Stage souls!" Fairy Eternity suddenly recalled something as she saw the Eldest Senior Sister and crawled out from inside Lu Yang.
"Of course, the souls Fairy Eternity caught are very valuable."
"In that case, shouldn't you give me some contribution points?"
"You should."
"Then, how many 'One-day Sect Leader Experience Coupons' can I exchange with my contribution points?" Fairy Eternity didn't bother to hide her intent.
Lu Yang looked at Fairy Eternity in shock. Is it too late to get a new golden hand now?
The Eldest Senior Sister quickly calculated, "Approximately enough for two months as Sect Leader."
"That much?" Fairy Eternity grinned from ear to ear. Last time, she got to be the Sect Leader for just three days and it wasn't enough. Now she could be Sect Leader for two months. Now that should be fun!
"I want to be the Sect Leader for two months!" Fairy Eternity, fearing the Eldest Senior Sister would change her mind, made a hurried decision.
Lu Yang hurriedly interrupted, "Eldest Senior Sister, this cannot be allowed. Fairy Eternity has always used my body to interact with others. Last time when I was the acting Sect Leader for three days, I found my master who had been missing for ten years, which counted as a major achievement. But what about this time?
I can't possibly claim to have found my master who had been missing for ten years twenty times, right?"
The Eldest Senior Sister frivolously replied, "No problem at all. We can simply say that Master was impressed with your successful stint as Acting Sect Leader last time and wants to nurture you by letting you serve as Acting Sect Leader for another two months."
As a Sect Leader, Daoist Buyu can appoint anyone as Acting Sect Leader whenever he wishes.
As a disciple, Yun Zhi can manipulate her Master's words as she pleases.
"Any more questions? If not, I shall become the Sect Leader!" Fairy Eternity was overjoyed, looking as happy as if it were the New Year.
"Coincidentally, the Sect will hold a celebration for its 120,000th anniversary two months from now. Fairy Eternity, you can carefully plan during these two months and show the world the elegance of an ancient Immortal at the celebration." The Eldest Senior Sister revealed a faint smile, which quickly faded.
"A Sect celebration?" Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity looked at each other, both full of doubt.
Following the Eldest Senior Sister's simple explanation, they finally understood. Everyone says the Seek Dao Sect has a history of 120,000 years, but strictly speaking, the Seek Dao Sect was still two months shy of its 120,000-year anniversary.
The founding of the Seek Dao Sect happened on the sixth day of November.
The day Daoist Xiantian, the founder of the Sect, got lost.
The Sect's celebration attracted visits from various powers and was a grand event.
Fairy Eternity was obviously showing signs of regret at having to organize the celebration.
"I guess the work of the celebration should be better off left to your people from the Seek Dao Sect. I'd rather not participate."
The Eldest Senior Sister looked at Fairy Eternity with a slightly surprised expression, "Fairy Eternity, as a guest official of this Sect, how can you count as not being one of us? If you're not a guest official, you won't have any contribution points."
"Hmm~~"
Fairy Eternity pursed her lips and found herself caught in a dilemma, trying to make a decision.
"Or are you suggesting that Fairy Eternity feels that there are too many details involved with the celebration and it's too difficult to handle, so is considering quitting?"
"Absolutely not, it's just a matter of organising a celebration. I shall be the Acting Sect Leader for two months!" A surge of fighting spirit ignited behind the fiery eyes of Fairy Eternity.
"Then we appreciate Fairy Eternity's efforts."
"No problem!"

chapters.title: Chapter 459 - 458 Fairy Inspects Seek Dao Sect_1
chapters.content:
While mortals attach great importance to their birthdays each year, cultivators differ; they have hundreds, even thousands of years, and some cultivators often cultivate in seclusion. If they had to celebrate their birthdays annually, they would be driven to distraction.
The custom among cultivators is to celebrate slightly every ten years and grandly every hundred years.
The same is true for their sects.
The 120,000th anniversary of the establishment of the Seek Dao Sect is a day that deserves grand celebrations.
There are few powers in the Central Continent that have outlasted the Seek Dao Sect, and of the Five Great Immortal Sects, the Seek Dao Sect was the first to be founded.
Major forces will surely come to congratulate, such as the imperial court, the other Four Great Immortal Sects, and the supreme class sects. Even attendance from a First Class Sect might be uncertain.
Being able to congratulate the Seek Dao Sect could be said to be a form of social capital.
One can imagine how lively the Seek Dao Sect will be in two months.
Thinking about what would happen in two months, Lu Yang felt an unpleasant crawling sensation on his scalp.
He's only at the Golden Core stage, why should he handle such matters? Isn't this a little too early?
"What you have to do, it's clearly this fairy who will act as the Sect Leader!" Fairy Eternity corrected Lu Yang's viewpoint.
As a new official taking office, her first task landed on Lu Yang.
"Come, give this fairy your body."
Being ordered by the Sect Leader was inescapable, so Lu Yang obediently handed over his body.
Fairy Eternity occupied Lu Yang's body, stretched lazily, and a smile spread across her face.
"Hehe, indeed, having a body and not having a body gives two different feelings."
Fairy Eternity turned her gaze to Yun Zhi, sparking her second task: "And you, Miss Yun, spread the news that I am the Acting Sect Master throughout the Seek Dao Sect."
"Yes." Yun Zhi's attitude toward the Acting Sect Master was even better than her attitude toward the Sect Leader. Whatever Fairy Eternity asked her to do, she did.
...
With the promotion from the Eldest Senior Sister, the news that Lu Yang had once again become the Acting Sect Master quickly spread throughout the Seek Dao Sect.
"What? Lu Yang has become the Acting Sect Leader again, what did he do this time!"
"Was it the Sect Leader who made Lu Yang the Acting Sect Leader?"
"Hasn't the Sect Leader always made the Eldest Senior Sister the Acting Sect Leader, why did it change to Lu Yang this time?"
Upon hearing this news, the conspiracy theorist grew silent for a while before mysteriously whispering to other people: "According to my analysis, this change in the Acting Sect Leader might involve a power struggle among the higher echelons!"
Upon hearing this, others were taken aback. They were all astute individuals, they understood immediately: "Are you suggesting that the Sect Leader thinks that the Eldest Senior Sister has held onto the power for too long, and wants Lu Yang to replace the Eldest Senior Sister, which might cause a fight between the Senior Sister and Junior Brother for power?"
"No, what I was suggesting is that the Eldest Senior Sister wanted
to rest and let the Sect Leader take over, but the Sect Leader refused and named Lu Yang to replace him."
"..."
"It seems this analysis does have some truth."
...
Fairy Eternity, in Lu Yang's body, took a slow walk around the sect. The radiant smile on her face made Lu Yang look several years younger.
"Greetings to the Sect Leader."
"Greetings to the Sect Leader."
Lu Yang's Senior Brothers and Senior Sisters, no, now Lu Yang saw all of them as disciples of the Seek Dao Sect, earnestly greeting him.
"All is well." Fairy Eternity nodded and raised her hand slightly, indicating that everyone didn't have to be so enthusiastic. She had only just taken office for an hour, and there were still two months to go.
She ambled on to the sparring platform where the disciples frequently practiced. On the platform, two Spirit Transformation Stage disciples were fighting fiercely - one with thunder rolling and the other with space shifting. Between their clash, all sorts of magic skills dazzled the eyes.
The disciples around were wary of Lu Yang, afraid that he would wield his Verbal Spell and challenge higher ranked cultivators again.
Lu Yang was also wary of himself.
Fairy Eternity stood beside the platform, with her hands behind her back, silently watching the two fight, showing no intention of entering the ring.
Now, with her help, Lu Yang has already formed the Invincible Elixir, there was no need to climb into the ring and fight against higher-ranked cultivators to cultivate his invincible momentum.
Why would there be a need to fight on the platform? Isn't it just the two on it pretending to not know that he is the Acting Sect Leader, beating him up fiercely?
This was a warning from the Invincible Elixir, and it was very effective.
Fairy Eternity adhered to the advice of the Invincible Elixir, silently standing under the platform, suppressing her itching heart, and not daring to take the stage.
"Their sparring is mediocre." She commented indifferently, unconcerned and displaying the deportment of a Great Power.
Fairy Eternity didn't come down the mountain specifically to do anything, she was mostly flaunting her status.
She then walked leisurely over to the 'Get It Again' Barbecue Shop on the business street, where Immortal Eternity and Eternity Sect leaders were all present.
All members of Immortal Eternity had arrived, as well as all high-level officials of the Eternity Sect, forming an impressive assembly.
The Eternity Sect's high-level officials were quite animated. Indeed, there was a great future in mingling with Lu Yang. A few days ago, Lu Yang was just a junior disciple, but now he had already become the Acting Sect Leader.
Masters Liu and Gao had weird expressions on their faces, bringing back old memories. The last time Lu Yang became the Acting Sect Leader, he had tricked them into working here as barbecue masters.
And now, four months had already passed by in a blink.
"Is the business here doing well?"
"Thanks to the leader's good fortune, business has been flourishing." No one else could perceive the difference in Lu Yang, but as Immortal Eternity, the third leader of Immortality, and as the owner of the Eternity Dao Fruit embryonic form, how could he not know that his body was now controlled by Fairy Eternity?
"Work hard, the barbecue shop is the front face of my Immortality, and you must not tarnish its reputation!" Fairy Eternity instructed.
"Yes!" When they were affirmed by the leader, everyone was greatly encouraged.
"Mmm, your attitude is good. The Nine Nether Sect is now expanding its market and opening shops everywhere, and Miss Yun, according to my instructions, went to negotiate with Emperor Xia, who promised to strongly support our shop opening."
Since she had become the Acting Sect Leader, it was only normal for the previous Acting Sect Leader to pass on the meeting contents to the current Acting Sect Leader.
"There is such a good opportunity!" The Eternity Sect leaders were moved. They originally thought that the Acting Sect Leader was just a nominal position, but unexpectedly, it was full of actual power, being able to command the Eldest Senior Sister with a single word, and even getting Emperor Xia to personally assist.
With the help of the court, the 'Get It Again' Barbecue Shop would surely blossom all over the continent, becoming the leader in the barbecue industry.
"Who among you knows how to paint? You can paint the scene of my arrival here and hang it at the entrance."
Fairy Eternity heard that the emperor's inscription was extremely valuable among the people. Any shop that could hang the emperor's character would do booming business.
She, as a noble fairy and also the Acting Sect Leader, these two identities combined were not more noble than the emperor's title?
"I'll do it." Immortal Eternity volunteered, serving the grand leader dedicatedly.
This was a chance conferred by the fairy and must be seized tightly.
As the third leader, he was most aware of how powerful the grand leader was.
Soon, Immortal Eternity finished the painting.
In the painting, Lu Yang stood in the very center, with Immortal Eternity and the high-level officials of the Eternity Sect surrounding him, depicting a scene of all looking up to Lu Yang.
This painting was of course hung at the entrance, and anyone who passed by would take a second look.
Lu Yang rubbed his chin, feeling that there was something strange in the painting's content, but he couldn't pinpoint exactly what was strange.
The fairy still wanted to go around, like visiting the peaks of the Grand Elder to the Eighth Elder in turn, to spread her fame in the Seek Dao Sect. But before this plan could start, she saw the Eldest Senior Sister appearing beside her at some point.
"Sect Leader, it's time for you to handle the sect affairs."

chapters.title: Chapter 460 - 459: The Golden Finger of the Fairy Eternity Makes Her Life Smooth Sailing_1
chapters.content:
Fairy Eternity had an interesting expression upon hearing her Eldest Senior Sister's reminder. Her face resembled that of an officer who had been working hard all year, just stepped out to go on vacation, and was immediately called back by their superior to handle work.
Suddenly, Fairy Eternity remembered that since being reborn and having a golden cheat, it was the existence of this golden cheat that made her life smooth sailing.
"Lu Yang, you deal with this."
The third round of responsibilities was placed on Lu Yang's shoulders once again, and he regained control of his body.
Lu Yang: "..."
One of these days, I'll also capture three transcendence tribulation stage souls, act as the Sect Leader, and let you do the work for me!
Eldest Senior Sister carried Lu Yang back to Sky Gate Mountain.
"All of these are..." the Eldest Senior Sister moved a pile of documents over to him. She had accumulated a portion while getting her Grandmaster out of jail, another portion when she was in the palace for a meeting.
Little by little, the pile had grown this much.
"The priority is deciding who to send to Ji State," Eldest Senior Sister reminded Lu Yang of the need to prioritize tasks.
Wu Youdao had revealed that the next target was Ji State. The imperial court and the Five Great Immortal Sects intended to carefully sweep through Ji State to see if they could find any trace of Great Yu's cultivators.
"As for the nine elders,"
Lu Yang was conflicted on whom to send for help. Ji State had over three hundred cities. If too few people went, it definitely wouldn't work. So, how many people should he send?
The Sixth Elder found it inconvenient to venture out, and the Eighth Elder risked being wanted if he left. Neither of them could be sent out.
Just as Lu Yang was wracking his brain over this, Eldest Senior Sister reminded him again: "While Seek Dao Sect indeed only has nine elders, this doesn't mean that there are only nine at the Unification Stage: the Deputy Hall Master of Task Hall, the person in charge of the Hundred Refinement Peak's cafeteria, the people in charge of the shopping street, and the owner of the Hundred Fragrance Building… are all at the Unification Stage and are peers of the elders."
Eldest Senior Sister started naming a bunch of people that Lu Yang had never even met before.
"There are quite a few people who are peers of the elders. Some are out carrying out tasks, some have semi-retired within the sect, and others are guarding the Secret Realms. While their cultivation levels may not compare to the elders, they are still much stronger compared to the people at the Unification Stage outside the sect," she explained.
Previously, Lu Yang had found it strange. Given the number of junior brothers and sisters he had, there couldn't possibly be only nine people of the elders' generation. So where had all the others gone?
After Eldest Senior Sister's explanation, Lu Yang understood. So it seemed that the eight elders and their father were diligent-- the others were hiding where he couldn't see them.
For example, the cafeteria that produced divine weapons. He had bought weapons there several times, but this was the first time he had heard about its manager.
And the Hundred Fragrance Building. He had been there more than once or twice, but he had never seen the building's owner.
"What about Elder Tao of the Scripture Pavilion?" Lu Yang mentioned an old man he had met at the Scripture Pavilion when he was compiling martial arts techniques before.
"Elder Tao is of the same generation as your Grandmaster; he's already retired and doesn't bother with worldly affairs," Eldest Senior Sister informed him.
"Alright, then let's send the Second, Third, and Fourth Elders as well as the Deputy Hall Master, the person in charge of the Hundred Refinement Peak's cafeteria, the people in charge of the shopping street, and the owners of the Hundred Fragrance Building to Ji State, making a total of seven people."
The Grand Elder would stay in the Task Hall. Both the Fifth and Seventh elders, being the main incomes of Seek Dao Sect, couldn't go.
"There are two Deputy Hall Masters in the Task Hall."
"Then send them all. That makes eight people." Lu Yang waved his hand generously, ordering these prominent figures amongst those at the Unification Stage to head to Ji State for support.
"I'll notify them immediately," Eldest Senior Sister nodded, taking initiative to handle the matter.
After the Eldest Senior Sister had left, Lu Yang realized that there must be more people of the same generation as the elders than he was told. Could it be that Eldest Senior Sister wanted to send these people, which is why she only mentioned them?
"No, no." Lu Yang shook his head, feeling that he was overthinking it.
Lu Yang picked up the topmost document, opened it, and found it to be an invitation to the Yun State Celebration.
According to the invitation, Seek Dao Sect was requested to send young disciples to participate in the celebration. Following several courtesies, the notes specified that, if possible, do not send disciples named Lu Yang or Meng Jingzhou.
Lu Yang: "..."
What happened to Meng Jingzhou and me? Didn't we shine at the Wild State Celebration, indirectly spreading the news of the Wild State Celebration to everyone in the world?
Among all the celebrations held in various states, only the Wild State Celebration is the most famous, which proves that Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou have put in a lot of hard work.
Lu Yang gave his approval: Let Wei Nanfei and Jin Qinqin participate in the celebration.
These two disciples also entered the Seek Dao Sect with Lu Yang. One was rescued by Senior Brother Dai Bufan when he was young, and the other had mistakenly eaten Green Wood Immortal Fruit when he was a child.
Using Lu Yang as a role model, though their cultivation speed is slower than Lu Yang and the others, their solid foundation and steady progress means that when they reach Lu Yang's realm, they could stand up to Li Haoran. They are the future backbone of the Seek Dao Sect.
Participating in such large-scale events can be very helpful for their future.
For example, if a few Great Yu cultivators show up at the celebration, it could broaden their horizons.
The next document is an official letter from the Golden Buddha Kingdom to the Seek Dao Sect.
The letter states that Lu Yang's second senior brother, who he has never met before, has cultivated his Golden Body to six feet tall. He moves the Buddha statues from the temple all day and sits there himself with his Golden Body. Because the cultivation of his Golden Body is so good, it is even more sacred than the Buddha statues. The monks did not realize it.
After a week, the old abbot realized that they were not worshiping the Buddha statues, but the Second Senior Brother.
During this week, the Second Senior Brother has been maintaining the state of his six-foot Golden Body.
From the tone of the letter, this is not the first time the Second Senior Brother has done such a thing, and the people of the Buddha Country hope that the Seek Dao Sect will quickly ask the Second Senior Brother to return.
"The Second Senior Brother indeed lives up to his name. He is clearly the chosen successor of our master." Lu Yang praised sincerely.
Then there was an invitation from the Sword Tower, which also came with a letter. The letter stated that the old veterans of the Sword Tower unanimously decided that Daoist Buyu is the contemporary leader of the Sword Dao, and they hope that Daoist Buyu will go to the Sword Tower to receive the plaque of 'Leader of the Sword Dao'.
Many great powers in the Sword Dao will attend, and the Sword Tower looks forward to the master's arrival.
The Sword Tower is located in Shu State and is renowned even among the First Class Sects. It represents the orthodox of the Sword Dao. The Sword Tower was once a superior sect, but it fell to a First Class Sect after the death of the Supreme Sword Dao master.
Although the Supreme Sword Dao master has passed away, his legacy and heritage are still present. The Sword Tower has more than ten Unification Stage masters who are all good with swords, extremely formidable.
It can be said that the power of the Sword Tower is even stronger than the Corpse Chasing Sect which is a dabbler superior sect.
The Sword Tower represents the orthodox of Sword Dao, and Daoist Buyu represents the peak of Sword Dao.
Daoist Buyu had once gone to the Sword Tower to compete and defeated more than a dozen Sword Tower cultivators in a row, eventually defeating the Sword Tower Master.
But the Sword Tower has always looked down on Daoist Buyu. Is this offering of a plaque to Daoist Buyu a step back?
By this time, the Eldest Senior Sister had finished her announcement and saw that Lu Yang was pondering the invitation from the Sword Tower when she returned.
"You want the master to go to the Sword Tower to receive the plaque?"
"Yes, would this alleviate the master's relationship with the Sword Tower?"
"Give up, the master will not go."
"Why?" Lu Yang wondered, "Doesn't the master want to reconcile with the people of the Sword Tower?"
"The Sword Tower has already recognized the master and admitted the master's position. This isn't the first time they want to award the master a plaque, but the master has never gone."
"The master is indifferent to fame and fortune?"
"That's because the invited guests are all people he has crossed paths with. If he goes, it'll be like walking into a trap."
"... the master's enemies really do appear in the most unexpected places. Oh right, can the master be sent to Ji State?"
Eldest Senior Sister thought for a moment and said seriously: "You are the Acting Sect Master, and the master is the Sect Master, you cannot command the master."
"So it's not possible?"
"That means I can write a letter suggesting the master go to Ji State."

chapters.title: Chapter 461 - 460 Rotating Work_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang politely declined the dinner invitation from the Sword Loft. As the Eldest Senior Sister mentioned, she penned a letter on a side-table, suggesting that Daoist Buyu take a trip to Ji State.
"Eldest Senior Sister, can you locate our master?" Lu Yang suddenly remembered. Their master had enemies all over the world and always kept multiple hiding places. His whereabouts were hard to predict.
"Yes."
As she spoke, the letter for Daoist Buyu was finished. The Eldest Senior Sister quietly folded the letter into an origami crane.
She gently blew on the crane; its eyes gleamed as if it was alive, fluttering its wings and flew out of the abode.
"What is this...?" Lu Yang had never seen this kind of magic before.
"Just a little magic I created in my spare time to amuse myself, I named it the 'Origami Technique'." said the Eldest Senior Sister casually.
Lu Yang gasped. Amusing oneself by creating magic? How did she do that?
Is the gap between people really that big? Why does he amuse himself by listening to Fairy Eternity tell stories about the dark history of ancient times?
If before Lu Yang dared not listen to Fairy Eternity's ancient stories too much, fearing that the ancient immortals would join hands to get rid of him, now he had nothing to fear.
There was no need to be afraid. If the matter got out, he was sure to be exterminated.
Whether he was dead or alive, what was there to fear in hearing a few more stories?
"Creating magic, it's no big deal." Fairy Eternity thought that Lu Yang lacked experience and wondered what was so hard about creating magic.
"I was already capable of creating magic during the Golden Core stage. The 'Playing Dead Technique' was created then. Follow me and learn well, you could also create magic!"
Facing the 'delicious pie' painted by Fairy Eternity, Lu Yang kept his distance, with no desire stirred.
What use is the 'Playing Dead Technique', couldn't she have created something like the 'Diving Spell'?
Lu Yang continued to peruse the documents.
Various elders pleaded poverty and requested more Spirit Stones. The Grand Elder said that the Task Hall's task rewards needed more Spirit Stones. The Second Elder said that there were not enough Spirit Stones to maintain the medicinal garden's Array Method. The Third Elder said that he, as a master, is not as wealthy as Meng Jingzhou...
These all seemed like very serious reasons, and Lu Yang was unsure how to make a decision, whether to refuse or allocate the budget.
"Leave this matter to me." The Eldest Senior Sister actively took over the document pleading poverty from the elder. Handling this kind of thing was still too early for Lu Yang.
Lu Yang thought to himself that it takes skill to maneuver between the elders. He was still too young to comprehend the dynamics between the elders and their methods of handling situations. He needs to learn more from his Eldest Senior Sister.
Then Lu Yang watched in disbelief as the Eldest Senior Sister wrote two words at the conclusion of the document- No.
The Eldest Senior Sister was concerned that Lu Yang, being thin-skinned, would hesitate to refuse directly.
Lu Yang breathed a sigh of relief after processing one document after another, and leaned back in his chair.
"Phew~ finally, everything's done."
When he was dealing with the documents, he didn't feel superior in his position of power, but rather felt that the test of the immortals was indeed difficult.
Luckily, he has safely overcome this test without any risks.
"My turn, my turn!" Seeing that all the work was done, Fairy Eternity was eager to possess Lu Yang's body and continue showing off her prowess.
"Perfect timing. Now that the paperwork is done, it's time to sort out the guest list for the Sect's celebration." The Eldest Senior Sister looked emotionlessly at Fairy Eternity who had already possessed Lu Yang's body.
Fairy Eternity: "..."
" I've been working for so long, and haven't even had a break!" Fairy Eternity glared at the Eldest Senior Sister, albeit looking a bit weird since she wore Lu Yang's face.
The Eldest Senior Sister remained unmoved, seeing right through Fairy Eternity's ruse: "It was Lu Yang who handled the documents just now, now it's your turn."
Fairy Eternity put on a smile, trying to ingratiate herself to Lu Yang: "Lu Yang, do you want your body back?"
Lu Yang remained unmoved, seeing through Fairy Eternity's insincere smile.
Fairy Eternity had no other choice but to lower her head and earnestly started to sift through the list of names for the guest list.
"These are all the super-grade sects and first-class sects registered with the court."
The Eldest Senior Sister had already prepared a list of names.
Invitations to the court and the Four Great Immortal Sects are a must.
Fairy Eternity counted the number of sects on the list: "Eight super-grade sects, one hundred and sixteen first-class sects."
This meant that in addition to the Five Great Immortal Sects, eight other sects had a Transcendance Tribulation Stage Great Power.
"Not right, now there are nine, the Corpse Chasing Sect should also be considered a super-grade sect."
Theim Sect Leader accomplished the feat of narrowly elevating his sect to the super-grade level.
The number of super-grade sects might not change for hundreds of years, the list the Eldest Senior Sister provided was compiled just last month, theoretically, the most recent one.
The Sect Leader of the Corpse Chasing Sect just happened to break through after this.
Lu Yang tallied up the known number of Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivators: there are at least five guaranteed by the Five Great Immortal Sects, and the eight super-grade sects have eight.
There must be quite a few on the court's side. There are four Transcendance Tribulation Stage generals stationed on the front lines, one of whom he had seen at the end of the Hanshui City incident.
And also, when the headquarters of the Eternity Sect was being eradicated, the court had also sent a cultivator in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
The Luoshui Guards, which was specially in charge of dealing with ancient cultivators, must have people in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage since they could handle ancient cultivators, and there definitely wouldn't be just one.
Apart from these, there are also those hidden Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivators. Everyone who is able to cultivate to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, excluding the Corpse Chasing Sect Leader, are of an esteemed generation and would generally not take action.
"The nine super-grade sects need to be invited, and these one hundred and sixteen first-class sects need to be filtered..." The Eldest Senior Sister patiently taught Fairy Eternity how to filter.
Fairy Eternity was quick on the uptake and soon thought of a filtration method: "Do we need to weed out those who have grievances with Daoist Buyu?"
She thought of a good point. If they invited a bunch of people bearing a grudge against Daoist Buyu, the celebration wouldn't go smoothly.
"Then there wouldn't be any sects left to invite."
"Alright then." Fairy Eternity hadn't made much headway.
With the hands-on instruction of the Eldest Senior Sister, Fairy Eternity quickly managed to come up with an invitation list that met the Eldest Senior Sister's expectations.
"This one about the second senior brother, you should ask the Eldest Senior Sister how to handle it." Lu Yang just remembered that when the Eldest Senior Sister was not around, they had received a complaint from the Golden Buddha Country about the second senior brother, and he didn't know how to respond.
Fairy Eternity hurriedly pulled out an official document from the bottom.
The Eldest Senior Sister opened it and glanced over it, understanding immediately: "So it's another issue with the second junior brother."
"What should we do?"
"No worries, this is not the first time the second junior brother has done something like this, we've received complaints from the Buddha Country before, just ignore it."
Fairy Eternity nodded, writing in the reply to the Buddha Country: Don't bother about him.
Lu Yang regained control of his body. He looked at the document which described the Meter-Tall Golden Body as majestic and impressive, and couldn't help feeling envious: "By the way, Eldest Senior Sister, can I learn Meter-Tall Golden Body?"
In battle, one only needs to give a loud shout, and the Meter-Tall Golden Body would rise from the ground, majestic like a god, solemn like a Buddha, sweeping away thousands of enemies.
Even thinking about it was exhilarating!
"You could give it a try."

chapters.title: Chapter 462 - 461 Learning the Six-foot Golden Body_1
chapters.content:
The Vajra Body, one of the highest-level magic skills in Buddhism. Once mastered, the practitioner could have a golden body for protection and attack, thus possessing both offensive and defensive abilities without any flaw.
Those who achieve the pinnacle of the Vajra Body can even be reborn and become a Buddha on the spot.
It is said that there was an enlightened monk in Buddha Country who, under a Bodhi tree, achieved ultimate enlightenment, perfected his Vajra Body so strong that nothing can break it, thus becoming invincible.
The highest-level magic skills are difficult to master, but not as challenging as the Universe in Palm, so Eldest Senior Sister thought that Lu Yang could learn it.
Lu Yang had a Senior Brother at the peak of the Golden Core Stage who had also mastered the Vajra Body.
"Who said that the Vajra Body is a magic skill of Buddhism. This magic skill existed even in ancient times!" Fairy Eternity exclaimed, who has the right to speak on this matter.
"It existed in ancient times?" Both Lu Yang and Eldest Senior Sister didn't know this.
Fairy Eternity snorted twice: "Of course, but in ancient times, although everyone's Vajra Body was called the Vajra Body, the sizes varied greatly. It was only after we five became immortals that the size of the Vajra Body was fixed."
Lu Yang was puzzled: "What does your becoming immortals have to do with the Vajra Body?"
"Of course, it's because we unified the measurements. The measurement standards of different tribes were different. After the five of us became immortals, we defined what a zhang is."
Lu Yang was quite shocked. Even the other four immortals would be fine, but Fairy, you can even unify the measurements?
"It was Yingtian Immortal who proposed it. One day he told us seriously that some people in the outside world were saying he was eight zhang tall, while others were saying he was one foot tall. He suspected that it was because of the different measurement standards of the tribes that made his height vary. After we unified the measurements, the problem indeed disappeared."
"Does the unification of measurements work so well?"
"Um, at that time, I was busy unifying the measurements among various tribes and didn't have time to tell the outside world how tall Yingtian Immortal was."
"So, you were the one who spread the rumor!"
"You can't really call it a rumor. It's just that at the beginning, a follower asked me how tall Yingtian Immortal was, and I was still half-asleep, so I just said eight zhang. The rumor spread, and I couldn't stop it. Realizing that this wasn't working, I quickly told the followers that Yingtian Immortal was one foot tall."
"Think about it, the outside world claimed that Yingtian Immortal was eight zhang tall, and others claimed that Yingtian Immortal was one foot tall. Isn't the average of the two Yingtian Immortal's normal height?"
Fairy Eternity made a lot of sense, and Lu Yang couldn't find any flaws for a while.
She continued: "I can also use the Vajra Body magic skill, but I know too many things and there's no need to use the Vajra Body."
"Things like Heaven and Earth Simulation, Big and Small Ruyi, have similar functions to the Vajra Body. They all engage in combat using a big weapon."
