Eldest Senior Sister nodded in agreement with Fairy Eternity's view. As the saying goes, 'all roads lead to Rome', many magic skills are similar, one only needs to master one type, there's no need to master everything like her.
"Come out with me."
Eldest Senior Sister took Lu Yang to the open space behind the hill, where she had taught Shrinking Ground Into Inches last time.
Fairy Eternity came out of Lu Yang's body, ready to teach Lu Yang as well.
Lu Yang's confidence was boosted, and his morale was high. With Eldest Senior Sister, a present day powerhouse, and Fairy Eternity, an ancient powerhouse teaching him together, he's sure to succeed!
"To practice Vajra Body, first maintain a peaceful state of mind."
"To practice Vajra Body, first mobilize your own Qi and Blood."
Eldest Senior Sister and Fairy Eternity said at the same time, leaving Lu Yang at a loss.
Who should he listen to?
Eldest Senior Sister looked at Fairy Eternity lightly: "A peaceful state of mind can bring out normal and even extraordinary performance. Fairy, why do you want to mobilize Qi and Blood?"
Fairy Eternity was not afraid of Eldest Senior Sister, she stared at Lu Yang without backing down: "Qi and Blood circulate through the meridians, which bear the spiritual essence. The Vajra Body is the result of the mixture of Qi and Blood and spiritual essence. Naturally, the first step is to mobilize Qi and Blood."
Lu Yang: "..."
Fairy, shouldn't you be making eye contact with Eldest Senior Sister? Why are you looking at me?
And in this situation, shouldn't I say something to make my position clear?
Unfortunately, he dare not offend either of them.
Facing the confrontation between these two powerhouses from past and present, Lu Yang had no choice but to keep a low profile.
"I am the Acting Sect Leader, listen to me!" Fairy Eternity used her trump card and pushed back Eldest Senior Sister.
"...Okay."
The battle between the two strongest figures of ancient and modern times came to an end. The magic duel happened in the silence. The world was completely unaware of it.
"Let me teach you, close your eyes, feel the Qi and Blood in your body, and try to mobilize them."
Lu Yang closed his eyes and listened internally. It seemed as if he could hear the sound of a big river flowing. This was the rush of Qi and Blood.
His Qi and Blood were far superior to the Golden Core Stage, and even a cultivator at the Nascent Soul Stage may not be able to match him.
"Go, mobilize the power of Qi and Blood, let the fluctuation of Qi and Blood coincide with the fluctuation of the meridians, creating resonance. The stronger the resonance, the stronger the power of Qi and Blood and spiritual essence!"
Thump—thump—thump—
The surroundings were silent, except for Lu Yang's heartbeat, strong and robust.
"Expand the power of Qi and Blood and spiritual essence. Imagine them as real entities, spreading from inside your body to outside with a bang, forming a human figure, preferably in your shape!"
Eldest Senior Sister standing nearby nodded slightly. Fairy Eternity's teaching method was similar to hers. Whether it's a calm state of mind or Qi and Blood, they could both achieve the Vajra Body in the end.
Next, it depends on Lu Yang.
Lu Yang was unaware of the expectations of Eldest Senior Sister. From beginning to end, his eyes were closed, Qi and Blood were surging, but his state of mind was very calm.
He vaguely caught a feeling, which was elusive but also very real.
Lu Yang grabbed on to this feeling and pulled hard!
Qi and Blood tumbled, spiritual essence burst out, Qi and Blood intertwined with the spiritual essence, circulating at high speed inside his body, and then rushed out!
The moment the two forces appeared outside his body, they formed a golden color that was invisible, sparkling like a golden vessel!
Boom—
The Vajra Body made its appearance in the world, appearing ten meters away from Lu Yang!
Lu Yang: "?"
Shouldn't the Vajra Body be around me for protection? What are you doing so far away?
"Well, although it's a bit far, and has no defensive power, it can attack."
The Vajra Body was extraordinarily sturdy; a casual swing with a round arm was not something that a person at the Golden Core Stage could withstand.
Lu Yang tried to control the Vajra Body, but found that it was indifferent, just like a sculpture.
"..."
Why does everyone else develop a Vajra Body with both offensive and defensive abilities while mine doesn't have either?
"How about you try going in the Vajra Body and see?" Fairy Eternity suggested, it was her first time encountering this situation too.
Other people who used the Vajra Body were all inside it; perhaps it's the same for Lu Yang.
Eldest Senior Sister not far away was also looking strange. There was no problem with the method Fairy Eternity taught, so why did it have such an effect?
Lu Yang had no choice but to try as Fairy Eternity suggested.
He ran over to the foot of the Vajra Body and found that it was indeed as solid as expected being created by him, he couldn't even find a place to get in.
"Try it from the bottom of the foot?" Fairy Eternity suggested again.
Lu Yang had to squat down, lift the Vajra Body's foot and enter the Vajra Body from underneath.
Once inside the Vajra Body, Lu Yang was excited; this was the Vajra Body he had cultivated.
He would let the people see the power of his Vajra Body!
He commanded with his mind, but the Vajra Body did not move!
Commanded again, the Vajra Body was still motionless!
Stood solid as Mount Tai!
"...Did I just cultivate a golden body or a damn turtle shell!"

chapters.title: Chapter 463 - 462 Daoist Buyu Narrates a Story_1
chapters.content:
"You know, the defense power of this Golden Body is really remarkable." Fairy Eternity had a knack for spotting strengths.
If you were to attack your own Golden Body, other than the Village in the Palm, no attacks would inflict any damage, at most just scratching the surface."
"This hard?" Lu Yang was taken aback. He thought the sword skills could break the Golden Body defense; he did not expect Fairy's evaluation of the Golden Body to be so high.
"After all, it's my teachings!"
"It would be appropriate as a defensive technique.", agreed Lu Yang, nodding his head. After spending a full day learning about the six-foot Golden Body, he had made some gains.
Now, that he had the Village in the Palm to attack and the six-foot Golden Body to defend, who could beat him?
...
The Tea House.
The beggarly Daoist put down his Chizi in his hand, telling a story in a vivid way.
The Daoist looked beggarly, his dust wiper was put on the table, his eyes sparkled, and his look was extraordinary.
"The Seek Dao Sect has a genius named Lu Yang. This child's talent is really amazing. When he first entered the Seek Dao Sect, he showed a astounding talent, that was the extremely rare Single Spiritual Root. All of you must understand the concept of Single Spiritual Root. Before the Great Era, Single Spiritual Root are seen once in a hundred years!"
"The Single Spiritual Root of Talent Lu is the best among them. The other Single Spiritual Root disciple who entered the door with him was the eldest son of the Meng Family. The eldest son of the Meng family was among the top of the influential families, naturally he was the foremost among the sons."
"Despite his status, the eldest son of the Meng Family was still jealous of Talent Lu and his Single Spiritual Root!"
"When it was learned that Talent Lu was a Single Spiritual Root, many influential families and sects proposed to marry with Talent Lu, but were blocked by the Seek Dao Sect."
"On the contrary, no one proposed to marry with the eldest son of the Meng Family despite his high status and strong talent, which shows the gap between the two!"
"After joining the sect, Talent Lu was taken in by Daoist Buyu as his closed-door disciple."
The guests murmured in surprise. They didn't expect that this Talent Lu's Single Spiritual Root was so extraordinary.
The beggarly Daoist was a wandering storyteller. He had just arrived at the tea house a few days ago. At first, the guests just came to listen to the story as usual and didn't have high expectations for the beggarly Daoist.
But as soon as the beggarly Daoist opened his mouth, he startled everyone, telling the"Legend of the Dao Sect", a story no one had heard before.
This was the latest version of the"Legend of the Dao Sect"!
The"Legend of the Dao Sect"is the most popular story among the common people today, with classic plots that make for delightful conversation, and people often discuss it after it ends.
Like the story of "Daoist Xiantian meeting the Immortal who pointed him the way to found the Seek Dao Sect", "The Nine Sons of Seek Dao Sect going down the mountain to suppress demons and support the Righteous Path", "Daoist Buyu opening the heavens with his sword, making all heroes surrender", and so on.
Anyone who didn't know the name of the Seek Dao Sect would be considered out of touch.
The latest version told by the beggarly Daoist was naturally enthusiastically received by the public.
The tea house owner had been smiling so much these few days that his face was starting to develop wrinkles.
"At that time, there was a great demon within the Seek Dao Sect. Daoist Buyu was suppressed by the great demon. The great demon took Daoist Buyu's place and became the sect leader, and no one in the Seek Dao Sect noticed."
"Talent Lu was the first to notice this. He saw through the disguise of the great demon, found Daoist Buyu, overcame numerous difficulties, and finally unsealed Daoist Buyu, enabling him to return to the human world!"
"After this battle, Daoist Buyu saw through the mortal world and traveled around the world, leaving the sect affairs in the hands of his most proud senior disciple."
"Talent Lu, rescued Daoist Buyu, earning the recognition of the sect, and was regarded as a great hero."
"The Sect Leader of Five Elements Sect even personally visited the Seek Dao Sect, wanting to meet this young Talent Lu. After meeting Talent Lu, the Sect Leader of Five Elements Sect was very polite to him, treating him as someone of the same status, and treated Talent Lu with the respect due to a sect leader."
The audience was impressed. After rescuing Daoist Buyu, this was how the Sect Leader of Five Elements Sect treated Talent Lu; Daoist Buyu's position was indeed high.
"Talent Lu has a unique vision and an impressive track record. What is the Seek Dao Sect? It is the leader of the Five Great Immortal Sects, and all the disciples inside are geniuses. They are all invincible in their own level."
"But Talent Lu dares to challenge across the levels. With a cultivation level of the Foundation Establishment Stage, he jumped three realms and challenged Golden Core, Nascent Soul, Spirit Transformation, consecutive battles with consecutive victories. The people of Seek Dao Sect were all shocked by this record!"
"Although Talent Lu is exceptionally talented, he is very humble. He has a great relationship with his fellow senior and junior brothers and sisters, and they often seek him out for learning and improving together. The atmosphere is harmonious."
The audience, who had never met Lu Yang, got a rough idea of him. Having high cultivation and a good character, what a perfect cultivator.
In"Legend of the Dao Sect"it was told that Daoist Buyu's fame spread all over the place, whenever he went to a place, there were people who knew him, enthusiastically invited him to a banquet, and even a sword dance performance. Daoist Buyu said that the friendship between gentlemen is as light as water, no need for such ostentation, and he rejected the invitation to the banquet.
Those who knew him showed loss and regret after being rejected.
What does this show? This shows that Daoist Buyu has friends all over the world.
Lu Yang is humble and good at making friends, this habit must have been learned from Daoist Buyu.
No wonder he was said to be the closed-door disciple of Daoist Buyu. This is the master-disciple lineage.
The beggarly Daoist was like a well-spoken storyteller, telling about Lu Yang's deeds. He talked for a whole morning, finally he struck his wooden block with a clatter.
"Tomorrow, I'll tell the story of another legendary disciple of Seek Dao Sect, Meng Tianjiao. Meng Tianjiao has a heart towards the immortal path, stays calm in the face of chaos, is not tempted, and has the discipline of a monk achieving Tao."
"Ladies and gentlemen, see you tomorrow!"
The beggarly Daoist drained the tea in his cup, got up and bid farewell.
"Here is your earnings for today." The tea house owner personally found the beggarly Daoist and handed him a bag of silver.
In the view of the tea house owner, the beggarly Daoist was like a money tree. As long as he was there, their tea house would become more and more popular!
The beggarly Daoist took the silver with a smile, and stashed it in his sleeve.
A paper crane flapped its wings and flew onto the beggarly Daoist's shoulder.
The beggarly Daoist was startled. He recognized the paper crane. It was a letter from Xiao Yun.
"What does Xiao Yun want from me?" Daoist Buyu wondered. Xiao Yun had just finished his jail release paperwork for him not a few days ago, why would she be looking for him again so soon?
In the letter, Yun Zhi chose her words carefully and respectfully, explaining the plans entrusted to Ji State by Wu Youdao, also explaining that the current affairs of the Seek Dao Sect are managed by Lu Yang, and she just helps with writing letters.
At the end of the letter, Yun Zhi wrote:
"Junior brother is not good with words. He asked me to tell master that the matter of Ji State is of great importance. Please, master, don't refuse and hurry over."
"Ji State, huh...I am actually in Ji State right now." Daoist Buyu put away the paper crane and sighed softly.
"What stage is Yun Zhi at, this paper crane can get through the[rules]set up by the Transcendance Tribulation Stage and deliver the letter unscathed to my hands?"
Daoist Buyu looked up and saw the sky canopy covering the city. The airtight canopy was broken with a small hole, which was hit by the paper crane.

chapters.title: Chapter 464 - 463 Sword Opens Heaven's Gate_1
chapters.content:
Several days ago, Daoist Buyu was released from prison. After parting ways with Yun Zhi, he continued to travel around the continent, promoting the"Legend of the Dao Sect"and his glorious image along the way.
When he arrived at Steadfast City in Ji State, he discovered that Steadfast City was already enveloped by a [rule], it was possible to enter, but not to leave. To the outside world, Steadfast City seemed to be functioning as usual, with people coming and going incessantly.
In reality, it was the power of the [rule] at work; entry was indeed possible, but no one could leave.
Those who seem to have left the city were in fact fake people created by the rule.
These fake beings were identical to real humans, they had same memories, habits, and behaviors.
Only when the rule was broken would the fake persons disappear from the outside world.
Initially, Daoist Buyu intended to shatter the rule with his sword. Just as he was about to take action, his finely honed combat instincts, developed over many years, prompted him to withdraw.
He quickly understood that this was not a Unification level [rule], but a Transcendance Tribulation Stage [rule].
Once he made his move, he would have attracted the attention of those who had laid the rule, and that would have been problematic.
"What a rotten turn of events!" Daoist Buyu spat on the ground, fully engrossed in formulating a countermeasure.
He disguised himself as a down-and-out Daoist, engaging in story-telling at a tea house, while observing the rule.
The rule had been in effect for quite some time, and yet the city continued to operate normally, indicating that the person who had imposed the rule did not intend to cause destruction.
Several days into his observations, the business of the tea house was booming and Daoist Buyu finally understood the rule that regulated this place.
Depending on one's roles, one needed to abide by different rules: guards adhered to guards' rules, officers adhered to officers' rules, and tea houses and bars had their own stipulations.
The place was governed by many rules, but there were only two core ones.
[First Rule: The Great Xia Dynasty does not exist; only the Great Yu Dynasty exists here]
[Second Rule: All residents of Steadfast City are subjects of the Great Yu Dynasty]
This indicated that the Transcendance Tribulation Stage of Great Yu had enacted the rule.
But what was the purpose? What was the use in carving out territory for the Great Yu Dynasty within the borders of the Great Xia Dynasty?
These questions had been bugging Daoist Buyu for days, but he was still unable to figure out the answers.
It was only when the paper crane from his good disciple flew over that he finally realized the objective of Great Yu.
Great Yu Dynasty wanted to seize a portion of the State Destiny power from Hanshui City and experiment with this power in Steadfast City.
The plans at Hanshui City and Steadfast City were interconnected.
Their objective was to study the power of State Destiny.
As for why the plan in Hanshui City had failed, and Wu Youdao and the other two were captured, but yet the Great Yu did not abandon Steadfast City,
It was because the cultivators of Great Yu did not know that Wu Youdao had been captured.
At that time, Fairy Eternity appeared to let Wu Youdao and the other two escape, but secretly captured them again. To the outside world, everyone knew that Wu Youdao and the others had successfully escaped.
The cultivators of Great Yu could only have access to publicly known intelligence. They still could not achieve omniscience and understand everything.
"So that's the case, the intentions of the Great Yu cultivators sure are grand." Daoist Buyu muttered while smirking coldly, lifting his gaze towards the sky pierced by the paper crane.
The sky was transformed by the rule, and the absence of healing within the sky signified a flaw in the rule.
It also implied that the Transcendance Tribulation Stage of Great Yu had sensed the presence of the paper crane.
"Master, is something the matter? Who sent you the letter?" The owner of the tea house cautiously inquired, feeling that the down-and-out Daoist's smile was somewhat strange.
"It's from my senior and junior apprentices."
"Are they also storytellers?"
"Something like that. By the way, boss, I have to break my promise. I won't be able to come here and tell stories tomorrow. Please apologize to the customers on my behalf."
"Ah, why?" The owner of the tea house was greatly surprised. Weren't things going smoothly? Why was he suddenly quitting?
And besides, if he's leaving, where would he go? Could he actually leave Steadfast City?
Suddenly, an overwhelming force that seemed to cover the entire world appeared, plunging the whole of Steadfast City into panic. People were thrown into a frantic disorder, not understanding why there was such an intense force or where to flee.
Daoist Buyu sighed softly, "Because I am about to make a move."
With a flick of his dust whisk, it turned into thousands of swords, densely packed across the sky, releasing millions of radiant golden Sword Qi, actually competing equally at that moment with the oppressive presence!
No longer were the people in the city affected by the oppressive presence!
"Ba careless for a moment, and a bug has actually sneaked in!" The man in the sky releasing the oppressive presence stared fiercely at Daoist Buyu.
The paper crane flew towards Daoist Buyu, he also noticed Daoist Buyu's presence.
He perceived that though Daoist Buyu was incredibly strong, he still lingered at the stage of Unification, and was not to be feared.
Without any fear, Daoist Buyu flew up to the sky and confronted the man releasing the oppressive presence.
He raised his hand towards the sky, and thousands of swords merged, forming an unparalleled sharp sword, bathed in thunder and lightning, appeared in his hand.
"Sword's Return to Sect?! " The man releasing the oppressive energy was surprised, revealing in his tone a bit of astonishment. He hadn't expected to see the sword technique that swordsmanship cultivators most highly praised here.
"I am Sect Leader of the Seek Dao Sect, Daoist Buyu. Who are you?"
"You may address me as Poxiao Venerable."
Daoist Buyu squinted. According to historical records, Poxiao Venerable was a cultivator from the early period of Great Yu, at the Mid-stage of the Transcendence Tribulation Stage.
Not that it meant he couldn't deal with him.
He was holding the precious sharp sword in his hand, with countless iron tools and magic artifacts in the city echoing, as if responding to Daoist Buyu's call, as if submitting to Daoist Buyu, the supreme one.
The magic artifacts in the city vibrated, echoing throughout the sky!
The sharp sword was sheathed, bright as a rainbow, cold as ice, standing upright towards the sky, with murderous intent!
He slowly let out the name of this move: "Sword Opens Heaven's Gate".
The sword slashed down, like a bolt of cloth, the sky trembling, bringing boundless killing intent, killing towards Poxiao Venerable!
The sword, resembling a hanging river, descended from the sky. Poxiao Venerable's hair stood on end as he avoided this strike.
Boom——
Sword Qi collided directly with the sky; the sky shattered, the heavens shook, white clouds disintegrated and vanished. Over Steadfast City was crystal clear, not a cloud for miles around, the bright disk of the sun hanging high in the sky, everyone in the city watching this spectacle!
Upon seeing this, Poxiao Venerable was scared out of his wits. This was simply not a technique that someone at the Unification stage could perform!
"But don't think I'm afraid. How many times can you perform this?"
This kind of trick, kept as a last resort, could drain the spiritual essence of someone at the Unification Stage in one or two uses. It posed no threat to him!
"I can perform it constantly!"
Daoist Buyu laughed heartily, once again demonstrating Sword Opens Heaven's Gate. Poxiao Venerable hadn't anticipated this move and was a beat too slow in dodging. His arm was directly cut off!
Countless Sword Qi shot from the severed arm, boundless Sword Qi chopped the arm into dust!
"You're asking for death!" Poxiao Venerable was furious. He had actually had an arm cut off by a cultivator at the Unification stage. If word got out, how could he mix in the Cultivation World!
"Asura Body!" Behind Poxiao Venerable appeared a six-armed Asura figure, holding a drum, holding a tower, holding a ruler...
Daoist Buyu and Poxiao Venerable fought fiercely, the fierce battle darkening the skies. Time was turning upside down, space shattered and then merged back again.
The more Poxiao Venerable fought, the more frightened he became. This was the first time he had encountered a cultivator at the Unification stage who could fight on equal terms with himself!
Pff——
Unfortunately, Daoist Buyu couldn't maintain this state for long. After a brief exchange, Poxiao Venerable seized the opportunity, the Asura Body stabbed through Daoist Buyu's Barrier Door, Daoist Buyu's aura rapidly weakened.
"To be able to push me this far, you should be proud, die!" The six arms of the Asura Body came down together, like divine punishment, unstoppable in their might!
"Dare hurt my cultivator of Great Xia!"
An enraged roar came from not far away, it was just one roar, but it had stopped Poxiao Venerable's actions!
Daoist Buyu spat out fresh blood, looked at the newcomer, and laughed.
"You arrived too late! If you're not coming any time soon, I'm ready to break through to the Transcendence Tribulation Stage!"
"Who are you!" Poxiao Venerable stared intently at the newcomer. The newcomer was able to stop him with just a shout; his cultivation level must be above his own!
"Leader of the Nine Palaces of Luoshui Guards, Chen Tao."

chapters.title: Chapter 465 - 464: Missed Opportunity_1
chapters.content:
Upon receiving his good disciple's letter, Daoist Buyu had already calculated everything.
Combat was inevitable, and although he could hold his ground against Great Yu Tribulation Cultivator for a while, it would be to his disadvantage in the long run.
The letter had already mentioned that powerful representatives of the imperial court and Five Great Immortal Sects were being dispatched. All he had to do was to erupt in a grand battle, attracting attention and hold on until they arrived to help.
"Elder Chen Tao," Daoist Buyu looked up at the ongoing battle with Poxiao, feeling more assured.
The Luoshui Guards were a mechanism of the court specially designed to cope with Tribulation Cultivators and ancient monks. The most powerful among them were known as the "Nine Palaces". Chen Tao, as the leader of the Nine Palaces, had unfathomable strength and realm.
When it came to seniority, Chen Tao was even more senior than Daoist Buyu's master, a genuine old monster.
Sending Chen Tao made it clear how seriously the court regarded the Great Yu Monk.
"Ptui!" Daoist Buyu spat out a mouthful of blood, grimacing in pain as if his body was falling apart.
He had used Sword Qi to bolster his body and temporarily enhance his physical strength during the fight. Now, as the Sword Qi dispersed, his injuries flared up. Every orifice was bleeding. In a few breaths' time, his clothes were drenched in blood, his entire body covered in it.
"That was quite a blow," Daoist Buyu fumbled a few pieces of premium Great Pills out from his sleeve. These pills had Elixir Patterns on them and exuded the attractive fragrance of Elixirs, and he chugged them all at once.
His wounds gradually healed, much to his relief.
"Clean body, clean clothes."
Daoist Buyu performed the cleansing spell for both the body and clothes. The blood disappeared, the clothes restored to their initial clean state, and his body felt light again.
"The pills from my Seventh Elder are really helpful."
The Great Pills he just took were precious elixirs made by the Seventh Elder from the roots of the Little Medicinal Kings. They were of great value and not easily replaceable. They could even be showcased at the Unification-level auction as the show-stopping piece, they were that coveted.
It was common for Daoist Buyu to encounter danger while traveling, hence he always carried life-saving elixirs with him.
"Luoshui Guard Chen Tao?" Poxiao stared hard at the suddenly appeared old man, not daring to make any careless moves.
He sensed a deep threat from Chen Tao.
"Run!"
He mustn't linger here; he needed to escape quickly!
"You think you can escape without our permission?" Another voice materialized behind Poxiao.
Poxiao spun around, only to discover another Tribulation Cultivator had joined the fray!
Down below, Daoist Buyu recognized this newcomer as another member of the Luoshui Guards' Nine Palaces.
"The Luoshui Guards have three at Tribulation Cultivation Stage, and the court has dispatched two of them. They truly pulled out all the stops." The more people there were, the happier Daoist Buyu became, as this reduced the chances of Poxiao escaping.
The newcomer did not give Poxiao the chance to react. The stellar Rune Laws were like a long river, flowing out of a void and converging into locks of laws. They attempted to capture Poxiao!
Poxiao saw the situation had turned critical. The runes were creating an endless stream, a sign of the opponent's complete mastery over Talisman Cultivation. If these chains, weaved out by a Talisman Cultivator, were to bind him, he would not be able to escape in a short period.
He rocketed into the sky, trying to break free from the siege of the two Tribulation Cultivators.
"Think of running? Did you ask my Seek Dao Sect's permission?" Uncle Ba's voice appeared above Poxiao's head, stepping down on him.
Uncle Ba stood at the Array Eye, forming a blockade at the highest point of Steadfast City, with Third Elder and others positioned at the Seven-star points.
The Seven Stars Guard, the North Star Array Method!
Poxiao did not engage in a fight with Uncle Ba and others. He invoked the Asura Body. An enraged Asura broke the space.
Just as he was about to slip into the space rift, a voice emanated from the rift.
"You think my Prison Suppressing Sect is non-existent?"
Many ancient beasts emerged from the space rift, such as Emperor Jiang, Golden Winged Roc, and Chaos, presenting ferocious faces with teeth bared, their giant bodies as big as mountains, emitting a terrifying aura from the ancient times!
Eight powerful beings, their bodies marked with these ancient beast patterns, walked out from the space rift.
The War Patterns cultivation method of the Prison Suppressing Sect!
"My Five Elements Sect…"
"From the Laurel Fairy Palace..."
"From the Suspension Temple..."
Only one person from Suspension Temple was dispatched, and he was the Supervisor of the Suspension Temple, whose fighting power was not inferior to Qiu Jin'an's!
Also, there were civil and military officials sent by the court. Each of them was full of fighting spirit, rubbing their fists and wiping their palms in anticipation.
The two Luoshui Guards with the highest cultivation level in the Nine Palaces were the fastest to arrive. Soon after, the unification stage cultivators from the Five Great Immortal Sects came to the sky above Steadfast City in succession, closing off the city completely.
All in all, there were actually more than forty cultivators at the unification stage who had arrived here.
These unification stage cultivators were all from the Five Great Immortal Sects, and any one of them pulled out at random was stronger than an ordinary unification stage cultivator.
With two out of Nine Palaces and the unification stage of Immortal Sects combined, even Wu Youdao and his party would have no choice but to take a beating if they dare to make a move.
Even if Wu Youdao and his companions received the support of the national destiny of Wild State, and Wu Youdao's Dragon and Tiger Qi transformed, they still wouldn't be able to fight these people!
The court and Immortal Sects had moved a large number of people to sweep any potential danger in Ji State to prevent incidents like that of Hanshui City from happening again!
It could be said that as long as a Great Yu monk dared to show his face, he would be jointly attacked by the righteous.
Daoist Buyu wouldn't dare to show himself for the same reason.
The people of Steadfast City had never witnessed such a spectacle. They couldn't distinguish between the Transcendence Tribulation Stage and the Unification Stage. They didn't even know that any of the cultivators here were all stronger than the City Lord of Steadfast City.
The City Lord of Steadfast City was only in the Refining the Void stage.
Nevertheless, the scene did not stop them from becoming excited and cheering. They had been tormented by the rules established by Asura Body Poxiao for too long. A slight violation would mean facing the threat of death, and they lived each day very cautiously.
"Boss, I'll be going first. We'll meet again." Daoist Buyu said goodbye to the completely stunned teahouse owner.
The teahouse owner was actually a cultivator, but his cultivation level was not high. He had opened a pub in Steadfast City to pass the time.
He could vaguely judge that the cultivation levels of these cultivators were higher than the City Lord, and they were top powers in the Cultivation World.
In nearly a hundred years, there had not been such a large number of powerful cultivators attacking together. Until now, he could hardly believe the scene he was witnessing.
"Ah, you're leaving?" The teahouse owner wanted to keep Daoist Buyu. Just now, Daoist Buyu spoke as if he was prepared to die, looking like he was ready to fight Asura Body Poxiao. So why was he leaving now that Hanshui City had been saved?
"If I don't leave now, I won't be able to leave at all." Daoist Buyu didn't explain too much to the teahouse owner. He escaped as everyone's attention was focused on Asura Body Poxiao.
"Catch him alive!" Chen Tao gave his command, only he was the first one to take action.
He bit his fingertip and drops of golden blood flew out, transforming into divine weaponry, raining down towards Asura Body Poxiao like a shower curtain.
"It's been a long time since we saw Senior Brother Chen Tao's hundred refinements of divine weapons!" The Immortal Sects sighed with emotion and took action together with Chen Tao. They attacked Asura Body Poxiao with various methods, leaving him powerless to fight back.
Asura Body Poxiao was filled with despair. He was finally caught by the laws transformed into chains of runes, and he was unable to mobilize any of his cultivation level.
"Finally caught one!" Chen Tao sneered. So far, the Great Yu monks had always been caught by the Seek Dao Sect. Now, it was finally the court's turn.
"By the way, where did the cultivator who was evenly matched with Asura Body go earlier?"
When Chen Tao arrived, his attention was entirely on Asura Body Poxiao and he didn't notice who was fighting Asura Body Poxiao.
"Ask the City Lord, he must have seen it." Uncle Ba proposed.
Under the scrutiny of a group of powerful cultivators with much higher cultivation levels than his own, the City Lord was shivering with terror. He ended up drawing a face that everyone was very familiar with.
"Damn it, we let Daoist Buyu escape!"
Everyone was agitated at their missed opportunity as if they had lost a chance of a lifetime.
If Daoist Buyu were here, what an excellent chance for revenge it would be!
"Torture Asura Body Poxiao severely. Without him, Daoist Buyu would have escaped!"
Asura Body Poxiao: "..."
Didn't they say that the cultivators of Great Xia used to get along peacefully? It didn't look like it.

chapters.title: Chapter 466 - 465: The Great Yu Imperial Teacher: Seek Dao Sect Must Die _1
chapters.content:
In the unoccupied cavern world, an old man with a face full of wrinkles suddenly stood up after hearing the news from his subordinate, and a terrifying aura swept across every inch of the space.
"What, Poxiao has been apprehended?!"
Seeing the Imperial Teacher's anger, the subordinate steeled himself and said, "Yes, Sovereign Poxiao has been captured by Great Xia. Several of our brothers hiding in Steadfast City have lost contact, they might have also been arrested."
Sovereign Poxiao was a vital force for the revival of Great Yu, a blade to cut through Great Xia. He didn't expect that before he could draw blood from Great Xia, he himself was captured instead.
Damn it!
"I've seen the rules of Steadfast City, they are indestructible. Outsiders can't possibly know what's happening inside Steadfast City, and Great Xia's reaction should have been delayed. You should explain in detail how Poxiao was discovered."
News of the matter came so abruptly that the subordinate had hardly been able to gather much further information.
"Sovereign Poxiao was discovered by Daoist Buyu, the sect leader of Seek Dao Sect."
"Daoist Buyu?"
As the master of one of the Five Great Immortal Sects, the Imperial Teacher had noticed Daoist Buyu. This person moved erratically and had inscrutable intentions. He was a tough cultivator to deal with.
"Imperial Teacher?" The disciple saw that the Imperial Teacher was lost in thought and paused.
"Nothing, continue."
"Daoist Buyu somehow noticed something strange about Steadfast City. He entered the city alone. Since Daoist Buyu was only at the Unification stage, Sovereign Poxiao didn't take him too seriously. And for several consecutive days, Daoist Buyu did nothing but tell stories in the tea house."
"But somehow, a paper crane penetrated the curtain of rules set up by Sovereign Poxiao, exposing a loophole and providing Daoist Buyu with an opportunity."
"Daoist Buyu utilized Sword Opens Heaven's Gate, splitting the curtain, and began to fight with Sovereign Poxiao. The battle was fierce and evenly matched, but Poxiao managed to defeat Daoist Buyu. Just as Poxiao was about to strike Daoist Buyu down, Luoshui Guards of the Nine Palaces arrived, blocking Poxiao's action."
"Originally Poxiao could have fled, but it wasn't just one person who arrived. There was another Transcendance Tribulation stage cultivator, and more than thirty Unification stage cultivators from the Five Great Immortal Sects, and more than ten from the imperial court."
The Imperial Teacher let out a sigh, raising his hand indicating he didn't have to continue. He could already guess what had happened next.
With so many cultivators taking action, there was no way Poxiao could have escaped. It was even difficult for him to commit suicide.
The subordinate angrily stated: "If it weren't for these people rushing in, our sovereign would have definitely escaped!"
The Imperial Teacher shook his head, the matter was not as simple as he had imagined, as he began to calmly analyze the causes and consequences of the event.
"There are three doubtful points about this matter."
"First, why did Daoist Buyu enter Steadfast City? Was it really a coincidence?"
"Second, how did the paper crane penetrate the curtain, and who created the paper crane, and what is their cultivation level?"
"Third, does the convenient appearance of the imperial court and Immortal Sect cultivators in Ji State indicate a coincidence or a premeditated plan?"
"If you think about it carefully, these three doubtful points can be connected."
The subordinate merely nodded in agreement before the Imperial Teacher, not daring to raise his head. However, he was actually a formidable Unification cultivator and once a dominant figure with extraordinary acuity in the early days of Great Yu. He had merely been stunned by the unexpected news. Now that the Imperial Teacher had pointed things out, he also started to understand.
The subordinate followed the Imperial Teacher's reasoning: "Daoist Buyu had already discovered something unusual about Steadfast City before he entered. He contacted the royal side in advance, letting them ambush the surroundings. He entered the city alone to investigate the situation.
Both sides agreed in advance that if there was no news within several days, those outside the city would use the paper crane to break the curtain."
"After a few days, the paper crane penetrated the curtain, and a great battle began!"
The Imperial Teacher nodded, his subordinate was quite intelligent, his thoughts were almost in line with his own, and he added a few points.
"The paper crane does not seem to be something a Transcendence Tribulation stage cultivator could deploy. It should have been done by a Semi-Immortal level person."
The Imperial Teacher tapped his chair, revealing a touch of relief: "At that time in Steadfast City, there must have definitely been a Semi-Immortal level overseer. One Semi-Immortal, two Transcendence Tribulation stages, and more than forty in the Unification stage. Was that team meant to catch Poxiao? No, they were there to catch me!"
The Imperial Teacher continued: "I once studied Daoist Buyu, and found that he behaves peculiarly and hard to fathom. As the Sect Leader, why would he abandon Seek Dao Sect and travel everywhere, even taking on the role of a storyteller? Is this something a Unification stage cultivator, a sect leader would do?"
The subordinate nodded in agreement. He, also at the Unification stage and a sect leader himself, certainly wouldn't do such a thing.
"After this incident, I finally understood his intention!"
"He has been roaming around telling stories under the pretense of seeking us out!"
With the Imperial Teacher's explanation, the subordinate had a sudden realization, the wisdom of the Imperial Teacher was indeed beyond his reach.
"So, that's it!"
"This Daoist Buyu, no, not just Daoist Buyu, but the entire Seek Dao Sect is a hindrance to the restoration of Great Yu!"
"Heavenly Calamity Sovereign was captured by the Seek Dao Sect at the Qingzhou feast."
"Huang Ming, who had been planted in Corpse Chasing Sect, was exposed by a disciple of the Seek Dao Sect, forcing His Majesty to act ahead of time, and the plan failed. We have lost contact with all three of the them till now!"
"And now Daoist Buyu has been searching for us everywhere."
"Every step of our plan has been thwarted by the Seek Dao Sect. Once or twice could be considered a coincidence, but three times in a row suggests that the fate of Seek Dao Sect is blocking the rise of Great Yu!"
"Seek Dao Sect has a history of 120,000 years, founded during the time of our Great Yu Dynasty. But now they are working against Great Yu every step of the way, truly ungrateful!"
"Do they think that by siding with the royal court and forming the so-called Five Great Immortal Sects, they can save their lives?!"
A killer intent emanated from the Imperial Teacher's eyes that made the subordinate shudder.
The last time the Imperial Teacher showed this look, was 180,000 years ago. Back then, the Imperial Teacher was in seclusion, and most of the Transcendence Tribulation stage cultivators fell into slumber, awaiting the arrival of the Great Era.
Six Transcendence Tribulation stage cultivators joined forces, displaying an overwhelming ambition, intending to rebel and overthrow the regime.
The six Transcendence Tribulation stage cultivators together shook heaven and earth, who could stand against them? One city after another was captured, the rebel army advanced unrestrained, even the imperial city fell in the end.
Just at this moment, the Imperial Teacher left his seclusion, taking on the six alone, he had the upper hand. In the end, he killed all six Transcendence Tribulation stage cultivators, burying a million rebels. Over the sky of the Central Continent, a cloud of blood lingered for three days.
Is the Imperial Teacher preparing to take on Seek Dao Sect this time?
The subordinate clenched his fist in excitement, it's time to teach Seek Dao Sect a lesson!
The six Transcendence Tribulation stage cultivators were no match for the Imperial Teacher, a small Seek Dao Sect wouldn't be able to withstand the Imperial Teacher's wrath, would they?
The Imperial Teacher slowly rose, like a giant beast awakening from a long sleep. Upon
awakening, it roared to the heavens, tearing apart the void, showing the world the terror and the greatness of the beast.
He ordered the subordinates decisively, "Gather everyone, prepare for action!"
The subordinate excitedly looked at the Imperial Teacher: "Are we taking action against Seek Dao Sect?"
The Imperial Teacher looked at the subordinate as if he were an idiot: "Poxiao has been captured, Great Xia will definitely find the location of this cavern. Naturally, we have to relocate."
The subordinate: "..."

chapters.title: Chapter 467 - 466: Kill Lu Yang First_1
chapters.content:
New unoccupied caverns submerged in spiritual energy where the Great Yu's monks began to move things out from their storage rings in order to decorate their new cave worlds.
Even palaces could be moved out of storage rings. Quickly, grand and magnificent palaces stood erect among the desolate cave worlds.
Next to a palace was an unnoticeable thatched cottage. It was the dwelling place of the Imperial Teacher.
The Imperial Teacher preferred a simplistic lifestyle, so his living quarters were very low-key and simple.
Sitting on a small stool, the Imperial Teacher had deep, profound eyes, like an ancient well, inscrutable to the end — the image of a sage planning strategies behind the scenes.
"Safe at last."
"How shameful it is to be forced to relocate by the Seek Dao Sect!"
He was none other than the second Imperial Teacher of Great Yu, the inheritor and champion of Great Yu's glory. Several emperors have become revered leaders under his tutelage.
The first Imperial Teacher had two distinguished disciples — his eldest disciple conquered all four corners, establishing the Great Yu dynasty and was later hailed as the first Emperor Yu, whereas he was the second disciple of the first Imperial Teacher.
He was not just the second Imperial Teacher, but also the Junior Brother of the first Emperor Yu. Who in the world would dare disrespect him!
His cultivation level was extremely terrifying. He single-handedly suppressed six cultivators who were at the Transcendence Tribulation stage.
All these were caused by Daoist Buyu's scheming which led to Poxiao's capture and the leak of the cave's location.
Even his subordinates showed anger. A mere sect daring to challenge the splendor of a dynasty: "Damned Seek Dao Sect!"
The Imperial Teacher's eyes darkened as he analyzed how to deal with the Seek Dao Sect. "So far, the Seek Dao Sect has thrice obstructed the path of Great Yu."
"During the Qingzhou grand ceremony, a monk from the Seek Dao Sect made a move, but under the influence of the State Destiny, we could not identify this Seek Dao Sect cultivator."
"Then there's a Junior Disciple named Lu Yang from the Golden Core Stage who identified Huang Ming, who was deployed in the Corpse Chasing Sect."
"Lastly, there's Daoist Buyu, the Sect Leader of Seek Dao Sect, who set a trap and captured Poxiao."
"These three must die. Starting with Lu Yang, who has the lowest status, if Great Yu does not make a move, we will become the laughingstock of Great Xia, let alone Great Qian who is hiding someplace."
Great Yu and Great Qian both intended to replace Great Xia, and they were in competition. The Imperial Teacher had tried several times to find out where Great Qian was hiding, hoping that Great Qian and Great Xia would fight and both get hurt, thereby enabling Great Yu to profit from it.
Regrettably, he found nothing.
The Imperial Teacher ordered his subordinate, "Go check on this Junior Disciple called Lu Yang. Find out where he is now, and if possible, kill him."
"Yes, sir!"
After his subordinate left, the Imperial Teacher thought. According to the information he received, a third party appeared during the Battle of Hanshui City — an immortal who called himself the Supreme Dou Tianzun of Heaven's Court, who defeated all three of Wu Youdao.
"What is the origin of this Heaven's Court? And who is Dou Tianzun?"
The Imperial Teacher, being a scholarly immortal, was rather clear about the current power distribution, but he had never heard of Heaven's Court or Dou Tianzun.
"This Heaven's Court seems to have sprung up out of the blue. How strange."
"Why did Heaven's Court intervene to stop Wu Youdao and why has it set its sights on the State Destiny?"
Five days later, his subordinate reported back.
"Did you find Lu Yang?"
"Reporting to the Imperial Teacher, yes we did."
"Did you kill him?"
"Well…"
"You couldn't even kill a Golden Core Stage Junior Cultivator?!" The Imperial Teacher was clearly irate. He was disgruntled by his subordinate's work efficiency. If everyone had this attitude, how could Great Yu be restored!
His subordinate was on the verge of tears. "Sir, Lu Yang has become the Acting Sect Master."
"What?"
The Imperial Teacher thought he had heard wrong. Despite his disdain for the Seek Dao Sect, he didn't expect them to be in such a predicament that a Golden Core Stage Junior Cultivator was appointed as the Acting Sect Master.
He refrained from acting against Daoist Buyu because Daoist Buyu was the Sect Leader, too conspicuous, and action against him would likely lead to mistakes.
Now that Lu Yang has become the Acting Sect Master, there would certainly be many people protecting him. Acting rashly would be unwise.
"According to the information I gathered, this involves a power struggle within the Seek Dao Sect. The power of the Seek Dao Sect has been dominated for years by a monk named Yun Zhi, who is essentially the Sect Leader.
Yun Zhi is Daoist Buyu's Eldest Disciple, her cultivation level is unknown, but Daoist Buyu did not want Yun Zhi to hold power for a long time and render him a puppet, so he had his Junior Disciple Lu Yang to be the Acting Sect Master."
The Imperial Teacher chuckled: "You are looking at the problem too superficially. Lu Yang is merely at the Golden Core Stage, how can he compete with his Senior Sister for power? It's clear that the Seek Dao Sect has anticipated my intention to act against Lu Yang and had him appointed as Acting Sect Master in advance to protect him!"
"Let me ask you, did Lu Yang become the Acting Sect Master right after he returned from Hanshui City?"
His subordinate was astounded and began to admire the Imperial Teacher even more. "You are indeed insightful, sir. That guy Lu Yang indeed became the Acting Sect Master after returning from Hanshui City!"
They followed the Imperial Teacher because he had an extraordinary talent for strategy, leaving nothing to chance!
The Imperial Teacher took on an air of understanding. "Hmph! No coincidences happen this often in the world. There are always calculations behind them."
"So how about that Lu Yang..."
"Kill! He must be killed!"
"A mere Seek Dao Sect... even if they have foreseen Great Yu's retaliation, could they protect a lowly Golden Stage Cultivator?"
"I will make the Seek Dao Sect and all the people in the world realize that in the face of absolute power, any plot is futile!"
His subordinate was overjoyed. He could already imagine the look on the Seek Dao Sect's faces after they killed Lu Yang — dumbfounded, enraged, but helpless!
"I have also gathered that the Seek Dao Sect will hold a sect celebration in two months to mark its 120,000th anniversary. Many different powers will be invited to the event, and we could use this chance to infiltrate the sect!"
The Seek Dao Sect had tight security measures, strict checks for entry and exit. Only during large scale events like these did they let their guard down.
"There's such a thing, huh." The Imperial Teacher's eyes sparkled with a smile creeping around his lips. "It seems that fate is indeed on the side of Great Yu."
"On its 120,000th anniversary, it will be time for the Seek Dao Sect to be destroyed."
He casually threw out a line, sentencing the Seek Dao Sect to death.
If they couldn't even handle the Seek Dao Sect, how could they talk about restoring Great Yu?
...
Meanwhile, Lu Yang was oblivious to the fact that he had been targeted by the Imperial Teacher of Great Yu and had been put on a hit list.
Actually, it was a misunderstanding caused by the asymmetry of information.
During the Qingzhou grand finale, the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign would have been able to escape, but was defeated by the Eldest Senior Sister summoned by Lu Yang.
At Hanshui City, Wu Youdao and the others were about to gain the power of the State Destiny, but they were stopped by Fairy Eternity who lived inside Lu Yang and who also caught Wu Youdao and his companions.
In Steadfast City, the paper crane that flew towards Daoist Buyu was instructed by Lu Yang.
If Imperial Teacher of Great Yu had known these three incidents were related to Lu Yang, Lu Yang would have been on the hit list long ago, and they certainly would not have waited until today.
Even if Lu Yang knew that he had been put on a hit list, he wouldn't care too much.
He had more important things to deal with now.
"Eldest Senior Sister, are you saying that as the Acting Sect Master, I have to go to the palace for a meeting?"

chapters.title: Chapter 468 - 467: The Gathering of Ancient Immortals_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang is currently impersonating Fairy Eternity while exercising the powers of the Acting Sect Master and planning the contents of the sect celebration.
After all, he can't just have everyone come over to eat, drink, and then finish the event after Fairy Eternity gives the opening and closing remarks, can he?.
This would be uncharacteristically bland for the sect's 120,000th anniversary celebration. Not just for Eldest Senior Sister, but even Lu Yang himself couldn't bear to watch this.
Only Fairy Eternity might be fine with it.
"For a celebration, why not just let everyone have a good time? Why make it so complicated?"
Fairy Eternity speaks from her own perspective, advising Lu Yang to discard the complexity of modern celebrations: "Our ancient immortal gatherings weren't even as complicated as yours. When I wanted to cook, the Qilin Immortal and the others would try to stop me, so I wouldn't become too tired."
An ancient immortal meeting basically involves Fairy Eternity using her personal charm to gather the other four unfortunate ones, and occasionally the wives of the Qilin Immortal.
"Well, what do you guys do at the gatherings?"
"We exchange cultivation experiences. As you know, there were only five of us immortals in the world at that time. It was hard to find others to interact with, so we all cherished each gathering."
"During the gatherings, everyone spoke freely, studied the wonderful uses of Dao Fruit, and the collision of thoughts often brought about new ideas or challenges for future generations."
Lu Yang nodded, this sounded right, like the common image of immortals, discussing the Dao, testing future generations.
"Like what, specifically?"
"I, for instance, researched how to create the largest explosion possible."
"Yingtian Immortal asked everyone if there are other tricky penalties you could think of."
"Time Immortal mentioned that he discovered a new use for the Time Dao Fruit. He created a mysterious space where time flows differently from the outside world. One day of cultivation inside was equivalent to a year passing in the outside world."
Lu Yang: "..."
Please don't bring disaster to the world.
"Sometimes, we also weave stories about the Heavenly Court, Buddhism, and things of that sort. Don't underestimate these stories. Each tale, carefully crafted by the five of us, contains profound wisdom that could enlighten future generations."
"Yingtian Immortal said this could also conveniently leave the future generations confused about the ancient history. This allows us to hide any times we may have disgraced ourselves."
Lu Yang felt that Yingtian Immortal was a hard character. With the help of Fairy Eternity, who was a bit of a drag, he did a lot to maintain his imposing manner. He just wondered if Yingtian Immortal knew that he had become a playboy in the eyes of future generations, an image of a man who impregnated countless female cultivators.
He empathizes with Yingtian Immortal and hoped the latter would understand him as well and would spare his life when he eventually comes to claim it.
"Sometimes we play with the planets, throwing them back and forth. The living beings below call this a meteor shower, seeing it as a miracle and making wishes when they see us throwing planets."
Lu Yang was a great listener, quietly listening to Fairy Eternity recount the history of the ancient times, occasionally asking guided questions. He listened for half an hour.
They say history repeats itself, and that we can use history as a reference in our actions. He carefully pondered the experiences from the ancient immortal gatherings, told by Fairy Eternity, looking for any useful points that he could utilize. In the end, Lu Yang concluded--
He wasted half an hour.
At this moment, Eldest Senior Sister walked into the abode. Although her expression seemed unchanged as usual, Lu Yang, being her Junior Brother, had a fifty percent success rate in detecting her subtle expressions.
He concluded that Eldest Senior Sister came with a purpose.
Although Fairy Eternity didn't have Lu Yang's success rate in detection, she also made the same judgment.
After all, she was doing a great job as the Acting Sect Master, and Miss Yun wouldn't visit the abode without a reason.
Fairy Eternity felt quite satisfied by the sight. With her as the Acting Sect Master, Lu Yang and Miss Yun were like her right and left hands, helping out with various matters.
"Eldest Senior Sister, what is the matter?" Currently, Lu Yang was the one in control of his body.
"I just received a message. Emperor Xia has an idea he would like to implement, and he is inviting the leaders of the Five Great Immortal Sects to the palace for a meeting."
Lu Yang and Eldest Senior Sister locked eyes for several seconds, then he pointed at himself in disbelief, thinking he might have heard wrong: "Me?"
"Not you, but Fairy Eternity." Eldest Senior Sister corrected earnestly.
"Well that's good... Wait, how is that any different!"
"How can there be no difference? It is me, the immortal going to the meeting, not you!" Fairy Eternity glared at Lu Yang, suspecting that he might be planning a coup!
Lu Yang brushed off Fairy Eternity's protests.
Although he had many titles, including the disciple of Daoist Buyu, junior brother of Yun Zhi, second-in-command of the Eternity sect, founder of Eternity faith, young Master of Heaven's Court, a host for Fairy Eternity, the most powerful cultivator at the Golden Core Stage, and the record breaker of challenging beyond his cultivation level, he was still uneasy about sitting in a meeting with Emperor Xia and the other leaders of the Four Great Immortal Sects, discussing the matters of the Righteous Path.
"I will be going with you." Eldest Senior Sister finally gave him some good news.
Lu Yang felt slightly relieved. After all, he was only at the Golden Core Stage. Having Eldest Senior Sister by his side would certainly help ease the pressure.
"Let's go."
There really wasn't much need to prepare for the meeting, it was enough just to show up. Eldest Senior Sister walked out of the abode and looked up at the sky. She pinched her thumb and index finger together, causing a piece of cloud to disappear in the sky, and a lucky cloud appeared under her feet.
"Acting Sect Master, please."
Since Lu Yang's body was possessed, Fairy Eternity took no reservations in using Lu Yang's body to board the cloud.
With a dismissive attitude, Fairy Eternity stood on the cloud, crossed her arms over her chest, looking straight ahead.
"Miss Yun, let's start."
Whoosh——
The fortunate cloud suddenly accelerated. Fairy Eternity didn't react in time and failed to stabilize herself, rolling from the head of the cloud to the tail, clinging on to the cloud with half her body hanging out.
It took her quite a bit of effort to crawl back onto the fortunate cloud, looking quite embarrassed.
"Miss Yun, you did that on purpose!" She glared at Miss Yun with a pout on her face.
Miss Yun responded nonchalantly: "No, it was an accident."
"It was on purpose!"
"An accident."
"On purpose!"
"Accident."
Lu Yang, interrupting the brewing battle between them, asked: "By the way, Eldest Senior Sister, did Emperor Xia mention what this meeting will be about?"
"He mentioned holding a competition for young cultivators, for screening those who wish to start over after disbanding their cultivation."
"What?"
...
The Imperial Teacher looked up as the lucky cloud flew over his head, squinting his eyes.
"What's wrong, Imperial Teacher?" his subordinate asked, eager to help.
"That was Lu Yang who just rode past on that fortunate cloud."
The subordinate was shocked: "What?! Should we attack him now?"
They had come near Seek Dao Sect to study the lay of the land, to see how they could infiltrate the sect and plan for the upcoming events.
They didn't expect to run into their target just as they neared Seek Dao Sect.
The Imperial Teacher shook his head, he had his plans: "Not now, killing Lu Yang now would be letting him off too easy. We must wait until the grand ceremony begins and kill him under the watchful eyes of everyone!"
Not only did he want to kill Lu Yang, but also destroy Seek Dao Sect!

chapters.title: Chapter 469 - 468: First Visit to the Imperial City_1
chapters.content:
In the palace of Great Xia.
Emperor Xia and the leaders of the Four Great Immortal Sects sat in unease, neither sitting nor standing comfortably, encountering such a situation for the first time in the many meetings they've had.
Lu Yang sat in the position of the Sect Leader of the Seek Dao Sect, with Yun Zhi standing behind him, assuming the appearance of a subordinate.
With Yun Zhi standing, who would dare sit?
Fairy Eternity would.
After all, the one invited to the meeting was the acting sect leader of the Seek Dao Sect, and Fairy Eternity was the acting sect leader.
As the leader of the Five Immortals of the Ancients, why can't she sit here?
It was even acceptable for her to sit on the throne.
In the spiritual space, Lu Yang didn't have as great courage as Fairy Eternity.
The Imperial City, as the largest and most prosperous city in the Central Continent and the hub of power, has always attracted countless cultivators.
Lu Yang was no exception. He longed for the Imperial City and was eager to take a tour, to experience different cultivation landscapes.
But he didn't expect it to come so quickly.
Originally, he planned to enter the Imperial City quietly, but an unintentional act led him into a conspiracy. After resolving it, he found himself in the vortex of political struggles, fighting for power and the throne. He skillfully navigated the vortex, which eventually drew the attention of Emperor Xia.
When he attended the court and met the emperor, his enemies made accusations, saying he had intention to rebel, slandering him. Emperor Xia waved his hand, gave his enemies a meaningful glance and asserted that Lu Yang, being Daoist Buyu's disciple, could never rebel. His enemies, court officials and cultivators in the Imperial City were taken aback.
His fame naturally grew.
This was the normal course.
He did not expect to jump directly over the process and meet Emperor Xia in the palace.
"Fellow Daoist Yun, please take a seat," Emperor Xia said with a forced smile.
Yun Zhi declined with a shake of her head, "I am now just an ordinary disciple of the Seek Dao Sect, how do I qualify to sit? Sect Master Lu here is the acting sect leader of our Seek Dao Sect."
Emperor Xia: "..."
Such an ordinary disciple of the Seek Dao Sect.
"Is this Sect Master Lu the same Lu Yang mentioned in the meeting half a month ago?" Emperor Xia asked even though he already knew the answer. Half a month ago, it was mentioned that the Heaven's Court was founded by a very outstanding young talent named Lu Yang.
He didn't expect that in just half a month, this young talent had already risen to a level equal to his.
Lu Yang secretly observed Emperor Xia in the spiritual space. The earthly emperor and righteous leader didn't seem as stern and firm as the rumors said, nor did he have the glamorous aura of a scholar. His temples were white, his cheeks slightly hollow, indicating insufficient Qi and Blood, and lack of energy.
If his identity was not known, no one would believe that this Emperor Xia was called the Emperor of All Ages.
Perhaps the previous Emperor Xia had both stern and scholarly traits, but after losing his lifespan, he was no longer as glorious as before.
"Emperor Xia, you know. You also know Sect Leader Qiu." Before the meeting, Eldest Senior Sister introduced Lu Yang, and gave Fairy Eternity a brief introduction.
"This is Fellow Daoist Luo Hongxia, the Palace Master of Laurel Fairy Palace, and the teacher of Lan Ting. She previously brought Lan Ting to propose marriage."
Luo Hongxia's eyes twitched, she did not go to propose marriage last time.
Looking at Lu Yang who was clean and tidy, she thought that this was the Lu Yang whom Lan Ting thought of day and night. He did not look as handsome as Lan Ting had described.
Whenever she thought of Lan Ting's excited description of how amazing Lu Yang was after returning from the Qingzhou Festival, she was filled with frustration.
She snorted coldly and didn't show any pleasant expression to Lu Yang.
"Looking so upset, did you eat something wrong?"
"This is Yang Ding, the Sect Leader of the Prison Suppressing Sect."
"Nice to meet you." Yang Ding harbored no hostility towards Lu Yang.
Even though Lu Yang was the disciple of Daoist Buyu, he was also Yun Zhi's junior brother. The positive and negative feelings cancelled each other out, resulting in no hostility.
"This is Master Jiesha from the Suspension Temple, who is currently practicing Silent Zen." Eldest Senior Sister introduced the only one in the transcendance tribulation stage among those present.
Master Jiesha's body was thin and dried up, the Kāṣāya passed down through generations in the Suspension Temple hung loosely on him; his eyelids drooped, and he held a rosary in his hand. He nodded without speaking.
Fairy Eternity was slightly surprised. This was the first time she had seen a high monk of Buddhism, and she didn't expect that the Buddhism they Five Immortals created would actually allow later generations to cultivate something, and even innovate on this basis.
The wisdom of later generations was indeed not to be underestimated, not inferior to hers.
Fairy Eternity frowned slightly.
"What's wrong?" Lu Yang asked.
"Someone is spying on us, it should be the person in control of the State Destiny." Fairy Eternity's counter-surveillance awareness was very strong, she was, after all, one of the people who could track the Five Immortals of the Ancients.
Lu Yang understood, it should be the immortals from the court side paying attention to this place; it was normal.
Just as Emperor Xia was about to speak, the Eldest Senior Sister took the lead and said, "After I returned to the sect, I visited many predecessors. One of them, who is learned and insightful, mentioned a method that can break through the lifespan limit and prolong one's life. "
"What's the method?" The others returned to their sects but found no way to help Emperor Xia out of his dilemma.
"In ancient times, there was a Heavenly Spirit Root, a peach tree. Eating its peaches can prolong one's life. However, this Heavenly Spirit Root can move and has run off somewhere."
"Is that so?" The others were moved, having never heard of such a thing regarding the Spirit Root before. The Seek Dao Sect truly had terrifying roots.
"I will send people to look for it." Emperor Xia was the first to regain his composure. There was no use in being anxious about this matter; whether or not they could find it depended on fate.
He then brought up another important matter, "The plans of the Great Yu cultivators in Ji State have been uncovered. Daoist Buyu from your sect was the first to discover Great Yu's plans. To rescue the citizens of the Dawn, he plunged himself into the situation.
With one sword, he broke the heavens, shattered the rules of the Great Yu's Transcendance Tribulation stage, fought against Great Yu's Transcendance Tribulation stage, matched wits and courage against each other, and sent out a signal.
He held on until the arrival of Palace Master Chen Tao and the Immortal Sect, and finally helped Palace Master Chen Tao capture the Great Yu's Transcendance Tribulation stage."
"This led to a round of applause and Chen Tao Palace Lord and the elders from the Immortal Sect highly praised and admired Daoist Buyu's actions. They wanted to commend him, but Daoist Buyu walked away from the recognition, staying out of the limelight. Despite several searches, they couldn't find him."
The people present looked strange. They had all heard the elders reporting about the situation in Steadfast City of Ji State. This seemed slightly different from what the elders reported, didn't it?
"Who wrote this report?" Qiu Jin'an wondered, had the spies from the Seek Dao Sect infiltrated the court?
Daoist Buyu had been exalted to the heavens in it.
With a dark face, Emperor Xia said, "It's from the popular storytelling series, "Legend of the Dao Sect"."
Qiu Jin'an: "..."
Everyone turned to look at Lu Yang and Yun Zhi. The meaning was clear, Daoist Buyu was their man, always causing trouble. So, what do you think should we do about it?
Being extremely intelligent, Fairy Eternity was ready for such a situation. She resorted to Yun Zhi's arguments, "As an acting Sect Leader, I was appointed by the Sect Leader, I have no control over the Sect Leader."
"So?"
"So, I can draft a letter, suggesting that the Sect Leader should abdicate and let a capable person take over, so that I can be the sect leader and control him then."

chapters.title: Chapter 470 - 469: The Increasingly Lively Anniversary Celebration_1
chapters.content:
The words of Fairy Eternity left everyone startled.
True to being the little disciple of Daoist Buyu, she was already coveting power and seeking to usurp the throne despite being at the Golden Core Stage.
Even the Eldest Senior Sister cast a sidelong glance.
Lu Yang facepalmed, knowing that nothing good could come out of attending the meeting in the Imperial City.
You, Fairy, should stop mimicking Eldest Senior Sister all the time. Even if you could imitate her speech, you would never be able to rival her abilities.
Neither our master nor Senior Sister would agree to you being the Sect Leader indefinitely!
Eldest Senior Sister, isn't that right?
Lu Yang turned to Eldest Senior Sister, who seemed deep in thought, contemplating the feasibility of Fairy's suggestion.
Emperor Xia coughed lightly to change the topic, "Let's leave Daoist Buyu out of this. We have learned the location of the Imperial Teacher from the ones in Transcendance Tribulation Stage in Great Yu. Mr. Chen Tao hastened there at the earliest opportunity, but unfortunately, he was a step too late.
The Imperial Teacher and his subordinates had already fled, leaving nothing behind, not even a trace of soil, which had been scraped off using a storage ring."
Emperor Xia sighed helplessly. The court had already acted swiftly, even skipping the stage of severe torture for Poxiao and directly soul-searched him to learn the location of the Imperial Teacher as quickly as possible.
However, Great Yu was no pushover either. They had abandoned their Cave Heaven and fled with a speed matching that of the elusive Eternity Sect.
With the Nine Nether Sect being manipulated by Heaven's Court and disabled, the dual Imperial Teachers of Great Yu undoubtedly posed the gravest threat at present. Capturing them at the earliest would reduce some pressure on the court.
"The major reason for calling everyone here is to discuss the matter of ancient cultivators disbanding their cultivation to start anew. We have typically been focusing on the Unification Stage and the Pass Tribulation Stage in the past."
"Since Sect Master Lu, who was involved in the matter, is also here, we realized after the incident with Huang Ming of the Corpse Chasing Sect that our previous understanding was mistaken. These ancient cultivators, aiming for a grand opportunity, would resort to any means, even disbanding their cultivation to start over, despite the uncertainties."
"They are still weak and pose no threat for now, but given time, they could grow into a major concern. They could potentially stab us in the back at critical moments or leak top-secret information."
Luo Hongxia slightly frowned, finding the matter quite tricky: "We understand the problem. Do we have any solutions?"
Emperor Xia had gathered everyone as he had some ideas.
"I have a solution. I will personally issue an edict to gather all young cultivators and hold a grand competition starting from the city level up to the state level, then to the national level. All young cultivators must participate, with no excuse whatsoever."
"Taking Qingzhou as an example, let it conduct its internal selection. Choose thirty cultivators for each level, representing the best of young cultivators in Qingzhou. Then gather these cultivators from seventeen states for a grand contest to screen out possible ancient cultivators who disbanded their cultivation and started over."
"Cultivators who disbanded their cultivation to start over have certain characteristics: they have abundant training experience and hence, are unlikely to make mistakes that regular cultivators would. Their fighting style also differs from that of the present cultivators. Using these two points, we could most likely identify them."
The approach seemed feasible. Luo Hongxia was slightly puzzled, "But what if these ancient cultivators concede halfway through the contest? What if they purposely lose in the state-level competition, preventing them from coming before us?"
Emperor Xia shook his head: "Concede? Noble ancient cultivators at the Unification Stage purposely conceding against peers after starting over? Their dignity wouldn't allow them to do so. Conceding would leave a flaw in their mindset that would impede their practice."
Lu Yang could vouch for this. During his fight with Huang Ming, the latter had resorted to using a technique like the Spiritual Arrow Feathers for the sake of victory. He'd rather expose his identity than lose to Lu Yang.
"Why only young cultivators? Can't older ones participate?" Fairy was slightly confused but did not voice her question out loud; she asked Lu Yang quietly instead.
"Think about it, Fairy. What do cultivators aim for when disbanding their cultivation to start over? They wish to perfect each level before progressing to the next. Why would they choose to spend their entire life on a single level? There's no benefit in doing so."
"Sounds reasonable. That's more or less what I thought."
Yang Ding considered a flaw in the plan: "What if your edict doesn't work and the cultivators who disbanded their cultivation to start over don't show up?"
"For those affiliated with Sects, it's easy. With the edict in place, even if they don't wish to participate, the Sect Elders would force them to."
"But what if we encounter those who, after starting over, hide in the Cave Heaven and refuse to come out until they reach the Unification Stage?"
"We can't do anything about that. If they hide in the Cave Heaven, no one can find them. No edict would work, but such cases should be rare. Would they resist exploring the new world that is Great Xia? Would they not want to study new cultivation theories, understand the power distribution, and choose to focus on closed-door training instead?"
"And even if they hide in the Cave Heaven and only come out after reaching the Unification Stage, they are just a few more Unification cultivators without any core information and pose no threat."
After Emperor Xia's explanation, everyone agreed that this plan was reasonable. Although it won't find all the ancient cultivators who disbanded their cultivation, identifying some of them would also be beneficial.
"Should the Immortal Sect send someone to participate?"
"Yes, cultivators who disbanded their cultivation to start over have reached the epitome at each level. Ordinary cultivators may not be able to defeat them. Do we want these ancient cultivators to win the championship?"
"Disciples of the Immortal Sect ought to prepare."
"Alright."
"As the Seek Dao Sect is soon to host a ceremony, we can schedule the grand finale, the national competition, there. What do you think, Sect Master Lu?" Emperor Xia turned to ask Lu Yang.
"Of course, there's no problem." Fairy Eternity responsive instantly. She had already secured Yun Zhi's approval; it was feasible.
The more people, the more bustling the ceremony, and the better she could showcase her competence as the Acting Sect Master!
Luo Hongxia looked at the pleased Fairy Eternity and suggested: "By the way, Sect Master Lu, you managed to defeat Huang Ming, who disbanded his cultivation, at the same level. Sect Leader Qiu also never stops praising you. Would you be willing to demonstrate your unique skills?"
Although it was proposed as a contest, the real intention was to teach Lu Yang a lesson. The chastisement wouldn't be too harsh, and Yun Zhi wouldn't object.
Fairy Eternity seemed reluctant: "Isn't it unfair to take advantage of your superior position?"
She, as an immortal, was about to fight against a cultivator in the Unification stage. That was almost like a two-tier combat.
Luo Hongxia misunderstood Fairy Eternity and thought she was referring to it being unfair for the Unification cultivator to fight against someone in the Golden Core stage.
She pulled out a small round box from her storage ring: "This is a supreme treasure of the Fairy Palace. It can adjust our levels to be the same, ensuring absolute fair play!"
As the dignified Palace Master of the Laurel Fairy Palace and a top-tier cultivator in the Unification stage, even after adjusting to the same level as Lu Yang, she could easily defeat him!
Hadn't Lu Yang defeated a cultivator who disbanded his cultivation to start over? Only cultivators with weak foundations would resort to such practices. She was far superior to those who disbanded their cultivation to start over!

chapters.title: Chapter 471 - 470 Fairy Eternity Pulls Out The Bay Laurel Tree _1
chapters.content:
"Let's do it then," declared Fairy Eternity, eager and unafraid of Luo Hongxia's challenge.
Since she made her debut, she has been a force to reckon with for sixteen ancient ages, continuously challenging people beyond her level and always victorious. She is the creator of the Invincible Elixir. When it comes to fighting, she fears no one!
Not even Yun Zhi!
Everyone did not attempt to stop the fight. On the contrary, they found it interesting and made way for Luo Hongxia and Fairy Eternity to face off.
Everyone wanted to see just how powerful Lu Yang really was, including Qiu Jin'an.
When Lu Yang had previously battled Huang Ming, Qiu Jin'an felt that Lu Yang had not fully displayed his capabilities and most likely had more tricks up his sleeve.
Luo Hongxia opened a small round box, a treasure made from the horn of a mythical beast known as the Restraining Light Treasure Box.
Invoking the ancestral incantations, Luo Hongxia activated the Restraining Light Treasure Box, which shot out two beams of light, one falling on her and the other on Fairy Eternity.
Just as Fairy Eternity was about to dispel the light beam, Luo Hongxia said, "Don't resist, the treasure box will adjust our realms to the same level."
Upon hearing this, Fairy Eternity gave Luo Hongxia some face and stopped resisting.
With a swoosh, the two were absorbed by the treasure box.
The interior of the box was a boundless space. Its environment could be altered according to the spellcaster's will - mountains, rivers, lakes, oceans, can all be conjured up for environmental battle.
The moment they entered the box, Luo Hongxia's realm began to change, tumbling from the Unification Stage, to Refining the Void Stage, and Divinity Transformation Stage, all the way down to the mid-stage of the Golden Core.
Hence, her physical strength and spiritual power were adjusted accordingly.
"Mid-stage Golden Core... this realm sure brings back memories," said Luo Hongxia with a smile. In her youth, she was also unmatched among geniuses of her level who dared not even fight her.
Now, with the experience from the Unification Stage, she returned to the mid-stage Golden Core realm. Who could be her match!
"Begin!"
Luo Hongxia threw out a seed and cast the "Tree-Planting Sutra." The seed sprouted, growing into a tall laurel tree that swayed vibrantly with life!
This laurel tree could provide her with a continuous source of power.
"Suspend the bright moon!"
Luo Hongxia raised her hand, and a bright moon hung high in the sky. The moonlight spilled onto the earth, turning into spears of light that shot towards Fairy Eternity.
Each spear of light was incredibly powerful. An ordinary mid-stage Golden Core cultivator would be severely injured and lose their combat capability if hit even once.
Fairy Eternity nimbly dodged the attacks, her movements light and graceful like a cat. With a slight shake of her body, she easily evaded the moonlight attacks.
She had developed this "Qilin Step" inspired by the nimble movements of the Qilin Immortal during their previous battle. She admired how his agile moves allowed him to narrowly evade attacks, something that greatly outshone Ying Tian's abilities.
