Seeing that she couldn't hit Fairy Eternity, Luo Hongxia formed hand seals and changed her tactics. The spears of light rained down like a downpour, endless and unceasing.
Against the inevitable attack, Fairy Eternity stomped her foot, and the earth beneath her rippled like a wave. Layer upon layer, it turned into a tsunami of dirt that roared towards Luo Hongxia, threatening to engulf her before the light spears could reach.
She pointed her finger lightly at the ground, and the earth instantly became incredibly solid and unmoving, blocking the rain of light spears.
"Point Ground Into Steel?!" cried out Luo Hongxia in surprise; she hadn't anticipated Lu Yang using this technique.
She sneered, "So what if you can use the ancient magic skill."
"Moon Fall onto Earth!" The moon above rumbled as it fell, crashing towards Fairy Eternity and collided with the unyielding earth, stirring up layers of dust!
When the dust settled and cleared, Luo Hongxia searched for Lu Yang's figure but found nothing.
"No, he's underground!" With her extensive battle experience, Luo Hongxia was all too familiar with this move from her younger days when Qiu Jin'an would often use it to ambush her. Practice makes perfect, and she could react in the shortest possible time.
What Fairy Eternity is using is a legitimate Earth Escape Technique, which isn't much different from Lu Yang's "Shrinking-the-Earth" method.
Luo Hongxia abruptly leapt into the air, hence having a chance to dodge, no matter from which direction Lu Yang would launch a surprise attack.
"Hang the bright moon."
A full moon hung in the sky once again. As long as Lu Yang dared to show his head, he would be attacked by the moonlight again!
Bang.
Fairy Eternity drilled out from the ground, not intending to attack Luo Hongxia, but rather the laurel tree she had planted at the start of the battle.
The magic power needed for Luo Hongxia's attacks couldn't be maintained by someone at the mid-stage of the Golden Core, even Lu Yang was just barely capable. So, the answer was obvious. The laurel tree was providing Luo Hongxia with a continuous supply of power.
This was in fact a battle technique commonly used by the Laurel Fairy Palace. Only students at the Nascent Soul stage could master it skillfully. Lan Ting wasn't able to use it. Relying on her abundant experience, Luo Hongxia managed to display it at the Golden Core stage.
Luo Hongxia was initially taken aback. She hadn't expected the opponent to have such a strong consciousness, and to pinpoint her weakness so quickly. But she soon calmed down.
The laurel tree had no offensive power. It had only two characteristics: one was providing spiritual essence to the caster, and the other was its absolutely formidable defense power!
Even with Lu Yang mastering several strong offensive magic skills, it was simply impossible to break the defense of the laurel tree in a short time!
"It's quite tough." Fairy Eternity casually punched the laurel tree. The tree just shook a bit, without shedding even a leaf.
"Looks like I'll have to use some means... Hundred Grass Withering Fist!"
In order to practice the fairy's boxing technique, she had learned thousands of herb boxing techniques. Out of these herb boxing techniques, she realized a side technique specifically countering herbal creatures. Once used, all plants would wither, no grass could grow, thus it was called Hundred Grass Withering Fist.
The laurel tree took a punch, its leaves turned yellow, and the branches withered. In the blink of an eye, it was dead!
Puff—
Luo Hongxia suddenly spat out a mouthful of blood, her face turned deathly pale. It was the backlash from the laurel tree.
She did not expect her opponent's punch to kill the laurel tree instantly. What kind of fist technique was this!?
So what? Even without the laurel tree, was she going to lose to a junior?
Luo Hongxia swooped down from the high air. Fairy Eternity uprooted the laurel tree and swung it at Luo Hongxia, leaving her dazed.
...
In the palace, a group of influential figures from the Righteous Path were gathered around the treasure box, chattering away.
"Who do you think will win?"
Those outside couldn't see what was happening inside the treasure box, so they could only guess.
"I'd bet on Hongxia. She's experienced in battle and not like those at the Unification stage who had to start over after disbanding cultivation. Lu Yang is just a youngster, how can he fight?" Yang Ding guessed, stroking his chin.
"I think so too." Emperor Xia agreed.
"Lu Yang also has a chance to win." Qiu Jin'an didn't dare to be too absolute with his words. After all, Lu Yang was the little junior brother trained by Yun Zhi. One couldn't be sure what kind of magic skill he would show.
"Look, the treasure box is glowing! We're about to see who the victor is!"
Boom—
Luo Hongxia flew out of the treasure box in a backward posture, seeing stars, her mouth full of leaves.

chapters.title: Chapter 472 - 471: Fairy Eternity Battles the Masters of Four Great Immortal Sects_1
chapters.content:
"Fellow Daoist Luo, are you okay?" Yang Ding was startled. Just as he was asserting Luo Hongxia's certain victory over Lu Yang, suddenly, Luo Hongxia got knocked out.
The position was hardly graceful, with dry yellow leaves all over her mouth and quite a few branches in her hair, like she had crashed into a tree.
"Pah, nothing major, just accidentally got hit by a tree." Luo Hongxia spit out the leaves from her mouth. Her injuries healed and after leaving the treasure box, she returned to the Unification stage.
"Hit by a tree?" Qiu Jin'an was puzzled. Ordinary trees couldn't hurt Luo Hongxia. Had Lu Yang used the "Tree-Planting Sutra" to attack using a tree?
Qiu Jin'an knew Laurel Fairy Palace's tradition of fighting using laurel trees and was aware of their impressive defensive force, but he had never thought that using a laurel tree as a fighting maneuver was possible.
"This junior named Lu Yang is a bit strange. I carelessly fell into his trap," Luo Hongxia bitterly said. Had it not been for the laurel tree suddenly withering, she wouldn't have lost so quickly.
"That powerful? Did you underestimate him, and he seized the opportunity?" Yang Ding looked suspiciously at Luo Hongxia. In her youth, Luo Hongxia had underestimated her opponents several times and faced defeats.
"If you're so capable, you try!" Luo Hongxia fumed.
"I will!" Yang Ding was up for the challenge. Luo Hongxia might have had a habit of underestimating, but he certainly did not.
Coupled with his well-honed war patterns, Yang Ding, using Golden Core Stage war patterns, had better maneuvering, responding capabilities and power than a sword cultivator!
A beam of light shot out from the treasure box and enveloped Yang Ding. Knowing the usage of the Restraining Light Treasure Box, he offered no resistance and successfully entered the treasure box, descending to the Golden Core Stage.
"Fellow Daoist Yang should be able to win." Emperor Xia nodded in approval. Unlike Half-Hermit Laurel Fairy Palace, the disciples of Prison Suppressing Sect who always stood against evil and promoted good possessed more combat experience than Luo Hongxia.
Furthermore, his unique way of practicing war patterns gave Yang Ding greater power when he lowered his realm.
"It should be so." Qiu Jin'an expressed his confidence in Yang Ding. No matter how strong Lu Yang was, it seemed impossible for him to defeat Yang Ding.
Only Master Jiesha and Eldest Senior Sister remained silent.
Whizz-
The treasure box trembled and Yang Ding staggered out. Yang Ding had fallen headfirst and crashed into the ground.
"Damn it, what kind of fighting style is that!"
Yang Ding cursed indignantly, frustrated as he had never felt so aggrieved. Just as his opponents had calculated, every move he made seemed to fall within their designs. Naturally, defeat was inevitable.
"And what about your hair?" Qiu Jin'an asked with a strange expression. Yang Ding had entered with a head of black hair, but came out bald.
He knew the answer, having seen Lu Yang use the Arhat Fist against Huang Ming.
"I've never seen such a detestable fist style. Not just attacking but also causing hair loss!"
Frustrated, Yang Ding rubbed his shiny bald head.
Paired with the tattoos on his body, he looked like a jailbreaking mob boss. Given his appearance, no one would believe he was innocent.
"This is Unity of Fist and Cultivation's Arhat Fist." Eldest Senior Sister explained, causing Master Jiesha's eyes to light up.
The Arhat Fist, a fist style that united with cultivation, with powerful effects like hair loss?
Why hadn't such a great talent come to the Suspension Temple, instead being scooped up by Daoist Buyu?
"Unity of Fist and Cultivation, no wonder." Yang Ding regretted. Although thinking back, the effects of this martial technique indeed resembled Unity of Fist and Cultivation, he just hadn't realised due to the absurd results.
"By the way, Old Qiu, Lu Yang challenged you to a fight." Yang Ding grinned maliciously at Qiu Jin'an.
"Lu Yang said you're merely at a higher cultivation level and if you were the same level, he would beat you to a pulp."
"He's tired of living!"
Infuriated, Qiu Jin'an turned down the challenge. Given the precedents of Luo Hongxia and Yang Ding, he didn't have confidence in defeating Lu Yang and didn't want to step up.
But since Lu Yang had challenged him, how could he not accept?
Qiu Jin'an cared about his reputation too!
A ray of light shot from the treasure box and Qiu Jin'an stepped in.
...
"Why did Sect Leader Yang Ding suddenly step in?" Lu Yang wondered. He had just beaten Luo Hongxia with Fairy Eternity's physical help and was recovering when Yang Ding fell from the sky, challenging him to a duel.
Fairy Eternity used the Invincible Elixir and following the advice of the Invincible Elixir, she managed to defeat Yang Ding. Following this, as per the Invincible Elixir's suggestion, she returned the control of the body to Lu Yang who then unleashed the Arhat Fist, resulting in a combined physical and psychological assault.
"That said, how do I get out?" After defeating two opponents, he should leave. Lu Yang started looking for a way out.
"Lu Yang, you little rascal, you dare challenge me!" A raging roar from Qiu Jin'an descended from the sky, stupefying Lu Yang.
"Let's do this, allow me!" Again invoking the sect leader privilege, Fairy Eternity possessed Lu Yang.
...
Whizz-
The treasure box trembled and a bruised and battered Qiu Jin'an staggered out.
"Old Qiu, are you okay!" Yang Ding ran up, helping Qiu Jin'an.
Giving Yang Ding a fierce look, Qiu Jin'an realised at the end of the fight that Lu Yang had never said any threatening words. Qiu Jin'an pushed Yang Ding away and instantly recovered his cultivation level and health.
"Nothing important, it's just what Lu Yang said at the end that I find disagreeable."
"What did he say?" Yang Ding asked with interest.
"He said Five Elements Sect and Suspension Temple are no match for him alone!" Qiu Jin'an slapped his thigh, angered.
Master Jiesha's hand, twirling a rosary, stopped. His eyes sparked.
Everyone had been defeated, the reputation must be restored. They, few men of the Unification Stage in their early years, lacked experience. But Master Jiesha, a veteran Transcendence Tribulation Stage that returned to the Golden Core Stage, should be able to defeat Lu Yang!
Without further discourse, Master Jiesha, steady as he was, with a mounting aura and a determined gaze, stepped into the treasure box.
Soon, Master Jiesha walked out from the treasure box with a disheveled look, but now with a head full of thick, lustrous hair.
He looked better than the previous three, but only marginally.
Master Jiesha glared at Qiu Jin'an, having known from the recent fight that Lu Yang had never uttered any threats.
"Ahem, we all know about Lu Yang's battle power now. Fellow Daoist Luo, please let him go." Qiu Jin'an coughed twice. Everyone had lost face and felt content now.
Luo Hongxia gave Qiu Jin'an a glare. She had wanted to release Lu Yang long ago, but these guys kept going in one after the other, not giving her a chance to interfere.
She silently commanded and the treasure box opened, releasing Fairy Eternity.
"Huh, is it over? But didn't the Emperor still not get his beating?"
Fairy Eternity scratched her head. She wasn't done fighting yet.
Emperor Xia: "....."

chapters.title: Chapter 473 - 472: Internal Battle of the Immortal Sect_1
chapters.content:
Emperor Xia recalled, other than always betting against Lu Yang, he hadn't done anything to provoke him.
Considering that they couldn't feel a thing inside the treasure box, it was quite clear - Lu Yang just simply wanted to beat him up.
Emperor Xia was absolutely against the idea of going one-on-one with Lu Yang.
Joking aside, even Master Jiesha was defeated by Lu Yang. He himself was well known for his non-martial prowess, and would definitely be beaten up worse than Luo Hongxia.
Judging by the harsh punishment handed out by Lu Yang, such as making Luo Hongxia chew on leaves, turning Yang Ding into a monk, and causing Master to renounce his monastic life, he probably wouldn't show any respect to an old man like him.
Clap clap clap.
He clapped lightly, seemingly ignoring Fairy Eternity's challenge, wearing a smile as refreshing as a spring breeze.
"Good, good, good. As expected from the young geniuses, such impressive battle prowess at such a young age, what a promising future!"
Fairy Eternity nodded, graciously accepting Emperor Xia's praise. This was a matter of course. She fought her way to the top, defeating numerous opponents, and becoming an immortal successfully.
"So, do you want to have a match with me?"
Emperor Xia feigned deafness and flattered Lu Yang, "Sect Master Lu, you rose to fame at a young age, you are high-spirited and ambitious. In the coming Great Era, there will definitely be a place for you!"
Fairy Eternity continued nodding. As the leader of the Five Immortals of the Ancients, she was invincible in the world. After her unexpected death and rebirth, she found that people had forgotten her name and legends. With the arrival of the Great Era, she could restore her past glory. She was determined to reclaim everything that belonged to her.
"Words I love to hear. So, do you want to spar with me?"
Emperor Xia went on, "Even though your master is Daoist Buyu, and cannot enter the court, you are after all a citizen of our Great Xia. Once you step down from the position of sect leader, I grant you the privileges to enter the court without bowing, and blade entering the hall."
The rewards were not light, requiring great merits to receive such honors. Though, this was enough to leave one's name in history.
Without mentioning the formidable strength that Lu Yang demonstrated by defeating the leaders of the Four Great Immortal Sects, just based on his key role in the destruction of the Eternity Sect, along with establishing the Heaven's Court and stabilizing the Nine Nether Sect, Emperor Xia was inclined to give such rewards to him.
Of course, the real reason was that Emperor Xia wanted to buy himself some time.
Emperor Xia was frantically signaling for Qiu Jin'an and the others to help change the subject.
He couldn't count on Yun Zhi. Whenever he sent any signals to Yun, Yun just returned a blank expression.
Qiu Jin'an coughed twice and praised Lu Yang as if he wasn't the one who was just beaten, "Sect Master Lu's battle awareness is outstanding. Even though I held back a little, forcing me into this state is not easy. When I was at the Golden Core Stage, I fought invincibly across the world without a single loss."
Yang Ding nodded, stroked his shiny bald head, and commented on the battle just now.
"Well said, Sect Master Lu's battle awareness is among the strongest I've seen in my life. He is a natural fighter. At such a young age, he has mastered the essence of Unity of Fist and Cultivation. It is no surprise that he is a junior brother nurtured by Fellow Daoist Yun.
Unfortunately, during our fight just now, I felt guilty about overpowering someone younger, and did not use my full strength and was unintentionally defeated. If I were at the Golden Core Stage, I would definitely spar with Sect Master Lu. I have never been afraid of anyone in fights at the Golden Core Stage."
Luo Hongxia looked at the two shameless people with disdain, feeling that being an Immortal Sect leader with them was a humiliation.
"Sect Master Lu's magic skills are also not bad, unheard of. It seems to be uniquely his own. Just with this ability, defeating those rogue cultivators who started over after disbanding cultivation should not be a problem. If I were at the Golden Core Stage, my winning rate >against those rogue cultivators would only be ninety percent, hardly worth mentioning."
What is an Immortal Sect leader? Not only do they need a high cultivation level, but they also represent the face of the sect externally, with extremely high requirements. Lu Yang felt that the three of them deserved to be the leaders of the Immortal Sects, their thick skins could rival his master's.
Fairy Eternity was successfully diverted, and did not bring up the one-on-one challenge with Emperor Xia again. Curious, she asked, "Then, among you three who were so powerful at the Golden Core Stage, who was the strongest?"
"Haha, that's a good question. I was the strongest when I was at the Golden Core Stage." The three Immortal Sect leaders said at the same time.
As soon as these words came out, the atmosphere suddenly turned tense.
Even Lu Yang, who was in the spiritual space, could feel this tense and solemn atmosphere.
The three leaders exchanged glances, moved their feet to stand apart, and were slightly vigilant.
Qiu Jin'an's eyes narrowed slightly, and he said carelessly, "I was the strongest in the Golden Core Stage, wasn't I? At that time, I challenged many levels higher than mine, and even destroyed a branch of the Eternity Sect. Both the Rudder Master and the Deputy_Rudder_Master were at the Nascent Soul Stage, and I captured them both alive."
Yang Ding chuckled coldly, "Laughable, that was when I was imprisoned by Old Buyu. Otherwise, I would have made my name known to the world long ago. Who can't defeat those at the Nascent Soul Stage?"
Luo Hongxia was also filled with confidence and refused to be left behind, "When we were at the Golden Core Stage, we cooperated against outsiders to deal with the Nine Sons of the Seek Dao Sect, so we never had a chance to compete. Now, the timing seems just right."
"Let's do it!"
"Who's afraid of who!"
"Let's do it!"
Luo Hongxia activated the treasure box, which shot out three beams of light, sucking the three of them into the box, and suppressing their cultivation to the Golden Core Stage.
The three of them entered the box, the solemn atmosphere dissipated, and the air returned to calm.
Fairy Eternity blinked, not understanding why they suddenly started to fight.
"I thought the Five Great Immortal Sects were united against a common enemy. But they do not seem to be united at all." She murmured, the Five Immortals of the Ancients were more united than this.
Lu Yang: "...."
Fairy, don't you want to guess why they are fighting?
After waiting for a while, Fairy Eternity saw that the treasure box had been quiet for a long time, and it was generally hard to decide the winner in a short time.
"Nothing now, right? Can we go back now?" With one less person at the meeting, Fairy Eternity's interest waned. Anyway, the topics for the meeting had been discussed, and the people had fought, it was time to go back.
As the Acting Sect Master, she had to manage the vast Seek Dao Sect and deal with a myriad of matters every day.
"Nothing now, let's go back." Emperor Xia looked at Lu Yang with a completely different look, eager to send this great Buddha back.
Even Daoist Buyu was not so troublesome when he was at the Golden Core Stage.
"Let's go." Yun Zhi was quite satisfied with Fairy Eternity's performance, she didn't cause any big trouble.
Fairy Eternity swung her arms and strutted out of the palace. Yun Zhi lagged half a body behind, maintaining a nonchalant demeanor.
The two rode the clouds and left, leaving only Emperor Xia and Master Jiesha.
"Master, you....."
Master Jiesha didn't say much and left in a flash.
In truth, he also wanted to enter the treasure box to show Qiu Jin'an and the others what it was like to be invincible at the Golden Core Stage. But after all, he was an elder and couldn't bring himself to act in such a way.
Of course, there was another reason. He suspected that if he entered the treasure box, he would face a combined attack from the three opponents, and he figured he wouldn't be able to withstand it.
Silent Zen was hard to practice. During meetings, he could only nod or shake his head and couldn't speak, which made him feel uncomfortable.

chapters.title: Chapter 474 - 473: Preparations from All Sides_1
chapters.content:
The news about the competition organized by the Imperial court quickly spread across the continent. Since the final bout is scheduled to take place in the Seek Dao Sect coinciding with the twelve-hundredthousand-year anniversary of the Sect, the competition was named the Seek Dao Conference.
Numerous sects eagerly warmed up, gearing up to send their proudest disciples into the battle.
The advent of the Great Era resulted in the emergence of countless prodigies. Many organizations have nurtured gifted disciples with excellencies far beyond previous generations, biding their time for a chance to surprise everyone.
And now, the opportunity is finally here!
"With the leaders of the Five Great Immortal Sects acting as judges, rewards such as magic skills, natural treasures, semi-immortal level cultivation experiences, chances to explore secret realms, and ancient books... these rewards would tempt even me. If I were still young, I would definitely take part," sighed the Tower Leader.
During his youth, he didn't have such an excellent opportunity where he could compete with the continent's best talents, let alone receive such lucrative rewards.
"Mingtai, you are the most gifted individual in our Sword Tower, the only person who has received the enlightened teaching in a millennium. I have faith in you making a name for yourself in the Seek Dao Conference," said the Tower Leader to Mingtai.
"I will not let the sect down!" Mingtai replied.
…
"Although our Flying Waterfall Sect is a second-class sect and wouldn't have usually been qualified to participate in the final bout, it's different this time. Kong Hao, you're as talented as core disciples from first-class and superior sects!"
"I know you've always been low-profile and don't like to show off. Despite becoming an enlightened disciple of the core tradition, you didn't try to win any followers or establish your small group as other people did but focused on cultivating instead. You don't meddle in worldly affairs," the sect leader said to Kong Hao.
"Master, I..." Kong Hao hesitated. He had chosen the Flying Waterfall Sect hoping for a quiet life, a peaceful practice. He hadn't expected trouble to find him even when he didn't want any.
"If it were any other competition, I wouldn't insist. But this time, it's organized by the Imperial court. I don't expect you to be a champion, but if you could just qualify for the final round and earn a chance for the sect to participate in the Seek Dao Sect's grand celebration, it'd benefit our sect greatly!"
"Furthermore, this competition will be evaluated by the leaders of the Five Great Immortal Sects. If they could offer you some critique, it would greatly benefit your cultivation!"
"Alright," Kong Hao relented.
…
"Semi-Immortal level cultivation notes? How can the Great Xia afford to give such amazing rewards, whose value is immeasurable... as for the Great Yu dynasty, which I've served for so many years, they wouldn't even provide me with notes of Pass Tribulation quality. Well, if they refused to give it to me, they shouldn't blame me for getting it from Great Xia instead!"
"With the cultivation notes of Semi-Immortal level, the other rewards, and the Single Spiritual Root of mine, the chances of me reaching the stage of Pass Tribulation in the future will be even greater!"
"A position befits Zhenjun's status is approaching!"
...
"Hmm, the final is at Seek Dao Sect? How convenient! I was wondering how to infiltrate the Seek Dao Sect, and voilà! there comes my chance."
"Seek Dao Sect, if something bad happens during the celebration, don't blame me. Blame the decisions made by the Imperial court!"
"Considering this, both the Seek Dao Sect and the Imperial court would likely invite Great Powers to ensure order. It's a little tricky, I wonder what cultivation level the people invited will be. Well, just to be safe, I'll bring everyone."
…
Laurel Fairy Palace.
"Lan Ting, our sect needs to select a candidate in the mid-stage of Golden Core to take part in the final bout. I've decided that you will be our representative. What do you think?"
"I obey your order!"
After receiving the order, Lan Ting dared to glance at her master. However, she couldn't discern her master's emotions as she was wearing a veil. After pondering for a moment, she managed to ask.
"Master, will I be able to meet Lu Yang at the Seek Dao Sect?"
Luo Hongxia's eyes twitched, slightly grinding her teeth: "Yes, you will. Even if nobody else can see him, you will certainly get to meet him!"
…
Five Elements Sect.
"Bai Ming, our Five Elements Sect should send a representative who is in the mid-stage of Golden Core to compete. You must make our sect proud."
"I guarantee successful completion, but disciple has one question."
"You ask."
"What happened to the wound on your face?"
"Don't ask what you should not."
…
Prison Suppressing Sect.
"Tianzhi, I have no particular expectations for this competition. However, if you encounter someone from the Five Elements Sect, beat them up hard. There's no need to show them any respect!"
"Yes."
Seeing Yan Tianzhi was about to leave, Yang Ding stopped him: "Wait a minute, won't you ask me how I got these injuries?"
"Anyway, it's not, me, who, did it."
…
Slaughterhouse.
"...."
"Master, say something. Even if we Buddhists advocate 'understanding without speaking', you can't just give me a look and expect me to understand!"
"Master, why did you just practice Silent Zen out of nowhere? Now that you can't speak or communicate through your Spiritual Sense or letters."
Master Jiesha still did not speak.
Mystified, Shi Chan put down his butcher knife, trying to understand the meaning behind his master's look.
The Suspension Temple is good in many ways: brothers are in harmony, resources are abundant, and are guided by Great Powers who have reached Pass Tribulation.
The only problem lies in interpreting their cryptic hints.
Shi Chan often complained that his master's words were as good as silence, and now, he has even stopped talking.
"Forget it, I should continue butchering pigs."
…
Meng Jingzhou arrived at Sky Gate Mountain, and the moment he entered the abode, he saw Lu Yang slouched lazily on a chair, crossing his arms on his stomach.
Eldest Senior Sister was not present.
"Why did you call me here?" Meng Jingzhou was annoyed at Lu Yang. Why did this youngster have to be the Acting Sect Master?
After receiving a Five Elements Sect magic skill as per their agreement, Qiu Jin'an just returned from the visit. Immediately upon his return, the Acting Sect Master summoned him.
"Little Meng, come on in, don't hold back." Lu Yang said cheerfully.
Meng Jingzhou glanced around the abode. There was only one chair in the entire abode, which Lu Yang was currently occupying.
Am I supposed to sit on your goddamn head?
Lu Yang conveniently neglected the eye-roll from Meng Jingzhou, and said leisurely,
"You must have heard about the conference organized by the Imperial court. It's going to take place alongside our sect's celebration. The conference is divided into various categories, one for each minor realm. The sect is taking the conference very seriously. After multiple discussions with the elders, participants for all other minor realms were decided.
However, the decision for a mid-stage Golden Core realm representative is still pending, causing quite the dilemma."
"The disciples that can represent the sect in the conference must be the best amongst all. After much thought, I decided it should be you entering the competition despite a tide of public opinion against it."
Meng Jingzhou's eyes lit up and he involuntarily grinned; he found Lu Yang's words pleasing and felt warm all over. "So you finally admit that I am stronger than you?"
The grin on Lu Yang's face widened: "I am one of the judges."
He had been striving for this moment, enduring hardships and suffering for the Fairy Eternity.
"Shit!"

chapters.title: Chapter 475 - 474 - Fairy Eternity: I will practice for you _1
chapters.content:
A month and a half flew by, during which the Central Continent was unusually bustling. There were city-level and state-level competitions, and all the prodigies of the Great Xia Dynasty gathered on the stage. The arena spewed shock after shock, with many obscure cultivators surprisingly proving their abilities, leaving those who knew them dumbstruck.
Even the disciples carefully nurtured and heavily pinned upon by the First Class Sects were occasionally defeated by unknown, minor cultivators.
Soon came the day for the Seek Dao Sect's celebration ceremony.
...
Throughout the month and a half, Fairy Eternity went rogue in the Seek Dao Sect while conspiring with Lu Yang. They were as thick as thieves, both scheming and misbehaving masterfully.
In the abode of Sky Gate Mountain, two Lu Yangs were sitting, one approving official documents and the other sleeping. Both were very busy.
"Just hold on a little longer; after the ceremony, it'll all be over!" Lu Yang encouraged himself as he reviewed the documents. Approaching the ceremony, he held the list of prominent youth from every state and the representatives of various forces attending the ceremony.
He was currently using the Tree Growing Spell to create a wooden avatar. The one sleeping was Fairy Eternity, who had successfully possessed a body.
"Fairy, are you sure you're helping me to cultivate?"
Perhaps feeling guilty for repeatedly possessing Lu Yang's body and monopolizing his cultivation time, Fairy Eternity took the initiative to help Lu Yang cultivate.
After all, the two were sharing the same body; whoever cultivated would benefit both.
Then, Fairy Eternity continued to sleep.
"Ha——" Fairy Eternity, awakened by Lu Yang, yawned broadly, giving Lu Yang dissatisfied side-eye.
"Of course, I am cultivating. This is a cultivation method associated with sleep, it's based on the principle of recovering cultivation level through sleep. This is a supreme cultivation method only obtainable by immortals. You, as a mere mortal, naturally cannot comprehend its mystery."
Lu Yang thought to himself that they already reached the peak of cultivators, wasn't it? What use is this sleep-based cultivation method?
Due to the enormous power vested in an acting sect master, Lu Yang had no power over Fairy Eternity. He could only continue to review the documents.
...
"So this is the Seek Dao Sect. How magnificent."
Standing in front of the mountain gate of the Seek Dao Sect, Mingtai was moved upon seeing the continuous mountains behind the gate and the rich spiritual essence permeating everywhere.
Representing the Sword Pavilion, he had progressed smoothly to the finals and entered the Seek Dao Sect with an elder.
The Seek Dao Sect was much more lavish compared to their Sword Pavilion.
Mingtai's actions didn't attract attention. Many disciples and forces participating in the finals were seeing the Seek Dao Sect for the first time and were shocked by its grandiosity.
The spiritual essence at the mountain gate was so abundant, what kind of scenery awaited them inside?
"Mingtai, let's go." The elder of the Sword Pavilion walked ahead, motioning for Mingtai to catch up.
As it was not the first time the elder from the Sword Pavilion had visited the Seek Dao Sect, he took familiar steps across the bamboo forest to the core area of the Seek Dao Sect, the main venue for this ceremony.
The main venue included Sky Gate Mountain, the Eight Elder Peaks, and a commercial street. It was the busiest and most bustling area of the Seek Dao Sect.
"The Seek Dao Sect has put in a lot of effort." The elder from the Sword Pavilion stroked his beard as he nodded in approval. For the ceremony, the Seek Dao Sect had cleared a space at the foot of the Sky Gate Mountain where they had erected an altar made entirely of white jade. There were three large statues on the altar, covered with red cloth.
The altar was set with ritual vessels and offerings like the tripod, gui, dou, zun, pot, ju, small ju, candlestick, incense burner, wine plate, chime bells, bianqing, all arranged according to the highest sacrificial rules.
Several Seek Dao Sect disciples guarded the vicinity of the altar to keep anyone from approaching it before the sacrifice began.
There were also many other tools and props used in religious rites, many of which were so antique that even he couldn't recognize them.
"It looks like the ancestral ceremonies of the Barbarian Tribes, but even more complex."
As the oldest branch of the human race, the barbarian tribe continues the ancient traditions. The barbarian tribe's ancestral rites have always been regarded by the world as the best representation of ancient ancestral ceremonies, with many scholars visiting the tribe to learn and extrapolate elements of the ancient world.
What the Elder of the Sword Manor didn't recognize was the scene of ancient tribal ancestor worship, and ascended immortals rites that Lu Yang made Fairy Eternity recall.
Although Fairy Eternity is not reliable in her actions, her memory can be trusted. She effortlessly re-enacted the ancient sacrificial rituals, creating an absolutely orthodox ceremony.
She could even recreate more ancient, orthodox gatherings of immortals, but Lu Yang rejected this idea.
"Elder Sikong, it has been a long time," said a voice.
The Elder of the Sword Manor heard a familiar voice calling him. Turning his head, he saw Lu Baqian, the recently popular Sect Leader of Corpse Chasing Sect. The person following him must be the candidate from the Corpse Chasing Sect for the final competition.
"Oh, it's Master Ru." Elder Sikong raised his hand in greeting, a swift casual gesture, in line with the style of sword cultivators.
"Hello, Master Ru," Mingtai echoed him.
"Haha, how did you know of my advancement to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage?" Lu Baqian laughed heartily, his eyes crinkling with joy.
Elder Sikong: "..."
"It seems you have been neglecting your cultivation, brother Sikong, which is why you haven't advanced to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage yet."
Lu Baqian, being the first of their peers to advance to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, was showing off everywhere. What's more, his cultivation level was so high that no one could compete with him.
Elder Sikong silently gripped the hilt of the sword at his waist hesitating for a moment but did not draw it.
"Is this a disciple from the Sword Manor?" Lu Baqian finally acknowledged Mingtai after his boastful display.
"Only the best has received the inheritance of the Supreme One," Elder Sikong said with a slightly better expression, taking pride in Mingtai being the pride of Sword Manor.
"The Supreme One's inheritance?" Lu Baqian gasped in a low voice. His pupils contracted, obviously surprised.
The Unification stage can be called the True Monarch, the Transcendance Tribulation Stage can be called the Venerable, and the Semi-immortal can be called the Supreme One.
This guy named Mingtai actually received the inheritance of the Sword Manor's Supreme One?
The Supreme One of Sword Manor was a semi-immortal of swordsmanship. Unfortunately, he fell halfway and did not become an immortal. His stringent inheritance conditions meant no one was qualified to inherit it. He never thought he would see in his lifetime someone worthy enough to inherit the mantle of the Sword Manor's Supreme One.
The Sword Manor sure managed to keep a low profile by finding such an exceptional heir without making any noise. If it weren't for this grand assembly, the Sword Manor probably wouldn't have brought Mingtai out.
"Zhao Po, our outstanding disciple from the Corpse Chasing Sect."
Without the exception of Huang Ming, Zhao Po would have been the true first young talent of the Corpse Chasing Sect. After the incident at Hanshui City compounded with Lu Baqian's personal guidance upon advancing to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, Zhao Po had made great leaps in his development.
"Alright, I'll chat with Master Ru, you youngsters can entertain yourselves." Elder Sikong waved his hand as if reminding them of their station. Whenever youngsters were present, he always had to keep up appearances, which made him uncomfortable.
"Hello Zhao Po, I'm Mingtai, are you a disciple of the Corpse Chasing Sect?" Mingtai grinned broadly, a natural charmer and conversationalist.
"So, you were part of the Hanshui City incident?"
The Hanshui City incident was the largest scale battle in nearly a hundred years, involving three Transcendance Tribulation Stage participants, including a dominant Major Sky Venerable. It attracted wide attention and some people even made it into a storytelling series, circulated widely among the public. Mingtai often went to teahouses to listen to these tales.
How could it not be exciting to meet someone who personally experienced the battle at Hanshui City?
Zhao Po nodded: "Yes, when the battle broke out above Hanshui City, I was with Lu Yang, Senior Brother, at the State Provincial Mansion. We were closest to the battle."
"You know Lu Yang, Senior Brother too?" Mingtai's eyes sparkled, his tone even more excited than before.
The most popular tale at the teahouses was the "Legend of the Seek Dao Sect: The Lu Yang Chapter"!

chapters.title: Chapter 476 - 475: 'The Legend of Seek Dao Sect - Lu Yang Part'_1
chapters.content:
Zhao Po was startled by Mingtai's reaction, unsure of why he was so excited.
"Did you not hear about the storytelling of 'The Legend of the Seek Dao Sect - Lu Yang Chapter'?"
Zhao Po shook his head. Recently, he had been engrossed in cultivation under the Sect Leader's instruction, with no time to hear any stories.
"I haven't heard the story, but I indeed know Senior Brother Lu Yang. Why do you ask?"
"Can you tell me about what Senior Brother Lu Yang did in Hanshui City? Is he as powerful as the legends suggest?"
"Indeed, he is extremely powerful. I have a Senior Brother named Huang Ming who is about my age, but is far superior to me in both cultivation talent and fighting ability. I later learned that he refined his cultivation after reaching the Unification Stage in the Great Yu era, explaining his prowess."
"At the time, I was ignorant. Coincidentally, I was exorcising ghosts with Senior Brother Lu Yang when we encountered Huang Ming. A conflict arose between us and a fight ensued."
"Who won?" Mingtai asked eagerly.
"Of course, it was Senior Brother Lu Yang. He went hand to hand with Huang Ming after his cultivation disbanding. He had the upper hand and handled it with ease!"
"That's formidable!" Mingtai was astonished. Even if he were to fight a cultivator who had disintegrated into the Unification Stage, he would be confident to win, but to handle it with ease is entirely impossible.
"Quite so. Senior Brothers Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou told me that only those of Unification Stage and above are qualified to be their opponents."
"Facts have proved it, too. After defeating Huang Ming, a Great Yu cultivator of the Unification Stage appeared intending to execute them. After handling him, the Emperor of Great Yu suddenly appeared and blanketed Hanshui City with the power of the rules."
Even now, Zhao Po feels a chill when recalling it. He had never encountered so many high-level cultivators in his life, but everything seemed to come at once when he encountered Lu Yang.
Mingtai seemed thoughtful, "No wonder, with that, everything makes sense."
"Hey, speaking of which, Senior Brother Lu Yang is here in the Seek Dao Sect. Can we expect to see a battle of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage this time?"
Zhao Po waved his hand, thinking Mingtai was overthinking. "No way, this is the Seek Dao Sect! Even the Emperor of Great Yu wouldn't dare to cause any trouble here. With so many elders and the Sect Leader present, the Transcendance Tribulation Stage would have their hands full."
It's already far-fetched to encounter a Transcendance Tribulation Stage battle once in a lifetime, let alone regularly.
Even if such a meeting occurs, it would be during the advent of a Great Era, not every few months.
"Would you like something to eat? I've heard the barbecue here is delicious."
Mingtai was not interested in food. He believes that cultivators should concentrate on cultivating. Eating is just to fulfill the appetites, an unnecessary behavior.
However, Zhao Po was passionate and he didn't want to be outright rude. "You go ahead, I'm not fond of barbeque."
"Oh, don't be like that, the barbecue here is really good. Once you try it, you'll know. Wait here, I'll go get us some." Zhao Po, as always, was enthusiastic. After all, having more friends opens more roads.
Just as Mingtai was about to say something, he saw Zhao Po sprinting towards the shopping street, soon losing sight of him in the crowd.
All he could do was to stop and wait.
Probably due to the booming business of the barbecue shop that Zhao Po mentioned, Mingtai had to wait for a while.
"Since I have nothing else to do, I might as well ask where Senior Brother Lu Yang is. When Zhao Po returns, we can go and meet him together."
Conveniently, a young man dressed in a Seek Dao Sect disciple's robe walked by, and Mingtai grabbed him.
The young man was startled, surprised at Mingtai's sudden pull. He wondered if he had met an enemy.
"Hello there, fellow cultivator, would you happen to know where Senior Brother Lu Yang is?"
"Lu Yang?" The young man reacted with a strange expression, examining Mingtai from head to toe. Unfamiliar with Mingtai's refined features and slightly unfamiliar appearance, he didn't recognize him.
"What are you looking for Lu Yang for?" asked the young man, looking cautious.
"Well, I am Mingtai from the Sword Tower. A few days ago, I listened to the latest version of 'The Legend of the Seek Dao Sect - Lu Yang Chapter' in a teahouse and was in complete awe of Senior Brother Lu Yang. I thought I'd take this opportunity to meet him in person."
"'The Legend of the Seek Dao Sect - Lu Yang Chapter'?" The young man was bewildered. What kind of ghost name was that?
"What does the storytelling say?"
"The storytelling describes Senior Brother Lu Yang as extraordinarily gifted, even among those with Single Spiritual Root. He is the most powerful one. He could also challenge higher levels, defeating the cultivators of the Spirit Transformation Stage when he was in the Foundation Establishment Stage!"
"Upon reaching the Golden Core Stage, he became even more formidable! In the Imperial Palace, he fought with the leaders of the Four Great Immortal Sects, beating the leader of Laurel Fairy Palace until his mouth was full of leaves.
The leader of Prison Suppressing Sect was beaten so hard that he vowed to become a monk, meanwhile, the leader of Suspension Temple was left speechless, growing hair with the intention to return to secular life!"
Initially, Mingtai thought the storytelling exaggeration about Lu Yang was a bit excessive. After all, it's a popular story and an exaggeration is normal. But Zhao Po just said that his opponents are all at least at the Unification Stage.
Isn't that the same as what was told in the storytelling?
"The leaders of the Four Great Immortal Sects were battered by Senior Brother Lu Yang, and all the eunuchs in the Imperial Palace saw it. The leaders of the Laurel Fairy Palace, Prison Suppressing Sect, and Five Elements Sect were beaten black and blue. Their injuries hadn't even healed by the time they left the Imperial Palace!"
"The emperor even greatly praised Lu Yang's actions, praising him as a young hero with extraordinary talents. He granted him the privilege to enter the court without bending his knees in respect, praising him without naming his name, and carrying his sword into the palace!"
The young man wore an even more peculiar look on his face. His master had briefly returned to the Seek Dao Sect a while ago, in the name of caring for the Righteous Path, and asked him what had happened during the Palace meeting.
He detailed everything to his master who then patted him satisfactorily on the shoulder, criticizing himself for not being a good enough teacher, as he had often been absent during his apprentice's cultivation. He declared that he was determined to help his apprentice achieve fame and fortune, asking him to watch out.
He never expected that achieving fame would be via this route!
He was aware of Qiu Jin'an and the other two getting beaten black and blue, after all, it was mess created by a fairy, and he was aware of the aftermath.
Qiu Jin'an and the other two had originally been competing for the title of strongest Golden Core Stage cultivator. However, during their fight, they got heated, all of them returning to their original realms, leaving themselves injured all over that they couldn't recover for quite some time.
Mingtai was about to say something more, but he suddenly heard a long, ancient bell chiming from the peak of Sky Gate Mountain, resonating in his ears.
Dong— Dong— Dong—
The bell echoed throughout the Seek Dao Sect, a total of twelve tolls symbolizing the Seek Dao Sect's history of 120,000 years.
The sound of the bell indicated that the celebration was about to begin. Everyone stopped what they were doing and turned towards the direction of Sky Gate Mountain.
The young man strode towards the altar.
He was originally planning to go to the altar, but was intercepted midway by Mingtai.
"Excuse me, cultivator, you never told me where Senior Brother Lu Yang is!" Mingtai said softly but urgently.
The robe transformed into light feathers and disappeared. Fairy silk danced on the ground, spreading throughout the body. The official crown, black robe, wide red skirt, white silk belt, yellow knee protector... formed a set of solemn and solemn clothing.
The young man looked back, a smile in his eyes, "I am Lu Yang."

chapters.title: Chapter 477 - 476: Opening of the Ceremony_1
chapters.content:
The bell toll rang, and guests filled the surroundings of the altar.
All eyes were on Lu Yang, who was dressed in ceremonial attire, his expression solemn and dignified.
Lu Yang walked step by step towards the altar, and people around him naturally made way.
No one knew at this time that a battle was raging in Lu Yang's mind.
"Come on, let me take over!"
"Fairy, can you fix this or not? Shall I do it for you?"
"As an Immortal, I have been worshipped by people since the ancient times, I know the procedure better than you!"
After a tug of war, Lu Yang was forced to relinquish control of his body.
Fairy Eternity ascended the altar carved from white jade, moving with a measured and confident stride, as if she had travelled through time from the ancient era, carrying with her a profound sense of history.
"Who is this young man?" The older generation who were watching the ceremony saw Lu Yang on the stage and were surprised. He didn't match anyone they knew.
"I heard he is Daoist Buyu's apprentice, Lu Yang. Recently, he has been very prominent. Some say that he is invincible in the Golden Core Stage and is the top amongst the younger generation."
"Invincible in the Golden Core Stage?"
The weight of this title is immense. The Golden Core stage holds a crucial position in the entire cultivation system. Being able to dominate and become invincible at the Golden Core stage implies limitless future achievements!
"That's not right. Even if he is invincible in the Golden Core stage, he shouldn't be on the altar."
"There are rumours that Daoist Buyu intends to groom this young apprentice, and has even allowed him to play the role of Acting Sect Leader, entrusting him with the task of organizing this grand ceremony."
"Don't believe what you hear from others. In my view, Old Buyu is afraid to show his face, so he pushed his apprentice to the front."
"This feels like something Old Buyu would do."
"Such accomplishments at such a young age, what great fortune! I wonder if this Lu Yang has a sweetheart. My family happens to have a few girls of suitable age, and their talents are not bad."
"But he is Old Buyu's apprentice!"
"In that case, never mind."
Dong——
With Fairy Eternity's ascent onto the stage, the bells chimed, creating a solemn and dignified atmosphere, as if transporting people back to a hundred thousand years ago.
The music being played by the Fourth Elder and his disciples was a special melody used for the Seek Dao Sect's rituals.
As a Confucian Cultivator, the Fourth Elder is well-versed in the laws of harmony and rhythm. His flute can summon all kinds of birds for worship. When he was younger, this skill attracted countless young girls.
The altar was set up for the worship of three gigantic statues covered with red cloth. The Grand Elder was casting a spell, pulling away the red cloth to reveal the true faces of the three statues.
Daoist Xiantian who founded the Seek Dao Sect, Celestial Master Guiyuan who started the Immortal Sect, and Vast Sea Daoist Lord who revitalized the sect.
These three have special meaning in the Seek Dao Sect and are known as the Three Ancestors of the Seek Dao Sect. When Lu Yang took his oath as a disciple, it was done under the tablets of these three ancestors.
Fairy Eternity held a jade stick in her hand, and with hands clasped and left hand on top, she bowed three times towards the tablets.
Seeing Fairy Eternity performing the ceremony with formal dignity from beneath the altar, Yun Zhi nodded in satisfaction.
In principle, even if Lu Yang becomes the Acting Sect Leader, he should not be qualified to represent the entire Seek Dao Sect in holding the worship ceremony.
However, the person standing on the altar is not Lu Yang, but Fairy Eternity.
As one of the Five Immortals of the Ancients and the owner of the Eternity Dao Fruit, Fairy Eternity is very qualified to worship the Three Ancestors of the Seek Dao Sect. The question should not be whether Fairy Eternity is qualified enough, but whether the fate of the Three Ancestors is strong enough.
Fairy Eternity lit the candles and incense, and amid the swirling smoke, she recited the ritual text with a clear and resonant voice that echoed throughout the Seek Dao Sect.
"To the sacred spirits, born in the deep of ancient times...with sacrificial offerings and abundant resources..."
The ritual text was ordered by Fairy Eternity, passed on to Lu Yang, who in turn commanded the Fourth Elder to write it.
As the most literate person in the entire Seek Dao Sect, it was only natural for the Fourth Elder to shoulder this important responsibility.
Fairy Eternity quickly noticed the high standard of the text written by the Fourth Elder - there were many characters she couldn't recognize, and those she could recognize were hard to pronounce.
After reciting the ritual text, a satisfied smile appeared at the corner of Fairy Eternity's mouth.
She was elated.
In the past, she had always been worshipped by others. Today, it was finally her turn to worship others.
As the Acting Sect Leader and client elder, her act of worshipping the Three Ancestors of the Seek Dao Sect was entirely justified.
"Our sect has prepared a variety of activities. Everyone please enjoy and rest for a day, the finals will commence tomorrow."
Lu Yang's plan for the ceremony was: start of the ceremony, guests have fun, start of the finals, end of the ceremony.
The purpose of the Righteous Path's is to find ancient cultivators who have restarted their cultivation during this competition.
However, Lu Yang believes that just based on the performance during the competition, it is hard to figure out whether the other party is truly an ancient cultivator. Hence, he suggested that by organizing activities during the ceremony and observing the actions of the competing cultivators, as well as their performance during the competition, it would be easier to discern.
As soon as this idea was proposed, it was agreed upon by Emperor Xia and the other Sect Leaders.
There are many cultivators placed within the Seek Dao Sect tasked with observation. Some were sent by the imperial court, some were sent by the Immortal Sects, all of them sycophantic individuals who are extremely good at picking up cues.
It is difficult for the Seek Dao Sect to find such sycophantic individuals so they didn't send any.
At the end of the ritual, a group of old veterans from the cultivation world were still very interested in Lu Yang. Elder Sikong and Lu Baqian were among them, as they were very close friends.
"I heard that this youngster fought so fiercely, leaving the leaders of the Four Great Immortal Sects shamed and heavily wounded."
"Just rumors, golden core stage can have such battle strength, not even the reincarnation of immortals can achieve that."
"Well you can't simply dismiss it. With the arrival of the Great Era, it's not surprising to encounter such talents. Haven't you heard of a prodigy who was able to Pass Tribulation at birth, unparalleled in cultivation, and ultimately succeeded in becoming an Immortal?"
"You do make a point there, but I have a feeling that something isn't right."
"Look, Qiu Jin'an and the others are right there, just ask them and we'll know."
"Let's go and ask."
Cultivators are always decisive, they act on their thoughts immediately.
Qiu Jin'an and company are looking around with gloomy expressions, trying to find Daoist Buyu.
The news about 'Legend of Seek Dao Sect - Lu Yang's Story' reached them. As soon as they heard it, they knew it was a dirty trick from Daoist Buyu.
After a month and a half of rest, the four had fully recovered. Yang Ding's hair had grown back, Master Jiesha's hair had also grown back to its original state.
"Fellow Daoist Qiu, I heard that Lu Yang fought against the four of you, is that true?" The old veterans turned to Qiu Jin'an and others, the anticipation of mischief clearly written across their faces.
The four of them simultaneously darkened their faces, not knowing how to answer.
"It's true, but..." Qiu Jin'an reluctantly nodded and was just about to explain, but he was interrupted by Lu Baqian.
"Fellow Daoist Qiu, you're mistaken. If you lose, you lose. It's normal for cultivators to experience losses and wins. Why the need to justify?"
As a transcendent cultivator in the Tribulation Stage, Lu Baqian's words carried a lot of weight.
"Right, Old Qiu, you always say that cultivators should be open and honest, accepting their weaknesses, why doesn't it apply the same when it comes to yourself?"
"This attitude is not conducive to your future cultivation."
Every one of them pitched in, word by word, each more enthusiastic than the last. A rare opportunity to mock Qiu Jin'an was before them, and they wouldn't miss it for the world.
Unable to endure, Qiu Jin'an gave Luo Hongxia a meaningful look, she understood immediately and pulled out the Restraining Light Treasure Box. The treasure box emitted a bright light, and all the people were drawn into it.
To balance the cultivation levels, both sides have to agree. However, if it was simply about pulling people in, Luo Hongxia alone could decide.
"Attack!"
Inside the treasure box, Master Jiesha took the lead with Qiu Jin'an and the others supporting him, they defeated the group of old veterans.

chapters.title: Chapter 478 - 477: Fishing_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang was still unaware that the guests invited by the Seek Dao Sect were being beaten up by another batch of guests they had invited.
Such situations were quite commonplace in the cultivation world. As powerful cultivators who acted based on their own likes and dislikes, fighting and killing were the norm, and being hunted down by others happened time and time again.
Daoist Buyu was deeply acquainted with this.
After Fairy Eternity had finished enjoying the ritual, she returned Lu Yang's body to him.
Senior brothers and sisters were setting up various activities along the roadside, so many that Lu Yang couldn't recognize them all.
When it was proposed that they could hold their own games, the senior brothers and sisters were eager to try. They all had their own ideas, and like a flurry of snowflakes, applications flew towards the abode. Fairy Eternity delegated the responsibility to Lu Yang. Seeing the number of applications, Lu Yang was overwhelmed and passed on the responsibility to the Eldest Senior Sister.
The Eldest Senior Sister's review criteria were very simple. As long as the activity was not dangerous and would not tarnish the image of the Seek Dao Sect, it could be held.
"Sect Master Lu."
"Hello, Sect Master Lu."
"Hello, Sect Master."
There were greetings everywhere. Lu Yang responded one by one, nodding his head. It was a pleasing feeling.
Lu Yang changed out of his heavy ceremonial robes.
"Acting Sect Master, do you want to buy a few books?" A senior brother greeted Lu Yang. He was a brother who often stood guard in the Task Hall.
The people of the Seek Dao Sect would call Lu Yang Acting Sect Master, and outsiders would address him as Sect Master.
"Buying books? Aren't there any in the Scripture Pavilion?" Lu Yang was puzzled.
"These are all good stuff not found in the Scripture Pavilion, do you want to take a look?" The senior brother from the Task Hall encouraged, and Lu Yang was interested. He stopped at the book stall to check out what kind of exceptional items were being sold here.
"What do you have here?"
"Although Acting Sect Master is the disciple of the Sect Master, you probably haven't had much contact with him. I have an autobiography written by the Sect Master here that details his life experiences. Would you like to buy one?"
"Master's autobiography?" This was indeed a book that wasn't in the Scripture Pavilion and Lu Yang was interested.
"I'll take one."
"Fifty contribution points."
Lu Yang smacked his lips, fifty contribution points for a book was really expensive. But he had accrued plenty of points due to his frequent achievements so he wasn't worried about running out.
He swiped his contribution points across, and the senior brother from the Task Hall handed over a book with a scroll cover to Lu Yang.
"Two Thousand Years of Prison Environmental Change in the Great Xia Dynasty"
"...Is this Master's autobiography?"
Lu Yang suddenly remembered, he had heard the Eldest Senior Sister talking about this book. She said that Master believed that everyone should leave something behind in their life, so he wrote a book based on his personal experiences. And what he wrote was this book.
Strictly speaking, the content in this book was much more reliable than storytelling, and certainly qualified as an autobiography.
Lu Yang felt a pang of regret. This book was so readily available in the outside world that you could buy it with spare change. But inside his own sect, it required fifty contribution points.
They were even scamming the Sect Master!
"Acting Sect Master, don't be angry, I'll give you another book." The senior brother from the Task Hall, who still had some sense of conscience, hurriedly said.
"What book?"
"As the Sect Master's youngest disciple, you are bound to encounter the Sect Master's enemies when you go out. I can give you a list of the Sect Master's enemies, how about that?"
"That's more like it."
Lu Yang took the book; its title was "List of Unification Stages in the Great Xia Dynasty"."
"...So, anyone at the Unification stage is considered Master's enemy?"
The senior brother from the Task Hall waved his hand, flipping open the book for Lu Yang: "Not necessarily. Acting Sect Master, see, I've highlighted a few names in the list."
"Are these Master's enemies?"
"Only these few hold no grudges against the Sect Master."
Lu Yang's heart sank. Having gained a master who hasn't taught him a single thing yet, he found himself surrounded by enemies everywhere he turned.
"Take care, Acting Sect Master. Come again next time." The senior brother from the Task Hall warmly saw Lu Yang off.
"Senior brother, do you still have that book from just now?" After Lu Yang left, someone came to buy a book.
"Which one?" The senior brother from the Task Hall squinted at the newcomer.
"It's the 'List of Unification Stages in the Great Xia Dynasty'. I don't think I've seen this book in the outside world." The man who came to buy the book looked young, about the same age as Lu Yang, and under the intense gaze of the senior brother from the Task Hall, he scratched his head awkwardly and laughed.
"I am Zhou Qingshi from the Pan Shi Sect, here to participate in the finals. I thought it would be rude not to recognize the elders at the Unification stage when I go out in the future, so I wanted to buy this book to study."
Upon hearing this, the senior brother from the Task Hall responded with a broad smile and dispelled his doubts: "I see, that's how it is. Bottom line, five thousand spirit stones."
"Five, five thousand?!" Zhou Qingshi was taken aback. Thinking about the usefulness of this book, he gritted his teeth and bought it.
The senior brother from the Task Hall signaled the people nearby to note down Zhou Qingshi's name and put him on the suspect list for close observation.
He sneered: "A Golden Core Stage cultivator hoping to recognize all the Unification Stages in the Great Xia Dynasty, do you think you are Junior Brother Lu?"
...
Not long after Lu Yang walked away, he saw a familiar face: "Palace Master Luo, what are you doing here?"
Luo Hongxia had just set up a temporary stall on the side of the street, technically an illegal structure, but no one dared to interfere with her. She was sitting on grass, with a box in front of her.
Luo Hongxia glanced at Lu Yang: "It's Sect Master Lu. I'm fishing."
"Fishing?" Lu Yang was puzzled. There wasn't even water here.'
Luo Hongxia didn't explain and gestured for Lu Yang to sit down.
After Lu Yang sat down, he heard Luo Hongxia idly say: "I suppose you've heard the storytelling from 'The Legend of the Seek Dao Sect - the Lu Yang Chapter'. The stories described are very detailed, and they are all true. I wonder who could have leaked them."
Lu Yang broke out in a cold sweat and quickly threw his Master under the bus: "It was all Master's doing. He cared about the meeting process in the name of the sect master, so I told him about my experience at the meeting."
"Hmph, it must have been him!" Luo Hongxia sneered, smiling defiantly.
Just as Lu Yang was about to say something, he saw a friend of Luo Hongxia's approaching. Lu Yang remembered him as the Master of the Xuan Gate.
Seeing Luo Hongxia, Xuan Gate Master smiled maliciously: "Fellow Daoist Luo, I heard that you were beaten by Master Lu. Is this true?"
A Golden Core Stage defeating a Unification Stage reeked of deceit, but that didn't stop him from coming over to taunt Luo Hongxia.
Unfortunately, Qiu Jin'an and Yang Ding were not present, otherwise he would taunt them all together.
Just as Lu Yang was about to explain, he saw Luo Hongxia wave her hand, indicating that he didn't need to explain.
"Indeed this has happened, Sect Master Lu can testify."
Luo Hongxia's unexpected admission caused a moment of surprise for the Xuan Gate Master.
This reaction seemed off.
"This involves ancient secrets. If you are interested, I can tell you about it."
"Ancient secrets?" The Xuan Gate Master was interested.
"There are too many people around here. Let's talk in the box." Luo Hongxia opened the box.
The Xuan Gate Master twitched at the sight of the box, which felt eerily familiar: "Isn't this the Restraining Light Treasure Box of your Laurel Fairy Palace..."
Before he could finish his sentence, he saw the box exploding with light, sucking the Xuan Gate Master into it.
Inside the box, the Xuan Gate Master heard a cold laugh coming from behind him.
"Heard you little guy wanted to know how we lost to Lu Yang?"
He turned around and saw Qiu Jin'an and Yang Ding, both smiling mischievously. Master Jiesha was wiping the blood off his fists, looking as if he were showing sympathy.
Qiu Jin'an and Yang Ding closed in on him, and the Xuan Gate Master's screams were heard soon after.
Lu Yang stared at Luo Hongxia dumbfounded as she closed the box, swallowing hard.
"That's what I call fishing."

chapters.title: Chapter 479 - 479: 478
chapters.content:
"Huh, there's quite a few people in this box, more than a dozen."
Fairy Eternity gasped softly, utterly surprised. The moment Luo Hongxia opened the box, she saw more than a dozen Unification Stage cultivators piled up inside, including a dabbler at the Transcendance Tribulation stage.
The bloodied mute old monk didn't have a scratch on him.
Qiu Jin'an and Yang Ding were rubbing their hands together, waiting for their prey to be hooked.
"Come on, hand over control of your body to me, and let me go inside the box to take a look."
Upon hearing this, Lu Yang broke into a cold sweat. He desperately advised Fairy Eternity, "Fairy, our Seek Dao Sect has plenty of activities, there's no need to engage in this one. It's too time-consuming."
"All right then." Fairy Eternity easily accepted the suggestion of her trusted aide.
Lu Yang quickly bid goodbye to Luo Hongxia and hastened to leave the area, hearing the gloating laughter from behind him.
"Fellow Daoist Luo, I heard you were beaten by Sect Master Lu. Is it true? And where are Fellow Daoist Qiu and Fellow Daoist Yang…"
Lu Yang quickened his pace.
Soon, he was distracted by something he'd never seen before.
"What is this..."
Lu Yang saw a small tent filled with cultivators below. They were dishevelled, holding ripped Talismans and looked lost in thought.
A wooden board hanging next to the tent read: "Seek Dao Sect: Origin."
"Acting Sect Master." A voice called from behind the small tent. It was Tao Yaoye, whom Lu hadn't seen in a while. She seemed very pleased to see him.
"Congrats on your promotion, Senior Brother Lu." Tao Yaoye teased.
Lu Yang displayed an awkward smile, "Junior Sister, stop teasing me."
Seeing that Lu Yang was embarrassed, Tao Yaoye didn't continue to tease him: "It's the sect celebration, and geniuses from all over are gathered at the Seek Dao Sect, so I took the opportunity to promote the 'Dream Mirage.'"
Lu Yang nodded, he had figured that out from the Array Method on the ground.
"How's the response?"
"Pretty good overall, it should be easy to promote it in the future."
Essentially, Dream Mirage is an illusion. For the attendees, illusions are not rare. The fact they consider it 'pretty good' shows the Dream Mirage's contents are quite impressive.
"What's the content of the Dream Mirage this time?"
"Our founding story of the Seek Dao Sect."
Lu Yang was amazed. "You made our founder's story of asking for directions and establishing the sect sound interesting?"
"It's slightly modified. Daoist Xiantian felt lost in his cultivation, couldn't make progress, and met an immortal being during meditation. The immortal advised him to head north for answers. As he headed north, he fought demons, witnessed countless injustices, and finally understood that the true pure land lies in one's heart.
He then established the Seek Dao Sect, representing the uncertainties of the mortal and immortal paths, and the quest for truth within our hearts."
Lu Yang was speechless.
So, basically, you only kept our founder's name unchanged?
Well, if it can make our sect's history sound better, our ancestor probably won't mind.
"Did you encounter any problem in the research of Dream Mirage? Need me to allocate some funds?"
Lu Yang, having all the power, acted quite generously.
Tao Yaoye quickly declined.
"Well, keep up the good work. Go for it." Lu Yang gave a few words of encouragement.
Walking past a few stalls, he saw Meng Jingzhou passionately giving a lecture.
"Fellow Daoists, only mortals chase after love. As cultivators, things like love only cause us to waste precious time. After intimacy, energy leaks, memory declines, and attention is difficult to concentrate. It greatly affects our cultivation progress."
"Furthermore, having a boyfriend or girlfriend is a waste of time. Wouldn't it be better to cultivate in close quarters during those times?"
"Look at me, this refined mana body is the result of giving up the affairs of the flesh. As the number one person in the mid-stage of Golden Core, representing the Seek Dao Sect in combat, I have proven my success!"
"You all know Sect Master Lu right? Despite being the Sect Master now, he still offers me his seat every time we meet. What does this signify? It shows that he respects me enough to give me his seat!"
The cultivators being drawn in by Meng Jingzhou's speech murmured in shock at this revelation.
"I have made a vow to never marry or engage in intimacy until I become an Immortal!"
"Do you want to have the same achievements as me?"
"We do!" A few plants shouted out loud.
Meng Jingzhou nodded with satisfaction, "I have a secret method here that can eliminate the desire for intimacy, who wants to give it a try?"
No one responded until a few seconds later, a man stepped forward to volunteer.
"I'll give it a try."
Meng Jingzhou was pleasantly surprised. He excitedly prepared to perform the Single Man's Curse Punch.
Li Haoran stepped onto the stage.
"Senior Brother Meng, can I try it?"
Meng Jingzhou's face turned dark. If he punched Li Haoran, he would likely have to go to Wild State again.
Seeing Meng Jingzhou's dark expression, Li Haoran inwardly rejoiced. At last, he was able to turn the tables and gain the upper hand.
"Haoran, you're here?"
A gentle feminine voice rang out, slightly full of surprise. A fragrant wind blew past as Su Yiren swept in and grabbed Li Haoran's arm.
Having searched for a long time, Su Yiren finally found Li Haoran at the celebration.
Li Haoran's pupils slightly shrink, he didn't expect Su Yiren to find him even though he was hiding in the Seek Dao Sect.
Seeing Li Haoran's horrified expression, Lu Yang was amused. Su Yiren was brought here by him.
It wasn't unusual for the sect to invite a hermit Unification Stage cultivator to the celebration.
"Mom, why are you here?" Qin Yanyan squeezed out from the crowd, mumbling complains about the lack of decency on public display.
"Mom?"
Li Haoran being loved by a beautiful woman had initially made others envious, but now their gaze was strange.
"Could this be the so-called May–December relationship?" Man Gu, one of the plants from earlier, was deep in thought.
After returning from the Wild State, he'd heard about Li Haoran's upcoming marriage to a Unification Stage cultivator who also had a child.
"Let's go, there's lots of interesting things here we can explore." Without further ado, Su Yiren dragged Li Haoran away by the sheer force of her willpower.
Qin Yanyan walked beside Li Haoran, warning them with her eyes, which unfortunately had little effect.
Li Haoran was surrounded by a beautiful woman and a cute daughter, which made others envious.
Seeing this, Lu Yang felt very satisfied.
"Junior Brother."
The voice of Eldest Senior Sister spooked Lu Yang.
"Eldest Senior Sister, what's the matter?"
Eldest Senior Sister frowned slightly, seeming puzzled: "We should have invited many Unification Stage cultivators, but why does it seem like not many have arrived?"
Lu Yang kept thinking, 'if you would just look inside the box, you might find everyone resting.'
"I'm not sure." Lu Yang played dumb. How could he possibly suggest that Eldest Senior Sister start a fight in the box?
"Then, let's search together."

chapters.title: Chapter 480 - 479: The Fox Borrows the Tiger's Might_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang considered selling out Luo Hongxia. There was a lot of stress in being around Eldest Senior Sister.
Eldest Senior Sister was tall and exceedingly beautiful, with a cold and indifferent demeanor, this attracted strong attention from both genders.
Wherever she walked in the street, she got many geniuses constantly turning their heads.
All of those looking back were from the outside, no one from Seek Dao Sect dared to gaze at Eldest Senior Sister.
Lu Yang was almost eighteen years old, with a height of 1.8 meters, half-a-head taller than Eldest Senior Sister, but he felt like the short one standing next to her.
"Gluttonous King competition, a thousand Spirit Stones as entry fee, competition between groups of ten!"
"Gluttonous King competition?" Lu Yang was mildly surprised, given cultivators could quickly digest everything they eat, when was this going to end?
He turned his head to see a mountain of Fasting Pills on the dining table.
Lu Yang: "..."
"Elixir Lottery, a thousand Spirit Stones or ten contribution points per entry, guaranteed Fine Pill within ten tries, guaranteed Elixir Cloud pill within a hundred tries!"
A senior brother from Elixir Cauldron Peak passionately peddled, catching Lu Yang's attention.
Lu Yang noticed that Eldest Senior Sister seemed interested, so he took the initiative to suggest, "I will give it a few tries, do you want to try, Eldest Senior Sister?"
Eldest Senior Sister looked at Lu Yang coldly, remained silent a while then said: "Alright."
Upon seeing Acting Sect Master and Eldest Senior Sister, the senior brother at Elixir Cauldron Peak was very enthusiastic: "Please sit, Eldest Senior Sister. Acting Sect Master, you too."
"We are here for lottery."
Upon hearing this, the senior brother from Elixir Cauldron Peak showed an embarrassed expression, "Lottery? I'm afraid my elixirs would not catch your eyes..."
"No worries, we are just playing."
As the interpreter of Eldest Sister's facial expression, Lu Yang knew she was interested in this activity, thus naturally, he couldn't disappoint her.
"Let's start with ten tries." Lu Yang paid a hundred contribution points without blinking an eye.
The senior brother at Elixir Cauldron Peak brought out a large pill furnace with a mouth at the bottom.
"Strike it ten times and ten elixirs will come out."
Upon hearing this, Lu Yang did as told, striking ten times, ten elixirs rolled out with rumbles, nine of them looked inferior, lacking smooth color, only one was flawless, labeled as Fine Pill.
"What are these elixirs?"
Lu Yang recognized common elixirs, but not those of Elixir Cauldron Peak.
"These nine are Heaven and Earth Creation Pills, they contain the way of time, gestating the creation of heaven and earth. They are full of randomness and even I, with my abilities, can hardly refine the second batch. This is a pill with infinite possibilities."
Lu Yang was slightly surprised and started looking at the nine inferior pills differently.
Eldest Senior Sister looked at the senior brother from Elixir Cauldron Peak and said coldly: "Tell the truth."
The senior brother from Elixir Cauldron Peak started, daring not to mess around in front of Eldest Senior Sister, he confessed: "Some time ago, while I was refining these elixirs, I had to leave for a bit, and forgot the time. By the time I got back, the elixirs were ruined."
"I thought it would work well for this celebratory activity to offer them as prizes for the lottery."
"Do you know that one of the conditions for me allowing this event was to not tarnish our sect's reputation?"
"Eldest Senior Sister, rest assured, I've been introducing myself as a Five Elements Sect disciple!" the senior brother from Elixir Cauldron Peak said, slapping his chest in assurance.
"Hmm?"
"No no no, I mean, I will pack up and leave."
Eldest Senior Sister raised her hand, stopping the senior brother from Elixir Cauldron Peak who was preparing to pack up: "Don't be in a hurry, let me try my luck."
"Here are a hundred contribution points, I will try ten times."
Eldest Senior Sister lightly struck the furnace once. A hidden force lingered within the furnace, echoing nine times after the initial hit.
Adding up to exactly ten times.
Ten pills rolled out rumblingly.
All ten pills were robust, with three of them entwined by Elixir Clouds.
Seven were Fine Pills, three were Elixir Cloud pills.
According to the odds, it would take three hundred entries to get three Elixir Cloud pills.
"Lucky." Eldest Senior Sister's lips curved slightly, she picked up an Elixir Cloud pill and carefully stored it. The rest of the pills were handed to Lu Yang.
She did not use any magic skills, this was pure luck.
Her luck was always good.
The two continued walking, looking for the reason of the disappearance of the Unification Stage cultivators.on one hand, while enjoying various activities on the other hand. Gradually, Lu Yang did not feel as restrained as before.
A master and disciple happened to pass by, noticing Lu Yang and Yun Zhi.
"Master, why is it that Lu Yang, who is of a similar age and has similar cultivation level as me, gets to be the Acting Sect Master and even has the privilege to preside over the sacrificial ritual?"
A young genius was somewhat jealous of Lu Yang. He belonged to one of the top nine sects, Control Qi Sect. His master was the sect leader of Control Qi Sect. He was not invited to the Seek Dao Sect's celebration solely due to his affiliation with the Control Qi Sect, but also due to being one of the cultivators who were part of the final competition.
His and Lu Yang's status was similar, but the gap between their positions was massive. He felt a sense of imbalance and somewhat unwilling to accept it.
"Shut up!" the Control Qi Sect leader scolded his disciple in a low voice.
The young genius was startled, his master was always polite and amicable with him, when did he ever scold him like this?
The Control Qi Sect leader was too busy to consider his disciple's reaction, he was sweating coldly, nervously eyeing Lu Yang.
His attention was not on Lu Yang, but Yun Zhi who was standing next to Lu Yang.
Although he didn't possess the high status of the five sect leaders, as a well-known high-tier sect, he was also an exceptional figure who was aware of some matters.
For example, he had heard that hundreds of years ago, a disciple from Seek Dao Sect defeated the four leaders of the Great Immortal Sects by himself, including the renowned Master Jiesha.
Who was Master Jiesha? Even in the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, he was an absolute powerhouse, even stronger than the patriarch of his own sect!
Master Jiesha was defeated proving the strength of the opponent.
And that was an incident that occurred hundreds of years ago. He didn't even dare to imagine how much that Seek Dao Sect disciple's cultivation level had improved over the years.
"This is the main character of the Great Era..."
Talents so extraordinary, perhaps no one can compare.
"Master..."
The young genius saw the fear in his master's eyes and heard his murmuring, he followed his master's gaze and saw the popular Lu Yang.
He had never heard his master give such high praises to anyone.
The young genius seemed to understand something and looked at Lu Yang with reverence.
Eldest Senior Sister noticed someone looking at her, she turned her head and saw the Control Qi Sect leader, it was not an important matter so she didn't think any further about it and continued.
"Did something happen, Eldest Senior Sister?" Seeing Eldest Senior Sister turned her head, Lu Yang thought she discovered something.
