Eldest Senior Sister slightly furrowed her brows, she indeed noticed something she couldn't understand.
"Strange, why does it feel like there are many unfamiliar Unification Stage cultivators?"
To hold the celebration, Seek Dao Sect invited many friends, cultivators from all sides came to the event, making it extremely lively. What puzzled Eldest Senior Sister was, she did not see many familiar Unification Stage cultivators along the way, but encountered a lot of unfamiliar ones.
If a few unfamiliar Unification Stage cultivators infiltrate a group, it's hard to notice. But if a few Unification Stage cultivators appear abruptly, it would be noticeable.

chapters.title: Chapter 481 - 480 Where am I now?_1
chapters.content:
"Many unfamiliar Unification Stage cultivators?"
Lu Yang was confused. He didn't know many Unification Stage cultivators, primarily those from his own Sect. Among the external Unification Stage cultivators he'd invited to the celebration, he only knew Su Yiren and knew the names of a few others.
Like the Sect Leader of the Control Qi Sect who just passed by, whom he had not recognized.
The newly acquired "Unification Stage List of the Great Xia Dynasty" did have brief details and portraits of the various Unification Stage cultivators, but Lu Yang had been busy exploring the streets and hadn't had a chance to look at it yet.
Unlike the unreliable Fairy Eternity, what Eldest Senior Sister said was highly credible, and Lu Yang had to take it seriously.
"Could they be Unification Stage hermits?"
Like Su Yiren, who was a hermit cultivator. Her presence wasn't widely known, and not many people could recognize her.
Eldest Senior Sister shook her head, denying this possibility, "I know most of the Unification Stage hermits. It can't be that all the ones I've never met are here."
Lu Yang frowned in thought. This was odd, the sudden appearance of so many Unification Stage cultivators. Were they friends or foes?
Enemies?
Any thought of attacking the Seek Dao Sect would only be attributed to madness.
Friends?
But why wouldn't they introduce themselves?
Lu Yang could not quite understand the thought process of these Unification Stage cultivators.
"Not just Unification Stage, there are three or four at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage as well who are also strangers," said Yun Zhi suddenly.
Lu Yang was shocked, this made the situation even more serious.
"Should we catch some and ask them?" Lu Yang suggested. If they caught the wrong person, as the Acting Sect Leader, he could always apologize.
"Alright." Yun Zhi nodded, Lu Yang's idea suited her.
A wooden sign blocked their path.
The sign read: Please hold your breath before entering.
"This wooden sign wasn't here when we passed earlier, was it?" Lu Yang puzzled. The two of them had almost completed a full round by now.
"Sixth Elder put up this sign." It was clear to Yun Zhi that this was not the first time she had seen the wooden sign; she recognized instantly that it was the work of the Sixth Elder.
Lu Yang was relieved and understood.
Everyone attending the celebration was a genius or a powerful cultivator, holding their breath was only a matter of thought and did not constitute a problem.
The arrival of the Sixth Elder did not cause much disturbance.
The two quickly met the Sixth Elder in a familiar location, the same spot where Luo Hongxia had been fishing.
Luo Hongxia and the Sixth Elder were close friends. It was a good opportunity for them to chat during the celebration.
Even though they couldn't speak, their relaxed demeanor indicated they were having a good time.
Lan Ting and Tao Yaoye were following their masters and also chatting via Spiritual Sense.
"Palace Master Luo."
"Fellow Daoist Yun."
The two saluted each other with a hand gesture.
"Lu Yang, it's been a while since our last meeting in Qingzhou," Lan Ting greeted warmly.
"Junior Sister Lan Ting, Do you know Junior Sister Tao?" Lu Yang noticed the two were smiling brilliantly and seemed to have a good relationship.
Both of them had Immortal bodies, so perhaps they shared many common topics.
"I've heard from my master that Palace Master Luo had taken in a prodigy as outstanding as my junior sister. I'm delighted to finally meet you today." Tao Yaoye started and took Lan Ting's hand, stepping aside to maintain distance from Lu Yang and Lan Ting.
Lan Ting also chimed in with a soft, sweet voice, "Junior Sister Tao and I hit it off immediately. She even plans to use my image for the Dream Mirage."
Tao Yaoye chuckled lightly, gently shaking Lan Ting's arm, "I've always wanted to use a beautiful cultivator's image for the Dream Mirage. I was astonished to see Junior Sister Lan Ting today. Who knew the world could contain such beauty. You couldn't be more fitting for the Dream Mirage."
"Ah the compliments, Junior Sister Tao is much more beautiful than I am. All I have to be proud of is my Cultivation Level."
The atmosphere seemed a bit peculiar to Lu Yang, but he couldn't quite figure out the source of that peculiarity, and decided to stay silent for the moment.
Yun Zhi noted that the Restraining Light Treasure Box was set aside next to Luo Hongxia and she initiated a conversation, "May I know if Palace Master Luo has any business with the Treasure Box? Is there anything pending?"
Luo Hongxia considered for a moment. Nearly all the old veterans of the Cultivation World that she knew were now inside the box, so it should be clear of tasks now.
"It's done."
"Can you lend it to me?"
This was the perfect time to catch those unfamiliar Unification Stage and Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivators using the Restraining Light Treasure Box.
"Um... "
Luo Hongxia seemed hesitant. Although the Restraining Light Treasure Box was the treasure of the Laurel Fairy Palace, the practice of borrowing treasures was common among the Five Great Immortal Sects. It wasn't a good excuse for her to decline.
Luo Hongxia was also feeling guilty. They were in Seek Dao Sect's territory and had shut all the powerful attendees in the Treasure Box. If this were to get out, it would be embarrassing for the Seek Dao Sect.
Plus, Yun Zhi was right there and it was too late to let the people out now.
Unable to think of a reason to refuse, she reluctantly decided to lend the Treasure Box.
"I thank Palace Master Luo in advance." Yun Zhi gave a salute, with a flick of her fingers, the Treasure Box floated up from the ground.
"Junior Brother, let's go."
Upon hearing Eldest Senior Sister's call, Lu Yang heaved a sigh of relief, and after a quick farewell to the two ladies, he quickly followed Yun Zhi.
...
True Monarch Wangyue was squatting in front of a stall, thoughtfully looking at the merchandise.
He was tasked by the Imperial Teacher to understand the situation of the celebration, but he hadn't expected there could be unexpected gains too.
"Interested in this?" The stall's owner was an old man who looked like an old farmer. He had a simple smile and picked up a book from the stall.
"I found this old book in a Secret Realm. It records the existence of someone called the Hundred Medicine Heavenly King from the Heavenly Court. If you're interested, I'll sell it to you for 800,000 Spirit Stones!"
True Monarch Wangyue was intrigued. The Imperial Teacher was distressed over the sudden emergence of the Heavenly Court, and he didn't expect to find a clue about the Heavenly Court here. It was a great merit!
To a Unification Stage cultivator, 800,000 Spirit Stones wasn't expensive.
He wasn't worried that it would be fake. This was the Seek Dao Sect's territory after all. No one would dare to sell fake goods. Doing so would be an affront to the Seek Dao Sect.
"I'll take it!"
Without further ado, True Monarch Wangyue exchanged his Storage Ring with the old man's Storage Ring and transferred the 800,000 Spirit Stones.
Just as he was about to pick up the book, a beam of light enveloped him and sucked him into the Treasure Box.
Snap.
The old book fell, landing on the ground.
"Martial Nephew Yun, what is this..." Uncle Ba looked slightly surprised at Yun Zhi.
"Eldest Senior Sister wants to ask him something." Lu Yang helpfully answered for Yun Zhi.
True Monarch Wangyue was bewildered, unsure of what had happened.
He had just bought a book, why was he here now?
Why were there so many people here?
He saw two Great Cultivators grinning sinisterly, rubbing their hands together, slowly walking towards him. An old monk with a kind face was giving off a murderous aura.
At a further distance, a group of beaten up Great Cultivators lay on the ground, wailing. This sight sent chills down his spine.
Where was he?
"I don't recognize him, who's this?" Qiu Jin'an was a bit hesitant. He had never seen True Monarch Wangyue before.
"Who cares? Since he was put in here by Fellow Daoist Luo, he must be here to mock us. It's definitely right to beat him up!" Yang Ding made a simple analysis and came to a conclusion.
"Makes sense."

chapters.title: Chapter 482 - 481: Why Are There So Many People in the Treasure Box? _1
chapters.content:
"Uncle Ba, this old book of yours…"
Lu Yang looked perplexed. He had heard the conversation just now. The old book detailed the stories of the Hundred Medicine Heavenly King.
Wasn't the Hundred Medicine Heavenly King you, old man?
Are you writing your autobiography?
Uncle Ba did not feel embarrassed at all and admitted directly, "I just want to exploit the fame we earned in Hanshui City battle, and use this opportunity to market and promote myself."
He thought that the appearance of the divine bean deity in the Hanshui City was the handiwork of Eldest Senior Sister.
"I planned to purposely leak some information to the outside world, so everyone knows about the mysterious and powerful Heaven's Court."
"Look at this book, it appears old enough. I specifically borrowed a magic artifact related to time magic from Old Five and aged this book with the artifact."
As a notorious member of the nine children of the Seek Dao Sect, Uncle Ba was meticulous in his deceit.
"Fifth Elder can control time?" Lu Yang was surprised. Amongst the people he knew, only he, Fairy Eternity, and Time Immortal could use time magic.
It is very difficult to cultivate time magic; if one does not have high suspicion, they will not learn it no matter how hard they try.
"No, Old Five doesn't have such an immense ability. He just happened to refine it. It's a tapestry that can change the time of the objects it wraps. He treasures it a lot. If it wasn't for myself and big brother intervening, he wouldn't have lent it to me!" Uncle Ba muttered, dissatisfied with Fifth Elder's stinginess.
He did not think about the fact that he was even more miserly than the Fifth Elder when it came to guarding the medicinal garden. If anyone picked a herb or two, he would act as though they were after his life.
"Did the Grand Elder also participate?"
What can I say? Lu Yang didn't feel surprised by this news, after learning about it.
He even felt that it was understandable.
"Let's go, capture all the unfamiliar faces."
Eldest Senior Sister did not interfere in Uncle Ba's antics. Uncle Ba's activities did not pose any risk and it wouldn't tarnish the image of the Seek Dao Sect. It fit well within the conditions of the event.
Moreover, there were important things to do right now.
She decided to gain momentum by capturing everyone and put them in the treasure box to understand what these unfamiliar cultivators were planning to do.
"Let's go!" With the support of Eldest Senior Sister, Lu Yang had the courage to go forward. He, being the representative of the Acting Sect Leader, saw no issue in capturing a few Unification cultivators.
The brother-sister duo, equipped with the treasure box, moved unimpeded in the Seek Dao Sect, capturing all the unfamiliar cultivators and stashing them away.
This even included the cultivators at the Transcendence Tribulation stage.
The Restraining Light Treasure Box was a top-tier treasure, passed down for a hundred thousand years in the Laurel Fairy Palace. Through the blessings of the Palace Master and Supreme Elders from generations, it had become extremely powerful, capable of trapping even those in the Transcendence Tribulation stage.
However, those at the Transcendence Tribulation stage could easily escape from the treasure box.
...
The black and white honorable was enveloped in a beam of light, and he assumed his identity had been exposed. He had a cruel look in his eyes and fought back fiercely, but he could only obediently enter the Restraining Light Treasure Box.
As soon as he entered, he saw the cultivator from Great Xia beating up his subordinates. While they weren't hitting hard, the humiliation was immense. His subordinates were fighting back desperately, receiving heavier punches in return.
Seventeen or eighteen Unification cultivators from Great Yu had been beaten and were lying on the ground, their status unknown.
"Damn it, we're definitely exposed!"
This obviously could not be the Seek Dao Sect's hospitality.
Most of the bigshots of Great Xia that he could name were here. Their message had obviously leaked somehow, which let the Seek Dao Sect grasp their handle. As such, they tactically arranged for people in the treasure box to capture them all in one fell swoop!
"What a clever plot." The black and white honorable's voice was cold. The Imperial Teacher was absolutely correct. The Seek Dao Sect was indeed an obstacle to the restoration of Great Yu.
But what of that? He was a late-stage Transcendent. Could he be trapped in this trashy box?
He turned his hands over, and black and white spheres emerged, slowly spinning and containing an infinite amount of destructive power.
Qiu Jin'an and Yang Ding, who were about to make a move, saw the black and white spheres and promptly retreated.
This person is definitely not at the Unification stage!
A cold smile crossed the black and white honorable's face. Just a handful of Unification cultivators, do they think they can trap me because they are overbearing?
Suddenly, he sensed danger. An old monk slowly walked over, full of compassion, with an intense Buddhist aura.
Another old man sat up from the ground, generating a purple steam that traveled three thousand miles eastwards, like a flowing ribbon. The old man grabbed this steam in his hand. It was the founder patriarch from the Control Qi Sect, the One Qi Venerable.
Wooden scraps scattered on the ground levitated and assembled into a puppet, the Puppet Honorable, the Grand Elder of Yanshi Sect.
One Great Power after another climbed up from the ground, radiating an aura exceeding the Unification Stage.
For the 120,000-year celebration of Seek Dao Sect, naturally they also invited the senior predecessors of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage to observe.
They all came to mock Master Jiesha, couldn't find Master Jiesha, so they went to find Luo Hongxia and were each put into the treasure box, suffering the beating of Master Jiesha.
There were only so many people at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. When a Transcendance Tribulation Stage with an unknown origin suddenly appeared, they naturally wanted to interrogate him carefully.
"All together!" Lu Baqian shouted, and several Transcendance Tribulation Stages attacked at the same time.
The Puppet Honorable showed a desperate look.
As expected, the Seek Dao Sect was well prepared!
He had fallen into their trap!
…
"Almost everyone is caught." Yun Zhi and Lu Yang walked around for a few circles, now everyone outside was familiar to them.
"Let's go in and interrogate them."
Yun Zhi was quite confident. She had caught so many people. Even if one or two of them didn't tell the truth, could it be possible that all of them wouldn't?
A beam of light enveloped the two of them, and they entered the treasure box.
"Fellow Daoists, someone else has come in, get up!" Lu Baqian, upon seeing someone come in, shouted, signaling everyone to attack.
He rushed to the front, unaware that the expression of the people behind him was filled with terrible memories, they showed a somewhat horrified expression and stopped in their tracks, not charging forward.
"Yun... Yun Zhi?" Lu Baqian also reacted, abruptly halting his steps.
"Why are there so many people?" Yun Zhi was also very surprised, she thought the box was filled with unfamiliar cultivators.
Lu Yang's eyes flickered, observing his surroundings.
Unfamiliar cultivators were all tied up, even the three seized Transcendance Tribulation Stages were no exception.
One of the Transcendance Tribulation Stages was currently confessing the truth of their actions.
"I confess, I've confessed everything."
"We are cultivators from Great Yu, acting on the orders of the Imperial Teacher. Seizing the opportunity of the celebration, we infiltrated the Seek Dao Sect to assassinate Lu Yang and then wipe out the entire Seek Dao Sect."
"All our comrades are here, captured by you."
Lu Yang made a strange face, unsure of what kind of expression he should show.
So these unfamiliar cultivators were from Great Yu. This was somewhat anticipated, but why on earth did they want to kill me?
Has my identity as the heir of Heaven's Court been exposed?
"How come all of you fellow Daoists are here?" Yun Zhi was puzzled.
Lu Baqian explained it with an expression that suggested they had expected all this: "That's a long story. We received the news that cultivators from Great Yu would infiltrate Seek Dao Sect, so I summoned my fellow Daoists to gather here and ambush them!"
"Yes, yes, yes, that's exactly what happened."
"We waited for a long time and finally, they showed up."
Everyone nodded their heads to corroborate Lu Baqian's story.
Otherwise, what would they say, that they came all this way to mock the four leaders of the Four Great Immortal Sects, but ended up being fished in and beaten up?
They could not lose that much face.
Obviously, they thought the cultivators of Great Yu were brought in by Luo Hongxia.
Out of respect for their senior predecessors, Yun Zhi did not expose their lies.
People like Qiu Jin'an also did not expose their lies. After all, they had already been beaten up; they needed to save some face.
The Great Yu cultivators who heard this regretted deeply.
I knew it was a trap!
The Puppet Honorable, whose cultivation level was the highest, was not convinced. He felt that things hadn't reached the point of no return yet: "How about you having more people, waits till the Imperial Teacher makes a move, you will all be done for!"

chapters.title: Chapter 483 - 482 Semi-Immortal?_1
chapters.content:
Time went back a bit.
"So this is the Seek Dao Sect, quite magnificent."
Mingtai stood at the entrance of the Seek Dao Sect, expressing his admiration.
"Mingtai, let's go." Elder Sikong urged him to keep up.
They passed through the bamboo forest, crossed the stream, and entered the core location of the Seek Dao Sect, the main venue for this celebration.
The River Spirit poked out its head to scrutinize every person entering the Seek Dao Sect, determining if they were eligible to enter.
"This year's celebration is more lively than ever." The River Spirit murmured as it watched the geniuses and great powers entering in a single-file, a satisfied smile spreading across its face.
It is a spirit of the stream, blessed by nature. Possessing a hint of spiritual light and enlightened by Daoist Xiantian, it developed true intelligence. Grateful for Daoist Xiantian's kindness, it voluntarily became the guardian spirit of the sect, witnessing the rise and fall of the Seek Dao Sect.
What the River Spirit didn't notice was, along with Mingtai, a group of uninvited guests also entered the Seek Dao Sect.
They moved through the bamboo forest silently, leaving no trace behind, as if they didn't exist, going unnoticed by everyone.
"I've heard about the formidable protective spirit of the Seek Dao Sect. Seeing it today, it truly lives up to its reputation. It's a pity that this time, you met me." The Imperial Teacher sneered, bypassing the River Spirit, leading his people into the Seek Dao Sect.
Upon entering the core area of the Seek Dao Sect, the Imperial Teacher dropped his disguise. With so many cultivators around who, even if they couldn't see them, might bump into them, continuing to hide would rather be disadvantageous.
On the way, the Imperial Teacher spotted several transcendence tribulation stage cultivators and thought to himself that it was a good thing he had brought enough people, or it wouldn't be so easy to destroy the Seek Dao Sect all alone.
"Sir, when should we take action?" The Black-White Venerable transmitted a message using spiritual sense, asking softly.
"No hurry, the celebration has just begun. It is when the Seek Dao Sect is most on guard. First, we need to figure out exactly how many unification stage and transcendence tribulation stage cultivators are participating in this celebration. Identify the difference in strength between the two parties, then decide when to act and at what time to act."
"By the standards of the immortal sect, every sect should at least have a transcendence tribulation stage cultivator and one method potent as the transcendence tribulation stage. The Seek Dao Sect couldn't possibly put all its forces into this celebration. Their sect treasury and other important places must be guarded."
"The River Spirit we just saw should be the method potent as the transcendence tribulation stage. The real transcendence tribulation stage cultivator of the Seek Dao Sect should be elsewhere. By the time we act quickly, and the transcendence tribulation stage cultivator of the Seek Dao Sect won't be able to react. Even if he manages to hurry over, it will be too late."
Ding—— ding—— ding——
The bell echoed through the Seek Dao Sect, twelve reverberations in total, signaling the official start of the celebration.
The group remained silent, watching their target slowly climb the altar to preside over the ritual ceremony.
"Such an ancient ritualistic method, it seems to originate from ancient times." The Imperial Teacher expressed his slight surprise. They were cultivators from the early Great Yu, separated from ancient times by only a Great Qian dynasty.
The Seek Dao Sect, which was established in the late stage of the Great Yu, was in possession of such an ancient ceremony.
"This Seek Dao Sect does have some stuff to offer." The Black-White Venerable commented lightly, his status among the group second only to the Imperial Teacher.
The age of the ritualistic method doesn't necessarily prove anything, it could possibly be found in some ancient book.
After all, until now, many ancient ruins have not been fully excavated.
"A common boy, who has repeatedly interfered with the plans of Great Yu, really does not know the word 'death'!"
The celebration came to a close, and the Imperial Teacher's brows relaxed, the corner of his mouth hooking up into a slight smile.
"Sir, you are..."
The Imperial Teacher analyzed to the group, "Haven't any of you noticed that compared to during the celebration's ritual, the number of high-level cultivators here is decreasing? It seems I overestimated the Seek Dao Sect's position in Great Xia."
"It seems these high-level cultivators had been compelled to participate in the celebration's ritual due to saving face. After the ritual ended, the various activities the Seek Dao Sect has prepared, including the finals among the young cultivators, are unable to catch their interest hence they left."
The group showed faces of excitement as the number of high-level cultivators decreased, implying that their actions were unhindered and the pressure significantly reduced.
"Heaven's will truly favors Great Yu," the Imperial Teacher's mouth curled upward, his mood jubilant. In this case, the downfall of Seek Dao Sect was ensured.
"But we can't let our guards down at the moment. It's inconvenient to use spiritual sense here. All of you scatter and gather information about the Seek Dao Sect. Later, come here to summarize."
The Imperial Teacher pointed at the ground beneath him, "I'll wait for you here."
"Yes."
The group dispersed, leaving the Imperial Teacher standing alone.
"They probably won't be returning for a while. I'll go gather some information about the Seek Dao Sect as well."
The Imperial Teacher was cautious in his actions, he needed to verify the information collected by his subordinates with his own findings to ensure the reliability of the information.
"The busiest place should be the passing market. Let's go take a look there." The Imperial Teacher strode towards the market.
"Just a small market street and it's hiding so many unification stage cultivators." The Imperial Teacher squinted, his profound cultivation level allowed him to instantly notice that the seemingly ordinary restaurant owners and shop assistants were all formidable experts. They could dominate realms in the outside world.
"Merely unification stage cultivators wouldn't be able to make waves."
He was capable of killing six transcendence tribulation stage cultivators alone. Even though all of them were in the early stage of transcendence tribulation, he found himself quite extraordinary. He didn't pay much heed to unification stage fighters.
"Sir, would you like some barbecue?" Xiao Wu, Xiao Liu, and Xiao Qi, the three attractive ghouls, were attracting customers at the entrance of the barbecue restaurant, attracting everyone's attention.
The barbecue restaurant was bustling with business. Master Liu and Master Gao were working with six arms between them, significantly increasing the efficiency of grilling.
"Make way, make way, I'm here to deliver meat." The boss of the slaughterhouse asked the customers to give way so he could enter.
The business of the barbecue restaurant was so good that despite their preparatory measures, the supplies of meat skewers were not enough.
The Immortal Eternity sat leisurely with his legs crossed, watching all of this with a smile on his face that he couldn't contain.
The sales of that day were as good as ten days combined.
The sign of the barbecue restaurant had been temporarily changed by Lu Yang, otherwise outsiders would remember the name of the barbecue shop and spread it outside. The Nine Nether Sect would find out that the Seek Dao Sect also had a "Come Again Barbecue Shop", making it difficult to fool the Nine Nether Sect then.
The Imperial Teacher heard Xiao Wu's call and looked up, and immediately saw the two barbecue chefs and the boss of the slaughterhouse, his heart jolted.
"Three unification-stage ghouls? Is the transcendence stage of the Seek Dao Sect here?"
Only a transcendence tribulation stage cultivator could refine unification-stage ghouls. Typically, ghouls and those who refine them are not far apart. Could the transcendence tribulation stage cultivator of Seek Dao Sect be hiding in this barbecue restaurant?
"What good luck." The Imperial Teacher smiled, brimming with confidence.
He had planned to investigate first, but didn't expect to be able to deal with a transcendence tribulation stage cultivator in advance.
Hiding and disguising were attributes of his Dao fruit; that's how he managed to evade the scrutinizing gaze of the River Spirit, a match for the transcendence tribulation stage, and lead his group into the Seek Dao Sect.
His Dao Fruit could ensure that he silently eliminated the transcendence tribulation stage cultivators in the Seek Dao Sect.
He walked into the barbecue restaurant and saw the laid-back Immortal Eternity.
The Immortal Eternity saw him too.
"Semi-Immortal?"
Both said at the same time.

chapters.title: Chapter 484 - 483: The Initial Form of the Imperial Teacher's Dao Fruit_1
chapters.content:
The Realm that the Imperial Teacher pretended to possess was the Unification Stage. But such deception could fool those at the Unification or Transcendence Tribulation Stage, but it could not deceive cultivators of the same realm.
If the Imperial Teacher made a sincere effort to pose, he might be able to deceive cultivators of the same realm.
But he had never thought that he would encounter a Semi-Immortal in the Seek Dao Sect!
Giant waves of shock surged in the Imperial Teacher's heart. This was just one of the Five Great Immortal Sects. It would be considered impressive if there were a few at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage. How could there be a Semi-Immortal?
The Immortal Eternity stared intently at the Imperial Teacher with a solemn expression.
Between cultivators of the same realm, without any special magic skills, it would be impossible to see through the other's cultivation level.
If two cultivators meet and cannot see through each other's cultivation level, there are two possibilities – either the other person's realm is higher than theirs or it is the same.
The chance of encountering an Immortal is rare in this world.
Then, the other person must be a Semi-Immortal.
Those who possess the preliminary form of the Dao Fruit are considered Semi-Immortals.
Is the one who is coming a friend or a foe?
The Imperial Teacher gritted his teeth. Although the other party was a Semi-Immortal, they only had their soul left, causing their combat power to decrease. So, a quick battle would be the best option.
He decisively utilized his magic artifact that he had refined for three thousand years, a Semi-Immortal-level eight-sided porcelain plate. He threw the porcelain plate onto the ground, and the shattered pieces formed a closed space trapping both of them in it. Using his preliminary Dao Fruit power, he cut off the connection between the Immortal Eternity and the outside world.
...
"Business is good today, the immortals should..." the Master spoke while grilling.
He suddenly paused.
Immortal? What immortal?
The Master scanned his little shop, which was bustling with customers. Master Gao and Master Liu were extremely busy, some Elders from his sect were handling the dishes, and three stunning ghosts were attracting customers outside the door.
"Old Gao, Old Liu, do you feel that someone is missing?"
Master Gao and Master Liu looked around, puzzled: "No, isn't everyone here?"
"Is that so?" The Master's eyebrows knitted into a frown, then slowly relaxed.
"Then I must have remembered incorrectly."
...
"Enemy!"
The Immortal Eternity was caught off guard by the Imperial Teacher's tactic. Being trapped in a temporarily constructed small space, it was clear that the enemy aimed to kill him.
Do they think he's easy to bully?
The Immortal Eternity let out an impassioned cry and emitted rays of golden light. The space shimmered like ripples, forming an all-encompassing heavenly blade severing all Spirit Roots.
"What of the heavenly blade, the Heaven's Will belongs to my Great Yu, Chaos Holy Lotus!"
The Imperial Teacher scorned, projecting a lotus, shrouded in chaos mist, from between his brows. The lotus petals emitted a white halo, a raging torrent incessantly illuminating all directions, melting the golden light.
"Chaos Holy Lotus?" The Immortal Eternity gasped in surprise. This was an unparalleled transcendent relic that released chaotic energy capable of counteracting the tribulation. It was specifically for cultivators breaking through to the Tribulation Transcendence stage.
Such a thing was always a legend. He had never heard of anyone possessing it.
"You do have some knowledge. This was excavated by me from the far north, it is the source of a whole chaos mountain range. It symbolizes the will of Heaven."
"Heaven's will my ass, Heaven's will is with my Eternity Lineage!"
"Eternity Lineage?" The Imperial Teacher frowned; he had never heard of this lineage.
"Ignorant. My Eternity Lineage is extremely powerful. I rank only third!"
The Immortal Eternity sneered, shocking the Imperial Teacher.
He was a semi-immortal powerhouse who ranks third, so who exactly were the top two?
At least they should be Semi-Immortals!
"Punishment by Fire!"
The Imperial Teacher pulled out eight copper rods from his storage ring. The rods, once inserted into the ground, instantly expanded and turned into Sky-Bearing Copper Columns.
"Freeze!"
The Imperial Teacher pointed at the Immortal Eternity, and the eight Sky-Bearing Copper Columns extended numerous iron chains. The Immortal Eternity tried to evade, but found a causality connection between himself and the chains that he couldn't break.
It was a guaranteed hit magic skill!
The chains tied up Fairy Eternity and suspended her in the middle of the eight copper columns!
Crackle—
Lightning suddenly appeared above, ravaging space, concentrating on a point, and directed at the Immortal Eternity!
"Dream Butterfly Technique."
The Immortal Eternity closed his eyes, transformed into countless fairy butterflies, struggled out of the chain bondage, then regrouped and stood on top of the copper columns, watching the missed thunderbolt from the side.
"Overturned Sea Seal!" The Imperial Teacher's palm flipped, and the deep blue palm seal, carrying the fishy smell of the sea wind, roared and pressed down towards the Immortal Eternity.
In the Great Yu era, the Overturned Sea Seal held impressive power. There was a general in Transcendance Tribulation Stage who wielded the Overturned Sea Seal to repel the invading millions of the Sea Clan with a single palm strike, staining the sea red instantly.
And this was just displayed by someone in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. If activated by a Semi-Immortal level powerhouse, its power would be even greater!
"Great Free and Easy Palm!"
The palm collided with the seal, causing a thunderous rumble, flesh and blood flying about, and the soul melting within.
The Imperial Teacher ended up with a severed arm, and his immortal blood dripped, turning into a sea of blood.
The Imperial Teacher snorted coldly, took the Great Pill refined from a thousand precious medicinal ingredients, quickly recovered the damage. Bones grew, muscles attached, skin covered, and his arm was restored.
"Physical injuries can be quickly healed, let's see what you can do about your soul damages!"
The Imperial Teacher looked at the damaged soul of the Immortal Eternity, holding the winning ticket. He once again performed the Overturned Sea Seal to end the Immortal Eternity's life in a single blow.
The soul is the basis and once damaged, even the Great Pill would struggle to recover it.
"Save your worries, Great Free and Easy Palm!"
After exchanging blows with the Immortal Eternity, the Imperial Teacher found something wrong. The opponent's soul was wounded and his cultivation level should only be able to exert seventy to eighty percent of his power. How could he still be in his prime state?
What the Imperial Teacher didn't know was that, in front of the Eternity Dao Fruit embryo, there was no such thing as soul damage — a damaged soul could be restored instantly.
The two exchanged hundreds of blows in a short time, too fast for the eye to follow.
"Cough."
The Imperial Teacher coughed up blood. The outcome of the duel saw him at a disadvantage.
The oppressiveness of the opponent was beyond his expectation.
The Immortal Eternity, who served as a substitute for Fairy Eternity, had always been powerful. But ever since his debut, he suffered strikes from the three great powers, Lu Yang, Fairy Eternity, and Yun Zhi, and became captive, his greatness never had the chance to fully reveal itself.
"Well, well, well, I underestimated you."
The Imperial Teacher knew that he wouldn't be able to fight on evenly. He activated the Dao Fruit embryo, severing his causality with the Immortal Eternity.
The Imperial Teacher slowly disappeared in front of the Immortal Eternity, as if he had become one with space.
The Immortal Eternity was on high alert, released his spirit sense, and vigilantly prepared for the Imperial Teacher's move.
Immediately, he felt a moment of confusion and revealed a bewildered expression.
"What am I doing?"
Immortal Eternity furrowed his brows, his memory seemed to have a gap, and he forgot what had happened.
Hidden in the dark, the Imperial Teacher detachedly watched all of this, looking for an opportunity to attack.
He was practicing the Dao Fruit of Causality and was currently in the embryo stage.
The Dao Fruit of Causality could control causality at will. Everything in the world was composed of causality. The acquaintance, interaction, and enmity between people were all part of causality.
Once the cause and effect between people are severed, one will forget the other's existence.
The River Spirit ignored the Imperial Teacher and his party, the Eternity Sect's higher-ups forgot about the Immortal Eternity, the punishment by fire made a sure hit, the Immortal Eternity forgot about the Imperial Teacher... all were effects of the Dao Fruit of Causality embryo.
Imperial Teacher had once killed six cultivators in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage because he made them forget his existence and took them down one by one!

chapters.title: Chapter 485 - 484: Self-Destruction_1
chapters.content:
The Imperial Teacher severed the causality between himself and Immortal Eternity, who in turn forgot about himself and lost the ability to perceive his own existence.
"Lunar True Fire."
He whispered in his heart, and with a hiss, a ball of fire burst forth from his mouth. This True Fire was specialized for targeting souls, dispersing them into nothingness. It ranked equal to the Sun True Fire, and after being refined by him, even a Semi-Immortal level powerhouse would struggle to resist.
The Lunar True Fire was like a bone-deep infection, mercilessly corroding the soul of Immortal Eternity.
"I remember now!"
At the moment the Imperial Teacher attacked Immortal Eternity, the causality between them was re-established, causing Immortal Eternity to recall his past.
His Eternity Dao Fruit started activating, his soul started to reform, and the Lunar True Fire was purified.
"As I suspected, the Lunar True Fire alone will not kill you."
Even though he had guessed this would happen, the Imperial Teacher was still taken aback, unable to discern the methods used by his opponent.
There were methods to deal with the Lunar True Fire, but each one was exceedingly troublesome and never as effortless as Immortal Eternity made it seem.
"Is it the power of the Dao Fruit, something related to the soul?"
This battle was proving more challenging than the Imperial Teacher had anticipated. He supposed that with nothing but a soul, Immortal Eternity would be easier to handle. He hadn't expected that Immortal Eternity's soul could reform at will, turning what should have been a weakness into a formidable strength.
Immortal Eternity was also pondering the techniques deployed by the Imperial Teacher, the ones that had made him forget the existence of the Imperial Teacher himself. He had never heard of such extraordinary magic skills. Was this the result of the Imperial Teacher's Dao Fruit?
Ordinary Cultivators rely on magic skills and physical prowess during battle, but when reaching the Unification and Pass Tribulation stages, they had to also concern themselves with certain 'rules'. These 'rules' would easily crush a medium or low-realm Cultivator, but for those at the same stage, they offered no clear advantage.
Everyone at that level could utilise the same 'rules', so no advantage was measurable.
However, once a Cultivator at the Pass Tribulation stage managed to condense a Dao Fruit, things changed significantly. Having a Dao Fruit meant that the Cultivator had access to a unique set of 'rules' of their own. Each Dao Fruit had different properties, and the understanding of the Dao Fruit themselves often resulted in variances among Semi-Immortal level powerhouses.
In battles among Semi-Immortal level powerhouses, it was vital to comprehend the nature of the opponent's Dao Fruit.
"Defeat Tribulation Immortal Body!"
A gigantic statue of a deity emerged, reaching the heavens and spreading across the ground. It nearly shattered the space and had the ability to pluck stars from the sky. The deity statue carried the characteristics of immortality and was indestructible!
The Imperial Teacher, once again, activated the Dao Fruit of Causality to sever his connection with Immortal Eternity.
"Damn it, this trick again..." Immortal Eternity ground his teeth in annoyance. Without understanding the principle of this technique, he would always be at a disadvantage. Swiftly, he began to use his magical power to inscribe a string of characters explaining the ins and outs of the situation.
Still, as the Dao Fruit of Causality was activated, the row of characters began to blur and became hard to distinguish.
Halfway through his words, his eyes turned hazy, and he forgot about the existence of the Imperial Teacher once more.
A silver needle materialized out of thin air. With a spatial leap, it jumped from the outside of the deity statue to the inside, striking Immortality Eternity right between the brows.
Immortal Eternity cried out in pain, his body weakened, and the Defeat Tribulation Immortal Body could no longer be maintained and collapsed with a thunderous roar.
The Imperial Teacher emerged, and Immortal Eternity's memories returned.
"Damn it, it's the Soul-breaking Needle crafted from the essence of gold and silver."
All the attacks employed by the Imperial Teacher were directed at the soul.
"Even if you know, what can you do? The Soul-breaking Needle can separate your three souls and seven spirits. I am genuinely curious to see how you are going to reform your soul this time!" The Imperial Teacher sneered, a pang of heartache causing his face to twist slightly. Soul-breaking Needles were incredibly difficult to forge - he had only ever managed to make three.
One had been used to display his formidable power when he assumed the role of Imperial Teacher, leaving him with only one. Making more was almost impossible.
The effects of the Soul-breaking Needle were immediate. Immortal Eternity felt as if his body was being torn apart from the inside; a massive force surged within him, threatening to explode out.
10 separate soul sections floated out, representing Immortal Eternity's three souls and seven spirits.
The Imperial Teacher was very interested to see which part of the soul Immortal Eternity would choose to reform.
After three moments, the ten soul sections still floated in the air. And with that, the Imperial Teacher was entirely reassured: dividing the soul had been the correct choice - the opponent could not reform.
"Lunar True Fire!"
He aimed at one of Immortal Eternity's three souls and began breaking them down one by one.
Suddenly, one of the soul sections opened an eye and Immortal Eternity's voice echoed out.
"Why would I need to reform? Explode!"
The Imperial Teacher's pupils constricted instantly, sensing danger. He had never heard of a Semi-Immortal risking their own soul by making one of their three souls self-destruct. It was suicidal.
The soul section exploded instantly, overturning the Imperial Teacher and throwing him down to the ground, his own soul also affected by the blast.
"Do you think it ends here?"
Another of the three souls exploded, stirring up a soul storm. The storm howled, black clouds filled the sky, and all senses ceased to function at that moment.
"Again!"
Boom ——
The third of the three souls exploded yet again.
Immortal Eternity's cold voice echoed amidst the explosions of souls, "I, the head of the Eternity lineage, am amongst the Five Immortals of the Ancients. I've dominated past and present, unbeatable. Now that I've returned, I plan to ascend to the peak of the path to immortality. I am eager to see whether your Dao Fruit or mine is superior!"
"Damn it!" The Imperial Teacher hurriedly activated the Dao Fruit of Causality to sever their connection.
"Explode again!" Immortal Eternity's voice came from one of his seven spirits, causing the Imperial Teacher to feel a chill down his spine.
He had already severed their causality; Immortal Eternity should not be able to remember him, yet why was he still attacking?
Before he could figure it out, a new wave of soul explosions arrived.
Boom —— Boom —— Boom ——
The seven spirits exploded one after another without any pause. The Imperial Teacher had never witnessed such a scene - his body was like a small boat caught in a tumultuous sea, prone to capsizing at any moment!
Immortal Eternity had anticipated this move long ago. Since no matter how he tried to leave clues, they would always be forgotten or erased, he decided not to leave any information about the Imperial Teacher at all.
Before the Imperial Teacher utilized the Dao Fruit of Causality, he left himself just one sentence —
Explode six of the seven spirits.
Three of his souls exploded three times, six of his seven spirits exploded, totalling nine soul storms that made the Imperial Teacher's own soul unstable and caused him to feel dizzy.
"Huff, huff ——" The Imperial Teacher was in disarray. He wore Treasure Clothes, which could defend even against attacks at the Pass Tribulation Stage, but they were left tattered and lost their defensive capabilities after the nine rounds of explosions.
The Imperial Teacher glared fixedly at the last spirit. Now with only one left, he wondered what Immortal Eternity could possibly do.
Then, right before his eyes, he watched as Immortal Eternity reformed his three souls and seven spirits, returning to his peak state.
The Imperial Teacher was best at drawn-out battles. His usual tactic was to first make his opponent forget about him using the Dao Fruit of Causality, then launch a sneak attack. Even a Semi-Immortal could not endure this endless cycle.
What he didn't know was that the Eternity Dao Fruit was the least afraid of drawn-out battles.
...
The black-and-white revered being looked at Yun Zhi and the others as if seeing dead people. "What use is it that you people are numerous? Once the Imperial Teacher makes his move, you are as good as dead!"
"The Imperial Teacher possesses a Dao Fruit and is a Semi-Immortal level powerhouse. If you let me go now, the Imperial Teacher might still spare your lives!"
His tone carried a hint of a threat: even in large numbers, those at the Pass Tribulation stage were nothing more than insignificant pests before a Dao Fruit!

chapters.title: Chapter 486 - 485: Are you referring to yourself as the method you mentioned? _1
chapters.content:
"The owner of the Dao Fruit's embryonic form is a Semi-Immortal?!" Lu Baqian's scalp prickled upon hearing the threat of the Black and White Venerable.
After he stepped into the Transcendance Tribulation Stage realm, he officially entered this circle, gradually understanding the strength of this stage and future cultivation direction.
The goal of the cultivators at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage is to condense the embryonic form of the Dao Fruit.
The embryonic form of Dao Fruit means that one can master an incomplete rule that belongs solely to oneself. Even if this rule is incomplete, it can still dominate all at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
If the Black and White Venerable is not bluffing, and if the Imperial Teacher of Great Yu is indeed a Semi-Immortal, then things could get quite troublesome.
The old ancestors of the various superior-class sects also recognized this problem, feeling its difficulty.
Most cultivators at the Unification stage do not know much about the Dao Fruit's embryonic form and Semi-Immortals. But seeing the worried expressions of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage old ancestors, they realized that dealing with the Imperial Teacher of Great Yu would be harder than they imagined.
Lu Baqian observed how Acting Sect Master Lu Yang looked, finding that Lu Yang seemed as usual.
Indeed, although this junior was temporarily made Acting Sect Master and was being groomed as the next Sect Leader, he still wasn't qualified to be involved in high-level topics like the Dao Fruit's embryonic form or Semi-Immortals.
Otherwise, he wouldn't look so indifferent.
Lu Yang was busy dealing with the incessant chatter of the fairies, not having the energy to notice Lu Baqian's gaze.
"What's a Semi-Immortal? I could defeat one with a single punch! In the ancient times, Semi-Immortals knelt and listened to my lectures!" Fairy Eternity declared arrogantly, not putting a Semi-Immortal in her eyes.
She sat in a deck chair, her skirt swaying with her movement, unveiling a portion of her fair calf.
A Semi-Immortal is not an Immortal.
There were so many Semi-Immortals in the ancient times, but only the five of them became Immortals, right?
"Second-in-command, do you want a Dao Fruit's embryonic form? I can give you one."
"Isn't it true that only those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage can condense the Dao Fruit's embryonic form?" Lu Yang expressed his surprise. This seemed different from the information he knew.
"What a thing to say! With me around, I can forcefully instill a Dao Fruit's embryonic form into you." Fairy Eternity promised emphatically.
Lu Yang firmly rejected her by shaking his head. He harbored rebellious intentions, planning to establish himself independently and break away from Eternity's faction.
"A Semi-Immortal... indeed, quite troublesome." Yun Zhi spoke in a light tone. If a Semi-Immortal hidden in the ceremony suddenly caused trouble, even if he were subdued instantly, it would still result in casualties.
"However, you all need not worry. The Seek Dao Sect has ways to deal with a sneak attack by a Semi-Immortal." Yun Zhi reassured everyone.
"Does the Seek Dao Sect have a Semi-Immortal?" Lu Baqian asked tentatively.
The only response he received was Yun Zhi's cold gaze.
Everyone sucked in a breath of cold air. From the looks of it, even if they don't have a Semi-Immortal, they do have ways to deal with one.
"Should we return to our sects to bring back our treasures to assist us?" Qiu Jin'an asked. The Five Great Immortal Sects still tended to stick together during critical moments.
Yun Zhi shook his head, "Treasures each have their own uses. There's no need to remove them from the Immortal Sects recklessly."
"Alright."
As Yun Zhi said no need, then there really was no need. Qiu Jin'an could tell that this was not about saving face, but absolute confidence.
"Then, what about these Great Yu cultivators..."
"First, lock them all inside the treasure chest. Each of you who helped subdue them will be rewarded accordingly after the celebration is over," Yun Zhi declared.
After all, they did help to fight and interrogate, saving her quite a bit of trouble.
Everyone's eyes lit up with eagerness. They felt that their decision to attend the Seek Dao Sect's celebration was definitely a wise one. Even if they got beaten up, it was worth it.
The Great Yu cultivators themselves weren't valuable. The valuable aspect was the information they held, especially about hidden treasure locations.
The cultivators who had been in slumber since the ancient times usually hid themselves and their treasures in two different places. These were their life's possessions, the capital of the future struggles of the Great Era.
Among them, there were many extinct heavenly treasures, the value of which was immeasurable.
Even if several First-Class Sects split a single treasure trove, it would still be enough to fill their bowls to the brim.
The Seek Dao Sect had already benefited greatly. Yun Zhi had brutally interrogated the Heavenly Calamity Sovereign, the Venerable Thunder, and others to learn the locations of the treasure troves.
When Lu Yang returned from Hanshui City, he met the Grand Elder in the Task Hall instead of his Senior Brother Dai Bufan, because Dai Bufan had been entrusted by Yun Zhi to go treasure hunting.
Everyone lined up out of the treasure chest, appearing on the street.
The geniuses who came to participate in the competition were flabbergasted at this sight. How did these untouchable figures come out of a box?
They held talents indeed, but to become famous and stand shoulder to shoulder with these figures, they still had a long way to go. If they encountered any accidents along this road, they wouldn't reach the peak.
Especially among these people, there were not only those at the Unification stage, but also those at the legendary Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
The figures at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage were mysterious. Most cultivators would never see one in their entire life.
The geniuses whispered among themselves, unable to hide the excitement in their eyes, "Look at that. Is that the One Qi Venerable of the Control Qi Sect? Our sect has received help from the One Qi Venerable. There's a portrait of the Venerable in our sect."
"And also the Puppet Honorable, the most powerful puppeteer. It's said that his puppet threads can control people like puppets."
"There's the newly ascended Transcendance Tribulation Stage's Sect Master Lu Baqian."
"My god, there are so many at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage!"
"Did you see Sect Master Lu? He is chatting and laughing freely with these figures, showing no signs of stage fright!"
"He truly deserves to be the designated next generation Sect Leader. If it were me, I would be too nervous to speak."
"Who could say it ain't so."
Of course, Lu Yang wasn't nervous talking to those at the Unification Stage or the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. He wasn't nervous even when talking to Immortals.
One Qi Venerable suddenly realized something, "Wait, there are three Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivators and about thirty Unification Stage cultivators inside the treasure chest. The chest alone can't hold them."
The treasure chest shook violently as if the people inside were trying to struggle free.
"No worries."
Yun Zhi bit her finger, gently drawing a blood mark on the treasure chest. The chest immediately stopped shaking and fell silent.
One Qi Venerable stared oddly at Yun Zhi, recalling the miserable scene when he was discussing the Dao with Yun Zhi.
You said that the Seek Dao Sect has a way to deal with a Semi-Immortal. This method wouldn't be you, right?
Yun Zhi returned the treasure chest to Luo Hongxia, "There are three Great Yu Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivators locked inside the treasure chest. Please keep it safe, Palace Master Luo."
Luo Hongxia almost dropped the treasure chest.
"Fellow Daoist Luo, rest assured. Fellow Daoist Yun has already sealed the treasure chest. There's absolutely no problem."
"Right, right, right. Even if there is a problem, it's not a big deal. We are all here to help you."
The crowd surrounded Luo Hongxia, mainly focusing on the treasure chest. The people confined inside were all treasures.
After Yun Zhi had given her instructions, she extended her Spiritual Sense. First, she went to the gathering point as mentioned by the Great Yu cultivators and found that the Imperial Teacher was not there. She then extended her Spiritual Sense throughout the area of the Seek Dao Sect, but she was still unable to locate the Imperial Teacher.
"Eldest Senior Sister, have you found the Great Yu Imperial Teacher?"
Yun Zhi shook her head regretfully, "I haven't found him. If he is still in the Seek Dao Sect, there are two possibilities: either the embryonic form of the Dao Fruit is taking effect, or he has temporarily opened up a spatial domain."
"I will search for his traces. The celebration can proceed as usual."

chapters.title: Chapter 487 - 486 The Final Begins_1
chapters.content:
The Imperial Teacher hid so well that even when the finals began, Senior Sister still couldn't find him.
The geniuses fed well and played well, resting for a full day before participating in the finals in high spirits.
The atmosphere of the final was high, and the elders of all the sects cheered for their disciples, hoping that they could achieve a good ranking.
Even if they show their sharpness in the finals, it will be enough to brag about in the outside world.
The geniuses came to draw lots according to the guide, to determine their opponents.
Meng Jingzhou, Bai Ming, Yan Tianzhi, and Lan Ting represent the mid-stage Golden Core of the Immortal Sects and gathered together.
"Who are your opponents?" Bai Ming asked, making sure they wouldn't face each other in the first round.
"My opponent is from the Control Qi Sect."
"I'm against the Xuan Sect."
Once they were certain they wouldn't face each other in the first round, they all breathed a sigh of relief.
"I don't see anyone from the Suspension Temple. Didn't they say that each sect would send a disciple from each realm?" Meng Jingzhou looked around, there were several monks, but none of them looked like they were from the Suspension Temple.
Bai Ming also frowned, he knew the situation of the Suspension Temple best: "It shouldn't be, Shi Chan should meet the requirements and be able to participate in the finals."
"Maybe he had something and didn't come?" Lan Ting guessed kindly.
"It's possible."
"I thought I could meet Lu Yang in this competition." Bai Ming shook his head. He was defeated by Lu Yang twice and wanted to redeem himself, but found that the representative of the mid-stage Golden Core of the Seek Dao Sect was Meng Jingzhou, not Lu Yang.
Yan Tianzhi also showed some regret. He had not fought with Lu Yang and wanted to have a try.
Meng Jingzhou curled his lips: "Don't worry, you'll definitely meet him. He's in the finals too."
Bai Ming was stunned: "Has he broken through to the late stage of the Golden Core?"
"Look at the judges' seat." Meng Jingzhou kindly reminded.
Bai Ming, Yan Tianzhi, and Lan Ting raised their heads to look.
The leaders of the Five Great Immortal Sects sat on the judges' seat, with Lu Yang sitting in the middle, waving at them with a brilliant smile.
Bai Ming: "???"
Why does it feel familiar?
It seems that the last time he came to the Seek Dao Sect, Lu Yang was sitting in this position?
Meng Jingzhou sighed, castigating Lu Yang ruthlessly: "Lu Yang, this dog, uses his power for personal gain, charms upper and bullies lower, and is lawless, making me fight while he enjoys his time on stage. When I become the Acting Sect Master, I must take revenge!"
...
On the judges' seat, Lu Yang reined his gaze back, looking curiously at Master Jiesha: "Master, didn't anyone come from the Suspension Temple?"
Master Jiesha was silent and gave Lu Yang a look that meant 'you figure it out'.
Lu Yang understood and gave Master Jiesha back a 'you figure it out' look.
Lu Yang didn't understand what Master Jiesha meant, and Master Jiesha didn't understand what Lu Yang meant either.
At this point, the last judge arrived, wearing a bright yellow robe and a friendly smile on his face.
"Jiang Qun pays respect to the elders." The young man named Jiang Qun saluted the five.
"Crown Prince, there is no need to be overly polite." Luo Hongxia said holding the treasure box. Along her way, many people asked about the treasure box, fearing that something might happen to it.
Jiang Qun wondered why Palace Master Luo had to hold the treasure box, but thinking that it might be her secret, he didn't pursue further.
The competition was hosted by the court, so it was necessary for the court to send someone.
Lu Yang recognized him. He was Jiang Qun, the eldest prince of Great Xia, disguised as Xia Qun at the Qingzhou event, and was the deputy to the governor of Qingzhou.
"Sect Master Lu, you're very accomplished at a young age." Jiang Qun laughed, being very friendly with Lu Yang.
He was at the Initial Fusion Stage Cultivation, among the six, his cultivation rank was second to last, of course, he had to be closer to the last one.
If Lu Yang leaves, he would become the last.
Moreover, Emperor Xia had instructed him before leaving to get on good terms with the Seek Dao Sect, and with Lu Yang.
Emphasizing Lu Yang, shows the importance the emperor attaches to him.
"I have worked hard and it's only right that I become the Acting Sect Master." Lu Yang said indifferently, blocking Jiang Qun, who didn't know how to continue the conversation.
Why isn't Sect Master Lu modest at all?
"Sect Master Lu has worked hard." It took quite a while for Jiang Qun to squeeze out a sentence.
Of course Sect Master Lu isn't modest. After all, the one controlling his body now is Master Huang, Yellow Bean.
The real Sect Master Lu has been sealed in the Spiritual Space, feeling miserable and distressed, whoever sees it will let out a cry of 'good'.
"The Qi Refinement group's competition should be starting now, right?"
All other realms are split into early, mid and late stages, only the Qi Refinement Stage, only has one group and is not further divided.
Mainly because there is no need to divide it further. The focus of this competition is to select ancient cultivators who start over after disbanding cultivation.
It's not likely that the ancient cultivators are stagnating at the seventh or eighth level of Qi Training. They don't need to waste too much time on Qi Training, the worst are all at the Consummation of Qi Training, or even possibly beyond Qi Training.
The ones who made it to the finals are all at consummation of Qi Training, only one thought away from the Foundation Establishment Stage.
A few cases occurred at the city and state levels where those at the ninth level of Qi Training surprisingly defeated those at the Consummation of Qi Training, but these ninth level Qi Trainers were soon eliminated.
These ninth level Qi Trainers are not facing ordinary Qi Trainers who have achieved Consummation, but rather Qi Trainers who have achieved Consummation and are hard to match in the same level.
"It's a pity that there are no longer any Qi Refiners, otherwise you could have seen Qi Refiners defeating Golden Cores and Nascent Souls at the Qi Refinement Stage." Fairy Eternity said with some regret.
"Qi Refiners?" Lu Yang had never heard of this concept.
"Qi Refiners were the cultivation system developed by the first cultivators. They constantly cultivated a breath in their belly, and they could improve themselves on a regular basis. In theory, they could become immortals through Qi Refinement."
"If Qi Refiners are so strong, why don't they exist now?"
"Qi Refiners are certainly strong, but their limitations are too severe. Only a very few people are able to cultivate it. It might not even be possible to find one suitable for cultivation among several million people. At that time, during the stages of developing the cultivation system, the Qi Refiner system was quickly discarded, and the present Qi Refinement stage developed from Qi Refiners."
"On the other hand, whereas Qi Refiners are extremely rare, once a Qi Refiner is found, their speed of cultivation is incredibly fast."
A disciple of Seek Dao Sect then communicated to Fairy Eternity, informing that the preparations were ready, and the Qi Refinement group matches could begin. Fairy Eternity then formally announced the start of the finals.
"Qi Refinement stage matches are so boring, the Foundation Establishment stage matches are so much better." Yang Ding yawned secretly, making sure the people below didn't see him.
On the stage, two Qi Refinement stage geniuses stepped up.
"Junior brother, please."
"Then I won't hold back."
The opponent laughed, brandished his sword, and thrust it at the other.
The other's eyes flashed with a successful calculation, and his aura surged, breaking through to the Foundation Establishment Stage!
Let's see how you can fight!
The opponent also smiled, and as he thrust his sword towards the other, his aura also surged violently, breaking through to the Foundation Establishment Stage!
Let's see how you can fight!
Yang Ding's wishes came true, a Qi Refinement stage match turned into a Foundation Establishment stage match.

chapters.title: Chapter 488 - 487: Anyone Who Doesn't Break Through on the Spot is a Major Subject for Observation_1
chapters.content:
Those who made it to the finals at the Qi Refinement stage were just a thought away from the Foundation Establishment Stage.
Among them were those who could have progressed to the Foundation Establishment stage a month ago but didn't, holding on till now to break through on the spot.
The first two contestants were Chen Chenxi and Su Youdao.
Chen Chenxi thought he had victory in his grasp after breaking through to the Foundation Establishment phase, but it seems his opponent had the same idea.
"These two youngsters have some interesting thoughts, but it's uncertain who will win."
The sect elders, watching and whispering quietly, couldn't confidently predict who will triumph in the end.
Both competitors were similar in Cultivation Level and foundation, making the outcome of their fight a toss-up to the finish.
"It is certainly my Lockheart Sect disciple who will win." Chen Chenxi's Sect leader from the Lockheart Sect stood up in his backing.
"Is that so? Are you looking down on my Broken Void Sect?" The leader of the Broken Void Sect narrowed his eyes, his tone heavy with implication. Su Youdao was from his sect.
The Lockheart Sect leader offered a warm smile: "I'm just stating the facts, how could that be considered disrespect?"
"How about we make a bet then?"
"What kind of bet?"
"A wager on which sect gets to claim Great Yu's cultivators."
"Good, let's bet. Who's afraid!" Both individuals were closely matched in strength, and their sect's strength were also comparable. They have long seen each other as rivals. If they declined the wager now, they would have to endure ridicule from each other in the future.
The fights within the Qi Refinement category were more intense than expected. According to incomplete estimates, 96% of Geniuses who had reached consummation stage in Qi Refinement broke through on the spot, raising the average combat power of the Qi Refinement group.
The final victor was a core disciple from the Control Qi Sect.
"Note down all those who did not breakthrough during the Qi Refinement match, they are now our key observation targets," Jiang Qun instructed his subordinates, suspecting them to be ancient cultivators restarting their cultivation.
"Yes." Jiang Qun received a transmitting response but saw no one. It was the Luoshui Guards hidden in the dark.
The Luoshui Guards received professional training and were proficient in hiding magic, skilled in cultivation, making it extremely difficult to detect their existence.
Jiang Qun was caught by the River Spirit when he had come to the Seek Dao Sect with the Luoshui Guards the previous day.
Jiang Qun nodded with satisfaction, not expecting to yield results so soon.
"Speaking of which, I wanted to pay a visit to the elders yesterday, but couldn't find them. It's a pity. I wonder where the elders were located yesterday?" Jiang Qun had arrived at the Seek Dao Sect before the ceremony's commencement.
After the conclusion of the ceremony, he wished to pay a visit to the leaders of the Immortal Sects. However, after making rounds, he only found Luo Hongxia, but she was busy chatting with Sixth Elder. As they were communicating through Spiritual Sense, Jiang Qun thought they were flirting, thus refrained from interrupting.
Fairy Eternity naturally included herself in the category of the "elders" and said: "I received the news at the last minute that Great Yu's cultivator was sneakily trying to infiltrate our Seek Dao Sect and disrupt the ceremony."
Qiu Jin'an naturally followed Fairy Eternity's lead and said: "After receiving the message from Sect Master Lu, we devised a plan to hide in the treasure box and lure Great Yu's cultivator into our trap."
Jiang Qun was confused. He wondered why the Luoshui Guards didn't receive this information, and why they needed to hide in a treasure box?
Yang Ding, who was nearby, explained: "Young nephew, you don't know that this treasure box is the priceless artifact from Laurel Fairy Palace. It has a mind-boggling ability. High-level cultivators can easily be drawn into the box."
"Such a miraculous thing?" Jiang Qun was astonished. He had never heard of such a treasure before. The Five Great Immortal Sects were indeed unfathomable.
"Then why wasn't I drawn in?"
"Your cultivation stage is too low."
Jiang Qun: "..."
"Then where is Great Yu's cultivator?"
"In the treasure box." Luo Hongxia patted the treasure box with a resentful face. With the added value of the treasure box, her status has raised. On her journey, everyone kept reminding her to take good care of the box, not to drop it or knock it, and even if any danger arises, she must shout for help, and they would come to her aid immediately.
Her importance rose with the box's prestige.
"You've caught everyone?"
Jiang Qun felt embarrassed. He was feeling proud of identifying a few cultivators who were suspected to be ancient cultivators starting their cultivation anew. However, to his surprise, the Seek Dao Sect had almost eradicated all the infiltrators from Great Yu.
Fairy Eternity calmly nodded: "Almost, except for one Imperial Teacher, who is a Semi-Immortal level practitioner. There's no telling where he's hiding. But Miss Yun has offered to handle this matter."
At first, when Jiang Qun heard that the Great Yu's Imperial Teacher was a Semi-Immortal, he felt anxious, but when he heard that Yun Zhi was handling the matter, his heart settled.
Wait a minute, why did Sect Master Lu just refer to Yun Zhi as what?
Jiang Qun's heart trembled. No wonder his father asked him to build a good relationship with Sect Master Lu. Sect Master Lu and Yun Zhi had a much closer relationship than he had anticipated!
Master Jiesha's hand, which was holding the Buddha beads, paused. He glanced over at Fairy Eternity and the others, feeling glad that he had practiced Silent Zen.
It's better to be a monk who doesn't lie.
Many geniuses chose to break through on the spot in the early and middle phases of the Foundation Establishment category as well, though they were significantly fewer than the Qi Refinement group.
Not all geniuses could reach the consummation stage at the early and mid-phases of Foundation Establishment.
The two winners were from sects that Lu Yang was not familiar with. Even Fairy Eternity had not heard of their sects' names before.
One was from a second-grade sect, and the other was from a third-grade sect.
The Five Great Immortal Sects did not send any participants for the first three group matches. At present, the lowest cultivation level among the disciples in the Immortal Sects was the late stage of Foundation Establishment. If they were forced to select participants for the first three group matches, they would have to send their food supplies instead.
"Have you noted down the names of those few people just now?" Jiang Qun transmitted a magical note to the Luoshui Guard behind him. But he still couldn't see the Luoshui Guard's figure.
"They've all been noted."
"Investigate their backgrounds when we return."
Qiu Jin'an stepped aside slightly and kindly said to the Luoshui Guard hiding behind Jiang Qun: "Why don't you reveal yourself, fellow daoist? After all, everyone can see you're hiding here."
"Also, everyone can hear your Spiritual Sense communication. Why don't you two just converse outright?"
Qiu Jin'an and others could hear and see Jiang Qun and the Luoshui Guard's conversation clearly. They asked, what was the point of them whispering and acting so mysterious?
The Luoshui Guard reluctantly showed himself.
To identify suspicious cultivators, the primary method is to assess their battle experience. Based on rich combat experience, there is a high probability that they are ancient cultivators restarting cultivation, a slight chance that they are Great Powers in disguise, and the least probability of possession.
This time, the rewards were exceptionally generous, increasing the likelihood of attracting Great Powers in disguise.
The first and third type of cases all belong to the category of key observation targets.
Great Xia did not consider ancient cultivators as enemies. Ancient cultivators who disband their cultivation and start anew do not violate the law. They would merely be considered illegal residents and could be penalized by being fined or being registered officially.
The main problem is that a majority of ancient cultivators do not comply with the rules of Great Xia. As these ancient cultivators carried their murderous and lawless ways from the ancient times into Great Xia, the authorities had to impose sanctions on these unruly ancient beings.
If ancient cultivators adhered to the rules after resurrecting, Great Xia wouldn't bother them.
In fact, Lu Yang was highly suspicious due to his rich combat experience and his ability to defeat an established Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivator like Master Jiesha, which was against the norm.
But considering the fact that he was Yun Zhi's junior brother and Yun Zhi had similar experiences, no one suspected Lu Yang of doing anything fishy.

chapters.title: Chapter 489 - 488 Same Name Technique_1
chapters.content:
Zhao Yuan's mouth curled into a cruel smile as he slowly advanced towards the dueling platform, preparing for the late-stage Foundation Establishment group tournament.
Many cultivators nowadays live too easy lives, having never experienced bloodshed or fiery battles. A little ruthless force from him, and they would break down into tears, forfeiting the match.
That's how he made his way up in both city and state-level competitions. If it hadn't been for the referees who intervened in time, everyone who'd gone against him would be dead by now.
However, it is a bit more challenging to kill someone in the broad daylight under the watchful eyes of the Seek Dao Sect.
No matter, if he cannot kill, then he shall scare his opponents into submission and hinder their path of growth. This way, there will be one less potential threat in the Great Era fights.
This time, his opponent is one of those so-called geniuses from the Seek Dao Sect?
He doesn't care. Whoever it may be, they will be rendered useless in front of an absolute gap in power.
"Greetings, I am Wei Nanfei from Seek Dao Sect."
Wei Nanfei is a fellow disciple of Lu Yang. He was poisoned in his childhood by his stepmother and was saved by the passing Dai Bufan.
"Independent cultivator, Zhao Yuan." Zhao Yuan responded dismissively, looking down upon Wei Nanfei.
Were it not for the finals, Wei Nanfei wouldn't even be eligible to share the same dueling platform with him.
After all, he is a powerful cultivator who is at the peak of the Unification stage and chose to Start Over after Disbanding Cultivation. He will certainly ascend another level through this re-cultivation and reach the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
"Please, Zhao Yuan."
Zhao Yuan moved, a green long knife appeared in his hand. A Dragon Eye Stone the size of a pigeon egg embedded in the hilt, and he slashed horizontally towards Wei Nanfei.
"So fast."
Wei Nanfei exclaimed, barely dodging the attack.
Zhao Yuan refused to let up, he twirled his wrist and the green long knife rotated mid-air before once again lunging for Wei Nanfei's abdomen.
Clink——
Wei Nanfei drew two axes from his waist. The axes intersected and blocked the green long knife.
"These axes look very familiar."
Man Gu muttered, then turned to ask Li Haoran next to him: "Junior Brother Li, do you recognize these axes?"
At this moment, Li Haoran was enjoying the company of Su Yiren on his left and Qin Yanyan on his right. His left hand had already been clenched by Su Yiren several times.
Thankfully, Li Haoran was capable of regenerating his limbs, and his wounds healed quickly. He treated it as a way to experiment with the Golden Core.
"These are imitations of the Open Mountain Axe, which I helped Wei Nanfei craft."
"Open Mountain Axe?"
Man Gu also found this name familiar.
Li Haoran then further explained, "It's the axe that the River Spirit gave us during the initiation test. There were three axes: the Mortal Axe, the Spirit Treasure Open Mountain Axe, and the Immortal Artifact Open Sky Axe. Wei Nanfei liked the style of the Open Mountain Axe, so he asked me to forge two for him."
Only then did Man Gu understand.
By this time the battle on the dueling platform had reached a fever pitch, and Wei Nanfei was proving more difficult than Zhao Yuan had anticipated.
Even though he was confident of defeating Wei Nanfei, this level of battle wasn't enough to shake Wei Nanfei's Dao heart.
In ancient times, Zhao Yuan loved to play the role of a sheep in wolf's clothing. He would pretend to be a genius to shatter the Dao heart of other geniuses.
"I must take some action!"
In determination, Zhao Yuan activated his trump card. His blood boiled, his skin swelled red—as if he had transformed into a frenzied beast!
The Dragon Eye Stone embedded in the hilt of the knife emitted a sinister red glow as if an ancient dragon was opening its eyes, exuding an oppressive force!
Boom——
The long knife slashed towards Wei Nanfei's face. Even though Wei Nanfei blocked it with his axes, his arms trembled slightly from the force of the blow.
...
"What kind of cultivation technique is this?"
Yang Ding frowned. The Prison Suppressing Sect didn't do much research on cultivation techniques but Yang Ding could tell that Zhao Yuan was using some technique that temporarily bursts with power.
"It seems like some kind of technique which burns lifespan to temporarily enhance combat power." analysed Luo Hongxia. It's very rare for someone in the present era to practice such a technique.
"It's the 'Heaven Burning and Blood Igniting Art'."
Fairy Eternity spoke unemotionally, showing off her extensive knowledge of ancient times.
Methods to burn one's lifespan to enhance one's battle power were common in ancient times. The Five Immortals of the Ancients burned a few years of their life spans for fun when they were free.
The Time Immortal often burned his lifespan even before becoming an immortal and was very difficult to deal with.
After all, the true body of Time Immortal was the Firmament Tree, the existence of the tree symbolizes the spanning of the human history or even longer, and its lifespan is close to infinity.
"So it's this technique." Although others were unfamiliar with it, they had heard the name of it before.
"Then the disciples of Seek Dao Sect are going to have a hard time. I'm afraid they can't win against this Zhao Yuan guy." Prince Jiang Qun frowned slightly.
Many signs indicate that Zhao Yuan might be a cultivator from ancient times.
"It's okay, Wei Nanfei also practices the 'Heaven Burning and Blood Igniting Art'."
"Really?" Qiu Jin'an was surprised, thinking no wonder you could recognize Zhao Yuan's technique.
"Yes, it was written by Miss Yun."
...
Wei Nanfei opened his mouth as if he wanted to say something, but Zhao Yuan acted faster and took the initiative to stop Wei Nanfei from speaking.
Thinking of surrendering, no way!
Seeing his opponent being unreasonable, Wei Nanfei could only shake his head helplessly and start activating his technique.
Zhao Yuan's power surged rapidly. Even though he was still at the late stage of Foundation Establishment, he could at least contend with someone in the late stage of Golden Core!
Kill!
Zhao Yuan laughed wildly in his heart, his momentum increasing step by step. Wei Nanfei could only avoid his sharp edge and evade his attack.
Zhao Yuan was relentless, determined to leave a psychological shadow in Wei Nanfei's heart through this battle.
Kill, kill, kill!
Zhao Yuan was getting stronger and his lifespan was burning faster and faster.
"Wait, why is my lifespan burning so fast!" Zhao Yuan cried out in horror.
The 'Heaven Burning and Blood Igniting Art' is his life's practice, it was impossible for him to get it wrong.
"It's you!" Zhao Yuan glared at Wei Nanfei.
Wei Nanfei sighed lightly, "I wanted to say earlier, if you gave in, I wouldn't have to use this move. But you wouldn't let me speak up. We both practice the 'Heaven Burning and Blood Igniting Art', why do we have to fight to the death?"
