"More importantly, you can't win against me."
"What are you talking about! What kind of 'Heaven Burning and Blood Igniting Art' do you practice!" Zhao Yuan was furious, who are you trying to fool? He should know this technique better than anyone else.
He had never heard of a technique that could help others burn their lifespan!
"Anyway, Eldest Senior Sister said it's called 'Heaven Burning and Blood Igniting Art'." Wei Nanfei muttered to himself. He also wondered why when he was selecting the technique, the elder presented two books, one was called 'Heaven Burning and Blood Igniting Art', and the other was also called 'Heaven Burning and Blood Igniting Art'.
The difference was one was dug out from the ancient Cave Heaven, and the other was written by Eldest Senior Sister.
He decisively chose the latter.
Zhao Yuan watched as his lifespan was draining away. Even if he stopped running the technique, it was no use. He quickly admitted defeat.
...
"What's happening?" Qiu Jin'an looked at this scene on the stage with surprise.
Fairy Eternity revealed an excited smile, just as she was about to expose Yun Zhi's shameful past, a cup of tea was placed next to her.
She turned to look, and there stood the icy Yun Zhi behind her, asking concernedly, "Acting Sect Master, have a sip of water to moisten your throat."
Fairy Eternity broke out in a cold sweat and dared not say more.
Yang Ding recalled a rumor that said each disciple of Seek Dao Sect had to complete two tasks each year. Yun Zhi, in order to complete the task, lied about having visited an ancient Cave Heaven and finding the ancient technique. However, the so-called ancient technique was fabricated by her based on the names.
Moreover, the same-name technique written by Yun Zhi was often much stronger than the original one.

chapters.title: Chapter 490 - 489: There is no such technique in the Demon Path_1
chapters.content:
The cultivation methods of the late stages of Foundation Establishment were fascinating, with disciples from the Immortal Sect going to battle against suspected ancient cultivators who had gone through Starting Over after Disbanding Cultivation.
They all showcased their Divine Abilities, especially Wei Nanfei, who was the bright spark amongst the disciples of the Immortal Sect, and everyone feared to come into conflict with him.
They only had a few years to live in the Foundation Establishment stage. One match may burn up their lifespan completely.
"Fortunately, the competition has an age limit." Meng Jingzhou remarked with a sigh from the stage's edge. The Seek Dao Sect did have successors waiting to play.
"How do you mean?"
"If they let a bunch of veterans from the Foundation Establishment stage come up, wouldn't they have to concede the match on the spot?"
Bai Ming nods. Indeed, the combined lifespan of the seasoned cultivators in a late stage of Foundation Establishment is not nearly as long as his, and Wei Nanfei's cultivation technique is particularly formidable against these veterans.
"The cultivation method does have its limitations - it can't burn the lifespan of cultivators whose cultivation level is higher than him. However, it doesn't really matter in this competition." Meng Jingzhou has a fair understanding of the method Wei Nanfei is cultivating.
The Seek Dao Sect disciples' cultivation methods are all openly discussed, which is convenient for mutual research and discussion to promote improvement. If someone does not discuss it openly, probably because they are too ashamed to open up, say, because they can't be close to women or something.
...
"A mutant version of the 'Heaven Burning and Blood Igniting Art', sounds interesting. Too bad I've practiced the 'Turtle Breath Technique', it acts as a lock on lifespan, specifically counteracting him."
Under the stage, a towering cultivator slowly opens his eyes, with a chilling gaze and a confident smile. To others, Wei Nanfei poses a formidable challenge, but to him, he is only pedestrian.
If it weren't for Wei Nanfei's good fortune, allowing him to proceed smoothly to the finals, how could he have had a chance if he encountered him?
Then, he turns away and leaves.
He is a cultivator from the early stages of Golden Core.
...
"Burning others' lifespan, quite innovative, a good prospect. If he had encountered me in my time, he could have taken me as his master, what a pity."
Underneath the stage, a cultivator dressed in a black robe murmurs to himself, lifts his hood to reveal a face covered in scars - knife wounds, burn marks, frostbite... Each scar is the result of a battle where he defied life and death.
It's through these battles that he has developed an extremely strong fighting consciousness, making him unsparingly formidable amongst beings of the same realm.
Then, he turns away and leaves.
He is a cultivator from the mid-stage of Golden Core.
...
"Wei Nanfei? Quite interesting indeed, these geniuses of Seek Dao Sect are quite astonishing. As for the lifespan burning, it hardly amounts to a threat."
Underneath the stage, a thin, monkey-like cultivator squints his eyes, analyzing Wei Nanfei's fights. As scene after scene flashes through his mind, he evaluates possible countermeasures.
Having gone through so many competitions, his fighting experience is incredibly rich and he has thought of methods for counteracting Wei Nanfei already.
Then, he sets foot on the stage.
He is the referee.
...
Fang Sheng stands on the stage, waiting for Wei Nanfei to come on stage.
This doesn't take long, as Wei Nanfei quickly leads a group of chickens, ducks, and pigs onto the stage.
Fang Sheng doesn't dare let his guard down; these are not just ordinary beasts, but beasts with cultivation levels.
It seems Wei Nanfei is also a Beast Tamer.
"Seek Dao Sect, Wei Nanfei."
"Yi Sect, Fang Sheng."
The two squaring each other up, their battles were on the verge of breaking out.
While Fang Sheng was studying Wei Nanfei's battles, Wei Nanfei was studying Fang Sheng's. The conclusion was that this was a formidable opponent, and he mustn't let his guard down.
That's why he exerted his full strength right from the start.
"'Heaven Burning and Blood Igniting Art'!"
A cold smile graces the corners of Fang Sheng's mouth: "Do you think I'm unprepared? I don't fear telling you that before going on stage, I had already ingested an elixir to counteract your technique. You cannot burn my lifespan!"
Fang Sheng has a few specially made elixirs that can lock his lifespan for a short duration. They were specifically refined by a master alchemist in case anything happens during the dormant period.
He didn't think he'd get to use them here.
Predicting that Wei Nanfei would be taken aback by this, Fang Sheng seizes this opportunity for close-quarters combat!
"Spear Uplifts Eight Directions!"
Wei Nanfei's axe was sharp and shiny, the reflection dazzling. He was incredibly quick in his movements, with clear, focused eyes. Without hesitation, he struck with all his strength.
Buzz——
The collision of the weapons produced a harsh buzzing sound.
"How is this possible? How can you have such power!"
Fang Sheng was taken aback, retreating while his spear touched the ground to dissipate the force exerted on it.
Based on observations from previous matches, Wei Nanfei could burn others' lifespans to elevate his own realm. This was a power only available to Wei Nanfei when he exerted his martial art techniques!
But clearly his lifespan had not been burned away.
Wei Nanfei sneered: "Who told you that I was going to burn your lifespan? Don't tell me all the ingredients I purchased from Hundred Fragrance Building were bought in vain?"
Fang Sheng seemed to remember something. Out of the corner of his eye, he saw chickens, ducks and pigs, all lifeless.
In miscalculated!
Heroes are as common as fish crossing the river. Wei Nanfei had already predicted that people would try to find ways to counteract his techniques.
Instead of letting his opponent take control, he decided to switch his combat style in advance.
"Power Cleaves the Sky!"
Wei Nanfei swung his twin axes, his muscles bulging as he put all his strength into his strike. Fang Sheng retreated continuously and quickly arrived at the edge of the ring.
This is bad, if I retreat anymore, I will lose!
"Don't think that you can win the match with trickery; true power is everything!"
Fang Sheng roared, a haze of spiritual essence arose from his dantian. The spiritual mist condensed into a pill; a ripe golden core was born.
A breakthrough in the midst of battle!
According to the plan, the breakthrough was supposed to occur half a month later, but he had no choice to advance it in order to avoid defeat.
He, a Genesis Master at the peak of Unification, had to start over after disbanding cultivation. Losing to a cultivator in the Foundation Establishment Stage would be a blow to his ego that he could not withstand!
Moreover, the rewards awarded after the competition would be enough to make up for the drawbacks of an early breakthrough.
Boom——
Fang Sheng counterattacked, and the full power of the Golden Core Stage was demonstrated. Wei Nanfei, who dominated in his realm, could only feel helpless in front of Fang Sheng, who was at a higher stage than him.
"Battling at the Golden Core Stage is challenging indeed... Breaking through to the Golden Core Stage and acting all big and mighty, as if nobody else could ever reach Golden Core Stage."
Wei Nanfei sneered. If it wasn't for the competition, he could have broken through half a month ago.
"Condense."
Heat radiated from Wei's dantian, the warmth spread throughout his body, and a golden core rose slowly just like the sun.
In front of Fang Sheng's surprised eyes, Wei Nanfei revealed a friendly smile.
"Alright, now we are both at the Golden Core Stage."
"My Golden Core may not be as good as Senior Brother Lu Yang, but it's more than enough to deal with you!"
He took out all kinds of livestock from his custom-made storage ring, and started burning their lifespans.
All were purchased from the Hundred Fragrance Building.
As expected, Wei Nanfei won.
...
In the judges' area, Qiu Jin'an rubbed his eyes in distress.
He always felt that these ancient cultivators were not as strong as he imagined. They had combat experience, but lack flexibility.
Burning the lifespan of livestock to advance one's stage seemed like an obvious strategy. Why hadn't they thought of it?
"Burning others' lifespan to enhance one's own fighting power...This seems like something right out of the Demon Path." Yang Ding mumbled quietly, but Fairy Eternity still heard him.
As the Acting Sect Master, she had to defend the reputation of their sect.
"We can't say it like that, our Seek Dao Sect is recognized by the imperial court as an upright and righteous sect, how can we have techniques from the Demon Path?"
"Besides, even the Demon Path doesn't have such techniques."

chapters.title: Chapter 491 - 490: The Origin of Mingtai_1
chapters.content:
"In the first match of the Golden Core Stage Initial Phase, the winner is the independent cultivator, Zhuang Xuan."
The emaciated referee declared the end of the first match, and the victor was a cultivator with no particular reputation.
Whether from a large or small sect, cultivators are provided with cultivation resources by their sects.
Independent cultivators are different, lacking in cultivation resources of all kinds, and without guidance from elders in their cultivation. Careless attention could easily lead to cultivation missteps that are hard to correct, causing their realm and cultivation quality to be significantly lower than that of sect cultivators.
To be able to defeat a group of sect cultivators, stand out amongst city-level and state-level competitors, and come to the Seek Dao Sect, one can only imagine the difficulty.
"Mark him down, he's highly suspicious." Jiang Qun instructed the Luoshui Guards.
He reviewed Zhuang Xuan's records of previous battles, and it could be said that Zhuang Xuan crushed his way to the finals, with each match ending within five moves. Even in the finals, the first match only required five moves to defeat his opponent.
He was terrifyingly powerful.
"Yes." The Luoshui Guard had already written down a long list of names.
"I will definitely win next time!" The losing side was a very energetic cultivator. Although he had lost to Zhuang Xuan, he was not discouraged and instead vowed to fight again.
Zhuang Xuan looked indifferently at his opponent and uttered two words softly.
"Boring."
"You!"
The loser's expression changed slightly, Zhuang Xuan was too arrogant.
Zhuang Xuan paid no heed to the reaction of the loser, jumped off the battle platform with his eyelids drooping, yawning out of sheer boredom.
If it were not for the generous rewards of the competition, he wouldn't bother to come and play in this childish battle with them.
There was no fun in winning, there was no challenge at all.
Soon, Zhuang Xuan faced his second match. His opponent was a polite sword cultivator. Judging by his manners, he seemed to be a Confucian cultivator who practiced the Gentleman Sword.
"My name is Mingtai from the Sword Tower, please advise me." Holding a sword with both hands, Mingtai bowed respectfully, with a bashful smile on his face.
Zhuang Xuan as usual looking like he just woke up.
He had no good feelings towards these polite cultivators, utterly lacking courage. They were all well and good in ordinary fights, but once on the battlefield, in a life and death battle, these were the first to die.
He had fought several times with Confucian cultivators at the Unification Stage, such cultivators should be debating in court, it was absolutely unnecessary for them to charge into battle.
Swish——
A flash of green Sword Qi shot past, Zhuang Xuan instinctively tilted his head back. The green Sword Qi grazed his neck, the cool wind blew past, and a faint Sword Qi mark appeared on the back of his neck, which soon turned bloody red.
"How did he manage to get his swordsmanship to such a level at this stage?" The competing cultivators gasped in astonishment. Some people who hadn't seen Mingtai's performance in the first match now realized that he was a formidable foe upon witnessing his move.
"If he has such a level of swordsmanship in the early Golden Core Stage, he could compete with Old Buyu." An old veteran of the cultivation world exclaimed, it had been a long time since a swordsmanship genius capable of competing with Old Buyu appeared in the Central Continent.
"This Zhuang Xuan is not a simple character either. He has never used his full strength from the beginning." Another old veteran of the cultivation world nodded, it was indeed the competition of the Great Era, the previous matches had already been eye-opening, and now at the initial phase of Golden Core Stage, all kinds of geniuses were showing their unique skills.
"It will be a fierce dragon and tiger fight." A tall cultivator slowly spoke, his eyes cold as ice.
He had lost to Mingtai in the first match and had studied Zhuang Xuan's fighting style. If these two were to meet, sparks were sure to fly.
"What a pity for my 'Turtle Breath Technique', nowhere to use it!"
On the stage, a jade pendant fell from Zhuang Xuan's neck.
The green Sword Qi from just now, not only left a faint blood mark on Zhuang Xuan's neck but also cut the string of the jade pendant.
Zhuang Xuan bent down and picked up the jade pendant with respect. His voice was low and hoarse, not the dispirited tone he had used before.
"Zhuang Xuan Daoist, are you finally serious?" Mingtai looked at Zhuang Xuan earnestly, eager for the challenge.
Zhuang Xuan didn't answer, he spoke to himself and also seemed to be speaking to Mingtai.
"This jade pendant is of great significance to me. It was given to me by my master before he passed away. My master told me that I was an orphan and when he found me, I was holding this jade pendant in my hand. The pendant is the only clue left by my parents. I have always kept it close to my body and never let it fall onto the ground."
"You are the first one to make it fall."
"Do you know, the dragon, it has a reverse scale, touch it... and you die!"
Zhuang Xuan let out a roar like a wild beast, sending chills down people's spines. Suddenly, he raised his head and stared deadly at Mingtai, his eyes like that of an insane demon beast.
"His momentum..."
The Sect Leader of Control Qi Sect was slightly surprised. At this point, Zhuang Xuan's aura was almost comparable to that of a cultivator at the initial Nascent Soul Stage.
Lest we forget, Zhuang Xuan is only at the initial phase of the Golden Core Stage.
Raging, Zhuang Xuan dashed towards Mingtai. His body emitted a terrifying black aura that made anyone tremble, it was unclear what cultivation method it was, but the only certainty was— no one wanted to be his opponent!
Bam——
Zhuang Xuan was swept away by a sword's aura and fell off the platform.
"Phew, that was close, close call." Mingtai seemed relieved and patted his chest.
After calming down, he walked to the edge of the platform, looked down at Zhuang Xuan who was still in a daze, and bowed with his sword.
"High momentum does not imply high cultivation level, Mingtai has learned his lesson."
Zhuang Xuan blinked and couldn't comprehend what had just occurred. Shouldn't he be the one rampaging and ripping Mingtai apart? How did he end up as the losing side?
...
"Where did you guys recruit that disciple from?" Lu Baqian was surprised as he looked at Elder Sikong.
Others might not see it, but he, a powerful Transcendance Tribulation Stage Cultivator, could clearly see it. This move contained the complexity of the universe and the endless changes, decidedly not something a Golden Core Stage could execute.
Even if it were a Nascent Soul Stage Swordsman, they would have to be called a genius to execute this move!
Seeing Lu Baqian, who had been victorious the whole way, showing this expression, Elder Sikong felt more refreshed than having an ice cube in summer.
"Hehe, I told you, Mingtai is the only one in our Sword Tower who has inherited the Supreme Inheritance."
...
"This move is quite something, it's about the same level as when I use my 'Sword Character Jue'." Inside the Spiritual Space, the imprisoned Lu Yang watched the battle on the platform through the small window left by Fairy Eternity.
Mingtai's move was indeed unexpected.
If it weren't for Mingtai, he would have almost forgotten that he was a sword cultivator.
"This little guy doesn't seem human." Fairy Eternity glanced at Mingtai and lost interest quickly.
She was not interested, but Lu Yang was, and he hastily asked what was going on.
"He seems to be a Sword Spirit who has gained true intelligence, became a living being, someone then created a body for him, invited him in, united spirit and flesh into one, making him a real human."
Lu Yang contemplated. He had the details of all the participating geniuses on hand. The information stated that Mingtai had been acknowledged by the Supreme of the Sword Tower and had inherited his mantle.
"Could it be that he is the Sword Spirit of the Sword Tower Supreme?"
This realization made sense of all things.

chapters.title: Chapter 492 - 491: How to Use the Regeneration Golden Core_1
chapters.content:
"A Sword Spirit can become a soul?"
"Ordinary Sword Spirits definitely cannot, but the Supreme Sword Tower is different. He is a Semi-Immortal, his Sword Spirit must have fought countless battles, immersed in the blood of Immortal Dao, possessing the aura of Immortal Dao."
"For example, take a look at that Kirin Immortality Medicine in the medicine garden. Wasn't it soaked in the blood of a Kirin Immortal and thus gained spiritual intelligence?"
With the rising power of the man and the ghost, they climbed to the position of the Acting Sect Master and learned some secrets.
Like the Supreme Sword Tower.
The word 'Supreme' can only be used to address those who possess Semi-Immortal level strength, Immortal Eternity can be addressed as Immortal Supreme.
No one knows the nature of the Dao Fruit form that the Supreme Sword Tower possesses. All we know is that he attempted to complete his Dao Fruit form with that opportunity, but he failed to become an Immortal and ended in complete destruction.
No one was suitable to inherit the mantle he left behind, and the Sword Tower suffered repeated defeats, falling to its present status as a First Class Sect.
If Mingtai is the Sword Spirit of the Supreme Sword Tower, it would make sense for him to inherit the Supreme Sword Tower's mantle and tradition."
"You should know, the higher a cultivator's cultivation level, the harder it is to produce offspring. It is even more difficult for Semi-Immortals to have descendants."
Lu Yang nodded, he knew about this. Most of Emperor Xia's princes and princesses were born when he was young, not because Emperor Xia is now old and weak and unable to bear children, but because his cultivation level is too high, making it difficult for him to have offspring.
Of course, it could also be that he genuinely cannot bear children anymore.
"Some Semi-Immortal Dao couples drip blood, mixing their Immortal blood together. If they're lucky, something similar to a Sword Spirit will be born in their blood. Over time, it will develop spiritual intelligence and will become their child."
"So the higher the cultivator's cultivation level, the more they need to be careful in a battle, they must not let their blood be seen."
"Why?"
"Imagine, two Semi-Immortals fighting, giving their all, spilling blood and guts, but still not being able to determine the victor, and deciding to continue the fight the next day."
"The next day they find that their blood has become sentient, they have a child, what should they do then?"
Lu Yang: "..."
That explained a lot.
"In the ancient times, Semi-Immortals were very careful when they fought. If they could avoid bleeding, they would. Even if they did bleed, they made sure to clean up the blood after the battle, to avoid any trouble later, and to avoid blame."
"Moreover, there is a dispute about this method of producing offspring. For example, the Kirin Immortal family steadfastly refused to use this method."
...
On the stage, both sides stood tall, prepared for battle.
"Seek Dao Sect, Li Haoran."
"Corpse Chasing Sect, Zhao Po."
Both sides exchanged courtesies, following the established etiquette.
"Brother Li, I await your move." Zhao Po looked serious, his opponent was a senior brother of Seek Dao Sect, he dared not be careless.
He had seen the strength of Lu Yang.
And also the Corpse Controller Wei Nanfei,
But he's not the same as he used to be, having been instructed by the Sect Leader, his power has soared, and the Living Corpse has undergone a transformation as well.
"Junior Brother Zhao, your move."
Zhao Po was not polite, he and the Living Corpse attacked together.
The Living Corpse was like steel, fearless of pain, it charged fiercely at Li Haoran, resembling a moving mountain. Li Haoran clapped his hands and managed to repel the Living Corpse but his arms were numb from the impact.
Before Li Haoran could even recover from the pain, he saw Zhao Po wielding a coin sword, with large brilliant coins, burning with a soaring golden aura, like sword qi, and like flames, exhibiting a terrifying attack power.
"Strike!"
The golden aura condensed into sword qi, piercing the air, resounding through the heavens, as brilliant as stardust.
Li Haoran faced the coin sword without fear and slapped it with his palm.
At the moment of contact between his palm and the golden sword qi, a strange change occured.
It seemed as if there was a thin membrane between his palm and the golden sword qi, made up of countless irregular fragments. Despite being thin, it was hard to break through, blocking the attack of the golden sword qi.
"Refining space?" Luo Hongxia recognised the Refining method Li Haoran used.
A skilled refiner can refine space for their own use, becoming a part of their weapon, but this is definitely not a skill that a Golden Core initial stage practitioner can master!
Fifth Elder looked at Li Haoran with a satisfied smile.
Recently, Li Haoran didn't advance in his cultivation; instead, he devoted his time to comprehend the technique of refining.
Zhao Po was inexperienced and hadn't seen such a refining technique before. Panicked, he was thrown off balance. Li Haoran wouldn't give Zhao Po any chance to respond.
He broke through the thin layer of space, gently flicked the coin sword with his two fingers, which contained an unseen rhythm.
Each flick weakened the power of the coin sword. After three flicks, the sword qi of the coin sword dimmed and lost its light.
Zhao Po's pupils shrank. He was unable to wield the coin sword any longer.
"Junior Brother Zhao, this coin sword is newly acquired, isn't it? You haven't fully refined it yet. Remember to use your own weapon in your next battle." Li Haoran said leisurely, temporarily severing the connection between Zhao Po and the coin sword.
This was also a handy technique for a refiner.
Zhao Po gritted his teeth. At this point, he had to follow through regardless of the risks.
He bit his wrist and poured the blood over the living corpse. The pores of the living corpse widened and absorbed the blood.
Under its pale skin, blood flowed, and it seemed almost alive.
"Attack together!"
The living corpse charged like an elephant, while Zhao Po soared like an eagle.
Generally, when two inexperienced people teamed up against one, it was difficult to perfectly coordinate their moves.
But it was different for Zhao Po and the living corpse. The pairing was seamless because they were incredibly intimate with each other.
The living corpse fought like a martial dao master. Its punches and kicks were fierce and overpowering, akin to an ax chopping or a knife slashing. Every attack carried deadly danger, like successive thunder claps echoing out in the ring.
Zhao Po, however, wielded his Peach Wood Sword and talisman in mid-air, aiming at Li Haoran's defensive loopholes and attacking them.
Li Haoran barely held on against their relentless onslaught, and was eventually placed at a disadvantage.
Boom!
Zhao Po and the living corpse hit Li Haoran's chest simultaneously, flying him backwards off the arena.
Gasping for breath, Zhao Po realized that their method of attack was exhausting for both him and the living corpse. They had to quickly resolve the fight.
"Clap, clap, clap——"
Lone clapping sounded from the audience. Whether it was Zhao Po or the spectators, they all followed the sound with puzzled looks.
The person clapping looked exactly like Li Haoran on the stage.
It was Li Haoran!
How could this be? Wasn't Li Haoran on the stage?
Only the sect leaders and elders of the major factions revealed knowing smiles as if they had already seen through the charade.
"Junior Brother Zhao, your performance is commendable. However, a clone alone can't defeat you."
"Clone?" Zhao Po raised his eyebrow, still not completely understanding how Li Haoran managed to pull it off.
Was it a wooden avatar like Lu Yang's?
Li Haoran calmly explained: "My Golden Core is named 'Regeneration Golden Core.' As the name suggests, it can regenerate lost limbs, heads, and legs."
"If I am cut into pieces, couldn't I piece together a complete body?"
Zhao Po's pupils constricted. 'Is such a thing really possible?'
"I also asked Senior Brother Man to teach me Corpse Chasing techniques. I used the Corpse Chasing technique to control my own dead body. Though its strength is not comparable to my own, it still possesses seventy to eighty percent of my power."
Li Haoran's mouth parted into a small, warm smile: "Since my clone can't beat you, what if I attack you together with my clone?"
Zhao Po's heart sank. Dealing with the clone was already challenging enough. How could he cope if Li Brother also joined the fight?
The other cultivators in the early Golden Core stage also felt uneasy. Li Haoran's combat power had been witnessed by everyone, and it was extremely tricky. This clone alone was a handful, teamed up with the main body was indeed daunting.
The lean judge glanced at Li Haoran below the ring and announced the result of the match.
"According to the rules, once the match begins, the participant who is off the stage is considered the loser."
"Zhao Po wins."
Li Haoran's smile froze on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 493 - 492: Appearance of Heaven's Court_1
chapters.content:
As a sword spirit that attained sentience, Mingtai's swordsmanship talent is enough to rival Lu Yang. In the initial stage golden core group competition, he was invincible. Only the genius cultivators from the Immortal Sect who were suspected of starting over after disbanding their cultivation put him in hard fights.
However, even these geniuses were defeated by his exquisite swordsmanship. Despite his relatively low cultivation level, he gradually developed the ability to overcome all kinds of techniques with a single sword strike!
Mingtai was the winner in the initial stage golden core group.
Mingtai stood on the battle stage, his hands were level with his chest, shyly waving his little hands at Elder Sikong.
In the sunlight, Mingtai's figure sparkled brilliantly, like it was made of gold.
"Seeing Mingtai is like seeing a shadow of Lu Yang." Meng Jingzhou sighed, his eyes glistening with unshed tears, reliving the past times, feeling deeply sentimental. It's evident that he had a profound friendship with Lu Yang.
"It's such a shame, Lu Yang was such a good man, why did he have to..."
The words stuck in Meng Jingzhou's throat, and he wept.
Bai Ming: "..."
He kindly asked, "Shall I go on stage for you while you cry?"
The mid-stage golden core competition had already begun, and Meng Jingzhou was the first to compete.
Meng Jingzhou wiped his tears, his expression firm, "No need, Lu Yang can't compete, I have to inherit Lu Yang's will and move forward bravely. I believe that's what he would want too if he were here."
With those words, Meng Jingzhou stepped onto the stage, each step heavy, as if he was carrying a great mission.
From the spectators' stand, Lu Yang contemplated if he could abuse his power to rule that this grandson Meng lost the match.
"Seek Dao Sect, Meng Jingzhou."
"Seduction Sect, Ye Mengyin."
Meng Jingzhou's opponent was a true disciple of the Seduction Sect, one of the superior sects, Ye Mengyin.
Ye Mengyin was in a clean, elegant long dress, her skin crystal clear as snow, her demeanour celestial. In the outside world, she was a fairy pursued by countless people.
Her charm ability was outstanding among her peers, a single frown or smile could elicit the deepest desire in any man. Even a woman, if not firmly grounded, could be charmed by her.
Ye Mengyin's voice was enchanting, her self-introduction seemed capable of melting hearts.
"Kind senior brother, please be gentle. Your servant girl can't withstand such power."
Ye Mengyin looked pitifully at Meng Jingzhou, subtly working her charm. In past city and state level competitions, just uttering these words would throw her opponents into confusion, causing them to surrender voluntarily.
"Why don't you forfeit? I don't discriminate between men and women when I fight." Meng Jingzhou looked at Ye Mengyin with a big smile, implying that he wouldn't show mercy whether it's men, women, or Lu Yang.
Meng Jingzhou's eyes were clear, showing no sign of fascination.
Ye Mengyin was taken aback; she had never met a cultivator of the same realm who was completely unaffected by her charm ability.
Even the geniuses had to devote some energy to resist her charm, unlike Meng Jingzhou who was completely unaffected.
As expected of someone from the Seek Dao Sect, he did have some ability.
Before the final match officially started, she had also wandered around the shopping street, partaking in leisure activities. She had heard Meng Jingzhou's self-promotion claiming "cultivators should remain single; women are all beautifuly disguised skeletons".
She didn't care about this, confident that Meng Jingzhou had yet to meet her.
Cultivators from the Seduction Sect had experiences of bewitching monks to renounce asceticism.
Ye Mengyin took an old zither from her storage ring and gently stroked the strings. The zither music flowed smoothly, like a gentle breeze, making the cultivators below the stage feel intoxicated.
She was a rare sound cultivator.
The harmonious combination of zither music and charm ability, along with the first-grade Desire Burning Golden Pill she condensed, made her invincible among cultivators of the same realm!
Except for Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, Tao Yaoye, Man Gu, Lan Ting, Bai Ming, Yan Tianzhi...
"Shocking Heaven Six Forms!" Meng Jingzhou roared, his voice drowning out the zither music. He took big steps forward, his fist glowing golden, rubbing against the air and sparking flames.
Two single golden elixirs were spinning, causing her charm ability to stop working.
The only threat to him was the zither music, which slowed his steps and hampered his movement. As a body cultivator, he was physically strong. Even Lu Yang wouldn't dare mess with him head-on.
This level of control was like a drizzle to him and had a negligible effect.
Ye Mengyin never thought that her proud technique would fail on Meng Jingzhou. Before she could react, she saw a fist as large as a sandbag smashing into her face. She fell to the ground with a thud, and even hearing the sound of the impact was painful.
Meng Jingzhou won.
"Little sister, are you okay?" In kindness, Meng Jingzhou pulled up Ye Mengyin. They were opponents during the match and had to hit hard, but after the match, they were cultivators helping each other.
Ye Mengyin looked at Meng Jingzhou with affection. This was the first time she had met such a powerful male cultivator. The male cultivators she had met in the past all bowed down to her, afraid to let her see something else.
Only Meng Jingzhou had no reaction to her.
"When I embarked on my path, I swore by the name of my sect that I would marry the person who defeated me."
This is terrible…" Meng Jingzhou laughed awkwardly. The luck in love affairs came so suddenly.
Ye Mengyin gently shook her head: "There's nothing terrible about it. There are rules in our sect that the disciples do not marry disciples from the Seek Dao Sect or members of the Meng family."
"Master said that marrying these two families could easily cause trouble for the sect."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
What does my Meng family have to do with you? Don't go to the Imperial City to find out. My Meng family has a universally acclaimed reputation. Although it's not very good, it's not as bad as the Seek Dao Sect to be lined up with us!
Forget it, don't think too much, as long as you can win.
With his lucky start, he cheerfully stepped off the battle stage and boasted to Bai Ming and the others.
"Did you see my fight just now? One punch and she was down."
"Impressive, impressive. I always tread lightly when fighting female cultivators, afraid that if I hit the wrong spot, I'd be mistaken for a scoundrel. It seems I need to learn from Senior Brother Meng." Bai Ming applauded. He learned a lot from Meng Jingzhou.
In the past, he cared too much about face, which was really unnecessary.
"Well done." Yan Tianzhi was concise and to the point.
Competitions were held one after another, both Bai Ming and Lan Ting successfully advanced. Their strength was clearly a cut above cultivators of the same level.
"It seems that the final winner of this group will be among the four of us." Meng Jingzhou said.
"We can't jump to conclusions so easily." Bai Ming shook his head, pointing to the cultivator standing on the stage at this moment.
"You saw the competitions in the previous realms as well, there are cultivators who can rival us from the Immortal Sect. The mid-stage golden core group is no different."
"See the cultivator on the stage? He's from our Yunzhou. He was very prominent in the Yunzhou competition, showing extraordinary combat talent. He's quick to adapt, has a solid foundation with no weak points. Even the hardest to cultivate, the spiritual power, isn't falling behind.
His golden core should be a devouring golden core among the first-grade golden cores, able to devour the opponent's spiritual essence during the fight."
As the few of them were whispering, a bright laughter rang out from above.
Under countless gazes, a young man dropped from the sky and landed on the battle stage, interrupting the match.
"How can this bustling scene be without our Heaven's Court?"
A few figures were still standing on the clouds, emitting intimidating auras.

chapters.title: Chapter 494 - 493 Young Master Lu_1
chapters.content:
"Heaven's Court?"
All the guests were startled upon hearing the young man's affiliation.
If the most talked about topic amongst low-level cultivators over the past two months was who could distinguish themselves in the competition, then the most discussed matter among high-level cultivators was the appearance of Dou Tianzun, who claimed to be the supreme being of Heaven's Court, during a battle in Hanshui City.
This was the first immortal being to openly appear, other than the Four Immortals of the Ancients.
Whether it's Great Qian or Great Yu, they're both figures that are possibly immortals in legends. Same goes for Great Xia, with rumors that immortals reside within the forbidden area of the palace. Yet no one has ever seen one.
The appearance of Dou Tianzun caused a great stir in the outside world. Everyone, from those at the Unification Stage to those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, were all discussing who Dou Tianzun is, and what Heaven's Court is.
There were various speculations about Dou Tianzun and Heaven's Court, but none have reached the consensus.
Some say Heaven's Court is an ancient organization that has just awakened. Others propose that Heaven's Court has been present since ancient times, always lurking behind history, manipulating the rise and fall of dynasties, and acting as the unseen hand behind everything.
What's unexpected is that Heaven's Court, uninvited, has openly made an appearance today at the grand competition held by the royal court and the 120,000-year celebration of the Seek Dao Sect. How bold of them!
Those with nimble minds could smell a strong scent of gunpowder from this act.
Heaven's Court is boding something ill.
"Who are you?" Fairy Eternity, serving as Acting Sect Master, controlled Lu Yang's body and asked sternly.
There was a hint of decisive killing intent hidden in her tone.
The youth from Heaven's Court stood unwavering on the stage, surrounded by a crowd of strong figures. Without showing any fear, he responded loudly with a clenched fist.
"Presumably, this is the well-known Sect Master Lu. Sect Master Lu's fame was earned at a young age, with a firm foundation. If you participate in the competition, you might easily secure the first place. What a coincidence, I share the same surname. I am the Young Master of our sect."
Fairy Eternity narrowed her eyes, ignoring his flattery. She spoke in a frosty voice, "So it's Young Master Lu. I wonder why you came to our Seek Dao Sect and disrupted the competition. What do you aim for with these people above us?"
Hovering above the stage were dark clouds, standing within them were five stern figures, with somber expressions, almost like deities.
"I am Heaven's Court protector, the Dark Ghost Heavenly King."
The Dark Ghost Heavenly King exuded an ominous black mist, as though he had just awoken from an ancient tomb, carrying the resentment of the dead and bringing endless disaster to the world.
"I am Heaven's Court protector, the Hundred Medicine Heavenly King."
The fragrance of medicine exuded from the Hundred Medicine Heavenly King. The aroma's origin was significant. Without frequent exposure to the Little Medicinal Kings, such a scent could not be cultivated.
"I am Heaven's Court protector, the Invincible Heavenly King."
The Invincible Heavenly King was like an Arhat of golden body in the Buddhist tales, or perhaps, he was the original form of the golden body Arhat! The Invincible Heavenly King's physique was vigorous and strong, with no traces of Barrier Door found anywhere on his body, representing the limit of the Body Cultivators.
"I am Heaven's Court protector, the Multi-treasure Heavenly King."
The Multi-treasure Heavenly King wore a string of magic artifacts around his waist. The most eye-catching of them all was a top-tier magic artifact, which could even make Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivators envious. This artifact had already developed its own spirit, obtained through the refinement of a Transcendance Tribulation stage soul. It was truly terrifying!
"I am Heaven's Court protector, the Golden Flame Heavenly King."
Golden flames occasionally twirled around the Golden Flame Heavenly King's body. These flames were not any of the 108 True Fires, but rather a combination of all 108, bringing the True Fire to a whole new realm!
The five figures seemed like towering mountains, unreachable. Their auras were ancient, as if they hailed from primeval times.
Just ancient auras. Anyone could tell these five Heavenly Kings were in their prime and far from senility; even their current state might not be their peak.
"How come our ancestors didn't make a move to rob these five people who haven't passed the tribulation yet?" the Sect Leader of the Control Qi Sect murmured. He was especially sensitive to auras, and he noted these individuals weren't at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
The One Qi Venerable shot the Sect Leader a glare, frightening him into silence for saying the wrong thing.
Only then did the One Qi Venerable explain through telepathic communication, "And you think you're smart? Are you more knowledgeable than all the other cultivators at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage present here?"
"Could the venerable ancestor please enlighten me?"
"Do you realize that to enter the Seek Dao Sect, one must pass through the River Spirit, whose powers are comparable to that of those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage? Anyone who can slip past the River Spirit into the Seek Dao Sect can't possibly be at the Unification Stage!"
"Do you think the ones who have revealed themselves are all the members of Heaven's Court present here?"
"From what I see, there's at least one Semi-Immortal from Heaven's Court lurking in the shadows."
"Particularly since the Seek Dao Sect has said they have methods to deal with a Semi-Immortal, but haven't made a move this time. This may be the worst-case scenario. Perhaps Dou Tianzun is also here, possibly right under our noses, and no one has noticed!"
The Sect Leader of the Control Qi Sect shivered, his spine going cold as he listened.
"Excuse us." The Dark Ghost Heavenly King spoke in a deep voice, seemingly the leader of the five Heavenly Kings.
The five Heavenly Kings descended from the sky, causing the surrounding people to swiftly make a clearance. They dared not approach them.
The intimidating auras emanating from them made some of the geniuses find it hard to stead their stance.
Young Master Lu appeared oblivious to the hostility shown by Fairy Eternity. With a smile on his face, he responded, "Having slept since ancient times, I haven't found a match since I awakened. Recently, I heard that your esteemed sect is hosting a competition, and decided to join the fun. So, I am here uninvited, and I hope Sect Master Lu doesn't mind."
Slept since ancient times?
Upon hearing Young Master Lu's introduction, the guests were shocked once again.
This Heaven's Court indeed originates from ancient times.
Young Master Lu glanced at the two geniuses on the stage. He then said, "These two are at the mid-stage of the Golden Core. Coincidentally, I am also at the same stage. With these two as my opponents, if I lose, we, the Heaven's Court, will leave. If I win, it proves my strength, and I will continue in the competition. What do you think?"
"Battling two with one, Young Master Lu, that's quite a boast of yours." Fairy Eternity scoffed.
"If we refuse to let you challenge, it will make us, Great Xia, seem petty. Fine then, if you win this match, you shall have the qualification to participate. If you lose, leave the Seek Dao Sect immediately!"
At the end of her words, Fairy Eternity's tone was heavy and hinted at a killing intent.
The geniuses under the stage muttered 'well said' in their hearts, wishing they could applaud on the spot. Young Master Lu's imposing demeanor hadn't put them, the geniuses, in his eyes. Facing the powerful Heaven's Court, Sect Master Lu didn't display even a hint of fear. Instead, she threatened the Heaven's Court.
Just based on this courage and insight, she surpassed all of them!
"Very well said, Sect Master Lu. I, Qiu Jin'an, support Sect Master Lu's viewpoint. Since ancient times, the winner rules and the loser suffers. If you lose, retreat from whence you came!"
The leaders of the Five Great Immortal Sects and the crown prince stood up to support Fairy Eternity.
Everyone glowed with excitement as they looked at the six major forces of the Righteous Path, including the Five Great Immortal Sects and the royal court, joining hands to face the enemy.
Only Meng Jingzhou, from start to finish, was staring at the so-called Young Master Lu with dead fish eyes.
The crown prince was feeling somewhat uneasy. It was his first time doing such a thing. He wondered if he had revealed any flaws. Why did the people of the Five Great Immortal Sects seem so skilled with this?

chapters.title: Chapter 495 - 494 Create History if There's None_1
chapters.content:
"This Young Master Lu is indeed a formidable adversary." Bai Ming and others wore serious expressions, directing their vigilant gaze at the high-profile Young Master Lu on the challenge stage.
"He's tough to handle." Yan Tianzhi also felt the pressure emanating from Young Master Lu, which came not only from him personally but also from the presence of Heaven's Court.
The attitudes of the Five Great Immortal Sects and the court sufficed to illustrate the tremendous power of Heaven's Court.
With a puzzled expression in her eyes, Lan Ting had a sense that the style of this Young Master Lu was very similar to someone she knew.
Lu Yang's opponents were two people, one was Mo Wenli, the true disciple of the Thunder Fire Sect, a first-class sect, and the other was Su Mo, who was hailed as a unique genius among loose cultivators. Sweating profusely, they watched Lu Yang's relaxed and comfortable demeanor.
"Don't hold back, let's attack together!" Su Mo commanded in a deep voice, directing Mo Wenli. For someone as proud as him, joining forces was a humiliation. But the opponent was Young Master Lu of Heaven's Court. If they wanted to win this round, they had to swallow their pride.
Mo Wenli frowned. What right did someone who was praised by loose cultivators as a genius have to command him?
"Follow my lead if you want to win!" Su Mo frowned, feeling the audacity of this successor, acting arrogantly without any provocation.
A shiver ran down Mo Wenli's spine. He was scared by Su Mo.
He saw the reflection of his master in Su Mo.
"You better have a strategy." Mo Wenli reluctantly accepted Su Mo's command.
Su Mo saw that Mo Wenli was aware of when to advance and when to retreat, so his face lightened slightly, and he sent a transmission: "The Art of War is clear, hesitate and the situation changes, swift battles yield swift victories."
"Your mastery over lightning techniques should have already reached an advanced level. If swordsmanship is considered the prime form of attack, then lightning techniques are considered the second best. I will use the power of my Golden Core to distract the opponent first, and you should gather power in the back. The moment you're ready, attack with all your strength!"
"Fine, but are you sure your Golden Core can distract the opponent?"
Su Mo didn't reply. The Devouring Golden Core he had painstakingly nourished after starting over after disbanding his cultivation could devour the spiritual essence of his opponents, causing anyone to panic for a moment.
In a Golden Core Stage battle, a moment of panic could decide the outcome.
Su Mo's calves sprang straight up, like an arrow, and he swooshed directly in front of Young Master Lu. Even judging by the speed he demonstrated, he was already faster than Mo Wenli!
At the very start of their confrontation, Su Mo felt the difficulty of dealing with Young Master Lu. The opponent had rich combat experience and exceptional adaptability. It was unrealistic to think about gaining the upper hand by relying on his own experience.
How could the opponent have such abundant combat experience? It didn't seem like it could be nurtured by fighting against those of the same realm level. It was more like it had been honed by battling against those of a higher realm, and more than one person at that.
Right, the opponent is Young Master Lu of Heaven's Court, surely benefiting from the training of experts, hence accumulating such formidable combat experience.
Even so, his target was to distract his opponent. As long as he could do that, it was enough!
"Devour!"
In his heart, Su Mo quietly commanded, summoning his Golden Core. The Devouring Golden Core spun wildly. Every time it made contact with Lu Yang's body, it could seize the spiritual essence within him.
This technique was invariably effective.
Unexpectedly, just as he began to utilize his Golden Core, he saw Young Master Lu slightly open his mouth, and he didn't know what he planned to do.
Su Mo soon discovered the answer - while he was devouring Lu Yang's spiritual essence, Lu Yang was also devouring his own spiritual essence. They had both reached a delicate equilibrium!
How was this possible?
Could it be that Lu Yang was also using his Devouring Golden Core?!
Su Mo gritted his teeth. Given the circumstances, he could no longer worry about that. He could sense an immense energy accumulating behind him - Mo Wenli's lightning technique was ready!
"Move aside!"
Mo Wenli gritted his teeth. The force of the lightning was so great that he was already struggling just to handle it, his arm trembling.
Su Mo hurriedly evaded, and a blast of formidable lightning force exploded behind him, its spectacle a dazzling display of light and the wild dance of electric snakes, its energy rippling.
Boom!
The lightning serpent swallowed Lu Yang whole.
Before Su Mo and Mo Wenli could even celebrate, they heard a whistling sound. A blade glimmered, slicing the lightning ball in half.
The lightning ball exploded, and a figure walked out of the explosion with a sword, appearing relaxed and satisfied.
"Impressive power, but it's a pity your strength is too scattered. If you could focus it on a single point, even I would have to struggle a bit." Young Master Lu casually commented on Su Mo's lightning technique.
This Young Master Lu is the paramount sword cultivator renowned for his attacks!
In the moment that Mo Wenli was stunned, Su Mo was the first to react. He moved abruptly. There was no room for hesitation on the battlefield!
Just as he was about to warn Mo Wenli, he saw another streak of sword light pass by. Mo Wenli had already been knocked off the stage.
"Let's get rid of one first."
The tip of the sword scraped across the challenge stage, which was full of tiny pebbles, creating an irregular sound that made Su Mo's hair stand on end.
Soon, Su Mo was filled with rage. He, as a great cultivator who started anew after disbanding his cultivation, had two thousand years of cultivation experience. He was about to reach even greater heights. How could he become anyone's prey?
He wanted to make his opponent realize how terrifying a great cultivator who started anew after disbanding his cultivation could be when he got serious!
...
"The winner, Heaven's Court."
The referee announced the result of the match.
On the stage, Young Master Lu sheathed his sword, his posture upright and elegant. He looked up at the judge's bench: "So, am I qualified to continue the competition?"
"As the sect leader, I will honor my word. You may continue competing."
"But sect leader, I have a question."
"Please ask, Sect Leader Lu."
"Just now, when Su Mo used his Devouring Golden Core to devour your spiritual essence, you were also devouring his spiritual essence. Could it be that you were executing the most ancient and initial technique from Taotie's toolbox of Divine Abilities—Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth?"
Young Master Lu looked at Sect Leader Lu in surprise, not expecting to be recognized by him.
"Sect Leader Lu has a sharp eye."
"How is the oldest Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth different from the current one?" Qiu Jin'an asked at the right moment.
Young Master Lu didn't answer; he was waiting for Sect Leader Lu's response.
Sect Leader Lu spoke in a voice that echoed throughout the arena: "You should all know that I've also cultivated Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth. During the learning process, I uncovered a secret about the Taotie clan."
"In ancient times, the Taotie clan was extremely ferocious. It is instinct for demon beasts to feed on live beings, but not for the Taotie clan. They did not resort to devouring live beings. Instead, they devoured the spiritual essence in the world, consumed the earth and stars as their sustenance, hence known as the Beast of Heaven, the Beast of Earth!"
"How did they manage to devour spiritual essence and the earth? It was accomplished by the most ancient Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth!"
"The initial form of Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth was too ferocious. It led to various races joining forces to combat them. Under this pressure, the Taotie clan was forced to transform Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth into its current form. Although claiming to devour everything, its power was greatly reduced!"
Sect Leader Lu continued, "Even nowadays, there are few in the Taotie clan who would use the most ancient Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth. Unexpectedly, Young Master Lu could use this technique. It seems the legends are not false after all, Heaven's Court truly is the first major power of ancient times."
Upon hearing this, everyone in the audience couldn't help but gasp in shock at this secret about the Taotie clan.
...
Inside the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity was excitedly wiggling her small toes, which shimmered like pearls.
"How was it, how was it? Didn't I perform well?"
"Well done, that's the feeling!"

chapters.title: Chapter 496 - 495 The Power of Bond!_1
chapters.content:
Just as Su Mo and Mo Wenli stepped down from the ring, they saw a figure rushing towards them, looking panic-stricken.
The figure was none other than the Sect Leader of the Thunder Fire Sect, who came up to Su Mo with concern, saying, "Master, are you alright?"
"Master?"
Mo Wenli was confused, not having fully understood what had just happened.
"This is your Grandmaster, and my master," the Thunder Fire Sect Leader explained to Mo Wenli in a whisper.
"Grandmaster? Didn't you say that the Grandmaster was dead?" Mo Wenli was startled. His attitude towards Su Mo just now had not been especially friendly.
"That was just a story for the outside world. In reality, your Grandmaster gave up his previous cultivation to focus on passing the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. He had several enemies in the past and feared retaliation after disbanding his cultivation, so he made it known that he was dead."
"If I had known I would be fighting with my own Grandmaster, you should have told me..." Mo Wenli looked at the Sect Leader of the Thunder Fire Sect with some resentment. If Heaven's Court hadn't intervened they would have ended up fighting each other.
The Thunder Fire Sect Leader scolded him, "Didn't it happen because you could not keep your affairs to yourself? Fear of exposure on the ring! What Young Master Lu said wasn't wrong. Look at what you've learned of the Thunder Technique, it's as scattered as split urine. Go into seclusion: if you can't improve, don't come out!"
Mo Wenli's face turned pale as death.
"Alright, now, don't scare the younger generation. Little Mo is still quite powerful. It's just that his opponent this time was stronger. I will guide you after we go back." Su Mo stood forward to mediate the situation. He was quite pleased with Mo Wenli, finding him a promising talent.
The Thunder Fire Sect Leader looked on silently.
"You didn't treat me like this in the beginning."
...
Below the stage, the five celestial kings were radiating an unwelcoming aura that kept others at bay. But this could not suppress their curiosity.
"Those five Heavenly Kings are terrifying. Just getting close sends shivers down my spine."
"You said it! These are ancient powers. The ancient times were chaotic, and life was cheap. Who knows how many lives these kings have on their hands?"
"Quiet, don't let them hear you!"
"We're whispering, they can't hear us, can they?"
"Better safe than sorry. Who can guarantee there isn't a secret method from ancient times for intercepting whispers? Just look at these five! Their murderous auras are so thick they're almost tangible. They must be the types to hold grudges. If they remember us, do you think we'll have any more good days?"
"But you seem to be harsher than us."
...
The five Protectors stood like stone statues, undistracted, indifferent to everything, neither happy nor sad.
"Not going to lie, this idea of the Acting Sect Master is pretty good. Using our home court advantage to have Heaven's Court make a grand appearance. We've made the name of Heaven's Court known. The demonic sect and ancient cultivators will surely fall into our trap."
The Grand Elder was elatedly sharing this thought. He had clearly seen the astonishment, fear, and panic on everyone's faces when they had first appeared – it had been a satisfying sight.
"Do you think we'll be exposed?" Uncle Ba asked apprehensively. It felt good to fool people, but it would be a nightmare if they were found out.
This time was different from before. In the past, they lied to cultivators of the same realm, but this time they were tricking even those in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
If they were to be exposed, it would be risky every time they went out.
They weren't afraid of those at the Unification stage since no one could beat them. But if those at Transcendance Tribulation Stage got involved, they could only pray their master could salvage the situation in time.
The Third Elder thought his second elder brother was worrying too much: "That won't happen. Our Martial Nephew Yun assured us that we would not be found out."
"Moreover, even if we are exposed, it's not a big deal. I have prepared a backup plan."
The four were surprised. The third elder had a backup plan?
"What backup plan?""
"I bought insurance from the merchant association for all five of us. Even if something happens, we can get a large sum of Spirit stones... I won't speak of this anymore; my disciple is making his appearance."
"Seek Dao Sect, Meng Jingzhou."
"Longteng Village, Long Huo!"
Longteng Village was a rather special power. It was both an administrative unit of the Great Xia and part of the sphere of influence of the influential Long family.
Eight thousand years ago, there was a great power with the surname Long. He settled in an uninhabited part of Ji State with his wife, concubines, and servants. No one knew where this great power came from—it seemed like he appeared out of nowhere. Some people speculated that he came from the East Sea and was a dragon man.
The great power had several children, and after he passed away, he left behind a huge amount of cultivation resources. His children also stayed here, continuing to thrive and multiply.
Thanks to the resources left by the great power and the decent talents of his children, the family didn't decline over time.
With generations of inheritance, outsiders begin to call them the Dragon Family of Ji State, and they became an influential family.
Gradually, this place took shape. Local officials came for inspection and deemed it suitable as a village. They reported it, and the superiors established it as a village. In respect for the Long Family's wishes, this place was named Longteng Village.
The village leader of Longteng Village, was the Clan Leader of the Long Family.
Long Huo was the son of the former Clan Leader of the Long Family. Although he was suppressed by the current Clan Leader in his childhood, as his talent began to shine, he became the most gifted person in Longteng Village. The current Clan Leader had no choice but to stop suppressing him.
Long Huo activated his Golden Core, coating his body with a thin layer of water membrane which could resist attacks to a certain extent. His was a water attribute Golden Core, the First-grade quality.
"Soaring Dragon Strike!"
Like a soaring dragon, Long Huo moved swiftly across the stage, leaving afterimages. His speed so fast that even Spiritual Sense could hardly determine his position.
He moved behind Meng Jingzhou, and while Meng Jingzhou was unresponsive, he delivered a chop towards his neck.
"Got him!"
He was overjoyed in his heart, thinking that the opponent had let down his guard.
Who would have thought, Meng Jingzhou slightly swayed his body and dodged the sneak attack.
"What!"
He should not have seen himself.
Meng Jingzhou yawned indifferently, not really impressed with this opponent.
Long Huo persisted, once again using the Soaring Dragon Strike. Endless attacks from all directions approached, yet Meng Jingzhou easily dodged all of them.
Down below the stage, Young Master Lu applauded, the excitement clear in his eyes, as if he had found a worthy opponent.
"Good, truly worthy of being the disciple representing the Seek Dao Sect. If I'm not mistaken, he has cultivated to the 'Self-Forgetfulness' realm of body cultivation. Even among the ancient geniuses, no one has reached this realm during the Mid-Golden Core stage!"
The Invincible Heavenly King nodded: "It seems like he has just stepped into the realm of 'Self-Forgetfulness', in this realm, without needing to think, the body can automatically evade less threatening attacks."
Less threatening doesn't mean there is no threat, If one can avoid an attack, they should.
After Young Master Lu's explanation, only then did the geniuses below the stage understand how powerful Meng Jingzhou, the Body Cultivator was.
Meng Jingzhou nodded with satisfaction, that young lad, Lu Yang, was quite generous.
Bang——
Meng Jingzhou performed the Shocking Heaven Six Forms, furiously stepped forward, and with cumulative power, he landed a triple-stacked punch, sending Long Huo flying!
Long Huo kept offloading the punch's power, retreating all the way to half a foot from the edge of the stage, before regaining his balance.
Meng Jingzhou was slightly surprised: "Not too bad, you could withstand that punch, bring it on!"
Meng Jingzhou no longer held back,continuously using the Shocking Heaven Six Forms, driving Long Huo back, but every time he thought he could punch Long Huo off the stage, Long Huo, beyond his expectations, always took the punch.
But even so, Long Huo gradually couldn't withstand such high-intensity attacks.
"You can't win against me, you should concede."
Should he concede?
Long Huo realized the gap between them and closed his eyes with a frustrated look. He was tired after fighting for so long, stuggling further would be in vain as the outcome was already decided.
Is the gap between him and the real geniuses this big?
"Brother Long Huo, you must persevere!"
"Long Huo, don't concede!"
"You are the man who won against me, representing our village in this tournament. How could you lose here!"
Images of his fellows surfaced in Long Huo's mind: childhood friends, close buddies, both enemy and friend as the son of the Clan Leader ...
It was like they appeared in front of his eyes, calling out his name by his side.
"I can't concede!"
He bears the hopes of the village, as a representative of the Long Family, how could he concede here!
The referee went to check on Long Huo, who had fallen on the ground.
"Already hit the lantern? Winner of this round, Meng Jingzhou."

chapters.title: Chapter 497 - 496: Unseal!_1
chapters.content:
Long Huo, with several life-saving elixirs stuffed into him, was rescued by the referee.
Meng Jingzhou won.
A cool sensation rushed through Long Huo's throat, the elixir began to work, he slowly regained consciousness, his mind blank, took a while before realizing, he had lost.
"Are you okay, you fought well."
Meng Jingzhou extended his hand to help Long Huo up.
Long Huo shook his head with a bitter smile: "Loss is loss, I am not one who can't afford to lose."
Meng Jingzhou, worried that Long Huo might be completely disheartened after losing, kindly said: "I'll wait for you to beat me next time."
Long Huo was silent for a moment, then nodded: "Deal."
After a brief exchange between the two, Long Huo descended the ring and saw the serious middle-aged village head waiting for him.
"Headman... I failed the village's expectation."
A smile appeared on the corner of the headman's mouth, he lightly patted Long Huo's shoulder: "To fight like this already deserves credit. Meng Jingzhou is anything but ordinary, he is both the Young Master of the Meng Family and a disciple of Seek Dao Sect, the number one sect and family in the world respectively. With these double identities, he can sweep all his peers."
"Look who's here."
Long Huo looked up to see two beautiful figures appearing behind the headman, one his childhood sweetheart, and the other, a sister figure who treated him as a younger brother.
"Brother Long Huo, you were amazing!" The childhood sweetheart was a lively little girl.
"Long Huo, you fought well, it was worth it for me to tutor you." The sister figure was a woman with a proud figure and an efficient manner.
"Everyone..." Long Huo's eyes filled with tears and he sobbed, vowing to practice hard after returning and not let everyone down.
Meng Jingzhou from a distance: "..."
Could they fight one more time? He wanted to give this kid a singlehood curse punch.
...
Under the watchful eyes of the crowd, the second round of the martial arts contest featuring Young Master Lu was about to begin.
"Heavenly Court, Young Master."
"Flying Waterfall Sect, Kong Hao."
Flying Waterfall Sect, a second-tier sect with shallow ancestry, the Sect Leader is but at the Refining the Void cultivation level. Even among second-tier sects, Flying Waterfall Sect is a name hard to be heard of, very unimpressive.
Bai Ming had specifically learned about a few opponents before the battle: "This Kong Hao is not simple, look at him so calm, like a Confucian Cultivator, more like an untamed beast in combat. Before even starting the fight, his wild demeanor alone makes his opponents shiver."
The Sect Leader of the Flying Waterfall Sect stroked his beard, looking satisfied with Kong Hao, who was attracting attention on the stage.
Thanks to Kong Hao, he was qualified to attend the ceremony and meet so many important people.
"Kong Hao, as expected, was hiding his power."
Kong Hao keeps to himself, rarely talks to people and acts modestly. Whenever there is a Sect-wide competition, Kong Hao always narrowly wins the first place, as if there is not much difference between him and the runner-up. But no matter how hard the second place chases, they can never beat Kong Hao.
He had guessed Kong Hao hid his power, but had not expected him to hide so much.
Young Master Lu unsheathed his sword, a weapon temporarily borrowed from the Sect's treasury.
The Green Peak Sword and the Dark Moon Sword had already made appearances at the Qingzhou grand ceremony. Using them again with his identity as Young Master would reveal his secret.
Lu Yang then used his powerful connections and had Fairy Eternity borrow a sword from the treasury on his behalf.
Lu Yang faced Kong Hao, his eyebrows slightly furrowed. This man surprisingly gave him an exceptionally dangerous feeling, even the great cultivator who started over after disbanding cultivation had not stirred this feeling in him.
"Truly, crouching tigers and hidden dragons..."
Kong Hao knew of the strength of the opponent in front of him, only by fighting with all his might would he have a hope of winning.
He placed two fingers on his lips, exhaled cold air, and the temperature on the stage gradually dropped. Lu Yang lifted his foot slightly, but it was somewhat sluggish as if stuck in a quagmire.
"An ice-based ability is quite rare..." Immediately, Lu Yang realized something's wrong, "No, it's not just cold air, there's poison gas mixed in with the cold air!"
If one were to mistakenly believe it to be only cold air and try to dispel it with their power, they would only allow the toxic gas to enter their body and be absorbed faster. By then, they would have put themselves in a passive situation.
"But it does not matter."
As a frequent visitor of Elixir Cauldron Peak, Lu Yang has resistance to most common poisonous gases. He won't be in trouble in the short term. With a gentle spin of his sword, he cleared up an area around him, free of both the cold and poisonous gases.
The various magic skills of Lu Yang standout, at a glance, it can be identified that it is his magic. When he was Young Master Lu, he could only display swordsmanship.
Luckily, he is a Sword Spirit Root, and his sword skills are excellent.
While Lu Yang was clearing the cold and poisonous gases, Kong Hao let out a low growl, his muscles bulged like a wild beast in rage. But his eyes were clear and cold, obviously maintaining his sanity.
He rushed up furiously, his fingernails elongated, resembling the claws of a Demon Beast, collided with the sword, and surprisingly did not break.
Lu Yang narrowed his eyes slightly, the solid foundation Kong Hao displayed did not seem like something a second-rate Sect could cultivate. This cannot be simply explained by exceptional talent...
As the crowd watched the two people fighting relentlessly on the stage, there were subtle exclamations from below. In comparison to the first quick battle, this one is difficult to conclude.
Only those Cultivators in the Unification stage could see, in this battle, Young Master Lu holds the advantage. Both parties seemingly traded offense and defense, each has their own, but in actuality, from beginning to end, it was Kong Hao being led by the nose by Young Master Lu.
"Merely with this, it won't pose a threat to me." Lu Yang thought to himself, deciding to go all out.
Lu Yang turned his wrist, the sword tip traced an arc in the air, each pore spewing thin-as-hair Sword Qi. The Sword Qi gushed and converged on the sword blade.
Sword Qi crisscrossed, like a rosy cloud, like a vast ocean, sweeping across all directions, swallowing heaven and earth.
Retreat—!
Kong Hao took this hit directly, even if his forearms were ready to block, it was of no use. His arms were bloody, his breath instantly wilted and he was panting heavily, the injury was not light.
"Lad, are you going to lose?" A voice echoed in his mind, the sound was low and slow, one could imagine what a massive being was speaking.
"What's it to you?" The strike just now made Kong Hao realize the gap between himself and Lu Yang. This was a gap in talent, which could not be bridged by hard work.
Standing behind the iron fence in his mind, he stared at the enormous creature.
The enormous creature chuckled, mocking Kong Hao's arrogance: "Speak politely, arrogant lad, without me, would you have today?"
"Since you were born, I have been inside you. You're a very stubborn soul, you may appear low-key, but have you ever admitted defeat in a fight? Your desire to win is stronger than anyone else's, if it wasn't like this, I wouldn't be bothered with you."
"What do you want to do?"
"Strength, you lack strength, I lend it to you."
Kong Hao silently stared at this massive creature. Indeed, even a tiny bit of its power would suffice for him to turn the tables and win.
But in order to use its power, one layer of the seal needs to be unlocked.
Should I unlock it?
The gigantic creature grinned, its massive beast eyes reflected Kong Hao's troubled expression. Once you've used my power, and you truly realize that it can make you stronger quickly, you will start unlocking the seal step by step. When that happens, I can come out.
Kong Hao gritted his teeth; the colossal creature was right. He didn't want to lose, he wanted to be champion.
Just one layer, just unlock one layer. There are still eight layers to not be unlocked.
The gigantic creature laughed silently, unlocking one layer of the seal. An ominous force passed through the iron fence and attached itself to Kong Hao.
"Hmm?"
In the outside world, Lu Yang looked surprised at Kong Hao. He felt a surge of power from Kong Hao's body, ceaseless, carrying fierceness and bloodthirstiness, almost ominous.
Kong Hao's body underwent changes, his injuries were healing at a visually observable speed. His previously heavily injured body was now fully recovered, his pupils vertically dilated, like a wild lion, and again, like a tiger, his skin sprouted a layer of beast hairs. There was no telling whether it actually grew, or a result of the spiritual energy.
"Roar—!"
Kong Hao roared, the sound shook the heavens.
Lu Yang felt his hair stand on end; this was the source of the danger he had sensed!
However, Kong Hao's condition seemed familiar to him, as if he had borrowed a power that wasn't his, similar to being temporarily possessed.
Lu Yang slowly raised his hand, watchfully staring at Kong Hao, and preparing to use his trump card.
"Referee, I accuse him of cheating."

chapters.title: Chapter 498 - 497 Lu Yang's Three Trump Cards_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang had three trump cards that he didn't use lightly.
The first was Eldest Sister's Form Boxing, which would summon Eldest Sister.
The second was invoking the Fairy Eternity, asking her to possess him.
The third was the Invincible Elixir, used to strategize a winning plan.
Any one of these trump cards could deal a fatal blow to a Cultivator of the same realm.
Lu Yang would only reveal a card if the opponent was too strong or initiated covert moves. Kong Hao was an example of the latter.
The power Kong Hao exhibited clearly wasn't his own. Lu Yang suspected that a powerful soul was dwelling within him—a tactic Lu Yang was all too familiar with, since he had one within him as well.
This made fighting practically impossible.
The powerful soul within Kong Hao was likely from someone of Unification realm at the very least. Lu Yang couldn't possibly compete with that using his own power.
He decisively used the Invincible Elixir. The answer it provided was clear and in line with his speculations: he should report Kong Hao to the referee.
"So this is the so-called genius, fighting me with external help?" Young Master Lu scoffed. "If you're going to ignore him breaking the rules like this, I might as well use the magic artifact bestowed by the Sect leader and my mentor, which can even withstand a hit from someone at the Pass Tribulation stage."
"Considering that the magic artifact is greatly beyond regulations, I decided not to use it in the fight. But if Kong Hao is allowed to break the rules, then I see no reason to hold back."
The referee was stunned upon hearing Lu Yang's accusation. Despite his vast experience, he had never encountered anyone using the power of another soul within them to fight.
Upon hearing Lu Yang's explanation, he began to realize something was off with Kong Hao's power—it wasn't his own.
This was certainly a violation of the rules.
"Defeated party, Kong Hao."
Just as Kong Hao was about to fight with his newfound power, he heard the referee declare the results and went off stage in disappointment.
The first people he encountered after descending the stage weren't from the Flying Waterfall Sect, but venerable senior Cultivators of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
"Make way, I want to see who is inside this lad."
"I created the Possess Art, let me examine him first, I am an expert in this."
"I am the highest in cultivation level, let me do it."
The Sect Leader of the Flying Waterfall Sect wanted to approach, but these big shots had already crowded him out.
"This aura resembles one of the Four Fierce Beasts." The One Qi Venerable, who was most sensitive to spiritual force, was the first one to make a judgment.
"Young man, do not resist, let me visit your Lingtai."
As the One Qi Venerable finished speaking, a small figure flew out from his Lingtai and into Kong Hao's Lingtai.
"Ho, this is a big one."
Kong Hao's Lingtai was much larger than those of the same realm, not as a result of his training, but it had been stretched by the enormous entity inside him.
An iron fence divided his Lingtai into two parts. The smaller part was Kong Hao's activity space, and the larger part was where the colossal entity was sealed.
Nine layers of strong seals were added in the middle of the iron fence. Unbreakable, the colossal creature glared fiercely at the One Qi Venerable, a hint of inscrutable fear in its beastly eyes.
The massive creature was a lion as big as a small hill. With pure white, long mane resembling drifting snowflakes, its breathing moved in rhythm. Two stout fangs growing upwards were like two shiny broad-bladed knives, and its tail was as long as its body.
"So it's the old Taozhu."
The One Qi Venerable sneered. This old Taozhu was not simple. Being so extensively cultivated as a Transcendance Tribulation Stage being, it could even lead the Taozhu clan. He wondered why it was sealed here.
"Isn't this Ji Xiong? I thought you had been killed after failing to compete for the clan leader's position. Never thought I'd find you here."
One after another, transcendence-tribulation stage cultivators rushed into Kong Hao's spiritual platform. As the stage was pretty rare, it didn't take long for someone to recognize the identity of Old Taozhu.
Kong Hao had never seen so many at the transcendence-tribulation stage in his entire life.
When he learned about Old Taozhu's cultivation level and identity, he was shocked.
He initially thought Old Taozhu was at the unification stage, but he turned out to be the incredibly terrifying transcendence-tribulation stage.
Being an orphan, as far as he could remember, Old Taozhu had been residing inside his body, sealed by someone unknown.
Kong Hao had always been afraid to reveal the existence of Old Taozhu, fearing that the Great Powers would covet him. This was why he chose to join the Flying Waterfall Sect, an insignificant second-rate sect.
Unexpectedly, the truth was still exposed in the end.
How would these Great Powers treat him?
There was no use hoping that Old Taozhu would tell the truth. The transcendence-tribulation cultivators inquired about what Kong Hao knew and combined it with the information they had about Old Taozhu. They deduced the big picture:
After Old Taozhu failed in competing for the Clan Leader position, he was hunted down, his flesh destroyed, and his soul damaged. He managed to escape to the Great Xia Territory, where a cultivator specialized in sealing magic, who was at the peak of unification, sealed Old Taozhu within Kong Hao's body.
Judging from the degree of the seal, that peak unification cultivator had shown kindness to Kong Hao. As Kong Hao's strength continuously increased, he could gradually unseal and utilize the power of Old Taozhu.
"You have two choices." One Qi Venerable guided Kong Hao.
"Release the seal, and we will capture Old Taozhu. Correspondingly, we will provide you with suitable rewards, including treasures and spirit elixirs. It's as if we're buying it from you. This is the safest plan."
