Old Taozhu being hard to deal with at the transcendence-tribulation stage is true, but isn't everyone present at the same stage? If they all attacked at once, Old Taozhu would have no choice but to resist passively.
"Or you can continue sealing Old Taozhu. As your strength increases, you can gradually unseal it. However, you run the risk of backlash in the process."
"Which will you choose?"
...
While all the transcendence-tribulation cultivators were observing Old Taozhu as if he was an exotic animal, the competition was proceeding in an orderly manner.
Feeling threatened by Meng Jingzhou's Single Curse Fist, Lan Ting became defensive and was defeated by Meng Jingzhou.
Meng Jingzhou earned the qualifications for the final round.
Following his master's instructions, Yan Tianzhi fought for his life when he encountered someone from the Five Elements Sect. He defeated Bai Ming and advanced smoothly into the semi-finals.
"Prison Suppressing Sect, Yan Tianzhi."
"Heaven's Court, Young Master Lu."
Lu Yang and Yan Tianzhi faced each other in the semi-finals.
Behind Yan Tianzhi, Taotie and Azure Dragon war patterns were flickering. The phantoms of the two demon beasts were barely visible but exerted an overwhelming pressure.
This was a unique cultivation method of the Prison Suppressing Sect, created by its founding master.
Seeing the two war patterns, Lu Yang applauded, "Finally, a worthy opponent. I've long heard of the unique war pattern system of the Prison Suppressing Sect. Even our master cannot stop praising it. True enough, it's as impressive as rumored."
"In ancient times, our human race had the habit of painting patterns on our faces. When these patterns are drawn correctly, they grant boundless power. This was our original strategy to combat floods and wild beasts. Our master thought that these patterns had been lost, but unexpectedly, in this new era, someone built upon these patterns, innovating the cultivation method of war patterns."
"Our master said that the person who created this method is greatly talented. It's a pity that he was born at the wrong time, in the transitional period between Great Yu and Great Xia. If he had lived in ancient times, he would undoubtedly have competed for the position of an immortal, securing a splendid future and a name that resounds through the ages!"
Lu Yang sighed as if reminiscing the master's evaluation of the founded master of the Prison Suppressing Sect.
In the judging panel, Qiu Jin'an and Luo Hongxia looked at Yang Ding in surprise.
You hadn't mentioned this before, this Lu Yang nearly praised your founding sect master to the skies.
Scratching his head in embarrassment, Yang Ding said, "I thought it would be a good opportunity to promote our Prison Suppressing Sect."

chapters.title: Chapter 499 - 498: Town_1
chapters.content:
Qiu Jin'an was furious. Yang Ding, you were always a well-behaved individual. How did you start making covert moves now?
How did he overlook this possibility!
The Five Elements Sect also wanted to publicize themselves. This was such an excellent opportunity to praise their own sect through Heaven's Court, and they just missed it!
Daoist Buyu was busy writing the "Legend of the Dao Sect." You could hear storytelling about the Seek Dao Sect in just about any teahouse now, which was boosting the sect's fame exponentially.
Qiu Jin'an also wanted to do this, but alas, the Five Elements Sect lacked the talent of Daoist Buyu.
Luo Hongxia was doing pretty well. The Laurel Fairy Palace was a semi-hermetic sect, filled only with female cultivators. Even without publicizing, its fame surpassed the Five Elements Sect and the Prison Suppressing Sect.
"Sect Master Lu, is there still time to publicize the Five Elements Sect now? We can negotiate the payment," Qiu Jin'an asked Fairy Eternity who was standing nearby. A widely accepted belief in the cultivation world is that the ancient era represented a pinnacle of power. So everyone was eager to associate themselves with that era.
With Heaven's Court's presence, it wasn't challenging to establish some connection with the ancient era.
Lu Yang was handling the partnership deals; Fairy Eternity didn't understand these things.
She sent a message to Lu Yang, who was in the middle of a battle on the stage. Lu Yang thought for a moment and responded.
"Although I could use this opportunity to compliment the Five Elements Sect, saying something like 'as expected of the Five Elements Sect that contains the power of the five elements. The founding patriarch was indeed a genius,' the timing isn't right. It could come across as unnatural and might harm the reputation of Heaven's Court.
Tell Sect Leader Qiu that it's not possible at this time but we may consider collaborating with the Five Elements Sect next time."
"Oh."
On the battle stage, Lu Yang was locked in fierce combat with Yan Tianzhi.
In the previous round, Yan Tianzhi fought tooth and nail to defeat Bai Ming for the sake of publicity. Naturally, he had his advantages to be able to defeat Bai Ming.
The Taotie and Azure Dragon were superior races within the Demon Race. Normally, a cultivator at the Golden Core stage could only have one type of War Patterns, but Yan Tianzhi's physique was exceptionally compatible with the cultivation method of War Patterns.
He retreated for closed-door cultivation after the Qingzhou grand ceremony and bathed in the dragon transformation pond, eventually comprehending the Azure Dragon War Patterns.
Compared to the Taotie War Patterns, Yan Tianzhi didn't have much time to master the Azure Dragon War Patterns, but even so, it was enough to put pressure on Lu Yang.
"These War Patterns are indeed challenging to deal with," Lu Yang gritted his teeth. This wasn't merely a publicity stunt— he was truly feeling the pressure.
Yan Tianzhi was known for his aggressive combat style based on physical close combat. Lu Yang wasn't a Body Cultivator, and facing Yan Tianzhi head-on was a losing strategy.
Classified by cultivation methods, Lu Yang could be identified as a magic cultivator and a sword cultivator.
If he could swap opponents with Meng Jingzhou, let Meng Jingzhou fight with Yan Tianzhi, and himself to fight with Lan Ting, both sides would surely advance.
Several spheres of water emerged behind Yan Tianzhi. Azure Dragon's water control was the power of Azure Dragon War Patterns.
The ends of the water spheres sharpened into water needles, targeting Lu Yang.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
"Startled Swan!" Lu Yang randomly named his sword move, which was actually the "Cutting Mantra."
At this realm, the sword moves used were basically the same and had no significant difference; the only variation was the name.
Despite the exquisite sword techniques of Mingtai, all moves could be summed up into Lu Yang's "Cutting Mantra", "Breaking Mantra", "Pointing Mantra", and other basic sword moves.
As long as they did not display notable styles such as "One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand", "All Swords Return", and "Sword Opens Heaven's Gate", there isn't much variation in sword cultivators' moves; the comprehension of swordsmanship was what determined the strength of basic sword moves.
The "Cutting Mantra" destroyed the water needles, which turned into mist as they touched the Sword Qi and enveloped the arena.
"Heaven's Opening!"
Lu Yang casually named another sword move. The Sword Qi manifested solemnly and powerfully, balanced and righteous, with an imposing aura that dominated all others.
Yan Tianzhi, who was planning to take advantage of the mist and get close to Lu Yang, felt a chill run up his spine, sensing a powerful threat.
He couldn't withstand this move with his physical body.
"Shield Ghost!"
A monstrous ghost holding a shield appeared in front of Yan Tianzhi, attempting to block the sizzling sword Qi. The clash between the Sword Qi and the ghost formed through War Patterns was silent but generated thousands of layers of shockwaves, which blew away the mist enveloping the arena.
Shield Ghost was Yan Tianzhi's first War Pattern. It lacked the power of attack but had an impenetrable defense among its peers.
Yan Tianzhi felt his pupils contract as he saw cracks appear on the Shield Ghost. It was barely holding up against this sword strike.
It's no surprise he was a genius in ancient times. He's incredibly strong.
Yan Tianzhi still did not know Lu Yang's identity.
"Take back!"
Yan Tianzhi recalled the Shield Ghost, which turned into War Patterns and branded on his arm. His arm bore part of the damage received by the War Patterns and immediately started bleeding.
Luckily, he only suffered equivalent damage; if it had been converted completely, his arm would have been pierced by the Sword Qi by now.
Yan Tianzhi once again summoned the Taotie and Azure Dragon War Patterns to launch another attack.
Lu Yang scratched his cheek, retracting his sword: "This is never going to end at this rate. Let me give a new technique I just learned a try."
"Seal!"
A glittering giant statue descended from the sky, enveloping Yan Tianzhi who was prepared to charge!
Bang!
Yan Tianzhi did not expect the sudden appearance of the statue, smashing his head into the inner wall of the statue and growing a big bump.
The two big War Patterns smashed into the statue, but the statue, heavy as a mountain, barely wobbled.
On the other hand, the shockwave produced by the impact deafened Yan Tianzhi temporarily.
"What is this?!"
Despite being knowledgeable, the audience couldn't recognize this move.
"Feels like the Sixteen Feet Golden Body technique from Buddhism."
"Don't be absurd. Who uses a Sixteen Feet Golden Body so far from the caster? It must be a lost ancient technique."
"Did you hear him say the word 'seal' just now? Maybe this is the lost ancient Verbal Spell!"
"What!"
Yan Tianzhi wanted to dig a hole and crawl out from beneath, but the arena was reinforced with powerful magic. Even a Divinity Transformation Stage battle couldn't damage the arena, thwarting his last hope.
Lu Yang was certainly capable of moving his own Golden Body. While Yan Tianzhi was stunned, he kicked his Golden Body over, causing Yan Tianzhi to roll off the arena with it.
Lu Yang won.
Young Master Lu has finally reached the final after defeating all his opponents and is about to face his lifelong adversary – Meng Jingzhou.
Lu Yang sat in recovery, replenishing the spiritual essence he just used. The final officially began.
Meng Jingzhou could hardly wait and leaped onto the arena.
He chuckled sinisterly, rubbing his hands together: "Hehe, finally it's my turn."
After learning from Qiu Jin'an, he finally had a chance to show his strength and deal with the lawless Lu Yang.
Becoming the Acting Master doesn't make you great, you still have to take your punishment!
"Seek Dao Sect, Meng Jingzhou."
"Heaven's Court, Young Master."
"Let's discuss. You cooperate with me in this round, and I will do the same for you next time." Lu Yang kindly suggested telepathically. As sect brothers, he preferred not to fight if it is not necessary, not to destroy their unity.
"You think you can avoid a fight just by saying so? I'm telling you, I'm determined to fight you today!" Meng Jingzhou was not willing to forgo the opportunity to fight Lu Yang.
Lu Yang sighed before trying another approach: "Then, as the Acting Sect Master, I command you to surrender."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
"How about we discuss it again?"

chapters.title: Chapter 500 - 499: Acting Showdown_1
chapters.content:
Meng Jingzhou, living under Lu Yang's tyranny, was forced to agree to the previous terms - to flatter Lu Yang this time, and have Lu Yang flatter him next time.
Two of the greatest geniuses of their era were at war. Although it was a play, neither of them had any intention of holding back.
The spectators under the stage were all seasoned cultivators. If they fought while holding back, it would be easy for their flaws to be exposed. Therefore, they were going all out.
Their battle was ferocious, exhibiting power, speed, and reflexes ... not only did it leave their victorious peers in shock but also revealed the immense gap between geniuses representing the state level.
Even those cultivators who had disbanded cultivation and started over were secretly alarmed.
Despite the efforts they'd poured into starting over, they stood no chance against the real geniuses.
The competition of this Great Era was truly terrifying to the extreme!
Lu Yang employed intricate sword arts, which even Mingtai found admirable. Meng Jingzhou's boxing techniques, passed on to him by the Third Elder, showcased the advantages of a body cultivator to perfection. His body's every part was forged flawlessly, with even the Transcendance Tribulation Stage elders unable to find fault.
"The Meng Family's bloodline was indeed terrifying..."
An elder murmured in astonishment. The Meng Family stirred trouble in the Imperial City and still securely held the title as the greatest influential family, all thanks to their irrefutable, absolute strength.
The Meng Family's power even made those Transcendance Tribulation Stage elders feel a thrill of fear.
And yet, the power they demonstrated was not all they possessed.
His punches were powerful, filled with vigor, capable of vanquishing demons, shocking the heavens and earth, breaking all obstacles; even beasts feared his mighty punches.
Sword Qi was boundless, breaking through like a river breaching a dam, severing the punch marks.
The two fought desperately, deadlock unbroken. Sweating with anxiousness, the competing geniuses kept their eyes fixed on every development on the stage.
Only by concentrating completely could they keep up with the two's movements.
These were their true peers; learning from them would greatly benefit their future battles.
Cough!
Careless for a moment, Meng Jingzhou got grazed across the shoulder by Sword Qi, losing Qi and blood. Falling into a disadvantageous position, Lu Yang pressed his attack, not allowing him any chance of recovery.
"Meng Jingzhou, don't give up!"
Someone voiced their feelings – Meng Jingzhou represented the world's geniuses, their hope. They did not want someone from Heaven's Court to win.
"Defeat this Young Master Lu!"
"Let them know this is the era of the Great Xia, not their glory days of the ancient times!"
Voices of encouragement reached Meng Jingzhou's ears. Unfortunately, against the absolute performance, all the encouraging cheers were ineffective.
"Shocking Heaven Six Forms!" Encouraged, Meng Jingzhou's veins popped, his eyes filled with blood, ready to risk everything.
Lu Yang extended two fingers, smeared blood on the blade, and initiated his final move.
"Void-Breaking Sword Art!"
Boom!
Draining all their spiritual essence, the two clashed in an ultimate showdown, raising a cloud of dust.
Woosh——
A figure was flung backwards, blood spurting continuously, heavily injured.
"It's Heaven's Court's person that was flung backwards!"
Someone rejoiced. This so-called Young Master Lu was seriously injured, something that had never happened before!
Lu Yang knelt on one knee, his sword planted in the ground, looking dazed due to the forceful impact.
But before anyone had the chance to celebrate, the dust cleared to reveal Meng Jingzhou sprawled on the ground, covered in blood, barely breathing, wounded even more severely than Lu Yang!
Meng Jingzhou's finger twitched, he struggled to open his eyes, tried to stand up multiple times, but his limbs seemed to refuse his commands. Eventually, he reluctantly gave up on getting up.
On the other hand, Lu Yang managed to muster enough strength to laugh despite his injuries.
The outcome had been determined.
The referee clenched his teeth. Allowing a man from the ancient times to win was the humiliation of the Great Xia, but as a referee, he couldn't show favoritism.
"I declare... Meng Jingzhou... defeated."
The last two words lingered in his mouth, trembling as he struggled to utter them.
The referee checked Meng Jingzhou's injury, breathed a sigh of relief. Though the wounds were significant, they weren't life-threatening, which wouldn't shake his foundation.
The Five Heavenly Kings rushed to the stage, helping their young master up.
"Young Master, are you okay?"
"Cough... I won't die... it was indeed a good fight." Lu Yang was still smiling, blood dripping from the corner of his mouth.
Golden Flame Heavenly King quickly took out a small pill bottle, uncovered the lid, and the scent of an elixir filled the air. He fed two golden pills to Lu Yang, who then began to meditate on the spot, quickly recovering his injuries and spiritual essence.
...
Meng Jingzhou lost.
The representative Mid-stage Golden Core generation's genius lost.
Many people couldn't accept this reality.
He almost won! He was on the brink of victory!
The Seventh Elder's elixir was very effective, Lu Yang quickly recovered to his initial state. He, surrounded by The Five Heavenly Kings, stood up smiling, looking at the five solemn Sect Leaders of the Five Great Immortal Sects and Crown Prince Jiang Qun.
"It seems that the geniuses of this era do have some abilities, the fight was not bad, but unfortunately, they are just that, abilities and nothing more."
As soon as these words were said, the crowd was stirred into a frenzy. His remarks were too arrogant. What did he mean by "nothing more"? Everyone saw the tiny gap between the two! A small detail could determine the victory. If there were to be a rematch, who knew who would win!
"Young Master Lu, your words suggest that you don't respect the geniuses of this era. You should understand that there are always people better than you, and skies higher than your sky. This world does not belong to your Heaven's Court." Sect Master Lu gave Young Master Lu a meaningful look, the threat in his words were clear to all.
Young Master Lu scoffed as though he found Sect Master Lu's words ignorant: "'There are always people better and skies higher?' That's just an excuse for mediocrities who've lost. When it comes to talent, who can surpass me?"
Dark Ghost Heavenly King looked down on the crowd with disdain: "If it were not for the ancients suppressing our young master, he would have become an immortal in ancient times, why wait till today?"
Young Master Lu glanced at the solemn Dark Ghost Heavenly King and waved his hand impatiently: "Protector Dark Ghost, enough, I am in a good mood today. Let's not discuss these--."
"Yes."
Dark Ghost Heavenly King ceased to speak and stepped back, statue-like.
Everyone inhaled sharply, the shock in their hearts was inexpressible. Was Young Master Lu's talent so high it even made immortals jealous?
What kind of amazing talent would that be?
There were only records of the Four Immortals of the Ancients and there were no accounts of their talent.
In other words, Young Master Lu's talent was unique, something that was not mentioned in any books, ancient and present.
"Just boasting, if Young Master Lu is so confident, why not try a fight with me?"
To everyone's surprise, Sect Master Lu leaped down from the stand and landed steadily on the battlefield.
"Speaking of which, Sect Master Lu is also at the Mid-stage Golden Core level, indeed a worthy opponent. But this tone, I don't like it." Young Master Lu twiddled his fingers, speaking slowly.
Their eyes met as if sparks were flying. The Five Heavenly Kings tactfully retreated, avoid disturbing Young Master's interest.
"So, are we doing this?"
"Bring it on!"

chapters.title: Chapter 501 - 500 Sect Master Lu versus Young Master Lu_1
chapters.content:
The fight between Lu Yang and Lu Yang was intense.
Sect Master Lu was proficient in magic spells. He was adept with the five elemental magic skills, and had dabbled in the pinnacles of time and space magic spells, achieving a unity of fist and cultivation that sent the leaders of the Four Great Immortal Sects scurrying for safety.
Young Master Lu mainly practiced swordsmanship. Despite his youth, his understanding of swordsmanship far exceeded that of cultivators at the same realm, even rivalling those at the Nascent Soul Stage.
"Who will win? It's said that this Sect Master Lu is highly accomplished in the aspect of magic spells, even creating numerous unique magic skills. There have been only a handful of individuals who have been able to create magic skills at this realm throughout history."
"At the grand celebration in Qingzhou, he defeated both Bai Ming and Lan Ting single-handedly, and no one could figure out the nature of his Golden Core."
"It's hard to predict the outcome. Haven't you heard what Young Master Lu said? His talent is so high that even immortals suppress him!"
Lu Yang, as expected of a Great Power, attracted everyone's attention with every move he made.
Especially the leaders of the Four Great Immortal Sects and the elder prince Jiang Qun, who wanted to see how Lu Yang would fight himself.
At the moment when Sect Master Lu leapt off the stage, Fairy Eternity willingly gave her body over to Lu Yang, enabling Lu Yang to control both bodies in combat.
"Fight well, Lu Yang. You must defeat the guy on the other side. This fight represents our Seek Dao Sect!" Fairy Eternity first cheered for Lu Yang in Sect Master Lu's Spiritual Space, before running to Young Master Lu's Spiritual Space.
"Destroy that one from the Seek Dao Sect. This time we must enhance the fame of our Heaven's Court!"
"...Fairy, you should rest if you have nothing else to do."
"Oh, alright."
During the time when Fairy Eternity was the Acting Sect Master, using Lu Yang's body for cultivation, Lu Yang's cultivation level indeed improved significantly, especially in terms of spiritual power, where he reached a new height.
Previously, when he controlled two bodies, he needed to concentrate fully and could not afford to be distracted.
Now, with him controlling two bodies, he still had spare energy to soothe Fairy Eternity.
Outside, Sect Master Lu and Young Master Lu fought fiercely, with victories and losses on both sides.
Sect Master Lu spat out the Three Flavored True Fire. The True Fire split into three streams, each with a different flavor. The flames licked the air like tongues of fire, causing the temperature to soar.
Young Master Lu flicked his wrist, shooting out three sharp Sword Qi.
"Three Flies of the Sparrow!"
Boom, boom, boom!
The Sword Qi and True Fire exploded, the heat wave mixed with the Sword Qi scraped their cheeks, causing a stinging pain.
Sect Master Lu used the Earth Escape technique to launch a sneak attack from underground. But it was as if Young Master Lu had foresight, as he evaded Sect Master Lu, who suddenly emerged from the ground, in advance.
Sect Master Lu stared intently at Young Master Lu with a heavy expression: "Foresight, clarity of the sword's heart, I've heard my master say that only those who are intoxicated with the sword, obsessed with the sword, can achieve clarity of the sword's heart. Has your understanding of swordsmanship reached such a level?"
Young Master Lu chuckled lightly, wiping away the bloodstain on his cheek. He had predicted the attack in advance yet his evasion was still a bit late; his face had been grazed.
"You're not simple either, creating a completely new kind of True Fire based on the Samadhi True Fire prototype. The magic spell you used to tunnel underground earlier seemed like Earth Escape but was slightly distinct. Is that also your own creation?"
"Creating two kinds of Five Elements magic spells at the Golden Core Stage is unparalleled even in the ancient times!"
Sect Master Lu's body suddenly shrunk to a height of only three inches. He hopped on the ground at an astonishing speed, covered in Three Flavored True Fire. He waved his Arhat Fist; despite his small stature, he put Young Master Lu under immense pressure. Young Master Lu didn't dare to take the blows directly and had to block with his sword instead.
The shrunken Sect Master Lu's boxing technique was astonishing, and even carried the oscillations of Buddha's chant, invoking compassion for all. His tiny fist struck the sword and emitted a clear resonance.
Young Master Lu's swordsmanship wasn't to be trifled with. He aimed his sword at Sect Master Lu, stabbing thrice consecutively, each attack barely dodged by Sect Master Lu.
After a hundred rounds of combat, neither could get the upper hand!
Each move was lethal and slackness would lead to defeat. However, both were quick in their reactions. They always identified the countermeasure to break the opponent's attack in the fastest amount of time and then counterattacked immediately.
Their offense and defense strategies, and their intrigue, held the Geniuses captive, their breaths held, their eyes unblinking, for fear of missing any minute detail.
At this point, they had forgotten their biases and only wanted to see what astounding moves the two fighters on the stage could make.
After a hundred and twenty rounds, both simultaneously retreated backwards, panting and adjusting their breaths, replenishing their spiritual essence.
Their previous contest had all but exhausted their spiritual essences.
"They say that sword cultivators can break thousands of spells with a single sword. I didn't believe it before, but seeing it today, it is indeed true."
Sect Master Lu fixed his gaze on Young Master Lu, looking for the right moment to attack.
"Sect Master Lu flatters me. I always thought that holding a sword, I could go anywhere in this vast world, that despite the plethora of geniuses, none could match the power of my sword. It was only after sparring with Sect Master Lu that I realized there are still people obstructing my path to immortality!"
Hundred Medicine Heavenly King couldn't help sighing in a voice audible to others around, "Young Master has never praised someone so highly before."
The Four Heavenly Kings nodded, "Young Master is such a proud person. Only the Master and Dou Tianzun can make him bow in admiration. It's rare to encounter an opponent who Young Master has been dreaming of during this journey."
"It's a pity that we had to leave in such a rush this time. If we had brought the Four Holy Sons with us, this battle might have been even more spectacular."
The Four Holy Sons?
Others heard this term and couldn't help but ponder, does Heaven's Court have four other exceptional geniuses beside this Young Master?
The Four Holy Sons naturally referred to Meng Jingzhou, Tao Yaoye, Man Gu, and Li Haoran.
Theoretically, Qin Yanyan was also a member of Heaven's Court, but her current identity was that of Qin Haoran's reincarnation.
Lu Yang fought himself for another eighty rounds, with no clear winner, and tacitly ceased fighting.
"Awesome! I have never had such an exhilarating fight with a cultivator of my own level before!" Young Master Lu laughed boisterously, exuding a wild and unrestrained aura, no longer viewing Sect Master Lu with a superior gaze.
Sect Master Lu responded with a modest smile, "If we continue fighting, we probably won't be able to determine the winner until tomorrow. The fight has become meaningless. Shall we call it a day?"
After a brief consideration, Young Master Lu quickly agreed to Sect Master Lu's suggestion.
"Let's call it a day then. I underestimated the geniuses of this world. Having you in the strife of the Great Era won't be dull!"
Sect Master Lu maintained his humble demeanor, "Your uninvited visit was impolite. Members of Heaven's Court, please leave."
Even though he had been asked to leave, Young Master Lu wasn't angry. He waved his hand grandly, turning around to leave.
"The five Protectors, follow me."
"Yes!"
The members of Heaven's Court arrived on a cloud and left on a cloud. Under the gaze of all, the cloud soared out of the Seek Dao Sect.
Watching this scene from the backstage where he was recovering from his injuries, Meng Jingzhou was filled with indignation.
"Damn it, I missed a big opportunity!"
"Brother Meng, what's wrong?" Man Gu asked.
In addition to Li Haoran, the Three Holy Sons of Heaven's Court were hiding here.
Man Gu and Tao Yaoye weren't great actors and appearing outside could easily reveal their identities, so they had been watching the battle from backstage all this time.
"Lu Yang got to show off twice, but only promised to help me show off once!"

chapters.title: Chapter 502 - 501: The Ceremony Ends_1
chapters.content:
Sect Master Lu and Young Master Lu ended up in a stalemate, much to the delight of the Geniuses, who enjoyed this much-needed consolation.
The cultivators who had to start over after disbanding cultivation looked solemn. With the ancient prodigies of the Heavenly Court ahead of them, and the current Geniuses behind them, they were caught in the middle. They felt they might not have a role to play in the endgame of this Great Era's conflict.
In the spectator stands, Qiu Jin'an retracted his gaze from the fight just concluded, slowly releasing his breath as he reflected, "The young can indeed be full of surprises."
Jiang Qun curiously asked, "Are you saying that it's impressive how Sect Master Lu is such a formidable fighter at such a young age?"
"No, I mean he is even more deceptive than Old Buyu."
"Back in his days, Old Buyu was fairly naive in his deception skills. Of course, I was also naive and ended up being deceived over and over again."
"Lu Yang is different. His deceit is seamless. He's not fooling a few people, he's fooling everyone in the world."
Jiang Qun stood speechless.
He felt fortunate to have been born in a later generation and didn't have to deal with Old Buyu in his prime. Who knows how much suffering that would have brought?
"However, there's one good thing about Lu Yang. When he deceives people, he only deceives outsiders. He doesn't swindle his own."
"I should encourage Bai Ming to spend more time with Lu Yang. While Bai Ming is talented and bright, when compared to Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, he falls quite short."
Yang Ding chimed in: "Even Tianzhi is not as good as Bai Ming. He's a bit stubborn. He should also learn more from Lu Yang."
Luo Hongxia would never allow her prized disciple to get close to Lu Yang. Who knows what could happen if they grow too close?
Master Jiesha would be reluctant to allow his disciple to get too close to Lu Yang. As monastic cultivators, honest communication is a staple. They can't let their disciple pick up Lu Yang's deceitful ways.
When Fairy Eternity took control of Lu Yang's body again, he cheerfully returned to the judge's seats.
"Rest of you still busy, should the competition continue?"
The competition was only halfway done, with several more rounds to go.
The competition proceeded smoothly. From the late-stage Golden Core group, to the early-stage Nascent Soul group... extraordinary cultivators emerged, not because their strengths were shocking, but because their strategies were.
The Luoshui Guards and the Immortal Sect were covertly observing those who entered the stage, identifying who might be ancient cultivators restarting their cultivation, who might be the Great Power playing the pig to eat the tiger, and who might have other tricks up their sleeve, like Kong Hao who has sealed the old Taozhu inside himself.
Fairy Eternity and the Immortal Sect leader were also discussing suspicious cultivators.
As the competition reached its climax and the list of finalists came out, the remaining tasks were handed over to the imperial court for investigation regarding the participants' histories.
After ten days of exciting competition, the event ended, and the Seek Dao Sect's celebrations came to an end too.
"Finally, it's over."
Lu Yang sighed in relief. Throughout the celebration, he had been on his feet with no help from Fairy Eternity.
"Second-in-command, great job!" Fairy Eternity did not hesitate to verbally praise him.
Lu Yang did not dare take all the credit and hurriedly responded humbly, "Thanks to the Fairy's effective use of her people, everyone worked their utmost."
"Sect Master Lu, when you come to the Imperial City, you must visit my residence. I shall host you generously!"
The crown prince recognized that Lu Yang was a talent, a potential significant assistant for the future seize of power in the throne.
Not to mention, Sect Master Lu was able to affectionately call Yun Zhi as "Miss Yun". He dared not think too deeply about this relationship.
...
As the celebration came to an end, the final division of spoils was underway.
Surrounded by the crowd, Luo Hongxia took out a securely wrapped treasure box.
"Handle it gently, don't damage the box."
"...This is a treasured artifact of my Fairy Palace, not your vanity case."
Luo Hongxia activated the box, and it emitted beams of light, absorbing everyone present.
Inside the box, the cultivators of Great Yu were still desperately smashing against the barrier. Their Transcendance Tribulation Stage joint attack was earth-shattering, yet it did nothing against the box, which had been sealed by Yun Zhi's single drop of blood.
"Everyone, don't be afraid. The Imperial Teacher is still outside, maybe they are fighting right now. The Imperial Teacher will come to rescue us!" The black and white Venerable tried to boost everyone's spirits.
He was calculating the time. The celebration was about to end, it was a good chance for the Imperial Teacher to make a move.
"See, the seal is open." Black and white Venerable pointed at the light not far away, and shouted joyfully. This gave the cultivators of Great Yu a glimmer of hope.
But to their surprise, once the seal was released, they were surrounded by Great Xia cultivators falling like dumplings.
"My Lockheart Sect made a great effort in capturing them, and should be granted a Great Yu cultivator!"
"Hey, hey, hey, Old Li, didn't you forget that during the competition you lost all the Great Yu cultivators to my Broken Void Sect?"
"Mind your words, gambling is illegal. Who gambled with you?"
"...Do you have any shame?"
"May I suggest, everyone, let's sit down and discuss how to distribute the Great Yu cultivators." As a newly advanced Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator, Lu Baqian voluntarily stepped forward to manage the situation.
These matters affected everyone's interests, causing a constant debate leading to heated arguments. It was fortunate that Lu Baqian stepped up as he managed to divert their attention.
The crowd together dealt with Lu Baqian, which gave an opportunity for the One Qi Venerable to step in and manage the situation.
Listening to their discussion bored Lu Yang to yawning. He did not care about the final decision. All he knew was that the strongest cultivator in Great Yu, the black and white Venerable, was given to the Seek Dao Sect.
As for the rest, he left them to continue the discussion.
"Oh right Venerable, how have you decided to deal with Taozhu?" Before leaving the treasure box, Lu Yang asked the One Qi Venerable.
His identity at that time was Young Master Lu, and it was inappropriate for him to be concerned about Kong Hao's situation.
"This young man Kong Hao wants to continue sealing the old Taozhu, hoping to live peacefully together. He believes that he will eventually win Taozhu over and become friends."
"Alright, that's one way to go about it." Lu Yang was somewhat worried about Kong Hao.
Taozhu was not like Fairy Eternity. Fairy Eternity was a loving and harmless beauty adored by all, she would never harm her own. Taozhu on the other hand, was a cunning old demon and could scheme against Kong Hao at any given time.
But after all, it was Kong Hao's own decision and Lu Yang should not interfere.
The eldest Senior Sister then exited the treasure box with Lu Yang, bringing along the unconscious black and white Venerable.
"Speaking of, where has the Imperial Teacher gone?"
Once out of the box, Lu Yang remembered that the Imperial Teacher was absent from the beginning to the end. Even the Eldest Senior Sister could not find him.
He thought the Imperial Teacher would make some trouble at the end of the celebration. So he kept a watchful eye for a long time, but nothing happened.
"Strange, could he have sensed something amiss and made a run for it?" Lu Yang thought to himself, realizing that dealing with the Imperial Teacher was not an easy task.
"Huh? It's the barbecue shop?" Lu Yang lifted his head to see that they had arrived at the barbecue shop. Master Liu and Master Gao were cleaning the grill. The three 'ghosts', Xiao Wu, Xiao Liu, Xiao Qi, were cleaning the bowls and chopsticks. The restaurant owner was sweeping and mopping the floor, as though they were getting ready to close.
He originally wanted to get a bite to eat. But seeing the restaurant in such a state, he thought it best not to bother them to reopen.
"Lu Yang is here, please come in." The restaurant owner greeted Lu Yang warmly.
In the Seek Dao Sect, Lu Yang was their pillar of support.
Why was he so friendly towards Lu Yang, was it because he was the junior brother of Yun Zhi? But it felt like there was another reason.
Who was it again who reminded him to be very polite to Lu Yang, even more polite than he usually was?
Who mentioned this to him?
Seeing the restaurant owner in a daze, Lu Yang asked curiously, "Is something wrong?"
The restaurant owner came back to his senses, realizing his rudeness, "Oh, nothing. Please take a seat."
Looking around, Lu Yang felt someone was missing, "Where's the Immortal Eternity? Is he at the breeding base?"
"Who?"

chapters.title: Chapter 503 - 502: The Disappearance of the Immortal Eternity_1
chapters.content:
Upon seeing the Sect Master's puzzled look, Lu Yang felt even more confused.
"Immortal Eternity, the belief of your Eternity Sect, is called Sha Meless."
The Master furrowed his brow: "Immortal Eternity is indeed our faith, but judging from what you're saying, he's with us?"
"Of course, after your Eternity Sect resurrected Immortal Eternity, he only had a soul without a body, so he needed to find a suitable body. You then called upon all the Foundation Establishment cultivators of the Eternity Sect for a competition. I emerged as the winner and under your guidance, met Immortal Eternity."
"Afterwards, Immortal Eternity was beaten up in my Spiritual Space. Eldest Senior Sister also contacted the court and eliminated your Eternity Sect altogether, turning all of you into ghouls."
As Lu Yang continued, the Master's brows furrowed even more. Lu Yang wouldn't lie about such matters, so was the problem with his memory or theirs?
The Master ordered Master Liu, Master Gao, and others to verify if Immortal Eternity had manifested.
From the two grilling masters to the three beautiful ghouls, all denied having seen Immortal Eternity.
"In my memory, the initial call for a competition amongst all the Foundation Establishment members of the Eternity Sect was to select promising young talents as reserves for the Eternity Sect's leadership. You indeed won that competition, but just as I was going to award you, the court broke in and arrested us all.
Shortly thereafter, we were all turned into ghouls by Master Yun Zhi to repay our sins in this place."
"At no point during this process did Immortal Eternity appear."
"Then why have you always urged me to expand and strengthen the grill shop, to open a chain of stores across the entire continent? Wasn't this goal set by Immortal Eternity?"
The Master denied again: "Not at all. I feel it's better to strive for a purpose than to drift aimlessly through life. So I asked for your help, Lu Yang, in expanding the grill shop. You then found the Nine Nether Sect to help us open franchises."
Lu Yang thought of another piece of evidence to confirm Immortal Eternity's existence: "What about your statue of Immortal Eternity? It used to be so unclear that one couldn't even distinguish the gender. But after Immortal Eternity appeared, you replaced all the statues with his authentic appearance, and even added a copy of 'Criminal Law' in the statue's hand."
"That's not it. One day, when I secluded myself for meditation, I saw Immortal Eternity approaching me in a dream. He held a copy of 'Criminal Law' and spoke to me kindly, saying that we were doing well and he would posthaste be truly reborn. After I woke up, I recognized this as a divine prophecy and promptly replaced the statues."
"But before that day came, our Eternity Sect was raided by both the Seek Dao Sect and the court."
Immortal Eternity often appeared in the grill shop. Everyone on the shopping street knew him, they just didn't know he was Immortal Eternity. Lu Yang inquired around other shops, but they also had no memory of Immortal Eternity.
Lu Yang even asked a few Senior Brothers and Sisters passing by, who were regular customers of the grill shop, but none of them had seen Immortal Eternity.
"Could there really be no Immortal Eternity?" After questioning around, Lu Yang began to doubt whether his memory had been distorted, or a false memory had been planted in his mind.
"Fairy, wake up, something's happened." Lu Yang shook Fairy Eternity, who was fast asleep.
After the festival, Fairy Eternity claimed exhaustion and overuse of her mind as excuses and fell into a deep sleep within the spiritual space.
Lu Yang didn't understand what could have tired her out, as she was simply sitting on the platform and had only joined him for one charade.
"What's the matter~" Fairy Eternity mumbled when she heard the calls, dragging out the last syllable.
With great effort, she cracked open her eyes to look at Lu Yang before turning back and falling asleep again.
"Let this Sect Leader sleep for a while more..." She said and then closed her eyes.
"Immortal Eternity is missing."
"What? The third in command is missing?"
Fairy Eternity sat up abruptly. In their lineage of Eternity, there were three people. She was the first in Command while Lu Yang was the second, and third was Immortal Eternity. The average cultivation level amongst them was of a Semi-Immortal, incomparably strong. But now, with Immortal Eternity gone...
It seemed the average cultivation level was still that of a Semi-Immortal?
It seems like the third in command wasn't that important after all.
"But that's not right, how did he just disappear all of a sudden?"
The reaction of Fairy Eternity actually relieved Lu Yang. It seemed like it wasn't his memory that had a problem, but rather everyone else's memory of Immortal Eternity had been erased and replaced with new memories.
Lu Yang detailed the current findings of his investigation to Fairy Eternity.
"Hmm, interesting. It sounds like a causality spell was cast, but that doesn't mean much to me, and since you're under my protection, you weren't affected."
"Causality magic?" Causality was profound and with his current realm, Lu Yang did not need to understand such things.
"Once a person is born, no, actually right from the womb, from when the soul is formed, he forms a connection with the world."
To explain it better, Fairy Eternity conjured up a piece of white paper and drew a circle on it.
"This circle represents you when you were just born."
She drew another circle not so far from it.
"This is someone else."
She connected the two circles with a line.
"After you're born, others see you, you form a causality with them. Similarly, you see them, and causality is formed between you two."
"You are strangers, so the causality is light. He looks at you once and soon forgets you, and you two would have no more causality."
"Let's say when you were born, you were extraordinarily powerful and ended up breaking his leg. He will definitely not forget you, and hence the causality between you will be deepened."
As she spoke, she thickened and darkened the line that connected the two circles. It was now very prominent.
"As you grow older, the people you come into contact with increases, and so the causality with the world also increases."
"Your playmates from childhood, the peers and elders you came into contact with after joining Seek Dao Sect are all the existences that have a close causality with you."
"Some cultivators choose to live as hermits because they develop too many causalities in the mortal world, which are unfavorable for cultivation."
"When everyone forgets your existence, the causality between you and others ceases to exist. That's the situation the third rank is facing currently."
Lu Yang hadn't noticed it before, but now he realized that ever since Immortal Eternity was reborn, he only had a limited circle of contact.
Upon his birth, he had come into contact with the upper ranks of Eternity Sect. He then met Lu Yang, Fairy Eternity, and the Eldest Senior Sister. Later he came to Seek Dao Sect and met the people on the shopping street and the disciples from Seek Dao Sect.
As long as the traces of these contacts were severed and causality was cut off, everyone would forget about him or get their memories replaced. Then, this person would lose all connection to the world.
"Of course, considering the cultivation level of the third in command and how everyone has cleanly forgotten him, causality spells as I know them wouldn't do that. Maybe in your era, they've researched stronger causality spells, or someone must have reaped a Dao Fruit related to causality."

chapters.title: Chapter 504 - 503: The Imperial Teacher Who Was Bombed for 10 Days_1
chapters.content:
"Does too much causality really affect cultivation?"
"Hard to say. I don't think so, but others might." Fairy Eternity shrugged, her views were often divergent from the general consensus.
"You remember the trait of the immortals as forgetting, don't you? Don't you think it has some similarities with the present context?"
Reminded by Fairy Eternity, Lu Yang realized that indeed it was so. In a way, an Immortal's trait seemed as though a manifestation of cutting off causality.
"The trait of the Immortals... is there to sever causality?"
"You got it right. Yingtian Immortal and the others believe that by severing all causality, one's cultivation level can advance further. However, I do not think so. I believe the more causality there is, the higher one's cultivation level will be."
"Advance further?"
Lu Yang seemed to have heard something incredible: "Can Immortals advance even further?"
"We used five Dao fruits for the calculation; theoretically, it is feasible. However, no one has succeeded, and no one knows whether it's possible to take another step forward. Jiuchong Immortal was the first to become an Immortal, and at least none of us five had succeeded. Before that, no one else did, either."
"The trait of the Immortals is actually a term used by Yingtian Immortal and the others. They were the first four to become immortals, and when they condensed their Dao fruits, they chose to forget on their Dao fruit's features. Without my approval, they named this feature as the 'Immortal's trait.'"
"I was the last to attain immortality and I didn't choose to forget when it happened, so I don't have the Immortal's trait."
"So, the Immortal's trait is not a necessity for an Immortal, but rather the result of the individual Immortal's choice?"
"Right. Take the Immortal who holds the State Destiny, for example, he also chose the trait of forgetting."
"But isn't his Dao fruit related to the State Destiny and Great Xia? The causality on him is so profound, unparalleled. Why would he choose this path?"
"It's simple. He wants to advance further and when the time comes, he just has to replace the subject of the cause and effect."
"Didn't you just mention the origin of the third leader's statue? Originally, it was solid evidence of the third leader's existence, causality was formed between the third leader and his statue. Now, this has been altered to the Master having dreamt about it, creating causality between the Master and the third leader's statue."
"The third leader set the goal to expand and strengthen his barbeque store. All actions by the store were conducted in line with this goal, causing causality between the third leader and all subsequent actions. Now, this has been altered to a goal set by the Master, meaning the Master now bears all the causality of these actions."
"This is a demonstration of changing the bearing subject of the causality. Substitution is also a form of forgetting."
Lu Yang vaguely grasped a clue, but Fairy Eternity said too much. It seemed like there were many clues, but he didn't know where to begin.
"Alright, let's not talk about this anymore. Let's save the third leader first."
"How do we save him?" Lu Yang was puzzled. He hadn't even found any traces of the Immortal Eternity yet.
Fairy Eternity, hands on hips, directed Lu Yang: "Call Miss Yun over here. Since when does the Sect Leader do the work instead of the subordinates?"
Under the coercion of the Acting Sect Leader's despotic power, Lu Yang had to go to Captive Peak to find Eldest Senior Sister.
Eldest Senior Sister was interrogating the Black and White Eminent at Captive Peak.
When Lu Yang arrived at Captive Peak, Eldest Senior Sister was whipping the Black and White Eminent, who seemed like an old man, but had a firm physique. Even though pained and shouting, he did not die from the whipping.
"Junior Brother, is there anything you need?"
Eldest Senior Sister paused, her whip created a hollow sound as it swung in the air, she folded it into three parts and held it in her hand with practiced ease.
"The thing is..."
Lu Yang explained what he had discovered, as well as Fairy Eternity's inference.
The Black and White Eminent listened from the side, unpleasantly surprised. He'd secretly researched for his whole life without being able to figure out what the Imperial Teacher's Dao Fruit Outline was. How could the other party ascertain it so easily?
From their words, does the Seek Dao Sect also have a Semi-Immortal? And the Imperial Teacher is fighting with him?
And why does Lu Yang, their target for this operation—who's only at the Golden Core Stage—know these things?
What on earth is the Seek Dao Sect?
"Senior, please come out."
Eldest Senior Sister asked Fairy Eternity to appear without any expression on her face. Fairy Eternity seemed like a child who had done something wrong, cowering upon seeing Eldest Senior Sister.
But she quickly reconsidered. She's the Acting Sect Leader, what does she have to fear?
Eldest Senior Sister looked calmly at the downcast Fairy Eternity: "I believe I should have told you before. Lu Yang is still young and his cultivation level is not high enough. The affairs of Immortals and Dao fruits are too distant from him. You shouldn't talk about these things too much, in case he becomes overambitious and it affects his cultivation. This time, you've said too much."
"I was wrong." Fairy Eternity, as the Acting Sect Leader, readily admitted her mistake when she was in the wrong.
"I wonder how you intend to find the Immortal Eternity who has had his causality erased?"
Eldest Senior Sister naturally remembered the existence of the Immortal Eternity too.
"Hehe, it's not easy for others to find him, but it's easy to find the third leader."
Fairy Eternity gave a proud smile, a testament to the pride she had in her own Dao fruit. She instructed Lu Yang to take out the statue of Immortal Eternity that he had gotten from the barbecue shop, then she recited the third leader's title and name.
"Immortal Eternity Sha Meless."
...
In the temporarily constructed space, two figures were panting heavily.
"You're really tough to deal with. What on earth is your Dao Fruit Outline?" Immortal Eternity possessed all the memories of the Eternity Sect's followers. His memory was vast, but he knew nothing about combat of this level. Even till now, he couldn't figure out the Imperial Teacher's Dao Fruit Outline.
After ten long days of self-destruction, even with the Eternity Dao Fruit Outline, he still couldn't hang in there.
If it was the complete Eternity Dao Fruit, no matter how many times he self-destructed, it would be fine. Unfortunately, the Eternity Dao Fruit Outline of Immortal Eternity had only been condensed half a year ago. It was still far from the complete Eternity Dao Fruit.
Being able to fight with the Imperial Teacher who had been condensing the Causality Dao Fruit Outline for ten thousand years and resist to this extent, was impressive enough.
Though Immortal Eternity was in a sorry state, the Imperial Teacher was in an even worse state. He couldn't count how many times he had been exploded in ten days. Not one part of him was unscathed.
He had encountered stronger opponents before, but this was the first time he'd met such a tenacious opponent.
He had thought about fleeing halfway through, but once he vanished and wiped out the causality, the other party would self-destruct, causing the space to become unstable and preventing him from opening even a single rift.
"What luck! I directly ran into the true defender of the Seek Dao Sect!" Even the Imperial Teacher with his good temper couldn't help but swear under such circumstances.
"True defender? I've only been at the Seek Dao Sect for half a year."
"Half a year? You, as a Semi-Immortal, hid in such a small place? What's so worthwhile here that made you stay? I admit I was wrong. I shouldn't have attacked you. How about this, since we didn't know each other before the fight, if you have nowhere to go, you can come to Great Yu.
I can help you restore your flesh!"
The Imperial Teacher thought that the other party was staying here in order to restore his flesh. There was no need for them to fight to the death. They could collaborate.
Immortal Eternity looked at the Imperial Teacher with suspicion, feeling that the man seemed cunning: "I'm a prisoner. You're even inciting me to escape?"
"A prisoner?"
The Imperial Teacher was horrified. Who could imprison a Semi-Immortal?
Suddenly, Immortal Eternity was startled, a small smile lighting up his face. He had sensed the call from the head leader.
Taking advantage of the Imperial Teacher's momentary stupor, Immortal Eternity struck quickly, locking the Imperial Teacher in a firm grip.
The Imperial Teacher knew instantly that he was screwed. He had allowed him to get a chance for a close-range self-destruction!
In the past, when Immortal Eternity self-destructed, he relied on the Causality Dao Fruit Outline and distanced himself as far as possible.
If he had been exploded by a close-range detonation a few times, he would've been blown to death already.
Unexpectedly, Immortal Eternity did not choose to self-destruct. Instead, a spatial gateway appeared behind him. He backed into it, clutching the Imperial Teacher.
Thud.
The two Semi-Immortal powerhouses both tumbled into Captive Peak.
The Imperial Teacher looked bewilderedly at Eldest Senior Sister with her icy demeanor and Fairy Eternity who was grinning mischievously.

chapters.title: Chapter 505 - 504 Us Three_1
chapters.content:
The Imperial Teacher was confounded. The temporary space he had created with Immortal Eternality was entirely his work, and aside from him, the host of the space, no one else should be able to trigger its opening for escape.
Yet, the present circumstance was such that Immortal Eternality had managed to take him away from the space without his permission.
An ability associated with the Dao Fruit in its preliminary form?
That was the only explanation he could draw upon for now.
The twin-entity of black and white was somewhat bewildered; the abrupt appearance of the individual before it bore resemblances to the Imperial Teacher, yet his bruised and battered face betrayed vast differences from the Imperial Teacher it held in its memory.
Upon setting eyes on the triad of Lu Yang, Fairy Eternality, and Eldest Senior Sister, Immortal Eternality felt an odd sense of familiarity surge within him, a sense so potent that it sent aching sensations through his soul.
But he quickly recalled, he was one of their own now; the unfortunate recipient of the beating was the Imperial Teacher.
"Eldest Sister, Second-in-command, you finally came to my rescue!"
As he sobbed and wept, Immortal Eternality felt the past ten days had been a sheer ordeal of utmost torment. Being forced to daily assault the Imperial Teacher had taken a toll on him; his nascent Eternity Dao Fruit withered and faded, his soul dimmed considerably, and his overall vitality seemed incapable of recovery.
Theoretically, as soon as the Master and the rest discovered his disappearance, if they were to invoke his honorary titles and real names upon the statue, then he should have been able to escape the temporary space.
He had ardently waited for an entire ten days, yet received no hailings from the Master or anyone else.
He postulated, if the Imperial Teacher had been able to make him forget the Imperial Teacher, there was a good chance he could make the Master and others forget him too.
"Look at you, embarrassing yourself. You couldn't even win after ten days." Fairy Eternality disdainfully eyed the weeping third-in-command. She commanded him to stop three steps away from her.
Fairy Eternality casually flicked her wrist. As if revived, the third-in-command's dimmed soul lit up and recovered its original glow.
The shriveled nascent Eternity Dao Fruit also started to emit some energy.
"Go back and practice diligently. Surely, the Dao Fruit of this immortal has more usefulness than just for self-explosion. "
Fairy Eternality, well-versed in self-detonation, could easily surmise from the appalling state of the third-in-command and Imperial Teacher, that this must have been due to the third-in-command's continuous self-explosions.
"Yes!"
"That's more like it. Now, get behind us."
The third-in-command slunk behind Eldest Sister and the Second-in-command shamefacedly.
Behind Fairy Eternality and Lu Yang was the twin-entity of black and white, bound to a pillar.
"Brother, what did you do to get beaten up this badly?" asked Immortal Eternality curiously, appearing all too interested in the gossip. Now he seemed to overflow with unspent energy.
The twin-entity of black and white could only stare back, lost for words.
The Imperial Teacher's eyes flashed like those of a hawk upon hearing Immortal Eternality address Lu Yang and Fairy Eternality as "Eldest Sister" and "Second-in-command".
Did this mean that among the three from Eternality Sect, he was ranked third?
The person they had targeted on this mission, Lu Yang, was second?
The knots within the Eternality Sect felt dreadfully interwoven and deep to him. He surmised that this place wasn't safe to stay any longer and he needed to plot his escape swiftly.
If dealing with the third-in-command was already arduous, how could he stand a chance against Eldest Sister and the Second-in-command, who were both present there? Would he even manage to survive if things escalated?
Decisiveness was inherent to him; without batting an eyelid, he activated his nascent Causality Dao Fruit erasing any traces of his presence.
The place was teeming with others; there was no way the other party would engage in unrestrained self-explosion, leading to harm innocent bystanders!
A faint smile appeared around his mouth. He strolled nonchalantly past Fairy Eternality; even though their scheme against Seek Dao Sect had botched, as long as he remained alive, his Master remained alive, and there would be a chance for Great Yu to be restored!
Smack—
Fairy Eternality watched the Imperial Teacher stride arrogantly past her, grinning like a lunatic. It was as though he didn't hold her even worth his glance.
Subconsciously, she reached out and slapped him across his face.
With a whirl, the Imperial Teacher landed face down on the ground.
"Has the Imperial Teacher lost his mind?" Fairy Eternality felt puzzled. Even if one were to flee, no one would do so in such a manner.
Is this the level of strategy that the Imperial Teacher, who was praised by the cultivators of Great Yu as unparalleled in intelligence and insight, possesses?
In comparison, she truly is much smarter.
"He must be a fool." Lu Yang nodded in agreement, thinking that whoever made a plan to infiltrate the Seek Dao Sect can't be that intelligent.
The Imperial Teacher lay on the ground, stunned. How could this be? He had already initialized the Causality Dao Fruit, so how could he get caught?
Unless...
'Immortal?!'
The Imperial Teacher widened his eyes, finally realizing the seriousness of the issue. Is the head of the Eternity legacy an Immortal?!
This has to be a joke. Throughout history, which Immortal has ever been given the title of 'Eternity'?
'Soul-breaking Needle!'
The Imperial Teacher took out his last Soul-breaking Needle. This needle once fragmented the soul of an Immortal Eternity!
He aimed at Fairy Eternity, the needle shot out with such speed it became invisible, and even had an "amnesia" attribute attached.
Fairy Eternity reached out with two fingers, casually catching the Soul-breaking Needle, examining it curiously: "What is this? Oh, it's an Immortal Treasure that can fragment souls, pretty innovative design. Let's try its power."
She casually pricked herself out of curiosity, theSoul-breaking Needle shattered, yet she remained unharmed.
'What? Just that?'
Fairy Eternity scoffed. This kind of tool might work on Semi-Immortals, but it's useless against an Immortal with such a powerful soul as hers.
The manifestation that he had been so proud of, the Soul-breaking Needle, didn't even slightly affect her!
You need to know, even his master, the first Imperial Teacher, wouldn't want to be poked with it!
He closed his eyes slowly, wrestling fiercely within his heart. When he opened them again, his eyes were wild, like those of a madman: 'Immortal, don't think that you've won just because I'm in your hands. Today, I will show you that a Semi-Immortal with over ten thousand years of cultivation isn't so easy to deal with. Even if I have to risk my life, I will tear off a piece of your soul!'
'I sacrifice my life to Great Yu!'
Blood flowed from the Imperial Teacher's seven orifices, using his lifespan as a sacrifice for a temporary outburst. This is also an effect of the Causality Dao Fruit.
Causality also means equivalent exchange.
A Semi-Immortal's lifespan is at least hundreds of thousands of years. The Imperial Teacher felt his lifespan rapidly decreasing, moving him closer to his final day, but his body grew stronger. If he had to fight the Immortal Eternity again, he was confident that he could capture her even if he had to explode himself!
It's a pity that this move can't be taken back once used. After the outburst, he would only have a few years of lifespan left.
The space trembled, spiritual energy scattered, and the soul felt pierced like it was stabbed with a needle. An overwhelming fear, from an unknown source, occupied their hearts.
Both Immortal Eternity and the two black and white dignitaries blanched, their hearts pumping with fear, feeling a lethal threat from this move!
'You forced me into this, now feel my ultimate move...'
Bang.
Eldest Senior Sister saw that the Imperial Teacher was continuously gathering power, and kicked him, knocking him to the ground.
The gathered energy from before was wasted, dispersing.
The lifespan that was sacrificed also returned to the world and cannot be taken back.
'How could this be? It's impossible for this move to be interrupted!'
The Imperial Teacher shouted, his face full of disbelief. Each of his decisions during his journey to the Seek Dao Sect had been unsuccessful, and now even his last-ditch effort was interrupted!
Lu Yang sighed, walking up to the Imperial Teacher. He pointed at himself and said: "Just admit your defeat. With us three here, even if Ying Tian Immortal came, he would have to admit defeat."
The Imperial Teacher took a deep breath, staring at Lu Yang. Since there was no escape or battle possible, he decided to drag him down too.
He activated the Causality Dao Fruit's other ability - Curse.
'I, Jin Buzheng, swear here and now, you will encounter the eight sufferings of birth, old age, sickness, death, failure, resentment, love, separation, and the five yin in your life. You will encounter the seven calamities of fire, water, demons, weapons, ghosts, fetters, and venomous robberies.
You will not be able to advance your cultivation during your lifetime, and after death, your soul will scatter!'

chapters.title: Chapter 506 - 505 Curse Backlash_1
chapters.content:
A curse is a form of manifestation of causality.
When an ordinary person casts a curse, they must pay a corresponding price.
For example, Meng Jingzhou's self-taught curse of singularity requires him to preserve his vital energy until he becomes immortal, which is the price he pays.
The Imperial Teacher, who has grasped the nascent form of the Dao Fruit of Causality, doesn't have to pay the price.
All types of trials and tribulations, this is a concept put forward by Buddhism, encapsulating all the worldly sufferings. Trials and tribulations can be regarded as the highest form of curse. Meng Jingzhou's curse of singularity is unworthy to even be compared to them.
After a series of blows, the Imperial Teacher realized that with Fairy Eternity present and Yun Zhi, who could break his desperate moves, present, it was impossible for him to escape.
Since he can't escape, he might as well pull someone down with him!
Of all his enemies, Lu Yang has the lowest cultivation level, and their main cause for coming to the Seek Dao Sect is Lu Yang.
Every time their plans failed, Lu Yang was involved.
WithType the capture of the Black and White Entity, it meant that other subordinates who infiltrated the Seek Dao Sect were also captured.
A total wipeout!
Rather than saying the Seek Dao Sect prevented the restoration of Great Yu, it would be more accurate to say that Lu Yang, the stumbling block, prevented it!
His being captured doesn't matter. Great Yu had a master and late-stage cultivators from the era of Great Yu, there was always hope for uprising.
Then let's get rid of Lu Yang!
He put the most painful and cruel curse on Lu Yang. It doesn't matter if Lu Yang is at the Golden Core Stage, even if he was at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, it would be a death sentence!
In the eyes of the Imperial Teacher, chains dropped from the sky one after another, assembling with blood and punishment, descending to the mortal world, bringing about the most severe punishment.
These chains represent the curse, they are the embodiment of the curse. Even those who are proficient in causal magic can't see it, only a semi-immortal like the Imperial Teacher, who has studied causality and condensed the nascent form of the Dao Fruit of Causality, can see all of this!
The chains are heavy, making a Dao Sound-like impact and shaking sound.
Dared to get so close to me, now it's too late to regret!
The Imperial Teacher watched with interest the expressions of these people, wanting to see their faces full of regret and sadness, regretting their contempt for him, and feeling sorry for Lu Yang's irreversibility.
He saw Lu Yang's unchanged expression, Fairy Eternity's puzzled face, and Yun Zhi's expressionless face.
But he didn't see the regret and sadness he wanted to see.
As the chains approached Lu Yang, Lu Yang emitted a golden light all over his body, revealing two lines representing causality. Two thick lines wrapped around his body, one connecting with Fairy Eternity and the other with Yun Zhi.
The moment the chains touched Lu Yang, they bounced off instantly and fell on the Imperial Teacher.
The Imperial Teacher watched as the curse backlash and let out a resentful roar: "No!!!"
What's going on with the causality on this kid?
Just two causal lines blocked my proud curse?!
The one who slapped me was an immortal, how could an immortal have such heavy karma with a mortal!
And the other one who interrupted my casting, her connection with Lu Yang also blocked the curse!
Just by the power of causality, it blocked the curse, indicating that the other party is also an immortal!
These two unimaginably beautiful people are both immortals!
What a joke, how could a small sect have two immortals!
The Imperial Teacher had lived for twenty thousand years, and he had never heard of any sect that had two immortals.
Forget about the sect, even their Great Yu dynasty didn't have them.
What on earth is this Seek Dao Sect? The word "a den of dangerous beasts" is not enough to describe its peril.
Even attacking the imperial palace is safer than coming to the Seek Dao Sect.
The Imperial Teacher felt as if there was a fire burning in his heart, making him roll around on the ground, and it was as if a water ball was covering his head, making him like a mortal and suffocating.
The backfire of the curse, the trials of fire and water among the seven trials.
"What's the matter?"
Lu Yang was puzzled. The Imperial Teacher first glared at him fiercely, chanting a lot of words he didn't understand, and then he rolled around on the ground, oscillating between life and death, wailing constantly.
"The curse backfired. He just tried to curse you with all sorts of trials and tribulations, but you have an immortal protecting you. You're not afraid of these curses. As the caster, he fell into the curse."
Fairy Eternity looked at the Imperial Teacher like he was a fool. Sure enough, he wasn't very smart.
The Black and White Entity saw that the Imperial Teacher had exhausted all his trump cards several times, only to be easily resolved, and his heart sank.
The depth of the Seek Dao Sect is unfathomable.
"Eldest Sister, can you protect me too?", the third brother sneakily approached.
Fairy Eternity gave him a glance and waved her hand, "Go away, protect you for what? If you get cursed, just self-explode and the curse will be nearly gone."
The third brother left dejectedly and continued to chat with the Black and White Entity.
"Bro, how were you caught? Are you with this fool rolling on the ground, infiltrating the Seek Dao Sect? Don't you know that the Seek Dao Sect is my Eldest Sister's turf?"
"In the old days, even the Four Immortals of the Ancients didn't dare to easily come to my Eldest Sister's territory. If they did, they would be very cautious, not even daring to take a breath."
The Black and White Entity: "..."
Stop talking, the more you talk, the more I regret.
"Luckily I surrendered to the Seek Dao Sect in advance, otherwise I would have been tortured like you." The third brother was glad he compromised in time when he realized Fairy Eternity was above him, and surrendered on the spot.
"So, are you currently a guest or an elder of the Seek Dao Sect?"
"Prisoner."
The Black and White Entity: "..."
"Anyways, we finally caught all the Great Yu cultivators. It's worth celebrating." Lu Yang clapped his hands. He had been unlucky recently, always encountering Great Yu cultivators whenever he went out. He wouldn't have to worry about this issue now.
"Hehe, thanks to me acting as Sect Master, efficiently managing things." Fairy Eternity put her hands on her hips and took credit, laughing so hard that she couldn't close her mouth.
"Fairy is wise! With Fairy here, what are Great Yu cultivators to worry about!" Lu Yang continued clapping, complimenting nonstop, working tirelessly to flatter Fairy Eternity.
"All caught?" The Black and White Entity heard Lu Yang say this and felt a bad premonition.
Lu Yang turned his head towards the Black and White Entity, giving a sly smile, and casually said, "You know Wu Youdao, the sixth Emperor Yu, right? He's also here, Fairy and I caught him."
"The emperor has been captured by you?!" The Black and White Entity was enraged. After the battle of Hanshui City, Wu Youdao went missing. He thought that Wu Youdao and the others were seriously injured and were hiding somewhere to recover. He never imagined they were captured by the Seek Dao Sect!
This Lu Yang really was the obstacle of their Great Yu!
He originally thought that in Hanshui City, Lu Yang's impact on the plan was just exposing the existence of Huang Ming. To his surprise, even the emperor was captured by Lu Yang.
The Eldest Senior Sister didn't care about the boasting of Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity. She was about to interrogate the Imperial Teacher who was rolling on the ground and wailing in pain.
"I ask, you answer."
"Ahhhhh!"
"How many cultivators does Great Yu have in total?"
"Ahhhhh!"
"Does Great Yu have any backup plans after this failure?"
"Ahhhhh!"
The Imperial Teacher was not unwilling to confess, it was the fact that the curse of all sorts of trials and tribulations was too harsh. The pain was so intense that he couldn't utter a word.
Yun Zhi was a bit helpless. She had interrogated countless people, it was the first time she encountered such a situation.

chapters.title: Chapter 507 - 506: The Imperial Teacher is Probably Beyond Saving _1
chapters.content:
Captive Peak is usually quiet, except for the cries of prisoners echoing in the air.
These cries usually die down quickly when the prisoners confess. Those who refuse meet their end, turned into Spirit Devices.
Today was different. The prisoner was howling non-stop for an hour.
Being a cultivator with high strength, the prisoner did not lose his voice.
"So, what should we do then?"
Lu Yang, Fairy Eternity, and the Eldest Senior Sister all seemed helpless as they watched the Imperial Teacher still wailing.
The Eldest Senior Sister even found him too noisy and set up a soundproof Array Method so he could scream inside it without disturbing others.
Instantly, it became quiet again.
With a shake of his head, Lu Yang expressed regret. He finally caught a key figure from the Great Yu, but he was a tough nut to crack, preferring to be consumed by the curse than revealing any information.
Yun Zhi had tried many ways to remove the curse, but none worked on the Imperial Teacher.
When faced with one of the many difficulties and sufferings, Yun Zhi would simply apply her magic skills. However, this curse encapsulated all kinds of difficulties and sufferings. Moreover, he was unable to further his cultivation level while alive and his soul would scatter upon death.
This was an unprecedented massive curse, and even the Imperial Teacher, who's partially mastered the Causality Dao Fruit, could not break it.
"What if we let Fairy give him Dao Fruit and let him explode several times to break the curse, and then retrieve the Dao Fruit again?"
Those who possess the complete Dao Fruit have absolute control over the Dao Fruit and can freely give or take it away.
Fairy Eternity shook her head, refusing Lu Yang's suggestion, "No, he already has a Dao Fruit within him. A person can't own two Dao Fruits at the same time."
"Even if he didn't have the Causality Dao Fruit, I couldn't give him mine."
"Dao Fruit isn't like clothing- you can't just put it on and off as you like."
"Dao Fruit represents rules. To obtain the Dao Fruit, one must understand the rules it represents. This fool knows nothing about my Eternity Dao Fruit. If I give it to him directly, his soul wouldn't be able to withstand the power of the Eternity Dao Fruit, and he would perish."
The Imperial Teacher's various performances led Fairy Eternity to question his sanity. She feared the seemingly Semi-Immortal was not so in reality.
"Wait a minute, Fairy. Then, I don't understand the Eternity Dao Fruit either. Can you hand me the Eternity Dao Fruit?" Lu Yang remembered how Fairy Eternity insisted on giving him the Eternity Dao Fruit.
Fairy Eternity looked at Lu Yang in astonishment, "Second-in-command, what are you talking about? Under my long-term guidance and subtle influences, your understanding of the Eternity Dao Fruit is way ahead of the third-in-command."
Lu Yang: "..."
What? When did that happen, and why didn't I know about it?
"You think I made you the second-in-command just because we have a good relationship? How could that be? I am fair and impartial. Ranking of the Eternity lineage depends on one's ability!"
\\Hearing about the opportunity to be promoted, the third-in-command hurriedly came over, "I will study the Eternity Dao Fruit with dedication, striving to become the second-in-command!"
Fairy Eternity glanced distastefully at the third-in-command and dismissively said, "Go away! What are you doing here? If you dare to become the second-in-command, I will take away your Dao Fruit."
Watching Lu Yang with envy, the third-in-command slinked away.
"Could the power of State Destiny lift the curse?" Lu Yang remembered how Meng Jingzhou from his sect, who was deeply cursed, managed to break the curse with the power of State Destiny.
Eldest Senior Sister nodded, "That might work."
She snapped her fingers and the Imperial Teacher, who was rolling in pain on the ground, floated and started rolling in the air.
"I will go to the imperial palace. Stay here and wait for me."
If they want to use the power of State Destiny, it would be best to look for it at its source.
Leaving behind these words, the Eldest Senior Sister headed for the palace.
The prisoners held at Captive Peak were all severe criminals. Those who were faint-hearted would tremble just by standing there.
Lu Yang was not afraid though. Both the newcomers and old-timers of Captive Peak knew him.
The newcomers were the ones he brought in, while the old-timers watched as Lu Yang brought the newcomers in.
Ironically, it was the prisoners who were afraid of Lu Yang.
The prisoners of Captive Peak discussed quietly, fearful of being heard by Lu Yang.
They only had their souls left and their powers and Spiritual Sense were sealed. The prisoners had developed their own ways to discuss things without getting caught by Lu Yang.
The cells of Captive Peak were made of refined stone, specifically for sealing souls and could not be destroyed.
The convicts would talk to the iron bars, and the sound would be transmitted by the vibrations of the bars. They would then use their sensitive souls to detect the message.
"Oh my god, did you see that fight? A Semi-Immortal level powerhouse attacked Lu Yang, and he took it without even retaliating, simply falling down."
"This Lu Yang is inscrutable. He appears to be at the Golden Core Stage, but his actual strength must be far beyond that."
"Did you notice, ever since this Lu Yang joined the Seek Dao Sect, more and more people come to Captive Peak. It started with Unification Stage, then Transcendance Tribulation Stage, and now even a Semi-Immortal. Do you think a Golden Core Stage could do this?"
"I have never seen a Semi-Immortal in my life. I didn't expect to see one here."
"Is this the Great Era's war? Even a Semi-Immortal falls and becomes a prisoner."
The prisoners felt more and more uneasy as they discussed among themselves. Lu Yang was becoming more and more inscrutable to them, and they decided not to provoke him by any means.
Lu Yang didn't know what the prisoners were discussing. He continued his conversation with Fairy Eternity on high-end topics during the Eldest Senior Sister's absence.
"Fairy, if Immortals need to sever causality for further progress, then isn't the Imperial Teacher who mastered the Causality Dao Fruit having an advantage?"
"It's not that Immortals need to sever causality for further progress. It's the Yingtian Immortals who believe that this is necessary." Fairy Eternity emphasized.
"Alright, it's the Yingtian Immortals who think so. But if the Imperial Teacher formed the Causality Dao Fruit, he could freely sever causality, couldn't he rise above the Immortals?"
Fairy Eternity shook her head, "Not exactly. When the Imperial Teacher condensed the Causality Dao fruit, he became deeply connected with the concept of 'causality'. When the Causality Dao Fruit is formed, he would be even more tightly connected to it, becoming one."
"Since he's become one with 'causality', how can he sever it?"
