"He must have heard from somewhere how Immortals value causality. That's why he struggled to form the Causality Dao Fruit. Little did he know that he's chosen a wrong path, which is a fundamental mistake."
"There are no shortcuts to becoming an Immortal. It won't work to cut corners."
"That being said, even though there might be realms above Immortals, none of the five of us really cares."
"Why?"
"Because it's unnecessary. We've all become Immortals. We have infinite lifespans and no adversaries. Life is great. Why the need to pursue a higher realm?"
Lu Yang felt the explanation from Fairy Eternity was very reasonable.

chapters.title: Chapter 508 - 507: Late Stage of Golden Core_1
chapters.content:
If it were up to Lu Yang, he reckoned that if he became an Immortal, he might be even more idle than a fairy, basking in the sun all day. He'd bask in the front, then the back, back to the front again, and at night, sleep on the sun.
Within the realm of the Immortal, there are further stages, and even beyond those stages are further stages. When would cultivating ever end?
"Fairy, you once said that replacement is also a form of forgetting. Could your recipe rights being transferred from you to the Yingtian Immortal be just another form of replacement?"
Fairy Eternity's eyes brightened as she patted Lu Yang on the shoulder: "Well, that's a point. Someone could have erased my traces after getting rid of me, and changed all my deeds to Yingtian Immortal's. I just assumed this bastard Yingtian Immortal was jealous of my talent and took advantage of my absence to steal my thunder."
"Such a teachable lad!"
"It's 'teachable child'."
Lu Yang mused to himself that Yingtian Immortal must have brain damage from food poisoning to even think of stealing your recipe rights.
"Among the Four Immortals, does anyone have the ability to erase your existence?"
Fairy Eternity furrowed her brows in thought. She considered all the methods of the Four Immortals but couldn't find a corresponding one. "No, none of them can do it."
Man and fairy discussed for a while, but they didn't come up with any more useful information.
It wasn't necessarily Yingtian Immortal who killed the fairy. Maybe the Qilin Immortal also had a share in the fairy's recipe rights.
Immortal belongings were rare to begin with, but Fairy Eternity's possessions were even scarcer.
Unless they could find the heritage Fairy Eternity had mentioned that was buried in the North Star. Surely the heritage would state who the item belonged to and they could draw conclusions from there.
Just as the two were chatting about what Acting Sect Master would do after retirement, Eldest Senior Sister returned with the Imperial Teacher.
Although no sound could be heard, looking at the distorted face and heart-wrenching expressions of the Imperial Teacher, he probably still hadn't lifted the curse.
"Eldest Senior Sister, can the power of State Destiny lift the curse?"
"It can, but Emperor Xia is not willing to lift it." Eldest Senior Sister casually threw the Imperial Teacher to one side.
"Why? Didn't Old Meng and Sect Leader Qiu have their curses lifted?" Lu Yang was confused.
"To be precise, it's not that the curse has been lifted, but rather, it has been shared."
"Shared?"
"With the power of State Destiny, the curse can be spread to everyone. After spreading, everyone will marry a quarter of an hour later than originally planned, which is an acceptable level of spreading."
"But the curse of the Imperial Teacher is too severe. Once spread to everyone, the consequences would be unthinkable."
Lu Yang then understood why Emperor Xia was unwilling to lift the seal for the Imperial Teacher. If it were him, he wouldn't be willing to do it either.
"So now…" Lu Yang glanced at the Imperial Teacher who was persevering and rolling around.
"Let him scream for now, we'll think about solutions later."
"Alright."
Nothing could be done anyway, as they couldn't extract anything from the Imperial Teacher's soul due to his current state of suffering, with his thoughts in disarray.
If they wanted to refine him directly into a Spirit Device, let alone that Fifth Elder couldn't refine a Semi-Immortal grade Immortal Treasure, even if they could, the Imperial Teacher's state would only produce a cursed Immortal Treasure, greatly reducing its effectiveness.
"The Yin Energy is too strong at Captive Peak, it's not good to stay here for a long time. You should go back first."
Yun Zhi also said to Fairy Eternity: "Senior, your performance as Acting Sect Master this time was good, I'm satisfied."
Fairy Eternity touched her nose, somewhat elated: "Just a petty sect. With my talent, I could even be an emperor. Wait till I catch a few more Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivators, I will continue being Acting Sect Master."
"I am going to the base where the Black-White Venerables have set up. They said there is a Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivator in a slumber, and only the Imperial Teacher knows where he sleeps. I'll see if we can find any related clues in the base."
Eldest Senior Sister asked the two to leave first, and once they had left, she called out Grandmaster who was suppressing Captive Peak.
"Grandmaster, this is Jin Buzheng, the second Imperial Teacher of Great Yu. Keep him here for now. When you side, be careful. He has formed a Dao Fruit, which should be a Dao Fruit of Causality."
In the past, Grandmaster felt that being a Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivator, suppressing Captive Peak, was more than enough and he was also contributing to the sect after retirement.
Now he felt he had greatly overestimated himself. The task of suppressing Captive Peak was too difficult for him.
"Don't worry Grandmaster, he is deeply trapped in countless difficulties and cannot extricate himself. He finds it hard to even protect himself let alone escape."
Fearing that the Grandmaster still wasn't at ease, Yun Zhi laid an Array Method in the cell where the Imperial Teacher was held.
Immediately after, she went to the Secret Realm where the Imperial Teacher and others were hiding.
After leaving Captive Peak, Lu Yang felt a lot lighter.
The celebration ended successfully, the reputation of the Heaven's Court was established, the Imperial Teacher of Great Yu and his group were caught, and Fairy's two-month Sect Master experience voucher expired.
Time to start cultivating!
...
Three months passed.
Lu Yang sat cross-legged, the two swords Qingfeng and Mingyue hovered on either side of him, emitting a faint Sword Qi.
The Invincible Elixir slowly rotated, continuously absorbing the spiritual essence from the outside world. The Dantian produced a cyclone of spiritual essence, which revolved faster and faster.
He brought his two fingers together, pointing to the sky, and exclaimed in a soft voice: "Break!"
With this move, Lu Yang's energy leaked out, like a mountain torrent erupting, irresistible.
The two swords, Qingfeng and Mingyue, collided, their Sword Qi entwined, leaving traces on the grass.
The Sword Qi was even sharper and formidable than before.
"I've reached the late stage of the Golden Core."
Two years in the sect, late stage Golden Core.
Lu Yang smiled and got up, feeling the changes within him. Now, even if he faced his past self from three months ago, he could easily defeat him.
For the past three months, he had focused on cultivation, never once leaving the sect, even when Meng Jingzhou asked him out.
After the celebration, he was in the limelight. All over the world, people knew about Lu Yang of the Seek Dao Sect, the number one in the mid-stage Golden Core who fought against the junior sect leader of Heaven's Court to a standstill.
Someone even proposed a marriage match, completely ignoring the fact that he was Daoist Buyu's disciple, which showed how determined they were.
One more reason Lu Yang refused to leave was because if he encountered Transcendence Tribulation Stage people again outside, wouldn't Fairy have to be Acting Sect Master again?
The process of scavenging the relics of Great Yu cultivators was proceeding in an orderly manner. Eldest Senior Sister went to the base and brought back all the valuable things.
Then, the various sects began to explore according to the locations of the treasures mentioned by the Great Yu cultivators. Two or three sects who were allocated to the same Great Yu cultivator would jointly send people to explore.
The Seek Dao Sect sent the Grand Elder to lead a team to excavate the treasure mentioned by the Black-White Venerables.
The Black-White Venerables, being Transcendence Tribulation Stage powerhouses, had so many good things that Lu Yang was dazzled when he looked at them.
A few days ago, Lu Yang received a message that the Imperial Teacher of Great Yu, after enduring all kinds of difficulties for three months, finally tormented himself to death. His soul was shattered, and the scene was terribly tragic.

chapters.title: Chapter 509 - 508: Theoretically, I Am At the Nascent Soul Stage Now_1
chapters.content:
"Congratulations! Congratulations! You've finally reached the Late Golden Core Stage." Fairy Eternity clapped her hands with a wide smile on her face.
"The speed of your cultivation is quite decent, just a bit slower than mine. I presume you're about as fast as Immortal Jiuchong and Qilin Immortal."
Although the speed of cultivation isn't the most crucial factor for achieving immortality, it embodies one's potential to become an immortal.
"Seeing you so diligently cultivating makes me think of Immortal Jiuchong and others who are constantly in a rush, savoring every minute and second like their buttocks were on fire. They're indeed diligent."
Lu Yang nodded. Competition was fierce in ancient times. If you were slower, you were behind in all aspects. Immortal Jiuchong and others' fervent cultivation was simply a reflection of the intense competition of that era.
On the contrary, now, although it is said that a great era is coming and talents are emerging with the spirit of ancient times, the zeal for cultivation is not as intense as in ancient times. People like Meng Jingzhou who are idling their days away, doing tasks outside, wasting time and delaying cultivation are despised.
"Sadly, no matter how diligent they are, their cultivation speed is not as fast as mine. They get defeated by me in cross-realm battles every time."
"Having said that, each time they escaped, their speed improved a bit. There were several instances when I almost didn't manage to keep up."
Lu Yang thought to himself that Immortal Jiuchong and the others were striving every minute and second, probably because they wanted to catch up with you and bear fewer beatings.
"According to my current cultivation speed, I will reach the Nascent Soul Stage in half a year at most," said Lu Yang. Since start, he never encountered a bottleneck. Sword Spirit Root cultivation method suggests, "be like a bamboo breaking through, soaring high," able to break through any obstruction and bottleneck.
"Actually, you can already be considered at the Nascent Soul Stage," said Fairy Eternity nonchalantly.
"Why?"
"What is the symbol of advancing to the Nascent Soul Stage?"
"In Dantian, cultivate a primordial spirit, manifest a baby." This is the definition for the Nascent Soul Stage in the cultivation world and Lu Yang had already memorized it.
Eldest Senior Sister had filled her abdomen with golden cores, chose a golden core to break it to reach the Nascent Stage, while the rest remained in the Golden Core stage. Based on the realm indicator, Eldest Senior Sister at that time was in the Nascent Soul Stage, not in the Golden Core Stage.
"Exactly! Now, I'm in the primordial spirit state. As long as I stay in your Dantian, aren't you in the Nascent Soul Stage?"
"Besides, you are capable of challenging realms above yours as soon as you leave the Seek Dao Sect. You have the true strength of the Nascent Soul Stage."
"You have the mark of the Nascent Soul Stage and also the power of the Nascent Soul Stage. If you're not in the Nascent Soul Stage, then who is?"
Lu Yang: "..."
I don't have a problem with that, but I'm afraid other Nascent Soul Stage cultivators might not agree.
"You don't believe me. When the ancient ancestors explored the cultivation realms, this was indeed the initial Nascent Soul Stage."
"When the ancient ancestors explored to the Golden Core Stage and couldn't find a way out, then one of them refined the primordial spirit of a Demon Beast into his Dantian and gained unparalleled power, sufficient to crush all of the Golden Core Stage. The ancient ancestors named this stage as the Nascent Soul Stage."
"But this kind of Nascent Soul Stage also came with a price. The lifespan was too short and the demon beast's primordial spirit was not compatible with the human body, making it easy to perish."
"Gradually, some people broke their golden cores and found a small person coming out of the golden core. This little person is one's own primordial spirit."
"In this way, there came the current cultivation method of the Nascent Soul Stage."
As initially, the Golden Core Stage was replaced by Demon Core, during the exploration of the Nascent Soul Stage, the human race also relied on the power of the Demon Race.
The method of replacing the Golden Core with the Demon Core still exists today. In the cultivation world, this kind of Golden Core Stage is called Pseudo Pill Stage.
"So that's how it is."
Lu Yang suddenly understood. The fairy had finally narrated, although not useful now, indeed was an authentic ancient secret story.
Suddenly, Lu Yang faintly heard fighting noises coming from a distance.
"This direction...is towards the Sect's gate?"
Lu Yang was surprised. Why would there be fighting at the gate? Is someone attacking the Seek Dao Sect?
Only such blatant attacks were possible for the Imperial Teacher to perform.
"Let's go and check it out," suggested Fairy Eternity excitedly. There were exciting things happening.
As Lu Yang descended the mountain, he ran into Meng Jingzhou, who was also heading to investigate the situation.
"What's going on?"
"I don't know. I'm just there to check it out," replied Meng Jingzhou.
"Together?"
"Alright."
The sound of the battle was intense. Along with the two of them, many Senior Brothers and Sisters were heading towards the gate to check the situation. There was a sea of people.
The closer to the sect gate, the more intense the fighting noises became.
Upon reaching the gate, they found several Unification stage cultivators battling in the sky. They were ruthless and aggressive with no unnecessary movements, perfectly showcasing the grandeur of the Unification stage.
Lu Yang recognized one of the Unification stage cultivators, Daoist Buyu.
"Hey, hey, hey, what's going on here? I just came back to the sect, was it necessary for my enemies to ambush me right at the gate?" Daoist Buyu yelled as he continually rolled and dodged. Although he looked harried, his movements were agile and none of the attacks hit their mark.
"Who has the time to ambush you here? You delivered yourself into our hands!" the other Unification cultivators replied in unison, coordinating their attacks and not giving Daoist Buyu a single chance to breathe.
"Gale blast!"
A hurricane swept across, stirring up countless sand and dust. Even the boulders on the ground were blown into the sky.
The whirlwind sandstorm roared towards Daoist Buyu.
With a sweep of Daoist Buyu's duster, the sandstorm was cut off.
"Then why did you all come to the Seek Dao Sect?"
"Well, originally we planned to propose a marriage to your disciple Lu Yang. But since we ran into you at the gate, we thought, before proposing, why not give you a beating first," said one of the Unification stage cultivator.
The other Unification cultivators nodded in agreement, that's what they also thought.
Lu Yang understood then. His master had finally returned to the sect and had run into a proposing team. Upon seeing Daoist Buyu, the proposing team was instantly furious and joined forces to attack Daoist Buyu.
Well, Lu Yang did not feel like helping his master at all.
The other Senior Brothers and Sisters were also watching the fight, none of them showing any signs of helping. Probably because it was rare to see a Unification stage battle, everyone was immersed in the learning atmosphere and had no spare time to act.
Tao Yaoye, in particular, was the most focused. This was real Unification stage combat, with harsher moves compared to usual duels, extremely suitable for implementation in "Dream Mirage".
Tao Yaoye had showcased the usage of Dream Mirage in the celebration activities, receiving many positive reviews. After the celebration ended, with the sect's support, Tao Yaoye was widely promoting Dream Mirage and had already started on a large scale.
Its target group was mortals and low-tier cultivators. Going by various counts, the ticket price was not high, but the total income was much more than Lu Yang's patent for the Flying Car.
Among the younger generation, Meng Jingzhou had the most spirit stones, followed by Tao Yaoye. Lu Yang was only third.
Man Gu as the adored treasure of the Barbarian Tribe, had a fair amount of pocket money, enough to rank fourth.
Fifth was Li Haoran, but this was temporary. Once he got married to Su Yiren and they had shared property, his wealth ranking would rapidly rise to second.
In the end, Daoist Buyu took advantage of an opening in the attack, turned into a sword light, and flew into the sect. The propose team's Unification cultivators then gave up chasing and left reluctantly.
Daoist Buyu was covered in dust and looked extremely embarrassed as he tried to steady his breathing.
All he did was pass by the sect's gate. Who would have thought that there would be enemies waiting there?
"Master, what kind of grudge do you have with those people?" Lu Yang asked curiously.
"Hard to say."
"Hard to say?"
"I have too many enemies; I can't keep track."

chapters.title: Chapter 510 - 509 Daoist Buyu returns to Sect_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang looked anxiously at the Liaison Cultivators flying away, his eyebrows furrowed in worry.
"What's wrong, can't bear to see them go? Want them to propose?" Meng Jingzhou joked. The procession of those seeking Lu Yang's hand in marriage had been endless since the end of the celebration. Meng Jingzhou had watched this with envy.
Now that Lu Yang was eagerly watching the marriage proposition team fly away, Meng Jingzhou could barely suppress his laughter.
Lu Yang slowly shook his head, revealing his concern. "I worry that if they find out they can meet Master by proposing to me, there'll be even more suitors."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
So that's what you get for asking an extra question!
The fact that a Liaison Cultivator could forget what they had done to offend someone was quite telling.
Lu Yang suspected that given his Master's propensity for making enemies, it wouldn't be surprising if one day he received news of his Master's sudden death out in the world.
To prevent such a mishap, Lu Yang kindly suggested: "Master, have you ever considered writing a will in advance? I fear you may not have time to do so when you're about to die."
Daoist Buyu gave his little disciple a deep look, sensing a certain level of similarity to his second disciple who had refined Yin and Yang Golden Cores.
"Have you met your Second Senior Brother yet?"
"Second Senior Brother? No. Isn't he in the Golden Buddha Kingdom?" Lu Yang was confused as to why his Master was asking this question.
"Never mind then."
Many disciples had come to spectate Daoist Buyu. He had been forced into seclusion for ten years, never appearing in public. Upon Lu Yang's deceptive persuasion, Eldest Senior Sister Attacked Daoist Buyu and compelled him to travel the world to promote Seek Dao Sect through storytelling. Since then, Buyu had never returned to the sect.
The disciples of the previous two generations had only heard of such a sect leader but had never met him.
Even among Lu Yang's peers, only Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had met Daoist Buyu. Tao Yaoye, Man Gu, and Li Haoran hadn't.
"I heard the Sect Leader's back. Let me have a look, let me have a look?"
"Isn't the Sect Leader Yun Zhi?"
"Finally, I get to see the real Sect Leader. When I'm out on missions and people learn I'm from the Seek Dao Sect, they'll always ask me if I'm Daoist Buyu's disciple first before letting me in."
"You guys haven't seen the Sect Leader?"
"Have you?"
"Yes."
"We're from the same generation. Where did you see him?"
"On the wanted poster."
The disciples pushed and shoved to get a glimpse of what the living, breathing Daoist Buyu looked like. If outsiders witnessed this scene, they'll easily mistake it for the disciples expressing their fondness for Daoist Buyu.
"Junior Brother, you're back."
The Grand Elder arrived late, or rather, only showed up after the dust had settled.
Lu Yang was able to arrive at the scene first. Surely, the Grand Elder couldn't be slower than Lu Yang?
The Grand Elder knew the Liaison Cultivators who had attacked Daoist Buyu. When they were inexperienced in finding burial sites, they accidentally dug up the ancestral tombs of others. When the owners sensed the disturbance and thought tomb robbers had struck, they came to investigate.
It was already too late for Daoist Buyu and the Grand Elder to escape, so they hid in the coffin and spent the night with the spirit of the old ancestor.
Once the incident was discovered, the owners searched everywhere for Daoist Buyu.
Since they were in the wrong, the Grand Elder didn't intervene. It was only fair that Daoist Buyu took the beating.
The other elders held back for the same reasons.
The Liaison Cultivators who had attacked Daoist Buyu were numerous and were all individuals Daoist Buyu and the elders had offended together. It wasn't appropriate for them to intervene.
"Passing by the sect, so I thought I'd visit." Daoist Buyu felt nostalgic. It had been a year since he last visited, and the position of the Acting Sect Master had already changed hands four times.
First Yun Zhi was Acting Sect Master, then Lu Yang took over for three days, followed by Yun Zhi again. Lu Yang then resumed the role for two months, and now it was Yun Zhi's turn again as Acting Sect Master.
The frequent change in the Acting Sect Master showed how chaotic the sect management was.
"I thought you had made more enemies and were returning to the sect to seek sanctuary."
Daoist Buyu didn't like this remark. "What are you talking about? When have I ever shirked responsibility and escaped danger?"
The Grand Elder's face darkened as he spoke, "What about the time when you impersonated a woman and wrote love letters to Fourth Elder? He was delirious day and night, giggling like a madman. After the truth was out, you stuffed the unfinished letter into my bedside drawer. What was that about?"
In his youth, the Fourth Elder had a pen pal named Ye Qianqian. They had never met and only communicated through letters. In her letters, Ye Qianqian claimed to have witnessed Fourth Elder's heroic feats of slaying Demon Cultivators and expressed admiration. This led to their correspondence.
As Fourth Elder found Ye Qianqian's words pleasing and her handwriting beautiful, and faintly sensed her admiration for him, he was hooked pretty quickly.
When Ye Qianqian claimed her hometown was hit by a flood, destroying all their crops, the Fourth Elder promptly sent her spirit stones along with his letter.
Unfortunately, even the most meticulous plans suffer setbacks. One day, the truth was out. Fourth Elder found out 'Ye Qianqian' was impersonated by one of his fellow disciples and angrily searched each disciple's room.
Seeing the situation deteriorate, Daoist Buyu stuffed the unfinished letter into the Grand Elder's bedside drawer.
As expected, the Fourth Elder ended up confronting the Grand Elder. The truth that it was Daoist Buyu's doing only surfaced after their conflict.
"Fourth Elder, as a Confucian Cultivator, adheres to the way of a gentleman. He is stiff and rigid and has a dull mind. He can be easily deceived by women when he is out. It's better that he is duped by me first rather than some stranger... no, it would make him more cautious."That was how Daoist Buyu justified his actions before the beating.
The Grand Elder shivered at the recollection. Scholars could indeed be ruthless when they chose to be.
"Since you're back, let's have a meeting. There's something to discuss."
The Grand Elder called everyone over: Yun Zhi, the eight Elders, Daoist Buyu, Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, Tao Yaoye, Man Gu, Li Haoran, and Qin Yanyan.
Eldest Senior Sister was also at the sect. She watched her Master get beaten up without lifting a finger to help.
Eldest Senior Sister had a valid reason—I'm not a Liaison Cultivator. I can't defeat them.
It was clear that Eldest Senior Sister genuinely had no desire to intervene.
With all Heaven's Court members present, they looked at each other, their minds heavy, remaining silent. The atmosphere was tense.
The truth was, with the Sixth Elder present, everyone felt uncomfortable speaking.
After listening to the Grand Elder's report via Spiritual Sense, even Daoist Buyu, infamous for his deceptions, was taken aback.
"So, the recent uproar about Heaven's Court is you guys?"
"It's us," the Grand Elder corrected sternly.
"...Forget that you guys didn't get my approval before pulling me into Heaven's Court to be a Heavenly King Protector. But why, based on the fact that I modified the 'Big and Small Ruyi' magic skill, did you name me the Growth Heavenly King?!"
Uncle Ba spread his hands in rationalization. "You weren't here. We had no other choice. Besides, in our Heaven's Court, we value democracy. The title we gave you has been unanimously approved by everyone excluding you."
Daoist Buyu was outraged, his veins popping. "Democracy my ass. Who's the Master? Is it Eldest Senior Sister or you? I demand justice!"
"Your senior disciple."
"The name Growth Heavenly King is quite good."

chapters.title: Chapter 511 - 510 Self-taught_1
chapters.content:
Daoist Buyu sighed, truly proud of his good disciple, Lu Yang. Without guidance, Lu Yang managed to concoct something as elaborate as the Heaven's Court.
Back when he himself was in the Golden Core Stage, he merely fooled other Golden Core Stage cultivators, but Lu Yang at his Golden Core Stage was already tricking not just the transcendent grandmasters from the Transcendence Tribulation Stage and the Three Great Demon Sects, but also low-level cultivators and the common people, impressing with his ability to deceive those above and below him.
Originally, he had intended to teach Lu Yang his deceptive tricks behind Yun Zhi's back. Now it seemed unnecessary.
As a master, unable to pass on your most prized knowledge - he wasn't sure if this was fortune or misfortune.
"As the Heavenly King's Protector, I should contribute to our Sect. I can help publicize our teachings in the outside world," Daoist Buyu proposed responsibly, eager to utilize his skills.
"You cannot." The Fourth Elder rejected Daoist Buyu's suggestion.
"You are infamous throughout the cultivation world, notorious, like a rat crossing the street, everyone is up for knocking you down. Common people and middling or low-level cultivators may not understand your circumstances, however, which high-level cultivator doesn't know you?"
"If you were to promote our sect in the outside world, your main targets would be common people and middle or low-level cultivators. However, the prime objective of Heaven's Court is to deceive our hidden enemies, who are all high-level cultivators. With you taking the lead in the publicity, it would in fact lower our credibility."
Daoist Buyu: "..."
Just taking analysis into account, without bringing in any strong, personal opinions, he had to admit that the fourth elder had a point.
Eighth Elder added, "In my opinion, Heaven's Court should avoid public activities for the moment. Making frequent public appearances gives the vibe of putting on a play. Keeping a low profile while allowing our enemies to speculate based on limited information about the power of Heaven's Court is a better strategy."
The less information they have, the wider their scope for imagination. Moreover, the strength of Heaven's Court is there for all those who care to see. Even if we don't act, others will interpret it as us plotting something in secret. It is the enemies who should be anxious."
As Buyu's primary mentor, Eighth Elder had his unique theories in the art of deception.
While listening to the elders' discussion, Lu Yang held back Fairy Eternity's burgeoning ambitions within his spiritual space.
"Hey, hey. Your master is back. You should hurry and ask him to pass the Sect Leader position to me!" Fairy Eternity banged at the edge of the bed, excitedly urging Lu Yang to reveal his ambitions, to seize power.
"Fairy, it's not that simple."
"What's so difficult about it? I see your master isn't really interested in being Sect Leader anyway."
"The problem isn't with my master, it's with Eldest Senior Sister. She has held power in the Sect for eleven years. She is obsessed with power and unwilling to hand it over easily. Letting you act as the interim Sect Leader twice previously was merely her wishing to take a break. Even if my master does not want to be the Sect Leader, the next most likely candidate is Eldest Senior Sister."
"Then what do we do?"
"As long as you, Fairy, can defeat Eldest Senior Sister, we can have the position of Sect Leader if we want it!"
Lu Yang had to stop her. He was worried that if he dared to claim to be the Sect Leader, his master might truly pass the position to him.
Fairy Eternity nodded, thinking that what Lu Yang said made sense: "There's no rush to be in a position as the Sect Leader. I'm not afraid of Miss Yun, I just think she's doing quite well as the current Sect Leader. I'll wait until I've returned to my peak condition, then strive for the position of Sect Leader!"
"Fairy, you are insightful, patient and hardworking. I am sure you are destined to show your talents in the Seek Dao Sect."
"That's what I think too."
The temporary meeting of Heaven's Court ended fairly quickly. In reality, there wasn't much to discuss. The main purpose was to inform Daoist Buyu, who was a member of Heaven's Court but unaware of it.
After the meeting ended, Daoist Buyu called Lu Yang to one side.
"Xiao Yang, stay back a moment."
"Master, what's the matter?"
Daoist Buyu cradled his whisk in his arm, stroking his white beard as he slowly said, "Nothing major, I just realized that since you became my disciple, I have never truly taught you anything. Now seems a good opportunity to teach you a bit about understanding Swordsmanship."
Lu Yang was thrilled; there weren't many in the Sect who were proficient at the art of the sword. Lu Yang's sword techniques were merely basic ones, relying on his innate talent for understanding the essence of swordsmanship.
Two years after becoming a disciple, and both being Sword Spirit Root, it's only now that the lessons have begun.
"Take out your sword, let me see."
Lu Yang drew out the Green Peak Sword and the Dark Moon Sword.
"You keep your swords in your Identity Jade?"
"Is there a problem with that?" Lu Yang was confused. He saw other mystic swordsmen do the same thing.
Could it be that a swordsman should be keeping his weapon close at all time, giving it meticulous care, so that he will be able to wield it more comfortably in battle?
"There is a big problem. When I was your age, I often fell victim to ambushes. In order to cope with these unexpected attacks, I carried my sword with me at all times. You keep it in your Identity Jade. What will you do when you encounter danger? Won't your reaction be slow?"
"Was the security in Great Xia this bad when you were young?" Lu Yang was startled. Since the start of his journey, he had never experienced an ambush. It was inconceivable that Great Xia had such disorder two thousand years ago.
"Although others say that the security in the Great Xia two thousand years ago was as good as it is now, based on my own experience, it was chaotic back then!"
"Then, did you report it to the government when you were ambushed?"
"The matter was too complex, I usually did not report it."
Lu Yang understood. The political system truly was dark.
"How complex exactly?"
"Mainly because I was the one who launched the first ambush. If the matter was taken to the government officials, neither of us would benefit."
Lu Yang: "..."
Daoist Buyu drew both swords slightly out of their scabbards, just exposing a part. The shimmering edge of the sword was reflected in his eyes.
Daoist Buyu couldn't stop lavishing praise on both swords, "Excellent swords. One of them was given to you by Xiao Zhi, and she even applied a seal on it. The other one was carefully forged by Old Five."
His own whisk was also forged by the Fifth Elder; it seemed like an ordinary whisk, but it contained countless Sword Qi, making it an unexpected weapon.
Daoist Buyu reluctantly handed the swords back to Lu Yang. Xiao Zhi was biased, he had asked her for the Green Peak Sword many times, but she never agreed.
"Show me your sword techniques, let's see how far you've come."
"Yes."
The sword handle aligned with his chest, Sword Qi spiraled on the blade, like a coiled flood dragon, full of vigor.
Lu Yang shouted, giving his wrist a shake, the sword was like a startled goose, the moves were sharp and unstoppable.
The Breaking Tactic, Dotting Tactic, Lifting Tactic...
Basic sword tactics in Lu Yang's hands seemed alive, combined like a cohesive line, the movements were smooth without a flaw.
Daoist Buyu: "..."
Is this what self-learning can achieve?
He felt that even if he personally instructed, the result wouldn't be much better.
Lu Yang sheathed his sword, the Green Peak Sword vertically behind his back, and he gave a slight bow to Daoist Buyu.
"Master, do you think there's anything about my sword techniques that needs to be improved?"
Lu Yang was quite nervous in his heart; he acquired all his sword techniques through self-study. Although he felt confident, his master might see a great deal of flaws in it.
Daoist Buyu pondered for a while before saying meaningfully, "Next time when you display your sword techniques, remember to leave a few flaws for me to point out."

chapters.title: Chapter 512 - 511: Sword Opens Heaven's Gate and Human-Sword Unity_1
chapters.content:
As a talent who practices both swordsmanship and magic skills, there is no doubt about Lu Yang's innate abilities.
In terms of magical talent, he is on par with Yun Zhi.
As for his talent in swordsmanship, it faintly has the potential to surpass Daoist Buyu.
"I originally intended to teach you how to correctly execute basic sword moves, but it seems that there's no need now."
Basic sword moves are the foundation of swordsmanship, and even a slight deviation in angle can lead to a noticeable change in power.
"The sword techniques that I've mastered require a high cultivation level, and I can't teach you yet. The technique 'One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand' requires a colossal reserve of spiritual essence. Your spiritual essence reserve is exceptional even during the Golden Core Stage, and there are only a few in the Nascent Soul Stage who can match your level.
However, you are still some way off from being able to use 'One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand.'"
"Once you reach the Nascent Soul Stage, I will be able to pass on 'One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand' to you."
'One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand' is a move that can be executed at the Divinity Transformation Stage. With one swing of the sword, myriad ethereal blades follow, like an army that eclipses the sky, a move every swordsman yearns to master.
Considering Lu Yang's talent in swordsmanship and his immense spiritual essence reserve, he should be able to execute it at the Nascent Soul Stage.
"You don't need me to teach you how to wield a sword while flying."
"It's too early for you to learn 'Victory without a Sword'; it's easy to go astray. And besides, you have the Green Peak Sword, so how can having no sword be better than having one?"
"The initial requirement for 'All Swords Return to the Source' is the Divinity Transformation Stage, which you're far from reaching."
"As for my signature move 'Sword Opens Heaven's Gate,' it's even more difficult. Don't even think about executing it without reaching the Unification Stage."
Daoist Buyu listed various sword moves, none of which were very suitable for Lu Yang to learn.
"Sword Opens Heaven's Gate? Did you come up with that move yourself, Master?" Lu Yang asked, as he had never heard of it before.
Daoist Buyu shook his head and sighed, "I was forced into it, it's not something I desired."
This was his admission.
Lu Yang looked at Daoist Buyu with envy. In fact, there aren't many sword moves for a swordsman. Moves like unifying the sword and self, 'One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand' etc. have been passed down from ancient times. Swordsmen stick to the rules and learn these sword moves.
The same sword move, based on different understandings and enlightenment of swordsmanship, can have disparate power when executed.
Those like Daoist Buyu who have created their own sword moves are rare.
The other cultivator who created his own sword move that Lu Yang knows of is the Supreme of the Sword Tower.
In the cultivation world, there are quite a lot of swordsmanship styles, such as Falling Rain Swordsmanship, Hundred Flower Swordsmanship, Poxiao Swordsmanship, Untroubled Swordsmanship etc. Some swordsmen aren't very creative with names, so there are quite a few with the same names. Lu Yang knows of at least four versions of the Untroubled Swordsmanship.
"Forced by circumstances?"
When you created this move, Master, you should have been a cultivator at the Unification Stage. There should have been few opponents in the cultivation world.
Could it be that Master had too many enemies, who attacked him unawares while he was unprepared? Surrounded by dozens of peers, even Master would have difficulty escaping. With injuries all over his body from the relentless attacks, hanging by a thread, Master had a flash of revelation at the brink of life and death, and understood the move that discerns life and death—the Sword Opens Heaven's Gate.
When this sword move was used, even the sky seemed broken!
Daoist Buyu stroked his white beard, saying, "That was more than a thousand years ago. I got into some trouble then, and your Grandmaster locked me on Sky Gate Mountain for ten years without leaving. You know me, being a worldly cultivator, how could I not go out?"
"But there was nothing I could do. Your Grandmaster's cultivation level was higher than mine, and he was good at seal techniques. He sealed off the whole mountain."
"I thought this wouldn't do. If this were to continue, wouldn't I be truly staying there for ten years?"
"At that moment, I reached the state of enlightenment, meditated on the spot, transformed my body into a furnace where all my lifetime understanding and insights of swordsmanship were refined, transformed, tempered, and polished. Finally, with a stroke of my sword, I broke the seal of the Sky Gate Mountain!"
"I named this move 'Sword Opens Heaven's Gate.'"
Lu Yang: "..."
Master, your process of understanding sword moves doesn't quite match my imagination?
"Speaking of swordsmen, before I became an immortal, I did meet one. He was truly formidable, the most invincible cultivator at his stage, a formidable adversary," recalled The Fairy Eternity, who was reminded of a past event when she saw Daoist Buyu mastering the sword moves.
"Fairy, please tell us more." Upon hearing that it was about one of his own kind, Lu Yang became very interested.
It's rare to hear about ancient swordsmen.
"That swordsman was called Liu Ningxuan. He was also an exceptional player of the zither, hence hailed as the Zither and Sword Venerable. You know the move 'Unifying the Sword and the Self,' don't you? It was created by him,"
Lu Yang's eyes widened a bit. 'Unifying the Sword and the Self' is a famous sword move that can dramatically increase one's combat power in the shortest time. Everyone says that this move has been passed down from ancient times, but no one knows who created it or where it comes from. Unexpectedly, he got the answer from the Fairy.
"Liu Ningxuan was quite a fighter. Like all swordsmen, he believed in the sword in his hand. Holding the sword, his entire aura was so different that it was rather intimidating. With the long sword in his hand, piercing space, shattering the void, and slicing time were not beyond him," Fairy Eternity added.
Lu Yang gasped. Piercing space, shattering the void, and slicing time all sound so powerful, much beyond his current abilities.
Presumably, this senior Liu Ningxuan was also an outstanding figure among the ancient swordsmen, perhaps even the highest-ranking one.
"Even when confronted with his sword, Fairy Eternity must retreat three times. One would not want to face it head-on."
"However, he too, was ultimately not a match for me, and was defeated by me."
"Fairy, you're amazing. How did this Zither and Sword Venerable lose?"
"That fight was truly dangerous. At that time, our battle was so intense that it shattered heaven and earth, and the constellations were in chaos. Perhaps he felt the threat of life and death from me and was under great pressure, which gave him a deeper understanding of swordsmanship in the dark."
"He also realized that he couldn't win with the original moves alone. He had to be innovative. He then pushed the move 'Unifying the Sword and the Self' to a whole new level, based on the understanding of swordsmanship that he quickly gained during the battle, a level that nobody has ever reached."
"After he unified the sword and himself, he turned into an Immortal Sword, his power skyrocketed, as if he were capable of creating a world."
Lu Yang listened with sparkling eyes, immersed in the cosmic-level battle, and eagerly asked, "And then what happened?"
Fairy Eternity scratched her head somewhat troubled, "Then? There's no 'then.' After he turned into a sword, he found that the integration with the sword was too close and he couldn't change back."
Lu Yang: "..."
Fairy, did you ever encounter a normal opponent when you became immortal?
At this time, Daoist Buyu slapped his forehead as if he had suddenly remembered something, interrupting Lu Yang, who was listening attentively to the fairy's past glories.
"I remember now, there's a move I can teach you."
"Which one?"
"Unifying the Sword and the Self. This move has been passed down from ancient times and is a signature move for swordsmen. It can instantly unleash incredible power. It's ideal for overcoming the odds and making a comeback when you're cornered..."
"Thanks, but no need."
Lu Yang decisively refused.
Daoist Buyu was puzzled. He couldn't understand why his disciple rejected it so quickly and decisively.
Since he wouldn't learn 'Unifying the Sword and the Self,' Lu Yang seemed to be unable to learn other sword moves at his current level.
"Well then, I will teach you how to comprehend the way of the sword."

chapters.title: Chapter 513 - 512: The Purpose of Comprehending Swordsmanship_1
chapters.content:
"Your sword technique possesses such strength, which implies that you have already entered the preliminary stage of understanding swordsmanship. To comprehend swordsmanship better, you need to understand its essence."
"Swordsmanship, essentially, is about the profound principles contained within the sword itself."
"As for what the profound principles contained in the sword are, we'll talk about that later."
"Have you ever wondered why your Spirit Root is called the Sword Spirit Root? If there's a Sword Spirit Root, would there be a Knife Spirit Root, a Gun Spirit Root, or a Staff Spirit Root, better yet, is there a Weapon Spirit Root?"
Lu Yang shook his head. He had never thought about this. He just felt instinctively connected to the sword, as if born with a natural affinity for it.
"The Sword Spirit Root stems from the mutation of the Golden Spirit Root. The Golden Spirit Root is distinguished by its ability to manage minerals and its extremely strong attack. The Sword Spirit Root, however, forgoes this control over minerals, instead mutating and maximizing its attack potential."
"The so-called Sword Spirit Root does not mean you naturally have a predisposition for the sword. It refers to your possession of the most powerful form of attack. The best carrier of all weapons is the sword."
"Only by using the sword can the characteristics of the Spirit Root be brought out to the utmost."
Lu Yang voiced his doubts, "But when I cast a magic spell, the power seems comparable to when I use the sword."
If the Sword Spirit Root could maximize its attack power to the extreme, then Swordsmanship should be the most powerful.
Seeing Lu Yang's puzzled expression, Daoist Buyu contemplated for a moment, "That proves an old saying."
"Which old saying?"
"Geniuses don't play by the rules."
"Experiences are summarized by predecessors, but there are things that even predecessors have never seen, such as someone like you."
"Even the claim that the Sword Spirit Root is the strongest is not necessarily true. Look at the Four Immortals of the Ancients. Who among them used a sword? If the Sword Spirit Root is the strongest, then why hasn't anyone become an immortal with it?"
In his heart, Lu Yang thought there might be a potential immortal. It's someone who integrates with his sword so well that he accidentally kills himself on the path to becoming an immortal.
Being referred to by the Fairy Eternity as a "rival" during the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, shows how formidable the adversary was.
The last one to be called a rival by the Fairy was the once-in-a-lifetime genius who had refined the Verbal Spell into a passive skill.
Moreover, it's not like there haven't been immortals who used swords. The Qilin Immortal frequently used a sword, and Lu Yang's Dark Moon Sword was a remake of the Qilin Immortal's blade.
"When seeking the enlightenment of swordsmanship, you must have a definite objective. Xiao Yang, may I ask, why are you seeking the knowledge of swordsmanship?"
When asked this question, Lu Yang remained silent for a long time. Since he began his journey of cultivation and started using the sword, he had never thought of what his purpose was.
He was simply drifting with the current, practicing aimlessly.
He slowly closed his eyes, immersing himself in a sea of memories, recalling what had happened since he began practising:
When he first joined the Sect, he made numerous friends. Although they frequently played pranks on each other, it was nothing more than a bit of harmless fun amongst friends. Whenever he faced problems, his Senior Brothers and Sisters were always willing to lend him a hand by solving his doubts and guiding him. His Eldest Senior Sister would teach him, laying a solid foundation for him to build on.
His Mentor was not very talkative, but Lu Yang could feel her deep concern for him...
With his eyes wide open, Lu Yang stared firmly into Daoist Buyu's eyes. His gaze was resolute as he voiced the answer deep in his heart.
"The lesson of swordsmanship is for protection!"
He wants to protect everything that is beautiful!
Daoist Buyu struck Lu Yang on the head.
"To protect what exactly? Who needs your protection? Is it your mentor or Xiao Yun?"
Lu Yang: "..."
Upon reflection, he realized there was some truth to it. Each and every one of his friends, like Meng Jingzhou, possessed unmatched talents. His Senior Brothers and Sisters were even more skilled than him. Every time they went out, it was his Senior Brothers and Sisters who dominated the scene, and his Mentor was altogether on another level.
As for his own mentor, his enemies were far from being someone he could handle. Does she not need protection?
"Stop having these fanciful thoughts all day. The sword is the most powerful weapon. The purpose of learning swordsmanship is naturally to seek the ultimate attack!"
Lu Yang nodded sagely, accepting his misinterpretation.
"Sword practice should be pure. The more pure the pursuit is, the better the understanding of swordsmanship will be!"
"As the saying goes, 'One sword breaks all.' This speaks directly to the manner of comprehension!"
"And the 'Break' technique that you constantly use, you ever wonder why it's the most powerful among the other techniques? Isn't it because 'Break' represents the pursuit of the sword?"
Remembering his path towards understanding swordsmanship, Lu Yang realized it to be true. Previously, whenever he sought to understand swordsmanship, he ignored everything else, focusing solely on how to become more powerful through swordsmanship.
Surprisingly, this coincided perfectly with the best way to comprehend swordsmanship.
Although it seems like an accident, Lu Yang had been somewhat prepared. This could be evidenced in Fairy Eternity's reaction. When he was learning about swordsmanship, Fairy Eternity did not point out any mistakes or suggest corrections, which means his approach was correct.
What Lu Yang didn't know was that while he was fully engaged in his class, Fairy Eternity was wholeheartedly following along in his Spiritual Space, nodding frequently and learning a great deal.
"So that's what swordsmanship is about." Fairy Eternity realized, having seen very few sword cultivators in the Ancient Era apart from the Zither and Sword Venerable.
Fairy Eternity thought it was a really good thing that she had a golden finger. Not all who revive have such luck. Since her revival, part of her work and lots of her leisure time have been spent immersing in a variety of interesting happenings in the Cultivation World along with the golden finger.
Not only did the golden finger help her to accomplish tasks, but she also benefited when it came across opportunities.
It's a win-win situation.
With his mentor's guidance, Lu Yang finally grasped what he had been missing. He used to feel as though his cultivation was hidden behind a veil, but Daoist Buyu had peeled that curtain away. Everything was clear to him now.
He crossed his legs, attempting to reflect on swordsmanship as his mentor had taught him.
"The pursuit of the ultimate attack..."
Noticing the fluctuating aura of Lu Yang's swordsmanship while he meditated, Daoist Buyu nodded slightly. The ability of his young disciple to grasp the essence of swordsmanship was indeed astounding.
Given that, it was time for him to depart.
His visit to the Sect was originally just a pit stop on his way home. His path of cultivation lay outside, in the real world. Having imparted the essence of swordsmanship to Lu Yang, his mission was accomplished.
With a sweep of his robe, he left the Sect.
The moment he stepped out of the Sect, he saw countless lines of suitors blocking the mountain gate. As these proposed suitors saw Daoist Buyu, their mouths twisted into strange, excited smiles.
"Our informant was accurate; this bastard has indeed returned to the Seek Dao Sect!"
"You, old Buyu thief, have finally shown up!"
Daoist Buyu's hair stood on end as a barrage of attacks rained down on him.
"Bodhi Destiny Palm!" A large green palm descended from the sky, larger and heavier than a mountain.
"Sky Demon Disintegration Technique!" A cultivator surrounded by black gas, his aura massively boosted, ready for battle.
"Disable all Weapons!"
"Creation Qiankun Array!"
"Lethal Thunder!"
Boom—Boom—Boom—
A continuous volley of dazzling attacks, shaking the mountains and making the sky tremble.
Daoist Buyu retreated back into the Sect in silence.
His journey to practice in the outer world could afford to wait a while longer.

chapters.title: Chapter 514 - 513: The Strategy of Drawing the Tiger away from the Mountain_1
chapters.content:
"Damn it, Old Buyu ran away so fast!"
"It's because you guys jumped the gun. I've said it before, we should have waited until he was out of the Seek Dao Sect before making a move! You guys were so hasty, attacking once you saw him, if I were him, I would have run too!"
"We couldn't help it, seeing our enemy made us too excited, we couldn't hold back."
"What should we do now?"
"There is a way, but it's uncertain if it will work."
"What's the plan?"
"Don't forget, we're part of a matchmaking party..."
...
Recalling the dense barrage of attacks, Daoist Buyu felt a lingering fear. If they had hit, he wasn't sure whether he'd have survived with just a severe injury or if he'd have lost his life.
"The people from the Trade Association are something else too, is this their way of treating customers? They wouldn't even sell me insurance!"
Daoist Buyu was quite angry, feeling that the people at the Trade Association were not proper traders. They didn't want to make money even when he wanted to buy the most expensive insurance.
...
"So this is the correct way to comprehend swordsmanship."
Coming out of his enlightened state, Lu Yang felt his understanding of swordsmanship had gone up a level. The Young Master Lu, who fought him to a draw three months ago, was no longer his match!
He opened his eyes, only to see Eldest Senior Sister bringing a stack of red auspicious envelopes to him.
"What's this?"
"These are the betrothal letters from the matchmaking party. They hope to enter the Seek Dao Sect and discuss marriage matters with you in person."
Lu Yang casually took an invitation. The source was unmistakably the First Class Sect, White Horse Temple.
"...Am I that popular?"
If Meng Jingzhou saw this, wouldn't he be so envious that he'd grind his molars?
"You being popular is one reason, but the main reason is that they want to enter the sect to find their master."
"Master hasn't left yet?" Lu Yang was surprised. He had assumed that, given Master's restless nature, he would have left after finishing his teaching.
It's not right to say he's restless. As he knew, Master served his jail sentences honestly until his term was up.
"He was planning to leave, but someone blocked the door."
Whether it should be said or not, Lu Yang wasn't surprised when this happened. On the contrary, he thought it was inevitable.
He knew that the whereabouts of his Master had been sold at a sky-high price on the black market and was in a state of 'priceless availability'. Any slight hint of information about the whereabouts would be bought up in the shortest amount of time. This shows the popularity of the Master.
Similarly, the news of the Master returning to the sect will naturally spread in the shortest time.
The Master's enemies are in the Unification stage, all of them are so fast it's scary. If anyone is proficient in space magic skills, they will be quicker.
Now, he feels there is nothing wrong in having "protection" as the goal of swordsmanship comprehension.
There is no need to protect others, mainly protecting himself.
"So what should we do now?"
Looking at the stack of betrothal letters, Lu Yang was overwhelmed. These were suitors, and if the Seek Dao Sect were to drive them away, they would be the ones in the wrong.
"There are two plans." The Eldest Senior Sister put down the invitation, analyzing.
"One is to respond to them as soon as possible, agree to let them enter the sect, find the master, and then they'll have achieved their goal."
Lu Yang shook his head, this plan definitely wouldn't work.
"What about the second plan?"
"Hand the Master over."
Lu Yang: "..."
The second plan was even worse than the first.
"Doesn't the master excel at transformation? Can't he just transform into someone else to slip away?"
The Eldest Senior Sister shook her head, rejecting this plan: "The White Horse Temple has brought out their temple's treasure, the Demon-Reflecting Mirror, which can see through all disguises."
"And even if the disguise isn't seen through, and the master successfully slips away, they wouldn't know about this and would still propose marriage to you at the door."
"Just hand the Master over then."
Considering that handing Daoist Buyu over was a risky move, the two first went to the Elixir Cauldron Peak to find the Seventh Elder.
"Martial Nephew Yun, Senior Brother Lu?" Seventh elder was astonished to see the pair arrive, it was unusual for the two to seek him out together.
"Is something wrong?"
After all, it then concerned their master, they couldn't be too straightforward. Lu Yang chose his words carefully: "Suppose, I'm saying suppose, there is a very powerful Unification stage cultivator, but he has many enemies, who are also in Unification stage. This Unification stage cultivator has bad luck and is besieged by his enemies, probably about fifty or sixty Unification stage cultivators."
"Is there an elixir that can help him survive under the siege of these people?"
Originally, Lu Yang didn't have much hope, but unexpectedly the Seventh Elder nodded: "There is a legend that there was an ancient elixir called Procreation Elixir, Senior Brother Lu, you have seen this pill formula before."
"As long as the unlucky Unification stage cultivator consumes the Procreation Elixir and gets pregnant, considering the humanitarian aspect, those who want to harm him should not go as far as to kill him."
"...This Unification stage cultivator is a man, are there any other methods?"
"Also, he can wish to be left with a full corpse, and after tens of thousands or hundreds of thousands of years, the corpse might gain consciousness and effectively resurrect. However, this is just a legend, who knows if the resurrected one would still be him."
"Is there a more reliable solution?"
"Yes, there is. The Unification stage cultivator you mentioned must have done all sorts of evil deeds. Reporting him to the authorities might get him arrested. Even though he would lose his freedom, at the least he'd be able to stay alive."
Lu Yang and the Eldest Senior Sister thought this was a good idea.
"Oh, you're here." Daoist Buyu found Lu Yang and the Eldest Senior Sister in the pill refining room, and along the way asked the Seventh Elder for several bottles of top-grade healing elixirs.
"Just so you know, I'm leaving."
Lu Yang was taken aback. He hadn't made up his mind to betray his master, yet his master was going to leave?
"Aren't you afraid of those people at the door?"
"I definitely can't beat them, but I have other methods."
"What methods?"
"I asked Big Brother to leave the Seek Dao Sect and cause some commotion in the neighboring state, making them think I've left the Seek Dao Sect. They'll all rush to the neighboring state, and I'll take the opportunity to leave the sect."
Daoist Buyu was laughing proudly. He had been roaming the world for two thousand years, and catching him in broad daylight would be simply dreaming.
Things went exactly as Daoist Buyu planned. The Grand Elder, as the oldest of the nine children in the Seek Dao Sect, didn't make many enemies, at least none were among the suitors.
The Grand Elder went to the neighboring state, impersonating Daoist Buyu, and revealed the latest chapter "Legends of the Questioning Path Sect — Meng Jingzhou Edition". He talked about how Young Master Meng, despite being rich, was self-disciplined, dedicated to cultivation, indifferent to women, and even laid a curse on himself.
For a long time, he couldn't even see women, which was truly admirable.
Finding out that Old Buyu was in the neighboring state and considering Old Buyu's ability to conceal himself, the suitor party was convinced and immediately set off for the neighboring state.
Daoist Buyu took this opportunity to safely escape from the Seek Dao Sect.
After the Master left, Lu Yang sighed slightly. He had thought of this method too, it could be considered as the safest one, but he was not willing to use it on Master.
He always felt that letting Master leave the Seek Dao Sect safely was something he wouldn't be able to bear on his conscience.
A few days later, an unexpected person found Lu Yang.
"Senior Brother Lu, can you accompany me on a mission?" Tao Yaoye invited him with a big smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 515 - 514 - The Master is Daoist Buyu, Naturally Belongs to Worldly Cultivation.
chapters.content:
"Doing a mission?" Lu Yang was clueless, what was the point of asking him to do a mission?
"Yes, Senior Brother Lu, you are very experienced and often travel in the outside world, so completing Sect missions should be a piece of cake for you."
"You still remember our first mission, right? It was to catch the Painted Skin Demon. If it wasn't for you, we would have let the Demon get away."
"Since that time, I've been on a few missions myself. Although they were all successful, the journey was full of twists and turns, and luck played a big part."
"So, I was thinking, could you join me for this mission?"
Lu Yang was surprised, "The Sect requires every disciple to complete two missions a year. Junior Sister, you've already accomplished your goal, right? Also, the Dream Mirage you sell is so popular that even Cultivators at the Nascent Soul Stage can't compete with your wealth. You don't need contribution points, why do you have to go out on a mission?"
Tao Yaoye gave a hearty laugh. "Of course, it's to slay demons and eradicate evil. As disciples of the Righteous Path, don't we have a responsibility to rectify the world's injustices?"
"Indeed."
"So, Senior Brother, will you join me?" Tao Yaoye asked, her hands behind her back, bending over slightly, looking at Lu Yang expectantly.
Lu Yang contemplated. In the past three months, he had been concentrating on advancing to the late stage of Golden Core Cultivation. He had turned down Meng Jingzhou's invitations several times. If he agreed to accompany Junior Sister Tao now, wouldn't he be accused of favoring love over friendship?
"Let's go."
As a disciple of Daoist Buyu, a Worldly Cultivator, Lu Yang naturally followed the same path.
For Worldly Cultivators, it's not advisable to always focus on cultivation. It's quite normal to gain worldly experience through missions outside the Sect.
"Great." Tao Yaoye was visibly elated.
"Wait a moment, let me ask Old Meng if he wants to join."
Tao Yaoye, having anticipated this, said with a smile, "I already asked Senior Brother Meng, he's currently in closed-door cultivation and cannot spare the time."
"Oh, I see. Then let's go." Lu Yang felt a tad disappointed for he had been looking forward to the journey by carriage.
Luckily, Daoist Buyu had schemingly ridden the Sect of the matchmaking crowd. Otherwise, as soon as Lu Yang stepped out, a group of Great Powers of the Unification Stage would be all over him, recommending their disciples, daughters, granddaughters...
...
On the flying boat, Lu Yang inquired about their mission.
"The mission originated from Mr. Song's household in Yuanhe County, Qingshui County, Yunzhou. His house possesses a mysterious painting that emits strange sounds at midnight daily. Several passing cultivators visited Mr. Song's house but none could solve the mystery of the painting. The last Cultivator suggested that the painting was beyond an ordinary cultivator's ability and recommended Mr.
Song to seek help from the Immortal Sect."
"I see."
The flying boat docked at Qingshui County. The two rented horses and set off for Yuanhe County.
Upon reaching Yuanhe County, they patted the horses, and the two creatures ran off back to their owner.
"Shall we head over to Mr. Song's residence?"
Lu Yang shook his head, "There's no rush. Let's first gather some information about Mr. Song and his family here."
"Alright."
Tao Yaoye today was vastly different from when she first joined the sect. Although her beauty was undeniable back then, she still had a youthful innocence about her. But now, at eighteen, she was splendid and mischievous, garnering a lot of attention on the way.
Both had remarkable demeanors, which made people wary of them, thus there was no harassment towards Tao Yaoye.
"Boss, two bowls of wonton soup, please. Make mine extra vinegary." Lu Yang picked out a wonton stall.
"Alright."
Two bowls of wonton soup were served. Tao Yaoye tasted it and commented softly, "Brother, the taste of this stall is so-so."
"So-so is a compliment, we're close to dinner time, but hardly anyone is here eating wontons, it gives you an idea of how average the taste is."
"Why are we eating here then?"
"The business is slow, the boss would be willing to chat with us...Boss, how long have you been running this stall?"
"It has been nearly thirty years. I am not bragging when I say that everyone in Yuanhe County knows of my wonton stall."
"Seeing you both like this, you're not from around here, are you?"
"We are healers from the neighboring Panlong County. Someone at the Song Family is sick, and they asked us to come have a look. We've just arrived, and haven't found our way to Mr. Song's house yet."
"Oh, you're going to find Mr. Song. It's not far from here. You walk straight from here, take a turn at the intersection, and you'll be there after one more left turn."
Lu Yang, of course, knew that the Song Residence was nearby, that's why he specifically found a wonton stall near their house.
Lu Yang lowered his head and quietly ate his wontons, slurped a spoonful of soup, it was really sour.
As Lu Yang didn't say anything, the wonton stall owner attempted to strike up a conversation.
"Healer, who's sick in the Song's family? Is it Mr. Song himself?"
The fact that they had called in a healer from a nearby county indicated a severe ailment. It was the perfect mundane talk for the neighborhood.
"I really can't say." Lu Yang replied with a shake of his head. Then, as if something just occurred to him, he casually asked, "Are you familiar with the Song family?"
"The Song family only came into prominence in the past twenty years, mainly due to Mr. Song. He is quite a character. When he was young, he became a scholar but later failed to achieve any fame. During his middle age, he lost his wife and son and lived in desolation and sorrow."
"Then one day, he suddenly came to his senses and started to do business. I don't know how he did it, but his wealth was growing day by day. He looked more energetic, followed by his remarriage and the birth of three sons and a daughter."
"Mr. Song tends to be a good person. He has built two schools and donated many books."
After listening, Tao Yaoye nodded, by all accounts, Mr. Song appeared to be a good person. The only mystery was how he became successful in his business.
However, this had nothing to do with their mission.
"Hey, isn't that Senior Brother Lu?"
A slightly surprised and joyous voice sounded, soft and soothing like velvet.
Lu Yang turned and was surprised to see the speaker, "Junior Sister Lan Ting?"
From afar, Lan Ting had already spotted a familiar figure at the wonton stall. She didn't dare to confirm it was Lu Yang until she got closer.
On seeing Lan Ting approaching, Tao Yaoye quickly stood up, positioned herself between them and warmly greeted her, "Junior Sister Lan, what brings you here?"
Lan Ting flashed a resplendent smile, "Oh, it's Junior Sister Tao, I only saw Senior Brother Lu and didn't spot you earlier. I apologize."
"As a cultivator, you should always be aware of your surroundings. It seems like Junior Sister Lan's cultivation skills still have room for improvement."
"Junior Sister Tao, your words are off the mark. Cultivators are skilled observers to protect themselves from danger. Would there be any danger in this place?"
A big grin lit up Lan Ting's face as she continued, "Besides, with Senior Brother Lu around, there wouldn't be any danger. Junior Sister Tao, it seems like you're underestimating Senior Brother Lu."
Lu Yang, hearing the exchange between the two women, felt that he should say something.
"Boss, can I have another bowl of wonton soup, please?"

chapters.title: Chapter 516 - 515: The Fairy of Eternity is Still More Experienced_1
chapters.content:
"One bowl for each person." The third bowl of wontons was ready, and Lu Yang pushed it happily towards Lan Ting.
Lan Ting glanced at Tao Yaoye unintentionally and sat down gracefully as if showing off her elegant manners. Then she gently picked up a wonton with her chopsticks.
Since Senior Brother Lu chose this place, it naturally had its unique characteristics... but the wontons were really unappetising.
Lan Ting stared at the bowl of wontons in surprise. These were the worst wontons she had ever eaten.
In fact, the quality of the wontons was mediocre at best, not the worst she had experienced, but Lan Ting had been raised in an influential family, always enjoying delicacies. Even after joining the Laurel Fairy Palace, although her diet had become healthier, the food was still the best in the Cultivation World.
She naturally found the mediocre wontons from the secular world hard to swallow.
The stall owner was pleased to see Lu Yang ordering another bowl of wontons. Everyone in the Yuanhe County knew the wontons were awful, they always ended up swindling strangers.
He had been selling wontons for nearly thirty years, and the majority of his customers were outsiders.
Lu Yang was lucky; there was a lot of vinegar in his bowl, masking the taste of the wontons.
No matter what, since they ordered wontons, they had to eat them. The three of them finished their bowls of wontons.
Lu Yang wiped his mouth and remembered he hadn't discussed the main issue yet. "Speaking of which, I haven't had a chance to ask Junior Sister Lan why you are here. Were you on a mission, too?"
"Yes, a man named Mr. Song asked the Laurel Fairy Palace for help. He said his family had a strange painting. It wouldn't burn, couldn't be thrown away or torn up and would make eerie noises at night. It's very dangerous."
Tao Yaoye chimed in, "Senior Brother Lu and I are assigned the same mission. Senior Brother Lu was worried I wouldn't be able to do it alone, so he came with me."
Lu Yang felt a little confused, Junior Sister Tao's words weren't wrong, but something felt strange.
"It seems Mr. Song requested help from both of our sects."
This was a common occurrence; those seeking help weren't sure which sect was reliable. They would tend to issue requests to several sects, and so disciples from the Five Great Immortal Sects often wound up with the same task.
For instance, Daoist Buyu and Luo Hongxia had once been assigned the same task when they were younger. Lan Ting had heard from their master that those two were assigned to expel ghosts. They stayed at an inn for three days but couldn't find the ghost anywhere. Eventually, they found it under Daoist Buyu's bed. When Daoist Buyu was sleeping, the ghost would watch him from beneath the bedframe.
Then, Daoist Buyu insisted that the ghost should pay half of the room's cost for the three days.
The ghost countered by citing Great Xia's laws, arguing that since, legally speaking, it wasn't a living being, it didn't have to pay for the room.
Daoist Buyu cited the laws of Great Xia in return, arguing that ghosts don't have human rights and cultivators are allowed to kill them on sight.
The ghost obediently split the cost of the room and was captured and taken into custody.
"Senior Brother Lu, Junior Sister Tao, have you two investigated Mr. Song's situation?"
Tao Yaoye recounted the results of their investigation, "These are the results of our joint investigation."
"Senior Brother Lu is amazing. He managed to investigate so much just after arriving at Yuanhe County. I'm sure Junior Sister Tao also contributed a lot. I have arrived three days earlier than Senior Brother Lu, but I only investigated a little bit more."
"It's a pity I was alone. If Senior Brother Lu were here to help, we would certainly have been able to investigate more."
Tao Yaoye, appearing to miss Lan Ting's insinuations, asked calmly, "What have you found out, Junior Sister Lan?"
"Mr. Song's troubles began twenty years ago. Actually, his family was almost destitute at that time, with little money remaining. He staked everything he had left on business ventures, which all ended in failure. He lost everything. Some people saw him walking towards a mountain, and it seemed like he sought death.
Surprisingly, half a day later, Mr. Song came down from the mountain, his expression clearer than before, carrying a painting."
"You know the rest. Mr. Song suddenly demonstrated outstanding business acumen, and wealth came pouring in. His family was happy and fulfilled."
Lan Ting glanced at Tao Yaoye with pride - how about that? This crucial piece of information had yet to be discovered by them.
After hearing Lan Ting's explanation, Tao Yaoye affectionately took Lan Ting's hand, "Junior Sister Lan, you're so smart, managing to discover so much all on your own! It looks like you're doing great by yourself."
With a broad smile on her face, Lan Ting linked arms with Tao Yaoye in a friendly manner, "Oh, please, it's no big deal. It's always better to have more people, strength is in numbers after all. It's a pity Senior Brother Lu came with you. If he had come with me, we would've completed the mission by now."
"So you think you're better than me?"
"Junior Sister Tao, please don't twist my words. After all, I came three days earlier. If Senior Brother Lu had also come three days earlier with me, given his abilities, wouldn't we have completed the mission?"
"That's true. With Senior Brother Lu's abilities, he could complete the mission by himself."
The two women strolled arm in arm with the radiant smiles of reunited friends, as close to each other as real sisters.
Lu Yang didn't pay any attention to the conversation between the two women. He was thinking about the information Lan Ting had gathered: "As expected, the problem lies with the painting."
"Let's go meet Mr. Song."
The trio headed towards Mr. Song's house. Along the way, Lan Ting kept glancing at Lu Yang.
"Junior Sister Lan, is there something on my face?"
Lan Ting chuckled, "No, I just think you are very impressive, Senior Brother. You're so young and already the sect's next leader. Moreover, you hosted the whole sect's celebration. As far as I know, this is a first throughout history. Compared to you, I fall far behind."
"Nonsense. My becoming the acting leader is all down to luck." Lu Yang's humility was sincere; he had become the acting leader due to his unlucky encounter with Fairy Eternity.
Noticing Lan Ting's disappointment, Lu Yang comforted her, "Moreover, you're very talented, Junior Sister Lan. I watched your fight with Old Meng; you were too nervous, it wasn't a reflection of your true abilities."
Hearing Lu Yang's encouragement, Lan Ting's face brightened with a smile, "That's true. I should be more confident. After all, I was representing the Fairy Palace's Golden Core Stage in that fight."
"Junior Sister Tao and I hit it off right away. I initially thought we could meet each other on the fighting stage, but unfortunately, that didn't happen, and I never had a chance to spar."
Tao Yaoye spoke softly, "Junior Sister Lan, do you enjoy fighting so much? From what I've seen, you're usually gentle and elegant, just like a well-educated lady."
Lu Yang felt something was off and asked Fairy Eternity, "Fairy, don't you think Junior Sister Tao and Junior Sister Lan act oddly?"
Fairy Eternity had been observing the situation in the Spiritual Space for some time and agreed that the girls' actions and tone were strange.
"I feel like I've seen this before… Oh, I remember now! That's how the geniuses from the Dragon and Phoenix tribes behaved in front of me. Complimenting and praising each other, they exhibited strong unity. They did that because they wanted me to accept them as disciples."
"So Junior Sister Tao and Junior Sister Lan are behaving like this because…"
Fairy Eternity stated with certainty, "They must want you to accept them as disciples too. After all, you demonstrated superior capabilities at the celebration!"
"That makes sense."

chapters.title: Chapter 517 - 516: Murder in the Secret Room_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang and his party successfully arrived at Mr. Song's residence without much difficulty.
Lu Yang politely knocked on the door. The door was answered by a young gentleman with no signs of cultivation; a mortal. He looked pale and had dark circles under his eyes, likely due to a lack of rest.
"Who might you three be…" the young gentleman asked, eyeing Lu Yang and his companions apprehensively.
"We three are disciples of the Immortal Sect, invited here by Mr. Song to resolve an issue regarding a painting."
"Disciples of the Immortal Sect!" The young man's eyes widened. The Song Family had sought the help of the Immortal Sect without much hope, yet the esteemed Immortal Sect had actually sent someone!
"I am Lu Yang, and these are my junior sisters, Tao Yaoye and Lan Ting."
"Lu Yang?! The unbeatable Lu Yang of the Golden Core Stage?!"
Upon hearing Lu Yang's name, the young man was even more surprised. Although he was just a mortal, he was from a wealthy family and knew a few things about the Cultivation World. Over the past three months, Lu Yang's name was mentioned more than any other cultivator.
Furthermore, the widespread promotion by Daoist Buyu had made Lu Yang's name incredibly well-known.
To the Cultivation World, Lu Yang was known as the top cultivator of the mid-stage Golden Core, but to the young man, he had simply heard that Lu Yang was the top cultivator of the Golden Core Stage.
To him, there was little difference between the mid-stage Golden Core and the Golden Core Stage.
"I am Song Tian. Welcome, esteemed cultivators. Please, come in," said Song Tian, inviting the three of them inside without showing any discourtesy.
From Song Tian's introduction, Lu Yang learned that Mr. Song's full name was Song Jinju. Song Tian was his eldest son. As Mr. Song was getting on in years, the Song Family's business was mainly being handled by Song Tian. He had learned about Lu Yang from his friends who practiced cultivation, and was sure that all the stories told in storytelling sessions were true.
In addition to Song Tian, Mr. Song also had two other sons and one daughter. The second son was named Song Qing, a scholar. The third son was named Song Qi, a wastrel who did nothing all day, to the frustration of Mr. Song. The young daughter was named Song Lian'er.
Lady Song had passed away from illness five years prior.
"Esteemed cultivators, you must save our Song Family. That painting is eerily strange, a haunting object. I haven't been able to get a proper night's sleep. The painting is definitely haunted. We've moved house twice, and it somehow always follows us," Song Tian desperately said upon meeting Lu Yang's party.
He had been living in fear for the past few days, but their arrival seemed to alleviate his anxiety.
Song Tian invited Lu Yang's group to take the top seats in the hall and had a maid pour tea for them. He called for the housekeeper to fetch Mr. Song from the study.
Song Tian then went off to gather the rest of the family.
After these recent events, the Song Family had been living in a state of constant anxiety. The fact that disciples from the Immortal Sect were taking action allowed them to finally rest easy.
Lu Yang picked up his tea cup and drained half of the hot tea in one gulp without flinching at the boiling temperature.
Hot water was nothing to him, he had used boiling water to bathe before he began his cultivation.
Setting down his cup, Lu Yang casually said, "There is a strong Yin Energy in the Song Family house."
Tao Yaoye nodded, "Indeed, and it's quite dense. There must be a demon creature hiding in the Song Family house."
Although this was the case, judging from the concentration of the Yin Energy, it posed no threat to the three of them.
