The three of them had sharp senses and heard the Song siblings approaching from afar, talking as they walked.
"Brother, I don't mean to criticize you, but we've already invited so many cultivators to our house. Every one of them left empty-handed. What makes you so sure this time will be different?" The speaker was disrespectful, most likely the third son, Song Qi.
"Third Brother, do not speak nonsense. These guests Brother invited this time are disciples of the Immortal Sect, nearly on par with the imperial court. They are true immortals, and dealing with a mere demon creature would be as easy as catching something within their reach."
Judging from the tone, it was probably the second son, Song Qing.
"Additionally, didn't you hear what Brother said? One of the cultivators who came this time is Daoist Lu Yang. Even if you are usually irresponsible and idle, you should have heard the storytelling session about the 'Legend of the Dao Sect'. As far as I know, the author of the book is the master of the Immortal Sect, a peerless expert in this world.
Although the events she describes seem incredible, they must be true!"
"Stop flaunting your so-called knowledge, second brother. You haven't even passed the imperial examination to be an entry-level scholar yet. Father has been angry with you several times, saying that you've just been wasting your time with books. Have you forgotten?"
"You!"
"Let's hope they can successfully remove the painting. Ever since Zhou heard about our family's situation, he doesn't dare to casually meet me." This voice was a bit timid, undoubtedly the youngest sister, Song Lian'er.
"Young sister, you still haven't severed ties with that guy? Have you forgotten what Father said about him? That man is worthless. He speaks sweet words, but he isn't really interested in you. He's just after our family's fortune!"
"Listen to your second brother's advice and end things as soon as you can. If father finds out that you're still in contact with Zhou, he'll beat you so hard he'll break your legs!"
"No, Zhou loves me!"
"Alright, we're about to meet the Daoist. Let's all act accordingly, especially you, Song Qi. Don't make a fool of yourself in front of the Daoist, or Father won't spare you!"
The Song siblings chatted as they arrived at the hall.
Lu Yang finished off the rest of the tea in his cup with a gulp. Just what he needed to clear his palate from the dumpling taste.
The interpersonal relationships within the Song Family seemed quite complicated.
The Song siblings arrived, and just a glance from Lu Yang was enough for him to match them to the voices of their earlier conversation.
He had already met the eldest son, Song Tian.
The second son, Song Qing, was the one dressed in the scholars' robe, looking neat and tidy with one hand rested on his abdomen.
The short one with the disgruntled face was the third son, Song Qi.
The one who could not meet Lu Yang's eyes and looked fearful was the youngest daughter, Song Lian'er.
"Greetings, Daoist."
Song Tian had quite an authority in the family, and when he warned the younger siblings to behave, no one dared to act recklessly in front of Lu Yang, not even the third son, Song Qi.
"Has Father not arrived yet?" Song Tian was puzzled, it should have been time for their father to arrive.
While Song Tian was puzzled, a figure burst into the hall, gasping for breath, "Young Master...It's terrible!"
Song Tian helped the housekeeper up, a sense of foreboding rose inside him, "What's wrong? Where is Father?"
"Master is dead!"
"What?!"
The Song siblings were taken aback in unison, and the youngest sister, Song Lian'er, nearly fainted.
Even Lu Yang and his two companions did not expect that they would hear about the death of the very person they were supposed to meet!
"Let's go check it out!"
Being the eldest brother, Song Tian quickly stabilized himself and asked the housekeeper to lead them to the study.
The door to the study was closed. The housekeeper brought everyone to a window at the side of the study. The window had a large hole in it, and they could see Mr. Song lying on the floor inside, surrounded by a pool of blood, showing no signs of life.
As the housekeeper helped everyone climb through the window, he explained, "I went to the study to get the master, but no matter how much I called, there was no answer. The doors and windows from the inside were locked. This was the master's habit, he felt it gave him a sense of security. I had a bad feeling, so I broke the window and entered.
As soon as I entered the room, I saw the master lying on the floor."
Tao Yaoye and Lan Ting exchanged glances. The case appeared to be the typical locked-room murder mystery, as the door was locked and no outsider could have gotten in.
Lu Yang kept silent, not revealing what he was thinking.

chapters.title: Chapter 518 - 517: Murderer_1
chapters.content:
"Don't touch anything at the crime scene!" Song Tian shouted loudly, warning everyone not to act recklessly and ruin the scene, which would make it difficult to identify the murderer.
Tao Yaoye and Lan Ting carefully studied the setting of the study room. It was simply furnished, with two rows of bookshelves, two paintings hanging on the wall, and some yellow talismans with a exorcising effect. Apart from these, there was a desk, a wooden chair, a tea table, and a vase on the tea table... it was no different from an ordinary study room.
The door was tightly shut, and according to the housekeeper, the windows were also tightly shut and couldn't be opened from the outside.
"This is..."
The window was in disrepair, Tao Yaoye found a small hole in the corner of the window.
The housekeeper explained from the side, "Before breaking the window, I made a hole to see if master was really in trouble."
"It must be you who killed father, big brother!" The second son, Song Qing, grabbed Song Tian's collar and screamed, extremely angry, his eyes were bloodshot, like a mad dog.
Song Tian was unhappy, his eyebrow furrowed, he pushed his younger brother away and rebuked, "What nonsense are you talking about!"
"I'm not talking nonsense. Don't think I don't know. After you took over father's business, it has been losing money all the time. You suffered a big loss due to a failed investment earlier, and you dared not tell father, fearing that father would be angry and take the family business away from you!"
"Now that you have killed father, you are the primary successor, and the family business is all yours!"
Song Tian was furious, "Nonsense! You have more motive to kill than me, you failed the exam several times, and our father broke your leg out of anger, and said that if you couldn't achieve a title, you would never inherit a penny from the family property in your life! I heard once from your friend that you were partying and swearing to kill father!"
"You bribed my friend!"
"Your friend has a weakness for money."
Song Lian'er, trembling, pointed at Mr. Song's corpse and said, "Stop arguing, look, father's eyes are still open, he died with his eyes open."
Everyone looked over and found that Mr. Song had died with his eyes open, looking straight at the tea table.
The youngest son, Song Qi, followed Mr. Song's gaze and saw a blue and white porcelain vase on the tea table.
"Blue and white porcelain vase... Blue and white porcelain... Qing... Song Qing, the second brother! This is the clue father left before he died! Song Qing, you killed father!"
The second son, Song Qing, was taken aback, "Nonsense, just based on such nonsense, you say I killed him?"
"Father is extending one finger with his right hand, clearly indicating the eldest brother!"
"More importantly, who present doesn't have a motive? Third brother, you resent father for cutting off your spending money, making you lose face among your friends. By killing father and inheriting part of the family fortune, you naturally have money!"
"And little sister, father was forcing you to break up with the boy surnamed Zhou. You didn't listen and have been secretly contacting him. Once Father dies, there's no one to stop you from marrying the boy surnamed Zhou!"
Song Qing pointed out each of their motivations one by one, each having a possible motive to kill.
Tao Yaoye suddenly asked, "When was the last time you all saw Mr. Song?"
"I saw father in the yard when I was reading in the morning, then went back to my room to read, that was two and a half hours ago."
The third son hesitated and said, "An hour ago, I came to the study to take some money. When I was leaving, I ran into father entering the study room, and he scolded me."
Song Lian'er said, "I brought a bowl of tea to father in the study half an hour ago."
The housekeeper echoed, "Miss was bringing tea in, and I was just outside the door, and I haven't seen the master since then."
Lan Ting nodded, "So Mr. Song passed away less than half an hour ago."
"What were you all doing half an hour ago, and who can prove it?"
The eldest son, Song Tian, took the lead in saying, "I was checking the account book in the shop at that time. The clerks can prove it."
The second son, Song Qing, also said, "I was reading, and while no one saw me, I have a habit of reading aloud. The maids passing by the house should have heard me."
The third son, Song Qi, said, "I was drinking and watching dances with friends at the brothel. The second son of Wang's family, the eldest son of Kong's family, and people from the Sun family were all with me. However, I was drunk and fell asleep. When I woke up, I was home, and I don't know who sent me back."
Song Lian'er had tears welling up in her eyes: "After serving my father tea, I remained in my room until Big Brother came looking for me."
"Can anyone verify this?"
Song Lian'er's voice got increasingly quieter: "No."
Tao Yaoye sharp senses picked up something odd: "Hold on, you said you served Mr. Song tea. So, where is the teacup?"
There was only a blue and white porcelain vase on the tea table, but no teacups.
It's impossible that Song Lian'er would wait for Mr. Song to finish his tea before taking away the cup.
Song Lian'er stammered, unable to utter a word.
"Little sister, you must say something!" Song Qi, the third son, quickly urged, his forehead dripping with sweat.
Eventually, Song Lian'er steeled herself and said, "The housekeeper told me there's no rift between a father and a daughter that couldn't be mended. He encouraged me to talk to my father about Zhou's issue. I served tea to my father to plead with him to approve of my affair with Zhou. He got angry as soon as he heard it and threw the teacup on the floor.
The housekeeper picked up the teacup and took it away. I went back to my room and cried."
Song Tian frowned at the housekeeper, hinting his questioning: "If that's the case, housekeeper, why didn't you mention it? And you should have known that our father would never approve of Little Sister's matter!"
The housekeeper met Song Tian's gaze, panic causing him to look away.
"Look into my eyes! What were you trying to do!" Song Tian demanded fiercely.
Seeing everyone looking at him with displeasure, the housekeeper realized he couldn't avoid it, he sighed in resignation: "Actually, the man Miss likes is my illegitimate son. I wanted to match them, but I didn't expect the Master to be so adamant."
Song Lian'er looked at the housekeeper, dumbfounded. She had not expected the housekeeper and Zhou to share this connection.
So, the words of encouragement the housekeeper had always spoken to her were not to spur her to pursue love?
Song Lian'er was blank, something in her heart crumbled.
Tao Yaoye whispered, "That being the case, it's highly likely that Song Lian'er and the housekeeper conspired together! The housekeeper could have fired a poisonous ice needle from the window to kill Mr. Song, and disguised it by piercing the paper window under the pretense of investigation."
Lan Ting shook her head, holding her own views: "If so, how could the housekeeper ensure that the eldest son would let him see Mr. Song? Keep in mind, he didn't know we were coming."
"In my opinion, it is possible that it's the second son, Song Qing. He claimed that he was reading in his room, but with a Recording Orb purchased from a merchant's guild broadcasting his voice non-stop, he could easily fabricate an alibi!"
The two debated in low voices, failing to reach a consensus, so they turned to Lu Yang.
"Senior Brother Lu, who do you think is the murderer?"
Lu Yang didn't respond. He silently walked over, crouched down next to Mr. Song, and took out a Soul Returning Pill.
This was something he had purchased from the Task Hall when he went to the Wild State, fearing any surprises. He hadn't used it until now.
The elixir melted in Mr. Song's mouth and he slowly aroused, looking a bit confused.
Lu Yang explained, "Mr. Song isn't dead. His soul was stolen. I used the Soul Returning Pill to reel his soul back."
Lu Yang, frequently being possessed, was far more experienced in dealing with souls than his two junior sisters.
"Mr. Song, we three came from the Immortal Sect. Who stole your soul?"
Mr. Song was initially a bit muddled, but upon hearing Lu Yang's words, his eyes became determined, and he named his attacker:
"It was the painting."
Lu Yang turned to everyone and said, "Look, we've found the murderer."
The Song siblings: "..."
Housekeeper: "..."

chapters.title: Chapter 519 - 518: Duel of the Invincible Elixir_1
chapters.content:
After Mr. Song's resurrection, he always felt there was an odd atmosphere in his home.
He remembered his family being quite harmonious before his death, so why did he sense a subtle animosity among his children after being dead for less than an hour?
Especially towards his youngest daughter, who was kneeling on the ground and crying bitterly. Was she weeping for his death? She truly appeared to be a considerate daughter.
Regrettably, no matter what, he couldn't let her marry the boy with the last name Zhou, for they were biological siblings.
Mr. Song temporarily set aside the family matters, focusing on solving the problem with the painting scroll first.
His appearance was unsightly; his face and clothes were covered in blood, a result of him vomiting blood due to disorder in bodily functions after his soul was pulled away.
"I thank you, Master Taoist, for saving my life!"
"There's no need, Mr. Song, but might I ask what went on with the painting scroll?"
Mr. Song heaved a sigh, sat down in the chair, and began recounting the past.
"Twenty years ago, I failed in my business and intended to commit suicide by jumping off a cliff. Surprisingly, I was saved by a tree branch on my way down. A rocky outcrop protruded directly below where I fell, on which I landed, discovering a cavern in the depths."
"Something deep in the cavern was calling me. As I was not afraid of death at the time, I followed the voice and found a talking painting scroll. The scroll offered help in my business, promising to make me extremely wealthy, so I took it out of the cave."
"With the assistance of the scroll, my business ventures were indeed as smooth as silk. Successful investments one after another made me the leading merchant in the county town. As a result, I married and had children; my family was blissful and harmonious."
When Mr. Song reached this part of the story, Lu Yang and his two companions silently glanced sideways at the Song siblings and the housekeeper.
"Would you continue?"
"In recent months, the scroll had been demanding my life every night. Out of fear, I tried drowning it and burning it, all to no avail. Even if I threw it to the outskirts, it would still find its way back home the very next day!"
Upon saying this, Mr. Song's eyes were filled with terror. These days, he had been continually bothered by the scroll, leaving him mentally drained, and recently he had been frequently startled awake by it.
Lu Yang stroked his chin; this was indeed something new.
"Let's go, take us to see the scroll."
Mr. Song led the three of them down a winding path and upon activating a hidden mechanism in a small room, a secret tunnel opened, deep and utterly dark within.
The secret room was full of all kinds of gold, silver, and jewels. These items were precious for mortals, but in Lu Yang's eyes, even the tassels on his sword hilt were more valuable than these.
Amongst them, there was a conspicuous box made of iron, wrapped round and round in talismans. Mr. Song tore off the talismans, opened the iron box, and revealed the painting scroll within.
"It was this one that took away my soul."
Thinking back on what had just happened, Mr. Song was still shaken. If not for Lu Yang's Soul Returning Pill, he would have most likely been doomed.
"Just as I suspected."
The closer they got to the scroll, the stronger they felt this gloomy aura.
Lu Yang unfurled the scroll; on it was an ink landscape painting, depicting a Washing Lady washing clothes by the riverside.
All of a sudden, the scroll distorted, and the Washing Lady, as if coming to life, slowly turned her head to gaze at the individuals outside the painting.
"Another cultivator?"
Water stains seeped out from the scroll and floated into the air, coalescing into the figure of the Washing Lady.
"Was it you who pulled his soul back?"
The Washing Lady glared at Lu Yang, hostility distorting her beautiful facial features.
"Cultivator, better not meddle in my business."
Feeling the intense threat emanating from Lu Yang's trio, she knew they were not like other cultivators she had previously encountered. If she could convince them to leave without resorting to a confrontation, that would be the best.
The Washing Lady pointed at Mr. Song and coldly said, "Twenty years ago, he promised me that as long as I helped him become a local tycoon, he would offer his soul to me. Two decades have passed; his family is happy, his business successful, and he is an affluent individual - it's time for him to fulfill his promise!"
"Is this true?"
Lu Yang turned his gaze towards Mr. Song, not at all surprised. There were definitely some details that Mr. Song had omitted; otherwise, why would the painting scroll assist him in his business dealings?
There must be something requested in return.
The Water Ghost he had met in Hanshui City helped people commit insurance fraud in exchange for salt, all operate on the same principle.
Mr. Song nodded in shame.
"Do you see?" The Washing Lady sneered, looking at Mr. Song scornfully.
"It was a mutually agreed promise back then, there weren't any falsehoods involved. Now, I am seeking to fulfil the promise, what's wrong with that?"
Lu Yang shook his head slowly, looking at the Washing Lady with pity in his eyes. "Have you read the penal code of the Great Xia?"
"The Great Xia Penal Code?"
A light smirk appeared at the corner of Lu Yang's mouth. He activated the Invincible Elixir and said, "The Great Xia penal code states that the injured party's promise to other parties, which allows infringement of specific legally protected interests, such as disposals of property and causing minor and severe injuries, are invalid if they result in death."
"Of course, not all promises resulting in death are invalid. Except for circumstances such as deathmatches, where no coercion was involved, such promises are enforceable; but your actions don't fall into these rare situations."
"If you were more studious and had learned Great Xia's legal history, you would know that many magic artifacts of the Demon Path in the past, used the fulfillment of desires as the bait, enticing others to exchange their lives for it, thereby achieving the purpose of refining their souls."
"At the time, the Minister of Justice noticed this situation and thus incorporated this clause into the Great Xia legal code to prevent magic artifacts like you from doing such things."
Lu Yang sighed, looking at the Washing Lady as though he was seeing an ignorant individual: "It seems we have not done a good job in promoting an understanding of the law."
Ever since learning of his master's frequent arrests, Lu Yang devoted his spare time to studying law, with the hopes of following his master's footsteps.
Now it seemed, studying law was indeed beneficial.
While many people have knowledge of the law, they often find themselves in a dilemma where they don't know which laws to apply and when.
But Lu Yang was different. He had the Invincible Elixir. When disputing over the law, utilizing the Invincible Elixir helped him select the most appropriate laws from his mind in the shortest amount of time.
It's important to note that the Invincible Elixir couldn't choose laws that Lu Yang had never learned before. After all, the conditions for victory given by the Invincible Elixir were based on Lu Yang's existing knowledge.
Fairy Eternity, observing from the spiritual space, was amazed. As the creator of the Invincible Elixir, she had never thought that the Elixir could be employed in this manner.
Tao Yaoye secretly sent a telepathic message to Lan Ting, "Junior Sister Lan, did you know about this?"
Lan Ting shook her head in confusion. "No, our sect doesn't teach this."
Both of them could see confusion in each other's eyes, feeling as though an invisible chasm had formed between them and Senior Brother Lu.
"You've already committed an offense under the penal law by seizing Mr. Song's soul, constituting attempted murder. Come with us."
The Washing Lady let out a cold chuckle, undeterred by Lu Yang's threat. "Don't think that just because you've read the penal code, you're the only one who understands. To tell you the truth, I am a magic artifact, and I am not under the jurisdiction of the penal law!"
Lu Yang looked up at the Washing Lady, saying, "Oh! Is that so? Then it's even better. Since you're an unowned artifact, there will be no problem if I destroy you."
Lan Ting looked somewhat puzzled- why did the conversation sound so familiar?
"Arrogant! Do you really believe I'm afraid of three little cultivators like you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 520 - 519: Watch me confess for you! _1
chapters.content:
The Washing Lady was unwilling to fight against Lu Yang and his companions, but that didn't mean she couldn't fight them!
They thought they could defeat her as if she were made of mud!?
A scroll hung in mid-air, and water continuously poured out from it, as if a waterfall was cascading, filling the entire secret chamber.
Seeing this, Lu Yang grabbed Mr. Song by the collar and ran out. While Lu Yang's cultivation level meant he would be fine, Mr. Song was an ordinary mortal and could be drowned within a minute if he remained in the secret chamber.
The group barely made it back to the surface when there was a loud bang, the small house built over the secret chamber was demolished, and the water from the scroll surged out like a fountain. The Washing Lady stood atop the water, looking down at Lu Yang from above.
Without intending to, Lu Yang tasted a few drops of water and seemed to have discovered something shocking.
"This is...freshwater!"
Tao Yaoye: "?"
Lan Ting: "?"
What was Senior Brother Lu Yang talking about?
Why does it matter if it's salty or freshwater? Isn't it normal for it to be freshwater?
Feeling the gazes of his two junior sisters, Lu Yang cleared his throat, acting as if nothing unusual had happened.
From his experience in Hanshui City dealing with water ghost, Lu Yang had developed a habit of determining whether the water used by his enemies was freshwater or saltwater.
The Washing Lady flicked her sleeve, and the spring under her feet divided into three streams, forming three water pythons, which raced towards the three of them.
Fearlessly, Lu Yang drew the Green Peak Sword, and powerful Sword Qi shot up into the sky. He struck at the water pythons, initially capable of dividing and multiplying. However, his sword contained countless mini Sword Qi that continuously pierced the water droplets, not giving a chance for new water pythons to form.
Tao Yaoye opened the Thousand Illusion Umbrella, the red umbrella-face served like a shield. The water python that slammed into it instantly dissipated.
The sash tied around Lan Ting's waist danced and extended longer, binding the water python aimed at her. The water python squirmed on the ground, shaking the earth as it attempted to break free from the sash's hold.
"Well, it seems I may have underestimated you!" The Washing Lady was secretly astonished. Her surprise attack, which could trouble even an ordinary Nascent Soul Stage cultivator, was surprisingly blocked by these three youngsters.
"Disperse!"
At her command, the three water pythons fell apart like melting snow in winter, scattering all around, then reformed into a waterfall that was several meters high.
The waterfall came plunging down, engulfing all three.
"Reel in!"
As the Washing Lady shouted out, Lu Yang, his companions, the water, and even she herself disappeared, leaving only the stunned Mr. Song and the fallen scroll.
"Is this inside the painting?" Lu Yang lowered his eyes to his hands. His hands were stripped of their skin, flesh, and blood; in black and white, they looked lifelike.
He had become a figure in a painting, with his entire body formed of ink wash.
"I haven't seen Junior Sister Tao and Lan Ting. Were we separated? That Washing Lady is craftier than I thought."
He had seen this spell used before. Back when his senior sisters and brothers were taking turns beating him, one of the senior sisters who was skilled in art had used it.
Breaking this spell was simple enough - defeating the spellcaster would allow him to return to his own state.
Of course, if the spellcaster defeated Lu Yang, he would also return to his own state. No need to explain how he knew this.
...
"Am I inside the painting?"
Lan Ting observed her surroundings and quickly made her judgement.
The Washing Lady appeared out of nowhere, putting Lan Ting on alert.
The Washing Lady raised her hand, signaling Lan Ting to hold back. "Don't attack, I have no ill intentions."
"Little girl, is there anything you wish for? I can make it come true, the price is your sparing my life."
From their previous exchange, the Washing Lady had concluded that she couldn't defeat all three at once and decided to pick them off one by one.
The wish and its price were rules laid by the person who created the scroll. Even the Washing Lady was bound by these rules.
If she couldn't fulfill the promised wish, she would be punished. Conversely, if she could fulfill the wish, her combat power would increase.
"Any wish is possible?" Lan Ting kept a wary eye on her.
"Just speak your mind, as long as it's within my power."
Lan Ting slowly uttered, her cheeks slightly reddening. "For instance, confessing my feelings to Senior Brother Lu Yang, and having him accept them?"
The Washing Lady looked Lan Ting over. She was pretty and had a good figure. Men would be attracted to women like her.
"That's an easy task."
The Washing Lady transformed into the likeness of Lan Ting. "Watch me confess for you!"
A similar scene also happened with Tao Yaoye. The Washing Lady was utterly confused, not understanding the appeal that this male cultivator seemed to hold for these two beautiful women.
...
"Senior Brother Lu Yang, I have finally found you."
The Washing Lady split into two, taking on the appearances of Lan Ting and Tao Yaoye. Acting startled and terrified, she ran towards Lu Yang.
The two women pounced on Lu Yang, causing him to panic.
He had never experienced such a situation before.
"Tao Yaoye", with teary eyes and a blush coloring her cheeks, looked at Lu Yang invitingly. "Senior Brother Lu Yang, I've always…"
"Lan Ting" quickly interjected, "Actually, I too…"
Lu Yang raised his hand, interrupting the two. "My dear junior sisters, don't you think I understand your feelings? But we are siblings in the sect, it's not appropriate to do things that breach moral principles. How would others perceive us?"
"Tao Yaoye", with determination in her eyes, said, "Senior Brother, I do not fear the judgments of others!"
Lan Ting echoed, "Exactly, Senior Brother, we live for ourselves, not for others' opinions. Can the judgment of others determine everything?"
Lu Yang was increasingly troubled. The more he thought about it, the more he felt something was off. "But I lack cultivation and experience, I'm afraid I'm not as perfect as you imagine."
"That's fine, Senior Brother, imperfections are okay."
"Right, right, who is perfect?"
Lu Yang shook his head, "Even if I were to agree, would the Sixth Elder and Palace Master Luo agree to such absurd things?"
"They would agree!"
Lu Yang thought he had been tactful enough. Seeing his junior sisters' determination, he had no choice but to say, "But both of you have Immortal bodies, and I have a Sword Spirit Root, I know nothing about Immortal bodies. Even if you were to take me as your master, I wouldn't be able to teach you anything."
"Apprentice to you?"
"Yes, weren't you both impressed by my performance in the finals, becoming the top cultivator in the mid-stage of the Golden Core, and wish to become my disciples?"
As someone who had lived for two generations, Lu Yang, who had no experience in romantic relationships, couldn't fully understand the behavior of women. The Invincible Elixir couldn't help in these matters either.
However, he had the aid of Fairy Eternity, who had mentioned early on when she woke up that as a woman, she understood women the best and could help him win over any girls he liked.
The Washing Lady: "..."
The confession failed. Since the wish couldn't be fulfilled, the Washing Lady's aura faded, and she could no longer maintain the scroll, spitting the three of them out.
She looked at Lu Yang warily, "I really underestimated you. You figured out my rules!"
Lu Yang was clueless, not understanding what the Washing Lady was talking about.
And why did he suddenly appear outside? Wasn't he supposed to defeat the spellcaster to get out?

chapters.title: Chapter 521 - 520: The Elusive Washing Lady_1
chapters.content:
With the rules broken and the Washing Lady's momentum greatly weakened, Lu Yang seized the opportunity and made his move first.
"Beheading Mantra!"
After Daoist Buyu's enlightenment, Lu Yang's understanding of what he saw had reached a higher level, and the power of the original Beheading Mantra was also different from the past.
The Washing Lady was split in two, screaming painfully, and she turned into two streams of ink, retreating back into the scroll.
Within the scroll, the Washing Lady's expression was filled with resentment. She glared at Lu Yang but didn't dare to show her face again, instead hiding within the scroll.
She wanted to kill, but she had realized from the fight just now that she would struggle even against Lu Yang alone, not to mention three people.
"Cultivator, I admit you are stronger than me, you win this time!"
If she was done speaking, the scroll floated up, ready to escape with a fast speed.
"Escape?"
The scroll flew, but Lu Yang's sword was faster. He once again cast the Beheading Mantra. With a single stroke, he cut the scroll down from the sky. The scroll fell, but without any damage.
Lu Yang clicked his tongue. he hadn't expected that the quality of the scroll would be higher than he estimated. With his current level, he couldn't cut it off.
"Cultivator, you are indeed strong, but you can't push things to an extreme. Let me go now, and I promise I won't come back, and I won't hurt Mr. Song. If you keep blocking my escape, you may protect the Song family for a while, but can you protect them forever?"
Lu Yang sneered, unmoved, and poked the scroll with his sword tip, "Don't think I don't know that such a magic artifact like you has its own rules. You've completed the goal for Mr. Song and you have to get your reward. If you don't claim your reward, at best your foundation will be shaken, at worst your intellect will be wiped out!"
The Washing Lady remained silent, not expecting that her rules would be figured out by Lu Yang so quickly, but she couldn't admit it: "Nonsense!"
Lu Yang didn't bother to argue with the Washing Lady. Regardless of what was said, he had to take the scroll away to ensure Mr. Song's safety.
Tao Yaoye and Lan Ting both chose to trust Lu Yang's judgment. Tao Yaoye stepped forward and took the scroll with her identity jade.
But the scroll quickly flew out of the jade.
"You think you can trap me with this thing?" The Washing Lady sneered. Though she was a masterless magic artifact, any storage ring could take her, but she could control the scroll and escape from the storage ring at any time. No one could catch her.
Tao Yaoye and Lan Ting tried twice with the identity jade, but the scroll escaped each time.
The two women looked serious. If they couldn't take the scroll away, once they left, the scroll would probably retaliate against Mr. Song's family.
"Let me try."
Lu Yang took the scroll. Initially, the Washing Lady didn't care much, but a force of absorption from Lu Yang's palm changed her expression.
Lu Yang used the Village in the Palm method, drawing the scroll into his palm.
"Success? Senior Brother Lu, what technique is this?" The two women were surprised and had never seen this move before.
"A spatial type great divine skill - Universe within the Sleeve." Lu Yang said lightly.
"Don't think you can trap me just because you know a spatial divine ability!" Lu Yang's palm transmits the voice of the Washing Lady. She escapes once again.
Lu Yang scratched his chin, used his Village in the Palm method again, drew the Washing Lady into it and then clapped his hands.
The Washing Lady, who fell into Lu Yang's palm, didn't know what was happening. She thought it was just a repetition of an old trick. She controlled the scroll to fly from the left palm to the right, then from the right palm back to the left, but she couldn't find an exit.
"Strange, where is the exit?"
Fortunately, she wasn't cultivating for the first time. She had seen many cultivators and spatial types of divine abilities; such divine abilities consume spiritual essence too quickly and can't be constantly used. With Lu Yang's cultivation level, he could only maintain it for three to five minutes.
"Senior Brother, is this going to work?" Tao Yaoye curiously watched as Lu Yang clapped his hands together. The more she watched, the more he seemed like a monk.
"Not yet. Using the Universe in the Sleeve consumes a lot of spiritual energy. I can only maintain it for a quarter of an hour."
"Then what do we do?" Mr. Song was anxious. Judging by the Washing Lady's intentions, she would surely retaliate against his family once she escaped.
He once had a crush on the Washing Lady too.
"It's okay. Consuming the Great Recovery Pill can prolong the casting time of the divine ability, and it should work for an hour."
"But we can't make it back to the sect in an hour." Lan Ting began to worry too and started thinking of solutions.
Lu Yang shook his head: "It's okay, I already have a plan."
…
"Dear customer, are you sure you want to sell a scroll-type magic artifact that carries a spirit device?" The manager of the Land Money Trade Association asked politely, his eyes shining.
A magic artifact carrying a spirit device can sell for a sky-high price.
This customer just looked a bit unusual; he held his hands in a prayer position, and the two female cultivators on his sides were like protectors, feeding him an elixir from time to time.
Is he some sort of a joyful Zen monk?
It was by necessity; Lu Yang couldn't free his hands to take the medicine, so he had to ask his two junior sisters to feed him the elixir.
Mr. Song volunteered to do this job at first, but he was intimidated by the stares of Tao Yaoye and Lan Ting.
"Daoist Lu, are you sure this can work?" Mr. Song asked softly, feeling a little insecure.
As Yuanhe County was remote and had a corrupt local custom where dumpling stalls often overcharged customers, the Land Money Trade Association didn't have a branch there.
Lu Yang and his group hence had to go to Qingshui County.
"Of course."
"But what if the scroll runs back to my house?"
"Then you're making a profit. You can sell it again."
"That makes sense."
Mr. Song always felt that there was something not quite right.
If Lu Yang himself couldn't hold the Washing Lady for a long time, he didn't believe the Trade Association couldn't either.
If they couldn't even trap a magic artifact, what reputation would the Trade Association have left?
The Trade Association heard that a magic artifact with a spirit device was for sale, and they immediately invited their senior appraiser to verify the authenticity of the magic artifact.
"My magic artifact is quite fast," Lu Yang reminded.
The branch manager laughed and pointed at the room, "With twelve different array methods deployed inside and outside this room. I want to see what kind of magic artifact can escape from here!"
Lu Yang opened his hand and Washing Lady drove the scroll to fly out of his palm in a flash.
Crash!
She collided head-on with the wall and fell to the ground.
The senior appraiser picked up the scroll, employed a secret method, and saw miniature array methods that appeared one after another before his eyes. With the effect of these array methods, he could decipher the structure of the scroll.
The appraiser stroked his white mustache and smiled with interest, "Interesting, it's made of Spirit Transformation-grade materials, but the person who refined it wasn't skilled enough to bring out the full potential of the materials. Even so, this magic artifact has a spirit device, which is extremely rare, not to mention that this one even contains rules."
"Three million spirit stones, how about this offer?" The appraiser gave the price with a cheerful smile.
Lu Yang thought for a while, removed the identity jade from his waist, and handed it to the appraiser, "I'm from the Seek Dao Sect."
"Five million spirit stones."
The appraiser immediately corrected his price on the spot.
Lu Yang continued, "I am Lu Yang, my brother is Meng Jingzhou, the young master of the Meng family. The two junior sisters behind me are from the same sect as me and one from Laurel Fairy Palace."
"Six million spirit stones."
The branch manager immediately raised the price on the spot.
Fearing that Lu Yang would continue speaking, he quickly added, "Really can't add any more. Let us make a bit too."
The Land Money Trade Association, as the largest trade association in the continent, also had cases where sellers undercut prices.
Although Lu Yang didn't know the market, he could bring out his identity to prevent the other party from undercutting the price.

chapters.title: Chapter 522 - 522: 521
chapters.content:
"Here, your Spirit Stones." After leaving the trade association, Lu Yang handed the storage ring from the trade association to Mr. Song.
Mr. Song was taken aback and almost dropped the storage ring. This was six million Spirit Stones. Was he just giving them away like that?
"No, no, no, I dare not take so many Spirit Stones, ten thousand, just ten thousand is enough." Mr. Song was but an ordinary person. If others knew he had so many Spirit Stones, he dared not bet on whether the public order of the Great Xia could deter them.
If he didn't want to take them, then he would just take a tiny bit.
Seeing Mr. Song like this, Lu Yang knew he had his concerns and did not insist. He sent Mr. Song back to Yuanhe County.
Then he distributed two million each to the two Junior Sisters.
Lu Yang never attached much importance to Spirit Stones. First, he had patent fees and also the earnings from the barbecue shop. These two added up, except for a wealthy person like Meng Jingzhou who has gained fortunes from his ancestors, as well as someone like Tao Yaoye who has ideas ahead of their time, no one in the younger generation is as wealthy as Lu Yang.
Secondly, he did not need Spirit Stones.
Magic artifacts; he had the Green Peak Sword given by the Eldest Senior Sister, and the Dark Moon Sword used by the Qilin Immortal.
Materials and treasures for cultivation, large Dan Spirit soil , could be exchanged at any time in the Task Hall, or picked some ginseng baby hairs.
As for cultivation methods, they were all in the Scripture Pavilion.
That was the advantage of being in a major sect, enough resources for cultivation, just focus on Cultivation.
The establishment of the Task Hall was not for the disciples to be busy with completing tasks, but for them to travel and learn, punish evil and promote good, so as not to lose their emotions in the process of cultivation.
The Seek Dao Sect has always disapproved of forgetting emotions for cultivation.
Looking at the Five Immortals of the Ancients, Lu Yang guessed that none of them had completely ignored their emotions, especially the Qilin Immortal.
The most famous force advocating forgetting emotions for cultivation was the Ruthless Sect.
"I have encountered several who claim to be emotionless, saying they are wholeheartedly dedicated to the Dao, and they are indeed ruthless in their actions. There are three who have killed their wives and children to prove their path of the Dao, and two who have turned all their clansmen into magical artifacts, not sparing a single family member.
Lu Yang thought for a moment and got the point. He did not expect the Fairy Eternity, who seemed naive and seemingly slow-witted, to think so clearly on this issue.
Upon leaving Yuanhe County and on his way back to Qingshui County, Lu Yang remembered he practices Swordsmanship, capable of sword flight, there was no need for him to ride a horse.
The Green Peak Sword rose up, three feet off the ground, Lu Yang leaped onto it, hands behind his back, robes fluttering in the wind, looking very impressive.
"Now you look like a Sword Immortal."
Lu Yang had heard of a special fighting method among swordsmen. Two swordsmen would stand facing each other, directing their swords towards each other. The one who was knocked down would lose.
Lu Yang felt that if he were to participate in this kind of fight, he could only use a flying car instead.
"Lu Yang, a Divinity Transformation Stage cultivator is targeting you." Fairy Eternity warned.
"A Divinity Transformation Stage cultivator?"
Lu Yang abruptly halted his Flying Sword, hair stood on end, with a boom, the figure dissipating the smoke and dust emerged to block Lu Yang and his two Junior Sisters.
"How audacious, daring to sell my magic artifact to the trade association! Seems like you are tired of living!"
The cold aura the figure emitted made Lu Yang and the two Junior Sisters' hearts jolt, reminding them about the invincible elixir, it was an early warning telling Lu Yang to run away quickly.
"Your magic artifact?"
Tao Yaoye was still confused. If the picture scroll had an owner, how could it be taken into the storage ring?
Lu Yang thought in the figure's position and understood: "You were worried that the Great Xia would trace the magic artifact back to you, so you erased your imprint in the magic artifact. You plan on reaping after the magic artifact takes possession of a person?"
"Not bad, quite smart." The cold figure didn't expect Lu Yang to be so quick to understand the reason.
However, this still did not change the fate awaiting Lu Yang.
"Looking at your jade tags, two from the Seek Dao Sect and one from Laurel Fairy Palace?"
"You dare to attack us even though you know our identities?"
The cold figure chuckled low, "What difference does it make if you're from the Immortal Sect? Even if the sect possesses magical abilities, it won't detect me when you lot die here!"
Lu Yang squinted his eyes. Whether the other party genuinely didn't know or was pretending, the sect could calculate the causality if a disciple was to get hurt. The perpetrator would definitely not be able to escape.
Tao Yaoye and Lan Ting were on high alert, silently gripping their weapons, ready to attack at any second.
"Dare to harm our boss's guests, die!"
Another cold voice rang out from the sky. A figure holding a nine-section whip cracked it towards the cold figure, with eerie ghost fire ignited on the whip. The Green Charm Ghost Fire, relentless in pursuit, was just like a painful ailment that clings to one's bones.
The two sides engaged in battle, deducting the magic artifacts. In less than a hundred rounds, the cold figure was captured by the master of the nine-section whip.
"You guys, come with us. Our boss wants to meet you."
The master of the nine-section whip gave a cold look to the three of them, his tone not leaving room for dispute.
The master of the nine-section whip was also at the Divinity Transformation Stage, but considering he effortlessly defeated the cold figure, his strength could be considered exceptional even among those at the Divinity Transformation Stage.
Tao Yaoye slightly shivered, she had seen this master of the nine-section whip before. It was when she went to the barbecue shop with Senior Brother Lu Yang. At that time, this guy was standing behind Vice Headmaster Shi, likely Vice Headmaster Shi's right-hand man.
His name was... Huo Huashen, possibly?
Why would people from the Nine Nether Sect come looking for them?
What was their intention?
Tao Yaoye didn't dare to delve further into her thoughts.
Even though Lan Ting didn't recognize Huo Huashen, judging by the aura he exuded, she felt he meant them no good.
Should they run? But the man's power clearly surpassed theirs by far. How would they escape?
"Who is your boss, and why does he want to see us?" Tao Yaoye asked warily, looking at Huo Huashen.
Huo Huashen gave Tao Yaoye a cold glance, "You'll know when you get there."
Tao Yaoye and Lan Ting turned to Lu Yang for help; he nodded. "Let's follow them and see."
The four of them remained quiet throughout the journey, making for an oppressive atmosphere. Huo Huashen led the way, bringing the three of them to a small pavilion.
This pavilion was in the middle of nowhere; it was extremely secluded, with no people passing by.
A man was sitting in the pavilion. He was dressed in black, looking as deep as an abyss. Just a glance was enough to feel like falling into an ice cave. Indeed, a major demon capable of causing a massacre.
It was Vice Headmaster Shi Huagu, one of the three deputy leaders of the Nine Nether Sect.
"Boss, the guests are here, and we've made sure no one else will come."
"I know. Stand in the back."
After Huo Huashen acknowledged, he moved to stand behind Shi Huagu and didn't utter a word, looking like a statue.
"So, you must be Mr. Tao, the creator of Dream Mirage, your reputation precedes you. I'm finally meeting you in person."
"The Dream Mirage has been a hit. Mr. Tao, you must have made quite a bit from the spirit stones. Nice."
Upon hearing this, Tao Yaoye broke out in a cold sweat. Unexpectedly, the ambition of the Nine Nether Sect was centered on her.
Did they have their eyes on Dream Mirage? Were they on a money grab, or did they want the patent?
"It's just some mortals watching, didn't make much." Tao Yaoye plucked up the courage and replied.
"Didn't make much? Mr. Tao, that's an uninteresting comment."
"So what is it that you want?"
"People die for money, and birds die for food. With Mr. Tao's wisdom, can't you guess what I want?"
Shi Huagu lifted the corner of his mouth in a cold smile.
"Mr. Tao, can you help us advertise our barbecue shop through Dream Mirage? We have enough budget, and the price is negotiable."

chapters.title: Chapter 523 - 522: Publicity Method_1
chapters.content:
Tao Yaoye paused for two seconds, then spurted out two words: "What?"
It wasn't that she didn't hear what Vice Headmaster Shi was saying, she just felt that his words didn't match the previous atmosphere.
Lan Ting was as stunned as Tao Yaoye.
Given the atmosphere just now, if Huo Huashen and Vice Headmaster Shi each held a large machete to their necks and demanded money, she wouldn't be surprised at all.
Lu Yang, on the other hand, had some expectations.
Rather, he had thought about this when Tao Yaoye first invented the Dream Mirage.
Even when Tao Yaoye first interacted with Vice Headmaster Shi at the barbecue restaurant with Lu Yang, he told her not to be too nervous when meeting people from the Nine Nether, as they might need her help someday.
At that time, Tao Yaoye didn't understand.
Originally, Lu Yang wanted to use his identity in Heaven's Court to find an opportunity to suggest to Vice Headmaster Shi to cooperate with Tao Yaoye. However, after a second thought, he found that it would seem that Heaven's Court overvalues the status of the barbecue shop, which might arouse suspicion in Vice Headmaster Shi, so he gave up on this idea.
It seemed that Vice Headmaster Shi was rather smart, thinking of cooperating with Junior Sister Tao without being reminded.
Vice Headmaster Shi, thinking that he had spoken too suddenly, smiled faintly.
"I wonder if Mr. Tao has heard of 'Come Again Barbecue'? My surname is Shi, I am the owner of the barbecue shop."
Seeing Tao Yaoye and Lan Ting still dazed, Lu Yang showed a surprised look: "The recently popular chain that has spread all over the continent, and all who have tried it can't stop praising 'Come Again Barbecue'?!"
"This must be Talent Lu, who managed to fight on par with the Young Master of Heaven's Court, truly a pride of our generation of cultivators."
The compliment from Vice Headmaster Shi was sincere, he knew well about Lu Yang's background. Being the personal disciple of Bean Tianzun and the designated next Master, Young Master Lu's talent would even make ancient immortals cautious, which speaks volumes about his strength.
Who would have thought that even someone as strong as Young Master Lu could encounter an opponent that is on equal footing with him!
"I've heard a lot about Mr. Tao. Mr. Tao is truly talented, able to create such a novel thing as the Dream Mirage, causing a stir in the Great Xia. Truly an achiever at a young age."
Vice Headmaster Shi lamented internally, such is the gap between people. Look at Tao Yaoye, not even twenty years old, already a millionaire. This was just the beginning, compared to himself, two thousand years old, owing a billion in debt, being struck by lightning every month.
"The person who brought you guys here is my subordinate, also the manager of the first barbecue restaurant, his surname is Huo."
"He isn't good at talking, and I've advised him not to speak out of turn. I hope he didn't say anything impolite on the way here."
Tao Yaoye thought to herself that he indeed didn't say anything impolite. In fact, he didn't speak at all, which was more frightening.
"I'm not sure how Mr. Shi intends to use the Dream Mirage for advertising?"
"Well, there's a waiting time before the Dream Mirage starts, right? I'm thinking of using that time to advertise our barbecue shop."
Tao Yaoye hesitated slightly: "But that time is only one minute, can such a short time be used for advertising?"
"One minute is enough, we'll produce a one-minute ad." Vice Headmaster Shi smiled, he had already done his research.
After these days of running the shop, Shi Huagu summarized two conditions for the shop's prosperity. One is a good reputation, meaning favorable taste and service to attract repeat customers, and the other is good advertising to build a name.
The Dream Mirage is growing much faster than their barbecue shop, countless people are watching it every day. It's an excellent method of advertising, definitely much more effective than running commercials at the Land Money Trade Association!
Vice Headmaster Shi's decision to use the Dream Mirage for advertising is based on multiple considerations. As an old demon, he has his own ideas.
One reason is the effective advertising. Another is Tao Yaoye's identity - a disciple of the Seek Dao Sect.
It's not easy to find an opportunity to cooperate with the Seek Dao Sect, this is an excellent opportunity to establish a connection with them!
Look at the Eternity Sect. They're trying everything possible to expand their influence in the Seek Dao Sect, infiltrating the sect, using both intrigue and clandestine methods.
It's not easy to establish a connection with the Seek Dao Sect.
If this effort succeeds, they, the Nine Nether, will publicly cooperate with the Seek Dao Sect while secretly cooperating with Heaven's Court. With back-up on both Righteous and Demon Paths, they'd be prepared for all eventualities, flexible and adaptable, taking all advantages into account!
"As for the expenses, what do you have in mind, Mr. Tao? Everything is negotiable."
Vice Headmaster Shi was prepared to go all out. This was an important means of advertising for the barbecue shop, and an opportunity to establish a connection with the Seek Dao Sect. He couldn't begrudge spending spirit stones.
Fearing that Tao Yaoye might refuse to cooperate, he even arranged for an actor to play the master of the Washing Lady, attempting to kill Lu Yang and the others on their way, and then let Huo Huashen save the day.
That way, they would owe him a favor, and be sure to agree to cooperate.
Under these circumstances, they were not likely to ask for a high price even.
In fact, this plan has flaws if you think about it. The one that put a ward against Lu Yang and the others was at the Divinity Transformation Stage. It took her twenty years just to harvest an ordinary human soul from Mr. Song. Even if you consider that she was being cautious with her demonic cultivation, the efficiency of secretly killing was extremely low.
Lu Yang saw through this, but he didn't point it out.
There's no need to. The barbecue shop is their own business. Even if Vice Headmaster Shi didn't use these methods, Lu Yang also wanted to use the Dream Mirage to advertise the barbecue shop.
Tao Yaoye was torn, this was the first time she had encountered such a thing and didn't know how much would be appropriate to ask for.
She sneakily glanced at Lu Yang, seeking his help.
She was afraid to use her Spiritual Sense to communicate telepathically with Shi Huagu around, fearing he might intercept it.
Lu Yang didn't know the market price either, this was the first case. He leaned slightly forward and asked with a smile, "I wonder how many Spirit Stones Mr. Shi is prepared to spend, and how long he wants to buy the advertising rights for?"
Shi Huagu didn't expect the other party to throw the problem back at him.
He gritted his teeth and said, "Ten million, for one year of advertising rights!"
Ten million, that's all a common Divinity Transformation Stage cultivator could accumulate in his lifetime. If it's a Divinity Transformation Stage cultivator from an influential family, there would be more money.
"Mr. Shi, you do love a joke." Lu Yang chuckled lightly as he took out the Storage Ring given to him by the association and placed it on the stone table.
"The three of us can earn six million for completing a mission, ten million doesn't seem to be enough, does it?"
Lu Yang wasn't bragging. Based on the earnings from each of his previous missions, earning six million this time was on the lower side. The last time he did a mission, he went out to cheer up Li Haoran and incidentally established the Heaven's Court. The time before last, he killed a tiger demon to solve the Ghoul problem, and incidentally infiltrated the Eternity Sect.
These were gains that couldn't be measured by spirit stones. The earnings from each of those missions were higher than this one.
"Twenty... no, thirty million!"
Shi Huagu's heart was bleeding. Nobody has used the Dream Mirage for advertising before. If it fails, this thirty million is just wasted.
Lu Yang still had the same relaxed and contented look, "A fixed price, fifty million, for one-minute ads at the beginning within a year, plus scenes of eating skewers in 'Come Again Barbecue' will appear in the Dream Mirage."
Vice Headmaster Shi hesitated, he hadn't thought of this method of advertising.
If the advertising is truly successful, fifty million might not be off the mark.
Thinking of the booming business of the barbecue shop, and the generous Heaven's Court, Shi Huagu set his mind, "Alright, fifty million it is!"
"Mr. Shi will be glad to have cooperated with us."

chapters.title: Chapter 524 - 523: Debt Repayment Thunder_1
chapters.content:
"This storage ring contains ten million Spirit Stones, which serve as a deposit. Please accept it, Mr. Tao."
Vice Headmaster Shi felt the pinch, as he had originally planned to use this ten million to acquire the rights to promotions, but now, this ten million has turned into a mere deposit.
"I need to reallocate funds to amass the remaining forty million, so I ask for your patience for about half a month, Mr. Tao."
"We have not yet completed capturing the one-minute promotional fantasy realm, so after half a month, the promotional fantasy realm, along with the forty million Spirit Stones, will be delivered to Mr. Tao."
"This is a wooden tag used for contact." Vice Headmaster Shi handed Tao Yaoye a wooden tag about the size of a palm. He has also given one to Lu Yang.
"Once the Spirit Stones have been collected, we will contact Mr. Tao through the wooden tag."
Shi Huagu's attitude couldn't be more thoughtful.
As Lu Yang had said before, in this matter, it was the Nine Nether Sect begging Tao Yaoye to do something; Tao Yaoye was the one holding the initiative.
"Fine, I have other business to attend to, so I will not keep your company any longer." Shi Huagu slowly rose to his feet, gave a signal to Huo Huashen, and asked him to see Lu Yang and the others out.
Huo Huashen understood what was intended and took out an eyedropper from his storage ring and handed it to Shi Huagu.
Shi Huagu in shock: "..."
"I asked you to see them off!"
If it weren't for Huo Huashen's high potential and given the time, he could become Vice Headmaster or even Headmaster, Shi Huagu would have slapped this bastard to death!
Huo Huashen thought to himself, can this be blamed on me? Your honor's one glance implicates a lot, who can understand that?
After Huo Huashen saw off the three of them, and they had walked about two miles, they heard a thundering sound behind them that startled them.
They turned around and saw a radical change in the weather where Shi Huagu was. The sky was filled with dark clouds, and there was lightning and thunder, as if apocalypse were imminent.
This was a Thunder Tribulation that posed a threat to life even at the Unification stage. Even though they were so far apart, they could still feel the pressure from the thunder…
"Wait, why don't I feel any pressure?" Lu Yang was puzzled. Judging by the looks on the faces of his two junior sisters and Huo Huashen, the power of thunder should have reached here.
Why doesn't he feel anything at all?
"Of course, it's because this fairy is present." Fairy Eternity stepped forward and boasted, her chin raised high in pride.
"Are you really so powerful, Fairy?" Lu Yang was very surprised, he did not expect Fairy Eternity to have such great influence.
"Naturally, most of the thunder tribulations originate from the Tribulation Dao Fruit blessed by Yingtian Immortal. So why wouldn't the thunder tribulation respect me?"
Although Yingtian Immortal was not the creator of thunder tribulation, his merit was in promoting and diversifying the methods and types of thunder tribulation.
For the first time, Lu Yang realized how significant Fairy Eternity's influence was - even the thunder tribulation had to give her face.
It seems that Yingtian Immortal left quite a psychological shadow on Fairy Eternity.
"Looking at this situation, this thunder tribulation should be the Debt Repayment Thunder tribulation, specially designed to punish those who owe money and refuse to repay it."
Lu Yang remembered that Huo Huashen had taken a part of Qin Haoran's inheritance from him, and the content of the inheritance was related to the IOU...
Lu Yang made sure that Huo Huashen, standing next to him, was still alive and marveled at how much importance Vice Headmaster Shi placed on Huo Huashen. Lu Yang was impressed that he had managed to survive this ordeal.
"The name of this thunder tribulation seems a bit too plain, doesn't it?" Lu Yang thought about it. In his impression, thunder tribulation should have names such as Shangqing, Zixiao, Guiji, Six-C, Six-A.
You named it Debt Repayment Thunder, why not name it IOU Thunder?
Yingtian Immortal, do you know how to name things?
"I think the names I came up with are fine."
Lu Yang suddenly came to a realization, and his expression twinkled as if he'd had an epiphany: "So it was you, Fairy, who named it! No wonder the name carries a return to simplicity. After thinking it over, I realize that there is profound wisdom in it. As the saying goes, return what you owe. If debtors would repay their debts, they wouldn't encounter thunder tribulation.
Therefore, those who don't repay their debts have to lose their lives. The name that Fairy has given it is really thought-provoking. A few short words contain multiple layers of deep meaning, it's really food for thought!"
Fairy Eternity revealed a smile that fit her age: "Hehe, I didn't think that deeply."
Seeing a Unification Stage cultivator Pass Tribulation was a rare occurrence, so they all stopped to watch for a while.
Actually, Huo Huashen had seen it several times before, but he was mainly accompanying Lu Yang and the other two.
In the grand scheme of things, this was just a spectacle. The Thunder Tribulation that threatened even someone at the Unification Stage was beyond their understanding, as the level was too high. Given Lu Yang and the other two's Realm, they couldn't grasp the secrets of Shi Huagu successfully passing his tribulation.
As for Fairy Eternity, she had witnessed Yingtian Immortal orchestrate this Thunder Tribulation firsthand, hence, she had nothing much to see.
Leaving Shi Huagu to his tribulation, Huo Huashen escorted the three of them onto the flying boat.
Before they left, Huo Huashen felt he needed to speak his mind, or he'd just stew in his thoughts.
"If you three ever get a chance, you should come by our barbecue joint. Although it can't compare to the mountain and sea delicacies of the Immortal Sect, our skewers are quite good."
"Alright."
In the flying boat's cabin, Lan Ting still seemed dazed.
How did it happen that they were just going to complete a regular mission and ended up being intercepted by the vice headmaster of the Nine Nether Cult, then asked to cooperate, and finally given ten million spirit stones, all before being sent away courteously?
Though Lan Ting didn't lack money, she had never seen such a way of making money before.
She was from the renowned Lan family. Most influential families would have a regional prefix. For instance, Yan Family of Qingzhou, Wenren Family of Liang State, and Ye Family of Liang State. Only a few influential families did not have such a prefix. When one mentioned the family with the surname 'Lan', it only referred to the Lan family.
This was the kind of treatment only top-ranked prestigious families got. This was the result of both power and accumulation over time.
Meng family was the same.
Though the Lan family was not on par with the most prestigious Meng family, it was still among the top influential families.
Lu Yang took a sigh of relief. This trip had gone rather smoothly. They didn't have to kill a Unification Stage cultivator, nor did they have to face a Transcendance Tribulation stage one.
"Senior Brother Lu, these ten million spirit stones..." Tao Yaoye looked eagerly at Lu Yang, holding the storage ring. The spirit stones had been too easy to come by, which left her feeling uneasy.
She felt like she hadn't done anything to earn ten million spirit stones. Plus, there was still forty million to be paid.
Lu Yang waved it off, "You earned it with your own skills. Keep it."
"Oh."
"There's another thing I need to remind you about."
"What?"
Lu Yang narrowed his eyes. He saw a few burly men stand up in the distance and begin to walk his way. He reminded her casually, "When you're out and about, don't flaunt your wealth. It can get you into trouble."
Tao Yaoye suddenly realized she had not transmitted her voice to speak with Senior Brother Lu earlier. Any cultivator who had paid some attention to their conversation would have heard what she had said.
Now, she was seen as a cultivator who had ten million spirit stones. It was a fortune that would take a Divinity Transformation Stage cultivator a lifetime to amass. She was only at the Golden Core Stage!
Wealth and power that do not match, are sure to attract trouble!
A few grim-faced burly men approached, their cultivation levels concealed. They were at least at the Golden Core Stage or perhaps even at the Nascent Soul Stage.
Long-distance flying consumed a cultivator's spiritual essence too much. Many cultivators would choose to travel in flying boats even if they could fly.
The sturdy men surrounded Lu Yang's group, ignoring both Lu Yang and Lan Ting. They looked at Tao Yaoye, and greed was barely concealed in their expressions.
"Fellow daoist, it seems you have quite a lot of spirit stones?"
"Having so many spirit stones with you... it's not safe. Why don't we keep them for you?"
"What do you guys want!" Tao Yaoye asked cautiously, secretly reaching for her Identity Jade in preparation to use her magic artifact at any moment.
What if the opponents were Nascent Soul Stage? She was not afraid at all.
The leading burly man just chuckled coldly, making no effort to disguise his intentions.
"Have you ever considered depositing your spirit stones with our Land Money Trade Association, fellow daoist? You get five percent interest annually."

chapters.title: Chapter 525 - 524 No Major Incidents Along the Way_1
chapters.content:
Seeing that Tao Yaoye was still in shock, another burly man quickly interjected: "The guild also offers financial products with an annual interest rate of eight to twelve percent. Guaranteed profits!"
Tao Yaoye deeply understood what Senior Brother Lu meant about not showing off one's wealth, otherwise, it would attract troubles.
Now the trouble had arrived.
One after another, they introduced all sorts of investment products, establishing foundations, low-risk high-return...She couldn't understand at all.
"No, I don't need it." Tao Yaoye firmly rejected.
What's the fuss about twelve percent interest? If she invested these ten million spirit stones into the Dream Mirage, to expand the scale, the return she would gain far exceeded twelve percent of interest.
"Ah, that's a real shame then." The burly men could only reluctantly give up seeing Tao Yaoye's steadfast attitude.
Such a good chance, why didn't she fall for it?
Luckily, this was just a slight diversion and nothing serious occurred along the way.
Except for an officer who halted the flying boat, claiming that a murderer was suspected of hiding among the passengers. He intended to verify the identification of each passenger. Shortly after, the murderer resisted arrest and injured people, only to be subdued by the burly men selling the guild's products.
The murderer shouted, "I've already poisoned the captain! Only I have the antidote. If you don't release me, the captain will die for sure. Get ready for the ship to be destroyed and all lives lost!"
It was a shame that before anyone could step forward to say that they knew how to pilot the boat, they saw the captain come out and announce that he was immune to poisons. He then went back to continue driving the boat.
There was also a Golden Core Stage cultivator trying to cheat on the fare — The Golden Core Stage cultivator was flying, while eating and flying, he got tired. As it happened, the flying boat was passing by, so he sneakily climbed to the tail of the boat to hitch a ride.
But his concealment skills were poor, so he was detected by the Ticket Checking Array and made to pay for the ticket.
And there was a pregnant woman about to give birth, fainting from the intense pain. Luckily, there was a Pill Master among the passengers who managed to save both their lives.
"Honey, wake up, we're nearly there!" The husband held the pregnant woman's hand, shouted loudly, but the severe pain caused his wife to pass out.
Everyone around was anxious, but they didn't know what to do. If the pregnant woman passed out, would it be a case of two lives lost?
"I am a Pill Master, I will help." Lu Yang faintly remembered the sound of this voice.
He turned his head to look, and the one who spoke was a female cultivator with a layer of golden elixir pattern on her sleeve. This was an outfit worn by Pill Masters. An Identity Jade hung from the female cultivator's waist from the Seek Dao Sect.
Lu Yang remembered, this person was Senior Sister Jasmine from Elixir Cauldron Peak, who was in the middle of the queue when they lined up to slap him.
This meant Jasmine Senior Sister was considered to have mid-level strength among the senior brothers and sisters who slapped him. That is, the Nascent Soul Stage.
Lu Yang didn't rashly greet her. He also wanted to know how Jasmine Senior Sister intended to help the pregnant woman.
Jasmine Senior Sister scanned with her Spiritual Sense, taking stock of the situation, her eyebrows slightly furrowed.
The pregnant woman was too unconscious and would not wake up without a strong stimulus. But too much stimulation might harm the baby.
Under these circumstances, there was only one way.
Jasmine Senior Sister shut her eyes, and a three-inch tall little figure flew out of her Lingtai, went inside the pregnant woman's head, temporarily taking over her body.
Wah──
Before long, a baby dropped to the ground with a cry.
"It's done."
Jasmine Senior Sister let out a sigh of relief as her Nascent Soul returned to her body.
The husband saw that the child was born and both mother and child were safe. He was excited and held Jasmine Senior Sister's hand, "Thank you so much for helping my wife give birth! I'm very grateful!"
Jasmine Senior Sister: "..."
There's no need to say thank you!
Jasmine Senior Sister tried to convince him to not send her a banner of gratitude, finally successfully.
"Senior Sister Jasmine." After the incident ended, Lu Yang went up to greet her.
"Junior Brother Lu? And Junior Sister Tao as well, I remember you, aren't you Junior Sister Lan Ting of the Laurel Fairy Palace? How did the three of you end up together?"
Jasmine Senior Sister had a good impression of Lu Yang; after all, they had shared some intimate physical contact and even bled together.
"Isn't it because Junior Sister Tao and I were on a mission and happened to meet Junior Sister Lan Ting who was on the same mission? It's a coincidence."
"I see."
"What about you, Jasmine Senior Sister, are you also on a mission?"
Jasmine Senior Sister proudly flicked her sleeve: "I went to take the qualification exam to become a Pill Master. Look, these are the new clothes I just got."
"Senior Sister, weren't you a Pill Master already, quite a long time ago?" Jasmine Senior Sister was already at the Nascent Soul Stage, so how was she just becoming a Pill Master now?
"Oh, that's what the Sect recognizes. It's not recognized outside, practicing medicine would be considered illegal, there's a risk of getting caught. Every time I go out on a mission, I treat patients stealthily."
"I thought about it a few days ago, instead of all the hassle every time, I might as well get a certification as a Pill Master."
"Congratulations, Senior Sister, on becoming a certified Pill Master of the Pill Refining Alliance." Lu Yang cupped his hands in congratulations, Tao Yaoye and Lan Ting also followed suit, trying to imitate him.
Jasmine Senior Sister waved her hand, thinking of the process of the exam made her feel bothered: "There's nothing to congratulate about, taking an exam is a lot of trouble. I ended up in the wrong examination room and didn't realize my mistake until after the exam. Turns out it was the selection exam for the deputy head of the Pill Refining Alliance's branch.
No wonder there were so many high-level people, almost caught up to me."
"I took the first place, and only found out I wasn't a Pill Master and wasn't eligible for the exam when they were re-verifying our identities afterward."
"I had no choice but to run to the examination room for apprentice Pill Masters. I continued to refine pills in front, and behind me, a group of master refiners were observing how I did it. It was really annoying."
Lu Yang felt what Senior Sister you should consider is the immense pressure on those apprentice Pill Masters taking the exam with you.
"And now you see the result, I have successfully become a Pill Master."
"The Pill Refining Alliance even asked if I could serve as the branch head, but I thought that would be too much trouble, so I declined. In the end, they forced an honorary deputy head title onto me."
Jasmine Senior Sister took out a golden alchemy furnace badge from her Identity Jade, the back was engraved with the word "Jasmine."
Lu Yang: "..."
Should I say one would expect nothing less from a senior sister of Elixir Cauldron Peak? Her way of doing things is really unique.
Fortunately, after helping the pregnant woman deliver, no more incidents occurred, and the flying boat arrived at Seek Dao Sect smoothly.
"Goodbye Junior Sister Lan!"
"Goodbye!"
Lu Yang and Lan Ting waved goodbye.
This boat included two stops, one at Seek Dao Sect and the other at Laurel Fairy Palace.
Once they arrived at Seek Dao Sect and just entered the core area, they saw a junior brother named Meng Jingzhou passing by.
"Have you finished your closed-door cultivation?" Lu Yang casually called out to Meng Jingzhou.
"Closed-door cultivation?" Meng Jingzhou was completely confused.
Tao Yaoye smiled and said: "Did you forget, Senior Brother Meng? A few days ago, I was about to go on a mission and wanted to call you and Junior Brother Lu along. But you were in closed-door cultivation then, so in the end, only Junior Brother Lu and I went on the mission."
Seeing Tao Yaoye's calm look with a hint of threat in her eyes, Meng Jingzhou then acted as if he had suddenly remembered.
"Oh right, I was indeed in closed-door cultivation those few days, just came out, still a little dazed."

chapters.title: Chapter 526 - 525: The Dao Fruit of Immortal Jiuchong and Qilin Immortal_1
chapters.content:
"Junior Brother Lu, you have a thank-you note." Ten days later, a Senior Brother on duty in the Task Hall delivered a letter to Lu Yang, who was consuming spiritual essence with his mouth wide open for cultivation.
Lu Yang opened the letter, which was written by Mr. Song.
The main point of the letter was to thank Lu Yang for his assistance in dealing with the Washing Lady, thus putting the Song Family's business on the right track.
The letter also mentioned his youngest daughter and Zhou, Mr. Song stated that after checking, Zhou turned out to be his biological son, and his younger daughter, Song Lian'er, was actually the daughter of the housekeeper.
As for what mishap led to this situation, Mr. Song didn't elaborate much in the letter. Lu Yang guessed that there was a mix-up when the midwife assisted during childbirth.
Lu Yang discreetly stored away the letter. The intricate relationships within the Song Family were giving him a headache.
"We're merely scratching the surface. Back in ancient times, tribes and clans were the norm, and relationships back then were far more complicated than this."
"Fairy, which tribe do you come from?" Lu Yang asked casually, only to be met with a lengthy silence from Fairy Eternity.
"... A small tribe, no point in mentioning it, it was wiped out when I was still underage. It became a battlefield for a man and a beast, and our tribe got caught in the crossfire." Fairy Eternity murmured quietly, her usual lively spirit nowhere to be seen.
Lu Yang fell silent, not knowing what to say at that moment. One wrong word might make the situation worse.
Before the era of the Five Immortals of the Ancients, it was not a glorious time. Small tribes were often crushed without mercy.
"Junior Brother, come over here."
Fortunately, at that moment, Eldest Senior Sister broke the uncomfortable silence with a message.
"Eldest Senior Sister, what's going on?"
When Lu Yang found the Eldest Senior Sister, he wondered why she seldom summoned him. Could it be that their master got captured again and needed someone to bail him out?
Or was their master imprisoned again and needed someone to visit him, but Eldest Senior Sister, concerned about her dignity, wanted him to go instead?
Or was their master finally caught by his enemies, hanging by a thread, and needed to be rescued?
"Wait for the others."
Not long after, the 'others' Eldest Senior Sister mentioned arrived at Sky Gate Mountain one by one: Meng Jingzhou, Tao Yaoye, Man Gu, Li Haoran.
"Greetings, Eldest Senior Sister."
The four of them arrived at Sky Gate Mountain and greeted Eldest Senior Sister politely.
"In light of tradition, the Five Great Immortal Sects occasionally hold exchange programs among disciples. This time, disciples of Seek Dao Sect have the opportunity to study in the Five Elements Sect. There are five positions, and I thought the five of you would be the perfect candidates."
Originally, disciples from Seek Dao Sect were set to go to Laurel Fairy Palace for the exchange. However, Palace Master Luo firmly refused to let Lu Yang go to Laurel Fairy Palace, so Eldest Senior Sister had to change it to the Five Elements Sect.
"To the Five Elements Sect?" Upon hearing the exciting news, Lu Yang and the others couldn't help but smile, their eyes gleaming with joy.
They had never visited other Immortal Sects before.
Meng Jingzhou was also thrilled; he didn't expect to be able to visit the Five Elements Sect again so soon.
Four months ago, Qiu Jin'an used Meng Jingzhou's body to launch a 'Single Curse Punch' at Uncle Ba and promised to teach Meng Jingzhou a Five Elements magic skill. Meng Jingzhou had learned a tremendously powerful Five Elements magic skill from Qiu Jin'an in the Five Elements Sect, but he never found an opportunity to use it against Lu Yang.
"Then, who is the one coming to our Sect for the exchange?"
"Shi Chan from the Suspension Temple."
Lu Yang had heard about Shi Chan before. Apparently, he was still working as a butcher in a slaughterhouse, but no one knew how he was performing.
"Then, prepare yourselves. You will set off in two days."
"Who will be our leading elder?" Lu Yang asked. Logically, there should be a leader for their group. It wouldn't be appropriate to let the five of them, who were all juniors, go to the Five Elements Sect without supervision.
"The Grand Elder hasn't returned since he impersonated our master to go outside last time. The Second Elder volunteered to go to the Five Elements Sect, but they didn't accept him."
"Due to issues from the past, the remaining elders are worried about revenge attacks if they go alone. Therefore, they dare not go."
"So, you are heading to the Five Elements Sect this time without a leading elder."
Lu Yang: "..."
Why does it feel so dangerous to go to the Five Elements Sect this time?
I hope we don't enter walking and leave lying down, right?
"Don't worry, I've been to the Five Elements Sect. I'll guide you." Meng Jingzhou saw an opportunity to be the leader and immediately stepped up to the plate.
Lu Yang gave Meng Jingzhou a sidelong glance. He could tell that Meng wanted to take advantage of this situation, probably to prank him: "Are you reliable?"
"More reliable than you."
"Then, okay."
Lu Yang didn't debate with Meng Jingzhou further. After all, there was no one else who could lead the team.
"The concept of the Five Elements in the Five Elements Sect has some merits. You can learn a thing or two when you get there." Eldest Senior Sister advised the five of them.
