The five of them unanimously agreed.
"Speaking of the Five Elements, the Dao Fruit of Immortal Jiuchong seems to have some connection with it."
"What is Immortal Jiuchong's Dao Fruit?"
"The Yin-Yang Dao Fruit. It represents the extremes of this world: extreme heat and extreme cold, rapid speed and stillness, strength and weakness, etc. It's pretty complicated to use, and it's not something that can be explained in a sentence or two."
"What about the Dao Fruit of Qilin Immortal?"
"The Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit. It can be simply understood as this: any technique or move used against Qilin Immortal cannot be used for the second time. For instance, if you use the 'Universe in Palm' technique against him and knock him to the ground or pull him into your palm, his Dao Fruit will quickly adapt to this technique.
If you attempt to use this technique again, it will be ineffective."
"One time, Immortal Jiuchong used an extremely hot flame to roast Qilin Immortal. Qilin Immortal yelled in pain. The next time that technique was employed, Qilin Immortal could dance and bathe in the sea of flames."
"Did Qilin Immortal then win?"
"No, Immortal Jiuchong recorded the process of Qilin Immortal bathing, and used it as leverage to have Qilin Immortal sabotage."
Lu Yang: "..."
Why are the ways you Immortals fight and the victory conditions different from what I imagined?
"Then, would there be any problems for Qilin Immortal to eat your cooking?"
Doesn't that mean Qilin Immortal would become immune after being poisoned by Fairy Eternity?
Fairy Eternity was puzzled by the question: "Problems? What do you mean? Do you mean he might grow tired of the food I cook? No way, as an Immortal Cook, I always strive for innovation. Every time, I prepare a different style of dish!"
Lu Yang felt that Qilin Immortal would probably be happier if Fairy Eternity didn't innovate.
"There's one more thing, I remember that during the competition for the immortal status, the Geniuses of Dragon and Phoenix clans lost to Qilin Immortal. Is there a fixed quota for becoming an Immortal?" Lu Yang had been puzzled by this for a long time. Is there a need for competition in becoming an Immortal? What were the ancients fighting for?
"Not really, it's just that the Dao Fruits of those two little girls conflict with Qilin Immortal's."
"Conflict?"
"Their Dao Fruit prototypes are the 'Natural Selection Dao Fruit' and the 'Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit'. Aren't the rules these Dao Fruit prototypes represent very similar to Qilin Immortal's?"
"Just as there can only be one Eternity Dao Fruit, and as long as I'm here, any Eternity Dao Fruit prototype cannot become a genuine Dao Fruit."
"There can only be one Dao Fruit of similar rules."
"Among the three of them, only one could ascend to immortality. The other two at most could become Semi-Immortals, almost reaching Immortal status but never quite there."

chapters.title: Chapter 527 - 526: I was wrong, dare to do it again next time_1
chapters.content:
"I see." Lu Yang had learned new knowledge he couldn't use for the moment.
"So there's only one Dao fruit that has similar traits. That means if there is an immortal fairy like you, something like Immortal Dao fruit, Indestructible Dao fruit, or Eternity Dao fruit, they can only take the form of a seed, unable to mature into a full Dao fruit?"
"If Time Immortal is present, the mature Dao fruit related to time would also be just one?"
"That's the principle"
Only then did Lu Yang realisze. No wonder they had to battle for ascension. This was like a fruit occupying the finish line, hueveryone aspired to reach that endpoint. The early bird gets the worm, and the latter ones who want to become immortals have to find another endpoint.
Because the immortals are powerful, semi-immortals could never risk offending the immortals or rebel against them.
"When I was a semi-immortal, there were four or five semi-immortal Dao fruits similar to mine, like the immature Immortal Dao fruit, immature Indestructible Dao fruit and so on that you mentioned."
"They heard that I could potentially pose a threat, so they called a group of people to strike, that was quite imposing, so frightful."
"Luckily I don't bluff, defeating this bunch was a piece of cake."
Lu Yang though, "The fairy is potent. Even though she usually enjoys bullying lower ranking cultivators, when meeting the same level, she becomes an invincible existence just like me."
Otherwise, she couldn't have produced the Invincible Elixir.
Generally speaking, the higher the Cultivation Level, the harder it is to determine the winner among the same rank.
Fairy Eternity, being able to confront four contenders at the semi-immortal stage, this battle power is definitely against the heaven.
"Fairy, how did you defeat them? Did you sacrifice yourself?"
Fairy Eternity waved her hand triumphantly: "No need for such trouble, I called over Yingtian Immortal and the other three to help me, all four of them had become immortals."
The result of four immortals fighting four semi-immortals is self-evident.
Lu Yang:"..."
Fairy, didn't you use Invincible Elixir even after becoming a semi-immortal, did you?
"So Fairy, you were the last one to become immortal?" When it came to the time Fairy Eternity was a semi-immortal, Lu Yang recalled that she once mentioned that she was the last one to become an immortal.
Using the fact that Fairy Eternity, with her Golden Core Stage cultivation, stooped to conquer Yingtian Immortal and Immortal Jiuchong who were at the Foundation Establishment Stage, it can be deduced that Fairy's cultivation progress was slightly faster.
"Originally, I should have been the first to become an immortal, but comments made by Time Immortal enlightned me I discarded my original immature Dao fruit, changed my plans, and began forging a brand new immature Dao fruit – it was the Immortal Dao fruit immature form, which delayed my process a little bit and allowed the other four to surpass me."
While Lu Yang was pondering this, Eldest Senior Sister's cold voice reached his ear, startling him and making him feel an icy sensation running down his spine.
"Senior, were you once again talking about the Dao fruit with our Junior Brother?"
Lu Yang just realised that during his conversation with Fairy Eternity, Meng Jingzhou and the rest had left, and now only he and Eldest Senior Sister remain.
And Eldest Senior Sister was staring at him with an unhappy expression.
Fairy Eternity waved her hands vigorously, pointing at Lu Yang and replied: "Nope, it was Lu Yang who started asking me!"
Regardless of whether that was the truth, she had to clear herself of the responsibility first.
Lu Yang couldn't possibly let Fairy Eternity tarnish his reputation, "Fairy started telling me. She said that looking at the Five Elements reminded her of what Immortal Jiuchong's Dao fruit was. She then shared that knowledge with me!"
Arguments break out within the Indestructible Sect.
Eldest Senior Sister was momentarily stunned and asked: "What is Immortal Jiuchong's Dao fruit?"
Eldest Senior Sister gained her knowledge about ancient times mainly from ancient books. Due to the immortality characteristic, although explicit records of the battles between immortals exist, any parts referring to the methods used by those immortals would be automatically erased. Eldest Senior Sister could only make conjectures based on the clues available.
Of course, those won't be as accurate as the accounts of Fairy Eternity, who was involved in the events.
"Immortal Jiuchong has Yin Yang Dao Fruit; Qilin Immortal has Survival of the Fittest Dao Fruit."
Eldest Senior Sister gave a nod of approval, "This is almost akin to what I had speculated. This means out of the Five Immortals of the Ancients, you have the Indestructible Dao Fruit; Yingtian Immortal has the Tribulation Dao Fruit; Immortal Jiuchong has the Yin-Yang Dao Fruit; Time Immortal has the Time Dao Fruit, and Qilin Immortal has the Survival of the Fittest Dao fruit."
There were five people who attained immortality in a relatively short period, showing how flourishing that era was. No wonder in the current Great Era, people compare the Great Era to the Ancient times.
"Additionally, pay attention when you talk to the Senior. You are only in the Golden Core Stage and learning too much about Dao fruit in advance may not be too beneficial. Now, knowing about the cultivation methods during the Unification Stage, and Transcendence Tribulation Stage should be enough."
Lu Yang felt that even knowing the methods of the Unification Stage and Transcendence Tribulation Stage was not very beneficial, as these weren't things that a practitioner at the Golden Core Stage should know about.
....
Two days later, with Meng Jingzhou leading the way and Lu Yang bringing up the rear, the five Seek Dao Sect's new generation disciples headed 蜎 the Five Elements Sect.
Considering the dangerous nature of the Five Elements Sect, Old horse lacked the strength for this mission. Meng Jingzhou chose not to travel by carriage and decided to travel with Lu Yang and the others on a flying boat.
"I didn't expect to ride the flying boat again so soon."
It's been less than half a month since Lu Yang last rode a flying boat.
"Sorry I am late," Tao Yaoye was the last one to gather and managed to board just before the flying boat took off.
The Promotion Fantasy Realm of Stone Bone has been prepared earlier. She retrieved the Promotion Fantasy Realm and the remaining forty million Spirit Stones from the main branch of the barbeque shop with the Sixth Elder.
The Spirit Stones were for her, and the Sixth Elder handled the fusion of the Promotion Fantasy Realm and Dream Mirage. Sixth Elder located Uncle Ba and the Eighth Elder to handle it.
She almost missed the departing time due to the round trip.
Li Haoran watched all this play out, with jealousy burning in his heart. His peers were not only stronger in cultivation and had better natural talents, but they were also successful in their endeavors. If they were not directly successful, they still had inherited wealth, like Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu.
But if he looked at himself - having nothing to his name - if he were to recover his previous identity and become the Master of the Nine Nether Sect, it might turn out to be even worse.
As his Cultivation Level increased, Li Haoran retrieved half of Qin Haoran's memories. And the more memories he retrieved, the harder he realized Qin Haoran's life had been.
It was inevitable that within these memories, there were instances of Qin Haoran's passionate encounters with Su Yiren....
At this point, Li Haoran didn't feel that Qin Haoran's life was difficult at all.
Hearing Li Haoran's complaints, Lu Yang comforted him sincerely: "Junior Brother Li, don't underestimate yourself. Your potential is no less than mine. If one day you could inherit Qin Haoran's identity, there is one aspect where you could me."
Li Haoran ignited hope and looked at Lu Yang expectantly : "What is it?"
"Your enemy is roughly equal to mine. Qin Haoran's enemies are at the Unification Stage, and whenever I go out, I often encounter those at the Unification Stage as an opponent."
Li Haoran: "..."
Please no. Lu Yang, you have a way with trouble and ironically, troubles seem to turn out to be blessings for you. I am not as capable as you.
Fortunately, nothing major occurred during the journey, and the group safely reached the Five Elements Sect.
They hadn't even disembarked from the ship when they noticed that the members of the Five Elements Sect had lined up at the gate to welcome them. Especially outstanding were the ones that looked like elders, clenched magic artifacts in their hands, possessed a fierce expression, and watched the landing ship with intense focus.

chapters.title: Chapter 528 - 527: Hospitable Five Elements Sect (Request for Monthly Pass)_1
chapters.content:
The Five Elements Sect, one of the Five Great Immortal Sects, is located on the Five Elements Spiritual Vein in Yunzhou. The Five Elements Spiritual Vein naturally corresponds to the Five Elements, making it the best place in Yunzhou.
Under the leadership of Sect Leader Qiu Jin'an, the Five Elements Sect is full of talents and is thriving. The sect is serious and diligent internally, striving to be the best, while being warm and friendly towards the outside world.
Even when disciples from the Seek Dao Sect come to study at the Five Elements Sect, old grudges are put aside, with elders coming out to meet them with magic artifacts, worried about any potential accidents befalling the Seek Dao Sect disciples.
"We are so welcomed here, with so many people coming out to greet us." Man Gu laughed as he looked at the crowd in front of the gate of the Five Elements Sect.
Lu Yang's eyes twitched as he learned from Fairy Eternity that those holding the magic artifacts were all in Unification stage, undoubtedly the elders of the Five Elements Sect.
Did they really need to hold magic artifacts to welcome them?
The flying boat docked while Meng Jingzhou led the team off the ship. Qiu Jin'an warmly greeted them, and behind him were five fierce and grim elders. One of the elders even held a banner in one hand and a weapon in the other, and it was unclear what he wanted to do.
"Welcome to our Five Elements Sect for observation and learning. Is there no leading elder?"
Qiu Jin'an did a headcount, only five men, not one of Seek Dao Sect's children were there.
Unwilling to let it be, Qiu Jin'an used his Spiritual Sense to survey the surroundings and see if there was anyone hiding nearby.
"No, the elders are all busy, so they didn't come." Meng Jingzhou explained truthfully.
With a look of regret, Qiu Jin'an shook his head. It was a pity that nobody walked into his trap.
The five elders behind him used their magic artifacts. The tips of the artifacts were shining brightly. Meng Jingzhou was taken aback, but luckily the magic artifacts weren't aimed at people but at the sky.
Boom, boom, boom...
Five attacks exploded in the air. The light they gave off was like beautiful fireworks exploding at night during the New Year.
With the sound of the explosions, the banner was unfurled: Welcome Seek Dao Sect disciples to our sect for study.
The Five Elements Sect was meticulous in their plans. They prepared for two possibilities. If the children of the Seek Dao Sect came, they would greet with magic artifacts, step on the Seek Dao Sect's children and unfurl the banners as a show of power. If Yun Zhi came, they would switch to fireworks and banners immediately.
Even though Yun Zhi did not show up, having only a few juniors coming over, it was enough to welcome with a banner unfurling and fireworks display.
"Dismiss, dismiss, Old Buyu hasn't arrived."
"I heard that Old Buyu has appeared in the Wild State, should we go check it out?"
"Forget it, it's probably another false alarm. Did we ever manage to catch him when we did obtain his whereabouts?"
"This son of a bitch is slippery, faster than a rabbit!"
"Man and Sword as One, One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand, nobody can find his true form with the continuous use of these two moves. By the time they find him, he would have already run off."
"You know what, if I ran into him, I could actually find him."
"How would you find him?"
"Did you see my eyes? I jumped into a furnace and smoked them for forty-nine days. Now my eyes can rival the Demon-Reflecting Mirror of the White Horse Temple!"
"If that's so efficient, is it easy to practice? I would also like to give it a try."
The elders, having fired off their fireworks and unfurled the banners, began to disperse and chat amongst themselves soon after.
Seeing that his target had not shown up, Qiu Jin'an coughed twice, giving Bai Ming a look to take care of the five men.
The Sect Leader and the elders had already left, but the disciples of the Five Elements Sect remained.
"Which one is Lu Yang? Point him out to me."
"That's him, the one who looks clean and tidy."
"Do not judge a book by its cover. I heard that he fought and won against Golden Core, Nascent Soul, and Spirit Transformation stages when he was at the Foundation Establishment Stage. Now he's at the Golden Core Stage, can he defeat those at the Refining The Void stage?"
"Even without him fighting at the Refining The Void stage, even I can beat a weakened one in that stage."
"Right."
"Who's the founder of the Dream Mirage?"
"Are you blind? There's only one female cultivator, still asking?"
"She's truly talented, why can't I think of such a profitable idea."
"What kind of good idea can you think of? You ate the skewers from Seek Dao Sect and wanted to open a shop outside, but found that the competition for barbecue shops is too fierce?"
"Isn't the robust one the Ancient Barbarian Tribe? I thought the Ancient Barbarian Tribe was extinct."
"It is rumored that he is a rare bloodline reverting back to its origin."
The disciples of the Five Elements Sect didn't frequent exchanges with the disciples of the Seek Dao Sect often, hence, they are extremely interested in Lu Yang and his party.
After Qiu Jin'an left, Meng Jingzhou looked at Bai Ming, puzzled: "Didn't you go for the exchange study?"
Bai Ming smirked: "There is no place left to go. Your Seek Dao Sect took Shi Chan, Yan Tianzhi went to the Suspension Temple, the Laurel Fairy Palace does not allow male disciples, my two Junior Sisters went there, I frequent at the Prison Suppressing Sect and there's no need for me to go, so I can only stay at the sect."
As Bai Ming walked, he introduced the situation of the Five Elements Sect to Lu Yang and the others.
"You should have seen it from the flying boat. Our Five Elements Sect is built on the Five Elements Spiritual Vein. Depending on the different specializations, our sect has divided into five divisions according to the Five Elements. The ones who greeted you with the Sect Leader just now are the Grand Elders of the Five Veins.
When they were young, they had some private grudges with your Seek Dao Sect's elders. They wanted to meet and reminisce the old times, but it's a pity they didn't come."
"What kind of grudges?"
Bai Ming heard from his Master about the several disputes between the Five Elements Sect and the Seek Dao Sect: "There were quite a few. For example, regular fights, your Seek Dao Sect's elders often use a Sea of People Tactic to fight our elders when you have superior numbers, and report to the government office when you are outnumbered."
"Sometimes they even use the Honey Trap. The fourth elder from your sect wrote a letter to our elder, using a female disciple's tone saying she had admired our elder for a long time and hoped to meet him. The letter mentioned that she was shy and didn't want to meet too many people, and requested for a private meeting. Our elder went, then nine people jumped out from behind a large stone.
Can you imagine that?"
Lu Yang felt that this plot sounded very familiar. Did the Fourth Elder learn this tactic after a sobering experience?
Li Haoran feared that there might be elders from the Five Elements Sect eavesdropping on their conversation, and Bai Ming's words might stir up old resentments and draw their ire. Hence, he swiftly changed the topic: "Which division are you from?"
"Me? I am proficient in the Five Elements magic skills, I don't belong to any divisions. I am a disciple of the Sect Leader."
"Only those like me who are skilled in all Five Elements magic skills can be disciples of the Sect Leader." Speaking of this, Bai Ming appeared slightly smug, the corners of his mouth curling up into a faint smile. Being proficient in the Five Elements magic skills, his talent in the Five Elements Sect was unique and rare.
"Then I should be suitable too." Lu Yang pointed at himself.
His magic skills were unique: he could use the Golden Body of the gold series magic skills, the "Tree-Planting Sutra" of the wood series magic skills, he hadn't learned the water series magic skills yet, he could use the Three Flavored True Fire of the fire series magic skills, and Shrinking Earth of the earth series magic skills.
Bai Ming turned his head to look at Lu Yang, surprise in his eyes: "You are indeed suitable, very fitting to be with the Sect Leader. Why didn't you come to our Five Elements Sect in the first place?"
Lu Yang scratched his head awkwardly: "The Seek Dao Sect was closer to my home, so I thought I'd try it first. I didn't expect to succeed right away."
Bai Ming: "..."
What a simplistic reason.

chapters.title: Chapter 529 - 528: Meng Family's Attack Method (Request for monthly tickets)_1
chapters.content:
"This is the Scripture Pavilion, which contains every book available on the market. Disciples are free to read the first floor, but to access the second or higher floors, you need to complete tasks to exchange for access,"
The Five Elements Sect also has a Task Hall. Unlike Seek Dao Sect, where the disciples can freely learn this realm's techniques when they reach a particular Cultivation Level, the disciples of the Five Elements Sect need to complete tasks first to study the desired techniques.
This system was established at the establishment of the Five Elements Sect. The theory was that the law should not be passed on casually. When something is obtained too easily, it may not be valued, but rewards gained through effort are cherished.
"However, as disciples here to study in the Five Elements Sect, we cannot expect you to also exchange contributions. As per tradition, you can each choose one technique. If you want to learn more, you will need to complete tasks."
"This is the lecture hall. Later, the Elder of Passing Skills will explain to you the 'Five Elements General Outline'. It's a requisite course for every disciple in our sect. But, of course, we won't forcibly impose our Five Elements Sect's theories on you. Just listen, and if you have any questions, feel free to ask the Elder."
"This is the Martial Skill Spreading Hall. Disciples of the Five Elements Sect usually practice here on regular days."
On several large platforms fortified by Array Methods, disciples dressed in robes of the Five Elements Sect were showcasing their elemental magic skills. The fierce battles made even the platforms shake slightly, triggering rounds of cheers from the audience.
Even from a distance, Lu Yang could feel the waves of energy produced by the battles. His hair was blowing slightly.
The platform was intense, shards of rock scattered across the ground. A senior brother from the Five Elements Sect pointed at the rubble and shouted, "Transform stones into gold!"
The rocks turned into shiny gold.
Then the senior brother coated all the gold with his Spiritual Sense and cast another magic skill: "A Thousand Gold Throw!"
The shining gold transformed into tangible forces distorting the very fabric of space. The golden forces surged toward their opponent under the influence of the magic skill!
"Is this the legendary technique that transforms wealth into an attack?" Tao Yaoye was astonished. She thought this technique was long lost, but she never imagined seeing it on display in the Five Elements Sect.
Bai Ming explained, "A Thousand Gold Throw is a secret technique of the Golden Meridian. It's powerful and Elder Zhang innovated it by connecting 'Transform stones into gold' with the 'A Thousand Gold Throw,' forming a linked technique.
"However, it has its drawbacks. After all, gold is a mundane entity whose value isn't high. Elder Zhang compensated for the lack of quality with quantity to achieve the desired attack effect."
"Impressive thinking," Lu Yang admired. He was already encountering these innovative thoughts upon his arrival at the Five Elements Sect, suggesting that he would undoubtedly learn many things in his journey here.
"Old Meng, do you want to learn this technique?" Lu Yang thought Meng Jingzhou was the most suitable for learning 'A Thousand Gold Throw.' Imagine the massive power when Meng Jingzhou transforms gold, jewels, and Spirit Stones into attacks.
Meng Jingzhou shook his head in disapproval, "My Meng Family knows 'A Thousand Gold Throw' as well, but our ancestors explicitly forbade us from practicing this skill. They termed it as a forbidden technique."
"Why?" Lu Yang was puzzled.
"Can you imagine a scene where a son quarrels with his father, and the son uses 'A Thousand Gold Throw' to use up all of his father's Spirit Stones?"
"That guy made it more illuminating as compared to the New Year fireworks, making the Imperial City as bright as daytime even late into the night. The noise was so loud nobody could sleep, and as a result, dozens of people surrounded our Meng Family in the middle of the night."
In the past, the Meng family offended others one by one. Yet, this time they managed to offend the entire Imperial City in one fell swoop. Even the Meng family couldn't withstand the ire of the entire city.
Lu Yang: "..."
From now on, I will never confess that I know you when I am in Imperial City to avoid being targeted by unknown enemies.
Meng Jingzhou continued, "Moreover, our Meng family has more remarkable techniques, no need to learn this one."
"More remarkable techniques, like what?" Lu Yang became more curious.
Meng Jingzhou continued, "I'm not very well aware of the technical details, but I can tell you how to use this technique."
"During combat, throw a considerable pile of Spirit Stones at the enemy. Consequently, the ownership of Spirit Stones goes from the Meng family to the opponent. Then, urge the opponent to return the Spirit Stones promptly. If they don't, the force of heavenly punishment, thunderstrike, will descend upon them and end their lives!"
Lu Yang looked askance, why does this technique sound so familiar?
"Oh yes, the thunderstrike force is also known as the 'Debt Repayment Thunder'."
Lu Yang also found the name of this heavenly punishment force familiar.
He glanced at Meng Jingzhou, and then at Li Haoran, who was entirely engrossed in the spectacle and oblivious to this conversation. Could it be that the person Qin Haoran borrowed money from long ago was the Meng Family?
Lu Yang finally decided to keep quiet about this matter. As the Eldest Senior Brother, he wanted to maintain brotherly affection within the sect, regardless of any past wrongs.
Judging from Li Haoran inheriting memories from Qin Haoran earlier, he either hasn't remembered who Qin Haoran borrowed money from, or perhaps the Meng family borrowed against a false identity and engaged in lending malpractice.
Let it be, so much time has passed since then. Qin Haoran is already dead, and now the one who owes the debt is Vice Headmaster Shi, so let the matter rest.
Bai Ming looked at Meng Jingzhou with a strange expression, "No wonder the Meng family has so many enemies. Just this combat style is enough to be deemed unscrupulous."
Meng Jingzhou defended his family's method vehemently, "What are you talking about? This is a legitimate use of the force of heavenly punishment. Is it wrong to utilize natural law? Which advancement of the human race was not due to understanding and applying natural rules?"
Bai Ming then led the five to a scorching hot location. Fire occasionally sprung from the ground, heating the terra cotta-hued earth. The temperature could be felt even through their boots. If they were not already at the Golden Core Stage, they would be dehydrated by now.
"This is the cultivation ground of the Fire Vein. It harbors various True Fires. Practicing fire attribute techniques or Fire Spirit Root here would lead to twice the results with half the effort. One could also learn about the essence of True Fire."
"My Daoist friend Li should find this relevant."
Li Haoran felt the most intense connection. Just standing here for a moment caused the spiritual essence in his body to bubble up, and his technique automatically began to rotate and cultivate.
He was a Fire Spirit Root, and this place suited him perfectly.
"Can I cultivate here?" Li Haoran felt like this place was a treasure tailor-made for him.
Bai Ming revealed a troubled look and hesitantly said, "Your Master is Elder Zhou Xin, isn't he?"
"Yes."
"And does he possess numerous True Fires?"
"Yes, my Master's Refining room contains all sorts of True Fires. He can use them whenever he needs to refine anything."
Lu Yang had seen Fifth Elder refining. The Fifth Elder had used several True Fires when refining the Dark Moon Sword.
"Elder Zhou Xin obtained several True Fires from Elder Huomai but used some unscrupulous methods. Elder Huomai might not vent his anger on his junior, but we can't say the same for his disciples."
"I advise you, don't practice here alone. It's unsafe."
Li Haoran: "..."

chapters.title: Chapter 530 - 529 - Competing in Refining Techniques _1
chapters.content:
Compared to Lu Yang, Li Haoran had always been grateful for having a reliable master. Even though he tossed him into lava, it was all for him to better understand the mysteries of the Fire Spirit Root.
However, he never expected his good master to have enemies within the Five Elements Sect.
And it was an entire Fire Vein faction.
Bai Ming patted Li Haoran's shoulder: "Don't worry, this is just an exception. I heard that Elder Zhou Xin is quite popular in the Refining circle and has excellent connections."
This was true, Elder Zhou Xin's refining skills were unmatched in the Cultivation World, and he had a great reputation.
Master refiners often judged their prowess by the number of patents they had registered, and Elder Zhou Xin had the most patents.
These patents also brought him enormous wealth, more than even the Seventh Elder, despite being a master refiner himself.
Of course, Zhou Xin's wealth was still less than that of Daoist Buyu.
Not that Daoist Buyu was particularly wealthy now, but his bounty on the black market was quite valuable.
"What are those people doing?"
Lu Yang saw a few nearly-naked Senior Brothers, regardless of the blazing earth, lying on the ground, eyes closed, as if smeared with a layer of liquid, reflecting the sunlight.
They also had a branch inserted next to them.
Last time he saw this pose was in his previous life during sunbathing.
"You're talking about them? Can't understand, huh? They are comprehending the Essence of the Sun. After research by the Fire Vein Elders, it was discovered that the larger the area exposed to sunlight, the greater the opportunity to gain insight."
"That branch was brought back by our master from the Wild State, it's said to be a battle trophy obtained by defeating an ancient cultivator. It is a branch of the Fusang tree and is beneficial for comprehending the Essence of the Sun."
"The liquid they have smeared on themselves is a specially made ointment."
"Is that an ointment that increases sense of the Essence of the Sun?"
"No, it's sunscreen."
Lu Yang silently panned his gaze, the Five Element Sect's cultivation method was distinctive indeed.
"Let's go, I will show you the cultivation site of Water Vein."
Before they could move, several cultivators with fire symbols on their foreheads approached, walking towards them with a sense of grandeur and vigor.
"Which one of you is Li Haoran?"
"What are you trying to do?" Meng Jingzhou frowned, standing at the front.
"Are you Li Haoran?" The cultivators with fire symbols looked at Meng Jingzhou.
Bai Ming stood in between the two groups, his tone somewhat displeased: "Senior Brother Yuan Gang, and the rest of the Senior Brothers, what are you trying to do?"
These people were Senior Brothers of the Fire Vein.
"Nothing in particular, just heard that Elder Zhou Xin's prized disciple is here, wanted to see what he looks like."
"They are our guests."
Yuan Gang spoke lazily: "I know, I am not planning to fight."
"I am Li Haoran." By this point, Li Haoran didn't want anyone else to deal with the situation, so he stepped forward.
"So, you are Li Haoran with the Fire Spirit Root. People are not always as they appear, eh? I heard that you are Zhou Xin's true disciple and a formidable refiner. Is that true?"
"What if it's true, and what if it's not?"
A glint flashed across Yuan Gang's eyes: "No matter what, my cultivation level is higher than yours, it wouldn't be interesting to defeat you in a duel. In that case, why don't we have a competition in refining, how about it?"
"Senior Brother Yuan Gang, Li Haoran is our guest." Bai Ming reminded Yuan Gang again.
Yuan Gang laughed: "Just a refining exchange. Let him learn our Five Elements Sect's refining methods, what's the problem?"
"A refining competition? Sure." Li Haoran had never been afraid of anyone when it came to refining.
"See, Li Haoran himself said it's okay."
"When will it take place?"
"Why wait for another day when we can do it now? It will provide an opportunity for everyone to witness."
As the disagreement ramped up between the two groups, more and more disciples of the Five Elements Sect were attracted to the scene, even those sunbathing came over.
"What's going on? What happened?"
"It's probably Yuan Gang stepping up, wanting to regain face for the Fire Vein Elder by having a refining competition."
"Did the other party agree?"
"They agreed."
"There will be a good show then. Senior Brother Yuan Gang's refining technique is even praised by the Elders. They say he is a future master refiner."
"Indeed."
Yuan Gang laughed and looked around. His gaze fell on Li Haoran: "So, do you want to compete now, or do you need some time to prepare?"
"I don't need any preparation, we can compete right now. So, what's the bet?"
Yuan Gang thought for a moment, then said seriously: "Ultimately, the magic artifacts we refine are used by cultivators, and they value power above everything else. So, let's see who can forge a magic artifact with more power, how about that?"
"What is the standard for greater power?"
Yuan Gang pointed to a few large red rocks standing in the distance: "Those are Magma Fine Stones, formed by the volcanic lava ejected by a Great Divine Skill practitioner condensed with great power. They are extremely durable, so the one who causes more damage to the Magma Fine Stone wins. The maximum charging time for a magic artifact should not exceed a hundred breaths."
The longer a magic artifact charges, the greater its power. If the charging time was unlimited, then it would be a competition on who could charge their magic artifact for longer.
"Agreed."
"Um, can the two of us also participate?"
Laughter echoed, Yuan Gang saw Lu Yang raise his hand with a smile, with Meng Jingzhou standing next to him.
"Do you two also know how to refine?" Yuan Gang looked at the two of them suspiciously. Of course, he knew Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, but he never heard that they were proficient in refining.
"Just about, it should be no problem to win against you." Meng Jingzhou said with a chuckle.
Yuan Gang was so amused that he laughed: "Brave! It's the first time I've heard someone say they can beat me in refining! Well then, why don't you participate in the competition so I can see your skills!"
Bai Ming was a bit puzzled, he secretly sent a message to Man Gu and Tao Yaoye: "Can those two really refine?"
Man Gu shook his head in confusion, while Tao Yaoye remained silent, recalling the entrance examination two years ago.
Their responses only deepened Bai Ming's doubts.
Yuan Gang signaled his follower, who pulled out a large amount of refining materials from his Identity Jade: fine steel, iron wood, agate, pure Yin water…
"These are refining materials, which can be freely used during the competition. Common refining materials are unlimited, rarer materials are limited in quantity. During the competition, you will have to compete for who can grab them first."
Lu Yang teased: "I've never seen such a fair competition before. The competition was proposed by you, the competition content was determined by you, and now even the refining materials are insufficient and need to be fought over."
Yuan Gang pretended like he didn't hear Lu Yang's taunt and casually asked: "So, are you still competing, or not?"
Lu Yang's smile didn't fade: "Of course we will compete. Otherwise, how can we let you know the power of our refining skills? But, if it's a competition, there must be a bet, right? Surely our faces can't be the stakes."
"If I lose, you can each choose a Flame of True Fire from this Fire Vein cultivation site."
"If you lose, you won't cultivate in my Fire Vein territory during your time in the Five Elements Sect!"

chapters.title: Chapter 531 - 530: Broken Stones! (Extra Update, Request for Monthly Tickets)_1
chapters.content:
The crafting competition commenced. Yuan Gang already had his magic artifact planned, and was the first to act, quickly snatching away some extremely precious crafting materials.
Li Haoran kept his eyes closed, pondering hard on what kind of powerful weapon he wanted to craft.
Meng Jingzhou meticulously picked several materials from the stack meant for crafting.
Lu Yang glanced at the agitated Yuan Gang, sneered, and hauled a piece of raw wood from the crafting material pile.
News of the competition among these four quickly reached the top echelon of the Five Elements Sect. The elders of the Five Veins, and Qiu Jin'an, appeared at the competition venue. However, they concealed their presence, unnoticed by all.
"Elder Song, Yuan Gang is your arranged contender, right? It's a bit too much," Qiu Jin'an frowned and turned towards the Fire Vein Elder, Song Duantian.
Song Duantian was plump, dressed in a bright red robe, and looked somewhat funny. But, those aware of his temper and achievements wouldn't dare to laugh.
"Sect Leader, you shouldn't make random assumptions. It's just that the child Yuan Gang is filial and made a self decision. How could that be my arrangement?"
Qiu Jin'an chuckled twice and didn't say anything else.
Did he really think Yuan Gang would certainly win?
The feud between Zhou Xin and Song Duantian was not just about who got the True Fire. More than a thousand years ago, both men had fallen for the same woman and pursued her passionately. With guidance from Daoist Buyu, Zhou Xin had successfully won over the woman, and they had a daughter named Zhou Lulu.
The grudges between the two couldn't be easily dissolved over time.
Moreover, Zhou Xin, who flaunted his wife in front of Song Duantian every day and even brought his family to visit during the New Year, was indeed a bit over the line.
As time ticked away, the venue became extremely silent. All four participants were absorbed in crafting their magic artifacts. The only sounds were the ringing of their projects being hammered, and the crackling sound of the True Fire.
"Done!" Yuan Gang relaxed, his shoulders drop with relief. When he was crafting his magic artifact, he became wholly focused, leaving no room for sloppiness.
Even as he devoted his full attention to creating the artifact he had planned, there was still no guarantee of success.
Now that it was done, victory was practically assured.
What materialized in his hands was a hollow, cylindrical-shaped artifact, primarily made from bronze. Both the inner wall and the exterior were covered in inscriptions.
"What kind of artifact is that?"
"It looks so weird."
"Has anyone seen it before?"
The disciples of the Five Elements Sect whispered amongst themselves, discussing this never-before-seen artifact.
"I named it the Meteor Cannon." This was a major weapon he had researched and developed, and it was its first public appearance.
Li Haoran acted as if he hadn't heard Yuan Gang, and continued crafting his magic artifact wholeheartedly.
The flame in his palm slithered like a fiery snake. Every inch of the magic artifact was being melted and reshaped under the heat of the flame.
This was the Dayan True Fire that Li Haoran had mastered. Although its power was not immense, it was the most suitable method for refining magic artifacts. Its flexible and versatile nature allowed him to craft exactly what he planned.
Seeing that Li Haoran wasn't distracted, Yuan Gang felt a bit disappointed. He stood there, holding the cannon, continuously infusing spiritual essence into it.
The inscriptions inside and outside the cannon pulsed with light as they gathered the spiritual essence, transmitting it to the bottom. The base of the cannon changed from green to red, emitting a terrifying aura.
Thirty breaths, forty breaths, ninety breaths, a hundred breaths!
Bai Ming, standing nearby, felt his hair standing on end, sensing the threat.
If he took a direct hit, it would likely result in serious injury.
"Let me show you the power of the Meteor Cannon!"
Bang!
As the Meteor Cannon let out a sound like thunder, Yuan Gang's laughter was quickly drowned out.
The blazing spiritual essence shell was fired, striking the lava stone like a thunderbolt with an incredible force!
Cracks appeared on the large stone instantly, spreading like a spider's web!
Surprised gasps kept sounding from the audience.
"Good heavens, what a potent power!"
"Can a practitioner at the early stage of the Nascent Soul destroy the lava stone?"
"What a formidable magic artifact!"
"This kid Yuan Gang really does me proud." Song Duantian chuckled with satisfaction. The power of the Meteor Cannon had brought glory to his face.
With a victorious look, Yuan Gang glanced at Li Haoran. At this point, Li Haoran had successfully crafted his artifact. It was an extremely thin needle, fine as cow hair, almost invisible to the naked eye.
Besides that, there was a disc as large as a grindstone, with meticulously complex inscriptions etched upon it, which made Yuan Gang feel dizzy just by looking at it.
Li Haoran placed this cow hair needle at the edge of the disc, then infused the spiritual essence into the disc to activate it.
The inscriptions lit up in rings, the Cow Hair Needle floated above the edge of the disk, slowly flying.
"Just this..." sneered Yuan Gang. Yet before he could finish, he saw the flying Cow Hair Needle as if it was bound above the disk by an unseen force.
The Cow Hair Needle speed was accelerating; for each loop it flew, its speed increased by one level. After sixty breaths, it was flying so fast that it was almost invisible, and by the seventieth breath, Yuan Gang fully lost sight of the Cow Hair Needle.
Eighty breaths, ninety breaths, one hundred breaths!
At the hundredth breath, the disk lost its spiritual essence, the Cow Hair Needle was no longer bound, and flew towards the Fine Stone at an invisible speed!
Shhh.
Only a slight sound was heard. The Cow Hair Needle penetrated through three Fine Stones in a row, and nailed onto the fourth Fine Stone, its tail not showing even a hint of trembling!
It left Cow Hair Needle-sized holes right in the center of the three consecutive Fine Stones!
"Brother Yuan Gang, thank you for your concession." Li Haoran smiled faintly with his fists cupped.
Refusing to concede defeat, Yuan Gang retorted, "The contest is about who can inflict more damage to the Fine Stones. I have created such a large web, while you only made a small piercing, you are not better than me."
Just as Li Haoran wanted to argue, he heard Meng Jingzhou's laughter, "Are we comparing the damage inflicted on the huge stone, right? Then it's my turn. Don't complain about it."
Yuan Gang frowned. What Meng Jingzhou had in his hand was not even a magic artifact, just a rope. What was he planning to do?
Meng Jingzhou did not explain, instead he simply tied the Fine Stone with the rope and flew higher and higher until he was out of sight, only faint sounds could be heard from afar.
"I wonder how high I must fly to smash the stone."
Yuan Gan snapped, "You only have one hundred breaths of time!"
If flown high enough, the Fine Stone could certainly be shattered.
Meng Jingzhou's voice floated down, unruffled, "But I didn't use a magic artifact. One hundred breaths is the time for using the magic artifact, not my time."
After some time, a meteor fell from the sky, carrying light and heat, aiming straight at Yuan Gang. The sight was visually shocking just to look at.
Yuan Gang hurriedly darted away.
Boom!
The Fine Stone crashed, splitting into pieces, stirring up an endless cloud of dust. A huge pit was formed in the Fire Vein which pained Song Duantian just by looking at it.
Meng Jingzhou landed, shaking his head and clucking his tongue, "Oh no, I thought your magic artifact, Meteor Cannon, could actually destroy stars. I overestimated you."
Yuan Gang's face turned ashen. The little fellow had clearly aimed that at him on purpose!
Meng Jingzhou turned his head, "Lu Yang, are you ready?"
"I've been ready for a while, waiting for the stone to fall." Lu Yang dusted off the wood chips on his sword. The artifact he had refined was a wooden sword, which would break with a snap.
With an ashen face, Yuan Gang frowned, struggling to understand Lu Yang's intentions.
Lu Yang walked over to another Fine Stone with a smile. He lifted his hand, his sword-dancing movements slow and graceful, presenting a unique beauty.
"I heard he practices swordsmanship. What does he want to do? Break the Fine Stone with his sword?"
"Impossible, this stone isn't something one at the Golden Core Stage could break, not even those who practice swordsmanship!"
Not just the disciples of the Five Elements Sect, even the elders of the Five Veins and Qiu Jin'an couldn't figure it out. They just found his movements familiar.
Lu Yang's sword-dancing stance was elegant, with a celestial demeanor, he looked like a different person altogether, wearing a pleased smile at the corner of his mouth.
Suddenly, the sword light flashed, and Lu Yang turned into a different appearance.
"Ha ha, you fools of the Five Elements Sect, you didn't even recognize me when I used this little apprentice's identity?"
"You want to catch me with those eyes? You're practicing your eye technique for nothing. You're all as good as blind!"
Daoist Buyu chuckled, his sword-moving mockery was directed at the six people in the shadows.
Daoist Buyu's Imitation Fist!
Boom! Boom!
A huge fireball appeared above Daoist Buyu's head, looking like a second sun. The energies of Metal Element intercrossing, a mighty army with massed ranks, killing enemies, and breaking illusions!
The hot-tempered Elder of the Fire Vein and the Elder of the Golden Vein took action. The fireball and the energies of Metal Element rained down, engulfing the Fine Stone.
The Fine Stone didn't even get a chance to turn into dust, it disappeared into thin air.
They didn't fail to recognize that this Daoist Buyu was a fraud, they just couldn't hold back.
Especially his tone, it was too similar.

chapters.title: Chapter 532 - 531: Ten Days in the Sky_1
chapters.content:
The fireball and aura of Jinwu continue to bombard, causing tremors throughout the fire vein.
A gale passes and scatters the dust, revealing a large pit in its wake, where all the molten fine stone was turned into nothingness, even Daoist Buyu disappeared without a trace.
"Your actions as elders of the Five Elements Sect are ruthless enough." Lu Yang shook his head as he appeared next to Meng Jingzhou, wondering what his master had done to provoke such an angry response at the Five Elements Sect.
Seeing Lu Yang, Yuan Gang started as if he'd seen a ghost, "What are you doing here? Who was that person just now?"
Lu Yang responded lazily, "Of course it was my clone, didn't you notice? A wooden avatar to be exact, doesn't it go well with a wooden sword?"
If it weren't for this, the fire vein elder and the gold vein elder wouldn't have been provoked to such an exaggerated response.
Using his true form to mimic his master would be utterly suicidal.
"Haha, you truly are the disciple of Seek Dao Sect, displaying such quick thinking." The lively laugh of Song Duantian resonated among the desolate surroundings as the Fifth Elder and Qiu Jin'an appeared.
"Yuan Gang, you have to understand that there will always be someone better, and there's always something above the heavens. Remember this lesson and refrain from arrogance and conceit in the future."
Regardless of Meng Jingzhou's use of continental gravity and Lu Yang's impersonation of Daoist Buyu to draw hatred, the concept of refining displayed by Li Haoran's accelerating cow hair needle alone far surpassed Yuan Gang's.
"Yes, master. I'll remember this lesson." Yuan Gang discreetly backed off.
"The victory of this competition belongs to your Seek Dao Sect. The challenger has agreed that you can select any true fire of your choice from this place. This promise is still valid. It is your destiny. You can choose from our sect, but there's only one opportunity per individual.
Whether or not you can grasp and comprehend the secret of real fire will depend on your own ability." Song Duantian chuckled dismissively.
What's true fire? It's something even a cultivator at the Golden Core Stage finds difficult to master. Even the most talented individuals capable of mastering true fire cannot possibly master all 108 types, can they?
Only by finding the true fire most suitable for oneself can one truly grasp it.
As for what is most suitable, that isn't something human effort can dictate. It all depends on fate.
Song Duantian snapped his fingers, and the ground cracked open. The red-hot earth collapsed, emitting white smoke as the temperature rose dramatically.
Batches of real fire erupted. Some appeared intangible, shrouded in a hazy mist; some carried the sound of a phoenix's cry, pleasing to the ear; some resembled a blooming red lotus, unfolding a profound mystery...
"Primordial Chaos True Fire, Nirvana True Fire..." Li Haoran named each true fire in turn, expressing his surprise. These true fires, with their robust foundations and vast fire momentum, were at a level higher than what his master possessed.
Song Duantian looked pleased: "How could the true fire controlled by the likes of Zhou Xin compare with what my Five Elements Sect possesses? These true fires are the result of 100,000 years of accumulation by our Fire Vein!"
The true fires amassed by Zhou Xin alone indeed couldn't compare to the true fires collected over 100,000 years by the Five Elements Sect.
Disciples of the Five Elements Sect gazed enviously; they had to complete countless missions to obtain even a single true fire.
"Although you two did not participate in the competition, you are also disciples of Seek Dao Sect, so come and select."
Tao Yaoye and Man Gu didn't expect they also had the chance to select a true fire.
However, neither of them were of the fire attribute, nor did they have the profound comprehension of people like Lu Yang. Whether or not they could obtain a suitable true fire was uncertain.
"Is this Six-C Divine Fire?" Li Haoran stood engrossed before a cluster of flames, his eyes sparkling with excitement.
The Six-C Divine Fire is another kind of true fire suitable for refining. Its inherent Wen, Wu fire and Qimen Dunjia momentum can devour impurities. It is also excellent for engraving inscriptions!
The Fifth Elder also has Six-C Divine Fire, which is a true fire passed down through generations of peak masters. Originally, Li Haoran intended to learn it from the Fifth Elder after returning from the Five Elements Sect, but since he has the opportunity to learn the Six-C Divine Fire now, it means that it is his destiny, and it shouldn't be missed.
With the Cultivation Level of the Golden Core Stage, one can at best learn two types of true fire; learning more would only be a burden.
Li Haoran has already grasped Dayan True Fire, so naturally, he would reserve the spot for the second true fire for Six-C Divine Fire!
"Lunar True Fire?" While choosing a true fire, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou noticed a cluster of pure white fire emitting a chill.
"Old Meng, why don't you give it a try? You already have Pure Yang True Fire, with Lunar True Fire, you'd have both Yin and Yang elements." Lu Yang nudged Meng Jingzhou with his elbow, wearing a cheeky grin.
"Get lost, with my Cultivation Level, incorporating both Yin and Yang would only result in self-destruction."
"Phoenix's Nirvana Fire?" The pair found another place with an indistinct whistling of a phoenix.
"It is said that this is the lineage true fire of the Phoenix clan. It possesses the power to resurrect." Meng Jingzhou looked interestedly at the Phoenix's Nirvana fire.
But, because it is the lineage true fire of the Phoenix clan, it is extremely difficult for other races to master.
"Don't even think about reincarnation, that's just a rumor." Lu Yang said, thinking about the story of Phoenix Nirvana as told by Fairy Eternity.
"However, the legend of Nirvana is false, but its ability to heal is real, and it is quite suitable for you." Meng Jingzhou often fights with his body and gets injured easily. It would be perfect for him to use Phoenix True Fire to offset these shortcomings.
"I choose it!" Meng Jingzhou declared confidently.
Lu Yang was the last to choose. He was attracted by a cluster of blazing fire, its golden crow shadow flickered within the flames as though possessing a spirit. It was the Sun True Fire.
Sun True Fire, also known as Golden Crow True Fire, holds rank alongside Meng Jingzhou's True Yang Fire as one of the two top Yang attribute true fires, possessing incredible offensive power.
Furthermore, there are ancient rumors of ten suns hanging in the sky, accompanied by ten golden crows that swept across the world, leaving nothing alive in their wake and devastating the earth. Unable to bear the sight of the world suffering, an Immortal shot down nine of them, leaving one to illuminate the world. This shows how dangerous the Golden Crow is.
"Perfect, since Three Flavored True Fire lacks offensive power, I can make up for it with Sun True Fire." Lu Yang said to himself.
"Golden Crow, ah, Immortal Jiuchong loved it the most." Fairy Eternity suddenly commented.
"Immortal Jiuchong?"
"Yes. At the time, Immortal Jiuchong was researching the Yin-Yang Dao Fruit and reached a bottleneck, so he looked everywhere for a solution."
"One such solution was to find the Golden Crow, representing extreme Yang, and the Jade Rabbit, representing extreme Yin, and enable them to mate. He hoped to engender the path of Yin and Yang to bring him enlightenment."
"He was worried that one pair wouldn't be enough, so he brought ten Golden Crows and ten Jade Rabbits."
"Those ten Golden Crows mated day and night, and finally couldn't take it anymore. They took advantage of the night to escape. Ten Golden Crows appearing together, it was extreme heat. Immortal Jiuchong quickly saw that his test subjects had run away, and he immediately shot down nine of them. However, he needed to preserve some for further experiments, so didn't kill them."
"At the time, I was saying to the tenth Golden Crow that I hadn't tasted Golden Crow yet, and suggested that he should shoot it down so that the four of us could have a meat feast. But Immortal Jiuchong's hand trembled and he missed, letting that Golden Crow escape. What a pity."
Fairy Eternity recounted the story regretfully, shaking her head. She still considers it a waste till date.

chapters.title: Chapter 533 - 532: Learning the Golden Crow True Flame_1
chapters.content:
In truth, Lu Yang was curious, now that nine Golden Crows had returned, how should the ten Jade Rabbits be allotted? Would they all breed together, or would the extra one be roasted by Fairy Eternity and used to poison the Four Immortals of the Ancients?
However, he felt he really didn't need to know so much of this shameful past. It was of no use to his cultivation, and it might make it difficult for him to survive if he ever encountered the Four Immortals of the Ancients.
In his mind, Lu Yang no longer had a positive image of the Four Immortals of the Ancients. If he was to meet them, he feared he couldn't save himself, even if he flaunted his good relationship with Fairy Eternity and claimed to listen to her stories about them every day.
Survival, after all, was doubtful.
"So, do you find understanding the Golden Crow True Flame much easier after hearing this fairy's story?"
Knowing the story behind a magic skill enhances one's deeper understanding of its essence. This was a universally recognized fact in the Cultivation World. Unfortunately, the histories of most magic skills sold on the market are too distant, making it difficult to trace the events of that time.
However, for Lu Yang, hearing Fairy Eternity's stories of the magic skills would only dilute his comprehension of them.
"Golden Crow True Flame..."
He used his magical power to gather a small flame on his fingertip. Even though it was a tiny spark, it contained immeasurable energy.
Staring at the Golden Crow True Flame, Lu Yang slowly closed his eyes to understand the substance of the True Flame.
"Which flame should I choose?" Man Gu was perplexed. He wished he could learn the Three Flavored True Fire. He once asked Lu Yang to teach him, but he couldn't seem to grasp it, let alone know where to start.
"Should I choose the Nirvana True Fire like Brother Meng?"
Observing Meng Jingzhou refining the Nirvana True Fire bit by bit, Man Gu shook his head, "No, it won't do. This is a True Fire of the Demon Race. It's not suitable for my bloodline, not to mention that my comprehension is not as good as Brother Meng's. I can't cross the racial boundary to understand this True Fire."
"Lunar True Fire? Not suitable either. My vitality is too vigorous. Understanding the Lunar True Fire would suppress my vitality and weaken me."
"Chaos True Fire? No, I know nothing about chaos and hence, cannot comprehend it."
"Ziwei Heavenly Fire? Not appropriate. Now that the stars are gone, the Ziwei Heavenly Fire derived from the Ziwei Star is a rootless flame. While it's powerful, it's hard to sustain its use."
"This flame seems somewhat familiar. Maybe I should try it." Man Gu happily settled in front of a cluster of flames.
It was the Samadhi True Fire.
Tao Yaoye was also agonizing over which flame to choose. She pondered over the Golden Crow True Fire, Lunar True Fire, and Dayan True Fire, to no avail. None of them seemed right for her.
Eventually, she decided to sit in front of a cluster of flames that resonated with birdsong.
Nanming Li Fire.
Lu Yang's comprehension was making good progress. He imagined himself as the Sun, hanging high in the sky, illuminating the world and nurturing life, when suddenly a giant hand took him and placed him next to a rabbit...
"Look at Lu Yang. He's obviously understanding the Golden Crow True Flame, but his body is displaying both Lunar and Solar powers. And these two powers seem to tend to blend together!"
The cultivators from the Five Elements Sect gasped at the sight. Understanding Lunar power through Solar power was indeed an incredible gift!
Furthermore, the fusion of these two extreme powers!
This man's comprehension of the True Flame was horrifying!
Even the Five Veins Elder and Qiu Jin'an were moved by this, such talent was rare, with only two or three instances in history!
"Old Song, this boy's talent is terrifying!" The Golden Meridian Elder transmitted a message to Song Duantian. They bore a great grudge against Daoist Buyu. Now that Lu Yang had fallen into their hands, they couldn't pass up the opportunity to vent.
After all, if the proverb "a day as a teacher, a lifetime as a father" was accurate, so was "a son inherits his father's affairs and repays his debts." So it was fair for Lu Yang to repay the debts!
Song Duantian frowned, "If we don't get rid of him, he will remember what we've done today. He will become a major problem in the future!"
"Indeed, he's a problem."
"What should we do?"
The Golden Meridian Elder stared fixedly at Lu Yang, torn within, until at last, a ruthless look came across his face, as if he had made some sort of decision.
"After all, we can forget about the grudge with Old Buyu!"
...
"Look, only the Solar power is left on Lu Yang!"
Unaware of the thoughts of the Golden Meridian and Fire Vein Elders, Lu Yang was focused on forgetting his earlier comprehension as quickly as possible.
He almost messed up by following Fairy Eternity's guidance and trying to understand the fusion of Lunar and Solar powers.
That was a close call.
He began understanding the Golden Crow True Flame again. Imagining himself as the Sun traversing the sky, everything was thriving and it was a vibrant scene.
The Sun seemed like a balloon, constantly expanding and contracting, as if it would explode at any moment, causing viewers to feel anxious.
Suddenly, a bird's song came from within the Sun. The sound was pleasant and resonant.
"Done!" Lu Yang was delighted. When he opened his eyes, they were as red as if they were little Suns.
He blinked, and his eyes returned to normal. They were clear and innocent, like those of a child. The previous scene seemed illusionary, causing some doubt.
"You succeeded?" Bai Ming was bewildered. The True Flame he had mastered was the Golden Crow True Flame, so he knew how difficult it was to comprehend this kind of flame.
"We'll know after trying." Lu Yang laughed, appearing very confident. He was sure this time it wouldn't be a problem because he had a thorough comprehension of the Golden Crow True Flame.
Lu Yang spread his left palm. A cluster of flames emerged, and the temperature around him shot up sharply.
The flame flickered mid-air, gradually taking shape. It already loosely resembled a bird.
"Mimicry of True Flame?" Bai Ming gasped, to mold the flame into the desired shape required a high level of control. Most cultivators wouldn't be able to do it without fifty years of hard cultivation.
And considering Lu Yang's ease, it didn't seem like he was intentionally trying to imitate the flame's shape but rather the True Flame naturally took this form!
Lu Yang curved his mouth into a confident smile. He raised two fingers of his right hand to his lips and half-heartedly exclaimed, "True Flame, show yourself!"
The True Flame turned into a Golden Crow, lifelike and intricate, as if it had come alive.
"The True Flame has turned into a Golden Crow?" Bai Ming cried out in surprise again. He couldn't contain his inner shock anymore and blurted out.
The cultivators and elders of the Five Elements Sect had already taken notice of what was happening with Lu Yang.
"He turned the True Flame into a Golden Crow on the first attempt?"
"No, Golden Crows are supposed to have three legs, but Lu Yang's has only two!"
"Is there such a thing as a two-legged Golden Crow?"
"The biggest symbol of a Golden Crow is its three legs. Can a two-legged bird still be called a Golden Crow?"
Lu Yang was also slightly confused. Why did the automatically formed "Golden Crow" from his True Flame look different from what he had envisioned?
He clenched his left hand, extinguishing the True Flame. When he spread his palm again to produce the flame, it still formed a two-legged "Golden Crow".
Unwilling to give up, he tried several times, hoping an extra leg would appear, but it was in vain.
Scratching his head, Lu Yang turned to Bai Ming, who hadn't seen anything like this either, and asked, "Do you know what's going on?"
Bai Ming was taken aback by the question, "Golden Crows always have three legs. Your two-legged creature can only be considered a golden bird."
"So, is mine considered a Golden Crow True Flame?"
Bai Ming's expression became increasingly strange, "Call it a Golden Bird True Flame."

chapters.title: Chapter 534 - 533: Dares a Single Body Spiritual Root Learn Nirvana True Fire? _1
chapters.content:
"Golden Bird True Flame?"
Lu Yang was puzzled. He should be cultivating correctly, looking at the Golden Crow True Flame, listening to the history of the Golden Crow Tribe told by Fairy Eternity, and contemplating himself transforming into the sun, and in the sun, he heard a bird singing.
The True Flame was just at his fingertips, with guidance from the Immortal, and the process of his enlightenment was perfect.
So why was there a two-legged golden bird?
"There are three possibilities." Fairy Eternity said, analyzing seriously.
Lu Yang was overjoyed. He didn't expect Fairy Eternity to be so reliable, to be able to propose three views. Gratefully, he bowed and asked, "May I receive guidance from the Fairy?"
"The first possibility is that you have practiced the Samadhi True Fire into Three Flavored True Fire, and the 'bit' that was missing has been applied to the Golden Crow True Flame."
"The second possibility is that although the original Immortal Jiuchong did not shoot dead the tenth Golden Crow, I was thinking that they could only watch the Golden Crow mate with the Jade Rabbit, which is a pity. So, one of the Golden Crows voluntarily gave me one of its legs. It was preparing for regeneration after mutilation when it was knocked down by the Jade Rabbit."
"The flame you cultivated could be from that Golden Crow that had not had time to regenerate."
"The third possibility is suggested by clues provided by the Kirin Immortal and verified by Immortal Jiuchong. The Golden Crow tribe originally had two legs. It gradually evolved into three legs to adapt to the harsh ancient environment.
Both Kirin Immortal's doctrine of survival of the fittest and the Phoenix Tribe Genius' concept of natural selection were in fact influenced by the history of the Golden Crow Tribe."
Lu Yang felt that none of these possibilities were plausible.
"Well, regardless of what kind of True Flame it is, as long as it is a True Flame."
Lu Yang cupped the Golden Bird True Flame in his hand, feeling the terrifying power it contained. It was a destructive True Flame that was even more powerful than the Three Flavored True Fire. Once it was released, probably only a few at the Golden Core Stage could withstand it.
The second successful person was Li Haoran. Possessing half of Qin Haoran's memories and experiences far exceeding people of the same cultivation realm, he was second only to Lu Yang.
He snapped his fingers, a small cluster of Six-C God Fire burning at his fingertips. He stared at it for a while, took off his wig, revealed his bald head, and used the Six-C God Fire to refine the wig, improving it to the next level.
Yuan Gang saw this and admired him. This person was really tough, willing to even refine his hair into a magic artifact in order to become stronger.
Man Gu was the third to understand True Fire. He grasped the Samadhi True Fire.
He noticed something going on with Lu Yang. Particularly when he saw Lu Yang holding the Golden Bird, he was thrilled and murmured in a low voice.
"The first True Fire Brother Lu comprehended was Three Flavored True Fire, which could elevate the standard of barbecue. After the second True Fire, the raw materials of barbecue were directly transformed?"
There was indeed a large gap between him and Lu Yang. He had a lot of room for improvement.
Half a day later, it was already deep into the night, and Meng Jingzhou, as well as Tao Yaoye, comprehended the Nirvana True Fire and the Nanming Li Fire. They were in the process of understanding the True Flame of the Demon Race, so their slow progress was understandable.
The Elders of the Five Veins were all very shocked when they saw Meng Jingzhou mastering the Nirvana True Fire.
"This kid from the Meng Family is not simple, he has even mastered the Nirvana True Fire."
"I thought he would give up."
"This is the determination of a great person. He possesses a Single Body Spiritual Root, his pure yang body is unbreakable, and the Nirvana True Fire is the True Fire of the Phoenix Tribe, which has the effect of invigorating yang and replenishing blood.
Once a Single Body Spiritual Root masters the Nirvana True Fire, the effects of invigoration probably exceed any Single Body Spiritual Root in history!"
"He can control his desires under these circumstances, not to break virginity, such willpower is admirable!"
"The addition of the Nirvana True Fire to the Single Body Spiritual Root will enhance the strength of the Single Body Spiritual Root, making the cultivation speed faster than before!"
They had lived for so long and this was the first time they heard that a Single Body Spiritual Root could push himself so hard, as to be prepared for a do-or-die battle.
Meng Jingzhou turned his head and looked at the Five Vein Elders who were discussing in low voices, he looked resentful.
You should have said this earlier. If you had, I would not have chosen the Nirvana True Fire.
Now he felt physical reactions, and he was afraid he could not even drink water.
Although all five of them had comprehended the True Flame, which made Song Duantian rather dissatisfied, he didn't say anything. After all, he had decided to let go of his grudge against Daoist Buyu.
The Elders of the Five Veins and Qiu Jin'an left the place. The cracked ground closed and the True Fire seeds became quiet again below the Fire Vein.
Bai Ming coughed slightly, "Shall we continue the visit?"
"Can we still visit at this late hour?" Lu Yang was amazed. If this were the Seek Dao Sect, the Senior Brothers and Sisters would be partying hard by this time.
Bai Ming was also amazed, not understanding why Lu Yang would say such a thing: "As cultivators, we do not need sleep. There are no such distinctions between day and night."
Looking around, Lu Yang found that the Brothers of the Fire Vein were still sitting and cultivating. Only the Brothers who were sunbathing naked during the day were absent.
There was no sun at night, so they could not sunbathe.
Meng Jingzhou recalled, "The Seek Dao Sect used to also cultivate relentlessly without distinguishing day from night. But ever since the Grandmaster retired and the Elder Masters took over, they changed the cultivation method to combine work with rest, advocating for cultivation during the day and recreation at night. There is no need to make ourselves suffer."
After changing the cultivation strategy, excluding the influence of Eldest Senior Sister, not only did Seek Dao Sect's overall strength not decline, but it also seemed to be slowly increasing, showing the feasibility of the new strategy.
"Here is the Water Vein." Bai Ming brought the five to a place filled with water vapor. There wasn't a single person on the surface of the lake, only water plants protruding above the water surface.
"Where are the people?"
Bai Ming stood on the water surface and pointed downwards, "They are all below. Please follow me."
The six of them held their breath, wrapped their bodies with spiritual essence to prevent their clothes from getting wet, and slowly sank into the water.
Upon entering the water, the view suddenly opened up, it was indeed bustling.
Spiritual plants, fish that haven't opened up their spiritual wisdom, strange rocks, whirlpools... It can be referred to as the underwater world.
"It's a pity that you do not possess the Water Spirit Root, otherwise you would be able to experience the unique spirituality of this place more easily."
The disciples of the Five Elements Sect moved freely in the water, showing that they often cultivated here. Some even moved in circles in the water, creating underwater cyclones. Two disciple collided their water cyclones, causing upheavals in the water.
The Seek Dao Sect also has a place for cultivating the Water Spirit Root, which is a vast lake that can contain the peak of Sky Gate Mountain without leaking it from the top. It's just that Lu Yang and his companions are not Water Spirit Roots, so there is no need for them to cultivate in such a place.
"The original Water Vein was just a lake. One of the Water Vein Elders travelled to the East Sea and found that the ocean and lakes were entirely different environments. So, he used his Storage Ring to steal a large amount of sea water from the East Sea and brought it to the Water Vein."
"Later, he thought that merely having sea water was not enough. There were no sea clans in it, so the true environment was different from the East Sea. The Water Vein Elder ran back to the East Sea again, contacted all the sea clans there, and asked if they wanted to move to the Five Elements Sect."
"Most of the Sea Clan refused, but a small part wanted to change their environment, so they followed the Elder back to the sect. The Elder took them to register, which involved a lot of procedures."
Bai Ming pointed to the front, "The seawater stolen from the East Sea, and the sea clans, are up ahead."

chapters.title: Chapter 535 - 534: Sea Clan and Ice Domain_1
chapters.content:
Actually, the Sea Clan is a kind of Demon Race, a race of demons that have lived in the sea for a long period of time.
Like the Long Clan, there are Long Clan in the Demon Territory and in the East Sea. The Long Clan of the East Sea belongs to the Sea Clan.
Upon their arrival in the Water Vein Sea, the sight of the six people turned dark, unable to see anything clearly. After the shadow gradually faded away, they could see what it was.
"That's a whale, a creature unique to the East Sea, which has not yet developed its spiritual wisdom."
The group then saw a group of beings with human bodies and fish tails, all female, with delicate features and excellent figures, their vital parts covered with shells, and their eyes sea blue.
"This is the Fishman tribe, also known as the Mermaid Tribe, believed to be the result of a transformation of ancient humans and great fish demons. The female mermaids often appear in groups and hunt, while the male mermaids take care of household chores."
Suddenly, another mermaid swam past, her tail undulating, her appearance even more outstanding than the Fishman tribe they'd just seen. She gave the group a glance and continued to swim.
"Is that a solitary mermaid? Has she been ostracized?"
"No, that's my Water Spirit Root Senior Sister Tang Fulign, who is researching how Water Spirit Roots squirt out seawater. She often disguises herself as a member of the Sea Clan."
Lu Yang was even more curious: "Is it difficult for Water Spirit Roots to squirt out seawater?"
"Of course, it's difficult. Water Spirit Roots are water, how can they produce salt?"
Lu Yang felt that this was indeed difficult.
"But that's not right, what use is there studying this?"
Bai Ming looked embarrassed: "Family disgrace should not be aired in public, please don't let word of this out, lest it reaches the court's ears."
"Don't worry, we're all tight-lipped." Meng Jingzhou guaranteed, indeed telling the truth. The identities of the young master and the four saints of their Heaven's Court had not been revealed yet, the strictness of their confidentiality is evident.
Of course, from a certain perspective, they were worried about the danger that might come about if their identities were exposed. It was a matter of self-preservation.
"Senior Sister Tang likes money. She heard that selling untaxed salt brings quick profits, so she's preparing to do so."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
No wonder he dared not let it reach the court's ears.
"With so much seawater here, wouldn't it be easier to just dry up the seawater into salt?"
"Senior Sister Tang said, she's responsible for her own actions. If she uses seawater to produce salt for sale, it would be easier for the court to trace it back to our sect."
"Good heavens, she's thought this through." Li Haoran exclaimed. She had considered every aspect of the situation, nearly as meticulously as Qin Haoran had.
"That's the Turtle Clan, that's the Shark Clan, and that's the Clam Clan." Bai Ming pointed out the origins of these sea clans one by one. When the sea creatures saw they were guests of the Five Elements Sect, they all nodded and greeted them.
The Turtle Clan with their heavy turtle shells, the Shark Clan who still had gills on their faces, and singing Clam women.
"What a pity the top Sea Clans like the Dragon Tribe and Kun Peng Tribe aren't willing to leave the East Sea to live in our sect. Even if they were willing to come over, they would only come to have a look around before heading right back." Bai Ming looked rather regretful, having never had the opportunity to meet the Long Clan and Kun Peng Tribe.
"The Kun Peng Tribe has asked me for help before." Fairy Eternity said, she was, of course, familiar with the Kun Peng Tribe, as the elder patriarchs of the Kun Peng Tribe would be extremely respectful towards her.
"What did they ask for your help with?"
Did they ask you to spare their lives, or were they hoping that you could make them taste better?
An alert from the Invincible Elixir caused Lu Yang to swallow his words.
"Have you heard of the description of the Kun Peng Tribe by people? 'There is a fish in the Northern Sea, whose name is Kun. The Kun is so big, I don't know how many thousands of miles it is. It turns into a bird, named Peng. The back of the Peng, I don't know how many thousands of miles it is.'"
In the ancient era when the planet was still in existence, the Kun Peng Tribe lived on a planet named Northern Sea.
"I've heard of it, why?"
"At that time, the old patriarch of the Kun Peng Tribe came to me, saying that the lack of standardization in measurement resulted in discrepancies in scales among different races, especially the standards for 'one mile', 'one meter', which resulted in confusion when describing their Kun Peng Tribe, as they could not be sure exactly how long they were."
"The old patriarch of the Kun Peng Tribe asked us, the Five Immortals of the Ancients, if we could standardize the measurements. At that time, we just happened to have this idea, so we agreed to his request."
Lu Yang: "..."
So that's what that description meant.
"Why does it feel a bit cold?" Tao Yaoye asked after the group had swam for a while.
Golden Core Stage cultivators aren't affected by heat or cold, but they can sense the temperature of the environment.
"We are approaching the Ice Territory. It was constructed by the first generation Water Vein Elder using Array Method. With the additions by subsequent generations of Water Vein Elders, the area has grown larger and the ice thicker. Not many people come on regular days, would you like to take a look?"
Cultivation methods and divine abilities of the ice attribute are considered a branch of the water attribute. There is also a Water Spirit Root variant called Ice Spirit Root. Thus, the Ice Territory is also a place needed by Water Spirit Root cultivators.
Just as they were talking, a giant iceberg slowly drifted towards them. The whale in front of the iceberg seemed as small as an ant in comparison, with only one-tenth of the iceberg showing above the water surface, and the remaining nine-tenths submerged below.
"Since we have a rare opportunity, let's go take a look." Meng Jingzhou said with a smile. When he came to the Five Elements Sect last time, he was engrossed in learning magic skills and didn't have time for a detailed tour of the Five Veins.
To the north of the Great Xia Dynasty is a region known as the frigid Extreme North, where few people, even from the Seek Dao Sect, have ever ventured.
The Extreme North region has few living creatures and few resources for cultivation. Basically, aside from ice, there's nothing there, so it's not worth the visit.
As they moved deeper into the Ice Territory, they could feel the biting cold more intensively. Under these conditions, even the Golden Core couldn't protect them, and they started to feel the harsh cold. Spiritual energy circulated three or four times slower than usual, making it feel sluggish.
But along the way, no one asked to stop, everyone continued swimming forward.
"Enough, we will stop here." Bai Ming also couldn't handle the cold any longer, his teeth were chattering.
Everyone sighed in relief. They were having difficulty keeping it together and were relieved that someone finally called a stop.
