"Given that the Ice Territory was established by the first-generation Water Vein Elder, doesn't that mean it's full of thousand-year-old ice, ten thousand-year-old ice, and even hundred thousand-year-old ice?" Man Gu asked curiously, his eyes gleaming. Living in the western high-temperature region of the mainland, he's never seen so much ice.
"Of course, there is. This place is filled with ice that is ten thousand to a hundred thousand years old. But it's of no use."
"Isn't it useful? I've heard that ten thousand-year-old ice is very valuable."
Bai Ming waved his hand and explained to Man Gu: "That's just brokers fueling the hype, making it seem splendid, saying things like ten thousand-year-old ice has historical connotations, that it contains ten thousand year old chilliness, and that it's a great help in cultivation. It's all a trick. They make it seem as if the older it gets, the more valuable it becomes.
Why don't they also consider selling the spiritual energy we breathe, which has been around for millions of years?"
"Even this water, these stones, they are nothing less than a hundred thousand years old."
Lu Yang nodded frequently at Bai Ming's point of view next to him, and accidentally caught sight of Meng Jingzhou staying silent and looked puzzled.
"Old Meng, what's the matter? Don't you normally like to speak at this moment?"
Meng Jingzhou sent Lu Yang a voice message: "Keep quiet. It was our Meng Family that hyped up the ten thousand-year-old ice."

chapters.title: Chapter 536 - 535 Time Stops_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang looked at Meng Jingzhou oddly, "Your Meng Family sure has plenty of ways to make money."
"Why are you looking at me like that? It's not like I'm the one who inflated the price of the ten-thousand-year ice. It's the Meng Family. The Meng Family of tens of thousands of years ago." Although Meng Jingzhou always refers to "our Meng Family," when it comes to his own reputation, he still tries to dissociate himself from the Meng family.
Even though it was the Meng family that artificially inflated the price of thousands of years old ice, this applies to ordinary ice. For things like Mystical Ice marrow and Ice Fetuses, the older they are, the more useful they are.
For instance, ancient cultivators who were in deep slumber frequently used tens of thousands of years old Mystical Ice Marrow to freeze their bodies. And now, they woke up and willingly walked into the trap of Great Xia.
Some were less fortunate. They either used Mystical Ice Marrow of insufficient age, or fake Mystical Ice Marrow, so only managed to get half-frozen before its effects wore off, forcing them to emerge prematurely. This was the situation with those ancient cultivators in the Unification stage that Lu Yang encountered in the bizarre events of Buyi town.
"Why bother with ten-thousand-year old Mystical Ice Marrow? In my humble opinion, one Eternity Immortal Fruit should be enough to ensure their hibernation till the end of time. They will never wake up prematurely," said Fairy Eternity.
"But isn't your Eternity Immortal fruit for the dead? It ensures that the corpses will not rot." Lu Yang inquired.
"It's essentially the same, those who freeze themselves with Mystical Ice Marrow are not too dissimilar from being dead. Why do you think they can sleep till now, unfettered by the limits of their lifespan? Isn't it because they were put into a state of suspended animation when they were frozen?" Fairy Eternity replied.
"Um, suspended animation might not be entirely accurate. It's more like time has almost stopped."
"Time stopped?" Lu Yang asked, confused.
Fairy Eternity solemnly nodded. At this moment, she recalled Miss Yun's warning – not to disclose too many unusual things to Lu Yang. She remembered her nonchalant and carefree life amongst the ancients, smiling proudly with her head held high.
Who does this Miss Yun think she is, anyway? I don't care a jot about her!
Tell him!
"What I'm about to share with you is extremely confidential. You must not tell Miss Yun about it!" she declared.
Despite her wisdom, Fairy Eternity quickly devised a plan that catered to both their needs.
"Fairy, whatever you say, I am as tight-lipped as they come. You can trust me," Lu Yang promised, patting his lips indicating his reliability.
Although Lu Yang still remembered Eldest Senior Sister's warning, his curiosity always got the better of him when Fairy Eternity started revealing such things.
However, if Fairy Eternity wanted to tell him about shameful past events from ancient times, that's a different story.
The first leader and the second-in-command exchanged glances and shared a knowing smile, seemingly having forgotten their internal dispute from a few days ago.
"If you cultivate your Heavenly Eyes and have superior vision, you'll find that everything in the world is in motion. Be it humans, objects, dust particles, or the smallest particles that constitute matter as viewed through the Heavenly Eyes."
"Everything moves."
"Immortal Jiuchong possesses the Yin-Yang Dao Fruit, controlling temperature to the extreme. He discovered that movement is not absolute. If you reduce the temperature to the limit, even the smallest particle would be frozen and unable to move."
"After Immortal Jiuchong asked Time Immortal about this situation, Time Immortal researched and asserted that under extreme cold, Immortal Jiuchong could use extreme cold to stop time."
"Wait, Time Immortal can stop time too?"
"Of course. Time Immortal can halt the time of the entire world. His range is much wider than Immortal Jiuchong's."
"Later, Immortal Jiuchong discovered that under high-temperature scenarios, the movement speed of the smallest particles would accelerate. So he adjusted the temperature to the maximum, a temperature far exceeding that of the Sun."
"Under extreme heat, the movement speed of the smallest particles reaches its limit, which is the speed of light. This is the domain of the Time Dao Fruit."
Lu Yang inwardly pondered the story just told, feeling that he gained a lot. "Are you saying, Fairy, that regardless of the kind of Dao Fruit, they all eventually lead to the same road?"
Fairy Eternity stared at Lu Yang's eyes for a moment. She was just reminded of this incident when she spotted the ten-thousand-year-old Mystical Ice Marrow. There was no other hidden meaning.
"Yes, I was just trying to tell you this. I didn't expect you to comprehend it on your own!"
As they conversed, the group arrived at the Golden Meridian.
Upon stepping into the Golden Meridian, everyone felt a slight numbness on their skin. Their Golden Cores automatically protected their bodies by coating them with a thin layer of Spiritual Energy, which made the numbness disappear.
"This is the unique invisible Golden Qi of the Golden Meridian. According to Elder Tong, also known as the Elder of the Golden Meridian, the Golden Meridian is composed of countless valuable Fine Stone veins. The Fine Stones have their own pride which prevents them from co-existing with other ores.
The collisions between the Fine Stones caused the leakage of the Golden Qi, creating the unique phenomena of the Golden Meridians."
Plant life rarely thrives in the earth of the Golden Meridian. Even when there are Spiritual Plants, they are types rich in metallic gloss, spirit stones influenced and assimilated under the influence of the Golden Meridian.
If they can thrive in an environment filled with Golden Qi, there's no need to say how formidable these Spiritual Plants are.
Lu Yang's Sword Spirit Root is a variant of the Golden Spirit Root. He is most sensitive to the active Golden Qi of the Golden Meridian. If the Golden Qi is refined, it forms the most basic form of Sword Qi.
Man Gu noticed that many disciples of the Five Elements Sect were sitting on the Golden Meridian, with numerous magic artifacts floating above their heads, rising and falling like they were floating on the sea.
Others paired up, controlling various magic artifacts in competition. The magic artifacts could even combine to form powerful formations. This showed the strength of their spiritual sense.
Bai Ming chuckled, "The Golden Meridian is most adept at controlling metal. You can think of it as Swordsmanship."
"If we are talking about those most adept at controlling metal, it has to be the first Elder of the Golden Meridian. His cultivation level was earth-shattering, every move he made was in accordance with the laws of nature. Otherwise, he wouldn't have been so powerful. If it weren't for him moving several veins here at the inception of the sect, we wouldn't have the Golden Meridian we have today."
"...So, did the Golden Meridian of your Five Elements Sect get... stolen from somewhere else?"
"You can't call it stealing." Bai Ming corrected. "That's called illegal mining."
"And the first elder of the Golden Meridian had studied law. At that time, the Great Xia had just been established, and the juridical system wasn't yet well-established. There weren't even draft laws in place, so he took advantage of this gap to contribute to the sect by 'borrowing' several veins."
There wasn't even a draft law, so it couldn't be considered a crime, right?
Lu Yang: "..."
"The first elder of the Golden Meridian said that as a cultivator, our actions should be in accordance with the laws of nature, implying that cultivators themselves are a part of the laws of nature. Thus, his moving of the veins to the Five Elements Sect does not constitute illegal mining but can be seen as a natural shift in the veins.
It only happened a little faster with his help, and is not a crime."
"And then?"
"The court didn't believe it."
"I figured as much."
"Later, he borrowed money from the Meng Family and bought these few veins."
Bai Ming glanced at Meng Jingzhou and added, "As for the loan borrowed from the Meng Family, it was paid off sixty thousand years ago."

chapters.title: Chapter 537 - 536: The Earth Vein suits me well_1
chapters.content:
"Our Meng Family has always been fond of helping others in need. There's no need to thank me for such a small matter."
After the war ended a hundred thousand years ago, the Land Money Trade Association disappeared without a trace. The Meng Family, as one of the two most influential families fighting for supremacy, was the most powerful existence at the time, with only the imperial court being a match for them.
The imperial court did not carry out any purge against the Meng Family, nor did it curb their influence, which shows the trust the court placed in them.
"By the way, what really happened during the battle between your ancestor in the Meng Family and the first Emperor Xia? How did your ancestor lose and what was their respective realm back then?" Li Haoran asked about this, stirring interest in everyone.
Meng Jingzhou shook his head: "Don't look at me, I really have no idea. Not even my father or my grandfather knows exactly what happened. "
"You should rather ask Eldest Senior Sister."
Others immediately dismissed the idea with a wave of their hands.
Who would dare to ask Eldest Senior Sister casually? It would be fine if it were a question about cultivation, but if it were just to satisfy curiosity, she would probably toss the person from the peak of Sky Gate Mountain to the foot of the mountain.
"Actually, I know a little about this." Man Gu said hesitantly.
"You do?"
"Yes. Our barbarian tribe had an ancestor who transcended the tribulation. He fought alongside the first Emperor Xia and witnessed the battle between the ancestor of Meng Family and the first Emperor Xia. My ancestor recorded this event, but that information is confidential. I never had the privilege to read the records. I only heard about it from our Clan Leader."
Although the power of the barbarian tribe could not compare to the Meng Family, in terms of historical legacy, it could only be compared with some of the large species from the Demon Territory.
Man Gu continued: "From the strength of the armies at the time, the Meng Family was more formidable. And in terms of individual combat, the ancestor of the Meng Family had higher chances of winning. I believe that both sides eventually chose not to fight with their armies to avoid unnecessary losses. However, what Clan Leader couldn't understand was why the first Emperor Xia won in the end."
"Anyway, the result was that the first Emperor Xia won. The two sides made a certain agreement during the battle that the victorious party would not punish the defeated one. From Brother Meng's situation, it seems that this agreement has been maintained till now."
Soon, Bai Ming led the five to another location and jumped into a deep pit: "This is the Earth Vein."
Standing on the Earth Vein, there was a sense of firmness and solidity, as if one was merging with the earth. It seemed that the earth of the Earth Vein was also extraordinary.
"The Earth Vein is known for its defense. When cultivated to perfection, as long as one steps on the earth, there will be a constant surge of strength."
"So, you're saying we just have to fight in the sky?"
Bai Ming shook his head, laughing with delight. If it were that simple to find a countermeasure, how could the Earth Vein exist in the Five Elements Sect?
He pointed to the ground two or three meters above his head: "Do you know what this place is?"
"Isn't it a dirt pit?" Man Gu was confused.
"You'll know once you jump out of the pit."
Upon hearing this, everyone took a deep leap and easily jumped out of the dirt pit.
Upon glancing down at the pit from mid-air, their pupils shrunk in surprise.
This was not a pit, it was a footprint!
Looking around, the Earth Vein was full of these "pits"!
"The people of Earth Vein never fight in the sky. They follow the laws of the universe, can change in size according to their will, and just focus on reaching the enemy. Why would they need to fly?"
Lu Yang felt that the method of Earth Vein practitioners was in line with his mentality.
"Please step aside, don't stand next to the footprint!" A voice came from afar.
Upon hearing this, Bai Ming quickly jumped out of the pit.
The moment he jumped out, he saw the ground rise. The firmly trodden earth became "soft" and the "pit" was filled up by magic.
"Senior Brother Kong, you almost buried me!" Bai Ming complained to the owner of the voice.
"Didn't I miss you?" The owner of the voice appeared with it, a brawny man of about two meters in height.
"Who are these five people?" Senior Brother Kong noticed the five strangers: Lu Yang and company.
"They are guests from the Seek Dao Sect."
"This is Senior Brother Kong Ling, the Eldest Senior Brother of the Earth Vein who is currently trying to comprehend the boundary between Refining the Void Stage and Unification Stage, attempting to break through. The footprints you just saw were all made by him."
"Good to meet you, Senior Brother Kong Ling."
"All's good, all's good. How's Old Dai doing? Is he still in the Task Hall?"
"The Grand Elder is out all year round, and Elder Brother Dai has taken over all duties of the Task Hall."
"Old Dai is still gifted after all. He's already reached the Unification Stage. I'm still a bit behind." Senior Brother Kong Ling looked envious.
While talking, Kong Ling's realm fluctuated from being undetectable to being apparent at Foundation Establishment Stage, and then ascended to a realm beyond the perception of Lu Yang and the rest.
"This guy is about to break through to the Unification Stage." Fairy Eternity made a judgment.
After bidding farewell to Senior Brother Kong Ling, the six arrived at the Wood Vein. Similar to the medicinal farm of the Seek Dao Sect, the Wood Vein was a place for planting spiritual grass. It was lush and radiated a mysterious aura. Just standing here, one could feel a sense of floating.
There was dense forest and it exuded vitality like springtime.
There were also giant trees that covered the sky, extending endlessly into the distance. Their tops were blocked by branches and leaves, as if hiding a secret.
"The attribute of Wood Vein is vitality. It has a strong regenerative power. This has some similarities with the Nirvana True Fire that Brother Meng has mastered."
"Are the little fellows from Seek Dao Sect here?" A lively girl's voice came from the giant tree.
The girl did a flip from the tree branch and landed steadily on the ground, a branch hanging from her mouth.
This was none other than Shangguan Yu, the person who Uncle Ba had come to meet at the Five Elements Sect.
"Not bad, youngster. Your cultivation is solid." Shangguan Yu slapped Lu Yang's shoulder. She had taken a keen interest in this boy who could be appointed Acting Sect Master when she visited the Seek Dao Sect last time.
Not meeting for more than a year, Lu Yang's rate of growth was beyond her expectations.
"We pay our respects to Elder Shangguan." Lu Yang and others dared not be disrespectful to Shangguan Yu. She was a senior to Sect Leader Qiu.
Hearing them call her 'Elder', Shangguan Yu frowned slightly, somewhat displeased: "Don't call me elder. Do I look so old? Call me sister."
Lu Yang and the others didn't dare call her that. They feared that even if they could get through Elder Shangguan, they might not get past Qiu Jin'an.
"If you call me 'sister', I will give you a good thing."
Shangguan Yu took out a small wooden talisman that radiated vitality. Seeing this, Fairy Eternity's eyes lit up and she immediately urged Lu Yang.
"Lu Yang, call her quickly. This is a valuable item."
With Shangguan Yu in front and Fairy Eternity behind, Lu Yang had no choice but to give in. Risking his life, he obediently called out...
"Sister Shangguan."
Shangguan Yu laughed when she heard this, she raised her toes and touched Lu Yang's head: "Good boy, this amulet is for you."
As a result, Lu Yang finally got the wooden talisman.
"Fairy, what is this piece of wood? All I can feel from it is a strong life force, but I can't tell what type of wood it is."
"Firmament Tree."

chapters.title: Chapter 538 - 537 Firmament Tree_1
chapters.content:
"Firmament Tree?"
Lu Yang's eyes bulged out in disbelief as he stared at the wooden charm.
"Isn't that the Time Immortal's true form?"
Most people do not recognize immortal objects, often assigning the term "immortal" to various rarities. For instance, people often refer to the Little Medicinal Kings as "Immortal Herbs," and call peerless treasures swords as "Immortal Swords," and name incomprehensible methods as "Immortal Methods."
But in reality, whether it's the Little Medicinal Kings or the peerless treasure sword, neither reaches the level of "immortal."
The Firmament Tree is different, it's definitely an immortal object, there's no room for dispute.
"I knew this thing looked familiar! It's definitely a part of Yingtian Immortal, it's just a bit too small, or else I would have recognized it right away!"
When it comes to familiarity with the Time Immortal, Fairy Eternity is second to none.
Lu Yang looked taken aback, and asked again: "So how did this little piece of Firmament Tree come about? Did the Time Immortal peel it off from his foot skin?"
Who could hew a piece of wood from the invincible body of a Time Immortal?
Fairy Eternity glanced at Lu Yang disdainfully: "How could that be possible, an immortal being has a flawless body, it wouldn't have foot skin-like thing that mortals have."
"So how did this little piece of Firmament Tree..."
"Maybe it was blown off by me."
Lu Yang: "..."
"It could also have been hit by Yingtian Immortal and the others. After all, the Time Immortal said he would definitely become an Immortal before he became one. He angered many when he said that none of you would be able to become immortals. After becoming an Immortal, Yingtian Immortal and the others attacked him in the dark many times."
"But this piece of wood is too small, I can't tell who hit it."
"If I remember correctly, wasn't it you, Fairy Eternity, who originally told Yingtian Immortal and the others when the Time Immortal only told you that?"
Fairy Eternity waved her hand, instructing Lu Yang: "The result was about the same, you shouldn't worry about so much. You should learn more from me in that aspect."
"Also, ask this little girl if she has more Firmament Tree."
If Sister Shangguan could give Lu Yang a piece of the small Firmament Tree, then there must be more pieces on her side.
"Sister Shangguan, can I ask you what this is, as I've never seen anything like it before?" Lu Yang asked politely.
"You haven't seen it before, right? This is just a small piece. The larger part is under the Wood Vein, it's a piece of charred gigantic tree. The vitality of the Wood Vein comes from this gigantic tree, our Sect's ancestor was quite surprised when he discovered the gigantic tree under the Wood Vein."
"The vigor of the gigantic tree has sustained the Wood Vein for a hundred thousand years without deterioration, which demonstrates the strength of this tree."
"Our ancestor also discovered this point, the vitality contained in the gigantic tree is unimaginably strong, surpassing what we in the Cultivation World can understand. None of the spirit trees recorded in the ancient books match this."
"So, our ancestor made a bold guess. This is not anything else, but a part of the body of the Wood Immortal!"
Nowadays, in the Cultivation World, they don't know the real name of the Time Immortal, they only know that it has transformed from a tree, so they habitually called it the Wood Immortal."
"Wood Immortal?!" All the people exclaimed in surprise, even Bai Ming who had never heard about this before, had no idea that the vitality of the Wood Vein was actually due to a gigantic tree.
"Sister Shangguan."
"Sister Shangguan."
As soon as they heard that the piece in Lu Yang's hand was a part of the legendary Wood Immortal, everyone started calling Sister Shangguan one after the other, even Bai Ming started to join in.
"It's too late to call now," Shangguan Yu turned her head to hide, so that they wouldn't see her smiling.
Then she turned back around, speaking seriously: "You'll have to call me that a few more times."
The echoing chorus of "Sister Shangguan" put a big smile on Shangguan Yu's face.
"Come on, one piece for each person, it can keep you safe. You can have one too, Little Bai Ming."
Shangguan Yu took out five small wooden charms and distributed them to everyone.
"Protect safety?" Lu Yang remembered when Meng Jingzhou was suffering from causality backlash, Fairy Eternity said that the Time Immortal has the ability to drive away evil, which could spare Meng Jingzhou from the causality backlash.
If the Time Immortal's body was truly effective in ensuring safety, then why did Qiu Jin'an go to borrow the power of the State Destiny from the Governor of the Wild State?
He entered his spiritual space, just as he was about to ask Fairy Eternity, he saw her make a decision and start to spread her divine consciousness.
Initially, Fairy Eternity wondered if doing so would offend the Five Elements Sect, but Shangguan Yu's reminder made her see reason, so she didn't mind it anymore.
She immediately spread her divine consciousness to scan the Wood Vein, and sure enough, she found the piece of gigantic tree that Shangguan Yu had mentioned.
The gigantic tree was unfathomably large, traversing the entire Wood Vein. The fact that Lu Yang and the others could easily tour the Five Veins and get around quickly was because they were moving near the junction of the Five Veins, where distances are much shorter.
In reality, the Five Elements Sect is only a bit smaller than the Seek Dao Sect, covering an area of eighty thousand miles, and the Five Veins are the backbone of the Five Elements Sect. One can imagine how vast the Wood Vein is, and how long a tree that can traverse the Wood Vein must be.
However, this tree, compared to the Firmament Tree that Fairy Eternity remembered, which had reached through the heavens and pierced the earth, was quite a lot shorter, even small, by comparison.
Fairy Eternity concentrated in the spiritual space and projected what the gigantic tree looked like.
The gigantic tree was charred black all over, showing signs of fire and lightning damage. Many layers of its old bark had fallen off, and it even looked as if some attacks had gone straight through its heart.
"What's going on?" Lu Yang was shocked. Even as a layman, he could feel what kind of attack this tree must have suffered. The term severe would be an understatement.
Fairy Eternity was silent for a while before finally speaking in a sober demeanor, that contrasted with her previous laughing tone: "Time Immortal was attacked and the attacker used the most common forms of attack to conceal their identity."
"At first, I thought that when I self-destructed, Time Immortal employed techniques like the Withered Wood Meeting Spring and the Golden Cicada Shedding Skin, leaving behind a doppelganger while the true form escaped. But that doesn't make sense. Yingtian Immortal had said that we shouldn't leave our doppelgangers in the world, as they could be a boon or bane for the world.
Therefore, there should not be a Time Immortal doppelganger here."
"Now that I see this piece of the Firmament Tree, I can be sure that it's Time Immortal's true form and a significant part of it has been reduced to nothingness."
Fairy Eternity did not remember any battle of such magnitude taking place when she was alive.
This was a battle of immortal calamity-level.
"After my demise, Time Immortal had once embarked on a grand battle, and the opponent was extremely powerful."
Time Immortal holds the Time Dao Fruit, allowing him to observe the past, predict the future, and restore his body to a state before it was injured. The fact that he was still left in such a state indicates the intensity and terror of his opponent.
Lu Yang trembled in his heart: "Did... Did Time Immortal... die?"
Fairy Eternity slowly shook her head: "I can't be sure. An immortal's vitality is more robust than you can imagine. Even without his physical body, he may still survive. But if Time Immortal is in this state, even if he is still alive but lost his physical body, his condition is probably not good."
"Time Immortal and I are different. With the Eternity Dao Fruit available, I could create a physical body to accommodate my immortal soul at will, but Time Immortal can't do that. The body of an immortal is crucial to an immortal being, and it's tough to find anything in the world that can replace or rebuild an immortal body."
If the Time Immortal's body has been reduced to this state, with his life and death unknown, what hope is there for blessings and protection?

chapters.title: Chapter 539 - 538: Housewife_1
chapters.content:
There had always been a question that had been bothering Lu Yang.
Even though merely reading the name of Fairy Eternity could resurrect her, why was it that it wasn't until three hundred thousand years later that she was inadvertently resurrected?
Referring to the method of the Imperial Teacher's Causality Dao Fruit, the person who assassinated Fairy Eternity might have used a similar method, erasing the world's impression of Fairy Eternity.
But, would this method also work on immortals?
No one could be certain of that.
Right now, the body of the Time Immortal is buried underneath the Wood Vein, her immortal soul has gone missing, leaving her fate unknown.
Given the state of the Time Immortal, what would the Yingtian Immortal, Immortal Jiuchong, and Qilin Immortal be facing? What roles did they play in the fall of the Time Immortal? Were they murderers or victims?
"Fairy, do you not remember at all what happened just before your fall? Any characteristics of the killer?"
Fairy Eternity furrowed her brows, striving to recollect the events of that time.
"My memories of that period are all very hazy. All I recall is that I was sleeping that day. In my drowsiness, I felt my soul lifting, feeling very comfortable, like it was melting. I don't remember anything after that. When I woke up later, it was when you called out my name, and my soul reformed, successfully resurrecting."
Lu Yang sighed, it seemed that he couldn't get any information from Fairy Eternity.
Fairy Eternity, who claims to be the first among the Five Immortals of the Ancients, certainly had notable abilities and couldn't have been attacked without any reaction. Either the attacker was too powerful, or something was wrong with Fairy Eternity's state.
"They are free to kill me, but to not spare the Time Immortal and the others, I'd better not find out who did this, or I'll beat them to death!" Fairy Eternity said angrily. It didn't matter if she died once. Over the long years, there would always be someone who happened to call out her name. However, the Time Immortal was different. Her main body was buried here. Chances of survival seemed slim.
In consolidating the Eternity Dao Fruit, the Time Immortal had given her much help, and this favor could not go unrequited.
"Upon returning, tell Eldest Senior Sister about this matter and let her make the decision." Lu Yang was dejected, regretting that he was temporarily unable to help Fairy Eternity.
"Since the Time Immortal's condition is unknown, how is the Firmament Tree still showing signs of life?" Lu Yang pointed to the wooden plaque he had just received.
Fairy Eternity looked at the shadow of the Firmament Tree she had constructed with a complicated expression and sighed lightly, "A unique object like the Firmament Tree can gradually recover its vitality and complete the transformation from death to life as long as there is a tiny bit of residue left.
This can be considered a different type of resurrection, but then it is a completely new Firmament Tree, and it has nothing to do with the Time Immortal."
"The Firmament Tree beneath our feet is gradually regenerating. In a few tens of thousands or hundreds of thousands of years, the Firmament Tree will completely resurrect and erupt from the ground, growing into a new towering Firmament Tree."
"That tree Shangguan Yu was standing near earlier, it shouldn't have grown this tall. It was influenced by the life force of the Firmament Tree. If I am not mistaken, the roots of that tree are very close to the Firmament Tree."
"The Time Immortal had also mentioned that in the past, the Firmament Tree encountered a great catastrophe, was cut off at the waist, and lost all its vitality. A new Firmament Tree grew out of the old Firmament Tree, and this is it."
"All right, that's enough sightseeing for you kids today. Have a rest tonight." Shangguan Yu clapped her hands and let Bai Ming take them to their accommodations. They would start to study the "Five Elements General Outline" the next day.
Although she didn't detect the existence of the Time Immortal's body under the Wood Vein, she knew how precious the Firmament Tree was. She wouldn't just share it with anyone. She felt that these five individuals were bound to achieve great things in their future cultivation, leaving a significant mark in history. She was here to cultivate a good relationship with the younger generation.
The accommodations arranged by the Five Elements Sect were at the intersection of the Five Veins, which was equivalent to Qiu Jin'an's territory, a position that could be compared to Sky Gate Mountain.
"Oh my, you're back. I haven't seen you in a long time, Sect Leader Lu." A familiar voice chuckled, teasing Lu Yang.
As soon as Lu Yang looked up, he saw Lin Shaoyou, the top disciple of Qiu Jin'an, with his Wood Spirit Root. He was at the early stage of Unification but had combat power comparable to that of the late stage. He was of the same genius level as Senior Brother Dai Bufan.
During the last visit of the Five Elements Sect to the Seek Dao Sect, it was Acting Sect Leader Lu who had entertained Lin Shaoyou.
Lin Shaoyou had assumed that the Eldest Senior Sister was still the Acting Sect Leader, so he had proposed challenging someone of his generation. But when the Eldest Senior Sister silently stepped forward, Lin Shaoyou retreated quietly, and the matter was dropped.
"Greetings, Senior Brother Lin," the five of them bowed and saluted.
"Alright, don't be so stiff. Relax. I just came out to get some fresh air because I got tired of practicing my magic skills. I happened to see you guys returning, so I came to greet you."
"Eh? Did the teacher give you wooden plaques?" Lin Shaoyou noticed the wooden plaques hanging on the chests of the six.
Bai Ming's face changed drastically, and he quickly pulled away Lu Yang and the others.
Lu Yang and the others didn't understand but obediently kept their distance.
With a crack, a startling thunderclap resounded and Lin Shaoyou was struck, his exterior charred and his insides tender, his body emitting black smoke.
Bai Ming explained in a low voice, "Senior Shangguan really hates being called old. If anyone knowingly offends this rule, their fate will be this."
"Ahem, it's nothing, a small matter." The charred corpse came back to life, its eyes glittering.
A faint crack was heard, and countless cracks appeared on the surface of the charred corpse. Lin Shaoyou calmly walked out of the corpse as if nothing had happened at all - even his clothes were brand new.
Bai Ming explained again in a low voice, "Eldest Senior Brother's clothes are synthesized from leaves grown from his body, which are then transformed into clothes. It's a process most people can't see clearly. I only figured it out when our master explained it."
Meng Jingzhou's eyes lit up. Lin Shaoyou was of the same generation as Dai Bufan, in other words, of the same generation as Eldest Senior Sister, and they were not in the Seek Dao Sect.
"Brother Lin, how old are you this year...."
Before he could finish, Lu Yang suddenly reacted, covering Meng Jingzhou's mouth from behind and dragging him back.
"Don't drag all of us into your death wish."
The others looked at each other in confusion, not understanding Lu Yang's sudden reaction.
Lin Shaoyou directly asked, "Does Junior Brother Meng have a question to ask?"
"No, nope, he was just sleep talking," Lu Yang answered on behalf of Meng Jingzhou.
"By the way, Eldest Senior Brother, weren't you mastering a new magic skill not long ago? Why are you still practicing magic skills?"
"Heh, heh, considering how talented I am, if I have new ideas and learn a new magic skill, that's perfectly normal, right?"
"So, what are you practicing this time?"
"I am combining Tree Growing Spell and Draw the Ground into a Prison to increase the strength of Draw the Ground into a Prison. It's a bit complicated to explain. Why don't I just show you."
Lin Shaoyou took out a few tree seeds from his bosom, spread them around as he spun in a circle. The seeds hit the earth and took root instantly. They grew rapidly around him, the branches and leaves twisting inward to form a bird cage.
The trees emitted a metallic sheen, very similar to a tree that has grown from a golden meridian.
"Look, like this." Lin Shaoyou punched the iron tree and it did not budge a bit. He then stomped on the ground, also to no effect.
The roots below formed a unified whole, unbending and extraordinarily firm.
"That's amazing," praised Bai Ming. This skill alone could catch someone off guard and trap anyone on the same level.
"Eldest Senior Brother, you seem to be executing this pretty smoothly. Why are you practicing further? Is there something lacking?"
"There's a minor issue with this combined magic skill that I haven't been able to overcome."
"What is it?"
"I don't know how to cancel it voluntarily."
Bai Ming: "....."
Bai Ming slowly raised his hand, forming a fist, "Take care, Eldest Senior Brother!"
Bai Ming signaled everyone to leave. Lin Shaoyou sighed, it seemed like he could only rely on himself now.
"Help, master!"
Boom, boom, boom —
Three thunderbolts descended, but Lin Shaoyou remained unharmed.
"Huh? What's the logic behind this?"

chapters.title: Chapter 540 - 539: Useful Ancient Knowledge_1
chapters.content:
"The elements of Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, and Water generate and overcome one other, each promoting or restraining the other. For example, Wood generates Fire, Fire generates Earth, Earth generates Metal, Metal generates Water, and Water generates Wood. They are the foundation of the world.
The existence of the five tones, five flavors, five colors, five transformations, five internal organs, and five senses is not a coincidence. Instead, these are results corresponding to the five elements..."
In the lecture hall, the Elder of Passing Skills was enthusiastically narrating the "Five Elements General Outline" on the podium. He was quite animated, gesticulating, and throwing himself wholeheartedly into the most exciting parts of the lecture.
From inside her Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity yawned, almost falling asleep. Her eyes were brimming with tears. The Elder's lecture paled in comparison to Daoist Buyu's, and was not as engaging and interesting at all.
"This is so boring; Immortal Jiuchong has already covered all of this."
"Isn't Immortal Jiuchong's Dao Fruit the Yin-Yang Dao Fruit? Does that not also relate to the Five Elements?"
"Have you forgotten about Jiuchong's Immortal Technique?"
Lu Yang pondered for a moment. When he was at Eternity Sect, Fairy Eternity had mentioned it once. He could barely recall the specific names, but he remembered a lot of numbers.
"Digital Immortal Skill?"
"To be accurate, it should be referred to as 'The Immortal Technique of Primordial Chaos, Two Polarities, Three Talents, Four Symbols, Five Elements, Six Harmonies, Seven Luminaries, Eight Wastes, Nine Territories, Ten Heavens, and One-and-Only Supreme Being.'
True to her reputation as the first one to become an immortal, even her technique's name is longer than others.
"Immortal Jiuchong had a deep understanding of concepts like Primordial Chaos, Yin-Yang, and the Five Elements. She spent quite a bit of time during her Transcendance Tribulation Stage deciding among the Dao Fruits of Chaos, Yin-Yang and the Five Elements. She ultimately chose the Yin-Yang Dao Fruit."
"Why didn't she choose the other two?"
"In Immortal Jiuchong's words, it was probably due to predestined fate."
"Fate?" Lu Yang could sense Immortal Jiuchong's feelings when she spoke those words. It was a fatalistic sentiment full of sense of impotence.
Fairy Eternity had told him that amongst the immortals, some believed in destiny while others did not. Fairy Eternity was part of the latter group. It seemed like Immortal Jiuchong belonged to those who believed.
"Yes, even Immortal Jiuchong found it very hard to make a choice. As each of the three Dao Fruits had its own advantages and disadvantages. In the end, she resorted to drawing lots."
"She went through a lot of trouble to accomplish this. After exhausting all kinds of secret treasures, she set up a large formation in the universe that blocks spiritual senses. The nodes of the formation were set up around stars. Then she asked us few to act as Protectors.
In the end, closing her eyes and sealing away her five senses and seven perceptions, she ensured that she wouldn't be influenced by the outside world before she felt comfortable to draw the lots."
"The result of the draw was the Yin-Yang Dao Fruit."
"Immortal Jiuchong didn't trust the results of the first drawing, so she mixed up the orders and drew two more times. Each time, it was the Yin-Yang Dao Fruit."
"If one time could be considered an accident, then when the result is the same all three times, it can be said to be a matter of destiny."
Lu Yang thought to himself that if the result was the same three times, wouldn't that just be a probability of one out of nine?
Considering that this might be the difference between him and the immortals, he decided to stop questioning it.
"Although she chose the Yin-Yang Dao Fruit, Immortal Jiuchong had a deep understanding of Primordial Chaos and the Five Elements."
"Don't think that a Dao Fruit is the entirety of an immortal. We immortals often gather, exchanging and reflecting on our insights, and sharing our understandings, experiences, lacks and surpluses. Therefore, we five people could be said to have an unsurpassable reservoir of knowledge regarding cultivation!" Fairy Eternity laughed proudly, her laugh filled with knowledge and wisdom.
Lu Yang nodded. This was indeed true. He had heard that the higher one's cultivation level, the more one needed to exchange and reflect with peers. Having a single exchange with a peer can sometimes be worth a hundred years of cultivation.
Considering the frequency at which the Five Immortals of the Ancients gather, their accumulated knowledge could very likely be equivalent to a million years of cultivation.
"Lu Yang, stand up and answer this question." The Elder of Passing Skills was glaring unhappily at Lu Yang. Though the Elder admitted that his lecture was indeed a dull one, seeing someone as audacious as Lu Yang daydream through it was a first.
Lu Yang stood up in panic. He had been too engrossed in listening to ancient secrets, and hadn't been paying attention to what the Elder was saying. He hurriedly sent a spiritual message to Meng Jingzhou.
Thanks to Fairy Eternity's cover, the Elder didn't discover that he was sending a message.
"What did the Elder just say?"
"Don't ask me, I was also not listening."
Meng Jingzhou was breaking out in cold sweat, fearing that the Elder might ask him next.
He had drifted off earlier, once he heard the Elder say "Earth", he started contemplating whether it would be better to directly bury living people instead of executing and then burying them?
"Man Gu, do you know?"
"I don't."
At that moment, he was wondering if being the last of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe, would he have reproductive isolation with present Barbarians.
Lu Yang asked around, but none of them had a solid answer.
"Lu Yang, answer the question. You couldn't have been not paying attention, could you?" The Elder of Passing Skills was still staring at Lu Yang.
Lu Yang took a deep breath. At this point, there was no other choice.
"Immortal Jiuchong's Dao Fruit is the Yin-Yang Dao Fruit, giving her the ultimate power. Yingtian Immortal's Dao Fruit is the Tribulation Dao Fruit, most Cultivators' tribulations are due to the Tribulation Dao Fruit. Time Immortal's Dao Fruit is the Time Dao Fruit, giving him control over the power of time.
Qilin Immortal's Dao Fruit is the Survival of the Fittest Dao Fruit, rendering all attacks he has experienced ineffective!"
The lecture hall fell silent.
"Elder, did I answer correctly?"
The Elder of Passing Skills was momentarily stunned.
He had a memory of Lu Yang speaking a lot, but he couldn't recall a single word Lu Yang had said.
What did he say?
"Elder, Elder?" Lu Yang called out to the Elder twice before the Elder snapped back to reality.
"Ah, ah?"
"Elder, you weren't daydreaming just now, were you?"
The Elder of Passing Skills gave a dry cough as if he didn't hear Lu Yang's last sentence. "Ahem, ahem. Lu Yang, your answer was more or less correct. Let me retell it. Five is the most stable digit in nature."
"For example, the Central Dynasty and the four other lands to the east, west, south, and north. The Five Great Immortal Sects, the Five Veins of the Five Elements Sect, Four Great Devil Sects along with the unknown Heaven's Court."
"According to the theory of the Five Elements, Heaven's Court is likely to become the Fifth Great Devil Sect, forming 'five.'"
"And you five, you are the five most outstanding individuals among the younger generation of the Seek Dao Sect. This also is in line with the theory of the Five Elements."
Meng Jingzhou sent a secret message to Lu Yang, "That was impressive. What did you do just now? I heard you speak a lot, but I can't remember a single word."
Lu Yang said seriously, "This is an ancient secret technique, and only I can use it."
He heaved a sigh of relief, glad that the Forgotten characteristic of the immortals came in handy.
The Elder of Passing Skills soon arrived at the main point of the day's lecture, "Next, let's discuss knowledge about the technique of Five Elements. Who among you is most familiar with it?"
"He is."
The other four all pointed at Lu Yang without hesitation. Lu Yang was surprised.
The Elder was slightly surprised but very pleased, "Oh, I heard you have a Sword Spirit Root. I didn't expect you to also be proficient in the Five Elements technique. Can you tell us how you cultivated it?"
Lu Yang scratched his head awkwardly. How was he going to explain that his cultivation of techniques was effortless and that he never encountered any bottlenecks?
"I just followed my intuition. Casually practiced a bit and then somehow made it."
Though the effectiveness of the technique was uncertain, his cultivation method was indeed quite casual.

chapters.title: Chapter 541 - 540: Learning the Water Dividing Technique_1
chapters.content:
"Stop spouting nonsense, do you think Five Elements magic skills are so easy to practice?" the Elder of Passing Skills scolded Lu Yang. If Five Elements magic skills were that easy to practice, what would they need the Five Elements Sect for?
"Don't think that just because you stumbled upon a Five Elements magic skill and practiced it casually, you can dismiss the learning of magic skills."
"What Five Elements magic skills have you practiced? Let me see."
In the Elder of Passing Skills' view, Lu Yang probably learned simple and easy-to-learn magic skills like Fireball and Earth Wall, thus finding Five Elements magic skills easy to practice.
Helpless, Lu Yang had to demonstrate the magic skills he learned one by one.
He opened his right hand, and a golden firebird appeared in his palm. It seemed lifelike, emitting terrifying heat, and burnt the quiz that the Elder of Passing Skills placed on the podium.
Lu Yang then opened his left hand, and the Three Flavored True Fire was burning fiercely.
The Elder of Passing Skills focused all his attention on Lu Yang's palm, failing to notice this little trick.
"What is this?"
"Golden Bird True Flame, Three Flavored True Fire."
"What?"
How come he hadn't heard of these two types of True Fire before?
When did the one hundred and eight types of True Fire become one hundred and ten?
Before the Elder of Passing Skills could react, he saw Lu Yang take out a seed and plant it in the ground.
The seed fell into the ground and rooted, sprouting two lotus flowers. On each lotus flower stood a Lu Yang, one dressed in clothes, the other wrapped in a lotus leaf.
"What kind of magic skill is this?" The Elder of Passing Skills almost popped his eyes out, this was unheard of.
"Tree Growing Spell."
What kind of Tree Growing Spell is yours.
Before the Elder of Passing Skills could voice his thoughts aloud, he saw Lu Yang retract his clone, burrowing around in the ground, moving freely. He could even take a couple bites of soil as if it was nothing.
"Earth Escape Skill?" The Elder of Passing Skills was very uncertain. Lu Yang's posture seemed like the Earth Escape Skill, but the circulation route of his spiritual essence was different.
"I named it 'Shrink Land'."
"You created it yourself?"
"Almost, came across it by chance."
The Elder of Passing Skills's face twitched. He didn't recognize any of the Five Elements magic skills demonstrated by Lu Yang. They were definitely not those simple and easy-to-learn magic skills.
"As for a metal-specific magic skill, sword forms should barely count."
Lu Yang did not plan to display the Golden Body. That was Young Master Lu's move; he was not Young Master Lu, so how could he perform the Golden Body?
"I haven't learned any water-based magic skills."
The Elder of Passing Skills was astounded. Lu Yang had learned four out of the five elements, and even mastered sword formation techniques without falling behind in any realm.
Could it be that this kid Lu Yang really has such a high attainment in Five Elements magic skills?
Born...taking on Seek Dao Sect as a master, it is indeed a big win!
"Very good, the magic skills of the Five Elements generate and overcome each other. Few people are able to learn two skills that overcome each other; you've managed to grasp four of the Five Elements. This shows that you have uncommon talent in this area."
"Exactly, not to brag, but Lu Yang's talent surpasses even Eldest Senior Sister!" Meng Jingzhou highly praised Lu Yang's talent in magic skills. As a good brother, he felt quite proud.
"Right, right, right, that's exactly what I think too." Li Haoran eagerly agreed.
Man Gu scratched his head, feeling that these two people had hidden meanings in their words. Was it just an illusion?
Forget it, let's just go with the flow.
"I think so too."
Only Tao Yaoye stayed silent.
Lu Yang was sweating profusely, Meng Jingzhou you little bastard, are you trying to kill me with praise?
You can't escape punishment for this!
"If you can master four of the Five Elements magic skills, the remaining water-based magic skills should not pose too great a difficulty for you."
"If you manage to master five different types of magic skills, according to the generating and overcoming cycle of the Five Elements, you can create powerful combination magic skills!"
"Well, do you want to learn a water-based magic skill?"
As soon as he heard about the opportunity to learn magic skills, Lu Yang was not going to refuse.
"I ask the elder for guidance."
Seeing Lu Yang's respectful attitude, the Elder of Passing Skills' impression of Lu Yang improved significantly. He nodded.
"Let me think... then you should learn the Water Division Skill."
"Water Division Skill?"
"Water Division Skill is an extremely difficult water elemental magic skill to learn. Even those with a water attribute dual spirit roots may not necessarily learn it. But conversely, the difficulty in learning it implies immense power. Once learned, it can subdue all water elemental magic skills!"
Everyone present was surprised, they hadn't realized that this skill was so potent.
The Elder of Passing Skills, stroking his white beard with a chuckle, said, "It is said that during the end of the Great Yu period, when the influential family monarchs raised armies and the world was in chaos, a man possessing the Great Divine Ability led a town of people to refuge, but their path was obstructed by a huge river. The river's waves were vast and its currents surging.
No ship could cross."
"The Great Divine Ability holder could naturally cross the river, but the common folk could not."
"The Great Divine Ability holder stood by the river, using his staff to touch the ground three times, and the gargantuan river parted in the middle revealing an eighty-meter-wide road, with the water flowing on both sides erecting like walls."
"Once all the people crossed the river, the water walls collapsed with a thunderous sound, and the river returned to its original state."
"That was the Water Division Skill!"
All water spells were rendered useless in front of this divine ability, which could partition a river.
"With your current realm, dividing a river could be too taxing for your body. However, dealing with water spells within your realm should not pose a threat."
Lu Yang gasped. The water division skill sounded formidable.
"Let's say it this way,"
The Elder of Passing Skills took out a water-filled glass, gently swiped on the glass, and the water in the glass divided into two distinct parts.
He tilted his head back and drank half of the water in one gulp, leaving the other half unchanged.
"Please teach me, elder," Lu Yang bowed his fist.
"Alright."
The Elder of Passing Skills did not give Lu Yang special treatment and explained the water division skill to all five of them.
It was a good opportunity to gauge Lu Yang's aptitude for the Five Elements magic skills.
"To learn the water division skill, you need to calm your mind, concentrate the spiritual essence in your hands, form the Five Elements water seal. Touch the tip of your thumb and pinky, and spread the remaining three fingers…"
The Elder of Passing Skills, the mentor of the disciples of Five Elements Sect, explained the skill in a dry and lackluster manner. But one would realize how remarkably clear his explanation was once understood.
It didn't take more than two hours for Lu Yang to grasp the knack of the Water Division Skill. However, Meng Jingzhou and others progressed slowly due to their limited talent in magic skills, especially those that required Water Spirit Root.
"Elder, I want to give it a try."
The Elder of Passing Skills gestured, and a water ball the size of a small ball floated towards Lu Yang.
"If you can divide this water ball into two, you have succeeded."
Lu Yang clasped his hands to form the Five Elements Water seal and recited the mantra silently.
"All the lakes and seas return to their origin, the nine rivers and eight lakes open four paths... split!"
With his right forefinger and middle finger clasped together, Lu Yang aimed at the water ball and shouted lightly. The water ball vanished into thin air!
Elder of Passing Skills: "..."
What's wrong? Where's the water ball?
"Try again."
He conjured another water ball and gestured for Lu Yang to proceed. Lu Yang cast the Water Division Skill, and the water ball disappeared into thin air again, leaving no trace.
Lu Yang was also puzzled. How could a water ball simply vanish? He wasn't studying a void magic skill. He turned to Fairy Eternity, "Fairy, did you see what I just did?"
Having heard that Lu Yang was learning a magic skill, Fairy Eternity naturally didn't miss the spectacle. She had been observing carefully from within the Spiritual Space.
"I saw it. After you cast the Water Division Skill, the water ball didn't vanish but became too tiny to be seen."
"Too tiny to see?"
"Yes, it split into two streams of gas. One stream comprised a small ball orbiting another small ball, and the other stream comprised eight small balls orbiting a central small ball."
"These two types of gases are common in the air."
Lu Yang: "..."
So I split the water into hydrogen and oxygen?

chapters.title: Chapter 542 - 541: The Power of Li Haoran_1
chapters.content:
The Elder of Passing Skills had long cultivated the Heavenly Eye, and when Lu Yang performed the water-dividing skill for the second time, he finally figured out the principle behind it.
"So, it actually decomposes water into the two gases of Light Air and Vital Qi. Typically, this only happens when water is struck by thunder magic. I didn't expect you could achieve the same effect with a magic skill. That's truly incredible."
Among cultivators in the Cultivation World, spells that can alter the structure of matter at the atomic level, such as turning stones into gold, are performed at will. The Elder of Passing Skills had so keen an understanding of atomic composition and categorization that he could turn any random stone into radioactive material.
Neither a First-Grade Golden Core nor a cultivator in the fulfilled Nascent Soul Stage feared radioactive materials as their cultivation had reached the state of flawlessness.
However, the Elder wore a puzzled look and stroked his white beard, recalling the crux of the matter: "But the magic skill I taught you should be able to separate water, making you immune to water-element attacks. Why does it have this kind of effect?"
Lu Yang responded earnestly: "Yes, this is indeed a water-dividing skill. As you can see, it separates water into two gases and also makes me immune to water-element magic attacks."
The Elder of Passing Skills thought for a long time, feeling something was off, but he couldn't put his finger on it.
Whether by its name or effect, this magic skill was exactly like a water-dividing skill.
This was truly a water-dividing skill.
"Congrats, you've finally mastered all five-element spells!" Meng Jingzhou, his best buddy, clapped his hands merrily. As he was less gifted in magic skills than Lu Yang and hadn't managed to learn the water-dividing skill, he had simply chosen to give it up.
After some hesitation, the Elder nodded.
"Seeing as you've learned all five-element magic skills, you can perform powerful combined magic skills based on the Five Elements Theory: the generation cycle of five elements is an endless process."
The Elder then fell silent. He'd been guiding disciples of the Five Elements Sect for a thousand years and had seen all kinds of five-element magic skills, providing guidance on how to combine them based on the types of skills they had mastered.
But for Lu Yang...
Truth be told, he'd never seen any of the five-element abilities Lu Yang had mastered.
"Five-element magic skills are a testament to your passion for spells. It would be counterproductive for me, an outsider, to instruct you how to cultivate. So, after class, practice on your own on how to combine the five-element magic skills."
"Let's have a quick test now. No cheating."
The Elder turned around to retrieve a stack of test papers from the podium, revealing the accumulated dust on the ground.
While the Elder wasn't looking, Lu Yang had one of his Golden Bird True Flames exhale a burst of flame, reducing the pile of tests to ashes.
Even though these five experienced pranksters were used to putting on acts, they couldn't help but laugh uncontrollably at the scene.
The Elder announced the end of class with a gloomy face.
...
"Junior Brother Li, are you seriously challenging me?" Lu Yang amusedly looked at Li Haoran, as he hadn't expected Li Haoran to challenge him of his own accord.
"Indeed, Senior Brother Lu, didn't you say you have mastered combining five-element spells? I want to learn from it!" Li Haoran said with a smile at the corner of his mouth. His decision was not made on a whim. Lu Yang's strength was in plain sight, but Li Haoran didn't challenge him without any backing.
He possessed half of Qin Haoran's memories, which included many powerful magic skills.
He didn't have to painstakingly study these skills' usage like the others; he could use them directly.
That was the confidence he held in challenging Lu Yang.
"Alright, it's just that I've only recently mastered five-element combination and have yet to test it. Parleying with you now gives me the chance. I accept your challenge!" An excited smile appeared on Lu Yang's face. He was eager to give it a shot.
He first let Fairy Eternity expand her Spiritual Sense to scrutinize the surroundings, ensuring that no one, such as the Elder of Passing Skills, would see him using the five-element magic skill, especially the gold-element spell.
"Go on, fight!" Meng Jingzhou seemed overjoyed for this unexpected excitement. He was also curious to see what tricks Lu Yang, this rascally grandson, had up his sleeve.
Tao Yaoye and Man Gu also stood by, with Man Gu even taking a sheep from the dining hall and using the Corpse Chasing Sect's skill to make it dance on the Three Flavored True Fire. The trio occasionally tore some roasted and aromatic chunks of sheep meat from the body to eat.
It couldn't be untold; this time, with the help of Lu Yang's Three Flavored True Fire, not even barbecue sauce was needed. The taste was a notch above what they had eaten back at the Corpse Chasing Sect.
Watching a fight while enjoying a meal- life couldn't get any better.
Before the fight started, Lu Yang kindly reminded, "Before we begin, don't cast any curses or such on me. They won't work. You wouldn't want to harm yourself with backlash."
Even though he didn't understand why Senior Brother Lu could resist the Curse Spell, Li Haoran knew Lu Yang wouldn't deceive him in this aspect.
So he had one fewer method at his disposal.
Since Qin Haoran could transfer his debts to Shi Huagu, he must have mastered Causality Spells.
One less method wasn't a big deal.
The atmosphere became tense as the two prepared for the fight.
Li Haoran was the first to make a move. With a fast and rhythmic hand seal, purple divine thunder condensed in the palm of his hands.
"Palm Thunder!"
The purple divine thunder shot out, ionizing the air. It appeared as a thunder dragon roaring and charging towards Lu Yang.
Lu Yang appeared to have anticipated this. With swift footwork, he shifted from his initial position just before the thunder dragon reached him. The thunder dragon hit nothing but the ground, leaving a charred mark.
"Borrowing Wind!"
The harsh wind howled, stirring up dust that blocked the view - dust that also obstructed the Spiritual Sense. But Lu Yang's Spiritual Sense wasn't something ordinary people could compare with. He expanded his Spiritual Sense. The range he could observe was limited, but he could still see three different types of attacks hidden in the dust.
"Golden Bird True Flames."
Two golden birds circled around Lu Yang, forming a flame whirlwind. Three types of attacks hit the whirlwind and vanished without even altering the wind direction.
"Junior Brother Li, these small magic skills won't work on me."
As the flame whirlwind dispersed the dust, Lu Yang laughed heartily.
Li Haoran calmly responded, "I know, a single attack won't affect Senior Brother Lu. But what if there are more attacks?"
"Palm Thunder!"
Four Palm Thunders erupted at the same time. Lu Yang's expression turned serious. He controlled the two golden birds, transforming them into two streams of light that collided with the four Palm Thunders, causing thunderous and fiery explosions.
"Senior Brother Lu, how's that?"
Li Haoran laughed, swinging his four arms and gathering another attack in his palm.
"Four arms?" Lu Yang was at a loss for a moment.
While Lu Yang was blocked by the dust just now and didn't see how Li Haoran had accomplished it, Meng Jingzhou and two others watching from outside had a clear view.
While Lu Yang was busy dealing with the attack, Li Haoran had removed his own two arms, but he hadn't fully torn them off; the arms were only disconnected at the flesh.
Then he used his Regeneration Golden Core to reconnect the two arms, and at the same time, two additional arms grew from his axilla.
Four arms, as a result.
Li Haoran knew well that Lu Yang wasn't an opponent that could be countered with common magic skills.
So, if one or two common magic skills won't work, what about using four different magic skills with four arms!
If it weren't for the substantial strain that four-armed form imposed on his body, Li Haoran would have grown six arms to battle Lu Yang.
Even though he couldn't physically have six arms, he could still employ other means to achieve the effect of six arms.

chapters.title: Chapter 543 - 542: Combination of Five Elements Magic Skill_1
chapters.content:
Meng Jingzhou and his two companions were enjoying the lamb, applauding at Li Haoran's ingenious tactics.
"This is a good strategy. Ordinary tactics won't work against Lu Yang," Meng Jingzhou exclaimed with admiration. As Lu Yang's old rival, he was well aware that winning over him using ordinary strategies was impossible. It would take a surprising move to defeat him.
"This skin tastes pretty good, even better than the lamb itself," Meng Jingzhou smacked his lips, having been eating the roasted lamb skin, whose smoky aroma tantalized his palate, followed by a delightful crispy sensation as he bit into it. The refreshing wild chive flowers accompanying the meal made it irresistible.
The taste of lambskin overshadowed that of the lamb itself.
Glancing at the Three Flavored True Fire that was blazing, Meng Jingzhou exclaimed, "I got it!"
He made a bold move by casting a wisp of Nirvana True Fire into the Three Flavored True Fire. The merging of the two kinds of True Fire set off crackling sounds.
Under the effect of the Nirvana True Fire, the lamb carcass gradually grew lamb skin. As the skin grew slowly, the lamb got to be meticulously roasted by the Three Flavored True Fire, making it even more delicious than ever!
Watching the scene, Man Gu's eyes gleamed in amazement. He hadn't imagined that Nirvana True flame could be employed in this manner.
If he hadn't associated Three Flavored True Fire with roasting before, due to a lack of exposure to it, that could be excused.
But it was really embarrassing that he had overlooked the use of the renowned Nirvana True Fire in roasting, especially in light of the fact that every cultivator in the Cultivation World knew about Nirvana True Fire.
It was incredibly disgraceful to his status as the heir to the barbarian roasting tradition!
Indeed, following Brother Lu and Brother Meng always led to enlightenment!
As a Confucian Cultivator, Man Gu held the sage's teachings in high esteem, constantly self-reflecting and seeking improvement.
While Man Gu was learning, Lu Yang was still dueling with Li Haoran, who had four arms.
With three heads and six arms, Li Haoran put great pressure on Lu Yang by exhibiting such an iconic Great Divine Skill.
"Palm Thunder!"
"Six-C Divine Fire!"
"Dayan True Fire!"
"Foot-long Bamboo!"
With four different hand gestures, he launched four different magic techniques simultaneously at Lu Yang.
The Golden Bird called out, igniting the Three Flavored True Fire, and stretched its wings. Each feather was as sharp as a sword, cutting through the air.
Neither the Six-C Divine Fire nor the Dayan True Fire could withstand Lu Yang's dual True Fire and Sword Qi attacks despite also being forms of True Fire, which were not celebrated for their explosive power.
The Palm Thunder also vanished during the collision.
Only a section of green bamboo, which Li Haoran had sharpened, made a snap to break the sound barrier and pierced Lu Yang's arm.
Lu Yang, who had sensed the presence of the green bamboo with his Spiritual Sense, was a little late in responding, causing his arm to get slashed.
"Well done, Junior Brother Li, coating the bamboo with poison," said Lu Yang, extracting an antidote pill from his Identity Jade while holding Li Haoran off with Golden Bird True Flame.
"I had no choice. You're too powerful, Senior Brother Lu. I can't beat you without some tricks up my sleeve."
"Moreover, you haven't shown your real skills yet."
All of a sudden, both Lu Yang and Li Haoran made their moves simultaneously, crashing against each other.
They both had the intention to catch the other off guard while talking, yet they ended up having the same idea.
"Arhat Fist!"
No longer holding back, Lu Yang lashed out. Li Haoran, as an Artisan Cultivator, was simply no match for Lu Yang in close combat.
When it came to hand-to-hand combat, only Meng Jingzhou, an exceptional Body Cultivator, and Man Gu, a Confucian Cultivator, could surpass Lu Yang.
But Li Haoran acted quickly. Knowing full well that he couldn't go toe-to-toe with the Arhat Fist, he immediately pulled off his two arms from underneath his armpits, temporarily transforming them into magic artefacts to strike Lu Yang with.
BANG, BANG, BANG!
In the blink of an eye, the two of them clashed dozens of times. But these temporary flesh magic artefacts were no match for the Arhat Fist, and Li Haoran was flung through the air.
On the bright side, Li Haoran was wearing a wig, so his encounter with Lu Yang didn't result in hair loss.
"Golden Body of the Same Size!"
With a light shout, Lu Yang summoned a golden body, which fell from the sky, covering Li Haoran firmly.
"Plant Tree Avatar!"
Lu Yang burrowed into the ground. A seed sprouted, developing into two duplicates of Lu Yang.
"I'm leaving the rest to you."
Lu Yang fist-bumped with his clone. The clone nodded, burrowed into the ground and swiftly approached Li Haoran like an earth dragon.
"Earth Escape!" Li Haoran didn't panic. He didn't know how to shorten the distance, but he knew the Earth Escape Skill.
The only drawback of a Golden Body of eighteen feet is not to seal the underground, which would allow those who can perform Earth Escape to get away.
At this moment, Lu Yang's clone arrived from underground, circling the Golden Body.
"Earth Cage."
The area beneath the Golden Body became a cellar, blocking off Li Haoran's retreat. Li Haoran was forced to emerge.
From then on, the Golden Body was no longer flawed.
Li Haoran grunted coldly, "I want to see what a newly born clone like you could do."
Lu Yang's clone emerged from the ground and entered the Golden Body.
Li Haoran's arm transformed, akin to white jade, and stabbed Lu Yang's clone.
Lu Yang's clone was not affected at all, as if its body was not its own.
"Universe within the Sleeve."
He extended his right hand and a continuous flow of lake water spurted out from the clone's palm, filling the Golden Body in an instant.
"Impossible. Your Universe within the Sleeve stores water, it doesn't connect with the lake. You are just a newly born clone. When did you absorb the water..."
As Li Haoran spoke, he suddenly remembered that Lu Yang had fist-bumped with his clone.
No doubt, Lu Yang must have already stored the water source in his palm before the fight began and passed it onto the clone during the fist bump.
He was careless!
"Water Separation!"
In just three breaths' time, the lake water filling the Golden Body had disappeared, transformed into hydrogen and oxygen!
With the sound of a bird's cry, a golden flame flashed within the Golden Body, causing a huge explosion that even left cracks in the interior of the Golden Body.
"Good grief, Lu Yang's move is really powerful." Meng Jingzhou was surprised, understanding the principle that the smaller the explosion space, the greater the power.
"Not only that, but the two types of gases that Senior Brother Lu decomposed seem to have also facilitated the explosion." Tao Yaoye said seriously, a single Golden Bird True Flame should not cause such an exaggerated explosion, there must be other factors at work.
"This is the combination of five-elemental magic skills that the Elder of Passing Skills mentioned, isn't it?" Man Gu was amazed; the Golden Body, Wooden Avatar, Water Separation, True Fire, and Shorten Distance, all five magic skills were present.
Lu Yang dispelled the Golden Body, revealing only two charred bodies.
"Junior Brother Li, stop pretending. I saw you use a magic skill to escape just now." Lu Yang smiled. He had been watching the movement of the Golden Body from beginning to end.
At the moment before the explosion, Li Haoran used a magic skill similar to Shadow Shifting to swap places with his clone and his real body.
He had long detected with his Spiritual Sense a Li Haoran's clone buried underground, presumably prepared to sneak attack him. Unfortunately, it didn't get a chance to be used, instead it became a lifesaving move.
Thud!
There was a muffled noise behind Lu Yang and Li Haoran crawled out from the ground.
"Such terrifying power." Li Haoran was still somewhat scared, he knew this was the result of Lu Yang restraining his strength. Otherwise, what awaited him wouldn't be one Golden Bird True Flame, but several Golden Bird True Flames plus the Three Flavored True Fire.
"Shall we continue?" Lu Yang turned around and asked with a smile.
"Of course I will..." Li Haoran didn't plan to surrender, but he suddenly felt dizzy, stumbled, and nearly fell.
"I am poisoned... no, what is this?"
Li Haoran detected something wrong with his body, he couldn't continue fighting, but he didn't seem to have encountered any poison throughout.
What was going on?
"Junior Brother Li, do you know that although Vital Qi is essential for living beings, too much of it is not good, it can cause dizziness, chest tightness, and other symptoms."
"From the beginning of our fight, I've been using the Water Separation technique, decomposing all the moisture in the air into Light Air and Vital Qi. As the amount of Vital Qi increased, you naturally couldn't handle it."
"If you were a little more observant, you would have noticed that I've been holding my breath all the time."
"So, do you want to continue?"
"I surrender."

chapters.title: Chapter 544 - 543: It's Normal for Righteous Path Disciples to Prepare Bone-Dissolving Liquid_1
chapters.content:
Tao Yaoye was dazzling with excitement as she saw Senior Brother Lu emerge victorious, and she was the first to applause.
Clap clap clap clap.
"What a thrilling battle!"
Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu thought for a moment, wiped the oil stains from their mouths and hands, and also led applause.
"Winning isn't easy." Li Haoran wasn't an easy opponent to deal with, in this battle, Lu Yang was completely exhausted with a punishing dull ache all over his body.
It was just that Li Haoran's battle experience was lacking and he had a few shortcomings. Otherwise, he wouldn't have been easily defeated by Lu Yang's combined Five Elements magic skill that forced him to exhaust his spiritual energy performing Shadow Shifting, despite being in a drunken stupor.
"Next time, Junior Brother Li needs to be more careful. If it were Old Meng, I wouldn't dare use this trick to beat him. Old Meng is a tricky fellow and would certainly not fall for such a simple ploy."
Li Haoran: "..."
I inherited half of Qin Haoran's memories, so how come I am now inexperienced and naive in the eyes of Senior Brother Lu Yang?
Qin Haoran was in the unification period, he inherited half, so at the very least he should be at a Half Step Unification phase, right?
Well, compared to Senior Brother Lu and Senior Brother Meng, the usefulness of the inherited memories from Qin Haoran was indeed limited.
Li Haoran stood in front of his charred avatar, lost in thought and sighed lightly.
"Senior Brother Lu is indeed remarkable."
Lu Yang could understand Li Haoran's feelings. Li Haoran's avatar was a back-up he had been preparing for a long time, but he never expected that he would have to give it up in exchange for the Shadow Shifting. If his true body had been inside the Golden Body and had been blasted, what would the outcome have been?
Lu Yang patted Li Haoran's shoulder and comforted him, "Junior Brother Li, don't lose heart, your spells are more than effective, it's just that your thinking isn't right. You are too straightforward, too honest. You can easily get tricked by cunning and crafty people."
"...I'm not feeling down, I'm just considering how to dispose of my corpse."
"Your avatar, Senior Brother Lu Yang, is made of wood and naturally decomposes into the earth when the spell is dismissed. But my avatar is made from flesh that was cut from my body."
And the same issue applied to Li Haoran's extra two arms that had grown out.
When Lu Yang thought about it, he realized it was indeed a problem. Junior Brother Li's avatar really was tricky to dispose of.
"Well, although I feel reluctant, I can see no other way."
Li Haoran took out a small bottle of liquid from his Identity Jade, removed the stopper, and a pungent smell hit his nose. With a stoic face, Li Haoran poured the liquid onto his avatar. The dark green liquid made the avatar emit dense white smoke, and the avatar dissolved at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Man Gu gasped, "Junior Brother Li, what is this?"
"Bone-Dissolving Liquid, something from Qin Haoran's memories that I mixed a few bottles of myself."
The ingredients for the Bone-Dissolving Liquid were complex, and he had spent a lot of contribution points to gather all the herbs needed.
Last time he failed in the final round controlling the avatar, he disposed of the avatar in the same manner.
There really was no other way to dispose of it. He surely could not dig a grave and bury his avatar.
Even though he does not believe in fate, he still feels it's a bad omen.
"Hey, what are you five up to!"
"Not good, it's the Elder of Passing Skills."
The commotion from their battle was huge, and Elder of Passing Skills detected it and came to investigate. As he arrived, the fight was over, but he saw Li Haoran pouring a liquid emitting white smoke.
Man Gu, worried the Elder of Passing Skills might misunderstand the situation, quickly stood out to explain.
"Elder, please don't misunderstand. Junior Brother Li is just disposing of his avatar, nothing else!"
Elder of Passing Skills nearly took action to eradicate the reincarnation of a former master of the demonic sect.
It was Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou who clarified the situation with their eloquence.
Li Haoran looked at Man Gu with a resentful gaze.
"So, it was Lu Yang practicing the Combined Five Elements Skill and conducting a live combat experiment."
The Elder of Passing Skills nodded, feeling reassured.
He didn't expect that by day Lu Yang would attend classes and then in the evening, Lu Yang would have figured out how to combine the elements.
Such rapid progress!
Lu Yang also felt the speed of the Invincible Elixir's conclusion was fast.
The Elder of Passing Skills didn't ask Lu Yang in detail how he combined the elements. Since he wasn't asked for guidance after Lu Yang mastered the skill composition, it showed that there were some things Lu Yang didn't want him to see, which was also reasonable.
"But, where did you get the recipe for the Bone-Dissolving Liquid?"
Elder of Passing Skills suddenly realized another issue - why did these pupils of a righteous path sect have a formula for Bone-Dissolving Liquid?
Li Haoran's eyes twitched. He didn't know how to explain. He certainly couldn't say that he was the reincarnation of Qin Haoran.
The Seek Dao Sect may accept him as the reincarnation of Qin Haoran and believe that one's past and present life have no connection, but that may not be the case with the Five Elements Sect.
Meng Jingzhou, as the team leader, earnestly explained, "Our Seek Dao Sect, along with the imperial court, had exterminated the Eternity Sect, and from them, we acquired several resources and pill formulas, among which was the recipe for the Bone-Dissolving Liquid."
"As the righteous path, we regard the eradication of demonic sects as our priority. The demonic sects are cunning and crafty, with countless tricks up their sleeves. Only by understanding the methods of the demonic sects can we better exterminate them!"
"I see, I thought you learned it from Old Buyu."
"Glad to know you are alright. I had thought something unexpected happened due to the noises. Rest well, we still have class tomorrow."
"Yes."
...
"Today, we will be learning the Five Elements Battle Tactics."
"The so-called Five Elements Battle Tactics are to assign each of you, based on your individual characteristics, to one of the five elements. This can increase your combined fighting power when you are fighting together."
Upon hearing this, their eyes brightened. This lesson was much more interesting than yesterday's.
"Based on the materials provided by the Seek Dao Sect, and also according to my understanding of you all, it's clear that you five all correspond to five different attributes. Therefore, you're a perfect match for this battle tactic."
"Gold signifies attack. Lu Yang, you are a Sword Spirit Root mutated from a Golden Spirit Root, and you can be considered a Golden Spirit Root. Moreover, you are the most aggressive one among the Golden Spirit Roots, and hence you fit the gold position."
"Wood represents transformation, existing between reality and illusion. Tao Yaoye, you specialize in illusions and the Feather Transformation Immortal Body, both of which are related to transformation. So, you correspond to the wood position."
"Water signifies recovery. Meng Jingzhou, initially, I thought you would serve as a fire attribute for assistance, but since you have mastered the restorative Nirvana True Fire, you inevitably belong to the water attribute. Thus, the water position is yours."
"Wait a minute, Elder, with my high Yang Qi, can I still stand in the water attribute position?"
In Meng Jingzhou's conception, water represents Yin, which completely contradicts him.
The Elder of Passing Skills didn't understand why Meng Jingzhou was questioning this, "But aren't you a Single Body Spiritual Root? You have abundant kidney water."
