As Meng Jingzhou mastered the Nirvana True Fire, which could invigorate Yang, his kidney water became more abundant. And due to the Single Body Spiritual Root, he would never leak kidney water.
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Just because I can't beat you doesn't mean I won't try!
"Fire is for assistance. Li Haoran, as a Fire Spirit Root, yet also a disciple of Zhou Xin, you are also a Refiner. So, the fire position fits you the best."
"Earth signifies defense. Man Gu, as a member of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe, is naturally a body cultivator. The defense power of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe is renowned, so you correspond to the earth position."

chapters.title: Chapter 545 - 544: Five Elements Combat Method_1
chapters.content:
After confirming the positions, the Elder of Passing Skills led the five outside the room and let them stand in the positions they had previously determined according to the five elements. Subsequently, with his hands behind his back, he said in a loud voice:
"To achieve a high degree of cooperation, we must first know ourselves and each other."
"The five of you are of similar age and have similar realms, which will make this step easier."
"Release your aura, each of you should carefully perceive the realm of the other four."
Lu Yang and the others sat cross-legged, closing their eyes in concentration, releasing their aura, and perceiving the dynamics around them with their spiritual sense.
"Hm? Such a powerful spiritual sense," the Elder of Passing Skills gave a light gasp, noticing that the spiritual senses of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were the most noticeable and obviously much stronger than the others.
Moreover, Lu Yang's spiritual sense was even stronger than Meng Jingzhou's, with a clear difference.
"Spiritual sense is the hardest to cultivate, and so far, I haven't heard of any method to cultivate spiritual sense at this stage. How did these two kids cultivate it?"
"Sure, Meng Jingzhou is a Single Body Spiritual Root, the data given to me by Seek Dao Sect also shows he has achieved the unprecedented Double Single Golden Core, abundant in Yang Qi and desires. As a Single Body Spiritual Root, he should always suppress his desires. In this kind of tempering, it makes sense that his spiritual sense is strong."
"What about Lu Yang? Is it Yun Zhi's secret method? Or was it a method Old Buyu came up with by pure chance?"
Lu Yang, tormented by Fairy Eternity, was particularly good with spiritual sense, his touch was very sensitive. Without hiding his aura, he could sense the condition of his three junior brothers and his grandson.
All four had cultivated to the late stage of the Golden Core; even Li Haoran, who had been delayed for a year by soaking in magma during the Qi Refinement stage, had finally managed to catch up with the others before setting out.
Lu Yang also perceived the vigorous Qi and Blood and Yang Qi of Meng Jingzhou. Just a glance could burn everyday ghosts, which was incredibly terrifying.
Of course, not all ghosts feared Meng Jingzhou; Fairy Eternity, for example, had no fear of him whatsoever.
About an hour later, everyone opened their eyes, having ascertained the others' details.
"Now for the second step, the transmission of spiritual essence."
The Elder of Passing Skills asked the five to line up in the order of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth. Starting with Man Gu, they placed their hands on the back of Li Haoran and began transmitting their spiritual essence. This continued in the same fashion, and finally, Tao Yaoye transmitted all of her spiritual essence, along with the others, to Lu Yang.
Lu Yang's eyes turned red instantly. Despite being prepared, the sudden influx of powerful spiritual essence still caught him off guard, the power reaching the limit of what he could withstand.
"Release it all!" the Elder of Passing Skills shouted.
Lu Yang pulled out the Green Peak Sword, and his spirit and energy combined as one. The sword Qi, like a bright whip, soared in an instant.
"Slice!"
The spiritual essence of the five transformed into sword Qi, like a breaking dam, it poured downward.
Bang!
A ten-meter-long sword Qi cut through the air like a waterfall, carrying an endless power as it slammed into the pond. Suddenly, the wind and clouds changed, the huge roar was deafening, and a massive crack opened up on the ground.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh-
After releasing this sword, all five were drained of spiritual essence to the last drop, their legs trembling as they sat on the floor. They looked at the crack in the ground, giggling foolishly.
Even Lu Yang was amazed at the power of that strike, the strongest he had ever made to date.
"Did you see that sword of mine? I knew this sword would definitely have this kind of power!"
"What does your sword count for? The aura that Man Gu and Li Haoran transmitted almost overwhelmed me. I used the Nirvana True Fire to restore my meridians while dispersing the power!"
"Man Gu, you transmitted too much spiritual essence."
"I was just trying to make it more powerful."
The five discussed in high spirits, their faces full of excited smiles, as they each recounted the process of their previous attacks.
The Elder of Passing Skills gave each of them a bottle of Great Recovery Pill and nodded in satisfaction, "For a first combined attack, that sword strike was quite good. Your next goal is to keep some reserve and not release all your spiritual essence at once."
"The Five Elements Battle Technique has been around for a long time. Elder Song and the other Five Veins Elders have used it frequently, even them, has only exerted a full power strike seven or eight times. Those were desperate times when they did not leave themselves any way out."
"Did they encounter a strong enemy?"
"They encountered your Seek Dao Sect Elders."
"..."
"Oh, and Old Buyu as well," the Elder of Passing Skills added an important figure.
"..."
The Elder of Passing Skills clicked his teeth, shaking at the memory of the attack back then.
It was truly exciting.
"Did Sect Leader cause trouble again?" Tao Yaoye asked.
To make the Five Veins Elders use a full power strike of the Five Elements Battle Technique, the grudge must be huge.
"It would have been seven or eight hundred years ago. Old Buyu took you Fifth and Eighth Elders to the Golden Buddha Kingdom and built a temple. I'm not sure if it was legal or not, but the temple was built."
"The temple's incense was particularly prosperous, probably due to some marketing technique, and there were many pilgrims."
Tao Yaoye was still confused: "What's the problem?"
"The problem was Old Buyu named the temple 'Five Visceral Temples', and inside were placed statues of Elder Song and the other four. This made the Buddha Country think that our Five Elements Sect was trying to steal their business, and they almost issued an international arrest warrant with the imperial court."
"Fortunately, Old Qiu took action in time to clarify the situation and explain the cause."
"When Old Buyu was being beaten, he said that they were carrying out an experiment to see if Elder Song and the other four could feel the faith."
Seeing the powerful sword strike of Lu Yang, Fairy Eternity smiled with interest: "This Five Elements Battle Technique has some merit, it's creative, Immortal Jiuchong developed something similar."
A chill rose in Lu Yang's heart. He had experienced the power of the Five Elements Battle Technique and it truly was formidable. As an immortal, Immortal Jiuchong had a broader perspective. What kind of powerful technique he had created!
"Please, Fairy, elaborate."
"Back when the Five Immortals of the Ancients and I had an exchange meeting to share our cultivation experiences, Immortal Jiuchong raised an idea. He proposed to combine Yin, Yang and the Five Elements to provide reference for future generations. If they could comprehend the mystery therein, they would surely make significant progress in the field of Yin, Yang and the Five Elements."
"Did Immortal Jiuchong succeed?" asked Lu Yang eagerly.
"Yes, it resulted in the game of Go. Haven't you played it?"
Lu Yang: "..."
Once the five had recovered sufficiently, the Elder of Passing Skills continued to have them transmit their spiritual essence with Lu Yang releasing it. However, they had to hold back, not like the first time when they were completely drained.
After several repetitions, the five quickly gained control of the amount of spiritual essence they were transmitting.
"Next is the third step, stand in line again according to the order you just stood in, forming a circle, and Lu Yang, you stand behind Man Gu."
"All five of you should transmit your spiritual essence to the person in front of you, control your speed and the amount of spiritual essence. If the speed is too fast or the amount is too large, the person in front won't be able to bear it."

chapters.title: Chapter 546 - 545: No trade, No killing_1
chapters.content:
All five were transferring spiritual essence to the person in front of them, and due to the consumption by the transfer of spiritual essence, everyone's spiritual essence would be exhausted over time.
Thankfully, Lu Yang had taught the other four the Swallow Heaven Cultivation Method. As they transferred spiritual essence, they would open their mouths wide and swallow the surrounding spiritual essence. The Elder of Passing Skills thought they were bewitched.
The essence transmission was also intended to achieve a state of mutual embeddedness—"you are in me, and I am in you." Lu Yang's spiritual essence was now no longer his own but was from the other four. The situation with the other four was not much different; their spiritual essences were thoroughly blended.
The Elder of Passing Skills did not expect them to enter this state so quickly.
"Now, we begin the third step, practicing combination skills..."
...
"Speaking of which, the time for exchange among the Five Great Immortal Sects is almost up. Our Junior Brother Lu and the others have already arrived at the Five Elements Sect. Why isn't Shi Chan from the Suspension Temple here yet?" Dai Bufan pondered while organizing intelligence reports.
"Could something have happened?"
...
The handsome monk stepped out of the slaughterhouse and headed toward the nearest docking spot for the flying ship.
"What a delicious smell."
The monk's nose twitched; he passed a restaurant. It was noon, the busiest time, and the smell of the food made him stop.
Eating a meal wouldn't delay boarding the flying ship.
He spontaneously changed his trajectory and walked into the restaurant.
"Waiter, do you have any free tables here?"
"Master, you've come to the right place! Our vegetarian dishes at the Thousand-Miles Fragrance restaurant are unbeatable!"
I don't want vegetarian dishes. Serve me two pounds of braised beef, a portion of roasted pork knuckles, and a bowl of lamb offal noodles."
The waiter looked at the monk in surprise, thinking he had heard wrong.
There are not a few people posing as monks these days, but this is the first time he's seen such a fake monk.
However, it doesn't concern him; he just serves what the customer orders.
"Sir, please wait a moment."
Not long after, a large plate of braised beef, a portion of roasted pork knuckles, and a bowl of lamb offal noodles were served. Shi Chan leisurely ate it all.
"Sir, that will be sixty-six coins."
The monk wiped his mouth casually and said lightly, "My master often told me that there's no murder without trade. If no one in the world ate meat, then there would be no one killing livestock, so your restaurant wouldn't sell meat dishes, only vegetarian dishes. He always cautions us not to order meat in restaurants so as not to promote improper practices."
The waiter, confused by this lengthy explanation, asked tentatively, "So, sir, you want..."
"To dine and dash. If I don't pay, it's not a transaction."
...
The gate of the Seek Dao Sect.
Two disciples guarding the mountain were yawning in boredom, chatting about the recent happenings.
"At least no one's been approaching Junior Brother Lu for marriage alliances recently. It's been much quieter."
"No kidding, I've never seen people lining up for it. Quite an eye-opener."
A slender figure walked over, palms joined, and asked loudly:
"Excuse me, is this the Seek Dao Sect?"
The visitor was handsome-looking, draped in a worn cassock, and his big, bright eyes were as clear as a still pond. He was completely bald.
If not for his robe, a disciple would have thought that he was a victim of Lu's Arhat Fist coming for revenge.
"Are you Junior Brother Shi Chan from the Suspension Temple?" one guard cautiously asked. He remembered Elder Brother Dai's instructions about the exchange period among the Immortal Sects and that monks from the Suspension Temple might come for learning and exchange.
"Indeed, it is I. I apologize for arriving late; washing dishes took up a lot of time," said Shi Chan.
One disciple, confused by Shi Chan's words, politely said, "Please wait here for a moment while I fetch Elder Brother Dai."
While one of the disciples went to fetch Dai, the other stayed behind to continue guarding the gate.
Not long after, Dai Bufan hurriedly arrived and saw Shi Chan meditating at the temple gate.
He looked at Shi Chan, who was dignified in appearance, with thick eyebrows and big eyes, a face full of righteousness and a solid foundation without any fluff. Dai Bufan nodded to himself in approval, truly worthy of a disciple nurtured by Master Jiesha.
Shi Chan was meditating cross-legged, suspended in mid-air. He sensed Dai Bufan's arrival, got up and paid his respects: "It's good to see you, Elder Brother Dai."
"Junior Brother Shi Chan, are you the only one visiting the Seek Dao Sect?"
"My Senior Brothers and Uncles at the Temple are busy, they didn't have the time to accompany me here."
"Busy?"
"Yes, Master heard of news regarding your Sect Leader in the Wild State, hence took my Uncles and Senior Brothers there."
Dai Bufan: "..."
If he remembered correctly, his own Master, impersonating Daoist Buyu, was spreading information in the Wild State, storytelling everywhere.
Could it be that the news Master Jiesha had heard was about his Master?
Forget it, his Master was blessed and didn't need his worries. The worst-case scenario would involve him getting caught and beaten up, but it wouldn't lead to death.
"Junior Brother Shi Chan, please come in."
Dai Bufan personally welcomed Junior Brother Shi Chan, hoping that his actions could touch Master Jiesha, so that he would go easy on his Master when beating him.
The two of them passed through the territory of the River Spirit and entered the core area of the Seek Dao Sect. The bustling activity in the Seek Dao Sect caused Shi Chan to gasp in surprise.
Compared with the Suspension Temple, the Seek Dao Sect was really exceedingly bustling.
"I wonder how much Junior Brother Shi Chan knows about Seek Dao Sect, and what he hopes to learn here?"
"My Master, while he could still speak, told me a lot about the prestigious Sect. Your Sect is abundant in training resources and plentiful magic skills. Especially the Scripture Pavilion, which houses an inexhaustible number of magical skills."
"I do have a couple of divine abilities that I want to learn."
"Junior Brother, feel free to speak up."
"I heard that Lu Yang has an Arhat Fist, which anyone who takes a hit from will lose all their hair. I wonder if I could learn it?"
"This…" Dai Bufan looked troubled. Of all the skills, why did you have to choose to learn Lu Yang's? Is it even possible to learn it?
"To be honest, Junior Brother Lu's Arhat Fist is indeed unique. Only he can perform it in the Sect, and he is currently visiting the Five Elements Sect for mutual learning."
"And there's Meng Jingzhou's Unity of Fist and Cultivation, his Single Curse Fist contains the concept of Causality. I wonder if that could be learned too?"
"…"
You boy, are you sure you're not here to stir up trouble, why do you choose to learn the skills that are not available?
"So none of them are here?" Upon receiving this news, Shi Chan seemed visibly disappointed.
He had long admired these two styles of martial arts, considering them to be the true Divine Abilities of Buddhism. Nothing, not even the "Transformation Sutra" or "Golden Body" could compare to them.
It's a pity that the ones who could perform them weren't around.
"It seems that it's not fated yet. It's not right to force it. Elder Brother Dai, you may continue with your tasks. I will take a walk around the Seek Dao Sect. Your Sect is indeed famous for a reason. I've never seen it before.
It's an excellent opportunity to broaden my horizons."
Dai Bufan was indeed quite busy. He was the de facto leader of the Task Hall. Even a day off meant amassing a mountain of work.
"Take good care of this token. With this command plate, it's as if I am accompanying you. You can move freely within our Sect, even areas like the Scripture Pavilion are accessible. If you have any questions, you can ask nearby Junior Brothers and Sisters; they will all be able to answer your queries."
Shi Chan received the token from Dai Bufan and expressed his gratitude.
Back at the Task Hall, Dai Bufan didn't deal with the tasks at hand, but pulled out a jade plate after some contemplation. This was his magical artifact for making contact with the Grand Elder.
He wrote on the artifact: "Master, Junior Brother Shi Chan said that Master Jiesha led all the cultivators from the Suspension Temple to Wild State looking for the Sect Leader's whereabouts. You are impersonating the Sect Leader and telling stories in the Wild State, and you might run into them, so please be careful."
Dai Bufan touched the center of the jade plate with his index finger to send the message.
Soon, the Grand Elder responded.
"Tell me earlier next time"
Dai Bufan was silent for a moment, then analyzed: "There isn't even a punctuation mark. It seems the situation is intense."
"Master is indeed Master, strategizing and planning far ahead. He must have known that such a predicament would happen, which is why he built the immense grave."

chapters.title: Chapter 547 - 546: Practice Brings True Knowledge_1
chapters.content:
Shi Chan was feeling the overall atmosphere of the Seek Dao Sect, and he was quite moved. He could feel that the entire Seek Dao Sect was positive and full of vitality, a stark contrast to the Suspension Temple.
He felt that their Suspension Temple lacked this kind of lively atmosphere.
"No wonder Seek Dao Sect is rumored to be the number one Immortal Sect. The rumors are indeed true."
The so-called rumor refers to the storytelling of "Legend of the Dao Sect".
He stood on the arena for a moment and saw the disciples of the Seek Dao Sect fighting fiercely, and their techniques were superb, worthy of applause.
Seek Dao Sect's disciples knew each other, but he was a stranger who stood out, so people quickly guessed his identity.
"Is this our visitor, Junior Brother Shi Chan of the Suspension Temple, willing to compete on the arena?"
Shi Chan smiled, shook his head and refused, stating that he came to the Seek Dao Sect to seek Buddhist teachings, not show off his bravery, which was against his principles.
Just kidding, if you guys start at the Nascent Soul Stage, I'll be damned if I could win. It would not be a competition, it would be a beating.
"My master often says that Daoist Buyu possesses both Buddha and demon natures. If not restrained, he would certainly cause chaos in the world. Daoist Buyu's cultivation speed is too fast, only my master can subdue him, I wonder what his disciples are like?"
He made inquiries about Lu Yang from the people around him.
Lu Yang was quite a character in the Seek Dao Sect. As the acting sect leader for two months and three days, he had made quite a name for himself. Any disciple could say a few things about him.
"I never expected that Lu Yang, would use his acting sect leader's authority to forcefully declare himself the winner. I find it deeply contemptuous. But based on his reputation, he is well-regarded in the Seek Dao Sect. No wonder he was able to master Arhat Fist. It seems that Lu Yang has a profound Buddhist nature and a bright future.
It seems that his misuse of the acting sect leader's authority was due to being possessed by a demon and going astray. How pitiful, how pitiful."
Compared with Daoist Buyu, Lu Yang is open and upright, and his reputation in the Seek Dao Sect is excellent.
"From what I heard from the Senior Brothers and Sisters, Daoist Buyu has four disciples, Lu Yang is the youngest, the second and third disciples are not in Central Continent, only the eldest disciple resides in Sky Gate Mountain."
"My master often reminded me not to provoke Daoist Buyu's eldest disciple. But as the saying goes, practice brings true knowledge. The scriptures and words of the ancients are nothing more than the experience of predecessors, and cannot be directly copied. Let me test it out."
Shi Chan followed the directions to the Sky Gate Mountain and found Yun Zhi, who was in cultivation.
Yun Zhi finished her cultivation and looked at Shi Chan with a bit of confusion, not understanding why a disciple from the Suspension Temple would seek her out.
"I am a disciple from the Suspension Temple, my Dharma name is Shi Chan, may I ask if you are Daoist Buyu's eldest disciple?"
"Yes, I am. What brings Junior Brother Shi Chan here?"
"I heard that Senior Yun Zhi's cultivation level is unmatched, unrivaled among her peers. I wonder if you could suppress to the late stage of the Golden Core and spar with me?"
"Okay."
"To be honest, since my cultivation journey began, I've never lost a battle. I have quite some confidence in my own cultivation level. Senior Yun Zhi could strike at her own will, no need to worry about whether I could withstand it."
In no time, Shi Chan walked down the Sky Gate Mountain with a limp and bruised face.
"It seems Master was right, I indeed should not provoke Senior Yun Zhi."
Shi Chan then went to the commercial street, where he could clearly feel from the shop owners to the assistants, that they were all formidable individuals.
"It appears that more than one-third of the people on this commercial street are experts."
As a matter of fact, everyone on the commercial street was an expert, just that the remaining two-thirds had returned to their true nature and he couldn't see it.
Suddenly, he stopped in his tracks, revealing a cautious look.
There was a cultivator ahead of him, with a strong aura of death, unsure how many lives he had taken!
A member of a demonic sect?!
Let's follow him and see.
He carefully trailed behind that cultivator, and followed him for half a block before stopping.
The cultivator stopped in front of a barbecue restaurant. Shi Chan sniffed the air, smelling a delicious aroma which was a combination of cumin and mutton, fully ignited by the flames. The smell made him salivate uncontrollably.
"Mutton Kebabs, fresh and authentic Mutton Kebabs!"
"Old Gao, Old Liu, I'm here to deliver you some meat."
Master Liu, hearing this, cheerfully passed the skewers in his hand to Master Gao to roast as he received the storage ring from the Master.
The storage ring was full of freshly slaughtered beef and mutton, extremely fresh. The meat was still twitching as if dancing.
"Young monk, you've been following me. Do you want to have some skewers?" The Master turned back, already having noticed the trailing Shi Chan.
"Young monk, would you like a couple of skewers?" Master Gao kindly offered Shi Chan.
Shi Chan slowly but firmly shook his head: "The little monk has no money."
Having meals in the restaurant isn't expensive, and if he can't afford it, he could always pay by washing dishes. However, these skewers are quite pricey, paid with spirit stones, and it wasn't like he could pay off the debt by washing a few days' worth of dishes.
"No worries, you seem to be from the Suspension Temple, a customer is a guest. These skewers are on us."
Shi Chan continued to shake his head: "I can't accept something for free. However, it seems like you have a farm. Coincidentally, I have worked on a farm before, I can work on your farm."
In fact, Shi Chan had been working in a slaughterhouse before, and if not for the fact his uncle had told him to learn at the Seek Dao Sect, he would still be in the slaughterhouse.
Since the Seek Dao Sect presented this opportunity, why not seize this chance to continue his cultivation?
"Uh..." The Master hesitated, this young monk was clearly a high monk from Suspension Temple, letting him go to the farm would probably not sit well with the Seek Dao Sect.
Shi Chan took out the token given by Dai Bufan: "Elder Brother Dai told me, with this token, I can go anywhere in the Seek Dao Sect."
Seeing that Shi Chan was determined, the Master no longer objected. Shi Chan happily ate the skewers.
He escorted Shi Chan through the core area, to a prairie. Here he had set up his farm, cattle and sheep everywhere, grass lush and delicious.
"Boss, you're back."
Xiao Wu, Xiao Liu, and Xiao Qi, the three beautiful ghosts, were astonished seeing the Master bringing a monk.
The Master of the demonic sect owning a farm was odd enough, but now a monk was also at the farm?
Shi Chan was also astonished to see the three beautiful ghosts, he hadn't expected the Seek Dao Sect to take in three beautiful ghosts. Were they practicing the inclusive teachings of the saints?
"Shi Chan pays his respects to the three female patrons."
The trio, Xiao Wu, immediately returned the courtesy.
Shi Chan quickly got on track, with swift and precise cuts, his cleaver traced along the muscles of the ox, segregating the meat into sections in the blink of an eye.
"Good, oh good. Namu Amida Buta..."
Shi Chan set down the cleaver, chanting the Death Mantra, to dissolve the resentment of the ox.
This was the reason why he had slaughtered countless cows but remained clean, without any resentment attached.
He had always strived to teach all butchers the Death Mantra, but, unfortunately, he had made little progress.
If all the butchers could do as he did, there would not have been the silly incident of a cultivator from Great Yu using the resentment of cattle and sheep to refine a soul summoning flag.
"Young monk, please stop your Divine Ability soon," the three ghosts of Xiao Wu begged. They were merely at the Foundation Establishment Stage, not capable of withstanding Shi Chan's Death Mantra invocation.
Hearing the words, Shi Chan immediately ceased his chanting.
He had forgotten that there were still three ghosts around.
Feeling guilty, Shi Chan kindly added, "If you grow weary of life one day, just tell me. I can conduct the rituals to help you transcend, free of charge."
The three beautiful ghosts repeatedly declined.

chapters.title: Chapter 548 - 547: Master Shi Chan_1
chapters.content:
As a disciple of the Suspension Temple, Shi Chan could charge a sky-high price for conducting a single religious ritual for someone.
In the Central Continent, the Suspension Temple is one of the Five Great Immortal Sects, possessing the most powerful Buddhist lineage. It can be considered the spiritual and de facto leader of all temples.
Thus, any representative of the Suspension Temple would be highly esteemed by the outside world. Although Shi Chan only called himself a 'little monk', to the outside world, all addressed him as a 'master'.
Moreover, his cultivation level being at the late stage of the Golden Core, was enough to earn people's admiration.
However, since the three enchanting ghosts had refused his good intentions, there was nothing more he could say.
With his hands folded in prayer, he moved with compassionate sorrow to a cattle and solemnly spoke.
"We cultivators often say 'my fate is in my hands, not in the heavens', refusing to believe in destiny and courageously rebelling against it. There are examples of those who have successfully walked the great path, but they are few. Whether their success in resisting destiny was just another twist of fate is uncertain."
"Perhaps all humans are bound by fate without knowing it. Fate is like shackles, no one can resist, not this humble monk, not the three ladies, and neither can you."
Shi Chan stood with one hand raised in front of his chest, the other stroking the strong back of the cow.
The cattle raised in the Seek Dao Sect could not be ordinary. Born of noble lineage, both the grass and water consumed daily were extraordinary. Its coat was smoother than any other Shi Chan had met in previous ranches.
"You were born to be butchered, to satisfy human cravings. Your flesh is an offering, satiating human greed. It seems grand, but it's a result of your lack of control over your own body."
"This humble monk is giving you a chance. If you don't wish to be chained by destiny and desire to escape your fate of being butchered, then moo once. If you're willing to offer yourself to the human race, then moo twice."
The cattle stood still, without making a sound.
Shi Chan sighed: "Just as I thought, you were born oblivious; your innate wisdom inadequate, unable to understand human speech, nor comprehend the Buddhist teachings."
Following that, Shi Chan silently recited obscure and complex scriptures.
"In the beginnings of the azure heavens, within the vastness of the universe, the boundless earth ..."
The cattle still had no reaction.
Shi Chan helplessly shook his head, bent down to pick up the cleaver from the ground and with one swift motion, the life of the cattle was ended.
"Benevolent, benevolent."
The three enchanting ghosts were taken aback by the scene.
"May I ask, young friend, what are you doing?" a benevolent voice rang out, deep and powerful.
Shi Chan turned his head but did not recognize the stranger.
"Your honor is…?"
"You can call me Boss Bu, I own this ranch."
Immortal Eternity had been watching Shi Chan's strange actions from afar as he interacted with the cattle for quite a while before finally putting an end to it, quite puzzled.
"So it's Boss Bu. I'm a disciple from the Suspension Temple and my Dharma name is Shi Chan. What I was doing just now was to enlighten the heart and allow the cattle to choose."
"The scriptures I was reciting are called 'Sutra of Crossing Over the Cattle'."
"'Sutra of Crossing Over the Cattle'?" Immortal Eternity was confused, he had never heard of it before.
"It's a scripture I wrote myself. I also have 'Sutras of Crossing Over Pigs' and 'Sutras of Crossing Over Sheep'. At previous slaughterhouses, I would always recite scriptures before the slaughter to let the livestock choose their own destiny, though so far none have responded."
"After the slaughter, I will recite the 'Pure Land Mantra' to dissolve the resentment of the livestock, allowing them to pass away peacefully."
The previous cattle was butchered by the master, Shi Chan was only responsible for butchering it, whereas this one had gone through the entire process.
Immortal Eternity felt that what Shi Chan said made sense. Their ranch was essentially a slaughterhouse, which easily brought to mind bloody scenes. This wasn't conducive to restructuring their newly reformed, positive image.
If they all did as Shi Chan did- explain first, then slaughter, and finally provide a crossing over, Yun Zhi, Big Brother, and Second-in-command would certainly see them in a new light.
There were only three in Seek Dao Sect who knew the true identity of Immortal Eternity.
There were a few more who knew the identities of the Masters, including Elder Brother Dai and the Grand Elder.
When it came to doing things, Immortal Eternity and his Big Brother, Fairy Eternity, were quite similar, both were decisive. They would take immediate action once they made up their minds, never hesitating.
He immediately notified the Masters and Vice Leader Jin, who were feeding the cattle in the ranch, as well as Master Liu and Master Gao in the barbecue restaurant, including several former elders of the Eternity Sect.
That night.
The barbecue shop closed for the day, and Master Liu and others headed to the breeding farm.
"Everyone has arrived, hasn't it?"
"Yes, all are present." The ones speaking were Xiao Wu and her two companions.
Although the three girls were not members of the Eternity Sect, they currently acted as the Master's left and right hands and were summoned to every meeting.
Immortal Eternity nodded and discussed Shi Chan's actions during the day, causing the Master and others to fall deep into thought.
"What Immortal means is..."
"Every one of us present is as trustful as family. I will be straightforward, we all are prisoners under Seek Dao Sect. Not sure when they may turn their back on us and execute us."
"I believe we should provoke change. Not only opening a barbecue shop or breeding farm, but we should also create an entirely fresh experience for others. Shi Chan's arrival presents a unique opportunity."
"The worst error when studying Buddhist teachings is deviating from the path. Shi Chan hails from the Suspension Temple, representing bona fide Buddhism. His Buddhist teachings are assuredly profound and authentic; we should learn from him, cultivate ourselves, develop a Buddha-like character. Only then can we truly show our transformation."
The Master among others nodded frequently. Indeed, an Immortal indeed exhibited a unique depth of thought. They were content with the status quo while the Immortal was plotting the next move.
"Since there are no objections, this matter is decided."
"Well..."
Xiao Wu timidly raised her hand. As they were only at the Foundation Establishment Stage, sitting in a meeting with the Master and others was tremendously stressful.
"Feel free to voice your concerns."
"Can ghosts learn Buddhist teachings too?"
Immortal Eternity rubbed his chin and hissed, "This is indeed an issue. We'll ask Shi Chan about it tomorrow."
The next morning, all the disciples of the Eternity Sect sought Shi Chan and explained their intention.
After pondering over Shi Chan's words, they felt these people possessed strong Buddhist inclinations and were destined with Buddha.
"Buddha saves destined beings. If you desire to learn from me, I certainly won't hide my knowledge."
"As for the three ladies, there's no need to worry. There have been precedents of ghosts studying Buddhism, and even stories of ghosts building temples after mastering Buddhist teachings. They have reshaped their true form through the power of faith; it's not a problem."
The three ghosts finally sighed in relief; their only concern was not to inadvertently free themselves from their state in the process.
They went about their day and gathered in the evenings to study Buddhist teachings and discuss the meaning of Buddhist scriptures. Their schedules were well-organised. Even Shi Chan gained fresh insights in the process of lecturing and discussion.
...
Dai Bufan stared in confusion at the information just handed in by his disciple.
Why did Shi Chan go to the breeding farm to work?
Why has the Eternity Sect started studying Buddhist teachings?
How would the Suspension Temple react upon learning about this?
Dai Bufan was unsure about Shi Chan's intentions. With his Master's life or death still uncertain and no one to turn to, he decided to consult Yun Zhi.
"Eldest Senior Sister..."
Dai Bufan explained what Shi Chan was up to and asked the Eldest Senior Sister about the actions Seek Dao Sect should take.
After a pause, Yun Zhi slowly said, "When Shi Chan first arrived he challenged me."
Upon hearing this, Dai Bufan's pupils contracted with shock. This was utterly reckless!
Not even the fearlessness of a newborn calf confronting a tiger could be compared to this. Even the notorious elder Master Jiesha would not dare to go this far.
"Senior Sister means..."
"My point is, don't be surprised by anything he does, considering he was audacious enough to challenge me."
"That makes sense."

chapters.title: Chapter 549 - 548: Origin of the Five Elements War Tactics_1
chapters.content:
"Finally, it's all done."
Lu Yang stretches lazily. Under the Elder of Passing Skills' guidance, their learning progress is fast and they have made small achievements in the Five Elements War Method.
The Elder of Passing Skills strokes his white whiskers, slightly nodding his head, "Very good, there's nothing more I can teach you."
Among the disciples he has tutored, Lu Yang's team of five is the quickest at mastering the Five Elements War Method. Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou's strong Spiritual Sense play a vital role in this, leading the way in their cultivation.
Another integral point is the unity among them which makes their learning much more effective.
"The Five Elements War Method is indeed powerful."
Li Haoran discreetly nods. If the Nine Nether Sect mastered the Five Elements War Method and Qin Haoran, along with the four Vice Masters, teamed up, they might be capable of defeating the debt collectors.
Of course, this hinges on the four Vice Masters being aware of the Nine Nether Sect's deficit predicament and the potential for unity amongst themselves in the future.
"Wonder which predecessor invented this fascinating Five Elements War Method? Who possesses such remarkable talent?" Lu Yang curiously asks.
"This Five Elements War Method was created by our Five Elements Sect's founding Master, Mister Tiankui. He was a unique genius of his era and left numerous foundations for our sect, among which the Five Elements War Method is one of them."
Mister Tiankui was well-known in the Great Xia, a Great Power who, a hundred thousand years ago, ranked alongside the Master Guiyuan of the Seek Dao Sect. He played a vital role in establishing the Five Great Immortal Sects.
The Elder of Passing Skills indulges in nostalgia, recalling the stories passed down verbally within the Five Elements Sect.
"Mister Tiankui was born in a scholarly influential family during the late period of the Great Yu, heavily influenced by the feudal theories of monarch, official, father and son. His original intent was to pass the official examinations, join the military to lay the groundwork for a rebellion in the future.
Once he summoned the masses, he could establish his own kingdom, how wonderful would that be... The last two sentences are Mister Tiankui's original words, not mine."
"Alas, before he could pass the official examinations, the Great Yu Emperor fell, assassinated on his throne, so Mister Tiankui's plans for rebellion collapsed."
"...Elder, wait a second. You just mentioned Mister Tiankui was heavily influenced by the feudal theories of monarch, official, father and son and then he rebelled? It's not proper for a junior to interrupt an elder, but Meng Jingzhou couldn't help himself."
"Yes, Mister Tiankui grew tired of studying those feudal theories and wanted to see what would happen if he didn't follow them."
Man Gu had an epiphany. So, Confucian Cultivators can also practice like this, not only reading books but also using practice to verify if the doctrines are correct. He had been too rigid in his studies before.
"During a chaotic era, Mister Tiankui being insufficient in cultivation level, didn't have the qualifications to vie for the world. So, he devoted himself to cultivation, wandering battlefields to grow stronger by killing."
"Despite Mister Tiankui possessing rare talents and cultivating at a rapid pace, by the time he established himself as a regional hegemon, the Jiang Family had already emerged victorious and proclaimed themselves Emperor. He was a step too late."
"Mister Tiankui roamed the world, feeling gloomy and depressed. One day, he accidentally stumbled upon the Immortal Realm and encountered a great fortune."
"Immortal Realm?" Lu Yang is affected by the word Immortal. Generally, these places would be called Secret Realms, but if they are worthy of being called Immortal Realms, then they must be related to Immortals.
"Just related to Immortals. Just look at you, frightened so easily. In front of this Immortal, what are Immortal Realms worth?" Fairy Eternity nonchalantly responds, truly unbothered. She herself is an Immortal, every action of hers is related to Immortals.
Lu Yang suspiciously looks at Fairy Eternity, speaking as if you know the location of an Immortal Realm.
And that too just a single location.
Fairy Eternity feels that she is being despised by Lu Yang's gaze. She pompously attests to her worth, "This Immortal is situated in your spiritual world, which is an Immortal's spiritual world. Simply put, this place can be considered the Immortal World!"
Lu Yang hears for the first time that the Immortal World is interpreted in this way.
He rolls his eyes and continues to listen to the Elder of Passing Skills' story after regaining his composure.
"According to Mister Tiankui's records, that Secret Realm was laid out by an Immortal, the plot for eternity, mysteries hidden everywhere. He even saw the residual image of an Immortal that had endured for countless years, like ancient history being reenacted in front of him, the Immortal's face, however, was unclear, all a blur!"
"Two Immortals were playing a game of chess, with chess pieces of black and white. The game was elegantly arranged, every move made after thorough contemplation. They would wait for months before making the next move, as if they were not just placing chess pieces, but eternity and the world's creatures!"
"During the game, a third Immortal took the form of a woodcutter, coming to watch the game."
"Mister Tiankui was engrossed in this, and when he returned to reality, a hundred years had already passed!"
"He noticed the black and white pieces clashing on the chessboard, struggling to connect into a line of five, leading to his enlightenment."
"Mister Tiankui believed that the five pieces corresponded to the five elements. When the five pieces align into a single line, victory is obtained, implying the immense power of uniting the five elements, which even an Immortal couldn't resist."
"He closed himself off to meditate on this insight, resulting in the creation of the Five Elements War Method, and upon his return, he established the Five Elements Sect."
"Regrettably, as Mister Tiankui emerged from his seclusion, the shadow of the Immortal disappeared, never to be seen again,"
"Mister Tiankui claimed that he had only comprehended a tenth or a fifth of it due to his limited talent. He believed that there must be deeper aspects in that game of chess that he hadn't discovered, for example, why did the third Immortal, the woodcutter, come to watch the game? And what did chopping wood symbolize?
Does it symbolize treating all beings as firewood, or is it to express his neutral stance?"
The Elder of Passing Skills shakes his head in regret. There are too many unsolved matters here. Ancient mysteries, even now their understanding of ancients is nothing but fragments.
Lu Yang: "..."
He remembers Fairy Eternity mentioning that the Yingtian Immortal and Qilin Immortal refused to eat the food cooked by Fairy Eternity, resulting in a game of chess that lasted a hundred years, using chess as an excuse. Martial Jiuchong was asked to chop firewood to facilitate cooking, but after chopping the wood, he went to watch the game.
And thus, the three of them managed to prolong the game for a hundred years.
Lu Yang initially thought that they must be playing a game like wei qi, embodying the philosophies of the universe.
Turns out, the two of you were playing a game of Go!
"See, what did this Immortal tell you? Jiuchong Immortal integrated Yin and Yang, the five elements into the chessboard to enlighten future generations. Isn't this a perfect example?" Fairy Eternity declares righteously, finally encountering an example that corroborates her words.
"By the way, Elder, does that Immortal Realm still exist?"
"Yes, it does. Even though the shadow of the Immortal has disappeared and no one can comprehend anything from it any longer, Mister Tiankui thought it's still an Immortal Realm after all, and so, he relocated it to our sect."
Lu Yang thought, no wonder the initial Golden Meridian Elder had relocated several mines back to the sect, your initial Sect Leader even relocated an Immortal Realm!
But now is not the time to complain about this.
"Can we enter the Secret Realm to observe the Immortal's chess game?"
After all, it is a place where three Immortals once stayed. There might be some clues.
Upon hearing Lu Yang say this, Meng Jingzhou and the others also became interested in this matter. This was something related to Immortals, they must take a look no matter what.
The Elder of Passing Skills pensively replies, "I need to consult the Sect Leader about this, but I believe he will agree."
(There will be an update at midnight)

chapters.title: Chapter 550 - 549: History Repeats Itself_1
chapters.content:
"You want to visit the place where our ancestor contemplated his enlightenment?" Sect Leader Qiu Jin'an paused after hearing the words of the Elder of Passing Skills.
A hundred thousand years ago when our ancestor first achieved enlightenment, the Immortal Realm was a forbidden zone, inaccessible to all but those who had passed the Transcendance Tribulation stage.
Over time, a hundred thousand years have passed, countless young geniuses and great powers of the Five Elements Sect have entered the Immortal Realm in search of their opportunity for enlightenment, trying to recreate the feats of our ancestor, but not a single one has succeeded.
As for the chess game played by the immortals, such historical scene has never happened again. Even now, there is no consensus on who those three ancient immortals were.
Qiu Jin'an looked up and saw an ancient painting hanging on the wall. The painting was filled with an aura of immortality and contained endless mysteries that were both incomprehensible and unfathomable.
Despite being an antique, it appeared as though it was protected by an unknown force that made it look nothing like a painting from a hundred thousand years ago.
In the painting, two immortals are sitting in stone chairs, both engrossed in thought. While their faces are obscured, it's easy to imagine two immortals deep in contemplation, their brows furrowed in thought. The third immortal, carrying firewood, can be seen observing the chess game with unwavering attention. His face, too, is indiscernible.
The black and white stones on the chess board are entangled in a deadlock, unable to form a connected chain. The battle is fierce and the outcome seemingly impossible to discern.
Mister Tiankui, a Confucian Cultivator with an extraordinary talent in painting, created this artwork upon his return from the Immortal Realm, depicting the scene he witnessed.
Next to the ancient painting, there's another one, also created by Mister Tiankui.
In the other painting, Mister Tiankui is elegantly depicted in a white Confucian robe, full of energy, clearly showcasing his power. He is seen standing, his foot atop two renowned great powers - the ancestors of the Meng and Jiang families.
Both of these great powers appear wounded, a clear result of a violent struggle. Yet, they still couldn't defeat Mister Tiankui.
Mister Tiankui, a Confucian Cultivator with an extraordinary talent in painting, created this scene from his imagination.
After Qiu Jin'an's gaze moved away from the two paintings and he pondered for a short while, he readily agreed.
"Perhaps, the children haven't been exposed to the relics of the immortals, and want to broaden their horizons. It's understandable."
"So be it, let me guide them."
This place, after all, is where our ancestor contemplated his path to enlightenment. Although it's now nothing more than a memorial, it deserves the requisite respect.
...
When Lu Yang and the others learned that they were allowed to enter the Immortal Realm and that Sect Leader Qiu Jin'an would personally lead them, the smiles on their faces could not be concealed.
This was the legendary Immortal Realm.
Among all publicly known secret realms, none have been classified as Immortal Realm, reflecting its rare and cherished status.
Of course, for someone like Lu Yang, whose body is an Immortal World, the Immortal Realm isn't anything extraordinary.
Under the guidance of Qiu Jin'an, the group swiftly reached their destination.
The Immortal Realm is located at the boundary of the Fire Vein and Water Vein.
"What high mountains," Man Gu exclaimed. The mountain stood tall, its peak shrouded by clouds, masking its true height.
One thing was certain - the height of this mountain was no less than that of Sky Gate Mountain.
Qiu Jin'an casually explained, "The Immortal Realm is located inside a cave on the mountain. Our ancestor was concerned that merely moving the cave would disrupt the layout of the immortals and the integrity of the Immortal Realm, so he decided to move the entire mountain."
For cultivators like Mister Tiankui, moving mountains or filling lakes is just a minor matter.
Lu Yang noticed that there was a barrier surrounding the base of the mountain, forming a faintly visible screen that was likely put up to protect the Immortal Realm. It prevented the disciples from sneaking in and disrupting the chess layout of the immortals.
Lu Yang noticed that not far from the entrance of the barrier, there was a half piece of a yellow talisman, stubbornly an affixed to the barrier, fluttering in the wind.
"This is a high-level seal drawn on this yellow talisman," Fairy Eternity casually commented. She glanced at the talisman and immediately deduced its entire shape and content.
Lu Yang was surprised. Could it be that there is not only an immortal's chess arrangement in the Immortal Realm, but also a formidable ancient demon?
Lu Yang conjured a possible scenario: Mister Tiankui encountered an ancient demon by chance, and after a fierce battle, the match ended in a stalemate. Unable to defeat the demon, he had no choice but to seal it in the Immortal Realm, using the immortal's chess arrangement to suppress it.
As time went by, the members of the Five Elements Sect had forgotten about this history. The ancient demon had broken through the seal, escaping from the Immortal Realm!
Or could it be that the ancient demon also possessed something similar to the DaoFruit of Causality, causing people to forget its existence?
Looking at Sect Leader Qiu's reaction, it seemed that he was unaware of the existence of the yellow talisman.
Lu Yang lifted his hand and pointed towards the inconspicuous yellow talisman in the distance, asking, "Sect Leader Qiu, what is that?"
"Is it a seal?"
"It's a seal strip."
Lu Yang was taken aback. "A Seal Strip?"
"Our ancestor rushed to move the mountain without getting permission from the court. Naturally, the court wouldn't stand for it, so they sealed the Immortal Realm and posted a seal strip."
"After paying the fine and bailing out our ancestor, the court agreed to let the Five Elements Sect take ownership of both the mountain and the Immortal Realm. As such, the seal strip is no longer necessary."
"At the time, the seal strip was not completely removed and because the people believed it to be a cultural relic, it was preserved."
A seal strip capable of sealing off the Immortal Realm was no ordinary object.
When there were no more questions, Qiu Jin'an led them over the protective barrier to the base of the mountain.
The closer they got to the mountain, the stronger the oppressive aura they felt. Without stopping, they walked into a damp cave.
As they stepped into the cave, their restless hearts suddenly calmed down, as though reflecting the state of mind of the immortals who were playing chess a hundred thousand years ago.
The cave was quiet, dark, and deep, with only the sound of their footsteps echoing in the void.
The deeper into the cave they went, the dryer the environment became, as if the cave was a completely separate world from the outside.
"This is the place," said Qiu Jin'an.
What laid before them was a stone table with a chessboard filled with black and white pieces, leaving no empty spots. Upon closer inspection, neither side had managed to connect five pieces together.
The final outcome of the Immortal's chess game was a draw.
The stone table, stones chairs, and the chess pieces seemed ordinary, but due to being utilized by immortals a hundred years ago, they gained a hint of immortality. This allowed these otherwise mundane objects to withstand the ravages of time without being eroded.
Qiu Jin'an shook his head in disappointment. As expected, no matter how many times he came here, the scene could never be recreated.
The luck of our ancestor was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity bestowed by the Immortals and it couldn't be repeated.
What Qiu Jin'an didn't realize was that Lu Yang appeared listless, as though he had lost his will.
Lu Yang's head drooped, as if he were dozing off. Suddenly, he jerked his head up to see an empty chess board in front of him, with the hands of two unfamiliar figures reaching into the chess box to retrieve chess pieces.
Meng Jingzhou, Tao Yaoye, and the others were gone - only Lu Yang remained as the observer.
Lu Yang was shocked. This scene seemed like a replay of Mister Tiankui's story.
Before he could react, he heard the two chess players conversing.
Their voices carried a special power that could calm emotions and stabilize the mind.
"Yingtian Immortal, will you go first?"
"Alright."
A white stone fell onto the center of the board.
It was Yingtian Immortal's move.

chapters.title: Chapter 551 - 550: Immortal Chess Game_1
chapters.content:
From Fairy Eternity, Lu Yang had known about the Yingtian Immortal, understanding his various affairs from before he became famous to after he became an immortal.
Yet today was the first time he met Yingtian Immortal face to face.
The Yingtian Immortal wore a pale blue robe, with wide sleeves and wave patterns on the cuffs. He was dignified, with an extraordinary demeanor. His golden pupils lent him an imposing aura, just like an emperor.
"According to Fairy Eternity, the Yingtian Immortal and Qilin Immortal are playing a chess game, so does that mean the person sitting across is Qilin Immortal?"
Lu Yang looked towards the other chess player.
Qilin Immortal had two coral horns on his head, with red scales on his cheeks and the backs of his hands. His eyes were like those of a dragon or a tiger, exuding an aura of fierce menace. This was not a symbol of an incomplete transformation, but the dignity of his existence as a Qilin.
He was a unique Qilin in the world. Transforming into a human form was merely for convenience of communication with other immortals. As such, there was no need to fully become a human, retaining the Qilin characteristics was his pride.
The Qilin Immortal wore a black robe. Upon a closer look, you would discover that the robe was embroidered with a pattern of many beasts. Only the Qilin Immortal, as the immortal of all beasts, was qualified to wear it.
"A historical echo?"
Lu Yang jolted. This was exactly like the story told by the Elder of Passing Skills, mistakenly entering the Immortal Realm and seeing two immortals playing a game.
Although the immortals were at the top of the cultivation system, they would not leave historical echoes with every movement. Otherwise, wouldn't everyone in the world be able to see immortals?
The reason for the echo here was that the chess game involved the timespan of a hundred years for three immortals, with their formidable powers influencing the space.
"Wait, but that's not right. The Elder of Passing Skills said that Mister Tiankui could only see the immortals, but their facial features were blurred. Why can I see them clearly?"
"Could it be that I have something to do with these two immortals..."
"It's because I'm here, of course." Fairy Eternity spoke in an abrupt manner. As Lu Yang turned his head, he saw Fairy Eternity, in her yellow skirt, appearing next to him, levitating slightly and being of the same height as him.
This was a historical echo, and her appearance wouldn't be noticed by Qiu Jin'an and the others.
"Fairy, you're here too?"
Upon reflection, Lu Yang would realize that since he could see the historical echo, there was no reason Fairy Eternity couldn't.
"What do you mean by saying that? Could you see these two lousy chess players without my presence? It's because of the resonance between the historical echo left by them and me that you see this scene." Fairy Eternity pointed casually towards the Yingtian Immortal and Qilin Immortal.
As soon as Fairy Eternity appeared, any admiration Lu Yang had for the immortals instantly vanished.
"What happened with Mister Tiankui? Did he just happen to catch the last historical echo?"
"Presumably, it was something created by Yingtian Immortal."
"Yingtian Immortal?" Lu Yang looked perplexed. Was it appropriate to say this in front of Yingtian Immortal?
Fairy Eternity didn't care about propriety. Even if it were the real Yingtian Immortal, she would still say such things in his presence.
"You've gotten something wrong. It's not because Mister Tiankui could see the historical echo, thereby understanding the Five Elements Battle Method. Instead, because he could understand the Five Elements Battle Method, he was able to see the historical echo."
"The reason why people later could not see the historical echo was not because the echo had dissipated, but because later generations couldn't understand something from the chessboard. Spreading such things wouldn't enhance their prestige."
"..."
Lu Yang once again felt the profound intention of Yingtian Immortal.
Yingtian Immortal and Qilin Immortal continued their game. With each chess move, a clicking sound was heard.
Just listening to the sound, Lu Yang felt as if his soul was being cleansed and sublimated.
"They play chess so quickly?"
Based on their speed of play, could they play for a hundred years?
Twenty minutes would already be too long.
"What's the point of watching these two lousy chess players? I've accelerated the process," Fairy Eternity said lazily.
Who would want to watch a chess game for a hundred years like that silly Mister Tiankui?
"So, you two are playing chess here. I've finally found you." The voice of the third ancient immortal came. It was the creator of the Go game, Immortal Jiuchong.
Immortal Jiuchong was dressed simply, in a linen garment and a straw raincoat. He walked in wet as if it was raining outside. He was holding an axe and carrying firewood that had just been chopped. He looked exactly like a simple woodcutter.
The only difference was that the firewood he was carrying was dry.
"Ho, isn't this phoenix tree wood? Did the Time Immortal ask you to chop it?" laughed Yingtian Immortal.
"You two have the nerve to comment. The Time Immortal asked me to call you two for a meal. You two were hiding here playing chess. It's been several years and you haven't finished!"
"What's the rush? It's rare for us two to have a chance to determine a winner, so why not play a good game? Each step needs to be considered, understand?"
"You go ahead and eat, and we will arrive shortly."
Jiuchong Immortal sneered. Looking at their speed of play, they will not finish even in fifty years.
You're asking me if I understand? The game of Go was created by me, you know nothing compared to me.
"Forget it, I will stay here and watch. So, you won't start another game after you finish this one." Immortal Jiuchong found a reason to stay and watch the game at ease.
"Time Immortal?" Lu Yang frowned, muttered to himself. Why would Time Immortal ask Jiuchong Immortal to chop firewood and call Yingtian Immortal and Qilin Immortal for a meal?
Shouldn't it be Fairy Eternity?
Lu Yang suddenly realized something.
That's it. An ancient nemesis eradicated Fairy Eternity's information through unknown means. Even historical echoes were no exception, and they also needed to be erased and replaced.
Just like Mister Tiankui, it was possible for him to learn about the existence of Fairy Eternity from the historical echo.
Directly erasing Fairy Eternity would be too difficult and prone to logical loopholes. It could be detected by others, so the best way was to replace her with an entity of the same level.
That's why a scene appeared where Fairy Eternity was replaced with Time Immortal in their conversation.
However, given that Mister Tiankui didn't know these immortals who played chess and chopped firewood, it seems he probably didn't understand the ancient language.
Lu Yang was able to learn the ancient language because he was taught by Fairy Eternity, but the Cultivation World had gone through historical discontinuities. It was already difficult to translate the ancient language, let alone being able to read and understand it fluently.
Lu Yang used his peripheral vision to steal a look at Fairy Eternity's reaction. He saw her gritting her teeth, "Which son of a bitch concealed my existence!"
As she spoke, she was flexing her body, ready to fight a major battle with the hidden hand at any time.
"Who's there?!" Jiuchong Immortal suddenly shouted and turned his head to stare at the spot where Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity were.
Lu Yang even felt that for a moment, he and Jiuchong Immortal made eye contact.
After Jiuchong Immortal shouted, Yingtian Immortal and Qilin Immortal also reacted sharply, looking towards the location of Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity.
Even though they couldn't see anyone, they could vaguely sense the presence of someone there!
They were trying to avoid Fairy Eternity when they felt guilty. And now, someone was hiding in their shadows, hence their sharp reactions.
"No, with the strength of the three of us, if someone was hiding, it would be impossible not to see. Even Time Immortal couldn't do this. Could Time Immortal be using the Time Dao Fruit to observe us from the future?"

chapters.title: Chapter 552 - 551: Shield_1
chapters.content:
Upon detection of someone peering into their time, the atmosphere in the Immortal Realm tensed up instantly.
"Could it be Time Immortal wanting to see when we would finally use Time Dao Fruit in this chess game?" Qilin Immortal wore a peculiar expression, although he too felt that taking several months to make a move in Go was a bit excessive.
The three immortals fell silent, feeling that this possibility was indeed real.
"Fairy, can they see us?" Lu Yang was really taken aback. Being thirty thousand years apart from the three immortals, he was viewing a reflection of the past. The fact that they could detect his presence under such circumstances was a bit too horrifying, wasn't it?
Fairy Eternity glanced at Lu Yang, "Don't flatter yourself. They've sensed my presence, not yours."
If Lu Yang's cultivation level was enough to alert the three immortals, they should have noticed him right from the start of viewing the reflection of the past.
Not to mention, Mister Tiankui, whose cultivation level is far superior to Lu Yang's, didn't elicit any reaction from the three immortals either.
"If you're talking about 'seeing', only Time Immortal can see 'us' in the future from the past. Yingtian Immortal and the others can only vaguely sense it, they can't even tell who is watching them."
Even so, Lu Yang still found the immortals terrifying.
Not all immortals are like Fairy Eternity.
Fairy Eternity suspected that Lu Yang had disrespectful thoughts about her, but she had no proof.
Immortal Jiuchong pondered for a bit and came up with another possibility.
"It's not necessarily Time Immortal. It could be an immortal from a future generation looking at us across the vast river of time. After all, given your pace of playing chess, we three will have to stay here for a hundred years, which is enough to generate a reflection of the past."
"You mean an immortal saw our historical reflection?"
"Indeed, this is a possibility. Right now, there are only four of us immortals. There are plenty of semi-immortals, all of them are incompetent and none of them can become immortals. It's quite normal for a few immortals to appear in the lengthy epochs of the future."
The three of them laughed heartily. If a few more immortals emerged in the future, they could possibly share the pain brought by Fairy Eternity.
"Hey, Jiuchong, Yingtian, Qilin, can you hear me?" Fairy Eternity shouted, releasing her aura, trying to send her aura over.
At the beginning, when she started viewing the historical reflection, Yingtian Immortal didn't notice her. It was when she unconsciously leaked her aura while saying she wanted to punish the mastermind that Yingtian Immortal was able to sense her presence.
"This aura…"
The three immortals, Yingtian, immediately became alert. This aura was on and off, like a dying candle, almost non-existent, yet they could sense the presence of the other party based on this faint aura.
"This aura is from ███!"
The three of them reacted simultaneously.
Fairy Eternity had been beating them since they were young. They have been constantly blasted ever since they became immortals. Even now, they were hiding here because of Fairy Eternity.
This aura was all too familiar to them!
It was definitely Yellow Bean!
Then they broke into a cold sweat, hoping they didn't say anything bad about Yellow Bean just now, did they?
Phew, they didn't.
"Can you three hear me?"
Fairy Eternity tried a few times, seeing that Immortal Jiuchong and the others didn't respond, she shook her head and regretfully gave up.
It seems that they can't hear her.
Lu Yang furrowed his brows. After Immortal Jiuchong and the others noticed the future's Fairy Eternity, they should have said the name of Fairy Eternity, but he only saw Immortal Jiuchong open his mouth, there was no sound, and the lip movements didn't match what Fairy Eternity was saying.
"Such a strong shield."
Replacing Fairy Eternity with Time Immortal under this situation is a glaring flaw. Even a fool could see the issue. It's simpler to just brutally block it out.
"Don't you find it strange that ███ has been releasing her aura, is there something she wants to tell us?"
Yingtian Immortal frowned, playing with the chess piece in his hand. He thought Fairy Eternity accidentally saw their historical reflection and wanted to tease them, hence she released her aura.
If that were the case, releasing the aura once would be enough. Why release it so many times?
Had she become addicted to it, or was she trying to convey some information, but couldn't because of the gap in time?
If it were the latter, why let Fairy Eternity convey the message? Wouldn't it be better to have Time Immortal do it?
Wait, could it be that something unexpected happened in the future and Time Immortal couldn't convey the message?
"Jiuchong, go get Time Immortal, let him see what's happening. I suspect ███ is looking for us!"
"Also, don't let ███ know about this." Qilin Immortal added. They didn't know what would happen if the Fairy Eternity from the past and the future met. Whether it would open a time tunnel, or annihilate the spot, causing a massive explosion, no one knew.
"Alright."
Without Yingtian Immortal and Qilin Immortal saying anything more, Immortal Jiuchong could also think of such things.
Turning into a stream of light, Immortal Jiuchong tore through space, covering thousands of lightyears in a single step. He crossed numerous galaxies to reach the North Star, ruled by Fairy Eternity.
On the North Star, immortal auras twirled around. Even a breath taken by a mortal could prolong life and cure diseases.
He saw many cultivators kneeling by the river, bowing three times and kowtowing nine times to the statue of Fairy Eternity by the river before respectfully scooping out a bowl of river water.
This was a special product of the North Star, the Mother-child River and Twin River.
Upon reaching Fairy Eternity's fairy mansion, he saw Fairy Eternity in the kitchen interacting with Qilin Immortal's couple of wives about cooking skills, while Time Immortal was restless, probably looking for an excuse to escape.
"Huh, Jiuchong is back. Have you finished chopping the Phoenix Tree wood?" Fairy Eternity poked her head out from the kitchen with flour on her face, and looked over cheerfully.
Immortal Jiuchong was frightened and froze in place.
He tried his best to suppress his aura, but he never expected that Fairy Eternity would discover him anyway.
"I've finished. It was quite tough though," he quickly reacted, being someone who had also experienced many storms, he placed the Phoenix Tree wood he was carrying on his shoulder down on the ground.
"Big brother Jiuchong, you worked hard." The phoenix tribe's geniuses cheerfully moved the Phoenix Tree wood into the kitchen, following which the sounds of dragons and phoenixes resonated tirelessly from the kitchen, as if some kind of dish was being prepared.
Immortal Jiuchong said loudly, "Yingtian and Qilin, those two rotten chess players were arguing about who made what move during their game. Time Immortal, can you go over there and rule on this?"
Time Immortal gratefully looked at Immortal Jiuchong, good brother, it was worthwhile to let him be the first to become an immortal.
"Alright, I'll go now."
Immediately afterwards, Time Immortal noticed that something was amiss. He saw Immortal Jiuchong with a solemn expression, not looking like he was helping him escape, but rather that he needed his help with something else.
What could be so important that they needed his help, and had to go around Fairy Eternity to ask him?
Time Immortal had a faint idea that something was happening.
The two immortals who first achieved immortality traversed an infinite number of galaxies and returned the same way they came. They moved faster than when Immortal Jiuchong was travelling alone.
On the way, Time Immortal listened to Immortal Jiuchong's account, his expression heavy, he didn't say a word.

chapters.title: Chapter 553 - 552 Time-Space Tunnel_1
chapters.content:
Age Immortal looked very young, similar in age to Lu Yang. Among the Five Immortals of the Ancients, Fairy Eternity held the most longevity, with Age Immortal ranking second.
His innate foundation surpasses other immortals by far.
When Age Immortal arrived in the Immortal Realm and saw the disorderly game of Go on the chessboard, he couldn't help but twitch at the corner of his eyes, wishing he could overturn the board.
You three are really smooth, leaving me behind to suffer while you run off here to enjoy yourselves.
Next, he sensed something strange about the Immortal Realm. In particular, he could feel Fairy Eternity's aura from the future, which induced a chill in him and a lingering fear.
"It's fortunate that I didn't bring ███ over. In all of history, no such encounter has ever occurred between immortals across countless eons. Especially the ███ wielding ████. I fear that a catastrophic annihilation would occur at the moment of meeting, overturning both the past and the future!"
Even Age Immortal couldn't be certain of what would happen if the two immortal fairies met. What he mentioned was a highly probable event. It was also possible that nothing would happen, and these two could even chat and laugh heartily.
But who would dare gamble on such a possibility?
With resonance annihilation, if the bet is lost, it would spell the end for them all.
Age Immortal bit his finger, and golden blood flowed from the tip. He closed his eyes, using fairy blood to draw an Immortal Eye between his brows.
When the third eye opened, the golden Immortal Eye looked vacant as if blind. This was because the focus of the third eye wasn't in the present but in the future.
He could vaguely see a silhouette standing in the Immortal Realm, far in the future. However, he couldn't even glimpse the figure's appearance.
"There's serious interference!"
"Hmm? Who is this?"
He sensed that there was another person standing next to Fairy Eternity. But this person was too weak, not having the qualifications to appear before him across space-time.
He could sense a small piece of Firmament Tree hanging from the person's chest; it was a part of him.
"Did I in the future entrust him with a piece of Firmament Tree as a token of trust?"
"Was I in the future sealed, and this cultivator is sent to find Fairy Eternity?"
Age Immortal frowned and guessed silently, not revealing his thoughts.
"How is it, did ███ say anything?" Immortal Jiuchong asked hastily.
Age Immortal shook his head: "It's no good. Relying solely on the Time Immortal Eye won't work."
Time Immortal Eye is a viewing tool that he refined using Time Dao Fruit to peer into the past and future. It used to be invincible, but somehow, it's ineffective this time.
"Is it because the distance is too far, or something is interfering?"
Without further hesitation, Age Immortal summoned the Time Dao Fruit.
The appearance of the Time Dao Fruit, which was intertwined with endless space-time laws, set off ripples of time, like a stone thrown into the sea of time.
"Don't look."
Just before the Time Dao Fruit was revealed, Fairy Eternity covered Lu Yang's eyes.
The Time Dao Fruit is the ultimate form of the law of space-time. Not to mention Lu Yang, who is at the Golden Core Stage, even those at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage would become mentally disoriented and lose their sanity under the influence of the Time Dao Fruit.
The Time Dao Fruit contains too much information, which cultivators cannot handle. The mind is bound to collapse under such an intense deluge of information.
With the help of Dao Fruit, Age Immortal finally saw Fairy Eternity's face clearly. Yingtian Immortal and the other two also saw Fairy Eternity through the erected time tunnel.
Before Age Immortal could rejoice, cold sweat trickled down his forehead as he exclaimed, "This is bad, the time tunnel can't hold any longer!"
Among everyone present, he felt it the most. Something was severing the time tunnel between him and Fairy Eternity. No, to be more accurate, something was cutting off the connection between the era he was in and the future!
What could it be?
"███, what did you want to say!"
Fairy Eternity also sensed something amiss, and quickly said, "I was assassinated…"
Boom——
The tunnel shattered, completely detached under the influence of a mysterious force. the contact between the two sides was cut off.
Age Immortal stepped back, supported by Yingtian Immortal and Qilin Immortal.
"Are you okay?"
Age Immortal shook his head to steady his breath and activated the Time Dao Fruit. In a blink of an eye, he recovered to his full state: "The problem isn't serious."
Moreover, now isn't the time to be concerned about his physical condition.
He looked around coldly and said, "Did you all hear what Fairy Eternity just said?"
"She was assassinated... it's a joke, it's impossible!" Qilin Immortal crushed a chess piece, disbelief filled his pupils.
"Out of us five, Fairy Eternity is the hardest to kill. A careless mention of her name would revive her, who could have the means to kill her?"
The fact remains, whether you believe it or not. Even though Fairy Eternity enjoys fun and games, she would never joke about such matters.
They had thought that Fairy Eternity might get in trouble in the future and need their help. At most, they only thought that Fairy Eternity might have been sealed, and they would need to help unseal her.
They could never have thought that Fairy Eternity would be assassinated.
If she could have simply been resurrected, Fairy Eternity would definitely not have disclosed this. This means that Fairy Eternity not only fell in the future but could also not be resurrected!
"Did you not hear? It was an assassination. There may be some means that we can't imagine that can prevent her resurrection." Yingtian Immortal jabbed the table with his finger.
"She was assassinated and didn't disclose the murderer. Does that mean that even Fairy Eternity didn't know who the murderer was?"
The four thought, could it be that Fairy Eternity knew the murderer was amongst them and was afraid that if she announced it here, the murderer's information would be leaked?
They quickly dismissed this possibility. With their trust in Fairy Eternity, if she said who the murderer was, there would be no doubt. Could three of them not overpower a single murderer?
This was unlikely.
Who was it that assassinated Fairy Eternity and left even her clueless about the assassin's identity?
"How far in the future is Fairy Eternity from us?" Yingtian Immortal asked. Once the time was ascertained, many arrangements could be made.
"It can't be determined. The tunnel shattered too quickly, I didn't have time to find out. But what can be confirmed is that it's something that happens at least ten thousand years later."
"Why did the time tunnel shatter?" Immortal Jiuchong frowned. If the tunnel were still there, they could obtain more information, at least knowing the time would be beneficial.
Age Immortal, looking pale, said, "There are two reasons. One, space-time has a corrective nature, and future information can't be transmitted to the past, which would result in space-time chaos. This effect could be mitigated with my Time Dao Fruit. But the main point is the second."
"Something affected the stability of space-time and cut off our connection with the future where Fairy Eternity is."
"What can be stronger than your Time Dao Fruit?"
Age Immortal scoffed unhappily at Qilin immortal's remark, "It's not about something being stronger than my Time Dao Fruit, but that I was using the Time Dao Fruit to solve the corrective nature of space-time, neglecting to consider that thing!"
"What could it be that can also affect space-time?"
"I'm not sure. But if something could compete with my Time Dao Fruit, it could only be another Dao Fruit!"
"There's one more crucial question. Why didn't we resurrect Fairy Eternity in the future?"

chapters.title: Chapter 554 - 553 Analysis of the Four Immortals_1
chapters.content:
"Why haven't we resuscitated Fairy Eternity in the future?"
When Yingtian Immortal asked this question, the Immortal Realm fell silent, with the other four immortals saying nothing.
Indeed, this is the most significant question. If others can't resurrect Fairy Eternity, can't one of them manage it?
If they only had to utter a name, who could prevent it?
"It's not just Fairy Eternity. There may be problems with all four of us!" said Immortal Jiuchong coldly, this was the only possibility.
Although the previous question had been answered, a bigger one was set before them.
What exactly had happened that even among the Five Immortals of the Ancients, problems arose?
"Could it be that all four of us also perished?" Kirin Immortal suddenly suggested, sending a shiver down his own spine at the words.
After all, it was also a possibility. If Fairy Eternity had perished, theoretically, the four of them could also be wiped out.
"What you're saying is the worst-case scenario, but it's not very likely." Time Immortal shook his head analytically.
"Fairy Eternity was assassinated, which indicates that the opponent might be no match for her, or perhaps stronger than her, but their strength would be limited, it couldn't be overwhelming. Under such circumstances, as long as the four of us unite, the hidden assassin would likely not kill us all."
"Right, Time, since you mentioned that our connection with the future has been severed by the use of Dao Fruit, can you identify how far into the future we've been cut off from?"
Time Immortal frowned, "I can try, but the probability of success is small. Wait a moment."
The Time Immortal activated the Time Dao Fruit once more, with the chaos energy raging. His true form completely transcended time and space, overlooking the entire continuum, but found the future clear and free of any obstructions or impediments.
"How did it go?"
"As I expected, it didn't work. The future is too clear."
"What about the communication cut-off you mentioned?"
