Time Immortal looked at the Kirin Immortal as if he were looking at an idiot, "I told you to listen during our gatherings and discussions."
Kirin Immortal flared up in anger. He had been toyed with by Time Immortal's Time Dao Fruit twice, he was no longer afraid of his tactics. Did he really think he couldn't match him?
Even though Time Immortal taunted Kirin Immortal with his words, he still explained, "The future is uncertain, and what I see is only the most likely scenario. The closer the future I see, the higher the probability, the further away it is, the less likely it is."
"Suppose the future I see is 'Scenario A', the most likely scenario where Fairy Eternity is not assassinated."
"The event of Fairy Eternity being assassinated would be 'Scenario B'. When I talked to Fairy Eternity just now, I used the Time Dao Fruit to establish a connection with 'Scenario B'. The so-called cut-off, is the severance of my connection with 'Scenario B', not 'Scenario A', 'Scenario C' or 'Scenario D'."
"So, does it mean that it's not certain that Fairy Eternity will be assassinated?"
"No, the future is a straight line, it doesn't branch. Fairy Eternity will definitely be assassinated. It's just that from Time Dao Fruit's perspective, this probability is very low and undetectable."
"I'll only figure out the exact time of the cut-off once I have practiced Time Dao Fruit to the extent where I can observe all future scenarios."
Since Time Immortal's thread led nowhere, none of the immortals was discouraged and they continued analyzing the matter.
"Only an immortal can harm another immortal. If Fairy Eternity was assassinated, it implies the assassin is an immortal. Other than us five, are there any other immortals?"
Jiuchong Immortal had the most authority on this matter: "According to my research, I was the first to become immortal, followed by the four of you in sequence, with Fairy Eternity being the last. There is no sixth immortal."
"In that case, there are two possibilities for the identity of the assassin who killed Fairy Eternity." Yingtian Immortal held up two fingers.
"One, someone in the future becomes an immortal, who is extremely talented."
"The other is that there aren't just five of us immortals; there is a sixth one!"
As soon as he said this, everyone was stunned.
"That's impossible! The phenomenon of becoming an immortal is utterly terrifying, how could the sixth person hide it!" Everyone had experienced the tribulation of becoming an immortal. It was an earth-shattering ordeal that was definitely unable to be concealed.
"Becoming an immortal is indeed impossible to hide, but what if the opponent achieved a Dao Fruit like the Causality Dao Fruit or the Destiny Dao Fruit and concealed their existence using the power of the Dao Fruit, isn't it possible?"
Hiding oneself, forgetting oneself, also meant forgetting the prior terrifying ordeal of becoming an immortal.
The one who controls the Causality Dao Fruit may not be the most superior among immortals, but it doesn't mean they can't become immortals.
"This also explains the severance mentioned by Time Immortal. The Causality Dao Fruit was used to sever the causality between the present and the future."
"Or it could have been the Destiny Dao Fruit, which severed Yellow Bean's destiny to live, altering her from life to death. We know too much about the future, Yellow Bean's death would be affected, the cut-off occurred to ensure that we don't know too much!"
"Let alone, there could be other Dao Fruits that we don't understand, there are numerous possibilities."
In fact, they didn't understand the Causality Dao Fruit or Destiny Dao Fruit much either. These were all theoretical possibilities.
Without condensing an intact Dao Fruit, no one knows its precise power.
For instance, the Eternity Dao Fruit, when it was at the nascent stage, Yellow Bean merely utilized it to restore herself, or to dash around within statues.
Who could've imagined that after a complete Eternity Dao Fruit was formed, Yellow Bean could self-destruct at any time and anywhere, while being able to resurrect just by having someone say her name?
"Or there's a third possibility for the assassin, for now, I can't think of it." Yingtian Immortal shrugged; coming up with two possibilities in such a short time was challenging enough.
The other three Immortals also shook their heads, unable to come up with a third possibility for the moment.
"Should we tell Fairy Eternity about this matter?" Kirin Immortal asked, both Yingtian Immortal and Time Immortal began contemplating the feasibility.
"Absolutely not!" Immortal Jiuchong was the first to step forward in protest.
"Given Fairy Eternity's character, once she's informed of her inevitable assassination in the future, she might say something like 'I'll commit suicide first so I won't be assassinated', then proceed to commit suicide on the spot, and patiently wait for her future resurrection!"
"She might even do other surprising things!"
Kirin Immortal: "..."
Yingtian Immortal: "..."
Time Immortal: "..."
It seemed indeed to be Yellow Bean's style.
Yingtian Immortal stretched lazily, "We'll have to prepare slowly, I reckon nothing will happen to Fairy Eternity for a while. You, Time, came out with the excuse of acting as a referee, it's about time for you to return. Otherwise, if Fairy Eternity becomes suspicious and comes to look for us, that would be problematic."
Thinking about the food made by Fairy Eternity and Kirin Immortal's wife, Time Immortal even thought of self-destruction.
"I guess it can't be helped. Who called me unlucky?" Time Immortal sighed and, with a defeated look, dragged his body to prepare for his return to the North Star.
"Hold on, your chess game is estimated to last for about a hundred years, which would certainly create a historical reflection. Erase the reflection of us foreseeing Fairy Eternity's future. If the assassin of Fairy Eternity saw the historical reflection, wouldn't that reveal the fact that Fairy Eternity can resurrect in the future?"
"You are really cunning and deceitful." Yingtian Immortal extended his thumb in admiration.
"It's called careful planning!" Time Immortal was furious.

chapters.title: Chapter 555 - 554 Immortal Sect Exchange Ends _1
chapters.content:
Time Immortal had returned to the North Star, and the din created by Fairy Eternity and Dragon and Phoenix geniuses was escalating, making him anxious.
"You're back, Time? How are Qinglin and Yingtian doing?"
Time Immortal spoke seriously: "Yingtian Immortal, the terrible chess-basket, cheated. I gave him a lesson, then they resumed the game. When I left, Qinglin and Yingtian were in a state of Enlightenment. They seemed to see the five elements and eight diagrams embodied in the Five-in-a-Row game—the laws of heaven and earth, yin and yang!"
"Immortal Jiuchong, the inventor of Five-in-a-Row, is protecting the law for them. I left them and returned ahead."
"Hey, these two guys are fortunate. I will cook something delicious for them to replenish."
Seeing the busy figure of Fairy Eternity, Time Immortal kindly reminded, "Especially for Yingtian, I see that his enlightenment is the deepest, and he is the one who needs nourishment the most!"
Fairy Eternity replied loudly: "No problem, I'm best at this!"
She rolled up her sleeves and tied her headscarf tightly. The full fire was on, and the cries of ingredients came soon.
Time Immortal sneered, thinking If Yingtian called me cunning and treacherous, I will not poison you to death this time!
...
"So this is Immortal's chess game. I can't seem to figure it out." Meng Jingzhou mumbled, looking at it from all angles, but couldn't figure out the mystery contained in the chessboard by the two ancient immortals.
Tao Yaoye and Man Gu had similar reactions, and they couldn't see anything.
Qiu Jin'an thought it's nonsense; the Five Elements Sect had not seen the historical reflections for a hundred thousand years, and they expected to see it as soon as they entered?
Lu Yang yawned out of boredom.
He had just woken up from a historical reflection, mentally exhausted, and for a while, he hadn't figured out where he was.
Before Yingtian Immortal and the others discovered Fairy Eternity, Lu Yang had watched the game for twenty years, only by speeding up through Fairy Eternity.
Even so, it was a great mental burden.
Not to mention that he passed through the space-time tunnel and directly faced the Four Immortals of the Ancients, connecting the past and the future.
The activity of Lu Yang caught the attention of Qiu Jin'an, but he didn't think much of it.
The ancestor of the Five Elements Sect had been immersed in the historical reflection for a hundred years, which was completely different from Lu Yang.
From the perspective of outsiders, Lu Yang just lowered his head, yawned, and then woke up. The whole process didn't last two or three seconds. No one would have thought that Lu Yang saw the historical reflection.
Although it's all because of the face of Fairy Eternity.
After about a quarter of an hour, Qiu Jin'an asked with a smile, "Have you seen it yet?"
As expected, nothing happened. Young people came here just for its rarity.
They all sighed, still hoping to encounter the Immortality, not to mention seeing the Immortals.
But in the end, nothing.
"Fairy, did you just transmit too little information?"
Fairy Immortal only transmitted five words, and the passage was closed due to unknown reasons. Lu Yang was worried that this call did not work.
"Don't worry. Although their wisdom is not as good as this Immortal, it is far superior to ordinary people. They must be able to guess something and leave a trap."
"However, it's still happening that I am destined to die, and the trick they left should not be used on me, but on other things."
"That's all right."
Though he knew much about the dark history of the Four Immortals of the Ancients, he was easily targeted by them. Qilin Immortal tricked him into eating soil, but Lu Yang still hoped that the Four Immortals of the Ancients could survive.
Li Haoran was in a daze. He had just looked at the chessboard and dozed off suddenly. In his blur, he saw four people in the realm of immortals, all in control of great power. They are not to be faced directly.
Then he woke up and blinked.
"Was it a dream?"
He tried hard to recall the things in his dream and who the four people in the Secret Realm were in his dream, but the more he thought about it, the more blurred the memory became.
"What just happened?"
Li Haoran frowned. He always felt that something had just happened, but when he thought about it carefully, nothing actually happened.
The group left the Immortal Realm, and no one noticed that a figure sat on the mountain peak, motionless like a stone statue. The figure lifted his eyelids and glanced at the leaving group, then drifted down and entered the Immortal Realm.
There was no difference in the Immortal Realm and before—the figure was a little puzzled.
"Weird, is it an illusion? I feel that someone had just seen the historical reflection."
The figure shook his head and put this matter behind his mind.
It must be an illusion. How could someone touch the historical reflection but not be immersed in it?
...
In the blink of an eye, a month had passed. The five people, including Lu Yang, gained a lot from the Five Elements Sect. They cultivated based on the positions of the Five Elements in the five veins, sorted out their meridians, and summarized their learnings for this month.
Lu Yang cultivated in the Golden Meridian, rising from the late stage of the Golden Core to the peak of the Golden Core late stage second layer. His Realm improved greatly.
"Farewell, Brother Bai Ming, until we meet again!" On the flying boat, Lu Yang and the others waved their hands and shouted.
The people of the Five Elements Sect all came to see them off.
...
Seek Dao Sect breeding farm.
"In the Green Sky at the very beginning, the emptiness of Azure falls is empty, great float..."
The high-level member of Eternity Sect shook their heads, and the chanting of Buddhist Sutras was loud and clear.
After nearly a month of Buddhist teachings, they had all changed a lot, especially the Immortal Eternity, who had the highest comprehension of Buddhist teachings and made rapid progress.
If he didn't deliberately restrain his advancement, his body would radiate a golden light.
"The good deeds of Buddha are profound. In the future, it is not impossible for me to join the Suspension Temple."
"The credits all go to good teaching from the junior master."
Immortal Eternity and Shi Chan bowed to each other in respect.
"It is a pity that time has come. I have to return to the slaughterhouse to understand the "put down the butcher knife and become a Buddha on the ground."
Shi Chan felt regretful. He and Immortal Eternity met too late. Many of his views were recognized by Immortal Eternity. He is much more open-minded than his own master.
This is a donor with great wisdom!
With the generous donor, his trip to the Seek Dao Sect had been worthwhile!
Xiao Wu's Three Ghosts advanced to the Golden Core period smoothly under the influence of Buddhist teachings.
This was also a natural thing to occur. Even if the high-level members of the Eternity Sect turned into bloated ghosts and were not allowed to access resources for cultivation, their casual instructions could change the understanding of cultivation and didn't require cultivation resources at all.
Moreover, with Shi Chan preaching and enlightening, they helped them to transform their souls into the Golden Core period effortlessly.
Disciples of the Seek Dao Sect felt that the skewers tasted better in the past month.
Slaughtering livestock inevitably brings resentment into the meat. True Fire can, of course, drive away resentment, but it is slightly inferior compared to Buddhist teachings.
During the slaughter of livestock, the Master and Vice leader Jin chant Buddhist teachings to dissolve resentment.
After Immortal Eternity discovered this, he was overjoyed: "This is a good method. If I have a chance, I will talk to the Second-in-command and see if this method can be promoted to every grill!"
This is proof of active labor reform.
"Shi Chan, you come again when given the chance. If you need anything, I will definitely meet your needs." Dai Bufan personally saw off Shi Chan.
After learning that his master was still alive, he was convinced that it was his good deeds that touched Master Jiesha and kept his master alive.
Shi Chan really has something to ask for help.
"Brother Dai, could you lend me some money?"

chapters.title: Chapter 556 - 555: Clue of the Time Immortal_1
chapters.content:
A thousand clouds drifted by, and the Grand Elder sighed with relief as he saw the Seek Dao Sect drawing closer and closer.
"Finally, I have safely returned to the Seek Dao Sect."
Although the journey from being captured by the Suspension Temple to his safe return to the Seek Dao Sect was full of twists and turns, being able to return was a blessing no matter what.
...
"I think, Junior Brother Shi Chan, you may not need to pack your things."
"Ah? Why?" Shi Chan thought silently, Elder Brother Dai seemed a friendly man, would he really send him away?
"Your Sect has arrived." Dai Bufan said, emotionless, his gaze slipping past Shi Chan to a group of monks walking from a distance.
Shi Chan turned to see his own masters and senior brothers bathed in Buddha's light, they were dazzling. Among them, Senior Uncle Jiechen held a person in his hand.
The cultivators from the Suspension Temple were highly skilled, covering hundreds of meters with each step, they already arrived at the gate of Seek Dao Sect within a blink of an eye.
"Senior Uncle Jiechen, why are you here?" Shi Chan was surprised, he didn't hear any news that his Sect would come to pick him up.
His master, Master Jiesha, was here too, who had been mute for a long time, hence there was no point in asking him either. So, he asked his Senior Uncle instead.
"Performing a good deed every day, we came to release the living." Master Jiechen pushed the person in his hand to return him unharmed to the Seek Dao Sect.
"Master, are you okay?" Dai Bufan looked at the Grand Elder, who had been returned from the Suspension Temple, with a strange expression.l
The Grand Elder gestured to Dai Bufan not to worry about him: "It's just exchanges between the upper echelons of the Sects, what troubles could there have been?"
Dai Bufan: "..."
Master Jiechen beckoned Shi Chan to come over.
"Thank you, Martial Nephew Dai for taking care of things this past month." Master Jiechen gave a nod of appreciation.
"Senior Uncle, you're too courteous." Dai Bufan responded with a bow.
...
The people from the Suspension Temple took Shi Chan away. On the road, Shi Chan kept his head down, appearing very downcast.
It seems that he won't be able to continue working at the slaughterhouse anymore.
"Shi Chan, what did you gain from your time at the Seek Dao Sect?" Master Jiechen kindly asked. Being called Jiechen, he was always full of smiles.
"I gained a lot. There are many experts in the Seek Dao Sect, and I've met many people who shared the same ideas as me!"
"But the most important thing is that I confirmed what my master once said. The head disciple of Daoist Buyu is indeed difficult to deal with."
"Naturally, could your master ever lie to you? The head disciple of Daoist Buyu is indeed difficult to deal with…wait, what did you say?" Master Jiechen suddenly realized something was amiss. How did this youngster know that Yun Zhi was difficult to deal with?
"Master didn't say that Daoist Buyu's eldest disciple is very powerful and should not be provoked? I think that learning from books is not enough, personal experience is necessary. Therefore, I went to Sky Gate Mountain to challenge Senior Yun Zhi.
Let me tell you, I certainly couldn't beat her." Shi Chan recalled the scene, feeling aches already, Yun Zhi was really strong." he said chilled with afterthought.
Upon hearing his good disciple behaving like this, Master Jiesha's flying body even shook a little, almost falling down.
He wanted to curse aloud, but remembering his practice of Silent Zen, he could only curse silently in his heart.
...
"We're back." Lu Yang and his four companions returned to the Seek Dao Sect. Home was indeed more welcoming. Look, Elder Brother Dai and the Grand Elder were waiting to receive them at the gate of the Sect.
"Grand Elder, Elder Brother Dai, thank you for your hard works, I have something urgent to speak with Eldest Senior Sister, so I'll leave first."
With that, Lu Yang quickly disappeared from everyone's sight, leaving everyone bewildered.
"What's the rush with this kid?"
"No idea."
Of course, Lu Yang was anxious. Regardless of what he had learned from his trip to the Five Elements Sect, just dealing with the ancient matters he had learned about, he needed the Eldest Senior Sister's decision.
As soon as Lu Yang returned to Sky Gate Mountain, the Eldest Senior Sister touched the ground with one foot, the other foot rooting at its side. She sat in a half-lotus position, her hands in a flower-holding gesture, holding two Golden Cores, with her breath as long as nature, her presence surprisingly low.
Before Lu Yang could utter a word, the Eldest Senior Sister slowly opened her eyes and asked, "Junior Brother, what makes you in such a hurry to find me?"
While speaking, she got up and flicked the Golden Cores in her hand into the sky, where they transformed into meteors, suspended high in the sky.
Lu Yang was stunned by the sight.
Seeing Lu Yang's surprise, Eldest Senior Sister casually explained, "A month ago, someone came to challenge me, hoping that I would suppress my realm to the late stage Golden Core. I agreed to his conditions, plucked two Golden Cores from the sky to temporarily suppress my realm. Then I thought since I had this opportunity, why not try to refine it for a while.
I just finished refining and let the two Golden Cores return to their original place."
A twitch appeared at the corner of Lu Yang's eye, he thought to himself, he would have been better off without her explanation.
"Where did you get this piece of wood?" The Eldest Senior Sister crooked her finger, and the piece of the Firmament Tree hanging around Lu Yang's neck flew up, bringing Lu Yang with it to face her.
As the Eldest Senior Sister examined the piece of the Firmament Tree, Lu Yang had never been so close to her before, and his mind was in a whirl. He could even feel her breath.
"A part of the Immortal Tree?" The Eldest Senior Sister raised an eyebrow, released Lu Yang, curious where he found such a precious item.
"Yes, it's a part of the Firmament Tree, and it was given to me by Sister Shangguan!"
"A part of the Firmament Tree? 'Time Immortal'?"
The Eldest Senior Sister was slightly surprised, so Sister Shangguan had the clue to the 'Time Immortal'?
Or perhaps Sister Shangguan didn't know it was the Firmament Tree, but only knew it was precious, and gave it to Lu Yang in advance to build a good relationship?
"Let me explain." Fairy Eternity chimed in, as she knew the most.
"When I and Lu Yang went to the Wood Vein of the Five Elements Sect, we found the Wood Vein was thriving with extraordinary vitality. I saw the amulet Sister Shangguan had given Lu Yang, so I scanned the entire Wood Vein with my Spiritual Sense, and then made the discovery."
Fairy Eternity moved her Spiritual Sense, recreating the corpse of the 'Time Immortal' buried underneath the Wood Vein.
"This is..."
"The corpse of the Time Immortal."
Yun Zhi's eyes widened in surprise, as she had not anticipated this news. She had visited the Five Elements Sect before, but out of courtesy, she had not scanned with her Spiritual Sense to see what was beneath the Wood Vein.
She had never expected the body of an immortal to be buried beneath the Five Elements Sect!
"The 'Time Immortal' died? No, just by a corpse, we still can't make a conclusion."
"Senior Sister, I want to confirm one thing. I read in the ancient books that the Nian Beast is a pet of 'Time Immortal'. Is this true?"
"Yes, the Nian Beast is a Demon Beast cultivated by the 'Time Immortal' using the Time Dao Fruit."
"Then there's no mistake. Every New Year, the Nian Beast is active, and then it disappears. One time, I tried to track the Nian Beast to see where it goes, but I startled it by using too much strength. Since then, the Nian Beast flees as soon as it sees me."
Mortal beings have a lifespan of only a hundred years and cherish their time. They celebrate the New Year once a year. But for cultivators who have a long lifespan, a year is nothing more than a snap of the fingers.
In the Cultivation World, the tradition is to celebrate the New Year every ten years, and the Nian Beast also appears once every ten years. Since Fairy Eternity resurrected, she has not yet caught up with the New Year of the Cultivation World.
"What I can confirm is that every New Year, the Nian Beast comes from the east and goes back to the west. Therefore, I suspected that the clue to the 'Time Immortal' lay in the East Sea or Buddha Country, which is why I asked my second Junior Brother to venture more towards the west."

chapters.title: Chapter 557 - 556: Motivation and Explanation_1
chapters.content:
"So, the reason Second Senior Brother has been wandering in the Buddha Country is this?"
Lu Yang was shocked; he thought that Second Senior Brother had crossed paths with Eldest Senior Sister, leading to his banishment to the western lands. He thought Second Senior Brother had to beg for food to survive in the Buddha Country and was living in poverty, disguised as a Buddha statue in temples. Very pitiful indeed.
It seems he had been overthinking things.
"Unfortunately, even after so many years, he hasn't found any useful clues. On the contrary, he keeps being sent back home by the Buddha Country and keeps having to sneak in." Eldest Senior Sister regretfully shook her head, finding it extremely challenging to look for clues about an Immortal who managed time.
Perhaps he should visit the Five Elements Sect and carefully observe the Firmament Tree.
"Since the Firmament Tree is rejuvenated, could the Time Immortal still be alive and return to reside within it?"
Fairy Eternity nodded: "It's possible. After all, it's hard to rebuild an immortal body, so using the original one is the preferred choice."
"There's also something else. I encountered Yingtian Immortal and the others in the Immortal Realm of the Five Elements Sect."
"What happened? Please explain in detail." Eldest Senior Sister was on alert. How did Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity get so much information from a single visit to the Five Elements Sect?
Fairy Eternity recounted in detail what she had seen and experienced in the Immortal Realm, with a particular focus on her conversation with the Time Immortal through a space-time passage. Of course, she wasn't aware that Yingtian Immortal and Qilin Immortal had been playing chess simply because they didn't want to eat.
Yun Zhi furrowed her brow slightly.
"I didn't see any historical reflection when I entered the Immortal Realm. I never would've thought that such significant events were hidden in the chess game."
Lu Yang was puzzled. According to Fairy Eternity, those who could gain insights from the chess game would see the historical reflection. So why couldn't Eldest Senior Sister see it?
Fairy Eternity rolled her eyes, thinking that Lu Yang was rather dull. "Yingtian Immortal showed the historical reflection to the later generations for style, not for someone like Miss Yun at my level. What's the point of letting her see the historical reflection?"
Lu Yang thought about it, and she was right. Even if Eldest Senior Sister had comprehended something, she wouldn't be too surprised by Yingtian Immortal's methods.
"Yingtian Immortal seems to have been the brains among the Five Immortals of the Ancients, considering everything so thoroughly."
"What are you blabbering about? Of course, I'm the mastermind. Do you think they could possibly be smarter than me?"
"If they were as smart as me, they would've thought of teaming up to secretly kill me and then resurrect me in the future. Wouldn't that solve everything?"
Lu Yang: "..."
One must say, this really is a method, just not one a normal person would think of.
"I thought you were going to say the Four Immortals should've told the past you about the plot and had your past self commit suicide to avoid being killed."
"That's the second plan." Fairy Eternity was thorough in her preparations and wouldn't just think of one method.
As if she hadn't heard the discussions they were having, Yun Zhi analyzed, "Fairy, you being assassinated is a fact. The remaining Four Immortals knew about this assassination from you, they must have prepared something. If they didn't prepare anything for you, then they must have prepared something for themselves, perhaps a last resort to save their own lives."
"So this would mean that the Four Immortals of the Ancients might still be alive, including the Time Immortal. They've remained hidden in the shadows of history, never making a move. But is it because they're in a terrible state or because of some other reason?"
"From the fact that the two of you couldn't get any information about the predecessor from the historical reflection, and that the space-time passage was disrupted, something else must be blocking everything."
Even if the Time Dao Fruit was ineffective, it shouldn't have only conveyed five characters, and the Time Immortal himself had said that something was interfering."
"It seems there's a force that's changed history, preventing later generations from gathering information about the predecessor from history."
The pen name for the Cookbook of the Immortal changed from "Fairy Eternity" to "Yingtian Immortal", and the ancient immortals replaced "Fairy Eternity" with "Time Immortal" in their speeches, etc. All these things proved this point.
"It seems that we can't entirely believe the information in the ancient books, some parts have been modified."
"Those who could've done this are likely the wielders of Dao Fruit, like Causality Dao Fruit, Destiny Dao Fruit, Consciousness Dao Fruit, Verbal Spell Dao Fruit, etc."
Eldest Senior Sister was mumbling to herself, she looked into Lu Yang's eyes briefly, thought that Lu Yang was still young and shouldn't be exposed to so much, then stopped speaking.
To himself, Lu Yang was exasperated, "Eldest Senior Sister, could you either not start talking, or finish what you were saying without stopping halfway?"
Out of these, he only knew about the Causality Dao Fruit, and could deduce its effects based on the actions of the second Imperial Teacher.
The Causality Dao Fruit could deceive even the immortals, making them forget their own existence!
The only ones that could kill immortals are immortals themselves. Did Eldest Senior Sister mean there was a sixth immortal in ancient times? This immortal wielded the Causality Dao Fruit and used it to erase their existence?
The other three types of Dao Fruit must have similar effects!
If there truly was a sixth immortal, Fairy Eternity was very powerful, the sixth immortal's Dao Fruit would've definitely countered Fairy Eternity!
Lu Yang secretly sought help from Fairy Eternity, she would definitely know the effects of these Dao Fruit.
What he didn't know was at the same time he was trying to get Fairy Eternity's attention, Eldest Senior Sister was also warning Fairy Eternity with her eyes.
Fairy Eternity believed Lu Yang shouldn't know so much and adamantly refused to explain the effects of the Dao Fruit.
"What could have been the motive of the hidden hand behind Lady Fairy's murder?"
Lu Yang had been unable to figure out this part. Assuming the enemy held the Causality Dao Fruit, even though Fairy Eternity had no conflicts with the world and was close with Four Immortals of the Ancients, if they killed Fairy Eternity, they would definitely provoke the Four Immortals of the Ancients. What reason would provoke them to make such a life-threatening move?
"Motive...reason…"
"Motive...reason…"
"There must be one, a reason regarding his own interests…"
He seemed to understand something, excitement appearing in his eyes, "Could it be possible that the Dao Fruit has devouring abilities? The more the Dao Fruit devours, the stronger it becomes?"
"Let's provisionally name it the Devouring Dao Fruit."
"If the Ancients actually had seven immortals instead of five, with the sixth immortal holding the Causality Dao Fruit, and the seventh the Devouring Dao Fruit, the seventh immortal devoured the sixth and gained the power of Causality Dao Fruit, hiding his own existence."
"The seventh immortal wanted to become stronger and planned on Fairy Eternity, striking secretly, attempting to devour the Eternity Dao Fruit, to become an undying existence. However, things went awry, like the Four Immortals of the Ancients arriving in time, causing the seventh immortal to fail in devouring!"
"This explains the existence of the Eternity Sect. He created the sect with the purpose of devouring the nascent Eternity Dao Fruit!"
Everything made sense now!
Fairy Eternity was also excited, patting Lu Yang's shoulder while saying she felt this was indeed the truth, "You make a good point!"
Yun Zhi interrupted their discussion: "Enough, Junior Brother. You shouldn't be too involved in this matter, it's too dangerous. Right now, what you should be doing is diligently cultivating."
"Oh."

chapters.title: Chapter 558 - 557: Third Senior Sister's Letter_1
chapters.content:
Three months had passed since Lu Yang had returned from the Five Elements Sect. One day, the Eldest Senior Sister received a Thousands-Mile Letter Pass, and she was momentarily startled.
She pondered in her abode for a moment, letting out a gentle sigh.
"It seems it's time to send Junior Brother on a journey," she said.
Right at this moment, Lu Yang was at a critical moment in his cultivation.
With his mouth wide open, he was devouring the spiritual essence, sweating profusely. The sweat turned into mist, gathering above his head as if it were auspicious clouds.
"Whew! I finally advanced from the Seventh Heaven to the Eighth Heaven of the Golden Core Stage!" he exclaimed.
Opening his eyes, he saw the Eldest Senior Sister standing in front of him, who asked blank-faced, "Since when was the Golden Core Stage divided into Seven Heavens and Eight Heavens?"
Lu Yang immediately pointed out the behind-the-scenes mastermind: "Fairy Eternity was the one who said it. She said that the more detailed the levels, the more motivated the cultivation, and every step will provide a sense of achievement!"
"Hey, hey, hey! Are you selling me out?" Fairy Eternity, donned in a pink nightgown, seemed to have just woken up, jumped out from Lu Yang's body, feeling unsatisfied upon hearing Lu Yang badmouthing her.
"How is this selling out? It was just Eldest Senior Sister asking a question, and I just answered truthfully."
"This is selling out."
"This is not selling out."
The Eldest Senior Sister felt that if she let the two of them continue to argue, nothing would be accomplished for the rest of the day.
She took out a letter with cursive, and cute handwriting on the envelope that read: 'to dear Senior Sister Yun Zhi'.
"What is this?"
"It's a letter from your Third Junior Sister, Gan Tian, sent from the Demon Territory. She says she's encountered some things related to the ancient past in the Demon Territory and wants me to find a scholar familiar with ancient history to go research with her or help her answer some questions."
This wasn't a normal letter, but a magic artifact. It came in two designs, mother-artifact and sub-artifact. The Eldest Senior Sister owned the mother-artifact, while Third Junior Sister owned the sub-artifact. What Third Junior Sister wrote in the letter would also appear on the Eldest Senior Sister's.
"I've thought it over, and the one who knows the most about ancient history is you. If you're not busy, you could take a trip to the Demon Territory."
Lu Yang considered the suggestion. He had broken through to the Eighth Heaven realm, but he was still a long way from the Jiuchong realm. It wasn't great to keep practicing in the sect, so he might as well get out and experience the world.
"I'll go."
Seeing Lu Yang agree so eagerly made the Eldest Senior Sister see the presence of their master in him.
She reminded him, "You may make some new discoveries at the border of the Central Continent and the Demon Race territory. You can ask Third Junior Sister about that after you meet her."
...
A cultivator dressed in grey silk robe landed, hands tucked into his sleeves, a smile playing on his lips, his eyes almost closed.
"Halt, state your name."
The Seek Dao Sect disciple standing guard raised his hand to stop the grey-robed cultivator from entering, watching him warily.
Anticipating this, the grey-robed cultivator pulled out a letter from his sleeve and handed it to the two disciples.
"Please do me a favor. I am Xu You, the housekeeper of the Meng family, here to visit young Master Meng. Please be accommodating."
Checking the contents of the letter, the Seek Dao Sect disciples found an introduction from the Meng family, certifying Xu You's identity. No one would dare to counterfeit this.
Usually the Meng family was the one deceiving others, not the other way around. Impersonating the Meng family meant you didn't want to stay on the Central Continent anymore.
"So it's Elderly Xu. May I ask why Elderly Xu is looking for Junior Brother Meng?"
Everyone in the Seek Dao Sect knew that Meng Jingzhou was the young master of the Meng family, although no one really mentioned it.
Xu You sighed. The smile on his face disappeared: "What else could it be, but to persuade the young master to return home. His parents miss him. They asked me to advise him to go home for a visit."
With these words, he pulled out two Storage Rings from his sleeve and handed them to the two Seek Dao Sect disciples.
"It's cold here. I suppose it's not easy for you two to guard the mountain gate. There are a few inexpensive little trinkets in these Storage Rings. Please make it convenient for me to enter."
The Seek Dao Sect disciples continuously insisted they should not accept it.
"We absolutely cannot do this. The Sect law forbids accepting bribes. Once found out, one will inevitably face severe punishment!"
"You two should take them. If you two and I, the three of us, don't mention this, then who would know?"
The two Seek Dao Sect disciples saw they couldn't refuse him and reluctantly accepted.
"A parent's longing for their child is only natural. Please come in, Elderly Xu." The Seek Dao Sect disciple neatly refolded the letter, returned it to the envelope, handed it back to Xu You, and moved aside.
Upon entering the Seek Dao Sect, Xu You abandoned his sorrowful, sighing expression, letting his amiable smile resurface.
The River Spirit revealed its head, rising to the surface of the water.
Xu You respectfully bowed his head to the River Spirit, waiting until the River Spirit returned to the water before continuing on his way.
He knew beforehand that the young master was in the Abode by the Body Refinement Peak, where the old horse was grazing. He could easily identify Meng Jingzhou's location.
He greeted the old horse, and the old horse responded with a snort, indicating that Meng Jingzhou was inside.
Xu You gently knocked on the stone door, three times, and then silently waited thirty seconds. Seeing no one answer, he knocked three more times.
Just as he prepared to knock with more urgency, Meng Jingzhou impatiently pushed open the stone door: "Who is it? I didn't seclude myself for cultivation... if anyone wants to find me, just walk in, right?"
Raising his head to see Xu You's face, he was surprised that it would be him knocking on the door. He cautiously queried, "Housekeeper Xu, why are you here?"
"Master Meng, may we go inside and talk? There are some things I can't say out here."
Meng Jingzhou had no choice but to invite Housekeeper Xu inside.
Once inside the abode, Housekeeper Xu found a grass mat and sat down, explaining his purpose: "The Master has noticed that you have not returned home for two years. He wishes for you to return and visit him. He misses you very much."
"Impossible."
Without a second thought, Meng Jingzhou rejected the idea. He had left home with such determination two years ago, how could he return now?
"The Master said he knows about all the wrongs you have committed, and he forgives you."
Meng Jingzhou suspiciously eyed Xu You's smiling face, trying to discern if the truth lay beneath his words.
"Really?"
"Yes."
Meng Jingzhou was ecstatic: "Even the incident in the brothel, where I cunningly arranged for my father and uncle to bid ostentatiously for the same courtesan, leading to the embarrassing situation of both pulling back the curtain at the same time – after learning about that, my father forgave me?"
"What about the time when I beat up Minister Li's grandson, Minister Gong's son, and even the prince? I thought I was discreet, but somehow my father found out. He forgave me for that too?"
"The incident when my father wished to take a concubine, and I told my mother about it, leading to her beating him up — my father has found out that it was me who did that, and he has forgiven me too?"
"And also..."
The more Xu You heard, the more alarmed he became. When he had left, the master had only mentioned two or three incidents, not the rest.
He coughed awkwardly and toughened up: "Actually, Master Meng, you do not have to rush to return home. The master is busy with state affairs and might not even have time to see you. You should take your time to decide when to return."
"My main purpose for coming here was for another matter."
"What matter?"
Xu You smiled and said in a deep, cold voice, "I heard that you have been close with Lu Yang, the talent. The Master said this boy is very gifted and will surely become a great talent in the future. Perhaps, he could be useful to our Meng family..."

chapters.title: Chapter 559 - 558: Lu Yang is my good brother, I won't hurt him!_1
chapters.content:
Lu Yang arrived at Meng Jingzhou's abode, and before he knocked on the door, he heard Meng Jingzhou talking with someone else inside.
"Impossible! What kind of person do you think Meng Jingzhou is? How could I let my brother sink into trouble!"
"This is the wish of the old master. If you want to control Lu Yang, this is the only way."
"You go and tell my dad this is impossible and that he should drop it!"
"Stop mentioning my dad! If he's brave, let him come to the Seek Dao Sect! I'll have my master give him a beating!"
"Young Master...sigh..."
Seeing his persuasion efforts were to no avail, Xu You gave up. He saw Lu Yang standing outside the door and was momentarily stunned.
He had already seen portraits of Lu Yang.
Lu Yang also felt a bit awkward. Although they were discussing a topic that pertained to him and seemed to not be particularly flattering, it was still embarrassing to face them directly.
Neither spoke as they nodded and passed each other.
Upon entering the abode, Lu Yang met an enraged Meng Jingzhou.
"Such an outrage! Look at what my dad is scheming!" Meng Jingzhou complained to Lu Yang. Although he usually tried to trick Lu Yang, he always sided with Lu Yang when it was most critical.
Lu Yang was greatly touched. True brotherhood never dies. He pretended not to have eavesdropped and asked: "Who was that just now...?"
"Xu You. I heard he used to be my dad's tutor and has now been promoted to housekeeper."
"Did he come to persuade you to go home?"
"At first. After a brief talk, he stopped trying to convince me. He said he needed my help with an important matter."
"What is it?"
"My dad wants to marry my younger sister off to you. I rejected the proposal for you."
Lu Yang: "..."
Now that's what I call a brother.
"Isn't your sister too young for cultivation?"
"It's an engagement, isn't it? Don't large families enjoy this kind of arrangement? Wasn't I also proposed to by a bunch of people when I was a kid? Same old process."
"My guess is my dad intercepted the letter I sent to my sister. Seeing that I praised your cunning, ruthless, and master-like demeanour in the letter, he felt you're talented and wanted you to be his son-in-law."
"That housekeeper Xu also relayed the message, suggesting that since your master is Daoist Buyu who can't find a wife, why not marry into our Meng family."
"Oh, by the way, what did you need me for?"
"Third Senior Sister sent a letter. She wants to go to the Demon Territory. I plan to go with her. Would you like to join us?"
"Which Third Senior Sister?"
"Third Senior Sister Gan Tian."
"Who's that?"
Only then did Lu Yang remember that Third Senior Sister Gan Tian hadn't returned to the sect in a long time. Being a low-key personality, not many of her stories circulated within the sect.
"My master has four disciples. Besides Eldest Senior Sister, I have two other senior siblings. They are Second Senior Brother Ye Zijin and Third Senior Sister Gan Tian. One is in the Golden Buddha Kingdom, and the other is in the Southern Demon Realm."
Meng Jingzhou finally understood and nodded, wagging his index finger. "I know your Second Brother is! He's the one who lost his Nascent Soul during his initial unification and couldn't even defeat his own Nascent Soul!"
"...I do hope you'll keep to these words when you meet Second Brother."
...
Xu You didn't go far. He sat next to Old Horse and took out two gourd wines, one for himself, and the other he shoved into Old Horse's mouth.
He first poured himself half a gourd of wine and then said: "Brother Horse, it's been two years. How are you doing at the Seek Dao Sect?"
"To be honest, I'm truly envious that you can stay by the young master's side. It's so easygoing. You know the family dynamics of the head of the family, it's really chaotic. Managing the whole Meng family is really wearing me out."
"That's why, as soon as I heard the Big Brother was missing his kid, I took the initiative to come to the Seek Dao Sect. Regardless of whether the young master returns or not, at least I can rest for a few days."
Old Horse glared at Xu You, raised his head, bit on the gourd and also downed half the gourd of wine. He then opened his mouth and the gourd was suspended mid-air.
"Do you really think it's easy following young master?"
Old Horse thought, do you think your job as a housekeeper is hard? Is your work anything compared to mine?
When I was bringing the young master to the Seek Dao Sect, before we even entered the gates, the young master had already pulled Yun Zhi onto the carriage. He asked Yun Zhi if she was also here to take the test and claimed he had the real test papers for it.
I was so terrified when he pulled Yun Zhi along.
When the young master and Lu Yang went out on a task, their first collaboration led them to infiltrate the Eternity Sect and even become the Rudder Master of the Eternity Sect. Just when we finally had the chance to return to the Sect, Lu Yang had to reveal the true name of Fairy Eternity out of the blue.
I watched with my own eyes as an ancient Immortal was resurrected, nearly scaring me out of my wits.
Later I took the young master to Qingzhou for a grand ceremony and halfway, two Great Yu Unification Stage and one Great Yu Transcendance Tribulation Stage people showed up; luckily, Yun Zhi made her move.
Afterwards, we went to Wild State. Oh, boy. There were three Transcendance Tribulation Stage people. One was even the Emperor of Great Yu. All three of their souls were brought back by me.
Can a Demon King like me handle any of these situations?
It's like I'm pulling the ancestors of the Meng family. Let him pull the carriage next time, I quit pulling it.
"If you think my job is easy, we can change."
It will give you just the experience you need to understand what high-level cultivators are like. Don't think you're great just because you have reached the Unification Stage. If you have not reached the Tribulation Stage, you might be embarrassed to follow the young master out the door.
Watching Old Horse crack open his mouth, laughing maliciously, Xu You sobered up significantly and shook his head vehemently.
Suddenly, Old Horse asked in confusion: "What did you do when you came to the Seek Dao Sect? Why did they come looking for you?"
"What did I...?" Xu You was momentarily confused.
She saw one of the gatekeeping disciples leading the way for the Grand Elder.
"Grand Elder, this is the one who bribed both of us. This is the Storage Ring he gave us."
Xu You: "..."
The Grand Elder wore a similar grin to Xu You, smiling slyly as he asked, "Brother Xu, tell me, to bribe the disciples of our sect is a serious crime. Are you ready to be handed over to the authorities or would you rather stay in our Seek Dao Sect for a few days?"
Being the oldest brother among the nine sons of the Grand Elder and the master of the Task Hall, he knew all about the sect's information and all of its Unification Stage disciples.
The patriarch of the Meng family, Old Horse, and Xu You were kindred spirits. They had their youthful adventures together, developing a tight-knit relationship. Later, Xu You became the patriarch of the Meng family while Old Horse divided his time between the Meng family and his original home in the East Sea.
"I'll stay in the Seek Dao Sect," Xu You made his decision quickly.
The Grand Elder did not say another word. He took out shackles that had been prepared in advance and locked them onto Xu You with a loud clatter.
"Hey, isn't that a bit harsh?"
The Grand Elder chuckled coldly: "Don't think I don't know what you're thinking. You probably think the job of a housekeeper is too tiring, so you want to take advantage of being arrested to take a few days off in my Seek Dao Sect."
"Speak up honestly. I'm not opposed to cooperating, but if you want to play smart...who else should I arrest if not you! Come with me!"
It was impossible to outwit him.
Xu You glanced back at Old Horse despairingly, only to see a mocking grin on Old Horse's face.
Just then, Meng Jingzhou stepped out of the door.
"Hey, Old Horse, Lu Yang and I are planning to go to the Demon Territory."
Old Horse's expression was ashen, wishing he could swap places with Xu You.

chapters.title: Chapter 560 - 559 United Demon Race
chapters.content:
Lu Yang and his companion hit it off right away and decided to venture into the Demon Territory.
"We can't rush into this. We need to gather some information about the Demon Territory first," Lu Yang said with restraint, trying to suppress the smile curling at his lips.
"Should Man Gu and the other two go to the Demon Territory?"
"Man Gu can't go. The bloodline of his Ancient Barbarian Tribe acts as a double-edged sword to the Demon Race.
It can suppress lower-level demons, but to high-level Demon Beasts, it would just attract hatred," Lu Yang recalled with a shudder the incident during their Foundation Establishment Stage when they were training in the dense forest, and Man Gu's Ancient Barbarian bloodline had awakened, drawing a mob of Golden Core Stage Demon Beasts upon them.
If Man Gu were to go to the Demon Territory, it would likely attract not just Divinity Transformation Stage but even higher-level Demon Beasts in droves. They would have nothing to do but to run for their lives.
Oh, considering that outrunning Demon Beasts might be impossible, they might as well just resort to Eldest Senior Sister's Imitation Fist.
"Junior Sister Tao is busy cultivating her Feather Transformation Immortal Body and cannot leave," Lu Yang added.
Before visiting Meng Jingzhou, Lu Yang had been to see Tao Yaoye. He had seen her enveloped in platinum feathers, as if she was nurturing something within, cut off from any external contact and not to be disturbed.
"Junior Brother Li should be free; we can ask him," they decided.
The two temporarily left Old Ma to his devices, unconcerned with Xu You who was shackled, and headed to the Hundred Refinement Peak to find Li Haoran.
Li Haoran was bare-chested, his wig removed, revealing sinewy muscles and a shiny bald head, as he swung a large hammer with a grunt, busily forging some kind of magic artifact.
The noise of refining magic artifacts was substantial. The disciples of Hundred Refinement Peak always set up sound-isolating Array Methods before refining, so as not to transmit the noise and disturb the other disciples.
"Phew, finally nailed it," Li Haoran exhaled, picking up the small rectangular object beneath the hammer.
"What kind of magic artifact is that?"
Hearing Lu Yang's voice, Li Haoran looked up and noticed the arrival of the two. He had been so engrossed in hammering that he had overlooked his surroundings.
"This thing? Oh, this isn't a magic artifact. It's compressed steamed buns," he explained.
"It's a special treat from the Hundred Refinement Peak's cafeteria, exclusive to our Sect's disciples. It combines steamed buns with Great Recovery Pills and Essence Concentration Pills. Whether during tiring travels or when drained of spiritual essence in battle, just one bite guarantees a recovery of both physical and mental energy!"
"It can also serve as a breastplate when placed over the chest, even more functional than the previous sesame seed cakes. Want to try? I've just made them," Li Haoran offered.
The two hastily declined, shaking their heads as they explained their purpose.
Li Haoran frowned, looking troubled, "Go to the Demon Territory? I'm afraid that won't be possible. My master told me to cultivate in the Sect in peace and not to leave until I've caught up with you both in terms of realm."
"Aren't you already in the late stage of the Golden Core?"
"Sure, but I only reached the late Golden Core Stage three months ago, while you two have been at it for five months," he responded.
Lu Yang understood. Li Haoran was currently at the Seventh Heaven of the Golden Core Stage, while he and Old Meng had reached the Eighth Heaven.
That was the difference.
"If you're planning to head to the Demon Territory, you'd better prepare in advance. Qin Haoran used to hide from debtors in the Demon Territory, so by extension, I'm quite familiar with it. There are some things to be cautious of. For example, Senior Brother Meng, it would be best not to bring that horse of yours to the Demon Territory."
"Ah, why's that?"
"Old Ma is a mutated demon beast. Having a demon beast pull a cart is asking for trouble with the Demon Race, isn't it?"
From the outside, Old Ma's forehead bore several dragon scales, readily classifying him as a mutated demon beast, that is, a creature with Demon Beast lineage but with mixed and impure blood.
Li Haoran was unaware of Old Ma's true identity.
But regardless of his knowledge, whether Old Ma was a Demon Beast or a mutated demon beast, having him pull a cart wasn't much different from bringing Man Gu into the Demon Territory.
"But if you two reversed roles with Old Ma, you probably wouldn't make enemies,"
"Reversed roles?"
"That's right, the two of you pull the cart while Old Ma sits on it."
"..."
What would be the point of bringing Old Ma then?
"Are Demon Beasts always this unified?" Lu Yang mumbled to himself. The Human race is a single race, but the Demon Race is a collective of many tribes. Would the Tiger Clan get angry seeing Old Ma pulling a cart?
That seemed excessively unified.
"The Demon Race wasn't always so united," Fairy Eternity knew the insider details.
"In the earliest times, Demon Beasts roamed rampantly, with no place for the Human race. The Tiger Clan, Long Clan, and many others had significant divisions among them, and it often came down to life or death battles."
"Later, as the Human race rose and tribes multiplied, the Demon Beasts began to feel the pressure. By our times, three of the Five Ancient Immortals were from the Human race, with the Demon Race only having the Qilin Immortal. The Time Immortal didn't belong to any race. With three against one, the Human race had a huge upper-hand, and that established their dominant position."
"Feeling the pressure from the Human race, the Demon Race united on their own, collectively calling themselves the Demon Race."
In his heart, Lu Yang thought they must have been afraid of being eaten by you, forced to unite against a common enemy.
"Junior Brother Li, could you tell us about the Demon Territory?" Meng Jingzhou asked.
Li Haoran nodded and drew a large circle on the ground with a stick and many smaller circles within it.
"This is the Demon Territory, and these small circles represent the Demon Race."
"Unlike Great Xia or Buddha Country, the Demon Race has a chaotic order and hasn't established a dynasty. They're similar to the early Human race, living in tribes as their strongholds. The relations between the various species are intricate and complex, with blood feuds, private enmities, alliances, and betrayals.
Don't just look at the superficial relationships between the Demon Races; there are many things we don't know about them."
"The Demon Race can be roughly divided into three categories: those friendly to the Human race, neutrals, and those who detest the Human race."
"For instance, the Long Clan and Phoenix Tribe are very close to the Human race, whilst the Taozhu tribe belongs to those who detest the Human race. The Chaos Tribe is neutral. When you reach the Demon Territory, be careful and try to approach the territories of those friendly to the Human race."
"The Demon Race prizes strength and bloodline purity. The purer the bloodline and the stronger one is, the more respect they receive."
"For example, pure-blooded members of the Long Clan, Phoenix Tribe, or Xuanwu, those who are both from large clans and of pure blood, hold the highest status among the Demon Race."
"Of course, the Human race is an exception; at least, I haven't heard of the Demon Race respecting us just because we're of pure-blooded Human descent."
Next, Li Haoran talked about the taboos of each species, such as how a dragon has its reverse scale that must not be touched, or how one shouldn't mention the selling of blood to the Phoenix Tribe, and so on.
"I don't know much about the Demon Territory, after all, right now I only have half of Qin Haoran's memories. A lot of things are unclear, and I might mislead you if I tell you everything. The Elders traveled everywhere in their youth; they must have been to the Demon Territory, so you can ask them if there are any other precautions."
"That makes sense."
The Elders were experienced, having been everywhere from the underworld to prisons, brothels, Buddha Country, and the Demon Territory.
Grand Elder was chatting with Xu You when the two of them found Uncle Ba.
"You're going to the Demon Territory, are there any precautions we should know?"
Uncle Ba lowered his head and thought for a moment before seriously saying,
"Don't tell them you're from the Seek Dao Sect."

chapters.title: Chapter 561 - 560: The Predecessor Digs a Pit, the Later Generation Falls into It
chapters.content:
"Uncle Ba, when you were young… did you ever cause trouble in the Demon Territory?"
"How could that be, I'm such an honest person. At most, I just helped others with some minor tasks, running errands. I wasn't the main one committing the bad deeds."
"I heard that both the Long Clan and the Phoenix Tribe are close to the Human race, so it should be possible to visit them, right?"
Lu Yang remembered that when they visited Li Haoran's hometown, they met a member of the Phoenix Tribe selling blood to create Phoenix Blood Stones. After revealing their identities, the Phoenixes were quite hospitable.
"It's possible to go, but that's provided certain little things haven't been exposed."
"What little things?"
"There's a saying that dragons and phoenixes bring auspiciousness, symbolizing good luck, and during weddings, wealthy families like to stick up dragon and phoenix paper cuttings."
"Old Nine pondered that a wedding is just a couple announcing to everyone that they are going to consummate their marriage at night. Therefore, the dragons and phoenixes in the paper cuttings should imply the same, but since people never have the chance to witness dragons and phoenixes mating, the cutouts don't resemble reality."
"Old Nine dared to be the first to secretly find a dragon and phoenix couple, observe their mating process, record it, and compile the firsthand information into a book called 'The Transformation of Dragon and Phoenix,' leaving a reference for future generations. I don't know if you've heard of it."
Lu Yang: "..."
How could I have not heard of it? The 'Transformation of Dragon and Phoenix' was the first thing I found on my first day in the Scripture Pavilion. It was even hidden in a corner, and I thought I had found a great opportunity.
Back then, the Senior Brother in the Scripture Pavilion was puzzled why the 'Transformation of Dragon and Phoenix,' a banned book that couldn't be found anywhere in the whole continent, was hidden there.
Turns out it was written by you, Master!
From the reactions of the Dragon and Phoenix clans, they still don't know it was you, Master, who did it, but who knows about the future.
"What about the Bai Ze clan?" Lu Yang had heard that the Bai Ze clan was neutral and often acted as mediators and witnesses when conflicts arose within the Demon Race.
"There's not much of an issue with the Bai Ze clan. It's just that back then, when we brothers caused some commotion in the Demon Territory and were chased fiercely, we disguised ourselves as Bai Ze to escape a disaster. Unfortunately, we were later spotted by a real Bai Ze who insisted on capturing us.
Out of desperation, Old Eight asked him, 'Since the Bai Ze clan knows everything, do you know what you don't know?'"
"While he was pondering the question, we took the opportunity to escape. I heard that the Bai Ze who was asked that question by Old Eight has now become the Clan Leader."
"The Bai Ze clan is fair and kind-hearted, with many affairs to attend to. They probably have long forgotten about our little incident."
"Caused a bit of a commotion?" Lu Yang felt that this commotion must have been significant.
"It wasn't anything major, just that we happened to be in the Demon Territory during the secret realm which opens once every five years. We decided to try our luck to see if we could get some good items. The requirements for entering the secret realm were high, one had to be of pure blood. Luckily, we were all pure-blooded from the Human race, and entered without any issues."
"Unexpectedly, once inside, the Demon Race turned hostile. They allowed us to enter but then specifically targeted us, trying to squeeze us out, trip us up, play dirty, and there were even some who wanted to kill us. Seeing this, we thought it was unacceptable, no way we were going to be bullied like that."
"So I blocked the entrance to the secret realm with stones, and Sixth Junior Sister created a fake entrance with an illusionary realm right beside the real one. Then we shouted out loud, claiming there was a problem with the entrance and that we couldn't leave."
"Of course, the Demon Race didn't believe it and walked into the fake entrance of the secret realm. Once inside, they found themselves not in the outer world, but an unknown space. He quickly tried to return, suspecting that they had encountered a spatial anomaly and could no longer exit."
"The fake entrance was linked to a specially made Beast Taming Sect storage ring, designed to hold living creatures. What he entered was indeed a storage ring, hence the unknown space."
A typical storage ring can only contain inanimate objects.
"When one Demon Race member's attempt failed, several high-ranking members of the Demon Race entered the fake secret realm entrance, reaching the same conclusion—they had encountered a spatial turbulence."
"The secret realm's entrance was open for ten days, and we left at the end of the tenth day, telling those outside that the secret realm was too dangerous and all the demons had died. The group of Demons that we had locked up for five years started searching the whole world for us once they got out."
```
"Why bother with such games when everyone could just compete for opportunities fair and square? Why stoop to underhanded tricks and cunning against us?"
Lu Yang: "..."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
"The Taozhu race... Well, since they're a demon race that detests the human race, provoking or not doesn't make much of a difference."
Uncle Ba nodded in agreement, "That's true, the Taozhu race's disdain for the human race has little to do with the Seek Dao Sect. The Boss merely visited the ancestral graves of the Taozhu for research purposes and was discovered by them in the end."
After questioning Uncle Ba, the two went on to ask the Third, Fourth, Fifth, Sixth, Seventh, and Eighth Elders, one by one.
The two were lucky to find out that what Uncle Ba said was a lie—the number of times the Nine Disciples of the Dao Seeking Sect had provoked the demon race was significantly more than Uncle Ba had let on.
"This precaution is clearly not just about not revealing our association with the Seek Dao Sect; it's practically telling us to stay away from the Demon Territory."
Lu Yang felt the perilous future brimming with murderous intent.
"It should be fine, look at how well our Third Senior Sister is doing in the Demon Territory, and she even gets a chance to study ancient history. We will be safe under her wing for sure."
"The only question is whether our portraits have made it to the Demon Territory or not."
"They probably haven't, since we haven't even heard the names of the demon geniuses. By that logic, the Demon Territory is not familiar with the geniuses of Great Xia either, at best they might know a name or two."
"Makes sense."
After discussing it, the two decided to head for the Demon Territory.
As cultivators, we should not shy away from a challenge.
They went on a major shopping spree, focusing on purchasing life-preserving items, storing them in the Identity Jade, and set off lightly equipped, taking a flying boat to the old place—Demon Suppressing Pass.
It was the Eldest Senior Sister who had dumped them there in the first place.
The once-booming wig industry at the Demon Suppressing Pass was in decline, and without Lu Yang's antics, wigs were no longer necessary.
The two no longer needed the elixirs for repelling insects; with their Golden Core Stage aura being emitted, no mosquitoes or insects dared to approach.
The dense forest stood between the Demon Suppressing Pass and the Demon Territory, and it was in this very forest that Lu Yang had advanced to the Golden Core Stage.
"Back then, those Golden Core Stage demon beasts posed quite a threat to us, and encountering a Nascent Soul Stage beast meant fleeing for our lives. Now, they seem trivial." Two cultivators at the Golden Core Eighth Heaven talked and laughed merrily in the forest.
Tall trees blocked the sunlight, and in the dark underbrush, pairs of green, glowing eyes greedily and bloodthirstily watched Lu Yang and his companion, full of lethal intent.
However, after the two old ancestors nonchalantly killed a Nascent Soul Early Stage demon beast, the hidden creatures knew to retreat from the difficulty and quietly withdrew. Nothing happened.
Even when they entered the territories of the Nascent Soul Stage demon beasts, those with a strong sense of territory dared not show themselves and acted as if they saw nothing, silently praying that no incident would occur.
None of those who had cultivated up to the Nascent Soul Stage were fools. They were very well aware of their own abilities; they were just mixed-blood demon beasts with mediocre combat power. The two humans' combat strength was on par with the top geniuses of the elite demon races; they didn't dare to provoke them.
The dense forest no longer posed a threat to Lu Yang and his companion.
Before officially entering the Demon Territory, the two took every minute to flex their might.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 562 - 561 Central Continent and Demon Territory
chapters.content:
```
Two Golden Core ancestors showed off their power, skilfully avoiding the territory of the Spirit Transformation Stage demon beasts—not because they couldn't defeat them, but because it was needless to seek trouble, as they reached the depths of the dense forest.
"Such thick fog."
What appeared before the two of them was a dense fog so thick they couldn't see their own hands in front of them, as if walking through a reed bed, unable to see the path ahead, only able to walk by feeling.
"Ha!"
Meng Jingzhou let out a 'ha', and with a swipe of his palm, a golden imprint shone brightly, taller than a person, with an astonishing palm wind. On a normal day, a single palm-strike like this could blow away a cultivator in the early stages of the Golden Core, yet now the palm imprint hit the fog and didn't even stir up a wave.
Even the palm wind couldn't disperse the fog before their eyes.
Lu Yang used his proud Spiritual Sense, but unexpectedly, it couldn't extend out at all, disintegrating as soon as it touched the fog.
"I had heard that the fog was dense in the depths of the forest, but I didn't expect it to be so strange, that even Spiritual Sense couldn't penetrate it. No, it should be said that it's decomposing the Spiritual Sense, right?"
During their training at Demon Suppressing Pass, both of them had heard that some parts of the dense forest bordering the Demon Territory were shrouded in thick fog, which never dissipated, even at noon.
"I originally thought that upon reaching the Golden Core Stage, this legendary fog would be nothing special. Now it seems I was thinking too simply. This might be the work of a Mirage King or some other demon beast."
Now that Spiritual Sense was unusable and their senses significantly weakened, their perception of the surroundings had decreased, making it easy to fall prey to a sneak attack.
The two did not dare to be careless, moving through the fog with utmost caution, trying hard to minimize their presence.
Actually, their worries were unnecessary. In the fog, just as they couldn't detect an enemy, the enemy also couldn't detect them; no one would choose to launch a sneak attack here.
"Could this be the anomaly Eldest Senior Sister spoke of?" Lu Yang suddenly recalled what Eldest Senior Sister had said before they set off.
"What did Eldest Senior Sister say?"
"Eldest Senior Sister told me there could be new discoveries at the border between the Central Continent and the Demon Territory. If I had any doubts, I could ask Third Senior Sister after seeing her."
"It must be the fog, then."
At that moment, Fairy Eternity awoke from her sleep. She had slept comfortably throughout the journey, and her strength had recovered quite a bit as well.
"Hm? You two, this is their territory, why is there a wall in front of you?"
Fairy Eternity woke up muddleheaded, rubbing her eyes while warning Lu Yang. If she didn't warn him in time, he would walk right into the wall.
"A wall?"
The fog was too thick in front of Lu Yang for him to see anything.
"A very tall and big wall, I can't see the end of it with just one glance... Wait, something's not right!"
Fairy Eternity exclaimed softly, sensing something amiss.
No matter how strange the fog, it couldn't obstruct her sight and Spiritual Sense; she could clearly see everything around her.
"What's not right?" Lu Yang had seldom seen Fairy Eternity react so strongly.
The last time she had such a strong reaction was when she was clamouring to suppress him, only to be counter-suppressed by the Eldest Senior Sister who was summoned later.
"I'll share my Spiritual Sense with you."
In the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity tapped Lu Yang's forehead of his spiritual body, linking her Spiritual Sense with his. Temporarily, Lu Yang gained the vision of Fairy Eternity.
Lu Yang felt light-weighted, his vision boundless, as if he were a high deity, everything laid out before him, to be manipulated at will.
"What is this!"
Lu Yang's face showed disbelief; before him was an unimaginably tall and thick wall, so vast that even with Fairy's wide-reaching Spiritual Sense, he couldn't see its end!
Fairy's Spiritual Sense even reached beyond the fog, where Lu Yang saw bushes, towering trees, demon beasts running about, and tribes gathering—a scene of thriving life.
The most crucial thing was that the demon beasts Lu Yang could see were standing on the wall!
"Lu Yang, where are you?"
```
Meng Jingzhou didn't realize Lu Yang had stopped walking; he kept moving forward, then turned his head to find that the person beside him was gone.
Lu Yang was silent for a moment, as he had clearly seen Meng Jingzhou "walk" onto the wall.
The moment Meng Jingzhou touched the wall, he stood on it, forming a right angle with Lu Yang.
And Meng Jingzhou continued to walk forward, indicating that he was completely unaware of this!
"Don't go any further, come back here!"
Lu Yang called out, and Meng Jingzhou turned around, puzzled, but since Lu Yang had called out, it must have been because he'd discovered something, so he took a few steps back to stand beside Lu Yang.
"What's wrong?"
Meng Jingzhou was perplexed.
Lu Yang's heart trembled. What his Spiritual Sense had observed, the process of Meng Jingzhou walking back and forth, made him realize something—the so-called solid wall before them was not a wall at all, but the Demon Territory!
The Central Continent and the Demon Territory were not on the same land mass but were two completely different continents, and these two continents were aligned vertically!
Lu Yang took a step forward, and through the eyes of his Spiritual Sense, the world spun around as he arrived in the Demon Territory.
Lu Yang stepped back to the Central Continent and shared his findings in full with Meng Jingzhou, who also fell silent for a long time after hearing them.
"It seems this is the 'new discovery' Eldest Senior Sister was talking about."
"Who would have thought that the Central Continent and the Demon Territory were two completely different continents… Wait, why is it named the 'Central' Continent?"
Lu Yang suddenly pondered another question.
Lu Yang had always thought that to the east of the Central Continent lay the Vast Eastern Sea, to the west the Golden Buddha Kingdom, to the south the Demon Territory, and to the north a frigid land, with the continent located at the center, hence the name "Central."
But with the Demon Territory and Central Continent vertically aligned, how could it be considered "central"?
Unless the other three places were also continents aligned vertically with the Central Continent!
Only if the Central Continent was completely enclosed by four other land masses could it truly be called the "Central Continent"!
"It's definitely the work of an Immortal," Fairy Eternity concluded decisively.
"The work of the Ancient Nameless One?"
"Most likely."
The Ancient Nameless One hadn't just refined the stars into a single continent, but five!
But no one knew what the purpose of the Ancient Nameless One was.
Refining stars into continents, which sounds impressive, is fraught with difficulties and not something that can be done just by talking about it.
If such an effort was put into refining continents, there must have been a purpose.
Lu Yang took a deep breath. Eldest Senior Sister had already anticipated this situation; that's why she said to ask Third Senior Sister if there were any questions.
The reason she didn't explain the situation of the continents before departing was probably that seeing with one's eyes is far more shocking and makes a deeper impression than hearing a description.
"Most cultivators don't know that the stars in the sky have already been refined, so it's likely that very few people are aware of the continents being arranged this way."
They had encountered many high-level cultivators, none of whom had ever mentioned the state of the continents, indicating that this knowledge didn't appear to have any impact.
"Let's not think too much about it for now; we can't flatten the continents anyway, so let's not trouble ourselves unnecessarily," Meng Jingzhou said.
"Right."
Both of them nodded and took a step forward, moving to another continent.
There was also thick fog on this side of the Demon Territory; they kept walking forward until the mist gradually dissipated.
They had officially arrived in the Demon Territory.

chapters.title: Chapter 563 - 562: Elopement
chapters.content:
By the time they officially arrived in the Demon Territory, it was already late, and the pale moonlight fell, illuminating the scenery before them. There was a forest in front of the pair, which is very common in the Demon Territory.
Unlike the Central Continent, which had almost fully developed the continent, the Demon Territory's system was relatively backward, with villages as strongholds and insufficient development. There were many primitive jungles in existence.
Moreover, the tribes that live on the borders of the Demon Territory were all mixed-blood Demon Race tribes, belonging to small tribes that simply didn't have the ability to develop the jungles.
"Where is Third Senior Sister?"
"According to the map Eldest Senior Sister gave us, we set off from the Demon Suppressing Pass and reached the Demon Territory. If we head north for two thousand miles, at the border between the Qiongqi Clan and the Howling Moon Tian Lang Clan, Third Senior Sister will be waiting for us there," Lu Yang took out the map, which Eldest Senior Sister had casually drawn.
It was very crude, only outlining the border of the Demon Territory and the territories of the Qiongqi and Howling Moon Tian Lang Clans. What species we would pass by in the middle was not marked at all.
"It's not far, about a three-day journey."
"Then let's set out."
After determining the direction, the two of them prepared to set out. Even though it was late, both of their cultivations were flawless, and they had even trained their eyes. As long as there was the slightest light, they could see the road clearly. Walking under the moonlight was the same as during the day.
Just as they were about to take a step, they sensed a rustling noise coming from deep within the forest, and could faintly hear shouting.
"Stop!"
"Don't let them escape!"
"Miss, stop running away!"
A man and a woman emerged from the depths of the dense forest. Upon seeing Lu Yang and his companion, they were slightly taken aback. They had taken advantage of the night to flee from an arranged marriage, aiming to escape to the lands of Great Xia. Unfortunately, their plan was not well-thought-out, and a mistake was made.
The people from their clan noticed something amiss and had been pursuing them all along.
Just when success seemed within reach, they hadn't expected that their clan would have anticipated their escape route and set up an ambush here.
"Break through!"
The man gritted his teeth. As long as they could get past these two and enter the fog, they would be able to make a clean getaway!
He pulled a broadsword from his storage ring, gripping it with both hands. His muscles swelled, and a mist condensing on the blade like autumn frost, naturally carrying a chill with it!
In the past, facing a powerhouse like Lu Yang, he would never have dared to make a move. But now, with his loved one by his side, pursuers behind, and freedom ahead, he must give it his all!
The woman was not weak either; she wielded twin swords, their tips moving in a dance of dragons and phoenixes!
"Those who block me shall die!"
The man and woman leaped high, reaching the height of Lu Yang's knees, only to be kicked away by Lu Yang.
Lu Yang squatted down, looking at these two little ones who were merely an inch tall, feeling quite helpless.
"What are you two doing?"
Before the pair could answer, they saw pursuers arriving quickly from behind, all about an inch tall. Most of them had human forms, while a few didn't even have human forms, retaining the appearance of their original race—the Insect Race.
Meng Jingzhou's eyelid twitched. They had just been about to leave when a pair of little bugs scurried out from the forest, ranting about "those who block me shall die" and charging over with weapons the size of toothpicks.
To say nothing of the fact that you two hardly have any cultivation level, even if you did, where would you get the courage to fight them?
The Insect Race was also part of the Demon Race. If the Dragon and Phoenix Tribes stood at the pinnacle of the Demon Race, then the Insect Race was at the very bottom, with even the Rabbit and Mouse Races having higher status than the bugs.
Because the Insect Race was inherently weak, they could only huddle together for warmth. Whether it was the Ant Tribe or the Mantis Race or the Dung Beetle and Mosquito Races, they would all live together, collectively known as the Insect Race.
Even after the Insect Race achieved form transformation, if their cultivation level was not enough, they could only transform into tiny one-inch-tall beings. Once they reached the Foundation Establishment Stage, their bodies could grow to the size of a Human race child, and only in the Golden Core Stage would they take on the appearance of an adult human.
The man coughed up blood and looked at Lu Yang in despair. Agile as he was, capable of contending with a Qi Refinement second layer cultivator, Lu Yang's strike was enough to severely injure him, which surely meant that Lu Yang was a Great Power above the fourth layer of Qi Refinement!
