Lu Yang had seen members of the Insect Race before; the couple of Silver Ring King Worms in the medicinal garden were of the Insect Race and were at least at the Spirit Transformation Stage.
But it was his first time seeing such a young member of the Insect Race. He used to take such tales as jokes, but today, seeing someone of the Insect Race daring to draw a blade on him... was even more amusing.
The group behind them, witnessing Lu Yang's skill, grew respectful and didn't dare to make any more commotion.
One of them stepped forward, trying his best to look up at Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, and knelt down, asking fearfully, "I am Li Shiqiang of the Insect Race. I do not know what brings the two esteemed ones here. If we have offended you, please forgive us."
He was the number one expert of his tribe, but in the face of the inscrutable duo of Lu Yang, he didn't dare to be discourteous and tried his utmost to be thorough in his manners.
"There's no offense to speak of. We are from the Prison Suppressing Sect. My name is Meng Yang, and he is Lu Jingzhou."
The other party had introduced themselves, so it would be inappropriate if they didn't do the same.
This was the story they had agreed upon while on the road. Claiming to be loose cultivators was not an option; the Demon Race valued bloodlines and the origins of the human race, and claiming to be a loose cultivator could lead to being looked down upon by the Demon Race or even provoke ominous thoughts.
Thus, they needed to fabricate a background with substance—impersonating the Dynasty was too risky, for they could end up facing legal consequences upon return.
The Seek Dao Sect identity was not usable.
There were too few people in Suspension Temple to impersonate.
The Laurel Fairy Palace was all female cultivators, so they couldn't pretend to be from there.
So they had to pick between the Five Elements Sect and the Prison Suppressing Sect.
Lu Yang chose the Prison Suppressing Sect.
Li Shiqiang felt flattered and astonished, for it was the first time he had encountered such polite Great Powers; there weren't many in the Demon Territory who reasoned with others.
"Commander Li, just let me and Xiaomi go," the small man running from the marriage pleaded bitterly, but Commander Li remained unmoved.
The truth was their escape plan had been doomed from the start; Great Xia would never allow members of the Insect Race to enter, that was an immutable rule.
If they were allowed in and started to reproduce, it would be intolerable, for even Qi Refinement first layer mosquitoes would be too much for ordinary people to handle.
The couple of Silver Ring King Worms were an exception; they were at the Spirit Transformation Stage, which made reproduction extremely challenging.
Both Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou became interested, and they crouched on the ground, using the moonlight to observe these tiny creatures, "Don't rush to take them away yet. Tell us what's going on."
Commander Li didn't dare go against their wishes and explained the situation in full detail.
The Insect Race was also divided into tribes, and the tribe they were from happened to be the weakest, without even a single mid-stage Qi Refinement insect. The son of a Clan Leader from another, stronger Insect Race tribe took a fancy to Song Xiaomi and, using his power to pressure others, wanted to marry her.
Song Xiaomi's tribe had no choice but to send her over, yet Xiaomi had a childhood sweetheart named Chi Shui, a prodigy of her tribe. However, against another tribe, he was no more than a mantis trying to stop a chariot.
Song Xiaomi and Chi Shui both opposed the marriage, which led to their escape under the cover of night, only to run into Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
"This is interesting. Come on, take us to see your Insect Race tribe," said Lu Yang.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had never seen what an Insect Race tribe looked like. Having come to the Demon Territory, it would be a waste not to witness its unique characteristics.

chapters.title: Chapter 564 - 563: The Might of the Golden Core Ancestor!
chapters.content:
```
Two powerhouses at least at the mid-stage of Qi Cultivation were set to visit the tribe, and leader Li dared not disobey, his heart filled with bitter complaints and terror.
Their tribe was weak, and if they offended these two powerhouses, they feared a mere wave of their hand could annihilate the tribe.
In the Insect Race, any group that formed a tribe numbered at least in the millions. Though the tribe might be destroyed, exterminating them entirely was an even greater challenge. It was precisely due to their numbers and potent reproductive capabilities that the Insect Race had survived from ancient times until now.
Countless ancient races had been wiped out, but the Insect Race still existed, spread across the Demon Territory, which was a testament to their ability to survive.
"I've eaten all kinds of Demon Race, but I still find it hard to stomach the Insect Race, never having touched them before," Fairy Eternity made a face of disgust, trying to keep her distance from the Insect Race. After all, even an Immortal Cook like herself had ingredients she preferred not to work with.
"However, I also don't need to eat Insect Race members since they've never troubled me."
"Fairy, are all the members of the Demon Race you've eaten ones who've troubled you?"
"Of course. You have no idea how vicious the Demon Race can be. They especially love to devour cultivators, as the flesh and blood of cultivators is greatly nourishing to them. Before I became an immortal, I was constantly chased by demons."
"Those days were not easy. If you didn't kill them, they would kill you, so I had to fight back and killed quite a few from the Demon Race."
"I'm not like the Yingtian Immortal or the Qilin Immortal, who have destiny on their side and are ridiculously lucky, with one opportunity after another. Immortal Jiuchong is backed by the Lianshan Clan, so he has no worries about cultivation, and not to mention the Time Immortal; even when I was just at the Qi Cultivation Stage, he was already at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage."
"I started from scratch, too poor to find cultivation materials. Without cultivation materials to become stronger, you would just end up being killed, so I ate the Demon Race members I killed."
Fairy Eternity sighed, those days had really not been easy. She couldn't even count the number of dangerous predicaments and situations of certain death she'd faced. Fortunately, she was capable of fighting, her strength increased rapidly enough to allow her to survive time and again.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou followed leader Li to the Insect Race tribe.
According to leader Li's introduction, their tribe was named "Hydroxy" and called the Hydroxy Insect Tribe. The tribe wanting to marry Song Xiaomi was the Stiff Insect Tribe.
"We've arrived, it's right there!"
Leader Li pointed ahead and announced.
Looking in the direction of leader Li's pointing, Lu Yang saw twinkling stars deep within the forest, bewitchingly beautiful.
Only when they drew close did they realize the glowing came from the backends of fireflies.
The Clan Leader paced anxiously at the entrance of the tribal gates, waiting for leader Li's news. Before he saw Li, he spotted two enormous creatures lurking in the dark, like man-eating beasts with glowing eyes, eying the tribe.
As a powerful insect at the third level of Qi Cultivation, he felt a lethal pressure in the presence of these two huge creatures.
These monsters were at least at the sixth level of Qi Cultivation!
A calamity of tribe extinction!
"All hands on deck!"
At the Clan Leader's command, the tribal warriors sprang into action, aiming their tiny toothpicks and pebbles at the two monstrous creatures.
"Clan Leader, don't attack, don't attack," leader Li, upon seeing this, hurried over in fright to explain, for upsetting these two powerhouses would turn a non-issue into a serious one.
"These two are Meng Yang and Lu Jingzhou from the Five Elements Sect. It's their first visit to the Demon Territory, and they wish to tour our tribe."
The Clan Leader breathed a sigh of relief; a fight, even with a victorious outcome, would still be a costly victory.
"I've brought back miss and Chi Shui,"
Song Xiaomi and Chi Shui, securely tied up, staggered to the Clan Leader.
"Dad, I don't want to marry him!"
"Clan Leader, please believe me, give me time, and I am certain to advance to the seventh level of Qi Cultivation!"
The Clan Leader glared furiously at Song Xiaomi and Chi Shui, his third-level Qi Cultivation pressure terrifyingly immense: "Stop this nonsense. Is this about what you want? I'm going to receive our honored guests, and I'll deal with you later!"
"Take them away!"
Turning back, the Clan Leader put on a forced smile: "Esteemed guests, this way, please."
"Wait a minute, don't take them away just yet," Meng Jingzhou said.
```
"Sir, do you have any instructions?" the clan leader asked reverently.
Meng Jingzhou stood with his hands behind his back, his tone calm, "Instructions? Hardly necessary. Although I'm not fond of the notion that lovers eventually become spouses, I have even less patience for those who abuse their power to force marriages!"
"If the two of you are genuinely in love, I've got your tribe's back!"
Finally, a chance to show off, could I really let it pass without acting?
Lu Yang looked at Meng Jingzhou disdainfully, easily guessing his thoughts.
Pathetic, showing off in front of a bunch of insects with at most three levels of Qi Refinement. Why not have someone at the Foundation Establishment Stage to play along?
Song Xiaomi and Chi Shui were overjoyed, never expecting such a powerful being to offer them protection willingly.
The clan leader was equally pleased. His daughter wouldn't have to marry off, and their tribe could gain the protection of a mighty figure—a stroke of incredible fortune.
Learning that their tribe would be under the protection of two great powers, the entire tribe erupted in cheers, warmly hosting the pair.
The two discovered that there were very few insect-shaped beings in the tribe, the majority were untransformed insects possessing intelligence but unable to speak.
The transformed insects in the tribe took up important roles, such as protecting and managing the village, and going out hunting. The insects that had captured Song Xiaomi and Chi Shui were responsible for protecting the village.
The Hydroxy Insect tribe went out of their way to entertain the two guests; they must not have been the first humans they hosted, as they appeared quite experienced in doing so.
Both guests sat cross-legged as ants worked together to carry huge bowls and chopsticks, fruits, and decorative flowers for them to enjoy.
Lu Yang took a bite of an unnameable fruit, crisp and refreshing. He sipped the juice in the bowl, the iciness soothing his throat—it was all rare delicacies unavailable in the Central Continent, specialties of the Demon Territory.
Fireflies acted as bonfires, clustering together like a river of stars, quite a beautiful sight. From above, the two looked as though they were seated within the Milky Way.
The only imperfection was the dance performance, with swarms of mosquitoes flying in front of them.
Fortunately, Meng Jingzhou's willpower was extraordinary, and he refrained from slapping the mosquitoes away.
The night buzzed with excitement.
The next morning, uninvited guests intruded into the Hydroxy Insect tribe.
A large group of insects from the Rigor Insect tribe arrived, one of the transformed insects arrogantly seated on a leaf, treating the Hydroxy Insect clan leader with contempt and not even bothering to step off the leaf.
He was the son of the Rigor Insect clan leader, Qing Dong.
He noticed two mounds not far from the Hydroxy Insect tribe and was puzzled; they hadn't been there during his last visit.
Whatever, no need to think too much about it.
"I heard my fiancée almost ran away yesterday, is there any truth to this?"
"Nephew Qing Dong is joking, there's absolutely no such thing!" the Hydroxy Insect clan leader denied vehemently.
Qing Dong's eyes narrowed slightly, "Are you saying I'm wrong?"
He exuded the aura of someone at the fourth level of Qi Refinement!
The Hydroxy Insect clan leader was shocked, not expecting someone so young to have reached the fourth level of Qi Refinement—a prodigy unheard of in their tribe's history!
In the midst of this standoff, a sound as heavy as thunder rumbled, shaking the earth. Insects fell to the ground in fright, and Qing Dong also tumbled from the leaf.
In Qing Dong's terrified gaze, the mounds awakened. They slowly rose like mountains from flat ground, their presence blocking out the sun and casting shadows over everyone.
It wasn't a mountain at all, but a person!
The man's eyes shone like two miniature suns, and the pressure he emitted caused Qing Dong to shiver uncontrollably.
"Just a Qi Cultivation Stage ant, and you dare to spout nonsense in front of me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 565 - 565: 564
chapters.content:
Qing Dong's teeth chattered, shaking uncontrollably; he had never seen such a terrifying presence. Just standing there, the mere presence of the other caused him to feel like he was suffocating, and he dared not even breathe deeply.
The other party even laid bare his identity—a mere ant.
"To disturb my tranquil cultivation, you truly have quite the nerve!"
Meng Jingzhou's tiger-like eyes glared ferociously, his natural majesty making even the spiritual energy of heaven and earth congeal!
Greatly alarmed, Qing Dong felt his spiritual essence freeze; this was the power only those who had turned their Qi into a foundation at the Foundation Establishment Stage possessed!
How did the Hydroxy Insect tribe manage to find such a mighty backer!
"Truly bothersome."
Another colossal being awakened, its voice lazy, its expression indifferent, reminiscent of a sword about to be unsheathed—even with just a fraction exposed, the blinding brilliance of the sword light made it impossible for everyone to keep their eyes open.
If Meng Jingzhou's arrival caused spiritual energy to congeal, then Lu Yang's arrival brought a murderous aura into the coalesced spiritual essence!
Another, another Foundation Establishment cultivator.
Qing Dong wished he were dead—if he had known the Hydroxy Insect tribe had connections with two Foundation Establishment cultivators, he would have never come here to force a marriage.
What concept was the Foundation Establishment Stage? The lord of the surrounding five-mile radius was an old mountain goat, and every year, whether it was the Hydroxy Insect tribe or the Corpse Insect tribe, they had to pay tribute to the old mountain goat to ask for peace.
This old mountain goat was a Foundation Establishment Stage Great Power!
Meng Jingzhou reached out a hand that seemed like a towering mountain, pressing down towards the Corpse Insect tribe.
Seeing this, Qing Dong desperately resisted, using a secret technique of the Corpse Insect tribe to transform into his original form, temporarily boosting his fighting strength from the early stage of the fourth level of Qi Refinement to the late stage!
"If you kill me, the Goat Clan Leader will not let you off!"
"How noisy. What Goat Clan Leader? Even if it comes, I'll suppress it just the same," Meng Jingzhou fearlessly continued to press down, unbothered by the Goat Clan Leader mentioned by Qing Dong.
Seeing his threat was ineffective, Qing Dong could only struggle for life: "Whirlwind Soaring Heaven Break!"
Qing Dong spun wildly, forming a tiny tornado drill; the green Protective Aura wind swept up, shredding the grass and leaves on the ground, leaving them in tatters. With this skill alone, no one in the Hydroxy Insect tribe could compete.
Qing Dong's eyes reddened as he charged toward the giant hand while screaming.
Unfortunately, before the absolute power of the great hand, all skill was futile; the hand possessed unmatched power, and the Whirlwind Soaring Heaven Break on the palm felt like a mere tickle.
As he faced Qing Dong's attack, Meng Jingzhou's gaze remained undisturbed, and he simply uttered a word softly.
"Suppress."
The Whirlwind Soaring Heaven Break ineffective, Qing Dong was even backlashed, tumbling to the ground, despairingly sensing the gap between himself and a cultivator at the Foundation Establishment Stage.
A Foundation Establishment Great Power, a single hand obscuring the sky.
Meng Jingzhou's hand stopped less than half an inch above Qing Dong's head, then calmly drew back and stood with his hands behind his back. With a magic skill, he whisked up a breeze that lifted his hair and robe.
"Crushing you would be as easy as crushing an insect, simply dirtying my hand,"
"By disturbing my cultivation, this time is merely a lesson. If there's a next time, you will pay with your life."
"Yes, yes, yes."
A Great Power's heart is kind; he did not slay indiscriminately, sparing Qing Dong from death's door. Qing Dong dared not disagree.
The Hydroxy Insect Clan Leader watched, dumbstruck. He had never imagined that these two were Foundation Establishment Great Cultivators, and his small tribe was fortunate enough to forge a connection with two such cultivators. If word spread out, who would dare provoke them?
Chi Shui watched Meng Jingzhou's towering figure with reverence; this was the embodiment of strength he aspired to.
Without such power, how could he ever protect the one he loved most?
He had decided; after this matter, he would temporarily leave the tribe to make his own way in the outside world, to cultivate to the heights of Meng Jingzhou!
"What fellow daoist dares to cause a commotion on my territory, even attempting to commence a massacre on my lands, isn't this going too far?"
An ancient voice came from afar, startling both the Hydroxy Insect Clan Leader and Qing Dong at the same time.
That was the voice of the old mountain goat; the two of them only had the chance to catch a glimpse of it from afar during the mountain goat's birthday feast.
Those who could sit next to the old mountain goat were extraordinary cultivators at the eighth or ninth level of Qi Refinement, among them not a few with the potential to break through to the Foundation Establishment Stage.
The probability was a full ten percent!
An old mountain goat with lustrous fur emerged from the woods, and upon seeing this, both tribes knelt in unison. The old mountain goat ignored the insignificant Insect Race and fixed its gaze on Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
Only cultivators of the same level deserved to converse with him.
He was cultivating when he sensed a dreadful Sword Qi passing through the southern part of his territory in a flash; it was clear that a Foundation Establishment Stage cultivator had entered his domain.
Like the territorial beasts of the dense forest, the Demon Beasts of the Demon Territory possess an even stronger sense of territory; uninvited trespass, without an explanation, can be regarded as a declaration of war.
Three Great Cultivators stood on the earth, and the Insect Race on the ground looked up at the three beings, who were superior to them in both cultivation level and stature, and a sense of awe arose in their hearts.
"Hmph."
Lu Yang snorted coldly.
"I thought it was some formidable existence, but it's just a Foundation Establishment Stage abomination. So what if I kill it, and what if I do not?"
The Sword Qi was even present in Lu Yang's nasal tones, which caused the old goat to shudder.
"This pressure… you are Golden Core Great Powers!"
The old goat cried out in shock, unable to conceal his surprise. Others might not feel it, but he could clearly sense the overwhelming aura emanating from Lu Yang, deep and boundless like an abyss, far beyond what his Foundation Establishment Stage could compare to!
And next to Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou's presence was no less formidable.
"What, they are Golden Core Great Powers?!"
The Clan Leader of the Hydroxy Insect's face changed abruptly, delighted to the point of nearly fainting.
What merit or ability did he have to be qualified to speak with Golden Core Great Masters, to even have a conversation with them through the night?
Such glory was indeed an honor to his ancestors.
"Golden Core Stage!!!"
Qing Dong's legs trembled as he recalled the recent events, at first thinking that Meng Jingzhou had stayed his hand perhaps out of respect for the Goat Clan Leader. But now it seemed that the Goat Clan Leader was nothing in their eyes.
He truly had escaped with his life.
"Great Ancestors gracing us with your presence is an honor we hardly deserve. Would you please Visit our humble abode?" The old goat had shifted to a smiling face, changing his attitude by a full one hundred and eighty degrees, inviting the two as guests.
The old goat had the fortune to meet three or four Golden Core Stage cultivators, but those compared to these two were like the difference between clouds and mud.
Could it be that these two were Mid-stage Golden Core Great Powers?
In which case, it was all the more important to forge good relations.
Even if good relations could not be established, at least a good karma should be secured.
Lu Yang nodded inwardly, recalling that he had said just last night not to show off in front of insects; instead, they should find a Foundation Establishment Stage to impress.
He had intentionally released Sword Qi earlier to attract the old goat.
The plan had gone smoothly.
"There's no need for a visit. We've had a discussion with the Hydroxy Insect tribe, and spending last night here was quite pleasant."
The old goat nodded eagerly: "I also think the Hydroxy Insect tribe is excellent. Although they are of the Insect Race, they have remarkable perseverance; they have a great future ahead. I've wanted to invite the young talents of the Hydroxy Insect tribe to my place many times, but never found the right opportunity."
The old goat understood that this was a hint to protect the Hydroxy Insect tribe.
"Good that you understand. Now leave," Meng Jingzhou waved his hand, dismissing the old goat, who was more than happy to comply.
The Hydroxy Insect tribe also took the opportunity to quickly leave this place of trouble. What if the two Great Cultivators suddenly remembered the incident from before and changed their minds, deciding to kill them?
"Alright, it's time for us to leave as well," Lu Yang stretched lazily. After spending the night in the Hydroxy Insect tribe, he had encountered many novel things.
"Please wait, sirs, I have something to give you."
The Clan Leader of the Hydroxy Insect clenched his teeth and made up his mind. The treasure they had discovered by accident was something their tribe certainly couldn't keep safe; it could easily bring disaster upon them.
Rather than that, it was better to give it to the two saviors.
The warriors of the Hydroxy Insect tribe dug up a Token from the ground and carried it over.
The Token was ancient-looking, with soil still clinging to its surface that hadn't been fully cleaned, clearly a valuable object of antiquity.
"This is…" Lu Yang thought to himself that this was truly good fortune befalling the righteous.
The Clan Leader of the Hydroxy Insect ordered those around to step back, he looked up seriously at Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou and said solemnly:
"This was discovered inadvertently while we were excavating land to establish our tribe. It is said that whoever possesses this Token can open the treasure trove of a Nascent Soul Stage ancestor!"
Even for two Golden Core Stage Great Powers, the treasure trove of a Nascent Soul Stage ancestor should be enticing, right?
Lu Yang: "..."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."

chapters.title: Chapter 566 - 565: The Legendary Token
chapters.content:
"Half-Step Nascent Soul Stage?"
Lu Yang picked up the token, which looked older than both he and Meng Jingzhou combined.
Half-Step Nascent Soul Stage sounds intimidating, just like the Nascent Soul Stage, but, in the end, isn't it just the Golden Core Stage?
With their combat power, except for not being at the Nascent Soul Stage in terms of realm, they met all the other indicators of the Nascent Soul Stage.
Any Nascent Soul Stage cultivators encountering them would have to address them politely as Daoist friends, and if someone were less principled, they might even call them seniors. If it was someone who knew their identities, beseeching for their lives wouldn't be impossible.
A treasure trove from the Half-Step Nascent Soul Stage was frankly useless to them.
They wouldn't even consider something of the Divinity Transformation Stage all that impressive.
Who was Lu Yang? The Young Sect Master of the Heavenly Court Sect, and once again the majority shareholder of a barbecue joint, holding the patent rights to the Flying Car. Saying he made a pot of gold every day wasn't an exaggeration.
Meng Jingzhou, that lethargic heir of a wealthy family, didn't even have the right to compare with him.
Meng Jingzhou also felt that the token wasn't very useful.
As Meng Family's Young Master, boasting that he was the number one profligate son under the heavens wasn't an overstatement, and any trifle he dropped could incite a scramble among Divinity Transformation strongmen.
Compared with Lu Yang, whose luck got him favored by the Eldest Senior Sister and Fairy Eternity, Meng Jingzhou didn't even have the right to compare.
"Then, thank you, Clan Leader."
It was best to accept the goodwill of the Clan Leader.
If outsiders knew that the weak Hydroxy Insect tribe had such an item, it would bring a cataclysm upon them.
"May I ask, how did you know this could open a treasure land of the Half-Step Nascent Soul Stage?"
"What was found with this token was a Demon Race corpse. The flesh and blood of the corpse had been eaten clean by demon beasts, leaving only a skeleton, a piece of paper, and this token — our tribe was established right above this skeleton."
"The paper was akin to a diary, clarifying the purpose of this token: to open the entrance to a treasure land. The owner of the treasure land was a mixed-blood white snake named White Sandalwood Ancestor. However, the location of the treasure land was not indicated."
"I see."
The two didn't ask further; it seemed that the other party didn't know much more about the token, either.
Demon Beasts were a particularly peculiar existence within the Demon Race; they had pure bloodlines but low intelligence or rather, lacked even basic spiritual awareness. And since the power of the Demon Race is founded on the purity of bloodlines, demon beasts are often very powerful.
The cause of their low intelligence, Lu Yang speculated, was a result of inbreeding.
In the Demon Race, marrying between close kin was very common. If in the Great Xia, they wouldn't even be able to get a marriage certificate.
The two set out, heading in the predetermined direction to rendezvous with their Third Senior Sister.
They affixed Godspeed Talismans to their legs, a great item exchanged at the Task Hall, much beloved by the disciples of the Seek Dao Sect.
Since going abroad made it easy to attract trouble, the Godspeed Talisman helped them leave the place of trouble quickly and save their lives.
Using the Godspeed Talisman on the road was also unparalleled.
The Godspeed Talisman, affixed to the calf, generated a force that propelled its user forward, making travel both faster and less tiring.
They sprinted at extreme speeds for an entire day, passing many Foundation Establishment Stage Demon Race tribes along the way. Their presence made such a commotion that many of the elder demons came out to check, but upon seeing their speed, they hurriedly retreated back to their nests in fear.
Just one glance was enough to tell that their cultivation levels were even higher. The Demon Race had many defiant beings; a single look could be taken as an insult, likely to provoke thunderous rage and bring disaster.
This was not a good sign.
"Hm? There are a lot of demon races here, and it doesn't look like a tribe. Is this the market Uncle Ba mentioned?"
The Demon Race didn't have towns, but they often needed to exchange goods, hence the markets came into existence.
Those who could open a market among the Demon Race were often local overlords, possessing absolute crushing strength over the surrounding tribes. As for being good at socializing and networking, that was secondary.
"Let's go take a look."
A Demon Race market, this was also something new to them.
The market was full of shapeshifting demon beasts. According to Immortal Fairy Eternity, this was one of the measures the Five Ancient Immortals used to standardize exchanges—using human forms for communication.
The Demon Race had various types, ranging from the large kind like the Kun Peng, which could grow hundreds of miles in length, to smaller creatures such as the Golden Crow and Jade Rabbit. Not to mention their lack of hands and feet, their habits in eating, clothing, living, and transportation were all different. When the Demon Race mixed together, these problems became even greater.
During the ancient times, numerous disputes arose due to differences in physique and form.
Latter on, the Five Immortals governed the world and established the principle that humans were the standard. When different demon races gathered together, they all transformed into human forms.
The Five Immortals subsequently vanished, but their influence has persisted to this day.
Shapeshifting did not completely mean taking on human forms; taking the Qilin Immortal as an example, many demon races preserved a part of their species characteristics when they transformed, like the Rabbit Race retaining their ears and the Cat Race keeping their tails.
There were also demon beasts that completely transformed into humans, so Lu Yang and his companion didn't stand out in the market area.
"Take a look, take a look, the Dry Qi Elixirs refined by Master Golden Monkey, five hundred Spirit Stones each!"
"What, it's Master Golden Monkey's Elixir! Master Golden Monkey is a master refiner at the Foundation Establishment level with a one-third success rate!"
"Quality guaranteed swords and clubs forged by the Bronze Rhino Tribe, the more you buy, the greater the discount! There's also a magic artifact personally refined by the Clan Leader of the Bronze Rhino Tribe. With it, it's not impossible to defeat a ninth layer Early Stage Qi Cultivation with an eighth layer Early Stage Qi Cultivation!"
"What, such an increase, enough to skip a whole level!"
Lu Yang: "..."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Is this some junk food market? What nonsense are they selling, a one-third success rate, if this were Elixir Cauldron Peak, the Seventh Elder would have beaten someone to death.
And that magic artifact refined by the Clan Leader of the Bronze Rhino Tribe, riddled with impurities and rife with flaws—Lu Yang, who doesn't even know how to refine, could make better ones.
"There aren't many powerful individuals in this market, just a bunch of those in the Qi Cultivation Stage, with the occasional few at the Foundation Establishment Stage."
Both had rich combat experience. With just a glance, they could roughly judge the cultivation levels of the demon races by their walking and breathing methods.
"Forget it, there should be a pawn shop here. Let's just sell the token."
The two found a pawnshop in the busiest part of the market.
Pawnshops seldom opened, but when they did, they could make enough to last half a year. A young lad was dozing off boredly, antlers like those of a water buffalo on his head.
In these past two months, he hadn't received any good items, just worthless trinkets, and the boss had gone to sleep inside the house.
"Guy, help us take a look at how much this token can be sold for."
Lu Yang took out a token from his bosom and handed it to the lad.
The lad wasn't paying much attention at first and gave it a casual glance, but then his eyes were glued to the token and he couldn't look away.
"This... this..."
Seeing the token, the lad's heart skipped a beat.
If this was truly the legendary treasure token, they would strike it rich!
Seeing that Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou's expressions were calm, he thought they probably didn't know the value.
He hurried to call the boss, who was sleeping like the dead.
When the boss heard the lad's description, he bolted upright from bed.
If it was the real deal, they wouldn't need to open the pawnshop for another ten years!
The boss's origins were unknown; he had a pristine white horn on his head and snake scales on his neck, possibly a mixed breed of the Demon Race.
The moment the boss saw the token, his hands trembled, and he nearly dropped it.
This was the notorious treasure token of the White Sandalwood Ancestor!
This was said to belong to the legendary White Sandalwood Ancestor who was only half step away from the Nascent Soul Stage!
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou's eyes twitched slightly. Why, from their reactions, did it seem like the White Sandalwood Ancestor wasn't at half step Nascent Soul Stage, but rather at half step transcending tribulation?

chapters.title: Chapter 567 - 566: You, You are Nascent Soul old monsters!
chapters.content:
Who is Senior White Sandalwood? He is the legendary figure at the Half-Step Nascent Soul stage, a goal countless members of the Demon Race can only hope for but never reach.
You should know that even the marketplace's owners are only at the Illusionary Core stage. When they see Senior White Sandalwood, they have to respectfully call him a senior.
An accident occurred when Senior White Sandalwood was breaking through to the Nascent Soul Stage, resulting in his death and the destruction of his Dao. His Storage Ring shattered, leaving behind only a Token.
Senior White Sandalwood was meticulous in his affairs. He divided his wealth into two parts: one was kept in the Storage Ring, and the other was hidden away, accessible only with the Token.
This Token was fought over by many tribes, changing hands several times, and somehow ended up being buried within the Hydroxy Insect Tribe.
Rumors say that within the treasure trove, there are cultivation insights from Senior White Sandalwood, as well as descriptions about the Mind State needed for breakthroughs. These two items are priceless treasures to Golden Core stage demons, things they would give everything to possess.
The tribes once vigorously searched for the Token but with no clues. Their efforts eventually came to nothing.
The pawnshop owner had not expected the Token to appear here; cold sweat broke out all over him.
He had thought of selling this object to the marketplace owner to seek his protection.
But when he calmed down and thought about it, would the marketplace owner protect him after getting the Token or silence him by killing?
Riches can tempt a demon's heart, and even if the marketplace owner had a good reputation, there was no guarantee he wouldn't commit wrongdoing when driven by profit.
If the Token wasn't sold to the marketplace owner, then it was even less safe to sell it to anyone else.
"Owner, how much is this thing worth in Spirit Stones?" Lu Yang had been waiting and waiting, only to see the owner sweating more and more, without giving any response.
Upon hearing Lu Yang's voice, the owner came out of his daze and hastily returned the Token: "It's worthless, worthless, we won't take it!"
It was an unbearable hot potato, holding onto it meant death.
Lu Yang and his companion felt utterly baffled; did Senior White Sandalwood truly reach the Half-Step Pass Tribulation stage?
After the two had left, the owner furrowed his brows and made a difficult decision.
"What are you doing, boss?" the Water Buffalo Tribe worker shouted.
"To sell information to the marketplace owner."
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou left the marketplace and ran for half a day more. As large Golden Core tribes appeared, the number of marketplaces increased. Without exception, the marketplaces knew the rules of the Demon Territory, not daring to lay hands on the belongings of a Golden Core ancestor.
As the Token frequently showed up in marketplaces, more and more eyes turned towards Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, these two careless fellows.
But these onlookers did not make a move; they were not qualified.
Several Golden Core ancestors had already set their sights on these two, ready to kill them and snatch the Token.
"You two juniors, it looks like you've got your hands on some good stuff," finally, a Golden Core ancestor could no longer hold back, revealing his true form as a green-faced ferocious tiger.
He flew in the sky, coldly looking down on them.
Two little guys who can't even fly, probably only at the Foundation Establishment Stage at best.
Foundation Establishment in front of the Void Pill Realm is nothing but a toy to play with.
"Fellow Daoist, eating alone isn't so nice, is it? Senior White Sandalwood's treasure is so vast, can you really consume it all by yourself?" Three more Golden Core stage demons appeared, intending to join forces to snatch the Token and divide the spoils afterward.
"It's the Serpent Bandit Triad!"
An observer at the Foundation Establishment Stage let out an involuntary cry. These three Golden Core stage demons were infamous for killing and plundering without disguise, and each of them was terrifyingly strong, at the Void Pill Realm. Combined, the three could battle against late Golden Core stage opponents.
"You three little snakes dare to covet that which I have laid my eyes upon!"
In the jungle, a ferocious fire blazed up, several Foundation Establishment cultivators screamed in agony and were burned alive. The figure of a lion with a fiery mane appeared, the local lord and Clan Leader of the Flame Mad Lion Clan.
Then one after another, more Golden Core stage figures appeared. The Foundation Establishment cultivators below watched, astounded, not even daring to breathe too loudly.
All the nearby Golden Core stages had arrived.
"Old lion, you really think you control everything?"
"Let's try and see!"
The Golden Core ancestors glared at each other with animosity, threatening with words, releasing their aura and competing in Realm, attempting to overpower each other in terms of momentum.
They completely ignored the two below them, who were at the Eighth Heaven of Golden Core stage.
"They truly don't take the two of us seriously." Lu Yang sighed.
Lest others think that they were now at the Eighth Heaven of Golden Core stage, even if they were at the late Foundation Establishment stage, these old fellows would still be unimpressive.
"Talk is cheap, let's see the truth in action!"
The old fellows above disregarded Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou entirely and started fighting amongst themselves in the sky.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou yawned; the skills of the old timers were severely lacking, riddled with flaws, making the fight utterly uninteresting. The Golden Core division finals they had seen before were far superior, with any two random contestants fighting better than these people.
In fact, any two randomly selected contestants could beat this group.
"Want to try one?"
While idle, Lu Yang took out two fruit from his Identity Jade. These fruits, bought in the marketplace, were a novel variety and said to be a specialty of the Demon Territory. They had a very short shelf life and spoiled easily, but their taste was unparalleled.
Meng Jingzhou bit into the fruit and juice squirted three meters away.
"Well, I'll be, this taste is really not bad; it's juicy and sweet!" Meng Jingzhou couldn't stop praising the unknown fruit.
Lu Yang thought for a moment, utilizing a water-dividing technique, he instantly turned the fruit into dried fruit. Taking a bite, it lacked the juiciness, but in return, the taste was sweeter.
The two snacked on fruit and dried fruit, waiting for the battle above to end.
As Golden Core Eighth Heaven ancestors, they couldn't just act rashly; masters always make their move at the last moment.
After finishing a few fruits, the fight neared its conclusion.
"Create some water, help me wash my hands," Lu Yang said after finishing the fruit, his hands sticky with residue.
Meng Jingzhou conjured two orbs of water, and they washed their hands. Then they got up, ready to take action.
"Hehe, who would have thought that so many people were after my token,"
Before the two of them could make a move, an ancient voice echoed in the jungle, startling the Flame Mad Lion Clan and others.
They hadn't sensed the other party's presence!
"Who is it!" the Flame Mad Lion roared, just as he was about to win.
"Eyeing the old man's possession and still asking who the old man is?"
A hundred-zhang long white serpent appeared, its eyes murky, hissing as it flicked its tongue.
"I am Bai Tan."
"What?!"
"How can this be possible!"
"The ancestor Bai Tan who was rumored to have fallen eighty years ago?!"
Exclamations rose one after another, whether they be the Golden Core ancestors in the sky or the Foundation Establishment cultivators on the ground, they all looked at the head of ancestor Bai Tan, full of suspicion and disbelief.
Ancestor Bai Tan was hidden in another space, which meant he could initially manipulate the power of space.
This was a symbol of the Nascent Soul Stage!
Ancestor Bai Tan was already a monster at the Nascent Soul Stage!
"The Nascent Soul Stage isn't enough, it's just that I failed my advancement eighty years ago and obtained a little insignificant benefit," ancestor Bai Tan modestly said with a smile, but no one dared to take his humility for real.
A failed advancement that resulted in gaining the power of space—what terrifying talent was that!
"So many at the Golden Core Stage, enough to concoct a furnace of Infant Transformation Pills! Plus, the treasures unlocked by the token, there's a seventy percent chance to advance to the Nascent Soul," ancestor Bai Tan said greedily, his tongue flickering.
Eighty years ago his realm failed to advance, and his situation was extremely bad. Worried he would become vulnerable to his enemies taking advantage of his weakness, he faked his death to escape, preserving his life. To make the faked death convincing, he even left behind his token.
Unfortunately, the token changed hands too frequently, and during the back and forth, he lost track of it, filled with regret.
That was his hope for the second break-through to the Nascent Soul Stage.
Fortunately, heaven does not seal off all exits. Yesterday he heard that two little demons got hold of the token, asking around for its price.
A heaven-sent opportunity.
The appearance of the token would surely attract many at the Golden Core Stage. With the numbers too great, even he would not be able to handle them all. He could only wait until the fight was over and they were exhausted before making a strong appearance to wrap things up.
"What a scheme, lying in wait for eighty years, using these two juniors as bait, inducing us to fight each other, both suffering injury, so you could benefit from it." The Flame Mad Lion fixed his gaze upon Bai Tan, deliberately stalling for time while secretly preparing a backup plan, activating a magical talisman that would allow for a short spatial jump to escape this place.
Bai Tan appeared undisturbed by the Flame Mad Lion's actions, to him, these Golden Core cultivators were already dead men.
He had disrupted the space; none of the Golden Core cultivators could escape.
This was the difference between a Half Step Nascent Soul Stage and the Golden Core Stage.
It was time to take back what belonged to him.
Ancestor Bai Tan opened his wide maw and pounced on Lu Yang and another person.
"You two little fellows, hand over the old ancestor's token nicely. As a reward, the old ancestor will let you die without feeling any pain,"
Lu Yang said nothing, silently extending a finger. A barely visible Sword Qi gathered at his fingertips, and then, he made a light swipe towards Bai Tan.
A tiny line appeared on the serpent's tongue.
Snap.
A piece of the serpent's tongue fell to the ground, sizzling, highly poisonous.
An extremely fine line appeared on Bai Tan's lower jaw as well.
It too fell to the ground.
"Flying up there must be tiresome; come down, everyone."
Meng Jingzhou chuckled lightly and activated the Shocking Heaven Six Forms, swinging a full circle.
The space trembled, and the Golden Core cultivators fell like dumplings, full of terror.
Ancestor Bai Tan even more so crashed to the ground with a thunderous sound, toppling who knows how many trees.
He couldn't care about the pain in his body; the situation in front of him was even more panic-inducing.
In Bai Tan's eyes, Lu Yang and the other person became increasingly huge. He screamed in fright, his voice shaking, his body shivering uncontrollably, a chill emerging from the depths of his soul.
"Condensing Qi into swords, one punch shattering the heavens—you, you are Nascent Soul old monsters!!!"
He had thought he was the hunter in the mantis stalking the cicada scenario, unwitting of the oriole behind.
He had never imagined that these two little demons were Nascent Soul old monsters!
"What, they're actually Nascent Soul old monsters!"
"Why would Nascent Soul old monsters take part in such trifling affairs?"
"Hush, do you want to anger the Nascent Soul old monsters?"
Everyone was chilled to the bone; Nascent Soul old monsters were fickle and all-powerful, each one a great demon renowned in their own right.
Lu Yang: "..."
Although he knew it was easy to bluff in the Demon Territory, he hadn't expected to succeed so effortlessly.
Is this the Cultivation World that Eldest Senior Sister talked about?

chapters.title: Chapter 568 - 567: Fragments
chapters.content:
```
The notorious old demons, who usually called the shots, were trembling with fear, not even daring to breathe heavily.
The Nascent Soul elders, who were rarely seen, a sight not expected for years on end, were not only seen this time but two at once.
"This token is yours, isn't it?" Lu Yang casually swung the token by its cord and asked.
"Yes... no no no, it's yours, Your Excellency!"
"I've heard the token can open up a treasure site, is that true? What have you hidden away?" Meng Jingzhou was curious; with such grand preparations, there must be something valuable.
"It's true, within the treasure site are my written insights on cultivation and materials needed for the next attempt at reaching the Nascent Soul Stage."
Ever since the loss of the token, Elder Sandalwood had secretly spread rumors in hopes of luring others to help him find the token.
"That's it?"
Half-Step Nascent Soul cultivation insights? The Seek Dao Sect's Scripture Pavilion had several shelves full of them; you could look at them whenever you wanted. Elder Sandalwood's half-baked cultivation insights weren't even worthy of shelf space.
As for the materials needed to reach the Nascent Soul Stage, they were even less significant.
The Seek Dao Sect didn't even have a tradition for what materials were needed for the break core to reach Nascent.
"Your Excellency, I truly didn't know who you were, and if I had known, I wouldn't have dared to do this even with ten thousand times the courage!" Elder Sandalwood was so full of regret he could die, banging his head on the ground fiercely, wishing he could knock his head off.
The other old demons followed suit, knocking their heads on the ground to show their loyalty.
Honestly, Lu Yang and his companion had never seen anything like this since they had set out on their journey.
It was truly satisfying.
Fairy Eternity popped up and seized the moment to broaden Lu Yang's horizons. "Hey, this is nothing. Back when I casually visited the mortal world in disguise, I often encountered such things."
"Generally, the other party would start by saying they're not easy to bully, bringing out their backing to show how formidable it is. After defeating their backing, they'd bring out the backing's backing and so on and so forth.
Eventually, the ultimate backing would appear, and passersby would often introduce them, saying they're underlings of the underlings of someone from Ying Tian Immortal, extraordinarily powerful and with direct access to Immortals."
"And then, upon meeting me, the big shot would stutter, saying, 'It's... it's you' 'Forgive my blindness, please absolve my sins, Immortal' 'Spare this small one just this once,' while slapping themselves across the face and fiercely knocking their heads on the ground, wishing they could shatter planets, sometimes even killing their own kin who had caused the trouble."
"When the big shot starts knocking their head on the ground, others would follow, all at once, a sea of people, a sight to behold."
"In the end, I would mete out punishment based on the severity of their crimes, sometimes ending them directly, sometimes ruining their foundation, or imposing other punishments."
"Sadly, your cultivation level isn't high enough yet, so you can't witness such scenes," Fairy Eternity said with a click of her tongue, expressing regret for Lu Yang. That was a treatment only Immortals could enjoy.
Lu Yang looked at the spiritual space that had turned into a tropical rainforest, feeling quite helpless.
Since arriving in the Demon Territory, Fairy Eternity appropriately transformed the once delicate Spiritual Space with a shake of her body; towering trees shot up from the ground, lush and leafy. She often lay on the trees to sleep, never falling off.
Now, she'd set up a swing, wearing ankle socks as she swung back and forth, her crystalline little feet swaying.
"So, Fairy, what happened when you encountered those troublemakers before you became an Immortal?"
"There are generally two outcomes in those situations."
"What are the two outcomes?"
"One is if the opponent's cultivation level is higher than mine and I can't beat them at the time, I can only run away."
"The other is even if the opponent's cultivation is not as high as mine, I usually end up being chased due to a stroke of fate."
```
"Sometimes when there are too many pursuers, they even start fighting among themselves. Fairy Eternity here encountered it two or three times. They surrounded me, blocking me from all sides, and I was unable to escape. Disagreements over who would get to kill me led them to fight each other, and I took the opportunity to flee amidst the chaos."
Lu Yang: "..."
Fairy, your experiences are quite bizarre.
"How should we deal with this bunch of old demons?" Meng Jingzhou asked in a low voice.
This group of old demons are ruthlessly brutal, and they definitely have blood on their hands. According to the laws of Great Xia, they all deserve the death penalty.
But this is the Demon Territory, and it's just how things are done here. They can't enforce the jurisdiction of another area and apply the laws of Great Xia onto them; the Immortal Sect's law enforcement power isn't used like that.
Besides, if they were all killed, the territories they govern would descend into chaos, inevitably leading to conflict and the death of many innocent members of the Demon Race.
Suddenly, the glorious serpentine imprint on the forehead of Elder Baitan flashed, casting out a Spiritual Sense projection that stunned all the demons present except for Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
A splendidly decorated white snake appeared, looking much younger than Elder Baitan and radiating a more vigorous life force.
"Who are you?"
"I am Baigu of the White Snake Clan, salutations to the two fellow Daoists. This Baitan is a clone of mine; I had planned to recall this clone after it reached the Nascent Soul Stage to help me ascend to the Spirit Transformation Stage. It seems Baitan encountered a life-threatening situation and thus activated the imprint I left."
"I implore the two fellow Daoists to spare Baitan's life. As a token of gratitude, I offer this fragment to you two!"
Lu Yang had heard of this kind of cultivation method before, where one refines a clone, and the achievements of the clone are reflected onto the original body. Female cultivators who practice the Dual Cultivation method also use this technique to impersonate twins, which not only adds interest but also accelerates their cultivation progress.
"What is this object?"
"It's said that there are three pieces of this fragment in total. When combined, they form the key to a Secret Realm. Unfortunately, I've never been able to find the other two pieces. I observe that the two fellow Daoists are deeply fortunate and will surely accomplish great things. You will definitely be able to find the other two fragments."
Before Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou could reply, an imprint also flashed on the forehead of the green-faced tiger, projecting a Spiritual Sense image.
A majestic tiger with stripes and two wings appeared, its face fierce, clearly startled upon seeing the green-faced tiger unconscious.
He looked around and, upon seeing Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, and Baigu, bowed with a fist and said, "I am a manager of the Qiongqi Clan. This is my unworthy son; I don't know what he did to offend the two of you, but please show mercy and spare his life."
"As a recompense, I offer this fragment to you two."
"It's said that this fragment serves as the key to a Divinity Transformation Stage Secret Realm. Unfortunately, despite years of searching, I've never been able to find the remaining pieces. Could I exchange my son's life for this piece?"
The flame imprint on the forehead of the Blazing Flame Wild Lion flared, and an old lion, his eyelids nearly failing to stay open, realized it was Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou's doing when he saw the most outstanding member of his clan unconscious.
He was the elder of the Wild Lion Clan, and the Blazing Flame Wild Lion was the member he most believed in, which was why he supported him to become the Clan Leader.
He couldn't just watch as the Blazing Flame Wild Lion was killed.
The old lion produced a piece of fragment.
"This is a fragment I chanced upon, and gathering three pieces forms the key to a Divinity Transformation Stage Secret Realm. May I trade it for his life?"
Lu Yang: "..."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
"Why don't you three see if the fragments in your hands can be pieced together?"

chapters.title: Chapter 569 - 568 Third Senior Sister
chapters.content:
The atmosphere suddenly became awkward.
When the first shard appeared, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had originally planned on claiming it. After all, it was from a Divinity Transformation Stage secret realm, which could very well contain treasures unidentified even by cultivators of that stage, left within the secret realm.
Assembling the shards wasn't easy; the White Snake Clan's Bone Collector had searched for many years without finding the other two pieces, so Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were prepared to spend a year or perhaps even longer in the Demon Territory, slowly gathering them.
A year or so later, the two would rightly reach the Nascent Soul Stage, and to break into a Divinity Transformation Stage secret realm would only make sense.
What neither of them expected was that in less than a minute, they had all the pieces.
"Bone Collector, Jin Xuan, so the other two shards were in your possession!" the old lion erupted in fury, suddenly opening his eyes wide, his gaze burning like torches, his fur bristling.
"Old lion, have you no shame? You hid that piece quite well!" Jin Xuan, who was also the Qiongqi Clan's Manager, was equally enraged.
He had searched for the other two shards for over a hundred years all over the Demon Territory, nearly running his legs off, only to find the piece was right under his nose the whole time.
Even through the projection of his Spiritual Sense, Lu Yang could feel the killing intent emanating from the three.
Bringing together the three shards could open a Divinity Transformation Stage secret realm, which was worth more than any Clone, illegitimate child, or talented junior—it was absolutely not something to be given up!
The three shards, sensing each other's presence, began to tremble violently before shooting out, quickly converging above Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
"This is bad!" The three old demons of the Demon Race turned pale with shock, not expecting the shards to fly out of their control and toward Lu Yang!
An opportunity that had fallen into their hands was not to be surrendered; such generosity did not exist in the Demon Territory!
"Don't panic—the key may be in their hands, but if they don't know the location of the secret realm, it's futile!" Bone Collector sneered, for what good was the key if one didn't know where the door was?
Even he didn't know the location of the secret realm.
"The most pressing matter right now is to intercept those two quickly and snatch the key back!" All three of them were great demons in the late stage of the Nascent Soul, and they refused to believe they couldn't overcome these two Nascent Soul Stage lads!
"You're right." The other two demons agreed, realizing they had panicked.
The three shards collided above the heads of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, forming a white jade disk. A white light appeared under their feet, corresponding with the pattern on the disk!
Boom—
The ground cracked, rumbling continuously, until the pair swiftly leapt aside.
"The secret realm is right beneath their feet!" Bone Collector's eyes bulged with fury, almost bleeding with anger.
"Hurry up and call in the Divinity Transformation Stage you know—we three alone can't stop these two!" Bone Collector shouted, it was easier to win three against two, but difficult to catch them.
Originally, he thought there was plenty of time—if they were caught multiple times, they'd eventually be captured. But now that the secret realm was right under their nose, there was no time to catch them multiple times.
They needed to urgently call for help from the Divinity Transformation Stage; even if the Divinity Transformation Stage got the lion's share, they'd still be able to partake in the spoils.
Without hesitation, the three old demons dispersed their Spiritual Sense projections and sought out acquaintances in the Divinity Transformation Stage.
Bone Collector and Jin Xuan had it easier; their backers in their respective clans were of the Divinity Transformation Stage, while the old lion needed to seek help from other places.
"Is this the key to opening the secret realm?" Lu Yang pointed at the floating white jade disk above him, looking puzzled.
"Judging by their reaction, yes," Meng Jingzhou's expression was equally priceless.
Within moments, an eight-hundred-li radius was enveloped by turmoil—as if someone had leaked the news, or perhaps a Divinity Transformation Stage worried about being outcompeted had called in friends and acquaintances to help, leading countless Divinity Transformation Stage beings to the opening of the secret realm.
Many in the Divinity Transformation Stage became interested in a secret realm left by someone of their own level.
It might contain treasures that could aid in elevating their realm, and cultivation techniques left by those at the same level also held significant value.
Whoosh—whoosh—whoosh—
One after another, enigmatic figures wielding tremendous power and of various shapes—all from the Divinity Transformation Stage of the Demon Race—appeared.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou swallowed hard; facing one or two Divinity Transformation Stage beings, they might not be in mortal danger, as they could flee if they couldn't fight.
But facing a swarm of Divinity Transformation Stage beings was a different story—then none of their Nascent Soul Stage talents would be of any use.
"The white jade disk is in the hands of these juniors?" A late-stage Divinity Transformation Qiongqi with glaring fangs looked coldly at Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
"To answer the senior, yes, it's these two!" Jin Xuan bowed his head, kneeling on the ground.
A giant white snake coiled in the sky, with two bulges on its head, seemingly on the verge of transforming into a dragon!
He was a Divinity Transformation Stage being from the White Snake Clan who Bone Collector had summoned.
The celestial wolf capable of swallowing the moon, the giant ape who could walk while carrying mountains...
One Divinity Transformation Stage being after another appeared, leaving Bone Collector, Jin Xuan, and the old lion three demons shaken with fear. Any one of these beings could sweep the three of them aside and could forcibly take over their territories without much resistance from them—they didn't even dare to fart too loudly.
Such was the power of being an entire realm apart!
Among the three demons, Jin Xuan was the strongest, possessing the strength just Half Step away from the Divinity Transformation Stage; but here, he also had to keep his head down and behave humbly, not daring to draw too much attention to himself.
The Golden Core elders and Foundation Establishment demons who had been knocked unconscious began to regain consciousness, only to wish they could lapse back into unconsciousness upon seeing those Divinity Transformation Stage beings in the sky.
Divinity Transformation Stage dragons are so rare to be seen; it could be decades before one shows up. How long were they unconscious, what happened, and how did so many of the Divinity Transformation Stage appear?
Was it their lifespans that were exhausted to exchange for this one opportunity?
"It's a bit tricky, if only I'd known, I would have carried Old Ma here." Meng Jingzhou clicked his tongue, "How about you show them a round of Eldest Senior Sister's Imitation Fist?"
Originally they were just showing off in front of the Golden Core members of the Demon Race, but how did they end up gathering so many from the Divinity Transformation Stage?
This is not following the script, where's the transition through the Nascent Soul Stage?
At the very least, let the two of them kill a few Nascent Soul Stage members before leading to the Divinity Transformation Stage, that would be something.
Lu Yang showed a troubled expression: "Third Senior Sister is still unaccounted for; wouldn't it be a little inappropriate to call Eldest Senior Sister over?"
They had come to assist Third Senior Sister in her archeological research, not to sweep through the Demon Territory.
Just as Lu Yang and his company did not take this group of Divinity Transformation Stage members seriously, those members also did not regard Lu Yang and his company highly.
They were merely two slightly talented juniors at the Golden Core Stage, hardly significant.
"Let's kill these two juniors first, then we can talk about exploring the Secret Realm."
"Alright."
The Divinity Transformation Stage members quickly came to an agreement, their aura turbulent and their killing intent unrestrained.
Lu Yang sighed; there was no other way; they had to force an invitation to the Eldest Senior Sister.
Thud—
Suddenly, a pleasant sound of a zither echoed through the sky, tingling like a stream striking against stones, inexplicably comforting and calming the restless hearts.
"Did I allow you to kill?"
As the zither music ceased, a figure in green appeared in front of Lu Yang, blocking all murderous intents directed at him.
The figure in green cradled an ancient zither, her posture lazy and looks stunningly beautiful, eyes covered with a black cloth, adding a touch of mystery.
"It's her!"
"Damn it, how could it be her!"
"Isn't she currently being hunted by various clans, yet she dares to show her face?!"
The pupils of those in the Divinity Transformation Stage shrunk, agitated and looking towards the green-clad figure with a combination of fear and disbelief, as a wave of terror spread among them.
This was a formidable figure even those in the Body Integration Realm could not handle, not someone they at the Divinity Transformation Stage could mess with!
"Run!"
Without hesitation, those in the Divinity Transformation Stage fled.
Clang!
The plucking of the zither strings vibrated the space, immobilizing everyone in mid-air, unable to move even a finger, fear unmistakably etched in their eyes.
"Did I say you could run?"
"Third Senior Sister?" Lu Yang asked tentatively, his tone carrying a hint of joy.
He had seen portraits of Third Senior Sister before.
"It's me."
"Senior Sister, how did you get here? We were just saying we need to find you!"
They were still hundreds of miles away from the location Third Senior Sister had given them.
Third Senior Sister spoke with a tone of helplessness.
"Eldest Senior Sister sent me a message, saying that it's unlikely you two would honestly come to find me. If there were any major disturbances in these few days, it likely would have been caused by you two. She told me to come to your aid, to prevent any accidents."
"How did you two manage to draw in so many from the Divinity Transformation Stage?"
Lu Yang said cautiously: "...If I said it was all a coincidence, would you believe me?"
"I do."
"You do?"
Lu Yang was overjoyed, not expecting the Third Senior Sister he had never met to trust him so much.
"Mmm, that's what I always tell Eldest Senior Sister when I cause trouble in the Demon Territory."
(Wishing you smooth sailing with the postgraduate exam, success in reaching the shore)

chapters.title: Chapter 570 - 569: A Ready-Made Gift
chapters.content:
```
Those in the Spirit Transformation Stage, even the least among the different races, are considered a core force with considerable say; even more so, some are the chieftains of their clans. Many from the Nascent Soul Stage come to join them, wielding overwhelming power. Such a combined force can roam and dominate the Demon Territory unchallenged, ignoring all rules.
——In the eyes of Foundation Establishment cultivators and Golden Core ancestors, those in the Spirit Transformation Stage are like heaven.
But those in the Spirit Transformation Stage know that compared to true cultivators, they are but mere ants.
Just like now, the legendary Fairy of Demon Sound appeared, and with a mere single move, she fixed them all in the sky, unable to move a fraction. They could only watch helplessly as the three people below talked and laughed freely, without a single thing they could do about it.
"When I previously traveled in the Demon Territory, many accidents occurred, all of which Eldest Senior Sister helped me with. Now, my cultivation level is different from before; I no longer need Eldest Senior Sister and can handle it all on my own,"
Third Senior Sister laughed, saying this is what growth is.
"As for you all..."
Third Senior Sister turned her head; even though her eyes were covered, she could still keenly observe the outside world.
"You all have struggled through the Demon Territory for so many years; you understand the rules here. The slayer shall be slain; you made your move against my junior brother, so there is no need for you to remain alive."
"Wait..."
The Qiongqi Clan desperately tried to break free, attempting to beg for mercy, but just as one of them uttered a word, Third Senior Sister once again plucked the strings of her zither.
The sound waves transformed into invisible fine threads, slicing apart the beings of the Spirit Transformation Stage and the Nascent Soul Stage in the sky into pieces, with chunks of their flesh falling pitter-patter to the ground, a bloody mess.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou swallowed hard; Third Senior Sister was truly ruthless when she took action.
"What's the big deal? That's how people were killed during ancient times," Fairy Eternity stepped forward as a witness. The Demon Territory of ancient times was even more dangerous than now, with countless cultivators and members of the Demon Race falling every day.
The Foundation Establishment and Golden Core Stage cultivators of the Demon Race who had just awakened were dumbfounded. The noble beings of the Spirit Transformation Stage were slaughtered so effortlessly; their minds couldn't process such immense information for a moment.
After a few seconds, a demon screamed out and ran away frantically from the place, and the remaining members of the Demon Race, as if waking from a dream, also fled one after another.
It didn't matter where they ran, as long as they could get away from here!
Third Senior Sister had little interest in these minions, letting them leave as they pleased.
With the rabble dead or gone, Third Senior Sister continued to observe Lu Yang, noting his solid foundation with some emotion.
She unfolded a dining cloth and laid it on the ground, gesturing for the two of them to sit down without being too formal.
"You've made quick progress in cultivation. I heard that when you entered our master's gate, it just so happened that master disappeared. It was Eldest Senior Sister who personally instructed you; you're really lucky."
"I too wish to be taught by Eldest Senior Sister, but alas, I missed the opportunity."
"I asked Eldest Senior Sister to send someone well-versed in ancient history from our sect, but instead, she sent you here. I did not expect that at such a young age, you would become an ancient history scholar recognized by Eldest Senior Sister."
Lu Yang offered a smile: "It's all luck, just luck."
Third Senior Sister waved her hand, encouraging Lu Yang, "How can it be called luck? Don't belittle yourself. Luck is only a part, your achievements today must also come from effort."
Lu Yang thought about it, and indeed it was true. If he hadn't strived to pass Fairy's trials, he wouldn't have survived to this day.
Third Senior Sister then turned to Meng Jingzhou with a slightly teasing tone, "If he is Lu Yang, then you must be the young master of the Meng Family?"
```
"Eldest Senior Sister mentioned that you, with your Single Body Spiritual Root, are brave enough to innovate and advance, forming two Single Golden Elixirs and even mastering Nirvana True Fire to speed up your cultivation, completely fearless of a weak will leading you astray into the Demon Path. Even Demonic Cultivators wouldn't dare to do this.
Just for this pursuit of the Immortal Dao in your heart, you have surpassed everyone else!"
"As your Senior Sister, it was a bit rushed the first time we met, and I didn't have a suitable gift ready for you. So, I'll open this Secret Realm and take you two to find some good things."
As a Senior Sister should, I can't let them down.
The entrance to the Secret Realm was right beneath their feet, and she moved the floating white jade disc into her grasp,
"This Secret Realm should have been left by a member of the Suan Ni of the Divinity Transformation Stage, who back then was also a renowned talent within the Demon Territory, full of pride and unruliness, who destroyed several small tribes based on his whims. Unfortunately, he later provoked a powerful existence that should not have been provoked.
The strong enemy attacked, and the Suan Ni was defeated, dying in the north. His defensive treasure, the white jade disc, was shattered by the powerful enemy into three pieces and scattered across the Demon Territory."
Third Senior Sister sighed, "I've also tried to find the fragments of the white jade disc but never succeeded, so the matter was left unresolved. I didn't expect that today you two little fellows would have assembled the white jade disc."
"...Yeah, I didn't expect to be able to assemble the white jade disc either."
Lu Yang, with a clear conscience, could say he did nothing—the white jade disc came to him on its own.
"Senior Sister, don't all Secret Realms have realm restrictions? Can you enter a Secret Realm at the level of Spirit Transformation?"
Third Senior Sister shook her head, "What you are referring to are Secret Realms left as fortune for future generations, with realm restrictions set. In those realms, descendants can gain rewards after passing trials, but this Secret Realm is Suan Ni's own personal treasury. As long as it can be opened, one can enter and exit freely without any restrictions."
"So that's how it is."
"Fortune-giving Secret Realms are quite rare in the Demon Territory, but they are more common in Great Xia, so it's not your fault that you have this misconception."
"Why are they common in Great Xia?"
"There are two reasons. One is that some Cultivators value affinity, preparing for their future cultivation. If descendants benefit from their Secret Realm, they form a good connection with them, which could reduce the harm they suffer when Passing Thunder Tribulation."
"And the second reason?"
"Great Xia imposes inheritance tax, and some Cultivators don't want to pay it, opting to set up Secret Realms for the destined ones. That counts as a gift and isn't taxed."
Lu Yang: "..."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Third Senior Sister weighed the white jade disc in her hand, "This disc is actually quite useful, but it's too high-level for you to use. Why don't I just give this disc to you two?"
She couldn't, like the Eldest Senior Sister, place several layers of seals on the white jade disc, to be unlocked one by one as Lu Yang's cultivation level increased.
The entrance to the Secret Realm was a black vortex dotted with starlight. Anyone who rashly entered without the key, even if not torn apart by the vortex, would be sent to unknown places, which is very dangerous.
Third Senior Sister seemed to know how to use the white jade disc just like that, activating it, connecting the white jade disc and the entrance to the Secret Realm, and then with a gentle twist, the entrance to the Secret Realm opened.
"All set."
"Senior Sister, you seem to be very familiar with how to use the white jade disc?" Lu Yang asked uncertainly.
"What about it, I observed that Suan Ni using this disc when we fought, and just watching a few times was enough to learn."
"...So, the Suan Ni was killed by you?"
"Did I not mention that? Oh right, I said he provoked a powerful enemy, it's all the same."

chapters.title: Chapter 571 - 570: Enjoying the Treatment of Daoist Buyu in Advance
chapters.content:
"When I first came to the Demon Territory, I was unfamiliar with the place, and that Suan Ni thought I was easy to bully, wanting to take liberties with me. In a fit of rage, I slew it. That Suan Ni was the pride of their race and being killed by me in front of all their geniuses, it was a huge disgrace. Naturally, the Suan Ni clan wouldn't let it go, and I had to flee for a long time."
"What happened after that?"
"Later, I asked Eldest Senior Sister to help me fight back, and now the Suan Ni clan has quieted down a lot, at least on the surface," Third Senior Sister said with a laugh. Now, there were quite a few people chasing after her, perhaps including assassins sent secretly by the Suan Ni clan.
Lu Yang heard that Third Senior Sister had entered the Demon Territory at the Divinity Transformation Stage, easily killing a genius of the same level from the Demon Race, and even managed to escape the pursuit of the Suan Ni clan. That was no simple feat.
The three entered the Secret Realm, where yellow sand filled the sky, and twisters carried boulders within, a certain death for anyone caught in them.
The wind was so strong that Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou almost got carried away.
And in the sandstorm, visibility was very low, making it hard to extend one's Spiritual Sense.
"This is a Wind-Calming Pearl, you both take one," Third Senior Sister gave each of them a green jade pearl. Holding the pearl, their bodies felt lighter as if there was no wind around them, allowing them to walk freely.
"It's not that there's no wind around, but the Wind-Calming Pearl releases wind in the opposite direction, which counteracts and neutralizes the wind around you," Fairy Eternity explained offhandedly.
"The innate abilities of the Suan Ni lie in wind and fog. These two Wind-Calming Pearls were likely refined from Suan Ni skulls."
"What treasures."
"You two follow me closely, otherwise it's very easy to get lost," Third Senior Sister loudly reminded.
"Third Senior Sister, can you see the path ahead?"
"Not see, but feel. After coming to the Demon Territory, I covered my eyes to train my other senses and not rely on eyesight or Spiritual Sense anymore."
As one's Cultivation Level increases, a cultivator's senses and Spiritual Sense become much sharper, but to further advance, relying solely on the improvements brought about by increased cultivation is insufficient; deliberate training is necessary.
"Senior Sister, did you decide to train your four senses after seeing the fog in the Central Continent and the Demon Territory?" Meng Jingzhou thought of the fog before entering the Demon Territory.
"Right, the fog was an awakening for me."
"Then Senior Sister, do you know why the Demon Territory was erected on the Central Continent, and what's the situation with the East Sea and Buddha Country to the extreme north?"
"I knew you would ask this. Time is tight right now. I'll explain it slowly after we get out."
"Time is tight?"
"Yeah, if those old folks realize I'm showing my face here, they'll definitely send someone to kill me. It's best for us to leave the Secret Realm before they arrive."
"Senior Sister, did you expose your identity as a disciple of the Seek Dao Sect?" Meng Jingzhou, as a cultivator who held the dual identity of being both a disciple of the Seek Dao Sect and Meng Family's Young Master, was always cautious of his own safety, heeding Uncle Ba's warning.
"Not really, I'm being hunted for my own abilities," Third Senior Sister said while casually playing her ancient zither, deflecting the incoming boulders with ease and enjoying herself.
"We've arrived."
The three arrived at a stone chamber, which was surrounded by an unnamed Array Method that blocked out the sandstorm and twisters, as peaceful as if it were a world cut off from the rest."
In front of the stone chamber lay two stone statues carved in the likeness of Suan Ni. Sensing the approach of strangers, the statues assumed a defensive stance, ready to attack.
Third Senior Sister, without even a glance, smashed the Suan Ni statues with a couple of slaps, picking up two half-finished keys from within the statues, joining them to form a complete key, and unlocked the stone chamber.
Lu Yang's eyes narrowed; these two Suan Ni statues were not simple, able to unleash a fighting force comparable to the early stages of Spirit Transformation in a short time. If he and Meng Jingzhou had come to the Secret Realm by themselves, just these two statues alone could have caused them much trouble.
"Indeed, this is a place only those at the Nascent Soul Stage could enter."
The great doors of the stone chamber thunderously opened, revealing a small pile of Spirit Stones and several books on Intercourse Cultivation Techniques.
The Suan Ni clan, being a branch of the Long Clan, inherited the Long Clan's inherently lascivious nature, addicts of Intercourse Cultivation. The Suan Ni initially began to trouble Third Senior Sister based on these reasons.
Besides, there were all sorts of rare and exotic treasures, dazzling to the eyes.
Meng Jingzhou picked up a bronze-colored fruit. As he held it, it felt like jade, cool to the touch, and he could sense the vitality contained within the fruit.
"Is this Mu Bai Jin Yu?"
Mu Bai Jin Yu, a heavenly treasure that has existed since ancient times, has extremely harsh conditions for its formation. Only a spiritual plant that has developed spiritual intelligence and absorbs the energy of Wu Jin through its roots can bear this fruit, which is greatly beneficial to cultivators with a Golden Spirit Root, enhancing their vitality and control over metal.
As far as Meng Jingzhou knew, only the Five Elements Sect had this type of fruit, which grew on spiritual plants rooted in the Golden Meridians, and the yield was very limited.
"Could it be that this Suan Ni killed a disciple of the Five Elements Sect, a case of murder and plunder..."
"I don't think so," said Lu Yang, who was nearby.
"Why?"
