Lu Yang picked up a piece of paper nearby and shook it, "This is a purchase receipt from the Five Elements Sect. If there's a problem with the quality, it can be returned."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
How can your Five Elements Sect operate more formally than our Meng Family?
Lu Yang picked up another piece of paper: "This is an IOU from the Suan Ni. To buy the Mu Bai Jin Yu, he borrowed quite a sum from the merchants, likely turning into bad debt now."
The Suan Ni did not possess Qin Haoran's ability and couldn't transfer causality and debt onto anyone who took it.
This Suan Ni was merely one of the geniuses of its clan, where the competition was fierce; some things had to be earned, fought for, or borrowed by themselves!
"Then it's perfect, take this fruit for yourself, it can enhance your Sword Qi," said Meng Jingzhou as he tossed the fruit to Lu Yang.
"Alright, quickly collect it with the Identity Jade. Once we get out, we can pick at leisure," said the Third Senior Sister, with her wealth of experience being chased, sensing that it was almost time to leave or it would be too late.
On hearing this, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou activated their Identity Jades and swept the Suan Ni's legacy clean.
"Let's go."
The Third Senior Sister took out a piece of beast skin and let the other two sit on it before she stared at the sandstorm and rushed out of the Secret Realm.
Boom!
No sooner had the three rushed out of the Secret Realm than they were viciously attacked. The beast skin wobbled precariously, nearly causing them to fall off.
"Demon Music Fairy, let's see where you can run today!"
"Hand over your life!"
"You've done enough evil deeds, you're sure to be executed today!"
Several cultivators at the Body Integration Realm were blocking the exit of the Secret Realm, their stored power attacks all bombarding the beast skin, startling Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
Both of them were only at the Golden Core Stage, so why were they prematurely suffering the treatment meant for Daoist Buyu?
The attack continued, and the beast skin was riddled with holes, its occupants gradually becoming translucent.
"Not good, this is an illusion created by the mirage bead!"
"You think you can catch me?"
As the illusion shattered, the Third Senior Sister sneered and turned into a streak of light, seizing the chance to break out of the encirclement.
In this moment, she was reminded of the first lesson from Daoist Buyu.
"Xiao Gan, as my third disciple, the first thing you must learn is how to escape,"
The teachings of Daoist Buyu had helped her survive against all odds on multiple occasions, playing a crucial role.

chapters.title: Chapter 572 - 571 Immortal's Secret Technique!
chapters.content:
"Stop, don't let her get away!"
"Die!"
"Kill her!"
A group of monsters from the Demon Race at the Unification Realm bellowed from behind, their bloodlines stimulated to the extreme, their innate divine abilities pouring down like rain, exploding in the air, the ground roaring, forests collapsing in swathes, and dust shooting into the air.
Whoosh—
The Third Senior Sister deftly maneuvered the beast hide, shooting out of the dust clouds, leaving her pursuers in the dust.
She didn't forget to reassure Lu Yang and another, soothingly saying, "Don't be afraid, Junior Brothers. I have learned the art of flying from the Fifth Elder. Although I am not as skilled as that old man, it is more than enough to shake off these people."
Consciously setting up a barrier on the beast hide to block the impact of the wind, the Third Senior Sister was aware that the extreme speed was still unbearable for those at the Golden Core Stage.
Moreover, the flight path of the Third Senior Sister was not something ordinary people could endure. To put it nicely, it was like a butterfly fluttering gracefully. To put it bluntly, it was like twirling crazily like a tornado, which was more ferocious than the unification of Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, and Man Gu.
Fortunately, the two had prior experience riding the Fifth Elder's flying shuttle at breakneck speeds, so they didn't pass out on the spot.
Along the way, the Third Senior Sister continually unleashed attacks behind her, mixing real with fake, exhausting the Unification Realm pursuers and eventually forcing them to give up chasing the trio.
"Told you, you couldn't catch up to me. Still insisted on chasing, such a waste of time."
The Third Senior Sister murmured as she made an impromptu landing, nearby was a stronghold she had set up.
"You two, are you okay?"
After landing, the Third Senior Sister noticed her two Junior Brothers wobbling as they walked, hardly able to stand steadily.
"No, no... forget it, I have a problem."
The two wanted to act tough and say they were fine, but their bodies honestly collapsed, unconscious.
The Third Senior Sister shook her head helplessly, used the beast hide to wrap the two of them up, and brought them to the stronghold.
Lu Yang heard the sparse sound of rain from outside and tried hard to open his eyes, his mind a blurred mess, momentarily unable to remember what had happened before he lost consciousness.
He stared at the cave ceiling until a drop of water condensed and splashed on his face, reluctantly turning his head and gradually recalled what had happened.
Lu Yang turned his head and saw a pair of legs... belonging to Meng Jingzhou.
Looking past Meng Jingzhou, he saw a rising bonfire and the Third Senior Sister sitting beside it.
In the dim cave, the flickering light of the fire made the shadow of the Third Senior Sister lengthen and shorten, constantly changing the shadows on her face, creating an intriguing beauty.
The Third Senior Sister played the lute and hummed softly, her voice melodious and pleasing to the ear, making one feel comfortable as if floating in water, held up by an invisible force.
"You two woke up? Seems like your physical condition is better than I estimated," the Third Senior Sister stopped strumming, her lips curling into a slight smile. This was an original lute piece she composed, capable of calming spirits and soothing souls.
Their premature awakening was also related to wearing the Time Immortal's relic given by Sister Shangguan.
"Both of us?"
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou woke up almost at the same time, Lu Yang facing Meng Jingzhou's feet, and Meng Jingzhou naturally facing Lu Yang's feet.
The two quickly sat up, still suffering from the aftereffects of their wild ride, feeling dizzy and almost collapsing back to the ground.
"Don't rush, you two. Take it easy for a bit."
"Where are we?"
"This is a stronghold I established a hundred years ago. It seems we're lucky that no one has discovered it in all those years; it's very safe."
"Those old monsters won't give up easily, I guess they'll search the area for a few days before they leave. The three of us might as well rest here for a few days."
"We were in a bit of a hurry earlier, but now that we have some time, let's check out the treasures we picked up in the Secret Realm."
Upon hearing this, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou opened their Identity Jades, pouring out a huge pile of heavenly materials and earthly treasures.
Lu Yang casually picked up a fruit-shaped piece of Wooden White Gold Jade, nibbling on it while rummaging through other treasures.
During consumption, the effects of the Wooden White Gold Jade would merge into the body, enhancing Sword Qi and vitality.
As his life force increased, the feeling of dizziness gradually dissipated.
"We'll split these Spirit Stones equally between us."
Lu Yang used his hands to split the pile of Spirit Stones into two equal parts.
"Take these cultivation techniques," Meng Jingzhou handed Lu Yang a stack of manuals.
Upon looking, Lu Yang saw they were manuals for Intercourse Cultivation.
"What do I need these for?"
"And they'd be useful to me?"
After thinking for a moment, Lu Yang felt that Meng Jingzhou made sense.
He took the manuals, casually flipping through a few, his expression one of disgust.
The orthodox Intercourse Cultivation techniques were about complementing Yin and Yang, while all that Suan Ni possessed were unorthodox methods of absorbing Yin to replenish Yang, which were harmful without limit.
"Burn them."
Lu Yang casually threw the manuals into the fire, and they quickly turned into a pile of ashes.
"Hm? Is there something inside the manuals?"
The characters from the manuals drifted out of the flames, gathered together, and transformed into a golden piece of paper that remained undamaged despite the searing flames.
Lu Yang looked surprised. It seemed that this was the real technique hidden within the manuals, which only revealed its true form through burning.
"Destroy before rebuilding, could it be a coincidence?"
Lu Yang murmured, directly pulling the golden piece of paper from the fire.
The paper was densely covered with tiny characters; indeed, it was a cultivation technique.
"This is..."
"What is it?"
"An Immortal's secret technique!"
"What?!"
It wasn't just Meng Jingzhou – even the meditating Third Senior Sister hadn't expected such an earth-shattering secret technique to be hidden within the Intercourse Cultivation manuals.
This Yang Invigorating technique was written in an ancient language that only Lu Yang could fully understand.
"What kind of technique is it?"
"Yang Invigorating Technique."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Are you kidding me, lad?
"Wait, why would an Immortal need a Yang Invigorating technique, which Immortal needs to invigorate Yang?"
Realizing something, Meng Jingzhou recalled an ancient rumor: "Is it the Yingtian Immortal? I've heard that Yingtian Immortal bedded a hundred women in a night, took good men's wives, and made countless women pregnant in one night!"
Lu Yang looked at Meng Jingzhou in disbelief. Where did such rumors come from? Wasn't he afraid that the Yingtian Immortal would strike down the rumor-monger during his Heavenly Tribulation?
After Immortals die, their Dao Fruit does not vanish. Fairy Eternity is a good example of this.
Lu Yang couldn't determine whether the Yingtian Immortal was still alive based on the existence of Heavenly Tribulations.
"It's for the Qilin Immortal; he has two wives," Lu Yang revealed the true user of this Yang Invigorating technique.
"Qilin Immortal?"
"That's the Demon Immortal that people often talk about. His true form is a Kirin, the only Kirin in the world. He has two wives, one from the Long Clan and the other from the Phoenix Tribe."
"This Yang Invigorating technique was researched by the Demon Immortal's two wives."
Third Senior Sister showed a surprised expression. Academia had speculated that the Demon Immortal's true form was a Kirin, but there was no concrete evidence, so no one could say for sure. This theory had been questioned since its inception, yet based on her Junior Brother's tone, he seemed very certain. Could it be that he had conclusive evidence?
As for the Demon Immortal having two wives, even though she had studied ancient history for many years, she had never heard of it.
During ancient times, the Dragon and Phoenix Clans had two supremely powerful beings that reached the realm of Semi-Immortals. Was her Junior Brother suggesting that these two individuals were the wives of the Demon Immortal?
No wonder Eldest Senior Sister assigned her Junior Brother to come over; although his Cultivation Level was not high, he had a deep understanding of ancient history.

chapters.title: Chapter 573 - 572: Junior Brother, Are You Talking About Unofficial History?
chapters.content:
"Junior Brother, have you heard about the battle between the Demon Immortal and the ancestors of the Dragon and Phoenix Clans?" Third Senior Sister recalled a legend, wondering if Junior Brother might have a different interpretation of it.
"The three of them could fight?" Lu Yang wondered in his heart, Isn't the Qilin Immortal kneeling at the Sword Array every day? Were the three of you fighting in bed?
"Yes, it's said that it was a fight for the position of ascension to immortality between the Demon Immortal and the Dragon and Phoenix Clans. It was a famous battle for ascension in history, ranking in the top ten great power battles. Many scholars have wanted to delve deeply into that battle."
"However, the existing records of that battle are very vague, making it difficult to study."
"Several ancient texts mention that the Demon Immortal and the ancestors of the Dragon and Phoenix were Semi-Immortals. The three engaged in a massive battle among the stars. They had the power to obscure the heavens, darkening the skies and dimming the sun and moon, plunging the world into darkness, so dark that you couldn't see your own hand.
People were in panic, and in the end, the Demon Immortal fought one against two to win the battle, turning the skies and bringing light back to the world."
"Fairy, do you know about that battle?"
"What kind of question is that? The two girls from the Dragon and Phoenix clans are my unnamed disciples, and the Qilin Immortal has been beaten by me since we were small. I'm very close to all three of them. How could I not watch such a huge battle?" Fairy Eternity felt that Lu Yang was underestimating her; she always cared about her friends.
"Not just me, Ying Tian, Suiyue, and Jiuchong were all watching from the sidelines."
"The battle was indeed fierce. Qilin Immortal's combat prowess was fierce; despite fighting against two, he was not killed."
"Initially, it was a free-for-all among the three, but as they fought, the Dragon and Phoenix girls realized the Qilin Immortal was the toughest to deal with. They decided they needed to team up to take down the Qilin Immortal first."
"The Qilin Immortal was seriously injured, beaten black and blue, looking as terrible as one can imagine. He thought this wouldn't do, with everyone watching; how would he keep up appearances if this look became well-known?"
"When he fought, he intentionally or unintentionally moved closer to the sun and the moon, nearly scaring the Golden Crow and the Jade Rabbit to death. Three Semi-Immortals fighting—if they got hit even once, they'd be laying low for half a year. Hit twice, they'd be laid up for a lifetime. So, the Golden Crow and the Jade Rabbit quickly took the sun and moon and ran away."
"Once they ran off, the world turned pitch black; without light, we immortals could see the Qilin Immortal's battle, but mortals and ordinary cultivators could not. The Qilin Immortal's plan succeeded."
"Still, the Qilin Immortal, fighting one against two, wasn't easy to defeat. Fortunately, there was no light; otherwise, if his battered appearance spread, I bet he'd wish he could die. My drawing skills are excellent; I took the chance to sketch it down."
"The Qilin Immortal has been beaten by me since childhood; his vitality is strong, and the effect of the Dao Fruit Outline's 'survival of the fittest' made him stronger the more he fought, perfectly suited for a war of attrition. In the end, the Dragon and Phoenix girls' techniques had little effect on the Qilin Immortal."
"The Qilin Immortal won the victory, and the two girls were thoroughly convinced by their defeat."
"After winning, the Qilin Immortal wanted to invite the Golden Crow and the Jade Rabbit back, but they refused to return; the Qilin Immortal had scared them away, so how could it be easy to ask them back?"
"With no other choice, the Qilin Immortal had to invite another pair of the Golden Crow and the Jade Rabbit."
Lu Yang: "..."
So much for no sun, no moon, changing the heavens and earth.
Lu Yang faithfully recounted the course of the battle to Third Senior Sister, who had a strange expression after listening.
"Junior Brother, is this... a folk tale?"
Such a wild tale, daring to spread such rumors about the Qilin Immortal.
"No, this is official history."
Third Senior Sister: "?"
Lu Yang saw that neither Meng Jingzhou nor Third Senior Sister needed the immortal-level Yang Invigorating Technique. With his cultivation level, he couldn't destroy it either, so he could only take it for himself and plan to exchange it for Contribution Points at the Scripture Pavilion later.
"What is this?" Lu Yang picked up a palm-sized small cage. The cage, with chains, held a golden Suan Ni, which flickered like flames, seeming unstable and elusive.
After hearing Lu Yang's description, Third Senior Sister quickly provided an answer, "This is the essence of a Suan Ni's spirit. It's crafted from the soul of a Suan Ni and is now a lifeless object. If absorbed, it can further stimulate one's bloodline and grant even more powerful divine abilities."
"It seems that the Suan Ni I killed had once murdered its own kind, attempting to absorb its essence for itself, but it was killed before it could do so."
"Murdering one's kin is a grave sin. Moreover, the Suan Ni targeted by that one was definitely of pure blood and high status. So much time has passed that even if I were to offer this to the Suan Ni Clan, they'd likely assume I'm just making excuses."
"Originally this was a spirit essence of the Spirit Transformation level. You two cannot absorb it, but nearly two hundred years have passed and even the seal is no longer effective, a large part of the essence has spilled out. It is now a Nascent Soul-level spirit essence, which makes it convenient for absorption."
"Junior Brother Meng, you can absorb this spirit essence. Suan Ni are born from the union of dragons and lions, naturally possessing characteristics of both the Long Clan and lion-kind, albeit not fully mastered."
"If you absorb the essence of a Suan Ni, you may gain attributes of both the dragon and lion, especially the famed Fearless Lion Seal from Buddhism. You might be able to glimpse a part of it."
"Here, take it." Lu Yang handed the essence of the Suan Ni to Meng Jingzhou.
There was no need for thanks between good brothers. Meng Jingzhou covered the cage with one hand and supported it with the other. The essence of the Suan Ni transformed into strands of golden light, entering his body through all meridians.
Sweat the size of soybeans beaded on Meng Jingzhou's forehead, quickly drenching his whole body, and his teeth chattered as he battled fiercely with the Suan Ni's spirit essence in his spiritual space.
"If you want to scream, then scream. I've placed a seal around this cave; nobody outside can hear what's happening here," Third Senior Sister reminded him, sensing that Meng Jingzhou was suppressing himself.
As soon as she finished speaking, Meng Jingzhou found an outlet for his pain. His eyes narrowed, turning golden, his throat trembled, and he emitted a roar that humans could not produce.
Roar—
The Lion's Roar.
"No sound of the dragon's chant, it seems you've mastered the Lion's Roar. What a pity, the dragon's traits are much stronger than the lion's."
"Nevertheless, it's not bad. Your roar has a bit of the grandeur of the Buddhism Lion's Roar. I heard you've also learned the Arhat Fist. Your affinity with Buddhism is profound. Perhaps you might learn the Fearless Lion Seal in the future."
"By the way, Senior Sister, what did you mean by dragon traits?"
"Oh, there are many, such as commanding the wind and rain, possessing a strong physical body, riding the clouds, dragon's innate licentiousness, and such—all good traits."
Meng Jingzhou always felt like there was one trait he definitely couldn't master.
"Even if you mastered it, there wouldn't be a problem. Eldest Senior Sister has always praised your willpower. If you gained that last trait, you'd still retain your vital essence, and your cultivation speed would undoubtedly be faster than Junior Brother."
Meng Jingzhou shook his head vigorously, feeling a chill of fear; fortunately, he had already broken away from the Meng Family and practiced acts of kindness. Only by such luck had he narrowly avoided disaster.
He was already struggling to endure it; if he obtained the innate licentiousness of the dragon, the chants from Suspension Temple would be in vain, and even if Master Jiesha possessed him, he couldn't resist the physiological urges.

chapters.title: Chapter 574 - 573: Cage
chapters.content:
```
"Cultivation is about pressing forward bravely without fearing difficulties and dangers," Lu Yang advised Meng Jingzhou. "Look at how Master makes enemies everywhere. Under immense pressure, his cultivation level has soared, making him the leading figure of our time."
Lu Yang admonished Meng Jingzhou not to think that evading the Dragon's intrinsic lasciviousness was a good thing; such an attitude was detrimental to cultivation.
The greater the pressure, the greater the potential. That's the truth Eldest Senior Sister told herself, a lesson she learned from Daoist Buyu.
Daoist Buyu practiced what he preached and perfectly proved the correctness of his theory. He's still applying his theory today, and his tireless spirit is something Lu Yang truly admires.
Meng Jingzhou gave Lu Yang a sideways glance, saying with irony, "Easy for you to say, you're not the one feeling the pain. Let's switch places and you'll see."
The Suan Ni that Third Senior Sister killed, true to being one of the Geniuses, possessed many valuable items.
"Is this a bottle of Nascent Transformation Pills?" Lu Yang took out a small bottle and poured out a pill, which resembled the Nascent Transformation Pills described in books. These pills can break through from the Golden Core Stage to the Nascent Soul Stage.
Elixir Cauldron Peak does not refine such things, so Lu Yang had never seen the actual item.
"These three bottles are all Nascent Transformation Pills."
"What kind of elixir is this?" Meng Jingzhou found a pill stored in its own small bottle. Upon opening it, a pungent elixir fragrance hit him, and it smelled like it was worth a fortune.
"With this scent, it should be a Soul Condensing Pill, which is used for breaking through from the Nascent Soul Stage to the Divinity Transformation Stage," Third Senior Sister identified the source of the elixir with a twitch of her nose.
Soon after, Meng Jingzhou found another Soul Condensing Pill.
Leaning against a stone wall, Third Senior Sister explained, "Suan Ni is already at the Mid-stage of Spirit Transformation. Soul Condensing Pills are useless to him. He must have hoarded these elixirs to win over his subordinates."
"There are many factions within the Suan Ni clan. To vie for the position of Clan Leader in the future, one needs not only the support of the higher-ups but also the loyalty of underlings, such as collecting materials, intelligence, and so forth."
"I've seen many underlings bullying the weak in the name of collecting materials. I've casually killed a few, and that's how I've made some of my enemies."
"As for the methods of garnering subordinates' loyalty, there are many. Some are based purely on trust, while others are bound by life-and-death contracts or master-servant pacts, and there are also those trained by the old generation to be loyal retainers."
"By the way, Third Senior Sister, there wasn't enough time in the Secret Realm for you to elaborate. What exactly are the Central Continent, Demon Territory, Buddha Country, East Sea, and the extreme north like?"
"Eldest Senior Sister also said if we encounter any strange phenomena at the border of the Central Continent and Demon Territory, we can directly ask you."
Upon this topic, Third Senior Sister no longer lounged lazily against the stone wall. She sat up straight, her tone turning serious.
"Strictly speaking, these are matters that cultivators of your level should not know. But since Eldest Senior Sister said so, she must have her reasons. Let me confirm once more, are you sure you want to know about this?"
Both of them nodded simultaneously. The question was right before their eyes, and not knowing the answer was unbearably tantalizing.
Seeing this, Third Senior Sister sighed, idly drew a few lines in the air with her fingertips, and a continent rose up in an orderly fashion—labeled as the Central Continent.
"Most cultivators believe that the world is flat and that we, the Demon Race, and the Sea Clan all live on the same single continent."
"But this is not the case."
As she spoke, a landmass the same size as the Central Continent appeared to the east of it, standing vertically relative to the Central Continent.
The vertical landmass to the east was a vast ocean.
"This is the East Sea."
To the west side of the Central Continent, a landmass shrouded in sand arose parallel to the East Sea Continent.
"This is Buddha Country."
To the south of the Central Continent, a landmass covered with dense forests and steep mountains stood upright.
"This is our current location, the Demon Territory."
To the north of the Central Continent, a white continent rose up, filling the last gap in the surrounding barrier.
"This is the scarcely populated extreme northern land."
Third Senior Sister pinched her fingers in the air, capturing a red, scorching sphere. She placed this sphere above the five continents.
```
"This is the sun and the moon,"
Third Senior Sister paused, then continued.
"There is also a continent that is not recorded in books, a continent only known to high-order cultivators,"
The sixth continent appeared, covering the top of the box.
Sealing the top.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were both shocked, their pupils contracted, disbelief written all over their faces.
"This continent is called the Spiritless Continent. As the name suggests, it is a land completely devoid of spiritual essence, without any value, not only do cultivators despise it, but even mortals are reluctant to go to such a place."
Spiritual essence has the effect of dredging meridians and strengthening the body; mortals who go to the Spiritless Continent will find their physical conditions deteriorate.
"You may have heard of that legend, thirty thousand years ago, the Ancient Nameless One turned stars into continents,"
"But the Ancient Nameless One did not turn stars into just one continent, but six,"
"The six indestructible continents formed a cube, locking everyone inside here."
"During this time, many cultivation geniuses attempted to break through the continents to reach the world beyond, but without exception, all failed, even those who were adept at space spells could not penetrate the bottom layer of the continent."
"There are even rumors that not even Immortals could break through the continents,"
"As for why the Ancient Nameless One would do such a thing, it remains a mystery."
"In fact, whether it's six continents or one whole continent, it has no impact on cultivators. The area of these six continents is vast enough that whether it is for cultivation or combat, there are no feelings of constraint."
"This..."
Although Lu Yang had anticipated the existence of the sixth continent and that they lived in a box so vast it seemed boundless, seeing this scene still felt like a fantasy.
Lu Yang had always wondered why the Ancient Nameless One would turn stars into continents, what was the purpose?
This left Lu Yang utterly mystified, and now at last, the answer was revealed—the Ancient Nameless One aimed to lock something up.
Using stars as material and the continents as barriers, an impenetrably massive box was constructed, so large that its size could not be calculated.
"If you don't believe it, you can go down and see for yourself if you know the Earth Escape Skill," Third Senior Sister added. Many cultivators found it hard to accept the truth upon their first encounter.
Seeing is believing, understandable.
"I'll go take a look," said Lu Yang without hesitation, standing up to dive.
This was not just his decision, but also the intention of Fairy Eternity.
The continental barrier was thick, and by Lu Yang's speed, it took days to calculate the descent.
Luckily, now at the Golden Core Stage, he could maintain internal circulation, going for a long time without breathing.
The only issue was sustaining the Earth Shrinking spell continuously, as he would run out of magical power.
This problem could be solved with the Great Recovery Pill.
Using the Earth Shrinking spell, he zipped down into the ground.
Three hours passed, and Lu Yang's spiritual essence was depleted. He created a small space underground using a ground-sealing method, where he rested for a moment after taking the Great Recovery Pill, before continuing his descent.
After repeating this twenty times, five days had passed.
His diving body paused as if he had stepped onto solid ground, feeling very tangible.
Earth Shrinking could not proceed.
He had reached the bottom of the continent.

chapters.title: Chapter 575 - 574: The True Identity of the Ancient Nameless One
chapters.content:
```
At the very bottom of the continent, not few cultivators have the ability to reach its depth, yet rarely do any choose to do so, lacking the consciousness to pursue it.
Lu Yang was no exception; he had never considered traveling to the very bottom of the continent using Earth Shrinking to view the scenery on the other side.
It wasn't until his Third Senior Sister mentioned it that he decided to take action.
The bottom of the continent was pitch-black, and nothing could be seen; Lu Yang wanted to use his Spiritual Sense to investigate, but he was stopped by Fairy Eternity.
"Don't use your Spiritual Sense to look. This thing is beyond your understanding; just one glance could overwhelm your mind."
Lu Yang obediently backed off, leaving matters of immortals to the immortals themselves; he would not interfere.
"Stay back a bit; I'm afraid something unpredictable might happen and affect you."
Fairy Eternity was seeing this sort of thing for the first time. Listening to the description given by that little girl Gan Tian, the barrier's characteristic is its impenetrability, but who knows if it has other functions like reflecting damage or something.
Lu Yang retreated further.
"Why are you rushing so far away?"
Fairy Eternity called Lu Yang back, and he obediently returned. Fairy Eternity lightly tapped Lu Yang's forehead twice, linking them with her Spiritual Sense.
In this way, no matter how far Lu Yang ran, as long as he did not go beyond the range of the Spiritual Sense, the two could communicate.
However, to prevent Lu Yang from suffering a mental shock, Fairy Eternity did not share her visual perspective with him as she had done previously.
"That's fine, you can go now."
Once she saw that Lu Yang had reached a safe area, Fairy Eternity unfolded her Spiritual Sense, analyzing inch by inch. Under the power of her formidable Spiritual Sense, the structure of the continent's bottom layer appeared before her eyes, increasingly furrowing her brows.
"There are two barriers set up here, each corresponding to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage and the Immortals. The first barrier cannot be breached by the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, and the second barrier cannot be breached by Immortals."
"Isn't there a position corresponding to Semi-Immortals?"
"The biggest difference between a Semi-Immortal and the Transcendance Tribulation Stage is the possession of a Dao Fruit Outline. You can consider a Semi-Immortal as a transitional phase between the Transcendance Tribulation Stage and an Immortal.
If you possess a Dao Fruit Outline at the early stage of Passing Tribulation, you are a Semi-Immortal, and if you possess one at the pinnacle of Passing Tribulation, you are still a Semi-Immortal."
"The difference between these two types of Semi-Immortals is in their foundational strength."
"It's only when a Semi-Immortal condenses a complete Dao Fruit and becomes an Immortal that their overall strength will leap in quality."
"So that's how it is."
Although Lu Yang was only at the Eighth Heaven of the Golden Core stage, he had already acquired a vast knowledge that even those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage might not possess.
"Such a complex structure; who laid it?"
Fairy Eternity gently tapped the first barrier; it was chiseled open, numerous runes twinkled, converging into a beam of white light. The white light flickered, and the barrier was restored to its original state, seamless, as if it had never been damaged.
This entire process didn't even last half a breath's time.
When Fairy Eternity tried to tap the barrier in the same way again, there was not the slightest change in the barrier—no signs of damage or holes at all.
"This is..."
Fairy Eternity hesitated.
"Fairy, what's the problem?"
"The barrier is operating on two types of Dao Fruits."
```
"Two kinds?"
"The Time Immortal's Time Dao Fruit and the Qilin Immortal's Survival of the Fittest Dao Fruit."
"The Time Dao Fruit allows time to flow backward, restoring the damaged barrier to its original state, while the Survival of the Fittest Dao Fruit prevents the same attack from breaking the barrier."
"Wait, no, that's not right. The strength of this barrier also includes the Immortal Jiuchong's Yin-Yang Dao Fruit. The Yin-Yang Dao Fruit has imbued the concept of 'hardest' into the barrier. The first layer is so hard that not even one at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage can penetrate it, and the second layer is so hard that not even the power of an Immortal can break through."
The nature of a Dao Fruit is to add a rule to the world. As long as Fairy Eternity desires, she could add the 'Immortal Rule' to the whole world, making everyone forever young and undying."
The barrier operates on the same principle; Time Immortal, Qilin Immortal, and Immortal Jiuchong, these three Immortals extended the rules of their Dao Fruits to the barrier, making it indestructible and the hardest existence that not even Immortals could breach."
"Still, that's not right. If those three Dao Fruits were here, I'd be able to recognize them at a glance, not repeatedly test and deduce the Dao Fruits from the phenomena... unless there's also Yingtian Immortal's Tribulation Dao Fruit."
"Right, there should also be the Tribulation Dao Fruit. Using the Dao Fruit, Yingtian Immortal executed 'Limitless Tribulation,' completely scrambling and reorganizing the rules of the Dao Fruits of Time Immortal and the others."
"What exactly is 'Limitless Tribulation'?"
"It's complicated to explain, but you can think of it as the largest and most chaotic of calamities. Executing such a calamity, even Yingtian Immortal cannot resolve it."
"And applying the Limitless Tribulation to the barrier is akin to tying a dead knot; unless you cut the rope, no one can untie it."
"So you're saying that this barrier is the handiwork of the Four Ancient Immortals, but even if they were all called over, they couldn't undo it?"
"That's the gist of it."
Lu Yang took in a sharp breath. The Four Ancient Immortals really went all out. What were they trying to do?
"Does that mean to say, the so-called Ancient Nameless Ones are the Four Ancient Immortals?"
Now that the composition of the barrier had been analyzed and attributed to the doing of the Four Ancient Immortals, then the Ancient Nameless One famed for refining stars into the mainland, could it be the Four Ancient Immortals?
Everyone fell into a logical misstep; the Ancient Nameless One wasn't a single person but four.
"It is indeed the four of them!" Fairy Eternity nodded affirmatively, her face brimming with a relaxed smile, "I knew my death had nothing to do with them."
Lu Yang hesitated, feeling that Fairy Eternity was being too quick to conclude. Could this really rule out the possibility of the Four Ancient Immortals conspiring to kill Fairy Eternity?
"This Immortal draws conclusions based on sound logic," said Fairy Eternity, changing the subject to another question, "Do you know how to break this barrier?"
If even Immortals could not open the cage laid out by the Four Ancient Immortals, as per Fairy Eternity's words, then all beings in the world would have to live within this cage from generation to generation.
"How can it be broken?"
"Limitless Tribulation is the biggest trouble. It's like a box locked with ten thousand locks, and you have ten thousand keys in your hand without knowing which key fits which lock. You have to open each lock with one key, not failing in the process because a single mistake means starting over. It's purely a matter of luck."
"To break the Limitless Tribulation, the only way is to continuously attack with the force of an Immortal. And due to the existence of the Survival of the Fittest Dao Fruit, you cannot repeat the same Immortal-level attacks."
"Then…" Following the train of thought laid out by Fairy Eternity, Lu Yang thought of a solution.
"Which is why my existence is needed. My self-destruction isn't limited by the Survival of the Fittest Dao Fruit; each of my self-detonations is unique."
"To unlock this cage barrier, we, the Five Ancient Immortals, need to make a move together. Time Immortal, Qilin Immortal, Immortal Jiuchong, and I will break the Limitless Tribulation while the three of them undo the rule limitations!"
Lu Yang's mind buzzed with a revelation, connecting all the evidence and visualizing the scene from three hundred thousand years ago. He understood why Fairy Eternity was so certain it wasn't the Four Ancient Immortals' doing:
After Fairy Eternity's death, the Four Ancient Immortals, unable to find the murderer and for some reason unable to resurrect Fairy Eternity, collaborated to carry out a shocking act, refining the stars into the mainland.
This was a glaring declaration to the murderer: either resurrect Fairy Eternity and undo this cage, or we all stay trapped in here together, and no one leaves!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 576 - 575: Daoist Buyu's Two Lessons
chapters.content:
```
Lu Yang was very touched by the fellowship of the Five Ancient Immortals.
They had laid down an unprecedented cage to imprison the murderer, which could only be unlocked by the collective power of the Five Ancient Immortals. What grand courage it took, what a masterstroke it was—Lu Yang admired it.
At the moment, Lu Yang had no other thoughts, just one question—without the Time Immortal, how to gather the power of the Five Ancient Immortals?
Fairy Eternity was also stumped by this question. After pondering for a while, she proposed a solution that sounded unfeasible, "Why don't you become an immortal and form Time Dao Fruit?"
Lu Yang: "..."
Fairy, are you overestimating me?
How difficult it is to master the rules of time! The Time Immortal relied on his identity as the Firmament Tree and traded endless lifespans to slowly grind and exchange time for time, just to control the laws of time.
I'm only eighteen this year; am I supposed to map out my plan to master Time Dao Fruit in advance?
How do I master it? Possess the corpse of the Time Immortal, or do you, Fairy, teach me the laws of time?
"It's a pity that the fate of Yingtian Immortal and the others is uncertain. Even if they are alive, we don't know where they are. Otherwise, it would just be a matter of finding them and asking," Fairy Eternity regretfully shook her head, but Lu Yang could tell she was in a good mood.
Previously, they had always been ignorant of the murderer's identity, suspecting one of the Four Ancient Immortals, but after this investigation, they finally ruled out the possibility of the Four Ancient Immortals and relaxed.
"Alright, time to go back."
The exploration of the deepest layer of the mainland was complete; there was no need to stay any longer.
The human and fairy joined forces; Lu Yang employed Earth Shrinking, gliding through the ground as if swimming.
With a push of his feet and a parting of the layers of soil with his hands, he was like a fish about to swim through the mainland... but he didn't manage to swim through.
Lu Yang blinked; his technique was perfect, but he just couldn't swim up.
Gathering momentum, he kicked with his feet and parted the soil layer by layer, like a fish trying to pass through the mainland... and still, he could not swim through.
Looking down at the barrier at the bottom of the mainland, he realized that this very thing was holding him in place.
Seeing Lu Yang's plight, Fairy Eternity had a sudden realization and remembered something, "Oh, I forgot, there is gravitational pull in this place; you're being pulled in."
The Four Ancient Immortals were adept at their craft, not just kneading stars into the mainland like putty; during this process, they preserved gravity, or rather, constructed a gravitational array method with magic skills... Regardless, the mainland did have gravity.
"Just use a bit more strength and you'll make it up," Fairy Eternity encouraged Lu Yang.
Descending was effortless for Lu Yang, only needing to use "Prison Ground" to slow down when sinking too fast.
But climbing back up was far too troublesome.
Having no other choice, Lu Yang endeavored to swim upward.
It took him five days to descend to the core and thirteen days to return to the surface, leaving him gasping for breath.
Fortunately, with Fairy Eternity's guidance on the direction, he didn't veer off course; otherwise, he might have ended up in the territory of the Suan Ni Clan or the Qiongqi Clan.
"Your trip took quite some time," Meng Jingzhou, who was meditating on his cultivation, felt Lu Yang's worm-like progress back to the surface and woke up early.
Lu Yang gave Meng Jingzhou a white look, "If you went down and back up, you'd take just as long."
Third Senior Sister looked curiously at Lu Yang who had appeared earlier than she had anticipated; the Junior Brother's round trip speed was a few days less than her estimate.
"With such speed, I'm afraid even those in the Nascent Soul Stage would be ashamed," she thought to herself. The Junior Brother was even stronger than she had expected, no wonder the Eldest Senior Sister had chosen him to be the Acting Sect Master.
"How was it? Did you find anything? Senior Sister didn't deceive you, did she?"
Lu Yang nodded; this journey had yielded great results, but the contents of the discovery could not be shared with others—it was too significant.
```
Moreover, speaking about the Dao Fruit of the Four Ancient Immortals was futile even if you did manage to, because you would forget it as soon as you finished talking about it.
"Now that you're back, you two stay here while I go outside to check if those old fellows have left," the Third Senior Sister said as she stood up and stretched. She cautioned them not to run around recklessly, as she would be back soon.
Third Senior Sister took a talisman in her hand, which spontaneously combusted. Before their very eyes, she vanished from the spot. She was invisible to both the naked eye and Spiritual Sense.
This was a very advanced Invisibility Talisman that only Fairy Eternity could see through.
About half an hour later, as promised, the Third Senior Sister returned with good news, "They've all left; we are safe now!"
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou both heaved a sigh of relief, thankful to be safe at last.
"Where are we heading to now?"
"To the Qiongqi Clan, where I have my second stronghold," she replied.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou gasped, thinking to themselves that Third Senior Sister was leading them straight into the lion's den.
"It's fine. I've lost count of how many times I've been to the Qiongqi Clan. No matter how formidable they seem to the outside world, their internal management is rather lax, nothing compared to our Seek Dao Sect," she reassured.
The two followed Third Senior Sister out of the cave only to discover that it wasn't situated in the mountain but below it. To leave, they needed to climb upwards.
The mountain was enveloped in thick fog and dew, with the muddy path pockmarked with potholes and numerous puddles formed recently after rain.
Suddenly, the Third Senior Sister stopped in her tracks.
"What's wrong, Senior Sister?"
Pointing at a small puddle, Third Senior Sister instructed, "Jump in after me."
"What?"
Without further explanation, Third Senior Sister leaped into the puddle. Strangely, although it seemed to be just a shallow accumulation from the rain, about two to three inches deep, when Third Senior Sister jumped in, she completely disappeared.
Although puzzled, the two trusted Third Senior Sister and jumped in after her.
Lu Yang felt as if his entire body was submerged in water, plunging into the depths of the East Sea, losing all sense of direction, unable to distinguish north from south. He desperately swam in one direction, then after a couple of strokes, his head popped up lighter, and he clamored out of the puddle.
The scenery around them appeared exactly the same as before they jumped in.
"This is the outside world," Third Senior Sister said with a smile. It was a place she had built upon first arriving in the Demon Territory, and naturally, it contained many secrets since it had remained undetected for so long.
Lu Yang understood that Third Senior Sister had utilized the mountain's natural rainfall to create an entrance using the puddle and had established a mirrored underground space. They had been hiding in that subterranean space all this time.
"This was the second lesson our master taught us: learning to hide," she said.
Daoist Buyu had taught Third Senior Sister that the first lesson was to flee for your life and the second to hide.
Lu Yang reminisced about the Eldest Senior Sister's teaching methods: the first lesson involved wielding large pots for acrobatics, the second was taking hot water baths.
It was hard to say which was superior.
"Our destination, the Qiongqi Clan, is one hundred fifty li in that direction," Third Senior Sister pointed out, noting that they would have to cross through a side branch of the Qiongqi Clan along the way.
"Take these two Invisibility Talismans. Light them when we get close to the side branch," Third Senior Sister handed one talisman to each of them.
"Side branch?"
"Yes, it's the Qiongqi with impure bloodlines. These Qiongqi aren't eligible to be included in the Qiongqi Clan's family registers. As you've seen for yourselves, the Demon Territory can be dangerous. They live near the Qiongqi Clan, acting as guards and servants," she explained.
"Was the first demon beast we killed a hybrid Qiongqi?" Meng Jingzhou asked quietly.
Lu Yang nodded in agreement—indeed, it was. That was when he, Meng Jingzhou, and Man Gu had gone to eliminate the Tiger Demon, which had mixed Qiongqi blood, a hybrid.

chapters.title: Chapter 577 - 576: Tomb of the Qiongqi Clan
chapters.content:
Third Senior Sister produced an Invisibility Talisman of extremely high grade that didn't impose any level restrictions on the user. Lu Yang burned the talisman, becoming invisible, and moved through the Qiongqi side branch tribe as if nobody was around.
Although it was referred to as a side branch tribe, that was in relation to the Qiongqi Clan. These side branches were still entities that would receive the highest respect from the Demon Race if placed in the outside world. Just by traveling this short distance, Lu Yang encountered a patrolling team.
The captain of the patrol team was actually a Foundation Establishment cultivator, with members all being strong existences at the eighth or ninth layer of Qi Refinement.
And this was only a small team leader; the captain of a larger team was likely to be a Golden Core ancestor, or at least a Half-Step Golden Core ancestor.
"The clan leader of this branch tribe is at the early stages of the Unification realm, a status which would secure a place among the Qiongqi Clan Elders, but he suffered an injury early in his years and can't make a move lightly," Third Senior Sister reminded. This branch tribe had the strength of a First Class Sect, and although it was the weakest of its kind, it could not be taken lightly.
Both men nodded in unison, assuring Third Senior Sister not to worry; if the brothers lacked anything in their abilities, it was definitely not their caution and carefulness.
Lu Yang also saw juvenile mixed-blood Qiongqi huffing and puffing while practicing their skills, jumping around in small courtyards, drenched in sweat yet not stopping.
"I must evolve my bloodline into that of a pure-blood Qiongqi and bring glory to my family!"
The eyes of the juvenile mixed-blood Qiongqi shone brightly, filled with hope.
The Demon Race possesses unique cultivation techniques that can purify bloodlines, making the leap from carp to dragon a possibility, although those who could achieve this step were few and far between.
"The method of bloodline evolution has been handed down to this day, huh." Fairy Eternity, who had long dealt with Demon Beasts, recognized at a glance the origin of the juvenile mixed-blood Qiongqi's actions; it was the bloodline evolution technique devised by the Qilin Immortal.
Before Qilin Immortal, there were methods of bloodline evolution, but they were too inefficient.
"Fairy, can he evolve into a pure-blood Qiongqi?"
"This Little Tiger's blood is mixed enough, with ancestors of six or seven different Demon Beasts. His talent might be considered genius in a side branch tribe, and cultivating this way, he can indeed advance to pure-blood, but that's as far as he'll go. Once he reaches pure blood and enters the Qiongqi Clan, he'll discover that there are plenty of geniuses just like him.
He won't stand out in the Qiongqi Clan."
"Is it that bad?"
"It's not bad; it's reality. The disparity in talent is clear. This Little Tiger wouldn't even qualify for the grand finals in Great Xia, let alone make it through."
"The Qiongqi Clan has many geniuses like him who are just as hardworking. Considering the resources these geniuses enjoyed previously were better than his, how can he stand out?"
"To become the strongest, both talent and resources are indispensable. Even if your talent is strong, not to mention being placed in a Second or Third Class Sect, even in a First Class Sect, can they fully exploit your talent? They cannot."
Lu Yang nodded; not to boast, but his talent was definitely not something that could be fully exploited in a First Class Sect, perhaps not even in the Five Elements Sect.
"So you see, hard work can indeed lead to success, but no matter how hard you work, you can't outpace those who work just as hard and are more talented than you are."
"Fairy, are you telling me all this to encourage me to practice more diligently?"
"No, what I mean is Miss Yun has great talent, is willing to endure hardship, and has cultivated for hundreds of years more than you. You probably won't be able to catch up with her. When our Immortal Lineage fights with her, I'll lead, and you'll support."
Lu Yang: "..."
The three of them passed through the side branch tribe without incident and arrived at the Qiongqi Clan. Teams of five Qiongqi patrolled the skies and the ground, with another team taking over every ten minutes.
"Strange, why is the Qiongqi Clan on such high alert? Are they going to war with the Howling Moon Tian Lang Clan?" Third Senior Sister muttered.
"Should we change locations?"
"No need, it's not like it's targeted at us anyway."
"How do you know, Senior Sister?" Meng Jingzhou asked curiously.
"If it were aimed at us, it would have to be the Qiongqi Clan Elders out patrolling, not this bunch of small fries. Such stringent security is probably just for show."
"... Makes sense."
"Every noon, there's a three-breath gap in the protective tribal array. We need to seize this opportunity to get in," Third Senior Sister said, familiar with the Qiongqi tribe's array methods. She seemed to have come here countless times before.
A quarter of an hour later, Third Senior Sister gave a signal, and the three of them timed it perfectly, successfully entering the Qiongqi territory.
The Qiongqi were accustomed to living in jungles and caves, so the tribal area was filled with hollowed-out tree trunks and mountains from within.
While moving through the tribe, they occasionally encountered a few Qiongqi gathered together, talking. Lu Yang faintly heard words like "envoy visit," which made him wonder.
Was this the reason for the Qiongqi tribe's strict vigilance?
An envoy visit?
What level of envoy would warrant such a grand reception by the Qiongqi tribe?
Lu Yang secretly asked Third Senior Sister.
"An envoy? A visit from an equal wouldn't cause such a stir. I fear it's a race even more powerful than the Qiongqi, perhaps of the Dragon and Phoenix caliber."
"Third Senior Sister, where are we going?"
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou followed Third Senior Sister deeper and deeper into seclusion. After walking for half a day without seeing a single Qiongqi, they felt an eerie chill.
"The tombs of the Qiongqi clan. If one wants to delve into archaeology, to excavate secrets hidden in history, one has to go to places like this. Whether it's murals or burial artifacts, they're all cultural relics worth researching."
"Didn't I ask Eldest Senior Sister to send someone knowledgeable about ancient history? It was here, at the Qiongqi clan's tomb, where I found something strange."
"Something strange?"
"It can't be explained in a few words. You'll understand once you see it."
The Qiongqi tribe took its ancestral tombs very seriously, with a Qiongqi of the Body Integration Realm stationed as the tomb guard. Unfortunately for the guard, he was virtually ineffective against Third Senior Sister, who even had the spare energy to bring the two juniors inside.
Seeing the Qiongqi clan's tombs, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were thoroughly shocked.
There stood an imposing Qiongqi statue, so vast it filled their entire field of view, carved from three mountains and assembled with great magical power.
The Qiongqi statue was lifelike, with a fierce tiger bearing wings on its back, commanding eyes, and posed as if about to take flight, as though it could soar into the sky at any moment.
Even just looking at this statue felt intimidating.
The Qiongqi clan's tomb was located right below this massive statue.
"It's said that this is a tomb built in ancient times, a style popular among the Demon Race during that era," explained Third Senior Sister, indicating they need not be overly surprised.
Suddenly, Meng Jingzhou halted in his tracks, pointing at the Qiongqi statue above their heads without daring to look up.
"Why do I feel like this statue is alive, constantly watching us? Is it an illusion?"
Lu Yang was startled and his skin crawled. In fact, he had the same feeling. If two people felt this way, it couldn't be just an illusion.
Third Senior Sister transmitted her voice to them, "I also feel like we are being watched."
"Inside the Qiongqi tribe, there's a legend that the one above our heads isn't a statue, but an ancient Qiongqi turned to stone, sleeping to this day, with the possibility of awakening at any moment!"
Both of them grew even more nervous.
Fairy Eternity, worldly and knowledgeable, offered an explanation, "You say it feels like someone is watching you—that's an Array Method. The Yingtian Immortal developed it and encouraged everyone to set up such arrays when building their tombs. It can scare people and serves as a legend."

chapters.title: Chapter 578 - 577: Yingtian Immortal Goes to Great Lengths
chapters.content:
```
The three of them felt as though they were being watched, a sensation that sent shivers down their spines.
Third Senior Sister continued, "It's precisely because of this legend that few amongst the Qiongqi ever come to the Qiongqi tomb; it's a place their own kind are reluctant to approach, fearing they might disturb the ancient Qiongqi that lies asleep here."
"However, you need not be afraid. I've been here several times, and while I have felt watched, that's all there is to it. Once we enter the tomb below, the sensation disappears."
"Throughout history, several members of the Qiongqi Clan at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage have come to investigate the Qiongqi tomb to see if the ancient Qiongqi, their forebear, truly lies in slumber. But all searches have been in vain.
They've said that the cultivation level of the ancient Qiongqi is far above theirs, and they, as unworthy descendants, don't have the right to probe into the status of their ancestor."
In the Demon Race, those at the Body Integration Realm are kings, while those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage are emperors. The birth of several from the Qiongqi Clan at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage means the birth of several Demon Emperors—a truly terrifying number.
The Qiongqi Clan is considered the pinnacle of the 'Tiger Demons,' their fame even spreading to the Central Continent, giving rise to the saying "adding wings to a tiger," which showcases the might of the Qiongqi Clan.
"Acknowledged by several Qiongqi Demon Emperors, the ancient Qiongqi is recognized by the entire Qiongqi Clan as the strongest existence."
Lu Yang: "..."
Third Senior Sister, don't say anymore. I fear that once you know the truth, you'll curse the Immortals, increasing the difficulty of your tribulation.
Yingtian Immortal, you really know how to stir things up.
"Yingtian Immortal once said, living a life is not only about focusing on one's reputation while alive but also on one's reputation after death, that is why he formulated such an Array Method, to leave behind a legacy for future generations."
"Aside from the Qiongqi, he must have also established such Array Methods in the ancestral tombs of the Kun Peng, Taozhu, Vermilion Bird, and other races. He didn't set up too many; setting up too many would fail to underscore the mysteriousness."
That the Array Method has lasted three hundred thousand years without damage and still can frighten people speaks volumes about the quality of Yingtian Immortal's product. On the other hand, it also shows how much he cared about this matter."
"Moreover, because it's necessary to weave a legend, the truth about the tomb's Array Methods had to be concealed, turning it into a secret."
From the way the Qiongqi Clan dare not come close to the tomb, it seems the Array Method has indeed become a secret."
"...Yingtian Immortal is quite helpful."
Lu Yang racked his brain to find words of praise for Yingtian Immortal, hoping to reduce the danger during his tribulation.
"It's not exactly about helping others. Think about it—whether it's the ancient Qiongqi or the ancient Kun Peng, they are the ancient Demon Race in your stories, with boundless magic powers, right?"
"No matter how boundless their magic might be, they can't be more powerful than the Immortals, can they?"
"The more mysterious the old Qiongqi and the others are, the more they highlight the power of us Five Ancient Immortals, right?"
Fairy, don't say anymore. If you keep this up, I'm afraid I'll truly start having irreverent thoughts about Yingtian Immortal.
Like Meng Jingzhou's method of willpower training, Lu Yang also trained his willpower while listening to ancient history.
The three of them entered the Qiongqi tomb, and, as expected, the feeling of being watched vanished, greatly easing their psychological burden.
"This is..."
Inside the Qiongqi tomb were many murals, most of them badly damaged by the ravages of time, crumbling into ruin.
The pigments used for the murals were immensely valuable, their worth described as a drop costing a thousand gold pieces. Despite this, the murals couldn't withstand the test of time, ending up in such a state, illustrating just how ancient both the Qiongqi Clan and the Qiongqi tomb were.
Lu Yang saw a mural depicting a young Qiongqi, its fur wet and glossy, clearly just born. Next, the young Qiongqi sprinted forward, gradually growing larger. It reached its prime, then began to age; its fur fell out, its body stooped and weathered, walking towards death.
At the final point of death was the Qiongqi tomb.
The murals also depicted many historical events that were significant to the Qiongqi Clan, events that they regarded with pride and sought to remember at all times.
Above the murals was a line of ancient text: Death is not the end; I have witnessed your glorious lives.
```
"These are ancient inscriptions left by Qiongqi, regarded by the Qiongqi Clan as a spiritual cornerstone. That is why the Qiongqi Clan doesn't fear death and takes a very open view towards it,"
Third Senior Sister truly was a professional archaeologist, casually referencing various cultural aspects of the Demon Race.
"This phrase wasn't written by Yingtian Immortal, was it?"
"No, this was Qiongqi's own creativity. Yingtian Immortal couldn't possibly come up with a phrase for each individual; that would lead to homogeneity and people might spot the flaw,"
Yingtian Immortal was meticulous and considerate in his actions.
"Senior Sister, where is this stronghold you mentioned?"
"We're almost there."
The tomb was pitch-black, as complex as a maze. Without a Qiongqi Clan Elder to lead the way, one could easily get lost in the tomb.
It was unclear how Third Senior Sister had figured out the structure of the Qiongqi tomb.
They walked about two li before they finished traversing the corridor. Third Senior Sister tapped on the wall bricks, and a secret door opened; she gestured for the others to follow.
Lu Yang noticed that there were many outward-facing arrows on the walls of the hidden room, and instantly understood.
There were many mechanisms inside the Qiongqi tomb; this was one of the trap rooms. If someone stepped in the wrong place, a volley of arrows would be released, shooting the intruder to death.
After an intruder was shot dead and the arrows were expended, they needed to be replenished, hence the trap room, which also served as the resting place for the three of them.
"Senior Sister, how did you manage to find such a place?"
They were both surprised. It was one thing to hide inside a tomb, but to hide in a trap room within the tomb? Who would've thought to look there? No wonder Third Senior Sister was so certain that hiding among the Qiongqi Clan was safe.
The three of them took a brief rest for several hours, adjusting their condition. Although they weren't worried about being discovered thanks to the Invisibility Talisman, maintaining invisibility still required a lot of energy.
Third Senior Sister was fine, but Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had been using the Invisibility Talisman for nearly a day, from the branch tribe to the Qiongqi tomb, and they needed to rest.
The two of them fell asleep as soon as they lay down in the trap room.
While the two were asleep, Third Senior Sister took out her paper, brush, ink, and inkstone, and recorded the events of the past few days.
She had turned her experiences in the Demon Territory into "Monster Field Chronicles," already completing eight volumes. She was currently writing the ninth.
Through their brief encounter, she had determined that this Junior Brother understood more about ancient history than she did.
With a Junior Brother proficient in ancient history present, she believed that the content of the ninth volume would be even richer than the previous eight.
"Hmm..."
She heard a rustling from Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, signaling they were waking up, so she quietly put away her four treasures of study and sat in silence.
After sleeping for a full three hours, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou woke up feeling refreshed and invigorated.
"Now that you're awake, it's perfect. I'll take you to the main tomb where, supposedly, the ancient Qiongqi is buried."
"Supposedly?"
Third Senior Sister nodded, slung her qin to her back, and tied the strings around the front. With her eyes covered by a black cloth, she looked like a hermit emerging from a bamboo grove.
She explained, "At the very least, the coffin of the ancient Qiongqi is there. As for whether Qiongqi really lies inside, I don't know. But that doesn't concern us; we're here to conduct archaeology, not to rob graves."
As a professional scholar, Third Senior Sister adhered to a belief in empirical evidence.

chapters.title: Chapter 579 - 578: Burial Objects
chapters.content:
The main tomb buried the Qiongqi of Ancient Times, considered the strongest existence of its kind. This place is luxuriously adorned with all sorts of rare treasures and ancient magic artifacts on display, as if the Ancient Qiongqi could come back to life at any moment, wielding these artifacts to wage war and slay its enemies.
Any of these treasures, if taken out and auctioned off, would require the auction house to prepare six months in advance and heavily promote it as the finale piece to be sold at an exorbitant price.
Even with the discernment of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, they couldn't identify the origins of these items and could only ask their Third Senior Sister for explanations.
Fortunately, Lu Yang had two ears, perfectly suited for listening to his Third Senior Sister in one ear and Fairy Eternity in the other.
Three fluorescent spirit grasses with the same appearance grew on the wall, demonstrating stubborn vitality.
"Kunlun Grass, it is said that this thing can improve one's foundation, cleanse the marrow, and even has a one in three chance of transforming into the rarely seen Kunlun Immortal Body!"
"Kunlun Grass, if you eat too much and become a Kunlun Immortal Body, it's not very useful. The Kunlun Immortal Body is the most useless of all the immortal bodies. The first immortal body I ever defeated was a Kunlun Immortal Body."
A feather emitting a pure white glow was placed inside a shell as tall as a person, looking extraordinary.
"Qiongqi Feather, from the center of the Ancient Qiongqi's back, it's said that with this feather, one could invoke the 'Demon Race Alliance' to request any Demon Race's assistance. And within the feather lies a true word of the Ancient Qiongqi. Whoever hears this true word must agree to the conditions proposed by the Qiongqi Clan."
"Qiongqi Feather, just a feather plucked from the old Qiongqi's back. It grimaced in pain for quite some time. With this thing, you can ask other Demon Races for help. Only the Qiongqi Clan can use it, and you need to drop blood on it and activate it with magical power. Then the feather will emit the old Qiongqi's voice — 'Give me some face.'
A palm-sized black hill stood on the ground, heavy beyond measure, warping the surrounding space. If not for the reinforcement of an Array Method, it would've probably collapsed into a black hole by now.
"Zhou Shan's Mountain Essence, there is a legend that in Ancient Times, there were two Great Powers controlling water and fire. They clashed in an epic battle for the Immortal's seat, with water and fire colliding, volcanoes erupting, oceans turning into magma, and stars exploding into countless meteorites.
In the end, the Great Power of fire triumphed, and the Great Power of water, in a fit of fury, knocked down Zhou Shan, from which the Mountain Essence was born."
"Zhou Shan's Mountain Essence, you remember that Golden Core Cultivator who could conjure saltwater, right? He got lucky, cultivating all the way to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, then got into a conflict with a genius of the Phoenix Tribe. They started fighting, destroying several spheres, and the genius from the Phoenix Tribe, having been guided a few moves by me, fought fiercely.
The salty Golden Core, blinded by desperation, crashed into Zhou Shan, creating this thing."
"Is this the core of Zhou Shan?"
"That's because he was hard-headed, using his head to compress Zhou Shan into such a small piece."
Lu Yang: "..."
All these treasures were sealed, and the slightest touch would alert the Qiongqi Clan, causing the entire Qiongqi tomb to lockdown, leaving tomb raiders no chance to escape.
As Third Senior Sister said, she was here for archaeological exploration, not for tomb robbing, and did not covet these items.
In the very center of the main tomb lay a coffin, large, dark, and extremely heavy. Rather than calling it a coffin, it might better be described as a great black boat that could traverse the River Styx, granting another life.
"This is Ten Thousand Year Underworld Wood, the best material for coffins, impeding all forms of Spiritual Sense investigation," Third Senior Sister explained.
"I remember this thing, old Qiongqi bought it from the Time Immortal, who used both the 'Tree-Planting Sutra' and the Time Dao Fruit simultaneously, turning a sapling into Ten Thousand Year Underworld Wood."
"Heaven and Earth treasures become more valuable the older they are, people often ask the Time Immortal to age their treasures, and sometimes if aged too much, they can even produce Little Medicinal Kings."
The Time Immortal used a genuine "Tree-Planting Sutra," something Lu Yang couldn't compare to.
Fairy Eternity said this as she extended her Spiritual Sense to investigate the black coffin, curious to know if the old Qiongqi was dead or alive, being from the same Ancient Times.
In this world, nothing could block the detection of an Immortal's Spiritual Sense.
"Sadly, it's truly deceased," sighed Fairy Eternity. An old acquaintance lay just nearby in the coffin, an indescribable feeling washing over her.
Without achieving a complete Dao Fruit, one's lifespan is ultimately limited. Old Qiongqi had no external injuries; it died of old age.
However, she wasn't too saddened, as she had little friendship with old Qiongqi, who often consumed humans until the era of the Five Ancient Immortals, when it no longer did so.
Therefore, when the old Qiongqi asked her to extend its lifespan, she didn't help.
"Look here, there are characters." Lu Yang whispered, pointing to a line of small characters at the bottom of the wall.
"Meng Potian was here. Who is Meng Potian?"
Meng Jingzhou's face colored slightly with embarrassment, "My father."
The Clan Leader of the Meng Family, when he was young, believed in reading thousands of books and traveling thousands of miles, having gone both south and north, even leaving marks in the Demon Territory.
With his father's character, it was only normal for him to leave small inscriptions like this here.
Third Senior Sister nodded, "The Qiongqi Clan also discovered this line of text."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Why is the Demon Territory more dangerous than I imagined?
No, that's wrong, I have already run away from home, I can't be considered a Meng Family member.
Lu Yang patted Meng Jingzhou on the shoulder, very loyal, "Don't be scared, if the Qiongqi Clan finds us, I'll throw you out to buy us some time."
"That won't be necessary, the Qiongqi Clan won't do anything to Junior Brother Meng."
Lu Yang was greatly surprised, he hadn't expected the Qiongqi Clan to be so magnanimous, capable of repaying grievances with virtue.
"Repaying grievances with virtue is a bit too much. Hundreds of years ago, the Qiongqi Clan also rushed to cause trouble for the Meng Family, but the Qiongqi Clan had their troubles and couldn't spare the time to deal with the Meng Family."
"What troubles did the Qiongqi Clan have?"
Lu Yang thought to himself, could it be that there was a huge battle in the Demon Territory hundreds of years ago, and the Qiongqi Clan got involved, facing attacks from both front and rear, unable to look after themselves, or could it be that there was infighting in the Qiongqi Clan, perhaps a struggle for the position of Clan Leader between two Qiongqi?
Third Senior Sister explained, "The Qiongqi Clan is by nature destined for poverty. Hundreds of years ago, they made losses in business and lost much money, causing widespread grievances within the clan. If it hadn't been for the Meng family lending them money, the Qiongqi Clan might not have overcome that obstacle."
"It is said that just fifty years ago they repaid their debts in full. Junior Brother Meng, as the Meng Family's Young Master, if the Qiongqi Clan were to find out about you, they should treat you respectfully. If you were willing to be buried in a Qiongqi tomb, I reckon they'd agree."
Meng Jingzhou finally breathed a sigh of relief; it seemed that the Meng Family status didn't always draw resentment.
Lu Yang glanced sideways at Meng Jingzhou, thinking the kid sure knows how to turn his Meng Family identity on and off.
Third Senior Sister bent her knees in three deep bows towards the black coffin, her posture dignified and her attitude respectful; the proper rites had to be observed.
"Predecessor Qiongqi, my apologies."
Before taking someone's burial items, one couldn't simply take them directly—that would be improper.
She walked to a corner of the main tomb, cautiously enveloping a pottery jar with her spiritual power and lifting it.
This pottery jar was the most inferior among the burial items, not even qualifying as a magic artifact. The purpose of the pottery jar was decorative.
The few patterns on the pottery jar puzzled her.
"Junior Brother, take a look at this pottery jar."

chapters.title: Chapter 580 - 579: The Highest Standard Battle in History
chapters.content:
"A pottery jar?"
Upon hearing Third Senior Sister calling him, Lu Yang interrupted Fairy Eternity's explanation.
Unlike the ancient and rough pottery jar paintings Lu Yang remembered, which required guesswork to understand their contents, the pottery jar from the Qiongqi Clan's funeral offerings was exquisitely detailed.
The painting depicted a catastrophic change in heaven and earth, as if the end times had come. All beings were like ants, and even through the pottery jar, Lu Yang could feel that extreme despair. In the face of such might, there was no room for resistance. The Ancient Qiongqi spread its wings, desperately protecting its race.
The intent of the painting was to illustrate the significant achievements of the Ancient Qiongqi, which had protected the Qiongqi Clan during a great disaster.
But Lu Yang wasn't focused on the Ancient Qiongqi; instead, his attention was on the background of the painting.
The apocalyptic disaster stemmed from the four indistinct figures in the background.
The four figures were blurry, but their every move displayed their boundless might.
"These four figures must be the Four Ancient Immortals," Third Senior Sister confidently stated.
Only the legendary Four Ancient Immortals could have caused the Ancient Qiongqi to spread its wings in protection of its kin.
"Indeed," Lu Yang nodded, his expression slightly solemn, having likely guessed the content depicted in the painting.
"But the question is, what kind of adversary could make the Four Ancient Immortals join hands to face the enemy?"
Third Senior Sister was particularly puzzled; from their positions, the Four Ancient Immortals stood in a line, clearly allied.
What enemy in ancient times could make these four legendary, invincible beings unite?
Even after consulting all the ancient texts, Third Senior Sister couldn't find any mention of such an adversary.
Lu Yang remained silent; of course, there was one—the mysterious being capable of assassinating Fairy Eternity and enraging the Four Ancient Immortals.
The painting depicted the Four Ancient Immortals' battle against the Immortal who had assassinated Fairy Eternity, unlike the usual sparring among the Five Ancient Immortals, which aimed to exchange insights on cultivation, learn from one another, identify and fill gaps, and mutually improve without intent to kill.
This was different. In the great battle of the Four Ancient Immortals against the mysterious Immortal, the five Immortals fought with all their might, without holding back, in a battle the likes of which had likely never been seen before!
This was the most powerful battle in history!
An epochal war!
Even Semi-Immortals had no place meddling in this battle!
But Lu Yang couldn't share these things with Third Senior Sister. Eldest Senior Sister had warned him, the identity and purpose of the secret antagonist were unknown, and he must not reveal the existence of Fairy Eternity.
Perhaps if the secret antagonist discovered that Fairy Eternity had been resurrected, they would want to kill everyone who knew of Fairy Eternity's existence as well.
Lu Yang shook his head, signaling that he also did not know who the Four Ancient Immortals' opponent was.
Just as Third Senior Sister was feeling disappointed, Lu Yang pointed out another detail in the painting.
"Third Senior Sister, look. There are other planets in the background of this painting, each with a ring of light around them; these should be protective shields."
The Four Ancient Immortals had not lost their rationality to anger; even amidst battle, they took the effort to protect these planets.
If there wasn't this layer of protection, I fear that most of the universe's creatures would have suffered death or injury.
"That's indeed the case." Third Senior Sister was extraordinarily surprised; this was a major discovery. Current historical records only mention how Jiuchong Immortal used Breath Soil to save people and contain no other accounts of the three Immortals saving anyone. This has led to ongoing disputes among historians over the personalities of the other three Immortals.
Now one thing is clear — the Four Ancient Immortals did not regard all beings as mere ants.
The protection of the planets by the Four Ancient Immortals was not actually discovered by Lu Yang, he had never seen the Four Ancient Immortals intervene, nor knew what the halo encircling the planets was. It was Fairy Eternity who recognized it.
In the Spiritual Space, Lu Yang frowned, confirming that the Four Ancient Immortals were, in fact, the Ancient Nameless One. Yet the Four Ancient Immortals had used a method to protect the stars during battle, which contradicted the historical records he was familiar with.
Historical documents state that the Ancient Nameless One refined stars into continents, causing countless deaths and injuries, leading to a disruption in historical continuity. Not even the ancient language was passed down. The Great Qian Dynasty was established out of the ruins, ushering in the era of Human race dynasties.
If it was the Four Ancient Immortals who refined the stars, how could they have disregarded the fate of all life in that process, leading to such a historical discontinuity?
"Could it be that, after refining the stars into continents, another event occurred that led to historical discontinuity?"
Lu Yang suddenly remembered there was that mysterious Fire Dynasty of unknown origin!
The Fire Dynasty was discovered within the Immortal Secret Realm. According to chronological estimates, it existed during ancient times, yet strangely, there are no current records of the Fire Dynasty, not even a mention of its name!
What exactly happened in the Fire Dynasty?
"Old Lu, what is painted on this pottery jar? Come take a look," Meng Jingzhou called Lu Yang over, knowing that not utilizing such a living fossil would be a waste.
The pottery jar mentioned by Meng Jingzhou was on the other side of the main tomb, with a painting of a dragon and a tiger in fierce battle.
A Qiongqi and a True Dragon were locked in a great battle when a radiant figure descended from the sky and put a halt to the fight between these two unparalleled demon emperors.
Before Lu Yang had a chance to respond, Third Senior Sister, rich in historical knowledge, began to explain.
"This is a very famous legend within Buddhism. You all must have heard of it—the Qiongqi Clan and the Dragon Clan are natural enemies with irreconcilable differences. There was a battle between a Qiongqi and a True Dragon that flooded the lands and caused utter chaos. Fortunately, a Buddha from the Buddhist sect intervened, taming both the Qiongqi and the True Dragon, and thus peace was restored.
This is also the origin of the phrase in Buddhism that the Buddha had 'the power to subdue dragons and tigers.'"
"From my research, this battle could very well have been between the Qiongqi Clan's ancestor and that of the Dragon Clan, fighting over the position of Immortal, only to be interrupted by someone."
"Actually, this painting here also puzzles me. It clearly depicts subduing the dragon and the tiger, which would be an insult to the reputation of the Qiongqi Clan. Why would it be placed here as a burial good?"
