At that time, Lu Yang was listening to the words of Immortal spoken by Fairy Eternity.
"The old Qiongqi had a daughter; she was beautiful and highly talented, rivaling the old Qiongqi himself. Many pursued the daughter, but she fancied no one and only liked the Qilin Immortal. Coincidentally, the Qilin Immortal also had affection for her, and they quickly took a liking to each other.
Later, when a genius from the Dragon Clan found out, angered, she went to confront the daughter of the Qiongqi Clan. This resulted in a fight between them."
"But the daughter of the Qiongqi Clan was no match for the Dragon Clan genius, she couldn't win the fight. Then the Qilin Immortal came along, pulling favors, and it took quite some reasoning before the two were pacified. It's said that after heading home, the Qilin Immortal had to kneel in the Sword Array every day."
"Later on, some of us got together and included this affair in Buddhist stories."
Lu Yang: "…"
What do I do? Should I tell Third Senior Sister about the Qilin Immortal's affair and how his wife found out?
If the Qilin Immortal finds out I know, will I even be able to leave this tomb alive?
"But come to think of it, why is it that only the old Qiongqi is buried here? Where is his daughter? Given how much the old Qiongqi favored her, shouldn't they be buried together?"
Fairy Eternity was puzzled, remembering that the daughter of Qiongqi was only at the peak stage of Transcendance Tribulation and not even a Semi-Immortal; she was supposed to die before the old Qiongqi.

chapters.title: Chapter 581 - 580: The Might of an Ancient Great Demon
chapters.content:
"Why do I always have a feeling that something is off about this coffin, one person short, where did Jin Caiwei go?"
The Qionqgi Clan uses 'Jin' as their surname, and Jin Caiwei is the little Qiongqi mentioned by Fairy Eternity.
Lu Yang: "..."
Why does this sound so odd?
"Wait, someone's coming. Hurry and call your Senior Sister and the Meng Family kid to leave," Fairy Eternity reminded.
"People are coming to this place?" Lu Yang wondered, knowing that Fairy Eternity wouldn't deceive him, he then spoke to Third Senior Sister.
"Third Senior Sister, let's hide quickly, people are entering the tomb!"
"How do you know?" Third Senior Sister was puzzled. She hadn't noticed anyone, so how did Lu Yang find out?
And why would there be people in a tomb, and another dead Qiongqi?
Lu Yang appeared calm: "Eldest Senior Sister gave me a magic artifact before we set off, which has the ability to warn of danger. Now this artifact is alerting us to danger, so there must definitely be someone coming in."
"Eldest Senior Sister is so partial?" Third Senior Sister didn't doubt it, such a magic artifact sounded like something the Eldest Senior Sister could offer.
The three of them quickly put everything back in place and sneaked back into the mechanism room.
To prevent tomb robbers from discovering the tomb's mechanisms, the mechanism room has the ability to block Spiritual Sense, which makes it a perfect hiding spot.
They had no sooner hidden themselves when they heard footsteps coming from the corridor's entrance.
"By the sound of it, there are two creatures from the Demon Race, one of which is a mature Qiongqi, and the other creature seems like... from the Di Jiang Clan?"
Third Senior Sister's hearing was extraordinary; she could determine the race of the comers just from the sound of their footsteps.
"Qiongqi and Di Jiang, this combination doesn't seem like tomb robbers or funeral attendants," Meng Jingzhou scratched his head.
As the two creatures from the Demon Race passed by the mechanism room, Lu Yang was trembling, fearing detection.
"Gold Clan Leader chose a rather unique place for discussions," the envoy of the Di Jiang Clan said with a smile, but he felt a bit scared inside.
When he entered the tomb, he felt as if something were watching him, but apart from the Gold Clan Leader, there were no other demons around.
Could it be that the ancient Qiongqi statue above him was watching?
The ancient Qiongqi is still alive?
The thought alone sent chills down his spine, and he hurriedly shook his head to rid himself of the terrifying idea.
Gold Clan Leader chuckled: "After all, it is a major matter, and we need to settle it under the witness of our ancestors to demonstrate the importance our clan places on the Di Jiang Clan's proposal."
"The Di Jiang Clan is making such a grand scene in the Qiongqi Clan's territory?"
Lu Yang transmitted a message to Third Senior Sister, not daring to speak aloud.
The security outside was as strict as if the Dragon Tribe and Phoenix Tribe had sent envoys; although the Di Jiang Clan was said to be a large clan, the Qiongqi Clan wasn't likely to treat them like this, right?
And even lead them into the Qiongqi tomb?
Third Senior Sister frowned, not quite understanding either, as she had been busy archaeologically examining the tombs of various large clans lately and hadn't paid much attention to the goings-on in the Demon Territory.
The Gold Clan Leader and the Di Jiang envoy moved further away, their voices becoming too faint to discern, and only cultivators like Third Senior Sister, who had especially trained their hearing, could make out their conversation in the main tomb.
"Greetings to our ancient ancestor," the Gold Clan Leader knelt before the black coffin.
Out of respect for the ancient Qiongqi's majesty, the Di Jiang envoy had no choice but to kneel as well.
"The Di Jiang Clan has been very active in the Demon Territory lately; several of my old friends have mentioned you to me."
"After the Taozhu Clan Leader mentioned your clan's idea to me, I was genuinely shocked. A notion as grand as uniting the Demon Territory and establishing the Demon Nation is extraordinary."
The Gold Clan Leader stared coldly at the Di Jiang envoy.
"What surprised me even more is that the Taozhu Clan agreed to your proposal, submissively bowing their heads in fealty," said the Gold Clan Leader.
This was the reason why the Gold Clan Leader felt so threatened and why he had brought the Di Jiang envoy to the Qiongqi tomb.
The Taozhu Clan was about as strong as the Qiongqi Clan; why would they bow their heads in fealty without a special reason?
The Di Jiang envoy sighed, "It can't be helped. With the coming of the Great Era, countless opportunities have arisen. Great Xia Country is powerful and thriving, with the Five Great Immortal Sects as its backbone. Even the Four Great Devil Sects can't stir up any trouble there, and they've even disbanded the Eternity Sect."
"In contrast, our Demon Territory has had an unbroken lineage since ancient times and, in terms of overall strength, is even stronger than Great Xia, yet we fight amongst ourselves, and based on our attitudes toward the Human race, we've split into three different factions."
"How can our Demon Territory, which is as disunited as sand, compete for opportunities in the future?"
"If my Di Jiang Clan were to unify the Demon Territory and then absorb the Sea Clan to establish a supreme Demon Nation, then what would Great Xia or Buddha Country amount to? Merely trifles!"
The Gold Clan Leader watched the Di Jiang Clan Envoy with extreme wariness.
The other's expression was fervent, not feigned, which meant he truly believed he could achieve this.
Where did the Di Jiang Clan's confidence come from?
"Does the Di Jiang Clan possess some peerless powerhouse?" Meng Jingzhou transmitted his question.
"As far as I'm aware, there is indeed a powerhouse in the Di Jiang Clan who has reached the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, quite strong indeed, but not capable enough to support such grand ambitions of the Di Jiang Clan."
"Looking back three hundred thousand years, there was a Semi-Immortal, but he has long since died of old age."
...
"It is rare for nobility to consider the Demon Territory, which I admire, but sadly my Qiongqi Clan has no interest in competing for dominance, nor do we care about any Demon Nation, so please, Envoy, leave." The Gold Clan Leader ungraciously issued the order to leave.
The Di Jiang Clan's words were pleasing to the ear, speaking of a supreme Demon Nation, the struggle of a Great Era, suggesting that Great Xia and Buddha Country were but dust. Yet, Great Xia was not so easily dealt with, and a fierce battle was certain to ensue.
As a Clan Leader, he could not lead his tribe into danger.
"Leave?" The Di Jiang Clan Envoy revealed a sinister smile, even more terrifying amidst the graves.
"Gold Clan Leader, it seems you have misunderstood something. I didn't come here to negotiate with you."
"What are you trying to do!" The Gold Clan Leader roared angrily, his wings unfurled, his tiger eyes wide and round as he bellowed into the heavens.
While talking, the Di Jiang Clan Envoy took a bone Token out of his bosom with the character "Di" inscribed on it.
As soon as this Token was brought out, a terrifying pressure emanated from it, as if a hundred thousand mountains were pressing down on the Gold Clan Leader, making the entire space shake and tremble.
Several figures appeared on the Token, one with a body red as blood and nine snake heads, giving off a cold gaze; this was the great demon Jiuying.
Another with a body as vast as a mountain, resembling a lion, its upward-growing tusks resembling blades of the heavens; this was the great demon Taozhu.
There was also the White Tiger, commanding the aura of slaughter, awe-inspiring and glaring in all directions.
Besides, there were several peerless great demons exuding a similar formidable aura.
The Gold Clan Leader trembled and could hardly stand steadily, nearly kneeling down. These great demons were actually the ancient ancestors of various races, known as demon emperors!
This implied that these Demon Emperors had all submitted to the Di Jiang Clan!
And what drew the most attention was the massive figure among the great demons, red as the blazing sun, with six legs and four wings, eyes agile and avaricious.
The Ancient Di Jiang, a Semi-Immortal great demon!
"Gold Clan Leader, submit to the imprint of my ancient ancestor!" The Envoy laughed heartily, urging the Token again, with even greater pressure.
He had already used this method to brand many great clans with the imprint of servitude.
"This bastard is still alive?" Fairy Eternity recognized the Ancient Di Jiang at a glance.
"Like the Phoenix Tribe genius, he is an embodiment of the Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit Outline, which allows control over beings weaker than oneself, and can even decide life and death!"
"That strong?" Lu Yang was taken aback.
"Fairly ordinary, he was just material for ten moves back in my Semi-Immortal days."
The Ancient Di Jiang wasn't considered very strong in the eyes of Fairy Eternity, but for the Gold Clan Leader, it was as if the sky were falling!
Under the massive pressure, the Gold Clan Leader cracked a wry smile, struggled to stand firmly, and slowly spread open his tiger paws, lying on which was a pristine white feather.
The Ancient Qiongqi Feather!
He had just worshipped the black coffin, seized the opportunity to remove the seal, and taken out this feather!
The Envoy sensed something was wrong. Different from an ancient ancestor known for controlling creatures, the Ancient Qiongqi was known for its combat prowess!
The Gold Clan Leader activated the Ancient Qiongqi Feather, the tiger roar echoed through the heavens, the tomb shook, the ground trembled, and a body larger than mountains filled the main grave, emitting such pressure that the Envoy shivered.
The Ancient Qiongqi lowered its head, its pupils reflecting the figure of the Ancient Di Jiang and those known as Demon Emperors.
Scorning the Ancient Di Jiang, it bared its large mouth, filled with a bloody aura, grinning in a semi-smile as it uttered slowly.
"Fellow Daoist, can you spare some face?"

chapters.title: Chapter 582 - 581: Give Some Face
chapters.content:
```
Ancient Di Jiang stared intently at the figure of his old friend, the Ancient Qiongqi, daring not to take anything lightly.
Although it was just a backup plan, he could already feel the pressure the Ancient Qiongqi was exerting on him.
Still, he was unafraid; both being Semi-Immortals, who could be inferior to whom? He had not feared the living Qiongqi, let alone the dead.
"What if I refuse to give it?"
Boom—
Without a second word, Qiongqi's claw came down, flattening as if to smash a watermelon, creating a terrifying whirlwind that swept across the Qiongqi tomb.
"Dare to control my Qiongqi Clan, it seems you are tired of living!"
Under that claw strike from the Ancient Qiongqi, the Transcendence Tribulation Stage demon emperors within the token exploded one after another, merely leaving behind a sense of pressure within the token, how could they withstand such a blow from the Ancient Qiongqi?
Ancient Di Jiang, utterly fearless, flapped his wings to meet the attack head-on.
The Ancient Qiongqi had long since perished, and the Ancient Di Jiang was far away in the eastern side of the Demon Territory. The two Semi-Immortals clashed across time and space, and the entire Qiongqi Clan felt this palpitation.
Outside the Qiongqi tomb, the massive Qiongqis bowed solemnly in the direction of the tomb, as if heeding a call of their bloodline, falling like hills.
Inside the Qiongqi tomb, Ancient Di Jiang laughed heartily and ceased his attacks.
"Gold Clan Leader, you and I are as close as brothers. The one I wanted to see most upon awakening was you. Today, having seen you, I am overjoyed that Gold Clan Leader's might is just as imposing as in the old days. My sending an envoy to your noble clan was to visit you. Now that my purpose has been achieved, I wish you a good sleep, farewell!"
The methodical unification of the Demon Territory was in progress; there was no need to provoke such a formidable enemy for no reason. The presence or absence of the Qiongqi Clan made little difference.
This visit served to test the depths of the Qiongqi Clan.
Click, the token fell to the ground and then turned into powder.
Ancient Qiongqi looked coldly at his old rival, Ancient Di Jiang, snorted dismissively, and dissipated into the air.
"Fairy, is this what you meant by 'giving face'?"
Lu Yang swallowed hard; no wonder they said this feather could compel any demon race to do something, turns out if they don't agree, Ancient Qiongqi just goes ahead and takes action.
"Yes, was there anything incorrect about my description?"
Fairy Eternity naturally inquired, with a tone that was off; the old Qiongqi was always polite and seeking face when speaking to her, but the tone was a bit harsher when speaking to others.
"...There's nothing incorrect."
"Would you like to chat with Ancient Qiongqi? It seems like he isn't entirely dead; his movements are just like those of the living."
Fairy Eternity waved her hand: "He's completely dead, at most what's left is a divine will. After just now's clash, the divine will and consciousness within the feather are completely drained."
"What if Ancient Di Jiang attacks again?"
"He won't be able to. This is the flaw of the Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit. Since in the battle just now Di Jiang voluntarily withdrew, no longer occupying the 'strong' position, he can no longer control the Qiongqi Clan."
"Fairy, Ancient Di Jiang mentioned he awoke from a deep sleep, does that mean he has been asleep since ancient times to become an Immortal?"
"If he says so, then it is so. Probably used some block of ice to freeze himself into an icicle which just melted now, or maybe he was soaking in something. There are many methods; essentially, all are imitating a standstill in time."
Not long ago, Lu Yang had encountered a Semi-Immortal from ancient times who had been in deep slumber—the Imperial Teacher of Great Yu.
"However, the higher the cultivation level, the rarer the heavenly and earthly treasures required for the deep slumber. One could say that the treasures used by a Semi-Immortal are the most precious. Moreover, during the slumber, as the Dao Fruit is still in its outline, its power will gradually dissipate, leaving only an empty shell.
After awakening, there will be a lengthy recovery period before returning to the peak of one's power."
Immortals have infinite lifespans and don't need to undergo deep slumber.
"Shall we go looking for Ancient Di Jiang?"
This was the second ancient character to make an appearance after Fairy Eternity and was likely to know many things.
Fairy Eternity displayed a look of disdain: "Tch, that old fellow is nothing good, extremely sly and well-hidden, hard to find. If we let Miss Yun come and turn the Demon Territory upside down, we could probably locate him."
```
Lu Yang: "..."
The dust settled after the clash between the two semi-immortals, and the Gold Clan Leader's eyes were cold as he stared at the Di Jiang Clan Envoy, who knelt on the ground, trembling with fear.
"Envoy, will you roll out of the Qiongqi Clan yourself, or shall I have someone carry you out?"
"I'll leave right now!"
The Di Jiang Clan Envoy had never imagined that the Qiongqi Clan's foundations were so robust, and with the Ancient Ancestor himself leaving, what was he, a mere envoy, still doing here?
The Di Jiang Clan typically had six legs, and at this moment, he wished he could sprout six more to scuttle and scramble out of the Qiongqi tomb, to flee from the Qiongqi Clan.
Third Senior Sister had listened to the entire event, perfectly reenacting the brief combat exchange inside the main tomb, just like ventriloquism.
Meng Jingzhou was flabbergasted; they were only there to conduct archaeological research, so how had they stumbled into such events, with the Ancient Di Jiang awakening and talk of unifying the Demon Territory?
Third Senior Sister wasn't doing much better; she had descended into the tomb countless times but had never before encountered such a situation.
The unification of the Demon Territory was a shocking mega-event, yet not a whisper of it had been leaked. It must have been the Ancient Di Jiang controlling the upper echelons of the major clans using the rudimentary form of the Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit. The extent of this control was absolute, ensuring secrecy.
It was only today, through a series of coincidences, that the Di Jiang Clan's schemes were exposed.
She took out a piece of fine paper from her Identity Jade to report the changes in the Demon Territory to Eldest Senior Sister, while Lu Yang ground ink beside her,
Eldest Senior Sister replied rapidly on the other side.
"Ask the junior brother how capable the Ancient Di Jiang is in battle?"
Third Senior Sister was quite surprised; how could the junior brother know about such things?
After pondering for a moment, Lu Yang replied to Eldest Senior Sister.
"He can't withstand a semi-immortal's self-destruction ten times."
"Then there's no need to bother."
The exchange ended.
Fairy Eternity, seeing there was nothing left for her to do, yawned out of boredom, climbed a tree, and hugged the trunk as she settled to sleep.
Before drifting off, she kindly reminded Lu Yang.
"Oh, by the way, there's a little something you should pay attention to."
"What is it?"
"The Qiongqi Clan Leader has noticed you."
Lu Yang was shocked and before he could warn Old Meng and Third Senior Sister, he saw the door to the chamber slowly open, and the immense tiger head of the Gold Clan Leader poke inside, with his cold pupils reflecting the silhouettes of the three people.
"If it wasn't for the ancient ancestor's reminder, I would never have thought to find three little thieves hiding here."
"Let's see, Demon Voice Heavenly Maiden, Lu Yang... from the Seek Dao Sect, and you're Meng Jingzhou from the Meng Family, are you trying to imitate your father?"
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Why did that sound so much like an insult?
Once the identities of the three were confirmed, Gold Clan Leader's expression softened, and he put on a pleasant smile.
"Please come out of here, the three of you, and follow me. We wouldn't want others to say that the Qiongqi Clan lacks hospitality."
Although these three had a suspicion of tomb raiding, the Demon Voice Heavenly Maiden had many enemies in the Demon Territory, and the Seek Dao Sect had a notorious reputation; none of them were particularly good people.
But considering the Qiongqi Clan's recent financial strain and the need to borrow money from the Meng Family,
He decided it was best to be gracious to these three.

chapters.title: Chapter 583 - 582: Uncle doesn't have anything nice to give you when we first meet
chapters.content:
"Gold Clan Leader, do you recognize the two of us, Senior Brothers?" Lu Yang cautiously inquired. The Gold Clan Leader wasn't just imposing in size; being the leader of the Qiongqi Clan, he was definitely a ruthless character without equal.
Before setting off, he and Old Meng had been wondering whether the people of the Demon Territory would be able to recognize them. The conclusion was that at most, the Demon Territory might know their names but not their faces.
Seeing the Gold Clan Leader like this, their earlier conclusion seemed a bit rash.
The Gold Clan Leader looked at Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou with a smile that was not quite a smile.
"Ordinarily, I wouldn't care about which geniuses are at the Golden Core Stage, as they're all empty talk before they've grown, but you, Lu Yang, are different."
"What's different about me?"
Lu Yang couldn't help but smirk, wondering if his unique talent had caught the Gold Clan Leader's attention?
"You are Daoist Buyu's disciple."
Lu Yang: "..."
"When I learned that the champion was Daoist Buyu's disciple, I specifically ordered someone to find a portrait."
"As for Meng Jingzhou, you are the Meng Family's Young Master, so I also had your portrait fetched."
"I never expected to find you two together with Fairy Mo Yin. Is there any relation between you?" The Gold Clan Leader narrowed his eyes as he scanned the three of them.
Fairy Mo Yin liked tomb-raiding and often hunted demons, making quite a few enemies. Yet, oddly enough, her cultivation level was so exquisite that no one could catch her.
Fairy Mo Yin's background is shrouded in mystery, unknown to everyone.
That Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou could enter Qiongqi's tomb must have been with the help of Fairy Mo Yin.
Why she would help them—could it be that Fairy Mo Yin was also from the Seek Dao Sect...
The Gold Clan Leader didn't continue this line of speculation; Fairy Mo Yin's identity was none of his concern.
As the Gold Clan Leader walked along, a thick fog began to emanate from his body, and a burly middle-aged man with tiger ears emerged from the mist.
"Please, this way."
He led the three to a small wooden cabin. The interior of the cabin was delicately crafted, unlike the rough caves and hollows commonly seen in the Qiongqi Clan. It clearly catered to human aesthetics, presumably prepared to entertain members of the Human race.
The Qiongqi Clan wasn't an isolated race; on the contrary, they frequently interacted with various tribes of the Demon Race and the Human race for the sake of business.
However, due to a lack of talent, they often failed in their business endeavors.
The Qiongqi Clan had rich heritage; if they were to sell just one or two of the burial items from the main tomb, even those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage would scramble to purchase them at sky-high prices.
Those were treasures to be kept safe, and selling them would be a sacrilege; the Gold Clan Leader had no desire to earn such a notorious reputation.
The Gold Clan Leader invited a shape-shifted clan member to pour tea for the three, his hospitality leaving them somewhat at a loss.
Third Senior Sister was especially worried there might be a conspiracy involved. With her skills, she could easily escape, but the two Junior Brothers wouldn't fare as well.
Eldest Senior Sister had entrusted their care to her; it would be unacceptable for anything to go wrong on her watch.
"I address Po Tian as my brother, so you may call me Gold Uncle," the Gold Clan Leader said with a hearty laugh, noticing the three were reserved.
Meng Jingzhou's eyes twitched. He had not expected the Gold Clan Leader's warm attitude was due to him, and considering what Third Senior Sister had said about the relationship between the Meng family and the Qiongqi Clan, the Gold Clan Leader's behavior became understandable.
But the problem was, he had already run away from home. Although his father had forgiven him, deep down he still felt uncertain.
Hesitating momentarily, he decided to honor the Gold Clan Leader's wishes and called out, "Gold Uncle."
The Gold Clan Leader let out a belly laugh upon hearing this and handed Meng Jingzhou a piece of paper.
"Good nephew, I have nothing much to give you since this is our first meeting. Take this IOU and keep it safe."
Meng Jingzhou instinctively tried to decline, accepting the gift: "This is too valuable... Wait, what did you say this is?"
"An IOU."
Meng Jingzhou flipped over the paper, and on the front, it was clearly written that the Gold Clan Leader owed the Meng Family a certain amount of Spirit Stones, with a certain amount of interest, to be repaid by a set date.
As a great demon king, the Gold Clan Leader had a very strong mental fortitude. He said without a change of expression, "Could you talk to your family about waiving my debt?"
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
In his impression, no one had ever dared to default on a debt to the Meng Family, let alone have it waived.
The Gold Clan Leader tentatively said, "How about just waiving the interest?"
Meng Jingzhou remained silent.
Not giving up, the Gold Clan Leader said, "It should be fine to repay the money two years later."
Meng Jingzhou worried that if he kept silent, the Gold Clan Leader might consider kidnapping him to demand a ransom from the Meng Family.
"No problem, I'll talk to my dad as soon as I get back. Pay back the money two years later, and we won't count the interest."
The Gold Clan Leader sighed in relief, it seemed he wouldn't have to worry about being struck by lightning for the time being.
"Speaking of which, I haven't seen Brother Po Tian for quite some time. I often ask the merchants about Po Tian and the Meng Family's recent circumstances. I've heard that the Meng Family, being the number one influential family of the Human race, has made many good connections in the Imperial City, is generous in giving and helping others, and is known for their kindness.
The cultivators of the Imperial City speak highly of them, and everyone welcomes a Meng Family member with a smile."
"Brother Po Tian is even more outstanding, shining brightly in the official circles. Both civil and military officials can't stop praising him, saying he has the talent of a great statesman of a bygone era..."
Meng Jingzhou felt restless listening to this, as none of those adjectives seemed to relate to the Meng Family.
"Uncle Gold, you can speak frankly if you have something to say."
"My nephew is quick to speak and act, clearly someone who is cut out for great things!"
"Uncle really doesn't ask for much, just hoping the Meng Family could lend us some Spirit Stones?"
"Lend again?" Meng Jingzhou was shocked. You were just trying to wriggle out of a debt and now have the audacity to ask for another loan? Is this the thick-skinned nature of a great demon king?
The Gold Clan Leader spoke earnestly, explaining seriously, "It's not borrowing again; the last time it was in my personal capacity, this time it is on behalf of the Qiongqi Clan. The two should not be conflated."
"...I can go back and talk to my family, but I can't guarantee success."
The Gold Clan Leader was overjoyed, his face reverting to its original form, "Then I would be grateful for my nephew's efforts in this matter!"
"It's a trivial matter, a trivial matter." Meng Jingzhou quickly said, deciding that for safety's sake, he'd better have the housekeeper speak to his dad when he got back.
It was about time for the housekeeper to have been released.
Originally, the Gold Clan Leader wanted to summon the Qiongqi Clan geniuses to spar with Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, but then he thought that these two were the champions of the Mid-stage Golden Core, and his own geniuses would probably have a difficult time winning.
And if he beat Meng Jingzhou, how could the Qiongqi Clan borrow any money?
For such reasons, he had to give up on the idea.
The Gold Clan Leader personally saw them out. He didn't dwell on the issue of tomb archaeology, and aside from Meng Jingzhou's identity, there was another reason.
That was to let these three spread the word about Ancient Di Jiang uniting the Demon Territory to Great Xia.
According to the records, Ancient Di Jiang was tyrannical in nature. Allowing such a great demon to unite the Demon Territory might lead to unpredictable fortunes and disasters.
"Yawn~" Fairy Eternity woke up from the tree, and seeing the three unharmed, she knew she was right in her assumption; the Gold Clan Leader had no intention of making things difficult for them.
"See, I told you it was a minor issue."
"The Qiongqi Clan has always been poor, and it's really not easy to have remained so up till now."
"I once suggested to Old Qiongqi that the name Qiongqi wasn't good; it's unlucky, and they should change it."
"What do you suggest the Qiongqi Clan change their name to, Fairy?"
"To something like Prosperity or Wealth."

chapters.title: Chapter 584 - 583: Golden Core Jiuchong Heaven!
chapters.content:
In the Qiongqi tomb, a large and a small figure stood silently in front of the black coffin, uttering not a word.
In pitch darkness, their pupils revealed an eerie, oily green that added a touch of terror.
If an elder of the Qiongqi Clan had been present, they would have recognized that the larger figure was the living fossil of the Qiongqi Clan, the oldest of its kind, a nine-thousand-year-old Qiongqi that had reached the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
Oddly, among these two figures, the Transcendance Tribulation Stage living fossil respectfully stood behind the smaller figure, not daring to overstep in the slightest.
The smaller figure gently caressed the sealed funerary objects, which buzzed like bees, as if ready to break their seals and join their master in battle.
"It's not time yet," murmured the small figure in a low voice, and upon hearing their master's command, the funerary objects quieted down.
The Gold Clan Leader crawled on all fours hurriedly into the tomb chamber, slowing his pace as he approached the main burial site, gradually transforming into a human silhouette.
Seeing the two figures, he steadied himself and bowed deeply.
"Young Ancestor, I have sent away the people from the Meng Family and the Seek Dao Sect. The Princely Heir of the Meng Family promised to speak to his father about lending us Spirit Stones," he reported.
Turned to face him, the figure addressed as Young Ancestor was a diminutive girl around thirteen or fourteen years old.
The girl nodded in approval of the Gold Clan Leader's actions.
"That's indeed good news."
"The Great Era is nearing, and that old codger from the Di Jiang Clan can hardly contain himself, wanting to unite the Demon Territory and seize the initiative," he said.
"His Dao Fruit Outline is indeed suitable for this. Our Qiongqi Clan need not follow the others. There is still some time before the true coming of the Great Era. What you need to do during this period is to improve your own realms," instructed the girl.
"Yes," the Gold Clan Leader and the living fossil said in unison, their eyes betraying a flicker of excitement.
The scale of the Great Era's struggle could be compared to ancient times, and if anyone knew best about the state of affairs in ancient times, it was none other than the Young Ancestor.
Suddenly, as if contemplating something, the Gold Clan Leader hesitated.
"Speak your mind, there's no harm in it," encouraged the girl.
"Young Ancestor, with the Qiongqi Clan's current strength, can we truly develop to the extent that we qualify to compete with behemoths like Great Xia and Buddha Country during the struggles of the Great Era for the opportunity?" he asked.
The girl rolled her eyes, somewhat exasperated, "I didn't say we have to vie for first place. Is it too much to aim for the top ten?"
"Oh," he responded.
...
The black market, a place teeming with mixed characters, where rumors spread like wildfire. As long as you're willing to pay, there's no information you can't find out.
In a tavern, two figures clad in black robes, their faces obscured, conversed.
That was the most common garb in the black market.
"Have you heard about the Demoness of Bewitching Music?"
"Who hasn't heard of the Demoness of Bewitching Music? With the strum of her ancient zither, thousands of Dao Sound threads slice demons into pieces, leaving not a single intact piece of flesh. That major demon is listed on the wanted lists of all races. Whoever catches her would make even those at the Body Integration Realm green with envy. If only I were strong enough, I'd want to catch her too!"
"Hey, who told you that stale piece of news? I'm asking about something that happened four months ago, when two attendants appeared beside the Demoness of Bewitching Music."
"Two attendants? To be honest, brother, I've been in seclusion for the past six months and haven't paid attention to such news."
"Buy me a drink, and I'll fill you in."
"Waiter, two jugs of your finest Monkey Wine!"
The man's nose twitched as he smelled the alcohol and let out two chuckles before he said,
"I won't say much about the Demon Sound Heavenly Girl, as everyone knows, it was just four months ago when suddenly two attendants appeared beside her, who were also of the Human race, and their realm was in the Nascent Soul late stage."
"Ever since she gained two more attendants, sightings of the Heavenly Girl became even more frequent. She would often visit the ancestral tombs of various clans. By the time these people were discovered, it was too late, as they had already made their escape without a trace."
"Even if they were caught in the act, the Heavenly Girl had plenty of tactics to escape with her two attendants, leaving those clans frustrated and stomping their feet."
"I've heard that some tomb guardians of the clans actually welcome the Heavenly Girl because they embezzle treasures themselves. If the Heavenly Girl comes, they can pin the loss of the burial objects on her."
"Unfortunately for her, the Heavenly Girl isn't interested in those clans. The ones she sets her sights on are clans with an inheritance of over three hundred thousand years and an ancient background."
"I heard that the next target for the Heavenly Girl is the Zhuyan Clan, she even sent out a notice in advance."
"That brazen?! The Zhuyan Clan has a Transcendance Tribulation Stage ancestor sitting in residence, so what exactly is the background of this Demon Sound Heavenly Girl?"
"As far as I can guess, she might be a direct disciple of the tomb raider ancestor from Great Xia, coming to our Demon Territory for a trial."
At this time, the people in the tavern had encircled the two, listening intently to the matters concerning the Demon Sound Heavenly Girl. One of them frowned and said, "How come I heard that the Heavenly Girl's two attendants once claimed in the Insect Race that they were from the Five Elements Sect?"
"Don't talk nonsense, the Five Elements Sect, being one of the Five Great Immortal Sects, conducts its affairs openly and honorably. How could they do such an unsavory thing as grave robbing!"
"What of the Five Great Immortal Sects, isn't Seek Dao Sect also one of them?"
While the crowd was arguing over the origins of the Demon Sound Heavenly Girl, the shadow who initially shared the intelligence quietly left and went outside the black market.
"Senior Sister, we're back."
The shadow lifted his hat, revealing Meng Jingzhou.
"How did the intelligence gathering go?"
"I pretended to be a knowledgeable person and rambled on for half a day. The people in the tavern were all ears. It seems they still don't know our identities and location."
Lu Yang quickly left through another exit of the black market and met up with Third Senior Sister to report on their findings.
"I approached the Bai Ze Clan to buy information about our identities and location. The Bai Ze Clan only had speculations, no concrete intelligence, so seeing that they knew nothing, I came back."
Third Senior Sister: "..."
I gave you two spirit stones to spy for intelligence in the black market, and you two didn't even spend a single one.
Over these four months, the three of them had been tomb raiding to explore ancient history while cultivating, and both Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou made rapid progress.
Golden Core Jiuchong Realm, climbing to heaven at every step, they had climbed from the Golden Core eighth heaven to the Golden Core Jiuchong, only a half step away from the legendary and seemingly unreachable Nascent Soul Stage!
Just as the three of them were inquiring about their own intelligence to ensure their safety, a shockingly outrageous news spread throughout the Demon Territory and permeated the entire Cultivation World.
- Ancient Di Jiang made a sudden appearance, with hundreds of large clans submitting to him, venerating Ancient Di Jiang as the Demon Emperor and establishing the Demon Nation. Ancient Di Jiang reluctantly agreed to the requests of the thousands of demons after demurring three times.
The Di Jiang Clan is in full swing constructing the imperial palace and is busily preparing for the grand ceremony of enthronement. Ancient Di Jiang has sent out invitations far and wide, to the Qiongqi Clan, Long Clan, Phoenix Tribe, Great Xia, Five Great Immortal Sects, Buddha Country, East Sea...
All the major forces have received invitations from Ancient Di Jiang to attend the enthronement ceremony.
"So many Demon Races have submitted?" Fairy Eternity was slightly surprised. That was quick. Are they getting carried away because there seems to be no immortals in the current world?
One of the characteristics of the Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit is that the more powerful beings under one's control, the stronger one becomes.
"These large clans must have Body Integration Realm or Transcendance Tribulation Stage members. Controlling so many Demon Kings and Emperors, Ancient Di Jiang's strength is probably even stronger than in ancient times by a notch, comparable to Old Qiongqi and ranking among the strongest of Semi-Immortals. No wonder he dared to declare himself emperor."

chapters.title: Chapter 585 - 584 Invitation
chapters.content:
The ancient Di Jiang was originally very powerful, the Imperial Teacher of Great Yu survived being blown up by Immortal Eternity for ten days, simply because he diligently hid in the corners of space, sustaining only minor damage from the explosion's residual waves.
When Fairy Eternity spoke of the ancient Di Jiang enduring ten attacks, she meant Di Jiang stood at the epicenter of the explosion and withstood ten blows directly, which is entirely different from what the Imperial Teacher of Great Yu experienced in terms of difficulty.
And could the explosive power of Immortal Eternity really be compared to that of Fairy Eternity?
Now, the ancient Di Jiang had a tendency to unite the Demon Territory and his strength had reached a new level, entering the first echelon of the Semi-Immortals, even the Immortal Lineage Second Boss was no match for him, which shows the might of the ancient Di Jiang.
...
Di Jiang Clan.
"Have all the invitations been sent out?" The ancient Di Jiang fluttered his wings slightly, emanating an ancient and mysterious aura of pressure that instilled fear in others.
In the Demon Territory, strength was revered. All those kneeling below were the strongest of their respective tribes, and he controlled these major tribes through controlling their strongest members.
If one observed carefully, they would find that these strong beings of the Demon Race had a complicated imprint in the depths of their eyes. These were master-servant imprints planted by the ancient Di Jiang.
Anyone who received this imprint must obey the ancient Di Jiang, their life and death not in their own hands.
The envoy of the Di Jiang Clan attempted to plant this master-servant imprint on the Gold Clan Leader, who could have expected that the Qiongqi Clan had profound resources and managed to shatter the token.
The nervous Clan Leader of the Di Jiang Clan looked at the Ancient Ancestor, rather unsettled, "Reporting to the great one, invitations have been issued to all major powers, except for the Four Great Devil Sects whose whereabouts are elusive and thus cannot be sent."
"The Four Great Devil Sects? Wasn't the Eternity Sect expelled already?"
"There is another rising force called the Heavenly Court Sect, its members are all from the Ancient Heavenly Court…"
The Clan Leader of the Di Jiang Clan meticulously reported the feats of the Heavenly Court Sect, from Heavenly Venerate Dou's emergence in Hanshui City to the Young Sect Master causing a commotion at the Seek Dao Sect celebration, each event showcasing the power of the Heavenly Court Sect.
The ancient Di Jiang scoffed, "Heavenly Court? An existence beyond comprehension. I have roamed the ancient era for tens of thousands of years and never heard of any Heavenly Court. Just like the Eternity Sect, it's all fabrication by some."
"As for Heavenly Venerate Dou, who knows if he is just a play put on by a Great Yu Cultivator, he's nothing to be afraid of!"
"Ancient Ancestor is wise!"
"There are also the geniuses of my Di Jiang Clan, who have been hidden for so long. It is time for the world to understand the power of my Di Jiang Clan."
A smile tugged at the corner of the ancient Di Jiang's mouth. The geniuses of the Di Jiang Clan were cultivated by his own hand, his rightful successors, and they were absolutely powerful.
Then, he coldly looked down at the Clan Leader of the Di Jiang Clan prostrating on the ground.
"Who allowed you to speak to your ancestor? You must understand respect for hierarchy, let someone from the Transcendance Tribulation Stage speak to me."
...
"You must have all received the invitation from the ancient Di Jiang, any thoughts?"
Emperor Xia gathered the Sect Leaders of the Five Great Immortal Sects, with six invitations laid out on the table.
Qiu Jin'an shrugged, "What can you do, just go. Watching the fuss doesn't cost a penny."
"Didn't Yun Zhi Daoist friend tell us about this before? The discussion at that time was that if the ancient Di Jiang unified the Demon Territory, it would actually be able to restrain those Demon Race that viewed the Human Race as enemies. In the future, whether for business or exchanges between cultivators of both sides, it would be much more convenient, with more benefits than drawbacks.
Our Great Xia needn't get involved."
"As for his appearance at this juncture, it's surely related to the imminent Great Era. However, the ancient Di Jiang is not yet powerful enough to threaten Great Xia. We can simply be spectators."
"That's true."
...
Golden Buddha Kingdom.
"The ancient Di Jiang wants to establish a Demon Nation?"
The ruler of the Buddha Country, with a tall figure and shiny head, half-naked upper body, was sitting on a lotus platform with a Buddha constructed of immortal gold behind him.
He looked at the invitation that had been brought over, twirled his Buddha Beads, and remained silent.
He wrote down names eligible to go on the paper, tore them into strips, crumpled them into balls, and began drawing lots.
"Forget it, just randomly choose someone to go."
```
...
East Sea.
The Old Dragon Emperor coiled on the stone pillar, his body nearly ten thousand meters long. The green dragon scales slightly revealed his age, and the dragon claws were covered with thick calluses, but no one dared to underestimate this old dragon; whether in the East Sea or the Demon Territory, there likely was no older being in the Demon Race today.
In his youth, he had relied on his power alone to suppress a rebellion that nearly resulted in the fragmentation of the entire East Sea during the Nine Dragons Civil War.
"It's also been a while since I've had any communication with the kin in the Demon Territory. Sending a few young dragons over to catch up would be nice—it's a good opportunity to inquire about any news of the Ancient Ancestor."
...
Jiuyou Sect.
Mu Baiyi watched the income from the barbecue restaurant with sheer joy. At this rate, he would definitely be able to pay off his loan within his lifetime, and even have the capital to build the Fengdu City well.
"All thanks to the Heavenly Court Sect."
While he was in high spirits, a piece of intelligence came from a subordinate that shook him to his core.
"The Demon Territory is establishing a Demon Nation, sending out invitations far and wide, inviting all major forces to witness it?"
"How come our Jiuyou Sect didn't receive one? Ah right, they can't find our location."
Such significant news had not leaked out even a bit before, how strong was Ancient Di Jiang's ability to block intelligence?
Mu Baiyi was perplexed; according to Young Master Lu's plan, they were supposed to focus on making money with the barbecue restaurant and not get involved in this matter.
But then again, not attending such a monumental event that would be recorded in the annals of history would feel like a loss in the future.
He pondered for a moment and then called Shi Huagu over.
"Ask Young Master Lu what the Heavenly Court Sect thinks about this?"
Shi Huagu was equally shocked when he learned of Ancient Di Jiang's nation-building. He promptly took out the Jiuyou Token, input a lengthy message, and inquired with Young Master Lu.
Soon, Lu Yang replied, "I have always been in the Demon Territory."
Mu Baiyi and Shi Huagu gasped, puzzled as to why anyone would go to the Demon Territory without cause. It seemed Young Master Lu must have known about Ancient Di Jiang's nation-building plans and had headed there in advance!
That's the foundation of the Heavenly Court Sect.
...
"Junior Brother, who are you messaging?" Third Senior Sister felt that Lu Yang was writing something.
Lu Yang casually said, "Oh, it's from the Jiuyou Sect; they were asking where I am."
"…The Jiuyou Sect?"
Third Senior Sister was silent for a while before asking in disbelief, doubting she had heard correctly for the first time.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou then laid out the entire situation of the Heavenly Court Sect, emphasizing how Eldest Senior Sister became the Sect Master, the eight Elders, and Daoist Buyu becoming Protector Heavenly Kings.
This was met with an even longer silence from Third Senior Sister.
Each generation was proving stronger than the last—her own master had never undertaken such endeavors in his youth.
Currently, the three were sitting on animal hides and had not rushed to the Di Jiang Clan. There was still a month left until the completion of the imperial palace's construction, so there was no need to hurry.
The trio had another destination—Creation Ancient Land.
If not for the Demon Territory establishing a nation, the once-in-a-hundred-years opening of Creation Ancient Land would be the major event that captured the attention of the entire Demon Territory.
When Creation Ancient Land opened, all geniuses of the Demon Territory would participate.
Besides cultivation level restrictions, there was only one requirement for participating in Creation Ancient Land—purity of bloodline.
Coincidentally, both Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were of the pure-blooded Human Race, fitting the criteria perfectly.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 586 - 585: Demon Race Geniuses (Happy New Year's Day, Extra Release, Vote for Monthly Tickets)
chapters.content:
The Creation Ancient Land, it is said that this secret realm has existed since ancient times, and the master who arranged it is so ancient that it's impossible to investigate. Even the name of the secret realm remains unknown.
The only thing that is known is that the secret realm harbors many opportunities. When the Demon Race's young talents enter the secret realm, if they are lucky enough, they can directly improve by a whole major level without any side effects, significantly reducing the time needed for cultivation.
Therefore, the Demon Territory has bestowed the name "Creation" to the secret realm.
Besides this, there are various heavenly and earthly treasures that only existed in ancient times. As ages changed and environments underwent drastic alterations, some treasures with strict requirements for their growth environment couldn't adapt to the current world and have become extinct.
Only in ancient secret realms can one find those extinct heavenly and earthly treasures.
If it weren't for the limitations of cultivation levels, even Demon Kings would wish to enter the secret realm to look for opportunities.
"Fairy, have you ever heard of the Creation Ancient Land?" Lu Yang asked, naturally turning to someone from ancient times for information about the ancient past.
"Listening to the description, it does fit the impression of a few secret realms in my memory, but none of them are known by the name 'Creation Ancient Land'."
"Names may differ between ancient and modern times; perhaps its name has changed."
Three pure-blooded members from the Human race quietly descended in the distance and walked towards the entrance of the secret realm.
Even before the opening time of the secret realm, various major clans from the Demon Territory had already arrived in droves. These clans' ancestral graves had basically all been visited by the three individuals, who were very familiar with them.
If they were to take out Fairy Eternity's cookbook, they could likely find their names in it.
Among these major clans, the Dragon and Phoenix Clans stood out the most; they are the two largest groups within the Demon Race, followed by countless other demons.
The Dragon gives birth to nine offspring, the Chao Feng Clan, Qiu Niu Clan, Ba Xia Clan, and so on, all look up to the Dragon Clan as the leader.
The genius of this generation's Dragon Clan is named Ao Yue, who appeared at the entrance of the secret realm in human form, with dragon horns on his head, handsome features, and wearing a yellow robe woven with golden and silver threads, seamless as the garments of heaven.
Accompanied by a crisp phoenix cry, all the demons looked up, where multicolored lights shone from afar, the luminescence of various flying birds' feathers.
The Chong Ming Bird Clan, Bifang Clan, Qing Luan Clan...
Leading the way were several colorful phoenixes.
The Phoenix Tribe is the king of birds.
As the birds landed, they transformed into human form. One was a vibrant and beautiful young girl with bright eyes, black hair, and red pupils, full of vitality, named Jiang Shishi.
Among the elders accompanying Jiang Shishi, there was one that all three people recognized, named Jiang Shan.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had encountered Jiang Shan at the crime scene of a fake Phoenix Blood Stone. Having learned a lesson from the people of the Seek Dao Sect, he was very enthusiastic upon realizing the two were from the Seek Dao Sect.
As for the Third Senior Sister, she was the one who had taught Jiang Shan a lesson back then.
The ancestral graves of the Dragon and Phoenix Clans were also sites well-visited by the three, and could even be seen as key investigation objects for Lu Yang.
He wanted to know the whereabouts of the geniuses of the Dragon and Phoenix Clans and thought it might be possible to find some clues in their ancestral graves.
Unfortunately, it wasn't that simple. Fairy Eternity used her spiritual awareness to scan both clans in detail, getting to grips with their foundations. She even uncovered many ancient secrets that the two clans themselves were unaware of.
Still, no clues were found.
Aside from the eye-catching Dragon and Phoenix Clans, there were many Demon Race clans with ancient grudges, confronting each other like pointed arrows.
For example, the enmity between the Tian Gou Clan and the Jade Rabbit Clan was well known throughout the Demon Territory.
The Tian Gou Clan has an ancient legend about the celestial dog eating the moon, and the Jade Rabbit Clan used to live on the moon.
It's no wonder a grudge formed when one eats away the home of the other so casually.
"White-haired and red-footed, with an appearance like a monkey, could it be Zhuyan?"
"And that one who dresses simply, low-key and unassuming, is she the never-seen-before genius of the Qiongqi Clan?"
"I heard that he took the initiative to go to the human race's Land Money Trade Association to learn the art of business. They didn't pay him, and the association feared he would return to our Demon Territory to establish a competing business, taking over their turf, so they have always refused to let him in!"
"How come I heard that the Qiongqi Clan is plagued by bad luck and the Land Money Trade Association feared being affected by it, so they didn't even dare to accept free labor?"
"That must be a rumor. The Qiongqi Clan has always had more than its fair share of negative gossip. There's even a legend that an Ancient Immortal suggested they change their name to the Prosperous Wealth Clan or the Rich and Honorable Clan, which just sounds fake when you hear it."
"Makes sense."
"Look quick, that's the prodigy of the Nine-Tailed Fox Clan from Qingqiu, just like in the legends, every frown and smile tugging at one's heartstrings!"
The prodigy of the Nine-Tailed Fox Clan was named Su Lian'er, dressed in a white robe, with nine white tails swaying behind her. She had red eye shadow in the corners of her eyes, adding an allure to her demeanor. She appeared to be around the same age as Lu Yang but already possessed the charm to captivate mortals.
Many geniuses of the Demon Race were gathered around Su Lian'er, showing infatuated expressions.
"I heard that the ancient Nine-Tailed Foxes were incredibly beautiful, with legends of 'sinking fish and falling geese, and shaming the moon and flowers.'"
"She does have a bit of her ancestors' looks." Fairy Eternity said with a hmph.
"Is she truly so breathtaking that 'fish sink and geese fall, and even the moon hides in embarrassment'?"
"Pretty much." Fairy Eternity pouted.
"Back then, it was spring, the flowers were in full bloom, and the Nine-Tailed Foxes were competing in magic with the Heaven Dogs by the lake. The power of their magic was so great that the fish hid at the bottom of the lake out of fright, and the geese were not quick enough to flee and got caught in the attacks, burning to a crisp and falling pitter-patter to the ground."
"The Nine-Tailed Fox used the moonlight to create an illusionary realm, and the Heaven Dog nearly fell for it. In a panic, he used the Law of Heaven and Earth and swallowed the moon in one gulp."
"After their battle, the ground was in disarray, flowers withering."
Lu Yang: "..."
How come this doesn't match the scene I had in my mind?
"After the great battle, people began to say that the Nine-Tailed Fox possessed beauty that 'made fish sink and geese fall, and shame the moon and flowers.' I've always suspected that she herself started this legend."
"After all, when Yingtian Immortal organized the high-level cultivators to learn how to keep up their prestige, the Nine-Tailed Fox took it quite seriously."
Fairy Eternity had no regard for the Nine-Tailed Fox's petty tricks.
The ancient Nine-Tailed Fox was ranked among the top ten beauties of bygone times, but in terms of looks, she still couldn't surpass Fairy Eternity, the premier beauty of that top ten.
The top ten beauties was a list combining looks, power, and Fairy Eternity's subjective judgment.
Fairy Eternity unarguably placed herself at the top.
As far as Lu Yang knew, Fairy Eternity ranked the Dragon and Phoenix Clans' geniuses and her follower Qinghe second to fourth based on her closeness to them.
The little Qiongqi Jin Caiwei and the ancient Nine-Tailed Fox were also among the top ten beauties, with their ranks changing depending on Fairy Eternity's mood.
Lu Yang thought thankfully this was a list Fairy Eternity compiled after getting to know him, bragging and boasting.
If this list had existed in ancient times, those ten individuals would probably have fought over their rankings until no one knew what might happen.
Correction, it would be nine individuals. Fairy Eternity established her supremacy through strength, so the contest for the top spot was uncontested.
"Fairy, did you also learn with Yingtian Immortal how to maintain your prestige?"
Fairy Eternity raised an eyebrow, her expression proud and confident.
"As the leader of the Five Ancient Immortals, every move I make is profound. Why would I need to learn from others?"
At that moment, the Spiritual Space turned into a tropical rainforest, and Fairy Eternity was dressed in animal skins and a grass skirt, exuding a primal wild beauty.
Looking at this scene, Lu Yang just couldn't see the prestige in the Fairy.

chapters.title: Chapter 587 - 586 Alliance
chapters.content:
The Creation Ancient Land is governed by two restrictive rules.
First, those who have entered the Creation Ancient Land cannot do so a second time.
Second, those who have entered the Creation Ancient Land must not disclose any information about the challenges within.
The purpose of these two rules is to ensure the fairness of the trials in the ancient realm to the greatest extent possible.
Therefore, whether it be the Demon Race present here or the pure-blood members of the Human race, none have any knowledge of the Creation Ancient Land.
These rules are not absolute constraints; if Eldest Senior Sister were here, she would likely come and go from the ancient land without any hindrance.
However, such a feat is too difficult to accomplish for Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
"This ancient realm originates from the primordial times; it must be quite complex. Should we find an ally?" Lu Yang suggested.
The Golden Core Stage is when one's plasticity is at its highest. How a cultivator practices during the Golden Core Stage and the outcome of their core formation will influence the rest of their life.
A typical example is Fairy Eternity, whose Invincible Elixir, despite being shattered into a Nascent Soul, still exerts a profound influence to this day.
As such, the Creation Ancient Land has set the realm restriction at the Golden Core Stage.
To the entire Demon Territory, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou are outsiders. Even if they are capable fighters, if the Demon Territory's geniuses swarm them, even possessing the Invincible Elixir would be of no avail.
The most prudent approach is to find allies.
"That sounds good," Meng Jingzhou nodded gravely.
Not only do the two of them belong to the Human race, they also have the dual identities of Seek Dao Sect and the Meng Family. Should their identities be exposed, they fear the fate of Demon Territory's geniuses would be more dire than fortunate.
"How about the Phoenix Tribe? The Phoenix Tribe has some ties with the Seek Dao Sect, and I have acquaintances within the Phoenix Tribe," Third Senior Sister suggested from the side, currently sporting a pair of tiger ears, with her eyes covered and a tiger tail swishing behind her.
She was temporarily impersonating a member of the Qiongqi Clan.
"The Phoenix Tribe, huh... Senior Sister, do you know who wrote 'Dragon and Phoenix Transformation'?"
"No idea."
"Our Master wrote it."
Third Senior Sister was taken aback for a moment; she genuinely had no clue about that.
Once again, she realized the countless misdeeds of their master, too numerous to record, wondering when he might inadvertently cause another mishap.
She then sighed, "Had I known this, I wouldn't have gone so hard on the Dragons and Phoenixes during our last battle."
"How hard did you go?" Meng Jingzhou asked cautiously.
"Afraid my image would become their Inner Demon in their future cultivation."
"Let's not talk about that now; it's irrelevant to our current situation. The Dragon and Phoenix tribes probably don't know about Master's misdeeds yet; we can join forces."
"What about the Dragon Clan?"
"Not so good with the Dragon Clan. Back when I sought advancement in battle, I often challenged Dragons to single combat, so I don't have the best relationship with them."
"At that time, I was at the peak of the Divinity Transformation Stage, seeking a breakthrough. I roamed the Dragon territory, challenging those of similar strength, and hid from those I couldn't beat."
"It wasn't just the Dragon Clan; I fought the White Tiger Clan, the Zhuyan Clan, the Taozhu Clan, and so on."
"..."
The two felt that the bounty on Third Senior Sister was too low.
"I was caught by the Phoenix Clan last time and had to ask Eldest Senior Sister for help. She dealt with the elders, allowing me to fight with those of my generation."
"The Phoenix Clan knows my true identity, yet they have kept it secret, proving they are reliable."
"Then let's collaborate with the Phoenix Clan."
Lu Yang and the others all nodded in agreement, trusting Third Senior Sister's judgement.
The three approached the Phoenix Tribe, attracting cautious vigilance from the Phoenixes and the bird species that followed them.
"Halt, who are you?"
Jiang Shan demanded, eyeing the trio warily.
Especially cautious of Third Senior Sister, he felt she posed a danger.
"It is I, Gan Tian," Third Senior Sister said coolly, introducing herself.
Upon hearing this name, Jiang Shan retreated several steps.
Not just Jiang Shan, but also two others from the Phoenix Tribe, who recalled being pinned to the ground and beaten by Third Senior Sister, turned pale and also stepped back.
The Elder escorting the Phoenix Tribe's genius, Jiang Shishi, had previously exchanged knowledge about cultivation with Eldest Senior Sister and was aware of Third Senior Sister's identity.
"We would like to discuss a matter with the members of the Phoenix Tribe. Could we find a quiet place to talk?"
Third Senior Sister was referring to the followers of the Phoenix Tribe. The Phoenix Tribe could be trusted, but these followers were a different story.
"Good."
Three individuals, an Elder of the Phoenix Tribe, Jiang Shan, and Jiang Shishi, were called aside by Third Senior Sister.
"Let me introduce you, these two are my Junior Brothers, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou."
Upon hearing these two names, Jiang Shishi was moved and looked the two men over with surprise.
As a genius of the Phoenix Tribe and the future Clan Leader, she always demanded the highest standards of herself and paid close attention to the situation of Great Xia's geniuses, especially those of her own generation.
These two were the ones mentioned most often in the intelligence she had gathered.
Lu Yang's magic spells were unparalleled and he was rumored to be a Sword Cultivator, but no one had ever seen his sword unsheathed.
Meng Jingzhou had a pure Yang body, could ward off ghosts and evil spirits, diligently practiced as a Body Cultivator, and had achieved unity of fist and cultivation, though his full capabilities remained uncertain.
She regarded herself as a genius of exceptional talent yet wasn't sure if she could defeat either of them.
"What are you planning to do?" the Phoenix Tribe Elder asked.
"To form an alliance and enter the Ancient Realm with you."
The Phoenix Tribe Elder did not immediately refuse but seriously considered the proposition, weighing the pros and cons.
These two were the strongest Golden Core Stage pair in Great Xia, and in terms of combat power, they were much stronger than the followers of the Phoenix Tribe.
Moreover, these two were from the Seek Dao Sect. Jiang Shishi, since birth, had been carefully protected and idolized. Too pure at heart and too thin-skinned, she was not fit to be a Clan Leader.
It would be good for the influence of the Seek Dao Sect to rub off on her.
Although the Seek Dao Sect had an infamous reputation in the Demon Territory, the Phoenix Tribe Elder knew that the sect did not scam its own people and had a guarantee of credibility.
"It is possible."
"Fellow Daoist Jiang, I am looking forward to learning from you," Lu Yang said with a smile as he clasped his hands in greeting.
Jiang Shishi was a beat late to respond, and then she returned the greeting.
"Fellow Daoist Lu, I look forward to learning from you."
"Senior Brother Jiang Shan, it's been a while since we last met. The last time I saw you two was at the Foundation Establishment Stage. At that time, I could foresee that you would shine brightly in the Golden Core Stage, but I never expected you to be this powerful," Jiang Shan expressed with emotion.
"Shishi, who are these two?"
A hearty laugh echoed, belonging to the Young Master of the Jiuying Clan, followed by a Protector of the Jiuying Clan, whose presence exuded a subtle but palpable pressure.
Even though the laughter was hearty, his eyes faintly betrayed a gloom as they swept over Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
Jiang Shishi frowned, displeased with the Jiuying Clan's Young Master: "Qin Feng, I've told you many times, we are not that close. Stop using such familiar terms!"
"Who is he?" Lu Yang asked Jiang Shan through a secret voice transmission.
"Qin Feng, the Young Master of the Jiuying Clan, taken as a closed-door disciple by an Elder of the Jiuying Clan who has passed the Tribulation, his status no less than the Jiuying Clan Leader himself."
"Ever since he started his cultivation journey, he has pursued Shishi relentlessly but without success. He probably sees you two as rivals now, you should be cautious."
"Alright."
Without lingering too long, Qin Feng warned Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou with his gaze and then left.
The Protector of the Jiuying Clan remained silent from beginning to end, but the pressure he willfully emitted said everything.
Third Senior Sister noticed this scene and her eyebrows knitted slightly.
Two more hours passed, and the Ancient Realm opened. Lu Yang and the others followed Jiang Shishi into the Ancient Realm.
The Protectors of the various clans were left outside the Ancient Realm.
After the two Junior Brothers entered the Ancient Realm, Third Senior Sister left the Phoenix Tribe's company.
Before leaving, she threw a remark at the Phoenix Tribe, "When I come back later, pretend you don't know me."
Half an hour later, Third Senior Sister rode in on a blood-dripping animal hide from afar, her flight unsteady. The blood dripping from the hide was her own.
Third Senior Sister had suffered serious injuries.
"Look, it's Fairy Eternity!" An observer with keen eyesight recognized Third Senior Sister.
"It's her, how did she get injured!"
Severely wounded, Third Senior Sister bit her lip, relying solely on her will to fly there, and she shouted angrily:
"Zhuyan Clan! You have no honor. You invited me to explore the ancient tombs of various clans, and now you repay me with treachery, sending assassins after me!"
"Even if I must die, I shall take you down with me!"

chapters.title: Chapter 588 - 587: The Test Begins
chapters.content:
(I made an error in the last chapter; it should have been the Qiongqi Clan.)
The Elder of the Qiongqi Clan, upon seeing the Third Senior Sister severely injured to such an extent, displayed a ferocious expression. His eyebrows furrowed as he loudly retorted.
"Witch of the Melodic Demons, do not spit blood and slander! When did my Qiongqi Clan ever instruct you to do such a thing!"
Originally, upon seeing the Witch of the Melodic Demons appear, the crowd had been prepared to capture her, but seeing this scene, they tactfully refrained from making a move.
After all, the Witch of the Melodic Demons was seriously injured and couldn't run away. It was a good opportunity to clarify who exactly was behind her actions.
The Third Senior Sister sneered repeatedly, "Never done it? Daring to act but not to own up, cowards!"
"Previously, your Qiongqi Clan sent someone to contact me, saying you wanted to secretly investigate the foundations of the various clans, focusing particularly on whether any ancient ancestors were still alive. Seeing how generous your Qiongqi Clan was, I accepted the commission. Risking my life, I went to the tombs of various clans to investigate."
"At first, I was puzzled, wondering what your Qiongqi Clan wanted to do. Now I finally understand. Your Qiongqi Clan had long since pledged allegiance to the Ancient Di Jiang, investigating the foundations of the various clans, precisely for the purpose of controlling them all!"
"Now that the Ancient Di Jiang has risen to power, you want to discard me like a used tool, kill me to silence me!"
The Elder of the Qiongqi Clan angrily refuted, "Nonsense, who doesn't know that my Qiongqi Clan is so poor it needs to borrow from the Meng Family? Since when have we been generous?"
"If my Qiongqi Clan had indeed pledged allegiance to the Ancient Di Jiang, how could we be so destitute!"
The Third Senior Sister momentarily was at a loss for words, it seemed to be a valid point.
"Wait, I remember the first clan to pledge allegiance to the Ancient Di Jiang was the Jiuying Clan, and the first one the person who hired me asked me to investigate was also the Jiuying Clan!"
The Third Senior Sister suddenly pointed at the Elder of the Jiuying Clan, her body trembling slightly, not just from her injuries, but also from feeling betrayed.
"It was you, the Jiuying Clan, who hired me! To clear yourselves of suspicion, the first one you had me investigate was your own Jiuying Clan's tomb!"
The Elder of the Jiuying Clan nearly spat out a mouthful of old blood. He was just watching the drama, so how did he become the party being watched?
"Nonsense!"
The Third Senior Sister sneered, "Whether it's nonsense, you know best in your heart! The hatred for today's assassination attempt will be repaid another day!"
With that, she made to leave.
"Quick, stop her!"
Seeing the Witch of the Melodic Demons trying to flee, the Elders of the various clans immediately took action to pursue and block her.
The Third Senior Sister, seeing the situation turn dire, spat out a mouthful of Essence Blood. Using her last bit of strength, she activated the beast hide. The hide rose up as if riding clouds and mist, jumping through space several times before vanishing, leaving the demon crowd cursing furiously, especially the Jiuying Clan cursing the most viciously.
Half an hour later, the Third Senior Sister, having disguised herself well, returned to the Phoenix Tribe's ranks, looking nothing like someone who was seriously injured.
Even the Elder of the Phoenix Tribe couldn't help but transmit his voice to ask, "Was it really the Jiuying Clan that hired you?"
"Of course it's false. What just transpired was a play I performed alongside the Elder of the Qiongqi Clan, seizing the opportunity to clear the Qiongqi Clan of suspicion."
"The Ancient Di Jiang seeks to rule the Demon Territory through strength, and the clans are bound to be resentful. This is the perfect chance to teach the Jiuying Clan a lesson and sow discord among the clans."
"Were you really the first to go to the Jiuying Clan?"
"False. It's all the same whether you believe what I say or not."
The Third Senior Sister indeed did not have direct evidence to implicate the Jiuying Clan.
But to accuse someone, evidence is not necessary, suspicion is enough.
The Third Senior Sister said coldly, "Since the Jiuying Clan allows their Young Master to act with impunity, they must bear the consequences of retaliation."
…
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, who had already entered the Creation Ancient Land, were still unaware of the Third Senior Sister's actions as they listened attentively to the rules of the Ancient Realm.
Upon entering the Ancient Realm, a voice from above that couldn't be distinguished as male or female spoke.
"Welcome to the Secret Realm. The Secret Realm is divided into three layers. Only by entering the second layer will one gain opportunities. The higher the evaluation in each layer, the more abundant the opportunities."
A three-story pagoda appeared in front of everyone, with each level representing a different space – a miniature version of the Creation Ancient Land.
```
They were currently at the entrance of the first layer.
"This layer contains a large number of Nascent Soul Stage Demon Beasts. For every Demon Beast killed, one can obtain a spirit core. Acquiring ten spirit cores means passing the first layer's trial."
"The time limit for the first layer's trial is ten days."
"At the deepest part of the first layer, there is a stairway to the second layer, which can be accessed by possessing a certain number of spirit cores."
"It is important to note that the second layer's trial will only begin after the first layer's trial has completely ended."
"The first layer's trial starts now."
A huge hourglass appeared in the sky, visible from any location on the first layer. The sand trickled down, marking the countdown of ten days.
"Fairy, have you seen this Secret Realm before?"
Fairy Eternity shook her head, "No. I don't know if I have never seen it, or it appeared after I died."
Most of the Demon Race geniuses, after listening to the rules, dispersed in all directions to enter the first layer and slaughter Demon Beasts.
Killing ten Nascent Soul Stage Demon Beasts was not easy, not everyone could challenge those beyond their level like Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
And the rules also stated that the higher the assessment for each layer, the richer the rewards. Certainly, the more Demon Beasts killed, the better.
Meng Jingzhou stood still, scratched his chin, and thought the rules seemed strict. But on closer consideration, there were quite a few manipulable aspects.
Meng Jingzhou gave Lu Yang a look: What do you think?
Lu Yang roughly guessed Meng Jingzhou's thoughts and replied with a look: Let's start by killing a few Demon Beasts to warm up.
"Do you two want to join forces to kill the Demon Beasts?" Jiang Shishi inquired, the situation on the first layer was ideal for forming alliances.
Two of them could join forces to kill Demon Beasts more efficiently, while one observed from the sidelines to prevent others from stealing their fruits of labor.
As for the followers of the Phoenix Tribe, they formed their own teams to kill the Demon Beasts and would just meet up at the stairway.
The followers were not bodyguards, and clashing with the Demon Beasts was an excellent opportunity for training. There was no need to protect Jiang Shishi.
"Let's check out the quality of the Demon Beasts first."
Lu Yang was very cautious. It wouldn't be good to actually encounter a Demon Beast and find out that, like them, it had talent, and a Nascent Soul could exhibit the combat power of the Divinity Transformation Stage.
"Alright."
Jiang Shishi had been advised by an Elder before entering the Ancient Realm. If she encountered any issues within, it was best to consider the opinions of these two people.
The first layer was a dense forest environment with Nascent Soul Stage Demon Beasts lurking in the depths of the forest.
The three of them cautiously extended their Spiritual Sense. The sounds of fighting not far away startled a great ape hiding in the trees.
The ape had a tuft of white fur on its chest. It beat its chest and swung from tree to tree. With a roar, it swung its fists and violently smashed down towards the three.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, with their rich combat experience, had already noticed the existence of the ape.
"Arhat Fist!"
"Slash!"
The two of them acted simultaneously. Meng Jingzhou used the Arhat Fist to meet the great ape's fists. The ape lost in strength to Meng Jingzhou and was actually blasted into the sky.
Lu Yang exerted force with his legs, leaped upward, drew his sword, and returned it to its sheath, the body of the ape cut in half. The enormous head rolled and stopped at Jiang Shishi's feet.
Jiang Shishi was dumbstruck. This was a peak Nascent Soul Early Stage pure-blooded great ape, and they had resolved it so easily?
"Done!"
The two high-fived, relaxed and comfortable.
"Looks like they are all ordinary Nascent Soul Stage. We can carry out the plan."
```

chapters.title: Chapter 589 - 588 Plan (Fourth Release, Requesting Monthly Pass)
chapters.content:
"What plan?" Jiang Shishi asked curiously. With such transparent rules, was there even room for a plan?
And how much time had passed before you thought of a plan?
"It's simple when you put it that way. Through our battle just now, we've confirmed that the first layer's Demon Beasts are merely at the late stage of the Nascent Soul Stage, which falls within the range that your Demon Race geniuses can handle."
"So if we want to get past the first barrier, all we need to do is to honestly hunt Demon Beasts, and anyone can accumulate enough spirit beasts."
"If you want to obtain more spirit beasts and receive better evaluations, you'll need to employ some extraordinary methods."
"Forming groups of three to speed up the hunting progress?"
Meng Jingzhou shook his head, dismissing Jiang Shishi's suggestion: "It's too inefficient. Did you notice the map shown at the beginning? The first layer is absurdly large, and it would take a whole day to run from the entrance to the opposite ladder entrance. Relying on just the three of us to hunt and find Demon Beasts would take several hours."
"Then what should we do?" Jiang Shishi didn't have enough experience and lacked Meng Jingzhou's keen observations.
Meng Jingzhou didn't answer, but counter asked, "You already know the combat strength of the two of us brothers; how would you assess it?"
Jiang Shishi stared at them blankly and gave a fair assessment, "Not beneath me and Ao Yue."
Ao Yue was the prodigy of the current generation of the Long Clan.
Jiang Shishi and Ao Yue were known as the two great prodigies of the Demon Territory, possessing the potential of Immortals.
This was the highest evaluation in the Demon Territory, and among those who entered the Ancient Realm, only the two of them held such an evaluation.
"That settles it, the three of us working together will make the plan foolproof."
To ensure the plan was foolproof, the three decided to use eight days to kill thirty Demon Beasts, accumulating enough to pass through. That way, even if their plan to block the door failed, they could still guarantee to get through.
It was also a good opportunity for the trio to adapt to each other while hunting the Demon Beasts, which would increase the chances of success when executing the plan.
...
The eight days passed in a flash, and Lu Yang's team became more and more adept at killing Demon Beasts. Even those at the late stage of the Nascent Soul Stage could not last more than two rounds against them.
Lu Yang looked up at the hourglass.
"We killed a few more than planned, taking a bit more time, but no big issue, let's head to the ladder entrance first."
"Alright."
Jiang Shishi was somewhat excited, having been ready to execute the plan for some time.
The trio quickened their pace, rushing toward the ladder entrance.
Yet, when they arrived at the ladder entrance, they involuntarily stopped in their tracks, disbelieving the scene before them.
Lu Yang's plan was to block the door. With their combat strength, the three of them could easily prevent anyone from reaching the ladder entrance.
Progenies were expected to rush over on the last day, and they just needed to block the entrance one day in advance.
But now, someone had already blocked the ladder entrance.
They were the ones who had to obediently hand over the Essence Blood!
"Haha, didn't see that coming, did you? I've heard your plan a while ago!" The Jiuying Clan's Young Master Qin Feng laughed heartily upon seeing their expressions.
