"Right when you guys entered the first layer and started making plans, I overheard the entire process of your planning!"
Qin Feng, delighting at Lu Yang's grimace, said, "I may not know who you are, but thanks for coming up with the plan."
"Blocking the door? It's indeed a good plan, but when it comes to power in the Ancient Realm, who can surpass our Demon Clan Alliance? Not even the Dragon and Phoenix Clans are our match."
The Demon Clan Alliance was a concept proposed by the Ancient Di Jiang. Before the establishment of the Demon Nation, the demons led by Ancient Di Jiang collectively referred to themselves as the Demon Clan Alliance.
The Di Jiang Clan's prodigy was personally trained by Ancient Di Jiang and had not entered the Ancient Realm.
With the Di Jiang Clan at the forefront of the Alliance, and with no Di Jiang Clan present, the remaining races all vied for the command of this operation in the Ancient Realm.
Qin Feng was just worrying about how to gain command authority, and this was a pillow delivered to him while he was dozing.
If he had proposed the plan to block the door, wouldn't the command of the Alliance for this operation be assuredly his?
As he had anticipated, while the geniuses of the Alliance were pondering whether to get Essence Blood by killing Demon Beasts or seizing it from others, Qin Feng presented his plan and won everyone's approval. They all praised Qin Feng's plan as a good one.
Qin Feng naturally became the leader of this operation.
Qin Feng was smug, and standing behind him were geniuses from the White Tiger Clan, the Taozhu Clan, and more—a total of dozens of people.
Even if Lu Yang's team was capable, they couldn't beat all the geniuses of the Demon Clan Alliance!
Lu Yang's face was ashen as he quickly thought of a solution.
As the situation became deadlocked, followers of Jiang Shishi hurried over, also not expecting to be blocked by the Demon Clan Alliance.
Then, Ao Yue and the other nine prodigies arrived, frowning silently at the scene.
Following that, geniuses from the Qiongqi Clan and other unallied prodigies came.
The entrance to the ladder was so narrow, being blocked by the Alliance was not something that could be overcome by sheer numbers.
Ao Yue clenched his teeth, "How will we know if we don't try?"
Ao Yue had a lot of sway among the geniuses. He transformed into an Azure Dragon dancing in the sky while the Bai Xia Clan and other creatures showed their true forms, ready to follow Ao Yue into battle.
Seeing this, the other geniuses transformed into their original forms, the gentle-furred Jade Rabbit, the black Heavenly Dog as large as a hill, the Qiongqi with a tiger's body and double wings on its back…
"Fight!"
With a dragon's roar, Ao Yue shook the space around him, burning the Dragon Clan Essence Blood. His dragon claws gripped the Dragon Ball and transformed into a stream of azure ribbon-like energy, charging toward the Demon Clan Alliance.
With him alone, he was powerful enough to fight late-stage Nascent Soul Demon Beasts!
"Fight!"
The geniuses unleashed unprecedented power, fusing into a force like a rope, determined to break through the blockade.
Unfortunately for them, the Demon Clan Alliance had long anticipated this situation. Under Qin Feng's command, they advanced and retreated in order, not something that Ao Yue and his companions could break through with mere passion.
The two sides battled for a full half day, with the Demon Clan Alliance like an iron wall, always unbreakable.
In the end, exhausted, Ao Yue's side was defeated and retreated from the battlefield.
Qin Feng walked up to Ao Yue with a look of triumph: "Fellow Daoist Ao Yue, I don't wish to make our relationship this strained. After the Demon Nation is established, we'll still need to exchange insights and progress together."
"How about this? You leave behind ten Essence Cores, give me all the rest, and I'll let you pass through here. What do you say?"
Ao Yue suddenly looked up, staring intently at Qin Feng with bloodshot dragon eyes, startling him greatly.
But he quickly recovered, realizing that staring him down was useless, nothing more than impotent fury.
After wavering back and forth, Ao Yue, pressured by the facts, handed over the Essence Cores.
A full twenty of them.
"As expected of Fellow Daoist Ao Yue, capable of killing so many Demon Beasts," Qin Feng said with a grin as he took the Essence Cores.
Seeing Ao Yue submit, the other geniuses also handed over their Essence Cores, keeping only their ten.
If they only had ten, then Qin Feng simply wouldn't let them pass.
Looking at the mountainous pile of Essence Cores, Qin Feng's smile was so wide he could hardly close his mouth, distributing them to all the geniuses of the Demon Clan Alliance according to the pre-arranged ratio.
Qin Feng claimed the highest proportion, receiving fifty-three cores.
Behind the Demon Clan Alliance was a huge box labeled "Essence Cores."
Qin Feng poured all fifty-three Essence Cores into the box.
It was still that emotionless voice.
"Qin Feng, fifty-three Essence Cores. Please proceed to the second layer."
Seeing that the time was about right, the geniuses of the Demon Clan Alliance also handed their Essence Cores to the Ancient Realm to obtain the qualification to pass through.
Next were Ao Yue and the others.
"Ao Yue, ten Essence Cores. Please proceed to the second layer."
"Dong Shu, ten Essence Cores. Please proceed to the second layer."
"…"
Since there was still some time left, Qin Feng strolled over leisurely to where Lu Yang and his two companions stood.
He blatantly ignored Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, not intending to let these two eye-sores enter the second layer at all.
Qin Feng approached Jiang Shishi, who was hanging her head low, and chuckled: "Shishi, I already told you that the two lackeys you recruited are useless. Look, now they can't even pass the level."
"As long as you agree to become my fiancée, you won't have to hand over your Essence Cores, and I'll let you pass. How about it?"
Jiang Shishi suddenly raised her head, revealing a smile: "Qin Feng, do you really think you have everything under control?"
"What do you mean!" Seeing Jiang Shishi smiling, Qin Feng inexplicably panicked.
Lu Yang, lying back casually, laughed: "Fellow Daoist Qin Feng, you need to work on your observational skills. You didn't even recognize my clone."
On the other side, Meng Jingzhou had transformed into Lu Yang's likeness.
Wooden Avatar!
Suddenly, a voice came from behind Qin Feng.
"Many thanks to Fellow Daoist Qin Feng for collecting so many Essence Cores for us."
Qin Feng spun around, his eyes wide with disbelief at the scene before him.
Meng Jingzhou had actually crawled out of the box, holding a large string of Essence Cores in his hands!
"We knew you were listening in at the time. You didn't really think that the three of us could block the exit, did you?"
"The blockade plan was for your ears to hear."
The rules never specified how the Essence Cores needed to be handed in, and anyone who saw a box labeled "Essence Cores" near the ladder would think that was the place for submission.
Plus, with everyone's attention on the Demon Clan Alliance, no one would notice anything odd about the box.
In fact, Meng Jingzhou had quickly built the box himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 590 - 590: 589
chapters.content:
Qin Feng thought he had hidden himself well, eavesdropping on the entire conversation of the three planners.
But among his peers, who could surpass Lu Yang in the use of Spiritual Sense?
After entering the first layer, Meng Jingzhou, using the map, calculated that even at their fastest, it would take a full day to travel from the entrance to the entrance of the heavenly ladder.
The first layer was a circular space, and since the rules stated that one must hunt Demon Beasts to obtain their essences, everyone's first instinct would be to scatter from the entrance, gradually exploring the first layer, looking for Demon Beasts, killing them, never thinking of checking out the heavenly ladder entrance for intel first.
Once the rules of the first layer were understood, both Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou thought of setting up a box at the heavenly ladder entrance to collect essences.
The only uncertainty in this plan was the unknown strength of the Demon Beasts. If a Demon Beast at the Nascent Soul Stage exerted power of the Spirit Transformation Stage, then not even the geniuses of the Demon Race would be able to obtain ten essences, let alone be fooled at the heavenly ladder entrance. Wouldn't it be faster for the three of them to join forces to hunt and gather essences?
Therefore, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou immediately hunted a Demon Beast with Jiang Shishi to gauge its strength.
Once they confirmed it only had the power of the Nascent Soul Stage, Meng Jingzhou immediately set off to the heavenly ladder entrance, leaving Lu Yang and Jiang Shishi behind.
To hide their true intentions, Lu Yang used the Tree-Planting Technique and Imitation Fist to transform his Clone into the appearance of Meng Jingzhou.
Lu Yang then sensed Qin Feng hiding in a secret place, decided to turn the tables, and made up a plan about blocking the entrance on the surface, while secretly conveying the real plan to Jiang Shishi using Spiritual Sense.
Only then did Jiang Shishi display anxiety and excitement. If she were to come up with a plan, not to mention in the shortest time, even ten days wouldn't be enough for her.
Is this the wisdom of the Human race geniuses?
Lu Yang and Jiang Shishi hunted Demon Beasts methodically, intentionally delaying their arrival at the heavenly ladder entrance.
That led to the scene just witnessed.
"Friend Qin Feng, you've worked hard. I'll take these essences," Meng Jingzhou stood at the edge of the box, laughing heartily as the essences, strung up and tied around him like zongzi, made everyone envious.
This was the accumulation of essences that all geniuses had gathered over ten days!
"Bastard!" Qin Feng, enraged, transformed into his true form, Jiuying. Jiuying had nine heads on a single body, each looking like a jet-black serpent.
All eighteen of his eyes were bloodshot, as if they could drip blood.
The plan to block the entrance was his suggestion to the geniuses of the Demon Clan Alliance, which led him to naturally assume a leading role.
Now that the plan had backfired, and he had been exploited, with no essences left, the geniuses of the Demon Clan Alliance would undoubtedly vent their fury on him.
Even if he had an ancestor at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage to cover for him, he would definitely not be able to withstand the wrath of these races.
"Return the essences!" Qin Feng roared, all nine serpent heads lunging at Meng Jingzhou, who had long anticipated such a foolish move from Qin Feng and sidestepped to dodge.
Seeing this, the geniuses of the Demon Clan Alliance realized they had been played by Meng Jingzhou, also revealed their Demon Race true forms, and pounced at Meng Jingzhou.
They surely could not fail to secure even a single essence and be unable to pass the first layer!
Ao Yue had thunder clapping in his palm, wondering whether or not to make a move and snatch the essences.
After all, their essences were also on Meng Jingzhou.
At that moment, Jiang Shishi stepped forward, blocking Ao Yue.
Pointing at the lively Meng Jingzhou, she said, "This person is my ally. We had already anticipated the Demon Clan Alliance's actions and laid an ambush in advance. Junior Brother Ao Yue, please rest assured, as should you, fellow Daoists. Our action was directed solely against the Demon Clan Alliance.
After he escapes, we will give ten essences to each one of you, ensuring that you can successfully enter the second layer."
That too was a pretext she and Lu Yang had discussed in advance.
From Ao Yue and the others' perspective, they didn't know that Qin Feng had been tricked by Lu Yang and the others; they could only assume that Lu Yang and his two companions were simply more skilled and had anticipated Qin Feng's actions, hiding in the box to stand for justice.
Having recovered what they lost, Ao Yue and the others wouldn't demand more essence, ten would suffice.
As a result, not only did Lu Yang and his two associates earn a reputation, but they also obtained the most essences.
Jiang Shishi felt lucky that the Elder had the foresight to agree to the proposal of joining hands; otherwise, she would have only had a pitiful ten essences.
Sometimes, she felt a shiver of fear thinking about it; the two human race geniuses were too calculating. No wonder the Elder always said that her talent for cultivation was enough, but she was somewhat lacking in wisdom; this was the difference.
"Thank you, Young Master Jiang!" The geniuses expressed their gratitude to Jiang Shishi for her generosity, with tears in their eyes.
Ao Yue always felt that something wasn't right, but now wasn't the time to dwell on it. Hadn't the Demon Clan Alliance just bullied them terribly? Wasn't this the time to strike back?
"Everyone, let's join forces and help this kind-hearted fellow break free!"
Ao Yue transformed into his Azure Dragon true form, his Dragon Ball bursting with thunder, and accompanied by a dragon's roar, swung his dragon claws, rampaging through the Demon Clan Alliance.
Seeing this, the geniuses of the Demon Race also charged toward the Demon Clan Alliance with howls.
The Demon Clan Alliance, while chasing Meng Jingzhou and fending off the attacks from Ao Yue and the other demons, coupled with their distrust of Qin Feng and their refusal to take orders, soon fell into disarray and fled in a panic.
"How about it, Miss Jiang, didn't you make a good deal by joining hands with us?" Lu Yang said with a chuckle. After arriving at the entrance to the ladder to heaven, he had not taken action himself, everything unfolding just as he had expected.
Especially watching Meng Jingzhou jumping here and there to dodge attacks, like a monkey, while he was resting comfortably in the back, Lu Yang felt even more content.
"Indeed, it was worthwhile," Jiang Shishi nodded. It was more than worthwhile; it was a windfall. Although the events of the Ancient Realm couldn't be disclosed, all the geniuses knew very well that just this action alone would elevate her status in their eyes.
The Demon Clan Alliance scattered, fleeing in all directions. The rules didn't state that killing was forbidden; if one died in the Ancient Realm, the laws of the realm prohibited recounts of what happened there, meaning no vengeance for the dead.
Meng Jingzhou, who had safely found Lu Yang and Jiang Shishi, was panting heavily and, upon seeing Lu Yang's carefree demeanor, knew he had again picked up the thankless task.
There was no choice; after all, he didn't know the Tree-Planting Technique or the Imitation Fist.
According to their agreement, Meng Jingzhou gave each of the geniuses ten essences, and the remaining eight hundred essences were divided between the three of them.
Everyone searched for a long time but couldn't find where to submit the essences. Ao Yue tentatively stepped onto the ladder to heaven, and with ten essences absorbed by the ladder, he was transported to the second layer; that's when everyone realized how to pass through the first layer.
One by one, everyone lined up and entered the second layer, leaving behind the geniuses of the Demon Clan Alliance lurking not far away.
Seeing that Lu Yang and the others had gone up, Qin Feng also wanted to enter the second layer, but without a single essence on him, a barrier appeared in front of the ladder to heaven, blocking his way.
As the last grain of sand fell in the hourglass, marking the end of the ten days, all the geniuses from the Demon Clan Alliance were teleported outside the Ancient Realm.
"It's all your fault, Qin Feng!"
The geniuses of the Demon Clan Alliance's eyes reddened with rage. The fortunes of Creation Ancient Land were gigantic, but they hadn't gained a single advantage.
"Protector, save me!"
Qin Feng, frightened, hurriedly hid behind the Protector.
Only then did he notice the atmosphere was somewhat off, or rather heavy, as if the glances from all races were inconspicuously converging on their Jiuying clan and they were not friendly.
What happened here?

chapters.title: Chapter 591 - 590: Seed
chapters.content:
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had no idea what was happening in the outside world. Disguised as geniuses of the Demon Race, they officially entered the second layer.
The second layer was fragrant with flowers, blooming in profusion, and everywhere lay beautiful scenery.
It was an endless flower garden, and within the garden, a graceful figure knelt on the ground, inhaling the fragrance of the flowers.
Noticing everyone's arrival on the second layer, the figure stood up and welcomed them with a smile and applause.
"Everyone, welcome to the second layer. I am the Spirit of the Secret Realm, and you can call me Luo Hong."
The Spirit of the Secret Realm exists only in Secret Realms created by those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, not a life form but more like a predefined magic spell.
However, this magic spell, imbued with ample experience, could mimic the thinking patterns of life.
The Primeval Secret Realm was an ancient one, and when announcing the rules at the first layer, it used modern language because the Spirit of the Secret Realm, Luo Hong, was learning.
In the absence of the Secret Realm's master, the Spirit of the Secret Realm held the highest authority.
"Greetings to our senior."
Although everyone knew she was a magic spell, no one dared to overtly treat Luo Hong as merely a spell, and they paid their respects earnestly.
"It seems this generation is still quite polite."
Luo Hong, unaffected by their politeness, clapped her hands gently, and a flower pot, along with a seed, fell on top of everyone's head.
"The first layer tested your combat strength, the second your character."
"The challenge of this layer is very simple: you must grow flowers."
"The seeds you hold are of the Moonshadow Flower, which when in bloom resemble a stunning beauty dancing in the moonlight, a feast for the eyes."
"The Moonshadow Flower takes fifteen days to complete its growth cycle. All you need to do is to make it bloom within this period, and you shall pass this level."
"The more vigorously the flower grows, the higher the evaluation."
"Mind you, during this time, you must not use any magic spells, Spirit Treasures, or other cultivator methods."
"Also, you may not converse with each other; you must grow the flower independently."
Seeing the tension among the crowd, Luo Hong added with a smile, "Don't be too nervous; the Moonshadow Flower is easy to care for. It takes root and sprouts as soon as it touches soil."
"Fairy, have you ever heard of the Moonshadow Flower?" Lu Yang asked stealthily.
"I have heard of it, indeed. The flower is quite beautiful and popular. If you haven't heard of it, it must be extinct by now," she replied.
The rules of the second layer seemed simple, alas he could not discuss them with Old Meng.
Jiang Shishi cradled the flower pot, planting the seed in the soil, loosening the dirt, and watering it carefully, yet the Moonshadow Flower showed no signs of sprouting.
Jiang Shishi frowned, instinctively wanting to consult with Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, but remembering the rule against discussing, she gave up the thought.
She began to recall the rules over and over, pondering if she had missed anything.
"What would Lu Yang do if he were in my place..."
...
Fifteen days swiftly passed, and the day of evaluation arrived.
The geniuses of the Demon Race and the two pure-blooded Humans lined up, waiting for Luo Hong's assessment.
One standing at the front was Su Lian'er of the Fox Clan.
Clothed in white, Su Lian'er's beauty was stunning as she held the flower pot, looking pitiful.
The flower pot was empty.
Luo Hong frowned, "Where is your flower?"
Tears streamed down Su Lian'er's face, compelling onlookers to wipe them away.
"The flower was growing very well, but I have inherited the beauty of our ancestors that can overshadow the fish and outshine the moon. As soon as the Moonshadow Flower bloomed, it withered away at the sight of me."
After staring at Su Lian'er for a long while, Luo Hong finally let out a long breath.
"Let it be, you pass."
Next was Jiang Shishi.
The Moonshadow Flower in Jiang Shishi's pot bloomed beautifully, captivating all who saw it.
Luo Hong nodded her approval, signifying a pass.
Then came Ao Yue.
Ao Yue's pot, too, was empty, without a trace of the Moonshadow Flower.
"Where's your flower?"
Ao Yue cupped his fists, respectfully saying, "I must inform my senior, I have not grown a flower."
"Give me a reason."
Hearing this question, Ao Yue straightened up and smiled, "Senior had mentioned at the very beginning that the second layer of the test was to assess integrity. In my opinion, the seeds given to us by senior couldn't grow Moonshadow flowers. This challenge tests our honesty!"
"...You have been eliminated."
"Why!" Ao Yue was frantic; he felt he should have been able to pass.
Luo Hong sneered coldly, "You still have the nerve to ask why. Indeed, I gave you all cooked seeds that couldn't sprout flowers, but who told you that this round was testing for honesty? The Human race is cunning and shameless. Does the Demon Race still talk about honesty? Can your honesty defeat the Human race?"
"This round tested lies."
"Although the lie told by the little girl from the Nine-Tailed Fox Clan was crude, she did lie, so I consider her to have passed."
"What about Jiang Shishi? How did she grow a Moonshadow flower?"
Luo Hong continued to sneer coldly, "Didn't you listen when I laid out the rules earlier? I said to make a flower grow in the pot. When did I say you had to plant the seeds I gave you?"
Ao Yue was left speechless by her words; when he thought about it carefully, indeed that was the case.
Not just Ao Yue, but all the Demon Race geniuses following him were holding empty pots, shamefully hanging their heads.
They all thought Luo Hong was testing for honesty.
Jiang Shishi breathed a sigh of relief after hearing this; fortunately, she had imitated Lu Yang's way of thinking, carefully studied the rules, and understood what Luo Hong wanted.
The Demon Race geniuses lined up behind Ao Yue were unsurprisingly eliminated one after another, and Luo Hong walked all the way to Meng Jingzhou before stopping.
She examined Meng Jingzhou from head to toe, intrigued by his active performance in the first round.
"Where's your flowerpot?"
Meng Jingzhou was empty-handed. Forget the flower, he didn't even have a pot.
"Please come with me."
Meng Jingzhou gestured for Luo Hong to follow him to a place brimming with Moonshadow flowers that looked extraordinarily beautiful.
Meng Jingzhou's pot had its bottom removed, encircling the most lush cluster of Moonshadow flowers, like a fence.
Meng Jingzhou, somewhat embarrassed, scratched the back of his head, smiling so wide it reached his ears, "Ah, I'm really embarrassed, I don't know what happened, but my flowers just grew so much they broke a hole through the pot. As you can see, this is the result."
"I remember you said, senior, that the more vigorously the flowers grew, the higher the evaluation, right?"
Luo Hong: "..."
I did say the more vigorously the flowers grew, the higher the evaluation, but this is just ridiculous.
It was blatantly obvious that he'd seen through the challenge being a test of lies and started spouting nonsense.
"You've passed."
The last one was Lu Yang, and his flowerpot was completely empty—no flower, not even soil.
"It's empty, you haven't passed..."
"Wait a moment," Lu Yang raised his hand to interrupt.
"The condition for passing was to make the flowerpot sprout a flower within fifteen days, correct?"
"Yes."
"Then I have passed."
"Where's your flower?"
Lu Yang pointed to the flowers all around the garden, confidently saying, "During these fifteen days, I have been transplanting the flowers from the garden into the pot and then moving them out again, replacing them with another batch, then moving those out too."
"All the flowers in the garden can be considered to have grown from my pot."
"If senior doesn't believe me, you can check the roots of all the flowers in the garden; they definitely have dirt from my pot on them."
Luo Hong: "..."
The condition for passing wasn't specified as the fifteenth day, it was the fifteen days since the start of the competition.
Luo Hong herself hadn't realized there was this loophole in the rules.
"That's not right. The second layer's test was to see whether you possess the quality to lie," Luo Hong tried to make a comeback for herself.
"Right, I just made everything up on the spot."

chapters.title: Chapter 592 - 591: Unusual Rewards
chapters.content:
Luo Hong: "..."
The reply from Lu Yang brought a huge shock to Luo Hong, to the point where she didn't know how to respond for a short while.
Since her birth, she had been a spirit of the Secret Realm, having seen all the geniuses of the Demon Race over the past 300,000 years. Nowadays, the leaders of the Demon Race who were young had all come here to attempt the trials.
Yet none of the geniuses from any race had brought her such a shock as she experienced today.
The second layer's test was indeed the ability to lie, but she never imagined someone could fabricate a lie so convincing that it deceived even her.
Or was what he said really a lie?
With her existing knowledge, she couldn't tell whether what Lu Yang said was true or false.
Fairy Eternity laughed hysterically in the Spiritual Space, rolling on the ground, gasping for air as she laughed, tears streaming from her eyes.
"No, no, I can't, my stomach hurts from laughing, hahahaha..."
She wiped away the tears at the corners of her eyes and tried to hold it in, but as soon as she saw Luo Hong's reaction, she couldn't help but burst into laughter again.
Lu Yang looked at Fairy Eternity helplessly, questioning whether this was really necessary.
And Elder Luo Hong, are you really unable to cope with this, isn't this the very thing the test is about?
Lu Yang always adhered to the rules in his actions, ensuring he didn't go beyond their scope.
If it's possible to do well within the rules, why bother to cheat?
The rules for this challenge were very simple, and the loopholes left by Elder Luo Hong were clear at a glance.
For example, there was no rule stating that the seeds had to bloom, or stipulating that they must only bloom on the fifteenth day, and so on.
The only uncertainty was whether Lu Yang could guarantee the real test here was to tell the truth or to lie.
After all, the rules for the second layer were declared by Elder Luo Hong herself; if Elder Luo Hong didn't abide by them, who could do anything to her?
Therefore, Lu Yang had made preparations for both scenarios, bringing an empty flowerpot for the assessment.
If the test was to tell the truth, he would simply say he hadn't managed to grow anything.
If the test was to tell lies, he would bring out the same set of pretexts he had just used.
Luo Hong took a couple of deep breaths, clenching and unclenching her fists, almost gritting her teeth as she announced the result.
"You... passed!"
It had to be acknowledged that, on the second layer, Lu Yang's performance was the highest in history.
Ao Yue and a cohort of Demon Race geniuses watched Lu Yang in shock.
From which race did this man come, having calculated since the first layer that Qin Feng would wait at the entrance of the ladder, setting up an ambush in advance?
During the second layer, he even used such an extraordinary method to pass the challenge.
Where had Jiang Shishi found these two exceptional talents?
And based on Ao Yue's understanding of Jiang Shishi, she should have made the same choice as himself for this challenge; yet the result was completely beyond his expectations—himself eliminated, Jiang Shishi progressed.
After the second layer's test concluded, Luo Hong forced herself not to think about Lu Yang's matter, fulfilling her duty.
She snapped her fingers, and a heap of treasures fell like rain, piling into a small mountain.
Luo Hong pointed to Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, Jiang Shishi, Su Lian'er: "You four proceed to the third layer; the rest are eliminated."
"Considering that you have already passed the first layer, each person may choose one treasure as a reward."
"This treasure can only be used by oneself, it cannot be transferred or recounted to another."
This rule was established to prevent powerful beings of the Demon Race from seizing the treasures.
After all, the treasures here could make even the Great Powers of the Demon Race envious.
"Demon Immortals above, this is the cultivation insight left by our Ancient Ancestor, including the stages of breaking core to reach Nascent Soul and the Nascent Soul Stage!" exclaimed the Jade Rabbit Race genius, his astonishment making his rabbit ears twitch and flutter.
Luo Hong had already translated these cultivation insights.
"Our Ancient Ancestor's cultivation insights are here too!" exclaimed a genius from the Qiongqi Clan in surprise.
Written on the cultivation insights were the words "Metal and Stone," indeed the name of the ancient Qiongqi.
It was not just these two races—ancient cultivation insights from clans such as the Jiuying Clan and the Taozhu Clan that had been eliminated in the first layer were also piled here, mixed with other books; without meticulous searching, they simply could not be found.
These Ancient Ancestors of the various clans were not all Semi-Immortals; more of them were at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
But the Transcendance Tribulation Stage of ancient times was not the same as the present. One from the ancient Transcendance Tribulation Stage could attend lectures given by Immortals and listen in on exchanges between Semi-Immortals; what they learned and heard was not on the same level as those of the Demon Race of the current Tribulation Stage!
Even among those at the Tribulation Stage, there was a distinction in status between an emperor of the ancient Tribulation Stage and one from the present in the eyes of the Demon Race.
Ao Yue also found the cultivation insights left by the Dragon Clan Ancestor, which made his heart thump wildly.
The Dragon Clan Ancestor was known as the most esteemed person below the Immortals, absolutely powerful.
"What is this, notes from an Immortal, 'Mating Records of the Golden Crow Clan and the Jade Rabbit Clan'?" The genius from the Rabbit Race was so startled upon seeing the title that he almost didn't hold onto the book firmly.
Lu Yang: "..."
He remembered that this thing was research on the changes of Yin and Yang conducted by Immortal Jiuchong. The things you people have collected in the Creation Ancient Land are quite complete, to have even this.
Aside from various ancient texts and photocopies, there were ancient heavenly materials and earthly treasures.
Such as the longevity grass that could extend one's life by five hundred years, the spirit fruits that could eliminate hidden injuries upon consumption, and various detoxifying herbs.
In previous years, there had been geniuses from the Demon Race whose relatives or lovers were afflicted with ancient deadly poisons, with their lives hanging by a thread and with no current means to detoxify them, who came to the Ancient Realm to overcome the challenges, searching for ancient herbs that had long been extinct.
This time, though, such an incident hadn't occurred.
"These things..." Fairy Eternity frowned slightly, swinging back and forth on a tree trunk.
"What's wrong with these things?"
"These items don't seem like something ordinary members of the Demon Race could collect."
"Many of the cultivation insights are from Semi-Immortals; ordinary Semi-Immortals wouldn't have the clout to demand the cultivation insights of other Semi-Immortals."
"And this 'Mating Records of the Golden Crow Clan and the Jade Rabbit Clan,' it's the research findings of Immortal Jiuchong. Only the four of us received photocopies; not even the Semi-Immortals have them."
"Who built this Ancient Realm?" Fairy Eternity wondered.
Lu Yang's heart skipped a beat upon hearing this.
It implied that this Ancient Realm was not the work of a Tribulation Stage member of the Demon Race, nor a Semi-Immortal, but could it be one of the Four Ancient Immortals?!
"Never mind, there's still the third layer. If you work hard to overcome the challenges, you might find a clue on the third layer."
"And what if I still can't find any clues?"
Fairy Eternity flashed a radiant smile, her teeth neatly aligned, and gave a thumbs up, "Then we'll pick a secluded place to give this little missy named Luo Hong a good interrogation!"
Lu Yang prayed he would find a clue on the third layer.
The geniuses from the Demon Race selected the treasures they fancied. Ao Yue did not choose the cultivation insights left by the Ancient Ancestor but instead took a spirit fruit that could eliminate hidden injuries.
Ao Yue and the others were transported out of the Ancient Realm.
Outside the Ancient Realm, the atmosphere was tense; all members of the Demon Race eyed the Jiuying Clan with intense scrutiny.
One could only enter the Creation Ancient Land once in their lifetime, to have gained nothing and to have believed the nonsense from Qin Feng, resulting in the elimination of the geniuses from the Demon Clan Alliance.
Qin Feng was hiding behind an elder, trembling with fear, worried that showing his face would result in being skinned alive.
As Ao Yue and the others were teleported out, the Phoenix Tribe Elder counted the number of people and breathed a sigh of relief; Jiang Shishi was still inside.
Jiang Shishi was about the same level as Ao Yue, and it was feared that if Ao Yue was eliminated, Jiang Shishi would be too.
Third Senior Sister spoke in an even tone, "You see, I told you that you wouldn't be let down if you cooperated with us."

chapters.title: Chapter 593 - 592: Meng Jingzhou: There is a Scandal
chapters.content:
The Phoenix Tribe Elder nodded in agreement. In his youth, he had also entered the Creation Ancient Land and knew that with Jiang Shishi's Mind State, it would be difficult for her to enter the third level, and she would most likely be eliminated.
Since she was not eliminated, it indicated a significant improvement in Jiang Shishi's Mind State.
To become a qualified leader, one's own strength is not enough; one must be calculating and learn to be thick-skinned.
The best at being thick-skinned was the Qiongqi Clan Leader.
"Who is still not out, Jiang Shishi and Su Lian'er?" a Demon Clan Elder counted the numbers, noticing the geniuses from the Phoenix Tribe and the Nine-Tailed Fox Clan had yet to come out.
"That's not right, there are still two others inside who followed Jiang Shishi," Qin Feng called out. Although he did not know the races and names of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, he would certainly never forget their faces.
"Oh, they followed Jiang Shishi?" Jiuying Clan Elder squinted his eyes, sensing a problem.
"Elder Jiang Wei, this is not quite right, is it? We had an early agreement that each tribe can only select one person to enter the Creation Ancient Land, yet your Phoenix Tribe sent in three?"
He was eager to shift the controversy, and according to Qin Feng's account, the Demon Clan Alliance's geniuses were eliminated in the first round, and the Phoenix Tribe couldn't shirk responsibility!
"What does it matter if three people entered?" Elder Jiang Wei sneered, not at all intimidated. In terms of heritage, the Phoenix Tribe was the strongest in the Demon Territory; even Ancient Di Jiang would not dare to control them for the time being.
The Dragon Clan was divided into two groups, one in the Demon Territory and the other in the East Sea, with their heritage split as well. The Dragon Clan in the Demon Territory could not match the Phoenix Tribe when it comes to heritage.
Elder Jiang Wei took the initiative to shoulder the matter, as he couldn't possibly reveal that Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were from the Human race or even from the Seek Dao Sect upon further questioning.
Claiming that Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were from the Phoenix Tribe might prevent conflict, as the Phoenix Tribe always acted domineeringly.
If it were revealed that the two were from the Seek Dao Sect, other tribes looking on would probably wade into the dispute.
If Gan Tian saw her own clan being bullied and called Yun Zhi over, the situation would become even more entertaining.
"The Phoenix Tribe really is domineering," members of the Taozhu Clan, the White Tiger Clan, and other Demon Clan Alliance tribes stepped forward to support the Jiuying Clan.
If they could use this opportunity to severely weaken the Phoenix Tribe, they could gain favor from Ancient Di Jiang.
"The Phoenix Tribe has a large family and business, and it's fine for them to hide two geniuses and send them in," the Dragon Clan Elder stepped forward to back the Phoenix Tribe.
He had learned that Ao Yue managed to enter the second level with the help from Jiang Shishi and obtained the Spirit Fruit to heal his dark injuries, a favor that should not go unrepaid.
"I think it's understandable for the Phoenix Tribe to make an exception this time," the Jade Rabbit Clan Elder waved his sleeve and stepped forward.
"My Tengu Clan..."
"My Ba Xia Clan..."
More and more members of the Demon Race started voicing support for the Phoenix Tribe.
Apart from the Demon Clan Alliance members, all the Demon Race geniuses here had received help from the Phoenix Tribe.
Third Senior Sister twitched at the corner of her eyes as she "witnessed" this scene.
What did these two youngsters do in the Secret Realm? Why were these Demon Races behaving as if they were intoxicated, standing on the side of the Phoenix Tribe?
This was not the scene when her master and the others entered the Secret Realm.
...
Lu Yang and his companions were transported by Luo Hong to the third level, which was extremely dim, almost pitch black, and otherwise empty.
Luo Hong took out four grass mats and sent them flying to the ground as if dealing cards.
"Don't be nervous, sit down. All four of you performed quite well in the first two levels already. Even if you don't pass the third challenge, your rewards will be much greater than the others," she said.
In the first level evaluation, Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, and Jiang Shishi were tied for the first place in history.
The second level evaluation ranked Lu Yang the highest, followed by Meng Jingzhou, then Jiang Shishi, and finally Su Lian'er.
The overall ranking was the same as the second level evaluation.
Lu Yang's score was the highest in history, followed by Meng Jingzhou as the second highest.
Lu Yang appeared the most relaxed, taking a seat as soon as he was told to.
The four sat down.
"How about it, want to bet on who will have the higher evaluation in the third challenge?" Meng Jingzhou winked at Lu Yang, eager to regain some ground.
"That wouldn't be good," Lu Yang said with a smile that did not match the sentiment of "not good."
Both of them were not ones to easily admit defeat.
What's the point of a bet if it's sure to win?
Meng Jingzhou saw Lu Yang smile and knew he had agreed, so he asked again, "What's the reward for the winning side?"
"You tell me."
"The losing side must do something for the winning side."
"It's a deal!"
Neither of them set any conditional limits, such as staying within their capabilities or moral boundaries. They both knew the other's request would certainly fall within those limits, no need for further discussion.
Luo Hong cleared her throat.
"As a member of the Demon Race, one must never forget history. You should gain experience and lessons from history."
"This third challenge tests your grasp of the ancient history of the Demon Race."
Lu Yang: "..."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Damn it, there's a dirty trick here. This is no competition at all.
Luo Hong, unaware of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou's thoughts, continued with the procedure.
"After I ask a question, you may buzz in to answer. A correct answer earns one point, a wrong answer loses one point, and no answer gets no points."
"Considering historical changes, I will ask questions from the perspective of the current-era Demon Race."
"Now, listen to the first question: Which race does a Demon Immortal belong to?"
Jiang Shishi and Su Lian'er were both startled.
Which race does a Demon Immortal belong to? Who knows that?
Many scholars of the Demon Race have studied ancient history and there are numerous speculations about the true form of a Demon Immortal. Should they just guess randomly?
"The Demon Immortal belongs to no race; he is the only Kirin in the world."
Lu Yang answered lazily—it was an easy question.
Meng Jingzhou yawned, utterly bored, already considering what to eat when he got back.
"Correct answer, one point."
Jiang Shishi and Su Lian'er looked uncertainly at Lu Yang. Was that a lucky guess or did he really know the true identity of the Demon Immortal?
Lu Yang thought to himself that this was just the tip of the iceberg; if they wanted to hear the shameful past of the Qilin Immortal, he could talk for three days and nights without stopping.
Luo Hong was quite surprised at the speed of his answer.
The questions of the third level were random; the queries at each test were different, and she was only responsible for judging right and wrong, without revealing the correct answers.
"Second question: Did the Phoenix Ancestor ever force the Demon Immortal to use the Sword Array, and if so, please describe the scenario from an objective and impartial point of view."
Jiang Shishi's eyes lit up. She might not know about the rest, but how could she not know about the Phoenix Ancestor?
Su Lian'er watched Jiang Shishi enviously. Why couldn't they ask about something related to the Nine-Tailed Fox Clan?
Jiang Shishi excitedly raised her hand and said, "I know this one. My Phoenix Ancestor once spoke the truth which made the Demon Immortal unable to raise his head, and with a plop, he kneeled on the ground. Under tremendous pressure, the Demon Immortal activated the Sword Array to resist but still ended up defeated and retreated!"
"This is the famous 'A Word Makes the Immortal Kneel' incident!"
"I guess this must have been before the Demon Immortal attained immortality."
Otherwise, it doesn't make sense that the Demon Immortal would lose to the Phoenix Ancestor.
"Incorrect answer, lose one point."
"What?!" Jiang Shishi questioned if she had heard wrong. This was a story she heard from her Clan Leader, absolutely reliable. How could it be wrong?
Seeing that no one else was answering, Lu Yang sighed softly and said, "I'm not sure about the specific incident you're referring to, Elder, but the only thing I can confirm is that on that day the Demon Immortal went home, the Phoenix Ancestor glared at him and asked coldly, 'Who did you go to see?' "
"Upon hearing this, the Demon Immortal's face changed drastically. He pulled out the Sword Array, knelt on it with a plop, swore to heaven that he would dare not do it again, and if he erred once more, he would be struck by five thunderbolts."
"Correct answer, add one point."

chapters.title: Chapter 594 - 593 How Did I Become Second Place?
chapters.content:
The Qilin Immortal had knelt in the Sword Array not just once; Lu Yang alone had heard of it happening over a dozen times. The actual count was definitely higher, but Lu Yang was uncertain as to the reason for this kneeling.
As for the Qilin Immortal swearing an oath to heaven... with Yingtian Immortal around, let alone the heavens striking with thunderous roars, even if it thundered every day, it would not matter.
"What?!"
Jiang Shishi stared blankly at Lu Yang, then shifted her gaze to Luo Hong's face.
After going back and forth three times, she finally confirmed that Lu Yang had indeed given the correct answer.
That's not what the Clan Leader told her, was it?
How come these two know more about the Phoenix Tribe's history than our Clan Leader does?
"Wait, what do you mean by 'intimates'? What was the relationship between my Ancient Ancestor and the Demon Immortal?"
Jiang Shishi seemed to detect something alarming from the answer.
Wasn't it recorded in history that the Ancient Ancestor and the Demon Immortal were rivals, who had waged a great war over the position of immortality? In the end, the Ancient Ancestor was defeated, and the Demon Immortal ascended to immortality.
Why would my Ancient Ancestor speak to the Demon Immortal in such a tone?
It did not match the history she knew.
Jiang Shishi's mind was a mess, with a single question causing her beliefs to turn upside down, overturning all her previous knowledge.
Meng Jingzhou glanced at the bewildered Jiang Shishi and continued to ponder what to eat when he returned.
Su Lian'er also looked at Lu Yang with suspicion. How could someone know more about the Phoenix Tribe's history than Jiang Shishi did?
What was the identity of this person named Lu Yang?
Luo Hong did not mind the reactions of the crowd; their reactions did not affect her posing questions, as that was the procedure.
"Please listen to the third question. The Dragon Clan Ancestor was extremely powerful, a hurdle for all members of the Demon Race on their path to immortality. In Ancient Times, there was an exceptionally talented individual of the Demon Race, whose talent in cultivation was worrisome, but who was extremely gifted in researching Divine Abilities."
"This genius, burning the midnight oil, developed a Great Divine Skill called the 'Dragon-Slaying Eighteen Palms.' Theoretically, if one could master these eighteen palms, even the Dragon Clan Ancestor would be defeated by this Divine Ability."
"Yet this genius did not perfect this Great Divine Skill. What happened?"
The "Dragon-Slaying Eighteen Palms" was a widely known ancient Great Divine Skill in the Demon Territory, unquestionably powerful, with all Demon Race members seeking its whereabouts, to no avail.
There were many theories about why the "Dragon-Slaying Eighteen Palms" was not perfected.
Su Lian'er hurried to answer, "According to the ancient books of my clan, this genius spent a lifetime and still did not perfect this Divine Ability. It seems his talent was limited."
Luo Hong did not comment; Su Lian'er's answer could not be considered wrong.
Seeing Luo Hong silent, Jiang Shishi offered another explanation, "Our ancient books have similar records, suggesting that this Divine Ability was contrary to the heavenly order. The genius faced a life-and-death tribulation. Despite battling with all his might, he failed to cross it, hence he died and the Divine Ability remained incomplete."
Luo Hong turned her gaze to Meng Jingzhou, signaling that he could answer.
Meng Jingzhou looked at Luo Hong, signaling her to ask someone else.
Luo Hong shifted her gaze to Lu Yang.
Lu Yang, feeling a bit embarrassed under Luo Hong's stare, hesitated for a moment before revealing an ancient piece of secret knowledge.
"About that, I've heard a bit of news. It was said that the Dragon Clan Ancestor's Dao Fruit was the 'Survival of the Fittest Dao Fruit Prototype,' which, if she survived an attack without dying, would make her even stronger."
"Therefore, if she were to survive the fully realized 'Dragon-Slaying Eighteen Palms,' designed specifically to counter Dragons without dying, she would become even more formidable."
"Upon hearing of this genius's deeds, she went to visit him, hoping he would perfect the 'Dragon-Slaying Eighteen Palms,' to help her become stronger. The genius, hearing this, was also very pleased, hoping that the Dragon Clan Ancestor would go all out to provide him with a reference."
"When the Dragon Clan Ancestor exerted her full power, the winds and clouds changed, and stars shattered as if facing the end of days. Upon witnessing this scene, the genius was literally scared to death."
"Back then, people called this genius Ye Gong, and this is the famous 'Ye Gong who loves dragons'."
Luo Hong nodded, very satisfied with Lu Yang's answer, "Correct, add one point."
"As for you two, your answers were not completely correct, so no points added or deducted."
The characteristic of forgetting belongs to the Dao Fruit, not the Dao Fruit Outline, which doesn't possess this feature; so when Lu Yang spoke of the Dao Fruit Outline, everyone could remember it.
"Now, please listen to the fourth question. The Dragon Clan Ancestor and the Phoenix Ancestor had a fierce battle during their Semi-Immortal phase, where the Phoenix Ancestor died and was resurrected. Please describe the details of this battle."
Upon hearing that this was about their Phoenix Ancestor, Jiang Shishi's face lit up with excitement.
She was well aware of this battle, in which both ancestors moved with such tremendous force that even the stars in the sky turned to dust and the sun was extinguished, leaving the universe in dead silence – it was a battle for the ages. The Phoenix Ancestor was even revived in the flames, awakening amidst the fire.
Both the Dragon and the Phoenix Tribes took great pride in the strength their ancestors demonstrated in that battle.
Just as she was about to answer, she remembered Lu Yang's active participation earlier and turned to look at him.
"You answer first."
Lu Yang's eye twitched; he actually didn't want to answer the question for fear of ruining the image of the Phoenix Ancestor in Jiang Shishi's heart.
But since the opportunity was offered to him, he had no choice but to speak.
Luckily, whatever happened in the Ancient Realm couldn't be mentioned outside, or just the few answers he gave would have turned the entire Demon Territory on its head.
To use the Fairy's words, their battle was akin to lighting a fire to burn paper, pulling hair, and drawing circles to cast a curse.
Repeating these details verbatim seemed somewhat disrespectful.
He kept a straight face, his expression serious, as he spoke with seeming reverence for the Dragon Clan Ancestor and the Phoenix Ancestor.
"That battle caused the heavens and earth to fall, space itself fractured, and both ancestors used their strongest methods. Hundreds of rounds passed with no victor determined, both of them using their race's True Flame as the primary attack, with Semi-Immortal level Talismans burning brightly within the True Flame, soaring to the sky, their power was awe-inspiring and unparalleled.
They also employed a part of each other's body as a medium to cast an extraordinary curse, with an ominous energy pervading the entire cosmos."
"The Phoenix Ancestor was slightly inferior and perished in the curse, only to be resurrected in the flames."
In fact, the Phoenix Ancestor had faked her death with the Playing Dead Technique after the Dragon Clan Ancestor's fire burned her, causing her to jump up yowling in pain.
But let's not mention that part.
"Answer is correct, add one point."
Jiang Shishi regretted it; she could have answered that question too!
"The sixth question, the ancestor of the Nine-Tailed Fox Clan bewitched the world..."
"The seventh question..."
Jiang Shishi and Su Lian'er vied to answer, continuing like this until the tenth question.
"All ten questions are finished, Lu Yang has ten points, clearing the third level."
In the ten questions, Su Lian'er answered five incorrectly, scoring negative five points, placing fourth.
Jiang Shishi answered four incorrectly, scoring negative four points, ranking third.
Meng Jingzhou didn't answer a single question, scoring zero points, ranking second.
"It's decided, we'll eat green bean cakes after getting out."
Meng Jingzhou finally decided what to eat and snapped back to reality, only to find the competition had ended.
"How did I become the second place?"

chapters.title: Chapter 595 - 594: The 4th Layer
chapters.content:
Due to his identity as the eldest son of the Meng Family, Meng Jingzhou knew a lot about the modern Cultivation World, even more than Lu Yang.
As for ancient history, he was completely in the dark.
Considering that the ancient history known to modern cultivators greatly differs from the actual ancient history, there was even less to say.
Without the need for comparison, he suggested that Lu Yang submit his answers for clearance.
As he had expected, Lu Yang got all ten questions right, scoring a full mark and passing with unprecedented success.
What he didn't expect was that his zero score would rank second.
Luo Hong gave Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou an approving look.
"The scores for both of you are the first and second highest in history, well done."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
What Meng Jingzhou didn't know was that those who had entered the third layer in previous years were all geniuses among geniuses, with extensive knowledge that spanned across ancient and modern times. Confident in their own learning, they rushed to answer questions as soon as the rapid-fire round began.
And then they ended up with negative scores.
An initial loss was accidental, and wanting to get their scores back in the positive, they continued to rush to answer, but the more they answered, the lower their scores became.
By the end of the ten questions, it was a competition to see who had more negative points.
Luo Hong pointed at Meng Jingzhou, Jiang Shishi, and Su Lian'er: "You three will receive rewards."
With a snap of her fingers, Luo Hong produced a mountain of treasures gleaming with golden light; each one was highly valuable, fetching sky-high prices and provoking covetous scrambles among the crowd.
Unlike the second layer, the mountain of treasures this time was even more valuable, containing long-lost Great Divine Skills like "Dragon Subduing Palm" and the like.
Above the treasures hovered a cursor, with most cursors marked with a "one", and a minority marked with "two" and "three".
For example, the "Dragon Subduing Palm" was marked with a three.
"Su Lian'er, you were average in the first layer, and in the second layer, you failed to see through what I wanted to test; lying is an instinct, and you were again average in the third layer. You may choose any one item from here."
"Thank you, senior Luo Hong!"
Entering the Creation Ancient Land, she never thought she would reach this stage; it was already far beyond her expectations.
"Jiang Shishi, you acquired two hundred and eighty soul shards in the first layer, setting a historical record with outstanding performance. In the second layer, you saw through what I wanted to test. Your performance was average in the third layer; you may choose any three items from here."
"Thank you, senior Luo Hong."
"Let me remind you, most of the treasures you can choose freely, but some are of such high value that choosing one is equivalent to two or three items."
"Dragon Subduing Palm" is marked with a "three", so picking it is equivalent to choosing three items.
The complete "Dragon Subduing Palm" was capable of defeating a Dragon Clan Ancestor; it was a premium Great Divine Skill, and even an incomplete version would allow one to dominate among peers within the same realm.
Luo Hong then turned to Meng Jingzhou, summarizing:
"In the first layer, you acquired two hundred and eighty soul shards, setting a historical record with Jiang Shishi, performing remarkably well. In the second layer, you not only saw through the testing content but also planted many flowers in the flowerpots. In the third layer, you achieved the second-highest score in history."
"You may choose any five items from here."
Choosing five items meant that Meng Jingzhou's overall performance could be ranked second in the history of the Creation Ancient Land.
If it hadn't been for Lu Yang's score, he would have been first.
Su Lian'er chose an ancient defensive talisman capable of withstanding a full-strength hit from someone in the Body Integration Realm.
Jiang Shishi selected a Phoenix contemplation painting, vivid with life, its ambition to soar high, almost as if the phoenix could fly out of the painting at any moment.
This painting, created by a Semi-Immortal, held the power to calm the spirit and rejuvenate the bloodline, accelerating the awakening process of the bloodline, profound and infinite.
The painting was marked with a "three".
Meng Jingzhou had trouble choosing, as most of the items here were of no use to him, and if he wanted, the Seek Dao Sect had them all.
"Hmm? What is this Cultivation Technique? What a strange name, 'Digital Immortal Skill'?"
"Such a long name?"
"I don't understand it."
Meng Jingzhou flipped through the Cultivation Technique, which was translated.
Marked with a "five" on the technique, it was the most valuable of all the treasures.
"So expensive and only half a book?"
Meng Jingzhou complained that this cultivation technique only described the process from the Qi Cultivation Stage to the Divinity Transformation Stage, which was the first half of the book.
"'Digital Immortal Skill'?!"
Upon hearing this name, Lu Yang's eyes widened in shock. This thing actually exists?!
This was a cultivation technique of Immortal Jiuchong!
"You've heard of it?"
Lu Yang nodded. This was definitely a great treasure.
"Don't exchange it yet, let me ask first."
Lu Yang turned his head and entered the Spiritual Space, "Fairy, do you know the contents of 'Digital Immortal Skill'?"
If the Fairy could recite it, there was no need to write it down.
Fairy Eternity scoffed with disdain, "This fairy can remember the name of Immortal Jiuchong's technique, but why would I remember the contents?"
"What about Old Meng's half of the technique..."
"Exchange it. This technique is quite good. Immortal Jiuchong has boasted about this technique to me before, saying that different people will gain different insights from it. It can help one realize their own Divine Abilities and also assist in understanding other Divine Abilities. There was something else, but I don't remember clearly."
With a firm response, Lu Yang left the Spiritual Space and nodded vigorously, uttering one word.
"Exchange."
Without doubting, Meng Jingzhou exchanged for the half of the immortal technique.
Luo Hong waved her hand, "The three of you may leave now."
Before they had a chance to speak with Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou and the others were teleported out of the Ancient Realm.
The vast space was left with only Lu Yang and Luo Hong.
"Senior Luo Hong, you..."
Luo Hong circled Lu Yang with interest, clicking her tongue in amazement.
"I've seen a few lucky ones who guessed one question correctly, but someone like you who answered all ten questions right has never existed before."
"I always thought no one could answer all ten questions correctly."
With a snap of her fingers, the dim third level instantly brightened. This third level was a city bustling with busy traffic, people coming and going, great demons walking among them, with the Demon Race and Human race living in harmony, a vision of a prosperous era.
"Don't be surprised. This is the Illusionary Realm where I usually live. I surely couldn't spend thirty thousand years just gardening and rolling around with demon beasts. The place you need to go is the fourth level."
"The fourth level?"
In the model of the Ancient Realm given upon entering, there was no sign of a fourth level.
Luo Hong smiled without saying a word, gesturing for Lu Yang to look up at the sky.
As they spoke, a beam of light appeared in the sky, transforming into a golden ladder connecting the third and fourth levels.
The beings in the city halted their steps, looking up at the sky, pointing and expressing a mix of fear and curiosity at the golden ladder.
"The one who created me said that if someone could pass through the Secret Realm, then they should be allowed to proceed to the fourth level."
"The fourth level is beyond my authority. I don't know what's on the fourth level either."
"Who created Senior?"
"I'll tell you when you come down from the fourth level," Luo Hong said with a smile.
Lu Yang realized he wouldn't get a word out of Senior Luo Hong until he reached the fourth level.
Nevertheless, it didn't matter; he was intending to go to the fourth level anyway.
"Then I shall take my leave for now, Senior." Lu Yang bowed.
"Go on, go on. I'll be waiting for your return."
Lu Yang stepped onto the golden ladder. As he tread upon it, a warm current flowed through his body, filling him with strength.
Soon after, Lu Yang disappeared into the fourth level, the golden ladder collapsed, turning into a golden rain that scattered over the city.
...
The fourth level was completely different in style from the previous three, resembling a woman's boudoir. Every detail showed that the owner of the room must be a meticulous person.
"This room looks familiar." No one else was around; Fairy Eternity appeared from the Spiritual Space, her attire still wild and unrestrained.

chapters.title: Chapter 596 - 595 Jiang Lianyi
chapters.content:
```
Before coming to the Ancient Realm, Lu Yang had never imagined that his training expedition here would involve so many events.
Well-known in the Demon Territory, he and Meng Jingzhou decided that since they were here, it would be a pity not to visit the Creation Ancient Land, so they entered the Ancient Realm under the guidance of their Third Senior Sister.
Unexpectedly, here he encountered the insights left by various great demons of ancient times, as well as the cultivation techniques of the Immortal Jiuchong.
In the fourth layer of the Creation Ancient Land, a place unknown to the geniuses who had entered the Ancient Realm for the past three hundred thousand years, and where even the spirit of the Secret Realm, Luo Hong, was not qualified to tread, the first visitor was welcomed.
The place was dead silent, with the echo of empty footsteps, as if someone was following behind.
Lu Yang observed the fourth layer carefully; the room's decorations were understated yet meaningful, suggesting that the owner was a predecessor with excellent cultivation.
Every decorative item in the room exuded an aura of ancientness and extraordinariness, and with Lu Yang's insight, he could only identify the origins of a small part of them.
A stone table carved from the marrow of top-grade spirit stones, a jade chair formed by the fusion of the essence of the sun and the moon, glass floor tiles forged from special star cores, a Kunlun bronze mirror, an Enlightenment teacup, a perpetual fairy lamp...
These were all items Lu Yang had only seen in his own Spiritual Space—Fairy Eternity occasionally liked to change the style of the Spiritual Space.
When Fairy Eternity had introduced these items to Lu Yang before, he had listened with his eyebrows twitching, as their value was beyond his imagination.
Now that these items were appearing before him in the flesh, it was a different feeling altogether.
Lu Yang noticed a jade flute hanging on the wall, its emerald green color elegant and slender, with fine details, and the patterns of hundreds of birds lifelike, giving a feeling of lightness and purity.
At the end of the room lay a bed, draped in a thin gauze, barely allowing one to discern the figure of a female cultivator lying on it.
"Fairy, do you remember whose room this is?"
Lu Yang asked in a low voice, careful not to disturb the room's owner.
"It's Jiang Lianyi."
A heaven-defying talent from the Phoenix Tribe, the Phoenix Ancestor, wife of the Qilin Immortal, one of the top ten beauties of ancient times, Jiang Lianyi.
Lu Yang's hand, poised to draw back the light gauze, hesitated for a moment, and he muttered to himself that it figured, before he parted the gauze, revealing the exceptionally beautiful woman lying on the bed, clad in vivid red as if she were a flame.
It was indeed the legendary Jiang Lianyi.
There was no breath in Jiang Lianyi, the vitality dispersed, her lips pale, eyes tightly shut, her expression peaceful, hands crossed over her chest.
"Has she passed away?"
Lu Yang was aware of the sleeping techniques used by ancient cultivators; no matter how deeply those cultivators slumbered, one could still sense a faint breath, which was completely different from Jiang Lianyi's state.
His voice trembled, his face displaying disbelief, how could a legendary figure like Jiang Lianyi possibly be dead?
But Lu Yang, recalling the corpse of the Time Immortal buried beneath the Five Elements Sect, and the old Qiongqi in the black coffin in the Qiongqi's tomb, had to acknowledge this fact.
The affairs of the ancient past were confounding and anything could happen.
The only thing he could do was accept it.
He didn't know if Fairy Eternity could accept it; Fairy Eternity and Jiang Lianyi were very close. Despite Fairy Eternity's typically jovial demeanor, she must be heavy-hearted when it came to the departure of friends.
If Jiang Lianyi was dead, what had become of Ao Ling, the Dragon Clan Ancestor, and what of the Qilin Immortal?
It's likely that the fates of the other two were not much better, and it's possible that all three had perished.
"She's not dead, this is the Playing Dead Technique."
Fairy Eternity glanced at Lu Yang, whose expression was complex as he struggled to come to terms with the news of Jiang Lianyi's death, thinking to herself why bother cursing someone else for no reason?
Lu Yang fell silent for a moment.
```
"...Playing Dead Technique?"
Fairy Eternity, couldn't you have mentioned that earlier? I got all emotional for nothing.
"You forgot, I taught her the Playing Dead Technique. Back then she wasn't very skilled and kept yowling while being burned..."
"Alright, alright, stop talking about it."
Lu Yang quickly interrupted Fairy Eternity's reminiscing. It wasn't very nice to bring up such things in front of others.
Fairy Eternity, with her hands on her hips, was quite proud: "My Playing Dead Technique is far more reliable than any minor trick like being frozen. The principle behind being frozen is to delay time and slow down the rate of lifespan depletion, but the lifespan will still fade away. Who knows, some unlucky fellow might oversleep and end up dead."
"Take Ancient Di Jiang, for example. Before sealing himself away, he had a lifespan of seventy to eighty thousand years. Now that he's awakened, he's probably only got twenty to thirty thousand years left."
"On the other hand, the Playing Dead Technique, once cast, is equivalent to being dead, so there's absolutely no worry about lifespan running out."
How could there be any depletion of lifespan in a state of death?
"Make way, I'll resurrect her."
Lu Yang conscientiously made room and stood aside. This kind of thing was beyond the capabilities of a Golden Core ancestor.
Fairy Eternity extended her index finger, with the flow of mystical principles emitting from her fingertip. Endless Daoist runes emerged, converging above her head and silently colliding, producing a dazzling light that made Lu Yang squint his eyes.
A massive influx of runes formed a reversal flow toward her fingertip.
Her index finger lightly touched Jiang Lianyi's forehead, causing ripples to spread out invisibly, like a silent breeze that made the light curtains surrounding the bed sway, and the stone table, jade chairs, and bronze mirror tremble slightly.
Caught in the ripples, Lu Yang sensed the flavors of both death and life. After careful reflection, he found it strange yet ultimately indiscernible.
Jiang Lianyi's complexion turned from pale to red in the blink of an eye, her cheeks becoming as rosy as those of a living person. Her long eyelashes quivered as if awakening.
"Mmm~~"
Jiang Lianyi let out a lazy hum, elegant and leisurely, just like Fairy Eternity when she first woke up.
With Jiang Lianyi's revival from death, the entire fourth level sprang to life. The stone table, jade chairs, and bronze mirror started to shake rhythmically, as if dancing. The jade flute hanging on the wall started to play a lively tune… as though celebrating their master's awakening with joy and jubilation.
Jiang Lianyi sat up from the bed, her head heavy. She felt as though she had slept for a very long time, so long that her slumber had to be measured in tens of thousands of years, her memories had become somewhat blurred, and she kept sorting through them in her mind.
She looked around, momentarily forgetting why she was sleeping here and why she was now awake.
Just as she turned her head, a pretty face, even more beautiful than her own, leaned in close.
"Lianyi, you're awake?"
Fairy Eternity crawled to the edge of the bed, coming close to Jiang Lianyi, which genuinely gave Jiang Lianyi quite a scare.
Seeing Jiang Lianyi awaken, Fairy Eternity's lips curled upward in a brilliant smile, her eyes twinkling with joy.
"Who are you?"
Jiang Lianyi looked bewilderedly at Fairy Eternity. She was, after all, a Semi-Immortal, and it was surprising she didn't detect someone approaching her.
"You don't recognize me? I'm Yellow Bean, Fairy Eternity Yellow Bean," Fairy Eternity earnestly introduced herself.
Jiang Lianyi was usually very cautious, but facing this young girl who had appeared out of nowhere, she couldn't muster any sense of vigilance.
Two streams of tears traced down Jiang Lianyi's cheeks uncontrollably. She wiped at her eyes with her wrists, but the tears kept flowing copiously and wouldn't stop.
Even though she was crying, there was an inexplicable feeling of joy in her heart.
"Strange, why am I crying?"

chapters.title: Chapter 597 - 596 Trust
chapters.content:
When Jiang Lianyi said, "Who are you?" Lu Yang's heart clenched fiercely.
It seemed that the mastermind behind the scenes had completely erased Fairy Eternity's existence, not just by replacing the name in books but by altering memories, erasing everything about Fairy Eternity from everyone's minds, and even mighty Jiang Lianyi was not spared.
Jiang Lianyi was a peerless Semi-Immortal with the qualifications to vie for the position of an Immortal, and if even she was not spared, one could only imagine how it would be for other cultivators and mortals.
No wonder no one mentioned Fairy Eternity's name to resurrect her after her death.
"Fairy Eternity, Yellow Bean?"
Jiang Lianyi stopped her tears, feeling utterly unfamiliar with the name and without the slightest recollection, her eyes filled with confusion.
The smile on Fairy Eternity's face gradually disappeared. Although she had braced herself, knowing that Jiang Lianyi had forgotten her still filled her with loss and sadness.
"Yes, I am Fairy Eternity, Yellow Bean, known alongside Qilin Immortal, Immortal Jiuchong, Yingtian Immortal, and Time Immortal as the Five Ancient Immortals. I was the last among the five to become an Immortal!"
"The last to become an Immortal was my husband, the fourth one; there were only four immortals in ancient times, where does the fifth Immortal come from?"
"What about your cooking skills then? I taught both you and Xiao Ling how to cook."
Xiao Ling was the Dragon Clan Ancestor, Ao Ling.
"Both of us are self-taught, with no master to guide us."
"And the Playing Dead Technique, the one you just used, I taught that to you and Xiao Ling."
"The Playing Dead Technique came to me and Xiao Ling when we were exploring a Secret Realm, an ancient ruin so old it couldn't be authenticated. After we left, the realm collapsed and became ruins."
"When you and Qilin Immortal got married, I even gave you an Immortal Fruit, inscribed with 'To the most beautiful of the Demon Race'!"
"I don't remember anything like that when my husband and I got married. Immortals Jiuchong, Yingtian, and Suiyue came to congratulate us and gave us Immortal Fruit, but none of the fruits were inscribed with 'To the most beautiful of the Demon Race'."
"We used to eat together often, and your abode, your bedroom, I have visited them all!"
Fairy Eternity listed event after event in vibrant detail, met with Jiang Lianyi's silence.
Jiang Lianyi was silent for a long time.
"Sorry, I don't have any recollection of what you've said."
Jiang Lianyi was no longer groggy like when she had just woken up; she had quickly sorted through all her memories, remembering even the things that happened before her deep sleep clearly.
At the time, her husband's behavior was strange, stubbornly insisting that she use the Playing Dead Technique to enter a state of death without explaining why. Trusting him, she had performed the Playing Dead Technique, and upon waking, her confusion was met with a strange woman and a Golden Core cultivator.
She was certain her memory was crisp and complete, with no gaps, logical from start to finish, and without a single detail related to Fairy Eternity.
Tears sparkled in Fairy Eternity's eyes, swirling endlessly, stubbornly refusing to fall.
When Jiang Lianyi saw the other's expression, her heart ached terribly, unable to pinpoint the reason.
"Fairy..." Lu Yang wanted to comfort Fairy Eternity, but as he tried to pat her shoulder, his hand passed right through.
Fairy Eternity was in a soul state.
Just as Jiang Lianyi was about to say some comforting words, she felt something at her chest. Instinctively reaching out, she pulled a stone from her chest.
"A Memory Stone?"
Jiang Lianyi became even more puzzled. She remembered that before she fell asleep, she didn't have this stone. Could her husband have slipped it in?
She channeled her spiritual essence into the Memory Stone, and intricate, magnificent patterns appeared on its surface.
The illusory shadow of a man with coral-like horns on his head emerged. He was elegant and graceful, dressed in a black robe adorned with patterns of countless creatures.
"Qilin Immortal?"
"Husband?"
This male illusory shadow was none other than Qilin Immortal.
Lu Yang also recognized Qilin Immortal. This was the second time he had seen him—the first being a reflection from history, and now, an illusory shadow.
"Lianyi, you may have many questions in your heart. You will meet someone, please don't panic. This person is trustworthy, even more so than I, than Ying Tian and the others!"
"You will find this person very strange, completely unable to recall her origin. Please think about it—if this person had nothing to do with you, how could she have unraveled your Playing Dead Technique?"
Jiang Lianyi was stunned.
Indeed, the ancient ruins had vanished, and only she and Xiao Ling knew the Playing Dead Technique. Her husband, Ying Tian, Jiuchong, Suiyue—none of them learned it, nor was there a need for them to do so.
How did this woman, who claimed to be Fairy Eternity, know the Playing Dead Technique?
"Someone has altered your memories. I do not yet know the identity of this person. You don't need to know the details of this matter, nor should you get involved. It is a battle at the level of Immortals. The only thing you need to know is that the person who woke you up is trustworthy!"
Subsequently, the illusory shadow of Qilin Immortal turned towards Fairy Eternity with a smile and clapped in congratulations, "Eternity, you have finally been resurrected. It is just unknown how far apart the era you are in is from mine."
"I am sorry that we never managed to resurrect you. The enemy's methods surpassed our expectations. Not just the Semi-Immortals, but even we were affected. We could only remember you by 'Eternity'; your real name has always eluded us."
"We attempted to call out your name in order, but each time we uttered one, we would forget the one we had said before, falling into a vicious cycle."
"The one slight consolation is that, according to the conversations through the temporal passageway, we confirmed that you will be resurrected in the future."
"Lianyi's affection for you runs deeper than for me. I didn't want her constrained by her lifespan, passing away without ever seeing you. That's why I arranged for you two to meet."
"Even if she has forgotten you, seeing your resurrection will undoubtedly bring her joy."
"To help you find Lianyi, I established this Secret Realm and hid Lianyi on the fourth level."
"To the Cultivators of later generations, this place should be considered an Ancient Secret Realm, or simply, an Ancient Realm. It doesn't matter anymore. In any case, this Secret Realm is of considerable value to the later Cultivators and quite famous. You love bustling places, so you'll definitely come here."
"While establishing this Secret Realm, I took the opportunity to give our Demon Race a chance."
"Through our conversations across the temporal passageway, we learned that you are in a soul state, accompanied by a Golden Core Stage young Cultivator. You must have been staying in this young Cultivator's Spiritual Space all along."
"This Secret Realm will attract not just you, but him as well."
"The first level's trial is a basic test of martial power. With you there, the Golden Core young Cultivator will have no problems passing it."
"The second level's trial is more complex. Your intuition is sharp, and you will make the right choices, so this trial should not be difficult for you."
"The third level is to distinguish you from the young geniuses of the Demon Race. Only you would be able to answer the questions there."
"By the way, I am currently fighting the one who tried to kill you using various means. I am not sure where I will be when you are resurrected. Hence, I will not leave a location for you—it would be pointless. If you are resurrected, the world is so vast, eventually, we are bound to meet."
"Well then, farewell."

chapters.title: Chapter 598 - 597 First Meeting
chapters.content:
```
As the Qilin Immortal's illusory shadow faded, the lines on the Remaining Image Stone dimmed and no matter how much spiritual essence was injected, it had no effect; the stone turned into a useless rock.
The entire place fell silent.
Jiang Lianyi spread her arms and slowly hugged Fairy Eternity, patting her back and said softly, "Don't cry, I believe you."
"Can you tell me about the me in your memories?"
Lu Yang couldn't touch Fairy Eternity because his soul hadn't cultivated enough, but for Jiang Lianyi, that was easy.
"Mm!"
Fairy Eternity nodded vigorously, holding back her tears.
Jiang Lianyi got out of bed and invited Fairy Eternity and Lu Yang to sit at the stone table, meticulously pouring tea.
The curled golden tea leaves unfolded in the cup, countless principles evolved within it, and then all merged back into the tea.
This was for Fairy Eternity to drink.
If Lu Yang took a sip, he feared he would be dissolved on the spot by the tea's principled essence.
Jiang Lianyi personally poured tea for Lu Yang, who quickly got up to thank her, feeling surprisingly flattered.
The tea Lu Yang drank was another kind, unknown in name, but definitely fine tea; the fragrance lingered at the tip of his nose, automatically triggering his cultivation technique to cultivate.
"Our acquaintance started with a misunderstanding..."
Fairy Eternity began narrating in a flowing manner, detailing the story of how she met and befriended Jiang Lianyi, including the minutiae of cooking lessons and playing dead technique.
"Back then, you and Ao Ling were crying and making a fuss about becoming my disciples, but I did not agree."
"Not long after that, the two of you faced the Qilin Immortal in battle, unable to contend with the survival of the fittest Dao Fruit Outline, losing the qualifications to become immortals."
...The process of her marriage to the Qilin Immortal, life after the wedding, attending the gatherings of the Five Immortals, and enjoying great conversations...
Fairy Eternity's description was so vivid that Jiang Lianyi was immersed in it, unable to extricate herself for a long time.
"In the end, I lost my will, and when I awoke, I saw Lu Yang."
At the end, even Fairy Eternity herself laughed.
"Why are you crying?"
Fairy Eternity noticed Jiang Lianyi sitting there dazed, with a vacant look, letting tears slip down her cheeks.
"Ah? Oh."
```
