```
Upon Fairy Eternity's reminder, Jiang Lianyi came to her senses as if awakening from a dream, apologized while wiping away her tears, and forced a smile.
"Sorry, you caught me in a moment of weakness. I don't know why I can't control my tears."
Was it because Fairy Eternity was pitiable, having awoken to find no familiar faces around her, completely forgotten by the world, or because she herself was unaware of her pitiable state and still lived carefree?
Or was there some other reason?
Jiang Lianyi wasn't sure.
She dried her tears, took a couple of deep breaths to steady her emotions, and regained her usual grace and elegance.
"Your memory of Jiang Lianyi is very similar to me, and the details you describe don't seem fabricated, but I really don't remember the events you've mentioned, I have no personal experience to feel empathy."
"A voice in my heart always tells me to believe in you, and my husband says the same."
"I choose to believe you, but it's a pity I have no recollection of those experiences, I'm not the phoenix genius of your memory, nor can I pretend to be that person."
"So—"
Jiang Lianyi stood up and stretched out her hand with a smile.
"May I get to know you again, my name is Jiang Lianyi."
Fairy Eternity stood up to shake hands, also smiling.
"My name is Yellow Bean."
```
The two shook hands, smiling at each other as if they were meeting for the first time yet also as if they had known each other for a long time.
Then Jiang Lianyi walked up to Lu Yang, startling him, unsure what the ancient ancestor was about to do.
Jiang Lianyi said gravely:
"Thank you for resurrecting Immortal Sister, I want to thank you on behalf of Xiao Ling and my husband!"
Having said this, Jiang Lianyi bowed deeply, alarming Lu Yang who quickly stood up saying it was unnecessary, trying to help Jiang Lianyi back to her feet.
But as Jiang Lianyi was a Semi-Immortal of high standing, how could Lu Yang shake her, despite exerting all his strength, he couldn't even move the hem of Jiang Lianyi's clothes.
All he could do was to watch helplessly as Jiang Lianyi bowed and then straightened up, his calves trembling.
"Can you talk about what happened before you used the Playing Dead Technique?" asked Fairy Eternity.
"There's no harm in speaking."
The three of them sat down, and Jiang Lianyi began recalling the past.
"At that time, I was cultivating when suddenly a dizziness swept over me, as if I had forgotten something very important. I felt an emptiness inside, yet upon trying to remember, I couldn't recall what it was that I had forgotten."
"My husband acted as my Protector. His expression changed drastically, filled with extreme anger; the rage filled his eyes. I had never seen him so angry."
"My husband revealed his true form as a Kirin, fully unleashing his pressure. The entire galaxy trembled. Being the closest to him, I felt it most acutely. That pressure was so immense that even I couldn't bear it; it was so powerful that it made my heart palpitate."
"My husband flew out of the abode, heading northward, crossing countless galaxies, and likely stopping around the North Star."
"It was then I noticed, not only my husband, but Ying Tian, Jiuchong, and Suiyue, all three displayed anger identical to my husband's, perhaps even more intense."
"When the four Immortals made their move, the entire universe could sense their presence. Their wrath made even my heart tremble, as if it could incinerate everything."
"Although they often sparred with one another, feeding off each other's moves and occasionally unleashing True Fire, none of their past clashes compared to this."
"I don't know who their opponent was, I only remember the battle lasting seven days and nights without a decisive victory."
"The level of that battle was too high, beyond my comprehension; I'm afraid I cannot describe the details."
"I'm not sure if the opponent vanished or for some other reason, but in the end, they used the power of the Dao Fruit to transform the myriad of stars into six great continents, forming a cube that sealed all living beings, including the four of them."
"My husband returned seriously injured, telling me the situation was very confusing; he asked me to quickly use the Playing Dead Technique and leave the rest to him."
"Seeing my husband so solemn, I didn't doubt him, and used the Playing Dead Technique; I 'died' to sleep."
"When I woke up again, I met you."
Fairy Eternity nodded, "So, this Secret Realm wasn't created by you, but by the Qilin Immortal?"
"At the very least, I have no memories of the Secret Realm, nor of a first or second layer."
"What should we do next? Do you want to leave this place with us?"
"Let me ask, how long have I been asleep?"
"Almost three hundred thousand years. Your Phoenix Tribe has now become the number one tribe in the Demon Territory, and they revere you as an Ancient Ancestor. There are no few legends about you in the outside world."
"I've slept for that long?"
Jiang Lianyi was surprised. She had thought at most a few tens of thousands of years had passed. With such a long time gone by, how much had the Cultivation World changed?
"Then let's go out and take a look."
Jiang Lianyi developed a keen interest in the outside world.
"Right, there's something else I didn't feel comfortable mentioning before." Jiang Lianyi thought about it, feeling uncomfortable keeping it inside.
"Go ahead."
"Can you wear something more formal?" Jiang Lianyi looked Fairy Eternity up and down, finding her style of attire too rough and crude.
"I cannot."
"Oh."

chapters.title: Chapter 599 - 598 Seven-star Sword Group
chapters.content:
"City Lord, these are the public documents submitted from below."
A subordinate, holding a stack of documents, placed them on the City Lord's desk, dividing them into two piles.
The City Lord was a rare female cultivator, with an exceptional appearance, and nobody dared to question her, nor did they dare to comment on her appearance.
Being able to serve as the City Lord in a city populated mostly by male cultivators, one could imagine the means and cultivation level of this City Lord.
"It's been three days, how come she has not come down yet?"
Luo Hong sat in the great hall of the third-layer City Lord's mansion, where she assigned herself the identity of City Lord.
After handling the affairs of the city, as per her routine, she looked up at the sky—that was the location of the fourth layer.
Suddenly, a gap appeared in the sky, and three figures emerged from the gap, flashing by and appearing in the great hall of the City Lord's mansion.
"Senior Luo Hong, we meet again," Lu Yang greeted her with a smile.
Luo Hong: "…"
I remember you went up alone; how come you've become three people on the way down?
Moreover, Luo Hong felt that the two people behind Lu Yang were unfathomably profound, with terrifying strength.
As the spiritual entity of the Secret Realm, Luo Hong could wield all the powers of the realm. With many treasures present, no genie from the Demon Race who grew into great power ever attempted to forcefully enter the Secret Realm, which indicated the terror instilled by Luo Hong.
Even so, she still felt that she was no match for the two people behind Lu Yang.
She even developed a sense of awe towards the red-clad female cultivator.
"Luo Hong pays respects to the female master!"
Immediately, Luo Hong knelt to the ground and kowtowed before Jiang Lianyi.
"Wait a minute, who are you?"
Jiang Lianyi stepped to the side, unwilling for people to kneel to her without reason.
"I am the spiritual entity created by the master of this Secret Realm."
"And who is your master?"
"Shi He, my master told me to call him Qilin Immortal."
Shi He was the name of the Qilin Immortal.
"The master created this Secret Realm, saying that if someone answered all the questions correctly on the third layer, they would be allowed into the fourth layer. The fourth layer is home to the female master, and once the female master appears, everything in the Secret Realm, including myself, will belong to her."
An intricate immortal imprint appeared on Luo Hong's forehead. She held the imprint with reverence and offered it to Jiang Lianyi.
"Indeed, it is the imprint left by my husband."
Jiang Lianyi accepted the imprint; it was the Seal of the Secret Realm, which could govern everything within the realm.
In an instant, Jiang Lianyi sensed the structure of the Secret Realm; with just a thought, she could make Luo Hong do anything, and the treasure trove of the realm could be opened at any time.
With a casual wave of her hand, Jiang Lianyi tore open a spatial rift, revealing a mountainous pile of treasures.
These were treasures that even the mighty geniuses of the Demon Race would envy but seemed like nothing special in Jiang Lianyi's eyes.
"Do you need anything?"
Jiang Lianyi turned to ask Lu Yang if he wanted, she could give all these treasures to him.
Lu Yang felt a bit conflicted. There was no doubt that the treasures were valuable, but he was not short of money, didn't need spirit stones, and when it came to magic artifacts, it's unlikely there were any more valuable than the Green Peak Sword. Moreover, with the Scripture Pavilion and Eldest Senior Sister available, he didn't need to consult the experiences left by the Demon Race's mighty ones.
"I heard that there's an immortal herb here that allows a demon prodigy to leap an entire major cultivation level after consumption, and there are no side effects?"
Jiang Lianyi reached out, spanning the distance through space, and plucked a spirit grass with seven twinkling leaves from the second layer.
"You're talking about the Seven-star Moon Chasing Grass; its growing conditions are extremely harsh. It indeed can enhance one's cultivation by a major level, for instance, from the late Golden Core stage to the late Nascent Soul stage, but to call it an Immortal Herb would be to overestimate it. Once consumed, one cannot progress to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage."
"Then never mind," Lu Yang believed that cultivation should take a systematic and gradual approach; there was no need to rush.
Jiang Lianyi replanted the Seven-star Moon Chasing Grass back into the ground.
"Can I pick a few swords to form a sword array?" Lu Yang suddenly asked.
"You can."
Jiang Lianyi beckoned, and seven precious swords of different styles floated out from the pile of treasures, each emanating a chilling gleam.
"These seven swords are all yours now."
All the swords in the Creation Ancient Land were here, and they were all growth-type magic artifacts.
The names of the swords were engraved on the hilts: Tian Shu, Tian Xuan, Tian Ji...
Luo Hong, who was most familiar with these treasures, explained, "These names correspond to the ancient North Star's seven stars, and this set of swords is called the Seven-star Sword Array."
Above each sword floated the number "two."
"Good stuff."
As a Sword Cultivator, Lu Yang was overjoyed to receive seven different precious swords, so happy that he couldn't close his mouth.
"How do I claim ownership, through blood recognition?"
Luo Hong solemnly said, "It's not that simple. These seven swords have spirituality. To subdue these swords, you need to nurture them with your body, heart, and blood. It's a long process which can take from a short month to a whole year."
The Seven-star Sword Array issued a series of sword cries, confirming Luo Hong's words.
Sword Cultivators are proud, and their swords have a pride of their own, not to be wielded by just anyone. They set three rules for using them at the time of their birth:
Only peerless Sword Cultivators, only peerless geniuses, and only with a sincere heart can one move them.
Although the Seven-star Swords had not yet developed spiritual wisdom, they had spirituality.
Fairy Eternity stepped forward, and wherever the sword cries were loudest, she struck firmly, and when the Seven-star Sword Array quieted down, she pointed at Lu Yang and said, "From now on, you will follow him, do you hear me?"
The Seven-star Swords issued a series of trembling sword cries.
What seemed to be random strikes were actually attacks that targeted their spirituality; Fairy Eternity could erase their spirituality with just a few knocks if she wished.
Afterward, they floated to Lu Yang's side, rubbing against him affectionately.
Lu Yang hastily kept his distance. A fluffy little rabbit rubbing against him was one thing, but with you seven swords, are you trying to slice me to death?
Lu Yang ran ahead while the Seven-star Sword Array pursued from behind, resolute and unrelenting. Eventually, Lu Yang used his Identity Jade to gather them inside, which finally calmed things down.
Jiang Lianyi then said to Luo Hong, "Continue to fulfill your previous duties in the Secret Realm as usual. Nothing changes."
"Yes!"
"Also, about my affairs and Immortal Sister's, don't speak of them to anyone."
"Understood!"
When they came down from the fourth layer, Fairy Eternity told Jiang Lianyi not to mention her existence outside; it might startle the target unnecessarily.
"Let's go. It's a good time to see what the Cultivation World looks like now."
Thirty thousand years have passed. Afraid that old friends are long gone, things aren't the same anymore.
"Speaking of old friends, there has been one recently," Lu Yang said, stroking his chin. By this time, Fairy Eternity had returned to the Spiritual Space.
"Who?"
"Ancient Di Jiang, he's been asleep since the ancient times and after waking up, he plans to unify the Demon Territory and establish the Demon Nation. It seems we'll be just in time for his nation-founding ceremony after we get out."
Jiang Lianyi was stunned for a moment before realizing who Lu Yang was referring to as Ancient Di Jiang. Indeed, times have changed.
"He can establish a Demon Nation? He's gotten quite capable, hasn't he?"
"There's another matter I'd like to consult you about," said Lu Yang.
"You are the one who revived Immortal Sister. There's no need to be so formal with me. Speak your mind."
"Have you heard of the Heavenly Court?"

chapters.title: Chapter 600 - 599: Attracting Hatred
chapters.content:
The exit of the Creation Ancient Land formed the ground for a standoff between two sides.
"Clan Leader Jiang, I advise you to surrender. That is the wise move to make right now; your Phoenix Tribe has gone too far," said the Jiuying Clan Leader coldly, his eyes venomous like a serpent's.
"Not to mention that your Phoenix Tribe sent three people in, two of them received rewards on the third level, and one person has yet to appear!"
All the Demon Race elders present had entered the Creation Ancient Land and knew it was divided into three layers, with rewards only available to those who passed the first layer.
The geniuses of the Demon Clan Alliance were eliminated without even passing the first layer.
Ao Yue and the others were defeated on the second layer, receiving only the most basic rewards.
Meng Jingzhou, Jiang Shishi, and Su Lian'er received the third layer's rewards.
If it were just that, it wouldn't be so bad—there have historically been geniuses from the Demon Race who received the third-level rewards.
But the problem was that someone had not left the Secret Realm, an unprecedented event!
The Creation Ancient Land was mysterious and unpredictable, and the rewards of the third level were rich enough to make those in the Body Integration Realm envious. So, what kind of rewards would someone obtain for staying longer in the Secret Realm!
The Jiuying Clan was suspected to be the patron of the enchantress of deceiving sounds, and their Young Master had previously laid a trap for the geniuses of the Demon Clan Alliance in the Ancient Realm. They had incurred the wrath of various major demon clans and urgently needed to divert their attention.
And the Phoenix Tribe was the perfect target!
For this, the Jiuying Clan even had the Clan Leader come over to exert pressure.
"If your Phoenix Tribe is willing to submit to the Demon Nation, we can overlook what has happened," the Jiuying Clan Leader said, his eyes darkening with his true intent showing.
The Phoenix Tribe was already within the sphere of suppression and gathering by the Demon Clan Alliance, but unfortunately, their foundation was too strong for Ancient Di Jiang to act rashly.
This was the perfect opportunity to use the pressure of the Demon Clan Alliance to bring the Phoenix Tribe into the fold—a significant achievement!
"Let bygones be bygones—a big talk indeed!" sneered the Phoenix Tribe's Clan Leader, seeing right through the intent of the Jiuying Clan Leader.
The Clan Leader of the Phoenix Tribe was named Jiang Xi, a graceful and beautiful woman clad in phoenix robes, noble beyond compare, with a resemblance to Jiang Shishi.
The Phoenix Tribe was a matrilineal race, with most strong members being women, and by tradition, the role of Clan Leader was held by a female.
"Your clan's genius lacked skill compared to ours, and now you're blaming my Phoenix Tribe for it?"
Without Lu Yang's and Meng Jingzhou's assistance at the first barrier, as well as the enlightenment from their actions, how could Jiang Shishi have passed the second level or obtained the Phoenix Contemplation Chart?
This was a treasure of contemplation left behind by an Ancient Ancestor. With Jiang Shishi's remarkable talent and the aid of this treasure, her advancement to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage was as like nailing a board.
For this reason alone, they would undoubtedly protect these two!
The original conflict involved the elders of the Jiuying Clan joining forces with the Demon Clan Alliance to pressure the Phoenix Tribe.
The Phoenix Tribe, with the Dragon Clan as their ally and various races in the Secret Realm who had received Lu Yang's help, was not afraid of the Demon Clan Alliance.
Seeing this, the Jiuying Clan summoned their Clan Leader, and the Phoenix Tribe, not to be outdone, summoned theirs as well.
As the situation developed, the Clan Leaders of the major races came to stand by their respective races and cheer for them.
"What's going on with Junior Brother? He hasn't come out in three days," Third Senior Sister quietly asked Meng Jingzhou.
If something had happened to Junior Brother in the Secret Realm, she would feel guilty for the rest of her life.
Meng Jingzhou revealed a helpless smile, "Senior Sister, not to mention that the rules of the Secret Realm forbid disclosing its events, I can't speak of it, and even if I could, I genuinely don't know what the hell Lu Yang is doing in there."
"You don't need to worry about him, Senior Sister. From what I know of him, he should be safe in the Secret Realm—maybe even more comfortable than we are on the outside."
Meng Jingzhou knew best what cards Lu Yang held: an Ancient Immortal protected him within; he could summon Eldest Senior Sister with his Imitation Fist; with both internal and external cultivation, what could go wrong?
"Refuse a toast only to drink a forfeit!"
The Clan Leader of the Jiuying looked fierce, as the majority of the Demon Race had already joined the Demon Nation. The unification of the Demon Territory by the Ancient Di Jiang was a done deal, yet the Dragon and Phoenix Tribes failed to see the situation clearly and dared to stubbornly resist. He kindly advised them to surrender to the Demon Nation early, but this was how they treated him.
They really didn't know the word 'death'!
"Haha, what's all the excitement here?"
A hearty laugh came from the sky, forces from outside the Demon Territory had arrived!
"Isn't this the Nine-headed Snake? You were locked up by me in the Secret Realm for five years, remember? We haven't seen each other in more than a thousand years, right?"
"What was your name again, member of the Taozhu clan? Remember me? I've beaten you up before!"
Meng Jingzhou recognized the voice as he looked up, Master.
The Third Elder was sitting on the clouds, cheerfully recounting the embarrassing moments of the Jiuying Clan Leader and the others.
Apart from the Third Elder, there were also the Grand Elder, Fourth Elder, Fifth Elder, and Seventh Elder.
More than half of the Elders from the Seek Dao Sect had arrived at the Creation Ancient Land.
"We've finally arrived." The Third Senior Sister breathed a sigh of relief; seeing the situation escalating, she contacted the Eldest Senior Sister to ask what should be done.
The reply from the Eldest Senior Sister was simple: I'll send someone to draw attention.
With the establishment of the Demon Nation imminent, every major force in the Cultivation World had sent people over, including the Seek Dao Sect. The Eldest Senior Sister had the Elders who went to observe the Demon Nation's founding ceremony help Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
"Seek Dao Sect's people!"
The Jiuying Clan Leader, seeing these familiar faces, flew into a rage, his face distorting as he suddenly transformed into his true form with a bang—a body composed of nine Swallow the Sky pythons.
He remembered the events of a thousand years ago like it was yesterday; if it weren't for these meddlers, he wouldn't have been trapped in the Secret Realm for five long years!
He almost missed out on his cultivation!
The Taozhu Clan Leader was similarly furious. A thousand years ago, he was a proud genius, the pride of the Taozhu clan. At the height of his fame, these people from the Seek Dao Sect challenged him to a duel in private.
If the Seek Dao Sect bunch had used tricks to win against him, it would have been one thing, but it was a fair fight, and he, outmatched in physical prowess and strength, lost to the Third Elder of the Seek Dao Sect!
This humiliation was something he kept to himself, sinking into a dark time because of it.
Now that the Third Elder from the Seek Dao Sect had publicized this incident, he couldn't stand it!
Not just these two races, even the usually good-natured Rabbit Race showed hostility upon seeing the Seek Dao Sect Elders.
"It's the Seek Dao Sect's people, let's all attack together!"
The demons, having their embarrassing stories revealed one by one by the Seek Dao Sect, disregarded any notions of decorum or the Demon Clan Alliance, eager to charge forward and capture them!
The great demons revealed their true forms, and chaos ensued as a horde of monsters danced wildly and demon energy soared into the sky.
Seeing that his goal had been achieved, the Grand Elder quickly grabbed everyone and fled.
"If you have the guts, stand still!" The Jiuying Clan Leader desperately chased after them, but the Grand Elder wasn't about to listen to his nonsense; conjuring clouds underfoot, he fled at the fastest speed!
The bustling Creation Ancient Land instantly became desolate, leaving only Third Senior Sister and Meng Jingzhou looking at each other, bewildered.
Even the Phoenix Tribe joined the chase.
Although there was no deep hatred between the Phoenix Tribe and the Seek Dao Sect, it would be awkward not to follow at this time.
Meng Jingzhou's mouth twitched, relieved that he had kept a low profile in the Demon Territory and hadn't exposed his identity as a Disciple of the Seek Dao Sect. What would have become of him if he had been exposed?
"Haha, I'm out!"
The exit of the Creation Ancient Land opened, and Lu Yang popped out, awaiting a warm welcome from everyone.
"Where is everyone?"

chapters.title: Chapter 601 - 600: Where is Ancient Di Jiang? I'm going to settle accounts with him.
chapters.content:
```
Based on Lu Yang's thinking, creating a record in the Ancient Realm and entering the fourth layer should have meant that many from the Demon Race would be waiting at the exit to press him for the rewards of the Ancient Realm.
In particular, the Jiuying Tribe, since he had targeted Qin Feng of the Jiuying Tribe in the Ancient Realm, wouldn't they take a leading role in attacking him once outside?
First, Qin Feng challenged him to a one-on-one duel, claiming the strong ruled, then upon Qin Feng's defeat, a Jiuying Clan Elder intervened, taking advantage of the weaker.
At that moment, the Phoenix Tribe stood by his side to fend off the Elder of the Jiuying Tribe.
Considering the Jiuying Tribe's ability to instigate trouble, all members of the Demon Clan Alliance sided with them, with statements like, "You who lack virtue have no right to the treasure of the Ancient Realm," "Hand it over swiftly, and your life will be spared," "Dare to insult a member of our Demon Clan Alliance, and you shall surely die today," and so on.
Unable to withstand the Demon Clan Alliance, the Phoenix Tribe struggled, and Lu Yang found himself in peril.
It was then that Elder Jiang Lianyi made her entrance, backing him up with a stern look from her phoenix eyes, releasing the aura of a Semi-Immortal, and declaring, "Let's see who dares to touch him!" She then went on a rampage, intimidating the world.
How exhilarating that would have been.
So why are only Old Meng and Third Senior Sister at the exit?
Seeing that the outside world didn't match Lu Yang's plan, Jiang Lianyi didn't wait for his signal and took the initiative to walk out of the Ancient Realm.
She wore a dazzling red dress, tall and elegant, her demeanor detached, inspiring awe in those around her.
Meng Jingzhou was stunned – how did another person show up?
Why hadn't he seen her inside the Secret Realm?
Even more shocked was Third Senior Sister, her voice trembling, "You... are you the Phoenix Ancestor?"
The Phoenix Tribe had portraits of their ancient ancestors, which Third Senior Sister had seen.
It was as if the person Junior Brother brought out was straight out of an ancient painting, the likeness was uncanny!
No, she was even more vivid than the images depicted.
Third Senior Sister had a keen interest in archaeology; the living embodiment of an ancient figure, let alone the widely renowned and legendary Phoenix Ancestor, was bound to excite her!
But then Third Senior Sister calmed down; no matter how lucky her Junior Brother was, it wasn't possible for him to find the real Phoenix Ancestor – this must be some sort of a clone or embodiment left by the Phoenix Ancestor.
"I am Jiang Lianyi."
The residents of the third-layer city spoke a modern language, which Jiang Lianyi had learned by scanning with her Spiritual Sense.
Upon hearing Jiang Lianyi introduce herself, Third Senior Sister's heart skipped a beat.
Was this truly the legendary Phoenix Ancestor?
Meng Jingzhou looked at Jiang Lianyi and Lu Yang as if he'd seen a ghost.
You, what's the situation? How did the Phoenix Ancestor herself come out after your trip to the Ancient Realm?
Overwhelmed with excitement, Third Senior Sister asked, "The legend says you had passed away. Have you resurrected, returning anew?"
Jiang Lianyi: "..."
Had the tale of her resurrection already spread to this era?
Would saying she survived by using the Playing Dead Technique until now damage her image?
She spoke indifferently, "Let's keep this matter quiet. Only the three of you know of my resurrection."
The three nodded repeatedly.
"Right, what about the other races of the Phoenix Tribe?"
Lu Yang thought to himself that having awakened the Phoenix Ancestor and with the tie to Fairy Eternity, it shouldn't be a problem for him to become the second ancestral figure of the Phoenix Tribe, right?
Third Senior Sister gave a detailed account of what had transpired from the time Lu Yang entered the Ancient Realm until his departure.
```
Jiang Lianyi furrowed her brows slightly, feeling somewhat displeased, "Zhu Tian really has some nerve, attempting to control my Phoenix Tribe with a Dao Fruit Outline while I'm not around."
Zhu Tian was the name dating back to the Ancient Di Jiang era; the Di Jiang Clan had their entire bodies flushed red, using "Zhu" as the surname.
As the possessor of the Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit Outline, Jiang Lianyi understood what it meant for an imprint to be placed by a Dao Fruit Outline—absolute control from the strong over the weak, where even life and death hung by a thread.
In the ancient times she had never done such a thing, and now, in a world without Immortals emerging, Zhu Tian, on the contrary, had grown bold—desiring not only to unify the Demon Race but also to control the Phoenix Tribe.
Had the foundations of the Phoenix Tribe been shallower, they might have already come under control.
"Where is Zhu Tian? I will go find him!"
With her naturally fiery temperament, was he about to trample over the Phoenix Tribe, thinking she was dead?!
Lu Yang was shocked and secretly asked in the Spiritual Space:
"Didn't you say, Fairy, that when someone awakens from a deep sleep, their strength is greatly diminished and requires a long time to recover? Can Elder Jiang, having just awakened, really defeat Ancient Di Jiang?"
"Are you kidding me, don't lump my Playing Dead Technique with those random tricks. By using the Playing Dead Technique, the vitality is completely locked within the body; Lianyi's strength is the same as it was in Ancient Times, at her peak!"
Fairy Eternity placed her hands on her hips, especially proud of her own Playing Dead Technique.
Upon confirming that Jiang Lianyi's strength hadn't diminished, Lu Yang became even more respectful and quickly advised, "Elder, please don't harm yourself over this matter. Zhu Tian is hard to track down, but the national founding ceremony is about to be held soon, and as the nation's ruler, Zhu Tian definitely will attend. We can go there and look for him."
"That's a good idea."
Lu Yang kindly suggested, "There's also another matter. The garment you are wearing is too conspicuous. I'm afraid you might be recognized before the ceremony even starts, and if Zhu Tian learns of your arrival, he might hide himself. Would you consider concealing your identity a bit?"
Without even mentioning Jiang Lianyi's identity, just her beauty alone, ranked among the top three in Ancient Times, would draw countless eyes wherever she appeared, always being the center of attention.
Moreover, with portraits of Jiang Lianyi inside the Phoenix Tribe itself, it'd be odd if no issues arose.
Jiang Lianyi thought it over and realized he was right. She took a black cloak from her Storage Ring and draped it over herself with practiced ease, as if she had done it countless times before.
"Huh? Why did I unconsciously do that?"
Jiang Lianyi paused, somewhat puzzled. With her personality, she never hid her actions; it didn't make sense for her to frequently wear a cloak.
It didn't add up.
Fairy Eternity wasn't surprised at all and explained through a telepathic message, "I used to often take you and Xiao Ling to auctions to play cat-and-mouse. We all wore cloaks back then."
Third Senior Sister took out a beast skin, inviting Jiang Lianyi to sit on it as they set out toward the Di Jiang Clan.
The four of them departed.
Aboard the beast skin, Fairy Eternity, feeling bored, suddenly remembered something.
"Isn't the way you and Lianyi address each other a bit incorrect?"
"Lianyi calls me sister, Lu Yang, you call her elder, and Lianyi calls you by your name."
"What's wrong with that?" Lu Yang didn't see a problem. Otherwise, what should he call her, Sister Lianyi?
"No, no, the order is a mess. Even though I didn't formally accept Lianyi as a disciple, there's the substance of a mentor-disciple relationship. Lu Yang, as the Immortal Lineage Second Boss and my disciple, by the rules of our lineage, your status should be higher than Lianyi's."
"So?"
"So you are Lianyi's Eldest Senior Brother!"
Jiang Lianyi nodded, "I'll listen to Immortal Sister."
Lu Yang: "..."
Fairy, don't talk nonsense; I'm afraid the Qilin Immortal might suddenly appear behind me.
And Elder Lianyi, don't mess around; my destiny can't bear such a title.

chapters.title: Chapter 602 - 601 Newcomer of the Heavenly Court Sect
chapters.content:
Third Senior Sister had flown on the Five Beast Skin for five days and finally arrived at the site where the Demon Nation's inauguration ceremony was to take place.
Originally, this place was a range of endless mountains, but after the efforts of the Demon Clan Alliance, it has been transformed into a plain, and a towering Imperial City has risen from the ground, standing on the plains.
The metal-forged city was particularly conspicuous in the wild Demon Territory.
The Great Yue stood tall, surrounded by mountains, and the magnificent metal city loomed within the embrace of the mountains, very eye-catching.
The entire metal city was painted black, a suffocating, overwhelming black that was extremely intimidating.
As the inauguration of the Demon Nation approached, all powers with cultivators in the Body Integration Realm were invited, and most of them had arrived at the metal city ahead of time. Furthermore, with the members of the Demon Clan Alliance stationed here, the metal city was bustling.
Great Xia, East Sea, Demon Nation, and various Loose Cultivators gathered here, and powers from the entire Cultivation World came to witness the event.
Having organized the Seek Dao Sect's anniversary celebration, Lu Yang had recognized all the Great Sects of Great Xia. Yet, this time, many unfamiliar powerful forces had come as well.
After all, the Demon Territory had been in chaos for three hundred thousand years, and the sudden announcement of nation-building piqued everyone's curiosity to witness this historic moment.
The founder was no ordinary figure—Ancient Emperor Jiang Zhu Tian, a semi-immortal who had lived since Ancient Times!
Anyone who had studied ancient history was aware of his fame!
"Demon City?"
Above the gates of the metal city hung two large characters—"Demon City."
Upon seeing these two characters, a vast aura assailed the senses, evoking the scent of ancient dust from history.
"Little Lu, Little Meng, this way, this way." As Lu Yang and his party landed at the entrance of Demon City, they heard the Grand Elder's voice transmission.
"Look to the left."
They turned their heads and saw the crouching Grand Elder and Third Elder at the roadside.
The Grand Elder and Third Elder were quite noticeable, with passing members of the Demon Race glaring fiercely at them. However, restrained by Demon City's rules, they could not act and could only enter the Demon City with simmering resentment.
With the nation's inauguration imminent, starting a fight near Demon City would be tantamount to slapping the Di Jiang Clan in the face. Even those with grievances against the Seek Dao Sect would not dare to seek revenge or cause trouble at this time.
For this reason, the Grand Elder and Third Elder dared to show their true faces.
There were four gates to Demon City. The Fourth Elder, Fifth Elder, and Seventh Elder were guarding the other three gates. Upon learning that Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were found at the East City Gate, the three Elders convened there.
"Fifth Elder, have you all managed to escape successfully?"
Meng Jingzhou remembered that during the pursuit, the members of the Demon Race were almost driven to burn their Essence Blood in anger. How could they have escaped under such circumstances?
The Grand Elder stroked his beard and laughed heartily, "The five of us dared to come to the Demon Territory because we were fully prepared. They'll need to reach the Transcendance Tribulation Stage if they want to catch up with us!"
"Fifth Elder, it has been a long time." Third Senior Sister greeted politely.
"Gan Tian, it's been almost a hundred years since we last met. Your harvest in the Demon Territory doesn't seem small; among your peers, your Cultivation Level is likely the highest, already at the pinnacle of the Void Refinement Stage. You will soon catch up to Little Dai." The Grand Elder chuckled. Gan Tian was inquisitive and hardworking.
When she was cultivating in the Seek Dao Sect, she often delighted them, in stark contrast to the frustrating Ye Zijin.
Both were disciples of Daoist Buyu, so how could there be such a vast difference?
"Void Refinement pinnacle?" Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou both showed surprised expressions, as they had always thought Third Senior Sister was in the Body Integration Realm.
Wasn't it said that the Void Refinement Stage cultivation fluctuations were quite significant? Why wasn't it apparent in Third Senior Sister?
"Of course, it's the pinnacle of the Void Refinement Stage," Fairy Eternity said lazily. "Haven't you noticed that this young girl has never personally taken action from the beginning to the end? Instead, she's been using magic artifacts, right?"
After being reminded, Lu Yang suddenly realized that all along the way, Third Senior Sister had either used the Ancient Qin Beast Skin or Invisibility Talismans, and never once resorted to magic skills.
"This girl took advantage of the fluctuations in her cultivation level during the Body Integration Realm to channel her magical power into the magic artifact, storing it in advance so that it could still be used normally when her cultivation level decreased."
Lu Yang remembered that when he and Old Meng took the Sect's entrance exam, Old Meng had brought several magic artifacts that had magical power stored in them in advance, all of which he had brought from home.
"When you reach the Void Refinement Stage, you can try to protect yourself in this way."
Even so, Lu Yang still thought that Third Senior Sister was quite daring, as cultivators in the Void Refinement Stage usually chose to seclude themselves, go into hiding, live an ordinary life, take the imperial examinations, or sit in prison... in short, they did whatever was safest.
How unlike Third Senior Sister, who was hopping around in the dangerous Demon Territory, and still had the capacity to take the two of them tomb exploring.
Lu Yang had learned some things about the Void Refinement Stage; he had heard that Daoist Buyu often spent the weak periods of the Void Refinement Stage in prison.
Several Elders would honestly stay within the Sect and not go out.
Many senior brothers and sisters chose to live as ordinary people, eating and living with them until danger arose, then they would reveal their cultivation level to show off.
The methods were varied.
"Fairy, how did you get through the Void Refinement Stage?"
Lu Yang was curious; it was hard to imagine Fairy Eternity secluding herself given her personality.
In the chaotic times of Ancient Times, it would probably be impossible to sit in prison or pose as an ordinary person.
"Simple, I created clones. Since the stability of my cultivation level was unpredictable, so was the cultivation level of my clones. Statistically, both my clone and I couldn't be at a low point at the same time; one of us would always have a higher cultivation level."
Lu Yang thoughtfully asked, "What if both you and your clone were at a low point at the same time?"
Fairy Eternity thought that Lu Yang's question was very stupid and said as if it were obvious.
"Of course, I would create several more clones."
"...That makes sense."
"Who is this..." The Grand Elder had noticed the black-robed person following behind Lu Yang for some time and had been reminiscing, not having the chance to inquire about their background yet.
An icy and crisp voice came from beneath the black robe, answering without any hesitation, "Lu Yang is my great master..."
Lu Yang was quick to react, hastily saying, "This is a newcomer in our Heavenly Court Sect."
The concept of the Heavenly Court was a ruse contrived by the Five Ancient Immortals to deceive later generations. Jiang Lianyi, of course, had heard of the term Heavenly Court.
Furthermore, with Fairy Eternity serving as the leader of the Heavenly Court, when Lu Yang invited her to join the Heavenly Court Sect, she readily agreed.
As for using the term "senior brother," Fairy Eternity insisted that Lu Yang was an inner disciple, while Jiang Lianyi was an unnamed disciple; by rights, Lu Yang would be Jiang Lianyi's senior brother, but Jiang Lianyi persisted in calling Lu Yang senior brother, and Lu Yang insisted Jiang Lianyi was his senior.
It can only be said that everyone has their own convictions.
"A new member has arrived?" The Seventh Elder was delighted; he had faith in Lu Yang's judgment, and anyone he brought into the Heavenly Court Sect was sure to be trustworthy.
The Seventh Elder walked with his hands behind his back, speaking with an air of an elder statesman, "I joined the Heavenly Court Sect earlier than you, which makes me your senior. Should you encounter anything you don't understand, feel free to ask me."
"The same goes for matters of cultivation. I still have quite some insights when it comes to cultivation aspects."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Third Senior Sister: "..."
"Okay."

chapters.title: Chapter 603 - 602: I Am the Phoenix Ancestor You Speak Of
chapters.content:
"I do have some issues with cultivation, I've been stuck at a realm for quite a while now, unable to break through."
The Seventh Elder nodded, "So you've hit a bottleneck period, quite common. I have elixirs that can help you break through the bottleneck."
"It's not a bottleneck, but someone has walked ahead of me, so I can't break through."
The Seventh Elder understood, it seemed the rookie had cultivated a special cultivation technique.
These special cultivation techniques were very common in the Great Qian and Great Yu eras, mainly characterized by the way that cultivators ahead in progress would absorb the cultivation efforts of those who follow, winner takes all. By the Great Xia period, since such techniques were too cruel and cultivators weren't lacking in methods of cultivation, these techniques fell out of favor.
"How about changing sects and starting over?"
"That probably won't work, there's no guarantee I can reach the current realm if I start over."
"I see, well if it really comes down to it, tell me who's ahead of you, and I'll have them restart!"
Jiang Lianyi was somewhat worried, "But that person is very strong."
"At the Transcendance Tribulation Stage?"
"Not that."
Upon hearing it wasn't the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, the Seventh Elder was reassured, patting his chest and guaranteeing, "As long as it's not the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, I can take them down without a problem."
Which of the Nine Disciples of the Seek Dao Sect wasn't renowned for their battle prowess?
"This isn't a place to talk, let's enter the city and then discuss," the Grand Elder said. Talking about such matters at the city gate wasn't appropriate, even if they used magic skills to silence their voices it wasn't safe. What if a cultivator at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage happened to pass by and hear them?
The Demon Clan Alliance had made thorough preparations; they had arranged accommodations for each force, and for the Seek Dao Sect, one of the Five Great Immortal Sects, they had arranged an entire floor of an inn.
Inside Demon City was even more prosperous, with countless cultivators of various shapes and colors.
Aside from the native cultivators of the Demon Territory, there were cultivators with fish-like features from the Sea Clan of the East Sea, bald and plainly dressed monks from the Golden Buddha Kingdom, and densely-furred loose cultivators from the far north...
Jiang Lianyi's gaze lingered on the monk from the Buddha Country for a moment, and Lu Yang suddenly remembered that Buddhism had been created by the Five Ancient Immortals, and that there were no Buddhist cultivators during the Ancient Times.
Lu Yang sent a voice transmission to Jiang Lianyi, explaining the current state of Buddhism, his knowledge was limited, so he could only give a general idea.
"So that's how it is, who would have thought the stories we made up would become so widespread in the Cultivation World."
Jiang Lianyi was slightly surprised, she had been listening when the Four Ancient Immortals were making up stories, even occasionally chiming in, which made her a founder of Buddhism in a way.
Lu Yang spread his hands, "After all this time, stories from Ancient Times have become legends, making it difficult to discern truth from falsehood."
Oh, and 'false' might not be the right word, rather the stories have been artistically embellished, selectively portraying ancient tales.
Upon reaching the inn, the Seventh Elder was still boasting non-stop. After all, it was rare to come across a newcomer of the Heavenly Court Sect, and he was determined to relish the role of a mentor this time.
"It's not bragging to say that my pill refining skills are second to none in the Cultivation World. If you have any needs regarding elixirs, feel free to come to me."
Not to be outdone, the Fifth Elder also said, "My artifact refining skills are truly extraordinary. To say they are the best in the Cultivation World is no exaggeration. Considering you are a newcomer to our sect, if you need a magic artifact, I can refine one for you!"
A slight smile formed on Jiang Lianyi's lips; the Fifth Elder's words reminded her of someone from her past, "An artifact refiner? What a coincidence, I too know an artifact refiner who also claims to be the number one in the Cultivation World."
The Fifth Elder raised an eyebrow, "So arrogant, I must meet him someday and show him who the real number one is."
"By the way, I haven't asked yet, what's your name?"
"Jiang Lianyi."
"That name sounds familiar," the Third Elder scratched his head.
Being a Confucian Cultivator and well-informed, the Fourth Elder chimed in, "It's the same name as the Phoenix Ancestor of the Phoenix Tribe."
As an old-timer of the Heavenly Court Sect, the Seventh Elder put on an air of worldly wisdom and praised, "That's a fine name. According to the theory of fate, having the same name as the Phoenix Ancestor could allow you to share in the Phoenix Ancestor's fortunes, which could be greatly beneficial to your cultivation.
Breaking through to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage in the future is not impossible."
Jiang Lianyi hesitated, but thinking about how both Immortal Sister and Elder Brother Lu Yang had assured her along the way that the people of the Seek Dao Sect were very trustworthy, she removed her hood and revealed her stunning true face.
```
"Phoenix Ancestor!!!"
The Grand Elder's eyes suddenly bulged, and he shuddered uncontrollably, his voice escaping him as he yelled out loud, staggering three steps back.
When he was young, he had sneaked into the Phoenix Tribe to visit the ancient tomb and had seen a statue of the Phoenix Ancestor.
The Third Senior Sister being able to freely come and go in the tombs of various tribes owed a great deal to the experience and maps given by the Grand Elder.
The Seventh Elder turned his head dissatisfiedly towards the Grand Elder, "Of course I know she shares the same name as the Phoenix Ancestor."
"She is the Phoenix Ancestor! I've seen her statue in the Phoenix Tribe!"
The Seventh Elder burst into hearty laughter, dismissing the claim, "Boss, you're really funny..."
Immediately after, his eyes rolled back, and he clattered to the ground, fainting from shock.
What did he just say a moment ago, that the Phoenix Ancestor had some issues in cultivation and sought him out for help?
Seconds later, the Seventh Elder came back to consciousness, his face still filled with disbelief, wondering if he was dreaming, and even slapped himself twice.
"Is the Phoenix Ancestor reincarnated and cultivating anew?" the Grand Elder asked cautiously, hardly daring to breathe.
Li Haoran's existence had introduced him to the concept of reincarnation.
"I haven't heard of any reincarnation and re-cultivation before. I am indeed the one you refer to as the Phoenix Ancestor. I had been in deep slumber in a secret realm, but a few days ago, Elder Brother Lu Yang woke me up. Reborn from the ashes, I've returned to the mortal world."
The Grand Elder gasped, the Phoenix Ancestor, a mythical figure... Where on earth did Lu Yang dig up this big shot?
And he even managed to swindle her into joining the Heavenly Court Sect.
You're much more impressive than your master.
Old Nine goes out every day to cheat and deceive, yet his tricks are not as sharp as yours.
I'll have Old Nine take you as his master when we get back.
"Wait a second, what did you just call Lu Yang?"
Lu Yang quickly intercepted, halting the discussion on the subject, "It's nothing, it's nothing, Elder Lianyi misspoke."
The Seventh Elder shivered as he looked at Jiang Lianyi. So, when you said you were at an impasse earlier, you meant at the Semi-Immortal Stage?
"Previously, you mentioned there was someone ahead of you that you couldn't surpass. Who was this person?"
"The Qilin Immortal, or as people now might say, a Demon Immortal."
The Seventh Elder: "..."
Did I just say I could easily beat anyone, as long as they weren't at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage?
The Fifth Elder's expression wasn't much better than the Seventh Elder's; he too had uttered quite a few bold statements just before.
"You also mentioned knowing someone who claims to be the number one in Refining Artifacts, was it?"
"Yingtian Immortal."
The Fifth Elder almost didn't catch his breath.
The Third and Fourth Elders kept silent, thankful they hadn't spoken up before.
"And what is your position in the Heavenly Court?"
"One of the Four Imperial Protectors of the Heavenly Court, the Empress of Nirvana of the South Pole."
All five Elders gasped in astonishment.
They had come to visit the founding ceremony of the Demon Nation with the intent to broaden their horizons, but they did not expect to gain such insight so soon.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 604 - 603 The Purpose of Getting Stronger
chapters.content:
The Nirvana Emperor of the South Pole is a collective crystallization of wisdom from the three disciples of Fairy Eternity.
"South Pole" is a prefix conceived by Fairy Eternity, "Nirvana" was Lu Yang's idea, and considering that Ancient Di Jiang dared to call himself the Demon Emperor, Jiang Lianyi couldn't allow herself to choose a less imposing title, thus she chose the honorable title of "Emperor."
Before embarking on their journey, the five Elders were prepared to witness the legendary Ancient Di Jiang, a living semi-Immortal from ancient times and a figure of true importance.
There were still a few days before the founding ceremony, but this was merely a convenient detour to bring Lu Yang to Demon City to gain some worldly experience.
How did things take such an unexpected turn in the blink of an eye?
And why would the Phoenix Ancestor join the Heavenly Court, even becoming one of the Four Imperial Protectors?
Could it be that the Heavenly Court isn't a myth, that it really existed in ancient times, and their Heavenly Court Sect is actually an ancient organization?
Even though the five Elders had traveled the world and seen many wonders, this was their first encounter with a semi-Immortal entity.
Especially from such close range.
Jiang Lianyi raised her hand, signalling to the five Elders that there was no need to be overly nervous.
"The survival of the Heavenly Court Sect still requires the support of esteemed seniors."
"We dare not presume such honor."
Before knowing Jiang Lianyi's identity, they could indulge themselves by claiming to be seniors, but now that they knew who she was, who would dare assume such a position in front of this revered deity?
Inside the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity was so amused by the scene that she started rolling on the ground with laughter.
"Yes, yes, yes! That's exactly the reaction we were hoping for. Back when Lianyi, Xiao Ling, and I hid our identities to go to auctions and such places, it was all for this!"
Lu Yang: "..."
While Jiang Lianyi was speaking with the five Elders, the kind-hearted Lu Yang wanted multiple times to reveal Jiang Lianyi's identity, but was stopped by Fairy Eternity each time.
This was the reason.
Elder Lianyi truly lives up to being your unacknowledged disciple; even forgetting that experience could evoke such expressions from the five Elders. Is it an innate understanding or muscle memory?
Fairy Eternity made a carp flip, bounding up from the ground, and dusted herself off, then profoundly instructed the Second-in-command on the points of Cultivation, "You see, this is the purpose of becoming stronger."
Heeding the Immortal's guidance, Lu Yang pondered deeply.
It seems my Mind State is still not fully cultivated; to this day, I'm easily swayed by the deceptions of an Immortal, believing Fairy Eternity might actually say something profound and philosophical.
Faced with such an ancient influential figure, the Third Elder just so happens to have a question to ask.
He had recently been reading diligently, trying to improve his cultivation, to avoid embarrassing himself when out in public.
"I've been reading books that say the Yingtian Immortal is fond of wives, likes to marry and procreate, and has impregnated countless women. Is this true?"
Jiang Lianyi: "..."
What kind of rumors are these, and aren't they afraid of encountering danger during their Pass Tribulation?
Setting aside other considerations, the offspring of Immortals aren't so easily conceived; if it were that easy, she would have long since been carrying her husband's child.
Jiang Lianyi gently shook her head, refuting this claim: "The Yingtian Immortal is chaste and self-cultivating, without such a fondness."
"I also heard that the Nine Nether, governing life and death and the Reincarnation, determining the lifespans of all beings, existed in ancient times?"
This is the latest propaganda doctrine after the Jiuyou Sect teamed up with the Heavenly Court Sect.
"False. In ancient times, there was no talk of the Nine Nether or Reincarnation; people died just as a lamp goes out and do not live into a second life."
"What about Buddhism? The books say that Buddhism already existed in ancient times, with innumerable followers spread across the cosmos, and was a major power of the ancient era, with Buddha standing on the same footing as an Immortal."
Jiang Lianyi continued to shake her head in denial, "False, Buddhism indeed existed since ancient times, and all four Immortals were involved in the affairs of Buddhism, making it a first-rate power. But it does not exist in the way you imagine."
"I've also heard that you and the Dragon Clan Ancestor had caused an upheaval while being a Semi-Immortal, with meteors filling the sky and stars being ground to dust. Even those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage dared not watch from a close distance. You even performed the art of rebirth from the ashes, being reborn amidst the flames, with the phoenix's cry echoing through the cosmos?"
"That is true," Jiang Lianyi said affirmatively, her expression serious.
Following that, she fell into deep thought, as if recalling that arduous battle. She sighed longingly, lamenting that the past could not be chased after.
The five Elders were stunned, feeling the weight of history in Jiang Lianyi's sigh.
It was a sense of solitude that no one else could empathize with.
Fairy Eternity introduced Lu Yang, "She has learned three parts of the essence from Yingtian Immortal."
Jiang Lianyi snapped out of her reminiscence and asked, "I have just woken up and am not aware of the current affairs in the Cultivation World. There is something I need to inquire from you all."
"Please speak, Elder Jiang. Whatever we know, we will disclose without reservation."
"Do you know where my husband, who is also a Demon Immortal, might appear?"
The five Elders shook their heads in unison, "We're sorry to disappoint Elder Jiang. How mysterious is the existence of a Demon Immortal? Not to mention his possible whereabouts, we have no clue at all... Wait, did you call the Demon Immortal 'my husband'?"
The five Elders looked at Jiang Lianyi as if they had seen a ghost. The Demon Immortal and the Phoenix Ancestor being in such a relationship?
Is this what knowledge from an ancient great demon is like? Any statement made could overturn their understanding.
Third Senior Sister reacted calmly; she had been promised this matter by Jiang Lianyi while controlling the animal hide. When she had first learned about their relationship, she almost fell off, hide and all.
Jiang Lianyi had approached the matter with a try-and-see attitude; not hearing useful information did not surprise her.
"It seems that I will have to inquire with the Long Clan."
This place was a gathering of various major forces, among them was the Demon Territory Dragon Clan and the East Sea Dragon Clan.
"Meng Xiaoxian, I heard you're here?"
Footsteps and hearty laughter came from outside the door; it was the Gold Clan Leader from the Qiongqi Clan.
The Gold Clan Leader had instructed his subordinates that if they saw Meng Jingzhou in Demon City, they should report to him as soon as possible.
The subordinate lived up to expectations and saw Meng Jingzhou on the way to the inn.
With the five Elders of Seek Dao Sect accompanying Meng Jingzhou, it was hard to miss them.
Once the Gold Clan Leader heard Meng Jingzhou had arrived, he didn't hesitate to come to the inn arranged for Seek Dao Sect.
Just thinking about the Qiongqi Clan having money excited the Gold Clan Leader tremendously.
After he mentioned it to the Meng Family Clan Leader, he agreed immediately. The Qiongqi Clan's ability to borrow money must be inseparable from Meng Jingzhou's good word.
The Gold Clan Leader acted briskly. Hearing Meng Jingzhou's voice from the central guest room in the corridor, he pushed the door open without a second thought and blurted out, "Our Qiongqi Clan was able to borrow Spirit Stones, all thanks to you, my noble nephew!"
Then he saw Jiang Lianyi, who had taken off her hood, standing out strikingly in the guest room.
Their eyes met.
The Gold Clan Leader silently retreated, stepped out of the guest room, and closed the door behind him.
Jiang Lianyi beckoned with her finger, and the door opened. The Gold Clan Leader was pulled into the guest room by an invisible force, his struggles futile.
The Gold Clan Leader said nothing else, closed his eyes, and surrendered with his hands raised, "I understand the rules. I saw nothing today, I know nothing, I implore Elder Jiang to spare my life!"
Jiang Lianyi was silent for a moment.
In her memory, the Qiongqi Clan were always tough as nails. Had things really changed so much in thirty thousand years?
Meng Jingzhou was puzzled; ever since he left the Qiongqi Clan, he had been in the Demon Territory and had not yet sent word back home.

chapters.title: Chapter 605 - 604 Ying Tian Immortal is Really Kirin Immortal's Good Brother
chapters.content:
Members of the Demon Race wouldn't recognize Jiang Lianyi, but as the Qiongqi Clan Leader, how could the Gold Clan Leader not recognize her?
In the image of Demon Immortals, the ancestors of the Dragon and Phoenix are the strongest among the Demon Race and are revered idols. Their standings are remarkably significant within the Demon Race.
Ancient Di Jiang's fame is resounding, but he still falls short in comparison to them.
The ancestors of the Dragon and Phoenix had partaken in the war for supremacy among immortals, and though defeated, they retained their honor.
Ancient Di Jiang didn't even have the qualifications to participate in the war for supremacy among immortals. The disparity was clear.
If Little Ancestor were present, the Gold Clan Leader would definitely not have begged for mercy.
The problem was not the absence of support at present. Little Ancestor, upon hearing of Ancient Di Jiang's claim to the throne, didn't even show any interest in coming. Facing someone like Jiang Lianyi, a great demon of the ancient times, why would he be so defiant, hoping that the opponent might grant him a swift end?
Furthermore, the conflict between Jiang Lianyi and Little Ancestor involved the Qilin Immortal; it was essentially a domestic issue, or rather, like the squabbles between a wife and a mistress. Why should he meddle unnecessarily?
The Qiongqi Clan was so destitute, and as the Clan Leader, he had his own way of survival.
Be ruthless when it's necessary, be submissive when it's necessary.
The Gold Clan Leader inwardly sighed, Little Ancestor was right. The power struggle in this Great Era was more complex than imagined. Even the Phoenix Ancestor had stealthily revived, and considering the Qilin Immortal was behind the Phoenix Ancestor, how could their Qiongqi Clan vie for the top spot?
Hold on, why don't we Qiongqi Clan just pledge allegiance to the Qilin Immortal?
With this thought, the path became clear for the Gold Clan Leader, who saw a bright future ahead.
Jiang Lianyi was unaware that the Gold Clan Leader had so many thoughts in a fleeting moment. She felt irritated by the sight of the Qiongqi Clan. Originally, she wanted to pick a random Qiongqi and give it a lesson to vent her frustration, but with the Gold Clan Leader acting like this, disciplining him would be unsatisfying and dull.
"Look into my eyes."
Jiang Lianyi's words seemed to contain some sort of magic, compelling the Gold Clan Leader to comply involuntarily.
As the Gold Clan Leader and Jiang Lianyi locked eyes, he suddenly transformed back into his original form, a majestic, winged tiger with colorful stripes, appearing in a vast space, with a high-hanging moon above and the great sea underfoot, completely isolated.
Jiang Lianyi's voice echoed from above: "You are not allowed to mention seeing me to anyone, including both direct and indirect references."
When the Gold Clan Leader regained his senses, he found himself back in the guest room, and what had just happened seemed like a dream.
"What did Elder Lianyi do?" Lu Yang quietly asked Fairy Eternity. To outsiders, the Gold Clan Leader had merely zoned out for a moment and soon recovered. Lu Yang suspected that Jiang Lianyi had employed some kind of technique.
"This is the Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit Outline. It can control what the loser must or must not say, and she just made this little tiger swear secrecy regarding her affairs."
The so-called loser generally needs to have fought a battle with Jiang Lianyi first, but the discrepancy in cultivation level between the Gold Clan Leader and Jiang Lianyi was too vast; thus, Jiang Lianyi could directly use the Dao Fruit Outline to control him.
"She has often used this power before."
"Why?" Lu Yang puzzled.
It was complicated to explain, and Fairy Eternity, with her head tilted back and eyes full of eagerness, thought for a while before explaining:
"The Qilin Immortal often sneaks out to seduce female members of the Demon Race, right? Initially, when Lianyi sternly intimidated him, the Qilin Immortal would confess everything like spilling beans."
"Later on, the Yingtian Immortal taught the Qilin Immortal that as an Immortal, one must have a poised character, be calm and unflustered in the face of events. The Qilin Immortal learned well, and since then, when Lianyi tried to intimidate him, he wouldn't tell the truth, acting tough as iron meat."
"Lianyi couldn't defeat the Qilin Immortal and was helpless about it, so she would seek out the suspicious female demons and fight them. Once defeated, she'd employ the Dao Fruit Outline to make them tell the truth."
"After they told the truth, the Qilin Immortal would kneel in the Sword Array."
Lu Yang: "..."
Qilin Immortal and Yingtian Immortal were indeed good brothers, with Yingtian Immortal teaching him how to deceive and even refining the Sword Array for him.
"Hm? Didn't I tell you before, that it was Yingtian Immortal who taught Lianyi and Xiao Ling how to fabricate the Sword Array?"
"Qilin Immortal had been kept in the dark, thinking that it was Lianyi and Xiao Ling who discovered it by accident. He was filled with immense regret when the truth was uncovered."
Lu Yang felt that the situation in ancient times was complex and intricate, with even Immortals engaging in cunning and struggle for power.
"It seems Elder Lianyi is quite certain that Qilin Immortal is still alive?"
According to Lu Yang's observations, Jiang Lianyi had been contemplating along the way how to find Qilin Immortal, as if she was convinced that he was still alive, untouched by the hidden hand behind the scenes.
"You noticed, since she's sure that Qilin Immortal is still alive, then he is indeed alive."
Fairy Eternity paused for a moment before explaining, "Do you remember me mentioning that if Qilin Immortal became an Immortal, Lianyi, and Xiao Ling could not become Immortals?"
"Lianyi was originally qualified to become an Immortal, but it was Qilin Immortal who defeated her and attained Immortality first, causing her to lose her opportunity."
"If Qilin Immortal had passed away, she would have felt the absence of the force suppressing the Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit Outline, and she could have become an Immortal right now."
Lu Yang had an epiphany.
"Cases like Lianyi and Xiao Ling are exceedingly rare among Semi-Immortals."
"There were many Semi-Immortals in ancient times.
The reason why they didn't become Immortals was not because we five were suppressing them, but because those Semi-Immortals simply could not cultivate to the step of becoming Immortals – it's a matter of talent," Fairy Eternity said with a hint of disdain for those Semi-Immortals, particularly Ancient Di Jiang who, lacking in talent, blamed the era for his shortcomings and insisted on becoming an Immortal in the current times.
This was also the reason why Jiang Lianyi, and Ao Ling, were widely acknowledged as the strongest beneath the Immortals, not because they had a powerful husband like Qilin Immortal, but because they themselves were incredibly strong.
Becoming an Immortal is not something you can achieve through sheer effort; it's the moment of enlightenment that's most crucial.
Back in the day, Fairy Eternity had many options for Dao Fruit and had trouble deciding, precisely because she had many moments of enlightenment.
Among her contemporaries who were Semi-Immortals, there were no few who held the outlines of the Immortal Dao Fruit and Indestructible Dao Fruit. Once the Dao Fruit Outline coalesced into Dao Fruit, it would be a congenitally invincible Dao Fruit. Who wouldn't want to coalesce it?
However, coalescing such Dao Fruits was extremely difficult, and even Fairy Eternity was not sure she could succeed without the inspiration from Time Immortal.
"Alright, you can go back now."
Jiang Lianyi tossed the Gold Clan Leader out the door as if the Demon King-level Qiongqi was no different to her than a Little Tiger.
No good as a punching bag, and useless to keep around.
…
With no inclination to continue witnessing the founding ceremony, the Gold Clan Leader, like someone granted a pardon, hurriedly flew back through the night to the Qiongqi Tomb to see the little ancestor.
"Little ancestor, terrible news..." The Gold Clan Leader stumbled and rushed to the little ancestor, intending to speak, only to realize he couldn't utter a single word.
The young girl's expression changed slightly at the sight of the Gold Clan Leader in such a state.
"Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit Outline? Jiang Lianyi's technique? She's still alive?"
In ancient times, she was also one of the female members of the Demon Race that Jiang Lianyi had confronted, and she was more than familiar with Jiang Lianyi's methods.
Zhu Tian did not use the Dao Fruit Outline in this way.
She immediately realized the significance and let a cold smile curl her lips.
"I had no wish to stir up conflicts, it would have been enough to be among the top ten forces in the Great Era. But now that Jiang Lianyi has surfaced, I shall become the eleventh top force!"

chapters.title: Chapter 606 - 605 Storm Gathering
chapters.content:
Two uninvited guests arrived at a large mansion in Demon City; the countenances of the Phoenix Tribe were so gloomy they could drip water.
When Demon City received other forces, they were arranged to stay in inns. For Great Xia, Buddha Country, Long Clan, Phoenix Tribe, the accommodations were even more upscale, arranged in mansions.
An elder from the Di Jiang Clan came uninvited, once again attempting to persuade the Phoenix Tribe to surrender.
The Phoenix Tribe also had an ancient figure akin to a living fossil, who personally came forward to refuse.
In such high-level confrontations, even the Phoenix Tribe Clan Leader, Jiang Xi, could only stand on the sidelines.
"Jiang Mingzi, it is said that 'heroes struggle to find a wise ruler.' Our ancestor actively wants to accept you. If your tribe could join the Demon Nation, the position of the second largest clan would be yours. Opportunities like this are rare; treasure it well!" the Di Jiang Clan elder said with a smile that barely concealed a threat in his eyes.
Another unwelcome visitor was the Clan Leader of the Taozhu Clan, with a Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivation level. His mere presence brought immense pressure to the Phoenix Tribe members.
"My Phoenix Tribe will not join any forces. Please leave!" responded the Phoenix living fossil, unfazed by their antics. From the records left by the ancestors, the Ancient Di Jiang was not an easy character to deal with; joining the Demon Nation was probably not as simple as it sounded.
"Leave? Jiang Mingzi, have you misunderstood something? I'm not here to ask you; I'm here to command you!"
"What do you intend to do!" roared the Phoenix living fossil.
"What to do?" The Taozhu Clan Leader sneered, pulling out a golden decree from his bosom. It radiated Immortal charm and was bedazzled with pearls and jewels, clearly a first-class Immortal treasure.
"See what this is!"
The Di Jiang Clan elder activated the decree with his Essence Blood. The decree was imprinted with the Dao Fruit Outline of the Ancient Di Jiang, and it also contained the full power of a strike from the Ancient Di Jiang.
If one could not withstand this strike, they would be branded with a master-servant imprint, submitting to the Ancient Di Jiang!
The Taozhu Clan Leader had submitted in exactly this manner.
"A Semi-Immortal decree!" Jiang Mingzi recognized immediately what the item was, due to the continuous legacy of the Phoenix Tribe.
"Summon the ancestor's token!"
As if facing a formidable enemy, he too pulled out a treasure from his bosom, a jade pendant intricately carved with a lifelike phoenix.
A colorful phoenix emerged from the pendant no larger than a palm, burning with True Fire, emitting a lazy yet astonishing aura, its presence in no way inferior to the Semi-Immortal decree.
Two silent and formless auras collided, as if two great demons from Ancient Times were contending across three hundred thousand years.
Boom——
Suddenly, the Semi-Immortal decree self-ignited, bursting into fierce flames. It became dim as if it were burnt paper, the aura of the Ancient Di Jiang no longer present, the imprint of the Dao Fruit Outline riddled with holes.
"Cough——"
The Di Jiang Clan elder and the Taozhu Clan Leader both stepped back, coughing up blood slightly.
"You may leave now," said Jiang Mingzi, holding the phoenix jade pendant, his expression unchanged.
"Very well, very well, you sure did well!" The Di Jiang Clan elder and the Taozhu Clan Leader laughed in anger, knowing they were outmatched, and left the mansion.
...
"Mr. Ji, is it really safe for us to be in Demon City?" whispered Kong Hao, shrinking his neck; his body was sealed with the old Taozhu, Ji Xiong. At Ji Xiong's strong insistence, he reluctantly came to Demon City to gain some experience.
"Be braver. There are many from the Human race who come to Demon City. If you keep quiet, no one will notice you," the old Taozhu said confidently with a smile.
He was a contender for the position of clan leader who failed and got sealed in Kong Hao's body. Hearing about the establishment of a nation in the Demon Territory, with the Taozhu Clan as part of it, he insisted on coming to see it for himself.
"Hm?"
The old Taozhu looked up, noticing two disheveled figures in the sky.
One of them was his old adversary, the current Clan Leader of the Taozhu Clan.
"What happened?" Kong Hao asked.
"Nothing much, just encountered an expected acquaintance," replied the old Taozhu indifferently.
...
The elder from the Di Jiang Clan and the Clan Leader from the Taozhu crossed several layers of guards without pausing for their salutes and hurried to the depths of Demon City.
In the depths of Demon City, where the light was dim, Ancient Di Jiang revealed his true form and sat on the massive imperial throne, resembling a small mountain.
To both sides of the throne stood rows of equally majestic and huge figures, faintly exuding the aura of beings in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, recognized in the Demon Territory as the existence of Demon Emperors.
As a being of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage himself, the elder from the Di Jiang Clan feared no Demon Emperor; his loyalty was to the ancient ancestor seated on the imperial throne.
The Ancient Ancestor valued hierarchical order; only those in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage were qualified to speak with him.
The two demons slowed their pace, knelt on both knees, and respectfully said, "Your Majesty, the Phoenix Tribe has sent their reply."
Ancient Di Jiang opened his eyes, which were frighteningly bright like two full moons, cold and profound.
"What did the Phoenix Tribe say?"
The elder, filled with indignation, replied, "The Phoenix Tribe stubbornly refuses to repent, and their stance is firm; they are unwilling to submit to Your Majesty. Regardless of whether I promised them high status in the Demon Nation, second only to our clan, or threatened them with force if they did not agree, nothing worked."
"We two carried the Imperial decree from our Ancient Ancestor, and pressed them with force but the Phoenix Tribe brought forth a phoenix jade pendant left by the Phoenix Ancestor to counter us, and we failed to control them."
The elder pulled out the Imperial decree from his chest; what was once a glistening, sacred command now tattered, clearly having endured severe damage and rendered unusable.
The expressions of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage great demons who flanked the imperial throne varied. This kind of decree contained the power of Ancient Di Jiang. It was precisely this kind of decree that had controlled them when the envoys of the Di Jiang Clan used it in the past.
They had not refrained from trying to rebel, but the decree's power was too formidable, and its changes too swift for them to react.
Not receiving the result he wanted, Ancient Di Jiang coldly huffed, shaking the space around him in dissatisfaction.
"Obstinate and foolish!"
He recalled his experiences from the Ancient Times, particularly the battles between Semi-Immortals, and his expression grew even uglier.
He knew the origins of that jade pendant: Lianyi liked jade flutes, and the jade pendant was a remnant piece from making a jade flute, a token of Lianyi, seeing the pendant was as seeing her.
"Do they really think that I'm afraid of the Phoenix Tribe? Let alone Lianyi's absence, even if she were present, the Phoenix Tribe wouldn't have the courage to defy me!"
He had undergone earth-shattering changes since the Ancient Times. Through the Dao Fruit Outline, he controlled nearly a hundred major clans, ten beings in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, and had a multitude of powerful subordinates under him. The Dao Fruit Outline had become increasingly perfected in this process, showing signs of coalescing.
Saying that it was a completely different time would not be an exaggeration.
If he could not solve even the minor issue of the Phoenix Tribe, what would have been the point of his dangerous awakening from the ancient slumber?
"If the Phoenix Tribe does not join the Demon Nation, it leads a significant number of races in the Demon Territory to follow their lead and also refuse to surrender."
"To unify the Demon Territory and establish the Demon Nation, the problem with the Phoenix Tribe must be resolved, either by making them submit or by erasing them from existence!"
"Today I have been benevolent, so if in the future the Phoenix Tribe is annihilated, let them have no grievances..."
The eyes of Ancient Di Jiang were cold and stern; unifying the Demon Territory would aid in advancing his Cultivation Level further, completing his transformation from a Semi-Immortal to an Immortal.
Others were waiting for the Great Era to fully revive, waiting for opportunities, but he did not need to wait for that chance. Today, the lack of powerful beings in the Demon Territory was his opportunity.
By acting early to seek the path to Immortality, he would then become a player in the revival of the Great Era!
Unifying the Demon Territory was just the first step; next, he intended to unify the East Sea, bringing the Sea Clan under his dominion, thus becoming unprecedentedly powerful.
With both the East Sea and the Demon Territory under his control, he would leap to become the number one power in the Cultivation World, surpassing Great Xia and the Buddha Country!
He could even venture further, attacking Great Xia and the Buddha Country to unify the Cultivation World.
By that time, it would be useless for anyone to awaken; even if the Four Ancient Immortals were to return, he would not fear them!
What he needed to do now was to ensure a successful founding ceremony and establish the Demon Nation, so that attacking the Phoenix Tribe would be justified, and no one could fault him.
Given the high status of the Phoenix Tribe in the Demon Territory, if he acted prematurely, it would easily tarnish his reputation and be detrimental to his image.
"Phoenix Tribe... I hope you can still be this defiant during the founding ceremony!"

chapters.title: Chapter 607 - 606: It's You!
chapters.content:
"There is another matter you must attend to,"
Ancient Di Jiang tossed a token to an elder of the Di Jiang Clan, who hastily caught it before it could fall to the ground.
"The Phoenix Jade Token you two saw among the Phoenix Tribe is called the Phoenix Order, to see the Phoenix Order is to see Jiang Lianyi."
"This is the Di Jiang Order I crafted, to see this token is to see me, as it contains the might of the outline of my Dao Fruit."
"The founding ceremony is imminent. It represents not only the establishment of a nation but also a show of power. It is crucial to the future development of the Demon Nation, as well as the world's perception of it. At that time, all the great powers will be present, which is the perfect opportunity to let these powers witness the strength of our Demon Nation."
Ancient Di Jiang spoke slowly, "To intimidate, the best way is to find a stepping stone."
"Our Demon Nation's foundation is unstable, and we should not make enemies of the great powers now."
"The Heavenly Court Sect has been in the spotlight recently, claiming to be led by Heavenly Venerate Dou from the Ancient Heavenly Court, it's laughable that the world believes it to be true."
"This so-called Heavenly Court Sect is the perfect stepping stone, big in name yet average in strength, and a counterfeit at that."
The Di Jiang Clan elder made a face, "But where do we find this Heavenly Court Sect?"
Ancient Di Jiang looked exasperated at his descendant, "Why search for them? Just get someone to play the part."
"They are fakes to begin with. If we have someone impersonate them, who can say we're the fakes?"
The elder's eyes lit up, and he respectfully praised, "Your wisdom is boundless, great ancestor!"
Ancient Di Jiang enjoyed the praise, his brows relaxed slightly as he continued, "I hear the Heavenly Court Sect has Heavenly Venerate Dou, a master, a Heavenly King protector, a Young Sect Master, and a Saint Heir."
"You just find a few to impersonate members of the Heavenly Court Sect, particularly the Heavenly King Protector, Young Master Lu and the like."
