"Although the Heavenly Court Sect is fake, Young Master Lu's strength is still considerable. Being recognized as the top among his peers in Great Xia, genius represents the future. Only by nurturing a genius can a power's extraordinariness be proven."
"When the founding ceremony begins, let the imposter Young Master Lu appear to challenge the Demon Nation. I will send my disciple to the stage for a duel with him."
"After defeating Young Master Lu, I will reveal the true face of the Heavenly Court Sect. This way, not only can the world witness the genius nurtured by me and step on Great Xia, but they will also marvel at my insight and depth!"
"Your wisdom is boundless!" The Di Jiang Clan elder showed a hesitant expression, voicing his concern, "But Young Master Lu's talent is truly rare in this world. If I randomly find someone, I'm afraid the great powers might see through the ruse."
Ancient Di Jiang waved his hand dismissively, "No matter, use the Di Jiang Order to control those imposters. Command them to squeeze out their potential, similar to burning Essence Blood, to forcibly strengthen themselves. This way, they will be almost indistinguishable from the real Young Master Lu."
"Alright, if there are no issues, then go."
Ancient Di Jiang sighed inwardly, none of his descendants were clever, everything required his personal intervention.
…
"Shall we go out for a walk?" Lu Yang suggested early in the morning, as staying idle in the inn was boring. It would be a good opportunity for Elder Lianyi to step out and experience the cultivation world of today.
Jiang Lianyi thought for a moment and felt that going out for a walk was a good idea, especially since finding the Qilin Immortal was not urgent.
Lu Yang got dressed properly, quickly freshened up, and stepped out of the inn.
As soon as he left, he encountered someone he had just become familiar with.
"It's you!"
Qin Feng of the Jiuying Clan glared at Lu Yang with teeth clenched.
Next to Qin Feng were the Geniuses of the Demon Clan Alliance.
Seeing Lu Yang leaving the inn, they came to a realization and angrily pointed at Lu Yang, "You're from the Seek Dao Sect!"
This guy isn't from the Phoenix Tribe at all, but from the Seek Dao Sect!
"I understand now, the ones accompanying Jiang Shishi must be Seek Dao Sect's Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou!"
One of the Demon Clan Geniuses reacted quickly, realizing the truth. Although they had never seen what these two looked like, considering the skills demonstrated in the Creation Ancient Land, only Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou could match.
In fact, Lu Yang wanted to say that there are three people in Seek Dao Sect whose level isn't much different from the two of us, so don't just assume it's us.
But speaking of it now is useless, they may be dim-witted, but lucky, they guessed right.
Man Gu and his two companions didn't show up in the Golden Core Stage finals, so the world isn't too familiar with their existence.
Lu Yang turned around and walked back to the inn, Qin Feng and the others didn't dare to barge into the inn, as cursing and swearing would damage their image, so they could only block the entrance in anger.
"Why did you come back?"
Jiang Lianyi was about to leave when she saw Lu Yang returning on the same path, expressionless.
"Miscalculated, someone recognized me," sighed Lu Yang as he described the situation at the door and how they made enemies in Creation Ancient Land.
Jiang Lianyi was somewhat troubled, as it wasn't convenient for her to intervene in the vendettas of the younger generation.
"How about I disguise you?" Jiang Lianyi, who comes from Fairy Eternity, is first-rate in disguise techniques. Although her memories had vanished, her skills were still there.
"That would be best!" exclaimed Lu Yang, delighted.
Jiang Lianyi stretched out both hands, holding Lu Yang's cheeks, and began to knead and rub his face. Soon, Lu Yang took on a completely different appearance, so much so that even an Elder wouldn't recognize him.
Lu Yang went back to change his clothes and after some thought, to make the disguise more thorough, he took a sword with him.
"Perfect," Lu Yang gestured a thumbs up to his own reflection in the copper mirror.
The two of them walked out of the inn boldly, and Qin Feng and the others didn't recognize Lu Yang at all.
Jiang Lianyi, wearing a cloak, emitted an aura that warded off strangers, and Qin Feng and the other juniors didn't dare to come close.
Moreover, judging by the figure, it was a female cultivator, which didn't match up with Lu Yang's appearance.
Demon City was bustling, a mix of the Demon Race and Human race, and though there were minor frictions, there were no major disturbances.
In Demon City, the Human race accounted for half the number, the Demon Race set up shops, shouting and selling goods, and envoys from Buddha Country were seen holding alms bowls seeking donations.
"Benefactor, you carry a heavy air of resentment. This monk is willing to recite scriptures to dispel the resentment from you. Would the benefactor be willing to donate some Spirit Stones to help our Buddhism cast a Golden Body?"
"Get lost, get lost, get lost, I've been building Demon City for over a month, and after its completion, they told me it was voluntary labor. How could your scriptures possibly disperse my resentment?"
The envoy from the Buddha Country gave an embarrassed chuckle and looked for the next person to beg from.
Soon, the Buddha Country envoy encountered Master Jiesha's Junior Brother, Master Jie Chen, and the two high monks from Buddhism clasped their hands together and chanted the name of Buddha.
"Jie Chen, it's been a long time since we last met. Would you be willing to donate some Spirit Stones to help our Buddhism cast a Golden Body?"
"Certainly," Master Jie Chen promptly took out a few Top-grade Spirit Stones from inside his robe and placed them into the alms bowl of the envoy, making a crisp sound.
"Chen Yuan, it's been a long time since we last met. Would you be willing to donate some Spirit Stones to help our Buddhism cast a Golden Body?"
"Certainly," Buddha Country envoy Master Chen Yuan took a few Top-grade Spirit Stones from inside his alms bowl and returned them to Master Jie Chen.
In this manner, the two high monks had earned themselves double the merit.
Jiang Lianyi found it an eye-opening experience.
When she first created the story of Buddhism, there was the setting of begging and casting Golden Bodies to accumulate merit, but she did not expect to see such an efficient method of accumulating merit.
To be honest, Lu Yang too found it an eye-opener.
Lu Yang also saw Sect Leader Qiu Jin'an asking the Sea Clan if they were willing to relocate to Five Elements Sect's Water Vein, promising that their sect would handle the immigration procedures.
Unfortunately, it didn't succeed. The Sea Clan agreed to visit the Five Elements Sect, but that was about it for relocation.
An elder of the Di Jiang Clan was looking for suitable candidates on the street, but didn't find anyone suitable after searching for half a day. When he saw Lu Yang, his eyes lit up.
It's you!

chapters.title: Chapter 608 - 607: From Now On, You Will Be Young Sect Master Lu
chapters.content:
```
Choosing a fake Young Sect Master Lu was not an easy task.
It wasn't as simple as dragging any Golden Core Stage cultivator from the street; even under the command of the Di Jiang Order, a normal Golden Core Stage cultivator could not replicate a sect master of Young Master Lu's caliber.
At the very least, they would need a Golden Core Stage cultivator with a solid foundation, only then would there be room for maneuver.
Secondly, they must be skilled with a sword.
During the period when Young Sect Master Lu ran rampant in the Seek Dao Sect, the most eye-catching skill he possessed was his swordsmanship.
And this person should not belong to any major power.
The disappearance of disciples from a major power could easily lead to trouble.
Therefore, an elder of the Di Jiang Clan searched for half a day and could not find a suitable candidate.
He noticed Lu Yang with a precious sword on his back.
The Ancient Di Jiang had awakened two hundred years ago, and while it seemed that he had unified most of the Demon Territory within a mere half-year, in reality, this was the culmination of two hundred years of accumulated strength.
During those two hundred years, the Di Jiang Clan had collected various pieces of intelligence in secret, including information on the geniuses of the current era.
Whether it was Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, Man Gu, Bai Ming from the Five Elements Sect, or Shi Chan from the Suspension Temple, they knew their appearances.
This person carrying the precious sword was not among the disciples collected by the Di Jiang Clan; he must be either a loose cultivator or a disciple from a lesser-known power!
Perfect for impersonating Young Sect Master Lu!
The one in the black robe beside him appeared to only be at the Body Integration Realm, not quite a concern.
The elder of the Di Jiang Clan made his plans in secret.
With so many people around, it wasn't convenient to act; the Di Jiang Clan elder was very patient and followed the two.
Being at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, unless a Semi-Immortal intervened, no one could counter him; he would not be noticed.
"Why is someone following us continually?" Fairy Eternity frowned unhappily.
Jiang Lianyi also nodded, "Indeed, someone has been following us the whole time; it must be a Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator from the Di Jiang Clan."
"What does he want?"
"Who cares."
"Right."
A human, a ghost, and a demon continued to roam Demon City.
"We are not allowed in here?"
Lu Yang came to the center of Demon City, which was cordoned off by a hundred-meter-tall temporary wall. Great demons at the Body Integration Realm guarded this area, and no one was allowed to enter without permission.
"This is the Heavenly Altar used for the founding ceremony," Jiang Lianyi explained after a quick scan with her Spiritual Sense, knowing what was inside.
"It looks like Zhu Tian has shed a lot of blood." The main body of the Heavenly Altar was made of colored glaze and white jade, precious even in Ancient Times—Lianyi didn't even have any.
If Lianyi desired some, she would need to take raw materials like sand and stones to the Time Immortal, adjust conditions like wind direction and temperature, and then request the Time Immortal use the Time Dao Fruit to craft a piece of colored glaze and white jade.
"Oh, it's fine to see during the founding ceremony," Lu Yang said, as seeing it in advance would lose its mysterious appeal.
"Shall we look around that street?" Lu Yang pointed towards the other side of a narrow passage.
"Sure."
A human and a demon entered the passageway, and the Di Jiang Clan elder finally seized the opportunity: he held his breath, focused, and quickly followed them.
With a swift movement, he soared through the air, appearing in front of Lu Yang and Jiang Lianyi.
"Boy, I've finally caught you at a good moment; you made me wait!"
Before Lu Yang could react, he saw the Di Jiang Clan elder swiftly pull out the Di Jiang Order, stimulating it with essence blood. The Illusory Shadow of Ancient Di Jiang emerged, becoming nearly tangible, with bared fangs and claws. It burst through Lu Yang's pupils into his Spiritual Space, taking control of him.
Wielding the Di Jiang Order was like the presence of an Ancient Ancestor itself; not to mention a mere Golden Core Stage cultivator, even someone at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage couldn't withstand it!
In the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity held the Illusory Shadow of Ancient Di Jiang by the neck with one hand, her expression bizarre. What kind of trick was this?
```
The Illusory Shadow of the Ancient Di Jiang fluttered about like a living creature, struggling with its limbs flailing and its six wings beating, whipping up a hurricane in the Spiritual Space.
Thud—
Fairy Eternity didn't even think, her other hand smashed down on the head of the Ancient Di Jiang Illusory Shadow, instantly interrupting its attack.
"A Semi-Immortal level spiritual attack, it does have some substance."
Fairy Eternity was very confident, within Lu Yang's Spiritual Space, she was an invincible existence.
At the same time, the walls of the Spiritual Space shimmered with light, and the runes kept changing as if they were preparing for a charged attack.
This was the contingency left by the Eldest Senior Sister in Lu Yang's Spiritual Space, ensuring his safety within.
The Ancient Di Jiang Illusory Shadow, blocked by Fairy Eternity, saw the runes around the walls fade and merge with the wall as if they had never appeared.
Fairy Eternity slightly exerted force with her right hand and crushed the Ancient Di Jiang Illusory Shadow.
From beginning to end, the Ancient Di Jiang Illusory Shadow offered no resistance.
Lu Yang, unfortunately, was controlled by the Di Jiang command, his eyes vacant, his arms drooping, his entire body slackened, no longer wary of the old man.
"You too!"
The elder of the Di Jiang Clan operated the Di Jiang command at Jiang Lianyi, who was also controlled and unresponsive.
"What's your name, and which Sect are you from?" The elder from the Di Jiang Clan wanted to confirm one more time that the person he found was suitable.
"My name is Yun Yang, from the Heaven's Gate Sect."
"Yun Yang? No affiliation?" muttered the elder of the Di Jiang Clan, recalling the data on the geniuses of Great Xia that he held, but there was no one named Yun Yang.
"And this person next to you?" The elder of the Di Jiang Clan focused his gaze on Jiang Lianyi, who was clad in a black robe with an indiscernible appearance.
"She is my master, Su Yiren."
"The hermit Body Integration Realm Su Yiren, so it's her." The elder of the Di Jiang Clan understood, not many cultivators in Great Xia knew of Su Yiren, let alone in the Demon Territory.
"Skilled with the sword?"
"Skilled."
"The two of you are lucky to have been chosen by the Ancient Ancestor. You will be impersonating members of the Heavenly Court Sect in the founding ceremony two days from now."
"You are no longer Yun Yang, but the Young Sect Master Lu of the Heavenly Court Sect."
"Yes, I am Young Sect Master Lu!" Lu Yang declared with resonance.
"Good attitude," the elder of the Di Jiang Clan said with a satisfied nod.
"As for you, Su Yiren, you are the Heavenly King Protector of the Heavenly Court Sect."
Beneath the black robe, Jiang Lianyi rolled her eyes and ignored him.
The elder of the Di Jiang Clan didn't mind and continued, "Yun Yang, what you must do is to impersonate the Heavenly Court Sect at the founding ceremony and engage in battle with our Sect's geniuses, after a fierce fight, you will be defeated by our Sect's geniuses!"
"Yes, I guarantee to complete the mission!"
The elder of the Di Jiang Clan activated the Di Jiang command again, "I order you, with the premise of disregarding the costs, to exert all your potential, you must reach the level of Young Sect Master Lu in a short time!"
After speaking, Lu Yang's body turned crimson as if he was aflame, and he fell to the ground, curling up into a ball, clutching the area of his chest in his clothes, and letting out heart-wrenching cries of agony.
"So painful... so hot... power... power keeps surging out!"
All power comes with a price, and Lu Yang could not bear this force, rolling on the ground, beads of sweat the size of beans breaking out on his forehead, soon completely soaking his hair with sweat.
Sizzle sizzle sizzle—
Lu Yang's body temperature grew ever higher, the heat evaporating the sweat, emitting a sizzling steam.
Amidst the steam, Lu Yang slowly got up, adapting to the force.
The elder of the Di Jiang Clan was elated, indeed worthy of the Di Jiang command bestowed by the Ancient Ancestor, the effect was surprisingly good.
"Master, I have reached the level of Young Sect Master Lu!"

chapters.title: Chapter 609 - 608: The National Founding Ceremony Begins
chapters.content:
"Show me a set of swordsmanship."
The elder from the Di Jiang Clan ordered, and Lu Yang, not in control, obeyed the elder's command, dancing with his long sleeves and wielding his sword. The sword's edge was so sharp it was unstoppable, tearing through the air wherever it passed, and it looked down upon everything with disdain.
The Slash Decree and Break Decree were each executed, all moves designed to kill an enemy, such that even a cultivator in the Nascent Soul Stage would be apprehensive to face them head-on.
"Good, very good!" The elder from the Di Jiang Clan laughed heartily. If he didn't know that this was an imposter, he would have truly believed this was the Young Sect Master Lu.
He took out two masks and a painting from his storage ring.
"This is a human skin mask refined by me, just input spiritual essence to use it, allowing you to change into any appearance you desire."
"This is the appearance of the Young Sect Master Lu. Yun Yang, you should change into the Young Sect Master Lu according to this painting."
"And you, Su Yiren, very few have seen your true face, but we cannot rule out the possibility of encountering someone who knows you this time. You wear the mask and change into whatever you like."
The two took the human skin masks. Light as a feather, the masks felt cold against their faces. Lu Yang adeptly transformed himself into the Young Sect Master Lu.
Jiang Lianyi did a quick job of it, changing into a look that was somewhat similar to her own, about sixty to seventy percent similar, then she took
off her hood, revealing her disguised appearance.
"Next comes acting. Your eyes are not right, lacking that aged feel."
"What is the Heavenly Court Sect? It's a continuation of the Ancient Heavenly Court. Thirty thousand years have passed; there should be a mind state of time-changing landscapes and people coming and going, a look in the eyes that is vast and carries a tinge of reminiscence, as well as disdain for the present day."
"Moreover, the Heavenly Court was a major organization in the ancient times, and the ancient times were the most prosperous and powerful period in the Cultivation World. As the Young Sect Master and Heavenly King Protector of the Heavenly Court Sect, you should display pride in the ancient heritage!"
Lu Yang: "..."
You've considered it quite thoroughly.
When Lu Yang appeared as the Young Sect Master Lu, his thoughts were almost aligned with this, serving as a psychological hint to help him quickly get into character.
At this thought, Lu Yang chuckled: "What a load of bullshit, this Di Jiang Clan, whatever ancient Di Jiang. When there's no tiger in the mountains, the monkey is king. He's nothing but a defeated general under Heavenly Venerate Dou and doesn't even have the credentials to join our Heavenly Court!"
Jiang Lianyi let out a cold snort, her demeanor indifferent, looking at the elder with contempt, her icy gaze devoid of any emotion.
"Yes, that's the feeling!"
The elder from the Di Jiang Clan slapped his thigh, surprised that the two of them got it in one go.
"Very good, it seems that you and your disciple have quite the talent in this respect."
The elder from the Di Jiang Clan was meticulous in his work and shared some information about the Heavenly Court Sect. Lu Yang nodded frequently, noting that the other party's information about the Heavenly Court Sect seemed very accurate, without any errors.
"Alright, you two will proceed with my arrangements at the founding ceremony in two days. Before that, revert to your original appearances and carry on as usual, do not expose yourselves."
"Yes."
The elder from the Di Jiang Clan nodded, reported the results to the Ancient Di Jiang, and left Lu Yang and Jiang Lianyi behind.
The two were silent for a moment, with Jiang Lianyi breaking the silence.
"What do you say?"
Lu Yang shrugged: "Don't ask me, I'm currently controlled by Di Jiang. Whatever he tells me to do, I'll do."
Jiang Lianyi nodded: "Me too."
Having achieved their greatest prize in the Demon City, the two did not wander around but returned to the inn to share the news with everyone, making the elders slap their thighs in regret.
"Why, oh why, don't I come across such fortuitous occurrences!" The fifth elder felt as heartbroken as if Daoist Buyu had died.
Meng Jingzhou was also full of regret, as the Saint Heir of the Heavenly Court Sect, to have missed the chance to appear on such a crucial occasion.
Lu Yang patted Meng Jingzhou's shoulder regretfully, "It's all fate."
Third Senior Sister remained silent on the side, she belonged to the Seek Dao Sect, not the Heavenly Court Sect.
...
Two days flew by in the blink of an eye, and the kingdom founding ceremony officially began.
The tall walls built around the Heavenly Altar were dismantled, and from a distance, the Heavenly Altar was a bright white light, dazzling to the eyes.
"Is this glaze white jade? Such a huge piece?"
Cultivators who came to watch were moved by the sight, and even Great Powers at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage who saw it were inwardly shaken. The Heavenly Altar wasn't built from pieces of glaze white jade but carved from one whole piece of white jade.
It wasn't an exaggeration to say it was a priceless treasure!
The Heavenly Altar was divided into nine layers, corresponding to the nine realms of cultivation.
The forces attending the kingdom founding ceremony were divided into two categories: those who were invited by the Di Jiang Clan, such as the Buddha Country, the Long Clan of the East Sea, and so forth. The Di Jiang Clan did not dare to neglect these forces and arranged the best spectator seats for them, even placing fruits and other spirit foods on their seats.
The other category was made up of Loose Cultivators or small forces that came uninvited. These small forces gathered around the Heavenly Altar, and how well they could see the event was entirely up to luck.
Lu Yang and Jiang Lianyi, as Loose Cultivators, were temporarily separated from the elders.
Third Senior Sister also had to continue her trials in the Demon Territory and was hence among the group of Loose Cultivators.
"Old Qiu, we meet again." The Grand Elder greeted with a beaming smile and a clasped hand salute. To his left was Qiu Jin'an.
In a public setting, Qiu Jin'an couldn't afford to show displeasure and so could only respond with a smile.
"Second Prince, it's you this time." The Grand Elder stood up and greeted across several sects.
Instead of Prince Jiang Qun, it was Second Prince Jiang Zhu who had been sent by Great Xia.
Jiang Zhu stood tall and valiant, distinguished in both literature and martial arts, and rumoured to harbor ambitions for the throne.
Jiang Zhu clasped his hands and responded with the courtesy of a junior to the Grand Elder's greeting.
"Daoist friend Ao Li, has it been two hundred years since we last met? I hope everything is well with the Old Dragon Emperor?" The Grand Elder turned to the right, where Ao Yue from the Long Clan of the East Sea, the envoy sent by the Old Dragon Emperor, was seated.
Ao Li had dragon horns on his head, and from horn to foot, he was adorned with gemstones; just his attire alone was worth as much as all the possessions of an ordinary cultivator at the Body Integration Realm.
Seeing the Grand Elder sitting next to him made Ao Li's face sour, and he huffed, declining to speak more.
"Palace Master, I hope you are well."
"Look at you, this attitude makes us seem so distant. If one didn't know better, they might think we have some animosity. Have you forgotten how I helped you pass through your Inner Demon Tribulation?"
At the mention of this event, Ao Li's expression grew even uglier.
Two hundred years ago, he fell into the Inner Demon tribulation, a dragon's nature tends towards indulgence, and he was caught in the sensuous trials of the Inner Demon. At that time, the Long Clan of the East Sea was at a loss, uncertain how to proceed. Fortunately, the Grand Elder, who was visiting, stepped in.
Through elixirs and acupuncture, he rendered Ao Li impotent and helped him pass the Inner Demon tribulation.
Afterward, Ao Li sought renowned physicians and took a hundred years to recover his ability to consummate.
The Grand Elder was magnanimous and didn't mind Ao Li's attitude, turning to greet Master Chen Yuan from the Buddha Country sitting next to Ao Li.
"Master Chen Yuan, it's been fifty years since we last met, how have you been?"
Master Chen Yuan sat calm and composed. Seeing the Grand Elder greeting from afar, he chuckled, placed a single hand over his chest, and replied politely.
"A monk doesn't speak idle words, to be honest, I didn't expect to see the benefactor here, it's truly an unfortunate occurrence."

chapters.title: Chapter 610 - 609: Gold Clan Leader and the Jiuyou Sect
chapters.content:
"Master Chen Yuan, you are truly heartless. When you were young, you traveled through Great Xia with a forged credential, begging for alms. The government office caught you, and you almost got arrested for possessing forged official documents. It was I who stepped in to explain, and that's the only reason the government office didn't pursue charges against you for holding forged documents."
Great Xia has strict requirements for the qualification of monks and daoist priests. Whether they are monks from the Buddha Country or disciples of the Suspension Temple, they are treated the same and need to pass exams and verifications. Only with a legitimate credential can they be recognized by the dynasty as a monk.
Only after recognition can they beg for alms and perform religious duties. Otherwise, it would be against the law.
When Master Chen Yuan was young and came to Great Xia to spread Buddhist teachings, the first thing he did was to obtain a credential.
Upon mentioning this, Master Chen Yuan grew even more restless: "If it weren't for you telling me that I needed to obtain a credential to preach in Great Xia and then selling me the fake certificate, how could the government office have arrested me?"
The Grand Elder spoke with confidence: "It was you who came to me first, saying the people in Great Xia were living miserable lives, suffering immeasurably, and that you came to Great Xia to help the commoners escape their plight by leading them to recite Buddhist scriptures in your Buddha Country and enter the monastic life."
"I told you that the commoners in Great Xia live better than those in the Buddha Country, but you didn't believe it. I just wanted to let you see the inside of a prison."
"Even the prisoners in prison don't live as miserably as you claim. How could the common people be as you describe?"
"Later, when I saw how fiercely you resisted when caught by the government office, that's when I stepped in to explain why."
The Grand Elder and Master Chen Yuan were sitting in the front row, with Ao Li from the Dragon Clan of the East Sea between them.
Ao Li, listening to their argument, felt increasingly curious and for a moment forgot the grievance he held against the Grand Elder and couldn't help but ask, "Did the government office release Master Chen Yuan?"
"Not exactly, though he didn't know he was carrying a fake certificate and thus wasn't charged with possessing forged official documents. However, because he didn't understand the rules of Great Xia and had crossed the border directly, he was considered an illegal immigrant and still got arrested—and they ended up catching me as well," the Grand Elder replied.
"Why did they arrest you?" Ao Li didn't catch on at first.
"Because I made the fake certificate."
"Oh, right."
Master Chen Yuan closed his eyes to rest, no longer bothering with the Grand Elder.
The Grand Elder continued to look for acquaintances at the event.
Being away from home, and with Daoist Buyu absent, the Grand Elder's words and actions represented the reputation of the Seek Dao Sect. In such a setting, he had to take the initiative and carry out the diplomatic work for the Seek Dao Sect.
The Grand Elder, in his youth, had traveled everywhere—the East Sea Dragon Clan, Buddha Country, Demon Territory Dragon Clan, Phoenix Tribe, Qiongqi Clan... He had acquaintances in all of them.
"Is Little Gold not here?"
The Grand Elder noticed that the seat of the Qiongqi Clan Leader was empty and found it strange. How could he miss such a grand occasion as the founding ceremony of the Demon Nation?
"You know the Gold Clan Leader?" Ao Li couldn't help but ask again.
"Know him? Of course, I do. When Little Gold mistakenly joined the demonic sect, it was we, the Nine Disciples of the Dao Seeking Sect, who acted in time to fish him out from their clutches."
Ao Li grew even more curious: "Which demonic sect?"
"Qin Jiunian, shut your mouth!"
The Gold Clan Leader, panting from exhaustion and late to arrive, heard the Grand Elder bringing up the matter and warned with his eyes.
Two nights ago, he had met Jiang Lianyi and then rushed back to his clan to meet with the little ancestor. The little ancestor, upon learning of Jiang Lianyi's return to the world, foresaw that there might be an incident at the founding ceremony and told him to hurry back to attend.
The Di Jiang Clan and Qiongqi Clan spanned much of the Demon Territory, and the Gold Clan Leader had rushed back just in time, exhausted from the journey.
And as soon as he arrived, he heard the Grand Elder revealing his shameful past.
The Gold Clan Leader was quite young compared to the other leaders of the major powers, only a little over nine hundred years old.
Nine hundred years ago, when he had just reached the Nascent Soul Stage, he felt that the Qiongqi Clan was stagnant and rigid in their thinking. He believed that if this continued, they would become poorer and poorer.
To find a way out, he left his hometown and sneaked into Great Xia.
With no legitimate identity, he mingled in the black market for a long time, and by chance, he joined the Jiuyou Sect.
He worked for the Jiuyou Sect for a while when he met a wealthy young master.
Just like him, the young master indulged in eating, drinking, prostitution, and gambling, often treating others, and the two quickly became friends.
The young master lived a life of dissipation, but his money seemed endless, which evoked strong envy in him.
Once, he tentatively asked the young master about his background, which influential family could be so wealthy.
The young master said he wasn't the scion of an influential family, the money wasn't given by his family but earned by himself.
This made the Gold Clan Leader even more curious, so he continued to inquire about the young master's lucrative secrets and whether he could also get involved.
At first, the young master disagreed, but it was only after he had slaved away, doing everything for him, that the young master finally agreed.
The young master said he had a friend who invented a pill formula that could extend one's lifespan. Although the improvement was modest, it was enough to make cultivators with nearing lifespans desperate to buy. Investing in this industry now would make money, invest a hundred to earn a hundred and twenty; the more you invest, the more you earn.
The Gold Clan Leader tentatively invested twenty thousand spirit stones and, after a year, the young master gave him twenty-four thousand.
That night, the Gold Clan Leader was so excited that he couldn't sleep, feeling that the opportunity to make money had arrived.
But he wasn't reckless either, worried about the instability of this business, he tested it for another two years.
For three consecutive years, there were high profits every year, and the young master didn't lie!
The path to riches lay before him!
Unfortunately, unforeseen circumstances arose, and the Gold Clan Leader's superior, the Rudder Master of the Jiuyou Sect, found out.
The Rudder Master ousted the Gold Clan Leader and started to negotiate directly with the young master.
Some time passed, and the Gold Clan Leader was hunted by the Jiuyou Sect, which left him fleeing while trying to understand why.
Even when he escaped back to the Demon Territory, he couldn't figure out why the Jiuyou Sect wanted to kill him.
Two hundred years ago, while chatting with the Grand Elder, he inadvertently mentioned this matter, and that was when he learned that the young master he knew back then was the Eighth Elder.
The Nine Disciples of the Dao Seeking Sect had set a trap for the Jiuyou Sect, causing it to suffer a huge loss, and he was the first follower of the Jiuyou Sect to be tricked.
It was probably out of vengeance that the Jiuyou Sect's Master ordered his death, but he managed to escape.
A little over a year ago, he discovered that three followers of the Jiuyou Sect had infiltrated the Demon Territory. Remembering the days when he was being hunted, he was so angry that he slapped the three followers to death.
Joining the Jiuyou Sect and being deceived by the Nine Disciples of the Dao Seeking Sect—this was a disgrace that he definitely couldn't let the Grand Elder reveal.
His tiger eyes glared wide with hostility as he looked at the Grand Elder, who spread his hands to show he wouldn't disclose the matter.
I'm just here to reminisce, no ill intentions.
The Grand Elder wanted to continue chatting with old acquaintances, but just then, the deep sound of the bronze bell rang, echoing like it came from the ancient times and reverberating above the Heavenly Altar.
Clouds rose above the Heavenly Altar, with the massive figure of Di Jiang appearing and disappearing within them, very mysterious.
The clouds in the sky shifted, forming auspicious clouds.
The founding ceremony officially began.
Out of politeness, the Grand Elder had to temporarily put aside his intention to chat.

chapters.title: Chapter 611 - 610: The Lifelong Learning of Ancient Di Jiang
chapters.content:
Clang— Clang— Clang—
Nine bell tolls rang out, and auspicious clouds in the sky transformed into various shapes of hundreds of demons, vivid as life itself, representing the Demon Race that pledged allegiance to the Ancient Di Jiang.
The auspicious clouds of the hundred demons changed again, bowing respectfully towards the Heavenly Altar before turning back into white clouds. Like snowflakes or mist, they fell upon the mortal realm, scattering over the Heavenly Altar.
The Heavenly Altar became hazy, shrouded in mist as if at the dawn of creation, indiscernible and impenetrable, mysterious, and enigmatic.
Music started to play, the flute's sound rippling, the zither ethereal, and the drum and se resonating together, creating an atmosphere of peace and harmony where countless members of the Human race and the Demon Race were immersed in the sweet melodies.
A figure the size of a hill appeared along with the music, swaying atop the Heavenly Altar, enveloped by endless mist, barely distinguishable as a six-legged, four-winged creature of ancient times.
The ancient creature was entirely crimson as if it were the sun, unusually conspicuous within the fog.
Thump—
The music shifted, becoming spirited and vigorous, forceful and inspiring, captivating the races of weaker determination with its rhythm, making them want to expand territories and charge into battle alongside the Di Jiang Clan.
The ancient creature danced atop the Heavenly Altar, its movements graceful and meticulous, representing the most orthodox ancient dance.
The ancient creature fluttered its wings, stirring up a wild wind, as if it were opening the heavens and splitting the earth at the dawn of chaos, turning into the sun, shining brilliantly above the nine-tiered Heavenly Altar.
A Semi-Immortal being, the Ancient Venerable Zhu Tian.
All the major powers were prepared and simultaneously brought out the Recording Orbs to document the process.
"Is that the legendary Ancient Di Jiang?"
"So terrifying. I feel like he is looking at me." Someone shivered under the subtle oppressive force of Zhu Tian, legs trembling, unable to stand straight; that was the pressure from Zhu Tian, as well as the weight of ancient history.
"Ancient Semi-Immortal, from the most prosperous era of ancient times, listening to the teachings of the Four Ancient Immortals." Another person spoke in a low voice, filled with emotion; those were the best of times, when four Immortals appeared simultaneously, and the number of Semi-Immortals and beings at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage were so many, it was ludicrous compared to the present.
For the common folk, the ancient times were history, were legends, but for Zhu Tian, those were events he had experienced firsthand.
Merely on this point alone, he was incomparable to current-day Cultivators.
"The Di Jiang Clan is very adept at music?" Lu Yang was surprised, noticing that the musicians responsible for stirring the audience's emotions were all from the Di Jiang Clan, something that could not be mastered overnight.
"The Di Jiang Clan has always been very proficient in music and dance. Zhu Tian, in particular, is a master of this art. Music can inspire and also bewitch the heart. Zhu Tian is well-versed in musical theory, and on this basis, he comprehended the outline of the Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit that can control beings."
"During the ancient times when their lordships opened the altar to teach, Zhu Tian would perform his talents before that. This guy's strength is mediocre, but his performance skills are first-rate."
"Why do the people around seem to have an urge to submit upon seeing Zhu Tian?" Lu Yang keenly noticed the unusual reactions of the people surrounding them.
"He's using the Dao Fruit Outline; he wouldn't dare to directly use other methods here. This is the most shallow level of control, a form of psychological suggestion. Using it here is probably to set the tone."
Jiang Lianyi's expression was odd—being another holder of the Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit Outline and a fellow student who learned with Yingtian Immortal the art of maintaining facade, she couldn't be deceived by any tricks Zhu Tian used.
Slowly stepping out were ten figures emitting a terrifying aura, each unique in shape, only slightly smaller than Zhu Tian's own form, some appearing old and decrepit, others brimming with vigor... These figures signified absolute power.
These were the ten Transcendance Tribulation Stage Demon Emperors under Zhu Tian's command!
A Semi-Immortal of the first rank, ten Demon Emperors, and nearly a hundred great clans, this power was even a few shades mightier than the forces the second-generation Imperial Teacher of Great Yu had prepared for the restoration of his nation!
"Quick, look, isn't that the Supreme Elder of the White Tiger Clan? Wasn't it said that he fell? How is he still alive?!"
"Still alive, he's an old Demon Emperor in the late stages of Passing Tribulation!"
"And that one there, that's the Clan Leader of the Taozhu Clan. It's said that there was originally another Taozhu at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage contesting with him for the leadership. The two fought one-on-one, and he killed the other in single combat!"
"Really? Killed a peer?"
"Could there be any doubt? Go and ask around the Taozhu Clan. Everyone knows!"
"Is that Nine-headed Snake over there the old Clan Leader of the Jiuying Clan?"
One by one, the origins of the Demon Emperors at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage were recognized, and all the Cultivators in the Body Integration Realm present were filled with dread and trepidation. Venerate Zhu Tian's preparations were too thorough. Under this power, it was feared that the Dragon and Phoenix Clans would not be able to resist and would have to submit!
Zhu Tian pondered for a moment before he began to speak slowly, with a solemn expression, "The Great Era is about to arrive, the Demon Race is fragmented, each fighting for themselves, which weighs heavily on our heart. How can such a Demon Territory preserve itself in the struggle of the Great Era?"
"Before I went into slumber, I was entrusted by the Qilin Immortal. The Qilin Immortal hoped that I would extend a helping hand to save the Demon Territory in times of future peril."
"I am no seeker of power, but merely entrusted by the Qilin Immortal. And now, as the Great Era approaches and I fear a repeat of the ancient catastrophe, I wish to unite the Demon Race and establish a Demon Nation."
"Only by binding the strength of all clans into a single rope can we pass through the tribulations of the Great Era and preserve the power of the Demon Race!"
"With the fall of the Qilin Immortal, the Demon Race lacks someone to lead the fight. Although I am not talented and cannot reach the heights of the Qilin Immortal, I have contended with many a Semi-Immortal. Out of their esteem for me, I have been given the laudatory title of 'the foremost below the Semi-Immortals,' a title I truly find undeserved."
Zhu Tian's voice was downcast, as if he felt that the title of "the foremost below the Semi-Immortals" was too exaggerated. Even though he possessed the strength that warranted the title, it didn't suit his understated nature.
It also seemed as if he were reminiscing about those deceased comrades, resenting that they left too soon, leaving the heavy burden of unifying the Demon Territory on his shoulders.
Suddenly, Zhu Tian's eyes lit up, breaking free from the ancient memories, rallying his spirits. Now was not the time for despondency—he needed to focus on the present and take up the great responsibility.
With a determined gaze, Zhu Tian announced in a voice that could be heard throughout the entire Demon City:
"Let heaven witness, let the Four Ancient Immortals witness, those people are gone, the Ancient Era cannot be pursued, the calamity of the Great Era is upon us. For the sake of countless lives of the Demon Race, I hereby declare, on this day, the Demon Nation is established and I shall be the first leader of the Demon Nation!"
Boom—Boom—
Suddenly, the sky was covered with dark clouds, lightning flashed, and thunder rolled. Four purple bolts of lightning as thick as water buckets struck down, as if the Four Ancient Immortals witnessed this historic moment and agreed with Zhu Tian's founding of the nation.
Zhu Tian's body trembled with excitement, his eyes brimming with tears: "Zhu Tian here thanks the Four Immortals!"
Shills arranged by the Di Jiang Clan started clapping enthusiastically from below the stage, the applause thunderous, deafening to the ears.
Jiang Lianyi: "..."
Husband's entrustment, being the foremost below the Semi-Immortals, crafting talismans to simulate lightning, arranging shills to lead applause, you're well prepared.
Jiang Lianyi suspected that all Zhu Tian learned in his Yingtian Immortal's lessons had been used here.
Lu Yang's expression was somber, the first time he had witnessed a counterpart on par with him in acting.

chapters.title: Chapter 612 - 611: Taking Action
chapters.content:
(Yesterday, Zhu Tian spoke of being the first one under the immortals, not the first one under the semi-immortals, this has been corrected.)
Everyone held their breath, and as four Immortal Thunders descended, it signified the establishment of the Demon Nation, with Zhu Tian as its first sovereign.
Being able to witness the establishment of the Demon Nation with their own eyes was indeed worth the journey.
Zhu Tian's visage was dignified, his voice deep as he cast his gaze onto the Phoenix Tribe, who had been invited to attend.
"Phoenix Tribe, now that the Demon Nation is established, it is time we need assistance. If you are willing to join the Demon Nation now, we promise to treat you generously!"
"Should you be unwilling, the catastrophe of the Great Era is imminent, and for the future of the Demon Race, we will have no choice but to resort to certain measures!"
The various powers that came to witness the event were startled. Was Venerate Zhu Tian intending to take this opportunity to subjugate the Phoenix Tribe and unify the Demon Territory?
The hearts of the Phoenix people trembled. They had anticipated that Zhu Tian would target the Phoenix Tribe after establishing the Demon Nation, but they did not expect it to come so swiftly.
The old Clan Leader of the Phoenix Tribe, Jiang Mingzi, stood up and swept his sleeves, letting out a cold snort, as thin streams of flame meandered around his body, readying for battle.
"Venerate Zhu Tian, do not assume I am unaware of your thoughts. Unifying the Demon Territory, the East Sea, and in one fell swoop making the Demon Nation the largest power under the heavens, your next plan is to attack Great Xia and the Buddha Country!"
"By that time, apart from your Di Jiang Clan, all other races will be cannon fodder, thrust into the front line of battle, all to satisfy your ambition!"
Zhu Tian exuded a pressuring aura, the combined weight of his own and that of the ten Transcendance Tribulation Stage demon emperors, a pressure towering like a mountain weighing down on Jiang Mingzi, making his bones creak.
Zhu Tian's expression was cold and contemptuous as he stared at Jiang Mingzi, who was still desperately resisting: "You younger generation are so impolite. Not to mention you, even Jiang Lianyi would respectfully refer to me as a dao friend when she sees me!"
"Your experiences are too shallow, you've never lived through the ancient affairs, you cannot empathize with me and realize the horror of the Great Era catastrophe. What qualifications do you have to speculate on my thoughts?!"
"With nothing but unfounded, nonsensical talk, you've positioned me as an enemy to the entire world. It's as if you truly do not grasp how the word 'death' is written!"
Zhu Tian radiated a terrifying aura. He wasn't angered by Jiang Mingzi's wild speculations; on the contrary, Jiang Mingzi's guesses were accurate.
The Demon Nation had just been established and its foundations were unsteady; it was not yet capable of facing both Great Xia and the Buddha Country simultaneously. He had to put on an angry demeanor, reprimanding Jiang Mingzi as spouting nonsense.
It was unexpected that the Phoenix Tribe also had wise individuals, it's just a pity that intelligence was misdirected!
Jiang Mingzi quietly slipped his hand into his chest, holding several ancient treasures left by the ancestors, ready to deal Zhu Tian a severe blow at the critical moment.
Whoosh, whoosh!
Two figures appeared side by side, standing next to Jiang Mingzi.
"That's the ancestral forefather of the Long Clan from the Demon Territory!"
"And from the East Sea Long Clan as well!"
Both the Long Clan of the Demon Territory and the Phoenix Tribe shared prosperity and loss; if the Demon Nation were to subdue the Phoenix Tribe, then the Long Clan would be next. They couldn't just stand by and watch Zhu Tian treat the Phoenix Tribe in such a manner.
Officially, the Long Clan sent Body Integration Realm individuals to participate in the ceremony, but secretly they had also sent two Transcendance Tribulation Stage members.
The Dragon and Phoenix Clans, three Transcendance Tribulation Stage beings!
"Overestimating oneself."
Zhu Tian sneered, and ten Transcendance Tribulation Stage great demons appeared. With just one command from him, the ten great demons would engage in battle with the three Transcendance Tribulation Stage members of the Dragon and Phoenix Clans.
Defeating these three would naturally lead to branding them with master-servant imprints.
His method of battle was akin to rolling a snowball, taking control of all defeated enemies to continuously grow his own power.
He dared to self-proclaim as the first under the immortals for this very reason; he had the confidence to back it up.
With himself plus the ten Transcendance Tribulation Stage individuals, he was a sure victor against any ancient semi-immortals!
However, Zhu Tian also dared not act rashly, for among these three was a Transcendance Tribulation Stage member of the East Sea Long Clan. If he were to actually strike at the people of the East Sea Long Clan, subduing the East Sea in the future would be fraught with difficulty.
Both parties were caught in a standoff for the time being.
Luckily for Zhu Tian, he had foreseen such a scenario.
"Haha, the Demon Race is founding their nation, and unification is imminent; how could the Heavenly Court Sect not be a part of such a major event?"
Someone laughed heartily below, and those nearby hastened to move aside, revealing an open space.
In the middle of the open space stood Young Sect Master Lu and a man in a black robe.
With a powerful leap, the two flew up to the Heavenly Altar. Just the two of them, yet they seemed to create a situation where three powers were in equilibrium.
"Who are you!"
Zhu Tian frowned, looking at the two men displeasingly.
"It's the Heavenly Court Sect's Young Sect Master Lu!"
"It's him! He actually came!"
"Right, Venerate Zhu Tian is an Ancient Semi-Immortal; it would be strange if people from the Heavenly Court Sect didn't come."
"It is said that the foundation of the Heavenly Court Sect is the Ancient Heavenly Court, with Heavenly Venerate Dou presiding, a true Immortal!"
"Is it the battle of ancient powers?"
"Who is that in the black robe, another Protector Heavenly King perhaps?"
"Possible!"
The crowd below instantly became excited; the appearance of the Heavenly Court Sect made the situation even more chaotic. What now, are they going to fight?
Mu Baiyi and Vice Headmaster Shi, hidden among the crowd, had finally waited for the entrance of the Heavenly Court Sect.
"The Heavenly Court Sect has indeed arrived. When Venerate Zhu Tian sent out invitations to all the major powers, Young Sect Master Lu was already in the Demon Territory. Appearing at such a critical juncture, he must have plans!"
"Yes, it's just not clear who that person in the black robe is. If he's just a Protector Heavenly King, I fear that will not be enough to handle the situation. To stand on equal footing with Zhu Tian, could it be that the Master of the Heavenly Court Sect has come?"
The two whispered among themselves. Although the Di Jiang Clan had not invited them, that didn't stop them from coming to watch the excitement.
Young Sect Master Lu's plan for the Jiuyou Sect included "Ally with Demon Territory." At first, they were puzzled. The Demon Race consisted of numerous tribes; who were they supposed to contact?
Now the answer was revealed; with Zhu Tian unifying the Demon Territory, they needed to establish connections with the Demon Nation!
"Could it be that even this is within Young Sect Master Lu's predictions... or even to say, the establishment of the Demon Nation by Zhu Tian is also the doing of the Heavenly Court Sect?"
The two exchanged a glance and saw the fear in each other's eyes. This was the Young Sect Master, with such a terrifying scheme; what kind of person was the Sect Master then?!
Terrifying.
Zhu Tian hooked the corner of his mouth into a cold smile, "Heavenly Court? A nonsensical invention!"
The Heavenly Court was a fabrication by the Four Ancient Immortals, how could it possibly be real?
Perceptive people noticed the hostility in Zhu Tian's tone. It seemed... he did not acknowledge the Heavenly Court?
Just as Lu Yang was thinking of improvising a few words on the spot, a disdainful voice rang out.
However, this voice came from the main stage of the Di Jiang Clan below.
"How has it come to be that any Tom, Dick, or Harry can enter the Heavenly Altar now?"
The owner of the voice kicked off the ground, soaring up to the Heavenly Altar, chin slightly raised, looking down on Lu Yang as if no one else mattered.
"So you're that so-called Young Sect Master Lu who is said to be able to hold his own against Lu Yang of the Seek Dao Sect, seemingly very formidable. But in my eyes, you're just so-so!"
"In my opinion, you and Lu Yang are both overrated geniuses, merely big fish in a small pond."
"Who are you?"
"Zhu Yunwu!"
The direct disciple of Venerate Zhu Tian, peerless genius of the Di Jiang Clan, Zhu Yunwu!

chapters.title: Chapter 613 - 612 Overwhelming
chapters.content:
Lu Yang didn't care about the nonsense Zhu Yunwu was spouting. He drew his sword and said with a smile, "What an arrogant junior. If you're not convinced, how about we fight a duel to determine the winner?"
"Good!" What was there for Zhu Yunwu to fear?
He didn't care whether this Young Sect Master Lu was an impostor or not. Even if the real Young Sect Master Lu came, he wouldn't be scared in the slightest!
Zhu Yunwu's appearance was impressive and handsome, with his clothes so bright they nearly glowed white. His entire outfit was meticulous, even his fingernails were trimmed neat and tidy.
The young ladies of the Demon Race who admired Zhu Yunwu let out shrill screams upon seeing their heartthrob.
"Big Brother Zhu is here!" The geniuses of the Demon Clan Alliance were thrilled upon seeing Zhu Yunwu's powerful entrance, feeling he could rival the Heavenly Court's Young Sect Master in presence.
"Zhu Yunwu, tsk, why is he here?" Ao Yue clicked his tongue, not too keen on confronting him.
"Is this guy named Zhu Yunwu that amazing?" Meng Jingzhou sent a message to Jiang Shishi.
This was a decisive moment for the fate of the Phoenix Tribe, and Jiang Shishi, feeling nervous as she watched the Heavenly Altar, her palms sweating, momentarily diverted her attention upon hearing Meng Jingzhou's question.
"Very amazing, he's even more powerful than me and Ao Yue!"
"When Zhu Yunwu first came onto the scene, he wasn't particularly outstanding, at best he was of Qin Feng's caliber, unable to compete with me and Ao Yue."
"Half a year ago, Zhu Yunwu emerged and sequentially challenged geniuses from various races. Even Ao Yue and I ended up being defeated by him."
"Did he suddenly become that powerful?"
Jiang Shishi shook her head, "It wasn't sudden. After that, I realized he has been a disciple of Venerate Zhu Tian since he was young. He's always been powerful, previously not beating me and Ao Yue because he was biding his time and hiding his capabilities."
"Half a year ago, Venerate Zhu Tian returned to the world, began to move within the Demon Territory secretly, intending to unify the Demon Race. Only then did Zhu Yunwu reveal his true strength!"
Jiang Shishi sighed, "A disciple personally taught by a Semi-Immortal is indeed terrifying. In terms of foundational talent, Ao Yue and I are not inferior to Zhu Yunwu, but Zhu Yunwu's master is Venerate Zhu Tian. That's the difference; he's from the dazzling geniuses of the Ancient Times and has survived until now, an existence to be feared.
His experience probably surpasses both Ao Yue's and my Masters put together!"
...
Venerate Zhu Tian was happy to let Young Sect Master Lu face his own disciple. Only this way could it demonstrate the high level of his disciple training.
The battle to establish one's might was about to begin at this moment!
Venerate Zhu Tian voluntarily withdrew, leaving the spot on the Heavenly Altar to Lu Yang and Zhu Yunwu.
The Dragon and Phoenix tribes, along with Jiang Lianyi, did the same.
The bustling Heavenly Altar was now left with just two people.
All eyes were on them.
Everyone wanted to know which of these two peerless geniuses was stronger.
Lu Yang unsheathed his sword, one of the Seven-Star Sword set, the Yao Guang Sword. It was three feet and four inches long, shimmering and shining, its own Sword Qi radiating from it.
Zhu Yunwu let out a low shout, transforming into his original form with six feet and four wings, his steps light and body lithe, seemingly dancing with countless afterimages.
"This is the Di Jiang Clan's Astonishing Phoenix Steps, moving as gracefully as a startled swan, as majestic as a dragon ascending the land!"
An old monster of the Demon Race recognized the technique that Zhu Yunwu was using.
It was said that such steps had long been lost, with no one from the Di Jiang Clan capable of performing them. The fact that the young Zhu Yunwu could execute these steps meant they must have been taught by Venerate Zhu Tian himself!
Beside Lu Yang's body surged hundreds, if not thousands, of Sword Qi strands, swirling in five-colored glows, creating an impressive scene that lit up the Heavenly Altar.
"Let me witness for myself just how formidable the so-called most aggressive Sword Cultivator is!" Zhu Yunwu's voice was cold, merciless, with a hint of mockery.
His steps changed again, adding an interplay with the wings to the original agile movements. The four wings became four swords, tearing through the air, sweeping across the ninth layer of the Heavenly Altar as if a myth was reborn!
Lu Yang responded with his sword, turning the hundreds and thousands of Sword Qi streams into roaring waves, clashing in overlapping layers, blossoming into a grand lotus flower!
Boom——
In the clash of powerhouses, Zhu Yunwu was defeated and sent flying back, crashing directly into the sculpted railings of the Heavenly Altar!
"What!"
Everyone was shocked. Lu Yang had defeated Zhu Yunwu in just one encounter?
Meng Jingzhou silently looked at Jiang Shishi, "Is this the very fearsome Zhu Yunwu you spoke of?"
Jiang Shishi was dumbfounded, having not expected Zhu Yunwu to lose so quickly.
Zhu Tian was furious, "What a joke! This wasn't his arrangement at all. With Zhu Yunwu losing face, how can they establish dominance in this battle of power?"
He used the Dao Fruit Outline and tried to forcibly control Lu Yang.
Yet to his astonishment, no matter how he tried to control him, it was as if the other party didn't sense it at all and remained unshaken.
This young man was not under his control at all!
What on earth were his subordinates doing? Using the Di Jiang order to control a Gold Core Period Cultivator and impersonate the Young Sect Master, Lu. Couldn't they even manage something so simple?
The elder of the Di Jiang Clan was sweating profusely as he pushed the Di Jiang order to its limit, which was smoking with effort, yet Lu Yang was not under its control.
Lu Yang pressed on with his victory, performing swordplay. His Seven-star Sword radiated brilliant starlight, turning into a meteor as it thrust towards Zhu Yunwu, who was down at the edge.
Lu Yang showed no mercy, having gone all out from the start!
Zhu Yunwu, still reeling from that previous sword strike and feeling dizzy, sensed danger and rolled over instinctively. The Seven-star Sword narrowly missed, brushing past his shoulder—a close shave!
Zhu Yunwu became alert but still couldn't understand what had happened.
Weren't they just sparring casually? Wasn't the opponent an impostor who surely couldn't best him?
What was with that sword technique just now?
Even if the real Young Sect Master Lu had come, his skill level would be only this much!
Zhu Yunwu was far from just a pretty face; his combat achievements were hard-earned. Despite the battle going off-plan, things had come to a head. He decided it was time for a real, earnest fight!
Zhu Yunwu knew he couldn't hold back any longer and exerted his full strength.
"Heavenly Step!"
Racing on six legs, stepping into the heavens, each step he took was devastatingly heavy, shaking even the space around him. This was his most powerful move, the ultimate skill that had defeated Ao Yue.
Realizing the formidable strength of his opponent, any tentativeness or holding back would be to his disadvantage. Thus, he promptly executed his ultimate move.
Zhu Yunwu took two steps and astonishingly floated in the air, as if there were invisible stairs before him.
This was not due to using a magic skill or wings, but because the two steps he took were so fast and forceful, they temporarily turned the air into a solid!
Lu Yang recalled the Seven-star Sword, its Sword Qi resonated with a metallic ring, and its splendor was dazzling. He effortlessly executed various sword techniques, so masterful that even the great masters of Swordsmanship witnessing this scene would feel ashamed of their own inferiority!
The peerless geniuses of the Human race and Demon race clashed once more, with resounding impacts that shook the heavens, bursting with light so fierce it resembled an exploding sun!
In the blink of an eye, the two had exchanged hundreds of moves, each too swift for the eyes to follow.
Contemporaries marveled at their horrific and terrifying prowess, but only those who fully perceived the course of their battle in the Body Integration Realm felt that though Zhu Yunwu, as a disciple of the Semi-Immortals, was fearsome, the Young Sect Master Lu was even more terrifying.
Their fight was not an equal exchange but a one-sided domination where the Young Sect Master Lu relentlessly overpowered Zhu Yunwu!
How terrifying was this combat strength!
Hundreds, thousands of Sword Qi with peerless might swept through everything. Zhu Yunwu executed several ultimate moves to no avail, unable to block Lu Yang's sword attacks!
Even Jiang Lianyi secretly sighed at the dreadfulness of Lu Yang's Swordsmanship talent.
The Immortal Sister didn't know sword techniques, which meant Lu Yang either taught himself or had guidance from another master.
If it were the latter, it would still be understandable.
If it were the former, then that would be terribly frightening.

chapters.title: Chapter 614 - 613: Invincible at the Golden Core Stage (Extra for Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
```
Whoosh—
With a sweep of the Yang Light Sword, Zhu Yunwu's one wing was severed and fell to the ground as blood gushed out!
"Huh huh huh—" Zhu Yunwu's eyes were bloodshot, and his handsome face was twisted. After hundreds of rounds of combat, he had fully realized that he was no match for his opponent on his own.
Since that was the case, he had no choice but to use the Essence Blood bestowed by his Master.
As Zhu Yunwu wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, he swallowed a drop of Essence Blood.
This was Zhu Tian's Essence Blood, extremely precious, capable of allowing Zhu Yunwu to exhibit the power of the Nascent Soul Stage while in the Golden Core Stage!
An endless stream of power surged from within his body, the wounds eroded by Sword Qi hissed and smoked and healed swiftly, and a new wing grew in place of the lost one.
"Again!"
Zhu Yunwu took the initiative to attack, charging at Lu Yang.
"Stepping Heaven Technique!"
Lu Yang hadn't anticipated that Zhu Yunwu's attack this time would be so swift. He held the Yang Light Sword across his chest to block the hit and took several steps back to dissipate the force.
The two were once more entangled in combat but, unlike before, Lu Yang could clearly feel that Zhu Yunwu was much stronger than earlier.
Lu Yang somewhat missed the finals held in Great Xia; if someone cheated, you could report them to the referee and get them disqualified. But not this time. This time's referee was on their side, and reporting was pointless.
Zhu Yunwu's strikes were forceful and powerful. Lu Yang switched from offense to defense, constantly neutralizing Zhu Yunwu's fierce attacks.
The Defense Technique.
This was a sword technique Lu Yang rarely used. He always believed that the best defense was offense. But this situation was unusual; unless he performed Intercourse Cultivation, going head-to-head with the current Zhu Yunwu was asking for trouble.
Zhu Yunwu strode through the skies, leaping high, his hind hooves gathering strength and his forehooves smashing down fiercely towards Lu Yang.
Lu Yang had anticipated this and dodged in advance, causing Zhu Yunwu to miss his target.
Zhu Yunwu twisted his body mid-air, altering his direction, and once again charged at Lu Yang.
Clang.
The Yang Light Sword was knocked away, landing in the distance.
"Without your sword, let's see how you fight!" Zhu Yunwu sneered confidently.
Zhu Tian also breathed a sigh of relief. Despite some twists and turns, winning was all that mattered.
Qin Feng and the others cheered, seeing the downfall of Young Sect Master Lu.
"I thought this Lu fellow had some real ability, but it seems he's just this much."
"I was worried for Brother Yunwu for a moment there. My concerns were unfounded."
"Exactly, how could Brother Yunwu lose?"
Lu Yang looked at his Yang Light Sword that was knocked away and scratched his head with some difficulty.
Picking it up was out of the question. Zhu Yunwu wouldn't give him that chance.
To select another sword from the remaining six and continue a war of attrition?
Forget it, listen to the Invincible Elixir instead.
Lu Yang sighed, admitting the method of the Invincible Elixir was better.
He took out an Elixir and swallowed it, and a warm current gathered in his Dantian.
...
The Seventh Elder uttered a light "Huh" from below the stage: "This Elixir..."
"Do you recognize it, Elder Seven?" the Fifth Elder communicated telepathically.
"I refined this Revitalizing Pill for Lu Yang."
"It sounds like an Elixir that restores spiritual essence."
"It is an Elixir that restores spiritual essence. This lad has a move that is absolutely invincible among his peers. Even I, reduced to the Golden Core Stage, couldn't bear it—it just consumes too much spiritual essence, so I specially refined this Elixir for him."
"What kind of technique?"
The Seventh Elder chuckled, but did not answer.
...
"Die!" Zhu Yunwu shouted, as his four wings flapped, executing the Stepping Heaven Soul-Severing, blocking off all escape routes.
Lu Yang took two steps back, his right hand flipped, and immediately the weather changed dramatically. Dark clouds tumbled, and the space on the ninth level of the Heavenly Altar seemed to freeze, slowing Zhu Yunwu's speed tremendously.
He felt as though he was no longer surrounded by air but by water, or rather something even more viscous than water, which hindered his movements.
"Look, what's that?"
Qin Feng shouted in astonishment, staring blankly at the sky.
```
A colossal hand pierced through the dark clouds, pressing down in a slow yet inevitable and inescapable descent.
It didn't feel like the hand struck the Heavenly Altar, but rather his very own body, filling him with a sense of powerlessness.
"Universe in Palm!" Zhu Tian recognized the move instantly, his eyes filled with disbelief as he watched the scene unfold, his Lingtai blanking out for a moment.
What sort of joke was this? Even if it was countless times smaller than the true Universe in Palm, it was still a technique that could only be used by those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. How could it be possible for someone at the Golden Core Stage to execute it?!
How terrifying must the opponent's magical talent be?
Yet the reality was right before his eyes, whether he believed it or not.
Executing a move theoretically impossible at the Golden Core Stage meant that no one at that stage could withstand it!
The major powers couldn't stay seated any longer, as this move had overturned their understanding.
They saw it clearly, Young Sect Master Lu had consumed an elixir to restore spiritual essence, not to temporarily boost his combat strength.
In other words, this was his true level of power.
Unbeatable at the Golden Core Stage.
This move was a true space-class Great Divine Skill, capable of sealing the space beneath the palm, which was why Zhu Yunwu couldn't move.
With a thunderous boom—
A lone hand covering the skies, sealing the space, placed itself over the Heavenly Altar.
Gulp.
Upon witnessing this display, Qin Feng and the others struggled to swallow, stunned by the overwhelming power demonstrated by the move. If Zhu Yunwu was the idol chased by the geniuses of the Demon Clan Alliance, this move represented a peak of despair so high that it extinguished even the thought of pursuit in their hearts.
It was just too hopeless.
Kong Hao, who had once faced Young Sect Master Lu in combat and fell into a disadvantageous position, had used Taozhu's power and was penalized by the judge.
"Mr. Ji, can I withstand this move?"
"I advise you to start learning the art of Possess right away to prevent joining me in death."
The five Elders whispered in secret discussion upon seeing this.
"Isn't this almost on par with Martial Nephew Yun's level during his Golden Core Stage?"
"About even."
The giant hand vanished, smoke and dust swirling around, obscuring the situation at the Heavenly Altar, which was protected by an Array Method that prevented the use of Spiritual Sense to peer through.
"Is Zhu Yunwu dead or alive?"
"He's moving, he's still alive!"
At first, everyone wondered who between the two would emerge victorious from the battle.
But after the Universe in Palm was executed, they only wanted to know whether Zhu Yunwu was dead or alive.
Being alive was already more than enough.
"Surprised? I'm still alive."
His wings trembled, dispersing the dust and smoke, and Zhu Yunwu appeared surprisingly vibrant, his injuries lighter than anyone had imagined.
"You've broken through to the Nascent Soul Stage?"
Lu Yang had a strong control over the battlefield. He noticed that after executing Village in the Palm, a distinct force erupted from Zhu Yunwu's location, neutralizing most of the attack.
This was a breakthrough to the Nascent Soul Stage.
"You have some insight."
Zhu Yunwu's words were harsh, but deep down he was frightened beyond belief.
Had it not been for a breakthrough amidst a life-or-death crisis, he might have perished under that palm.
With how cold-blooded his master was, his life or death would hardly be of concern.
"So, what now? Let's see how you plan to fight!"
Zhu Yunwu once again took the initiative, the previous move having drained the opponent of spiritual essence, reducing him to a bow at the end of its strength and no longer a threat. He would certainly not give the opponent a chance to consume an elixir.
In contrast, he himself, having broken through amidst battle, was brimming with spiritual essence.
A reversal of power.
"Heh."
Lu Yang couldn't help but shake his head and chuckle.
"What are you laughing at?" Zhu Yunwu asked, displeased.
Lu Yang slowly raised his head, his gaze piercing as if it could see through the hearts of men, making Zhu Yunwu feel uneasy.
"You don't really think you're the only one who can break through to the Nascent Soul Stage, do you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 615 - 614: Breakthrough to Nascent Soul
chapters.content:
Zhu Yunwu's pupils suddenly shrank, his four wings bristled, and the smile froze on his face.
As Lu Yang's adversary in battle, he was deeply aware of just how formidable an existence Lu Yang was.
If Lu Yang were to break through to the Nascent Soul Stage, Zhu Yunwu feared even burning his Essence Blood wouldn't be enough to defeat his opponent!
Lu Yang took measured steps towards Zhu Yunwu, the sound of his footfalls echoing dah-dah-dah, each step marked by a slight pause. It was as though his footsteps were not just landing on the Heavenly Altar but also stamping on Zhu Yunwu's spiritual essence.
He was at ease, strolling leisurely as if he were in his own backyard, not taking Zhu Yunwu seriously at all.
Already at the cusp of the Golden Core Stage Nine Heavens realm, Lu Yang could break through at any moment, but his plan had been to visit the Demon Nation and then return to the Seek Dao Sect to ascend slowly—after all, it was a major realm breakthrough, and it warranted a sense of ceremony.
Unfortunately, plans had changed.
Seeing the dire situation, Zhu Yunwu let out a low shout and launched the first strike to seize the initiative!
He absolutely couldn't let him succeed in ascending!
With his wings vibrating and hooves treading the sky, the space around them shook as Zhu Yunwu fought desperately, like a tsunami of mud and rocks pouring down!
Boom—
Caught off guard, Lu Yang was rammed by Zhu Yunwu, crashing against the railing of the Heavenly Altar.
"Huff huff, so he's at the end of his tether."
Zhu Yunwu burst into wild laughter, suddenly relaxed.
That's right, the previous Overarching Heaven Hand Imprint had already drained all of his spiritual essence. Where would his opponent get the strength to break through the realm? He realized he had been too anxious.
Ptooey.
Lu Yang spit out a smear of blood, which starkly contrasted against the immaculate lustrous jade of the altar, attractively visible.
Wiping the blood from the corner of his mouth, he stood up and walked toward Zhu Yunwu, still with that confident smile on his face.
"Come at me again."
Zhu Yunwu's eyes turned bloodshot in an instant, fear spreading through his heart. He attacked Lu Yang with the frenzy of a crazed bull.
With every attack, Lu Yang didn't dodge or avoid, facing Zhu Yunwu's impacts head-on. However, with each of Zhu Yunwu's strikes, the distance Lu Yang was forced back shortened.
This last time, Lu Yang had only retreated a half step.
Amid the repeated collisions, cracks appeared on the surface of the Golden Core. A milky glow began to escape through these fissures, quickly healing Lu Yang's injuries.
Boom—
Zhu Yunwu once again charged up for an attack, but this time Lu Yang finally moved; he thrust out his right palm, forcefully pushing out, and pinned down Zhu Yunwu's head, stopping the blow dead in its tracks!
Zhu Yunwu's face was filled with disbelief, looking up at Lu Yang, only to be met with an overflowing smile... and Lu Yang of the Nascent Soul Stage.
Bones crackling, he underwent a swift bone refinement process, his physical condition now starkly different from before.
Spirit, energy, and soul fused into one, drawing upon the momentum of the Invincible Elixir as a catalyst, interweaving within his Dantian, giving birth to a mysterious power.
The Invincible Elixir shattered completely, the surging spiritual essence bursting forth, coursing through all the meridians in his body. A formidable vortex of spiritual essence formed above the Heavenly Altar, madly rushing into Lu Yang's body, reinvigorating his withered meridians and filling the nascent child being born.
In his Dantian, a Nascent Soul the size of a fingertip curled up, radiating a tranquil milky light. It absorbed the surrounding spiritual essence, growing in size until it was three inches tall and freely moving, ceasing to assimilate the energy.
Unlike a real newborn child, the Nascent Soul was pale and tender, its face brimming with excitement and joy.
"Is that all?"
Lu Yang tensed his muscles, his body like a great dragon, pulsing with strength as he threw a punch right in Zhu Yunwu's face!
"How is this possible?"
Zhu Yunwu couldn't believe it, not only was his opponent able to break through to the Nascent Soul Stage at any time, but where did he get such strength right after the breakthrough? Didn't he need to solidify his foundation and refine his Nascent Soul?
Typically, cultivators spend time consolidating their cultivation after entering the Nascent Soul Stage.
But Lu Yang, as the strongest Golden Core holder, remained undefeated throughout hundreds of battles in the Golden Core Stage, achieving a streak of victories that solidified his foundation without any need for seclusion to consolidate his cultivation level!
Zhu Yunwu had never encountered such a situation before. Lu Yang's series of unexpected moves caught him off guard and made him lose his advantage. Lu Yang didn't even have to use his swordsmanship; he could suppress Zhu Yunwu just with his bare hands and feet.
"I must win!"
Driven mad, Zhu Yunwu burned his Essence Blood without regard to the consequences, temporarily boosting his combat power.
The onlookers gasped in astonishment. Zhu Yunwu's foundation was unstable, and burning Essence Blood at this moment for a breakthrough—even if he won this round—would likely complicate future advancements!
The Illusory Shadow of Zhu Tian loomed behind Zhu Yunwu, barely visible. As the Di Jiang Clan's ancient ancestor and most powerful being, Zhu Tian was the source of their bloodline, and the appearance of his Illusory Shadow was one of the signs of burning Essence Blood.
To borrow strength from an ancestor in order to defeat a powerful enemy!
Roar—
Zhu Yunwu let out a beastly roar, completely losing his sanity. Lu Yang produced an elixir, and while Zhu Yunwu roared, flicked it into Zhu Yunwu's mouth with his fingertip.
Zhu Yunwu wanted to spit it out, but Lu Yang stepped forward, lifted his chin upwards, and Zhu Yunwu swallowed the elixir instinctively.
"What did you give me to eat!" Zhu Yunwu exclaimed in shock.
He felt the power he gained from burning his Essence Blood rapidly disappearing; this elixir had forcefully interrupted the process.
Lu Yang explained with a smile, "A Breakthrough Pill, which can help someone break through from the Foundation Establishment Stage to the Golden Core Stage, or from the Nascent Soul Stage to the Golden Core Stage."
This was a gift from the Seventh Elder, who had just successfully made a Breakthrough Pill and gave one to Lu Yang as a celebration while concocting the Revitalizing Pill for him.
Zhu Yunwu felt a lump in his throat. Indeed, not only was the power from burning Essence Blood fading, but his realm was also falling!
He completely lost his composure. How could he continue to fight like this?
"Worthless!"
Venerate Zhu Tian was furious. He was now sure that the one on the Heavenly Altar was the real Young Sect Master Lu. Otherwise, where could such a peerless genius come from?
No matter what, Zhu Yunwu must not lose here.
This was a matter of face!
The first battle in the foundation of the Demon Nation; should he be defeated by the Heavenly Court Sect, it would become a lifelong laughingstock!
He sent a strand of his spiritual essence to possess Zhu Yunwu.
"Master..."
"Waste, let me do it!"
Venerate Zhu Tian temporarily took control of Zhu Yunwu's body, halting the fall of his realm.
"Rise!"
With a light command, Zhu Yunwu's realm miraculously returned to the Nascent Soul Stage!
Lu Yang had just learned from Fairy Eternity that his opponent had changed from Zhu Yunwu to Venerate Zhu Tian.
He was quite helpless. It was bad enough that the Demon Nation officials were biased, but to have an official enter the fight?
Fairy Eternity couldn't stand it and rolled up her sleeves, ready to charge, "Zhu Tian, this rascal, has always been sneaky ever since I've known him. He dares to go this far, step aside, I'll take over!"
Lu Yang invited the divine presence, allowing Fairy Eternity to strike at will.
Meanwhile, Venerate Zhu Tian was scolding Zhu Yunwu within the Spiritual Space.
"You useless thing, unable to defeat such an opponent, forcing your master to intervene. Watch how I fight!"
Venerate Zhu Tian, controlling Zhu Yunwu's body, geared up to fight back when suddenly Lu Yang's fist landed heavily on his face, leaving him dazed and confused.
In a daze, he also heard something about the "Immortal Fist Technique."
Zhu Yunwu, witnessing this scene, kept silent and humbly absorbed the lesson.

chapters.title: Chapter 616 - 615: Just because you haven't heard of it, does that mean the Heavenly Court doesn't exist?
chapters.content:
```
The Immortal Fist Technique rained down relentlessly, rendering every defensive move ineffective; it was as if the opponent could see through his weaknesses, with each punch landing exactly where he was most vulnerable, causing unbearable pain.
The onlookers didn't realize the identities of the two fighters on the Heavenly Altar had subtly elevated, but they could all see that Zhu Yunwu was being beaten even more miserably now than before.
Zhu Yunwu diligently learned his master's moves, feeling he had gained a lot; perhaps this was his master's intention all along.
Seeing that his defenses were useless, Zhu Tian changed his tactic, adjusting his stance so that the blows would hurt him less.
What puzzled Zhu Tian the most was a feeling of familiarity with his opponent's techniques, as if he had been beaten like this in the Ancient Times.
But upon careful recollection, he couldn't match the feeling with any memory of an adversary.
Strange indeed.
The pain yanked him back from his reverie to face reality.
```
