Continuing like this wouldn't work; he had to put some distance between them and regroup.
He intentionally revealed a flaw, tempting Fairy Eternity to attack his weak point, and she took the bait. Zhu Tian seized the moment to leap to the right.
Fairy Eternity had anticipated this and leapt to the right as well, continuing her assault on Zhu Tian.
She had already figured out every move in Zhu Tian's arsenal.
After trying eight or nine times, Zhu Tian finally flew up into the sky, gasping for air, distancing himself from Fairy Eternity and looking at her with an unexplainable fear.
This wasn't the fear that had surfaced while being beaten; it was a terror from the Ancient Times, lingering deep within his heart.
Zhu Tian's eyes were cold as he twisted his plump body, altering his footsteps as his four wings fluttered, resonating like musical instruments, creating an indescribable harmony. It was akin to hundreds of people playing different instruments, with different roles and rhythms, yet when played together, they were in perfect sync, as if that was how things were always meant to be…
This was his signature skill, of astonishing power, only barely within the reach of those at the Nascent Soul Stage.
A massive tidal wave rose above the Heavenly Altar, reminiscent of the world-ending flood from the Ancient Times, the waters imbued with a corrosive, destructive force. Even a single droplet would make skin sizzle and smoke, and being submerged by the floodwaters would certainly leave no remains.
"He summons a flood, what dance is Zhu Yunwu performing, does anyone know?"
"It seems to be the legendary Dance of the Immortal's Demise, a unique dance of Venerate Zhu Tian, known only to him. That's no ordinary flood—it's an ancient deluge that once destroyed several stars!"
"It seems Venerate Zhu Tian holds this disciple in high regard."
"Young Sect Master Lu is no ordinary figure either, he has suppressed Zhu Yunwu from the beginning to the end, a rare talent of the Ancient Times indeed."
Hearing the discussions below, Lu Yang felt a bit nervous.
"This dance is called the Dance of the Immortal's Demise, does it mean that a semi-immortal once died under this move?"
Fairy Eternity waved her hand dismissively, "It's just the name that sounds intimidating; in reality, it's not that impressive."
"The Yingtian Immortal once said during a lesson that, as a Transcendance Tribulation Stage or semi-immortal, regardless of the actual power of the move, the name must sound impressive to achieve a psychological advantage over the opponent."
"I don't believe in that philosophy; a useful technique trumps everything else, as for the name, anything casual will do."
Lu Yang: "..."
The apocalyptic flood gathered and swirled in the air; the faster the flutter of the four wings, the greater the volume of the floodwaters produced.
In the end, the water amassed to such an extent that it blotted out the sky, thicker even than dark clouds.
If it were to pour down, it would surely submerge the entire Heavenly Altar. The flood covered such a vast area that not even those attempting to fly away could escape!
"Go!"
With a beat of his four wings, Zhu Tian let the apocalyptic floodwater fall, having lost its supporting force, crashing down onto the Heavenly Altar with a tremendous roar.
Fairy Eternity remained unfazed, pointing her index finger into the air, releasing a "pop" sound; instantly, all the moisture in the air disappeared as if an invisible hand rewound the flow upwards, erasing any trace of water above her head, including the apocalyptic flood.
"The Diving Spell."
"How is that possible!"
Zhu Tian's eyes rounded in shock. Had his prized technique been countered just like that?
The Diving Spell?
This magic skill had long been lost to history, known only by Ancient Cultivators. Could his opponent truly hail from the Ancient Times?
"Not good!"
```
Above the head of Fairy Eternity, there wasn't just the world-ending great flood, but also Zhu Tian himself!
Zhu Tian felt the water in his body rapidly disappearing, shriveling up as if he were a corpse that had been dead for a year.
If he tried to force a move, his body would fall apart.
"La——When spring warms, awakening all beings——"
Zhu Tian sang aloud, the Song of Spring from the Four Seasons Ballad, where spring symbolizes revival, restoring vitality.
After his revival, it took only two hundred years to return to his peak condition, and the Song of Spring was credited for this feat.
"You do have a knack for singing," Fairy Eternity murmured. Zhu Tian often sang to liven up the atmosphere before commencing his sermons.
She rose in the air, riding the clouds and the mist, continuing to duel with Zhu Tian above the ground.
The Immortal Fist Technique was unpredictable and encompassed all things; Zhu Tian's various attacks could be cleverly countered by Fairy Eternity.
The Immortal Fist Technique was derived from various herbal punches; herbs can be medicine or poison, and in Fairy Eternity's hands, they could switch at will.
Not to mention that Zhu Tian had forgotten Fairy Eternity's combat style, which wasn't typical for her, even if he had not forgotten, he would still have been miserably defeated by Fairy Eternity in combat of equal rank during the Ancient Times.
"Enough!"
Zhu Tian could no longer control himself, a strand of Spiritual Sense returned to his body, and he bellowed, abruptly interrupting the fight.
The Nascent Soul Stage was too distant for him; he had long forgotten the abilities one could use at that stage and was unable to defeat Young Sect Master Lu.
Zhu Tian, colossal like a mountain, flapped his four wings, stirred up a hurricane, and flew to the Heavenly Altar; the hurricane blew people all around, with quite a few being swept away.
Ten Transcendance Tribulation Stage Demon Emperors followed closely behind, surrounding Lu Yang.
Zhu Tian revealed a cruel smile as he looked at Lu Yang as if he were a dead man:
"I, who reigned supreme in the Ancient Times, have never heard of any Heavenly Court. Youngster, you fabricate this nonexistent Heavenly Court, claiming to be Young Sect Master Lu and tarnishing the reputation of the Ancient Times, do you not see me, a Great Yu Cultivator, in your eyes?"
"I, considering the difficulty of your cultivation journey, did not wish to expose your identity, but you have repeatedly caused disturbances at the Demon Nation's founding ceremonies, where exactly do you place the face of the Demon Race, the face of the Demon Territory!"
When Zhu Tian spoke these words, the crowd below exploded in uproar; no one expected Venerate Zhu Tian to reveal such a secret.
"There was no Heavenly Court in Ancient Times? So, the Heavenly Court Sect is fake?"
"Then exactly who is this Young Sect Master Lu..."
"How could it be possible, if the Heavenly Court Sect is fake, does that mean Heavenly Venerate Dou defeating the Great Yu Cultivator is also fake?"
"Why couldn't it be possible, perhaps it was just a play staged by the Great Yu Cultivator themselves, to divert the attention of the masses!"
"What kind of person is Venerate Zhu Tian, he surely wouldn't deceive people on this matter!"
Mu Baiyi and Shi Huagu exchanged glances, doubts rising in their hearts.
The Heavenly Court Sect is fake? How could that be? Then who was the person they had cooperated with, and what was their background?
But Venerate Zhu Tian's words were there, and they couldn't help but believe them.
"Could it be that we've been deceived?"
While everyone was discussing, a cold voice echoed throughout the Demon City.
The cold voice seemed to laugh, laughing at the ignorance of the world, laughing at Zhu Tian's unawareness.
"Zhu Tian, just because you haven't heard of it, does that mean the Heavenly Court doesn't exist?"
"Who is speaking!"
Zhu Tian anxiously scanned the surroundings, releasing his Spiritual Sense to sweep the vicinity, that voice eerily familiar to him.
A figure in a black robe flew out, lightly landing on the Heavenly Altar, shielding Lu Yang behind them.
"Who are you!" Zhu Tian was on high alert, a bad premonition taking hold of him as he stared at the robed figure.
The person in the black robe lifted their hood to reveal a face of unparalleled beauty.
The person looked at Zhu Tian with a smile that wasn't quite a smile, their gaze filled with disdain and scorn.
"One of the Four Imperial Protectors of the Heavenly Court Sect, the Emperor of Nirvana from the South Pole, Jiang Lianyi."

chapters.title: Chapter 617 - 616 Shocking the World (3rd Release, Monthly Ticket Request)
chapters.content:
"One of the Four Imperial Protectors of the Heavenly Court Sect, the South Pole Nirvana Great Emperor, Jiang Lianyi."
When Jiang Lianyi introduced herself, her voice was very soft, but the moment she lifted her hood, the whole room fell into silence, and her self-introduction could be clearly heard by everyone.
"Phoenix Ancestor of the Phoenix Tribe?!"
"Am I seeing things, or is that really the Phoenix Ancestor of the Phoenix Tribe, one of the two great ancestors of the Demon Race, Lord Jiang Lianyi!"
"Wasn't she said to have fallen? How is she still alive?"
Two high-ranking members of the Eternity Sect breathed a sigh of relief, and Shi Huagu, with a confident wave of his hand, said, "I've said before that I've met Young Sect Master Lu. I've tested him with ancient secrets, and I've verified his identity with lie-detecting magic skills. His identity is genuine!"
"I think Venerate Zhu Tian is just a sore loser and blurted that out in desperation!"
The audience was astounded, not just the minor cultivators, but even well-known great powers of cultivation stood up from their seats, their eyes fixed on Jiang Lianyi, imprinting this scene on their minds.
Cultivators from Buddha Country and Great Xia, even if they had never seen Jiang Lianyi's face, had heard of her great name.
This was a person of remarkable reputation since Ancient Times, far more famous than Zhu Tian. After three hundred thousand years of historical accumulation, she had become almost a divine belief for the Demon Race.
The faith of the Demon Race is in the Demon Immortal, whose appearance is unknown, making Jiang Lianyi an existence that could summon the response of the entire Demon Race with a single call.
The Demon Race reacted even more intensely, their brains boiling with excitement, at a loss for words, speaking incoherently.
Many members of the Demon Race were moved to tears, excitedly kneeling on the ground, crying out for the revelation of the Immortal, and paying their respects to Jiang Lianyi.
Even the great demon kings showed heartfelt respect, kneeling before Jiang Lianyi and praying for her blessing.
It was as if the myths of ancient times had come back to life.
Zhu Tian relied on the power of the Dao Fruit Outline to make the Demon Race submit, whereas Jiang Lianyi, with her mere presence, caused the Demon Race to turn their backs on him.
Members of the Demon Clan Alliance were wavering, unsure of which side to lean towards.
The Transcendence Tribulation cultivators from the Long Clan of the East Sea rubbed their eyes vigorously, thinking that they were seeing hallucinations from their failing vision, unable to believe the scene before them.
The Old Dragon Emperor, sensing danger to the Phoenix Tribe, had sent him expressly to help them.
Now it seemed, help what? With the Phoenix Ancestor still around, how could the Phoenix Tribe be in trouble? This was an existence on par with their own ancient ancestor. With no Immortal appearing, who could be an opponent?
The Transcendence Tribulation cultivators from both the Long Clan of the East Sea and the Long Clan of the Demon Territory all looked towards Jiang Mingzi and the Phoenix Tribe, wanting to know if they were aware of Jiang Lianyi's existence and if this was indeed the Phoenix Tribe's trump card.
Glancing over, they saw Jiang Mingzi crying like a child, wiping away tears and snot with his hand.
As the highest in cultivation level in the Phoenix Tribe, he was the pillar and the backbone, the one who had to make decisions on all major matters. Many members of the Demon Race coveted the Phoenix Tribe's treasure, and one misstep by him could lead the tribe into unrecoverable doom, a heavy burden indeed.
Zhu Tian's pressure for the Phoenix Tribe to choose sides had been almost unbearable for him.
With the return of the Ancestor, someone was finally above him, and he could at last lay down his burden.
The Phoenix Tribe members were even more inconsolable than Jiang Mingzi, crying noisily, some unable to maintain their human form, transforming into Phoenixes representing the Five Virtues, their cries reverberating throughout Demon City.
As for the younger geniuses, upon seeing Jiang Lianyi, their minds went blank, losing the ability to perceive the outside world.
Only Meng Jingzhou, who had seen Jiang Lianyi before, remained coherent.
"Damn it, why am I not the one standing on the Heavenly Altar? I could beat someone like Zhu Yunwu too."
The two had agreed to return to their Sect together to break through to the Nascent Soul Stage, but Lu Yang, that bastard, couldn't be trusted, staging a breakthrough at the last moment and stealing the spotlight.
Taozhu, sealed within Kong Hao, was also stunned. The transformation of Demon City was completely beyond his expectations.
He had merely wanted to witness the establishment process of the Demon Nation, and incidentally to see how his enemies were faring. How had it turned into this situation?
Moreover, a figure like the Phoenix Ancestor was one of the "Four Imperial Protectors" in the Heavenly Court—just how terrifying was the power of the Ancient Heavenly Court?
The five Elders, upon seeing everyone's reaction, felt slightly reassured. See, they didn't know what our reaction to meeting the Phoenix Ancestor was like, everyone felt the same.
Atop the Heavenly Altar, there was dead silence.
Some of the ten Demon Emperors genuinely submitted to Zhu Tian, while others were controlled by the Dao Fruit Outline. Regardless of their situation, at the sight of Jiang Lianyi, they all felt the intimidation that juniors feel in the presence of their elders.
Zhu Tian was breaking out in a cold sweat.
The Demon Race of today was unaware of Jiang Lianyi's identity, but as an ancient great demon, how could he be ignorant of who Jiang Lianyi was?
The wife of the Qilin Immortal.
Just those five words were enough to elevate Jiang Lianyi's status to another level, completely overshadowing him.
Damn it, why did Jiang Lianyi have to appear at such a critical moment?
If it came to a one-on-one fight, Zhu Tian was not afraid.
He admitted that Jiang Lianyi was very strong, at the top of the first tier of semi-immortals, but he controlled so many of the Demon Race, and his Dao Fruit was nearly complete, making their power comparable.
Stay calm, stay calm, Zhu Tian took deep breaths to steady his emotions and think clearly about the situation, organizing his thoughts.
Hadn't it been confirmed? He hadn't felt the suppression of the Qilin Immortal's Dao Fruit, which indicated that the Qilin Immortal had already perished. With the Demon Nation established and his military might, he didn't need to worry about someone like Jiang Lianyi making waves.
If this were not the case, he wouldn't have dared to use the Qilin Immortal's name to legitimize his position during the founding ceremony.
"What, don't recognize me anymore?"
Jiang Lianyi saw Zhu Tian lost in thought and spoke with a cold sneer, showing no mercy.
Zhu Tian was unwilling to clash with Jiang Lianyi at this point. He transformed into human form and, with hands clasped, smiled and said, "I've seen Cultivator Jiang. It has been three hundred thousand years since we last met, and you are as graceful as ever."
"Only, when did I ever hear that you joined the Heavenly Court?"
Zhu Tian wanted to control the Phoenix Tribe and intended to use them as pawns. He surely coveted the treasures he had left them.
Under these circumstances, how could Jiang Lianyi possibly give Zhu Tian face.
"Must I report my affairs with the Heavenly Court to you?"
"Not to mention someone like you, not even the Qilin Immortal would dare to meddle so much in my business!"
Hearing the exchange between the two, the crowd stirred into fervent discussion once again, their expressions excited, as if an ancient veil of secrets was being lifted before them!
"The Ancient Heavenly Court really exists!"
"How come I've never heard of it before? I thought the Heavenly Court described in the books was just made up by Ancient Immortals for fun."
"You know nothing, fool. Immortals have profound schemes and considerations; it's not for fun. How ignorant!"
"This Young Sect Master Lu is truly the number one genius of ancient times, no wonder he was able to defeat Zhu Yunwu."
"Did you listen to what Lord Jiang said? She is one of the Four Imperial Protectors of the Heavenly Court; there must be people above her, like the Heavenly Court Master, Heavenly Venerate Dou."
"Young Sect Master Lu is a disciple of Heavenly Venerate Dou, a pupil of an Immortal!"
The crowd marveled at Young Sect Master Lu's talents and fortune.
It's all about having a good teacher, after all.
Zhu Tian frowned: "What exactly is this Heavenly Court ..."
Jiang Lianyi's lips curved into a mocking smile, looking down on Zhu Tian: "The Heavenly Court is an existence known only among Immortals, related to the secrets of Immortals. If I weren't the wife of the Qilin Immortal, I wouldn't be entitled to know, either."
"As for you, do you think you're worthy?"

chapters.title: Chapter 618 - 617: Senior Brother Lu and I Both Worship Under Heavenly Venerate Dou
chapters.content:
Zhu Tian's moods were turbulent and he found himself speechless.
Although he now preens in his glory, unifying the Demon Territory and establishing the Demon Nation.
In Ancient Times, he wasn't like this. There were many stronger than him back then. Not to mention the Human race, even within the Demon Race there were Dragons, Phoenixes, Qiongqis, and others more powerful than him.
When it comes to the hidden secrets of Ancient Times, Jiang Lianyi knew far more than he did.
What Zhu Tian paid attention to was the Heavenly Court, while the audience noted the phrase "if not for my being the wife of the Qilin Immortal".
Two from the Di Jiang Clan whispered among themselves, "Who is the Qilin Immortal?"
"Are you stupid? It's obviously a Demon Immortal!"
The academic circles had long conjectured that the Demon Immortal was the Qilin Immortal but never found concrete evidence. Today, through a conversation between two great demons, the true identity of the Demon Immortal was solidified.
The two from the Di Jiang Clan were shocked, they exchanged looks, held their breaths, and realized the gravity of the issue as their voices went out of control.
"Elder Jiang Lianyi is the wife of the Qilin Immortal?!"
This was earth-shattering news!
That the Qilin Immortal was married was one thing, but his wife was none other than his rival Jiang Lianyi?
It was known to all that Jiang Lianyi lost to the Qilin Immortal and was deprived of her chance to become an Immortal. Hence, everyone thought they were rivals, but once the Qilin Immortal ascended, past rivals were no longer a threat and old grudges were dropped.
But no one expected the Qilin Immortal to let go of grudges so thoroughly that they ended up as husband and wife!
Those who had secretly plotted against the Phoenix Tribe paled in an instant. If Jiang Lianyi's return made them abandon their covetous plans for the Phoenix Tribe's treasures, then knowing Jiang Lianyi's ties with the Qilin Immortal made them worry about being held accountable.
It used to be said that Jiang Lianyi was not invincible and that the Qilin Immortal was above her.
Now who would dare to say that?
The Jiang Lianyi of today represents the will of the Qilin Immortal, which is the sky for the Demon Race!
"Then, about the legitimacy of the Demon Nation..."
If Jiang Lianyi does not acknowledge the Demon Nation, even if it successfully establishes itself, its reputation would be tarnished.
Perhaps many within the Demon Race would curse the Ancient Ancestor in secret, something the Ancient Ancestor could not tolerate.
They say that Great Powers of Cultivation view mortals as ants—yet that's merely a metaphor. If they truly regarded mortals as ants, would they care what mortals think?
All beings with sentient intelligence, no matter the differences in strength or status, cannot be so disconnected as to be indifferent to insults from those of lower status.
"Jiang Lianyi and the Qilin Immortal are husband and wife?" Shi Huagu couldn't understand. He remembered that in Ancient Times, the Heavenly Venerate Dou was the master of the Ancient Heavenly Court and was opposed to the Four Ancient Immortals. So how did the Qilin Immortal's wife end up working for the Heavenly Court?
Mu Baiyi, on the other hand, had deeper considerations. He gently shook his head, signaling Shi Huagu not to think too simplistically.
"The affairs of Ancient Times are intricate and complex, filled with too many unknowns. Take the current situation, who says a marriage signifies closeness?"
"They could have had a conflict, differing ideologies, and Jiang Lianyi defected to the Heavenly Court. Why couldn't that be possible?"
"Or maybe Jiang Lianyi was originally from the Heavenly Court, and only later married the Qilin Immortal."
"There's another possibility." Mu Baiyi paused before the third possibility, fear creeping into his voice.
Fear for the terrifying might of an Immortal as suggested by his third guess.
Shi Huagu pressed, "Master?"
Mu Baiyi shook his head, forcing himself to not dwell on it too much, and continued, "There's a chance, that to an Immortal, only another Immortal is considered a rival. Whether in the Qi Cultivation Stage or a Semi-Immortal, in the eyes of an Immortal, there's no difference. To the Four Ancient Immortals, where Jiang Lianyi is or which faction she joins is insignificant!"
Arrogance!
That was the impression of the Four Ancient Immortals that Shi Huagu formed after hearing the Master's speculations.
But considering the enigmatic power of Immortals, he felt that the Master's speculations were not without reason.
"Do you still remember Young Sect Master Lu saying that only because he might become an Immortal did the Four Ancient Immortals suppress him?"
"Right, he did say something like that."
"Can we then infer that because Jiang Lianyi couldn't become an Immortal, the Four Ancient Immortals didn't care about her whereabouts?"
They exchanged glances, feeling they were gradually touching upon the truth.
"I neglected the affairs of the Heavenly Court. Would you mind resting at the Imperial Palace for a moment? After I preside over the ceremony, we can catch up," Zhu Tian suggested casually.
Jiang Lianyi chuckled lightly, and her expression suddenly turned cold, "Zhu Tian, you think to use the power of the Dao Fruit Outline to control the members of my tribe, as if I'm unaware of it?"
"And the matter of the Heavenly Court, you think a light and careless oversight can just be glossed over?"
Jiang Lianyi pointed at Lu Yang, her voice cold, "He is my Senior Brother, and when a Senior Brother is insulted, how can I, as his Junior Sister, sit idly by!"
...
"Pfft—cough cough..."
The Grand Elder sprayed out a mouthful of tea, nearly choking himself to death.
He was leisurely sipping tea, taking pleasure in watching these inexperienced fools reveal their shocked expressions. He felt incredibly satisfied.
Until he heard Jiang Lianyi call Lu Yang her Senior Brother.
His face filled with shock as he looked up at the Heavenly Altar, what kind of backstory are you all setting up for the Heavenly Court?
"Senior Brother?!"
Everyone's pupils shook, and each sentence from Jiang Lianyi revealed an ancient secret, each more shocking than the last.
Jiang Lianyi and Young Master Lu were actually in a Senior Brother-Junior Sister relationship?
"He is your Senior Brother?!"
Zhu Tian was completely befuddled, How have I never seen this person in the Ancient Times?
Jiang Lianyi's lips curved into a cold smile, "Just because you haven't seen him doesn't mean anything. The Four Ancient Immortals have all met him!"
True, the Four Ancient Immortals had all encountered Lu Yang through the time channel, though they only saw a silhouette and couldn't make out his face.
"Lu Yang and I both have sworn allegiance under Heavenly Venerate Dou, so naturally, we are in a Senior Brother-Junior Sister relationship!"
Lu Yang: "..."
Elder Lianyi, I know you can't stand seeing Elder Zhu Tian bully the Phoenix Tribe, and you want to fight him, but can you not drag me into this?
"So we can't settle this peacefully?" Zhu Tian's face also darkened. As a Semi-Immortal, to not be given face by Jiang Lianyi, what, did she think he was afraid of her?
He was just unwilling to stir up trouble, but that did not mean he was afraid of her!
Thirty thousand years had passed, and he was no longer the same person he had been!
"Where are my Ten Generals!"
Zhu Tian bellowed fiercely.
"Here!"
Ten Transcendance Tribulation Stage great demons stepped forward in unison, releasing their oppressive aura freely. The sky and earth changed color, and their momentum was terrifying.
As the foremost individual beneath the Semi-Immortals and with the addition of ten Transcendance Tribulation Stage great demons, his lineup was practically invincible under the Semi-Immortals. He refused to believe that he couldn't take down Jiang Lianyi!
If he could defeat Jiang Lianyi, he could naturally control her with perfect justification.
Then, the issue of legitimacy, combat power, establishing authority—all his problems would be resolved at once.
Jiang Lianyi, you brought this upon yourself!
Faced with such a terrifying array, Jiang Lianyi gently laughed, unfazed.
"Indeed, ten at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage plus you attacking together, even Ao Ling would not be your match."
"It's just a pity that your opponent is me."
Although Jiang Lianyi was smiling, there wasn't a hint of mirth in her eyes, "Zhu Tian, have you forgotten something?"
"Both of us possess the outline of the Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit, and our battle isn't about who has more people or who holds the advantage."
Zhu Tian's pupils contracted sharply, a foreboding feeling enveloping his heart.
All they saw was Jiang Lianyi raising her hand and snapping her fingers lightly.
Click.
The imprints controlling the ten Transcendance Tribulation Stage great demons disappeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 619 - 618: This trip to Demon City was worth it; I will come again during the next founding of a nation.
chapters.content:
The Transcendance Tribulation Stage great demon noticed the master-servant imprint had vanished and hurriedly retreated far from the battlefield.
Joining a battle between Semi-Immortals, you wouldn't even know how you died.
Moreover, even if they defeated Jiang Lianyi, what would they do if the Qilin Immortal appeared to settle the score?
No matter how strong Venerate Zhu Tian was, he couldn't overpower an Immortal.
There were those truly loyal to Zhu Tian; if they won, they would be acknowledged as having made a dragon's achievement, with boundless prospects.
The elders of the Di Jiang Clan naturally pledged loyalty to Zhu Tian. Since Zhu Tian was the Ancient Ancestor, it was only reasonable for them to lend a hand, both emotionally and rationally.
Moreover, he had led the wolf into the house, the real Heavenly Court Sect, and he would not be able to escape the reckoning afterward.
Now there was still time to atone for his merits.
The ancient ancestor of the Jiuying Clan and the Clan Leader of the Taozhu Clan saw this as an opportunity, being the first and second to pledge allegiance to the Di Jiang Clan—they were grasshoppers on the same string.
The three great demons exchanged thoughts briefly through Spiritual Sense, confirming each other's intentions, and turned to go support Zhu Tian.
Suddenly, a darkness appeared overhead, and three enormous shadows enveloped them.
"Gentlemen, where are you off to?"
The elder of the Di Jiang Clan looked up, staring intently at the three massive figures, and spat out words through clenched teeth.
"Jiang Mingzi!"
Elders of the East Sea Dragon Clan, the Demon Territory Dragon Clan, and the Phoenix Tribe moved to intercept.
The Di Jiang Clan elder turned his head and sought help from seven other Transcendance Tribulation Stage great demons, but they turned a deaf ear, clearly maintaining neutrality.
After all, no matter which side lost, the law did not punish the masses; they would not be held accountable and had no need to muddy the waters.
Besides, they were forcefully controlled by Zhu Tian and harbored no small amount of resentment in their hearts; they hoped Jiang Lianyi would win.
"Bastards!"
The elder of the Di Jiang Clan could see their intentions and cursed inwardly.
"Roar—"
The elder of the Demon Territory Dragon Clan made the first move, transforming into an enormous Azure Dragon, turning clouds into rain, turning rain into water, and attacking the Di Jiang Clan elder.
The East Sea Dragon Clan elder aimed at the Jiuying Clan elder, releasing a never-ending stream of seawater from his Storage Ring. Merging with the seawater, he became a Dragon God of the sea, terrifying to the extreme, able to tear mountains apart with a single claw.
The Jiuying Clan was the ultimate evolution of the serpent clan, and since ancient times, dragons and serpents had been in conflict when coming ashore.
Jiang Mingzi pulled out a great flag, unfurling it to reveal an image of phoenixes singing over Mount Qi. This was one of the treasures left by the Ancient Ancestor, the Five Virtues Great Flag.
In the past, he was worried about others coveting the treasure and dared not use it. But now that the Ancient Ancestor had returned, if not now, when?
"Damn it!"
The Clan Leader of the Taozhu Clan went numb at the sight of Jiang Mingzi taking serious action.
He was a newly advanced Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator, while Jiang Mingzi was an established late-stage one. Not to mention, Jiang Mingzi possessed a treasure, the gap between them was ridiculously large.
At this point, he had no choice but to fight, despite his reluctance.
...
Above the Heavenly Altar, Lu Yang and Zhu Yunwu saw the two Semi-Immortals about to commence battle and, without a second thought, leapt down from the Heavenly Altar.
"Immortal Extermination World-Ending Dance!" Zhu Tian danced, his steps imbued with destruction and annihilation, shaking the entire Demon City as though the end of the world had come!
This was a world apart from the power of the dance Zhu Yunwu had been manipulated to perform.
Floodwaters transformed into water tornados, eight of them positioned according to the Eight Diagrams, blocking all escape routes.
Jiang Lianyi extended her delicate jade hand and took out a jade flute from behind her. This was the jade flute hung on the fourth layer's wall in the Creation Ancient Land, evidence of Jiang Lianyi's fondness for the instrument.
Pale lips lightly blew across the flute, fingers pressing the holes, eyes closed in concentration, long hair dancing in the breeze, playing as if enchanted and bewitched.
The crisp sound of the flute pierced through the blockade of the eight water tornadoes, as if the whole world became tranquil, devoid of any sound.
If the eight water tornadoes represented the utmost motion, then the crisp flute sound constituted the utmost stillness.
Motion met stillness.
Crack—
The temperature plummeted abruptly, the eight tornadoes began to ice over from the base, instantly turning the entire twister into an ice pillar, and the temperature in the Demon Territory dropped to freezing, causing the onlooking cultivators to breathe out puffs of air.
"Go!"
Jiang Lianyi put down the jade flute and with a hook of her index finger, lifted it upwards, the eight frozen water tornadoes unexpectedly shattered into ice chunks, forming a dragon shape, smashing towards Zhu Tian.
"Space, congeal!"
Zhu Tian bellowed, the space above his head compressed continually, forming a spatial barrier that blocked the ice chunks' bombardment.
The onlooking crowd saw the attack range exceed the Heavenly Altar, with the aftershocks sweeping towards them, they quickly retreated to the entrance of the Demon City, watching the magic duel progress, holding the Recording Orbs steadily in their hands, determined to record the whole process.
Since the founding ceremony began, the Recording Orbs had been activated, truly capturing the whole process of the grand event.
Watching the thrilling battle above Demon City, Qiu Jin'an's eyes twitched, "Originally, I came to watch the Ancient Di Jiang nation-building just for fun, but how did it turn into the Ancient Heavenly Court wreaking havoc on Demon City in the blink of an eye, and then into a magic duel between two Semi-Immortals, with six Great Demons of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage dueling?"
The transformation was so swift he couldn't even react.
He remembered the upheaval of the Qingzhou festival and the battle at Hanshui City, these two incidents shared a common feature.
Qiu Jin'an turned his body to the side and quietly asked the Grand Elder, "Where is Lu Yang from your sect?"
The common feature of these two incidents was that both Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were present.
The Grand Elder could not reveal Lu Yang's whereabouts, he responded without changing his expression, "He had other matters and didn't come."
Qiu Jin'an nodded, it seemed Meng Jingzhou had a knack for attracting disasters.
Others were also feeling emotional; they had never imagined they would witness a battle between Semi-Immortals in their lives. The trip to Demon City was worth it; if the Demon Nation were to be established again, they would come again.
"This is one of the uses of the Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit Outline," Fairy Eternity explained to Lu Yang. Laymen enjoy the show, while professionals discern the technique. She was the only one in the audience who understood the intricacies of the magic duel.
"Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit Outline is not only about controlling people. Spiritual essence, magic skills, objects... everything falls within its domain of control."
"Lianyi controls Zhu Tian's tornadoes, and Zhu Tian controls space; both are examples."
Lu Yang had a strange look on his face, recalling a fallen Ancient Great Power, "Why does it sound so similar to Verbal Spell?"
"There is a difference. The Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit Outline can only control those weaker than oneself, while Verbal Spell can even control the strong. It's a pity, really. The other party had a good chance of becoming an Immortal, like a Verbal Spell Dao Fruit or something similar, which wouldn't conflict with the Qilin Immortal's Dao Fruit," she continued.
"The pity is, they couldn't hold their tongue," Fairy Eternity said with a shake of her head, lamenting her once adversary.
The Gold Clan Leader felt a profound sense of regret. Such an exciting fight, and their Ancient Ancestor had not come to watch; he could only describe it to them afterward... Wait, describe? His expression suddenly turned pale as he remembered the Ancient Ancestor had instructed him to record the event with a Recording Orb.
In his haste, as soon as he arrived, he heard the Grand Elder reveal his shameful past and had forgotten about it!
He quickly set about rectifying the situation, asking the leader of the Ba Xia Clan, "Can you make a copy of this excellent Recording Orb for me?"
The Ba Xia Clan Leader sized up the Gold Clan Leader, "Do you have the money?"
The Gold Clan Leader gritted his teeth, a bit distressed, since a copy of the Recording Orb was definitely not cheap.
"Forget it, I'll make do by describing it to the Ancient Ancestor..."
As they were speaking, a booming sound was heard, and Zhu Tian fell from the Heavenly Altar, crashing into a big crater.
The Gold Clan Leader looked at Zhu Tian, who had fallen to the ground, "I'll buy it!"

chapters.title: Chapter 620 - 619: Battle of the Semi-Immortal!
chapters.content:
The Ba Xia Clan Leader started off sitting on the ground but then raised his price, making the Gold Clan Leader grind his teeth in frustration.
But when he thought about how splendid this battle had been, he realized that it would take a storytelling master to describe it with vivid, evocative language.
"Fine, but you can't raise the price again!"
The Gold Clan Leader glared threateningly at the Ba Xia Clan Leader, thinking that they must believe the Qiongqi Clan was easy to bully.
After paying the money, the Gold Clan Leader felt more and more heartache.
"Maybe I should find some time to learn storytelling?"
If he could tell stories, would he have been cheated out of this money?
Zhu Tian tried to flip himself up like a carp leaping out of the water, but Jiang Lianyi would not give him the chance. She leapt down from the Heavenly Altar and landed a kick in the pit where Zhu Tian was, almost making him spew his guts out.
"Cough—"
Zhu Tian, pinned to the ground by Jiang Lianyi, tried several times to get up but failed and became furiously angry.
"So I let you take two moves and you really think you're something special!"
Zhu Tian hadn't expected Jiang Lianyi to be so hard to deal with. Judging by the reaction of the Phoenix Tribe, they were unaware of Jiang Lianyi's existence, which meant that she must have awakened recently. Therefore, it should take a long time for her to return to her glory days.
However, as soon as they clashed, he discovered that Jiang Lianyi was already in her ancient peak state, showing no signs of weakness, which caused him to be at a disadvantage.
Damn it, how is that possible.
He roared angrily, transforming back into his original form, enlarged his body, and sent Jiang Lianyi flying.
Jiang Lianyi stepped on the air twice and steadied herself in the sky, calm and unperturbed. Her arms swung, and she transformed into a colorful phoenix.
The phoenix soared high with wings outspread, adorned with colorful feathers all over. The sunlight pierced through the feathers and cast rainbow light onto the ground.
Cultivators with hidden injuries were bathed in the rainbow light, and their injuries gradually vanished.
The members of the Demon Race were strongest when they fought in their original forms, and both Semi-Immortals, now reverted, went all out in their attacks!
Zhu Tian propelled himself with his feet, overturning the meticulously crafted Liuli White Jade Heavenly Altar, which was not only an altar but also a magic artifact!
The several hundred meters tall Liuli White Jade Jiuchong Heavenly Altar was thrown out, smashing heavily towards Jiang Lianyi. She twirled her wings to catch the altar, dissipating its force and attached a layer of lightning before throwing it back.
Zhu Tian opened his mouth, releasing an invisible sonic wave to immobilize the altar. Under the sonic attack, the altar shook slightly but intensely and was again hurled toward Jiang Lianyi.
If Jiang Lianyi dared to catch the altar in the same way as before, it would explode along with the lightning attached to it!
Jiang Lianyi had long seen through Zhu Tian's scheme, and she commanded space to lock down the altar.
"Back at you."
In the hands of the two Semi-Immortals, the Heavenly Altar seemed like a toy, being tossed back and forth, but only witnessing Cultivators knew after several turnovers, the altar was charged with layers of attacks, which could cause severe injuries even to veterans at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage if detonated.
Eventually, the Heavenly Altar could no longer withstand the stacking attacks and exploded between them.
Two Semi-Immortals and six great demons at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage wielded magic, and four battles dazzled the onlookers, who wished they had more pairs of eyes to watch.
There were plenty of cultivators in the Body Integration Realm present. If they could kind of follow the Transcendance Tribulation Stage battles, the Semi-Immortal fights were genuinely incomprehensible to them.
But that didn't stop them from unanimously choosing to watch the Semi-Immortal level battles.
The spiritual essence within a thousand miles was drained, controlled by the two powerful Semi-Immortal demons.
The two demons battled from the sky to the ground and from the ground back to the sky. Their fighting shattered space along the way, leaving devastation in their wake, and the six battling great demons at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage all kept their distance to avoid being caught in the ferocity of the clash.
The sky was filled with colorful lights and wondrous sights—Celestial Maidens scattering flowers, the Phoenix's majestic arrival, the Wutong generating phoenixes…
Then, with thunder roaring and lightning flashing, two massive shadows battled behind the storm clouds, illuminated only momentarily by the lightning revealing a brief glimpse of their combat spectacle.
Zhu Tian danced gracefully, resembling a winged pig performing a dance, with a solemn song accompanying the movements.
"No need to boast of a bountiful autumn harvest, after the fall, inquire how the heads roll…"
Jiang Lianyi, sensing something, fanned her phoenix wings and flew sideways, narrowly escaping the imperceptible blades that shaved off a few phoenix feathers.
"The Autumn Song in the Song of Four Seasons?"
Jiang Lianyi, proficient in music, sang softly, also imbued with a murderous intent.
Two different types of rhythms echoed through the sky, turning into visible ripples, stirring up spatial fluctuations, kill intents lurking all around, ambush from every direction!
Suddenly, a torrential downpour began from the heavens, pelting the ground with a crackling noise.
"Hm? This isn't rain, it's... seeds?"
Lu Yang picked up a seed from the ground, unable to discern its origin.
"These are Dragon-binding Vine seeds, which shouldn't exist in your era."
"Dragon-binding Vine?"
"As the name implies, it once bound Ao Ling."
Lu Yang recalled that Fairy Eternity had mentioned Jiang Lianyi and Ao Ling were not far apart in strength, with Jiang Lianyi having a forty percent chance of victory and Ao Ling sixty percent.
As the Dragon-binding Vine seeds touched the ground, they sprouted roots and grew vigorously, and in a blink, the entire Demon City was overrun with Dragon-binding Vines, resembling countless hands reaching for the sky, which was somewhat eerie.
The Dragon-binding Vines grew rapidly, suddenly bending and wrapping around Zhu Tian, who flapped his four wings like four heavenly sabers, capable of splitting heaven and earth, invincible.
This time was no different, as his four wings sent out four sabre energies, chopping the Dragon-binding Vines to pieces.
But immediately after, Zhu Tian sensed something was wrong; the cut sections of the vines were burning with robust flames—it was as if the insides of the Dragon-binding Vines were hollowed out and filled with fire.
"This is bad, it's Nirvana True Fire!"
The Dragon-binding Vines regrew, and Zhu Tian continued to flap his wings, cutting them down, but no matter how many times he cut them, they would regrow, endless and inexhaustible.
Fairy Eternity explained to Lu Yang, "The Dragon-binding Vine is a special immortal vine cultivated by Lianyi, charred with Nirvana True Fire, allowing a strand of flame to merge into the seeds, so when you use the Tree Planting Spell to sprout and grow, the vine becomes an immortal vine that grows eternally under the enhancement of Nirvana True Fire."
"Under the control of the Dao Fruit Outline, the Dragon-binding Vine will move according to Lianyi's will, flexible and unpredictable, impossible to guard against."
"Xiao Ling was caught off guard by this move last time and was bound tightly."
Zhu Tian was also bound by the Dragon-binding Vine, his six wings wrapped around him like rice dumpling leaves.
He refused to be restrained like this and let out an angry shout.
"Law of Heaven and Earth!"
He displayed the Law of Heaven and Earth, transforming into a colossal beast, his muscles bulging in an attempt to break free with brute strength. When becoming larger didn't free him, he reverted to human form, trying to squeeze through the gaps in the vines.
Under Jiang Lianyi's control, the Dragon-binding Vine could expand or contract, and no matter what form Zhu Tian took, it tightly bound him, making escape impossible.
"You're forcing my hand!"
Zhu Tian's eyes were split with rage, and he opened his mouth wide; countless ancient ghosts spewed out, forming a ghostly army.
The ancient ghosts were of various shapes, including humans, demons, and peculiar spirits; they were the losers of an ancient war, swallowed by Zhu Tian and refined with the capabilities of the Dao Fruit Outline.
"The legendary passing of the ghost army makes all demons retreat!"
A great demon at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage exclaimed in horror, recognizing a well-known ancient legend: where the ghost army passes, nothing grows for thousands of miles, and planets become barren. This is a taboo for the Demon Race, often used to scare children.
It turns out that Venerate Zhu Tian was the origin of this legend!
No matter how he looked at it, Lu Yang found this move familiar.
"Familiarity is right; the Tiger Clan learned this technique, turning it into the Ghoul Method, which is the backstory to the phrase 'to follow like a lackey for the tiger,'" said Fairy Eternity nonchalantly.
Jiang Lianyi exhaled a ball of flame, hotter than the sun's temperature; this was the origin of Nirvana True Fire!
She bit the tip of her tongue, and her phoenix Essence Blood dripped into the Nirvana True Fire, which let out a phoenix cry and transformed into a phoenix identical to herself.
This was the true Phoenix Nirvana!
Nirvana True Fire, the most rigid and yang, is the best at containing ghostly and demonic evils!

chapters.title: Chapter 621 - 620: Victors are Kings, Losers are Bandits, the Weak are Prey to the Strong
chapters.content:
Tens of thousands of ancient ghostly soldiers formed ranks, neat and uniform. Many of these ghostly soldiers had become legends, passed down through generations, and were truly powerful.
Later, they all became defeated subordinates under Zhu Tian.
If Zhu Tian didn't possess real abilities, he wouldn't have dared to claim the title of emperor.
The phoenix transformed from the Nirvana True Fire had a temperature comparable to the sun. Demon City was cast from metal, yet even the metal walls showed signs of melting under such a terrifying temperature, not to mention the cultivators below.
They say cultivators aren't affected by cold or heat, but if the temperature gets this high, they can only use their cultivation level to withstand it.
Those with elders to protect them are in a relatively better situation, capable of holding on. For someone like Kong Hao, who traveled to Demon City alone, the only option would be to flee from the city and watch the battle from further away.
"Go!" Zhu Tian ordered, and the ghostly soldiers marched and formed an array in the sky, a dark and oppressive mass carrying a terrifyingly cold aura, bearing down on Jiang Lianyi.
"Explode." The Nirvana True Fire phoenix spread its wings and soared high, hot as the blazing sun, hurtling forward with a whoosh, as fast as lightning.
When the two sides collided, it was like yin meeting yang, forming a giant Tai Chi pattern in the sky.
Immediately after, the Tai Chi pattern exploded, with the phoenix turned into sparks scattering across the sky.
Yet, most of the ghostly soldiers remained.
Seeing this, Zhu Tian burst into loud laughter.
"Condense!" Jiang Lianyi remained unfazed, softly chanting, and using the power of the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit to control the Nirvana clone and reassemble it.
The Nirvana clone charged into the ghostly army, exploding once more.
"Condense!"
Zhu Tian was dumbfounded. He had never heard of someone's clone exploding and then reassembling, only to explode again repeatedly!
Wait, this technique seemed somewhat familiar. He had encountered it in ancient times. Who was it again?
Witnessing this scene, Lu Yang's eyelid twitched involuntarily. This technique was indeed familiar; wasn't it the favorite battle method of Fairy Eternity?
Lacking the Initial Form of Eternity Dao Fruit, the Initial Form of Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit was used to control the situation instead.
"It seems that Lianyi, despite her memory loss, has not forgotten the teachings of this Immortal."
Boom—
The Nirvana clone exploded on Zhu Tian, raising a cloud of dust, leaving Zhu Tian in a pathetic state, with even his wings scorched.
Zhu Tian sang the Song of Spring, quickly recovering his condition before the next wave of attacks.
"Condense!"
The Nirvana clone reassembled, Zhu Tian readied himself for battle, and as the Nirvana clone approached, Zhu Tian manipulated space, creating a barrier to block the next explosion.
Suddenly, the space behind him rippled, and Jiang Lianyi moved through the space, arriving behind him.
"Not good!"
Behind Jiang Lianyi, a giant phoenix shadow emerged, surrounded by countless avian illusory shadows – the Vermilion Bird, Blue Luan, Chongming, Bifang...
"The Worship of Ten Thousand Birds! That's the legendary Worship of Ten Thousand Birds!" a great demon exclaimed from below.
"The Phoenix Ancestor subdued all birds, they revered the Phoenix Ancestor as their sovereign, hence the saying that the phoenix is the king of birds in later generations!"
The giant phoenix shadow spread its wings, the myriad birds turning into feathers, becoming part of the phoenix.
The phoenix shadow soared into the sky, diving down swiftly, and Zhu Tian, looking up, saw what seemed like a fire-bathing phoenix bursting from the sun, an intimidating sight.
Zhu Tian wanted to dodge, but suddenly everything around him, including himself, slowed down.
"Spatial lockdown… No, this is time stopping!"
Zhu Tian wore a look of disbelief; he hadn't expected that Jiang Lianyi's Initial Form of Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit could even freeze time!
She had never exerted her full strength from beginning to end!
Time stopped, and Zhu Tian lost his ability to perceive the outside world. When time began to flow again, the phoenix silhouette was already too close for him to avoid.
Boom—
The phoenix's beak pierced through Zhu Tian's body, nailing him to the ground!
"What just happened? Why did Zhu Tian suddenly stop moving?" Lu Yang wondered. With the distance just now, Zhu Tian could have evaded, but he remained immobile as if fixed to the spot by a spell.
Fairy Eternity saw through the technique: "It wasn't that he didn't move; it was that everyone stopped moving for a moment in time. Lianyi controlled time, causing it to halt."
"With this fairy present, you can see the whole process of the battle. To others, it looked as though the phoenix silhouette suddenly jumped in front of Zhu Tian, and he was struck because he failed to dodge in time."
"Time stopping? Elder Lianyi can even do that?!" Lu Yang was astonished.
"The Playing Dead Technique is about seeking life in death, deceiving time, and in a sense, defeating time, so she can stop time. However, this unconventional manner of defeating time is not the right path, which is why she can only stop it for a breath or two."
"Were it the Time Immortal, stopping time for a thousand or eight hundred years wouldn't be an issue."
In a battle between Semi-Immortals, a mere breath or two can determine victory or defeat.
"As for why she didn't use it before, she probably wanted to hide her skills. Revealing one's trump card under the watchful eyes of many isn't a wise move. Not to mention, have you seen her use an Immortal Artifact from beginning to end?"
When Lu Yang thought about it, it was true; Elder Lianyi surely had an Immortal Artifact refined by the Yingtian Immortal, but she hadn't used it, which was telling.
"Victors reign, losers suffer. Zhu Tian, do you admit defeat?" Jiang Lianyi transformed back into her human form and, looking down at the severely wounded Zhu Tian on the ground, asked coldly.
Zhu Tian, dejected, also understood the crux of the matter. He completely accepted his defeat in this battle. Even if it were to happen again, the outcome would still be a loss.
"I admit defeat."
Jiang Lianyi said nothing more. She brought her index and middle fingers together, lightly touched Zhu Tian's forehead, and activated the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit, forming a master-servant imprint on Zhu Tian's body.
Survival of the fittest, victory and defeat, were truths both of them adhered to, otherwise, they would not have the Initial Form of the Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit.
During the Ancient Times, Jiang Lianyi had already defeated Zhu Tian, but at that time, the four immortals governed the world, and there was no need to control Zhu Tian.
Today was different. An unchecked Zhu Tian could very well resort to sneaky tactics.
Moreover, Zhu Tian now knew she could stop time; this knowledge could not be leaked.
"Your establishment of the Demon Nation is beneficial to the Demon Race; I won't obstruct it. The Phoenix Tribe may also join the Demon Nation."
With the master-servant imprint in place, Zhu Tian was nominally the ruler of the Demon Nation, but Jiang Lianyi was the true sovereign.
"You act ostentatiously, always in the spotlight. If you continue this way, you will drag the Demon Race into an abyss from which there is no return."
Not to mention anything else, the mere fact that Zhu Tian wanted to attack Great Xia was a path to certain death.
Jiang Lianyi heard from Fairy Eternity that there were immortals in Great Xia, and not just one.
Zhu Tian obviously wasn't convinced, but as the loser, he had no choice but to listen to whatever Jiang Lianyi said.
As the dust settled, onlookers saw Zhu Tian on the ground admitting defeat, and Jiang Lianyi, the victor, still with her expression cold.
In the presence of the deterrence of two Semi-Immortals, no one dared to approach.
"Senior Brother."
Jiang Lianyi approached Lu Yang, respectfully calling him Senior Brother. Everyone spontaneously cleared a path. Fortunately, Lu Yang was prepared and kept his composure, nodding steadily, embodying the poise of a Young Sect Master.
Even as Lu Yang walked ahead, Jiang Lianyi half a step behind, their respective statuses were clear.
Lu Yang cast a glance at Zhu Tian and said indifferently, "Let's go. The Demon Nation is nothing special."
The two of them left the Demon City, and amidst the awe and respect of the powerful beings, they vanished into thin air, mysterious and unfathomable.

chapters.title: Chapter 622 - 621 Unpredictable Destiny (Extra for Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
"Phew, it's finally over," Lu Yang and Jiang Lianyi walked far away from Demon City and removed the Invisibility Talisman.
"It's not over yet. I've used the power of the Dao Fruit Outline to control Zhu Tian. There are too many prying eyes here. Let's wait until most of them have left before we look for him."
...
The battle of the Semi-Immortals drew attention, but not many noticed the three fights at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
Of the three fights, the one between Jiang Mingzi and the Taozhu Clan Leader had the widest gap and was the least suspenseful.
With an Ancient Ancestor backing him, Jiang Mingzi fought more wildly than before. Ever since the Taozhu Clan joined the Demon Nation, Clan Leader Ji Youming had been throwing his weight around like a bully, humiliating the Phoenix Tribe, who dared not retaliate for fear of giving the Demon Nation an excuse to attack.
Now they finally had a chance to fight back.
"Jiang Mingzi, why don't we sit down and talk?" Ji Youming spat out blood from the beating, feeling a chill in his heart. He realized that Jiang Mingzi intended to fight him to the death, without holding back at all.
"Talk to your mother, you're sure to die today!"
Jiang Mingzi was quick-tempered, something that his status had previously prevented him from showing.
"Very well, you're forcing me!"
Ji Youming, furious, burnt his Essence Blood, exhaling smoke and summoning lightning.
The thunder and lightning that appeared during Zhu Tian and Jiang Lianyi's fight weren't caused by either of them, but by Ji Youming instead.
"Luo Tian Immortal Thunder!"
The lightning seemed to form a world of its own. In the clouds, mountains and rivers appeared, and all animals and plants transformed into lightning, which then destroyed that world. The lightning turned into a purple-blue torrential flow, viciously smashing down on Jiang Mingzi!
A few Body Integration Realm cultivators who were paying attention to the commotion jumped in alarm, knowing they would be reduced to ashes under that thunder if it were them.
"I hereby set the rule [Within three breaths, you cannot dodge]," roared Ji Youming, "old thing, die!"
Jiang Mingzi unveiled the Five Virtues Banner, shaking it vigorously. The banner fluttered, displaying the prominent ancient characters for Benevolence, Righteousness, Propriety, Wisdom, and Trust. The purple-blue thunderous torrent that fell on the banner did not show the slightest bit of its power.
"How is this possible!" Ji Youming was shocked. This move was one of his ultimate tricks; how could it be so easily neutralized?
Jiang Mingzi sneered, but of course, he wouldn't tell his opponent that the Five Virtues Banner was a top-notch defensive treasure, capable of muddling Yin and Yang, impervious to myriad magics.
"I hereby set the rule [Within three breaths, you cannot dodge]!"
"Fate is unpredictable!"
An enigmatic force coalesced at the tip of Jiang Mingzi's finger. Ji Youming sensed something was wrong, and as he turned to run, he realized the rule made it impossible to escape within a single breath and was forced to withstand the attack.
"Don't think you're the only one who can defend!"
From his Storage Ring, Ji Youming pulled out a lion's skin, a defensive magic artifact crafted from the corpse of his predecessor, Ji Xiong.
Plth.
Jiang Mingzi's finger pierced through the impregnable lion's skin, touching Ji Youming's forehead.
"What have you done!"
Ji Youming felt something change, but he couldn't pinpoint what it was.
Jiang Mingzi certainly wouldn't reveal the function of his technique to his enemy.
The two continued to fight. Ji Youming repeatedly made mistakes; either his cultivation technique got stuck, or his seal formations were a beat too slow. All sorts of coincidences abounded.
Fate is unpredictable; the Divine Ability Causality reduces an opponent's luck for a period of time.
In other words, it brought bad luck to Ji Youming.
After hundreds of exchanges, Ji Youming, who was already inferior to Jiang Mingzi, now also faced the defense of the top-notch treasure, the Five Virtues Banner, which made any attack on Jiang Mingzi useless. Coupled with his terrible luck, he made error after error, essentially getting pummeled during these hundreds of exchanges.
Jiang Mingzi attacked ruthlessly, with lethal blows, until finally...
"Aaah—"
Jiang Mingzi transformed into a giant phoenix, tearing open Ji Youming's chest with its steel-strong talons.
Seeing the tide of battle turn against him, Ji Youming initiated Astral Projection, burned his lifespan, and decisively fled!
"Hmph, he sure ran off fast."
Jiang Mingzi coldly huffed. He hadn't expected Ji Youming to flee so resolutely; unless he too burned his lifespan, there was no way to catch up to Ji Youming.
"Perhaps I hit him too hard and scared him off?"
Jiang Mingzi didn't bother with Ji Youming anymore, collecting his body into a Storage Ring and went to find the Ancient Ancestor in Demon City.
…
"Huff, huff, huff—" Ji Youming's heart still raced with fear, and seeing that Jiang Mingzi was not chasing, he stopped burning his lifespan.
"Returning to the clan in the state of a soul, it's very likely that I would be discovered along the way."
"Possess someone, and use their body to return!"
Ji Youming arrived outside the city, where there were all the minor cultivators who, without the protection of a Senior Brother, didn't dare enter the city to watch the battle. He could just pick anyone.
"It's you!"
Without another word, he rushed into a minor cultivator's Lingtai.
The minor cultivator's soul was meditating, and upon seeing Ji Youming, he was greatly startled.
"Kid, what's your name?" Ji Youming sneered sinisterly, revealing his true form – an appearance that could stop a crying child in fright.
"I, I'm called Kong Hao." The minor cultivator named Kong Hao was clearly very nervous.
"Kong Hao, is it? I'll remember your name... Wait, where did this iron barrier come from?"
Just as Ji Youming was about to attack Kong Hao to initiate possession, he discovered that there was an iron barrier between himself and Kong Hao.
"This is a seal. How come you have a seal inside you? Who is it sealing?"
Ji Youming couldn't make head nor tail of it, when suddenly, a familiar and chilling voice sounded.
"Of course it's sealing me!"
Ji Youming turned sharply only to find another Taozhu inside the barrier, shivering uncontrollably, and he cried out in shock.
"Ji Xiong!"
Ji Xiong had lost an eye, and it sounded as though there was something stuck in his throat; his laughter was hoarse and unpleasant, his schadenfreude apparent to anyone who heard it.
"Ji Youming, you dared to commit insubordination, to scheme for the position of Clan Leader. Did you ever think you would end up like this?"
"What, what are you going to do!"
If this were his prime, he naturally wouldn't have feared the former Clan Leader, but he had just fought a bloody battle with Jiang Mingzi and was at his weakest. Encountering the former Clan Leader now, he was only in for a beating.
"What do I intend to do? Obviously, share this enclosure with me!" Ji Xiong bellowed, and subdued Ji Youming!
This was the place where Ji Xiong had been sealed. Ji Youming might leave, but Ji Xiong would never let his enemy get away.
He had been confined here for many years; he hadn't understood how to break the seal, but he certainly understood how to create one!
…
Half a day later, the battle in Demon City concluded, and the clash between the two ancient Semi-Immortals shocked the world.
Ji Youming went missing, his life or death uncertain.
The two cultivators from the Long Clan at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage and the elders from the Di Jiang and Jiuying clans had fought without a clear winner, but any observant person could tell that this was just an external excuse. Both the elder of the Di Jiang Clan and the Ancient Ancestor of the Jiuying had suffered heavy injuries, requiring a long period of rest and recovery.
In the Imperial Palace of Demon City, Zhu Tian transformed into a human form and sat on the throne that symbolized power.
"Your Majesty..." The bandaged elder of the Di Jiang Clan stood waiting at his side.
"Enough, step back. There's nothing for you here," Zhu Tian said dismissively with a wave of his hand.
After the elder of the Di Jiang Clan left, two figures, a man and a woman, appeared in the palace; it was Jiang Lianyi and Lu Yang.
The grand Imperial Palace, with only three people, seemed extraordinarily empty.
Zhu Tian rubbed his hands with feigned enthusiasm, smiling as he offered his seat, "Friend Jiang, please sit. The chair is cold; let me warm it up for you."
Jiang Lianyi turned to look at Lu Yang, "Senior Brother, would you like to sit?"
Lu Yang: "…"
I, a member of the Human race, sitting in the seat of the ruler of the Demon Nation?
Lu Yang looked at Zhu Tian: "You sit?"
The three of them went round in circles until ultimately, Zhu Tian took out two more thrones from his Storage Ring, solving the dilemma.
The three chairs formed a circle, almost like villagers huddling around a stove to chat.
Jiang Lianyi posed the question she most wanted an answer to: "Do you know where my husband is?"
"Ah, he's still alive?"

chapters.title: Chapter 623 - 622: A Terrified Zhu Tian
chapters.content:
The moment the words escaped his lips, Lu Yang felt as if his life hung by a thread, his existence subject to unpredictable fate.
Jiang Lianyi cast a cold glance at Zhu Tian but did not make a move.
This was a necessary precaution, she worried Zhu Tian might lie, so she used the power of the Dao Fruit Outline to secretly command him to conceal nothing and say whatever came to mind.
Zhu Tian made up for his oversight before it was too late, quickly saying, "I meant, I thought the Qilin Immortal had died long ago."
After speaking, Zhu Tian wished he could slap himself twice across the mouth.
In the past, he would always speak after careful thought, so what was happening today? Why wasn't he thinking before speaking?
Jiang Lianyi: "..."
It appeared that forced truth-telling had its drawbacks.
Well then, it looked as though Zhu Tian, let alone knowing any clues about her husband, didn't even know whether her husband was dead or alive.
Once he calmed down, Zhu Tian broke out in a cold sweat, his hands and feet turning icy.
The way Jiang Lianyi asked implied that the Qilin Immortal must still be alive, and if Zhu Tian hadn't felt the suppression of a superior Dao Fruit, it was only because his cultivation was inadequate.
The Qilin Immortal being alive and himself having acted against Jiang Lianyi... this...
Zhu Tian dared not contemplate the consequences of this matter; facing the Qilin Immortal, he wouldn't have enough lives to spare!
"Do you know the Immortal Sister?"
"Who?" Zhu Tian looked confused, having never heard the name before.
"Me, the Fairy Eternity." Fairy Eternity appeared openly, emerging from Lu Yang's body. With the master-servant imprint placed on Zhu Tian, he would not reveal her identity.
Upon seeing Fairy Eternity, Zhu Tian was horror-stricken, almost thinking he was hallucinating. He jumped to his feet, unable to control his voice.
"An Immortal!!"
He had lived through the era when the Four Ancient Immortals reigned, often listening to the Immortals' lectures; he couldn't be more familiar with them.
This kind of bottomless power, undoubtedly belonged to an Immortal!
To think that within the body of Young Master Lu, there lurked an Immortal!
Thinking back to the affairs of the Ancient Heavenly Court, could it be that this Immortal was none other than Heavenly Venerate Dou, the hidden fifth Immortal of ancient times?
No wonder Young Master Lu had not been controlled by the Di Jiang mandate, he had thought it was Jiang Lianyi who intervened, but now it appeared that it might have been the Immortal who took action.
Zhu Tian suddenly realized that even though he was a great demon from ancient times, he knew far too little about the affairs of the ancient, like a frog in a well. What he knew only scratched the surface.
"Fine, it seems that I have encountered yet another who does not recognize me." Fairy Eternity pouted, not surprised; even Jiang Lianyi, who was closest to her and one of the strongest among the Semi-Immortals, couldn't remember her, let alone someone like Zhu Tian.
Zhu Tian, quite perceptively, offered the fourth imperial chair for Fairy Eternity to sit.
The four of them sat in a circle, continuing their chat with a strong rural homey atmosphere.
"Tell us, what made you decide to enter into slumber, and why choose to resurrect now?"
"That story begins with the cataclysmic battle waged by the Four Ancient Immortals, a battle whose adversaries are still unknown to us..."
As Zhu Tian spoke, his gaze shifted toward Fairy Eternity, becoming more panic-stricken than before.
The master of the Heavenly Court, the hidden fifth Immortal, the enemy of the Four Ancient Immortals—could it be that the adversary they faced back then was this Great Power?
Fairy Eternity glared, "Don't look at me, continue."
"Oh, oh," Zhu Tian quickly calmed his frightened heart, feeling as though he had walked along the edge of life and death.
For the Qilin Immortal killing him was as easy as flipping a hand, and this master of the Heavenly Court, having fought the Four Ancient Immortals, likely possessed even greater strength than the Qilin Immortal.
If it had been this being who intervened at the Heavenly Altar just now...
Zhu Tian shivered.
Seeing how cordial the relationship between Young Sect Master Lu and the Heavenly Court Master is, if one can't get on the good side of the Heavenly Court Master, then cozying up to Young Sect Master Lu is also a way of indirectly saving the situation.
Zhu Tian continued, "Friend Jiang, you've witnessed that battle as well, haven't you? It's a realm we Semi-Immortals can never reach. The chasm is too vast and insurmountable, driving one to despair..."
Jiang Lianyi corrected, "I'm not in despair."
"...It drives me to despair."
"At that time, I was thinking there's no such thing as eternal existence. The Four Ancient Immortals couldn't possibly reign forever. Since I couldn't shine in the era of the Four Ancient Immortals, why not slumber and await the time when there would be no Immortals, and preferably no Semi-Immortals either? Then I could awaken?"
"The more I thought about it, the better the idea seemed. I quickly scavenged a heap of heavenly treasures for a deep sleep, burying them in my coffin before interment."
"I left a message for my descendants, instructing them to resurrect me in an era devoid of Immortals."
"This became the Di Jiang Clan's top-secret knowledge, passed down strictly from one Clan Leader to the next."
"Over two hundred years ago, my descendants woke me up."
"Upon awakening, hey, what a great era indeed, where Semi-Immortals are invincible."
"Then, I spent two hundred years restoring my strength while establishing the Demon Nation—just this morning the Demon Nation was completed, and you all came attacking."
Seeing that Zhu Tian really didn't know anything, Jiang Lianyi didn't waste any more time asking questions and prepared to leave.
"As I've said before, the Phoenix Tribe will become a member of the Demon Nation. Once the Demon Territory is united, you should focus on governing the Demon Nation, and I will monitor you at all times."
In ancient times, Immortals ruled over tens of thousands of Life Stars, and Semi-Immortals, a bit less, could rule over several hundreds. Fairy Eternity was an exception, ruling just one.
Zhu Tian had experience in governance.
Upon leaving the Imperial Palace of Demon City, Immortal Fairy Eternity returned to Lu Yang's body.
"Where shall we go next?"
"To the Phoenix Tribe."
...
Qiongqi Clan.
The petite figure studied intently the Recording Orb that the Gold Clan Leader had purchased at a hefty price, with a grave expression.
The battle between the two Semi-Immortals was worth studying over and over.
"Indeed, it's Jiang Lianyi, and she's in her prime no less."
The petite figure clicked her tongue; she had thought Jiang Lianyi had just awakened, far from her peak condition. Now she saw that with wide and unrestrained movements, not even holding back, Jiang Lianyi hadn't even used her trump cards before she dispatched Zhu Tian.
"Could it be that Heavenly Venerate Dou gave her some good stuff?"
"Ancestor, what is our next step..." the Gold Clan Leader asked timidly at her side.
"First, join the Demon Nation. It's not shown on the Recording Orb, but given Jiang Lianyi's character, she must have placed a master-servant imprint on Zhu Tian. Nominally, the Demon Nation is Zhu Tian's, but in reality, it belongs to Jiang Lianyi."
"With Jiang Lianyi present, it's a foregone conclusion that the Demon Nation will be united. Our Qiongqi Clan has always refrained from joining; it's better to take the initiative now and join the Demon Nation, maintaining some degree of initiative."
The petite figure had constantly been in conflict with Jiang Lianyi in ancient times. Nobody knew Jiang Lianyi's character better than she did. Taking advantage of the smokescreen to imprint the master-servant mark, it might fool others, but not her.
"I never heard Heavenly Venerate Dou mention this Heavenly Court," said the petite figure.
Realizing there was nothing more to glean from the battle of the Semi-Immortals, the petite figure casually tossed the Recording Orb behind her, giving it to the Gold Clan Leader.
"Whether you keep this Recording Orb or destroy it, just make sure it's not seen by outsiders."
The Gold Clan Leader, puzzled, asked, "Is it because the battle of the Semi-Immortals is of great importance and shouldn't be divulged lightly?"
"It's because the Ba Xia Clan drove a hard bargain, and the embarrassing process of you buying the Recording Orb was recorded."
"Oh."

chapters.title: Chapter 624 - 623: Return to Phoenix Tribe
chapters.content:
The Phoenix Tribe, three Transcendance Tribulation Stage ancient ancestors sat side by side, looking exceptionally tense.
Ao Li, the envoy from the East Sea Long Clan, the clan leaders of the Demon Territory Long Clan, and the Phoenix Clan were also there, but they didn't even have the qualifications to sit.
Besides, there were the old members of both clans, all great demons who had left a significant mark in the Demon Territory, having gained great fame for their deeds. As the newer generation took over, they retired from active life.
They held extremely high positions within the clan, and even the clan leaders would have to treat them with utmost respect upon meeting them.
With the three ancient ancestors present, their own identities and statuses seemed insignificant; they could only stand.
The ancient ancestor of the Long Clan from the Demon Territory felt the heavy atmosphere and attempted to make conversation, saying, "It's uncertain when the Phoenix Ancestor will arrive."
The gathering of people from both clans was for the anticipated return of the Phoenix Ancestor.
After Jiang Mingzi had killed Ji Youming, he wanted to go to Demon City to find the Phoenix Ancestor, but was a step too late; the battle of the Semi-Immortals had ended, and both Lu Yang and Jiang Lianyi had already left.
Thinking that the ancient ancestor would surely want to return home to have a look, he hurried back to the Phoenix Tribe to wait.
He didn't even take the time to refine Ji Youming's corpse, just kept waiting.
The two branches of the Long Clan thought the same, convening at the Phoenix Tribe, hence the current scene.
Now, the periphery of the Phoenix Tribe was packed with various great demons from major tribes, all of them there to curry favor with the Phoenix Tribe.
In the past, if the Phoenix Tribe was considered the first great tribe of the Demon Territory it was due to their deep heritage; while powerful, they hadn't reached a level commanding universal submission.
Now it was different, with the return of the Phoenix Ancestor even if the Phoenix Tribe claimed not to be powerful, no one would believe it.
"I really envy you all. With the Phoenix Ancestor's return, the Phoenix Tribe is on the rise," said the two Transcendance Tribulation Stage beings from the Long Clan enviously as they looked at Jiang Mingzi. With the return of the Phoenix Ancestor, all internal and external troubles facing the Phoenix Tribe could be resolved. Why couldn't their Long Clan have such fortune?
"Oh no, not at all," Jiang Mingzi's mouth was nearly split with his grin.
Clang—
The members of the Phoenix Tribe who were guarding the door came pushing it open, out of breath, pointed outside, and excitedly said, "The ancient ancestor, the ancient ancestor is here, in the sky!"
"What!"
The three Transcendance Tribulation Stage great demons hastily stood up and went out to welcome their arrival.
In the sky floated a magnificent sunset cloud, as dazzling as Jiang Lianyi's bright red dress, strikingly conspicuous.
Upon the sunset cloud, the congregation of the Heavenly Court Sect assembled, not just Jiang Lianyi and Lu Yang, but also Third Senior Sister, Meng Jingzhou, and the five elders.
Of course, they all appeared in the guise of members of the Heavenly Court Sect.
Third Senior Sister originally didn't want to pretend to be a part of the Heavenly Court Sect, but she couldn't stand everyone else going to the Phoenix Tribe—and she felt a bit lonely and sad not going.
"What are you all doing here!"
Lu Yang messaged Meng Jingzhou.
"We will be returning to the Sect together soon; what's wrong with gathering a bit earlier!" Meng Jingzhou responded confidently.
"Ancient ancestor!"
"Phoenix Ancestor!"
"We pay tribute to the Phoenix Ancestor!"
Seeing Jiang Lianyi, members of the Dragon and Phoenix Clans fell to their knees, overcome with excitement.
"All right, get up," Jiang Lianyi raised her hand. Seeing her clan members after three hundred thousand years, she was equally moved.
Up until now, she hadn't rushed to meet her clansmen, mainly because the tribe had built her up too much, with tales like being reborn from fire, to name one. To be honest, she felt embarrassed to deny it and equally so to falsely acknowledge it.
Accompanied by members of both clans, Jiang Lianyi entered the Phoenix Tribe's Ancestral Hall.
Lu Yang and the others did not descend from the clouds; since Jiang Lianyi was going home to see her clan members, they felt no need to interfere.
The Ancestral Hall was filled with tablets of the Phoenix Tribe's ancestors, the one at the very top being Jiang Lianyi's, with a recently added Qilin Immortal beside it.
Jiang Lianyi: "..."
You all move quite quickly.
"What's your name?" Jiang Lianyi noticed that Jiang Mingzi was the highest in cultivation within the Phoenix Tribe.
"Responding to the ancient ancestor, my name is Jiang Mingzi."
"Late-stage Transcendance. Very good. The Phoenix Tribe's endurance over these many years couldn't have been without your protection. You have worked hard."
"It was no trouble at all!" Jiang Mingzi's eyes were brimming with tears.
"And you two, what are your names? I hear that the Long Clan has now split into two groups, one in the Demon Territory and the other in the East Sea?"
```
"Senior, yes, I am Ao Chunqiu," replied the old ancestor from the Dragon Clan of the Demon Territory.
"And I am Ao Fan," said one of the old ancestors from the East Sea Dragon Clan.
"Do you have any news of Ao Ling?"
Ao Fan clenched his fists, feeling bitter inside, "Senior, no."
He had heard that the two ancient ancestors were both friends and foes, and he had hoped to inquire about the ancient ancestors from the Phoenix Ancestor. Now it seemed hopeless.
Jiang Lianyi nodded, as this was within her expectations.
She suspected the husband must have hidden Ao Ling very well out of fear that the puppet master behind the scenes would discover her. The Dragon Clan alone would probably not find any clues.
"You don't have to worry about Xiao Ling's safety. She is merely using a secret technique to sleep somewhere. I will do my best to find her."
"Thank you, Senior!" Ao Fan and Ao Chunqiu said excitedly. With the help of the Phoenix Ancestor, their chances of finding the ancient ancestors greatly increased.
"There's no need to thank me; it's what should be done. My relationship with Xiao Ling is closer than you might imagine – we both are wives of the Qilin Immortal."
"Ah?"
The Dragon and Phoenix Clans were both taken aback by this news.
But after careful consideration, it made sense. The Qilin Immortal was powerful, so having two wives was nothing unusual.
"As for the affairs of the Demon Nation, the Phoenix Tribe and Dragon Clan of the Demon Territory are welcome to join. A unified Demon Territory is beneficial for the development of the Demon Race."
"As for your concerns about Zhu Tian becoming overambitious and attacking the Human Race, he wouldn't dare with me present."
