```
"The East Sea Dragon Clan doesn't need to join the Demon Nation. I heard that the chaos in the East Sea is not much better than that of the Demon Territory. If Xiao Ling were here, the East Sea would be her territory, so I won't intervene."
"Yes!"
The reassurances from Jiang Lianyi swept away the worries of the Phoenix Tribe and the Dragon Clan of the Demon Territory.
"I've heard there's a talented junior in the clan, named Jiang Shishi. Bring her to me; I want to take a look."
Jiang Lianyi recalled Lu Yang mentioning this junior when speaking of the Creation Ancient Land. The Immortal Sister had appraised her talent as passable.
For Immortal Sister to appraise her as passable meant it was a high evaluation.
Hearing the ancient ancestor mention his daughter, Clan Leader Jiang Xi's heart pounded excitedly.
Jiang Shishi could never have expected the ancient ancestor to take the initiative to seek her out. When she was brought to the Ancestral Hall and saw the ancient ancestor, she was completely bewildered.
Had it not been for her mother, Jiang Xi, who sent her a message to kneel and pay respects, she would have forgotten even that.
Jiang Lianyi examined Jiang Shishi, causing everyone to feel very tense.
"Not a bad seedling, just a bit rigid in her thinking. But that's not a big problem. I will personally mentor her."
Not to mention, it was imperative not to be outdone by Zhu Yunwu, who was raised by Zhu Tian.
And Jiang Lianyi was quite pleased with Jiang Shishi's talent; enough to consider her a worthy successor.
Afterwards, Jiang Lianyi listened to Jiang Mingzi's report on the Phoenix Tribe's journey of three hundred thousand years since her slumber. There had been difficulties and dangers, but also the emergence of geniuses. Jiang Mingzi narrated excitedly, and Jiang Lianyi listened quietly, occasionally interjecting with a knowing smile.
"Not bad, it seems the Phoenix Tribe has developed well. Now I can rest assured."
Jiang Lianyi got up to leave, startling Jiang Mingzi, who feared that the ancient ancestor might think the Phoenix Tribe had not developed well without her and would therefore disregard them.
"Ancient ancestor, please don't leave!"
"Ancient ancestor, please don't leave!"
People from the Phoenix Tribe kneeled as one, beseeching Jiang Lianyi to stay.
Jiang Lianyi turned back helplessly, "I have just awakened and haven't yet had a chance to see this new world. I'm just stepping out for a walk."
"Oh."
Jiang Mingzi stood up, embarrassed.
Jiang Lianyi heaved a sigh of relief, having found a legitimate excuse.
Having been mentored by Fairy Eternity and always hanging around with her, Jiang Lianyi was not someone who liked to stay in one place. Asking her to stay in the Phoenix Tribe indefinitely was harder than killing her.
She left the Ancestral Hall and leaped up, merging with Lu Yang who was sitting in the clouds.
"Senior Brother, shall we return to the Seek Dao Sect? Immortal Sister told me that the Sect has a female major demon, whose strength matches that of Immortal Sister. Once she regains her power, the three of us will confront the female major demon together!"
Lu Yang: "..."
Is it still possible to quit the Immortal Lineage now?
```

chapters.title: Chapter 625 - 624 Changes in the Nascent Soul Stage
chapters.content:
On the way to Great Xia, as everyone was resting, Lu Yang finally found the time to apprehend the mysteries of the Nascent Soul Stage.
Ever since his breakthrough in the Nascent Soul Stage at the Heavenly Altar, there had been a series of continuous events, leaving him no time to properly study.
"The power of space..."
Lu Yang stretched out his hand, and the space in his palm slightly twisted, tearing, stretching, and deforming, forming a vortex-like shape.
One of the characteristics of the Nascent Soul Stage is the preliminary mastery of spatial power.
Storage Rings are the most typical spatial magic artifacts. To craft a Storage Ring, one's cultivation level must be at the Nascent Soul Stage at a minimum; to control even bigger spaces, one would need powers of the Divinity Transformation Stage or Body Integration Realm.
For instance, Seek Dao Sect's Identity Jades are a special type of Storage Ring, all crafted by the Fifth Elder.
Before Eldest Senior Sister gave him the Green Peak Sword, the most valuable magic artifact Lu Yang possessed was the Identity Jade.
He felt that his speed, strength, agility, and Spiritual Sense had all undergone earth-shattering changes.
That so-called number one genius of Great Xia, when compared to him, was nothing special!
Lu Yang also discovered that his Spiritual Space had expanded more than tenfold, comparable to a football field—this was the spiritual strength exclusive to the Divinity Transformation Stage.
If he wished, he could crush all cultivators at the Nascent Soul Stage with just his Spiritual Sense attacks—dazing them at the least, or reducing them to idiocy at the worst.
Lu Yang slowly closed his eyes, concentrated his thoughts, and softly exclaimed, "Astral projection!"
His body remained as his Soul ventured outside, feeling a cool breeze. This was the omnipresent sinister wind that only Souls could perceive. For Souls with an unstable foundation, it was a disaster. For Lu Yang's Soul, however, the sinister wind was merely a somewhat cool breeze with no threat.
In the state of Astral Projection, his sensory abilities escalated even further.
Astral Projection was another characteristic of the Nascent Soul Stage, although Lu Yang had managed it during the Foundation Establishment Stage.
Back then, after killing the Tiger Demon and acquiring the magic skill to command ghost servants from it, he cultivated this skill, enabling his Soul to act as a ghost servant, achieving Astral Projection.
However, at that time, his Soul was too fragile, susceptible to injury from even the slightest disturbance. Severe cases could even damage his foundation, which is why Lu Yang had since refrained from employing this technique.
Hence, for a cultivator to possess another, two essential conditions must be met. One is a cultivation level reaching at least the Nascent Soul Stage; the other is compliance with the "Possession Laws," which require a procedural approval before possessing.
"They say Astral Projection can allow one's Soul to travel thousands of miles, to face the vast sea in the morning and the Cangwu trees by dusk. It's time to give it a try."
Lu Yang laughed excitedly. His Soul completely left his body, sprinting forward at full strength to see how far he could fly.
Then, he watched, eyes wide open, as his physical body meditated among the clouds, growing increasingly distant.
The Auspicious Cloud was navigated by Jiang Lianyi, moving surprisingly fast, not something Lu Yang's Soul could match in its Astral Projection flight speed.
"Hey—wait for me!" Lu Yang's Soul hastily shouted.
"You rascal."
Getting wind of Lu Yang's odd behavior, the Grand Elder chuckled and pulled his Soul back.
Lu Yang, a little embarrassed, scratched the back of his head and chuckled foolishly as he continued to observe the changes within him.
Looking inward at himself, in the area of his Dantian, he found the chubby white Nascent Soul and Fairy Eternity beside it, laughing heartily to the point of tears.
"Hahahaha, to dare leave your body in Soul form while Lianyi navigates the cloud! Aren't you afraid she might leave you behind!"
Lu Yang glowered, not wanting to be laughed at by Fairy Eternity, "Fairy, what are you doing in my Dantian?"
"What kind of question is that? Is it any of your business where this Fairy is?" retorted Fairy Eternity hands-on-hips. With Lu Yang's body being so vast, where couldn't she go?
"Let's not talk about that. Take a look at your Nascent Soul. Doesn't it resemble me a bit?"
Lu Yang rolled his eyes, feeling the Fairy was spouting nonsense: "How's that possible? My Nascent Soul naturally looks like me... Damn it, how come it really does look a bit like you!"
The Nascent Soul was white and chubby, and its eyebrows resembled those of Fairy Eternity—it was extremely adorable.
What was this situation?!
"You've forgotten. When I was the Acting Sect Master, and you handled the Sect affairs for me, I assisted in your cultivation."
"In other words, a part of your Golden Core Stage cultivation was actually cultivated by me."
"It's only natural for the Nascent Soul to bear a semblance to me."
Lu Yang: "..."
"If I'd known it would be like this, I wouldn't have let you cultivate for me no matter what. You should've handled the sect affairs yourself."
But now, it's too late to say anything.
"What is the use of this Nascent Soul?"
Lu Yang had heard that the Nascent Soul Stage is infinitely mysterious, not to mention the power of space and astral projection, but the most crucial aspect is the Nascent Soul itself.
The quality of the Golden Core and the cultivation method during the Golden Core Stage will directly determine the strength of the Nascent Soul.
Considering that Fairy Eternity, a senior cultivator, was present, it was more convenient to ask directly.
When this topic came up, Fairy Eternity chuckled with pride.
"This Nascent Soul is formed from the shattering of the Invincible Elixir, the essence of the Invincible Elixir is concentrated in this infant (Nascent Soul)!"
"Therefore, your Nascent Soul is quite different from ordinary Nascent Souls. Other cultivators at the Nascent Soul Stage have to sacrifice their Nascent Soul and control it to fight."
"Theoretically, when you're at the Nascent Soul Stage and sacrifice your Nascent Soul, it can fight on its own."
"That smart?" Lu Yang was startled. It was as if he had two selves. When using the Wooden Avatar, he would no longer need to divide his attention to control it, and could fight two battles at the same time.
This truly meant doubling one's combat power!
My painstaking efforts to maintain a 100% win rate during the Golden Core Stage were not in vain!
"That's why I have named this type of Nascent Soul 'Invincible Nascent Soul'!"
"...Is it possible to change the name?"
"No!" Fairy Eternity was firm in her stance.
"Alright then."
"The Invincible Nascent Soul is formidable, but there's a prerequisite if you want the Invincible Elixir to fight for you."
"What's the prerequisite?"
"That is, you need to defeat your Nascent Soul."
"???"
Lu Yang was full of question marks.
But considering his unparalleled combat power, defeating his own Nascent Soul should not be difficult.
"Would you like to give it a try?" Fairy Eternity suggested.
"Let's try!"
Fairy Eternity pulled Lu Yang's soul and Nascent Soul into the Spiritual Space and instructed Lu Yang, "Feel carefully, do you and your Nascent Soul seem to be connected by an invisible thread?"
"There is such a feeling."
"Cut off this thread!"
"You have to use your imagination, imagine there really is this thread, and you have a pair of scissors in your hand that can cut off the thread!"
Lu Yang followed Fairy Eternity's instructions step by step and cut off the connection with his Nascent Soul.
The moment the connection was severed, the Nascent Soul opened its eyes and charged at Lu Yang ferociously.
"Such speed!" Lu Yang exclaimed. "But still not a match for me!"
Half a moment later, Lu Yang was lying on the ground, pinned and pounded by the Nascent Soul, looking up at Fairy Eternity with his last breath.
"Fairy, why is this Nascent Soul so strong?"
Fairy Eternity nodded as if it were a matter of course:
"Didn't I tell you? This is the Invincible Nascent Soul. If it can even beat you, isn't that invincible?"

chapters.title: Chapter 626 - 625: Elder Brother Dai, We Need to Report Some Situations to You
chapters.content:
Lu Yang felt that Fairy Eternity made a lot of sense, but upon careful consideration, he always felt something was off.
Fairy Eternity continued to explain the principle of the Invincible Nascent Soul to Lu Yang, "The Invincible Nascent Soul is a part of you; it knows all the moves you do, and it doesn't know the ones you don't."
"The Invincible Nascent Soul can't think for itself; it only makes the best choices based on instinct."
"The difference between you and it is that it can choose the most suitable moment to use the most appropriate move with the most suitable power, whereas you fall short in all these aspects."
"In other words, the Invincible Nascent Soul is your strongest state."
"To defeat the Invincible Nascent Soul, you must break through your limits and surpass your Nascent Soul in every aspect!"
"...Fairy, could you stop talking about this for now, and could you stop the Nascent Soul from hitting me?"
Lu Yang was at his wit's end, being hit by the Nascent Soul while listening to Fairy Eternity's lecture!
"Use your imagination. Just reconnect that broken thread, and you'll be fine."
Lu Yang had no choice but to endure the beating while closing his eyes, imagining the thread reconnected and establishing a connection with the Invincible Nascent Soul. Only then did the Invincible Nascent Soul stop its attack and enter a dormant state.
Lu Yang looked at his Nascent Soul, his heart still racing. If it were not for being in the Spiritual Space, he would have been beaten to a pulp by the Nascent Soul, seriously injured and unable to get up.
"So while other cultivators at the Nascent Soul Stage can control their Nascent Souls in combat, until I can defeat the Invincible Nascent Soul, I can only fight by myself?"
"That's not exactly true. Let me ask you, what is the definition of a Nascent Soul?"
Lu Yang thought for a moment and said, "Born in the dantian, resembling a baby, composed of pure and turbid qi, possessing great power, and having the ability to possess others."
"Immortals have infinite lifespans, and I am only sixteen, no different from a baby. My soul is also composed of pure and turbid qi, and my strength needs no mention, on par with Miss Yun. I can also possess you."
"According to this definition, when I am in your dantian, I am your Nascent Soul."
"In other words, you have dual Nascent Souls."
"If I am in a good mood, I might help you in battle."
Lu Yang: "..."
Fairy, I appreciate your kind intentions, but please just lie down peacefully in the Spiritual Space and don't cause any trouble.
"So this Invincible Nascent Soul is completely useless now?"
"Not exactly. 'Unable to defeat' is one thing, but the Invincible Nascent Soul is still a part of you; if you died, it would cease to exist. If you were to encounter an enemy you can't defeat..."
Lu Yang was delighted, "The Invincible Nascent Soul will help me deal with them?"
"It will separate from your body and run away as fast as possible."
"..."
Lu Yang painfully massaged his brow, only to realize that rubbing the brow of a soul body was useless.
Meng Jingzhou saw Lu Yang deeply engrossed in researching the changes of the Nascent Soul Stage and felt extremely envious and covetous.
It was Lu Yang who had found the Phoenix Ancestor, Lu Yang who had made a splash, and Lu Yang who had formed the Nascent Soul. It seemed like he had been just a spectator throughout their journey in the Demon Territory!
Lu Yang opened his eyes and saw Meng Jingzhou's resentful expression. He guessed Meng Jingzhou's thoughts at a glance and consoled him thoughtfully, "You need to look on the bright side—now that I've reached the Nascent Soul Stage, the title of the strongest Golden Core Stage falls to you. Doesn't that make you feel much better when you think about it?"
Meng Jingzhou nodded subconsciously, then suddenly realized something was wrong.
"Nonsense, even when you were at the Golden Core Stage, I could still beat you!"
Lu Yang shook his head, "I don't believe it, unless we have a fight right now. If you can defeat me, I'll admit you're the strongest at the Golden Core Stage."
"Where's your face?"
The two of them bickered and squabbled, finally arriving at the borders of Great Xia.
To enter the Great Xia border, one needed to verify their identity, go through a security check to prevent carrying items that didn't comply with regulations—like in the early days of Great Xia's establishment when the systems were imperfect, a cultivator stole a large amount of sea water from the East Sea.
Therefore, Jiang Lianyi decisively chose to stealthily cross the national border.
Her identity was too sensitive, and once exposed at the border, she could imagine the ensuing chaos without needing to elaborate, fearing that the entire city would be disturbed. People would rush over to gawk at her as if she were some rare animal, which she found exceedingly annoying.
Moreover, as one of the Heavenly Court's Four Imperial Protectors, her appearance with the Seek Dao Sect would reveal their identities as well.
After sneaking across, Jiang Lianyi sped up her journey, smoothly arriving at the Seek Dao Sect.
"Not a bad place."
Jiang Lianyi commented. The Seek Dao Sect's territory was vast, guarded by a Sect Protection Array at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage level, and the spiritual essence was extraordinarily abundant, appearing to be almost on par with the power of the Phoenix Tribe.
With five Elders vouching for her, River Spirit let her in without checking her identity.
It was only after entering the Sect that Jiang Lianyi truly felt surprised.
Talents abounded, far surpassing what the Phoenix Tribe could compare with.
In ancient times, tribes were established with bloodlines as the bond, whether it was the Human race or the Demon Race; Sects emerged after the end of the ancient era, and Jiang Lianyi had not seen Sects before.
She hadn't paid much attention when Lu Yang had introduced them before, but now that she saw them in person, she realized she had underestimated the concept of a Sect.
Why the Demon Race revered pure blood was ultimately because it symbolized strength. Each race devoted itself to cultivating pure-blooded members of the Demon Race, maximizing the potential within their bloodlines.
The Sects, on the other hand, focused not on bloodlines but on talent, teaching students in accordance with their aptitude, each with their own strengths, which was clearly much more advanced than the way of the Demon Race.
"Little Dai must still be waiting for us to bring back intelligence on the Demon Nation. Little Lu and Little Meng, you both understand the situation there better, so go and report to Little Dai."
After entering the Sect, the five Elders were in high spirits, looking for the other three Elders to show off their experiences in the Demon Territory.
They were extremely pleased with themselves for not having missed out on this trip.
By the time Lu Yang came to his senses, only he, Third Senior Sister, Meng Jingzhou, and Jiang Lianyi were left on the spot.
"Third Senior Sister, would you take Elder Lianyi to visit Sky Gate Mountain?"
"Sure."
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou entered the Task Hall, navigating their way to Elder Brother Dai's office like old hands.
The two of them often made outstanding contributions to uphold justice, and Dai Bufan praised their character endlessly, giving them special permission to visit him directly without needing to report first.
Knock, knock, knock, Lu Yang knocked on the door politely.
"Come in," Dai Bufan's voice came from the room.
Dai Bufan was in a good mood. Recently there had been a decrease in Demon Path activities, giving him a much easier time. He sat in his chair, humming a tune.
He then saw Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou entering the room.
"Oh, it's you two. Hasn't it been over half a year since I've seen you? I heard that Junior Sister Gan Tian invited you two to the Demon Territory. Judging by the time, you must have just caught the Demon Nation's founding celebration. Did you come back after viewing the celebration? You've been quite quick."
He was waiting for a report from the Grand Elder concerning the Demon Territory, not expecting the Grand Elder didn't arrive, but Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou returned first. He guessed the Master and others were slacking off, making the two youngsters report to him instead.
"Yes, we accompanied Third Senior Sister in the Demon Territory and learned a lot, gaining some insights. Just now, the Grand Elder told us to report the events of the Demon Territory to Elder Brother."
Dai Bufan laughed a couple of times, not taking it too seriously, and casually asked, "Then tell me, what did you see in the Demon Territory? Did you meet the legendary Ancient Emperor Jiang Zhu Tian, Venerate Zhu Tian?"
"We did meet him," they replied.
"How was he? Did he look quite impressive?"
Lu Yang candidly relayed, "It was like this: I awakened the Phoenix Ancestor Jiang Lianyi and even brought her into the Heavenly Court Sect. Elder Lianyi and I attended the founding ceremony, and she also took the opportunity to reprimand Venerate Zhu Tian, resulting in a battle of Semi-Immortals. Additionally, six Transcendance Tribulation Stage Demon Emperors also joined the fight."
On hearing this, Dai Bufan silently stood up, stepped aside, and with a gesture of invitation, said:
"Come, Junior Brother Lu, from now on, you are the Hall Master of the Task Hall."

chapters.title: Chapter 627 - 626: A Draw
chapters.content:
"And you, Junior Brother Meng, no, Vice Hall Master Meng, the Task Hall shall be left to the two of you to be responsible for."
Dai Bufan felt he couldn't keep up with the changing times and was at the age of retirement; it was time to step down and let more capable hands take the lead.
Two years ago, before he had met Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, he thought he was doing well for his age, being an early-stage Unification cultivator with a bright future ahead.
During his tenure overseeing the Task Hall, he was able to deduce the desired intelligence from intricate and subtle matters, unravel complex issues to reveal the truth, and issue tasks that not only punished evil and promoted good but also served to train junior brothers and sisters. To say he was the backbone of the Seek Dao Sect would not be an exaggeration.
Now, he felt like he was no backbone at all, completely unable to cope with the affairs of these two!
Your first trip out, you both joined the Eternity Sect, and then the Eternity Sect was annihilated.
On your second trip out, you discovered that Junior Brother Li Haoran was the reincarnation of the former Master of the Jiuyou Sect.
The third time you went out, you created the Heavenly Court Sect and reached a deep cooperation with the Jiuyou Sect.
On your fourth expedition, you encountered a Transcendency Tribulation Stage Great Yu Cultivator at the Qingzhou festival, prompting the Eldest Senior Sister to take action.
The fifth time you went out, you ran into three Great Yu Cultivators in Hanshui City, all at the Transcendency Tribulation Stage, and you even captured all three of them.
Then, on your sixth outing, you went ahead and resurrected the legendary Phoenix Ancestor, causing a commotion at the Demon Nation's founding ceremony.
I clearly heard you two were just helping Junior Sister Gan Tian with an archaeological investigation; how did you manage to dig up the Phoenix Ancestor while at it?
I can't even begin to imagine what you'll get up to the next time you leave!
The legendary Semi-Immortal, and just by taking a trip, you actually resurrected them and triggered the Battle of Semi-Immortals?!
A battle involving six Transcendency Tribulation cultivators and two Semi-Immortals was something Dai Bufan had never witnessed in his life, yet not only did you see it, you were the main causes of it!
"No, no, no, that won't do at all!" Lu Yang waved his hands repeatedly, rejecting Dai Bufan's suggestion.
"Sit down. I'll talk to our master, he'll definitely agree!"
"No way, no way, I'm of low status, with cultivation too weak to bear such a responsibility!"
Meng Jingzhou also spoke up in support of Lu Yang: "Yes, indeed, he can't be the Task Hall Master. He's the Young Sect Master of the Heavenly Court Sect, and Elder Brother of Elder Lianyi. Elder Lianyi is right here in our sect, and if she finds out about this, she definitely won't agree."
Dai Bufan abruptly turned his head to look at Meng Jingzhou, his eyes full of astonishment and confusion, as if he were listening to a myth.
What exactly did you guys do in the Demon Territory?
He placed his hands firmly on Lu Yang's shoulders and pressed him back down into his seat.
Elder Brother Dai, with a smile brimming on his face and a gentle tone in his voice, personally served Lu Yang tea and water.
"Come, Hall Master Lu, tell us about your experiences in the Demon Territory."
The two of them took turns asking and adding details about their experiences in the Demon Territory, of course, omitting the presence of Fairy Eternity, suggesting it was just Lu Yang's luck to successfully navigate the Creation Ancient Land and awaken Jiang Lianyi.
Dai Bufan painfully tapped his forehead, unable to comprehend their outlandish experiences.
"So you're saying that in essence, the Demon Nation already belongs to the Heavenly Court Sect?"
"That's one way to understand it."
"..."
"Elder Brother Dai, if there's nothing else, we'll take our leave," Lu Yang cautiously said, taking the opportunity while Elder Brother Dai was tapping his forehead to quickly exit the Task Hall with Meng Jingzhou.
Meanwhile, Elder Brother Dai had not yet recovered from the shock of the information.
The two men parted at the entrance of the Task Hall and returned to their respective peaks.
Upon his return, Meng Jingzhou was ready to breakthrough to the Nascent Soul Stage.
Back in his abode, he saw Old Ma leisurely munching on grass at the entrance, content as could be.
"Old Ma, I'm back from the Demon Territory. You really missed out by not going this time, the trip was incredibly rewarding!"
He didn't care whether Old Ma wanted to listen or not and went on to regale him with his experiences in the Demon Territory over the past six months.
After hearing everything, Old Ma was filled with regret, hating himself for being timid and afraid, for not witnessing the battle of the Semi-Immortal himself.
If only he had known he would have the Phoenix Ancestor's support, what was there to fear? He could have swept through the Demon Territory with ease.
He couldn't allow this to happen again; next time, he must follow this lad and see the world!
...
"I wonder if Elder Lianyi has met Eldest Senior Sister yet," Lu Yang was a bit worried.
Lu Yang made his way up the mountain with familiarity and reached the peak, only to find a worried Third Senior Sister, without sight of the Eldest Senior Sister and Jiang Lianyi.
The Third Senior Sister was sitting at a stone table, her fingers crossed and thumbs twirling around each other, clearly anxious and concerned.
"Third Senior Sister, where are the Eldest Senior Sister and Elder Lianyi?"
"Oh, it's Junior Brother. Just a moment ago, I don't know what came over her, but Elder Lianyi wanted to test Eldest Senior Sister's skills as soon as she met her. Eldest Senior Sister readily agreed."
"Considering that sparring might cause too much commotion, they went to the alternative space Eldest Senior Sister had created to fight. I've been waiting here ever since."
Lu Yang gasped, Elder Lianyi, you really are bold, challenging the Eldest Senior Sister as soon as you arrive.
"Third Senior Sister, are you worried that Eldest Senior Sister might lose?"
Third Senior Sister sighed and gestured for Lu Yang to sit. Then, she shared her concern: "I'm worried that Elder Lianyi, having just come into this world, might suffer a collapse of her Dao-heart upon defeat."
"Eldest Senior Sister never knew how to hold back in a fight. Just from what I know, quite a few of our seniors have suffered a collapse of their Dao-heart due to her, and it took them hundreds of years to recover their spiritual will."
"How did they manage to recover?" Lu Yang asked curiously; it was the first time he had heard that a Dao-heart could heal, albeit the cost was drastic, requiring hundreds of years.
"They suppress their cultivation level and pretend to be juniors, swaggering among the young, often allowing others to mock them for their low realm or poor talent, and having no hope in this life. Then they would find the strength to fight back, revealing a portion of their true power and striking back at their detractors."
Starting from the Qi Cultivation Stage, they'd join a small sect. Once they reached the Foundation Establishment Stage and the sect began limiting their growth, they'd move on to a mid-size sect for cultivation, and so on through the Golden Core Stage, Nascent Soul Stage… They'd repeat the process I just mentioned throughout their cultivation journey."
"And believe it or not, this method is quite effective. There were even some seniors who found companions through this and ended up, well, a May-December romance, getting happily married and experiencing a second spring in their lives. Their mental state turned younger than before, and with the power of love, they even improved in strength."
Lu Yang: "..."
So the seniors spent hundreds of years just showing off and slapping faces, huh.
As they spoke, the space above them warped, and Jiang Lianyi, in human form, fell from the sky, smashed into the ground, and kicked up a cloud of dust.
Lu Yang and the Third Senior Sister hurried over to check the situation.
They saw that Jiang Lianyi's breath had ceased, with no signs of life, clearly dead beyond doubt.
"Elder Lianyi, are you alright?"
Revived by Lu Yang's concern, Jiang Lianyi abruptly sat up, her heart still pounding with fright.
"That was close, I had no idea there would be such a powerful junior in the future."
"Luckily, I committed suicide before my defeat and ended the fight, so I could barely claim a draw with her!"

chapters.title: Chapter 628 - 627 Another Hidden Enemy
chapters.content:
Jiang Lianyi reminisced about the battle he had just fought, feeling it was both thrilling and extremely dangerous:
"Worthy of being the master of our sect, indeed powerful."
"Just now, I battled with Sect Leader Yun in an alternative space, exchanging hundreds of moves within a few breaths' time, and it was difficult to distinguish the victor, the intricacies involving mind games and tactics are too complex to explain clearly in a short time!"
"Sect Leader Yun's moves were fierce, fully demonstrating the elegance of later generations. Many say that the present can't compare with the past, but in my opinion, that's a big mistake. Sect Leader Yun, as a pinnacle figure of the latter era, has proven everything!"
"The two of us fought fiercely, shattering the space, shaking time itself, and chaos qi spread everywhere."
"I originally planned to use the Phoenix Rebirth Technique to unleash my potential for an ultimate showdown with Sect Leader Yun, but sadly, the gateway to the alternative space opened, and I accidentally fell through. The battle ended without a clear winner, so it could only be counted as a draw!"
Lu Yang: "..."
Third Senior Sister: "..."
Lu Yang felt that given Elder Lianyi's mentality, even if he lost, his Dao heart wouldn't collapse.
Fairy Eternity was very pleased with Jiang Lianyi's battle achievements: "Worthy of being an unregistered disciple of mine, being able to use such a method to maintain the win rate at the critical moment shows promising talent, with a bright future ahead!"
"For me to fight Sect Leader Yun to a draw, and then have you and the Second-in-command assist me later, the scales of victory will surely tip in my favor!"
It should be noted that in a battle between equals, any small change can alter the outcome of the fight!
Eldest Senior Sister flew out of the alternative space and upon hearing Jiang Lianyi's description of the battle, she felt somewhat helpless.
Wasn't it you who said you wanted to show me some ancient divine abilities, and then took the initiative in attacking, casting over a hundred spells within a few breaths' time? And after I blocked them, I launched an offensive, and you immediately used the Playing Dead Technique to escape the alternative space, right?
"Eldest Senior Sister." Lu Yang greeted obediently.
"Reached the Nascent Soul Stage? Not bad; your foundation is solid.
Despite having just made your breakthrough, there's no need to solidify your foundation, which is indeed worthy of someone who had the Invincible Elixir as a foundation." Eldest Senior Sister nodded; Lu Yang was making rapid progress in his cultivation, which showed he hadn't been negligent in his training while in the Demon Territory for the past half-year.
"Third Junior Sister, the Sixth Elder has been missing you all this time. Now that you're back at the sect, you'd better go see her and not wait for the elder to come looking for you, which would disrupt the proprieties."
"Alright." In front of Eldest Senior Sister, Third Senior Sister lost the lawless demeanor she had in the Demon Territory and was well-behaved, doing whatever Eldest Senior Sister told her to.
After Third Senior Sister descended the mountain, Eldest Senior Sister gestured for Lu Yang to sit down, and Jiang Lianyi was also invited not to sit on the ground but to take a seat on a stone chair.
"Eldest Senior Sister, these are special products I brought back from the Demon Territory."
Lu Yang, like someone presenting treasures, took out four imperial chairs from his Identity Jade, which Elder Zhu Tian had insisted on giving him before he left the Demon Nation.
The atmosphere instantly changed when the stone chairs were replaced with imperial chairs.
"Junior Brother, Immortal Eternity, what did you do in the Demon Territory, and how did Elder Lianyi come back to life?"
Eldest Senior Sister asked with a tone of resignation. Honestly, she was quite taken aback when Third Senior Sister showed up with Jiang Lianyi.
One needn't think hard to realize that this matter had something to do with Junior Brother and Immortal Eternity.
Fairy Eternity emerged and assumed a half-kneeling posture to take a seat.
A human, a demon, and a ghost detailed their experiences in the Demon Territory, especially focusing on the discoveries about the world's structure and the Recording Orb left by the Qilin Immortal, as well as the identity of the mastermind behind the scenes during the battle of the four immortals.
Upon hearing this, Eldest Senior Sister remained silent for a long while – a truly unexpected gain this time.
"The battle between Immortals cannot be decided in a short time, especially since the hidden manipulator is suspected of possessing the Causality Dao Fruit, making them even more difficult to deal with. But to be able to fight the Four Ancient Immortals for seven days and nights without a victor, it seems that the manipulator's strength is even greater than I had anticipated."
Fairy Eternity nodded, "That's what I was thinking too."
Then she spoke with indignation, "That Qilin Immortal kid, who knows what he's scheming, or perhaps he's fallen asleep? Lianyi has caused such a commotion in the Demon Nation, yet there's no sign of him."
This was also one of the reasons why Jiang Lianyi made a public appearance at the founding ceremony of the Demon Nation.
Her standing upon the Heavenly Altar meant that Fairy Eternity had been resurrected, a message she intended to convey to the Qilin Immortal. Yet even so, the Qilin Immortal still had not shown himself, indicating that his current situation was very complicated.
Either he was in a deep sleep for some reason, or he was unable to or should not meet Fairy Eternity.
In the Recording Orb, the Qilin Immortal spoke with brimming confidence, 'The enemy is too dangerous, leave everything to me. My wife, you will definitely meet Fairy Eternity, I'm happy for your resurrection, Fairy Eternity.'
It's possible that right after the Qilin Immortal boasted those fierce words, he was secretly attacked by the hidden manipulator.
Eldest Senior Sister gently shook her head, "In fact, there is another possibility, isn't there? It's just that neither of you is willing to think in that direction."
Lu Yang was puzzled and looked at Eldest Senior Sister with incomprehension.
In contrast, Fairy Eternity and Jiang Lianyi's faces looked somewhat troubled.
Eldest Senior Sister continued, "The Qilin Immortal might have perished, the suppression disappeared, and some Semi-Immortal took this opportunity to become an Immortal, re-establishing the suppression."
Lu Yang's heart skipped a beat, that was indeed a possibility. Then a question arose, "But isn't it said that the ascension to Immortality makes a grand commotion that cannot be concealed? Could no one have noticed a Semi-Immortal becoming an Immortal?"
"The ascension to Immortality does indeed cause a big scene, but it's not impossible to hide. For example, one could use the chaos of a battle between two armies or the tumult of a Semi-Immortal in combat to cover up the trials of ascension. Someone became an Immortal using this method a hundred thousand years ago."
"However, the probability of the Qilin Immortal falling is very small. After all, the characteristics of the Qilin Immortal's Dao Fruit make it extremely difficult for him to be killed. If such a high-level battle took place, the ancient texts would have a record of it."
Hearing what Eldest Senior Sister said, Fairy Eternity and Jiang Lianyi's expressions eased slightly.
Eldest Senior Sister added, "Based on Elder Lianyi's account of the battle of the Four Ancient Immortals, it leads to another question. Do you remember the Immortal who was preparing to pluck the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit?"
Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity nodded, of course, they remembered. After the birth of Immortal Eternity, a shadow lurked beside Immortal Eternity, intent on plucking the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit. Then Eldest Senior Sister noticed, eradicated the shadow, and found it to be a thing similar to an Immortal's clone.
Eldest Senior Sister felt the experience was familiar, recalling that she had once clashed with the shadow's true body, which had infiltrated Great Xia and was repelled by Yun Zhi.
"The opponent is undoubtedly an Immortal, but definitely not at the level capable of battling the Four Ancient Immortals for seven days and nights."
"Did he hide his strength?" Lu Yang speculated.
Eldest Senior Sister shook her head, "I would be able to sense if he were hiding his true power; that was his genuine level."
"Could it be that he was recovering from a severe injury?"
"That's also unlikely, no injury requires three hundred thousand years to heal. When I fought him, I didn't feel he was wounded."
Lu Yang furrowed his brow, this meant that besides the hidden manipulator, there was another concealed enemy.
Even if they were not as strong as the hidden manipulator, they were still of the Immortal level, not to be underestimated—a troubling realization.
...wait a minute, why am I subconsciously considering him an enemy? I am only at the Nascent Soul Stage, do I even qualify?
Lu Yang realized something was amiss—when had his perspective become so high?

chapters.title: Chapter 629 - 628: The Great Commotion of Breaking Through to the Nascent Soul Stage
chapters.content:
Lu Yang realized that his mindset had become somewhat ungrounded recently and forced himself to rapidly cool down and assess his combat strength.
As the strongest Golden Core Stage cultivator to advance to the Nascent Soul Stage, capable of challenging opponents above his level, he was not incapable of fighting against those in the early stages of Spirit Transformation, especially if he added his wits to the equation; he might even be able to overcome early-stage Spirit Transformers.
This meant that he possessed the combat strength of an early-stage Spirit Transformer.
Furthermore, by invoking divine possession, seeking help from Fairy Eternity, and using the Imitation Fist technique taught by his Eldest Senior Sister to summon her, he could increase his combat strength to a whole new level.
All these advantages combined, he could indeed hold his own against an Immortal.
"Elder Lianyi, would you be interested in becoming a guest cultivator of our Seek Dao Sect?" the Eldest Senior Sister proactively invited.
"Become a guest cultivator of your Seek Dao Sect?" Jiang Lianyi wore a strange expression. As the true ruler of the Demon Nation and Phoenix Ancestor, the foremost figure below Immortals, and having just fought you to a standstill, her status stood clear; how could she join your Seek Dao Sect?
Moreover, she hadn't yet heard what benefits came with being a guest cultivator of the Seek Dao Sect, nor what obligations it entailed.
The Eldest Senior Sister paused, then added, "Immortal Sister is the first guest cultivator of our Seek Dao Sect."
"Such a sincere invitation is difficult to decline!"
A smile appeared at the corner of the Eldest Senior Sister's mouth. "Then let us welcome Elder Lianyi to the Seek Dao Sect."
"Elder Lianyi will be the second guest cultivator of our Seek Dao Sect. However, since Elder Lianyi's public identity is one of the Four Imperial Protectors of the Heavenly Court, openly joining our Seek Dao Sect could lead to speculation about the relationship between the Heavenly Court and our sect, so we kindly ask that Elder Lianyi keep her guest status confidential."
"That makes sense. So what are the benefits of joining your Seek Dao Sect, and what exactly would I need to do? For instance, is there a requirement for how long I need to stay with the Seek Dao Sect?"
"Having you as a guest cultivator is already an honor for the Seek Dao Sect; we wouldn't dare to restrict your freedom. However, should the Seek Dao Sect face danger in the future, we hope that as a guest cultivator you could lend a hand."
"In return, should you take a fancy to something from the Seek Dao Sect, just let me know, and I shall gift it to you. You will also have access to places like the Scripture Pavilion."
Jiang Lianyi thought it over; she didn't consider it a loss, and Immortal Sister was also a guest cultivator.
If she managed to find Ao Ling and he became a guest cultivator of the Seek Dao Sect, then he would also have to address her respectfully as Senior Sister.
It was a clear win-win.
As for the offerings of the Seek Dao Sect, she had no interest in them at the moment.
The Scripture Pavilion was a good place; it held the densest concentration of knowledge in the Cultivation World, and was worth a look.
"What does Elder Lianyi plan to do next?"
Jiang Lianyi thought for a moment and spoke seriously, "This world thirty thousand years in the future is unknown to me, so I plan to explore this unfamiliar Cultivation World and search for clues about my husband and Xiao Ling. If I could also find clues about the other three Immortals, that would be even better."
"That is how it should be."
The Eldest Senior Sister took out a jade token and offered it to Jiang Lianyi.
"What is this?"
"A map of the Cultivation World; there may be slight discrepancies in the details, but the overall layout should be correct."
Jiang Lianyi did not hesitate, "Then I thank the Master for this."
It would seem distant to decline amongst one's own, after all.
"As for Junior Brother Lu, now that you have stepped into the Nascent Soul Stage, you should devote yourself to composing the Nascent Soul Stage section of the 'Mind Seeing Method.' I shall review it afterward."
Lu Yang suddenly felt immense pressure and his head began to ache; his heart, which had warmed up since his return from the Demon Territory, chilled once more.
I'll have to write down the cultivation techniques; I'm afraid I won't be able to leave the Scripture Pavilion for the next month.
"Do you want to go to the Scripture Pavilion with me, Elder Lianyi?" Lu Yang, seeing that Jiang Lianyi seemed interested in going to the Scripture Pavilion, took the initiative to invite her.
"That sounds good."
The Eldest Senior Sister casually wrote a note and handed it to Jiang Lianyi, "Show this note to the person guarding the entrance of the Scripture Pavilion, and they will let you in."
Before Jiang Lianyi descended the mountain, she altered her appearance to prevent other members of the Dao Seeking Sect from recognizing her.
The two descended the mountain and saw many disciples of the Dao Seeking Sect running in one direction, seemingly to join in the excitement.
"Is that... the direction of Old Meng's abode?"
Lu Yang remembered that Old Meng said he was going to break core to reach Nascent, fearing that he was now having a breakthrough to the Nascent Soul Stage.
He changed his mind on the spot and headed for Old Meng's abode.
Arriving later than others, Lu Yang saw Meng Jingzhou's abode crowded with many senior brothers, senior sisters, junior brothers, and junior sisters waiting to witness the spectacle. Lu Yang and Jiang Lianyi could only stand at the back.
Jiang Lianyi had a good impression of this little fellow who had been with Lu Yang all along, possessing Nirvana True Fire and such exuberant Yang Qi that even the Phoenix Tribe, famous for its pure Yang, couldn't compare with him.
Outside Meng Jingzhou's abode, one marvel after another unfolded: endless swirls of purple Qi circling the mountain peak, golden lotuses bursting forth from the ground and taking root, and Arhats' illusory shadows chanting scriptures among a series of other phenomena, creating a far greater commotion than when Lu Yang made his breakthrough to the Nascent Soul stage.
No wonder so many people rushed over to watch.
Countless senior brothers and sisters pointed and admired the spectacle, marveling at Meng Jingzhou's talent.
"Look, the purple Qi is enshrouding; that's the Purple Qi Talisman that costs ten thousand contribution points to exchange for one!"
"There's also the Falling Golden Lotus Talisman; a single golden lotus is worth five thousand contribution points, and it seems there are more than a hundred here!"
"And the Buddhist chants, the Arhat illusory shadows… my heavens, how many contribution points must have been spent?"
"Listen, there's the cry of a phoenix; could it be the mythical phoenix undergoing Nirvana?!"
In terms of financial strength, few in the Dao Seeking Sect could rival Meng Jingzhou. Even cultivators at the Divinity Transformation Stage expressed their astonishment, admitting that they would never dare to spend so extravagantly.
Lu Yang's eyes twitched slightly; he and Old Meng had originally planned to make a bit of a spectacle when breaking through to the Nascent Soul stage upon returning to the sect. After all, a cultivator only gets one chance in a lifetime to do it, so of course, they wanted to make it grand.
This was an inspiration he got from listening to Immortal Sister recount how Immortal Jiuchong achieved Immortality.
He just didn't expect that Old Meng would make such a big commotion.
Old Meng's talent was not much different from his own. The breakthrough to the Nascent Soul stage was just a matter of a moment's thought. The fact that the spectacle had been going on for half an hour and still no breakthrough had occurred, like constipation, could only mean one thing—he was waiting for the spectacle to nearly finish before he broke through.
No sooner had this thought crossed Lu Yang's mind than the phenomenon changed again. Arhats chanted sutras, their sonorous Buddhist scriptures capable of purifying the soul, and shadows of ancient ancestors appeared, forming a circle as if performing a sacred offering, kneeling before Meng Jingzhou's abode. A Great Power flicked a flower into a smile, providing a blessing…
The mighty aura of the Nascent Soul broke through the abode, piercing the heavens, and everyone present could feel the formidable presence of this Nascent Soul.
"Look, Junior Brother Meng has two Nascent Souls!"
Above the abode, two Nascent Souls bearing Meng Jingzhou's likeness were curled up, heads to feet, radiating supreme energy.
Gradually, the two Nascent Souls' rotation sped up, creating a perfect circle.
A senior brother watched the two Nascent Souls intently and slowly remarked, "It looks remarkably like the Tai Chi Diagram, with the two Nascent Souls rotating and a line that flows like water separating them in the middle, symbolizing one Yi Yang and one Lianyi!"
Lu Yang, "…"
Why is this the first time I'm hearing that the Tai Chi Diagram is one Yi Yang and one Lianyi.

chapters.title: Chapter 630 - 629 A Whole New Realm
chapters.content:
Lu Yang even suspected the Senior Brother who shouted Tai Chi Diagram was a shill hired by Old Meng.
Jiang Lianyi watched in amazement, she had witnessed many geniuses in Ancient Times and their cultivation philosophies, yet it was her first time hearing about the Tai Chi Diagram of Yi Yang, was this the cultivation philosophy of thirty thousand years later?
No wonder the current Phoenix Tribe wasn't doing as well as the Human race, their thinking wasn't as advanced as humans'.
The other phenomena were bought by Meng Jingzhou with money, but the Pure Yang Tai Chi Diagram formed by the two Nascent Souls was an authentic and genuine phenomenon.
Lu Yang felt relieved that he hadn't had any intentions when he formed his Nascent Soul, if there really had been a phenomenon, it probably would have been the Invincible Nascent beating himself up.
That would have been embarrassingly humiliating.
Oh no, wait, that would be Young Sect Master Lu making a fool of himself, nothing to do with him.
Jiang Lianyi pondered thoughtfully, noticing another difference in Meng Jingzhou, "It's my first time seeing someone with two Nascent Souls."
Lu Yang was curious, "Weren't there cultivators who refined two Nascent Souls in Ancient Times?"
Jiang Lianyi shook her head slightly, "During the Golden Core Stage, there were a few people who refined two Golden Cores, but those two Golden Cores had different properties. By the time they cultivated to the Nascent Soul Stage, according to the law of Yin and Yang conservation, they would merge into one Golden Core, then break the core to reach Nascent, achieving a Nascent Soul."
"Do you know why the Nascent Soul Stage is not called the Baby Stage, but has 'Nascent' prefixed to it?"
"Please enlighten me, Elder."
"'Nascent' means beginning, first, or foremost. Simply put, Nascent Soul Stage means the initial phase of an infant."
"So?"
"So this little guy named Meng isn't at the Nascent Soul Stage, he's at the Dual Nascent Stage."
Lu Yang's eyes twitched slightly, Elder Lianyi's naming skill was on par with Fairy Eternity.
Fairy Eternity nodded in the Spiritual Space, "Dual Nascent Stage is a good name, perfectly fitting the reality!"
Lu Yang: "..."
At the very least, call it the Repeated Nascent Stage.
What realm Meng Jingzhou was called didn't matter to him, but he himself was a Dual Nascent.
The two Nascent Souls whooshed into the Abode, various phenomena transformed into petal flurries, raining down petals in a stunningly beautiful display.
Meng Jingzhou's lips curled into a smile as he pushed open the door of the Abode, looking refreshed and clearly happy about his breakthrough into the Nascent Soul Stage.
Only Lu Yang knew he was happy about the perfect conclusion of his performance.
"Congratulations, Junior Brother Meng, breaking core to reach Nascent—your future is boundless!"
"Dual Nascent Souls, unheard of! Junior Brother Meng, you have pioneered a historical first, you really stand out!"
"Congrats to Senior Brother Meng for achieving Nascent Soul, we will all look up to Senior Brother Meng as our idol and strive forward courageously!"
"You're all exaggerating, dear Senior Brothers, Senior Sisters, Junior Brothers, and Junior Sisters. I'm merely at the ordinary Nascent Soul Stage, I don't deserve such excessive praise."
While he verbally declined, Meng Jingzhou's heart was almost blooming with laughter.
Once most of the crowd had left, Lu Yang and Jiang Lianyi approached.
"Old Lu, you're here. Did you see my performance just now? Bet you regret advancing earlier and missing out on this kind of treatment," Meng Jingzhou boasted to Lu Yang with pride.
Calls you an ungrateful brat for advancing first.
When he saw Jiang Lianyi next to Lu Yang, his expression slightly changed, and he quickly greeted her, "I have seen Elder Lianyi."
Even though Jiang Lianyi had changed her appearance, Meng Jingzhou wasn't stupid; the person beside Lu Yang must be Jiang Lianyi.
Hearing Meng Jingzhou say this, Old Ma ran over, spouting human language, "I have seen the Phoenix Ancestor!"
The legendary Phoenix Tribe, the first under the Demon Immortals, he thought he would never meet the Phoenix Ancestor in his life, only to encounter her here!
"Damn, Old Ma, you can talk?" Meng Jingzhou was surprised, as it was the first time he had heard Old Ma speak, although they had known each other for years.
Jiang Lianyi glanced at Old Ma, "A Demon King level, is this youngster your Protector?"
Old Ma dared not hide anything, confessing everything, "By my brother's trust, before he returns home to be killed by our brother, I must not let others kill him."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Old man, are you holding a grudge for too long? I've almost forgotten what I did.
Luckily, Meng Jingzhou wasn't one to hold grudges. He quickly pushed aside the old man's resentments and started discussing his Nascent Soul Stage breakthrough with Lu Yang.
"Old Meng, congratulations, Elder Lianyi said she's never seen anyone with dual Nascent Souls before. It's unprecedented, so instead of calling it the Nascent Soul Stage, we should call it the Dual Nascent Stage."
Meng Jingzhou really wanted to say what a terrible name that was, but considering it was named by the Phoenix Ancestor, and the Phoenix Ancestor was right there, he wouldn't dare criticize it even if he borrowed courage from someone else.
"...Good name."
"How is it, what unusual changes have you felt after reaching the Nascent Soul Stage?" Lu Yang asked, excited. With two kids now, it must be different from the ordinary Nascent Soul Stage.
"Let's not talk about strength, that's certainly increased, but the most important thing is I feel a change in my blood."
"A change in the blood, what kind of change?"
Meng Jingzhou said sternly with a straight face, "It can invigorate yang."
"...Any other changes?" Lu Yang looked at Meng Jingzhou oddly; Old Meng wasn't too far from becoming Monk's Meat.
"There should be, but I haven't found them yet, it requires gradual exploration."
The Invincible Nascent Soul had Fairy Eternity as a reference, so Lu Yang could directly understand the function of Invincible Nascent. With Meng Jingzhou's situation having no reference, he could only research gradually.
"What about you, what's your Nascent Soul like?"
Lu Yang perked up when this topic came up: "My Nascent Soul was personally guided by an Ancient Immortal, known as Invincible Nascent. It can automatically battle on my behalf, deploying the most appropriate moves with the most suitable power to defeat the enemy at the most suitable time, even surpassing me as an opponent!"
Meng Jingzhou took a deep breath. Old Lu's Nascent Soul sounded incredibly powerful, not in the same league as his own.
"Okay, you've just made your breakthrough, you need to stabilize your realm. Elder Lianyi and I won't bother you any longer."
"No need to see us out."
Lu Yang said goodbye and left with Jiang Lianyi towards the Scripture Pavilion.
At the entrance of the Scripture Pavilion was Zhou LuLu, the Senior Sister he hadn't seen in a long while. She was, as always, engrossed in reading a book, with her head tucked down.
"Senior Sister Zhou, reading again?" Lu Yang greeted her with a smile.
"Junior Brother Lu, long time no see," Zhou LuLu said with a sigh of relief upon recognizing Lu Yang.
"I heard you've been in the Demon Territory for the past six months?" Zhou LuLu looked at Lu Yang enviously. She had always wanted to venture out but, because she was shy, rarely left the Sect, let alone going to a completely unfamiliar place like the Demon Territory.
"Senior Sister Zhou, you could actually take a walk around the periphery of the Demon Territory. It would be good for building confidence."
"No, no, I'll just stay in the Sect. That's...," Zhou LuLu noticed the unfamiliar yet imposing Female Cultivator next to Lu Yang.
By regulation, outsiders weren't allowed inside the Scripture Pavilion.
"This is a guest invited by Eldest Senior Sister who said she wanted to have a look around the Scripture Pavilion. This is a pass from Eldest Senior Sister," Lu Yang introduced.
Seeing there was a pass from Eldest Senior Sister, Zhou LuLu didn't say anything more.
"Then you go inside, just remember not to damage the books."
"Of course."
The two entered the second floor of the Scripture Pavilion, where the Cultivation Techniques for the Golden Core Stage and Nascent Soul Stage were kept. When Lu Yang was writing the Golden Core section of the "Mind Seeing Method," he had lived there for a whole month to complete it.
"Take your time looking around, Elder Lianyi. I'm off to study the Cultivation Techniques," Lu Yang temporarily parted ways with Jiang Lianyi.
After Lu Yang left, Jiang Lianyi took interest in these Cultivation Techniques she had never heard of before and could feel the rapid changes with the times.
"'Great Sun Cultivation Skill,' 'Crane Cry Skill,' 'Farming Skill'... Hmm, why is this book hidden away?"
She noticed that at the lower shelf on the eastern side, the Cultivation Techniques were rarely sought after, possibly because they were common in the market and were covered with a layer of dust.
Pushing aside these techniques, she discovered a hidden compartment behind them, which was very hard to detect.
Jiang Lianyi opened the compartment and found a book hidden within.
"Dragon and Phoenix Transformation?"

chapters.title: Chapter 631 - 630: Daoist Buyu Faces This Calamity in His Fate
chapters.content:
Jiang Lianyi's expression conveyed a trace of doubt. From the name, it seemed that this should be a cultivation technique related to the Dragon and Phoenix Clans, akin to the body refinement magic skill of the human race.
"I've never seen a cultivation technique for humans to transform into dragons and phoenixes in the ancient times. Is this a recent creation?"
With curiosity, she carefully opened the book.
Then, all sorts of inappropriate words leaped into view, describing the mating process of the dragon and phoenix in vivid detail, which truly gave her quite a scare, as if electrically shocked, she promptly threw the book down.
"This... what is the meaning of this!"
Such books did not exist in ancient times.
"Elder Lianyi, what's wrong?"
Lu Yang heard the commotion and hurried over. The second floor was very quiet, so even a slightly louder word would catch the attention of others on the floor.
"Who wrote this book?"
"Which one?"
Lu Yang closed the book and, upon seeing the title on the cover, was speechless for a long while.
Why was this book everywhere?
When he first came to the Scripture Pavilion, he encountered this book and thought it was some kind of fortuitous encounter or mystical cultivation technique, only to have an elder brother from the Scripture Pavilion tell him it was an adult book.
It was only before he left for the Demon Territory that he learned from Uncle Ba that this was something written by his master, and what was kept in the Scripture Pavilion might be the original copy.
All the copies of "Dragon and Phoenix Transformation"outside had been destroyed, and the copy on the first floor was taken away by an elder brother of the Scripture Pavilion. How come there was still one on the second floor?
Master, just how many copies did you leave in the Scripture Pavilion? Is it appropriate to use the saying 'A crafty rabbit has three burrows' here?
"Who wrote this book?" Jiang Lianyi was angry and humiliated, determined to make the author pay!
Lu Yang, feeling his scalp tingle from the question, knew the answer could endanger the life of his master. Since he became a disciple, his master had been good to him.
Although he was often not in the sect and had never guided his cultivation, his master would often make enemies everywhere, inadvertently making it so that he dared not disclose his sect affiliation when outside, and frequent imprisonments due to his master's troubles even prevented him from taking the imperial examinations.
But no matter what, Daoist Buyu had all sorts of faults, he was still his master!
"It was written by my master, Daoist Buyu."
This calamity was fated for his master; it was both a tribulation and an opportunity. His master often taught the Eldest Senior Sister that pressure brings motivation, so he must have been well prepared for this.
Jiang Lianyi nodded slightly, a terrifying smile curling up at the corner of her mouth, "The Sect Leader of our Seek Dao Sect, Daoist Buyu?"
"Yes."
"Where is he now?"
"He roams everywhere, his whereabouts unknown, even the elders of the sect cannot find him."
"Got it, I will look for him after I go out."
Jiang Lianyi took the book "Dragon and Phoenix Transformation" with her, as its contents should not be seen by others.
Just then, a hunched old man approached, his appearance plain and unremarkable.
"Esteemed Daoist, this book belongs to our Scripture Pavilion. The token Xiao Yun gave you only allowed you to enter and freely read the books, but it didn't say you could take it away, did it?"
The voice was full of years and stories, belonging to a thin-faced old man.
He spoke slowly but with an undeniable finality.
"Elder Tao." Lu Yang greeted him with a fist and palm salute. This person was of his Grandmaster's generation, retired here to guard the Scripture Pavilion, with unfathomable cultivation.
Jiang Lianyi scoffed coldly, revealing her true identity, not placing this elder in her sight.
"The Phoenix Ancestor?!" Elder Tao's eyes widened suddenly, and his eyelids twitched repeatedly. As a senior cultivator from the older generation with more experience than even the eight Elders, he had seen the statue of Jiang Lianyi in the Demon Territory.
"Heh, and what if I wanted to take her away?"
Elder Tao was firm as well, "Then you just take her away; I'm not stopping you!"
Lu Yang: "..."
...
Inside the Seek Dao Sect, all seemed quiet and calm, but outside, as news of the awakening of the Phoenix Ancestor, the legendary great demon from ancient times, spread, chaos had already erupted.
In the Demon Territory, the East Sea, Buddha Country, imperial courts, among the martial world, The Three Great Demon Sects, the underground black market—everywhere there were cultivators, this news caused a shock.
"The Phoenix Ancestor, who disappeared for three hundred thousand years, is still alive? And her combat power is undiminished from before, even defeating Venerate Zhu Tian who was known as the first under the Immortals?"
"Moreover, the Phoenix Ancestor is claimed to be one of the Four Imperial Protectors of the Heavenly Court, and appearing alongside her at the Demon Nation's founding ceremony was the Heavenly Court Young Sect Master!"
"The Heavenly Court Sect actually possesses such a terrifying foundation?"
"See what I said? I told you long ago that the Heavenly Court Sect is the real Ancient Heavenly Court. Don't you think that after reading a couple of books, you can say that the Heavenly Court Sect is made up. The truth is right here!"
"The Phoenix Ancestor herself revealed the true form of the Demon Immortal, the Kirin, indeed the auspicious creature from legends!"
"Furthermore, the Qilin Immortal and the Phoenix Ancestor are actually a married couple. The foundation of the Phoenix Tribe is probably far beyond what the world can imagine. It's no wonder there were rumors in ancient times that none dared to provoke the Phoenix Ancestor among Semi-Immortals. With the Qilin Immortal as a supporter, they truly dare not provoke her."
In a small tavern, the thoroughly drunk patrons discussed matters of the Demon Territory with great animation, as if they had witnessed the shocking battle of Semi-Immortals with their own eyes.
"Wait a minute, Venerate Zhu Tian and the Phoenix Ancestor—are there two Semi-Immortals in the Demon Territory?"
On the surface, none of the major powers possess a Semi-Immortal, with the highest being at the Pass Tribulation stage. With this, the Demon Territory has suddenly become the most powerful force.
"Semi-Immortal ah..."
Whether they were Foundation Establishment stage cultivators or Nascent Soul stage old monsters, all held a sense of reverence when it came to the realm of Semi-Immortal, a realm they were sure they could never reach in their lifetimes.
Even most of the Foundation Establishment cultivators didn't know about the "Semi-Immortal" realm; learning about it from others' mouths, they could return and boast about this knowledge.
Divine Transformation Stage Cultivators are considered the backbone of the Cultivation World, and they possess a keener sense, sensing something extraordinary from this news.
"Two ancient Semi-Immortals awakening one after the other can't be a coincidence. This is the prelude to the Great Era strife..."
The old man in the dirty Daoist robe listened to these messages with sporadic sighs, feeling even more than others.
"How did Xiao Yang get involved with the Phoenix Ancestor and even managed to lure her to our Heavenly Court Sect? Even I couldn't pull off something like this."
Daoist Buyu was quite puzzled; every time he heard about his little disciple's deeds, it refreshed his understanding.
"Xiao Yang is bold enough to deceive even the Phoenix Ancestor. When I see him next time, I must tell him, 'deceive anyone but not those you cannot afford to provoke,' or trouble will surely arise."
Daoist Buyu, with his rich experience in deceiving others and still being alive to date, was not a matter of luck but because he had a bottom line, which was to absolutely never provoke those he could not afford to.
For example, with a person of the Phoenix Ancestor's status, he would definitely avoid her at all costs, not seeing her even once.
"Hmm? Someone's coming?"
Daoist Buyu, with his sharp instincts, felt the approach of a Unification Stage Great Power, and moreover, the aura was wild, not like that of the Human race!
A burly middle-aged man walked into the small tavern and sat next to Daoist Buyu, his deep voice filled with respect for knowledge.
"I hear that the hottest storytelling work 'Legend of the Dao Seeking Sect' was written by you. Do you still take disciples?"
Daoist Buyu looked up to see the middle-aged man's appearance and was slightly startled: "Gold Clan Leader?"

chapters.title: Chapter 632 - 631 Various Nascent Soul Cultivation Techniques
chapters.content:
The Gold Clan Leader was also taken aback and, looking left and right, failed to recognize Daoist Buyu in disguise, "Do you know me?"
He had travelled thousands of miles to Great Xia, seeking the top storyteller there, how could the other party recognize him?
Was his fame really that widespread?
The Gold Clan Leader became cautious, his aura spreading, a deadly air slicing through his robe, suspecting the other party was a creditor, but then he thought that his only creditor was the Meng Family now.
"It is I, Daoist Buyu," Daoist Buyu said in a low voice, not afraid of revealing his identity, as he had no grudge against the Qiongqi Clan.
Daoist Buyu had his principles in deception, picking his targets carefully, not swindling poor families, and the Qiongqi Clan was already poor enough, there was no need to wreak further havoc on them.
As for the Gold Clan Leader's unwitting entanglement with the Jiuyou Sect, that had been Eighth Elder's trickery, what did that have to do with him?
He wasn't afraid that the Gold Clan Leader harbored any ill intentions either.
Could someone with ill intentions live so poorly?
"Daoist Buyu?" The Gold Clan Leader widened his eyes and then realized, no wonder the storytelling was "Legend of the Dao Seeking Sect", it turned out it was being narrated by their own Sect Leader, which made perfect sense.
"Hold on, how did you find me?"
"Oh, that's simple. In the early years, when I dodged debt repayments and hid everywhere, I gained a lot of experience in hiding, so naturally, I got good at finding people too."
Daoist Buyu: "..."
"So you want to take me as your master to learn storytelling?" Daoist Buyu hesitated, this was the first time someone had actively approached him to be a disciple.
The Gold Clan Leader also hesitated, knowing Daoist Buyu had a bad reputation, wondering if becoming his disciple might negatively affect his own reputation as well.
But then again, Daoist Buyu was truly a good teacher, eloquent and skilled in deception, exactly what he lacked. As the saying goes, to use others' strengths to address one's own weaknesses, this was the case.
He gritted his teeth, thinking fortune favors the brave, and to learn real skills, one must take risks.
It was worth the gamble.
"Yes, I'm here to become your disciple!"
Daoist Buyu was as if moved by the Gold Clan Leader's determination.
Although it was said that the Qiongqi Clan had peculiar fates, often attracting disasters, and even the Land Money Trade Association dared not take them in, he always acted cautiously and should not encounter any problems.
"There's no need for formal discipleship, you're nearly a thousand years old, and our Seek Dao Sect does not take disciples of such age. However, you can follow me and learn."
...
After betraying his master, Lu Yang continued his study of cultivation techniques in the Scripture Pavilion without any guilt.
Jiang Lianyi wasn't in a hurry to find Daoist Buyu either; after all, he couldn't escape Great Xia, and the most important thing now was to learn about the changes in the cultivation world over the past 300,000 years.
If there were things she did not understand, she simply needed to ask Elder Tao.
Facing Phoenix Ancestor's curiosity, Elder Tao shared all he knew without any hesitation. He had no intention of probing into how Jiang Lianyi arrived at the Seek Dao Sect; since Xiao Yun had sent her, she must have been trusted by Xiao Yun. As a retired man, he only needed to take care of his section of the Scripture Pavilion, leaving the affairs of the Seek Dao Sect to the younger generation.
Furthermore, answering the questions of Phoenix Ancestor allowed the Phoenix Tribe to recount ancient secrets, a perfect arrangement for both.
The cultivation techniques in the Scripture Pavilion encompassed everything. The last time Lu Yang visited, he was at the Golden Core Early Stage and had glanced through some Nascent Soul Stage techniques, finding them difficult to grasp. Now that his cultivation level and perspective had advanced, those Nascent Soul Stage techniques were no longer hard to understand.
"'Pure Yang Method'... Oh, it's the ancestral cultivation technique for those with Single Body Spiritual Roots, no need to bother." According to Lu Yang's understanding of the 'Pure Yang Method,' it either contained motivational words left by the predecessors with Single Body Spiritual Roots, akin to a form of spiritual chicken soup.
Or it could be a mild cultivation method, like dousing with cold water or staying in an ice cellar when the body feels overheated, or it might be an aggressive cultivation method, such as taking aphrodisiacs to increase Yang Qi—with a mindset of no destruction, no construction.
The latter method could effectively enhance the cultivation speed of those with Single Body Spiritual Roots, but the risks were also enormous. It was said that several predecessors couldn't withstand the effects of the drugs.
Old Meng, with the assistance of Nirvana True Fire, would make those predecessors who took aphrodisiacs say it's too aggressive.
"'Mountain Lifting Method,' a Body Refinement cultivation technique. When perfected to a high degree, one at the Nascent Soul Stage can achieve the ultimate strength, moving mountains and filling seas effortlessly." Lu Yang took a sharp breath—this Mountain Lifting Method was truly impressive. Old Meng might consider practicing it.
But he'd pass—it's not suitable for him as he isn't a Body Refinement practitioner and can't cultivate such techniques.
"If you want to practice Body Refinement, there's a shortcut you can take," Fairy Eternity suggested kindly, seeing Lu Yang's interest in these kinds of cultivation techniques.
"What shortcut?"
"Getting struck by lightning. If you can Pass Thunder Tribulation, it can greatly enhance your body's strength. Before becoming an immortal, Yingtian Immortal often did this. If it weren't for his great fortune, ample elixirs, and destiny, he would have been struck dead a long time ago."
"But it really does work. There was a time when Yingtian Immortal could suppress Qilin Immortal in fights. Later on, when Qilin Immortal became desperate, he also undertook Thunder Tribulation. Only then did they fight to a draw again. The two improved each other through competition, becoming a beautiful legend. Many geniuses followed suit, imitating them, resulting in quite a few being struck dead."
There are ways to attract Thunder Tribulation not only when breaking through to a new realm.
"I'm only at the Nascent Soul Stage, wouldn't getting struck by lightning be very dangerous?"
Fairy Eternity waved her hand dismissively, as if she had a plan for everything, "What's there to fear? Have you forgotten Invincible Nascent Soul? If you encounter Thunder Tribulation you can't withstand, Invincible Nascent Soul will use escape as a warning—it's very safe."
"... Invincible Nascent Soul will be safe, but what about me?"
This was a difficult question, and Fairy Eternity couldn't come up with a good solution at the moment.
"Er, should I show up and make the Thunder Tribulation go away?"
"Are you sure Thunder Tribulation will respect you?"
"Hard to say. The formidable ones will respect me, like the Nine Nether World Thunder, but you're just at the Nascent Soul Stage, likely to face insignificant and small Thunder Tribulations that may not even recognize me."
Lu Yang shook his head, dismissing Fairy Eternity's suggestion and continued to delve into the cultivation techniques.
"'Art of Immortal Against All Tribulations,' a cultivation technique specifically for tempering Nascent Souls. If cultivated to the highest degree, the Nascent Soul becomes indestructible, existing eternally. Even if a great star fell, or countless tribulations were suffered, it would remain unscathed."
Lu Yang took in another sharp breath, amazed that such a top-tier formidable cultivation technique was just lying on the shelf so casually. If he could perfect it, it seemed even more powerful than his own Invincible Nascent Soul.
He looked up to ensure he was not in the "Yun Zhi Section", and continued to turn the pages, eager to see how this technique should be cultivated.
"To cultivate an immortal Nascent Soul that never perishes, you first need to allow the Nascent Soul to Pass through countless tribulations."
"... Damn, turns out this is a theoretical cultivation technique," Lu Yang lamented, recalling that there was such a category of cultivation techniques.
These theoretical cultivation techniques are theoretically feasible, but only in theory. In practice, no one has ever succeeded.
Such techniques were either meant to deceive novices or were the ingenious ideas of powerful cultivation figures.
"Who wrote this... Tao Ran? Never heard this name before."
Lu Yang seemed to remember something, turned his head to look at Elder Tao, who was not far away explaining modern cultivation concepts to Elder Lianyi, as though he had found the author of the technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 633 - 632: The Second Senior Brother Overcomes His Nascent Soul
chapters.content:
"...It seems Elder Tao really has a lot of free time."
Lu Yang silently put the cultivation technique back and continued to study other techniques.
The variety of cultivation techniques at the Nascent Soul Stage was numerous; it would be more accurate to say they were a clash of ideologies rather than mere techniques.
For example, some predecessors advocated for a breakthrough in the face of death, believing that one could only elevate themselves and their Nascent Soul when confronted with a desperate situation.
Others felt that cultivation should be a gradual and steady process, without rushing.
Lu Yang preferred the latter—having Fairy Eternity in his Spiritual Space was already akin to a deadly situation; if he faced another desperate circumstance, it would be a situation with no chance of survival, rendering any elevation useless.
"This technique is quite good, 'Nascent Soul Nurturing Swordsmanship.' It feels very suitable for me, as I can use it for reference. Cultivating this technique uses the Nascent Soul as a scabbard to nurture the heart sword. Once the heart sword is formed, the Nascent Soul can wield it, and conservatively speaking, it could increase the combat power of the Nascent Soul by 30 percent!"
The Nascent Soul, which is transformed from the Golden Core and controlled by the primordial spirit, is not a physical entity; therefore, it lacks a weapon to wield. Naturally, if it possessed a weapon, its combat power would be expected to increase.
"This technique is useless for you," Fairy Eternity reminded.
"Why?"
"Because the Invincible Nascent Soul can already wield a sword, the purpose of cultivating this technique has already been achieved."
"The Invincible Nascent Soul can use swordsmanship? Why haven't I seen it do so?" Lu Yang recalled his painful experiences fighting with the Invincible Nascent Soul and didn't remember it using sword techniques.
"Because you didn't use swordsmanship during your battles. Haven't I said? Whatever you can do, the Invincible Nascent Soul can do as well, and even better."
"If you don't believe it, just try and see."
Lu Yang was indeed curious. He entered the Spiritual Space, conjured a sword for himself, and then disconnected from the Invincible Nascent Soul to do battle with it.
The miracle happened; Lu Yang fought more and more bravely as the battle progressed, his swordsmanship flowing effortlessly as if second nature to him, clearly signaling a breakthrough in his swordsmanship to a level unattainable by other cultivators. Even the older generation of cultivators would clap in amazement if they witnessed it, but then he was defeated by the Invincible Nascent Soul.
"*cough cough* How is the Invincible Nascent Soul so difficult to defeat? Fairy, how did you beat it in the past?" Lu Yang was getting pummeled on the ground by the Invincible Nascent Soul, truly unable to overcome it.
Fairy Eternity's gaze shifted evasively, "Just... try a few more times and you'll manage to beat it."
Lu Yang looked at Fairy Eternity with skepticism, "How many times did you try?"
"I'm not good at math; I didn't keep count!"
"..."
Lu Yang detached from the Spiritual Space, repeatedly consoling himself that it was a good thing the Invincible Nascent Soul was powerful, that it was a good thing...
As Lu Yang walked and browsed, he finally arrived at the long-anticipated "Yun Zhi Section," and the very first book thrilled him.
"Is this Eldest Senior Sister's cultivation journal from when she was at the Nascent Soul Stage?"
"Let's see how Eldest Senior Sister cultivated her Nascent Soul. To cultivate the Nascent Soul, step one, break core to reach Nascent; step two, overcome Heavenly Tribulation... Huh?"
Why does it differ from others at the second step?
"Come to think of it, I seem to have heard people say that Eldest Senior Sister encountered the Heavenly Tribulation while breaking through to the Nascent Soul Stage, whereas other cultivators faced it when breaking through the Spirit Transformation Stage."
