"Senior Brother Ye Zijin followed Eldest Senior Sister's method and also encountered the Heavenly Tribulation during the Nascent Soul Stage, and then his Nascent Soul developed intelligence and gave him a thrashing."
Lu Yang felt he had something in common with his Senior Brother, whom he had never met, yet they were already connected as brothers of the same path.
"Elder Tao, how did Eldest Senior Sister manage to face the Heavenly Tribulation during the Nascent Soul Stage?"
Lu Yang actively inquired as Elder Tao should be aware of the specifics.
"Oh, that matter? Back then, Xiao Yun accidentally wandered into an ancient trial ground at the pinnacle of his Golden Core stage. He undertook a trial there and fought against the shadow of the previous record holder; he defeated the shadow and took the top spot on the rankings."
"Who was the previous record holder?" Jiang Lianyi asked curiously. If it was an ancient figure, she should have heard of them.
"Yingtian Immortal?"
Lu Yang: "..."
So it was you, Yingtian Immortal, who, in a rush of frustration, decided to strike down Eldest Senior Sister.
Fairy Eternity nodded: "It sounds like something Yingtian Immortal would do; he used to regret his moves often while playing Go."
"So you let him take back his moves?"
"Of course, we let him. Why not? The spirit of playing chess lies in fairness. If he wants to take back a move, fine. But then we would beat him up, and after that, we would feel remorse too, saying we shouldn't have hit him, and pretend like it never happened."
"..."
"I remember the ancient trial ground that Miss Yun went to; it existed even before the ancient era. Yingtian Immortal went there during his Golden Core stage, broke the record, and became the top name at the time, creating quite a sensation."
"I was too far away at that time and couldn't make it. By the time I could go, I had already reached the Nascent Soul Stage."
"I guess after he became immortal, he left a magic skill in the trial ground. If someone broke his record, they could expect to be struck by lightning or something."
"It's not exactly revenge, not completely. At least after being struck, it indeed strengthened the Nascent Soul."
Lu Yang continued to ask, "What about Second Senior Brother, did he also enter the ancient trial ground and break the record?"
It seems Second Senior Brother is even more formidable than I imagined.
"You mean Ye Zijin? He intended to go, but wasn't allowed; after Xiao Yun left the ancient trial ground, it closed and has never been opened since, and the reason remains undiscovered to this day."
Jiang Lianyi guessed the reason, knowing that Yingtian Immortal was a person of principles: "He probably feared someone else surpassing his record. Yingtian Immortal's principle is to not lose face twice."
"...He does have some principles," Lu Yang commented helplessly.
"Then where did Second Senior Brother's Thunder Tribulation come from?"
"He cursed Yingtian Immortal for an entire day."
Lu Yang gasped in awe—it was just like his Second Senior Brother to have such courage.
Even with Fairy Eternity's protection, he wouldn't dare to treat Yingtian Immortal this way.
"You know what happened afterward. The kid, when breaking his core to reach Nascent, attracted a Heavenly Tribulation, which was extremely imposing with two bolts of lightning striking down at the start."
"Those two bolts enlightened Ye Zijin's Nascent Soul, making it a truly eye-opening entity. It flew to the skies, able to shatter the Thunder Tribulation, then flew back into his body and gave its owner a pounding." Elder Tao marveled at such a scene, having never witnessed anything so outrageous in his five thousand years of life.
Lu Yang felt envious upon hearing it; his own Nascent Soul would only flee from Thunder Tribulation.
"I also heard that the Second Senior Brother destroyed his own Nascent Soul and forged a new one?"
"That's just a ruse for outsiders. The real situation was rather special and not convenient to disclose to outsiders. But you are not outsiders, so it's no harm telling you—Ye Zijin actually conquered his own Nascent Soul."
Lu Yang was deeply moved; this was the breakthrough he longed for. He eagerly asked, "How did Second Senior Brother conquer his Nascent Soul?"
"He said that no matter how strong the Nascent Soul is, it's still part of him. Since it's a part of him, his whole surely is stronger than a part, so he was certain to defeat his Nascent Soul!"
"He also said that a spiritual victory is still a victory."

chapters.title: Chapter 634 - 633: No Shortcuts in Cultivation
chapters.content:
Lu Yang was astounded by the cleverness of his second senior brother's method. How come he had never thought of it!
"Fairy Eternity, would this method work?" He looked towards Immortal Fairy with full of expectation.
"You can fool yourself."
"Your second senior brother's Nascent Soul possesses intelligence; a couple of careless words would suffice to deceive it, but your Invincible Nascent Soul lacks intelligence—how are you going to fool it?"
Lu Yang, dejected, realized this method wouldn't work and that he had no choice but to honestly defeat his Nascent Soul.
Lu Yang returned to "Yun Zhi Zone," studying the articles written by the Eldest Senior Sister word by word, finding them full of profound meaning and considered to be of great wisdom. He gained a lot after reading them.
"As expected of the Eldest Senior Sister, her written insights are very sound, and upon careful contemplation, one can glean even deeper understanding."
This was much more useful than the advice from Immortal Fairy.
The more Lu Yang read, the more he felt these articles spoke to his heart—they were just like what he would have written himself!
Two months flew by in this way, during which Lu Yang was constantly stationed in the Scripture Pavilion, never straying from the second floor, studying these Nascent Soul Stage Cultivation Techniques day and night, and reaping abundant rewards.
He was sitting cross-legged on a grass mat, in the Five Centers Toward Heaven posture, breathing slowly, as if asleep, yet as if he was entering an even deeper level of enlightenment.
Various cultivation concepts and methods swirled in his mind like a tangled mess, chaotic and disordered.
What he needed to do was unravel the chaotic tangle of insights to single out the useful elements and then modify them according to his own circumstances, to ultimately forge a Cultivation Technique that was uniquely his own.
Studying various Cultivation Techniques was a great mental strain for a cultivator. Only because Lu Yang's Spiritual Power was unmatched in his realm could he withstand the tremendous impact of these cultivation insights without fainting, which would have surely happened to any other cultivator at the Nascent Soul Stage.
Lu Yang opened his eyes, which sparkled brilliantly, and with a knowing smile on his lips, he began to write fervently, penning a new chapter.
"This must be the Cultivation Technique that the Eldest Senior Sister wanted me to write."
...
"There's improvement compared to last time, only eighty percent of the content requires my revision."
After reading the Nascent Soul Stage part of the "Clear Mind Technique" written by Lu Yang, the Eldest Senior Sister said so.
The last time Lu Yang wrote the Golden Core part, eighty percent also needed revision, but that was because two-tenths were direct quotations of sentences from the Eldest Senior Sister.
This time, at least, the remaining two-tenths contained original content recognized by the Eldest Senior Sister.
"What does your Nascent Soul look like, and what special features does it have? Let me see it," said the Eldest Senior Sister, wishing to inspect Lu Yang's Nascent Soul before tailoring the Technique.
"Uh—this is a bit difficult," Lu Yang said, looking embarrassed. Until he could overcome the Invincible Nascent Soul, he couldn't manifest it.
Eldest Senior Sister raised an eyebrow, "Where can I see it?"
"Spiritual Space."
Without further ado, the Eldest Senior Sister's soul left her body and flew into Lu Yang's Spiritual Space.
Jiang Lianyi was also curious about the state of Lu Yang's Nascent Soul. According to Lu Yang, his Golden Core was the same as that of Immortal Sister, so his Nascent Soul should be the same as well.
But, she had forgotten what Immortal Sister's Golden Core and Nascent Soul looked like.
In the two months at the Scripture Pavilion, she had roughly grasped the current state of the Cultivation World; continuing to stay there seemed pointless.
Lu Yang's Spiritual Space became lively, with the native resident Immortal Fairy, visitors Eldest Senior Sister and Jiang Lianyi, and the tenant, Lu Yang himself.
Lu Yang, familiar with the routine, disconnected and then promptly was severely beaten by the Invincible Nascent Soul before reconnecting to it adeptly.
The performance ended.
The expressions on both the Eldest Senior Sister's and Jiang Lianyi's faces were quite a spectacle, as the former was reminded of her long-unseen Junior Brother Man and the latter now lamented her memory loss, forgetting that Immortal Sister also had such an entertaining experience.
However, Eldest Senior Sister was truly deserving of her title; she noticed that Lu Yang's Nascent Soul was different from that of the second Junior Brother's.
"Fairy Eternity told me that, theoretically, as long as I defeat the Invincible Nascent Soul, it could be used by me," Lu Yang said.
Eldest Senior Sister looked at Fairy Eternity with profound meaning, "Theoretically, huh..."
As if her little trick had been seen through by Eldest Senior Sister, Fairy Eternity's eyes wandered, avoiding direct eye contact.
Turning her head, Eldest Senior Sister spoke seriously, "To defeat your Invincible Nascent Soul, you cannot resort to clever tricks. Just as there are no shortcuts in cultivation, you can only practice diligently, and must surpass your Nascent Soul in every aspect!
Lu Yang humbly asked for guidance, "Then how did Eldest Senior Sister manage to reach this realm in less than a thousand years?"
"By talent."
"..."
"Alright, I already know how to modify your cultivation technique. It will take just an hour to fix."
Eldest Senior Sister left the Spiritual Space, waving her hand to signal Lu Yang and Jiang Lianyi to leave; she preferred to work on cultivation techniques alone.
In reality, it was mainly to get Fairy Eternity to leave because she was too noisy.
As the junior brother, Lu Yang was very obedient to the Eldest Senior Sister.
As a worthy opponent, Jiang Lianyi held respect for the Master.
Both went down the mountain.
"Oh right, I haven't introduced you since you arrived. There's another person in our Immortal Lineage that you, Senior, have not yet met," Lu Yang remembered the Third Boss of their lineage.
In private, Lu Yang had asked Fairy Eternity whether Jiang Lianyi was part of the Immortal Lineage, to which Fairy Eternity had given a negative response.
'Lianyi and Xiao Ling, although they are my disciples, have made no achievements on the Immortal path, and their Dao Fruit has already been determined—they are from the lineage of survival of the fittest,' Fairy Eternity had said.
The Immortal Lineage has strict standards for membership.
It was now afternoon, not yet time for dinner; the barbecue stall was not open, and the staff were expertly using the Array Method to skewer.
After many improvements, the Array Method had evolved from a simple meat skewering array to a multifunctional professional Skewer Array that could handle enoki mushrooms, green beans, and more.
Under the strategy of distant engagement and close attack advocated by Immortal Eternity, the barbecue shop's influence was flourishing underground, secretly controlling many restaurants and was a true commercial empire!
In front of the barbecue shop, Lu Yang encountered someone unexpectedly.
"Junior Brother Man, what brings you here?" Lu Yang asked.
"Senior Brother Lu, it's been a long time, more than half a year, hasn't it?" Man Gu giggled, scratching the back of his head.
"I just had a breakthrough to the Nascent Soul Stage, so I came to celebrate with some skewers."
"Congratulations, congratulations, Junior Brother Man, your cultivation progress isn't slow." Lu Yang smiled in felicitation. "Shall we go and eat together then?"
Man Gu naturally agreed.
Jiang Lianyi noticed Man Gu's identity and let out a sound of surprise.
"Is this young man the last of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe?" she asked.
"Speaking of which, since the existence of Fairy Eternity has been erased, what is your recollection of how the Ancient Barbarian Tribe came to be?" Lu Yang inquired.
According to Fairy Eternity, the Barbarian tribe lived on the North Star, and it was by her curse on their bloodline that the Ancient Barbarian Tribe was formed, one of its characteristics being the ability to restrain the Demon Race.
Since the existence of Fairy Eternity was erased by the person behind the scenes, the origin of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe must also have changed.
Jiang Lianyi looked bemused as she explained, "The story goes that the Yingtian Immortal, regardless of beauty or ugliness, made countless women pregnant, one of whom was the progenitress of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe. Then was born the first generation of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe."

chapters.title: Chapter 635 - 634: The Nascent Soul of Man Gu
chapters.content:
```
The mastermind grafting the experience of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe onto Fairy Eternity did not surprise Lu Yang.
The author of the Demon Beast cookbook had already been changed to Yingtian Immortal, and since the bloodline suppression of the Barbarian tribe against the Demon Beasts was inerasable, the only way was to make Yingtian Immortal the progenitor of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe, thus explaining the bloodline suppression issue.
Man Gu's appearance was the epitome of masculine beauty among men, but if it were to be changed to the female form, retaining Man Gu's appearance would be quite terrifying.
One could only say that Yingtian Immortal was lecherous with a unique taste in aesthetics.
This was the most reasonable and plausible explanation.
After Fairy Eternity recounted her myriad sins within the Ancient Barbarian Tribe, Jiang Lianyi realized that her memory had been altered.
What a terrifying method.
"Brother Lu, who is this..."
Man Gu looked at Jiang Lianyi with confusion; in his memory, he had never seen this person at the Seek Dao Sect.
"She's a new member of our Heavenly Court Sect, one of the Four Imperial Protectors, Phoenix Ancestor Jiang Lianyi."
Since everyone was from the Heavenly Court Sect, there was no need for secrets.
Moreover, Man Gu had personally witnessed the unfortunate revival of Fairy Eternity and knew more than the Elders did.
Man Gu retreated several steps in alarm, his pupils constricting in shock; even his newly advanced Nascent Soul Stage showed signs of instability.
He had spent the last two months in seclusion trying to break through and was unaware of the earth-shattering changes in the outside world.
"Phoenix... Phoenix Tribe..."
Man Gu's lips quivered like he had seen a ghost, his words barely coherent.
Lu Yang patted Man Gu's shoulder, signaling him to calm down, and pushed him into the barbecue shop, where Man Gu gulped down two large kettles of tea before he finally began to settle down.
When Master Liu saw Lu Yang come in, he treated him with the reverence due to an ancestor, all the while secretly sending word to the Master and Fairy Eternity to hurry over.
"It seems Junior Brother Man has been quite diligent in cultivation lately, losing touch with the outside world; quite a few things have happened recently..."
Lu Yang said with a smile, methodically recounting his experiences in the Demon Territory.
Man Gu looked at Lu Yang with admiration, thinking that this was what it meant to be a role model; when would he ever reach such a level.
As the sage says, "In times of great events, be the calm"; Brother Lu was exactly that.
In contrast, he had been so flustered upon meeting the living Phoenix Ancestor, which was not befitting; he needed to reflect!
"Second-in-command, you're here?" Fairy Eternity and the Master arrived from the breeding farm, covered in dust.
"Could this be the legendary Phoenix Ancestor Jiang Lianyi beside you?" the Master asked cautiously, noticing the quiet woman sitting next to Lu Yang.
Although he worked long-term at the breeding farm and barbecue shop, he hadn't forgotten his identity as Master, skilled in gathering and integrating information.
For instance, he had recently learned that the Snack Stall Union planned to raise prices, the Hot Pot Alliance intended to launch new dishes, and there was a new fried skewer shop in town, along with the establishment of the Demon Nation.
Combining this information, it wasn't hard to deduce that the person next to Lu Yang was the Phoenix Ancestor who had changed her appearance.
Jiang Lianyi's gaze passed over the Master and settled on Fairy Eternity, her eyes narrowing slightly in displeasure:
"You're the one who almost formed the Eternity Dao Fruit, trying to stop my sister's revival?"
Fairy Eternity broke out into a cold sweat, repeatedly expressing his unworthiness, almost ready to kneel down.
Confronting the Imperial Teacher, he still had the confidence to put up a fight, but facing Jiang Lianyi, he could feel a wide gap between them; this was not an opponent he could handle with a self-destruct, and in a direct confrontation, he would be undoubtedly defeated!
Jiang Lianyi withdrew her gaze, sparing Fairy Eternity.
```
"Well, you are just a chess piece pushed forward by others, what use is there to trouble you?"
Immortal Eternity felt as if he had received a great pardon.
Seeing that the atmosphere on the scene was a bit tense, the Master hurriedly stepped forward to smooth things over, presenting a plate of grilled mutton kebabs.
"This is our improved mutton kebab, please taste."
With one bite of the kebab, Lu Yang was slightly surprised, this improvement method was extraordinary, it was even more delicious than before!
Man Gu was somewhat discouraged; their barbeque, the Barbarian tribe's specialty, had lost.
"How did you achieve this?"
The Master brought forward another plate of raw mutton kebabs. When Lu Yang had entered earlier, he hadn't paid careful attention, but with the Master's prompt, he quickly realized the difference in these kebabs.
"There's no smell of blood, and just looking at the kebabs brings a reassuring feeling. Are these kebabs consecrated?"
The Master smiled humbly and said, "Almost, these have been blessed by Master Shi Chan of the Suspension Temple. He recited the Rebirth Mantra while slaughtering the livestock, eliminating the animals' resentment and elevating the meat to a whole new level."
Lu Yang nodded in praise. This was a problem he had never considered before, and it seemed that this Shi Chan whom he had never met was indeed incredibly intelligent, matching wits with Meng Jingzhou and second only to himself.
"There is indeed potential for expansion." Lu Yang thought of the bustling 'Try Again' barbeque chain shops in the outside world. If they were to add meat blessed with the Rebirth Mantra, the flavor would improve further, and business would likely boom even more.
Jiang Lianyi also felt the skewers tasted nice, "Pretty good kebabs, just not as good as the ones I grill."
Lu Yang broke out in a cold sweat. Jiang Lianyi's cooking skills could make the Time Immortal see their life flash before their eyes. Who would dare eat her kebabs if they weren't strong in cultivation?
Fortunately, Jiang Lianyi had no intention of showing off her skills and didn't plan to reveal her hand, which made Lu Yang breathe a sigh of relief.
Master Liu and Master Gao were quick and capable, promptly grilling batch after batch of kebabs.
"Come, let's celebrate Junior Brother Man's breakthrough to the Nascent Soul Stage!" Lu Yang organized the celebration, with everyone holding up a cup of tea.
"Wait a moment." Man Gu spoke apologetically.
Just as Lu Yang and Jiang Lianyi were puzzled, Man Gu took out his Nascent Soul.
Man Gu's Nascent Soul appeared very seasoned, a baby's body with the face of a sixty-year-old man.
Man Gu placed three mutton kebabs before the Nascent Soul and worshipped it:
"Ancestors above, please dine first."
After the ritual.
"Junior Brother Man, your Nascent Soul looks pretty mature..." Lu Yang's eyes twitched slightly. What kind of peculiar Nascent Soul was this?
He looked towards Jiang Lianyi, who also shook her head indicating she had never seen such a thing before.
Man Gu laughed awkwardly, "My Golden Core was the Ancestral Pill, which can summon the ancestors to possess me and aid me in battle. After breaking the core to reach Nascent, my Nascent Soul took on the appearance of the ancestors. However, the appearance is random; the face often changes, and it's uncertain which ancestor it will resemble."
"No matter which person it turns into, they're all ancestors, so I thought, shouldn't I worship before eating?"
Lu Yang: "..."
"Does your Nascent Soul serve any purpose?"
"Yes, depending on which ancestor my Nascent Soul takes the form of, I can inherit that ancestor's characteristics."
"If the ancestor was renowned for their Space Spells during their life, then I can perform Space Spells. If the ancestor was known for their speed, then my speed will be enhanced."
"That's incredible. Then, this ancestor you are currently paying homage to, what were they known for during their life?"
"This ancestor was quite formidable, having followed an Immortal in the Ancient Times and was noted for their simplicity."

chapters.title: Chapter 636 - 635: Meng Jingzhou's New Move
chapters.content:
Having a simple mind isn't always a bad thing; a person with a simple mind can effectively resist spiritual attacks.
Lu Yang was very doubtful whether his spiritual attacks could harm the Man Gu endowed by his ancestors.
Ordinary people counter spiritual attacks head-on, seeing which side has greater spiritual power and who uses it better.
But it's different for those with simple minds. They are like cotton, able to cushion the impact of spiritual assaults.
Based on descriptions, the Nascent Soul of Man Gu is formidable, but when applied in practice, it has a significant flaw—it can't fully recognize all ancestors.
One can't blame Man Gu for this; considering the cultural level of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe, very few portraits have been handed down. Those that were came from occasional passing cultivators skilled in painting.
Therefore, while Man Gu can remember the features of all the ancestors, it can't match them to their appearances. When using the Nascent Soul, there's a lot of uncertainty.
"The true name of this ancestor has been lost over the course of time," they say, "but legends of the ancestor have been handed down. It is said that although the ancestor had a simple mind, his luck was exceptional. Even if his actions went in completely the opposite direction of his goals, he would still achieve his targets."
"Moreover, this ancestor once came into contact with the Dao of Life, and it's truly regrettable that he was interrupted just as he was about to understand it."
Admiration filled Man Gu's eyes; this ancestor was one of the oldest from the Ancient Barbarian Tribe who had followed an Ancient Immortal. His status within the tribe goes without saying.
"Fairy, do you recognize the ancestor that Man Gu worships?"
With skepticism, Lu Yang looked at Fairy Eternity, suspecting that the anxious-looking Nascent Soul ancestor might have been one of Fairy Eternity's first victims.
"Man Ergou, right? I know him well. That kid listened really attentively to my lectures. He asked the most questions after class, like why members of the Demon Race don't wear clothes in their original form but have to once they transform, that kind of thing. His attitude towards learning was miles ahead of the other members of the Barbarian Tribe."
"It's just that his natural intelligence couldn't reach my level," sighed Fairy Eternity with regret. He had high hopes for that student, but talent couldn't be made up for with diligence.
Lu Yang thought to himself that this certainly seemed like a victim.
"This kid often got lost. Once, he wanted to return to the Barbarian Tribe but went in the wrong direction, and after circling the North Star, it took him an entire round to find his way back to the tribe, already late for class."
"He remembered what I taught in class about cultivators needing the spirit of taking the lead in exploration, so he insisted on drinking water from the Mother-child River to see if he could get pregnant, and Qinghe had to stop him and send him back to the tribe."
"Another time, he accidentally wandered into a pond where a female cultivator was bathing. He accidentally saw her, and she screamed—a fuss ensued, demanding compensation, and then two male cultivators jumped out, saying that without a proper explanation, things wouldn't end well today."
"Man Ergou had never encountered such a situation, and he was at a loss as to what to do. Fortunately, he remembered my teaching—that one should be fair, to return a tooth for a tooth and an eye for an eye. If there is a mistake, correct it; there is no greater virtue."
"And then?"
"Then he said, 'I saw your body, so you can see mine. That's fair,' and he started to undress."
"Those three were foolish not to take the hint. Seeing Man Ergou wasn't coughing up any Spirit Stones, they all swarmed him, and ended up not being able to beat him."
Lu Yang: "..."
This ancestor from the Ancient Barbarian Tribe was truly formidable.
"Why are all of you here? You didn't invite me to dine together?"
Meng Jingzhou strutted into the barbecue restaurant with the ease of someone entering their own home.
He had passed by the barbecue restaurant, his mouth watering, and upon entering, he saw Lu Yang and the other two, along with the Nascent Soul of Man Gu, and was instantly shocked.
"Damn, Junior Brother Man, your Nascent Soul looks pretty mature."
And it doesn't look like you at all.
Meng Jingzhou tried his best to hold back the latter half of his thoughts, not voicing them out loud.
Man Gu retracted his Nascent Soul, ate the tribute skewers on behalf of his ancestor, and started to explain the origin of the Nascent Soul, which left Meng Jingzhou clicking his tongue in wonder.
"Leveraging the power of ancestors, worthy of being the final member of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe, blessed by bloodline. An unusual Nascent Soul indeed, I think Junior Brother Man will soon surpass Lu Yang to become the second Nascent Soul Stage in the world."
Lu Yang gave Meng Jingzhou a sidelong glance, "Who is the number one Nascent Soul in the world?"
Meng Jingzhou pointed to himself, stating matter-of-factly, "Of course, it's me."
"Aren't you at the Twin Nascent Souls stage? What's with pretending to be a Nascent Soul cultivator?"
Meng Jingzhou flew into a rage, "Lu Yang, you really don't know how to speak. If it weren't for the Phoenix Ancestor being here, I'd have a go at you."
Although Lu Yang was also at the Twin Nascent Souls stage, no one knew this, so he could freely pass himself off as at the Nascent Soul Stage.
"Twin Nascent Souls stage?" Man Gu recalled his cultivation knowledge and couldn't find a corresponding realm.
"Old Meng is a pioneer; he has two Nascent Souls."
"Two Nascent Souls?!" This time, it was Man Gu's turn to be shocked. He had neither heard of it nor seen it recorded in history that there was a cultivator with Twin Nascent Souls.
To create a precedent, that's where Brother Meng's strength truly lies!
Man Gu had been learning from Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou for two full years and even up to this day, he still felt there was no end to his learning; the depth and ideas of his two Senior Brothers were realms he might never reach in his entire life.
One must continue to learn as long as one lives.
Just as Meng Jingzhou was about to get angry again to assert himself, Lu Yang took the opportunity to interrupt his train of thought.
"Two months have passed, and your realm has stabilized. Is there anything special about having two Nascent Souls?"
Indeed, as soon as cultivation was mentioned, Meng Jingzhou's attention was diverted. He chuckled, "Big gains. I'll demonstrate it to you."
Meng Jingzhou smiled proudly, activated his two Nascent Souls, and two chubby little tots who looked exactly like Meng Jingzhou as a child perched on his shoulders.
"Fusion!"
Meng Jingzhou uttered lightly, causing the boundary between him and the two Nascent Souls to blur, gradually merging into one.
Two bulges grew on Meng Jingzhou's neck and two more under each of his armpits.
"Ha!"
Meng Jingzhou exerted some force, and the bulges on his neck turned into two heads, while under his armpits four arms grew out.
"Just learned it and still not very proficient with it, heh heh, what do you think?"
"Holy crap, three heads and six arms?!" Lu Yang was truly shocked. This was the technique all Body Cultivators dreamt of mastering. To his knowledge, only the Third Elder among Body Cultivators at the Body Integration Realm could do this, and beyond that, it was a technique for those who had passed the Transcendence Tribulation.
With previous examples to learn from, Meng Jingzhou managed to learn this by teaching himself, effectively being a self-taught pioneer. His talent and insight were second only to his own.
Isn't this far more formidable than his own Invincible Nascent Soul?
Fairy Eternity assured patting her chest, "If you can beat the Invincible Nascent Soul, it will fight even more powerfully than his three heads and six arms when it gets serious."
Jiang Lianyi was also slightly shocked. Was this the talent one obtained from being single?
The human race is indeed powerful; it's no wonder that among the Ancient Immortals, only one was from the Demon Race.
Not a single one of the Demon Race geniuses at the founding ceremony could boast such talent.
Meng Jingzhou noticed Lu Yang's expression, reveling in pride, silently thrilled.
Man Gu felt from the bottom of his heart that Meng Jingzhou was really impressive, sincerely praising:
"Twins are indeed different."

chapters.title: Chapter 637 - 636 Nascent Soul Leverages Power
chapters.content:
Seeing the varying degrees of astonishment from the three people, Meng Jingzhou knew his grueling two months of intense training hadn't been in vain.
He, the unrivaled top figure of the Nascent Soul stage, how could he be compared to the insignificant Lu Yang?
Each realm has its unique advantages, and he claimed both the first and the last place in the correct number sequence of realms.
Meng Jingzhou sat down and casually picked up two skewers, sniffed them, and instantly realized something was amiss.
"They smell better than before."
After taking a couple of bites, he was certain his feelings were accurate.
"They also taste better than before."
"They've been blessed."
"What do you mean by blessed?"
Lu Yang repeated the Master's words verbatim, and Meng Jingzhou was equally impressed.
It seemed that this never-before-met Shi Chan indeed had extraordinary talents, with wisdom to match Lu Yang, second only to yours truly.
With the taste of the skewers elevated, Meng Jingzhou's appetite improved as well. Holding a skewer in one hand and toasting tea with Lu Yang with the other, he ate with great pleasure.
As for grilled kidneys and oysters, he welcomed them all, much to Man Gu's surprise.
Meng Jingzhou, seeing Man Gu's puzzled look, explained offhandedly: "Another benefit of forming a Nascent Soul is that my blood becomes the best Yang Invigorating tonic. Now, any Yang Invigorating tonics or aphrodisiacs are useless to me."
One could say the current Meng Jingzhou was like a legendary tonic, a drop of his blood on the outside world would cause a frenzied scramble, selling at sky-high prices.
If Meng Jingzhou wished, he could live in a brothel, indulging in pleasure every night.
Did he wish to? Of course, he did.
"Brother Meng is amazing," praised Man Gu, giving a thumbs up.
"Your constitution reminds me of Yang Kongdong," said Jiang Lianyi suddenly.
"Who is Yang Kongdong?" Lu Yang racked his brains but had no recollection of this name.
"He's the one who formed a Harem Golden Core. Hasn't Fairy Eternity mentioned him to you?" Jiang Lianyi appeared slightly surprised; Yang Kongdong was quite famous in ancient times.
"...It turns out to be him." Lu Yang realized Fairy Eternity indeed hadn't mentioned this individual's name.
"Yang Kongdong's Harem Golden Core was formed by simultaneously gaining the power of all the women in his harem, causing his combat strength to soar, earning him the reputation of the greatest Golden Core of ancient times."
"After he and his harem cultivated to the Nascent Soul stage, they became Harem Nascent Souls, and during battle, he would summon out his harem's Nascent Souls to fight alongside him."
Lu Yang imagined the scene: Yang Kongdong charging into battle, followed by eight or nine children yelping and yelling behind him. It seemed quite peculiar.
"Yang Kongdong's constitution, known as the Intercourse Cultivation Body, was naturally blessed with luck in love affairs. Cultivating the Love-making Technique, the more he dual cultivated with female cultivators, the faster his cultivation level would rise."
"His constitution also made him very enduring in the matters of the bedchamber, and his blood, too, had Yang Invigorating effects."
"At one point, his harem numbered over a hundred."
Meng Jingzhou's eyes turned red with envy; we both have Yang Invigorating constitutions, so why do I fall so short compared to him?
Is there no justice in the world?
"There's no need for you to envy him; while Yang Kongdong had his luck in love affairs, he also faced calamity because of it. Failing to manage the conflicts within his harem properly, he ended up being killed by them in unison, torn to pieces, a truly tragic death."
Meng Jingzhou shuddered and felt that being a Single Body Spiritual Root wasn't too bad after all.
"Wait, Elder Lianyi, are you saying Yang Kongdong could utilize the Nascent Souls of his harem for battle during his Nascent Soul Stage?" Meng Jingzhou suddenly asked.
"Yes, is there a problem?"
Meng Jingzhou stroked his chin, entertaining a bold idea.
"If Yang Kongdong can use someone else's Nascent Soul to fight, can't I also use someone else's Nascent Soul to fight?"
"?"
Meng Jingzhou said in a deep and meaningful tone, "Think about it. Yang Kongdong has nearly a hundred people in his harem. Does that sound like a harem to you? That's just lust. If lust allows him to borrow others' Nascent Souls to fight, can't I rely on friendship to do the same?"
After all, he already had two Nascent Souls; what harm would there be in having a few more?
Jiang Lianyi's eyes widened slightly, astonished by Meng Jingzhou's idea.
More importantly, theoretically, it was feasible!
"It might just work, and I happen to have the cultivation technique Yang Kongdong used on hand for reference."
With a new idea, all four of them became restless. They left their half-eaten skewers and hurried back to Sky Gate Mountain to discuss the feasibility of this method with Eldest Senior Sister.
Eldest Senior Sister had just finished modifying Lu Yang's cultivation technique when the four of them rushed to her, explaining their purpose.
"Yang Kongdong? Intercourse Cultivation body? Harem Golden Core?"
Eldest Senior Sister had not heard of this matter; after all, not every bit of history has been passed down from ancient times.
The spirit of Fairy Eternity emerged, confirming that Yang Kongdong indeed existed.
Upon seeing Fairy Eternity, Man Gu became very excited. According to Lu Yang, Fairy Eternity was the great Immortal who had created their Ancient Barbarian Tribe!
The creator of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe!
Jiang Lianyi took out Yang Kongdong's cultivation technique, called the "Multi-Cultivation Technique."
With the presence of the Eldest Senior Sister, Fairy Eternity, Jiang Lianyi, and Lu Yang—four Great Powers—the "Multi-Cultivation Technique" was quickly understood.
"Most of this technique describes how to cultivate with a harem; it's useless to Junior Brother Meng. However, the 'borrowing power' concept relevant to the Golden Core Stage and Nascent Soul Stage can be used," Eldest Senior Sister pointed out, referring to two chapters of the technique.
This was a method she had not thought of before, and since she had plenty of Golden Cores, she did not need to use this method.
"Let's have the Meng Family Kid try it first; his constitution is closest to Yang Kongdong's, so he's the most likely to succeed in Nascent Soul borrowing," Fairy Eternity suggested, casually deciding the fate of a Nascent Soul elder.
The four Great Powers studied Meng Jingzhou while modifying the cultivation technique.
The Nascent Soul elder, Man Gu, could only quietly await the outcome.
"Why isn't any of our ancestors famed for their wisdom?" Man Gu thought about the traits of his ancestors and felt a bit regretful.
Soon, half a day passed, from evening to early morning, they finally made some progress.
"Junior Brother Meng, try the method written on this paper," Eldest Senior Sister handed over a condensed version of the method on a sheet of paper.
Meng Jingzhou treated it as a treasured finds and studied it earnestly.
Meng Jingzhou's cultivation comprehension was not inferior to Lu Yang's. Before long, he understood the method on the paper, which was to substitute the 'lust' in the "Multi-Cultivation Technique" with 'friendship.'
"Old Lu, let's try it in sync," Meng Jingzhou said. When it comes to the strongest bond, it had to be with Lu Yang.
"Okay."
Both of them simultaneously operated the cultivation technique and achieved synchronization. They found that the method was indeed effective as Lu Yang's Invincible Nascent Soul floated above his head and flew toward Meng Jingzhou's Dantian.
Meng Jingzhou stood up excitedly, "Haha, it really works! Now I have three Nascent Souls!"
With the support of three Nascent Souls, he felt his whole body brimming with power.
Lu Yang hesitated for a moment before saying, "My Nascent Soul isn't easy to control, it's quite... volatile. Be careful, Old Meng."
Meng Jingzhou burst into laughter, unconcerned, "What are you talking about? I've got two Nascent Souls inside me; what's to fear even if yours is volatile..."
Suddenly, Meng Jingzhou's expression changed drastically, and an intense pain erupted from his Dantian as a fierce fight broke out there.
Lu Yang's Nascent Soul was beating up his own Nascent Souls!

chapters.title: Chapter 638 - 637 Usage of the Invincible Nascent Soul
chapters.content:
Lu Yang's Nascent Soul lived up to the name of Invincible Nascent Soul, proving to be quite formidable in combat, managing to press Meng Jingzhou's two Nascent Souls while fighting two against one!
Moreover, the two Nascent Souls were completely powerless to fight back; it was a one-sided battle!
Meng Jingzhou was caught off guard by this sudden attack and writhed in pain on the ground.
The Invincible Nascent Soul was incompatible with Meng Jingzhou, causing Meng Jingzhou's belly to swell alarmingly.
"Old Meng, hang in there, I'm going to call a doctor; we must save your Nascent Soul!" Lu Yang shouted frantically, looking very anxious.
"Old Lu... damn you... taking advantage of the fact my Nascent Soul can't fight on its own!"
Meng Jingzhou quickly endured the intense pain and focused his attention on his Dantian, ready to have a decisive battle with Lu Yang's damn Nascent Soul.
The Invincible Nascent Soul possessed the ability to fight autonomously, whereas Meng Jingzhou's twin Nascent Souls required control, which led to the lopsided situation.
Frightened, Lu Yang quickly retracted his Nascent Soul, and Meng Jingzhou immediately felt much better.
Lu Yang spread his hands: "Don't look at me like that; it was the Nascent Soul that beat you, not me. My Nascent Soul went into your body and became uncontrollable."
"Get lost, get lost, get lost." Meng Jingzhou dismissed him impatiently, unable to voice any complaints after being beaten, feeling infuriated at the sight of this damn guy.
At the same time, he was secretly alarmed; how terrifying Lu Yang's damn Nascent Soul was! Even if he had controlled his two Nascent Souls in the fight just now, he most likely would have been at a disadvantage, only certain to win if it were three against one.
However, judging from the act of borrowing strength from Lu Yang's Nascent Soul, the method was broadly successful. The problem lay with Lu Yang, this damn guy.
Lu Yang quietly asked Fairy Eternity, "Fairy, if I partner with Old Meng and defeat the Invincible Nascent Soul, would that count as my victory over the Invincible Nascent Soul?"
Fairy Eternity glanced at Lu Yang, "Why don't you say the two of us partner up to defeat the Invincible Nascent Soul?"
"..."
"Junior Brother Man, you try with Junior Brother Meng," the Eldest Senior Sister commanded. There was still another person at the Nascent Soul Stage present.
Man Gu was eager to try; he had wanted to test it out for some time.
He learned from the method just written by the Eldest Senior Sister, imitated Lu Yang's posture, and sat cross-legged next to Meng Jingzhou.
Fairy Eternity and Jiang Lianyi watched with great interest; this was a very novel method, unheard of since Ancient Times.
The auras of Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu resonated, and the mature Nascent Soul flew out from the top of Man Gu's head, entering Meng Jingzhou's Dantian.
The Eldest Senior Sister saw Man Gu's Nascent Soul and her eyes twitched slightly.
She, too, had never seen such a Nascent Soul before.
Meng Jingzhou regained the power of three Nascent Souls, and the increase in strength was quite noticeable.
"Haha, this time it's really a success!"
With a thought, he summoned the three Nascent Souls; two resembled Meng Jingzhou, and one was even bigger than Meng Jingzhou's father.
"Fusion!"
Meng Jingzhou shouted loudly, merging with the three Nascent Souls, transforming into a magnificent, eight-armed Immortal, majestic and almost divine!
This was the limit of Nascent Soul fusion — there was only so much space on the neck, which couldn't fit a fifth head.
After transforming into the eight-armed Immortal, Meng Jingzhou felt reborn, but his thoughts became very different, and he was rather slow-witted.
"Wait, slow-witted?" Fortunately, the foundations that Meng Jingzhou had laid previously were still there, and he quickly realized something was amiss.
It was as if a veil covered his Spiritual Space, blurry and hazy, with his thought processes significantly slowed down.
Clearly, Meng Jingzhou had not been present when Man Gu introduced this ancestor who had followed an Immortal.
Man Gu hurriedly clarified the characteristics of this ancestor, Meng Jingzhou grimaced as he initiated the fusion, returning the Nascent Soul.
Wasn't there a single normal Nascent Soul for him to use for experiments?
The thought crossed his mind, but then it dawned on him that this was the Seek Dao Sect, and he came to terms with it.
"Junior Brother Meng, Junior Brother Man, both of you try once to see if you can merge someone else's Nascent Soul into your own body."
The first two experiments were barely successful, albeit the outcomes were not entirely satisfactory, yet they could still confirm the viability of this method.
Now it was up to Junior Brother Meng and Junior Brother Man.
Unexpectedly, Lu Yang and Man Gu both failed, only managing to transfer the Nascent Soul into the other's Dantian, but the recipients couldn't harness the power of the Nascent Soul, and Man Gu's ancestor was even beaten up by the Invincible Nascent Soul.
"It seems then, could it be that Junior Brother Meng's special constitution is responsible for this effect?"
"Fairy Eternity nodded, "Yang Kongdong and the Meng Family Kid share similar physical traits; perhaps that's no coincidence." You see, during Ancient Times, there was no such thing as a Single Body Spiritual Root; such a constitution only came about after those times."
Jiang Lianyi thought of Yang Kongdong's fate with some regret, "What a pity, bodies endowed for Intercourse Cultivation are extremely rare. It was only during our era, when various constitutions emerged incessantly, that bodies suited for Intercourse Cultivation appeared."
"Yang Kongdong was dismembered by his harem; at that time, even if we wanted to examine his constitution closely, there was no opportunity."
If they could have understood it, cultivation theory could have advanced a step further.
Suddenly, an idea struck Lu Yang, "Right, Junior Brother Man, don't activate your powers. Let me see if I can transfer my Nascent Soul into your Dantian."
"Alright." Although Man Gu wasn't quite sure what Lu Yang intended to do, he had always done whatever Lu Yang asked of him.
Lu Yang executed his cultivation technique, summoning the Invincible Nascent Soul and transferring it into Man Gu's Dantian.
"It worked!"
Lu Yang rejoiced, indeed it was feasible.
Taking advantage of the moment before the Invincible Nascent Soul started its assault on Man Gu's Nascent Soul, Lu Yang hurriedly retracted it.
Although he couldn't subdue the Invincible Nascent Soul to serve him, sending the Invincible Nascent Soul into another's body and defeating the enemy from within was nonetheless a method!
Fairy Eternity praised Lu Yang's intelligence upon seeing this; how had she not thought of this method before?
Oh, that's right, back then no one had decoded Yang Kongdong's cultivation techniques.
That night, Lu Yang was filled with gratitude and considered himself lucky that among the three, only his Nascent Soul hadn't been beaten.
Dawn arrived, and with nothing else pressing, Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu left one after the other.
"Here, I've made some revisions to the cultivation technique." Once Meng Jingzhou and Man Gu had left and Lu Yang had a moment to himself, Eldest Senior Sister handed him an entirely new "Mind Seeing Method," which had undergone drastic changes in both appearance and content. Lu Yang only had to flip through a couple of pages to notice the differences in this cultivation technique.
In terms of content, it was far more coherent and structured than what he had written; in terms of power, it was undoubtedly superior; and regarding the authorship, his own name was actually listed before Eldest Senior Sister's.
Lu Yang was deeply moved.
He slightly conducted the technique for a small circulation and immediately felt it was tailor-made for him, a perfect fit.
Jiang Lianyi glanced over it and couldn't help but admire the level of the Master; had it been her, she surely couldn't have written such a profound yet accessible cultivation technique.
It was as if Lu Yang remembered something, and he proudly said to the Eldest Senior Sister, "By the way, Eldest Senior Sister, I've conducted an experiment just now—I can send the Invincible Nascent Soul into an enemy's body to defeat them from within."
"Oh, that is indeed a good method. Use it on me, let's see the effect."
"Okay."
Lu Yang performed the cultivation technique, summoning the Invincible Nascent Soul and aiming it at the Eldest Senior Sister's Dantian.
The Invincible Nascent Soul's eyes were cold and devoid of emotion, it harbored no desires or wants. It coldly regarded the Eldest Senior Sister, then turned tail and fled.

chapters.title: Chapter 639 - 638: Sword Washing Pool
chapters.content:
The Invincible Nascent Soul ran incredibly fast, like a bolt of lightning. Lu Yang knew that even he could never fly that swiftly.
But no matter how fast it was, it was impossible to escape from Eldest Senior Sister's palm. With a gesture of a feigned grab, Eldest Senior Sister recaptured the Invincible Nascent Soul that almost fled the Sect boundaries.
Even when captured by Eldest Senior Sister, the Invincible Nascent Soul still did not give up, exhausting all means to break free: Earth Shrinking, creating prison from land, Heaven and Earth in an Inch, Lu-style Arhat Fist ... If the opponent were in the Nascent Soul Stage, they would have been beaten to death long ago.
Unfortunately, the opponent was not in the Nascent Soul Stage, so all these efforts were in vain.
Whether it was trying to escape or attack, all the techniques the Invincible Nascent Soul utilized, despite using its full power, could not overcome Eldest Senior Sister.
With teeth bared and claws brandished, the Invincible Nascent Soul continued to try to attack Eldest Senior Sister, until she flicked it on the forehead, finally causing it to quiet down in a daze.
Eldest Senior Sister held the little feet of the Invincible Nascent Soul, swinging them back and forth, with a thoughtful expression, "Such attacking power is quite extraordinary; it's a decent method of attack."
Having said that, she then tossed the Invincible Nascent Soul back to Lu Yang.
"However, this is not the proper way. You still need to hone your skills and strive to overcome your Nascent Soul."
"Yes."
Having learned the techniques of this stage, Lu Yang quieted down to prepare for training in the Sword Array.
The Seven-star Sword set that he acquired from the Creation Ancient Land had been idly lying in his Identity Jade ever since he took out one of them at the Heavenly Altar while serving as Young Sect Master.
This was not Lu Yang's intention, as his original plan was to form a Sword Array with the Seven-star Sword set.
There are two paths of cultivation for Sword Cultivators: one is to polish a single sword to break all spells, with the aim of achieving unification with the sword; the other is to master the Sword Array, which can enhance the sword's power beyond its innate capacity—it's quite magical.
It was unfortunate that Lu Yang's master had passed away early, and neither Eldest Senior Sister nor Jiang Lianyi were adept at the Sword Array, leaving him without guidance.
Had Jiang Lianyi understood swordsmanship, she wouldn't have been deceived by the Sword Array that Qilin Immortal knelt to.
The good news, though, was that after being intimidated by Fairy Eternity, the insubordinate Seven-star Sword set had obediently submitted to Lu Yang, not daring to resist, saving him the time needed for refining and taming.
"If Junior Brother is practicing swordsmanship, you might want to try the Sword Washing Pool. Once you have gained from the Sword Washing Pool, I have a set of Sword Array techniques that you can learn," Eldest Senior Sister mused, considering the spoils of war she had acquired that could be used by her junior brother.
"The Sword Washing Pool?" Lu Yang had no idea that there was a Sword Washing Pool in the Sect.
"That was the place where master practiced his swordsmanship in the early days. Later, after Master's swordsmanship reached a high level, he no longer needed to cleanse his sword, and that place fell into disuse," she explained.
Among the disciples of Seek Dao Sect, there were many who used swords as their weapons, but Lu Yang was the only one who could be considered a true Sword Cultivator.
The Sword Spirit Root is rare. After Daoist Buyu, Lu Yang was the second cultivator in the Seek Dao Sect to possess a Sword Spirit Root.
"After you descend the mountain, simply head east for about eight hundred miles, and there you will find the Sword Washing Pool," directed Eldest Senior Sister.
"At present, you are passively controlling the Seven-star Sword set, without establishing a connection with them. The Sword Washing Pool can enhance your communication with them, allowing you to fully control the Seven-star Sword set, which is the foundation of learning the Sword Array," she explained.
"The Sword Washing Pool can wash away the malevolent energies of both cultivators and their swords, increasing the synergy and coordination between them."
"It wasn't only Master who practiced there; Grandmaster also frequented the Sword Washing Pool for cultivation."
"Ah? Grandmaster was also a Sword Cultivator?" Lu Yang recalled the little fellow who guarded Captive Peak, and he could not link him with Sword Cultivators.
"No, he did it to cleanse the malevolent energies towards Master, to prevent himself from striking too hard and killing Master," she clarified.
"..."
Sometimes, Lu Yang felt it was not easy for his master to have lived to this day.
Jiang Lianyi showed no interest in the Sword Washing Pool and proposed a visit to Captive Peak. Eldest Senior Sister happily agreed, saying she could take Jiang Lianyi there.
...
Following the direction pointed out by Eldest Senior Sister, Lu Yang descended the mountain, passed through the core area of Seek Dao Sect, and arrived at the vast grasslands on the perimeter.
The grassland was once extremely dangerous to Lu Yang, with various Demon Beasts scattered over it, and the ranches established by the Master and the Immortal Eternities were at the edge of the grassland.
But now, Lu Yang was not the same as before; these terrifying Demon Beasts were insignificant. As long as he wanted to flee, these beasts couldn't even catch up with him!
Over the grasslands, Lu Yang flew with his sword, hovering more than three feet above the ground, speeding quickly. Behind him, hordes of Demon Beasts pursued, each emitting the aura of the Nascent Soul Stage and occasionally, amongst them were a few Spirit Transformation Stage Demon Beasts howling, causing the ground to tremble—utterly terrifying.
"Why fear the Demon Beasts of the Spirit Transformation Stage? There are also those in the Void Refinement and Body Integration Realms here," Fairy Eternity reminded kindly, noting that Lu Yang was afraid too soon.
```
"However, you don't need to be too afraid; those Demon Beasts in the Void Refinement Stage and the Body Integration Realm won't bother to chase you."
"These Demon Beasts should be tamed to actively attack any disciple they perceive as a threat."
As for whether it's for training purposes or just for fun, that remains unknown.
Finally, at the critical moment, Lu Yang successfully flew out of the prairie's range, and the pursuit of the Demon Beasts stopped abruptly, they did not advance any further.
"Junior Brother, were you practicing flying?" Unexpectedly, Third Senior Sister was at the edge of the great prairie, still blindfolded, she had judged from the breath and sound of the wind that Junior Brother had just staged a life and death chase on the prairie.
"Third Senior Sister, don't the Demon Beasts chase you when you pass the prairie?"
"Don't you know? As long as you reveal your Identity Jade, those Demon Beasts will not attack you. Didn't Eldest Senior Sister tell you?" Third Senior Sister shook her Identity Jade.
"No."
"Then she probably thought those Demon Beasts posed no threat."
"What are you doing here, Senior Sister?"
Third Senior Sister pointed towards a dark mountain range in the distance, "That is Tangting Mountain, I was missing a raw material for crafting my magic artifact, I dug some up there and was just preparing to go back. What about you, are you going for the Cave Heaven experience?"
"I'm planning to go to the Sword Washing Pool."
"Sword Washing Pool... Oh right, you're a Sword Cultivator, that place is indeed suitable for you. Do you know the way, or shall I take you there?"
Eldest Senior Sister just pointed in a general direction, it would be even better if someone could lead the way.
"Thank you, Senior Sister."
"We're all siblings in the same sect, there's no need to say thanks."
With Third Senior Sister guiding him, Lu Yang quickly arrived at the Sword Washing Pool.
The Sword Washing Pool was nestled between two ancient trees, each a millennium old, in a mountain hollow. The leaves from the trees fell into the pool and quietly floated there, creating a scene as still as a paused picture.
The Sword Washing Pool had not been visited by a cultivator for two hundred years, and now this place was finally receiving some human presence.
"Here is the Sword Washing Pool."
Lu Yang scooped the leaves out of the pool, revealing the crystal-clear bottom. The water possessed a magical power; just looking at it could cleanse the soul.
"What a great place!" Lu Yang's eyes gleamed; merely looking at the Sword Washing Pool allowed him to imagine how his master had cultivated here over a hundred years ago.
"According to Master, to use the Sword Washing Pool, one must place the sword into the water to wash away all impurities."
Lu Yang took out the Seven-star Sword set. The seven divine swords immediately clung to Lu Yang as soon as they appeared, frightening him into hastily pushing the swords into the pool.
Submerged in the pool, the Seven-star Sword set actually calmed down, and Lu Yang could even sense the feelings they were conveying to him: comfort, coolness.
Continuing this way, Lu Yang was sure he could truly master the Seven-star Sword set within the Sword Washing Pool.
He also sat down cross-legged nearby, settled his mind, and started to communicate and interact with the Seven-star Sword set, to be of one heart with them.
Three days went by in a flash, with Lu Yang sitting motionless, and Third Senior Sister keeping watch over him.
She noticed changes in Lu Yang and was secretly amazed by Junior Brother's talent in swordsmanship. She had a feeling that Junior Brother had become as if he vanished, attaining the realm where he was communicating with the sword, becoming one with it.
To achieve such attainments in just three days was astonishing.
Lu Yang entered a mysterious state that was indescribable, and during these three days, he maintained a continuous, if somewhat blurry, communion with the Seven-star Sword set, greatly enhancing their connection.
He slowly opened his eyes, his gaze tranquil, like an ancient well.
He had done it; he had completely mastered the Seven-star Sword set!
Lu Yang lifted his right hand, and with a upward flick of two fingers, the Sword Washing Pool danced in the air according to his will, splashing water and the Seven-star Sword set all over the place.
"Huh?"
Wasn't I mastering the Seven-star Sword set? How did it turn into the Sword Washing Pool?
```

chapters.title: Chapter 640 - 639: Annihilation of Immortal Sword Array
chapters.content:
"Oh no, I got it wrong."
Lu Yang finally realized the reason, these past three days he wasn't communicating with the Seven-star Sword Array, but with the Sword Washing Pool!
"Little Junior Brother you..."
Because her eyes were closed, Third Senior Sister sensed the movement outside through her other senses and took a moment to figure out what her little junior brother had done.
He'd lured the Sword Washing Pool away!
"Hold on, it was an accident, I can explain!" Lu Yang quickly shouted, frantically trying to sever the connection with the Sword Washing Pool in secret.
But the emotional bond he had formed with the Sword Washing Pool over three days wasn't something he could simply cut off.
After several unsuccessful attempts, he had to admit something—the Sword Washing Pool had latched onto him.
Buddy, you don't have to do this, right? Can you follow someone else, please? I'm just a minor figure with little power, I dare not claim you.
Blatantly taking a sect's treasure for oneself is unacceptable anywhere.
Third Senior Sister wore an expression that said 'you don't need to explain too much': "Eldest Senior Sister always said that our little junior brother was immensely talented, just a bit unorthodox, and seeing it today proves it."
She hadn't had the chance to see it in the Demon Territory, but now she finally had.
"..." Eldest Senior Sister, couldn't you say something good about me?
"It's just that an accident occurred during communication, I didn't practice it wrongly," Lu Yang said earnestly, correcting Third Senior Sister's misconception.
"Fairy, why didn't you remind me that I was communicating with the Sword Washing Pool all along?" Could Third Senior Sister not notice something was off? Could you, a Fairy, not notice either?
"Ah? I thought you wanted to control the Sword Washing Pool first, and then use it to control the Seven-star Sword Array."
"...It indeed seems possible to do so."
Following Fairy Eternity's train of thought, Lu Yang realized he could indeed control the Seven-star Sword Array by controlling the Sword Washing Pool.
The Seven-star Sword Array felt comfortable in the Sword Washing Pool and wouldn't fake it. Having experienced it once, they would definitely want to experience it again.
To enjoy it a second time, they would have to behave themselves!
"Forget it, then I'll just inform Eldest Senior Sister about it."
At this point, he couldn't forcibly separate himself from the Sword Washing Pool.
Lu Yang collected the water he had poured out back into the Sword Washing Pool, and then packed up the Sword Washing Pool along with the Seven-star Sword Array into his Identity Jade with practiced ease, as if cleaning up a crime scene.
On their way back, passing through the great grassland, he took out his Identity Jade, and sure enough, the demon beasts no longer attacked them.
By this time, Eldest Senior Sister and Jiang Lianyi had already finished their tour of Captive Peak. The Ancient Cultivators imprisoned in Captive Peak were shivering with fear.
What kind of background did the Seek Dao Sect have to be able to dig up the Phoenix Ancestor who had been missing for hundreds of thousands of years?
If before they had looked down on the Seek Dao Sect because of their ancient status, now they had lost even that last bit of pride.
When it came to antiquity, who could surpass the Phoenix Ancestor?
Even summoning the Four Ancient Immortals, they were contemporaries of the Phoenix Ancestor; there was no precedent or priority.
As for Grandmaster, his reaction was barely any better than Elder Tao's, especially when he heard from Eldest Senior Sister that it was Lu Yang who had unearthed the Phoenix Ancestor, his expression was spectacularly expressive.
A student outdoes his master indeed. This youngster, Lu Yang, was much more adept at causing trouble than his own master was.
Grandmaster was relieved that he had already retired. If he were still in the position of Sect Leader, he wouldn't be able to settle the chaos that Lu Yang had stirred up.
...
"Are you saying you've refined the sect's Sword Washing Pool?"
Eldest Senior Sister was startled for a moment upon hearing her little junior brother's report.
If I remember correctly, I told you to go to the Sword Washing Pool to refine the Seven-star Sword Array—not to refine the Sword Washing Pool itself.
"It was accidental," Lu Yang reiterated that there was a reason behind the incident.
However, even if there were reasons, Lu Yang was not in the right on this matter. Taking the Sect's property for his own, no matter how you look at it, there must be punishment.
"I remember you promised me, Master, that I could take anything from our Sect?" Jiang Lianyi stepped forward, coming to her Senior Brother's defense.
"If that's the case, what if I take away the Sword Washing Pool?"
"Of course, you can."
Thus, the reasoning behind this matter was explained.
The Eldest Senior Sister's original intention was just to find a reason to rightfully give the Sword Washing Pool to Lu Yang.
To the Seek Dao Sect, the Sword Washing Pool was a dispensable asset; only two sword cultivators had emerged in the past two thousand years, and the pool was scarcely used.
It was only that it could not be given directly to the Junior Brother, as that would be considered disregard for the Sect's rules and regulations, unfavorable for the unity of the Sect.
"Well, since you've already acquired the Sword Washing Pool, in just a few days you'll be able to master the Seven-star Sword Assembly and have the foundation to practice the Sword Array."
The Eldest Senior Sister took out a small booklet from her bosom.
"This is a spoil of battle I claimed after encountering an enemy. It just so happens there is a Sword Array in it. This is the first level; you take it and learn first."
Lu Yang took the booklet, and seeing the name of the Sword Array, his hand shook, almost failing to hold it steady.
"Destroying Immortal Sword Formation."
"Can this Sword Array really 'destroy the Immortal'?" Lu Yang asked with a trembling voice.
It was a rhetorical question—if it couldn't destroy the Immortal, why would it be named such?
"It can't really. I suppose it's just a name meant to intimidate."
Lu Yang: "..."
Who was the lunatic who came up with this name?
"I don't know who the other party was either."
The Eldest Senior Sister recalled the events: "I stumbled upon him by chance. He was plotting a major move in secret, and once successful, it would have turned Great Xia upside down. The situation was urgent, with no time to seek help. I was forced to act and then killed him."
"He was undoubtedly an ancient cultivator, but I am not sure if he was from Great Yu or Great Qian."
"This Sword Array, as well as your Green Peak Sword, were possessions of that person."
"I've tested the power of the Sword Array myself. It can't destroy the Immortal, but its power is still quite considerable. What you have is the first level; I will give you the subsequent ones once you raise your realm."
"Was the opponent a sword cultivator?"
"No, he merely knew how to wield a sword. It seemed he had some knowledge of talismans, array methods, and the like, but his grasp wasn't very refined. With his realm, he could bully a Semi-Immortal, but against someone of the same level, he would be outmatched."
"...wait, he was an Immortal?!"
The Eldest Senior Sister didn't understand why Lu Yang was so shocked: "Of course, he was an Immortal. Even a Semi-Immortal wouldn't dare to give their Sword Array such a name."
"He was probably the weakest Immortal I've encountered, even weaker than the one I met in the Eternity Sect."
It wasn't just Lu Yang who was unsettled, even Jiang Lianyi was not calm.
The Eldest Senior Sister spoke lightly, but the opponent was the weakest of Immortals. Even the weakest Immortal was still an Immortal, and she had just killed him!
Fairy Eternity recalled the aura of the Dao Fruit she sensed deep within the treasury of the Seek Dao Sect, which must have belonged to this person.
"Psh, just killing an Immortal, talking as if nobody else could do it. It's only because I didn't come across the opportunity, otherwise, I could kill one too."
Lu Yang was about to thank the Eldest Senior Sister and start bonding with the Seven-star Sword Assembly, then begin to practice the Sword Array to become a qualified sword cultivator when he detected a change with the Nine Nether Order. Someone from the Jiuyou Sect was contacting him.
After reading the text on the Nine Nether Order, his face showed a strange expression.
"What's wrong? Has the Jiuyou Sect contacted you?" asked the Eldest Senior Sister.
"The Jiuyou Sect is telling me that the Master of the Yaoyang Sect wants to meet me."

chapters.title: Chapter 641 - 640: The Sincerity of the Heavenly Court Sect
chapters.content:
The headquarters of Jiuyou Sect.
A massive map of Great Xia dominated the front wall, with all seventeen states and tens of thousands of cities precisely indicated on the map.
On the map, one-fifth of the cities were marked with crimson dots, signifying that Jiuyou Sect had extended its reach deep within these cities, even infiltrating Imperial City, the largest city in the world.
Mu Baiyi stood with his hands behind his back, quietly gazing at the map, muttering to himself with eyes filled with unhideable greed and desire.
"Soon, very soon..."
"The Dynasty is nothing significant, they haven't even noticed such large-scale actions of our sect..."
"In no time, there will be Jiuyou Sect barbecue shops all over Great Xia..."
Unable to help himself, Mu Baiyi touched one of the red dots on the map, each representing a barbecue shop, which signified a future influx of vast wealth into Jiuyou Sect, helping him repay loans.
Although currently they were still in the investment and store construction phase, with profits being thin as they were reinvested into building more shops, the future prospects were promising.
With this wealth, he would no longer have to worry about the exposure of his identity as a sect member taking out loans and being responsible for monthly repayments leading to a scandal.
This was lifesaving money.
"All thanks to Heavenly Court Sect," Mu Baiyi felt a renewed awe for the sect after having witnessed the Phoenix Ancestor defeat Venerate Zhu Tian in person.
According to Young Master Lu, there were still several key figures from the Ancient Heavenly Court who had yet to awaken. Even so, Heavenly Court Sect was clearly beyond Jiuyou Sect's league.
"Master, Vice Hierarch Shi from Yaoyang Sect wishes to have an audience with you," reported a Vice Sect Hierarch with the last name Xiang, presenting an invitation from Yaoyang Sect.
Mu Baiyi raised an eyebrow, a bit puzzled. Jiuyou Sect believed in reincarnation and its cultivation techniques generally focused on yin attributes, while the name of Yaoyang Sect alone suggested their techniques were yang attributes. There was little interaction between the two sects.
"What does he want to do?"
However, a meeting was still necessary; after all, some courtesies had to be observed among demonic sects.
Jiuyou Sect's headquarters certainly couldn't be exposed, so a day later, the two Sect Masters met in a teahouse, with Yaoyang Sect covering the cost for an entire floor.
The Sect Master of Yaoyang Sect arrived on time with two Protectors.
The Sect Master of Yaoyang Sect was a man who looked to be in his thirties or forties, with a face covered with horizontal flesh, bald, one-eyed, and a frightening scar stretching from his forehead to his cheekbone, giving him a rather intimidating appearance.
"Hahaha, Brother Mu, it's been quite a while since we last met!"
The Sect Master of Yaoyang Sect greeted him enthusiastically, behaving as if he were Mu Baiyi's close brother.
"Get to the point, if there's nothing else, goodbye."
Mu Baiyi responded coldly, unwilling to deal much with the Sect Master of Yaoyang, whose warmth was more than he could stand.
"Oh, come on, with our relationship, would I bother you for no reason?" the Sect Master of Yaoyang sat down, rubbing his bald head and speaking cheerfully.
"What is it?"
"I've noticed that your Jiuyou Sect's barbecue shops are quite popular these days. I've tried them myself, and indeed they offer amazing value. With such quality of Spirit Food at this price, it's no wonder the business is doing so well."
"What do you want to do?" Mu Baiyi eyed the Sect Master of Yaoyang with suspicion; anyone who thought of touching his money was asking for a fight to the death.
"Don't be nervous, we're not here to steal business."
"I've heard that the next barbecue shop isn't just backed by Jiuyou Sect, but also has people from Heavenly Court Sect?"
Mu Baiyi's expression turned stern: "Have you planted moles within our sect?"
The cooperation between Jiuyou Sect and Heavenly Court Sect was a secret known only to the high echelons of Jiuyou Sect.
"Mutual feelings,"
Vice Sect Hierarch Chi also knew that there were members of the Jiuyou Sect within his own sect, but he didn't know who specifically.
He looked at Mu Baiyi eagerly, rubbing his hands together, "So I just wanted to see, since your Jiuyou Sect has such a close relationship with the Heavenly Court Sect, you must have a way to contact them. I was wondering if you could help us get in touch with them. I'd like to meet them and get acquainted."
He had also personally gone to Demon City and witnessed the Phoenix Ancestor taking charge of the Demon Nation, plus the previous incident where Heavenly Venerate Dou defeated Great Yu Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivators, and Young Master Lu caused an uproar in the Seek Dao Sect. All these events indicated that the power of the Heavenly Court Sect was unfathomable.
While their Yaoyang Sect was strong, they were not so arrogant as to oppose the Heavenly Court Sect, which would be like smashing an egg against a rock.
Perhaps in the future, the Yaoyang Sect might have to rely on the Heavenly Court Sect, so it was always good to become familiar with them in advance.
Mu Baiyi's original intention was not to allow the Yaoyang Sect to meet with the Heavenly Court Sect. It was possible that benefits that could have gone to the Jiuyou Sect would fall into the hands of the Yaoyang Sect instead, considering how Young Master Lu casually set up a barbecue restaurant and got the Jiuyou Sect's economy running.
However, one of the strategies Young Master Lu had given included "inwardly connecting ruthlessly with Yaoyang and other sects", and if Young Master Lu found out that the Yaoyang Sect Master offered to make contact and was refused by himself, there would likely be consequences.
"Helping to contact the Heavenly Court Sect is possible, but we're not a charity here. What price is your sect willing to pay?"
Vice Sect Hierarch Chi was prepared for this and gave a look to the Protector behind him. The Protector then took out a piece of yellow paper from his chest and placed it in front of Mu Baiyi.
"I've heard that your barbecue restaurant offers a delivery service, but because it involves traveling between cities, the skewers cool down over time and the taste suffers."
"This is a unique type of paper from our sect, capable of heating and keeping warmth. Also, it is easy to produce and costs little. If you're interested, Daoist Mu, I can share with you the method for making this paper."
For the Yaoyang Sect, this paper was superfluous, of no use to keep, but too precious to discard. It would be better used as a token to curry favor with the Jiuyou Sect and establish a rapport with the Heavenly Court Sect.
Mu Baiyi and Vice Sect Hierarch Shi, standing behind him, both brightened up at this. It was truly a useful item that could greatly increase their delivery volume.
"Good, I will contact them right now."
Seeing the sincerity of the other party, Mu Baiyi immediately took out the Jiuyou Order.
"But let me make it clear in advance, I can only contact Young Master Lu and don't have contact details for anyone else from the Heavenly Court Sect."
"Young Master Lu is fine," said Vice Sect Hierarch Chi eagerly, as Young Master Lu's status was entirely a match for the leader of a demonic sect.
Mu Baiyi wrote down on the Jiuyou Order Vice Sect Hierarch Chi's request for a meeting, and soon, the other side responded.
"What did they say?"
"The old place, Yanjiang County, let's meet at the barbecue restaurant headquarters again."
Vice Sect Hierarch Chi was elated at the news and immediately shared the method for refining the heating paper with Mu Baiyi, who realized after a brief mental run-through that it was indeed genuine.
Moreover, the Yaoyang Sect would not dare deceive him on this matter.
"Could I trouble Daoist Mu to put in a few good words for me with Young Master Lu?"
"No problem at all!"
...
In Yanjiang County, at the barbecue restaurant headquarters, the three parties met.
Mu Baiyi and Vice Sect Hierarch Chi sat upright with bated breath, nervous sweat beading on their backs.
"Daoist Mu, didn't you say you would put in a few good words for me? Speak up!" Vice Sect Hierarch Chi transmitted his voice to Mu Baiyi.
Mu Baiyi broke out in a cold sweat, no longer retaining his previous composure.
Sitting opposite them were Jiang Lianyi, the Great Emperor of the Southern Pole Nirvana, and Yun Zhi, the Master of the Heavenly Court Sect.
Upon learning that leaders of the sects were meeting, Lu Yang, out of respect for the Jiuyou Sect and the Yaoyang Sect, and to show the sincerity of the Heavenly Court Sect, had specifically invited the Sect Master of his sect to attend.

chapters.title: Chapter 642 - 641: Saint Heir of the Heavenly Court Sect
chapters.content:
The barbecue restaurant headquarters closed up for the night, unknown to all, under its calm exterior, currents swirled.
Tonight, the leaders of the three sects were meeting here.
The Jiuyou Sect and the Yaoyang Sect attached great importance to the meeting with the Heavenly Court Sect.
The leaders of both sects personally received their guests, accompanied by a number of Body Integration Realm experts, displaying the profound depth of the demonic sects.
The Heavenly Court Sect also greatly valued the two sects, the Master, the Great Emperor of Southern Nirvana, all were present, sitting in chairs with four Protector Heavenly Kings standing behind them.
Even Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had to stand in the back row in such a situation.
If one were to consider the Immortal Fairy within Lu Yang's body, it could be said that Heavenly Venerate Dou was also present.
Mu Baiyi and Sect Master Chi were extremely nervous; who would have thought that just a meeting would bring such important figures from the Heavenly Court Sect.
What use was there in bringing so many people, all together they still couldn't match the power of a single Phoenix Ancestor.
The scene of the Phoenix Ancestor's battle with Ancient Di Jiang was captured by the Recording Orb and had gone viral among the upper echelons of the Cultivation World; anyone who saw it broke out in a cold sweat, feeling inferior.
Not to mention the Master of the Heavenly Court Sect who was seated there, someone only talked about but never seen.
The strength of the Heavenly Court Sect Master was a mystery, according to what Young Master Lu had said before, she had fought evenly with Yun Zhi, who was suspected to be in the late Pass Tribulation stage, meaning she was also at that level!
"You, you all, greetings. I, on behalf of the Jiuyou Sect, welcome all members of the Heavenly Court Sect," said Mu Baiyi, forcing calmness, stumbling over his words as he started the meeting.
After all, this was the Jiuyou Sect's territory, so he had to take the initiative.
"I don't know if Young Master Lu has introduced me to the two of you. My name is Mu Baiyi, the Master of the Jiuyou Sect."
"This is Chi Dongfang, Master of the Yaoyang Sect."
"You, you all, hello." Sect Master Chi was also shaken by their arrival, his eyelids twitching as he strove to calm his emotions.
"I'm called Jiang Lianyi; you should have all seen me before," Jiang Lianyi greeted lazily.
"We have seen Elder Jiang before," both Masters said in unison.
"My name is Yun Mengmeng; both of you can address me as Sect Leader Yun."
"We have seen Sect Leader Yun before."
The Eldest Senior Sister's disguise skills were far more sophisticated than those of the Nine Disciples of the Dao Seeking Sect; no one could recognize her.
Her voice was cold, with a sense of detachment from this world, looking down at all beings with profound indifference:
"Little Lu mentioned that two leaders wanted to meet with him, but he felt that, as merely the Young Sect Master, he is not qualified to welcome leaders of your stature. What is it that you seek with Little Lu?"
Sect Master Chi laughed apologetically, "The great name of the Heavenly Court Sect is widely known, full of heroes and deep roots; thus, I wished to meet and acquaint myself. No demands, no demands."
As a sign of sincerity, he took several treasures out of his Storage Ring.
"A mere token of my respect, not worthy of it truly."
These treasures were hastily chosen from his collection, the gifts originally planned for Young Master Lu were not sufficient for this gathering.
