Lu Yang identified each of the treasures: the highest quality Life-Sustaining Pills, immensely helpful in restoring spiritual essence for those in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage; the Stone Marrow of Longevity, the essence born from the Stone of Longevity, capable of extending life by eight hundred years, assuming no other longevity items had been consumed; the Taiyi True Water, known as the water of the beginning, which could accelerate the cultivation pace of cultivators with a Water Spirit Root...
The Fourth Elder stepped forward, took the treasures, and returned to his original position.
"I heard that your Yaoyang Sect venerates the sun, believing that the sun is the source of all cultivation?" Jiang Lianyi said with a chuckle, finding it quite novel when she heard Lu Yang introduce the Yaoyang Sect — it was the first time she had heard such a theory.
After all, the sun thirty-thousand years ago was actually the domain of the Golden Crow tribe, and she was the queen of all birds; even the Golden Crow tribe respected her above all.
Not a single member of the Golden Crow tribe managed to cultivate to the Semi-Immortal realm, and thirty-thousand years have passed, the Golden Crow tribe has long since been extinct.
As for what the current sun is, she didn't know.
Yun Zhi nodded, "There are indeed claims about the sun. I once attempted to fly into the sun to investigate, but, unfortunately, an unparalleled great array sealed it off, making it impossible for me to peek or enter."
Sect Leader Chi slapped his thigh, no longer afraid when it came to professional matters: "My sect and Sect Leader Yun observed the same phenomenon. There's a seal around the sun, preventing any possibility of exploration."
"Someone must have sealed the sun, preventing us from gaining more power from it!"
Yun Zhi did not echo Sect Leader Chi, but continued, "If the great array were forcibly broken, unpredictable events might occur."
"Unpredictable events?" Sect Leader Chi was taken aback, after all, they didn't possess the ability to forcibly break the sealing array.
"The sun could split apart, leading to a catastrophe for all living beings," Yun Zhi said calmly, leaving Sect Leader Chi terrified.
Lu Yang had just found out that Eldest Senior Sister had investigated the sun.
Eldest Senior Sister sent a voice transmission to Lu Yang, "Judging from the style of the array method, it must have been left by cultivators of Great Yu or Great Qian. It's of a high level, at the Immortal grade. The purpose of constructing the array is unclear.
It may be to announce sovereignty over the sun, perhaps for protective purposes to prevent cultivators from damaging the sun in battle, of course, there might be other reasons."
Lu Yang was startled. Since Eldest Senior Sister confirmed it was an Immortal-level array and suggested that it was the work of Great Yu or Great Qian cultivators, that meant there were immortals among the cultivators of these two eras!
"Do not fear immortals, Miss Yun can slay immortals, and so can this fairy!" Fairy Eternity slapped her chest and gave herself a thumbs-up, signaling to Lu Yang to be at ease. She wouldn't allow herself to be outdone by Miss Yun in this aspect.
Lu Yang felt that Eldest Senior Sister's Imitation Fist was still more reliable.
Sect Leader Chi then said, "Our sect has discovered that to obtain the power of the sun, one must first gain its recognition."
"My sect's Saint Heir is, indeed, one of the geniuses who has gained the sun's recognition."
As the sound of his voice fell, a tall and handsome sunny cultivator stepped forward, emitting a surprising Yang Qi. This seemed to be the constitution described in legends, one that hadn't appeared in a thousand years.
"Wu Qihang greets all the seniors!"
Wu Qihang clasped his fists in greeting, his posture perfect.
"This is our sect's Saint Heir Wu Qihang, with a Pure Yang Immortal Body. I wonder if he might catch the eye of Sect Leader Yun or Elder Jiang and if my disciple might interact with peers from your esteemed sect?"
To garner attention from the Heavenly Court Sect, they needed to showcase the strength of the Yaoyang Sect. A competition among high-level members was out of the question, but allowing the disciples to compete was an option.
Lu Yang glanced sideways. Pure Yang Immortal Body — one of the nine great Immortal bodies; he hadn't expected the Yaoyang Sect to really find such a talented treasure. Without asking, he knew that this person was undoubtedly the main focus of the Yaoyang Sect's cultivator, perhaps even the only one.
"Haha, a Pure Yang Immortal Body is indeed rare. I didn't expect to meet one here. Let me give it a try!"
A man strode out like a shooting star, his bearing majestic, emitting Yang Qi that should not be possible at his current realm. Behind his head, a Pure Yang Tai Chi Diagram slowly revolved, like an innate divine presence!
"You are..."
"Heavenly Court Sect's Saint Heir, Long Jingzhou!"

chapters.title: Chapter 643 - 642 Meng Jingzhou: What sort of thing dares to compare its Yang Qi with me?
chapters.content:
At the moment he saw Meng Jingzhou, Sect Leader Yun suddenly widened his eyes, his face full of disbelief.
He was extremely sensitive to Yang Qi, and he could feel the richness of the Yang Qi emanating from Meng Jingzhou's body, not at all inferior to the one he had carefully cultivated in Wu Qihang!
What's going on, could it be that the other party is also a Pure Yang Immortal Body?!
A Long Clan surname, a genius of the ancient Dragon tribe?
The hybrid offspring of the Dragon and Human races were called the Long Clan; in ancient times, they had their own planet, and now the Long Clan lived in the East Sea.
"Junior Brother Long, show some respect!" Lu Yang rebuked Meng Jingzhou with some displeasure, "The Sect Leader and Elder Lianyi have yet to agree, how dare you join the fight!"
Meng Jingzhou frowned and retorted, "If the Yaoyang Sect wants to exchange, should we avoid battle?"
"Lu surnamed, don't think that just because you are highly regarded by the Heavenly Venerate and Sect Leader, you can do whatever you want, you are not the Sect Leader!"
"Behaving timidly is a disgrace to the Heavenly Court's reputation!"
Lu Yang looked coldly at Meng Jingzhou, not taking his provocation to heart, "Respecting elders and acting prudently is the way of the Heavenly Court!"
Meng Jingzhou sneered, "If I were prudent in my actions, I couldn't have become the Saint Heir, don't forget how I got this title!"
"Sooner or later, I'll take over your position as the Young Sect Master!"
"Enough, no more arguing."
Sect Leader Yun said, his voice soft but final, "If Little Long wishes to engage with the opponent, then let him engage."
Meng Jingzhou's eyes lit up with joy, kneeling on the ground and clenching his fists tightly, "Thank you, Sect Leader."
Sect Leader Yun raised an eyebrow; it seemed there wasn't complete unity within the Heavenly Court Sect.
The two young geniuses faced each other, with the Yaoyang Sect making introductions first, "I am Wu Qihang, the Saint Heir of the Yaoyang Sect!"
Meng Jingzhou raised his hand and waved casually, "Heavenly Court, Long Jingzhou."
"No offense intended!"
Facing the Saint Heir of the Heavenly Court Sect, Wu Qihang did not dare to be careless, especially noticing the Pure Yang Tai Chi Diagram hanging behind the other's head, which was very eye-catching and obviously not ordinary.
Since his birth, it was the first time he had encountered someone of the same realm whose Yang Qi could rival his own.
Meng Jingzhou revealed a mocking smile, "Offended? Do you really think you can beat me?"
"We'll see with a test!" Humiliated several times, Wu Qihang also became enraged. He was a genius hidden away by the Yaoyang Sect, confident that in terms of talent and combat strength, he was second to none among the top geniuses of his time!
The two moved almost simultaneously, instantly emitting a thunderous explosion, with flames shooting into the sky and deafening sounds filling the air.
For today's meeting, both sects concealed the heavens' secrets in this place, isolating the barbecue restaurant's headquarters from the outside world, so nothing that happened inside would be known to the outside.
Including the duel between the two geniuses.
"Heavenly Days Beget the Residual Night!"
Behind Wu Qihang, a miracle appeared, with the dark waves of the sea supporting a slowly rising sun, symbolizing hope and light, and the entire hall's temperature soared instantly, leaving scorch marks on the floor and furniture!
Sect Leader Yun watched his good disciple's silhouette with satisfaction. It seemed he hadn't forgotten his teachings; when facing a powerful enemy, any tentative attack could put oneself at a disadvantage, so it was better to use full strength to suppress the opponent right from the start!
"This is the phenomenon possessed by the Pure Yang Immortal Body after breaking core to reach Nascent, capable of preliminarily increasing the surrounding temperature; it is the most basic realm," explained Jiang Lianyi, with a slightly regretful tone.
"In Ancient Times, there was a Pure Yang Immortal Body whose combat strength was against the heavens, possessing such vigorous life force that even severed limbs could regenerate.
The Golden Crow tribe, the contemporary representatives of the sun, were extremely envious; the Golden Crow genius fought the person numerous times and was defeated each time, their Dao heart shattered, leading them to withdraw from the battle for immortality voluntarily,"
"Later, the two fell in love and promised each other a lifetime under the witness of the sun."
```
"...Wait a minute, fell in love?" Lu Yang interrupted Jiang Lianyi's narrative, suspecting he had heard wrong.
"The genius from the Golden Crow Clan is a fair maiden with bright eyes and red hair, quite pretty to look at. What's wrong with liking someone from the Pure Yang Immortal Body?"
"No problem, please continue."
"Later, the Pure Yang Immortal Body recognized his ancestors and returned to his clan, only to find out that he was also from the Golden Crow Clan, to be exact, half from the Golden Crow Clan. His mother was from the Golden Crow Clan, and his father was from the human race."
"His mother had fled her marriage from the Golden Crow Clan and fell in love with his father. After she gave birth to him, she was captured and taken back to the Golden Crow Clan. His father desperately tried to stop them, but it was in vain."
"He also discovered that the Golden Crow Clan's genius was his own younger sister, born to his mother after she was taken back, with the man she was supposed to marry."
"And then?"
"In the end, his mother became the Clan Leader of the Golden Crow Clan and had two husbands."
"..."
Lu Yang felt a headache coming on; such a complicated relationship. Better to just watch Old Meng fight.
Meng Jingzhou was like a war god on the battlefield, his Pure Yang Tai Chi Diagram shining like another sun, its brilliance surpassing even the phenomena of the Pure Yang Immortal Body, at times showing a tendency to suppress the latter.
As a Body Cultivator, one adept in physical cultivation, the two collided with their bodies. Wu Qihang suffered a major disadvantage upon contact, as the opponent's Yang Qi was so vigorous it could form a Golden Body, incredibly sturdy and indestructible.
"Impossible!"
Wu Qihang yelled in disbelief. Even if the other was also a Pure Yang Immortal Body, at most, it should be a draw, not such an overwhelming disparity!
Sect Leader Yun was also puzzled, speculating about Meng Jingzhou's body constitution. With everyone from the Heavenly Court Sect present, he didn't dare to examine him rashly.
"There are only a few body constitutions in this world with robust innate Yang Qi; the Single Body Spiritual Root, the Child Golden Body, the Pure Yang Immortal Body..."
"It feels like the Single Body Spiritual Root, but the Single Body Spiritual Root is slightly weaker than the Pure Yang Immortal Body. It shouldn't be showing such strength?"
Sect Leader Yun was at a loss for a while, feeling that the Heavenly Court Sect was unfathomably deep, and this Saint Heir Meng Jingzhou might possess some kind of ancient body constitution.
Meng Jingzhou smiled coldly, without offering much explanation, like a great master of the Martial Dao, every move demonstrating his understanding of martial arts and his control over power.
Wu Qihang, refusing to accept this, had fists glowing red, skin burning hot, like two little suns, his body fluids evaporating, forming steam that sizzled with white vapor, cloaking him like a monster born in the sun.
"Sun Fist!"
Meng Jingzhou laughed heartily, never afraid of anyone in a fistfight, not even Lu Yang if he showed up.
As the two exchanged punches, sawdust flew from the floorboards, sparking in the air, flurrying and scattering, turning to ashes.
"This is the Pure Yang Tai Chi Fist!"
Lu Yang, as if facing a great enemy, clenched his teeth: "He really managed to figure it out!"
"Tai Chi aims for softness to overcome hardness, but his Pure Yang Tai Chi Fist aims for hardness to overcome hardness, using absolute strength to defeat the opponent. Even I would have to exert myself to beat him!"
Wu Qihang was blasted away by Meng Jingzhou, hitting the wall and coughing up blood unceasingly.
Not willing to give in, he stared at the figure standing amid the dust: "You, what is your body constitution!"
The Yang Qi was so heavy that it made him feel cold inside.
Meng Jingzhou sneered, full of disdain.
"You're just someone who relies on body constitution! All of my cultivation is the result of hard work and practice, what has it got to do with my body constitution!"
"The hardships I've endured for the sake of power, are nothing you could possibly imagine!"
```

chapters.title: Chapter 644 - 643: The Origin of the Jiuyou Sect
chapters.content:
Meng Jingzhou spoke the absolute truth, which even Lu Yang had to admit.
According to records, Old Meng was the only one with a Single Body Spiritual Root who had pushed himself to the brink of death through cultivation, commendable for both his courage and perseverance.
Wu Qihang's defeat lacked suspense, and even if it were to happen again, the outcome would be unchanged. Wu Qihang willingly admitted defeat; their hearts in pursuit of the Dao were too far apart.
He knew he was no match once he heard Meng Jingzhou's disdain for the physique.
"I've learned my lesson."
The protectors of Yaoyang Sect helped him up and took him to the back yard for healing.
Sect Leader Yun took a sip of tea to moisten his throat and said at a leisurely pace, "Master Chi, it seems that the saint heir of your sect has some deficiencies in his cultivation, you must carefully guide him once you return."
"Indeed, indeed," Master Chi said, sweating profusely, feeling once again the unfathomable depths of the Heavenly Court Sect and the need to cling to them tightly.
He made eye signals to Mu Baiyi, who remained silent, hoping to smooth things over, but Mu Baiyi pretended not to see.
It's your own fault for wanting to showcase the might of Yaoyang Sect, what does your embarrassment have to do with me?
Reaching into his bosom, Mu Baiyi took out a storage ring and offered it to Yun Zhi with an apologetic smile, "Sect Leader Yun, this is the earnings from our business. According to our agreement, sixty percent belongs to your sect."
Yun Zhi scanned it briefly with her Spiritual Sense and then tossed it back to Mu Baiyi.
Confused about her intentions, Mu Baiyi wondered if he had done something wrong to offend the Heavenly Court Sect.
"The barbecue shop is developing and needs funds now, so keep this money for the time being. Once it stabilizes and turns a profit, we can return our share."
Overjoyed at the words, Mu Baiyi realized that the Heavenly Court Sect had been paying close attention to the growth of the barbecue shop and appreciated his hard work.
With these spirit stones, the speed of opening new barbecue shops would only increase!
Great Xia was within their grasp.
"Master Mu, I have some new ideas for improving the quality of the skewers. You might want to give them a try," Lu Yang smiled and pulled a scripture from his storage ring.
"What is this?"
"The Rebirth Mantra. When slaughtering livestock, the animals generate resentment that lingers in the meat and affects its quality. By reciting the Rebirth Mantra during slaughter, this issue can be easily resolved."
"I've tested it, and it indeed improves the taste of the skewers."
Mu Baiyi's eyes widened in amazement and his mouth opened wide in delight.
If Young Sect Master Lu had put it into practice, there was nothing to doubt.
"But the Rebirth Mantra... Does your sect also delve into Buddhist teachings?"
None of the members of the Heavenly Court Sect he had dealt with seemed to be from Buddhism.
"Buddhist teachings?" Lu Yang chuckled lightly, finding the question laughably naive.
"My master, Heavenly Venerate Dou, is one of the founders of Buddhism. How could he not be well-versed in its teachings?"
"What?!"
Both Mu Baiyi and Master Chi were unable to stay calm, as were the protectors from both sects. The fearsomeness of Heavenly Venerate Dou was far beyond their imagination!
A founder of Buddhism—what an immensely important status. Perhaps even Buddhism itself was unaware of this matter; otherwise, they would have come to worship Heavenly Venerate Dou long ago.
If Heavenly Venerate Dou were to make public his identity as a founder, all of Buddhism would rely on him to seek acknowledgment of the orthodox way.
Such is the power of figures from Ancient Times; their actions and influence carried from Ancient Times into the present, their influence profoundly far-reaching.
Mu Baiyi asked again, "I also saw Elder Jiang showing great prowess in Demon City, defeating Venerate Zhu Tian. Since then, the Phoenix Tribe has even taken the initiative towards the Demon Nation. So, about this Demon Nation..."
"You're quite sharp-minded for a junior," Jiang Lianyi admitted directly, without any attempt to conceal it. "You guessed right, Zhu Tian is under my control, and the power of the Demon Nation can be utilized by me."
Silence, absolute silence.
Everyone from both sects held their breath upon hearing the news, and the whole place fell deathly quiet.
Gulp.
Sect Leader Chi swallowed, his hands turning cold.
The vast Demon Nation—had it just become part of the Heavenly Court Sect?
Mu Baiyi had anticipated this, but he was still shocked when Jiang Lianyi admitted it directly.
Yun Zhi's cool voice carried a hint of nonchalance, "The enemies of the Heavenly Venerate are the Yingtian Immortal and three other immortals. If even the Demon Nation can't be controlled, how can we talk about dealing with the four immortals?"
"The waters of Great Xia run deeper than I imagined. At the very least, there's one Immortal. The scuffles between your two sects have not been taken seriously by the dynasty, but if this continues... in this tumultuous time, it's easy for things to change."
"The Eternity Sect is a lesson from the past. If the Eternity Sect still existed, the demonic sect could have had another Semi-Immortal. Such a pity."
Semi-Immortal?
"So what you're saying is..." Mu Baiyi said.
The response was a cold look.
"Speaking of which, how did your Jiuyou Sect come to discover 'Nine Nether'?" Yun Zhi continued, "According to my investigation, since the disappearance of the ancient Nine Nether, there has been no trace of it in the world. Yet your Jiuyou Sect insists that there is a Nine Nether in the world that offers souls reincarnation. What's the story behind this?"
The origin of the Jiuyou Sect had always been a mystery, only known to the high-ranking insiders. This was a good opportunity to ask.
The Heavenly Court Sect had questions, and naturally, Mu Baiyi was expected to answer them, but before that, they needed to send the Yaoyang Sect away.
"Sect Leader Chi, it's getting late. May I see you out?"
Sect Leader Chi could hear the hint to leave. Since he had already accomplished his goal for the night, the origin of the Jiuyou Sect was of no concern to him.
"Let's go."
After the Yaoyang Sect left, Mu Baiyi saw that only his own people were left and felt reassured to speak, "Actually, it's not really a secret. The reason we believe in the existence of Nine Nether begins with the founder of our sect."
"Eighty thousand years ago, the founder was born, seemingly with innate knowledge. His mind was always filled with various cultivation knowledge, which became clearer with the rise of his cultivation level. All those pieces of cultivation knowledge were verified to be true, except for one that didn't match the theories of the time."
"Reincarnation?"
"Yes, reincarnation. In his memories, he mentioned that the souls of all the deceased would reincarnate in a place called 'Nine Nether'. He was no exception. The only difference was that while everyone else would have their memories erased after reincarnation, he retained the memories of his past life."
"For this reason, he secretly established the Jiuyou Sect, intending to investigate the mysteries of reincarnation and to discover the whereabouts of Nine Nether."
"Our founder wasn't exactly reincarnated in the true sense; his memories were vague. To speak disrespectfully, it might have been the result of a failed Possession by a Great Power."
"As for the most recent case, it would be my predecessor, Sect Leader Qin Haoran."
"After Sect Leader Qin passed away, the three Vice Sect Hierarchs stumbled upon a page from Sect Leader Qin's diary. The diary recorded Qin Haoran's confusion about his past life and his incomprehension of the future."
"So, they each found a cultivator who claimed to be the reincarnation of Sect Leader Qin to inherit his legacy."
At this point, Mu Baiyi showed a pleasing smile, leaning slightly forward, "I, of course, don't believe in those they have found. I only trust your sect's judgment. Your Sect's Qin Yanyan is indeed the reincarnation of Sect Leader Qin."

chapters.title: Chapter 645 - 644: Li Haoran's Nascent Soul
chapters.content:
Mu Baiyi originally didn't care about who was the reincarnation of Sect Leader Qin, assuming that with Qin Haoran's poverty, could there possibly be any money left in his inheritance?
Anything of value would have been sold long ago, so how could it have lasted until now?
He couldn't plainly tell the three Vice Sect Hierarchs about this; if they knew that the Jiuyou Sect was without money, there would be trouble.
Moreover, the three Vice Sect Hierarchs had deeper seniority than he did; if the three of them wished to fight over Qin Haoran's legacy, let them fight. Whichever home the flower falls into, what did it have to do with him?
But now it was different—the power of the Heavenly Court Sect was laid out here, and whether Qin Yanyan was a reincarnation or not, she had to be a reincarnation!
Gender was not an issue, nor was there any rule that determined one must retain the same gender after reincarnation.
Furthermore, the Heavenly Court Sect had Heavenly Venerate Dou and the Phoenix Ancestor, surely they were more powerful than the three Vice Sect Hierarchs, so the person they identified was definitely reliable.
If they really could find the reincarnation of Sect Leader Qin it would be perfect; this would be the first example to truly confirm the existence of reincarnation!
For the Jiuyou Sect, there could be no better news than this.
The reason they worked hard to build Fengdu was just for this.
Seeing that she couldn't get any more useful information from Mu Baiyi, the Eldest Senior Sister bid farewell with a word and got up to leave directly.
As people from the Heavenly Court Sect left one after another, Mu Baiyi and the Protectors finally breathed a sigh of relief.
The presence of Sect Leader Yun was too overpowering; even just sitting opposite her made him feel weak in the knees, not to mention those Protectors standing behind him.
"Phew—finally they have left."
Mu Baiyi had been afraid to even breathe too heavily from beginning to end, constantly anxious, fearing a single wrong word might anger these two ancient Great Powers.
The Eldest Senior Sister took Lu Yang and others back to the Seek Dao Sect on a cloud. After the four Elders who were there for show left, they started to analyze the origins of the Jiuyou Sect.
Matters involving Immortals were dangerous; it was harm and no benefit for the Elders to know, it was better not to know.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were already in the game; it made no difference for them to know.
"The role of the Jiuyou Sect is different from what was expected."
"I originally thought that the purpose of establishing the Jiuyou Sect was the same as that of founding the Eternity Sect, which was to condense the outline of the Dao Fruit."
"Looking at the matter with the ancestor of the Jiuyou Sect, it seems that the 'Reincarnation Dao Fruit Outline' came first, followed by the Jiuyou Sect."
"Who exactly condensed the 'Reincarnation Dao Fruit Outline'?"
"Why not ask Junior Brother Li? As the ninth life, he should know more than Mu Baiyi does," Lu Yang suggested.
Li Haoran was the most solid proof of the "Reincarnation" reality, and he also had the memories of Qin Haoran; he certainly knew more than Mu Baiyi did.
"That's a good idea."
The Eldest Senior Sister was decisive and immediate in action. As soon as she said they would ask, she led everyone straight to the Fifth Peak.
"Is he in closed-door cultivation?"
The abode of Li Haoran was tightly closed, and there was dust accumulated at the entrance, indicating that he had been in seclusion for at least a month or more.
"He is preparing to make a breakthrough to the Nascent Soul Stage," the Eldest Senior Sister realized with a sweep of her Spiritual Sense what Li Haoran was doing inside the abode.
"Judging from the progress of his cultivation, he will break through to the Nascent Soul Stage in half a day; let's wait."
"Alright."
Half a day passed in the blink of an eye for cultivators.
"The breakthrough is coming."
Noticing the fluctuating energy emanating from deep within the abode, this was a sign of approaching the Nascent Soul Stage breakthrough.
The energy in the abode surged and ebbed like towering waves in a tsunami, and like a volcano suppressed for too long, just waiting for an outlet to erupt!
Boom—
At the moment when the energy reached its critical point, the power hidden within the Golden Core fully burst forth, like a volcanic eruption. The intense fire energy was so concentrated that it didn't even escape the abode!
The Seek Dao Sect provided abodes of extremely high quality for its disciples so it wouldn't fail to contain the energy of breaking core to reach Nascent.
Meng Jingzhou was an exception; he did it on purpose.
The terrifying flame power converged into the body of its master, and with a loud bang, the abode's door flung open, revealing Li Haoran's hearty laughter, "Hahaha, I've finally reached the Nascent Soul Stage!"
Then he saw the Eldest Senior Sister and others sitting at the doorway, and his laughter came to an abrupt halt.
"E-Eldest Senior Sister, hello."
"Mm, hello to you too."
"..."
Li Haoran didn't know what to say because of the sudden appearance of the Eldest Senior Sister.
"You should first stabilize your breath. It's taboo to experience great joy or sorrow right after a breakthrough."
"Oh, okay."
Li Haoran quickly sat cross-legged on the spot, silently reciting a calming mantra to stabilize his breath and regulate his body.
When he opened his eyes again, he was met with Meng Jingzhou's looming face, which gave him quite a fright.
"Senior Brother Meng, what are you doing? You scared me to death."
"Just observing what kind of Nascent Soul you've condensed to see if I can borrow it."
"So, did you figure it out?"
"No."
Li Haoran's mouth twitched. Was this something you could just observe by getting closer? He pushed away Meng Jingzhou's big face, "Then step back, I'll show you again."
The Eldest Senior Sister was there; it was the perfect opportunity to show off.
Li Haoran summoned his Nascent Soul, which was different from everyone else's in color, a red Nascent Soul made up of flames.
"A Nascent Soul that has absorbed two types of True Fire?" Both the Eldest Senior Sister and Jiang Lianyi had seen many Nascent Souls, especially Jiang Lianyi, who had seen many types of Nascent Souls during the era of ancient geniuses.
Except for Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, and the Man Gu's.
"Cultivators with the Fire Spirit Root have a chance to condense a Nascent Soul like this one. Because of its affinity with flame and its baby-like appearance, the Cultivation World usually refers to this kind of Nascent Soul as..."
Lu Yang blurted out, "Red Child?"
The Eldest Senior Sister glanced at Lu Yang, "Huo Ying."
"But that's just a matter of naming. Like how Junior Brother Meng's Single Body Spiritual Root is also known as the Pure Yang Spirit Root, you can call it Red Child if you like."
"Ignite!"
Li Haoran shouted loudly, and under the influence of the Huo Ying, his body erupted in blazing True Fire, preventing any enemy from approaching.
"Does your Nascent Soul have any other functions?" Meng Jingzhou asked again.
Li Haoran laughed heartily, dissipating the True Fire, "Of course, it does."
"But that's all theoretical; give me a moment to prepare."
Li Haoran frowned in silence for a long time, retracted his Nascent Soul into his body, and then let out a pained cry.
There was a loud bang, and Li Haoran's body exploded, tearing into pieces, his limbs, torso, and head flying in different directions, startling Meng Jingzhou immensely.
Had Junior Brother Li finally succumbed to the pain of relying on others and chosen to end his misery?
At that moment, Li Haoran was flying freely in the air, even doing flips and somersaults, laughing as he explained, "Don't panic, Senior Brother Meng, this is the ability of my Nascent Soul."
While speaking, Li Haoran's limbs and torso started to move, taking on different postures, clearly being controlled by someone.
"The Regeneration Golden Core allows me to regenerate from severed limbs, and after reaching the Nascent Soul Stage, this ability has been enhanced. Even if my body is dismembered like this, I can still control and recover."
"However, the head consumes too much to restore, so I've decided to do this."
The limbs and torso formed a new whole, displaying various skills, while Li Haoran's head hid at a distance, his expression smug and proud.
"In this way, my head won't get hurt."

chapters.title: Chapter 646 - 646: 645
chapters.content:
"If you want to increase deterrence, you can also do this!"
Huo Ying displayed its might once again, and Li Haoran's body and head were coated with a layer of flames. If he were to suddenly appear at night, he could make a bunch of people cry in fright.
Lu Yang seriously contemplated the uses of Li Haoran's Nascent Soul.
"If the body is completely disassembled, there will be six parts attacking. If controlled properly, the enemy will face attacks from six directions, making it hard to defend against."
"If only the head flies out, with the remaining body forming a headless corpse to attack, it would be first-rate in saving one's skin."
"Senior Brother Lu, I have more than just this one way to save my skin!" Hearing Lu Yang's analysis, Li Haoran burst into laughter.
"Unify!"
His head reattached to his neck without a single flaw, showing no indication that just a second earlier, he had been in a headless corpse form.
"Come on, Senior Brother Lu, attack me!"
Lu Yang didn't hold back. His two fingers came together, and he directed an invisible Sword Qi at Li Haoran.
With a slight shake of his body, Li Haoran's right arm detached, and the invisible Sword Qi flew between his torso and right arm.
"How about that?" Li Haoran reattached his right arm, spun around, and his body was unharmed, intact.
"Interesting, what if it's like this?"
Lu Yang didn't give Li Haoran time to react, striking out over ten Sword Qis in quick succession—a barrage Li Haoran definitely couldn't dodge with his dismemberment trick!
Li Haoran's expression changed, as his reaction speed truly wasn't quick enough to dodge so many Sword Qis.
However, he soon revealed a slight smile.
It wasn't without a solution.
He took off his head, held it by the hair, swung his arm around, and with a swish, he threw his head out.
Thump thump thump thump.
Li Haoran's body solidly withstood all the Sword Qis, while his head turned into a streak of light and fled far away—if the Sword Qis had been a certain death attack, he could use this method to escape with his life.
Lu Yang couldn't help but applaud. This Red Child's Nascent Soul was indeed useful and versatile, all depending on one's imagination.
Not long after, Li Haoran's head flew back, reuniting with his body, restored as before.
"Hiss, Senior Brother Lu, you really don't hold back."
Upon reuniting with his body, Li Haoran felt the pain from the Sword Qi wounds.
Meng Jingzhou watched Li Haoran's Huo Ying and fell into deep thought. His own Nascent Soul could transform into three heads and six arms, but could Junior Brother Li's Nascent Soul allow his three heads and six arms to fly everywhere?
Unlike Li Haoran, who used magic skills as his means of attack, he was a Body Cultivator, heavily relying on the integrity of his body. Breaking his body apart to strike the enemy was nowhere near as powerful as assuming a stance and throwing a couple of punches...
"Wait a minute, it actually could be done..."
Suddenly, Meng Jingzhou had an idea and approached Li Haoran.
"Junior Brother Li, I'd like to discuss something with you. I have some insights about cultivating at the Nascent Soul Stage and need your cooperation."
"What insights?"
"My physique is a bit special, I can borrow other people's Nascent Souls. Here is a cultivation technique for you to study—it would enable you to lend me your Nascent Soul."
Li Haoran had an odd look on his face; it was the first time he had heard that Nascent Souls could be borrowed.
Could it be that the Meng Family didn't just lend money, but also Nascent Souls?
"I'll study it."
Li Haoran quickly learned the cultivation technique Meng Jingzhou handed over—a mere sheet of paper, extremely simple, faster even than learning Man Gu.
The two sat cross-legged, resonating with each other. Huo Ying flew out of Li Haoran's body and into Meng Jingzhou's Dantian.
Meng Jingzhou felt the power of Huo Ying, a force only present in the stage of three Nascent Souls, extraordinary and peerless.
He let out a loud shout, initiating the process of Nascent Soul Unification, and once again became a divine being with four heads and eight arms.
Next, Meng Jingzhou severed four of his arms, allowing the remaining four arms to hold them. This transformed him into a divine being with four heads and four arms, as well as four weapons!
Meng Jingzhou "ha" and "heied" as he swung the detached arms, whipping up a wind, using them as if they were the most suitable weapons for him, perfect and natural.
"Success!"
Li Haoran watched, the corners of his eyes twitching slightly, feeling that Senior Brother Meng resembled not so much a cultivator of the Righteous Path, but more like a leader of the Demon Path.
Eldest Senior Sister, who had kept silent until now, spoke up. Her voice was soft, yet it carried the power to quiet the entire scene, "Junior Brother Li, we've just returned from the Jiuyou Sect. They shared with us the origins of their sect. Do you have memories regarding this part?"
As soon as it came to serious business, Meng Jingzhou promptly returned the Nascent Soul to Li Haoran.
Hearing about the origins of the Jiuyou Sect, Li Haoran paused, then nodded sincerely, "Indeed, but it's not very complete."
"Qin Haoran said to Senior Yi Ren that he was in his eighth Reincarnation, and I am in the ninth."
"The reason he could ascertain he was in his eighth lifetime was because he carried the memories of his previous seven lives."
"However, I have not yet fully inherited Qin Haoran's memories, they are intermittent regarding the earlier lives."
"But, it does not matter."
Li Haoran nodded, sifting through the vast memories of Qin Haoran for relevant information.
Qin Haoran possessed nearly two thousand years of memories, a voluminous quantity that Li Haoran could not bear. In order not to lose himself in the sea of memories, Li Haoran asked his master to seal away those memories, to be unsealed only when needed, bit by bit.
"The memories from my first three lives are quite vague, I can't recall what happened."
"About eighty thousand years ago, in my fourth life, due to a fortunate coincidence, 'I' awakened, gaining some past life memories. From those memories, 'I' learned about cultivation and embarked on the path of cultivation."
"As the cultivation level increased, other parts of the memories from the first three lives surfaced, such as 'Nine Nether' and 'Reincarnation,' something Mu Baiyi should have already discussed with you."
"Relying on the fragmented memories of the past lives, the fourth life established the Jiuyou Sect to delve into the true meaning of Reincarnation."
"Of course, nothing substantial was gained, and to add insult to injury, the sect's den was raided by two constables. Because he was a man of great integrity, allowing his subordinates to flee while he covered for them, he failed to escape and was caught and sentenced to life imprisonment."
"In the fifth life, I reincarnated in the Buddha Country and renounced worldly desires to become a nun. Then, I fell in love with the abbot of the neighboring temple, and we both left our orders to marry under the witness of Buddha."
"In the sixth life, I joined the Jiuyou Sect, and relying on past life memories, rose to the position of Master. Driven by greed for the sect's wealth, which I appropriated for myself, failing to pay the monthly dues on time, I was assassinated."
"The seventh life was that of a woman, who served as a palace maid, engaging in daily scheming and intrigue within the royal harem." At this point, Li Haoran's expression turned somewhat ugly, as he recalled some unpleasant matters.
"The eighth life, you all know him, was that scoundrel Qin Haoran, who also had the highest cultivation level. He wanted to Pass Thunder Tribulation to advance to the Transcendence Tribulation Stage to dodge his debtors and ended up struck dead by lightning."
"The ninth life is me."
Such were the tumultuous lives I've led.
Eldest Senior Sister, having listened to the tale, asked calmly, "The fourth life came into being eighty thousand years ago, and after Qin Haoran died, he immediately reincarnated as you. This means that there was not an immediate reincarnation from the fourth life to the fifth, there was a gap in time, correct?"
Li Haoran nodded, "Yes, the further back, the longer the temporal gap between lives, but in my case, there was no gap."
"Based on this timeline, your first three lives weren't part of Great Xia, but rather belonged to Great Yu or Great Qian, right?"
"That would be correct."
Eldest Senior Sister continued, "The decreasing gap between reincarnations, leading up to no gap at all, may be a kind of countdown or a method of accumulation. This life might be your last, or perhaps something will happen in the tenth after you die."
"Indeed."
After some thought, Eldest Senior Sister turned to ask Jiang Lianyi, "I'm fine now, Senior Jiang, do you have any questions?"
Jiang Lianyi nodded, "Could you elaborate on your experiences of scheming and plotting in the royal harem?"
"...I cannot."
"Then I have no further questions either."

chapters.title: Chapter 647 - 646: The Origin of the Annihilation Immortal Sword Array
chapters.content:
"What are you thinking about?" Lu Yang saw Meng Jingzhou squatting on the ground in deep thought, as if he was pondering some profound question.
Meng Jingzhou looked up at Lu Yang, "I'm thinking about which concubine was Junior Brother Li in his sixth lifetime, and whether she later became the empress. If she did become the empress, she would be an ancestor of the current emperor."
Lu Yang: "..."
Emperor Xia's lifespan is about to end, and you're looking for an ancestor for their family, huh.
"Junior Brother Li, you've just had a breakthrough and still need to consolidate it, so I won't disturb your cultivation," said Li Haoran, having told everything he knew. Eldest Senior Sister also got the answers she wanted, and there was no need to delay Li Haoran's cultivation anymore.
...
Three days later, at Sky Gate Mountain.
Lu Yang was seated cross-legged on a sword-shaped rock, with a naturally formed stone pond beside him, which was precisely the Sword Washing Pool that relied on Lu Yang.
In the Sword Washing Pool, seven swords swam around in the water like seven lively and joyful fish.
Lu Yang felt the increasingly clear connection with the Seven-star Sword formation and abruptly opened his eyes. With a lift of two fingers, the Seven-star Sword formation leapt out of the water, shining brilliantly under the sunlight and obediently following Lu Yang's control.
Lu Yang exhaled deeply, finally having established a connection with the Seven-star Sword formation.
He carefully took out the first layer of the "Immortal-Slaying Sword Array." This was a genuine Immortal's artifact, which could stir up mayhem wherever it went and was extremely precious.
"My things are also very precious, why don't I see you taking such careful care of them?" Fairy Eternity felt this was unfair treatment. Such Immortals that even Miss Yun could defeat, with obviously low-level skills, why bother so much with their stuff?
"Have you ever given me anything, Fairy?"
"The Invincible Elixir and the Invincible Nascent Soul, these are incredible items that make you invincible among your peers! My renowned reputation in the Ancient Times was built upon the Invincible Elixir!"
"Go and ask around, which genius didn't lose courage at the mention of me back then, fleeing in panic. Many geniuses' martial spirit was shattered by me..."
Having practiced until this day, Lu Yang had long been able to multitask, listening to Fairy Eternity recounting her glorious past while focusing on cultivating the sword array.
The "Immortal-Slaying Sword Array" was an Immortal-grade grand array, and even the first layer was very obscure and complex. Fortunately, with Lu Yang being a Sword Spirit Root and having extraordinary talent in Swordsmanship, it only took half an hour to understand. If it had been Meng Jingzhou, he wouldn't have been able to discern much even after half a month.
The preamble of the Immortal-Slaying Sword Array outlined the mindset of the array's creator during its creation. Lu Yang murmured:
"This sword array came into being as I traveled the world, seeking traces of Ancient Immortals, hoping to match them in skill. I stumbled upon the remains of this array, which still had the blood stains of an Immortal. Based on the clues, one could infer that this is an array left behind by an Ancient Immortal."
"The Ancient Immortal was truly talented, to have created such an array – magnificent indeed. Yet my own talent should match that of an Ancient Immortal. If the Ancient Immortal could create such an array, it means I could create it too. Had I been born in the Ancient Times, it would be I who created this array."
"Therefore, this sword array is as if I had created it myself, just that there's a discrepancy in time."
Lu Yang: "..."
He really wanted to know which ancient Immortal had created this sword array. Where's the shame?
At the same time, he was also curious; it seemed like none of the Four Ancient Immortals used swords, otherwise Fairy Eternity wouldn't be completely ignorant of Swordsmanship.
Putting his doubt aside for the moment, Lu Yang continued delving into the sword array.
Regardless of its dubious origins, the sword array was truly powerful.
"The Immortal-Slaying Sword Array has specific requirements for the number of swords. At least two are needed, and at most nine. The more swords, the greater the power of the array."
In front of Lu Yang lay nine swords, including the Seven-star Sword formation he had recently bonded with, the Green Peak Sword, and the Dark Moon Sword.
"Rise!"
His thought stirred, and the sword moved with his heart, like a startled swan. Nine swords shot up straight, piercing through the clouds and rushing towards the sky with extreme velocity. In the blink of an eye, they surpassed Lu Yang's control distance and broke contact.
Lu Yang tilted his head back and waited for a long time. Under the influence of gravity, the nine swords finally returned along the same path and reentered Lu Yang's control range.
The nine swords aligned in a row, like a nine-toothed rake descending from the sky. They plunged into the ground like slicing through tofu, leaving only a section of the hilt above the surface.
Logically, a Sword Cultivator at the Nascent Soul Stage should not be able to control nine long swords at the same time, let alone in such a carefree manner.
Lu Yang's Spiritual Power far exceeded that of the average person. Coupled with Fairy Eternity's threat on the Seven-star Sword Array and the desire to soak in the Sword Washing Pool again, Lu Yang and the Seven-star Sword Array shared the same intention, making the most accurate decisions without any effort.
There was no need to mention the Green Peak Sword and the Dark Moon Sword. Lu Yang cherished these two swords so fiercely that in combat he would rather forget his identity as a Sword Cultivator and use magic skills instead of wielding these two swords.
This kind of treatment towards swords was absolutely unique among Sword Cultivators.
The bond between Lu Yang and the nine swords propelled him to today's achievements.
"Array, rise!"
Lu Yang voiced out softly, and the nine swords resonated. The grass beneath his feet trembled slightly, overcome by the Sword Qi released by the nine swords.
The nine swords formed a Sword Array that sealed the heavens and the earth, creating a Sword Qi so dense that not even spiritual essence could penetrate it.
"Array, move!"
With the Green Peak Sword held in the highest regard, the sword hummed incessantly, suspended high above as though an inverse heavenly blade, severing all foes. With just a gesture from Lu Yang, the first layer of the Exterminate Immortal Sword Formation activated, crashing down with pressure comparable to an inverted mountain of sword tips.
Boom—
Beneath the nine swords, everything was annihilated. Even as the master of the Sword Array, Lu Yang felt subdued by the array's power when observing it from the side.
"Phew, worthy of the Exterminate Immortal Sword Formation!"
Not far away, Third Senior Sister Gan Tian was seeking guidance on ancient history from Jiang Lianyi. Lianyi had been paying attention to Lu Yang's movements, and when she saw him deploy the Exterminate Immortal Sword Formation, her face showed a peculiar expression.
With doubts, she asked Gan Tian to pause for a moment and walked straight over.
After the Sword Array dissipated, traces of Swordsmanship lingered in the air, where even a Golden Core Stage cultivator could be wounded just by being present.
Lu Yang collapsed on the ground, gasping for air. Even with his Spiritual Power and spiritual essence, he could not sustain the exertion of the Sword Array.
However, the power of the Sword Array was indeed considerable, much stronger than using the Green Peak Sword alone.
"Elder Lianyi, what brings you here?"
"I just felt that the Sword Array you deployed seemed familiar."
"Familiar?"
Jiang Lianyi was silent, recalling the way Lu Yang had deployed the Sword Array, and then she suddenly realized.
"That's the Sword Array my husband kneels on!"
The Qilin Immortal often knelt on the Sword Array, and she had grown accustomed to it. So much so, she had forgotten that what her husband knelt on after making mistakes was indeed a Sword Array.
Lu Yang cautiously asked, "Where is the Sword Array the Qilin Immortal kneels on now?"
Jiang Lianyi waved her hand indifferently, "I broke it and threw it away somewhere long ago."

chapters.title: Chapter 648 - 647: An Evenly Matched Battle (Vote for Monthly Ticket)
chapters.content:
Lu Yang was now in a dilemma, debating whether or not to continue studying the Annihilating Immortal Sword Array.
He had just learned the basics when he heard the dreadful origin of the Sword Array, which really dampened his enthusiasm for learning.
If he didn't study it, there were no other Sword Arrays to learn.
If he did, this was a Sword Array that the Qilin Immortal had used to bamboozle his wife, and its power was uncertain.
You don't want to learn it only to find out it makes your sword tips go soft.
"That won't happen," Fairy Eternity said after hearing Lu Yang's concerns, immediately rejecting the idea.
"You don't need to worry about the power of the Sword Array. It's very strong. The Qilin Immortal and Ying Tian Immortal just tampered with the Immortal Sword."
"Fairy, you understand Sword Arrays too?"
"I'm relying on intuition."
"...Is your intuition reliable?"
"My intuition tells me my intuition is very reliable."
"..."
Lu Yang fell silent for a moment, sighed, and seemed resigned to his fate. He decided to study it. Regardless of its power, it must be the highest level Sword Array available to the Seek Dao Sect judging from its class.
Jiang Lianyi agreed with Fairy Eternity, believing that the Sword Array was powerful and worthwhile to learn.
As for Jiang Lianyi's opinion, Lu Yang found it completely unconvincing—he had never seen her disagree with Fairy Eternity.
"There's one more thing I need to tell Senior Brother," said Jiang Lianyi, looking serious.
"What is it?"
"I have been living at the Seek Dao Sect for over two months now, and I have grasped the basic situation of today's Cultivation World. It's time for me to go out and explore. Along the way, I'll look for Daoist Buyu and the prodigious younger generation of the Phoenix Tribe. I promised to teach her, and I must keep my word."
Lu Yang thought to himself, as expected. Jiang Lianyi couldn't possibly stay at the Seek Dao Sect or by Fairy Eternity's side forever. She had another purpose for leaving, which Lu Yang could guess without her saying.
The whereabouts of the Qilin Immortal and Ao Ling.
Jiang Lianyi's feelings for these two were no less than her feelings for Fairy Eternity.
"Then I wish Elder Lianyi a smooth journey, may all your wishes come true, and may you achieve your goals soon," Lu Yang said, clasping his fists with a smile.
Although he had exposed the fact that his master was the author of "The Transformation of Dragon and Phoenix," he didn't tell Elder Lianyi that by finding Eldest Senior Sister, she could locate their master, which allowed his master to live a bit longer.
As a disciple, he had done all that was right and just.
Fairy Eternity also came out to bid farewell to Jiang Lianyi, saying fiercely, "Achieve your goal and come back fast. If anyone outside bullies you, tell me, and I'll have Miss Yun teach them a lesson!"
"Certainly."
Jiang Lianyi did not leave immediately but quietly departed on the fifth afternoon while Lu Yang was comprehending the Sword Array.
Two days later, Lu Yang's mastery of the Sword Array grew more and more proficient, consuming much less energy than before.
"What's lacking is a target to test the Sword Array's power."
After practicing for so many days, the lawn had been sliced down several layers by the Sword Array. He felt its power was significant, but without a reference object, it always seemed incomplete.
On Sky Gate Mountain, there were only so many targets. Eldest Senior Sister was definitely not an option, neither was Third Senior Sister, leaving only that damn Puppet...
Thinking of the Puppet that had been pushing him down since he began his cultivation, Lu Yang felt he should have no problem with it now.
The perfect experimental target!
No sooner said than done.
Sky Gate Mountain wasn't so large, and Lu Yang quickly found the Puppet, which was digging a hole to plant a tree under a pine tree.
"Hehe, I've finally found you. Let's settle our new grudges and old scores together!"
...
An evenly matched battle began.
Within ten breaths after the start, the Invincible Nascent Soul fled for its life.
Twenty-five breaths into the battle, Lu Yang was beaten black and blue, howling as the shovel struck him repeatedly.
After one minute of fighting, Lu Yang was buried in the ground, becoming brothers with the pine tree planted next to him.
The fight ended with the puppet narrowly victorious.
Only after the puppet staggered away from the pine forest with a shovel on its shoulder did Lu Yang dare to crawl out, still trembling with fear.
"Indeed, it's the puppet that has been beating me up since I was young. It's got some skills, it seems that I am not its match at this stage."
During the battle with the puppet, Lu Yang didn't even have a chance to deploy his 'Annihilate Immortal Sword Array' before the fight was over.
Given Lu Yang's bottom-of-the-barrel cultivation level at Sky Gate Mountain, it was indeed difficult to find a target that he could freely practice his array method on.
"Old Lu, are you there?"
Meng Jingzhou's voice echoed through the pine forest. He was there to find Lu Yang, attracted by the noise of the fight and suspecting that Lu Yang might be around.
On hearing this, Lu Yang quickly dusted off the dirt from his body, not wanting to give Meng Jingzhou the chance to laugh at him!
After removing the pine branches stuck in his hair and cleaning himself up, he pretended to have just heard and replied irritably, "Stop shouting, I'm here!"
"What about the injuries on your face..."
The puppet had been very precise; the swelling on his face could only dissipate naturally.
Lu Yang maintained a calm expression, "It's nothing. I just ingested an elixir, but the potency was too strong to digest. Eldest Senior Sister had to strike the acupoints on my face to help absorb the medicinal effect, that's all."
Meng Jingzhou looked at Lu Yang skeptically, feeling that the lad was spouting nonsense.
"By the way, I just happened to have mastered a sword formation, you should try it."
Lu Yang quickly diverted Meng Jingzhou's attention to avoid him seeing through the ruse.
Moreover, this lad was indeed the perfect target.
"Oh, so you've started learning sword formations. I'm quite eager to see the power of your sword formation!"
The sword array was a sword cultivator's trump card; Meng Jingzhou could gauge Lu Yang's abilities through it.
"Then you better be careful!"
Lu Yang knew Old Meng would agree and did not hesitate. He flicked his hands, and nine glittering swords appeared above Meng Jingzhou's head, their sharp sword qi causing palpitations.
Meng Jingzhou let out a chant and exhibited three heads and six arms, with all six arms reaching for the sky as if to withstand the strike.
"Annihilate Immortal Sword Array!"
"Damn it, wait a moment, what's the name of this sword array..."
As soon as Meng Jingzhou heard the name Lu Yang had called out for the sword array, he knew he was in trouble; it sounded ridiculously powerful!
Before the sword array could fall, Meng Jingzhou was seen with his six arms up, knees hitting the ground with a thud, his kneeling posture extremely proper.
Frightened, Lu Yang hurriedly retracted the sword array and helped Meng Jingzhou up, a grin spreading across his face.
"Old Meng, there was no need for such grand courtesy just for me to hold back."
Meng Jingzhou was instantly furious, "Bullshit, I wasn't paying you any respects. It was your sword array that made me kneel. Standing under the sword array, my legs wouldn't obey me!"
Lu Yang was utterly confused.
Seeing Lu Yang still feigning ignorance, Meng Jingzhou cursed, "Don't play dumb with me. You did that on purpose, didn't you? Your sword array has an effect that makes people kneel, and standing beneath it, I couldn't control my legs!"
Lu Yang, having never stood under his own sword array, was unaware it had such an effect. He scratched his head; the experiment was truly effective, and there was even an unexpected gain.
But why would the 'Annihilate Immortal Sword Array' have such an effect?
Fairy Eternity pondered for a moment, then figured something out, explaining, "I see now. It must be the Qilin Immortal adding an 'automatic kneeling array method' to the sword formation, worried that his own kneeling posture wasn't perfect, which wouldn't allow Lianyi and Xiao Ling to forgive him."
"I knew Qilin Immortal was meticulous; there was no way he would set up a simple sword formation."
Lu Yang: "..."
It was a good thing Elder Lianyi left early. What a mess it would be if she found out about this?

chapters.title: Chapter 649 - 648: Sword Flight
chapters.content:
```
Although forcing Meng Jingzhou to kneel was an immensely pleasurable experience, Lu Yang's focus wasn't on this.
The power of the Sword Array aside, this forced kneeling capability was definitely first-class in utility.
Take Meng Jingzhou's performance just now as an example, even though he had his defenses set, the sudden imposition of kneeling disrupted his stance and center of gravity, breaking his defense and catching him off guard!
Not to mention the upper limit of this move, the Qilin Immortal himself had practiced it, and once mastered, it was even effective against Immortals.
It's just unclear which Cultivation Levels the first layer of the Sword Array is effective against.
It's definitely effective against those at the Nascent Soul Stage, but what about the Spirit Transformation Stage?
That's hard to say.
Moreover, the Spirit Transformation Stage Senior Brothers and Sisters within the Sect can't be considered ordinary, so they don't make for a good reference.
"Forget it, I'll find some unlucky Divinity Transformation Stage cultivator to test it on when I have the time."
Lu Yang was sincerely grateful to the Qilin Immortal for leaving behind such an exceptional Sword Array and resolved to share this wonderful news with Elder Lianyi when the opportunity arose, as a way to repay the Qilin Immortal for his 'eating dust' kindness.
"Come on, let's continue!" Lu Yang insisted on resuming the unfinished experiment with Meng Jingzhou, who flatly refused.
A joke, I am not foolish; isn't it enough to kneel once? And you expect me to kneel a second time?
"Alright then, what do you want with me?"
With Meng Jingzhou's character, he certainly wouldn't seek him out without reason.
"You know I ran away from home, but I'm still using the Spirit Stones my sister gave me before leaving, which doesn't bode well for this young master's reputation."
"This young master has found a great way to earn money and live independently, making and spending my own money."
"Just so happens I've heard there's a black market out there where, from time to time, a gathering of Nascent Soul old monsters is held, where they exchange information, barter goods, and purchase treasures. I plan to go there and make a hefty profit!"
Going alone would be boring, might as well bring someone along for the ride.
Lu Yang stroked his chin; it sounded like a decent place. Both he and Meng Jingzhou were at the Heavy Nascent stage, round up, they could be considered Nascent Soul Stage, so they were eligible to go.
"Okay."
Meng Jingzhou smiled and patted Lu Yang on the shoulder, "I knew you'd agree. I'll go call Old Ma."
Lu Yang caught Meng Jingzhou as he was about to leave, "No need to call Old Ma, I'll take you there."
Meng Jingzhou was puzzled, "How will you take me? Sword flying?"
Lu Yang revealed a mysterious smile, "Something like that."
...
With the popularization of the Flying Car invented by Lu Yang, more and more cultivators favored this novel transportation magic artifact. It was safe, and even in the event of a collision in the sky, the car's airbags ensured the safety of those inside—a much more convenient option compared to the traditional Flying Swords.
In the sky, aside from the common flying boats, the use of flying cars was on the rise year by year.
The Flying Car was a fresh novelty, and for the majority of cultivators, it was fairly rare. Some cultivators would look back, captivated by the elegant flying car passing by.
However, today, there was a more eye-catching transportation artifact in the sky than the flying car, drawing frequent side glances from passengers on flying boats.
It was an artifact approximately two and a half meters long, one and a half meters wide, and one and a half meters tall, with an open-top design, spacious interior space where cultivators could stand, sit, squat, or lie down. Its grayish-brown exterior exuded understated luxury.
The uneven surface bore the marks of time's erosion, indicating the long history of the artifact and its endurance against the ravages of time.
The Sword Washing Pool carried Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou toward their destination, each lying on opposite sides of the pool.
"Is this what you meant by sword flying?"
"Is a scabbard part of a sword?"
"Yes."
"Isn't the function of a scabbard to hold a sword, acting as a kind of container?"
"Yes."
"Isn't the Sword Washing Pool also for holding swords, essentially acting as a kind of container?"
"Yes."
"So, isn't the Sword Washing Pool equivalent to a scabbard?"
"Yes."
"Then, isn't the Sword Washing Pool part of a sword?"
"Yes."
"So, when I fly using the Sword Washing Pool, isn't it essentially the same as sword flying?"
```
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
What you said really makes sense.
"You're not wrong, this is indeed more comfortable than ordinary sword flight." Meng Jingzhou stretched lazily, feeling so comfortable he wanted to doze off, conceding to Lu Yang's correctness.
Considering the influence of public decency, Lu Yang didn't add pool water either, for taking a bath in public would hardly be graceful.
A flying boat passed by, with a child on board holding the hand of a female cultivator, pointing at the two big brothers lying in the pool, and emitting a childlike voice.
"Mommy, what magic artifact is that?"
The female cultivator quickly pulled the child into the rest cabin.
Just as Lu Yang was enjoying the unique sword flight experience common to sword cultivators, an officer dressed in official attire stopped the two of them, with a stern expression, raising his right hand to halt the Sword Washing Pool.
"Cease flying."
"What can I do for you, officer?"
Lu Yang stood up from the Sword Washing Pool, looking puzzled, guessing by the uniform the official wore that he must be an officer responsible for managing air order.
But he couldn't understand why he was being stopped.
New magic artifacts aren't allowed in the sky, but there didn't seem to be such a rule.
Drunk flying?
Neither of them had drunk any alcohol.
"You're overloaded."
Lu Yang: "..."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
"Who is piloting this magic artifact?"
"I am," said Lu Yang.
"What is your cultivation level?"
"Nascent Soul Stage."
The officer looked down to write the ticket: "The regulations decree that sword flight may only carry one person, violators are fined a base penalty of fifty to a hundred Spirit Stones, Increasing proportionally with the offender's cultivation level, except in special circumstances such as emergency avoidance or rescues."
"You are at the Nascent Soul Stage, so the fine ranges from five thousand to ten thousand Spirit Stones. Seeing as your attitude is decent, as per the regulations, that will be a fine of five thousand Spirit Stones. Any objections?"
"Wait, does this count as sword flight?"
The officer nodded, his expression unchanging: "Isn't the scabbard part of the sword?"
"It is."
"Doesn't the scabbard serve the purpose of holding a long sword, acting as a container?"
"It does."
"This is a Sword Washing Pool, right?"
"It is."
"Doesn't the Sword Washing Pool serve the purpose of holding long swords, also acting as a container?"
"It does."
"...Alright, officer, no need to say more, I'll accept the fine," Lu Yang admitted his bad luck, figuring he could guess what the officer would say next even without thinking too hard.
"Then sign here." The officer tore off the ticket, handing it to Lu Yang.
"Wait a moment." Meng Jingzhou stopped Lu Yang.
Five thousand Spirit Stones weren't a large sum, but Meng Jingzhou felt that, since they came out to make money, it was not good fortune to have to pay a fine without earning anything first; he stepped forward to plead on behalf of Lu Yang.
"Officer, you see my brother is flying with a sword for the first time and wasn't familiar with the rules. We are disciples of the Seek Dao Sect, can you give us a bit of leeway?"
Upon hearing that the two were disciples of the Seek Dao Sect, the officer's eyes widened in surprise, and his attitude clearly changed: "You're really from the Seek Dao Sect?"
"Could this be fake?" Meng Jingzhou took out his own Identity Jade, proving his identity.
The officer retracted the ticket, allowing the two of them to breathe a sigh of relief.
But then, the officer rewrote the ticket and handed it over to Lu Yang:
"The higher-ups have ordered that the fines for Seek Dao Sect disciples are to be doubled. That will be ten thousand Spirit Stones."

chapters.title: Chapter 650 - 649: Black Market
chapters.content:
"Isn't flying by car considered sword-flight?" A flying car can carry up to five people, which is more than using the Sword Washing Pool to transport people.
The officer gave Lu Yang a glance and explained, "A flying car is a specialized flying magic artifact, each one undergoes quality inspection, and there are specific regulations for it in the law; if your Sword Washing Pool had such regulations, that would work too."
Lu Yang conceded defeat.
The two had died before achieving their goal, already indebted before they'd even begun to make money.
Luckily, no issues arose thereafter.
During several days of flight, to avoid being exposed to the elements, they landed at an inn and incidentally helped the proprietress deal with a younger brother-in-law who came to claim his late brother's heritage, declined the cherished heirloom gifted by the proprietress in gratitude, and deduced that the proprietress was the murderer of her own husband.
At the second inn, the two encountered Qi Refinement cultivators quarreling over a Grade-A room and even obtained from them the location of a nearby treasure site; seizing treasures valuable to Foundation Establishment cultivators, they turned them over to the local government office, posting a lost-and-found notice, which drew out two Foundation Establishment families, uncovering centuries-long grudges between them.
The feud ended with both Clan Leaders severing their own lives in a torrential downpour.
At the third inn, they came across a wealthy young lady being chased for a thousand miles. They escorted her home, only to discover and eliminate a fierce ghost that had been harbored in her house for over a decade.
This forced the person behind the ghost to reveal themselves, clashing with them in a fight before being captured by the duo, who respectfully declined the young lady's offer of marriage and, following clues left by the ghost's keeper, dismantled a Demon Path Loose Cultivator's stronghold.
The Sword Washing Pool carried them safely to Youzhou.
"We've finally arrived." They let out a long sigh. Although it was only a few days' journey, it felt like more than a month had passed, and their bodies ached all over.
"Your pool isn't comfortable to lie in, is it?"
"It's because there's no water in it; it's actually quite comfortable for a bath."
Fairy Eternity thought to herself, wasn't it because the two of you encountered so many things along the way?
The black market mentioned by Meng Jingzhou is located at the foot of a mountain in the Youzhou region. It is usually hidden within a secret realm and emerges through a spatial swap at the interchange of Yin and Yang, providing a place for trades.
At that time, cultivators from nearby cities will come here for secret trades, including individuals like Lu Yang who travel from even farther away.
"We've arrived just in time. There's a gathering of Nascent Soul old monsters here every month on the fifteenth."
Both were dressed in black robes, collars raised to cover their faces, revealing only a pair of eyes. This was one of the black market's rules, which facilitated escape in case officers from the government office arrived to make arrests.
When they reached the black market, it had already been open for more than an hour, and the cultivators who had been waiting outside had entered, making the entrance seem deserted.
There were cultivators guarding the entrance to the black market, which was meant to prevent mortals from accidentally wandering in and causing unnecessary trouble.
The guards did not stop them from entering.
He had seen with his own eyes how they flew with the Sword Washing Pool and changed into black robes, their movements smooth and practiced, the mark of veterans.
Being able to handle such a large pool for flight indicated they were at least Gold Core Period cultivators.
Upon entering the black market, they noticed it was quieter than a usual market, with only the occasional chatting among cultivators.
Within the black market, trading cultivators employed methods like sound focusing and Spiritual Sense transmission to ensure the secrecy of their transactions.
Due the lack of government office supervision, many items that couldn't be seen on normal days were available in the black market.
For example, the Cultivation Technique in Lu Yang's possession.
"Boss, are you sure this book is the Qi Refinement chapter of the 'Legend of the Dao Sect' used by Lu Yang, Talent Lu, for his cultivation?"
The boss swore up and down, "How could this be fake? I have a distant relative in the Seek Dao Sect, and this is the cultivation technique he brought out from there!"
"Little brother, I see you're at the Qi Cultivation Stage, why not buy a copy and try it? I guarantee that after cultivating it, you'll soar to the skies and become a genius like Talent Lu!"
Without the supervision of the government office, many counterfeit goods can be found in the black market.
Lu Yang silently put it back, it was just too fake.
However, there were also fakes that weren't so blatantly obvious, such as the so-called latest version of 'Legend of the Dao Seeking Sect' lying next to it.
Upon closer inspection, you'd realize that the title was 'Legend of the Gaps Sect'.
Thinking about it, it was easy to understand why such books would appear here. The real 'Legend of the Dao Seeking Sect' was found all over the streets outside, there was absolutely no need to sell it in the black market. This one was meant to deceive those with poor eyesight or cultivators who were too embarrassed to put it down once they picked it up.
Lu Yang also saw a claimed Purple Gold Gourd that supposedly could suck someone in if their name was recited and they responded.
A real Purple Gold Gourd was worth more than the entire black market combined. Even a replica would be a magic artifact treasured by those at the Divinity Transformation Stage. Whether real or fake, they definitely wouldn't appear here.
There were various shapes and sizes of storage rings. The Artifact Refiners were not detailed, and the quality couldn't be guaranteed; accordingly, their prices were much lower than in the outside world.
Some of these storage rings were genuine, made by Artifact Refiners without qualifications, while others, from the surface, seemed real but actually had a limited number of uses due to refining errors. Once used up, they would break and were counterfeit, discernible only to those with an in-depth understanding of storage rings.
There were also plenty of ghost-repelling and evil-dispelling talismans which are hard to fake. Selling counterfeits could lead to serious trouble, so all of them were authentic. But Lu Yang and his companion didn't need them; a single drop of Meng Jingzhou's blood was more effective than a stack of talismans.
Facing ghosts of the same level, Meng Jingzhou's Yang Qi was so vigorous that merely emitting his aura could melt the other party.
There were also enchanting female cultivators canvassing on the street corners, whom the two directly ignored.
"How come there are no souls, eyeballs soaked in potion, Soul Summoning Banners, and stuff like that?"
Having browsed halfway through, Lu Yang felt the atmosphere of the black market was as eerie and ghostly as he had imagined, but the items for sale were quite different from what he had expected.
Meng Jingzhou looked disdainfully at his good brother, "This black market was established to evade taxes."
"What you're talking about is the Demon Path black market. If I knew the location of that kind of market, I'd just wipe it out and go to the government office to claim the reward. Why bother attending a Nascent Soul Stage meeting? That would be far more profitable than what we're doing now."
Lu Yang had to admit Meng Jingzhou's point made sense.
"Here we are, this is the meeting place for us old monsters at the Nascent Soul Stage."
Meng Jingzhou pointed to a luxurious palace, pitch-black all over with statues of rare beasts at the corners of the eaves. An Array Method blocked Spiritual Sense probing, and two Gold Core Period Cultivators stood guard at the entrance.
This was the place he had learned about from Dai Bufan, absolutely reliable.
Lu Yang turned to Meng Jingzhou and asked, "Speaking of which, I've never asked you, what's the self-reliance method of making money you mentioned?"
"Selling blood."

chapters.title: Chapter 651 - 650: Selling Blood
chapters.content:
Lu Yangxin thought no wonder this kid insisted on running to such a forsaken place, it turned out he came here to sell blood.
So shameless.
He wasn't even afraid of the Phoenix Tribe finding out and eliminating him as a competitor.
Lu Yang had already planned it out; when the time came, he would step forward, assuming the identity of Elder Brother Phoenix Ancestor, to persuade the Phoenix Tribe to leave a complete corpse.
"Please stop, elders," the two Golden Core cultivators stationed at the entrance of the hall politely stopped the two men, intending to confirm their realms.
Those who usually come here have invitations; just displaying it would be enough. There are also Nascent Soul Stage cultivators from foreign lands without invitations; in such cases, one's realm needs to be confirmed.
Otherwise, anyone wearing a mask could enter the Nascent Soul Hall of the black market; that would be quite the joke.
"Are you calling out to me?" Meng Jingzhou stopped in his tracks and gave a cold glance, releasing a whiff of Mid-stage Nascent Soul realm aura that intimidated the two guards.
The two Golden Core guards hurriedly apologized, sweating profusely. The person before them was definitely a Nascent Soul Stage cultivator, and at the very least a mid-stage Nascent Soul!
"We wouldn't dare, please enter, elders."
As the two entered the hall, the atmosphere abruptly changed; the hall was brightly lit, and a careful observation would reveal that the lighting actually came from millennium-lasting mermaid oil lamps!
This item is extravagantly priced and deemed priceless in the market. Its source is from the Mermaid Clan in the East Sea, a significant family that was eligible to be invited to the grand opening ceremony of the Demon Nation.
The process of refinishing mermaid oil lamps is difficult and kept secret; few people in the world know of it, but Lu Yang and his companion, being of no ordinary status, were aware of the process.
The most challenging part of the oil lamp is its materials; the requirements for the mermaids are exceedingly high, needing a Body Integration Realm mermaid with a potbelly to cut off the fat from its stomach. Then, by using the limb regeneration technique, the wound would heal, and the fat would regrow.
This cut-off fat was then the raw material for refining the mermaid oil lamps.
As for why the refining process is kept secret, Lu Yang felt it might be similar to the reason why the Phoenix Tribe sells blood, which does not warrant further inquiry.
In the center of the hall were placed over a dozen magic artifacts and dozens of herbs, all useful for Nascent Soul Stage cultivators but of no use to Lu Yang and his company.
There were also many side halls, judging by their names, some traded intelligence, some provided private chats for old Nascent Soul monsters, some custom-made elixirs, and some custom-made magic artifacts...
"It seems quite crowded over there, shall we take a look?"
The main hall had dozens of figures in black robes, indicating that all of these were at the Nascent Soul Stage. They were all heading toward one of the side halls, a place for bartering items, and it seemed that it was time for a conventionally agreed moment when interested old Nascent Soul monsters would gather for trade.
Inside the side hall, the old Nascent Soul monsters grouped in twos and threes, each with their small cliques.
"Old Monster Pei, I didn't expect you, old geezer, to still be alive. Make sure to inform me in advance when you die, and I'll be sure to come and congratulate," said an elderly lady leaning on a wolf-headed cane.
"Then it's too bad, I'm definitely dying before you, Madam Xie!" Old Monster Pei's eyes held an aged and cold look, giving the sensation of being watched by venomous serpents.
Those who came here were Nascent Soul old monsters from nearby cities. Even if they tried to hide their identities, everyone could guess with reasonable accuracy.
As for Old Monster Pei and Madam Xie, they barely made an effort at disguise; anyone familiar could recognize them at a glance.
These two were renowned peak Nascent Soul Stage figures in the vicinity; here, they were invincible, free from any danger.
The Nascent Soul families they founded were also powerful, possessing numerous industries: iron smelting, textiles, escort services, and so forth, amassing wealth beyond measure.
Some even said that these two were the true masters of the black market, although no one could prove it.
Meng Jingzhou could confirm it; the information he received from Elder Brother Dai indicated that the true masters of the black market were indeed these two. Their conflict was a show for outsiders, designed to blur the line between truth and pretense.
Dai Bufan's intelligence, as long as it did not concern Lu Yang and his partner, seemed to be comprehensive and reliable.
"Do you have any elixirs or heavenly materials and earthly treasures that can cleanse marrow and refine essence? There will be a hefty reward."
An old Nascent Soul Stage Cultivator shouted, seeking treasures to improve the aptitude for his juniors.
"Which fellow Daoist has an entrance qualification for a First Class Sect's disciple? I'm willing to trade a Nascent Soul Transformation Elixir for it."
"Really, can one really trade a Nascent Soul Transformation Elixir for it?" A Nascent Soul Stage Cultivator who had some resources was obviously tempted.
The Nascent Soul Stage Cultivator with the trading need took out a wooden box sealed with Talismans, and threads of Elixir Fragrance wafted from the box.
"This scent... Indeed, it's the Nascent Soul Transformation Elixir. I don't have the entrance qualification for a First Class Sect, but I have something better."
"Something better? Could it be from a Super-grade Sect?" The holder of the Nascent Soul Transformation Elixir was shocked.
"Not so, it's even higher than that."
