"The Five Great Immortal Sects?" The Nascent Soul Stage Cultivator became agitated, wondering when the entrance qualifications for the Five Great Immortal Sects were available for sale.
Even if they were for sale, it would not be something that a single Nascent Soul Transformation Elixir could buy.
Once one entered the Five Great Immortal Sects, it was like a fish leaping through the dragon gate; from then on, the future would be bright, with limitless possibilities. Any disciple from the Five Great Immortal Sects, whether in the Qi Refinement or Foundation Establishment Stage, would have to be treated as an equal by these dozens of Nascent Soul Stage Cultivators!
"Fellow Daoist, you're not bold enough. It's even higher, and this slot I have is for the entrance qualification of the number one power in the world."
The holder of the Nascent Soul Transformation Elixir became puzzled, wondering what sect could be above the others.
The nearby Nascent Soul Stage Cultivators all pricked up their ears to eavesdrop; if these two didn't make a deal, they could step in to trade.
The mysterious person nodded and said slowly:
"The Great Xia Imperial Palace is recruiting eunuchs, and as long as one registers, they can get in."
The holder of the Nascent Soul Transformation Elixir flew into a rage, nearly starting a fight.
Fortunately, he calmed down at the last moment. The black market prohibits fighting; those who break the rules are banned from entering the black market forever at the least, or they might leave their lives here at the worst.
The other party's action to infuriate him was obviously intentional.
Meng Jingzhou moved closer to the Nascent Soul Stage Cultivator who had just suppressed his rage, speaking in a hushed voice, "Fellow Daoist, in half a year the Seek Dao Sect will be recruiting disciples. The questions have already been set, and as it happens, I have the real exam questions for Seek Dao Sect's entrance test. Are you interested?"
"Scram!"
He could tell right away this was a scam.
"Don't be angry, my friend. If you don't want that, I also have blood that can invigorate yang, which works even better than the Phoenix Tribe's blood. Are you interested?"
The Nascent Soul Stage Cultivator was about to yell "scram" again, but as he opened his mouth, he realized that he actually needed such an item quite badly.
"Really better than the Phoenix Tribe's blood?"
Currently, Phoenix Blood Stones soaked in the Phoenix Tribe's blood were used for yang invigoration, but they worked only moderately and carried the risk of being discovered by the Phoenix Tribe. If there truly was blood more effective than that of the Phoenix Tribe, it would be more than desirable.
But what kind of blood would be more effective than the Phoenix Tribe's?
Lu Yang snorted coldly, setting up the punchline for Meng Jingzhou: "This is the blood of a Great Power who still has a virgin's body, someone who has entered and exited a brothel seven times without leakage, who can remain color heart when a woman sits on his lap, earning even the praise of palace eunuchs for his excellent self-restraint. All his Yang Qi is locked within his blood.
How could it be compared to the lowly Phoenix blood, lascivious serpent's venom sack, or the Yin and Yang Reunion Flower!"
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Dammit, your setup is worse than none at all; how come I sound so pitiful?

chapters.title: Chapter 652 - 651: The Transaction
chapters.content:
Honestly, the owner of the Infant Transformation Pill was tempted.
He was in his twilight years, and because he had indulged excessively in his youth, his vitality was depleted, not even the blood of the Phoenix Tribe could save him. This led him to seek a way out for his descendants, hoping they could cling to a Great Sect as their support.
With a Great Sect out of reach for now, if there was something to invigorate his Yang Qi that could let him feel good, it seemed like a viable option.
If his descendants were inadequate, why not just have more?
He felt his identity was well concealed and should not be recognized by anyone.
"How much for a drop?"
"Ten thousand Spirit Stones per drop."
"Words alone are no proof, how can I tell if the blood is real or fake?"
Meng Jingzhou let out a light laugh and took out a small porcelain vial, "That's no problem. There's a drop of blood in this vial. Swallow it and refine it, and you'll know the effect."
The methods of the Cultivation World are mysterious and unfathomable; Cultivators of the Curse lineage can cast curses from afar using blood, hair, and other such items. It's hard to guard against.
Meng Jingzhou had anticipated this and the blood he brought today had been pre-treated, with all traces of the owner's identity thoroughly erased.
The owner of the Infant Transformation Pill took the small porcelain vial with suspicion, pouring the blood into the palm of his hand.
A single drop of blood, like a blood-colored gemstone, glowing and smooth with an extraordinary origin. The Yang Qi it emitted was particularly impressive, clearly surpassing the blood of the Phoenix Tribe by more than just a few notches!
Such a fine item.
The Nascent Soul elders around omnivorously watched the drop of blood, their expressions betraying their longing.
If this was the real deal, indeed, they needed to buy a vial.
After ensuring there was no trickery with the blood, the owner of the Infant Transformation Pill swallowed a drop and silently refined it.
There was a reaction!
The face of the owner of the Infant Transformation Pill flushed red; the effect of the blood was much stronger than he had expected. His body reacted instinctively, and his desires surged, unstoppable even by running his Cultivation Technique!
Meng Jingzhou was also somewhat surprised; he hadn't expected his blood to be this effective.
As for feeling happy about it, it didn't seem like something worth celebrating.
"I'll buy it!"
"Fifty thousand per drop."
"You!"
"If you don't like it, don't buy it," said Meng Jingzhou with a nonchalant air. He held the upper hand, as he could sell the blood for however many Spirit Stones he wanted.
"Fifty thousand then, give me three drops!" said the owner of the Infant Transformation Pill through gritted teeth. Such things couldn't be bought with money; fifty thousand was a good deal!
Meng Jingzhou happily accepted the Storage Ring containing one hundred fifty thousand Spirit Stones; money was coming in fast, enough to pay his fines fifteen times over.
If he didn't reveal his identity from the Seek Dao Sect, he could even afford thirty fines!
Lu Yang clicked his tongue in wonder, having seen those who sought children through borrowed essence, but this was his first time encountering someone seeking children through borrowed blood.
Unfortunately, it seemed the Nascent Soul elders were cautious in their actions. Seeing how swiftly the owner of the Infant Transformation Pill completed the transaction and the steep price of the Yang Invigorating blood, they hesitated and ultimately, no one opted to trade.
The two made a round through the side hall and saw no chance of business, so they had to give up.
"Let's go somewhere else; I know of another black market," Meng Jingzhou transmitted, having meticulously gathered information on several black markets.
All were learned from Senior Brother Dai Bufan, whose intelligence wasn't easily leaked. For this information, Meng Jingzhou paid a heavy price—he promised Dai Bufan he would refrain from causing any trouble for the next half year.
The two retraced their steps and left the black market.
Just as Lu Yang was about to take out the Sword Washing Pool to fly on his sword, a sinister voice came from behind him.
"Are you two Daoist friends leaving already?"
"Who's there!"
Lu Yang suddenly turned his head, as four Nascent Soul elders cloaked in black robes emerged from the dense forest, their eyes cold and their expressions unfriendly.
"What do you want!"
"What do we want?" the leader sneered.
"Daoist friend, the blood you took out in the side hall, the Yang Invigorating Blood that surpasses even the blood of the Phoenix Tribe, has made us quite envious."
"There were too many people in the side hall to speak frankly, so our appearance here should make our intentions clear to you."
Meng Jingzhou slowly clenched his fists, becoming alert, "We are naturally slow-witted and do not understand the meaning of you four Daoist friends."
The leader wasn't giving up, "Can't the price be a little lower? Even for the blood of the Phoenix Tribe, it's only two or three thousand per drop!"
Meng Jingzhou coldly chuckled, his stance firm and unyielding, "No, I underwent countless dangers to obtain this Yang Invigorating Blood. It's fifty thousand Spirit Stones per drop, not a fraction less!"
"If it were you, would you lower the price?"
"Is that so? That's a pity. I was thinking that if you were accommodating, we could also become friends. But since you are heartless…"
The leader's voice trailed off as he gave a significant glance to the three beside him. They reached into their sleeves, and with a flash of cold light, suddenly cast something towards Lu Yang.
Lu Yang had anticipated this and with a swift motion, caught three Storage Rings.
The leader shook his head with a show of regret, "No discount then, so be it. There is a total of five hundred thousand Spirit Stones here, Daoist friend, please confirm the amount."
Lu Yang swept his Spiritual Sense over the rings, accepted the three Storage Rings, and signaled Meng Jingzhou with a glance, "Indeed, it's five hundred thousand Spirit Stones, let's complete the transaction."
Meng Jingzhou took out ten bottles of blood from his Identity Jade and threw them to the other party.
The leader's eyes darted, noticing Meng Jingzhou's subtle movements even in the darkness, especially when he saw Meng Jingzhou's Identity Jade, "You're a Disciple of Dao Seeking Sect?"
"So what if I am?" Meng Jingzhou inwardly cursed his bad luck for revealing his identity as a disciple of the Dao Seeking Sect.
The leader stared intently at Meng Jingzhou, speaking slowly, "If you are disciples of the Dao Seeking Sect, then we cannot let you leave easily. I have a reputation to consider, and if word gets out, I fear I won't be able to get by in the community."
A smile formed on his lips, his back to the moonlight, making his expression unclear, but his bright, icy teeth were visible.
"What do you want to do?" Lu Yang felt the men's attitudes shift after learning their identities.
"Please be our guests at my residence, as a courtesy from the host!"
Knowing their identities and failing to extend hospitality would reflect poorly on him among his peers.
Lu Yang, wary, eyed the four men and shook his head lightly, "I think that will be unnecessary."
Their strange attitude was a clear sign of ulterior motives!
The leader pressed closer, "Daoist friend, it's just a visit to my house. Why be so cautious?"
Lu Yang laughed coldly, having already seen through the charade, he warned them,
"Daoist friend, for a hundred thousand years, Great Xia has been governed by the Righteous Path, and the methods of Evil Demons are not advisable. Could it be you are unaware that many like you have been captured by Great Xia, stumbling into prison, living in regret for the rest of their lives?"
"As Disciples of Dao Seeking Sect, we stand with the Righteous Path and will resolutely not consort with Evil Demons."
"If you're thinking of using a back door to get your descendants into the Dao Seeking Sect, that's nothing but wishful thinking!"
The leader's eyes turned frosty as he stealthily slid his hand into his sleeve, touching a Storage Ring. With a flick of his finger, several lost Cultivation Techniques fanned out like a deck of cards, "Is there truly no chance? To be frank, my family has amassed a substantial wealth of treasures and cultivation books, perhaps there's something you might fancy?"
"No chance at all!"
Seeing the resolute attitudes of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, the leader let out a long sigh to the heavens.
"Enough, enough. Let's go."

chapters.title: Chapter 653 - 652 Encounter
chapters.content:
Originally, Lu Yang was prepared to sell the real entrance exam questions of the Seek Dao Sect, but since the other party already knew they were from the Seek Dao Sect, it wouldn't be good to sell fake questions and have them come looking for us later.
After the four people left, more robed figures approached the pair, looking to buy Yang Invigorating Essence Blood.
They probably thought it embarrassing to buy it in front of everyone in the side hall.
Meng Jingzhou felt the joy of making money for the first time.
Just when Meng Jingzhou thought that no more buyers would come and they could call it a day and return, another robed figure flew over, walking steadily as they held one hand to their chest, polite and courteous, "Benefactors, do you still have any Yang Invigorating Essence Blood for sale?"
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Monk, at least disguise your identity a little.
You say you breached the vow of chastity; if Buddha comes looking for trouble, whose head is it going to fall on, yours or mine?
The courteous monk continued, "Also, this poor monk has no Spirit Stones. May I ask if it's possible to offset the cost with religious services? Monastics do not lie; I am skilled at conducting rituals, be it for birthdays, extending lifespan, exorcising demons, or crossing over the deceased."
Upon hearing this, Meng Jingzhou seriously considered, the precondition for celebrating a birthday is having a son, the precondition for extending lifespan is when one's lifespan is depleted, the precondition for exorcising demons is to have demons daring enough to come near him, and the precondition for crossing over the deceased... is being dead. It seems he wouldn't need any of them.
Lu Yang had a thought and suddenly asked, "May I know the honorable monk's dharma name?"
The courteous monk answered any question asked, "I am Shi Chan."
"Shi Chan, Fellow Daoist?"
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou both exclaimed in surprise, not expecting to encounter a fellow cultivator from the Suspension Temple here.
Shi Chan, hearing the familiar tone of the two, felt quite astonished.
Among the people he knew, none seemed to sell Yang Invigorating Blood.
The three of them took off their robes simultaneously, revealing their true faces.
Shi Chan had handsome features, a neat kasaya, an indifferent expression, and a smile that saw through the mortal world, clearly a distinguished monk.
Although they had not met formally before, they had seen his portraits.
"Are you Fellow Daoists Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou?" Seeing them, Shi Chan was overjoyed, his voice raising two pitches, his indifferent demeanor slightly melting.
Half a year earlier, he had visited the Seek Dao Sect mainly to learn Lu-style Arhat Fist and Single Curse Fist from these two, but it was bad luck that he missed them.
"To think I would encounter the two Senior Brothers here truly is fate."
Lu Yang was also surprised; during the Qingzhou grand ceremony, Shi Chan was the only outstanding disciple of the Five Great Immortal Sects who did not attend because he went to the slaughterhouse. Due to Master Jiesha practicing Silent Zen, no one informed Shi Chan about the Golden Core finals.
"If my memory serves me right, shouldn't Shi Chan, Senior Brother, be at the slaughterhouse?"
Shi Chan shook his head lightly, "I was there originally, but alas, three months ago, a barbecue place named 'Grill Again' bought our slaughterhouse. The people from the grill, upon learning my identity, let me go."
Lu Yang thought to himself that this was probably because they feared Shi Chan would discover Grill Again was backed by the Jiuyou Sect.
After all, our demonic sect and your Immortal Sects are irreconcilably opposed.
"But it doesn't matter, I was planning to leave anyway. It just so happens that at that time, I had an epiphany about 'laying down the butcher's knife to become Buddha immediately' and successfully broke my core to reach Nascent, entering the Nascent Soul Stage."
While talking, the three walked towards the city center.
Great Xia had no curfew, so even at night, the city was bustling and vibrant. The three put away their robes and displayed their usual garb without standing out in the crowd.
Lu Yang casually asked, "So how did you end up at the black market without any Spirit Stones?"
Could it be that you can still beg for alms at the black market?
Shi Chan smiled slightly, "I would get some by reporting it."
"..."
At this point, Shi Chan's tone carried some regret, "I thought it was that kind of black market that trafficked souls, but alas, after a round, I found it was just a small black market for tax evaders."
"My master could still talk when he told me that these kinds of small black markets are tacitly allowed by the government offices, and it's not suitable to report them."
"Although we can't report the black market, meeting two Senior Brothers here is already an extraordinary gain."
"It's my foolishness that I did not connect the Yang Invigorating Blood with Senior Brother Meng. The brothers from the Seek Dao Sect have long told me that Senior Brother Meng is a rare cultivation genius, with a Dao heart as firm as iron, seeking strength without indulging in the company of women."
"It's within reason that Senior Brother Meng could cultivate to the Nascent Soul Stage and his blood would have the effect of invigorating Yang."
"So what do you want Old Meng's blood for, could it be that you have someone in your heart?"
"Senior Brother Lu jokes, I am a monk, how could a monk have such a thing as someone in his heart?"
"I wish to refine the Pure Yang Blood to temper my mind state to a realm where I can sit amidst chaos without being disturbed."
Shi Chan stopped walking, extended his right hand, and pointed to the bustling brothel next door, smiling lightly, "This is where I temper my mind state."
"With a beauty in my arms, my heart as calm as Zen meditation, seeing her as a painted skeleton—that's when one's mind state is truly complete."
"I've heard that Senior Brother Lu's master, Daoist Buyu, is also a cultivator who practices amidst the secular world; surely, Senior Brother Lu is familiar with the worldly cultivation methods and should understand my approach."
In fact, Lu Yang wanted to say that his master would generally practice his Worldly Cultivation in the jail, not in places where one spends money, but saying so would disgrace their Immortal Sect, so he decided against explaining.
We are all disciples of Immortal Sects, it's just a few drops of blood, not worth much money. Meng Jingzhou is generous; he gave Shi Chan twenty drops directly.
For an ordinary Nascent Soul Stage, one drop would be effective, but for a genius Nascent Soul Stage cultivator like Shi Chan, one or two drops wouldn't suffice, hence he needed twenty drops in one go.
Shi Chan, feeling the Yang Qi in the blood, put his hands together and bowed slightly, "Shi Chan thanks the two Senior Brothers in advance."
Shi Chan didn't stand on ceremony, consuming all twenty drops of blood.
"It really works."
Shi Chan's eyes brightened, the effect of Senior Brother Meng's blood was much stronger than he had anticipated; his body responded in a way he had never felt before.
Unable to suppress the power of Meng Jingzhou's blood, he headed straight for the brothel, his expression indifferent, transcending the mundane world.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou didn't know how long Shi Chan would stay in the brothel, so they had no choice but to wait in a nearby tavern.
It was a good opportunity to count the money earned that evening.
"One hundred and fifty thousand Spirit Stones, five hundred thousand Spirit Stones, one hundred thousand Spirit Stones… a total of two million three hundred thousand Spirit Stones!"
Meng Jingzhou couldn't help but beam with joy; his first business venture had earned him so much money, it seemed he had a natural talent for commerce.
However, this business couldn't be carried out continuously. The blood he sold that evening wasn't casually extracted from his body, but was condensed and refined to resemble Essence Blood.
He needed a few days of rest to refine the second batch.
"However, proving that I can make money is enough, why should I keep selling blood?"
Two million three hundred thousand Spirit Stones is an amount that a Nascent Soul Stage Cultivator couldn't produce on the spot.
"Here, I'll give you half."
With a chuckle, Meng Jingzhou pushed half of the Storage Ring toward Lu Yang. Although what Lu Yang, this damn guy, advertised wasn't very flattering, it had helped significantly, and he contributed to later sales of the blood; sharing the Spirit Stones was only right.
Lu Yang didn't decline and accepted the Spirit Stones.
The two sipped on water—free of charge—while casually chatting, ignoring the angry glares of the tavern owner.
"Is Shi Chan supposed to come out now?"
As they spoke, Shi Chan walked out of the brothel, his expression as indifferent, joyless and sorrowless as when he had entered.
Lu Yang gestured for Shi Chan to join them.
"How did the tempering of your mind state go?"
With a light smile, Shi Chan replied, "The tempering failed."

chapters.title: Chapter 654 - 653: The Enlightened Monk
chapters.content:
```
Although his attempt to temper his mind state failed, Shi Chan, as a monk who had mastered Buddhist teachings, was not discouraged.
"There is no need for my two senior brothers to worry about my breaking the precepts."
"The path of cultivation is full of hardships; how can one expect smooth sailing without any ripples? Failure is an unavoidable part of the journey."
"It is through failure that one realizes the true value of success."
"Only after experiencing the pleasure of indulging in carnal desires, can one truly appreciate how much more resilient the mind becomes once it has been successfully tempered."
"...But what if Master Jiesha finds out about your transgressions?"
"Only the three of us know of this matter. As monks, we do not tell lies, but since neither of you are monks, I would ask you to lie should the master inquire."
Lu Yang gestured for Shi Chan to not stand while speaking and to sit and drink some water, "But what if Master Jiesha asks you?"
Upon hearing this, Shi Chan's expression changed slightly, remembering the consequences if his master found out, but then he relaxed again, "Then I will simply have to practice Silent Zen."
Lu Yang: "..."
Worthy of being an enlightened monk, he sure is thorough in his considerations.
Meng Jingzhou looked at his Daoist friend Shi Chan with a soulful gaze, his eyes filled with silent reproach.
So the ancient Pure Yang Immortal Body can have a girlfriend, and now even monks are allowed to visit brothels?
Does that mean I'm the only unlucky one left?
"Buddha once said, 'You must rise from the place where you fall.' Since I have failed today, when I make money in the future, I will fight again. I plan to stay in this city for a few days; what are the two senior brothers' plans?"
Meng Jingzhou made a pause gesture, "Are you sure those were Buddha's words?"
Shi Chan smiled and rolled up his wide sleeves, dipped his index finger in water, and drew three circles on the table, explaining,
"In Buddhism, past, present, and future are seen as one. There is a past Buddha, a present Buddha, and a future Buddha. As a Buddhist disciple, of course, my goal is to become a Buddha. Although I am not a Buddha now, I will definitely be one in the future. Since past, present, and future are one, wouldn't that mean what I say is also what Buddha says?"
Meng Jingzhou felt that Shi Chan joining Suspension Temple was a loss for the Seek Dao Sect.
Lu Yang asked Fairy Eternity, the creator of Buddhism, about what he did not understand regarding Buddhism,
"Fairy, is this a Buddhist teaching?"
"I can't remember, I'm only responsible for making up stories; I don't deal with theoretical matters."
Fairy Eternity was lazily lying on her lotus pedestal, arching her back and stretching like a little cat.
At that moment, Lu Yang's spiritual space transformed into a vast and empty grand hall with glazed tile roofs and detailed carvings on the doors and windows.
The grand hall was thriving with incense offerings, dedicating the true form of Fairy Eternity, the founder of Buddhism, and her lotus pedestal.
As the founder of Buddhism, all Buddhist monks now were her disciples once removed.
Since she encountered one of her grand-disciples, it seemed a good opportunity to redecorate the second-in-command's spiritual space to change the ambiance."
"Then who is responsible for the theory?"
"Everyone else but me."
"..."
"I'm curious, Senior Brother Shi Chan, how do you plan to make money?"
Considering that Shi Chan wanted to earn money by reporting illegal markets, Lu Yang was quite skeptical about Shi Chan's ability to make money.
"By conducting religious ceremonies."
"Oh right, you're a monk," Lu Yang suddenly remembered that Shi Chan was from Suspension Temple.
```
Shi Chan looked at Lu Yang in confusion, then lowered his head to examine his own attire.
From his clothes to his way of doing things, he seemed every bit the part of a monk.
"Then, the poor monk will rest for the night and meet with the two of you here in the morning."
"Hold on a second, do you still have money? Where are you planning to stay?" Lu Yang grabbed Shi Chan, who was ready to leave in a hurry.
If previously Shi Chan was too poor to afford Old Meng's blood and could only afford a visit to the brothel, whether he had money left after that was another matter.
Shi Chan, being forcibly dragged back by Lu Yang, explained, "The monk is penniless, but everywhere under the heavens is home to me. I have already found a bridge hole—it may not block the wind, but it can keep out the rain. There's neither wind nor rain tonight, which makes it suitable for accommodation."
Lu Yang was speechless—as fellow disciples of the Immortal Sect, while we stay in inns, you stay under a bridge. How would this look if it got out?
"Anyway, the two of us made quite a bit of money tonight, so Old Meng will treat you to a stay in an inn."
Meng Jingzhou glared at Lu Yang, thinking, You play the good guy and I foot the bill?
Lu Yang soothed Old Meng, "I'm letting you do a good deed. Think about it, who is Shi Chan? He's a highly attained monk from the Suspension Temple. You usually do so many bad things, offering accommodation to a highly attained monk is a great merit. Considering you shared spirit stones with me, I'm letting you have this opportunity to earn merit."
"Get lost, get lost, get lost." Meng Jingzhou wasn't buying Lu Yang's pitch but staying in an inn wouldn't cost many spirit stones, so if it meant playing host, then so be it.
"I've never seen Buddhist services before; it's a good opportunity to stay here for a few days and see how you perform your rites."
"Then, I thank the two senior brothers."
Seeing that the two were willing to stay in the city, Shi Chan felt genuinely happy.
Maybe he would have the chance to learn two kinds of martial arts and also learn from Senior Brother Meng how to restrain his inner desires.
The blood of the common Single Body Spiritual Root wouldn't have such an effect; Senior Brother Meng must have pushed himself to the limit to create this Yang Invigorating blood.
He couldn't even handle twenty drops; he couldn't begin to imagine how Senior Brother Meng, who was full of this blood, endured it.
When it came to staying in inns, Meng Jingzhou had some unpleasant memories.
"We've stayed in three inns in a row, and something has happened in every one. Surely nothing could happen a fourth time, right?"
Lu Yang was always confident in his luck, "No, think about it—how many times have we encountered Body Integration Realm, Transcendance Tribulation Stage, and Semi-Immortal fights, and haven't we always made it out unscathed, without even a scratch?
"That's obviously a sign of our good fortune."
Meng Jingzhou thought it might be wiser to consider why they kept running into so many Great Power battles.
The three of them successfully found an inn that catered to cultivators, fitted with a Gathering Spirit Array to aid in cultivation.
If it were just Lu Yang and the other, any inn would do—just opening their mouths and using "Swallow the Sky" was more effective than any Gathering Spirit Array.
But since Shi Chan was with them, that was not an option.
"Innkeeper, three Grade-A rooms," Meng Jingzhou, who was in a rare mood to splurge after earning some money, decided to pay for the rooms for all three of them.
The innkeeper was male, so it was unlikely there would be a scenario involving a nephew struggling over an inheritance.
There were plenty of Grade-A rooms available; there was no risk of cultivators fighting over room availability.
The three smoothly made their way to their respective rooms.
Lu Yang pushed open the door to his room and saw chaos inside; the wardrobe and table had toppled over, the window was wide open letting in gusts of cold air, and on the bed, a man and a woman were tangled together. The man, clad in black, had a dagger in his hand and murder in his eyes. The woman was disheveled, struggling fiercely with marks of blood on her neck, matching the stains on the dagger.
The room was protected by a soundproof array that prevented any noise from escaping.
The woman fighting desperately looked at Lu Yang as if he were her last hope.
Lu Yang stepped out of the room and glanced at the room number.
He had walked into the wrong room.

chapters.title: Chapter 655 - 654 Assassin
chapters.content:
"Well, if you let her go now and voluntarily surrender to the government office, you could still be considered as turning yourself in," Lu Yang walked back into the room, earnestly advising the murderer.
Clearly, the adjacent room was where the woman was staying; the assassin had climbed in through the window, intending to kill her but was caught by Lu Yang.
"You're going to die too!"
The black-clad figure with the dagger, seeing Lu Yang return, flashed a glint of cold light in his eyes, only to be pinned to the ground by Lu Yang.
"I guess you won't be turning yourself in either."
With a single hand, Lu Yang subdued the man in black, his tone calm.
The man in black couldn't believe it; he hadn't even clearly seen Lu Yang's movements before he was subdued.
"Foundation Establishment Stage?!"
He, a ninth-level Qi Refinement assassin, was subdued in an instant; his opponent could only be a Foundation Establishment Great Cultivator!
At this point, the only option was suicide!
Lu Yang grabbed his head, broke off two of his front teeth—which contained deadly poison—and then picked up a rag from the ground and stuffed it in his mouth to prevent him from biting his tongue to commit suicide.
He also pressed several points on his body, sealing his meridians and rendering him incapable of moving.
The black-clad assassin was in despair. Who exactly was this uninvited guest—was he a bodyguard hired by the target? How could he be so familiar with suicide prevention?
Yet he had failed to notice that he had smeared a slow-acting poison on his dagger. When not active, no one could detect it, and once it took effect, not even a god could cure it. His target had already been stabbed by him; her life was not long for this world.
And even if it were noticed, it would be useless, for his poison was rare in the world, and he did not have an antidote himself.
Lu Yang took out a pill from his Identity Jade and handed it to the woman, whose soul was still in shock.
"You've been poisoned; the dagger was coated with a toxin called 'Green Ghost Binding Soul'. It will act in three days, and then the green ghost will claim your life, and it will be over. It's not an extremely rare poison; my Detoxification Pill can cure it."
All these were leftover poisons from Elixir Cauldron Peak.
"Ah? Ah, thank you."
The woman numbly took the Detoxification Pill, feeling icy cool and very comfortable, which gave her heart some peace.
After calming herself, the woman looked at Lu Yang with gratitude, "Thank you, sir, my name is..."
"Stop, don't tell me your name, where you come from, your identity, or why there's an assassin after you. I am just a fellow guest next door; I don't know anything. I see you have cultivation; I have nullified the assassin's cultivation, so you can take him to report to the officials yourself."
Lu Yang interrupted the woman's narrative with practiced ease.
Having wandered the martial world for many years, he thrived on creating trouble and could tell at a glance that she was a complication, potentially tangled in countless issues.
"Haha, Old Lu, I heard some noise over here and knew something was happening in your room!" A hearty laugh came from behind Lu Yang, belonging to Meng Jingzhou.
Meng Jingzhou entered the room, and his smile froze.
The situation in the room was straightforward and clear, showing what had happened at a glance.
How come it was him being the heroic savior again?
"Miss, did you run into some trouble that led to someone trying to kill you?"
Lu Yang was about to intervene, but then he heard the woman introduce herself:
"My name is Fu Ling, and I have come from Xuan City next door. My family runs a fabric business, and I've come here seeking to expand our family enterprise."
"Since childhood, I have shown a remarkable talent for business, and my father has often thought of entrusting me with managing our entire family business, a notion always obstructed by my stepmother."
"My stepmother believes that the family business should be inherited by her son, so she has constantly made things difficult for me, but fortunately, I have managed to overcome these difficulties."
"The assassin must have been sent by my stepmother; I owe my life to you, young master, for my escape from this calamity."
Lu Yang shook his head lightly, "This assassin shouldn't have been sent by your stepmother."
Fu Ling was quite surprised, with bewilderment flickering in her eyes.
"Why does the young master say so?"
"Since you came here to expand your family business, your stepmother would at least wait until the trade routes in this city were established before getting rid of you. Killing you now would be akin to throwing away the industry here."
Fu Ling thought about it seriously and agreed that it was possible.
"Could it be because I went to the black market?"
"What do you mean?"
"The young master might not be aware, but there is a black market not far from here. I went to the black market tonight and saw a twenty-year-old glossy ganoderma which looked quite good, so I bought it. Could it be that I stumbled upon a deal and what I purchased wasn't just glossy ganoderma but something else?"
"Can you show it to me?"
Grateful for having her life saved, Fu Ling trusted that Lu Yang would do no harm and took out the glossy ganoderma she had bought from the black market.
The glossy ganoderma was the size of a palm, dark red in color, with rings of patterns on its cap.
"Miss, you're half right. This is indeed glossy ganoderma, but not the ordinary kind. This is a three-hundred-year-old Thunder Tribulation glossy ganoderma, which has been struck by lightning and survived a major disaster. Its appearance is quite different from that of ordinary three-hundred-year-old glossy ganoderma."
"It seems you're quite lucky, Miss."
Lu Yang, being a friend of the Little Medicinal Kings, had learned a lot about plants from them.
"Still, this isn't the reason for your assassination attempt."
"Then why?" Fu Ling's eyes gleamed with confusion.
"The assassin had poison hidden in his front tooth. It's clear that he is a professional killer, not someone driven by greed. He entered through the window with the intent to take your life."
After some thought, Fu Ling said, "I have a childhood sweetheart who is dear to me, and he is quite outstanding. A female disciple from a sect took a liking to my childhood sweetheart, but he rejected her. The reason he gave was that although the female disciple is quite excellent, if he hadn't met me first, perhaps he could have fallen for her."
"It might be possible that this female sect disciple sent the assassin to kill me."
Lu Yang pondered, and that seemed plausible; for the moment, he couldn't find a flaw in this theory.
"Which sect does this female disciple belong to?"
The assassin, still twisting on the floor with a rag stuffed in his mouth by Lu Yang, wasn't able to utter a word.
He had listened to Fu Ling and Lu Yang's analysis for a while and finally spat out the rag.
"So, um, may I say something?"
All three of them looked down at the assassin in unison.
The assassin, feeling guilty under their gaze, still went on, "Miss Fu Ling, right? Sorry about that, it seems I've mistaken you for someone else. My target is in the room opposite; her name is Peacock."
Fu Ling: "…"
Lu Yang: "…"
Hearing what the assassin had said, Meng Jingzhou appeared to unravel the mystery, showing an expression of sudden realization, "So that's how it is."
Lu Yang was baffled, "What do you understand?"
"I encountered a Tribulation Cultivator in my room. He was well-hidden, but I still discovered him. After I subdued him, he confessed that he was there to steal a glossy ganoderma."
At that moment, Shi Chan also walked over, "Hmm, I was looking to find the two Senior Brothers in their room; how come you're both here?"
"What's the matter?"
"It's like this, I came across a woman staying here in the corridor, named Peacock. She said she was being targeted by an assassin. Seeing that I possess cultivation, she requested my protection. I wanted to ask the Senior Brothers for your opinion."

chapters.title: Chapter 656 - 655: Self-Reliance
chapters.content:
Shi Chan encountered a benefactor who requested protection for the first time; as a monk, practicing compassion and protecting others is indubitably his duty.
He agreed but didn't know exactly what preparations were necessary for protection, or what to guard against.
Shi Chan felt that his two senior brothers, who had wandered the martial world for many years, should have far more experience than himself, who spends his days slaughtering pigs, so he came to inquire.
Lu Yang glanced down at the assassin.
He had been planning to ask around on the other side if there was a girl named Peacock, lest the assassin be lying.
Now there was no need for inquiry.
Meng Jingzhou glanced at Lu Yang on his left, rescuing a damsel in distress, then at Shi Chan on his right, capable of protecting the beauty.
Why did it turn out to be a Tribulation Cultivator when it was his turn?
Tribulation Cultivator, what are you doing hiding so conspicuously in my room? Go rob someone else; how else would I get the chance to play the hero and rescue the damsel?
The Tribulation Cultivator hadn't entered the wrong room by mistake; he just felt that since the night was deepening, there wouldn't be any new guests, so he hid in the room unoccupied, preparing to wait until Fu Ling fell asleep to steal away that three-hundred-year-old Thunder Tribulation glossy ganoderma.
Who would have thought that three men would come to lodge so late at night?
One could only say that, just like Meng Jingzhou, they were just unlucky.
Shi Chan suddenly noticed Fu Ling and was filled with doubt, "Benefactor Peacock, why are you here?"
"Master, you have mistaken me for someone else, my name is Fu Ling."
"Senior Brother Shi Chan, what's going on?"
"Benefactor Fu Ling looks exactly like Benefactor Peacock."
Lu Yang was taken aback, "Miss, do you have a sister?"
"No..." Fu Ling was about to deny it when unexpectedly a layer of blurry memories surged into her mind, "Yes, I have a twin sister, but we were separated when I was very young."
Lu Yang pondered over the events that had just unfolded and, feeling he understood the situation, said to Shi Chan, "Go call for Miss Peacock and tell her the assassin has been caught."
Shi Chan was surprised—so the person lying on the floor was the assassin?
Indeed, that black outfit didn't seem to belong to a good person.
Miss Peacock, hiding in Shi Chan's room and holding the Buddha beads left by Shi Chan, was overjoyed upon learning that the assassin had been captured.
She had even been considering spending the night in the same room as Master Shi Chan.
True to a master, he caught the man so quickly.
"Peacock is grateful to the master!"
Shi Chan chanted Amitabha Buddha, "Benefactor need not thank me; it is the merit of my two senior brothers. I did not contribute in this matter."
Peacock took his modesty for granted and handed Shi Chan a Storage Ring, "Here are some Spirit Stones, please accept them, Master."
Shi Chan gently shook his head, "As monks, we should harbor compassion; saving people is my inherent duty, how could I accept money for it?"
"This is not for the master, but a donation to the Buddha's incense fund."
Shi Chan continued to refuse, "I am the Buddha."
"Ah?"
Peacock was confounded by Shi Chan's words, and without further explanation, Shi Chan followed Lu Yang's instruction and brought Miss Peacock to Fu Ling's room.
The two young women, seeing each other, were too shocked to speak.
The air grew tense.
It was Fu Ling who first broke the silence, her lips quivering and her voice tremulous as tears involuntarily streamed down her cheeks, "Sister?"
"You, you are my sister?"
"Sister!"
"Sister!"
The two young girls embraced each other, weeping bitterly. Separated at the age of two, they reunited eighteen years later—a touching scene.
"Sister, where did you go back then, and why are you called Peacock now?"
Peacock, wiping away her tears, sobbed, "After I went missing, Master found me. He took me around the area but couldn't find any of you, so he took me back to his gym and raised me."
"I was too young at the time to remember my own name, so Master named me Peacock."
Lu Yangxin thought he knew it—a professional assassin like this shouldn't misidentify a target, and indeed there was a reason behind it.
Fu Ling's room became overcrowded all at once: Lu Yang and his two companions, Fu Ling, Peacock, the assassin, and the Tribulation Cultivator brought over by Meng Jingzhou.
Seven people gathered together.
Lu Yang scanned the room in silence, taking in the newly reunited sisters, an assassin with poor eyesight, and a Tribulation Cultivator looking to steal. He had probably intended only to stay at the inn.
I just entered the wrong room, so how did all this happen in the blink of an eye?
Now that he understood the full story, Lu Yang felt too embarrassed to suggest that Fu Ling should take the assassin to the Government Office by herself.
The two newly reunited sisters, one holding an assassin and the other a Tribulation Cultivator, went to the Government Office to report the crime, joking and laughing. The scene felt off no matter how he thought about it.
"Let's go, let's take them to the Government Office," Lu Yang sighed, deciding to see his good deed through to the end.
Moreover, he couldn't escape the situation. Even if he didn't go to the Government Office, the constables would come looking for him to give a statement as a witness.
The seven of them made a noisy exit from the inn, leaving the innkeeper stunned.
He didn't remember having so many guests upstairs.
After Lu Yang explained everything to the innkeeper, the latter broke out into a cold sweat.
It was fortunate that the three heroes were present; otherwise, a murder might have occurred at his inn. He did not even dare to think about the consequences. Who else would dare to stay at their inn after that?
The innkeeper thanked them profusely, waived Lu Yang's party's lodging and meal fees, and offered to let them stay as long as they liked.
The innkeeper also waived the sisters' fees, out of apology for the incident that nearly happened in the inn, making the same promise to them.
The group of five, along with the two they were holding, hadn't walked far before they encountered patrolling constables. After hearing the full story, the constables promptly escorted all seven back to the Government Office for a detailed account of the events.
Subsequent events unfolded as Lu Yang had predicted. The assassin and the Tribulation Cultivator were handed over to the Government Office, while the three of them gave statements as witnesses. In the end, each of them received a banner for acting bravely in the face of injustice, as well as a Spirit Stone reward.
This time, Shi Chan did not refuse the reward.
After all the commotion was over and they were physically and mentally exhausted, they could finally return to the inn to rest, unlike the sisters, whose spirits were too agitated by their recent reunion.
After a night, Lu Yang stretched and felt totally relaxed; his spirit was rejuvenated.
"Old Meng, time to get up!"
Lu Yang gently knocked on the door, calling Meng Jingzhou awake.
Meng Jingzhou opened the door with a dark expression, staring gloomly at Lu Yang.
Lu Yang ignored Meng Jingzhou's gaze.
Shi Chan emerged from his room, full of vitality and in a completely different state from the night before, clearly well-rested: "Elder Brother Lu Yang, good morning."
"What's the plan today? Are we going to perform religious services?"
"That's the intention," Shi Chan replied.
With a teasing tone, Lu Yang said, "And here I thought you were going to use the Spirit Stone the Government Office rewarded you with last night to go to the brothel to temper your Mind State."
"Elder Brother jests. Without merit, one should not accept rewards. I haven't done much yesterday; it was thanks to the two of you that I acquired a good reputation for acting bravely. The Spirit Stone given by the Dynasty is hard to refuse, so consider it a donation from the Dynasty to the Sect. It shouldn't be used personally," responded Shi Chan.
"Do you want some Spirit Stones from me?" Meng Jingzhou said, laughing.
Shi Chan shook his head refusing: "Using the Spirit Stones from Senior Brother Meng to go to the brothel wouldn't count as me going, but rather Senior Brother Meng. It wouldn't achieve the desired purpose of tempering oneself."
"Master often taught me to rely on my own efforts. The Spirit Stones I use to go to the brothel must be earned through my own abilities."

chapters.title: Chapter 657 - 656 Doing Good and Accumulating Virtue
chapters.content:
```
"So, how do you plan to attract business, go door to door asking?"
Shi Chan shook his head and pulled out a banner from his Identity Jade. The banner listed all sorts of services, from Expel Ghost to fertility blessings to curing illnesses; it had everything, quite comprehensive indeed.
On the back of the banner was written "Prices negotiable."
Shi Chan, along with the two others, arrived at the busiest part of the city, paid the site fee, found a small open space, set up his stall, raised the banner, and sat down steadily in front of the table.
His actions were practiced, indicating that this wasn't his first time doing this.
Shi Chan also kindly brought out two more chairs for Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou to sit on.
To the left of Shi Chan's stall was a noodle vendor, and to the right, sesame seed cake was being sold. His banner, similar to that of a fortune teller, was very conspicuous.
Passersby frequently turned their heads, noticing this unique monk. However, due to his unique presence, no one dared to approach him for help at first.
Shi Chan felt somewhat regretful, as he never had much business when he first started his stall. Once people realized he was indeed a monk of abilities, they would queue up to seek his help. But then, seeing the crowds and the overwhelming number of tasks, unable to handle the demand, he would leave early.
"The common people lack innovative spirit, afraid to accept new things. If I had the eloquence of my esteemed teacher, I would surely go to the tea houses and tell stories to propagate Buddhist teachings."
This was the first time Lu Yang encountered praise for his master, and he felt surprised and honored. If his master, who was beneath the nine springs, knew this, he would surely be gratified.
"By the way, Senior Brother Meng, have you ever considered joining Buddhism? I see that you have a deep connection with Buddhism, an autodidact who has developed the Single Curse Fist, surely a future Buddha just like me."
"... Having a Single Body Spiritual Root doesn't mean I'll be celibate for life."
Being a Single Body Spiritual Root meant being forcibly celibate, whereas Buddhism prescribes voluntary celibacy, which are two different matters.
Meng Jingzhou had already inquired through Lu Yang about Fairy Eternity's situation; he knew that once he became an immortal, he wouldn't be constrained by his Single Body Spiritual Root and could freely indulge in his desires.
"Senior Brother Meng, you are mistaken. Buddhism advocates doing good deeds and accumulating virtue to gain good fortune. There was once a nun who asked the Buddha what if someone who usually did evil unintentionally did a good deed, whether they could still obtain good fortune.
The Buddha replied affirmatively, pointing out that for those who do good deeds, it is the act that counts, not the intention."
"So what?" Meng Jingzhou was completely confused and didn't understand what Shi Chan was trying to say.
"What I mean is that it is the act that counts, not the intention. Senior Brother Meng, although you are forced to be without a partner of the opposite sex, in reality, you have fulfilled what Buddhism requires, which is staying away from desires, truly reflecting a deep Buddhist connection."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Just wait, I'll see when you save up enough money to visit a brothel. I'll book the entire place in advance and gift you twenty drops of Yang Invigorating blood, let's see if you don't explode with frustration!
With no business for the moment, Lu Yang chatted with the old man selling noodles on his left, while Meng Jingzhou talked with the sesame seed cake vendor on his right.
After waiting for about half an hour, they finally had a customer.
The newcomer was lavishly dressed, adorned with gold and silver, with jade rings on both thumbs, and portly.
"Master, my luck has been terrible lately, I've had nothing but bad fortune, and several of my business deals have fallen through. Can I seek wealth here?"
Shi Chan looked indifferent with his hands clasped together: "Benefactor, if I were able to seek wealth, I wouldn't be setting up a stall here."
"..."
The wealthy man had never before encountered such an honest little monk; he had thought the monk would spout some nonsense, urging him to make a donation, then put on a show of seeking wealth for him.
Shi Chan then suggested a second method: "If benefactor insists on seeking wealth, then you could ask my senior brother for help. Senior Brother Meng's family wealth is extensive, rich enough to rival nations. If you seek wealth from him, you could borrow money."
"Benefactor could also do more good deeds, which could counteract the run of bad luck."
The rich man felt this little monk wasn't very reliable, shook his head, and left the place.
```
```
Seeing the wealthy merchant leave, Fairy Eternity shook her head gently, filled with some regret.
"Foolish."
In the grand hall, Fairy Eternity, draped in her monk's robe, sat on the lotus pedestal, her aura dignified. Yet her little feet were not quite still, her delicate and pearly toes wiggling constantly.
"Who's foolish?" Lu Yang asked, puzzled.
"That merchant, unable to recognize a good heart, wouldn't take advice."
"I have always advocated for doing good deeds and accumulating virtue, saying that it will surely dispel the misfortune clinging to him."
"My advocacy for charity and virtue is based on personal experiences. My life has been smooth sailing because I've always enjoyed doing good deeds, being charitable, and helping others."
"I recall, before I became immortal, in times of chaos and wanton killing, conflicts between two people would inevitably end in death."
"I've fought above my level and defeated Yingtian Immortal and Qilin Immortal. And not only did I spare their lives, but I also cooked for them, turning strife into friendship, and my actions became widely celebrated."
"It is often said in Buddhism that saving a life is more meritorious than building a seven-level stupa, and that principle originates from this deed."
"During the Ancient Times, interactions were limited. To learn from others, one had to endure harsh trials and make poisonous vows. Even then, one might not learn the true skills, as masters would keep several secrets, and more gravely, some manipulated their disciples with cultivation techniques through curses and tricks."
"I, however, did differently. Seeing Lianyi and Xiao Ling's talents in cultivation, I generously imparted to them the art of cooking and the Playing Dead Technique."
"Then there's the Barbarian tribe. Noticing their simple nature – strong but clueless in wielding their power – I enlightened them, allowing the tribe to grow stronger."
Listening to Fairy Eternity's stories, Lu Yang finally understood the true power of strength.
Could it be that his own misdeeds had invited this calamity called Fairy Eternity, bringing bad luck upon himself?
After the failure of his first business deal, Shi Chan was unthwarted and waited for the second deal.
"Eh, little monk, what are you doing here? Are you out of money?"
A strikingly beautiful woman stopped by, looking at Shi Chan with lively interest.
"It turns out to be Benefactor Miao Shan."
"And who is this?" Meng Jingzhou inquired.
"Let me introduce you. This is Benefactor Miao Shan from the Spring Fragrance House, one of the many women who served me last night," Shi Chan explained.
Last night, after refining twenty drops of Pure Yang Blood, Shi Chan hailed multiple women from Spring Fragrance House to test himself, aiming to hone his mind state.
"If you're out of money, little monk, I'm willing to serve you once for free," Miao Shan teased, licking her lips with a seductive gaze.
"Benefactor Miao Shan jests. Indeed, I did not withstand the test last night and failed to train my mind state. However, it's been merely one night, and now my mind is as still as water; I am definitely not tempted by the benefactor's offer," Shi Chan declared.
Seeing Shi Chan decline, Miao Shan was quite disappointed.
She glanced at the big flag Shi Chan had set up, advertising his services, and then asked:
"What if I say I want to have a child?"
"Then the benefactor would need to pay."
Meng Jingzhou's eyes reddened. Was this the result of Shi Chan's doing good deeds and accumulating virtue?
```

chapters.title: Chapter 658 - 657 Admonishing
chapters.content:
Meng Jingzhou felt that he had done a fair share of good deeds, despite his less-than-ideal background and being compelled to collude with the Meng Family, but he had run away from home early on and severed ties with the family.
After arriving at the Seek Dao Sect, he dedicated himself to Qi Refinement, lest one day his father would come to find him and hang him up for a beating.
Was it the consequence of messing around with Lu Yang every day?
That's not right either; how come Lu Yang has such a profound destiny that he could receive personal instruction from Fairy Eternity?
Miao Shan blinked, her face exuding the glow of spring, "How much for the little monk?"
"Ten taels of silver."
"Here."
Miao Shan did not hesitate, she took out a silver ingot from her sleeve and slapped it onto the table.
Shi Chan examined the ingot for authenticity, then turned to ask, "Which one of you Senior Brothers is willing to offer your services for the female benefactor's request?"
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Lu Yang: "..."
Now it was Miao Shan's turn to be stunned, "Wait, isn't it supposed to be you, little monk?"
Shi Chan pressed his palms together reverently, his expression solemn, and seriously said, "Benefactor Miao Shan, as a monk, how could I partake in such activities?"
Miao Shan's expression turned strange; based on your behavior last night, you hardly resemble a monk.
"What happened at the Spring Fragrance House last night was just a test that I failed to resist," he replied.
"So, can I not ask for a child then?"
"Yes."
Shi Chan handed the silver ingot back to Miao Shan.
"In a few days, once I've saved enough silver, I will return to the Spring Fragrance House to temper my Mind State."
Miao Shan's expression finally improved.
After Shi Chan had turned away two prospective buyers, another half an hour passed before the third potential deal arrived.
"Master, you can exorcise evil spirits here, right?" A middle-aged man approached Shi Chan, looking troubled—a perfect mark for a swindling fortune teller who could easily be deceived by ambiguous words into believing the fortune teller was a real master.
"Yes, benefactor, are you seeking to drive away evil spirits? Based on my observations, there's no evil demon inhabiting you, it's just troubles of the heart causing anxiety and excessive sweating," Shi Chan replied.
Shi Chan poured tea, filling the cups with calming tea made by the Suspension Temple.
"The tea is on the house, please enjoy."
The middle-aged man guzzled down the tea and calmed down.
"It's not me; it's my daughter."
"What happened to your esteemed daughter?"
"My daughter once went out and met a boy living two blocks away from our home. She fell head over heels for him, experienced love at first sight, claiming it was a match made in heaven, so deeply in love she was."
"I disapprove of this match, and she has fasted in protest — she hasn't eaten for three days in a row!"
"Whenever she'd throw a tantrum and fast in the past, she couldn't bear it for more than a day, but this time she's persisted for three whole days. Even her favorite barbecue from Come Again Barbecue Shop doesn't tempt her!"
"Benefactor, splitting up lovers is not a good deed. I would not engage in such behavior for money, as it would harm my virtue," Shi Chan responded.
"Moreover, love at first sight has existed since ancient times and is not at all uncommon."
"However, it is not right for her to fast to the point of risking her life. I can try to reason with your esteemed daughter."
"That would be wonderful."
Shi Chan packed up his stall, and the three of them headed to the middle-aged man's residence together.
On the way to the residence, the trio learned that the middle-aged man's name was Zhong Ming. His family was in the medicinal herb business. His wife had died early, and he had raised his daughter alone. His daughter was named Zhong Qing'er, and the young man was named Kang Wei.
That morning, he had purchased a three-hundred-year-old glossy ganoderma. Coincidentally, the owner of the ganoderma was a female cultivator at the Qi Cultivation Stage. He asked the female cultivator if there was a master who could solve the problem if his daughter was bewitched, and she recommended Shi Chan, whom she had met at an inn the night before.
"So, it was Ms. Fu Ling who referred him," Lu Yangxin thought. No wonder Zhong Ming started by asking Shi Chan if he could exorcise evil spirits without even suspecting he was a swindler.
The residence wasn't small, featuring triple courtyards and a few servants employed by the family.
Zhong Ming led the three to Zhong Qing'er's boudoir, where food that had gone cold, including skewers, lay on the floor.
"This is my daughter's boudoir, uh, as a monk, is it permissible for you to enter a lady's room?"
"Of course, it is." Shi Chan pushed the door open and confidently walked into the boudoir.
It was a very ordinary boudoir, with a circular tea table in the middle, burnt-out candles, various books, and on the wall side, a copper mirror and makeup items such as rouge were displayed.
With her pale face showing extreme hunger, Zhong Qing'er lay on the bed. Seeing her father bring in a monk and two other men whose roles she did not understand, she said with her last bit of strength:
"If I can't be with Kang, I'd rather starve to death!"
"Miss, I've come to persuade you to eat some food. If you choose to starve to death, I also offer soul-delivery services, although the price is somewhat higher than persuading."
"I am actually better at soul delivery. I worked in a slaughterhouse for over a year. Countless livestock died by my hand, and I have delivered the souls of those animals."
Shi Chan once again took out the large banner, pointing to the word "Soul-Delivery" written on it, to prove he wasn't lying.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou made a great effort to look solemn, as if they were Shi Chan's left and right Protectors.
Zhong Qing'er: "..."
"I am not good at talking, and I lack Daoist Buyu's eloquence to successfully persuade. However, I do have Fasting Pills here that can force the young lady to consume them."
"If the young lady is unwilling, I can also throw you out of the residence, onto the street. At that point, no one will care for your safety. Without the support of your family, you will naturally be willing to eat."
The more Zhong Qing'er listened, the paler her face became.
Zhong Ming was also greatly startled; the master appeared kind, but his methods were far from it.
Scared to tears by Shi Chan, Zhong Qing'er wondered: Had her father brought in a monk or a butcher?
"I, I'll eat."
She just wanted to scare her father, not actually starve herself to death.
"Can I have the grilled skewers from the barbecue restaurant again?"
"No, Benefactor. You haven't eaten for three days, and binge eating could put your life at risk. You should focus on a light diet."
Shi Chan turned to Zhong Ming and said, "Please make a bowl of plain porridge for the benefactor."
Zhong Ming was initially shocked, as he did not expect his daughter to agree to eat so quickly. He then became overjoyed and promptly went out to prepare the meal himself.
Soon after, Zhong Qing'er sipped plain porridge little by little with a spoon.
"Many thanks to the master. How much would be appropriate for the offering money?"
Shi Chan shook his head: "We cannot leave yet. Your daughter really is bewitched, as there is a faint wave of magic skill emanating from her."
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou nodded silently, having noticed this as well. Zhong Qing'er was clearly under someone's magic spell, which had caused her current state.
They just didn't know which magic skill had been cast or rather, what magic skill makes one fall in love with a person?
"She is under the effect of Dream Magic," Fairy Eternity identified the spell cast upon Zhong Qing'er in a glance.
"Dream Magic?"
"It's a magic skill that makes people dream, with the content of the dream being controlled by the caster. Remember my Dream Pillow? It's similar to that, although not nearly as sophisticated as my pillow," Fairy Eternity explained.

chapters.title: Chapter 659 - 659: 558
chapters.content:
"Magic skills related to dreaming?" Lu Yang rarely dealt with such things, and the Dream-entering Technique was quite obscure. To his knowledge, only a few people like the Grand Elder in the Seek Dao Sect had researched it, and the Grand Elder was the one who mastered it best.
Suddenly, Lu Yang's expression turned strange. He vaguely remembered meeting a mysterious man in his dreams when he just started cultivating, and that person claimed to be 'Tofu Heavenly Venerate,' boasting that eating tofu would make one stronger...
Back then he was naive and thought it was just a simple nightmare.
Now he wondered, could it have been the doing of Eldest Senior Sister?
"If you're unfamiliar with Dream-entering Technique, it's easy to fall prey to it. But with this Immortal here, I guarantee you won't be controlled by any Dream-entering magic!" Fairy Eternity spent her days in the Spiritual Space either watching the commotion or taking long naps, which showed how deep her research into Dream-entering Technique was.
"Can dreams really control a person?"
"Of course they can. You should have experienced this. When you wake up from a dream, the memory fades over time, until only a vague concept remains, right?"
Lu Yang nodded. That was the process.
"What if someone uses magic to determine the content of your dreams, and does so over a long period of time? Couldn't you be subtly changed by that?"
Lu Yang had an epiphany and remembered something.
A long time ago, there was a merchant guild that used large-scale Dream-entering magic to advertise for their guild and sell products, making that specific product sell exceptionally well.
Later, when the scandal was exposed, Great Xia penalized the guild so heavily it almost went bankrupt and established advertising laws to prevent such incidents.
"Fairy, are you saying Miss Zhong is in that situation?"
"Yes."
With the guidance of the Immortal, Lu Yang immediately shifted his consciousness back.
Shi Chan and Meng Jingzhou were still discussing what magic might have affected Zhong Qing'er when they saw Lu Yang confidently announce the answer he had just received, earning Shi Chan's high praise.
"As expected of Elder Brother Lu Yang, Benefactor Zhong Qing'er must have been affected by this kind of magic!"
Meng Jingzhou glanced at Lu Yang sideways. He knew well what Lu Yang was capable of, and such a professional answer clearly came from the Immortal's enlightenment.
Shi Chan turned to ask Zhong Qing'er, who was still eating porridge and pickled vegetables.
"Benefactor, did you truly fall in love with Kang Wei at first sight without having met him anywhere else, like in a dream?"
The three of them weren't hiding their conversation, so Zhong Qing'er heard everything while eating her porridge. With Shi Chan's question, she frowned slightly, somewhat unsure, "I don't remember clearly, but I do feel like I've seen him before, yet when I think hard about it, I haven't really met him."
"When I saw Kang Wei on the street a week ago, I felt like we had known each other for a long time, like we were fated lovers."
Zhong Qing'er did not blindly fall in love with Kang Wei, and if he had indeed been doing something behind her back, she was determined to seek an explanation.
Shi Chan held up two fingers: "Two possibilities."
"Either the Jiuyou Sect is right, and there really is reincarnation in this world and you had a predestined relationship with Benefactor Kang in a previous life."
"Or you were influenced by the Dream-entering technique."
Lu Yang thought to himself that reincarnation did exist, but it was limited to Li Haoran alone.
"The second possibility is the greatest."
Zhong Ming, who had been listening all along, suddenly got angry and slammed his thigh, "I knew there was something off about that Kang rascal!"
He was about to grab a shovel and rush out to capture Kang Wei.
Shi Chan stopped Zhong Ming, "Benefactor, do not act hastily. Kang Wei's actions have already violated the law, but we need solid evidence to proceed confidently."
"How about this, the three of us will also enter dreams tonight, and find evidence in the dreamscape—that's the most reliable method."
Upon hearing Shi Chan's suggestion, Zhong Ming calmed down.
Indeed, that was the best approach.
Lu Yang, hearing Shi Chan's plan, asked, "You know the Dream-entering technique?"
"I've learned a bit."
"When this humble monk was out exorcising demons, a female demon coveted my beauty, wanting to control me in a dream state. Thankfully, at that time, I was reciting scriptures in the Great Buddha Hall in my dream, where the Buddha statue revealed its spirit and suppressed the demon."
"Worried about similar incidents, I studied the Dream-entering Technique."
"If tonight Kang Benefactor still casts his illusionary dream magic, then I will pull both Senior Brothers into the dream as well."
"Good."
"Please ask Benefactor Zhong Ming to bring three sets of bedding, so that us three brothers may sleep."
Zhong Ming immediately called for his servants to clean the floor of the boudoir, and moved three sets of fine bedding from the side rooms.
"It is rather embarrassing to say, but legend has it that the founder of Buddhism could fall asleep anytime, anywhere, truly reaching the realm of 'co-existing with heaven and earth.' This poor monk is far from such a realm, as I must be in a bed to sleep."
Lu Yang sneaked a glance at Fairy Eternity, who was fast asleep on the lotus platform in a particularly ungraceful position.
Back in the Demon Territory, Fairy had often slept in trees, indeed able to sleep wherever and whenever.
The Dream-entering Technique must be performed at night; otherwise, if only the three of them entered the dream, it would be pointless without Kang Wei also doing so.
Waiting was a rather boring affair, so the three of them started to chat with Zhong Qing'er.
Zhong Qing'er saw Shi Chan was dignified in appearance; although a monk, he was extremely handsome, even more so than the elegant Mr. Kang.
Shi Chan noticed this and advised, "Benefactor, this poor monk is a follower of Buddhism. If you harbor unusual thoughts towards me, I ask you to dispel them, lest you create turmoil in your heart."
Meng Jingzhou looked at Shi Chan from all angles with displeasure, now wanting to feed Shi Chan twenty drops of Yang Invigorating Blood.
As night fell, Zhong Qing'er started to nod off while chatting and soon fell asleep.
"Has the other party cast their magic skill?" Meng Jingzhou was eager to try; he had never entered a dream voluntarily before.
"Wait a little longer."
About a quarter of an hour later, Shi Chan suddenly said, "Here it comes!"
"Prepare to enter the dream, Senior Brothers!"
Meng Jingzhou immediately lay down, snuggled into the comfortable bedding, and closed his eyes.
Suddenly, Meng Jingzhou's expression changed: "Damn it!"
"What's wrong?"
"Too excited, I can't fall asleep!"
"..."
Luckily, Lu Yang was quick to adapt, crawling out of the bed and stretching his body: "No worries, I'll knock you out with one punch, and you'll be asleep. Just relax or it won't work as well."
"Damn it, wait a moment, are you serious..."
An enormous fist appeared before Meng Jingzhou's pupils, growing larger and larger, until with a 'thud,' he lost consciousness.
Lu Yang was very satisfied with the result and peacefully fell asleep.
Shi Chan also fell asleep.
In the dream, he formed hand seals, casting the Dream-entering Technique, pulling himself and the two sleeping beside him into Zhong Qing'er's dream.
"This is the dream realm? Such a novel sensation." Meng Jingzhou consciously entered a dream for the first time and felt a hazy sensation.
Lu Yang also found it interesting. They were in a Peach Blossom Forest, with petals fluttering down like pink snow.
"There is the benefactor," Shi Chan pointed to a pavilion not far away. The pavilion was the best spot in the entire Peach Blossom Forest for viewing the blossoms, allowing one to see the flowers without being covered in petals.
"Let's not make any noise, and sneak over to take a look first."
The three of them tiptoed closer to the pavilion.
Inside the pavilion, Zhong Qing'er was dressed boldly, far more seductive than in her boudoir.
Zhong Qing'er was holding the hand of a fantasized version of Shi Chan, looking at him with tender affection.
The fantasized Shi Chan had hair and looked even more handsome.
"Shi Chan, can we be together?"
"Yes."
Not far away, a man stumbled over, watching the scene in disbelief.
"Qing'er, who, who is he?"
Zhong Qing'er looked at the man and said indifferently, "Kang Wei, let's break up."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
He turned his head to look at the real Shi Chan.
Are you a succubus with an Immortal body?

chapters.title: Chapter 660 - 659: The Pendant
chapters.content:
Originally, Lu Yang and his two companions planned to find conclusive evidence to expose Kang Wei's true colors, so that Zhong Qing'er would realize that her past love was nothing but a deception.
Now there was no need, as she had moved on to another love, falling for Shi Chan.
"Senior Brother Meng, you jest," said the monk humbly. "I am merely more handsome than the average man."
"It's a pity that people only care about my good looks and show no interest in my Buddhist teachings," he lamented.
Meng Jingzhou's desire to punch someone grew even stronger.
Meanwhile, in a small pavilion, the drama of two men vying for one woman continued to unfold.
"Kang Wei, you are a good person, but we are not suited for each other," Zhong Qing'er said as she nestled in the fake Shi Chan's embrace, constantly watching his expression while speaking to Kang Wei, for fear of displeasing the man she was with.
The fake Shi Chan teased her by flicking her nose lightly: "Silly girl, why would I be unhappy? You rejected him and chose me—I am too happy to care about anything else."
"Shi Chan, you're truly kind."
"So are you."
Kang Wei: "..."
What was going on, everything was fine yesterday, how come he was being cuckolded today?
And in a dream, no less.
"Looking at Kang Wei like this, he just seems like an ordinary person," Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou said, frowning. "He doesn't have any trace of having cultivated."
Even if a cultivator doesn't display their cultivation level, their breathing and walking patterns differ from those of ordinary people who haven't cultivated.
Unless the other person is purposely concealing it, or they have reached the realm of returning to simplicity and truth.
"How can an ordinary person use dream invasion techniques?" Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou frowned, wouldn't that make the two of them look foolish?
"Let's take action. I can't stand to watch any longer. I'm getting goosebumps," Meng Jingzhou suggested.
Shi Chan watched his own counterfeit commit acts of affection with Zhong Qing'er, becoming a bit too much to bear, and silently nodded in agreement.
"Go!"
Meng Jingzhou yelled, startling Lu Yang with his loud voice.
"Who's there!"
Kang Wei was the first to react, as he was lucid in the dream. Zhong Qing'er was the owner of the dream but was confused and slow to respond.
Kang Wei's quick reaction was of no use; when the three geniuses of the current age struck, even those in the Divinity Transformation Stage had to avoid their edge and dared not confront them head-on, let alone an ordinary person like him.
The trio swarmed over and pinned Kang Wei to the ground; Shi Chan moved a thought, and a rope appeared, binding Kang Wei securely.
"I've had my eye on you, you little shit, keep still!" Meng Jingzhou said fiercely, his face twisted menacingly.
It was only then that Zhong Qing'er reacted: "Two Shi Chans?"
Shi Chan quietly watched Zhong Qing'er, thinking that after this matter was dealt with, he should keep as far away from the Zhong residence as possible.
Suddenly, Kang Wei's figure began to fade, and Shi Chan swiftly conjured a talisman and affixed it to Kang Wei's forehead, preventing any further change.
"I have stopped his awakening," the monk said. "Please, Senior Brothers, wake up and go to Benefactor Kang's home. I will stay here to prevent any mishaps."
"All right, but how do we wake up?"
"Follow my lead." Shi Chan demonstrated a hand seal and placed it over his chest. He didn't conceal the flow of his meridians while forming the seal, allowing Lu Yang and the others to learn just by watching once, given their talents.
The two of them gradually woke up, kicked off their covers, and sprang up in a swift movement.
They had already obtained Kang Wei's address from Zhong Ming and, carrying Shi Chan, they ran down the streets, ignoring the surprised looks of passersby. After running through two streets, they found Kang Wei's house.
Kang Wei's home was just a typical brick and tile house, nothing compared to the Zhong's three-sectioned mansion.
The two burst through the front door and found Kang Wei fast asleep inside.
"He truly is an ordinary person."
"What's that in his hands?"
Kang Wei's fingers were crossed over his chest, holding a pendant.
"There's spiritual essence fluctuating from the pendant; it must be a magic instrument. His ability to invade Miss Zhong's dreams must be related to it," they concluded.
Lu Yang shook Shi Chan awake: "Wake up, we've arrived."
In the dream, Shi Chan felt himself waking and hastened to throw Kang Wei out of the dream first.
If he were the only one to emerge and Kang Wei remained, the latter could potentially take Zhong Qing'er hostage.
Kang Wei and Shi Chan woke up one after another.
Kang Wei knew very well the other party was a cultivator, and he certainly couldn't overpower them.
"Benefactor Kang, I hope you will confess the truth," the monk stated.
"Choose, will you confess willingly, or do we beat you up first and then you confess?" Meng Jingzhou rotated his wrists, making clicking noises, and pinning Kang Wei against the wall, he threw a punch near Kang Wei's ear.
Lu Yang remained silent, extending two fingers and shooting out a three-foot-long cyan Sword Qi. With a casual swipe, the corner of a table nearby was sheared off, terrifying Kang Wei.
He was just an ordinary mortal, never having witnessed such a scene.
"I'll confess, I'll confess, where should I start?"
"Start with how you met Miss Zhong and where you got the pendant from!"
"Yes, yes."
"The first time I saw Miss Zhong was a month ago, by sheer coincidence. I saw her on the street and fell in love with her at first sight."
"Since then, I could neither eat nor sleep, restless and constantly thinking of her."
"But I knew that with my own standing, I was not worthy of a rich young lady. Yet, I couldn't let her go."
"That's when Boss Hong found me, saying he had a pendant that, if pointed at Qing'er, would allow me to enter her dreams every night. Over time, with continuous suggestion, she would fall for me."
"To buy this pendant, I even took out a hefty loan from the trading company."
"Who is Boss Hong?"
"He's a local ruffian around here, I met him at the gambling den. He has over thirty men under him, and he even cultivated at the Bamboo Leaf Sect before. He's a Cultivator with a Cultivation Level so profound it's unfathomable but later committed a mistake and was expelled from the Sect."
"Even though he was expelled, it's said he still has connections with high-ranking individuals of the Bamboo Leaf Sect in secret." Kang Wei tried to intimidate the three by dropping the name of the Bamboo Leaf Sect.
"Where is Boss Hong?" Lu Yang was unmoved, having never heard of this minor sect.
Kang Wei didn't reply. Meng Jingzhou showed an angry visage like the legendary Acala, frightening Kang Wei into trembling and having no choice but to lead the three to Boss Hong.
Boss Hong's residence was not far from here, just across the street.
"Hong Residence, quite imposing."
Boss Hong's place was even larger than the Zhong family's.
"Halt, who are you people!"
Being the local ruffian, Boss Hong had arranged manpower at the gate of Hong Residence to prevent enemies from approaching.
Lu Yang and his two companions didn't bother to answer them, simply waving their hands to send them flying.
Inside the Hong Residence, Boss Hong's men were carousing, making a racket while eating and drinking. Seeing the three intruders, they rushed up in an attempt to stop them.
Meng Jingzhou punched the air and the resulting shockwave from the sonic boom knocked those men out cold.
...
In a room deep within Hong Residence, Boss Hong was conversing with a young girl: "Junior Sister, your request is a bit difficult, ah. The government office is very strict about these matters, and if they trace it back to me, my life is over."
The girl smiled faintly and handed Boss Hong a wooden box: "I'll have to trouble Hong Senior Brother with this."
Boss Hong opened the box, and his heart skipped a beat.
This was actually a Foundation Establishment Pill! And the quality was not the worst kind at that!
