He collected the box without a flicker of emotion, laughing, "Though the government office is strict, what kind of man would your Senior Brother be if he had no means? However, who is it that you want your Senior Brother to kill?"
"Her name is Fu Ling, from Xuan City, at the third level of Qi Refinement, and she's here to discuss business. But she's just a somewhat pretty woman who dares to vie with me for Brother Qing's affection, truly unaware of how the word 'death' is written!"
Boss Hong chuckled nervously: "If that is so, she indeed deserves death."
Suddenly, the sound of a fight came from outside.
Boss Hong frowned: "I'll go out and see what's happening."
"Who are you people!"
Boss Hong emerged from the house, radiating the full aura of Qi Refinement Completion in an attempt to scare off the three intruders.
A woman followed Boss Hong out; she was dressed in beautiful clothes, well-proportioned, and looked pitiable.
At first, Lu Yang thought she was abducted by Boss Hong, but then realized she was actually at Foundation Establishment Stage.
A disciple of the Bamboo Leaf Sect?
"Is this pendant what you sold to Benefactor Kang?" Shi Chan intoned a sutra and brought out Kang Wei along with the pendant.
"What of it?" Boss Hong frowned, not expecting this to be the issue.
Selling a pendant wasn't illegal. Why would a monk bring two Protectors in the middle of the night to find him?
Lu Yang sneered: "It's true selling a pendant isn't illegal, but inciting Kang Wei to seduce Miss Zhong of the Zhong family is wrong."
He didn't say another reason: the pendant was a magic instrument, and Kang Wei, a mere mortal, was able to afford it simply through a loan, suggesting the pendant's origin was not entirely reputable.
"Who are you to be sticking your hands in so deep!" Boss Hong had been through the underworld for many years and was not someone easily bullied. He let out a low shout, and two enormous hands made of black mist emerged behind him.
"Seek Dao Sect, Lu Yang."
Clang.
Boss Hong said nothing else, immediately kneeling on the ground with his hands clasped behind his head: "I am guilty, I surrender."

chapters.title: Chapter 661 - 660 Profound Good Fortune
chapters.content:
If it had been constables who came, Boss Hong would have had the courage to resist.
But Lu Yang was different.
In Great Xia, who didn't know Lu Yang? Cultivators knew that he had fought the Young Sect Master of the Heavenly Court Sect to a standstill during his Golden Core Stage, and ordinary people knew him as the protagonist of the "Legend of the Dao Seeking Sect: The Lu Yang Story".
The Five Great Immortal Sects were such lofty forces with clouds of great cultivators. It was said that within the Immortal Sects they didn't even bother to differentiate levels within the Qi Cultivation Stage. The ancestor with the highest cultivation level in their Bamboo Leaf Sect was merely at the Nascent Soul Stage, not even worthy to carry shoes for someone from the Immortal Sects.
Not to mention Lu Yang from the Seek Dao Sect, a peerless genius who was so young yet had once served as the Acting Sect Leader, a sure future Sect Leader of the Seek Dao Sect.
Even the City Lord would have to be extremely polite when facing Lu Yang, let alone a mere Qi Stage cultivator like himself.
Meng Jingzhou cast a glance at Lu Yang, who appeared somewhat smug, and regretted deeply.
He was a step slow when reporting his name; even if he reported it now, it would not have the same effect as Lu Yang's.
The young girl who emerged with Boss Hong was also startled by Lu Yang's name; it was the legendary Talent Lu.
Compared to Talent Lu, her beloved didn't amount to much.
Moreover, this Talent Lu was rather handsome too.
The two standing beside Talent Lu, judging by their positions, seemed to be of similar status, both very handsome, especially the monk, who was the most handsome.
The girl contemplated which one of the three men to choose.
Lu Yang squinted and smiled, "Boss Hong, turning yourself in is not just a matter of surrendering; you must also truthfully confess all your actions."
"I'll confess, I'll tell everything!" said Boss Hong hastily.
"Where did the amulets you sold come from, and how many did you sell?"
"It was over a month ago. Someone approached me, asking me to help sell a batch of amulets. Originally, I didn't want to agree, but the person had high cultivation, and if I refused, the consequences would be dangerous. I had no choice but to agree to that person's demands."
"That person had another condition: I could only sell the amulets to ordinary people and not to cultivators."
Lu Yang frowned, "Who was that person, what did he look like, and what was his cultivation level?"
"I don't know his name; he was skinny and tall, just like a bamboo pole."
"I also don't know his cultivation level."
The brows of Lu Yang and his companions furrowed slightly. It seemed that the person who sold the amulets had some motive, but it was unclear what it was.
"Fairy, wake up, don't cultivate anymore." Lu Yang entered the grand hall in the Spiritual Space and tried to wake Fairy Eternity, who was practicing the Dream-entering Technique.
"Ah? What's happening? Did Miss Yun call for me?" Fairy Eternity slowly sat up from her lotus pedestal, her eyes half open.
"We've encountered a situation and need to borrow your insights."
"Yawn—What situation?"
"Do you see the amulet in my hand?"
"Amulet?" Fairy Eternity, looking through Lu Yang's perspective, saw the amulet swinging in his hand, "Who crafted this?"
"Is there a problem with the amulet?"
"No problem, it's just that the crafting technique is terrible, nowhere near as good as my Dream Pillow."
Lu Yang: "…"
"And who are the targets, does it work on both ordinary people and cultivators?"
"It's crudely made, it can only enter the dreams of ordinary people. The idea is not bad; if it were crafted more delicately, it could also enter the dreams of cultivators."
"If there's any issue, it's that this amulet can record dreams."
"Record dreams?"
"That means, whatever dream you have using the amulet, any influence it has on the dreamer, it can all be recorded."
For a moment, Lu Yang could not understand what the other party's intentions were.
Forget it, I don't want to think about it anymore, let the government office handle it.
"And who might you be?" Lu Yang turned his gaze toward the pitiful-looking young girl.
"I, I am his junior sister, just passing by to visit him." The girl was frightened by Lu Yang's stare.
"Oh, there's a twenty-year age difference between you, and you're visiting him late at night, a man and a woman alone together in one room?"
"That's right, yes."
Shi Chan stepped forward, reciting a mantra, a huge golden Buddhist character imprinted on the girl's forehead: "Benefactor, please tell the truth."
Under the influence of the mantra, the girl spelled out the purpose of her visit: "I was asked by Hong Senior Brother to kill an opponent named Fu Ling..."
Lu Yang: "..."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Why is it Fu Ling again?
Since everything had become clear, there was no need to stay any longer. Lu Yang left the Hong residence and found patrolling constables on the main street.
"Constable brother, there's another case here!" Lu Yang called out to him, having handed over an attempted murderer, a Tribulation Cultivator, to him just last night.
Who would have thought they would meet again here?
After Lu Yang explained the situation at the Hong residence, the constable looked at him as if he had seen a ghost.
Last night you brought in a failed assassin, and tonight you caught a group in the midst of a murder plot?
The constable almost thought Lu Yang was an out-of-town assassin here to expand his business, using the government office to eliminate local competitors.
Soon, the constable contacted his superiors, summoned a large group of constables, and escorted everyone from the Hong residence to the government office for overnight interrogation.
The Zhong family father and daughter, as witnesses and victims, also came to the government office.
"Master, is it over?" Zhong Ming asked excitedly.
"Indeed, the matter with your daughter was caused by Kang Wei using a magic instrument. Now that everything has been revealed, it's up to the government office to deal with it."
"Thank you so much!" How could Zhong Ming not be excited? The problem that had troubled him for a week was solved by the master in one night, "Then, about this incense money..."
"Five hundred taels of silver."
For Zhong Ming, five hundred taels of silver was just a drop in the bucket, and he immediately took out a silver note for one thousand taels.
"Master, this is a little token of my appreciation."
"It's too much." Shi Chan insisted on only accepting five hundred taels, and as Zhong Ming could not persuade the master otherwise, he could only take out a silver note for five hundred taels and offer it respectfully.
With the matter concluded, Shi Chan returned to the inn without giving Miss Zhong a second glance.
"Are you going to Spring Fragrance House tonight to refine your Mind State?" Lu Yang chuckled, following Shi Chan's religious ceremonies was indeed an eye-opener.
"Not at all, it was just one night ago, and it is not yet the time when my desires are at their peak, so it would not achieve the best refining effect. In my opinion, it is better to wait three more days."
"You're meticulous."
When the three returned to the inn, they coincidentally met the Fu Ling sisters, who had just arrived back as well.
"Oh, Master, you've come back so late."
"The rituals took a bit longer, and I see that the two benefactors didn't return early either."
Fu Ling's smile narrowed her eyes to slits: "Today was lucky, a client that could never be negotiated with finally agreed today, we discussed many details. When we snapped out of it, we realized it had gotten this late."
Shi Chan recited an Amitabha Buddha: "Benefactor Fu Ling is indeed blessed with good fortune."
"Then I'll take the Master's auspicious words to heart, but today's events were indeed strange."
"I don't know what happened, but the client from yesterday, who proposed many outrageous conditions, changed his tune today, saying he wanted to do a good deed and accumulate virtue, wondering if what the Master said would come true or something like that."

chapters.title: Chapter 662 - 661: High Efficiency
chapters.content:
"I was too exhausted last night and didn't have the chance to ask. Miss Peacock, why were you targeted by assassins?" Meng Jingzhou acted with valor and a sense of righteousness.
Peacock pondered for a moment. The three men had saved her life last night; she trusted them and saw no harm in telling them, "This isn't a good place to talk. How about we discuss it back in my room?"
The three men and two women, five in total, went to Peacock's room.
As Peacock poured tea for the four of them and set the teapot down, she began slowly, "This story starts after my master left the Daoist temple."
"My master ran the Daoist temple named Mountain River Temple, and it was only him and me."
"In his youth, my master incurred many romantic debts and was often sought out by lovers. Over time, seeing that my cultivation level was sufficient to protect myself, he decided to travel under the guise of visiting other places and left the temple to avoid his debts."
"Once they learned my master had left, those lovers stopped coming to the temple as often. It was quiet and I was left alone."
"One day, as I was meditating in my room, I heard a loud noise from the courtyard. When I went out to check, I found a bloodied man who had crashed into the yard."
"The man was handsome, but gravely wounded; his clothes were soaked with blood."
"Without a second thought, I brought him into the house, cut open his clothes and treated his wounds."
"The man slept for almost a week. I don't know what cultivation technique he practiced, but his wounds gradually healed."
"After he woke up, he was taciturn and didn't even say 'thank you.' He stayed in the temple without leaving, and I couldn't just throw him out, so I let him stay."
"Another month passed and his injuries had healed. Suddenly, he grabbed my wrist and told me he had fallen for me and wished I would go with him."
"I didn't even know his name or identity, and he was very insistent, gripping my wrist so hard it hurt. After I struggled free, I immediately rejected him."
"The man's lips curled into an indifferent smile, saying he had never been refused in his life, and I was the first. He also said that anyone he took a liking to had only two options: become his or die. If I didn't go with him, he promised to send endless assassins after me. Then he left."
"I wasn't sure if he was bluffing or what, but his words had an evil tone, and I was terrified. So, I packed up that very night, thinking that if I came to a bustling city, the assassins he sent wouldn't dare to find me."
"That's how I ended up in Chunjiang City, where I met the young lady and the three gentlemen."
"So audacious?" Meng Jingzhou raised an eyebrow. Neither he, the Saint Heir of the Heavenly Court Sect, nor the roguish Young Sect Master beside him behaved that way.
"Miss Peacock, rest assured, with us here, no assassin will be able to harm you!"
"Amitabha, so that's what happened."
"It seems last night's assassin was the first. More will likely come to take Miss Peacock's life."
Shi Chan took out a string of sandalwood Buddha Beads from his sleeve and offered it to Peacock, "This string of beads, blessed with the poor monk's prayers, can withstand attacks from those at the Nascent Soul Stage for a quarter of an hour, and the monk will sense it too. Please accept it, Miss Peacock, for your protection."
"Nascent Soul Stage?"
Peacock's eyes widened in disbelief. Such a gift must be worth a fortune in Spirit Stones—she couldn't afford it even if she sold herself.
"I, I can't afford this."
Shi Chan smiled gently and pushed it into Peacock's hands, "Buddha once said, saving a life is more meritorious than building a seven-story pagoda. The poor monk will surely be repaid; you need not give anything, Benefactor. All I hope is that you avoid doing evil and strive to do good deeds in the future—that will be repayment enough."
"Then, thank you so much, Master."
Peacock wrapped the Buddha Beads carefully in a handkerchief and tucked them into her chest, handling them as if they were a treasured possession.
"This is the second time I've received a boon from Buddhism," Peacock said with a contented smile.
"The second time?"
"The first was a story my mother told us. My sister and I weren't born yet, and I was very young, so I don't remember it well."
"Sister, you must remember it better than I do, right?"
Fu Ling hummed softly and began, "At first, our father and mother could not conceive for a long time, until they heard that an abbot at Ancient Forest Temple was skilled in helping people have children. So, mother went to Ancient Forest Temple and found the abbot, Master Yuxin."
"After returning, Mother truly became pregnant."
"Mother often said that the birth of both of us was a blessing from Buddhism, a boon granted by Buddha, and that we should do good deeds and accumulate virtue in the future to repay the grace of Buddha's descent into the world."
"After my sister went missing, Mother also went to the Ancient Forest Temple to seek Master Yuxin, but unfortunately, by that time, Master Yuxin had already passed away."
Lu Yang's expression turned strange. Were the methods of Master Yuxin for seeking a child that effective, or were they really legitimate?
Lu Yang turned his head and asked Shi Chan, "Have you heard of the Ancient Forest Temple and Master Yuxin?"
Shi Chan gently shook his head, "There are so many temples in the world, this monk cannot recognize all of them. As for Master Yuxin, I have never heard of him. Perhaps he's a high monk who hides in plain sight."
Clang, clang, clang.
Peacock's room door was knocked on.
"Is Miss Peacock there?"
Peacock immediately became alert, staring intently at the door, feeling a strong sense of crisis.
"Who is it?"
"From the Government Office."
Peacock didn't understand and became even more vigilant. What did the people from the Government Office want with her? She had explained everything when she reported the case last night.
Lu Yang frowned when he sensed with his Spiritual Sense that indeed constables were outside the door, at the very least dressed as constables.
Moreover, their Cultivation Level wasn't low, with at least the Golden Core Stage, and there was also a faint smell of blood on them, obviously, they had just killed someone.
Lu Yang signaled with his eyes that with them there, everything was fine; all she had to do was open the door.
Peacock bravely opened the door to find three unfamiliar constables.
The constables saw three men and two women in Miss Peacock's room and were also taken aback.
Why are there so many people?
"Which of the two ladies is Miss Peacock?"
The leading constable couldn't tell Fu Ling and Peacock apart; it would be embarrassing to mistake someone else for her.
"I am. May I ask what's the matter?" Miss Peacock said indifferently.
"It involves Miss Peacock's privacy, so could Miss Peacock please step outside for a moment?"
Peacock became even more alert and shook her head firmly, "You can trust everyone here, you can speak in front of them."
The leading constable hesitated a moment, then chose to respect Peacock's wish.
"It's like this. Based on the reason you gave when reporting the case last night for being targeted by assassins, as well as the employer the assassin named, we reported the situation overnight and have now locked on to the man who wants to kill you based on this information."
"The Prefectorial Governor considers this a severe threat and asked us to act immediately."
"Just now, in a joint operation in the city, we took down this man's stronghold and arrested him. A total of three at the Divinity Transformation Stage, fifteen at the Nascent Soul Stage, and several at the Golden Core Stage were involved in the operation."
"We'd like to confirm with Miss Peacock. Is this the man?"
With that, the constable pulled a piece of paper from his bosom. The man in the picture looked handsome and carried a hint of malevolence.
Peacock: "..."
You government officials sure work fast.

chapters.title: Chapter 663 - 662 Ambush
chapters.content:
"It is this person." Peacock nodded with a strange expression.
The efficiency of the government office struck her as unusually high, prompting a slow reaction from her.
"Then there's no mistake," the lead constable sighed with relief.
If they had made a scene all day only to catch the wrong person, it would have been a huge joke.
However, even if they had caught the wrong person, the one they now held was no good individual either.
According to the evidence at hand, the caught individual was a serial offender with a long list of atrocities, and everyone involved in the operation was set to receive considerable credit.
"As per regulations, Miss Peacock, you still need to complete a recognition record. Could you accompany us to the government office?"
Peacock nodded, knowing that it was her legal duty.
"Can they come with me?" Peacock asked, pointing to Lu Yang and his two companions, as well as her younger sister Fu Ling. She felt somewhat nervous about going to the government office alone.
"Of course, that's possible, but they cannot observe during the recording of the statement," the head constable said, understanding Peacock's worries. It was only human to feel that way.
While they were talking, two more constables ascended the stairs.
"Which one of you is Miss Fu Ling? Eh, Brother Li, you are here too? Weren't you out catching someone?" The two constables who arrived later were taken aback upon seeing the head constable.
Brother Li, who was the lead constable, casually responded, "Well, we've just finished catching the person and are now confirming with the victim. What are you guys doing here, Xiao Wu?"
"Oh, we've just finished interrogating a suspect. According to the suspect, she attempted to hire a thug named Hong to assassinate a girl named Fu Ling, so we came here to verify as well."
"Which one is Miss Fu Ling?"
"I, I am Fu Ling." Fu Ling rose from the bed and stood beside her sister Peacock.
But who would want to kill her?
Brother Li: "..."
Xiao Wu: "..."
The assassins seem to have set their sights on you two sisters, constantly revolving around you.
"Would you two ladies please come with us?"
The sisters nodded.
"Miss Peacock, you were lucky that the assassin you encountered last night was only at the Qi Cultivation stage. According to the captured assassin's confession, above him, there were assassins at the Foundation Establishment, Golden Core, and Nascent Soul stages. If he failed his mission, more powerful assassins would come after you."
"Although it was our oversight that allowed the assassin to sneak into the inn last night, rest assured, Miss, now that we have a lead, such an assassination will certainly not happen again."
If it weren't for the assassin spilling everything last night, the government office would not have deployed three cultivators at the Spirit Transformation stage and fifteen at the Nascent Soul stage.
As for whether there were any higher-level cultivators sent in secret, Brother Li was unaware.
Just like last night, the group arrived at the government office once again.
The officer on duty at the door was surprised; they were the night shift, and it was unusual to see this same group of people for two consecutive nights.
"I wish to inquire about the background of the benefactor who threatened Miss Peacock," Shi Chan addressed the officer.
"I apologize, young monk, but we have rules that non-related personnel cannot inquire about the details of a case," the officer explained.
Shi Chan nodded, showing understanding.
The Dynasty was quite professional in this regard.
The Five Great Immortal Sects indeed possessed law enforcement authority but couldn't use it based on personal curiosity, as it would contravene the original purpose of granting such authority.
Last night, the three who recorded their witness statements identified themselves as ordinary cultivators, without revealing their affiliation with an Immortal Sect.
According to Shi Chan's experience, if you mentioned you were from one of the Five Great Immortal Sects, it would certainly alarm the City Lord, who would warmly welcome you, but also find ways to subtly hint when you would leave...
After all, the Immortal Sects held supervisory authority, and involving them could nullify a year's worth of work.
The sisters were taken away by the two groups of constables to record statements, while the three men stayed in the case handling area, waiting for the outcome.
"Fairy, could you help listen in on the interrogation?" Lu Yang asked, unable to resist.
At this moment, Fairy Eternity was painting on the wall of the magnificent hall; with a brush in hand and a pile of buckets filled with paint at her feet, her face smeared with a myriad of colors.
As for what she was painting, it was too abstract, and Lu Yang could not make it out at the moment.
"Sure," Fairy Eternity replied, tossing the brush into a bucket, and using the back of her hand to wipe her face, which only made it messier, before sharing her Spiritual Sense with Lu Yang to explore the interrogation of the captured man.
The interrogation room was shielded with Array Methods specially designed to block Spiritual Sense probes, but obviously, they could not block Fairy Eternity's more powerful senses.
...
Within the interrogation room shrouded with layers of Array Methods, two experienced constables stared solemnly at the man they had just apprehended.
The man was handsome, with a cunning demeanor, and his hands were locked with a Detaining Spirit Lock, rendering his spiritual essence useless.
The two experienced constables were under great stress; they suspected that their captive had a mental illness, with a way of thinking different from ordinary people, and they were not sure whether he was pretending or indeed ill.
"Name?"
The handsome man laughed carelessly, habitually playing with his fingernails, but unfortunately, his hands were locked by the Detaining Spirit Lock, and he could not fidget with them.
"Ha, this is the first time someone dares to so blatantly ask for my name. There's no harm in telling you, my name is Ye Xiao."
"Age?"
"One thousand six hundred years old."
Slap!
The constable slammed the table angrily and pointed at him, exclaiming, "I advise you to confess honestly, do not play dumb with me!"
Ye Xiao had a gloomy look in his eyes, "If I were you, I wouldn't raise my hand. Just two low-rank cultivators, daring to point fingers at me. Call an Integration Period cultivator who is qualified to speak to me here."
The other experienced constable seemed to have thought of something, and pulling his partner aside, he asked warily, "Are you an Ancient Era Integration Stage cultivator who started over after disbanding cultivation?"
"You have some insight."
The two constables suddenly realized, and it all made sense now.
"Specific identity?"
"You dare to capture me without even knowing who I am. You're quite bold!"
"I am the master of Night Pavilion, Ye Xiao. Even the emperor of Great Yu would treat me with respect!"
The two constables recalled their ancient knowledge, it seemed there was such an organization in ancient times, an assassination organization, established during the 60,000 years of Great Yu's history, dating back 140,000 years to today.
"Then why did you continue to establish an assassination organization after you started over after disbanding cultivation?"
Based on the capture, this person called Ye Xiao had founded a new assassination organization and was domineering.
"Just two insects, daring to inquire about my plans. Telling you is of no consequence."
"In the struggle of the Great Era, human effort is limited. Fighting alone for resources will ultimately not match great powers; that's why I reestablished the Night Pavilion."
"Do you know what the strongest type of cultivator is? It's not the Sword Cultivator who can break through everything with one sword, or the Body Cultivator with an unmatched body. Those are just frontal combat. Among cultivators, combat is extreme, and assassination is the best way to fight, which is why assassins are the strongest cultivators."
As he spoke, Ye Xiao slowly stood up, "With the return of the Night Pavilion to the human realm, you all will be sacrifices!"
"As for that woman who caught my interest, called Peacock, is it? She cannot escape the palm of my hand!"
"I have said that she either submits to me or dies."
"No one who has defied me has yet been born!"
The constable slammed the table again in anger, "Sit down and behave yourself!"
As if he hadn't heard at all, Ye Xiao spoke to himself, "Having disbanded my cultivation to start over, there are naturally people protecting my path."
The two constables' faces changed, realizing something.
There was an accomplice they had not caught, and with no low cultivation level!
A terrifying pressure enveloped the City Lord's mansion, clearly that of an Integration Period Cultivator!
In the dark of night, the Integration Period Cultivator reached out his large hand, crushing the layers of Array Methods in the interrogation room, lifting off the roof, and said respectfully, "Master, I am late."
"Vice-master, you've finally come to fetch me!"
The Vice-master had been trained by Ye Xiao from a young age, marked with a master-servant imprint, and even after starting over with his cultivation and despite their vastly different cultivation levels, the Vice-master was bound to obey Ye Xiao's commands.
Suddenly, three more Integration Period presences surged into the sky, targeting the Vice-master, each one stronger than the Vice-master!
"The Prefectorial Governor is truly prescient. There really were people behind the scenes."
"Stop talking nonsense, hurry up and catch him, then we can go back and rest."
"He's a big fish."
The Vice-master glared furiously, "Dynasty's lackeys!"
They were caught in a trap; the Dynasty had laid an ambush!
The Vice-master turned to flee, but the three Integration Period cultivators did not give him that chance. They struck simultaneously, capturing the Vice-master.
The two constables heaved a sigh of relief and pushed Ye Xiao back into the chair, "Sit down and behave yourself!"
"I've confessed."

chapters.title: Chapter 664 - 663 Learning Martial Arts
chapters.content:
Chunjiang City Government Office announces: Recently, the victim, Ms. Kong, was attacked by an assassin. Three righteous cultivators took action bravely and captured the assassin, preventing a malicious attack, and Ms. Kong was unharmed. According to the investigation, this violent case was a crime of passion.
Based on clues provided by the assassin, the Government Office immediately carried out a comprehensive investigation, secured related evidence, and followed the trail to the assassin organization "Night Pavilion," with all relevant personnel now arrested.
It is reported that the organizer of this violent case and the leader of the assassin organization are both Great Yu Cultivators, Ye by name, a reborn cultivator. He relied on Protector Fan, the former Deputy Chief of Night Pavilion, who was arrogantly protective and feigned madness and stupidity.
Currently, the Government Office has arrested Fan, and Ye is confessing to his crimes. According to Ye's statement, Night Pavilion is related to many violent murder cases, and Ye will face severe legal sanctions.
Early in the morning, notices were posted at the entrance of Chunjiang City Government Office and the city gates, explaining the commotion from last night. The citizens gathered around the notices to discuss fervently.
After all, no matter how well-prepared, the noise from three Body Integration Realm cultivators jointly capturing another of the Body Integration Realm cannot be small.
"Good catch! These ancient cultivators are really lawless!"
"Again with the ancient cultivators, it never ends. If you ask me, we should kill them all early, so much trouble!"
"I heard that the incident in Hanshui City last year was done by ancient cultivators."
"The Hanshui City case was a major one, involving three Transcendance Tribulation Stage ancient cultivators. We can't compare to that."
As Lu Yang and his companions were leaving the city, they happened to notice the notice posted at the city gate.
"Senior Brothers, have you heard of Night Pavilion?" Shi Chan had little interaction with ancient cultivators and was not very knowledgeable about ancient organizations.
In contrast, Lu Yang, who was knowledgeable about ancient affairs, said, "Night Pavilion is an assassin organization established in the middle period of Great Yu, named after its founder, Ye Xiao. At the time, the emperor and the Imperial Teacher were competing for power, and to woo the support of high-level cultivators, the emperor was quite courteous to Night Pavilion."
"With the disappearance of Ye Xiao, Night Pavilion went through three generations of leaders and declined significantly, eventually being replaced by a new rising assassin organization."
Lu Yang listened to the entire interrogation record last night.
Ye Xiao indeed had the capital to be arrogant. His activities were confined to the nearby cities where the highest cultivation level was only the Divinity Transformation Stage. With Deputy Chief Fan, a Body Integration Realm Protector, he was extremely secure.
And according to Ye Xiao's investigation, previously, the Dynasty had never caught any ancient cultivators who had to start over after disbanding cultivation. They did capture a few at the Body Integration Realm, but that was because those ancient Body Integration Stage individuals acted too ostentatiously and specifically provoked the Body Integration Realm cultivators of Great Xia.
He, however, targeted low-ranking cultivators.
Based on his experience in Great Yu, Great Xia would think their strength was only at the Nascent Soul Stage and at most would send someone at the Spirit Transformation Stage to capture them, not anyone at the Void Refinement Stage or the Body Integration Realm.
This time was no different. He just fancied a Qi Cultivation Stage female cultivator and sent a Qi Cultivation Stage assassin to kill her.
Who could have expected that the assassin sent out last night would result in Great Xia dispatching three Divinity Transformation Stage cultivators today, as if cultivators cost nothing?
If that were the case, he wouldn't be worried. His attitude since the interrogation started last night showed he was fearless.
He could escape anytime with the Deputy Chief present.
But what was outrageous was that Great Xia didn't play by the rules and secretly sent three at the Body Integration Realm.
Even if one fewer person had been sent, the Deputy Chief could have escaped.
Through the Immortal consciousness of Fairy Eternity, Lu Yang knew even more.
Last night was just about revealing three at the Body Integration Realm...
It was all for the purpose of continuing to fish.
Asking those at the Body Integration Realm to take command, even if they didn't take action, they still had to be paid for their services. The Dynasty allocated plenty of funds to eradicate evil in Youzhou, so why not use them?
Furthermore, it's rare for dark forces to show themselves, hardly coming across one in several years. These are achievements. If not for the time constraint, the Prefectorial Governor even considered asking someone at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage to come over.
It was just too bad they overestimated Night Pavilion. They had just one at the Body Integration Realm.
"I thank you in advance for teaching Shi Chan, Senior Brothers," the monk said.
Last night at the Government Office, Shi Chan proposed learning the Single Curse Fist and Lu-style Arhat Fist from them, and Lu Yang and his companion agreed without reservation.
"Senior Brothers have gifted me with Pure Yang Blood and taught me the boxing techniques; I have no way to repay you."
"It's a pity that all of my learning comes from the Buddhist teaching my master passed on to me, and without the permission of my sect, it must not be shared."
"In terms of creating magic skills, I am far from matching Senior Brothers."
"Should an opportunity arise in the future, I will surely repay this favor."
Lu Yang laughed heartily and patted Shi Chan's shoulder, "We're all Immortal Sect disciples, don't worry about it."
"Speaking of which, aren't you going to continue setting up your stall to make money today?"
Shi Chan shook his head, "Benefactor Zhong Ming has already given this humble monk five hundred taels, enough for a visit to the Spring Fragrance House."
"Another visit and your mind state will be trained?"
"Whether it will succeed or not remains to be seen, but this monk must have this realization."
All three were at the Nascent Soul Stage, throwing a punch could topple houses with the wind from the fist—it was inconvenient to practice this in the city, hence they chose to go out.
"Let's do it here."
The three found an empty area with no one around, preventing accidental injury to passersby.
Lu Yang started first, "Let me say this in advance, I'm not clear why my Arhat Fist leads to hair loss, I haven't understood the principle yet. What I can do is demonstrate it a few times for you to watch."
"That's sufficient."
Shi Chan knew Arhat Fist, for he wanted to understand the differences between the Lu Family's Arhat Fist and the common Arhat Fist.
Lu Yang took a firm stance and began to show his posture, starting the vigorous punches with a heave and a ho.
Every punch was powerful, with the sound of Buddha's chant faintly audible—a sign of reaching a high realm in cultivating the Arhat Fist.
Shi Chan watched Lu Yang's every punch and kick with a serious expression.
Lu Yang finished, "How about that?"
Shi Chan shook his head, "This monk's talents are dull, I couldn't see any difference."
"My turn, let me try," another spoke up.
Meng Jingzhou was eager for someone to learn the Single Curse Fist, or rather, it would be best if everyone mastered it. Sparring with each other using the Single Curse Fist would make everyone single, creating an ideal world.
"This Single Curse Fist originates from the Single Body Spiritual Root lineage, I'm not sure if outsiders can learn it, you should be prepared," he cautioned.
"This monk understands."
As Meng Jingzhou performed the Single Curse Fist, leaving aside the effects of the technique, just the sheer power of the fist alone was terrifying, comparable to the Arhat Fist.
Shi Chan furrowed his brow tightly; he got some clues about the Single Curse Fist. It was a technique that contained causality and greatly tested one's perception.
After completing the form, Meng Jingzhou was not even out of breath, "How about it?"
"Containing causality and demanding a lot from the practitioner's destiny, this monk, not being a genius with excellent conditions like Senior Brother Meng, might find it difficult to learn."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Let's demarcate an area and spar, and you can explain to me what excellent conditions mean.
Shi Chan studied for a whole day, ending in regret.
It was not until three days later, after Shi Chan had amassed energy and strength, that he had still not learned it.
Shi Chan once again consumed twenty drops of Pure Yang Blood, recited the "Heart Sutra," and walked into the brothel with an unaffected and detached demeanor.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou waited at the inn for the results.
From evening till early morning, Shi Chan finally returned.
On the way back, Shi Chan continued to recite the "Heart Sutra," just as he had upon entering.
Both were rather surprised, as this time took much longer than the last—did he endure the whole night?
"Did you succeed?"
Shi Chan stopped chanting and spoke seriously, "This monk chanted the sutra, maintaining an empty and spiritual mind state. Into the second half of the night, the female benefactors exerted all their tricks, breaking this monk's spiritual serenity."
Lu Yang: "..."
"However, this trip has been greatly beneficial," Shi Chan added.
Meng Jingzhou was curious, "What benefit?"
"This monk has become more enduring than before."

chapters.title: Chapter 665 - 664: Great satisfaction
chapters.content:
Tea house.
"There's a genius in the Seek Dao Sect, named Meng Jingzhou."
"This Meng Jingzhou is extraordinary, hailed as the great heir of the world's number one influential family, the Meng Family. He is known in the Jianghu as Young Master Meng!"
"There's no need to say more about Young Master Meng's talent; he is one in a million with a Single Spiritual Root!"
"If it were an ordinary person with such talent and background, they would have settled for the status quo, without striving for further progress. But Young Master Meng was different; he voluntarily gave up the comfortable life of the Meng Family, came to the Seek Dao Sect, and after passing through the numerous trials of the Seek Dao Sect, he eventually became a disciple."
"Young Master Meng relied not on external aids, but pursued immortality with all his heart, his will as firm as iron, truly admiring."
"One day, Young Master Meng went out on a mission, accompanied by a female disciple from the Immortal Sect. Together they pursued an evil Jiao over thousands of miles, engaged in three great battles, and finally managed to slay the beast at the Bi Shui Pond."
"That evil Jiao was no easy foe. In the battle at the Bi Shui Pond, the Jiao fought desperately, releasing poison gas. The two geniuses from the Immortal Sect found it difficult to dodge. Young Master Meng pushed the Immortal Sect female disciple out of the way and was poisoned himself."
"Young Master Meng managed to suppress the poison temporarily with his cultivation level, but as the battle came to an end, the poison could no longer be contained."
"It was then that the two realized that this evil Jiao was a lustful creature, releasing not simply poison, but a gas that induced lust!"
"Whoever was poisoned would lose their reason, seeking out the opposite sex to vent until the poison dispersed; this has been the case since ancient times."
"But who was Young Master Meng, after all? His will was unyielding, and he showed not the slightest sway in the face of feminine allure, preferring to suffer swellings all over his body rather than vent his desires."
"In the end, Young Master Meng managed to overcome the poison of the lustful Jiao through sheer willpower!"
This was a newly emerging storyteller, surnamed Jin. There were Jianghu rumors that his predecessor, the one who used to tell the 'Legend of the Dao Seeking Sect', was approaching his time limit and found a successor.
Of course, that's just a Jianghu rumor; the storyteller named Jin has repeatedly come forward to deny this claim.
However, the storyteller named Jin indeed had the qualifications to inherit the mantle, for his stories were captivating and highly praised, second only to the previous storyteller.
"To find out what happens later, please stay tuned for the next installment!"
The storyteller named Jin clapped a wooden block, signaling the end of today's storytelling session.
Wearing a mandarin jacket and brimming with excitement, Jin ran backstage to look for Daoist Buyu.
"Big Brother, how did I do?"
Daoist Buyu, holding a horsetail whisk and dressed immaculately clean, set down the teacup in his hand and responded indifferently, "Not bad, you have improved."
"It seems you have a talent in this area. Your oratory skills weren't up to par simply because you lacked the right training opportunities."
"Thank you, Big Brother, for cultivating me!" Jin, the Gold Clan Leader, looked at Daoist Buyu gratefully. Without Daoist Buyu, he wouldn't have reached his current position.
He was now focusing on promoting Meng Jingzhou, so that the Meng Family might be more lenient when it was time to repay his debts.
"But you still have areas that need to be honed."
"Please enlighten me, Big Brother!"
"Your adaptability is lacking; to train in this area, you'll have to pay a certain price."
The Gold Clan Leader showed a determined look: "Big Brother, I'm willing to pay any price to grow stronger."
Daoist Buyu was pleased with the Gold Clan Leader's attitude. He who aspires to great deeds must have the resolve to sink his boats: "Then follow me in deceiving the masses!"
"Back when we, the Nine Disciples of the Dao Seeking Sect, successfully deceived the Jiuyou Sect, it was the outcome of years of accumulated skills in deceiving others!"
The Gold Clan Leader took this to heart; after all, he was the first to be deceived.
"You must always remember the legal stipulation for 'especially huge amounts in fraud'; that is the bottom line."
Seeing Daoist Buyu speak so solemnly, the Gold Clan Leader grew nervous and swallowed hard: "What if we cross the bottom line?"
"You will be sentenced to life imprisonment!"
The Gold Clan Leader nodded vigorously as if he had been enlightened, "I remember."
"Different regions have various regulations concerning 'particularly significant amount of fraud'. I will tell you each one of them."
"Thank you for the pointer, elder brother!"
As the two prepared to discuss further, they suddenly felt as if disaster loomed large, like a sharp knife was poised at their neck, ready to sever their heads from their bodies at any moment.
Danger was imminent!
The bustling streets, the moving crowds, the cries of vendors, the sugared paintings dropped by children... everything seemed to slow down, as if time around the world had decelerated.
Only a graceful figure seemed out of place in this world, approaching them with leisurely steps.
This elegant figure stuffed a sugared painting into the child's hands and stood still in front of the two men.
"I was passing by this city and felt the imprint I had left, so I came over to check it out. I didn't expect such an unexpected windfall."
"Phoenix... Phoenix Ancestor?!"
The Gold Clan Leader was the first to recognize Jiang Lianyi, followed by the nefarious Daoist Buyu.
Cold sweat broke out from both men; they shouldn't have provoked the Phoenix Ancestor, but judging by her demeanor, it didn't seem like she was untroubled!
Jiang Lianyi happened upon this place and sensed the imprint she had left on the Gold Clan Leader's body. She was curious as to why the Qiongqi Clan Leader was in Great Xia.
She followed the location of the imprint and unexpectedly found Daoist Buyu.
"Found you."
Daoist Buyu's scalp tingled under Jiang Lianyi's gaze.
He had always been careful in his actions; when had he provoked such a mighty figure?
Moreover, he had never even met her!
As if aware of Daoist Buyu's confusion, Jiang Lianyi took out a book from her storage ring that Daoist Buyu found incredibly familiar.
"Dragon and Phoenix Transformation"
"I hear you're the author of this book?"
Damn it, I forgot about this book!
The Gold Clan Leader watched in shock. Even he had heard of "Dragon and Phoenix Transformation", a forbidden book that infuriated both the Dragon and the Phoenix tribes. The book's authorship was a mystery, and it was you who wrote it?!
"No need to answer; your expression says it all." Jiang Lianyi turned "Dragon and Phoenix Transformation" into ashes.
Lu Yang had kindly reminded her that his master was a liar through and through, not to be trusted.
Jiang Lianyi rolled up her sleeves deliberately.
"To insult my Phoenix Tribe is a sin that must be punished."
"Considering Lu Yang is my Senior Brother, and you are Lu Yang's master, it seems that we should each be accountable for our own actions, so I don't go too easy on you."
"I also currently serve as a guest elder of the Seek Dao Sect, and a guest elder assaulting the Sect Leader is an act of insubordination, which breaks the social etiquette."
"Fortunately, my sister told me that those with great aspirations should not be bound by trivial rules, and that I should temporarily cast aside rigid formalities."
Daoist Buyu was utterly baffled by her words. Lu Yang became your Senior Brother? Wasn't that just an act? And what's this about being a guest elder of the Seek Dao Sect? When did our sect start having guest elders?
A series of question marks flashed through Daoist Buyu's mind.
More bewildered than Daoist Buyu was the Gold Clan Leader, who seemed to have pieced together the true identity of the Seek Dao Sect, based on the Phoenix Ancestor's few words.
"Wait, wait a moment, don't hit me yet, I have questions... Ah!"

chapters.title: Chapter 666 - 665: Moving Clouds and Bringing Rain
chapters.content:
Daoist Buyu, the Sect Master of the Seek Dao Sect, was a writer, educator, and author of works such as "Dragon and Phoenix Transformation," "Two Thousand Years of Prison Environmental Change in the Great Xia Dynasty," "Wish Granting Technique: Local Edition," and "Legend of the Dao Seeking Sect." He took on four disciples, namely the strongest contemporary figure Yun Zhi, the foe of the Buddha Country Ye Zijin, the enchantress of demonic sounds Gan Tian, and the Young Sect Master of the Heavenly Court Sect Lu Yang.
His educational contributions are eternally immortal and will be remembered by history.
In an unrefined moment, a quarrel broke out between him and the Ancient Ancestor of the Phoenix Clan. The confrontation escalated into a physical fight. Daoist Buyu was overpowered by the Phoenix Clan's Ancient Ancestor and passed away at over two thousand years of age, much to everyone's satisfaction, with universal celebration ensuing.
…
Time flow resumed.
Daoist Buyu and Gold Clan Leader were beaten to within an inch of their lives, thrown onto the rooftop by Jiang Lianyi to prevent them from tripping passersby.
Daoist Buyu was mostly perplexed, wondering who could have leaked the information about the "Dragon and Phoenix Transformation"?
Big Brother, Old Two, Old Three, Xiao Zhi...
The scope was too broad, and they all had motives. It was difficult to guess.
The Gold Clan Leader felt wronged. Why should she be beaten up for being the other woman? Just because she looked easy to bully?
From the few words uttered by the Phoenix Ancestor, could it be that the Seek Dao Sect was established by the Ancient Heavenly Court?
This would also explain why the Phoenix Ancestor was a guest elder of the Seek Dao Sect.
However, judging by Daoist Buyu's expression, he was unaware of this fact. Could it be that this was a secret even the Sect Leader didn't know of?
This was a secret indeed, a fearfully secretive Seek Dao Sect that seemed like one of the Five Great Immortal Sects to the public but was all an act.
What a terrifying thought to maintain such an act for a hundred thousand years.
Maybe he should persuade the Ancient Ancestor not to go it alone. She could either join the Qilin Immortal or ally with the Heavenly Court Sect.
Jiang Lianyi glanced at the Gold Clan Leader who was lost in his wild thoughts but didn't pay much attention to it.
With the imprint of the Dao Fruit Outline, no matter what he knew, he wouldn't be able to divulge it. There would be no leakage of secrets.
...
Chunjiang City.
Lu Yang sat beside Shi Chan, waiting for business to come their way.
Today his luck was good; it wasn't long before someone approached them.
A handsome young man sought out Shi Chan with a request, "Master, do you know how to make it rain?"
"Amitabha, naturally, I possess the skill to call forth rain," Shi Chan replied.
"Then can you make it rain heavily tomorrow evening for me? The price is negotiable," the handsome young man pleaded eagerly, having finally found a master who could make it rain.
"Before I agree, what is the reason you seek such a rain, Benefactor?" Shi Chan asked.
Not daring to lie to the Master, the handsome youth explained, "Tomorrow, a dear female friend and I have a date. I thought if a heavy rain were to suddenly fall in the evening and neither of us had brought an umbrella, we would surely get soaked."
"This would give me an excuse to take her to a nearby inn under the pretense of changing clothes, which would facilitate ensuing developments," he added.
Shi Chan joined his hands together and advised, "Please go back, Benefactor. This act is unvirtuous. I implore you to desist."
Still hopeful, the handsome young man implored, "Master, you name your price, I can give you any amount of Spirit Stones."
"This is not a matter of Spirit Stones, Benefactor. Please go back," Shi Chan insisted.
Seeing Shi Chan's resolute stance, the young man had no choice but to leave disappointedly, seeking other experts capable of cloud manipulation.
"Fairy, can you make rain?"
"Who can't? Although raining is a method of the Dragon Clan, the principle is quite simple. Even you could learn it," the Fairy replied.
"What's your suggestion?"
"The simplest method is for you to fill a storage ring with water, then fly up into the sky and toss the ring into a watering can. If you activate the storage ring through the watering can, it'll be just like making it rain."
"If you think one watering can isn't enough, you can use several more."
Lu Yang nodded, "That does sound pretty simple."
It didn't even require a magic skill, so there'd be no risk of learning it incorrectly. The only downside was the extravagant use of storage rings and watering cans.
"All rainmaking methods evolved from this principle. Take for instance the time when Immortal Jiuchong became immortal—the heavens rained sweet dew, golden lotuses sprouted from the earth, sounds of the great Dao resonated, accompanied by all sorts of chaotic celestial phenomena, making a humongous racket as if he were afraid others wouldn't know he was the first to become immortal."
"Later, he told us the truth. The so-called heavenly sweet dew was actually just him storing sweet dew in a watering can, which he then doused over himself after he became immortal."
"As for the golden lotuses springing from the earth, he planted lotus seeds in the ground and used the 'Tree Planting Spell' to expedite their growth. Cultivating these golden lotuses took many precious spiritual materials to successfully induce the mutation of the green lotuses."
"About the sounds of the great Dao, that was a bit more complicated. He secretly collected the calls from various clans and mixed them together. That way, no one could distinguish what the sounds of the great Dao really were; they would only feel that the sounds were formidable."
"In order to conjure so many extraordinary phenomena, he almost drained all his resources. It was purely for saving his face, but he suffered for it. You see, when I became immortal, there were no special phenomena at all, just plain and clear."
Lu Yang: "..."
Immortal Jiuchong, if you heard that, it was Fairy Eternity who spilled the secrets, and debts have their creditors. Please don't come after me; I'm just an onlooker.
Soon, a young man dressed as a scholar approached, though he appeared somewhat haggard.
"Master, can you expel ghosts?"
Shi Chan nodded; this was Buddhism's forte: "Of course, has your home been troubled by a ghost, Benefactor?"
"It might be, but I've never actually seen it."
"What happened?"
The scholar explained with a worried frown, "Every night while I'm deep in sleep, I always feel like there is someone near me, yet when I open my eyes, there is nothing to be seen. This has been happening for a long time."
"I've also sought help from several masters. Either they leave empty-handed or they leave a protecting talisman behind when they go, but none of it has had any effect."
"I've even reported it to the authorities, and indeed calling the officers worked. The ghost wouldn't appear when an officer came by, but as soon as the officer left, I would feel someone's presence next to me again at night. An officer can't stay by my side every night."
"Last night I was tormented by a ghost and felt drained of energy. I bought a 300-year-old glossy ganoderma from a friend to replenish my vitality. The friend who sold the ganoderma recommended you, Master."
"May I ask who your friend selling the ganoderma is...?"
"It's Brother Zhong Ming. He said he just sought your help a few days ago for exorcism."
"I see, that did happen."
Shi Chan stood up, gathering his belongings: "If that's the case, then this humble monk and two Senior Brothers will go and take a look."
"That would be wonderful," the scholar beamed with joy.
"May I have the honor of knowing your name, Benefactor?"
"My name is Xu An."
"So you are Benefactor Xu."
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, finding that there was finally some serious business to attend to, also packed up their things and followed Shi Chan, curious about the situation.
On the way, Xu An gave a brief introduction to his circumstances. He was a scholar with a wife. Xu An's parents had passed away early, leaving him a substantial inheritance that allowed him to live without financial worries. His greatest aspiration was to study the classics diligently, top the imperial examinations, and honor his ancestors.
Xu An led the three through several alleyways: "We're here."
Xu An's residence was no smaller than that of Zhong Ming, which made sense considering anyone who could afford a 300-year-old glossy ganoderma that had survived Thunder Tribulation must indeed be quite wealthy.

chapters.title: Chapter 667 - 666 Too Many Suspects
chapters.content:
"Benefactor Xu's residence is quite large,"
Xu An smiled apologetically, "Both of my parents were cultivators and left behind a considerable fortune. Unfortunately, I have limited talent and have never been able to embark on the path of cultivation, which I'm afraid has become a jest among you three."
Since he couldn't cultivate, he devoted himself to studying the scriptures and sought to earn a name and fortune to not disgrace his parents.
Regrettably, he had no achievements in the imperial examinations either.
Xu An rarely spoke of these things to others, but Lu Yang and the other two were an exception.
He had heard from his elder brother Zhong Ming that Shi Chan and the two Protectors were very likely cultivators at the Foundation Establishment Stage or even the Golden Core Stage. Such individuals of high cultivation level wouldn't covet his paltry possessions.
On the inside of the Xu family's gate was a yellow talisman, posted there previously by an exorcist. Although it was said to be of little use, it provided some peace of mind.
As the four entered the Xu residence, they happened to see a girl sweeping the courtyard. Judging from her plain clothes, she was a servant girl.
Upon seeing her master bring three guests inside, she quickly stepped aside to avoid disturbing the visitors.
The maid was quite attractive, and Meng Jingzhou took a second look at her.
"This is Xiao Cui," Xu An said with a smile.
"Last year, when I went to participate in the examination, I rested overnight at a mountain temple and happened to meet Xiao Cui there. She said someone malicious was chasing her and asked for my help in covering for her. Soon after, several fierce and evil men burst into the temple, and I covered for her as she had instructed, saving her.
She insisted that she could not repay my great kindness with anything else, so she became my maid."
"Greetings to the masters," Xiao Cui said timidly, her voice soft and gentle.
Meng Jingzhou nodded, recognizing her as a ghost.
The four walked through the flower-hanging gate into the second courtyard, where a richly dressed woman came out of a room, "Husband, you're back just in time, the three-hundred-year-old glossy ganoderma soup that you bought has been prepared... and who might these three be?"
Upon seeing Lu Yang and the others, the opulent woman paused, a monk accompanied by two secular disciples?
"Xiangyu, hurry and greet these three great masters."
"I've been telling you that my sleep has been terrible of late, as if a malevolent ghost were haunting me, leaving me feeling dazed all day. Several cultivators have been invited but to no avail."
"Just now, elder brother Zhong Ming, who often deals with cultivators, recommended these three great masters to us. They are truly skilled and capable individuals."
"Allow me to introduce my wife, Liu Xiangyu."
"So, you are Madam Liu."
"Greetings to the three great masters," Liu Xiangyu performed a respectful curtsy.
"As merely a woman of the household, it pains me to see my husband suffer daily, but I am powerless to help. Thank you, three great masters, for your efforts."
"Amitabha, this poor monk will do his best," Shi Chan replied cautiously, not wanting to be overly confident. She was a Snake Demon.
"Please, this way, great masters," Xu An warmly invited the three into the hall to be properly entertained.
"There's no need, we must take a good look around your residence to prepare accordingly," the visitors responded.
"Very well, very well," Xu An was overjoyed. True experts indeed acted decisively.
"Xiao Zhu, come here," Xu An called out. Before long, another maid, who had been busy with her chores, hurried over.
"Xiao Zhu, please show the three great masters around the courtyard."
"Yes, of course," Xiao Zhu complied.
Xiao Zhu was pretty, with a lively sparkle in her eyes.
Lu Yang saw through Xiao Zhu's true form; she was a Snake Demon.
Right before the three were led away by Xiao Zhu, Liu Xiangyu brought out a bowl of black soup, which was the medicinal broth made from the three-hundred-year-old glossy ganoderma.
Given Xu An's constitution, he couldn't possibly consume an entire glossy ganoderma at once. The soup was made only with a small portion of it.
Meng Jingzhou sniffed, furrowing his brows slightly. He wasn't sure, but he thought he smelled a hint of blood in the black broth.
After a careful inspection around the Xu residence, the three had a good understanding of the situation.
The residence with three entries and exits housed five people, including Xu An and his wife, along with three maids.
Simply put, only Xu An was human.
The third maid was named Xiao Qiu, and she was a Spirit Device.
When it was time for the vegetarian dinner in the evening, Xu An looked forward to the trio, "Great masters, have you discovered anything?"
Shi Chan recited an Amitabha, "We have made some discoveries, but the specific situation will depend on tonight."
There were too many suspects, and they weren't sure who was responsible.
"Tonight, the three monks will stay by Benefactor Xu's side to protect him."
"Then Xu would like to thank the three masters in advance!"
The candles were blown out, and the three masters sat in meditation by Xu An's bedside, while Xu An, his mind at ease, had already fallen sound asleep.
Suddenly, a fragrant breeze blew through, and the consciousness of Lu Yang's trio lightened, and they fell into a deep sleep.
A beautiful figure pushed open the door, smiling and looking at the three of them.
"I thought the benefactor had invited some remarkable experts, but it turns out they are just three little Golden Core Stage youngsters."
Under the investigation of the figure's Spiritual Sense, she determined that all three had Cultivation Levels at the Golden Core Stage.
"I wonder when I can reveal my true identity to the benefactor."
The figure, seeing Xu An's sleeping face, licked her lips, took off her clothes, and gently kissed him.
The two did not touch, but a wisp of Yang Qi floated out from Xu An's lips and was absorbed by the figure.
Afterward, the figure ran her hands over him.
Lu Yang's trio pretended to be sound asleep, but in fact, they were all secretly observing the scene and communicating with each other through Spiritual Sense.
"Xu An really has enviable fortune, this female ghost's Cultivation Level is not low."
"No wonder he feels a lack of Yang Qi, it would be strange if it wasn't deficient."
"So it turns out that the one absorbing Xu An's Yang Qi is the maid Xiao Cui."
"She's pretending quite earnestly."
Ghosts can't touch physical objects, so when they cleaned the courtyard during the day, they were just posing and controlling with their intent, which the three of them noticed when they saw Xiao Cui.
It was the same at this moment, Xiao Cui was just absorbing Xu An's Yang Qi and was entwined with him in a dream, a common method used by lustful ghosts.
Meng Jingzhou was particularly sensitive to ghosts, which is why he took an extra look at Xiao Cui.
After a while of intimate contact, Xiao Cui left Xu's residence contentedly, and the three of them immediately followed to investigate.
It was late at night, and many shops had already closed.
Xiao Cui arrived at the door of a closed shop, looked around to ensure no one was there, and lightly knocked on the wooden door.
The person inside seemed to expect someone and opened the door immediately upon the knock.
Xiao Cui walked into the shop confidently.
Lu Yang looked up and saw: Here we go again, Chunjiang City Barbecue Restaurant branch.
"Welcome, Rudder Master, to inspect our store!" said the restaurant's waiter respectfully.
"How many times have I said it, we in the Jiuyou Sect run a legitimate business, call me store owner."
"Yes, yes."
The waiter took out an account book, "This is today's revenue report."
Xiao Cui opened the account book and checked each entry one by one. The barbecue restaurant was the main project of the Jiuyou Sect, and no mistakes could be afforded.
Seeing the Rudder Master in a good mood, the waiter suddenly said, "Store manager, do you really want to continue being that Xu An's maid?"
"With your status, why bother? If you ask me, just reveal your identity and capture him, bring him here, and he will comply with everything."
The waiter was anxious, as their Rudder Master, who was at the Nascent Soul Stage, condescended to be a maid in a mortal's house.
Xiao Cui flatly rejected the idea, "Impossible, the young master saved my life, how could I treat him in such a manner?"
"As for revealing my identity, that's even more impossible. If he knew who I am, he would be accused of harboring a member of the demonic sect, how would he proceed with his imperial examinations then?"

chapters.title: Chapter 668 - 667: Not a Shallow Blessing
chapters.content:
(I made a mistake in the last chapter, Xiao Zhu is a Fox Demon)
"This barbecue restaurant is actually run by the Jiuyou Sect. I shall subdue this demon right away. I ask for the assistance of the two Elder Brothers!"
Shi Chan was about to reveal himself when he was stopped by Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
"No, no, no, we're all on the same side. There's no need for violence."
"Same side?"
Shi Chan's eyes were filled with confusion. Who was he on the same side with?
Lu Yang and the other trusted Shi Chan's character and decided to reveal some of the inner workings of the Seek Dao Sect to him.
"Actually, the fact is the Heavenly Court Sect was established by us..."
The two patiently explained how they had come up with the Heavenly Court Sect and how they had deceived the Jiuyou Sect.
After listening, Shi Chan fell silent for a long time, not saying a word.
No wonder his master had always warned that the disciples of the Seek Dao Sect were full of tricks and to be careful in dealing with them.
He hadn't taken it seriously before, but now he knew his master was right.
The buzz about the Ancient Heavenly Court was all a fabrication by Elder Brother Lu Yang.
If this were to spread, it would cause a huge uproar indeed.
"Thank you to the two Elder Brothers for your trust."
Since Xiao Cui was the Rudder Master of the Jiuyou Sect in Chunjiang City and is considered half one of their own, it was inconvenient to take action. The three had no choice but to return to Xu An's room, resuming their feigned slumber to avoid any mishaps.
Not long after the three had begun their act, another figure barged into the room. Seeing the three of them in a stupor, she breathed a sigh of relief.
It was the maid, Xiao Zhu.
"As expected of Sister Xiao Cui, the effect of the mesmerizing scent is excellent."
"It's a pity, though my cultivation level is comparable to Sister Xiao Cui's, I can't beat her since she is the Rudder Master of the Jiuyou Sect and we're in human territory."
"But it's not a big problem. She can only consume Yang Qi and can't really do anything with our patron in bed. She can only enjoy it in dreams, which is not as satisfying as the real thing."
"I had originally planned for tomorrow night, but since our patron has taken glossy ganoderma and his Yang Qi is abundant, there's no harm in having my share."
While speaking, Xiao Zhu began to undress, revealing her fluffy white fox tail and ears, cuddling up to Xu An.
Lu Yang and the others: "..."
"What should we do, should we go stop it?"
"It looks like Xu An's glossy ganoderma he ate during the day is doing its job; his Yang Qi is still strong."
"It seems she doesn't have any ill intent."
After the event, Xiao Cui left contentedly.
Just as the three were about to get up, they heard the door being pushed open again and a third figure entered, shy and timid.
It was the maid, Xiao Qiu.
Like Xiao Cui, Xiao Qiu checked the effectiveness of the mesmerizing scent, saw that Lu Yang and his companions were still deep in slumber, and exhaled in relief.
She lay on top of Xu An, awkwardly absorbing Yang Qi, whispering in Xu An's ear,
"Master, Xiao Qiu likes you."
The three secretly communicated through Spiritual Sense.
"I can tell she's a Spirit Device. Can either of you see her true form?"
"This monk's vision is limited. I cannot perceive it."
"It's a jade pendant, refined by a Nascent Soul Stage refining master, and moreover, it's a magic artifact capable of advancement." Although Lu Yang's vision was on par with Meng Jingzhou's, he had the assistance of an Immortal.
"I recall Xu An said his parents were just ordinary Qi Cultivation Stage cultivators. A magic artifact with a Spirit Device doesn't seem like something Qi Cultivation Stage cultivators could get."
Magic artifacts with Spirit Devices are rare to come across. Lu Yang had seen the most top-tier Spirit Devices, which had the souls of Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivators refined into them.
Xiao Qiu's origin was not that extravagant, but it certainly was not something a Qi Cultivation Stage could obtain.
"It might be something his parents stumbled upon, like something we might find in a black market. They bought it without knowing what treasure it was, and left it to Xu An as an inheritance. Xu An wearing it all the time caused the jade pendant to absorb Yang Qi or Vital Essence from him, hence awakening it."
This also explained why Xiao Qiu was so affectionate towards Xu An.
Just as Xiao Qiu was blissfully absorbing Xu An's Yang Qi, the two figures returned once more.
It was Xiao Cui and Xiao Zhu, who thought that today's opportunity was rare and decided to indulge once more; by a twist of fate, they encountered each other at the door.
"Xiao Qiu, why are you here? Are you a cultivator?"
Xiao Qiu panicked at once.
Xiao Cui and Xiao Zhu were quite astonished; both knew each other's circumstances, but they had no idea that Xiao Qiu was also not human.
"No, you are a Spirit Device; could it be that you are the jade pendant our benefactor lost?"
They recalled their benefactor mentioning a jade pendant left by his parents, a token of remembrance infused with emotions, worn night and day.
But one day, for some unknown reason, the jade pendant mysteriously vanished, eluding all search efforts, causing him great regret.
So, the jade pendant was here all this time.
Before they were unaware, but now Xiao Qiu, having absorbed Yang Qi, was revealed in her true form.
Xiao Qiu nodded awkwardly, admitting the two elder sisters' guess, and left Xu An's side.
Xiao Cui clenched her teeth in frustration: "I was careful with the amount of Yang Qi I took from our benefactor, how could he still be weakened? It was all because of you!"
Worried that the benefactor wouldn't recover, she only sneaked in every four days.
The three maidens refused to give way to each other, all wanting to continue with Xu An. Their auras clashed, and Xu An unconsciously grunted, which frightened them into halting.
The three maids had no choice but to leave sullenly, abandoning any further bedroom activities.
No sooner had they stepped out than they saw Liu Xiangyu in the courtyard, her beautiful face twisted in anger.
"You... all of you are not human!"
Liu Xiangyu hissed with gritted teeth.
These past days, seeing her husband grow haggard, she thought it was her own fault for exerting too much, leading to an imbalance of Yin and Yang and draining her husband's energy.
That's why she reduced their intimate encounters.
As for the ghosts her husband mentioned, she pretended to be scared on the outside, but inside she was indifferent, knowing it was impossible.
How could there be ghosts under her watch, a mighty Nascent Soul Stage Snake Demon?
Little did she expect, there actually were!
Xiao Cui turned out to be a Nascent Soul Stage ghost!
Xiao Zhu was a Nascent Soul Stage Fox Demon!
Xiao Qiu was a Spirit Device of a magic artifact!
If not for their recent clashing auras, she wouldn't have discovered them at all.
All this time, she thought her husband's weakness was her own doing. Just a few days ago, she happened to encounter a mysterious seller of Yang Invigorating Blood in the black market, so she bought a drop, diluted it in some glossy ganoderma soup, ready to enjoy herself tonight.
As for Lu Yang and the other two, it didn't matter; they could just be knocked out.
Who would have thought she hadn't even entered the room when she sensed the three maids competing inside her husband's room?
So the Pure Yang Blood I spent a fortune on was for you three to use!
The three maids had long known of Liu Xiangyu's true form since she had been preoccupied with hiding her identity in front of Xu An, not expecting the maids to be secretly watching and inadequately alert.
"Mistress, please let me explain," said Xiao Qiu, the most timid, trying to defend herself.
Liu Xiangyu threw a soundproof Array Method into Xu An's room, then set up an Array Method around the Xu residence to isolate it from the outside world, her tone chilling.
"Talking is useless. By the rules of the Cultivation World, might makes right. Today, I will show you the consequences of being maids who steal from their masters!"
Xiao Cui was fearlessly defiant; she, the mighty Rudder Master of the Jiuyou Sect, the largest underground force in Chunjiang City, had no reason to fear Liu Xiangyu, the foreign Snake Demon.
"Xu An has shown me kindness, I will not leave him!"
Xiao Zhu was equally resolute: "Xu An's ancestor saved my life. To repay such an immense debt, I can only repay his descendant after taking human form!"
Though Xiao Qiu was timid, she was determined when it came to matters involving Xu An: "The master has awakened me; I will belong to the master for life!"
In the courtyard, the four Nascent Soul Stage beings stood unyielding; a Nascent Soul-level battle was about to erupt.
The three feigning sleep were caught by surprise by such an occurrence, at a loss for what to do.
"What should we do?" Lu Yang asked for the other two's opinions.
Meng Jingzhou gritted his teeth so hard that sparks seemed to fly:
"Let's kill Xu An first!"

chapters.title: Chapter 669 - 668: Pagoda Suppressing the Snake Demon
chapters.content:
Meng Jingzhou felt that ever since he had started selling his blood, he had not encountered any good fortune.
First, there was Shi Chan testing one's Zen heart in the brothel, followed by the great chaos in Xu An's harem.
The key was that both of these people used his own blood!
He said he felt that the glossy ganoderma soup Liu Xiangyu brought over smelled bloody, and lo and behold, it was his own!
What to do when the harem catches fire? Just eliminate the chief culprits, and all troubles will be no more.
Alternatively, he could spare Xu An's life and just throw a Single Curse Fist.
In the courtyard, the Snake Demon, Ghost Cultivator, Fox Demon, and Spirit Device were in a fierce battle; thankfully, the Array Method temporarily shielded the situation here, or the patrolling constables would have come to investigate long ago.
Liu Xiangyu, with a shake of her body, transformed into a white serpent tens of zhang long, thicker than a water barrel, hissing as it flicked its forked tongue, cold eyes fixated on the three maids.
"I hit it off with master right from our first meeting, sealing a lifelong promise amidst the Qingming spring rains. Where does it leave room for you monsters and demons to interfere!"
The serpent's body rolled and thrashed, shaking the earth and creating cracks in the ground, opening its gaping maw to swallow the three maids whole.
Xiao Qiu stretched out her arms, and countless vague black specters fused with the night, concealing her figure, and even her Nascent Soul emerged to block the white serpent's gaping maw.
"What counts as love at first sight? Love that hasn't been tested by life and death is but empty talk!"
"That day, my identity was exposed, and I was pursued by the government office. Fortunately, I encountered the benefactor who let me use the Haoran righteousness he generated to conceal my form. Only then did I survive!"
"If not for my unusual identity, which after explaining to the benefactor could have affected his imperial examinations, I would have married him long ago, leaving no chance for you to become the main wife!"
Xiao Zhu revealed her true form of the Demon Race, a snow-white fox spirit looking like a sprite in the snow, graceful and agile.
"Let it snow!"
Suddenly, heavy snow began to fall in the courtyard, the temperature plummeted, breath turned to frost, and water froze upon contact.
"I'm the spirit of a snow fox. Over a hundred years ago, the benefactor's ancestor rescued me from a hunter's trap. I wandered into a forbidden land, swallowed an unknown fruit, awakened the ancient bloodline in me, and used the power inherited in the bloodline to cultivate a human form."
"I had wanted to repay the benefactor's ancestor in my human form, but by the time I could, he had already turned to dust. Since that's the case, I will repay the benefactor!"
"Had I not worried about the benefactor accepting my true identity, I would have confessed my feelings to him long ago!"
Liu Xiangyu let out a cold laugh, "Every one of you sneaks a bite at night, rendering the master drained of energy, yet you all have your justifications. I was the one who found out about the glossy ganoderma affair; the Pure Yang Blood was purchased by me. What have the three of you done!"
"Had it not been for your simultaneous appearance tonight, I would still be unaware that all three of you are non-human, to the extent that the master had to invite three at the Golden Core Stage from outside!"
The white serpent stirred a violent wind, icy and bone-chilling, howling as it approached, causing an involuntary shudder.
Xiangyu opened a barrier, temporarily blocking Liu Xiangyu's attack.
Her true form was a jade pendant, a defensive magic artifact.
"My lady, please calm your anger. The master awakened me, but not knowing how to face him, I delayed revealing my identity and did not intend any deception."
Just as the second round of battle was about to erupt, a sound of Buddha's chant alarmed all four of them into ceasing their actions.
"Amitabha, could the four lady benefactors please stop fighting temporarily for this poor monk's sake?"
Shi Chan voluntarily stepped into the courtyard, accompanied by two Protectors, one wielding a sword and the other ready with a clenched fist.
"You three woke up, no, you've never fallen into unconsciousness?!"
The faces of Liu Xiangyu and the rest shifted slightly, revealing a hint of panic; none of them had noticed that the three individuals the benefactor had invited were indeed conscious.
"This shouldn't be happening; the mesmerizing fragrance I released should cause anyone at the Nascent Soul Early Stage without guard to faint for three hours!" Xiao Cui was the most shocked, aware of how potent her mesmerizing fragrance was.
Definitely not something those at the Golden Core Stage could resist.
The more important issue was that these three people knew their true identities!
What were they to do if their husband found out?
"You've been pretending to sleep all this time!"
The four women's cheeks flushed with shame. Could it be that everything that happened in bed with Xu An tonight was seen clearly by these three?
In their anger, all four women attacked at once.
The white snake coiled, a multitude of ghosts roamed the night, the snow fox brought down snowfall, and the jade pendant revealed its spirit.
"The monk harbors no intention of instigating conflict."
Facing the joint attack of the four women, Shi Chan remained calm and composed as he took out a Jiuchong magic artifact and tossed it into the air. The artifact emitted a pale golden glow that enveloped the four women, rendering them immobile.
"What, what kind of magic artifact is this?"
The four women were astonished, having never seen such a wondrous magic artifact before.
Jade pendant Xiao Qiu felt even greater pressure from a superior magic artifact.
"Ladies, you cannot overcome the three of us," said Shi Chan with a sigh, releasing the four women from the suppression. A golden figure appeared behind him, with a Vajra in his left hand and a Dharma wheel in his right, the epitome of the orthodox Sixteen-foot Golden Body.
In Lu Yang's hand, the Green Peak Sword gleamed with a cold light, its piercing Sword Qi like countless needles to the eye, so daunting that one dared not look directly at it.
