Meng Jingzhou executed the Three heads and six arms technique; each of his powerful arms was ready to explode with force, one punch could reach the sky, another could split the earth, and his expression was fierce with rage in his eyes.
"Nascent Soul... no, is it the Divinity Transformation Stage?!"
Liu Xiangyu and her three maids turned pale in an instant. Although these three men appeared to have similar cultivation levels, the aura they displayed was unmistakably that of the Divinity Transformation Stage!
Even without the Jiuchong magic artifact, any one of them could subdue her!
Were there not only two Divinity Transformation Stages in Chunjiang City, both affiliated with the government office? Where had her husband found these three Divinity Transformation Stages from?
Seeing that the four women had calmed down, Shi Chan retracted his Golden Body, and Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou followed suit.
"Beneath Xu An's trust, I have come to address his lack of Yang Qi. I implore you four ladies not to make things difficult for this monk," he said.
The four women naturally agreed, acting very docile.
Liu Xiangyu transformed into her human form and invited the three masters to the hall to talk.
"Before we discuss the matter, let me introduce myself," said the monk. "My Dharma name is Shi Chan, a disciple of the Suspension Temple."
The women's expressions changed again, anxiety setting in—they were in the presence of a high monk from the Suspension Temple.
Very little was heard about the disciples of the Suspension Temple, which was shrouded in mystery to the outside world, so the four women couldn't gauge Shi Chan's intentions.
Xiao Cui was the most nervous; as the Rudder Master of the Jiuyou Sect, if her identity was exposed, she feared there would be no escape.
"Ms. Liu, if this monk isn't mistaken, are you from the white snake clan of the Demon Territory?" questioned Shi Chan.
"The master sees clearly," she admitted.
"Ms. Liu, heed this monk's advice—your relationship with Mr. Xu An is truly improper," he said.
Liu Xiangyu's face turned deathly pale, a bad premonition washing over her: "Is the master suggesting that my husband and I, being human and demon, have distinct paths, and ultimately cannot remain together?"
Shi Chan shook his head. "Not at all. What I mean is that, when registering a marriage, one must verify their race. Mr. Xu An is unaware of your identity, meaning the two of you merely have the reality of husband and wife, without the title."
"I suggest the two of you go to the government office to register."

chapters.title: Chapter 670 - 669 Elder Brother Lu Yang Speaks the Truth
chapters.content:
Liu Xiangyu did not dare to tell Xu An about her true identity, so the two had never registered their marriage.
Xu An was not particular about these things. If his wife was unwilling, then let it be, no big deal.
Upon hearing this, the eyes of the three maids lit up.
Although Xu An and Liu Xiangyu had always referred to each other as husband and wife, it turned out they had never actually registered their marriage.
Indeed, to register a marriage at the government office, at the very least, both parties' identities must be verified.
Since Benefactor did not know Liu Xiangyu was a Snake Demon, it meant they had not registered their marriage yet.
Then what kind of official wife are you?
Since you, Liu Xiangyu, did not register, does that not mean we are all on the same starting line?
The master is truly worthy of the title, seeing issues they could not see.
"As for the four of you taking turns to be intimate with Benefactor Xu, resulting in his insufficiency of Yang Qi, it's beyond the scope of this poor monk's abilities,"
"However, my senior brother here can solve your problems,"
Shi Chanzhen introduced Meng Jingzhou earnestly.
"My senior brother possesses Yang Invigorating Blood, which I am sure Liu Benefactor is not unfamiliar with."
"Benefactor Xu is a mortal, a single drop of Yang Invigorating Blood must be diluted by hundreds, if not thousands of times before consumption. In the long run, this poor monk recommends you ladies purchase several drops of Yang Invigorating Blood,"
Meng Jingzhou put on a serious face and took out several small bottles containing Yang Invigorating Blood.
"One hundred thousand Spirit Stones per drop."
He demanded a sky-high price.
After a hot sale on the black market, Meng Jingzhou realized he had sold them too cheaply.
This blood, from the strongest Single Body Spiritual Root of ancient times, with effects like invigorating Yang and strengthening kidneys, prolonging life, immunity to all poisons, enhancing memory, and improving physical constitution, was a marvellous item that you couldn't buy even if you had Spirit Stones. One hundred thousand Spirit Stones per drop expensive? Not at all.
"I'll buy five drops!"
Liu Xiangyu went all in, understanding that the three maids saw an opportunity and wanted to contend with her for the position of official wife.
If she lost her status as the official wife, how often she would have to compete with the three maids for her husband's affection in the future would be determined by who bought more blood today.
"I'll buy six drops!"
Xiao Cui shouted. The barbecue shop was doing well, and as the store manager, she had a substantial percentage cut, making her the wealthiest among the four women.
"I, I'll buy three drops."
Xiao Zhu didn't have much confidence, as she came from an unorthodox background and did not have many Spirit Stones.
As for Xiao Qiu, her situation was even sadder; she was a Spirit Device and didn't have a single Spirit Stone.
Meng Jingzhou left behind fourteen small bottles and took back the rest, casually accepting one million four hundred thousand Spirit Stones.
Tsk, earning these Spirit Stones didn't bring any sense of achievement at all.
"Then this poor monk will return to Benefactor Xu's room with the three senior brothers, and wait until dawn,"
"Please clean up the traces of the fight in the courtyard, ladies."
Snow had fallen earlier thanks to Xiao Zhu, and the courtyard was still chilling everyone to the bone.
A few hours later, Xu An woke up feeling quite good.
"Did the three masters have any gains last night? I feel much more refreshed upon waking up today."
Meng Jingzhou thought to himself, of course, if it hadn't been for the invigorating Yang Invigorating Blood you had last night, after being intimate with a ghost, a demon, and a spirit device, you wouldn't even be able to get out of bed today.
"Amitabha, there were some gains last night, and the problem has been resolved. Benefactor will no longer suffer from insufficient Yang Qi."
Xu An's eyes lit up with joy. The expert recommended by Elder Brother Zhong Ming was indeed formidable, "Thank you for your hard work, Master. Then, about the fee…"
"Five hundred taels of silver will suffice."
Xu An was surprised, not because it was expensive, but because the price was too cheap.
He had sought many experts, but none could solve his problem, yet the master fixed it in one night, and it only cost five hundred taels of silver?
For someone with an inheritance from his parents, five hundred taels of silver was nothing.
"Then why have I always been lacking energy?"
"When the time comes, Benefactor will know himself."
"Ah, oh."
Xu An thought to himself that the master was still playing word games, all mysterious and secretive.
After tidying up his clothes, Xu An prepared to have breakfast and continue reading the sages' books.
As soon as he stepped out the door, he saw his wife and three maids standing neatly at the entrance.
The four women said in unison:
"Husband\\ benefactor\\ master, I have actually been hiding something from you."
"In fact, I am a Snake Demon\\ a Ghost Cultivator\\ a Fox Demon\\ a Spirit Device."
The four women each showed their divine abilities and revealed their true forms: a several dozen feet long white snake, a ghost cultivator with a sinister wind swirling about, a fluffy fox, and a spirit device whose figure faded into a jade pendant.
Xu An's eyes rolled back, and he fainted on the spot.
Lu Yang sighed, this courage just wasn't enough.
But the following matters had nothing to do with them anymore.
The three of them took advantage of the sparsely populated streets in the early morning to return to the inn.
A pair of hidden eyes watched quietly as the trio's figures disappeared into the inn, then turned to instruct their subordinates.
"Tell the boss, they've returned to the inn; it's time to make a move."
After being tossed about all night, even the energy of the three of them felt exhausted and needed a good rest.
About an hour later, a knock came at Lu Yang's door.
"Is anyone there?"
Lu Yang, sitting cross-legged, opened his eyes but still felt a bit sluggish; he hadn't fully rested.
Who was looking for him?
Under the probe of his Spiritual Sense, he saw many people standing in the corridor, dressed in the style of government office personnel.
Lu Yang stood up and opened the door, facing a somewhat portly middle-aged man.
Upon seeing Lu Yang, the middle-aged man's face broke into an enthusiastic smile.
"Assuming this must be Seek Dao Sect's Lu Yang, allow me to introduce myself. My surname is Liu, and I am the City Lord of Chunjiang City."
Lu Yang was startled, how would the City Lord know about his existence?
Lu Yang suddenly realized—in front of Boss Hong, he had boasted, calling out his own title; it must have been disclosed during the interrogation of Boss Hong!
That was careless, as he was too focused on showing off at the time and didn't consider the aftermath.
City Lord Liu also called Meng Jingzhou and Shi Chan from the neighboring rooms, inviting them all into Lu Yang's room.
City Lord Liu said amiably, "For the three noble nephews to visit Chunjiang City without saying hello, we're truly being treated as strangers."
"May I know if the three of you are here with a mission from the Immortal Sect?"
"Amitabha, we monks have come to Chunjiang City for some private matters."
Hearing it was a private matter, City Lord Liu's smile grew even broader: "If the three noble nephews don't mind, why not come to my residence for a simple meal tonight?"
If it's a private matter, that's great; I'll quickly help you resolve your private matter so you can leave soon.
Suddenly, Lu Yang said, "Originally, we came for private affairs, but in Chunjiang City, we happened upon clues regarding the demonic sect."
Upon the mention of the demonic sect, City Lord Liu visibly tensed up: "Do you need me to dispatch men to assist?"
Lu Yang shook his head, declining City Lord Liu's offer and seriously said, "We are investigating covertly. If the government office's people also start to act, the situation would become complicated, with the risk of alerting the enemy."
"Based on the current clues, we've discovered traces of the Jiuyou Sect's activities in Chunjiang City, and they've been active for some time. Our preliminary judgment is that the person leading the activities is a Ghost Cultivator who likes to consume the Yang Qi of men. There has already been one male victim, who was fortunate that we arrived in time.
He was spared from disaster and retained his life."
"We also discovered that this Ghost Cultivator was involved in a brawl between four Nascent Soul Stage beings, with various factions competing and refusing to yield, making the situation extremely complex."
"Senior Brother Shi Chan, isn't that so?"
"Amitabha, monks do not tell lies; Elder Brother Lu Yang is correct."

chapters.title: Chapter 671 - 670: An Unexpected Event
chapters.content:
Before arriving, City Lord Liu had already inquired about the identity of each Immortal Sect disciple who had come to Chunjiang City.
Among them, the most notable was Lu Yang.
As a disciple of Daoist Buyu, the most popular character in storytelling, he was very likely the future Master of the Dao Seeking Sect.
Being the fourth disciple of Daoist Buyu, the likelihood of him telling the truth was questionable.
Therefore, when Lu Yang said they had found clues of the demonic sect in Chunjiang City, City Lord Liu was in a state of skepticism mixed with belief.
But after Shi Chan affirmed it, he believed what Lu Yang said.
Shi Chan, a dignified disciple of Suspension Temple and a bona fide monk, would not lie.
"If that's the case, then I'll have to trouble Young Hero Lu to continue searching for clues of the demonic sect in our city," City Lord Liu said, "after all, this concerns the safety of millions of city residents."
"Should you three heroes have any needs, just ask, and I will do my best to fulfill them."
Confirming that Lu Yang and the other two had truly found demonic sect clues in Chunjiang City, and considering that it involved four Nascent Soul Stage cultivators, City Lord Liu knew he must take it seriously.
If he wasn't careful and a major casualty occurred, it was questionable whether he could remain as the city lord.
"City Lord Liu is being too courteous," Lu Yang said solemnly, serious as a general heading into battle, "eliminating demons and protecting the Dao is our duty, there is no need for thanks."
Meng Jingzhou also chimed in from beside him, clenching his fist and with the light of justice shimmering in his eyes, "Rest assured, City Lord Liu, with the three of us brothers here, the demonic sect will not cause any turmoil!"
Seeing this, City Lord Liu silently marveled, "Truly young talents!"
Shi Chan kept recalling the words Lu Yang had previously said.
Every word that Elder Brother Lu Yang said was true, not belonging to "deception," but why did it feel inconsistent with objective facts?
"Well, since you three heroes still need to investigate the demonic sect clues, I won't bother you any further, as I must prepare to welcome a VIP."
"A VIP?"
"The One Qi Venerable from the Control Qi Sect. Today at noon, he will escort members of the Night Pavilion to the Imperial City. The Prefectorial Governor is concerned about further incidents and has specially requested the One Qi Venerable for the escort."
Lu Yang understood.
He had seen this One Qi Venerable during the 120,000th anniversary celebration of the Dao Seeking Sect, one of the invited Transcendance Tribulation Stage ancestors, truly an old brand of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. Lu Baqian, a dabbler in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, was incomparable to him.
Lu Yang and the others bid farewell to City Lord Liu.
Returning to the second floor of the inn, they saw the Fu Ling sisters cautiously peeking out.
"Have they all left?"
The sisters had never seen such a high-ranking official as the city lord, and were almost scared to death upon hearing that the city lord was coming.
"They have left," Shi Chan replied.
"You three heroes, are you really..."
Even Nascent Soul Stage cultivators would not warrant the city lord personally visiting, right?
"Immortal Sect disciples."
"Immortal Sect disciples?!" the Fu Ling sisters exclaimed, their beautiful eyes widening in shock.
Only then did they remember, Lu Yang and the others had helped them many times, yet they still didn't know their names.
"I am Shi Chan, a humble monk, and these two are my senior brothers, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou," Shi Chan introduced.
"The Lu Yang from 'The Legend of Lu Yang of the Dao Seeking Sect' who at the Foundation Establishment Stage could challenge those at the Divinity Transformation Stage?"
"The Meng Jingzhou from 'The Legend of Meng Jingzhou of the Dao Seeking Sect' with a will as firm as iron, unperturbed even in the company of a sacred maiden?"
Lu Yang: "..."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
While what was said was the truth, why did it seem so strange to hear?
And why were the sisters having such a strong reaction?
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had seldom listened to storytelling and were unaware that they were currently the most beloved figures among the common folk.
The Gold Clan Leader, in order to promote Meng Jingzhou, had even concocted many tales about him, such as "When the holy maiden threw herself into his arms, Young Master Meng sat unperturbed."
"Young Master Meng was poisoned by the seductive jiao's toxin and managed to endure its debilitating effect with sheer willpower, something unprecedented."
"When Meng Jingzhou travels, all evil spirits give way."
"Some people, troubled by ghosts in their dreams, received guidance from a master to hang a picture of Meng Jingzhou catching ghosts on the wall, and thereafter, they were no longer plagued by spirits in their dreams."
"Every day, Meng Jingzhou consumes three little ghosts," and so on.
After hearing his own legends, Meng Jingzhou's face darkened - what kind of nonsense was all this?
In the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity let out a light exclamation and poked Lu Yang's back.
"Ask these two girls if they have seen anyone," she said.
"Why?" he asked.
"Someone has left dream imprints on them, and that person's cultivation level is not low; it feels malicious."
Lu Yang was alarmed, sensing that this did not bode well, and quickly asked.
"Have the two of you encountered any strange people or events today?"
The sisters Fu Ling looked puzzled, wondering why Young Hero Lu would suddenly ask such a question.
"Now that you mention it, on our way back from a business deal, indeed, a mysterious person walked towards us and said that we should have a beautiful dream."
"What did that person look like?"
"He was skinny and tall, just like a bamboo pole."
...
"Venerable, all the people are here."
City Lord Liu brought out all the members of Night Pavilion from the dungeon, shacked with magical artifacts that blocked spiritual essence, guarded day and night by several cultivators of the Body Integration Realm to ensure no accidents occurred.
One Qi Venerable nodded solemnly, his gaze sweeping over Ye Xiao and others, causing tingles on Ye Xiao's scalp.
Being escorted by a cultivator who has passed the Transcendance Tribulation was apparently giving them too much credit.
City Lord Liu commanded his subordinates to escort them into the cages and affix seals.
One Qi Venerable nodded again, "Let's go."
Suddenly, an ethereal voice echoed from thin air, sounding sinister, "Hehe, it won't be so easy to take away someone I have set my eyes on."
"Who's there!"
One Qi Venerable expanded his Spiritual Sense, scanning every inch of the surrounding space.
A tall, slender shadow cloaked in darkness stepped out from the void, smiling enigmatically at One Qi Venerable.
"The Transcendance Tribulation cultivator of Great Xia, you shall stay here," it said.
One Qi Venerable waved his hand fiercely, blasting City Lord Liu and the others away, "Quickly, leave this place!"
The opponent knew who he was yet dared to strike, clearly they came prepared!
"Leave?" The slender dark figure sneered coldly, as an unseen power enveloped the entire city.
"I would like to see who among you can leave this place."
One Qi Venerable became instantly alert, but before he could react, his vision blurred, and the scene before him shifted.
It was still Chunjiang City, but all the colors had faded.
...
Outside the city, travelers about to enter Chunjiang were dumbstruck as they watched the city vanish into thin air, leaving behind a massive pit.
...
"What is this place!" One Qi Venerable was like a soldier facing battle, not even understanding what had happened.
Both City Lord Liu and the members of Night Pavilion were all here; they hadn't moved an inch, yet in this place, every person and thing appeared faded as if washed out.
The tall dark figure spread its arms wide: "Transcendance Tribulation cultivator of Great Xia, welcome to my world. I call it the Void Realm."
Upon hearing the words "Void Realm," One Qi Venerable recalled a piece of history and reacted swiftly, drawing out his Life-bound Magical Treasure, "The power of the Dao Fruit Outline - you are a Semi-Immortal!"

chapters.title: Chapter 672 - 671 Void Venerate
chapters.content:
"So, what has happened here?"
In the inn, Lu Yang and his two companions looked at each other in confusion. In the blink of an eye, the colors around them instantly darkened; when they pushed open the window, the street outside was the same.
Lu Yang extended his Spiritual Sense to observe the objects around him. The material and density had not changed at all.
The purpose of the color change seemed to be to inform them that some unknown change had occurred here.
"Fairy, do you know what's going on?"
Fairy Eternity carefully sensed for a moment, "Hmm, it seems you have been pulled into another space. This is a space completely controlled by an individual. The entire town has been brought into this space, severing contact with the outside world."
"Those who were left outside the city would probably see Chunjiang City disappear, leaving only a large pit on the ground."
"It's like the power of a Dao Fruit Outline, but it's not one that's appeared in ancient times. I have never seen it before."
Lu Yang: "…"
How did a Semi-Immortal pop up again?
"Old Lu, what's the situation, what did the Immortal say?" Meng Jingzhou stealthily asked Lu Yang.
"We've got big trouble on our hands."
Suddenly, power fluctuations came from the distance.
"It's in the direction of the dungeon!" Lu Yang had the sharpest senses.
"Let's go have a look."
"The two Benefactresses, please stay here, we will return shortly."
...
"Void Realm?"
One Qi Venerable, holding a treasure gourd, stared intently at the Illusory Shadow.
According to historical records, at the end of the Great Yu, the world was in chaos, heroes vied for power, and before the Jiang and Meng influential families had fully risen, there was one force that was very likely to win the world.
That was the Great Yu's largest Sect at the end of its period, the Void Sect. The founder of the Sect was a Semi-Immortal known as Void Venerate.
Unfortunately, the Void Sect could not withstand the rise of the Jiang and Meng influential families and was jointly destroyed by them. The whereabouts of Void Venerate became unknown.
Void Venerate's Dao Fruit Outline was known as the Void Realm Dao Fruit Outline, which is a type of Dao Fruit Outline that creates entirely new spaces. The ability is to forcibly pull people into a completely new space. As for what happens upon entering the new space, ancient texts made no record of it.
This new space came to be called "Void Realm".
"Are you Void Venerate?"
The tall, dark figure expressed slight surprise, "Oh, I did not expect someone still remembers me."
"The books on the market do not contain records about me. It seems you, Great Xia's upper echelons, have internal information."
Now that his identity had been recognized, the tall figure no longer hid his true face. Layers of dark matter peeled off from his body, revealing a handsome face.
"Jiang Pingan established Great Xia with State Destiny as the foundation, and State Destiny thrives on stability and prosperity. To destabilize it, nothing is more effective than establishing an assassination organization."
Jiang Pingan was the first Emperor Xia.
Void Venerate sighed with a touch of regret, "It's a pity that Great Xia's supervision is too strict; I could not find the right assassination organization. Thus, I had to search among ancient cultivators, and fortunately, I found this Night Pavilion."
"Just taking the chance to eliminate Night Pavilion and kill you, a Transcendance Tribulation Stage of Great Xia!"
"Big words for someone of your standing!" One Qi Venerable opened the treasure gourd, and an endless stream of purple Qi, like a flowing ribbon, burst out, sweeping toward Void Venerate.
This was the innate One Qi he had cultivated since his youth, soft enough to form chains to trap people, firm enough to break mountains and seas, shattering space.
Void Venerate lightly hopped backward, dodging the attack.
The One Qi Venerable felt some regret, for that strike was but a feint aimed at the Void Venerate, its real purpose was to shatter the space and break out of the Void Realm.
Unfortunately, the Void Realm, being a product of the Dao Fruit Outline, could not be broken by the innate purple energy.
The Void Venerate sensed the slight tremor of the Void Realm and sneered coldly, "I did not expect the innate purple energy to possess such might. Condensing innate true qi and returning to simplicity, the method of Qi Refinement is indeed extraordinary. What a pity that its lineage will be severed here."
If he wasn't careful, he could indeed have been harmed by the innate purple energy.
After some thought, the Void Venerate flicked his finger, breaking the shackles and cages holding the people of Night Pavilion, "You've been freely killing people in the city, disperse their attention."
Like receiving amnesty, those of Night Pavilion complied with the commanding order of a Semi-Immortal-level Great Power, who would dare not to?
Besides, who wouldn't enjoy killing when they had joined an assassin organization?
The One Qi Venerable grew furiously angry, "How dare you! Here I establish the rule [All members of Night Pavilion must not move!]"
The anticipated constraint did not materialize, and the assassins of Night Pavilion moved freely.
"Annihilate them!"
City Lord Liu bellowed as the officers sprang into action; the common people were like lambs to the slaughter in front of these assassins, with no power to fight back.
"Did I allow you to move?"
The Void Venerate said languidly, with a mere thought, a massive black cage sealed off Liu and the others.
The One Qi Venerable's expression darkened as though water could drip from it; he had not at all seen how the black cage had been formed by the Void Venerate.
Fairy Eternity, who was observing the battle, suddenly realized, "So that's how it is, this place is that Semi-Immortal's home ground. Rules don't work here, but he can rely on his mind to activate Void creations, a power he holds in the Void Realm."
"The Void Realm is his turf, he can morph anything here, it feels almost identical to a dream realm."
Lu Yang hurriedly sent a message to the One Qi Venerable, "Venerable, rules are useless here. The opponent's powers might be activated by their thoughts to create Void objects. We will handle the people from Night Pavilion!"
The One Qi Venerable didn't expect to find Lu Yang here.
Lu Yang and the two others intervened bravely, intercepting the assassins from Night Pavilion.
"Mere three at Nascent Soul Stage, daring to block our path?" the deputy head of Night Pavilion, protector to Ye Xiao, sneered as his hand reached out.
Slap.
Another large hand appeared across the sky, blocking the deputy head of Night Pavilion.
"Leave this person to me!"
A figure soared out from the city; he was one of the three who had initially ambushed the deputy head of Night Pavilion. After the ambush succeeded, he wasn't involved in the aftermath, enjoying his vacation in Chunjiang City, never expecting to encounter such an event.
Although he was stronger than the deputy head of Night Pavilion, he was not yet strong enough to decide the victor immediately.
"They're just three at the Nascent Soul Stage, let's go together!" the Nascent Soul Stage assassins from Night Pavilion did not take Lu Yang and the others seriously.
The Golden Body rose from the ground, one palm striking dead a Nascent Soul Stage assassin, leaving only debris behind.
Meng Jingzhou displayed the Divine Ability of three heads and six arms, charging into the group of assassins, sweeping through them like a whirlwind. When an assassin attempted a sneak attack from behind, he discovered that his dagger couldn't even pierce Meng Jingzhou's skin.
"Call the Sword Washing Pool!"
Lu Yang called out lightly, and the Sword Washing Pool flew out from his Storage Ring, crushing a Nascent Soul Stage assassin on impact.
Two long swords shook off the water from the Sword Washing Pool and flew to stand by Lu Yang's side, like Protectors.
"Clone!"
Lu Yang split into a Wooden Avatar; one hand wielding the Green Peak Sword, the other the Dark Moon Sword, the two swords combined their might, plowing the ground with sword qi, their radiance outshining all, chopping the assassins to pieces.
The remaining assassins who were temporarily spared shuddered in fear; these three were certainly not at the Nascent Soul Stage!

chapters.title: Chapter 673 - 672: Chunjiang City Full of Hidden Dragons and Crouching Tigers
chapters.content:
The residents living near the dungeon, upon seeing the assassins mobilize en masse, were frightened to the point of losing their souls.
All these assassins had cultivation levels, and to kill them was as easy as flipping their hand!
But, what they didn't know was that, as afraid as they were, the assassins were even more terrified.
Although there were many assassins from the Night Pavilion, none were a match for Lu Yang and his two companions. Even the assassins at the Nascent Soul Stage couldn't withstand a single move, not to mention those at the Golden Core Stage, Foundation Establishment Stage, and Qi Cultivation Stage—who died in droves with each attack.
"Split up and run!"
The assassins were scared stiff; they enjoyed killing, but not suicide. These three were simply not opponents they could handle.
Any astute observer could see that, after this battle, as long as one survived, they could cling to the coattails of a Semi-Immortal, ascend to the skies in a single bound, and have boundless prospects ahead.
They mustn't fall at the hands of these three, no matter what!
"Thinking of running?" Lu Yang exchanged a look with Meng Jingzhou, and they acted simultaneously, circling around the assassins.
"Draw the prison!"
"Draw the Ground into a Prison!"
Most assassins hadn't even reacted before they were trapped in the cages—either stuck on the ground or underground!
"What kind of move is this!"
The assassins panicked. The underground prisons were indestructible. Daggers broke upon contact, and the cages above ground were actually rings of light, from within which not a single person could leave!
Some of the more clever assassins, seeing that they couldn't beat Lu Yang and the others, had already fled in panic.
"Split up and pursue!"
Shi Chan retracted his eighteen-foot Golden Body and, with wind beneath his feet as if he had sprouted wings, he walked on air, covering a hundred yards in one step, almost as if he were teleporting through space.
One of Buddhism's six Divine Abilities, the Divine Foot.
Meng Jingzhou, being a Body Cultivator, wasn't suited for fast flying speeds and relied on the explosive force of his legs to be even faster than flying.
It was just that he couldn't quite reach the speed of Shi Chan.
"This is still too slow."
Meng Jingzhou hesitated for a moment. Originally, he hadn't wanted to use this technique, but lives were at stake, and it wasn't a time for saving face.
"So be it, let the world witness the power of the Nascent Soul Stage!"
He retracted his three heads and six arms and merged his two Nascent Souls again, sprouting six legs from his lower half!
He didn't have the Divine Abilities, but he could grow six legs!
"Stop, don't run!"
Meng Jingzhou targeted an assassin. All six legs pushed off simultaneously, charging toward the target.
The assassin glanced back and was almost scared out of his wits.
The six-legged monster was rapidly closing in, and then a fist as large as a sandbag smashed over, killing with a single blow.
Meng Jingzhou's aura was ferocious. Today, any assassin who laid eyes on him in this form could consider themselves dead!
Lu Yang commanded his Clone to intercept the assassins while he flew using the pool, with Qingfeng and Mingyue, his two swords, flanking him like Protectors, following closely by his side.
The moment he spotted an assassin, the two swords flew out instantly, taking their heads, or he would crash into them with the Sword Washing Pool, mashing them into a pulp.
Some assassins realized that they wouldn't be able to escape this way and had to take hostages as a threat.
He burst into a wealthy family's home, where those living in such places were either rich or noble—perfect for taking hostages.
"Don't move, if any of you do, I'll kill them!"
He charged into the house, glaring fiercely at the male master of the house, and threatened with a harsh voice.
Four sets of eyes, filled with killing intent, gazed steadily at him.
"Dare to threaten my husband?"
Four figures surrounded the assassin, causing him to break out in a cold sweat from fear.
He could sense that each of them was stronger than him in cultivation.
Before he could react, a huge snake tail swept across, hitting him so hard that not a single bone remained unbroken, and he was instantly bereft of life.
"What exactly happened?" Liu Xiangyu furrowed her brow tightly, the incident had occurred so abruptly that they had no idea what the specific changes were in Chunjiang City. They only knew there were massive energy fluctuations overhead, far beyond their cultivation levels, completely out of their league to intervene. Just one wave of such energy could crush them to pieces countless times over.
"Xiao Qiu, you have protective abilities, stay here to guard the husband well, we three will go out to check on the situation and see if there's any way we can lend a hand."
"Yes, mistress."
One assassin chose the shop, proving to be quite clever.
"Nobody move!"
The assassin released the pressure of the Golden Core Early Stage, which for ordinary people was a catastrophic disaster. Based on experience, as soon as he released the pressure, the commoners would tremble and couldn't even stand up.
But reality was entirely the opposite.
The shop attendants, as if they hadn't felt the pressure at all, simultaneously looked up and regarded the assassin with curious eyes.
"Well, well, someone's quite daring, even daring to threaten us!"
"Close the door, don't let him escape!"
"Damn it, honest businesses get targeted by assassins, it's tough being an honest person."
The assassin staggered backwards two steps, suddenly stricken with a sense of impending doom.
He turned to run, but the shop door closed with a bang on its own, seamless without even a crack, preventing anyone from peering through to see what was happening inside.
"Help me..."
"Gag him!"
Bang!
The shop door was knocked open by the assassin, who lay sprawled on the ground, struggling to crawl away.
The inside of the shop was pitch black, from the darkness countless hands reached out, grabbing the assassin's ankles, pulling him back in.
The assassin's nails desperately scratched the ground, leaving behind only white marks.
The door closed once more, and after that, there was no more sound.
Perhaps the door had been closed too forcefully, the signboard reading "Come Again Barbecue Shop Chunjiang City Branch" slightly wobbled twice.
Then there were the beggars who suddenly rose up to injure people, fighting with the assassins.
When Lu Yang saw this scene, he remembered what Eldest Senior Sister had once said, that true beggars are seldom seen nowadays, and the beggars one sees are cultivators cultivating amidst the mortal world.
These cultivators might not be as powerful as Lu Yang and his peers, but they were more than enough to handle the assassins.
The One Qi Venerable saw Lu Yang and his two companions sending the assassins running in utter defeat and laughed boisterously.
"Is this the assassin organization you wanted to save?"
The Void Venerate, having lived through the power struggles of the Great Yu's final period, wasn't perturbed by such matters, not allowing them to disrupt his mind state.
Without uttering a word, he conjured countless magic artifacts out of thin air—swords, spears, axes, halberds, precious cauldrons, divine towers, jade bottles, and feather fans—all tribulation-level magic artifacts.
The Void Realm was his home ground, and anything below the level of immortals he could create.
If he were to achieve the Dao Fruit of an Immortal, he would be able to turn the insubstantial into reality, transforming the Void Realm into a completely new world. This would not be a small world like a Cave Heaven, but a universe of the Great Era.
By then, he would be the true master of this world.
Tribulation-level magic artifacts fell like rain, all blocked by a thirty thousand li stretch of purple qi. The innate purple qi was left riddled with holes after this volley of attacks.
"I want to see just how many times this stretch of purple qi can block the attacks."
The Void Venerate once again produced countless tribulation-level magic artifacts, dazzlingly suspended in the air, smashing towards City Lord Liu and the others, forcing the One Qi Venerable to take the brunt of the attack.
He had trapped City Lord Liu and the others, instead of killing them, precisely to tie down the One Qi Venerable!
"Void Venerate!" the One Qi Venerable roared angrily.
"What, want to beg for mercy..."
The Void Venerate smiled coldly, but before he could finish speaking, an immense force sucked him into a gourd.
The One Qi Venerable quickly covered the mouth of the treasured gourd.
The treasured gourd was purple at its base with decorative golden patterns. If one responded to its name, they would be sucked inside.
The Purple Gold Gourd.

chapters.title: Chapter 674 - 673 Buddha Beads
chapters.content:
"So the Purple Gold Gourd is a magic artifact of a senior One Qi Venerate." Everyone in Chunjiang City looked up to watch the battle, waiting for the outcome, and Lu Yang was no exception.
He had only heard the Eldest Senior Sister mention the name of the Purple Gold Gourd, that it contained the Yin and Yang energies, and that anyone sucked into the gourd would be torn apart by these two energies in an instant.
However, he had no idea who actually possessed this magic artifact.
He had previously seen something on a black market stall claiming to be the Purple Gold Gourd, and he knew at a glance that it was a fake.
Selling the entire black market wouldn't even be enough to match the value of the real Purple Gold Gourd's spout.
"Is it over just like that?" Lu Yang felt that the battle ended too quickly.
"Do you think it's that easy to defeat a Semi-Immortal? This guy's nascent Dao Fruit can create things out of thin air. Even if he's trapped in the gourd, he can still use this ability."
"Never underestimate any Semi-Immortal. His abilities may not amount to much in the outside world, but once in the Void Realm, there are few Semi-Immortals who can defeat him."
"That strong?"
Lu Yang was surprised, which meant that Void Venerate hadn't yet played his trump cards.
Indeed, as Fairy Eternity had predicted, the Purple Gold Gourd shook violently, and no matter how the One Qi Venerable tried to suppress it with his magic, he couldn't stop the gourd from shaking.
Bang!
The spout of the gourd was forced open by the endless magic artifacts, and Void Venerate successfully escaped.
"It seems you're not completely useless for someone at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage."
Void Venerate was shrouded in darkness, protected by numerous layers of armor that were riddled with scars, clearly damaged by the Yin and Yang energies.
As the armor fell off layer by layer, the person of Void Venerate himself appeared unharmed.
...
"Senior Brothers, I sense that the protective Buddha Beads I left with Benefactor Peacock were activated. There may be danger on her side, I'll go take a look," Lu Yang heard Shi Chan's transmission and was suddenly alarmed.
"Be careful, Ye Xiao has never shown up, and he's likely gone to kill Miss Peacock. Old Meng and I will also head over there!"
...
Lu Yang guessed right; having broken free from his restraints, Ye Xiao headed straight for the inn to kill Miss Peacock.
He had said the person he set his sights on would either submit to him or die!
And he always kept his word.
"Huff huff, who gave you this magic artifact!" Ye Xiao was gasping for breath, with Peacock right in front of him, but no matter what he did, he was blocked by the Buddha Beads in Peacock's arms.
The creator of the magic artifact must be an extremely powerful being, at least as strong as himself!
"You don't need to know!"
Seeing Ye Xiao was unable to harm her, Peacock breathed a sigh of relief, thankful for the magic artifact given to her by Master Shi Chan.
She herself couldn't afford a magic artifact that could block an attack from someone at the Nascent Soul Stage for fifteen minutes.
"If I can't deal with you for now, then your twin sister, I'm not sure if she's older or younger, is in danger!"
Ye Xiao revealed a cruel smile; he was already envisioning the twisted and sorrowful expression that would appear on Peacock's face after he killed Fu Ling.
"Run, sister!" Peacock quickly said, placing herself in front of Fu Ling to block Ye Xiao's strike.
But her reaction speed was no match for Ye Xiao; he only needed to circle around her, and she wouldn't be able to protect Fu Ling.
Ye Xiao turned into a black shadow and appeared behind Fu Ling. Her defenses were down, her neck's tendons visibly bulging.
He was about to succeed!
A gigantic gold hand appeared, abruptly, between Ye Xiao and Fu Ling, stopping the deadly blow.
"Benefactor, you have too much of a murderous intent."
The attack thwarted, Ye Xiao quickly retreated, knowing the other's cultivation was not low and he might suffer if he fought face-to-face.
He was an assassin, skilled in ambush, not in frontal combat.
"Master Shi Chan!"
The sisters saw Shi Chan arrive, as if they were seeing hope for life, and were thrilled beyond words.
"Little monk, the Buddha Beads from the Peacock are from you!"
Ye Xiao looked at Shi Chan as if seeing an enemy he had sworn to kill.
Without the Buddha Beads, he would have succeeded long ago!
"Amitabha, Benefactor has good eyesight. The rosewood Buddha Beads are a magic artifact refined by this humble monk upon an insight during the late Golden Core stage using the power of vows."
"Nonsense, that's impossible!"
Ye Xiao was furious. Could a magic artifact refined by someone at the late Golden Core stage block an attack from someone at the Nascent Soul Early Stage?
"Benefactor, please restrain your anger. Those who have left the householder's life do not speak lies. Ever since I became a monk, I have only been defeated once, and losing to me is no disgrace."
Shi Chan was telling the truth; the only time he had been defeated was when he went to the Seek Dao Sect to challenge the Eldest Senior Sister.
Ye Xiao was even more enraged. How could he, a man who had started over after disbanding his cultivation, the Night Pavilion master who made countless cultivators tremble in fear during the Great Yu Era, be defeated by a little monk from later generations!
It must be a psychological tactic!
"Little monk, I'm going to show you what happens when you anger an assassin!"
Boom!
The two-meter-long Sword Washing Pool smashed through the wall, plunging headfirst into the inn's hall. Ye Xiao only felt a tremendous force hitting him, and he was sent flying, breaking several bones, and crashing through the opposite wall.
"How is it, are you two ladies hurt? Where's Ye Xiao?" Lu Yang, worried that Shi Chan couldn't handle Ye Xiao, hurriedly flew the pool over.
Ironically, piloting a water pool was much faster than flying by himself.
Shi Chan pointed to the hole on the opposite wall, his hands joined in prayer.
"He has already been hit flying by Elder Brother Lu Yang."
Meng Jingzhou then entered through the other side of the wall, holding a person in his hand.
"When I arrived, I saw a person lying on the roof, gravely injured but still breathing. Do any of you know this man? I think he can still be saved."
"Senior Brother Meng, this person is Benefactor Ye Xiao, who has just been struck flying by Elder Brother Lu Yang."
"Ah, this is Ye Xiao? Never mind, no saving him then." Meng Jingzhou disdainfully dropped Ye Xiao to the ground and stepped on him a couple of times.
What trash; even Lu Yang could defeat him.
"What should we do now..."
Before Meng Jingzhou could finish speaking, the earth trembled, the Fu Ling sisters were thrown into disarray, and the inn's rooftop was lifted off. As the dust settled, the indifferent figure of the Void Venerate with various Transcendance Tribulation Stage magic artifacts floating around him appeared, ignoring Lu Yang and others.
To him, these Nascent Soul Stage cultivators were insignificant.
With a wave of his hand, he produced a drop of precious nectar, which he dropped into Ye Xiao's mouth, reviving him and healing his injuries.
He had come here for two reasons: one was to reduce the number of Great Xia's Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivators, and the other was to let Ye Xiao train a group of Body Integration Realm assassins. Both strategies were aimed at destroying the Great Xia established by Jiang Pingan.
Lu Yang inwardly cursed at the bad timing; this meant that One Qi Venerable had lost.
The Dao Fruit Outline abilities of the Void Venerate were his secret. By dragging everyone into the Void Realm, he showed his hand, meaning the Void Venerate had no intention of leaving any survivors!
"Venerate." Knowing he was no match for Lu Yang and the others, Ye Xiao slinked behind the Void Venerate.
The Void Venerate glanced over Lu Yang and the other two, his gaze settling on Meng Jingzhou, his brow slightly furrowing.
"You're a Meng Family member?"
Defeated by the ancestors of both the Jiang and Meng families, the sect he had established was eradicated by those two forces. His hatred for the Jiang Family was by no means less than his hatred for Great Xia!
All members of the Meng Family had to die!
As the Void Venerate reached out to kill Meng Jingzhou, suddenly, his expression changed. He sensed someone attacking the barrier of his Void Realm.
"Who is it!"
Crack!
A rift appeared in the sky, and a tall, lanky man resembling a bamboo pole appeared, staring coldly at the Void Venerate.
"Damn it, it was hard enough finding a clue to Twin River, now I'd like to see who the blind fool is that dares to mess with the person I've imprinted!"

chapters.title: Chapter 675 - 674: Turning the Intangible into Tangible
chapters.content:
The sudden turn of events startled everyone present.
Especially the Void Venerate, whose somber expression was so dark it seemed like it could drip water.
The Void Realm was his territory, isolated from all external perceptions. In theory, no one should have been able to find it, let alone enter it.
The exterior of the Void Realm was more fragile than its interior. To break through the Void Realm from the outside, one's Cultivation Level had to be at least at the level of the One Qi Venerable, which was the late stage of Passing Tribulation.
He sensed the imprints flickering in the palms of the Fu Ling sisters and understood.
Someone had left a mark on these two sisters and had followed it to find him.
Although he didn't know what the Twin River was, or what the relationship between the two sisters and the Twin River was, since they had come to the Void Realm, they would leave their lives here!
Anyone who entered the Void Realm might know the capabilities of his Dao Fruit Outline, and absolutely could not be allowed to leave!
Once the capabilities of the Dao Fruit Outline were leaked, the opponent would have corresponding countermeasures, and the advantage of his Dao Fruit Outline would be greatly diminished in the future.
No matter whether this skinny bamboo pole was at the late stage of Passing Tribulation or at the peak, or even a Semi-Immortal, he was confident he could keep them here!
"Twin River?" When Lu Yang heard the familiar term, he asked Fairy Eternity, "Is it the Twin River that you created, which, if drunk, would result in the birth of twins?"
"Were the Fu Ling sisters born from drinking the water of the Twin River?"
Lu Yang remembered what the Fu Ling sisters had mentioned: their mother had gone to the ancient forest temple to seek a child from a master known as Master Yuxin. The process of seeking the child was unknown, but eventually, the Fu Ling sisters were born.
So, was it Master Yuxin who gave the mother of the Fu Ling sisters the water from the Twin River to drink?
"If you put it that way, it's really possible," Fairy Eternity exclaimed, examining the Fu Ling sisters carefully and seeing nothing out of the ordinary.
"Fairy, can't you tell if these sisters are the products of the Twin River?"
Fairy Eternity rolled her eyes, "Who would be able to tell that? It's not like I gave birth to them."
"But if these two girls really have something to do with the Twin River, it is possible to find the river by following them."
"How do we find it?"
"That's actually quite simple," the Fairy said. "With a minor magic skill of tracing origins, I can find it. However, only I can use this method; that skinny bamboo pole that just popped up definitely can't."
"Then what's his method?" Lu Yang stealthily glanced at the two opposing figures in the sky, both overconfident in their own strength—unlikely to be settled by a mere exchange of words.
"The creatures born from the Mother-child River and the Twin River have a trait; when they die, their Soul transforms into the energy of nothingness and returns to the river, becoming part of the river, which is commonly said as 'falling leaves return to their roots.'
"However, there is a precondition that these creatures must die peacefully."
"Why is there such a precondition?" Lu Yang didn't understand.
"People are born without any concept of good or evil, and the Mother-child River and the Twin River must also maintain absolute purity," said the Fairy. "If they die with regrets or resentment, it would contaminate the river, thereby affecting creatures born later. Hence, I added such a limitation."
"I see," Lu Yang nodded, realizing that Fairy Eternity had put much thought into creating the two rivers.
"This skinny bamboo pole probably wants the two girls to die peacefully in their sleep, and when that happens, their true Spirits will return to the Twin River."
"However, he only left an imprint and hadn't prepared to lull the girls into a dream before being dragged into the Void Realm together by this boy called Void."
Fairy Eternity's guess was correct; seeing the intrusion of outsiders, Void Venerate was filled with a killing intent, and the skinny bamboo pole wasn't any better off.
He had put in an unknown amount of effort to find the Twin River.
After he woke up, he heard about Master Yuxin's ability to help people have children and realized that Master Yuxin knew the location of the Twin River.
Unfortunately, by that time, Master Yuxin had already passed away of old age, making it impossible to begin the search. He could only settle for the next best thing—finding the latest Twin River twins, the Fu Ling sisters.
If he killed the sisters directly, their true Spirits would harbor resentment and wouldn't return to the Twin River.
But he couldn't wait a hundred years for the sisters to die of old age. Moreover, as Twin River twins, they had great fortune on their side, making it difficult to kill them easily. Therefore, he could only make the sisters die in their dreams.
He had found the two sisters and was ready to make them spend a lifetime in their dreams tonight, sleeping to death within.
Unexpectedly, before evening came, this situation arose.
This was the Immortal Artifact of the legends, the Twin River created by Immortals, an ancient supreme treasure crafted by the Yingtian Immortal. Its value rivaled that of other Immortal Artifacts, embodying the Yingtian Immortal's supreme Divine Ability and the essence of heaven and earth.
Whoever blocked his acquisition of the Twin River was his sworn enemy, harboring a vendetta as deep as the sea of blood!
"I will take these two away," the tall, thin man said coldly, not paying any attention to the Void Venerate.
The Void Venerate was angered by the tall, thin man's commanding tone: "Fellow Daoist, you really don't take me seriously!"
"So, will you let them go or not?" The tall, thin man showed no mercy to those who stood in the way of his destiny.
"What if I say no?"
"Then we will see the truth through combat!"
Both men had their own pride and neither was willing to back down.
Moreover, the Void Venerate had never intended to let the other party leave alive.
"Ten Thousand Creations!" With a thought from the Void Venerate, a plethora of magic artifacts appeared, nearly a hundred kinds, and each one was steeped in deadly poison, incurable, guaranteeing death upon the slightest contact!
"Void Collapse!"
The space beneath the tall, thin man's feet twisted, like a swamp impossible to escape. Facing various magic artifacts, he had no place to dodge!
The Void Realm was the domain of the Void Venerate, and he could control it at will!
Facing the deadly attacks that cut off any retreat, the tall, thin man's brows furrowed—he hadn't expected the opponent to be capable of creating such void machinations.
He whispered softly, "Enter Dream."
As the words "Enter Dream" were spoken, the entire Void Realm fell into a hazy state that seemed both illusionary and real, as if everything was false, yet also genuine.
Everyone seemed to be covered with a veil that slowed their thoughts.
Even the One Qi Venerable was slightly affected, but he quickly regained his senses.
Only two people in the room were unaffected, one was the Void Venerate and the other was Lu Yang.
"Fairy, what's happening?"
Fairy Eternity showed a grin of interest: "This is getting interesting. It seems that the Dao Fruit Outline of this tall, thin man is related to dreams, and now he has merged the Void Realm with dreams. All of you are both in a dream and in reality."
"If this were the outside world, he could merely pull everyone into a dream, but this is the Void Realm, not the real world. His Dao Fruit Outline can thus exert further influence, allowing the dream to directly affect reality. He is not far from reaching the realm of 'Turning the Void into Reality.'"
"But that's not the most interesting part. Do you know what is?"
"What is it?"
"The Dao Fruit Outlines of these two people—one who creates the Void Realm and one who masters dreams—both belong to the lineage of 'Turning the Void into Reality,' and no Immortals have ever arisen from this lineage."
"Do you remember why the Qilin Immortal fought a great battle with Lianyi and Xiao Ling?"
Lu Yang's pupils dilated, realizing the implications of Fairy Eternity's words: "You're saying that only one of them can become an Immortal?"
"Correct, the struggle for ascension is a fight to the death!"
The One Qi Venerable was a step slower but also realized he was in a dream, causing his heart to skip a beat.
He didn't know what the struggle to become an Immortal entailed or that these two were in a life-and-death situation, but he had a guess about the identity of the tall, thin man.
"Dreamscape... the Dao Fruit Outline of dreams, could it be that he is the Nightmare Supreme?!"
The Nightmare Supreme, a figure from the late stages of the Great Qian, wielded the Dao Fruit Outline of dreams, once contended for supremacy with the first Emperor Yu, but ultimately lost.

chapters.title: Chapter 676 - 675: Heavenly Court Sect Master
chapters.content:
```
"Dream realm?" The Void Venerate raised an eyebrow, the opponent was actually similar to his own Dao Fruit.
"Are you the Nightmare Supreme?"
As the last Semi-Immortal of Great Yu, he knew more about the Nightmare Supreme.
This entity was the overlord of the dream realm, his enemies would die in their sleep in extremely painful ways, and there had been times during battles between two armies when he caused a million soldiers on the opposing side to enter a sleepwalking state, thus controlling a million soldiers and making them slaughter each other.
The enemy generals would die in the midst of the million soldiers' sleepwalking.
If it hadn't been for the help of the Imperial Teacher with the first Emperor Yu, it would not have been certain that they could defeat him.
The Nightmare Supreme did not answer, his cold gaze said it all.
He had awakened from ancient times, spreading pendants in this place, collecting the dreams of mortals to strengthen the outline of his Dao Fruit of the dream realm.
The Dao Fruit outline of the dream realm needed to collect various types of dreams to become complete.
Since losing to the first Emperor Yu at the end of Great Qian, he had lain dormant and had awoken in different eras.
Each era has its characteristics, creating different kinds of dreams.
The dreams of this era greatly enriched the outline of his Dao Fruit of the dream realm, and with the Twin River created by the Immortals, none among the Semi-Immortals could be his match!
For now, the first to be dealt with was the Void Venerate.
Shi Chan and Meng Jingzhou woke up from their dreamlike states one after another, with Shi Chan awakening earlier because he knew the Dream-entering Technique.
To say they woke up was actually not entirely accurate, as they hadn't left the realm of dreaming; the Void Realm and the dream realm had become one, and they were in a "lucid dreaming" state.
"Two ancient Semi-Immortals?" Meng Jingzhou was extremely surprised after hearing Lu Yang's introduction, as the situation seemed to be growing more and more serious.
Taking advantage of the fight between the two ancient Semi-Immortals, the One Qi Venerable rescued City Lord Liu and others from their cages and explained the situation.
City Lord Liu nearly didn't catch his breath upon hearing this.
How could such a small place as Chunjiang City be the site of a battle between two great Semi-Immortals?
"Venerable, who do you think will win?"
The One Qi Venerable shook his head; it was a meaningless question, "No matter who wins, we've seen their methods, and neither will let us live. Now the only plan is to wait for them to both be grievously injured in their fight, and then I will strike unexpectedly with thunderous means, only then is there a chance of victory."
"We rely on the Venerable then!" City Lord Liu quickly expressed his gratitude. This concerned the lives of a million people in Chunjiang City.
The One Qi Venerable didn't respond to City Lord Liu; he wasn't in the mood for that now.
Only he knew how difficult this task was and how low the chance of success was.
These two were Semi-Immortals who had fought through life and death situations, and though they were losers in the battle for the world, one should consider who they were defeated by.
The combat experience of these two was likely so extensive it would make one's scalp tingle; the chance for them to injure each other sufficiently to reveal weaknesses was extremely small.
Regardless, all that was left was to try.
"Condense."
The spatial vortex created by the Nightmare Supreme came to a halt at the command of a single word from the Supreme, space froze as if time stopped, and the tearing force of the space disappeared.
He was the sovereign of the dream realm, and in the dream realm, he could achieve the effect of Verbal Spell.
As for the nearly a hundred magic artifacts created by the Void Venerate, he could also create them.
"Create!"
Nearly a hundred magic artifacts also appeared behind the Nightmare Supreme.
The dazzling array of magic artifacts collided in the air, the sound of their impacts nearly tore the space apart.
"Law of Heaven and Earth."
"Law of Heaven and Earth."
```
Two Venerates simultaneously deployed the Law of Heaven and Earth, their heads touching the blue sky and their feet standing firm on the ground, armed with divine weapons, capable of warding off all kinds of magic spell attacks, invulnerable to myriads of magic.
The Nightmare Supreme was indeed famous, but he, the Void Venerate, was no ordinary figure, either. Had not the Jiang and Meng families joined forces a hundred thousand years ago, it would still be uncertain to whom this world truly belonged!
"Plague of diseases, the Five Decays of Heaven and Man," the Nightmare Venerate used a cruel curse technique.
This was a magic skill he could only employ within the realm of dreams. Unless one became immortal, any cultivator could not escape the destiny of the Five Decays of Heaven and Man. No matter how extensive your lifespan or how you reached towards the heavens, in the end, you would be constrained by the suffering of the Five Decays, unable to withstand the power of time.
In an instant, the Void Venerate transformed into an old man with white hair, unable to straighten his back; his body emanated an odour. Countless wailing souls surrounded him, covering the skies and too numerous to count – these were the innocent lives he had taken throughout his life.
"A scapegoat satchel assumes the disaster, troubles abound once out of bounds."
In the hands of the Void Venerate, a palm-sized straw doll appeared. Twining a strand of hair around it, the straw doll spontaneously combusted, turning to ashes.
The Void Venerate was restored to his original form, and countless wronged souls turned into black raindrops, falling upon the earth.
The straw man scapegoat technique—unless faced with a tribulation of becoming immortal, such as the Immortal Calamity, the straw man could save a life.
"Purge the locusts with Immortal Thunder, sweep clean the human realm!"
Azure-purple Immortal Thunder descended upon the world, a single step away from the true Immortal Thunder. All beings and spirits were like locusts in front of Immortal Thunder, merely a motley crew, insignificant and feeble.
The One Qi Venerable watched, his scalp tingling. He could not protect himself in front of such a level of Immortal Thunder. Even if he didn't die, he would be gravely wounded!
"Naught but a slight effort, Withered Wood Meeting Spring, spring returns to the earth!"
With a step, the Nightmare Supreme sprouted a large rootless tree from beneath his feet. Its branches swayed, emanating waves of time. The Purging Locust Immortal Thunder gradually shrank, as if it had never appeared in the first place.
Fairy Eternity laughed upon seeing this, "The Yingtian Immortal fought against the Time Immortal before they became immortal in just this manner. When the Yingtian Immortal struck with thunder, the Time Immortal would reverse time. No thunder could descend, frustrating the Yingtian Immortal nearly to death."
The battle Fairy Eternity spoke of was recorded in historical texts, which, although now lost, did exist during the era of the Great Qian. The Nightmare Supreme had devised this countermeasure after learning of that battle.
In the Void Realm and the realm of dreams, their techniques seemed almost infinite, capable of using any method below that of an Immortal's. They could materialize any of the one hundred and eight types of True Fire, causing space to collapse, and countless Divine Abilities were too numerous to count.
It was precisely because their techniques were so closely matched that the battle stagnated, making it hard to determine a victor.
Meng Jingzhou was rather worried, "Old Lu, who do you think will win between them?"
Lu Yang shook his head, "It's not up to them to determine the victor."
"What do you mean?"
Lu Yang didn't say anything, but simply pointed above his head where there was nothing. However, when the Nightmare Supreme had broken into the Void Realm earlier, a crack had formed, momentarily connecting it with the outside world.
Lu Yang had seized this opportunity.
Suddenly, both sides of the battle stopped in unison. The Void Realm and the realm of dreams severed their connection with the outside world, but an ominous feeling inexplicably arose within them, as if a tremendous threat was rapidly approaching.
Crack—
At the upper level of the dark space, above the heads of the two ancient Semi-Immortals, a fissure appeared without warning, just wide enough to fit one person.
The Void Venerate's pupils constricted sharply.
If when the Nightmare Supreme had intruded into the Void Realm he had felt the other force attacking the realm, this time he felt nothing before a rift was torn open.
It was as if the barriers of the Void Realm and the realm of dreams were illusory, easily torn asunder as simply as splitting a piece of paper in two.
A beautiful figure stepped leisurely through the spatial rift, and the fissure could not close for a long time.
The figure looked indifferent, her expression showing not a ripple of emotion. She regarded the two ancient Semi-Immortals as if they were nothing. Seeing Lu Yang below, her expression slightly softened, but quickly returned to indifference.
"Who are you!" the Nightmare Supreme watched her warily.
Her appearance did not match any supreme being he knew of.
The beautiful figure glanced over the two Venerates, her tone as ancient and unchanging as if the collapse of heaven and earth could not affect her state of mind:
"Master of the Heavenly Court Sect, Yun Mengmeng."

chapters.title: Chapter 677 - 676: The Might of Sect Leader Yun
chapters.content:
"Heavenly Court Sect Master?"
The two supreme beings from ancient times frowned. As semi-immortals who had revived in the present age, they had thoroughly investigated this ancient organization.
The origins of the Heavenly Court Sect could be traced back to the Ancient Times, and every move it made shocked the world.
First, there was the battle in Hanshui City, where the Heavenly Court Master, Heavenly Venerate Dou, controlled the Power of National Fate with a single immortal thought, overwhelmingly defeating three from Great Yu at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage.
Later, the Young Sect Master of the Heavenly Court brazenly appeared at the Seek Dao Sect, challenging the geniuses of the world. In the end, he fought Lu Yang of the Seek Dao Sect to a standstill and left with his head held high.
Not long ago, the Phoenix Ancestor also revived and defeated Zhu Tian Venerate, who had ascended to emperorship.
Every move demonstrated the Heavenly Court's incredibly powerful strength, and they made no effort to conceal their power, a testament to their confidence in their own strength.
The two Venerates had fought their whole lives and would not be easily frightened off by a mere title.
If it were Heavenly Venerate Dou in person, they would turn tail and run, as he was very possibly an Immortal—not a terrifying existence they could contend with.
Since it was not Heavenly Venerate Dou, there was nothing to fear; whether it be the Phoenix Ancestor or Sect Leader Yun, they were all but semi-immortals.
Ancient Immortals had names and were limited to just four. The sudden emergence of Heavenly Venerate Dou was already inconceivable, and it was highly unlikely for another Immortal to suddenly appear.
If not an Ancient Immortal, then Sect Leader Yun could only be a semi-immortal.
"Thinking of stepping on our heads to gain fame? Sect Leader Yun isn't afraid of bursting his guts with bravery!"
Semi-immortals, in their domain, meant nothing.
From the way the other party had easily pierced through the Void Realm's space, it was apparent that they dealt with an embryonic Spatial Dao Fruit.
Yun Zhi looked towards the two, her eyes revealing confusion.
"Who are you?"
The veins on the ancient semi-immortals' foreheads bulged as they exploded in rage—they had not encountered such provocation in a long time.
Not recognizing them, what business did you have coming here!
"Seeking death!"
"Law of Heaven and Earth!"
"Myriad Weapons Profound Mystery!"
Two divine beings, as tall as the sky, wielding all sorts of divine weapons, attacked from both sides, determined to kill Yun Zhi and scatter her soul!
The expression of One Qi Venerable grew even more solemn. The involvement of the Heavenly Court Sect Leader Yun, friend or foe unknown, added a third power to the battlefield, making the fight all the more unpredictable.
"Looks like these two also don't dare to underestimate Sect Leader Yun, using their big moves right from the start," he observed.
City Lord Liu did not understand, "Didn't they fight the same way earlier on, from the very start? The move seems to have modest power; it didn't inflict any real damage."
One Qi Venerable shook his head to correct City Lord Liu's misconception, "They did not harm each other just now because they are about evenly matched in their abilities. If it were any other semi-immortal, they would definitely not dare to take that move head-on!"
Law of Heaven and Earth, offensive and defensive combined, is an extremely strong Dharma body, named along with Buddhism's Impenetrable Golden Body—indestructible and unrivaled in defense.
Myriad Weapons Profound Mystery, formed from a variety of magic artifacts for an offensive onslaught, is as unstoppable as a bamboo slicing through butter, overwhelming by sheer volume, making any defense seem futile!
Yun Zhi raised her hand, and the golden bell tied to her wrist jingled, creating endless spatial ripples. The ripples swept over every inch of space, and the two divine beings became as if subject to a binding spell, immobile, maintaining the pose of lifting their weapons high.
The bell rang again.
Another layer of spatial ripples spread, and the two beings were as if struck in the chest by a mythical hammer. They let out a cry as they were sent flying backward, smashing into the Spatial Barrier, leaving them dazed and disoriented.
"Where did you get the confidence from? So, you rely on having an Immortal Artifact in hand!"
The two fixed their eyes on the golden bell on Yun Zhi's wrist, understanding that even with the use of an embryonic Spatial Dao Fruit, it should not be possible to easily break their combined attacks.
If not for using "Reversal of Heaven and Earth" to reverse their own time, that blow just now would have taken their lives!
The opponent had used a power beyond that of semi-immortals!
"No wonder, coming from the Ancient Heavenly Court, they actually have an Immortal Artifact. It makes sense, having the support of Heavenly Venerate Dou; it would be strange if they didn't."
The Nightmare Venerate revealed a greedy look.
```
Why was he so obsessed with finding the Twin River, if not because it was also a type of Immortal Artifact, albeit a rather unusual one?
If he could master the Twin River, then the Void Venerate would become nothing but a pile of bones on his path to becoming an Immortal!
Originally, the two of them had planned to kill Sect Leader Yun and then turn on each other, but now it seemed that it was not the time to hold back.
Whoever obtained the Immortal Artifact bell would win the internal strife!
Kill!
"Fairy, is the bell on Eldest Senior Sister's wrist an Immortal Artifact?" Lu Yang was astonished. Ever since he first met Eldest Senior Sister, she had been wearing the bell on her wrist, which he had thought was just a normal decoration. So, the golden bell was an Immortal Artifact?
Fairy Eternity nodded lazily, lying on the lotus seat in the great hall, propping her cheek with one hand. Since Miss Yun had made her move, there was no need for her to turn the tide anymore.
"It is indeed an Immortal Artifact, but it has nothing to do with the attack just now. Miss Yun simply struck out with her palm and broke both of their moves," she said.
"I've told you before, Semi-Immortals are those who have perceived the embryonic form of Dao Fruit in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, and their physical constitution hasn't changed. Once they become Immortals, that's when the real gap widens."
...
"Moving stars and changing fights, sun and moon appearing together!"
"Changes in the celestial cycle, great floods that end the world!"
"Cycle of life and death!"
"Stripping away the five senses!"
The brilliant sun and the lofty moon emerged in the sky, representing the ultimate yin and yang, turning slowly and forming a true Tai Chi Diagram.
This was a move once used by Immortal Jiuchong during his Semi-Immortal days!
Suddenly, the sky was filled with stars, and their movements heralded mysterious powers, calling upon the past and present, causing the apocalyptic flood of bygone times to descend upon the world once more, with force no different from the ancient deluges!
A huge bronze wheel appeared, heavy like a grinding millstone, moving slowly but capable of crushing anything in the world. The wheel represented Yun Zhi's lifespan; each mark stood for a phase of her life, and when the wheel completed its rotation, it signified the end of Yun Zhi's life!
A curse of life and death through time!
By stripping away the five senses, they left Yun Zhi without the perception of the outside world, making her vulnerable to their assault!
In the outside world, the two of them would not be able to display such heaven-defying moves, but this was a unique blend of the Void Realm and dreams, with conditions so favorable that they could unleash attacks at will.
Still feeling uneasy, they exchanged glances and made up their minds to simultaneously unleash a move, despite the heavy toll it would take on them to perform it.
"Time stops!"
Time came to an abrupt halt, and the bustling Chunjiang City was reduced to a silhouette in time, with only ancient beings capable of overlooking all of time, moving within the frozen moment.
"Die!"
The move they had poured countless efforts into descended, the sun fell from the sky, and the moon plummeted to the ground. The catastrophic flood that haunted the ancestors' nightmares cascaded from the heavens, shrouded with the heavy breath of death. The bronze wheel spun rapidly, forewarning the end of life.
In the stillness of time, Yun Zhi blinked her eyes, gazing at the two Semi-Immortals with clear division of black and white in her eyes, devoid of any emotion.
The two Semi-Immortals shuddered with fear, sensing something was terribly wrong.
How could anyone move while time was stopped?
Especially when all five senses were sealed off!
Yun Zhi moved, taking a step that ruptured time, and the flow of time resumed.
With a casual wave of her hand, the sun and moon shattered, the flood dissipated, and the bronze wheel reversed.
As if the world was being destroyed, all was silent.
The light and shadows from the destroyed sun and moon reflected Yun Zhi's expression, unchanged by joy or sorrow.
The Void Venerate and Nightmare Supreme were struck by backlash, coughing up Immortal blood.
Their pupils filled with fear, making them forget about their injuries.
"She, she is an Immortal!"
```

chapters.title: Chapter 678 - 677: One Move
chapters.content:
```
"What did they just say, that the Sect Leader Yun of the Heavenly Court Sect is an Immortal?" City Lord Liu doubted his hearing for the first time in his life.
In this era when Semi-Immortals are rare, could there actually be an Immortal?
Even in the battle at Hanshui City, it was nothing more than a strand of Heavenly Venerate Dou's spiritual awareness, and not his true body.
To think that not just two Semi-Immortals appeared in Chunjiang City, but even an Immortal has come?
The One Qi Venerable nodded solemnly, "There's no mistake, only an Immortal could easily and comfortably unravel the tactics used just now."
With the situation having developed to this point, he had stopped thinking about the sneak attack.
Facing an Immortal, no tactics would be of use.
Whether the people of Chunjiang City lived or died now depended on the whims of the Heavenly Court Sect.
...
"Who would have thought, the Ancient Heavenly Court actually had two Immortals."
The Void Venerate narrowed his eyes as various ancient runes quietly crawled up his wrist.
"Fellow Daoist, if you and I join forces to defeat this person, our names will surely be passed down through the ages, what do you say?"
Nightmare Supreme showed no fear. This was a rare opportunity in a thousand years to slay an Immortal. Distracting him with words and then launching a sneak attack could possibly succeed—it was worth a try!
To kill an Immortal would be to obtain the greatest fortune in the struggles of the Great Era!
"Agreed."
The two exchanged glances and attacked at the same time!
Boom!
They struck each other and then turned to flee towards the outside world.
Each wanted the other to engage Yun Zhi so they could themselves escape.
Against an Immortal, there was no chance of winning!
Not the slightest bit!
Only by fleeing could there be a sliver of hope for survival.
Both broke open their own worlds, one unraveled the Void Realm, and the other the dream realm.
Huge fissures tore open in the Void Realm and the dream realm.
Just as they had half of their bodies escape into the outside world, Yun Zhi suddenly clapped his hands.
The fissures closed, and they were pulled back by an invisible pair of hands.
The vast gap in power made them realize that escape was impossible. They had to go all out if they wanted to live!
"The human follows the earth, the earth follows the heavens, the heavens follow the Dao, and the Dao follows nature!"
The Void Venerate disappeared, merging with the Void Realm. At that moment, he was the Void Realm, and the Void Realm was him!
The Void Realm would help him realize his consciousness, including killing Yun Zhi!
This state was extremely dangerous. A moment's carelessness could result in being devoured by the Void Realm, becoming its nourishment.
"The Dao is great, the heavens are great, the earth is great, I am also great!"
Nightmare Supreme used a similar method, merging with the dream realm to gain power. At the same time, he ran the risk of becoming part of the dream realm, never waking up again.
Two colossal faces appeared above Chunjiang City, roaring in unison.
"This is you forcing our hand! Your fate includes a death tribulation that should come to pass today!"
They were the essences of the Void Realm and the dream realm. Every word they spoke was the will of the Void Realm and the dream realm, including causality.
That sentence was not a threat or intimidation, but an actual causality curse!
Spiritual Energy chaotically surged for no reason, forming a vortex and then causing a massive Spiritual Energy explosion—a disaster made possible by a one in a billion chance!
In the history of Great Qian, the people of an entire city perished in this kind of disaster.
Space twisted into turmoil, becoming chaotic flows. No tangible thing could remain intact in such spatial distortion—an event with one in ten billion odds of occurring.
```
Once, a peak Pass Tribulation powerhouse persisted for three seconds in space-time turbulence before being torn into shreds of flesh.
Ancient illusory shadows appeared, a million-strong army, banners, and floating corpses everywhere… Time lost its meaning at that moment; a time travel event that had only a one in a billion chance of occurring actually happened!
The descending army roared as they charged towards Yun Zhi, their banners declaring to the world that they were the troops of Great Yu!
In the last years of Great Qian, the Nightmare Supreme in the dream realm defeated the million-strong army of Great Yu!
One after another, events that were statistically impossible to occur happened, and all sorts of disadvantages occurred to Yun Zhi.
A massive shadow loomed over Yun Zhi, a range of undulating black mountains, things created from the Void with an incredibly high density, so heavy they were incalculable, with signs of space collapsing all around.
In the face of misfortune and the black mountains, Yun Zhi remained unmoved. She sighed, stretched out a soft and boneless jade hand, and chopped down with a hand blade.
Unremarkable and yet profoundly simple.
Spiritual Energy disaster, space distortion, time travel, black mountains… all turned into nothingness, as if they had never existed.
Heaven and earth were cleansed.
