Two screams rang out as Yun Zhi split both the Void Realm and the dream realm down the middle, dividing them into two, revealing Chunjiang City to the daylight, returning it to the original world. The colors restored, the clear blue sky reappeared overhead.
The two melded Venerates were gravely injured as they separated from their fused state, their lower halves dropped to the ground, creating two large craters.
One Qi Venerable swallowed his saliva.
With just one move, she had dealt with two ancient Semi-Immortals.
Was this the power of an Immortal?
Having reached the original world, the two Venerates still didn't give up hope, letting their lower halves take their shape while their upper halves turned transparent, flying in different directions.
But after flying just a few yards, they were slapped back to the ground by Yun Zhi, unable to get up.
They tried to let their primordial spirits escape, a process so rapid, with one thought spanning thousands of miles, that no one could catch up. It was their last life-saving measure, having survived the hands of the first Emperor Yu and the first Emperor Xia thanks to this trick.
Yet, just as they flew up about two feet, Yun Zhi pressed their primordial spirits back into their bodies.
"Who would have thought that this time it would be two Semi-Immortals."
Yun Zhi reconnected the Venerates' bodies, dragging one by the ankle of the Void Venerate and the other by the ankle of the Nightmare Supreme, then disappeared.
Before disappearing, she sent a message to Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
"After dealing with the follow-up matters in Chunjiang City, come find me on the hillside thirty miles east of the city."
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou shivered with fright after hearing the message.
Although they thought of themselves as performing many acts of justice in Chunjiang City, being summoned by Eldest Senior Sister made them feel inexplicably guilty, as though they had been doing something wrong in the city.
...
"Is it over?"
"The Master of the Heavenly Court Sect has left?"
The citizens of Chunjiang City cheered with joy upon seeing the three figures in the sky vanish. They had walked a fine line between life and death and surviving warranted celebration.
"The Master of the Heavenly Court Sect saved us?"
"Yes, it must have been her!"
"Strange, why can't I remember the battle that just took place? I can recall the whole fight against the two Semi-Immortals."
"Now that you mention it, it seems I'm the same."
"With your memory, it's a good thing I wrote it down just now... Odd, why is there nothing on the paper?"
Forgetfulness spread throughout the city.
"Venerable one, do you still remember Sect Leader Yun's fighting techniques?"
One Qi Venerable shook his head and sighed deeply, a trace of indescribable melancholy, "I can't remember. It seems the legends are true. No wonder there are no records of the immortals' battles in the ancient texts. It's not that people didn't want to record them, it's that they simply couldn't."
"Right, where did Ye Xiao go?" City Lord Liu suddenly remembered that they had intended to escort Ye Xiao away.
"Stop looking, he was caught in the crossfire during the battle between the two Semi-Immortals and turned to ashes. That deputy sect leader is still alive, though, I'll go look for him."
One Qi Venerable stretched his aching back, just in time to boost his confidence by dealing with the deputy sect leader.

chapters.title: Chapter 679 - 678: How Did You Two Manage to Attract Two Semi-Immortals?
chapters.content:
"It's finally over," Lu Yang let out a long sigh of relief, the battle between the semi-immortals had frightened him terribly.
"Since when have you been such a coward?" Fairy Eternity looked at Lu Yang with puzzlement.
"Remember when I battled Miss Yun, you weren't this scared."
That was a genuine Immortal battle, compared to their skirmish, what were those two semi-immortals? Nothing but a village brawl.
Lu Yang: "..."
It made sense, but something still felt off.
"Good thing you invited Eldest Senior Sister," Meng Jingzhou was also shaken by the battle, without her, their journey would likely have ended in disaster.
"Amitabha, no wonder I could not defeat Senior Sister Yun," Shi Chan finally understood why his master had said not to provoke Yun Zhi.
Lu Yang had introduced the Heavenly Court Sect to Shi Chan, who already knew that Eldest Senior Sister was the Sect Master.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou turned their heads in surprise to look at Shi Chan, their faces filled with disbelief, "You fought with Eldest Senior Sister?"
Shi Chan, who answered every question, calmly said, "When I went to Seek Dao Sect to study, I once challenged Senior Sister Yun, but unfortunately, I never won."
Realizing that Shi Chan had done something so foolhardy, the two men saluted him with admiration. Truly a high monk, his courage was extraordinary.
"Is everything all right now, young heroes?" Fu Ling asked cautiously, during the battle they had barely dared to breathe.
Lu Yang nodded, "Chunjiang City is now safe."
With Eldest Senior Sister there, no demon or ghost could cause trouble.
"Will you continue to train your Mind State here?" Lu Yang asked Shi Chan.
Shi Chan shook his head slightly. The incident was over, but the brothel would not reopen for a while and he had no desire to do so. As such, he needed to find a new place to train his Mind State.
"Then I'll wish you success in advance," Lu Yang said with a beaming smile, saluting him. He and Old Meng still had to find Eldest Senior Sister and could not accompany Shi Chan.
"The monk thanks the two Senior Brothers for their kindness."
The second floor of the inn had become completely open-air, with wooden shards flying everywhere, a complete mess.
Lu Yang picked up a piece of wood, apparently part of the roof, used his finger as a sword, and in a few strokes carved it into the shape of a wooden sword, engraving the characters "Lu Yang" at the hilt.
He carved two wooden swords, one for each of the Fu Ling sisters.
"This wooden sword contains a Sword Qi of mine, useful for self-defense; evil spirits dare not approach. If you encounter danger, the released attack is as powerful as a full strike from the pinnacle of the Nascent Soul Stage. If you run into any difficulties in the future, you can also bring the wooden sword to Seek Dao Sect to find me."
According to Fairy Eternity, using the sisters' connection to perform magic skill to find Twin River, the sisters would not sense it.
It's best not to let the two sisters know about Twin River; knowing could easily bring disaster upon themselves.
The sisters carefully put away the wooden swords and thanked Lu Yang. These were invaluable protective talismans that could save their lives at a critical moment.
Seeing Lu Yang giving gifts with such seriousness, Meng Jingzhou wanted to give something as well.
But then he thought, besides Yang Invigorating Blood or Spirit Stones, he didn't have anything suitable for a gift.
After thinking, he made a promise, "If in the future you need Spirit Stones, feel free to borrow from the Meng Family."
The three men bid farewell to the sisters and then saw the heartbroken innkeeper.
A fine inn, now only the first floor can house people. Even though the dynasty provides disaster relief funds to rebuild the inn, it will take a long time.
The benevolent young master Meng gave the innkeeper some spirit stones as compensation for lost wages.
The three of them then went to bid farewell to City Lord Liu.
After such an incident in Chunjiang City, they could forget about the casual dinner promised for the evening. City Lord Liu was as busy as a spinning top, maintaining order and relief efforts within the city while also having to compose official reports to the authorities above.
When the three visited, they happened to witness One Qi Venerable showcasing his mighty prowess, battling fiercely against the vice-leader of the Body Integration Realm from Night Pavilion, leaving the vice-leader battered and bruised.
The trio parted ways outside the city, going their separate directions, with Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou heading to a small hill thirty miles east of the city as per Eldest Senior Sister's instructions.
...
When Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou reached the small hill, they coincidentally arrived as Eldest Senior Sister was conducting a simple interrogation to clarify the identities of the two ancient supremes.
Eldest Senior Sister had set up an array method around the hill, causing outsiders to unconsciously stay away from the area.
"So that means, one of you is Nightmare Supreme from the end of Great Qian era, and the other is Void Venerate from the end of Great Yu era?"
"There's no need for such formality, senior, you can just call me Little Dream."
"And you can call me Little Void."
The two Venerates were as earnest as they could be.
Under someone else's roof, one has no choice but to bow their head, and both ancient supremes were outstanding figures of their times, never showing stubbornness when it was time to admit weakness.
From an era perspective, Sect Leader Yun is a being from the ancient era, which predates theirs, and in terms of cultivation level, she is an Immortal, surpassing them in power.
Addressing her as a senior had no issues whatsoever.
"Eldest Senior Sister, the matter on our end has been resolved," they reported.
Eldest Senior Sister took out the imperial seat brought by Lu Yang from Demon City. Siting in the seat, she calmly inquired about the course of events.
"Let's hear the full story. I remember Junior Brother Meng, before you left, you asked Junior Brother Dai about the black market information and even promised 'to absolutely not cause trouble for at least the next half a year.'
She had accidentally heard these words from Dai Bufan.
Unexpectedly, not even half a year had passed, barely half a month, and it led to a great battle between two ancient semi-immortals.
Meng Jingzhou repeatedly claimed his innocence, wanting to clarify the matter:
"Eldest Senior Sister, the truth must be recognized. Old Lu and I were both victims."
"With the intention of independent entrepreneurship, I left the black market after making my first fortune in life, and happened to encounter Shi Chan soliciting alms on the way out. Seeing him down-and-out, in difficult living circumstances, out of concern from a fellow sect member, we decided to accompany Shi Chan in his worldly cultivation of the mind state."
"In Chunjiang City, the three of us acted heroically, saving two sisters multiple times, providing the government office with a clue about an assassin organization, and peacefully resolving the conflict involving four Nascent Soul Stage monsters, allowing them to coexist peacefully in one place."
"The city lord, upon learning about our deeds, even took the initiative to invite us to dinner."
With firm conviction, Meng Jingzhou pointed at the two venerates kneeling on the ground and shouted, "It is clearly these two who caused trouble out of nothing, insisting on battling in Chunjiang City. We are the true victims."
"Their wanton battle tore off the roof of the inn we were staying in, completely disregarding the innkeeper's feelings."
"Even the innkeeper's losses were compensated by me on their behalf!"
Lu Yang also chimed in with support, "Right, these two not only brawled in a public place but also took criminals hostage, openly shielding criminal organizations and attempting to steal ancient treasures. They have committed every conceivable crime, an extensive list too long to record!"

chapters.title: Chapter 680 - 679 Twin River
chapters.content:
Two Venerates knelt silently on the ground, but the more they listened, the more something seemed amiss.
"Does the Ancient Heavenly Court really understand the law so well?"
"Also, shouldn't they be addressed as 'Master'? Why are they being called 'Eldest Senior Sister'?"
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were using their true appearances. As noble Semi-Immortals, their main concern was to understand the powerful forces that might pose a threat to them today. Naturally, those at the Nascent Soul Stage would not catch their eye, let alone the fame Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou gained during their mere Golden Core Stage.
After listening to Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou's back-and-forth explanations, Eldest Senior Sister confirmed that the fight involving the two great Venerates indeed had nothing to do with the two junior brothers.
"Junior brother, you just mentioned that these Venerates intended to steal ancient relics. What exactly were they trying to steal?"
"Heh heh, the Second-in-command doesn't know much about it, let me explain," Fairy Eternity emerged from Lu Yang's body.
The two Venerates looked at Fairy Eternity with shock and suspicion, as none of them had noticed that there was another person residing within Lu Yang!
This is impossible!
Even if someone from the Transcendance Tribulation Stage were inside Lu Yang's body, they would not escape their detection!
Is this woman a Semi-Immortal?
"You remember the story of those Fu Ling sisters, don't you?"
Eldest Senior Sister nodded, the experiences of those two sisters were indeed strange.
"In fact, these two sisters were not born from their parents but were born after their mother consumed water from the Twin River," Fairy Eternity explained.
"What is the Twin River?" Eldest Senior Sister had never heard of the Twin River.
"Then I must mention my greatness," Fairy Eternity continued.
"Back in Ancient Times, I had countless followers. Some followers asked me for children, others for twins. I happily agreed and with my supreme magical power, I created the Mother-child River and the Twin River."
"Anyone who drinks from the Mother-child River will become pregnant."
"Anyone who drinks from the Twin River will bear twins."
Nightmare Supreme widened his eyes in disbelief, staring at Fairy Eternity with terror in his trembling voice, "You—no, are You the Yingtian Immortal?!"
He had come here to search for the Twin River, not expecting to encounter its creator!
The legendary Yingtian Immortal was actually a woman!
Lu Yang: "..."
Without saying more, it was clear that another adjustment of historical facts had led to Fairy Eternity's possessions being attributed to Yingtian Immortal.
After listening, Eldest Senior Sister paused and recalled certain things. She looked at Fairy Eternity with a strange gaze, her feelings complex and somewhat unable to believe what she had heard, her tone differing from her usual.
"You mean to say… you created the Mother-child River, and anyone who drinks from it will become pregnant?"
Fairy Eternity, innocent by nature, failed to notice the oddities in Eldest Senior Sister, and nodded earnestly, "Yes, what's wrong?"
"Where is the Mother-child River now?"
Fairy Eternity shook her head, "I don't know. When the Yingtian Immortal and the others reshaped the continent, the geography changed, and I don't know where the Mother-child River was moved to."
Eldest Senior Sister's expression became even more peculiar, her mouth opened as though she wanted to say something but ultimately she said nothing.
Lu Yang noticed the change in Eldest Senior Sister's expression. Since he had joined the sect, Eldest Senior Sister had always maintained an expression of neither joy nor sorrow; Lu Yang had never seen such a range of expressions from her before.
Lu Yang did not dare to ask what Eldest Senior Sister was thinking.
"Although we can't find the Mother-child River, we can find the Twin River. I had the Second-in-command stealthily pluck a pair of hairs from those two girls. Through their hair, I can trace back to the source and find the Twin River."
Lu Yang spread his hands, with the two strands of hair lying in his palm.
Fairy Eternity pinched a complex and obscure ancient seal, a technique only she knew, unknown even to the Four Ancient Immortals.
The moment the seal touched the two strands of hair, they turned into a wisp of light green smoke, drifting into the distance.
"Let's go, follow this smoke to find the Twin River!" Fairy Eternity waved her hand grandly, leading the way and calling for everyone to follow her.
Everyone followed.
The green smoke drifted for quite a while, and after passing by a temple, it began to slow down.
```
When Lu Yang passed by, he saw the name of the temple, Ancient Forest Temple.
The Ancient Forest Temple was situated at the foot of the mountain, with continuous mountains stretching behind it.
The spirited smoke lingered over more than a dozen mountain peaks and wavered in a maple forest, showing no sign of moving forward.
"Why isn't it moving?"
Fairy Eternity explained, "The Twin River is in the Secret Realm. The spirited smoke can't directly reach the Secret Realm, so we need to find the entrance to the Secret Realm."
"According to the traces of the spirited smoke's circulation, the Secret Realm should be here."
Fairy Eternity stepped forward two paces and pointed at an inconspicuous large rock in the maple forest.
The spirited smoke had been circling around this area, and the center of its rounds was this boulder.
Eldest Senior Sister flicked her finger and shot a thread of spiritual essence into the boulder, and the smoother side of the rock turned into a black vortex.
"This is it."
Eldest Senior Sister didn't hesitate. She threw the two Semi-Immortals into the vortex and then stepped into the vortex herself. Fairy Eternity, Lu Yang, and Meng Jingzhou followed closely into the vortex.
As everyone entered, the black vortex disappeared, and the boulder returned to its original appearance; nobody could tell that it was the gateway through which one could find the Twin River, created by Immortals.
"Such rich Spiritual Energy!"
Lu Yang exclaimed in surprise. He stepped onto the lawn, where wide rivers meandered their way, their origins unknown. The surface of the river radiated with spiritual energy, nourishing this part of the Secret Realm; the vegetation by the river was lush with ancient trees, bushes, green grass... all extinct Spiritual Plants of the modern day.
Moreover, these Spiritual Plants all came in pairs, and due to the nourishment of the Twin River, their medicinal effects were much stronger than originally.
The surface of the river also bore the Twin Lotus that could help cultivators form golden cores, which were First-Grade.
The Twin Lotus was originally a product of the Twin River, initially called Sister Flowers, later renamed by the Yingtian Immortal.
The two Venerates felt it even more clearly; they sensed the profound forces contained in the river, the purest essence of the Dao. Simply by contemplating near the river, it was of great help in refining their Dao Fruit.
"Yes, this is the Twin River created by this Fairy," Fairy Eternity said with a chuckle, pointing at the river. The environment here was exactly like that of Ancient Times, bringing back a wave of nostalgia for her.
"Who would have thought it's still so well-preserved?" Fairy Eternity was somewhat surprised. This was almost the entirety of the Twin River, and it was hard to imagine that it would remain so intact after the war that reshaped the continent.
"Fairy, is that your abode over there?"
Lu Yang pointed to a stone chamber on the riverbank and said, the words "Immortal Mansion" engraved in the ancient language. From the size, it seemed to be only a part of the Immortal Mansion.
"Indeed it is. But that shouldn't be the case, this Fairy didn't establish an Immortal Mansion beside the Twin River."
Fairy Eternity murmured to herself, and then had a sudden realization: "I understand now, it must have been Qinghe who helped preserve it for this Fairy!"
"It's just that everything was too chaotic at the time; she didn't manage to preserve everything!"
Whether it was the Twin River or the Immortal Mansion, both were preserved by Qinghe in a moment of crisis.
"Let's see what's inside."
The door to the Immortal Mansion was tightly locked, but Fairy Eternity used her soul as a key and opened the Immortal Mansion.
The interior of the Immortal Mansion was as if time had stopped, spotless and dust-free, as if the owner of the house hadn't gone far. On the bookshelf were various books, each book cover looking brand new.
"This is where this Fairy read her books."
Lu Yang noticed a small booklet on the shelf that stood out, titled "Immortal's Quotations."
Out of curiosity, he took it down and flipped through it, where profound ancient language filled his sight:
I am born in response to Heaven!
Those who defy this Fairy, be slain!
How dare mortals defy the Immortal!
Mighty power resides within me, do not force me to undo the seal!
Fairy Eternity even thoughtfully annotated who said each of these phrases after them: Yingtian Immortal, Immortal Jiuchong, Qilin Immortal, Time Immortal, the list was complete.
Lu Yang quietly closed the book, placed it back where it belonged, and pretended not to have seen it.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 681 - 680: Fairy Eternity's Cultivation Insights
chapters.content:
```
At this moment, Lu Yang wished he possessed the art of forgetfulness, to erase all that he had witnessed.
Though he had already learned much about the shameful past of the Four Ancient Immortals, that knowledge came solely from testimonies, leaving room for rebuttal.
But now there was no room for denial, as physical evidence existed, and who's to say the Four Ancient Immortals wouldn't just destroy him along with the "Immortal Cultivation Insights"?
"I had forgotten that I originally placed the 'Immortal Cultivation Insights' here."
Fairy Eternity, bold and skilled, took the book from the shelf again, reminiscing with some fondness.
"This is quite the treasure. Back when the Yingtian Immortal and the others were imparting their teachings, I eavesdropped and wrote down the contents of their lectures."
As Eldest Senior Sister entered the Secret Realm, without restraining the actions of the two ancient venerates, they too came to the study, and upon hearing the Fairy's words, their eyes shone brightly at the sight of the "Immortal Cultivation Insights", their hearts pounding with excitement.
Oh Heavens, this book actually contains the teachings of immortals, and their insights are precious beyond measure, a priceless treasure!
However, now reduced to prisoners, they could only look on with desire, not daring to reach out and take it.
Hearing the Fairy's words, could it be that she is not the Yingtian Immortal?
Then who is she... wait, could she be the Heavenly Venerate Dou, the master of the Heavenly Court?
The two semi-immortals finally guessed the identity of Fairy Eternity, trembling in their boots.
"Is this a study?"
Eldest Senior Sister also noticed the Fairy's abode and stepped in to see a dazzling array of ancient books. How valuable ancient books are—just taking out any one of them and putting it up for auction would cause a frenzy.
"Yes, this is where this Immortal reads and studies."
Lu Yang, looking at the predominantly new books, thought that Fairy Eternity really did like books, showing reluctance even to read them.
Eldest Senior Sister noticed this too, but said nothing further.
The study contained every kind of book, from ancient customs and practices to cultivation manuals, with everything one could wish for. There was no shortage of cultivation insights from semi-immortals, including those of Zhu Tian and Jiang Lianyi.
The cultivation insights of the semi-immortals were voluntarily provided, mainly to bulk up the collection in the study; Fairy Eternity couldn't be bothered to read them.
She was, after all, the foremost Immortal of the ancient times, embarking on an unprecedented path. Why would she need to reference others' cultivation experiences?
There was even a "Culinary Bible", of course, authored by the Yingtian Immortal.
"So you were all here." Meng Jingzhou, who was exploring the Secret Realm, turned to find everyone had disappeared. Breaking into a cold sweat, he only relaxed upon seeing everyone in the study.
"How's it going? Found anything good here?" Meng Jingzhou elbowed Lu Yang.
"Yes."
Lu Yang handed the "Immortal Cultivation Insights" to Meng Jingzhou and said solemnly, "This Immortal text contains discourse and behavior of the Four Ancient Immortals, encapsulating the world and harmonizing with the Great Dao. Back then, even ancient semi-immortals and those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage queued up to study. You better take a good look."
"There's such a treasure!" Meng Jingzhou was astonished. Lu Yang was indeed a true brother, always remembering to share the good stuff.
Meng Jingzhou flipped through a couple of pages and then returned the book to Lu Yang.
"Why aren't you looking any further?"
"It's all in ancient language; I can't understand it."
"... When there's a chance, I'll teach you the ancient script."
"Strange, where has my diary gone to?"
Fairy Eternity wandered around the study and couldn't find her diary.
"Fairy, you keep a diary too?" Lu Yang asked curiously.
"Of course, with so many amusing things to record, naturally, I would keep a diary to note them down."
```
"What does the diary say?"
Fairy Eternity looked at Lu Yang warily, "How could a diary simply be shown to others?"
Lu Yang pursed his lips, his wariness quite strong, "It probably disappeared, after all, the diary has your strong personal touch, Fairy. It's not something that can be blamed on Yingtian Immortal by changing the name. Since the mastermind behind the scenes wants to erase your existence, naturally, the diary that proves your existence would also be erased."
Fairy Eternity became furious, "Damn it, I will avenge this indignation!"
The two Venerates trembled in fear, overwhelmed by fright, always feeling that the conversation between these two contained earth-shattering ancient secrets. Could it be that they would be silenced?
"Even my cultivation experience is gone?"
Fairy Eternity equally couldn't find her cultivation experience.
"It seems that too was erased by the person behind the scenes, after all, my talent is unparalleled. If I were to attribute my cultivation experience to Yingtian Immortal, it would seem too fake, as Yingtian Immortal doesn't possess such ability!"
Lu Yang looked at Fairy Eternity with a weird expression, "You have cultivation insights, Fairy?"
"Why not? I've written a thick book of insights, detailing everything from how to have fun to how to sleep comfortably, with thorough explanations. It not only references classic doctrines but also my personal experiences."
Lu Yang thought it was just as well that this cultivation experience was lost – it was better to lose a book than to lose face.
Yet, Eldest Senior Sister actually agreed with Fairy Eternity's view, "Predecessor has the heart of a child, which is truly rare. Especially after becoming an Immortal, to still be like a child is even more extraordinary. This cultivation experience must teach people how to maintain the heart of a child. Predecessor is so noble."
Fairy Eternity, as if finding a confidante, smiled so broadly her mouth wouldn't close, "Miss Yun, you really understand!"
Then Fairy Eternity turned her head and said fiercely to Lu Yang, "Did you hear that? This is called having the heart of a child. Learn a thing or two from me in the future!"
Lu Yang: "..."
Fairy Eternity waved her hand, "Miss Yun, pack up and let's move this Secret Realm back to our Sect."
Moving it back, she could stroll leisurely within the Secret Realm.
From the Twin River to the study, everything there was hers to move back – Great Xia couldn't object on any grounds.
"Alright."
The group left the Secret Realm, and it was now night, with the forest dark as pitch.
Eldest Senior Sister extended her right hand, pressed it against a boulder, and emitted a faint glow. When she withdrew her hand, a meandering river appeared in the palm of her hand.
This was the true Universe in Palm.
"Let's go."
With the matter resolved, the group headed back to Seek Dao Sect.
As they neared their destination, the two Venerates realized the place they were headed to was Seek Dao Sect.
Was the Ancient Heavenly Court hidden within Seek Dao Sect?
Or was it the case that Seek Dao Sect was originally established by the Ancient Heavenly Court?
Whichever it was would suffice to show the ingenious methods of the Ancient Heavenly Court.
First, Eldest Senior Sister left the Twin River Secret Realm next to the kitchen of Sky Gate Mountain, then she took the two Venerates to Captive Peak.
If she had not arrived in time, these two might really have succeeded in their plans to destroy Chunjiang City – they must not be let off.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou returned to their respective mountains.
"Miss Yun has arrived? Who did you catch this time?" the childlike sect master asked laughingly, having come to terms with it all. Being a senior as well as at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, he could not behave improperly just because a few ancient criminals were captured.
Eldest Senior Sister put the two on the ground and introduced their capture, "We caught two Semi-Immortals, one claims to be Nightmare Supreme, the other claims to be Void Venerate."
The childlike sect master covered his heart, almost unable to catch his breath.

chapters.title: Chapter 682 - 681: Old Acquaintance
chapters.content:
Last time, bringing the Phoenix Ancestor was one thing, but this time directly bringing two ancient Semi-Immortals to Captive Peak, huh?
I am at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, not an Immortal.
If this continues, he can hardly imagine what sort of formidable figures he might bring back next.
"Lu Yang again, that kid?" The Child Ancestor suddenly realized the source of the unending disturbances since his retirement.
"Junior Brother just happened to be at the scene."
The prisoners of Captive Peak let out a chorus of gasps.
In the past two years, the prisoners held in Captive Peak all had relations with this cultivator named Lu Yang.
Moreover, each prisoner had a more heaven-defying background than the last, first there was Emperor Yu, followed by Semi-Immortals contending for supremacy over the world. If Captive Peak could also be counted as a power, it would be on par with the Demon Nation.
The Demon Nation only had two Semi-Immortals.
In their lifetime, they never imagined they would see the two great Venerates contending for supremacy over the world.
Emperor Yu, Wu Youdao, looked away when he saw Nightmare Supreme; his gaze flickered.
As the sixth Emperor Yu, he was well aware of the formidable might of Nightmare Supreme; in the struggle of the ancestors for supremacy over the world, it was an undisputed fact that Nightmare Supreme was the most significant stumbling block.
"Nightmare stays here, I'll take Void out for a bit."
Eldest Senior Sister wasn't afraid that Nightmare could escape. She had already planted a thought seed within Nightmare Supreme. If he even entertained the idea of escape, the thought seed would grow and torment him to an existence worse than death.
Knowing about the thought seed, Grandmaster finally breathed a sigh of relief.
Void Venerate had no idea where Yun Zhi intended to take him, being carried by the scruff of his neck by Eldest Senior Sister. They sped through the air and ultimately arrived at their destination.
Imperial Palace of the Imperial City!
Void Venerate's eyes greened with envy in an instant.
If it wasn't for the Jiang Family and Meng Family, this place would have been his territory—no, the entire Great Xia would have been his!
Before reaching the Imperial Palace, Yun Zhi sent a message to Emperor Xia, asking him to clear his attendants.
Emperor Xia, who was dealing with memorials from Chunjiang City in Yangxin Hall, was initially startled but quickly understood and ordered the eunuchs and palace maids to leave.
Yun Zhi, holding Void Venerate by the collar, arrived at Yangxin Hall. Void Venerate, seeing Emperor Xia, who bore a slight resemblance to Jiang Pingan between his brows, was so angry that his breathing became unstable.
"I presume he is the Void Venerate who contended with my ancestor for dominion over the world?"
Emperor Xia scrutinized Void Venerate carefully, clicking his tongue in wonder; it was not easy to have a chance to meet the opponent of his great ancestor.
With Yun Zhi's strength on clear display, Void Venerate would be wary, but facing the descendant of his enemy, especially one with little talent in cultivation like Emperor Xia, Void Venerate was not so particular.
"It seems that Jiang Pingan has done many evils, such that his descendants barely have a few years to live!"
He instantly recognized Emperor Xia's frailty, which stemmed from the deficit in lifespan, and couldn't help but revel in schadenfreude.
Emperor Xia's complexion turned rather unsightly, this was his most painful issue.
Yun Zhi suddenly remembered that Fairy Eternity once mentioned that there exists a Heavenly Root in this world, resembling a peach tree, outside the category of heavenly materials and earthly treasures. The peaches born from the tree could prolong life, but its whereabouts were unknown.
And the secret realm where she had grown up, aside from the Mother-child River, also harbored innumerable peach trees.
Could it be that one of the trees in the secret realm was that so-called Heavenly Root?
If that were the case, Emperor Xia could be saved.
This matter was still uncertain, so there was no need to tell Emperor Xia and give him false hope.
Void Venerate's mood inexplicably improved quite a bit; originally he thought Sect Leader Yun brought him here to tease him, but now it seemed like it was to provide him with some entertainment.
Wait a minute, since Sect Leader Yun and this Emperor Xia knew each other, could it mean that Great Xia was colluding with the Ancient Heavenly Court?
Something felt quite wrong.
"Then I'll go ahead and take him in to meet someone," Yun Zhi said offhandedly, and upon hearing those words, Emperor Xia personally opened the door for Yun Zhi.
The Void Venerate was somewhat puzzled, why did she need to take him to see someone else?
Yun Zhi had no intention of explaining to the Void Venerate and instead, while holding onto him, they walked to the back courtyard of the Imperial Palace, a place referred to as "forbidden" by the palace maids and eunuchs.
Red walls, red doors, green tiles—these were the impressions the palace residents had of the forbidden area.
As for what the forbidden area actually looked like, why no one was permitted entry, and who exactly lived inside, that remained unknown.
The tall red doors were carved with two bronze demon beast heads, holding door knockers in their mouths, and Yun Zhi gently knocked three times on the knockers.
Clang, clang, clang.
The bronze demon beasts' sinister eyes lit up, and the door opened quietly without a sound.
Upon entering the forbidden area, the Void Venerate found that the inside was not as seen from the outside.
From the outside, the forbidden area showed no buildings, hills, or anything rising above the red palace walls.
But inside, the forbidden area was vast and boundless, with rivers and mountains all present, yet all were very low, with the tallest mountains only thirty to forty meters high, like small mounds.
The rivers were pitifully narrow and the lakes so small they resembled puddles formed after rain.
It was as if objects from the outside world had all shrunk upon entering this place; they were like giants walking through the world.
The more the Void Venerate looked at one of the mountains, the more familiar it seemed, "Wait, that mountain is Mount Tai'an, and next to it is Bamboo Forest Lake..."
As the Void Venerate matched the surrounding scenery one by one, he suddenly realized.
This was a miniaturized version of Great Xia!
"Let me see who Fellow Daoist Yun has brought here, ah, a familiar face."
A relatively young-sounding voice echoed from the horizon.
"This voice…" Upon hearing this voice, the Void Venerate's aura uncontrollably leaked out, filled with murderous intent.
The young man dressed in coarse hemp cloth, carrying a hoe, landed with a cheerful look and smiled brilliantly at the Void Venerate. His clean-cut appearance made it easy for others to feel affection for him.
"Void, it's been about a hundred thousand years since we last met, right?"
The Void Venerate, seeing the young man, wished to devour him whole; he would never forget that face in his lifetime: "Jiang Pingan, you're still alive!"
If it weren't for Jiang Pingan, he would have been the reigning emperor; Great Xia should have been his!
The youth's smile grew even wider: "If you're still alive, why can't I be?"
Jiang Pingan made a bowing gesture: "Fellow Daoist Yun, please let him go, with you and me here, he can't run away."
Yun Zhi released her grip, and the Void Venerate flipped in the air to land steadily on the ground.
"Void, I know you're not convinced, thinking that it was only because I and the gentleman fought two against one that we won against you."
The Meng Family's ancestor, Meng Gentleman.
"Actually, I alone could defeat you; it was merely faster to win against you with two people, that's all."
The Void Venerate sneered again and again, believing your ghost tales would be the real encounter with a ghost.
"Look, I'm not a cheater, and since we rarely meet, if you're so unconvinced, then let's have a real fight again. I won't ask anyone for help, how about that?"
"Fine!"
The Void Venerate agreed readily.
"Void Realm Descend!"
The Void Venerate shouted aloud, with a sly smile as if he had succeeded in his plot, opened the Void Realm, and enveloped the two of them into the Void Realm, while the Eldest Senior Sister brought out the Emperor's chair and waited by the side for the outcome.
It wasn't long before the Void Venerate could no longer smile.
"Jiang Pingan, did you damn well become an immortal!?"

chapters.title: Chapter 683 - 682: The Issue with Titles
chapters.content:
The Void Venerate was both shocked and furious, "You little brat Jiang Pingan, you really are shameless, aren't you? Even after becoming an immortal, you have the nerve to challenge me to a duel?"
"Duel my ass!"
Yun Zhi had only sat on the imperial chair for a short while when she saw the Void Realm shatter and the Void Venerate being beaten black and blue by Jiang Pingan, looking less than human.
Abilities like regenerating from severed limbs or resurrecting from a drop of blood all failed at this moment; the injuries of the Void Venerate visibly worsened at an alarming rate, failing to heal.
Thump.
The Void Venerate was thrown onto the ground, and Jiang Pingan let out a long breath, wiping the non-existent sweat from his forehead as if he had just been through a fierce battle.
"Void, this time I didn't use any tricks. It was a fair one-on-one duel, solely relying on real skills. You should be thoroughly convinced by your loss this time, right?"
After becoming an immortal, Jiang Pingan never had the chance to show off to someone he knew. He had waited for this opportunity for a hundred thousand years, only to realize it today.
Satisfying.
If not for the fact that the Void Venerate was in too much pain to even stand, he would have pounced on Jiang Pingan and bitten his neck off.
"This chair isn't bad at all, who made it?" Jiang Pingan took notice of the imperial chair Yun Zhi was sitting on. If not for his recent advocacy of a simple life, he would have wanted to make such a majestic chair for himself.
"It's a specialty of the Demon Territory, a gift from my junior brother."
"I remember your junior brother's name is Lu Yang?" Jiang Pingan rarely paid attention to the outside world, only recalling the name from casual conversations with Yun Zhi.
"That's right, I have high hopes for him. He's already brought me quite a few surprises. For instance, he played a part in capturing the Void Venerate this time. In the future struggles of the Great Era, he will surely have a place."
Jiang Pingan laughed, "I've never heard you speak so highly of anyone before."
Hearing that Lu Yang had helped capture the Void Venerate, Jiang Pingan took a liking to this cultivator he had never met.
"Actually, there is another person whose destiny is also extraordinary."
"Who?"
"A junior brother sent by the Meng Family."
Jiang Pingan clicked his tongue in wonder and envy, "Why can't our Jiang Family produce such talent."
Apart from himself, the ancient ancestor, the most talented in the current Jiang Family was Prince Jiang Qun, who achieved a Cultivation Level of the Body Integration Realm before a thousand years old, but still far from Yun Zhi's description of "extraordinary."
The Void Venerate, listening to their conversation, suddenly remembered the descendant of the Meng Family he saw in Chunjiang City.
Is it him?
What luck does Meng Gentleman have, to have such an outstanding descendant despite not being the best in character.
At that time, he only noticed that Meng Jingzhou was a descendant of the Meng Family and didn't pay attention to more details. With Yun Zhi's evaluation, one could tell that this descendant of the Meng Family must be a cultivation genius, at the very least, a Semi-Immortal like himself.
"What do you plan to do with the Void Venerate?"
"His heart is not in the right place, releasing him would be like releasing a tiger back to the mountain, a source of endless trouble. I plan to strip his physical body and suppress his soul at Captive Peak."
Unlike Semi-Immortals who were Immortal Eternity without a prior record and who had repentance in their hearts, the Void Venerate had only temporarily submitted to strength and couldn't be let go.
Jiang Pingan nodded; he had no objections to Yun Zhi's handling method. If it were him, he would make the same decision.
The Void Venerate was adamantly opposed to his rule, and letting him loose in the outside world could easily stir up trouble, unsettling the State Destiny and giving other forces an opportunity to exploit.
"There's another matter I'd like to hear your opinion on,"
"What is it?" Jiang Pingan was somewhat surprised; he noticed a faint frown on Yun Zhi's face as she spoke, an expression he had never seen before.
"I have a friend named Yun Mengmeng who recently discovered that she is not the birth child of her parents, but was born from a magic artifact created by an Immortal with the power to nurture life. Yun Mengmeng's mother gave birth to her through this magic artifact. How should she address this Immortal?"
Jiang Pingan hissed, he had lived for a hundred thousand years and had never heard of such a thing.
"I don't know." Jiang Pingan thought for a long time but couldn't figure out what the proper address should be.
Having achieved her purpose in coming to the Imperial Palace, Yun Zhi didn't stay any longer. Carrying the Void Venerate back to Captive Peak of Seek Dao Sect, she still had to interrogate the two Semi-Immortals.
Especially the Nightmare Supreme, a Semi-Immortal from the end of the Great Qian, certainly knew many secrets not known to others. Not to speak of distant matters, the situation of Twin River alone was previously unknown to Yun Zhi.
Jiang Pingan waved goodbye: "Take care, no need to send me off, I'll come to visit the prison when I get a chance!"
...
The atmosphere among the prisoners tensed up again upon seeing Yun Zhi return to Captive Peak.
Without a word, Yun Zhi pressed her hands on the foreheads of Nightmare Supreme and Void Venerate, and with a gentle pull, both felt their bodies lighten as their souls and bodies separated.
The child-like grandmaster dragged away the empty husks with a smile. They were good materials for refining magic artifacts.
Yun Zhi coldly looked at the two: "Now you have two choices, either tell me the intelligence you know truthfully, or don't even think about keeping your souls, which are just perfect for refining magic artifacts. Using the souls of Semi-Immortals as materials in magic artifact refining will also be a contribution to the Refining community."
Being experienced in reading people, both could tell at a glance that Yun Zhi wasn't bluffing.
"We'll tell everything."
Yun Zhi nodded her head, satisfied with their attitude, and locked them each in a segregated hut for individual interrogation.
She began with the interrogation of Nightmare Supreme.
"Where did you learn the information about Twin River?"
"I saw it in an ancient book, which not only recorded Twin River but also Mother-child River, though I only learned the location of Twin River, and don't know where Mother-child River is."
"Where did you get this ancient book?"
"After I led my army and broke through the imperial palace of Great Yu, I found it in the Imperial Library there."
The history books record that Nightmare Supreme broke into the imperial palace of Great Yu, self-declared as emperor, and the world, under the pretense of eradicating a rebel, fought for supremacy, ending up defeated by the rising Emperor Yu.
Great Yu was the dynasty closest to ancient times; the ancient books in its Imperial Library were probably more than all of the ancient books in the world combined.
"Where are the ancient books now?"
"They were burned after I memorized them," said Nightmare Supreme, quite nervous.
"Hmm?" As expected, Yun Zhi was not too satisfied with this answer.
Nightmare Supreme quickly explained, "It's true, my subordinates can testify. My thinking at the time was that even if I failed to conquer the world, with the knowledge in my head, my opponents would want to keep me alive for this intelligence."
Indeed, Emperor Yu and the Imperial Teacher considered this when they fought against Nightmare Supreme, refraining from delivering a fatal blow and giving him a chance to flee.
"What was the cultivation level of the first Emperor Yu and the first Imperial Teacher?"
"When they fought against me, they were definitely Semi-Immortals, but whether they became Immortals after that, I do not know."
"What do you mean?"
"After surviving the great battle, I didn't go into deep sleep right away but hid in the shadows to see how Wu Yao ascended the throne step by step."
Wu Yao, the first Emperor of Great Yu.
"Wu Yao presided over the founding ceremony, and during the event, there were changes in the winds and clouds, various natural phenomena emerged, and the sounds of thunder echoed continuously. The whole sky and earth were illuminated by Thunder Tribulation.
Although the historians wrote that this was a sign that Wu Yao's establishment of the Great Yu Dynasty aligned with the will of heaven and earth due to his brilliant and heroic qualities, I suspect it was the Celestial Tribulation of ascension to Immortality mentioned in the ancient books!"

chapters.title: Chapter 684 - 683: Wu Yao
chapters.content:
It's quite common to artificially create a grandiose presence at a nation's founding ceremony—be it Great Qian, Great Yu or even Great Xia had made no small stir during their own founding ceremonies.
If one were to trace the source, it could be traced back to Immortal Jiuchong's ascension to immortality.
Therefore, neither Yun Zhi nor Jiang Pingan paid too much attention to the founding ceremony.
Unexpectedly, Wu Yao chose to use the founding ceremony as an opportunity to pass his immortal tribulation and ascend to immortality.
Originally, Nightmare Supreme, relying on his status as a semi-immortal, believed that even if he were defeated by Wu Yao and the Imperial Teacher by chance, so what? He still had the chance to make a comeback.
But he never considered that Wu Yao might have become an immortal.
The mere possibility of Wu Yao becoming an immortal was enough to make him beat a hasty retreat, not even daring to probe.
If he probed, he would give Wu Yao the opportunity to capture him in return, which would be a loss not worth the risk.
Better to slumber in the shadows, collecting different dreams from various eras, and ultimately ascend to immortality himself.
Unfortunately, he perished mid-journey, becoming a prisoner, unable to even preserve his own body.
"Wu Yao has become an immortal?"
Eldest Senior Sister was somewhat puzzled; if this were true, it would lead to another question:
Semi-immortals slumbering until now before awakening implies that their lifespans are not sufficient, but an immortal's lifespan is infinite, with no need to slumber.
If Wu Yao had become an immortal, why would he watch idly as Great Yu fell, replaced by Great Xia?
You should know that in the last days of Great Yu, the strongest was Void Venerate who was locked up next door. Not even an immortal was present, and Wu Yao, with absolute power, could definitely have extended the lifespan of the Great Yu Dynasty.
But he didn't, why?
Not taking action under such circumstances must indicate he had some scheme, it's just that for the moment, Wu Yao's purpose is unknown.
An immortal lurking in the shadows is bad news for Great Xia—the two semi-immortals present were capable of throwing Great Xia into utter chaos, let alone an immortal.
"What Dao Fruit does Wu Yao possess?"
Since they considered Wu Yao an enemy hidden in darkness, it was essential to know the enemy to make further plans.
"I'm not clear on what Dao Fruit it is, but I do know the outline of his Dao Fruit," said Nightmare Supreme truthfully.
"Let's hear it."
"His Dao Fruit outline is known as the Exchange Dao Fruit Outline; it can be understood as equivalent exchange or sacrifice. One can obtain concrete things through exchange, such as magic artifacts, spiritual plants, or a single powerful attack, as well as intangibles, such as fate or causality. It's very complex to use."
"Once it becomes a full Dao Fruit, I don't know to what extent he can utilize it."
"What moves does Wu Yao have?"
"He knows many tricks; flashy ones. Even when he enters into dreams, he can rely on those moves to fight several bouts with me. For instance, there's the Mystical Six-A Technique, which can command ghosts and spirits, perform exorcisms and divination of the past, present, and future."
"Like the Erect Shadowless technique, which allows him to enter an ethereal state, rendering all attacks ineffective, its efficacy comparable to a fully-realized Pure Immortal Body."
"He also has the Six Divine Abilities of Buddhism—I remember him displaying the Heavenly Eye Technique, Heavenly Ear Technique, and Divine Foot. I don't know whether he has mastered the remaining three."
"Oh right, he can also employ the Eradication Immortal Sword Array. Once activated, every being within the bounds of the sword array becomes involuntarily submissive to its power. I accidentally fell for this trick myself—it's extremely formidable."
"It's said that this sword array is inspired by the techniques of ancient immortals, with an astonishingly great origin."
Eldest Senior Sister: "..."
...
Outside, the battle that took place in Chunjiang City was spreading through the Cultivation World at a terrifying speed.
The disappearance and reappearance of Chunjiang City were undeniable facts.
The emergence and clash of two ancient supremes terrified anyone who heard of it.
The powerful ancients recorded in history appeared alive before their very eyes, as if time had flowed backward, causing a sense of confusion and attracting much attention.
Moreover, the most mysterious Sect Leader Yun of the Heavenly Court Sect finally made a move, facing two adversaries alone and exhibiting power beyond that of a Semi-Immortal!
Sect Leader Yun is actually an Immortal!
Although due to the characteristics of immortals, everyone couldn't remember the details of the battle, the memory of her introducing herself and defeating the two ancient supremes was preserved.
In every street and alley, teahouses and winehouses, those with a bit of cultivation level were discussing this matter.
The Qin Heart Winehouse was the largest winehouse in several nearby cities, with a Nascent Soul Stage Spirit Chef in charge, whose signature dish "Qingfeng Ballad" was so delicious that its aroma wafted for ten miles.
Usually, as soon as the food arrived at the table, the diners would be eager to taste it with their chopsticks.
But today, after the food was served, the cultivators at the table were still fervently discussing the matters of Chunjiang City.
"Have you heard about what happened in Chunjiang City? Something big happened!"
"Who doesn't know about Chunjiang City, where two Semi-Immortals clashed? Someone consulted ancient texts and confirmed that those two were none other than Nightmare Supreme and Void Venerate!"
Cultivators who were unaware of the situation gasped in shock upon hearing these names, not even paying attention to the food that had been placed before them: "My God, is that Nightmare Supreme the one who annihilated the Great Qian Dynasty?"
"Is Void Venerate the one who fought with our ancestors for supremacy over the world?"
"Yes, those two. They shifted Chunjiang City to another space and then, for some unknown reason, started fighting. Even the seasoned Transcendance Tribulation Stage One Qi Venerable of the Control Qi Sect was no match for them!"
"So who won between them?"
The storyteller smiled and shook his head, refusing to continue: "Loan me your magic artifact for a couple of days."
The listener, eager and impatient, didn't want to lend the magic artifact but also wanted to hear the rest of the story. He hesitated for a moment, then gritted his teeth and said, "I'll lend it!"
"Neither of them won."
"How is that possible?"
"Why wouldn't it be possible, the Heavenly Court Sect has intervened."
"Was it Heavenly Venerate Dou? The only one who could stop the fight between two supremes, suspected to be an Immortal, must be Heavenly Venerate Dou, right?"
This time, the storyteller cultivator didn't keep them in suspense: "It was Sect Leader Yun of the Heavenly Court Sect. Although the details of the battle haven't been revealed, what's certain is that Sect Leader Yun captured both supremes!"
The cultivators at the dining table were so shocked by this news that they were at a loss for words: "How, how could this be possible, unless Sect Leader Yun is, is..."
"An Immortal!" another companion said.
"Doesn't that mean the Heavenly Court Sect has two Immortals?"
A cultivator swallowed hard: "Gosh, no wonder they're an ancient major power, they reveal two Immortals at once."
"Exactly, now people are saying that the Heavenly Court Sect is the current number one power."
In a corner, three guests were leisurely enjoying their signature dish "Qingfeng Ballad," seemingly oblivious to the discussion around them.
"Elder, are you still satisfied with your meal?" Daoist Buyu asked cautiously, while Gold Clan Leader looked at Jiang Lianyi, full of expectation.
Jiang Lianyi wiped her lips and commented indifferently: "Mediocre, not as good as what I can make."
Daoist Buyu complained inwardly; ever since Jiang Lianyi had beaten them up, she had been following them around, and they neither dared to ditch her nor send her away.
Their fraudulent business had not been in operation for a long time.
Among the three, only Gold Clan Leader was shocked by the fact that "Sect Leader Yun is an Immortal," but Jiang Lianyi didn't care, and he didn't dare to appear overly concerned either.
Jiang Lianyi, who had fought Yun Zhi to a standstill, certainly knew Yun Zhi's cultivation level.
"It's a pity, if I had followed Elder Brother Lu Yang at that time, I would have had the chance to confront a future Semi-Immortal."

chapters.title: Chapter 685 - 684: Transcendence and Omniscience
chapters.content:
Sky Gate Mountain.
The wondrous sound of a zither, ding ding dong dong, was melodious and flowing, like the clear babbling of a brook beside the ear, light and airy as if from the soft clouds deep within, bringing an indescribable comfort to all the meridians of the body.
Lu Yang lay lazily in the grass, using his hands as a pillow, with a blade of foxtail grass in his mouth. Listening to his Third Senior Sister's zither music, he felt the fatigue from his trip to Chunjiang City vanish almost entirely.
While listening to the Third Senior Sister's zither music, Lu Yang picked a lotus seed from a plate and tossed it into his mouth.
If there were a connoisseur around, they would recognize these as seeds of the Twin Lotus; the surface of the Twin River was covered with them, and Lu Yang had plucked several lotus heads when he left.
The Third Senior Sister was truly a cultivator skilled in music. Lu Yang didn't know much about this and couldn't make sense of the musical scales and modes, but just as an ordinary person listening, it was already very soothing.
"Senior Sister, what's the name of this piece you're playing?"
The Third Senior Sister stopped the strings, and the music ceased, giving way to silence around them, "This is an ancient piece given to me by Elder Lianyi, called 'Phoenix Perches by the Stream.' It was created by the elder during a moment of inspiration while resting by a stream."
Jiang Lianyi wielded a jade flute as her weapon, unrivaled in the realm of music.
Even the Fairy Eternity, who always strived to be the first, had to concede defeat.
"Senior Sister, how did you come to be a disciple of our master?" Lu Yang asked curiously.
The Third Senior Sister sighed rarely, "My parents were just Gold Core Period Cultivators and didn't know much about our sect. The entrance test back then was organized by our master, who saw I had an exceptional talent and wanted to take me as his disciple."
"At the time, I didn't know what kind of person our master was, I just knew he was the sect leader."
"Since the sect leader wanted to take me in, of course I was willing."
"I never expected that, after just two lessons, the teaching location would change."
"To where?"
"To the prison. During that time, Eldest Senior Sister was in seclusion, and the Second Senior Brother had gone to the Buddha Country. I could only take advantage of the times I went to visit the prison to have lessons with master. It was truly hard studying, and the people in the jail praised me for being a filial daughter when they saw me."
"Thankfully, after Eldest Senior Sister left seclusion, the learning environment improved significantly."
"Eldest Senior Sister taught you?"
The Third Senior Sister shook her head, "Eldest Senior Sister acted as a guarantor to get our master out. She is not skilled in music, so she couldn't teach me."
"Master himself knows music?"
"He does, and he's even more skilled than me. He can play the sword and sing at the same time, producing a variety of sounds and imitate the sounds of different musical instruments. It's said that he developed these skills in his youth while doing storytelling, playing music on the side to enhance the entertainment."
Lu Yang hadn't expected his master to have such a high level of skill.
The Third Senior Sister continued to play, and Lu Yang enjoyed the zither music until discordant sounds disrupted his peaceful mind state.
Fairy Eternity huffed coldly, offended that Lu Yang had underestimated her, "Who says I do not understand the way of music? The pieces I play inspire people."
"You know the way of music, Fairy? I've never heard you play before," Lu Yang said, his respect temporarily elevated due to Fairy Eternity finding the Twin River, thus addressing her more honorably by changing from "you" to "you."
"The music I play is not something a mere Nascent Soul Stage cultivator has the privilege to hear."
"When I play my music, I do not use an Immortal Artifact, but instead use the essence of the Dao as the strings, making heaven and earth tremble, resonating with the great Dao. The pieces carry a majestic presence, revering all through the ages. Those who listen cannot help but tremble with excitement."
Now even more curious, Lu Yang asked, "So how do you play it?"
"Self-destruct."
"...No wonder the body was trembling."
"Speaking of which, didn't you have time to self-destruct when you were being assassinated, Fairy?"
According to Fairy Eternity's temperament, her first reaction should have been to self-destruct, which would both injure the assailant and save her own life.
"Now that you mention it, that does make sense. Why didn't I self-destruct?"
Fairy Eternity frowned and bowed her head, trying to recall the events of that time, but everything remained chaotic. She was unsure whether it was due to the methods used by the hidden assailant or her own condition at the time.
"Damn it, if I hadn't encountered trouble back then, I would have already broken through to a level above that of an Immortal!"
"Immortal Jiuchong became the first amongst the Immortals. It should have been my turn to be the first."
Lu Yang felt invigorated when he heard this subject, even forgetting to eat the lotus seeds by his mouth: "Is this the breakthrough to a realm above Immortals that you mentioned before? The one where you sever all causality and advance your cultivation?"
Fairy Eternity rolled her eyes: "That's what Immortal Jiuchong and his ilk theorize. I advocate that the more causality one has, the higher their cultivation can be, which is how one truly breaks through."
"According to the theory held by Immortal Jiuchong and the others, the realm above Immortals is called 'Transcendence,' untouched by all causality and existing beyond everything."
"According to my theory, the realm above Immortals is called 'Omniscience,' connected to all things in the world, reaching a state of omniscience and omnipotence, perfectly matching my intelligence and wisdom!"
Lu Yang appraised Fairy Eternity from head to toe. After returning to the Seek Dao Sect, the grandiose palace in the spiritual space disappeared, reverting to the simple room decoration.
As Fairy Eternity explained about the realm above Immortals, she was rolling around and talking, with disheveled hair, her clothes in disarray, giggling and laughing, a sight hard to associate with words like "intelligence" or "omniscience."
Fairy Eternity grabbed her little feet with both hands and, grunting, sat up cross-legged like a Weeble, swaying from side to side: "It would be great if my cultivation insights were still here. Maybe I could remember what happened back then."
"By the way, I suggest you hold the plate and run far away now, so you can keep the lotus seeds in the plate," Fairy Eternity suddenly said.
Lu Yang was surprised: "What do you mean?"
The sound of the qin ceased, and Third Senior Sister suddenly said to Lu Yang: "Junior Brother, hurry and distance yourself from here, your Senior Sister is about to have a breakthrough."
As she spoke, dark clouds gathered above Sky Gate Mountain, with the distant sound of thunder beginning to rumble.
Lu Yang quickly realized—Third Senior Sister was about to break through to the Void Refinement Stage, and the thunderstorm she had summoned was her Thunder Tribulation!
After reaching the Nascent Soul Stage, every subsequent realm breakthrough would invite a Thunder Tribulation—it was a rule set by Ying Tian Immortal!
Run!
Without a word, Lu Yang abandoned even the lotus seeds on his plate and sprinted down the mountain!
Having just read "Discourses of Immortals," he was now most fearful of encountering a Thunder Tribulation!
Lu Yang was fast, but Invincible Nascent Soul was even faster, quickly outpacing Lu Yang.
Lu Yang: "..."
When Invincible Nascent Soul reached the foot of the mountain and stopped running, Lu Yang also halted, understanding this to be the safest place as deemed by Invincible Nascent Soul.
"Why suddenly have a breakthrough?"
"It's not really sudden. This young lady was performing the 'Phoenix Perching on the Stream' gifted by Elder Lianyi. Unlike my self-destructive technique, this tune soothes the mind state. As her realm in the Void Refinement Stage fluctuated, this piece was perfect for stabilizing her state, and given she was already on the cusp of a breakthrough, this occurrence is well within reason."

chapters.title: Chapter 686 - 685: Immortal Dao Heavenly Eye
chapters.content:
"Is someone about to make a breakthrough?"
"Judging by the direction of the Thunder Tribulation clouds, is it Sky Gate Mountain?"
"Is Eldest Senior Sister about to break through?"
"What nonsense are you spouting; would Eldest Senior Sister's breakthrough cause such a small commotion?"
"Could it be the Sect Leader?"
"How long has the Sect Leader not returned?"
"Junior Brother Lu...no, that's not right, he just broke through to the Nascent Soul Stage."
"It's Gan Tian Senior Sister!"
Disciples and elders of the Seek Dao Sect all noticed the Thunder Tribulation clouds above Sky Gate Mountain. River Spirit poked its head out from the river's surface, looking up at Sky Gate Mountain. It temporarily created a gap in the Sect Protection Array, allowing the Thunder Tribulation to pass through.
With the Sect Protection Array in place, the Thunder Tribulation would strike not Gan Tian, but the Sect Protection Array itself.
This was considered external interference with the Thunder Tribulation, and its power would only grow stronger. Even the Sect Protection Array might be damaged by it.
Lu Yang retracted his Invincible Nascent Soul, unable to deny that the little thing was indeed fast. Despite Lu Yang's best efforts, he hadn't been able to catch up, resigning to be the runner-up.
Gradually, spectators gathered at the foot of Sky Gate Mountain.
Even within the Seek Dao Sect, opportunities to observe someone breaking through to the Void Refinement Stage were rare, and each instance would attract a crowd eager to watch and learn.
"Junior Brother Lu, who is breaking through?"
"Third Senior Sister."
"So it really is Gan Tian Senior Sister."
Disciples of Dao Seeking Sect, various elders, and eventually even the small vendor selling mutton kebabs all arrived.
"This makes the fifth disciple to cultivate to the Body Integration Realm, right?" Fourth Elder said with a smile.
Yun Zhi, Ye Zijin, Dai Bufan, along with Fourth Elder's eldest disciple Ji Hongwen.
"Wow, it's quite a spectacle; even my uncle's breakthrough to the Void Refinement Stage wasn't this grand," Meng Jingzhou exclaimed. He had seen his uncle's breakthrough, but he was young at the time and had only caught a glimpse of the event, not even clearly understanding the type of Thunder Tribulation.
He had been telling Old Ma about the exciting experiences in Chunjiang City when he saw something happening on Sky Gate Mountain and hurried over to join the excitement.
A deep, serene voice arose from behind Lu Yang and company: "I was just looking for you two."
The two turned abruptly, only to see Dai Bufan with an insincere smile.
Heaven knew what Dai Bufan felt when he saw the news about Chunjiang City; it was only twenty miles away from the black market he had told Meng Jingzhou about!
And to think they had vowed not to cause trouble for half a year?
However, after reading the report, Dai Bufan knew that this matter really couldn't be blamed on Lu Yang and company.
But could you two cause any more trouble?
"Keep yourselves in line for the upcoming months. We'll be recruiting new disciples soon, and you two should set a good example," Dai Bufan warned them.
The two honest people nodded vigorously.
"Look, the Thunder Tribulation is about to descend," Lu Yang shouted, pointing to the sky above.
The azure-purple Thunder Tribulation looked like towering waves, an oppressively dark mass tilting down, twisting space into a tangled twist.
Third Senior Sister stood right beneath the Thunder Tribulation, unflinchingly still, without any intention of even taking off her eye mask.
Dai Bufan commented from the side, "Gan Senior Sister is quite confident, huh? Her eyes are extraordinary—they're a lethal weapon. She isn't planning to take off her mask even during the Thunder Tribulation. It looks like she's prepared to tough it out."
"What's so different about Third Senior Sister's eyes?" Lu Yang inquired.
"Those are the legendary Heavenly Eyes of an Immortal, said to be possessed only by Immortals. They can see through the Demon Race's true form, ghosts and spirits, emit golden light, move mountains and split stones, break waves and cut through tides. What other mysteries they hold, I do not know," he explained.
"Fairy, have you ever heard of the Heavenly Eyes of an Immortal?" Lu Yang asked the great Fairy Eternity, turning to her after speaking to Elder Brother Dai.
"The lad surnamed Dai is right; she indeed possesses the Heavenly Eye of the immortal path. To say it's an actual immortal's eye is an exaggeration, for this girl hardly has the cultivation level strong enough to bear an immortal's eye." The moment Fairy Eternity first laid eyes on the Third Senior Sister, she knew that her eyes were of the Heavenly Eye of the immortal path.
Covering one's eyes with a black cloth could not escape the perception of immortals.
"The Heavenly Eye of the immortal path does have extraordinary traits. You could think of it as a special constitution, similar to an immortal body. Cultivators who possess the Heavenly Eye are indeed very powerful," she said.
As they spoke, the Thunder Tribulation descended, and without relying on any magic artifact, the Third Senior Sister contended against the Thunder Tri bulation with her physical body alone, making Lu Yang's scalp tingle from the crackling sounds.
"This is the best way to Pass Tribulation, using magic artifacts to pass is considered inferior, using the force of the Thunder Tribulation to temper the body is the right path, at the very least that's how the Yingtian Immortal originally designed it," she asserted.
The power of the Thunder Tribulation surged in an instant, catching the Third Senior Sister off guard. A trickle of blood flowed from the corner of her mouth, quickly engulfed by the raging tribulation.
Fortunately, this wave of the Thunder Tribulation was over, with the sudden surge marking its end.
"Be careful, there's another wave of Thunder Tribulation coming!"
An Azure Dragon composed of lightning coiled in the sky, its five claws extraordinarily sharp, capable of shattering the space with a mere clench.
Dai Bufan spoke with a worried face, "This is bad, this must be the Nine Heavens Azure Dragon Tribulation, said to be a Thunder Tribulation fashioned by the heavens and earth using the Dragon Clan Ancestor as a template."
This basically meant the might of the Dragon Clan Ancestor was acknowledged by the heavens and the earth, leaving an eternal imprint in the world.
In truth, Lu Yang knew that it wasn't about the heavens and earth giving recognition, but rather the Yingtian Immortal directly using his younger sister as the manifestation of the Thunder Tribulation.
The common folk were unaware that the Yingtian Immortal governed the Thunder Tribulation, believing the current tribulation was a test bestowed by the heavens and earth.
It must be said, such a notion would definitely align with the Yingtian Immortal's wishes.
Pluck, pluck, strum, strum.
The vibrations of the strings resonated, and clear sounds emerged as if trickling water manifested before everyone's eyes.
Suddenly, a golden Phoenix appeared from nowhere, as if born from the melodies, soaring straight up to battle the Nine Heavens Azure Dragon Tribulation.
This scene provoked a chorus of exclamations from the crowd: "A clash between Dragon and Phoenix, a spectacle unseen for a millennium!"
"Is this the reward Eldest Senior Sister Gan Tian received in the Demon Territory?"
"Cultivation has always been symbolic. Could this mean that Eldest Senior Sister Gan Tian, like the Dragon and Phoenix, will soar between heaven and earth to become a supremely powerful being?"
"Very likely!"
Lu Yang silently watched everything, making no comment.
He looked back and forth yet felt it resembled less a struggle between Dragon and Phoenix, and more like the Qilin Immortal's wives in a domestic squabble.
The battle between the Dragon and Phoenix concluded, and both disappeared.
Without giving the Third Senior Sister a moment to breathe, a cage-like black lightning descended, sealing off her escape routes.
"The Prison Descends, this is bad, it's the Inner Demon Tribulation!" Dai Bufan's expression changed. When the Inner Demon Tribulation descended, a cage would lock all paths. There was no retreat; it must be passed!
Dai Bufan looked anxiously at Gan Tian, who was trapped by the Inner Demon Tribulation.
The Inner Demon Tribulation would block all external information; no reminders could be given, and she could only rely on herself!
"Senior Brother, what's the Inner Demon Tribulation like?" Lu Yang had yet to Pass the Inner Demon Tribulation.
Dai Bufan spoke gravely, "During the Inner Demon Tribulation, you'll encounter the person you love, perhaps your best friend, your partner, your elder, or someone you cannot forget. Even if you realize they're just Inner Demons, facing those who are indistinguishable from real people, you'll still find it hard to strike!"
Figures of the Inner Demon Tribulation began to emerge within the prison.
Holding a horsetail whisk, radiating an immortal presence and the demeanor of a sage.
"Master?"
Lu Yang had a peculiar expression, thinking how his master's appearance in the prison didn't seem out of place at all.
"I wonder if the Third Senior Sister can bring herself to strike against Master?"
Just as Lu Yang was worrying for the Third Senior Sister, he saw her with no hesitation whatsoever, grabbing the ancient zither to smash against Daoist Buyu, then removing the black cloth covering her eyes to reveal a pair of sacred and profound eyes, from which golden light burst forth!

chapters.title: Chapter 687 - 687: 786 True Lord Gan Tian
chapters.content:
Above Sky Gate Mountain, Third Senior Sister held nothing back, unleashing the Heavenly Eye of Immortal Dao—a power she hadn't even used in the Demon Territory—at the moment she saw Daoist Buyu.
Boom!
Daoist Buyu, incarnated as an Inner Demon, hadn't even reacted before the golden light from the Heavenly Eye of Immortal Dao severed one of his arms, significantly reducing his combat power!
Third Senior Sister pressed her advantage, her beautiful eyes blood-red, a sign that the Heavenly Eye of Immortal Dao was being pushed to its limit.
A thicker, more incisive beam of golden light shot out, and as Daoist Buyu, now an incarnation of an Inner Demon, hastily rolled to the side, Third Senior Sister violently turned her head to relentlessly pursue and pound him.
"Hiss—" Down below, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou both took a sharp breath. Third Senior Sister was showing no mercy at all.
"No wonder Third Senior Sister dared to venture into the Demon Territory alone. With this move, I guess there aren't many at the Body Integration Realm who'd dare to resist."
"This is the advantage of being Old Nine's disciple," the Fourth Elder behind them sighed. "When facing an Inner Demon tribulation, there's absolutely no holding back."
"Just like how Ye Zijin passed it back then."
"But having said that, the Heavenly Eye of Immortal Dao is truly powerful. It's comparable to special physiques of Immortal bodies and truly not to be underestimated."
The Inner Demon tribulation is a formidable obstacle for cultivation practitioners, but once one becomes a disciple of Daoist Buyu, there is no fear of the Inner Demon tribulation.
The Inner Demon tribulation can also manifest one's parents, but since Third Senior Sister's parents were only at the Golden Core Stage, it would be too unbelievable for them to exert Body Integration Realm power in the Inner Demon tribulation, making them unsuitable as a test for her.
Lu Yang: "..."
He wasn't afraid of his master appearing in the Inner Demon tribulation now; he was afraid that it wasn't his master who would appear.
"To think that Third Junior Sister's Inner Demon tribulation is the same as the Second Junior Brother's—it's our master," Eldest Senior Sister's voice sounded beside Lu Yang, startling him.
"Eldest Senior Sister, when did you get here?"
Eldest Senior Sister looked at Lu Yang with a rather strange expression: "It's only natural for me to come out and watch when Third Junior Sister is passing her tribulation."
"Have the two demi-immortals been judged yet?"
"Not yet, those two know many secrets, and it will take more than a short time to interrogate them. However, we've already made a lot of progress, such as finding the original owner of the 'Immortal Sword Array' you've learned."
"Who is it?" Lu Yang remembered it was Eldest Senior Sister who killed the owner of the sword array. Given the circumstances at that time, capturing them alive was difficult, so they were killed, hence the identity of the sword array owner was unknown.
"The first Emperor Yu, Wu Yao."
"What the heck?"
Lu Yang was briefly stunned by this revelation.
Seeing that Lu Yang didn't hear clearly, Eldest Senior Sister repeated it.
"The first Emperor Yu, Wu Yao."
Lu Yang certainly heard it; he just hadn't processed it yet.
The founding emperor of Great Yu was thus quietly slain by Eldest Senior Sister?
What a disgrace to call yourself an Immortal!
Even Fairy Eternity was stronger than you.
"Senior Brother Lu, Senior Brother Meng, it's been a long time," a pleasant voice arose, laced with a touch of joy. They turned around to see it was Tao Yaoye.
"Junior Sister Tao, it's been a long time indeed."
It really had been a long time; from the journey to the Demon Territory to the battle in Chunjiang City, it had been more than half a year since they last saw each other.
Cultivation knows not the passing of years, and truly it is not just idle talk.
Tao Yaoye had become even more beautiful, standing gracefully like a jade statue, her delicate smile enchanting, her tenderness flowing like water, appearing like a banished fairy. Just her presence alone was a scene to behold.
"Have you made progress with your Feather Transformation Immortal Body?"
Lu Yang remembered that before going to the Demon Territory, he had invited Tao Yaoye, but unfortunately, she was in the midst of a critical period of comprehending the Feather Transformation Immortal Body and could not leave.
Now, it looked like not only had she successfully comprehended the Feather Transformation Immortal Body, but she had also broken through to the Nascent Soul Stage, and her entire temperament was different from before.
Tao Yaoye was delighted that Senior Brother Lu had noticed her transformation, her eyes curving into smiling crescents, "Yes."
She heard that Senior Brother Lu had returned from the Demon Territory and had been wanting to meet him, but she couldn't find the opportunity until Gan Tian passed her tribulation, gathering all the disciples, and finally giving her the chance to see Senior Brother Lu.
The Feather Transformation Immortal Body is a type of immortal physique which allows one to borrow power from one's future self. During the process of borrowing power, one's body will transform, becoming as pure and exalted as an immortal.
At the beginning of the establishment of the cultivation system, those with the Feather Transformation Immortal Body borrowed light from the future that turned into feathers, resembling ascension to immortality. Therefore, the ancients called this process "Feathered Ascension to Immortality," hence the name Feather Transformation Immortal Body.
But the transformation is not without cost; apart from falling into a lengthy period of weakness after the "Feathering," due to borrowing power from the future, that future self becomes weak. If, at that future moment, one is engaged in battle, it results in a sure-death situation, which is why generations of Feather Transformation Immortal Bodies do not use this ability lightly.
"This girl's talent is quite something, I reckon she might be stronger than another Feather Transformation Immortal Body I've encountered," the Fairy Eternity mused.
