"Fairy, you've also encountered a Feather Transformation Immortal Body?" Lu Yang thought about it and realized it made sense; in the ancient Great Era, with geniuses clashing, all sorts of physiques would emerge.
"Indeed, that guy was some Saint Heir from a holy land, can't remember his name, had a pretty face but was truly unprincipled. He was jealous because the Fairy, at the time, was well-known and wanted to use me to gain fame."
"As a result, he overestimated himself and got soundly defeated by me. Seeing he couldn't beat me, ah, he got desperate and activated his Feather Transformation Immortal Body, borrowing strength from his future self, and his realm surged explosively from the peak of the Nascent Soul Stage to the Void Refinement Stage!"
Lu Yang: "..."
Without the Fairy continuing, he could roughly guess what happened next.
As they reminisced, the Inner Demon masquerading as Daoist Buyu was defeated, the Thunder Tribulation dissipated, and Third Senior Sister's realm stabilized at the Body Integration Realm.
She became the fifth among the disciples to attain the position of a Great Power upon reaching Body Integration.
The crowd congratulated her upon seeing this.
Dai Bufan stepped forward to offer his congratulations with a fist salute, "Congratulations to Junior Sister Gan Tian, from now on we can address you as True Lord Gan!"
"Junior Sister Gan Tian is remarkable indeed."
"Senior Sister Gan, you're so amazing!"
"Senior Sister, your eyes are shining!"
Third Senior Sister thanked everyone one by one, neither arrogant nor impetuous as she covered her eyes again.
Eldest Senior Sister stepped in front of Gan Tian and said, "Alright, Third Junior Sister has just broken through and needs to calm her mind and consolidate her realm."
Though Eldest Senior Sister spoke softly, no one dared to ignore her words. After everyone had offered their congratulations, they obediently left.
The Elders saw that Gan Tian had successfully passed her tribulation without any mishaps, so they too left.
With the tribulation over, River Spirit closed the gap in the Sect Protection Array.
"It's a pity about this zither," Third Senior Sister said, caressing the charred ancient zither with a touch of heartache. It had been struck several times while she was dealing with the tribulation of the Inner Demon, and its strings were completely broken.
"Don't worry, now that you also reached the Body Integration Realm, I will find suitable materials and craft you a new one as a congratulatory gift," Eldest Senior Sister said indifferently.
The two Venerates had shared the locations of their treasure troves, and the collection of a Semi-Immortal was truly bountiful; among it, there would certainly be materials better suited for crafting a zither.
Actually, the best material for crafting a zither would be the Time Immortal, but Eldest Senior Sister felt it would be disrespectful to use the remains of such a venerated predecessor and thus didn't bring it up.

chapters.title: Chapter 688 - 687: Reversing Yin and Yang, Defying Fate!
chapters.content:
"Should we break off a branch from Time Immortal to craft a zither?" Fairy Eternity suggested, of course, through mental transmission. She didn't say it out loud—Gan Tian was still unaware of Fairy Eternity's existence.
Time Immortal's body was vast, with even a single branch being five or six chi thick.
"Wouldn't this be disrespectful to Elder Time?" Eldest Senior Sister hesitated.
Fairy Eternity didn't care at all: "Oh, what's all this about respect or disrespect? Time Immortal often uses parts of his own body to refine tools."
"Branches and leaves are just like Time Immortal's hair, using one to refine a tool is nothing."
"He uses parts of his own body to refine tools even when there's nothing else to do."
When it comes to the best refining materials, there's nothing better than Time Immortal, the oldest being in existence. What material could possibly compare to his body?
"Immortal Jiuchong also considered using his own body for refining."
"Doesn't he wield the power of the Yin-Yang Dao Fruit, which represents change? Yin and Yang complement each other, spawning endless creation and shaping fate. He can create life through the power of the Dao Fruit."
"Originally, he wanted to pull out one of his ribs to create life, but then he started to wonder whether the result would be his sibling or his son or daughter, and that troubled him so much that he ultimately gave up on the idea."
Lu Yang: "..."
Are the customs of you ancient folks all so fierce?
"Eh, speaking of which, I might have a way to improve little Meng's situation," Fairy Eternity mused, suddenly inspired by a spark of ingenuity.
"Improve what?"
"Have you ever heard of reversing Yin and Yang, defying the heavens to change fate?"
Lu Yang had a vague impression—it seemed to be an incredibly powerful Great Divine Skill.
"Right, it's a Great Divine Skill that can defy the heavens and change fate, but it can only be used on oneself, not on others."
"If little Meng knew this skill, perhaps he could change his Single Body Spirit Root constitution and even possibly improve his luck."
"Fairy, you know this skill?"
"Of course I do. Here, I'll teach it to both of you. Whether you can learn it depends on your own ability."
Lu Yang couldn't close his grinning mouth at the prospect of learning such an impressive Divine Ability.
Lu Yang shared Fairy Eternity's idea with Eldest Senior Sister, who also thought it feasible. The only issue was that the skill was so difficult to learn that it couldn't be mastered in the Nascent Soul Stage.
"We can try it."
"Senior, tell us how you perform this skill, and we'll compare notes." Eldest Senior Sister also knew this skill but hadn't thought it could be used on Meng Jingzhou.
"Okay."
They communicated their knowledge quickly through Spiritual Sense, and after confirming that they both understood the same Divine Ability, Eldest Senior Sister felt reassured.
After Gan Tian entered the Body Integration Realm and went into seclusion to consolidate her realm, only Eldest Senior Sister, Lu Yang, and Meng Jingzhou—who had been carried away by the crowd but later called back by Lu Yang—were left on Sky Gate Mountain.
Upon learning the news, Meng Jingzhou was overjoyed.
Had the heavens finally taken pity, allowing him the chance to turn his luck around and defy destiny?
Lu Yang spoke earnestly, "If you're grateful, you can kowtow twice to me, and I'll accept it on Fairy's behalf."
"Get lost."
Fairy Eternity floated out from within Lu Yang's body, her expression serene and peaceful, just like an Immortal imagined in fantasies.
Fairy Eternity, with her fingers poised like an orchid, said leisurely, "I see that you are extraordinarily gifted and will surely achieve great things in the future. Today, I bestow upon you a chance at Immortal fortune. Whether you can seize it depends on your own destiny."
"Meng Jingzhou thanks the Immortal!"
At the peak of Sky Gate Mountain, Eldest Senior Sister did not return to Captive Peak to continue the interrogation but instead observed Fairy Eternity's teaching process.
"Reversing Yin and Yang can disrupt the order of heaven and earth, make the sun and moon lose their regularity, equatable to reversing right and wrong, blurring black and white. It ranks among the top few incredibly powerful moves even within Great Divine Skills. If you two intend to learn it, be mentally prepared..."
"The key to mastering this move lies in the Spiritual Sense within your heart. To overcome fate, you must first believe in fate..."
"After learning the superficial aspects of Reversing Yin and Yang, you can only transform a part, just enough to change your Pure Yang Spirit Root into a Yin and Yang Spirit Root..."
"When using this move, avoid exerting too much force, or else you will change from a Pure Yang Spirit Root to a Pure Yin Spirit Root..."
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were incredibly well-behaved, sitting on the ground attentively, eagerly remembering every word Fairy Eternity said.
"In fact, if you wish to learn Reversing Yin and Yang, you have the best reference right before your eyes."
"What is it?" they asked in unison.
Fairy Eternity pointed overhead: "The sun."
"Daytime is yang, nighttime is yin. Whether it's the interchange of Taiyin and Taiyang from our past or the present variations, they all exemplify Reversing Yin and Yang very well. Unfortunately, few people can comprehend this," Fairy Eternity sighed, as if lamenting the ignorance of ordinary people.
Meng Jingzhou seized the opportunity to flatter: "That's why they say a predecessor is an Immortal, able to perceive what ordinary people cannot."
"Oh, I haven't grasped it myself. It was the Time Immortal who told us this," the Fairy responded.
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
It took a full day for Fairy Eternity to clarify the principles of this Great Divine Skill.
"I've explained the principles; whether you can comprehend them or not depends on your own fate."
"I suggest that you observe closely during the transformation of the sun and moon. It will help you learn this Divine Ability."
"Yes," they replied in unison.
In the following days, they did nothing but focus on studying, pondering over Fairy Eternity's method wholeheartedly.
Reversing Yin and Yang, defying destiny, is indeed a Divine Ability powerful enough to rank in the top few, and even with Lu Yang's talent, he couldn't learn it in a short time.
On the fifth morning, during the transition of the sun and moon, they looked up at the sky, watching the silver moon that represented the Power of Taiyin lose its original color, draped in a red veil that deepened, completely dyeing the moon red and transforming it into the blazing sun, the symbol of the sun's power.
At that moment, Lu Yang felt an epiphany, as if a layer of paper in his heart had been pierced through.
He gradually closed his eyes and continued to evolve the magnificent and splendid scenes of the morning and evening transitions of the sun and moon in his mind.
Lu Yang revealed a confident smile.
He had learned it.
He sensed a change in his fate.
Meng Jingzhou scratched his head in frustration; his talent for magic skills was top-notch, but learning such an overpowering Divine Ability was still too difficult.
He turned to ask his good brother, "Lu Yin, have you learned it?"
The confident smile on Lu Yang's face froze: "…Wait, what did you just call me?"
"Lu Yin. Is there a problem?"
Lu Yang quickly turned to ask Fairy Eternity and Eldest Senior Sister, "What's happening to me?"
Unlike Meng Jingzhou, Fairy Eternity and Eldest Senior Sister both noticed the change in Lu Yang. A magical force had blessed Lu Yang, changing his name to "Lu Yin," as if he had been born with that name; even the name on his Identity Jade at his waist read "Lu Yin."
Fairy Eternity scratched her head in consternation: "Reversing Yin and Yang, defying heaven to change one's name?"
"Does this count as having learned it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 689 - 688: Causality Great Divine Skill
chapters.content:
Lu Yang had lived for eighteen years, never imagining that he would one day change his name.
The magic skill was real, and defying the heavens was truly defying the heavens.
"Does this count as having learned it?" Lu Yang looked at Fairy Eternity with suspicion, thinking that this didn't feel right at all.
Fairy Eternity declared confidently and with sound reasoning, "Why wouldn't it count? Don't you know that a name represents one's fate? Changing a name is changing one's destiny. By changing your name, your future will be different."
She added, "To take a step back, curses are cast using one's name. By changing your name, you are changing your causality. You are no longer the same person you were before. The change of name on the identity jade signifies that. Curses cannot descend upon you."
When a curse is initiated, it locks onto the identity "Lu Yang." Once Lu Yang became "Lu Yin," abandoning his previous identity, the curse could no longer find its target and naturally could not descend upon Lu Yang.
Eldest Senior Sister also agreed with Fairy Eternity's view, "Although I don't know why the results of Junior Brother's cultivation deviated from what was expected, directly changing your name at the level of causality proves that this move is indeed a Great Divine Skill related to causality."
Mastering a Great Divine Skill related to causality at the Nascent Soul Stage was an unprecedented feat.
Only Meng Jingzhou was completely lost, clueless about the Great Divine Causality Skill and what had been mastered.
Did I miss something?
Lu Yang explained, "It's like this, we were cultivating the Great Divine Skill that reverses Yin and Yang, right? I succeeded. I used to be called Lu Yang, now I am called Lu Yin."
"..."
"Hold on, give me a moment to process this." Even with Meng Jingzhou's intellect, he couldn't immediately come to terms with this fact.
"You mean to say that you used to be 'Lu Yang' and now you're 'Lu Yin,' even the name on your identity jade has changed?"
"Right."
Meng Jingzhou took in a sharp breath, finding the magic skill to be far too heaven-defying; he hadn't even noticed any sign of Lu Yin using his divine ability.
Eldest Senior Sister looked at Lu Yang for a moment and then said, "Junior Brother's move is truly extraordinary; it has fundamentally changed your name. If you encountered someone in the Body Integration Realm who does not understand causality divine abilities, they could still be fooled."
Both causality and time-related magic skills were known for being abstruse and difficult to comprehend. Most cultivators spent over a decade practicing without seeing any results, and within the Body Integration Realm, those who understood causality divine abilities were scarce.
Even among those in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, most only roughly understood some causality divine abilities. The Imperial Teacher of Great Yu, who used causality as the outline for Dao Fruit, was extremely rare.
Having an outline of Dao Fruit indicates achievements in that area, which highlights the extraordinary talent of the Imperial Teacher of Great Yu in causality.
After Lu Yang mastered the skill, Eldest Senior Sister was stunned for seven days, during which Lu Yang consolidated his skill, and Meng Jingzhou sought to comprehend it.
Seven days later, Lu Yang found that there was nothing about the skill that needed consolidation, whereas Meng Jingzhou found everywhere a need for comprehension.
Meng Jingzhou was forced to admit that he could not learn the skill.
Forget it, let Lu Yang change his name. I, the young master, do not need to change mine.
Seeing the two no longer cultivating, Eldest Senior Sister continued her journey to Captive Peak to interrogate the two Venerates.
...
Headquarters of the Yaoyang Sect.
On the walls, there were murals of the sun totem, which glowed, illuminating the meeting room brightly.
Sect Leader Yun convened the high-ranking members to discuss important matters. Everyone remained silent, listening to what Sect Leader Yun had to say.
"Today, I have summoned you all here mainly to discuss two matters," Lu Yang stated.
"The first matter, as everyone knows, our sect's research on harnessing solar power has recently been progressing slowly, the main reason being that our multiple attempts to ascend to the sun have burnt several of our cultivator brethren to death."
This was not the sun transformed by a Golden Crow in the ancient times, today's sun is blazing hot on the surface, and even with great protective formations, one can feel the terrifying temperature of the sun. In such an environment, cultivators at the Body Integration Realm could only last a few seconds before being reduced to ashes.
Continuing with these sun-ascending experiments, I fear that next, it will be the turn of us higher-ups to ascend and perish.
"Thus, I think we might need to change our approach. How about ascending to the moon at night? The sun and the moon are one, so it might also indirectly help us study the sun."
No sooner had he suggested this than everyone opposed it.
The Vice Sect Hierarch was the first to stand up and berate Meng Jingzhou for his disloyal act, "The sun and the moon never appear at the same time, which demonstrates that even if they are one, there is still a gap between them. Our sect believes in the power of the sun, how could we submit to the power of Taiyin? This is absolutely unacceptable!"
Some Elders also expressed their loyalty, "Those cultivators who burnt to death must have had insincere hearts and did not receive the sun's approval. I, an old bag of bones, have worshipped the sun my entire life and am certain I can withstand the test and ascend to the sun. Therefore, count me in for the next group of sun ascension members!"
Meng Jingzhou looked helplessly at the fervor of the higher-ups.
I can understand and respect your fearlessness, but if you all ascend to the sun and self-immolate, who will be left in the upper echelons of our Yaoyang Sect?
He knew that his proposal would not be accepted by the crowd.
"Let's put aside the sun ascension plan for now and discuss the second issue," Meng Jingzhou continued.
"The power of Saint Heir Long Jingzhou from the Heavenly Court Sect is surging with Pure Yang force, even stronger than a Pure Yang Immortal Body, which suggests that the Ancient Heavenly Court has some special cultivation methods."
"Moreover, I have sensed that Long Jingzhou and Young Master Lu might have a significant conflict, probably related to the issue of the Ancient Heavenly Court heir. We can exploit this discord, secretly win over Long Jingzhou, and incite internal strife within the Heavenly Court Sect to our benefit!"
One of the Yaoyang Sect Elders was puzzled, "What could we possibly do? The Ancient Heavenly Court is large and influential, and they have Heavenly Venerate Dou, an ancient immortal, and the Phoenix Ancestor who defeated Venerate Zhu Tian, a semi-immortal. Intimidation is certainly not an option, and we can't outbid them with benefits."
Meng Jingzhou shook his head, "You've misunderstood one thing; it is the Ancient Heavenly Court that is large and influential, not Long Jingzhou."
"There would always be an imbalance in the distribution of resources within any power. The resources available to Long Jingzhou would definitely be less than those to the Young Sect Master, which is our opportunity."
"With the full support of our sect, are we really inferior to the resources the Ancient Heavenly Court allocates to Long Jingzhou?"
"What's more, we have researched the sun for tens of thousands of years, and our findings greatly benefit cultivation practices. I refuse to believe that Long Jingzhou wouldn't be tempted," he asserted.
The higher-ups felt that Meng Jingzhou had a point.
"We could give it a try. If we can covertly win Long Jingzhou over to our side, it will make our future moves much easier," they pondered.
"Indeed, indeed, this could be worth attempting," they agreed.
Just as they were discussing, Meng Jingzhou's guard rushed into the conference room, holding an intelligence report and handed it hurriedly to Meng Jingzhou.
The report detailed how Sect Leader Yun had demonstrated his divine powers in Chunjiang City, capturing two ancient supremes and their whereabouts unknown.
Meng Jingzhou set down the report.
"Consider the matter of exploiting internal conflicts within the Heavenly Court Sect for our benefit null and void, and let's replace the second topic," he said.
All the higher-ups looked at Meng Jingzhou in unison.
Meng Jingzhou spoke earnestly, "Should we, the Yaoyang Sect, consider pledging allegiance to the Heavenly Court Sect?"

chapters.title: Chapter 690 - 689: Master Chi
chapters.content:
Elder Chi saw the intelligence report and kept a calm façade, while a cold sweat broke out secretly.
It turned out that the Sect Leader Yun he had met in the barbecue restaurant was actually an Immortal, meaning that the Heavenly Court Sect possessed two Ancient Immortals.
There was no point in trying to instigate internal divisions within the Heavenly Court Sect to profit from it; he might as well just join the Heavenly Court Sect outright.
With the Jiuyou Sect now focused on running their barbecue business and lacking a target to divert the Dynasty's attention, the Yaoyang Sect had nearly been discovered by the Dynasty on several occasions.
If this continued, their exposure was inevitable.
Elder Chi made several copies of the intelligence report and distributed them, letting the high-ranking members see the strength of the Heavenly Court Sect.
With two Immortals presiding, they could easily overturn Great Xia, and the current situation of the demonic sect being chased by Great Xia was not at all on the same level.
Obviously, the top echelons of the Yaoyang Sect were also shocked by the might of Sect Leader Yun; they simply were not qualified to plot against such an entity.
They were probably going to be wiped out before they even had the chance to scheme, leaving no trace of their souls behind.
"Another Immortal, the Ancient Heavenly Court is truly fearsome."
"Do you remember the Phoenix Ancestor? She is one of the Four Imperial Protectors, which suggests that the other three are also Semi-Immortals."
"I heard from the Jiuyou Sect that the enemies of the Ancient Heavenly Court were the Four Ancient Immortals. If they didn't deceive me, the Ancient Heavenly Court probably has yet more cards up its sleeve."
"So we are to seek refuge with the Heavenly Court Sect? It's absurd. Are we to hand over the foundation of our sect just because the Heavenly Court Sect is powerful?"
"Do they believe in the power of the sun? Can they help us spread the faith so that all people worship the power of the sun?"
"We aren't handing anything over, just seeking protection. It's not as serious as you think!"
"Not serious? I'm afraid we might not have a say in the matter when the time comes!"
The high-ranking officials argued fiercely, each holding to their convictions and not giving way to the others.
The elder with the most seniority stroked his beard and slowly said, "The Ancient Heavenly Court indeed has its strengths, but this does not mean we should align ourselves with the Heavenly Court."
"The Yaoyang Sect has its pride; how can it live under others?"
"If we were to seek refuge with the Heavenly Court, it still remains to be seen whether we'd become part of the Heavenly Court, or just cannon fodder for them!"
Many people agreed with the elder's remarks.
"Indeed, we can't entrust our fate to others."
"Moreover, as long as we produce results and make the world believe in the power of the sun, then we can follow the example of our ancient ancestors and use the power of faith to imbue the sun with life. When the supreme Sun God is there to protect us, our sect will not necessarily be weaker than the Heavenly Court!"
The founder of the Yaoyang Sect was an archaeologist who discovered that in times even more ancient than the Four Ancient Immortals, the ancestors were exploring cultivation systems and their faith gave life to the objects of their worship, which the ancestors referred to as "deities."
This also spawned the breakthrough to the "Divinity Transformation Stage."
From the outset, the Yaoyang Sect set a goal to draw strength from the sun, to spread its greatness, to make all people believe in the sun, and to turn the sun into a true deity.
Elder Chi felt that there was some sense to it.
"Since we cannot reach a consensus, let's each make a concession. We can try to make contact with Saint Heir Long Jingzhou and thus get close to the Heavenly Court Sect. How about that?"
This proposal from Elder Chi met with unanimous agreement from the high-ranking members.
…
After the meeting was adjourned, Sect Leader Chi let out a sigh of relief—it was finally over.
"I don't even know when this damn job as Sect Leader will end."
When he was just a low-level Cultivator, his favorite activity was watching the stars and moon at night, but back then, his Cultivation Level was too low to see them clearly.
By chance, he discovered that looking at objects through two lenses made them appear larger.
Based on this discovery, he invented a telescope that could clearly view the stars.
After applying for the patent, he heard about a nearby astronomy enthusiast group and found his way to the organization, following the trail.
Only after joining did he realize that it was actually a damn demonic sect.
Once you join the Jiuyou Sect, you can't leave; leaving means death, so he had no choice but to join obediently.
He originally intended to keep a low profile and live out his days quietly, but the higher-ups, upon learning that he invented the telescope, decided he was a talent worth cultivating. They promoted him rapidly, and before he knew it, he had mixed his way into the upper echelon.
Having reached the high ranks, he thought he might as well spend his life just mixing through.
But then when it came to electing the Sect Leader, he was unexpectedly elected with a high number of votes, on the grounds that his bald head resembled the sun.
He even comforted himself that being the Sect Leader wasn't so bad—at least no one would boss him around.
Then he realized that this position of Sect Leader was a pitfall—nice-sounding it was called Sect Leader, but cruder terms would be a sacrifice.
Whenever the Yaoyang Sect faced significant setbacks, like unsuccessful solar research or several strongholds being taken down by the Dynasty, the higher-ups believed this was the Sun God's punishment to the Yaoyang Sect, demanding the Sect Leader to make a sacrifice to heaven.
This wasn't as simple as the Sect Leader kowtowing to the sun a few times; it meant the Sect Leader becoming a sacrifice, personally offering himself to heaven. It was said to be a tradition left by the first Sect Leader.
Take the sun-climbing experiment for instance—if it failed again, he feared he would be the next one to undertake the trial.
He was promoted from high-level to Sect Leader so swiftly he hadn't even had time to find out how the previous Sect Leader had died.
It was only after becoming Sect Leader that he learned previously the sky was dominated solely by the sun with the stars being nothing but Illusory Shadows, and the Yaoyang Sect had always regarded this as a symbol of the sun's greatness.
Then one day, the stars were no longer Illusory Shadows, but real, vivid celestial bodies, and the sun was no longer the sole ruler of the sky.
This incident caused panic within the Yaoyang Sect, leading them to believe it was an ominous sign, which resulted in the sacrifice of the previous Sect Leader.
Sect Leader Chi was terrified when he heard this, afraid the higher-ups would find a reason to sacrifice him as well, but thankfully, they were relatively rational and did not continue the practice of sacrificing consecutive Sect Leaders.
The higher-ups were all at the Body Integration Realm, and the most senior Elder was even at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage; he had absolutely no way to resist.
During his tenure, he had faced several major incidents—those that would require the sacrifice of a Sect Leader. He had survived safely because he had his own methods.
He had invented the telescope, and patent revenue poured in, generating vast wealth. According to the rules, he was supposed to pay taxes.
When it came to the point where it was necessary to sacrifice the Sect Leader, he would deliberately avoid paying taxes, letting the Dynasty take him away, for they didn't know he was a Sect Leader of the demonic sect and handled him as an ordinary Body Integration Realm tax evader.
Normally, one would be imprisoned for a few decades, and after he was released from prison, he would continue being the Sect Leader, with the higher-ups no longer bringing up the topic of sacrifice.
"If only I could defect to the Heavenly Court Sect," he thought. It was certainly safer than this accursed place.
He took out a Token; this was a Yaoyang Token, which worked the same way as a Jiuyou Token, enabling long-distance communication.
When he last met with the Heavenly Court Sect, he had given one Token to each person.
"This one should belong to Saint Heir Long Jingzhou."

chapters.title: Chapter 691 - 690: Young Master Lu Seems to Have Said that Sect Leader Yun Tied with Yun Zhi
chapters.content:
The headquarters of Jiuyou Sect.
In the pitch-dark room, four pairs of eyes glinted like those of wolves.
Starting with Sect Leader Qin, Jiuyou Sect advocated simplicity; whether in light or darkness, it made no difference to them, being Integration Stage Experts, and they did not need to light lamps.
This was an internal high-level conference of Jiuyou Sect, presided over by Mu Baiyi, with three Vice Sect Hierarchs in attendance, primarily to summarize the Sect's gains for the quarter.
Shi Huagu held the quarterly report of the barbecue shop. As an old major demon, the joy in his eyes at this quarter's profits was almost too great to conceal.
"The reports have been distributed to everyone, and I trust you all reviewed them before the meeting."
"The barbecue shop's profits are encouraging, especially since we collaborated with Tao Yaoye, a friend from Seek Dao Sect. By using 'Dream Mirage' for publicity at the start, our barbecue shop's fame has soared. Now, even if someone hasn't tasted our skewers, they've certainly heard of us."
Tao Yaoye only had Nascent Soul Stage cultivation level. Technically, he wasn't qualified to be addressed as "friend" by Shi Huagu, but Shi Huagu cared little for such rules; anyone who could help him make money was his friend.
As the barbecue shop flourished, the Jiuyou Sect was gradually consolidating its other operations such as a zoo, funeral industry, smuggling, and tomb raiding. These were managed by Vice Sect Hierarch Xiang.
The smuggling and tomb raiding businesses provided a steady supply of "talent" to the Great Xia's prisons year after year.
Of course, they were merely consolidating, not closing down.
Mu Baiyi knew that for Jiuyou Sect's economy to develop healthily, relying solely on the barbecue shop wouldn't suffice; stable progress required diversifying the business portfolio.
Privately, rumors circulated that Shi Huagu would soon replace Vice Sect Hierarch Xiang and become the new Executive Vice Sect Hierarch.
Whether these were rumors or leaks was unclear.
What Vice Sect Hierarch Xiang regretted most now was not being the first to contact the Heavenly Court Sect, allowing Shi Huagu to get the upper hand.
The profits from the barbecue shop had everyone drooling. Shi Huagu treasured it so much that he would let no one else interfere.
Joking aside, this was his life-saving money; he'd fight anyone who tried to touch it.
"Since the income is so considerable, do we know when the construction funds for Fengdu can be approved?" Vice Sect Master Shee directly asked Mu Baiyi; he was the Vice Sect Hierarch specifically responsible for the construction of Fengdu.
Mu Baiyi coughed twice, "Building Fengdu is indeed important, but at this time of high-speed development for our Sect, I ask that Vice Sect Master Shee put the greater good first and temporarily set aside the construction of Fengdu."
Fengdu's construction would halt temporarily until the Sect's debts were secretly paid off.
Seeing Mu Baiyi's decisive tone, Vice Sect Master Shee did not pursue the matter further.
Mu Baiyi turned to Shi Huagu sitting opposite him, "Vice Headmaster Shi, I see that our barbecue shop pays quite high taxes; is there any way to reduce them?"
Hearing this question, Shi Huagu frowned with a pained expression, "I'm looking into it, but we're in the food industry and the Dynasty doesn't have significant tax relief policies for this sector."
"I see…"
Mu Baiyi was slightly disappointed and then pulled out another report.
"This is a report from the Rudder Master of Chunjiang City, just handed to me before the meeting, please take a look."
The three Vice Hierarchs were shocked upon reading the content of the report; their voices trembled.
"This, this, the Sect Master of Heavenly Court Sect is an Immortal?!"
The report, penned by the female ghost Xiao Cui, detailed the battle between the two Venerates in Chunjiang City, how Sect Leader Yun spectacularly captured both Venerates, and the heroic deeds of the barbecue shop in slaying the assassins from the Night Pavilion, for which the government office presented an award banner.
When Mu Baiyi first received this intelligence, he was no better off than the three Vice Hierarchs.
He hadn't expected that Sect Leader Yun, whom he had met at the barbecue shop's headquarters, was an Ancient Immortal from legends.
He just didn't know the name.
Shi Huagu's brow furrowed deeply as he remembered what Young Sect Master Lu had said, "No, there's another piece of intelligence hidden within this report."
"What is it?" Vice Sect Master Xiang couldn't discern the clue.
"When I first met Young Sect Master Lu Yang, he told me that their Sect Master once crossed hands with Yun Zhi of the Seek Dao Sect..." Shi Huagu paused, as if fearing the utterance of those words might bring calamity, but he continued, "The result was evenly matched."
"What, how is that possible?!"
"Old Shi, are you suggesting that Yun Zhi of the Seek Dao Sect is also an Immortal?"
Mu Baiyi tapped the table heavily with two fingers: "Quiet down, everyone quiet."
"All of you are Integration Period Cultivators, have you forgotten the most basic concept of a cultivator? When a fact occurs, what should be done is acceptance, not doubt!"
"Don't forget, the Heavenly Court Sect has never deceived us. Since Young Sect Master Lu says it is so, then it is!"
"This is a piece of intelligence worth more than its weight in gold, known to no one else in the world but us."
"This must have been intelligence the Heavenly Court Sect intended to offer as a gesture of goodwill to us, pity that our vision was limited, not realizing their intentions until today!"
The three Vice Sect Masters hung their heads in shame.
Mu Baiyi looked solemn and brooded: "If Yun Zhi of the Seek Dao Sect is an Immortal, then the Dynasty's strength is more terrifying than we had imagined."
"The Seek Dao Sect has an Immortal but no intention to compete with the Dynasty for power, which indicates that the Dynasty might also possess Immortals!"
The three Vice Sect Masters fell silent. If this were the case, then even if they managed to establish their Fengdu, it would not be a match for the Righteous Path.
Mu Baiyi was the calmest: "Things haven't deteriorated to that extent. The Righteous Path has two Immortals, and the Heavenly Court Sect also has Heavenly Venerate Dou and Sect Leader Yun, two Immortals. The situation is equitable."
"We can get closer to the Heavenly Court Sect by presenting gifts to Young Sect Master Lu."
"As a disciple of Heavenly Venerate Dou, Young Sect Master Lu is certain to control the affairs of the Heavenly Court in the future. Now is the perfect time to invest!"
...
"You're saying the Yaoyang Sect's people want to find you?" Lu Yang looked at Meng Jingzhou holding the Yaoyang command, slightly puzzled.
The message on the Yaoyang command from Sect Master Qi to Meng Jingzhou read: Saint Heir, our sect has some enlightenment on improving the cultivation method of absorbing the power of the sun. If you're interested, please come to Poyang City in Yuzhou State for a discussion.
"Is this to share a cultivation secret with you?" Lu Yang was even more puzzled after reading the contents on the Yaoyang command, isn't this overture of goodwill too obvious?
"Could it be they have heard about what happened in Chunjiang City and want to ingratiate themselves with me?"
After pondering, Lu Yang thought it quite possible.
Before Lu Yang could respond, he felt the Jiuyou command in his arms stir.
He pulled it out to look.
"What's up?" Meng Jingzhou craned his neck to see.
Lu Yang casually spread out the Jiuyou command: "The Jiuyou Sect is seeking me out."
"...What should we do? Act separately or gather both sects together?"
Lu Yang stroked his chin: "No need to rush a reply, let's go to Elder Brother Dai for intelligence."
With Li Haoran around, they knew a lot about the Jiuyou Sect, but they knew very little about the Yaoyang Sect.
...
Task Hall.
Dai Bufan regarded them both with a strange look.
"Are you saying, the Jiuyou Sect and the Yaoyang Sect each bribed you in private?"

chapters.title: Chapter 692 - 691 Bribery
chapters.content:
```
Dai Bufan heard for the first time that the demonic sect was actively offering benefits.
Does the demonic sect see you two as umbrellas for protection or what?
How come I fight the demonic sect every day, but never see them begging for mercy or bribing me?
"You can't call it a bribe, they just want to give it to us voluntarily, we're just too embarrassed to refuse," Meng Jingzhou corrected.
"Plus, the target of bribery charges are dynasty officials, not commoners like Old Lu and me."
Lu Yang also chimed in, "To infiltrate the enemy's ranks, we've had to endure humiliation and accept their gifts under duress."
Dai Bufan: "..."
"Forget it, this is all the intelligence on the Yaoyang Sect, you two take a look," he said.
Dai Bufan stuffed a pile of files to them, instructing them to look there and return them after they were done, preparing them in advance for the role of main and deputy hall masters.
He still had a mountain of work to deal with.
In a few months, the Seek Dao Sect was due for another round of recruitment. Considering that last time he did not prepare in advance, and ended up recruiting troublemakers like Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou who always caused anxiety, promising seedlings like Bai Ming and Lan Ting were poached by other sects beforehand.
This time, Dai Bufan decided to scout out several good seedlings with excellent character, temperament, and spiritual roots in advance.
What he had to do now was to identify these people from the myriad pieces of intelligence from Cloudy Seas and Misty Clouds.
Many of the Yaoyang Sect's pieces of intelligence were so evident that they couldn't hide them even if they wanted to.
For instance, sending two cultivators at the Body Integration Realm to the sun to die on a regular basis, the sect's wish for everyone to worship the sun, and treating Laurel Fairy Palace as their hypothetical enemy, and so on.
Having been established for sixty thousand years and studied the sun for that long, one could imagine how profound their research on the sun's power techniques must be.
But no matter how profound, it surely couldn't be more than what Lu Yang knew.
In the newly obtained library of Fairy Eternity, there was the Immortal Jiuchong's understanding of the forces of the ultimate yin and yang.
Could the Yaoyang Sect ever be stronger than the Immortal Jiuchong who possesses the Yin-Yang Dao Fruit?
The pair, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, spent three full days poring over the intelligence until they had completely grasped it all.
"Finished reading?" Dai Bufan raised an eyebrow. With just a thought, the files on the Yaoyang Sect automatically returned to their place.
"More or less."
"Do you need a few elders to accompany you?" Dai Bufan would certainly not let two Nascent Soul Stage cultivators meet the master of the demonic sect alone; it was too dangerous.
"Four elders."
"Good, wait here and I'll make contact for you," he said.
Dai Bufan stood up and left Task Hall to invite elders from various peaks to make a move.
As soon as the elders heard there was a chance to become Protector Heavenly Kings again, their attitudes were more enthusiastic than ever. They nearly broke into a fight over it, but with Dai Bufan's persuasion, they agreed to settle it by drawing lots.
In the end, Uncle Ba, Third Elder, Fourth Elder, and Seventh Elder would accompany Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
Meanwhile, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou took out their respective tokens and notified the masters of both their sects, and then picked a restaurant for the meeting in two days.
In the matter of presenting gifts at the meeting, the Heavenly Court Sect took the initiative.
The two sect masters quickly responded, saying they would definitely attend.
...
Two days later, the restaurant was booked out, and the three sects gathered together once again.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou took the seats of honor, backed by four mighty Protector Heavenly Kings standing tall like towers.
The Protector Heavenly Kings, with their tiger-like eyes wide and fierce, commanded a subtle yet undeniable authority.
Mu Baiyi and the master of the other sect did not expect to see each other here, leading to an awkward moment.
The other sect's master had not expected the Young Sect Master Lu to be present.
Wasn't it said that the Young Sect Master Lu had a rift with the Dragon Saint Heir? How come he was here when he should have given a private gift to the Dragon Saint Heir, and let Young Sect Master Lu tag along?
Could there be changes that he was unaware of?
```
"Having parted for so many days, you both still possess such charm, hahaha." Master Chi clasped his hands in greeting, adopting the demeanor of a peer to break the awkwardness first.
Behind Master Chi stood two young maidens, with their demure appearances and skins so tender they seemed capable of squeezing out water.
Master Chi gave a covert signal, and the two maidens obediently walked over to Meng Jingzhou, completely compliant, causing Meng Jingzhou's eyelids to twitch.
"Master Chi, what is this about?"
"Just a small token of appreciation. You and I both practice pure yang cultivation techniques and must regularly vent out excess energy. Consider these girls a meeting gift and please, Saint Heir, accept them."
Master Chi felt that simply offering cultivation techniques to the Saint Heir might not be enticing enough, so he decided to up the stakes.
Meng Jingzhou naturally would not accept them and feigned anger, "Could it be that you wish to plant spies by my side through this opportunity?"
Master Chi quickly responded, "Saint Heir, please calm your anger, I have no such intentions."
No matter how much Master Chi persuaded, Meng Jingzhou remained vigilant and refused to take in the two maidens.
Seeing the Saint Heir's firm attitude, Master Chi had no choice but to let the maidens return.
Meng Jingzhou narrowed his eyes, "Master Chi, do you truly have a method to enhance the absorption of solar power?"
Master Chi did not expect his previous actions to have created a gap between himself and the Saint Heir, which was against his intention.
Lu Yang laughed heartily, patting Meng Jingzhou's shoulder, "You're overthinking it. Master Chi wouldn't dare to scheme against us. It's nothing of the sort."
Seeing Lu Yang smoothing things over for him, Master Chi looked gratefully at Lu Yang, then produced a wooden box with a seal on it.
He released the seal, and inside the box were several books related to cultivation methods that utilized solar power.
The Fourth Elder stepped forward, skimmed through the books, and respectfully said to Meng Jingzhou, "Saint Heir, these are indeed cultivation methods that utilize the power of the sun for reference."
Meng Jingzhou nonchalantly hummed in response, waving his hand impatiently, "Then let's accept them."
Master Chi had not prepared a gift for Lu Yang and had to hastily retrieve a treasure from his storage ring, "Young Sect Master Lu, please accept this with my compliments."
Lu Yang glanced at the items and recognized their origins, chuckling, "Hundred Herb Pill, True Dragon scales, Ginseng King filaments... Master Chi is most thoughtful. I won't stand on ceremony then."
The Seventh Elder stepped up to accept these treasures on behalf of Lu Yang.
Mu Baiyi saw how much effort Master Chi had put into his gifts and if what he offered was inferior, it could easily leave a bad impression of the Heavenly Court Sect.
It seemed likely that this was why the Heavenly Court Sect had gathered their two sects together.
Mu Baiyi begrudgingly took out treasures from his storage ring and presented them to Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, who accepted them without objection.
After both sect leaders finished presenting their gifts, they suddenly said at the same time, "I have a question to ask."
The two exchanged angry glances.
Lu Yang, with a jovial smile, raised his hand to signal them to be patient, "We have plenty of time, one at a time."
"Let's do this, Master Chi spoke first earlier, so let Master Mu speak first this time. What do you both say?"
Master Chi had no choice but to agree.
Mu Baiyi asked, "Our barbecue restaurant is thriving, making a fortune each day, but the taxes imposed by the Dynasty are too high. Does Young Sect Master Lu have a solution?"
Mu Baiyi cunningly aligned Lu Yang with his own side.
The four Protector Heavenly Kings frowned internally at this unexpected problem. How should they respond?
Lu Yang simply smiled and instead of replying, turned his head to Master Chi, "And you?"
"It's like this, Young Sect Master Lu surely knows that our Yaoyang Sect, in our pursuit of making the populace revere the sun, has been researching solar power. Recently, our numerous attempts to ascend to the sun have failed. Do you, Young Sect Master Lu, perhaps have a method?"
Master Chi was anxious, knowing that if another attempt to reach the sun failed, he would have to resort to tax evasion again, which might land him in jail for a few decades as a refuge.
The four Protector Heavenly Kings frowned again internally. What could possibly be done? The sun is extremely yang and powerful; whoever approaches, perishes. Could the Yaoyang Sect be expecting Yun Zhi to make a move?
Upon hearing this, Lu Yang intertwined his fingers, placed them before his chest, and leaned slightly backward in his chair, resting against its back.
"The issues both your sects are facing can actually be resolved through a single method."
"Master Chi, have you ever heard of solar energy?"

chapters.title: Chapter 693 - 692: Solar Energy
chapters.content:
"Solar... energy?"
Master Chi was taken aback. As the Master of the Yaoyang Sect, he was very familiar with everything related to the sun, but what exactly was this "solar energy" Young Master Lu was referring to?
"Taken literally, it seems to refer to the energy of the sun?"
"A simplistic understanding, but that's the gist of it."
Lu Yang suddenly brought up another matter, "You just mentioned that the Sun Ascending Project has been continually failing. It must be a plan that has been put into action in recent years; previously, the study of the sun's power was always conducted from a distance."
"Given that, why embark on a Sun Ascending Study?"
Master Chi sighed, "Young Master Lu doesn't know, but recently, our research on the sun's power hit a bottleneck. The radicals proposed that we should study the sun up close by ascending to it. However, the sun is not so easily approached. Several Body Integration Realm cultivators have already been burned to death by the sun."
Lu Yang leaned back in his chair lazily, toying with the non-existent dirt under his fingernails, "Your sect is quite bold, daring to ascend to the sun."
"Are you aware that all the stars in the sky were originally Illusory Shadows, and over a hundred years ago, a supremely powerful being used a world-shocking method to fill in these stars' positions?"
How could Master Chi be unaware? The former Master of his sect sacrificed his life for this very event.
"That supremely powerful being is an existence that even our Heavenly Court Sect finds troublesome. Your Yaoyang Sect dares to ascend and probe the sun, aren't you afraid of violating that being's taboo and having your sect eradicated in one fell swoop?"
After listening, Master Chi broke out in a cold sweat. An existence that even the Heavenly Court Sect found troublesome must be an Immortal.
The Yaoyang Sect's Sun Ascending was tantamount to causing trouble right under the eyes of an Immortal. A single careless act could potentially offend the Immortal and bring catastrophe upon the Yaoyang Sect.
He was against the Sun Ascending Plan from the start, but the higher-ups were determined to follow through, even if it meant death. Now, all they could do was wait for an Immortal to annihilate them.
"So, what is Young Master Lu's opinion?"
"The purpose of the Yaoyang Sect is to spread faith, not to ascend to the sun, right?"
"Correct."
"Master Chi should know that the sun's power contains both light and heat, light for illumination and heat for providing temperature."
Master Chi nodded. This fact was written in the "True Interpretation of the Sun's Power," something everyone in the Yaoyang Sect knew and was a required topic for the annual exams.
The "True Interpretation of the Sun's Power" is a book internal to the Yaoyang Sect, mandated to be owned by every individual.
Lu Yang then took out a magnifying glass, "This is the cheapest magnifying glass. Simply place it under the sun, and the sun's power will converge at one point; at its mildest, it can burn ants, and at its worst, it can start a fire. This is the initial manifestation of solar energy."
Master Chi continued to nod. What Lu Yang was saying was all fundamental knowledge, and the magnifying glass was his own invention; he could not be more familiar with it.
"Since the sun possesses energy, then why not make use of this energy?"
"We have already been utilizing it, researching Cultivation Techniques for the sun's power and improving methods for absorbing it more efficiently."
Lu Yang calmly shook his head, "Not in this way of usage. Why should cultivators practice the techniques you've written? Just because your techniques pertain to the sun's power?"
"Yin and Yang, the Three Talents, the Four Images, and the Five Elements—there are as many types of cultivation techniques as there are hairs on an ox. Do cultivators really need to choose your techniques?"
"If cultivators do not choose your techniques, then your doctrine of venerating the sun won't spread and won't gain recognition from the people."
Thinking back on the Yaoyang Sect's actions over the last sixty thousand years, Master Chi realized it was indeed true. In a world where most cultivation techniques were centered around spiritual essence, they had expended great effort studying sun's power techniques that very few people looked at, making it difficult to spread their faith.
"Please enlighten me, Young Sect Master Lu."
"I've already explained the method, to utilize solar energy. Not by composing a cultivation technique for the power of the sun, but letting solar energy enter the homes of ordinary people. For example, storing solar energy and using it to provide light?"
"Allowing ordinary people to use solar energy, how is that possible?" Master Chi exclaimed in disbelief, having never considered this possibility.
Lu Yang smiled casually, "How is it not possible? If Tao Yaoye from the Seek Dao Sect can make 'Dream Mirage' affordable for the common folk, can't your sect use array methods to accumulate solar energy and release it at night?"
"As for the propagation of Dream Mirage, Mu Baiyi has the most authority to speak."
Mu Baiyi nodded in agreement. The wider the spread of Dream Mirage, the more famous his barbecue shop became, and the more prosperous his business, which was directly reflected in the profits.
"If a disciple of the Seek Dao Sect can research such a thing, surely the Yaoyang Sect can do it too?"
"If this research is successful and candles are replaced, with each household holding an invention from your Yaoyang Sect, why would you worry about spreading your teachings?"
Lu Yang looked meaningfully at Master Chi, "To make the world believe in the sun, the first thing to do is to let the world profit from it. Master Chi, you must understand this principle."
Master Chi suddenly felt as if a great truth had been revealed to him, truly, an ancient power possessed a higher level of cognition than his own.
"Of course, generating light with solar energy won't happen overnight. How to collect, store, and release solar energy, how to simplify the structure, how to reduce costs, etc. These are issues that require in-depth research, which your sect can address step by step."
"Moreover, this is just one example I've given on the fly. There are many things solar energy can do, and Master Chi, you can study them slowly after you return."
Research was Master Chi's forte, and he had become a high-level member of the Yaoyang Sect because he invented the telescope.
Furthermore, this plan was much more reliable than the 'Ascend to Sun' project, and it was bound to be approved by the higher-ups. If he could produce results, wealth and fame would flow to him endlessly.
This was an unparalleled development opportunity for the Yaoyang Sect!
He must lead the research himself and keep the results in his hands, so the higher-ups wouldn't dare to sacrifice him at the first sign of trouble.
It was a deal with multiple benefits!
Master Chi's excitement was beyond words.
Was this the wisdom of an heir to an ancient power? With just a few words, not only had he solved the problem of the Yaoyang Sect, but he had also resolved his own plight!
If heirs were like this, what sort of extraordinary wisdom must Heavenly Venerate Dou, the legend himself, possess!
Lu Yang's gaze rested on Mu Baiyi, silent, exerting a subtle pressure on him.
After a pause, Lu Yang spoke.
"Regarding the tax issue for the barbecue shop, Mu Master can consider cooperating with the Yaoyang Sect."
"Cooperate?" Mu Baiyi was extremely surprised. Apart from the fact that their sects were as different as Yin and Yang in nature, even if they were naturally aligned, where would they start with cooperation?
Seeing the astonished look on Mu Baiyi's face, Lu Yang knew that the other party hadn't understood his meaning.
"Mu Master, you're less familiar with Great Xia's policies than this person from ancient times," Lu Yang said.
"Do you know about Great Xia's tax incentives for research industries? The high reductions or even exemptions for developing new technology? The high reductions or even exemptions for using energy other than Spiritual Energy?"
Lu Yang looked at Mu Baiyi as if he were looking at a fool, thinking to himself that even a sect master like him didn't know as much as he did.

chapters.title: Chapter 694 - 693: The Three Religions Join Forces
chapters.content:
Mu Baiyi paid no attention to Lu Yang's gaze, nor dared he care about it.
Lu Yang's three questions came as a revelation to him.
"Does Young Sect Master Lu mean that our Jiuyou Sect can collaborate with the Yaoyang Sect to open a barbecue shop?"
"Not a barbecue shop, it's a solar energy technology development association, one of whose industries involves barbecue," Lu Yang corrected.
If it were just a barbecue shop, where would the tax incentives come from? Only by changing the nature of the business could they enjoy tax benefits.
To avoid being thrown into prison and following in his master's footsteps, Lu Yang had studied laws and policies diligently, and only he knew the effort it had taken.
"Right, right, right, it's a solar energy technology development association," Mu Baiyi nodded repeatedly, admitting Young Sect Master Lu indeed had a sharp mind.
Isn't this the "internal alliance with Yaoyang, ruthlessness with the secondary sects" from the strategic plan Young Sect Master Lu gave for conquering the world?
Perhaps Young Sect Master Lu had anticipated today's situation long ago.
What an astonishing display of wit.
If he had Young Sect Master Lu's brain, why would he need to masquerade as a believer to take out loans?
He'd have built several Fengdus by now!
To say nothing of being a sect leader, the believers would worship him as the founder of the faith!
Great Xia has always encouraged innovation; whether it was Lu Yang's invention of the flying car or Tao Yaoye's Dream Mirage, both had enjoyed tax incentives.
Moreover, since spiritual energy is fundamentally a strategic resource, Great Xia encourages the use of alternative energy sources, which led to the series of tax policies discussed by Lu Yang.
In Lu Yang's view, to have an industrial revolution in the Cultivation World, there was no need to follow the progression of his previous life step by step – from steam to electricity. They could take a leap straight to clean energy with solar power.
It was something he thought of while perusing the Yaoyang Sect's materials; he just hadn't figured out how to guide the Yaoyang Sect in this direction when the opportunity presented itself.
"Joining to establish an association and developing new solar technologies, Great Xia will strongly support the association; with such support, the barbecue shop's taxes will be a non-issue."
"Additionally, barbecue requires continuous infusion of spiritual essence into True Fire to maintain it; if the Yaoyang Sect can produce results in their research, they could use solar energy to sustain True Fire. In such a case, the Dynasty would not only cut taxes but might also provide subsidies."
The future Lu Yang described made Mu Baiyi's eyes shine; recognizing the Heavenly Court Sect had been the best decision of his life.
Seeing Chie Guantian deep in thought, Lu Yang smiled and said, "Chie Guantian, I know what you're thinking. You're wondering if the Yaoyang Sect can research solar energy on their own, without needing to collaborate with the Jiuyou Sect, right?"
"No, no, not at all," Chie Guantian denied vehemently, though that was exactly what he had been thinking.
"It's okay, humans are drawn to benefits; I understand," Lu Yang said.
"But please, Chie Guantian, consider carefully that the first requirement to establish a solar energy technology development association is a clean identity."
"Registering such a large-scale association has strict requirements on the identity of the registrant and the spirit stones needed; at the very least, it requires to be in the Body Integration Realm."
"If I'm not mistaken, aren't you the only one in your sect at the Body Integration Realm who has not been placed on a wanted list?"
"Is Chie Guantian planning to use his identity as a great inventor to register the association, then use his record of being jailed seven times for tax evasion to make the government office scrutinize the association as a key suspect?"
Chie Guantian broke out in cold sweat, not expecting the other party to have investigated his identity so thoroughly.
In fact, he had always used two faces: one was Chie Guantian, the inventor of the telescope, his true face; the other was the master of the Yaoyang Sect, his false face.
The purpose was to let other members of the demonic sect recognize him and secretly report on him.
He had not anticipated that the other side would see through his disguise.
It wasn't Lu Yang who had seen through Chie Guantian's disguise, but Eldest Senior Sister.
After their last meeting, Eldest Senior Sister had recognized Young Sect Master Chie's true identity.
"On the other hand, looking at the Jiuyou Sect, the owner of the barbecue shop, Shi Huagu, has been commended by the Dynasty multiple times and has completely earned the trust of the Dynasty. With him establishing the chamber of commerce, it will surely save a lot of trouble."
Meng Jingzhou slammed his hand down on the table and shouted, "This shop takes sixty percent of the barbecue shop's profits, so are you saying, Young Sect Master Chie, that you are unwilling to involve our sect in the matters of the chamber of commerce?"
Although Meng Jingzhou was only at the Nascent Soul Stage, his words sounded like a threat from someone in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage to Young Sect Master Chie.
It was then that Young Sect Master Chie remembered that while the barbecue shop was ostensibly an asset of the Jiuyou Sect, in reality, it was the Heavenly Court Sect that held the majority stake!
This was not a union of two sects forming the chamber of commerce, but three!
What had he been thinking about, wanting to go solo, cutting off the financial avenues of the Heavenly Court Sect? Was he tired of living?
This was precisely the opportunity to cling to the Heavenly Court Sect's coattails!
Young Sect Master Chie forced a smile, "Young Master Lu, Dragon Saint Heir, I was only joking. Heavenly Venerate Dou above, I truly had no intention of going at it alone."
"Is that so, then that's good," Lu Yang smiled, as though what he had said before had been a joke all along, and patted Meng Jingzhou on the back.
"Old Dragon, calm down. Look, Young Sect Master Chie has no such intentions."
"That's more like it," Meng Jingzhou snorted coldly, unwilling to talk more with these people.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou stood up and raised their tea cups, and the two sect masters also hastily stood up and raised their cups.
"Then, let's toast to our three sects' friendship lasting forever, to our master."
"To Heavenly Venerate Dou."
"To Heavenly Venerate Dou."
"To Heavenly Venerate Dou."
The four drained their cups, showing their reverence for Heavenly Venerate Dou.
Heavenly Venerate Dou, watching in the Spiritual Space, was very satisfied with the four's attitudes towards him.
"Do you two have any other matters?" Lu Yang stretched himself.
"No more, no more, many thanks to Young Master Lu for the reminder."
"I am slow-witted. In the future, I will still need Young Master Lu to enlighten me more," said Chie.
After Lu Yang had dangled benefits and threats, the two sect masters truly admired him from the bottom of their hearts, recognizing him as an ally not to be crossed.
After the Heavenly Court Sect took its leave, the Young Sect Master and the Saint Heir left with the four Heavenly Kings.
The two sect masters had profound cultivation levels, and their hearing was stronger than that of the average person in the Body Integration Realm. Even from a great distance, they could faintly hear the conversation between Young Master Lu and the Dragon Saint Heir.
"Why bother telling them all this? If they have troubles, let them solve it themselves. What can they do for us if you help them? Are we in need of that little money, or do you think they'll be able to help when we fight the Four Ancient Immortals?"
"After all, in the past, Jiuyou had a good relationship with us, and there is also a position of the Sun God in the Heavenly Court, so there is some affinity. Seeing them in such a pitiful state, helping out a bit where we can wouldn't hurt."
"It's like we're begging them to join the chamber of commerce; who cares about that? It's not like we want to study solar energy to replace candles so we can continue to show them the way forward. Without us, would the Yaoyang Sect even know what to do next? They don't recognize goodwill!"
"Alright, Old Dragon, everyone has their difficulties; there's no need to let them know our considerations," Lu Yang said.
Eventually, the dialogue faded into the wind and was no longer audible.
Hearing this, the two sect masters were deeply ashamed. If it weren't for the Heavenly Court Sect's remembrance of past relations, they wouldn't even have had the chance to grab onto the Heavenly Court Sect's coattails.

chapters.title: Chapter 695 - 694: Dai Bufan: I have a mission for you two
chapters.content:
"You know, this using sunlight for illumination and heating sounds familiar, I've done this before too," Fairy Eternity said with a chuckle as they were on their way back, comfortably stretching herself.
She had been cultivating in her sleep to restore her strength, and now that she was awake, it signified a temporary pause in her cultivation process.
"Fairy had a tough time sleeping, you used solar energy during ancient times as well?"
"I've never heard of solar energy per se, but the method of use is probably similar."
"How did you use it?"
"There was a time when I really enjoyed reading, day and night. Although my eyesight is exceptional and I can see everything clearly even in the dark, it lacked atmosphere."
"So, I summoned a Golden Crow. During the day, I'd have it conserve its energy and not shine, and at night I'd let it light up for me. You know, it was as bright as daylight."
"Sometimes when cooking and the heat wasn't enough, I'd call on a Golden Crow to help fan the flames and heat things up. Of course, I wouldn't let it help for free; I always invited it to stay for the meal."
"...I have a feeling that the way we're talking about using the power of the sun for light and heat isn't quite the same thing."
"Is that so? I think it's quite similar. Look, didn't I store up the sun's power first?"
"Yes."
"And after storing it, isn't it released again?"
"Yes."
Fairy Eternity clapped her hands, "See, it's exactly the same."
Lu Yang patiently explained to Fairy Eternity the difference: "The solar energy I'm talking about can be used for lighting and heating, but it can also heat water, replace horses, and power cars."
"My sun's power can do that too. I could have the Golden Crow boil water or pull me around, flying here and there."
Lu Yang: "..."
After duping the two Masters according to the plan, the members of the Heavenly Court Sect headed home, returning to the Seek Dao Sect.
Lu Yang was trying hard to explain to Fairy Eternity that solar energy wasn't what she thought it was.
Meng Jingzhou, on the other hand, was studying the cultivation technique that the Yaoyang Sect had respectfully offered, learning how to absorb the sun's power to the greatest extent.
On the cultivation technique manual, a bare-chested man faced the sun with arms wide open, letting sunlight touch every inch of his skin. The images were lively and lifelike, simple and easy to understand.
In the margins, the Yaoyang Sect also noted that one must strip naked, leaving no shred of fabric, especially around the crotch area, as there's no shame in cultivation practices.
The reasoning was sound: Shouldn't the crotch area be cultivated as well?
Beyond that, it listed various positions for sunbathing.
The Yaoyang Sect was considerate; besides the male version of the technique, there was also a female version.
Looking at the two books in his hands, Meng Jingzhou was silent.
The cover of the second book featured a bare-chested woman, and he was considering whether to open it.
No wonder no one learns your sect's techniques. Are these even legit techniques?
The four Protector Heavenly Kings dropped Lu Yang and his companion off at the entrance to the sect and then returned to their respective peaks.
"Do you feel like there are fewer people in our sect?" Lu Yang asked, noting that both on the way there and in the Task Hall, there were fewer disciples than usual.
"Now that you mention it, it does seem like it."
The two went to the Task Hall to report the situation of their mission to Elder Brother Dai.
"Elder Brother Dai, the overall situation regarding the contact with the two sects is as follows... Elder Brother Dai?"
After Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou finished reporting, they realized that Dai Bufan was somewhat distracted, seemingly preoccupied with other thoughts.
Dai Bufan snapped out of his reverie, "Ah, alright, you've done well. The bribes the two sects offered you were obtained through your own skill, so there's no need to turn them over to the sect."
Afterward, Dai Bufan looked troubled as he gazed at the two men, as if he were wrestling an inner conflict, hesitant and indecisive. Finally, with gritted teeth, he made a significant decision, "Your timing is perfect, I have a task here that needs to be completed by you."
"A task?"
Dai Bufan slid a small booklet in front of the two, which recorded the information of several mortals, all of young age.
"These people are...?"
"These are a few candidates for this year's sect recruitment. The plan is to observe their conduct before the recruitment, to see if they are capable of cultivation if they meet the standards of our sect, and if so, invite them to our sect for the entry exam on the second day of the second month next year."
Aside from those disciples at critical cultivation junctures, on other assignments, stationed to maintain the sect's operations, or in the Void Refinement Stage, most disciples of the Seek Dao Sect were dispatched by Dai Bufan to observe the candidates' conduct.
Observing conduct isn't something that can yield results in a day or two; at the shortest, it would take a month, and at the longest, half a year is also possible, so those sent out may not have time to undertake a second observation mission.
It was truly a lack of available hands that compelled Dai Bufan to have Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou observe the candidates' conduct as well.
This was exactly what he had been agonizing over.
If it weren't for the fact that he was otherwise engaged, he would rather complete the task himself than ask Lu Yang and the other to do it.
Who knows what trouble they might cause.
"So that's it." Lu Yang revealed a confident smile, patting his chest in assurance, "Elder Brother Dai, don't worry. Do you not know us yet? We shall surely complete the task!"
Dai Bufan sighed and, as was customary before departure, reminded the two, "If you find people not on the list who also meet the conditions for our sect's recruitment, you may also recommend them to me."
"No problem."
"Right, do you know what our sect's requirements are for a candidate's conduct?" Dai Bufan was still not entirely at ease.
"Honesty and integrity."
"Steadfast in cultivation."
Dai Bufan nodded, feeling somewhat relieved, "Good to know, you may go."
...
In the carriage, the two looked through the booklet with the information, which listed three mortals, all around fifteen years of age.
"Let's go to Nine Dragons City in Youzhou first, since it's closest to us."
Meng Jingzhou pointed to the mortal on the first page of the booklet.
The mortal on the first page was a young boy named Xie An, discovered by one of their senior brothers while on a mission in Nine Dragons City.
It was a mission to eradicate the red-clothed Fierce Ghosts, who had done much evil. After a comprehensive search, the senior brother finally found the haunt of the red-clothed Fierce Ghost.
Knowing that the senior brother would not dare unleash his full strength in a place crowded with mortals, the ghost concluded that the senior brother cared for the lives of the mortals and tried to use the threat against their lives to bargain for its own escape.
And the person being threatened was Xie An.
In that crucial moment, Xie An displayed an extremely steady psychological quality. Even when threatened by the red-clothed Fierce Ghost, he remained unflustered and managed to enrage the ghost with his words, causing it to reveal a flaw which the senior brother exploited to kill it.
At that time, Xie An was still young, not yet of the age to test for a Spirit Root, and it was unknown how his innate talents were.
"From the looks of it, this boy named Xie An seems to be a suitable seed for cultivation," Lu Yang said with a smile. Remaining unflustered in the face of danger is something that many cultivators are unable to do; only with such psychological fortitude is survival possible.
He and Old Meng possessed such mental resilience.

chapters.title: Chapter 696 - 695: Fairy, Can You Speak Up Sooner Next Time?
chapters.content:
In Nine Dragons City of Youzhou, a city of moderate development, the person with the highest cultivation level was the City Lord, an early-stage Spirit Transformation cultivator.
It was rumored that outside the city lay a secret realm, yet no one had been able to discover it, and so the tale gradually became a legend.
Besides that, there were the locally renowned three Great Sects: Mixed Yuan Ancient Sword Sect, White Sun Ascension Sect, and Qian Kun Purple Cloud Palace, each with Nascent Soul cultivators in residence.
For those like Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou who were at the Heavy Infant Stage, they could strut through Nine Dragons City unimpeded, with no one to block their way.
However, they were not troublemakers; they were here on a mission, and only through covert observation could they determine one's character.
"It should be in this direction." Meng Jingzhou left Old Ma at the stables, and he and Lu Yang went out to look for someone.
"The information says that Xie An has no parents and lives in a run-down temple outside the city."
Following the leads provided by their intelligence, the three came to this dilapidated temple. The temple's archway was on the verge of collapse, and the inscriptions were illegible, with no clue as to how long it had been since the temple's construction or why the monks had moved out.
The small temple was draughty from every corner, and the lotus platform was completely empty, even devoid of a Buddha statue.
Dry straw covered the ground in front of the lotus platform, with extinguished embers in the middle. Xie An was nowhere to be seen, only an old beggar lying sluggishly on the ground, propping up his head with one hand and picking lice off himself with the other.
"Shall we reveal ourselves and ask where Xie An is?" The two communicated in whispers, not daring to rashly show themselves and ask the old beggar.
If the old beggar knew Xie An, it would alert Xie An to their presence, which would be unfavorable for secretly observing his character.
Analyzing the situation, Lu Yang said, "Let's wait a bit longer. Look how neatly the bedding is folded; it definitely wasn't done by the old beggar. It's very likely Xie An's doing, which means even though he has left, he hasn't gone far."
Indeed, as evening approached, the filth-covered Xie An was supported into the temple by a little girl.
Upon seeing this, the old beggar took perverse joy in their misfortune, "So, you went to the Mixed Yuan Ancient Sword Sect? I told you they wouldn't accept either of you."
Xie An stayed silent, but the little girl defending him said indignantly, "That's too much! They didn't even test Xie Brother's Spirit Root. They saw his tattered clothes and said straight away that he definitely has no talent for cultivation and threw him out of the Sect!"
The little girl's clothes were ragged, as though she had just been unearthed from a dirt pit. Lu Yang could see that if the young girl were cleaned up and dressed properly, she would be a Beauty in the making.
The old beggar yawned, "The price for a Spirit Root stone is high, and it has a limited number of uses. Nobody would bother to test you."
Xie An frowned but said nothing.
"Alright, don't sulk. Look at what I've got today." The old beggar, as if by magic, produced three large white steamed buns.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had been watching all day long, and the old beggar hadn't moved from his spot.
"Steamed buns!" The little girl's eyes lit up at the sight of the buns.
An old man and two children ate steamed buns by the fire, quietly and contentedly.
Midway through their meal, Xie An suddenly said, "Qiao'er Sister, I'm going to try the White Sun Ascension Sect tomorrow."
Xie An's eyes were resolute.
"Good, I'll go with Xie Brother."
The old beggar scoffed as if mocking Xie An for engaging in a futile effort.
After eating the steamed buns, an excited old beggar pulled Xie An aside, cleared the dry straw, and revealed a makeshift Go board etched into the stones.
The old beggar took out a handful of black and white pebbles.
"Come on, Xie Lad, play a couple of games with me."
Xie An agreed, and the elder and the youngster engaged in battle over the Go board, while the girl called Qiao'er watched from the side.
After five rounds, Xie An won every game, leading to the old beggar's immense regret.
The night passed, and while the old beggar was still asleep, Xie An and Qiao'er headed towards the White Sun Ascension Sect, with Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou secretly following.
At the gates of White Sun Ascension Sect, Xie An expressed his purpose and wished to have his Spirit Root tested, but the two Outer Gate Disciples on duty scoffed at Xie An.
"Scram, scram, scram! Where did this little beggar come from? Someone like you could have a Spirit Root?"
"Even the Qian Kun Purple Cloud Palace, whose Nascent Soul Patriarch has gone missing, wouldn't want you."
Once again, Xie An was pushed to the ground. He stayed silent, enduring the humiliation, biting his lip till it bled.
Today's disgrace would be returned a hundredfold!
That evening, Xie An was again helped back by Qiao'er, with the old beggar still showing the same schadenfreude expression.
"I told you already, no one wants a person like you."
It was the same routine—eating steamed buns and playing Go. And again, the old beggar kept losing.
Just when he was about to lose for the fifth time, the old beggar suddenly said, "Xie An, do you really want to cultivate?"
Xie An nodded vigorously.
"Little girl, what about you? You've been following Xie An since he saved you from the bandits. Do you also want to cultivate?"
"Wherever Brother Xie goes, Qiao'er will follow!"
The old beggar stared into Qiao'er's eyes, then suddenly burst into loud laughter.
"Very good, very good. I indeed wasn't wrong about you two! You are naturally born with excellent potential for cultivation!"
The old beggar pulled out a token as if performing a magic trick and threw it to Xie An.
"What is this?" Xie An's eyes were filled with confusion.
"Take this token to the Qiankun Ziyun Palace tomorrow; I want to see who dares not to accept you!"
With that, the old beggar's figure dimmed and gradually disappeared.
"Wait, who are you really?" Xie An tried to grab the old beggar but caught only a wisp of white smoke.
"Once you join the Qiankun Ziyun Palace, you will naturally know who I am, hahaha."
The old beggar vanished.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou remained silent.
Who would have thought that an old beggar would appear now? Clearly, this was the Nascent Soul ancestor from the Qiankun Ziyun Palace, who had disappeared and now, unexpectedly encountering Xie An, was moved to take him as a disciple.
If they didn't reveal themselves now, Xie An would become a disciple of the Qiankun Ziyun Palace. The Seek Dao Sect couldn't lower its pride to compete with such an insignificant little sect for disciples.
The space twisted, and two figures emerged, their clothes bright and resplendent, clashing with the dilapidated temple surroundings.
"Who are you!" Xie An watched Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou with wariness, cautiously shielding Qiao'er behind him.
Lu Yang smiled slightly, "Don't be alarmed. We are disciples of the Seek Dao Sect..."
Inside the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity suddenly said, "Oh, this boy is disguised as someone at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage."
Lu Yang's smile froze.
Could you have mentioned that a bit earlier, Fairy?
"You've seen him before at the sect's celebration. I remember he's the Supreme Elder Wuji Zun from the Super-grade Sect, Wuji Gate."
"..."
So you big shots just love to masquerade as common folk, huh?
Understanding Xie An's true identity, Lu Yang went through the entire process in his mind:
Considering the current situation, if he wasn't here, Xie An would join the Qiankun Ziyun Palace. Disciples there would humiliate Xie An, some might even suspect that he found the token, and then Xie An would train diligently, defeat a bunch of disciples, and astonish everyone.
Then, he would move up from being an Outer Gate Disciple to an Inner Gate Disciple. Elders, because of conflicts of interest, would plot against Xie An. The Sect Leader, being weak, wouldn't be able to protect him. At that point, the old beggar would appear and take Xie An as his disciple in front of everyone, shocking the crowd.
Afterwards, Xie An would lead the Qiankun Ziyun Palace to conquer the other two Great Sects and become the most powerful sect in Nine Dragons City.
