He might even discover a Secret Realm outside of Nine Dragons City, gaining an opportunity and finding a new reason to grow stronger.
From then on, he would soar to the heavens.
Just as Meng Jingzhou was still amiably asking Xie An if he wanted to test his Spirit Root, Lu Yang suddenly said, "Are you the Great Wuji Zun?"
Meng Jingzhou's body stiffened, and he silently stepped back.
He knew that Lu Yang wouldn't make a mistake in such matters.
Xie An's face was cold, "Not bad for a disciple taught by Yun Zhi, to be able to see through my true form."
Speaking of Yun Zhi, Lu Yang suddenly recalled what Third Senior Sister had once said, that some Great Powers, after being struck down, would break their Dao heart and, in order to reclaim it, would start from the life of a common person by showing off and slapping faces.
Was Wuji Zun in such a situation?
But that didn't make sense chronologically.
Lu Yang asked cautiously, "You should have already reclaimed your Dao heart, so why start over again?"
Xie An revealed a cruel smile, "I've become addicted."

chapters.title: Chapter 697 - 696: Ice Spirit Root, Unparalleled Genius!
chapters.content:
Fairy Eternity felt that Xie An's words made a lot of sense.
Indeed, these kinds of things are very addictive, and she often went about with Jiang Lianyi and Ao Ling in tow.
Lu Yangxin said, "I knew there was something off with you, Xie An. Great Xia has no beggars; the old beggar was just a disguise. So, are you truly just a beggar?"
This isn't a test of character at all. Who's testing whom is anyone's guess.
Elder Brother Dai, what kind of lousy list did you give me? The first person on it is not normal.
"Then, I wish the respected elder a joyful cultivation. We'll take our leave first," Lu Yang signaled to Old Meng with his eyes. He had a lapse of judgment just now, revealing Xie An's identity in front of Qiao'er, which might affect Xie An's chance with the younger girl, so he felt extremely guilty.
The two men backed away and left the ruined temple.
"Wait," Xie An, with an unhappy expression, glared at Lu Yang. "You called me out in front of Qiao'er. How am I supposed to interact with her in the future?"
Hearing that Xie An was a Transcendance Tribulation Stage Great Cultivator, Qiao'er had a numb expression, obviously shocked by the news.
"Do you need something, senior?" Lu Yang's face was plastered with a respectful smile, as deferential as one could be.
"Since you've called me senior, I can't be stingy. How about this: I'll suppress my realm to the early Nascent Soul Stage, and we can have a fight. Let me teach you something about combat!"
Lu Yang: "..."
If the senior wants to hit me, he could just say so without going through all this trouble.
"Are you going to fight or not?"
Xie An indeed showed the demeanor of an elder, not pressing his opponent with a higher realm.
Lu Yang sighed. It seemed inevitable that they would fight.
"Then please enlighten me, senior," he said.
The two stepped out of the ruined temple. This was the outskirts of the city, rarely frequented by pedestrians, which explained the temple's dilapidation.
Xie An released some of his suppression; his realm gradually climbed—Qi Cultivation Stage, Foundation Establishment Stage, Golden Core Stage, early Nascent Soul Stage!
He simulated his appearance from the Nascent Soul Stage with great magical power, even simulating a Nascent Soul.
Imitating the Nascent Soul Stage was a piece of cake for him; he had done it before when recovering his Dao heart.
"Come on, Lu boy!" Xie An struck a pose, displaying the magnanimity of an elder, allowing Lu Yang to make the first move.
Lu Yang didn't dare to be negligent as he wielded the Green Peak Sword. Drawing his sword was like drawing water, the sword light razor-sharp, combining essence, energy, and spirit into one, with an elusive sword intent that would shame all sword cultivators in the world.
"Excellent swordsmanship!" Xie An's eyes shone. The kid had improved his swordsmanship from the last festive battle with the Heavenly Court Sect.
If Xie An had really been an early stage Nascent Soul, he would not have been this kid's match.
Fortunately, he now had the perspective of someone who had reached the Transcendance Tribulation Stage but was in the Nascent Soul Stage!
Snap!
The Nine-section Whip lashed out, its tip striking the air and sending out splinters of lightning.
The Nine-section Whip, yielding yet overwhelming, was like a flood dragon in water, unpredictable and hard to grasp. A slight touch to the Green Peak Sword deflected its sharpness, rendering its formidable power useless if it couldn't hit its target!
Lu Yang flicked his wrist, and the long sword split into four—indistinguishable as to which was the true Green Peak Sword.
Sword light gathered sword qi, falling from the nine heavens and entangling with the flood dragon in the water, making it hard to tell them apart in their struggle.
Then, both the Three Flavored True Fire and the Golden Bird True Flame flew out together, the temperature rose drastically, the air scorched and twisted. As Xie An spit out purple lightning, lightning and fire collided, roaring as if heaven and earth were shattering.
Lu Yang drew an underground prison to trap Xie An below. Xie An laughed, and countless water dragons sprouted from under his feet, breaking the prison. Lu Yang used a water-splitting technique to dissolve them; the water dragons hadn't even touched him before they turned into vapor and dispersed in the air.
Lu Yang dove underground as the Intertwined Stem Lotus bloomed, giving birth to twin figures. Two men, two swords, attacked Xie An at the same time. Xie An misstepped through the narrow gaps between the swords, and as his third eye released a Nascent Soul wielding the Nine-section Whip, he tangled with the two Lu Yangs.
Their magical duel continued, with neither able to gain the upper hand nor emerge victorious.
"Good lad, you've actually managed to exchange blows with me." Xie An's corners of his mouth curled up into a sinister smile, but do you think that's all I've got?"
"Today, I'll let you witness just how terrifying a Nascent Soul Stage cultivator is with the experience of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage!"
Xie An stepped across the Supreme Ultimate Steps, his footsteps sketching out a grand array. Within the array, spiritual energy stirred wildly, the soil burst open, and vegetation grew rampantly. This array method could control all vegetation within its range and required a high degree of precision to deploy—an array that no cultivator at the Nascent Soul Stage could possibly execute!
The vegetation went wild, entangling heavy clumps of earth, with a Nascent Soul armed with a Nine-section Whip at its topmost layer, sealing off all avenues of retreat!"
"Break!"
Lu Yang uttered a light cry, simultaneously slashing out with his Green Peak and Dark Moon Swords, shattering wood into splinters and creating a gap. But before he could rush out, the gap was blocked by the wildly growing trees.
Lu Yang soared into the sky, seeking escape, but above him, Xie An's Nascent Soul blocked the way, leaving no chance for escape!
Lu Yang looked enviously at Xie An's Nascent Soul wielding the Nine-section Whip in battle, wondering why his own Invincible Nascent Soul had to strike himself... Wait, the Invincible Nascent Soul seemed capable of more than just hitting its own master.
"Predecessor, I'm sorry for the offense!" Lu Yang employed his cultivation technique, severing the connection with the Invincible Nascent Soul, and sent it towards Xie An's Dantian.
Xie An burst into hearty laughter, "If you have any tricks up your sleeve, use them now and show me whether you possess even a fraction of Yun Zhi's elegance... Damn it, what is this?!"
Before Xie An could finish laughing, the Invincible Nascent Soul barged into his Dantian and started attacking anyone it came across.
He had lived for several thousand years but had never seen anyone's Nascent Soul fight like this!
Xie An hastily summoned his Nascent Soul back and began battling the Invincible Nascent Soul within his Dantian.
No matter how the Invincible Nascent Soul struck, each move was exquisitely superior and ingeniously precise, always hitting Xie An's pain points. Even with his experience at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, he couldn't cope with such attacks, which left him writhing on the ground, sweat the size of soybeans rolling down his forehead.
Suddenly, an infinite strength burst forth from Xie An, expelling the Invincible Nascent Soul from his body.
Lu Yang reconnected with the Invincible Nascent Soul and smiled, "Predecessor, that was not the combat power of the Nascent Soul Stage."
Just now, in a bid to prevent himself from being viciously beaten by the Invincible Nascent Soul, Xie An had subconsciously employed a portion of his power.
"Enough, enough, you win. Just scram if you've got nothing else," Xie An waved his hand irritably, conceding defeat.
Lu Yang clasped his hands, sheathed his sword, and turned his head to shout, "Old Meng, time to leave."
"Hold on, this little girl has an exceptional constitution," Meng Jingzhou said with excitement in his voice.
Meng Jingzhou was holding a Spirit Root Stone the size of a palm—the highest quality type that didn't require contact to assess a person's Spirit Root. It only needed to be placed next to a mortal to detect their spiritual roots.
While watching Lu Yang battling Xie An to an indistinguishable outcome, he thought it was a good opportunity to test Qiao'er's Spirit Root.
A clear, ice crystal, free from impurities, appeared within the transparent stone as it lay beside Qiao'er.
A variant Single Spiritual Root—Ice Spirit Root!
"This girl has the Ice Spirit Root!"
"What, such good fortune?" Lu Yang was delighted to hear this, an unexpected boon indeed.
"Oh, I forgot to mention earlier, that girl is also at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. You've seen her at the celebration, she's the Supreme Elder of the Seduction Sect," Fairy Eternity reminded.
Lu Yang: "..."
Qiao'er finally snapped out of the fact that her dear Qiong was actually the Supreme Omnipotent Sovereign, radiating an intense chill that struck fear into others.
"Supreme Omnipotent, who would have thought it was you!"
For half a year she had called him Brother Xie, planning in secret to provide Xie An with resources, enjoying the thrill of nurturing him, before revealing her identity and marrying him. But to think that Xie An was the despicable Supreme Omnipotent Sovereign!
Feeling this familiar power, Xie An's expression changed as he, too, became furious: "Qian Jiao, it's you, old witch!"
He had been looking forward to practicing cultivation together with Qiao'er, facing many dangers, capturing her heart, being forced to reveal his identity at a critical moment, defeating their enemies, and soaring the heavens together with Qiao'er. He never expected Qiao'er to be the old witch Supreme Qian Jiao!
Lu Yang felt that the Purple Cloud Palace of Heaven and Earth was truly blessed to have taken in two cultivators at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage as disciples, an achievement not even the Seek Dao Sect could boast of.

chapters.title: Chapter 698 - 697: Nine Dragons City Secret Realm
chapters.content:
```
Lu Yang felt that it was a good thing Xie An and Qiao'er went to the Qiankun Ziyun Palace. With two more at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, other sects wouldn't be harmed by these two, creating a win-win situation.
Meng Jingzhou quietly moved next to Lu Yang. Qiao'er, no, now known as Venerable Qianjiao, exuded a chill so intense that it seemed to freeze his very marrow.
"Is the Transcendance Tribulation Stage so common now that you meet a couple whenever you step outside?" Lu Yang muttered softly.
After giving it some thought, Meng Jingzhou spoke seriously of his experience going out with Lu Yang, "It seems like we run into those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage every time we go out."
Lu Yang: "..."
Indeed that seemed to be the case.
"Wuji, you old fart, stop acting like a kid! And looking so young!" Qiao'er scolded Xie An. Had she known Xie An was Venerable Wuji, why would she have stayed here for half a year?
Such a waste of feelings!
Xie An, refusing to show weakness, spat out a mouthful of phlegm, "You have the nerve to talk? When you were chased by robbers, crying you told me, 'Please, brother, save me, my parents and servants have all been killed by robbers.' You played the part so well!"
"Not as well as you. You spent all your time loitering around old beggars, playing chess with them, sneaking into a Nascent Soul Stage sect with such twists and turns!"
"You shameless thing!"
"You're the one without shame!"
As the two at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage quarreled, locking gazes as if in battle, the air seemed to freeze. This left Lu Yang and his companion terrified, fearing they might actually come to blows.
If they did start fighting, the first to suffer would be them.
Lu Yang, when serving as the proxy of the Acting Sect Master, had read intelligence on these two at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
The two were contemporaries, having known each other since childhood, were childhood friends, and there were even rumors they had a childhood betrothal. After Venerable Wuji's family fortunes declined, Venerable Qianjiao's family called off the marriage, and hence they never wed.
Regardless of whether the rumor was true or false, after joining their respective sects, they rivaled each other from the Qi Cultivation Stage all the way to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, incidentally raising their sects to the status of Super-grade Sects.
In their era, they were the brightest geniuses, their peers witnessed their talents with shame, feeling unworthy of comparison.
No matter the era, anyone who could cultivate to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage was a genius among geniuses.
After becoming characters of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, the two took on the airs of elders and weren't as quick to come to blows as before. Moreover, being at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, a mere fight could lead to catastrophic destruction, making the aftermath quite troublesome to restore.
Still, the number of times they secretly competed were not few, such as by cultivating disciples and having their disciples fight each other, or by disguising themselves as disciples to fight.
Seeing this, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou quietly made their exit, fearful of being caught up should they leave too late.
"Wait, don't go yet. There seems to be a secret realm in this temple," Fairy Eternity called out to Lu Yang.
"A secret realm? Where?"
"Right behind that lotus platform in the temple," Fairy Eternity directed Lu Yang.
Driven by curiosity, Lu Yang sneaked behind the lotus platform in the dilapidated temple.
Behind the lotus platform was covered in dust. Lu Yang brushed away the dust to reveal the entrance to the secret realm, which was a small indentation.
"Old Meng, come over here, there's a secret realm," Lu Yang called to Meng Jingzhou, who was guarding the entrance to the dilapidated temple.
Meng Jingzhou hurried over at his words.
Hearing that there was a secret realm, the two at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage temporarily ceased their squabble and were also surprised to find the indentation.
The two had been painstakingly disguising themselves as mortals and had failed to notice the entrance to the secret realm nearby.
"Legend has it that there's a secret realm outside Nine Dragons City; this must be it," Lu Yang surmised.
```
"Who would've thought there really is a secret realm?" Xie An exclaimed in surprise. He had already set up a secret realm in the nearby woods, just waiting for the day he would join the Purple Cloud Palace of the universe and become the Eldest Senior Brother. Then, during a chance encounter, he hoped to gain an opportunity.
The opportunity he arranged was enough for him to cultivate to the Body Integration Realm.
"Try dripping blood on it?" Meng Jingzhou suggested.
"Okay." Lu Yang dripped blood into the groove, filling it completely, but there was no reaction.
Xie An analyzed seriously, "This must require some kind of token to fill it. As for what that token is, I have no idea."
"Why does this groove look so familiar?" Lu Yang wondered.
"Right, why don't you try using the token that old beggar gave you?"
Upon hearing this, Xie An placed the Purple Cloud-shaped token in the groove, and it filled exactly one-third of it.
"Does it mean we need the tokens from the three Great Sects? Shall we go and ask the other two sects for theirs?"
"No need for such trouble."
Qiao'er pressed her hand onto the groove, gently tugging at it, tearing open a spatial rift. She pointed toward the entrance of the secret realm, "Now we can enter."
Lu Yang: "…"
The four of them were curious about what was inside the secret realm and directly jumped in.
The secret realm was not large; its main feature was a luxurious palace.
The four walked into the palace, where a statue was enshrined. Due to the lack of offerings over the years, the statue looked worn and damaged.
It seemed to sense that the secret realm had been opened and someone had entered. The statue trembled slightly, and an old man with a beard of white whiskers appeared. The old man looked at them contentedly.
"It must be you four who, according to the prophecy, have gathered the three tokens and opened the secret realm."
"This is a divine thought I left behind. I know you have many questions. Don't rush, let me explain slowly."
"I don't know if you have heard of my name, I am called Zhang Dao. I was once the strongest in Nine Dragons City, at the peak of Spirit Transformation cultivation level, so much so that even the City Lord would pay his respects to me as a junior."
"Unfortunately, despite my carefree life, I ultimately had to face the issue of 'lifespan'."
"Great strength does not mean unlimited lifespan. At that time, I had no hope of reaching the Void Refinement Stage, and my end was near. I wasn't afraid of death, but I had three disciples who were all excellent. They developed rifts among themselves and established their own sects, creating the three Great Sects.
While I was alive, I could still suppress their disputes, but if I were to die, they would inevitably engage in infighting."
"Thus, on my deathbed, I left a prophecy: 'When the three sects unite, the three tokens converge, under Buddhism there lies Pass Tribulation.' I left behind a cultivation technique that extends to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. To obtain this technique, one must gather all three tokens which are the personal tokens of my three disciples."
"You were able to gather all three tokens, which must mean they have reconciled. I am very gratified. Knowing that the last sentence of the prophecy refers to this place shows your exceptional wisdom."
The old man opened a small wooden box, which contained a thread-bound cultivation technique.
"This is a technique I obtained in my youth from the Wuji Sect. Although it is incomplete, containing only the first half, it can ensure your cultivation reaches the Divinity Transformation Stage. It is by practicing this that I reached the peak of Spirit Transformation."
"To obtain the latter part of the technique, you have to find a way to join the Wuji Sect."
Xie An looked at the old man, hands behind his back, and asked indifferently, "Do you know who I am?"
"Who are you?"
Xie An changed his appearance, with his face and body shifting, reverting to his original appearance, and stared coldly at the old man.
"I am called Xie Jiu. You can also call me the Venerable Wuji."
The old man remained silent for two seconds and then knelt down quietly.
"I am sorry, I should not have stolen the cultivation technique."

chapters.title: Chapter 699 - 698 Kind-hearted Ji Hongwen
chapters.content:
If a talented youth were to join the world's Purple Cloud Palace, with talent, hard work, and opportunity on their side, they could cultivate to the Nascent Soul Stage, unify the other two major sects, collect three tokens, open the secret realm, receive the teachings of the ancestral master Zhang Dao, and obtain the incomplete Transcendance Tribulation stage techniques of a super-grade sect, ultimately cultivating to the Divinity Transformation Stage.
Should their luck be even better, they could join a super-grade sect, perfect their techniques, and reach straight for the clouds, becoming a Transcendance Tribulation stage powerhouse.
Of course, all of these premises are based on the actual existence of such a talented youth, and not on someone like the Infinite Honored One pretending to be a youth.
Gathering his thoughts, Lu Yang silently watched the scene unfold before him.
Zhang Dao was kneeling on the ground, fervently kowtowing: "I'm sorry, I shouldn't have stolen the thing, your honor is magnanimous, please spare me!"
Zhang Dao never dreamt that stealing a single cultivation technique, and after so much time, would lead the Infinite Honored One, this great figure, to personally seek him out.
Zhang Dao was just over a hundred years old, and before he had started cultivating, the Infinite Honored One was already an unreachable Transcendance Tribulation stage, a peerless great power beyond his lifetime's reach.
Is there a problem with this cultivation technique? Is it hiding some secret that could even entice those at the Transcendance Tribulation stage?
Zhang Dao couldn't figure it out.
The Infinite Honored One sighed lightly: "Enough, rise, your original self is already dead, what remains here is but a divine consciousness, and what use is there in punishing a divine consciousness that won't last much longer?"
"Thank you, Honored One!" Zhang Dao knocked his head on the ground three more times before standing up.
"However, there is one thing I need your cooperation with."
"Your command is my wish, Zhang Dao will go through fire and water!"
"Tomorrow I will join the Purple Cloud Palace. When the time comes, I'll find a way to collect the three tokens, and I'll come looking for you. Then you'll pretend not to recognize me and pass on that technique to me."
Zhang Dao was filled with question marks upon hearing this; the matters spoken by the Infinite Honored One were beyond his comprehension.
But he didn't dare to ask more, simply nodding vigorously in agreement.
"Infinite, you still wish to continue on this path?" the Thousand Charms Honored One teased.
When Zhang Dao heard the Thousand Charms Honored One refer to the Infinite Honored One, cold sweat broke out; judging by her tone, this young lady was also a remarkable figure.
The Infinite Honored One snorted coldly: "Why not?"
He had just been beaten up by Lu Yang using the Invincible Nascent Soul and had some difficulty accepting this fact; he needed to go to the Purple Cloud Palace to find some self-confidence.
The four left the secret realm, and Lu Yang hurriedly bade farewell to the two great powers. After the farewells, they quickly departed, still able to hear the great powers' conversation from a distance.
"What are you following me for?"
"To see what you old thing are up to in the Purple Cloud Palace."
Lu Yang quickened his pace to leave.
Back in the stables of the city, they found Old Ma, who looked at them sideways.
Inside Nine Dragons City, it was he who had the highest cultivation level. Others might not sense the disturbances outside the city, but he was acutely aware.
What's the matter with you two? Weren't you going to recruit disciples and inspect their conduct? Why are there auras of two Transcendance Tribulation stage beings where you left?
Can't you two consider the cultivation level of me, the Protector?
"Why are you looking at me like that? It was all an accident." Meng Jingzhou noticed Old Ma's skeptical eyes and spoke truthfully, seriously defending himself.
"Right, I can vouch for what Old Meng said," Lu Yang voluntarily stepped forward as a witness.
Old Ma rolled his eyes; what use was it for them to vouch for each other?
They got on the carriage and rapidly left Nine Dragons City, then took out a booklet and drew a cross next to the name "Xie An" on the first page.
"Let me see, the nearest one from here should be this Gu Junye from Yinzhou's Lintian City."
"The report says it was Junior Brother Wei Nanfei who, while on a mission in Lintian City, disguised himself as a school teacher and encountered him at a private school. Wei Nanfei praised him for being calm and composed despite his youth, deliberate in actions, and having great academic achievements."
Wei Nanfei and Lu Yang were part of the same group that joined the Seek Dao Sect. He cultivated the "Heaven Burning and Blood Igniting Art." Even though his talent was not as good as Lu Yang's and Meng Jingzhou's, for the outside world he would still be considered a top-tier genius.
He especially demonstrated his prowess in the finals, securing the first place in the late stage Foundation Establishment group.
After hearing this, Lu Yang analyzed, "So, this person named Gu Junye doesn't like to talk, enjoys daydreaming, and doesn't like to be active?"
"You could say that."
Just as the two were about to continue assessing Gu Junye's information, they felt the carriage shake and come to a halt.
"Old Ma, what's happened?"
Meng Jingzhou poked his head out and asked, with Old Ma snorting and signaling for Meng Jingzhou to look up at the sky.
A refined laughter descended from the heavens.
"Junior Brother Meng, has Old Dai also sent you out?" The youth dressed in Confucian robes descended to greet them; he recognized the carriage.
"Senior Brother Ji?"
The newcomer was none other than the Fourth Elder's lead disciple, Ji Hongwen, who was at the early stage of Unification.
Hearing the commotion outside, Lu Yang also stuck his head out.
Ji Hongwen, seeing Lu Yang, couldn't help but laugh, "Old Dai has sent both of you out? Seems like the sect really is short on people."
"What are you doing, Senior Brother Ji?"
Ji Hongwen lifted the booklet in his hand, "Well, Old Dai said that staying in the mountains all the time isn't good for cultivation, so he sent me out to observe the conduct of the people on the list too."
"How many have you observed?"
"Just one. I've just finished observing him. He's a good seedling. His father is a mortal, and his mother a cultivator, but his mother disappeared when he was young, leaving only half of a jade pendant as a clue. He and his father depend on each other for survival. He said he wants to cultivate diligently to become a great cultivator so he can use this half of the jade pendant to find his mother."
"When he said that, his eyes revealed an unwavering will, but his roots are quite average; he has Three Spirit Roots, just barely meeting the sect entry standards."
"I thought this kid's filial piety was praiseworthy, so I decided to help him find his mother by meticulously observing the jade pendant."
"If that half of the jade pendant is worn for a long time, it can enhance one's Spirit Root and improve their physique. The pendant also hides a cultivation technique, which can only be opened after the youngster manages to draw Qi into his body."
"Through this half of the jade pendant, I concluded that the kid's mother is no ordinary cultivator."
"But that's as far as my analysis goes; I couldn't find the person."
"No choice, I had to make a trip to the Heavenly Strategy Sect and ask a friend to use the Causality Divine Ability to trace back to the source and find the kid's mother."
"So, did you just come back from the Heavenly Strategy Sect?" Lu Yang asked.
Ji Hongwen shook his head, "After leaving the Heavenly Strategy Sect, I learned that the cause related to the jade pendant was at the First Class Sect, the Hear Sea Sect in Yu State, and I went directly to them."
"I discovered once I got there that the kid's mother was the saintess of the Hear Sea Sect. She went against the sect's wishes, secretly married a mortal, leading to the Hear Sea Sect's wrath. They captured the saintess back and suppressed her under the sect."
Meng Jingzhou suddenly realized, "Then, Senior Brother Ji, surely you took decisive action, fought a great battle with the sect leader of the Hear Sea Sect, and saved the saintess?"
Ji Hongwen looked at Meng Jingzhou with confusion, "No, what are you talking about? I went to report the incident. The Hear Sea Sect was restricting personal freedom, which constitutes the crime of illegal detention; naturally, this is something for the government office to handle."
"Did their family of three reunite then?"
This time, Ji Hongwen nodded, "They did reunite."
"After the government office rescued the saintess, they arrested a bunch of people from the Hear Sea Sect, including the sect leader and the Supreme Elder. They're probably looking at several hundred years of incarceration."
"The investigation revealed that the half jade pendant the boy wore was a treasure of the Hear Sea Sect stolen by the saintess, which incurs a theft charge. She's probably also facing several hundred years of incarceration."
"Just now, I've come from taking the kid to visit the prison."
"Before leaving, I told him if he still intends to cultivate, he can come to the Seek Dao Sect to participate in the entrance examination on the second day of the second lunar month next year. I don't know if he will come or not."

chapters.title: Chapter 700 - 699 Curse
chapters.content:
Lu Yang felt that the Junior Brother he had never met might not join the Seek Dao Sect.
Moreover, even if he did join, what that person's purpose in cultivation was still a matter up for debate.
What if he was diligently cultivating with the goal of passing tribulation to escape the infernal prison?
Seeing Senior Brother Ji's self-satisfied demeanor at having done a good deed, Lu Yang felt embarrassed to voice his own thoughts.
Ji Hongwen encountered Meng Jingzhou's carriage, greeting him was one part, but showing off his good deed to a couple of acquaintances was also part of the motive.
"How about the two of you, did you just come from the Sect, or did you also finish observing someone?"
Lu Yang didn't know how to explain what had happened just now, he could only stiffen his resolve and say, "We have finished observing someone, but he has already been pre-selected by the Infinite Sect, and probably won't join our Sect."
"We also found a promising youngster not on the list, with an Ice Spirit Root, but he's been pre-selected by another sect as well."
"Which sect?"
"Seduction Sect."
Ji Hongwen felt slightly regretful, "Then that's really unfortunate."
He trusted the discernment of these two Junior Brothers. Anyone they took notice of might not have impeccable moral conduct, but they certainly possessed talent in cultivation, an outstanding dragon and phoenix among men.
Lu Yang and the other both nodded in agreement, indeed, it was quite unlucky.
"Alright, then, I'm off to observe the second person, I'll see you back at the Sect," Ji Hongwen waved his hand and soared into the sky, heading towards his next destination.
"Goodbye, Senior Brother Ji."
The carriage moved slowly forward, Old Ma traversing through space at a rapid speed, a feat that only Integration Stage Experts like Ji Hongwen could notice.
...
In the state of Youzhou, Lin Tian City, a rather unassuming small town, its highest Cultivation Level was merely at the Nascent Soul Stage.
Meng Jingzhou, as usual, left Old Ma in the stable, taking out carefully blended fodder, with Old Ma leisurely eating, swishing his tail contentedly.
Gu Junye was easy to find, attending class at Bailu Academy in the city.
"The sage said: 'Learning and frequent practice, is it not a pleasure...'" the schoolmaster nodded and recited, lecturing from the platform.
Gu Junye sat in a corner with an aloof air that kept others at a distance, his smooth white face sharp and cold, his eyebrows like willows, his stature tall and elegant, his eyes dull, his scholar's robe accentuated his lean figure.
The social atmosphere of Lin Tian City was relatively liberal, allowing even women to attend school.
Despite Gu Junye's unapproachable demeanor, numerous girls still sent him furtive glances, ignoring the teacher to look his way.
"Young master Gu is so handsome."
"It's a shame that Young Master Gu wasn't born to the main wife but as a concubine's child and cannot inherit the Gu Family's estate."
"It's better that he can't inherit, so he could marry into my family."
"Come on, how many sisters in the city feel the same way, do you think it would be your turn?"
"I've heard he has some secret on him, some have seen him often talking to himself."
The girls whispered among themselves, stealing glances at Gu Junye, their cheeks flushing, hearts racing.
Gu Junye seemed not to hear these whispers at all, focusing on the lecture and taking notes, his handwriting as meticulous as his upright stature, neat and without fault.
After school, a girl secretly called Gu Junye to a corner behind the academy, boldly confessing her feelings.
"Junye, I like you."
Gu Junye looked at the girl coldly, he himself couldn't remember how many had confessed to him already.
The closer the girl got to Gu Junye, the more excited she became, her heart almost leaping out of her chest.
"I'm sorry, I still have to study."
"Also, please don't call me Junye, our relationship is not that close."
Gu Junye rejected her mercilessly. He was a Great Power who had endured eighty of the ninety-nine Thunder Tribulations to become a True Immortal, just one short of ascending, but fell during the Immortal Tribulation due to not reaching Consummation. He did not know why he had come to this later era.
In this life, he was determined to cultivate again and become the ultimate True Immortal!
As a being who had passed the Thunder Tribulation, how could he accept such ordinary affection from mortals?
The woman covered her face and fled.
Gu Junye found it all rather boring, so he returned to the academy to pack his things and prepare to go home.
Just as he was about to leave, he heard a commotion.
"Mu Yu, how could you deliberately push down Junior Sister Mu Xi!"
"I—I didn't."
"If you didn't, then did Junior Sister Mu Xi fall down by herself!"
"No, that's not what I mean."
"Then what do you mean! Just now, you were the only one behind Junior Sister Mu Xi, if it wasn't you who pushed her, who else could it be!"
"Not only do you make life difficult for Junior Sister Mu Xi on normal days, but this time you actually went so far as to lay your hands on her!"
"Everybody, don't blame my sister; I believe she didn't do it on purpose."
"Junior Sister Mu Xi, you're just too kind, which is why Mu Yu keeps bullying you."
"Junior Sister Mu Xi, everyone is here, don't be afraid."
A delicate-looking girl sat on a chair with disheveled clothing; this must be Mu Xi who had fallen down.
Gu Junye knew Mu Xi, she was from the Mu family, just like himself, born from concubines, with a weak and delicate appearance that easily evoked a protective instinct in others. In the academy, there were often senior brothers who took the initiative to look after Mu Xi.
Another woman was anxiously defending herself; it was Mu Yu.
Mu Yu was Mu Xi's older sister. Gu Junye had heard that Mu Yu, taking advantage of her status as the older sibling, often bullied Mu Xi.
"Excuse me, make way, you're blocking the path," Gu Junye said indifferently, with a tone of command, somewhat displeased.
Along with him in reincarnation was the celestial demon beast sealed within his eyes, Swallow the Sky Beast; if he were to be in a bad mood, it could distract him and let the Swallow the Sky Beast escape, bringing disaster upon the mortal realm.
Seeing that it was Gu Junye, the crowd hurriedly made way.
"Junior Sister Mu Xi," Gu Junye followed suit and called her as the others did.
"Senior Brother Gu..." Mu Xi locked eyes with Gu Junye, her face turning slightly red.
"You're also in the way."
"Ah? Oh." Only then did Mu Xi realize her chair was right in the middle of the path, and she quickly got up to move it.
Gu Junye nodded in satisfaction and left.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had been hiding nearby, observing everything, and hissed in response.
Let's not mention for the moment that Mu Xi had intentionally fallen and then shifted the blame onto Mu Yu.
"Fairy, you need to make it clear to me this time, is this Gu Junye a reincarnated Great Power, or someone who has started over after disbanding their cultivation, or perhaps a Great Power in disguise?" Having learned from a prior incident, Lu Yang sought confirmation from Fairy Eternity first.
Fairy Eternity waved her hand dismissively, "You're thinking too much. Where would so many Great Powers come from? He's just a mortal."
"Really?"
"When has this fairy ever been wrong?"
"Good." Lu Yang still trusted the judgment of Fairy Eternity.
"However, there is indeed something wrong with this young man."
"What's wrong?" Lu Yang became tense.
"He's been cursed by someone."
"Cursed?"
"Quite a simple little curse. Its effect causes young women who see him to experience heart problems."
Lu Yang nudged Meng Jingzhou who was grinding his teeth next to him.
"You don't have to be jealous of this kid anymore; the reason the girls he meets blush and their hearts beat faster is because of a heart condition."

chapters.title: Chapter 701 - 700: The Mindset of the Strong
chapters.content:
Meng Jingzhou, who had been grimacing, suddenly calmed down upon hearing Lu Yang's words and straightened his already neat collar.
"Nonsense, who's jealous of this kid."
"I'm merely concerned that his luck in love affairs is too vigorous, which could easily morph into a calamity. That's all."
Lu Yang nodded, pretending to believe Meng Jingzhou's absurd story.
"But you mentioned he's under a curse. What's that about?"
Meng Jingzhou had previously suffered from curse backlash and had traveled to the Wild State in search of a remedy, knowing too well how troublesome dealing with a curse could be.
Lu Yang turned his head, tossing the question to Fairy Eternity, "Fairy, would you elaborate?"
"It's quite a simple little curse, one that wouldn't even affect a cultivator, only causing the young women he touches to have rapid heartbeats. Over time, it could lead to heart disease."
"The issue isn't severe for now, not yet at the point of causing illness, but given enough time, it will certainly become troublesome."
"Do we know who's behind it?"
"It's unclear."
"Is there a way to lift the curse?"
"That's actually easy. If I recall correctly, your Identity Jade contains Breath Soil, spirit of wood, and Thousand Illusion Bamboo... Simply refine these items into an elixir according to the right proportions, and the curse can be lifted."
Unlike the severe curse Meng Jingzhou had encountered before, which Fairy Eternity wasn't adept at handling—resulting in her resorting to the Playing Dead Technique—this time was different. This was a minor curse, the likes of which she had encountered many times in Ancient Times, and she could handle it with ease.
"To refine it into an elixir, it seems we need to find an alchemist." Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were both incapable of refining pills.
As long as the curse could be broken, the one who cast the curse would naturally surface when they noticed something amiss.
The two men followed Gu Junye back to his home. The Gu Family was a locally renowned Golden Core lineage, and Gu Junye, the second son of the patriarch, had his own independent courtyard.
Upon returning to his courtyard, as usual, he completed his academy's assigned homework. By then, night had fallen.
Standing in the yard, he spread his arms wide and slowly closed his eyes, basking under the moonlight.
After a long while, he opened his eyes and gazed at the bright silver moon in the sky, a look of reminiscence in his eyes, as if missing someone from a past era.
Shifting his gaze, he sighed softly, "Who would've thought that even the power of the moon's radiance is so scarce now? The day of my cultivation restoration seems infinitely far away. When will I be able to regain my cultivation level? Could it be that we are now in the age of decay?"
"I truly miss those days when I roamed the world freely. I wonder if the people of this world still remember the title of 'Master of All Laws.' I'm afraid it has been forgotten."
"The ancients are gone, and the past cannot be pursued."
Feeling a pang in his right eye, he covered it and grimaced, "Swallow the Sky, I fear you're the only one who still remembers me."
"Young Master, dinner is ready," the housekeeper respectfully called from the doorway.
Gu Junye set aside his nostalgic feelings, "I can't believe I can no longer fast. If Xuanyuan, the Sword Master, and the Immortal Sage knew, they would probably die laughing."
"We have your favorite ginseng duck soup."
"Got it, I'll be right there."
After dining with his family, Gu Junye returned to his room, took out his brush, ink, paper, and inkstone, and grasping the hem of his clothes, began to grind and paint.
With intense concentration, he fixed his eyes on the tip of the brush, holding his breath. After an hour, a picture of "Master of All Laws' Proof of Immortality" sprang onto the paper, and he wrote down his past life's story in the blank spaces.
At sixteen, he stepped onto the path of cultivation, established his Foundation at seventeen, formed his Golden Core at eighteen, and his Nascent Soul at nineteen. He broke the record for the fastest cultivation speed, becoming the youngest Nascent Soul cultivator and making countless old Nascent Souls hold him in awe, addressing him as a fellow daoist.
Gu Junye put down the brush, satisfied with the painting. Known as the "Painting Saint" in his previous life, though he had lost much of his power, painting such a work was still effortless.
He tidied up his Four Treasures of the Study and fell into a peaceful sleep.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, hiding on the rooftop, looked around awkwardly, not wanting to continue their surveillance of Gu Junye.
"Old Lu, keep an eye on this kid. I'm going out for a bit."
Lu Yang grabbed Meng Jingzhou, who was ready to flee, "Don't even think about running. Did you forget the oath we swore when we became brothers, to share weal and woe together?"
Meng Jingzhou retorted angrily, "Bullshit, I never became sworn brothers with you!"
"I think this young man is quite suitable for cultivation," Fairy Eternity concluded after observing for a long time.
"Why?" Lu Yang didn't understand.
"Yingtian Immortal and the others used to talk like this, saying it's the mindset of the strong, and they encouraged me to learn from it. Although I don't quite understand their thinking, there must be something to it, which might actually be helpful for cultivation," she said.
Lu Yang: "..."
Early in the morning, Gu Junye washed his face, got himself neat and tidy, and jogged to the academy.
"The Great Era is approaching, and even though I'm not of age for cultivation yet, I can prepare in advance. Jogging strengthens the body and builds physical fitness," he reasoned.
Gu Junye struck a pose, his eyes cold yet resolute, and quickly jogged toward the academy.
Gu Junye loved to jog in the early morning when the streets were sparsely populated, so he didn't have to worry about bumping into pedestrians.
As he turned a street corner, a figure suddenly rushed out—it was the pitiful-looking Mu Xi.
Gu Junye's habit of jogging to the academy was well-known, and Mu Xi had waited there early just to bump into Gu Junye!
Her scheme was successful!
Seeing Gu Junye getting closer and unable to stop, Mu Xi felt a thrill of joy. She pretended to be startled, screamed, and left her hands awkwardly in the air, making it easier for Gu Junye to catch her.
But soon Mu Xi couldn't laugh anymore as Gu Junye sent her flying two meters away, sprawling on the ground.
"Junior Sister Mu Xi, are you alright?" Gu Junye watched her vigilantly, for his Master of All Laws eyes perceived that this girl might have an enchanting immortal body, which could bring chaos to the nation in the future, and he should avoid too much contact.
"I'm, I'm fine," Mu Xi felt like she had been hit by a horse carriage when Gu Junye bumped into her; now her head was spinning.
Despite the future troubles she might cause to the nation, Gu Junye, feeling guilty for knocking her down, kindly helped Mu Xi up.
"Thank you, Senior Brother Junye."
Gu Junye frowned and corrected, "There are distinctions between men and women. We don't have much of a relationship, so you shouldn't address me so intimately."
"Moreover, your academic performance is too poor. My mother has always taught me not to associate with those who have poor academic records."
Mu Xi: "..."
Out of guilt, Gu Junye took Mu Xi to the academy. Her cheeks flushed, and the male students at the academy felt envy seeing them together.
The female students felt the same.
However, some classmates thought they were a natural match, a perfect couple.
Mu Xi secretly looked up to gauge Gu Junye's reaction. Noticing that Mu Xi was looking at him, Gu Junye frowned inwardly. Could it be that Mu Xi had seen the Swallow the Sky beast sealed within his eyes?
The teacher came on stage with an iron ruler and textbook, beginning today's lesson.
The academy advocated not just book learning but also physical strength. After an hour of teaching, the instructor had the students run around the academy.
After the run, Mu Xi's face changed suddenly.
"Junior Sister Mu Xi, what's wrong?"
"I lost the jade bracelet my father gave me! I had it clipped in my book while I was jogging, and now I can't find it!"
"What? How can this be good?"
Hearing this, the classmates became somewhat agitated; everyone knew about Mu Xi's jade bracelet and its considerable value.
"Search—It must be hidden in this room!"
"Right, it has to be here!"
Following someone's suggestion, the classmates echoed the sentiment.
Soon, the jade bracelet was found.
"Mu Yu, it was you who stole it!"

chapters.title: Chapter 702 - 701: Very Much in Line with Elder Brother Dai's Standards
chapters.content:
```plaintext
Everyone looked in unison at Mu Yu's wrist, where the jade bracelet matched exactly the description offered by Mu Xi.
"Mu Yu, what have you got to say for yourself now!"
"It's not like that. Father gave both me and Sister Mu Xi a jade bracelet each. This one is mine," Mu Yu explained in panic.
"With Mu Xi's bracelet gone, and now it turns up with you claiming it's yours, do you have any proof?"
Mu Yu was at a loss for words, how could she explain this?
"Return the jade bracelet to Junior Sister Mu Xi immediately!"
"Sister, if you wanted this bracelet to make a pair, you could have just told me directly. Why go through all this?"
"I can prove whose bracelet it is," Gu Junye suddenly said.
The crowd turned to Gu Junye, not understanding why he would suddenly take Mu Yu's side.
Gu Junye, who had never cared about the opinions of others, spoke in a cool voice, "This morning, I accidentally knocked Junior Sister Mu Xi two meters away. Given the situation then, it's certain that her bracelet wouldn't have remained unscathed."
"Look at the bracelet on Mu Yu's wrist. Not a single flaw can be seen, clearly, it has not been in any collision."
The first student who noticed Mu Yu with the bracelet was not happy: "What if the bracelet is of such good quality that it didn't break from the collision?"
Slowly, Gu Junye explained, "There's another method. Do you know why the government office often requires criminals to provide a thumbprint?"
"Take a look at the inside of your own fingers. Do you see the lines circling? That's called a fingerprint, and everyone's fingerprint is unique. Whenever you touch something, your fingerprint naturally leaves a mark."
"However, with our naked eyes, we can't discern anything. I suggest we report this to the government office and ask a cultivator to use their Dharma eye to discern. Naturally, we will know the answer."
"Fine, then let's report it to the officials!"
Quickly, a constable with cultivation level arrived from the government office to examine Mu Yu's jade bracelet.
"How strange, there are no fingerprints," the constable frowned.
Mu Xi smirked inwardly, knowing that calling in a cultivator would be useless. Her family had connections within the government office, and having been exposed to such knowledge, she was aware of fingerprints. Both she and her sister Mu Yu had the habit of bathing every night, washing away any fingerprints in the warm water. Not a trace was left.
"There are no fingerprints, which means this bracelet belongs to Mu Yu," Gu Junye said indifferently, while looking at both Mu Yu and Mu Xi.
"This morning, when I knocked Junior Sister Mu Xi down and helped her up, I had touched her bracelet. There should be my fingerprints on it."
"It's fortunate that Brother Constable is here, so he can thoroughly search the room to see where the bracelet really is."
"Ah, I've found the bracelet," Mu Xi suddenly said, offering everyone an apologetic smile, "It was pressed under the very bottom of some books."
"Junior Sister Mu Xi, you're too careless."
"Indeed, indeed. You've worried us all." Everyone breathed a sigh of relief and indicated to Mu Xi not to dwell on the matter.
"Wait a minute, this isn't over yet. You searched someone's belongings on a whim and falsely accused Mu Yu. You owe her an apology," Gu Junye said with a frown.
"Gu Junye, I'm warning you not to go too far!" the student who first found Mu Yu with the bracelet shouted angrily, "Are you expecting all these people to apologize to Mu Yu?"
"Not everyone. Him, her, her, her..." Gu Junye pointed out a few people, "These people didn't say anything earlier, so they don't need to apologize."
"You!"
"And Junior Sister Mu Xi, though you didn't falsely accuse Mu Yu, your carelessness caused Brother Constable to come here for nothing, wasting his time. You need to apologize to Brother Constable and everyone here."
"Junye is right," the teacher said, holding a metal ruler and intermittently tapping his palm in a frightening rhythm.
Under duress, everyone grudgingly apologized one by one.
After the incident, Mu Xi found Gu Junye in private and said in a low voice,
```
"Junye, there's really no need for things between us to be this tense,"
Gu Junye didn't answer. He had already said their relationship wasn't that close; whoever Junye was, he certainly wasn't him.
"Junye, my father thinks we are well suited for each other. Tonight he plans to propose to your family and set the marriage arrangement."
Only then did Gu Junye react, looking up at Mu Xi.
As the reincarnation of a Great Power who had passed tribulation, how could he ruin his vital essence here? How would he cultivate in the future?
He remained silent, continuing to read his book, as if he didn't care about the matter.
Seeing this, Mu Xi stood for a while before leaving.
In truth, it was she who had spoken to her father in private, expressing her wish to marry Gu Junye.
It didn't matter to her that Gu Junye had no feelings for her. Once the marriage was arranged and they had reasons to interact, he would slowly come to like her.
After school, just as Mu Xi had said, the Mu family came to the Gu family with betrothal gifts to propose marriage.
Gu Junye's father, the head of the Gu family, had already discussed and agreed to the marriage during the day. Now it was just a formality.
Both the Gu and the Mu families were Golden Core influential families. Whether considering their backgrounds or appearances, Gu Junye and Mu Xi were a perfect match.
"No, I disagree with this marriage," Gu Junye declared openly in front of everyone, opposing the decision of both families.
"Impudence! Since when do you have the right to speak here!" Gu Junye's father erupted in anger, feeling his face had been lost.
He had never really cared about this second son of his.
"I am one of the parties involved in the marriage arrangement. Why would I not have the right to speak?" Gu Junye ignored his father's rage. As the reincarnation of the Master of All Laws, not even the tribulation of ninety-nine stages to immortality could make him bow. Whom should he fear?
"The commands of the parents and the words of the matchmaker cannot be defied!"
"You bumped into Mu Xi today. Men and women should not touch each other. How can Mu Xi marry someone else in the future with this on her record?"
"We are both families of cultivators. When we embark on the road of cultivation, it is normal for men and women to come into contact. Should we then differentiate between genders in battle as well?"
In his past life, he didn't know how many female cultivators of the Demon Path he had slain; was he supposed to marry each of them as well?
"Making a fuss for no reason!"
Unable to win the argument with Gu Junye, his father could only accuse him of making a fuss.
Tears welling in her eyes, Mu Xi looked at Gu Junye: "Junye, do you dislike me that much?"
Faced with so many people, Gu Junye's father couldn't come down off his pedestal, and Mu Xi's father came forward to smooth things over: "It's nothing, just a child throwing a tantrum. Once they enter the bridal chamber, it'll all be fine."
"I won't enter the bridal chamber."
"You have no say in the matter, I will see you to the bridal chamber if I have to force you!"
Upon hearing this, Gu Junye said nothing, but nodded and walked to the door. He invited in several constables who had been waiting outside for a long time.
"Constable brothers, see, what did I tell you? There's a case of violent interference with the freedom of marriage here. They want to forcefully take me to the bridal chamber."
When he learned of his impending marriage arrangement, he went to file a report after school before returning home.
...
Secretly observing, Meng Jingzhou looked towards Lu Yang, holding Gu Junye in high regard: "He abides by the law, conducts himself with honesty and integrity, and cultivates earnestly. He fits Elder Brother Dai's criteria perfectly. This must be the person Elder Brother Dai is looking for."
Lu Yang also nodded: "He's a promising candidate suitable for joining our Seek Dao Sect."

chapters.title: Chapter 703 - 702: The Temple of Immortals
chapters.content:
The two family heads, under the pressure of the constables, were forced to annul the recently settled betrothal.
Gu Junye did not choose to make a big fuss. The crime of violently interfering with marital freedom was ignored if unreported, and since the party involved withdrew the accusation, there were no repercussions.
After the constables left, Gu Junye furrowed his brows, pondering over an issue.
If his father were to be imprisoned due to the crime of violently interfering with marital freedom, would it affect his imperial examination?
"It seems my mastery of the law is still not proficient enough," Gu Junye reflected inwardly and decided not to absorb the power of moonlight tonight but to continue studying the law instead.
Even though he was the reincarnation of a great power from ancient times, that was a long time ago, and the current environment is different from the ancient times. Only by adapting in advance could he follow the Righteous Path.
That's why he listened attentively in class and studied diligently after class, his grades far ahead of his peers, earning him praise from his tutors who believed he could become the second top scorer in the exams.
"Why don't you go find an alchemist to refine an elixir that can lift the curse?" Lu Yang said to Meng Jingzhou.
After observing, Gu Junye indeed appeared to be the person Elder Brother Dai was looking for, so there was no need to further assess his character.
Of course, the main reason was that observing this young man was too embarrassing, even for Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou with their thick skins.
"Okay," Meng Jingzhou took the pill formula dictated by Fairy Eternity and written by Lu Yang.
Finding an alchemist was easy. The Land Money Trade Association offered potion-making services, and even if the association's alchemists were not the best in town, they were top-notch and ranked within the top five, capable enough to make such a beginner level elixir.
"Xi'er, let's go," Father Mu said.
Mu Xi did not expect Gu Junye to be so heartless. To avoid marrying her, he actually called the constables!
"Junye, you'll regret this! There is a flaw in your fate, and only I can mend it. Besides me, anyone you care for will be harmed because of you!"
Gu Junye remained unmoved. He didn't believe in fate; if he did, he would not have defied the heavens and achieved Immortality in his previous life.
Cultivation is about defying the heavens!
"My fate is in my own hands, not decreed by heaven."
Fairy Eternity warned Lu Yang, "You mustn't have such thoughts. Yingtian Immortal is particularly harsh on those who do."
Lu Yang nodded repeatedly. The Yingtian Immortal claimed to be born in accordance with the heavens, so suddenly declaring one's fate not subject to heaven's will was directly opposing Yingtian Immortal.
Even if you harbor such thoughts, you can't voice them.
After Meng Jingzhou revealed his identity at the Land Money Trade Association, the person in charge soon personally attended to Young Master Meng with a very friendly attitude. Upon hearing that Young Master Meng wanted to refine an elixir, the association's master refiner was immediately summoned.
Theoretically, any apprentice refiner with ten years of experience could make the elixir Meng Jingzhou intended to produce, but that would not reflect the due importance placed on him.
Even without the status of Young Master Meng of the Meng Family, just the words 'Nascent Soul Stage disciple of the Seek Dao Sect' were enough to garner the same respect.
This was the status equivalent to Divinity Transformation Stage, while the strongest in the city were merely at the Nascent Soul Stage.
"Remember, the elixir should dissolve in water and be colorless and tasteless," Meng Jingzhou reminded, planning to administer the elixir to Gu Junye in secret.
"Uh, Young Master Meng, may I remind you that poisoning is a crime," the person in charge of the association warned, not knowing the purpose of the pill formula, intending it as a friendly reminder.
Meng Jingzhou's face darkened, "I know."
Soon, a tray held a single gray elixir.
Meng Jingzhou was slightly disappointed, thinking that if someone from Elixir Cauldron Peak had made it, there should at least be an Elixir Pattern on it.
But he couldn't be too particular; where would he find an Elder Brother from the Elixir Cauldron Peak now? As long as the curse could be lifted, it was sufficient.
Meng Jingzhou accepted the elixir and went to the Gu Family to meet up with Lu Yang.
"How is the observation going?"
"My shoes are nearly torn from pacing."
Meng Jingzhou took out the elixir, Fairy Eternity glanced at it, confirmed it was indeed the type she had described, and Meng Jingzhou then confidently dissolved the elixir in the Gu Family's duck soup for dinner.
Gu Junye finished drinking the duck soup and wiped his mouth, showing no signs of irregularity.
"No reaction?"
Fairy Eternity rolled her eyes, "What reaction do you want? Although the curse was cast on this young man, its effects influence those around him. After lifting the curse, naturally, he won't feel anything different."
"Let's go check on the Mu Family," Lu Yang called out to Meng Jingzhou, as Mu Xi had shown an abnormal reaction to the annulment of the marriage.
The two sneaked to the Mu Family under the cover of darkness and spied on Mu Xi's boudoir.
Inside the boudoir, Mu Xi was clenching her teeth and pinching a red paper doll, with Gu Junye's birthdate written on the back of it.
"Gu Junye, you'll regret this!"
The red paper effigy was a treasure she had sought from a temple outside the city that could cause anyone who stayed near Gu Junye for an extended period to develop heart disease.
That way, Gu Junye would have no choice but to marry her!
Suddenly, the paper effigy self-combusted, scalding her fingers and making her scream in pain!
It wasn't just the pain in her hands, her heart ached fiercely too!
"Ah!"
"Why is the paper effigy burning up?"
To maintain the effigy's power, she had to drip a drop of blood on it every day, dyeing the white paper effigy red by force.
This was actually a method of creating a Life-bound Magical Treasure, and now that it was burning up, she was experiencing backlash, with the heartache being one of the symptoms!
"Go to the temple!"
Feeling that something was terribly wrong, she panicked and fled to the temple outside the city.
"Follow her!" Lu Yang sent a message to Meng Jingzhou through spiritual voice transmission.
They had only been in Lintian City for less than two days and hadn't heard of any temple.
No one knew when the temple had been established; it seemed to have appeared overnight. The location of the temple was secretive, known to very few.
Mu Xi had stumbled upon it by accident when a classmate mentioned that praying at the temple before exams could lead to good grades.
The temple had neither a temple keeper nor incense offerings, only a statue of an amiable-looking elderly clay sculptor. The temple was as clean as new, as if divine beings mysteriously protected it.
"Immortal, my paper effigy has burned up!"
A voice echoed in the temple: "Someone has broken the curse, and you are suffering the backlash."
"And the one who broke it is already stealthily tracking you."
Lu Yang was startled; they had been discovered!
The other's Cultivation Level was higher than both him and Old Meng!
A powerful assault rushed towards Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou. Lu Yang quickly drew the Green Peak Sword to defend, while Meng Jingzhou let out a loud shout, tensing his muscles to withstand the attack with his body.
The gap between their realms was too great, and they were directly swept out of the temple, crashing into the trees outside!
The huge clay statue seemed to come alive, opening its eyes and stepping down from the altar. It supported itself with the temple door as it bent over and walked out from the temple.
The three-meter-tall clay sculpture looked down at the two men with a cold gaze.
"Fairy, what is this?"
"This is a method of worship, his true form is unable to continue being used for unknown reasons, only his soul remains."
"In order to obtain a physical body, he constructed this temple here, satisfying the desires of believers to garner their faith!"
"This method is from the era of the Great Qian," Lu Yang gritted his teeth. If the characteristic of the Great Yu Dynasty is the "Imperial Teacher system," then that of the Great Qian Dynasty is "spirituality" and "faith."
"What realm?"
"The Body Integration Realm."
The clay sculpture looked at the two men coldly, its mouth curving into a humanized, sinister smile.
"Two ignorant juniors, you appear to be geniuses from some Great Sects."
"I didn't want to cause unnecessary killing, but since you are aware of my existence, I cannot allow you to live!"
The oppressive aura of the Body Integration Realm enveloped them, making them unable to move.
Suddenly, a roar came from the sky, like the legend of a dragon's chant.
A white horse without a single stray hair arrived through the air, kicking over the clay sculpture with one hoof, its gaze proud and domineering!
A few dragon scales on the brow of the white horse emitted a faint light in the dark night.
The clay sculpture was kicked over and lay still, staring dead at the white horse.
"Great Demon King!"
How could a Dragon-Horse King of the Great Demons appear here!

chapters.title: Chapter 704 - 703: Excited Old Ma
chapters.content:
The clay figure became very excited upon seeing Old Ma, but Old Ma was even more thrilled at the sight of the clay figure.
It wasn't easy, it was finally going to be a Protector for once!
Was it easy to encounter an opponent at the Body Integration Realm?
Meng Jingzhou, that kid, finally drew in an enemy at the Body Integration Realm, and there was only one.
As soon as it felt the commotion from outside the city while in the stable, he rushed over immediately!
Fearing that enemies beyond its capabilities would show up later.
This time was a rare opportunity that absolutely couldn't be missed!
The clay figure stared at Old Ma, whose bloodline was pure, undoubtedly a great demon king from the Dragon horse clan living in the East Sea!
"You..."
The clay figure had barely uttered a word when Old Ma stepped on the void, and a pure white True Dragon illusory shadow appeared behind him, the standard for a pure-blooded Dragon horse clan!
The white True Dragon illusory shadow coiled into a circle, resembling the moon in the sky!
Old Ma wouldn't give the clay figure a chance to speak, for the night was long and rife with dreams, so the fight needed to be swift!
The clay figure didn't expect Old Ma to be so disrespectful, not even exchanging a few pleasantries before starting the fight.
He was a Great Yu Cultivator, and in the long span of more than a hundred thousand years, his slumbering technique went awry. When he woke up, he found his body had decayed, leaving only his soul.
Having no other choice and unwilling to start over through possession, which could take who knows how long, he chose the Belief Sculpting Technique passed down from the Great Qian Dynasty and picked Lin Tian City, a rather unremarkable city.
He thought he had been cautious enough since this place hardly saw a Body Integration Realm cultivator in decades. How could he have encountered a great demon king at the Body Integration Realm on such a quiet night?
Where did this member of the Demon Race spring from, and isn't Great Xia going to do something about it?
Accompanied by an excited dragon's cry from Old Ma, his fur shook as he leaped into the air, his Qi and Blood turning into raging flames, charging at the clay figure on auspicious clouds and fierce flames.
Horse Stomping All Under Heaven!
The clay figure's ten fingers shot out, summoning endless water from thin air, forming a wall of water that pressed toward Old Ma. Old Ma's mouth gaped wide as the dragon scale at his brow twinkled twice, and the wall of water split in the middle, allowing Old Ma to race through.
Water Splitting Technique!
He had spent years living in the East Sea, playing with seawater with ease. That the opponent dared to play with water in front of him was like not knowing how to spell death!
The clay figure didn't expect Old Ma to easily pass through the water wall, disrupting his chance to attack. All four of Old Ma's hooves kicked out simultaneously, like four imposing mountains, and shattered the clay figure!
"This is too much!" the clay figure roared in anger. Even if he hadn't recovered to his peak period, he shouldn't be beaten so miserably by another demon king of the same realm.
A third eye split open between the clay figure's brows, revealing a natural Heavenly Eye. Although it wasn't as powerful as the Immortal Dao's Heavenly Eye, it held many secrets and helped him excel in the Body Integration Realm.
The third eye released a beam of golden light, freezing Old Ma in that space, unable to move.
Old Ma didn't panic; instead, he revealed a joyful smile.
Two mystical horns appeared on Old Ma's head, the unique dragon horns of the Long Clan!
He neighed long and loud, exhaling demonic energy from his mouth and nose. Sweat streamed down and evaporated, turning into mist.
The clay figure clenched his teeth tightly, trying to forcefully suppress Old Ma, but now that Old Ma had revealed his dragon horns, there was no way he could be suppressed.
Old Ma was as fast as lightning, riding the light as he moved, slightly lowering his neck to ram the clay figure with his dragon horns!
"Golden Armor Protector Divine Seal!"
A seal emerged from the brow of the clay figure, a protective mantra he had learned from the Buddha Country, extremely powerful!
But in front of Old Ma, the mantra was like a layer of tissue paper, easily punctured. The clay figure was struck by the dragon horns, and his lower body was smashed to pieces, with thousands of strands of Metal Qi from the dragon horns cutting it to dust.
The clay figure used many divine abilities with his third eye, lighting up the sky and making it as bright as day, but all were neutralized by Old Ma.
Under passive defense, the clay figure was forced back constantly.
"Old Ma is quite excited," muttered Meng Jingzhou.
It had been nearly three years since he had seen Old Ma so active.
"I don't care who you are, or what the outcome today is, you will surely be hunted down in the future!" the clay figure shouted, unclear whether he was bluffing or threatening.
Old Ma grew even more excited upon hearing this, which meant the clay figure had no reinforcements now.
Why not beat him harder, then?
The white dragon illusory shadow merged with Old Ma, his Dragon's Blood boiling to the heavens. Old Ma transformed into a hundred-zhang long Dragon horse, his brow dragon scales covering his body like gleaming white armor.
If there were any cultivators who had fought with Old Ma who saw this move, they would've fled as far as they could.
Dragon's Battle in the Wild is a technique that even Meng Jingzhou's father would dare not face head-on.
```
"No!" The clay statue let out a desperate scream.
Boom!
The clay statue crumbled into dust under the impact, dying without a complete corpse.
Old Ma proudly snorted, returning to normal size.
Content.
The commotion here quickly attracted the attention of the government office, and the City Lord hurriedly brought people over to investigate the situation.
"City Lord, your arrival is timely. This one named Mu Xi cursed others and we've caught him red-handed," Lu Yang presented Mu Xi, who might not have lived had Lu Yang not protected him earlier.
At the same time, Lu Yang and his companion also showed their Identity Jades from the Seek Dao Sect to prove their identities.
The City Lord looked at the two with uncertainty. Were these disciples from the Seek Dao Sect? Catching a mortal caused such an uproar.
"Cough, it's not just about catching this mortal. Originally, there was a divine temple here, inside of which was enshrined an ancient figure from the Integration Stage," Meng Jingzhou explained awkwardly, as the divine temple had already been flattened in the recent battle.
Hearing Meng Jingzhou's description, the City Lord was petrified with fear; such an ancient being from the Integration Stage had been hidden so close to his jurisdiction.
"Thank you both for your help."
"It was merely our duty."
"We have other matters to attend to and must be going," the two men said as they clasped their fists and handed Mu Xi over to the City Lord to deal with. They and Old Ma returned to the city.
They still had tasks to complete.
"Shall we test Gu Junye's Spirit Root?" Lu Yang suggested.
If Gu Junye had at least Three Spirit Roots, he would be eligible to take the Seek Dao Sect's test.
It was late at night by then, when everyone should have been sleeping, but the battle had been so loud that everyone, including Gu Junye, had awakened.
Gu Junye stood in the courtyard with his hands behind his back, shivering. The cool breeze tousled his hair as he stared unblinkingly in the direction of the battle.
"Is the enemy... coming?"
Meng Jingzhou concealed his presence and waved a bone-testing stone near Gu Junye; inside the stone, a spotless water mass the size of half a fist emerged.
"Wow, a Water Spirit Root, this kid really has some potential."
Now that his character and qualifications posed no issues, Lu Yang and his companion revealed themselves, startling Gu Junye.
Fortunately, Gu Junye's Dao heart was unchangeable through the ages, and he quickly recovered.
He watched Lu Yang and his companion quietly and sighed softly, "Has the day finally come?"
"... We are disciples of the Seek Dao Sect. You may have heard of our names. I am Lu Yang, and he is Meng Jingzhou."
The two were regular characters in storytelling.
Hearing their names, Gu Junye's look changed, "Xuanyuan Sword Master, the Unbreakable Sage... I never would have thought that you two had also reincarnated."
Lu Yang: "..."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
After a pause, Meng Jingzhou continued, "... After our assessment, we both agree that your character and qualifications meet the entry requirements of our Seek Dao Sect. You may come to the Seek Dao Sect on the second day of the second lunar month next year to take the entrance examination."
"This is a map to the Sect and some travel expenses," Meng Jingzhou gave Gu Junye a map and some Spirit Stones.
After everything was settled, as the two men were about to leave, Gu Junye stopped them.
"Wait a moment; could you fulfill one of my wishes? I am willing to do anything in return."
...
The next day, the academy was abuzz with discussions about the battle from the night before. Some said it was a battle between Great Cultivators, some said it was the Passing of the Thunder Tribulation, others thought the Demon Race had attacked; there were various speculations.
It wasn't until class began that people noticed Mu Xi was absent that day.
Mu Yu thought back to the government officers who had entered their home to search last night and was somewhat distracted.
Gu Junye sat in a corner as always, earnestly listening to the lecture.
Suddenly, two tall figures appeared at the classroom door, backlit and their features obscured.
Both the teacher and the students were taken aback, unsure who these two were.
"Who are you!" The teacher demanded.
The two figures walked into the classroom, ignoring the teacher's demand as though it didn't exist, and headed straight for the dazed Gu Junye. They sincerely clasped their fists and said.
"Fellow Daoist, we've finally found you. We're facing an unprecedented crisis, and only you can resolve it. This world needs you!"
```

chapters.title: Chapter 705 - 705: 704
chapters.content:
In the academy, both students and teachers were very surprised as they watched the two mysterious figures walk in.
These two figures seemed to naturally exude a mysterious aura; simply standing there, they gave off an imposing pressure.
Gu Junye saw these two approaching him and wasn't too surprised.
He sighed softly, "It seems I've finally been found by you."
One of the mysterious figures, with a hoarse voice that didn't match his youthful appearance, said, "Fellow Daoist, I know that since that incident, you've lost faith in the organization and chosen to live in seclusion here, but please believe in the organization."
The words of the mysterious figure touched a taboo in Gu Junye's heart. He clenched his fists tightly and suddenly looked up, with raging True Dragons seemingly roaring in his eyes.
"Believe in the organization?"
"If I believed in the organization, why would it send us on such a mission, a mission that was certain death?"
"Can you imagine, one second your friend is still talking and laughing, and the next they are pierced by tentacles, turned into a desiccated corpse?"
"Endless enemies surged like a tide, the Saint Monarch who was said to live in eternal light died, the Pan God with the power to create heaven and earth died..."
"All dead, all dead, only I am still alive!"
"Doesn't the organization know what it was like there? Where was the organization when we were trapped, where was the support?"
The other mysterious figure's face was covered with knife scars, as if he had experienced one bloody battle after another. He had fought countless times, and his Dao heart was as firm as iron, but when he looked at Gu Junye, his heart also trembled.
The mysterious figure remembered all the deeds of the person before him, which to them were like myths and legends.
He traversed the long river of history, leaving legends of his own at every node, undergoing the nine cycles of reincarnation, cutting down immortals with strength, and balancing the three realms of heaven, earth, and humanity with his power alone.
The mysterious figure explained with a tone of bitterness, "The organization was held back by heavenly enemies and couldn't come to your aid."
He pointed to the scars on his face, "These wounds were left during that time."
"Fellow Daoist, the monsters from the Abyss are crawling up again, the organization needs your help, this world needs your salvation!"
Gu Junye stared at the two mysterious figures, as if seeing the images of old friends in them.
He slowly stood up, resigning himself with a sigh, "Well then, I shall make the journey."
Seeing Gu Junye agree, the stern faces of the two mysterious figures couldn't help but reveal smiles.
"Please, fellow Daoist!"
Without the intention of explaining to the crowd, Gu Junye left the classroom, surrounded by the two mysterious figures, under the watchful eyes of everyone.
He looked up at the sky and with a profound leap, disappeared into thin air.
...
"So you're just going to stay here for half a day and head straight home after school?" Once outside the city, the two mysterious figures changed their faces, revealing their true identities.
The two mysterious figures turned out to be Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou!
"Thank you, Senior-Brothers," Gu Junye said, bowing with fists clasped, his face flushed with excitement.
Meng Jingzhou waved his hand, "It's no big deal."
Lu Yang patted Gu Junye's shoulder, "You must come next February, I have high hopes for you!"
After that, the two sat in a carriage and went to the next place.
"You know, this is quite fun."
"Right? I think so too."
```
...
After the two left, about half a day passed before two figures flew in from afar, landing at the ruins of the immortal temple,
they frowned tightly at the sight of the collapsed temple and the broken clay sculptures scattered all around.
"The life-token isn't mistaken, Wang Chuan has truly perished."
"But how is this possible? Although he was still in the process of reconstituting his physical body, he was at the Body Integration Realm. The strongest cultivator in this city is only at the Nascent Soul Stage, how could they have harmed Wang Chuan?"
"Could it be a passing Great Xia Body Integration who discovered him?"
"That shouldn't be it either, Wang Chuan was formidable. Unless he encountered a top-tier Body Integration cultivator, he should have been able to escape."
"How strange."
"Once we see what happened at that time, everything will become clear."
One of them silently recited an incantation, and the faith energy scattered around began to coalesce once again. Although they couldn't bring Wang Chuan back to life, they could review last night's events through the faith energy.
Last night's scenes appeared in the palm of a hand: two Nascent Soul Stage geniuses discovered Wang Chuan. As Wang Chuan made a move, he was suppressed by a white horse that descended from the sky. In a flash of lightning, Wang Chuan was vanquished, his soul annihilated by the white horse.
Watching the illusory shadow, the two figures shivered upon seeing the white horse perform "Dragon-Horse Unification, Dragon Battles in the Wilderness."
If it were them, they likely wouldn't have been able to withstand this move either.
"Those two Nascent Soul Stage cultivators look somewhat familiar... I remember now, aren't they the two rising stars from the Seek Dao Sect? This one is called Lu Yang, once fought evenly matched against the Young Sect Master of the Heavenly Court Sect." One of them realized suddenly, they would not even have noticed Lu Yang's existence if not for the Heavenly Court Sect.
"Who's the white horse then?"
"Don't know, never seen it before."
"Let's take this intelligence back for our superior to see."
The two immediately flew back to headquarters.
```
