```
The headquarters was located in a newly opened space. The two knocked on the door, verified their identities with their spiritual power, and entered the space.
In the space, there were powerhouses as numerous as the clouds, and each individual possessed unique skills renowned in history. Although the two were at the Body Integration Realm, they ranked at the bottom among these people and were responsible for running errands.
"Master, this is the scene before Wang Chuan's demise."
The two presented a magic artifact respectfully, temporarily refined from faith energy.
The leader was a youth who appeared even younger than Lu Yang.
Wang Chuan held substantial influence in the Body Integration Realm, and his unexpected demise took everyone by surprise. Therefore, his death was treated with utmost importance, and if possible, they were determined to avenge Wang Chuan.
Otherwise, if subordinates died at will in the outside world and he remained indifferent, it would dishearten his followers, who might then defect to Wu Youdao.
This was the Great Yu Alliance headquarters, aimed at gathering all the slumbering cultivators from the Great Yu Era. The rise of Great Xia was beyond expectations, so some advocated the notion that there is strength in numbers, moving together as one. Since they believed there was no future with Wu Youdao, the sixth Emperor Yu, they formed another power faction.
They hadn't heard from Wu Youdao in a long time and wondered what he was scheming in secrecy.
The Imperial Teacher thought it best to plot first and then act. With such a long absence of news, perhaps he was preparing to do something earth-shattering.
The youth watched the depiction of Wang Chuan's last moments and suddenly lit up with inspiration, even temporarily setting aside the thought of avenging Wang Chuan.
He was fixated on the sword in Lu Yang's hand, his excitement palpable, and a greedy look flashed in his eyes: "Emperor Yu's personal sword!"
Although it looked different from the original, he recognized the origin of the Green Peak Sword in an instant.
Everyone was astonished; they all knew the youth looked down on Wu Youdao. The only one he would refer to as "Emperor Yu" was none other than the founding monarch of the Great Yu Dynasty, Wu Yao.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 706 - 705: The Sacrifice of the Great Yu Dynasty
chapters.content:
How did Emperor Yu's personal sword end up in the hands of this junior cultivator? Was it dug up from an ancient tomb?
People let their imaginations run wild, while the young man's confidants knew more about the matter.
They had heard the young man say that Emperor Yu, Wu Yao, had long since become an Immortal, only it was unknown to the public.
What does Emperor Yu's personal sword signify? It signifies an Immortal Sword!
This is something all Semi-Immortals dream of possessing.
No wonder the adult was so excited.
"Which of you knows who the holder of the Immortal Sword is?" the young man had not paid attention to the younger generation, as it was unnecessary to do so until a genius had grown up.
There are so many talents in the world, and he was once one of the many talents. Now, looking back, how many are still alive? Only himself.
"Reporting to the adult, this person is named Lu Yang, a disciple of the Dao Seeking Sect Master, who once fought to a draw with the Heavenly Court Sect Young Master during the Golden Core Stage."
Hearing this, the young man began to take Lu Yang a bit more seriously.
But just slightly.
"One of the Five Immortal Sects, the Dao Seeking Sect, huh..."
Seeing the young man seemed somewhat interested, a confidant advised telepathically, "My lord, Lu Yang holds Emperor Yu's personal sword, which may have been bestowed by Emperor Yu himself. We must not act rashly."
This Lu Yang, could he possibly be a direct disciple of Emperor Yu? Otherwise, how could he obtain Emperor Yu's personal sword?
Combining that with Lu Yang's feats, being able to fight the Heavenly Court Young Master to a draw—and it is said that the Young Master's master is Heavenly Venerate Dou of the Heavenly Court, a true Ancient Immortal.
It makes sense for a disciple of an Ancient Immortal and a disciple of Emperor Yu to be evenly matched.
The young man did not become angry at his confidant's caution, but instead laughed heartily with a meaningful expression, "If I were not privy to the inside story, what you say would indeed make sense. Unfortunately, your guess is impossible. Emperor Yu is no longer amongst us."
The confidant was shocked upon hearing this. Emperor Yu was gone? What did that mean? Emperor Yu was an Immortal, how could he no longer be present?
"What do you think was the reason Emperor Yu allowed the dynasty to be destroyed?" The young man asked in return, but it sounded more like he was talking to himself, "He was seeking an opportunity, an opportunity to leave this world."
The young man had a nostalgic look in his eyes, "Ever since ancient times, this world has been sealed. No one can leave; no one can enter. Since Emperor Yu rose in the last era of Great Qian, contended for the world with many heroes, and established the Great Yu Dynasty with overwhelming authority, and his Cultivation Level is that of an Immortal.
Whether you look at the scale of his power, his Cultivation Level, or his life experience, he had reached the pinnacle of existence and had no further room for advancement."
"So he always wanted to leave this world, to see what the outside was like."
"Wu Youdao shouted the slogan of restoring Great Yu. Did Emperor Yu not know? Of course, he knew, he just didn't need to care."
"Rather than saying the Great Yu Dynasty was destroyed, it would be more accurate to say that Emperor Yu personally sacrificed his own dynasty. As for what method he used, you don't need to know. That's the power of Dao Fruit; I could explain it to you, but you wouldn't remember."
"After the destruction of Great Yu, I saw Emperor Yu several more times. He hadn't left, perhaps he hadn't met some condition yet. Until recently, I felt a momentary burst of Emperor Yu's presence, which erupted and then dissipated, and there was no longer such a person in this world, and I believe it was then that Emperor Yu left this world."
"So, you don't have to worry about Emperor Yu coming back. He has already left this world. This young man named Lu Yang just happened to come upon Emperor Yu's personal sword by a twist of fate."
"Divine items belong to those who are capable. Lu Yang, a mere mortal with only Nascent Soul Stage Cultivation Level, how is he qualified to possess such divine treasures?"
"I guess the conditions for Emperor Yu to leave this world were harsh, perhaps requiring not just the sacrifice of the Great Yu Dynasty, but also of himself, and in the end, only he was able to leave, unable to take anything with him, hence he left his sword behind."
"So what I am interested in is not merely a sword, but everything that Emperor Yu has left behind!"
"And the clue lies with this kid named Lu Yang."
The youth stared at the replay of Lu Yang once more, murmuring an incantation, his fingers calculating Lu Yang's location when suddenly his body trembled inexplicably, as if someone had slapped him.
"Hiss, strange." The doubtful youth looked around, considering whether to recalculate, but after some thought, he decided against it.
"My lord, what's the matter?"
"I actually can't determine this kid's location—not just his, but also the location of the kid beside him and Old Ma... Ah, it must be Emperor Yu's sword that can sever anything, surely the Immortal Sword has cut off my connection with Lu Yang. Otherwise, this kid must have obtained some other mystical artifact that can block calculations."
The young man's expression became even greedier, "This kid has quite the fortune, it's probably going to be difficult to find his location."
"My lord, I have a plan," the confidant spoke. He was responsible for collecting intelligence on Great Xia and was the most informed about the situations of the major sects there.
"Let's hear it."
"As I know, the second day of the second month next year is the day when the Seek Dao Sect recruits disciples. That kid named Lu Yang will surely be at the Seek Dao Sect then."
"Moreover, at that time, the Seek Dao Sect will be busy organizing tests and won't have time to watch over him, their defenses will be lax, and we could take the opportunity to launch a major assault on the Seek Dao Sect, catching them off guard!"
"By then, not just the insignificant Lu Yang, but the entire Seek Dao Sect would be in the palm of your hand!"
The young man's eyes lit up; this was indeed a good idea, a perfect opportunity to eradicate the Seek Dao Sect and establish his authority.
Perhaps the mystical artifact left by Emperor Yu was obtained by the Seek Dao Sect and merely bestowed upon Lu Yang.
The artifacts left behind by Emperor Yu, and perhaps even the legendary "Sword Array of Immortal Annihilation" rumored to be from ancient times and improved by Emperor Yu himself, could be found in the Seek Dao Sect—with its power so great, it could bring Immortals to their knees!
"Sometimes you do come up with good ideas, kid."
The confidant bowed and nodded, "It's merely some tricks I've picked up from the master."
The young man was very pleased with the bootlicking from his subordinate.
...
"Strange," Fairy Eternity murmured.
"Fairy, what's the matter?" Lu Yang asked.
"Just now, someone tried to calculate your causality, but I casually blocked them. I'm not sure who's trying to scheme against you."
"The other party couldn't figure out your causality, and tried to indirectly calculate it through the Meng Family Kid and the little white horse, but I blocked them as well."
Lu Yang was equally puzzled. He had been following the teachings of Elder Brother Dai conscientiously and honestly all along; all the attention-seeking was done by Old Ma. Why would someone still want to scheme against him? "Is the other party strong?"
Fairy Eternity tilted her head, touching her chin, "Judging by how I waved them away with a flick of my hand, they're certainly not as strong as me."
Lu Yang: "..."
That's like not saying anything at all, isn't it? In your worldview, Fairy, is there anyone stronger than you?
"Although there's no one stronger than me, there are those with similar strength; for instance, Miss Yun. The adversary's power is certainly no match for Miss Yun's."

chapters.title: Chapter 707 - 706 Escape of Jin Chan
chapters.content:
Old Ma brought the two to the third destination: Quanzhou Yan Mountain City, named after the Yan Mountain it leans against.
"The third person is called Tao Tingfeng, fifteen years old, from Quanzhou Yan Mountain City. Eh, it was Man Gu who, after slaying demons at Yan Mountain, discovered him while passing through Yan Mountain City."
"What was Junior Brother Man's evaluation?" Lu Yang asked curiously.
Meng Jingzhou looked at the notes on the booklet, his expression odd: "He said Tao Tingfeng is timid and afraid of trouble, daring not to stir up disputes, and his character is far inferior to Brother Lu and Brother Meng."
"...Is Junior Brother Man praising us?"
Meng Jingzhou wasn't sure either: "Looking at the overall context, he should be praising the two of us."
Tao Tingfeng was born into a Nascent Soul family, a very influential and well-known large clan locally, and Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou found the Tao Family easily.
The private tutor hired by the Tao Family saved the Tao family disciples from having to attend the local private school.
Moreover, unlike most private schools, the Tao Family not only taught its disciples the words of the sages but also imparted knowledge of cultivation.
When Lu Yang and another sneaked into the Tao Family, Tao Tingfeng and the other Tao family disciples were listening to a lecture from a clan uncle.
The Tao family disciples all looked up to this clan uncle as an idol. He was quite gifted in the path of cultivation, reaching the Foundation Establishment Middle stage at only thirty, and the Tao Family people said he might break through to the Nascent Soul Stage, producing the second Nascent Soul ancestor for the family.
"In the path of cultivation, impatience is most to be feared. Before cultivating, one must cultivate the mind. Those who are restless and rash are prone to deviate into madness when cultivating..."
"Qi Refinement, Foundation Establishment, Golden Core, Nascent Soul...each realm is like a great stairwell, and ascending one can turn your status and position upside down."
"Don't look at our Tao Family as a Nascent Soul family, wielding some influence on this patch of land in Yan Mountain City. But once you leave Yan Mountain City and witness the Spirit Transformation families, you'll see that even our proud Nascent Soul family is nothing much."
"When I was young and traveled around Quanzhou, I once saw a peak Nascent Soul Great Power take action. It was truly like a thunderous roar from the mountains and seas, awe-inspiring and majestic, completely enthralling."
The Tao Family ancestor was also nothing more than a Nascent Soul Early Stage cultivator.
"For example, the great battle that happened in Yan Mountain City half a month ago, the Demon Race secretly infiltrated Great Xia and hid in Yan Mountain. Thanks to the Righteous Path expert who took action, killed the demons, otherwise, who knows what catastrophe might have occurred."
"If I am not mistaken, that must have been a legendary Divinity Transformation Stage Great Power."
Upon hearing the words "Divinity Transformation Stage", the Tao family disciples let out a collective gasp of amazement.
"This Nascent Soul Stage of the Tao Family..." Lu Yang, finding the lecture boring, sent a thread of his Spiritual Sense to probe the Tao Family ancestor's condition.
Although the Tao Family ancestor and Lu Yang were both at the Nascent Soul Early Stage, under normal circumstances individuals of the same level could not probe with Spiritual Sense, but Lu Yang was clearly not bound by the usual rules.
"What's up with the Tao Family ancestor?" Meng Jingzhou, unlike Lu Yang, was listening attentively to the lecture.
"Rather than saying he's at the Nascent Soul Stage, it's more like Half-step Nascent Soul Stage. It seems he has sequelae from forcing his breakthrough, possessing the power of a Nascent Soul but with a limit on the number of times he can take action," Lu Yang surmised.
Your Nascent Soul family's Nascent Soul seems a bit too forced, doesn't it?
"That's nothing," Meng Jingzhou waved it off. As a son of the premier influential family of the era, he had seen various families, "I've even seen a Golden Core Stage person consult a fortune teller, who said he was destined to reach the Nascent Soul Stage, and then he had his family publicly claim to be a Nascent Soul family."
After all, influential families are not like organizations certified by the Dynasty that need annual assessments. The strength of the family completely depends on what people say, and there is a lot of leeway in that.
Of course, the Meng Family definitely didn't have a hint of exaggeration; otherwise, they wouldn't still be living so well in the Imperial City.
"Class dismissed."
"Let's go, let's go, time to play." Kids of that age have a strong desire to play, and Tao Tingfeng was no exception.
Tao Tingfeng listened to his clan uncle recount the battle that took place in Yan Mountain, itchingly eager to check out the situation for himself.
Let's take a look.
After a moment of hesitation, Tao Tingfeng quickly made his decision and headed for Yan Mountain.
Although the Dynasty had sealed off Yan Mountain, forbidding entry to travelers, Tao Tingfeng had played on the mountain since he was young and knew a secret path.
Sure enough, that path wasn't blocked, and Tao Tingfeng made his way to the site of the battle on Yan Mountain with practiced ease.
The depths of Yan Mountain were full of deep pits punched out by Man Gu's fists, which Lu Yang recognized at a glance.
Seeing these deep pits, Tao Tingfeng's eyes bulged in shock—is this what combat at the Divinity Transformation Stage looked like?
Suddenly, something flashed across the sky and whooshed down towards Yan Mountain, landing not far from Tao Tingfeng, startling him immensely.
Tao Tingfeng originally didn't dare to approach, but his curiosity got the better of him, and he decided to take a look.
"It's a person!" Tao Tingfeng finally saw what had come crashing down—it was a cultivator, severely injured with only breath going in and none coming out.
The gravely injured cultivator tensed up when someone approached, but realizing that it was an unthreatening mortal, he relaxed.
Then he remembered, what difference did it make if it was a cultivator or a mortal? Even if the other had malicious intent, what could it matter? His injuries were beyond redemption, and without the need for anyone to act, he was going to die.
"Are you alright?" Tao Tingfeng approached the seriously wounded cultivator cautiously—the latter was obviously not okay.
The mortally wounded cultivator let out a wry laugh: "To think that I, Master Guanqi, would meet such an end, and the last person I see would be a youngster like you."
"I've calculated and calculated, but in the end, I just couldn't outwit fate."
"Master Guanqi?" Lu Yang muttered under his breath; in his memory, during the Great Qian, there indeed was a cultivator at the Body Integration Realm.
"Well then, it seems that my destiny was never meant to cross with this object."
At this moment, Tao Tingfeng noticed that Master Guanqi was clutching a wooden box tightly to his chest.
"This thing is called the Golden Cicada shedding skin; it's something I snatched from a troublesome opponent at a great cost, and to think that in the end, it would fall into the hands of a youngster like you."
"It seems this object and you are fated."
"Young man, this item is exceedingly rare through the ages, once you have it, you must be cautious above all, never allowing a second person to know that you possess it!"
With that, Master Guanqi closed his eyes peacefully, his body gradually turning into dust and vanishing, leaving behind only the wooden box.
Tao Tingfeng was bewildered by all these sudden changes; he brought his palms together and bowed twice toward the spot where Master Guanqi had disappeared. Then, with trembling hands, he opened the wooden box and found inside a glistening golden cicada shell.
"Fairy, what is the Golden Cicada shedding skin?" Lu Yang asked.
"In ancient times, there was a cicada demon who cultivated to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, a feat never before achieved by his kind; his entire body turned golden. He comprehended a divine ability named 'Golden Cicada shedding skin,' which could improve ones innate qualities. It was through this divine ability that he reached the Transcendance Tribulation Stage."
"The shell he left behind after his metamorphosis came to be known as 'Golden Cicada shedding skin,' a top-tier treasure for enhancing one's innate qualities."
"What happened to that cicada demon later on?"
"I crushed him to death," the fairy replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 708 - 707: The True Lord Watching the Game
chapters.content:
Lu Yang saw the death of the cicada demon as careless and felt silent for a while; he didn't even know the name of Jin Chan yet.
Fairy Eternity saw Lu Yang's silence and guessed what he was thinking, and with the attitude of someone who had been through it all, she spoke earnestly, "This is but a cruel aspect of the ancient battles, you need to adapt more."
"The cruel things I've experienced far exceed your imagination, even now, I do not wish to recall them."
Lu Yang had a realization, indeed, the struggles of the Great Era were life and death battles, far from the understated way Fairy Eternity described them, certainly involving bloody conflicts.
For Fairy Eternity, this was not a pleasant experience, which is why she didn't want to recall it.
"Back when I wanted to finish off Jin Chan, I even used my 'Universe in Palm,' getting juice all over my fingers, and the feeling still disgusted me when I think about it." Reminiscing about that battle, Fairy Eternity showed a look of disgust and symbolically shook her hands.
Fairy Eternity stood up from the bed, the mattress was soft, bouncing twice as she got up.
"You've seen 'Universe in Palm' before, right? The 'Universe in Palm' I used back then was this—big." Fairy Eternity stretched out her arms and gestured a large circle with effort.
Fairy Eternity then extended a finger, "It was like this at that time."
While speaking, she even poked Lu Yang a few times.
Lu Yang: "..."
Fairy, isn't that a bit too abstract of a gesture?
Tao Tingfeng carefully examined the golden cicada shed in the box, which seemed like an incredibly precious treasure.
He had heard from his clan uncle that only Integration Stage Experts were called true lords, which meant that Guanqi Zhenjun must have been in the Integration Stage.
A treasure a Integration Stage Expert was unwilling to part with until death, just shows how valuable this treasure must be.
"What do we do with this thing? Should we try to claim ownership?" Tao Tingfeng felt a surge of interest, this was a massive stroke of luck from the heavens.
Meng Jingzhou glanced at the booklet's comments on Man Gu, recalled Tao Tingfeng's recent actions, sneaking up the mountain and getting close to Guanqi Zhenjun, and muttered softly,
"How does this look like someone who is timid and fearful?"
Lu Yang, stroking his chin, speculated, "Do you think it's possible that Junior Brother Man is being compared with the two of us?"
Meng Jingzhou thought about it and felt Lu Yang had a point; compared to him and Old Lu, this kid named Tao Tingfeng indeed seemed downright cowardly.
While they were talking, Tao Tingfeng, following what his clan uncle had taught him, bit his finger and dropped a drop of fresh blood on the golden cicada shed.
The blood droplet disappeared quickly once it touched the golden cicada shed.
"Is it working?"
Tao Tingfeng was delighted and continued to bleed until he was pale and nearly anemic, only then did the golden cicada shed stop absorbing the blood. Instead, it floated in the air and abruptly entered Tao Tingfeng's body, startling him immensely.
He hastily touched the spot where the golden cicada shed had entered, but found nothing.
There was also no discomfort in his body.
"Does this count as successful ownership recognition?" Tao Tingfeng wasn't quite sure.
"...Is this method of claiming ownership not too simplistic?" Lu Yang commented.
"This is called ultimate simplicity, returning to the original purity," Fairy Eternity said in one breath, using two idioms.
"But did Guanqi Zhenjun just die like that?" Meng Jingzhou was somewhat puzzled.
They had just squatted here for a while, and an Ancient Era Integration Stage Expert just died like that, was it not too easy?
```
From the injuries of Watcher True Monarch, it was clear that he had experienced a fierce battle in his life, and it was even possible that it wasn't just once. His injuries were not only external; even his soul was severely wounded, like a candle flickering in the wind, ready to extinguish at any moment.
Now it had indeed extinguished.
"He is not dead, Fairy said Watcher True Monarch had imprinted his last trace of weak consciousness into the Jin Chan shell. As for now, he has already fled into Tao Tingfeng's spiritual space,"
In Tao Tingfeng's spiritual space, a feeble voice arose, "Kid... I didn't expect... that you would know the method of acknowledgment."
Watcher True Monarch's original idea was to let Tao Tingfeng take good care of the Jin Chan shell; he was hiding inside it, quietly recovering. He didn't expect this junior to directly claim ownership of the Jin Chan shell through a blood pact!
He was forced to follow the Jin Chan shell into Tao Tingfeng's spiritual space.
Forget it, perhaps it was really not his fate to be with the Jin Chan shell.
Tao Tingfeng was startled by this voice, "Ah, you, you are still alive?"
Watcher True Monarch didn't speak anymore; he was in too poor a condition now and needed to rest quietly.
Tao Tingfeng was somewhat flustered and didn't know what to do, so he went home, fell into a panic-stricken sleep, his mind filled with the events that unfolded at Yanshan.
After resting for a night, Watcher True Monarch finally felt a bit better and could speak continuously.
"I didn't expect to still be alive, kid, where is this?"
Hearing Watcher True Monarch speak again, this time Tao Tingfeng was mentally prepared and didn't act too panicked.
"Replying to True Monarch, this is Yanshan City, Quanzhou."
"So, it is Quanzhou." Although Tao Tingfeng couldn't see Watcher True Monarch, he felt that the current True Monarch must have a contemplative expression.
"True Monarch, who are you really?" Tao Tingfeng recalled the historical figures he had learned about; there seemed to be no one called Watcher True Monarch.
Watcher True Monarch was somewhat displeased for not being recognized, "You, the younger generation, are truly ignorant. I am Watcher True Monarch of Great Qian, an Integration Realm Cultivator, proficient in all Hundred Skills of Cultivation."
Although Tao Tingfeng already knew that Watcher True Monarch was in the Integration Realm, hearing him admit it still plunged him into great shock.
Good heavens, the Integration Realm, even the most powerful person his clan uncle ever met was only at the pinnacle of Nascent Soul Stage.
Another thought struck Tao Tingfeng, "True Monarch, what exactly is this Jin Chan shell, and why is there no change after entering my body?"
Watcher True Monarch snorted coldly, "Ignorant junior, had it not been for the struggle to obtain this Jin Chan shell, I wouldn't have been hunted down and ended up in such a state."
"This Jin Chan shell is a supreme treasure, even useful to me in the Transcendence Tribulation Stage."
"It was snatched from a cultivator of the Great Yu Era. Initially, I had an agreement with two others who were supposed to help me in exchange for benefits, and the item would be mine. Little did I know, those two were untrustworthy, broke our agreement, became greedy for the wealth, and tried to snatch the Jin Chan shell from me."
"Those two dared to steal from me, they really didn't know whether to live or die."
Watcher True Monarch revealed a cruel smile, although his own situation wasn't much better himself.
"Enough, I still need to rest."
That Watcher True Monarch could say so much had already drained all his strength.
…
Lu Yang was temporarily using Fairy Eternity's spiritual consciousness and could observe Tao Tingfeng's spiritual space; this was his first time seeing such a weakened Integration Realm expert.
On the other hand, the one residing in his own spiritual space had been lively ever since the revival, even managing to exchange a few moves with Eldest Senior Sister.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 709 - 708: An Eye-Opening Experience
chapters.content:
Half a month had passed since Guanqi Zhenjun made his abode in his own spiritual space. During this time, Tao Tingfeng had been learning about cultivation both at the academy with his clan uncle and under the tutelage of Guanqi Zhenjun. Of course, this naturally involved enduring Guanqi Zhenjun's scoldings.
"Rubbish, all rubbish! What the hell is this nonsense?"
"To draw Qi into the body like that? No wonder the realms of your family are so lowly."
"You need to calm your mind and feel the omnipresent spiritual essence. Then, at dawn, use the first glimmer of morning light as a lure to mobilize the spiritual energy around you and draw both the light and the spiritual energy into your body. The more concentrated the spiritual energy around you during this process, the better!" cursed Guanqi Zhenjun.
"When it's time for you to draw Qi into your body, don't use the method taught by your clan uncle; it's rubbish."
On the stage, the Foundation Establishment Middle-stage clan uncle paused and said, "Of course, the method I'm teaching you to draw Qi into your body is just one of many. You may end up joining one of the Great Sects, and then you can use the methods taught by your Sect."
Hearing these words, Lu Yang shuddered. He remembered the cruel experiences Eldest Senior Sister put him through when he had first joined the Sect to induce Qi into to his body - the water barrel exercises, grabbing tofu, eating tofu - until he developed a psychological shadow over tofu. Only then had he successfully drawn Qi into his body and stepped into the Qi Cultivation Stage.
It was said that this was the initial method used by the ancients to draw Qi into their bodies. Although it was simple, it was very effective.
"Fairy, how did you draw Qi into your body? Did you use the ancient method?"
Fairy Eternity was quite surprised, "Ah? There's a method for drawing Qi into your body? Isn't it just something that happens after you sleep, isn't that how it was for you?"
Lu Yang: "..."
He then turned his head and asked Meng Jingzhou, "Old Meng, how did you draw Qi into your body when you were starting out?"
Meng Jingzhou stroked his chin and replied, "Let me think... back before the scandal broke and when my relationship with my dad was still good, he told me that the most important thing to draw Qi into the body was the concentration of spiritual essence; the denser, the better."
"After coming to the Sect, I arranged a circle of top-grade spirit stones around me, shattered these spirit stones to fill the abode with thick spiritual essence, and just absorbing a trace was enough."
Lu Yang: "..."
Even cultivators at the Body Integration Realm wouldn't dare use such a lavish method.
"Do you have some conflicts with your father?" Lu Yang had never asked Meng Jingzhou why he ran away from home, assuming he did it on a whim.
Now it seemed there were some hidden reasons.
Meng Jingzhou waved his hand nonchalantly, "They are all trivial things, too many for me to count."
Lu Yang felt that Meng Jingzhou's return home was a long way off.
After school, Tao Tingfeng ran all the way to a large shop. A long line had formed at the entrance, with excitement gracing the faces of those in the queue.
A wooden sign was propped up at the entrance of the shop, on which was written: "Eternal Life."
"What is this place?" Guanqi Zhenjun frowned, for in his memory, he hadn't seen such a venue. Was it some new fad among the mortals?
"Dream Mirage, haven't you heard of it, Zhenjun?" Tao Tingfeng looked at Guanqi Zhenjun with an utterly shocked expression. There were still people who hadn't heard of Dream Mirage?
"Dream Mirage?" Guanqi Zhenjun thought hard but truly had no recollection of such a thing.
"It's said to be created by a Great Power from the Seek Dao Sect, allowing you to enter an illusionary realm and experience a different life."
At these words, Guanqi Zhenjun snorted coldly. He was proficient in all the Hundred Skills of Cultivation and could guess the principle of Dream Mirage simply by its description, "I thought it was something significant. It turns out to be an illusionary realm, just clever tricks and petty playthings."
"Dream Mirage is not a petty plaything. It's very popular, all across the continent," corrected Tao Tingfeng as he paid for a ticket.
Inside the shop, the ground and walls were equipped with array methods that could be activated with the tickets in hand.
"Wait, are you saying that this thing is all over Great Xia?" Chess Watcher True Monarch seemed to have discovered some incredible fact.
"Yep, and every shop is packed with people just like this one," Tao Tingfeng said, pointing to the throng of people inside the shop.
Chess Watcher True Monarch's heart trembled slightly as he multiplied the cost of the tickets Tao Tingfeng had paid by the number of people in the shop, and then by the number of shops across the continent.
A rough estimate showed that it could make him a lifetime's worth of Spirit Stones in just four months!
How much had the creator of Dream Mirage earned in Spirit Stones by now?
He probably had enough to buy the lives of several cultivators at the Body Integration Realm!
Chess Watcher True Monarch shivered, wishing he could travel back in time to Great Qian and make money this way.
If he had that many Spirit Stones, he would have broken through to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage already. Would he have had to sleep until now, getting robbed and chased down by enemies?
Tao Tingfeng tore open the ticket as the Array Method beneath his feet activated. Emptying his mind, he entered the Illusionary Realm.
What first caught his eye was a sunny and handsome cultivator holding a skewer in his left hand and another in his right, with others grilling skewers beside him. The cultivator took a skewer, and as the view zoomed in, one could clearly see the juicy skewers glistening.
The cultivator's mouth was full of the rich taste and he exaggeratedly exclaimed "Wow" and gave a thumbs up: "Visiting the barbecue shop again, so delicious!"
Chess Watcher True Monarch: "..."
What the heck is this?
"Eternal Love" officially begins.
The male protagonist of "Eternal Love" is a disciple from one of the Great Sects. He has a childhood sweetheart junior sister, and another junior sister he meets while on a mission from another sect. Coincidentally, both junior sisters fall for him.
The story revolves around the three of them and, after a series of trials and tribulations, the male disciple finally realizes his true feelings and rescues his childhood sweetheart junior sister from a gang of demons, confessing his love. With tears in her eyes, the junior sister agrees, and they live happily ever after with an eternal life together.
The story ends.
After watching Dream Mirage, Tao Tingfeng found himself craving skewers: "Time for some skewers."
Chess Watcher True Monarch scoffed at Tao Tingfeng's behavior: "Indulging in gluttony, how can one realize the ultimate path."
On the way to the barbecue shop, they passed by the Land Money Trade Association, where a new model of a Flying Car was displayed at the entrance. Tao Tingfeng looked on with envy but could only yearn; it was something beyond his means.
Chess Watcher True Monarch also looked on with envy. The profit from this thing called a Flying Car was incredibly high, and even he was getting green with envy.
These were all such simple things; why hadn't he thought of them back in Great Qian!
Oh right, it would have been pointless to invent these things in Great Qian because they don't protect intellectual property.
"Come for Barbecue" was as popular as ever—so much so that even the Immortal of Spirit Transformation Realm, who had ascended the mountain to slay demons not long ago, had visited this barbecue shop.
Chess Watcher True Monarch's eyes turned green with envy.
He made a secret vow to himself: once he restored his Realm, he would definitely steal the barbecue shop's recipes!
"How's your observation going? Who is this Chess Watcher True Monarch?" Meng Jingzhou asked Lu Yang, as he couldn't see into Tao Tingfeng's Spiritual Space.
Lu Yang pondered for a moment before replying, "He's a pauper."

chapters.title: Chapter 710 - 709: Pursuing the Killer of True Lord Guanqi
chapters.content:
```
Just as Tao Tingfeng was enjoying some kebabs, he happened to see a young man about his age entering the barbecue restaurant. The young man was filthy, dressed in tattered clothes, looking like a beggar from the streets.
"Excuse me, are you hiring here?" the dirty young man asked.
"I don't ask for much, just the minimum wage is fine." The dirty young man saw that the barbecue shop was booming and figured they must be overwhelmed with work. This was his opportunity.
"Get out of here, you little beggar, we're not hiring." The owner chased the young man away; after all, their shop was ostensibly a barbecue restaurant but secretly a stronghold of the Jiuyou Sect, so there was no way they could hire outsiders.
"I am not a beggar!" the young man shouted angrily.
What kind of person was he? If it were not for his bad luck and being robbed by villains, how could he have ended in such a plight and be mistaken for a beggar?
This was a profound humiliation!
The owner did not intend to listen to the young man any longer and directly grabbed him by the collar, tossing him out.
"Off you go."
The dirty young man felt the money in his pocket; all he had was enough to pay for lodgings, but not enough for a flying boat or a horse-drawn carriage to his destination.
He sighed, knowing that finding a job quickly was the most pressing matter.
Tao Tingfeng didn't pay too much attention to the dirty young man's plight and continued to focus on enjoying his kebabs.
Time flew by, and more than half a month had passed. Tao Tingfeng's performance in the clan school became increasingly outstanding. He could answer all the questions that his clan uncle posed during lectures, and he even achieved a perfect score in the semi-annual school examination, earning the admiring glances of everyone.
In the past, Tao Tingfeng's academic performance was at best above average, never exceptional, but with the help of Observing Chess True Monarch, his horizons and knowledge had been greatly enhanced. The content discussed by his clan uncle in classes was nothing more than the simplest introductory knowledge to him.
"Cousin, you are so amazing!"
After class, many of the Tao Family disciples would gather around Tao Tingfeng, casting envious glances his way. With a modest smile, Tao Tingfeng would say it was just luck, and that he wouldn't achieve such good results next time.
Those among the Tao Family disciples who had previously outperformed Tao Tingfeng looked at him with slightly envious eyes. What did it matter if he had good grades? The most important thing in cultivation wasn't knowledge, but the Spirit Root!
The Observing Chess True Monarch also slowly recovered from his soul injury during this time. He had improved very slowly—from barely able to speak when he first met Tao Tingfeng, to now being able to speak more comfortably, just over a month later.
In fact, this was the normal recovery speed for cultivators.
The likes of Fairy Eternity, throughout the entire cultivation world, she was the only one.
Even the Four Ancient Immortals couldn't achieve the level of vitality that Fairy Eternity displayed.
"True Monarch, can my Spirit Root really change through the shedding of Jin Chan?" Tao Tingfeng was most concerned about his Spirit Root at the moment.
The day for the family's Spirit Root test was approaching, and he had learned about his own Spirit Root in advance from Observing Chess True Monarch.
A combination of Wood, Fire, and Earth Spirit Roots, he had Three Spirit Roots.
If it had been in the past, he would have been ecstatic; without doubt, it was the best Spirit Root in the clan.
But now things were different. With the broadening of his horizons through knowing Observing Chess True Monarch, he no longer wanted to confine himself to the small Tao Family.
Three Spirit Roots were far from enough.
"Of course, you can." In the Spiritual Space, right beside Observing Chess True Monarch, was the Jin Chan that had already merged with Tao Tingfeng.
Observing Chess True Monarch proudly said, "This Jin Chan is a relic left by an Ancient Cultivator who cultivated to the peak of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. Had not that ancestor of Jin Chan met with a mishap, he might have even advanced a step further, becoming a legendary Semi-Immortal!"
"With the Jin Chan, it's enough to transform your Three Spirit Roots into a Single Spiritual Root!"
"It's even possible for you to attain an Immortal body."
Tao Tingfeng's eyes shone upon hearing this; the thought of joining the Five Great Immortal Sects as a Single Spiritual Root ensured his future would be boundlessly bright!
"However, if you join an Immortal Sect, remember to hide your Spirit Root well," Observing Chess True Monarch instructed.
"Why is that?" Tao Tingfeng asked, puzzled.
Observing Chess True Monarch spoke with an air of disappointment, "It's called concealing one's capability. It is said that a tree that stands out in the forest will be destroyed by the wind. If you, as a Single Spiritual Root, join a sect, you will inevitably attract jealousy from your peers."
```
"You should know, the larger the Great Sect, the more rampant the phenomenon of factionalism. Take Seek Dao Sect, for example, if you have a Single Spiritual Root, you would not only suffer oppression from your Senior Brothers, but even the Elders might lay their hands on you!"
"What, what should I do?"
With confidence, Grandmaster Guanqi said, "Easy. Jin Chan can help you conceal your Spirit Root. Unless someone at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage personally investigates, no one can see through your true spiritual foundation."
Tao Tingfeng finally breathed a sigh of relief.
Then he remembered another problem, "Right, Grandmaster, you said before that you ended up in this state because someone was hunting you down. Who are they?"
"You currently lack any cultivation level; don't worry about these issues. They're too far removed for you. All you need to know is, you must hide my existence well and not let outsiders become aware of it."
"Okay." Without needing further reminders from Grandmaster Guanqi, Tao Tingfeng would have done so anyway.
Lu Yang, who was secretly observing, heard a reminder from Fairy Eternity.
"There are three from the Body Integration Realm rushing over here at high speed, and they have solid foundations."
"What?!" Lu Yang startled, could they be the enemies of Grandmaster Guanqi coming after him?
Grandmaster Guanqi stole a Jin Chan from a Great Yu Cultivator and killed two companions driven by greed. Whether for wealth or revenge, they would seek out Grandmaster Guanqi.
"Should I summon Eldest Senior Sister?"
Fairy Eternity waved her hand, "It won't be a problem, just watch."
The three from the Body Integration Realm flew at a great speed, and everyone in Yanshan City saw them.
The three from the Body Integration Realm descended onto Yanshan, finding the spot where Grandmaster Guanqi had initially fallen.
The leader picked up a delicately crafted wooden box from the ground, which was the box that had previously contained the Jin Chan.
The leader calculated with his fingers, then suddenly turned his head, looking down at the city of Yanshan.
"Found you!"
Seeing the three Body Integration Realm cultivators flying over, Grandmaster Guanqi panicked, "Kid, run! The people hunting me are here!"
"Run, run where?"
"It doesn't matter where, just run first and figure it out later!"
Obeying Grandmaster Guanqi's instructions, Tao Tingfeng didn't even bother to pack; he got up to run out the door.
A terrifying presence enveloped him, making him feel as though he was trapped in endless darkness. Even Grandmaster Guanqi in the Spiritual Space was too scared to move.
"Kid, I'm asking you, do you have another soul inside your body, or have you seen something similar to the Jin Chan?"
"No, no I haven't." Tao Tingfeng forcibly calmed himself, offering a strained smile.
The leader frowned, unsatisfied with Tao Tingfeng's response, but didn't continue to release the terrifying aura, "Are you telling the truth, kid?"
"The truth." With the terrifying presence gone, Tao Tingfeng gasped for air.
He finally dared to look at the newcomers.
Three cultivators he didn't recognize, undeniably powerful.
The leader looked at Tao Tingfeng, sighed, then said seriously,
"We are the Luoshui Guards. Grandmaster Guanqi, we are here to inform you that you are under arrest for the robbery of a Jin Chan from a certain Great Yu Cultivator, a suspected robbery crime."
The leader then turned his attention to Tao Tingfeng, "As for you, you are under arrest for concealing and covering up the proceeds of a crime and sheltering a criminal suspect."
The Luoshui Guards in Great Xia were specially tasked with handling evildoers from the demonic sects, cultivators who abused their power to bully others, and ancient cultivators who violated the law.
The leader, Lu Yang, and Meng Jingzhou both knew him; he was a friend of the Fifth Elder, one of the Nine Palaces of the Luoshui Guards who had been involved in arresting the Fifth Elder for street racing multiple times, Yu Qian.

chapters.title: Chapter 711 - 710: A Flood Hits the Dragon King's Temple (Extra for Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
"The Luoshui Guards?" Tao Tingfeng's eyes widened in shock; his uncle had told him about this organization, which was established by the dynasty to specifically deal with high-level cultivators.
He had just been enjoying the spectacle, never expecting they would come looking for him directly.
Yu Qian and the other two simultaneously took out their tokens, which were engraved with the words "Luoshui".
"Accuse me of concealing and harboring the proceeds of a crime? Me?" Tao Tingfeng had never paid much attention to criminal law, forgetting it as soon as he heard it; how could he have expected that he would be breaking the law just like that?
Yu Qian's eyes narrowed slightly as he stared at Tao Tingfeng, "Tell me, how did you initially meet True Master Guanqi, and how did you manage to make Jin Chan recognize a new master?"
This was one of the secret methods used by the Luoshui Guards, which, if there was a significant difference in realm, could determine whether the other party was lying.
Shi Huagu also possessed a similar secret method, which had been employed in the past to test whether Lu Yang was from the Heavenly Court Sect; however, the effect of Shi Huagu's secret method was not as good as that of the Luoshui Guards.
Tao Tingfeng, with a stiff resolve, recounted the situation at that time in full.
"At the time, the true master had said to me, 'This object is called Jin Chan. It was seized from a formidable opponent. Keep it safe...'"
"At the time, I thought the true master had died, so I tried to make Jin Chan recognize a new master through a blood pact..."
"Later on, the true master was still alive..."
After listening, Yu Qian's brow furrowed slightly and he asked seriously, "So you knew that Jin Chan was stolen by him, but you still chose to keep it safe?"
"And after True Master Guanqi entered your spiritual space, you provided him with a place to recover?"
"How reckless! Do you not realize how dangerous that action was?"
"What do you think Jin Chan is? It's an item that would entice even those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage; True Master Guanqi was willing to risk his life just to steal it."
"After Jin Chan recognized you as its master, you actually dared to shelter him?"
"If he had regained his physical form, the first thing he would do is try to possess you!"
"Do you think he would be so kind as to teach you cultivation?"
Yu Qian took out a book, which documented various deeds of cultivators at the Body Integration Realm within Great Qian, and read, "True Master Guanqi, real name Du Guan, born in the year 82,281 of the Great Qian era, sacrificed his own village to advance to the Nascent Soul Stage.
In the Spirit Transformation Stage, he bonded with a fellow cultivator of the same realm and later killed his partner to prove the Way of Heartlessness. In the early Integration Stage, he is recorded to have committed robbery and murder three times; in mid-stage...
later, losing hope of breaking through to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, he dedicated himself to the study of the Hundred Skills of Cultivation."
Yu Qian closed the book and stated emphatically, "You're helping this kind of person, and cultivating under his guidance?"
"I, I... I just thought he was easy to talk to, and assumed he was a good person..."
Yu Qian cut off Tao Tingfeng's protest, "The 'good person' you're talking about, is he the one who robbed Jin Chan?"
"Heh heh, cultivators of Great Xia, I had no idea you would investigate me so thoroughly," True Master Guanqi said with a sinister laugh.
"Du Guan, the crimes you committed in Great Qian are historical issues that Great Xia doesn't concern itself with. But robbing a Great Yu cultivator within the borders of Great Xia constitutes the crime of robbery," Yu Qian stated.
"Not murder?" Guanqi knew that falling into the hands of Great Xia meant certain death, since the crimes he committed were far more than just robbery.
"Murder? Are you referring to killing a Great Yu cultivator? Unfortunately, the victim is not dead; we just haven't found his whereabouts yet. As for the two companions you slew, you were acting in self-defense and have not committed a crime."
When True Master Guanqi and his two companions fought among themselves, the commotion they caused attracted the attention of the dynasty. When the authorities arrived, Guanqi had just fled, and his two companions were left dead and critically wounded.
The critically injured person was beyond help, so the Luoshui Guards conducted an emergency soul search and learned the full details of the incident.
The identity of the robbed Great Yu cultivator remained unclear, only known to have just awakened and still in the recovery period. Guanqi, having somehow heard about it, joined forces with his two companions to rob the Great Yu cultivator.
After Guanqi fled, the seriously wounded companion, seeing that the Great Yu cultivator was also gravely injured but still had some strength left, chose to start over after disbanding his cultivation and quickly fled, leading to the following series of events.
They were also searching for that Great Yu cultivator, as the victim needed to be found.
The Great Yu cultivator had fled northward, while True Master Guanqi had fled southward; the Luoshui Guards split into two groups.
Yu Qian did not expect that he would find True Master Guanqi before locating the victim.
Yu Qian said to Tao Tingfeng with a stern expression, "Whether you have committed the crime of concealment and abetment still requires further investigation, but you are suspected of covering up and hiding the proceeds of a crime, and you need to come with us."
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou sighed inwardly, as they had seen Tao Tingfeng recognize the Jin Chan as its master through blood, they knew this kid had gotten into trouble. They had been observing him ever since, to see if the kid realized there was an issue.
At this juncture, there was no need for observation anymore.
"Let's go; the matter is not yet settled."
...
Panting heavily—
The grimy youngster who had once appeared in the barbecue restaurant was now frantically running towards the outskirts of the city.
For the past half a month, he had been working in the city to save money. He'd gotten himself a clean set of clothes, and in another half a month, he would have enough money to take a flying boat to his destination.
"I don't know if those three Great Xia cultivators were here to catch me, but to be on the safe side, I'd better run."
The young man felt extremely unlucky; he hadn't bothered anyone, waking up from his slumber in Great Yu to this present time, and shortly after his awakening, three Great Qian cultivators came knocking on his door to snatch the Jin Chan.
This was his reliance during the strife of the Great Era; how could he just hand it over willingly!
After the battle, not only did he lose the Jin Chan, but in order to save his life, he was also forced to start over after disbanding his cultivation.
"Damn my luck!"
Suddenly, he stopped dead in his tracks.
"Kid, you run quite fast."
Two figures appeared like a wall, blocking the young man's path.
It was Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
Back at the barbecue restaurant, the two had noticed something different about the young man— his walking posture, his breathing, both unlike an ordinary person's— he definitely had a foundation of cultivation.
At that time, they suspected that the young man was starting over after disbanding his cultivation, but they had no proof.
Now that the Luoshui Guards were involved, and the kid ran, he definitely was starting over after disbanding his cultivation!
This performance delivered right to their doorstep, let's see if Elder Brother Dai would still say that these two only caused trouble when they went out!
"What are you going to do?!" The young man knew at a glance that these two were cultivators, and now that he was merely a mortal, he certainly couldn't beat them.
"What are we going to do." Meng Jingzhou sneered, warming up his arms and legs as he pulled the youngster to an abandoned courtyard, "Speak, are you an ancient cultivator who has started over after disbanding your cultivation!"
"No, no!" the young man insisted bravely.
"Oh, still not admitting it, huh? Hang him up!" Lu Yang pulled out a whip from his identity jade, giving it a couple of tugs to make sure it was sturdy.
This was an interrogation method Lu Yang had learned from his Eldest Senior Sister.
Meng Jingzhou thoughtfully found some rope, tied the young man up, and hung him from a tree.
Whipping through the air with a crackling sound, the young man's scalp tingled as he watched the two men's ferocious appearance. If he didn't confess, his life might be in danger.
"Don't hit me, don't hit me; I'll confess."
"Speak, what era of cultivator are you, and what is your name!"
"I am a cultivator from the era of Great Yu, with the Daoist name Xiantian."
(For Alliance Hierarch Many Elephants, an additional chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 712 - 711: Truly Two Good Kids
chapters.content:
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, upon hearing the youth's self-introduction, simultaneously stiffened, taking two unconscious steps back, as if a great disaster loomed over them.
A Daoist Xiantian?
The founder of a sect?
Lu Yang was the first to regain his composure, cracking his whip with a snap that sent sparks flying, scaring the youth into shivering terror.
He sneered, "You've really got some nerve, trying to impersonate the venerable predecessor I admire the most! Let me ask you, what is the real name of Daoist Xiantian?"
"Qi Tongtian."
"How did the Seek Dao Sect get its name?"
"I spent a hundred thousand spirit stones to have the Heavenly Strategy Sect calculate a good feng shui location for my sect. I set out following the results, but got lost halfway and had to ask for directions from an old farmer by the roadside. To commemorate this experience and show gratitude to the farmer, I named the sect 'Seek Dao Sect'."
"How many wives does Daoist Xiantian have?"
"When did I ever get married?"
"Why haven't you married?"
"I was too poor, had no spirit stones. All the spirit stones were spent on building the sect."
The youth's feet were bound and he was hung from a tree where every breeze threatened to spin him around.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou exchanged glances; something was wrong, he had answered everything correctly, it seemed that the other person really was Daoist Xiantian.
Lu Yang cleared his throat, his face breaking into a smile as he hurriedly let down the hanging Daoist Xiantian, "Daoist Xiantian is the person I respect the most. When I face difficulties in my cultivation, I often reminisce about how you, Old Master, founded Seek Dao Sect under such harsh conditions. It truly inspires me. We thought you were an impostor just now, forgive us, Ancestor."
Now merely an ordinary man, having hung for a long time, Daoist Xiantian felt dizzy the moment he touched the ground and was slow to grasp Lu Yang's words.
Meng Jingzhou earnestly produced a chair from somewhere, inviting the Ancestor to sit.
Daoist Xiantian expressed his thanks and sat in the chair to recover for a while, suddenly realizing they were referring to him as "Ancestor."
"Hold on, you two are from Seek Dao Sect?"
The two nodded and bowed deeply, exuding utmost respect, "I'm Lu Yang, just call me Little Lu."
"My name is Meng Jingzhou, you can call me Little Meng."
Daoist Xiantian looked at them with a strange gaze, recalling a story he had heard by the roadside.
"You're the one who, in the Foundation Establishment Stage, challenged higher levels and defeated those in the Golden Core Stage, Nascent Soul Stage, and Divinity Transformation Stage, Lu Yang?"
"And you, Meng Jingzhou, are the one whose determination in Dao is unwavering, who remains undistracted and dedicated to the way?"
"Ancestor, you must be tired from hanging on the tree, let me massage your shoulders."
"I will rub your legs."
As they massaged the Ancestor, they chatted casually, "Ancestor, didn't you establish the Seek Dao Sect? Why aren't you in deep slumber within the sect?"
There was a tomb of Daoist Xiantian in the sect, and everyone was unaware that Daoist Xiantian's 'death' was a feigned one, and his true form was elsewhere.
Daoist Xiantian felt like crying but no tears came, "I never expected the sect I established back then would last till now."
When he established the Seek Dao Sect, he was only at the Refining the Void stage. It was after the sect was built that he ascended to the Body Integration Realm, which meant it was quite an ordinary First-Class Sect. Who would have thought that a First-Class Sect could last for one hundred and twenty thousand years, and even thrive more and more.
At that time in Great Yu, the moral climate was poor. If a sect was destroyed, the enemy would certainly dig three feet into the ground to find it, not only to search for treasure but also to eliminate the roots. If he had chosen to slumber within the Seek Dao Sect, and one day the sect was destroyed, he would have been killed by the enemy while still asleep.
If he had known that the Seek Dao Sect would do so well, he would not have had to go through the trouble of finding a secluded place to sleep in the first place.
"Then why did you Start Over after Disbanding Cultivation?"
The Daoist Xiantian felt even more wronged: "Do you think I wanted this? When I woke up, I hadn't even fully regained my composure before three Great Qian Cultivators rushed in to rob me of my Jin Chan Escape Technique, the leader seemed to be called something like True Jun of Watching Chess. They were all ruthless, one more so than the others.
If I hadn't taken a gamble to Start Over after Disbanding Cultivation and escaped, I would have left my life there."
Lu Yang's mouth twitched. So it turned out True Jun of Watching Chess's robbery target was you.
Meng Jingzhou said indignantly, "That's too much, this True Jun of Watching Chess really has no respect for the laws, he does not take our Seek Dao Sect seriously at all!"
Lu Yang was even more furious, "To actually treat the Ancestral Master in such a way, if I encounter him, I'd rather give up my worthless life to fight him to the death!"
The Daoist Xiantian was deeply moved after hearing this. What good children they were.
He continued, "After escaping, I heard that the Seek Dao Sect was still around and had become one of the Five Great Immortal Sects. So, I wanted to go back to the sect, but it's too far from here, I needed to earn enough for the journey first."
"I hadn't even finished earning the travel money when the official cultivators from Great Xia came to kill me. I was about to run away when I was caught by you two and hung up here."
"Why would you run at the sight of Great Xia cultivators if you've done nothing?" Lu Yang massaged the Daoist Xiantian's shoulders even more attentively.
The Daoist Xiantian looked troubled: "I have to run even if I haven't done anything. I'm not a cultivator of this era after all, and if the official cultivators of Great Xia saw me, they would definitely want to capture me. I feel the Seek Dao Sect is safer."
Lu Yang understood. The Ancestral Master had just woken up not long ago and didn't understand Great Xia. He was judging Great Xia by the standards of the Great Yu era.
Great Xia does not arrest all ancient cultivators. For those who are willing to abide by the rules of Great Xia, they'd just be registered and not mistreated.
As for the victims like the Ancestral Master here, they'd be even more protected.
The Daoist Xiantian sighed, "Such a pity for my Jin Chan Escape Technique."
"How did those three Great Qian cultivators led by True Jun of Watching Chess know that you had the Jin Chan Escape Technique?" Meng Jingzhou asked curiously.
The Daoist Xiantian seemed to remember something, he pounded his thigh vigorously and angrily said, "It must be those people from the Great Yu Alliance."
"The Great Yu Alliance?" Lu Yang remembered that Wu Youdao seemed to have mentioned this organization.
"It's an alliance formed by Great Yu Cultivators. After I awoke, they found me right away and hoped I would join them. I found them unreliable, so I refused."
"They must have discovered that I possessed the Jin Chan Escape Technique but couldn't take action directly, as it would violate the rules of the Great Yu Alliance. So, they secretly informed the Great Qian cultivators to rob it from me, and then they'd retrieve it, thus legitimizing their actions."
"They probably didn't expect the Great Xia cultivators to come so quickly. Unable to confront them directly, they had no choice but to back off."
Lu Yang assured with a slap on his chest, "Ancestral Master, rest assured, if we get a chance to encounter that Great Yu Alliance bunch, our Seek Dao Sect will definitely help you get even!"
The Daoist Xiantian felt that these two were truly filial, and they had high talents too. Indeed, as the storytelling went, they were rare good seeds.
With these two present, the future of his Seek Dao Sect was boundless. In the clashes of the coming Great Era, it would surely have a place.
"By the way, Ancestral Master, we've just finished our mission and are about to return to the sect. Do you wish to go back with us?"
"Yes."

chapters.title: Chapter 713 - 712 Elder Brother Dai, Guess Who This Is
chapters.content:
Old Ma looked at the youngster getting into the carriage with a slight difference of opinion, not knowing who he was or why Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou would bring them back to the sect.
Could it be a promising new sprout they've just discovered?
But they should have passed the entrance trial before being able to join the Seek Dao Sect.
Whatever, what does it have to do with me? I'm just a coachman.
Old Ma didn't think about it any longer and concentrated on doing his carriage-pulling job well.
"Rest assured, Ancestral Master, we will definitely be able to retrieve Jin Chan for you."
"We've just received news that the Luoshui Guards, which are the official cultivators from Great Xia, have captured Master Guanqie."
"That fast?" Daoist Xiantian was quite surprised, how did you two find out?
"However, returning the stolen goods is best left to the elders of the sect to handle. We, being younger and less influential, are not suited to come forward in this matter."
Daoist Xiantian nodded his head, it made sense.
"Ancestral Master, you might not be quite aware, but the current atmosphere of the sect isn't quite the same as during your time, it's more open now."
"The ones currently managing the sect include not only elders but also several disciples."
In just one day, Old Ma brought the three of them to the Seek Dao Sect, surprising Daoist Xiantian greatly. Even if he had been traveling himself, he would only achieve this speed.
Oh no, considering he was prone to getting lost, he might not be able to reach Seek Dao Sect in ten days; that's why he had previously been eager to save money for flying on a spirit boat.
But what he had not considered was that he was now undocumented and could not ride on a spirit boat.
As some senior and junior brothers returned from their missions, the Seek Dao Sect became livelier than when the two had left, but it had not yet returned to its usual state, as some people were still out on missions to observe conduct.
"Wow, the Seek Dao Sect has grown so much." Daoist Xiantian marvelled, not to mention how much larger the sect had become since its establishment; even the gate was more imposing than before.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou took Daoist Xiantian up to the entrance of the Task Hall, "Ancestral Master, please wait here. As you know, your status is special. If we directly take you there, we're afraid the higher-ups of the sect might not accept you instantly."
"How about this, we two will go in first and explain the ins and outs clearly, then you can enter."
"Alright, I'll follow your arrangement," Daoist Xiantian laughed cheerfully. Indeed, this matter required a process of acceptance.
...
Dai Bufan had a thick stack of mission reports in front of him, detailing the observation results of conduct.
All the mortals whose conduct needed to be observed had been screened by him, and as it turned out, his eye for people was quite good; most of these individuals met the standards of the Seek Dao Sect.
"This lad who went to visit the prison is not bad, very filial. I wonder if he will come to the Seek Dao Sect."
"This little girl is not bad either; she accidentally found a storage ring and smartly used it for farming. The ambiance of her family, though, is not too good."
"Just don't know yet how Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had fared," Dai Bufan muttered. He felt a bit anxious, worried that these two would stir up more trouble.
"There shouldn't be anything wrong. Recently, there have been no reports of conflicts at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage."
A smile appeared on Dai Bufan's lips. After these few experiences, he had mentally prepared himself that even if those two caused trouble, leading to battles among the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, Semi-Immortals, or brought back one or two ancient Semi-Immortals, he wouldn't react too strongly.
Just as Dai Bufan was musing, he heard a polite knock on the door, "Elder Brother Dai, the two of us are back."
"Come in."
The wooden door opened, and Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou walked in, buoyant and elated.
"Have you finished your observation?"
"It's over,"
"Tell me, what about the three people I asked you to observe? Are their characters up to par?"
Lu Yang and his companion regretfully shook their heads, "Among these three, only one has a character that passes muster."
"Only one?" Elder Brother Dai's brows furrowed slightly, puzzled. Could his judgement be that poor?
"For instance, that mortal named Xie An, he's actually Xie Jiu from the boundless Great Power, disguised. A cultivator, disguised as a mortal—the brazenness is utterly shameless!"
"Oh, is that so?" Dai Bufan was slightly surprised, not expecting these two to be so unlucky as to encounter someone from the Transcendance Tribulation Stage disguised as a mortal.
Could it be because he was punished by Senior Sister Yun last time and hadn't yet recovered his Dao heart?
"What about that Tao Tingfeng?"
Meng Jingzhou shook his head regretfully, saying, "Tao Tingfeng is no good either, this guy has no respect for the law, openly commited crimes, harboring robbers and even helping to keep their loot. When we left, he was being taken away by the Luoshui Guards."
"So the only one with commendable character is Gu Junye?"
"Exactly, this Gu Junye is an extremely rare and promising youth. Not only does he strictly abide by the law, but he also knows how to use it as a weapon to protect himself, studies hard in class, and uses all available time outside of class to exercise his body. He's also very filial, obeying his mother's words."
"He meets the criteria you mentioned, Elder Brother Dai, of being honest and down-to-earth, and cultivating earnestly,"
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had high praise for Gu Junye.
"His mentality is also good, calm in the face of issues. Even when we informed him he could participate in the Seek Dao Sect's entrance exam, he didn't get overly excited,"
"We also found that Gu Junye holds himself to the standards of a cultivator at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, bearing the world in his heart, and he's expressed to us multiple times his desire to save the world."
"And he doesn't hide it; in front of his classmates and teacher, he openly shared this aspiration with us,"
Dai Bufan nodded, "With such character, he truly is a rare find."
"By the way, Elder Brother Dai, haven't you mentioned that if we find someone who isn't on the list but still fits the criteria for our Sect, we could recommend them to you?"
"I did say that. Did you find someone?"
"You could say it's an unexpected gain from our trip outside. However, this person has a somewhat complex background; he's a Great Yu Cultivator who, for some reasons, had to start over after disbanding his cultivation,"
Lu Yang assured him vehemently, "But you can rest assured, Elder Brother Dai, his character is guaranteed to meet the recruitment standards of our Seek Dao Sect! And he's very well-known; you will definitely recognize him."
"A Great Yu Cultivator starting over after disbanding his cultivation?" Dai Bufan hesitated slightly, finding it difficult to decide. These two youngsters really know how to find them; if one isn't careful, this type could be a traitor.
"We brought him back to the Sect specifically because we were afraid you wouldn't feel reassured, Elder Brother Dai."
"Then bring him in, let me have a look,"
"Right on it."
Soon, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou brought a handsome young man before Dai Bufan, the youth still smiling somewhat shyly.
"Elder Brother Dai, can you guess who this is?"
"Who might it be?"
Lu Yang introduced him with enthusiasm, "This is none other than the founding patriarch of our Seek Dao Sect, Daoist Xiantian Qi Tongtian."
Elder Brother Dai's eyes rolled back, and with a clang, he collapsed to the ground, fainted.
"What—what's going on?" Daoist Xiantian was a bit flustered.
Meng Jingzhou said seriously, "Probably isn't too strong mentally, never seen the patriarch before, too overwhelmed."

chapters.title: Chapter 714 - 713: Meeting with the Higher-ups
chapters.content:
When Dai Bufan awoke once more, he saw Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, and Daoist Xiantian squatting on the ground, their heads leaning forward as they watched him, confirming that everything that had happened was not a dream.
"Elder Brother Dai, you've finally awakened."
"Don't call me senior brother, I don't deserve such a title from a junior brother like you," Dai Bufan said as he got up, casting a gloomy glance at the two rascals, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
I asked you to go out and select a few disciples, and look what you've done, you've actually brought our founding ancestor with you.
Dai Bufan was always known for his calm and composure, otherwise, he couldn't have managed the Task Hall or handled such a vast amount of intelligence information.
But he felt that ever since he met Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, his emotional fluctuations had significantly increased.
And now, his head was still spinning.
"Come on, Elder Brother Dai, let me help you up," Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou supported Dai Bufan, one on each side, and helped him back into his chair.
"Are you really the legendary founder, that lost Daoist Xiantian?" Dai Bufan was still in disbelief.
Although Lu Yang and the other had never deceived him before, the matter at hand concerned the founding ancestor, so he dared not make any mistakes.
After Daoist Xiantian started over after disbanding his cultivation, his appearance changed drastically, no longer matching the statue of the founding ancestor left behind by the Seek Dao Sect.
Daoist Xiantian, somewhat embarrassed, gestured with his hand: "It's an exaggeration to describe me as legendary. My Daoist name is indeed Daoist Xiantian, but sadly, my identity proof was destroyed in a battle not long ago."
"A battle not long ago? What about your current cultivation level...?"
"I lost the fight, the injuries were too severe, and the only option was to start over after disbanding cultivation to seek a chance at survival. Luckily, I managed to live," said Daoist Xiantian lightly, although the situation at the time had been extremely dangerous.
Starting over after disbanding cultivation was not guaranteed to be successful, and to ensure a higher chance of success, it was best to disband one's cultivation at one's peak. For Daoist Xiantian to do so when he was severely injured meant that the chance of failure was greatly increased.
"Ancestor, you know your status is special, and I can't make this decision alone," Dai Bufan said awkwardly. "How about this, I'll take you to see Senior Sister Yun, and have her decide what to do?"
"Fine," Daoist Xiantian was an easygoing person.
Dai Bufan respectfully invited Daoist Xiantian to Sky Gate Mountain to find Yun Zhi, and before leaving, he turned back to glare at Lu Yang and the other: "You two, follow along!"
Lu Yang shook his head secretly, feeling that Elder Brother Dai was quite a hot-tempered man, with a poor disposition; he wondered how he had managed to cultivate to the Body Integration Realm.
In contrast, he himself dealt with the harassment of Fairy Eternity in the Spiritual Space every day and still managed to focus on his cultivation, the difference between them was clear.
...
Sky Gate Mountain.
Gan Tian, who had just consolidated his realm, had also been sent out on a mission by Elder Brother Dai, leaving only Yun Zhi on Sky Gate Mountain.
Yun Zhi, in a rare occurrence, was not cultivating but sat on an imperial chair, sipping tea in small mouthfuls.
The round stone table was surrounded by four imperial chairs, which made the table seem somewhat out of place.
As Yun Zhi sipped her tea, she considered whether to get a matching stone table from somewhere.
"Senior Sister Yun," Dai Bufan greeted her with his hands clasped together.
"Hmm?" Yun Zhi put down her teacup, her gaze puzzled as she looked at the four of them.
Junior Brother Dai, Junior Brother Meng, Little Junior Brother, and a young man she had not seen before.
"There's a matter that requires Senior Sister Yun's decision," Dai Bufan said, tugging at the corners of his mouth, trying to maintain a serious expression as he explained the unfamiliar young man's origins.
"So, you mean to say, this person is our founding ancestor, Daoist Xiantian, Qi Tongtian?"
Yun Zhi was also stunned for a moment after hearing the explanation, not expecting that the founding ancestor was still alive.
After pondering for a while, she asked earnestly, "Ancestor, do you wish to be Sect Leader?"
```
"Ah? I'm to be the Sect Leader?" This time, it was Daoist Xiantian's turn to be stunned. He had assumed that the present-day sect was just like those in the Great Yu Era, where people would go to any lengths to seize the position of Sect Leader.
He even worried that upon his return to the Seek Dao Sect, the members might not welcome another supreme ruler above them and would make things difficult or even attempt to do away with him.
He hadn't expected that his junior would actually want him to take over as the Sect Leader directly.
"No, no, no, this won't do," Daoist Xiantian waved his hands repeatedly, "Setting aside the fact that I'm just a mortal now, even if I regained my Body Integration Realm, I'd still be incapable of managing such a large sect."
The scale of the Seek Dao Sect now was worlds apart from when it was first established, and he had no idea how to manage it.
"That's alright, Junior Brother also served as the Sect Leader for three months, and managing the Seek Dao Sect is quite easy."
Daoist Xiantian was even more surprised. Had the standards for becoming a Sect Leader really dropped this low? Someone at the Nascent Soul Stage could become a Sect Leader?
No, that wasn't the right way to think about it. If this junior could defeat a Spirit Transformation cultivator while he was still at the Foundation Establishment Stage, and now had cultivated to the Nascent Soul Stage, wouldn't his real combat power be comparable to the Body Integration Realm?
"I really can't be the Sect Leader; you don't have to be this way with me, just treat me as an ordinary disciple of the sect." Daoist Xiantian just wanted to focus on his cultivation, cast aside his past, and return to the Body Integration Realm.
"By the way, Eldest Senior Sister, the Golden Cicada Shedding that belongs to our Ancestor is currently in the hands of the Dynasty. Could you see if you could help retrieve it?" Lu Yang took the opportunity to ask.
"What's the deal with the Golden Cicada Shedding?"
Lu Yang recounted the experiences of the Ancestor after waking up, naturally omitting the part where he and Old Meng had strung up the Ancestor.
Presumably, that memory wasn't too pleasant for the Ancestor, so it was left unsaid in his presence.
Yun Zhi nodded, "I see, that shouldn't be difficult."
"Does the Ancestor wish to meet with the high-ranking members of our sect?" Yun Zhi inquired further.
With the Ancestor being alive, such a significant event logically ought to be made known to the high-ranking members of the sect.
Daoist Xiantian gladly agreed, as it would be good to meet the outstanding juniors of the sect.
…
Soon, the eight Elders of the Seek Dao Sect gathered in the Task Hall. The stunning Sixth Elder was the exception; if she were to appear in her true form, it might suffocate Daoist Xiantian.
She only sent over a projection.
The eight Elders, having seen much of the world, were not only more advanced in cultivation than Dai Bufan but also had greater capacity for tolerance.
"Is this our Ancestor?"
"He looks so young."
"He doesn't look like his statue."
"Nonsense, could he look the same after starting over with his cultivation?"
"Should we replace the Ancestor's statue with a new one? I think the old one is quite worn out."
"Boss, look at you, digging graves all the time and yet never managed to dig up the Ancestor. Look at Little Lu and Little Meng, they found the Ancestor just by going out once."
"Who's been digging graves? I call it field research, and even the tomb's owner has consented to it."
"If the tomb's owner could speak, it would be you lying in the coffin, Boss."
Suddenly, the Eighth Elder appeared to remember something and quietly approached Daoist Xiantian, asking softly, "By the way, Ancestor, are you still taking disciples?"
"Ah?" Daoist Xiantian hadn't quite grasped the situation yet when he heard the Eighth Elder eagerly touting himself.
"Don't look down on me just because I'm ranked last among the Elders, it's just because I joined the sect later. I am a Body Integration Realm powerhouse, after all, and an expert in the art of talismans. Just give me the nod, and you'll have a late-stage Body Integration Realm disciple right away, one who bypasses the teaching process."
"What do you think of me?"
```

chapters.title: Chapter 715 - 714: After Sleeping for 120,000 Years, My Sect Becomes the Number One Great Sect
chapters.content:
Daoist Xiantian hesitated and pointed behind the Eighth Elder, kindly reminding him.
"I won't speak of my own thoughts for now, but this junior named Yun Zhi seems to have a different opinion from yours."
The Eighth Elder turned his head to see the frosty Yun Zhi.
Yun Zhi said coldly, "Eighth Elder, it is good to want to make progress, and I will faithfully convey your ideas to Grandmaster."
The Eighth Elder broke into a cold sweat upon hearing this, thinking that if his teacher found out, wouldn't he be sent to Captive Peak? After all, Captive Peak wouldn't miss just one more of him.
"No, no, no, let's discuss this reasonably," the Eighth Elder quickly changed to a flattering smile.
"Sit back down."
The Eighth Elder hurriedly took his seat, sitting up straight and proper.
Daoist Xiantian leaned over and whispered to Lu Yang sitting beside him, "I've been wanting to ask, is this junior named Yun Zhi the current Sect Leader?"
Lu Yang shook his head, "No, but generally, the Sect Leader listens to what she says."
"The Sect Leader is so obedient?"
