"Grandmaster, do you know that today's Great Xia has the Five Great Immortal Sects?"
"I've heard about it in storytelling." It was from street storytelling that he learned about how his own sect became a top power today.
"The masters of the Five Great Immortal Sects altogether wouldn't be a match for Eldest Senior Sister with just one hand."
Daoist Xiantian's pupils widened. Was this junior named Yun Zhi really that strong?
He had heard that the Abbot of Suspension Temple was a transcendent Transcendance Tribulation Stage Great Power.
How powerful must this junior named Yun Zhi be? She probably stands out even among those in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
At that moment, Eldest Senior Sister was narrating the experiences of Daoist Xiantian after his awakening, reaching the point where Observing Chess Venerate and three others competed for the Golden Cicada's shell, which filled the Elders with righteous indignation, prompting them to slam the table in anger.
"How dare they bully our Grandmaster, those Great Qian Cultivators are truly tired of living!"
"Where are they? Let's deal with them!"
"They've already been caught by the Dynasty."
"Let's storm the jail!"
"Right, right, right, let's storm the jail!"
Bullying the Grandmaster, they must make the Great Qian Cultivators see the methods of the Seek Dao Sect.
"What nonsense!" Grand Elder, being the big brother, scolded, and the other seven Elders quieted down.
"We're the leading force of the Righteous Path, what's this talk of storming a jail? Don't you know to use your brains and find a legitimate way to solve this?"
"What do you suggest, big brother?"
"We commit a crime ourselves and get locked up with Observing Chess Venerate, wouldn't that solve it?"
"Right, right, right, big brother always thinks of the clever ways."
"It's a good plan."
The Elders discussed committing crimes with great enthusiasm, and seeing how adept these juniors were at sharing tips for committing crimes, Daoist Xiantian felt that this scene didn't seem like it would occur in a Righteous Path sect.
"Little Meng, our Seek Dao Sect is still a Righteous Path sect, right?"
Meng Jingzhou nodded steadily, "That depends. Sometimes we impersonate a demonic sect."
"What?"
As the Elders discussed fervently, Eldest Senior Sister walked over to Daoist Xiantian.
"Grandmaster, are you going to see the other high-level membres?"
"Yes."
"Very well, Junior Brother Lu, Junior Brother Meng, both of you follow me; we're going to Captive Peak."
Captive Peak was quite far from the core area of the Seek Dao Sect, and since Daoist Xiantian was still mortal, walking there would take many days to reach.
Yun Zhi plucked a cloud from the sky, invited the three of them to sit on it, and brought them to Captive Peak.
"Where is this?" Daoist Xiantian felt the gloomy chill of Captive Peak.
"Captive Peak. Our sect has the authority to enforce the law, and those imprisoned here are all criminals who have violated Great Xia's laws that we've encountered."
The prisoners at Captive Peak, seeing Lu Yang, flashed a hint of fear in their eyes.
Although this kid's cultivation level is low, every time Captive Peak has imprisoned a heavyweight, it's been related to him.
Who has he captured this time?
"Xiao Yun is here, Little Lu and the Meng Family Kid are also here," the Child Grandmaster walked out of the room, greeting with a smile, though somewhat nervously.
Then he turned his gaze to the only stranger of the visit, and heaved a sigh of relief.
"I thought we were going to have to capture another Semi-Immortal, turns out he's just a mortal."
The Child Grandmaster resumed his normal demeanor, even more relaxed than usual.
He opened the empty cage and casually said to Daoist Xiantian, "Go in by yourself."
Lu Yang coughed, "Cough cough, Grandmaster, you are mistaken, he's not a prisoner."
"Not a prisoner?" the Child Grandmaster puzzled, "Then who is he?"
"Daoist Xiantian, Qi Tongtian."
"…Who?"
"Our ancestral master, Daoist Xiantian."
The Child Grandmaster's eyes widened, his pupils reflecting Daoist Xiantian's figure, his face etched with disbelief, and he turned to Yun Zhi for confirmation.
Yun Zhi nodded, indicating that what Lu Yang said was true.
The Child Grandmaster looked at Lu Yang as if he'd seen a ghost, the color of shock clear on his face, thinking, 'You little rascal are more troublesome than the nine of them combined.'
Back then, those nine only stirred up trouble among peers, I, with some effort, could handle that, but you, on the other hand, meet Ancient Era Integration Stage and Transcendance Tribulation Stage Semi-Immortals without batting an eye, and now you even cause a commotion involving our ancestral master?!
"It's a coincidence, all coincidences," Lu Yang insisted on his innocence, he wasn't the one causing trouble; trouble came looking for him.
"Who is this?" Daoist Xiantian interrupted the awkwardness, initiate the question.
"The previous Sect Leader of Seek Dao Sect, Tang Shengyi, with a cultivation level at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage."
"Junior Tang Shengyi pays his respects to Ancestor Daoist Xiantian," said the Child Grandmaster, bowing deeply.
Daoist Xiantian, not used to this, tried to evade, as this was the first time he was being revered by a Transcendance Tribulation Stage great power.
He felt awkward and tried to divert the topic, looking around and asking, "Speaking of which, who are all these imprisoned here? Could you introduce them?"
"Let this junior introduce them to Ancestor Daoist Xiantian, most of the criminals held in Captive Peak are Great Yu Cultivators, with a few from Great Qian, all captured by this disciple," the Child Grandmaster offered eagerly, pointing to one of the cages, "Here we have Venerable Thunder."
The first person introduced shocked Daoist Xiantian, his voice barely controllable, "Venerable Thunder, the Transcendance Tribulation expert who controls thunder and lightning?!"
Legend has it that Venerable Thunder was a pinnacle of thunder techniques in that era, revered by fellow thunder technique cultivators. Even during Daoist Xiantian's time, there was a sect claiming their ancestor received the true legacy of Venerable Thunder, indicating the extent of his influence.
"Here is the Venerate of Black and White imprisoned."
"The Venerate of Black and White? The left hand and right arm of the second-generation Imperial Teacher in legends!"
The Child Grandmaster scratched his head, "We had actually captured the second-generation Imperial Teacher, but there was an accident in the middle, and he died from a curse backlash."
He quickly added, "Although the second-generation Imperial Teacher wasn't captured, our sect did manage to capture Wu Youdao."
"Emperor Wu Youdao of the sixth reign?"
Daoist Xiantian stared at the young man with imperial dignity in the cage, filled with indescribable shock.
This was, after all, Emperor Wu Youdao of Great Yu, the second most gifted in history.
It was a good thing the dynasty had changed since his time, or else, in his era, this would have been an outright treasonous crime.
"These two are Nightmare Supreme and Void Venerate," the Child Grandmaster pointed to two soul bodies, "Their physical bodies have already been used as refining materials."
Seeing that Daoist Xiantian had no reaction, the Child Grandmaster slapped his head, "Oh right, you might not recognize Void Venerate, he was a Semi-Immortal who vied for the world with Emperor Xia during the last days of Great Yu."
Daoist Xiantian, stunned by the successive astonishing truths, lost his ability to react, staring blankly, speechless.
He hadn't heard of Void Venerate, but he knew of Nightmare Supreme, a notorious Semi-Immortal, one of the former hegemons, the strongest contender for supremacy at the end of the Great Qian period. If it had not been for Emperor Yu the First, it might have been Nightmare Supreme who would have established a dynasty.
Questions flooded his mind, one after another.
How were these legendary supreme beings captured?
Why does the Seek Dao Sect seem even more formidable than the descriptions in the storytelling?
How strong is this sect that I founded?

chapters.title: Chapter 716 - 715: The First Demonic Sect is Also My Sect
chapters.content:
When Daoist Xiantian started over after disbanding his cultivation and fled to the outside world, coming into contact with the concept of the "Five Great Immortal Sects" for the first time—and learning that one of them was the sect he had founded—he was stunned for quite a while and even doubted for a moment that it was merely a coincidence of names.
Only after confirming the address did he truly believe it was not just a coincidence but indeed the very sect he had founded.
The word outside was that the Five Great Immortal Sects either had cultivators at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, or they possessed means on par with those of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. Such statements had already surprised him greatly.
After all, that was the exalted Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
Now, arriving at Captive Peak and seeing all these legendary characters being held captive—Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivators were one thing, but there were even two semi-immortals!
These were the legendary semi-immortals, cultivators who didn't exist in his era.
This Seek Dao Sect doesn't look like it only has cultivators at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage!
"Hehe, Qi Tongtian, you've created quite a sect," a cold, sneering laugh came through, and Daoist Xiantian felt it was somewhat familiar, like he had heard it somewhere before.
Following the voice, he found its owner in a corner—A dried-up old man, hunched over, his face covered with wrinkles.
"Lotus Fire True Monarch?!" Daoist Xiantian recognized the origin of the withered old man.
He was a Body Integration Realm True Monarch from his era, one who had committed countless evils but had withstood the Lotus Fire's scorching for three days, eventually subduing it and founding the renowned Supreme Lotus Fire Sect.
As a fellow in the Body Integration Realm, Daoist Xiantian couldn't compare himself with Lotus Fire True Monarch, whose Supreme Lotus Fire Sect was one of the key members of the "Demon Alliance," the largest cultivation organization of the time.
Back then, even if he had taken the initiative to greet Lotus Fire True Monarch, the latter wouldn't have deigned to give him even a glance.
Who would have thought that upon their next meeting, the other would have become a prisoner at his feet?
"This was captured by Old Seven when he went out searching for pill-refining materials," the child-like ancient master said, recalling for a moment before he remembered who Lotus Fire True Monarch was.
"Daoist Xiantian, who would have thought we'd meet here."
An icy voice sounded from the cell next door—a middle-aged man with a look of desolation on his face.
Daoist Xiantian scrutinized the man carefully and finally matched the middle-aged man with someone from his memories.
"Are you Ten Thousand Swords True Monarch?"
In his memory, Ten Thousand Swords True Monarch was a young man with a radiant presence, brimming with vigor, a solitary sword cultivator who acted solely on his whims, and if anyone displeased him, he would slay without distinction between righteous and demonic.
Once, he got terribly drunk and unintentionally killed a lone daughter of a Body Integration Realm cultivator. That cultivator was a seasoned Body Integration Realm, well-known for a long time, and also an important member of the Demon Alliance. Enraged by the news, he vowed to slay Ten Thousand Swords True Monarch in vengeance.
But unexpectedly, he was pierced through the heart by Ten Thousand Swords True Monarch and met an untimely death.
Only then did people realize that Ten Thousand Swords True Monarch had reached the pinnacle of the Body Integration Realm.
He was captured too?
"He was brought back by Old Nine," the child-like ancient master said with a twisted mouth, presumably having seen Daoist Buyu's swordsmanship, which caused his dao heart to waver, leading to his downfall.
Just as Daoist Xiantian was about to say something, in the corner of his eye, he caught sight of a major figure who could summon winds and storms in his era.
"Blood Demon Venerable?"
This was the imperial teacher of his era, with Emperor Yu being nothing more than a puppet while he was the one truly holding imperial power.
The infamous Demon Alliance was founded by him!
Lu Yang knew Blood Demon Venerable all too well; he and Old Meng had encountered a group of Great Yu Body Integration Realm cultivators in Buyi Town. After capturing them, these Body Integration Realm cultivators divulged the location of their treasure-filled Cave Heaven.
Eldest Senior Sister led Lu Yang and the other to that Cave Heaven and, inadvertently, awakened Blood Demon Venerable, who was in slumber there.
Then, Eldest Senior Sister casually captured him and brought him back.
Blood Demon Venerable's eyelid twitched, and he silently turned his back, pretending not to recognize Daoist Xiantian.
Daoist Xiantian hadn't expected that those imprisoned here were either legendary characters from the myths or Great Cultivators from his era with renowned reputations.
Does Seek Dao Sect have such good Feng Shui?
Spending one hundred thousand spirit stones to have Heavenly Strategy Sect calculate the Feng Shui was too valuable, right?
"Grand Ancestor, this way please, our Sect has another cultivator at the transcendence tribulation stage," Yun Zhi gestured invitingly, asking Daoist Xiantian to follow her.
As soon as Daoist Xiantian arrived at the Scripture Pavilion, he was dazzled by the endless array of cultivation techniques.
"This, so many cultivation techniques?"
When he had founded Seek Dao Sect, there were barely enough techniques to fill half a bookshelf, and many were just to make up numbers, nothing compared to the current Scripture Pavilion.
"Why is Xiao Yun free to come here? Have you written some new cultivation technique?"
A gaunt-faced old man appeared, none other than Elder Tao, the guardian of the Scripture Pavilion. Seeing Lu Yang next to Yun Zhi brought back unpleasant memories.
Last time Lu Yang brought the Phoenix Ancestor here, nearly causing him to lose face. Thankfully, he admitted his mistake just in time.
Yun Zhi shook her head: "I have not written any cultivation techniques recently. It is Junior Brother and Junior Brother Meng who have brought someone here, wishing to meet you."
Elder Tao laughed heartily, unconcerned, "As long as it's not the Phoenix Ancestor, I'm willing to meet anyone."
Elder Tao's gaze fell upon Daoist Xiantian: "Is it him who wishes to meet me? Who is he?"
Out of respect for a cultivator at the transcendence tribulation stage, Daoist Xiantian took the initiative to introduce himself, "My name is Qi Tongtian."
"So it's Little Qi, just call me Elder Tao. Is this the disciple being prepared for this year's entry into the Sect... wait a moment, what's his name?"
Elder Tao stopped mid-sentence, feeling that something was amiss. That name sounded too familiar.
He carefully asked, "Daoist Xiantian Qi Tongtian?"
"Yes."
Elder Tao looked as if he had seen a ghost, instinctively taking two steps back in confusion, Wasn't it said that the Grand Ancestor was dead? How could there be a re-emergence?
Is the moral climate of Seek Dao Sect so poor that it has resurrected the Grand Ancestor?
Yun Zhi introduced to Daoist Xiantian, "This is Elder Tao, the guardian of the Scripture Pavilion, at the transcendence tribulation cultivation level."
"Nice to meet you," Daoist Xiantian greeted politely.
"Just call me Little Tao," Elder Tao said, nodding and bowing, not daring to be presumptuous.
Lu Yang took the initiative to explain the circumstances behind the Grand Ancestor's awakening, convincing Elder Tao that it wasn't an issue with the Sect's moral climate.
"Grand Ancestor, if there's any cultivation technique or secret tome you fancy, please take it," offered Elder Tao.
Daoist Xiantian chuckled sheepishly, feeling a bit out of place as he was now a mere mortal and hadn't started cultivating; the cultivation techniques and secret tomes were of no use to him.
After leaving the Scripture Pavilion, Daoist Xiantian suddenly remembered something Elder Tao had mentioned.
"What was Little Tao talking about earlier regarding the Phoenix Ancestor? Did that esteemed figure visit our Seek Dao Sect?"
Daoist Xiantian had heard that the Phoenix Ancestor was one of the Four Imperial Protectors of the Ancient Heavenly Court. Such an ancient figure should have no relation to their Seek Dao Sect.
Meng Jingzhou replied, "Yes, the Phoenix Ancestor has visited. After all, the Phoenix Ancestor is a guest elder of our Seek Dao Sect."
"Guest elder?" Daoist Xiantian became even more confused, his eyes filled with incomprehension, "But isn't the Phoenix Ancestor a member of the Heavenly Court Sect, the leader of the Four Great Devil Sects?"
Lu Yang casually explained, "Oh, that's nothing. The Ancient Heavenly Court is our Seek Dao Sect."
"Ah?" Daoist Xiantian stood there, stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 717 - 716: The Once Strongest Trump Card of the Seek Dao Sect
chapters.content:
"The Ancient Heavenly Court is our Seek Dao Sect?"
He had heard that the Ancient Heavenly Court was replete with strong figures—there were Heavenly Venerates, Sect Leaders, Four Imperial Protectors, Protector Heavenly Kings, and all kinds of geniuses.
In particular, it was said that a Phoenix Ancestor of the Phoenix Tribe overpowered Venerate Zhu Tian and Sect Leader Yun captured two great Semi-Immortals.
Wait, two great Semi-Immortals?
Daoist Xiantian suddenly remembered the Nightmare Supreme and the Void Venerate imprisoned at Captive Peak.
Weren't these the very two great Semi-Immortals mentioned in the rumors?
At Captive Peak, he had been bombarded with one piece of news after another until he had lost the ability to think; only now did he come to his senses and realize that Sect Leader Yun would hardly send two great Semi-Immortals to the Seek Dao Sect willingly.
Unless Sect Leader Yun was one of their own from Seek Dao Sect!
With that thought, everything became clear!
But that wasn't quite right either. If the Heavenly Court Sect originated from ancient times, could it be that the Seek Dao Sect was actually an ancient Great Sect?
How did he not know about this?
"To be precise, some members of our Sect are from the Heavenly Court Sect," Lu Yang corrected him.
"Our Ancient Heavenly Court took on the role of a demonic sect in order to eradicate all demonic sects in one fell swoop, enduring humiliation and bearing heavy burdens in disguise."
Daoist Xiantian looked at Lu Yang with an odd look in his eyes.
Disguising as a demonic sect, they had become the head of the demonic sects?
With the power that the Ancient Heavenly Court had shown, if placed in their era, it would have been enough to sweep the world several times over.
As they spoke, the four arrived at the bamboo forest at the outer edges of the Sect, where a stream babbled through.
"River Spirit Elder, please show yourself," Yun Zhi called out loud.
The calm stream turned turbulent, a fountain erupted from the river surface, and an aged figure appeared above the fountain.
"What brings you here?" River Spirit asked indifferently.
"Xiao Lu!" When Daoist Xiantian saw River Spirit, his eyes lit up, and he blurted out River Spirit's nickname.
A trace of embarrassment crossed River Spirit's face; there were still people who knew his name.
No, he wouldn't acknowledge that as his name.
"Who are you?" River Spirit's gaze fell on Daoist Xiantian, not recognizing the young man.
"It's me, Qi Tongtian," Daoist Xiantian excitedly introduced himself. He did not expect Xiao Lu, River Spirit, to still be around.
The history of the stream was even longer than that of the Seek Dao Sect.
Before the Seek Dao Sect came into existence, a trace of spiritual essence had emerged in the stream without yet having developed spirituality.
When Daoist Xiantian was wandering outside, he chanced upon the anomaly in the stream. He locked the trace of spiritual essence within the stream to ensure it wouldn't dissipate and brought the stream back to the Seek Dao Sect, leading to the existence of River Spirit.
Truth be told, Daoist Xiantian had saved River Spirit's life, which was why he had been guarding the Seek Dao Sect all along.
"Damn it, you're Qi Tongtian? You're still alive?" Upon seeing Daoist Xiantian, River Spirit rarely showed an excited expression, and he couldn't suppress the smile tugging at his mouth.
"Alive, just with some mishaps," Daoist Xiantian scratched his head, sheepishly chuckling.
"Seems like quite a big mishap, you've become a mortal."
"Still being alive is good enough."
"That's right, you've always had that mentality."
"Now the Seek Dao Sect has become quite something else, completely different from when you first established it." River Spirit had personally witnessed how the Seek Dao Sect had grown stronger step by step.
Daoist Xiantian nodded, "I see that. The juniors are all very diligent, much stronger than I was."
The two exchanged words that only they understood, their expressions excited.
Having met after an expanse of 120,000 years, they seemed to revert to the times of the Great Yu Era, with endless topics to discuss. They talked for the better half of the day before taking a pause, still seeming as if they had much more to say.
Yun Zhi reminded from the side, "Elders, if you wish to chat, you can do so anytime in the future. Ancestor, you still have one more person to meet."
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were puzzled; they had thought that all the high-ranking members of Seek Dao Sect had been met.
Who else hadn't been met?
"Right, we haven't seen everyone yet, let's go," Daoist Xiantian slapped his forehead, remembering that they couldn't spend all their time here.
"Xiao Lu, see you later."
River Spirit laughed and cursed, "I've told you I don't want that crappy name; think of a new one for me later!"
"Eldest Senior Sister, is there anyone else we haven't met yet?" Lu Yang asked quietly.
"Yes, there's one more person, you'll see when we get there."
The last high-ranking member was quite far from this location, so Eldest Senior Sister once again plucked a cloud and took the three of them on a flying boat.
Across the great prairie, Captive Peak, the original site of the Sword Washing Pool... the cloud flew over these places without any intention of slowing down.
It was not until they reached the depths of the Seek Dao Sect that Lu Yang and his companion had never visited before that they stopped in a desolate mountain area.
"This is Cangmang Mountain, where a senior figure from our sect is in seclusion," she said.
"The reason you haven't met him is that he has been in seclusion all this time."
"Moreover, his identity is quite special; very few people know about him."
As she spoke, Eldest Senior Sister parted the withered vines and revealed the cave behind them.
"Senior, are you there? If you are not in seclusion, please come out."
Soon, a youthful voice came from the cave, sounding as if it was a teenager around Daoist Xiantian's age.
"Why are you shouting so loudly, don't you know to respect your elders?"
In the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity quietly uttered a sound of surprise.
Before Lu Yang could ask what had happened, they saw a teenager walk out from the cave, his face showing impatience.
"Let me introduce you. This is the founding ancestor of our sect's revival, Vast Sea Daoist Lord Fang Wuya."
"!!!!"
This time, it was Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou's turn to be shocked.
Vast Sea Daoist Lord from 50,000 years ago!
He's still alive?
Wasn't he just at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage?
"No, he is a Semi-Immortal," Fairy Eternity revealed the realm of Vast Sea Daoist Lord.
"I'm busy in seclusion, what do you want?"
The existence of Vast Sea Daoist Lord was the Seek Dao Sect's strongest trump card; he would not take action unless the sect's very survival was at stake.
At least, that was the case before Yun Zhi joined the Seek Dao Sect.
After Yun Zhi joined the Seek Dao Sect, her cultivation progressed by leaps and bounds every day, and Vast Sea Daoist Lord believed that this junior had potential and thus offered to provide guidance.
Subsequently, she defeated him soundly, leaving him spitting foam, falling flowers and flowing water, unable to stand up again.
Since then, he vowed to make a strenuous effort to achieve immortality and regain his dignity as the reviver of the sect, and so he secluded himself deep within the Seek Dao Sect.
From then on, he disappeared from sight within the Seek Dao Sect.
"We have found a senior figure who might need to meet you," she said.
"Oh, which junior might that be?" Fang Wuya asked casually, as for him, being the reviving ancestor, Yun Zhi was a junior, and so was everyone else to him.
"This one," Yun Zhi stepped aside, revealing Daoist Xiantian.
"The one we've found is the founding master of our sect, Daoist Xiantian Qi Tongtian."
"Hello, I am Qi Tongtian," Daoist Xiantian greeted as politely as ever.
"Ancestor... Master?"
Fang Wuya was taken aback.
Originally, he had the highest status within the Seek Dao Sect, both in terms of cultivation level and seniority; he was first in both.
Then came Yun Zhi, causing his cultivation level to fall to second place within the Seek Dao Sect.
And now, it turned out he wasn't even the most senior in terms of lineage either.

chapters.title: Chapter 718 - 717 I'll Protect You Once
chapters.content:
"Junior Fang Wuya pays his respects to the Ancestral Master." Fang Wuya bowed deeply, performing a grand ritual of greeting.
"You flatter me, you flatter me," Daoist Xiantian hastily waved his hand, asserting that Fang Wuya's contributions to the Seek Dao Sect were no less significant than his own.
"The Ancestral Master founded the Seek Dao Sect, and that deserves my utmost respect," Fang Wuya earnestly declared.
"Eldest Senior Sister, are there others in our sect who know of the existence of the Vast Sea Daoist Lord?" Lu Yang asked quietly.
"The Vast Sea Daoist Lord is our sect's strongest hidden card, not to be played lightly. According to the rules, only the Sect Leader is qualified to be privy to this knowledge."
"However, during Grandmaster's generation, the Grandmaster did not inform my master about the Vast Sea Daoist Lord; as a result, only the Grandmaster knew of his existence within our sect."
Lu Yang thought, could it be that the Grandmaster feared that the master, knowing about the presence of the Vast Sea Daoist Lord and relying on a Semi-Immortal, would become even more reckless in causing trouble abroad? That must be why he didn't tell the master.
It seems that the master's widespread deceit and trickery have caused the Grandmaster to lose trust in him.
On the other hand, although I myself resurrected an Ancient Immortal, brought forth figures from the Ancient Era Integration Stage, Transcendance Tribulation Stage, and Semi-Immortals, it was all ultimately through various fortuitous coincidences, not intentional on my part.
Perhaps it was for this reason that Eldest Senior Sister considered me not to be a troublemaker and was willing to disclose the matter of the Vast Sea Daoist Lord to me.
Fairy Eternity looked at Lu Yang in surprise. Could it be not because the troubles you stirred were beyond the Vast Sea Daoist Lord's capabilities, that whether informing you about his existence made a difference or not, Miss Yun still told you?
"Later, the Grandmaster saw that I had remarkable talent in cultivation and hoped the Vast Sea Daoist Lord could enlighten me on my cultivation dilemmas. It was for this reason he set precedent aside and introduced me to the Vast Sea Daoist Lord."
"And then?"
"Then I helped the Vast Sea Daoist Lord with his cultivation perplexities. He had an epiphany and has been in closed-door cultivation ever since."
Lu Yang: "..."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Did the Vast Sea Daoist Lord really seclude himself because he had an epiphany?
"By the way, Eldest Senior Sister, Celestial Master Guiyuan isn't still alive, is he?"
Eldest Senior Sister gently shook her head, "Celestial Master Guiyuan disappeared a very long time ago."
"If Celestial Master Guiyuan were still around, there wouldn't be any talk of decline and rejuvenation for the Seek Dao Sect."
Celestial Master Guiyuan was from the same era as the ancestors of the Xia family and the Meng family, having established the concept of the Five Great Immortal Sects. His strength was unquestionable. If such a person had remained with the Seek Dao Sect, how could it have possibly declined, and how could there be any talk of 'rejuvenation'?
After some thought, Lu Yang realized this made perfect sense.
"What happened to Celestial Master Guiyuan?"
"According to the sect's daily records, 80,000 years ago, Celestial Master Guiyuan mentioned he wished to travel and venture the world. After that, his whereabouts became unknown, leaving no message, and nobody knew where he had gone."
"I believe that the old master must have been trapped somewhere, unable to leave," Eldest Senior Sister sighed. Celestial Master Guiyuan was a Semi-Immortal, and Semi-Immortals have a limited lifespan. With 80,000 years having passed, it's unknown whether he is still trapped somewhere or if his lifespan has run out and he has perished.
Of course, it's also possible that he unluckily encountered an Immortal and was directly killed.
"Speaking of which, why have you turned into a mortal, Ancestral Master? Did you start over after disbanding your cultivation?" Vast Sea Daoist Lord inquired.
Daoist Xiantian nodded, "Yes."
"So, do you plan to start cultivating again? How about I teach you?" Vast Sea Daoist Lord's expression showed a trace of excitement.
Daoist Xiantian always felt there was something odd about Vast Sea Daoist Lord's offer.
Even though he was at the Body Integration Realm before, returning to the Body Integration Realm wouldn't be difficult; but being instructed by a Semi-Immortal would indeed yield better results than cultivating alone.
"Very well."
Vast Sea Daoist Lord, seeing that Daoist Xiantian had agreed, became even more excited, "So shall we begin our cul..."
"Ah no, there's no rush right now," Daoist Xiantian interrupted Vast Sea Daoist Lord's next words.
"You see, I'm definitely going to cultivate within the sect in the future, which means I'll inevitably interact with the sect's disciples."
"I can't possibly tell them I'm the grandmaster, as that would make them feel too constrained."
Daoist Xiantian said with an embarrassed smile, "And I can't just join Seek Dao Sect directly, as that would seem like I'm using backdoor connections, giving the impression that our Seek Dao Sect has shady dealings."
"So what do you mean?"
"The entrance trial is about to begin, right? I was thinking, maybe I could join our sect as an ordinary disciple by passing the entrance trial, starting everything afresh."
Vast Sea Daoist Lord's eyelid twitched, unsure of what to say. After a long silence, he finally spoke respectfully, "I shall heed the grandmaster's command."
"In that case, since I haven't made any progress in my seclusion, how about I show you around the current Seek Dao Sect?" Vast Sea Daoist Lord said with a smile.
He had been in seclusion for so long that the moment he closed his eyes, all he saw was Yun Zhi's fists and kicks, threatening his life, with no cultivation progress to show for it.
Besides, one cannot transition from Semi-Immortal to Immortal just by secluding oneself; throughout history, no Immortal has ever achieved this solely through seclusion.
"That's a very accurate thought." Fairy Eternity, with her immense wisdom, saw right through Vast Sea Daoist Lord's thoughts.
She selflessly shared her insights on becoming an Immortal with Lu Yang, "To cultivate into an Immortal, the most important thing is to have enlightenment and the right mindset. There are many Dao Fruits similar to the Eternity Dao Fruit, such as the Immortal Dao Fruit, Indestructible Dao Fruit. So why did they not succeed, while I did?"
Lu Yang couldn't help but say, "Could it be because you, Fairy, are exceptionally talented?"
Fairy Eternity was about to say "It's because I have a good mindset," but upon hearing what Lu Yang said, she immediately smiled broadly, giggling happily, "Right, because I'm a genius."
Vast Sea Daoist Lord continued, "Presumably, after meeting the grandmaster, Yun Zhi directly brought the grandmaster here without giving you a chance to look around the current Seek Dao Sect."
"The current Seek Dao Sect is quite different from your time. Not to mention the far-off places, just take Captive Peak, for example. It houses convicts with profound cultivation levels."
Daoist Xiantian nodded, "Yes, I visited Captive Peak and indeed found it filled with Great Cultivators from legends, including Nightmare Supreme and Void Venerate."
"Yes, and it holds Nightmare Supreme and Void Venera... wait, who did you say was in Captive Peak?" Vast Sea Daoist Lord paused, sensing something amiss.
How long have I been in seclusion, and since when has Captive Peak been holding a Semi-Immortal? Why didn't I know about this?
Seeing the strange look in Vast Sea Daoist Lord's eyes, Daoist Xiantian pointed at Yun Zhi, "I heard it was Yun Zhi who captured them."
Yun Zhi was standing next to Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
Previously, Vast Sea Daoist Lord's attention had been focused solely on Daoist Xiantian and he hadn't noticed the presence of two cultivators at the Nascent Soul stage.
"Who are you two?"
"Greetings, Vast Sea Daoist Lord, my name is Lu Yang, a disciple of Daoist Buyu."
"Greetings, Vast Sea Daoist Lord, my name is Meng Jingzhou, a Meng Family Member, now accepted into our sect."
Vast Sea Daoist Lord's knowledge of Daoist Buyu's disciples was still at the stage of the third disciple, Gan Tian; He didn't know there was now a fourth one.
"Two fine juniors. Since you were brought to meet me by Yun Zhi, she must think highly of you, believing you both have exceptional talents and promising futures."
"Yun Zhi's judgment has always been sound."
"As a grandmaster, I can't meet you without offering something, but I don't have any suitable gifts on hand."
After thinking it over, Vast Sea Daoist Lord said, "In that case, if you two cause any trouble in the future, I will protect you once."
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou quickly expressed their gratitude, "Thank you, Vast Sea Daoist Lord!"

chapters.title: Chapter 719 - 718: Mid-stage Nascent Soul
chapters.content:
Although it was their first meeting, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had already developed a great fondness for the Vast Sea Daoist Lord.
This is the bearing of a senior.
When the Vast Sea Daoist Lord offered to protect the two of them once, Yun Zhi originally wanted to persuade him otherwise, but Lu Yang and his companion were so polite and quick to express their gratitude that she found it inappropriate to interject.
Daoist Xiantian decided to stay with the Vast Sea Daoist Lord for the time being, and Yun Zhi, along with the two ancestors, said their farewells and took Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou back to their respective mountains.
"You two focus on your cultivation."
"As you command."
...
Four months had passed, and there was less than a month left until the second day of the second lunar month.
The disciples who had been sent on missions were returning one after another. Dai Bufan, looking at the piles of mission reports, nodded frequently, very satisfied, which proved that most of the mortals he had selected were of good character.
On the Sword Stone, Lu Yang assumed the Five Centers Toward Heaven posture, his Sword Qi restrained; the two swords, Green Peak and Dark Moon, the Seven-star Sword formation, and the particularly conspicuous Sword Washing Pool, all floated around Lu Yang, protecting him.
With each breath, a fresh essence circulated through his body, breaking through the acupuncture points and the locked chains of his body, making Lu Yang seem like a Flood Dragon that had been slumbering in the abyss, soaring to the sky, spreading his wings across the nine heavens!
Hu——
Lu Yang exhaled a breath of turbid air, the pollution within his body. The turbid breath turned into a streak of Sword Qi and zipped out, followed by countless giant trees being sliced in half and tumbling down in succession.
A breath that devours mountains and rivers, a mouth that spits out Sword Qi.
Lu Yang's understanding of swordsmanship had ascended to a new level!
In today's Cultivation World, apart from Daoist Buyu, no one has been heard of achieving this at the Nascent Soul Stage!
"Mid-stage Nascent Soul now."
Lu Yang felt the changes after his promotion carefully. Although it was not as earth-shattering as when he broke core to reach Nascent, there were indeed changes, and they were significantly enhanced!
Now, he could defeat an Invincible Nascent Soul at the Nascent Soul Early Stage!
"Invincible Nascent Soul, come fight!"
Empowered with great strength, Lu Yang sought to challenge the Invincible Nascent Soul. Soon enough, the Invincible Nascent Soul made him realize the reality.
"Wait, go easy on me."
After all, the Invincible Nascent Soul was also at the Mid-stage Nascent Soul level.
Lu Yang was in pain and reestablished the connection with the Invincible Nascent Soul, which then calmed down and returned to the Dantian.
After a brief exchange with the Invincible Nascent Soul, Lu Yang indeed discovered his shortcomings.
"Though my strength and speed are equal to that of the Invincible Nascent Soul, its techniques are clearly more sophisticated. In theory, I should be able to do the same."
Lu Yang calmed down, repeatedly recalling the experience of the beating he'd just taken, and gained much from it.
"Perhaps this is the true use of the Invincible Nascent Soul, to help me find my shortcomings."
He then excitedly manipulated the nine long swords, activating the Sword Array.
"Destroy Immortal Sword Array!"
The nine long swords hung high above his head, their tips pointing downwards, exerting a tremendous sense of oppression.
Especially that Sword Washing Pool, the sense of oppression was the greatest.
Thud, Lu Yang knelt on the ground, unable to stand up.
"Doesn't this damned Sword Array distinguish friend from foe, affecting even the master!" Lu Yang raged.
Fairy Eternity pouted, "Have you forgotten what this Sword Array was originally for?"
This was the Sword Array that the Qilin Immortal had set up for himself. Since its creation, it was meant to be used against the master of the Sword Array.
...
At the entrance of Meng Jingzhou's abode.
The stone door boomed open, and Meng Jingzhou retracted the Yang Yang Tai Chi Diagram, stepping out of the abode to bask in the sunlight, comfortably stretching himself.
"It feels great to finally reach the mid-stage Nascent Soul," Lu Yang said contentedly.
"Hm? Old Ma, what are you doing?" Meng Jingzhou noticed Old Ma sitting outside the entrance to his abode, sitting on the ground with his hind legs crossed and his front legs resting on his knees, continuously exhaling and inhaling white breath from his nostrils.
"Are you cultivating?" Meng Jingzhou was seeing Old Ma cultivate for the first time and wasn't quite sure.
Old Ma glanced at Meng Jingzhou. He had previously thought that being at the Body Integration Realm was quite satisfactory; as long as those who had passed the tribulation did not appear, he was an invincible existence.
But now he realized he was wrong. Since he had dragged Meng Jingzhou away from the Meng Family, three years had passed, and all the enemies they had encountered were beyond his capabilities.
They were either too numerous or had higher cultivation levels.
In any case, none of them were ones he could handle.
It was only the encounter with the clay statue not long ago that had given him a bit of reassurance, letting him know he was indeed a great power of the Body Integration Realm who commanded the horizon.
If he didn't put more effort into cultivation now, it was uncertain who would be the protector of whom in the future.
...
"What a bustling street." Daoist Xiantian and Vast Sea Daoist Lord arrived at the street market. Considering their unfamiliar presence in Seek Dao Sect, which stood out too much, Vast Sea Daoist Lord cast a spell to conceal their presence.
Vast Sea Daoist Lord thought he had finally found a place the grandmaster had never been to.
He had just visited Captive Peak to confirm that Nightmare Supreme and Void Venerate were indeed captured, and then he listened to the incessant complaints of the child teacher Tang Shengyi about how there were too many semi-immortals and those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage imprisoned in Captive Peak, keeping him busy, who was just at the Transcendance tribulation stage himself.
After several detours, the two of them finally came to the street market.
They moved through the bustling street like passers-by of the world, unnoticed by both the disciples of the Seek Dao Sect and the great powers hiding in the market street.
"Mutton kebabs here, fresh and authentic mutton kebabs!"
Smelling the sizzling fragrance of mutton fat dripping onto true fire, Daoist Xiantian sniffed.
"It smells wonderful."
If he were in the Body Integration Realm, having long passed the stage of satisfying culinary desires, he wouldn't be tempted by mere mutton kebabs.
But now, as a mortal, he needed to eat.
"Grandmaster, would you like some?" Vast Sea Daoist Lord asked considerately.
"Dear customers, would you like to come in for some mutton kebabs?" The person calling out at the entrance of the barbecue shop asked with a smile.
"Yes... wait, can you see us?" Vast Sea Daoist Lord instinctively replied on behalf of Daoist Xiantian, then suddenly realized something was amiss.
They were supposed to be in a state of concealed presence through their dao techniques and shouldn't have been noticed.
Unless the other person was at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage!
Where did Seek Dao Sect get a third person at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage!
Vast Sea Daoist Lord suddenly looked up, staring at the crier, a soul entity with the fluctuations of a Dao Fruit Outline, "Semi-immortal?"
"Who are you?" he demanded.
"Me? I used to be Immortal Eternity. Now I'm the owner of this barbecue shop and the slaughterhouse," replied the figure.
"Immortal Eternity? You're from the Eternity Sect!" Vast Sea Daoist Lord grew more cautious, as the Eternity Sect actually had a semi-immortal in their midst, and they had infiltrated their Seek Dao Sect.
This meant that among the Four Great Devil Sects, the Eternity Sect was the strongest!
Vast Sea Daoist Lord urged his Dao Fruit Outline, ready for action.
"Wait, wait, you've misunderstood. I was captured and brought here to Seek Dao Sect," Immortal Eternity hastily explained, recognizing the Vast Sea Daoist Lord at a glance, who looked identical to a statue.
"What's going on?" Vast Sea Daoist Lord frowned, withdrawing his Dao Fruit Outline. He had been in retreat for three hundred years, but it felt like he'd been away for tens of thousands of years, with Seek Dao Sect undergoing earth-shattering changes he knew nothing about.
If he looked closely at when the changes happened, he would discover that they hadn't occurred over those three hundred years, but rather within the last three.
Immortal Eternity invited the two grandmasters into the barbecue shop and instructed Master Liu and Master Gao to bring out their special skills and serve their best dishes.
"To tell you how I came to your Seek Dao Sect, I'd have to start from the beginning. It all began when Seek Dao Sect disciples were carrying out a mission, tasked with eliminating a Tiger Demon..."

chapters.title: Chapter 720 - 719 Master of All Laws
chapters.content:
On the second day of the second month, it was recruitment time.
The colossal airship slowly descended near the Seek Dao Sect, and countless young talents bounded out, excitedly gazing at the continuous stretch of mountains in the distance.
"There lies the legendary gate of the Seek Dao Sect!"
"Who knows how many will pass the test this time."
"It's said that less than one percent made it into the Seek Dao Sect last session."
"That's so low. I heard that both the Prison Suppressing Sect and the Five Elements Sect don't have such extreme acceptance rates."
"Not only that, I've also heard that those who were filtered out either entered a super-grade sect or a first-grade sect, with only a few entering a second-grade sect."
"You see, even those who weren't selected last time are considered promising seeds to other top sects."
"Young master, don't forget the Clan Leader's admonition; joining the Seek Dao Sect must not be forced."
Most of the young geniuses were accompanied by family elders. Whether they could join the Seek Dao Sect would decide their future paths. Without family elders, it was easy to lose confidence amid endless self-doubt before the test began and defeat oneself without a fight.
Of course, there were also those who came alone, like Lu Yang, who didn't even know what a Spirit Root was last session and still tried his luck, or Meng Jingzhou, who had run away from home.
A handsome young man with a cold expression walked down from the flying ship, each step he took measured, with a long and sustained breath indicating he possessed martial skills.
The cold and detached young man looked towards the Seek Dao Sect not far away, with a hint of a mysterious smile curling at his lips.
"I hope the Seek Dao Sect can bring me some surprises."
"Fellow daoist, did you come by yourself?" a voice called out to the young man, who turned his head to see two youths around his own age, one with a shy smile and the other with a serious expression.
The one speaking was the youth with the shy smile.
"Who are you?"
"My name is Qi Tong, and this is Fang Ya. We two are also here to take the tests of the Seek Dao Sect. It seems you have the same goal as us. How about joining us?"
The young man with the cold expression gave a snort, "Who are you to call me 'fellow daoist'? My name is Gu Junye, the reincarnation of the Master of All Laws."
"Master of All Laws?" The youth with the shy smile was taken aback. The Master of All Laws was a celebrated and powerful Great Cultivator.
The Master of All Laws, a figure from the early period of the Great Yu Dynasty, had a natural affinity for magic skills and could quickly master any he attempted, almost as talented as an Immortal.
He reached Foundation Establishment at seventeen, Golden Core at eighteen, Nascent Soul at nineteen... His cultivation speed surpassed all other talented cultivators, reaching the Transcendance Tribulation Stage in record time, a historic feat.
He was known to say, "All magic skills are in my heart," which is why he was titled the Master of All Laws.
In the era of Daoist Xiantian, to praise a genius, one would say they had "the potential of the Master of All Laws."
What was the Master of All Laws doing here?
What is reincarnation? Was it a Great Divine Skill that the Master of All Laws had comprehended?
Qi Tong looked at Gu Junye with surprise and uncertainty, not expecting to encounter such legendary figures outside of Captive Peak.
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord slightly frowned, his gaze on Gu Junye wary. Was the other party the reincarnation of the Master of All Laws? Could it be that the Jiuyou Sect was created by the Master of All Laws?
"However, meeting here must mean that we three are fated. Follow me to the Seek Dao Sect," said Gu Junye as he walked towards the sect, signaling Daoist Xiantian and the Vast Sea Daoist Lord to follow.
"Ancestor, wouldn't it be better if we waited at the gate rather than coming down from the flying ship?" the Vast Sea Daoist Lord sent a telepathic message, thinking it too troublesome.
Daoist Xiantian, who couldn't send telepathic messages, spoke softly, "We must not miss any detail in our disguises. What if someone notices that we came out of the Seek Dao Sect? Wouldn't our cover be blown then?"
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord felt the ancestor was overthinking things, but since it was the ancestor's plan, he didn't feel it appropriate to comment.
The crowd gathered at the Dao Seeking Sect like a tide, with several times more mortals coming to participate in the selection than the previous session.
All of this could be attributed to the widely popular storytelling "Legend of the Dao Seeking Sect" that had attracted many mortals who admired the sect.
Gu Junye and two others mingled in the crowd, inconspicuous.
Meanwhile, a carriage slowly passed by them.
On the carriage, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were muttering.
"Why has no one come to sit on our carriage?"
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou remembered that on this day three years ago, the Eldest Senior Sister got on the carriage, claiming she, too, was there for the entrance examination.
Meng Jingzhou, unaware of his impending embarrassment, boasted about knowing the exam questions; but when they arrived at the sect's gate, the Eldest Senior Sister got off, flew into the air, and announced she was the chief examiner for that year's test.
How impressive.
They also wanted to randomly invite someone onto their carriage and then claim they were there for the entrance examination, replicating Eldest Senior Sister's experience.
Unfortunately, they never found the opportunity.
"Shall we have Old Ma make another round?" suggested Meng Jingzhou, after having Old Ma circle near the Dao Seeking Sect several times already.
Lu Yang shook his head, "Forget it, let's get off. It's almost time, and don't forget we need to organize the examination."
The higher-ups of the Dao Seeking Sect, intending to train their disciples, had the sect's disciples organize both this and the last entrance examination. The organizer last time was the Eldest Senior Sister, and this time it was Dai Bufan.
Dai Bufan felt that with him in charge, nothing could go wrong, so he let Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou become one of the organizers.
Elsewhere, Daoist Xiantian was making friends all around.
"Fellow Daoist, you're also here for the examination, aren't you? My name is Qi Tongtian, what's yours?"
The man took offense at being called a "Fellow Daoist" by Daoist Xiantian.
He snorted coldly and said nothing more.
Any Tom, Dick or Harry thinks they can address me as a Fellow Daoist.
If not for Emperor Yu's treasure, who would come to such a place?
They considered that even with the Dao Seeking Sect's defenses relaxed during the recruitment, a hasty attack by their Great Yu Alliance might still be resisted, leading to the activation of the Sect Protection Array and holding off until Dynasty reinforcements arrived.
Such a scenario would mean a failure of their plan and an increased difficulty in acquiring Emperor Yu's treasure next time.
Therefore, leading by example, he disguised himself as a mortal and participated in the entrance examination.
Joining him in the examination were several of his trusted subordinates.
Not far away, cultivators from the Great Yu Alliance were lying in wait, ready to strike inside and out at his command, to abruptly attack and defeat the Dao Seeking Sect!
At first, his subordinates thought the Alliance Hierarch was overreacting. To deal with the mere Dao Seeking Sect, why go through such trouble?
But when they saw a Body Integration Realm old horse disguised as a common horse, continuously circling around the Dao Seeking Sect, they realized the sect was not as simple as it appeared.
This old horse was clearly a great demon king belonging to the Dao Seeking Sect, patrolling secretly and looking for suspicious characters!
The subordinates communicated secretly with their Spiritual Sense; they were at Pass Tribulation stage and were not afraid of being detected by the Dao Seeking Sect's people.
"The master is truly the master, always so thorough in his considerations."
"Of course, the master is none other than the famous Master of All Laws, a name that has resonated through the ages!"

chapters.title: Chapter 721 - 720 Bone Testing
chapters.content:
"What is this attitude!" Vast Sea Daoist Lord blocked the forefather's kind greeting, only to be met with a scornful cold snort, and immediately grew angry.
The person narrowed his eyes and scrutinized Vast Sea Daoist Lord carefully. Besides Emperor Yu and the original Imperial Teacher, he had yet to see anyone dare to speak to him in such a manner. In his eyes, Vast Sea Daoist Lord was already a dead man.
Were it not for the inappropriate circumstance, he could crush this mortal to death a thousand times over with just a thought.
Seeing that the two were about to quarrel, Daoist Xiantian quickly stepped between them, "Fang Ya, that's enough, that's enough. It's my fault. I shouldn't have greeted them directly. They are probably shy. Try to understand."
If it were the Great Yu Era, Daoist Xiantian would think the other party simply didn't want to talk to him—a feeling he was very familiar with. During the Great Yu Era, a cultivator could go half a day without speaking a word. If they weren't snorting coldly, they were using their gaze to signal, just like deaf-mutes.
But now it was the Great Xia Era and, according to his observations over this past half a year, the people of Great Xia were more optimistic and cheerful. They wouldn't coldly snort so rudely. The other party was most likely shy and fearful.
Gu Junye sighed softly but did not speak.
Just as the person was about to speak, a commotion amongst the crowd interrupted him.
A mist of water rose, forming auspicious clouds, lifting Dai Bufan aloft.
With hands clasped behind his back and a solemn expression, Dai Bufan spoke loudly to the throng of people who had come to take part in the examination:
"I am the main person in charge of this examination, Dai Bufan."
"This examination has three rounds. Those who pass all three rounds may become disciples of the Seek Dao Sect."
"We shall now begin the first round of the examination, the Spirit Root test."
"You must form a line in order, awaiting my assessment of your Spirit Roots."
"The rules for the first round are simple. Anyone under the age of sixteen, with Three Spirit Roots or higher or possessing a special physique, may pass the first round.
Accompanying persons should keep a distance from the gate of Seek Dao Sect and wait for the final result, hoping that their younger generation may have the fortune to join the Seek Dao Sect.
Dai Bufan sat at the table, in front of him a long queue, with Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou standing behind him with folded arms like two protectors.
Both of their eyes were restless, searching for Gu Junye's position. However, after looking for quite some time, they couldn't find him due to the crowd being too large.
The first person sat down and extended their hand. Dai Bufan took the pulse like a doctor. With just a simple touch of two fingers, he activated his cultivation technique and quickly understood the person's situation.
"Appropriate age, Gold and Water Dual Spirit Roots, good. What's your name?"
The first person, when asked their name, was pleasantly surprised: "My name is Pang Yu!"
"Alright, you've passed. Go on through."
The first one had Dual Spirit Roots, which made Dai Bufan feel that his luck was good today; it seemed they were going to recruit many disciples with decent talent this year.
He tested thirty people in a row, all with Dual Spirit Roots or Three Spirit Roots.
There are two types of mortals who come to participate in the examinations of the Seek Dao Sect. One type hears about recruitment and pays their own expenses to try their luck. The other is singled out by Dai Bufan, suspected of having the qualifications suitable for the Seek Dao Sect.
Dai Bufan seeks out qualified mortals in advance because he is worried they might head to the Five Elements Sect or the Prison Suppressing Sect instead.
The Five Elements Sect, Prison Suppressing Sect, and Laurel Fairy Palace would conduct covert pre-examination investigations before recruiting and would appear in person to inform those who pass that they are welcome at their sects.
Such practices were common among the immortal sects, and if the Seek Dao Sect didn't do the same, they'd be at a disadvantage.
In fact, many disciples mentioned in their mission reports that while on their tasks, they encountered disciples from other immortal sects. There had even been cases of one mortal being observed by multiple immortal sects.
When several immortal sects inform someone that they can participate in their entry tests, they usually choose the Seek Dao Sect.
Joining the Seek Dao Sect, perhaps I too could become the protagonist of "Legend of the Dao Sect".
"Three Spirit Roots, are you Zhuang Ping?" Dai Bufan suddenly asked.
"Yes, I am Zhuang Ping. May I ask what this is about?"
"Nothing much, you may proceed." Dai Bufan suppressed the urge to continue questioning and remembered the mission report from Ji Hongwen.
Ji Hongwen kindly reported the crime, sending both the upper echelons of the listening sect and Zhuang Ping's mother to the prison, even taking care of Zhuang Ping's process for visiting the prison, which was extremely considerate.
I originally thought Zhuang Ping wouldn't choose the Seek Dao Sect, yet unexpectedly he really did come.
Half of the people had already completed the bone test. Aside from a few who were trying to bluff their way through, most had passed the first round of tests.
"Using elixirs to temporarily forge Dual Spirit Roots, did you really think I couldn't see through it? You have failed." Dai Bufan gave a look, signaling Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou to take action, leading the person away for later processing.
Using elixirs to falsify Spirit Roots must be for fraud. A mere mortal couldn't possibly obtain such high-level elixirs on their own; there must be someone else behind it.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou stepped forward and took the person away, handing him over to Man Gu and Li Haoran. Afterwards, they continued to stand by Dai Bufan's side, like guardian deities.
At last, a familiar face arrived for Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
Gu Junye gave a meaningful look to the Sword Master Xuanyuan and the Saint Invincible, for they had once fought side by side across the world, assaulted the Heavenly Realm above and hunted the Abyss below, and settled the chaos within the realm of humans. Such a bond forged in battle couldn't be eroded by mere reincarnation!
He then generously extended his arm.
"Water Spirit Root? Are you Gu Junye?" Dai Bufan exclaimed in surprise, for from the reports of Lu Yang and the others, it wasn't hard to tell that they highly regarded Gu Junye.
"Indeed, I am."
Gu Junye possessed a Water Spirit Root, the same type of Spirit Root as Dai Bufan.
Dai Bufan also realized that Gu Junye had undergone long-term training, something that couldn't be achieved without great perseverance, indicating a resolute Dao heart.
Dai Bufan pondered if Gu Junye really was as outstanding as Lu Yang and his colleague had praised, passing the tests shouldn't be a problem. Should he offer to take him as a disciple on behalf of his own mentor, just like Senior Sister Yun did with Lu Yang?
Oh no, that's not right; the two situations are different. The Sect Leader was imprisoned and couldn't take disciples, while his own master was alive and well, bouncing around energetically. There's no need to take a disciple on his mentor's behalf; it's best to let his master do it.
"Alright, you may proceed." Dai Bufan waved his hand, somehow feeling that there was something off about Gu Junye's tone, but didn't think too much of it.
As Gu Junye walked away, he revealed the person standing behind, causing Dai Bufan's heart to clench.
"Hello, my name is Qi Tong, and I'm here to participate in the tests."
Dai Bufan had long heard that the Ancestor of their sect was going to participate in the tests as well. Although mentally prepared, the reality still felt awkward.
Should he offer his seat to the Ancestor, letting the Ancestor sit where he was?
With a touch of his two fingers, Dai Bufan instantly measured the Ancestor's Spirit Root.
"Wood Spirit Root, passed."
This wasn't favoritism; Daoist Xiantian did possess a Wood Spirit Root.
Daoist Xiantian's original talent was Three Spirit Roots, but after starting over after disbanding his cultivation, his talent changed to Dual Spirit Roots.
Later, the Eldest Senior Sister personally visited the headquarters of the Luoshui Guards to explain the situation, where she extracted the Gold Cicada from Tao Tingfeng and brought it back.
With the help of the Gold Cicada, Daoist Xiantian's talent reached new peaks, transforming him into a cultivator with a Single Spiritual Root.

chapters.title: Chapter 722 - 721: Gu Junye's Inner Demon
chapters.content:
"Next,"
Conscious of his role as Protector, Lu Yang called out obsequiously.
Naturally, following Daoist Xiantian was Vast Sea Daoist Lord.
However, Dai Bufan was unaware of this, knowing only that Daoist Xiantian had come to participate in the Sect's entrance examination.
Vast Sea Daoist Lord possessed the demeanor of an expert, silent and as cold as ice.
Dai Bufan lightly placed two fingers on Vast Sea Daoist Lord's wrist and quickly arrived at a conclusion, "A Mutated Spiritual Root, Thunder Spiritual Root?"
"What is your name?"
"Fang Ya."
Dai Bufan recalled the name, realizing that Fang Ya was not listed in the character assessment; did he come based on reputation?
"Fang Ya, is it? I'll remember you. Make sure you perform well."
Dai Bufan held Vast Sea Daoist Lord in high regard, thinking that if he were to be vigorously cultivated by the Seek Dao Sect in the future, he would at minimum reach the peak of the Body Integration Realm and become a pillar of the Sect.
Being a mortal, Fang Ya was unaware of the good fortune it was to be valued by Dai Bufan, feeling not the slightest shred of gratitude for the goodwill showed to him, he simply rose to his feet and walked to the second trial. It was only after joining the Seek Dao Sect that Fang Ya realized the grand opportunity he had missed today.
Fairy Eternity looked at Lu Yang with astonishment, not understanding why he suddenly embarked on an inner monologue.
"Next." This time, it was Meng Jingzhou's turn to call out.
Dai Bufan's eyelid twitched; he always felt like an emperor seated on the throne, with two little eunuchs by his side chirping out the summons for some lord to attend.
Earlier, when he had Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou drag away those with fake Spirit Roots, he had not without reason hoped to replace them with others. Unfortunately, his plan did not succeed.
Next in line after Vast Sea Daoist Lord was Master of All Laws.
Initially, Master of All Laws had thought of fabricating just any Dual Spirit Roots, but since the three individuals before him all had Single Spiritual Roots, wouldn't his falsified Dual Spiritual Roots pale in comparison?
That wouldn't do. He couldn't accept that.
Master of All Laws extended his hand, letting Dai Bufan probe.
Dai Bufan's Cultivation Technique could investigate the physical condition of another, but it was useless against an opponent of Master of All Laws' caliber.
Master of All Laws was confident that he would not be seen as anything out of the ordinary.
This was the confidence of a Semi-Immortal.
A surprised look spread across Dai Bufan's face, "An Immortal body for longevity?"
From the name alone, this was a body type that possessed a long lifespan, one so rare that not even five instances could be found from ancient times to the present.
Dai Bufan muttered to himself, wondering what was going on. It was one thing for this cohort to be of high quality, but for such occurrences to be successively emerging?
Starting with Gu Junye, this was the fourth person.
The individuals lined up behind began to grow restless, looking at Master of All Laws with envy. Such a physique was sought after voraciously by the Five Great Immortal Sects.
"What is your name?" asked Dai Bufan.
"Gu Xie."
Fairy Eternity stared at Gu Xie for a moment, "Something feels off."
"Is there a problem with this person?" Lu Yang asked.
Fairy Eternity took another two looks, marking his words with certainty, "This man is a Semi-Immortal."
"A Semi-Immortal?!" If Lu Yang hadn't already been accustomed to seeing Immortals and Semi-Immortals, the sheer revelation would have made him exclaim.
"Yes. He has a Dao Fruit Outline; he's definitely a Semi-Immortal," said Fairy Eternity with certainty.
"It seems this matter must be reported to Eldest Senior Sister," Lu Yang thought for a moment. This was beyond Elder Brother Dai's ability to handle; the person hiding their identity to enter the Seek Dao Sect likely had ill intentions.
However, Lu Yang did not immediately return to Sky Gate Mountain, as this could potentially alert Gu Xie, spooking him.
Afterwards, Dai Bufan tested roughly two hundred individuals.
"Dual Spirit Roots of water and wood, and innately compatible with cultivating Spiritual Plants?" Dai Bufan had found another promising seedling.
"I remember your name is Zhou Xing'er?"
This was also a mortal previously examined for their character.
There had been a record in the mission report that Zhou Xing'er was born in a mountain ravine. Mountain villages generally favored boys over girls, and Zhou Xing'er was no exception. Until a year ago, Zhou Xing'er had chanced upon a special Storage Ring that allowed her to plant grains and vegetables which grew exceedingly well inside it.
With this special Storage Ring, Zhou Xing'er had managed to avoid the fate of being married off.
According to Seek Dao Sect's investigation, the Storage Ring was forged by the Fifth Elder. During a high-speed boat chase by the government office, it was inadvertently lost.
Upon learning of this, the Fifth Elder stated bluntly that there was no need to retrieve it.
"Alright, you may go now."
"Thank you, Venerable One."
Lu Yang, seeing that the time was about right, sent a message to Dai Bufan: "Elder Brother Dai, I have something to attend to and need to step away for a moment."
Dai Bufan couldn't have been happier for Lu Yang to leave; he would have preferred if Lu Yang took Meng Jingzhou with him, but unfortunately, Lu Yang lacked the awareness and left alone.
Man Gu took Lu Yang's place.
"Next!"
Man Gu's voice was strong and full of energy, reminiscent of the imperial guards at the gates of the Imperial Palace announcing the arrival of a dignitary.
...
The first round of trials ended with a full eight hundred people advancing to the second round.
These eight hundred individuals would be eagerly sought after by second-class sects, while the First Class Sects would appear somewhat more reserved.
"Congratulations to everyone for passing the first round of trials. Now, let's begin the second round."
Dai Bufan continued to preside over the trials, while disciples from other sects surrounded the eight hundred participants to maintain order.
The location for the second round of trials was a bamboo forest, which was the domain of the River Spirit.
"It is often said that on the path of cultivation, inner demons are rife. In truth, your inner demons have already taken root within your hearts even before you step into the world of cultivation."
"The eager expectations of your parents, the deep affection of your elders, the fear of failing this trial... all of these are the makings of inner demons!"
"The second trial will test whether you can confront your inner demons and overcome them!"
"Of course, considering that your minds are not yet mature, overcoming your inner demons will be a great challenge. Consequently, in the second trial, you can choose to face your inner demons alone or team up to conquer them."
"After all, friends' company and assistance are also indispensable on the road to cultivation."
"All of you are so impressive, possessing a Water Spirit Root and even the legendary Immortal body," Daoist Xiantian said with a laugh, expressing envy for Gu Junye and Gu Xie. "I've heard that the Master of All Laws is an Immortal body too."
"Perhaps one day you could become a mighty being just like the Master of All Laws."
Gu Xie remained unmoved by Daoist Xiantian's praise.
Gu Junye patted Gu Xie on the shoulder in the tone of someone instructing their junior: "While physical constitution is important, what matters more is to have a steadfast heart of Dao!"
Gu Xie snorted coldly and subtly dodged Gu Junye's hand without any expression.
"Let's do this; since it's said that many hands make light work and meeting at the sect gate is fate, why don't the four of us team up to overcome our inner demons?"
Gu Xie sneered inwardly, thinking this was a good opportunity to join their team and use the chance to eliminate all three of them, ensuring he was the only one to clear the trial.
"Very well."
Suddenly, the bamboo forest was enveloped in a mist, and figures were no longer visible just ten feet apart.
River Spirit stood on the water, which bubbled and frothed, releasing numerous bubbles that floated into the air and grew larger and larger until they were the height of a person.
These enormous bubbles wrapped around everyone, and for those in teams, the bubbles collided and coalesced into even bigger ones, allowing these temporary groups to enter a single bubble to confront a common inner demon.
...
"It seems we have arrived in the Illusionary Realm," remarked Daoist Xiantian as the four of them awoke once again to find themselves in a desolate and uninhabited area, realizing they were in an Illusionary Realm.
Gu Xie harbored a smirk inside, curious to see what kind of inner demons these three would face – most likely just remonstrations from parents or scary little ghosts, nothing substantial.
He waited for the three of them to show their embarrassing sides!
Suddenly, the weather changed, and a flash of lightning struck, splitting a distant mountain peak to pieces, startling Gu Xie. What was this situation?
Gu Junye stood with his hands behind his back, tilting his head up at a forty-five-degree angle, gazing indifferently at the sky and murmuring, "It's coming."
"What's coming?" Gu Xie couldn't help but ask.
Gu Junye covered his agitated right eye, calming the restless Swallow the Sky beast within, and lifted his hand to point at the darkening sky above.
In the sky, thunder rolled majestically, like the roar of dragons and cries of phoenixes, with the potential to destroy heaven and earth.
"I did not expect my inner demon to truly be this," he said softly.
"What exactly is this?" Gu Xie's eyelids twitched, feeling an ominous premonition.
Gu Junye sighed gently, "The Thunder Tribulation that caused my fall in my previous life, the ninety-nine Heavenly Immortal Tribulation."

chapters.title: Chapter 723 - 722: The Real and Fake Master of All Laws
chapters.content:
"What the hell is that?" Gu Xie doubted he had heard correctly.
How did it suddenly turn into the ninety-nine ascendancy tribulation?
Are you the semi-immortal or am I?
Plus, he had never heard of any thunder tribulation called the "ninety-nine ascendancy tribulation"!
What in the world is this ninety-nine ascendancy tribulation! Did I miss some ancient text?
Within the ninety-nine ascendancy tribulation, Gu Xie saw the Jade Pure Heavenly Tribulation, the World Vast Thunder Tribulation, the Silent Purple Thunder Tribulation... It was as if all the thunder tribulations were gathered together.
Boom.
The ninety-nine ascendancy tribulation hadn't fully formed yet, but its mere residual power had already flattened one mountaintop after another, and several large rocks fell from the sky, landing near their feet.
Outside the Illusionary Realm, Dai Bufan's eyelids twitched uncontrollably.
He had originally wanted to see how the Ancestor would conquer his Inner Demon. The Ancestor's Inner Demons hadn't even appeared when the sudden lightning blinded him.
"Whose Inner Demon is this!"
Whose mortal Inner Demon is making such a commotion, the thunder tribulation I faced when ascending to the Body Integration Realm wasn't even like this!
"That person named Gu Junye," the River Spirit said, creating a chair out of water and sitting down with legs crossed.
He controlled all Inner Demons and knew every Inner Demon that was born.
Dai Bufan abruptly turned his head, staring at Meng Jingzhou: "You need to give an explanation."
Meng Jingzhou wanted to drag Lu Yang into sharing the blame when he suddenly remembered Lu Yang had gone missing before the second round of trials began, thinking could it be that Lu Yang knew there would be trouble, so he ran away in advance?
"It's normal for kids to have a wild imagination."
"What's the Ancestor's Inner Demon?" Dai Bufan asked the River Spirit out of curiosity.
The River Spirit waved his hand: "He might have had Inner Demons before, but not anymore. If he didn't team up needlessly, he could have already passed."
...
Daoist Xiantian truly had no Inner Demons. In the Great Yu Era, he did have them, but ever since he saw them captured at Captive Peak, his Inner Demons disappeared.
Gu Xie felt his eyelids twitch as he watched the thunder tribulation swirling above his head. If he made a move, he would certainly expose his identity, but if he didn't, he would be struck to death by lightning and fail.
Why did I ever think joining a team with you three was a good idea?
Daoist Xiantian had never seen such a huge commotion from a thunder tribulation in his life. He muttered in admiration, "Truly worthy of the Master of All Laws, even his Inner Demon is this strong."
Gu Xie looked more bewildered than when he faced the thunder tribulation: "Who is the Master of All Laws?"
Daoist Xiantian pointed at Gu Junye: "Him, he is the reincarnation of the Master of All Laws."
Gu Xie froze. If he is the Master of All Laws, then who am I?
Soon Gu Xie realized, Gu Junye was an imposter.
Ignorant of death!
Wait, that's not right. Everyone only knows that the Master of All Laws is at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, not knowing that he's already a semi-immortal, and it's impossible for someone at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage to face the ascension tribulation!
How did Gu Junye know that I am a semi-immortal?
He nonchalantly asked Gu Junye, "How did you know that the Master of All Laws is a semi-immortal, I haven't heard anything about this?"
Gu Junye turned his head, his eyes reflecting loneliness, as if recalling a past life: "What semi-immortal? Of course, the Master of All Laws is at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage."
"How could someone at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage possibly pass the ascension tribulation!" Gu Xie was furious, feeling he had been fooled.
A mocking smile appeared on Gu Junye's lips as he said meaningfully, "To ascend is to ascend, if it's not achieved, it isn't. Where does the term semi-immortal come from?"
"It's nothing but the ramblings of the world."
Gu Xie wanted to retort, but upon further thought, he found Gu Junye's words quite logical.
Gu Junye stopped paying attention to Gu Xie, as he actually didn't know about the realm of a semi-immortal; his response to Gu Xie had been purely improvisational.
He looked up at the fully formed ninety-nine ascendancy tribulation and said calmly, "No matter, since the trouble started with me, I shall be the one to end it."
In front of the stunned gazes of the three, Gu Junye slowly ascended, confronting the thunder tribulation head-on!
Bathed in the onslaught of the thunder tribulation, Gu Junye stood unmoved, as if the image of a figure from an ageless past emerged in that moment, eternal as time itself!
At that moment, Gu Xie felt the person before him was the true Master of All Laws, and he himself was the counterfeit.
The next moment, both Gu Xie and the Vast Sea Daoist Lord realized that Gu Junye was undoubtedly a mortal. The reason he could fly up to face the thunder tribulation without harm, no matter how it struck him, was because this was the Illusionary Realm!
```
Inner Demons are a figment of imagination, and so is one's own strength!
With this realization, both of them felt greatly reassured.
It would be good if strength could rely solely on imagination.
Vast Sea Daoist Lord saw this as a perfect opportunity to see what his Inner Demon was.
If he didn't open his heart, River Spirit wouldn't be able to draw out his Inner Demon.
In an instant, Gu Xie and Vast Sea Daoist Lord's strength surged, imagining themselves in the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, fighting side by side with Gu Junye against the Thunder Tribulation.
Daoist Xiantian, lacking in imagination, could only watch helplessly from below.
The three joined forces to resist the Thunder Tribulation.
"How can this Thunder Tribulation be so powerful?" Having experienced it firsthand, Gu Xie had an ominous feeling, realizing that the tribulation was even more ferocious than it appeared.
...
On the other side, Zhou Xing'er also fell into the clutches of an Inner Demon, being scolded by her mother.
"I gave birth to you and raised you all these years. Find a good family to marry into later. You could even earn some Spirit Stones for your brother's cultivation!"
Zhou Xing'er meekly complied, without uttering a word.
...
Thunderbolts fell, containing endless power, as if to restart the heavens and earth, to recreate the world.
"This is the Jade Pure Heavenly Tribulation." Gu Junye explained, having seen the description of the Jade Pure Heavenly Tribulation in ancient books sold at street stalls.
Gu Xie was so battered his mouth smoked; far from being able to eliminate the three of them, he was lucky to survive himself.
Vast Sea Daoist Lord, truly possessing a Thunder Spiritual Root, had his own method of dealing with the Thunder Tribulation, faring slightly better than Gu Xie.
Gu Junye had imagined resisting the Thunder Tribulation countless times. Except for the eighty-first bolt, he could survive them all.
...
"What kind of Dual Spirit Roots do you have? That's perfect. Transplant your Spirit Roots to your brother and let him cultivate. His talent for cultivation must be higher than yours!"
Zhou Xing'er continued to be dictated to by her mother, who wore a belligerent expression and spittle flew as she spoke. Zhou Xing'er just hung her head, not daring to retort.
...
"This is the Obliteration Purple Thunder Tribulation!"
The purple heavenly thunder descended, blasting through space, annihilating everything, leaving the three struggling at death's door.
Gu Xie was charred all over, Vast Sea Daoist Lord and Gu Junye didn't fare much better; the eighty bolts of the tribulation left not a single good piece of flesh on them.
Gu Xie glared at Gu Junye with hatred – once I conquer Seek Dao Sect, you will be the first to die!
Crack—
The Eighty-first Thunderbolt descended. The three resisted staunchly and finally made it through.
With a splash, all three landed simultaneously, crashing into a pit, hanging by a thread.
...
"Are you saying that a Semi-Immortal infiltrated the entrance examination?" Eldest Senior Sister's eyelid twitched upon hearing Lu Yang's report.
"Yes, his name is Gu Xie, but his real name is not known."
Before Lu Yang could say more, he was interrupted by Eldest Senior Sister raising her hand.
"Junior Brother, wait a minute. I feel someone is using me as their Inner Demon. I'll go have a look."
...
"It's finally over." Gu Xie breathed a sigh of relief, which had been a long time coming. He was worried that if the tribulation continued, he might not be able to resist using the Dao Fruit Outline.
The Dao Fruit Outline was definitely not something conjured by a mortal's imagination. Once used, it would reveal everything.
```
