```
Gu Xie cut himself off from River Spirit's probing. To River Spirit, it appeared Gu Xie had no Inner Demons.
It had to be over now.
But before Gu Xie could even catch his breath, he felt an immense pressure from the sky, even more daunting than the earlier Ninety-Nine Ascension Tribulation.
Looking up, he saw a female cultivator levitating, her back to the sun, her features indistinct, as if she were divine.
The Inner Demon of Vast Sea Daoist Lord—Yun Zhi.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 724 - 723 A Worthy Opponent
chapters.content:
"Yun Zhi?" Gu Xie was astonished. Whose Inner Demon was this?
Yun Zhi rarely made a move, so the outside world knew very little about her, but who was Gu Xie? He had been secretly gathering intelligence on the major powers of Great Xia, including Yun Zhi.
Yun Zhi, the first disciple of Daoist Buyu, had an astonishing talent for cultivation. She had once, during an exchange at the Immortal Sect, defeated four Sect Leaders, including three at the Body Integration Realm and one at the Pass Tribulation Stage.
Therefore, it was obvious that Yun Zhi's strength was at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
She absolutely could not be a Semi-Immortal.
In this respect, Master of All Laws had the most authority to speak. He was the fastest cultivator in history, even Emperor Yu and Wu Yao's cultivation speeds were slightly inferior to his.
Even he couldn't achieve cultivation to Semi-Immortal status in a mere thousand years.
So it was impossible for this Yun Zhi of the Seek Dao Sect as well.
So whose Inner Demon was it?
Gu Junye's?
Impossible, his Inner Demon was that ridiculous Ninety-Nine Ascension Tribulation, which he had already passed.
That person called Qi Tong?
His reaction did not seem to indicate that.
Then it must be Fang Ya!
Gu Junye stumbled up from the ground, feeling the boundless mana emanating from the silhouette in the sky, with an expression of unprecedented solemnity.
"I have passed the Ninety-Nine Ascension Tribulation, becoming an immortal, unmatched under the heavens. Yet, I never thought that beings from the celestial realm would take advantage of the Ascension Tribulation to tear open the rift between the mortal and immortal realms and enter the mortal world!"
Gu Junye knelt on the ground powerless, "The two of you, we can only rely on beings from the celestial realm now!"
Gu Xie: "..."
Yun Zhi couldn't also be your Inner Demon, could she? How many Inner Demons do you have?
Immediately afterward, Gu Xie sneered coldly. It didn't matter whose Inner Demon it was, he now imagined himself at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. At the same realm, he feared no one!
Gu Xie leapt up and threw a golden fist imprint towards Yun Zhi, and then...
Boom!
Gu Xie was slapped to the ground by Yun Zhi, sprawled out in the shape of the character "大".
"Ptooey!"
Gu Xie sat up, spat twice, and spat the mud out of his mouth. What realm was this Inner Demon at, to have such formidable strength!
"So my Inner Demon is Yun Zhi," Vast Sea Daoist Lord thought to himself. This was actually within his expectations, only he had never been willing to admit it.
After all, he had been beaten so badly back then.
"This is troublesome," Vast Sea Daoist Lord was distressed. His Inner Demon was something he absolutely could not overcome.
What to do? Should he reveal his identity and ask River Spirit for a backdoor?
He couldn't bear the shame.
...
Meanwhile, River Spirit was sitting with legs crossed, pretending not to know that Fang Ya was Vast Sea Daoist Lord, with the look of someone enjoying the show.
Just wait to be beaten up!
"The Inner Demon is Senior Sister Yun? Whose Inner Demon is that?" Dai Bufan was very confused. Among these four people, who has seen Yun Zhi?
That's not right either. Even if they had seen her once, she wouldn't become their Inner Demon.
...
Vast Sea Daoist Lord noticed Gu Xie, who had been slapped down, and pondered. He had realized during the Thunder Tribulation that this youngster named Gu Xie had a rich imagination. Considering this trial was about unity, perhaps they could join forces with him to defeat Yun Zhi!
"Fight together?" Vast Sea Daoist Lord asked.
Gu Xie was also clever and instantly understood Vast Sea Daoist Lord's intention.
They indeed could join forces.
Gu Xie and Vast Sea Daoist Lord took to the skies, facing off against Yun Zhi, their momentum difficult to distinguish as superior or inferior.
"Mountain Shifting Seal!"
"Myriad Fathoms Divine Light!"
Both of them, acting as if they had agreed upon it beforehand, made their moves simultaneously. Gu Xie utilized the Mountain Relocating Seal, transforming a hundred thousand continuous mountains into a fist imprint that he grasped in his palm and decisively hurled forward with a punch!
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord summoned the Myriad Fathoms Divine Light, which morphed into a divine sword that took up most of the sky. The sword's tip pointed downward, piercing through the clouds, and plunged towards Yun Zhi!
Boom—Boom—
The more they fought, the more vigorous they became. Since the Yun Zhi in the Illusionary Realm was the Vast Sea Daoist Lord's Inner Demon, the braver Vast Sea Daoist Lord became, the weaker the power of the Inner Demon's Yun Zhi manifested. As one grew stronger and the other weaker, the two finally transitioned from being under heavy attack to fighting on equal footing.
…
"Could they actually defeat Senior Sister Yun Zhi?" Dai Bufan had been paying close attention and was quite astonished.
"Junior Brother Dai, who is trying to defeat me?"
Dai Bufan turned around and did not know when Yun Zhi had arrived behind him.
"Senior Sister, how did you get here?"
"Someone has taken me as their Inner Demon, and I sensed it. I came to see what was going on and to confirm the situation."
"Is it inside this bubble?"
"Yes."
Yun Zhi nodded, said nothing more, took a step forward, and disappeared on the spot, entering the bubble.
…
"Huff—"
"Huff—"
Gu Xie and the Vast Sea Daoist Lord were covered in wounds, but their eyes were filled with hope. United, they might be able to defeat Yun Zhi!
The most evident trait was Yun Zhi's aura, which was continuously declining, and now it had fallen to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage!
The Inner Demon's version of Yun Zhi suddenly paused for a moment, then returned to her previous state.
They did not know if it was an illusion, but the two felt that the Inner Demon Yun Zhi's gaze seemed more animated than before.
Gu Xie even felt that the Inner Demon Yun Zhi was looking towards him intentionally or unintentionally.
Regardless of these distractions, they aimed for a quick battle to avoid any further complications!
"Imprisoning Heaven Finger!"
A finger, larger than mountains, descended from the sky, intending to suppress the Inner Demon Yun Zhi.
"Thousand Layered Waves Strike!"
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord unleashed a thousand palms, with each strike more powerful than the last. By the time he reached the thousandth palm, the combined power was strong enough to shatter heavens and earth!
Below, Gu Junye watched the battle with great interest, eager to learn these techniques.
The Imprisoning Heaven Finger and the Thousand Layered Waves Strike struck at the same time. The Inner Demon Yun Zhi raised her right hand, and the golden bell on her wrist tinkled.
Tinkle.
Along with the clear ringing of the bell, it was as if an invisible wall had appeared before the Inner Demon Yun Zhi, blocking all attacks.
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord was only three inches away from the Inner Demon Yun Zhi but could not break through no matter what.
The Inner Demon Yun Zhi turned over her palm and lightly struck out. All the attacks were returned in kind!
The Inner Demon Yun Zhi continuously executed moves, no longer as rigid as before. Her moves were ingenious, and each one, though not exceeding the power of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, managed to push Gu Xie and the Vast Sea Daoist Lord back, leaving them struggling to keep up.
Gu Xie was beaten until he was bruised and swollen, with eight broken bones and his internal organs jumbled together. Despite his willpower, he could not keep a straight face in the face of such injuries.
All Gu Xie felt now was regret. Had he known this would happen, struck by lightning and then beaten up, he would have chosen a different method to infiltrate the Seek Dao Sect!
After a series of exchanges, the Eldest Senior Sister gauged Gu Xie's hidden strength and no longer sought to end the battle. She pretended to be overpowered, appearing to fade away into the air as if her strength had been exhausted.
With a loud explosion, the bubble burst, and Gu Xie faintly heard the Inner Demon Yun Zhi say, "A formidable opponent."
Before leaving, the Eldest Senior Sister instructed Dai Bufan to ensure that these four passed this challenge.
…
"Eldest Senior Sister, you're back already?" Lu Yang had been seated on the Emperor's Throne for just a short while—the seat had not even warmed up—when he saw the Eldest Senior Sister return.
"Things went rather smoothly. Did you say earlier that a Semi-Immortal sneaked into the entrance exam?"
"Yes."
"Don't worry about him, he's a decent opponent. It's good for Senior Vast Sea to deal with him; it will help restore his confidence."

chapters.title: Chapter 725 - 724: The Third Test
chapters.content:
"I just looked around, and it's not just him that came; there are also a few unfamiliar Transcendence Tribulation Stage practitioners disguising themselves as mortals and mingling in the trials. They must be in league with one another."
"There are several from the Transcendence Tribulation Stage?" Lu Yang was astonished. Could such high-level cultivators dare to intrude into the Seek Dao Sect? Were they tired of living?
Eldest Senior Sister thought that Lu Yang was worried about the sect and comforted him, "There's no need to worry. Our sect also has Transcendence Tribulation Stage practitioners, enough to deal with the situation. With me here, the sect has been too peaceful for too long, which can breed complacency. It's good for them to have some action."
"You can go back and continue organizing the trials. Nothing will go wrong with me here."
"Yes."
Following the sacred decree of Eldest Senior Sister, Lu Yang returned to the bamboo forest to continue organizing the trials.
"River Spirit Senior, long time no see." Lu Yang greeted politely. They hadn't seen each other for four months.
River Spirit huffed coldly, unwilling to pay attention to Lu Yang.
He remembered clearly the actions of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou during the entry trials three years ago.
Seeing that River Spirit was not fond of him, Lu Yang sidled up to Meng Jingzhou and asked softly, "How is the second trial going?"
Meng Jingzhou rolled his eyes. "Gu Junye has already finished his trials, and you're only now arriving. Could you be any later?"
Meng Jingzhou decided then and there that when he got married, he would send invitations to everyone except Lu Yang. He'd wait until the wedding night was over before sending one to Lu Yang the next day!
He definitely had to get his revenge!
"Gu Junye teamed up with the two Ancestral Masters and that Immortal body lad to pass the second trial," Meng Jingzhou said.
Lu Yang nodded, which was expected.
"The others aren't progressing as quickly; I don't think they'll finish before half a day or a day has passed."
For most people, Inner Demons are extremely difficult to overcome. The Inner Demons that Gu Junye and his team faced required only fight and kill to resolve, and regardless of whether they passed or not, the result would be quickly seen.
The same could not be said for others whose Inner Demons couldn't be resolved by brute force.
For instance, the Inner Demon that Lu Yang was watching belonged to Zhou Xing'er.
Zhou Xing'er's mother favored sons over daughters and preached the importance of husbands. She had hoped to have two sons, but was disappointed when her second child was a girl. As a result, she often berated Zhou Xing'er, calling her a loss-maker, which led to Zhou Xing'er developing a subservient and timid personality, afraid to resist.
Although later, Zhou Xing'er earned quite a bit of money for her family with the help of her Storage Ring, her status at home did not improve.
When Zhou Xing'er's mother learned she was eligible to enter Seek Dao Sect, she was even more scornful, thinking Zhou Xing'er was delusional.
Zhou Xing'er's relatives also mocked her, and after learning about her Storage Ring, they demanded it, arguing that Zhou Xing'er was too young to safeguard such a valuable item.
Of course, Zhou Xing'er refused, which only made her relatives' treatment of her even worse.
Zhou Xing'er had tried to resist. She had proposed severing ties with her family several times, but each time, her mother would talk about the unbreakable bond and the debt of upbringing, as if such connections couldn't just be cut off.
With no other choice, Zhou Xing'er rose in revolt, heading alone to Imperial City to assassinate Emperor Xia.
The assassination attempt failed, and the whole family was executed.
The Inner Demon was vanquished.
Zhou Xing'er came to her senses and stretched lazily, "That'll teach you not to sever ties with me; finally, you're all dead."
She certainly could have chosen to cultivate peacefully in the Seek Dao Sect, but she always felt unsettled with her family alive, hampering her ability to focus on cultivation. Now that they had all died in the Illusionary Realm, she felt enlightened.
Lu Yang: "..."
He pretended not to have seen Zhou Xing'er and turned to look at Zhuang Ping nearby, feeling somewhat schadenfreude.
"What's the Inner Demon for Zhuang Ping, whose mother was sent to the prison by Senior Brother Ji?"
"Retaliate against Senior Brother Ji? Retaliate against the people of the Sea Listening Sect?"
In the Illusionary Realm.
The prison.
"Mother, I will definitely save you!" Zhuang Ping roared, veins bulging on his neck as he looked at his mother in the cage, his emotions out of control.
"No, don't save me, I deserve what's come to me today!" Zhuang's mother said through tears streaming down her face.
"Mother, I must learn all the skills necessary to save you! Even if I have to use an axe to split it open, I will rescue you!" Zhuang Ping held the axe in his hand, the legendary Heaven Opening Axe, capable of splitting heaven and earth, more than enough to split open a prison cage.
"Son, don't do this, you can't contend with the Dynasty!" Zhuang's mother shook her head, urging her son to realize his folly and not to confront the Dynasty, as there would be no good end to it.
Zhuang Ping's lips trembled, and with a clang, the axe fell to the ground. He knelt down powerlessly, weeping bitterly, "Mother, I'll listen to you."
...
"To conclude, my mother prevented me from storming the jail, which counts as meritorious behavior in stopping someone from committing a serious crime, and should lead to a reduction in her sentence," Zhuang Ping said calmly to the Ministry of Justice Officials.
Zhuang's mother had her sentence reduced, Zhuang Ping's Inner Demon dispelled.
Lu Yang: "..."
Half a day had passed and among the eight hundred, less than fifty had overcome their Inner Demons, showing the difficulty of overcoming them.
Those who had not dispelled their Inner Demons were trapped within them, unable to escape without outside intervention.
Elder Brother Dai, seeing that the time was about right, invited River Spirit to make a move, dispersing the thick fog and water spheres, and freeing everyone from their Inner Demons.
Those who hadn't passed the second stage felt dejected; they were destined to have no part in Seek Dao Sect and were asked to leave by the disciples.
Elder Brother Dai clapped his hands and said aloud to the remaining fifty, "Congratulations on successfully overcoming your Inner Demons. Now we move on to the last stage, the third stage."
Elder Brother Dai paused for a moment and continued, "Cultivation is not without sentiment or morality, and amongst these, filial piety is of utmost importance."
"The third stage tests filial piety, that is, your attitude towards your parents, brothers, and sisters."
"Unlike the second stage where you could form teams, the third stage tests you individually. In this stage, you will forget your original identity and act according to your true nature."
"Let's begin the third stage."
Elder Brother Dai bowed to the River Spirit at his side, "Senior, please."
The River Spirit moved with a thought, once again raising a mist. The mist contained an illusionary array method, and anyone enveloped by the mist would fall into an Illusionary Realm.
Gu Xie smiled slightly at the corner of his mouth. A test of filial piety seemed to be no challenge for him. While others would forget their original identities, he would not. As long as he took good care of his parents and respected his siblings, passing the test would be easy.
He entered the Illusionary Realm and found himself on top of a barn, where there was a hole in the roof he was fixing with tools.
"Where am I?"
Suddenly, thick smoke rose from the barn, making him cough violently.
Soon, he heard someone shouting, "Fire!"
His mind conjured up his identity in this stage of the test.
He had three family members: a father, a stepmother, and a younger brother born to his father and stepmother.
His father and stepmother worried that he would compete with his brother for the family assets and had tried to harm him multiple times. This fire was their doing!

chapters.title: Chapter 726 - 725: Gu Xie Who Could No Longer Hold Back
chapters.content:
The fire came suddenly, and Gu Xie knew that things were not looking good. If he burned to death here, there would be no need to talk about filial piety.
Moreover, he was a mortal now and couldn't wield any magical powers.
Waiting for the fire to die out or someone to save him would be too late. If he wanted to live, there was only one way: he gritted his teeth, adjusted his position, and jumped from the top of the barn.
He was lucky, only breaking his leg.
A day later, Gu Xie lay there, wishing for death, with not a single person at home to take care of him. He didn't even have the right to lie in a bed, but could only lie on a straw mat covered with a straw mat.
"Son, are you alright?" Gu Father asked, seemingly concerned.
In his heart, Gu Xie thought, I'm lying here, how can you ask if I'm alright? If it weren't for you starting the fire, would I have been burned?
If this were reality, he would have killed Gu Father several times over, but this was the test stage, testing filial piety, and he had to suppress the anger in his heart and force a smile, "Father, I'm fine."
Gu Father sighed with relief, "I said there's no need to have the doctor prescribe medicine, what a waste of money. You've been strong since you were a child, you can get better without medicine."
"Father is right."
During mealtime, Gu Xie's stepmother said in a shrill and delicate voice, "When will you be better? The house can't support a useless person."
Three months later, Gu Xie finally recovered and could work on the ground.
After another three months, Gu Father came to Gu Xie and said that every other family had a well, and they should dig one for their own house too.
This task naturally fell on Gu Xie; Gu Father and Gu Mother didn't want to let Gu Xie's brother do the work.
Gu Xie was very strong, panting and swinging the shovel, and in half a day he had dug a well three to four meters deep.
Just as Gu Xie was about to take a rest, a shovel of dirt fell on his head. Looking up, he saw his father and brother filling in the pit.
"What are you doing? I'm still down here!"
Gu Father and his brother turned a deaf ear and increased the speed of shoveling dirt into the pit, intending to bury Gu Xie in the ground.
Gu Xie was furious, not even bothering to pretend anymore.
Fortunately, he had dug a few small holes in the well wall to serve as a ladder. In no time, he climbed out of the well using the small holes, giving Gu Father and his brother quite a scare.
With a face full of dust and dirt, Gu Xie exclaimed, "What are you doing!"
Gu Father quickly calmed down, "We didn't know you were down there."
Gu Xie glared at Gu Father with hatred. If it weren't for the test, he would have buried this whole family in the ground!
Time passed, and Gu Xie seemed to have forgotten the two life-and-death crises and the hardships imposed by his family. He was respectful to his parents and loving toward his brother, but unfortunately, the father fell seriously ill and ultimately couldn't be cured. The brother married into another family, went to the city, and never contacted his family again.
By contrast, Gu Xie appeared extremely filial, a paragon of filial piety in the village.
Latterly, Gu Xie's filiality spread to the county town, and the magistrate, wanting to commend him, promoted him to constable.
Gu Mother, for some reason, developed a bad habit of gambling. As a constable, Gu Xie saw his mother in the gambling dens many times during raids and always let her escape.
In time, the magistrate found out and dismissed Gu Xie.
Gu Xie married and had children, living with Gu Mother. Unfortunately, the good times did not last. Gu Mother gambled away the family fortune. It was winter at that time, and without any money, there wasn't enough food for everyone.
Gu Xie's wife suggested, "We can have another child if one is lost, but there is only one mother. Let's bury the son."
Gu Xie agreed with his wife's idea. One night, the two of them went to dig a hole, and before digging very deep, they felt their shovel hit something.
"A jar?"
The couple opened the jar and found it filled with gleaming gold!
Overjoyed, with this jar of gold, not only did they not need to bury their son, but their family could become famous wealthy folk from miles around!
Kneeling on the ground, the wife believed their filial piety had moved the heavens.
With this jar of gold, Gu Xie's family quickly began to live a life of luxury, moving into a big house. Gu Mother enjoyed her twilight years and passed away peacefully.
Half a year later, the owner of the gold came to Gu Xie's family, demanding the return of the gold. Gu Xie's family had long spent all of the gold and couldn't return it.
Gu Xie was imprisoned.
The Illusionary Realm ended.
Gu Xie came to his senses and discovered that he was the last one to wake up; Gu Junye and the others had awakened much earlier.
Dai Bufan, upon seeing Gu Xie awake, shook his head gently, "You have failed."
"I failed?" Gu Xie was astonished, wondering how he could have possibly failed when his filial piety was well-known far and wide.
"Not to mention that your family tried to murder you several times, yet you still treated them with utmost respect."
"Let's talk about how your stepmother gambled repeatedly; you not only failed to stop her but even abused your power to shield her from justice. Not to mention when you wanted to bury your son, constituting attempted murder, and how you used the gold you found to provide for your stepmother's comfortable old age, to the extent that you couldn't return the gold, committing embezzlement."
Among those who failed with Gu Xie were his trusted subordinates. However, they lacked Gu Xie's tolerance. Under relentless difficulties posed by their family, they could bear no more, ultimately killing their entire family instead of making it to become constables.
Gu Xie pointed at Gu Junye and the others, asking, "So they all passed?"
"Of course, they passed."
Dai Bufan felt that if Gu Xie were simply let go, he might react impulsively. So he snapped his fingers and replayed Gu Junye's Illusionary Realm experience.
After jumping off the roof and breaking his leg, Gu Junye immediately took his parents to the county magistrate, who deemed the parents guilty of attempted murder and sentenced them to ten years' imprisonment.
Passed the trial.
"How does that conform to filial piety!" Gu Xie was furious, clearly remembering that the third trial was meant to test filial piety.
"Making parents aware that harboring ill intentions is unacceptable, and that wrongdoing must be punished, naturally conforms to the principle of filial piety."
Dai Bufan replayed Daoist Xiantian's Illusionary Realm experience.
While digging a well, Daoist Xiantian saw his father and brother trying to bury him alive. He leaped out of the well and killed both of them.
Passed the trial.
"He committed murder, and that still counts as passing!" Gu Xie himself had thought about killing his father and brother but controlled himself.
"That was self-defense."
Gu Xie angrily pointed at his failed subordinates, "Then why do their murders count as failures?"
Elder Brother Dai patiently explained, "Self-defense requires immediacy. They were just harboring pent-up anger from being bullied over time, which eventually became unbearable, leading to an explosive retaliation. At the moment they committed murder over a trivial matter, there was no immediacy, so it did not constitute self-defense."
"Harboring anger with no outlet goes against the path of cultivation."
Seeing Gu Xie's emotion run out of control, Daoist Xiantian stepped forward to offer him some kind-hearted consolation, somewhat sheepishly, "Daoist Gu Xie, you are too kind-hearted. When others want to kill you, how can you still endure it? That's not good. You should be decisive in your actions, like me."
Unable to suppress his anger any longer, since joining the trial, Gu Xie had faced humiliation after humiliation. First, during the second trial, he was inexplicably struck by lightning eighty-one times. Then, he was left broken and battered by Yun Zhi. Later, in order to uphold filial piety, he withstood all manner of indignities.
And now, the Seek Dao Sect told him he had failed and called him too kind-hearted!
It was intolerably insulting!
"Too kind-hearted your ass!" Gu Xie wanted to slap Daoist Xiantian away with a sweep of his sleeve.
He had thought that by passing the trials, he would gain entry to the core area of the Seek Dao Sect and strike from within. Who could have imagined nobody from the Great Yu Alliance would pass the trials, suffering a complete defeat!
Such a mortifying disgrace!
He could bear it no longer; they all had to die!
"How dare you attempt to harm others!"
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord sensed the impending danger as Gu Xie's murderous intent rose, realizing that this person, Gu Xie, had hidden his true strength!
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord struck out boldly, colliding with Gu Xie's sleeve. The force of their clash spilled upwards, surging towards the heavens!
Thinking to kill an ancestor, he must be tired of living!

chapters.title: Chapter 727 - 726: The Foundation of the Seek Dao Sect
chapters.content:
"Pass Tribulation Stage?" Vast Sea Daoist Lord and Gu Xie had just engaged in combat when he misjudged the other's realm.
Without utilizing the outline of the Dao Fruit, even a Semi-Immortal would find it difficult to distinguish whether the opponent was at the Pass Tribulation Stage or a Semi-Immortal.
"You dare cause trouble at the Seek Dao Sect, I think you're tired of living!" Although Vast Sea Daoist Lord did not pay much attention to external affairs, he was still aware of who was at the Pass Tribulation Stage nowadays.
Gu Xie was not included among the Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivators he was familiar with.
So the answer was clear, Gu Xie was an Ancient Cultivator!
"Are you Master of All Laws Gu Mo?" Vast Sea Daoist Lord recalled the immortal body displayed by Gu Xie, the most famous of which was the cultivation prodigy from the early days of Great Yu, Master of All Laws Gu Mo!
"You have some insight." Gu Xie smirked coldly, the one before him was merely at the Pass Tribulation Stage, no match for him!
"Attack!" At Gu Xie's command, his followers shed their disguises, revealing their true realm, Pass Tribulation Stage!
There were no less than three Pass Tribulation Stage cultivators hidden in the crowd!
Seeing the bad turn of events, River Spirit swung his arm, and countless bubbles rose up from the river, enclosing the mortals participating in the third round of the test and the disciples organizing the test, quickly sending them into the Seek Dao Sect to ensure their protection.
"How come so many at the Pass Tribulation Stage suddenly appeared?" Dai Bufan was shocked, and who was the person exchanging blows with Master of All Laws?
"Elder Brother Dai, we two are definitely not involved in this matter." Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou quickly disclaimed any responsibility to prove their innocence, as they had behaved honestly throughout the test period.
"…Do you two know who is fighting with Master of All Laws?"
"Yes, we know, he is Vast Sea Daoist Lord."
"He's still alive?!" Dai Bufan was shocked; he had thought Vast Sea Daoist Lord had long since perished.
"Wait, does that mean, the Inner Demon of Senior Sister Yun that appeared in the second round, was from Vast Sea Daoist Lord?" Dai Bufan had thought it was the Inner Demon of Gu Junye.
Lu Yang nodded.
…
"He is Master of All Laws?" Daoist Xiantian was startled, turning his gaze to Gu Junye.
And who was Gu Junye?
Gu Junye's expression was grave as he watched the magnificent interplay of magical powers within the bamboo forest; he was still unable to recover his cultivation level and unable to join a battle of this magnitude.
"Who would have thought that the three corpses he severed in order to pass tribulation and become an immortal would survive until now!"
…
River Spirit mobilized the power of the great formation to battle against the three Pass Tribulation Stage cultivators from the Great Yu Alliance.
With the enhancement of the great formation, he was equivalent to a Pass Tribulation Stage cultivator, but fighting against three of the same level seemed too strenuous.
"Elder River Spirit, we are here to help you!"
Two venerable figures appeared, standing before the three Great Yu Pass Tribulation Stage cultivators, namely, Grandmaster Tang Shengyi, the child teacher, and Elder Tao from the Scripture Pavilion.
They sensed the battle in the bamboo forest and joined the battle immediately.
"Oh, who would've thought the Seek Dao Sect had so many at the Pass Tribulation Stage, such profound concealment!" The three Great Yu Pass Tribulation Stage cultivators sneered, the Sect's strength was beyond their expectations, but not yet enough to influence the outcome of the battle.
After all, their Great Yu Alliance had more than just the three of them.
Suddenly, several auras soared into the sky from outside the Seek Dao Sect, causing Grandmaster Tang's expression to change.
The other side had two more hidden Pass Tribulation Stage cultivators!
No, not just Pass Tribulation Stage, but also more than twenty at the Body Integration Realm!
All-out attack!
Five Transcendence Tribulation Stage and over twenty Body Integration Realm cultivators lined up in two rows, momentarily overwhelming the forces of Seek Dao Sect.
"Dare to attack our Seek Dao Sect, seeking death!" Streaks of light flashed across, appearing on the battlefield.
"Master, we have arrived." The Grand Elder led seven Elders to the bamboo forest, arriving alongside the owners of the market street, Hundred Fragrance Building, the deputy master of the Task Hall, Dai Bufan, Ji Hongwen, and others...
All of Seek Dao Sect's Body Integration Realm cultivators had assembled here!
"Merely Body Integration Realm cultivators, you cannot stir up a storm!" A cultivator from the Great Yu Alliance arrogantly laughed, his side boasting five Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivators!
One of the Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivators from Great Yu brazenly made a move, extending a dark hand toward the Grand Elder. The hand transformed into a demonic claw made of smoke, and anyone who touched it turned into dense water!
Boom!
The Grand Elder threw an object that looked like a brick at the demonic claw. The claw's owner winced in pain and immediately withdrew the claw.
The owner of the demonic claw saw what had hit him, a greenish-blue porcelain pillow.
The Immortal Treasure Dream Pillow, originally possessed by Fairy Eternity, was later a treasured artifact kept by Eternity Sect. Master Liu and Master Gao attacked Seek Dao Sect with the Dream Pillow but were captured by Seek Dao Sect. The Dream Pillow became the Grand Elder's magic artifact.
"What's the matter, you don't dare to fight me?" the Grand Elder, holding the Dream Pillow, sneered coldly.
His strength was comparable to Daoist Buyu, both being at the Half Step Transcendence Tribulation Stage. With the enhancement of the Dream Pillow, he possessed the power to contend with Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivators!
"So, we have just one more Transcendence Tribulation Stage force, that's all!"
The Great Yu side remained fearless.
"Just one more?" The Third Elder, clad in iron armor, walked on air, standing in line with the Grand Elder.
He suddenly threw a punch, the punch's fierce wind blowing the Body Integration Realm cultivators of the Great Yu side into disarray. Even the Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivators of Great Yu felt immense pressure and had to adopt defensive stances!
This punch was comparable to a Transcendence Tribulation Stage Body Cultivator!
The iron armor was mottled with rust, stained with blackish blood. It seemed like nothing more than ordinary battlefield armor, but anyone aware of its origins would never underestimate it!
This was the armor worn by Celestial Master Guiyuan in the final battles of Great Yu. It was stained with the blood of enemies, all from Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivators. Wearing this armor, a Body Integration Realm cultivator could match a Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivator!
The Five Great Immortal Sects each had methods to rival Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivators, and Seek Dao Sect's method was this set of armor!
"Now, the battle strength is even!"
The child Grandmaster chuckled lightly, a massive yellow-bronze bell descended from the sky, surrounded by mysterious and profound chaos runes. In an instant, the bell sounded a deep and ancient hum, the sound waves spreading like ripples, causing the entire space to tremble subtly.
"Chaos Subduing Bell!" A Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivator from Great Yu recognized the origin of the yellow-bronze bell.
The child Grandmaster, during his time as Sect Leader, was also a Great Power who rarely met an equal in the Cultivation World – otherwise, he couldn't have restrained people like Daoist Buyu.
His Life-bound Magical Treasure, the Chaos Subduing Bell, was also well-known in the Cultivation World, with many renowned figures falling to its sound.
"Kill!" The child Grandmaster's expression changed, and he shouted fiercely. The bell sound surged once more, and both sides engaged in fierce combat!
...
The clash between Vast Sea Daoist Lord and Master of All Laws took place at a higher altitude.
"Eye of the Heavens!" An eye appeared in the sky, blasting out a beam of black light, catching Master of All Laws off guard.
In that moment, time suddenly slowed down, giving Master of All Laws enough time to react and nimbly avoid the black light.
"Fairy, can you tell what form the Dao Fruit Outline of Master of All Laws is?"
"Hmm, since he has the Immortal body of longevity, and he just slowed down time, it should be the Longevity Dao Fruit Outline."

chapters.title: Chapter 728 - 727: Embryonic Eternal Life Dao Fruit and Embryonic Spatial Dao Fruit
chapters.content:
"What is the Embryonic Eternity Dao Fruit? Does it belong to our Immortal Lineage?" Lu Yang asked.
"Let me think about how to explain it to you," Fairy Eternity said, tapping her forehead as she pondered seriously before continuing.
"To explain the Embryonic Eternity Dao Fruit, one must start with the Eternity Immortal Body."
"Do you know about the Eternity Immortal Body?"
"I've heard a bit about it. It's said that those with the Eternity Immortal Body have a lifespan several times longer than others at the same Realm."
"If you explain it that way, it's somewhat correct, but it's not comprehensive."
Master of All Laws, with his Eternity Immortal Body, meant it was very likely he had lived from the early days of Great Yu until now without any periods of dormancy, truly an old antique.
The Eternity Immortal Body is exceedingly rare and is seldom described in texts.
However, coincidentally, there was one with an Eternity Immortal Body in Ancient Times.
"The Eternity Immortal Body has two functions. One is as you said, to live longer. The other is to accelerate one's own time."
"What does it mean to accelerate one's own time?"
"Taking the one called Master of All Laws as an example, if he needs an entire day to learn a magic skill, he can make himself twelve times faster."
"To the outside world, it would seem he learned the magic skill in just one hour instead of a whole day."
"Similarly, his Eternity Immortal Body also works when he's cultivating. An hour of his cultivation is equivalent to an entire day for others."
"Isn't this Master of All Laws said to be a cultivation prodigy, with fast cultivation progress and skill acquisition? That's the reason."
Lu Yang suddenly realized, so that's how it was.
Turns out the talent of Master of All Laws isn't as frightening as people say – it's all about the accumulation of time.
"With his Eternity Immortal Body, it's easiest for him to form an Embryonic Eternity Dao Fruit; that's just how the lazy do it."
"The Embryonic Eternity Dao Fruit inherits the abilities of the Eternity Immortal Body, transforming 'eternity' into 'immortality,' as well as accelerating one's time."
"Didn't you just see it? Master of All Laws manipulated time to dodge the Vast Sea Daoist Lord's Eyes of the Heavens."
Lu Yang nodded. With his ability, he naturally couldn't clearly see the process of Master of All Laws manipulating time, so he had been using the perception of Fairy Eternity to watch ever since the fight began.
And he saw it very clearly.
"My Eternity Dao Fruit and Time Dao Fruit are of a higher order than this kind of Dao Fruit Outline; he counts as half a person from our Immortal Lineage."
"Let me demonstrate for you."
...
"There was no magic skill fluctuation just now; was that the ability of a Dao Fruit Outline? Are you a Semi-Immortal?" the Vast Sea Daoist Lord narrowed his eyes as he looked at Master of All Laws.
Logically, with Master of All Laws' skills, he shouldn't have been able to dodge the Eyes of the Heavens, but he did.
There was only one explanation – a Semi-Immortal.
"Heh, I didn't expect your strength to be lacking, but your eyesight is rather good," said Master of All Laws, his lips curling into a mocking smile, confident of his victory.
The gap between someone at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage and a Semi-Immortal couldn't be bridged by any means.
"Lacking in strength?" The Vast Sea Daoist Lord's gaze turned icy, filled with unrestrained killing intent. It was the first time he encountered a cultivator daring to evaluate him in such a manner!
Just as Master of All Laws was about to say something more, he suddenly raised his hand and slapped himself, causing both Master of All Laws and the Vast Sea Daoist Lord to be stunned for a moment.
Master of All Laws looked at the Vast Sea Daoist Lord unsurely, questioning, was this the opponent's doing?
...
"You see, I can control his actions at will," Fairy Eternity said proudly. "What do you think, should I make him slap himself a couple more times?"
Lu Yang: "..."
"Eldest Senior Sister is letting the Vast Sea Daoist Lord practice, Fairy, you better behave yourself."
Then, Lu Yang thought of another problem: "Doesn't that mean that as long as he condenses a Dao Fruit, he will have both the powers of the Eternity Dao Fruit and the Time Dao Fruit?"
This was simply too terrifying.
"In theory, that's the idea, but the outline of the Dao Fruit of Longevity has a big problem."
"One is that although he has the characteristic of 'immortality,' he is not at the level of the Third Boss, who can explode and recover at will; at most, he can survive several fatal injuries. His ability to control time is also not comparable to that of the outline of the Time Dao Fruit."
"In Ancient Times, there was a Semi-Immortal with the outline of the Dao Fruit of Longevity who died at the hands of the Time Immortal, who was also a Semi-Immortal at the time."
"Two is that as long as Fairy Eternity and the Time Immortal are around, he will never be able to condense a Dao Fruit."
"Three is that our Immortal Lineage has very high demands on one's temperament, and with his kind of temperament, he cannot condense a Dao Fruit."
"At the Semi-Immortal level, merely sitting in meditation and silent cultivation is useless. The key is to comprehend. You never know when some trivial, everyday matter could inspire you and clear the clouds to reveal the sun on your cultivation path, leading to advancement in your Cultivation Level."
"Cultivation isn't something that works simply by accumulating time."
"Even so, isn't the outline of the Dao Fruit of Longevity very formidable? Can Senior Vast Sea really win?" Lu Yang's worry was not unreasonable. Facing an opponent who controlled time and was immortal, how could he be defeated?
"He can win."
...
Neither of the two Semi-Immortals from past and present bothered to ponder why the Master of All Laws suddenly slapped himself; they continued their fierce battle.
"Raging Waves!"
Vast Sea Daoist Lord extended two fingers and used the Shadow Shifting technique, summoning the waters of the East Sea.
He had roamed the East Sea, leaving an imprint at the seabed; he could summon the waters above the imprint at any time.
The waters of the East Sea plummeted from the sky, engulfing the Master of All Laws.
Even though the Master of All Laws could control time, it was hard to escape from such a large-scale magic skill, unless he fled Seek Dao Sect, which would contradict his original intention.
An invisible barrier supported the water, causing the waters of the East Sea to linger in the air, drowning both the Vast Sea Daoist Lord and the Master of All Laws.
The Master of All Laws took out a long spear, his proud magic artifact that was only one step away from being an Immortal Artifact.
The spearhead was engraved with the reverse Five Elements imprint, capable of breaking through all things related to the Five Elements, such as the waters of the East Sea.
Time accelerated, the reverse Five Elements spear moved too quickly to be seen, breaking through the water, stabbing toward the back of Vast Sea Daoist Lord!
"Freeze!" Vast Sea Daoist Lord had long noticed the existence of the reverse Five Elements spear and uttered a light cry, as the seawater turned to ice, forming a huge iceberg that emitted wisps of cold air that even those battling below in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage and Body Integration Realm could feel.
Ice, also belonging to the category of the Five Elements, was within the scope of what the reverse Five Elements spear could pierce. The spear penetrated Vast Sea Daoist Lord's body, and the enormous backlash split the iceberg in two.
However, contrary to expectations, Vast Sea Daoist Lord was unharmed, while the Master of All Laws had a fist-sized through wound in his abdomen.
"Misdirection... No, this is a spatial technique!" the Master of All Laws spat out blood, knowing full well the power of the reverse Five Elements spear.
At first, he thought Vast Sea Daoist Lord had transferred the injury to him, but he soon realized that wasn't the case. There are many conditions for using the Misdirection technique, and they weren't met just now!
He had used a spatial technique!
It appeared as though the spear had pierced through Vast Sea Daoist Lord, but in reality, Vast Sea Daoist Lord had transferred the part of himself that would be pierced by the spear onto the Master of All Laws!
Embryonic Spatial Dao Fruit!

chapters.title: Chapter 729 - 728 Restraint Relationship
chapters.content:
"I didn't expect you to also possess an Embryonic Dao Fruit!" the Master of All Laws said, wiping the fresh blood from the corner of his mouth with his thumb, as his abdominal wound quickly healed as if it had never been there.
The ability of the Immortality Dao Fruit Outline—Indestructibility.
"Time acceleration, wound regeneration…" the Vast Sea Daoist Lord, lacking the encyclopedic knowledge of Fairy Eternity, could only rely on tiny clues gleaned from battle to analyze the abilities of the Master of All Laws' Embryonic Dao Fruit.
"The only question is how many times that wound recovery can be performed. If it can be used indefinitely, then that will be troublesome."
"Reverse Scales Dragon Summoning!"
"Ten Thousand Woods Coexistence!"
"Sun and Moon Brilliance Together!"
"Blue Lotus Transcending Calamity!"
Within the accelerated time, the Master of All Laws cast more than ten different magic skills in one breath. This was the advantage of time acceleration: while others cast a single spell, he could overwhelm his opponent with an order of magnitude more!
Dragons swept around, bodhi seeds took root upon touching the ground, growing into vast sky-reaching trees that merged with the dragon shadows to form ancient bodhi dragons, roaring across heaven and earth.
Both sun and moon made their rare appearance, a spectacle only seen in the ancient past. The power of yin and yang shone dazzlingly.
A pure lotus petal formed of pure magic power fluttered about, each petal containing the power to obliterate.
"Go!"
The Master of All Laws lived up to his title, casting over ten different kinds of magic skills. To learn even one would require an exorbitant amount of time, but only the Master of All Laws had the time to learn such a quantity of spells.
Anyone might defend against a few magic skills, but it was impossible to defend against them all.
To the surprise, the Vast Sea Daoist Lord casually smiled, allowing the spells to hit him without sustaining a scratch.
"Not good!"
The Master of All Laws sensed something was terribly amiss, accelerated time once more, and urgently changed his position. Then, over ten different magic skills hit the original spot, causing an explosive shockwave!
"Purple Heaven Divine Thunder!"
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord turned ice into water, bright divine thunder raining down into it. The whole expanse of water buzzed with the force of lightning and thunder. Even if the Master of All Laws was faster, facing such unavoidable attacks, he could only defend passively!
"What, is this the extent of the legendary Master of All Laws?" the Vast Sea Daoist Lord chuckled lightly. He was born with the Thunder Spiritual Root and was adept at thunder magic, which was a wise choice not to take for his Spirit Root.
In terms of fame, the Vast Sea Daoist Lord, the reviver of his lineage, surely did not have as wide a renown as the Master of All Laws, a genius whose name had been passed down through the ages. But a great reputation did not necessarily mean great strength.
There were still suppression relationships between Embryonic Dao Fruits, and clearly, the Immortality Dao Fruit Outline did not suppress the Embryonic Spatial Dao Fruit.
"No doubt, in the early periods of Great Yu, you were constantly overshadowed by the Second Imperial Teacher," the Vast Sea Daoist Lord said casually, walking on water. Thunder rained ceaselessly from the heavens, slashing the Master of All Laws into a state of near death.
The Master of All Laws realized he could no longer fight in the water, cast the Diving Spell, and parted the East Sea waters, thereby giving him the space to evade the thunder.
"What do you mean?" The Master of All Laws' mood was unstable.
"Did I strike a nerve?" the Vast Sea Daoist Lord continued to probe into the Master of All Laws' wounds.
"The Causality Dao Fruit Outline held by the Second Imperial Teacher could erase his own existence, making it ideal for assassinations."
"Although you can automatically recover from injuries, it is not an infinite process. There would eventually be a moment when the Second Imperial Teacher would outlast you."
"The Dao Fruit Outline of the Second Imperial Teacher was naturally suppressive of your own!"
"Shut up!" shouted the Master of All Laws, seemingly haunted by some unbearable memory, unleashing his three heads and six arms as time stopped for a few breaths.
"Linked Fates!"
The Master of All Laws cast a curse, linking his own life with that of the Vast Sea Daoist Lord—the spell disregarded spatial defense, meaning both would suffer injuries and die simultaneously!
With his 'Indestructibility' trait, only the Vast Sea Daoist Lord would die!
Such a move would be effective against almost all Semi-Immortals, but it still wouldn't work against the Second Imperial Teacher.
Talking about curses in front of the Causality Dao Fruit Outline was nothing short of a joke.
Destruction energy converged in the hands of the Master of All Laws. He clenched his fist and smashed his own head into oblivion.
Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivators possess self-healing capabilities, yet this form of destruction energy inherently inhibits healing, unless one could recover with the power of the Embryonic Dao Fruit. Otherwise, self-healing would be impossible!
What Master of All Laws hadn't anticipated was that the Vast Sea Daoist Lord's head didn't explode as expected. It was as if he wasn't afflicted by the shared life-and-death curse at all.
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord chuckled without any intention of explaining.
"Fairy, what's going on?" Lu Yang couldn't understand.
"It's actually a clever tactic. He indeed suffered injury, but as he was injured, he used the power of space to fix his head in place. It's like smashing a watermelon and then gluing it back together. In this way, there's no difference between being injured and uninjured."
Lu Yang was astounded. He had never imagined that the Embryonic Spatial Dao Fruit could be used this way.
No wonder Eldest Senior Sister said that the Ancestor of the Vast Sea could handle the Master of All Laws.
While the fierce battle raged in the bamboo forest, none of the combatants had noticed a figure quietly infiltrating the Seek Dao Sect.
In fact, both Fairy Eternity and Lu Yang had spotted him but chose not to concern themselves with it.
After all, the intruder was heading towards Sky Gate Mountain.
...
"Seek Dao Sect really isn't easy to deal with, even the lord is engaged in a tough battle," whispered the shadow. He was one of the confidants of the Master of All Laws. His mission was to infiltrate Seek Dao Sect and search for Emperor Yu's treasures.
This was originally a contingency plan. After all, no one expected that the foundation of the Seek Dao Sect would make the Great Yu Alliance engage in such a struggle.
Fortunately, the Master of All Laws had devised contingency measures.
If both parties were deadlocked, he would dispatch someone to seize Emperor Yu's treasures during a vulnerable moment within the Seek Dao Sect.
Just by finding the Immortal Artifacts left by Emperor Yu, one could reverse the world's fate!
He was a mid-stage cultivator of Great Yu, once a renowned Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivator, with the title of Yellow Springs Lord. He had drowned several large cities in the Yellow Springs, taking pleasure in the wailing of all beings.
In the legends of the Jiuyou Sect regarding "Yellow Springs," it is said that before the souls of the dead enter the Nine Netherworld, they must first cleanse their souls in Yellow Springs.
The "Yellow Springs" mentioned here originated from the deeds of the Yellow Springs Lord.
The Yellow Springs Lord naturally possessed a talent for treasure-hunting, even more powerful than the treasure-seeking rats of the Demon Territory. As soon as he entered the Seek Dao Sect, he sensed the aura of treasures.
The dense aura of the treasures was something he had only seen a few times in his life.
"It is definitely Emperor Shun's treasure!"
The Yellow Springs Lord suppressed his excitement and crawled towards the source of the aura.
"This is the mountain. According to the information, this place is called Sky Gate Mountain, so Seek Dao Sect's treasury is indeed at Sky Gate Mountain."
"Seek Dao Sect, you're asking for it! Even though you were a power of my Great Yu, you defected to Great Xia. Today's annihilation is divine justice; retribution is swift!"
As he climbed halfway up the mountain, he happened upon a puppet carrying a hoe.
Because Lu Yang often practiced swordsmanship on the mountain, the trees of Sky Gate Mountain suffered great damage, so the puppets had no choice but to take on the major task of tree-planting.
The puppet glanced at the Yellow Springs Lord and stood still, blocking his path.
"Get lost!" shouted the Yellow Springs Lord impatiently, swinging his hand to strike down.
In his view, a mere ragged puppet was not worth noting.
Clang!
When the Yellow Springs Lord's hand struck the puppet, a crisp sound rang out, but the puppet remained unmoved.
The Yellow Springs Lord's face bore an expression of disbelief as he cried out, "A Transcendence Tribulation Stage puppet?!"
The puppet lowered its head to glance at the Yellow Springs Lord's iron hand and slowly raised its hoe.

chapters.title: Chapter 730 - 729: Why Seek a Dead End?
chapters.content:
"Not good!"
The Respected Huangquan felt a bad omen, as if it wasn't a hoe that the puppet had raised, but a sharp heavenly blade!
"Huangquan Secret Art!"
Just as the hoe slammed down, the Respected Huangquan hastily used his life-saving secret art, transforming his entire body into the waters of Huangquan.
The waters of Huangquan were split in two by the hoe, forming two clusters of water. The two clusters hastily retreated, merged, and once again took on the form of the Respected Huangquan.
"Huff huff huff—"
With lingering fears, the Respected Huangquan watched the puppet. A mere hoe strike had brought him to the brink of a life-and-death crisis, pushing him into a desperate situation.
How could the Seek Dao Sect have such a high-level puppet?
As far as he knew, even the Yanshi Sect, one of Great Xia's super-grade sects and the most skilled in puppet crafting today, couldn't create the puppet before him.
Then who had crafted it!
Fear flickered in the eyes of the Respected Huangquan. The depths of the Seek Dao Sect were truly terrifying. Even with foreign invaders, they still had the strength to guard their treasury, and it was guarded by a puppet of Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
Quickly, the fear in his eyes vanished, replaced by a thick ridicule. He wasn't a character to be scared off by mere puppets. This puppet was made of special materials, extremely hard to destroy by brute force.
"But the gap between a puppet and a cultivator can't be bridged by puppetry arts!"
"Hereby establishing the [Rule: Within Sky Gate Mountain, spiritual essence cannot drive magic artifacts]."
Being at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage conferred the ability to establish rules; no matter how sophisticated the puppetry arts, they would be thwarted by the power of rules.
Puppets are a type of magic artifact, with two ways for them to move: one is through covert control by the puppet master, and the other is movement by the puppet itself.
A Transcendance Tribulation Stage puppet would require at least a Body Integration Realm Cultivation Level for a puppet master's control. If the puppet at hand was managed by a puppet master, then the puppet master was definitely not at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
If the puppet master was at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, he would control the puppet while also engaging in combat. However, such a situation had not happened.
If there was no puppet master in control, then a self-acting puppet was nothing more than a lifeless object, certainly no match for him!
The puppet, constructed of wood, was crafted based on a female form, but the creator did not carve any facial features—it had no face.
The puppet slightly tilted its head, and although no expression could be seen, one could imagine the puppet's look of confusion at that moment.
Bang!
The puppet threw a punch at the Respected Huangquan's face out of the blue, landing squarely in the center and knocking out two of his front teeth.
"How is this possible!"
The Respected Huangquan was so panicked that he didn't even care about his knocked-out teeth. He was certain the rule he had established was in effect, and because the range of the rule he set was very narrow, it was highly constraining, so much so that even he couldn't use magic artifacts.
Yet the puppet moved with ease!
The puppet clearly had no intention of offering an explanation, and with a kick it knocked over the Respected Huangquan.
The Respected Huangquan's eyes grew more sinister. Originally, he wished to end the battle quickly, as he'd sneaked in unnoticed. Being discovered by people from the Seek Dao Sect was very likely to tip off those in the bamboo grove, potentially moving the battlefield here.
But now he could no longer afford such concerns.
"Nether Fierce Ghost Technique, Huangquan Ferrying, Naihe's Three Sighs!"
Huangquan arose, corroding the earth, with thousands of Fierce Ghosts wandering about, exuding mournful sighs of resentment, reaching to the heavens almost materializing, transforming Sky Gate Mountain into what seemed like a purgatory on earth, unbearable to endure.
The Respected Huangquan held nothing back. This was his ace technique, the one that allowed him to dominate an entire era. In that era, the mere mention of "Huangquan" would plunge cultivators into panic and despair.
This move was too ostentatious; not only the disciples hiding in the core area, but also the Elders fighting in the bamboo forest sensed the disturbance from Sky Gate Mountain.
At first, they were alarmed, realizing there was an invasion by external enemies. But when they noticed the source of the commotion was Sky Gate Mountain, they dismissed it as nothing and continued their entanglement with the enemies before them.
The puppet, as if it hadn't seen the move from the Underworld Master, strode forward with a hoe in hand, stepping on the corrosive waters of the netherworld, its soles remaining completely unharmed.
Fierce Ghosts living in the netherworld rushed towards it, howling, but with a single sweep of its hoe, all the ghosts and demons were dispelled.
"How is this possible!"
The Underworld Master was flabbergasted, this was his strongest move, and the puppet couldn't possibly be unscathed!
The puppet swung its hoe in a simple motion, inescapable, each strike terrifying as if the sky were collapsing, quickly leaving the Underworld Master covered in wounds.
Seeing the hoe, bearing the breath of death, raised again, he didn't hesitate, disregarding the consequences, he once more used the netherworld secret technique and fled towards the peak of Sky Gate Mountain at full speed!
He couldn't keep entangled any longer, only by finding Emperor Yu's Immortal Treasure would there be a chance to break the situation!
The puppet watched the direction in which the Underworld Master ran but didn't pursue him.
"This is the place!"
The Underworld Master sensed an intense aura of treasures, getting closer and closer!
He broke through a forest and, following the aura of treasures, arrived at a cave; with a single punch, he blew open the cave and the scent of treasures overflowed, a fragrance he had never smelled before, mesmerizing!
Emperor Yu's Treasure was here!
The wealth of the Seek Dao Sect included everything imaginable, the deeper inside, the more precious the goods.
The treasures of the Body Integration Realm and the Transcendance Tribulation Stage were all ignored by the Underworld Master.
He arrived at the deepest part of the treasury, his eyes filled with greed as he saw Immortal Artifacts casually placed all around.
"Immortal Dao Array Diagram, 'Extinguishing Immortal Sword Array,' Nine Dragons Protective Aura..."
Suddenly, as if sensing something, he lifted his head towards a fruit laid out on the desk, his body trembling uncontrollably.
As a confidant of the Master of All Laws, he had once seen the Master of All Laws show his Dao Fruit Outline, a hazy fruit that contained the Dao of eternal life and the power of time, infinitely profound.
And the fruit on the desk was complete, with no signs of haziness, flawless and intact.
The Master of All Laws' long sigh at that time still echoed in his heart.
'Only a solid fruit is the true Dao Fruit, when will my fruit reach Consummation?'
Now, a solid and perfect fruit lay before his eyes, and he was filled with immense panic.
Was this the legendary Dao Fruit?
How could it be here?
All the Immortal Artifacts here were left by Emperor Yu, what about this Dao Fruit?
Did Emperor Yu really go to the outer world?
A myriad of questions surged in his mind, accompanied by an indescribable sense of horror.
A protracted sigh came through.
"Why seek your own demise."
The Underworld Master turned sharply, to see at the entrance of the cave a female cultivator holding a cup of tea, the fragrance of the tea drifting gently, as if Dao melodies were flowing within.
This was the Enlightenment Tea picked just this year, also the finest quality Enlightenment Tea in the world.
The female cultivator savored her tea, blowing away the Dao melodies mixed in the tea fragrance, as if she hadn't been the one speaking just a moment ago.
The Underworld Master was about to speak when he realized that his body had stiffened, unable to move, like a clay sculpture, watching helplessly as the female cultivator slowly approached.
The female cultivator extended a finger to touch the Underworld Master's forehead, and his body slowly began to dissipate, turning into nothingness.

chapters.title: Chapter 731 - 730: Aren't You Going to Get Up First?
chapters.content:
"So the puppets I've been battling every day are at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage?" Lu Yang was dumbfounded as he saw everything that had happened at Sky Gate Mountain through Fairy Eternity's immortal consciousness.
Fairy Eternity chuckled twice, unsurprised, "I told you long ago that there are guardians in the sect treasury."
Lu Yang remembered that when he had gone to the Eldest Senior Sister to collect the patent fee for the Flying Car, and she had taken him to the treasury to get Spirit Stones, he had been worried about how easily the treasury's doors could be opened. Since the Eldest Senior Sister was not always on Sky Gate Mountain, he felt the treasury was not secure.
At that time, Fairy Eternity had said not to worry about the security of the treasury.
"Wait a minute, you knew all along that the puppet was at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, and you never stopped me when I fought with it?" Lu Yang asked with a dark face.
"I thought you were having a good time fighting," Fairy Eternity said with schadenfreude, clearly doing it on purpose.
...
In the high sky, Master of All Laws saw that Vast Sea Daoist Lord was tricky to deal with, and since the dignitary from the underworld had made a brief eruption at Sky Gate Mountain and then went silent, he was likely already killed.
This indicated that Seek Dao Sect still had experts hidden, and fighting on was not a wise move.
Moreover, Vast Sea Daoist Lord was indeed tough to handle as any of his direct attacks could be deflected by Vast Sea Daoist Lord.
He left a clone to keep Vast Sea Daoist Lord occupied and turned to run away.
But before he could get out of Seek Dao Sect's territory, he ran into an invisible barrier, crashing into it hard.
"Spatial Barrier?"
"Is Seek Dao Sect a place where you can come and go as you please?"
As Vast Sea Daoist Lord spoke, he used spatial cutting to shred the clone Master of All Laws had left behind.
Master of All Laws's expression was as dark as dripping water; it seemed a fight to the death was inevitable today.
"World without limits, Myriad Laws Unite!"
Master of All Laws accelerated time, transformed into a Thousand-Armed Buddha, and casually launched various attacks that merged into one.
The Five Elements, Yin and Yang, reality and illusion, wind and thunder, the Soul... All kinds of attacks were unleashed all at once, like an Immortal shaping the world, shattering it to pieces as energy from all components of the world spilled out, forming a magical skill storm!
He attacked not Vast Sea Daoist Lord, but the cultivators from Seek Dao Sect and the Great Yu Alliance fighting below.
Myriad Laws Unite, a touch from a Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator means death!
He didn't care about the lives of the Great Yu Alliance; he was betting Vast Sea Daoist Lord did!
Master of All Laws bet correctly; Vast Sea Daoist Lord indeed cared.
Vast Sea Daoist Lord employed an Embryonic Spatial Dao Fruit to absorb all attacks into an Alternative Space.
That was the opportunity Master of All Laws had grasped for!
What Vast Sea Daoist Lord held was the Dao Fruit Outline, not the Dao Fruit itself; the space that could be opened was limited, and Master of All Laws didn't believe Vast Sea Daoist Lord could stop the vast assault and still have the energy to set up spatial whirlpools for defense around him!
"Die!"
Master of All Laws's destructive energy converged at his fingertips, which pierced through Vast Sea Daoist Lord's abdomen!
"Always moving around with accelerated time, so annoying, but now I've finally caught you!"
Vast Sea Daoist Lord's cold voice rang out, and Master of All Laws had a bad feeling. He tried to withdraw his hand but found it was already fixed to Vast Sea Daoist Lord's abdomen, unable to pull free!
Master of All Laws made a decisive move, severing his right hand, and continued to use time acceleration to distance himself from Vast Sea Daoist Lord.
"Too late!"
Vast Sea Daoist Lord had already left a spatial imprint on Master of All Laws; no matter how fast Master of All Laws moved, he could be caught up with!
Master of All Laws needed time to recover from his injuries, which was extremely short, less than a breath's time, but Vast Sea Daoist Lord gave him no such moment, relentlessly pursuing him and leaving him in a sorry state.
"Rebirth from bones, Lifespan Curse!"
Master of All Laws shouted loudly, removing the spatial imprint and once again using the curse magic to link his lifespan with that of Vast Sea Daoist Lord, causing both to consume the same lifespan!
This was a move uniquely created by Master of All Laws, as it would be useless for anyone else to learn it.
Lifespan is intimately related to one's realm; if the realms are the same, then there's no need to use this move. If the realms are not the same, then there's even less reason to use it, as it's impossible for a cultivator of a lower realm to have a longer lifespan than one of a higher realm.
Only someone with a naturally long-lived immortal body like Master of All Laws could use this move against cultivators of the same realm.
"Accelerated Lifespan!" Master of All Laws rapidly consumed his own lifespan, and under the influence of the curse, the lifespan of Vast Sea Daoist Lord was also swiftly depleting.
In a contest of lifespan, Vast Sea Daoist Lord was certainly no match for Master of All Laws.
"Spatial Collapse!"
A tremendous gravitational force appeared around Vast Sea Daoist Lord and Master of All Laws, warping time and causing the flow of time to become extremely slow, which made the originally swiftly depleting lifespan now ebb away very slowly.
"Damn it," Master of All Laws hadn't expected this move.
"Die, you!" Vast Sea Daoist Lord engaged in close combat with punches and kicks. Master of All Laws's boxing technique was unparalleled, but in front of Vast Sea Daoist Lord, who possessed spatial displacement, no boxing technique was of any use.
Boom!
Vast Sea Daoist Lord kicked Master of All Laws away, sending him flying like a kite with its string cut.
Seeing Lu Yang, Master of All Laws's eyes lit up, and he swiftly flew towards him.
"That's right, this lad has Emperor Yu's Immortal Sword!"
"Not good!" Vast Sea Daoist Lord suddenly realized what Master of All Laws intended to do but without the spatial imprint, he couldn't possibly catch up with Master of All Laws.
Just when Master of All Laws thought he was about to obtain the Immortal Sword, his body suddenly stopped obeying him, and with a stumble, he fell to his knees in front of Lu Yang with a thud.
Everyone watched this scene incredulously, whether it was the Seek Dao Sect or the Great Yu Alliance, they all involuntarily ceased fighting and stared dumbfounded.
Without a doubt, it was Fairy Eternity who was in control.
Lu Yang fell silent for a moment, then took a step to the left.
He certainly did not dare to be knelt to by a Semi-Immortal.
Master of All Laws thought this was an accident and felt utmost humiliation. He turned to the left and pounced towards Lu Yang fiercely, trying to snatch the Immortal Sword.
At that moment, Fairy Eternity, worried that Lu Yang would get hurt, hurriedly controlled Master of All Laws to stop.
Just as Master of All Laws had lunged forward like a tiger descending the mountain, he was commanded to stop, and due to inertia, his head hit the ground first.
He was prostrating himself fully.
Lu Yang once again fell silent as Master of All Laws repeatedly performed the gesture of respect. Would it be impolite for him to dodge?
"Uh, maybe you should get up first?" Lu Yang suggested awkwardly.
After all, the man was a full two hundred thousand years older than him and had a higher cultivation level.
Finally, Master of All Laws realized that all that had happened was no accident. There must be someone pulling the strings behind the scenes, controlling him!
Who could it be?!
It was an Immortal, and moreover, an Immortal in the Seek Dao Sect who possessed his superior Dao Fruit!
Master of All Laws wanted to escape, but Fairy Eternity, thinking he still intended to harm Lu Yang, directly ordered him not to move.
Vast Sea Daoist Lord arrived in time, trapping Master of All Laws with the magic of spatial confinement.
"Phew, finally dealt with."
After a hearty and satisfying battle, Vast Sea Daoist Lord captured Master of All Laws alive, his confidence soaring.
In a fight between Semi-Immortals, it was extremely difficult to determine a winner, and it was even more difficult to capture the opponent alive.

chapters.title: Chapter 732 - 731: Bountiful Harvest
chapters.content:
The battle of Semi-Immortals is exceedingly difficult to conclude, with self-detonations by Immortal Eternities that could last for ten days and the second Imperial Teacher being blasted for the same duration being common occurrences.
In the same vein, if Vast Sea Daoist Lord and Master of All Laws were left to clash, it is quite possible they could fight for eight to ten days as well.
Fairy Eternity secretly sabotaged, allowing this battle to come to an early end.
However, Vast Sea Daoist Lord was completely unaware of all this.
Master of All Laws wanted to struggle, but it was in vain; the complete spatial confinement nailed him in place, and without the permission of Vast Sea Daoist Lord, there was no way he could escape.
He could never have anticipated encountering a superior Dao Fruit Immortal from the legends at Seek Dao Sect – was it the Time Immortal here, or the Immortal in charge of the "Undying" Dao Fruit?
Either scenario demonstrated the terrifying nature of Seek Dao Sect.
At this point, his view of Lu Yang completely changed; with an Immortal residing at Seek Dao Sect, there was no way Lu Yang's Immortal Sword could have gone unnoticed by an Immortal's discerning eyes.
How could an Immortal possibly ignore such an exceptional Immortal Sword and allow a Nascent Soul Stage Cultivator to possess it?
The answer was almost self-evident – the Immortal held Lu Yang in extremely high regard, even bestowing him with an Immortal Sword!
Lu Yang always felt that Master of All Laws looked at him strangely, but he couldn't quite pinpoint what was odd about it.
The Great Yu Alliance wanted to flee, but how could the Dao Seeking Sect allow them to do so when they were known for relentlessly pursuing their enemies until the end?
Particularly, the child Grandmaster Tang Shengyi, who fought most fiercely, evoking unpleasant childhood memories in many of the Elders.
"Grandmaster's combat skills seem to have improved quite a lot," the Grand Elder commented as he hurled the Dream Pillow at others while discussing via telepathy with his junior brothers and sisters.
"Indeed, looking at him now, he could take on two opponents single-handedly."
"When did Grandmaster become so formidable?"
What the Elders didn't know was that the child Grandmaster, while guarding Captive Peak during his spare time, often sought combat advice from the prisoners there.
The prisoners brought to Captive Peak in recent years were extraordinary individuals: the sixth Emperor Yu, those at the peak of Transcendance Tribulation Stage, Semi-Immortals, Imperial Teachers from the late stages of Great Yu... all were legendary warriors with a history of countless battles.
As the child Grandmaster asked them for advice, they dared not hold anything back, sharing their knowledge generously.
The child Grandmaster's combat skills rapidly improved.
"Spatial Cage!"
Vast Sea Daoist Lord used the Dao Fruit Outline to trap all the cultivators of the Great Yu Alliance in the bamboo forest, with not a single one able to escape.
"Hahaha, trying to run? Can you escape?"
After capturing Master of All Laws, Vast Sea Daoist Lord's confidence skyrocketed!
In this area of Seek Dao Sect, aside from Yun Zhi, he was the strongest!
"It seems that everything's finally settled." Elder Brother Dai ended the fight, letting out a sigh of relief as the crisis passed without major peril.
Who would have thought that a mere entry test for disciples would suddenly escalate into a battle amongst Semi-Immortals, even involving two Semi-Immortals taking part in the entry test.
"It seems with the coming of the Great Era, all sorts of demons and deities are emerging. Junior Brother Lu and Junior Brother Meng were merely unlucky, happening upon high-level conflicts," Elder Brother Dai thought to himself.
"Junior Brother Lu, Junior Brother Meng, prepare to wrap up the final steps of the entry test."
Under the urgent circumstances, all participants of the third round were brought to Seek Dao Sect, among whom only Zhuang Ping, Zhou Xing'er, Gu Junye, and Daoist Xiantian passed the test.
Apart from Gu Junye and Daoist Xiantian, the expressions of those who took part in the third round were still unsettled, having witnessed firsthand the foundations of Seek Dao Sect and observed the battle of Semi-Immortals. Such a level of combat is terrifying not just to mortals but would also strike fear into the heart of cultivators.
The disciples of Seek Dao Sect escorted the eliminated individuals out of the sect, and their elders, seeing their younger generations unharmed, were overcome with emotion.
They were wise and had seen their younger ones in the center of the unfolding battle. They had braced themselves for the possibility of their demise, yet unexpectedly, none of the younger generation had been injured.
The joy of survival overshadowed the dismay of being screened out by the Seek Dao Sect.
The four new recruits of the Seek Dao Sect didn't have any elders to see them off, so there was no need to consider farewell arrangements.
Zhuang Ping's mother was locked in prison and couldn't come out.
Zhou Xing'er's elders had always looked down on her and wouldn't come to see her.
Gu Junye had come alone.
As for Daoist Xiantian, it goes without saying--the Seek Dao Sect was his home.
In the bamboo forest, the cultivators of the Great Yu Alliance were all captured, and Daoist Xiantian even spotted two familiar Body Integration Realm cultivators. It was these two who had invited him to join the Great Yu Alliance, and after he refused, they revealed the fact that he possessed Jin Chan to True Master Guanqi.
"So they are from the Great Yu Alliance." Daoist Xiantian realized with a start, and was surprised at how quickly the Great Yu Alliance had been caught.
Handling the affairs of the Great Yu Alliance was no longer the responsibility of the elders--Grandmaster Hongwen would take care of it himself.
They had watched the entire process of the three rounds of testing and were now quietly discussing the new disciples through transmitted messages.
"This one, Gu Junye, is not bad; he can be taken under my wing," the Grand Elder said with a smile. This was Dai Bufan's intention, as they both shared the Water Spirit Root. In the future, Dai Bufan could do the teaching himself, which would take a load off his shoulders as a master.
"Zhou Xing'er has quite a talent in cultivation; it just so happens I haven't taken a disciple in many years. Raising one to take care of my medicine garden would be good," Uncle Ba mentioned.
"Then Zhuang Ping will be mine. This lad has a connection with Hongwen; it was Hongwen who assessed his character," the Fourth Elder laughed, not minding that Zhuang Ping's roots were but Three Spirit Roots.
Of course, it was too early to say who would be whose disciple. Accepting a disciple is a mutual process; it requires consent from both the master and the disciple.
These three had just arrived at the Seek Dao Sect and were unfamiliar with everyone. They would be given a month's time, and after a month, they could decide whom they would choose as their master.
"What should we do about the Ancestor? Should I take him under my name?" The Eighth Elder asked eagerly, following Daoist Xiantian's intention to treat him as an ordinary disciple.
"Are you really not afraid of the master breaking your legs?" the Third Elder sighed, removing his armor.
Mentioning the master, even the scam-savvy Eighth Elder was scared.
The matter of Daoist Xiantian's affiliations was a thorny issue. After asking around, no one dared to take Daoist Xiantian as a disciple, fearing that their own master might lock them in Captive Peak on a whim.
The eight elders didn't dare, but someone did.
That person strode toward Daoist Xiantian "Qi Tong, would you like to follow me in cultivation?"
The speaker held significant weight within Seek Dao Sect, and it was none other than Vast Sea Daoist Lord.
The eight elders: "..."
Those unaware of the situation envied Daoist Xiantian, who was about to be taken as a disciple by a Semi-Immortal--a tremendously fortunate opportunity.
Those in the know had much more complicated feelings.
They were stunned that the patriarch of the resurgence was still alive and even more surprised by his very clear intention.
"I am willing!" Daoist Xiantian didn't care who he apprenticed under as long as he could have a peaceful environment for cultivation.
All in all, the Seek Dao Sect made a bountiful haul today, not only taking in four new disciples but also recruiting a Semi-Immortal, five Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivators, and more than twenty Body Integration Realm cultivators into Captive Peak.
It was all a cause for great joy and celebration.

chapters.title: Chapter 733 - 732 Zhu Tian: How Did So Many Semi-Immortals Suddenly Appear?
chapters.content:
The battle unfolded by the Seek Dao Sect was too big to cover up; disciples participating in the entrance examination and their parents all witnessed it.
Soon, the news spread throughout the streets and alleys.
"Good heavens, Master of All Laws has appeared, that's the legendary peerless genius, to think he has cultivated to the level of Semi-Immortal!"
