"And his followers too, five at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, and over twenty at the Body Integration Realm, my goodness, that's almost half the Demon Territory there."
"That's not even the most terrifying part. The fact that they ambushed the Seek Dao Sect only to be captured by them in return!"
Previously, people thought the Seek Dao Sect only had one cultivator at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, plus one method comparable to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, which is the standard configuration for an Immortal Sect. Who could have imagined that Seek Dao Sect had such a terrifying foundation.
After this battle, the Seek Dao Sect truly solidified its status as the leader of the Five Great Immortal Sects.
"The ancestor who revived the Seek Dao Sect 50,000 years ago, the Vast Sea Daoist Lord, is still alive; everyone thought he was at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, but he secretly advanced to a Semi-Immortal!"
"The Seek Dao Sect is indeed fearsome."
"I have a nephew who participated in the Seek Dao Sect's entrance examination. He happened to witness the whole process, and there's one thing no one has mentioned."
"What detail? Fellow Daoist, do tell."
"You know of Lu Yang, Talent Lu, right?"
"Who hasn't heard of Lu Yang, the genius who fought beyond his rank during the Foundation Establishment Stage to challenge the Divinity Transformation Stage, a peerless prodigy unrivaled in the world!"
"That's not all; according to my nephew, after Master of All Laws was defeated, he knelt down in front of Lu Yang. Lu Yang didn't want to be worshiped and stepped to the left, but Master of All Laws stubbornly adjusted his position and kept kowtowing to Lu Yang, with an extremely proper posture!"
"What, a Semi-Immortal kneeling to Lu Yang?! How is that possible!"
"I too find it hard to believe, but my nephew saw it with his own eyes, it's indeed a fact!"
Daoist Buyu and the Gold Clan Leader, who were eating and drinking on the side, listened to the whole discussion. Daoist Buyu was quite surprised.
"The Vast Sea Ancestor is still alive?"
He, as the Sect Leader, was actually unaware of such matters and only learned about them through others' discussions.
The Gold Clan Leader was also surprised, never expecting the Seek Dao Sect to have a Semi-Immortal.
"Looking at the current situation, who knows how many Great Powers are hiding in the dark. I hope the young patriarch can make a strong showing and truly place the Qiongqi Clan in the top ten in the struggle of the Great Era."
"I mustn't slack off either," the Gold Clan Leader encouraged himself. Following Daoist Buyu for half a year brought about a metamorphosis in him.
"Daoist Buyu, who are we going to deceive next?"
...
In the Demon Territory, Demon City.
In the ancient and distinguished palace, Zhu Tian was staring at the intelligence report handed to him, somewhat dazed.
"This isn't right. I've waited for more than two hundred years and haven't seen any Semi-Immortal appear. How come as soon as I take the position of Master of the Demon Territory, Semi-Immortals pop up from the ground like radishes?"
"Not to mention Jiang Lianyi, Nightmare Supreme, Void Venerate, Master of All Laws, Vast Sea Daoist Lord... How did so many Semi-Immortals suddenly appear?"
He had slept from the ancient times until now, aiming to be king and enjoy dominance in an era without Semi-Immortals, savoring absolute power. If he had known this era would be this lively, he would rather have continued sleeping, waiting for the next era, instead of squeezing into this crowded one.
"With how lively this is, I'm afraid Immortals might enter the stage too... oh wait, Lu Yang's Spiritual Space is already occupied by an Immortal."
Zhu Tian bared his teeth in frustration, "Even if I am the foremost beneath the Immortals, I'm afraid I won't fare well in the struggle of the Great Era."
"Is it too late to go back to sleep now?"
...
Seek Dao Sect, Captive Peak.
Captive Peak was never as lively as it was today. Usually, they would capture one by one, but today was different, with a whole thirty people joining the Captive Peak 'family'.
If Captive Peak were to be considered a force, it would be a top-tier power on par with the Demon Territory.
Upon entering Captive Peak, Master of All Laws's pupils contracted sharply, as if he had seen a ghost.
There were Wu Youdao, Nightmare Supreme, Void Venerate, and many familiar Great Yu Cultivators.
No, it's not just many acquaintances, all the sleeping Great Yu Cultivators he knew of were here!
When exactly, and how, were these people captured and brought here?
Especially Wu Youdao, if he's here, where is Jin Buzheng?
Jin Buzheng is the Second Imperial Teacher.
The Nightmare Supreme and the Void Venerate are here, weren't they captured by the Ancient Heavenly Court... Could it be that the Seek Dao Sect is the public facade of the Ancient Heavenly Court?
One terrifying fact after another surfaced, each one more dreadful upon closer consideration.
The Master of All Laws realized that it was no injustice for him to be captured by the Seek Dao Sect, for the Sect's strength was far beyond what they had shown!
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord escorted the Master of All Laws and others into Captive Peak, using the Embryonic Spatial Dao Fruit to reinforce each cell.
"The rest I leave to you," said the Vast Sea Daoist Lord, greeting someone at the entrance to Captive Peak before striding away.
The Master of All Laws turned around, wanting to see who the Vast Sea Daoist Lord was speaking to.
There were two figures at the entrance of Captive Peak, one male and one female, both known to the Master of All Laws.
Lu Yang and Yun Zhi.
How could it be these two people?
Wait, the Master of All Laws remembered the Inner Demon Yun Zhi from the second round of the test.
If Yun Zhi wasn't Gu Junye's Inner Demon but the Vast Sea Daoist Lord's, to what realm had Yun Zhi ascended to inflict the Vast Sea Daoist Lord with an Inner Demon?!
And why would this Lu Yang come here?
Yun Zhi didn't give the Master of All Laws a chance to think, tossing him into a room isolated from external probing.
"Ha, don't dream of getting any information from me..."
Yun Zhi gave a fist salute to Lu Yang, "I humbly request the elder to take action."
"Oh dear, in the end, it comes down to this Immortal's help."
An ominous figure appeared that chilled the Master of All Laws to the bone, emanating authoritative pressure from the roots, displaying absolute control from a superior over an inferior.
Immortal!
A being of higher standing, the holder of the Immortal Dao Fruit!
Fairy Eternity emerged giggling from Lu Yang's body and pointed at the Master of All Laws' forehead.
"By my command, you must answer all questions, withhold no knowledge, and tell no lies."
"Yes," the Master of All Laws replied unconsciously.
"Now you may ask."
"Thank you for your assistance, senior."
"Which power do you come from?"
"We come from the Great Yu Alliance, I am the Alliance Hierarch."
"When did you awaken?"
"I possess an immortal body and have never slept, having lived from the beginning of Great Yu to the present."
"Why did you attack our Seek Dao Sect?"
"For Emperor Yu Wu Yao's immortal treasures. Seeing that Lu Yang held Wu Yao's Immortal Sword, I suspected that the Seek Dao Sect might have Wu Yao's other treasures. If I could obtain the Immortal Artifact, my strength would greatly increase. That's why I planned to infiltrate the Seek Dao Sect to conspire from within and seize this place."
Eldest Senior Sister frowned slightly, somewhat confused, "How did you know I killed Wu Yao and obtained all of Wu Yao's treasures?"
"What?!" The Master of All Laws' eyes widened in shock, and he found himself lost for words, struck as if by a thunderbolt, unable to digest the news for a good while.
Wu Yao is dead? And you killed him?
If I had known this, I would have to be kicked in the head by a donkey to come to your Seek Dao Sect!

chapters.title: Chapter 734 - 733: Questions and Answers
chapters.content:
```
Master of All Laws wished he could become an Immortal right then, solidify the longevous Dao Fruit, reverse time, and return to yesterday, firmly deciding not to enter the Seek Dao Sect
What kind of godforsaken place was the Seek Dao Sect? He had lived for two hundred thousand years, and this was the first time he'd heard of Immortals being killed off!
Being able to kill Wu Yao meant that Yun Zhi was definitely an Immortal.
There was also this unnamed female Immortal with an Immortal Dao Fruit.
Adding them up, the Seek Dao Sect had two Immortals.
With such strength, why bother being one of the Five Great Immortal Sects? Why not just straight up replace Great Xia?
"Replacing Great Xia, that actually seems feasible," Fairy Eternity pondered seriously as she stroked her chin.
Isn't it said that each dynasty can only last a hundred thousand years, and now it's just the right time for a change of era? If she rides the trend of the times, joins forces with Miss Yun to unify the Central Continent, and becomes the emperor herself...
"Lu Yang, what do you think of me establishing a Great Bean Dynasty?"
"By then, I'll be the Bean Emperor," Fairy Eternity counted on her fingers, "The emperor takes turns, Miss Yun can be the second Bean Emperor, you the third, and whoever you want to appoint for the fourth term is up to you."
Lu Yang: "..."
The naming skills of the Fairy, as always, leave much to be desired.
As a flattering courtier, Lu Yang heaped praise on Fairy Eternity: "The Fairy is remarkable, casting aside hereditary succession for abdication, so the capable can take office. This is something that Great Qian, Great Yu, and Great Xia have never achieved. Your action, Fairy, will surely be admired for thousands of years to come and worshiped by future generations as a wise and enlightened monarch!"
"Of course, I am remarkable," Fairy Eternity placed her hands on her hips, chin slightly lifted, with a face displaying a hint of pride.
Yun Zhi ignored the disingenuous Lu Yang and the nearly floating Fairy Eternity, continuing to inquire: "The treasure of Wu Yao lies within the Seek Dao Sect, so you should have easily considered the possibility that there was someone capable of killing Wu Yao within the sect. What led you to dismiss this possibility?"
"I thought Emperor Yu had left this world, gone beyond the bounds of this box, and that your people from the Seek Dao Sect had happened upon his abandoned possessions by chance."
"Emperor Yu has a way to leave this world?" Lu Yang was quite surprised. The world's box was a creation of the Four Ancient Immortals who worked together to trap the one behind the curtain; even someone as powerful as that couldn't leave, so how did Emperor Yu manage it?
"He must have,"
"During these two hundred thousand years, I have met Emperor Yu many times. Since I am considered his junior and there were no conflicts of interest between us, he was rather friendly towards me, revealing his wish to go to the outer world."
"His Dao Fruit is the Exchange Dao Fruit, which emphasizes swapping. Anything belonging to him can be used as a bargaining chip for exchange."
"I suspect the reason he allowed the Great Yu Dynasty to perish was precisely because he wanted to sacrifice the entire Great Yu Dynasty, and not just let it happen. He might have even quickened the demise of Great Yu. The rampant natural disasters and human calamities during its last days, leaving people destitute and desperate, might not be a mere coincidence.
Perhaps he first sacrificed the destiny of the Great Yu Dynasty, then sacrificed the dynasty itself."
"In any case, his plan was to sacrifice the Great Yu Dynasty in exchange for a way to reach the outside world."
"I had thought that he had departed for the outside world since then, but during the era of Great Xia, I discovered traces of his activity twice, though I never saw him personally."
"Nineteen years ago, in the state of Yu, a violent aura suddenly appeared, definitely that of Emperor Yu. The violent aura vanished in a flash, and its transformation was unlike any common occurrence. This led me to speculate that Emperor Yu had left this world."
"Yu state?" Eldest Senior Sister nodded her head; this was consistent with the location where she had fought the ancient Immortal, and the process was roughly similar.
"If the person I battled was indeed Emperor Yu, then it's quite possible he took that opportunity to abandon his Dao Fruit, sacrifice himself, and, by dying, escape to the outside world."
Back then, Wu Yao wanted to contaminate the power of national fate, a force tied to countless lives. Regardless of success or failure, it would shake the causality of people across the world. Seeing the dire situation, Yun Zhi had no choice but to give it her all.
The battle concluded swiftly, and Yun Zhi wasn't sure whether Wu Yao had actually died or escaped to the outside world.
```
However, there was no difference in the end; both scenarios resulted in the absence of Emperor Yu, the unpredictable element.
Nineteen years ago?
Lu Yang was startled. Wasn't that exactly the time he had just transmigrated to this world after his death?
Damn it, could it be that my previous life was in the outer world, and Wu Yao, you swapped yourself out and brought me in?
"By the way, Fairy, can I ask if the Master of All Laws has ever felt the suppression of a Dao Fruit, in order to confirm whether the Time Immortal is still alive?" Lu Yang remembered another matter.
The Dao Fruit of Longevity contains two superior Dao Fruits: the Immortal Dao Fruit and the Time Dao Fruit.
Fairy Eternity looked disdainfully at the Master of All Laws, "It won't work; he hasn't fully mastered the Dao Fruit Outline of Longevity. He cannot sense the suppression of a superior Dao Fruit. Perhaps an Immortal Body of Longevity from the Ancient Times could, but not him."
"He's lived for two hundred thousand years and still hasn't fully mastered it?" Lu Yang was astonished. The Master of All Laws had not only lived for two hundred thousand years but could also use the Immortal Body of Longevity to expedite his cultivation process.
"As I said, the key to mastering the Dao Fruit Outline lies in one's comprehension; it's not something that can be accumulated with time. Those with poor comprehension could live for a million years and still not become an Immortal."
"Do you know the whereabouts of the Four Ancient Immortals?" Yun Zhi asked directly.
The Master of All Laws shook his head, "I do not know."
"There is an Immortal-level formation around the Sun that prevents anyone from approaching. Do you know who is responsible for this Immortal-level formation?"
The Master of All Laws showed a strange expression, clearly aware of the inside story.
"There are two Immortal-level formations around the Sun. The first Immortal-level formation was left by the original Emperor Qian, who claimed to have established a new order upon the ruins of Ancient Times. He was ambitious and asserted that even the Sun and Moon in the sky were his possessions. He did not allow anyone to approach and hence set up the first Immortal-level formation."
"After Great Qian collapsed, Wu Yao established the Great Yu Dynasty and tried many times to approach the Sun to observe the power of the Sun and Moon. However, he could not break through the formation left by the original Emperor Qian."
Angered, he then set up another Immortal-level formation so that the original Emperor Qian could also not obtain the Sun."
Lu Yang: "..."
Were you two founding emperors out of your minds?
"How many Immortals were born during the Great Yu Era?"
"Two, one was Emperor Yu Wu Yao, and the other was Imperial Teacher Guan Shanhai."
"The first Imperial Teacher Guan Shanhai?"
"Yes, both of them became Immortals during the grand founding ceremonies of their respective dynasties."
"Do you know what the Dao Fruit of Imperial Teacher Guan Shanhai is?"
"I do not know."
"How many Immortals were born during the Great Qian Era?"
"To my knowledge, only the original Emperor Qian, as he left an Immortal-level formation on the Sun. As for whether there were others who achieved Immortality, I am unaware."
"One last question, do you know of the Fire Dynasty?" Yun Zhi asked calmly.
Upon hearing this, the Master of All Laws's pupils contracted sharply.

chapters.title: Chapter 735 - 734: The Disappearance of the Fire Dynasty
chapters.content:
"You also know about the Fire Dynasty?!"
"Also?" Yun Zhi realized that Master of All Laws was aware of the Fire Dynasty.
Since learning of the existence of the Fire Dynasty in the Immortal Secret Realm, Yun Zhi had used all sorts of connections to inquire about news of the Fire Dynasty.
But whether it was the first Emperor Xia, Jiang Pingan, or the recently captured Nightmare Supreme and Void Venerate, none had ever heard of the Fire Dynasty.
This led Yun Zhi to doubt at times whether the Fire Dynasty had ever existed.
Finally, she had encountered someone who knew of the Fire Dynasty.
"This place is indeed safe, and besides you three, no one else knows what I've said, right?" the Master of All Laws, controlled by Fairy Eternity, had to reveal everything he knew.
"Of course," Yun Zhi replied, and Fairy Eternity and Lu Yang echoed her sentiment. With the three of them here, this was the safest place in the world.
If not for Fairy Eternity's presence, the Master of All Laws would under no circumstances have been willing to talk about the Fire Dynasty. He had confided in his trusted followers about Wu Yao but had not uttered a word about the Fire Dynasty, which was telling.
Thinking that there were two immortals here, one who had slain Emperor Yu and another who possessed the Immortal Dao Fruit, she felt somewhat relieved.
"I too was unaware of the existence of the Fire Dynasty at first. Not to boast, but in my zeal to learn numerous magic skills, I've visited all the Scripture Pavilions in the world, including those in the Imperial Palace of Great Yu."
"Not a single book mentioned the existence of the Fire Dynasty."
"It was only after I had cultivated to Semi-Immortal, faked my death to escape, and went into hiding, that I learned about the Fire Dynasty from the relics left in secretive realms, the clues revealed by Wu Yao, and the ruined temple murals."
"And when I returned to those secret realms where clues to the Fire Dynasty had been, I found that those places and the ruined temples had been vandalized."
Lu Yang frowned, "When exactly was the Fire Dynasty established?"
"After the ancient times, before the Great Qian Dynasty."
"What?!" Lu Yang was shocked. There had been a dynasty established in that period.
Fairy Eternity did not know of the Fire Dynasty's existence, so does that mean it was established after the Four Immortals sealed off the world?
"People say that in ancient times there was a battle among immortals that turned the stars into continents, after which the heritage was severed and even the ancient language was lost. Emperor Qian built the Great Qian Dynasty on the ruins of the ancient world."
"This is a misconception,"
"After the Ancient Immortals turned stars into continents, the Fire Dynasty was established using the ancient language, and then after another hundred thousand years, the dynasty was destroyed."
"The cause of its destruction is unknown, but one thing is certain, someone was deliberately trying to erase the existence of the Fire Dynasty."
"And that person was an Immortal!"
"That Immortal eradicated all traces of the Fire Dynasty's existence—architecture, mortals, cultivators, books, even the language... Everything was gone."
"It was as if they wanted to sever everything related to the Fire Dynasty."
"Anyone who knew of the Fire Dynasty's existence was at risk of being obliterated by that Immortal. In the late stage of Great Yu, I befriended a Semi-Immortal, who went by the Taoist name 'Wood Imprint.' He also knew of the Fire Dynasty, and originally, our plan was to establish the Great Yu Alliance together. He was not an Immortal body and chose to hibernate."
"We had agreed that when the Great Era arrived, I would awaken him."
"But what I didn't expect was that he perished before the Great Era even arrived."
"Every five thousand years, I would check on the status of the Wood Imprint Venerate,"
"Thirty thousand years ago, in accordance with routine, I went to the Wood Imprint Venerate's Cave Heaven, but when I arrived, I found him pierced through the chest, struck down by an untimely death!"
The voice of the Master of All Laws trembled, "There were no signs of struggle at the scene. Even if he was in deep slumber, had someone attempted a sneak attack, his instincts would have alerted him to danger and he would have risen to fight. Even if overpowered, it should not have been a case of instant death."
"The one who killed him was not a Semi-Immortal, but an Immortal!"
At this point, the Master of All Laws showed a fearful expression, the fall of the Wood Imprint Venerate having cast a great psychological shadow over him.
"This is why I keep confirming that this place is secure and that no one else is eavesdropping,"
"Should that Immortal learn about the matters here, my fate would likely be perilous."
"So that's how it is," Yun Zhi mused thoughtfully, not having expected the Fire Dynasty's existence to contain such hidden turmoil.
It was probably that very Immortal who went to great lengths to conceal the Fire Dynasty's existence who caused the break in the ancient lineage.
At first, Yun Zhi had been unable to find any trace of the Fire Dynasty's whereabouts and thought that the reason for its disappearance might be similar to that of Fairy Eternity's, erased by malevolent forces behind the scenes using special methods.
Now it seemed that the cause of the Fire Dynasty's destruction was uncertain, but the reason for its thorough disappearance was someone else's doing.
"What does the Fire Dynasty have to do with the Four Ancient Immortals?" Yun Zhi asked again.
She remembered that in the Immortal Eternity Secret Realm, there were ruins of the Fire Dynasty, and the ruins featured statues of Immortals whose gender she couldn't distinguish.
The Master of All Laws said cautiously, "I saw a mural in a ruined temple, terribly damaged. I could only roughly make out that it was a mural from the early days of the Fire Dynasty's establishment, depicting four majestic figures. I surmise, and it's just a guess, that the Fire Dynasty might have been founded jointly by the Four Ancient Immortals."
Uncertain about Yun Zhi and her companions' stance towards the Four Ancient Immortals, the Master of All Laws stressed that these were all conjectures.
From the ignorance of Yun Zhi and her companions regarding the Fire Dynasty, it was quite possible that the members of the Ancient Heavenly Court had fallen into a collective slumber before the establishment of the Fire Dynasty, only to have awakened recently.
Wait, that's not right either. Among these three, there were two Immortals; did they have any need to sleep?
The Master of All Laws was horrified, venturing a bold guess. Could it be that you, members of the Ancient Heavenly Court, are impostors?
He dared not continue this train of thought, fearing being silenced, even wanting to slap himself twice as punishment for being too clever and thinking too much for no reason!
"The Four Ancient Immortals founded the Fire Dynasty... the Immortal concealing the Fire Dynasty's existence... Is this related to the death of the Time Immortal?" Lu Yang murmured softly. If that were the case, then the strength of this unknown Immortal must be terrifyingly powerful.
"What, the Time Immortal has fallen?" The Master of All Laws' expression perked up when he heard Lu Yang's musings.
He quickly met the unfriendly gaze of Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity and gave an awkward smile.
"Covering up the existence of the Fire Dynasty, what is his purpose?" Yun Zhi was equally puzzled. Was there some unspeakable secret associated with the Fire Dynasty?
Yun Zhi hadn't expected that the affair of the Fire Dynasty would involve an Immortal, moreover, an extremely ruthless one.
Yun Zhi glanced at Lu Yang and suddenly remembered that he was only at the Nascent Soul Stage and not yet at a level to comprehend the machinations of Immortals.
"Junior Brother, leave the matter of the Fire Dynasty to me; don't involve yourself,"
Lu Yang scratched his head, wondering if his Eldest Senior Sister was overestimating him. Being just a Mid-stage Nascent Soul Cultivator, even if he wanted to investigate the Fire Dynasty, his Cultivation Level wouldn't allow it.

chapters.title: Chapter 736 - 735: The Popular Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou
chapters.content:
Lu Yang felt that the matter of the Fire Dynasty sounded very dangerous.
An esteemed elder had been sleeping soundly, only to be killed because he knew about the Fire Dynasty.
Now that no one in the Cultivation World knows about the Fire Dynasty, one could infer that the methods of the Immortal responsible were far from gentle; probably, he killed all those who knew, leading to the complete disappearance of the Fire Dynasty.
As the saying goes, a wise man does not stand under a shaky wall; naturally, he intended to stay far away.
"However, what kind of unspeakable secret does the Fire Dynasty hold?" Lu Yang wondered. He had known about the existence of the Fire Dynasty for a long time, but hadn't witnessed any great fortune or terror befall them.
"Strange."
"Junior Brother, you should focus on your cultivation now and not get involved in Immortal affairs," said the Eldest Senior Sister as she took Lu Yang out of Captive Peak, to prevent him from knowing too much.
Fairy Eternity chuckled, as this showed who held the higher place in Miss Yun's heart.
"Oh, and Elder, you should leave as well."
The Eldest Senior Sister also sent Fairy Eternity away because, given her nature, she would probably turn around and tell the Junior Brother everything she knew at once.
After asking all the important questions, it was best to verify the truth and falsity of the remaining ones with the Master of All Laws, then corroborate it with his close confidants.
"The Fire Dynasty existed for a hundred thousand years, which means I've been dead for four hundred thousand years?" Fairy Eternity suddenly felt a hundred thousand years older.
"The focus of your concern might be somewhat different from others," someone remarked.
While they were talking, they encountered Vast Sea Daoist Lord hurrying towards the inner reaches of Seek Dao Sect.
"Elder Vast Sea, what are you doing?"
"Just don't say you've seen me," Vast Sea Daoist Lord hastily said, continuing his flight toward the inner reaches of Seek Dao Sect.
Lu Yang was baffled by the hurried manner of Vast Sea Daoist Lord.
It was only when he reached the nine peaks of Seek Dao Sect that he understood the reason.
While he and the Eldest Senior Sister were interrogating the Master of All Laws, various Great Sects had sent their visiting cards, wishing to visit Seek Dao Sect to witness the elegance of the legendary Vast Sea Daoist Lord.
Representatives from the nine Super-grade Sects and the other four Great Immortal Sects had all arrived, making Seek Dao Sect exceedingly lively for a time.
After all, opportunities to see a Semi-Immortal were rare, and not everyone was like Lu Yang, who either harbored an Immortal in his body or encountered a Semi-Immortal upon leaving his home.
Presumably, Vast Sea Daoist Lord was not willing to meet so many people, which is why he hid in the depths of Seek Dao Sect.
Since Daoist Buyu was often away and the Eldest Senior Sister was in Captive Peak, the Grand Elder had no choice but to take charge and entertain the guests.
"Elder Vast Sea is in seclusion. Dear guests, please leave your gifts and then return the way you came," advised the Grand Elder politely and meticulously, fully demonstrating the demeanor of a Great Sect.
Since learning that Vast Sea Daoist Lord was still alive, the Grand Elder had been standing much straighter than before.
Had it been in the past, even on Seek Dao Sect's grounds, the Grand Elder would not have dared to speak in such a manner.
The decision not to tell the upper echelons of Seek Dao Sect that Vast Sea Daoist Lord was still alive proved to be right.
The representatives of the various Great Sects huffed and glared but dared not make a scene.
...
"Old Lu, over here." Lu Yang heard Meng Jingzhou's voice and looked up to see Meng Jingzhou on the second floor of Hundred Fragrance Building, gesturing to him almost like a brothel hostess summoning customers.
When Lu Yang reached the second floor, he saw many familiar faces.
"Lan Ting, Bai Ming, Yan Tianzhi, you're all here too," Lu Yang greeted them with a smile. Each of the Great Sects had also brought their outstanding younger generation along.
Man Gu, Tao Yaoye, Li Haoran, and Meng Jingzhou, as the excellent younger generation of their own sect, were also present.
"Your Seek Dao Sect is making quite a name for yourselves," Bai Ming said with a laugh, patting Lu Yang's shoulder enviously; all along the way, he had heard discussions about Seek Dao Sect.
"It's just luck, all luck," replied Lu Yang with humble laughter.
"It's a good thing that your Seek Dao Sect is only now becoming famous. If it had happened a few days earlier, I'm afraid all those who had wanted to join our sect would have run over to your side."
The Five Elements Sect had just finished recruiting disciples a few days ago.
"The same goes for the Laurel Fairy Palace. When our senior sisters went to test mortals' characters and decide who could join our Laurel Fairy Palace, many people said they wanted to join the Seek Dao Sect and become Junior Sister to Senior Brother Lu Yang," Lan Ting said with a hint of grievance.
Had it not been for their earnest persuasion, the number of disciples recruited this year might have been less than half of previous years.
Tao Yaoye suddenly felt a strong sense of crisis.
"Is there anyone who wants to become my junior sister?" Meng Jingzhou pointed to himself and asked.
Lan Ting looked odd and hesitated before nodding, "There are."
Meng Jingzhou was delighted, feeling his charm was on par with Lu Yang.
"It's because you're known as the young master of the Meng Family, and word has spread about how you sit unmoved amid chaos, single-mindedly seeking cultivation."
"So?"
"So, those girls secretly say you're the 'cold and noble Buddha of the Imperial City' and want to take advantage of the momentum to become the Buddha's wife."
Meng Jingzhou's face darkened.
Yan Tianzhi, who had remained silent, couldn't hold back a laugh any longer, and burst out laughing. His laughter seemed contagious, and soon everyone was laughing.
"Aren't we all at the mid-stage Nascent Soul by now? How about we find a place to spar?" Bai Ming suggested after they had eaten and drunk their fill.
"Let's do it." Everyone was at the age where they relished combat, and they all agreed.
...
The news that Lu Yang and others would fight in the arena spread quickly.
Lu Yang's reputation was too significant. Even in a sect like the Seek Dao Sect, where talents were common, Lu Yang's deeds were unique.
"Our sect is going to fight with other Immortal Sects."
"Really, who's going to fight?"
"Senior Brother Lu, Senior Brother Meng, Senior Brother Li, Senior Brother Man, and Senior Sister Tao."
"So many people!"
"Hurry up, we'll miss it if we're late."
The area around the arena was bursting with people, their eyes filled with excitement.
New recruits Zhuang Ping, Zhou Xing'er, Gu Junye, and Daoist Xiantian were also there to watch the fight.
"So, who's fighting who?"
"Junior Sister Lan Ting, how about you and I have a friendly spar?" Tao Yaoye said, holding a red paper umbrella and half her face hidden in shadow, as she took the initiative to challenge Lan Ting.
"Sure, please go easy on me, Junior Sister Tao."
"Someone from the Barbarian tribe?"
"Right."
"Then it's you and me." Yan Tianzhi spoke concisely. The method for cultivating War Patterns in their Five Elements Sect came from ancient tribes, and here was Man Gu from the Ancient Barbarian Tribe—how could he not be eager for a good fight?
"Junior Brother Li Haoran seems to have no reputation in the outside world, eh? I wonder how skilled he is?" Bai Ming said with a smile. Both Man Gu and Tao Yaoye had resounding reputations outside, but only Li Haoran seemed non-existent, never having made a move.
"We'll see when we try." Li Haoran was not intimidated by Bai Ming. He was suspected to possess a nascent outline of a Reincarnation Dao Fruit, with an unclear origin. If he were to leave the Seek Dao Sect, it was very likely that certain interested parties would target him, which could explain why he was not well-known.
But not being well-known didn't mean he couldn't fight.
"So, does that leave just the two of us?" Lu Yang hadn't expected opponents to be chosen so quickly, and now only he and Meng Jingzhou were left on the field.

chapters.title: Chapter 737 - 736: The Contest
chapters.content:
"Old Lu, don't worry, I won't let you lose too badly," Meng Jingzhou said, indicating he would preserve some dignity for Lu Yang with a brotherly concern.
Lu Yang's face darkened. "Meng Jingzhou, do you have no shame at all? I can't use my Seven-star Sword Array or Village in the Palm, so am I supposed to just spew Three Flavored True Fire at you until you die?"
The Seven-star Sword Array and Village in the Palm were techniques associated with his identity as Young Sect Master Lu, definitely not to be used in front of a crowd.
The Immortal-slaying Sword Array was also reserved for Young Sect Master Lu, so that was out as well.
Against other cultivators of the same level, Lu Yang was confident he could win without resorting to these trump cards.
But Meng Jingzhou was a different story; without getting serious, he couldn't be defeated.
"How about I take a step back and promise not to use Single Curse Fist, how does that sound?" Meng Jingzhou generously suggested.
Lu Yang suspected the reason no one dared to fight Meng Jingzhou was that they were terrified of being struck by Single Curse Fist.
If that hit them, their life would become as wretched as Meng Jingzhou's own sad fate.
Of course, Lu Yang wasn't much better off; his Lu's Arhat Fist was equally fearful to others.
"...How about you don't hold back, and you try using it on me, see who's tougher," Lu Yang, who had faced the trials of Immortals without dying, didn't believe that Single Curse Fist could harm him.
Meng Jingzhou pretended not to hear Lu Yang's words.
He wasn't stupid. Lu Yang, that rascal, was constantly causing trouble and stumbling upon opportunities. Who knew if he might end up marrying a Semi-Immortal or Immortal one day? He dared not use Single Curse Fist on Lu Yang.
"Old Lu, if you don't say anything, I'll take that as your agreement to our fight!" Meng Jingzhou said with a cold smile. Once the fight started, it didn't matter whether Lu Yang agreed or not—it would be considered agreement!
...
"Junior Sister Tao, it's been a year since we last met. I'm curious how far your cultivation has progressed—or has there been no progress at all?" Lan Ting flicked her fingertips, releasing countless whirlwinds. They seemed weak, but any mid-stage Nascent Soul who met them would be gravely injured.
Tao Yaoye twirled her umbrella and spun on her toes to ward off the whirlwind attacks from all directions with a dance-like grace.
"Junior Sister Lan has taken the trouble. In cultivation, persistence is key. With long-term commitment, there's bound to be some reward. There are so many people in this world who yearn for cultivation but don't get the chance. Compared to them, I'm already very fortunate."
Lan Ting chuckled softly, and with a light step on the platform, faint lights illuminated, forming several intricate arrays.
"Junior Sister Tao seems content, which is good. Speaking of which, Junior Sister, you managed to invent something as wondrous as the Dream Mirage, which is very popular in the mortal realm. Seeing how rapidly Dream Mirage has developed, you must have devoted a lot of effort. If you had focused that effort on cultivation, perhaps you could have achieved even greater success than now."
Tao Yaoye smiled sweetly, her movements not a moment too slow. She closed her red umbrella, transforming it into a spear, and struck at the Array Eye of the large formation.
"The Dream Mirage is a combined effort of wisdom between Elder Brother Lu Yang and me. The name was even his idea. How could I not put in some effort on it and honor the hard work we both shared?"
Lan Ting engaged in combat with the sash of her dress, moving between illusion and reality, with softness overcoming strength.
"I have also experienced the Dream Mirage a few times, especially the part in 'Eternal Love' where fellow disciples become a couple and live happily ever after, evoking the envy of many outsiders."
"Illusionary Realms are like dreams, Junior Sister Tao. You created such heartfelt illusions; I wonder how many times you've experienced them in dreams. I've heard that those who attain mastery over Illusionary Realms often struggle to distinguish between the illusion and reality. Junior Sister, you must not follow in those footsteps and trap yourself in an Illusionary Realm."
Tao Yaoye smiled sweetly, "First, I'd like to thank Junior Sister Lan for her concern, but it seems she has little contact with Elder Brother Lu Yang and may not know that his specialty is breaking through illusory realms. With the Elder Brother here, there will be no danger of getting trapped in illusions."
"If I really get trapped in an illusory realm, Elder Brother Lu Yang will also come to my rescue."
As Lan Ting tried to hook away Tao Yaoye's red paper umbrella by wielding the Nascent Soul with the primal chaos Yin and Yang as a weapon, she said,
"Elder Brother Lu Yang has a heart for the world, and if Junior Sister Tao is in trouble, of course, he will lend a hand. However, there are so many in the world facing dangers; I'm afraid that when the time comes, Elder Brother Lu Yang might be too preoccupied to attend to Junior Sister. It's still wiser for Junior Sister to learn to save herself."
Tao Yaoye moved gracefully, her wrist turning to dodge the attack of the primal chaos Yin and Yang and enshrouded Lan Ting in an illusionary realm.
"I'll travel the world with the Elder Brother, punishing the wicked and rescuing those in need. Should I encounter any difficulties, Elder Brother will naturally help me. Junior Sister Lan, being an outsider, I'm afraid you won't witness such scenes."
…
As someone born with a Five Elements Immortal body, Bai Ming's Nascent Soul was unique to the Five Elements; it appeared in five colors.
The five-colored Nascent Soul clasped its tiny hand, summoning the five elemental magic skills of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth for an attack.
"Go!"
The five-element magic skills blasted toward Li Haoran simultaneously. With the screech of the Golden Crow's True Flame, the heat blurred the vision. Within the True Flame, multiple flying knives were enveloped, with Weak Water enhancing the Golden Crow's True Flame.
Walls of earth sprang up on all sides, trapping Li Haoran inside, while infinite trees emerged from beneath the ground, their branches poisoned and bristling with spikes, untouchable.
"The reputation of the Five Elements Immortal body truly lives up to its name," Li Haoran said, facing the five different attacks with composure, and summoned a flame in his palm to strike back at Bai Ming's Golden Crow True Flame.
He collected the Weak Water released by Bai Ming with a replica of a jade bottle, smashed the earth walls in front of him with a sledgehammer, refined the incoming flying knives into a weapon for his own use with his skill of artifact refinement, and cut down the continuously emerging trees with a Bodhi arm, leaving the disciples below in awe.
Facing the five different attacks with divided and calm processing showed how composed Li Haoran was in combat.
"What's the point of launching five attacks at once? I can launch six!" Li Haoran chuckled and urged his Nascent Soul.
An explosive bang sounded, and Li Haoran was blown to pieces, which truly startled Bai Ming, who thought Li Haoran had made a mistake in his cultivation.
"Look, Elder Brother Li can still move!" someone shouted excitedly from below.
Amidst the dust, six objects moved at high speed—Li Haoran's head, torso, and four limbs.
Bai Ming's eyelid twitched as he watched; even when fighting with members of the demonic sect, he had never encountered such an unorthodox combat style.
Li Haoran's head spat out Six-C Divine Fire, his torso lunged straight at Bai Ming, his hands held gourds refined to expel Yin and Yang energies capable of seizing souls, and his boots were studded with poison-coated iron spikes that would burst out instantaneously if blocked, catching one off guard.
Six attacks were launched simultaneously!
Bai Ming and his Nascent Soul struggled to respond to these attacks, barely keeping up with the various Divine Abilities and magic skills. The hidden mechanisms in the various magic artifacts often plunged him into peril.
Suddenly, Li Haoran's hair flew out, each strand stiff as steel needles, forming a whirling disc that sped towards Bai Ming!
"You've been wearing a wig this whole time?!"
Bai Ming cast an envious glance toward the neighboring platform. Why were Tao Yaoye and Lan Ting's fight so harmonious, while his own was fraught with deadly traps everywhere.

chapters.title: Chapter 738 - 737: The Strongest Single!
chapters.content:
```
Yan Tianzhi and Man Gu were evenly matched.
Yan Tianzhi didn't hold back, unleashing the three great War Patterns of Shield Ghost, Taotie, and Zhuyan right from the start.
The Zhuyan War Pattern had been inscribed by him during the Nascent Soul Stage.
Behind Yan Tianzhi, the two demons and a ghost roared, causing the space itself to ripple slightly, which was an awe-inspiring sight.
Man Gu summoned the Nascent Souls of his ancestors, and whichever ancestor's form the Nascent Soul took on, Man Gu would acquire the abilities of that ancestor; hence, his combat power during the Nascent Soul Stage was the most variable.
Luckily, this time the summoned ancestor was a legendary figure with great renown, one who had even followed Fairy Eternity in the ancient times and was quite famous!
When Man Gu merged with the Nascent Soul, his entire temperament changed in an instant, becoming ancient, mysterious, and powerful!
"Roar——"
Clutching an eight-sided purple-golden hammer, Man Gu was ferocious and haunting, his roar resounding in every direction, his very voice a match for Yan Tianzhi's three great War Patterns in terms of intensity!
This was the most common way of combat among the Barbarian Tribe in the ancient times: intimidate your enemies with a couple of fierce roars before the actual fight.
At the same time, there was a recording of the sage's teachings playing in the background, striking a jarring note amidst the intense atmosphere.
"When friends come from afar, is it not a pleasure..."
"Among any three walkers, one is surely my teacher..."
This was from the talismans affixed to the handle of the hammer, capable of playing the sage's teachings and serving as the only evidence of Man Gu being a Confucian Cultivator.
Yan Tianzhi fused with the Shield Ghost, and an arm's length in front of him, a shield appeared–a person tall, with a dark aura swirling around it.
Yan Tianzhi, wielding the shield, charged forward, with Taotie and Zhuyan acting as his protectors on either side, all of them rushing towards Man Gu!
The eight-sided purple-golden hammer swept across all directions, and this was the "Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique" Man Gu had mastered, powerful and swift as lightning that could shake the heavens and resound through the celestial palace!
In the Yan Mountains, Man Gu killed a Spirit Transformation stage great demon that had infiltrated Great Xia, which was battered beyond recognition by that very hammer.
A regular Nascent Soul Stage cultivator wouldn't dare to even touch the hammer.
With the augmentation of his ancestral Nascent Soul, Man Gu's Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique was brought to a whole new level.
Although ancient ancestors had not learned such a hammer technique, the one he was channeling had followed Fairy Eternity and had innate combat intuition. When his spirit inhabited Man Gu's body, it manifested in an all-around enhancement excluding intelligence!
Taotie opened its mouth to inhale and exhale in all directions, Zhuyan swept his club across the world, and the hammer, like thunder on the run, lifted waves of spiritual essence with each strike.
The two ascended to the sky and entwined in battle up in the air, the heavy hammer in Man Gu's grasp swung as swiftly as the wind, a manifestation of the strength from the Ancient Barbarian Tribe's bloodline.
Boom!
The hammer smashed down on the shield, and Yan Tianzhi felt it like relentless waves crashing down, with a force that was continuous and unyielding, affecting his internal organs and all his meridians.
"Thrilling!" Yan Tianzhi laughed heartily, for it had been a long time since he experienced such an exhilarating battle!
...
Meng Jingzhou, under the effects of Lu's Arhat Fist, had become truly bald, a veritable Buddhist child of the Imperial City.
"Sword Control Technique!" Lu Yang was surrounded by sharp Sword Qi, and pointing upward with two fingers, the Sword Washing Pool surged like a dragon emerging from an abyss, colliding with Meng Jingzhou like a big truck.
"Shocking Heaven Six Forms!" Meng Jingzhou's execution of the Shocking Heaven Six Forms was even more masterful; his seemingly simple and unadorned punch was in fact laden with the power to split mountains and crack stones, resonating with the heavens and earth and drawing the surrounding spiritual essence to its aid, the mere sound of the punch classified as a sonic attack.
Upon collision, Meng Jingzhou took a half step back, showing that the Sword Washing Pool still had the upper hand in terms of power.
Lu Yang attempted to send the Invincible Nascent Soul into Meng Jingzhou's body, kindly helping him advance to a triple-Nascent Soul stage Great Power.
But Meng Jingzhou, unappreciative of good intentions, ran as fast as he could, refusing to let the Invincible Nascent Soul touch him at all costs.
```
"Golden Bird True Flame, Three Flavored True Fire!"
"Nirvana True Fire!"
The three true fires collided, causing a massive explosion with two birds chiming in, flames shot up to the sky, and the arena turned into a blasting furnace, within which two nimble figures fought amid the flames.
Within the firelight, the pure Yang Tai Chi Diagram reappeared, and the six-armed deity's boxing techniques rumbled like thunder, clashing hard against the Sword Washing Pool, Lu Yang conjured clones with the Tree Planting Spell, each wielding the Green Peak and Dark Moon swords to fight, yet still at a disadvantage.
"Look, it's three heads and six arms!" disciples of the Prison Suppressing Sect exclaimed in shock, unable to believe what they were seeing.
"How can this be possible!"
This was the Great Divine Skill most revered by body cultivators, never heard of anyone being able to use it at the Nascent Soul Stage.
"Baldy, three heads and six arms, that's the wrathful Vajrapani, the Protector of Buddhism from the Suspension Temple!" One of the Suspension Temple's senior brothers saw Meng Jingzhou and his eyes lit up.
Amongst the flames, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou fought while conversing.
"Don't forget you still owe me a chance to show off," Meng Jingzhou reminded Lu Yang.
Meng Jingzhou was referring to the Mid-stage Golden Core finals when Lu Yang had him concede to allow himself to take the spotlight first, promising to give Meng Jingzhou a chance to shine afterward.
But now at the Mid-stage Nascent Soul, Lu Yang, that bastard, still hadn't fulfilled his promise.
Lu Yang fell silent for a moment, if Meng Jingzhou hadn't reminded him, he really would have forgotten about it.
With composure, Lu Yang intentionally slowed his sword techniques, "Of course I remember, it's just that I hadn't found the right opportunity until now."
Meng Jingzhou's six eyes looked askance at Lu Yang, suspecting that the young man had forgotten his promise.
Sword light and fist shadows intertwined, Sword Qi gracefully agile, seeking to find a gap to breach Meng Jingzhou's defense. Meng Jingzhou, transformed into the wrathful Vajrapani, faced the sword moves like a violent storm, using his fists to ward off the Qi and dissipating myriad assaults into nothingness.
"Shocking Heaven Six Forms!"
With six arms, he performed the Shocking Heaven Six Forms; its power magnified exponentially, the Green Peak Sword positioned across his chest, Lu Yang, along with his sword, was sent flying backward and tumbled off the stage with a roll.
"What, so it's Senior Brother Meng who won!"
"During the Mid-stage Golden Core finals, Senior Brother Meng lost to Young Sect Master Lu, who then fought Senior Brother Lu to a draw—how could Senior Brother Lu lose to Senior Brother Meng?!"
"This shows that the strength of these three individuals is not much different; any slight disparity can affect the final outcome!"
"Such a terrifying Single Body Spiritual Root, probably unmatched by any previous generations with Single Body Spiritual Roots."
"The strongest Single Body indeed."
"If Junior Brother Meng remains single, his future is boundless."
Meng Jingzhou, hearing the discussions below, darkened in complexion, wishing they hadn't praised him at all.
When Lu Yang fell off the arena, he was caught by the Sword Washing Pool, after climbing out, he pointed towards the top of a nearby mountain, slightly puzzled.
"Why is everyone flying out, has something big happened?"
The Great Sects, as if with a collective intuition, all flew out from the hospitality hall, swarming like bees towards the Seek Dao Sect's gates.
It didn't take long for some curious senior brothers to find out what was happening.
"It's the Sect Leader who has returned; all the elders and sect leaders from the Great Sects have gone to welcome the Sect Leader."
Meng Jingzhou looked out, observing the individuals from the Great Sects with their gleaming weapons, which didn't at all look like a welcome for Daoist Buyu.
Lu Yang kept silent, presuming that his master must have heard about Vast Sea Daoist Lord still being alive and had hurried back to pay respects to the ancestor.
But the master seemed to have forgotten, he was not the only one who wished to meet the Vast Sea Daoist Lord.

chapters.title: Chapter 739 - 738: Daoist Buyu Returns to the Sect
chapters.content:
The Seek Dao Sect was not far away when two sneaky figures approached it.
"Big brother, as a member of the Demon Race, can I really enter the Seek Dao Sect?" The Clan Leader of the Gold Clan had a worried frown on his face, looking anxious.
Daoist Buyu stroked his beard, pondering for a moment, "Our sect has always treated everyone equally, regardless of whether they are from the Demon Race or Human Race. However, I'm not sure about the Vast Sea Daoist Lord; maybe he doesn't take kindly to the Demon Race."
"In that case, hide here. I'll go ahead and scout the path."
"Be careful, Big Brother."
"Don't worry, I've been roaming the jianghu for so many years, when have I ever encountered an accident?"
Daoist Buyu, who now looked different than his usual untidy appearance, was dressed in a clean and graceful Daoist robe, his hair bun neat, with a few loose beard strands fluttering in the wind.
Daoist Buyu stepped steadily towards the gate of the mountain.
Soon, under the watchful eye of the Gold Clan Leader, Daoist Buyu was discovered by the visiting Great Sects. The sect members poured out of the Seek Dao Sect in droves, shouting as they gave chase to Daoist Buyu.
Daoist Buyu fled in an embarrassing scramble, narrowly escaping capture several times.
The Gold Clan Leader shivered at the sight, feeling that the Human Race cultivators were even more ferocious than their Demon Race. While frightened, he couldn't help but be touched—his big brother had used himself as bait to lure away danger and protect his safety; recognizing him as a brother was not a mistake.
"Big Brother is truly loyal."
"When I get back, I'll speak to Little Ancestor and see if our families can form an alliance. With the Vast Sea Daoist Lord and Little Ancestor, two semi-immortals overseeing things, it shouldn't be hard to maintain a top ten position in the struggle of the Great Era."
...
"Buyu, the Old Thief, if you have the guts, stop running!" Each one of the cultivators at the Body Integration Realm visiting the Seek Dao Sect had a deep-seated grudge against Daoist Buyu.
Although they didn't get to see the legendary Vast Sea Daoist Lord on this trip, seeing Daoist Buyu was also a trip well made.
"You dare chase me? Be careful that the Vast Sea Ancestor doesn't settle scores with you afterwards!" While Daoist Buyu was in hasty flight, he didn't forget to intimidate everyone.
Daoist Buyu felt that his luck had been really poor for the past half-year, plagued by continuous misfortune, being found and chased time and again. Now even at the doorstep of the Sect, he still encountered so many acquaintances.
"Should I pay a visit to Buddhism?"
Daoist Buyu hesitated for a moment, but thinking of his second disciple Ye Zijin's reputation in the Buddha Country as "like the passing of Buddha," he figured Buddhism probably wouldn't bless him, his master.
A flash of sword light whisked past him, and Daoist Buyu instantly snapped back to attention, "First, I need to focus on escaping. I'll think about luck later."
"Unite man and sword!"
Daoist Buyu uttered lightly and merged into one with his sword. The sword transformed into a beam of light, moving at an ultimate speed.
"One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand Swords!"
The sword flickered, turning into thousands upon thousands of swords. Each one's length, style, pattern, and even the tassel were identical to the original. Even if one used Spiritual Sense to investigate, they couldn't determine which one was the initial sword.
Daoist Buyu was hiding among the swords.
"Open the Heavenly Eye!"
"Heavenly Eye, reveal thyself!"
"All causality lies within the circle!"
"Demon-Reflecting Mirror!"
"As visible as a fire in the dark!"
All the cultivators showed off their divine abilities, determined to catch Daoist Buyu.
Unfortunately for them, Daoist Buyu was not so easily captured. His method of escape was based on Swordsmanship, further refined with hints from "The Ancestor of Thieves," combined with his own insights. Without someone at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, nobody should dream of catching him.
...
"My master sure is popular," Lu Yang stood at the gate of the mountain, remarking as he watched the chaos. Third Senior Sister Gan Tian stood beside him, while countless flying swords whirled through the air, dazzling even Fairy Eternity who praised Daoist Buyu's talent.
The disciples of the Seek Dao Sect and various other great sects had all gathered here, their heads swiveling left and right, up and down, following the swarm of flying swords.
Their elders chased after Daoist Buyu, and regardless of whether they caught up or not, they wouldn't be able to return to the Seek Dao Sect; Lan Ting and the others couldn't continue fighting either, as continuing would soon leave them unable to find their master.
Among the four groups of combat, only the group consisting of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had determined a winner—it was still an internal squabble.
Taking advantage of the moment of watching the battle, Meng Jingzhou pointed at his shiny bald head, "Old Lu, why don't you use your Eternity Technique?"
Lu Yang activated the Eternity Technique, his large hand clasped on Meng Jingzhou's head, and miraculously, hair began to grow—it truly was as if an immortal had touched his head, granting him lifelong growth.
The flying swords flew farther and farther away, and Qiu Jin'an and the others also followed to a distant place, until only a few small dots could be seen.
"Then, this is where we part ways." Bai Ming and the others hurried to say their goodbyes, following in the shadows of their masters.
The disciples of the Seek Dao Sect waited at the gate for about a quarter of an hour when the disheveled Daoist Buyu returned to the sect on a flying sword.
It was unclear whether the dirt on him was from being captured and beaten on the ground or from escaping through the sky amidst a barrage of attacks.
But in any case, he had returned safely, more or less.
"Hahaha, there's no need for such a welcome, everyone disperse," said Daoist Buyu, waving his hand as if the disheveled state was not his own.
After all, Daoist Buyu was the sect leader, and his authority still stood. When he said for people to disperse, they dispersed, without any warm greeting.
"Gan Tian has become a Unification True Monarch, not bad, not bad at all. It seems the journey to the Demon Territory has been quite fruitful," Daoist Buyu said, slightly surprised by Gan Tian's advancement speed. He had estimated that Gan Tian would need another two or three years to reach the Unification Realm.
This meant there were unexpected gains during the trip to the Demon Territory.
"Little Lu has reached the mid-stage Nascent Soul, and so has Little Meng," Daoist Buyu clicked his tongue in wonder. They truly were seeds of the Great Era—he thought he had cultivated quickly, but the young generation was even faster.
"By the way, did the Phoenix Ancestor visit our sect?" Daoist Buyu asked, causing Lu Yang's body to stiffen.
"Why do you ask, master?"
"Some time ago, the Phoenix Ancestor brought 'Dragon and Phoenix Change' to me and even gave me a beating. I was thinking that I didn't leave my name on it, so I guessed someone must have told the Phoenix Ancestor about it."
Lu Yang laughed awkwardly, "The Phoenix Ancestor has eyes and ears everywhere, maybe she figured it out by using the law of causality."
"Is that so? I also heard that the Phoenix Ancestor claims to be from our Heavenly Court Sect, what's that about?"
Just as Lu Yang was grappling with how to explain this to his master, Meng Jingzhou eagerly stepped in, "Put simply, Old Lu awakened the sleeping Phoenix Ancestor, and the Phoenix Ancestor now acknowledges Lu Yang as her senior brother."
"?"
Clearly, such a simplistic explanation was beyond Daoist Buyu's comprehension.
Daoist Buyu temporarily skipped over the things he found difficult to understand and asked eagerly, "What about the Vast Sea Daoist Lord? Is he really still alive?"
"Not only is the Vast Sea Daoist Lord alive, but there's also another ancestor who is still among the living."
"Who is it?" Daoist Buyu thought about all the ancestors but couldn't recall an ancestor who should still be alive.
"Daoist Xiantian. By chance, when Old Meng and I were out on a mission, we encountered Daoist Xiantian, who had started over after disbanding his cultivation. We brought him back with us."
Daoist Buyu was silent for a moment, "Is there anything else I'm not aware of?"
Lu Yang thought for a while, counting on his fingers, "Nothing much else, just that Old Meng and I encountered the Void Venerate and the Nightmare Supreme while we were out. Seeing we couldn't win, we asked Eldest Senior Sister for help."
"Then there's the Master of All Laws, who led the Great Yu Alliance. They set their sights on the immortal sword I had, planning to sneak into the sect and rob it, but we caught them all in one swoop."
"I reckon most of the Great Yu Cultivators are now in our Captive Peak, leaving hardly a few outside."
Daoist Buyu was silent for an even longer time. He knew about the Void Venerate and the Master of All Laws but had no idea these things were related to Lu Yang.
Living for two thousand years, the things he caused were nothing compared to his young disciple's gains in a single year.
"Little Lu, have you considered taking over as sect leader now?"

chapters.title: Chapter 740 - 739: The Spring and Autumn Brush Technique
chapters.content:
Lu Yang shook his head like a rattle-drum, firmly rejecting his master's suggestion.
Having seen Fairy Eternity act as the Acting Sect Master for three days and three months, one could tell that being a Sect Leader was no leisurely position. It seemed more appropriate to suggest that Eldest Senior Sister, who is highly respected and academically exceptional, take on the role instead.
Daoist Buyu was quite relieved. He hadn't expected his young disciple to be so steadfast in his Daoist heart, unmoved even by such an astronomical chance to inherit the Sect Leader's position.
"Is Xiao Zhi around?"
"Eldest Senior Sister is currently interrogating Master of All Laws and a few others whose names we don't even know at Captive Peak. Would you like me to call her out?"
Daoist Buyu breathed a sigh of relief that she wasn't there, "No no, I was just asking casually."
Although he had been quite honest during this period, he always felt an inexplicable sense of guilt whenever he saw his eldest disciple.
After returning to the Sect, Daoist Buyu saw that his third and fourth disciples had made significant progress in their cultivation and was very happy.
"I wonder when the five of us will be able to reunite. It's been a hundred years since your second Senior Brother has come back."
"Your second Senior Brother caused such a stir in Buddha Country that even I was implicated, to the point where the followers of Buddhism look at me with disfavor."
Daoist Buyu shook his head gently. Oh, what a disciple, causing trouble and implicating the Sect. How many times had he taught him, to hide his identity when causing trouble outside, yet he never seemed to remember the most stressed points.
However, on the flip side, since the second Senior Brother caused trouble outside and never returned to Seek Dao Sect, in some sense, he was also keeping the trouble away from the Sect.
Buddha Country still often sends letters to Seek Dao Sect, hoping they will bring Ye Zijin back as soon as possible.
Every time, Daoist Buyu fobs them off with excuses like "A sovereign's command may be disobeyed far from home."
Lu Yang thought to himself that the dislike the Buddhists had for his master probably had little to do with his second Senior Brother.
Regarding this second Senior Brother, whom Lu Yang had only seen in portraits, he had heard many legends about him.
Always spouting cryptic yin and yang aphorisms, the second Senior Brother had caused incidents like revealing high-ranking Buddhist monks breaking their precepts, vigorously promoting the practice of 'joyous' Zen cultivation, and even pretending to be Buddha statues to enjoy offerings. These minor issues were not worth mentioning.
Beyond that, the second Senior Brother had suggested to many high-ranking monks that they learn the Phoenix clan's nirvana technique, so that they could gain numerous relics and live another life after self-immolation, thereby providing a continuous stream of relics for Buddha Country, benefiting greatly.
The second Senior Brother also advanced a more progressive theory based on the Buddhist advocacy of liberating living beings to accumulate virtue: "Giving birth is also a form of liberating life," encouraging monks to have more children to accumulate virtue.
However, the conservative thinking of the high-ranking monks in Buddha Country could not accept the second Senior Brother's advanced ideas, and they not only rejected his proposals but also sent people to capture him numerous times.
Luckily, the second Senior Brother had learned from Daoist Buyu the art of escaping, allowing him to mix in Buddha Country without harm.
Lu Yang had also heard that some pessimistic monks believed the birth of the second Senior Brother signaled the coming of the 'Degenerate Age,' giving him the reputation of being 'the death of Buddha.'
According to what Fairy Eternity, a founder of Buddhism, explained, the term 'Degenerate Age' was a cool-sounding phrase she came up with.
"Your second Senior Brother is also a cultivation genius. If it weren't for Xiao Zhi, he would have been the most talented cultivator of his generation. Unfortunately, he was born at the wrong time."
"By the way, where is our ancestral master, Daoist Xiantian?" As the Sect Leader, Daoist Buyu felt it was necessary to pay respects to the founder of Seek Dao Sect.
"I'll go look for him." Lu Yang had no idea where the ancestral master had gone.
After searching around, Lu Yang found Daoist Xiantian eating skewers in a barbecue restaurant.
The people at the barbecue shop, upon seeing Lu Yang arrive, thought he was there for an inspection.
Lu Yang quickly persuaded Master Gao and the others to stand down, "It's all right, carry on with what you were doing. I'm here to find him."
"Ancestral Master, my teacher said he would like to meet with you."
"Your teacher? The current Sect Leader of the Seek Dao Sect?"
"Yes."
Daoist Xiantian quickly slurped up two mouthfuls of his food, "Then let's go."
Lu Yang invited Daoist Xiantian to the summit of Sky Gate Mountain where Daoist Buyu had been waiting for a long time. Upon meeting, he immediately kowtowed and paid his respects.
"The current Sect Leader of the Seek Dao Sect, Ye Wanli, pays respects to the Ancestral Master."
"Such a heavy courtesy is undeserved. Please, rise. And besides, I am now just an ordinary disciple of the Seek Dao Sect, so you don't need to treat me this way."
Daoist Buyu's eyes lit up, "Then Ancestral Master, do you lack a teacher? What do you think of me?"
Lu Yang felt that Daoist Buyu truly was cut from the same cloth as the Eighth Elder, thinking along the same lines.
He kindly reminded, "The Ancestor Han Hai has already taken him as a disciple."
Daoist Buyu: "..."
"Right, Ancestral Master, could you tell me about the early days when you founded the Seek Dao Sect? To tell you the truth, I am a writer who has always been committed to promoting the Seek Dao Sect. You hold first-hand historical information about the Seek Dao Sect, so let's join forces. Together we could further augment the renown of our Sect."
Daoist Xiantian laughed heartily upon hearing this, "That's a good thing." He had a favorable impression of Daoist Buyu because the current achievements of the Seek Dao Sect were no doubt greatly influenced by this Sect Leader's efforts.
"When it comes to how the Seek Dao Sect was established, we need to go back to 120,000 years ago. According to the customs of that time, cultivators who had reached the Void Refinement Stage would seek a stable and safe cultivation spot, either by joining a sect or by founding one themselves. I chose the latter."
"The Heavenly Strategy Sect was known for its highly accurate divinations. So, I spent one hundred thousand Spirit Stones to ask them to find me a feng shui treasure land. They told me that those Spirit Stones were not taken by them, but accepted by heaven, as a gesture of sincerity.
After telling me the location of the treasure land, they also advised that I must arrive at the designated time, or it would affect my fortune."
"Unfortunately, it was dark at that time, my cultivation level fluctuated greatly, making flying difficult. Furthermore, I had a tendency to get lost. If this continued, I would surely not reach the treasure land on time, so I asked a local farmer for directions."
"The farmer pointed me in a direction, and by following his advice, I managed to reach the treasure land just as dawn was breaking."
"After the sect was successfully established, thanks to my good reputation and favorable conditions I offered, many cultivators at the Void Refinement Stage were willing to join my sect, and a lot of promising young disciples also sought tutelage under me, which gave the Seek Dao Sect its initial scale."
Daoist Buyu was nodding and making notes the whole time,
"At the end of the era of Great Yu, the world was shrouded in darkness, and people lived in fear. Daoist Xiantian, seeking stability and safety, decided to establish a sect."
"Daoist Xiantian, with a sincere heart, consulted heaven, and heaven pointed out the way ahead, stressing that time was of the essence and action must be taken promptly."
"The time before dawn is the darkest. Following the will of heaven, Daoist Xiantian went through numerous difficulties. Not only was his cultivation level affected, but he also lost his way. Fortunately, with the help of the common people, he was able to overcome these challenges and finally reach the location indicated by heaven."
"With the establishment of the Seek Dao Sect by Daoist Xiantian, the dark world witnessed the light of dawn. At that time, many people of like minds, disturbed by the turmoil in the world and influenced by the personal charisma of Daoist Xiantian, willingly joined the Seek Dao Sect, which grew increasingly more powerful..."
Having finished writing, Daoist Buyu looked up at Daoist Xiantian, "Ancestral Master, please continue?"

chapters.title: Chapter 741 - 740: One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand Swords
chapters.content:
Daoist Xiantian was immersed in memories dating back a hundred and twenty thousand years, while Daoist Buyu held a writing brush, recording the memoirs of Daoist Xiantian. If one didn't look at the contents Daoist Buyu was recording, it would seem like a harmonious picture of the young and the old.
Daoist Xiantian talked from dawn till dusk, not stopping until he had fully digested the kebabs he had eaten at noon.
Lu Yang and Gan Tian took a brief glance at the things their master was recording with their Spiritual Sense. They worried that Daoist Xiantian wouldn't be able to accept Daoist Buyu's overly advanced ideas of propaganda and might do something outrageous, such as an ancestor beating his unworthy descendants. In tacit understanding, they decided not to mention this.
And it's not that what the master was recording was incorrect, as at the very least, each sentence was indeed spoken by Daoist Xiantian, only perhaps slightly embellished.
"It seems our Second Senior Brother learned the art of twisting truth from Master," Third Senior Sister communicated through Spiritual Sense.
All the bad habits of Daoist Buyu were learned by the Second Senior Brother, no wonder he had such a notorious reputation in the Western Buddha Country.
"If Second Senior Brother learned it from Master, where did Master learn his skills from?"
"From the Eighth Elder. Isn't there a saying that Master was brought up by the Eighth Elder from infancy?"
"What about the Eighth Elder, then? Our Grandmaster does not seem to have such a character."
"Self-taught genius."
"Truly gifted talent."
Daoist Xiantian didn't have his Spiritual Sense yet, as he had not begun cultivating, but seeing Daoist Buyu rapidly recording, filling several pages densely, he knew that the current Sect Leader had captured everything he said. He nodded in great satisfaction.
"Keep up the good work, I have high hopes for you."
Rarely did anyone not mind his ramblings and was willing to listen to his historical accounts, which put Daoist Xiantian in an excellent mood.
Daoist Xiantian found Daoist Buyu increasingly pleasing to the eye, of course, it could also be because they both had a knack for getting lost.
Daoist Buyu, feeling recognized by the ancestor, immediately declared, "Rest assured, Grandmaster, I will make sure to propagate the glorious deeds of establishing the Seek Dao Sect!"
"Very good, very good, with people like you in the sect, how could it not flourish!"
"By the way, Grandmaster, do you know the whereabouts of Vast Sea Daoist Lord?" Daoist Buyu hadn't finished his round of inquiries.
Daoist Xiantian shook his head: "I don't know."
The Seek Dao Sect was too vast, and without a way to contact Vast Sea Daoist Lord, nobody could find him.
"Your first disciple and the previous Sect Leader might be able to find Vast Sea," Daoist Xiantian said.
Daoist Buyu grinned sheepishly and didn't pick up on the hint, for everyone knew that Xiao Zhi and his own master definitely knew where Vast Sea Daoist Lord was.
"It's getting late, I should head back," Daoist Xiantian said while yawning. After talking for the better half of the day, he was tired.
"Let me walk you out," said Daoist Buyu warmly. He wasn't worried about revealing Daoist Xiantian's identity by doing so, as Daoist Xiantian's public identity was as the disciple of Vast Sea Daoist Lord, second in seniority only to the Sect Leader in the Seek Dao Sect.
After seeing off Daoist Xiantian, Daoist Buyu returned to Sky Gate Mountain: "Come on, tell me, what has happened since I last left?"
All the major events involving the Demon Territory and Semi-Immortals that Daoist Buyu had heard about on his way were related to Lu Yang. Now that he had the chance to ask the person involved, he certainly wouldn't miss it.
When Daoist Buyu last returned, it was just after the sect's celebration had ended, and Lu Yang was only at the mid-stage of the Golden Core. Now, Lu Yang had reached the mid-stage of the Nascent Soul. Many things had happened in between.
As he had experienced it all personally, Lu Yang spoke in an endless stream.
As he spoke, Lu Yang began feeling that something was amiss: "Wait, wasn't it just over a year since I advanced from mid-stage Golden Core to mid-stage Nascent Soul? How did so much happen in such a short time?"
Daoist Buyu was delighted with the storytelling material, much richer than the experiences of the Grandmaster.
The Grandmaster's experiences were all about the difficulties of establishing the sect and strategizing against cultivators of the same realm.
Looking at Lu Yang's situation, although he was only at the Nascent Soul Stage, the enemies he provoked started at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, and with some luck, he could even attract the attention of a couple of Semi-Immortals.
With Lu Yang's trouble-causing ability, Great Yu would have collapsed twenty thousand years earlier if he had been alive back then.
After all, the Imperial Teacher of Great Yu was only at the level of Transcendance Tribulation.
"...Master of All Laws just suddenly kowtowed like that, I was quite surprised too," Lu Yang naturally could not reveal the matter of Fairy Eternity, so he insisted it was a coincidence.
However, to Daoist Buyu, whether it was a coincidence or not was not important.
"That's enough. Rest for a day, tomorrow I will teach you the sword technique 'One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand.'
Daoist Buyu had wanted to teach this move the last time he returned to the sect, but Lu Yang's cultivation level was not sufficient. This technique required being at the Divinity Transformation Stage, and now Lu Yang had just qualified.
...
In the early morning, filled with energy, Lu Yang was dressed in his training clothes, holding the Green Peak Sword in his hand.
"Originally, I wanted to teach you the integration of human and sword and 'One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand,' but since you're not willing to learn the integration, let it be," he said.
"You've already met the preliminary conditions: the sword follows your heart, your mind is clear, your spirit blends with the sword, action and stillness are as one."
Normally, only swordsmanship geniuses at the Divinity Transformation Stage could achieve these four realms, but Lu Yang, with his Sword Spirit Root, had already touched upon these realms while pondering swordsmanship.
"With a clear heart, banish stray thoughts, focus on swordsmanship, drive the Sword Qi out of your body to materialize, and fuse your Spiritual Sense with Sword Qi to achieve the free differentiation of Sword Qi, producing thousands of Sword Qi with a single thought," he explained.
"Like this."
Daoist Buyu extended his index finger, and a stream of Sword Qi burst forth. With a gentle shake of his finger, the illusory shadow left by the Sword Qi in the air turned into countless streams of Sword Qi. Lu Yang watched, astounded, never imagining Sword Qi could be used in this way.
"Sit in meditation to calm your mind, be relaxed and natural. Hold firm with your hands, look straight with your eyes, let your Qi circulate the microcosmic orbit endlessly..."
Daoist Buyu then instructed the heart mantra of the sword technique.
Lu Yang's talent in swordsmanship was in no way inferior to magic skills, and he grasped it instantly.
With a whoosh, accompanied by hundreds of Sword Qi, the Green Peak Sword was unsheathed, sounding like a dragon's chant.
"Go!"
With a light shout from Lu Yang, the Green Peak Sword soared into the sky, followed by hundreds of Sword Qi, as if a mighty army was galloping across the heavens, with the Green Peak Sword as the general commanding the troops!
With a thought from Lu Yang, the hundreds of Sword Qi solidified into hundreds of Green Peak Swords.
"Success!"
Lu Yang brought his two fingers together and pressed downward. Hundreds of Green Peak Swords fell like rain, with a ripping sound through the air, tearing up the grass, toppling trees, and pockmarking the ground.
If a cultivator at the early stage of Spirit Transformation had been standing below, they would've been turned into a hedgehog by now.
Lu Yang was delighted. In just half a day's time, he had learned 'One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand,' a technique that had stumped countless swordsmanship geniuses.
Daoist Buyu nodded in satisfaction. His little disciple learned sword techniques even faster than he did back in the day.
Neither the master nor the disciple noticed that a puppet was quietly watching them from the shadows.
"Since the Green Peak Sword can do it..."
Lu Yang had a new idea. He put away the Green Peak Sword and took out the Sword Washing Pool.
"Let the Qi circulate the microcosmic orbit endlessly... Go!"
The Sword Washing Pool soared into the sky, multiplying into hundreds high above, darkening the sky like dense clouds.
"Fall!"
The Sword Washing Pool fell like a shower of meteors, with an unavoidable sword intent, crashing to the ground, denting the solid earth several inches deep. A cultivator at the mid-stage of Divinity Transformation would likely be killed by this barrage of sword technique.
"Indeed, the power of the Sword Washing Pool is greater!"
Daoist Buyu looked at the Sword Washing Pool with a puzzled expression.
"Why does this thing look so familiar?"

chapters.title: Chapter 742 - 741 Sect Civil War
chapters.content:
"Isn't this the Sword Washing Pool I often use?" Daoist Buyu thought to himself no wonder it looked so familiar; as a youth, he frequently used the Sword Washing Pool to cleanse the malevolent energy.
This was a treasure passed down through the generations of the Seek Dao Sect. Even the Grandmaster would often use the Sword Washing Pool to cleanse his malevolent energy, lest he accidentally kill Daoist Buyu in a fit of anger.
From this perspective, the Sword Washing Pool was indeed Daoist Buyu's lifesaver.
Seeing his master taking notice, Lu Yang felt quite embarrassed, "I was just inspired by the legends of you and Grandmaster, wanting to emulate you both, so I meditated beside the Sword Washing Pool to comprehend swordsmanship. It's probably because I was too close to the Sword Washing Pool that it became attached to me."
As if to confirm Lu Yang's words, the Sword Washing Pool joyfully flew a circle around Lu Yang.
"You're not wrong though, the Sword Washing Pool really is a very handy attacking magic artifact."
