The Sword Washing Pool was far more useful than the Green Peak Sword. Although the Green Peak Sword was an Immortal Sword, it had been sealed by the Eldest Senior Sister, making it just a sword matching Lu Yang's cultivation level when he used it.
The Sword Washing Pool was different, not only was its quality high, but it also had a mind connection with Lu Yangxin, making it as easy to use as one's own limbs.
Just like the 'One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand' in front of him, it pounded the ground into pits and dimples, its power immense.
"If you put it that way, the Sword Washing Pool is indeed quite useful." As a master of swordsmanship, Daoist Buyu also recognized the strength of the Sword Washing Pool.
It was a pity he wasn't fated to possess it, and so Lu Yang benefitted instead. He could only silently send his blessings.
"Come on, you have to practice your swordsmanship frequently to get familiar with it. Try it a few more times."
Lu Yang nodded obediently and spurred the Sword Washing Pool into action. The sky once again was filled with Sword Washing Pools, casting Sky Gate Mountain's peak into darkness.
"One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand, fall!"
Boom—Boom—
With the success of the previous attempt, this time the casting was even smoother.
"Haha, Old Nine, I didn't think you'd actually teach disciples," the Grand Elder's hearty laughter came from the sky.
Daoist Buyu didn't appreciate the Grand Elder's words: "Go on, what do you mean by saying I still can teach disciples? Look at Xiao Zhi, Xiao Jin, Xiao Tian, and Xiao Yang, which isn't taught by me?"
The Grand Elder scoffed at Daoist Buyu's claim, "Enough, you talk as if Xiao Zhi's high cultivation level has anything to do with you."
As if it was agreed upon, shua shua shua, one after another Elder flew to Sky Gate Mountain, the Second Elder, Third Elder... even the rarely seen Sixth Elder showed up.
Once the Sixth Elder arrived, everyone tacitly switched to using Spiritual Sense for communication.
"It's been a long time since we brothers had gathered together like this, why not take this chance to practice a bit?" the Grand Elder suggested with a smile.
Daoist Buyu's face darkened, "Last time you said that, you guys ganged up on me and beat me half to death, and afterward, you made me become the Sect Leader."
"That's where you're wrong, Old Nine. How many people covet the position of Sect Leader? The eight of us, out of consideration for our fellow sect members, reluctantly gave up our desire for the role and let you take it, and now you're blaming us."
Daoist Buyu chuckled, "I haven't been mixing in the jianghu for one day, how can I believe your nonsense."
"Don't worry, this time we'll exchange fairly, just like before, a casual practice, no dividing into sides, a chaotic battle among the nine of us."
"That's more like it."
The eight Elders and Daoist Buyu shared a smile, as if reminiscent of the halcyon days under the Grandmaster's tutelage.
"Let's have a round."
Nine renowned Integration Period cultivators from the present age commenced a battle atop Sky Gate Mountain, where Daoist Buyu's Swordsmanship, the Grand Elder's Dream Spells, Uncle Ba's Talismans, the Third Elder's Body Cultivation, the Fourth Elder's Confucian Cultivation, the Fifth Elder's Artifact Refining Technique, the Sixth Elder's Pure Immortal Body, the Seventh Elder's Alchemy, and the Eighth Elder's Array Method were all peerless, the pinnacle of achievement within their respective realms.
Although Daoist Buyu and the Grand Elder had already reached Half-Step Transcendance Tribulation Stage, the battlefield was unpredictable. When the nine of them made a move, victory wasn't guaranteed just by having a higher Cultivation Level.
The Elders rarely battled, so the Disciple of Dao Seeking Sect quickly chose the nearest distance to watch.
The battle of Integration level cultivators was earth-shattering; there was no need to watch from directly underneath, like Lu Yang did.
"Who do you guess will win?"
"The Sixth Elder's Pure Immortal Body can be immune to all magic skills. Within the realm of the Immortal Body, the Sixth Elder is invincible!"
"Though the Pure Immortal Body is powerful, it's not invincible."
"It should be the Grand Elder. I heard when he was young, he was a tough nut to crack. It was only in his later years that he began to cultivate his nature and character, digging around and building tombs against regulations."
"Yes, yes, I've heard from the elders in my family that the Grand Elder has quite a few enemies in Imperial City, starting with not a few Third Grade officials." The speaker was a Senior Brother who lived in Imperial City. Though his family wasn't as illustrious as the Meng Family, they were considered an influential family in Imperial City.
"If you put it that way, then our Sect Leader is stronger than the Grand Elder. The streets of Imperial City are filled with our Sect Leader's enemies."
"You underestimate our Sect Leader. It's not just the streets of Imperial City that are filled with enemies. Throughout the entire Cultivation World, whether it's the Central Continent or the Demon Territory and Buddha Country, just ask any cultivator who has lived for two thousand years—who doesn't have a grudge against our Sect Leader?"
"Why do I feel like you're taking pride in this?"
"Of course, I'm proud. Our Sect Leader, surrounded by enemies everywhere, can still hop around lively—that's called ability."
The nine Integration Period cultivators fought fiercely, each displaying Divine Abilities as if the heavens had split and the earth had shattered, creating a commotion far greater than when Lu Yang practiced his swordsmanship.
The hard land of Sky Gate Mountain was like mud before the Elders, easily manipulated. Trees collapsed as if swept away by a hurricane, uprooted and leaving not a blade of grass behind.
The Elders attacked the strongest, Daoist Buyu and the Grand Elder first, combining Array Methods with Talismans, Alchemy with Artifact Refining Techniques... But the two weren't easy targets. Their Swordsmanship and Dream Spells were mighty and unpredictable.
However, under the joint attack of the seven Elders, they eventually showed signs of fatigue and began to reveal flaws.
Just as the disciples were speculating about who the final victor might be, a Puppet soared into the sky and, like dumplings being dropped in a pot, slapped the Elders one by one down to the ground.
It was only with the Sixth Elder that the strikes were a bit softer.
The Elders and the Sect Leader, whose Cultivation Level could reach the heavens and penetrate the earth, were effortlessly defeated, falling to the ground in a pitiful state.
As they lifted their heads, they saw a Puppet standing before them, carrying a bunch of hoes and without a word, handing each one a hoe and pointing at the ravaged Sky Gate Mountain.
The message was clear: clean up the aftermath, or nobody leaves today.
Witnessing this scene, Lu Yang felt extremely relieved, fortunate that his low Cultivation Level didn't qualify him to participate in such a high-level battle.
The Puppet handed the last hoe to Lu Yang.
Lu Yang, recalling the scene when he executed 'One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand', silently took the hoe and joined the Elders in the leveling brigade.
…
Outside the Seek Dao Sect, the Gold Clan Leader was still anxiously waiting for news from Daoist Buyu.
"It's been a whole day. Why hasn't my elder brother sent any message? Is Seek Dao Sect too dangerous, not allowing me to enter?"
"Or has my elder brother forgotten about me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 743 - 742: Immortal
chapters.content:
Daoist Buyu was a cultivator with a firm spirit, and in order to meet the Vast Sea Daoist Lord, he stayed at the Seek Dao Sect for three whole days.
Unfortunately, Daoist Buyu's sincerity did not move the Vast Sea Daoist Lord, who never showed up.
Having no choice, Daoist Buyu had to abandon this idea and, after instructing Lu Yang for three days, drifted away.
Lu Yang, who held his teacher and the Dao in high regard, waved goodbye to Daoist Buyu at the mountain gate.
Once Daoist Buyu was some distance away from the mountain gate and the Body Integration cultivators who had been waiting there for days saw their opportunity, they swarmed him, determined to execute the old thief Buyu on the spot.
The scene was incredibly chaotic.
Lu Yang was still young and could not bear the sight of parting and death. He held back his tears, silently turned around, and chose not to watch what happened behind him.
When he returned to Sky Gate Mountain, Lu Yang saw his Eldest Senior Sister whom he hadn't seen for three days.
"Eldest Senior Sister, have you finished the interrogation?"
"It's finished. As I said before, the matters of the Fire Dynasty are dangerous, and you should not get involved."
The Eldest Senior Sister thought for a moment and felt that these words might not be enough to deter him, so she added, "Do you still remember the Time Termination Flower from the medicinal garden?"
Lu Yang nodded, as he certainly remembered the Little Medicinal King's Time Termination Flower, which was a very beautiful flower. Legend had it that it would bloom in its most beautiful state only when the world was ending and all living beings were in turmoil, even stopping time in its tracks.
"I've always wondered why, according to historical records, there were no great events that could be described as the end of the world and the turmoil of all living beings. Yet, when the ancestors of our sect found the Time Termination Flower, it had already bloomed."
"I originally thought the legend was wrong."
"That was until just now, when I went to the medicinal garden and asked the Time Termination Flower some questions. I finally confirmed that it indeed bloomed at the time of the Fire Dynasty's downfall."
"Of course, the flower itself does not know this."
"Do you understand? Only an Immortal can bring about the end of the world and the turmoil of all living beings, and it has to be a malevolent Immortal at that. This is not an existence you can afford to provoke."
Lu Yang nodded like a chick pecking at grains. With his weak constitution, he definitely wouldn't interfere with the affairs of the Fire Dynasty.
"By the way, Eldest Senior Sister, didn't you say a long time ago that there are no immortals in this world?" Lu Yang suddenly asked. This was something that Eldest Senior Sister had mentioned casually when he was in his first year at the Seek Dao Sect and had not yet reached the Foundation Establishment, while he was cultivating on Sky Gate Mountain.
There were talk of the Five Ancient Immortals, as well as the Imperial Teachers, Emperor Qian, and Emperor Yu, not to mention several Immortals. How could it be said that there are no immortals in the world?
"The 'Immortal' I was referring to is not a cultivator who has condensed a Dao Fruit."
"On this matter, Fairy Eternity should be able to understand."
"An Immortal is someone who does not age, does not die, does not get born, does not get extinguished, and has no limits to their lifespan. They roam freely between heaven and earth, not bound by any rule. These are the words from 'Words of the Saint' and represent the original definition of 'Immortal.' This came about even before Immortal Jiuchong and others."
Fairy Eternity emerged from within Lu Yang's body, exemplifying her point, "Miss Yun is right; this is the original definition of an Immortal. Later, we gradually figured out the 'Dao Fruit Outline' and 'Dao Fruit,' and we started to call those who condensed a Dao Fruit as Immortals."
Lu Yang instinctively nodded, then suddenly realized there was something off in Fairy Eternity's words, "I see... wait a minute, Fairy, did you just say 'we figured out the Dao Fruit Outline and Dao Fruit'?"
"Yes, the Dao Fruit Outline was something we of the Five Ancient Immortals created."
"You remember that the Time Immortal's true body is the Firmament Tree, right? His power is equivalent to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage."
"Why do you think he was at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage when I was in the Qi Cultivation Stage, still at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage when I reached the Nascent Soul Stage, and still the same when I myself reached the Transcendance Tribulation Stage? Do you think he was unwilling to obtain the Dao Fruit Outline?"
Lu Yang vaguely realized some earth-shattering possibility, but still continued along with Fairy Eternity's implication, "Why is that?"
Fairy Eternity chuckled, "Because he alone couldn't derive the Dao Fruit Outline. Only when we reached the Transcendance Tribulation Stage and joined our efforts were we able to derive the Dao Fruit Outline."
"Of course, it was mainly thanks to me. Immortals like Yingtian Immortal were just freeloaders."
"Back then, when we carved out the Dao Fruit Outline and the Dao Fruit, when it came to naming it, we thought the title 'Immortal' was quite fitting, so we named those cultivators who possessed a Dao Fruit as Immortals."
Lu Yang took a sharp intake of breath, so Fairy Eternity, you're one of the founding figures of the cultivation system.
And her naming skills weren't bad either, Lu Yang thought Fairy Eternity might suggest names like 'Invincible Stage' or something of the sort.
Fairy Eternity continued, "Based on the original definition of 'Immortal', indeed, no one in the world can truly be called an Immortal."
Lu Yang decided that he should probably show more respect to Fairy Eternity going forward, considering she was not only a founding figure of the Dao Fruit but also the founder of Buddhism.
"Oh, the name 'Immortal' was Yingtian Immortal's idea. My suggestions of 'Invincible Stage' and 'Bean Stage' were unanimously rejected by them."
Fairy Eternity stomped her feet in frustration, "Since I made such a major contribution, what's wrong with naming the realm after me? And they even opposed it, so infuriating!"
Lu Yang: "..."
Fairy, you could've left out those last two sentences.
...
Being someone who had seen much of the world with Fairy Eternity, Lu Yang soon calmed his inner turmoil after learning such shocking history, and he chose to continue his cultivation methodically.
He was still far from becoming an Immortal himself, so he didn't dwell on such distant matters.
Time flies during cultivation, and in the blink of an eye, an hour had gone by with Lu Yang cultivating.
"Old Lu, want to go out and play?" Meng Jingzhou, who couldn't stand to see Lu Yang cultivate, came to Sky Gate Mountain full of excitement, urging Lu Yang to go out and have fun, which was utterly annoying.
Fortunately, Lu Yang's mind was as steady as an old Buddha in meditation, unswayed by external influences.
"Let's go to the East Sea."
"Let's do it." Lu Yang sprang up from the big rock.
His resolve was not firm, swayed by Meng Jingzhou's incitement, a promising cultivator thus fell from grace, a situation that was truly lamentable.
"But why did you suddenly think of going to the East Sea?" Lu Yang asked puzzledly, reasoning there must be a motive behind it.
"Isn't it because Old Ma comes from the dragon horse clan and his hometown is in the East Sea? He wanted to visit his relatives, and of course, I was all for it."
"I was thinking, if Old Ma is going to the East Sea, then the two of us could take this opportunity to go together, especially since neither of us have ever been there."
"Good brother." Lu Yang was very moved. When it came to going out and having fun, Old Meng never forgot him.
In reality, Meng Jingzhou had another reason for going to the East Sea.
Lately, people had been calling him the strongest bachelor and encouraging him to stay single, saying his prospects were boundless. He couldn't handle such flattery due to his thin skin, so he wanted to escape somewhere quiet.
The East Sea was a perfect place, far away and without acquaintances.
There was no need to mention this to Lu Yang; it would only lead to more praise from him, defeating the purpose of leaving.
"Just the two of us?"
"I was about to call Junior Sister Tao and the others. After all, it's rare for us to travel far."

chapters.title: Chapter 744 - 743: Sealing Bloodline
chapters.content:
Tao Yaoye, upon hearing that she could go to the East Sea with Lu Yang, happily agreed.
Li Haoran too, upon hearing that he could go out, immediately agreed, fearing that Lu Yang might change his mind.
"To the East Sea, yes, yes!" Man Gu's eyes lit up, but then he remembered something and showed a look of difficulty.
"What's the matter?" Lu Yang asked.
"Aren't there many from the Sea Clan in the East Sea? You know about my bloodline, Brother Lu. Although it becomes extremely powerful when fighting the Sea Clan, it also enrages them."
"I'm worried that as soon as I go to the East Sea, before I even do anything, I'll be surrounded by the Sea Clan."
Lu Yang remembered the blessing that Fairy Eternity had brought to the Ancient Barbarian Tribe.
"Indeed, that's a problem... Fairy, do you have any good solutions?" Lu Yang thought for a moment and decided that asking the chief culprit directly would be quicker.
"Sure, you can just use the Invincible Nascent Soul and beat all the Sea Clan that surround you." Fairy Eternity giggled and waved her little fists as if there were invisible enemies in the Spiritual Space.
"...Is there a more peaceful way?" Lu Yang has always advocated avoiding violence whenever possible.
"I, as the Fairy, can condescend to enhance the effect of the Barbarian tribe youngster's bloodline so that even members of the Sea Clan at the Body Integration Realm would fear him, ensuring that the five of you can strut around the East Sea. Although this will attract the hatred of those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage of the Sea Clan, how many of them could there be in East Sea?
You won't encounter them," she said casually.
"...Could we choose another method?" Lu Yang heard that there were the Dragon Palace and nine great Sea Clans in the East Sea, at least ten at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
And he knew that a colossal entity like the Dragon Palace couldn't possibly have only one person at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
Fairy Eternity said reluctantly, "Then there's only the seal left. Temporarily seal the Ancient Barbarian Tribe's bloodline and remove the seal when you leave the East Sea."
Lu Yang was overjoyed. "Let's go with that method!"
Fairy Eternity then drew an extremely abstruse Array Method.
"What is this?"
"A sealing Array Method. You don't have the Cultivation Level to draw it, so have your Second Elder do it."
"Alright then."
The group found Uncle Ba at the entrance of the herb garden. Uncle Ba was lying on a recliner, his face covered with a leaf as big as a hand, humming a cozy tune. Two leaves, each half the height of a person, hung above his head, gently swaying as makeshift fans.
"Uncle Ba, we need a little help from you."
Uncle Ba opened his eyes and took the leaf off his face. His gaze, filled with earnestness, made him somewhat uncomfortable as he looked at Lu Yang and the others.
"Speak plainly, don't look at me like that."
"We're planning to go to the East Sea for a couple of days. Man Gu's bloodline tends to attract hostility easily. We've found an Array Method in ancient texts that can seal bloodlines, so we've come to ask for your help."
"So that's it, then it's easy. What does the Array Method look like?"
"Right here." Lu Yang took out the Array Method copied from the Spiritual Space.
Uncle Ba took it, clicking his tongue in wonder: "It's truly an ancient Array Method, ingeniously designed."
"Wait a moment, it will be ready in an hour." For an unfamiliar Array Method, Uncle Ba had to study it thoroughly before he could draw it. The layers, the order of the strokes, how much spiritual essence to use... these were all areas that needed research and experimentation.
An hour later, Uncle Ba asked Man Gu to lift his shirt, gave him a slap on the stomach, and an ancient seal was left on it.
"Done."
"Speaking of which, I've sealed bloodlines for someone before, but not as sophisticated as the Array Method Lu Yang found."
"Who have you sealed for?" Lu Yang asked curiously.
"It was a friend I made when I was young, from the East Sea Dragon Palace, named Ao Ran."
"You have a friend from the Dragon Palace?" Lu Yang and the others were surprised. They had thought they would be confronting the world as enemies like in the Demon Territory, and were prepared for it.
Uncle Ba glared at Lu Yang and the others disapprovingly, "What's that supposed to mean? What's wrong with having a friend in the Dragon Palace? The one with enemies all over the world is Old Nine."
Lu Yang gave an 'oh', realizing that it was similar to the situation in the Demon Territory; his psychological preparations hadn't been in vain.
"He has the purest Long Clan bloodline. He asked me to seal most of his bloodline so that the strength he displayed outwardly would be weaker."
"Why would he do that?" Lu Yang and the others were puzzled.
"So that when someone annoys him, he can grimace and say, 'You forced me to unlock the seal'."
Lu Yang: "..."
"Be careful when you go to the East Sea. Although the Dragon Palace keeps a check on things, the situation in the East Sea is quite chaotic."
"Quite chaotic?"
"The East Sea is home not only to the Sea Clan but also the Human race. The Sea Clan lives in the sea, while the Human race lives on the islands. Due to historical grudges, disputes occur frequently between them, and since it's beyond the jurisdiction of Great Xia, their fights tend to be unrestrained."
Not only Lu Yang, even Meng Jingzhou was hearing about this for the first time; they were both unfamiliar with the East Sea.
Only Li Haoran, with memories from his past life, had a better understanding of the East Sea, especially since the Jiuyou Sect had expanded their business into the East Sea or conducted secret transactions there. Great Xia's reach didn't extend to the East Sea, and the smuggling business that the Jiuyou Sect was currently engaged in had been expanded by Qin Haoran during his time as master.
One of the reasons Qin Haoran expanded the overseas business was so that if a creditor ever came knocking, he could flee to the East Sea.
Unfortunately, this leader of the Demon Path was chained by love and trapped himself in Great Xia.
Uncle Ba kindly reminded them, "By the way, none of you have been underwater before, and I'm guessing you're not great swimmers. You'd better exchange for a Water-Repelling Pearl before going to the East Sea. The Task Hall has them, and they'll help you move freely underwater."
Unlike the Diving Spell, which Fairy Eternity used to drain the water from both friend and foe, the Water-Repelling Pearl truly repelled water.
"Can I ask what my master did in the East Sea?"
"Oh, a lot of things, like having an ambiguous relationship with the Dragon Palace princess or something."
Lu Yang was shocked, not expecting his master, now aged and decrepit, to have had his dashing moments when he was young: "My master had an ambiguous relationship with the Dragon Palace princess?!"
"Not so much ambiguous, just that Old Nine, when he was young and needed to save someone, required a treasure from the Dragon Palace. That treasure was the princess's favorite magic artifact, hidden inside her body. Old Nine shrank himself, sneaked into the princess's stomach, and stole the treasure. When it was discovered later, Old Nine started calling the Dragon Palace princess 'mommy'."
Lu Yang: "..."
The five thanked Uncle Ba and headed to the Task Hall, where each exchanged for a Water-Repelling Pearl. The pearls were pricey, but the five had accumulated a lot of Contribution Points from missions, so the cost was not a concern.
The Senior Sister at the Task Hall saw that Lu Yang and the rest had all exchanged for Water-Repelling Pearls and hurriedly called Dai Bufan.
Dai Bufan thought Lu Yang was about to lead a major operation with the four others, but upon hearing they were only accompanying Old Ma to visit relatives and would swing by the East Sea for a couple of days, he breathed a sigh of relief.
"Go, go, have a good time."

chapters.title: Chapter 745 - 744 Searching for the Elixir of Immortality
chapters.content:
Five people crammed into the carriage, and Old Ma was eager to return home. Normally, a trip to the East Sea would take four to five days, but this time, it only took them half a day to reach the Great Xia border, Ming City.
After verifying their identities, the five of them entered the city and handled the paperwork for leaving the country.
"Name?"
"Lu Yang."
"Identity?"
"Disciple of Dao Seeking Sect."
"What is the purpose of your trip to the East Sea?"
"Touring."
"Okay, you may pass."
"Hm? Why are there so many people?" Meng Jingzhou noticed that there were three large ships at the port for leaving the city, and from the flags on the ships, it seemed that they belonged to the official fleet of Great Xia.
Was the dynasty sending envoys to visit the Dragon Palace in the East Sea?
"Excuse me, brother, what is the purpose of these three large ships that are about to set sail?" Meng Jingzhou randomly stopped a kind-looking passerby to ask.
"Oh, you mean those? I've heard that it's an expedition organized by the Second Prince."
"What is the Second Prince going to sea for?"
The man sounded mysterious and lowered his voice: "I've heard that Emperor Xia is seriously ill, with little lifespan left. The Second Prince, having heard that there is an elixir of immortality in the East Sea, organized three large ships to search for this elixir."
Meng Jingzhou of course knew that Emperor Xia had little lifespan left, but he had not expected that this matter had already spread among the common people.
"Fairy, does an elixir of immortality truly exist in this world?" Lu Yang asked, overhearing the conversation between Meng Jingzhou and the passerby.
"Anyhow, I don't recall ever cultivating such an immortal medicine." Fairy Eternity, as the leader of the Immortal Lineage, could grant immortality to everyone in the world if she wished.
"Now that I think of it, I did cultivate it once. It was when Immortal Jiuchong was studying the power of Yin and Yang, asking the Jade Rabbit and the Golden Crow to mate. However, after mating for too long, they became lackluster and listless, so they asked me for a solution."
"I cultivated an Immortal Dao Fruit and ground it into powder, which I then mixed with water and fed to the Jade Rabbit and the Golden Crow."
"Looking at it from this angle, the research findings on the Yin and Yang powers by Immortal Jiuchong also owe some credit to me."
Lu Yang was amazed. This Immortal Dao Fruit sounded much more effective than any Yang Invigorating Medicine.
The Jade Rabbit and Golden Crow studied by Immortal Jiuchong would have at least reached the Body Integration Realm in their cultivation.
"However, one Immortal Dao Fruit can only grant immortality to one person; a whole bunch of Jade Rabbits and Golden Crows consuming it would only lead to a life-extension, not eternal life," she continued.
"Other than that, I have never cultivated the Immortal Dao Fruit again."
"How do you cultivate the Immortal Dao Fruit?" Lu Yang felt this was a skill worth learning, which could potentially save Emperor Xia.
"It's simple. Just a drop of my blood on any plant will cultivate an Immortal Dao Fruit."
Lu Yang: "..."
It was simple indeed, but impossible for him to learn.
"I also haven't heard of the Yingtian Immortals cultivating an elixir of life. I suppose those few blockheads wouldn't be able to do it either, but as for a Semi-Immortal, I can't say for sure."
"Can a Semi-Immortal also cultivate the Immortal Dao Fruit?"
Fairy Eternity rolled her eyes, speaking in a languid tone: "How could they? Semi-Immortals themselves cannot achieve immortality, let alone cultivate an elixir for it."
"If there is a Semi-Immortal from the Immortal Lineage, such as those with the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit or Initial Form of Indestructible Dao Fruit, then it's possible they could cultivate a medicinal herb that significantly extends lifespan."
"By the way, Second-in-command, are you sure you don't want to consider an Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit? It's free of charge," Fairy Eternity once again tried to tempt Lu Yang.
"No, I want to rely on my own efforts to cultivate the initial form of the Dao Fruit," Lu Yang said to himself, determined not to become the kind of man who lives off others like Li Haoran.
Seeing Lu Yang reject her once again, Fairy Eternity appeared quite disappointed.
"Then you'll have to work hard. Look at Li Haoran, he's already a Semi-Immortal, while you're only in the Second Infant Stage."
"It's called the Double Infant Stage... Wait, what do you mean Li Haoran is a Semi-Immortal?"
"Li Haoran has the initial form of the Reincarnation Dao Fruit, of course he's a Semi-Immortal," retorted Fairy Eternity, who as the creator of her Realm, held the ultimate interpretive authority.
Upon hearing this, Lu Yang's gaze towards Li Haoran, who was busy handling his exit documents, changed instantly.
Who would have thought that Li Haoran, the slowest in cultivation amongst the five of them, turned out to be the highest in Cultivation Level.
"What's the purpose of going to the East Sea?"
"Going home to visit relatives."
"Then I wish you a pleasant family visit."
"Thank you."
Lu Yang and the others noticed after they finished processing their clearance documents, a noisy commotion arose from behind them.
"Look quick, it's a monster!"
"Really, it's become sentient."
When the five turned their heads, they saw Old Ma standing on two legs, one leg on the counter, the other hoisting a carriage, handling his clearance documents, full of whimsy and discordance.
No wonder there was a commotion; had it been Lu Yang and his friends, they too would have stared a bit longer.
After Old Ma finished with the pleasantries and set down the carriage, he resumed walking on all fours, passing the stunned group with steps as steady as an ordinary horse.
"Come on, what are you standing around for, haven't you seen me walk upright?" Old Ma urged the five naive folks. Judging from their reactions, they still needed more life experience.
"I thought you were going to smuggle yourself to the East Sea," someone said.
Old Ma snorted through his nose, ignoring Meng Jingzhou.
He couldn't possibly admit that he had originally come to Great Xia by smuggling himself in and was nearly caught by the Dynasty.
Such an embarrassing story was best left untold.
"Oh wow, it's the ocean." The group, still in their youth, couldn't help getting excited at the sight of the lush waves and surging tides of the great sea.
Tao Yaoye was especially thrilled, slipping off her shoes and stepping onto the soft sand, letting the sea water wash over her feet. The cool sensation was strangely comforting, and she laughed continuously.
Lu Yang was a bit more composed; he had seen the ocean in his past life.
Of course, the oceans of his past life could not possibly be larger than the current East Sea, nor would there have been a hundred-meter-long whale performing dives above the sea of his past life.
One witnessed a hundred-meter-long whale leaping from the sea surface, shooting up a thousand meters high, then plunging headfirst back into the ocean. With a bang, it burst like a bomb upon the water's surface, making waves heave and swell.
There were also groups of fish floating on the sea surface, forming a long queue to construct a hovering fish bridge under the sunlight. It glittered as though the bridge was forged of gold and silver. A couple embarked from each end of the bridge, met in the middle to express their feelings, creating an incredibly romantic scene.
Both of these phenomena were characteristic sights at the border of the East Sea. The only difference was that the former, the whale jumping, was done because the whales enjoyed it, while the latter, the construction of the fish bridge, was a paid attraction.
Three large ships in search of the elixir for immortality set sail with their crew brimming with enthusiasm, determined to find the legendary immortal medicine to extend the lifespan of Emperor Xia.
These three behemoth ships, crafted by Cultivators with the most exquisite shipbuilding skills procured by the Second Prince, were not only vast in size, featuring nine layers of cabins with a plethora of materials, akin to a small city, but were also powered by Spirit Stones.
Once set sail, their speed surpassed that of flying ships by a significant margin, making them the fastest mode of transport on the sea.
Then the crew watched as a carriage dashed across the surface of the sea with incredible speed. The horse looked back at the three large ships with disdain, accelerated again, and soon left the ships far behind. Faint cheers could even be heard from the carriage.
After all, no matter how fast the ships were, they couldn't outpace a great demon king rushing home to visit relatives.

chapters.title: Chapter 746 - 745 Danger, Danger, Extreme Danger!
chapters.content:
Facing Old Ma's speedy journey, the crew could only stare blankly, letting Old Ma overtake them.
Such a big boat, even if they were to burn Spirit Stones desperately, could not possibly overtake Old Ma.
Unless they invited a Transcendance Tribulation Stage Cultivator to carry the boat and run across the sea.
Old Ma completely ignored the three big boats, his four hooves churning rapidly, even occasionally letting out joyful neighs.
The dragon horse race was located on the southern side of the East Sea, and after leaving the port, Old Ma headed straight south.
Ming City's port is three hundred miles away from the East Sea, which lies within the territory of Great Xia, but Great Xia finds it inconvenient to manage this three hundred mile wide sea, as they can't issue exit documents on the sea surface. Great Xia only sends Cultivators to patrol the sea periodically.
After running three hundred miles, a mist rose off the sea surface, making the direction unclear.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou felt a sense of déjà vu at this scene; when they went to the Demon Territory, they encountered a similar situation, only reaching the Demon Territory after passing through the fog.
Old Ma was very familiar with the mist, and could reach the East Sea even with his eyes closed.
"It seems that mists have been set up in all four directions, east, west, south, and north," Meng Jingzhou guessed, "but what's the purpose?"
"It must be that they don't want ordinary people to know they live inside a huge box," Lu Yang said. For now, the mist didn't seem to have any disadvantages.
"Box? What are you two talking about?" Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou's discussion wasn't hidden, and Tao Yaoye and the others heard it all.
Out of the three, only Li Haoran retained memories from a past life and wore an expression as if he already knew, while Tao Yaoye and Man Gu had never left Great Xia and had never experienced passing through the mist.
"It's like this, according to the research Old Meng and I have done, the Four Ancient Immortals refined the stars into six continents, turning the world into the shape of a box..."
Tao Yaoye and Man Gu were extremely surprised after listening, as they had never imagined the world to be completely different from what they thought – they had been living inside a vast, boundless box all along.
Man Gu was more excited than surprised; he knew that venturing out with Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou would broaden his horizons, "So the Ancient Nameless One finally has a name?"
Man Gu remembered when he first joined the Eternity Sect, the Rudder Master introduced them to the stars refined by the Ancient Nameless One.
Li Haoran also became unsettled, as Qin Haoran's memories didn't mention the stars refined by the Four Ancient Immortals.
While the five of them were talking, Old Ma had already led them across the mist to reach the East Sea, docking at an island.
"If this island hasn't changed its name, then it should still be called Cloud Gathering Island. This is where nearby Cultivators gather. We'll meet here on this island two months later," Old Ma spoke once again in human language.
This had been agreed upon beforehand. Old Ma was going home to visit relatives and obviously couldn't take Lu Yang and the others with him.
The purpose of the Lu Yang group's visit to the East Sea was to see the world, not to meet Old Ma's relatives.
Therefore, before they set off, they'd agreed to split up after reaching the East Sea and then regroup at a certain place before returning to the Seek Dao Sect.
"Farewell, Old Ma."
The five said their goodbyes and waved to Old Ma.
After getting off the carriage, they were greeted by the sea breeze, an atmosphere they could never experience in Great Xia.
"Where to now?"
"None of us have ever been to the East Sea, let's get a map of the East Sea first, or maybe, Junior Brother Li, could you draw us a map of the East Sea?"
Li Haoran appeared troubled and sighed, "It has been a hundred years since Qin Haoran last visited the East Sea, and you know this place is the East Sea, not Great Xia."
"So?"
"So even if Great Powers fight and turn the sea upside down, it won't go back to how it was. The Sea Clan fights over territories, which leads to changes in possession, and hence, the map of the East Sea changes too. Only Cultivators who live in the East Sea year-round know what its map looks like now."
"The concept of territory is strong among the Sea Clan. I could indeed draw a map from a hundred years ago, but what was a safe route a hundred years ago doesn't mean it's safe now. You wouldn't want to be flying along and then get shot down by the Sea Clan, right?"
"That does sound a bit troublesome, but it's not a big problem. Didn't Old Ma say so? This Cloud Gathering Island is a gathering place for East Sea Cultivators. There should definitely be a map here."
"Right, it's a good opportunity to make contact with the East Sea Cultivators."
After a discussion among the five of them, and considering Daoist Buyu's widespread fame, combined with the fact Uncle Ba only mentioned having a friend in the Dragon Palace and not how many enemies they might have, it seemed reasonable to assume that aside from Ao Ran of the Dragon Palace, everyone else could be an enemy.
The five donned black cloaks, with Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, Tao Yaoye, and Man Gu altering their appearances before they felt safe to set foot on the island.
Li Haoran didn't need to change his appearance. Lu Yang and the others had often carried out tasks outside, and their names were well-known, so they could be recognized. Li Haoran, on the other hand, had barely left the Seek Dao Sect and was unknown to others.
"We come from a prestigious sect, so even if we don't flaunt ourselves when we go out, we shouldn't be sneaking around like this, should we?" Meng Jingzhou lamented helplessly.
It was only after they landed on the island that Meng Jingzhou realized their attire was actually common among East Sea cultivators, most of whom wore black robes.
According to Uncle Ba, East Sea cultivators always had some issue clinging to them, hence they were always cautious in their conduct. If their deeds were to be judged in Great Xia, they would face at least a three-year sentence at minimum.
"If someone came to East Sea to sell clothes, they could lose a fortune," Meng Jingzhou clicked his tongue, dismissing the prospect of a business opportunity with sharp negation.
Lu Yang cast a glance at Meng Jingzhou: "East Sea cultivators aren't as bizarre as you imagine, they just wear a black cloak over their clothes, not like flashers who wear nothing but a black cloak."
"It looks like we're in a market district, but the cultivation levels of these cultivators..."
Lu Yang swept the area with his Spiritual Sense, observed the vast expanse of the island, and the market occupying most of it, bustling with cultivators, yet he was astonished to find not a single one at the Foundation Establishment Stage.
The highest Cultivation Level among them was at the late stage of Qi Refinement.
Oh, that's not right, they should be called Qi Refinement Ninth Level Consummation.
"What's there to fear if their cultivation is low? We're here to seek a map, not to pick a fight," Lu Yang remarked.
"Excuse me, fellow daoist, do you have a map of the East Sea here?" Meng Jingzhou approached and casually grabbed a passerby who looked hurried.
The passerby, not expecting to be suddenly accosted by Meng Jingzhou, quickly shook off his hand: "If you want to buy a map, go to the Treasure Pavilion, why bother me!"
With that, the passerby quickened his pace and left Meng Jingzhou behind.
"I was only asking for directions; no need to be so cautious," Meng Jingzhou grumbled.
Li Haoran, who had some experience in this matter, said, "In East Sea, maps are considered important commodities, not everyone will tell you where to find them. Let's just head to the Treasure Pavilion as he suggested."
"Very well."
The Treasure Pavilion was the largest store in the market district of the Cloud Gathering Island, and one of the two Qi Refinement Ninth Level Consummation cultivators Lu Yang detected with his Spiritual Sense was stationed there.
"What can I get for you, guests? To be honest, our Treasure Pavilion has all kinds of treasures. Magic artifacts, Talismans, Array Method diagrams, contemplation diagrams..." said the manager of the Treasure Pavilion with a faint air of pride.
Their Pavilion Master was a Half Step Foundation Establishment Stage Great Power, who had possessed a damaged Foundation Establishment Level Spirit Treasure, making him the foremost person below the Foundation Establishment Stage!
"Do you have maps?"
"Yes, of course."
"We'll take your best map, marked with safe sea areas," said Lu Yang decisively.
"Alright," the manager ordered a disciple to fetch a wooden box from the storeroom.
"Thank you for your patronage, that will be ten Spirit Stones."
Meng Jingzhou casually took out ten Spirit Stones without even blinking, his lavishness startling the manager.
Could it be that this person was a Great Cultivator at the seventh level of Qi Refinement?
After Meng Jingzhou opened the map, the four leaned in to examine it.
They found that the map was indeed a map, but it only covered a radius of twenty miles at sea, documenting dangerous locations that belonged to unheard-of races.
Xiao Ling Fish Tribe, highest cultivation at the eighth level of Qi Refinement, dangerous!
Sea Bull Tribe, highest cultivation at the ninth level of Qi Refinement, dangerous!
Ink-Black Octopus Tribe, the old ancestor suspected of breaking through the Qi Refinement Stage, extremely dangerous!

chapters.title: Chapter 747 - 747: 746 Chapter: Banquet
chapters.content:
Meng Jingzhou held his forehead, his tone filled with helplessness, "Is there a larger map available, perhaps one that marks the territories of clans like Xuanwu and Kun Peng?"
The manager was startled by Meng Jingzhou's words, "The Xuanwu and Kun Peng Clans are legendary tribes. The seas where they reside are forbidden zones of life, off-limits to the human race. How could we possibly know their locations?"
Meng Jingzhou thought of the Kun Peng Clan elder who had visited his family during the New Year, and found him quite kind and affable, even giving him New Year's money.
Meng Jingzhou regretted that Old Ma had dropped them off too early, wishing they had traveled deeper into the East Sea to seek a place with Nascent Soul Stage cultivators.
This godforsaken place didn't even have anyone at the Foundation Establishment Stage.
"Where to find a Nascent Soul Stage cultivator to ask for directions..." Lu Yang pondered, when suddenly a flash of inspiration struck him, realizing he had walked into a dead end.
"We worry about crossing the sea by air, at risk of attack from sea clans, which is why we wanted to purchase a map to find a safe route."
"But why must we look for a safe route? We can just blindly fly eastward; after all, the nearby sea clans don't even have anyone at the Foundation Establishment Stage. By the time they react, we'll already be long gone."
An epiphany struck Meng Jingzhou, "Right, if we just keep flying east, we'll eventually run into a Nascent Soul Stage cultivator or a Nascent Soul Stage sea clan member."
The manager listened to the frightening conversation of the five and wondered, could these five be the legendary Nascent Soul Stage elders?
Encounters with a Nascent Soul Stage elder were rare, perhaps once in ten years. How could it be that five of them had suddenly shown up today?
Lu Yang and his four companions ignored the manager's reaction. Having finalized their plan, they immediately took to the skies, ready to cross the sea.
Lu Yang took out his Green Peak Sword, sprinting close to the surface of the sea, with huge sprays of water flaring on either side.
Meng Jingzhou ran swiftly atop the sea; as a body cultivator, he was faster on foot than by flight.
Man Gu pulled out a hammer, unscrewed the hammerhead, leaving only the handle which had a small hole, turning it into a flute.
As a Confucian cultivator, he couldn't simply run across the sea like Meng Jingzhou, as it didn't befit his status.
Tao Yaoye spread her red paper umbrella, while Li Haoran took out a treasured gourd he had crafted himself.
Each displaying their divine abilities, the five flew towards the deeper regions of the East Sea, leaving the dazed manager behind.
Just as Lu Yang anticipated, there was no dangerous zone that could threaten them at the edge of the East Sea.
If there were any danger, it was them—the five were the greatest peril.
The Qi Refinement cultivators at the ninth level, those at the Foundation Establishment Stage, and even Golden Core Stage sea clans trembled underwater at the sight of the five swiftly passing by, fearing that they would suddenly stop to cause them trouble.
Even a Nascent Soul Stage sea clan settled in the area wouldn't dare to act rashly against five Nascent Soul Stage cultivators, letting them pass right above their heads.
"The outer boundary of the East Sea is indeed vast; we've flown for half the day and not a single Nascent Soul Stage sea clan has come to bother us."
Lu Yang estimated; they had been flying for three days now without so much as a glimpse of a sea clan's shadow.
What the five of them didn't realize was that, as they flew at high speed, their aura leaked out, displaying a presence far exceeding that of the Nascent Soul Stage. Not to mention those of the Nascent Soul Stage, even Divinity Transformation Stage sea clans didn't want to collide head-on with them.
And those at the Void Refinement Stage, with variable cultivation levels, did not dare show themselves either.
"Look, over there, someone!" Tao Yaoye exclaimed with surprise—it was a group of several people flying in the air just like them.
"Let's ask them." Seeing this, Lu Yang adjusted his course atop the Green Peak Sword and approached, "Fellow daoists, may I inquire where you are heading?"
The three people laughed, "Naturally, we're going to a banquet. Surely, fellow daoist is doing the same?"
"A banquet?"
"Indeed, a banquet hosted by a Body Integration Realm elder of the Sea Clan, who has invited powers from the vicinity. Anyone at the Nascent Soul Stage or above is welcome, regardless of their status. Fellow daoist, if you're not otherwise engaged, you could join us."
"I am also welcome to attend?" Lu Yang's interest piqued; the individuals before him were merely at the Nascent Soul Stage, and a banquet hosted by a Body Integration Realm elder would surely have many Great Cultivators. They could use the opportunity to find a more accurate map, and judging by the host's gesture, he didn't seem to be narrow-minded.
It was also a chance to meet other cultivators from the East Sea.
"Of course, they say the elder enjoys liveliness, and as long as one's cultivation is sufficient, there's no need for an invitation to attend."
Lu Yang was delighted—what a fortuitous event.
"Hold on, let me call my companions to go along."
Lu Yang flew back to explain the situation.
"I've heard that banquets are a common affair in the East Sea, a local tradition which should not be missed," said Meng Jingzhou, who loved lively places, and was the first to heed the call.
Tao Yaoye and the others also happily agreed to attend the banquet.
On their way to the banquet, through conversation, Lu Yang learned that the three people were Loose Cultivators who occupied an island called Fangshan Island and were known as the Three Heroes of Fangshan Island.
Lu Yang and his four companions said they were disciples from the Five Elements Sect, eliciting continuous exclamations of surprise from the Three Heroes of Fangshan Island.
"By the way, I heard that a genius appeared in Great Xia, named Lu Yang, do you know him?" the Three Heroes of Fangshan Island asked.
Lu Yang nodded calmly, undisturbed by the strange looks from Meng Jingzhou and the other three, "More than knowing him, I have crossed hands with him. He is a quite formidable opponent. Moreover, he has great prestige within the Seek Dao Sect, and I heard that even when the Dao Seeking Sect Master intended for him to succeed as the Sect Leader, he declined."
The Three Heroes of Fangshan Island once again sighed with wonder, feeling that this Lu Yang truly was extraordinary, not on the same level as them.
As they got closer to the location of the banquet, many Sea Clan and Human race cultivators began to appear in the vicinity.
The eight of them dived into the sea, where the Water-Repelling Pearl allowed Lu Yang and the others to move and breathe without restriction underwater.
Colourful corals teemed on the seabed, like a cluster of underwater palaces, with rainbow-like schools of fish weaving in between, radiantly beautiful.
As they went deeper, instead of growing darker, the light became increasingly brighter.
This was not sunlight streaming into the sea; rather, there was a golden and glittering palace at the sea bottom, reflecting a multitude of lights, beautifying the surrounding marine scenery in a breathtaking display. All around the palace, pearls and Night Pearls were embedded, glittering brilliantly, lighting up the surrounding sea.
Various members of the Sea Clan swam past the eight, and this time Lu Yang and the others finally recognized the origins of the Sea Clan; the Mirage Clan, the Kunpeng Clan, the Yaksha Clan, the Turtle Clan...
After verifying their cultivation levels, the eight smoothly entered the palace.
There were quite a few cultivators at the Spirit Transformation and Void Refinement Stages attending the banquet. Lu Yang and his companions, being at the Nascent Soul Stage, naturally sat at the very back.
The banquet was about to begin, with various Spirit Fruits and exquisite liquors laid across the tables. Under the enhancement of Array Methods, the Spirit Fruits didn't float away, and the liquors didn't mix with the seawater.
"Red Sun Fruit, Qi-boosting Fruit... This Elder sure is generous," Meng Jingzhou chuckled. These fruits meant little to him but were great supplements for ordinary Nascent Soul Stage cultivators.
Looking around, tables were laden with countless Spirit Fruits, a very grand gesture indeed.
Lu Yang overheard people discussing in hushed tones, "I heard that Elder was in Great Xia before, and his cultivation advanced by leaps and bounds. He only returned three days ago."
"Great Xia really is a land full of opportunities. If it weren't for its strict governance, I'd love to make my mark in Great Xia."
"You said it. I also heard that Elder is sworn brothers with the Clan Leader of the Meng Family and can even come and go freely from the Immortal Sects."
"It's unclear if Elder will stay here this time or continue to cultivate back in Great Xia."
Lu Yang: "..."
Why does this Elder's experience sound so familiar?
Before Lu Yang could inquire further, the sound of gongs and drums announced the start of the banquet, and a familiar figure appeared at the front.
Vastly different from his usual appearance, Old Ma was flanked by two young mares on either side. The young mares looked coy, blushing on their cheeks, and Old Ma teased them from time to time, making them even more bashful.
Old Ma laughed heartily, looking very pleased with himself, raising his hoof as if it were sticky, holding up his cup, "This banquet is to celebrate my return from Great Xia. There's no need to be reserved, everyone, enjoy yourselves to your heart's content."
"Elder, tell us about your experiences in Great Xia," a shill called out loudly.
Old Ma did not decline and began to recount his tale, with a hint of boasting, "My journey to Great Xia was highly rewarding. I have been residing in the Immortal Sects for many years, with countless opportunities, having seen numerous Transcendance Tribulation cultivators. Even if I didn't wish to meet those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, they would flock over, unstoppable."
"Then, Elder, you must have seen those at Transcendance Tribulation Stage take action," the shill asked again, looking up at Old Ma with admiration.
"What's so great about Transcendance Tribulation Stage battles? I have even witnessed battles among Semi-Immortals, and that was truly an eye-opener," replied Old Ma.
"Come on, let's drink," Old Ma lifted his cup and drained it in one gulp.
"To the Elder!" the crowd echoed in unison, downing their drinks as well.
Old Ma was in high spirits, descending the platform to clink cups and drink with the cultivators, one cup after another, until he was utterly drunk.
The cultivators were flattered and shocked.
Old Ma drank his way from the very front of the banquet to the very end.
"Come, drink!"
Old Ma raised his cup, looking up to meet Lu Yang's eyes.
"..."
They exchanged a silent gaze.

chapters.title: Chapter 748 - 747: Lord Ma Zhen
chapters.content:
Seeing Lu Yang, Old Ma sobered up considerably.
Although Lu Yang had disguised himself, Old Ma had known him for a long time and had always been there whenever Lu Yang changed his appearance.
Old Ma's gaze shifted and upon seeing the four people beside Lu Yang, all the effects of the alcohol vanished.
No way, how come you five are here?
Do you know how far this place is from where I left you? With your speed, even flying at full strength, it would take three days to get here!
So you came straight to my home right after I set you down?
Although the Dragon horse clan can't compare to the Kunpeng Clan, the Xuanwu Clan, or other top ten clanta, it still holds a considerable status in the East Sea. According to the hierarchy of the Great Xia sects, it belongs to a First-Class Sect.
And with Old Ma's return, it meant that the status of the Dragon horse clan in the Sea Clan had risen yet another step.
Over the years, as Old Ma continued his training, he indeed became the top expert of the Dragon horse clan, unbeatable even by the Clan Leader or the Supreme Elders.
Returning home with honors, Old Ma naturally wanted to flaunt his achievements.
For this reason, he deliberately left Meng Jingzhou and the others on the fringe of the East Sea, considering with their abilities, asking for directions and finding a map would take at least ten days to reach the depths of the East Sea.
That didn't even include the troubles they might encounter on the way. If something else happened, it could take half a month to get here.
Unexpectedly, instead of meeting two months later as planned, it had only been three days and they already bumped into each other, and in such an awkward situation.
"Fellow daoist, toast to True Gentleman Ma," the three heroes of Fangshan Island prompted Lu Yang via transmission when they noticed him standing there dumbfounded.
Despite the approachable manner of True Gentleman Ma from the Dragon horse clan, he is still at the Body Integration Realm. If he gets displeased, a casual gesture from him would be unbearable for someone at the Nascent Soul Stage.
"True Gentleman Ma, I toast to you," Lu Yang said respectfully. As Yun Zhi's junior brother, the Immortal Lineage's second-in-command, the Young Master of the Heavenly Court Sect, and the Phoenix Ancestor's senior brother, he didn't put on airs and was amiable, especially courteous toward his seniors.
"True Gentleman Ma, we toast to you," Meng Jingzhou and the others joined in on the fun, struggling to suppress their laughter.
"True Gentleman Ma, do you recognize these five?" Old Ma's attendant, who previously played the role of the comic relief, asked with obvious intent. He sensed something odd in the atmosphere between Old Ma and Lu Yang's group.
"Recognize them? Of course, I do. We had the fortune to meet True Gentleman Ma at the Seek Dao Sect," Lu Yang replied with a hearty smile.
"Ah, right, I know them. They are from Great Xia… Which part of Great Xia are you from now?"
"Five Elements Sect."
"Right, they are the geniuses from the Five Elements Sect, truly extraordinary. Indeed the pillars of society, destined for greatness in the future," Old Ma generously praised, assuming Lu Yang and the others wouldn't dare to reveal their true identities.
"The Five Elements Sect, one of the Five Immortal Sects?" someone exclaimed. This was an impressive background indeed, no wonder the ancestor paid so much attention to these five.
Several members of the Sea Clan were even considering marrying off their younger relatives as an investment.
One of the advantages of the Sea Clan is their prolific nature. Even if the investment failed, it wouldn't matter much, but success would bring numerous benefits.
Meng Jingzhou nodded continuously, "True Gentleman Ma has a renowned reputation in our Great Xia. In recent years, there have been several battles between those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage and Semi-Immortals, and True Gentleman Ma was present at all of them. He moved freely and emerged unscathed, showing extremely clever tactics.
Even those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage had to address him with the honorific 'Old'."
"The Seek Dao Sect has strict controls on who enters and exits, but True Gentleman Ma is an exception. He can enter and leave as he pleases, with no one to stop him."
...
After the banquet ended, Old Ma secretly sought out Lu Yang and his four companions, and, following a whispered instruction, they arrived at a side hall of the palace.
"Why have you come here?"
Old Ma looked perplexed, a question he had stifled throughout the entire banquet.
With an innocent face, Lu Yang replied, "This is our first time in the East Sea, we're not familiar with the place, so we thought of finding a place with higher-level cultivators to buy a map. It just so happened that we ended up here."
"It really was a coincidence," Lu Yang emphasized that today's meeting was unintentional.
Old Ma: "..."
He knew he should not have left in such a hurry back then; if he had left a map, they would not have had any issues today.
"Wait here, I'll find you a map," Old Ma said with a grimace, having not returned to the East Sea for over a hundred years and without any maps on hand.
Soon after, Old Ma returned with five jade slips in his mouth, which contained the most detailed maps he could find in a short time.
Upon activating the jade slips with their Spiritual Sense, Lu Yang and his companions finally saw the full scope of the East Sea. Indeed, it was much more detailed than the maps sold at Jubao Pavilion for ten Spirit Stones each, including everything from the top ten Sea Clan races to the Human race islands, and even the lesser Sea Clans.
After sending Lu Yang and his group away, Old Ma was in high spirits. With Lu Yang and the others at the banquet, he felt too embarrassed to enjoy himself fully.
"Should I find an excuse to have another banquet? But what reason would be good enough..."
The Sea Clans loved to hold banquets, a tradition left behind by the Dragon Clan since Ancient Times.
...
"Back in Ancient Times, we also used to hold banquets frequently," said Fairy Eternity, inspired by seeing the Dragon horse Clan's banquet, "especially when Zhu Tian would sing and dance, it was very lively."
As they entered the East Sea, Lu Yang's Spiritual Space was once again drastically altered by Fairy Eternity. She filled the Spiritual Space with seawater and transformed herself into a Jiaoren, half fish, half human, swimming leisurely and comfortably.
A sea bed was also placed on the water's surface, where Fairy Eternity could lie down and sleep when tired, which was quite convenient.
Lu Yang felt that if he slightly shook his head, he could hear the sound of the sea.
"Second Boss, you should practice diligently. Your Spiritual Space is still not large enough," Fairy Eternity taught earnestly, warning Lu Yang against becoming negligent or lazy.
"Yes, yes, I will certainly practice diligently to create a larger playful space for you, Fairy," Lu Yang agreed.
"It's a pity that we're too far from the Demon Territory; otherwise, I could invite Zhu Tian over and hold a banquet right here in the East Sea," Fairy Eternity remarked. When she spoke of a banquet, she meant the legendary feasts of the immortals, grand and splendid, on a scale the Dragon horse Clan could not match.
In his heart, Lu Yang taught that Zhu Tian, after all, is the ruler of the Demon Nation; Fairy should at least spare him some dignity.
Lu Yang recalled how Zhu Tian would call him "big brother" and, before leaving, insisted on giving him four imperial chairs, showing utmost sincerity.
"Fellow Daoists, do you have a place to go in the East Sea? If it's not imposing, you might consider visiting Fangshan Island for a chat?" The three heroes of Fangshan Island invited Lu Yang and his companions.
It was rare for them to meet cultivators from Great Xia, especially those from a top power like the Five Elements Sect, so naturally, they wanted to seize this opportunity to connect.
"That would be nice."
Meng Jingzhou agreed readily, since they had no other plans, they might as well visit Fangshan Island.

chapters.title: Chapter 749 - 748: Spirit Vein
chapters.content:
Upon learning that Lu Yang and his companions were disciples of the Five Elements Sect, not only did the trio from Fangshan Island extend olive branches, but numerous other powers also made overtures, hoping for a visit to their territories and even hinting at the possibility of arranging marriage alliances with their daughters.
In comparison, Lu Yang and his companions felt that the trio from Fangshan Island were more reliable.
When they arrived at Fangshan Island, Lu Yang realized that the so-called Fangshan Island was not a single island, but rather a term for a group of islands, similar to myriad twinkling stars surrounding the main island.
According to the trio, the main island of Fangshan Island possessed a third-grade superior Spirit Vein, which incited envy among the Nascent Soul Stage Cultivators. Rumors had it that beneath the Spirit Vein lay hidden a heavenly treasure of earth, though of course, this remained merely a legend, unseen by anyone.
Spirit Veins were also a specialty of the East Sea, which Lu Yang had heard of. A first-grade Spirit Vein allowed Qi Cultivation Stage practitioners to cultivate, a second-grade allowed Foundation Establishment Stage practitioners to cultivate, and so on.
Within the same grade, Spirit Veins could be further divided into upper, middle, and lower ranks.
A third-grade upper rank was the best Spirit Vein a Nascent Soul Stage Cultivator could obtain.
The trio were the masters of Fangshan Island. Aligned with them were several families, Loose Cultivators, and countless ordinary humans. All in all, their numbers totaled over a million people. The ordinary humans worked from sunrise to sunset, mainly to provide seedlings for cultivation.
Qi Refinement level cultivators had different roles, such as serving as spiritual farmers, planting spirit grains, and so forth.
Fangshan Island was like a small kingdom, which left Lu Yang and his companions utterly astonished.
"Master." The maids were already waiting on Fangshan Island for the trio's return early on.
The maids were meticulously selected and trained by the families of Fangshan Island and were of decent appearance.
Yan Daixia was the leader among the trio, and he invited the group to the main hall and asked the maids to serve tea.
"Wait a moment," Lu Yang stopped the maid, causing Yan Daixia to grow tense, fearing he had somehow offended Lu Yang.
Lu Yang covered his Identity Jade, which bore the insignia of the Seek Dao Sect, not allowing Yan Daixia to see it.
"Brew this, please. We are more accustomed to drinking this," Lu Yang said with a smile, handing the maid a packet of tea.
Yan Daixia's pupils contracted upon smelling the aroma of the tea, "Is this..."
"Enlightenment Tea?"
"It really is Enlightenment Tea?!"
"Why, has Brother Yan tasted it before?"
Yan Daixia was far from qualified to have tasted such tea. He had been fortunate enough to attend a few banquets organized by Body Integration Realm figures, during which one of the Integration Stage Experts mysteriously presented a treasure, which was the Enlightenment Tea.
The other Integration Stage experts wanted some, but he refused to give it to them. Only after much persuasion did he brew a pot for them to share.
The packet that Lu Yang took out could not only brew a pot, but a whole basin would still be too much.
Lu Yang was not short on Enlightenment Tea. Not to mention the distant sources, there was even an Enlightenment Tea Tree King in the medicinal garden, from which the Eldest Senior Sister got her tea. Given Lu Yang's relationship with the Little Medicinal Kings, obtaining a few packets of Enlightenment Tea was effortless.
And this was without taking into account Fairy Eternity's innate restraining effect on spiritual plants.
Once the Enlightenment Tea was ready, the trio drank it with the same care as if they were consuming an immortal elixir, very cautiously lifting their teacups to drink.
The fragrance was even richer than that of the Enlightenment Tea from the banquets!
Brother Yan's gaze toward Lu Yang and his companions now carried a trace of reverence.
"Brother Yan, would you be willing to introduce us to the powers of the East Sea?" Lu Yang wanted to match them to the markings on the map.
One ought to reciprocate a favor; Yan Daixia spared no details, "The East Sea can be divided into two major powers: the Sea Clan and the Human race.
The Sea Clan consists of ten supremely powerful races, including the Long Clan, Kunpeng Clan, Kui Clan… Each of these races has Transcendance Tribulation great demons ruling them, especially the Long Clan, whose depths are unfathomable, with unknown numbers of Transcendance Tribulation figures; it is said that the Old Dragon Emperor has already lived for nine thousand years."
"Below the ten great races, there are others like the Dragon-horse Clan, Mirage Clan, Ao Clan, Fishman tribe, Yaksha Clan, Dragon-man Clan, etc. All of these Sea Clan races have Body Integration Realm great demon kings in command."
"The races further down the line are too numerous to count, such as the Sea Spider Clan and the Spirit Fish Clan. These races have Divinity Transformation Stage experts sitting in power, but whether they have any at the Void Refinement Stage is unknown."
Cultivators in the East Sea who reach the Void Refinement Stage tend to keep a low profile, hiding the news of their breakthrough to prevent their enemies from learning of their newfound strength and seeking them out.
"Compared to the Sea Clan, the human race here is relatively weak. To protect themselves, they formed the East Sea Cultivator Alliance. The ones who advocated for this alliance were Penglai, Fangzhang, and Yingzhou, the three immortal islands, which also wield the most influence within the alliance.
Each has Transcendance Tribulation Stage ancestors in power, taking on the roles of Alliance Hierarch and Deputy Hierarch."
"The powers within the alliance with cultivators at the Body Integration Realm include..."
"The threshold to join the alliance is at the Foundation Establishment Stage; these people are ordinary members within the alliance. By reaching the Golden Core Stage, they're considered senior members."
"We three brothers are managers in the alliance, and above us, there are Hall Masters, Elders, and so on."
After the introduction, Lu Yang gained a basic understanding of the East Sea powers: Your East Sea's levels of hierarchy are truly numerous, and after all that division, even the Alliance Hierarch wouldn't match up to a Four Imperial Protectors in our Heavenly Court Sect.
During the chat, Yi Daxia seized the opportunity to ask questions about cultivation.
Actually, they were somewhat embarrassed. Originally, they wanted to offer some treasures in exchange for cultivation experiences, but once Lu Yang brought out the Enlightenment Tea, none of their treasures seemed of any use.
This one pack of tea leaves could buy several Fangshan Islands.
They could only ask shamelessly.
Although the Nascent Souls cultivated by Lu Yang and his group were peculiar, they were still quite clear about the traditional ways of cultivation. The cultivation problems that had troubled the three heroes for decades were easily addressed by Lu Yang, who could point out solutions with just a few words, solving the issues effortlessly and earning the heroes' utmost admiration.
The only challenging question was one posed by Yi Daxia, "How should one utilize the Nascent Soul in battle?"
Lu Yang pondered; he was still being beaten by the Invincible Nascent Soul, Meng Jingzhou's dual Nascent Souls were unprecedented, Man Gu's ancestral spirit Nascent Soul was obviously not a reference, and Li Haoran's dismembered Nascent Soul wasn't much better.
After going in circles, only Tao Yaoye's Nascent Soul was reliable.
"Right, we have long resided in the Central Continent and have never seen a Spirit Vein. I wonder if Yi Daxia could satisfy our curiosity?" Meng Jingzhou asked.
Among the five, only Li Haoran had seen the appearance of a Spirit Vein, relying on memories from his past life.
"That's easy," Yi Daxia said with a smile.
Generally speaking, a Spirit Vein is the lifeblood of an island, a sacred ground that cannot be shown to outsiders.
But since Lu Yang brought out the Enlightenment Tea, he couldn't be considered an outsider anymore.
"This way, please."
The three heroes personally led the way, inviting the five into a cave. With a lamp in hand, they illuminated the path ahead.
The cave was winding, and the deeper they went, the more they felt the change in Spiritual Energy's density. After about ten minutes of walking, the cave gradually brightened, even more radiant than the heroes' lanterns.
"We've arrived."
The three heroes extinguished the lantern and gestured for the others to proceed.
Ahead was a pool of deep blue spring water, protected by an Array Method. The spring radiated sparkling Spiritual Energy, which flowed through underground channels towards various parts of Fangshan Island. The water's tributaries formed Second and Third Grade Spirit Veins.
Suddenly, the ground trembled, the Spirit Vein boiled, and the abundant Spiritual Energy broke through the large array, causing emerald green ripples to spread across the sky.
Yi Daxia's expression changed, "This is a sign from heaven and earth; a heavenly treasure is about to emerge!"
Lu Yang quickly raised his hand, asserting his innocence, "This has nothing to do with me."

chapters.title: Chapter 750 - 749 Another Big Feature of the East Sea
chapters.content:
The three heroes of Fangshan Island looked at Lu Yang with astonishment, not understanding why he would suddenly prove he was unrelated to the matter.
It had long been rumored that Fangshan Island hid a rare treasure. Now that it had just appeared, how could it be related to someone who had just arrived?
"Uh, this might have something to do with me," admitted Tao Yaoye, raising her hand awkwardly and drawing a crowd of onlookers with her embarrassment.
"I felt something beneath the spirit vein connect with me."
As she spoke, the spirit vein boiled more fiercely, piercing the sky, and a green light flashed. A palm-sized, three-leafed gleaming green grass swayed in the air.
Lu Yang and the others did not recognize this green grass.
"Fairy, do you recognize this thing?"
"This thing is the Feather Transformation Immortal Grass, it looks quite ancient considering its appearance," identified Fairy Eternity with just a glance.
"Feather Transformation Immortal Grass? What's the relation to Junior Sister Tao's Feather Transformation Immortal Body?"
"The Feather Transformation Immortal Grass is cultivated for one's own Feather Transformation Immortal Body. Consuming the Immortal Grass can greatly shorten the cultivation process, saving at least a hundred and ten years worth of cultivation, or even up to a thousand years.
I reckon this is something left behind by some Feather Transformation Immortal Body, who either forgot to consume it or died before they could, leaving it here until it sensed the Feather Transformation Immortal Body within Tao Yaoye, leading to its emergence."
"Of course, others can consume it too."
Upon hearing this, Lu Yang was slightly shocked—the prospect of avoiding a hundred and ten years of cultivation effort was incredibly powerful.
He himself had only been practicing for three years.
"However, I would advise you all not to consume it right now. This Feather Transformation Immortal Grass can still be replanted," the immortal suggested.
Lu Yang claimed Fairy Eternity's knowledge as his own, sharing it with the crowd, which earned him their admiring gazes.
With the appearance of the Feather Transformation Immortal Grass, the spirit vein grew even more lively, and the concentration of spiritual energy rose significantly compared to before.
Previously, the Feather Transformation Immortal Grass was rooted at the deepest part of the spirit vein, drawing spiritual essence. Now that the Immortal Grass had emerged, the true grade of the spirit vein was revealed.
The spirit vein of Fangshan Island was not fourth-grade but fifth-grade!
However, the trio felt no joy, only a sense of impending disaster.
"This is bad!" exclaimed Yan Chuan, his expression drastically changing.
"What's wrong?" asked Lu Yang and the others, not understanding the situation.
"A rare treasure's emergence has triggered unusual phenomena between heaven and earth. Cultivators nearby surely have detected it."
"Although they may not recognize the Feather Transformation Immortal Grass, once they realize that the spirit vein has upgraded from fourth-grade to fifth-grade, they'll definitely guess that previously the Immortal Grass had been absorbing most of the spirit vein's power."
"A treasure capable of drawing a vast amount of spiritual energy— even if they don't know what it is, they'll realize it's an item of immeasurable value."
"You live in Great Xia and are unfamiliar with the rules of the East Sea."
"The rule of the East Sea, treasures belong to the capable! There will be people coming to seize the Immortal Grass!"
As cultivators of the East Sea, the three heroes sensed the looming crisis immediately!
The emergence of Immortal Herbs spelled disaster, not fortune!
This, too, was characteristic of the East Sea.
A terrifying pressure descended, accompanied by an aged voice.
"Yan Chuan, old man has arrived. Why haven't you come out to greet me?"
"It's the Hall Master of the Alliance, Gao Feng—he lives near Fangshan Island!" Yan Chuan recognized the identity of the speaker just by his voice.
"What's his cultivation level?" asked Lu Yang with interest.
"The peak of the early stage of Spirit Transformation!"
The three heroes dared not delay and quickly left the Spirit Vein to go out and greet Gao Feng.
Gao Feng's eyes were cold and gloomy as he flew in the air, staring at the three heroes with a frosty gaze.
"A rare treasure has appeared on Fangshan Island, hand it over to avoid bringing unwarranted disaster upon your island," he said coldly.
Trembling with fear, Hero Yan managed to suppress his terror and spoke, "Senior Gao, the Alliance has rules that prevent members from robbing one another."
Unmoved, Gao Feng replied, "Rob? How can it be considered robbery if you're willingly giving it to me?"
Meanwhile, a figure burst forth from the sea, looking at the three heroes with a smile that wasn't quite a smile, "Yan Chuan, luck has befallen Fangshan Island. As neighbors, isn't it only fair that I get a slice of the fortune?"
The neighbor of Fangshan Island, the Clan Leader of the Shark Clan, possessed a top-notch Cultivation Level at the early stage of Divinity Transformation.
These two were the closest Divinity Transformation Stage cultivators to this location.
"Ha, how dare any random riffraff reach for something coveted by our Five Elements Sect?" Lu Yang sneered coldly.
Meng Jingzhou, Tao Yaoye, and the others came out from the cave entrance one after another, standing their ground.
"You are the disciples from the Five Elements Sect who attended Lord Ma's banquet!" Upon seeing Lu Yang, Gao Feng wavered, and the Clan Leader of the Shark Clan felt the same.
Gao Feng was not afraid of the Five Elements Sect. The East Sea was so distant from the Five Elements Sect that surely they wouldn't dare to interfere just for mistreating their disciples, would they?
Despite the chaos within the East Sea, they were quite united externally, and the upper echelons of the Alliance wouldn't allow the Five Elements Sect to meddle.
What he feared was Old Ma.
Gnashing his teeth, Gao Feng did not even utter a harsh word and turned away to leave.
The Clan Leader of the Shark Clan's face was so sullen it looked like it could drip water, as he dived back into the sea, pretending as if nothing had happened.
Seeing the two Divinity Transformation Stage cultivators leave, the three heroes heaved a sigh of relief, having survived the ordeal.
"Is that it?" Man Gu scratched his head, having thought the atmosphere was leading to a fight.
"Of course, matters aren't that simple," Lu Yang shook his head.
"Gao Feng is worried about angering Old Ma, which is why he only temporarily left. In that case, why not just make sure that Old Ma doesn't find out it was him?"
"If it were me, I wouldn't rob in broad daylight. I'd cover my face at night, rob and then run. Who would know it was me?"
Meng Jingzhou gently shook his head, feeling that Gao Feng lacked sophistication, "That's inexperience. A failed daytime robbery followed by a nighttime heist, even with a concealed face, still makes you a suspect. If it were me, I'd simply not show up during the day and then rob at night with my face covered, leaving no room for suspicion."
Li Haoran then added, "However, there's still a chance to salvage the situation. Call together more people at night to broaden the pool of suspects. That way, Gao Feng would be relatively safer."
Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, and Li Haoran discussed the methodology of committing the act back and forth, leaving the three heroes bewildered.
Aren't you disciples of the Righteous Path, who have never been to the East Sea? How come you're so familiar with such tactics?
Man Gu hurriedly took out paper and pen to record the discussion process of Lu Yang and the others. Truly exemplary, they had so quickly adapted to the local way of thinking.
Tao Yaoye looked at Man Gu with a peculiar expression. Are you learning their methods, or are you taking down their testimonies?
As darkness fell, figures shrouded in black robes and masked faces appeared, staring greedily at Fangshan Island like grim reapers.
