"So Fangshan Island has a fifth-grade Spirit Vein. This is a rare treasure comparable to a fifth-grade Spirit Vein."
"Why not take the opportunity to claim Fangshan Island for ourselves? The three Yan Chuan are merely at the Nascent Soul Stage—occupying such a fine Spirit Vein is a waste."
Following Lu Yang's instructions, the heroes had already evacuated the people of the main island to the surrounding smaller islands ahead of time.
"One, two, three... twelve in total. Quite a turnout, huh? All at the Divinity Transformation Stage," Lu Yang said with a smile as he limbered up.
"Since we have arrived at the East Sea, we should certainly enjoy the unique culture here. After indulging in the banquets, it's time to experience a fight."

chapters.title: Chapter 751 - 750: Do They Think Our Five Elements Sect Is Easy to Bully?
chapters.content:
```
"Twelve at the Divine Transformation Stage, this may be a bit difficult to fight," said Lu Yang, difficulty on his lips, but the smile on his face couldn't be concealed no matter what.
```
```
In Great Xia, it was rare to encounter anyone who dared to battle him, especially to the death.
```
```
It was a pity that he couldn't make full use of his cultivation.
```
```
Lu Yang fondly remembered the Qingzhou festival, fighting against his peers, with Golden Core Stage Cultivators reversing the situation against those at the Foundation Establishment Stage.
```
```
With limited options in the East Sea, since Foundation Establishment Stage adversaries were not available, he would have to make do with Divine Transformation Stage Cultivators.
```
```
Meng Jingzhou and the others were all very excited, as it was rare to have a chance to enjoy a good fight.
```
```
"I thought they would also call upon those at the Nascent Soul Stage," Tao Yaoye said, puzzled, as this differed from her expectations.
```
```
Lu Yang explained, "This is a secret mission. The fewer people involved, the better. Moreover, those who partake in a secret mission have to share the spoils—it's hush money. If those at the Divine Transformation Stage can handle it, why bother involving the Nascent Soul Stage just to make up the numbers?"
```
```
Although Lu Yang had never done such a thing before, it did not prevent him from thinking from another's perspective.
```
```
Out of the twelve Divine Transformation Stage Cultivators, including those at the mid and late stages, there were surely members of the Human race and the Sea Clan. Lu Yang guessed the organizer this time wouldn't be Gao Feng, as he wouldn't be able to command so many from the Divine Transformation Stage.
```
```
It must be the appearance of a rare treasure that attracted distant Divine Transformation Stage Cultivators who, due to the distance, didn't arrive immediately. After arriving later and hearing from Gao Feng about their Five Elements Sect being here, they organized this plan.
```
```
Lu Yang didn't care about the accuracy of his guess; he would fight first and ask questions later.
```
```
Facing the encirclement of twelve Divine Transformation Stage Cultivators, Lu Yang dared to strike first. The Green Peak Sword reflected the moonlight above his head, startlingly bright.
```
```
Aside from real-deal Cultivators like Master of All Laws, few noticed the sword that Lu Yang used, even though he claimed to be from the Five Elements Sect; he could still wield the Green Peak Sword.
```
```
Sword Qi shot out like a ribbon, with the momentum of a rainbow, and the intent piercing the void. The Divine Transformation Stage Cultivators saw the Sword Qi coming and their calm expressions changed as they hastened to dodge.
```
```
"Truly worthy of being an Immortal Disciple from Great Xia, even at the Nascent Soul Stage he can release Sword Qi that can injure us!"
```
```
"It's said that the Five Elements Sect is divided into Five Veins according to the Five Elements; it seems he must be a disciple from the sect's Golden Vein!"
```
```
Seeing the formation of the Divine Transformation Stage Cultivators thrown into disarray, Meng Jingzhou and the other four seized the opportunity to strike.
```
```
Meng Jingzhou transformed into a Protector of Buddhism, displaying the form of three heads and six arms, and looked imposing in every direction.
```
```
Man Gu invoked his ancestral spirit, wielding his great hammer with fierce vigor. Those like Gao Feng who encountered him were in for broken bones and torn tendons.
```
```
Li Haoran's body burst into flames, dividing into six identical forms attacking from different directions.
```
```
The red umbrella opened, spreading an illusionary realm. Tao Yaoye moved with ease within the realm, continuously dragging her opponents into the illusion.
```
```
However, these Divine Transformation Stage Cultivators were thriving in the East Sea for a reason, and they were not to be underestimated.
```
```
They targeted Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, recognizing their superior combat abilities, and sent six Divine Transformation Stage opponents to fight them.
```
```
Tao Yaoye and the others were forced to contend with two opponents each.
```
```
"Bihai Tide Birth Decision!"
```
```
The calm sea surface erupted with towering waves, forming walls of water. The sharp Sword Qi collided with the walls, splitting them in two and losing much of its force.
```
```
"Raging Whale Suppressing Fist!"
```
```
The Whale Clan and the Shark Clan had always been adversaries; this was a powerful fist technique developed by the Whale Clan specifically to counter the Shark Clan.
```
```
However, to the knowledge of the three heroes, there were no Divine Transformation Stage members among the Whale Clan nearby.
```
```
"Abyssal Chains!"
```
```
A cultivator flicked his sleeve, revealing pitch-black, barbed chains that rattled out. Li Haoran, with his keen eye, immediately saw that these chains had been battle-hardened and were full of malevolence, clearly responsible for the deaths of many.
```
```
The chains moved with agility in mid-air, lashing Li Haoran with numerous wounds.
```
```
East Sea Cultivators often practiced a variety of combat techniques in secret. The moves they used tonight would not be normally demonstrated, and regardless of victory or defeat, their identities would remain concealed.
```
```
"Ice Dragon's Chant!" The sea surface froze over, and an ice dragon surged out, repelling Lu Yang.
```
```
"Whale Swallowing Heaven and Earth Fist!"
```
```
"Raging Shark Suppressing Fist!"
```
```
"Clear Light Long Fist!"
```
```
Three Divine Transformation Stage Cultivators dragged Meng Jingzhou into the sea, each employing different fist techniques. They secretly activated secret techniques, activating their bloodlines and momentarily boosting their combat abilities. Meng Jingzhou was caught off guard and plunged into the sea bottom.
```
```
"So-called Immortal Disciples are merely this," laughed the cultivator who had used the Bihai Tide Birth technique, his eyes revealing a mocking smile. He was thankful he had made ample preparations and brought enough people. If only five Divine Transformation Stage Cultivators had come, they really wouldn't be able to deal with these Immortal Sect geniuses.
```
```
"We also don't wish to be hostile with the Immortal Sect. Just hand over the rare treasure that has emerged, swiftly leave Fangshan Island, and we can let bygones be bygones!"
```
```
They wanted not merely Immortal Herbs but also the fifth-grade Spirit Veins!
```
```
Lu Yang steadied himself in the air and glared coldly at the three opponents, "East Sea Cultivators truly are remarkable; daring to look down on our Five Elements Sect—do you take us for made of mud!"
```
```
"Where are my people!" Lu Yang bellowed.
```
```
"Here!"
```
Meng Jingzhou surged out of the sea, his body emitting steams of scalding vapor as the vigorous Yang Qi dried the seawater on his skin.
Man Gu's eyes were blood-red; this time, they had summoned a barbarian general who had seen battle, a subordinate of the first Emperor Xia.
Li Haoran, wreathed in flames, had his wounds from the whipping chains heal rapidly.
Tao Yaoye closed her red paper umbrella as two Divine Transformation Stage Cultivators became lifeless, trapped in an illusion, and tumbled into the sea.
The Cultivators of the East Sea cultivated their powers but not their hearts, hence they were not adept at dealing with illusionary realms.
"Form up!"
The five of them took their respective positions as if they had practiced countless times.
"Is this... the Five Elements Sect's Five Elements Battle Formation?!"
One of the Divine Transformation Stage Cultivators exclaimed in shock; he had seen Five Elements Sect disciples in action in Great Xia before—five Nascent Soul Early Stage disciples who had used the Five Elements Battle Formation and had actually defeated five Divine Transformation late-stage Cultivators!
"So there are still some who know their stuff, Arhat Fist!"
Lu Yang stood at the metal position, leading the assault. Under the enhancement of the Five Elements Battle Formation, his speed and strength increased geometrically. He moved as fast as lightning, each punch landing precisely on the abdomen, causing his opponents' organs to revolt in pain.
Their hair was falling out in clumps.
"Stop him quickly!"
"Turbulent Sea Scripture!"
The three Divine Transformation Stage Cultivators wanted to repeat their old trick, but Lu Yang's combat power had long since evolved, with each punch and kick comparable to the impact of mountains—unstoppable.
His Sword Qi was even more dazzling, slicing through layers of water curtains and reflecting the horrified visages of the three Divine Transformation Stage Cultivators on the blade of the sword.
"Twin Ice Dragon Chant!"
Two ice dragons burst from the water, aiming to bite Lu Yang. Man Gu used Shadow Shifting to swap locations with Lu Yang and, with a loud yell, endured the attack from the two ice dragons.
Meng Jingzhou unleashed Nirvana True Fire, causing Man Gu's frostbite to recover rapidly.
Man Gu stood at the earth position, taking charge of defense.
Meng Jingzhou took up the water position, focusing on healing.
Tao Yaoye took the wood position, leading the changes, capable of teleporting the team instantly to anywhere within the great formation and coordinating the combat of the other four.
"Don't think you're the only ones who can use combination techniques, the Ocean's Boundless Measure!"
The five Divine Transformation Stage Cultivators, having gathered strength in secret, produced a tsunami over a hundred meters high. Within it loomed ghastly faces and hands that, with sorrowful screams, lunged at Lu Yang and the others.
If Lu Yang and his companions dodged, Fangshan Island behind them would be submerged in the ocean!
"Let me handle this!" Li Haoran called out, as several types of flames appeared around him!
Three Flavored True Fire, Golden Bird True Flame, Nirvana True Flame, Six-C Divine Fire, Dayan True Fire, Samadhi True Fire, Nanming Li Fire!
Most of these flames were learnt by the five from the Fire Vein of the Five Elements Sect.
Under the boost of the Five Elements Battle Formation, Li Haoran could wield all the True Fires mastered by everyone!
Li Haoran stood at the fire position, assisting in attack!
The seven types of flames intertwined, forming a soaring fire tornado that met the ghastly tsunami with fervent heat and destruction.
Boom!
The tsunami collapsed, and the ghosts hidden within it perished in wails—the collected souls of hundreds of years from those five Divine Transformation Stage Cultivators, gone in an instant!
"Attack together!"
Twelve Divine Transformation Stage Cultivators struck simultaneously, seeking a flaw in the Five Elements Battle Formation. But how could the skills passed down for a hundred thousand years from the Five Elements Sect have any flaws for them to exploit? Not to mention Lu Yang and his team's seamless coordination, as if they had practiced for years.
The twelve Divine Transformation Stage Cultivators fled in a bloody retreat, using skills like the Great Demonic Technique to escape in a blood-fueled dash, in utter disarray.
The Five Elements Battle Formation had overwhelming combat strength, but it was not known for speed. Catching one or two Divine Transformation Stage Cultivators was conceivable, but the remaining ten were certainly going to escape.
A smile curved Lu Yang's lips, "You think you can just run after losing? Just right, I've learned a new move from my master, so I might as well practice on you guys!"
"Old Meng, lend me a hand!"
Meng Jingzhou was bewildered, not understanding what Lu Yang was borrowing from him. Then, his body tilted, and Lu Yang grabbed his ankle, lifting him up.
"Hey hey hey, what are you doing?"
"Quit your chatter, quickly use Three Heads and Six Arms, One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand Swords!"
"Why has it gotten dark?" Gao Feng puzzled, as if the moonlight above had suddenly disappeared, not forgetting to look up at the sky even in his frantic escape.
This glance chilled him to the bone.
The dense shadows blocking the moonlight weren't anyone else, it was Meng Jingzhou!
Thousands of Meng Jingzhous, each using Three Heads and Six Arms, descended from the sky, yelling and punching as they fell, striking towards the twelve Divine Transformation Stage Cultivators scattering in all directions!

chapters.title: Chapter 752 - 751: One Meng Transforms into Ten Thousand Mengs
chapters.content:
The East Sea had always been known for its vastness and abundance, famously hosting all sorts of rarities. Twelve Divine Transformation Stage cultivators could certainly be considered leaders in their own right, frequently attending various banquets and having seen their share of wonders—not to mention the odd-looking members of the Sea Clan from the depths of the ocean.
But they truly had never seen a swarm of Meng Jingzhous falling from the sky.
Not even in their wildest nightmares had they envisioned such a scene.
A sky full of Meng Jingzhous exhibited their three heads and six arms technique, covering an immensely wide area. It was futile for the twelve Divine Transformation Stage cultivators to scatter and flee, as they were all within the reach of the One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand Swords attack.
The three heroes of Fangshan Island, who watched from a distance, were completely dumbfounded.
Lu Yang was huffing and puffing with exhaustion. Unleashing this terrifying move was not easy. Deploying the standard One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand Swords involved solidifying sword intent into a sword body. And if one could form a sword body, one could also form the Sword Washing Pool, or even Meng Jingzhou.
The normal application of One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand Swords didn't demand much from one's Spiritual Sense; its main mode of attack was simply overwhelming the enemy with a barrage of flying swords.
However, One Meng Becoming Ten Thousand Mengs was not so simple. It was equivalent to thousands of Meng Jingzhous attacking at once, requiring an immensely powerful Spiritual Sense to execute—a feat not even Lu Yang's Spiritual Sense could manage on its own.
Luckily, they were in the midst of using the Five Elements Battle Formation which not only allowed for sharing strength but also sharing Spiritual Sense.
It goes without saying that Lu Yang's Spiritual Sense was the best among his peers.
Meng Jingzhou, having constantly contended with Yang Qi, had also cultivated his Spiritual Sense to formidable strength.
Tao Yaoye, who excelled in Illusionary Realms, also possessed an exceedingly powerful Spiritual Sense.
Li Haoran, having inherited Qin Haoran's memories, had likewise seen an expansion of his Spiritual Sense.
As for Man Gu... Man Gu's Spiritual Sense was rather average.
Only by combining the Spiritual Senses of all four individuals—Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, Tao Yaoye, and Li Haoran—were they able to perform One Meng Becoming Ten Thousand Mengs.
"I just thought to give it a try; if it hadn't worked, we could have switched to the Sword Washing Pool. I didn't expect it to be a success," Lu Yang said, stroking his chin. It was a tactic he had come up with on the spur of the moment, and now it seemed the effect was quite satisfactory.
Meng Jingzhou was screaming and swinging his fists around, not needing to worry about any particular technique as the intensity of the Spiritual Sense didn't allow for such fine control.
Just fight and get it over with.
Those at the Divine Transformation Stage, already wounded, were beaten into the sea one by one like dumplings being dropped into a pot by the multitudes of Meng Jingzhous attacking them.
The thousands of Meng Jingzhous vanished.
"Thought you could run!" When Meng Jingzhou returned, he had six Divine Transformation Stage cultivators in his six hands.
Lu Yang and the others also sprang into action, entering the sea to retrieve the fallen Divine Transformation Stage cultivators.
"One, two, three... all twelve accounted for," Lu Yang declared, as if the mission was accomplished. He clapped his hands and took an Elixir to restore his strength.
The three heroes of Fangshan Island, who had witnessed the whole process, had their eyes popping out of their heads. These were twelve Divine Transformation Stage cultivators!
They had heard that Immortal Sect disciples possessed extraordinary combat prowess, unbeaten among their peers and even capable of challenging those of higher Cultivation Levels. Yet they had not imagined it to this extreme. Faced with opponents who both in Cultivation Level and number far exceeded them, not only had they won, but they had also taken them all alive?!
As the three heroes saw the fight end and thought to approach, they heard Lu Yang telepathically cautioning them.
"Don't come over just yet. If you three come over now and learn of their identities, you're bound to attract vengeance in the future."
Upon hearing this, the trio immediately understood the implication.
Lu Yang proceeded to remove the masks from each of the captured individuals, snorting coldly.
"Daring to oppose our Five Elements Sect, they must truly not wish to live. Have they not ventured out to inquire? In Great Xia, aside from the Seek Dao Sect, who would dare provoke someone from our Five Elements Sect?"
"Do you have a Semi-Immortal backing you up by any chance?"
The cultivators at the Divinity Transformation Stage broke into a cold sweat and kept kowtowing, not to mention having a Semi-Immortal supporting them, they had never even heard of a Semi-Immortal in the entire East Sea.
"All you know is to kowtow and beg for mercy, not very impressive. Hand over all your valuables," Meng Jingzhou kicked over Gao Feng, signaling them to be more cooperative.
Robbery is also a distinctive feature of the East Sea, one must experience it at least once.
The cultivators at the Divinity Transformation Stage were filled with regret. Wasn't it said that Great Xia was peaceful and that cultivators only sparred without intending to kill? Why did it not seem to be the case at all?
The local cultivators of the East Sea couldn't surpass this attitude either.
As captives, it was already their great fortune to be alive; wealth was a trivial external possession... While comforting themselves with this thought, they painfully took out their most cherished treasures.
Cultivation techniques, maps, secret realm information, magic artifacts, spirit stones...
Li Haoran shook his head in disappointment: "The level of you East Sea cultivators is really lacking. Handing over your storage rings just like that, if it were me, I would prepare two storage rings, one overt and one covert. The covert ring would be hidden inside my body, casually tear a slit in my flesh, place the storage ring inside, and then let the flesh heal."
Due to personal reasons, Li Haoran had substantial experience in hiding things.
The cultivators at the Divinity Transformation Stage hung their heads in shame upon hearing his words, realizing even their experience in hiding things was inferior to the disciples of the Five Elements Sect.
"Alright, the rare treasure of Fangshan Island now belongs to our Five Elements Sect, all of you get lost!"
"Yes, yes, yes." The cultivators at the Divinity Transformation Stage felt as if they had received a great pardon and nodded eagerly.
"Wait a second, don't leave just yet, there's one more thing,"
"Please speak," the cultivators at the Divinity Transformation Stage, seeing Meng Jingzhou stopping them, thought he might change his mind on a whim and were all on tenterhooks.
"The three heroes of Fangshan Island have done us a great favor; I've memorized all of your faces. If I ever learn that something has happened to Fangshan Island, regardless of whether or not you are suspected, none of you will escape my wrath!"
Meng Jingzhou paused, then glared and shouted angrily, "Why are you still standing there? Get lost, am I supposed to keep you here for dinner?"
Upon hearing this, the cultivators at the Divinity Transformation Stage fled as if their lives depended on it; the five of them were too malevolent, and even their mere presence was terrifying.
Thus, the matter was concluded, and the three heroes of Fangshan Island flew over timidly.
"Is it, is it over?" Hero Yan still felt the situation was somewhat surreal.
"It's over. In the future, if anyone asks about the whereabouts of the rare treasure, you just have to tell the truth," Lu Yang said. Feathered Immortal Herbs were too valuable, a treasure that even a cultivator at the body Integration Realm would covet. For the three heroes to possess it was more a curse than a blessing.
Immortal herbs were not something they were qualified to possess in the first place. To have obtained a fifth-grade spirit vein was already a great stroke of luck, and the three heroes were all very grateful to Lu Yang and his companions.
Suddenly, Lu Yang thought of another safety concern, "If I remember correctly, a fifth-grade spirit vein is usually in the possession of a Divine Transformation Stage Cultivator. Won't it be risky for you three to have it?"
It was common in the East Sea for cultivators to fight over territory; otherwise, the maps from a hundred years ago wouldn't be so different from those of today.
Even after Lu Yang warned those twelve cultivators at the Divinity Transformation Stage, it was uncertain whether other cultivators at the same stage might covet this place.
Hero Yan sighed, "Indeed, it's not very safe, but there's not much we can do about it. The immediate plan is to rely on the fifth-grade spirit vein for cultivation and advance to the Divinity Transformation Stage as soon as possible. Only then will Fangshan Island truly be secure."
"From what I see, your cultivation level is already at the late stage of the Nascent Soul, isn't it?" Lu Yang suddenly commented.
Hero Yan informed truthfully, "Previously it was at the late stage Consummation of Nascent Soul. After drinking the Enlightenment Tea, I've reached the Half Step to Divinity Transformation Stage. It's just that I don't know when I'll be able to take the final step."
Lu Yang smiled and said, "Why not take advantage of tonight and let you ascend to the Divinity Transformation Stage."

chapters.title: Chapter 753 - 752 Soul Condensing Pills
chapters.content:
"Tonight?!" Yan Chuan thought he must be hallucinating.
Ascending to the Divinity Transformation Stage, was he supposed to ascend just like that today?
He had prepared to ascend to the Divinity Transformation Stage within the next twenty years.
Step back a bit, to ascend to the Divinity Transformation Stage one must Pass Thunder Tribulation, and for that, many contingencies must be prepared with no room for negligence.
Helping someone ascend to the Divinity Transformation Stage, especially those in the Half-Step Divinity Transformation, was fairly simple for Lu Yang, a matter of just a single Elixir.
Immortal Disciples prioritized their own Cultivation Realm and at most, they used Elixirs as a supplement.
Elixirs, after all, are external aids; power gained through reliance on them tends to have flaws and is not beneficial for future Cultivation.
It was different for Yan Chuan. As a Loose Cultivator, being able to reach the Nascent Soul Stage was already extremely fortunate. To reach the Nascent Soul Stage, he had switched through countless Cultivation techniques, leading to a chaotic vital energy, making it difficult to further his Realm.
Consuming Elixirs could actually help him purify and organize his vital energy.
"Senior Brother Lu, do you have an Elixir that can help someone breakthrough to the Divinity Transformation Stage?" Tao Yaoye asked. If they were at the Refining Pill peak, such Elixirs would be plentiful, but this was the East Sea, who would carry Elixirs they didn't need themselves?
"Coincidentally, yes."
Lu Yang fumbled around in his Identity Jade, and took out a bottle of Elixirs.
The round Elixirs rolled out, making Yan Chuan's eyes widen.
"Soul, Soul Condensing Pills?"
This was a precious Elixir with no set market price. He had seen it twice at auctions, where it fetched sky-high prices, and one of those times, a bidder was a disciple from the Yingzhou Islands.
Even disciples from the Yingzhou Islands had to obtain Soul Condensing Pills from the outside world, which showed how precious the Elixir was.
This Soul Condensing Pill came from the time when Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou went to the Demon Territory. The Third Senior Sister didn't bring a gift to meet them, so she took Lu Yang and the others to raid the legacy of a certain Suan Ni, which she had slain when she first arrived in the Demon Territory. The legacy of that Suan Ni included a Soul Condensing Pill.
Lu Yang had never seen what the Thunder Tribulation of the Divinity Transformation Stage looked like and took this opportunity to broaden his horizons.
"It's of no use to me, Yan Chuan, it's yours." Lu Yang casually tossed the Soul Condensing Pill to Yan Chuan, with a gesture as casual as if he were throwing a sugar bean.
Yan Chuan caught the Soul Condensing Pill with both hands, treasuring it immensely.
"But, but I'm not ready to Pass Thunder Tribulation." The hope of ascending to the Divinity Transformation Stage was in his hands, but Yan Chuan knew his own limits. Being a common Nascent Soul Stage cultivator, he had a high probability of being killed by Thunder Tribulation without proper preparation.
"Oh right, I forgot Thunder Tribulation can actually kill people." Lu Yang just remembered a fact he had long neglected.
After thinking about the people he knew, Lu Yang finally recalled an example: "Speaking of which, the only person I know who was killed by Tribulation was Qin Haoran."
If Qin Haoran hadn't died, there wouldn't be a Li Haoran now.
"Fairy, do you have a solution?" After much thought, Lu Yang decided to ask for a strategy from the resourceful Fairy Eternity.
"To Pass Thunder Tribulation, the most important thing is to have confidence. As long as your confidence is strong enough, Thunder Tribulation is just a formality."
"Really? There's such a theory?" Lu Yang wondered to himself when he had ever heard of this theory.
"At least when I Passed Tribulation, that's how I did it, all the way up to the Immortal Tribulation."
Lu Yang: "..."
Was this really about confidence, or was it because you, Fairy, were simply too strong?
If he told this method to Yan Chuan, he was afraid that with full confidence, Yan Chuan would be struck dead by the Thunder Tribulation.
Since Fairy was unreliable, he had to rely on himself.
"Junior Brother Li, you have the most experience, do you have any methods?"
Li Haoran thought for a moment before saying, "Passing Tribulation is most importantly about relying on oneself. If there are others helping out, it will only increase the power of Thunder Tribulation. So when Yan Chuan Passes Thunder Tribulation, we cannot interfere."
"However, with Yan Chuan's cultivation level, passing the Thunder Tribulation is indeed difficult. Therefore, you can attempt to use a magic artifact to resist the Thunder Tribulation; it's just that using a magic artifact is not a good method, as it won't have the effect of body tempering through the tribulation.
Once you reach the Divinity Transformation Stage, you'll be inherently weaker than others."
"We should find a way to temporarily enhance Yan Chuan's physical body."
At this moment, Meng Jingzhou had an idea, "How about this, Yan Chuan temporarily possesses me, taking control of my body to pass the Thunder Tribulation. This way, the soul will be tempered, while Yan Chuan can place his own corpse on top of my head, so the physical body is tempered as well."
"With both the soul and body tempered, once combined, it will be as if both have been refined."
Yan Chuan felt that this method wasn't very reliable.
After discussing back and forth, they finally chose the most straightforward method—feeding elixirs.
The newly submitted storage ring contained elixirs that provide temporary bursts of power, all meant for use during the Divinity Transformation Stage—absolutely reliable. If Yan Chuan feels that he can't get through it, just take one.
"Yan Chuan, relax and believe in yourself," Lu Yang had not forgotten Fairy Eternity's way, as he encouraged Yan Chuan before he faced the tribulation.
"I will not let you down!"
Yan Chuan clasped his fists, his expression resolute. Now filled with unprecedented confidence, all five Immortal Sect disciples had done their utmost to help him; if he still lacked confidence, it would be inexcusable.
Yan Chuan went to the mountaintop and asked everyone to stay far away.
He first took a Soul Condensing Pill, and his foot that had been hesitantly hovering at the threshold of the Divinity Transformation Stage finally stepped over!
His entire body felt like it was ablaze, heating up from inside out.
Boom.
The clouds were dense, rolling incessantly like spilled ink. Amidst them, lightning flashed and thunder roared, dancing wildly like dragons and snakes, illuminating the entire night sky as if it were daylight.
"Come on!" Yan Chuan shouted loudly with a resolute as-if-throwing-caution-to-the-wind attitude.
An extremely fiery purple thunderbolt cleaved down from the clouds, unstoppable as if splitting bamboo, ferocious beyond compare, with the force to destroy everything, striking directly at Yan Chuan.
He saw his eyes slightly close, a low shout coming from his mouth as his hands formed seals. In an instant, a brilliant golden light surged around him, turning into a huge golden shield, and forcefully received this thunderbolt capable of destroying mountains.
The other two heroes witnessed this scene and were deeply moved. The power of the Thunder Tribulation was terrifying; could their senior brother really withstand it?
"This Thunder Tribulation doesn't seem to be very strong, does it?" Man Gu telepathically remarked.
"The ordinary Thunder Tribulation at the Divinity Transformation Stage is just like this," Li Haoran explained. This tribulation was like a drizzle to them, but a great test for Yan Chuan.
As the thunderclouds churned, each subsequent thunderbolt was more powerful than the last, each one more terrifying. They seemed to crush both Yan Chuan's will and physical body simultaneously, yet Yan Chuan did not take any elixirs; relying solely on his own cultivation level, he withstood the repeated purifications of the Thunder Tribulation.
After the Thunder Tribulation passed, the dark clouds dissipated.
Yan Chuan sat cross-legged on the mountain peak, his clothes tattered, and his hair singed, looking like a beggar.
He opened his eyes, feeling the power he had just gained, unable to contain his joy, and burst into hearty laughter.
He flew down from the mountain and bowed to Lu Yang and the others, "Thank you all for your help. I have no way to repay your great kindness and generosity!"
"Senior brother, you made it?!" Another hero's voice trembled, hugging Yan Chuan, crying and laughing at the same time.
Yan Chuan couldn't help but cry as well.
He had thought that his life would stagnate at the Nascent Soul Stage, with no hope for Spirit Transformation, but unexpectedly, with the help of Lu Yang and the others, he had ascended to the Divinity Transformation Stage without even taking the emergency elixirs!
Fairy Eternity was triumphant, not at all surprised, "How about that, didn't I say that you could make it through on faith alone?"
Lu Yang was genuinely shocked; he hadn't realized confidence could be so effective. Could it be that he could also pass the tribulation like this?
"With me around to protect you, you'll surely have full confidence, and passing the tribulation won't be a problem!"
Lu Yang's unwavering confidence wavered.

chapters.title: Chapter 754 - 753: Feathered Immortal Herbs
chapters.content:
"Hero Yan, you have just broken through your realm and your foundation is not stable. You should seek a quiet place to retreat and cultivate, which is the most important thing to do right now," Lu Yang kindly advised.
"You're right, Daoist," Hero Yan replied to Lu Yang with the utmost respect. With the arrival of Lu Yang and his four companions, Fangshan Island had gained a fifth-grade Spirit Vein, and he himself had succeeded in passing the Thunder Tribulation to become a cultivator at the Spirit Transformation Stage.
With the help of the fifth-grade Spirit Vein, his two brothers also had a chance, albeit slight, to cultivate to the Divinity Transformation Stage.
Little did he expect that his kind gesture of telling Lu Yang about the banquet hosted by True Master Ma would bring such rewards.
Wait, that being said, didn't True Master Ma's banquet seem to have just taken place this morning?
Hero Yan reviewed the day's events:
In the morning, he attended True Master Ma's banquet.
At noon, he invited Lu Yang and his four companions to Fangshan Island.
In the afternoon, the Spirit Vein fluctuated, and Immortal Herbs appeared.
At night, twelve cultivators at the Divinity Transformation Stage attacked, and he took Soul Condensing Pills and became a cultivator at that stage.
"How should we deal with the Feather Transformation Immortal Herb? Should we take it back with us or consume it now?" Lu Yang and his company gestured towards the Feather Transformation Immortal Herb, contemplating which option was more beneficial.
"Why don't we pluck a leaf and try it, to see how many years of cultivation it can enhance?" Li Haoran had heard of the Feather Transformation Immortal Herb but had never seen it, let alone consumed it.
Lu Yang shook his head, dismissing Li Haoran's idea, "The Immortal Herb is precious. If we pluck a leaf without the proper sealing method, the medicinal properties will escape through the break, making the loss outweigh the gains."
"If consumed in its entirety, it can indeed rapidly enhance cultivation level, but skipping the settling phase might actually be detrimental to future cultivation."
Ordinarily, the Feather Transformation Immortal Herb is consumed by those at the Body Integration Realm or the Transcendence Tribulation Stage. These stages of cultivation to consummation require not enlightenment but time-consuming effort.
"In my opinion, we should take it back to the sect and hear what Eldest Senior Sister has to say."
Everyone nodded, finding this to be a good idea.
Lu Yang placed the Immortal Herb into a wooden box and affixed several talismans.
...
When the night was deep and everyone was quiet, the wooden box shook continuously as if an invisible hand was touching it.
Opening the box, the Immortal Herb shook its head and stealthily climbed out.
It looked up at Lu Yang, who was meditating, and sneered disdainfully.
"You want to eat me? In your dreams."
That being said, it remained vigilant, cautiously climbing down the bed. The moment it tried to push open the window, the lamp lit up, brightening the room.
A chilling voice came from behind the Immortal Herb.
"It really is an Immortal Herb that has gained sentience."
The Feather Transformation Immortal Herb twisted its head abruptly to see Lu Yang, who was smiling enigmatically.
Swish, swish, swish—four figures appeared in the room, encircling the Feather Transformation Immortal Herb.
"Senior Brother Lu really guessed right; this is a Little Medicinal King," Tao Yaoye said, her eyes gleaming as she looked at the Feather Transformation Immortal Herb.
"Who would have thought to find a Little Medicinal King in the East Sea," Li Haoran commented in amazement. Immortal Herbs were rare enough, but this one was a Little Medicinal King, which even cultivators at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage would desperately covet.
"First time seeing a Little Medicinal King, eh? Does it taste good?" Man Gu had never been to a medicinal garden.
When they openly discussed how to deal with the Immortal Herb earlier, Lu Yang secretly transmitted a message to them, suspecting that it was a Little Medicinal King-level Immortal Herb.
In the evening, when the Immortal Herb heard that it was to be taken back to the Sect, it could no longer keep up the act and showed its true colors.
Actually, Lu Yang wasn't suspicious; he had heard from Fairy Eternity that, based on the age, this Immortal Herb was planted in the Ancient Times, and its owner might have been the Saint Heir who used to bully men and women and was beaten up by Fairy Eternity.
That Saint Heir also had a Feather Transformation Immortal Body; seeing he couldn't defeat Fairy Eternity, he borrowed power from the future to raise his realm to the Void Refinement Stage.
Then he got beaten even worse.
"I figure it was planted here in Ancient Times. After I beat him up a few times, his brain stopped working right, and he forgot where the Immortal Herb was planted," Fairy Eternity assuredly analyzed, and it seemed to make sense.
Lu Yang felt that this Kunlun Saint Heir was really unlucky.
Having grown from the Ancient Times until now, one would know it must have gained consciousness.
Spiritual Plants with consciousness naturally yearn for freedom; they're planted in the ground for a lifetime without the ability to move, and once they can finally roam, they certainly want to wander and play everywhere.
The Feather Transformation Immortal Herb usually moved around Fangshan Island through Spirit Veins, which is why there were legends of rare treasures in the Spirit Veins on Fangshan Island.
This time, it resonated with Tao Yaoye and was discovered by Lu Yang and the others, so it knew it was going to be taken back. Thus, it feigned death during the day, making Lu Yang and the others let down their guard, planning to run away at night.
Unfortunately, its plan didn't succeed.
"Who planted you originally?" Meng Jingzhou asked curiously.
"Human race, watch your tone!" The Feather Transformation Immortal Herb looked down on the short-lived Human race, and of course, the Demon Race was considered short-lived in its eyes too.
Meng Jingzhou's palm produced a clump of Pure Yang Flame, his tone ice-cold, "How about we roast you to eat?"
His barbecue skills hadn't gone to waste, let alone the fact that the three founding members of the barbecue shop were all there.
Man Gu knowingly whipped out the Man family's ancestral secret sauce, and if he was lucky, he might even channel the spirit of the Man family's first-generation ancestor.
The Feather Transformation Immortal Herb, feeling the scorching flames, flapped its leaves, trying to extinguish the fire in Meng Jingzhou's palm, and said with a forced smile, "It's just a joke, see how you can't take a joke?"
"Really, it's not that I don't want to tell you; I genuinely don't know who planted me."
"At the time I was planted, I wasn't a Little Medicinal King."
Lu Yang nodded; that was the truth. If the Feather Transformation Immortal Herb had been a Little Medicinal King in the Ancient Times, then the Kunlun Saint Heir would have carried the pot everywhere, ensuring the Immortal Herb was with him at all times.
"Fairy, the Kunlun Saint Heir isn't still alive, is he? Should we return the property to its original owner?" Even in the treacherous East Sea, Lu Yang still harbored a conscience.
Fairy Eternity casually waved her hand, "No need; he is already dead. According to the rules of the Ancient Times, this Immortal Herb should belong to me. But I don't need this thing either, so I'm giving it to you youngsters."
Lu Yang's heart skipped a beat; he couldn't believe that the strife of the Great Era of the Ancient Times was truly cruel. Even the mighty Feather Transformation Immortal Body fell to Fairy Eternity's hand, and judging from Fairy Eternity's tone, this Kunlun Saint Heir wasn't even considered a strong opponent.
"That was when I was still a Semi-Immortal. The Kunlun Saint Heir... oh, he had become the Saint Lord by then. The Kunlun Saint Lord insisted on fighting with me. Just like before, unable to defeat me, he continued to borrow power from his future self through his Feather Transformation Immortal Body."
"Then you killed him?"
"Not at all. It was him borrowing power from his future self that got himself killed."
Lu Yang listened, completely confused and didn't understand what happened.
Seeing Lu Yang so befuddled, Fairy Eternity patiently explained, "His future self was already dead. When he borrowed power from his future self, he also borrowed the state of being dead, leading to his current self's death as well."
"See? Does that make it a closed loop?"
Lu Yang: "..."
Wait, why is my brain even more confused now?
Fairy, did any of your opponents ever make sense?

chapters.title: Chapter 755 - 754 Safe Journey
chapters.content:
The Feathered Immortal Herb, surrounded by Lu Yang and his four companions, especially Meng Jingzhou holding the Pure Yang True Fire and staring at it with fierce intent, knew that escape was futile, sighed deeply, and accepted its fate.
"Alright, alright, I won't run anymore."
Compared to being roasted and eaten now, being captured and kept for later was clearly the way to survive.
"That's more like it," Meng Jingzhou said as the Feathered Immortal Herb calmed down, clenching his fist to withdraw the flames, while Man Gu astutely put away the barbecue seasoning.
Man Gu had just gone through several ancestors without getting to the very first ancestor of the barbecue Man family.
"But just to be clear, you can't eat me, at least not all of me," the Feathered Immortal Herb said, eyeing the five cautiously.
"Of course," they replied.
A Little Medicinal King like the Feathered Immortal Herb was extremely precious; no one would consume it all at once. The other Little Medicinal Kings in the medicinal garden were all living well, maybe just plucking a few leaves and roots when necessary, but never harming the main body.
"Can I trust your promise?" the Feathered Immortal Herb asked suspiciously, looking at Lu Yang. It had seen everything clearly during the battle with the Divinity Transformation Stage, noticing you, boy, were the most cunning.
"I swear to the Yingtian Immortal, that if I lied just now, may the Yingtian Immortal bring down lightning to strike me!" Lu Yang lifted three fingers and swore to the heavens.
"That harsh?!"
The Feathered Immortal Herb, shocked by Lu Yang's ruthless oath, shook its leaves a couple of times, the equivalent of nodding in belief.
"Don't worry, we won't mistreat you. Our sect has several Little Medicinal Kings," said Li Haoran with a hearty laugh. As the reincarnation of Master Qin, he had learned Master Qin's way of managing people; to get subordinates to obey, one must use both the stick and the carrot.
At the same time, the ability of Master Qin to provide not actual items as carrots had also been learned by Li Haoran.
"Junior Sister Tao, you have a connection with the Immortal Herb. Before we return to the sect, would it be alright to entrust it to you for safekeeping?" Lu Yang asked with a smile.
Little Medicinal Kings cannot be kept in Storage Rings; they must be packed in boxes and wrapped up.
He already had Fairy Eternity chattering in his ear and certainly didn't want another Little Medicinal King around.
"Then thank you, Senior Brother Lu, for the trust," Tao Yaoye happily accepted. Being together with a Little Medicinal King, not to mention anything else, would surely be enlightening.
For a Little Medicinal King to live so long was not without reason.
The Feathered Immortal Herb had a unique ability to hide its presence, even from the Spiritual Sense of a Transcendance Tribulation Stage Great Power, who couldn't find it.
One day later, Hero Yan came out of seclusion, solidifying his realm, and was now a genuine Divinity Transformation Stage cultivator.
Moving up to the Divinity Transformation Stage, one would normally be full of pride and energy, but Hero Yan was not. He always maintained a humble heart.
After all, the incredible feat of Lu Yang and his four companions capturing twelve Divinity Transformation Stage cultivators with only their Nascent Soul Stage Cultivation Level was vivid in memory.
"Hero Yan, are you going to Penglai Island to seek a promotion? Could you possibly take us five with you?" Lu Yang asked politely. Previously, as a Manager in the East Sea Cultivator Alliance, now that he had advanced to the Divinity Transformation Stage, he could apply to raise his rank to Hall Master.
Coming to the East Sea, one must at least take a stroll around Penglai Island.
With the map given by Old Ma, they knew how to get to Penglai Island, but being unfamiliar with the place, it was better to ask Hero Yan for an introduction.
"Of course," Hero Yan quickly replied.
After Yue Daxia gave some instructions to the other two heroes, he prepared to set out for Penglai Island.
Penglai Island was far from Fangshan Island. In the past, Yue Daxia had to stop several times while flying to Penglai Island, but with his successful advancement to the Divinity Transformation Stage, his Dantian expanded and his spiritual essence was abundant, eliminating such troubles.
...
"...Five Daoists... slow down," Yue Daxia called out, gasping for breath as he watched the five in front of him fly ahead.
Yue Daxia sat on a painting, which wobbled uncertainly as if it could plunge into the sea at any moment.
He had never imagined that, as a cultivator in the Divinity Transformation Stage, he would have less spiritual energy than Lu Yang and the other four. He had just been promoted and didn't have any Divinity-level energy restoration pills on hand.
Lu Yang stood on a Flying Sword, spun around, and picked up double lines of water spray on the water's surface, gracefully stopping in front of Yue Daxia.
"Yue Daxia, are you alright?"
"Slow, slow down," he pleaded.
Seeing that Yue Daxia was running out of energy, the five slowed down willingly.
Just then, a hundred-meter-long whale emerged from the water, blowing a water spout a hundred meters high from its blowhole, which displayed a rainbow of colors under the sunlight.
"How come we always encounter these kinds of whales on the way?"
"These are whales trained by the Alliance. Their bellies contain a world within and can transport people. They are expensive; even those in the Qi Cultivation Stage can't afford it. I rode one when I was in the Golden Core Stage, but as my cultivation level increased and I became faster than the whales, I stopped using them," someone explained.
"This sea route leads to Penglai Island; that's why we keep seeing them."
Lu Yang nodded, realizing that these whales were akin to the flying ships of Great Xia.
"If Yue Daxia really is too tired, why not take a ride in the whale's belly?" Man Gu kindly suggested.
Yue Daxia nodded reluctantly. He wasn't short of money now, but thinking back to his proud departure made him feel a bit embarrassed.
The journey continued without incident, and the six of them successfully arrived at Penglai Island.
Except for their initial entry into the whale's belly, when they happened upon a whale hijacked by a Tribulation Cultivator demanding everything from the passengers. Later, Lu Yang and others helped out, only to find a group disguised as ordinary cultivators, actually armed escorts transporting goods. The Tribulation Cultivator's target was precisely these goods.
They robbed everyone to conceal their true purpose.
Additionally, the whale accidentally entered a maelstrom, being transported to an unknown Secret Realm, where a Unification level demon was sealed. They later discovered that someone among the passengers had long been bewitched by the demon, deliberately leading everyone into the Secret Realm to sacrifice to the demon.
Fortunately, among the passengers was the only daughter of a Unification True Monarch, who had run away, disguised as a man, mingling and chatting cheerfully with Lu Yang and the others. When the daughter faced danger, her father came to rescue her, dealing with the demon, returning everyone and the whale to the original sea route, and the daughter had to bid farewell to Lu Yang and his companions.
Moreover, Yue Daxia recovered his energy and left the whale. During the flight, they encountered the Sea Hare Tribe and the Clam Clan at war, sparked by the Clam Clan's loss of a precious treasure, pointing the blame at the Sea Hare Tribe. Later, Lu Yang found the lost treasure, which was the cargo previously escorted by the armed guards, halted the war, and unraveled the mystery.
It turned out to be caused by the Clam Clan Leader's daughter. Confessing her act, she had been in a secret love with someone from another race, not accepted by her clan, and in revenge, she stole the Clam Pearl, sparking the war. The band of Tribulation Cultivators who robbed them earlier were arranged by her lover.
"We're finally at Penglai Island. The security in the East Sea is really poor; even riding a whale entails so many incidents," Lu Yang grumbled quietly.
Meng Jingzhou and the other three nodded in agreement, sharing that the conditions in the East Sea were far from those in Great Xia.
Yue Daxia looked at the five with a peculiar gaze. He thought, "I've ridden whales countless times between the Foundation Establishment and Golden Core Stages without a single incident."
Is it still possible to distance myself from them now?
If it really comes down to it, I can forfeit my cultivation level, and even demote my Spirit Vein.

chapters.title: Chapter 756 - 756: 755
chapters.content:
Penglai Island, as the headquarters of the East Sea Cultivator Alliance and the largest force of the East Sea human race, truly boasted an extraordinary style. A continuous stream of whales docked at the shore, and as they opened their mouths, cultivators surged forward, coming out from within the whales' maws.
The island's inhabitants were still predominantly ordinary people, but cultivators were not in short supply. They could be seen everywhere, with those at the Qi Refinement Stage and Foundation Establishment Stage being particularly common. Compared to Fangshan Island, Penglai was as different as heaven and earth.
The Island Master of Penglai was an old cultivator at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. According to the classification of Great Xia, Penglai Island was considered a super-grade force, one of only nine in the entire Great Xia.
Moreover, Penglai Island gathered the vast majority of East Sea cultivators, with profound and imposing foundations, even stronger than the super-grade sects of Great Xia by several measures.
Upon arriving at the Alliance headquarters, Daoist Yan found himself before a nine-layered pagoda. The pagoda was ancient and had endured many years, having gone through countless baptisms of time. Each layer of the pagoda was engraved with talismans, array methods, or patterns that contained the profound truths of the Dao, exemplifying the mysteries of the laws of heaven and earth.
Standing before the pagoda, one felt as small as an ant.
"Five esteemed Daoists, I shall first go in to register at the Alliance. Once I am finished with my affairs, I will then take you all on a tour of Penglai Island. Does that sound good?" Daoist Yan said with a cupped-fist salute. Non-members of the Alliance were not allowed to enter the pagoda.
"No problem at all, Daoist Yan, you go ahead with your business," Lu Yang said with a chuckle. They were not in a hurry.
Being at the Divinity Transformation Stage carried some weight in the Alliance. Once Daoist Yan entered the nine-layered pagoda and explained his situation, it didn't take long for a Divinity Transformation Stage cultivator to come out and greet him. When they heard that Daoist Yan had passed the Thunder Tribulation through his own efforts, their words carried an extra measure of respect.
"Let's go. Daoist Yan has his own matters to attend to, so let's take a look around by ourselves," Lu Yang called out to the others. It shouldn't make much of a difference without a local guiding them.
"Take a look, freshly caught Nine-Star Thunder Eel." Someone was holding a meter-long, shiny black eel and shouting. The eel had four spots on each side, with an additional spot right at the center of its head—a rather rare Nine-Star Thunder Eel.
"Uncle, how much for this Nine-Star Thunder Eel?"
The uncle chuckled softly and said nonchalantly, "Not for sale."
The person became annoyed, "If you're not selling it, then why are you shouting about it!"
"If I didn't shout, how would you know that I caught a Nine-Star Thunder Eel?"
"Freshly unearthed ancient elixirs from a secret realm, one hundred thousand spirit stones per bottle!" Someone was displaying several small medicine bottles with soil still on them.
This was a custom in the Cultivation World. Elixirs from secret realms were sold unopened, leaving it to a gamble whether the elixirs inside were good or bad, and also as a way to test one's discernment.
"There are ancient elixirs here," Tao Yaoye whispered, quite astonished.
The Little Medicinal King was disdainful, "What ancient elixirs, only the mud is ancient."
As a Little Medicinal King who had lived since ancient times, it had eaten more soil in its lifetime than it could count, and it could tell the era of the soil without tasting it—just a glance was enough.
"Kebabs, freshly grilled mutton kebabs here, eat one for longevity, two for a breakthrough in realm, three for eternal life."
Hearing the familiar shouting, Lu Yang instinctively turned his head and was surprised to find a barbecue shop by the roadside.
"A barbecue shop has opened up here?" Meng Jingzhou exclaimed. The Jiuyou Sect was really striving to make money by expanding its overseas business to Penglai Island.
Lu Yang shook his head, his expression serious, "Our barbecue doesn't have this flavor, and they're not using True Fire. This is a counterfeit."
Beyond that, Lu Yang also found flying cars without trademarks and the Dream Mirage without authorization... All were outright knockoffs.
In Great Xia, copyright management was strict, but that was not the case in the East Sea. Here they believed that anything that made money was fair game, even murder and arson, let alone protecting intellectual property rights.
For this reason, the pill formulas, array methods, and so forth of Great Xia are subject to strict lineage teachings, and unauthorized transmission is undoubtedly a death sentence.
Lu Yang calculated that he had lost at least eight million spirit stones in the East Sea.
Lu Yang's heart ached—eight million! That was more than enough to buy Old Meng's life.
Meng Jingzhou glanced at Lu Yang with a sideways look, always feeling that this kid was bad-mouthing him.
Li Haoran consoled him sincerely, "The East Sea is just like this, you'll get used to it. Back in the day, Qin Haoran made a fortune by peddling pirated goods in the East Sea. That was the capital he used to marry Yi Ren."
Lu Yang: "..."
"Why is there a portrait of my master here?" Lu Yang discovered a picture of Daoist Buyu on the notice board, with a bounty written at the top.
Daoist Buyu, Dao Seeking Sect Master, with a bounty of one billion spirit stones.
Even the bounty was issued jointly by the Sea Clan and the human race.
"I'd always heard that my master fetched a high price in the black market, and now I see it's true."
Lu Yang commented, one billion spirit stones, that was way more expensive than Old Meng's eight million spirit stones.
Aside from Daoist Buyu, there were many familiar faces on the bounty list, such as the Grand Elder, Sixth Elder, Seventh Elder, and Eighth Elder.
Half the upper echelon of the Dao Seeking Sect was on that list, of course, none of them had a bounty as high as Daoist Buyu. He firmly topped the list, an unshakable status.
Before leaving, Lu Yang heard Uncle Ba say that the Grand Elder entered and exited the tombs on Penglai, the abbey, and Yingzhou seven times, and even built a tomb in the style of the ancient tombs on an island in the East Sea. When the Penglai trio discovered this tomb, they all thought it was their own ancestral tomb, nearly losing their minds over it.
In the end, Penglai Island triumphed and joyously moved the coffin back home, compared the family genealogy for half a day, knelt and worshipped in front of the coffin, and then the Grand Elder sprang from the coffin...
At the time, the Sixth Elder was in the middle of a breakthrough during her Pure Immortal Body phase, making her Pure Domain quite unstable, and it was sound-activated. She attended a banquet where the host spoke, and her Pure Domain opened up. Every time someone spoke, her domain was triggered, and she was consequently blacklisted from banquets.
The Seventh and Eighth Elders, taking advantage of the fact that Great Xia's laws couldn't reach them here, swindled everywhere, with their scam technique growing day by day. Eventually, the East Sea couldn't take it anymore, and after several failed attempts to capture them, they asked Great Xia to apply the principle of personal jurisdiction to arrest the Seventh and Eighth Elders.
Great Xia, citing respect for the sovereignty of the East Sea, refused to deal with the case.
Passers-by looked at the bounty and felt it was quite nostalgic, triggering memories of the past.
"Who would have thought that Daoist Buyu is still up there, it's been hundreds of years, he hasn't shown up in the East Sea for two hundred years, has he?"
"Exactly, I still remember when Daoist Buyu's bounty was five hundred million spirit stones. He once pretended to have been captured and, in partnership with the Dao Seeking Sect's Grand Elder, they swindled the bounty money."
"After that incident, his bounty went up to one billion. And every time there's a sign of him, a Great Power leading a team personally comes to try to capture him."
"One billion spirit stones, huh, if you could catch Daoist Buyu, you'd be set for resources for several lifetimes of cultivation."
"Catching Daoist Buyu, that's just wishful thinking. I heard that previously some cultivators did misdeeds under Daoist Buyu's name and after that incident, even Tribulation Cultivators dared not use his name anymore."
Lu Yang felt fortunate that he was currently using the identity of a disciple from the Five Elements Sect.
Considering the relationship between the Dao Seeking Sect and the Five Elements Sect, even if the Five Elements Sect minded, it wouldn't matter.

chapters.title: Chapter 757 - 757: 756
chapters.content:
"It's still my master who's reliable, not on the bounty notice," Meng Jingzhou, Man Gu, and Li Haoran said with self-satisfaction.
The bounty notice only listed the masters of Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye.
Lu Yang said nothing, silently walked around to the back of the notice board, where the bounties for the Third Elder, Fourth Elder, and Fifth Elder were posted, slightly lower than those on the front of the board.
"Our entire sect has been annihilated," Meng Jingzhou clicked his tongue.
Lu Yang frowned and rebuked Meng Jingzhou, "What do you mean 'our sect'? The bounty notice lists the Seek Dao Sect, what does that have to do with our Five Elements Sect?"
Li Haoran nodded repeatedly, agreeing with Lu Yang's reasoning.
"Besides, it's not an utter annihilation, Uncle Ba wasn't on the bounty."
Uncle Ba hadn't lied; he was the only senior survivor of the Seek Dao Sect.
Seeing how dangerous the East Sea was, the five of them checked again to make sure they were all disciples of the Five Elements Sect and agreed to shout for their Sect Leader first before anything else if they ran into Qiu Jin'an.
Lu Yang felt that, considering the life-and-death bond he shared with Qiu Jin'an in Hanshui City, Sect Leader Qiu shouldn't fuss over such a trivial matter.
Lu Yang and the others left the notice board, and before they did, they overheard passersby discussing other topics.
"The Immortal Appraisal Congress is coming up soon."
"What Immortal Appraisal Congress? It's just a fame-grabbing event for the disciples of the three islands."
"What can you do? The disciples of the three islands, whether in cultivation talent or in attire and provisions, are far superior to us. Who among the same realm could beat them?"
"But they shouldn't use the heads of us ordinary cultivators to boost their fame."
"Just accept it."
...
"Did so many people come to Penglai Island because of that Immortal Appraisal Congress?"
"That should be the case."
"Hey, this magic artifact looks pretty interesting," Li Haoran discovered an exquisitely crafted magic artifact in a forge. The artifact was an iron lotus flower, likely a hidden weapon given its structure, forged with an entirely different philosophy from that of Great Xia. It was perfect to purchase and study.
"How much for this magic artifact?"
"I'll buy this magic artifact," a voice rang out from behind them. They turned and saw a cultivator dressed elegantly with three wave patterns embroidered on his cuffs.
The cultivator was handsome and possessed a Nascent Soul Stage cultivation level. He was followed by several servants with cultivation levels not weak, all at the Nascent Soul Stage, with one even at the Divine Transformation Stage, which among the servants Lu Yang had encountered, ranked them as quite high.
"Who are you?" Li Haoran frowned, finding the man impolite.
"So it's Fellow Daoist Fan Chong, we failed to welcome you properly," the shopkeeper came out with an apologetic smile.
"No need for nonsense, I'm buying this iron lotus flower. It will come in handy at the upcoming congress; how much?" Fan Chong, the cultivator called, didn't even glance at Li Haoran and completely ignored him.
"For others, it would be 280,000 Spirit Stones, but since it's you, just the cost price of 100,000 Spirit Stones."
Fan Chong gave a signal, and one of his servants took out 100,000 Spirit Stones to purchase the artifact. Even so, the shopkeeper still smiled as he saw them off.
After Fan Chong left, the shopkeeper heaved a sigh of relief and looked at Li Haoran with a hint of dread, "Lucky for you, you didn't fight him for the artifact. If you'd angered him, you might not be able to leave Penglai Island."
"Who is he, is he famous?"
"You're not from around here, are you? Disciples of Penglai Island are divided into three categories: outer sect, inner sect, and core. You can tell by the wave pattern on their sleeves. The cultivator just now named Fan Chong is a core disciple of Penglai Island."
"And Fan Chong is extremely special even among the core disciples."
"He is a disciple of Xuanling Daoist, whose father is the legendary Island Master of Penglai Island."
Lu Yang realized, So he's the grand-disciple of someone who's passed the Transcendence Tribulation, no wonder he's so arrogant.
Quite the grand display, leaving the house with so many Nascent Soul Stage cultivators. He thought of his own master, Yun Zhi, who always kept a low profile when she traveled.
The shopkeeper sighed, "If it weren't for his special identity, someone would have already taken over his Dream Mirage and flying car business."
Lu Yang nodded, saying no more.
Lu Yang and his companions left the shop and continued to wander the streets. They had intended to check out the so-called Immortals Appraisal Convention, but unfortunately, it was an event organized by the three islands, and without an invitation, they couldn't enter.
Just as Lu Yang and his companions were contemplating whether to use some tricks to take a look at the Immortals Appraisal Convention, a disciple dressed in the Penglai Island style blocked their way. The disciple's sleeves had two wave patterns, and he deliberately exuded an oppressive aura, being at the Divine Transformation Stage.
"Who are you?" Li Haoran looked at the other party warily and repeated the question.
The disciple still didn't answer, staring coldly at the five of them. He thought to himself: Unfamiliar Nascent Soul Stage cultivators who I've never seen before mustn't be from our three islands. Just right, several were badly injured and won't recover for a while, I'll just use these five to fill in the numbers.
"Hey, you five are in luck. I'll take you to the Immortals Appraisal Convention in a bit. If you perform well, you might catch the eye of a Penglai Island disciple or an elder and become a servant."
The disciple's attitude was forceful, giving no chance for Lu Yang and his companions to say anything, before leading them towards the core area of Penglai Island.
Lu Yang and his companions, being merely at the Nascent Soul Stage, were in no position to resist a Divine Transformation Stage cultivator.
On the way there, through the few words dropped by the disciple, Lu Yang learned that this disciple's name was Xu Ze. He was bringing them to participate in the Immortals Appraisal Convention, which was a grand event inviting prominent figures from various places. Not only were cultivators from the East Sea invited but also those from Great Xia.
Though it's called the Immortals Appraisal Convention, it's primarily for the fame of the three islands' disciples.
Penglai Island's disciples are the elite among cultivators, known as seeds of the Immortal Path, with exceptional battle power. The best way to prove their extraordinary strength is to challenge cultivators of the same level, and not just one-on-one, but one against many.
Unfortunately, Lu Yang and his four companions belong to the "many" that were challenged.
Colloquially known as stepping stones.
Defeating Lu Yang and his four companions would naturally bring great fame and prestige.
The main venue of the Immortals Appraisal Convention was a round arena with passages on two sides, one for the three islands' disciples to enter and the other for regular Nascent Soul Stage cultivators.
The Immortals Appraisal Convention had already begun for a while, and because the three islands' disciples were too heavy-handed, more than ten regular cultivators were unable to continue fighting. Penglai Island had captured more than a dozen cultivators to fill in temporarily, and Lu Yang and his four companions were among them.
"I thought there would be Immortals, or at least a Semi-Immortal or two, but it turns out to be a bunch of self-proclaimed seeds of the Immortal Path joining the convention." Lu Yang yawned, You guys from the Penglai trio really dare to name things.
They were waiting in a rest room on one side of the arena, ready to participate. Initially, they wanted to teach these regular Nascent Soul Stage cultivators how to fight, but these cultivators were very wary and unwilling to speak with Lu Yang and the others.
Lu Yang figured it out, Xu Ze wasn't making empty promises. Ordinary cultivators that performed well at the Immortals Appraisal Convention really did have a chance to join Penglai Island.
That is why these regular Nascent Soul Stage cultivators saw Lu Yang and the others as rivals and were very guarded.
As Lu Yang and his companions were getting bored waiting and considering if they should have a go at each other first, it was finally their turn to go on stage.
"Hey, you five, it's your turn. Hurry up and get on."
Lu Yang and his companions went through the passage to the arena and saw their opponents.
Fan Chong, who they had just encountered half a day ago.

chapters.title: Chapter 758 - 757: Battle of attrition (Seeking monthly votes)
chapters.content:
```
"Who would have thought that this time it would be the core disciple Fan Chong, these five Nascent Soul Stage cultivators are going to be unlucky."
"Even among the core disciples, Fan Chong's combat talent is quite rare, unmatched within the same realm."
"Exactly, I heard that although Fan Chong is just at the Mid-stage Nascent Soul, he managed to fight a hundred rounds against an early Spirit Transformation cultivator before being defeated. He transcended an entire major level to challenge, truly the capacity of an ancient genius."
"Gosh, is he that strong?"
"How could he not be? His master is the Daoist Mystic Spirit, only daughter of Island Master Penglai. Not to mention the island, there are few in the East Sea who dare to provoke her."
"At the Immortal Ascertainment Conference, to identify seeds of the Immortal path, it looks like Fan Chong is this cohort's most likely candidate to become an Immortal seed."
Lu Yang and the others had excellent hearing. To challenge beyond one's level, this Fan Chong would not be easy to deal with.
As the eldest amongst the five, Lu Yang analyzed the battle situation, looking for a way to win, "In my view, although Fan Chong's combat power is extremely strong, his spiritual essence is limited. As long as we fight him in shifts, we will eventually wear him down!"
"Good!" Meng Jingzhou was the first to respond to Lu Yang's call to action.
Man Gu was quite puzzled. Was Fan Chong as strong as Brother Lu said? Could it be that he had some hidden cards that I hadn't noticed?
Or is it said that even a lion uses all its strength to hunt a rabbit?
"So it's you five," Fan Chong said with a cold laugh, not expecting that the passersby he encountered in the shop would be his opponents. It truly seemed like fate.
"All five of you, come at me!" Fan Chong slightly lifted his chin, his status was such. His reputation was already big enough, what he needed now was an overwhelming victory to establish his image.
Only by doing this could he become famous in one fell swoop at the Immortal Ascertainment Conference and be remembered by all.
"You're looking for a quick battle, surely due to a lack of magical power," Lu Yang remained cool and composed as he analyzed.
"This battle is dangerous; thus, as the Eldest Senior Brother, I'll go first and scout out the path for you."
Just as Fan Chong wondered why these five had yet to engage in battle, Lu Yang's figure turned into lightning, speeding towards him, and in an instant, he rushed in front of the opponent.
"So fast!" Fan Chong was startled and instinctively raised his sword to block.
He was a Sword Cultivator.
"I told you not to create a Flying Car without my permission!" Lu Yang used his fingers as a sword, bringing them together to release a streak of Sword Qi.
The Sword Qi was like a dragon, overwhelmingly powerful, clashing with Fan Chong's long sword with a metallic clanging sound, and Fan Chong was actually forced to take several steps back by this strike.
If he were facing Talisman Cultivators, Array Cultivators, Body Cultivators, Lu Yang would even use his Green Peak Sword to fight.
But since the opponent was a Sword Cultivator, when facing a Sword Cultivator of the same level, Lu Yang didn't even need to use a real sword.
"I told you to pay me a patent fee for creating the Flying Car!"
Lu Yang's resentment towards the sky, eight million Spirit Stones, oh! He wasn't short of money, but he couldn't be happy seeing his money ending up in someone else's pocket.
"Arhat Fist!" Lu Yang combined fist and sword techniques, whether Fan Chong used his sword to block or attack, Lu Yang anticipated it. From the start of the battle, Fan Chong had not managed to lift his wrist.
At the same time, large clumps of his hair fell to the ground.
"My hair!" Fan Chong cried out. He always cared about his appearance. How could he face people now?
"Phew, not so easy to deal with," Lu Yang pretended to pant a few breaths, signaling the next Meng Jingzhou to take over.
Meng Jingzhou's strikes were also ruthless, beating Fan Chong to a swollen face.
"I haven't been this flamboyant even when going out, look at how capable you are!"
Then came Tao Yaoye, Man Gu, and Li Haoran.
Without permission, broadcasting the Dream Mirage is just like openly stealing money. Even the good-tempered Tao Yaoye couldn't help but get angry.
Man Gu was inspired by Lu Yang's actions and understood that even when hunting a rabbit, a lion gives it his all. An ancestral spirit possessed him, delivering a brutally fierce beating.
Li Haoran had a very bad impression of Fan Chong. True Fire flourished, but he still held back, otherwise, Fan Chong would have died long ago.
```
The battle-by-rotation plan was going smoothly, and Fan Chong was left as devastated as if he had been run over by a large truck five times.
"I'll make you fight!" Fan Chong showed a ferocious expression as an iron lotus flower flew out of his sleeve.
The iron lotus flower bloomed, and eighteen petals shot out, each petal steeped in deadly poison!
Li Haoran summoned the Six-C Divine Fire and the Dayan True Fire in the palm of his hand, which looked like jade, and caught the iron petals, instantly refining them into his own magic artifact and throwing them back.
Fan Chong screamed miserably as he collapsed to the ground, convulsing from the poison.
The cultivators invited to watch the battle were shocked, as if they had entered an Illusionary Realm.
"Who are these five people? Each one of them is overwhelming Fan Chong in the fight!"
"Have they concealed their realms?"
"No, they are at the Mid-stage Nascent Soul!"
"How did five such peerless geniuses suddenly emerge?"
"Could it be that Fan Chong isn't as strong as the rumors suggested?"
Fan Chong wailed, "Master, kill them! Kill them all!"
His eyes filled with resentment, since they had made him lose all face at the Immortal Appraisal Gathering, he wouldn't let them walk out of Penglai Island alive!
Penglai Island was his turf!
"To insult my disciple like this, do you think Penglai Island has no one?" On the stands, a female cultivator with a beautiful face said indifferently, looking coldly at Li Haoran. Her chest was partially exposed, highlighting her tall and tempting figure, which was a common sight in the East Sea and not considered inappropriate.
The woman flew down from the stands, none other than Fan Chong's master, the only daughter of the Penglai Island Master, Daoist Xuan Ling.
At this moment, no one was interested in Daoist Xuan Ling's figure, as she exuded her pressure, demonstrating the dignity of a Unification True Monarch.
Even Lu Yang and his group of five were enveloped by the pressure, unable to move.
"Master!" Seeing his master come down, Fan Chong saw a glimmer of hope.
Daoist Xuan Ling didn't even glance at him, extending her fair fingers to lift Li Haoran, who was rooted to the spot, for a careful examination.
Daoist Xuan Ling gave a beguiling smile and said in a seductive voice, "You are quite handsome. If you become my male concubine, this matter can be forgotten."
Meng Jingzhou: "?"
Lu Yang wondered if being so openly accepting of male concubines was also a characteristic of the East Sea?
Since they were already here, they might as well let Junior Brother Li have the experience.
Li Haoran looked back in despair, seeking help from Lu Yang and the others, but unfortunately, they were unable to help.
"Junior Brother Li, just accept it. We will remember your sacrifice," Lu Yang encouraged Li Haoran.
Li Haoran grew more desperate, knowing he couldn't rely on these fellows.
Just as Li Haoran was debating whether to struggle before succumbing to Daoist Xuan Ling or to submit outright, another dispassionate voice came from the stands.
"Xuan Ling, take your filthy hands off him."
Another female figure leaped down from the high stands, her pressure dispersing Daoist Xuan Ling's and granting the people at the meeting a secret sigh of relief.
The woman protected Li Haoran behind her, warily watching Daoist Xuan Ling.
"Friend Su, this is an internal matter of Penglai Island, you're being a bit too meddlesome," said Daoist Xuan Ling.
Friend Su curled her lips into a mocking smile, "Internal matter?"
"This man is my husband, how can I not be involved?"
The one protecting Li Haoran was Su Yiren, who was invited to observe the Immortal Appraisal Gathering.

chapters.title: Chapter 759 - 758: The Popular Li Haoran
chapters.content:
At the Immortal Ascension Assembly, two Unification True Monarchs stood in flowing robes, coldly eyeing each other, unwilling to yield. The aura they emitted collided on the stage, forming two distinctly separate domains.
"Senior Su, this person is not even twenty years old, how could he be your husband? This excuse is rather far-fetched, don't you think?" Xuan Ling Daoist stared intently at Su Yiren, trying to find a flaw in her reaction.
Xuan Ling Daoist's fame stretched far and wide across the East Sea, and as a stunningly beautiful female cultivator herself, she innately resisted Su Yiren from Great Xia.
Su Yiren calmly said, "Haoran and I are already engaged, and his parents have acknowledged this marriage. How could that be considered an excuse?"
As these words were spoken, the crowd erupted into shocked murmurs, and while many were astonished, more were filled with envy and jealousy.
"Good heavens, engaged before twenty, how is that possible? Is being handsome really that appealing?"
"I'm so envious. His cultivation level isn't high, yet he's favored by two Unification True Monarchs. If only I had such luck."
"Indeed, if I could attract the attention of a Unification True Monarch, there'd be no need for me to cultivate in this lifetime."
"Senior Su seems to be in high spirits."
"It's no match for Xuan Ling Daoist luring away a married man."
Xuan Ling Daoist placed her index finger in her mouth, drawing out a trail of saliva, while the other end was connected to her outstretched tongue. She looked at Li Haoran with passionate eyes: "What of a married man, handsome? I see you have ample kidney essence; surely Senior Su is unwilling to give herself to you. Why not give in to me?
I can make you soar to the heavens tonight and provide you with all the resources you need for your future cultivation."
Su Yiren chuckled lightly, not taking Xuan Ling Daoist seriously: "Heh, do you really think by debasing yourself, you can lure my husband? My love, between me and Xuan Ling Daoist, whom do you choose?"
Feeling the weighty gazes of both Su Yiren and Xuan Ling Daoist upon him, Li Haoran's scalp tingled.
If possible, he would choose neither.
But considering the current situation, choosing neither was likely to make it very difficult to leave the Immortal Ascension Assembly alive.
He forcibly dredged up Qin Haoran's memories and earnestly held Su Yiren's hand; her body trembled, surprised by Li Haoran's bold move.
"Yi Ren, I've always liked you."
Before Su Yiren could respond, Xuan Ling Daoist reacted.
"Alright, since you're unwilling to choose me, then don't blame me for using some tricks!"
Twelve Flying Swords hovered behind Xuan Ling Daoist, their tips pointing outward, forming a circle, slowly rotating.
This was the Sword Array fashioned by the Penglai Island Master for Xuan Ling Daoist, demonstrating his affection for his only daughter.
Xuan Ling Daoist had only mediocre talent, and even her current Unification cultivation level was bolstered by countless elixirs and magical medicines provided by the Penglai Island Master.
Xuan Ling Daoist was barely at the Body Integration Realm, let alone the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
