And as long-lived as Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivators were, it meant that the Penglai Island Master could protect Xuan Ling Daoist for a lifetime. Consequently, Xuan Ling Daoist acted recklessly, without heed to consequences.
If she took a fancy to a male concubine, she would simply seize him.
Taking Fan Chong as her disciple wasn't without reason related to Fan Chong's handsome appearance.
Of course, now with Fan Chong's hair gone, his face bruised and swollen, suffering from severe burns and poisoned, he was far from handsome.
The twelve Evildoer Slaying Swords transformed into twelve streaks of azure light, bursting forth and tearing through the space, forming the Sword Array, emitting a sharp and piercing hum.
Su Yiren clenched her delicate hand and threw a punch, lifting boundless waves of air, blowing the twelve Evildoer Slaying Swords away.
Mystic Spirit Daoist's expression changed, not expecting Su Yiren to break the sword array in this manner. She wanted to put some distance between them, but Su Yiren wouldn't give her the chance, engaging in close combat nonstop. Her seemingly frail and pale body contained terrifying strength, with each punch she threw capable of causing ripples in the fabric of space.
Li Haoran's face turned pale at the sight, despite Su Yiren's outwardly gentle and weak appearance, her true identity was that of a Body Cultivator.
Lu Yang still had the energy to make comments, "Junior Brother Li is very lucky ah, to have two Unification True Monarchs fighting over him out of jealousy."
Lu Yang waited a good while for Meng Jingzhou to pitch in with his jests, but turning his head, he saw Meng Jingzhou grinding his teeth in irritation.
Oh, and another jealousy-ridden Great Power during the Nascent Soul Stage had emerged.
Being accustomed to Body Integration Realm battles, especially the high-level ones fought by the Elders, the early-stage Unification battle between Su Yiren and Mystic Spirit Daoist was just a minor skirmish for Lu Yang.
That was Lu Yang's perspective, but it didn't mean everyone saw it the same way.
All those who were qualified to be invited to the Immortal Ascension Assembly were prominent figures in the East Sea, surrounded by entourages, with refined tastes in food, clothing, and shelter. Yet, despite all this, most had never witnessed a Unification True Monarch in action in their lifetimes.
The refreshing sea breeze blew as an elder stood in the center of the platform, adopting a Tai Chi stance. With a flip of his hands, he neutralized the attacks of Su Yiren and Mystic Spirit Daoist.
"Fellow Daoists, for the sake of my face, could you stop fighting? I believe the priority should now be finding an antidote for Martial Nephew Fan Chong."
Both ceased their attacks as if by some unspoken agreement and let out a simultaneous cold huff.
"As expected, it was Anchorite Dingfeng who put a stop to this battle."
"That is Anchorite Dingfeng, touted as the strongest under Island Master Penglai, renowned for his defeat of Unspeakable..."
"Shh, do you have a death wish? You dare to speak of such things!"
Su Yiren, hanging on Li Haoran's arm, returned to the resting area where Lu Yang and the others were. She adopted a clingy demeanor, a stark contrast to her earlier battle-ready stance.
"Thank you, Senior Su, for lending your aid," Lu Yang thanked with a bowing fist, though he wanted to call her sister-in-law, he feared Li Haoran might settle scores with him afterward.
"It was nothing but a small effort," Su Yiren modestly replied, believing that given the identities of Lu Yang and the others, they surely had a backup plan.
"This Immortal Ascension Assembly is not quite interesting, let's leave," she declared.
Under the envious gaze of the crowd, Su Yiren led Lu Yang and the four others away.
"Wait, five people, with remarkable strength... could they be from Fangshan Island?" One of the invited Cultivators suddenly thought of something.
"Fellow Daoist, do you know something?" another Cultivator inquired.
The invited cultivator did not hide anything, as the events on Fangshan Island would reach Penglai Island within a few days anyway.
"Before leaving, I heard that a rare treasure appeared on Fangshan Island, which attracted the attention of twelve Divinity Transformation Stage cultivators. Yet, they were stopped by five Mid-stage Nascent Soul Cultivators," he shared.
The battle on Fangshan Island caused quite a stir, particularly since Meng Jingzhou who could clone himself into a myriad of forms, was easily noticeable.
"Five Mid-stage Nascent Souls held off twelve Divinity Transformation Stages?" the other exclaimed incredulously, wondering how that was possible. Fighting above one's level was already defying the heavens, let alone facing multiple opponents.
The one in the know spoke in a lowered voice, "It's not just that they held them off—they captured them alive!"
"Captured alive?! Is that even possible?!"
"Of course it's possible. It is said that these five Nascent Soul Stage Cultivators used the Five Elements Sect's Five Elements Battle Formation during the combat. This is a closely guarded secret of the Five Elements Sect, which proves that they must be disciples of the sect, likely direct disciples of the Sect Leader!"
"So the disciples of the Five Elements Sect are that fearsome."

chapters.title: Chapter 760 - 759 How did you manage to cause so much trouble in just half a day?
chapters.content:
"It's about time, we still have a friend waiting for us at the Alliance headquarters."
On the way to the Alliance headquarters, Lu Yang struck up a conversation, "Speaking of which, how did Senior Su come to Penglai Island? Was it to attend the so-called Xianjian Conference?"
Su Yiren shook her head, "It was just on the way. I'm friends with a princess from the East Sea Dragon Palace. I was invited by her to attend the Dragon Emperor's feast. Concerned about potential complications on the road, I arrived in the East Sea in advance, and the cultivators of Penglai Island invited me to the Xianjian Conference."
"I see," Lu Yang remarked, thinking that with Su Yiren's taste, she would not specially come for such a conference.
Their internal conflicts were fiercer than the clashes at the Xianjian Conference.
Lu Yang arrived just in time to see Yan Chuan finishing the paperwork and walking out of the pagoda.
"Finally, it's done." Yan Chuan felt a burden had been lifted, as the Alliance really gouged them, not only with complicated procedures but also with subtle hints at demanding money. After half a day, everything was finally in order.
"I apologize for the long wait, my fellow Daoists. I didn't expect becoming a Hall Master to be so difficult," Yan Chuan said with an embarrassed smile, noticing Su Yiren close to Li Haoran.
"And who might this be?"
"It's like this..." Lu Yang explained succinctly, and the more he spoke, the paler Yan Chuan's face became.
Attending the Xianjian Conference, taking turns to beat up Fan Chong, being taken as a male concubine by the Island Master's sole daughter, two Unification True Monarchs fighting it out, humiliating Xuan Ling Daoist in public... all in just half a day.
How did you manage to stir up so much trouble in just half a day?
Only with these events did he qualify to attend the Xianjian Conference as one of the many spectators.
Suddenly, he realized the female cultivator he hadn't met before was an Integration Stage Expert and hastily paid his respects, "Junior Yan Chuan has seen Senior Su."
"Considering Penglai Island might retaliate against us later, it's safer for you not to stick with us, Yan Chuan," Lu Yang kindly advised. Being a disciple of the Five Elements Sect, he couldn't cover for Yan Chuan.
Bringing up his identity as Young Sect Master Lu would be a different story, though.
Yan Chuan felt Lu Yang made sense. Spending time with Lu Yang and the others was too overwhelming, and he, being merely at the Spirit Transformation Stage, could not cope.
"Then, we shall part ways here. If the esteemed Daoists visit my Fangshan Island later, I shall definitely host you."
"Farewell."
Yan Chuan and Lu Yang's group exchanged a formal farewell with cupped fists and then turned to leave Penglai Island.
"Just advanced to the Spirit Transformation Stage but without pride, that's quite the rare Mind State," Su Yiren commented. She had seen several newly advanced Spirit Transformation cultivators in the East Sea who were unbearably arrogant, with rather poor mental states.
In fact, this was a common issue among East Sea cultivators, focusing heavily on Cultivation Level while neglecting Mind State, which often led to deviation or hitting bottlenecks.
Li Haoran thought to himself, if you knew what Yan Chuan has been through with us, you'd understand why he lacks pride.
Su Yiren had visited Penglai Island a few times and was quite familiar with it. Li Haoran also had half of Qin Haoran's memories, so together as guides, they were more than sufficient.
"The place we are in now is the main island of Penglai, which is divided into the inner and outer circles. The inner circle is the core area of Penglai, where things like the Xianjian Conference and the headquarters of the East Sea cultivators' Alliance are located."
"We are currently in the outer circle, the most densely populated area with East Sea cultivators. Due to the Xianjian Conference, there are more cultivators in the outer circle than usual. These shops in the outer circle belong to families and elders among the various factions of Penglai Island. Tracing back their roots, they are definitely properties of these factions," continued Su Yiren.
"Surrounding the main island are three thousand islets inhabited by mortals who cultivate grain, raise silkworms, and mine—these activities support the livelihood of Penglai Island's disciples."
Li Haoran interjected, "Especially the mining areas, which are incredibly strict. In my previous life, I tried to steal a few Spirit Stones and got caught."
During the 120,000th anniversary celebration of the Seek Dao Sect, Li Haoran and Su Yiren met and informed her about his awakening of past life memories, and he explicitly stated that Qin Haoran was the Master of the Jiuyou Sect.
To this, Su Yiren did not feel surprised; Qin Haoran was always shrouded in secrecy, and at first glance, he did not seem like someone engaged in legitimate business.
Moreover, Qin Haoran had mentioned that he would be reincarnated, which was a viewpoint of the Jiuyou Sect, indicating that Qin Haoran was very likely one of the high-ranking members of the Sect.
The group of six found a restaurant to settle down in; the East Sea had heavy moisture, which low-level cultivators could not withstand, so most of the tea provided in the restaurant had the effect of dispelling dampness.
Lu Yang and the others didn't need to dispel dampness, but they didn't mind trying a pot of the tea for its taste, and also ordered a few special dishes on the side.
Looking at the wriggling worms that were served, Lu Yang and his companions simply couldn't bring themselves to eat, but the minced fish was actually quite delicious, exquisitely so.
"What a pity, the fish just isn't old enough, its spiritual essence isn't abundant. If it lived for another ten years, the taste would certainly reach another level," Meng Jingzhou said with a hint of regret. He often frequented major restaurants when he was messing around in the Imperial City and was quite a connoisseur of food.
"That's easy to handle." Immortal Herbs, emerging from behind Tao Yaoye, chimed in, "Just ask the shop to bring over a fresh Crucian Carp; it has to be alive."
They had requested a private room, so they weren't worried about outsiders seeing the Immortal Herbs.
Meng Jingzhou did as suggested, calling over the Shop Assistant to bring a Crucian Carp that was still lively and bouncing.
The Shop Assistant came up holding a basin, with a white Crucian Carp swimming inside, as white as jade.
He left the basin and walked away, giving them a strange look from his eyes.
While their shop advertised fresh meals, it was the first time they encountered customers willing to chomp on a fish so directly.
Immortal Herbs didn't care what the Shop Assistant thought, tearing off an imperceptible tiny bit of its leaf and feeding it to the Crucian Carp.
Endowed by fate, the Crucian Carp received an opportunity and burst into milky-white radiance; after the light vanished, it became a twenty-year-old Crucian Carp, brimming with spiritual essence.
"Done," announced the Immortal Herbs with an air of accomplishment.
"Little Medicinal Kings? " Su Yiren exclaimed in shock, unable to recognize the species of Immortal Herbs, but she could tell this was a Little Medicinal King.
"Just a tiny bit made the fish gain twenty years of cultivation?" Meng Jingzhou was surprised; the Immortal Herbs were too miraculous.
The leaf in the very center of the Immortal Herbs shook gently, acting as its head, "It's not as convenient as that; it's just that this fish requires very few resources for its cultivation."
"If it were any of you five, such a small piece of leaf would only allow you to cultivate for an extra week."
Lu Yang used the Green Peak Sword to slice the Crucian Carp into pieces, and everyone tasted a piece, finding it several times more delicious than the previous fish.
Su Yiren had visited the East Sea numerous times, but she had never tasted such quality Crucian Carp before.
Seeing how useful Immortal Herbs were, Su Yiren's eyes lit up as she thought of something. She took out a small porcelain bottle from her Storage Ring and inquired of the herb.
"This is a treasure I obtained by chance, could its quality be improved by a level as well? I will have great use for it in the future."
Meng Jingzhou felt that this small porcelain bottle and its contents were extremely familiar.
Isn't this my Essence Blood?
Senior Su, what are you planning to do?

chapters.title: Chapter 761 - 760 The Legend of the Penglai Island Master
chapters.content:
A cultivator who has succeeded in their cultivation can calculate the information of the owner of the blood based on the blood itself, and use it for sneak attacks, curses, and so on.
Therefore, before Meng Jingzhou sold his blood, he erased all the information contained in the essence blood. Nobody could trace it back to him, not even Su Yiren.
"What is this?" Li Haoran asked with some confusion, not clear about what Su Yiren was planning to do.
"This is blood I obtained from a black market auction. It cost me a hundred thousand spirit stones."
Meng Jingzhou looked strangely amused. When he sold his blood, it had been ten thousand spirit stones a drop. This price hike was outrageous, wasn't it?
To be a member of the Meng Family and still lose money, what a shame.
"This blood should be true blood of a pure-blooded member of the Demon Race. It has the effects of enhancing cultivation, invigorating yang, and replenishing qi. I thought to buy it as a gift for my husband. If the immortal herbs can amplify the effects of this blood, that would be even better."
Li Haoran was very touched after hearing this. He hadn't expected Su Yiren to be so considerate of him.
Lu Yang also recognized that this was Meng Jingzhou's essence blood. He didn't remember Old Meng's blood having the effect of increasing cultivation. If Old Meng's blood did have that effect, he himself would drink three big bowls of it first.
Senior Su, have you started to spout nonsense with your eyes wide open just to lure Li Haoran into bed?
"It's not possible. I can only help living beings enhance their cultivation. If we could find the owner of the blood, that might work," the Immortal Herbs firmly put an end to Su Yiren's thoughts.
"I see." Su Yiren's mood noticeably dropped.
Lu Yang stole a glance towards Meng Jingzhou, considering whether to tell Su Yiren the truth and give Old Meng a chance to improve his cultivation. This could also count as a stroke of luck for Old Meng.
Meng Jingzhou quickly shook his head in tiny, rapid movements, rejecting the opportunity.
A scene formed in Meng Jingzhou's mind:
In the dead of night, as he lay in bed sleeping soundly, Su Yiren crept into his room in the dark. The moonlight outlined Su Yiren's exquisite figure. With resolve, Meng Jingzhou said "I cannot do anything to betray Junior Brother Li", to which Su Yiren replied, "It will hurt only for a second, very quickly".
Despite Meng Jingzhou's struggles, he was eventually overpowered by Su Yiren, who tied him up and started to draw his blood...
What kind of situation was this?
During the happy chatter, the crucian carp was devoured by everyone, leaving only a cleanly picked fish skeleton behind.
The crucian carp had a stroke of immortal fate by accidentally consuming immortal herbs, resulting in a surge in its cultivation, reaching a twenty-year realm that no fish in its species had ever achieved before. But little did it know, all of this was a scheme of the human race. Pierced by an immortal sword, the human cultivators divided and consumed it, not even leaving a complete body behind.
After enjoying the delicacies of the East Sea, Lu Yang and the others went downstairs to pay the bill. Lu Yang noticed a statue placed on the counter—a middle-aged man with a goatee.
"Who is that statue of?" Lu Yang asked casually.
"He is the Island Master of Penglai, Three Mountains Taoist," said Li Haoran. "There are many legends about the Three Mountains Taoist in the East Sea. For example, when fishermen encounter storms and rains at sea, the Three Mountains Taoist happens to pass by and saves the entire boat with a wave of his hand.
He said that in the future, when they go out to sea to fish, they can silently pray to him for a safe journey."
"There are also legends of farmers having a bountiful harvest in autumn, but then a sudden downpour threatens their crops. Once again, the Three Mountains Taoist appears and the situation is similar to the story of the fishermen. One of these legends might be the original, and the other could have changed through word of mouth."
"Or, there's a tale of an epidemic breaking out somewhere, and the Three Mountains Taoist bestows nectar springs, curing diseases and saving lives."
"Or else it's about a cultivator encountering a bottleneck in their cultivation, restless in spirit, and the Three Mountains Taoist appears, helping the cultivator break through..."
"Anyway, there are so many legends, all of them have been around for four or five thousand years, and nobody knows how much truth there is in the legends. But among the cultivators of the East Sea, the Three Mountains Taoist is the object of worship, adored by families and households."
"Speaking of efficacy, it's definitely not especially miraculous. Even if he incarnated into tens of thousands, he couldn't fulfill everyone's wishes. Not even immortals have such great abilities."
"But the Three Mountains Taoist has long been famous, and faith has become a habit. Having something to place one's soul into, whether it's effective or not, is no longer important."
"Among the three islands of Penglai, Penglai is revered the most, and this is not without reason linked to the Three Mountains Taoist."
"I heard that the Golden Buddha Kingdom wanted to spread their teachings to the East Sea, but because of the Three Mountains Taoist, they ended in failure."
Lu Yang thought of Fan Chong, "Fan Chong, being a disciple of the Three Mountains Taoist, bullies others using his master's influence. It seems to me that this Three Mountains Taoist isn't as good as the legends portray."
Li Haoran was unable to explain this question either, shaking his head helplessly and saying, "Perhaps the Three Mountains Taoist, always keeping a low profile, does not strictly discipline his followers?"
He looked at Su Yiren, who also shook her head, "I have met the Three Mountains Taoist once, and he was very considerate in his dealings with others. Even when meeting cultivators of middle to low rank, he did not act too arrogantly. He wasn't much different from the image in folk tales; I also cannot imagine why Xuan Ling the Taoist and Fan Chong would behave that way."
Fairy Eternity suddenly spoke up with some puzzlement, "What's the deal with this Three Mountains Taoist, concocting so many outlandish legends? If he doesn't have such great abilities, he shouldn't stir up all this fuss."
In the spiritual space, Fairy Eternity lay on a seabed, floating on the sea surface, her fishtail flapping away.
Lu Yang suddenly remembered that although the current Fairy Eternity behaved in an extremely unreliable manner, she was also an object of faith during ancient times, even creating the Mother-child River and Twin River to fulfill the fertility wishes of her devotees.
"Fairy, is there any reasoning to this?"
"I don't know much about the power of faith," said the fairy. "Qinghe understands this better. She told me that as the source of faith, one must control the legends well. You must not create an all-powerful image of yourself. Take me for example, if a devotee asks for a child, I did have the ability to create the Mother-child River, so I would fulfill such requests."
"If a devotee asked for power, I did not wish to grant it, I would clarify this from the start to avoid a continuous stream of devotees hassling me for power, which would be very annoying."
Lu Yang nodded, not quite understanding.
"You all don't look like cultivators from our East Sea," observed the shop owner, noticing that Lu Yang and his companions seemed very interested in the statue of the Three Mountains Taoist, which was uncharacteristic of local cultivators.
Lu Yang nodded. They were disciples of the Five Elements Sect, indeed not East Sea cultivators.
"Would you like to offer your respects to the Three Mountains Taoist? He's very efficacious." The shop owner looked very devout.
Lu Yang and the others thought it over and decided that honoring the local culture by paying respects might be good.
Lu Yang pressed his palms together, bowed deeply to the statue of the Three Mountains Taoist, and silently wished earnestly, hoping that the legendary figure of the East Sea could bless them, "May our journey through the East Sea be safe and without incident."
Meng Jingzhou and the others followed suit, paying their respects as well.
...
Inside the core area of Penglai Island, at the heart of a ninth-grade spirit vein.
A man with a goatee was sitting in meditation on a mat when he suddenly spat out blood with a "wa" sound, his expression one of shock and uncertainty.
"Which deity is offering worship to me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 762 - 761: The Unmatched Great Power
chapters.content:
Three Mountains Taoist steadied his breath and attempted a calculation to discern the origin of the other party, but before he could reach a result, he was struck by two slaps that left him dizzy and disoriented.
"Is there a Venerate Great Power playing with the mortal world, paying homage to my divine image?"
Although the Three Mountains Taoist could not ascertain the other's intentions, the mere act of paying homage inflicted serious injury upon him. His attempt to divine the stranger's origin backfired, indicating that the other's status and methods were both superior to his own.
"The two slaps weren't severe, might this signify that the Venerate Great Power harbors no malice toward me?"
Venerate Great Powers are fickle in temper; Three Mountains Taoist could only hope that this one was merely passing through the East Sea, with no intention of lingering.
"It seems that the Venerate Great Power granted a wish?"
Caught up in spitting blood, he hadn't noticed what wish the Great Power had granted.
Surely a being with such immense clairvoyance, what could possibly require my assistance?
Three Mountains Taoist shook his head, not wanting to dwell on the matter—probably just a jest at his expense.
He was always careful in his dealings, knowing whom he could provoke and whom he must not.
"Why did I have the foolish idea to use the power of faith for cultivation?" Three Mountains Taoist lamented, realizing that if not for this, he wouldn't have fallen into such a state.
Master of the Stilling Wind stood at the entrance to the core of the ninth-grade Spirit Vein, bowing deeply, "Island Master, Second Prince Jiang Zhu of Great Xia has arrived at Penglai Island and requests an audience with you."
Three Mountains Taoist wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth; this was a troublesome time, with no patience for outsiders.
About to decline, he suddenly realized that the Second Prince was not a local of the East Sea, and neither was the Venerate High Person; had they been, he would've been made to spit blood before now, not just today.
The biggest recent change in the East Sea was indeed the Second Prince's fleet.
Could it be that the Venerate High Person was part of the Second Prince's entourage, and that earlier action was meant as a warning to me?
As he was about to refuse, he changed his mind at the last moment, "Then I shall grant them an audience."
...
"Worshipping the Three Mountains Taoist, why don't you bow to me when I stand right here?" Fairy Eternity, furious, fanned Lu Yang's face to and fro with her fish tail, drenching his face in water.
"Am I not capable of ensuring your safety in the East Sea?"
Fairy Eternity, as the leader among the Five Immortals, had been invincible since ancient times. There could be enough of her faithful to fill a planet. Yet Lu Yang, ignoring her, had worshipped the Three Mountains Taoist, whom she had never even heard of.
"Fairy, don't be mad. It was just an experiment, not a genuine act of worship," Lu Yang hurriedly apologized and explained.
Fairy Eternity pouted, hands on her hips, turning her head away, refusing to pay Lu Yang any attention.
It took quite a while for Lu Yang to persuade Fairy Eternity, who finally started to pay him attention but still sulked.
"Your worshipping him served no purpose. You, the Immortal Lineage Second Boss, stand under my protection; your destiny surpasses his."
"You probably made him spit blood just by that single act of worship."
Lu Yang, startled by Fairy Eternity's claim, sheepishly said, "Really? But didn't you also bow to the three ancestors during the sect's celebration?"
"That's not the same situation at all. Aside from being an honorary guest of the Seek Dao Sect, there's no harm in paying respects to the ancestors of the sect; after all, they didn't cultivate through the power of faith," she argued.
"Why don't you try bowing to the Third Boss when you return to the sect? I guarantee that each bow from you will bring forth a mouthful of his blood."
Seeing how serious Fairy Eternity was, Lu Yang decided it was best to avoid such salutations in the future, lest he invite trouble.
Bowing to the Third Boss was fine; with the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit, a little blood loss was inconsequential, but if the Penglai Island Master were to spit blood, that was a price he could not afford to pay.
"The Second Prince's fleet has arrived?" Lu Yang and the others noticed three large ships docked at Penglai Island, which stood out conspicuously, attracting many cultivators to the spectacle.
The last time the Great Xia Dynasty made such a show of arriving in the East Sea was three hundred years ago, for the ascension of Yingzhou Island's new Island Master.
Watching the Second Prince disembark, followed by several attendants who matched the Integration Period Cultivators from the sect's 'Great Xia Dynasty Integration Period Name List' sold during the celebration, Lu Yang observed attentively.
The list was all of Master's enemies.
"It seems there is one attendant not on the list, could he be a Body Integration Cultivator secretly nurtured by the Dynasty, or at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage?" Lu Yang felt that the latter was more likely.
"Speaking of which, are there any legends about longevity medicine in the East Sea?"
Li Haoran nodded, "Yes, there are quite a few."
"For instance, it is said that deep within the eighth-grade spirit vein of Yingzhou Island, there is an Immortal Herb of longevity planted by the Venerate of Evergreen from ancient times."
Lu Yang turned his head back to his Spiritual Space to ask those who were informed, "Who is the Venerate of Evergreen?"
Fairy Eternity was fishing in the sea, and while speaking, blew out bubbles, "He's a Semi-Immortal who possessed an Eternity Dao Fruit. He even had the audacity to compete with me for the position of the Dao Fruit, but I knocked him down with just two punches. He can't take a hit."
Li Haoran continued, "For example, in the northern corner of the East Sea, there is a mysterious island that only appears during the transition of the old and new years, at high tide. The island is full of traps, with endless ferocious beasts protecting the Immortal Herbs at the island's center. Consuming these Immortal Herbs allows one to ascend by daylight and live a long life."
"There is also the deepest part of the East Sea where there is a dormant volcano on the seabed. The volcano's crater is filled with embers, and within these embers blooms a fiery red flower. Its species and effects are unknown, nor is it known whether it can grant longevity."
"And there's more..."
Li Haoran listed over a dozen legends in one go.
"The East Sea is home to so many species that it's difficult to communicate, leading to all kinds of bizarre legends."
"When Qin Haoran came to the East Sea, he visited most of these legendary places, and all were false."
If Immortal Herbs truly existed, Qin Haoran would have risked his life to pick one. Just one would be enough to settle a large part of Jiuyou Sect's debt.
Even a place like the depth of Yingzhou Island's spirit vein was considered by Qin Haoran for a secret visit.
But that was Yingzhou Island's lifeline, and with the Island Master at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, Qin Haoran feared that he might enter but not leave with his life.
The group was very relaxed, eating and drinking, and playing for most of the day.
"Be careful, Venerate of the Waning Moon is coming this way," warned Su Yiren.
No sooner had she spoken than a lean-looking Cultivator stood before Lu Yang and the others.
"The Second Prince has requested the honor of your presence. May I know if you gentlemen would be so kind as to oblige?"
"How does the Second Prince know we are here?" Man Gu was surprised; the Second Prince truly had considerable means to have located them upon their arrival at Penglai Island.
Li Haoran helplessly transmitted a message, "Because Elder Brother Lu Yang used Arhat Fist."
The Cultivators of the East Sea might not know, but which Cultivator from Great Xia wouldn't recognize Lu Yang's fists that specialized in treating dense hair growth.
The event at the Appraisal Conference caused such a stir, and with a bit of inquiry, it was easy to learn of Lu Yang's presence.
After all, it's the Second Prince, although his status can't compare to that of his Junior Brother Yun Zhi, yet some face must be given.
"Then let's go," Lu Yang said with a smile, curious about what the Second Prince had in mind.
This was not Lu Yang's first encounter with the Second Prince Jiang Zhu; he was present during the founding ceremony of the Demon Nation, only at that time, the Second Prince was longing from below, while he as the Young Sect Master was impressing all on stage.
The Venerate of the Waning Moon led the group into the most luxurious tavern in the outer rings of Penglai Island.
Upon the arrival of Lu Yang and the others, the Second Prince greeted Lu Yang with a smile.
"I have long heard of the great name of Daoist Lu Yang, and seeing you today, you truly stand out from the ordinary."
Lu Yang took notice of the table, which was filled with a large spread of dishes.
Assuming that Lu Yang had a taste for good food, the Second Prince modestly said, "I've just ordered a few dishes casually. I hope Daoist Lu Yang won't mind."
Though he said the order was casual, in reality, each dish was the tavern's signature specialty.
Lu Yang didn't say much. Being a polite person, he knew that the value of this table full of dishes was less than that of a twenty-year-old carp, and he tried not to disdain the Second Prince's lack of sophistication.

chapters.title: Chapter 763 - 762: Second Prince
chapters.content:
"Mister Meng, it's been three years since we last met, hasn't it? In the Imperial City, I often hear of your elegance through the storytelling sessions."
Second Prince Jiang Zhu stood tall and striking, with a valor that was out of the ordinary, smiling as he lightly patted Meng Jingzhou's shoulder, as though they were good friends reuniting after a long time.
"You two know each other?" Lu Yang thought about it and found it to be true; who in the Imperial City didn't know Meng Jingzhou?
Meng Jingzhou sent a message to Lu Yang using a magic skill: "Back when I was making waves in the Imperial City, I beat up his younger brother, his own flesh and blood brother. It was after that incident that we got to know each other."
Lu Yang thought to himself, what a guy, truly worthy of the title Imperial City bully, even hitting a prince.
"I presume these two must be Tao Yaoye and Man Gu, who invented the Dream Mirage, and this would be...?" Second Prince hesitated upon seeing Li Haoran.
Tao Yaoye and Man Gu often went out on missions, so the second prince could easily get their information, but he did not recognize Li Haoran, who rarely left the sect.
Su Yiren had called out "Haoran" at the Immortal Appraisal Convention, without mentioning the full name.
"I am Li Haoran, disciple of Dao Seeking Sect."
"So, it is Daoist Li Haoran, I have long admired you."
"Then this must be the reclusive Su Yiren, my friends, please have a seat."
Seeing Su Yiren clasping Li Haoran's wrist, Second Prince recalled the news he heard at the Immortal Appraisal Convention, glancing strangely at Li Haoran, but his good upbringing allowed him to quickly conceal his gaze.
"May I know what affair brings Prince Your Highness to seek us out?" Meng Jingzhou, having had contact with the Second Prince before, knew that they must have been summoned here for a reason.
"Nothing much, just that both of us are subjects of Great Xia, encountering each other in the East Sea, a meeting to reminisce and taste the delicacies of the East Sea is all."
Meng Jingzhou thought to himself, I'll believe that when pigs fly. With three big ships full of Great Xia cultivators, do you really need to come over just to reminisce with us?
Man Gu, hearing that the purpose was so straightforward, buried his head and started eating.
Though the flavor wasn't as good as the white crucian carp they had eaten before, there was a greater variety. Eating more kinds would count as broadening their horizons.
"I've heard that Daoist Lu Yang was a disciple of Daoist Buyu, whose magic skills and swordsmanship are extraordinary, capable of contending with the so-called Young Sect Master Lu and even became the acting sect master twice. Truly, your future is boundless, and I don't know how many cultivators in the Imperial City regard you as a role model!"
Lu Yang modestly said, "Your Highness flatters me, it was all due to my own efforts, and has nothing to do with my master."
The corner of Second Prince's eyes twitched, unsure how to respond to that statement.
"I heard that Your Highness's trip to the East Sea is to search for the elixir of eternal life, I wonder if there is any clue?"
Second Prince chuckled: "I just visited the Island Master of Penglai, and I heard some secrets from him. There might indeed be an elixir of eternal life."
"We too are concerned about His Majesty's health, and if needed, we can assist Your Highness in searching for the elixir."
"I appreciate Daoist Lu Yang's kind thoughts, but the elixir's growth conditions are harsh, and if something were to happen to you, it would be hard to explain to the Dao Seeking Sect."
"No worries, we immortals have ways to protect ourselves, Your Highness need not worry about our safety."
Having said this, the Second Prince had no grounds to dismiss their offer to help anymore.
"Then I thank you all for your kindness."
...
Lu Yang and his companions, upon receiving the invitation by the Second Prince, took the initiative to board the ship.
"These three ships must have cost a pretty penny, it seems that Your Highness has come to the East Sea fully prepared to search for the medicine."
The Second Prince looked deeply troubled as he sighed and said, "Although big brother claims to have no interest in competing for the throne, no one knows whether he's telling the truth or lying. Old Three is also eyeing the throne with covetous intent."
"Our father is the pillar of Great Xia. If he falls, it will inevitably trigger a struggle for the throne and plunge Great Xia into chaos."
"Although I have no interest in competing for the throne and do not wish to see siblings fighting each other, that's why I took to the sea in search of medicine. If this voyage to the East Sea can find the elixir of life and extend our father's lifespan, then these three ships will have been worth it."
"I have met the Crown Prince twice, and from his demeanor, he doesn't seem interested in the throne."
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had met Prince Jiang Qun once at the Qingzhou festival, where at the time he went by the name Xia Qun, serving as the deputy to the Prefectorial Governor of Qingzhou.
The other time was at the celebratory event of the Dao Seeking Sect, where the Crown Prince represented Great Xia.
"Some say big brother is biding his time, accumulating power in the shadows. There are even rumors that father's limited lifespan is somehow connected to big brother."
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou exchanged a glance, realizing the affairs of the Imperial City were more complicated than they had imagined.
The Second Prince suddenly realized the topic was a bit too heavy; he had said too much. These were not things that people like Lu Yang and the others should know about. Shifting his mood, he laughed and said, "Enough of that, why talk about such disheartening matters? The seascape of the East Sea is vast and boundless, there's no need to dwell on these vexations."
The large ship hoisted its sails and set out, where the azure sky and the profound sea seemed to merge at this moment, creating a seamless panorama of the sky and sea as one. On the sea's surface, sunlight scattered like broken gold, glittering and reflecting a dazzlingly bright world of light and shadows. Indeed, looking at it could soothe one's mind.
However, Lu Yang felt indifferent to the beauty of the East Sea; his mind was filled with the seawaters of the East Sea and a mermaid of immortal caliber darting around in chaos.
"Could this be the young friend Lu Yang?" An elderly man appeared beside Lu Yang, as silent as a shadow.
Earlier, as Lu Yang watched the Second Prince disembark, the surrounding attendants were all at the Body Integration Realm, except for this elder he didn't recognize, whom he suspected to be at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage.
Now, having Fairy Eternity confirm it, he knew the other was indeed at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage.
"Who are you?"
"I am Cang Mingzi; I once had the fortune of crossing hands with Daoist Yun Zhi."
Lu Yang realized why such a formidable Transcendence Tribulation elder was being so polite to him, addressing him as a young friend—turns out he had been defeated by his Eldest Senior Sister.
"Daoist Yun Zhi has been cultivating for less than a millennium, yet she has already reached a transcendent and saintly realm, truly making this old skeleton blush with shame."
"Predecessor Cang Ming is joking, I don't know how many people are envious of your cultivation level."
"It's just a result of grinding away over time. Given that you're Daoist Yun Zhi's Junior Brother and possess such remarkable talent, you are bound to have a place in the conflicts of this Great Era."
Seeing the flourishing young Lu Yang, Cang Mingzi felt quite emotional. Afterwards, he walked away with his hands clasped behind his back, shaking his head as he went.
"What's the word?" Meng Jingzhou suddenly asked Lu Yang out of the blue via a transmission of sound.
Lu Yang sighed, replying with a sound transmission, "The Second Prince is too eager to make friends with us. If I'm not mistaken, we might face a shipwreck soon."
Despite the Second Prince's effort to appear indifferent to the throne, he had just said he was unsure whether his big brother would contest for the throne, and that Old Three was also eyeing it eagerly.
The use of "also" implied that the Second Prince himself coveted the throne.
And here were he and Old Meng—one the future Sect Leader of Dao Seeking Sect and Yun Zhi's Junior Brother, the other, the Young Master of the Meng Family.
If he could win them over, the throne would virtually be in his grasp.
A fast way to build friendship would naturally be through joint survival of a dangerous ordeal.
"I wonder if he would still have the courage to try and win us over, knowing that we're both from the Heavenly Court Sect."

chapters.title: Chapter 764 - 763: Acting
chapters.content:
Just as Lu Yang had anticipated, when the large ship was midway through its journey, the skies changed abruptly. Lightning flashed, thunder roared, and the ship was lifted a hundred meters high by the waves before crashing down onto the sea surface with a violent thud.
Had the ship's hull not been reinforced by multiple array methods, it would have been shattered into pieces long ago.
Lu Yang thought to himself, I knew it would be like this. On this single ship, he had already encountered three Body Integration Realm cultivators, not to mention the number on the other two ships.
With so many high-ranking cultivators on board, to encounter such a terrifying storm clearly meant it was orchestrated by someone.
It's known that Body Integration Realm cultivators possess a portion of the power of natural laws, and for them, dispelling a sea storm is but a matter of speaking the word.
Su Yiren's expression turned grave as she protected Lu Yang and the four others, communicating telepathically, "Be careful. I tried to dissolve the storm using the power of natural laws, but it was useless. Someone is causing trouble behind the scenes, and they're at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage!"
The dark clouds overhead tore open, and a pitch-black figure appeared in the sky, enveloped in storm and rain. The eyes that shone a ghostly green like amber seemed as though they came from the netherworld itself.
The pressure was as deep and unfathomable as a prison, steadfast and irresistible, weighing heavily on everyone's hearts.
"It really is a Transcendance Tribulation Stage!" Su Yiren broke out in a cold sweat, having not anticipated such bad luck on this trip, encountering a Transcendance Tribulation Stage adversary.
Tao Yaoye and Man Gu became somewhat panicked upon hearing about the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. They rarely ventured out with Lu Yang and had never witnessed such a grand scene.
Lu Yang, maintaining his composure, telepathically explained the situation to everyone.
"Don't panic, everyone. This is all part of the Second Prince's plan. He wants to create a disaster so that we will all owe him a favor in his bid for power," he said.
"If I'm not mistaken, Elder Cang Mingzi is conveniently not on board at the moment. First, the Body Integration Realm cultivators will meet the enemy, then the Second Prince will come to ease our minds. He will ask us to join forces and overcome this hardship together. To make it convincing, he will even injure himself."
"At the critical moment, Elder Cang Mingzi will appear belatedly and battle the dark figure for three hundred rounds. Overpowered, the dark figure will be defeated and retreat in disgrace."
The group, relieved, felt indignant at the same time, believing the Second Prince had gone too far.
"Form up to meet the enemy!"
With a loud shout from the Second Prince, three figures flew out from each of the large ships, all of them at the Body Integration Realm!
The Second Prince, on this journey, was followed by nine Body Integration Realm cultivators!
These nine cultivators, all battle-hardened veterans, had anticipated combat might arise in the East Sea and had practiced numerous times in advance.
A covert and powerful surge of spiritual energy began to fluctuate; they were setting up an array method — the Nine Heavens Responding Thunder Array, inscribed with complex and profound talismanic characters. As their fingertips traced through the air, strands of light emerged from within their bodies, coalescing into a vast nine-sided net.
The nine Body Integration Realm cultivators each took their position at a corner of the grid, forming hand seals to harness the quintessence of heaven and earth.
Seeing this, the Second Prince hurriedly ran to Lu Yang's side to calm him and the others, "Dear Daoist friends, do not panic. The Nine Heavens Responding Thunder Array formed by these nine Body Integration Realm cultivators is capable of countering a Transcendance Tribulation Stage; we will be safe."
Even though the Second Prince said this, Lu Yang, still a Nascent Soul Stage Cultivator, couldn't help but feel panicked at the thought of a Transcendance Tribulation Stage making a move against him.
Trembling, he asked, "Where is Elder Cang Mingzi?"
The Second Prince showed a regretful expression, "Just a moment ago, he said he spotted a rare fish and wanted to catch it for a meal. We never expected to be attacked by a Transcendance Tribulation Stage adversary in such a short time!"
As they conversed, the mysterious Transcendance Tribulation Stage made a move, shattering an array at the bottom of the ship that stabilized the vessel. A wave crashed over them, and everyone, including the Second Prince, was tossed about helter-skelter, struggling to stand.
"Are we really going to be alright?" Meng Jingzhou clung to the side of the ship, his figure swaying from side to side.
The Second Prince, with a resolute look, assured, "We will be fine. I am willing to risk my life to ensure everyone's safety!"
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were deeply moved.
The Second Prince looked up at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage dark figure who was fighting, and called out sternly, "Who are you exactly? I am the Second Prince of Great Xia, Jiang Zhu. Do you intend to make an enemy of Great Xia!"
The Transcendance Tribulation Stage dark figure let out a cold laugh, looking down at the Second Prince with disdain, showcasing the arrogance typical of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
"Nonsense."
With a single word from the Transcendance Tribulation Stage dark figure, the Second Prince felt a tightness in his chest and was blown away, crashing against the cabin and vomiting blood twice. His hairpin fell out, and his hair chaotically stuck to his face, making him look utterly pitiable, a stark contrast to his usual image.
Lu Yang, with all the composure of a sage, telepathically messaged everyone, "What did I tell you? To gain sympathy, the Second Prince was bound to get injured, and I must say, he plays his part quite convincingly."
"Maybe he got really hurt in order not to blow his cover," Meng Jingzhou said admiringly as he looked at the blood-spitting Second Prince, "He's really committed for the throne; my opinion of him has changed."
Tao Yaoye and Man Gu looked up to Lu Yang with admiration, as everything that had happened so far had been within Elder Brother Lu Yang's expectations.
"How dare you harm someone!"
Cang Mingzi arrived belatedly, bellowing in anger as he displayed boundless Dharma forms, silently chanting ancient spells. Instantly he triggered a resonance from the depths of the sea. The tumultuous waters, as though pulled by an invisible force, began to gather around him. The water no longer raged but followed some peculiar laws, gradually taking on the shape of a giant human figure.
The two sides engaged in a fierce battle, each displaying divine abilities that churned the seas, scaring the Sea Clan living below into trembling.
"Old Cang, that's about enough acting, if we keep this up, the ship is going to fall apart," the Second Prince secretly transmitted a message to Cang Mingzi, feeling Cang was being far too reckless; just now, he hadn't been lightly wounded.
The Second Prince's plan was just as Lu Yang had anticipated, including the injury, which was part of the plan.
The Second Prince had asked Cang Mingzi to create a clone for him to fight against and ultimately defeat.
Moreover, the clone couldn't have any distinct features—if it resembled any of the Sea Clan, afterward, if Lu Yang and the others started to cause trouble for that Sea Clan, everything would be exposed.
Given the power of the Seek Dao Sect and Lu Yang's identity, it was very possible that Yun Zhi and Vast Sea Daoist Lord, these two Semi-Immortals, would join forces to come to the East Sea to settle accounts.
This was why he designed the clone to appear as a mere shadow.
Cang Mingzi was astonished, not understanding what the Second Prince was talking about: "The clone isn't ready yet."
He had genuinely gone fishing just now.
Second Prince: "?"
He instantly realized something was terribly wrong.
Damn it, how did a real Transcendence Tribulation Stage show up?!
"Trouble."
Seizing the moment when Cang Mingzi was distracted, the Transcendence Tribulation Stage shadow stretched out a huge hand covered with talismans, potent enough to crush anything.
The Nine Heavens Lightning Array was pierced by the large hand, and like chicks, Lu Yang and the four others were swept away by the giant grasp, with Su Yiren, intending to save them, also caught in the grip.
After the Transcendence Tribulation Stage shadow captured Lu Yang and the others, the weather returned to normal, calm and peaceful, as if no battle had ever occurred.
The Second Prince slumped to the ground, utterly devoid of any post-disaster optimism.
"It's over, Yun Zhi's Junior Brother, the Meng Family's Young Master got abducted on my ship, and their whereabouts are unknown."
Forget about the succession to the throne; he only hoped now that the Seek Dao Sect and the Meng Family wouldn't come knocking to claim his life.
...
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, is our abduction also part of the plan?" Tao Yaoye asked uncertainly as they were trapped in a water bubble, with the immense claw hurrying across the East Sea, carrying the sphere in its grasp.
Lu Yang also felt that something wasn't quite right; could it be that the Second Prince intended to play the hero saving another hero?
"Fairy, can you discern the origin of this shadow?"
"Hmm? Isn't this the Kunpeng Clan?" Although the shadow tried hard to conceal its kind, it was immediately recognized by Fairy Eternity.
Lu Yang: "..."
He felt that the Second Prince couldn't possibly have the capacity to get a Transcendence Tribulation Stage from the Kunpeng Clan to act in this play.

chapters.title: Chapter 765 - 764: Venerable Black Feather
chapters.content:
```
The Kunpeng Clan's ancestor moved at such a swift pace that everyone was simply unable to make out the surroundings clearly.
As the scenery changed in the blink of an eye, a mere glimpse outside would leave one's head spinning.
Suddenly, everyone felt emptiness beneath their feet, and the water mass that had restrained them disappeared as they dropped to the ground like dumplings.
Fortunately, the fall was not from a great height, so although disheveled, no one was hurt.
"Why is this ground so rough?" Man Gu said, rubbing his behind.
"No, this isn't the ground, it's a bird's nest," Li Haoran said with a solemn expression; beneath their feet were interwoven branches, each as thick as two men, plucked from some unknown tree.
The bird's nest was so immensely vast and boundless that it extended for a thousand miles, and even if Lu Yang and the others flew with all their might, it would still take a good while to reach the end of the nest.
Li Haoran's complexion worsened as he remembered an ominous rumor, "I've heard that in ancient times, ferocious birds would go out to capture food for their chicks, and us geniuses with years of cultivation and bodies full of unmatched spiritual essence are considered great nourishment, perfectly suited for feeding young birds!"
Man Gu was startled and recalled the records of his tribe, confirming Li Haoran's words were not false: "Our Barbarian tribe has similar records that in ancient times, the ancient Barbarian Tribe would capture food for their younglings, and the most suitable as food were the various fierce beasts of ancient times, each with unparalleled spiritual essence in their bodies."
Everyone gave Man Gu weird looks and silently moved away from him.
Seeing the atmosphere turn grave, Li Haoran quickly added, "However, the situation has not yet reached a dead end; I have also heard that in order to train their chicks, the ancient ferocious birds would let the chicks fight with the captured cultivators, which would help in training the young birds. Usually, the chicks and the cultivators are matched in cultivation level.
If we manage to defeat the young birds, we may be able to escape."
A cold, black wind blew past, making everyone shiver with a bone-chilling coldness.
Everyone looked up, only to see the true form of the black shadow that had appeared: an immensely large peng bird with wings spread that reached over a thousand miles, feathers as dark as ink, and the bird's nest engulfed in its shadow.
It then shrank in size and transformed into a human figure with an appearance of over fifty years old, with narrow and deep-set eyes that shone with a ruthless and merciless light.
The Kunpeng Clan's ancestor, the Venerable Blackfeather!
"I have sought you out for an important matter, and you shall not lie!"
"Are you disciples of the Five Elements Sect? How has Shangguan Yu been faring recently?"
Shangguan Yu, mother of Qiu Jin'an, and at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage in cultivation.
Everyone: "..."
This identity as a disciple of the Five Elements Sect seemed not as safe as imagined.
Seeing everyone's silence, Venerable Blackfeather frowned slightly, "Are you not disciples of the Five Elements Sect? But that can't be, aren't you able to perform the Five Elements battle formation?"
"You don't know Shangguan Yu? That's also not right; I've heard she often mingles among you young cultivators, and you even have amulets for safety, which must be given to you by Shangguan Yu."
The amulet mentioned by Venerable Blackfeather was obtained when they visited the Five Elements Sect for an exchange study. After seeing the Firmament Tree, Shangguan Yu had Lu Yang and the others call her Sister as a reward, she took a small section of the tree branch and made it into amulets for Lu Yang and the others.
Lu Yang and the others still wore the amulets around their necks to this day.
With caution, Lu Yang asked, "Elder, are you... very close with Sister Shangguan?"
Venerable Blackfeather revealed a smile as if to say 'of course', "Back when Shangguan Yu and I were still in our cultivation days, we met in the East Sea. I led her in exploring the East Sea, together we sought out secret realms, found Immortal Herbs, overcame difficulties, and passed through tough times.
If not for Qiu Duanya's sweet talk to steal her heart away, the two of us would've long been joyfully united in marriage!"
"If it weren't for Qiu Duanya, Qiu Jin'an would have been my son!"
Qiu Duanya, father of Qiu Jin'an and the former Sect Leader of the Five Elements Sect.
"What, haven't you heard her mention me?" Venerable Blackfeather asked dissatisfiedly, seeing the dumbstruck faces of Lu Yang and the others.
```
Esteemed Black Feather had long harbored a secret affection for Shangguan Yu, yet he never dared to go to Great Xia to see her. When he heard that disciples of the Five Elements Sect were in the East Sea, he took it upon himself to invite Lu Yang and the others back to inquire about Shangguan Yu's recent situation.
Concerned about his reputation, he invited Lu Yang and the others while wearing a mask, worried about being recognized by outsiders.
Esteemed Black Feather saw through the disguises of Lu Yang and the others at a glance, but that didn't matter. Since they knew the Five Elements battle technique and had tokens, they must be disciples of the Five Elements Sect.
"Er, actually, we are disciples of the Seek Dao Sect," Lu Yang said, bracing himself and explaining awkwardly.
"Seek Dao Sect, the grand disciple of Tang Shengyi?"
Seeing that Esteemed Black Feather's expression was turning from sunny to cloudy, Lu Yang quickly added, "But we have a good relationship with Sister Shangguan. She has visited our Seek Dao Sect as a guest, and I was the one who hosted her."
Upon hearing this, Esteemed Black Feather's countenance improved, "Then how has she been doing recently?"
Lu Yang thought for a moment and said, "I think she seems to be quite happy."
This was an absolute truth. Among all the Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivators Lu Yang had met, Shangguan Yu was the most lively and cheerful.
"Does she have any plans to remarry?" Esteemed Black Feather asked the most crucial question.
Lu Yang remembered Uncle Ba's unrequited affection and felt that Shangguan Yu probably had no feelings for Uncle Ba.
"She probably doesn't."
Upon hearing this, Esteemed Black Feather hung his head in dejection and was greatly disappointed.
"It's fine, it seems our fate has not yet arrived. The matters that occurred here must not be disclosed to others. If I come to know of any leaks, you will all be punished!"
"Yes," everyone hastily agreed, not daring to say otherwise.
"However, my Kunpeng Clan is not unaware of the proper rites. Since you've come to my Kunpeng Clan, you should be well received."
Esteemed Black Feather once again enveloped everyone with a bubble of water, himself transforming into a black-winged great peng bird, whistling past, flying out of the nest and plunging downward.
North of the East Sea was a forest growing in the water, the trees soaring into the clouds, as tall as the clouds themselves. Esteemed Black Feather's nest was built atop the tallest of these trees.
Beneath the bird's nest was the living area of the Kunpeng Clan. The group saw a large kun breaking through the sea's restraint amid surging waters and leaping waves. In an instant, it burst forth from the constraints of the sea, rising like a moving island, scales glittering with strange light that gradually dissipated, replaced by sturdy feathers becoming a peng bird soaring into the sky.
Esteemed Black Feather brought the group to the Clan Leader of the Kunpeng Clan.
Upon seeing the ancient ancestor suddenly bringing six people, the Kunpeng Clan Leader hurriedly paid his respects, "I pay my respects to the ancient ancestor."
"These six are honored guests of our clan, treat them well."
"Yes, yes, yes," the Kunpeng Clan Leader quickly nodded in affirmation, always striving to fulfill the ancient ancestor's instructions to the best of his ability.
Clan Leader Xiao?" Meng Jingzhou blurted out upon seeing the Kunpeng Clan Leader.
Wasn't this the very Clan Leader Xiao who had visited the Meng Family during New Year's and even given him a New Year's gift?
Clan Leader Xiao was startled, seeing through Meng Jingzhou's disguise and appeared even more surprised than Meng Jingzhou, "Young Master Meng?"
"Has the Meng Family come directly to the ancient ancestor to collect a debt?"

chapters.title: Chapter 766 - 765: The Sorrow of the Kunpeng Clan Leader
chapters.content:
"Meng Family Member?" Elder Heiyu's expression turned strange; he hadn't expected Meng Jingzhou to have that kind of identity.
He knew about the debt relationship between the Kunpeng Clan and the Meng Family, but as the ancestor of the Kunpeng Clan, his status was such that he would never personally go to the Meng Family to borrow money or to pay a New Year's visit. These matters were always handled by Clan Leader Xiao, accompanied by a group of Elders.
The Kunpeng Clan had their own Sea City, but due to poor management in recent years and cash flow issues, they had to borrow spirit stones from the Sea Clan or cultivators of the East Sea. In order to avoid being looked down on later, they went to Great Xia to borrow spirit stones from the Meng Family.
Naturally, Elder Heiyu couldn't admit that it was him who had personally brought the creditor here; it would tarnish his image, "They came to find me on their own initiative."
Lu Yang: "..."
Elder, you live in such a high place; how did we even fly up here?
Lu Yang quietly asked Meng Jingzhou, "How many spirit stones does the Kunpeng Clan owe your family?"
Meng Jingzhou shook his head, "How would I know? I wasn't even aware of the Kunpeng Clan borrowing spirit stones."
Elder Heiyu quietly asked Clan Leader Xiao, "How much do we owe the Meng Family in spirit stones?"
"There are still 1.6 billion spirit stones left unpaid."
"Can we repay it?"
Clan Leader Xiao clenched his teeth, as if making some decision, and said, "Spirit stone turnover has been tight recently, but I've heard that in Great Xia, cultivators at the Body Integration Realm can work as bodyguards, and the going rate is one million spirit stones per day. If I work as a bodyguard for a year, the debt can be almost paid off."
"Is there another way?" Elder Heiyu frowned, feeling that it was a loss of face for the clan leader to go out and work as a bodyguard.
"There is, bodyguards at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage earn even more."
Elder Heiyu: "..."
It seems you'll have to work as a bodyguard then.
"Uh, we were just passing by the Kunpeng Clan, just wandering around, not here to collect a debt," said Meng Jingzhou. He surely didn't dare mention the bird's nest incident.
Given Clan Leader Xiao's behavior, it's likely he's unaware of the relationship between Shangguan Yu and Elder Heiyu. Otherwise, during his visit to Great Xia to pay a New Year's visit, he would've inquired about Shangguan Yu's situation and wouldn't need Elder Heiyu to personally come out and capture them for interrogation.
"Really?" Clan Leader Xiao was overjoyed, prepared to be at Meng Jingzhou's beck and call.
"Really."
At that moment, in Clan Leader Xiao's eyes, Meng Jingzhou was not a creditor but an honored guest.
"Why haven't you poured tea for Young Master Meng yet?" Clan Leader Xiao hurriedly instructed. Looking around, he saw only guests and the ancestral figure, so he had to pour the tea for Meng Jingzhou himself.
Elder Heiyu, feeling awkward, spread his wings and soared high into the sky, returning to his nest.
It was evident that Clan Leader Xiao was generous. Although the tea wasn't as good as Enlightenment Tea, it was the next best thing.
"I've heard that you've joined Seek Dao Sect, Young Master Meng?"
"Yes, these are my Junior Brothers and Junior Sisters," Meng Jingzhou naturally included Lu Yang among his Junior Brothers.
"She is too?" Clan Leader Xiao looked in surprise at Su Yiren, who was snuggling up to Li Haoran's shoulder, her age and cultivation level hardly seeming like that of a disciple.
"She's not; she's Junior Brother Li's fiancée."
Clan Leader Xiao hissed quietly, feeling very envious of Li Haoran.
If only he could have such good luck to become the Clan Leader three hundred years ahead of time.
"I didn't expect our ancestors to be so polite to the disciples of Seek Dao Sect. It seems you indeed have great influence, Nephew Meng," laughed Clan Leader Xiao heartily.
"What do you mean?" asked Meng Jingzhou, puzzled. "Is there a story behind this?"
"It seems you are unaware, Nephew Meng. There was a bit of a grudge between our ancestor and Elder Tang Shengyi."
Originally, this was a secret that shouldn't have been shared, but Clan Leader Xiao was in such a good mood and grew fonder of Meng Jingzhou the more he looked at him, thinking that it wouldn't hurt to share.
"That happened four thousand years ago when our ancestor's cultivation level was about the same as yours. Two cultivators from Great Xia came to the East Sea to temper themselves, they were Elder Tang Shengyi and Elder Shangguan Yu."
"Elder Tang Shengyi was fishing in the East Sea, using quite precious elixirs as bait. Seeing the value of the elixirs, our ancestor transformed into a Kun Fish, devoured the elixirs, and fled without taking the bait, repeatedly causing heavy losses to Elder Tang Shengyi.
Eventually, Elder Tang used a transformation technique to disguise as an elixir and had Elder Shangguan Yu throw him into the water as bait."
"Our ancestor, being careless, fell for the trick and swallowed the elixir that was actually Elder Tang Shengyi."
"Upon seeing this, Elder Tang Shengyi reverted to his original form and beat our ancestor until he vomited and had diarrhea, begging for mercy."
"Elder Shangguan Yu, seeing that they had hooked something, pulled up the fishing rod and ended up reeling in both our ancestor and Elder Tang Shengyi."
"They fought from the water to the sky and from the sky back to the water, with Elder Tang continuing to overpower our ancestor."
"Back then, our ancestor was one of the geniuses, undefeated in a hundred battles. He had never been beaten like that before and ended up crying, which is how the matter was resolved."
"Elder Shangguan Yu, being kind-hearted, saw that our ancestor was injured and comforted him, treated his wounds, and even scolded Elder Tang for being too harsh."
"I guess it was after that incident that our ancestor developed a fondness for Elder Shangguan Yu. He thought it was a secret, but it had long since become common knowledge."
Clan Leader Xiao grew more excited as he spoke. To uncover what had happened back then, he had visited many elders, and that was how he pieced together the story.
"Elder Tang Shengyi, having recorded our ancestor crying with a Recording Orb, even made copies. I once went to your sect and got a copy from Elder Tang. It really makes me laugh every time I watch it," said Clan Leader Xiao, slapping his thigh and laughing so hard tears came out.
"Just now, I was lucky to have said I'm very familiar with Sister Shangguan," thought Lu Yangxin. "Otherwise, just based on what Grandmaster did, the Black Feather Revered One would probably have them strung up on a bird's nest at the very least."
"Moreover, when they adventured in the East Sea later, whether delving into secret realms or searching for Immortal Herbs, whenever there was danger, it was either Elder Tang Shengyi pushing our ancestor out front to face it or our ancestor throwing Elder Tang in the way."
"When it came time to part ways, as our ancestor pondered whether to confess his feelings to Elder Shangguan Yu, Elder Tang suggested leaving it to fate. 'Pull out a feather and say you won't confess, pull out another and say you will. When you've pulled the last one, you'll have your answer,' Elder Tang said."
"Our ancestor even asked if it would hurt, to which Elder Tang retorted, 'If you can't handle that much pain, how can you say you love her?'
"Our ancestor gritted his teeth and plucked feathers all night long, until he had none left. The final result was to go and confess, and so he went…bare as the day he was born—hahaha! Elder Tang had a Recording Orb; I even begged him for a backup copy."
"Before he could confess, Elder Shangguan Yu had already fled in shock."
"After Elder Shangguan Yu returned to Great Xia, our ancestor sent love letters but, being nervous, forgot to sign them. The letters recounted their experiences in the East Sea, and Elder Shangguan Yu thought they were from Elder Tang."
Meng Jingzhou looked at Clan Leader Xiao, who was laughing heartily, and kindly reminded, "Clan Leader Xiao, would you like to turn around and look behind you?"
Clan Leader Xiao, unable to stop the smile on his face, turned his head to look behind him.
Then his smile swiftly faded away as he saw the Black Feather Revered One, his face as dark as ink.
The Black Feather Revered One coldly spoke, "Mingli, I notice your cultivation has not improved recently; perhaps you've been slacking off. Come, let's go practice together."

chapters.title: Chapter 767 - 766: The Attack Was Still Too Light
chapters.content:
The Clan Leader Xiao Mingli's laughter became more and more feeble, eventually turning into a hollow chuckle.
The venerable Black Feather extended a claw and clutched at Clan Leader Xiao's shoulder, his gaze as cold as if he were looking at a dead body.
"Ancestor... there are outsiders present, let's not make a spectacle for others to mock."
Clan Leader Xiao used Lu Yang and the others as a shield.
Usually very concerned with face, the venerable Black Feather couldn't care less at this moment and grabbed Clan Leader Xiao by the neck.
Lu Yang, skilled in learning, took inspiration from Clan Leader Xiao's storytelling and had taken out a Recording Orb early, hoping to capture the last moments of Clan Leader Xiao's life.
Unfortunately, the venerable Black Feather gave no opportunity, directly dragging Clan Leader Xiao to his higher-layered nest.
Soon, the skies above the Kunpeng Clan were filled with piercing cries of birds. All the Kunpeng clansmen stopped their work, looking up at the skies with puzzlement, not understanding where these bird cries were coming from.
Suddenly, the cries of the birds stopped abruptly.
Clan Leader Xiao died pursuing the desires of his heart, a fitting end.
"Cough cough, the ancestor really doesn't hold back, eh? Knocked me out cold in the end," Clan Leader Xiao staggered back after the piercing cries stopped, his face swollen and bruised with gold feathers sticking out of his head.
"Dunno how long I was out cold."
"Clan Leader Xiao, are you alright? The venerable Black Feather was too harsh," Meng Jingzhou asked deliberately out of politeness.
"Surviving means I'm alright. Just bad luck this time, got caught by the ancestor exposing weaknesses. So many in the clan know about the ancestor's past issues, why doesn't he lecture them?" said Clan Leader Xiao resentfully.
"Everyone in the Kunpeng Clan knows about the venerable Black Feather's past?"
"Of course." Clan Leader Xiao confidently said, "I ask them if they know about the ancestor's matters, and for those who say they don't, I recount the whole story to them."
Meng Jingzhou gasped, thinking that the venerable Black Feather had been too lenient.
Lu Yang guessed that Clan Leader Xiao's strength could place him second in the Kunpeng Clan.
If anyone were ranked lower, the venerable Black Feather wouldn't have left them alive.
Indeed, Lu Yang's guess was correct; in the Kunpeng Clan, Clan Leader Xiao's strength was second only to the venerable Black Feather, stronger than the elder Kunpengs.
"Originally, I was prepared to personally show you around the Kunpeng Clan as a gesture of hospitality," Clan Leader Xiao rubbed his face with a grimace, "but with these injuries on my face, it won't heal in a moment. Wearing a mask while showing you around wouldn't be proper."
"Xinghai, stop cultivating and come here for a moment," Clan Leader Xiao sent a message to his son.
Soon, a golden-winged great Peng bird, dozens of zhang tall, landed at Clan Leader Xiao's doorstep. Seeing his father transform into human form, he too took on human shape—a handsome blond young man with azure eyes.
"This is my youngest son, Xiao Xinghai."
Xiao Xinghai was startled to see his father bruised and battered, "Dad, what happened to you?"
"It's nothing, just took a fall."
"Fell on the Black Tortoise shell of the Xuanwu Clan?"
"Scram, scram, scram! Don't ask what you shouldn't," Clan Leader Xiao raged, wanting to give this little Kun brat a thrashing.
"These six are friends from the Dao Seeking Sect. They are about your age. Entertain them in my stead."
In the territory of the Kunpeng Clan, Lu Yang and the others dared not offend the venerable Black Feather and posed as disciples of the Five Elements Sect.
"The Dao Seeking Sect, one of the Five Immortal Sects of Great Xia?" Xiao Xinghai was quite surprised.
Only a week had passed since the Vast Sea Daoist Lord and the Master of All Laws had clashed, and news of the Dao Seeking Sect possessing a Semi-Immortal had yet to reach the Kunpeng Clan, deep in the northern parts of the East Sea.
If Xiao Xinghai knew, he would be even more astonished.
"Then do you recognize Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou?"
"I am Lu Yang, and this is my junior brother Meng Jingzhou," Lu Yang introduced first.
"That's not right, the two of you don't look like that in the portraits."
"Our Seek Dao Sect has quite a few enemies in the East Sea, so we've disguised ourselves."
Xiao Xinghai recalled the bounties on eight of the nine disciples of the Seek Dao Sect and understood Lu Yang's meaning.
"Well, let's go, I'll take you around."
Meeting the renowned geniuses of the Great Xia, Xiao Xinghai was extremely excited, volunteering to transform into a golden-winged bird and carry Lu Yang and the others."
The golden feathers, like glaze and gold, shone brilliantly under the sunlight.
Having left the Clan Leader's home, seated on Xiao Xinghai's back, everyone finally had the chance to witness the living environment of the Kunpeng Clan.
Whole groves of seeker trees took root in the East Sea, some thousands or tens of thousands of feet high, half submerged in the sea and half emerging above it, with dense branches interlocking to form a canopy that shielded the sunlight above, offering a cool and pleasant shade beneath.
The Kunpeng Clan had two types of dwellings, one being a hollowed-out section of a seeker tree, the other a constructed bird's nest.
The Clan Leader's home belonged to the former.
Due to the enormous size of the Kunpeng people, their dwellings were also ridiculously large; the entrance of tree hollows was generally several dozens of feet high, making Lu Yang and his companions feel as if they had wandered into a land of ancient giants.
Occasionally, large peng birds flew past them, casting curious glances their way.
"Prepare to enter the sea!" Xiao Xinghai warned loudly, his feathers transforming into golden scales, like the legendary golden dragon.
Riding on the golden Kun's back, Lu Yang and the others clung to the dorsal fins; cold seawater came from every direction, engulfing them, yet their Water-Repelling Pearls activated, negating the pressure of the water, allowing them to move freely under the sea.
Under the sea was a completely different scene from above. Countless large Kuns swam through the water, with many even bigger than Xiao Xinghai—although their scales were not as perfect as his.
Clearly, there were more Kun fish than peng birds.
"Most of our clan really enjoys living underwater," explained Xiao Xinghai.
Besides Kun fish, there were many other Sea Clan members here. They were from nearby clans coming to the Kunpeng Clan's Sea City to trade goods.
The scale of Sea City was comparable to that on Penglai Island, and from this one could tell that the Kunpeng Clan deserved their reputation as one of the ten great races of the East Sea.
This was a place that neither Qin Haoran nor Su Yiren had ever visited. It was a feast for the eyes, and Tao Yaoye watched intently, thinking of using it as a scene for Dream Mirage in the future.
She fell from the ship, and Elder Brother Lu Yang dived into the sea. As she stopped breathing, he kissed her, passing air to her, creating such a beautiful scene.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, if I fell into the sea, would you save me?"
Lu Yang looked at Tao Yaoye up and down in surprise, seeing her moving with ease in the water and not understanding why she asked such a question.
"Junior Sister, have you also taken in some water in your head?"
"...I mean I want to use the East Sea as a backdrop to shoot a Dream Mirage. There's a scene where I fall into the sea and you come to save me."
Lu Yang suddenly realized and said excitedly, "So that's it. Then, junior sister, as you fall into the sea, certainly the East Sea Dragon Clan would be to blame. After I save you, I would battle the East Sea Dragon Clan for three hundred rounds, pulling out the dragons' tendons.
Then, to seek revenge on me, the Dragon Clan would try to flood Penglai Island, and I would bravely appear, sacrificing myself before the Dragon Clan."
"Later, Eldest Senior Sister would appear, gathering my three souls and seven spirits, creating a body from lotus roots, and I would be resurrected through the lotus root body, causing an uproar in the Dragon Clan and restoring peace to the East Sea."
"Is that how you want to film it, junior sister?"
"...And what about me?"
Man Gu, who was listening on the side, was puzzled: "Weren't you already saved?"

chapters.title: Chapter 768 - 767 The Calabash Brothers Stir Up the Sea
chapters.content:
"You can film Dream Mirage, I thought only Fan Chong of Penglai Island could do that!" Xiao Xinghai heard the conversation between Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye and was very interested in the topic.
Lu Yang introduced with considerable pride, "What's Fan Chong? Just a nobody. This is my Junior Sister, Tao Yaoye, not only is she beautiful but also incredibly smart. The Dream Mirage was her invention!"
Tao Yaoye's cheeks blushed slightly when she heard this, but she pretended not to hear Man Gu's response.
"As for Fan Chong of Penglai Island, he's just a copycat. If he were in our Great Xia, he would have been jailed long ago. Junior Sister Tao is the original creator."
"That's amazing." Xiao Xinghai's eyes lit up as he listened.
"Can you arrange a role for me? I don't mind playing a hero or a villain." Xiao Xinghai had long wanted to become a character in the Dream Mirage; not to mention, this thing was famous.
Tao Yaoye thought the Kunpeng Clan was quite warm and hospitable; the Black Feather Ancestor didn't vent his anger on them, the Clan Leader Xiao told them stories of Great Powers, and Xiao Xinghai, who kept transforming into pengs and kuns, pulled them in for a tour; that was quite generous.
"Sure." It's just a role.
Lu Yang pondered, "What do you think of the script just now? How about we replace the Long Clan in it with the Kunpeng Clan, and you play the Kunpeng who drags Junior Sister Tao into trouble?"
"Yes, yes, yes." Xiao Xinghai immediately agreed when he heard he had so much screen time.
"What about me, can I get a role too?" Meng Jingzhou edged over to join the fun.
Lu Yang, with a look of disdain, pushed Meng Jingzhou aside, "There are enough roles, no place for you."
Meng Jingzhou said enthusiastically, "How can there not be? Aren't you on the mission to scrape bones and restore flesh to your parents? I can play your dad."
Li Haoran also came over, "Yi Ren and I are actually fiancées, how about we play the parents?"
To play Lu Yang's father, Li Haoran was willing to sacrifice his image and play the pretty boy.
"Get lost, kid. You two cause trouble, and I'll play your dad."
"Fine, fine, fine, I'll change roles... But no, there aren't many important roles in your script." Meng Jingzhou felt his status was too high to play an insignificant character in the Dream Mirage.
"Think of a way to modify the script."
"Brother Lu, give me a role too?" Man Gu joined in too; he wanted to be part of the Dream Mirage as well.
Lu Yang felt a headache coming on; where were all these important roles in the Nezha Conquers the Sea story supposed to come from?
Tricky.
Suddenly, Lu Yang had a flash of inspiration and found a solution, "We can change everyone's background, say that a vine gave birth to four gourds, and when the gourds split open, they turned into four people."
"Hey, that's a good background, really fits the fact that the East Sea is rich in natural treasures."
