"When the time comes, I'll pop out of a gourd first and challenge Xiao Xinghai. If I can't beat him, Old Meng, you go on next, followed by Junior Brother Man, and Junior Brother Li, just like that, we'll fight..."
After all, Su Yiren was a hermit and not suited to appear in the Dream Mirage.
Xiao Xinghai, hearing the intense discussion by Lu Yang, also joined the exchange; the five of them grew more and more excited, almost wishing they could practice a round right then and there.
"I'll start with this move when the time comes..."
"Then I'll strike back like this, an injury for an injury..."
Tao Yaoye didn't quite understand why Lu Yang and the others were so excited.
"What's Junior Sister Tao's identity?" Meng Jingzhou asked the key question.
Lu Yang, stroking his chin in thought, said, "A butterfly spirit... no, that doesn't make sense, where would a butterfly spirit in the East Sea come from? How about we set her as a disciple of the genius of Penglai Island?"
"What do you think, Junior Sister Tao?"
"I'm fine with anything."
Tao Yaoye looked utterly disinterested; however she heard it, her role in the script wasn't significant, so whatever went, let it be.
"Xiao Tao, do you have feelings for Lu Yang?" Su Yiren transmitted her voice to Tao Yaoye.
Su Yiren, after all, had been through it all. Unlike Lu Yang and his group of numb-headed blockheads, she noticed the budding affection Tao Yaoye harbored for Lu Yang.
Tao Yaoye's cheeks flushed redder than before as she transmitted her voice back, her tone shy, "Senior Su, you noticed?"
"Mhm, I noticed a bit."
"Do you have any ideas, Senior Su?"
Su Yiren thought for a moment and then seriously suggested, "Cultivation."
"Cultivation?"
With conviction, Su Yiren said, "That's right. As long as you work hard at cultivating and surpass Lu Yang in cultivation level, when the time comes, you can drag him into the bridal chamber by force. Even if he resists, it'll be no use!"
"For instance, I can do that with Haoran."
Tao Yaoye thought about it, and it seemed to indeed be the case, perfectly in line with the Cultivation World's principle of respecting the powerful.
Su Yiren recalled something else and said, "Additionally, after you return to Great Xia, you could go to the black market in Chunjiang City of Youzhou. I bought this drop of blood there, and everyone who has used it says it's excellent..."
While Su Yiren and Tao Yaoye whispered, on the other side, Lu Yang had already finalized the details of the script.
"Penglai Island grows our four gourds. Brother Xinghai, if you want to eat Junior Sister Tao, just let her drown, then I will make my entrance, bursting out from a gourd... Sorted, let's do it this way! Shall we find a place to practice?"
Tao Yaoye needed a real place as a template to construct the Dream Mirage scene and then make alterations based on it.
Without having seen Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, Man Gu, Li Haoran, and the Kun Peng in battle, Tao Yaoye couldn't construct the Dream Mirage.
"Are there any islands nearby?"
"There are." Xiao Xinghai said. For such a fun matter, even if there weren't any, he'd get the elders of the clan to build an island.
"Junior Sister Tao, why don't you also walk through the rehearsal?"
"Alright." Tao Yaoye, having just received Su Yiren's true transmission, shook off her earlier dispirited state.
Xiao Xinghai carried everyone to an island filled with the chirping of birds and fragrant flowers.
This place was beyond the territory of the Kunpeng Clan, but because it was right next to the clan's domain, no one dared to live here; it was a deserted island, perfect for putting on a play.
...
Tao Yaoye changed into a new outfit, dressing in the Penglai Island uniform, looking cheeky and adorable.
With her hands behind her back, holding a pair of shoes, her ankles disappeared into the soft sand and water as she hummed a cheerful folk song, walking along the shore, her hair adorned with a freshly plucked wildflower.
Suddenly, a demon wind blew by, and the Kun Fish, transformed by Xiao Xinghai, surfaced, its emerald eyes fixated on Tao Yaoye, emanating extreme danger.
"Such pure cultivation, truly a favorite child of heaven and earth. Penglai cultivator, today you ought to fall into my belly!"
Xiao Xinghai exercised his divine ability, and Tao Yaoye's figure wobbled, falling forward into the sea unconsciously, blowing bubbles and struggling while crying for help.
In that critical moment, deep on Penglai Island stood a gourd vine. The gourd vine was an ancient primordial Spirit Root, which after enduring countless trials and tribulations, finally matured.
A cracking sound was heard as the first gourd to ripen was the red one.
The red gourd split open, and Lu Yang, dressed in red gourd-leaf-made shorts, sprang out, quickly growing to the size of an ordinary man with the breeze.
"Evil creature, how dare you harm people!" shouted Lu Yang as he dived into the East Sea, lifting the thoroughly drenched Tao Yaoye in his arms.
Tao Yaoye hadn't expected Lu Yang to make such an intimate gesture. Now being held by him, she was so nervous she stuttered, "Elder Brother Lu Yang, thi-thi-this..."
"Junior Sister Tao, act more convincingly when we're rehearsing," Lu Yang whispered.
As quiet as a mosquito, Tao Yaoye murmured her agreement.

chapters.title: Chapter 769 - 768: The Four Gourd Brothers
chapters.content:
Tao Yaoye's face blushed fiercely as she rapidly contemplated what to do next.
What was the script supposed to be, after being saved by Elder Brother Lu Yang, how should she have acted?
She nervously looked into Lu Yang's eyes and noticed an almost imperceptible excitement hiding within their depths.
Could it be that Elder Brother Lu Yang, while claiming to act sincerely, was actually just as flustered when he held her?
Lu Yang gently put her down on the riverbank, his movements tender, as he tried hard to conceal the excitement in his eyes and turned briskly to run back towards Xiao Xinghai.
"Hold, demon! Fight with me for three hundred rounds!"
Xiao Xinghai, unwilling to be outdone, retorted, "Who dares to spoil my good deeds!"
"You're not even worthy of knowing my name!"
"Since you want to save her, then stay behind yourself!"
"We'll see if you have the ability to make that happen!"
Lu Yang, wielding the innate treasure sword that came with the congenital gourd, without any formal instruction, yelled 'wah yah yah' as he fiercely dueled with Xiao Xinghai.
Tao Yaoye lay on the riverbank, tilting her head to watch Lu Yang who was getting into the heat of the act, wondering if there was no more of her role left in the scene?
The Immortal Herbs Fairy emerged from Tao Yaoye's clothes and kindly suggested, "Why not eat one of my leaves, gain a few hundred years of strength, and overpower that Lu Yang."
Tao Yaoye seriously considered this suggestion.
"Kun Peng Nine Transformations!"
Xiao Xinghai's aura surged, and his body swelled to several times its size, like a golden wall hurtling towards Lu Yang, sending a flurry of water splashing!
Lu Yang kept retreating, but with Xiao Xinghai executing the Kun Peng Nine Transformations, his massive form was unexpectedly agile and light, not something that could be overcome by merely stepping back.
"Tianshan Seven Swords!"
Lu Yang struck a sword gesture with form and grace, inventing a random name for a sword technique, and with a gentle wave, illusory shadows became countless true swords, forming a sword array that blocked Xiao Xinghai's charge.
This was a simplified version of One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand.
"Transform, Peng!"
Xiao Xinghai transformed into a great Peng, and Lu Yang seized the opportunity to flip over and mount its back. Xiao Xinghai tried to shake Lu Yang off, flying high into the cold ether before plunging into the icy East Sea, continuously spinning, but Lu Yang clung stubbornly to the feathers and would not let go.
The two battled fiercely in the sky.
"Foul beast, with a thousand years of cultivation, why do you choose to commit evil!"
"The world is unkind, treating all beings as straw dogs. If I feed on all creatures, what's wrong with that!"
Xiao Xinghai became more excited as the battle waged on, letting out a long cry, the sound of his call gradually becoming smooth and deep.
He began to change, transforming into a golden True Dragon, tens of zhang in length!
"No way, the Dragon Transformation Manual?" Lu Yang recognized Xiao Xinghai's move; he wasn't acting, he was genuinely shocked.
Lu Yang had learned ancient Divine Abilities that appeared famously powerful from Immortal Fairy Eternity in order to impersonate a being from the Ancient Heavenly Court, and among them was mention of the Dragon Transformation Manual.
Although for various reasons, Lu Yang did not learn the Dragon Transformation Manual but instead learned Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth.
"You're from the Kunpeng Clan and yet you learn the Dragon Transformation Manual?"
Up to now, Lu Yang had always thought that only the Human race would learn the Dragon Transformation Manual.
"It's about leveraging strengths to cover weaknesses. The Long Clan is indeed stronger than our Kunpeng Clan; this has to be acknowledged," Xiao Xinghai said with a grin, speaking nonchalantly.
"Just look at the Long Clan with their Dragon Ancestor, a Semi-Immortal. The rumors from the Demon Territory suggest that just like the Phoenix Ancestor, they're both spouses of the Qilin Immortal, capable of strutting around among the Semi-Immortals."
"Look at our Kunpeng Clan, we don't even have a single Semi-Immortal. It's only natural for me to learn from the strengths of the Long Clan. If we don't learn from other races' strengths, how can we make the Kunpeng Clan stronger?"
Lu Yang felt Xiao Xinghai made quite a bit of sense.
He felt he had fought Xiao Xinghai enough and, admitting defeat, stepped down to let the next 'gourd brother' take the stage.
"Ahhhh—" Lu Yang screamed as he fell to the shore, lying next to Tao Yaoye.
The orange gourd split open, and Meng Jingzhou, dressed in bright orange shorts, made a sparkling entrance.
"You beast, how dare you harm my brother, you're looking for death!"
Meng Jingzhou, like a rocket taking off, stomped on the ground fiercely and leapt into the sky, inheriting Lu Yang's will to battle the dragon-transformed Xiao Xinghai.
Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye lay side by side, resting on their arms as they watched Old Meng slay the dragon, or the dragon slay Old Meng.
With Nirvana True Fire to boost him, Meng Jingzhou transformed into a fiery phoenix and battled with Xiao Xinghai.
Xiao Xinghai, after transforming into a dragon, indeed performed better than when he executed the Kunpeng Nine Transformations. The Long Clan was famous for their formidable physiques, and Meng Jingzhou was equally renowned for his, making it hard to determine the winner between them.
"When we create the Dream Mirage, let's remove the smiles from both of their faces," Lu Yang reminded Tao Yaoye as Meng Jingzhou and Xiao Xinghai fought, barely holding back their laughter, which seemed like a struggle to contain.
Then Old Meng too screamed miserably and fell beside Lu Yang. Next, Man Gu leapt out from the yellow gourd and Li Haoran from the green.
The four gourd brothers lost in succession, lying on the ground, their fates uncertain, while Xiao Xinghai laughed wildly in the air.
"It seems that this time not only will I devour a genius cultivator, but I will also obtain four congenital treasure gourds!"
Just then, the gourd vine gleamed with a hopeful light, uplifting the spirits, and the four gourd brothers radiated red, orange, yellow, and green light.
They floated into the air, wrapped and merged by the light, becoming a brand-new being.
Mini Lu Yang, his body shimmering with the four colors of light, made his entrance!
The moment mini Lu Yang appeared, he put immense inexplicable pressure on Xiao Xinghai, who broke into a cold sweat.
Meng Jingzhou and the others exited, watching Lu Yang covered in four colors of magic-created light fly up into the air, grabbing Xiao Xinghai's tail, and smashing him into the water, drawing dragon tendons, as Xiao Xinghai stuck out his tongue languidly towards the sea surface.
A perfect ending.
After all, it was just a play; they couldn't really draw dragon tendons. These were props provided by Xiao Xinghai, sturgeon tendons.
To celebrate the end of the first play, Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, and Man Gu lit a fire, grilling the sturgeon tendons to share with everyone.
"What a delicious taste," Xiao Xinghai exclaimed after biting into the steaming grilled sturgeon tendon, his eyes lighting up.
The Sea Clan rarely used barbecuing as a way to cook.
"Well, let's take a break and then perform the second act. How about 'The Kunpeng Floods Penglai Island, the Gourd Brothers Suicidally Split Heaven and Earth, and the Gourd Immortal Comes to the Rescue'?"
Considering the Eldest Senior Sister wasn't very fond of appearing in the spotlight, when discussing the script, everyone decided to change her role to that of the Gourd Immortal who had planted the congenital gourd seeds.
"Okay," everyone was in high spirits, getting more invested the more they performed.
Suddenly, Su Yiren pointed to a patch of mist floating on the sea not far away, her expression one of confusion, "What is that?"
Xiao Xinghai turned to look and his expression changed drastically, "Not good, it's the Sea City mirage, run!"
"The Sea City mirage?"
Upon hearing this, Su Yiren summoned her magical power and pulled everyone to run in the opposite direction, utilizing her power over the rules.
"Here I establish the [Rule: The Mist Disperses]!"
The mist remained completely unaffected.
The mist moved too quickly, and before Su Yiren could lead them far away, the mist shrouded everyone, engulfing them completely.

chapters.title: Chapter 770 - 769 Mirage of Sea City
chapters.content:
The Sea Mirage, a mysterious phenomenon long known to drift through the East Sea.
It is said that the Mirage Clan was once incomparably powerful, ranking among the top ten races of the East Sea. Their most famous divine ability was the Sea Mirage. Eight thousand years ago, an accident occurred while the ancient ancestor of the Mirage Clan was delving into magic skills. He became possessed, leading to the uncontrolled Sea Mirage engulfing the core members of the Mirage Clan.
Since then, the Mirage Clan had fallen from its position among the top ten races, and the uncontrolled Sea Mirage roamed the East Sea without any pattern, swallowing up living beings, be they from the Human race or the Sea Clan.
Some beings managed to walk out of the Sea Mirage, some unharmed, others insane and incoherent.
There were also those who disappeared within the Sea Mirage, never to be seen again.
According to the recollections of those who came out safely, they encountered the missing individuals inside the Sea Mirage, but those people were controlled by illusions and became extremely aggressive.
Once, several Demon Emperors at the Transcending Tribulation Stage joined forces in an attempt to disperse the Sea Mirage. They encountered the crazed ancient ancestor of the Mirage Clan. After a fierce battle with everyone, the Mirage Clan's ancestor perished from exhaustion. Even after the death of the Mirage Clan's ancestor, the Sea Mirage did not dissipate.
After that, no one else tried to confront the Sea Mirage; it was regarded as a traveling disaster that one should flee upon sighting.
...
"What, the life tablet can no longer sense Xiao Xinghai's location!?" The Clan Leader of the Xiao Clan, currently healing from an injury, discovered the life tablet meant for Xiao Xinghai had mysteriously gone dark, signifying not death, but that he was beyond the range of the tablet's senses.
"Beyond the life tablet's sensing range? Does that mean they've entered a highly ranked Secret Realm? No, that can't be right. Although Xinghai loves to mess around, he would never enter a Secret Realm without notifying anyone, especially not with a guest!"
"Could they have been swept into some place... Oh no, it's the Sea Mirage!" the Xiao Clan Leader quickly realized.
...
"Oh, Clan Leader Xiao, what brings you leisurely to our place today?" Hearing of Clan Leader Xiao's arrival, the Clan Leader of the Mirage Clan hurried to welcome the true form of the Xiao Clan Leader.
Clan Leader Xiao was in no mood for idle chatter with the Mirage Clan Leader. His green eyes coldly stared at the Mirage Clan Leader as his beak, curved like a hook, pecked at the Mirage Clan Leader's forehead.
"Let me tell you, my son and our distinguished guest are trapped inside the Sea Mirage you created. If anything happens to one of them, you best be ready for revenge!" he said.
The Mirage Clan Leader turned deathly pale with fear.
"Tell me, how exactly does one escape from the Sea Mirage?" Clan Leader Xiao was preparing to enter the Sea Mirage to conduct a rescue. Before coming to the Mirage Clan, he had already sent people to locate the moving mist nearby his territory, confirming his suspicions.
The Mirage Clan Leader, on the verge of tears, said, "Clan Leader Xiao, that isn't the Sea Mirage at all. Otherwise, my clan wouldn't be utterly helpless!"
"Not the Sea Mirage?"
"That's right. Eight thousand years ago, the old ancestor found a mysterious space. He claimed that if we could comprehend the secrets of this mystic space, it might be possible to become a Semi-Immortal. For this, he created layers upon layers of Array Methods to meditate in seclusion."
"Later, nobody knows what the old ancestor did, but the mysterious space exploded into a mist. None of those Array Methods worked, and since the old ancestor's place of seclusion was at our core location, the explosion of the mystic space ended up swallowing most of our core members."
Clan Leader Xiao's expression became even graver.
...
"What do we do now?" Lu Yang and his group were trapped inside the Sea Mirage, not daring to move.
They tried to explore the area with their Spiritual Sense but found it was virtually impossible to make any progress here, and that included Su Yiren, who was at the Body Integration Realm.
Only Man Gu, who knew little about the Sea Mirage and its terrifying aspects, remained unaffected, but after a brief explanation from Xiao Xinghai, even he was frightened.
"According to those who have calmly walked out from here, regardless of whether they stayed put or wandered aimlessly, they were able to leave this place!" Xiao Xinghai recalled the intel.
By those who 'calmly walked out', he meant the people who did not go insane.
"So no matter what, we can leave?" Man Gu asked.
"It's not that simple, those who went mad, as well as those who disappeared in the Sea City Mirage, must have done the same, so whether we can leave safely is a matter of luck."
"The lucky ones encounter no trouble, the Sea City Mirage leaves us be, those less fortunate get attacked by people previously trapped here, dragging on for a while before they can leave too. According to records, there's not just one at the Body Integration Realm trapped here. Those even less lucky, well, they are either killed or driven insane by the illusionary realm."
"Fairy, do you have a way to handle this?" Knowing the Sea City Mirage's notorious reputation in the East Sea, Lu Yang understood this wasn't a situation he could resolve alone and sought help.
The Fairy Eternity, who had transformed into a mermaid, was lying on the sea sleeping when she was reluctantly awakened by Lu Yang.
"What's the matter... *yawn*... what has happened?"
"We're trapped by the Sea City Mirage."
"Sea City Mirage? The Mirage Clan's divine ability... *yawn*... Isn't that something you can just blow away?"
"Wait, this isn't the Sea City Mirage, how could the Mirage Clan have the power to create something like this?" The Fairy Eternity knew exactly what the Mirage Clan was capable of.
"So, what is this then?"
Fairy Eternity frowned, speaking seriously, "A battlefield relic from an immortal war! Both sides were immortals, and everywhere here are traces of the immortal battle and the Dao Fruit."
"Tell me, why did you just say this place is the Sea City Mirage?"
Lu Yang relayed the legends about the Sea City Mirage.
"The Sea City Mirage created by a member of the Mirage Clan at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage... that must be a deception."
"It's likely that the Transcendance Tribulation stage member of the Mirage Clan sensed the traces of the immortal battle here and attempted to comprehend the outline of the Dao Fruit through this way. But carelessly, they failed to control it, unleashing the dormant power of the battle relic, which consumed them as well."
"So who fought in this place?"
Fairy Eternity carefully sensed the battlefield relic, "I can feel that one of the sides was the Qilin Immortal. The Qilin Immortal's Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit is suitable for every member of the Demon Race, it's their natural instinct. Perhaps the Transcendance Tribulation stage member of the Mirage Clan sensed it vaguely too!"
"But that's not right, in my memory, the Qilin Immortal has never been involved in such a battle after becoming an immortal!"
Lu Yang also grew tense, realizing something was amiss, "Could it be the battle involving the Four Ancient Immortals and the hidden mastermind after your demise, Fairy?"
Fairy Eternity shook her head, "It shouldn't be, this battle wasn't so exaggerated, but this was absolutely not a sparring match, it was a fight to the death."
Lu Yang pondered, how could this be, the enemies of the Four Ancient Immortals should only include the hidden mastermind. Who else could the Qilin Immortal fight against?
Wait, there seems to be one.
"Fairy, do you remember, after you fell, there emerged a Fire Dynasty, the Fire Dynasty seemingly gave birth to an immortal, and they deliberately erased their own existence from history."
"Could it be possible that the Qilin Immortal's adversary was the immortal that emerged during the Fire Dynasty?"
"An immortal born from the Fire Dynasty, it is indeed possible."

chapters.title: Chapter 771 - 770: You Dump, I Dump
chapters.content:
"Fairy, can you discern anything else?" Lu Yang hadn't expected to stumble upon a site where a Qilin Immortal and a Fairy from the Fire Dynasty had clashed.
"Judging from the battle, it seems the Qilin Immortal was at a disadvantage. His moves were mostly defensive… No, could it be that he was protecting someone?"
Fairy Eternity slightly furrowed her brows, feeling that the Qilin Immortal's fight wasn't as brave as she remembered.
"Let's not worry about that for now. This fog is very dangerous for you all. You should escape first."
Fairy Eternity released her Spiritual Sense, enveloping the entire thick fog.
"How should we go?"
"The dense fog is continuously shifting positions. You are already near the center of the fog and have been surrounded."
Lu Yang was immediately alarmed, "What's inside the fog?"
"Most likely people who were trapped in the fog before. There are traces of a Qilin Immortal using Dao Fruit in battle here. The residual power of the traces still exists and can control people in the fog, from Body Integration Realm to Foundation Establishment Stage. Fortunately, there is no one from the Pass Tribulation Stage; otherwise, we could only ask Miss Yun for help."
"You'll run in the direction I tell you to."
"Okay."
…
"Gentlemen, I have a secret treasure given by the Sect that can guide us and help us get out of this," Lu Yang said solemnly, as per Fairy Eternity's instructions, pointing northward where the least number of enemies were located, making it the easiest direction to break through.
"This way!"
Without any doubts, everyone followed Lu Yang and ran toward the outside of the fog.
"Also, be prepared to fight. The secret treasure tells me we are surrounded!"
As soon as Lu Yang finished speaking, a water spear shot towards him—fast and precise.
Bang!
Su Yiren appeared in front of Lu Yang, facing the water spear with a palm strike that had the momentum of surging waves, dispersing the fog around them. However, the fog quickly rolled back in and shrouded everyone again.
Taking advantage of the moment when the fog dispersed, everyone saw their opponent: a more than three-meter-tall crab wielding two pincers, its body decayed and back covered in moss, having died who knows how many years ago.
"It's a Body Integration Realm crab from the Tyrant Crab Race!" Su Yiren recognized its origin and Cultivation Level.
Not just the Tyrant Crab Race, but countless Sea Clan and Human race members, all dead yet still moving, surrounded everyone.
Li Haoran vigilantly watched the fog, letting various meticulously crafted magic artifacts float around him. Cold sweat appeared on his forehead, "Next time, we should invite a friend from the Corpse Chasing Sect for a tour around the East Sea."
The Tyrant Crab Race's Body Integration Realm being suddenly lifted its pincers and flung them forward. The pincers were thrown toward Su Yiren's waist in an attempt to cut her in half!
"Spirit Marrow Cleansing Technique!" Su Yiren exclaimed softly, her fair skin containing endless strength as she directly countered the crab's attack. The crab's shell, known for its defensive power, was indented by her two punches.
The deceased Sea Clan and Human race members followed the Tyrant Crab Race Integration Realm's assault. Their shapes were varied, and their aura was ferocious—the leaping of a blue whale, the soaring of a sea swallow demon king, and the towering form of a millennia-old turtle demon among them. Some were ancient monsters, others were once peerless geniuses, but their eras were too long gone.
Xiao Xinghai had only heard their names and had never seen them in person, so he couldn't match them up.
"Form up!"
Lu Yang shouted, and the five people once again executed the Five Elements Array Method, sharing spiritual essence, and their combat power skyrocketed several times.
"One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand!" Lu Yang brought out the Sword Washing Pool, and countless Sword Washing Pools filled the sky, falling like shooting stars. Whether it was the Sea Clan or Human race, everything below the Divinity Transformation Stage was smashed to pulp.
Even those in the Divinity Transformation Stage were gravely injured, and their combat strength was drastically reduced!
```
"Shocking Heaven Six Forms!"
Meng Jingzhou displayed the power of three heads and six arms; his body seemed as if cast from iron and bronze, his muscles as convoluted as the roots and branches of a sinewy dragon, his fists stirring up an immeasurable force, each punch as if shaking heaven and earth itself!
Man Gu wielded a giant hammer weighing tens of thousands of pounds, directly clashing with a blue whale; every collision caused the sea water to violently surge, forming a massive vortex!
"Thousand Mechanism Change!"
Around Li Haoran appeared nine different types of magic artifacts: a jade gourd, a precious cauldron, a small hammer, a wooden sword... the nine magic artifacts ignited with True Fire, forming a small Array Method to block attacks from all directions.
"Feather Transformation Immortal Body!"
Faced with zombies, Tao Yaoye's skillful use of the Illusionary Realm was hardly effective, so she resolutely decided to activate her Feather Transformation Immortal Body; she was enveloped in milky white light, the milky white light transforming into pristine white feathers, and Tao Yaoye's aura suddenly surged!
Divinity Transformation early stage!
She borrowed power from her future self, temporarily transforming into the early stage of the Divinity Transformation!
The cost was that her future self, at the early stage of Divinity Transformation, would at some point drop to the mid-stage of Nascent Soul.
Tao Yaoye's spiritual essence grew like floodwaters bursting forth, and even the four people in the formation with her felt an endless stream of power!
Watching Lu Yang and the others unleash their divine abilities, Xiao Xinghai envied them greatly.
"Kun Peng Nine Transformations! Dragon Transformation Manual!"
Xiao Xinghai simultaneously cast two divine abilities, transforming into a hundred-zhang-long, four-clawed golden dragon; the golden dragon grew a pair of golden wings, each flap stirring up boundless hurricanes!
"Roar!" Xiao Xinghai faced off with a thousand-year-old turtle demon, his powerful dragon claws scratching three deep marks on the turtle's shell!
This turtle demon was a famed half-blood old devil of the Divinity Transformation Stage in the East Sea a thousand years ago, who once defeated a rival of the same stage from the Xuanwu clan, causing an uproar at the time.
Meng Jingzhou looked up in surprise at Xiao Xinghai; this lad really had some methods in his cultivation.
"Don't tangle with them, keep running!" Lu Yang knew very well that lingering here would only lead to their deaths; according to Fairy Eternity, there was an endless stream of Body Integration Realm powerhouses rushing this way.
Lu Yang held the Green Peak and Dark Moon swords in his hands, and with Sword Qi, he slashed a path which was quickly swallowed by the thick fog; he sat in the Sword Washing Pool, pushing through with force: "Run this way!"
The group fought their way through a bloody path.
While running, Lu Yang asked Fairy Eternity, "Isn't the Qilin Immortal-associated with the Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit? How come it still has the means to control others?"
"You've forgotten, Lianyi's Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit Outline has the ability to control others, and the Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit Outline is a lower counterpart of the Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit—the higher Dao Fruit possesses all abilities of its lower counterpart."
"However, the relationship between the Eternity Dao Fruit and the Eternity Dao Fruit Outline isn't like that."
"... The great Array has shifted position again. There's a fair amount of Immortal traces ahead; Immortal traces contain dense understanding of laws. Not to mention you guys, even those in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage can't withstand this amount of information with just a glance—they would go mad. That's how the previous people went insane. Run eastward!"
The site of the Immortal battle was filled with deadly traps, and it was rare for anyone who wandered in to make it out. However, thankfully they had the help of Fairy Eternity, who could point Lu Yang to a clear path.
The bloodstained group emerged from the fog, miraculously escaping alive. Along the way, they encountered three bloody battles; despite injuries, they were only minor and no serious harm was done.
"I've already marked that site. Once you lot have settled down, Second-in-command, come back to the site. Let's have a careful look at it," said Fairy Eternity, who had long since discarded the warning from Eldest Senior Sister.
"Okay."
Coincidentally, Lu Yang had discarded it too.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 772 - 771: Night Exploration of the Immortal Battle Ruins
chapters.content:
"We actually made it out alive?" Xiao Xinghai felt a lingering fear, still unable to believe it. This was the moving natural disaster of the East Sea, and it was said that the chances of escaping from the Sea City Mirage were less than ten percent, with the chances of safely escaping being less than one percent.
What kind of secret treasure did Lu Yang have that made such effective guidance?
Tao Yaoye's realm had fallen back to the mid-stage Nascent Soul, and she appeared weak, even taking restorative elixirs to no avail.
Seeing Tao Yaoye about to collapse from weakness, Lu Yang quickly caught her and asked with concern, "How are you feeling?"
As he spoke, Lu Yang was about to take out elixir to heal Tao Yaoye.
Tao Yaoye gently shook her head, her voice very weak, "This is a side effect of using the Feather Transformation Immortal Body. Elixirs won't help, I need several days of quiet rest to recover naturally."
"Where have we run off to?" Meng Jingzhou tried to find some landmarks, but, unfortunately, there was nothing but empty sea and drifting dense fog.
"Just a moment."
Xiao Xinghai dipped his head into the sea, then raised it back up and wiped his face, "This area below is the territory of the Mirage Clan, considered a subsidiary race to our Kun Peng Clan. I'm quite familiar with them."
Just as Xiao Xinghai was about to lead everyone into the depths of the sea, he saw several hundred-zhang-long Kun Pengs flying in the distance, shouting and revealing excitement and joy in their words.
"Young Master, you've come out safely!"
"Uncle Kun, Uncle Yue, why are you here?" Xiao Xinghai recognized the newcomers as his father's confidants, no longer vigilant.
"Isn't it because the Clan Leader heard that you and the honorable guests were swallowed by the Sea City Mirage? He ordered the two of us to track the Mirage, so we could keep tabs on your whereabouts at any moment," they explained.
These two senior members of the Kun Peng Clan dare not get close to the Sea City Mirage, always cautiously observing from a distance.
"Let's go, let's head back. The Clan Leader was so anxious he nearly stormed to the Mirage Clan's gates. He'd be over the moon to know you've safely returned."
Originally, Uncle Kun and Uncle Yue wanted to take out healing elixirs for Lu Yang and the others, but when they saw them pouring out various elixirs with Elixir Patterns and Elixir Fragrance from their bottles, they dismissed the idea.
With everyone safely back, Clan Leader Xiao was overjoyed, having not expected everyone to escape from the Sea City Mirage unharmed and sane.
"It's good that you're back, it's good that you're back." Clan Leader Xiao arranged accommodations for everyone, telling them to rest well.
...
In the middle of the night, Lu Yang broke out of his state of meditation, or to put it accurately, he was immersed in cultivation when he was awakened by Fairy Eternity's tail.
"Hurry, hurry, hurry, the ruins haven't gone far," said Fairy Eternity excitedly.
Though the Kun Peng Clan didn't need to sleep, they typically cultivated at night, which meant there were not many people outside now, making it an excellent opportunity for covert actions.
Lu Yang steered the Sword Washing Pool, following the direction pointed out by Fairy Eternity, and flew out of the Kun Peng Clan's territory, quickly finding the aimlessly drifting dense fog.
Suddenly, Lu Yang broke free of Fairy Eternity's enchantment and realized the problem.
"Wait a moment, there are several at the Body Integration Realm in there. Wouldn't I be seeking death if I went in?"
"What are you saying? With this fairy here, could you possibly run into trouble? Earlier there were too many people, and some methods weren't convenient to use. Just a slight release of my Immortal might is enough, and that bunch of zombies surely wouldn't dare to come near," she reassured.
"Well, that's reassuring," Lu Yang again fell under the enchantment of Fairy Eternity.
Lu Yang felt a very comfortable force clinging to his body's surface, but upon a closer examination, he couldn't sense anything at all.
He entered the ruins of the Immortal battle, and under the reinforcement of the Immortal might, indeed, he didn't encounter any zombies controlled by the Dao Fruit.
If Lu Yang could see clearly the surroundings, he would know it wasn't that there were no zombies, but rather, zombies scared by his approach would run far away.
"Is this daytime?" Lu Yang entered the remains of the immortal battle, suddenly feeling as though everything in front of him turned white, engulfed in a thick fog that even darkness couldn't penetrate.
"It's perfectly normal, despite you being able to see this fog from the outside world, this place is actually a small world isolated from the outer realm, much larger than what you see in the fog."
"Tsk, the fight must have been fierce, nothing was left behind." Fairy Eternity expressed her dissatisfaction slightly, the battle between Qilin Immortal and the opponent was too intense, everything around had turned into dust and void, now making it impossible to determine where they were and why the conflict started.
"No, there's something over there, walk deeper." Commanded Fairy Eternity, and Lu Yang obediently moved inward.
The deepest part was where the battle was fiercest, covered with traces of Dao Fruit, so that even Cultivators at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage dared not approach or look straight at it.
"To the right, yes, right here."
Lu Yang followed Fairy Eternity's instructions and squatted down to pick up a jade bracelet from the ground.
The jade bracelet was delicate like congealed fat, similar to a bright moon, transparent and lustrous, with a lifelike dragon etched upon it.
"This is the Dragon Pattern Bracelet, it belongs to Xiao Ling." Fairy Eternity exclaimed in surprise.
"Originally, Qilin Immortal had requested the Ying Tian Immortal to forge two Immortal Artifacts, one was the jade flute that Lianyi often blew, the other was the Dragon Pattern Bracelet that Xiao Ling wore on her wrist."
It was precisely because it was an Immortal Artifact that it could survive the battle.
"Why would Xiao Ling's possession be here? This was her favorite item, she would only take it off when she slept... I see that Qilin Immortal's moves were mostly defensive, could it be that an Immortal of the Fire Dynasty wanted to erase Xiao Ling, and that led to an intense battle with Qilin Immortal?"
Fairy Eternity murmured, and if that was the case, everything made sense.
Though Ao Ling was the strongest Semi-Immortal, she was still no match for an Immortal, and she would have a hard time defending against the Immortal of the Fire Dynasty looking to erase her.
Qilin Immortal arrived just in time to fight fiercely against the opponent, destroying everything.
During the battle, Xiao Ling's Dragon Pattern Bracelet was left here.
"Fairy, since Senior Ao Ling is also a Semi-Immortal, she would have to use the Playing Dead Technique to endure the lengthy time in order to meet with you, right?"
"Right."
"Then do you think it's possible that this place might be where Senior Ao Ling is in slumber?"
Fairy Eternity jolted, "That's it, it's not that Xiao Ling was no match for the opponent but that the opponent took advantage of Xiao Ling's slumber to kill her!"
Lu Yang suddenly remembered something Master of All Laws had once said – he had a friend who, for knowing about the existence of the Fire Dynasty, was killed by an Immortal while in slumber!
Such a similar method!
Lu Yang carefully asked, "Fairy, do you think it's possible that Senior Ao Ling might have... "
Fairy Eternity shook her head firmly, "Impossible, the Dragon Pattern Bracelet has the capability to resist an Immortal's attack. Even if Xiao Ling took off the bracelet, if she was attacked by an Immortal, the bracelet would still automatically protect its owner."
"Now the bracelet's energy might be exhausted, but it hasn't shattered, which indicates Xiao Ling faced danger but the bracelet blocked it. It should be that Qilin Immortal moved Xiao Ling to another place."
"I could originally track Xiao Ling's position through the Dragon Pattern Bracelet but Qilin Immortal severed the connection between the bracelet and Xiao Ling very cleanly, and it wasn't done by brute force.
Only Qilin Immortal and the Ying Tian Immortal who forged the bracelet could do such a thing, and there are no traces of Ying Tian Immortal's battle here, implying that Qilin Immortal was the only one who fought."
"This suggests that Qilin Immortal doesn't want anyone to locate Xiao Ling through the bracelet."

chapters.title: Chapter 773 - 772: The Dao Fruit of Annihilation
chapters.content:
Lu Yang took out a piece of red cloth and carefully wrapped up the dragon-patterned jade bracelet.
This was an authentic Immortal Artifact that could withstand several attacks from an Immortal; even though its energy was now exhausted, it was still quite valuable.
"It seems that the Immortals of the Fire Dynasty are very strong," Lu Yang said, his expression grave. The Immortal who actually wanted to kill Ao Ling was equivalent to making enemies with the Qilin Immortal and even the Four Ancient Immortals. This was an irreconcilable situation where neither side would stop until the other was dead.
"But why didn't the adversary attack Elder Lianyi? Is it because they couldn't find her? No, that's not right. Elder Lianyi appeared in the Demon Territory, and the entire Cultivation World knew about it. The adversary must also be aware. They didn't act against her for some other reason?"
"Wait, I remember Master of All Laws saying that there were Immortals deliberately erasing the existence of the Fire Dynasty, and all who knew were to be killed."
"If the Immortal who is erasing the Fire Dynasty is the same one who is opposing the Qilin Immortal..."
Lu Yang seemed to have realized something and analyzed, "Could it be that Elder Ao Ling and Elder Lianyi didn't go into slumber at the same time? Elder Lianyi fell asleep earlier, right after the great war, before the Fire Dynasty was established. Elder Ao Ling went to sleep later, by which time the Fire Dynasty had already been established.
Elder Ao Ling knew about the Fire Dynasty's existence, perhaps even more than Master of All Laws did, so that's why Elder Ao Ling was also within the scope of those marked for death?"
The more Lu Yang thought about it, the more shocked he became. If this assumption was correct, what exactly was the purpose of this Immortal who would even make enemies with the Four Ancient Immortals?
"Fairy, can you tell what kind of Dao Fruit the opponent of the Qilin Immortal possesses?"
Fairy Eternity frowned, releasing her divine consciousness to carefully observe all traces around them, not missing any signs. Her tone was unusually hesitant.
"This is precisely what puzzles me the most. The techniques used by the adversary of the Qilin Immortal are very familiar to me, it's almost like, almost like they are fighting against me."
"What?!" When Lu Yang heard Fairy Eternity say this, his heart skipped a beat. The more he heard, the more he felt that the waters surrounding the Fire Dynasty were deep.
Might as well ask Eldest Senior Sister to come and discern this. When the time comes, just say that Fairy Eternity controlled me to come here.
Fairy Eternity pointed at a certain battle mark: "Look at these ruins, they are all filled with Dao Fruit techniques left by the Qilin Immortal, but all these techniques are severely damaged, having been destroyed once."
"Usually, after I self-destruct, the Dao Fruit techniques of the Qilin Immortal would become like this."
"Could it be that the adversary can self-destruct as well... wait, what if it's not self-destruct but annihilation?"
Fairy Eternity slapped her palm in realization, "That's right, the adversary possesses the Annihilation Dao Fruit. No wonder it looks so familiar, it's so much like mine!"
"What is the Annihilation Dao Fruit?" Lu Yang asked, hearing of such a Dao Fruit for the first time, completely bewildered.
"Let me think where to start," said Fairy Eternity, now touching upon her own domain, "Do you still remember that before I had the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit, I had another Dao Fruit Outline?"
Lu Yang nodded, Fairy Eternity had mentioned this before.
According to Fairy Eternity, she was supposed to be the first Immortal of this world, except that she found it difficult to decide on a Dao Fruit. She had formed an initial Dao Fruit Outline but wasn't satisfied with it. Later, inspired by Time Immortal, she discarded the initial Dao Fruit Outline and formed the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit.
Afterwards, she became an Immortal and formed the Eternity Dao Fruit.
"The very first Dao Fruit Outline I formed was the Annihilation Dao Fruit Outline. As the name implies, it is a Dao Fruit capable of destroying all things, with fearsome combat power!"
"Back then, I felt that becoming an Immortal with the Annihilation Dao Fruit wouldn't quite fit my intentions. Time Immortal then told me that everything has its rise and fall, prosperity and decay are just fleeting moments for nature. Only by imitating nature and returning to simplicity can one maintain eternal strength."
"I found this idea to be very much in line with my thoughts, so I abandoned the Annihilation Dao Fruit Outline and switched to the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit," said Fairy Eternity nonchalantly, but only those who had reached the Transcendence Tribulation Stage could understand the terrifying implication of her words.
It was already extremely difficult for a Transcendence Tribulation Stage practitioner to comprehend even one Dao Fruit Outline, let alone someone like Fairy Eternity who could change her Dao Fruit Outline at will.
"What is immortality? Immortality is nature; it is eternity. There's prosperity, and there's decline. Thus, I, as an immortal, can be resurrected or self-destruct."
"Then, who exactly is the Qilin Immortal's opponent…"
"This is why I find it strange. Back when I was alive, no Semi-Immortal managed to condense the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit. It's a challenge of great difficulty, and only a heaven-sent genius like myself would have been able to accomplish it."
"Could it be that during the Fire Dynasty era, there was a talent only slightly inferior to mine?" Fairy Eternity scratched her head in vexation, unable to figure it out.
"If that's the case, then it's possible that Qilin Immortal really might not win."
When it came to the problem of the Dao Fruit, Fairy Eternity was puzzled, and Lu Yang was even more at a loss.
Seeing that the ancient battleground had been thoroughly explored, to glean any information about Elder Ao Ling's whereabouts from here was impossible. To prevent others from discovering Ao Ling, Qilin Immortal had erased all possible clues. Lu Yang suggested they head back home.
After Fairy Eternity agreed, Lu Yang took advantage of the night to return to the Kunpeng Clan, and the night passed without incident.
"Fairy, there is one more important thing." Lu Yang said solemnly, as a reminder.
"What is it?"
"Regarding our findings in the ancient battleground, we will definitely have to tell Eldest Senior Sister once we get back. We should say that after accidentally entering, you, Fairy, used your powers during our fight with the zombies to carefully observe the place, leading to our discovery. Don't mention that the two of us came here under cover of night."
"You always think things through, Second-in-command."
Lu Yang and the others rested quietly in the Kunpeng Clan for three days, mainly because Tao Yaoye needed to recuperate while Lu Yang and the four others rehearsed with Xiao Xinghai for The Calabash Brothers Stirring the Sea.
Although Tao Yaoye wasn't present, they could record everything with a Recording Orb to show her later.
"According to the plan, we should rehearse the scene where the Kunpeng Clan floods Penglai Island. Given the significance of such an event, wouldn't it involve your clan's Elders or the Clan Leader? Should we go and ask them?" Lu Yang hesitated, questioning if the portrayal would be too realistic?
Xiao Xinghai waved his hand, "No need for such trouble, I can just play my dad, right?"
He performed the Kun Peng's Nine Transformations and, in a shake, turned into a nine-hundred-zhang-long golden-winged great Peng, majestic and imposing, the spitting image of Clan Leader Xiao.
Xiao Xinghai smiled proudly: "Although only the outer form has changed, it's enough."
"Whenever I cause trouble outside and encounter something I can't handle, I just disguise myself as my dad, and it works every time."
"Come on, let's continue the play."
Xiao Xinghai chuckled merrily as the play was at its peak. He spread his arms, casting a shadow over the island.
"Three Mountains Taoist, hand over the fourth Calabash Brother, or I'll flood your Penglai Island!"
The fourth Calabash Brother looked up at the shadow, feeling a chill in his heart.
The real Clan Leader Xiao appeared, transformed into a thousand-zhang Kun Peng, appearing behind Xiao Xinghai, his gaze cold…

chapters.title: Chapter 774 - 773 Dragon and Phoenix Contest
chapters.content:
Lu Yang visited Tao Yaoye and, as arranged, brought a Recording Orb, within which the captured scenes were incredibly precious.
Tao Yaoye lay in bed, holding the Recording Orb, saw the clan leader of the Xiao beating his son, Xiao Xinghai, and thought perhaps he hadn't rested well.
"Didn't you five say you were going to put on a play? How did it turn into a real fight as the acting went on?"
Maybe this was a tradition of the Kunpeng Clan, the ancestors beating the clan leader, the clan leader beating his son, a physical memory passed down through generations, Tao Yaoye mused randomly.
From the Recording Orb also came the angry voice of Clan Leader Xiao.
"You little brat, I was wondering why there are things being blamed on me that I never did. Turns out, you're the culprit!"
"Dad, go easy on me, can you blame me? If your reputation wasn't so bad, would others have doubted it?"
"You still think you're in the right!"
A fight between a cultivator of the Body Integration Realm and one of the Nascent Soul Stage, without any surprise, was utterly one-sided.
Unfortunately, the four gourd brothers' commotion stopped at the flooding of Penglai Island, a scene that could now only be imagined by Tao Yaoye.
But it wasn't too hard to imagine, when Clan Leader Xiao disciplined Xiao Xinghai, it was by summoning huge waves to submerge Xiao Xinghai, or even replacing Xiao Xinghai with Penglai Island, it was presumed Penglai Island could be flooded as well.
Tao Yaoye couldn't help but laugh out loud, lying in bed bored, watching the Recording Orb was quite amusing.
...
"Xinghai, my friend, are you alright? Clan Leader Xiao was too harsh," Meng Jingzhou repeated what he had said not long ago.
"Hey, my dad just doesn't understand my painstaking efforts," Xiao Xinghai lay on the bed, while four of Lu Yang's group peeled fruits for him and poured him water.
"Currently, our clan only has the venerable Black Wing Ancestor as a Transcendance Tribulation elder. My dad is the most likely to become the next one to Pass Tribulation, but it's a pity he can't bring himself to do it, so I, as his son, have to push him a bit."
"The so-called Transcendance Tribulation Stage is a realm that one must pass through ordeals to ascend."
"But ordeals aren't of just one kind. If the Thunder Tribulation is an ordeal, isn't the hatred that I've dragged upon him an ordeal as well?"
Lu Yang kindly consoled Xiao Xinghai, "Xinghai, my friend, don't say more. When Clan Leader Xiao was beating you just now, you said the same thing, and he didn't believe you, and he beat you even harder."
Otherwise, Xiao Xinghai wouldn't have been confined to his bed.
He now felt even weaker than Tao Yaoye after using the Feather Transformation Immortal Body.
But the good news was that he could recover by taking Elixirs.
The bad news was that Clan Leader Xiao had ordered a ban on him using Elixirs for recovery.
That was the [Rule].
A Nascent Soul Stage challenging a Body Integration Realm, forcing the latter to exert the power of the rules, Xiao Xinghai could indeed be proud of himself.
"How about trying my Nirvana True Flame?" Meng Jingzhou's palm pulsed with an orange-red flame, the Nirvana True Flame known for its healing properties.
Xiao Xinghai hastily shook his head, "No, no, in cultivating the Dragon Transformation Manual, I've acquired some characteristics of the Long Clan. The Nirvana True Flame signifies the Phoenix Tribe; dragons and phoenixes are rivals, and it would only add to my injuries."
This was, indeed, a theory unheard of before.
"Fairy, is that true?" Lu Yang asked for confirmation from the ancient cultivator.
"It's true. Xiao Ling and Ao Ling have always been rivals, either competing for the Immortal position or vying for the Qilin Immortal on the bed."
Lu Yang: "..."
The competition always has something to do with immortals, right.
"It seems to have become a tradition, flowing in the bloodline of the later generations of the Dragon and Phoenix Tribes."
"However, there's also the saying 'Auspicious Dragon and Phoenix,' which indicates that the power of the dragon and the phoenix can coexist. I've seen them quite united when they resist a third party, like Qiongqi, Nine-Tailed Fox, and such. It's just that this young Kunpeng is too seriously injured to regulate the two forces and allow the dragon and phoenix to coexist."
Xiao Xinghai spoke again, "However, there is still a way."
"What is it?"
"Although Dragon's Blood doesn't have healing effects, it does strengthen the body. As long as I soak in Dragon's Blood, I can still speed up the recovery of my injuries."
Dragon's Blood is not considered an Elixir and is not regulated by the [Rules].
"You have Dragon's Blood?" Lu Yang remembered that Fairy Eternity had told him about the key to learning the Dragon Transformation Manual, which required soaking in a large amount of Dragon's Blood.
"I don't have any on hand. I used it all up while practicing the Dragon Transformation Manual, but we can buy some at the Sea Market in the Dragon Palace. That's where I got the Dragon's Blood I used for cultivation."
After discussing among themselves, Su Yiren stayed to look after Tao Yaoye, and the four of them decided to visit the Sea Market at the Dragon Palace.
"Take me with you. The fresher the Dragon's Blood, the better the effect. If you go back and forth, the effect will be greatly reduced." Xiao Xinghai struggled to get up, frightening Lu Yang and the others into hurriedly pushing him back down onto the bed.
"You can't even stand up properly, let alone go to the Sea Market."
"You can carry me there," insisted Xiao Xinghai, still not giving up.
"Isn't that too conspicuous? Would the Clan Leader let you leave?"
"It's fine, I have a way."
...
Carrying a coffin, Lu Yang and his companions flew towards the Sea Market of the Dragon Palace.
Xiao Xinghai was a renowned genius in the East Sea. If he were to be carried on a litter to the Sea Market of the Dragon Palace, it would be somewhat disgraceful.
By covering him with a coffin, there was no need to worry about being recognized.
It was a solution that served multiple purposes.
The coffin was a magic artifact with the ability to block Spiritual Sense.
The Sea Market of the Dragon Palace is the largest in the East Sea, where all types congregate. Different from Penglai Island, which is exclusively visited by the Human race, the Sea Market of the Dragon Palace is frequented by both the Sea Clan and the Human race.
The Sea Market of the Dragon Palace was a chaotic mix of all sorts, with something new happening every day, but carrying a coffin around the market was indeed a first.
"Who has died?"
"The ones carrying the coffin are four humans. Could it be a human elder?"
"Then what are they doing here? Are they planning a sea burial at the Dragon Palace? Would the Dragon Palace allow it?"
"Who knows."
"Strange, why do I see these four humans smiling so happily?"
"Perhaps it is joy born of sorrow."
Lu Yang and his group, chatting and laughing, arrived at the Sea Market of the Dragon Palace. The market was situated deep undersea, a place that should have been dim and dark, shrouded in pitch blackness, but the mighty Dragon Palace lit up the depths with countless Night Pearls arranged in a great formation, illuminating the deep sea.
"This place is really huge." As Lu Yang and his companions descended, they looked down at the Sea Market of the Dragon Palace, which resembled a giant dragon adorned with countless jewels, slumbering on the ocean floor, unbothered by the Sea Clan wandering about or the buildings erected on its body.
At the end of the Sea Market, there stood an ancient and simple great hall, a place well-known to everyone in the East Sea as the Dragon Palace.
The Dragon Palace was not open to outsiders, not even to Flood Dragons that were one step away from transforming into a Dragon.
"When we attend the Old Dragon Emperor's birthday banquet, we'll get to see what the Dragon Palace is like." The Old Dragon Emperor's birthday banquet was approaching, and through their connection with Su Yiren, Lu Yang and his companions were able to gain entry.
With the fame of the Nine Disciples of the Dao Seeking Sect, it was impossible to receive an invitation, and their arrival would be akin to walking into a trap.
"This is just too disrespectful. As the Immortal Lineage Second Boss and Lianyi's Senior Brother, the Old Dragon Emperor should come out personally and invite you into the Dragon Palace," Fairy Eternity, the mermaid, swam back and forth in the Spiritual Space, indignant on Lu Yang's behalf.
Even though Lu Yang didn't feel he had been treated unjustly.

chapters.title: Chapter 775 - 774: Coffin
chapters.content:
```
Lu Yang ignored Fairy Eternity's incessant chatter and focused on carrying the coffin.
"Speaking of which, the quality of this coffin is really quite good. According to what Xinghai said, it can even isolate the spiritual sense of a Unification-stage cultivator."
Generally speaking, coffins in the Cultivation World are designed to isolate spiritual sense, as a mark of respect for the deceased.
But to refine a coffin to this extent is quite rare.
"I always felt this coffin looked familiar." Lu Yang frowned, then suddenly remembered.
"Isn't this the coffin that the Grand Elder often sleeps in?" Back when Lu Yang had just learned Heaven and Earth in an Inch and was randomly teleported to a cliff, he was fortunate enough to break into the tomb that the Grand Elder had constructed, where the style of the coffins resembled that which Xiao Xinghai lay in.
"It's probably that the Grand Elder built tombs all over the East Sea, and Xinghai happened to pick it up," Meng Jingzhou was not surprised at all.
In the East Sea, there were many such legends where a certain genius inadvertently broke into a tomb chamber, passed tests set by predecessors, and obtained inheritance and magic artifacts, soaring to the skies thereafter.
It's just that the magic artifact Xiao Xingai got was a coffin.
Lu Yang thought Old Meng's explanation made sense. After all, wasn't Ying Tian the Immortal buried as a sacrificial offering only to rise tremendously afterward?
This tradition has historical precedence.
"According to what Xinghai said, the Long Clan is extravagant with money and does not sell their blood just because they're short on cash. They sell their blood mostly when they seek the completion of certain tasks, and in return, they reward with dragon's blood once the tasks are completed."
"Because dragon's blood is more precious than gold, the tasks sought are also very difficult."
"Moreover, some tasks involve the private affairs of the Long Clan, not suitable for public disclosure, so they are usually assigned at secret contact points."
"Lugging around this coffin everywhere we go, isn't that a bit awkward?" Man Gu asked, the stares gathering around them were palpable.
"Although leaving it by the roadside wouldn't worry anyone about it being stolen, it still has a bad influence, doesn't it? How about we find a place to set it down and then move the coffin over after we find the dragon's blood?" Meng Jingzhou suggested. They had already reached Sea City, so there was no issue with transportation distance or freshness of the dragon's blood.
He sent a message to Xiao Xinghai: "What do you think, Xinghai?"
No response.
"Oh right, the coffin can isolate spiritual sense, sound can't get through," Meng Jingzhou remembered. His voice could not penetrate, unless they opened the coffin.
"Then we'll decide for Xinghai—find a place to store it... Ah, coming up ahead is the Land Money Trade Association, I didn't realize they have a branch here too."
Meng Jingzhou said with a smile, noting the broad scope of the Trade Association's services, extending all the way to the East Sea.
In this respect, the Meng Family was not inferior, with the East Sea and Demon Territory also within their scope of operations.
"Perfect, the Association offers temporary storage services for large items."
...
At the edge of Sea City, within the Dragon Palace.
"Damn it, have we still not found the treasure?" a Dragon Clan Elder raged, a draconic-being afire with anger, wishing he could tear the thief of the treasure into a thousand pieces!
"The plot is meticulous; this is a long-planned theft. It must have been orchestrated by someone at the Body Integration Realm at the very least. I'm afraid they will not be easy to find," another Dragon Clan Elder was equally furious but managed to remain rational, analyzing the situation.
"Ancient Ancestor above, I pray for your blessing that we find the treasure quickly," the third Dragon Clan Elder implored, beseeching the legendary Ancient Ancestor to manifest.
"Search! Whoever carries the treasure cannot perform spatial movement. They surely haven't gotten far. Even if it means turning the East Sea upside down, we must find them!"
```
"Especially Sea City, that's where the thieves are most likely to be!"
"Why don't we use our Spiritual Sense to scan the entire Sea City?"
"Foolish, scanning the entire Sea City with Spiritual Sense would cause a huge commotion. Do you want the foreign clans to know that we have lost our treasure? Take your people and act separately, scan in small areas!"
"Remember, do not let outsiders know what we are doing!"
...
"Boss, we really did it." A rat-faced Body Integration True Monarch said excitedly, and even with the temperament of the Body Integration Realm, he couldn't help but get excited.
The other two Body Integration True Monarchs, though silent, couldn't hide their excitement and joy in their eyes.
The Dragon Clan treasure! They wouldn't have to worry about resources for cultivation in this lifetime, and they even had hope for advancing to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage!
"Don't get excited, we've only succeeded halfway. Don't forget we are still in Sea City, which is under the control of the Dragon Clan. Only by getting the treasure out of Sea City can we consider this a success," said the eldest brother who was likewise excited but maintained his composure, knowing well that it wasn't the time to celebrate.
"But, Boss, this treasure belongs to the Dragon Clan, it cannot be placed into a Storage Ring. How are we going to take it out of Sea City?" another little brother said worriedly.
Without placing it into a Storage Ring, they risked detection by the Dragon Clan's Spiritual Sense.
"No worries, I've thought of a way long ago." The boss took out a magic artifact from his Storage Ring.
"Look at what this is!"
"A coffin?" the three little brothers exclaimed in surprise.
The boss's expression was grave as he recalled the scene and felt fear, he lowered his voice, and started to tell his little brothers the story of their rise to fortune: "That's right, back when I was a tomb raider, I snuck into an ancient tomb. After many life-threatening encounters, I finally reached the depths of the tomb. Unfortunately, there were no burial items, and even the coffin was empty.
I suspect that the owner of the tomb had already transformed into an Immortal through corporeal dissolution!"
"A thief should never leave empty-handed, so I took the coffin!"
"This coffin is a real treasure. Even with our Body Integration Realm's Spiritual Sense, we can't probe inside!"
The three little brothers tried and found this to indeed be the case.
"Are we planning to put the treasure in the coffin and then smuggle it out by transporting the coffin?" The little brother thought the Boss was truly deserving of his title, his plan was meticulous.
No matter what, the Dragon Clan wouldn't disrespect the deceased by opening the coffin for inspection, such unseemly behavior would undoubtedly raise suspicions that the Dragon Clan had lost something very important.
The Dragon Clan cared about face and would never do such a thing.
"Right, but it's not that simple. Carrying a coffin around Sea City is too ostentatious and will attract the Dragon Clan's attention."
"Then what do you suggest, Boss?"
"I have a connection at the Land Money Trade Association. I've already notified them in advance. We'll store the coffin with the Trade Association, and once the commotion dies down, we'll retrieve it," the boss explained.
"Also, we need to disguise ourselves." The boss took out four elixirs from his chest.
"These elixirs I acquired from the black market in Great Xia, they are the works of a master refiner of the Seek Dao Sect. It's said that after consuming one, you can temporarily lower your Realm. We are all in the Body Integration Realm, and if the Dragon Clan starts investigating, they'll definitely suspect those in the Body Integration Realm first, which could put us in danger.
If we lower our Realms, the Dragon Clan won't suspect us!"
"Boss, you're brilliant!" The three little brothers were very excited, the Boss had thought of everything, his plan was seamless, covering all aspects.
...
"Excuse me, can you store a coffin here?" Lu Yang and his group carrying the coffin entered Land Money Trade Association and politely inquired.

chapters.title: Chapter 776 - 775 Good Service Attitude
chapters.content:
"It's about time they arrived," mused Manager Liu of the trade association in secret.
As a manager, he did not need to stand at the front desk, but today was special and could not be taken lightly.
He had a private collaboration with the Four Thieves of Juxuan Island. Although his cultivation level was low, his identity with the Land Money Trade Association gave him standing here. Coupled with the leverage he had over the Four Thieves of Juxuan Island, they dared not treat him lightly, making their relationship one of equal partnership.
Of course, the Four Thieves of Juxuan Island also had leverage over him.
According to the plan, today the Four Thieves of Juxuan Island would come to the association to store the coffin.
Generally, the trade association did not offer a service for storing coffins—it was not a funeral home, after all. That's why he had stayed here all day, waiting for the Four Thieves of Juxuan Island to come so he could personally receive them.
"Old Liu, the chairman has called for a brief meeting of all members at the manager level and above," another manager called out to Manager Liu.
Manager Liu frowned. He hadn't expected the chairman to call a meeting at such a critical moment. He wanted to refuse, but feared giving himself away, as the chairman's biggest pet peeve was people not attending meetings.
What a pain, he thought. Just wait until I get hold of the Dragon clan's treasure and then I'll resign.
It looked like he had to delegate this task to a subordinate, but he couldn't openly say that they needed to receive a coffin—that would be too blatant, too suspicious at first hearing.
He turned to a delicate-looking woman and instructed, "Su Yu, remember, the principle of our trade association is to serve the customers. Regardless of their requests, we must do our utmost to satisfy them. Do you understand?"
Su Yu had not expected the usually aloof Manager Liu to give her guidance and was deeply moved. She quickly responded, "Manager Liu, I've got it."
Manager Liu nodded, "Good, as long as you remember."
"Come on, Old Liu, we need to hurry," a friend urged him.
"They're here."
Half a quarter of an hour later, the meeting concluded, and he didn't ask Su Yu but went to the warehouse for a look instead.
"There's no coffin in the warehouse yet; it seems they haven't arrived."
Manager Liu went to the front desk and dismissed Su Yu. "That's enough, Su Yu. I'm here, you can go back and rest."
After all, Su Yu was an outsider; he couldn't let her see the Four Thieves of Juxuan Island and risk introducing unpredictable elements.
Manager Liu stood at the front desk and, in less than two minutes, saw Lu Yang and his group enter the trade association with the coffin.
"Excuse me, do you store coffins here?" asked Meng Jingzhou. He was the most familiar with the association and was in charge of liaising.
Manager Liu thought to himself, an unfamiliar face, they must have come in disguise, being quite cautious.
He displayed an understanding smile, pretending not to recognize Lu Yang and his companions, and treated them like ordinary customers. "Of course," he replied, "our trade association provides all services within our power. You wish to store a coffin? That can be arranged."
Meng Jingzhou was slightly surprised; he hadn't expected the Sea City branch of the trade association to be so service-oriented and thought his request might be politely declined.
He had prepared to look for an inn to store the coffin, even though the inn might not agree, but he planned to try offering more Spirit Stones.
If that failed, they would have no choice but to keep carrying the coffin. He didn't care about worldly views; it was mainly because Man Gu was thin-skinned.
"How many days do the four honored guests wish to store it for?"
"We plan on three days, but it's hard to say, we might extend the duration depending on the situation. After all, we don't know what it's like at the Long Clan's end. How many Spirit Stones will it be?" Meng Jingzhou asked offhandedly, still uncertain how long it would take to complete the Dragon's Blood task.
Manager Liu understood, it seemed they also didn't know when things would die down.
Upon hearing Meng Jingzhou inquiring about the cost in Spirit Stones, Manager Liu jolted. Taking Spirit Stones would be recorded in the ledger, wait a moment—the Four Thieves of Juxuan Island were not ignorant of rules; could it be that they intended to hint that everyone was on the same boat, warning him not to entertain thoughts of secretly moving the treasure?
"Three hundred Spirit Stones."
Meng Jingzhou casually took out three middle-grade Spirit Stones.
"Hey, be gentle with the coffin, it's not a dead person inside." Lu Yang reminded Manager Liu as he moved the coffin.
Manager Liu was not surprised and smiled indifferently, his movements gentle, "How could I not know that the coffin contains the Long Clan's treasure? This thing is worth more than my life."
After sending off Lu Yang and his group, someone called out to Manager Liu.
"Old Liu, the vice-chairman says that all the managers and above are to attend a meeting to go over the spirit of the earlier conference."
"I'm on my way, Su Yu, keep an eye on the front desk."
"Alright, Manager Liu."
A few minutes later, the four thieves of Juxuan Island sneaked in carrying the coffin into the trade association.
"Strange, where's Old Liu? Didn't he say he would wait here for us?" The eldest brother was puzzled as to why there was only a young girl at the front desk.
"May I ask what the four guests are here for?" Su Yu posed with a greeting gesture.
Wondering if this was an arrangement by Old Liu, the eldest brother asked with some doubt, "We're here to store a coffin, is that possible?"
As Su Yu was about to refuse, she suddenly remembered Manager Liu's instruction to be service-minded and to fulfill the guests' needs as much as possible, so she put on a smile, naturally sweet, "Of course, that's possible."
The elder brother thought to himself that it really must be an arrangement by Old Liu, otherwise the association wouldn't have agreed so readily.
Letting this young girl deal with them, he was cautious about the Long Clan tracing it back to him.
"How many days do the four of you plan to store it?"
"Let's start with three days, and then we'll see if we need to extend it," the eldest brother guessed that the Long Clan could only search for about three to four days. During that time, if they couldn't find it, they would surely suspect that the treasure had been taken elsewhere, making Sea City a lot safer.
Of course, if the Long Clan was suspicious, it was no trouble to store it for a few more days. He could afford to wait.
"Alright, that will be three hundred Spirit Stones," Su Yu said with a polite smile, collecting three hundred Spirit Stones first. If they went beyond three days, it'd be an extra hundred per day, which was the rule.
"You're charging money?" The elder brother thought: what kind of arrangement was this, charging money for such a secretive deal?
Then the elder brother understood—it was Manager Liu warning them through the mouth of the young girl; they couldn't shortchange the promised benefits when everything was settled.
The elder brother pulled out three hundred Spirit Stones and handed them to the young girl, "We won't forget you."
"And remember to handle it carefully and quietly. After all, it's something that shouldn't be seen in the light." The elder brother reminded Su Yu to be careful, feeling that the young girl's movements were too large and could easily attract the attention of others around.
"Understood."
Su Yu, seemingly delicate but surprisingly strong, carried the coffin to the warehouse, handling it gently. Recalling the words of the Juxuan Island thieves, she took out a black cloth and covered the coffin.
"Since it should not see the light, then let's cover it."
Upon leaving the trade association, the youngest brother secretly asked, "Elder brother, isn't this medicine too potent? We're only in the Divinity Transformation Stage now."
He had thought they would only drop one realm.
The eldest brother was unaware that the elixirs sold on the black market were discarded pills from the Seek Dao Sect's Elixir Cauldron Peak, which could be either weak or exceptionally potent.
"It's all part of the plan; this way, the Long Clan will definitely not suspect us."
An hour later, Manager Liu's meeting ended, but he did not return to the front desk.
Since the coffin was now stored here, today's task was complete.
"Next, we just wait for this to blow over. Hopefully, everything goes smoothly," Manager Liu muttered to himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 777 - 776 Ancestral Dragon Grass
chapters.content:
"This is the place."
Lu Yang and his three companions arrived at a small tea house, where the environment was noisy, and people from all walks of life had gathered.
"Shop Assistant, a pot of high mountain jasmine tea, please."
"Coming right up."
According to Xiao Xinghai, this tea house was a secret location for issuing missions. Ordering a pot of the non-existent high mountain jasmine tea meant you weren't just a customer, but a cultivator there for a mission.
Not all the time were members of the Long Clan waiting here for cultivators to take on missions. Sometimes one would have to wait half a day before a member of the Long Clan appeared, and at the worst of times, three days might pass without seeing any.
Lu Yang and his party were in luck. After drinking two pots of tea, they received a message from a member of the Long Clan.
"Four young friends, come to the room at the end of the west side for a chat."
The four finished their tea in one gulp, and truth be told, whatever tea the Shop Assistant had served, it tasted surprisingly good.
They arrived at the room in the west section and saw it was empty except for one Long Clan member, wrapped tightly to conceal his identity. Only two exposed dragon horns proved his heritage.
In the minds of the Long Clan, dragon horns were a source of pride that should not be concealed.
"Are you here for Dragon's Blood?"
"Yes, our friend is gravely injured and needs Dragon's Blood for healing."
The black-robed member of the Long Clan let out a cold snort, as if believing Lu Yang was just putting on a pitiful act. "We are but strangers meeting by chance; we each have our needs. There is no need to explain so much to me. What you want the Dragon's Blood for is none of my concern."
"I need you to help me find the Ancestral Dragon Grass."
"Ancestral Dragon Grass? The grass that is said to be the Dragon Clan Ancestor's favorite and is now on the brink of extinction?" Li Haoran recalled the origin of that grass from Qin Haoran's memories.
The black-robed Long Clan member looked at Li Haoran with a bit of surprise, not expecting the young generation to know about Ancestral Dragon Grass, as not many of the older generation even knew of it anymore.
"My subordinate vanished without a trace while transporting Ancestral Dragon Grass. It might have been the doing of my arch-enemy, or some accident might have occurred. However, I have a premonition that the grass is in Sea City."
"I have a unique status. Every move I make might draw the attention of potential adversaries, so it's inconvenient for me to search for the grass personally."
The black-robed Long Clan member flicked a drop of blood: "This is a drop of my Dragon Clan Essence Blood. If this drop of Dragon's Blood comes near the Ancestral Dragon Grass, it will sense it. Take this Dragon's Blood and search for the Ancestral Dragon Grass. If you find the grass, obtaining Dragon's Blood will not be a problem."
Lu Yang took out a porcelain bottle, poured the Dragon's Blood into it, and attached the bottle to his waist.
He could feel a terrifying energy emanating from the drop of Dragon's Blood, an energy not seen in the Divinity Transformation Stage, nor would the Void Refinement Stage have such stable fluctuations.
Could the other party be in the Body Integration Realm?
To Lu Yang's knowledge, members of the Body Integration Realm were considered Elders within the Long Clan.
It seemed the internal affairs of the Long Clan were not completely united; the Elders were holding each other in check.
The Dragon's Blood of a Body Integration Realm Long Clan member would be of great benefit if Xiao Xinghai could receive its nourishment.
The black-robed Long Clan member waved his hand: "This matter is of great importance. You must proceed in secret, making sure that no one, especially members of the Long Clan, detect your actions!"
"Also, take this box. It has the effect of blocking Spiritual Sense. If you find the Ancestral Dragon Grass, put it in this box. That way, no one else will discover what you've obtained."
The black-robed Long Clan member tossed a small wooden box to Lu Yang.
"That's all, go now. Report back to me on your progress in three days."
After leaving the tea house, Li Haoran pondered. He had heard that the Old Dragon Emperor revered the Dragon Clan Ancestors and had a fondness for Ancestral Dragon Grass. Could it be that this black-robed member of the Long Clan intended to offer the Ancestral Dragon Grass as a birthday gift to the Old Dragon Emperor at his birthday banquet?
As the master of the Dragon Palace, the Old Dragon Emperor, who possessed the East Sea, had countless rare treasures. The birthday tributes that would please him had to be unique, like the Ancient Dragon Grass.
This would explain why they emphasized the need to act without the Long Clan's notice; after all, who in the Long Clan wouldn't want to offer the Ancient Dragon Grass as a birthday tribute to earn the Old Dragon Emperor's favor?
Li Haoran's guess was not wrong; the black-robed members of the Long Clan were indeed thinking along these lines.
He also considered that if there was no progress in three days and he couldn't find any Ancient Dragon Grass, he would have to look for something else as a birthday tribute.
Lu Yang had never heard of Ancient Dragon Grass and when he asked Fairy Eternity, she said she hadn't heard of it either.
"It's probably just been renamed. We didn't call it that back then. As for the grass that Xiao Ling likes, when did she start liking grass... Oh, I remember now, there was a time she pretended to be a gentle lady, gardening and planting flowers, all to catch the attention of Qilin Immortal.
