It made Qilin Immortal suspicious that Xiao Ling might have been possessed by someone."
"Later, seeing that the plan didn't work, Xiao Ling gave up gardening and gave all those things to me. I saw that Xiao Ling had done a good job, the plants were strong and healthy, and I loved them so much that I made them into dishes and prepared a huge banquet called the Hundred Grass Feast. I invited the Time Immortal, the four of them, and Little Ling Lianyi."
"Then, somehow rumors spread claiming that Immortal Jiuchong had fainted on the way home after tasting the Hundred Grass Feast."
"That's nonsense. Clearly, I saw Immortal Jiuchong happily hopping and bouncing while eating at that time."
Lu Yang suspected that Immortal Jiuchong might have had hallucinations after the meal.
Lu Yang remembered the second layer of the secret realm where Elder Lianyi was in slumber, which was planted with a multitude of ancient rare flowers and plants, among which there should be Ancient Dragon Grass.
However, the Dragon Palace was too far from the Demon Territory, and it was feared that Xiao Xinghai's wounds would have already healed by the time he returned from there.
...
The inn.
This place that claimed to be an inn actually provided not rooms but Cave Heavens for cultivation.
The four thieves of Juxuan Island rented a Cave Heaven.
"We'll hide here for a few days. Unless necessary, let's not leave the Cave Heaven in the next few days," the Boss said.
The Boss remembered something, "Right, Old Four, when we stole the treasure and a member of the Long Clan caught us, after we erased him without leaving a trace, we also took the box he was holding. What was inside the box?"
"In the rush, I only glanced inside the box quickly. It was a grass, but I don't know what kind it was."
The sly-looking Old Four took out a wooden box which contained a grass that resembled a dragon's claw, lying peacefully inside.
The Boss looked it over from left to right but couldn't figure out the origin of the grass, "What is this? Does anyone recognize it?"
"No."
"Is it Dragon Paw Grass?"
"Old Three, you recognize it?"
"Uh, no. I just named it that because it looked like a dragon's paw."
"...If you don't recognize it, then keep quiet!"
"Alright."
"This thing must be of great value; the Long Clan member is dead to the last speck, but the box and this grass are still intact."
...
The Elders seeking the Long Clan's rare treasure let their subordinates take action while they gathered to analyze, "The Dragon Ball cannot be kept in a Storage Ring, so the thief who took the Dragon Ball must find another way to wrap it."
"It also must be capable of shielding from Spiritual Sense, in case we use ours to search."

chapters.title: Chapter 778 - 777: They Did It!
chapters.content:
"Things that can block Spiritual Sense are nothing more than cloth or boxes; these items are all too common in Sea City. This is the Dragon Palace Sea City, the most bustling Sea City in the entire East Sea. During transactions, it's perfectly normal to use cloth or boxes to wrap items."
Another Elder shook his head, "It doesn't matter, it has already narrowed down our search. The cloth or box holding the Dragon Ball won't be too large, and it must be of a high grade, imperceptible even to those at the Body Integration Realm."
"Such high-level cloth or boxes are rare; the ones we've sent out from the Dragon Clan to search are all at the Spirit Transformation stage or higher, and they can't see through it. There's a very high chance that these boxes are our target."
The theft of the Dragon Ball was a serious matter, and the Elders mobilized all the forces they could to search for the Dragon Ball.
"Should we lock down the suspect to the Integration Period?"
"No, the perpetrator is without a doubt at the Integration Period, but the criminal might also have subordinates. To avoid us, they may let their subordinates carry the Dragon Ball."
"Of course, we must investigate all the Integration Period Cultivators currently in Sea City, no matter the reputation—good or bad!"
An Elder angrily slammed the table, "Last time the Dragon Ball was stolen, it was done by the Old Buyu thief, and this time, which thief dares to commit the crime!"
"Enough, what's the use of saying this now? The urgent matter is to find the Dragon Ball as fast as possible, or else let's just wait for the Palace Master's fury."
...
"Where should we start looking for the Dragon Ancestor Grass?" Meng Jingzhou was troubled; they were completely clueless about Sea City.
"We'll just have to search slowly; consider it browsing through Sea City." Lu Yang was very laid-back about it.
"By the way, Junior Brother Li, have you been to the Dragon Palace's Sea City before?"
"I haven't."
"Alright then."
Lu Yang and the others roamed aimlessly through Sea City; they had three days and were in no rush.
"Huh, the Dragon Clan has temples, too?" Lu Yang passed by a temple bustling with incense, where both the Sea Clan and the Human race came to offer prayers.
"What temple is this?" Lu Yang walked curiously into the temple and discovered that there were no divine statues inside, just a spirit tablet with the words "Ying Dragon Revered One" written on it.
Li Haoran said, "Senior Brother Lu, don't you know? This is the temple of the Ying Dragon Revered One. It's very famous among the Sea Clan."
"Legend has it that the Ying Dragon Revered One was an extremely powerful being from the ancient Dragon Clan, controlling the celestial phenomena. The weather and thunderstorms would change according to his moods. There are also rumors that the Ying Dragon Revered One was a True Dragon, even more powerful than the Dragon Clan Ancestor."
Lu Yang thought to himself that he had indeed heard of a Ying Dragon, named Yingtian Immortal, who had cultivated the Dragon Transformation Manual and had transformed into a True Dragon, thus earning the title of Ying Dragon. This was a side story told by Fairy Eternity when she explained the Dragon Transformation Manual.
If nothing was unexpected, Yingtian Immortal and the Ying Dragon Revered One should be the same person.
Considering he knew all about Yingtian Immortal's shameful past, and thinking about how he himself would have to Pass the Thunder Tribulation once he reached the Spirit Transformation stage, out of a sense of guilt, Lu Yang felt he should at least light an incense for Yingtian Immortal.
Lu Yang lit a stick of incense and imitated the crowd, bowing respectfully.
"To every debt there's a creditor, and to every crime there's a culprit. If Your Excellency is seeking revenge, please look for Fairy Eternity."
"And by the way, please help find Ao Ling and the Dragon Ancestor Grass."
Meng Jingzhou and the other two saw Lu Yang offering incense and thought he was just immersing himself in the culture of the East Sea. They each lit a stick of incense and also bowed to the Ying Dragon Revered One.
Regrettably, the Ying Dragon Revered One did not manifest. After one day, having visited numerous places, they still hadn't found the Dragon Ancestor Grass.
"Strange, why do I feel like someone is tracking us?" Lu Yang frowned. He always felt as if someone's Spiritual Sense was repeatedly sweeping over the wooden box he carried, but when he tried to sense it carefully, there was nothing.
It was either his own delusion, or the level of the opponent's concealment was terrifyingly high.
"Could the Dragon Clan have noticed our actions? That shouldn't be possible." Lu Yang murmured to himself, vexed, as they hadn't even found the Dragon Ancestor Grass yet, and were already being watched.
In hiding, two members of the Dragon Clan were taken aback.
"Has he discovered us?"
"That's impossible, right? He's only at the Mid-stage Nascent Soul, and we, being at the peak of the Divinity Transformation Stage and having specifically cultivated our Spiritual Sense, how could he possibly discover us?"
"Do you think these four are related to the loss of the precious treasure?" After two days of searching, the Dragon Clan in the shadows had already identified several suspects. Among them, Lu Yang and his party were suspected due to the wooden box they carried, and their suspicious behavior put them on the list.
"Hey, did you hear what he just said? He mentioned 'Could the Dragon Clan have noticed our actions,' it must be them!"
"Don't get excited, it might just be a coincidence, let's keep observing," the more level-headed Dragon Clan member restrained his companion.
...
The next day.
"Big brother, it's not good, the Dragon Clan has started searching the Cave Heavens!" Old Three rushed into the Cave Heaven in a hurry.
They assigned someone to scout the situation each day and to check on the Dragon Clan's search progress. Today, it was Old Three's turn.
"Don't panic, tell me carefully."
"The Dragon Clan has begun searching each Cave Heaven one by one, regardless of Cultivation Level or race; they didn't let a single one go!"
Big brother frowned, "Have they searched even those in seclusion?"
He had planned to avoid the search by staying in seclusion.
"It's no use; they've broken into all the Cave Heavens that have gone into seclusion in the last three days, except for those who have been secluded for more than three days, then the Dragon Clan wouldn't enter."
There are records of entry and exit for each Cave Heaven. Those secluded for more than three days hadn't left the Cave Heaven and couldn't have stolen the Dragon Ball.
"Trouble."
"Big brother, what trouble? The Dragon Ball isn't in our possession, they can't trace it back to us."
Big brother shook his head, "We have no proof of identity, which usually is not a big deal, but during such a critical time, the Long Clan will definitely consider us suspects."
"Considered suspects, how can we transport the coffin then?"
"What should we do?"
Big brother gritted his teeth, "Leave Cave Heaven. If need be, we can hang around the outside world for a few days, the Long Clan wouldn't possibly check identities on the street."
"Alright."
...
The third day.
"Hard to find," Man Gu sighed. It had been three days.
Suddenly, Lu Yang felt a disturbance in the Dragon's Blood at his waist. He stared at the four people from Juxuan Island who passed by and sneered, "Found them!"
These four were evidently not subordinates of the black-robed members of the Long Clan, which meant they must've killed for plunder, seizing the Dragon Ancestor Grass, but were too afraid of the black-robed Long Clan members to sell it.
"Follow them!"
Lu Yang secretly transmitted his voice, and Meng Jingzhou's trio's expressions shook with excitement—they had finally found them.
"Big brother, someone is following us," the second brother transmitted, their expertise being tracking and sneaking as the four thieves of Juxuan Island.
"I've sensed it too, but don't worry, they're only at the Nascent Soul Stage," big brother said calmly, "They're from the Human race, so it has nothing to do with the Dragon Ball. Let's lure them to a deserted place and see what they want."
The four thieves of Juxuan Island weren't afraid of Lu Yang and his group; it was clear that the big brother had noticed them and was intentionally leading them to a secluded area. Lu Yang and his group were not afraid either.
The eight people met in a quiet spot on the edge of Sea City.
"I should not know you four, so what business might you have?" Big brother coldly regarded Lu Yang and his group.
The closer he got, the more Lu Yang could feel the restlessness of the Dragon's Blood—it seemed that the Dragon Ancestor Grass was on them.
"You've taken something you shouldn't have. Aren't you afraid of offending the Elder of the Long Clan?"
Once Lu Yang said this, big brother relaxed by half; the other had said "the Elder of the Long Clan," not "the Long Clan," indicating that this indeed had nothing to do with the Dragon Ball.
"What thing, I'm not aware of it," big brother shook his head. The only thing he carried that could relate to an Elder of the Long Clan was the unidentified grass.
But why should they hand over anything to four Nascent Soul cultivators? Why not just get rid of them and have nothing more to worry about?
"Not aware? Killing members of the Long Clan for wealth and causing harm, and you tell me you're not aware? Do you take me for a fool?"
"Should I call over the Elder of the Long Clan who's behind me?"
Big brother's eyes tightened. If the Elder of the Long Clan got involved, it might expose the affair of the Dragon Ball.
You cannot be spared!
The four thieves of Juxuan Island made their move simultaneously, aiming to instantly take care of Lu Yang and his group.
Lu Yang drew his sword, and Sword Qi burst forth, creating a deep ravine in the ground, his expression deadly serious: "Do you truly wish to make a move?"
"That is something the Old Dragon Emperor is fond of. I advise you to hand it over, and we can all live in peace," he added.
For a moment, both sides were at a standoff.
Lu Yang heard that the Elder of the black-robed Long Clan didn't want to make a fuss. If they fought with the four opposite them, the commotion might become widely known.
Big brother was deeply alarmed, the earlier Sword Qi was extremely dangerous; the person in front was difficult to deal with, a tough nut to crack. They wouldn't be able to determine the winner in a short time, and there was no need to fight over an unknown grass here.
They should have never taken that grass in the first place.
Although humiliating, he knew priorities; he took out a wooden box and tossed it to Lu Yang, "Is this it?"
Fairy Eternity was curious about what this Dragon Ancestor Grass was. She scanned it with her Spiritual Sense and suddenly understood.
"I thought the Dragon Ancestor Grass was something special. Xiao Ling had just started gardening but wasn't skilled. She grew a bunch of weeds, subjecting Lianyi to frequent teasing. Xiao Ling stubbornly claimed she enjoyed growing weeds."
"That Dragon Ancestor Grass is just an ordinary weed from Xiao Ling's backyard!"
Lu Yang: "..."
I've heard nothing, Elder Ao Ling please don't seek me out.
With Fairy Eternity having spoken, Lu Yang was sure that the wooden box truly contained the Dragon Ancestor Grass. He directly put the small wooden box into another provided by the Elder of the black-robed Long Clan.
Double-layered wooden boxes ensured that no one from the outside could see what was inside—absolutely safe.
Secretly, two members of the Long Clan transmitted messages, somewhat excited.
"Did you hear that? One side wants to deceive the other, and their people have found them."
"Obtained from killing a member of the Long Clan, and it's something the Old Dragon Emperor likes, it must be the Dragon Ball—they did it!"
"To think there's an Elder involved!"

chapters.title: Chapter 779 - 778 Juxuan Island Four Thieves: Why Is There a Person in the Coffin?
chapters.content:
```
The two Dragon Clan members conducting the covert surveillance felt their scalps tingle with numbness, having initially suspected an outsider was the culprit, they hadn't expected an inside job involving an Elder.
The one bold enough to commit such an outrageous act was an Elder whose strength should not be underestimated.
"What do we do now, do we catch them all?"
The composed Dragon Clan member looked at his companion with surprise, "Are you out of your mind? There are eight of them, four at the Spirit Transformation Stage, and four at the Nascent Soul Stage, and those four at the Nascent Soul Stage seem as if they could match the ones at the Spirit Transformation Stage in battle. Just the two of us, catch them?"
"Then what do we do?"
"Here's the plan, you go and notify the Elders, and I'll stay here to keep watch. Those four at the Nascent Soul Stage who got the Dragon Ball will definitely hand it over to the Elder involved in the crime. We'll catch them red-handed, and we'll both be greatly credited!"
"You're the clever one!" Realizing the urgency, his companion promptly set off to alert the Elders.
Lu Yang and the four from Juxuan Island completed their trade and successfully obtained the Ancestral Dragon Grass.
The leader of the Juxuan Island thieves sent a secret message, "There's been a change of plans, move out quickly!"
The three underlings were puzzled, "Has our theft of the Dragon Ball been exposed?"
The leader looked at his three underlings with an air of frustration, as if to say, if it weren't for me, Juxuan Island would be nothing; you three would have been caught long ago.
"Didn't you hear what those four at the Nascent Soul Stage said? The grass belonged to an Elder of the Dragon Clan. We stole his grass, do you think he would leave us a way out?"
"Once the four at the Nascent Soul Stage report back to the Dragon Clan Elder, we're all done for!"
If they were still at the Body Integration Realm, there might have been room for maneuvering, but against an Elder of the Dragon Clan, even four at the Spirit Transformation Stage wouldn't last a single claw swipe!
"So what do we do?"
With gritted teeth, the leader made his decision, "No time to worry about that, let's quickly get to the guild and move the Dragon Ball."
Meanwhile, Lu Yang and his group decided to find the black-robed Dragon Clan Elder.
Seeing the two groups split into different directions, the composed Dragon Clan member observing from the shadows followed Lu Yang's group without hesitation.
As for the four thieves from Juxuan Island, once the Elder arrived, even if they managed to escape Sea City, the Dragon Clan could capture them again!
Such was the confidence of the East Sea's Dragon Clan!
The Juxuan Island thieves hurried back to their guild, where it was already the third day, and Manager Liu had long been waiting at the front reception.
The leader urgently sent a message, "Old Liu, quickly bring out the coffin!"
"What happened, has it been exposed?" Manager Liu could tell from the leader's tone that something was amiss.
You look different today?
You four did not look like this three days ago when you stored the coffin, very cautious of you.
"Not yet, just retrieve it, and if the Dragon Clan questions you, just play it cool, they won't suspect you!" The leader didn't forget to reassure Manager Liu, otherwise if Manager Liu thought they were unreliable and decided to report them to claim merits, that would be troublesome.
"OK."
Manager Liu entered the storeroom, passed the coffin covered with Su Yu's black cloth, and retrieved the coffin that he had personally stored three days ago.
"Here, be careful with it." Manager Liu carried out the coffin.
"We shall meet again." The Juxuan Island thieves took the coffin and hurriedly left.
While transporting the coffin, they did not forget to put on a mournful façade, pretending as if they had lost a dear brother.
To be a great thief, one needed not only high cultivation but also a sharp mind and good acting skills. Passersby believed that the coffin indeed contained a dead person.
The four thieves, crying their eyes out, tricked the guards and left Sea City with the coffin.
Having left Sea City and traveled about two miles, the four took out Godspeed Talismans, affixed them to their legs, and sped up their pace to distance themselves from this place of trouble as fast as possible.
```
They raced along, changing their course numerous times, sometimes flying through the sky, sometimes swimming through water, until they finally arrived at the predetermined island.
"Phew, we're safe now."
Their hearts had been pounding with fear on the journey there, worried that the Long Clan would discover their actions and thwart their efforts at the last moment.
"We did it, quickly take out the Dragon Ball!" The second brother exclaimed with excitement, hardly believing they had been successful. Though there had been unexpected incidents along the way, their eldest brother's wise decisions had turned danger into safety.
The eldest brother was also thrilled. He pushed open the coffin and exchanged a glance with Xiao Xinghai who lay inside, then froze.
In silence, he closed the coffin lid, and when he opened it again, Xiao Xinghai was still lying inside.
Xiao Xinghai yawned, "Have I been out for three days already? Did you get the Dragon's Blood?"
"Did you change your appearances again to avoid recognition?"
Xiao Xinghai had heard that the Long Clan didn't have good relations with both the Dao Seeking Sect Master and the Grand Elder, so it made sense to be cautious.
The four thieves of Juxuan Island looked at Xiao Xinghai with uncertainty. As cultivators who had lived for more than a thousand years, they were in tune with the movements of those in the Body Integration Realm, and were not familiar with Xiao Xinghai, a young Kun Peng who had only been practicing for three years.
"Elder brother, what's happening? Has the Dragon Ball become sentient?" the youngest brother asked telepathically.
The eldest brother nodded secretly, sharing the same thought, "It's very possible. I've heard that some exquisitely crafted Immortal Artifacts and Semi-Immortal Artifacts can develop spiritual intelligence and transform into human form."
"And did you hear him? He said 'have I been out for three days,' referring to us stealing him from the Dragon Palace three days ago. It seems like he's quite happy to be out of the Dragon Palace."
"While he's at the Nascent Soul Stage, he could tell at a glance our appearances were disguised, which isn't something a Nascent Soul Stage could normally do!"
"What did he mean by Dragon's Blood then?"
"Unclear, could it be that the Dragon Ball needs to absorb Dragon's Blood to exhibit its true effects?" the second brother speculated.
Being at the Integration Stage, they did have some Dragon's Blood on hand, though it wasn't very fresh.
"Is this what you need?" The eldest brother took out a small jar of Dragon's Blood from his Storage Ring, his tone involuntarily respectful.
"This isn't very fresh." Xiao Xinghai felt that the Long Clan really wasn't righteous, bullying Lu Yang and his friends from afar, and for a completed mission, they provided old blood.
"Please make do with it," the eldest brother said with an apologetic smile.
"Pour it in here," Xiao Xinghai said, lying flat in the coffin, currently in a severely injured state.
Xiao Xinghai sighed, "If not for the constraints of the rules, I wouldn't have to rely on absorbing Dragon's Blood to recover."
The hearts of the four thieves jolted; indeed, the Dragon Ball had come alive and, after transforming into a human, its strength had diminished significantly, necessitating the absorption of Dragon's Blood to recover.
As for the rules he mentioned, they must be the result of conflicts between those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage or even Semi-Immortal great powers.
The eldest brother reverently poured the Dragon's Blood into the coffin, while Xiao Xinghai didn't mind if his clothes got stained with blood; he lay there comfortably, absorbing the Dragon's Blood, practicing the Dragon Transformation Manual.
As they heard the dragon's roar coming from Xiao Xinghai's body, the four thieves dared not slack off.
The eldest brother stood nearby, offering an apologetic smile, carefully choosing his words for fear of offending what they believed was the essence of the Dragon Ball.
"Brother Zhu, do you have any plans for what to do next?"
Xiao Xinghai was startled, "Brother Zhu? Who's that, a nickname you've given me?"
"Isn't your true form the Dragon Ball? If you don't like that title, we can change it," they replied.
Xiao Xinghai was even more puzzled, "Have you lost your memories? I am Xiao Xinghai."
Xiao Xinghai and the four thieves of Juxuan Island looked at each other, their gazes filled with bafflement.
Then, the realization struck the four thieves, and they erupted in fury so loudly that their roars could be heard throughout the entire island.
"Where is the Dragon Ball?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 780 - 779: Catching the Culprit Red-Handed
chapters.content:
The Four Thieves of Juxuan Island stared at Xiao Xinghai with murderous intent.
"Who the hell are you! Where's the Dragon Ball!"
Xiao Xinghai was completely baffled. What Dragon Ball? Who are you four, and where am I?
The frustration of The Four Thieves of Juxuan Island grew, they had spent a hundred years preparing to steal the Dragon Ball, only to have it switched out after the heist!
It must have been that Liu who did it!
"Still playing dumb, die!"
Although their realms had fallen, they were still at the Divinity Transformation Stage, not to mention Xiao Xinghai was seriously injured and struggling to even stand.
Despite not understanding what was happening, Xiao Xinghai, with an innocent face, allowed them to attack him.
Just as their attack was about to hit Xiao Xinghai, a strand of his hair suddenly burst forth with a dark light.
Being a genius of the Kunpeng Clan with unmatched cultivation talent, it was unthinkable for him not to have something to save his life.
This strand of hair was one of Black Feather Venerable's feathers, which would reveal itself when Xiao Xinghai faced danger.
"Ah——"
The four from Juxuan Island were swept by the dark light and ceased to breathe.
...
The Long Clan received a clue and split their forces to pursue both Lu Yang's group and The Four Thieves of Juxuan Island.
"Those four at the Divinity Transformation Stage left with a coffin?" The Dragon Clan Elder sneered coldly, did they really think they could escape like that?
"Chase them!"
The Dragon Clan Elder, leading a large group of followers, flew out of Sea City grandly, inquiring with the fish near Sea City about the direction of the four.
It was his talent. He was born with the ability to communicate with these ordinary fish without spiritual intelligence.
From the information provided by the fish, they transformed into their original shapes; dozens of True Dragons flew impressively over the ocean surface, their presence formidable.
"It's this island!"
By the time they arrived, they saw Xiao Xinghai lying in a coffin, covered in blood, panting and extremely weak, unable to stand, while the four Divinity Transformation Stage thieves lay on the ground, their blood spilled everywhere.
The assembly of dragons was shocked by the scene. This person had fought in a bath of blood and slain the four thieves; he was a hero of the Long Clan!
The dragons descended; some confirmed the identities of the four Divinity Transformation Stages, while many gathered around Xiao Xinghai, praising his heroic deed.
Xiao Xinghai was totally bewildered.
I was just lying in a coffin, opened it and someone wanted to kill me, the feather from the elder counterattacked, and now I'm a hero of the Long Clan?
Where did Lu Yang and his three companions go?
...
Lu Yang's group, with the Ancestral Dragon Grass, prepared to find the black-robed member of the Long Clan, but halfway there, Lu Yang halted the others.
"Hold on a second."
"What's up?"
"If we hand over the item to the Dragon Clan Elder and he goes back on his word, takes advantage while we go back for the coffin and flees, what then?"
"We don't recognize him with his face covered."
"Makes sense, so we just take the coffin and find him directly?"
"Right."
Lu Yang's group turned around and headed to the Commerce Association.
In the Commerce Association, Manager Liu finished his business and no longer stayed at the front desk, assigning another subordinate to stand guard there.
"Hello, we've come to collect a coffin we stored three days ago, and deposited three hundred Spirit Stones at the time." Meng Jingzhou took out a voucher, which Manager Liu had issued.
The front desk clerk checked the voucher against the records, confirmed it was correct, and after quite some time, found the coffin covered with the black cloth.
After receiving the coffin covered with the black cloth, Lu Yang and the others thought to themselves how considerate the Commerce Association was.
```
He lifted the black cloth, confirmed that the coffin was indeed the model they had previously chosen, and then rushed off excitedly to find the black-robed member of the Long Clan.
Lu Yang and his three companions carried the coffin, ignoring the odd looks from those around them, and ran into the room at the far western end of the tea house.
The black-robed Long Clan member had been waiting in the room all along.
Lu Yang, holding the wooden box with the Ancestral Dragon Herb in one hand and the coffin on his shoulder,
The black-robed Long Clan member's body shook, not expecting that Lu Yang's claim of a friend being gravely injured and in need of Dragon's Blood three days ago was true.
Three days had passed, and they had helped him find the Ancestral Dragon Herb, but his friend was already dead.
Common folk always fantasized that bathing in Dragon's Blood could bring the dead back to life and grant immortality, but in reality, Dragon's Blood was nowhere near that miraculous.
"Elder, we have completed the task."
The black-robed Long Clan member didn't expect Lu Yang and his companions to be so efficient with their task: "You weren't discovered, were you?"
"No."
Lu Yang handed over the wooden box.
The black-robed Long Clan member opened the box and saw the Ancestral Dragon Herb that resembled a dragon claw lying inside; he breathed a sigh of relief, relieved that it had been found at last.
Lu Yang rubbed his hands together and sheepishly smiled, "Elder, since we have completed the task, how about the Dragon's Blood..."
The Blood of a Body Integration Realm Dragon would undoubtedly greatly aid in Haoran's recovery; it might even take his Dragon Transformation Manual to a higher level.
"Of course, I will give it to you. I always keep my word."
Just then, a huge dragon claw lifted the roof of the teahouse, scaring everyone inside into running away in all directions.
"Ao Ran, I didn't expect you to be the one who stole the Dragon Ball, and you even called four humans to assist you!"
Three giant dragons circled above Sea City, staring down at the black-robed member of the Long Clan; their whiskers fluttering in the water current, their dragon eyes commanding, all displaying the imposing authority of the overlord of the East Sea.
"Aoye, you falsely accuse me!" roared the black-robed Long Clan member Ao Ran, "What Dragon Ball? I've never even seen it before, and these four? I don't know them at all!"
He had indeed heard that the Dragon Ball was lost; it was obviously your responsibility to guard the Dragon Ball. How could its disappearance have anything to do with me?
Lu Yang and his companions felt the name Ao Ran sounded familiar.
Man Gu, the least cluttered in thought, was the first to remember. Before they had set out for the East Sea, Uncle Ba mentioned he had a friend there named Ao Ran, who always liked to play with sealing his cultivation level, planning for a breakthrough right at the critical moment.
"Elder Ao Ran, we four are from the Seek Dao Sect, I am Man Gu, and these three are Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, and Li Haoran!"
"You are from the Seek Dao Sect?" Ao Ran recollected the letter Uncle Ba sent him not long ago, mentioning that five outstanding juniors from the Seek Dao Sect were heading to the East Sea, and these young ones were always stirring up trouble. If he were to encounter them, he should look out for them.
"And you say you don't know them!"
When the three from Aoye heard the name Lu Yang, it seemed to trigger a memory: "Old Buyu's disciple, Lu Yang!"
They could not believe that both master and disciple had taken turns trying to steal the Dragon Ball, truly not taking their Dragon Palace seriously at all!
"You three stop making senseless accusations!" Ao Ran protected Lu Yang and the others, suspecting that the trio was seizing the opportunity to make trouble.
"Making senseless accusations? Then what is that in the wooden box?"
Ao Ran, standing on the side of justice, was not afraid of slanted shadows. He opened the wooden box, showing the dragon claw-shaped herb: "Ancestral Dragon Herb, a congratulatory gift for the Palace Master's grand birthday. Is there a problem with that?"
The three from Aoye hesitated; this wasn't right. Wasn't the Dragon Ball supposed to be in a wooden box?
Suddenly, their gaze fixated on the most conspicuous coffin in the room.
"What's inside that coffin?"
Angrily, Ao Ran opened the coffin: "Of course there's a person inside the coffin!"
Everyone then saw a sparkling and translucent orb, the size of a palm, resting securely inside the coffin.
It was indeed the Dragon Ball.
The room fell deathly silent, as still as the grave.
Ao Ran: "..."
"Caught red-handed, what excuse do you have left?"
"You were about to slit your wrist and let your blood, were you trying to make the Ball recognize a new master?"
```

chapters.title: Chapter 781 - 780: Old Ba, I Really Can't Cover This Matter
chapters.content:
Lu Yang couldn't figure it out, no matter how much he turned it over in his mind—how on earth did Xiao Xinghai disappear and become some kind of Dragon Ball?
Did Xiao Xinghai rise from his coffin and replace himself with the Dragon Ball?
Meng Jingzhou and Li Haoran were equally baffled.
Only Man Gu had a sudden realization, his face filled with sorrow, "My dear friend Xinghai has succumbed to his grave injuries and has become Sarira!"
Lu Yang: "..."
Man Gu, would you mind not speaking? You're about to interrupt the little thread of thought I have.
"What exactly is a Dragon Ball?" Lu Yang whispered to Li Haoran.
"I've never seen the real thing myself, just heard it from others. A Dragon Ball is the Long Clan's most treasured relic, an ancient oddity of mysterious origins and indeterminate rank. It's incredibly hard, indestructible, can neutralize all poisons, heal injuries, aid cultivation, and even bring good fortune. Its wonders are endless," Li Haoran explained.
Then, Lu Yang remembered. His Master once stole the Long Clan's most treasured relic to save someone. It seems that what the Master stole was this very Dragon Ball.
Who would've thought it would be his turn, as the disciple, to steal the Dragon Ball... Pah, almost got dragged into a pit by the Long Clan. I have no clue what's going on.
Aoye was still arguing with Ao Ran, the more he looked at the coffin, the more it seemed familiar.
"This is that bastard Qin Jiunian's coffin!" Aoye finally remembered where the coffin came from.
Grand Elder of the Dao Seeking Sect, Qin Jiunian.
The coffin belonged to the Dao Seeking Sect, and so did the people who moved the Dragon Ball. This matter definitely can't be unconnected to the Dao Seeking Sect!
Ao Ran held his forehead, feeling that today's issue was becoming more and more unexplainable.
Just then, a deep and authoritative voice rang out from the sky, "Enough, Aoye. This matter should have nothing to do with the people of the Dao Seeking Sect."
Aoye looked up to see a True Dragon, larger even than himself, enter the sea. It had a sinuous body full of power and its claws held another coffin.
Aoye frowned, "Ao Li, weren't you pursuing another group of people?"
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou recognized Ao Li, who represented the Long Clan at the Demon Nation's founding ceremony, attesting to Ao Li's high status in the Dragon Palace.
Moreover, Ao Li had old ties with the Grand Elder.
Back then, during Ao Li's tribulation of the Inner Demon, specifically the seduction test, he was deep in the quagmire and couldn't break free. The Grand Elder exerted a little effort, destroyed Ao Li's body in a way that left him inhuman, and successfully helped him overcome the seduction. It was a life-saving grace.
Ao Li landed and opened the coffin in his claw, which was filled with Dragon's Blood, and Xiao Xinghai was inside it, absorbing the Dragon's Blood.
This blood was Ao Li's own, the highest quality among those of the Body Integration Realm in the Dragon Clan.
Xiao Xinghai greeted from within the coffin, "Lu Yang, what's our situation now?"
The inexplicable warmth from the Dragon Clan was too much for him to handle.
Lu Yang, too, wanted to know what the situation was now.
"Nephew Xinghai, explain in detail what happened after you left the Kunpeng Clan," said Ao Ran.
Xiao Xinghai was perplexed but complied, consciously skipping the part where his father beat him—after all, family scandals should not be publicized, and he didn't want to shame his father in the eyes of others.
He only mentioned lying in the coffin being carried by Lu Yang and the others to the Dragon Palace's Sea City.
Ao Ran had a flash of insight, finally clearing up the confusion, "So, are you saying that the disciples of the Dao Seeking Sect and those four cultivators at the Spirit Transformation Stage took the wrong coffin?"
The Grand Elder's coffins were hidden all over the East Sea, so it wasn't surprising they were mistaken.
Ao Li shook his head to correct him, "Not four cultivators at the Spirit Transformation Stage. After their death and the removal of their disguises, it's been confirmed that they were the notoriously infamous thieves from Juxuan Island."
"Four from the Divinity Transformation Stage? This Ancestral Dragon Herb was taken from four at the Divinity Transformation Stage!" Meng Jingzhou remarked.
Ao Ran nodded, relieved, "It must have been the Juxuan Island thieves who stole the Dragon Ball and also killed my subordinates, snatching away the Ancestral Dragon Herb. All of it was unconnected to the disciples of the Dao Seeking Sect."
Ao Li agreed, "That's what I was thinking too. It must be a misunderstanding."
```"However, it's an indisputable fact that Xiao Xinghai, my dear nephew, helped our clan to slay the four thieves of Juxuan Island. He is still a hero to our clan!"
Lu Yang and his three companions also breathed a sigh of relief. As long as the situation was clarified, things would be easier to handle. After all, the four of them were innocent cultivators of the Righteous Path and couldn't just turn into thieves after making a round in the Dragon Palace.
That would tarnish the reputation of the Seek Dao Sect.
Of course, even without Xiao Xinghai as a witness, Lu Yang would have been able to clarify the situation and clear the suspicion.
Because Fairy Eternity had been laughing ever since.
She must have witnessed the whole incident but said nothing!
In the Spiritual Space, the mermaid, Fairy Eternity, was laughing so hard that she no longer had the energy to swim in the sea; she was rolling back and forth on the waterbed, her laughter echoing through the Spiritual Space, completely ignoring Lu Yang's dark expression.
Lu Yang only wished he were an immortal, so that he could teach the meddlesome Fairy Eternity a lesson!
"By the way, Fairy, have you seen this Dragon Ball before?" Lu Yang had just heard from Li Haoran that the Dragon Ball was an ancient artifact, and Fairy Eternity, also being from ancient times, might recognize it.
"What Dragon Ball? Isn't this the very pearl that the Qilin Immortal and Yingtian Immortal always squat on the ground, bouncing around? This thing should come in a set, right?"
"Ah?"
Fairy Eternity was confused by the puzzled look in Lu Yang's eyes: "Haven't you heard the story? Isn't it common to see images of 'Qilin Playing with Pearls', 'True Dragon Playing with Pearls' and such in the markets, claiming they are auspicious signs?"
"It's not wrong to say they're auspicious. Whenever I invite them for a meal, they always play a round before eating, and they keep it on the table during the meal."
"Right, this thing also has a function as an antidote, though I don't know what it's used for."
Lu Yang understood; the object was probably a magic artifact that could neutralize poison. Every time they had a meal, the Qilin Immortal and the Yingtian Immortal would bring out the Dragon Ball under the guise of playing with marbles.
Although from Fairy Eternity's description, the Dragon Ball didn't seem to have much of an effect as an antidote.
"But this pearl is so big, isn't it hard for the Qilin Immortal to play with?" Lu Yang gestured with his hand. The Dragon Ball was the size of a palm—how could one play with that?
"Oh, that's not its original form. There's a protective shell on the outside. Let me show you what the pearl actually looks like."
Lu Yang was about to protest when he heard a string of arcane ancient words emanating, and the Dragon Ball resting quietly inside the coffin began to crack open with numerous fine lines.
Crack, crack...
Under the watchful eyes of the crowd, the Dragon Ball split open to reveal its original form—a pearl the size of an elixir pill, its surface dull and gray.
"Look, this is what it looks like. This pearl was made from an entire celestial body; it's incredibly sturdy."
The members of the Long Clan were shocked. Wasn't the Dragon Ball indestructible? How had it suddenly cracked?!
Lu Yang guiltily lowered his head.
Suddenly, the Identity Jade at Lu Yang's waist grew hot, resonating with the dull, gray pearl.
The gray pearl floated out of the coffin, and before Lu Yang could react, he felt a tremendous suction force pulling him firmly against the pearl.
Lu Yang then realized that it was the dragon-patterned bracelet inside the Identity Jade resonating with the pearl in an unknown harmony!
"Oh no..."
To the astonishment of the onlookers, with a whoosh, the pearl took off towards the heavens with Lu Yang, vanishing without a trace.
The speed was so fast that no one present could keep up; they were left in the dust.
Aoye blinked his enormous dragon eyes twice: "Did Lu Yang steal the Dragon Ball... or did the Dragon Ball steal Lu Yang?"
Ao Li was also unsure how to handle the situation and hesitantly said, "Should we contact the people from the Seek Dao Sect?"
Ao Ran gazed up at the sky, in the direction where Lu Yang and the pearl had disappeared, and sighed deeply in his heart.
Old Ba, I truly can't cover for this.```

chapters.title: Chapter 782 - 781 Ao Ling
chapters.content:
"Oh no, Brother Lu is gone!" Man Gu panicked upon seeing Lu Yang and the Dragon Ball together on the flying boat.
Meng Jingzhou rolled his eyes, not worried about Lu Yang's safety in the slightest.
With the Eldest Senior Sister he could summon and an Immortal protecting his body, it would be a real shock if Lu Yang were to run into trouble.
The Long Clan did not know the full story; with Lu Yang and the Dragon Ball both vanishing, this was not an issue they could resolve.
"Report to the Palace Master immediately, let the Palace Master decide!"
…
At the Seek Dao Sect, on Sky Gate Mountain, in the meeting hall.
Yun Zhi was holding a routine meeting to discuss recent matters that needed attention, with eight Elders in attendance and the Vast Sea Daoist Lord auditing.
Midway through the meeting, Gan Tian barged into the hall and delivered a letter just sent over from the East Sea into Yun Zhi's hands.
Yun Zhi opened the envelope, scanned it with her Spiritual Sense, and her expression revealed a hint of strangeness.
"Martial Nephew Yun, has something urgent happened?" the Grand Elder asked. It must be urgent for Gan Tian to interrupt the meeting.
Yun Zhi did not explain but used her magic skill to project the contents of the envelope into the center of the hall for all to see.
The eight Elders also showed strange expressions on their faces.
"Lu Yang stole the Dragon Ball and wants our Seek Dao Sect to send someone to the Dragon Palace to discuss how to handle this affair?"
"What kind of comprehension do you have? From the description in the letter, it's clear that the Dragon Ball has stolen away Martial Nephew Lu Yang!"
In fact, even the Dragon Palace did not know how to describe the incident and had to keep it vague.
Considering that Lu Yang has Yun Zhi's support, it could not be ruled out that he had some special means to snatch the Dragon Ball away from a group of dragons at the Body Integration Realm.
The crowd was not unfamiliar with Lu Yang; although he often used the truth to deceive others, recklessly exercised the Acting Sect Master's authority to challenge above his level, measured salt for cooking by the second, fooled the demonic sect by forming the Ancient Heavenly Court, and frequently practiced strange magic skills... Lu Yang had never been known for sly theft or robbery.
So it must have been the Dragon Ball that took Lu Yang.
"What kind of background does this Dragon Ball have that it even abducts people?"
"What should we do, who will go?" The eight Elders looked at each other, except for Uncle Ba, they all had a poor reputation in the East Sea; it wouldn't do for them to go to the East Sea to find Lu Yang and end up trapping themselves.
"Lu Yang is the hope of the Seek Dao Sect, we can't ignore this, I will go!" The Grand Elder stood up to take the lead, and the other seven Elders responded, all quite agitated.
A crisp, youthful voice chimed in, "Alright, stop fighting over it, I'll go."
The eight Elders looked over, it was the Vast Sea Daoist Lord who had been listening silently all this while.
"I once said that if Lu Yang were in trouble, I would save him once. As a Daoist Lord, I cannot break my word; it's time to fulfill my promise."
Seeing the Ancient Ancestor willing to handle this matter, the eight Elders were reassured.
With the Ancient Ancestor taking action, Lu Yang would surely be safe.
Yun Zhi, seeing the Vast Sea Daoist Lord's full confidence, found it inappropriate to interject and so let the Vast Sea Daoist Lord take charge.
"Then, we will trouble the Ancient Ancestor."
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord laughed heartily, "A mere trifle!"
…
"Where is this?" Lu Yang looked around in bewilderment, seeing mountains and rivers, lush green grass as far as the eye could see, like a paradise on earth. Just moments before, he had been clinging tightly to the Dragon Ball, wind streaming into his mouth, how did he suddenly end up here?
Fairy Eternity emerged from Lu Yang's body, clicking her tongue in amazement, "This place is inside the pearl's inner space."
"I do not remember this pearl having this structure, was it refined after my death?"
"Designed quite cautiously, if it were not for the dragon motif bracelet opening this space, I would not have noticed that there is a Cave Heaven here."
The pearl was originally refined from an entire star, and adding an internal space on this basis was effortless.
"The dragon motif bracelet is the key to enter the pearl's space, strange, it never had this function before."
"Moreover, if the space is not opened via the dragon motif bracelet, the pearl's space will be transmitted to a random location."
Lu Yang, stroking his chin in thought, the dragon motif bracelet, Dragon Ball, peeling off the Dragon Ball's shell—to reach this space, these three conditions needed to be met.
Especially if the space is not opened with the dragon motif bracelet, it will be transmitted to a random location, unreachable by anyone, almost as if it were guarding against someone.
"Look over there!" Fairy Eternity, excited, pointed in a direction, and Lu Yang followed where she pointed, discovering a boundless and vast lake, with mist rising from the water, like an Immortal Realm, and faintly in the center of the lake, there was a small pavilion.
"It's Xiao Ling!" Without further explanation, Fairy Eternity hurriedly pulled Lu Yang's hand and rushed in that direction.
Lu Yang felt as though he had teleported, arriving at the small pavilion in less time than it takes to blink.
Lu Yang saw the inside of the small pavilion clearly and unconsciously held his breath.
In the center of the small pavilion lay a stunningly beautiful woman in black, her collar and sleeves edged with exquisite cloud-patterned brocade, like an ink lotus blooming in the night, both solemn and mysterious. Her black hair cascaded like a waterfall along the edge of the bed, shining faintly, highlighting her skin white as snow, delicate and smooth.
The pair of warm, jade-like dragon horns above the woman's head revealed her race.
Was this fairy the other wife of Qilin Immortal, Dragon Clan Ancestor Ao Ling?
Suddenly, Lu Yang noticed something was off and was stunned.
Even though there was a significant difference in cultivation level between him and Ao Ling, he could still sense that Ao Ling's soul was shattered, riddled with holes, to the point of no return.
This was as dead as one could be.
Recalling the process deduced at the site of the battle among immortals, could it be that after Qilin Immortal escorted Elder Ao Ling away, they encountered another attack, resulting in Elder Ao Ling's death and disappearance?
"Fairy, this..."
Fairy Eternity also saw this scene and, rare as it was, became infuriated, her brows furrowed like sharp swords, her aura causing the entire space to become unstable.
"Who is responsible for this treachery!"
"If not for Xiao Ling casting the Playing Dead Technique, she would be already dead!"
"Fairy, is Elder Ao Ling still alive?" Lu Yang asked incredulously. In such a state, could she still be revived?
"Of course, during the Playing Dead Technique, no matter what damage is encountered, it is all considered within the scope of 'playing dead'."
"Since it's 'playing dead,' then naturally she is still alive."
Fairy Eternity extended her slender fingers, which concentrated a glittering fairy energy, as if stars had descended to the mortal world, dazzling to behold.
In an instant, an invisible ripple spread from her fingertips, enshrouding the shattered soul of Ao Ling, who had already died.
The soul, broken into millions of pieces, gathered and connected, restoring Ao Ling's original form.
Life and death, destruction and rebirth, the ways of nature were undeniably demonstrated at this moment, containing truths far beyond Lu Yang's current understanding.
Ao Ling slowly opened her eyes, life returning to them.
She turned her head to look at the expectant Fairy Eternity, her voice trembling, tears first moistening the corners of her eyes, then silently sliding down her cheeks, leaving behind clear trails like pearls falling from a string onto her lapels.
"You are Immortal Sister, have they finally resurrected you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 783 - 782 The Reason Immortal Fairy Eternity Cannot Be Revived
chapters.content:
Ao Ling awoke from a long slumber, and upon seeing Fairy Eternity, she couldn't help but shed tears.
"Xiao Ling, do you still remember me?" Fairy Eternity pointed at herself, incredulous, as Lianyi had completely forgotten her.
Ao Ling wiped her tears, gently shaking her head with an apologetic look in her eyes, "I don't remember, but my husband and the others said that there were once five Immortals in the world, but with the fall of the fifth Immortal, everyone's memories were tampered with, causing them to forget the existence of that Immortal."
"So my husband and the others told me about this Immortal, saying that she was a very important existence to me."
Ao Ling held Fairy Eternity's hand, looked into her eyes, and said earnestly, "That Immortal is you, Immortal Sister."
"It's just that I have no recollection of the things my husband and the others have told me about."
What Ao Ling did not say was that upon waking and seeing Fairy Eternity for the first time, she felt an inexplicable trust and a strange sense of closeness.
It was as if there had always been a void in her heart, and upon seeing Fairy Eternity, that empty space was silently filled.
"My husband also said that if anyone could awaken me from the Playing Dead Technique, it would be only you, Sister."
"Where is my husband? He said he would bring you to wake me up, where is he now?"
Ao Ling looked around for the Qilin Immortal but found herself lying in a small pavilion, surrounded by a vast and boundless lake.
"Strange, where is this? I clearly remember that I was sleeping in the Abode."
Ao Ling's eyes revealed bewilderment, this was not as her husband had described.
"Sister, what's going on?"
Fairy Eternity was equally clueless, and Lu Yang, who had been silent until now, suddenly asked, "Predecessor Ao Ling, could you talk about what happened before you went to sleep?"
"Who is this…" Ao Ling only then realized that there was a young Cultivator at the Nascent Soul Stage beside Immortal Sister.
"Lu Yang, the Second-in-command of our Immortal Lineage," Fairy Eternity introduced him with a tone that showed great regard for Lu Yang.
"He is the one who resurrected me."
"Ah?"
Ao Ling was even more perplexed, this too was beyond her expectations.
She lowered her head in thought, organizing her memories, "Before I went to sleep, let me think where to start, yes, from the day the battle of the Immortals broke out."
"At that time, Lianyi was cultivating, and my husband was her Protector; I was reading a book when suddenly my mind went blank, a piercing pain in my chest, as if I had forever lost something."
"After that, I heard my husband let out a roar and then deployed his true form as a Kirin, striding across the heavens, where he passed, countless stars shattered, turning into fine dust."
"The three Yingtian Immortals from the adjacent Immortal realms reacted similarly to my husband, sensing something and all heading towards the North Star region."
"The four of them engaged in fierce combat with an unknown enemy, and I had never seen them so angry before; it was a do-or-die situation."
"That battle lasted a full seven days, during which I went to find Lianyi to ask what had happened, but like me, she knew nothing."
"Seven days later, my husband returned severely wounded and said the enemy was mysterious and difficult to deal with. To be safe, he asked Lianyi and me to both use the Playing Dead Technique."
"Lianyi applied the Playing Dead Technique, but I insisted on not sleeping, demanding that my husband explain the situation."
"At my insistence, he explained the reason behind the events."
"It was then that I learned that all the abnormalities that had occurred were related to your demise, Immortal Sister."
"The one who killed you also erased your existence. Your four husbands knew of your death as an immortal and were furious. They wanted to obliterate the murderer but failed. All they could do was to fall back on a secondary plan, reshaping the stars and forming the six continents, confining the murderer here."
"We were unable to eradicate the murderer in a short time; we didn't even know where the murderer was."
"After discussing it, your four husbands decided that what needed to be done was to find a way to revive you, sister."
"They said the easiest way to revive you was to say your name, but even they had forgotten your name. They even transformed into thousands and said different names at the same time, but it still resulted in failure."
"Logically, saying so many names at once, there should have been a correct one by chance—it's a matter of probability."
"Therefore, they suspected that one of the clones had said the correct name, but the murderer secretly interfered, using some undetectable method, making the name said by that clone incorrect."
"This is merely inference and cannot be proven. After all, once they had said your name, your four husbands would forget what they had said."
Lu Yang said solemnly, "There's another possibility."
"What is it?" Fairy Eternity and Ao Ling asked Lu Yang simultaneously.
"The hidden enemy only blocked the name 'Fairy Eternity Yellow Bean' in the ancient language, not the current language."
"I remember you once said, Fairy, that no matter the language system, as long as someone says your honorific and your fairy name, you can be revived. But only you knew this, and you told no one else."
Fairy Eternity remembered. This was right after she had been revived; Lu Yang, while learning to "foresee the future," also picked up the ancient language and asked if she could be revived in any language system, and that's how she had answered.
"The language of today?" Ao Ling didn't understand what Lu Yang was talking about. It felt like a lot had happened while she was asleep.
How long had she been asleep, exactly?
Since waking up, Ao Ling had always spoken in the ancient language. Both Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity were fluent in it, so communication wasn't an issue. She had no idea that no one in the outside world spoke the ancient language anymore.
"Yes, according to the evidence available, the Fire Dynasty collapsed, and the ancient language disappeared. The outside world now uses a different language system for communication," Lu Yang analyzed earnestly.
"With this understanding, it all makes sense. Using the ancient language, it is impossible to revive you, Fairy. Neither the four Yingtian Immortals nor the hidden enemy knew this; nobody even considered this possibility," Lu Yang concluded, feeling a sense of relief and fear after coming to this realization.
It was fortunate that no one knew about it, because if the hidden enemy had continued the blocking after the change in language systems, Fairy Eternity might never have had a chance to be revived.
To think that he casually revived Fairy Eternity with just a mention—it was almost too much good luck. Could it be that all the good karma from saving the world in a past life had been used up on this?
Pah, what kind of good fortune is reviving Fairy Eternity considered?
"Wait, wait, are you saying that the Fire Dynasty established by the four husbands has fallen?"
Ao Ling was astonished; how could the Fire Dynasty, established by the four immortals, have disappeared?
"Predecessor Ao Ling, you know about the Fire Dynasty?"
Ao Ling nodded: "Of course, I witnessed the establishment of the Fire Dynasty with my own eyes."

chapters.title: Chapter 784 - 783: Another Junior Sister
chapters.content:
"Unable to revive my Senior Sister by calling out her name, my husband and the others sought other methods,"
"After some discussion, they took Qinghe's suggestion and attempted to use the power of belief to revive her, thus establishing the Fire Dynasty."
"The power of belief is that useful?" Lu Yang was surprised; he wasn't too familiar with this area of knowledge.
However, considering that the Great Qian Dynasty followed the "faith in the divine," allowing a dynasty to be built on this foundation indicates that the power of belief has its merits.
Fairy Eternity shook her head; she viewed belief as something people worshiped for fun and hadn't paid much attention to it.
Ao Ling continued to reminisce, "My husband and the rest, on the foundation of the Fire Dynasty, established two major belief systems: 'Heavenly Court' and 'Abode of the Dead.'"
Lu Yang: "..."
Did I just experience an auditory hallucination, or did I hear some very familiar terms just now?
"The Heavenly Court belief system was to manage the mortal world."
"The Abode system was established to govern life and death."
"The general principle was to use 'Heavenly Court' to collect belief for you, my Senior Sister, to craft an immortal body, so in the Fire Dynasty, the statue of the Heavenly Court Master is modeled after you—you are the Heavenly Court Master!"
Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity looked at each other. Lu Yang saw excitement in Fairy Eternity's eyes, and Fairy Eternity saw her own excited reflection in Lu Yang's gaze.
"Second Boss, you indeed have the ability to foresee the past, oh no, that's wrong, to foresee the future!"
Lu Yang didn't really want to talk.
"And the Abode Master, with the authority to control life and death, resonated with your immortal power, Elder Sister. The Eternity Dao Fruit is indestructible, so in this way, it might be possible to call back the Eternity Dao Fruit."
"If unsuccessful, they could still use the control over life and death characteristic of the Abode system to revive you, my Senior Sister."
"Of course, all this is theoretical. Nobody has put it into practice, so the outcome is unknown, but judging by their attitudes, my husband and the others seemed to think there was a high probability of success."
Lu Yang suspected that the Yingtian Immortal and the others were so confident because they knew that Fairy Eternity would be revived in the future.
"Meanwhile, my husband and the rest were also tirelessly analyzing the culprit's identity and abilities."
"Time Immortal attempted to observe the past to search for the killer's process of committing the crime but found that period shrouded in a haze, obscuring everything from view."
"Some suspected it was the Causality Dao Fruit at work, while others guessed the Verbal Spell Dao Fruit or even the Replacement Dao Fruit. Many different Dao Fruits were theorized, all of which exist only in theory. Without direct contact with each one, it's impossible to assert which one the culprit utilized."
"The only certainty is that the killer was immensely powerful, surpassing the abilities of my husband and his companions."
"It was at the ten-thousand-year mark since the creation of the Fire Dynasty that a genius emerged in later generations, a member of the Imperial Shi Clan; he achieved immortality by proving the Insight Dao Fruit."
"The Insight Dao Fruit allows one to see clearly through all, sitting in one place yet witnessing all directions, nothing in heaven and earth is concealed, all lay bare before one's eyes."
"To sit in one place and witness all directions; that's quite impressive. This seems much more useful than the Time Dao Fruit's ability to observe the future. I wouldn't have expected such a genius to emerge from a place like the Imperial Shi Clan," praised Fairy Eternity.
Being able to sit and witness all directions means being able to see through all the past, present, and future.
Although the Time Immortal could observe the future, she couldn't do so with precision, only able to see one possible future scenario.
Ao Ling shook her head and said, "Sister, you think too highly of him. He has barely become an Immortal and ranks at the bottom in terms of strength."
Lu Yang's eye twitched. Only a Semi-Immortal like Ao Ling, who could sense the suppression of the Dao Fruit, was qualified to make such a statement. There were also Elder Lianyi, Eldest Senior Sister, Fairy Eternity, Yingtian Immortal, Immortal Jiuchong, Time Immortal, Qilin Immortal... Upon counting, there were quite a number of people indeed who were qualified to say such a thing.
"Husband and the others asked this 'Left Historian Immortal' to observe the process of the crime. He exerted the Dao Fruit to the point of sweating profusely, but he couldn't discern any useful outcomes."
"In his attempts to observe the future, he could only catch glimpses of a certain segment and couldn't control which period it would be. For example, once he saw that in three hundred and ninety thousand years, there would be a struggle for power in a Great Era, and some Immortals would fall."
"Only when he observes the present world can he achieve detailed accuracy."
As Lu Yang heard the observational results of the Left Historian Immortal, his heartbeat slowed for a moment. Wasn't this the present time?
The fall of the Immortal, was it referring to the first generation Emperor Yu? Or was it some other Immortals?
"After another ten thousand years had passed, my husband was uncertain when he could resurrect Sister, so he suggested that I go into a deep sleep and wait for Sister to wake me up when she resurrected, and so I laid down to sleep in the Abode."
With a limited lifespan, Ao Ling couldn't wait forever.
"So it's no longer the Fire Dynasty now?" Ao Ling was still preoccupied with this issue.
Lu Yang replied, "Forty thousand years have passed since the Fairy's demise, and the Fire Dynasty had already perished three hundred thousand years ago."
"Moreover, Fairy and I have discovered a battle site left by the Qilin Immortal, who fought with an Immortal possessing the Annihilation Dao Fruit. It's very likely that the battle site is the Abode where you, Elder Ao Ling, were sleeping!"
"The energy in the dragon-patterned bracelet that Yingtian Immortal made for you, Elder, has been completely depleted." Lu Yang took out the dragon-patterned bracelet and returned it to its owner.
Ao Ling took the bracelet and froze, fully aware of what the depletion of energy from the dragon-patterned bracelet meant.
Lu Yang continued, "Moreover, when the Qilin Immortal was transferring you, you were also attacked, causing your soul to be fragmented until the Fairy lifted the Playing Dead Technique."
"And now, outside, no one knows of the Fire Dynasty's existence anymore. It's very likely the doing of that Immortal with the Annihilation Dao Fruit who, in his effort to erase all information about the Fire Dynasty, did not hesitate to antagonize Yingtian Immortal and three other Immortals."
Ao Ling hadn't expected so much to have happened during her slumber.
Fairy Eternity, noticing the awkward atmosphere, kindly offered reassurance and took control, "Alright, alright, let's not dwell on these matters. Thinking more about it won't lead to any results and with me here, nothing can go wrong."
Ao Ling nodded vigorously and said with conviction, "I believe in Immortal Sister."
Lu Yang thought to himself, Elder Ao Ling, can you not trust her in such situations?
"And you, your name is Lu Yang, right?" Ao Ling got out of bed, swishing her dragon tail.
She bowed deeply to Lu Yang and said solemnly, "Thank you for reviving Immortal Sister. My husband, the four of us, Lianyi, and Qinghe all owe you a tremendous debt of gratitude!"
Lu Yang was flustered and certainly did not dare to accept such an honor, but whether he dared or not was not for him to decide, for he couldn't even make Ao Ling's single hair strand flutter.
Seeing this, Fairy Eternity hurriedly intervened, "Ah, Second Boss, don't be shy. As the Second-in-command of the Immortal Lineage, you hold a much higher position than unnamed disciples like Xiao Ling and Lianyi. Based on seniority, it wouldn't be too much for Xiao Ling to address you as 'Senior Brother'."
"Fairy, don't talk nonsense. The hierarchy isn't ordered like that." Lu Yang warned Fairy Eternity with his eyes, but regrettably, Fairy Eternity did not have eyes to see this.
Ao Ling bowed again and said with a cunning smile, "Elder Brother Lu Yang, Ao Ling pays her respects."

chapters.title: Chapter 785 - 784 The Orthodox Heavenly Court
chapters.content:
Lu Yang's heart trembled, "Fairy, you really aren't afraid of making a fuss, are you?"
"I haven't done anything, and I already have two Junior Sisters of Semi-Immortal status."
"Do I deserve it?"
If Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi were his Junior Sisters, what should their husband, the Kirin Immortal, call him?
"Have you met Lianyi?" Ao Ling suddenly asked.
Jiang Lianyi was also an unregistered disciple of Immortal Sister, so if Jiang Lianyi hadn't awakened, would it be proper for her to call Lu Yang 'Elder Brother' before Jiang Lianyi, making her Lianyi's Senior Sister?
"We have met her, she was in a deep sleep within the Secret Realm of Demon Territory, and was awakened by the Fairy."
"I see."
Ao Ling thought for a moment that, since both she and Jiang Lianyi were unregistered disciples and had such a good relationship, there was no need to distinguish between Senior and Junior Sisters.
"Where is Lianyi now?"
Lu Yang pondered for a moment and replied, "She should be in the Demon Territory. She has been inquiring about Elder Ao Ling's whereabouts. I guess she hasn't found any clues."
Lu Yang hadn't expected to find Ao Ling before anyone else.
Ao Ling laughed and corrected Lu Yang's way of addressing, "If Elder Brother calls me 'Elder Ao Ling,' wouldn't it confuse our generational ranking? Just call me 'Junior Sister Xiao Ling.'"
Lu Yang dared not call her that.
"It's quite unexpected that Elder Brother Lu Yang could be recognized by Sister. As far as I know, the Immortal Lineage has only ever had Immortal Sister by herself."
Fairy Eternity said proudly, "You didn't see that coming, did you? The Second-in-command is a fine seedling of our Immortal Lineage. Without me, he could have attained immortality through enlightenment."
Ao Ling was surprised. She hadn't expected Lu Yang to receive such high praise from Sister, a praise not even her husband and the other three Immortals had ever received.
Lu Yang hastened to say, "Now, there are three people in the Immortal Lineage."
"Oh? There's someone else who has gained Sister's recognition?" Ao Ling was even more astonished. The Immortal Lineage had actually grown threefold.
"The third person is a Semi-Immortal, formed through the power of faith, and his Dao Fruit Outline is also immortal," said Lu Yang, who had to share the troubles with Immortal Eternity as equally shameless.
"I also have another Elder Brother?"
Fairy Eternity waved her hand indifferently, "That doesn't count. The Third Boss, who relied on the shortcut of faith to form his initial Immortal Dao Fruit, is barely considered part of our Immortal Lineage. All he knows is self-destruction; he can't even master the Playing Dead Technique."
"According to the Sect's terms, I am the Sect Leader, the Second-in-command is the Deputy Sect Leader, and the Third Boss would be a menial disciple."
"You and Lianyi being considered his Senior Sister would be about right."
"What about husband, do you know where he is?"
"He's probably still alive," Lu Yang didn't know how to phrase it.
"Probably?" Ao Ling didn't understand why Lu Yang would say it like that when she could clearly feel the suppression from above's Dao Fruit.
Otherwise, she would have become an Immortal by now.
"Elder Lianyi has been awake for over half a year. When she first awoke, she happened to encounter Xiao Zhu, no, Venerate Zhu Tian establishing the Demon Nation. Elder Lianyi clashed with him, and it shocked the world."
"Nowadays, with no Immortals openly existing in the outer world, the news of two Ancient Semi-Immortals fighting spread quickly, and everyone knows about it."
"Venerate Zhu Tian's unification of the Demon Territory and the establishment of the Demon Nation is indeed a major event. The Demon Territory has never been unified since its inception."
"The current problem is, if the Qilin Immortal is still alive, he should be aware of Elder Lianyi's awakening. However, he has not shown himself, which is quite strange."
This was not only Lu Yang's opinion but also Yun Zhi's. Fairy Eternity might not speak it out loud, but perhaps she thought the same in her heart.
Ao Ling wore a peculiar expression: "It's only been half a year; isn't it very normal for my husband not to know?"
"Ah?"
"Don't you go into retreat, Elder Brother? My husband often goes into retreat for a decade or two. When we were at the Fire Dynasty, he even had a retreat that lasted hundreds of years."
Lu Yang: "..."
If you put it that way, it seems to make sense.
Lu Yang recalled his own cultivation experience; not long ago, he had gone into retreat for an hour.
Eldest Senior Sister seemed to be in a state of constant enlightenment, not requiring retreats.
Fairy Eternity even advocated for achieving enlightenment through the mortal world and not to go into retreats.
Now that I think about it, it's quite normal for cultivators to go into retreat for ten or eight years, let alone Immortals who have infinite lifespans and a vague sense of time.
They are the supreme powerhouses who could even play a game of Go for a hundred years.
"However, the Time Immortal really did run into trouble," said Lu Yang again.
"We discovered the physical body of the Time Immortal's Firmament Tree, scarred all over—surely the result of a battle among Immortals. The Firmament Tree was empty, with no Immortal Soul present. It's uncertain whether the Immortal Soul dissipated into the world or fled."
Fairy Eternity nodded on the side, as Lu Yang conveyed her words.
"How could this be? Brother Suiyue actually ran into trouble!" Ao Ling became serious—this was no small matter. An Immortal in charge of time could actually die; who could be behind this dark deed?
"From the intelligence we've gathered so far, after you fell into slumber, an Immortal in possession of the Eternity Dao Fruit sought to kill you, resulting in a battle with the Qilin Immortal. The Fire Dynasty was destroyed for unknown reasons, and some Immortals deliberately concealed the existence of the Fire Dynasty, and the fate of the Time Immortal remains unknown."
"All these events are very likely to have occurred during the same period."
Lu Yang hadn't expected that during the era of the Fire Dynasty, an Immortal was born, which means that there were five Immortals within the Fire Dynasty.
Even so, the Fire Dynasty still met its demise. It's feasible to assume that a single Immortal in possession of the Eternity Dao Fruit couldn't have done this alone; there must have been some other great unknown event that occurred at the time.
"By the way, Elder, we've also established a Heavenly Court over here. Would you consider joining us?"
"You've established a Heavenly Court, too?" Ao Ling heard this claim for the first time.
Lu Yang touched his head, a rare embarrassed smile on his face: "It's a long story. I formed the Heavenly Court, and truly, I had no idea the Fire Dynasty had established a Heavenly Court; otherwise, I would have chosen a different name."
"Now, the name of our Heavenly Court is too well-known; it would probably be difficult to change it."
"You could probably understand that there are some things we're not convenient to do ourselves. I've heard the Fairy talking about the Heavenly Court, so I also crafted one to use that identity for certain matters."
Lu Yang heard from Fairy Eternity that the Five Ancient Immortals had come up with many versions of the Heavenly Court. Now it seems, maybe that was the contingency plan prepared by the Yingtian Immortal and his three peers, only Fairy Eternity didn't know?
"So who is in this Heavenly Court you've established?"
Lu Yang counted on his fingers and said: "Let me list them for you: the Heavenly Court Master is the Fairy, there's a Senior Sister named Yun Zhi who serves as the Heavenly Court Sect Master, one of the Four Imperial Protectors is Elder Lianyi, there are nine Protector Heavenly Kings, I'm the Young Sect Master, and there are four Saint Heirs."
Ao Ling was puzzled: "The original purpose of establishing the Heavenly Court was to resurrect Immortal Sister. Since you have resurrected Immortal Sister and she is also the Heavenly Court Master, then the Heavenly Court you've established would be the legitimate one."

chapters.title: Chapter 786 - 786: 785
chapters.content:
```
Lu Yang hadn't anticipated that the Heavenly Court he later established would become the orthodox one.
But on closer thought, what Ao Ling said wasn't without reason.
Ao Ling noticed something odd about a member of the Heavenly Court, "I don't know who this Yun Zhi that Senior Brother speaks of is, but she is actually the Sect Master of the Heavenly Court, with a status only below Immortal Sister, ranking even higher than Lianyi."
Just as Lu Yang was about to explain, Fairy Eternity interjected, "Miss Yun is my archenemy, we are almost equally matched in strength. Once I return to my prime, and with you, the Second-in-command, and Lianyi joining forces, the four of us together will surely be able to defeat Miss Yun and return in triumph."
Lu Yang looked at Fairy Eternity in utter surprise, How has this got anything to do with me?
Fairy Eternity, as if she had read Lu Yang's mind, explained, "You are the Second-in-command after all. We share weal and woe, fortunes and misfortunes alike."
Is the cost of being Second-in-command this heavy?
And since I resurrected you, have I even enjoyed a single day of blessings?
"To think that such an extraordinary person exists," Ao Ling was astonished. To be called an archenemy by Immortal Sister, the people of later generations really should not be underestimated.
"Lianyi has already crossed hands with her," Fairy Eternity said.
"What was the outcome?"
Fairy Eternity seriously said, "It was a draw."
Relieved, Ao Ling thought that this Yun Zhi was not as difficult to deal with as he had imagined.
"Senior, are we going to leave via this pearl?" Lu Yang felt although the environment inside the pearl was lovely, a favored place for a hermit Cultivator, one couldn't always stay there.
"Of course we have to leave," Ao Ling nodded, then asked with confusion, "But how do we leave?"
The space inside the pearl was crafted by the Qilin Immortal, even Fairy Eternity and Ao Ling didn't know about it, let alone know how to leave.
Lu Yang: "..."
Fairy Eternity volunteered confidently, "That's easy, it's just a broken pearl. Shatter it, and we can get out."
Forcibly breaking the pearl from the outside would cause the internal space to teleport randomly, but breaking the pearl from the inside wouldn't present this problem.
Lu Yang was startled; this was an Immortal Artifact refined from an entire star, capable of neutralizing all poisons and containing a small world within it.
To talk of shattering an Immortal Artifact as if it were nothing seemed excessively extravagant.
"Then what do you suggest we do?" Fairy Eternity had only this one solution.
Lu Yang scratched his head; he was even less aware of what to do.
"Speaking of which, when I entered this pearl, it was constantly flying. Where was it flying to?"
...
Within the inner circle of Penglai Island, at the core of the Ninth-grade Spirit Vein.
Unknown to all, the three Transcendance Tribulation Stage powerhouses of the Human race from the East Sea secretly gathered here.
"Big brother, are we really going to do this?" The person speaking was nervous, the Island Master of Yingzhou, known as Mr. Listening Sea.
```
```
Three Mountains Taoist sighed softly, "There's nothing else I can do; I am deep in the mire of faith and cannot extricate myself."
"Although I've established faith in various places to aid in the formation of the Dao Fruit Outline and become a Semi-Immortal, the power of faith also has its drawbacks."
"Let's not mention the fact that I was once worshipped by a being of higher status to the point of vomiting blood; that was actually not too bad, as such Great Powers wouldn't worship me every day—it was a rare occurrence in the world."
"The worst is that my body is not under my control, but influenced by faith; every action is to fulfill the wishes of the believers!"
Three Mountains Taoist had watched helplessly numerous times as his body disobeyed his commands and acted against his intentions.
"My physical body is almost completely out of my control, I must act to save it while I can still control it."
The fact that Three Mountains Taoist had become a Semi-Immortal was only known to the Island Master of Fangzhang Island and the Island Master of Yingzhou.
If not for Three Mountains Taoist's dire situation, he would have long publicized his Semi-Immortal cultivation level and unified the East Sea.
Three Mountains Taoist said resentfully, "I've tried letting my daughter do evil things to ruin my reputation, but the faith of the East Sea cultivators in me is deep-rooted, and a few misdeeds couldn't harm my reputation at all!"
"There are not a few Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivators in the East Sea, big brother, so why do you want to possess the Old Dragon Emperor? Although he is the most powerful Transcendance Tribulation Stage in the East Sea, his lifespan is also reaching its limit."
The one asking the question was the Island Master of Fangzhang Island, Venerate of the Six Harmonies.
Three Mountains Taoist waved his hand dismissively, "You don't need to worry about this. Semi-Immortals and Immortals differ; an Immortal's cultivation resides both in the immortal soul and the immortal body. A Semi-Immortal's cultivation is all in the soul, and the Dao Fruit Outline is bound to my soul."
