"Once I possess the Old Dragon Emperor, I will still be a Semi-Immortal, and the Old Dragon Emperor's lifespan will jump from ten thousand to a hundred thousand years. There is no need to worry about lifespan issues in the future."
"Moreover, the Old Dragon Emperor commands the entire Long Clan, and what is the Long Clan? It is where the Dragon Clan Ancestor was born, not to mention that the Dragon Clan Ancestor was the Qilin Immortal's wife. One can imagine the wealth of the Long Clan, not only in terms of Spirit Stones.
They might even have Semi-Immortal or Immortal level magic artifacts, like the stone pillar he always wraps around, which is at least a Semi-Immortal level magic artifact!"
"Once I possess the Old Dragon Emperor, all of this will be ours!"
The words of Three Mountains Taoist made the other two Island Masters' blood boil with excitement.
"It's just a pity that the old geezer, the Old Dragon Emperor, refuses to leave the stone pillar. We can only make our move when he holds his longevity feast!" Three Mountains Taoist sighed. The Dragon Palace had profound depths, even as a Semi-Immortal he dared not charge in rashly.
The Island Master of Fangzhang Island, Venerate of the Six Harmonies, asked again, "But possessing the Old Dragon Emperor in front of a crowd is no simple matter, setting aside the fact that everyone will see, the point of possession would be lost.
Most importantly, big brother, your Dao Fruit Outline won't be of any help in possessing him, and your soul strength is not as strong as the Old Dragon Emperor's. How will you manage it?"
Three Mountains Taoist smiled coldly, already prepared for this, "Six Harmonies, have you forgotten the 'Great Void Immortal Grass' on Yingzhou Island?"
Venerate of the Six Harmonies was shocked, "You mean the Great Void Immortal Grass?"
It is widely rumored that a stalk of Immortal Grass that grants everlasting life grows deep within the Eight-Grade Spirit Veins of Yingzhou Island, planted by the ancient Venerate of Evergreen during the Ancient Times.
But in reality, it's not the said Immortal Grass but the Great Void Immortal Grass that causes hallucinations. Those who are poisoned by the Great Void Immortal Grass fall into an illusionary realm, believing themselves to be immortal in their dreams, hence the myth of the 'Immortal Grass that grants everlasting life.'
The poison of the Great Void Immortal Grass would affect even a Semi-Immortal, which is extremely terrifying.
Over the long years, the Island Master of Yingzhou had already mastered the antidote to the poison of the Great Void Immortal Grass.
"We just need to release the Great Void Immortal Grass at the longevity feast under the guise of presenting a gift, catching the Old Dragon Emperor off guard. Then, everyone will be poisoned and fall into the illusionary realm, the Old Dragon Emperor included. Only we will be spared."
"The poison of the Great Void will affect even the soul, and I will take that opportunity to possess the Old Dragon Emperor in one fell swoop!"
"Afterwards, no one will know what happened at the longevity feast!"
Three Mountains Taoist had long prepared for possessing the Old Dragon Emperor, taking every precaution to ensure that all was ready.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 787 - 786: Meticulous Plan, Infallible
chapters.content:
"So how do we move the Great Void Immortal Grass?" the Vast Sea Daoist Lord continued to inquire, his brows slightly furrowed, full of concern.
He always felt that the preparations this time were not secure enough.
"If we don't set up restrictions around the Immortal Grass, the poisonous gas will be released all along the way, poisoning every creature it passes. That would be all too obvious."
"But if we do set restrictions, I'm afraid a small box wouldn't be enough to contain it, right?"
Mr. Listening Sea was confident about this issue. He took out a small wooden box, "Can you feel even a trace of poison coming from inside?"
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord was startled, "Is the Great Void Immortal Grass inside this?"
"Indeed, it is."
Mr. Listening Sea opened the wooden box, and a slender and elegant Immortal Herb appeared before the three of them.
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord instinctively urged his cultivation technique to resist the poison but realized that although the Immortal Grass was within reach, it emitted no poison.
"What kind of Array Method is this?"
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord noticed that besides the Great Void Immortal Grass, array patterns were also carved within the wooden box.
Mr. Listening Sea closed the wooden box with a faint smile, "Everything has its nemesis, and for the Great Void Immortal Grass, there is something that overcomes it. This is a detoxifying Array Method discovered by the sages of Yingzhou in an ancient secret realm which can neutralize all poisons, precisely countering the Great Void Immortal Grass."
"Regrettably, according to research, this set of detoxifying Array Method should have an Array Eye, but it has never been found."
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord was amazed, not expecting such a wonderful thing to exist.
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord wanted to open the box again to take another look at this rare object, but Mr. Listening Sea stopped him.
"It cannot be opened again. Inside the wooden box, there is another Array Method set up. The next time the box is opened, the other Array Method will crush the Great Void Immortal Grass, releasing all of its poisonous gas, which even this detoxifying Array Method would not be able to suppress."
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord then realized, "So it is to be opened during the Old Dragon Emperor's birthday banquet!"
"Exactly."
After thinking for a moment, the Vast Sea Daoist Lord felt that everything had been calculated from the beginning, with no details overlooked.
"The only flaw is that the Juxuan Island thieves failed to do their job well," the Three Mountains Taoist sighed softly.
"There's a Dragon Ball in the Dragon Palace, said to be an object from ancient times, greatly related to the Dragon Clan Ancestor. The Old Dragon Emperor treasures it deeply, and that Dragon Ball also has detoxifying properties, which might affect the Great Void Immortal Grass."
"Fortunately, although the Juxuan Island thieves did not manage to steal the Dragon Ball, intelligence from the Sea City of the Dragon Palace says that a disciple from the Dao Seeking Sect took it. Even the Dragon Palace doesn't know where the Dragon Ball has gone."
"It's better lost. As long as the Dragon Palace can't find the Dragon Ball, anything is possible."
Mr. Listening Sea handed the box to the Three Mountains Taoist, who solemnly took care of it.
The trio exchanged smiles and set about their tasks.
No one noticed that a pellet the size of an elixir flew towards Penglai Island at an unbelievable speed, passing through the layers of restrictions, through the wooden box, and precisely into the center of the detoxifying Array Method.
It looked just like the Array Eye.
The Great Void Immortal Grass withered at an incredible rate.
...
"Lu Yang, come forth!" the Vast Sea Daoist Lord called out, using the embryonic Spatial Dao Fruit, and gently tugging at the void.
All to no avail.
"It shouldn't be like this, where has that boy Lu Yang run off to?"
Vast Sea Daoist Lord could not understand. He possessed the embryonic form of a Spatial Dao Fruit, which allowed him to travel anywhere in the Cultivation World effortlessly, and locating a Nascent Soul cultivator through the power of the embryonic Dao Fruit was a simple task.
"Lu Yang, come!"
Vast Sea Daoist Lord attempted his method once again, reaching out and scratching at the air, but he still could not find any trace of Lu Yang.
Meng Jingzhou watched Vast Sea Daoist Lord as if he were possessed by fierce ghosts, his body not obeying his commands, scratching at an empty space incessantly, remaining silent all the while.
Since even the Grandmaster couldn't find Lu Yang, it's feared that the kid might have gone to some secret realm laid by immortals or the likes.
Five days ago, Vast Sea Daoist Lord had used the embryonic Spatial Dao Fruit to open a spatial channel and stepped across to the East Sea in one stride, asking Meng Jingzhou and the others for information.
Meng Jingzhou and the other two had no idea where Lu Yang had flown off to, all shaking their heads, unable to clarify.
Vast Sea Daoist Lord had no choice but to keep using the embryonic Spatial Dao Fruit, summoning Lu Yang like one would summon a soul.
And had not succeeded.
Later, Vast Sea Daoist Lord brought Meng Jingzhou, the three of them, and Xiao Xinghai—a hero of the Long Clan—back to the Kunpeng Clan, and the revered Black Feather greeted them personally.
Even the formidable Black Feather was but a junior in front of Vast Sea Daoist Lord.
If the records were not mistaken, Vast Sea Daoist Lord had once had dealings with the Kunpeng Clan, and that was all fifty thousand years ago.
Whether looking at cultivation level or seniority, Black Feather did not dare to act presumptuously.
"Don't worry, little Meng and the rest of you. With me here, I have no rivals in the entire East Sea," Vast Sea Daoist Lord said indifferently, his tone revealing an unsurpassed confidence.
His words were not mistaken. For the East Sea that lacked a semi-immortal, he indeed was an invincible presence.
Five days later, when the aftereffects of Tao Yaoye using her Feather Transformation Immortal Body disappeared, and the birthday banquet of the Old Dragon Emperor was about to commence, Vast Sea Daoist Lord took everyone to attend the banquet.
The nine-thousand-year-old birthday banquet of the Old Dragon Emperor was a top-tier event in the East Sea. All Sea Clan and Human race cultivators above the Void Refinement Stage received invitations.
Vast Sea Daoist Lord stood with his hands behind his back, atop auspicious clouds. The sea surface was full of Human race cultivators showing off divine abilities, crossing the East Sea to join the banquet.
The sea held countless old ancestors of various races, transforming into their original forms—be it fish, crab, or shellfish—accepting the invitation to come.
"It's been a long time since I visited the East Sea, and it's still as bustling as ever," Vast Sea Daoist Lord commented casually, displaying the demeanor of a Daoist lord. In terms of the number of species, the East Sea was even more abundant than the Demon Territory.
"You've traveled the East Sea before, Grand Ancestor?" Meng Jingzhou asked curiously.
Vast Sea Daoist Lord laughed heartily, his spirits high, "Of course. Once upon a time, I made quite a name for myself in the East Sea. Alas, you young cultivators only know that I'm the reviver of the Seek Dao Sect, not aware of my experiences in the East Sea."
Vast Sea Daoist Lord's active years in the East Sea were too distant, so far back that even Clan Leader Xiao and Xiao Xinghai had not heard of his exploits there.
"The 'Vast Sea' in my Daoist title is to commemorate the years I spent active in the East Sea."
"Back then, I was still in the Body Integration Realm, studying the way of space, which caused spatial turbulence that transported me from Seek Dao Sect to the East Sea."
"I was severely injured by the spatial turbulence, my power fallen to less than that of the Golden Core Stage. Fortunately, fishermen of that time saved me."
"In that small fishing village, I met a little princess who had snuck out of the Dragon Palace. We hit it off right away."
"Under the little princess's care, my injuries gradually healed. We got along famously and became Dao companions, adventuring together in the East Sea, seeking Immortal Herbs, encountering Tribulation Cultivators, and entering Secret Realms..."
Vast Sea Daoist Lord let out a long sigh, his tone full of melancholy, "Alas, 'a different path does not allow for common plans,' we belonged to different races and couldn't be together at the end."
Meng Jingzhou and the others were immersed in Vast Sea Daoist Lord's sigh, as if they could feel his emotions from that time.
In the back, Black Feather muttered to himself, "That's not right. Didn't I hear that it was the Long Clan who said dragons are naturally lascivious, and that Elder Vast Sea couldn't withstand the pressure and secretly slipped away?"
Vast Sea Daoist Lord suddenly turned his head, staring intently at Black Feather.

chapters.title: Chapter 788 - 787: Transcendance Tribulation Stage Fights Back Against Semi-Immortal
chapters.content:
The battle between those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage and Semi-Immortals was about to erupt, a high-level combat which hadn't been seen in the East Sea for a hundred thousand years.
As a seasoned veteran at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, the respected Hei Yu acted decisively and without hesitation.
While Vast Sea Daoist Lord was immersed in the sorrow of his memories, he secretly spurred the Dao of Time in a counterattack against Vast Sea Daoist Lord, appealing to time to unravel a corner of the historical truth.
Vast Sea Daoist Lord dared not be careless, countering with the embryonic outline of the Spatial Dao Fruit.
Hei Yu even used some unknown secret technique, causing Vast Sea Daoist Lord to lose one of his five senses, leaving him temporarily deaf. Even as Hei Yu pleaded for mercy multiple times, Vast Sea Daoist Lord heard none of it.
Vast Sea Daoist Lord narrowly won, yet Hei Yu was defeated with honor!
Meng Jingzhou felt that the Kunpeng Clan truly deserved their reputation as one the ten great Sea Clans; their survival to this day must surely be tied to their formidable strength.
Out of consideration for the many races coming and going above the surface of the East Sea and the presence of the Kunpeng people nearby, Vast Sea Daoist Lord didn't strike with full force, thus leaving Hei Yu with some dignity.
Therefore, Hei Yu's face was not looking good.
Xiao, the Clan Leader, and Xiao Xinghai sighed inwardly, feeling the elder truly courted death by speaking recklessly about everything.
Xiao Xinghai was almost ready to bring out a coffin, to prevent the elder from having an unattended corpse left in the wilderness, which would make people say that the descendants of the Kunpeng Clan were unfilial.
No need to bring it out since he's still alive.
This coffin had been soaked in a large amount of Dragon's Blood, turning the pure black coffin completely blood red inside and out, which looked particularly terrifying, and its quality had risen by a half tier compared to before.
Upon hearing the shameful past uncovered by Hei Yu, Su Yi Ren became even more determined to make good use of the Yang Invigorating Essence Blood in the bottle.
"Exactly which kind of Demon Beast's blood is this? It seems even more effective than Dragon and Phoenix blood; could it possibly be from an offspring produced by a Dragon and a Phoenix?"
A group of people sneaked into the East Sea, and as soon as they went under the water, they heard someone calling out.
"Yi Ren, over here, over here!"
Looking toward the voice, Su Yi Ren saw a Dragon girl draped in a flowing, colorful scale dress waving at her.
The Dragon girl's facial features were smooth and she was a rare gentle beauty.
"Gu'er, what are you doing here?" Su Yi Ren asked in surprise; it was this very Ao Gu'er who had invited her to the Old Dragon Emperor's birthday banquet.
Ao Gu'er took Su Yi Ren's hand, her dissatisfaction apparent, "That's what I'm saying, you didn't come to the Dragon Palace to see me sooner, waiting until the day of the banquet to show up."
Ao Gu'er didn't forget the matter at hand and formally greeted Vast Sea Daoist Lord, "This must be Senior Vast Sea, my father sent me here to wait for you all."
Upon hearing the name Ao Gu'er, the expressions of Meng Jingzhou and others turned odd.
After all, it had been from Ao Gu'er that Daoist Buyu had stolen the Dragon Ball, shamelessly calling her 'mommy' afterward.
It was fortunate that Lu Yang hadn't come along; otherwise, what an awkward situation this would be.
Meng Jingzhou thought again that it was wrong; he was just an onlooker enjoying the show, what did Lu Yang's awkwardness have to do with him?
It's a pity Old Lu didn't come.
Ao Gu'er led everyone to dive down, all the way to the bottom of the sea, to the end of the Sea City intricately shaped like a True Dragon—the Dragon Palace.
The Dragon Palace was surrounded by age-old corals, with gently swaying seaweeds as curtains, and the palace complex was majestic and splendid.
The interior walls of the Dragon Palace were inlaid with a variety of dazzling gemstones and pearls, emitting a soft, yet blinding light.
There were numerous shrimp and crab guards standing in strict vigilance, as well as patrolling members of the Yaksha clan.
A portion of the guests had already arrived at the Dragon Palace; they were the heads of major forces, extremely interested in the movements of the top cultivators of the Cultivation World. Vast Sea Daoist Lord was no mystery, having been very active fifty thousand years ago, with many images of him passed down through the ages.
"Look, that's Vast Sea Daoist Lord!"
"The legendary Semi-Immortal..."
"Why don't we have such characters in the East Sea?"
"In the struggle of the Great Era, even Semi-Immortals have begun to appear."
Ao Gu'er led the group through the Dragon Palace and arrived at its deepest part, pushing open the heavy doors where an ancient Azure Dragon coiled around a giant stone pillar that seemed to have no end in sight.
In front of Vast Sea Daoist Lord, the Old Dragon Emperor dared not act arrogantly. He climbed down from the stone pillar and, with a thud, transformed into human form.
The Old Dragon Emperor really was very old. Having taken human form, he resembled an elder with one foot in the coffin, tremblingly walking as if a single wave could knock him over. Ao Gu'er hurriedly went to support him.
"Ao Cang pays his respects to Senior Vast Sea."
"Enough, if you're unwell, there's no need to strain yourself," Vast Sea Daoist Lord said, seeing the Old Dragon Emperor like this, worried he might fall over and lose consciousness.
"I've come here to talk about the matter of the Dragon Ball. Originally, I had planned to use my Embryonic Dao Fruit to easily find Lu Yang and your Dragon Ball."
"I just don't know what went wrong later on, but I've been unable to find him. What's so special about your Dragon Ball?"
The Old Dragon Emperor shook his head: "I don't know either. I only know it's an ancient relic, indestructible and has the power to detoxify. I didn't even know there was a smaller pearl inside the Dragon Ball."
"An ancient relic, and you've never thought to investigate its origins?"
The Old Dragon Emperor looked troubled: "Senior, as you know, there have been gaps in history. We know so little of the ancient times. When our ancestors inherited the Dragon Palace, it was filled with all kinds of heavenly materials and Spirit Treasures, and we didn't recognize many of them. The Dragon Ball was among these treasures, not particularly conspicuous."
"It took us tens of thousands of years, but we finally managed to categorize all these treasures."
"Just categorizing them was difficult enough; tracing their origins is even more impossible. You can understand that, right?"
Vast Sea Daoist Lord blew his beard and glared. When had he ever experienced such wealth? If the Seek Dao Sect had been this rich, would he have become known as a great reviver of the sect?
Wasn't it because he appeared when the Seek Dao Sect was at its poorest that he was hailed as a reviver?
Even though he later made the Seek Dao Sect wealthy, it hadn't reached the ostentatious level of the Dragon Palace.
Of course, the Seek Dao Sect was definitely richer than the Long Clan now, having taken down several lairs of Semi-Immortals.
"Well then, since you don't have any leads, I will try harder to find them after the birthday banquet is over." Vast Sea Daoist Lord said it casually, but he had no confidence in his heart.
With no leads, where was he going to find Lu Yang?
He had promised to protect him, yet it was an inauspicious start.
"By the way, Senior, there is someone from our Long Clan who would like to meet you," the Old Dragon Emperor said.
"Who?" Vast Sea Daoist Lord thought to himself. He hadn't been to the Dragon Palace for tens of thousands of years, what familiar person could there be?
A graceful and alluring Dragon Beauty emerged from behind the stone pillar. Her eyes captivated the soul, and the three dragon scales on her forehead added an irresistible charm.
"Yi, Yi Ren?"
Vast Sea Daoist Lord was unsettled, this person was Ao Ya, who had left an indelible mark in his heart.
"You've become a Semi-Immortal too?!"
It had been fifty thousand years; could someone in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage live that long?
In front of Ao Ya, Vast Sea Daoist Lord became visibly uncomfortable, not knowing where to put his hands.
Ao Ya gave Vast Sea Daoist Lord a look: "I'm not as capable as you are. I was just a person at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. Before I went into slumber, I told my descendants to either wake me up if the Long Clan faced a crisis or when you resurfaced."
Ao Ya, smiling radiantly, took Vast Sea Daoist Lord's hand and pulled him toward the adjacent room without any explanation: "Conveniently, I've just awakened a few days ago and haven't restored my strength to its former level. It's a perfect time for Intercourse Cultivation with me. It's also a good opportunity to discuss why you ran away back then!"
Vast Sea Daoist Lord's face turned pale in an instant. He came to the East Sea to protect Lu Yang but somehow, his chastity was jeopardized first?
The Transcendance Tribulation Stage was challenging a Semi-Immortal once again.

chapters.title: Chapter 789 - 788: Great Victory at Transcendance Tribulation Stage
chapters.content:
Vast Sea Daoist Lord looked helplessly at everyone, hoping for assistance.
Being a Semi-Immortal was merely having one more Dao Fruit Outline than those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, with no increase to physical constitution; after fifty thousand years, facing Ao Ya again, he was afraid he would end up with the same fate as fifty thousand years ago.
Unfortunately, in this situation, even Li Haoran, the cultivator with the best cultivation level in the room, was unable to help, to say nothing of the others.
Although Meng Jingzhou's blood possessed Yang Invigorating effects, his limited cultivation meant his blood was only effective for cultivators at the Divine Transformation Stage and was of no use on this occasion.
Everyone bid farewell to Vast Sea Daoist Lord with eager eyes.
Once Ao Ya took Vast Sea Daoist Lord into an adjacent secret chamber, the atmosphere at the scene returned to normal.
The Old Dragon Emperor cleared his throat and his old face reddened; in terms of cultivation level, Ao Ya was inferior to him, but after all, she was an ancient ancestor from fifty thousand years ago with a status that made it inappropriate to say anything.
But taking an old flame straight to the room upon reunion seemed overeager.
However, such thoughts could only be muttered inwardly.
The Old Dragon Emperor could understand the urgency of ancestor Ao Ya, considering that as a member of the Dragon Clan, he also shared the innate lustful trait.
It's just that he was too old now to act on it.
"Vast Sea senior and ancestor Ao Ya are reminiscing about the glorious old days; there's still some time before the royal banquet begins. Why not go to the main hall and catch up with old friends?"
Everyone readily agreed.
The main hall of the Dragon Palace was a huge palace built from colorful corals, with mother-of-pearl reflecting the bright moonlight, creating bright, glowing walls, while seaweed swayed gently like emerald curtains.
Members of the Sea Clan attending the banquet had transformed into human forms for convenience; otherwise, their true forms were too varied and different in size, some tens of feet long, some thousands, making it impossible to sit together.
By this time, half the invited cultivators had already arrived, and when Meng Jingzhou entered the main hall, he even saw the Second Prince, who was in high spirits.
It was said that the Second Prince's search for life-extending treasures was not going well.
It occurred to Meng Jingzhou that it wasn't necessary to use longevity items to extend Emperor Xia's life, as using an Immortal Herb like the Feathery Immortal Grass that forcibly elevated one's realm could also extend one's life.
With a higher realm, longevity wouldn't be a problem.
However, he wasn't prepared to tell this to the Second Prince, who was deliberately trying to ingratiate himself; Meng Jingzhou didn't like this Second Prince very much.
When the Second Prince saw Meng Jingzhou, his eyes lit up and he came forward to greet him, "Meng Jingzhou, you really came."
Ever since Lu Yang and his companions were abducted by a mysterious cultivator at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, he had fallen into a state of anxious unease. Fortunately, later on, he heard that Lu Yang and the others were now in the Dragon Palace's Sea City, currently residing with the Kunpeng Clan, and only then did he breathe a sigh of relief.
If something had happened to Lu Yang and his companions on his ship, whether he could have returned to Great Xia alive was questionable.
With the resources of the Seek Dao Sect and Meng Family, if they really sought revenge, the ten cultivators at the Body Integration Realm and one at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage aboard those three ships wouldn't stand a chance.
"I deeply regret Lu Yang's disappearance and have sent people to inquire about his whereabouts to no avail," the Second Prince sighed, shaking his head in genuine regret. If he could find Lu Yang, he would be indebted to him, and Lu Yang would likely support him in the fight for the throne later on.
"It's fine; Old Lu has a huge life, nothing will happen to him," Meng Jingzhou said carelessly.
If there was anyone among the present company who was least worried about Lu Yang's safety, it would undoubtedly be Meng Jingzhou.
If the Old Dragon Emperor could encounter trouble, Old Lu certainly would not.
"Vast Sea senior didn't come?" the Second Prince continued, wishing to meet this legendary ancestor of resurgence.
"The grandmaster is discussing the Dao with friends of the Dragon Clan."
"I see."
Meng Jingzhou and the people from the Kunpeng Clan were seated together, munching on the fruits and melons on the table every now and then.
The Dragon Palace began to stir slightly, mainly because the cultivators from the human race were reacting quite strongly. The Blackfeather Venerable turned to look and let out a soft "huh."
"I didn't expect the Three Mountains Taoist and his two companions to arrive so early. They're really showing great respect to the Old Dragon Emperor," he said.
The Three Mountains Taoist, Mr. Tinghai, and the Six Harmonies Venerable were pillars of the East Sea cultivators, with immense influence. In particular, the Three Mountains Taoist was venerated by human cultivators, many of whom had bowed down to his statues praying for a smooth cultivation journey.
Man Gu noticed that the Three Mountains Taoist was carrying a small wooden box and suddenly remembered that they seemed to have come empty-handed.
"Should we also prepare some gifts?" he wondered.
Man Gu felt a bit embarrassed that they came to the East Sea and freeloaded without offering anything in return.
Meng Jingzhou waved his hand dismissively, "The Old Dragon Emperor is an elder. It should be the cultivators of the Void Refinement and Body Integration realms who prepare gifts. We, the juniors, just need to take care of eating and drinking."
Reassured, Man Gu buried his head back into eating the fruits.
"Blackfeather." A majestic-looking member of the Sea Clan approached to greet him, his specific race indiscernible.
The Blackfeather Venerable also smiled as he saw the visitor, "Xuanshui, it's been ten years since we last met. I heard you were bedridden not long ago, but now you're as lively as ever?"
"Don't even mention it. If I hadn't made up an excuse, those descendants of mine would still want me to be the clan leader, which is really annoying. I told them I'm old and frail, bedridden, and that it's time for a new clan leader."
"I've always told you that being a clan leader is no easy job. Look at me, I've been retired for a long time," said the Blackfeather Venerable smugly, taking pride in his foresight.
Seeing the two exchanging pleasantries, Meng Jingzhou quietly asked Xiao Xinghai who that person was.
"That's Xuanshui Venerable from the Black Tortoise Clan who's at the transcendence tribulation stage. He and Old Blackfeather have known each other since they were young. The two have a very close relationship and often act together. Because both of them have black bodies, they're known as the 'Two Blacks of the East Sea.'"
"The Two Blacks of the East Sea?"
"You know, our clan is known for its speed, while the Black Tortoise Clan is known for its defense. When the two elders were younger, they couldn't sit still and were always causing trouble. If they encountered someone they couldn't provoke, Old Blackfeather would just grab Xuanshui Venerable and run."
"If the pursuer was relentless and chased after them, the elder would use Xuanshui Venerable's tortoise shell to block the attacks and use the force of the attacks to speed up their escape. This move was invincible, and no one could do anything about them."
"Now that they've both reached the transcendence tribulation stage, they rarely act together."
"Did they get more sedate with age?"
"It's more that Old Blackfeather's speed has reached the pinnacle; no one can catch up with him anymore, so he no longer needs Xuanshui Venerable's protection."
Besides Xuanshui Venerable, the other seven great transcendence tribulation stage members of the Sea Clans took their seats. Some of them were exceptionally handsome, others looked ordinary, but they all shared one trait: their eyes were restrained, displaying an extraordinary presence.
In contrast, both the Blackfeather Venerable and Xuanshui Venerable's eyes were roving, giving off an unserious vibe.
The seven Sea Clan transcendence tribulation stage members kept their distance from Blackfeather Venerable and Xuanshui Venerable, afraid that the two might reveal their shameful past.
As time passed and the time for the birthday banquet drew closer, all the invited guests had arrived. Ao Ya and the Vast Sea Daoist Lord left the secret chamber to go to the birthday banquet.
Ao Ya looked radiant and spirited, having recovered her former strength.
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord looked deathly pale, his calves trembling.
"Esteemed ancestor, are you all right?" Meng Jingzhou asked with concern.
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord clenched his teeth and forced a smile, "No major issue, just need a moment to recover."
"I envy you for having a Single Body Spiritual Root; you don't have to suffer like me."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."

chapters.title: Chapter 790 - 789: Delivering a Big Gift
chapters.content:
Although the Embryonic Spatial Dao Fruit that the Vast Sea Daoist Lord possessed wasn't the weakest among the Semi-Immortals, Meng Jingzhou felt that once he himself reached the level of a Semi-Immortal, he might well be capable of battling the Vast Sea Daoist Lord!
Particularly when he saw Ao Ya and the Vast Sea Daoist Lord exchanging flirtatious glances, the Daoist Lord was clearly enjoying it.
Meng Jingzhou then knew that when the Vast Sea Daoist Lord had been dragged into the secret chamber to be squeezed dry, it was of his own volition; otherwise, he would have long since used his Embryonic Spatial Dao Fruit to escape!
Envious of the Single Body Spiritual Root, huh? Wait until I cultivate to the Semi-Immortal level, then I'll let you experience the Single Curse Fist of a Semi-Immortal!
Finally, the Old Dragon Emperor made his entrance.
With the appearance of the birthday-elder Old Dragon Emperor, everyone in the venue rose in unison, offering congratulations on his longevity. Their voices thundered, resembling the roar of waves crashing against mountains.
All the high-ranking cultivators from the East Sea gathered here to jointly congratulate him, and only the Old Dragon Emperor in the East Sea could enjoy such a treatment.
The only exceptions were Ao Ya and the Vast Sea Daoist Lord; they ranked higher than the Old Dragon Emperor and needed no such display of respect.
"Alright, alright, there's no need to be so reverential towards this old man," the Old Dragon Emperor, sitting on the Palace Master's seat, said with a charitable smile on his face. He signaled everyone to be at ease, asserting that the most crucial part of celebrating longevity was to relax.
The clam ladies and Fishman tribe danced gracefully in the center of the main hall, their dance movements were so enchantingly beautiful that they captivated the audience.
Dancing was also a method of cultivation, and there weren't a few cultivators who used dance to pursue the Dao; it's just that very few cultivators chose this path for cultivation.
Up to now, the one who had achieved the highest mastery through dance was Zhu Tian.
Ever since Zhu Tian came into the world and established the Demon Nation, more cultivators started to take the path of using dance to pursue the Dao.
...
"Can't find any other way to leave this damned pearl, maybe it's still best just to smash it," Fairy Eternity said with a smug laugh, sure that in the end, her initially proposed method was the solution.
Lu Yang, having no other alternative, agreed to Fairy Eternity's method.
...
The birthday banquet proceeded in an orderly fashion. There was the dance in the water, the conch clan played immortal music, and Water Clan scholars recited poetry and composed verses praising the authority and grace of the Old Dragon Emperor.
The Dragon Clan Elders transformed into their true forms, revealed their magical skills, or put on a play about the great deeds the Old Dragon Emperor had done in his youth.
Seeing this, the Old Dragon Emperor raised his cup high and laughed heartily, as if he had become two thousand years younger.
The Black Feather Venerable felt very uncomfortable below, as behind those great deeds there lay untold stories unknown to most. He was very tempted to reveal them, but considering this was a birthday feast, it wouldn't be good if the play depicted the old birthday star whacking people with his cane.
The Xuan Water Venerable also felt extremely uncomfortable.
The play came to a close and next was the presentation of birthday gifts.
In his youth, the Old Dragon Emperor was a playboy, unrestrained and promiscuous, with no fewer than thirty children.
It is well known that the higher the cultivation level of a cultivator, the more difficult it is for them to have offspring, and the Dragon Clan was no exception.
Take Ao Ya as an example, when she was inseparable from the Vast Sea Daoist Lord, spending an entire month without leaving the chamber, yet Ao Ya did not conceive.
"Father Emperor, this is a Nine-Turn Spirit Elixir that I asked the Great Xia Pill Refining Grandmaster to refine. It can regulate the body and nourish both body and spirit," said the Crown Prince of the Dragon Palace, opening a box containing a spirit elixir with nine elixir patterns. As soon as the box was opened, a rich fragrance wafted out, truly a marvelous elixir.
"Father Emperor, this is an Everlasting Colorful Evergreen Flower I collected from the depths of the Nether Abyss seabed," said the Second Prince of the Dragon Palace, presenting his gift. The Everlasting Colorful Evergreen Flower, which never withers, symbolizes longevity and is very suitable as a gift.
However, this flower grows in the Nether Abyss, a place teeming with Body Integration Realm Demon Beasts, full of danger. Being able to pick such a flower is enough to show the filial piety of the Second Prince of the Dragon Palace.
More than thirty princes and princesses successively presented their gifts, some focusing on effects, others on sentiment. The common point was that all these items were extremely difficult to obtain, and each new item brought forth exclamations from the crowd. It was no wonder the affluent Dragon Palace could afford to give such valuable gifts.
The majority of their gifts of the Body Integration Realm couldn't compare to these.
"The Everlasting Colorful Evergreen Flower is quite pretty," muttered the Vast Sea Daoist Lord, as he chewed on the Nine-Turn Spirit Elixir to restore his Yang Qi.
Meng Jingzhou looked at the Vast Sea Daoist Lord with a bizarre expression. How come you always carry that thing around, Venerable Ancestor?
Vast Sea Daoist Lord seethed silently, transmitting his explanation: "This was just taken from our sect by using the embryonic Spatial Dao Fruit!"
Meng Jingzhou gave an 'oh' in response.
Suddenly, he saw Vast Sea Daoist Lord reach under the table, secretly using the embryonic Spatial Dao Fruit to open a small spatial gate that led directly to the Nether Abyss, and he harvested a five-colored everlasting flower.
"I will give this to little Ya after the birthday celebration is over," Vast Sea Daoist Lord said, brimming with joy.
After the princes, princesses, Dragon Clan elders, and those in the Body Integration Realm had presented their gifts, it was the turn of those in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage to express their regards.
Among all the gifts presented before, the one that Old Dragon Emperor liked the most was the Ancestral Dragon Herb given by Ao Ran. He immediately called for Ao Ran to bring the Ancestral Dragon Herb forward, wanting to take a good look at it.
The Old Dragon Emperor held immense reverence for the Dragon Clan Ancestor, the mighty Ao Ling Ancient Ancestor, known as one of the strongest Semi-Immortals. He similarly cherished everything related to Ao Ling.
He carefully examined the Ancestral Dragon Herb, shaped like a dragon's claw, as if envisioning a scene from Ancient Times where the Dragon Clan Ancestor was carefully nurturing the Ancestral Dragon Herb, watching it grow strong and vigorous.
"Dragon Emperor Elder, I have an item here that also relates to the Dragon Clan Ancestor," said Three Mountains Taoist, holding up a wooden box with both hands as a sign of respect to the Old Dragon Emperor.
Although Vast Sea Daoist Lord's arrival had put him on edge for a moment, the thought of the Great Void Immortal Grass being effective even for a Semi-Immortal had calmed him down.
"Oh, it's also related to the Dragon Clan Ancestor? What is inside the box?" Old Dragon Emperor's interest was piqued. Despite regular conflicts between the Sea Clan and the Human race in the East Sea, he still held admiration for Three Mountains Taoist, the Human race leader.
The Dragon Clan Ancestor was a legendary figure in the East Sea, his influence not at all inferior to Jiang Lianyi's influence in the Demon Territory.
All eyes turned towards Three Mountains Taoist, eager to know what was inside the box.
Master Hearsea and the Sovereign of the Six Harmonies, lacking in experience, started sweating coldly at the thought of what was about to happen.
With a slight smile and a calm demeanor, Three Mountains Taoist spoke unhurriedly, "The most important part of a gift is the surprise. Why not have Dragon Emperor Elder open it himself to see?"
"That sounds good."
Standing nearby, Ao Gu'er took the wooden box and handed it to the Old Dragon Emperor.
Seeing this, Three Mountains Taoist knew his plan was mostly successful.
In fact, there was nothing related to the Dragon Clan Ancestor inside the box; it was simply an excuse to get the Old Dragon Emperor to open the box himself and get close to the poison of the Great Void Immortal Grass.
Impatient, the Old Dragon Emperor opened the wooden box.
A 'bang' was heard, as if something had shattered, and thick smoke billowed out from the box, obscuring the view.
Two figures suddenly appeared. When Old Dragon Emperor saw one of the figures clearly, he was dumbstruck, too excited to speak for a long while. Clutching his chest, his eyes rolled back, and he nearly passed out.
Three Mountains Taoist circulated his cultivation technique to resist the poison of the Great Void Immortal Grass. He hadn't expected the poison of the Great Void Immortal Grass to be so potent that it could even block Spiritual Sense and sight.
A cold smile crept across his lips as he casually approached; "Dragon Emperor Elder, do you like the grand gift I have brought you?"
"I-I like it."
"Do you currently feel your mind is blurred, your soul unstable, as if experiencing illusions?"
"Yes."
As Three Mountains Taoist moved closer, a look of triumph on his face, he froze upon reaching the Old Dragon Emperor and seeing the two figures in the smoke.
As the smoke dispersed, the figures of Ao Ling and Lu Yang were revealed.
Three Mountains Taoist stood rooted to the spot, his gaze empty and fixed.
How is the Dragon Clan Ancestor here?
Have I been poisoned too?

chapters.title: Chapter 791 - 790 Ao Ling Appears
chapters.content:
"Dragon Clan Ancestor?!"
Those attending the birthday banquet, upon seeing the strikingly beautiful woman in the black dress standing quietly in front of the Old Dragon Emperor, all sharply rose to their feet in unison, their eyeballs bulging round with utter disbelief on their faces.
Several distinguished personages of the Sea Clan were too astonished to maintain their human form and, with a loud 'bang,' reverted to their original shapes, exceedingly massive in size, instantly plunging the Dragon Palace into chaos.
Ao Ling's reputation in the East Sea was far-reaching, and her portraits were equally widespread. Those who qualified to attend the banquet were undoubtedly prominent figures in the East Sea, and they had all seen images of Ao Ling.
Those Sea Clan members with profound backgrounds, those whose ancestors had been Semi-Immortals, even had records of their ancient ancestors being defeated by Ao Ling.
The Phoenix Ancestor had also declared at the founding ceremony of the Demon Nation that she and the Dragon Clan Ancestor were both wives of the Qilin Immortal.
Layer upon layer of identity was added up, leaving no room for people to not be shocked.
"Good heavens, she looks exactly like the one in the ancient paintings, it really is the Dragon Clan Ancestor."
"How could the Dragon Clan Ancestor appear here?!"
"Is this the object related to the Dragon Clan Ancestor that the Three Mountains Taoist spoke of?!"
"This is more than just 'related'!"
"Worthy of being our East Sea Human race leader, he actually found the Dragon Clan Ancestor who had disappeared for three hundred thousand years!"
"The cultivators of ancient times are appearing one after another. The Great Era has arrived indeed."
Mr. Listen-to-the-Sea and the Six Harmonies Grandmaster, upon hearing these exclamations and praises, showed a glimmer of confusion in their eyes, slapped themselves, and then turned their heads to see that the Dragon Clan Ancestor was still standing there.
Was the hallucinogenic effect of the Great Void Immortal Grass really this powerful? Had they been affected even though they were operating their cultivation techniques?
Before opening the wooden box, the Old Dragon Emperor had exhausted his imagination, pondering what belongings of the ancient ancestor could possibly be inside such a small box.
He never imagined that the box contained the ancient ancestor herself.
"Where have we ended up?" Not only were the attendees stunned, even Lu Yang, one of the parties involved, was bewildered.
Why were there so many people here, and who was this excited old Dragon Clan man nearly passing out in front of him?
Wait, could this be the Old Dragon Emperor's birthday banquet?
The timing seems to fit.
"Eh, why is there a withered stalk of Great Void Immortal Grass here?" the voice of Fairy Eternity echoed in the Spiritual Space.
"What is Great Void Immortal Grass?"
"A herb used to forge the mind through illusionary realms; its effects aren't particularly strong. When I plate food for cooking, this thing is just about good enough to serve as a garnish."
Fairy Eternity was meticulous about culinary presentation, balancing color, aroma, and taste.
Lu Yang, hearing Fairy Eternity speak so casually, took it that the herb was merely a famous yet ineffective Immortal Grass.
Pfft—
Old Ma, representing the Dragon horse clan, spat out his Spirit Wine, looking at Lu Yang as if he had seen a ghost.
What on earth happened during the time I was away?
You only left the Dragon horse clan a month ago; how did you, Lu Yang, end up standing alongside the Dragon Clan Ancestor?
Ao Ling, having experienced much of the world, reacted quickly. She bowed to Lu Yang and said, "I thank the young daoist for awakening me from my slumber. May I ask if you would be willing to join my Heavenly Court?"
Lu Yang returned the bow with full courtesy but with a firm attitude, "I deeply appreciate the kind offer of Ao Ling, senior. However, as a disciple of the Seek Dao Sect, I cannot possibly join any other power!"
"That's quite a pity."
The content of their casual conversation led the crowd's thoughts to wander.
"So it turns out that the Dragon Clan Ancestor, like the Phoenix Ancestor, is also of the Heavenly Court."
"With the Dragon and Phoenix Ancestors both in the Heavenly Court, and hearing that both have the potential to become immortals, it's a wonder they haven't ascended. Just how powerful is the Heavenly Court?"
"The Dragon Clan Ancestor had been in slumber all along; was it Lu Yang who awoke her?"
If Vast Sea Daoist Lord was shocked to see Ao Ling, then seeing Lu Yang stand beside her was sheer horror.
He employed the Embryonic Spatial Dao Fruit, grabbed Lu Yang by the scruff of his neck, and instantly pulled him to his side.
"What's going on with you, lad?"
Lu Yang offered an innocent explanation, "I had no idea. The Dragon Ball drew me in, and I saw the Dragon Clan Ancestor lying inside, so I woke her up."
Vast Sea Daoist Lord poked Lu Yang's forehead, "You really are bold, kid. Luckily, the Dragon Clan Ancestor wasn't grumpy upon waking, otherwise a mere sneeze from her could have killed you!"
"I won't dare to do it again, I won't dare to next time," Lu Yang said with a conciliatory smile.
"Long Clan's Ao Cang pays respects to the Ancient Ancestor!" The Old Dragon Emperor stood up shakily and kowtowed to Ao Ling.
Ao Ya also prostrated himself in homage.
There was another member of the Long Clan in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, named Ao Xiu, at the mid-stage of cultivation level. He was the deputy palace master of the Dragon Palace and it was he who led Ao Li and others to the Demon Nation's founding ceremony.
He hadn't expected to see the Phoenix Ancestor at the founding ceremony of the Demon Nation, and half a year later, to encounter his own clan's ancient ancestor at the palace master's longevity feast.
"Long Clan's Ao Xiu pays respects to the Ancient Ancestor!"
Ao Ling noticed that among the Long Clan there were only three in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, her eyebrows slightly knitted, "Does the Long Clan not even have a single Semi-Immortal nowadays?"
The Old Dragon Emperor, ashamed and at a loss for words, did not know how to answer.
Shaping the outline of a Dao Fruit was not so easily accomplished.
Whether it were the Sea Clan or the human race, at this moment their wills unified, and all respectfully paid homage in one voice.
"We pay respects to Elder Ao Ling!"
All beings prostrated themselves, their cries rumbling like mountains and seas.
The Three Mountains Taoist remained composed and calm. He knelt on the ground and along with everyone else, also called out in respect to Elder Ao Ling.
Suddenly, a pair of delicate shoes appeared in his line of sight.
He looked up to see that Ao Ling was standing in front of him at some unknown time.
Ao Ling stared at the Three Mountains Taoist, her eyes slightly squinting, her pupils suddenly turning into vertical golden dragon eyes revealing a highly dangerous smile.
"If what I saw just now is correct, at the moment of my arrival, you were on the verge of astral projection, attempting to possess this member of my clan?"
The Three Mountains Taoist's art of possession was secretive, and he had immediately stopped as soon as he saw Ao Ling, confident that no one had noticed.
However, he may have fooled others, but there was no fooling Ao Ling, who had experienced extensive battle and had extraordinary insight during the Ancient Times.
The Ancient Times were much more chaotic than today, and acts of possession occurred frequently.
"What?!"
With Ao Ling's words, a wave of shock rippled through the crowd. They looked at Ao Ling and the Three Mountains Taoist incredulously. Those whose minds were a bit slower hadn't even grasped the situation.
The Three Mountains Taoist looked bewildered, not understanding what Ao Ling was talking about.
"Elder Ao Ling, is there perhaps some misunderstanding you have with me?"
Ao Ling scoffed coldly, seeing through the Three Mountains Taoist's situation in a glance, "Misunderstanding? Then perhaps you'd like to explain, how this outline of a Dao Fruit formed through the power of faith came to be within you?"
Hearing that the Three Mountains Taoist possessed an outline of a Dao Fruit, both the Sea Clan and human race showed surprised expressions.
"The Dragon Clan Ancestor just said what? The Three Mountains Taoist has an outline of a Dao Fruit, doesn't that mean he has become a Semi-Immortal!"
"He would be the first Semi-Immortal in the East Sea in a hundred thousand years."
Only to hear Ao Ling continue, "I don't know where you learned such a half-baked method of using the power of faith to form the outline of a Dao Fruit, blindly letting the power of faith enter your body without discerning."
"I imagine most of the time, you can't even control your own body."
"Under such circumstances, if you didn't opt for possession, I am quite curious what other methods you could have for saving yourself?"
Ao Ling was originally not very familiar with the power of faith, but the foundation of the Fire Dynasty was faith. After spending twenty thousand years in the Fire Dynasty, she had become well-versed in the use of the power of faith.
"I didn't expect the Dragon Clan Ancestor to be so knowledgeable about the power of faith," the Three Mountains Taoist said with a vicious look in his eyes and a face so dark it could drip water. He listened as Ao Ling analysed his situation word by word. Knowing he couldn't bluff his way through, he stopped pretending.
"I originally planned to secretly possess the Old Dragon Emperor and thereby control the entire East Sea, but since you're not giving me this opportunity, don't blame me for using force!"
He didn't want his intention to possess the Old Dragon Emperor to be known, for fear that it would cause complications.
But that didn't mean he couldn't fight!
Sitting obediently by the Vast Sea Daoist Lord's side, Lu Yang thought to himself that if he was as strong as the Three Mountains Taoist, he wondered if bowing to him would make him vomit blood.

chapters.title: Chapter 792 - 791: Nascent Soul Stage Old Monster Defies the Semi-Immortal
chapters.content:
"Ancestor, please help," Lu Yang quietly transmitted his voice to Vast Sea Daoist Lord.
Everyone's attention was focused on Ao Ling and the Three Mountains Taoist, and no one noticed this Nascent Soul old freak.
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord had learned about the matters of the Heavenly Court from Yun Zhi.
"Since I've promised to protect you once, you may act as you please, with my support as a safety net," he said.
Lu Yang asked the Vast Sea Daoist Lord to open a teleportation portal and secretly transport him away. At the destination, he cast the Tree Planting Spell to create a clone, which he masked to prepare for his entrance as Young Master Lu.
This mask was given to Lu Yang by a Transcendance Tribulation Stage member of the Di Jiang Clan when he was first impersonating Young Master Lu. Without the insight of a Semi-Immortal who had cultivated a Dao Fruit Outline, no one could see through the true identity beneath the mask.
...
A vague and misty voice spread throughout the Dragon Palace.
"Oh, a mere Semi-Immortal dares to challenge the Four Imperial Protectors of the Heavenly Court? Do you truly believe the Heavenly Court is so easily provoked?"
With the help of the Vast Sea Daoist Lord, Lu Yang's voice echoed through the Dragon Palace after being transmitted through space several times.
This was a Semi-Immortal's technique, and the voice was processed so that no one could detect its source.
"Heavenly Court!"
"It's someone from the Heavenly Court!"
The Human race and the Sea Clan were greatly alarmed and agitated. To think that as soon as Ao Ling awakened, someone from the Heavenly Court had arrived; their response time was incredible, suggesting they had left some sort of contingency on Ao Ling which alerted them the moment he awoke.
Along with the opening of a spatial fissure, a figure emerged from the other side.
It was the long-absent Young Sect Master Lu.
Young Sect Master Lu wore a sword at his waist and a smile as refreshing as the spring breeze, his charm undiminished. He bowed to someone behind the gateway, "Thank you for your help, Uncle. This is as far as you need to bring me."
Afterward, the gateway closed, and they sent out no more Protectors, as if they were unconcerned about the safety of this Young Sect Master... or perhaps, they had absolute confidence in him.
"The Island Master of Penglai, Three Mountains Taoist?" Young Sect Master Lu's lips curled into a cold smile.
His eyes narrowed slightly, "It's merely a Dao Fruit Outline formed from the force of faith, and you have the audacity to make such noise here. To deal with an insect like you, there's hardly a need for Junior Sister to act; I can do it for her."
As he spoke, he glanced meaningfully at a certain point in space.
The face of the Three Mountains Taoist darkened. As legend had it, the Heavenly Court was guarded by Heavenly Venerate Dou and Sect Leader Yun, two Immortals far beyond his ability to contend with.
But he, a dignified Semi-Immortal, even if the other was Young Sect Master Lu, just in the Nascent Soul Stage, dared to audaciously claim he could take him on.
The Three Mountains Taoist laughed with rage, "If that's the case, then I must truly learn of the methods of the Ancient Heavenly Court..."
Before the Three Mountains Taoist could finish speaking, Young Sect Master Lu brought his palms together, bowed deeply to the Three Mountains Taoist with sincere respect, immediately causing the Taoist's face to turn deathly white, blood churning up to his throat.
"Ah—"
The Three Mountains Taoist spat out a mouthful of blood, staining the nearby sea red.
He staggered back two steps, looking at Lu Yang not with contempt or anger but fear.
A Nascent Soul's bow, and a Semi-Immortal spits blood!
The crowd was shocked at the sight, their understanding of cultivation theory completely overturned, "What kind of technique is this!"
Even the Vast Sea Daoist Lord showed a strange expression. What sort of technique is this, that a bow could cause someone to spit blood.
"How is this possible, a Nascent Soul Stage able to make a Semi-Immortal spit blood, how did he achieve it?"
"The fact is right before you, do you still doubt?"
"Perhaps there is another expert from the Ancient Heavenly Court present."
"No, it must be for some other reason. It seems I've read about this somewhere..."
"I remember now. I've seen in the ancient texts from the Great Qian era, Cultivators who practice the power of faith are most afraid of encountering opponents with a higher destiny than themselves."
The man excitedly talked to himself, his words coming out at a rapid pace, "That's right, the Heavenly Court ruled in ancient times, and Young Sect Master Lu is the future owner of the Heavenly Court. Moreover, he is an Immortal's disciple; naturally, his destiny far surpasses that of the Three Mountains Taoist!"
"What a terrifying Young Sect Master Lu!"
"No, what's truly terrifying is the Heavenly Court!"
People were discussing quietly among themselves, becoming more alarmed as they gradually approached the truth.
Ao Ling bowed respectfully to Young Sect Master Lu, "Senior Brother Lu, there is no need for you to take action. This person can be dealt with by your Junior Sister as well."
Young Sect Master Lu returned the bow with a smile as warm as a spring breeze on his face, a smile that came from the heart, "Junior Sister Xiao Ling, we haven't seen each other for three hundred thousand years. Is everything well with you?"
"Thank you for your concern, Senior Brother Lu. All is well with me. I just never expected that after sleeping for so long, the world would no longer remember the Heavenly Court and the Underworld."
"The Underworld? What place is that?" The crowd paid attention to another term in Ao Ling's speech.
"I have not heard of it."
"The long river of time is vast and can erase the memories of all living beings. When I first awoke, I didn't expect that even the once eternal rule of the Heavenly Court would be unrecognized."
Young Sect Master Lu appeared rather reflective, shaking his head in mild amusement, "I was alerted by the imprint left by my Master, and I thought something had gone wrong. I didn't expect that you had actually awakened. I was planning to wake you up myself in ten more years, but unexpectedly, Lu Yang awakened you first."
"Well, it's ultimately an internal matter of your Dragon Clan. It's not appropriate for me to intervene."
"Speaking of which, this Lu Yang and I have quite a connection. I had a magical duel with him once, and it ended in a draw."
"A draw?" Ao Ling was profoundly shocked, "Senior Brother, even our Master and Sect Leader praise your talent nonstop, saying you could stand shoulder to shoulder with both of them in the future. Is this Lu Yang really that strong?"
"Young Sect Master Lu is the Senior Brother to the Dragon Clan Ancestor?"
The crowd remembered that Jiang Lianyi had once addressed Young Sect Master Lu as "Senior Brother."
It was unexpected that this Young Sect Master Lu was actually the Senior Brother to the ancestors of both the Dragon and Phoenix.
Just by that alone, he could probably do as he pleased in the Ancient Times!
Young Sect Master Lu saw that the Three Mountains Taoist was staring at him intently, his muscles taut, extremely tense, as though he was about to run away at the first sign of trouble.
He chuckled lightly, "Relax, the matter between you and Junior Sister Xiao Ling has nothing to do with the Heavenly Court. If I were to intervene now, I'm afraid Junior Sister Xiao Ling would get angry with me."
"I came here only to ensure Junior Sister Xiao Ling's safety. Now that I see she is unharmed, I can rest assured."
"Whether you defeat Junior Sister Xiao Ling or she defeats you, the Heavenly Court will not interfere."
"My promise can represent the will of the Heavenly Court."
With that said, Young Sect Master Lu stepped aside.
Just when everyone thought Young Sect Master Lu was moving aside to watch the fight, they didn't expect him to approach Lu Yang.
"Acting Sect Master Lu, it's been a long time since we've seen each other. Seeing that your Cultivation Level has improved, how about we have a match?"
Lu Yang was stunned, comfortably seated and not wanting to draw attention to himself, yet the other party approached him.
He was not looking for trouble, but he wasn't afraid of it either, so he turned his head to seek the opinion of the Vast Sea Daoist Lord with a glance.
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord huffed and glared, almost slamming the table, "Do you need to ask me? Of course, show him the strength of our Seek Dao Sect's geniuses!"
With the Vast Sea Daoist Lord's approval, Lu Yang was relieved and felt confident to go ahead boldly.
Meng Jingzhou watched coldly as the two played their three-character act, regretting not having thought of doing the same himself!

chapters.title: Chapter 793 - 793: 792
chapters.content:
Ancient young prodigy and modern young prodigy faced each other, both filled with fighting spirit, ready for battle.
"The natural talent of Sect Master Lu is the highest I have ever seen. Even though Seek Dao Sect has Vast Sea Daoist Lord, a Semi-Immortal, the pond is still too small to nurture a True Dragon."
"Our Heavenly Court welcomes the wise and virtuous. Should you be interested, you might consider joining us. There will certainly be a place for a Saint Heir for you."
"Oh? Aren't you afraid that I'll take the place of your Young Sect Master?"
Young Master Lu laughed heartily, "The strong are revered; this is an unchanging truth through the ages. If you can defeat me and lead the Heavenly Court to its former glory in the Great Era, why not give you the position of Young Sect Master?"
People secretly admired him in their hearts, not in vain was he the one sitting in the position of Young Sect Master; his magnanimity far surpassed that of his peers.
Lu Yang simply shook his head, "I appreciate Young Master Lu's kind intentions, but Seek Dao Sect has granted me great kindness and nurturing. If I were to abandon it and disregard everything, I would be no better than a scoundrel."
"That's a shame," Young Master Lu genuinely invited Lu Yang to join the Heavenly Court. With Lu Yang joining, he felt confident that it would significantly increase their chances of winning in the future Great Era's conflicts.
Unfortunately, it meant they could only battle.
Even Young Master Lu, with his unparalleled talent, did not dare to hold back against Lu Yang. Seven long swords floated vertically around him, protected by the words "Tian Shu," "Tian Xuan," "Tian Ji," etc., engraved on the hilt, indicating the origin of these seven swords.
"That's the legendary Seven-star Sword Set!" The Clan Leader of the Ao Clan recognized the origin of these seven swords and exclaimed in shock.
"What is the Seven-star Sword Set?" Most people had never heard of the Seven-star Sword Set.
The Ao Clan Leader spoke solemnly, "In Ancient Times, there was a Sword Cultivator named Liu Ningxuan, peerless in both the zither and sword, and was the most powerful Sword Cultivator of that era. His talent was comparable with the Venerate of the Great Xia's Sword Tower."
"Our clan had an ancestor who cultivated to the peak of Transcendance Tribulation, and yet, he was slain by a single sword strike from Liu Ningxuan!"
Everyone gasped. The Ao Clan was known for its defensive strength. Someone at the peak of Transcendance Tribulation certainly had an unquestionably powerful defense. Yet, he was slain by Liu Ningxuan?
"Liu Ningxuan was an expert in the Unification with the sword; when united with the sword, it reached an ultimate height. With one strike, all below an Immortal were doomed to certain death!"
"Everyone thought he would cultivate to become a Semi-Immortal or even an Immortal. Sadly, after a battle, he disappeared and was never seen again. Some say he was trapped in the Immortal Realm and unable to leave, others say he died."
"The Seven-star Sword Set were Liu Ningxuan's swords!"
Lu Yang did not expect the Seven-star Sword Set to have such an origin.
He knew of Liu Ningxuan, the unparalleled expert in both the zither and sword, the one famed for his exceptional unity with the sword.
"Fairy, did you know about this?"
This caught Fairy Eternity off guard. She pondered seriously, then shook her head, "I don't quite remember, that lad was fighting with a lot of flashy swords when he battled me, but I didn't pay much attention to what the swords looked like. They all looked more or less the same, anyway."
Young Master Lu grinned, holding Tian Shu Sword, "Speaking of which, our last fight was when we were at the Mid-stage Golden Core. Unexpectedly, more than a year has passed, and both of us have advanced to the Mid-stage Nascent Soul."
Lu Yang remained silent, quietly drawing the Green Peak Sword.
Whoosh—
The sword light soared to the sky, cutting through the water, turning the area into a vacuum.
Two types of True Fire revived on the Green Peak Sword, transforming into golden divine birds with Sword Qi. The golden birds flapped their crimson wings, completely unaffected by the waters of the East Sea!
The Tian Shu Sword's Qi was magnificent and proud, coming from Ancient Times, even purer and sharper. The other six Flying Swords looked like six Flood Dragons breaking free from their cages, each splitting the golden divine birds in two.
After the golden divine birds were split, they turned into two smaller golden divine birds, their intense heat undiminished!
"What kind of True Fire is this?"
Even with the wide experience of the cultivators from the East Sea, they had never seen this form of True Fire.
"It looks like the True Flame of the Golden Crow, but the problem is, I've never heard of any Golden Crow with just two legs?"
Even children who had not yet begun their cultivation had heard of the three-legged Golden Crow.
The two fought from the water to the sky, from the sky to the island, clashing for hundreds of rounds. Everywhere they went was left in ruins, and their display of combat strength shocked everyone present.
Is this the level one can achieve at the Mid-stage Nascent Soul?
These significant figures of the East Sea had been prodigies in their youth, with cultivation levels and battle might far surpassing their peers, yet none could match the prowess of Lu Yang and Young Master Lu.
Some ancestors at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage weighed in their hearts, feeling that they could barely reach this level.
"Wasn't it said that Lu Yang is a magic cultivator? How has his Swordsmanship become so formidable, barely matching Young Master Lu?" asked an ancestor at the Body Integration Realm, puzzled.
In terms of Swordsmanship alone, Lu Yang was not an equal match for Young Master Lu. It was through his magic skill attacks that he managed to contend with Young Master Lu.
Another ancestor at the Body Integration Realm shook his head, "No, he is not just a magic cultivator. When I was in Great Xia seeking an Elixir, I heard that Lu Yang has a Sword Spirit Root, which is why he was taken as a disciple by Daoist Buyu!"
```
"He actually has a Sword Spirit Root?!" The surrounding people were alarmed, their pupils shaking.
Throughout ancient and modern times, never had there been a Sword Cultivator with such a peak talent in magic skills.
"Good, good, good, worthy of the opponent I have my eye on, I never expected that even after cultivating to the mid-stage Nascent Soul, you could still fight me on equal footing!" Young Sect Master Lu laughed heartily, having not experienced such a thrilling fight in a long time. Those who could battle him to a draw were, at the very least, in the late stages of Spirit Transformation.
With a flick of his wrist, the Tianxu Sword returned to the Seven-star Sword formation, and Young Sect Master Lu pointed towards the sky, causing the Seven-star Swords to form a grand Array Method.
"Sect Master Lu, try this move!"
Young Sect Master Lu extended two fingers and gently shook them, the sound of swords ringing incessantly. The Seven-star Sword formation appeared above Lu Yang's head, its bright, sharp tips pointing downward.
"Sect Master Lu better be careful, this Array is called 'One Sword Immortal Kneels,' even the Qilin Immortal, who had become an Immortal, had to kneel before this sword array!"
The audience, upon hearing this ancient secret, became agitated, their voices uncontrollable.
"One Sword Immortal Kneels, what a domineering Array Method name!"
"The Qilin Immortal was defeated by this sword array?!"
"Who created this sword array? I've never heard about any Immortal from ancient times who was skilled in both swordsmanship and the Array Method."
The people discussed fervently, having read through various ancient and modern books, but none had recorded this piece of history.
"That's right, this would be a scandal for the Qilin Immortal, why would he allow it to be passed down to later generations."
"Array, activate!"
With the words 'Array, activate!' spoken, the sword array came into motion, collapsing and overwhelming everything in its path, destroying and obliterating as if tearing the heavens and earth apart.
With a thump, even Lu Yang couldn't withstand the oppressive force of the sword array and knelt on the ground.
He looked up determinedly at the sword array without any hint of submission, withdrawing the Sword Washing Pool.
"One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand!"
Lu Yang, guided by his sword intent, transformed myriad Sword Washing Pools that covered the sky and loomed like dark clouds before a torrential downpour, containing the might of the heavens and the earth.
Just when everyone thought that Lu Yang was going to lose, his action stunned them all.
"What is this technique?!"
"Didn't he just say it? One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand."
"But there are no swords."
"Perhaps Lu Yang's understanding of Sword Dao has reached the realm where he believes the heart contains a sword, and anything could be a sword! After coming to the East Sea, it was said that he defeated more than a dozen Divinity Transformation Stage cultivators with just this technique!"
"Right, right, right, I also heard that this technique can even transform swords into physical forms, creating figures with three heads and six arms."
Lu Yang, completely focused, paid no attention to what the outside world was saying about him. He was concentrated on the battle before him and lightly commanded:
"Go!"
The Sword Washing Pools fell like torrential rain, and just seeing this scene was absolutely terrifying.
The collision of two streams of Sword Dao unleashed a radiance unheard of before, making the heavens and earth tremble, the sea of clouds boil over, rising straight into the sky.
"Who won?"
The Sword Washing Pools and the Seven-star Swords lay scattered on the ground. Lu Yang and Young Sect Master Lu both propped up their bodies with their swords, kneeling on the ground, staring fiercely at one another. Although their spiritual essence was utterly drained, their eyes still burned with an unyielding fighting spirit.
"Enough, enough, let's stop here." Suddenly, Young Sect Master Lu burst into laughter. "If we keep fighting, we'll have to rely on swallowing elixirs, which wouldn't be fair to you. This battle is over."
"Then it's over." Lu Yang agreed readily, knowing that continuing the fight, regardless of the outcome, would be meaningless.
The two exchanged smiles, feeling a sense of mutual respect for each other.
The seasoned cultivators in the Transcendance Tribulation Realm witnessing this scene sighed, "Indeed, as unparalleled geniuses, they rarely meet their match. Encountering an equally matched opponent is greatly beneficial for their future cultivation."
Tao Yaoye felt that Lu Yang's acting was even more convincing than Dream Mirage.
Man Gu, having witnessed the entire process, was shocked and felt that he could never learn such acting skill in his lifetime.
Li Haoran thought that if Qin Haoran had a mind like Lu Yang's back then, Jiuyou Sect would have made a fortune by now.
Meng Jingzhou was considering whether, if he suddenly made a move, he could take out the exhausted Lu Yang and Young Sect Master Lu in one fell swoop and ascend to the position of Young Sect Master himself.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 794 - 793 The Dao Fruit Outline of Three Mountains Taoist
chapters.content:
On the other side, the main battlefield of the Dragon Palace.
Compared with the fight between Lu Yang and Young Master Lu, the battle here was of a higher level and attracted more attention.
"Nine-Tier Demon-Suppressing Pagoda!" Three Mountains Taoist took the initiative, pulling out a pristine white nine-tiered small pagoda.
The headquarters of the East Sea Cultivator Alliance was a nine-tiered pagoda, but few knew that it was actually the life-bound magical treasure of the Three Mountains Taoist.
The Three Mountains Taoist recited an incantation under his breath, and in an instant, the pagoda radiated a ten thousand zhang of light, transforming into a dawn-like golden beam shooting straight at Ao Ling.
Ao Ling shook his body and transformed into a ten thousand zhang dark black True Dragon, his body covered in gloomy shiny scales that flickered with a deep and mysterious dark light.
Seeing that a Semi-Immortal battle was about to erupt, everyone hurriedly fled from the Dragon Palace.
Meng Jingzhou appeared exceptionally calm, for it was only a battle between Semi-Immortals, and he had already witnessed it twice.
This wasn't even as entertaining as Lu Yang's double act.
"Transform!"
The Three Mountains Taoist shouted loudly, and the pagoda grew as large as a mountain, aiming to suppress Ao Ling. Ao Ling's tail flicked lightly, easily flipping the pagoda over.
The Three Mountains Taoist was on high alert, as Ao Ling had not used the Dao Fruit Outline but merely relied on her physical strength to effortlessly overturn his prideful life-bound magical treasure.
Ao Ling then struck with her dragon horn, causing a tsunami on the seafloor, howling like the wind. The Three Mountains Taoist frightenedly shifted the pagoda to block in front of himself.
The dragon horn was the hardest part of Ao Ling's body. Even though the pagoda was the life-bound magical treasure of the Three Mountains Taoist and had been refined for a long time, it still could not withstand Ao Ling's strike.
Boom—
The Three Mountains Taoist was sent flying together with the pagoda, pillars collapsed, and a huge hole appeared in the walls of the Dragon Palace, he was directly knocked out of the Dragon Palace!
Lu Yang and Young Master Lu took the opportunity to escape through the hole and began to fight on the sea surface.
"Who do you think will win?"
"The Dragon Clan Ancestor, I suppose. It's said that she was an absolute powerhouse even during the era of geniuses in Ancient Times, seldomly losing in a Semi-Immortal battle."
"I think so too. Moreover, don't forget that the Long Clan are naturally strong in physique. The physical strength of the Dragon Clan Ancestor has probably reached the pinnacle, and the Three Mountains Taoist certainly wouldn't dare to engage in close combat with her physique."
"Don't jump to conclusions so quickly. I've heard that there is no absolute strength or weakness among Semi-Immortals; there exists a restraining relationship. If the Dao Fruit Outline of the Three Mountains Taoist happens to restrain the Dragon Clan Ancestor, then the outcome could be reversed."
The Three Mountains Taoist, regardless of the discussion among the crowd, silently wished in his heart, "I vow here to enhance my physical strength, strengthen the pagoda, and obtain the ability to subdue dragons!"
After making his wish, the Three Mountains Taoist felt a revolutionary change in himself, his physical strength reached the limit of the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, the pagoda became almost indistinguishable from an Immortal Artifact, indestructible, and the parts that had been damaged just now had been restored to their original state.
The weaknesses of the Long Clan flashed before him one by one, and Ao Ling's True Dragon form seemed full of flaws in his eyes!
After making his wish, the Three Mountains Taoist seemed like a different person, growing more valiant as the battle waged on, and was able to contended with Ao Ling using his physical body. Even due to having mastered the technique for subduing dragons, he almost suppressed Ao Ling, eliciting gasps of amazement from the distant onlookers.
"I remember that the Three Mountains Taoist wasn't known for his physical prowess, how could he engage in a physical fight with the Dragon Clan Ancestor?"
The physical strength of Ao Ling was said to be at the pinnacle, which all Body Cultivators ultimately sought to achieve. No one expected that the Three Mountains Taoist, known for divine abilities and magic skills, could reach this level!
This was the Dao Fruit Outline obtained by the Three Mountains Taoist through the power of belief—the Wishing Dao Fruit Outline. It allowed one to make three wishes using the Dao Fruit, but the range of wishes was related to the wishes of the believers.
For instance, few believers made wishes about the soul, so he could not use the Wishing Dao Fruit Outline to strengthen the soul.
"Wishing Dao Fruit Outline? No surprises there." Ao Ling noticed the change in the Three Mountains Taoist and sneered with disdain. She had seen this kind of Dao Fruit Outline during the Fire Dynasty era.
The biggest problem with this Dao Fruit Outline was that the wishes were restricted, most of which were made by mortals, who would never make absurd wishes like controlling time or space.
The Three Mountains Taoist was enraged by Ao Ling's contemptuous laughter, casting the dragon-subduing technique. The pagoda immediately shone with blinding light, and gray chains flew out from the base of the pagoda, rapidly entwining towards Ao Ling, attempting to bind her. No matter how much Ao Ling grew or shrank, she could not break free.
"Ancient Ancestor, we have come to assist you!"
The Old Dragon Emperor and two other members of the Long Clan at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage were about to come forward to help Ao Ling when, unexpectedly, Ao Ling suddenly stretched out her claws, grabbed the grey chains, and with a strong pull, directly snapped them.
"Enough, enough. To deal with a mere Semi-Immortal who draws power from the faith, you needn't bother to help."
When those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage intervene in a battle against Semi-Immortals, a single misstep can lead to casualties, making it more of a burden than a help.
Accompanied by a dragon's roar, the sea water began to boil as if a submarine volcano had erupted, causing all the water around the Dragon Palace to boil, and seaweed among other things to burn.
This was the Long Clan's inherent True Fire that could burn underwater and was difficult to extinguish, its intensity even greater than that of Phoenix Nirvana's True Flame; otherwise, it wouldn't have burned Jiang Lianyi out of her Playing Dead Technique in the past.
Of course, part of it was also due to Jiang Lianyi's lack of skill at the time. The current Jiang Lianyi wouldn't fear being burned anymore.
The Long Clan was born with the ability to command wind and rain, and with the True Fire as their life force, they effectively mastered Yin and Yang, proficient in both water and fire.
When Ao Ling fought the Three Mountains Taoist again, the latter felt enormous pressure from the battle. Ao Ling's dragon claws appeared to be invulnerable to all magic, capable of shredding any magic skill.
Worse still, he felt that each of Ao Ling's strikes was stronger than the last, and even with his tower, he couldn't withstand the relentless attacks.
"Thinking you'll be fine with a tower for protection, how naive. Strike from beyond the mountain!"
Ao Ling exerted ingenious strength, the force penetrated the tower and struck Three Mountains Taoist directly in the chest, immediately leaving three bloody claw marks on his chest, from which blood flowed out and mingled with the sea water, turning into a dense fog of blood.
"I make a vow here, not to strengthen the tower but to heal the wounds!"
Three Mountains Taoist's wounds healed at a rate visible to the naked eye.
His wounds healed quickly, but Ao Ling's attacks were even faster.
