The Three Mountains Taoist had a foreboding feeling; he was overconfident. Had he known, he would have made a run for it instead of mouthing off about the situation; now he couldn't win the fight nor escape without losing face.
He had already tried making wishes for powers like "commanding the sea", "summoning wind and rain", "increasing luck", and so on, but none were a match for Ao Ling.
He even felt Ao Ling growing stronger as time passed. What started as a battle of equals turned into a completely one-sided affair.
Boom—
Three Mountains Taoist tried to flee the battlefield multiple times, but each time, Ao Ling dragged him back. Eventually, he had his lower half shredded by dragon claws and fell into the sea, creating a surge of waves.
Ao Ling transformed back into human form, standing on Three Mountains Taoist's face, her expression cold and indifferent.
The outcome had been decided.
"What if I said that I just wanted to Possess you for fun and would give your body back after I'm done? Would you believe that?"
Ao Ling laughed coldly, "What do you think, do I believe that?"
Seeing that Ao Ling had no intention of sparing him, Three Mountains Taoist shouted loudly.
"If you don't help me now, I'll be beaten to death!"
After a moment of deadly silence, an old figure with a dark face appeared.
If possible, he would certainly prefer not to take action. He had not planned on battling a legendary figure like Ao Ling, nor did he expect the Young Sect Master Lu to show up, which indicated that the Heavenly Court had taken notice of this place.
Although confident he could defeat Ao Ling, he also knew that he was no match for the Heavenly Court.
The Young Sect Master Lu glanced at his concealed position, likely having discovered him. Fleeing would be futile.
The Young Sect Master Lu, who was feigning ignorance, glanced at the dark-faced elder who had abruptly appeared.
It was Fairy Eternity who informed him that there was another Semi-Immortal hiding in the Dragon Palace, likely Three Mountains Taoist's ally.
Lu Yang speculated that this person was a Great Qian Semi-Immortal, and the method Three Mountains Taoist used to solidify the Dao Fruit Outline with the power of faith likely came from him.

chapters.title: Chapter 795 - 794 The Power of Ao Ling
chapters.content:
The Great Qian Dynasty was founded on faith and the divine path, and Lu Yang speculated that there might be some connection between it and the Fire Dynasty.
Otherwise, how could it be such a coincidence that two consecutive dynasties were related to faith?
"I have seen fellow Daoist Ao Ling, I am..." the dark-faced old man began to introduce himself with his title, Lord of Mountains and Rivers of Great Qian, but was abruptly sent flying with a kick from Ao Ling before he could finish.
After allying with the Three Mountains Taoist, what good could he be?
Forget the nonsense, fight first and talk later—decide the victor and then listen to explanations!
"Very well, very well, since fellow Daoist Ao Ling does not wish to show me courtesy, then do not blame me for being impolite!" The Lord of Mountains and Rivers had thought that Ao Ling, this legendary character from ancient times, was someone who would act with propriety. Little did he expect that the other party would not play by the rules and start fighting right away.
So, you want to fight, let's fight!
He gave the Three Mountains Taoist an incomplete method for cultivating faith, hinting that the Three Mountains Taoist could possess the Old Dragon Emperor, with the intent of using him to obtain the incense offering of the great deity Yinglong.
He had not expected things to escalate to this point.
"He said he is the Lord of Mountains and Rivers, the great general of the Great Qian Dynasty who fought in all directions?"
"After the campaigns ended, he was ennobled by the first Emperor Qian as the Lord of Mountains and Rivers, to forever enjoy the offerings of the land!"
When a Transcendance Tribulation Stage Ancient Ancestor heard the dark-faced old man's title, he was moved. This was a warlike figure from the Great Qian Dynasty, wielding great military power, skillful at conquering battles, victorious in every fight.
The Lord of Mountains and Rivers brandished his arm, and a white bone spear appeared in his hand.
She transformed back into a True Dragon's body, her entire being swirling with purple-gold flames and lightning. The spiritual essence of the entire sea area grew restless, erupting with earth-shattering roars!
Despite the impact, the figure of the Lord of Mountains and Rivers did not waver. His body twisted and, with the swiftness of thunder, his spear thrust towards Ao Ling.
Ao Ling felt a sense of ominous danger, promptly twisted its dragon body, and dodged the spear tip.
The spot where she had just been turned into nothingness, vanishing completely, as seawater rushed in to fill the void.
"Ancient Ancestor, be careful! According to records, the Lord of Mountains and Rivers controls a Devouring Dao Fruit Prototype!" Ao Ya urgently transmitted her voice. Historical records indicated that those who battled with the Lord of Mountains and Rivers often ended with no remains left, utterly devoured.
"Devouring Dao Fruit Prototype?" Ao Ling narrowed its draconic eyes slightly. This was indeed a bit troublesome.
The Dragon head tilted to dodge a streak of glinting attack.
It was none other than the Three Mountains Taoist!
While Ao Ling and the Lord of Mountains and Rivers briefly clashed, the Three Mountains Taoist used all three wishes on recovery, quickly mending his wounds and even restoring his spiritual essence to consummation.
"I'll help you!"
Two Semi-Immortals fought against Ao Ling!
The Nine-tier Demon Suppression Tower and the white bone spear struck together.
The Three Mountains Taoist continued his wishes with "Enhance body, Enhance tower, Turn mountains and oceans upside down," while the Lord of Mountains and Rivers brandished the white bone spear, donning armor refined with incense offerings, as if returning to the glorious months of blood-soaked battles conquering in all directions, thirty thousand years ago.
Although now advanced in years, his combat strength remained at its peak.
Three Semi-Immortals made their move, and the entire environment of the Dragon Palace sea area became tumultuous. Spectators at a distance watched as the space above the Dragon Palace sea was covered in darkness, with three figures fiercely battling, their every movement capable of changing heavens and earth!
"Three Chants Heavenly Wind!"
Ao Ling commanded the wind and rain, stirring up boundless hurricanes over the East Sea; these winds targeted the soul, filled with Yang Qi, capable of causing astral projection, quietly dissolving souls within the wind, truly frightening.
"Under the Bodhi tree, boundless wondrous Dharma!" The Three Mountains Taoist had discreetly learned the heart-stabilizing methods of Buddhism, which could anchor the soul firmly within the body, unaffected by the external world.
But all he could do was maintain his sense of self in the wind, unable to counterattack.
The soul of the Lord of Mountains and Rivers was well-forged and sturdy, not fearing the Three Chants Heavenly Wind.
"Apocalyptic Red Lotus!"
A red lotus, radiating the power of karmic fire, surfaced over the East Sea, the dark clouds tinted red, resembling fresh blood, as if doomsday had arrived.
"Innate Ren Water."
Ao Ling stood atop the crest of a wave. Every drop of water under her feet could transform into a vast lake. Innate Ren Water, made from a mixture of the three innate divine waters of the sun, moon, and stars, had vanished from the world without a trace at a time when the stars did not shine.
Firelight intertwined with water light, like the collision of two worlds, creating a bizarre and colorful interplay of shadows.
Innate Ren Water overpowered the Apocalyptic Red Lotus, bearing down on the Lord of Mountains and Rivers.
The Lord of Mountains and Rivers remained unshaken, still letting the Innate Ren Water approach.
Before it could touch him, the water was completely devoured by the Dao Fruit Prototype, leaving not a trace on him.
"Make a wish here, for this is a Dojo, combining the powers of Mount Penglai, Fangzhang, and Yingzhou!"
This time, three wishes needed to be used, and during this period, there was no defense, so the Three Mountains Taoist and Ao Ling didn't dare to make such wishes when they were fighting one-on-one.
Now he took advantage of the battle between Mount Spirit Jun and Ao Ling to complete the power accumulation in one fell swoop.
"Three Mountains suppress demons!"
This was the reason for his Taoist title of Three Mountains, which enabled him to mobilize the power of the three mountains of the East Sea!
Illusory shadows of the three mountains appeared, and although they were merely shadows, they were no less powerful than actual mountains descending.
Within the shadows, there was the power of the spirit veins of these three mountains!
Penglai Island originally had a ninth-grade spirit vein, Yingzhou Island was originally an eighth-grade spirit vein, but since the Great Void Immortal Grass had been plucked, it had recovered to a ninth-grade spirit vein!
The Three Mountains descended, suppressing all enemies!
Ao Ling was repeatedly struck by the three immortal mountains, spitting blood, while Mount Spirit Jun pursued the victory relentlessly, like a persistent affliction, gripping his long spear, jumping with force, deftly moving about the dragon's body, the tip of the spear gathered the Survival of the Fittest Dao Fruit Prototype, and the scarlet dragon blood rained down, dyeing the night sky red.
The three immortal mountains rose and fell, stirring up thousands of feet of waves and blood mist, and Ao Ling's black dragon body was battered, dripping with blood.
"Kill!" Mount Spirit Jun's eyes turned bloodshot, reverting to his old habits, once he attacked, it was a battle to the death. This was how he had made a name for himself during the time of Great Qian, notorious throughout the land.
"Fairy, is Senior Ao Ling really okay?" Lu Yang, seeing this scene, felt his eyelids twitch uncontrollably, wasn't this a clear path to defeat?
Fairy Eternity indeed revealed a look of great interest, as if enjoying the spectacle, "Do you really think Xiao Ling is at a disadvantage?"
"Isn't she?" Lu Yangxin wondered if Senior Ao Ling, being beaten to such an extent, could still turn the tables.
"Heh heh, have you forgotten her Dao Fruit Outline?"
Suddenly, Lu Yang remembered that Ao Ling mastered the Survival of the Fittest Dao Fruit Prototype!
While the Young Sect Master and the Heavenly Court Master were speaking, the scales of victory began to tip.
Whether it was an illusion or not, the Three Mountains Taoist always felt that Ao Ling, despite being seriously injured, not only did not have a diminished aura, but seemed to be gaining strength.
"The power of the Three Mountains!"
The weight of the three mountains pressed upon Ao Ling, rendering her immobile, giving the Three Mountains Taoist a slight sense of security.
Suddenly, Ao Ling seemed to gain new strength, her dragon spine arching, flipping over the three mountains that had been pressing down on her!
The Three Mountains Taoist's eyes widened in shock; wasn't Ao Ling gravely injured? How could she still possess such power?
A hint of a smile appeared in her enormous dragon's eyes, reflecting the uncertain expressions of the two semi-immortals.
"Had enough?"
The black dragon flipped over, its body radiating a shimmering, holy light, its wounds healing rapidly.
"This is impossible!"
Mount Spirit Jun cried out involuntarily, most of Ao Ling's upper body had been devoured by his Dao Fruit Prototype, and this kind of devouring was at the level of the soul, not something that could be easily repaired!
Unmoved, Ao Ling lunged with her enormous dragon claw to suppress the two beneath it.
"If you've had enough, then it's my turn!"
"Not good, the Devouring Vortex!"
Mount Spirit Jun used the Dao Fruit Outline of the Devouring to attempt to devour Ao Ling's dragon claw, but the giant claw directly shattered the Devouring Vortex, pressing down with undiminished force on the two semi-immortals!
Mount Spirit Jun placed his white bone spear across his chest, but it was still crushed by the dragon claw.
The white bone spear that had accompanied him through countless semi-immortal battles without fail, was unexpectedly shattered so easily by the dragon claw.
"This is an Immortal's Body!"
Mount Spirit Jun wore a look of disbelief; that the dragon claw could shatter the Devouring Vortex, break the white bone spear, not through skill, but purely by overpowering them with physical strength!
Ao Ling possessed the Survival of the Fittest Dao Fruit Prototype; as long as she survived an attack, she would grow stronger.
In other words, the more she was attacked, the stronger she became!
But being both semi-immortals, how could one possibly defeat her from the start?!
The Three Mountains Taoist could wish to strengthen his body to the pinnacle of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
However, Ao Ling could break through the limit of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage and reach the pinnacle of an Immortal's Body!
If Ao Ling were to enhance her body to the level of an Immortal's Body, even the Qilin Immortal of her semi-immortal days would not be able to defeat her!

chapters.title: Chapter 796 - 796: 795
chapters.content:
There exists an insurmountable chasm between a Semi-Immortal and an Immortal; it's not just about the perfection of the Dao Fruit. An Immortal's physique and soul—if one possesses either, they can crush a Semi-Immortal.
"Get out of my way!" the mountain and river lord was held down by a dragon claw, unable to break free, he burned his Essence Blood and bellowed, executing the Law of Heaven and Earth.
"I make a vow here for the Three Mountains to become one!"
The three mountains of Mount Penglai merged into a pitch-black immortal mountain equipped with forbidden powers. Those who approached the dark mountain were unable to use their magic skills and divine abilities, and their physical bodies would be greatly weakened.
A young divine figure, carrying the pitch-black immortal mountain, towered between heaven and earth. The East Sea was as deep as two hundred thousand meters; yet, the young divine figure stood on the seabed, his head emerging above the ocean's surface.
This was what the mountain and river lord looked like in his youth.
The space surrounding the divine body collapsed. The waters of the East Sea could not approach, forming a vacuum zone around him, devouring everything.
Ao Ling sneered coldly, her expression one of disdain. She was as tiny as dust in front of the young divine figure, yet the aura she emitted was far greater.
Ao Ling charged with her dragon horns. Approaching the young divine figure, even the Embryonic Dao Fruit was unable to consume her dragon scales.
The young divine figure lifted the pitch-black immortal mountain, lowering his head to smash it against the terrifying black dragon.
Ao Ling was unfazed, effortlessly piercing through the immortal mountain as if penetrating a piece of paper, burrowing into the young divine figure's forehead and emerging from the back of his head, piercing through the Lingtai.
"Ah—"
The technique executed at the cost of burning Essence Blood was broken, both the mountain and river lord and the Three Mountains Taoist suffered backlash, vomiting blood profusely. Their energy plummeted rapidly.
The spectators had not anticipated this scene at all. The Dragon Clan Ancestor, previously at a disadvantage, instantly turned defeat into victory, effortlessly suppressing two Semi-Immortals. It was a crushing victory.
The majestic black dragon triumphantly returned, as if a king victorious from battle against foreign races, its tremendous aura making heaven and earth hold their breath.
To defeat two Semi-Immortals single-handedly was a result no one had expected!
At the same time, the battle between Lu Yang and the Young Master Lu approached its end, concluding in a draw.
"Look, I told you Xiao Ling could win." Fairy Eternity smiled with satisfaction. After all, she was her unacknowledged disciple.
"Congratulations to Senior Ao Ling for the grand victory!" The people of the East Sea bowed in unison, practically shouting their lungs out, the sea surface trembling along.
Different from the previous bow that was out of respect for seniority and legend, this time they truly felt convinced by Ao Ling's combat prowess.
The Long Clan was the most excited— their ancient ancestor displayed divine might and invincibility, evoking genuine pride in their hearts.
Dragon claws pinned down the two Semi-Immortals, the cold dragon eyes staring intently at them.
"Quick, move aside!" Fairy Eternity suddenly transmitted a message to Ao Ling.
An unexpected change occurred, Ao Ling felt a chilling terror as if falling into an ice pit, sensing some great horror unfolding.
She abandoned the mountain and river lord and Three Mountains Taoist without hesitation, quickly shifting her position!
A slash imbued with the breath of termination and death descended from the heavens, the mountain and river lord and the Three Mountains Taoist didn't even have the chance to scream before they were cleaved in two by the sudden blade of light; both their bodies and souls turned to nothingness, leaving no traces in the world!
Ao Ling gasped in shock. If it weren't for
"Unexpectedly, you managed to dodge a casual strike from me." A deep voice echoed through the world, heavy and pronounced as if signifying the end of the world.
Whether it was the Sea Clan or the human race, their Lingtai felt covered in dust, suffocating them.
Even the battle of the three Semi-Immortals just now had not given them this sensation.
No, there was simply no comparison between the two!
A hazy figure cut across the sky, appearing above the East Sea, with the aura of death permeating every inch of space. Under its influence, even the East Sea began to freeze into blocks of ice.
The figure was obscured by thick fog, its features unclear.
An Immortal!
The people of the East Sea could never have dreamed that an Immortal would suddenly enter the fray, let alone one with killing intent towards Ao Ling.
"I thought your soul was shattered and you had long perished, yet unexpectedly, you are still alive. It doesn't matter; if I killed you once, I can kill you a second time."
The hazy figure spoke in a calm tone, as if discussing an inconsequential matter, decreeing the life and death of a Semi-Immortal effortlessly.
Lu Yang felt goosebumps all over. This hazy figure was the very Immortal who had battled with the Qilin Immortal and shattered Ao Ling's soul!
Even he was deliberately erasing the existence of the Fire Dynasty!
"Oh right, and you, you know who I am, so you must die too." The hazy figure glanced at Lu Yang and, with a flick of his finger, shot out a bolt of black lightning.
Lu Yang was stunned. Who are you? What have I done to know your identity?
"How dare you!" Vast Sea Daoist Lord was furious, positioning himself in front of Lu Yang. He used the embryonic Spatial Dao Fruit to divert the black lightning away.
"Cough—"
The energy contained in this black lightning was too terrifying; even space was affected. Vast Sea Daoist Lord could only barely redirect the attack, forcing himself to spit out a mouthful of congested blood after strenuously manipulating the Dao Fruit Outline.
Vast Sea Daoist Lord's eyes twitched as he recalled his initial confidence upon arriving at the East Sea, and he wanted to slap himself twice.
Telling yourself to protect this kid Lu Yang!
The battle of the Semi-Immortals was still acceptable, within his capabilities.
But how did a true Immortal jump out of nowhere? Who the hell could guarantee protection against that!
The shadowy figure did not expect Vast Sea Daoist Lord to be able to divert his attack and was slightly surprised, but then immediately figured out why.
"So it's the embryonic Spatial Dao Fruit, somewhat interesting. However, that's all it is, interesting. In the end, you are a mortal, and you must not defy the decree of the Immortals."
The hazy figure also didn't care about the actions of Vast Sea Daoist Lord.
"Ancestor, are you alright?" Lu Yang asked cautiously.
Vast Sea Daoist Lord rolled his eyes: "Not very good."
"But I have said that I would protect you, so I will definitely do so!"
Lu Yang was extremely astonished, not expecting that even under these circumstances, the ancestor claimed he could protect him. What kind of ace up his sleeve was this?
Vast Sea Daoist Lord quietly reached into his bosom and tore a Talisman.
A spatial channel opened, and a graceful figure stepped out, expression serene, neither joyous nor sorrowful, as if not even the collapse of the heavens could shake her Daoist heart.
Everyone held their breath, their bodies shaking uncontrollably.
The graceful figure had demonstrated her might in Chunjiang City without concealing her appearance, and all high-level Cultivators had a portrait of her.
The figure looked around her, her gaze sweeping over Lu Yang, Young Master Lu, Vast Sea Daoist Lord, and Ao Ling before finally raising her head to fix her gaze on the shadowy figure in the sky.
The shadowy figure frowned. He seldom paid attention to the outside world and had never seen this graceful figure before.
However, sensing her composed attitude and the aura she concealed, making her seem almost like an ordinary mortal, he knew she was an Immortal just like himself.
It seems she was an Immortal from a later generation.
Not to be feared.
The person he wanted to kill could not be stopped by anyone!
The hazy Immortal ignored Yun Zhi, activated the Dao Fruit of Oblivion and fired an Immortal Thunder as thick as a bucket toward Lu Yang and Young Master Lu.
Yun Zhi moved with elegant steps, extending her fair, jade-like hand with a bit of her snowy wrist exposed. Without even looking, she casually caught the Immortal Thunder as if completely unaffected by the essence of obliteration, and threw it back at the hazy Immortal.
The Immortal naturally wouldn't be hurt by his own attack, but when he confidently caught the Immortal Thunder, he let out a muffled grunt.
Unexpectedly, without a proper check, he was injured by Yun Zhi!
He felt that in addition to his own power, the returned Immortal Thunder mixed with another force.
How many tens of thousands of years had it been since he last suffered an injury?
"Who are you!" The hazy Immortal no longer underestimated Yun Zhi but regarded her as an Immortal on the same level as himself, treating her seriously.
"Heavenly Court Sect Master, Yun Mengmeng," Yun Zhi introduced herself calmly.
Vast Sea Daoist Lord secretly heaved a sigh of relief. Fortunately, before leaving, Yun Zhi was not at ease and left him a spatial Talisman, saying that if something went wrong, he should tear the Talisman, and she would immediately rush over.
"Hmm?"
The hazy Immortal was puzzled. When did a Heavenly Court Sect pop up?

chapters.title: Chapter 797 - 797: 796
chapters.content:
```
"Who are you?" Yun Zhi observed the other and sighed inwardly.
Her premonition had indeed been correct; her junior brother really did manage to provoke an unexpected high-profile individual.
Although she did not know the details of what had happened, since the Ancient Ancestor of the Long Clan was here, it probably was not unrelated to her junior brother. The same was true for this grey mist Immortal standing before her.
Fortunately, before she left, she had told their revered ancestor to seek her out if they encountered any insurmountable difficulty.
Her premonition had proved accurate.
Immortals shrouded in grey mist rarely walked in the outside world. Only beings like the Yingtian Immortal from ancient times, as well as Ao Ling, the one that got away, could draw their attention.
Now they would have to add Lu Yang to that list; it must have been Ao Ling who informed them.
One Semi-Immortal, one at the Nascent Soul Stage, they had assumed it would be an easy capture, but then suddenly a woman claiming to be the Heavenly Court Sect Master emerged, with cultivation profound enough to interact with the natural laws.
What is this Heavenly Court Sect?
Wasn't the Fire Dynasty I annihilated aware of the Heavenly Court? Why does someone still know of it?
And if they knew of the Heavenly Court, how could they be unaware of my existence?
Within the grey mist, the Immortal frowned; he did not feel any connection of causality with this self-proclaimed Sect Master of the Heavenly Court.
The grey mist Immortal had no intention of answering Yun Zhi's question. Right now, all he wanted was to kill Lu Yang and Ao Ling. As for this person claiming to be the Sect Master of the Heavenly Court Sect, she posed no threat.
Not to mention that he was far superior to Immortals like the Yingtian Immortal, being the preeminent figure in the path of Immortals!
"Die!"
The grey mist Immortal made a sudden move, full of the aura of destruction. Space collapsed, condensing into a blade of light that signified death and finality. Coiled with the silence of Immortal Thunder, it furiously struck at Ao Ling.
The blade of light annihilated everything; anything it touched turned to nothingness, not something that merely Devouring a Dao Fruit Outline was comparable to.
To say nothing of Ao Ling, who possessed only the body of an Immortal, even a true Immortal would not dare to take this blow head-on!
As if foreknowing the future, Yun Zhi took a step forward and appeared in front of Ao Ling. She gently pushed out her palm, causing ripples in the fabric of space.
The spatial ripples collided with the blade of light, and Yun Zhi's gaze met that of the grey mist Immortal. A silent shockwave erupted, threatening to flatten the entire East Sea!
The East Sea trembled, mountains quaked, and waves crashed. Beings living at the edge of the East Sea didn't know what had happened, yet they felt an inexplicable panic, as if a calamity loomed!
Those attending the birthday celebration were quaking with fear, chilled to the core. A battle between Immortals, a scene only from ancient times, was unfolding before them!
Even Meng Jingzhou, who had seen his fair share of troubles with Lu Yang, was taken aback, having not anticipated the conflict escalating to the point where Eldest Senior Sister would fight an Immortal.
The most conflicted of all, however, was the Old Dragon Emperor.
Today was his nine-thousandth birthday, yet it had started with the Three Mountains Taoist attempting to possess him, followed by the appearance of the Ancient Ancestor Ao Ling, then the arrival of the Great Qian Semi-Immortal, and the battle among the three Semi-Immortals. Now, it had escalated into a battle of Immortals.
Even with birthday surprises, there needn't have been quite so many, he thought. He was of an age that could not withstand such shocks.
"From the looks of it, are you unwilling to concede?" The grey mist Immortal scoffed, cold with the implication that if the obstruction continued, he would not hesitate to kill her too!
As he spoke, the strength of the Immortal's blade of light in his hand increased by a fraction.
Yun Zhi uttered four words calmly, as if she were a Fairy High Above who was detached from worldly concerns.
"Invert Yin and Yang."
The blade of light, which originally carried the intent of destruction, suddenly burst with life and emitted a gentle glow, devoid of any aggressive force.
Rocks enveloped by the gentle light rapidly grew a layer of moss in the blink of an eye.
```
The school of fish was enveloped in a gentle glow, rapidly aging at an inconceivable speed.
Unlike the inversion of Yin and Yang that Lu Yang had learned, this was a bona fide Divine Ability of inverting Yin and Yang, transforming the supremely destructive light of the Heavenly Blade into a force of creation!
"What is your relation to Immortal Jiuchong!" the misty Immortal exclaimed, having seen Immortal Jiuchong use this move before.
"No relation, it's just a common magic attack," Yun Zhi replied in an even tone, as if what she had just done was a trivial matter.
"Above the heavens and below the earth, I alone am honored!" the misty Immortal declared, pointing one hand to the sky and the other to the ground, spewing the truth, "This world shall end!"
Suddenly, a raging inferno ignited at the other end of the sky, as red fiery clouds flared up like the gates of the underworld had opened, and scorching rain of fire fell from the sky, turning everything it touched to ash!
The night sky illuminated by the flames was like daylight, yet it appeared more harrowing than the day.
Thirty thousand years ago, it was with this move that the misty Immortal led the Fire Dynasty to its doom!
He was indeed curious to see how this Sect Leader Yun would deal with it!
Some Body Integration Realm ancient ancestors stood stunned, murmuring to themselves, "Heavenly fire descends, this is the fire of the three disasters that brings the world to its end, as told in Buddhist legend."
Even more Body Integration Realm ancient ancestors revealed a look of despair; even with their cultivation level, just a touch of moisture would cause them to perish in the raging flames, burned to cinders.
If this rain of fire were to fall, the entire East Sea would be engulfed in flames capable of drying up its waters!
"Return the wind, reverse the fire," Yun Zhi spoke again indifferently, uttering four words as her hand gestures changed, forming an obscure seal.
The heavenly fire disappeared, as if it had never occurred, leaving everyone bewildered, as though they had forgotten what had just happened.
Only Lu Yang, with the help of Fairy Eternity, witnessed the entire process:
As soon as the Eldest Senior Sister uttered the words "Return the wind, reverse the fire," the heavenly fire that was about to touch the ocean's surface retreated back to the sky, and the panicked fleeing ancestors reversed their course, returning to their original positions.
It was like watching an old movie in reverse, as the scene rewound, going back to the beginning.
A Great Divine Skill related to time, Return the wind, reverse the fire.
"Not too shabby!" After witnessing Yun Zhi's methods, the misty Immortal remained confident, thinking that Yun Zhi was just so-so.
Yun Zhi couldn't be bothered to speak, her steps bloomed with lotuses, as golden lotus flowers unfolded in the air, their light piercing through the long enveloping dark clouds.
Yun Zhi threw a punch without looking back, and with a crackling sound, her fist grew larger in the stunned eyes of the misty Immortal, filling his pupils.
Boom—
Yun Zhi's fist hammered onto the face of the misty Immortal!
The speed of the punch was so fast that the misty Immortal had no time to react!
Yun Zhi punched repeatedly, aiming only for the face, curious to see what the misty Immortal actually looked like.
The misty Immortal finally realized the gap between him and Yun Zhi; his punches were powerful and heavy, as if they contained the force of countless stars, each strike felt like the cosmos smashing down on him, causing excruciating pain.
The misty Immortal's heart was set on retreat; if this continued, not only would he fail to kill Lu Yang and Ao Ling, but even his own life would be at risk!
Under the relentless attack, the mist grew extremely unstable, showing signs of collapse at any moment, unable to protect the misty Immortal any longer.
Finally, with another heavy punch from Yun Zhi, the fog shielding the face dissipated, revealing the misty Immortal's visage.
Standing below and using Fairy Eternity's divine consciousness to watch the battle, Lu Yang was stunned.
He felt a rare sense of absurdity and fear.
The face was none other than that of Fairy Eternity!

chapters.title: Chapter 798 - 797: What on earth did you revive from the Four Ancient Immortals?
chapters.content:
"Ah? How does this person look exactly like me?" Fairy Eternity was also stunned, greatly puzzled.
Staring at that familiar and incredibly beautiful face, Lu Yang looked up to the heavens and let out a helpless, wry smile.
What on earth did the resurrected Four Ancient Immortals bring about?
When Ao Ling forebear spoke of establishing the Fire Dynasty with the goal of reviving Fairy Eternity, Lu Yang had a rough guess.
The Four Immortals founded the Fire Dynasty with great momentum, spending a hundred thousand years on it, surely not without causing even a single splash.
Take the Three Mountains Taoist as an example, how many Semi-Immortals could he produce in a hundred thousand years?
If there were a result, what would it be?
According to what Elder Ao Ling said, the purpose of establishing the underworld was to recreate Fairy Eternity's Dao Fruit, which clearly had not been successfully done; otherwise, it wouldn't be his turn to revive Fairy Eternity.
Considering that the Dao Fruit of the Immortal who fought Qilin Immortal was the Extinction Dao Fruit, which Fairy Eternity once intended to condense.
And Fairy Eternity stated that the Extinction Dao Fruit was extremely difficult to condense, with no one succeeding in Ancient Times.
Then, all of a sudden, an Immortal emerging from the Fire Dynasty with the Extinction Dao Fruit seemed unlikely.
It was quite possible that by a fluke, the underworld condensed the Extinction Dao Fruit.
And the purpose of establishing the Heavenly Court was to shape an Immortal's body with the power of belief.
That body of the Immortal would naturally resemble Fairy Eternity.
In other words, if the founding of the Fire Dynasty had a result, it was very likely the birth of an Immortal who looked like Fairy Eternity, and whose Dao Fruit was the Extinction Dao Fruit.
The Grey Mist Immortal, or call it Grey Bean.
The actions of Grey Bean before also corroborated Lu Yang's guessing.
Lu Yang's guess was accurate enough, hence Grey Bean wanted him dead.
And this action allowed him to see clearly another matter.
Grey Bean erasing the existence of the Fire Dynasty was not to make the Fire Dynasty disappear, but to keep people from knowing her existence.
After all, Grey Bean was the Master of the Heavenly Court during the Fire Dynasty period; everyone from the Fire Dynasty knew her.
It was just that Lu Yang still did not figure out why Grey Bean needed to do so much, and what she was chasing after?
"Could it be like the Three Mountains Taoist, controlled by the power of belief, thus wanting to extinguish the source of belief?" Lu Yang had a reasonable guess.
Fairy Eternity shook her head: "I don't know. There is such a possibility. If the Yingtian Immortals are still alive, then the only sources of belief's power left are those few Immortals and Xiao Ling."
"Their realm is high enough, and their influence is great. There indeed could be the possibility of killing to free themselves from restraint, but why kill you?"
Lu Yang also thought that was right; he didn't believe in Grey Bean after all.
It's not like just knowing about Grey Bean would make him believe in her; that would be too narcissistic of Grey Bean.
Inside him was the legitimate Master of the Heavenly Court, Yellow Bean.
Wait a minute, judging from Grey Bean's previous behavior, which was very similar to Fairy Eternity's, there indeed might be a chance of narcissism.
Moreover, from Grey Bean's point of view, his cultivation level was merely at the Nascent Soul Stage, and it wasn't impossible for Nascent Soul Stage Cultivators to believe in an Immortal.
But Lu Yang still felt something wasn't quite right.
For example, Grey Bean once said to him, "You who know my identity must also die."
How did Grey Bean know that he had guessed her identity? Could she sense it?
Lu Yang tossed the question to Fairy Eternity, hoping for an answer, but what he got back were two faces looking at each other in bewilderment.
"Right, you haven't believed in her, so how could she sense it?"
Lu Yang nodded, as expected, he couldn't count on Fairy Eternity; he better think more on his own.
Ao Ling saw the true face of the Ashen Immortal, and like Lu Yang, she too felt a sense of absurdity.
No wonder her husband couldn't beat the Ashen Immortal.
Grey Bean Bean didn't want the world to know who she was, and soon the grey mist cloaked her face again, returning to a mysterious guise.
"Did any of you see the face of that Immortal?" Black Feather Venerable was most curious about this, but unfortunately, after asking around, everyone said they hadn't seen clearly.
Everything happened too quickly, surpassing the reaction range of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage; only Yun Zhi, Lu Yang who watched the battle using Immortal Consciousness, and Ao Ling who temporarily possessed the sight of an Immortal, saw Grey Bean Bean's appearance.
Even the Vast Sea Daoist Lord did not see Grey Bean Bean's face.
"Cloud Falling Palm."
Yun Zhi transformed her fist into a palm, like a white cloud, ever-changing and filled with wondrous power, with a single palm strike causing Grey Bean Bean to vomit blood, all spewed into the grey mist.
Grey Bean Bean was incredulous, she the foremost person in the path of Immortality since the Ancient Times had never met a rival, not even the likes of Immortal Jiuchong were her match; how could she be beaten so badly?
"Immortal's Path Killing Fist!" Grey Bean Bean had her own unique set of fist techniques, unrivaled in her punches, causing heaven and earth to change color, with the power of the Dao Fruit of Extinction flowing like a river, vast and boundless, an invisible pressure like mountains crushing down, solidifying the very air.
She had once used this set of techniques to beat Immortal Jiuchong until he vomited blood!
Unmoved, Yun Zhi struck out with another palm.
The fist and palm collided, instantly causing the Spiritual Energy above the Dragon Palace to boil over, triggering a massive explosion of Spiritual Energy and also drawing upon the spiritual essence of the watching Cultivators, who had no choice but to sit down and meditate on the spot, sorting out their disrupted spiritual essence and meridians.
Boom——
A figure flew out from the massive explosion of spiritual essence, coughing blood nonstop—Grey Bean Bean.
Seeing that she was getting away from Yun Zhi, Grey Bean Bean took the opportunity to flee.
Her attacks continuously dissolved by Eldest Senior Sister, and unable to best her in close combat, even revealing her true face to her opponent, it seemed she would not be able to kill her prey; it was best to make a hasty retreat.
She never intended to defeat Yun Zhi in the first place; using the Immortal's Path Killing Fist was just a means to seek an opportunity to escape.
If she didn't escape, she might even lose her life in the East Sea!
Exactly where did this Heavenly Court Sect come from, and who is this Yun Mengmeng, the Master of the Heavenly Court Sect!
But would Yun Zhi let Grey Bean Bean escape so easily? She used "Flying Body Trailing Shadows," a Divine Ability even more profound than Shrinking Ground Into Inches, which allowed her to hide within heaven and earth for spatial leaps.
Grey Bean Bean sensed with her Immortal Consciousness that Yun Zhi was relentlessly pursuing her, her face twisted with ferocity, she steeled her heart.
"Master of the Heavenly Court Sect, you're forcing my hand!"
"Sky Demon Disintegration Technique!"
"Five Elements Grand Escape!"
At the cost of a grave injury, Grey Bean Bean used the Sky Demon Disintegration Technique, and for added caution, the Five Elements Grand Escape as well, transforming into objects of the Five Elements and merging with the world to make a distant escape.
"Return Wind, Recall Fire."
Yun Zhi once again reversed time, returning to the moment before Grey Bean Bean had used the Sky Demon Disintegration Technique.
Grey Bean Bean, still refusing to give up, exerted the Sky Demon Disintegration Technique once more, but to no avail; time was reversed again.
Grey Bean Bean gritted her teeth and utilized the Dao Fruit of Extinction: "Destroy the concept of 'time'!"
She could temporarily destroy a certain concept; by destroying the concept of time, the magic skill of time reversal failed to function.
"Sky Demon Disintegration Technique! Five Elements Grand Escape!"
Only then did she finally escape from the palm of Yun Zhi.
There was no relief for Grey Bean Bean, just a feeling of suffocation. She, the Lord of the Heavenly Court, was chased around by the Master of the Heavenly Court Sect.
From a positional standpoint, the Master of the Heavenly Court Sect should be ranked below the Lord of the Heavenly Court!

chapters.title: Chapter 799 - 798 Vast Sea Daoist Lord: What did I come to the East Sea for?
chapters.content:
The people from the East Sea gazed as the two immortals vanished from sight, letting out a sigh of relief.
It's good that they have left, good that they have left, the pressure of the divine battle was too immense for them, even the shockwaves could have reduced them to dust and bones.
The chasm between immortals and mortals is evident.
"Since ancient times, this must be the first immortal conflict to have occurred," even the Transcendance Tribulation Stage ancients felt a sense of gratitude that they survived the ordeal, and amidst their relief, they realized the historical significance of this battle.
What kind of luck is this, something that has not occurred in three hundred thousand years, and it happened to them.
Ao Ling secretly felt fortunate that Yun Zhi stood on his side; such combat power would have been invincible even in the Ancient Times, able to be named alongside Immortal Sister.
Man Gu mused that following Brother Lu and Brother Meng out was indeed an eye-opening experience.
Lord Ma felt he should not have come to the birthday banquet, or rather, when he saw Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou at the banquet, he should have turned tail and run.
For tens of thousands of years, the East Sea had been calm and serene, yet the arrival of Lu Yang and others directly turned the East Sea upside down. There was the revival of the Dragon Clan Ancestor Ao Ling and the appearances of immortals.
"Looking at the situation now, it seems whether I cultivate or not doesn't make much of a difference," originally, Lord Ma thought he should diligently cultivate to become a Transcendance Tribulation Stage immortal as soon as possible, to be a qualified Protector.
Now it seems, Transcendance Tribulation Stage might not be qualified to be Protectors.
The birthday celebrant, the Old Dragon Emperor, stepped forward, cupping his hands towards everyone: "My guests, today's events were unexpected, and I am unable to continue hosting you all, please forgive me."
Indeed, the Dragon Clan was no longer in a position to host the guests. Having experienced battles involving three Semi-Immortals and two immortals, the Dragon Palace was leveled, and gold, silver, and jewels scattered in the deep sea trenches, not knowing how long it would take to rebuild the Dragon Palace.
However, this would not affect the status of the Dragon Clan as the overlord of the East Sea, with Ao Ling's return, the status of the Dragon Clan would only rise further than before.
Initially, everyone wanted to meet the Dragon Clan Ancestor Ao Ling, but since the Old Dragon Emperor had come out to usher people away, staying on with a thick face might lead to no results, so they had to give it up.
Even Black Feather Sovereign, who looked as if he relished the spectacle, was dragged away by Clan Leader Xiao.
As the crowd left, only the Dragon Clan, Seek Dao Sect, and Young Master Lu remained on site.
"Ancient Ancestor, I never expected you to be a person of the Heavenly Court," Ao Ya said excitedly, with great admiration for Ao Ling.
This person is the first in battle strength amongst Semi-Immortals, the pride of their Dragon Clan.
"Ao Ya has seen the Ancient Ancestor, has seen Lu Predecessor."
"Let me introduce you all, this is my Dao companion, Vast Sea Daoist Lord Fang Wuya," Ao Ya was open-minded, not caring much for a marriage ceremony. Since she had performed Intercourse Cultivation with him, he was now her Dao companion.
Vast Sea Daoist Lord could only cup his hands: "Junior Fang Wuya pays respect to the Dragon Clan Ancestor."
As a fellow Semi-Immortal to Ao Ling, it was acceptable to address each other as Dao companions, although now he became a junior, Vast Sea Daoist Lord was still delighted inside.
Meng Jingzhou cast a disdainful glance at Vast Sea Daoist Lord, his face nearly unable to conceal his smile. And you still say you envy me for being a Single Body Spiritual Root?
"Wuya, you haven't finished paying your respects yet," Ao Ya whispered to Vast Sea Daoist Lord.
Vast Sea Daoist Lord was puzzled. To whom else should he pay respect?
Ao Ya nudged her lips towards Young Master Lu, indicating that since he was the Ancient Ancestor's Senior Brother by generation, he too was their senior.
Vast Sea Daoist Lord's face darkened.
I'm to pay respects to him?
Under Ao Ya's persistent urging and the pressure from Ao Ya, Vast Sea Daoist Lord could only offer a forced smile as he paid his respects towards Young Master Lu: "Junior Fang Wuya pays respect to Young Sect Master Lu."
Lu Yang felt that once he returned to Seek Dao Sect, he would have some good days ahead.
"Ancient Ancestor, our Clan still has two other Transcendance Tribulation Stage individuals, would it be convenient for you to meet them?" The Old Dragon Emperor asked tentatively, observing Ao Ling's expression.
Meeting Ao Ling was a rare opportunity, the two other ancestors had missed this chance due to their slumber, for which the Old Dragon Emperor felt pity on their behalf.
```
"And there are those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, it seems you've been faring quite well in the East Sea," said Ao Ling, slightly surprised. Although the Long Clan had no Semi-Immortals, having five at the stage of Passing Tribulation already made them a top-tier force.
In Lu Yang's memory, only the Dynasty of Great Xia had more at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage than the Long Clan.
Oh no, there is one more now, the Demon Nation.
With Ao Ling's consent, the Old Dragon Emperor hurriedly went to the depths of the Dragon Palace to awaken two slumbering ancient ancestors. They were ancestors from twenty thousand and thirty thousand years ago, representing one of the most crucial foundations of the Long Clan.
The Old Dragon Emperor moved aside the rubble to enter an underwater secret chamber. Inside, there were three crystals arrayed, one of which was empty; that was where Ao Ya had stayed.
The other two crystals silently enshrined two humanoid members of the Long Clan.
The Old Dragon Emperor activated a secret method, resonating with the patterns on the crystals.
Humming sounds—
As the resonance synchronized, the crystals bloomed like flowers, and the two Long Clan ancestors slowly awoke.
"Who dares awaken us, has the Long Clan encountered a crisis of life and death?"
According to ancestral teachings, they were only to be awakened in a life-or-death crisis for the Long Clan.
The Old Dragon Emperor spoke respectfully, "Two ancient ancestors, there is no crisis for the Long Clan at present. It's just that someone wishes to meet you, hence your awakening."
The two ancestors were instantly furious: "Nonsense! Who do we think we are, to be summoned on a mere whim?"
"It was I," Ao Ling quietly watched the two Transcendance Tribulation Stage True Dragons.
"You are who..." The two ancestors began to scold instinctively, but when they turned and saw Ao Ling, their faces looked as if they had seen a ghost, and their hearts practically stopped beating.
"Ao Ao Ao Ao Ao Ao Ling, the Ancestor?!"
Honestly, if it weren't for the second half, Lu Yang would have thought they were just howling.
"Do you object?"
The two ancestors hastily clambered out of the crystals, grinning ingratiatingly: "For the Ancestor to wish to meet us juniors is an honor, and should anyone object, I would surely thrash them to death!"
Seeing his juniors so full of vim and vigor, Ao Ling was in good spirits.
The Old Dragon Emperor said to the two ancestors with a beaming smile, "Two ancient ancestors, the Ancestor simply wished to meet you, nothing more. You may continue your slumber."
The two ancestors glared at the Old Dragon Emperor. Hearing of the Ancestor's awakening, who could possibly sleep now?
"I will return to the Heavenly Court for a while. After meeting some old friends, I will come back," Ao Ling did not linger in the Long Clan, departing with Young Master Lu.
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord reluctantly bade farewell to Ao Ya and returned with the members of the Seek Dao Sect.
The two groups parted ways at the Dragon Palace. Once they had left the Dragon Palace, they began to regroup, and Lu Yang retracted his clone.
Ao Ling listened to Fairy Eternity's recount of many matters, most of which concerned the Seek Dao Sect, and she was eager to see the sect that Immortal Sister had so highly praised.
A graceful figure returned, and upon seeing this, Lu Yang quickly stepped forward to greet her: "Eldest Senior Sister, you're back. This person..."
Yun Zhi replied with an even tone, "I inflicted serious injury, but he escaped."
"Junior Brother, and Senior Ao Ling, both of you come with me. Tell me, who is the one I fought against?"
She wanted to know who this unexpected Yellow Bean was.
Watching the three of them walk away, the Vast Sea Daoist Lord was slightly stunned.
Reflecting on the events at the East Sea, he had first played a part in Lu Yang's ruse, then took a hit from an Immortal, and finally, for no apparent reason, ended up as Lu Yang's junior?
Wasn't I supposed to stroll around the East Sea unchallenged?
```

chapters.title: Chapter 800 - 799: Dai Bufan: Didn't you say you were just going to the East Sea to have fun?
chapters.content:
On the uninhabited island, four figures formed a circle, each sitting on an imperial throne.
The strength of these four figures was terrifying, with each nearly reaching the level of an Immortal.
Yun Zhi quietly listened to Fairy Eternity, Ao Ling, and Lu Yang's account before calmly summarizing.
"So, the Four Ancient Immortals originally wanted to resurrect a senior Fairy but accidentally, due to some mistakes, ended up with a senior Fairy that possesses the Dao Fruit of Annihilation?"
"And there is a high chance that this person is the same Immortal who deliberately hid information about the Fire Dynasty?"
Yun Zhi showed a puzzled expression as Junior Brother Lu had promised he would definitely not get involved with Fire Dynasty affairs.
It had only been a month, so how did they even end up finding the Immortal who was hiding Fire Dynasty information?
"Miss Yun, you really can't blame me for this. The mist suddenly enveloped us, and I had no idea that the dragon pattern bracelet I found was the key to the Dragon Ball; I just thought it was Xiao Ling's trinket and let Second-in-command pick it up." Fairy Eternity defended Lu Yang without mentioning their nocturnal venture to the relic site of the Immortal battle.
Yun Zhi was not surprised by Fairy Eternity's response: "Who taught you to say that?"
"Second-in-command."
Yun Zhi cast a cold glance at Lu Yang without saying a word.
Lu Yang felt he couldn't keep corroborating with Fairy Eternity anymore; it was too easy to spill the beans about him.
Ao Ling, who had remained silent while sitting beside them, looked at Immortal Sister to his left and then tapped Yun Zhi on the right, uttering a curious sound.
"Strange, why do I feel like you two resemble each other a bit?"
Lu Yang thought that Senior Ao Ling probably needed glasses; although Fairy Eternity and Eldest Senior Sister were both peerlessly beautiful in their own ways, one was silly while the other was as smart as ice and snow. Where could he possibly see any resemblance between them?
"Not in looks, oh, I can't quite put my finger on it, but anyway, you two just seem alike," Ao Ling couldn't explain what he felt either.
Yun Zhi said calmly, "Perhaps Senior Ao Ling is mistaken, Senior Fairy and I bear no resemblance."
"Really?" Ao Ling always believed his instincts were right.
"It's an illusion."
"Alright then."
The four resumed discussing the main topic.
"Following the methods of Grey Bean, anyone who knows about her is within her hunting range," Lu Yang pondered.
"Hold on, hold on, why call her Grey Bean!" Fairy Eternity was quite dissatisfied with Lu Yang's naming.
Eldest Senior Sister also felt the name lacked intimidation; it didn't sound like the name of a strong being.
"Then what should we call her, Annihilation Immortal?" Lu Yang was a bit troubled; they needed a code name to discuss, after all.
"No way, no way, how can she take such a domineering name?" Fairy Eternity opposed again, clearly feeling the name Annihilation Immortal stole the limelight from her moniker, Fairy Eternity.
Lu Yang turned to ask Ao Ling, "Senior, did Grey Bean have a name during the Fire Dynasty era?"
Ao Ling seriously said, "She was the master of the Heavenly Court in the Fire Dynasty and had no name. But considering her purpose is to resurrect Immortal Sister, calling her Yellow Bean might also work."
"Then we'll call her Grey Bean." Fairy Eternity quickly concluded the matter.
Eldest Senior Sister pondered, "This means I am also a target of her hunt."
Lu Yang analyzed seriously. It seemed all four present were in danger... wait, that's not right. Eldest Senior Sister could beat Grey Bean, Fairy Eternity could resurrect, Senior Ao Ling had the dragon pattern bracelet for protection, which left only himself as the most endangered?!
Lu Yang prayed that Grey Bean's personality was like Fairy Eternity's, preferring to challenge the strong and not like him, who only liked to fight those weaker than himself.
"If Senior Ao Ling trusts me, you might consider giving me the dragon pattern bracelet. I know someone who can recharge it with energy."
"Here." Ao Ling naturally trusted Yun Zhi.
Yun Zhi safely secured the bracelet.
"Speaking of which, I've always been unaware, and my husband never told me that Immortal Sister, you belong to the Fishman tribe," Ao Ling said with a smile, looking at Fairy Eternity lying half-fish, half-human on the throne.
Since the journey to the East Sea began until its end, Fairy Eternity had maintained her mermaid form.
Lu Yang: "..."
Fairy, how about you change back, and while you're at it, clear out the seawater in my brain too.
...
Originally, Vast Sea Daoist Lord could have led everyone back directly to the Seek Dao Sect, but considering Lu Yang and the others only had records of leaving Great Xia, without records of returning, it would be hard to explain, so he had Lu Yang and the others descend to get registered.
Yun Zhi and Vast Sea Daoist Lord had returned by using an Embryonic Spatial Dao Fruit, with no immigration records, so naturally, they did not need to go through the entry procedures.
As for Ao Ling, her identity was special, so it was not convenient for her to appear before the public.
After Lu Yang and the others completed the procedures, Vast Sea Daoist Lord crossed the border, opened a spatial passage, and the other end of the passage was the Seek Dao Sect.
"A lot has happened in the East Sea, Junior Brother Dai is in charge of intelligence affairs and probably doesn't know about the events in the East Sea yet. You five, having experienced it yourselves, should go and inform Junior Brother Dai," Eldest Senior Sister instructed.
"Okay!"
Eldest Senior Sister invited Ao Ling to visit Sky Gate Mountain, while Lu Yang and the others rushed excitedly to the Task Hall.
They were frequent visitors to the Task Hall and easily found Elder Brother Dai's room with practiced ease.
"Elder Brother Dai, are you in?" Lu Yang knocked on the door gently.
"Come in."
Dai Bufan, seeing all five of them, laughed and said, "Didn't you go with Old Ma to have fun in the East Sea? You're back so soon? Did Vast Sea Daoist Lord bring you back?"
Dai Bufan had heard that Lu Yang was kidnapped by a Dragon Ball, and Vast Sea Daoist Lord had gone to the East Sea to find him.
Lu Yang nodded; it was indeed Vast Sea Daoist Lord who had brought them back.
Seeing Lu Yang's hesitant look, Dai Bufan teased, "Could it be that you've encountered some issues in the East Sea and want to discuss them with me?"
"Yes." Lu Yang was organizing his words, trying his best to make it so that Elder Brother Dai could smoothly accept the intelligence.
From past experience, Elder Brother Dai, although highly cultivated, was not so firm in spirit, often easily shocked.
"Elder Brother Dai, here's the thing, originally we wanted to have fun in the East Sea, and we indeed experienced a lot of the East Sea's specialties, like fighting and brawling, but rest assured, we were using our Five Elements Sect identities, we definitely didn't discredit our sect," Lu Yang said, touching the back of his head, feeling somewhat embarrassed.
"Then, well, there was a bit of an accident. I accidentally awakened the Dragon Clan Ancestor Ao Ling, and Elder Ao Ling insisted on calling me 'Senior Brother,' making the old Vast Sea ancestor call me 'Senior' too."
"The Three Mountains Taoist from Penglai Island wanted to possess Old Dragon Emperor, luckily Elder Ao Ling stopped him, and then a Lord of Great Qian showed up. Elder Ao Ling, fighting one against two, beat them both up."
"Then suddenly, an Immortal appeared, intending to attack Elder Ao Ling, but didn't manage to kill Elder Ao Ling; instead, she killed both Three Mountains Taoist and the Lord of Great Qian."
"Seeing that no one could beat this Immortal, Eldest Senior Sister stepped in to help, engaging in a fierce battle with this Immortal."
Lu Yang sighed, "We just didn't catch that Immortal, even though we inflicted serious injuries, she got away, really a pity."
After listening, Dai Bufan laughed heartily, "Junior Brother Lu, you really have a wild imagination, quite rich in creativity."
"If Elder Brother Dai doesn't believe me, Elder Ao Ling is currently in our sect, having tea with Eldest Senior Sister. She can verify what I'm saying."
Elder Brother Dai was smiling, but his eyes were empty, as if his expression was frozen at that moment.
"Elder Brother Dai? Elder Brother Dai?" Lu Yang called out twice without a response and curiously waved his hand in front of Dai Bufan.
Still no reaction.
Lu Yang tentatively poked Dai Bufan on the shoulder, Dai Bufan wobbled for a bit, then with a thud, collapsed onto the table, startling Lu Yang quite a bit.
Lu Yang gasped; he thought he had been subtle enough, so why was Elder Brother Dai's reaction still so strong?

chapters.title: Chapter 801 - 800: Junior Brother Gu, what have you realized from this?
chapters.content:
```
"Elder Brother Dai, wake up, wake up."
```
```
Dai Bufan faintly heard someone calling his name.
```
```
Who's calling me, so noisy.
```
```
Dai Bufan struggled to open his eyes and saw Lu Yang's big face very close to his own, looking at him earnestly.
```
```
Seeing that he had woken up, Lu Yang's big face moved a little further away.
```
```
Dai Bufan shook his head, feeling like he had forgotten something. What had happened before? Why had he passed out?
```
```
"Is it Junior Brother Lu? What do you need?"
```
```
Lu Yang revealed a line of people behind him, all trussed up like zongzi (rice dumplings).
```
```
Lu Yang bragged to Dai Bufan, smiling somewhat sheepishly, "Elder Brother Dai, I just went out for a little adventure and, by accident, I captured the Four Ancient Immortals, all the sleeping Semi-Immortals from the ancient past, the first Emperor Qian, the first Emperor Yu, the first Imperial Teacher, the first Emperor Xia...
Now the conflict of the Great Era will definitely be won by our Seek Dao Sect!"
```
```
"What?!"
```
```
Dai Bufan's eyes snapped open, he sat up straight, his eyes wide and round as he looked at Lu Yang's detestable big face.
```
```
He looked confusedly at Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, and the others, the trussed-up Four Ancient Immortals had all vanished without a trace.
```
```
"So it was a dream, just a dream..."
```
```
Dai Bufan felt a chill down his back, recalled the scenes from his dream, a false alarm, and was immensely relieved.
```
```
The Grand Elder was proficient in Dream Spell, and Dai Bufan also knew some dream magic skills; it had been hundreds of years since he last had a nightmare.
```
```
"Elder Brother Dai, are you alright?" Lu Yang asked concernedly, thinking to himself that Elder Brother Dai's spiritual fortitude was lacking, this was hardly anything significant. If not for fear that Elder Brother Dai might end up on the must-kill list too, I'd be tempted to reveal Grey Bean's identity to you.
```
```
Memories gradually coming back, Dai Bufan remembered what Lu Yang had said before he fainted.
```
```
"Lu Yang, you really are trouble. They say there are no Semi-Immortals in the East Sea, yet you went there, and not only did you make it so the East Sea had Semi-Immortals, you also managed to get two of them killed.
```
```
As for the battle of Immortals, it hadn't been initiated in thirty thousand years.
```
```
"Everything that happens in the East Sea will make history, and you're telling me all these events are related to you?"
```
```
Lu Yang felt strangely flustered being praised by Dai Bufan out of the blue, "It's not as great as you make it sound..."
```
```
Dai Bufan forcibly stabilized his heart of Dao, "All of you tell me properly, how did it go from playing in the East Sea for two days to causing a great battle among Immortals?"
```
```
As the one who had experienced most of it, Lu Yang recounted the majority of events, while Meng Jingzhou and the others supplemented the story.
```
```
Dai Bufan finally untangled the sequence of events. Based on what Lu Yang and his group had described, the trouble in the East Sea couldn't really be blamed on Lu Yang; it was just a matter of pure luck.
```
```
From the intelligence perspective, this was invaluable information that was worth its weight in gold. Dai Bufan could say that the events in the East Sea had shaken the Cultivation World, but the ins and outs were only fully understood by Lu Yang and his group, while others only saw the superficial phenomena.
```
```
From the perspective of the manager of the Task Hall, Dai Bufan just wanted Lu Yang to take his place.
```
```
Dai Bufan held his forehead, feeling a headache coming on. He chased the group out like he was shooing away flies, "Alright, alright, I get the picture, let me have some peace."
```
```
He needed to properly digest the intelligence from the East Sea.
```
```
After Lu Yang and the group left, Dai Bufan sat cross-legged, steadied his breath, and repeatedly went over the events of the East Sea in his mind, finally exploding in a roar.
```
```
"Even if it was luck, everything that happened was just too unbelievable!"
```
```
Boom—
```
```
In a fury, Dai Bufan's aura surged to the sky, and he ascended to the mid-stage of the Body Integration Realm in one fell swoop!
```
```
...
```
```
A month had passed since the entrance exam of the Seek Dao Sect, and the four new disciples who were recruited had all joined the tutelage of various Elders.
```
```
Daoist Xiantian became a disciple under the Vast Sea Daoist Lord, Gu Junye under the Grand Elder, Zhou Xing'er under Uncle Ba, and Zhuang Ping under the Fourth Elder.
```
```
With the Grand Elder nowhere to be found, presumably lying in a coffin somewhere, Elder Brother Dai had no choice but to take on the role of master, instructing Gu Junye in an open area behind the mountain.
```
Just the thing to change up the mood.
"Our lineage, not only in charge of the Task Hall, also holds the power of punishment; the most important thing is to avoid causing trouble. Since you've joined our lineage, you must follow the rules and remember not to stir up any problems,"
"Alright, Senior Brother," Gu Junye sat honestly across and listened attentively.
"Speaking of bad examples, Lu Yang here is the most typical case. Whenever he goes out on a mission, he's bound to cause some sort of trouble.
At first, it wasn't too bad, just getting mixed up with the Eternity Sect and the like, but then he attended the Qingzhou celebration, encountered two ancient cultivators in the Body Integration Realm and one in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, later went to Wild State, and ran into three ancient cultivators in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage...
Not long ago, he returned from the East Sea, and the affairs of the East Sea are not unrelated to him,"
Dai Bufan carefully listed Lu Yang's inexplicable connections with high-ranking cultivators, each time Lu Yang returned, what he brought back nearly scared him to death.
"Gu Junior Brother, what did you learn from all this?"
Gu Junye's eyes sparkled with admiration: "A real man should be like this!"
Dai Bufan: "..."
Is it still possible to switch out this junior brother for another?
...
When Lu Yang returned to Sky Gate Mountain, he saw Eldest Senior Sister and Ao Ling drinking tea; Ao Ling was sitting with her legs crossed, looking very relaxed and bold.
"Our Sect already has Fairy Eternity and Elder Lianyi as our guest officials; I wonder if Elder Ao Ling would be interested in becoming a guest official of our Sect."
"Damn it, Lianyi managed to get ahead of me again," Ao Ling regretted. Why was it that Jiang Lianyi woke up first and not her?
Being a step behind meant lagging in every aspect; even if she became a guest official now, she was still one Jiang Lianyi behind Fairy Eternity.
"So, what are the benefits of becoming a guest official?"
"There are of course many benefits to becoming a guest official. For example, if the elder fancies anything from our Sect, feel free to take it,"
"Oh, there's such a good deal?" Ao Ling's gaze landed on the recently arrived Lu Yang, showing a keen and playful smile, which gave Lu Yang a bad premonition.
"Junior Brother is not an object," Yun Zhi reminded.
"However, our Sect has caught a few Semi-Immortals, confiscated their possessions, and now they are all placed in the treasury; the elder can pick one item you like from there."
Now that Lu Yang had been used as bait to hook a bunch of Semi-Immortals, the foundation of the Seek Dao Sect was richer than that of the Long Clan.
"Or make contributions to our Sect, earn Contribution Points, and exchange them for 'A Day as Sect Leader Experience,' temporarily becoming the leader of our Sect; everyone in the Sect must follow the orders of the Acting Sect Leader."
"Does that include guest officials as well?"
"Guest officials are no exception."
Ao Ling slapped her thigh: "I'm in!"
"Can I also earn Contribution Points?" Fairy Eternity suddenly thought of it, as she hadn't earned any Contribution Points in a long time.
Yun Zhi said, "Fairy Eternity has made indelible contributions to our Sect, naturally, you have earned Contribution Points."
"Then I want to exchange for 'A Day as Sect Leader Experience'!" Fairy Eternity's eyes gleamed.
Yun Zhi was not surprised: "May I know how long the fairy wants to exchange for, one year or two years..."
Seek Dao Sect had caught a few Semi-Immortals, and Fairy Eternity had made many contributions, her Contribution Points could be described as massive.
"One year will do,"
Yun Zhi nodded: "That being the case, starting from today..."
"Hold on, I'm just exchanging in advance; I don't want to be the Acting Sect Master right now,"
Fairy Eternity recalled that the last two times she immediately became the Acting Sect Master, organizing a Five Elements Sect exchange meeting, and hosting the twelve-million-year celebration of the Seek Dao Sect; both were fraught with difficulties. If it hadn't been for having Lu Yang as a trump card, she would have faced significant challenges.
This time, she was going to choose a good opportunity to be the Acting Sect Master again.
This time it was Yun Zhi's turn to be astonished; she hadn't realized that when she wasn't paying attention, Fairy Eternity's intelligence had greatly improved.

chapters.title: Chapter 802 - 801: Intense Competition for the Position of Acting Sect Leader
chapters.content:
```
For the past 300,000 years, battles between immortals have occurred, but never before had such a battle openly taken place in front of the public.
The incident in the East Sea spread like a hurricane, sweeping through streets and alleys in the shortest time.
"Who would have thought, not long after the Phoenix Ancestor's awakening, the Dragon Clan Ancestor has been resurrected too!"
"Doesn't this mean that both of the Kirin Immortal's wives have made an appearance."
"I heard it was the Three Mountains Taoist who discovered the Dragon Clan Ancestor's whereabouts. He wanted to give the Old Dragon Emperor a surprise and presented it as a gift at the birthday banquet."
"Odd, I heard it was the Three Mountains Taoist who wanted to possess the Old Dragon Emperor. It went wrong midway, and his sneak attack failed, but he was stopped by the Dragon Clan Ancestor."
"That's what I heard too, otherwise, how else would they have started fighting afterwards."
"The Dragon Clan Ancestor fought against two, suppressing two Semi-Immortals all by himself. That's pretty exaggerated."
"Doesn't Venerate Zhu Tian claim to be the strongest beneath the Immortals? Could he achieve this?"
"Not sure."
"Who do you think was the Immortal that appeared later on, trying to kill the Dragon Clan Ancestor, and even fought with the Heavenly Court Sect Master?"
"They say the Ancient Heavenly Court and the Four Ancient Immortals are rivals. Could it be that the Immortal is one of the Four Ancient Immortals?"
"That doesn't seem right either. If one of the Four Ancient Immortals took action, would the Kirin Immortal just stand by and watch?"
"Then who do you think it could be?"
"It could possibly be the first Emperor Qian, the Sovereign of the Central Heavens."
"That can't be, didn't that Immortal even kill the Lord of Mountains and Rivers?"
"Maybe he's had it in for the Lord of Mountains and Rivers for a long time, so killing him with one strike isn't surprising."
"Now that you mention it, that seems accurate."
...
Qiongqi Clan.
Upon hearing the news of the Dragon Clan appearing in the East Sea, the Gold Clan Leader immediately took leave from Daoist Buyu and rushed back to the Demon Territory.
Before he even entered the ancient tomb, he heard the angry voice of the young ancestor, Jin Caiwei.
"Damn it, why do they keep popping up one after another!"
The Gold Clan Leader entered the ancient tomb and saw the young ancestor with her hair standing on end in anger, like an annoyed kitten that nobody should touch, while the Transcendence Tribulation Stage members of the Qiongqi Clan nearby didn't know how to console her.
There was no way to console her. With Jiang Lianyi's appearance, the young ancestor had to lower her goal from the top ten of the Great Era's contention to the top eleven. With Ao Ling's appearance, she would have to drop to the twelfth.
If a few more acquaintances of the young ancestor were to pop up, there'd be no point in competing in the Great Era at all.
Moreover, he suspected another significant reason for the young ancestor's fury—both of the Kirin Immortal's wives were awake, so what was left for her?
"Jin Que, why have you returned?" Jin Caiwei noticed the approach of the Clan Leader Jin Que.
The Gold Clan Leader thought to himself that he was worried about the young ancestor's outburst.
Of course, he couldn't say that.
"I've made a great brother in Great Xia. This brother is extraordinary, with an extensive network of friends. His connections spread across the entire Cultivation World, and all Body Integration Realm cultivators greet him warmly. He's extremely popular," said the Gold Clan Leader, giving a thumbs-up to Daoist Buyu, praising him without end.
"With his network, I can connect with the Seek Dao Sect."
"The Seek Dao Sect has the Vast Sea Daoist Lord, a Semi-Immortal with an embryonic Spatial Dao Fruit, a top-notch figure even among Semi-Immortals. Young ancestor, do you think we should ally with the Seek Dao Sect, joining forces to carve out our own place in the Great Era's contention?"
"Moreover, having one more friend means one less enemy. It's also good to have fewer enemies in the future." This was the insight the Gold Clan Leader derived through Daoist Buyu's connections, deduced in reverse.
Jin Caiwei fell silent; Jin Que's proposal made sense.
But she was used to being independent and didn't like to cooperate with others.
"Let me think it through thoroughly."
...
Zhu Tian sat on the imperial chair, his face full of conflict.
"How is it that even Elder Sister Ao Ling is alive now? Is it really that hard to claim kingship and dominance?"
```
He began to seriously consider the feasibility of falling into a deep sleep once again.
"How about I diligently lick Elder Brother Lu's boots?"
"I'm not sure what Elder Brother Lu lacks. Should I try sending him a couple of beauties?"
...
While everyone was discussing Ao Ling's whereabouts and the identity of the combatants in the battle of Immortals, someone quietly approached the entrance to the Seek Dao Sect's gate.
The person stepped through the gate, intimidated the River Spirit with a glance, and successfully entered the Seek Dao Sect.
With familiar ease, they climbed to the summit of Sky Gate Mountain, where they saw the practicing Lu Yang, as well as Ao Ling, who was lying on the ground, hugging her tail, and sleeping.
The person raised a hand, and terrifying spiritual essence began to converge in the palm.
Ao Ling sensed someone was trying to launch a sneak attack and abruptly opened her eyes. With a carp's flip, she got up and slapped her palm toward the intruder.
The latter-coming palm moved faster and struck first; the collision of the two palms created a wind that flipped the intruder's cloak, revealing a face Lu Yang was very familiar with.
"Elder Lianyi!"
"Jiang Lianyi, I knew it was you! No one else would sneak up like this and try to sneak attack me!" Ao Ling laughed and cursed.
Jiang Lianyi, as if she hadn't seen Ao Ling at all, bowed to Lu Yang: "Elder Brother Lu Yang, greetings."
Jiang Lianyi guessed that Ao Ling must be at the Seek Dao Sect at this time.
Then she turned her head and said to Ao Ling with a half-smile, "Junior Sister Xiao Ling, how dare you address your Senior Sister by name? That's not proper."
Ao Ling was unphased: "Being unnamed disciples, we don't need to differentiate between Senior and Junior Sisters."
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, you be the judge. I acknowledged you as my Elder Brother first, I should be Xiao Ling's Senior Sister, right?"
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, you tell us, neither I nor Lianyi qualify to be disciples to Immortal Sister, so calling you Elder Brother is overstepping our bounds. Originally, we shouldn't even divide Senior or Junior Sisters, right?"
Lu Yang felt a headache coming on. Elder Ao Ling, please don't say that, it's terrifying.
Lu Yang really wanted his Eldest Senior Sister to come back, but unfortunately, she had gone to fix a dragon pattern bracelet and wouldn't return for a while.
Luckily, although there was no Eldest Senior Sister, there was Fairy Eternity to smooth things over.
Fairy Eternity floated out from the Spiritual Space to mediate: "Since ancient times, the powerful have been revered. How about the two of you fight it out, and whoever wins will be the Senior Sister?"
Lu Yang listened and broke into a cold sweat, thinking Fairy Eternity, you might as well have stayed away.
"Our Immortal Lineage values harmony above all. There's no need to resort to fighting," Lu Yang hurriedly advised. If these two ancestors started fighting within the Seek Dao Sect, not even the Vast Sea Daoist Lord could stop them, to say nothing of the risk of ending up in a Dragon-and-Phoenix tag-team battle.
As an Elder Brother within the Seek Dao Sect, Lu Yang held considerable sway in the eyes of the Dragon and Phoenix ancestors, so since he advised against fighting, they would not fight.
Jiang Lianyi had another card up her sleeve. She suspected Ao Ling had certainly become an honored guest of the Seek Dao Sect: "Guest Elder Ao, I became a guest elder before you, so according to Sect tradition, you should address me as your Senior Sister."
Ao Ling had anticipated Jiang Lianyi would pull this move and scoffed: "You might not know, but I can exchange Contribution Points to become the Acting Sect Master, so even Guest Elder Jiang must listen to this Acting Sect Master!"
Jiang Lianyi was taken aback; indeed, she did not know that Contribution Points could be exchanged for the position of Acting Sect Master and had not paid attention to this.
"Immortal Sister, how can I earn Contribution Points?" Jiang Lianyi asked, turning towards someone more knowledgeable on the matter.
"Contribution Points, as the name implies, are earned by making contributions to the Sect, like the time I dispatched a Unification Realm practitioner who had done numerous evils and served as Acting Sect Master for three days," the knowledgeable one explained.
Jiang Lianyi's eyes lit up upon hearing this--it didn't sound difficult: "When I go back, I'll have Venerate Zhu Tian capture a couple of evil Unification Realm practitioners and present them to Elder Brother Lu Yang."
Jiang Lianyi snorted coldly, thinking anyone could make such a claim: "I will go to the East Sea and have the Dragon Clan also capture a couple of Ancient Era Unification Stage practitioners for Elder Brother Lu Yang!"
"I can even have Venerate Zhu Tian capture ten Unification Realm practitioners!"
"I can capture ten Unification Realm practitioners too!"
"I can capture someone from the Transcendance Tribulation Stage of ancient times!"
"I can also capture someone from the Transcendance Tribulation Stage of ancient times, a pair of them!"
"I can let Venerate Zhu Tian present the Demon Territory to Elder Brother Lu Yang!"
"I can unify the East Sea and present it to Elder Brother Lu Yang too!"
Lu Yang listened, completely bewildered, wondering how the conversation had led to him becoming the master of the Demon Territory and the East Sea?

chapters.title: Chapter 803 - 802: Under Fairy Eternity, a Forest of the Strong
chapters.content:
Lu Yang felt that being at mid-stage Nascent Soul, he truly couldn't bear the responsibilities of both the Demon Territory Lord and the East Sea Lord.
"Oh, it's all because of Xiao Ling and Lianyi's good intentions. The small matters of the Demon Territory and the East Sea, why don't you just accept them?" Fairy Eternity said with an easygoing tone.
"If you really don't dare to accept them, I can take them off your hands."
Obviously, Lu Yang didn't dare to accept, but there were others who did.
Lu Yang thought about it; Fairy Eternity, being the Master of the Heavenly Court and the founding emperor of the Fire Dynasty, now concurrently holding the titles of Demon Territory Lord and East Sea Lord, could be said to hold enormous authority, unmatched by anyone.
"Even if you do accept them, would you actually manage them?" Lu Yang remembered that during Ancient Times, Fairy Eternity didn't like managing, she only governed the North Star, which the Four Ancient Immortals had forced upon her.
Lu Yang suspected that giving the North Star to Fairy Eternity was probably just to keep her from wandering around everywhere, providing her with a stable home.
"What's so hard about managing? I can have Xiao Ling and Lianyi manage the East Sea and Demon Territory."
Although Fairy Eternity wasn't good at managing, she excelled in using people.
