"Immortal Sister, can you let us see where you usually live?" Jiang Lianyi asked.
"Sure, sure." Fairy Eternity obviously agreed.
Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi projected a thread of Spiritual Sense, delving into Lu Yang's Spiritual Space.
"Come, come, come, now that you're here, make yourselves at home, have a seat." Fairy Eternity warmly entertained the two Semi-Immortals.
Fairy Eternity had long ago drained the water from the Spiritual Space, and now Lu Yang's Spiritual Space had returned to its original soft and tender appearance, with a bed lying sideways against the wall, along with tables, chairs, and other furniture.
Lu Yang silently watched all this, without a word.
Whose Spiritual Space was this, after all?
Having seated herself, Jiang Lianyi then remembered that her visit was not solely to greet Ao Ling.
"What exactly is going on with the celestial battle in the East Sea? Xiao Ling, who has targeted you?"
Ao Ling frowned and thought for a while, "Explaining this matter is rather complicated. If I tell you everything, you'll be in danger."
"So, I will only share the things I can tell you."
"After the initial battle between my husband and the murderer, you entered a Playing Dead state, while I helped my husband establish the Fire Dynasty..."
"Wait a second." Before Ao Ling had finished speaking, Jiang Lianyi interrupted her.
"Didn't we agree to use the Playing Dead Technique together back then?"
...
Imperial Palace of Great Xia.
Jiang Pingan, holding a hoe, finished his farming and sat on a small stool wiping sweat, looking up at the visitor.
"Fellow Daoist Yun, what brings you here?"
Yun Zhi took out a palm-sized red parcel from her sleeve, lifted the red cloth, revealing a delicately-made dragon-patterned bracelet.
Jiang Pingan was captivated by the design of the dragon-patterned bracelet, "Eh, what exquisite craftsmanship. Who made this?"
"It's an Immortal Artifact crafted by Yingtian Immortal, capable of withstanding several attacks from Immortals under full power."
"Wow, it really is an extraordinary item." An Immortal Artifact refined to such a degree was truly peak craftsmanship, "I see the inside of the bracelet is empty, do you want me to refill it with energy?"
"This is indeed my intention."
Jiang Pingan turned the dragon-patterned bracelet over in his hands, inspecting it twice, "Alright, then let me study it."
As he studied the bracelet, Jiang Pingan recalled the information he had just received, chatting idly.
"Fellow Daoist Yun, whom did you confront in the East Sea, one of the Four Ancient Immortals?"
Because Immortals possess the Forgetfulness trait, people can only remember that a celestial battle took place in the East Sea, but cannot recall the process of the clash between the two sides.
Yun Zhi shook her head, "She's an Immortal from ancient times, but not one of the Four Ancient Immortals."
"I shouldn't say too much about her origins. If you know too much, she'll kill you too."
"Oh, does Fellow Daoist Yun think I'm not a match for that Immortal?" Jiang Pingan let out a sound, his tone laced with faint pride.
As the founding emperor, Great Xia stood unyielding for a hundred thousand years, and his contributions were immense. This was not only due to his wise decisions but also because of his unfathomably high cultivation level.
Yun Zhi nodded, "Indeed, you can't beat her."
"Alright then, if I can't win, I can't win," Jiang Pingan resigned to reality like a wilted eggplant, hanging his head low.
When Yun Zhi returned to the Seek Dao Sect with the energy-filled dragon-etched bracelet, she found Lu Yang, Ao Ling, and Jiang Lianyi neatly lying on the ground.
Yun Zhi tapped Lu Yang's forehead, knocking everyone out of his Spiritual Space.
"Eldest Senior Sister, you're finally back," Lu Yang greeted Yun Zhi with immense relief, grateful to have a solid backbone. He alone struggled to deal with the two ancestors of the Dragon and Phoenix, not to mention the troublemaking Yellow Bean.
Just now in the Spiritual Space, they almost came to blows twice.
Yun Zhi handed the dragon-etched bracelet to Ao Ling, then turned to ask Jiang Lianyi.
"Elder Lianyi, are you here to see Elder Ao Ling?" she inquired.
Jiang Lianyi snorted coldly, "Who'd want to see her? I'm here for intelligence on the East Sea."
Yun Zhi simply uttered "Oh," and didn't say more.
Excitedly emerging from Lu Yang's body, Fairy Eternity began tallying up the numbers.
"Me, the Second-in-command, Xiao Ling, Lianyi, hmm, everyone's here!"
"Who's all here?" Lu Yang's brain couldn't quite make the connection.
"Of course, it's our team to challenge Miss Yun that's all here!"
Lu Yang: "..."
Wait, Fairy, can't you guys go get yourselves killed without dragging me into it?
Fairy Eternity, with a grand wave of her hand, though she had yet to return to her prime and match Miss Yun, now had the support of Ao Ling and Lianyi, and with the Second-in-command as their strategist, they were barely equipped for battle with Miss Yun.
Seeing this, Lu Yang quickly intercepted Fairy Eternity, who was about to make a grand gesture, "Stop, stop, stop, Fairy, calm down for a second."
"I am calm," Fairy Eternity said with bluster.
"No, no, no, think about it, Fairy. We, or rather, you guys aren't ready to fight Eldest Senior Sister yet. We're still missing someone."
"Missing someone? Who else?"
Lu Yang kindly reminded her, "The Third Boss, as a Semi-Immortal, he's an important force!"
Fairy Eternity slapped her forehead, "Oh right, I forgot about him."
The Sky Gate Mountain wasn't far from the street barbecue shop, allowing Fairy Eternity to take control of Immortal Eternity from afar.
Counting money at the barbecue shop, Immortal Eternity was suddenly inspired by Fairy Eternity; it was as if someone had grabbed the back of his clothes, causing his body to bend like a shrimp as he flew backward, arriving at Sky Gate Mountain.
Immortal Eternity, upon seeing the grand assembly at Sky Gate Mountain, was clearly stunned.
What's going on here?
"Greetings to the Boss and the Second-in-command. Boss, did you call for me?" Immortal Eternity carefully asked, a bad premonition creeping over him.
Fairy Eternity nodded, affirming, "I've decided to challenge Miss Yun today. I've already devised a strategy. As a member of the Immortal Lineage, you must contribute."
Being the Boss, she naturally had to be clear about rewards and punishment, "Here's a chance for you to distinguish yourself. Go and test Miss Yun's strength as the vanguard. If you can defeat Miss Yun, I'll let you take the position of Boss!"
"Ah?"

chapters.title: Chapter 804 - 803: Fighting Yun Zhi
chapters.content:
"Go forth, Third Boss!"
Under the crafty Lu Yang's implication, Fairy Eternity's intelligence skyrocketed, and she knew to send someone to test the waters before the battle commenced.
"Xiao Ling, Lianyi, the two of you must closely observe Miss Yun's combat methods!"
Immortal Eternity intended to refuse, but he was constrained by the Eternity Dao Fruit and controlled by Fairy Eternity, rendering his reluctance futile; he had to join the fray regardless.
Seeing Fairy Eternity amass her forces, seemingly ready for a battle to the death, ripples stirred in Yun Zhi's eyes, which were calm as a lake.
The bravest among them, the Third Boss, under Fairy Eternity's control, took the initiative to attack.
"Great Free and Easy Palm!"
The Third Boss, with a determined gaze, unleashed a palm strike. Radiance exploded like a torrential flood and thunderous force. Where it passed, the very space seemed to rip open with a fissure, an impressive might indeed!
Yun Zhi pushed out a palm in return, which appeared to have no attack power or anomalies to onlookers, but only the Third Boss could clearly feel the horror of this palm strike.
Before Yun Zhi's palm even touched the Third Boss, starting from his raised right hand, he began to crack and crumble.
"Restore!"
The Third Boss shouted, and his shattered soul miraculously reassembled itself.
Yun Zhi grasped the Third Boss's neck, which started to freeze from the throat and quickly spread.
The Third Boss didn't even have time to react before he turned into an ice sculpture.
Yun Zhi tossed the Third Boss aside and said calmly, "Next."
Facing such dire straits, Fairy Eternity still managed to remain composed and calm, waving her hand to command her troops.
"Everyone, attack together!"
Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi, worthy of being Fairy Eternity's two great generals, led the charge on receiving the order.
Fairy Eternity herself had the resolve of an emperor leading a charge, spearheading the attack with such speed that she outstripped even Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi.
"Immortal Fist Technique!"
From the rear, Lu Yang watched as Fairy Eternity and her two warriors engaged in fierce battle, employing various combat techniques and frequently casting immortal magic. Eldest Senior Sister massacred all around her, an imposing sight to behold.
The air was thick with the aura of slaughter and death. Fairy Eternity and her companions fell one after another, dead beyond any doubt.
Lu Yang looked at his emotionless Eldest Senior Sister approaching and shivered.
"Eldest Senior Sister, I'm not with them!" Lu Yang immediately declared his stance; serving as a treacherous courtier in the Doudou Dynasty was just a provisional measure. His true loyalty lay with Eldest Senior Sister Yun Zhi!
"I know," Eldest Senior Sister said calmly, showing no emotion.
"Senior Fairy and the others are probably going to die once. I'll leave them in your company; I won't wait around."
"Oh."
A short while later, a miracle occurred: Fairy Eternity and her companions were resurrected, returning to the World of the Living.
"Fortunately, I had prepared in advance and used the Playing Dead Technique."
Fairy Eternity and her companions felt relieved, having avoided a shattered Dao heart.
Lu Yang felt that even if you three lose your Dao heart, it wouldn't matter.
"Second-in-command, how are you doing? Are you injured?"
"Um, I didn't fight with Eldest Senior Sister." Lu Yang felt the need to stand firm in his stance, not to follow Fairy Eternity's whims anymore.
"Then did Miss Yun hit you?"
"No." If Yun Zhi had made a move, Lu Yang would have been lying down alongside Fairy Eternity and the others.
Fairy Eternity clapped her hands: "Then you managed a draw as well."
"Who would have thought we could fight to a draw with Miss Yun. Let's keep pushing forward!"
Lu Yang: "..."
Your concept of a draw seems a bit too broad, doesn't it, Fairy?
He then pointed at the Third Boss, who was frozen in ice: "It wasn't all draws; the Third Boss lost."
Fairy Eternity waved her hand: "No problem, just kick him out of the Immortal Lineage, as if he never joined the battle."
"I've been thinking, the preparation for this battle was too hasty. Next time, we should make proper preparations in advance." Fairy Eternity began to reflect, determined not to make the same mistake twice in the same spot.
Lu Yang wondered if he was preparing his burial site in advance.
His tomb inscription would read, "Heavenly Court Young Sect Master died in the Heavenly Court's internal strife."
"Right, we didn't call the Little Medicinal Kings this time!" Fairy Eternity remembered a group of key combatants.
The fighting power of the Little Medicinal Kings was not to be underestimated.
"Let's go, off to the medicine garden," Fairy Eternity urged Lu Yang.
"What about the Third Boss?"
"Forget about him, the ice will melt on its own."
Lu Yang took the two Junior Sisters to the medicine garden.
At the entrance of the medicine garden, Uncle Ba dozed off, pondering how to instruct his newly accepted disciple, Zhou Xing'er.
It had been so long since he last taught, he had forgotten how to instruct.
"How did Martial Nephew Yun originally teach Little Lu? I remember starting with playing with a big jar?"
Just as Lu Yang arrived at the entrance of the medicine garden, he heard Uncle Ba reminiscing about past events he'd rather not remember.
"Oh, it's Little Lu..." Uncle Ba opened his eyes and upon seeing Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi standing behind Lu Yang, he was so frightened that he tumbled off his rocking chair.
Why were the Dragon and Phoenix Ancestors here?
"You've met Elder Lianyi before, so I won't introduce her. This is Elder Ao Ling, who is also part of our Heavenly Court Sect," Lu Yang said.
Uncle Ba recalled the news that had come from the East Sea, his expression peculiar.
He was very curious to know what kind of enchantment potion Lu Yang had conjured to first deceive the Phoenix Ancestor into joining the Heavenly Court Sect and then the Long Clan.
"The three of us want to stroll in the medicine garden, is that alright?" Lu Yang said with more confidence than before, backed by two Semi-Immortals.
"Are you picking herbs?"
"No, just going in to chat with the Little Medicinal Kings."
"Then go on in."
At that time, the Immortal Herbs were being cultivated in the most spiritually fortified area of the medicine garden.
"I'm telling you, don't think you're something special just because you came first. We Little Medicinal Kings are judged by age, understand? By age!" the Immortal Herbs said commandingly to the ginseng babies.
The ginseng babies were born after ancient times, thus younger than the Immortal Herbs in terms of age.
But the ginseng babies clearly didn't accept this hierarchy. They moved their leaves and roots, sneering, "Attack, let it witness the supremacy of strength!"
The Little Medicinal Kings swarmed over, either with leaf slaps or root whips, battering the Immortal Herbs into whining miserably.
When Lu Yang and his group arrived at the medicine garden, they just happened to witness this scene.
Lu Yang didn't know whether he should intervene to stop all this or wait until the Little Medicinal Kings were done before showing himself.
Soon, Lu Yang didn't have to ponder anymore. The tall Enlightenment Tree King saw Lu Yang and company and pulled apart the Little Medicinal Kings and the Immortal Herbs.
"You have arrived, human race boy?" the ginseng babies greeted with their roots.
"What 'human race boy'? This here is the Immortal Lineage Second Boss; show some respect, you little medicinal kids!" Fairy Eternity burst forth to flaunt her authority.
"You, who are you!" The Immortal Herbs, seeing Fairy Eternity for the first time, were stuttering in fright, overwhelmed by her presence.
"Hmph, this Immortal is the first of the Five Ancient Immortals, Master of the Heavenly Court—Fairy Eternity!"
"An Immortal?" The Immortal Herbs were stunned, finding it hard to believe that an Immortal was dwelling within Lu Yang.
No wonder Lu Yang had such formidable fighting capabilities; they must all be the result of the Immortal's tutelage.
"This Immortal has come today with two of the Four Imperial Protectors to visit you and to deliver some good news!"
"What's the good news, what's the good news?" The three-inch-tall Little Medicinal Kings jumped around Lu Yang excitedly, welcoming Fairy Eternity's inspection.
"Just now the four of us battled with Miss Yun and ended in a tie," Fairy Eternity said.
"A tie, how impressive!" The Little Medicinal Kings looked up to Fairy Eternity with admiration, their eyes full of longing.
"This Immortal thinks that if we bring you along next time, it might change the outcome of the battle. Are you willing to join the fight?"
"We are willing!" The Little Medicinal Kings shouted in unison.
Fairy Eternity nodded, pleased with the Little Medicinal Kings' response. Their readiness alone was a step up from the Third Boss.

chapters.title: Chapter 805 - 804: Late Stage Nascent Soul
chapters.content:
The Little Medicinal Kings had long been dissatisfied with Yun Zhi's atrocities, and naturally, they were overjoyed to have someone willing to lead them in a struggle against her.
Lu Yang felt lucky that the Little Medicinal Kings were cultivated in the Seek Dao Sect's medicinal garden. The people of the Seek Dao Sect bore no ill will toward the Little Medicinal Kings; otherwise, given their intelligence, who knows how many times they might have been duped outside.
Even Fairy Eternity could deceive the Little Medicinal Kings, which shows just how gullible they were.
"Big sis, when are we going to have a showdown with Yun Zhi!" The ginseng baby was quite excited.
Fairy Eternity had followed Lu Yang for quite some time and had learned one or two percent of Lu Yang's cunning schemes.
Fairy Eternity waved her hand, "There's an old military saying, 'Haste does not bring success to the seeker of tofu.' We've just had a fight with Miss Yun, and she must be on guard now. Acting now is not the best choice; we need to catch her unprepared."
Fairy Eternity had a very high reputation among the Little Medicinal Kings. Whatever she said, they would listen to, and if she said to pick another time to challenge Yun Zhi, then another time it would be.
Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi watched Fairy Eternity getting along with the Little Medicinal Kings and murmured quietly, "This is the heart of innocence, truly enviable."
"That's where Immortal Sister is stronger than us."
The Ascending Immortal Grass had not yet had time to acclimate to the atmosphere of the medicinal garden and was not very familiar with the Seek Dao Sect, not understanding why the Little Medicinal Kings were so excited.
"The Yun Zhi you mention is that difficult to deal with?"
The ginseng baby crossed its root arms and felt the Ascending Immortal Grass was arrogant, "If you can beat the major demon Yun Zhi, I'll let you be the boss of this medicinal garden!"
The Ascending Immortal Grass sneered. Don't think it was just taking hits before; it actually had a trump card: it could not only promote the growth of cultivators' cultivation levels and the age of spiritual plants, but it could also use this ability on itself, enhancing its own age.
By doing so, it would be able to transform successfully and possess the power of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage from the start!
The last spiritual plant with such a heaven-defying ability was the Firmament Tree!
"It's a deal!"
With a menacing aura, the Ascending Immortal Grass rushed to Sky Gate Mountain to challenge Yun Zhi and establish its prestige in the medicinal garden.
"Hey, are you Yun Zhi? I'm here to challenge you!"
At that moment, Yun Zhi was inviting Gan Tian to join her for tea and Enlightenment, while also helping her to solve problems on her path of cultivation.
A red clay stove boiling with Enlightenment tea leaves rolling in the pot. The fragrance of the tea was so enticing that just smelling it made one feel enlightened.
Upon hearing the arrogant challenge of the Ascending Immortal Grass, after a moment of thought, she grabbed it and stuffed it into the teapot to be boiled together with the leaves of the Enlightenment tea.
Yun Zhi poured the tea, and the fragrance was even more intoxicating than before. She pushed the red clay teacup towards Gan Tian, "Drink it, it will increase your cultivation level."
...
Ao Ling had been staying at the Seek Dao Sect for half a month, during which time she not only studied the current power structure but also visited Captive Peak. She had given a good scare to both the prisoners and the children's Grandmaster, and had met Daoist Xiantian, scaring him just as much.
Lu Yang also accompanied Ao Ling to visit the Scripture Pavilion, where they saw walls filled with cultivation techniques.
Lu Yang was quite nervous about going to the Scripture Pavilion, worried that his master might still have "Dragon and Phoenix Transformation" hidden there. If Ao Ling found it, he would have to inherit the position of Sect Leader with tears in his eyes.
As the saying goes, a scourge left for a thousand years, Ao Ling did not find "Dragon and Phoenix Transformation."
...
Daoist Buyu, who was telling fortunes at his stall, suddenly sneezed.
"Who's thinking of me now?"
He thought about all the people he had provoked, and it seemed like any one of them could be thinking of him.
```
"Speaking of which, ever since Xiao Jin went home to visit his family, my luck has gotten a lot better," Lu Yang mused.
…
Half a month later, Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi left the Seek Dao Sect together. Lu Yang didn't know whether Ao Ling intended to explore the outside world or if he planned to unify the East Sea to present it to Fairy Eternity.
After the departure of the two great ancestors of the Dragon and Phoenix, Lu Yang began to focus on his cultivation.
Following his journey to the East Sea, he realized that his cultivation level was too low to be involved in the struggles of immortals.
Lu Yang was incredibly earnest, devoting most of his time to cultivation or sparring with Invincible Nascent Soul.
After enduring a long period of one-sided beatings, Lu Yang's combat skills sharpened considerably. He could now exchange a couple of moves with Invincible Nascent Soul before getting beaten.
"Keep it up, Second-in-command, you'll soon defeat Invincible Nascent Soul!" Fairy Eternity encouraged Lu Yang without regard to the facts but full of good intention.
A year and more whisked by.
The Cultivation World was calm and quiet; no major incident like the one in the East Sea drew people's attention.
The only topic of repeated discussion was the revival of the Dragon Clan Ancestor, who seemed poised to conquer the East Sea with fierce momentum. People speculated whether he had been instructed by the Heavenly Court Sect to unify the East Sea in preparation for the great era's coming struggles.
Leading the Sea Clan, Ao Ling took Penglai Island under his control, cracking down hard on rampant piracy issues there.
"The Calabash Brothers Stir Up the Sea," produced by Dream Mirage, received critical acclaim, especially the scenes showing lessons taught to the Kunpeng Clan. The Sea Clan repeatedly studied these scenes.
At the same time, "The Calabash Brothers Stir Up the Sea" also promoted the East Sea. Cultivators from Great Xia noticed vast unexplored areas of the sea containing various precious natural treasures of immense value, leading to an increase in the number of cultivators heading to the East Sea.
Lu Yang didn't pay much attention to external affairs; he continued his diligent cultivation and didn't leave the Seek Dao Sect. When not cultivating, he simply visited places within the sect he hadn't been to before.
Luckily, Vast Sea Daoist Lord didn't bother Lu Yang. Lu Yang never saw even a shadow of him. According to Junior Brother Qi Tongtian, aside from teaching him cultivation, Vast Sea Daoist Lord was using the Embryonic Spatial Dao Fruit to go to the East Sea Dragon Palace.
Out of a sense of brotherhood, Lu Yang reminded Qi Tongtian to inform Old Meng about this matter.
At that moment, he opened his mouth wide, like a whale engulfing water, as endless external spiritual energy surged into his body, further expanding his meridians, which had already reached their limits.
Lu Yang's skin quickly turned red, a sign that his meridians were on the verge of rupturing.
He clenched his teeth tight; despite the pain that made him want to roll on the floor, he never let out a cry.
Boom—
As the engulfed spiritual energy reached a critical point, it was like a door had opened. Lu Yang's body visibly changed at a remarkable rate, his meridians becoming more resilient and able to accommodate more spiritual energy.
"Phew—breakthrough achieved."
Lu Yang exhaled a breath of turbid air and stood up with a smile, having finally made a breakthrough to the late Nascent Soul stage. As a holder of the Sword Spirit Root, reaching the late Nascent Soul stage was merely a matter of time for him, without any real bottlenecks.
"With my current methods, not even someone in the late Spirit Transformation stage could bother me."
The methods Lu Yang referred to were conventional ones, excluding Senior Sister's Imitation Fist and other remarkable powers.
"And as Void Refinement stage cultivators rarely act on whim, this means, as long as I don't encounter someone in the Body Integration Realm, I can roam freely in the outside world!"
Lu Yang laughed heartily, feeling he truly lived up to the name of a Nascent Soul old monster.
Fairy Eternity yawned in the Spiritual Space, "But Second-in-command, the enemies you encounter outside never seem to be below the Body Integration Realm."
Lu Yang's smile stiffened, realizing she had a point.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 806 - 805: The Research Achievements of the Yaoyang Sect
chapters.content:
Lu Yang had just excitedly reached the late stage of the Nascent Soul phase when Fairy Eternity poured cold water on his excitement.
Seeing this, Fairy Eternity hastened to comfort him, "Oh dear, reaching the late stage of the Nascent Soul is already quite remarkable. Think about it, it's not every time you come across an enemy outside that they are in the Body Integration Realm."
Lu Yang recalled the enemies he had encountered: Emperor Yu Wu Youdao, Void Venerate, Nightmare Supreme, Gray Bean... indeed, none were in the Body Integration Realm.
Just as Lu Yang was reminiscing about his past achievements, he suddenly felt a token in his bosom heating up. He took it out and saw that it was the Yaoyang Sect trying to contact him.
The message on the token said that the Yaoyang Sect had recently made some breakthroughs in solar energy research and hoped that Young Master Lu could come and offer guidance. It was the same old place, the barbecue restaurant in Yanjiang County, the headquarters of the restaurant.
It also mentioned offering the annual dividends of the barbecue restaurant to the Heavenly Court Sect.
Lu Yang, having no other matters at hand, agreed to go. The Saint Heir Long Jingzhou was still in seclusion, and it was uncertain when he would emerge.
This small matter did not necessitate the need for Eldest Senior Sister to make an appearance and show support, so Lu Yang spoke with several Protector Heavenly Kings, who all indicated there was no problem.
The Heavenly Court Sect set out in a grand fashion.
…
At the barbecue restaurant headquarters, Sect Leader Chi of the Yaoyang Sect and Mu Baiyi of the Jiuyou Sect were very nervous, as if they were not just welcoming a colleague but rather preparing for an inspection by a superior.
It was only natural for the two Sect Leaders to be afraid, given the immense impact of the battle among immortals in the East Sea, which implied that there was a hierarchy of strength among immortals, and that Sect Leader Yun was more powerful than another immortal.
Add to that the outstanding performance of Ao Ling in the East Sea and the widespread fame of Heavenly Venerate Dou.
All this pointed to one fact—that the Heavenly Court Sect was the foremost power in the world.
"Haha, long time no see, Sect Leaders," Lu Yang greeted with a cheerful smile.
Seeing that neither Sect Leader Yun nor Heavenly Venerate Dou was there, and neither were the Dragon and Phoenix ancestors, both Sect Leader Chi and Mu Baiyi quietly sighed in relief, feeling much less psychological pressure.
But facing Young Sect Master Lu, the heir of the Heavenly Court Sect, they dared not be careless.
Young Sect Master Lu took his seat, while the five indifferent Protector Heavenly Kings stood behind him. The two Sect Leaders personally bent down to pour tea for him.
"Young Sect Master, this is the income of the barbecue restaurant from the past year, as well as the account books for revenue and expenses," Mu Baiyi said cautiously, pushing a Storage Ring towards Lu Yang. The Spirit Stones stored within the ring were massive in quantity. Mu Baiyi felt reluctant to part with so many Spirit Stones.
Lu Yang gave a signal with his eyes, and the Fifth Elder, Multi-treasure Heavenly King, took the Storage Ring and scanned it with his Spiritual Sense. He then respectfully bent over and said to Lu Yang,
"Young Sect Master, the tally is correct."
Lu Yang, utterly bored, yawned, "Then let's accept it."
Mu Baiyi felt a pang of emotion; truly, those from the Heavenly Court Sect couldn't care less about such trivial amount of money, so much so that they didn't even bother to inquire how many Spirit Stones were in the Storage Ring.
"Mu Sect Leader came for me, not just for a trivial matter like Spirit Stones, right?" Lu Yang said with a smile, sipping his tea as if he saw through Mu Baiyi's thoughts.
Mu Baiyi forced a smile, "Young Sect Master is insightful, indeed I am puzzled by a matter and seek your guidance."
"What is it?"
Mu Baiyi chose his words carefully, observing Lu Yang's reaction as he spoke, fearful of touching upon any taboo, "I heard that Ao Ling, the Ancient Ancestor of your sect, once said at the Old Dragon Emperor's birthday banquet, 'The mortals no longer know about Heavenly Court and Netherworld.' I wonder what this 'Netherworld' really is..."
Lu Yang had anticipated that Mu Baiyi would ask this question and there was a hint of mirth in his eyes, "What, have you forgotten what I said? I told you long ago that our Heavenly Court Sect and your Jiuyou Sect had an ancient bond."
Mu Baiyi's heart slowed at these words, his face filled with an excitement he couldn't conceal, "Then this Netherworld really is..."
"The ancient place that governed the Nether and Reincarnation. All things under heaven, after death, have their Souls enter the Netherworld to undergo the six paths of Reincarnation."
Lu Yang didn't deceive Mu Baiyi; the underworld was indeed just as he said, a fact that Ao Ling had told him.
Not only Mu Baiyi but also Sect Leader Yun, who had always been at odds with the Jiuyou Sect, widened his eyes in disbelief.
It wasn't just them who had taken note of Ao Ling's mention of the underworld; many people in the Cultivation World were speculating about its meaning.
But no one could clearly define what the underworld actually was.
Now, at last, Young Sect Master Lu had confirmed that the underworld was the ancient Nine Nether!
The five Protector Heavenly Kings also heard this for the first time, but they knew that Lu Yang was bluffing and didn't react much.
Mu Baiyi's face flushed with excitement; luckily, the Heavenly Court Sect kept their old ties, otherwise, the good job at the barbecue shop wouldn't have fallen to the Jiuyou Sect.
There was also what Young Sect Master Lu had said before, that if the Jiuyou Sect wanted to make a presence in the strife of the Great Era, they had to plan gradually, with an aim to "allying with the Demon Territory and East Sea"!
Now that the Long Clan had unified the East Sea, that saying was soon to come true!
What Young Sect Master Lu said that day was gradually coming to fruition!
Was it a stroke of genius or a carefully premeditated plan?
Whichever it was, it was enough to demonstrate the terrifying nature of the Young Sect Master Lu!
"Sect Leader Yun, let me take a look at whatever your sect has been researching," Lu Yang said with interest.
It had been over a year to produce results, which was not a slow pace. Things like solar-powered lights and solar water heaters were innovations that had never existed in the Cultivation World. The Yaoyang Sect had not only to research but also to reduce the costs for mass promotion among the public, which were challenging points.
In Lu Yang's anticipatory gaze, Sect Leader Yun took out a scroll from his storage ring.
The scroll was spread open, depicting a sun with several panels of unknown material around it; given the size of the sun, those panels were terrifyingly large.
The panels were engraved with many complex arrays. Lu Yang, who knew nothing about array methods, had no idea what they were for.
Uncle Ba, the Hundred Medicine Heavenly King who was an expert in array methods, let out a light gasp.
"Sect Leader Yun, this is…?" Lu Yang didn't need to feign understanding; the complexity of these array methods was such that probably only a cultivator in the Body Integration Realm could comprehend them.
When asked about his specialty, Sect Leader Yun was very excited: "Ever since Young Sect Master Lu mentioned solar energy to me, our entire sect was shaken and has been researching how to fully utilize solar energy."
"But halfway through our research, we encountered a problem. There are six sides to the continent and we, Central Continent, are just one side."
"This means that no matter how fully we utilize solar energy, we can only use one-sixth of it, with the remaining five-sixths going to waste."
"So?" Lu Yang guessed what the scroll's contents might be.
"So, we are planning to assemble an array method on the surface of the sun that can collect solar energy, ideally enveloping the entire sun to prevent any waste of solar energy."
"Then transfer the collected solar energy down here."
"Only, researching this set of array methods is quite difficult, but fortunately, our entire sect has worked together and finally overcome the technical hurdles."
"The array method on the scroll is the fruit of our research."
Lu Yang: "..."
Aren't you taking steps that are a bit too large?

chapters.title: Chapter 807 - 807: 806
chapters.content:
Lu Yangxin said, "Your Yaoyang Sect really dares to dream, installing a complete Array Method around the sun."
"Solar energy includes both light and heat, and your Yaoyang Sect has monopolized it. What are the Demon Territory, East Sea, and Buddha Country supposed to use? Aren't you afraid they'll wipe you out?"
"There's also the far north; just because there are fewer people doesn't mean there are no Cultivators."
"It's already cold up there, and you're taking away the sunlight."
"This is like making enemies of the whole world."
"And with such a massive project, can your Yaoyang Sect actually pull it off?"
Hearing Lu Yang's soft sigh led the Sect Master to become anxious.
"Young Sect Master Lu, is there a problem with our plan?"
"There is an Immortal-level grand array on the sun that blocks it, forbidding anyone from approaching. Do you know who is responsible for this Immortal-level grand array?"
The Sect Master shook his head; they had investigated for a long time, many colleagues had died without uncovering the origin of the Immortal-level grand array.
With a grave voice, Lu Yang revealed a secret, "According to investigations by the Master of our sect, that array was laid out by both Emperor Qian, the first Celestial Emperor, and Emperor Yu, the first Wu Yao, respectively. It's a struggle between two Immortals separated by a hundred thousand years, involving even deeper matters not meant for you to understand."
"By setting up another Array Method around the sun, are you trying to get involved in the struggle of Immortals?"
In the past, the Yaoyang Sect might send people to the sun without Emperor Qian's concern, but if the Yaoyang Sect were to install another layer of Array Method around the sun, it would undoubtedly be a direct provocation.
If the Yaoyang Sect were to be destroyed by Emperor Qian, Lu Yang wouldn't care; one less demonic sect is actually preferable.
Lu Yang's concern was that Emperor Qian might act without restraint, using too powerful moves and harming the innocent.
Considering the actions of the mountain and river lords, it wasn't beyond possibility that their superior could do such a thing.
The Sect Master was shocked, breaking into a cold sweat. To think there were two sorts of Immortal-level grand arrays on the sun, involving the Yaoyang Sect in the struggle of Immortals could mean obliteration, a fate even worse than death!
"Have you researched anything else?"
"Yes, yes." The Sect Master hurriedly responded, continuing to search within his Storage Ring.
As he searched, he said, "While researching how to set up an Array Method around the sun, we incidentally discovered some by-products, such as..."
Lu Yang nodded, this time it sounded more reasonable.
Before he could see what the Sect Master had taken out, he found himself plunged into darkness, making Lu Yang worry that the Sect Master intended to take advantage of the chaos to harm him.
The meeting of The Three Great Demon Sects took place after the barbecue restaurant closed, at night, with the lights on in the hall.
As soon as the Sect Master took out the research achievement, it was as if a sinister wind blew through, extinguishing all the lights.
Fortunately, none present at The Three Great Demon Sects' emergency meeting were weak; they could all use Spiritual Sense, allowing them to see clearly without the need for light.
"What's the deal with your candle?"
Lu Yang observed with his Spiritual Sense that what the Sect Master had taken out was a large red candle. As soon as this candle appeared, all the other candles in the room went out.
"This is called a solar-powered charging candle. It can absorb solar energy during the day, and then can be lit at night."
"And the sudden darkness in this room is because...?"
"This thing can absorb all the light and heat around it, so naturally, there's no light left when it absorbs them," the Sect Master explained as if it was obvious.
"...Isn't the absorption efficiency of your candle a bit too high?"
If this is just a by-product of researching the sun's Array Method, the Cultivation World might plunge into an ice age and a dark era at the same time.
"Isn't it good to have higher efficiency?" Everyone says the higher the efficiency the better. In pursuit of ultimate efficiency, the Sect Master had spared no efforts.
"Keep it down, will you?"
"Alright."
"Old Chi, get us a box of these high-efficiency solar energy-absorbing candles for our Jiuyou Sect," Mu Baiyi said, showing great interest in the candles.
What a great invention, with these candles, why worry about lacking atmosphere at our meetings in the future?
Lu Yang didn't fully understand the aesthetic tastes of the Jiuyou Sect.
"Any other research results?"
"Yes, we've also discovered that we can use solar energy to boil water."
Lu Yang nodded, solar water heaters, I've seen these things before, they're handy.
Master Chi lit the candle, and the room once again became bright with light.
Master Chi brought out a large wooden barrel, which was another result of their research; it had absorbed solar energy during the day.
He filled it with water, and in just a few breaths, the water in the barrel began boiling, bubbling energetically with high efficiency, as usual.
Excited by the sight, Master Chi said, "We've also discovered that the steam produced from boiling water contains immense power, which could possibly be harnessed to do something with steam!"
"Although in this area, we've only conducted preliminary research and haven't achieved any significant results yet."
Lu Yang: "..."
This is the first time I've seen someone research steam machines in reverse from solar energy.
"Stop researching steam and focus on solar energy."
"Got any other research results?"
Master Chi scratched his head awkwardly; their main focus over the past year was on trying to establish an Array Method around the sun, which unfortunately, Lu Yang rejected. The solar candles and water heaters were merely byproducts.
"Although there are no other research results, our two sects' collaboration has uncovered that we can establish a new line of business."
"What new business?"
This time it was Mu Baiyi's turn to explain: "You see, in some places they have the custom of burial at sea, where bodies are given to rivers, lakes, and seas, to be consumed by fish, symbolizing a return to nature."
"We could expand our thinking and perform cremations by sending the bodies to the sun. According to the death statistics provided by Old Chi, even those at the Body Integration Realm would disintegrate into ash on the sun."
"Don't you see, the principle is similar to that of burial at sea, even more so thorough in death?"
"Considering that a person's soul only disperses seven days after death, we can schedule the cremation for after those seven days to prevent the soul from directly melting upon contact with the sun."
Clearly, Mu Baiyi had given this a lot of thought, even taking the folk custom of mourning in the first seven days into account.
"Young Sect Master Lu, do you think this business is feasible?"
Lu Yang was silent for a long time, then slowly asked, "Putting other aspects aside, running a barbecue joint while operating a cremation service, even that of cremation by fire, what do you think customers will think?"
The two sect leaders thought about it, and it did seem a bit inappropriate.
"Well, it's apparent you two have put a lot of effort into cooperative win-win strategies, but the thought process has gone astray. Keep up the good work!" like an elder brother, Lu Yang vigorously patted the shoulders of the two sect leaders, with an encouraging tone in his voice.
"If the candles and barrels can be mass-produced, they are bound to be widely popular."
On his way back to the Seek Dao Sect, Lu Yang suddenly asked,
"Elders, what do you think of Yaoyang Sect's research results?"
The Fifth Elder said earnestly, "They are suitable to join our Refining Peak."

chapters.title: Chapter 808 - 807: High Efficiency
chapters.content:
Lu Yang wondered how the Refining Peak relied on patent fees to make money for the Seek Dao Sect with this kind of mindset.
He felt that he was ultimately someone with a steadfast Dao heart, and although he was surrounded by a bunch of lunatics, he had never been disturbed by these people and his thinking remained sane.
Fairy Eternity nodded in approval at Lu Yang's inner thoughts and pointed at the five Elders, "Exactly, they are all lunatics, only the two of us think normally."
"Just look at what the Yaoyang Sect has been researching, utterly failing to make full use of solar energy."
"If it were me, I'd simply push the sun towards the far northern lands, melt the glaciers, revive the vegetation, and make the climate pleasant."
Lu Yang thought to himself, does Fairy want to turn the far north into the far northern seas?
When Lu Yang returned to Sky Gate Mountain, ready to hand over the offerings collected from the Jiuyou Sect to Eldest Senior Sister, he happened upon Eldest Senior Sister and Meng Jingzhou talking about something.
"Junior Brother is here too, that's perfect. You two are clever, it's suitable for you to handle this matter," Yun Zhi called Lu Yang over.
Initially, Yun Zhi wanted Lu Yang to handle it, but at the time, Lu Yang was busy hoodwinking two Sect Masters at the barbecue stand, so she had to settle for a second choice and called Meng Jingzhou, who had just come out of seclusion.
"Eldest Senior Sister, what's the matter?"
"You know that our founder has joined our Sect for a year now, and he has successfully cultivated to the Foundation Establishment Stage," she replied.
"According to the rules, after reaching the Foundation Establishment Stage, each disciple must complete two tasks each year."
"Originally, I thought the founder didn't need to do Sect missions; he had enough experience when he was young."
"But the founder is very stubborn, saying he can't be treated as a special case. He insists on doing the tasks. A few days ago, he just completed his first task, and during the mission, there was an accident."
"What kind of accident?" Lu Yang asked, curious.
"He got lost."
Lu Yang: "..."
"I'm worried he might encounter more danger, so I wanted to find someone sharp to follow him."
"I see," Lu Yang nodded. That was indeed in line with the founder's personality.
"Don't worry, Eldest Senior Sister. Leave it to Old Meng and me; we'll make sure to protect the founder!"
Meng Jingzhou considered another issue, "However, it seems that the founder isn't very willing to have someone follow him. If we were to secretly follow and only intervene when he's in danger, wouldn't that give us away?"
Yun Zhi was also thinking about how both Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had interacted with the founder. Even if they were discovered, out of consideration for his own dignity, the founder wouldn't make a fuss about it.
After pondering for a moment, Lu Yang said, "This problem isn't too difficult to solve; we just need to add one item to the exchange goods in the Task Hall."
...
"Before setting off, I should exchange for some life-saving items," Daoist Xiantian with an unseasoned face but seasoned in the ways of the world mused, never leaving without preparation.
However, he didn't have any spare spirit stones on hand to exchange for anything too extravagant.
"Let's see, Revitalizing Pills, can quickly restore spiritual essence, a hundred and twenty Contribution Points, a bit expensive, huh."
"Sorrow Breaker, a highly toxic substance, ten Contribution Points... wait, why does the Sect sell poison, and why so cheaply?"
"Triple Yang Strength Elixir, upon consumption one can obtain the power of Triple Yang, significantly boosting fighting capability for a short period without side effects, a hundred Contribution Points."
Daoist Xiantian pondered. It seemed like an elixir for a temporary boost in fighting power, which would be very helpful to him, and the price was right.
```
"That's the one."
Daoist Xiantian finished preparing and set out for his destination.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou followed covertly. Now, both were at the Nascent Soul late stage, while Daoist Xiantian was only at the Foundation Establishment early stage, utterly unaware of their presence.
"What task did our ancestor receive?" Lu Yang asked Meng Jingzhou.
"It's said that there's a small village called Wang Family Ditch in Ji State, located deep in the mountains. To reach the town at the foot of the mountain takes two hours of walking. A series of disappearances have occurred in Wang Family Ditch, involving able-bodied young men. These men seemed to have lost their minds, as if lured away by something."
"The government office has sent people to investigate, but alas, no significant findings. The area around Wang Family Ditch is mountainous, and even spreading one's Spiritual Sense would not easily reveal the missing men's whereabouts, let alone the fact that there are no powerful cultivators in that area capable of deploying Spiritual Sense to search for people."
"Senior Brothers from the Task Hall speculated based on intelligence that these disappearances might have been the work of demon creatures that slipped into Great Xia and possess strength below the Golden Core Stage."
Although Daoist Xiantian was at the Foundation Establishment early stage, he had combat capabilities comparable to those at the Golden Core early stage. It could be said that no one in the Foundation Establishment early stage was stronger than he was, a testament to the advantage of starting over after disbanding cultivation.
Lu Yang pondered for a moment, "This task sounds like it will take quite some time. Ancestor has a lot of work cut out for him."
"The disappeared are all able-bodied men. I wonder if the creature is after their masculine energy for a blood sacrifice or covets their robust bodies for Intercourse Cultivation."
Meng Jingzhou nodded, "The demon creature is cautious, making those who disappeared leave the village voluntarily, leaving almost no clues behind. And after such a long time, clues are even harder to find."
The two discussed the task. Had it been them, they'd also have no better plan. They could only start by visiting and investigating to determine any commonalities among the missing, then disguise themselves as ordinary people, hoping to be abducted by the demon creature.
This whole process would take at least half a month.
And that's not counting the journey to and fro.
Daoist Xiantian, riding a flying vessel, closed his eyes to meditate, continually simulating in his mind how to complete the task.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou flew stealthily behind, almost getting detected by the captain.
If they had been discovered, they'd surely be suspected of wanting to rob the flying vessel, like Tribulation Cultivators.
Fortunately, both were seasoned veterans and encountered no mishaps.
Daoist Xiantian estimated that they were almost at the destination. He popped open an umbrella and with a deep leap, jumped into the dense forest. Relaxing his right hand, the umbrella snapped shut and whizzed back to the flying vessel.
"This should be near Wang Family Ditch," murmured Daoist Xiantian, looking around. The desolation gave him a bit of trepidation.
"Should be, right?"
Following the information in the task and his instinct, he walked into the mountains.
After about an hour, he finally saw signs of human habitation.
It was a cave, where at its entrance lay an extinguished fire pit, seeming to have been put out less than a day ago.
Daoist Xiantian entered the cave and, hearing noises inside, quickened his pace. Then he called out loudly,
"Excuse me, could you tell me the way to Wang Family Ditch?"
As he took in the situation inside the cave, he paused, taken aback.
In the cave, there was a seductive woman, bare-skinned, flickering her serpent-like tongue while entwined with several sturdy men.
The seductive woman saw Daoist Xiantian and also froze.
"A cultivator? How did you find this place?"
```

chapters.title: Chapter 809 - 808 The Power of Three Yangs
chapters.content:
The Snake Demon couldn't understand how her hidden lair, which was extremely secretive, could have been discovered. How had they found this place?
"Eh? What have I found?" Daoist Xiantian was bewildered by the Snake Demon's question. If I had found the place, would I still be asking for directions?
In the shadows, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou looked at each other. How come they had bypassed the process and ended up directly in the enemy's lair?
All four individuals present were perplexed.
"Little Cultivator, come over and play with sister," the Snake Demon enticed, her smooth white hair flowing, her alluring eyes like silk, and her voice as captivating as the gentle orchid. She extended a finger, beckoning Daoist Xiantian.
The Snake Demon was very confident in herself. She was a beauty, and with her talent for seduction, no cultivator at the Foundation Establishment stage could resist her charm.
She could tell that he was merely a cultivator who had just achieved Foundation Establishment and that he had delicate features, perfect to be kept as a boy toy.
The Snake Demon's seduction technique was excellent, and even Daoist Xiantian nearly fell for it, but he was a Great Cultivator of the Body Integration Realm who had started over after disbanding his cultivation. He had his own ways to counteract the seduction.
"Eyes of Suiyue!" He wiped his eyes, and the effect of the seduction technique no longer influenced him.
"What are the Eyes of Suiyue?" Lu Yang was puzzled. Although he had never heard of them, judging by the name, they seemed to have something to do with Suiyue. Could it be an ability that predicted the opponent's moves—a foresight?
Meng Jingzhou shook his head; he had not heard of it either. Lu Yang had no choice but to ask Fairy Eternity, who indeed knew about it.
Fairy Eternity, with a rare serious expression, stated, "It's a type of eye related to time that can see what someone will look like when they're old."
Lu Yang: "..."
"Then, Fairy, can you do it?"
Lu Yang thought, although its effects were questionable, it did seem like a technique capable of resisting the art of seduction.
"No, I don't, don't learn it," Fairy Eternity rejected him outright.
Daoist Xiantian flipped his palm, and a small golden seal appeared with "Daoist Xiantian's Inquiry" engraved on it.
This was his Life-bound Magical Treasure. Originally, it was a magic artifact of Body Integration level, but considering his current Cultivation Level couldn't fully activate it, he had to seal most of its functions and suppress the magic artifact to the level he could wield.
"Go!" Daoist Xiantian shouted, flinging the small seal towards the Snake Demon.
The small seal flashed with golden light, dazzling the Snake Demon. She attempted to twist her waist to dodge but was too slow. It grazed her waist, leaving a deep gash, from which demon blood flowed freely.
"Human race cultivator, you're seeking death!"
The Snake Demon used her bloodline power to temporarily stop the bleeding, though the wound didn't fully heal.
She transformed in a flash into a thick white python with venomous fangs, opening her maw wide and lunging at Daoist Xiantian.
"Just a little Cultivator who has just established his foundation, and you dare to come here alone!" The Snake Demon's voice was filled with resentment. Since he didn't want to be a boy toy, he might as well stay!
Daoist Xiantian, with his rich combat experience, remained calm and took a big step back. The spot he had been in was crushed into a crater by the Snake Demon.
From the brief exchange, he concluded that the opponent was at the Golden Core early stage.
Seeing the Snake Demon still trying to bite him, Daoist Xiantian made a hand gesture, enlarging the Daoist Xiantian's Inquiry Seal and lodging it in the Snake Demon's mouth.
"Demon-Subduing Talisman!"
He brought his two fingers together and quickly drew a talisman in the air, striking the Snake Demon's vital point. The Snake Demon wanted to scream in agony, but her mouth was blocked by Daoist Xiantian's Inquiry Seal, rendering her unable to cry out.
"Shuang'er, I'm coming to help you!"
A voice echoed from the depths of the cave, another transforming Snake Demon appeared, identical to the first one.
"Twins?" Daoist Xiantian hadn't expected an accomplice, and this one was also at the Golden Core early stage.
"The two of us have been hiding here and still got discovered; seems you have some tricks up your sleeve. Why don't you stay and enjoy yourself with us?"
"How can you blame me for finding you when you hide in such an obvious place?" Daoist Xiantian also realized that these two Snake Demons were the targets of the mission. The robust men scattered all over the ground were the missing people from Wang Family Ditch.
The problem is, if it's a place he can find just by wandering around, why did you two sisters think it was well hidden?
The elder snake demon forcefully smacked the snake demon named Shuang'er, compelling her to spit out the magic seal.
The elder snake demon also transformed into a gigantic white python, and the snake demon sisters acted with perfect understanding, simultaneously striking and circling Daoist Xiantian.
Daoist Xiantian tried multiple times to break through the blockade, but all his attacks were rebounded by the smooth snake scales. Even he nearly got entangled several times.
He no longer targeted the vital seven-inch point as the sisters were well-prepared for it and unlikely to fall for it. Instead, Daoist Xiantian caught them off guard, holding the magic seal in his palm and slapped toward the Dantian area of the snake demon Shuang'er.
This is a common combat technique among Gold Core Period Cultivators, known as "Shaking the Golden Core," which can cause the Golden Core to wobble, temporarily severing its connection with the body, and thereby exposing a vulnerability.
"Ah, you can fight like this?" Lu Yang was greatly surprised, wondering why no one had taught him to fight like this against Golden Core Stage opponents.
Were it not for Fairy Eternity's commentary at his side, he would not have known about the technique of "Shaking the Golden Core."
Fairy Eternity rolled her eyes, "How many of your opponents have been at the Golden Core Stage?"
Lu Yang thought for a moment; indeed, it seemed he had rarely fought with Golden Core Stage Cultivators.
"No, that's not right. After reaching the late Foundation Establishment stage, I fought with a group of Golden Core Stage Demon Beasts in the border forest!"
It was a throng of Golden Core Stage Demon Beasts, yet Fairy Eternity had never mentioned the technique of Shaking the Golden Core.
Fairy Eternity waved her hand dismissively, with a look of considering Lu Yang's interests, "Shaking the Golden Core is a clever combat trick, but using such tactics won't allow you to cultivate an unbeatable force, let alone an Invincible Elixir."
"...I'm not exactly chasing after the Invincible Elixir anyway," he mumbled.
Although the snake demon sisters were caught off guard by the Shaking the Golden Core technique, they were not inexperienced cultivators and quickly stabilized their Dantians to prevent Daoist Xiantian from launching another sneak attack.
Snake demon Shuang'er rapidly spun around and suddenly extended her tail, aiming to strike Daoist Xiantian. He anticipated the move and leaped up to dodge the blow.
But unexpectedly, as he was suspended in the air and unable to move, the elder snake demon also extended her tail and swept Daoist Xiantian off his feet.
"Pfft—"
Daoist Xiantian was directly swept against the stone wall, ending up dusty and disheveled.
If he had been fighting alone, Daoist Xiantian would not have feared any one demon, but with two demons cooperating, especially in sync sisters, he was constantly at a disadvantage in combat.
Numerous cuts appeared on Daoist Xiantian's body, and each time he attempted to leave the cave to fight in an open area, the snake demon sisters blocked his way.
"Huff, huff—"
Daoist Xiantian, gasping for breath and creating some distance from the snake demon sisters, realized that he was unlikely to win with his abilities alone.
He took out a warmly radiating elixir from his bosom, the very Elixir of Triple Yang Strength he had exchanged for one hundred Contribution Points!
He swallowed the elixir in one gulp, and a warm current flowed through his body, filling his limbs and bones.
"It really works," he thought, feeling power surging endlessly within his body.
But then, Daoist Xiantian lost that power, to his utter astonishment. The warm current flowed out of his limbs and dripped onto the ground where it formed a large array.
A thick smoke billowed above the large array. Two figures appeared within the smoke, vague and indistinct.
As the smoke cleared, the two figures revealed their true forms; it was none other than Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
"Grandmaster, were you looking for us?" Lu Yang pretended to be ignorant of the situation, his expression confused, while Meng Jingzhou also feigned ignorance, his gaze clear and lucid.
"What are you two doing here, and where's my Triple Yang Strength?" Daoist Xiantian exclaimed in shock. How could consuming an elixir produce two people?
"The two of us are it," they said.
Lu Yang pointed to himself, "I'm Yi Yang."
He then pointed to Meng Jingzhou beside him, "He has two Pure Yang Nascent Souls, so he is Er Yang."

chapters.title: Chapter 810 - 809: None Shall Escape
chapters.content:
"Is the power of 'Three Suns' like this? Why does it feel different from what I imagined?" Daoist Xiantian wondered, but upon closer consideration, he found Lu Yang's explanation quite sensible.
"Other sects often give elixirs extravagant names. Our sect is more traditional; we don't go for flashy names. We stick to the facts. The names reflect the actual effects of the elixirs. I've even used a 'Ten Bulls Strength Pill' before, which summons the power of ten cow demons."
Lu Yang illustrated his point with personal experiences, proving that the 'Three Suns Strength Pill' was indeed a summoning elixir and not something he or Meng Jingzhou had sneakily rigged while waiting for the elixir to smoke.
"So that's how it is." Daoist Xiantian nodded, feeling quite pleased. He hadn't realized that the Seek Dao Sect was so traditional.
For an old-timer like him, set in his ways, tradition was what he cherished most.
Although there hadn't been such straightforward elixirs in his time.
"You demon, surrender now!" Meng Jingzhou shouted angrily, releasing two Nascent Souls brimming with Yang Qi, radiating intense heat.
"Nascent Soul Stage!?" The snake demon sisters were shocked, too frightened to even move.
Even in a place with many cultivators like Great Xia, it wasn't common to run into a Nascent Soul Stage Cultivator so casually, right?
And why did he have two Nascent Souls?
Lu Yang regretted it; the chance to show off had been snatched by Old Meng, the shameless one, even though it was Lu Yang who had come up with the idea for the 'Three Suns Strength Pill'.
But then again, he couldn't casually deploy his Nascent Soul for reconnaissance like Old Meng could.
The snake demon sisters quickly regained their composure, "Don't think you're the only ones with backup. We have our own!"
They were no match for Nascent Soul Stage Cultivators, but they spoke as if they had strong backgrounds too.
Lu Yang was curious to see what kind of backup these sisters could possibly have, so he let them call for help.
The elder snake demon took out a snake scale and snapped it with force.
Soon after, a thunderous noise came from deep within the woods, as though some immense creature was weaving through the trees, colliding with and rolling huge stones around.
"Who dares to bully my daughters!" A massive snake head blocked the cave entrance, its cold serpent eyes glaring straight at Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
"We are from the Seek Dao Sect. Your two daughters have broken the law and need to come with us," Lu Yang said, showing his identity jade and explaining the reason.
The giant white snake displayed a human-like sneer, one of cold mockery. Did they really think the Seek Dao Sect was that impressive? If she couldn't beat them, couldn't she just escape?
She transformed into a graceful woman in white, darting into the cave mouth, intending to use her early Spirit Transformation cultivation level to rescue the snake demon sisters!
But an early Spirit Transformation cultivation level was nothing in front of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou. Meng Jingzhou exhibited his 'Three heads and six arms' technique, pinning the woman in white to the ground with his powerful, muscular arms.
"Please, spare us!" Another snake demon arrived belatedly, the husband of the woman in white.
"I ask for your highnesses' mercy." He transformed into human form, repeatedly offering apologetic smiles. He knew that Great Xia was the territory of the Seek Dao Sect, and opposing them would have dire consequences.
"Just a small token of appreciation, please accept it," said the snake demon wisely. Knowing that force wouldn't work, he took out a storage ring containing three hundred thousand spirit stones.
"Dad, there's no need to give them the spirit stones. They have no cause to arrest us. We sisters haven't forced these people!" The snake demon sisters, obviously having spent a long time in Great Xia, knew the rules well, that one couldn't just arrest people without cause.
"Haven't forced them?" Daoist Xiantian gestured at the men lying in a haphazard way. The fight was so intense just now, yet these men had shown no response, clearly bewitched and losing their sense of the outside world.
"It's just a bit of fun play," the sisters argued, using their demon magic to release the men from their control, bringing them back to their senses.
Once they regained their senses, yet still smitten by the sight of the snake demon sisters, Daoist Xiantian questioned whether they had been coerced. They all claimed it was voluntary.
"Then you two have also violated criminal law by absorbing yin to supplement yang," Daoist Xiantian thought of another reason. Absorbing yin to supplement yang is a method of Demon Cultivators and also a violation of the law.
The righteous practice is the mutual complementation of yin and yang, but the Snake Demon sisters are both at the Golden Core Early Stage, so how could they possibly engage in yin-yang complementation with mortals?
"Who said we absorbed yin to supplement yang?" The Snake Demon sisters seemed to have anticipated Daoist Xiantian would ask this question.
Daoist Xiantian carefully examined the condition of these men and discovered that they indeed hadn't been drained. They looked frail because they had been excessively indulgent these past days.
Excessive indulgence leading to kidney deficiency is not illegal.
"Then why did you two sleep with so many men?" Daoist Xiantian was puzzled.
"High sexual desire."
"..."
"You've entered the country illegally."
"Ridiculous, we went through the procedures before coming here!"
Although their family lives in the mountains, it doesn't mean they sneaked into Great Xia; they're just accustomed to living in the wilderness.
This truly stumped Daoist Xiantian. It definitely wasn't kidnapping as it was evident the men came voluntarily; at most, they didn't inform the villagers when they arrived.
Truly not guilty?
The Snake Demon sisters sneered coldly. Don't think that just because they're from the Demon Race they don't understand the law—they had studied it thoroughly. They didn't even take money for their encounters, so it couldn't count as prostitution.
Lu Yang pulled out chains and bound the Snake Demon sisters without explanation, causing the sisters to panic.
"By what right are you binding us?"
Lu Yang curled his lip, "As if you're innocent. This is a typical case of organizing debauchery."
Once the Snake Demons are delivered to the nearby government office and a certificate is issued, the mission will be considered complete.
Meng Jingzhou, meanwhile, bound the group of men. Although the crime of organizing debauchery only penalizes the organizers, these men, as participants, might not be committing a crime, but they couldn't escape administrative punishment—they'd be detained for at least ten days.
"You too, come with us to see the government office."
Lu Yang bound the woman in white with chains.
"Why are you binding me? I didn't sleep with these men, and even if you're from the Seek Dao Sect, you can't just arrest people randomly," the white-robed woman exclaimed angrily.
Lu Yang rolled his eyes, too lazy to deal with such legal ignorance, "I've already said we're from the Seek Dao Sect and on official duty. You still tried to snatch people away right in front of us, which is a clear case of obstructing public duty."
Lu Yang turned to look at the white-robed woman's husband, "Do you want to come with us willingly, or should we tie you up as well?"
"What did I do?" the Snake Demon's husband asked, puzzled. He hadn't shown any intent to act from the very beginning.
"Attempted bribery."
Lu Yang then looked towards Daoist Xiantian, who was still standing there stunned, "And you."
Suddenly, Lu Yang remembered the Snake Demon named Shuang'er who tried to force the Grandmaster to become her male concubine. The Grandmaster was unwilling, and when Shuang'er attacked the Grandmaster, it could potentially constitute an attempted rape or indecent assault.
He thought to remind the Grandmaster, in case the government office asked for a victim's statement, he shouldn't be caught off guard.
Seeing Lu Yang pinning charges on everyone, and then turning his gaze towards him, Daoist Xiantian became nervous and shakily asked, "Is it too late for me to turn myself in now?"

chapters.title: Chapter 811 - 810: Following the Example of the Younger Generation
chapters.content:
"Do you have any crimes to confess?" Lu Yang didn't understand why the grandmaster was suddenly intent on turning himself in, and he also sensed that the grandmaster was quite nervous.
Had the grandmaster committed some crime without his knowledge?
Daoist Xiantian racked his brain for quite a while; he had been the honest type during the Great Yu Era, and even more so after he started over after disbanding his cultivation—he hadn't made any mistakes.
He spoke uncertainly, "Err, does founding the Seek Dao Sect count..."
Meng Jingzhou, frightened, strode up quickly and covered Daoist Xiantian's mouth, "You can't say such things carelessly."
Since Wang Family Ditch is under the jurisdiction of Jinniu City, Lu Yang had to take not only the snake demon's family but also the stalwart men of Wang Family Ditch, who had been infatuated with beauty, to the government office of Jinniu City to see how the officials would deal with them.
Lu Yang and his two companions escorted these demons and people down the mountain. After they arrived at the government office of Jinniu City and identified themselves, the City Lord set aside his work and came to meet them in person.
"Two Divine Transformation Stage Snake Demons at the early stage and two Golden Core Stage Snake Demons at the early stage?" The City Lord was stunned by Lu Yang's accomplishment; there was only one Divine Transformation Stage Cultivator in Jinniu City, at the mid-stage.
He had been the City Lord in Jinniu City for more than a decade and had only encountered one case involving a Divine Transformation Stage Cultivator. This Disciple of the Seek Dao Sect had brought two right upon arriving?
"You must not wrong a good demon—I didn't bribe anyone at all!" The snake demon's husband cried out in defense, insisting that Lu Yang and the others were framing him and that he had never offered any Spirit Stones as a bribe.
The people from Wang Family Ditch were still not clear-headed at the time and couldn't testify, leaving the statement of the snake demon's family, which was sure to favor the snake demon's husband. Overall, only the testimony of Lu Yang and his two companions was against the snake demon's husband, but this level of testimony didn't form a complete chain of evidence, which wasn't enough to convict.
Meng Jingzhou had anticipated the snake demon husband's reaction. He was always careful in his actions and wouldn't let a mere snake demon find a loophole.
Meng Jingzhou calmly took out a Recording Orb, which captured the entire process from when Daoist Xiantian summoned them to the capture of the snake demon's family, leaving the snake demon's husband speechless.
With irrefutable evidence, even the white-clothed woman who had intended to deny the charges had no choice but to obediently accept the fine.
As Lu Yang had predicted, the government office took Daoist Xiantian aside to record his statement as a victim.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou gave their statements as witnesses.
"Thank you so much," the City Lord said, shaking hands with the three of them. A Disciple of the Seek Dao Sect had shown excellence as soon as he took action, not only helping to solve the disappearance case of Wang Family Ditch but also capturing two early-stage Divine Transformation Stage snake demons, which was also considered an achievement.
Considering he couldn't restrain the snake demon couple on his own, the City Lord hurriedly asked three Divine Transformation Stage Cultivators from nearby cities for assistance while they were recording the statements, finally feeling at ease.
Then, as requested by Lu Yang, the City Lord provided a certificate with Jinniu City's official seal, confirming that Daoist Xiantian had completed his task.
Now that their task was finished, Lu Yang and his companion planned to take the grandmaster back to the Seek Dao Sect, but Daoist Xiantian felt that since they had come so far, it would be nice to buy some local specialties to take back as gifts.
Although Lu Yang felt that no one in the Seek Dao Sect would dare to accept gifts from the grandmaster, he couldn't win against Daoist Xiantian's will, so he went along with it.
"What do you think about this little golden calf..." Lu Yang asked, pointing to a small golden calf statue in the shop.
However, when he turned around, Daoist Xiantian had already disappeared.
"Where did he go?" Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou exchanged a glance; how had they lost him just by walking along?
Losing the grandmaster—how could this be allowed?!
Meng Jingzhou was naturally cheerful and thought quite optimistically, "It can't be thought of that way. Since we were the ones who found the grandmaster and now we've lost him again, one deed cancels out the mistake, right?"
"...do you believe that yourself?"
"No."
"Then stop wasting words, and start searching!"
After bustling about for half an hour, they finally found the Daoist Xiantian at a noodle stall, eating noodles.
"You've come here to eat noodles?" Lu Yang breathed a sigh of relief, spared from a beating this time.
Daoist Xiantian scratched his head, looking somewhat embarrassed, "Somehow, I don't know what happened, but as I walked, I just lost track of you two."
Then Daoist Xiantian looked around and motioned for Lu Yang and his companion to sit down and join him for noodles, then he said, "I just wanted to find a teahouse to rest my feet. Right while drinking tea, I overheard the people next to me discussing the matter of the Ruthless Sect."
"The Ruthless Sect?" Lu Yang's eye twitched; his revered master had such outrageous luck. He didn't have any intelligence on the Ruthless Sect, but his master found a lead just by getting lost.
Daoist Xiantian nodded, "Yes, I heard the cultivator next to me say that there's a Ruthless Sect base nearby. It seems they are recruiting followers. The cultivator sitting next to me was thinking of joining them."
"I wanted to tell you about this, but I couldn't leave to find you, so I decided to follow them instead."
He pointed to a shop not far away, "They are inside there."
It was a tailor shop, and two plainly dressed cultivators came out, precisely the ones wanting to join the Ruthless Sect.
"Follow them." Daoist Xiantian quickly finished his bowl of noodles, even drinking up the soup. After wiping his mouth, he signaled for Lu Yang and his friend to follow him.
The two cultivators being trailed were only at the Foundation Establishment Stage. With the help of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou for cover, Daoist Xiantian didn't need to worry about being detected.
"Revered master, you don't need to track them all the way to the base. It's enough for Old Meng and me to handle such things," Lu Yang advised. When it came to hunting down demonic sect bases, he and Old Meng were quite experienced.
Daoist Xiantian shook his head, speaking earnestly, "I heard that you two once went undercover in the Eternity Sect, remaining hidden for several months, and ultimately managed to break through and eradicate their headquarters, eliminating all their influence. You two are the pride of our Seek Dao Sect."
Lu Yang wanted to say that they hadn't eradicated them all; the higher-ups were still striving for the barbeque business within their Sect.
"Although I founded the Seek Dao Sect, I haven't contributed much to its success. You have treated me too well, and I feel undeserving."
"I want to learn from you two and go undercover in the Ruthless Sect to eradicate them!"
Lu Yang had heard of emulating the sages but never emulating the younger generation.
"Ah, that's too dangerous!" Meng Jingzhou was shocked. You sure dare to dream, revered master. If anything were to go wrong, they would face more than a beating upon returning to the Sect.
Daoist Xiantian waved his hand, showing his determination, "There's no venture without danger. I've made up my mind, don't try to persuade me otherwise."
Seeing Daoist Xiantian so resolute, Lu Yang could only agree. With him and Old Meng secretly protecting him, nothing should go wrong. It was highly unlikely that Ruthless Sect higher-ups would show up at this place.
Even if the higher-ups of the Ruthless Sect did appear, it's not like the Seek Dao Sect didn't have their own high-level cultivators.
Thinking this way, it seemed the revered master was quite safe.
The three of them followed their targets across six cities, finally arriving at the Ruthless Sect's stronghold.

chapters.title: Chapter 812 - 811: The Ruthless Sect's Initiation Test
chapters.content:
The Ruthless Sect is said to be comprised entirely of heartless individuals, with extremely stringent recruitment conditions. Because of this, their followers are the fewest in number among the Four Great Devil Sects.
Of course, in terms of the number of followers, it still doesn't compare to the Heavenly Court Sect, which, though only established two years ago, has a history of four hundred thousand years.
It is unclear whether the philosophy of the Ruthless Sect genuinely possesses some merit, or whether they have other methods, but the cultivation levels of the Ruthless Sect's followers are generally quite high.
"The philosophy of the Ruthless Sect is that only those who sever all ties of compassion and righteousness can attain the Dao and achieve the highest immortal status. Worldly relationships are seen as shackles to them, and emotions such as familial love, romantic love, and friendship are considered poison, not to be touched.
Even if such feelings exist, they must be cut off early on," Lu Yang recounted the intel on the Ruthless Sect to his ancestor.
The Daoist Xiantian didn't know much about the Ruthless Sect, similar to how Lu Yang at his initial Foundation Establishment stage only knew of the name of the Eternity Sect.
But now, Lu Yang was different; outwardly, he maintained a good relationship with Dai Bufan, who was in charge of intelligence, and secretly, relying on his status as Young Sect Master, he was able to gather a lot of information from the Jiuyou Sect and the Yaoyang Sect.
However, the Ruthless Sect was naturally exclusionary and indifferent towards the Jiuyou Sect and the Yaoyang Sect, which is why these two sects couldn't completely clarify the situation within the Ruthless Sect.
"Is that the stronghold of the Ruthless Sect there?"
The place where Lu Yang and others were located was a jungle. The two men they were tracking knocked on the bark of a large tree and were then sucked into it, disappearing from sight.
Using his Spiritual Sense, Lu Yang discovered that the inside of the tree was hollow, with roots serving as channels, transporting people to an underground cavity below the root system.
"This must be the fifth cultivator who entered the underground, right?" Meng Jingzhou communicated telepathically with the others; they were unsure about the situation here and were observing as, besides the two cultivators who had just gone in, three more cultivators entered the underground cavity alone.
"Then it must be correct; today is the day the Ruthless Sect recruits members," the Daoist Xiantian was certain he hadn't heard wrong. "I'll head down first."
"Wait, wait," Lu Yang quickly grabbed the Daoist Xiantian, "My brother and I have some experience in this area; how about we accompany you down?"
Lu Yang didn't feel at ease letting the Daoist Xiantian go to the Ruthless Sect alone.
The Daoist Xiantian thought for a moment and felt that Lu Yang made sense. Although his own cultivation experience surpassed that of these two juniors, in terms of infiltration experience, he was inferior.
"Alright."
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou put on masks, altered their appearance, and suppressed their realms to the early stage of Foundation Establishment.
As long as the Ruthless Sect underground had no one in the Divinity Transformation Stage, they would not see through their cultivation level.
The three, together, followed the process they had learned earlier, tapping a specific part of the tree's bark, and a suction force pulled them into the tree, sliding down to the underground cavity.
"Oh, more people have arrived, and three at that?" The people from the Ruthless Sect were somewhat puzzled when they saw Lu Yang and his companions; logically, heartless people rarely teamed up. To see two together was rare enough, but three was even rarer.
However, it wasn't unheard of, so they did not suspect too much.
"Follow me," the Ruthless Sect follower at the entrance said expressionlessly.
Lu Yang used his peripheral vision to survey this underground cavity; it was just like a large inn buried underground, and it was uncertain how long this stronghold had been constructed.
This area belonged to Ye City, so the precise name of this stronghold should be the Ruthless Sect Ye City Rudder.
The leading Ruthless Sect follower had a cultivation level that was not low, fast approaching the Golden Core Stage.
