Along the way, several more Ruthless Sect followers were patrolling, all of them at the Golden Core Stage.
The follower led Lu Yang and the others to the deepest part of the underground cavity. At this time, seven cultivators had already arrived there, wishing to join the Ruthless Sect—with cultivation levels ranging from both high and low, some as high as the Golden Core Stage, and others at only the third layer of Qi Refinement.
However, it seemed the Ruthless Sect was not particularly concerned about cultivation levels from their reaction.
"Foundation Establishment Early Stage cultivators, huh? Understood, you may leave," said the cultivator in charge of selecting sect disciples, nodding his head with an indifferent expression and dead fish eyes that made everyone look like a corpse to him.
Lu Yang noticed that he was the highest in Cultivation Level here, a Mid-stage Nascent Soul.
"How did you find this place?" asked the Nascent Soul Mid-stage cultivator.
Lu Yang replied in the same tone, "We followed some people here. The three of us have always wanted to join the Ruthless Sect, and now that we have finally found an opportunity, we came."
There was no need to lie about how they found this place. It was more characteristic of Demon Cultivators to follow others here.
The Mid-stage Nascent Soul cultivator didn't respond to Lu Yang's answer, but the fact that he didn't dismiss Lu Yang suggested that he didn't suspect him.
Or rather, he didn't need to suspect at all; he only believed in the results of the test.
After Lu Yang, another two hours passed with no new cultivators wishing to join the Ruthless Sect, and the Mid-stage Nascent Soul cultivator coldly said:
"That's enough, no more waiting. Even if others come, they are not fated to join our sect."
"My name is Niu Qianshan, and I am the Rudder Master of this branch. There's no need to elaborate on your purpose here; it is to join my Ruthless Sect," he said.
"Our sect does not care about your background or your Cultivation Level. As long as you can be ruthless and heartless and uphold the path of ruthlessness, you are one of us."
Niu Qianshan took out a stack of yellow papers, on which were drawn Array Methods that Lu Yang couldn't understand. He gestured for his subordinates to distribute the yellow papers to all the cultivators.
"Wow, such a brilliant Array Method. The person who designed this is definitely talented," complimented Fairy Eternity, a rare praise from her.
Niu Qianshan continued, "The entry test of our sect is not as tedious as those of the Jiuyou Sect or the Yaoyang Sect. Our test only has one criteria, and that is to prove that you all are ruthless and heartless!"
"What you need to do next is to meditate and enter tranquility on these yellow papers."
"After entering tranquility, the Array Method on the yellow paper will peer into your minds, learn of the people you are closest to deep in your heart—possibly your parents, your elders, or friends—and will materialize them."
"And you will forget your current situation, forget that this is a test, and believe it to be reality. You need to kill the people you see!"
By the end, Niu Qianshan showed madness and ferocity, his entire demeanor twisted.
He himself had killed his wife and children to join the Ruthless Sect.
"Of course, considering that your opponents might have a higher Cultivation Level than you, making them difficult to kill, the Array Method will materialize people with the same Cultivation Level as you."
"The test begins!"
Niu Qianshan issued the order impassively. Ten testers, including Lu Yang, sat down on the Array Method to meditate. They were all ruthless individuals with firm Daoist hearts and quickly entered tranquility.
When Lu Yang woke up again, he felt his mind was in chaos, as if he had forgotten something. Soon, with the help of Fairy Eternity, he came to his senses.
"I remember now, I am taking part in the Ruthless Sect's test. I need to kill the people that appear in the Illusionary Realm. Since I've regained my consciousness, passing the test shouldn't be hard..."
Lu Yang didn't finish his sentence when he saw two familiar figures approaching him. One was Yun Zhi, the other was Yellow Bean.
"..."
As if I could win against them! Ha!

chapters.title: Chapter 813 - 812: Joining the Ruthless Sect (Extra for Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Lu Yang, upon seeing these two people, shivered with fear, his heart stopped beating.
"What's the deal with you Ruthless Sect folks? If you didn't want me to join, you could've just said so, there was no need for all this trouble."
And matching the Realm, why didn't you suppress Eldest Senior Sister to the Golden Core Stage, so I could see what a sky full of Golden Cores looks like?
Lu Yang could even feel the Invincible Nascent Soul itching to move... itching to run.
If it was a fight against one of them, Lu Yang felt that he could give it a try, of course, winning or losing was another matter.
But if it was against both, Lu Yang thought he might compete with the Invincible Nascent Soul to see who could run faster.
"Junior Brother, what's wrong with you?" the Eldest Senior Sister asked with a frown, her tone as usual.
Only then did Lu Yang notice that they weren't in some empty blank space, but at the Sky Gate Mountain of the Seek Dao Sect.
That's right, since it had to be a complete simulation, naturally the environment would have to be simulated as well.
"No, nothing."
"Second-in-command, why do you look so dazed, has your cultivation messed up your mind?" Yellow Bean cackled as always, even poking Lu Yang's face for good measure.
"... I don't think you, Fairy, have any right to talk about me."
"Eh, I can challenge Miss Yun again?" Fairy Eternity emerged from the Spiritual Space, the genuine Fairy Eternity.
Defeating a fake counts as a win too.
She possessed the simulated Yellow Bean and immediately self-destructed.
"Damn it, Fairy, wait..."
Before Lu Yang could dissuade her, he watched as Fairy Eternity, without a second word, decisively blew herself up.
Boom—
In reality, the Array Method couldn't withstand such power and directly exploded.
Niu Qianshan raised an eyebrow: "Failed that quickly?"
The explosion of the array meant the challenge had failed, and such a quick failure only meant that the assassination failed, and instead, they were killed.
To kill the person closest to you, a part of the Ruthless Sect, is akin to assassinating them. Failing at an assassination suggests a moment of compassion during the killing.
"It seems this child is not suitable for my Ruthless Path."
...
Yun Zhi, flying mid-route, furrowed her brows slightly: "The sensation is gone?"
She had sensed her own likeness appear somewhere and wanted to check it out. As she was mid-flight, it seemed her likeness dissipated, and she could no longer sense its source.
"Strange."
...
Lu Yang woke up in a daze, still caught in the after-effects of Fairy Eternity's self-destruction.
Niu Qianshan walked up to Lu Yang and said indifferently: "You've failed, go back to where you came from."
Before Lu Yang could say anything, he heard an explosion from where Meng Jingzhou was. Meng Jingzhou's array also burst open.
Meng Jingzhou cursed loudly, angrily wanting to dismantle the stronghold: "Who the hell could kill this!"
Niu Qianshan watched Meng Jingzhou coldly, not only had he failed, but he was also angry, which was an emotion people of the Ruthless Sect should not have.
"You're also not suited for my Ruthless Path, both of you should leave."
There is no shared cause amongst those who stand on different paths. Staying here would be useless; the Ruthless Sect does not make exceptions or allow for special admissions.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou transmitted messages secretly to each other.
"What should we do?"
"For now, let's leave. Even if we don't take the initiative, this Niu Qianshan will throw us out. Seems like the Ruthless Sect all have this kind of personality."
"Alright."
Watching Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou leave, Niu Qianshan called his subordinate, a Cultivator in the late Golden Core Stage.
"These two know the location of our stronghold. They cannot be left alive. Go and eliminate them, and make it quick."
Although Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou showed to outsiders that they were at the Foundation Establishment Early Stage, Niu Qianshan was always cautious. He would send the most capable person available. If the Rudder Master were not otherwise engaged, he would have even considered sending the Nascent Soul Early Stage Rudder Master to do the job.
...
```
When they left the branch of the Seek Dao Sect in Ye City, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were still discussing the test they had just gone through.
"Why did you start fighting within the Array Method?" Lu Yang asked curiously. He had the Fairy's help to come to his senses during the test, knowing that he had to kill someone close to pass it. Since Old Meng did not come to his senses, how come he fought with a close person.
Meng Jingzhou's face darkened: "The one that appeared in the Array Method was you, you rascal, I simply wanted to teach you a lesson."
Lu Yang became interested and made an 'oh' sound, "Then if you lost in the Array Method, you should admit that I'm stronger than you, right?"
When this topic came up, Meng Jingzhou's face darkened even more: "In the Array Method, you damn well started using Eldest Senior Sister's Imitation Fist right off the bat. How the hell was I supposed to fight?"
It was impossible for the Array Method to simulate Yun Zhi's moves, but Imitation Fist itself has the ability to draw on the original's power, it's just that Lu Yang rarely used it that way.
The Lu Yang in the Array Method drew a trace of strength from the Eldest Senior Sister, naturally, Meng Jingzhou was no match for him.
"Someone has been following us."
"I know, it's probably someone from the Ruthless Sect assigned to kill us."
"That's just perfect, we can disguise ourselves as him and continue infiltrating the Ruthless Sect."
Both of them made their move together, capturing the person from the Ruthless Sect, who didn't even have a chance to react.
"You are not at the Foundation Establishment Stage!" the man stated coldly.
Without another word, Lu Yang stepped forward and gave him a slap, "Shut up with the nonsense and stay put."
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou dragged the man to a concealed spot, and Lu Yang wanted to check on how the ancestor was doing below.
He saw the ancestor still meditating on the Array Method and from his relaxed expression, it seemed he was trapped in it, unable to break free from the Illusionary Realm.
"With the ancestor's personality, if he can't break through the Illusionary Realm, then he can forget about passing the test."
"Fairy, would you mind lending a hand?"
Naturally, Lu Yang wanted to fulfill the ancestor's wish as best as he could.
"Hmph, looks like you need this fairy's help after all." Since it was Lu Yang's request, Fairy Eternity didn't mind lending a small helping hand.
With a slight exertion of her immortal power, she helped Daoist Xiantian come to his senses from the Array Method.
...
At that moment, Daoist Xiantian was at the bamboo forest of the Seek Dao Sect, having a heart-to-heart with River Spirit Xiao Lu.
Speaking of the person closest to him, naturally, it was Xiao Lu, who was from the same Great Yu Era as him.
Suddenly, he was taken aback, remembering that this was a trial and the Xiao Lu before him was fake.
He sighed softly. Even if this was an Illusionary Realm, he wasn't willing to lay a hand on Xiao Lu, but he also knew that without killing this fake Xiao Lu, he would never be able to join the Ruthless Sect.
If Little Lu and Little Meng could wipe out a demonic sect, then he, as their elder, certainly couldn't fall behind.
So kill!
With a prepared mind against one unprepared, and with River Spirit Xiao Lu at the Foundation Establishment Early Stage, Daoist Xiantian took advantage of her unawareness and killed River Spirit Xiao Lu.
Daoist Xiantian awoke to find Niu Qianshan standing in front of him.
Niu Qianshan patted Daoist Xiantian on the shoulder: "Not bad, you passed the trial so quickly, which shows you're suited for our Ruthless Way. From today onward, you are one of us in the Ruthless Sect."
Lu Yang, who had been observing with his Spiritual Sense, exhaled in relief. With this, the ancestor had successfully infiltrated the Ruthless Sect.
Just as he was about to turn around and say a few words to Old Meng, he saw a large group of people approaching them fiercely, their presence overwhelming. They uprooted the big tree above the branch's top and flew straight into the underground cavity.
The leader declared his identity: "Nobody move, squat down with your heads in your hands, I'm the chief arresting officer of Ye City, you are all under arrest!"
The chief arresting officer turned his attention to Daoist Xiantian: "A new member? You're under arrest too!"
...
Sky Gate Mountain.
Yun Zhi closed her eyes, immersed in the comprehension of the great Dao of heaven and earth.
Suddenly, she sensed two anxious figures rushing towards her.
"Junior Brother, Junior Brother Meng, what happened?"
Lu Yang was so exhausted he could hardly catch his breath: "Eldest Senior Sister, it's terrible, the ancestor has been arrested by the dynasty for joining the Ruthless Sect."
Yun Zhi: "..."
Junior Brother, do you even hear what you're saying?
(Added for Alliance Hierarch BuiBuibui)
```

chapters.title: Chapter 814 - 813: Who in the Seek Dao Sect Hasn't Been in the Great Prison?
chapters.content:
Yun Zhi vaguely remembered that she was worried about the Sect Ancestor's safety while he was out on a mission and specially asked her Junior Brother Lu and Junior Brother Meng, both clever fellows, to secretly assist the Sect Ancestor.
Before they knew it, three days had passed. "How come you two returned safely but the Sect Ancestor has not?"
"What happened?"
The two of them scratched their heads; this matter was truly difficult to explain.
Lu Yang tried to explain the situation as succinctly as possible, "This is what happened. The Sect Ancestor had successfully completed the mission. However, on the way back, he stumbled upon a lead concerning the Ruthless Sect. At that time, the Ruthless Sect was conducting its initiation trial, and he decided to go undercover in the Ruthless Sect, just like we did, to break through them."
"We were worried about the Sect Ancestor's safety, so we also participated in the trial. The trial involved killing the person you are closest to inside an Illusionary Realm. Both Old Meng and I failed, but only the Sect Ancestor succeeded."
Yun Zhi, rarely driven by curiosity, temporarily set aside her concerns about Daoist Xiantian's predicament, "Who did you see in the Illusionary Realm, Junior Brother Lu?"
Meng Jingzhou was also curious about this question, as Lu Yang had been eliminated before him. What kind of enemy, or rather, who was the person he was closest to that he had encountered?
"It was, it was that one person..."
"Who?"
Lu Yang hemmed and hawed, finding it embarrassing to say in front of the person involved.
"Is that even a question? Who else could it be but me, Fairy Eternity!" boasted Fairy Eternity, emerging from her body, proud as she showed off to Yun Zhi.
"Our Immortal Lineage is united as one, with a shared heart and purpose!"
Yun Zhi didn't react, simply uttering, "Continue, Junior Brother Lu."
"After the Sect Ancestor passed the trial, he had just joined the Ruthless Sect when the government office led a raid that took down the stronghold of the Ruthless Sect, capturing all its followers and the newly joined Sect Ancestor as well. Seeing the bad situation, we immediately returned to the sect to report."
"Wait a second. How did the Sect Ancestor pass the trial?" Yun Zhi noticed a logical flaw.
She didn't interact much with the Sect Ancestor, but she knew he was a person of deep sentiments and loyalty. How could he possibly have passed the Ruthless Sect's trial?
Lu Yang, not daring to look directly into Eldest Senior Sister's eyes, stammered, "Well, I saw that the Sect Ancestor really wanted to join the Ruthless Sect, and as you know, Eldest Senior Sister, I am a dutiful child. I try to fulfill the wishes of my elders. So, I asked Fairy Eternity for help to break the Sect Ancestor's mental barrier and made him realize that he was in an illusion."
Yun Zhi looked at Lu Yang, who guiltily lowered his head, then she turned to Fairy Eternity, who was not at all intimidated by Yun Zhi and spoke confidently.
"When the Second-in-command asked for my help, how could I refuse?"
Yun Zhi sighed, then continued, "Then, did the Sect Ancestor not reveal that he was from the Seek Dao Sect, saying instead that he was undercover in the demonic sect?"
The government office surely wouldn't be making arrests including undercover agents.
In fact, as soon as the Sect Ancestor was captured, Lu Yang immediately sent a spiritual message to him, urging him to explain the situation.
"No, he felt it was too embarrassing and didn't want to say that he's from the Seek Dao Sect."
Although Lu Yang didn't think being from the Seek Dao Sect and ending up in jail was a big deal—hadn't their mentor, Daoist Buyu, been in and out of prison seven times, taking it easy and setting several records in the Great Xia jails?
His mentor took pride rather than shame in it, even writing a book about his exploits and becoming a legendary figure in the Great Xia jails—for Daoist Xiantian, it was a hurdle he couldn't mentally overcome.
Yun Zhi was in a dilemma. Naturally, she could speak with the local government office to explain the situation and have them release the Sect Ancestor, but considering the way the Sect Ancestor was acting, it seemed he didn't want his identity as a member of the Seek Dao Sect to be revealed.
"Junior Brother Dai often deals with these kinds of situations. Go and ask him if he has any good suggestions."
"Yes."
Following Yun Zhi's directive, the two of them rushed to the Task Hall to find Dai Bufan.
When Dai Bufan saw Lu Yang and the other, he was taken aback, "Why are you here instead of protecting the Sect Ancestor?"
Having advanced to the Mid-stage of Unification, his state of mind had undergone a change, making it hard for the external world to disturb him. Even upon seeing Lu Yang and the other, he didn't get the same sense of seeing the grim reapers coming for his soul as he used to.
Meng Jingzhou said seriously, "The Dynasty has mobilized its power to protect Ancestor Master, who is now very safe and temporarily doesn't need our protection."
"It was Eldest Senior Sister who sent the two of us to find you for a solution."
"Oh? What happened?" Dai Bufan was interested; he hadn't expected that there was something even Eldest Senior Sister couldn't resolve and needed to seek his wisdom for.
"Ancestor Master wanted to join the Ruthless Sect, and then he was captured by the Dynasty."
"Cough cough——"
Dai Bufan coughed violently, almost coughing up his lungs.
"You two, explain the process in detail."
Lu Yang and his companion recounted most of the events, omitting the affair involving Fairy Eternity.
"So it was just going undercover; you scared me to death." Dai Bufan breathed a sigh of relief, thinking that Ancestor Master couldn't possibly be so lacking in discernment as to leave Seek Dao Sect and join something like the Ruthless Sect.
"No, going undercover is also very dangerous, is this how you two protect Ancestor Master!?"
Lu Yang and his companion nodded, acknowledging the danger; after all, they had been captured.
"How long will Ancestor Master be detained?" This was Dai Bufan's most pressing concern.
"The government office said that Ancestor Master had just joined the Ruthless Sect, had no criminal record, and his attitude in admitting his wrongdoing was sincere, so a fifteen-day detention would suffice."
"Good, it's only fifteen days." Dai Bufan thought to himself that if it were to be two months or more, he would do whatever it took to rescue Ancestor Master.
"Then you two should either visit the prison more often or stay with Ancestor Master, just ensure that Ancestor Master doesn't suffer any grievances in his cell."
To get Ancestor Master out without revealing his identity, Dai Bufan could only think of having Ancestor Master pretend to be from one of the other four Immortal Sects, claiming he was there to go undercover, though this method was somewhat unscrupulous.
Moreover, Ancestor Master impersonating someone from another sect didn't seem right.
Fifteen days were neither too long nor too short, like Ancestor Master was going to experience mortal life.
"Yes."
...
"Which option should we choose, visiting the prison more often or accompanying Ancestor Master in the jail?"
"I lean towards the second option, it seems more thorough in terms of care."
"How about we first go to the jail to see Ancestor Master's condition before deciding?"
"That's also an option."
The two discussed and sped from Seek Dao Sect all the way to Ye City's jail, carrying two large lunch boxes.
"It should be around here." There were many cells in Ye City, and it was not appropriate to use Spiritual Sense here for fear of arousing suspicion, so the two searched one by one.
Lu Yang heard two people talking not far away.
"I never expected Ancestor Master that you would actually come here to accompany me." The speaker was filled with emotion, joy mingled within his words.
"Neither did I expect that you, as the Sect Leader of our sect, would not flee after making a mistake but voluntarily get locked up here, truly a role model for the sect."
Lu Yang saw Ancestor Master and his own Master locked up together, with the Gold Clan Leader beside them, and fell silent for a long time.
How did these three end up together?

chapters.title: Chapter 815 - 814: The Ubiquitous Daoist Buyu
chapters.content:
"Little Lu, Meng Family Kid, over here, over here," Daoist Buyu had noticed the footsteps of Lu Yang and his companion early on and beckoned them over.
"Master, what are you doing here?" Lu Yang's eye twitched. How should he put it? Encountering his master in the prison didn't feel the least bit surprising.
Even though his master had changed his appearance, Lu Yang recognized at first glance that this was indeed his esteemed master.
"And you, Gold Clan Leader..."
The Gold Clan Leader, on the other hand, hadn't changed his appearance at all.
Lu Yang and his companion were unaware that after the Demon Nation's founding ceremony, the Gold Clan Leader had taken Daoist Buyu as his big brother in order to practice his eloquence.
Lu Yang still remembered how high-spirited the Gold Clan Leader was when they met in the Qiongqi Clan, how he faced Venerate Zhu Tian's oppressive aura without servility or arrogance. How did things come to this so quickly, to be on the same level as his master?
The fall from grace was indeed too rapid.
"I'm here to learn from Daoist Buyu," the Gold Clan Leader chuckled, feeling a little embarrassed to run into an acquaintance in a place like this.
For the life of him, Lu Yang couldn't figure out what was there to learn from his master.
Daoist Buyu laughed heartily, not feeling the slightest embarrassment: "Ah, I'm here teaching Little Gold that those who deceive will eventually be caught. To get him accustomed to life in prison early on, to teach him how to live comfortably and at ease within these walls, I deliberately left a small flaw, allowing the Ye City government office to capture both Little Gold and me."
Daoist Buyu patted the Gold Clan Leader on the shoulder, imparting precious knowledge: "Be confident, the most important thing in our profession is to have confidence. The face is the reflection of the heart, with confidence in your heart, your face will shine, and only then will the other side believe your fabrications!"
Lu Yang held his forehead, wondering why his master hadn't been this serious when teaching him... Oh, there was no need to teach him this sort of thing.
"This is an unexpected gain, running into our ancestor here. I heard that the ancestor was trying to infiltrate the Ruthless Sect and got caught in the process?"
Lu Yang nodded and shared the information he had gathered earlier: "After receiving intelligence on the location of a Ruthless Sect stronghold, the Ye City Government Office collaborated with several nearby cities to eradicate that stronghold, and our ancestor was captured as a result."
"So that's what happened."
"We bought some food from Blessed Tower, but we're not sure if it suits your taste, ancestor."
Meng Jingzhou opened two large food containers; the aroma was enticing. Although a Daoist Xiantian had transcended the desire for gastronomic satisfaction on a mental level, he was currently at the Foundation Establishment Early Stage, and his body instinctively reacted.
"It smells so delicious," Daoist Xiantian's nose twitched as he took the chopsticks and dug heartily into the meal.
"What about my chopsticks?" Daoist Buyu pointed at himself. They, as cultivators on the Worldly Path, didn't adhere to abstinence from food; enjoying good cuisine was the Righteous Path of worldly cultivators.
"There's only one pair of chopsticks," Meng Jingzhou thought, How would I know that the Sect Leader would also be locked up here?
Of course, even if he had known Daoist Buyu was here, he wouldn't have planned to prepare an extra pair of chopsticks.
Left with no choice, Daoist Buyu used his spiritual essence to condense a pair of chopsticks and started eating.
Ye City prison was under the influence of an Array Method that restrained both Cultivation Level and spiritual essence. Even for Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou being there, using spiritual essence felt extremely difficult, like being mired in a swamp, unable to move freely.
Ye City was considered a big city, and the City Lord had a Cultivation Level in the Void Refinement Stage, so the Array Method was also of the Void Refinement level. However, this level of Array Method was nothing in front of Daoist Buyu.
Daoist Buyu, being a Half Step past the Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator, simply could not be contained by the local prison's Array Method, as he could cast magic skills at will.
Not to mention a Half Step past the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, even the Gold Clan Leader at the Body Integration Realm could freely use magic skills.
Considering that blowing his cover might lead to his old friends gathering to watch the spectacle, Daoist Buyu used a fake identity when he entered the prison, pretending to be at the Foundation Establishment Stage.
The same went for the Gold Clan Leader.
"Speaking of which, it's lucky that our patriarch didn't join the Ruthless Sect. I had mixed with them for a while, and that place really wasn't fit for humans," Daoist Buyu couldn't stop talking even while eating.
"At that time, I happened to encounter the Ruthless Sect recruiting, and without time to inform anyone, I decided I would test the waters first, so I joined them."
"Ah?" nobody expected Daoist Buyu to have such an experience.
"Isn't the test to enter the Ruthless Sect to kill the person closest to you? How did you pass that test?"
"Easy, the person closest to me is myself. I encountered another me in the Array Method, totally identical in strength. You know how we forget the past within the Array Method, so when I saw another me, I thought I had mistakenly entered some Secret Realm, and had to overcome myself to succeed. Then I made an on-the-spot breakthrough and killed myself."
"After passing the challenge, the Ruthless Sect would investigate who the Array Method showed as the person closest to you. You'd need to kill that person in reality to truly become a member of the Ruthless Sect."
"When they investigated and found out the closest person to me was myself, they obviously couldn't ask me to commit suicide, so they let me through."
"After I joined the Ruthless Sect, I discovered they were delving into the doctrine of ruthlessness. And to pursue this doctrine, they would marry and step onto the path of emotions, then kill their wives to prove their ruthlessness, to fortify the mercilessness within their hearts."
"I saw this and thought it unacceptable. If the doctrine of ruthlessness continued this way, how many innocent women would suffer?"
"So, I proposed to the higher-ups of the Ruthless Sect that killing wives to demonstrate ruthlessness as a practice was misguided. After all, if you killed your wife in a moment of impulse, what would you do if you regretted it later?"
"The higher-ups of the Ruthless Sect felt there was some reason to my words and asked if I had a better idea."
"I said that to prove the way of ruthlessness, one must look to the long term, not just kill all the time. After killing all close to you, how would you continue to demonstrate ruthlessness?"
"I recommended instead of falling in love with a wife and then killing her, it would be better to fall in love with her and then let her sleep with another man."
"Common sense says that seeing your wife sleep with another elevates either anger or excitement, yet neither of those emotions should ever surface in a member of the Ruthless Sect."
"Seeing your wife sleep with another can maximize feelings of anger or excitement. Thus, I further suggested that Ruthless Sect disciples should watch the entire process of being cuckolded."
"If your wife is cuckolded and you have no reaction, only then are you a qualified member of the Ruthless Sect!"
"The higher-ups of the Ruthless Sect thought there was some sense in my idea, so they began to experiment with it on a small scale. When the small-scale trials were successful, they let me propagate this theory widely throughout the Ruthless Sect. I was free to sleep with whomever I wanted, and the disciples of the Ruthless Sect were too angry to speak."
"Alas, I later blew my cover." Daoist Buyu sighed in regret, looking back on his actions with a sense of loss. He was too young and inexperienced back then, and before he could successfully locate the headquarters of the Ruthless Sect, he had no choice but to leave.
"How did you blow your cover?"
"While indulging with their wives, I lost control and let out a laugh by accident."

chapters.title: Chapter 816 - 815: Three Generations of Grandparents and Grandchildren Gather in the Big Prison
chapters.content:
"After the chaos within the Ruthless Sect, the higher-ups had to kill a number of people to suppress the situation,"
"Normally, a show of force by making an example of a few would suffice, but it doesn't work with the Ruthless Sect."
"Those devoid of compassion lack the emotion of fear; they only see their own interests. Merely killing a few doesn't serve as a deterrent. Only by striking down a large number can the rest be made aware of the high-ranking members' resolve, weighing the pros and cons before deciding to back off."
Recalling that scene from his younger days, Daoist Buyu clicked his tongue in amazement; it was the first time he'd witnessed such clean and decisive killing.
"However, things didn't calm down quickly. With the Ruthless Sect's leadership having their own hierarchy, and influenced by those below, they began to turn on each other. It's said that even the Master survived more than one assassination attempt."
"After the internal strife was quelled, the Ruthless Sect started dredging up the past and traced the source of the troubles back to me, preparing to execute me—presumably because there was also dissatisfaction with my 'improved' version of attaining enlightenment through murdering my wife."
"Luckily, I was at the Spirit Transformation Stage back then, and I had a life-saving magic artifact given by my master. With that, I barely managed to escape from the Ruthless Sect."
"It's a pity, though. I had planned to stay undercover in the Ruthless Sect to find out the location and the ins and outs of their headquarters. I didn't expect them to be so impatient and intent on killing me, even though all my actions were in line with the teachings of the Ruthless Sect."
Daoist Buyu shook his head, feeling that with his understanding of the doctrine of Ruthlessness, the Ruthless Sect should have considered making him their Master.
"Although I didn't get to uncover the full extent of the Ruthless Sect's secrets, I figured out that they had two Vice Hierarchs and one Master. The Master's cultivation level is unknown, but the two Vice Hierarchs are at the early and mid-stages of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage."
Lu Yang gasped in shock; this intelligence was unknown even to Yaoyang Sect and Jiuyou Sect, and it suggested that the Ruthless Sect had at least three members at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, stronger than both of those sects.
"What happened afterward?" the Great Ancestor asked earnestly, eager to know more.
"After that, I ran away," Daoist Buyu curled his lip, "Seeing that the Ruthless Sect couldn't take a loss, I dropped the act. I immediately contacted my sect and Great Xia to destroy every Ruthless Sect stronghold I knew of—killing those who deserved it and saving those who could be saved."
"First came the internal turmoil, then the Righteous Path's suppression. After two rounds of blows, the Ruthless Sect was severely weakened and stayed quiet for a few hundred years."
"Didn't the Ruthless Sect seek revenge on you afterward?" Lu Yang inquired.
Daoist Buyu pointed out the flaw in Lu Yang's thinking: "They don't possess 'hatred,' so why would they seek revenge on me?"
"However, you're right that there were many who wished to take revenge on me, to prove their enlightenment through hatred. It's also a path of Ruthlessness. One such person, Su Moran, harbored the greatest enmity toward me. He was a mid-stage Transcendance Tribulation Vice Sect Hierarch, presumably because I had tricked him rather severely at the time."
"But, well, Su Moran isn't too keen on letting others know he wants revenge on me."
"Why is that?"
"Because wanting revenge on me means he harbors hatred for me, temporarily deviating from the path of Ruthlessness, which indicates that his cultivation has hit a bottleneck."
"And hitting a bottleneck, with the cessation of his cultivation progress, would lower his standing within the Ruthless Sect."
"The Ruthless Sect is that dangerous," the Great Ancestor shuddered in retrospective fear, feeling lucky to have been captured. If he had joined the Ruthless Sect, he might have been exposed in less than two days.
"Lucky for you, Great Ancestor, that you didn't join the Ruthless Sect," the Gold Clan Leader voiced the concern on behalf of Daoist Xiantian from the side.
Daoist Buyu glanced at the Gold Clan Leader: "Go on, you're not from our Seek Dao Sect, so stop calling him 'Great Ancestor.'
"Don't speak like that, big brother. I think there's potential for cooperation between our Qiongqi Clan and your Seek Dao Sect. If we join forces in the future, wouldn't it be easy for us to clinch a spot in the top ten powers of the Great Era?"
Daoist Buyuyu thought about his excellent disciple Yun Zhi and felt that there was no need for an alliance with the Qiongqi Clan—his Seek Dao Sect could become a top ten power on its own.
Originally, Lu Yang thought it was quite safe for his ancestor to stay in prison, and it would suffice for him and Old Meng to visit frequently. However, the discovery that his ancestor and master were imprisoned together suddenly made him uneasy.
Lu Yang consulted with Old Meng through voice transmission, "Should we go to the prison to protect our ancestor?"
"That might be unnecessary. Although our ancestor looks young and inexperienced, let's not forget he is a Great Power who chose to start over after disbanding his cultivation. He has been honing his Daoist heart for a long time; he shouldn't be so easily influenced by the Sect Leader." Meng Jingzhou thought that perhaps Lu Yang had too much confidence in the Sect Leader's influence.
Before Lu Yang could reply, he heard Daoist Buyu lecturing Daoist Xiantian.
"Ancestor may not know this, but our Seek Dao Sect has a tradition of staying in prison."
"You know, in the secular world, there's a profession where people go to hotels to sleep, test the living conditions, and provide suggestions for improvements."
"Our Seek Dao Sect also has a similar profession. You see me walking through the streets and alleys all year round, observing various city jails to investigate the environment. This task isn't suitable for government officials; those from above would improve the jail conditions temporarily for inspections, so what can they really uncover? Therefore, we must rely on our own means."
"It's not just me. A couple of years ago, the Minister of Justice also joined me in prison to inspect the conditions. What I'm telling is not made up; you can inquire in the Imperial City; it's common knowledge. Even His Majesty often mentions this matter in the court as a laudable anecdote."
"So that's how it is." Initially, Daoist Buyu didn't quite believe what Lu Yang and his colleague said about the disciples of Seek Dao Sect frequently entering prison. But after Daoist Buyu explained it this way, he suddenly realized and felt less guilty about being in prison.
Meng Jingzhou felt that having the ancestor and Daoist Buyu together was indeed very risky.
"Let's move in together after all."
"And commit what kind of offense?"
There was a particular way to be put in prison; the ancestor was only imprisoned for half a month. If the offense they committed was too light, they might not be detained at all. However, if it was too severe, being locked up for two to three months would not be worth it.
"How about we steal something? That's the simplest." Lu Yang suggested earnestly.
...
At the City Lord's mansion, the City Lord looked troubled as he listened to the two men making accusations at the foot of the hall.
"Are you saying you're called Lu Yang, you stole two thousand nine hundred Spirit Stones from Meng Jingzhou, and you refuse to return them?"
The City Lord then shifted his gaze to the other person.
"And you're saying you're called Meng Jingzhou, you also stole two thousand nine hundred Spirit Stones from Lu Yang, and you also refuse to return them?"
The two men nodded earnestly.
They had checked it out; in this region, the threshold for a Nascent Soul Stage cultivator to be charged with theft was three thousand Spirit Stones. If the amount was less than that, it could only be treated as an administrative case.
And the maximum punishment for an administrative case was detention for fifteen days.
Since they stole from each other and refused to return the items or reconcile, the City Lord had no choice but to give them the maximum penalty, detaining them for fifteen days.
Treating the offenses as canceling each other out and acting as if nothing happened was not an option either, because the cases were independent and could not be merged.
The City Lord hissed in frustration, having heard that disciples from the Seek Dao Sect enjoyed Enlightenment in prison; could the rumors be true?

chapters.title: Chapter 817 - 816: The Powerful Gold Clan Leader
chapters.content:
"Grandmaster, we've come to see you," said Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou with a smile as they looked at the Daoist Xiantian sitting cross-legged on the ground.
The light from the oil lamp cast their figures, making them look incredibly tall.
The Daoist Xiantian wore a confused expression as he looked at Lu Yang and the other, who had brought bedding with them.
We've only been apart for half an hour, haven't we? How did you manage to end up in the same cell as me so quickly?
Daoist Buyu was deeply touched, never expecting his dear disciples to worry so much about his life in prison that they made a special trip to live with him.
"This place is actually quite suitable for the two of you to cultivate," said Daoist Buyu seriously.
The array method in the prison could restrain spiritual essence, but Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou's cultivation level was too high, their foundations too solid. They couldn't be fully restrained. Cultivating in the prison was like martial artists training with weights. If they could adapt to this environment, it would be greatly beneficial to their future cultivation.
"There's such a good thing?" Lu Yang was delighted, believing that good people are rewarded.
"Your master isn't wrong about that," Fairy Eternity said.
At that moment, Lu Yang's spiritual space underwent a major transformation. A row of thick pillars divided his spiritual space in two. Lu Yang was on one side, and Fairy Eternity on the other.
Fairy Eternity, as the head of the family, was very righteous, adhering to the principle of sharing hardship. She had herself locked up in the cell, even donning tattered prison clothes, suffering alongside Lu Yang.
"...Wait, isn't your living environment a bit too nice, Fairy?"
Lu Yang looked at his own side, covered with straw for bedding, tattered clothes as a pillow, and shackles on his hands and feet.
On the other hand, Fairy Eternity had an expensive and soft bed, a wardrobe for her clothes, a tea table with chairs and a teapot, and on the walls hung paintings by Fairy Eternity. Chickens were pecking at bugs on the ground – it was a painting of the battle between dragons and phoenixes.
Plus, with the prison clothes Fairy Eternity was wearing, she looked more like a privileged prisoner enjoying life in the prison.
Whereas Lu Yang seemed like the powerless type, bullied by the head jailer.
"My body is delicate; how could I sleep on straw?"
"Go, go, go, cultivate. I've even suppressed your Spiritual Sense so that you can cultivate it along with your other skills," she said.
After being shackled, Lu Yang indeed felt that his Spiritual Sense wasn't as naturally manageable as before.
In reality, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou sat cross-legged and cultivated according to the teachings of Daoist Buyu.
At the same time, Daoist Buyu, in order to temper the disciples' Daoist heart, continuously disturbed their cultivation by talking with the Daoist Xiantian.
Fortunately, both disciples had high cultivation talent and entered a meditative state quickly, unaffected by Daoist Buyu's interference.
Five days flew by, and Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou could both feel a slight improvement in their cultivation level. They believed that, without the suppression of the array, their control over spiritual essence would reach a new level.
Daoist Buyu found it strange to watch the two disciples with their mouths open wide, devouring the spiritual energy of heaven and earth.
"Is this the legendary innate Divine Ability of the Taotie Clan, Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth?"
"This is far more efficient than a Gathering Spirit Array, and you can cultivate anywhere, anytime."
The Gold Clan Leader looked baffled. Was the Taotie Clan's Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth really like this? It didn't match what he had seen before.
Just as Daoist Buyu was about to have another chat with the Daoist Xiantian, his expression suddenly changed.
With a loud boom, the cell lid was flipped open as if it was merely a box. The inmates inside lifted their heads to gaze at the dark night sky and the menacing silhouette standing below it.
"Damn, it's an enemy attack!" The jailer's face changed drastically as he shouted. His whole being was alert, weapon in hand, as he flew into the sky and stared intently at the silhouette.
The figure, as if oblivious to the Nascent Soul Stage jailer, coldly scanned the prisoners.
The nearby residents lit their oil lamps and peered through their paper-covered windows, trembling as they debated whether to hide inside their houses or flee.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou broke from their meditative state and looked at the silhouette.
Not being able to sense the other party's cultivation level meant that the other was an Integration Period Cultivator!
"Where are the people from the Ruthless Sect?" the figure said coldly.
Prison break!
Lu Yang and the other were astonished; they hadn't expected the Ruthless Sect to be so audacious as to actually attempt a prison break.
The captives from the Ruthless Sect were held deep within the prison, far from where Lu Yang and the others were imprisoned.
The followers of the Ruthless Sect were heavy offenders, and those who wished to join the sect likewise had criminal records, closely guarded by the Ye City government office.
But no matter how closely they were guarded, it wouldn't be possible to stop an Integration Period Cultivator from breaking into the prison!
"Audacious villain, perform the Dance of Arms!"
The prison head roared furiously, brandishing his weapon. The gleaming weapon, extra blinding against the night sky, seemed like another streak of moonlight.
The Dance of Arms is a form of martial dance, created under the moonlight, and if performed at night, its power could double!
That shadowy figure didn't even spare a glance at the prison head, and casually caught the moonlight-like weapon with a raised hand. Using all his strength, the prison head couldn't make the weapon budge an inch.
"Boring."
He tossed the prison head away, weapon and all, with a flick of his hand, and extended a finger, shooting out a black light intended to pierce through the prison head!
Whoosh—
An eerie wind, seemingly from nowhere, scattered the black light.
"Who is it?"
The figure's eyes narrowed as a majestic Qiongqi appeared in the air, its eyes flashing a bloodthirsty red, each breath carrying coldness and murderous aura, exhibiting an ancient and terrifying power.
"Roar!!" The Gold Clan Leader bellowed, like the lion's roar from Buddhism, the roar shaking heaven and earth, shattering space.
"An Integration Period Qiongqi?" The shadowy figure furrowed his brow. The City Lord's cultivation level was only at the Void Refinement Stage; how could there be an Integration Period Qiongqi here?
The Gold Clan Leader's gaze was piercing as he looked at the shadowy figure, thinking that if he could capture this person, it would be a great achievement according to what his older brother had said!
"It seems you knew I was bored in the cell and specially came to entertain me!" The Gold Clan Leader didn't take the shadowy figure seriously at all. Unlike the Di Jiang Clan, known for their grace and dancing, their Qiongqi Clan had been renowned for their combat prowess since ancient times!
With a swipe of his massive tiger paw, the air suddenly filled with a tearing wind. The figure's eyes turned piercingly sharp, and with a light tap of his foot, he moved through the wind like a phantom, easily evading the attack.
"The Qiongqi Clan is nothing more than this." The figure sneered. Suddenly, as if sensing something, he looked down to find three claw marks appearing on his chest out of nowhere, blood flowing profusely.
"This is all the ability the Ruthless Sect has, no wonder they willingly accept being cuckolded." The Gold Clan Leader laughed boisterously and lunged at the figure again.
The shadowy figure seemed to be provoked by the Gold Clan Leader's words, or perhaps they had stirred some unpleasant memories; endless dark energy surged from his sleeves, turning into shadows of ghouls.
"Expel Ghost technique?" The Gold Clan Leader sneered, showing his snow-white tiger teeth. A gentle beat of his wings stirred the surrounding air currents, causing the shadows of ghouls to tremble, showing signs that they were about to go out of control.
"It seems our Qiongqi Clan rarely takes action, making the world forget our Ghoul method!"
At the mention of the Ghoul method, Lu Yang's eyes twitched slightly, recalling the reason he joined the Eternity Sect was to eliminate a Tiger Demon proficient in the Ghoul method.
"No, the Ruthless Sect shouldn't be here to rescue anyone," muttered Daoist Buyu, frowning. From what he knew about the Ruthless Sect, rescuing people had no benefits for them.
Moreover, in the Great Xia, dragons hid amongst men, and towns that seemed to lack powerful figures could actually harbor hidden experts like the current situation. They were not only unable to rescue anyone but were also at risk of losing themselves.
Daoist Buyu spread his Spiritual Sense to search for anomalies in Ye City, and suddenly his expression stiffened, transforming into a sword light and shooting straight for the City Lord's mansion.
"Not good, something's happening at the City Lord's mansion!"

chapters.title: Chapter 818 - 817: Turmoil at the City Lord's Mansion
chapters.content:
Ye City Lord's Mansion.
City Lord Duan Xiu stepped out of the meditation chamber, furrowing his brows as he looked toward the direction of the prison.
"Who would be so audacious as to dare come here to perform a prison break!"
He had once been a military commander and was later transferred to Ye City to serve as the City Lord. His military experience had molded him into someone who remained unflustered in the face of danger. He analyzed the situation calmly and immediately summoned his subordinates, "To dare to break into the city to free a prisoner, the perpetrator must be at least at the early Integration stage.
Quickly, go to the neighboring four cities for backup and notify the troops stationed nearby!"
"Yes!"
Duan Xiu put on his old black battle armor and his helmet, as if he had returned to his military days a hundred years ago.
"Husband, what on earth is..."
"Dad, what happened?"
Duan Xiu's wife and son also noticed the disturbance as they came out of their rooms, seeing Duan Xiu in his armor, their expressions filled with concern.
Duan Xiu's resolute eyes softened as he held his wife's hand, stating seriously, "It's just a group of miscreants. Don't you know my strength? There won't be any issues."
"Besides, Ye City has yet to deploy its secret weapon."
"Then you must be careful."
Both Duan Xiu's wife and son were very worried about him.
Without looking back, Duan Xiu waved his hand and shouted, "Enough, go back and rest."
After bidding farewell to his wife and child, Duan Xiu headed to the underground chamber of the City Lord's mansion.
Few knew that beneath Ye City lay a Body Integration Realm level City Protection Array, which once activated could surely hold the enemy at bay until reinforcements arrived, if not outright defeat them.
He twisted a book on the bookshelf, which with a clatter moved aside to reveal a stone door. He channeled spiritual essence into the stone door, which opened to expose a long tunnel.
He swiftly entered the tunnel, making his way to the underground chamber.
As he passed through the tunnel, oil lamps affixed to the stone walls lit up one after another, illuminating the path all the way to the deepest part of the chamber.
"What!"
Upon reaching the chamber, he was taken aback to find that the Array Eye of the City Protection Array inscribed on the chamber walls had been annihilated beyond repair.
"How is this possible!"
Without his spiritual essence acting as a key, no one could have broken in here!
"City Lord Duan, are you surprised?"
A voice akin to a phantom's emerged from behind City Lord Duan.
"Who's there!" City Lord Duan whipped around, for he had had his spiritual essence unleashed from the start but hadn't sensed anyone approaching him.
The other's cultivation level exceeded his own!
The stranger introduced himself with a name City Lord Duan had never heard before, "Ruthless Sect, Wu Lei."
"So it really is your Ruthless Sect!" City Lord Duan watched Wu Lei warily, discreetly reaching for his Storage Ring to withdraw a red-tasseled spear.
"It seems you've split your forces, one to rescue the prisoners and one to hold me up!"
Wu Lei shook his head slightly, stating indifferently, "The rescue was merely a distraction, our true purpose here is to kill you!"
"Bold!"
The red-tasseled spear soared like a dragon ascending to the heavens, its tip twinkling with a fierce light as flames surged wildly.
Although he was at the Void Refinement Stage, he currently possessed the fighting power of the Body Integration Realm, unafraid of this member of the Ruthless Sect named Wu Lei!
Wu Lei's hands gently parted, his fingertips flickering with currents of electricity, stirring up a wild thunderstorm within the confined chamber!
Thud—
City Lord Duan, at the center of the thunderstorm, was ravaged by the lightning. Before the red-tasseled spear could even reach Wu Lei, he was struck, losing control over his body, and the spear clattered to the ground.
"Did you not know, City Lord Duan, that even within the Body Integration Realm there are levels of strength?" Wu Lei's words were devoid of any mocking tone, but given the current circumstances, the sarcasm was all the more potent.
"How can this be!" City Lord Duan, numb from the electricity, lacked even the strength to make a fist, and looked at Wu Lei in disbelief.
Even if there were differences within the Body Integration Realm, the outcome should not have been decided in one move. The thunderstorm he had unleashed had, unbelievably, struck all his weak points!
"What's so impossible about that?"
A voice all too familiar to Duan Xiu sounded from behind Wu Lei.
"Wenwu?!"
City Lord Duan's eyes widened as he looked at his son, Duan Wenwu, who came out from behind Wu Lei.
"You're an undercover agent for the Ruthless Sect?!"
The existence of the secret room, his own weakness—if all these were leaked by his son, then everything made sense!
Duan Wenwu looked at his frozen father and smiled, "I haven't truly joined the Ruthless Sect yet. Only after I kill you, I will be considered a member of the Ruthless Sect."
To join the Ruthless Sect, one needs to kill their closest kin.
For Duan Wenwu, his closest kin were his parents.
But his Cultivation Level was too low, even if City Lord Duan stood right here and let him attack, he couldn't even harm a single hair of City Lord Duan, who had a life-preserving magic artifact given by the Dynasty.
Therefore, he needed the higher-ups of the Ruthless Sect to make a move.
The higher-ups of the Ruthless Sect wouldn't help him for no reason, so he promised to help open the treasury of Ye City and let Wu Lei take whatever he desired.
"Why!" City Lord Duan's eyes were bloodshot as he struggled against the raging thunder within his body.
"Why? You have the nerve to ask why!" Upon hearing this question, Duan Wenwu seemed to strike a nerve, his expression becoming manic.
"You neither used your privilege to trade benefits with the Sect and send me to a Super-grade Sect or a First Class Sect, nor did you allow me to use the treasures of the treasury to increase my Cultivation Level, leading to me being twenty-five years old this year and still stuck in the Golden Core Stage!"
"I am the son of the City Lord, yet you haven't used your privilege for my sake even once!"
"Mother only comforted me, saying I was not naturally suited for Cultivation and could pursue a career in government!"
"A career in government, a career in government, a career in government, are you trying to make me become as inflexible as you are!"
"Have you ever considered my feelings!"
"Since you named me Wenwu, where is the 'martial' aspect!"
Twenty-five years old and still in the Golden Core Stage—he wasn't slow in Cultivation talent, but this was not the result of Duan Wenwu's Cultivation; rather, it was achieved with the savings City Lord Duan had used to help his son advance.
This was already the limit; Duan Wenwu's aptitude was too poor. If he were to advance further, the heavenly materials and earthly treasures needed were not within City Lord Duan's ability to provide.
"Trading benefits would harm the interests of the citizens of Ye City. The treasury belongs to the Dynasty, not to me personally; how can I give it to you..."
"Enough, don't speak any further!" Duan Wenwu shouted in anger, "Since you insist on upholding your dignity as the City Lord, then don't blame me for being ruthless!"
Inside the Ruthless Sect, there's a method to improve one's aptitude, requiring the heartblood of a family member as a catalyst.
The higher the family member's Cultivation Level, the better the effect of the catalyst.
If his father, a Cultivator of the Void Refinement Stage, were to be used, he could possibly transform into a genius with Dual Spirit Roots!
"Wenwu..." City Lord Duan's vision blurred as he gazed at the unrecognizable Duan Wenwu, with a surge of memories flashing through his mind: the birth of his son, his babbling, learning to walk, climbing trees to rob nests, being hit on the back of the hand by his teacher, crying while reciting books, testing for the Spirit Root, drawing breath into his body...
How did his good son turn out like this?
Seeing his father like this, Duan Wenwu's tone suddenly softened, and he sighed, "Father, I do love you and Mother, but I want to become stronger. For that, I have to sacrifice you both, I hope you can understand me."
"True Master, please make your move!" Duan Wenwu bowed to Wu Lei, his eyes flashing with a murderous intent, "Please kill my parents and everyone in the City Lord's Mansion!"
If the Dynasty were to learn of his joining the Ruthless Sect, they would surely use this as a clue for an investigation, bringing endless trouble.
For this reason, he reported the branch of the Ruthless Sect in Ye City, had all the branch members arrested, and then Wu Lei and another high-ranking member of the Ruthless Sect used this as an excuse to strike, breaking into the jail and killing his father and everyone else in the City Lord's Mansion who resisted.
And his own name would appear on the list of the dead, effectively erasing Duan Wenwu from the world, allowing him to join the Ruthless Sect smoothly without fearing the Dynasty's pursuit.
Considering the dangerous profits involved, he had given True Master Wu Lei so many benefits; once he joined the Ruthless Sect, he would naturally receive Wu Lei's support.
Wu Lei didn't say anything, his body surged with lightning and a bolt of thunder condensed in his palm.
"City Lord Duan, farewell."
Woosh—
A ray of sword light descended from the sky, slicing a deep chasm between Wu Lei and City Lord Duan, cutting open both the secret room and the room above it.
Wu Lei looked up sharply, glaring at the old Daoist holding the sword overhead, squeezing out four words through clenched teeth.
"Daoist Buyu!"
Daoist Buyu observed Wu Lei, gradually matching him with the person in his memories, and came to a sudden realization.
"You're Wu Lei? We haven't seen each other in over a thousand years, right? I remember when I joined the Ruthless Sect, you were in the late stages of Integration. How come you're still at that stage? Doesn't the Ruthless Sect's method of Cultivation work?"

chapters.title: Chapter 819 - 818 Revenge of the Ruthless Sect
chapters.content:
The upper echelons of the Ruthless Sect were well aware that Wu Lei was always serious and humorless, devoid of emotional fluctuations, and had walked far on the merciless path.
But now, he truly struggled to maintain a tranquil mind.
Years ago, Daoist Buyu's actions had severely damaged the fortune of the Ruthless Sect, leading to a considerable decline in the sect's vitality.
When the Ruthless Sect recovered its strength, many privately wished to seek revenge on Daoist Buyu as their peace of mind had been disrupted by him.
But by that time, Daoist Buyu had progressed from the Divinity Transformation Stage to the Body Integration Realm and had even become a Sect Leader, making him not so easy to kill anymore.
Moreover, this bastard Daoist Buyu had too many enemies; when someone from the Ruthless Sect intended to kill him, it was highly likely a Righteous Path cultivator at the Body Integration Realm would suddenly appear, also seeking revenge on Daoist Buyu.
The problem was that if the people from the Ruthless Sect were present, the Righteous Path Body Integration cultivator would definitely take care of them first before dealing with Daoist Buyu.
Ironically, the improved version of the 'Path Enhancement via Spousal Sacrifice' proposed by Daoist Buyu was approved by the Master and even described as "highly praised," so much so that it remained in use within the Ruthless Sect even after Daoist Buyu's defection.
This led to very few people within the Ruthless Sect thereafter seeking to augment their cultivation through marriage without affection.
The thought of entering into love and marriage with the aim of sending one's wife away... who the hell could carry on with that?!
In the matter of cultivation, the higher the cultivation level, the more one's mind state is required to be. After the Daoist Buyu incident, many high-ranking members of the Ruthless Sect were stuck at their current cultivation levels, and it took them hundreds of years to finally recover their original mind state.
Now, Wu Lei was on the verge of failing to maintain his mind state.
"Are you Daoist Buyu... the Sect Leader?" the City Lord had not expected Daoist Buyu to come to the rescue. Was he just happened to be in Ye City?
Daoist Buyu scratched his chin: "Actually, I've been in your Ye City's prison all along, but since I was concerned about being surrounded by old friends and disrupting the order of Ye City's prison, I thoughtfully used a false name and changed my appearance."
"I'm only stepping up to face this crisis for Ye City, to atone for my sins and earn merits."
Daoist Buyu had an expression that clearly stated they had better reduce his sentence after his meritorious deed.
Upon hearing Daoist Buyu's words, Wu Lei's heart stirred, and he quietly crushed a jade slip.
Daoist Buyu then started reminiscing with Wu Lei: "You seem quite without prospects staying in the Ruthless Sect. Why not join our Seek Dao Sect's Captive Peak? It's full of great powers capable of guiding you, a mere cultivator at the Body Integration Realm."
"I'll tell you, I don't inform others about such a great place within our Seek Dao Sect. It's because we know each other that I'm telling you about it."
"Shut up!" Wu Lei barked in a low voice.
His palms came together, and the lightning around him surged as he instantly summoned a storm cloud. Amid the thunderous roar, countless lightning bolts darted out like agile snakes, striking at Daoist Buyu.
They were all in the late stages of Body Integration; he himself had lingered in this stage for two thousand years, a true veteran, and still he was supposed to be unable to kill you!
The longsword left its sheath, Sword Qi soaring across, like a Milky Way waterfall, resembling a flowing ink painting. The Sword Qi waterfall surged backwards into the sky and collided with the thunderclouds.
The thunderclouds seemed to be made of paper, pierced through by the Sword Qi waterfall.
Daoist Buyu twisted his wrist, and with a light flick of his sword tip, it resonated with heaven and earth, drawing in the scattered Sword Intent around. The sharp Sword Intent gathered on the blade, incredibly fine and fast.
The Sword Intent erupted, illuminating Wu Lei's horrified face.
Wu Lei quickly created armor from lightning, protecting his vitals, but even this strike was not enough to withstand the concentrated Sword Intent, which pierced through his shoulder blade.
Wu Lei retreated continuously, putting distance between him and Daoist Buyu.
"We're both at the Body Integration Realm, so how come you can't even take one of my moves? How is the gap between us even greater than I imagined?"
"Daoist Buyu, you thief!"
Wu Lei could no longer suppress his anger. By seniority, he belonged to the same generation as the children's grandmaster, and Daoist Buyu was just a younger member!
Daoist Buyu shook his head gently, worried about Wu Lei's prospects: "Look at you, with such an unstable mind state, how are you supposed to get ahead in the Ruthless Sect?"
Wu Lei formed hand seals and chanted a thunder spell. Instantly, the clouds in the sky roiled and rumbling thunder ensued, followed by several thick lightning bolts heeding his call and striking down ferociously.
The light from the clashing sword glares and lightning illuminated the entire city, causing a deafening explosion to erupt.
-Pfft-
As the light dissipated, Wu Lei spurted blood from his mouth; his right arm shorn off, and at the stump, Sword Qi flickered, preventing the wound from healing!
Wu Lei had not expected that, although both at the late stage of the Body Integration Realm, the gap between him and Daoist Buyu was so immense—just a few rounds in and he had already sustained such injuries!
Daoist Buyuh's eyes narrowed slightly; he had been on guard for Wu Lei's escape, yet the opponent seemed intent on dragging the fight, continuously engaging him in a battle of wits.
What was he waiting for?
Suddenly, a terrifying pressure enveloped Daoist Buyu. Daoist Buyu, who was flying in the air, could hardly bear the pressure and almost fell from the sky!
The aftershocks of the pressure wreaked havoc in Ye City, chilling the civilians to the bone; they shivered uncontrollably, teeth chattering.
"Buyu, you little brat, I didn't expect to find you here."
"Here, I set the rule, [No information may be transmitted out of Ye City]."
"Here, I set the rule, [No one may leave Ye City]."
As the two rules were established, a curtain blacker than the night sky appeared above the man's head and spread rapidly to the surroundings, until it enveloped the entire Ye City.
"Now, it's time for us to settle our scores."
The middle-aged man with a cold look in his eyes gazed at Daoist Buyu, his voice booming like thunder, causing the space to tremble with his mere words.
Daoist Buyu looked up at him, laughing: "I was wondering why that waste Wu Lei kept not running away, turns out he wanted to hold me back for you, the Grand Master Su, to come over."
The Vice Sect Hierarch of the Ruthless Sect, Su Moran, at the mid-stage of Transcendance Tribulation.
With Su Moran's support, Wu Lei suddenly felt emboldened: "You little thief Buyu, today is the day you die!"
As Daoist Buyu just said, no cultivator on the righteous path knew that Daoist Buyu was here and now Ye City has been sealed off by Vice Hierarch Su, allowing entry but no exit.
The huge gap in cultivation level laid bare; without reinforcements, this was a once-in-a-millennium chance to kill Daoist Buyu!
Su Moran was also a victim of an event from the past; in fact, he was the highest in cultivation among the victims. His hatred for Daoist Buyu ran deep into his bones, yet he was always cautious and would not act without being certain of a kill.
If Daoist Buyu truly escaped, it would be even harder to kill him later!
"Grand Master Su, you old man, how come you're just like that idiot Wu Lei? Over a thousand years have passed, and you're still stuck at the mid-stage of passing tribulation?"
"Have you reached the limit of your cultivation level, or is it that... there's a flaw in your mind state?"
Su Moran remained unmoved, pulled out two axes, and said in a heavy voice, "You little brat Buyu, wasting time is useless. You will not be able to find a loophole in the rules and escape from Ye City."
"For today's opportunity, I have waited for over a thousand years."
Unless he killed Daoist Buyu, Su Moran would always have a flaw in his mind state, tormented by hatred. To progress further in his cultivation and reach the late stage of Transcendance Tribulation, he had to kill Daoist Buyu; no other method would work!
Daoist Buyu wanted to say something more, to delay time and look for a chance to survive. Although his strength was half a step into the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, he was ultimately just at half-step and not yet capable of contending with Transcendance Tribulation cultivators, let alone his opponent being an old-hand at the mid-stage of Transcendance Tribulation.
Su Moran had been investigating Daoist Buyu and knew that if he let him speak any further, he might indeed find an opening.
The way to deal with Daoist Buyu was to not let him speak.
Whiz!
Su Moran's muscles tensed, and the two massive axes crashed down with a thunderous roar. The axes were broad and their blades sharp beyond compare—meant to be wielded with two hands, yet Su Moran held one in each.
The axes slammed down on Daoist Buyu, who crossed his sword in defense, but the force was far more than Daoist Buyu could withstand.
Daoist Buyu spat out blood, being directly smashed into the artificial mountain in the City Lord's mansion and ended up in a spread-eagled "big" character.
"If you attempt to flee, these three million civilians of Ye City will have to pay with their lives for your actions," said Su Moran coldly, aware that this was a leverage point on Daoist Buyu.
"Flee? Why should I run?"
Daoist Buyu slowly raised his head, half of his face drenched in blood, looking exceptionally terrifying, with a wicked smile forming on his lips.
"Do you know why I have not ascended to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage?"
With strength, he shattered the artificial mountain and stepped towards Su Moran, his aura rising like climbing bamboo segments.
"I was afraid that after ascending to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, you old fart wouldn't dare come after me!"

chapters.title: Chapter 820 - 819: Daoist Buyu Ascends to the Transcendence Tribulation Stage
chapters.content:
Lu Yang, who was in the distance, heard his master speak like this and suddenly remembered something Fairy Eternity had said upon first meeting his master; she had mentioned that his master could have already reached the Transcendance Tribulation Stage long ago, yet for some reason, he had always suppressed his cultivation level.
Was it all for today?
Su Moran's expression tensed as he stared at Daoist Buyu, then suddenly relaxed.
As a cultivator in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, he knew all too well how difficult it was to break through this stage—mind state, cultivation level, condition, enlightenment, elixirs... without one, the rest would be in vain.
Back then, in order to advance to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, he didn't hesitate to blood sacrifice an entire town, using heaven and earth treasures to temper his body. Unfortunately, he still failed, and due to the failed promotion, he sustained severe injuries and fled to the Demon Territory while being pursued by the forces of Great Xia, hiding and healing for over a hundred years.
Only after sacrificing an entire demon race was he finally able to successfully advance to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, and the journey was fraught with twists and turns.
For over a thousand years, he had always kept an eye on Daoist Buyu's movements. For instance, over a decade ago, Seek Dao Sect declared Daoist Buyu missing, and it was only ten years later that Daoist Buyu re-emerged before the public eye.
Those ten years of absence must have been Daoist Buyu recovering in secret after failing to Pass Tribulation!
Having failed the Pass Tribulation and sustaining injuries just ten years ago, it was impossible to attempt Tribulation again in such a short period of time!
"Advancing to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage? Just bluffing,"
"Whether I'm bluffing or not, you old geezer, try and you'll find out!"
Daoist Buyu roared, no longer suppressing himself. His aura gradually climbed and then skyrocketed. Although his oppressive power wasn't as terrifying as Su Moran's, it was not something a cultivator in the Body Integration Realm could possess.
It was the aura that only someone at the early stage of Transcendance Tribulation could have. Daoist Buyu hadn't yet reached the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, but he already possessed the aura of that stage!
Boom!
Daoist Buyu, releasing all restraints on his aura, attracted the Heaven-shrouding Thunder Tribulation, dispelling Su Moran's oppressive force. Zigzagging purple-gold lightning ravaged the skies and earth with such ferocity that the land itself trembled.
The citizens of Ye City, whether ordinary people or cultivators, all felt fear and dared not lift their heads to gaze upon the terrifying Heavenly Tribulation.
"Oh-ho, Purple Sky Annihilating Thunder, your master's talent is quite good," Fairy Eternity remarked after just one glance at the Thunder Tribulation, recognizing the type of Tribulation and boasting proudly to Lu Yang, "Of course, it can't compare to the Thunder Tribulation I faced during my Ascension."
Even before Yingtian Immortal became immortal, Thunder Tribulation existed in the world. Yingtian Immortal's Tribulation Dao Fruit was to control the original Thunder Tribulation and to create new forms of it.
According to Fairy Eternity, after Yingtian Immortal's Ascension, the types of Thunder Tribulation increased more than tenfold, becoming complex and plentiful, meeting all the needs of cultivators except for those who wished not to undergo Tribulation.
"There really is a Thunder Tribulation," Su Moran felt that things seemed somewhat beyond his expectations.
Unfortunately, no one could interfere during Tribulation; whoever did so would also need to undergo Tribulation.
He started to think about retreating, slowly moving towards the edge of Ye City. He didn't need to gamble whether Daoist Buyu could really become a Transcendance Tribulation cultivator here or not.
But Daoist Buyu obviously didn't want Su Moran to leave. As Su Moran approached the edge of Ye City, Daoist Buyu dragged the Thunder Tribulation closer to him. If Su Moran dared to leave Ye City, Daoist Buyu was ready to quickly catch up to him, forcing them to undergo the Tribulation together!
Daoist Buyu dared to bet that he could survive the Thunder Tribulation, but Su Moran didn't dare to take that bet.
Seeing this, Su Moran had no choice but to abandon the idea of leaving Ye City.
Facing the thousands of rampaging purple-gold lightning snakes in the sky, Daoist Buyu leisurely exhaled a breath of clear air, and with a thought, countless Spirit Swords emerged from beneath the soil.
One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand!
With two fingers pointing towards the sky, a myriad of Spirit Swords emerged from the ground like fish leaping over the Dragon Gate, their blades twirling elegantly to meet the thousands of lightning serpents.
The clash between sword and lightning once again lit up Ye City as if it were broad daylight, the intensity far surpassing the battle with Wu Lei!
One after another, more ferocious bolts of lightning followed in quick succession, each strike more violent than the last. Daoist Buyu held a Spirit Sword horizontally, its surface reflecting his serene eyes.
Under Daoist Buyu's feet, a magnificent Sword Path unfurled; with each step, a Spirit Sword would emerge, these were the swords of Sword Cultivators he had defeated, their essence etched into his Sword Path as part of it, powered by the sword intent of his heart.
These illusory shadows of Spirit Swords originated from Foundation Establishment Stage opponents, some from Divinity Transformation Stage adversaries, and even an entire wall from the Sword Tower... Now, under Daoist Buyu's empowerment, they had all advanced to a level capable of withstanding Heavenly Tribulation.
Facing the unending assault of Heavenly Tribulation, Daoist Buyu casually picked up a sword from his feet that had cracked in a previous thunder strike, discarded by him, absorbed and restored by the Sword Path; he picked up another and kept repeating this action.
In the throes of the terrifying Heavenly Tribulation, the space within three feet of Daoist Buyu seemed like a sanctuary, unaffected by the Thunder Tribulation.
However, Daoist Buyu did not simply resist with Swordsmanship alone. In truth, not every Spirit Sword could completely block the Thunder Tribulation; portions of it still passed through the swords to Daoist Buyu, who used the tribulation to temper his spirit and body.
During this process, his cultivation level steadily climbed while his presence became increasingly concealed, appearing diminished to outsiders.
When the strongest and final bolt of Thunder Tribulation descended, Daoist Buyu actively dispersed the Sword Path at his feet.
Crack!
Daoist Buyu seemed to become a sword himself, a boundless sea of sword intent hidden within his body, like an Immortal Sword in its scabbard, unnoticeable until the last Thunder Tribulation was about to hit, then the Immortal Sword sprung forth, cutting through the lightning!
The Thunder Tribulation split in two, its light fading, and the clear night sky reappeared before everyone's eyes.
"Is this what it feels like to be in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage? It really is more comfortable than the Body Integration Realm," Daoist Buyu said, sensing the changes following his ascension and revealing a smile.
A typical cultivator would need to consolidate their cultivation upon first reaching the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, but Daoist Buyu had deliberately suppressed it during the late stage of body integration for decades and no longer needed seclusion to solidify it.
He abruptly looked up, staring at the indifferent Su Moran, and spoke leisurely.
"Master Su, you've waited for over a thousand years for the chance to kill me, haven't you?"
"Quite coincidentally, I too have waited for this opportunity for over a thousand years."
"Without killing you, I cannot rest easy."
"Arrogant! Do you think, just by advancing to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, you're qualified to duel with me?" Su Moran's tone remained as flat as ever. Having just ascended to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, lacking in battle experience, with a clear gap in cultivation level—how does Daoist Buyu intend to fight him?
Daoist Buyu revealed a mocking smile and suddenly launched an attack, catching Su Moran off-guard. His sword broke through Su Moran's defense, leaving a scar on his face.
Daoist Buyu pressed on immediately, locking eyes with Su Moran.
"In the Sect, I have my mentor to practice with; outside the Sect, I had Senior Jiekill to spar with. Why would you think I lack experience in dueling with those in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage?"

chapters.title: Chapter 821 - 820 Someone Wants Your Life
chapters.content:
```
"Our Sect Leader has schemed this far?" Meng Jingzhou was astonished, wondering if Daoist Buyu provoked others all along just for this battle today?
Lu Yang said somberly, "No, I think it's just our Master's nature to make enemies everywhere."
"Has that little thief Buyu reached the Pass Tribulation stage?" The Ruthless Sect Body Integration Realm above Lu Yang's head noticed the commotion at the City Lord's mansion, obviously, someone who also had a history with Daoist Buyu.
"Still have the energy to care about others?" The Gold Clan Leader's eyes burned red as he fanned the demonic fire, opened his huge bloody mouth, and swallowed all sorts of ghostly shadows summoned by the other, refining them into Ghouls in his stomach for his own use.
The Qiongqi Clan is naturally a battle-oriented race, who, once in combat mode, only focus on their opponents and disregard their surroundings.
According to Fairy Eternity's judgment, this is called being single-minded.
"Who can win?" Daoist Xiantian watched the skies above the City Lord's mansion anxiously. He hadn't seen the likes of a Transcendence Tribulation Stage battle even during his time in the Body Integration Realm, let alone expect to witness one so soon after just a few days in the prison.
...
Daoist Buyu's feet paved the grand path of Swordsmanship once more, with countless sword shadows sprouting from beneath, the murderous intent shocking the world. Sword beams soared into the sky in an unpredictable fashion, as if dragons were soaring and phoenixes were dancing!
The Spirit Sword exhaled colorful Sword Qi, sharp and dazzling, captivating the soul.
