Su Moran felt his hair stand on end. He hadn't even come into contact with the Sword Qi when he felt a piercing pain, as if thousands of needles were pricking him.
He suddenly lifted two giant axes, with countless shattered mountain illusions emerging behind him, all mountains he had split with his axe.
"Five Mountains Fissure!"
A swath of mountainous illusions poured down with the swing of his axes as if heaven and earth were collapsing!
The citizens of Ye City trembled in fear, knowing that if this strike were to hit Ye City, the city would be reduced to rubble, leaving no survivors!
Daoist Buyu sat cross-legged on one leg, using his sword as a zither, playing and singing with a song that was bold and stirring, resonating with ten thousand swords. The Sword Qi soared, stirring the heavens and the earth, shattering the mountainous illusions!
Lu Yang suddenly remembered his Third Senior Sister saying that she was good at music, which she had learned from their Master.
"Here, I establish a rule. [You are not allowed to call out the names of your moves]." For the first time, Daoist Buyu, in his Transcendence Tribulation Stage identity, set a temporary rule.
Su Moran, wielding his axes, was about to shout his move when he was nearly choked by Daoist Buyu's rule.
The matters bound by Daoist Buyu's rules were trivial, so their binding power was immense. Moreover, since Su Moran had previously laid down two [Rules] to seal off Ye City, he now had no strength to defy Daoist Buyu on the level of rules.
"During a fight, don't randomly shout the names of moves; it's bad for your throat... One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand!"
Tens of thousands of Spirit Sword illusions flew out from the grand path of Swordsmanship, resonating with each other, their light merging into a three-foot divine sword.
"This is the Unification of Ten Thousand Swords!" Daoist Buyu taunted again and again. Even if Su Moran repeated the mantra of tranquility in his mind a hundred times, it was useless, and he couldn't help but feel furious.
You won't let me call out my moves, fine, but you can—and you do it on purpose, naming them incorrectly!
"Getting old and the brain not working well? Why do you believe whatever I say?" Daoist Buyu looked at Su Moran disdainfully, wondering how he could be the Vice Sect Hierarch with such ability.
Suddenly, as the divine sword condensed from ten thousand swords was about to pierce Su Moran, it burst apart, becoming ten thousand swords once more. Su Moran was caught off guard, his body riddled with sword holes.
"I already said it's One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand. Didn't you think to guard against it?" Daoist Buyu laughed, his eyes full of mockery.
Watching the battle from afar, Lu Yang silently thought to himself, these moves of yours, Master, they couldn't possibly have been honed by sparring with Grandmaster and Master Jiesha, could they?
For more than a thousand years, Su Moran had been keeping an eye on Daoist Buyu's movements and fighting styles.
However, Daoist Buyu's style was so varied that it couldn't be grasped through mere observation, let alone countered!
The fight quickly escalated, with swords dazzling and axe shadows intertwining, the air heavy with the sparks of fierce combat.
```
Daoist Buyu moved like a specter, his long sword casting shadows with every movement, transitioning from complex to simple, and back to complex, his techniques ever-changing and endless. The dual axes carried a great force and swung as swift as the wind, providing an impenetrable defense like water off a duck's back.
Wu Lei, who was watching the battle from the side, didn't dare to intervene in a fight of this caliber. With his cultivation level, even taking a single blow would result in certain death or severe injury!
Suddenly, Daoist Buyu found an opening, his sword tip flicked, expertly breaking the crossed axes' defense and exposing the chest's barrier door.
"This is bad!" Su Moran thought to himself, wanting to reset his defensive stance, but the opening had been methodically forced by Daoist Buyu's attacks, who had anticipated this very moment. Another move, long in the making, would not give Su Moran any chance to react!
"Sword Opens Heaven's Gate!"
The sharp sword cleaved down like a ribbon of silk. The sky trembled, carrying limitless intent to kill, aiming straight for Su Moran!
When he was at the late stage of Body Integration Realm, this move forced even the Transcendance Tribulation Stage Poxiao to dodge, and now that he had ascended to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, the power of this strike far surpassed before!
The heavens split open, and a swath of mighty Sword Qi engulfed Su Moran.
Suddenly, Su Moran appeared at another location, the life-saving talisman on his chest starting to burn, signifying that he had just died once.
"Sword Opens Heaven's Gate!"
Without a second thought, Daoist Buyu advanced and struck Su Moran, who had just escaped with his life, with another sword.
The firmament shook, the blade's edge clear and brilliant, like a dazzling rainbow, hacking towards Su Moran!
This time, without a life-saving talisman, the sword struck true, bisecting his body in two!
Su Moran circulated his profound energy, burning his essence blood to heal his body. Although his body recovered, his vitality was severely damaged, and a visible line could still be seen down the center.
He desperately tried to flee Ye City.
Bang!
He ran headfirst into an invisible wall that surrounded Ye City.
He had established the rule here that [no one may leave Ye City].
No one, including himself.
Just as he was about to lift this rule, he heard Daoist Buyu's voice from behind: "[You are not allowed to leave Ye City]."
Having set two rules himself, Su Moran had given Daoist Buyu the authority to set two rules as well. The second rule had not been used until this moment!
"Wait..."
Su Moran tried to say something only to see Daoist Buyu, not even listening, pierce through Su Moran's Lingtai with his sword and stomp on his body, crashing down from the sky with a heavy impact on the ground.
"Wait—spare my life, we could go to Demon City, let Venerate Zhu Tian use the Dao Fruit Outline to turn me into your slave!" Su Moran quickly pleaded.
Daoist Buyu's white teeth gleamed, terrifying in the darkness.
He shook his head slightly: "I'm sorry, I've accepted a commission, someone wants your life."
"Who, who is it? I can give you double, no, triple the reward!"
Daoist Buyu was smiling, a cold smile: "Over a thousand years ago, I, along with the Seek Dao Sect and the Dynasty, exterminated the bases of your Ruthless Sect and saved quite a few people—men and women, young and old, many of whom were tortured beyond recognition by your sect."
"Upon seeing me, they cried, begging me to kill every member of your Ruthless Sect."
"What kind of reward does Master Su think he can offer to make those people forget their hate for your Ruthless Sect?"

chapters.title: Chapter 822 - 821: There's no need to trouble Yun Zhi with such a trifle
chapters.content:
"I..."
Su Moran still wanted to argue, but Daoist Buyu twisted the spirit sword embedded in Su Moran's forehead, directly crushing his Lingtai.
It was exceedingly difficult to kill someone at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. A soul flew out from Su Moran's Lingtai, desperately fleeing at the cost of its source energy.
"Trying to escape?"
Daoist Buyu sneered, with a thought, sword Qi filled the space, occupying every inch. Any object attempting to move within the sword Qi's domain would be slashed into pieces.
Scared stiff, Su Moran's soul dared not move. Daoist Buyu took out a red gourd, opened its mouth, and sucked Su Moran's soul into it.
To extract information from the soul, he would have to ask his master to do it later; the soul of a person at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage was too strong. If he attempted it rashly, Su Moran's soul could backlash against him.
"What a pity, those people I saved back then can't witness this scene," Daoist Buyu sighed inwardly. Those events were over a thousand years ago. Only Cultivators at the Void Refinement Stage could live until now, and none of those he had rescued had cultivated to the Void Refinement Stage.
Daoist Buyu looked up, casually releasing a sword Qi that pierced Wu Lei, who was just about to turn around and flee.
Meanwhile, the battle between the Gold Clan Leader and the member of the Ruthless Sect at the Body Integration Realm was reaching its end. The sight of Su Moran's defeat terrified the Body Integrator of the Ruthless Sect, who, losing all desire to fight, tried to flee the battlefield.
But the Gold Clan Leader wouldn't give him the chance. With a flap of wings, the wind of Jinhai immobilized his body for an instant, and before he could react, the Gold Clan Leader opened its gaping maw and swallowed him whole.
"Look, this is how you should fight in a battle. Fight with single-minded dedication; that's the only way to bring out the strongest combat power," Fairy Eternity highly praised the Qiongqi Clan's method of fighting, having instructed the Barbarian tribe to learn from it numerous times.
"Is it, over?" Ye City Lord could hardly believe that he had witnessed Daoist Buyu achieving a breakthrough during battle, killing the Vice Sect Hierarch of the Ruthless Sect.
"It's over. The follow-up work will trouble City Lord Ye. I'm going back to the prison to check on my cellmates," Daoist Buyu said.
"All set." Daoist Buyu returned to the prison, patted the red gourd, and boasted to Lu Yang and the others about his spoils of war.
Daoist Buyu gleefully calculated, "Catching a mid-stage Transcendance Tribulation and a late-stage Body Integration. How many days could I serve as Acting Sect Master if I exchanged them for Contribution Points... Oh no, I am the Sect Leader."
Daoist Buyu suddenly remembered his own status.
"So impressive," Daoist Xiantian admired, looking up to Daoist Buyu. Achieving a breakthrough in the midst of battle, challenging those beyond his level, was a moment worthy of being heavily recorded in history, to become a beautiful tale for future generations.
"We've caught a Vice Sect Hierarch, Su Moran must have a lot of intelligence. We have to be cautious that the Ruthless Sect doesn't come to snatch him away," Daoist Buyu knew that this was not truly over until they delivered Su Moran's soul to the Seek Dao Sect. Only then would it be finished.
"Should I summon Eldest Senior Sister?" Lu Yang volunteered, ready to use the Imitation Fist of the Eldest Senior Sister.
Daoist Buyu waved his hand, "No need to trouble her with such a small matter, just invite the Vast Sea Daoist Lord over."
He lowered his head and said to Daoist Xiantian, "Ancestor, you must have a way to invite the Vast Sea Daoist Lord over, right?"
"Yes, of course." As both a senior and junior to the Vast Sea Daoist Lord, Daoist Xiantian had both the connections and moral grounds to contact him.
He took out a transmission talisman from his chest. The talisman ignited by itself, opening a door of space. A figure emerged from it.
The figure closed his eyes, stretched out his arms, and his clothes were disheveled, "Come here, Yar, give us a kiss… huh, where is this?"
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord felt the shift in space, having been transported from the East Sea to the land.
Everyone silently watched the Vast Sea Daoist Lord emerge from the space door, shivering, not daring to speak in the presence of a Semi-Immortal who had mastery over the embryonic Spatial Dao Fruit, fearing no one had the ability to escape.
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord surveyed his surroundings; they were mostly familiar faces: Daoist Xiantian, Daoist Buyu, Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, and also a member of the Qiongqi Clan he did not recognize. He presumed that Daoist Xiantian must have used a transport talisman, which should only be used when encountering danger.
He cleared his throat and asked seriously, "I was in the midst of seclusion, may I know why you have sought me out?"
The others, having observed the Vast Sea Daoist Lord's recent behavior, did not quite believe he had been in seclusion.
Daoist Xiantian pointed at Daoist Buyu and said, "This is the situation: he has captured a Vice Sect Hierarch of the Ruthless Sect. Fearing accidents during transportation, we wish to trouble you to transmit the soul of the Ruthless Sect's Vice Sect Hierarch back to the Seek Dao Sect."
"You've captured the Vice Sect Hierarch of the Ruthless Sect?" The Vast Sea Daoist Lord was greatly surprised. The members of the Ruthless Sect were known for their caution, making it extremely difficult to capture their high-ranking cultivators.
"Very well, leave this matter to me. I would like to see who dares to snatch someone from my hands!" The Vast Sea Daoist Lord was delighted and spoke with natural arrogance.
Over at the City Lord's residence, City Lord Duan personally arrested his son.
Looking at his still-struggling son, he sighed, wondering how his good son could have turned into such a state.
The son's crimes were too grave, surpassing the scope of what the City Lord could handle. This matter would have to be handled by the Dynasty... it was likely inescapable from death.
City Lords of nearby cities arrived with a large entourage, along with the troops stationed nearby. They rushed to City Lord Duan's location as soon as they could, only to find that the battle had already concluded.
"What's this? Daoist Buyu has captured a Vice Sect Hierarch of the Ruthless Sect?"
On hearing this, the crowd was astonished. This was a significant matter, far beyond their capacity to handle. They needed to report to the Dynasty immediately and request for a high official to make a determination."
...
Imperial City.
It was deep into the night. Normally, officials would have been resting by now, but high-ranking cultivators have the advantage of being able to work regardless of day or night.
Exhausted, the Minister of Justice was reviewing a document. He did not usually work so late, but recently, with the East Sea attracting attention and cultivators from Great Xia forming expeditions there, numerous foreign cases had arisen, making management troublesome.
Furthermore, as the types of foreign cases diversified, the existing laws proved inadequate, necessitating the formulation of new legislation.
Also troublesome was the issue with the Demon Nation: they were intent on establishing diplomatic relations with Great Xia, and matters related to legal negotiations were his responsibility.
"How come both the Demon Nation and East Sea, which used to be quiet places, have become so lively in the past two years? Is it because of the struggles of the Great Era?"
"Isn't it said that the Great Era's struggle harkens back to ancient times, with geniuses vying to Pass Tribulation and battles erupting everywhere?"
After finishing the last document, the Minister of Justice was ready to go home and rest.
His subordinate burst through the door in a flurry, reporting hastily, "Sir, there's urgent news from Ye City in Ji State; a major figure of a demonic sect has been arrested."
"Such good news?" The Minister of Justice immediately brightened up, his sleepiness dissipated. He had not expected to receive such good news late at night.
"Who was the Daoist friend that made the capture?"
"Er... it was Daoist Buyu."
"I'm asking who made the capture, not who was captured."

chapters.title: Chapter 823 - 822: All the Prison Buddies Have Left
chapters.content:
After listening to the detailed report from his subordinate, the Minister of Justice was sure he hadn't misunderstood.
It was indeed Daoist Buyu, that grandson, who had captured Su Moran.
"Let's go to Ye City, and also, bring some of the Luoshui Guards. Remember to keep it quiet, so as not to alert the Ruthless Sect to our activity!"
Accompanied by a small elite force, the Minister of Justice rushed to Ye City, recalling the scenes of being toyed with by Daoist Buyu in his younger days at Imperial City, seething with indignation.
"He has reached the Transcendence Tribulation Stage? Is there no justice left in this world!"
"Let His Majesty handle the myriad state affairs in the future, I'm going to cultivate!"
...
On the way to Ye City, they joined forces with the men from the Luoshui Guards, led by Luo Changhe from the Nine Palaces, who was at the mid-stage of Transcendence Tribulation.
Regrettably, they were a step too late: Su Moran's soul had already been transferred back to the Seek Dao Sect by the Vast Sea Daoist Lord.
However, they weren't entirely late; Daoist Buyu and his fellow prisoners were still here serving their sentences.
"Old Xu, over here!" Daoist Buyu waved at Minister of Justice Xu Xin below.
Xu Xin realized that he really couldn't see through Daoist Buyu's cultivation level, convinced that he had truly reached the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, rather than temporarily boosting his powers through some secret technique to defeat Su Moran.
As soon as Xu Xin landed, he heard Daoist Buyu say in an old and croaky voice, "Little Xu, you're an old man now, you understand the rules of the cultivation world without me saying them, where the accomplished are revered. Bearing in mind that we were once peers, you just need to call me Daoist Buyu."
Xu Xin rolled his eyes, not wanting to engage with Daoist Buyu.
It was then that he turned his attention to Daoist Buyu's fellow prisoners.
"Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, what are you two doing here?"
He had seen Lu Yang before when he was framed and thrown into jail by Daoist Buyu.
As for Meng Jingzhou, could he not recognize a Meng Family Member, an influential force that had pushed forward the legal progress of Great Xia?
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou opened their mouths but were too embarrassed to admit that they had been stealing from each other and ended up here accompanying their illustrious ancestor.
Seeing Lu Yang and his companion like that, Xu Xin understood they must have been tricked by Daoist Buyu.
"Where's Su Moran?" Xu Xin remembered the purpose of his trip.
"Sent back to our Seek Dao Sect by the Vast Sea Daoist Lord," chuckled Daoist Buyu.
Hearing this, Xu Xin turned to leave for the Seek Dao Sect but was grabbed by Daoist Buyu.
"Hey, wait, wait, wait. I went to great lengths to capture Su Moran, that counts as a major merit, right? Just go through the procedures to get me out of here."
Daoist Buyu's original intention for staying in the prison was to show the Gold Clan Leader what life was like, but since the events in Ye City, it was no longer suitable for experiencing life, so it was better to leave prison.
Daoist Buyu pointed to the Gold Clan Leader beside him: "And my little brother here, just call him Goldie. He also captured a Body Integration Realm member of the Ruthless Sect, which is another major merit."
Xu Xin took a long look at the Gold Clan Leader, wondering who would voluntarily mix with Daoist Buyu – was his brain all right?
"Fine, I will go through the formalities with the City Lord later. Is that everything? If there's nothing else, I'm leaving." Xu Xin was eager to head to the Seek Dao Sect.
"Wait, wait, there's more. You also have to release this person."
"Can't you say everything all at once? Who is this person now?" Xu Xin followed the direction Daoist Buyu was pointing and saw Daoist Xiantian sitting in the corner.
"A disciple of our Seek Dao Sect. He was planning to infiltrate the Ruthless Sect as an undercover operative, but he got caught when Ye City raided their base. He was too ashamed to admit he was from the Seek Dao Sect, didn't want to tarnish our name, so he ended up here."
Xu Xin was amazement personified, never expecting the Seek Dao Sect to have such a pure-hearted disciple. Seemingly having only completed Foundation Establishment, he must have been with the Seek Dao Sect for about a year.
To remain untainted such a short while after joining the Seek Dao Sect was impressive.
"That can be arranged."
Xu Xin was about to leave when he suddenly stopped in his tracks, "There is nothing else this time, is there?"
"No, no more, off you go."
Soon, the Dynasty's people left the prison. Daoist Buyu, the Gold Clan Leader, and Daoist Xiantian also left the prison, leaving only Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou behind.
The two looked at each other in dismay. In the blink of an eye, the once-bustling cell was left with just the two of them.
"Think about it, it seems we really don't have a reason to be released."
Neither of them had contributed during the fight, and they weren't wrongfully imprisoned like the Ancestral Master.
"So how much longer do we have to be locked up?"
"Ten days."
The two shook their heads and sighed. Well, they'd just have to honestly cultivate here for ten days.
"There's not even a place to shelter from the wind and rain." Lu Yang looked up to see a clear starry sky. The roof had been ripped off by someone from the Ruthless Sect who was in the Body Integration Realm earlier.
He was still cultivating in his Spiritual Space with shackles on, enviously watching Fairy Eternity on the other side of the cage enjoying life.
"So much for good people getting good rewards."
...
After Vast Sea Daoist Lord brought Su Moran's soul back to the Seek Dao Sect, he immediately called for the children's Grandmaster at Captive Peak, Elder Tao from the Scripture Pavilion, and invited Yun Zhi.
Wu Lei's body was handed over to the Fifth Elder, who was told to refine it into a magic artifact at his convenience.
Su Moran's body wasn't refined; after all, it was Daoist Buyu's spoils of war, which could be used to strengthen his personal sword.
The upper echelons of the Seek Dao Sect's combat power gathered to directly search Su Moran's soul and obtained all of his memories.
At that moment, the Ministry of Punishments and the Luoshui Guards arrived posthaste to discuss matters related to the Ruthless Sect with the Seek Dao Sect.
Vast Sea Daoist Lord shared the intelligence and said with a frown, "The Ruthless Sect really is hard to deal with. According to Su Moran's memories, the appearance and age of the Master of the Ruthless Sect are unclear, suspected to be a Semi-Immortal.
Based on Su Moran's guess, the purpose of establishing the Ruthless Sect was to gather all the heartless people to observe their insights on the path of ruthlessness, to complete himself."
"Does that mean that the Master of the Ruthless Sect has been the same person since its establishment?" Luo Changhe from the Luoshui Guards was surprised. The Ruthless Sect was the oldest among the Four Great Devil Sects, existing since the beginning of Great Xia.
"Highly likely!"
"Enough of that for now. According to Su Moran's memories, the Ruthless Sect's headquarters has his life token. Once the soul leaves the body, the life token will shatter, and the high ranks of the Ruthless Sect will immediately abandon the headquarters and relocate."
"I'll open a space portal to the headquarters. With some luck, we might still make it in time."
The group stepped through the portal and arrived at the headquarters of the Ruthless Sect, at the bottom of the Canglong Lake in Yun Province.
Unfortunately, by the time they got there, the Ruthless Sect had already evacuated, and the entire lakebed was moved by Great Divine Skill, which also lowered the water level of the Canglong Lake by several tens of meters.
"Then let's go to the various branches!"
With all the locations of the branches in Su Moran's memory, Vast Sea Daoist Lord immediately opened countless space passages to those branches.
The Ruthless Sect branches were all guarded by strong cultivators, the weakest being at the Nascent Soul Stage.
But such cultivation levels were insignificant in the face of the combined forces of the Seek Dao Sect and the Dynasty.
Some branches were of higher status and had direct means of communication with the high ranks of the Ruthless Sect. Learning that the Vice Sect Hierarch had been captured, they immediately fled.
These branches were very few, only one-tenth of the total. The Dynasty and the Seek Dao Sect uprooted ninety percent of the branches and conducted overnight interrogations.
The situation for the remaining one-tenth of the branches wasn't much better either. They could run, but due to cultivation level restrictions, they were too slow, and many were caught by the Body Integration Realm cultivators who had arrived.
The Ruthless Sect was shaken to its core and severely wounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 824 - 823: When the Whale Falls, Life Thrives
chapters.content:
The collaboration between Seek Dao Sect and the Dynasty to exterminate the Ruthless Sect caused such a commotion that anyone with even a slight connection to the intelligence network knew about it.
Even the great powers of the Cultivation World were so shocked by this news that they were rendered speechless for a long time.
Moreover, upon hearing this news, some great Cultivation powers slumped into their chairs, their faces a picture of disbelief.
"Old Buyu has reached the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, how is that possible?"
The housekeeper wore a troubled expression, "Whether it's true or not, I don't know, but I heard that this news was deliberately spread by Daoist Buyu himself."
"...That does seem like something he would do."
"He formed his golden core just one day before I did and boasted about it right in front of me. If he has really reached the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, imagine how insufferable he'll become?"
"If that guy can reach the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, there's no reason I can't."
"Heavens are blind!"
"Cultivation retreat! Cultivation retreat!"
Similar scenes played out across the Cultivation World, with many significant figures cursing the heavens while deciding to go into retreat.
Even those in the Demon Territory and East Sea at the Body Integration Realm were not exempt, all attempting to make a breakthrough to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
When Zhu Tian attended the court, he found more than half the ministers absent, and only upon inquiry did he learn they had all gone into retreat.
With Daoist Buyu's ascension to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, the bustling Cultivation World suddenly became quiet.
Those with keen senses suddenly had the feeling that a Great Era was approaching, and after this collective retreat, it's feared that many would emerge at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
"I heard there's a saying in the East Sea, 'When a whale falls, all creatures rise,' which perfectly describes the current situation."
"Isn't the phrase 'a whale falls' used when a whale dies? Daoist Buyu isn't dead, is he?"
"We can pretend he's dead."
Of course, the quiet referred to the upper echelons of the Cultivation World. Those cultivators who had not yet reached the Body Integration Realm were not very familiar with Daoist Buyu and were unaffected.
...
Buddha Country.
Across the boundless desert, a figure whizzed by in the air, leaving the camel-riding travelers below no time to discern its form before it disappeared. Shortly after, several more figures flew by, pursuing the one who had passed first.
"Ye Zijin, stop right there! If I don't adjudicate you by the proper Buddhist teachings today, how can I face the ancient sages?" Several well-known high monks of Buddha Country were chasing after their second brother, Ye Zijin, with the monk Pu Xuan leading them.
Ultimately, they were accomplished monks who had clashed with Ye Zijin not just once or twice, and after some struggle, they finally surrounded him.
"Ye Zijin, what nonsense have you added to the sages' writings!" The monks glared at Ye Zijin in anger.
Knowing he could not defeat them, Ye Zijin quickly gestured to prevent conflict, "Eh, eh, eh, let's not be hasty, we're all monastics, no need for violence."
"All I did was add a couple of lines, look how worked up you all are."
"Adding annotations next to the scriptures is a tradition of our Buddha Country. You all can annotate the works of the ancients, and I, Ye Zijin, even as a simple saintly monk, have the right to annotate the scriptures. There's no issue with that."
"You always say that Buddhist teaching is vast and unfathomable, that even a lifetime of study will only touch the surface, so what's wrong with praising it as 'Buddhist teaching is boundless'?"
"In Buddhism, we often say 'only now do I realize that I am myself,' which means after pursuing Buddhist teachings for a lifetime, the ultimate answer lies within oneself, right?"
"Then, if I write 'Buddhist teachings are boundless; turning back is the shore,' that's not wrong either."
"Nonsense, that sentence clearly encourages others to return to secular life. If a disciple of Buddhism saw your words and had a great enlightenment, then returned to secular life because of it!"
Ye Zijin hurriedly said, "You can't recklessly blame me for that, it's his lack of understanding, not my fault."
"I, Ye Zijin, am wholeheartedly devoted to Buddhism, and that's widely acknowledged in our Buddha Country. How could I possibly encourage someone to leave Buddhism?"
The several high monks, upon hearing this, were fuming with anger. What widely acknowledged? Everyone wants to erect a stele for you!
"Then what's the meaning of placing a copy of the 'Eternity Technique,' which can make hair grow, next to the scriptures?"
"Oh, that. I lost it. Since you found it, can you return it to me?"
"Not to complain, but you guys get angry too easily. This constant cultivation of the mind doesn't seem to be very effective. Now, look at my master. Now that's real cultivation of the mind; always cheerful, he's even made a breakthrough to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage."
Upon hearing Ye Zijin mention Daoist Buyu advancing to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, Master Pu Xuan's veins bulged with rage.
He was a contemporary of Daoist Buyu and had not expected Buyi to reach the Transcendance Tribulation Stage before him.
The more he thought about it, the angrier he became, his breath fluctuating wildly as he gritted his teeth and chanted the scriptures.
"This aura... he has to be cautious at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage!" The other masters noticed Master Pu Xuan's fluctuating aura, were thrilled beyond measure, and quickly formed a circle to protect him.
Ye Zijin felt a twitch in the corner of his eye.
"Come on, how can a breakthrough happen just from a few words? Is advancing to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage that easy?"
Ye Zijin took advantage of Master Pu Xuan's tribulation and the other monks' protections, which left nobody to watch over him, and he sped up his escape from the desert.
"I need to find a place where Master Pu Xuan won't find me. Anyway, now that he's advanced to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, he shouldn't bother with a junior like me anymore. If anyone, he should be looking for my master."
Ye Zijin brought his hands together in front of his chest, radiating a peaceful and holy light, indeed resembling a saintly monk, "Master, I presume after your advancement to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, there are few who can match you. Worried that you might be too lonely, I've found you a rival to give you some pressure. As your disciple, there's no need for thanks."
...
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were totally unaware of the changes happening outside, nor did they care. With their low cultivation levels, they were merely minor figures and had no need to know too much.
The two had a rather comfortable ten days in the prison. The leaky roof issue was quickly fixed by an officer skilled in earth magic from Ye City, and collapsed pillars from the battle were also repaired by an officer adept in wood magic.
"I didn't realize there were such convenient magic skills." Lu Yang witnessed the entire process of the prison's repair, admitting the officers' specialized skills. Although his cultivation level was higher than these officers, when it came to the technique of building a prison, he was far inferior.
He could only draw dungeons without even a door.
Cultivation was aided by using Array Methods to increase control over the spiritual essence within the body.
There was also no need to worry about food. Daoist Xiantian, although exonerated, didn't return to the Seek Dao Sect but stayed in Ye City, bringing meals from Ye City's finest restaurant, Fu's Delight, to Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou every day.
"Ancestor, you are too generous," Lu Yang said, somewhat embarrassed, though he knew that such an amount of Spirit Stones meant little to Daoist Xiantian.
Daoist Xiantian was certainly not short of money; on the contrary, he could be considered extremely wealthy. The Seek Dao Sect had a retirement system, and retired elders received a sum of Spirit Stones each year.
This meant that Daoist Xiantian had not claimed twelve thousand years' worth of retirement funds, an unimaginably immense sum of Spirit Stones, making him one of the wealthiest in the Body Integration Realm.
After ten days, Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou ended their secluded cultivation in the prison and escorted Daoist Xiantian back to the Seek Dao Sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 825 - 824: Either you come back, or I go there.
chapters.content:
"Eldest Senior Sister, we have returned!" Lu Yang and his companion immediately reported their safety to Eldest Senior Sister upon returning to the Seek Dao Sect.
It was mainly to report the safety of their ancestral master and to prove that they had completed the task assigned by Eldest Senior Sister.
"You've returned ten days later than I anticipated. Did something unexpected happen on the road?"
Yun Zhi was slightly puzzled. She had heard from her master that the matter with their ancestral master had already been clarified with the government office in Ye City and that he had been released long ago.
Why did it take Junior Brother Lu and his companion ten days to safely bring the ancestral master back to the Seek Dao Sect?
Lu Yang was embarrassed to say that the ancestral master had indeed been released, but the two of them had not made it out.
"Yes, there was a little accident on the road."
Yun Zhi nodded without dwelling too much on this matter, thinking that some kind of mishap on the way back was quite in line with Junior Brother's luck.
"Your timing is perfect. Fairy Senior has asked you to come out for a moment."
"What's the matter?" Fairy Eternity popped her head out, coincidentally resting it on Lu Yang's shoulder, making it look as though Lu Yang had grown two heads.
Yun Zhi opened a wooden box, revealing a green peach inside, the peach still attached to a segment of branch. Rather than calling it a peach, it looked more like a flawless work of art.
"Is this peach the one that Fairy mentioned before, the fruit borne by the peach tree-shaped Heavenly Root?"
Fairy Eternity looked at the peach, quite astounded, "You actually found it. I thought it wouldn't be found for a thousand or eight hundred years."
"What is this?" Meng Jingzhou whispered, glancing at Lu Yang's expression, suggesting that he knew the inside story.
"Consider it one of the top natural treasures. You know that Emperor Xia doesn't have many years left. Eldest Senior Sister asked Fairy if there was a way to prolong his life, and Fairy mentioned that in ancient times there was a peach tree, a Heavenly Root, whose peaches were natural objects that extended one's life and could save the emperor's life."
"There's actually such a thing." Even Meng Jingzhou, with the backing of the Meng Family, had never heard of such treasures in the world.
"Does that mean the emperor can be saved?" Meng Jingzhou rejoiced. Although the Crown Prince could make a competent emperor, it would be best not to change emperors if possible, to avoid destabilizing the situation.
"The item is correct, but it seems that it's not ripe yet, right?" Fairy Eternity remembered that ripe peaches were pink in color.
"That's what I thought too." Yun Zhi, getting confirmation, closed the box. The peach hadn't been completely picked, and the nutrients in the branch were enough to let the peach mature.
Then they would wait for the peach to ripen before sending it to the Imperial City.
"Speaking of which, where did you find this Heavenly Root?" Fairy Eternity asked with curiosity.
Upon hearing this question, Yun Zhi showed a momentary discomfort. She hadn't expected the peach orchard back home to actually have that Heavenly Root. No wonder the spiritual essence at home was so abundant, and it seemed it wasn't just due to the Mother-child River.
"I found it by chance. That peach tree has already run away."
"Alright." Fairy Eternity felt a bit regretful. It wasn't the first time that Heavenly Root had run off on its own legs.
"There's another matter. Junior Brother Meng, here is a letter from your family. They also asked me to relay a message, hoping you would come home for a visit."
"They're asking me to go home again." Meng Jingzhou rolled his eyes. Having caused so much trouble, he couldn't believe his father would forgive him.
As long as his father didn't say he forgave him, he was determined not to go home!
Meng Jingzhou opened the envelope, browsed through the letter, and his face grew paler and paler, his hands trembling.
"What happened?" Lu Yang asked curiously.
"The letter says that if I don't return home, my father will personally come to the Seek Dao Sect."
Lu Yang: "..."
Rather than getting beaten up at the Seek Dao Sect, I suggest you go home and take your punishment.
"Eldest Senior Sister, can we stop my father from entering the Seek Dao Sect?"
Yun Zhi shook her head: "Our Seek Dao Sect does not prohibit family members from entering the sect to see their disciples."
Meng Jingzhou scratched his head anxiously after much deliberation, it seemed he had no choice but to go back.
"Old Lu, you should come back with me too. If there's an outsider present, my dad probably won't beat me too harshly,"
"Will that really work?"
"Definitely, my dad admires you so much, he even wants you to marry my sister, he'll definitely give you some face." Although he didn't know if it would work or not, he'd drag Old Lu into it first.
"Seriously?" Lu Yang always felt that Meng Jingzhou's words weren't quite sincere.
"Would I lie to you?"
Lu Yang said earnestly, "Considering I often deceive you, it would be normal for you to trick me a couple of times."
"Why do you sound so righteous when you say that? Just tell me if you're going or not."
"I'll go." Lu Yang of course wanted to go, since it was a rare opportunity to visit Imperial City.
His last trip to Imperial City was when he was acting as the Sect Leader, where he went straight to the Imperial Palace to meet with Emperor Xia and the leaders from the other four Immortal Sects. He had not yet seen what the rest of the city was like outside the palace walls.
To call Imperial City a holy land for cultivation wouldn't be an overstatement. A multitude of cultivators gathered there, it was a dazzling spectacle. The strongest cultivators of the Cultivation World, the most skillful artifact refiners, the best alchemists—were all in the Imperial... no, wait, they seemed to be all from the Seek Dao Sect.
"But should we disguise ourselves?"
"Disguise as what?"
"Look, you're a Meng Family Member, and I'm a disciple of Daoist Buyu. If both of us go to Imperial City together, I'm worried we won't even make it through the city gates before being stopped by someone."
The two looked at each other and silently took out their masks, changing their appearances.
Old Ma had long finished visiting relatives in the East Sea and had returned to the Seek Dao Sect.
He was quite happy to hear that Meng Jingzhou was going back to Imperial City.
But he soon realized something was amiss. Meng Jingzhou going back by himself was no problem, but why was Lu Yang also going? Could there be trouble in Imperial City?
Old Ma laughed at himself, thinking he was overreacting. How could there be a problem? That was the unassailable and mighty Imperial City, filled with strong people—how could anything happen?
"Great, let's go to Imperial City and overthrow Emperor Xia to establish the Soybean Dynasty!" Fairy Eternity, hearing they were going to Imperial City, was also very excited.
In celebration of the soon-to-be-established Soybean Dynasty, Fairy Eternity took off her prison garb, washed up, and changed into a bright yellow imperial robe, her head crowned with a diadem. Little Face was tight with concentration, trying hard to look serious.
Meanwhile, with a wave of her hand, she transformed the cages in the Spiritual Space into a palace built with immortal stones. Fairy Eternity sat upright on the throne, as if enthroned in the heavens, looking down at her sole subject—Lu Yang.
Lu Yang felt that Fairy Eternity's rise to power was even faster than Goujian's period of hardship.
"Subject Lu Yang pays his respects to your Majesty."
"Address me as Your Holiness." Fairy Eternity commanded.
Lu Yang, quite amenable to suggestion, corrected himself, "Your Holiness, Lu Yang pays his respects to your Majesty."
"I always feel like there should be something embroidered on these clothes," Fairy Eternity muttered, but considering emblems like dragons, phoenixes, and kirins, it wouldn't reflect her standing.
Even collectively, Little Ling Lianyi and Qilin Immortal were not her match; including them on the imperial robe would be undervaluing herself.
"Second-in-command, what do you think I should embroider on this imperial robe?" the founding Soybean Emperor inquired of her chief steward, Lu Yang.
"Your Majesty, historically, imperial robes always bear the strongest beings," Lu Yang reminded.
Fairy Eternity had an epiphany, and instantly began embroidering on the imperial robe using her thoughts.
"Done."
When Lu Yang looked, he saw that the imperial robe was embroidered with Fairy Eternity herself and the Eldest Senior Sister.

chapters.title: Chapter 826 - 825 Young Master Meng Returns Home
chapters.content:
Lu Yang wanted to speak but stopped himself, thinking that the imperial robe looked rather peculiar.
"Fairy, are you sure you embroidered yourself and Eldest Senior Sister on the imperial robe?" Lu Yang looked at the robe, unsure if the two people on it were who they were supposed to be.
"Of course, doesn't it have the names written right here?" Fairy Eternity said, pointing at two spots on the robe.
Lu Yang thought to himself that it was lucky she had written the names; otherwise, he would've believed her if she said the embroidery depicted him and Old Meng.
"Xiao Yang, didn't you say that the imperial robe has always featured the strongest? Speaking of who the strongest are in the Cultivation World today, naturally it's me and Miss Yun!" Fairy Eternity puffed out her chest, pride evident in her expression and tone.
"...Why do you call me Xiao Yang?"
Fairy Eternity looked puzzled, "What's the problem? I heard that's how emperors address the people around them."
Lu Yang: "..."
Forget it, there's no need to explain such complex matters to a fairy.
"Then, should I make some minor adjustments to the embroidery of you and Eldest Senior Sister on the imperial robe?" Lu Yang could barely look at the figures on it.
"Sure." Without hesitation, Fairy Eternity took off the robe and tossed it to Lu Yang, then, barefoot, she gleefully ran around the great hall.
Lu Yang conjured golden and silver threads with his mind and threaded the needle, and soon the delicate and beautiful face of Fairy Eternity appeared on the imperial robe.
"Eh, indeed it's slightly better than my own level," Fairy Eternity rarely admitted that Lu Yang was better than her.
Lu Yang calmly continued with the embroidery of Eldest Senior Sister, and quickly, her figure emerged on the robe as well.
Just as Lu Yang was about to praise Fairy Eternity a bit more and reinforce his position as head steward, a crack appeared in his Spiritual Space, and Eldest Senior Sister emerged through it.
She turned her gaze to Lu Yang, who was handling the needle and thread, and to the imperial robe resting on Lu Yang's thigh, her eyes twitching unusually.
"Junior Brother, you..."
Lu Yang quickly stood up, eager to clear himself of blame: "It has nothing to do with me, the fairy made me do it!"
"Hey, wasn't it you who suggested embroidering me and Miss Yun on the imperial robe?"
"Fairy, don't talk nonsense, I didn't say anything."
Listening to her Junior Brother and Fairy Eternity passing the buck back and forth, Yun Zhi roughly understood what had happened.
"Senior Fairy, have you considered changing the style of the imperial robe?" Yun Zhi kindly suggested, hinting that the garment didn't quite resemble an imperial robe.
"Change the style?" Fairy Eternity pondered for a moment before realizing suddenly.
"You mean, since I am the strongest in this era, just embroidering myself on the imperial robe would suffice!"
Yun Zhi sighed softly, "Fine, let's just leave the robe as it is."
After all, there was nobody else in the Spiritual Space. The fairy could wear it however she liked.
After Yun Zhi left, Fairy Eternity, brimming with excitement, put on the imperial robe and happily twirled, showing it off to Xiao Yang, "How does it look, how does it look? Isn't it beautiful?"
Xiao Yang bowed respectfully, "Your Holiness naturally possesses exquisite beauty, and the robe merely accentuates your appearance."
...
In the past, when going to the Demon Territory or the East Sea, one had to find someone familiar with the local conditions. This time, with Meng Jingzhou, a local, accompanying him, Lu Yang didn't need to ask around anymore.
"It's a pity about Junior Sister Tao and the others. They've all gone to eradicate the Ruthless Sect."
Lu Yang had wanted to invite Tao Yaoye and Man Gu to Buddha Country, but he later learned of the significant changes with the Ruthless Sect. Now, the Seek Dao Sect hardly had any idle members. Without exception, they were all mobilized to deal with the remnants of the Ruthless Sect.
Li Haoran was the only one not out on a mission, as he was fully immersed in comprehending the Artifact Refining Technique, and it wouldn't be right to disturb him.
Old Ma led the two of them, and within just two days, they had arrived at Imperial City.
Imperial City, as the largest city in Great Xia, and indeed in the entire Cultivation World, was unimaginably vast. From a great distance, Lu Yang could see several enormous dark silhouettes within Imperial City, which were the city's mountains.
A river hundreds of yards wide bisected Imperial City, thereby creating South City and North City.
This was Lu Yang's second visit to Imperial City, yet he still found it extremely awe-inspiring.
At the city gate, Lu Yang saw many cultivators from the Demon Race, Sea Clan, and Buddha Country. Their attire and features were markedly different from the cultivators of the Central Continent, making them easily recognizable. These cultivators were rarely seen in other cities, but they were everywhere in Imperial City.
Those who could travel from other continents to Great Xia, these cultivators, had at least a cultivation level at the Nascent Soul Stage.
The soldiers at the city gate saw Meng Jingzhou's identity proof and their pupils constricted sharply.
Young Master Meng has actually returned to Imperial City?!
As the carriage entered Imperial City, the soldiers, out of professional integrity, did not report Meng Jingzhou's arrival to their superiors.
Meng Jingzhou was not a wanted criminal; there was no necessity to report it.
The person who had come to Imperial City with Young Master Meng, was it the legendary disciple of Daoist Buyu?
The carriage stopped at a place with a plaque that read "Meng Residence."
In the lower right corner of the plaque was a name—Jiang Pingan.
The founding Emperor Xia himself had endorsed the Meng Residence, which was akin to an amulet of immunity from the death penalty.
"We've arrived, this is my home." Meng Jingzhou jumped down from the carriage, and seeing the familiar gate, he was filled with emotion.
It had been almost six years since he had run away from home, and now he had finally returned.
"This is your house?!" Lu Yang got out of the carriage and saw that the Meng Residence's gate was as high as the legendary Gate of Heavenly Peace, with complex and exquisite patterns carved on the vermilion doors.
Two stone lions at the entrance, each with a stone ball in its mouth, looked almost alive, while the steps were carved from top-grade spirit stones, bordered with carvings of auspicious clouds and mythical creatures.
Even the gates of the Imperial Palace could not be more grand.
Indeed, one of the mountains he had seen from afar in Imperial City was located within the bounds of the Meng Residence.
"Was this plaque written by the founding Emperor Xia?" Lu Yang noticed the name of the person who had endorsed the plaque. The Meng Family indeed had the standing for such honor; after all, they were once a major power that contended with Emperor Xia for the rule of the land.
"What's so strange about that, the plaque of the Imperial Palace was even written by my ancestors." Meng Jingzhou said.
The two guards at the entrance saw Meng Jingzhou alight from the carriage, and were so excited that they were at a loss for words. One of the guards quickly ran inside to inform the family head, "Yo-young Master has returned!"
"Wow, it's still you two watching the gate." Meng Jingzhou obviously recognized these two guards.
Before he couldn't discern the cultivation levels of these two guards, but now he could see that they were both cultivators at the late stage of Spirit Transformation.
The remaining guard laughed awkwardly and said, "Young Master jests, it's only been a few years. Not everyone can increase their cultivation level as rapidly as you, Young Master."
Meng Jingzhou wanted to say more, but his expression changed as he felt a terrifying aura spreading from inside the Meng Residence.
"Good lad, you've finally returned!" A middle-aged man suddenly appeared before Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou. Lu Yang did not even see how this middle-aged man had appeared.
"Dad, dad, I've returned." Meng Jingzhou, feeling guilty, dared not meet his father's eyes.
Seeing his long-lost son, Meng Potian let out a hearty laugh and patted Meng Jingzhou on the shoulder.
"Good, it's good that you're back."
Hearing his father's normal tone, Meng Jingzhou guessed he had truly been forgiven and finally dared to look up and earnestly call out, "Dad."
"Family disgraces should not be publicized. Your willingness to come back and face punishment pleases me greatly."

chapters.title: Chapter 827 - 826: Good Brothers Would Stab Their Own Sides for Each Other
chapters.content:
Meng Jingzhou's face underwent a drastic change when he heard the words, trying to use words to defuse the crisis.
"Dad, we're still outside."
"A trivial matter."
Meng Potian waved his hand grandly, bringing both Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou into the Meng Residence.
Old Ma snorted through his nose and instructed two guards to unload the carriage, while he himself leisurely walked into the Meng Residence to catch up with his second brother, Xu You.
"It's been a long time since I've been back to the Meng Residence. Where does Second Brother live again?"
...
Meng Potian led Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou to the main courtyard of the Meng Residence, a place Meng Jingzhou had enjoyed since childhood, other than his fondness for mountain climbing.
But now he felt there really was no need to come here to reminisce about his childhood.
"Father, there are still outsiders here," Meng Jingzhou tried once more to reason with his father.
He was the one who had been ignorant as a child, intentionally making many mistakes, but so many years had gone by that even he, the culprit, had forgotten them; why must his father continue to dwell on them?
"So, you must be Lu Yang, quite the fine figure of a man," Meng Potian's tone softened slightly when he faced Lu Yang, "Little Boat has been praising you, saying you have the talents of Daoist Buyu, always stirring up a series of events every time you go out."
Lu Yang: "..."
Old Meng, you're just making up stories about me in the background, right? Which time did I go out and you weren't by my side?
"The Great Era's struggle needs a talent like you."
"I've heard that you don't have a Dao companion yet, and with your master being Daoist Buyu, certainly no one dares to become your Dao companion. It just so happens that my daughter is twenty-eight, pure and lovely, a perfect match for you—I think our two families can agree on a marriage."
Before Lu Yang could even retort, he saw Meng Potian turn around with a stern face to look at Meng Jingzhou, his tone icy and sinister.
"Alright, there are no outsiders now."
Seeing that Meng Potian was about to pull out the metal ruler to teach Meng Jingzhou a lesson, Lu Yang could not bear to watch a good brother be beaten, and took a step forward: "Please wait a moment, Uncle Meng."
Meng Jingzhou was deeply moved, true friends indeed show their colors in times of trouble.
Meng Potian turned his head, puzzled as to why Lu Yang would stop him.
"Old Meng being punished by you must indeed have committed a grievous act, but him being alone, your punishment might lack force."
"Coincidentally, I happen to know a technique called 'One Meng Becomes Ten Thousand,' which can create ten thousand Meng Jingzhous, ensuring Uncle Meng you will thoroughly enjoy the punishment."
To execute 'One Meng Becomes Ten Thousand' is much more difficult than 'One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand,' demanding extremely high spiritual essence and Spiritual Sense.
But no matter, Lu Yang could temporarily increase his spiritual essence by taking elixirs, and as for the strength of the Spiritual Sense, he could temporarily borrow some from Fairy Eternity.
Meng Potian was overjoyed upon hearing this, never expecting Lu Yang to know such a technique, and bluntly told him to boldly use it.
Lu Yang did not hold back, grabbing Meng Jingzhou by the ankle and began to perform the sword technique.
"Damn it, Old Lu, you son of a..."
"One Meng Becomes Ten Thousand!" Lu Yang shouted loudly, interrupting Meng Jingzhou's last words.
Meng Potian looked up as if he had realized something and saw a dense crowd of his sons in the sky, so he swooped up with his metal ruler to beat them.
The pitiful screams of Meng Jingzhou circled above the Meng Residence, rather melodious, and upon seeing this, Lu Yang hastened to record it with the Recording Orb.
Before long, Meng Jingzhou fell to the ground rubbing his behind, walking with a limp.
"That's the spirit!" Meng Potian was becoming more and more fond of Lu Yang. After all, he was a disciple of Daoist Buyu, and it showed that he'd learned some real skills.
The commotion caused by Meng Jingzhou's return was substantial, and soon enough, the direct members of the Meng Family had all gathered in the courtyard to watch the excitement.
The first to arrive at the courtyard was a man who looked to be about thirty years old. "Jingzhou, you're finally back. You don't know how much your mother has missed you. She stays at home every day, refuses to go out, fearing that she might not be there when you return..."
"Where is my mother now?"
"She's been at the Imperial Palace for several days."
Meng Jingzhou sighed and then introduced Lu Yang, saying, "This is my second uncle, Meng Poli."
"Nice to meet you, Uncle Meng."
Second Uncle Meng Poli said, "Eh, this kid is far more polite than you, Jingzhou. You've never called me uncle like that."
Meng Jingzhou rolled his eyes, "Uncle, have you forgotten that time you got drunk, insisting on becoming sworn brothers with the stone lion at the door, declaring yourself the eldest brother and the pair of stone lions the second and third? You even said that from then on, I should call the stone lion second uncle instead of you."
Meng Poli's face turned red with embarrassment, and he coughed guiltily, "Cough cough, things said when drunk shouldn't be taken seriously."
"Jingzhou is back?" A gentle and refined voice spoke up. The newcomer looked exactly like Second Uncle Meng Poli but had an entirely different comportment, clearly someone who had spent a long time immersed in books and learning.
"This is my third uncle, Meng Poci. He's my second uncle's twin brother."
"Remember I once told you about an uncle at the Lock Demon Gate? That's him."
Lu Yang kind of remembered. He and Old Meng were thrown by the Eldest Senior Sister into the dense forests bordering the Demon Territory at the edge of Great Xia. The place they went to was the Demon Suppressing Pass.
At that time, Meng Jingzhou had expressed regret that he had an uncle at the Lock Demon Gate. It would have been better if they had been thrown there.
"Third Uncle, how come you've returned from the Lock Demon Gate?"
Meng Poci didn't seem to have the ironclad aura of a border-guarding general. Instead, he seemed more like a great scholar one might encounter in an academy.
Meng Poci smiled lightly, "I've been stationed at the Lock Demon Gate for fifty years. Last year, the Dynasty issued an order to recall me."
"That's great news," Meng Jingzhou said with a smile. He figured that after Great Xia made diplomatic connections with the Demon Territory, in an effort to ease the relationship between the two, they decided to withdraw his uncle, who was particularly adept at combat.
"Brother, you've finally returned?" A lovely figure appeared out of nowhere and ran excitedly up to Meng Jingzhou.
"Little Sister!" Meng Jingzhou smiled happily, patting and ruffling his sister's hair playfully.
If anyone in the Meng Family treated him the best, it was his little sister. When he had run away from home without a penny to his name, it was his kind-hearted little sister who gave him a Storage Ring. The treasures inside that ring had lasted him until now without running out.
"This is my sister, Meng Jingyu."
"Hello, Brother Lu Yang," Meng Jingyu said with a sweet smile, indeed as pure and adorable as Meng Potian had described.
"Ah, really well-behaved."
"Here, this is a gift for you from Brother Lu Yang." It was Lu Yang's first time meeting someone who called him brother, as he usually dealt with peers or much older cultivators.
Lu Yang took a wooden sword out of the Identity Jade, a carving he had made while practising his swordsmanship based on the design of the Green Peak Sword, capable of piercing through cultivators at the Divine Transformation Stage.
"Thank you, Brother," Meng Jingyu said as she gratefully accepted it, her manners impressing Lu Yang and making him marvel at how she seemed a completely different species compared to Old Meng.
"Brother said in his letters about the interesting encounters you had during your travels. Brother Lu Yang, is your experience while cultivating abroad always this fascinating?" Meng Jingyu looked up at Lu Yang with admiration. She had never left the Imperial City all her life and was particularly interested in everything Lu Yang had experienced.
"What exactly did he say?"
"Brother mentioned that you often get into trouble, like when you strayed down the wrong path and joined the Eternity Sect willingly. To rescue you, he had to destroy the sect.
You enjoyed challenging those at the Foundation Establishment Stage while you were at the Golden Core Stage, and he also mentioned that you're constantly surrounded by admirers, though you remain unaffected and your luck in love affairs doesn't seem to work on you."
With an unchanging expression, Lu Yang simply laughed it off with a "heh heh."

chapters.title: Chapter 828 - 827: The Origin of the Name Meng Potian
chapters.content:
```
"By the way, where's Grandpa?" Meng Jingzhou had waited quite a while and still hadn't seen his grandfather, who doted on him the most. If Grandpa were here, his dad definitely wouldn't have dared to beat him like that.
"He's in seclusion, and there's no set date for his return."
Then Meng Potian added, "Well, Jingzhou coming home is a good thing. I've had a meal prepared. Let's have a family gathering."
In Meng Potian's words, 'family' also naturally included Lu Yang, who had just joined them.
The Meng Family, as the number one influential family in the Cultivation World, had astonishing wealth. The scrumptious dishes on this table were made with precious ingredients, many of which even Lu Yang couldn't identify.
"Come on, eat up, don't be shy. All these dishes aid in cultivation," Meng Potian invited Lu Yang to enjoy the meal without reserve and to treat this place like his own home.
"This is considered delicious? Let this Fairy show the Meng Family a trick or two," Fairy Eternity said, rolling up her imperial robe sleeves to demonstrate her prowess, but Lu Yang quickly stopped her.
"Your Majesty has a body more precious than gold; it's been unheard of for an emperor to cook," Lu Yang said.
"Oh, that's a bother," Fairy Eternity muttered, considering whether she should simply abdicate her throne to let Xiao Yang take over as the next Bean Emperor.
But upon further thought, she felt that Xiao Yang was too young and inexperienced, and it wasn't yet the time for him to inherit the throne.
"It's the Meng Family's loss for not witnessing my culinary skills."
After calming down Fairy Eternity, Lu Yang finally focused on savoring the meal.
He didn't know the Cultivation Level of the Meng Family's Spirit Chef, but this was the first time he had tasted Spirit Food this delicious. One bite of the venison warmed his body through and through, and upon careful reflection, he could feel his cultivation level slowly advancing.
In fact, the benefits of the Spirit Food on the table went beyond that. Lu Yang possessed a high talent for cultivation and had not yet encountered any bottlenecks.
If a cultivator who had been stuck at a bottleneck for a long time consumed this meal, their bottleneck would vanish without a trace, allowing them to smoothly advance to the next realm.
Meng Jingyu, who must have heard other stories about Lu Yang from her brother, was extremely curious about his experiences. Even during the meal, she couldn't help but continuously ask Lu Yang.
"Brother Lu Yang, can you tell me about how you joined the Eternity Sect?"
"Brother Lu Yang, I've heard that you formed your Golden Core faster than my brother. What kind of Golden Core did you form?"
"Can you really help someone shave their head?"
Lu Yang felt that he had been too lenient when he had helped Meng Jingzhou's father teach him a lesson earlier.
"Has Sister Xiaoyu already started the Qi Refinement?" Lu Yang noticed the spiritual essence fluctuation in Meng Jingyu. Although she was not yet sixteen, starting the Qi Refinement a few months early was not a problem.
"I'm already at the Qi Cultivation Stage," Meng Jingyu proudly said, smiling. Among her peers, she was the first one to start the Qi Refinement. According to popular sayings, she was at the second level of Qi Refinement.
After the banquet was over, Meng Jingzhou's father arranged a small courtyard for Lu Yang to stay in, next to Meng Jingzhou's and then next to Meng Jingyu's.
Clearly, this was not where the guestrooms were located, but a place where only Meng Family Members were qualified to live.
"Your little courtyard is quite clean," Lu Yang said with a smile. After six years away from home, Old Meng's courtyard was still immaculate, showing how much the Meng Family cared for Meng Jingzhou.
"Of course, how can it not be? I'm the eldest son, after all. This place is definitely cleaned every day," Meng Jingzhou said, laughing as he walked into the courtyard, only to be repelled by a force.
"What's going on?" Lu Yang was surprised. Was the Imperial City so dangerous that even in the Meng Family, one could be attacked?
"Damn it, who cast a Dustless Charm in my yard?" Meng Jingzhou was furious. This was obviously the effect of a Dustless Charm, meant to repel any foreign objects from the courtyard.
Foreign objects included the very owner of the courtyard as well.
```
Even this Old Monster at the Replenishing Infancy stage was able to drive away, which speaks to the high quality of this Dustless Charm.
Meng Jingzhou tore off the Dustless Charm stuck at the entrance and successfully entered the courtyard.
The place where Lu Yang lived was seemingly cleaned by someone daily. It was not only clean but also free of any Dustless Charms.
Having confirmed the place of residence, Meng Jingzhou took the initiative to offer Lu Yang a tour around the Meng Family estate.
"This is the Martial Arts Hall, where both direct and collateral members of the Meng Family can cultivate," he said.
On the platform, one cultivator after another sparred with magic skills and Divine Abilities. Although they were no match for Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou at the same realm, within their own realm, they were quite remarkable.
"These people are the future of the Meng Family. We've put in great efforts to ensure they have fruitful cultivation."
"Once they have made some achievements in their cultivation, they can get involved in the family's various affairs, such as lending and collecting debts, and so on."
"I heard that my father and uncles cultivated in the Martial Arts Hall too. All the instructors here are at the Body Integration Realm," Meng Jingzhou remarked.
"This is the Academy. Remember how I knew a lot about cultivation before joining the Seek Dao Sect? I learned it all here," he explained.
Within the Academy, the sound of reading aloud resonated. Through the window, Lu Yang saw Meng Jingyu nodding and swaying as he read, deeply engrossed in his studies.
Then there were the Refining Pills Chamber, Refining Implements Chamber, and the Finance Office - the Hundred Skills of Cultivation could all find a place to be practiced within the Meng Family, its comprehensiveness on par with the Seek Dao Sect.
"I can't take you into this mountain, I can't even enter it myself," Meng Jingzhou said, as he brought Lu Yang to the foot of the mountain. The peak soared into the clouds, rivaling Lu Yang's own Sky Gate Mountain.
"It's said that all the Great Powers of our Meng Family live on this mountain, though I'm not sure how many are at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage."
Before Meng Jingzhou began his cultivation, he only knew that the Meng Family's Great Powers resided on the mountain without understanding their Realms. Now that his horizons had broadened, he had a clear understanding that the Meng Family was the first influential family, and he believed there were multiple cultivators at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage living there.
Otherwise, it would be tough for the Meng Family to establish a footing in the Imperial City, let alone in the Cultivation World.
"Although I can't take you there now, rest assured, once I become the family head in the future, I'll make sure to take you up the mountain for a visit," Meng Jingzhou confidently promised.
Lu Yang hesitated as he looked at Meng Jingzhou,"Can a person with a Single Body Spiritual Root even become the family head?"
A family head without a wife or heir—how selflessly impartial would that be?
Meng Jingzhou was very confident, "What are you talking about? Once I become an Immortal, what would this Single Body Spiritual Root even matter?"
"A Single Body Immortal Root?"
"Get lost."
"Speaking of which, your father's name is pretty domineering. Did your grandfather name him?" Lu Yang recalled that among the people he knew, no one had such a commanding name. They were either called Yellow Bean or Sha Meless, neither of which sounded like the name of a strong person.
"It was indeed my grandfather who named him, but the meaning behind the name may not be what you're imagining," replied Meng Jingzhou.
"How so?" asked Lu Yang.
"My grandfather told me that on the day my father was born, the Imperial City experienced a rainstorm that only came once every hundred years, and my grandmother had a difficult labor delivering my father."
"My grandfather couldn't help at all; he could only pace in the courtyard. It was also raining, so he was in a very bad mood and cursed, 'What rotten weather this is!'"
"As it happened, right after my grandfather finished cursing, my father was born."
"To commemorate that moment, my grandfather named my father Meng Po Tian (Meng Break the Heavens)."

chapters.title: Chapter 829 - 828: Competing in Wealth
chapters.content:
```
Although it wasn't very polite, Lu Yang truly felt that Grandpa Meng's cultural level might not be much higher than Man Gu's.
It might even be quite comparable.
"Then Meng Poci and Meng Poli... never mind, I won't ask." Lu Yang thought it was after all elder's matter, and such an overly disrespectful question was unnecessary to ask. He did not want Old Meng to reveal too much and have the Meng Family Members kick Old Meng out of the Meng Residence.
"What is that place?" Lu Yang pointed to a room covered with forbidden spells, the entrance guarded by a Meng Family Elder, looking like a restricted area.
"It's where the IOUs are stored."
"My father told me that if all those IOUs could be cashed in, they could buy half the Imperial City."
Lu Yang took a sharp breath, no wonder it was a forbidden area, such a place warranted heavy guard regardless of how many people were assigned.
"And it's not just IOUs, our Meng Family has a Divine Ability called 'Borrowing magic skill,' when cultivators above Unification ask to borrow money, they not only leave an IOU, they also lend us one of their abilities."
"Our family then etches that skill onto paper, and in battle, we can reproduce that person's skill."
"That's amazing." It was probably a unique Divine Ability of the Meng Family, one that Lu Yang hadn't heard of elsewhere.
Even Fairy Eternity shook her head, saying she had never heard of such a thing.
...
Meng Potian, Old Ma, and the great housekeeper Xu You gathered together, the three brothers hadn't been together for nearly six years, now having drinks in the side room.
Old Ma lay lazily on a wooden chair, using magic skill to bring the grass on his plate to his mouth, his horse's hoof clinging to the wine cup, sipping intermittently.
"Old Ma, you've worked hard taking care of Jingzhou on the way."
Old Ma wanted to modestly claim it was no hardship, but recalling the heart-in-mouth experiences over the past six years, he couldn't casually smile and utter the words "It wasn't hard."
"Not hard, just bad luck."
Meng Potian: "..."
He remembered Old Ma used to be rather modest. How come after playing the role of Protector to his son for a while, he had changed like this?
"What do you think of the boy Lu Yang?" Meng Potian had a good impression of Lu Yang. He had seen many young talents, but whether in cultivation level or character, none could compare to Lu Yang.
If Lu Yang and Xiaoyu took a fancy to each other, the idea of him marrying into the family wasn't a joke.
Old Ma's eyes twitched, unpleasant memories flooding back, suddenly reminded of the moment when Lu Yang inadvertently revived Fairy Eternity.
"So I'm just saying, your Meng Family's IOUs could buy half the Imperial City, right?"
"Right."
"His luck could destroy half the Imperial City."
...
"Do you want to try something tasty?" Meng Jingzhou asked.
Lu Yang puzzled: "Didn't we already eat during the welcoming feast? I thought it was pretty delicious?"
"Those weren't the tastiest. Those Spirit Foods aim for both flavor and effect, but one can't have it all, so they fall short of real delicacy. I'm going to take you to the best place to eat in the Imperial City." After all, the Imperial City was his territory, and Meng Jingzhou intended to fulfill his duties as a host.
"Then let's go," Lu Yang said with a smile, recalling how Eldest Senior Sister liked to try local specialities wherever she went. If it was really as good as Meng Jingzhou boasted, he might take some with him when leaving the Imperial City.
Considering Meng Jingzhou's formidable reputation in the Imperial City, where everyone recognized him, the two of them conscientiously donned masks before leaving the Meng Residence.
The place Meng Jingzhou spoke of was called Heavenly Fragrance Pavilion, the most luxurious restaurant in the Imperial City, and there were even rumors of a Transcendance Tribulation Stage Spirit Chef there, though that chef hadn't cooked for several decades.
```
The Tianxiang Tower was packed to the rafters, but fortunately, Lu Yang and his companion didn't arrive too late—they still found three empty tables when they got there.
After they had settled down and ordered their dishes, the remaining two tables had also been taken.
"This really is delicious." Lu Yang tasted a bite after the dishes were served, admitting that Old Meng hadn't lied—the food here was even better than what he had at the Meng Residence.
"Of course, would this young master's taste be inferior?" Meng Jingzhou said proudly, eager to dig in as well.
He hadn't had the chance to eat here for five or six years.
Perhaps as an inherent repulsion between kindred professions, Fairy Eternity held the food from Tianxiang Tower in disdain.
While Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were enjoying their meal and discussing their upcoming moves, they noticed some commotion at the entrance of the restaurant and couldn't help but look over.
They saw a young man in black clothes, with an extraordinary presence, walked in with a female companion, not caring in the slightest about public decorum, with two guards following them.
Lu Yang noticed that the youth's black clothing was woven from the dark golden silk of the ice mountain silkworm, impervious to water and fire, resistant to knives and swords, extremely rare.
Even in Imperial City, where scions of officialdom were a common sight, few were entitled to wear such clothing.
"No more space?" The young man frowned, as the restaurant was so crowded there wasn't a single empty table.
He walked up to a table and stared down at the guests seated there from high above.
"This young master is taking this spot, so scram."
The patrons at that table seemed to realize that the young man was not to be trifled with and quickly nodded in agreement, vacating their seats.
Seeing the simpler dishes on Meng Jingzhou's table, the young man scoffed, "Poor wretches have no business here."
He then waved over, "Shop Assistant, bring me a pot of century-old Divine Drunkenness!"
The diners were taken aback by the young man's flippant tone.
A regular pot of Divine Drunkenness was equivalent to one year's income for a small family in Imperial City; the value of a century-old one was unimaginably higher.
Although those who frequented the restaurant were all wealthy or noble, those who could afford a pot of century-old Divine Drunkenness were few.
Seeing the young man's lavishness, his female companion was awash with admiration, clinging even tighter to him and intentionally rubbing her chest against his arm.
Meng Jingzhou snorted coldly; he hadn't seen anyone flaunt their wealth so overtly in front of him before.
And showing off his female companion was even more excessive.
He immediately signaled the Shop Assistant too, "Bring this young master a pot of century-old Divine Drunkenness as well."
The young man seemed not to have heard Meng Jingzhou, as he continued ordering extravagantly, "Steamed Cloud Mist Spirit Fish, I want a ten-year batch, and if one year is missing, I'll flip your restaurant upside down!"
Meng Jingzhou ordered with precision, not even looking at the prices, "Shop Assistant, give us a portion of Steamed Cloud Mist Spirit Fish, a ten-year batch."
The young man glanced at Meng Jingzhou, saw a stranger he presumed was just another cultivator looking to make connections in Imperial City, and scoffed, deliberately choosing the most expensive dishes, "Blanched Five Elements Spirit Vegetables, Red-Braised Crowing Sun Chicken, Supreme Clear Soul-Refining Porridge…"
"We'll also have the Blanched Five Elements Spirit Vegetables, Red-Braised Crowing Sun Chicken, Supreme Clear Soul-Refining Porridge…"
Meng Jingzhou had not intended to order these dishes, as, despite being highly nourishing, they lacked the taste of the dishes he initially selected, but he didn't mind playing along with this young man.
Whatever the young man ordered, Meng Jingzhou followed suit without any sign of backing down. The young man no longer felt that unique sense of superiority, as if he was looking down on all others, feeling his face had fallen in front of his female companion.
He slapped the table hard, "Shop Assistant, tell me this, what's the most expensive thing here?"
The Shop Assistant hesitated for a moment, then carefully explained,
"Replying to the customer, the most expensive thing here would be the room rent."

chapters.title: Chapter 830 - 829: The Prestige of Meng Jingzhou
chapters.content:
```
"Who's asking about rent!" the young man bellowed with rage. Why would I ask you about rent? What use would renting this lousy place be to me?
The shop assistant was probably frightened by the young man's aggressive stance and stuttered as he spoke.
"G-Guest, you didn't make it clear, I-I didn't know you couldn't afford it," he stammered.
"You!"
The commotion from the young man was drawing too much attention, quickly catching the interest of the other diners.
"Isn't that the Left Chancellor's grandson, Li Zhuo?"
"He's the one known as one of the Four Young Masters of the Imperial City, Li Zhuo. I heard the Left Chancellor particularly dotes on this grandson?"
"Goodness, the person competing with Li Zhuo in terms of wealth is in for big trouble, aren't they?"
"Who would say otherwise? In the Imperial City, who dares to vie for attention with Li Zhuo."
"And that shop assistant, he's probably going to face disaster too."
Lu Yang wasn't very familiar with the prices in the Imperial City, and curiously inquired, "Is the rent for the Tianxiang Building very expensive? Why does it seem like he can't pay?"
Meng Jingzhou yawned out of boredom at the side: "A poor devil, understandable really. It's just about swelling one's face to fill out a fat man's figure, wanting to save face in front of a lady. Tighten the belt, order a pot of wine and a few side dishes, and that's all the money he can muster. As for the rent, even if he breaks his waist, he won't be able to come up with that amount.
Shop assistant, I'll pay a year's rent for this place!"
Hearing this, the shop assistant was overjoyed and immediately went over to serve Meng Jingzhou's table, giving him a shoulder rub and leg massage: "Thank you, sir!"
Li Zhuo's face turned alternating shades of red and white. He was extremely conscious of his public image, always flamboyant, and had never suffered humiliation here before.
He even felt that the eyes of those who recognized him and originally regarded him with awe were now looking at him differently.
He quickly tallied up how much he could extract in Spirit Stones: "It's just a year's rent. I'll pay two years for the Tianxiang Building!"
The shop assistant, delighted, rushed to Li Zhuo's side and began massaging with practiced movements.
"Three years," Meng Jingzhou said languidly, without even lifting an eyelid; to him, it was all chump change.
The shop assistant switched sides once more to Meng Jingzhou.
"Three and a half years...four years!" Li Zhuo didn't dare to take out that many Spirit Stones, but not wanting to lose momentum by settling for half a year, he upped it to another half year.
"Five years, and add today's expenses for everyone to my tab," Meng Jingzhou said offhandedly, feeling good about today and wanting to spend freely.
The shop assistant ran back and forth, wishing he could split into a clone to massage both patrons at the same time.
