Li Zhuo was so angry that he wanted to curse. Who was this upstart anyway? Once he found out this person's identity, he would make sure he couldn't complete a single business deal in the Imperial City!
"Six years!"
He narrowed his eyes, glaring at Meng Jingzhou's detestable face: "Wait, I can come up with that many Spirit Stones, but can you?"
"Since you've already claimed you've got five years covered, you need to prove you've got that many Spirit Stones!"
Meng Jingzhou sneered: "I can come up with not only just the rent for five years but for six as well. I simply can't be bothered to compete with you, that's all."
"This is what you said!" Li Zhuo couldn't believe it. For his rival to pull out so many Spirit Stones, even he felt a great pressure to produce such an amount all at once.
"Go fetch a Meng Family member to collect the rent!" Li Zhuo ordered his guard. The Tianxiang Building was a Meng Family property.
He also had his guard go home to fetch more Spirit Stones as he didn't have enough on him.
Soon after, the housekeeper Xu You arrived, as he usually was the one to collect rent for the Tianxiang Building.
Li Zhuo, with much pain, took out a Storage Ring and handed it to Xu You. The six years' worth of rent he had scraped together would surely invoke the wrath of his father and grandfather if they learned of his actions today.
```
But it doesn't matter now, all that matters is getting this bad blood out.
Xu You checked the Storage Ring with his Spiritual Sense, and it indeed contained six years' worth of rent.
"Now it's your turn!" Li Zhuo stared at Meng Jingzhou with a death grip, "I want to see how you're going to produce six years of rent!"
Meng Jingzhou turned to Xu You and extended his hand: "Uncle Xu, give me some Spirit Stones."
Xu You passed the recently acquired Storage Ring to Meng Jingzhou. Although Meng Jingzhou was in disguise, that was how he looked when he arrived in the Imperial City, which Xu You had seen before.
"Look, six years of rent."
"You're a Meng Family Member?!" Li Zhuo realized, unable to suppress his fury any longer. He felt like a clown, played by the opponent.
"I'm playing you for sure! Scaring away customers and feeling justified about it!" Meng Jingzhou dropped the act and simply took off his mask.
Seeing this, Li Zhuo felt like a bucket of cold water had been dumped on him. The rage ready to explode dissipated completely, leaving him standing there, dumbfounded, before he started pointing at Meng Jingzhou with trembling fingers, exclaiming, "You're Meng Jingzhou?!"
How could this guy have come back!
Why didn't anyone inform him?
Or could it be that he is the first person to know of Meng Jingzhou's return?!
"Wow, Li Zhuo, growing some guts, are we? Daring to call this young master by name?" Meng Jingzhou sneered, twisting his neck and flexing his wrists with audible pops, step by step approaching Li Zhuo, who was so frightened he couldn't even bother about the beautiful companion in his arms anymore, and kept retreating.
The spectators watching the spectacle hadn't expected that the one competing with Li Zhuo in terms of wealth would be Meng Jingzhou.
"The Meng Family's Young Master has returned!" someone who understood what this meant shuddered inwardly. It seemed that the Imperial City would not be tranquil for the coming days.
"Who's the Meng Family's Young Master?" asked someone unfamiliar with the Imperial City.
"The Meng Family's Young Master Meng Jingzhou, the one who joined the Seek Dao Sect, haven't you heard?"
"How does he compare to the Four Young Masters of the Imperial City in terms of strength?"
"The Four Young Masters of the Imperial City are nothing. If Meng Jingzhou hadn't left the city, not one of them would dare to show their face. This guy once dared to hit the little prince hard!"
"I heard Li Zhuo was taught a lesson by someone, was it done by this Meng Jingzhou?"
"Right, it was him!"
"Who's the guy sitting next to Meng Jingzhou?"
"Don't know him."
Li Zhuo's face turned ashen, seriously frightened by Meng Jingzhou. He forced a smile and said, "Young Master Meng, what are you talking about? It's just that I was too excited to see you after such a long time, I forgot the rules."
"Old Lu, how about it, do you now realize my status in the Imperial City?" Meng Jingzhou boasted proudly. This was a rule he had set back then, that Li Zhuo and his ilk had to call him 'young master' when they saw him.
Lu Yang rolled his eyes, uninterested in engaging with him. What's the big deal? I'm the Sect Leader at the Seek Dao Sect.
"Old Lu... He's Lu Yang!" Those familiar with Meng Jingzhou's identity and who had read "Legend of the Dao Seeking Sect" could easily guess Lu Yang's identity, and they exclaimed in shock.
In terms of fame alone, Lu Yang's name was more widely known than the Left Chancellor's.
Maybe people didn't know what the Left Chancellor's name was or what he'd done, but they definitely knew what Lu Yang was all about.
"That disciple of Daoist Buyu, the next Sect Leader of the Seek Dao Sect, Lu Yang?!"
"That's him, now who else would dare to take the name Lu Yang!"
"How did both of them end up in the Imperial City!"

chapters.title: Chapter 831 - 831: 830
chapters.content:
```
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, the two major characters of "Legend of the Dao Sect", even had individual chapters dedicated to their stories by Daoist Buyu, truly making their names renowned throughout the world.
Whether it was cultivators from other regions or local cultivators from the Imperial City, all had heard of their great fame.
And local cultivators of the Imperial City knew even more, such as the formidable reputation Meng Jingzhou once held in the Imperial City.
If it hadn't been for his later departure from home, there would be no such thing as the "Four Young Masters of the Imperial City."
Recently, Lu Yang's name had become somewhat more prominent than Meng Jingzhou's, as Daoist Buyu's ascension to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage attracted much attention, inadvertently shining the spotlight on Lu Yang as well.
Lu Yang held his forehead, not expecting to be so famous that Old Meng merely had to shout "Old Lu" for his identity to be guessed.
Since that was the case, there was no need for disguises anymore.
Lu Yang also removed his mask, revealing a face well-known to the people.
"It really is him!"
"You're Lu Yang!" Li Zhuo's attention shifted to Lu Yang.
His grandfather had some entanglements with Daoist Buyu, so he had instructed him that if he should ever encounter Lu Yang, he must teach him a good lesson.
Now, he felt managing to protect himself was good enough.
"Little Zhuo, you're acting quite arrogant, huh? Stealing someone else's seat when you have no place to dine. How come you didn't act like this when you were hanging out with me?"
Li Zhuo awkwardly offered a placating smile, not daring to speak.
"Uncle Xu, don't worry about us. We're going to take another stroll around the Imperial City."
"Alright," Xu You replied with a smile, and left the Tianxiang Tower.
"Young Master Meng, can I leave too?" Li Zhuo cautiously asked, inching backwards.
"Wait a minute, where do you think you're going? When I was bidding earlier, I said I'd pick up today's tab. Since you ended up bidding higher, doesn't that mean you should fulfill that promise?"
"What Young Master Meng says is right, absolutely right." Li Zhuo dared not utter a word of objection, now only wanting to quickly distance himself from Meng Jingzhou, unconcerned about any spirit stones or female companion.
"Alright, get lost."
Li Zhuo, as if granted amnesty, hastily left the Tianxiang Tower.
...
News that Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had shown up quickly spread throughout the Imperial City.
"What, the disciple of Old Buyu has appeared?" Upon hearing this, the Chief of Staff from the Ministry of Personnel couldn't sit still. His cultivation talent was limited, with no hope of reaching the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, thus he did not enter seclusion.
He had never thought he would have a chance to defeat Daoist Buyu, yet fate seemed to have thrown an opportunity his way with the arrival of Daoist Buyu's young disciple.
"Son, come here. How has your cultivation been going lately?" The Chief of Staff called over his youngest son, the most promising of all his children with the best talent for cultivation.
The son of the Chief of Staff was handsome and striking, capable of turning the heads of young ladies when walking down the main street.
"Thanks to the elixirs provided by father, I haven't encountered many bottlenecks, and have now reached the peak of the Nascent Soul stage," he said.
The Chief of Staff nodded, then added, "I hear some people are now calling you a genius?"
His son displayed a confident smile, "I dare not claim to be a genius as that is merely the people's high regard, but in terms of battle, I indeed have never been defeated."
"That's good to hear. Daoist Buyu's young disciple, Lu Yang, has come. Your father may not be a match for Old Buyu, but now I'm counting on you. Go and compete with Lu Yang."
"Eh?" The Chief of Staff's son was flabbergasted. Sure, he was talented, but he was not up to competing with a prodigy like Lu Yang who had won the championship at the Dao Seeking Sect's 120,000th anniversary celebration.
After all, that was someone who could fight the Young Sect Master to a draw.
If I were that powerful, what would I be doing in the Imperial City? I'd have joined the Heavenly Court Sect in a heartbeat.
...
"Grandfather, I was bullied by Meng Jingzhou and Lu Yang." As soon as Li Zhuo returned to the Prime Minister's Residence, he cried injustice, growing more indignant with every step along the way. Yet he was no match for Meng Jingzhou and Lu Yang, and he could only seek his grandfather's help.
His grandfather had old scores to settle with both the Meng Family and Daoist Buyu, and any opportunity for payback was sure to be seized!
The Left Chancellor was an old man with white hair. After listening to Li Zhuo's exaggerated account, he pondered for a moment.
```
"Are you saying that Old Buyu's disciple has also come?"
"It's mainly that Meng Jingzhou, he's really going too far!" Li Zhuo said indignantly, though he didn't care much for Lu Yang.
The Left Chancellor paid no heed, continuing to mutter to himself: "If you were to take Lu Yang as your big brother, then you and Lu Yang would be of the same generation, and Daoist Buyu would become the generation of my son, isn't that the logic?"
"What?"
"What indeed, go quickly and acknowledge Lu Yang as your big brother!"
...
Upon returning to the Meng Residence, Lu Yang received a snowfall of invitation cards, filling up an entire table.
"So many, quite popular, huh," Meng Jingzhou teased.
Despite having many enemies in the Imperial City, as Meng Family's Young Master, those who disliked him didn't dare to confront him openly.
Lu Yang drew a line in the middle of the table and explained to Meng Jingzhou: "On the left are challenge letters, and on the right are brotherhood pacts."
"The challenge letters are from the younger generation of my master's enemies, and the brotherhood pacts are from the grandchildren generation of my master's enemies."
"What are you afraid of with the challenge letters, just fight," Meng Jingzhou said.
Lu Yang sighed deeply: "I'm naturally not afraid of fighting alone, but the problem is that these are all joint challenge letters."
In other words, they were planning a group beating.
Meng Jingzhou scratched his head, this was indeed a tricky situation. Lu Yang couldn't possibly go into a group fight foolishly, nor could he just start acknowledging a bunch of underlings.
If he ignored these invitations and went out, it didn't rule out the possibility of Lu Yang being ambushed, or swarmed by people wanting to acknowledge him as their big brother.
"I've got an idea," Meng Jingzhou said, a flash of inspiration coming to him.
"What is it?"
...
The Luotian Forest, a small forest within the Imperial City, was a place where cultivators often came to sense the spirit of wood.
Today, Luotian Forest was busier than usual, bustling with the children of officials and disciples of influential families gathered together.
"You received a response from Lu Yang as well?" Li Zhuo chatted with the son of the Chief of Staff, whom he got along with well.
"Yeah, it said to come to Luotian Forest to resolve issues, but how come we haven't seen anyone after half a day?" the son of the Chief of Staff wondered.
Just as everyone was puzzled, they saw Meng Jingzhou leap down from the treetops.
"Quiet down, everyone. If anyone else speaks, I'll make my family raise your interest rates," he threatened.
The crowd immediately fell silent.
"The purpose of gathering everyone today is something you are all well aware of, all of you are here for my brother, Lu Yang."
"Some of you carry the hatred of the older generation and want to challenge Lu Yang, while others want to take advantage of our Sect Leader and take Lu Yang as your big brother. These feelings are understandable," Meng Jingzhou said.
"But there is only one Lu Yang. If you swarm him, he certainly won't be able to beat you all; if you all swarm to acknowledge him as your big brother, he won't be able to accept you either."
"To resolve this issue, Lu Yang and I have discussed and decided to host a grand tournament."
"A tournament?" the crowd frowned, not understanding Meng Jingzhou's intentions.
"As the saying goes, the strong are revered, and the strong have privileges," he explained.
"This tournament is named the First Annual Lu Yang Championship. It's a group competition, with pairs fighting against each other, the winners advancing to the next round until a champion is decided."
As everyone was still digesting Meng Jingzhou's words, suddenly a human-height red box descended from the sky, landing before Meng Jingzhou with exquisite packaging.
Meng Jingyu, standing atop a tree, caught her breath— it was she who had thrown the box.
Meng Jingzhou quickly opened the box, revealing Lu Yang tied to a chair, and introduced with ceremony:
"And this, is the prize of the tournament—Lu Yang."
"Whoever wins the tournament, be it to challenge Lu Yang or to take him as your big brother, will have the opportunity to do so."

chapters.title: Chapter 832 - 831: Four Wins
chapters.content:
After Meng Jingzhou announced the competition rules, the Lor Forest fell into dead silence, and the crowd was like a pack of wolves in the night, their green eyes fixated on Lu Yang tied to a chair.
Lu Yang felt his scalp tingle, realizing it was one thing to see a flurry of invitations piled up on the Meng Family's table, but quite another to have those who sent the invitations standing densely in front of him in person.
"Master, just how many people did you offend in the Imperial City? You're already at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, why don't you hurry over and take care of these enemies?"
In the perilous Cultivation World, one must be decisive in killing to ensure one's own protection.
Meng Jingyu sat atop the tree canopy, with fruits transported from the East Sea and desserts from Tianxiang Tower on her left, and on her right, fruit juice squeezed from fruits brought from the Demon Territory. All of these were her hard work for tying up Lu Yang, packaging him in a beautiful box, and throwing it out at the right moment.
Meng Jingyu watched the scene below with great enthusiasm, finding this much more interesting than cultivating or reading.
"According to brother's words, this will let me witness how cultivators fight against each other, which will greatly aid in my cultivation later on," she mused.
"Even if father asks, I can say practice brings true knowledge," she reasoned.
With that, she continued to watch, excited about engaging in such an activity for the first time.
"Lu Yang is right here, why bother with a competition? Let's all go at him together!" someone in the crowd shouted. He carried the hope of his family and sought to redeem himself, not having the time for this kind of dilly-dallying.
"Lu Yang is going to be my big brother in the future; I dare anyone to try and lay a hand on him!" another voice rang out from the crowd, the speaker also bearing his family's hopes to acknowledge Lu Yang as an older brother, thereby lowering Daoist Buyu's generational rank.
"Ganging up on him shows no true skill, defeating Lu Yang in a fair fight is the Righteous Path!"
"Nonsense, you're at the Spirit Transformation Stage; of course, you have the gall to say you can fight him one-on-one. Let's see you reduce to the Nascent Soul Stage and try fighting Lu Yang then!"
"Quiet down, everyone just quiet down," Meng Jingzhou had anticipated such a situation.
"Whoever dares to make another racket, I will announce on behalf of the Meng Family that your clan is our best partners in cooperation!"
Meng Jingzhou, with his hands behind his back, looked down at the crowd, and where his gaze fell, people bowed their heads, not daring to meet his eyes for fear of becoming the Meng Family's partners.
"That's more like it. Any objections? If not, get ready for the competition," he declared.
Truthfully, many were quite happy to have a competition, as Imperial City was large, and they rarely had a chance to gather for one-on-one battles.
Those daring to form teams to challenge Lu Yang were confident in their Cultivation Levels, not those whose levels were purely a stack of elixirs.
Away from Imperial City, if placed in a Sect, they would be disciples from either a First-Grade or a Super-grade Sect.
"Come on, let's start drawing lots," Meng Jingzhou brought out a large box containing paired number plaques; whoever drew the same numbers would be opponents.
The box was also treated to isolate Spiritual Sense, eliminating the possibility of cheating with Spiritual Sense.
The young masters followed Meng Jingzhou's instructions and queued up to draw lots, hoping to encounter a slightly weaker opponent.
Some rejoiced while others despaired, and there were those confident in their strength, believing they would not be defeated.
"I'm doomed, my opponent is Sun Chuanxian!" someone went pale, knowing they stood no chance against their opponent.
Sun Chuanxian, the son of the Minister of War, one of the four young masters of Imperial City, excelled in martial strength.
Sun Chuanxian, after getting his number, didn't even check who his opponent was.
His Cultivation Level was achieved through sheer effort, without the aid of Elixirs, and few present had the credentials to be his opponent.
"An Nan'er is here too?"
Yet another individual unfortunate enough to draw a lot pitting them against one of the strongest cultivators of their age in the Imperial City.
An Nan'er, the granddaughter of the national guardian, was said to have experienced strange phenomena at birth, and if not for the national guardian's intervention, the entire Imperial City would have been enveloped by these phenomena.
Aside from her, there were also Luo Wushuang, son of the Minister of War, acclaimed as unparalleled in both literature and martial arts, and Zhong Yi, son of the Chief of Staff, with his meticulous mind, said to be able to obtain anything he desired.
Sun Chuanxian's match ended quickly. He condensed an icy frost dragon, exhaled a breath of dragon's breath, and turned his opponent into an ice lump, tossing them out of the arena.
Seeing how swiftly and cleanly Sun Chuanxian fought, Ning Fan, the son of the Grand Censor, looked up at the sky, realizing that with this pace, the competition might not last until the end.
Putting aside the final prize which was Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou had relied on his ability to fight and bullied him quite a few times. He really wanted to defeat Sun Chuanxian, but unfortunately, his strength didn't allow it.
"Ning Fan, do you want to win?" Meng Jingzhou quietly approached Ning Fan, smiling slyly.
"What advice does Young Master Meng have?"
"I wouldn't dare to advise, but I have a little something here that might be able to help."
"What little something?"
Meng Jingzhou pulled out a small wooden puppet from behind his back, three inches tall, unpolished, and without a painted face, looking extremely crude in its craftsmanship.
"This is a puppet I've just plucked from a tree."
"In the next match with Sun Chuanxian, you won't need to lift a finger, just throw out this puppet, and it will fight for you. This puppet can unleash a realm similar to yours, and it's not against the rules. So, what do you say, do you want it?"
"There's such a great thing?" Ning Fan exclaimed with joy.
"Five hundred thousand spirit stones to rent it once."
"That expensive?" Ning Fan was taken aback. He was not like Li Zhuo; he came from a family with particularly strict discipline and didn't have that many spirit stones.
"That's just perfect, we also offer lending services here." This was the Meng Family's old business, and Meng Jingzhou proficiently took out a bag of storage rings filled with high-grade spirit stones and a lending contract.
"Seeing as we're acquainted, the annual interest is only ten percent, not too much, right?"
"This..."
"Hey, you're on the verge of breaking through to the Divinity Transformation Stage. Once you reach the Divinity Transformation Stage, won't you be able to pay out five hundred thousand?" Meng Jingzhou hadn't swindled Ning Fan; reaching the Divinity Transformation Stage meant the family would give rewards, at least five hundred thousand.
"I'll take it!" Ning Fan said, gritting his teeth. He borrowed five hundred thousand from Meng Jingzhou and gave it right back to rent the small wooden puppet.
"Can this thing really fight?" Ning Fan skeptically held the small puppet, doubting its potency.
"What kind of talk is that? My reputation may not be great, but I've never sold a fake." Meng Jingzhou said.
Ning Fan thought back and realized it was true.
Soon, the first round ended, and it was time for Ning Fan's match with Sun Chuanxian.
Knowing how formidable Sun Chuanxian was, the crowd didn't think much of Ning Fan's chances.
Unexpectedly, at the start of the match, Ning Fan didn't use any magic skills to attack or defend, but instead threw out a small wooden puppet.
The three-inch-tall wooden puppet brandished its wooden sword, making hee-hee-ha-ha sounds as if to intimidate Sun Chuanxian.
Seeing this, Sun Chuanxian burst into laughter, not taking it seriously.
Suddenly, the wooden puppet unleashed a terrifying Sword Qi, shocking Sun Chuanxian into retreating and using an ice dragon to block so that he wasn't injured.
Sun Chuanxian, as if facing a formidable enemy, got into a battle-ready stance, no longer underestimating the small wooden puppet.
Up on the stage, Lu Yang was seriously controlling the wooden puppet to fight with Sun Chuanxian.
Lu Yang had created this puppet by combining a Wooden Avatar with Earth Shrinking. He figured as the grand prize, earning a small side profit wasn't unreasonable. It was after discussing with Meng Jingzhou that they staged this act.
Sun Chuanxian got his wish to fight with himself.
Ning Fan could defeat Sun Chuanxian.
Lu Yang made five hundred thousand spirit stones by renting himself out.
Meng Jingzhou acquired an IOU for five hundred thousand.
This was a situation where everyone wins.

chapters.title: Chapter 833 - 832 Unity is Strength
chapters.content:
"How did it go, little sister, did you learn?" Meng Jingzhou leapt onto the treetop and guzzled down the fruit juice that Meng Jingyu was about to drink.
Meng Jingyu looked at her brother with a brooding expression, and after a while said, "Then why don't we set up an underground betting ring and bet on Ning Fan winning?"
Meng Jingzhou waved his hand dismissively, "Our Meng Family colludes with officials and merchants, but we still cannot engage in illegal activities."
...
The little puppet's swordsmanship was extremely exquisite; Sun Chuanxian had seen many sword cultivators, but never one with such skill.
"Ice Dragon emerges from the sea!" Sun Chuanxian shouted loudly, summoning two ice dragons. The dragons breathed frost, icing the ground and leaving a layer of frost on the leaves above.
The little puppet continued to chuckle indistinctly while brandishing its wooden sword, forming a rudimentary domain of swordsmanship around itself. Neither the dragon's breath nor the extreme cold could harm it!
"Ning Fan, I didn't expect you to have such a trick up your sleeve!" Sun Chuanxian's impression of Ning Fan changed. He had sparred with Ning Fan many times, and Ning Fan had never revealed his identity as a puppeteer. On the stage, he even used the puppet's cute appearance to deceive him; what a deep schemer!
Ning Fan was also surprised, not expecting the little puppet to be so formidable. The five hundred thousand spent was worth it.
"It seems my biggest competitor in this competition is you! With this trick, even Lu Yang would have a hard time if he encountered it!"
The second round of the competition was happening simultaneously, and Sun Chuanxian noticed that Lu Yang, who was tied to a chair, was always paying attention to this side, indicating that he also thought highly of Ning Fan's puppetry!
Ning Fan believed in getting what you pay for, so since Ning Fan had shelled out five hundred thousand spirit stones, the service he provided had to be worth that amount; therefore, he controlled the puppet clone with great dedication.
"Slash!"
Just with a light *whisk*, the little puppet decapitated the two frost dragons and, like a small hammer, knocked Sun Chuanxian out of the arena.
"Ning Fan wins!"
"Did I really win?" Ning Fan's eyes brightened with joy.
Just as he was about to retrieve the puppet, he saw the little puppet run into the crowd and disappear from sight.
The service worth five hundred thousand had thus come to an end.
The other matchup in the second round was equally eye-catching, involving the Minister of War's son, Luo Wushuang, and the national guardian's granddaughter, An Nan'er.
"Daoist An, I didn't think we would meet here," said Luo Wushuang clad in armor and wielding a halberd, looking as though he had burst through a battlefield, awe-inspiring and formidable.
"Unfortunately, this time I cannot give you any leeway. My father has commanded me to defeat Lu Yang, to wash away the shame of his previous defeat to Daoist Buyu!"
An Nan'er's expression was calm as the two jade bracelets on her wrist enlarged, transforming into two jade rings that buzzed in the air.
"What a coincidence; my grandfather also admonished me to acknowledge Lu Yang as my brother. I am determined to win this battle!"
Upon hearing this, the prize Lu Yang was about to say, "If it's just about acknowledging a brother, there's no need for the battle," when he saw Meng Jingzhou, as if anticipating Lu Yang's words, dashed over with a leap and shoved a cloth in Lu Yang's mouth.
Just kidding, did you think you could take all the good fortune for yourself?
This was an unequal battle. Luo Wushuang was at the early stage of the Divinity Transformation Stage, while An Nan'er was at the peak of the Nascent Soul Stage. One was an undefeated genius of warfare, and the other was an extraordinary individual born with strange phenomena. If both were on the same level, they could have fought an even battle.
But with a realm's difference, there wouldn't be much competition.
The two looked at each other, each seeming to have made up their mind, and said simultaneously.
"Daoist An, if I defeat you with a higher realm, you probably won't accept defeat meekly. Now I will suppress my realm. If you lose then, you will be convinced in both heart and words," Luo Wushuang said, as he formed hand seals to bind himself, suppressing his level to the peak of the Nascent Soul Stage.
"Daoist Luo, don't think that because I am a realm lower than you, you are sure to win. Truthfully, I have already broken through to the Spirit Transformation Realm, but until now, I simply sealed my cultivation," An Nan'er made a gesture on her forehead, and her aura surged dramatically; in the blink of an eye, she advanced to the Divinity Transformation Stage.
Luo Wushuang: "..."
An Nan'er: "..."
The scene fell into a deadly silence. An Nan'er was the first to speak up, breaking the stalemate.
"Won't you recover to the Divinity Transformation Stage?"
After a moment of silence, Luo Wushuang said, "...that would take an hour. How about you continue to seal your cultivation level?"
"Once the cultivation level is unsealed, it takes two hours before it can be sealed again."
Both parties once again fell into a prolonged silence. It was not possible to have everyone dryly wait here for an hour.
"Luo Daoist friend, I apologize in advance!" An Nan'er made up her mind. Although dominating someone with her realm was not her intention, it was the only option she had now.
"Damn it, wait a minute..." Luo Wushuang hadn't expected An Nan'er to act so decisively, and before he could react, the two jade rings behind her pounced forward, knocking him away.
"An Nan'er wins!"
Elsewhere, Zhong Yi, the son of the Chief of Staff, who was also held in high hopes by everyone, encountered a quite challenging opponent.
"Who is this person, so capable of fighting? It looks like Zhong Yi is going to lose."
"Probably some household's illegitimate child, hidden away and unwilling to meet people."
Zhong Yi was sent flying by his opponent and stumbled back several steps before steadying himself. Panting, he glared at his opponent: "I never imagined there would be such a master hidden in the Imperial City; you've kept yourself well concealed. Who are you? How come I've never seen you before!"
The opponent seemed to be a young man about the same age as Zhong Yi. Hearing Zhong Yi's question, a slightly embarrassed expression appeared on the young man's face as he explained slowly.
"Actually, I'm just a cultivator from outside the city. I heard that the Luo Heavenly Forest in the Imperial City is quite famous, so I came to check it out. Then you all appeared, pushed me into the crowd, and I felt it would be inappropriate to leave at that time, so I didn't. That guy surnamed Meng even insisted on drawing lots with me.
After the draw, I started fighting in a daze and then encountered you."
"By the way, I'm at the Body Integration Realm."
Zhong Yi: "..."
How can you, as someone at the Body Integration Realm, have the nerve to fight with a bunch of us young people? Don't you have any shame?
The Body Integration Realm young man slapped the back of his head and laughed: "Having shame wouldn't get me to the Body Integration Realm now, would it?"
Then he left the field nonchalantly, not even leaving his name behind.
"Zhong Yi wins!"
Zhong Yi was terrifyingly strong. He overcame all obstacles and met An Nan'er in the final round, eventually defeating her after three hundred exchanges.
"Congratulations to Daoist Zhong Yi for the victory." Meng Jingzhou clapped with a smile, revealing a path that exposed the tightly bound Lu Yang behind him.
"Now, whether Daoist Zhong Yi wants to challenge Lu Yang or become sworn brothers with him, he can do either."
Actually, there was no need to ask. Meng Jingzhou could see the burning fighting spirit in Zhong Yi's eyes; he was definitely here to challenge Lu Yang.
But could someone at the early stage of Spirit Transformation really defeat Lu Yang?
Zhong Yi didn't answer directly but said in a deep voice, "Our ancestors braved thorns and hardships, passing down a cultivation system through generations. At the end of the Great Yu era, the Jiang Family rose, leading countless troops to establish the Great Xia Dynasty, which shows that some things can't be done by a single individual. Unity is strength."
Zhong Yi pointed at Lu Yang and stated resoundingly, "I choose to gang up on Lu Yang!"

chapters.title: Chapter 834 - 833: Blurring the Lines between Fake and Real
chapters.content:
Lu Yang's reputation was well-known, his fame spread far and wide, and Zhong Yi wasn't foolish; if he were to fight Lu Yang himself, he was sure to be the one losing.
When the crowd below heard Zhong Yi's wish, they all looked up in unison, staring at Lu Yang, including those who had wanted to acknowledge Lu Yang as their "big brother".
After all, it was the wish of the first-place winner, which was meant to be fulfilled.
And besides, the matter of acknowledging a big brother could still be done after the fight.
"Old Meng, what should we do?" Lu Yang started sweating profusely, feeling like a fat white pig tied to a chair, about to face a pack of ravenous wolves.
Meng Jingzhou had already anticipated this situation and signaled to Lu Yang not to worry, "Relax, I've already filed with the government office; our event is following legal procedures. It's not considered a mass brawl, so even if a group fight breaks out, it's fine."
"...What about me?"
"You're just normal collateral damage."
"Damn you, Old Meng!" Lu Yang forcefully shattered the chair and the ropes and took off running, knowing that if he didn't run now, he would lose the chance entirely.
Meng Jingzhou let out a cold laugh at this scene. He still remembered the incident from not long ago where one turned into many Mengs. You told me to fight my dad! he thought.
If he didn't get his revenge, his conscience would be uneasy!
"Brothers, charge! Let's take down Lu Yang together!" Someone from below shouted, and immediately the young masters surged forward like a swarm, launching various techniques at Lu Yang as if they cost them nothing.
Lu Yang suspected that the person who shouted was arranged by that bastard Meng Jingzhou.
The first stage of the first Lu Yang Championship ended, the second stage officially began, and all the cultivators eliminated in the first stage were revived to participate in the second-stage competition!
"Earth Shrinking!" Lu Yang dived into the earth like diving into a pool, dodging the attacks. The ancient trees in the Loytian Forest reached the sky, with labyrinthine root systems, and Lu Yang hid among these roots, making him extremely hard to find.
"Where is he!"
"Use Spiritual Sense to find him!"
"No use, his Spiritual Sense is too strong; he's shielded himself, we can't find him!"
Lu Yang was like a deep sea shark, looking up at these ignorant tourists in the sea, the tourists completely unaware that danger had quietly descended.
"Draw Prison!"
Lu Yang drew a circle underground, and the young masters standing on the edge suddenly fell into an underground prison.
Just as one young master was about to shout for help, he heard Lu Yang's sinister threat, "Don't scream, or I'll hit you with Arhat Fist."
Thanks to Daoist Buyu, Lu Yang's Arhat Fist was also renowned.
The young master immediately shut his mouth and nodded, clearly taking a stand.
Lu Yang satisfactorily weaved through the area, looking for his next target.
Two, three, four... more and more people fell into Lu Yang's underground prisons, and Luo Wushuang was the first to detect something was amiss.
"Something's wrong, several people are missing!"
"I heard that Lu Yang obtained the ancient earthworm inheritance, which not only allows him to burrow underground but also to create underground prisons!" Zhong Yi said earnestly, spreading his Spiritual Sense, staring at the ground beneath him with tension and alertness, a drop of cold sweat trickling down his cheek.
If Lu Yang were to pull him underground, it would be too embarrassing.
Lu Yang, seeing that the crowd had become aware of his scheme, stopped making moves for the time being.
"Can't worry about that now. Since he's hiding underground and we can't find him, we might as well just turn the whole ground upside down!" A young master bellowed in anger, smashing his fist onto the ground, causing several cracks to appear.
Seeing this, others followed suit, using either brute strength or earth-element and wood-element magic skills. The Loytian Forest seemed to come to life, with every inch of soil churning upwards.
Lu Yang shrank to the size of an inch and hid behind a pile of soil that had been turned over. Even so, he was spotted by the sharp-eyed crowd.
"There he is!" Sun Chuanxian pointed at the tiny Lu Yang and shouted.
"Ice Dragon Technique!"
"One Wood Reaching the Heavens!"
"Whirling Sand and Flying Stones!"
Lu Yang, seeing no way to evade, had no choice but to return to his original size and, at the same time, he activated the Three Flavored True Fire and the Golden Bird True Flame. The two types of True Fire fused into one, forming a fiery wall.
The ice dragon collided with the True Fire, emitting sizzling steam and obscuring the vision of the crowd.
Lu Yang took that opportunity to strike quickly, aiming to hit as many as he could.
"Arhat Fist!"
Sun Chuanxian, being the closest to Lu Yang, was the first to receive the treatment of the Arhat Fist.
"Not good!" Sun Chuanxian instinctively raised his hand to block, suddenly remembering the terrifying effect of the Lu Family's Arhat Fist. He tried to switch from blocking to dodging, but it was too late: he was struck by Lu Yang's fist and sent flying backward.
Along with his body, his hair was sent flying as well.
"Quick, dodge it, don't touch him!" someone shouted from the side. No one dared to confront him head-on, and they all dodged hastily. Lu Yang, like a wolf among sheep, caused the flock to scatter wherever he went.
At the crucial moment, Zhong Yi stood up to take control of the situation, "Everyone, don't be afraid. I've learned the forbidden move of Buddhism, the 'Eternity Technique.' I guarantee that everyone's hair will grow back!"
Hearing this, the crowd regained their boldness, continuing to fight Lu Yang with renewed confidence.
Lu Yang found himself in a difficult position. Even as strong as he was, it was impossible for him to defeat so many at once, especially since these were not just any ungrounded Loose Cultivators; their combat strength was outstanding within the same realm.
As Lu Yang was getting hit, Meng Jingzhou watched with delight, cheering from the sidelines.
"Old Lu, the left side, someone's aiming for you on the left... Hey, I'm warning you, how could you still get hit?"
"Put some effort into it, did you not eat?"
"Don't just defend, Old Lu; go on the offensive!"
"Look at you lot; you can't even fight properly. How did you train to get such cultivation levels? Put some force behind it!"
"Old Meng, you're forcing my hand!" Lu Yang roared in anger, thinking Old Meng believed he had no way to deal with him.
Lu Yang changed his moves, no longer using a combination of fist technique and magic skill, focusing solely on fist technique. The style also shifted and became even sharper, causing the crowd to struggle to adapt for a moment.
Meng Jingzhou, however, found Lu Yang's movements increasingly familiar.
Suddenly, Meng Jingzhou felt as if part of the strength within his body had been siphoned away, drifting towards Lu Yang, who was in the midst of battle within the crowd. Lu Yang's form shifted, taking on Meng Jingzhou's own appearance.
Meng Jingzhou's Imitation Fist!
Meng Jingzhou felt a sense of doom and immediately turned to run, but the Lu Yang who had transformed into his likeness was not about to give him the chance. Breaking through the crowd's obstruction, he quickly closed in on Meng Jingzhou.
The others, about to attack, saw this and quickly halted, exchanging looks, each wondering who they should strike at.
"Old Lu, how dare you transform into my likeness!" one Meng Jingzhou accused, grabbing the collar of the other.
"Nonsense, I am Meng Jingzhou. You're the shameless one trying to mislead everyone!"
"I'm the real one!"
"No, I am the real one!"
"Little sister, I'm your brother!" one Meng Jingzhou jumped onto the treetops, seeking help from Meng Jingyu, who was watching the commotion.
The other Meng Jingzhou also leaped into the tree, speaking softly and tenderly, "Little sister, can't you recognize your own brother?"
Meng Jingyu watched as both brothers leaped up, her small mouth agape with shock.
She looked at one brother, then at the other, seeing that they were identical, which made her hesitate.
"Brother wrote in his letter that he often manages to defeat Brother Lu Yang. Why don't you two fight it out, and whoever wins is my real brother?"

chapters.title: Chapter 835 - 835: 834
chapters.content:
Meng Jingzhou was taken aback by the words, he quickly analyzed the situation. Lu Yang had transformed into his appearance, which limited all sorts of moves and drastically reduced his combat power, but when that bastard Lu Yang turned into him, he had also borrowed a portion of his strength. If they really started fighting, victory or defeat was up in the air!
With that being the case, the answer was obvious!
The real Meng Jingzhou launched the first attack and kicked his doppelganger down by the tree.
Zhong Yi witnessed the scene and was the first to make a judgment, shouting, "A sneak attack, such a despicable act could only be done by Lu Yang!"
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Have I ever done something so good that would make you guys think I'm of high moral standing?
He immediately jumped down from the tree, standing next to his fake self, making it once again difficult for everyone to distinguish who was who.
"What do we do?"
"Hit both, won't lose anything even if we hit the wrong one!" Luo Wushuang shouted.
Everyone thought this made sense. In fact, it might be a good opportunity to hit Meng Jingzhou.
They fought with Lu Yang or accepted Lu Yang as their big brother on their elders' orders, whereas hitting Meng Jingzhou was a desire that came from their hearts.
"Old Lu, you bastard, dragging me into this mess!"
"We're both about to get hit, and you're still acting?"
"Acting my ass, I'm seeking justice here!"
Both Meng Jingzhous argued non-stop, but it didn't matter anymore. Now, everyone didn't care which was real and which was fake.
Oh wait, wrong, it's best if they can distinguish the real Meng Jingzhou—their strikes would be fiercer.
Meng Jingzhou realized this too. Lu Yang turning into him was a brazen scheme, one where, even if the real and fake were discerned, everyone would feign collective blindness and pretend not to see!
So malicious!
"Brothers, charge, take down Meng Jingzhou... ah, no, take down Lu Yang, save Young Master Meng!"
"Attack!"
Seeing two Meng Jingzhous, everyone was fired up, their moves more vicious than before.
"No way, Old Meng, you're so hated that their attacks have gone up a notch after I turned into you," one of the Meng Jingzhous suddenly said, making everyone realize he was the fake Meng Jingzhou.
Forget the fake for now, let's beat up the real Meng Jingzhou!
The moves originally prepared to hit that Meng Jingzhou were all transferred to the other Meng Jingzhou.
"Old Meng, do you have no shame, impersonating me!" the other Meng Jingzhou cursed, as if he were the real Lu Yang.
Everyone hesitated again, unsure of who was real and who was fake.
"Fellow Daoists, since we can't tell them apart, let's stick to the original plan and hit both!"
Elsewhere, An Nan'er quietly withdrew from the battle and jumped up to the treetops, sitting next to Meng Jingyu.
"Jingyu, who do you think is your brother?"
Meng Jingyu was munching on fruit and, when she heard An Nan'er's question, she looked up at her with an innocent smile.
"Both are my brother."
...
"Arhat Fist!"
"Arhat Fist!"
Both Meng Jingzhous, as if cloned, performed the Arhat Fist in perfect synchrony.
This was actually pretty normal since it was Meng Jingzhou who had taught Lu Yang the Arhat Fist in the first place.
"Which side is losing hair?"
The beaten young masters hurriedly checked their own hair and actually found that their hair was intact, not a single strand had fallen.
One of the Meng Jingzhous suddenly realized and pointed at another Meng Jingzhou, saying, "I know now, you little rascal must have used the Arhat Fist and 'Eternity Technique' at the same time!"
"Nonsense, it was clearly you who used the Arhat Fist and 'Eternity Technique,' and now you're pinning it on this young master!"
Both Meng Jingzhous wanted to prove that they were Lu Yang.
Lu Yang had thought about changing back to his original appearance, but once he did, he feared the crowd would have no excuse to deal with Meng Jingzhou, and in the end, he himself would be the one who was out of luck.
"Shocking Heaven Six Forms!" one of the Meng Jingzhous roared as his momentum rose to a new level, the ground under his feet trembling and rolling back and forth.
Although Lu Yang did not know the Shocking Heaven Six Forms, it didn't matter, as no one else had seen what the real Shocking Heaven Six Forms looked like either.
The Shocking Heaven Six Forms were the Third Elder's secret technique, and the younger generation had no chance to witness this move, only the older generation had seen it when they were beaten up.
Lu Yang used his fists as swords, his momentum also soaring to a new level, his boxing technique becoming even more lethal, "Shocking Heaven Six Forms!"
Although he had brought Meng Jingzhou as a scapegoat, Lu Yang's situation was still not optimistic, there were too many people. Had it not been for his regular sparring with the Invincible Nascent Soul, he would have been easily overwhelmed by the concentrated attacks and defeated.
"Hmph, you're forcing this young master's hand!" Meng Jingzhou got angry, summoning his dual Nascent Souls, which upon unification, transformed into a deity with three heads and six arms.
Three heads and six arms were Meng Jingzhou's ultimate technique, rarely used. Daoist Buyu, who would tell stories for safety reasons, would not reveal the techniques of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, so the crowd was unaware that only Meng Jingzhou could use the three heads and six arms.
"Shocking Heaven Six Forms!" With three heads and six arms, the power of the Shocking Heaven Six Forms multiplied severalfold, making it impossible for his peers to withstand this punch.
Zhong Yi quickly made a judgment, "So strong? Then he must be Lu Yang, concentrate your attacks on the other one!"
The real Meng Jingzhou's pressure drastically decreased, but he didn't know whether to feel happy or upset.
What do you mean the stronger one must definitely be Lu Yang?
Seeing this, Lu Yang quickly drew his Green Peak Sword to face the enemies.
Although Lu Yang rarely used swords, his identity as a sword cultivator was known by the world. When everyone saw the Green Peak Sword come out and his extraordinary swordsmanship, they were convinced that Meng Jingzhou couldn't be impersonating and turned to attack the real Meng Jingzhou.
Of course, they didn't make it too obvious when targeting the real Meng Jingzhou, they still left a third of the people to attack Lu Yang, with even some shouting, "Who would have thought that Young Master Meng's swordsmanship was so outstanding, I am impressed!"
The real Meng Jingzhou cursed in his heart, since when did I his mother know how to use a sword.
Meng Jingzhou, being focused on by the attacks and having part of his strength borrowed by Lu Yang, quickly ran out of energy and fell in the midst of the beating.
Seeing the scapegoat go down, Lu Yang reverted to his original form, also returning the borrowed strength to Old Meng.
When the crowd saw that the one who had fallen was the real Meng Jingzhou, their expressions changed dramatically, all of them hurriedly helping Meng Jingzhou to his feet.
"Ah, Young Master Meng, if only you had said you were the real one earlier, then we wouldn't have hit you so hard."
Upon hearing this, the crowd echoed in agreement, "Yeah, yeah, we all thought you were Lu Yang, that's why we went all out."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
I've only been away from the Imperial City for a little over five years, how can every single one of you become so shameless.
The first Lu Yang Competition continued in its second round, and Lu Yang, the prize, was still resisting defiantly, refusing to admit defeat.
Without Meng Jingzhou as a scapegoat, the pressure on him immediately returned to what it was originally.
In the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity sat on the imperial throne, elongating her voice, and leisurely asked, "Xiao Yang, do you want this fairy to lend a hand?"
Lu Yang thought to himself that if the fairy wanted to fight, she should just say so directly, her eager expression was hardly concealed.
Lu Yang bowed deeply, "I implore Your Majesty to lend assistance."
In reality, Lu Yang, who was at the center of the crowd, opened his eyes, which held the weight of eons, as though he had traversed through endless ages.
He surveyed the crowd and then slowly said, "You common fools, mere mongrels, are fortunate to gaze upon my presence, why do you not kneel?"

chapters.title: Chapter 836 - 836: 835
chapters.content:
"So arrogant?!"
"It's simply ignoring us completely!"
Everyone had been fighting until they were tired, but now upon hearing Lu Yang's wild words, they suddenly regained their energy.
Facing the excited crowd, "Lu Yang" didn't back down an inch, his eyes as calm as ancient wells, "Heh, not putting you in my eyes, what right do you have to be in my sight?"
In the Spiritual Space, Lu Yang covered his face and sighed. Why did he let Fairy Eternity take over for him?
This was going to make trouble out of nothing.
But it was too late to change anything, his body had been handed over to Fairy Eternity. Even if Lu Yang had regrets, he could forget about getting his body back before Fairy Eternity had her fill of fun.
From a distance, Meng Jingzhou watched Lu Yang spouting wild boasts with uncertainty and apprehension, thinking to himself, "Oh no, could he have been beaten silly?"
"Go!" Luo Wushuang was the first to make a move, controlling the ancient trees in the Ruo Tian Forest. The roots of the ancient trees writhed like tentacles, bursting out of the ground to ambush Fairy Eternity.
Fairy Eternity had anticipated this. The moment the tree roots surged up, she lightly tapped her toe on them, flipping in the air with ease to dodge the ambush.
"Roar—" Zhong Yi lay on the ground like a lion with its mane flowing, emitting a heaven-shaking roar.
This was Buddhism's most authentic Lion's Roar, a roar that could even shatter space itself.
The Lion's Roar caused ripples in space, and the sound waves formed a lion, pouncing at Fairy Eternity.
This was a sign that the Lion's Roar of Buddhism had reached a minor achievement, able to replicate a third of the true essence of the Protector Lion of Buddhism.
"Ice Seals Thousands of Miles!" Sun Chuanxian also made his move, his palms covered with a layer of ice film. If touched by his fists, whether from the Human race or the Demon Race, they would turn into ice statues.
At the same time, Luo Wushuang once again spurred the ancient tree roots, constraining Fairy Eternity's space to move and ensuring that the Lion's Roar and the breath of an ice dragon could hit Fairy Eternity.
"Such annoying roots, Hundred Grass Withering Fist!" Fairy Eternity muttered impatiently, throwing a terrifying punch. The moment the ancient tree roots touched Fairy Eternity's fist, they rapidly withered and lost their vitality.
Seeing this, Luo Wushuang quickly severed her connection with the ancient tree, but it was a step too slow. She felt her body drained of strength as if her power had been siphoned out. Lacking the energy to even stand, her legs gave in, and she slumped to the ground.
"What kind of move is that!?"
The Protector Lion formed by sound waves was about to touch Fairy Eternity when it suddenly trembled uncontrollably, as if encountering some terrifying existence. It couldn't maintain its form and burst into nothingness with a loud sound.
Everyone was confused, not knowing what Fairy Eternity had done.
Only Lu Yang, observing the fight from the Spiritual Space, could roughly guess the reason: Fairy Eternity had often eaten great demons in Ancient Times, and the great demons had etched this fear into their bloodlines.
If the Lion's Roar had not replicated a third of the true essence of the Protector Lion of Buddhism, it would not have been a problem, but once it did, revealing a third of the lion's true essence, it had to face the suppression of Fairy Eternity.
This was a suppressive force even more terrifying than the bloodline of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe.
In the blink of an eye, only Sun Chuanxian was left to face Fairy Eternity, and the others, fearing they might be accidentally harmed by his Ice Seals Thousands of Miles, didn't dare come close.
Around Sun Chuanxian, the temperature dropped to an extremely terrifying level, the air dried, and the ground condensed into ice—that was merely the residual power emitted by his pair of icy palms.
"Feeling great just by holding two chunks of ice?" Fairy Eternity scoffed. Suddenly, heat radiated around her, melting the ice on the ground. Her actions were elegant and light, like an ancient god tree that bore ten suns, with layers of flames bursting from the ground, turning it into a sea of fire.
"Fusang Tree Fist!"
This was also one of the Immortal Fist Techniques, allowing one to consider themselves as the Fusang Tree, with flames more terrifying than the Golden Crow.
Fairy Eternity danced among the flames, her movements graceful as if she were an Immortal male.
"Such beautiful movements!"
"I've heard that the lord of the Demon Nation, Venerate Zhu Tian, ascended through dance. Lu Yang's dance could probably compare with Venerate Zhu Tian at the Nascent Soul Stage."
"Why does this move look so effeminate?"
The onlookers had strange looks on their faces, if Lu Yang's previous combat was the epitome of masculinity, these current moves were as effeminate as they could get.
"It's probably something he learned from Daoist Buyu."
"Makes sense."
The crowd nodded in agreement, accepting this inference.
Sun Chuanxian was engulfed in a sea of flames and couldn't make out Fairy Eternity's position at all. Fairy Eternity only needed two punches to break through Sun Chuanxian's 'Thousand Miles of Ice'.
"Let's attack together!"
In the midst of Sun Chuanxian's defeat, the crowd finally stopped worrying about accidental harm and collectively took action.
Fairy Eternity's combat skills were incredibly exquisite, a level that even Lu Yang couldn't reach. Each punch and kick was delivered with perfect force, and she could even use one party's attack against another, the essence of borrowing force against force.
The crowd was extremely surprised; just moments ago, Lu Yang who had been suppressed in the fight now seemed valiant beyond measure, as if possessed by an immortal, unbeatable and unparalleled.
They realized that Lu Yang's combat power had escalated to a new level, making him even more difficult to deal with, so there was no need for them to hold back anymore.
"Nascent Soul out of the body!"
All the present cultivators were in the Nascent Soul Stage, any one of them, if taken out into the outside world, would be considered a formidable Nascent Soul old monster.
The young masters, each bearing the legacy of an influential family, had Nascent Souls each unique in its own way—metal, wood, water, fire, earth, ice, thunder, space, physical techniques, equipment techniques... it was like a hundred schools of thought contending, each with its own strength.
Lu Yang couldn't help but feel a cold sweat for Fairy Eternity.
It was Fairy Eternity fighting in his place, but it was his body that would suffer the injury.
"A bunch of inherently flawed Nascent Souls, no matter their number, it's all in vain," said Fairy Eternity, her tone light and breezy, still not taking everyone's Nascent Souls seriously.
"Today, you will witness my Invincible Nascent Soul!"
"Invincible Nascent Soul?"
The crowd was especially puzzled, as they had never heard of a Nascent Soul with that name.
Only Lu Yang, the person involved, was acutely aware of the changes happening inside his body, invisible to everyone else.
Fairy Eternity's consciousness entered the Dantian, disconnecting Lu Yang, and she personally subdued the Invincible Nascent Soul.
At the moment of disconnection, the Invincible Nascent Soul, sensing great danger, tried to flee, but Fairy Eternity would not give it the chance to escape.
Fairy Eternity caught the Invincible Nascent Soul by the legs, pinned it down in the Dantian and started beating it. Even though the Invincible Nascent Soul mastered numerous techniques and represented Lu Yang's theoretically strongest state, it couldn't withstand the attacks from Lu Yang's second Nascent Soul—the Immortal Fairy Nascent Soul.
The first Nascent Soul was no match for the second, and had to submit at the feet of the second.
"Appear!"
With a light shout from Fairy Eternity, a chubby white Nascent Soul flew out of the Dantian and appeared above Fairy Eternity's head.
The Invincible Nascent Soul bore a nine-tenth resemblance to Lu Yang and a tenth to Fairy Eternity. During his Golden Core Stage cultivation, Fairy Eternity had once aided Lu Yang, hence the slight resemblance to her.
But those unfamiliar with Fairy Eternity wouldn't notice it.
"Invincible Nascent Soul, go, take out their Nascent Souls!"

chapters.title: Chapter 837 - 836 Borrow Without Repaying
chapters.content:
Fairy Eternity had given a command, and Invincible Nascent Soul didn't dare to disobey.
The Invincible Nascent Soul produced a hundred-zhang Sword Qi, sweeping across the heroes, whipping up a sword wind that rustled the leaves incessantly, sounding so alarming that it made people's hearts panic.
"The Nascent Soul can actually wield such terrifying Sword Qi?" Witnessing this Sword Qi, everyone was shocked by Lu Yang's swordsmanship cultivation level and hurriedly controlled their own Nascent Souls.
Everyone, as if by agreement, chose to make their own Nascent Souls avoid the attack.
Unlike the Invincible Nascent Soul, ordinary Nascent Soul Stage cultivators couldn't fight automatically and needed to allocate a portion of their spiritual essence to battle.
This presented an opportunity for Fairy Eternity.
Seizing the moment when everyone was controlling their Nascent Souls, Fairy Eternity made a bold move; if she were a starving wolf, then these princely heirs and officials' children were merely a flock of little sheep—for the wolf amidst the sheep flock, anyone seen was attacked.
"Watch the fist!"
The Immortal Fist Technique appeared soft and gentle, yet it was filled with diverse changes and immense power.
"So this is indeed how Invincible Nascent Soul is supposed to be used. Fairy Eternity murmured to herself, "My guess was correct."
"Fairy, what did you say?" Lu Yang didn't hear what Fairy Eternity had said.
"Ah, it's nothing. I was saying that you need to focus on your cultivation and defeat your Invincible Nascent Soul as soon as possible."
"...Haven't I already defeated the Invincible Nascent Soul this way?" Lu Yang remembered Fairy Eternity saying she was his second Nascent Soul.
If the second Nascent Soul had defeated the first Nascent Soul, didn't that mean he also had defeated the first Nascent Soul?
"It can't be counted like that." Fairy Eternity was rarely so clear in her logic, explaining the reason to Lu Yang.
"You see, since I helped you defeat the Invincible Nascent Soul, it now follows my command, not yours."
"And since you must follow my command, you and the Invincible Nascent Soul are in a parallel relationship; there's no question of who commands whom."
Lu Yang understood that if he wanted to control the Invincible Nascent Soul, he had two options: either make Fairy Eternity listen to him, or defeat the Invincible Nascent Soul himself.
Compared to the two, the likelihood of the second method being successful seemed higher.
In reality, everyone was overwhelmed; the Invincible Nascent Soul's attack methods were too fierce. To prevent their own Nascent Souls from being injured, they had to concentrate on controlling them.
But once they concentrated on dealing with the Invincible Nascent Soul, no one was left to handle Fairy Eternity.
"Half of you deal with Lu Yang's Nascent Soul, and the other half deal with Lu Yang!" someone among them shouted, suggesting that to break the deadlock, they must unite their will and follow the command.
He was called Lin Zhongren, the son of the minister of the Ministry of Justice, not as outstanding as Zhong Yi and others, but also quite excellent among his peers in the Imperial City.
Now that Zhong Yi, Luo Wushuang, and Sun Chuanxian had been defeated in succession, and An Nan'er had been sitting next to Meng Jingyu with no intention of joining the battle, someone needed to step up and take charge.
Lin Zhongren came forth to command everyone, and they reluctantly accepted.
"Wait, where is Lu Yang's Nascent Soul!"
People were astonished to find that the Invincible Nascent Soul had vanished before their very eyes.
Suddenly, Lin Zhongren seemed to be hit by something and was sent flying, hanging from an ancient tree.
"It's Lu Yang's Nascent Soul; Lu Yang's Nascent Soul has turned invisible!" Someone with quick reactions guessed what Lu Yang's Nascent Soul had done.
Invincible Nascent Soul could use most of Lu Yang's moves, and during the Foundation Establishment Stage, Lu Yang had tried learning a technique called the Invisibility Charm, which only hid the body, not the clothes. Since its effects were rather limited, Lu Yang seldom used it.
But the Invincible Nascent Soul was different; it had no clothes to worry about, so the technique had nothing holding it back.
The Lin Zhongren, who wanted to take charge of the overall situation, was sent flying by the Invincible Nascent Soul, and chaos ensued again. Some people dealt with Fairy Eternity, while others looked for the Invincible Nascent Soul. In the meantime, anyone trying to take control of the crowd was also defeated by the Invincible Nascent Soul.
In the Spiritual Space, Lu Yang thought that to capture the thieves, one first captures the king, and it seemed that although the Invincible Nascent Soul lacked wisdom, it could still react most reasonably based on instinct.
The Invincible Nascent Soul, tossing out moves as if they cost nothing, simultaneously used "Swallow the Sky" to devour the spiritual essence of Luo Tian Forest.
Other people couldn't absorb spiritual essence nearly as fast as the Invincible Nascent Soul, and soon the spiritual essence of the forest was completely depleted, leaving everyone's own spiritual essence dwindling without any chance of replenishment.
Anyone who pulled out a Spirit Stone to absorb spiritual essence would also have it snatched away by the Invincible Nascent Soul.
From a distance, Meng Jingzhou who was watching the battle, smacked his thigh and exclaimed, "Old Lu's Nascent Soul is just like him, as if carved out of the same mold!"
Honestly, even he couldn't bring himself to do something so unscrupulous.
The Invincible Nascent Soul and Fairy Eternity created pressures both spiritual and physical. Even if some left the Nascent Soul alone and focused on challenging Fairy Eternity, it was futile. Fairy Eternity was too strong.
Fairy Eternity, striding like a tiger and prowling like a dragon, looked down upon the world. With one punch she topped another, "I've already said, you're no match for me."
"There is a great calamity between heaven and earth, and I was born in response to that calamity—destined by divine mandate. How could you commoners be my match?"
"However, considering you possess some minor talents, you might just qualify to be subjects of the Great Bean Dynasty."
Whether they were already on the ground or about to be, everyone was stunned by her last statement.
What the heck was the Great Bean Dynasty? They had never heard of it.
"The Great Bean Dynasty is a dynasty I am planning to establish, the rightful ruler of the world. You may address me as Empress Bean," Fairy Eternity declared.
This was the first time anyone had seen someone so brazenly declare their intention to establish a new dynasty.
She completely disregarded Great Xia.
This Lu Yang was really pushing his luck, his utter lawlessness even surpassed Daoist Buyu!
Lu Yang, with a pleading look, stared at the ceiling of the Spiritual Space, feeling his reputation was being harmed.
"Doesn't anyone wish to join my dynasty?" asked Fairy Eternity, somewhat disappointed. It seemed that only the Second-in-command wanted to join the Great Bean Dynasty.
A truly loyal subject.
With no will left to fight, everyone was violently defeated by Fairy Eternity and beat a hasty retreat.
Having recalled the Invincible Nascent Soul, Fairy Eternity stood with hands on her hips, exuberant with pride as she watched the retreating figures of the influential family heirs, laughing mockingly, "Humph, you're nowhere near my level in a fight!"
Inside the Spiritual Space, Lu Yang looked up ingratiatingly at Fairy Eternity, who sat high above, trying to negotiate.
"Your Majesty, look, the battle is over, and this body of your servant..."
But to Lu Yang's surprise, Fairy Eternity showed a look of wanting more, "This Imperial City seems quite fun. Xiao Yang, let's talk about it, can I continue using this body a bit longer?"
"Ah? That's... not very good," Lu Yang hesitated. If he let Fairy Eternity use his body again, how much worse could his reputation get?
Fairy Eternity, noticing Lu Yang's reluctance to lend his body, changed her approach, "Miss Yun promised me the position of Acting Sect Master for one year, and I've decided to use that opportunity now. As the Acting Sect Master, I now command you to surrender your body."
After returning from the East Sea, Yun Zhi thought Fairy Eternity had made a great contribution and could be Acting Sect Master for a year. At that time, Fairy Eternity had said she would use it later.
Lu Yang: "..."
So, Fairy, you kept the position of Acting Sect Master just to order me around in the future, didn't you?
"Your servant obeys," Lu Yang acquiesced.

chapters.title: Chapter 838 - 837: Lotus Pavilion
chapters.content:
Fairy Eternity again summoned the Invincible Nascent Soul to the Spiritual Space.
After being defeated by Fairy Eternity, the Invincible Nascent Soul no longer initiated combat upon seeing Lu Yang, evidently becoming much more docile.
"Little Nascent Soul, for now, listen to Xiao Yang's commands. Whatever he tells you to do, just do it."
"Xiao Yang, you should practice more with the Invincible Nascent Soul, after all, this pertains to your ascension to the Divinity Transformation Stage."
"It would be best not to order the Invincible Nascent Soul to lose to you. Cultivation is a matter where shortcuts should be avoided. It's wiser to stay grounded, to prevent any complications from arising later when you cultivate to higher levels."
The founding royal emperor taking a personal interest in the cultivation of his subject made evident the stature of this subject in the heart of the emperor.
Lu Yang nodded, indicating he understood.
Fairy Eternity, seeing how obedient Lu Yang was, felt a deep sense of satisfaction akin to that of a mentor.
After issuing her instructions to Lu Yang, Fairy Eternity prepared to experience the life in the Imperial City.
Meng Jingzhou arrived at Lu Yang's location first. He looked at Lu Yang with an odd expression, a bit hesitant, and tentatively called out, "Fairy Eternity?"
Fairy Eternity was startled, "How did you see through me?"
Her disguise was practically flawless; how could this Meng Family whelp have recognized her?
Immediately afterward, she whispered a caution, "Do not spread word. I'm currently the Acting Sect Master, and with the authority vested in that position, have temporarily possessed Lu Yang, wanting to come out and have some fun."
Meng Jingzhou felt secretly pleased, thinking Lu Yang, you had your days reigning as the Acting Sect Master, but did you ever foresee this day.
"The junior understands and will not disclose."
"Brother Lu, are you alright?" Meng Jingyu rushed over in a hurry, gripping Lu Yang's sleeve, showing great concern.
"Brother Lu, you looked so handsome fighting valiantly just now."
"Who would have thought you, little girl, would have such an eye for talent," Fairy Eternity, hearing Meng Jingyu complimenting her on being handsome, was quite pleased.
"In the future, if you encounter any troubles, I... I've got your back!" Initially, Fairy Eternity intended to refer to herself as "this Fairy," but then she thought better of it, remembering she was currently using Lu Yang's identity and needed to be cautious not to reveal her true self.
If Miss Yun were to find out she had exposed her identity, there would be no end to the nagging.
After numerous rounds of battle, the ancient trees in the Luo Tian Forest were left leaning haphazardly, the ground a chaotic mess as if a land dragon had churned it up. Having returned to the Meng Residence, Meng Jingzhou requested the help of a Family Elder to restore the Luo Tian Forest to its original state.
...
"Dad, I truly couldn't defeat that Lu Yang," said the Princely Heir to his father after returning home to report the results of the battle.
"It wasn't just me fighting him alone; dozens of people were attacking him at once, and none could overcome him. His Nascent Soul was staggeringly powerful. Even a gifted Divine Transformation Stage Cultivator couldn't produce such Sword Qi!"
"I don't know if Lu Yang is capable of multitasking or if his Nascent Soul has some other special trait, but it's as if there are two Lu Yangs, and his way of fighting is especially deceitful, often resorting to surprise attacks."
"There's a Nascent Soul like this?"
"Yes, I've never even heard of Lu Yang's Nascent Soul before; it must be something he created himself."
Hearing this, the father of the Princely Heir stroked his beard in contemplation, "Old Buyu's little disciple really does have a trick up his sleeve, even creating his own Nascent Soul.
Although unable to defeat Lu Yang, the Princely Heir felt that the battle in the Luo Tian Forest had been quite fruitful nonetheless.
However, this kind of satisfying gain was something the older generation couldn't understand, so there was no need to mention it.
...
"What the heck, Lu Yang beat all of you?" The Chief of Staff was utterly shocked upon hearing the news; his son was renowned for his strength, almost invincible within his own rank, yet how could the gap be so large?
Chief of Staff, disappointed like iron not turned to steel, poked Sun Chuanxian on the forehead, "Tell me, you always boast about how strong you are. Why do you falter at the critical moment?"
With a bitter expression, Sun Chuanxian replied, "Dad, you don't understand how powerful Lu Yang is. His swordsmanship is exceptional, his fist techniques are even stronger than his swordplay, and he is proficient in various magic skills. His Nascent Soul is also particularly powerful; I just can't compare with him at any point."
"Dad, why don't you lower your Realm and have a fight with him?"
The Chief of Staff of the Ministry of Works rolled his eyes; he wasn't foolish. The fact that he couldn't even beat Lu Yang's record of military achievements was apparent, and it would be more reasonable for him not to suppress his realm for battle.
...
After the battle in the Luo Tian Forest, the world once again felt the power of Lu Yang. He was seen as someone with the potential to attain immortality—destined to claim a place in the grand struggle of the Great Era.
Of course, Lu Yang himself was indifferent to this, for he was currently being beaten up by the Invincible Nascent Soul and had no time to care about how the outside world viewed him.
"Huff, huff—" Lu Yang gasped for air, warily watching the Invincible Nascent Soul.
He had by now indirectly taken control over the Invincible Nascent Soul; otherwise, the beating he received would have been even worse.
"Worthy of being my theoretically strongest state, it's really not easy to catch up."
The Invincible Nascent Soul represented the strongest state Lu Yang had achieved during his Nascent Soul period. To defeat the Invincible Nascent Soul, Lu Yang could only refine his skills to their optimal state.
Sparing with the Invincible Nascent Soul had provided Lu Yang with tremendous improvement.
In reality, Fairy Eternity had temporarily possessed Lu Yang's body, and she didn't always play around. During her leisure time, she also helped Lu Yang with his cultivation.
In the blink of an eye, the time had come for the Lantern Festival.
Meng Jingyu excitedly made a fuss about going out to have fun, insisting on bringing along Meng Jingzhou and Fairy Eternity.
"Brother Lu Yang, let's go out and have fun."
"Let's go," Fairy Eternity said excitedly, leaping up from the bed and interrupting her cultivation as soon as she heard there was fun to be had.
The Lantern Festival in the Imperial City was extraordinarily lively with every household decked out with bright lanterns and decorations. The streets were filled with joyous people, a sight that was pleasing to the eye.
"What place is that?" Fairy Eternity suddenly pointed at a tavern lit with red lanterns, sensing a strong aura of worldly desires emanating from it.
Meng Jingyu shook her head, not knowing what place it was; she had never been to such a place.
Meng Jingzhou explained with a strange look on his face, "That is the Lotus Pavilion, a stronghold the Seduction Sect has established in the Imperial City."
Fairy Eternity had some recollection of the Seduction Sect; she had even met the Seduction Sect's Supreme Elder, the Respected Thousand Charms, and didn't know whether she had returned to the Seduction Sect or continued to play the part of the wolf in sheep's clothing.
"And what exactly is the Lotus Pavilion for?" continued Fairy Eternity.
"The Lotus Pavilion is different from your typical brothel. It's run by disciples of the Seduction Sect, who offer their arts but not their bodies. The Seduction Sect's disciples are skilled in all sorts of arts, including the zither, chess, calligraphy, painting, poetry, and literary composition. Brother Lu, would you be interested in paying a visit?"
The person offering this explanation was not Meng Jingzhou, but someone else.
Meng Jingzhou turned his head and saw Zhong Yi standing beside them, gently waving a paper fan, the picture of elegance.
Meng Jingzhou's expression turned sour, "If I'm not mistaken, it's the Confucian Cultivators who usually visit the Lotus Pavilion, isn't it?"
Having no talent for literature, one risks embarrassing oneself in a place like the Lotus Pavilion.
Zhong Yi chuckled softly, using a slightly provocative gaze to look at both Meng Jingzhou and Lu Yang.
"What's the matter, didn't Daoist Buyu teach you poetry and literature? As his disciple, have you not learned a thing?"
"That sounds quite fun," said Fairy Eternity, intrigued. Such places didn't exist in the Ancient Times, "Little Sister Yun, shall we take a look inside?"
Meng Jingyu, who rarely had the chance to visit such a place, was also very interested.
"I want to go."
"Then let's go," Fairy Eternity said enthusiastically, grabbing Meng Jingyu's small hand, causing her little face to blush.
Fairy Eternity didn't feel there was anything inappropriate in doing so; she used to pull Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi along in the same way.
Zhong Yi's smile froze on his face. How could he be completely ignored?
"Completely disregarding my provocation, that's some deep scheming."

chapters.title: Chapter 839 - 838 Xiao Yang, Can You Write Poems?
chapters.content:
```
The Lotus Pavilion is quite famous among the literati and scholars of the Imperial City.
First, it has the backing of the Seduction Sect, a legitimate super-grade sect of the Righteous Path. Anyone who enters the Seduction Sect can rightfully be called a "Beauty," and the Sect places great importance on the Lotus Pavilion, seeing it as part of the disciples' cultivation journey. Thus, one can imagine the caliber of the beauties at the Lotus Pavilion.
Second, the courtesans of the Lotus Pavilion are indeed very talented, perhaps even more so than those of the Hanlin Academy. If one's literary work is recognized by the Lotus Pavilion, fame in the Imperial City soon follows.
Naturally, Fairy Eternity didn't care about this; she was just there for the spectacle.
Today is the Lantern Festival, and the Lotus Pavilion is even livelier than usual.
Inside the Lotus Pavilion, there isn't the heavy scent of rouge that one might find in a typical brothel; on the contrary, it more closely resembles a refined haven, like the peach garden of immortals, frequented by gentlemen and ladies.
There are also female cultivators in bright dresses flying in the sky, with long sashes swaying in the wind as they gently play the pipa, exuding a beauty reminiscent of an exotic Buddha Country.
Fairy Eternity also saw many individuals she had defeated in the Rotan Forest.
As for the young masters of the Imperial City, setting cultivation levels aside, they are certainly the most well-rounded in their skills. From a young age, they studied cultivation, Confucianism, and mastered both the literary and martial arts at private schools.
If they did not study the knowledge of Confucianism and learn a few verses of classical poetry, it would be embarrassing to only be able to say "Damn it, awesome" when encountering formidable individuals later in life.
The Lotus Pavilion is a respectable place; it doesn't indulge in the matters of the boudoir, so it is not unusual for women to visit as well.
Meng Jingyu's curiosity was no less than Fairy Eternity's; she looked enviously and curiously at the unique beauties.
"All the sisters are so pretty."
"Really?" Fairy Eternity didn't feel the same and thought the disciples of the Seduction Sect were rather plain. They couldn't rank among the ancient top ten beauties, let alone compare to herself, the foremost of the ancient top ten beauties.
"You, little girl, will surely grow up to be prettier than all of them," said Fairy Eternity sincerely. She often had a knack for judging people accurately, and she was particularly fond of this young girl who had complimented her fighting style as handsome. Fairy Eternity affectionately pinched Meng Jingyu's little nose, prompting a blushing Meng Jingyu to lower her head and hum a soft affirmative.
Just as he walked in, Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Isn't it a bit inappropriate for you, senior Fairy Eternity, to be using Lu Yang's face while speaking such cheesy words? It's a bit unsettling to watch.
In the Spiritual Space, where Lu Yang was sparring with the Invincible Nascent Soul, he temporarily stopped his cultivation, looking at Fairy Eternity with a strange expression.
Do you not understand the notion of gender differences, Fairy?
"Oh, Brother Lu is here too?" Luo Wushuang noticed Lu Yang's arrival at the Lotus Pavilion, his realm having recovered to the early stages of Spirit Transformation.
"Lu Yang is here?"
"The same Lu Yang who showed great power in the Rotan Forest?"
"Where is he?"
The battle in the Rotan Forest had only recently concluded, and the event was fresh in everyone's memories. Even those who hadn't participated had heard about it.
"The upstairs is quite lively," Fairy Eternity remarked, looking up to the highest floor of the Lotus Pavilion, where Luo Wushuang was standing by the railing, greeting her.
"Why not come up, Brother Lu? It is said that the true disciple of the Seduction Sect, Ye Mengyin, is cultivating here on the top floor," coaxed Zhong Yi, once again urging Lu Yang to go upstairs.
Fairy Eternity continued to ignore Zhong Yi, holding Meng Jingyu's little hand as they ascended the stairs.
Meng Jingzhou raised an eyebrow, sensing that Zhong Yi had ulterior motives, but could he dare stop an Immortal from ascending?
