"Brother Meng is here as well," greeted Luo Wushuang, who bowed and invited Meng Jingzhou and the others to join him at his table.
Compared to the time in the Rotan Forest, Luo Wushuang was dressed more fastidiously and formally at the Lotus Pavilion, exuding an even more dignified presence.
"What's this all about?" Meng Jingzhou observed the literary and scholarly figures filling the top floor of the Lotus Pavilion, where a female cultivator sat behind a layer of green gauze, playing the mandolin; the music tinkled, as if bathing in the spring breeze.
Luo Wushuang looked perplexed, "Doesn't Brother Meng know? I thought you, too, had come for Ye Mengyin."
Meng Jingzhou did know of Ye Mengyin, a beauty on par with Junior Sister Tao. During the previous Great Daoist Competition, Ye Mengyin represented the mid-stage Golden Core cultivators of the Seduction Sect against Meng Jingzhou.
Seeing that Meng Jingzhou truly was unaware, Luo Wushuang explained, "Ye Mengyin has been at the Lotus Pavilion for only half a month and has already become the Courtesan. People are willing to spend a fortune for just a glimpse of her."
"But she is a direct disciple of the Seduction Sect, rumored to have the protection of the esteemed Qianjiao. Such an individual wouldn't lack for Spirit Stones."
"Therefore, Ye Mengyin set a rule: whoever can compose poetry that satisfies her, will be granted an audience and a dance performed just for them."
```
The dance of Ye Mengyin is not only extraordinarily beautiful but also greatly beneficial for cultivation.
Luo Wushuang pursed her lips and gestured for Meng Jingzhou to look at the group of seated people, "See, it's already been five days and still, no one has produced a poem to her satisfaction."
"Today is the Festival of Lanterns, and Ye Mengyin has requested that the poems be related to the festival."
Not everyone who came here did so for the dance of Ye Mengyin, many were here to make a name for themselves in the Imperial City.
As they spoke, someone handed over their composed poem to a maid, who then passed it to Ye Mengyin behind the green gauze.
"Full moon, lanterns bright as day, Lantern Festival at the market's gate, Riddles hidden in laughter's sway, Sweet dumplings warm the throat, soft as silk's embrace."
Ye Mengyin read the poem in a soft voice and then continued playing her zither.
There was an uproar of laughter from the crowd; this was nothing more than a mediocre ditty, daring to show its face in the Lotus Pavilion.
The author of the poem fled in a panic.
Swish!
Zhong Yi snapped open his fan with great vigor and looked toward Lu Yang, saying softly with a laugh, "Brother Lu, as a disciple of Daoist Buyu, should be well-versed in poetry, shouldn't you try writing one?"
"After all, Daoist Buyu left behind several famous pieces right here in the Lotus Pavilion."
He was certain that Lu Yang was overflowing with talent in cultivation, but clueless about the scholarly arts of the Confucian cultivator; otherwise, why hadn't his name come up before this?
If Lu Yang's attempt at poetry failed, he would only serve as a source of mockery, becoming a laughingstock.
Fairy Eternity was puzzled, "Since when was I skilled at poetry?"
Zhong Yi was at a loss for words, not expecting Fairy Eternity to admit it so straightforwardly, rendering his plans for provocation useless.
"Since Brother Lu is too timid to try, then allow me to give it a shot?" the person behind Zhong Yi declared, looking at Fairy Eternity with slight contempt.
Only then did Fairy Eternity notice there was someone behind Zhong Yi.
Fairy Eternity pointed at the man, feigning a look of sudden realization, "Oh, I remember you, you were beaten by me in the Luo Heavenly Forest!"
His combat power was average at best, hardly leaving an impression.
Inside the Spiritual Space, Lu Yang could not help but introduce the man's identity to Fairy Eternity, "His name is Yang Changbin; his father is a scholar at the Hanlin Academy, and he himself is a Confucian cultivator. It's said that he wrote characters at three, poems at five, and by ten, he could write essays. His poetry and essays are quite renowned in the Imperial City."
Zhong Yi had brought Yang Changbin along especially to the Lotus Pavilion to write a poem. Seeing Lu Yang was also there, he planned to embarrass Lu Yang with poorly written poetry as a contrast to Yang Changbin's expertise.
Unfortunately for him, Lu Yang saw through his ruse and did not fall for it.
"It's Yang Changbin!"
"Damn, why did he have to come too!"
Yang Changbin's fame was even greater than Lu Yang had imagined; the crowd, seeing him, showed expressions of regret, as if just by his composing a poem, he would win the favor of a dance from Ye Mengyin.
Yang Changbin revealed a self-assured smile, having already thought of a poem related to the festival prompt before arriving.
He had someone fetch ink, brush, paper, and inkstone, wrote down a poem with swift, dragon-like strokes, and had a maid pass it on.
Behind the green gauze, Ye Mengyin once again stopped her zither playing to softly read the poem aloud, finishing with a rare critique.
"What a pity, while the words are beautiful, the overly ornate language has made it rather mediocre."
The crowd burst into laughter; they had all thought, after hearing Ye Mengyin read it, that it was an exemplary poem that would win her favor. Yet, they hadn't expected her to critique it so bluntly.
Yang Changbin, red-faced with anger and embarrassment, turned back, glaring at the crowd furiously, especially at Fairy Eternity, who was laughing the loudest.
"With Brother Lu's laughter so resounding, surely you have some ready work in your mind. Why not produce it for us all to see?"
Fairy Eternity scratched her head and hurriedly went into the Spiritual Space seeking help from her golden benefactor.
"Xiao Yang, can you write poetry?"
Lu Yang hesitated a little, "Writing poetry is quite a challenge for me, but if you're talking about reciting a few lines to make a show, I do have some."

chapters.title: Chapter 840 - 839: Becoming a Scribe in a Cultivation World
chapters.content:
```
"Well, Brother Lu, if you can't come up with anything, there's no need to force it. Just admitting it would suffice," sneered Yang Changbin upon seeing Fairy Eternity deep in thought, certain that Lu Yang couldn't produce a poem.
Meng Jingzhou wanted to write poetry, but the problem was that he genuinely didn't know how. The best he could muster resembled mere doggerel.
Meng Jingyu stared eagerly at Fairy Eternity, tugging at her sleeve in concern. She could tell that Zhong Yi and Yang Changbin were deliberately targeting her brother Lu.
Luo Wushuang frowned, feeling that Yang Changbin was going a bit too far.
"If I must write, then write I shall," declared Fairy Eternity, pulling out the Four Treasures of the Study from her Identity Jade and quickly penned a poem.
"That fast?" Yang Changbin's frown deepened. It was almost as if she had the poem premeditated, her pen flying across the paper without a moment's hesitation.
An ominous feeling arose without warning; perhaps Lu Yang truly was a master of the Confucianism Path.
The maid took the poem and handed it to Ye Mengyin behind the green gauze.
Ye Mengyin noticed the movement before the green gauze and, upon hearing that Yang Changbin had challenged Lu Yang to compose a poem, was prepared to bail Lu Yang out. However, to her surprise, Lu Yang was actually able to craft verses on the spot.
She glanced over the short lines, her expression shifting to one of shock; her hands trembled uncontrollably with excitement. Was this really a poem Friend Lu Yang composed on the spot?
She had been ready for Lu Yang's poetry to fall short, even preparing to write and recite the verses for him.
She had never expected Friend Lu Yang to possess such remarkable talent.
"Miss?" A maid noticed Ye Mengyin's reaction and reminded her in a whisper.
Ye Mengyin, as if waking from a dream, regained her composure and steadied her spirit, ready to recite the poem.
"Why hasn't Daoist Ye begun the reading?" Zhong Yi raised an eyebrow. This was an unprecedented occurrence, and everyone was curious.
Just then, from behind the green gauze, came the clear voice of Ye Mengyin: "Green Jade Case on Yuanxiao..."
Everyone quieted down, eager to hear whether Lu Yang had written a mere doggerel or a fine piece.
"The east wind unfurls flowers on a thousand branches. And blows down stars like falling rain. The scent of fine steeds and ornate carriages fills the street. As the sounds of phoenix flutes stir the air, the light of the jade flask shifts, and for one night dragon and phoenix dance."
Silence filled the air.
All present were immersed in the imagery of the verses, unable to extricate themselves: "For one night, dragon and phoenix dance… With just a few short lines, the splendor of Yuanxiao is depicted so vividly."
There were indeed many poems describing Yuanxiao scenery, but to so instantly captivate with a mere handful of lines had been unheard of for centuries.
Some cast stealthy glances at Yang Changbin; regardless of how the latter half turned out, the exquisitely descriptive artistry of the opening alone put it streets ahead of Yang Changbin's overly ornate composition.
Yang Changbin's complexion turned ashen. He had not expected that his carefully prepared poem would be overshadowed by Lu Yang's spontaneous work.
He let out a derisive snort. What did it matter if the first half was well written? If the latter half proved mediocre, it would ruin the entire poem.
Meng Jingzhou, on the other hand, wasn't too surprised. After all, an Ancient Immortal capable of anything would have no trouble composing a few lines of excellent poetry.
Meng Jingyu admired Fairy Eternity with a sense of reverence, finding her increasingly impressive.
Could Brother Lu, with his high talent in cultivation and combat, also excel so in poetry and prose?
From behind the green gauze, Ye Mengyin softly read the latter half.
"Moths in snow willows, threads of gold. Silent laughter slips away with a faint fragrance. In the crowd, I search for him a thousand times over. Then suddenly, turning my head, that man is there… in the dim light of fading lanterns."
As she read the last line, Ye Mengyin gazed dreamily at it; having only skimmed it previously, she had not appreciated the meaning within the words. But as she read it aloud before everyone, she gradually discerned Lu Yang's intent.
"That man is there in the dim light of fading lanterns." Could this line be meant for her...?
Utter silence prevailed.
```
After listening to the second verse, someone who was about to drink tea froze with their arm in mid-air, holding the teacup, unable to bring it to their lips for a long time.
Many others turned their heads in shock to look at Fairy Eternity, their faces brimming with disbelief.
If the first verse's description of beautiful scenery was a rare and exquisite phrase, then the second verse elevated this piece of poetry to an even higher level.
A phrase for the ages!
Once this verse was recited, it outshone all through the ages, and any other poem depicting the Lantern Festival paled in comparison. There was simply no chance of surpassing it!
Yang Changbin had intended to find fault in the second verse to embarrass Lu Yang, but when Ye Mengyin recited it, his mouth opened, yet he was rendered speechless, ultimately closing it in dismay.
He didn't even have the qualification to critique this poem.
"Why are you all looking at me?"
Fairy Eternity turned to Meng Jingyu next to her, meeting her gaze, puzzled by everyone's intense reaction and feeling somewhat baffled.
Meng Jingyu was still immersed in the verse "I searched for him thousands of times in the crowd, then turned back unexpectedly, and there he was, at the place where the lights were dim," and her heart began to beat uncontrollably as she locked eyes with Fairy Eternity.
Was this using poetry to express love, could it be that Brother Lu had been looking for her all along?
"Very good, I had no idea that Brother Lu indeed received the true teachings of Daoist Buyu, to be able to compose such a timeless masterpiece!" Zhong Yi had planned to use this opportunity to make Lu Yang appear foolish, but he didn't expect Lu Yang to have hidden his depth so well.
Previously, Lu Yang had only shown his identity as a Cultivation genius, never revealing his Confucian Cultivator identity.
Zhong Yi considered himself to be quite scheming, but if he possessed such talent, he certainly would have been unable to conceal it, and would have become renowned worldwide for it long ago, rather than waiting until today.
And the provocations he had made several times before — Lu Yang hadn't been fooled by any of them.
Zhong Yi looked at Lu Yang with a hint of fear in his eyes, realizing that opposing someone with such a profound and unfathomable mind would surely spell misfortune for himself!
"This is called not being proficient in poetry?" Luo Wushuang recalled what Lu Yang had just said, and watched him with a mixture of laughter and tears. If this is considered not proficient, then no one in the world would dare to claim to be a poet or lyricist.
"Just learned it," Fairy Eternity chuckled and scratched the back of her head.
She had seen such expressions on people's faces before, when she took Xiao Ling and Lianyi out to play the fool to catch the wise.
She never expected that the poem composed for her by Second-in-command would have a similar effect.
"Xiao Yang, you're amazing!" In the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity excitedly looked at Lu Yang, feeling such sensations for the first time in a long while.
"Hmm, Xiao Yang, what is that expression?"
Lu Yang looked strange, having anticipated everyone's reactions.
He sighed, "Nothing, I just didn't expect that my identity could also be used this way."
Lu Yang truly didn't expect that one day he would be able to show off pretending to be an official scholar, even though it was Fairy Eternity using his identity to do so.
Fairy Eternity didn't quite understand what Lu Yang meant.
"Your identity?"
She remembered Lu Yang often saying that she was supposed to be the golden finger, like a living grandfather or grandmother by his side.
She asked Lu Yang what he meant, and he explained it was like residing in the Spiritual Space, able to use knowledge to help the master of the body show off.
Realizing this, Fairy Eternity had an epiphany, "Oh, I get it, so according to your terminology, Xiao Yang, your current identity is like a 'pocket-sized little old man'!"
Lu Yang: "..."
I help you show off, Fairy, and this is how you repay me?

chapters.title: Chapter 841 - 840: Can't Jump to Save His Life
chapters.content:
The old youngster Lu Yang was pondering a serious question.
As a transmigrator with modern knowledge, not only had he become a disciple of the top sect in the world, but he had also become the top-ranked junior brother, hosting an ancient immortal in his body, and was friends with the highest-status young master. His cultivation talent was among the top of his generation, with hardly a few to rival him throughout history.
So why was it never his turn to show off?
…
"I invite Daoist Lu Yang to come in for a chat," came Ye Mengyin's voice from behind the blue gauze.
No one was surprised. If Lu Yang's poem couldn't satisfy Ye Mengyin, then it wasn't their problem, but rather that the Lotus Pavilion deliberately didn't want to entertain them.
Fairy Eternity, amid the envious and admiring gazes of those present, lifted the blue gauze and saw Ye Mengyin, who hadn't shown her face for several days.
Fairy Eternity had some impression of Ye Mengyin. After all, she had organized the 120,000th anniversary celebration of the Seek Dao Sect.
In the Imperial City, rumors spread of Ye Mengyin's irresistible charm and beauty that could capture hearts at first sight. Ye Mengyin indeed lived up to her reputation, being so stunning that her natural coquettishness and every little movement had their own grace, even surpassing Tao Yaoye and Lan Ting in seductive power.
But Fairy Eternity felt none of this allure—Ye Mengyin wasn't even as beautiful as herself.
Ye Mengyin, meeting Fairy Eternity's clear gaze, was rather shocked. Her allure affected even her fellow senior and junior sisters, and Meng Jingzhou's ability to defeat her last time relied on his willpower.
This was the first time someone looked at her with such clarity as Lu Yang.
"Daoist Lu Yang, it's been a while. Would you care to step into to side room for a conversation?" Ye Mengyin asked, her cheeks flushed. It was her first time inviting a male cultivator into her boudoir.
They were separated from the others by only a layer of blue gauze. Their voices and movements were clearly observed by everyone present, leaving no room for privacy.
"Sure," Fairy Eternity agreed without overthinking, readily accepting the invitation.
In the boudoir, with a spot of cinnabar between her brows and wearing a radiant, flowing long dress embroidered with intricate patterns of apsaras and auspicious clouds in vibrant colors, and her skirt fluttering with her dance moves while her hair swayed in the breeze, Ye Mengyin seemed even more lively.
Watching this dance was greatly beneficial for one's mind state in cultivation.
"Your dancing is not good," Fairy Eternity couldn't help but criticize. This level of dancing was too poor, far from Zhu Tian's standard.
"Dancing should be an expression of the heart, and look at you, your moves are all stiff and rigid, lacking spiritual energy."
"Come, follow me."
Fairy Eternity herself demonstrated, her movements light and ethereal, like a stunning fairy stepping out of an ancient painting, every frown and smile exuding an indescribable charm, a dance that Ye Mengyin, who only relied on her coquettishness, couldn't begin to compare with.
Ye Mengyin was stunned. Elder Brother Lu Yang could dance?
She had entered the path through dance and possessed the highest dancing talent within the Seduction Sect, otherwise she wouldn't have qualified to represent her sect in the Seek Dao competition.
Ye Mengyin had thought that among her peers, no one could surpass her in dancing.
Turns out, among the female cultivators, indeed there wasn't anyone, but among the male cultivators, there was one.
"Could Daoist Buyu actually be adept at dancing?" Ye Mengyin recalled the rumors about Daoist Buyu and hadn't heard anything about dancing skills.
Although Fairy Eternity danced gracefully and beautifully, she was currently using Lu Yang's body, which looked quite awkward from the outside.
Luckily, Ye Mengyin truly loved dance and didn't mind the odd dissonance of Lu Yang's appearance, earnestly learning from Fairy Eternity.
"Ah, that's better. You need to comprehend the meaning behind the dance, not just copy the moves."
Fairy Eternity was actually even more skilled at dancing than Zhu Tian. Both Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi had learned from her, but she was self-conscious about her status. During gatherings of immortals in ancient times, she would let Zhu Tian perform, content to just watch from the side.
Although Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi had learned the dance, when it came to innate talent for dance, they still couldn't match Zhu Tian.
In the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity, with jewels and gold adorning her hair and her hairdo elegantly coiffed, with vermillion eyeshadow at the corners of her eyes and donned in a robe of bright yellow, danced gracefully in the great hall, every inch of her skin from her jet-black hair tips to her rounded, jade-like toes brimming with vibrant energy.
Fairy Eternity had not danced for a long time, and she needed to dance in sync in the Spiritual Space and reality to regain the sensation.
Lu Yang watched Fairy Eternity's dance, absorbed in thought about which historical minister had the privilege of seeing the monarch dance.
After the dance, Ye Mengyin was out of breath and panting, yet her smile was bright and joyous.
She could feel her significant progress in the art of dance.
"Many thanks to Elder Brother Lu Yang for the instruction!" She bowed earnestly, not daring any negligence.
With this guidance, she saved ten years of arduous cultivation - addressing him as "Honored Master" would not be too much.
However, she was still puzzled about the last phrase Lu Yang spoke, "But the one was at the place where the lights were waning." What did it really mean? Was it truly written for her? If it was meant for her, it didn't seem quite right given what followed after entering the boudoir.
Could it be that Elder Brother Lu Yang was disappointed with her because of her lack of dance talent?
Ye Mengyin grew more convinced of this possibility the more she thought about it.
...
The words created by Fairy Eternity at the Lotus Pavilion quickly spread throughout the Imperial City, shocking even the great Confucian Cultivators of the Hanlin Academy.
A good poem could not only make one famous for generations, but more importantly, it could become a means of cultivation for Confucian Cultivators.
"This poem is even better than the ones made by Old Buyu by quite a margin. It seems Lu Yang's learning doesn't just depend on Old Buyu; his innate talent for Confucian cultivation is also incredibly astounding!"
"Magic skills, Sword Cultivators, Confucian Cultivators... His talent surpasses even that of Old Buyu. The outside world spreads word that he has the potential to become an immortal, and it seems the rumors are true."
"Pay attention to this line in the second part of the poem 'I searched for him in the crowd, time and again. Suddenly turning around, the one was there, at the place where the lights were waning.' People outside say it was written for a young girl from the Seduction Sect, but I have a different opinion."
"Why not share your thoughts, Elder Brother Zeng?"
"You must have heard numerous rumors about Lu Yang. Have you ever heard any involving love affairs? Not even once, right? This indicates that Lu Yang might be indifferent to such matters, and this poem isn't as superficial as the world believes."
"Under this major premise, if we look at the phrase, 'The one was at the place where the lights were waning,' 'the one' might very well refer to himself!"
"The meaning of this line, then, is that Lu Yang underwent untold hardships in his cultivation, seeking something he could never find, and finally had an epiphany, realizing that what he sought was truly his own heart!"
"I've seen too many cultivators who have lost their way and their hearts after embarking on the path of cultivation. Even though they have achieved some progress, they seem lost and confused, resulting in a lack of power for further advancement."
"Knowing others is wisdom but knowing oneself is enlightenment. By incorporating his cultivation insights into this poem, Lu Yang aims to awaken many cultivators, prompting them to introspect and to overcome the barriers within their hearts."
"Wow, it does seem to be the case."
...
The residence of the Second Prince.
The Second Prince, staring intently at the intelligence in his hand, had a gleam in his eye.
"Securing the throne will require Lu Yang's assistance. It's time to make contact with him."

chapters.title: Chapter 842 - 841: Great Foolishness Masquerades as Wisdom
chapters.content:
The Second Prince did not find the Immortal Herbs that could extend one's lifespan in the East Sea.
But this did not affect his plan.
If he could find the Immortal Herbs in the East Sea and prolong the Emperor's life, his own stature in the Emperor's heart would rise, and he might even surpass his elder brother and be designated as Crown Prince.
If he failed to find the Immortal Herbs, it would still be fine, since the Emperor would see his filial piety. Compared to his elder brother, who did nothing, this was still a point in his favor.
Besides, going to the East Sea was truly dangerous, with the battle between two Immortals in the Dragon Palace. A slight repercussion and he would have died an untimely death. Having gone through such a perilous situation, the Emperor could not possibly remain indifferent.
Therefore, whether he found the Immortal Herbs or not was not important. What was important was that he had gone to the East Sea.
Even so, after he returned and waited a year, as the Emperor's health progressively declined, the appointment of a successor was still not announced, which made him somewhat anxious.
It was then that Lu Yang arrived at the Imperial City, and through the acquaintances from the East Sea, he invited Lu Yang to his residence for a chat, to connect emotionally, and for Lu Yang to help him ascend the throne—all of which seemed quite natural.
Very few knew that the Second Prince was a person of meticulous thoughts.
...
"Hmm, the second son of the Xia Family wants to invite this Fairy over?" Fairy Eternity received the invitation and found that the Imperial City was indeed bustling. She received invitations every day. Apart from the second son of the Xia Family's, there were also numerous poets and scholars' invites following one another, all of them inviting her to write poetry.
She rejected them all according to Lu Yang's advice.
"Your Majesty, you should call him the Second Prince," Lu Yang reminded her. Calling him the second son of the Xia Family in front of the Second Prince would mean waiting for a grimace from him.
"Oh, alright then." Fairy Eternity was a qualified Emperor, open to advice and amenable. Whatever Lu Yang suggested, she listened to it.
"Then let's go to the second son of the Xia Family's place." Fairy Eternity liked lively places, and the invitation said that the second son of the Xia Family would host a banquet for Lu Yang.
"Let's also call on Old Meng. He's more familiar with affairs in the Imperial City, so we won't be completely in the dark when we get to the second son of the Xia Family... the Second Prince's house," Lu Yang said, nearly slipping up and continuing with Fairy Eternity's designation.
Meng Jingzhou furrowed his brow upon learning that the Second Prince intended to host a banquet for Lu Yang. Based on his understanding of the Second Prince, this banquet was likely not going to be as simple as just having a meal.
However, since the Immortal wanted to go, he didn't dare to stop her. If any issues arose, he would just step in to shield the Immortal.
This time, Meng Jingzhou did not bring Meng Jingyu; this kind of occasion was not suitable for Meng Jingyu to attend.
The Second Prince's banquet was scheduled for three days later. After three days, Fairy Eternity went to the banquet accompanied by Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou.
The Second Prince placed great importance on Lu Yang. On the day of the banquet, he personally greeted Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou at the entrance.
He saw them from a distance, hurried over, and with a warm but appropriate smile, he greeted them with a bow, "Gentlemen, since we parted in the East Sea, it has been a year since we last met, and I have missed you dearly."
Meng Jingzhou maintained a similar smile and returned the greeting with a bow, "Your Highness, the Prince, is too kind."
"Please, come inside."
"Please."
The purpose of the Second Prince's banquet was to welcome and catch up with Lu Yang. Now that the key guest had arrived, the banquet naturally started as expected.
Perhaps worried that the banquet would not be lively enough, the Second Prince also invited many young nobles. Lu Yang knew a small portion of them, but he had never seen even more of them, meaning that the young nobles the Second Prince had invited were not all of his peers.
As the three took their seats, the Second Prince initiated conversation, "I have long heard that Cultivator Lu Yang has arrived in the Imperial City. Unfortunately, I have been busy with official duties and could not entertain Cultivator Lu Yang. Today, I have finally found some free time to welcome and refresh Cultivator Lu Yang, and I hope you do not take offense."
"Cultivator Lu Yang has made quite a name for himself in the Imperial City, not only defeating all peer geniuses but also composing a poem at Lotus Pavilion that won universal acclaim. Even the great scholars of the Imperial Academy praised your composition, proclaiming that your poem possesses the ability to enlighten and reveal truth."
"Come, let me introduce these gentlemen to you."
"This is the grandson of the Minister of the Treasury, Hong Guanshan."
"This is the son of the chief historian of the Great Marshal's residence, Kong De."
"This is..."
The Second Prince introduced them one by one, while Hong Guanshan and others wore arrogant smiles, taking pride in their own identity.
Fairy Eternity merely nodded politely. She was not interested in the identities of these people, and terms like 'Minister of the Treasury' were also unknown to her.
Meng Jingzhou listened by the side, his expression changing subtly. Fairy Eternity might not understand what these people represented, but he certainly did.
These people were involved in all aspects of Great Xia: the military, finances, the security of Imperial City, and so forth. If they could all be utilized by the Second Prince, it would be an extremely formidable force.
This was the Second Prince introducing to Lu Yang just how many people supported him.
Fairy Eternity, growing impatient with the introductions, finally couldn't help but ask, "Why do you always have to mention their fathers and grandfathers when introducing them? Are they not well-known by themselves?"
"When I introduce myself, as long as I say I am Lu Yang, everyone knows who I am without saying anything else."
As these words were spoken, the smiles on the faces of Hong Guanshan and the others became stiff, striking a nerve.
Merely at a glance, he had made them feel utterly self-conscious. This ability to discern the truth was truly terrifying. No wonder the Second Prince was so eager to win over Lu Yang!
"And what does their status have to do with me?" Fairy Eternity asked, puzzled. She didn't care what these people were called, let alone who their fathers and grandfathers were.
She would rather the introductions be finished quickly and the banquet begin without delay.
Moved by this development, the Second Prince didn't believe for a moment that Lu Yang didn't understand the introductions. Lu Yang said he didn't care about their status. Was he implying that he didn't want to join this imperial power struggle?
Seeing this, the Second Prince simply stopped introducing his own supporters and started the banquet, following Lu Yang's lead.
The banquet proceeded normally with dancing girls for entertainment, toasts made amid laughter, and revelry with wine.
The dancers were graceful, but next to Ye Mengyin, they paled in comparison, and compared to Fairy Eternity, they were not even worthy to carry her shoes. Fairy Eternity wasn't much interested in dancing.
"Put on a show with Zhu Tian, and that might be worth watching."
Fairy Eternity wasn't too fond of drinking. She remembered the Time Immortal soaking his body in a vat of Immortal Wine, the aroma overpowering, causing even Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivators to feel dizzy and as if they were in the land of immortals upon just a whiff.
At that time, Qilin Immortal and Immortal Jiuchong faced the wine vat and drank, acting like drunken fools afterward, in a most unseemly display.
Fairy Eternity, considering herself one of the top ten beauties of ancient times, felt she needed to maintain her status and could not engage in such undignified behavior, so she was somewhat resistant to wine.
"Oh, Xiao Yang, would you like to see the scene of Qilin Immortal and Immortal Jiuchong acting like drunken fools? I have the images retained," she offered.
Upon hearing this, Lu Yang quickly shook his head. Such a sight was a death sentence for anyone who watched; he preferred to live a little longer.
The Second Prince got thoroughly drunk, and, under the influence of the wine, he approached Lu Yang and began to pour out his woes.
"Lu Yang, my friend, my heart aches."
"The Emperor's time is running short, yet the succession remains undecided. My elder brother claims he has no desire to cling to the throne, but in the royal family, there are no true affections—who can say for sure?"
"And there are the fourth and fifth brothers, claiming indifference toward the throne, yet they prepare in secret."
The Second Prince shook his head and sighed, his voice filled with genuine sorrow, "The winds of change are unpredictable in Imperial City. You, being an outsider, see it all most clearly. Tell me, who in the end shall seize the throne?"
The people indulging in the feast overheard the Second Prince's drunken words and pretended to discuss among themselves while they secretly observed Lu Yang's reaction.
His Highness was using the wine to speak frankly, wanting to know if Lu Yang would join their camp.
Meng Jingzhou's expression changed subtly, realizing this as well. If the response were to be careless, it might drag both the Meng Family and the Seek Dao Sect into the competition for the throne!
And both the Meng Family and the Seek Dao Sect had always maintained a neutral stance, not taking part in the struggle for the throne!
Such a precedent could not be set!
Lu Yang also realized this was the Second Prince's true purpose in inviting him over.
He was being forced to take sides!
His response had to be cautious not to give the Second Prince any opening.
Just as Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou were both considering how to reply, Fairy Eternity interjected with a surprised expression and asked:
"Does it mean that I get to decide who becomes the Emperor?"

chapters.title: Chapter 843 - 842: We Should Learn More from the Fairy
chapters.content:
```
Fairy Eternity had thought that establishing her own Great Soy Dynasty would be quite an endeavor, such as requiring her and Miss Yun to take action, overthrowing the Great Xia Dynasty, and establishing a new dynasty.
Considering that overthrowing Great Xia was not something that could be resolved through force alone and would likely meet with considerable resistance, Fairy Eternity had always been too lazy to create the Great Soy Dynasty in the outside world.
Who would have thought that the royal family of Great Xia would be so agreeable, allowing whomever she wanted to become the emperor to assume the throne.
She was now the Acting Sect Master of the Seek Dao Sect, the Master of the Heavenly Court, and soon to be the founding emperor of the Great Soy Dynasty. Being the leader of the three most powerful entities in the world was a privilege she had not even enjoyed during the Ancient Times.
She would say, where in the world are there so many conniving plots? Look, everyone is a good person.
Lu Yang looked at Fairy Eternity with astonishment and disbelief. Fairy, was your intelligence all just for show before?
"Xiao Yang, why are you always looking at me?" Fairy Eternity asked, puzzled by the sight of Lu Yang. It was the first time she had seen the second-in-command with such a shocked expression.
"It's nothing, I just think the Fairy is very smart."
"Of course I am smart." Although she didn't understand why the second-in-command had suddenly said this, Fairy Eternity was nonetheless happy to hear Lu Yang praise her intelligence.
In reality, Meng Jingzhou admired Fairy Eternity's response immensely. Truly worthy of being an Immortal, not only is her cultivation level revered since ancient times, but her emotional intelligence is also extraordinarily high, leaving others in the dust.
In contrast, Lu Yang had the Immortal by his side all these years and had learned nothing, spending his days plotting against himself.
You should learn a thing or two in the Spiritual Space!
Upon hearing Fairy Eternity's reply, everyone's expressions changed, admiring her sharp response. She skillfully avoided answering the question and even ensnared the Second Prince!
The Second Prince was at a loss whether to say "Lu Yang decides" or "Lu Yang does not decide."
To say he decides is to commit a severe crime worthy of death; to say he does not decide is to imply that Lu Yang is useless, and the Second Prince would lose face trying to associate with him.
Such scheming, such calculation, coupled with her formidable cultivation level, no wonder she is called the number one among the younger generation!
Even Daoist Buyu at his young age could not achieve this level!
Fortunately, the Second Prince was meticulous in his thinking. Although startled by Fairy Eternity's response, he continued to feign drunkenness, which would give him an excuse to deny responsibility if something happened later.
Suddenly, Fairy Eternity added, "If you don't know who should be emperor, then I will become the emperor. Would you like to seek a position under me?"
The Second Prince immediately broke out in a cold sweat and dared not pretend to be drunk anymore.
If he kept up the act, who knows what kind of treasonous words Lu Yang might utter next.
It was said that when Lu Yang was in the Luo Heavenly Forest, he had boasted of his desire to create the Great Soy Dynasty, and now he was bringing up the topic again.
Could it be that he had anticipated his own actions back in the Luo Heavenly Forest? What terrifying foresight.
Some jokes, Lu Yang can make, but he cannot.
Who is Lu Yang? He is the next Sect Leader of the Seek Dao Sect, highly valued by the Semi-Immortal Yun Zhi. During his disappearance in the East Sea, the Vast Sea Daoist Lord personally came looking for him, which shows how much importance the Vast Sea Daoist Lord places on Lu Yang, not to mention that Lu Yang had saved the life of a Dragon Clan Ancestor.
The future Immortal Sect Master and someone who has extremely close relationships with three Semi-Immortals, no one can match his status or background.
As long as Lu Yang is just talking and not truly plotting rebellion, who would dare to take action against him?
Not even the emperor dares.
"Prince Lu Yang was just making a joke," the Second Prince did not dare to continue the conversation. If he kept going along with it, it wasn't just his chance to inherit the throne that would be in jeopardy, but his current position as the prince would be at risk as well.
The Second Prince looked at Fairy Eternity with a hint of reverence. This was the first time he had encountered a genius whose mind was even more meticulous than his own.
Indeed, there is always someone higher, and a heaven above heavens.
Fairy Eternity didn't understand why everyone looked at her with reverence. Was it because she was about to become the emperor?
```
It seemed to make sense.
The Second Prince changed the subject and, pointing at the dancers, said, "Does Friend Lu Yang have any interest in these dancers? If you're interested, you can take them all back with you. Intercourse Cultivation with them could even increase your Cultivation Level."
"What do I need them for?"
Seeing Lu Yang's refusal, the Second Prince wasn't surprised; with Ye Mengyin, the bright pearl, as a precedent, these dancers indeed wouldn't catch his eye.
He clapped his hands, and a procession of attendants carrying trays filed out from a smaller room. Each tray held a variety of rare treasures and secret Cultivation Techniques that were very helpful for cultivation. Any one of these items, if taken out, would qualify as the final auction item at an auction, and even the other invited guests coveted these objects with a burning gaze.
His Highness had truly spared no expense.
"I felt a kindred spirit when I first met Friend Lu Yang, so I prepared some modest gifts. I ask that you, Friend Lu Yang, accept them and not look down upon them," he said.
Fairy Eternity truly looked down on them; with just a glance, she recognized the origins of these items, which were of no help to her. In fact, the stones at the entrance of her Abode were more valuable than these items.
But on second thought, these items were not for her use; they were for Lu Yang's use.
Then there was indeed some help in them.
These treasures were carefully prepared by the Second Prince for Lu Yang, with the intent of making this connection. If Lu Yang accepted these items, it would imply he was inclined to stand on his side.
Very anxiously, the Second Prince observed Lu Yang's reactions in secret.
"For free?" Fairy Eternity thought, Imperial City sure has a lot of good people.
"Naturally," the Second Prince nodded and said with a smile.
"Then I'll not be polite, thank you."
The head attendant took out a Storage Ring, collected all the items from the trays into the Storage Ring, and presented it with both hands.
Seeing Fairy Eternity accept the Storage Ring, the Second Prince's smile deepened.
It seems that all the previous talk was because she didn't want to be tested.
Even if she didn't support him in the future after accepting these treasures, she wouldn't oppose him either.
What free gifts? No reward without merit—how could there be anything given for free in this world? Everything comes at a price.
"Fairy, you shouldn't take these things," Lu Yang said with slight concern from within the Spiritual Space. If it had been him, he wouldn't have accepted anything from the Second Prince.
"Hmm? Why can't I take them?" Fairy Eternity didn't understand why her golden finger was so anxious.
"By accepting the gifts, it's as if you've taken a side."
"Taken a side? What side?"
"Eating from someone's hand softens the mouth, accepting someone's generosity obliges you to do their bidding," Lu Yang tried to explain in plain terms.
"Didn't I confirm beforehand? They were just giving it for free," Fairy Eternity replied, always meticulous and thorough in her actions.
"What if you become enemies in the future? Would you lay a hand on the Second Prince then?"
"Of course, I would," Fairy Eternity found the Second-in-command's question utterly nonsensical.
"Moreover, it's not like I took it for nothing. I did say thank you, after all."
Lu Yang: "..."
Maybe I'm being thin-skinned; should I learn from Fairy on how to be more thick-skinned?

chapters.title: Chapter 844 - 843: So Emperor Xia Holds Such a High Status
chapters.content:
After returning to the Meng Residence, Meng Jingzhou found his father and detailed the events that had occurred at the Second Prince's official residence.
Upon hearing this, Meng Potian was not surprised by the Second Prince's efforts to win over Lu Yang.
He looked at Lu Yang with a smile, "Among the nine princes, it's not only the Second Prince who wants to make contact with Little Lu. It seems he is the first one who couldn't restrain himself, which is normal, considering his usual inability to remain composed."
"Not just him?" Meng Jingzhou was surprised, it turned out Old Lu was quite popular.
"Since the Crown Prince is not very keen on succeeding to the throne, it's inevitable that some princes become interested in it. According to the intelligence we've gathered, the Fourth Prince and Fifth Prince are also willing to compete for it."
"Is the throne really that attractive?" Meng Jingzhou thought to himself that the throne was useless; he wouldn't want it even if it were offered to him.
Meng Potian glanced at his son and Lu Yang. They were all family, so there was nothing he couldn't say, "That is the throne, bearing the State Destiny, carrying the will of countless people, the one who sits below one and above tens of thousands.
As long as the one in the forbidden area of the Imperial Palace doesn't intervene, then Emperor Xia is the most respected person under heaven, with no one who dares to defy his will."
In the Spiritual Space, upon hearing Meng Potian's words, Lu Yang pondered; it seemed to be true, Emperor Xia did indeed appear to be a highly respected individual.
"Why didn't I feel this way before?" Lu Yang wondered, recalling his previous impression of Emperor Xia.
Then he remembered, the first time he met Emperor Xia was when Fairy Eternity wanted Emperor Xia to be the fourth in charge.
Then it was Fairy Eternity serving as the Acting Sect Master, challenging not only the masters of the Four Great Immortal Sects but also Emperor Xia, which frightened Emperor Xia into granting him various privileges such as entering the court without bowing and ascending the hall bearing a sword.
With these experiences, plus Fairy Eternity constantly nagging about the Ancient Immortal's embarrassing moments, it was hard for him to feel any awe towards Emperor Xia.
"You have also had contact with Great Yu Cultivators, especially since your Seek Dao Sect captured Master of All Laws from the Great Yu Alliance, as well as Wu Youdao, the sixth Emperor Yu, and the second Imperial Teacher of Great Yu. Why have they chosen to awaken at this time? Is it merely for immortality? No, they have the intention to replace Great Xia and rebuild Great Yu."
Meng Potian did not know that Wu Youdao and the second Imperial Teacher of Great Qian had also been captured by the Seek Dao Sect.
"It is said that the one in the forbidden area of the Imperial Palace does not take action unless the life or death of Great Xia is at stake, thus sitting on the throne would actually mean being the master of the Central Continent."
"Exactly what realm is that person from the forbidden area of the Imperial Palace?" Meng Jingzhou had long heard of an ancestor from the Jiang Family in the forbidden area of the Imperial Palace.
Meng Potian's expression turned grave as if discussing some sort of taboo, and slowly let out two words.
"Immortal."
"Oh, I guessed as much."
Fairy Eternity and Meng Jingzhou accepted this fact calmly, showing none of the intense emotional changes Meng Potian had expected.
Both Great Qian and Great Yu were founded by Immortals, so it was only logical for Great Xia to have an Immortal as well.
Meng Potian's face twitched slightly, wondering what these two young men had encountered outside, for they seemed entirely unimpressed by the notion of an Immortal.
"No wonder our ancestors couldn't beat those of the Jiang Family," Meng Jingzhou understood, knowing why their ancestors had lost; Jiang Pingan was an Immortal, and it was impossible for a mere gentleman like Meng to win against him.
"Our ancestors were really disappointing, had they won, I would be the Crown Prince now."
Meng Jingzhou felt the weight on his shoulders grow heavier, realizing that the task of producing an Immortal for the Meng Family had fallen on him.
"So now you understand why the throne is so important; it's akin to being the spokesperson for an Immortal."
While they were speaking, the door was knocked on, and housekeeper Xu entered.
"Master, someone is here to repay a debt."
The housekeeper Xu rarely referred to Meng Potian as "big brother," as calling him "big brother" gave off the impression that they were some sort of underworld force, especially with a phrase like "big brother, someone is here to repay a debt," making the Meng Family seem like some kind of illegal operation.
The Meng Family had always been law-abiding in their dealings, unlike a demonic sect which had never registered as an illegal organization.
"Who is it?" Meng Potian asked. Normally, mundane matters of lending and repaying debt could be handled by Xu You without necessitating the involvement of the family head.
For Xu You to inform him meant the person's identity was not low, or the amount being repaid was substantial.
"The man claims to be Shi Huagu, wishing to repay the ten billion Spirit Stones he once owed."
Meng Potian nodded, "One billion spirit stones is indeed a sizable sum."
"Shi Huagu... I remember he is the one who opened the Come Again Barbecue chain, right?" Meng Potian had some impression of this newly risen commercial prodigy.
"But I don't recall us ever lending him money."
Especially when it involved lending one billion spirit stones, Meng Potian would definitely have remembered.
"The promissory note has been checked, it is indeed issued by our Meng Family. The only thing is that the debtor's column has been altered by causality divine ability, it seems he voluntarily took on the previous debtor's responsibility."
Meng Potian was moved by this, hardly believing there could be such a person of deep feeling and loyalty in the world.
"Come, take me to see him."
Meng Potian had just stepped one foot out the door when he turned his head and shouted to Meng Jingzhou and Lu Yang, "You two probably haven't seen the repayment process before. Come take a look and gain some experience."
Even if Meng Potian hadn't said anything, Meng Jingzhou would have wanted to join the excitement.
The name Shi Huagu was all too familiar to him.
...
The Meng Residence's guest reception area.
There were many private rooms in the reception area, differing in quality according to the business value.
Shi Huagu was nervously waiting in a superior private room for someone from the Meng Family who could make decisions to arrive.
"Don't be nervous, you've already saved up one billion spirit stones, haven't you?" Sect Leader Mu Baiyi had also come. Shi Huagu's debt, including the issues left by the previous leader, was somewhat official business. He had accompanied him to prevent any hitches along the way.
"At last I don't have to fear the lightning strikes anymore," Shi Huagu sighed with relief. He had waited for four long years for this day, enduring a thunder tribulation each month, fifty tribulations in total. It was a miracle that he was still alive.
He should never have been so reckless as to steal Qin Haoran's treasure in the first place.
This was no treasure at all!
Had it not been for the Heavenly Court Sect showing him the way, he would have had no idea how many lifetimes it would take to accumulate so many spirit stones.
"Are you Shi Huagu?"
Meng Potian appeared with Meng Jingzhou and the possessed Lu Yang, his face beaming with a warm and sincere smile.
"Yes."
Shi Huagu noticed Meng Jingzhou and Lu Yang, and was slightly startled, not expecting these two to be present.
He had met Lu Yang once when he sought Tao Yaoye for advertising, while he had only seen portraits of Meng Jingzhou.
Mu Baiyi had met both of them in the corpse inn in Wild State.
To Shi Huagu, they were just two talented juniors, so he didn't think much of it. He handed over Qin Haoran's promissory note, as well as the storage ring containing one billion spirit stones, to Meng Potian, anxiously waiting for the outcome.
Meng Potian first inspected the promissory note carefully. The Meng Family always followed the rules; they wouldn't take money that wasn't theirs.
Then he checked the storage ring three times. The Meng Family had its principles; the money that was theirs couldn't be a cent short.
"Mmm, the promissory note is authentic, and there are indeed one billion spirit stones in the storage ring."
Upon hearing this, Shi Huagu let out a sigh of relief, standing up to take his leave, but Meng Potian stopped him.
"Wait a moment, you haven't paid the interest yet."

chapters.title: Chapter 845 - 844: This is much faster than robbing money
chapters.content:
"Interest?" Shi Huagu shuddered upon hearing this word.
It was hard to imagine an Integration Stage Expert losing control over his own body.
"Yes, of course there's interest on a loan. Otherwise, why would we lend you money?" Meng Potian said as a matter of course, unable to understand why Shi Huagu had such a strong reaction.
The Meng Family was not running a charity. Anyone could borrow money as long as they repaid it. If that weren't the case, the Meng Family would have gone bankrupt a long time ago.
Shi Huagu's face, while smiling, looked even uglier than if he were crying.
Dammit, how could I have constantly overlooked the existence of interest?
Next to him, Mu Baiyi, who was responsible for appeasing his subordinates, also changed his expression and lost his composure.
He too had forgotten about the interest.
Not only did Shi Huagu owe money, but he also did.
The difference was that he had disguised himself as a member of the Yaoyang Sect when borrowing money from the Land Money Trade Association.
He had been thinking that the profits from the barbecue restaurant were decent enough, and he should pay off his debts quickly to avoid any troubles.
If this got out, even being at the Half Step Pass Tribulation Stage wouldn't save his life.
"How much... how much is the interest?" Shi Huagu stammered in fear, wishing he could dig up Qin Haoran's corpse and whip it.
Meng Potian was quite enthusiastic toward a big client like Shi Huagu and was impressed that Shi Huagu was willing to take on such a debt, being a man of integrity and emotion.
However, as much as he admired Shi Huagu, the account needed to be settled clearly.
"You see, it was made very clear when you took out the loan. It was a 'Safe Tribulation Passing Insurance.' If you successfully advanced to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, the interest would no longer be calculated. You'd only have to repay the principal. If the tribulation was failed, then a twelve percent annual interest rate would be applied."
Meng Potian wrote and calculated the process in the air to help Shi Huagu understand.
"It has been forty years since the loan was taken out. It was agreed to use 'equal principal and interest' for repayment. With a loan of one billion, that averages out to a repayment of one thousand one hundred million every month... After subtracting the ten billion you've repaid, there's still forty-five billion left."
The air was filled with dense calculations, which terrified Shi Huagu.
As an Integration Stage Expert, he certainly had the ability to do these simple calculations; he simply didn't dare accept this reality.
Off to the side, Mu Baiyi's eyelids twitched. If he had that many Spirit Stones, Fengdu would have been built long ago.
And that was just the Spirit Stones Shi Huagu owed. His own debt was even larger.
He had thought that the sooner he repaid it, the sooner he'd be free, and he could speed up the construction of Fengdu. Now, it seemed better to put it off; there was no rush to build Fengdu.
Recently, the Jiuyou Sect and Yaoyang Sect were prospering under the leadership of the Heavenly Court Sect. Guided by Young Sect Master Lu, the Yaoyang Sect soon changed its research direction, and solar-powered candles and such were about to be launched. Surely, they would make Spirit Stones faster than running a barbecue restaurant.
Mu Baiyi tried to look on the bright side.
In the Spiritual Space, Lu Yangxin thought, no wonder the Meng Family follows the law so strictly. Earning money legally seems faster than breaking the law.
You couldn't rob as much money as they were making.
Fairy Eternity felt a deep regret: "What a shame. I've made a huge loss. I should have deposited some Spirit Stones in a bank. Thirty thousand... no, forty thousand years have passed. How many Spirit Stones could I have earned!"
"...Uhm, may I ask, Your Highness, are you sure there's any bank that's been open from ancient times to now?"
Fairy Eternity thought about it, realizing Xiao Yang had a point.
So Fairy Eternity returned to her usual cheerful self.
Shi Huagu and Mu Baiyi left the Meng Residence, both looking dejected.
"Master, what's the plan, return to headquarters?"
Mu Baiyi shook his head, "Have you noticed that the living standards of the people in the Imperial City are higher than those in other cities? This means they are more accepting of new things. Previously, when we started our barbecue restaurant, we began in smaller places and gradually spread to the surrounding cities."
"Barbecue restaurants are quite common, our advantage is the taste is good, anyone can accept it, it isn't a new thing."
"But not everything invented by the Yaoyang Sect can be accepted by everyone at first glance. I believe that if we want to break into the sun energy market, we need to start in the Imperial City."
"Then you go and contact the people of the Yaoyang Sect, let's all come to the Imperial City to do some research."
Shi Huagu thought it was no wonder that the other was a Master, this ability to observe and think was indeed stronger than his own.
...
"Father Emperor, your son has returned."
Inside the Imperial Palace, the majestic Crown Prince kowtowed before Emperor Xia.
Three months ago, someone accused officials in Ji State of corruption and deception. To investigate corrupt officials and their dishonest practices, Jiang Qun went to Ji State in disguise, interacted with the common people to find clues, confronted obstructing officials by revealing his identity, intimidated everyone, made the acquaintance of a beauty, and gained a romantic encounter.
And now, he had just returned to the Imperial City.
Unimaginably, he hadn't seen his Father Emperor for three months, and now he was aged to such an extent.
The once vigorous Emperor Xia was no longer to be seen; the current Emperor Xia was like an old man approaching the end of his life, face full of wrinkles, with drooping eyelids that covered his eyes.
It had been agreed that he still had ten years of lifespan left, and yet not even half of that time had passed and he was already near his end!
Emperor Xia was most fond of his eldest son. Seeing Jiang Qun return, he showed a smile, put down the memorial he was holding, and gestured for him to come closer.
"Father Emperor, your health..."
Jiang Qun felt a surge of sorrow in his heart.
He kneeled in front of the throne, letting his Father Emperor stroke his head, as if returning to his childhood when he would sit on his Father Emperor's lap while he sat on the throne.
"Cough cough, it doesn't matter, I know my own body, and I can still live for a while longer," Emperor Xia's eyes were cloudy, his vision severely reduced, and his speech had a spray of saliva, not very articulate.
"Heaven still lacks the strength to take my life."
"I know you desire the freedom and have no intention to inherit the throne, as a parent, I will not force you," he continued.
"However, if the heir to the throne isn't appointed early, and if one day I can't hold on and depart this world, the Power of National Fate that clings to me will have no master, and it might cause turmoil. At that time, it will be unavoidable, requiring the ancestors to step in and suppress it."
"This State Destiny is the foundation of our Great Xia, we cannot afford any mishaps."
"Old Two is too scheming, often outsmarting himself, and Old Three knows he lacks the talent to govern, devoting himself to literature... All eight of your younger brothers have various flaws, unfit for great responsibilities. I can't rest easy entrusting the country to them, and you are also well aware of your seven sisters..."
"Father Emperor, please stop talking, I will take the throne!" Jiang Qun was heartbroken, his voice choked with tears, and he nodded in agreement.
He knew his Father Emperor had always thought highly of him, otherwise, he would not have entrusted him with dealing with the officials of Ji State, which was a way to establish prestige.
"Ah, that's what you said, you can't go back on your word!" Emperor Xia suddenly sat upright, his eyes became clear and sharp, staring at Jiang Qun with an intensity that showed no sign of his impending end.
Jiang Qun: "..."
Dad, if you're fine, please stop the acting.
Second brother said there is no truth in the royal family, it's all about intrigue and plotting, and he was utterly right.

chapters.title: Chapter 846 - 845: The Cold Throne
chapters.content:
```
"I've changed my mind," Crown Prince Jiang Qun declared composedly, not feeling an ounce of shame in his words.
What do you mean I want to be emperor? Who heard that? Is there proof?
"Hey, I've taught you since you were little to keep your word and be trustworthy; have you forgotten that?" Emperor Xia became agitated. It had not been easy to coax an admission out of him, and was revoking one's word something so easily done?
Jiang Qun looked incredulously at his imperial father. Where was your honesty and trustworthiness when you pretended to be sick just now?
"Your regret is useless; I've recorded it all with the Recording Orb," Emperor Xia, knowing what his eldest son was like, had made thorough preparations.
Just honestly be the emperor, will you?
"I have no shame!" insisted Jiang Qun, stubborn as a pig unafraid of boiling water, a stark contrast to the graceful image he presented to the outside world.
Father and son glared at each other, like two fighting cocks, neither willing to back down.
In the end, it was Emperor Xia who couldn't hold out and conceded first.
He let out a long sigh and said, "Look at you; every family clamors for the throne, but why do you stubbornly refuse to take it?"
"Once you inherit the throne, not only will you reign over the Central Continent, but you'll also become the vessel of the State Destiny. You know the magical benefits of the State Destiny, and how it aids in cultivation."
Jiang Qun also spoke his mind, "Father, you know best how restrictive it is to sit on the throne. Let's not talk about anything else; can you roam around incognito all day like me?"
"Cultivators desire freedom. If I take the throne and become unfree, even with the aid of the State Destiny, if my Mind State falls, how will I be able to continue cultivating?"
"Hmm? Father, why do you have that expression on your face? As a cultivator, have you not even grasped such simple truths?"
Emperor Xia: "..."
Don't think that having a higher cultivation talent than your father makes you impressive.
"And about that elder in the forbidden land, I don't know his identity, but I reckon he must have sat on the throne before. Why do you think he abdicated? Certainly, he must have felt uncomfortable too?"
"How about this? You pick someone you like as your successor. I think the Second, Fourth, and Fifth Princes all have the aspiration. They can inherit the throne, and I'll help them to ensure they make no mistakes."
Emperor Xia became irate: "Nonsense, our family hasn't had such a precedent in a hundred thousand years."
"If there's nothing else, Father, I'll take my leave. You just focus on resting and recovering," Jiang Qun said, about to make his exit.
"Hold on," Emperor Xia suddenly had an idea and called out to Jiang Qun.
Jiang Qun reluctantly came back, his hands tucked into his sleeves, and respectfully asked, "What is it?"
"Didn't you say before, when you went among the people incognito and faced injustice, revealing your identity felt especially satisfying?"
Jiang Qun hesitated briefly before telling the truth: "...Yes."
"So, you know all about my habits. Why don't you take on my appearance and handle some state affairs for a few days, while I go out and have some fun?"
Jiang Qun stared at his father in shock, Father, are you even listening to yourself?
Emperor Xia felt his son was right, for cultivators the most important thing is to live freely: "I don't have many days left, can't I enjoy life a bit? As my eldest son and helping your father with his worries, is there any problem?"
"By your command." Since his father had put it that way, Jiang Qun had no choice but to comply.
"Come here, sit down here," Emperor Xia quickly made room, pushing his eldest son onto the throne while he went to the imperial treasury to look for treasures that could hide his identity.
```
Emperor Xia's cultivation level was average, only at the Divinity Transformation Stage. Relaying solely on his own tricks to disguise himself made it quite easy for him to be recognized, but it didn't matter. His methods might have been lacking, but the national treasury was full of means to hide one's identity.
Prince Jiang Qun watched his father's retreating figure, even from the silhouette he could sense his father's joy, as if he had finally been liberated from the throne.
He sighed, feeling that the throne was not at all comfortable, cold and chilling to the heart.
"How come this chair doesn't even have a cushion?"
"And how come after my father sat for so long, it hasn't even warmed up?"
…
Perhaps the news of the Second Prince's banquet for Lu Yang had been spread by someone with an agenda, or maybe the other princes could no longer contain their impatience. Since Fairy Eternity had left the Second Prince's company, she had been receiving gifts from the Fourth and Fifth Princes every day.
Although Lu Yang's wishes couldn't completely determine the outcome, they could play a significant role in the succession of the throne.
Everyone wanted to win over this heavyweight chip.
Fairy Eternity was completely unaware of her own importance and did not care why people sent her gifts, graciously accepting everything as it came.
She used the gifts to help Lu Yang with his cultivation. His sleep quality had improved greatly compared to before, while he himself was competing with the Invincible Nascent Soul in the Spiritual Space.
"One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand!"
Lu Yang shouted, and in the expanse of his Spiritual Space appeared densely packed blades, striking fear into those who saw them.
The Invincible Nascent Soul also performed One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand, with sword Qi turning into tangible blades emerging from the ground.
Both the person and the nascent soul executed their moves at the same time, tens of thousands of blades collided, sparks flew, and the killing intent reached the heavens.
Then Lu Yang and the Invincible Nascent Soul both performed the Village in the Palm. Their palms clashed, thundering like the roar of thunder.
After executing two major moves in succession, Lu Yang was short on spiritual essence. Just as he was catching his breath, the Invincible Nascent Soul charged aggressively and knocked him away.
"Stop, stop, stop, let's not fight anymore." Realizing the Invincible Nascent Soul wanted to continue, Lu Yang hurriedly called a halt.
His total amount of spiritual essence was equal to that of the Invincible Nascent Soul, yet after executing both moves, the latter still had energy to spare. This meant that the Invincible Nascent Soul had used its spiritual essence more efficiently in constructing the moves, without any waste, and this was something he needed to learn.
"Do it again, let me watch."
Lu Yang, by Fairy Eternity's decree, could command the Invincible Nascent Soul at will, not only allowing it to spar with him but also to repeat certain moves for him to observe.
This greatly accelerated Lu Yang's cultivation progress.
"Eh, the Jiang Family's fourth son is inviting this fairy over." One day, as Fairy Eternity was receiving gifts as usual, she found an invitation among them. The Fourth Prince's tone in the letter was full of boldness, expressing his wish for Lu Yang to visit his residence, to fulfill the duties of a host.
Lu Yang had heard that this Fourth Prince had a strong rivers and lakes essence, loved making friends, and didn't care about the status of his friends, mingling with people of all kinds.
Lu Yang hadn't paid much attention to this before, but ever since Master Meng mentioned that the Fourth Prince also had ambitions for the throne, he began to ponder the Fourth Prince's purpose.
Being friends with people from all walks of life, in other words, the Fourth Prince's informants were spread everywhere, a terrifying intelligence network, likely even more meticulous than the information Elder Brother Dai had.
Lu Yang reflected that the Fourth Prince must have felt his gifts were enough to establish rapport, and only then did he send the invitation.
"Fairy, will you go?"
"Let's go." Fairy Eternity had quite enjoyed herself the last time she visited the home of the Second Prince.

chapters.title: Chapter 847 - 846: The Fourth Prince's Strategy
chapters.content:
```
The Fourth Prince had planted spies among the Second Prince's guests, and knew every detail of the banquet held in honor of Lu Yang.
"Lu Yang managed to turn the tables in a very short time. His cunning is truly admirable, so much that even my brother, known for his meticulous scheming, fell into the trap."
Knowing that Lu Yang was a tough opponent, the Fourth Prince consequently sent gifts to the Meng Residence for several days, expressing his goodwill.
Now he felt that he had shown enough goodwill and could proceed to the next step of his plan.
…
"Brother Lu Yang, I have long admired your reputation, and seeing you today, indeed, your bearing is extraordinary!" Just like the Second Prince, the Fourth Prince stood at the entrance to express his importance, yet he behaved according to the customs of the rivers and lakes, not like a noble prince but more like a chivalrous bandit standing up for justice.
It was commonly said that he was forthright in his dealings, not caring about the status of those with whom he formed friendships, but in reality, each person he befriended was of use to him. To this end, he even became sworn brothers with many unremarkable cultivators, in order to conceal his real intentions.
Meng Jingzhou had gone into closed-door cultivation on short notice, and Fairy Eternity did not summon him.
Moreover, Fairy Eternity felt that whether or not Meng Jingzhou was called made little difference, as she had the Second-in-command in her Spiritual Space to offer counsel and devise strategies.
Although the Second-in-command's wisdom was not equal to her own, he could still serve as a reference.
The Fourth Prince covertly observed Fairy Eternity's attitude and found that she was indifferent to his praise, which he inevitably found somewhat strange.
Fairy Eternity also thought that the Fourth Prince was odd. Why speak so much truth in front of me. Isn't this common knowledge? Isn't it redundant?
The Fourth Prince felt that Lu Yang was indeed elusive and had to continue saying, "Brother Lu, please come inside quickly."
The Fourth Prince's official residence was elegantly sorrowful with flowing water and picturesque gardens, complemented by the music of musicians, creating a charming atmosphere.
Many cultivators gathered at the Fourth Prince's official residence, among whom members of influential families only made up a small part, with the majority being brothel masters, teahouse owners, painters, doctors, and even matchmakers.
These were friends who had shared life-and-death experiences with the Fourth Prince and were absolutely trustworthy.
Unlike the tunes played by the musicians, Fairy Eternity could feel that ever since she arrived, the crowd had been looking at her with a tense expression.
The Fourth Prince escorted Lu Yang to the secondary seat, while he sat in the seat of honor.
Once the Fourth Prince was seated, the atmosphere seemed to relax considerably, and fine wine and dishes were served as if money were no object, even more lavish than the offerings at the banquet held by the Old Dragon Emperor of the East Sea.
Of course, this was partly because the Fourth Prince's guests were significantly fewer than those at the Old Dragon Emperor's banquet.
Although the quality of the Spirit Food was mediocre and Fairy Eternity disdained it, considering that eating these dishes could indeed help Lu Yang increase his cultivation level, she reluctantly ate them.
The alcohol flowed, and entertainers would intermittently liven up the mood with their magic skills and Divine Abilities, creating a continuous flow of laughter and conversation.
Suddenly, the Fourth Prince became sentimental, putting down his bronze wine cup and letting out a long sigh.
"What a pity, I'm afraid we won't have many opportunities for such gatherings in the future."
As soon as these words were spoken, the atmosphere of the venue immediately became heavy, and the guests all put down their chopsticks and turned their gaze en masse toward the Fourth Prince.
Before coming, they had roughly guessed the reason why the Fourth Prince had gathered them here: they were to conspire for a significant cause.
"Your Highness, why do you say that?" someone asked loudly.
The Fourth Prince looked at the crowd with a complicated gaze, cast another glance at Fairy Eternity, who was still eating quietly, picked up his wine cup, and drank a cup in one gulp.
Perhaps the words that followed were so treasonous that he needed the courage that only wine could bring.
```
"Father's lifespan is running out, and I, as his son, am unable to offer any help. Watching Father age day by day has robbed me of peace in both sleep and appetite."
"In my dreams, I often see Father passing away to the heavens, and my elder brothers, fighting over the throne, render the people's lives a misery. Waking up in the middle of the night, I am drenched in a cold sweat."
"I often think that Father, who loves his subjects as his children, would never want to see such a scene. I want to change all of this, yet I, alone and lacking strength, how could I intervene in the struggle for the throne?"
"When that time comes, with Great Xia in turmoil, we who care deeply about the world, how could we sit here and drink merrily?"
Thinking of the scene described by the Fourth Prince, everyone lowered their heads, some even shedding tears of genuine sorrow.
Fairy Eternity raised her head slightly, unable to understand why they were suddenly engaged in a theatrical performance.
Never mind, it had nothing to do with her. Fairy Eternity continued to lower her head and help Lu Yang eat.
Of course, the Fourth Prince was unaware of Fairy Eternity's thoughts. Seeing Lu Yang raise his head, he thought Lu Yang was beginning to take an interest in them.
A middle-aged gentleman, who appeared to be well-educated, said, "If we are to speak of a way, there is indeed one, but this method is so treacherous and against the Dao that it must not be used."
The Fourth Prince eagerly said, "Mr. Lu, please speak."
"It must not be said," Mr. Lu continued to shake his head.
"How can such treachery compare to the peace and well-being of the millions of people in the world?" Pressed by the continuous questioning of the Fourth Prince, Mr. Lu finally revealed his plan.
"If you desire peace in the world, then there must be an undisputed sovereign of all to succeed the throne; naturally, that should be the Crown Prince. However, the Second and Third Princes certainly will not stand idly by, and that's why there's a struggle for the throne."
"As long as the three princes lose their eligibility to compete for the throne, it naturally belongs to you."
Upon hearing this, the Fourth Prince wanted to voice his objection but, as if Mr. Lu had already anticipated what the Fourth Prince was about to say, he continued, "I know Your Highness has no intention of competing for the throne, but for the sake of the people of the world, there is no other way."
The Fourth Prince opened his mouth, wanting to say something in rebuttal, but the words seemed so feeble on his lips. Furthermore, his loyal friends looked at him with such earnest gazes that he couldn't bring himself to utter a word of refusal.
"Enough, enough," the Fourth Prince capitulated, lowering his head.
Then he asked, "But how are we to make my three elder brothers give up their claims to the throne?"
Everyone fell silent; this was the most difficult part.
The Fourth Prince turned to inquire of Fairy Eternity: "Brother Lu, do you have a way?"
Upon being asked, Fairy Eternity slurped up a mouthful of noodles, then looked up at the Fourth Prince: "It's simple, isn't it? Just start a rebellion."
Lu Yang had expected the Fourth Prince to show a shocked expression, but the Fourth Prince, as if he had anticipated Fairy Eternity's response, continued to inquire.
"Would you be willing to help me?"
The Fourth Prince was waiting for this very response from Lu Yang. According to the intel gathered from the Second Prince, Lu Yang often bragged about rebelling and establishing a new dynasty, cleverly evading the issue of competing for the throne, which made the Second Prince wary of engaging too deeply with Lu Yang.
But the problem was, he really did entertain thoughts of rebellion!
Without rebelling, he would never have a chance to succeed to the throne.
If Lu Yang answered "unwilling," it meant he was acknowledging that he was just talking big and had other methods, thus forcing him to take sides.
If Lu Yang defiantly claimed he was "willing," then even better, it would directly involve Lu Yang, making him stand on the Fourth Prince's side.
"Sure," Fairy Eternity agreed enthusiastically, which perfectly aligned with her desire.

chapters.title: Chapter 848 - 847 Rebellion
chapters.content:
```
"So you're plotting a rebellion. What preparations do you have?"
Fairy Eternity inquired, observing the manner of the Fourth Prince and his companions, which hinted at them not acting on a whim but rather being well-prepared.
"Of course, we are," laughed the Fourth Prince heartily. With Lu Yang's assistance, or rather once Lu Yang became involved, the Seek Dao Sect would inevitably take action. By dragging the Seek Dao Sect into this, they had a ninety percent chance of successfully usurping the throne!
"Brother Lu Yang, look here—this is my brother Gongsun Jiu. He possesses an unrivaled cultivation technique capable of explosive speed, on par with someone in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage for a brief period. He can approach our eldest brother under the guise of presenting a treasure and strike within a mere instant, leaving no opportunity for a reaction!"
The man named Gongsun Jiu grinned broadly, "His Highness has shown me great kindness, and this is the perfect opportunity to repay His Highness's favor."
Killing the Crown Prince was a move that would seal one's fate. Gongsun Jiu was already resolved to lay down his life for the Fourth Prince.
"This is my brother Tang Feng, a master of assassination techniques so profound they seem supernatural. Should Brother Gongsun's attempt fail, he will carry out a second assassination. No one would expect the interval between two assassination attempts to be so short."
Tang Feng had an average appearance that would not stand out in a crowd.
"Your Highness saved me from dire straits; my life is yours to command!"
"And this brother here, he specializes in poison-making, capable of killing soundlessly. One who sleeps under its effect will never wake again."
"This brother is in charge of intelligence. Nothing in the Imperial City, big or small, escapes his notice."
"And him—he is actually a disciple of my second brother, already well-versed in my second brother's dietary habits and daily routine."
"And there's more..."
Assassins, intelligence gatherers, planted spies, accomplished actors, scholars who had failed the civil examinations...
The Fourth Prince introduced them one by one. Those attending this banquet were all close confidants of the Fourth Prince, utterly loyal to him. Moreover, each of them possessed unique skills, hidden within all walks of life. If they were to truly demonstrate their abilities, they could carve out a significant reputation in the world of martial arts.
The Fourth Prince had long schemed against his three elder brothers. The only complication had been that their capabilities remained enigmatic. With Lu Yang's participation, everything became straightforward.
Could their secret cards possibly outmatch the Seek Dao Sect?
"I had originally planned to target our father, the Emperor, as well. Every additional day he lives, the powers of my younger brothers grow, threatening my position. Unfortunately, he is protected by the State Destiny, making him difficult to harm, but I can take action in other ways—such as destroying anything that might extend the Emperor's lifespan!"
"Oh, it seems you are quite prepared," Fairy Eternity nodded with an indifferent comment.
"Brother Lu Yang, it's still not enough. We need your help!" The Fourth Prince looked at Lu Yang with earnest, pleading eyes.
