"Can't you make up your mind?" Fairy Eternity thought for a moment, and then decided, "Well then, I'll give the Jiang Family's youngest a hand just this once."
"Fine, I'll help."
The Fourth Prince's smile revealed the success of his scheme. From his first contact with Lu Yang until now, he had been recording everything with a Recording Orb, ensuring Lu Yang couldn't just walk away from it all.
Now Lu Yang was trapped on the same boat as he was!
Fairy Eternity rose to her feet, one to act on her thoughts immediately. "Then let's make a trip. Relying solely on your people to deal with your three brothers is a bit of a stretch. We'll need to seek external assistance."
Delight filled the heart of the Fourth Prince. She was about to take him to the Seek Dao Sect for support.
"Hold on, I'll prepare some gifts for the meeting."
"There's no need."
…
After leaving the Imperial Palace, Emperor Xia disguised himself, transforming into a fresh-faced young man—vastly different from his usual demeanor.
```
He heard his eldest son say, "If you want people to look down on you, then you must disguise yourself as an inexperienced cultivator, giving off the impression that you lack experience, and this would easily lead to conflicts."
All of this was advice based on Jiang Qun's experience.
Suddenly, Emperor Xia saw two familiar figures, one was Yun Zhi's Junior Brother, and the other was his own Fourth Prince.
What were they doing here?
What puzzled Emperor Xia even more was that Lu Yang was arguing with an officer at the entrance of the Ministry of Punishments, and it seemed like quite a fierce quarrel.
"Why not, don't you have any sense of reason?" Fairy Eternity was somewhat angry; her well-conceived plan was facing setbacks right from the start.
"Move along, move along, this is not a place for your nonsense," the officer impatiently shooed Fairy Eternity away.
Emperor Xia briskly walked forward and sternly rebuked the officer.
"Hold your tongue! As Ministry of Justice Officials, how can you treat people so unreasonably?"
The officer glanced at Emperor Xia and simply ignored him.
A glint of joy crossed Emperor Xia's heart; this was the perfect opportunity to impress.
Under such circumstances, it must have been that Lu Yang encountered some kind of issue and came to the Ministry of Punishments to file a complaint, but they, due to corruption and favoritism, refused to handle the case, leading to this quarrel.
Now it was his turn to step in and uphold justice. When the officials at the Ministry of Justice underestimated and ignored him, and better still, should he uncover some shameful secret within the Ministry that they wished to silence, that's when he would reveal his identity as Emperor Xia to their astonished eyes!
He turned his head towards Lu Yang, feigning not to recognize him, and folding his hands in greeting, he asked, "Fellow cultivator, may I know what has happened that brought you to the Ministry of Punishments to file a report and be treated so unreasonably?"
Fairy Eternity scrutinized Emperor Xia from head to toe, and not knowing what was happening, Emperor Xia felt inexplicably guilty.
Could it be that Lu Yang had seen through his identity?
That shouldn't be the case; the jade pendant he wore was a national treasure-level magic artifact, not something a Nascent Soul Stage cultivator could see through.
Fairy Eternity, stamping her foot in anger, pointed at the Fourth Prince and said indignantly, "It's because I came to report his plot of treason. The Ministry of Punishments refused to accept the report, thinking I was lying! This is such injustice!"
Emperor Xia: "..."
Wait, what did you just say?
The reaction of the Fourth Prince was even more shocked than that of Emperor Xia. With eyes widened in disbelief, he stared blankly at Lu Yang and exclaimed, "Is this your idea of helping me?"
He had never imagined that while Lu Yang had verbally agreed to help him rise against his brothers, claiming to find him assistance, he would then turn around and take him to the Ministry of Punishments to report his own plot of treason.
Fairy Eternity, looking puzzled, regarded the Fourth Prince, not understanding why he reacted so strongly, "Yes, what's the problem?"
"Isn't it because you said you wanted to eliminate your three elder brothers so that you could ascend to the throne? I thought that if you launched a revolt, all would be resolved."
"I heard that in Great Xia, those who rebel are to have their families executed. That way, your three brothers would surely be dead."
"Here I am, finding outside forces to help you."
"And what about me?!" The Fourth Prince glared at Fairy Eternity. Whether his brothers would die, he couldn't be sure, but one thing was certain—he was doomed!
"But at the time, you only mentioned getting rid of your three brothers; you didn't say you wanted to live, did you?"
Fairy Eternity figured that, with the nine generations of the Fourth Prince's family gone, the Jiang Family would have no one left, and it would be her turn to ascend the throne—a stroke of fortune delivered right to her door.

chapters.title: Chapter 849 - 848: The Terrifying Calculations
chapters.content:
Emperor Xia had thought to reveal his identity and scold the Ministry of Punishments officer, but when it came to it, the words just wouldn't come out.
It was the first time he had heard of an imperial son's rebellion leading to the execution of his entire family, no wonder people from the Ministry of Punishments were so eager to send Lu Yang away—it was completely justified.
The Fourth Prince stared intently at Lu Yang, trying to detect any hint of jest in his words.
However, Fairy Eternity showed no reaction; what she had said was indeed her genuine thought.
The Fourth Prince burst into laughter out of anger, "Lu Yang, let me tell you, don't try to act clever. Back in the courtyard, it was you who brought up the idea of rebellion first. If you report me, you won't be able to get away either!"
Fairy Eternity found it odd and couldn't understand the thought process of the Fourth Prince, "How was it me who first mentioned the rebellion? Wasn't it you who gathered all those who planned to rebel? This shows that you were the one preparing to revolt. I just went along with your train of thought."
The Fourth Prince recollected what had transpired in the courtyard and suddenly realized that from the beginning to the end, Lu Yang had not substantially participated in the rebellion plans!
This was neither complicity nor instigation—it was innocence!
No, there was still a possibility for things to change.
"These are just your words, there is no evidence!"
Indeed, for a matter of such gravity as rebellion, mere verbal testimony was not enough to convict someone, especially given that all along, only Lu Yang himself had mentioned his intention to rebel.
The brothers who had plotted in the courtyard all shared a life-and-death bond with the Fourth Prince and understood the gravity of the situation; they would never betray their own!
"Ah, don't you have a Recording Orb? I saw you recording from the moment I entered your house—isn't it for using it as evidence now?"
In the eyes of Fairy Eternity, the Fourth Prince's thoughts were the same as hers; in order to kill his three elder brothers and instigate a rebellion to exterminate the entire family, leading to mutual destruction.
Perhaps the Fourth Prince himself was not resolute enough to report his own actions, so he sought her help, inviting her to his home as a guest and discussing the rebellion in front of her, saving the evidence in the Recording Orb.
And just as the Fourth Prince wished, she went to the Ministry of Punishments to report the matter.
The only two problems were that the Ministry of Punishments seemed reluctant to intervene in this affair, and the Fourth Prince was looking to back out at the last moment.
What a dilemma.
The look in the Fourth Prince's eyes changed again as he saw Lu Yang; it turned into one of fear, dread, and shivering.
In just a visit, Lu Yang had calculated everything meticulously, putting on an act from the moment he walked in, pretending to confide his true intentions for cooperation, allowing the Fourth Prince to reveal his hand, and even predicting that the Fourth Prince would use the Recording Orb as a threat, turning it back on him and making the orb meant to be a threat into evidence of rebellion!
His cunning surpassed even what he had shown at the Second Prince's residence!
How laughable that he had thought to bind Lu Yang to his ship. He wasn't qualified to plot against Lu Yang; he'd have to first survive the immediate crisis!
Seeing things go awry, the Fourth Prince turned tail to flee, but Fairy Eternity would not let him escape.
With Cultivation Level at the Divinity Transformation Stage, the Fourth Prince was no different from a mortal in front of Fairy Eternity. She, controlling Lu Yang's body, grabbed the Fourth Prince's wrist and threw him to the ground, causing him to see stars and the earth below to cave into a large pit.
Fairy Eternity also took the opportunity to steal the Storage Ring from the Fourth Prince, which contained the Recording Orb.
The one-sided exchange between Fairy Eternity and the Fourth Prince caused a great commotion, catching the attention of the Minister of Justice, who hurried over to see what had happened.
Who would dare to cause trouble at the entrance of the Ministry of Punishments? Did they think the Ministry was easy to bully?
"Ah, has the person in charge arrived?"
Lu Yang told her that based on the clothes of the approaching person, it was the Minister of Justice, a senior Fourth Grade official.
A Fourth Grade was indeed a high-ranking official, even the Chief of Staff from the Ministry of Punishments was just a Third Grade.
"The timing is perfect. I've just caught someone plotting a rebellion. I've come to report it. The Recording Orb is inside his Storage Ring, and your people here refused to file the case."
The officer did not recognize the Fourth Prince, but could the Minister of Justice not recognize him? Seeing the Fourth Prince being held down by Lu Yang, he trembled with fear.
Who? The Fourth Prince rebelling?
He had served in the Ministry of Punishments for hundreds of years and this was the first time he had heard of someone reporting a prince for rebellion to the Ministry.
Was this something their Ministry could handle?
"Ah, you're not going to take care of a rebellion?" Fairy Eternity asked, causing the Minister of Justice to break out in a cold sweat.
"Don't talk nonsense, what do you mean by saying that the Ministry of Punishments doesn't deal with rebellion? If this gets out, those who don't know any better might think that the Ministry of Punishments is planning to rebel itself."
"Since you can't make a decision, then let someone who can make a decision come forward." Seeing the Minister of Justice still hesitating, Emperor Xia reminded from the side.
He knew his own son's character better than anyone; his good son probably really did intend to rebel. This matter must have a resolution!
As the Minister of Justice was hesitating, he had a moment of clarity upon hearing Emperor Xia's reminder. Right, what am I worrying about? It's not like there's no one above me.
With that thought, he immediately went in to find Minister of Justice Xu Xin.
At that moment, Xu Xin had just finished a short period of seclusion and had come out to refresh his spirits.
Before he could even relax, he heard his subordinates reporting to him.
"Lu Yang is here to report that the Fourth Prince is rebelling?!"
He wouldn't dare imagine such nonsensical things even when he faced his Inner Demon trial.
But the problem was this was not an Inner Demon trial, it was happening right before his eyes!
Xu Xin painfully clutched his head, had Daoist Buyu tired of tormenting him, and now it was his apprentice's turn?
This little apprentice's troublemaking skills were much stronger than Daoist Buyu's had ever been.
"Accept it, they've come all the way here to complain, it wouldn't be right not to accept it."
Based on his understanding of Lu Yang, although the kid could stir up trouble, he seemed not to tell lies.
The Ministry of Punishments, unusually, prepared to hold court to handle the case.
The Minister of Justice came to the entrance of the Ministry and respectfully invited Fairy Eternity inside, fearing that this little ancestor might cause some other trouble, like reporting that the Second Prince was also rebelling or something.
"You come in too. You heard the entire conversation I had with the youngest of the Jiang Family just now, didn't you? You're a witness." Fairy Eternity pulled Emperor Xia in as well.
"Right, what was your name again?"
Emperor Xia had already thought of a name before leaving the Imperial Palace; the Jiang Family liked to use fake names, and they traditionally liked to use "Xia" as a surname, and as the Emperor himself, the choice of name was obvious.
"Xia Tian."
He had prepared a whole set of false identities, not afraid of any identity check by the Ministry of Punishments.
The Ministry of Punishments held court.
Trusting Lu Yang, Xu Xin personally broke the seal on the Fourth Prince's Storage Ring and took out the Recording Orb inside.
In the Recording Orb, the Fourth Prince was vividly describing how exceptional his brothers were, explaining how he planned to take down his three elder brothers one by one, which made the witnessing Emperor Xia, standing beside him, turn ashen with rage.
The evidence was conclusive.
Xu Xin let out a breath. Just as Lu Yang had described, the Fourth Prince intended to rebel—this was a capital offense.
"Guards, throw the Fourth Prince into the dungeon!"
"Xu Xin, you dare!" The Fourth Prince became desperate. If he was thrown into the dungeon, then all hope was lost!
Xu Xin was indifferent to the Fourth Prince's bluster. "I was an officer before your father was even born, you are nothing," he thought impatiently, gesturing to have the Fourth Prince taken away.
"Lu Yang, rest assured, a prince committing a crime will be judged just as any commoner. This matter will certainly receive a fair trial," Xu Xin said agreeably to Lu Yang, hinting that Lu Yang should stop causing trouble since their Ministry's facilities were small and couldn't withstand much turmoil.
"Could the punishment extend to exterminating his nine clans?" Fairy Eternity was most concerned about this.
Xu Xin: "..."
Seeing Xu Xin not answering, Fairy Eternity turned to ask Emperor Xia:
"What do you think, can we exterminate his nine clans? If not, eradicating three clans works too."
Emperor Xia: "..."
Back in the Imperial Palace, you tried and failed to hit me, now you want to kill me outright, huh?

chapters.title: Chapter 850 - 849: The Fox Borrows the Tiger's Menace
chapters.content:
After Lu Yang, the great power, walked away, Xu Xin finally breathed a sigh of relief. Otherwise, this kid would have been clamoring for the Ministry of Punishments to execute the Fourth Prince's entire clan, making the situation difficult to resolve.
But immediately, another problem presented itself: the evidence of the Fourth Prince's rebellion was undeniable, yet he couldn't directly judge the Fourth Prince. This matter was too big for him to handle.
"Master, you still have superiors above you," the Deputy Minister of Justice reminded his confused boss with good intentions.
Xu Xin had an epiphany.
Right, I am merely the Minister of Justice, a Third Grade official. Matters of rebellion should be handled by His Majesty.
...
After Jiang Qun ascended the throne, he displayed exceptional political ability, handling various state affairs no less adeptly than Emperor Xia; otherwise, Emperor Xia would not have entrusted the throne to him temporarily.
"Father always said how troublesome it was to deal with the affairs of the state, to maneuver among various factions to balance interests. It seems it's not that difficult after all."
Jiang Qun placed a completed memorial on top of the half-person-tall stack of memorials.
The only problem was he remembered there weren't so many memorials before.
"Daoist Buyu has successfully passed Tribulation, and a large number of people have entered seclusion because of it," Jiang Qun realized the reason and sighed inwardly.
It was just a larger number than usual, but it didn't exceed his capabilities.
"Let me see this memorial. Master Xu has temporarily left seclusion, huh? What has he encountered... My fourth brother plotted rebellion, Lu Yang reported him, and even requested to execute his entire clan?!"
Jiang Qun trembled slightly after he skimmed through it.
I take back what I said before. Father, do you deal with matters like these on a daily basis?
As he read the memorial carefully, he grew angrier with every line, finally snorting coldly and slamming the table.
"How dare you, my fourth brother, even think of killing me! You are truly audacious!"
He replied to the memorial, instructing the Ministry of Punishments to summon several Transcendance Tribulation Stage great powers from the court to capture all of fourth brother's allies in one fell swoop!
As for the matter of executing the nine clans, that too was easy to handle.
"Wouldn't pardoning myself suffice?"
...
The major purge against the Fourth Prince's faction began quickly. The people on the Fourth Prince's side didn't even fully understand what had happened before they were inexplicably arrested.
Wasn't it said that Lu Yang was seeking external forces to help the Fourth Prince eliminate the first three princes? How did it end up with his own side being arrested?
What happened?
The Fourth Prince's faction was not small, and during the arrests, they attempted to resist, sparking numerous battles.
However, with several Transcendence Tribulation Stage veteran ministers as the backbone, their resistance didn't make a splash.
The fall of the Fourth Prince shocked the various forces within the Imperial City. Originally, as Emperor Xia's life seemed to be at an end, all factions had their schemes, looking to profit from the situation. But now, the dynasty quelled them temporarily with an overwhelming force.
The Second Prince couldn't believe the intelligence he read. In just a few days, his fourth brother had been eliminated by Lu Yang.
"Could it be that he wants to warn everyone not to attempt to usurp the throne by winning him over?"
The Second Prince shivered, resolving never to be an enemy of that man!
The Fifth Prince, who had originally wanted to win over Lu Yang, calmed down, not daring to target Lu Yang any further, with all subsequent plans of alliance nullified.
...
Fairy Eternity, the mastermind behind the scenes, heard the news about the Fourth Prince's mansion being sealed and happily awaited the Ministry of Punishments to raid the Imperial Palace.
"To my knowledge, according to the legal system of Great Xia, the Emperor has the power to pardon. If you want to implicate the entire clan through the Fourth Prince's affair, I'm afraid it is impossible," Emperor Xia explained to Lu Yang, who had been muttering all the way about when the Ministry of Punishments would raid the house.
The muttering was making him twitch with irritation, so he had to step in to stop Lu Yang's grumbling.
"There is such a law?" Fairy Eternity indeed did not know, and even with her wisdom, couldn't come up with a foolproof plan to usurp the throne.
"It seems that the Jiang Family had far-sightedness indeed, devising such a thorough law about immunity back then, already considering events that would happen today!" Fairy Eternity frowned; the Jiang Family was capable of formulating such meticulous laws; their carefulness was not much weaker than that of the Second-in-command, only a hair's breadth away from hers.
Emperor Xia: "..."
I think when the immunity was first put in place, no one had anticipated what happened today.
"I see you as someone with talent as well. How about you join me?"
Fairy Eternity felt that Xia Tian was quick-witted and could be appointed as Prime Minister once the Great Soy Dynasty was established.
Emperor Xia was unaware that he had already been demoted to the future Prime Minister; he only heard that Lu Yang was a genius of his time, frequently engaging in unusual behavior, with odd occurrences always happening around him.
His time was running out, so he might as well witness the growth of a future genius firsthand and reveal his identity at a critical moment—it would make this experience worthwhile.
"Sure," Emperor Xia agreed cheerfully.
...
"That's Lu Yang!" In the darkness, several pairs of green, gleaming eyes were staring fixedly at Lu Yang.
They were the brothers of the Fourth Prince, having broken through the encirclement and temporarily escaped a prison fate.
But this was only temporary. Now that the Imperial City was sealed off, they could not escape capture, which was just a matter of time.
Being captured was not feared, but the traitor Lu Yang must die!
With Gongsun Jiu's swift Cultivation Technique, Tang Feng's assassination skills bordering on supernatural, and the advanced poisoner... All these were brothers of the Fourth Prince, proud of their ability to execute the elder three princes—once they made their move, Lu Yang, a mere Nascent Soul Stage cultivator, could not possibly withstand them!
"Attack!"
Gongsun Jiu's Spiritual Sense transmitted his shout, and, hearing the signal, his brothers moved like envoys from Nine Nether, their strikes meant death!
No sooner had they left the ground than they sensed several terrifying pressures coming their way, pinning them down firmly.
Thump.
Unable to withstand such pressure, they fell to their knees, faces filled with panic.
Transcendence Tribulation Stage, and not just one but several Transcendence Tribulation Stage powers had taken action against them!
Even the Ministry of Punishments did not dispatch this many Transcendence Tribulation Stage powers when inspecting the Fourth Prince's residence!
What was happening? Why were so many Transcendence Tribulation Stage powers protecting Lu Yang?
Could it be that Lu Yang had calculated even this!?
An old man carrying a shoulder pole emerged from an alley, hawking his services: "Sharpening scissors, come get your scissors sharpened!"
The old man stood before Gongsun Jiu, a look of disdain on his face.
"Daring to lay hands on His Majesty, you must truly be tired of living."
Gongsun Jiu and the others looked bewildered. His Majesty? What His Majesty?
The safety of Emperor Xia was of utmost importance; there was no way he could have left the Imperial Palace alone. Experts from the palace had been following him all along, secretly protecting him.
Even if Gongsun Jiu and his group were targeting Lu Yang, there was a potential risk of harming His Majesty, and they could not be allowed to make a move.
In the Spiritual Space, Lu Yang was analyzing the situation with Fairy Eternity.
"Your Majesty, having exposed the Fourth Prince, you may be subject to revenge from his remnants in the future. You need to be careful," Lu Yang said.
Lu Yang was not worried about Fairy Eternity's safety; he was worried about his own body.
His skinny arms and legs couldn't withstand Fairy Eternity's tussling.
Fairy Eternity was touched, not expecting Xiao Yang to be so concerned about her, and reassured him saying, "Don't worry, don't worry at all, I've always been lucky, and there won't be any danger."

chapters.title: Chapter 851 - 850 Open Mountain Axe
chapters.content:
Despite being completely unaware himself, Fairy Eternity had, in effect, already become a figure of great interest in the Imperial City, with various powers keeping a close eye on Lu Yang's every move.
The Second Prince and Fifth Prince were especially attentive to Lu Yang's dynamics.
They knew that the remnants of the Fourth Prince would certainly make a move against Lu Yang, which was the price for opposing the princes.
Although they were in competition with the Fourth Prince, it was still a matter among the royal family, and it was not Lu Yang's place, an outsider, to interfere.
Moreover, he had used the filthy means of denunciation.
A bloody price must be paid!
Yet, after a long wait, what came was the silent disappearance of the Fourth Prince's followers, without leaving behind even a single corpse, only several large pits that were formed when they were kneeling on the ground.
"Transcendence Tribulation Stage! There's more than one Transcendence Tribulation Stage powerhouse by Lu Yang's side!" They concluded simultaneously, if only one Transcendence Tribulation powerhouse made a move, it couldn't have been handled so cleanly!
"No wonder Lu Yang has always been so confident; we thought he was backed by the Seek Dao Sect, but we didn't expect him to have a Transcendence Tribulation expert right by his side!"
The two were filled with shock and uncertainty, the more they interacted with Lu Yang, the more frightening they found him to be, his strength unfathomably deep!
Nobody knew, however, that the glorious Lu Yang had long been possessed by an Ancient Immortal, and the current Lu Yang was nothing more than a puppet casually played with by an Ancient Immortal, how sad and lamentable it was.
Back at the Meng Residence, because the Meng Family was besieged from all sides, outsiders couldn't possibly enter the residence, but Meng Potian was very optimistic about Lu Yang's future and granted him rights within the Meng Family equivalent to those of Meng Jingzhou.
That meant all rights except inheritance rights, which included bringing outsiders in.
Meng Potian, in particular, after hearing that Lu Yang relied on the Ministry of Punishments to eliminate the Fourth Prince, felt more than ever that Lu Yang was fated to be aligned with their Meng Family.
"Brother Lu Yang, you're back?" Meng Jingyu ran over excitedly upon seeing Lu Yang return.
"Who is this brother?" Meng Jingyu curiously looked towards Xia Tian, who was behind Lu Yang.
Emperor Xia's face twitched when he heard Meng Jingyu calling him "brother."
He knew Meng Jingyu, he even personally attended her hundred-days feast.
The mother of the Meng Jingzhou siblings was Emperor Xia's eldest sister, the Princess Royal, so by generation, the Meng Jingzhou siblings were his nieces and nephews.
"His name is Xia Tian. Although his Cultivation Level isn't great, he makes up for it with a sharp mind and now he's following me," Fairy Eternity said in a tone reminiscent of a bandit leader, which to Meng Jingyu sounded inexplicably impressive.
Meng Jingyu blinked and cheerfully greeted, "Hello, Brother Xia."
Now, Emperor Xia began to regret his decision, how could he forget that, although following Lu Yang might broaden his horizons, Lu Yang had a good relationship with Meng Jingzhou and was sure to be in frequent contact with Meng Family Members.
What should he do?
He had just entered the Meng Residence and was already reduced in stature.
Meng Jingyu had little interest in Xia Tian and pulled Lu Yang by the hand towards the study.
"Brother Lu Yang, the teacher left some homework for me to do about Ancient Times, can you teach me? Brother often praises you for your exceptional knowledge of Ancient Times."
The Meng Family valued the comprehensive development of their children, which included history.
Upon hearing this, Fairy Eternity immediately agreed.
"A trifling matter."
When it came to Ancient Times, who could be more familiar than her?
...
Meng Jingyu was a devoted and studious child. The study was lined with neatly arranged books whose covers were slightly dirty, clearly the result of frequent perusal, unlike Fairy Eternity, who would just leave books to collect dust in the study.
"How do I solve this problem? There was an Ancient Immortal who forged the Open Mountain Axe. What was the reason for its forging?"
If the real Lu Yang had been there, he would have tactfully told Meng Jingyu that there was nothing worthwhile in studying ancient history, and that focusing on modern history was a good approach.
But Lu Yang had been possessed, and Fairy Eternity only spoke the blunt truth.
"If you're asking about that, there's a lot to tell..."
...
The next day, the private school teacher scanned the fidgeting Meng Family juniors with a cold gaze. He was famously grumpy and stubborn, and he feared no one.
"Yesterday's homework was indeed challenging, especially the origins of the Open Mountain Axe."
"As everyone knows, the Open Mountain Axe is an ancient magic artifact. Although its power is nowhere near that of the Immortal Artifact, Sky-Opening Axe, its fame is by no means less than that of the Open Mountain Axe."
The Open Mountain Axe and Sky-Opening Axe were both very famous. Back when Seek Dao Sect conducted their entrance trial, River Spirit had drawn forth from the river an ordinary axe, an Open Mountain Axe, and a Sky-Opening Axe.
"Regarding the origin of the Open Mountain Axe, there's no clear record in any ancient text, but if you carefully read the additional materials I assigned, you can infer the answer."
"The Open Mountain Axe was forged by the Yingtian Immortal before he became an Immortal."
"According to the records, the ancient people were trapped within a hundred thousand mountains, unable to travel or communicate with the outside world. Yingtian Immortal forged an axe, split open the mountains, and created a path. The ancient people revered this axe as the Open Mountain Axe."
The teacher's voice grew colder: "But look at you. You all handed in blank papers. Of course, there were those who didn't submit blank papers, like Meng Jingyu. Come, tell us what you wrote!"
Meng Jingyu spoke confidently about the story Fairy Eternity had told him yesterday: "In ancient times, Yingtian Immortal was poor and destitute. To make a living, he dug through mountains to collect a toll. He would place his axe across the path and say to travelers, 'This mountain is mine to open, this tree is mine to plant.
If you wish to pass through here, leave behind some money as a toll.' Only after receiving the money would Yingtian Immortal lift the axe to let them pass."
"The ancient people thus called this axe the Open Mountain Axe."
"Is this what you learned from reading books?" The teacher looked puzzled. Which bootleg book was corrupting the youth?
"Brother Lu Yang told me all this; it must be right." Meng Jingyu had complete trust in Lu Yang.
"Lu Yang? Call him over. I'll have a word with him!" The teacher was certainly aware of Lu Yang's reputation, but Lu Yang was known for his cultivation talents, not as a history prodigy. He himself had devoted years to the painstaking study of ancient history and would not be intimidated by Lu Yang in matters of ancient history.
Meng Jingyu promptly invited Fairy Eternity over.
"Brother Lu Yang, the teacher said you were wrong about yesterday's story."
"Ah, where was I wrong?" Fairy Eternity wondered, puzzled. Had she remembered incorrectly? That shouldn't be. She had come up with all those details for Yingtian Immortal herself.
The teacher reiterated the standard answer, which was also the academically accepted one.
"Isn't that pretty much what I said?"
The teacher, puffing with anger and glaring, retorted, "It's very different. According to you, Yingtian Immortal is a highway robber!"
Fairy Eternity asked defiantly, "How did that turn into robbery? Yingtian Immortal painstakingly used the axe to carve through the mountains and forge a path. He cultivated the 'Tree-Planting Sutra', planted trees, and charged a small fee. Isn't that reasonable?"
"But Yingtian Immortal wouldn't say something like 'this mountain is mine to open!'" The teacher felt this was a slander of the image of Ancient Immortals!
Fairy Eternity was even more puzzled, "If you don't say it like that, how will others know that you were the one who opened the mountain and be willing to pay the fee willingly?"

chapters.title: Chapter 852 - 851: An Unexpected Acquaintance
chapters.content:
```
The private school teacher opened his mouth, intending to retort, but the words just wouldn't come out.
It seemed that what Lu Yang said also made sense.
"Then how do you explain the Open Mountain Axe, the Yingtian Immortal couldn't possibly have used the axe to split open a path in the sky, shout 'This sky was opened by me,' and then charge a toll, naming the axe after that!"
The teacher thought of the origin of the Open Mountain Axe, and how none of the ancient books from the past recorded why Yingtian Immortal named the magic artifact the Open Mountain Axe; this was a mystery that plagued scholars of ancient history, with numerous conflicting theories.
Some said that the Immortal had used the magic artifact to split the heavens, separating the chaos and dividing yin and yang, others said that when the axe was forged, there were phenomena of sky-opening, where all spirits bowed in worship, and there were even those who said that with this axe, the Immortal could reforge heaven and earth, unleashing landslides, fires, winds, and thunders...
Ancient historians debated endlessly over this, never reaching a consensus, all were speculations, with no evidence.
"Because Yingtian Immortal thought this name was very cool, what other reason does he need?" Fairy Eternity looked at the private school teacher, puzzled.
Although she always felt that names for martial arts techniques and magic artifacts didn't need to be flamboyant, and that simplicity was good, like the Playing Dead Technique or the Immortal Fist Technique, Yingtian Immortal always thought the names of techniques and artifacts had to be cool, such as the Open Mountain Axe, the Chaos Furnace, the Universe Bell.
"Ridiculous, what sort of person is Yingtian Immortal, there must be profound meaning behind his choice of names!" The teacher obviously did not believe Fairy Eternity's words, considering them absurd.
"Like the legendary Chaos Furnace, clearly recorded in ancient books, Yingtian Immortal once used this furnace to refine chaos, which is why it was named the Chaos Furnace!"
"You're talking about the Chaos Furnace, huh? That's because I—" Fairy Eternity unconsciously exposed her identity midway through her words, feeling it was inappropriate, and on the fly she changed her story, "That's because Yingtian Immortal once cooked a Qiongqi in the furnace, so he named it the Chaos Furnace."
A Qiongqi, one of the four fiends of ancient times, as famous as the Qiongqi itself.
Fairy Eternity actually missed the Chaos Furnace quite a bit, feeling that when she cooked without it, something was missing from the flavor.
The private school teacher hesitated for a moment and didn't argue back; suddenly, he remembered that Yingtian Immortal seemed to have written a "Culinary Bible," which mentioned how to cook Qiongqi, and it seemed to make sense.
Could it be that Yingtian Immortal's level in naming was really so low?
"Lu Yang, since you claim to have some understanding of ancient history, would you dare to come to my Imperial Academy for an academic discussion?"
The private school teacher named Ye Gu was not a member of the Meng Family, but rather a historian from the Imperial Academy; he was teaching at the Meng Family's private school simply because they paid well.
"Right now?"
"Right now!" Ye Gu, having been continuously challenged by Fairy Eternity, decided to seek help at the Imperial Academy.
No sooner had he spoken these words than the Meng Family disciples below burst into joyous noise.
If the teacher returned to the Imperial Academy, it meant they wouldn't have class today.
Ye Gu shot a fierce glare at these rascals and had the printed test papers distributed, resulting in an instant outcry.
Emperor Xia hadn't entered the private school; he was waiting outside and then saw Lu Yang walk out.
"Where are you off to?"
"To the Imperial Academy, this person thinks I am pretty good at ancient history and has invited me to give a lecture there," Fairy Eternity declared gleefully.
Emperor Xia looked perplexed; the Imperial Academy was full of cantankerous old scholars with stubborn attitudes. They were willing to have Lu Yang give a lecture?
"I am inviting you to my Imperial Academy for an academic debate!" Ye Gu corrected.
"Provoking me into action, huh? I understand all that," Fairy Eternity saw right through Ye Gu's none-too-subtle machinations.
As Lu Yang's follower, Emperor Xia naturally also went to the Imperial Academy.
...
The Imperial Academy was a renowned institution in Great Xia, but unlike other schools, it didn't focus on cultivation but on history, with most information on the histories of Great Qian and Great Yu originating from the research achievements of the Academy.
And the most mysterious and oft-discussed ancient history was also within the area of study at the Imperial Academy.
```
Along the way, Fairy Eternity saw many disheveled scholars arguing with each other, each holding their own opinions, and none willing to give ground.
"This 'Culinary Bible' clearly records that cooking should use seconds as the unit. How can there be a mistake!"
"Mistaken characters, these must be mistaken characters!"
"What mistaken characters? It must be because the Yingtian Immortal likes salt. Have you not heard that after Yingtian Immortal defeats strong enemies, he always speaks condescendingly, saying, 'The salt I've consumed is more than the roads you've traveled.' That's solid evidence!"
Three scholars started to quarrel, and they seemed ready to come to blows at any moment.
In the Spiritual Space, Lu Yang silently watched all this, feeling that Yingtian Immortal's reputation might be very hard to recover.
Lu Yang then saw another group of scholars discussing.
"Based on my analysis, Yingtian Immortal's Dao Fruit may very well be related to the Heavenly Tribulation."
"Indeed possible... What did you just say?"
"I was saying Yingtian Immortal... Right, what did I just say?"
The two scholars looked at each other blankly, unable to remember what had just happened.
Ye Gu led Lu Yang and Emperor Xia to the depths of the academy, to a simple thatched cottage.
Inside the thatched cottage, an elderly man with pale complexion was discussing something animatedly, his expressions lively with excitement.
The old man was none other than the dean of the academy, Qi Xiuya, long renowned and masterly knowledgeable in ancient and modern history, unmatched in his understanding of history, and thus reverently known as "Dean Qi" or "Old Qi" in the outside world. He rarely showed his face outside, living a secluded life, so much so that even the famous Lu Yang had never heard of him.
He could even be said to have no enmity with Daoist Buyu, indicating just how disconnected he was from the world.
The person sitting opposite him had his back to the door, making it impossible to see his face.
When Qi Xiuya saw Ye Gu enter, he asked with surprise and a smile.
"Little Gu, at this time you should be teaching at the Meng Family, why have you come here?"
"Teacher, while I was giving a lecture at the Meng Family, we discussed the origin of the Open Mountain Axe, and this Daoist friend named Lu Yang offered another possibility for the origin of the Open Mountain Axe."
Ye Gu repeated what Fairy Eternity had said, and Qi Xiuya stroked his long white beard, silent.
"That is an interesting viewpoint, but there's no evidence, is there?"
Not knowing whether Fairy Eternity was right or wrong, Qi Xiuya had to seek the opinion of the person sitting opposite him.
"Daoist Jin, what do you think?"
Qi Xiuya formally introduced the person opposite him: "Let me introduce, this is a Daoist friend I recently made. He may look young, but he has a unique insight into ancient history. Our brief conversations have greatly enlightened me."
The person known as Daoist Jin thought for a moment: "Indeed, I've heard that in earlier years, before Yingtian Immortal rose to prominence, he was short on cultivation resources and collected tolls using the Open Mountain Axe, even uttering 'This mountain was opened by me...' and such."
"Strange, people nowadays shouldn't know about this."
Daoist Jin stood up and faced Lu Yang, his gaze slightly astonished.
Only then did Lu Yang get a clear view of Daoist Jin — a petite girl with delicate and adorable features, her Little Face stern, not given to smiles or laughter.
Lu Yang did not recognize Daoist Jin, but Fairy Eternity did.
She was the young progenitor of the Qiongqi Clan, Jin Caiwei.

chapters.title: Chapter 853 - 852 Jin Caiwei
chapters.content:
Fairy Eternity recognized Jin Caiwei at the same time as Jin Caiwei recognized Lu Yang.
Ever since the last time the Gold Clan Leader returned to the clan and proposed an alliance with the Seek Dao Sect for their Qiongqi Clan, she had been pondering the issue.
The Seek Dao Sect did indeed qualify for cooperation with them due to having the Semi-Immortal Vast Sea Daoist Lord, who possessed the embryonic Spatial Dao Fruit.
However, she was used to doing things alone and did not like cooperating with others.
Afterward, she listed the forces that currently surpassed their Qiongqi Clan, feeling that without alliances it would be difficult to establish a foothold in the Great Era's conflict.
Zhu Tian ruled the Demon Territory, with more than ten cultivators who had passed tribulation under his command, and with Jiang Lianyi and Ao Ling awakening, she couldn't contend with the forces of these three familiar Ancient beings.
It is suspected that there is a Semi-Immortal within the Buddha Country, and in a real fight, she herself might not be afraid, but the Qiongqi Clan as a whole definitely couldn't defeat the Buddha Country.
The Great Xia Dynasty had inscrutable strength, and there was a very good chance they had Immortals, unbeatable.
The Ancient Heavenly Court was even harder to fight, with two Immortals.
As for the Great Yu forces, she couldn't contend with the three great masters: the original Emperor Yu and the two Imperial Teachers.
The Great Qian forces remained out of sight.
An unknown Immortal had also emerged in the East Sea, and it was uncertain which force was behind them, but they too were unbeatable.
The fact that the Meng Family could provoke so many formidable enemies and still survive indicated that there must be a Semi-Immortal behind them.
This does not even take into account the three Ancient Immortals including Yingtian Immortal.
Jin Caiwei grew more and more alarmed as she counted, realizing that it would be impossible to maintain a position in the top eleven if the Qilin Immortal didn't show up.
These powers were either too large and wealthy, unsuitable for cooperation with the Qiongqi Clan, or they had Immortals, where she wouldn't hold the initiative.
Considering this, only the Seek Dao Sect met the conditions for cooperation, with both sides having Semi-Immortals and being roughly equal in size.
"Little Jin Que had a good point, we could consider partnering with the Seek Dao Sect," she said.
Based on this consideration, she decided to visit the Seek Dao Sect for an assessment.
But she didn't go directly to the Seek Dao Sect, being too straightforward was not good, so she headed to Imperial City, the cultivation center of Great Xia, to learn the cultivators' opinions on the Seek Dao Sect.
During this time, she heard that the Imperial Academy had some research on ancient history, so she wanted to come here to see the findings of the Imperial Academy's research and by chance ran into the Academy's Dean, Qi Xiuya.
But she did not expect to encounter Lu Yang here.
As the next Sect Leader of the Seek Dao Sect, highly valued by the Vast Sea Daoist Lord and a cultivation prodigy, Lu Yang was a key figure for Jin Caiwei to investigate.
From Lu Yang's recent revelation of Yingtian Immortal's secrets, it appeared Lu Yang had secrets of his own.
"Oh, it's Little Tiger!" Fairy Eternity pointed at Jin Caiwei and laughed, not expecting that Jin Caiwei the Little Tiger would still be alive; she had held Jin Caiwei even before she could take on human form.
Upon hearing Lu Yang bluntly reveal her identity, Jin Caiwei instantly became alert, her hackles raising, and her pupils turning into the bright yellow of a tiger's, like a little cat startled by shock.
He was clearly only at the Nascent Soul Stage, how could he possibly see her race!
Fairy Eternity suddenly realized that she was using Lu Yang's identity, which meant she couldn't possibly recognize Jin Caiwei, so she pointed at the jade pendant on Jin Caiwei's chest and said,
"Oh, I mean the little tiger on your jade pendant is really cute."
The tiger medallion jade pendant on Jin Caiwei's chest was a gift from the old Qiongqi.
Realizing it was all a misunderstanding, Jin Caiwei finally breathed a sigh of relief.
"Fairy, who is this person?" Inside the Spiritual Space, Lu Yang realized that Fairy Eternity was trying to conceal the truth.
"Do you remember when we were in the Qiongqi ancient tomb, there was a coffin belonging to the old Qiongqi? The old Qiongqi had a daughter named Jin Caiwei, who had a good relationship with the Qilin Immortal, though she didn't get along with Xiao Ling and Lianyi."
"At that time I was puzzled; the old Qiongqi died of old age, Jin Caiwei was only at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, so she should have died before the old Qiongqi, yet there was no grave for Jin Caiwei in the ancient tomb."
"Now I understand, this little tiger didn't die but entered a slumber after breaking through to Semi-Immortal, and has now awakened."
"Semi-Immortal?!" Lu Yang was startled. How did a Semi-Immortal suddenly appear? Weren't they supposed to be very rare, popping up as frequently as white radishes?
This case was different from dealing with Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi; Jin Caiwei didn't remember Fairy Eternity, nor did she have messages left by the Qilin Immortal, so getting cozy with her was out of the question.
President Qi was unaware of the complex relationship between this human, demon, and immortal. Seeing Jin Caiwei agree with Lu Yang's point of view, he couldn't help but smile with interest.
He was aware of Jin Caiwei's capabilities, which far surpassed his own understanding of ancient history.
This indicated that what Lu Yang said was true history, and indeed the Open Mountain Axe was the magic artifact Yingtian Immortal used to intercept and demand a toll.
"It seems that young friend Lu Yang has a profound understanding of ancient history. I just happen to have a question and would like to seek answers from both of you."
Emperor Xia listened in surprise, so the Open Mountain Axe really came about like that?
"Go ahead and ask," Fairy Eternity said, finding herself a chair and sitting down next to Jin Caiwei.
Jin Caiwei was a very cautious person, reluctant to interact with strangers, yet for some reason, she did not feel uncomfortable when Lu Yang sat beside her.
President Qi earnestly asked, "Legend has it that during Ancient Times, Yingtian Immortal and Time Immortal fought a battle on the moon after they achieved immortality. Unfortunately, very few were qualified to watch it. Do you know anything about the process, or who ultimately won?"
After pondering for a moment, Jin Caiwei earnestly said, "I have heard of this matter. It's said that Yingtian Immortal and Time Immortal had a fundamental conflict in their cultivation techniques, necessitating a grand battle to prove their Dao hearts."
"In that battle, Yingtian Immortal wielded the Open Sky Axe with a power that shocked the world; it seemed as if it truly had the ability to cleave heaven and earth. As a being born from the Firmament Tree, Time Immortal naturally resonated with trees. Time Immortal controlled the trees, and ancient trees reached up to the skies, endless and boundless, impossible to see the end at a glance."
"The two Immortals clashed with awe-inspiring powers, an ultimate display of destruction and an extreme force of life, dazzling for all eternity. Countless ancient trees were felled by Yingtian Immortal, yet many more ancient trees regenerated from severed branches, an incessant cycle that turned the entire moon into a sea of old trees.
Those who witnessed the battle trembled with fear, not daring to approach, lest they be swept up in the confrontation."
"In the end, they concluded in a draw, neither side victorious."
Although she had not witnessed the battle herself, Jin Caiwei recounted the story as her father had told her, confident in its accuracy.
Even now, the thought of that scene, as described by everyone, sent chills down her spine – the combat power of Immortals was truly terrifying.
"Huh? That's how it went down? Wasn't it just that Yingtian Immortal and Time Immortal got drunk one day, with Yingtian Immortal bragging about how fast he could swing his axe, and Time Immortal boasting about how well he cultivated the 'Tree-Planting Sutra' and how quickly saplings grew?
Both refusing to back down, they had a contest on the moon, didn't they?" Fairy Eternity scratched the back of her head, her recollection not quite matching with the picture painted by the little tiger.
"Then Yingtian Immortal kept swinging his axe tirelessly, and Time Immortal kept casting the 'Tree-Planting Sutra', both of them worn out and panting."
"Their antics even scared away the Jade Rabbit clan that lived on the moon."

chapters.title: Chapter 854 - 853 The Wives of Qilin Immortal
chapters.content:
"Is that so?" Principal Qi thought to himself that the scene described by Lu Yang was somewhat different from what he had anticipated, and it was actually Jin Caiwei's description that better matched his understanding of immortals, with grand gestures and a commanding presence.
Jin Caiwei, uncharacteristically hesitant, didn't know whether to affirm or deny Lu Yang's answer.
She was born at the end of the ancient times, an era long past when geniuses contested the path of ascension. The Four Ancient Immortals were in their prime, ruling over the cosmos, and her father, the elder Qiongqi, was one of the ancient forces, his status just below that of the four immortals.
At that time, her cultivation level was not enough to truly participate in many events, such as battles between immortals; she could only rely on her father's narrations.
The battle between Yingtian Immortal and Time Immortal was known to her through her father's descriptions.
She remembered the Qilin Immortal saying that much of history had been glossed over by that shameless Yingtian Immortal. One must not only look at the surface but consider the actual situation.
The scene described by Lu Yang fitted with what the Qilin Immortal had called the "actual situation."
Furthermore, Lu Yang spoke with more certainty than she did, as if he had seen it with his own eyes, providing vivid details. This confidence was something Jin Caiwei lacked.
"I also do not know," Jin Caiwei helplessly shook her head, unable to judge the veracity of Lu Yang's words.
"I see," Principal Qi thought that this battle was indeed enigmatic, which did align with the characteristics of ancient history.
Principal Qi then earnestly advised Ye Gu, "Little Gu, I have long told you not to become arrogant just because you have learned a little about ancient history. Ancient times were the most glorious and brilliant era in the cultivation world, abound with endless legends. Even a lifetime's pursuit could not reveal all its mysteries."
"Look at these two young friends. Their understanding of ancient history surpasses yours, yet they provide two different answers for the same event, which shows the mystery of ancient history."
Ye Gu felt deeply shamed by Principal Qi's words.
"Teacher, I understand my mistake."
"As long as you understand, that's good. Now, go back to the Meng Family to teach."
After being sent back by Principal Qi to the Ye Family, Ye Gu continued to discuss ancient history with Jin Caiwei and Lu Yang. Jin Caiwei's descriptions were truly eye-opening and allowed him to learn many ancient secrets.
"Are you saying that the Qilin Immortal had not only the Dragon Clan Ancestor and the Phoenix Ancestor as wives, but there was also a junior ancestor from the Qiongqi Clan who was his wife?"
When Jiang Lianyi publicly declared that the Qilin Immortal had two wives, herself and Ao Ling, it caused a huge stir in the academic field of ancient history. It was unexpected to learn that the Qilin Immortal had yet another wife.
Principal Qi only knew that the cultivator before him was called Jin Caiwei but was unaware that the junior ancestor of the Qiongqi Clan was also named Jin Caiwei; he couldn't correlate the two.
Unlike the renowned great powers like Ao Ling and Zhu Tian, Jin Caiwei's fame was not as widespread. Later generations only knew of the elder Qiongqi and were unaware of a junior Qiongqi.
"May I ask, in which ancient tome did fellow Daoist Jin find these records?"
As a scholar, Principal Qi naturally could not simply believe whatever Jin Caiwei said; there had to be evidence.
He had perused numerous ancient tomes, yet none ever mentioned anything about the Qilin Immortal having three wives.
"Of course, there is."
Jin Caiwei mysteriously produced an ancient tome from the ancient times, which clearly recorded that the Qilin Immortal had three wives—the third being from the Qiongqi Clan.
Principal Qi, having received this ancient tome, treasured it as a priceless artifact.
The contents detailed many things unknown to later generations, the value of which was immeasurable.
"I always thought it strange; the current emperor can have three palaces and six courtyards, so how could the Qilin Immortal, a magnificent immortal, possibly have just two wives."
Emperor Xia: "..."
Director Qi, I haven't provoked you, have I? I've never withheld funding for your Tai Academy.
"Fairy, what's going on here?" Lu Yang was very puzzled. While Director Qi was translating the ancient language word for word, Lu Yang had already finished reading it.
Which ancient tome would dare to write that the Qilin Immortal has three wives? Are Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi made of clay or something?
"Was the ancient book falsified?"
"There's no falsification. This book is indeed from ancient times; it's probably written by Little Tiger herself."
Fairy Eternity guessed a lot, and this ancient book was indeed written by Jin Caiwei during the Ancient Times—anyone who came to investigate would say it's the real deal.
The only problem is, not everything recorded in ancient books is guaranteed to be the truth.
Lu Yang sincerely felt that being a historian was a tough job. On the one hand, the Yingtian Immortal acted unscrupulously for the sake of prestige, and on the other, Jin Caiwei fabricated history to climb the ranks. Anyone who researched it ended up confused.
Luckily, he had Fairy Eternity, who knew the entire truth about ancient history... No, that's wrong, the best thing was that he didn't know!
One of Jin Caiwei's purposes for coming to the Tai Academy was to spread rumors. Although she couldn't defeat Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi, she could gain an advantage in public opinion.
After deceiving Director Qi, Jin Caiwei looked at Lu Yang with a wary eye. This man named Lu Yang was no simple character; she feared he knew she was lying.
While Director Qi busied himself with the ancient book, Jin Caiwei bared her little tiger teeth and made a threatening grimace at Fairy Eternity, warning her not to reveal the truth.
"The Qilin Immortal indeed has another wife who is a little Qiongqi."
Fairy Eternity, contrary to her normal behavior, did not expose Jin Caiwei's lie, but instead helped her, leaving Lu Yang very puzzled.
"Fairy, you this..."
"What's the matter? Little Tiger is not wrong, the Qilin Immortal himself admitted it."
"There's such a story?!"
"That must have been before the Qilin Immortal got married to Xiao Ling and Lianyi. They pressed the Qilin Immortal to reveal whom he truly liked and whom he would take as his wife."
"He hugged them both and said that he liked both of them, so they were both his wives."
"If you follow this logic, that means the Qilin Immortal also likes Little Tiger, naturally making Little Tiger one of his wives as well." Fairy Eternity didn't just spout nonsense; everything she said was well-founded and logical.
"So the Qilin Immortal actually has quite a few wives, like the little Qiongqi, the Nine-Tailed Fox, and so on."
Lu Yang felt that it was fortunate that the Qilin Immortal had become a true Immortal. If the Qilin Immortal were only a Semi-Immortal, he might have ended up like that Harem Golden Core, facing a terrible fate of being dismembered.
"Later on, I felt that the Qilin Immortal liked so many people that I wanted to know if there was anyone he liked the most, just like ranking the top beauties of Ancient Times. Although they are all quite pretty, there should be some sort of order."
"I gathered all his wives and asked the Qilin Immortal who he liked the most."
"Shivering with excitement, and seeing him shiver so terribly, I tied him to a chair, securely, and then he stopped shivering."
"Perhaps the Qilin Immortal loves each person equally; in the end, he never did say who his favorite was."
Fairy Eternity shook her head in disappointment, unsatisfied with the outcome.
"After I left, I heard that the Qilin Immortal was beaten and howled quite loudly. It was probably a bit of spousal affection, but since it's private, I didn't inquire further."
Jin Caiwei didn't know what Fairy Eternity was thinking, but seeing her help with the lie, she seemed like a promising junior who could be greatly nurtured in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 855 - 854 Enough Hands
chapters.content:
Having achieved her purpose at the academy, Jin Caiwei saw no need to stay any longer and quickly bid farewell to Dean Qi.
"Little Tiger, wait up, do you want to hang out with me?" Fairy Eternity squatted down in front of Jin Caiwei and asked with a smile.
Jin Caiwei had a tiger-shaped pendant; Fairy Eternity referring to it as Little Tiger wasn't inappropriate.
Coming across a person from Ancient Times was rare. Even though she couldn't remember her past, Fairy Eternity was still quite willing to make more contact.
Moreover, establishing a new dynasty always required people.
"Follow you?" Jin Caiwei sized Lu Yang up and down. If it had been anyone else speaking to her like that, she would have torn them in half by now.
But she had an inexplicable sense of familiarity towards Lu Yang, which curbed her impulse.
"Yeah, follow me," Fairy Eternity said cheerfully, pointing to Xia Tian, who was acting as her retainer.
"Look, there's already someone who's willing to hang out with me."
Jin Caiwei pondered. Her purpose in coming to Great Xia was to study what kind of sect the Seek Dao Sect really was; following Lu Yang indeed matched her purpose.
"Fine, I'll follow you for a while."
In the Spiritual Space, Lu Yang's eyes twitched as he listened to the two converse. If it were him, he would never dare to have a Semi-Immortal following him around.
"Who is this person willing to hang out with you?" Jin Caiwei noticed the unobtrusive presence of Emperor Xia.
"His name is Xia Tian; he is an exceptionally talented individual," Fairy Eternity valued Emperor Xia highly.
Jin Caiwei wasn't very interested in Emperor Xia and simply responded with an "Oh."
Fairy Eternity led the way, with Xia Tian and Jin Caiwei following behind as retainers.
Xia Tian valued Jin Caiwei's ancient knowledge and quietly approached to ask, "Miss Jin, do you have any intention of joining the academy? With your talent, you could quickly rise to the position of dean."
Even Dean Qi admitted he was not as knowledgeable as Jin Caiwei in ancient history.
Jin Caiwei, tilting her head back with disdain, glanced at Xia Tian. She was not tall, so she had to look up at everyone, which made her rather fond of Lu Yang, who was willing to squat down to talk to her.
"Crazy," she said.
"Hey, girl, you don't recognize kindness!" Xia Tian, with his identity, had never been spoken to like that.
But he was not one to hold grudges. When this girl found herself in danger, he would step forward and reveal his identity, and she would regret her behavior!
Jin Caiwei took a few quick steps, trying to keep up with Lu Yang's pace and stand beside him: "Where did you learn all this ancient knowledge from?"
Dean Qi might not know the intricacies, but she understood that the ancient knowledge Lu Yang possessed was incredibly unbelievable. There was no way he could know so much detail about ancient knowledge just from reading books.
Fairy Eternity looked at Jin Caiwei meaningfully and transmitted her voice: "Why would I need to learn it? I originally knew it all."
Jin Caiwei furrowed her brows, feeling more and more that Lu Yang was no simple character: "Who exactly are you?"
She suspected that Lu Yang wasn't the real Lu Yang and had been possessed long ago, with the possessor being a powerful figure from Ancient Times.
This could also explain why Lu Yang's talent was so terrifying.
Fairy Eternity put her index finger to her lips, eyes slightly deepened, and whispered, "Shh, Little Tiger, you are not supposed to know who I am yet."
Jin Caiwei's expression changed slightly, realizing that Lu Yang calling out her race was indeed no coincidence!
Fairy Eternity lowered her voice again, speaking in a secretive tone, "This Fairy has been asleep since Ancient Times, desiring to overthrow the Great Xia Dynasty and establish a new one. Little Tiger, would you be willing to lend me a hand?"
Jin Caiwei felt a chill, Lu Yang actually wanted to overthrow the Great Xia Dynasty, which supposedly had an Immortal in it. Daring to say such words, could it be that he was an Immortal too?!
This is a huge pitfall, and she had no intention of getting involved. Once involved, there would be no escaping it!
It might even involve a battle among Immortals, something she couldn't afford to touch!
"I refuse!" Jin Caiwei firmly rejected the olive branch Fairy Eternity had thrown her.
Fairy Eternity chuckled twice, as if mocking Jin Caiwei's naïve and ignorant actions.
Jin Caiwei watched Lu Yang warily, fearing he would make a move; she dared not regard Lu Yang as being at the Nascent Soul Stage anymore, "What are you going to do!"
"Relax, I won't force you. Actually, you and I have crossed paths before, it's just that you have forgotten, I've even held you in my arms," replied Fairy Eternity.
"Nonsense!" Jin Caiwei didn't believe Fairy Eternity's words, she couldn't remember ever being held by anyone, wait... it seemed she really had been held by someone before.
Fairy Eternity sighed leisurely, "Through the endless ages, the great waves have washed away so much truth, can you really trust your memory?"
"But you don't need to hurry away from me, follow me, and I will unveil the truth for you."
It was unclear what Jin Caiwei was thinking, but after hearing Fairy Eternity's words, she really did not run away from her.
In the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity excitedly shook Lu Yang's shoulders.
"How about it, how about it, did I look convincing, was it good enough to fool them!"
Lu Yang: "..."
Actually, Fairy, you looked pretty good just now, can't you restrain yourself a bit in the Spiritual Space?
Lu Yang bowed deeply,"Your Majesty is a once-in-an-eternity wise ruler, with all the world's people in your heart, all the vicissitudes of life under your control, naturally, whatever you act out looks real."
Hearing Lu Yang praise her so highly, Fairy Eternity laughed joyously, then suddenly, as if remembering something, she began counting on her fingers,
"Little Tiger, Xia Tian, we're a bit short on manpower."
"Short on what?" asked Lu Yang.
"Short on people for a rebellion. Although Little Tiger is a Semi-Immortal and theoretically quite capable in combat, we're still a bit short for a rebellion."
"It would be nice if we had a few more helpers."
Lu Yang dared not respond, afraid Fairy Eternity would count him in the list of rebels.
Wait a minute, whether or not she counted him, it seemed to make no difference, the body Fairy used to rebel on the outside was his own!
During their conversation, Fairy Eternity led Jin Caiwei and Emperor Xia through Luo Tian Forest, the shortest route back to the Meng Residence.
The trees towered up to the skies, and the Meng Family Members had long since replanted the trees broken and toppled during battle, completely erasing any signs that a fierce fight had once taken place here.
Suddenly, a cold voice came from not far away.
Emperor Xia squinted his eyes to look, there were two visibly weak female cultivators being blocked by a group of cultivators; the cultivators had magic artifacts in hand and looked unfriendly.
The lead black-robed cultivator spoke chillingly, all the while infusing spiritual essence into his magic artifact,
"You two got something good at the auction, eh? Would you mind parting with it; in return, we'll let you keep your lives."
The two frail female cultivators had never encountered such a situation and were so frightened they were trembling.
They were not cultivators from Imperial City but had merely come to the city upon hearing about desirable items at the auction. They had not expected to be targeted just for winning a finale item at the auction.
Emperor Xia was inwardly pleased; wasn't this the chance to reveal his identity while incognito?
Before he could act, he heard Lu Yang calling out joyfully to the two besieged female cultivators, "Xiao Ling, Lianyi, what are you two doing here?"

chapters.title: Chapter 856 - 855: Lu Yang's identity is now quite clear.
chapters.content:
The two female cultivators were originally besieged, and the atmosphere on the scene was extremely tense, but the call from Fairy Eternity broke this silence.
Upon hearing the two extremely familiar designations, Emperor Xia's body stiffened suddenly, incredulously looking at the exuberant Lu Yang, then turned his head to look at the two female cultivators being waylaid and robbed.
Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi, as semi-immortals with lofty reputations from ancient times, had their portraits long circulated among the major powers, but the two female cultivators in front of them obviously differed in appearance from those two ancient semi-immortals.
Had Lu Yang mistaken someone else for them?
Or had he not been calling Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi?
The two female cultivators, hearing Lu Yang calling them with such an intimate manner, were very puzzled, as Elder Brother Lu Yang would never normally address them in this way.
Originally, they had wanted to re-experience life in ancient times by disguising themselves as loose cultivators to attend the auction, intending to bid on the finale piece and be targeted by a tribulation cultivator. At the very moment the tribulation cultivator was about to strike, they planned to reveal their identities and shock everyone present.
Now that Lu Yang had called out their identities, there was no need to continue the pretense.
The two women shed their disguises, revealing two exquisitely beautiful faces that captivated the soul.
Indeed, it was Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi.
"You..." The tribulation cultivators, originally filled with greed, each turned pale and started to flee.
But there was no chance to escape in front of the two semi-immortals. A huge dragon claw illusory shadow fell, moving slowly yet inescapably, and several tribulation cultivators were effortlessly pinned to the ground by Ao Ling, unable to move, their hearts filled with boundless terror.
After dealing with a few minions, Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi walked over to Lu Yang to take a closer look.
They hadn't expected to encounter Lu Yang in Imperial City, and they also felt that there was something different about him today.
"What's the matter, don't recognize me anymore?" Fairy Eternity asked with a smile, startling Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi as their pupils contracted sharply, then quickly realizing who she was and breaking into delighted smiles.
It was Immortal Sister!
"It really is you!"
The two women, one on the left and one on the right, affectionately looped their arms around Fairy Eternity's, basking in the glory that envied the bystanders.
"What are you two doing here!" Jin Caiwei looked at Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi cautiously.
They were the two people she least wanted to encounter, and she had run into both of them at once.
Jin Caiwei, completely on guard against the two women, struggled even to maintain her humanoid form, her eyes turning into golden vertical pupils, with two white tiger ears emerging from the top of her head, baring her teeth to reveal two small tiger fangs.
"Jin Caiwei! You're still alive?"
Before, Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi had been preoccupied with Fairy Eternity, and only now did they notice Jin Caiwei was also here.
Jin Caiwei, relying on the fact that no one recognized her, had not disguised herself since leaving the Demon Territory, always presenting her true form, which was easily identifiable at a glance.
"Of course, I'm still alive. Don't think you two are the only ones with a Dao Fruit Outline!" Jin Caiwei's true form, a mighty white tiger with bone wings on its back, manifested behind her, revealing her identity as a rare white Qiongqi.
Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi, both semi-immortals who had battled their way out of Ancient Times, had no reason to fear Jin Caiwei, who was like a flower raised in a greenhouse.
Ao Ling sneered coldly; behind her, emerged a black dragon exuding an aura of the primeval, condescendingly looking down at Jin Caiwei, "Oh, then I really want to see how much substance your Dao Fruit Outline has!"
Jiang Lianyi stepped forward, and a phoenix illusory shadow soared out from a sea of fire, its cry echoing through the heavens.
The white Qiongqi, black dragon, and golden phoenix, three great ancient immortal beasts gathered, none yielding to the others, with the black dragon and golden phoenix's might clearly surpassing the white Qiongqi.
A great battle was on the verge of breaking out.
The Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator secretly responsible for ensuring Emperor Xia's well-being was bitterly complaining; what kind of situation was this?
Initially thinking that serving in Imperial City would mean protecting Emperor Xia from any danger—a sure relaxing duty—he hadn't been informed that he might encounter a clash between three great ancient immortal beasts in the Imperial City!
Three Semi-Immortals, all with Immortal backgrounds. He'll probably burn out all his blood and still won't be able to save Emperor Xia.
"Alright, alright, we're all friends here, put it away, put it all away." Seeing that a fight was about to break out, Fairy Eternity felt that this wouldn't do and hurriedly stepped in between to stop the conflict.
Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi obediently retracted their Illusory Shadows, and Jin Caiwei immediately felt the pressure lessen, retracting her Illusory Shadow as well, although the atmosphere remained tense.
"Xiao Ling, Lianyi, what are you doing here?" Fairy Eternity clasped the hands of the two women, smiling very happily.
Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi's cheeks turned slightly red, and they were somewhat uncomfortable with Fairy Eternity's question. They casually pointed to the Tribulation Cultivators lying on the ground.
"Isn't this just experiencing ancient life? We came to Imperial City for an auction, bought some valuable treasures at random, and ended up attracting them."
The Tribulation Cultivators crushed by the draconic might regretted deeply that they hadn't consulted the almanac before leaving today; they just wanted to rob a path, and somehow they bumped into these two extraordinary Great Powers.
What exactly was your life like in Ancient Times, even going to auctions? Are auctions some sort of interesting place?
"So that's how it is." Fairy Eternity nodded her head. It was she who taught Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi the good habit of fishing at auctions.
"Who says we're friends? Who exactly are you!" Jin Caiwei stared at Fairy Eternity. A mere sentence was enough to make the proud Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi lower their guard voluntarily. Who was this person really?
Emperor Xia was also surprised. He had long known that the buzz about the Ancient Heavenly Court was fabricated by the Seek Dao Sect, with Lu Yang as its founder.
However, he was unaware of Fairy Eternity's existence, assuming Heavenly Venerate Dou was another identity of Yun Zhi.
As for Lu Yang knowing Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi, he wasn't surprised; after all, both Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi had publicly admitted to being members of the Ancient Heavenly Court.
What surprised him was the good relationship between Lu Yang and Ao Ling, Jiang Lianyi—how close they got as soon as they met, with an extremely intimate attitude.
If Jin Caiwei hadn't interrupted midway, they would probably have gotten even closer.
Jin Caiwei is an ancient Qiongqi, so does that mean she is the third wife of the Qilin Immortal?
Emperor Xia thought of Jin Caiwei's refusal to join him, and found an explanation.
"What's it to you!" Jiang Lianyi shielded Fairy Eternity behind her, extremely protective as if she was afraid that Jin Caiwei would swallow Fairy Eternity in one bite.
Jin Caiwei looked intently at Lu Yang's face that revealed a hint of handsomeness, recalling all the experiences she had before.
Lu Yang declared himself as an Immortal, which assuredly made him an Immortal.
More familiar with ancient history than herself, a witness to it, an Ancient Immortal.
This meant Lu Yang was definitely one of the Four Ancient Immortals.
Familiar with ancient history and also acknowledged her as the third wife of the Qilin Immortal.
Held her in his arms.
She herself did not feel repelled by Lu Yang, even feeling a natural closeness.
Likes to be mysterious.
Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi were close to Lu Yang, even showing an attitude of complete compliance.
Then the answer was obvious.
Jin Caiwei pointed at Lu Yang, a bit angry, but upon recalling the acknowledgment that she was the third wife, her emotions leaned more toward joy, and her voice rose several notches.
"Ah He, it's you!"
The Qilin Immortal, whose real name was Shi He.

chapters.title: Chapter 857 - 857: 856 Chapter: Surrendering Oneself
chapters.content:
At this moment, the real Lu Yang's mind was struck by enlightenment, receiving a phrase that could predict future events of Heavenly Initiation, highlighting his path and destiny.
Every man must die, either by the hands of the Yingtian Immortal or by the Qilin Immortal.
In any case, death is inevitable.
If the Qilin Immortal were to witness this scene, Lu Yang would have no idea how to survive.
"What, Ah He? I am not the Qilin Immortal," said Fairy Eternity, the foremost among the Five Ancient Immortals. She would diminish her own value by pretending to be the Qilin Immortal, for she walked with integrity and sat with dignity.
"Not him?" Jin Caiwei looked at Fairy Eternity skeptically. Do I look stupid? Who are you trying to fool?
Could it be anyone other than Ah He who was so close to Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi?
"Indeed, she is not my husband."
Ao Ling looked down at this little girl, a smile that was not quite a smile on her face: "Little girl, the affairs of the ancient times are complex and intricate, how could you possibly understand them all?"
"Don't you dare call me little girl!" Jin Caiwei was furious. She hated being referred to that way, especially by Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi!
But hearing what Ao Ling said, could it be that Lu Yang really wasn't the Qilin Immortal?
Jin Caiwei began to feel uncertain.
Her knowledge of ancient affairs was indeed not comprehensive. For instance, she knew nothing about the Ancient Heavenly Court, while Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi had long been its members, clearly indicating an inequality in knowledge between the two sides.
"If he is not the Qilin Immortal, who else could he be!" Among the Four Ancient Immortals, only the Qilin Immortal met all the criteria.
If there were no outsiders present, Ao Ling would not mind disclosing the identity of Immortal Sister to Jin Caiwei, but now was clearly not the appropriate moment.
Ao Ling looked at the only outsider present: "Who is this man?"
"His name is Xia Tian, and he's a recent addition to my ranks," she replied.
"A follower?"
Ao Ling gave Xia Tian another glance. She knew that Immortal Sister's standards were exceptionally high, and she didn't just take in followers casually. If this Xia Tian had become a follower of Immortal Sister, he must have something special about him.
But looking at him, his cultivation level seemed ordinary, and if it came to a fight, even Elder Brother Lu Yang might best him. What did Immortal Sister see in him?
Well, it didn't matter. Immortal Sister had her reasons for everything she did.
Facing three Semi-Immortals, Emperor Xia didn't show any fear. Being a Semi-Immortal was one thing, but he had the backing of an ancient ancestor, acting as a present-day spokesperson for that great venerable being—his status was not inferior to that of a Semi-Immortal.
But could he still enjoy secretly roaming around if he revealed his identity?
Emperor Xia thought to himself, why was it that when his eldest son went out, he enjoyed life, but when he himself went out, he either encountered those clamoring to execute him or ran into three Ancient Semi-Immortals, neither of which provided a good opportunity to reveal his identity.
"Lianyi, have those lying on the ground go to the Ministry of Punishments to turn themselves in. I have things to discuss," Fairy Eternity said, referring to the panic-stricken Tribulation Cultivators.
"Alright."
Jiang Lianyi approached the few Tribulation Cultivators. The cultivators wanted to escape, but with the dragon's might oppressing them, they couldn't even move.
Jiang Lianyi activated the outline of the Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit, leaving an imprint on each of the Tribulation Cultivators, putting them under her control.
Witnessing this, Jin Caiwei scoffed coldly, reminded of the imprint left by Jiang Lianyi on Jin Que.
That happened just before the founding ceremony of the Demon Nation when the Gold Clan Leader accidentally entered an inn and saw Jiang Lianyi, who had not long been revived. To avoid drawing attention, Jiang Lianyi ordered the Clan Leader not to speak of her.
Although the Gold Clan Leader remained silent, Jin Caiwei had encountered Jiang Lianyi more than once and immediately recognized the imprint left by her.
"You seven, go and turn yourselves in at the Ministry of Punishments, confess all your crimes, but you must not reveal any information about me, Ao Ling, or Jin Caiwei," she commanded.
Being able to become Tribulation Cultivators means this wasn't their first or second time engaging in such matters.
Jiang Lianyi, Ao Ling, and Jin Caiwei, after all, have special identities. If the Ministry of Punishments were to learn that the two of them had come to the Imperial City, then Emperor Xia would become aware, potentially creating issues out of thin air.
The fewer troubles, the better.
"Yes!" Seven Tribulation Cultivators stood up and shouted in unison.
Ao Ling withdrew her dragon presence, and the seven Tribulation Cultivators staggered to their feet, appearing no different from usual. However, their destination was somewhere they would certainly never choose to go in the past.
They were indeed unwilling to surrender themselves to the Ministry of Punishments, but under the effect of the Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit Outline, they had no room to resist, not even able to exhibit a reluctant expression.
...
Ministry of Punishments.
Ever since passing the hot potato that was the Fourth Prince over to His Majesty, Xu Xin felt as if a huge weight had been lifted off his shoulders, and his steps were much lighter.
