The subordinates he had trained could also hold up the sky on their own. During his seclusion, they fulfilled their duties impeccably, handling the Ministry's cases in an orderly fashion and even revised the latest edition of "Possession Laws".
Even Xu Xin felt that he wasn't far from reaching the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. His pleasant mood was conducive to a breakthrough; nourishing his nature with his heart, it was an extremely profound state.
"I wonder how Daoist Buyu's little disciple is doing now. Speaking of which, this lad is indeed talented."
Xu Xin shook his head with a wry smile. After coming out of seclusion, he heard a lot of news about Lu Yang: the great battle in the Luo Tian Forest, crushing his peers with an invincible posture, composing poetry at Lotus Pavilion, attracting Ye Mengyin's favor, and so on.
Putting aside the stubborn insistence on decimating nine generations, Daoist Buyu's little disciple was still far more pleasing to the eye than Daoist Buyu himself.
At that moment, the Minister of Justice walked in, hesitant to speak.
"What is it?" asked Xu Xin, in a good mood and thus, more gentle in tone than before.
"To report to the superior, outside... never mind, perhaps you should see it for yourself," the Minister of Justice felt it unbelievable to explain, better to let Xu Xin see it in person.
"Very well," Xu Xin, accompanied by the Minister of Justice, went to the reception area and saw seven familiar figures.
"Shi Lei, Bai Yiwen, Zhao Tuo..."
These were all clients of the Fifth Prince.
Shi Lei, as if not seeing Xu Xin, recounted his past wrongdoings like spilling beans.
"We followed the orders of the Fifth Prince, leaked the imperial examination questions, and profited from it..."
"The Fifth Prince, in his effort to win over officials, had us arrange for their nephews and relatives to be placed within the dynasty..."
"This time at the auction as well, someone bought an item the Fifth Prince had set his sights on, and even after the Fifth Prince revealed his identity, they still refused to give face and bought the item at a high price, causing the Fifth Prince to lose face. We received orders to retrieve the item by any means necessary, and afterwards, we disguised ourselves..."
As clients of the Fifth Prince, every deed they did was inevitably tied to the Fifth Prince.
Xu Xin: "..."
No, the issue with the Fourth Prince had just ended, and now the Fifth Prince was popping up?
You seven, did you see the Fourth Prince get caught and suddenly have a change of heart, coming together to surrender?
"Hold on a second. Why are you suddenly deciding to surrender?" Xu Xin couldn't help but ask. These seven didn't seem like the type to be struck by a sudden bout of conscience.
Influenced by the Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit Outline, Shi Lei and the others couldn't reveal the information about Jiang Lianyi and the other two ancient Semi-Immortals. Initially, it was Immortal Sister who commanded Jiang Lianyi, and Jiang Lianyi who ordered them, the seven of them.
"It was Lu Yang who told us to come and surrender."

chapters.title: Chapter 858 - 857: The Gradually Growing Soybean Dynasty
chapters.content:
As Shi Lei and others were swayed by Lu Yang to come forward and confess, numerous cold cases were reopened, all connected to the Fifth Prince's efforts to win people's favor.
The Ministry of Punishments became busy, even busier than during the Fourth Prince's rebellion.
The Fourth Prince's rebellion was no small affair, but it was only one case, merely requiring a bit more effort when it came to arrests.
However, the Fifth Prince's situation was different. This time there were multiple cases, with a broad impact, implicating many officials in the dynasty.
The Ministry of Punishments interrogated Shi Lei and the others throughout the night. The good news was that they had a cooperative attitude, answering all questions, and since they were the Fifth Prince's dirty mitts, they had a lot of evidence, which helped the Ministry save much effort.
...
Prince Jiang Qun regretted disguising himself as his father to ascend the throne, dealing with an endless stream of memorials, the bitter medicinal soup that was said to slightly prolong lifespan, and handling the intrigues in the harem and with various elders...
"Luckily, the Right Chancellor and the Left Chancellor are not in seclusion, capable of sharing some of my burden."
The Right and Left Chancellors dealt with many of the less important memorials, allowing the Crown Prince to catch his breath. Although he didn't find it difficult to handle these memorials, it was boring, and now that he was using his father's identity, there were many things he could not do.
"How I miss making incognito visits; I wonder how far Father has progressed."
Jiang Qun opened a memorial sent from the Prefectorial Governor of Yu State, which reported the discovery of remnants from Great Yu in Yu State, suspecting the presence of a Great Qian Cultivator at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
He had already contacted the troops stationed in Yu State, asking them to join the search for the Great Yu remnants, but given the unknown strength of the remnants, he requested the dynasty to send reinforcements.
"In that case, let the Luoshui Guards go to Yu State."
Just as Jiang Qun was about to process the next memorial, Eunuch Li came to report.
"Your Majesty, the Minister of Justice Xu Xin requests an audience."
"Let him in."
Xu Xin, taking measured steps, entered the hall and bowed to Jiang Qun, "Xu Xin pays respects to Your Majesty."
"Rise, Minister Xu."
"Yes."
"What brings Minister Xu here?"
Xu Xin took out a small booklet, which Eunuch Li presented to Jiang Qun.
Jiang Qun, looking puzzled, took the booklet: "What is this?"
"Your Majesty, these are the crimes committed by the Fifth Prince."
"Who?" Jiang Qun thought he had misheard.
"It's the list of crimes of Fifth Prince Jiang Tang."
Jiang Qun, alarmed, quickly skimmed the booklet with his Spiritual Sense, his eye twitching as he saw the litany of Old Five's various offenses, offering explanations for many of the dynasty's long-standing secret cases.
"Time is of the essence, and for fear of startling the snake by hitting the grass, only some of the crimes have been verified."
Even just these partial offenses were serious enough. If they were all confirmed, the fate of the Fifth Prince would not be much better than the Fourth Prince's.
The only difference was that the crimes of the Fifth Prince did not require the execution of his entire family, sparing Jiang Qun from having to pardon himself again.
…No, how did it come to be Old Five's turn to cause trouble right after Old Four's issue had settled down?
I've only been the temporary Emperor for three days, and two brothers have already fallen into my hands.
Father, how come you didn't deal with anyone when you were the Emperor, but as soon as you left, all these issues came knocking?
In history, there have been instances of princes acting as regents, but none where a prince dealt with other princes while acting as regent.
Handling one might be acceptable, but dealing with two—how would future generations view this part of history?
"How were these things investigated?" Jiang Qun, knowing that Xu Xin was thorough and reliable, would not fabricate things to deceive him.
Moreover, even if it were fabrication, one would not dare to do so recklessly.
He was just curious.
"It was the retainers of the Fifth Prince, led by Shi Lei, who confessed."
"Shi Lei is so honest?" Jiang Qun frowned.
"According to what Shi Lei and the others confessed, they were persuaded by Lu Yang to come to the Ministry of Punishments to turn themselves in."
Jiang Qun couldn't help but hold his forehead. The Fourth Prince's situation had been reported by Lu Yang, and now the Fifth Prince's matter was also inseparable from Lu Yang. Lu Yang, are you determined to send all my brothers to prison to clear the way for my ascension?
"Lu Yang alone persuaded them to turn themselves in?"
"That I do not know, but Shi Lei and the others said that when Lu Yang was persuading them, there was also a cultivator named Xia Tian present."
Jiang Qun: "..."
Isn't Xia Tian damned Emperor Xia's alias?
I knew this wasn't so simple; it's indeed Emperor Xia's intent!
...
In the Luotian Forest, Fairy Eternity is holding a meeting, sitting in a circle with Ao Ling, Jiang Lianyi, Jin Caiwei, and Emperor Xia.
"It's rare for us all to gather together. There's only one purpose for today's meeting, and that is that I am ready to establish a new dynasty. I have even thought of a name for the dynasty, called the Great Soy Dynasty."
Upon hearing this, the posture of Ao Ling and the others straightened slightly, all startled by Fairy Eternity's words.
Some were shocked at the idea of establishing a new dynasty, others were shocked at the name of the dynasty.
"The sage once said, 'The throne of the world should be seated by the virtuous.' As someone born with such virtues, I ought to be the emperor."
Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi clapped their hands vigorously, their gazes burning as they looked at Fairy Eternity. Had Immortal Sister finally harbored the ambition to vie for the world?
Fairy Eternity's face revealed a smile, pressed her hand down to signal Xiao Ling and Lianyi not to be overly enthusiastic, and then continued:
"I have observed the long river of history. Each dynasty's change has been filled with blood and fire, plunging the people into misery, and the entire world into suffering, which goes against my wishes."
The speech of Fairy Eternity was written by Lu Yang in the Spiritual Space. As she read according to the script and improvised on her own accord:
"I believe that establishing a brand-new dynasty doesn't necessarily have to be through war; it can be done by peaceful means."
"For example, I had once cooperated with the Fourth Prince to report his rebellion, and by implicating his entire clan, we were able to break the Jiang Family without attacking."
"But I didn't expect that the ancestors of the Jiang Family had some tactics of their own, setting up a system of amnesty in advance, which foiled my plans. Truly a tough opponent to deal with!"
"However, it doesn't matter. What matters go smoothly all the time? The process of starting a business is always tough. I believe that as long as we stand united, there's no difficulty we can't overcome!"
Fairy Eternity stood on the table, arms raised high, shouting: "Ladies and gentlemen, are you willing to join me in establishing a new dynasty?"
"We are willing!"
Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi need not be asked—their unconditional support for whatever Fairy Eternity does is a given.
"Good, then I appoint you two as great generals."
After Fairy Eternity's exclamation, she jumped down from the table with a huff, and looked at Jin Caiwei: "Little Tiger, what about you?"
Jin Caiwei had no particular thoughts about establishing a new dynasty, but since Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi were supporting it, if she didn't, she would be at a disadvantage, which was intolerable.
"I am also willing!"
"Then I also appoint you as a great general."
All four women turned their gaze towards Emperor Xia simultaneously, their eyes almost speaking the question: what about you?
Emperor Xia felt his scalp tingle beneath their stares. Everyone else had agreed, would it be unsociable of him to disagree?
Emperor Xia could only slowly raise his hand: "I also agree."
"I appoint you as Prime Minister."
The Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator secretly protecting Emperor Xia marveled at the scene. He had lived for thousands of years and had never seen anything like it.

chapters.title: Chapter 859 - 858: Plotting for Power and Usurping the Throne
chapters.content:
```
The Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator secretly protecting Emperor Xia thought that it was quite good to have the Emperor team up with three Semi-Immortals; it was an absolute guarantee of safety, and there was nothing for him to worry about anymore.
After all, his responsibility was to protect Emperor Xia, and he didn't care about anything else.
Below, the three newly appointed generals each petitioned for permission to go to war, to prove their value.
"I possess the Survival of the Fittest Dao Fruit Prototype, which can temporarily enhance me to the level of an Immortal's Body, allowing me to hold my own against a Jiang Family Immortal for a time or two." In terms of combat power, Ao Ling was the strongest. She could be attacked by others before fighting with a Jiang Family Immortal, thereby reaching the level of an Immortal's Body.
Jiang Lianyi enjoyed helping others and liked helping Ao Ling the most.
"I have the Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit Prototype, which allows me to control others, turning everyone in the Imperial Palace into one of us, breaking through from the inside and launching a surprise attack on the Jiang Family!"
Little Tiger Jin Caiwei was not to be outdone: "I have the Plane Dao Fruit Prototype, which can flatten objects into a plane. If it solidifies into a complete Dao Fruit, I could turn the entire world into a plane!"
The three generals looked to the Prime Minister, eager to see what the Prime Minister, who had been highly regarded by Fairy Eternity, was capable of.
"...I can commit suicide."
Ao Ling: "?"
Emperor Xia felt that his Divinity Transformation Stage cultivation was definitely of no use in a rebellion, seeming only capable of creating an opportunity for the Great Soy Dynasty by abdicating the throne through suicide.
"Alright, alright, I've already said that we need to use peaceful methods. Look at you all, talking about using Dao Fruit Prototypes and suicide."
"Then how do we peacefully overthrow the Great Xia Dynasty?" Ao Ling wondered, as she was already prepared to fight with a Jiang Family Immortal.
If it were just Fairy Eternity alone, it would be difficult to think of any effective method, but fortunately, Fairy Eternity was never alone; her Spiritual Space had the old man Lu Yang devising strategies.
"As the saying goes, to seize power and usurp the throne, to overthrow Great Xia, one must take these two steps: seizing power and then usurpation. I believe we should usurp first and then think about seizing power."
"What does usurpation mean? Naturally, it means to take over the throne itself!"
"The importance of the throne goes without saying — several princes are breaking their heads over it, all for that very throne, aren't they?"
"If we seize the throne, then naturally we will have overthrown half of Great Xia."
Fairy Eternity said earnestly, "Therefore, I think we should go to the Imperial Palace and steal that chair!"
"Great idea!" Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi clapped in unison enthusiastically and vigorously.
In the Spiritual Space, Lu Yang breathed a sigh of relief. Thanks to his calculations, he had managed to reduce the death penalty to a fixed-term imprisonment.
The best outcome would be for Fairy Eternity to be captured and to cool her heels in prison for a year.
The treacherous Lu Yang harbored treasonous thoughts and deserved death a thousand times over.
"Xia Tian, what do you think of this idea?" asked Fairy Eternity.
"Good idea."
This time Emperor Xia found his role.
"I'm very familiar with the Imperial Palace; I'll plan the route."
...
In the still of the night, five figures stealthily infiltrated the Imperial Palace.
```
Although the Crown Prince, being at the Body Integration Realm, did not need to sleep or rest, he was not a mule; he couldn't work from dawn to dusk and then dusk to dawn again.
Moreover, Jiang Qun was currently impersonating his imperial father, and his father's sickly appearance did not fit the persona of someone who worked continuously.
It was precisely by using this method that he had escaped from the harem.
"Everyone be careful not to use your Spiritual Sense, so as not to startle the snake by hitting the grass," Fairy Eternity reminded everyone.
According to Fairy Eternity's investigation over the past few days, the Immortals of the Jiang Family resided in the most forbidden area deep within the Imperial Palace and did not concern themselves with the various happenings in the palace.
However, if cultivators of Xiao Ling's level were to use Spiritual Sense for reconnaissance, it would easily draw the attention of the Jiang Family's Immortals.
"Understood," Emperor Xia whispered.
Emperor Xia was the last person who should be using Spiritual Sense, as there were Imperial Guards with higher cultivation levels than his. If he were to use Spiritual Sense, the Imperial Guards would detect him immediately.
The five of them were literally "shadows" as Jin Caiwei used the Survival of the Fittest Dao Fruit Prototype to turn the group into a two-dimensional state, moving along the ground.
This was mainly to consider the safety of Emperor Xia and Lu Yang, both of whom had low cultivation levels and would be easily discovered if they infiltrated the palace.
"Did you strip away the concept of 'height,' leaving only 'length' and 'width'?" Ao Ling asked, glancing at Jin Caiwei with admiration.
She had assumed Jin Caiwei's Dao Fruit Prototype was like her father's, a Soul Dao Fruit Prototype, but she was surprised to discover it was an entirely new type of Dao Fruit Prototype. This creativity was not to be underestimated.
Even she would be caught off guard if she encountered Jin Caiwei's Dao Fruit Prototype for the first time.
"You have some discernment," Jin Caiwei snorted coldly, brimming with pride. She had expended a great deal of effort to condense this type of Dao Fruit Prototype.
Being in a two-dimensional state wasn't the same as being invisible; it just made them harder to detect.
If they were discovered, it would not be a problem, as Jiang Lianyi could use the Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit Prototype to control those who discovered them, making them overlook their presence.
In his spiritual space, Lu Yang felt, for stealing a chair, was it really necessary to use Dao Fruit Prototypes one after another?
Previously, the second Imperial Teacher had only used one type of Dao Fruit Prototype to infiltrate the Seek Dao Sect.
With the help of two Dao Fruit Prototypes, the group of five with six souls smoothly arrived at their destination—the Daming Hall.
The Daming Hall was silent and pitch-dark, but this did not matter. Even Lu Yang and Emperor Xia, who had the lowest cultivation level and fighting capacity respectively, could discern the layout of the Daming Hall with the faint moonlight; needless to say, for the three ancient Semi-Immortals.
It was not the first time Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity had been to the Daming Hall. The Righteous Path Leadership Conference had been held here, and they previously expressed their gratitude to the Sect Leaders of the other Four Great Immortal Sects here as well.
In front of the Daming Hall was the Dragon Tail Path, a mix of stairs and ramps. The surface was tiled with flowered bricks, the eaves were densely structured with interlocking bracket sets, the indoor and outdoor crossbeams were decorated with color paintings, the upper parts of doors and windows were set into rhombic patterns, and each detail carried a deeper meaning.
But the most eye-catching was the throne at the end of the Daming Hall, admired by thousands and symbolizing the sovereignty of the Great Xia.
"We've finally arrived," Fairy Eternity whispered in excitement, striding eagerly to sit on the chair.
Jiang Lianyi's eyes lit up, and she immediately took out the Four Treasures of the Study, swiftly capturing the scene in a drawing.
In the monochrome painting, Lu Yang sat high upon the imperial throne, hands resting on the armrests, his eyes as piercing as a dragon's, exuding an intimidating presence, the very image of a lord over all under heaven. Above his head hung a plaque with the words "Upright and Bright," along with a high-hanging Qin mirror.
If one looked closely, they could even see the signatory's name in the corner of the plaque—Meng Junzi.
"Fairy, how does it feel to sit on the imperial throne?" Lu Yang asked.
Fairy Eternity swayed a little in the seat, not quite satisfied, "Not so great, Zhu Tian's chairs are more comfortable."
No matter how prestigious the chair symbolizing the imperial power was, it was still made by craftsmen with only a bit of cultivation; it could not compare to the Emperor's Chair personally made by Zhu Tian.

chapters.title: Chapter 860 - 859 The Cold Throne Is Gone
chapters.content:
Fairy Eternity sat on the cold throne and let out a light sigh.
"This chair is both hard and cold, now that I've become the master of the Central Continent, I can't even get a good chair."
Emperor Xia: "..."
Originally, I thought sitting on the throne was pretty good, but the way you say it makes me seem so pitiable.
"Zhu Tian knows how to enjoy life, the imperial chair he made is much more comfortable than this one."
Zhu Tian had a wide range of interests, including but not limited to dancing and furniture making, and the furnishings in the Demon Nation Imperial Palace were all made personally by Zhu Tian.
From this perspective, the grandeur of the Imperial Palace of the Demon Nation far exceeded that of the Great Xia Imperial Palace, as it was made by a Semi-Immortal.
Furniture from the Abode of the Five Ancient Immortals was all made by Zhu Tian.
Jin Caiwei heard that even her father's coffin was made by Zhu Tian, and in this regard, even the Grand Elder's craftsmanship could not compare to Zhu Tian's, it was far inferior, such was the gap between the Body Integration Realm and a Semi-Immortal, and no amount of skill could bridge it!
"Where's the imperial seal?" Fairy Eternity couldn't sit still even on the throne, searching around.
"What do you need the imperial seal for?" Lu Yang asked, as this wasn't part of the plan.
"I want to see what the imperial seal looks like. Isn't it said that every emperor must have one? As the original Bean Emperor, I should see what Great Xia's imperial seal is like to prevent making one."
Fairy Eternity was meticulous in her actions; being an emperor meant looking the part.
Lu Yang looked at the imperial robe Fairy Eternity was wearing, embroidered on the front with the smiling face of Fairy Eternity and on the back with the icy and handsome face of Eldest Senior Sister, thinking that Fairy Eternity didn't need to be too particular about the imperial seal.
After all, even with the imperial seal in hand, she wouldn't look like an emperor.
Everyone was a first-time thief with little experience, unsure of what to do now.
Ao Ling leisurely admired the murals in the Daming Hall, which depicted how the Jiang Family rose in the last days of the Great Yu and quickly grew into one of the several forces contending for the world, how the Jiang Family and the Meng Family teamed up to fight the Void Venerate, and how they eventually parted ways, clashing swords and struggling for the supreme position in the world.
"The pigments used in these murals are subpar; they're starting to fade," Ao Ling commented.
"In the past, the murals in our house were blessed by the Time Immortal, immune to the ravages of time, eternally constant."
"And the quality of these magic artifacts is also just so-so, merely pleasing to the eye." Jiang Lianyi pointed to a row of magic artifacts on display near the wall.
"The magic artifacts in our house were all refined by the Yingtian Immortal, exclusively Immortal Treasure grade."
Emperor Xia: "..."
Don't go too far, okay? There's the Time Immortal and the Yingtian Immortal. Daming Hall was, after all, overseen by our ancestor, so give some face.
Our ancestor Jiang Pingan wasn't an expert in Refining, so where could he get so many Immortal Treasures to decorate the place?
Jin Caiwei, having not seen much of the world, managed not to find faults everywhere.
Jin Caiwei looked eagerly at the throne: "How much could this throne sell for?"
Her Qiongqi Clan was in dire need of Spirit Stones, and if they could sell the throne, it would make the endeavor worthwhile.
Fairy Eternity kindly explained, dispelling Jin Caiwei's thoughts: "It's just for show, not worth much."
The group, while attempting to steal the throne, gave the Daming Hall a once-over, commenting as they went.
"How are we going to move this throne?" Jiang Lianyi asked since the throne belonged to someone else and couldn't be placed in the Storage Ring. Taking it directly would be too conspicuous.
"I'll do it." Jin Caiwei volunteered, activating the Outline of the Dao Fruit, extended both palms, one above the other, fitting the throne nicely between them.
With a light clap of her hands, the throne suddenly disappeared, replaced by a piece of paper.
"Done."
Jin Caiwei flattened the imperial throne into a plane, rolled it into a scroll, and hugged it in her arms, making it much smaller as a target.
"This Dao Fruit Outline of yours is quite convenient to use, isn't it?"
"Of course, not to mention a mere imperial throne, even the entire Imperial Palace I could flatten into a plane," Jin Caiwei boasted proudly, showing off her abilities.
"Alright, alright, let's get going," Fairy Eternity called to everyone.
The group was flattened into a plane by Jin Caiwei, repeating the old trick, and they left the Imperial Palace.
The next day, as the court convened, Jiang Qun was stunned to see the empty space.
"Where's the chair?"
I did say the chair wasn't comfortable, but that doesn't mean it should have been taken away.
…
Recently, two shocking and outrageous incidents occurred in the Imperial City.
One was the exposure of the Fifth Prince's crimes, with his followers being successively caught, causing a great stir in the official circles, and many officials were dismissed.
The news profoundly disturbed the Second Prince.
It had only been a few days since his younger brother's mishap, and now only he and the Crown Prince remained as the heirs to the throne.
Considering the significant role Lu Yang played in this process and the likelihood of being targeted for revenge by the remnants of the Fifth Prince's party, the Ministry of Punishments did not publicize Lu Yang's merits.
The other incident was the audacious theft of the imperial throne.
Rumors had it that, on that day, Emperor Xia and the ministers, like him, stood through the morning court session, which earned high praise from the officials.
The throne, which had been in the Daming Hall for a hundred thousand years, had never been moved, leaving everyone to wonder who dared to commit such a heinous and treasonous act.
Some suspected the long-missing progenitor of thieves, others believed the reclusive Thief King was responsible, and yet others proposed it was the return of their descendants seeking fame across the world.
There were various theories, but not one was conclusive.
Xu Xin arrived at the Imperial Palace with a worried frown, his steps heavy as if weighed down by lead. He didn't care about the rumors; they were all groundless speculations to him, randomly theorized.
But he could not afford such indifference, for the Emperor had given him a strict order to find the whereabouts of the throne at all costs.
The best method would have been to directly ask the owner of the throne where it was, but it belonged to Jiang Pingan, and the Crown Prince did not dare disturb the ancestor over such a matter by going to the forbidden land.
So, Xu Xin had no choice but to put the burden on his dear Minister Xu.
"How is the investigation going?" Xu Xin arrived at the Daming Hall with a group of capable subordinates, who were famous detectives from the Ministry of Punishments, known for missing no clues, no matter how slight.
However, it seemed they were about to meet their match with this case.
"Reporting to your excellency, the perpetrator is extremely cunning and has left no evidence behind," reported the subordinates, who had investigated several times from the exterior of the Imperial Palace to the Daming Hall, without finding a single useful clue.
"Could it be someone with the ability to hide their actions?" Xu Xin asked, furrowing his brow. He himself was a detective, although he had not solved a case in a long while after becoming the Chief of Staff.
The Minister of Justice shook his head, spreading out a detailed map of the Imperial Palace that covered the entire table: "Your excellency, please see, there are multiple Array Methods for detection within the palace, as well as the Imperial Guards on patrol. Unless it was the work of an Immortal, something should have been left behind."
"But an Immortal wouldn't stoop to stealing such a trivial thing."
Immortals, having reached the pinnacle of their cultivation, wouldn't possibly get drunk and steal a chair from the Imperial Palace.
Xu Xin sighed, suggesting another possibility, "The perpetrator must be extremely familiar with the layout of the Imperial Palace. It's an inside job."

chapters.title: Chapter 861 - 860: The Law is Vast and Indomitable, Lax but not Leaky
chapters.content:
```
"Was it stolen by someone from the palace?" asked the Minister of Justice through a voice transmission; he dare not speak it aloud—the matter was too grave.
If they were to delve deeply into the investigation, who knows what they might uncover.
The Ministry of Punishments had recently clashed with the imperial family, with two princes ending up in their clutches—an unprecedented event in history.
"It's most likely one of two possibilities: either an immortal intervened, or it was indeed someone from the palace."
But regardless of the possibility, neither made sense.
There was no motive for the crime.
Why would anyone steal the imperial throne after a full meal, to have the Emperor conduct court standing?
By that logic, it seems all ministers would have a motive.
"You, draft a list of those who are familiar with the palace's Array Method."
"Yes."
The Minister of Justice was efficient in his work and quickly produced a list, which was populated by names from the royal family; Emperor Xia was at the top of the list.
Xu Xin slapped the Minister of Justice on the head, "Fool, why put His Majesty on the top? Could it possibly be His Majesty who stole it?"
Hearing this, the Minister of Justice promptly removed Emperor Xia's name.
Emperor Xia had nine sons and seven daughters. With the capture of the Fourth and Fifth Princes, two suspects were eliminated.
Of course, in addition to the princes and princesses, Emperor Xia's personal eunuch, Eunuch Li, and others also were under suspicion.
Having obtained Prince Jiang Qun's approval, the Ministry of Punishments quickly began the search.
"Minister Xu, how goes the investigation?" Jiang Qun called for Xu Xin in Yangxin Hall, eagerly hoping to find out the whereabouts of the throne.
Otherwise, how embarrassing it would be when Father Emperor returns to find no throne.
"To report to Your Highness, after the investigation over these two days, it appears that all princes and princesses are without suspicion—except for one."
"Oh? Who is it?"
Xu Xin stated seriously, "Prince Jiang Qun."
"According to our investigation, since Prince Jiang Qun returned from Ji State, he has disappeared for many days, with no word on his whereabouts, which is highly suspicious!"
Jiang Qun suddenly began coughing violently.
"Your Highness, are you alright?" Xu Xin got a huge fright, worrying that he might have angered His Highness.
Considering that His Highness's lifespan was nearing its end, he'd be in deep trouble if he accidentally caused him to breathe his last.
"I'm fine, I'm fine, it's just an old ailment," Jiang Qun waved his hand, indicating Xu Xin need not panic so.
After a couple of harsh coughs and clearing his throat, Jiang Qun said, "Qun'er has no interest in vying for the throne; this is common knowledge. He would never stoop to steal it and has no motive. Minister Xu, you should investigate others."
Xu Xin opened his mouth as if to say, Your Highness, are you trying to shield Prince Jiang Qun? But then he thought better of it; His Highness had a point. If another prince had stolen the throne, one could explain it as "trying out the feeling," but Prince Jiang Qun was famously indifferent to the struggle. Why would he steal the throne out of the blue? It made no sense.
"Yes."
Beyond the Imperial Palace, standing at the entrance, Xu Xin pondered deeply; but if it wasn't Prince Jiang Qun, then who could it be?
"Forget it, I should go award Lu Yang. That lad has always been sharp-witted. I'll ask him for his thoughts."
Lu Yang first reported the Fourth Prince's rebellion, and later persuaded Shi Lei and others to turn themselves in, unraveling numerous mysterious old cases. This was a significant achievement, and the Ministry of Punishments was definitely going to award him for it.
It was just that Xu Xin had been so busy recently with the Fifth Prince's faction and the matter of the throne that he hadn't found time to see Lu Yang.
```
Now he wanted to change his mood.
…
Meng Residence.
Fairy Eternity brought four new members of the Da Dou Dynasty to stay at the Meng Family, treating it as their base.
Hidden in the shadows and responsible for protecting Emperor Xia during his Transcendance Tribulation stage, he really had the urge to tell the Ministry of Punishments the truth, finding it difficult to keep a straight face. Several times he almost burst out laughing.
Unfortunately, his mission was to protect Emperor Xia, and he couldn't do anything beyond that.
He had thought that protecting Emperor Xia would be a tedious task, but he had not expected the process to be so rich and colorful—far more interesting than solitary cultivation.
"Would you like to come up and take a seat?"
Fairy Eternity rewarded her armies, allowing the three great generals to sit on the imperial throne to experience it.
"Forget it, it doesn't look comfortable to sit on," Ao Ling and the other two shook their heads in refusal, indicating that they had no covetous desire for the throne. The emperor could rest easy, there was no need for tests.
"Alright then," Fairy Eternity had not expected Ao Ling and the others to be so astute, seeing through her test. If any of them had dared to take a seat, she would have stripped them of their posts and seized their properties.
Fairy Eternity turned to ask Lu Yang in the Spiritual Space.
"Xiao Yang, what were you talking about 'covetous hearts' and 'seizing properties' just now?"
"It's nothing, just talking to myself out of boredom," he replied.
While Fairy Eternity was establishing the Da Dou Dynasty, Lu Yang was also busy, constantly sparring with the Invincible Nascent Soul, making rapid progress in strength. He could vaguely contend with the Invincible Nascent Soul, even managing to analyze the external situation while doing so.
Even though the cost was being defeated by the Invincible Nascent Soul.
But Lu Yang persisted in doing so, which was commendable for his determination.
"Xiao Yang, now that we have the throne, what's our next step?"
After thinking for a while, Lu Yang said, "Rebellions need a just cause, like fabricating a sword slaying a white serpent, or having a fox howl about 'Great Chu rising, Chen Sheng as king.' Or maybe digging a stone out of the river with 'A one-eyed stone figure stirs the Yellow River and the world rebels' inscribed on it—of course, it's all fake."
Fairy Eternity, ever so clever, got the point immediately and drew out her vowels, "Faking it, I understand. The Immortals Jiuchong often do such things."
"The fox howl is too common and not very convincing. Right, we could bury a stone in the ground and write on it. Let's see, write 'Da Dou rising, Lu Yang the king'!"
"Uh, my status is humble, no need to include my name," Lu Yang hurriedly refused when he heard this, as he had no desire to be associated with rebellion.
Fairy Eternity held Lu Yang in high regard, "Xiao Yang, do not belittle yourself. As a faithful minister under me..."
"That's 'a minister by your side,'" Lu Yang corrected her seriously; he still had the responsibility of being the imperial teacher and managing the cultural fortunes of the Da Dou Dynasty.
"Ah, a minister by my side. As my faithful minister, how could I neglect you? We shall share fortunes together!"
While Fairy Eternity and Lu Yang were talking, Xu Xin arrived at the Meng Residence, heading straight for Lu Yang.
Fairy Eternity did not notice the movements outside, but the three great generals did.
Ao Ling reacted the fastest; they couldn't let Xu Xin see the three of them together with Lu Yang. That would be difficult to explain, and everything about the Ancient Heavenly Court would be exposed.
Jin Caiwei clapped her hands three times in succession, and the three of them turned into three paintings hanging on the wall, blending in seamlessly.
Xu Xin, accompanied by people from the Ministry of Punishments, pushed the door open and entered with a hearty laugh.
"Ha ha, Lu Yang my boy, so you were staying at the Meng Residence. It took quite an effort to find you. You reported the Fourth Prince and persuaded Shi Lei and others to turn themselves in. I've come especially to commend you," Xu Xin announced.
To show his regard for Lu Yang, Xu Xin personally carried a tray containing a commendation order, cultivation resources, and other items.
Then, as he pushed the door open, he saw Lu Yang seated on the imperial throne.

chapters.title: Chapter 862 - 861: Apprehension and Resolution
chapters.content:
Xu Xin silently retreated, closed the door behind him, then turned and reentered.
Seeing Lu Yang still seated on the throne, he confirmed he was not mistaken.
"Lu Yang, so it was you!"
I checked all the princes and princesses without a clue, I even didn't spare Eunuch Li's house, and it turns out it was you, kid!
I even suspected the Crown Prince before, His Majesty was indeed correct, it wasn't the Crown Prince's doing.
Are you that bored that you decided to steal the throne?
Xu Xin's voice directly pulled Fairy Eternity out of the conversation in her Spiritual Space back to reality.
Fairy Eternity, wanting to find Ao Ling and the other two, discovered they had long since flattened themselves pretending to be paintings on the wall, and now only she and Xia Tian remained at the scene.
"What happened? What happened?"
The Ministry of Justice officials who had come with Xu Xin to commend Lu Yang stretched their necks in curiosity upon hearing their boss shouting loudly.
"Wow, Old Buyu's disciple sure has some guts, to even steal the throne—Old Buyu himself never had the nerve for that."
"The student surpasses the master—ancient wisdom certainly does not deceive me."
"Perhaps Master Xu had long suspected it was Lu Yang, hence using the award ceremony as a pretext to capture him!"
"Don't forget, Master Xu used to be the number one detective in the Imperial City."
"A sharp sword does not age."
Sounds of amazement came one after another, some shocked that the criminal was Lu Yang, others admiring Xu Xin's brilliant deduction.
"Lu Yang, do you have anything to say?"
Fairy Eternity had a strong sense of loyalty; without ratting out the three generals, she preserved the vital forces for the Kingdom of Beans. She stood up from the throne with righteousness and said, "One should take responsibility for their own actions. This affair was orchestrated by Xia Tian and me."
Emperor Xia: "..."
Couldn't you have at least said I was just a servant passing by?
"The Prime Minister?"
Xu Xin turned his head, looking toward Xia Tian.
Speaking of which, this Xia Tian seemed to have been present as a witness when Lu Yang reported the Fourth Prince, and he was beside Lu Yang when he persuaded Shi Lei and the others. He also had a part in stealing the throne. What was his relationship with Lu Yang?
"Yes, Xia Tian is the Prime Minister of our Kingdom of Beans!"
"Kingdom of Beans?" Xu Xin looked back at Fairy Eternity.
Fairy Eternity patted her chest: "The kingdom I founded."
Xu Xin inwardly felt perplexed; he had only casually asked a few questions, so how did things keep getting bigger?
"…Take the two of them into custody."
The Kingdom of Beans had only just started, and it was already besieged by the Ministry of Punishments, with the Minister of Justice personally capturing the founding ruler and the first Prime Minister.
In secret, a transcendence tribulation stage powerhouse mused over his duty to protect Emperor Xia, wondering if Xia being arrested by the Ministry of Punishments counted as Xia encountering danger?
After the Ministry of Punishments took away the founding ruler and the first Prime Minister, the three generals reverted to their original forms.
"What do we do?" Jin Caiwei, faced with such a situation for the first time, didn't know what to do.
"No worries, let's have Elder Brother Lu Yang join us in the East Sea—we have diplomatic immunity." Early on, when Fairy Eternity proposed the idea of stealing the throne, Ao Ling had anticipated the potential capture of Immortal Sister and saw this as an opportunity to persuade Lu Yang to change allegiances and join them in the East Sea.
Jiang Lianyi rolled her eyes at Ao Ling: "Your East Sea doesn't even have a country, where will you get diplomatic immunity from? Elder Brother Lu Yang should join our Demon Nation instead!"
Similarly, Jiang Lianyi wanted to pull Lu Yang to her side, making it easier to connect with Fairy Eternity.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang is mine!"
"He's mine!"
"Mine!"
As Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi argued over who would get Lu Yang, Jin Caiwei would look towards those speaking, becoming increasingly confused.
...
Imperial Palace.
After capturing the wanted criminals, Xu Xin hurried to the Imperial Palace to report the situation.
"For what reason has Master Xu acted in this manner?" Jiang Qun did not expect Master Xu to return so quickly within half a day.
Xu Xin hesitated, unsure of how to broach the subject. Even after pondering all the way there, he hadn't figured out how to start.
"Your Majesty, the one who stole the imperial throne has been found."
Jiang Qun's eyes lit up; Master Xu truly was a brilliant detective, having so quickly uncovered the truth.
"However, there's also a conspiracy to rebel connected to this matter."
"Rebellion? Which one of my sons is it?"
Jiang Qun thought to himself that the Fourth and Fifth Princes had been imprisoned by Lu Yang. If Lu Yang intended to ascend to the throne through such means, that would leave only the Second Prince.
"Is it the Second Prince?"
"It's Lu Yang."
"?"
Jiang Qun was briefly confused, but then understood the ins and outs of the situation—it was Lu Yang who had reported it.
Soon Xu Xin's words overturned his speculation: "According to this servant's investigation, the one who stole the throne is Lu Yang, intending to establish the Soy Dynasty, which indicates he harbors a treasonous heart. Apprehended along with Lu Yang was an accomplice."
"Lu Yang? Rebelling?"
It took Jiang Qun considerable effort to combine these two unrelated concepts.
Lu Yang rebelling? Could it be that the Seek Dao Sect was finally about to challenge the world for supremacy?
"Your Majesty, how should this be dealt with?" Xu Xin asked, completely at a loss after spending two thousand years in the Ministry of Punishments and never encountering such a situation; he had to seek guidance from his superior.
He discovered that passing the buck to his superior was a rather effective strategy, one he would resort to more in the future.
Jiang Qun also faced a dilemma, unsure of how to deal with the situation.
Well, since Father Emperor has temporarily entrusted me with the throne, I cannot simply shirk my duties.
Jiang Qun slammed the table, his imperial authority emanating: "Even the emperor is subject to the same laws as the common folk. Members of the Seek Dao Sect are no exception. I shall personally interrogate Lu Yang!"
"Go, bring Lu Yang to the Daming Hall!"
"Yes!" Xu Xin secretly sensed trouble; it seemed His Majesty was truly serious this time, and things looked grim for Lu Yang.
"Wait a minute." Jiang Qun called Xu Xin back, causing Xu Xin to wonder if His Majesty had reconsidered and was going to let Lu Yang off the hook.
"Also, bring the imperial throne to the Daming Hall."
"As evidence?"
"As a chair."
...
Soon, Lu Yang and his accomplice Xia Tian were brought before the Daming Hall for Jiang Qun to personally interrogate them.
Considering Lu Yang's special status, this matter was not widely publicized. Aside from the Ministry of Punishments, no one knew the throne had been found, nor that Lu Yang was responsible.
Jiang Qun, dressed in imperial robes and wearing the diadem, walked with a steady gait, his gaze sharp and spirited, exuding an aura of power. Seated on the throne, he emanated the presence of a ruler, a stark contrast to the aura of Fairy Eternity in imperial attire.
The Imperial Guards flanked both sides of the Daming Hall, holding their magic artifacts with a display of imperial grandeur.
"Minister Xu, have the prisoners been brought here?"
"They are before the hall."
"Bring them in."
After Jiang Qun spoke, Eunuch Li called out, "By the Emperor's command, bring in the prisoners!"
The entire Daming Hall echoed with Eunuch Li's voice.
Soon, four Imperial Guards brought in two figures. The morning sunlight cast long shadows over them.
Jiang Qun, facing the sun, couldn't make out their faces clearly. He was well acquainted with Lu Yang and could recognize him by his build even against the backlight.
But the question was, why did the other figure also look familiar?
Finally, as Lu Yang and the other stepped out of the sunlight, Jiang Qun could see their faces clearly.
"Your Majesty," Xu Xin reported, "Lu Yang and his accomplice Xia Tian are both present."
Jiang Qun: "..."
Dad, you've gone undercover and now you're bringing it to me?

chapters.title: Chapter 863 - 862: The Emperor's Great Talent
chapters.content:
```
Jiang Qun stiffly turned his head to look at Xu Xin.
"Master Xu, what's this situation with Xia Tian?"
You never told me there was someone named Xia Tian before.
Xu Xin's main concern had been Lu Yang; he viewed Xia Tian as an insignificant character, not worth mentioning. Therefore, he hadn't elaborated before, but now that His Majesty had asked, he naturally had to explain in detail.
"Your Majesty," Xu Xin began, "besides Lu Yang, there was also a fellow conspirator named Xia Tian. According to Lu Yang, this cultivator named Xia Tian has a quick mind and is proficient in governance. After establishing the Great Soy Dynasty, Lu Yang promised to appoint Xia Tian as the Prime Minister, which persuaded Xia Tian to join."
Jiang Qun held his forehead and tried to organize his thoughts. After listening to Xu Xin, his mind was in such a mess that he couldn't make sense of the logic for quite some time.
Does this mean my father joined a new dynasty and became the Prime Minister, so he wants to overthrow Great Xia?
No, Father, you wouldn't push yourself to this extent just to make me emperor, would you?
As a Crown Prince acting as regent, I've just dealt with two younger brothers, and now I'm using my power to deal with the current emperor for treason. Historians will likely consider this a scandalous tale in the history books.
Emperor Xia, who was making eye contact with his eldest son, also felt awkward. He hadn't expected that after stepping out for a bit, he would end up back here, and in such a predicament.
When he had been detained by the Ministry of Punishments yesterday, he contacted the Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivators secretly protecting him, asking them to rescue him from the Ministry of Punishments, but they refused.
The reason was that their duty was to ensure Emperor Xia's safety, and they couldn't act unless he was in danger—a dutiful fulfillment of their responsibilities indeed.
Emperor Xia felt they were just there to watch the spectacle.
If his identity was revealed in the full view of the public, claiming he was Emperor Xia who whimsically abdicated the throne to exercise, he would lose all face.
Emperor Xia wondered if Jiang Qun had been fooling him. How come it seemed so satisfying for Jiang Qun to reveal his identity during his incognito outings, while he himself, as a ruler of a nation, faced so many restrictions when doing the same in his own lands?
Moreover, he remembered Yun Zhi saying that Lu Yang often found himself in unusual situations. This was not what Yun Zhi had described.
Jiang Qun also realized that his father's identity couldn't be disclosed publicly, so he waved his hand to dismiss the others: "All right, all of you may leave. I will personally interrogate these two prisoners."
"Ah?" Xu Xin and the others found themselves in a difficult position—who had ever heard of an emperor conducting an interrogation alone? What if something went wrong?
"Your Majesty, this..."
"Withdraw!" Jiang Qun commanded sternly, and Xu Xin and the others did not dare to contradict the emperor's will, and so they left.
After the others were dismissed, the grand Daming Hall was left with only Jiang Qun, Lu Yang, and Emperor Xia—no outsiders remained, so there was no need for pretenses.
Jiang Qun dropped his imperial dignity and reverted to his usual demeanor, helplessly descending from the throne, and approached Emperor Xia: "Dad, what were you thinking, stealing the throne? And you even asked Lu Yang to join you. How should this matter be handled?"
Emperor Xia blew his beard and glared, no longer hiding his true self, reverting to his aged appearance: "Bullshit, what do you mean Lu Yang joined me in stealing? It was Lu Yang who dragged me into it!"
In the Spiritual Space, Lu Yang's pupils shrunk upon seeing Emperor Xia's true appearance, realizing that Xia Tian was actually Emperor Xia and that the previous Emperor Xia had been an impersonation by the Crown Prince!
Emperor Xia defended himself righteously: "Furthermore, what do you mean 'stealing the throne'? The throne is the heritage of our ancestors; I have always had the duty of safeguarding it. What law did I break by moving the throne from one place to another?"
Jiang Qun was at a loss for words. It seemed like a valid point; no laws were technically broken.
"That's not entirely correct," Jiang Qun remembered something else and pointed at Lu Yang, "He didn't know your identity; he's guilty of theft."
```
"Huh? I knew his identity," Fairy Eternity said.
"When I went to the Imperial Palace to steal the throne, didn't I specifically ask you for your opinion, and you said you agreed."
After being immersed in Lu Yang's long-term legal education, apart from the fact of rebellion, Fairy Eternity always followed the rules and laws.
Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi's plan to have Lu Yang switch alliances was doomed to fail.
In terms of scheming, Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi were no match for Fairy Eternity.
"How did you know?" Emperor Xia was shocked, as he had hidden it well; how could Lu Yang possibly recognize him?
After all, he was protected by a magic artifact of national guardian level!
"I just used my eyes," Fairy Eternity felt there was nothing difficult about it; a disguise that could be seen through at a glance might fool Semi-Immortals at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, but it was far from fooling her.
Emperor Xia thought to himself, hearing that Yun Zhi was very fond of this little Junior Brother; could it be that Yun Zhi had given Lu Yang some magic artifact that could see through disguises?
Of course, there were also those who had not seen through it, like Lu Yang.
"Fairy, did you know all along that Xia Tian was Emperor Xia?"
"Of course I knew, I just forgot what his name was."
Only after Fairy Eternity mentioned it did Lu Yang recall that when she encountered Emperor Xia at the entrance of the Ministry of Punishments, she had asked, "What was your name again?" rather than "What is your name?"
"Didn't you ever think of capturing Emperor Xia or something?" Lu Yang had thought that after meeting Emperor Xia, Fairy Eternity would do something like seizing the emperor to command his subjects. Since Fairy Eternity had no such intentions, Lu Yang didn't associate Xia Tian with Emperor Xia.
"Never thought about it."
"Why?" Lu Yang didn't understand.
"Because it's against the rules to kill envoys from another country during war," Fairy Eternity said. Unlike Lu Yang, who excels in using cunning and poison, Fairy Eternity preferred to act openly and aboveboard.
"..."
"So you made him Prime Minister because..."
"Of course, it's because I recognize talent above all, selecting the able without regard to their past," Fairy Eternity said proudly, never sparing words when it came to praising herself.
Clapping her hands, she spread them out carelessly: "Since Xia Tian was once Emperor Xia, and was called a once-in-a-millennium emperor, he's naturally skilled at managing affairs. Wouldn't it be perfect for him to be the Prime Minister of our Great Bean Dynasty?"
Lu Yang: "..."
Why do I feel like the Fairy makes a lot of sense? Is it because I've been fighting the Invincible Nascent Soul too much lately?
"I've thought it all through. After the Great Bean Dynasty is established, Emperor Xia will become the Prime Minister. Once he's done, I see his son is also talented, so he'll become the second Prime Minister. As for the Prime Ministers after that, we'll just pick from the Jiang Family," Fairy Eternity planned far ahead, charting the blueprint for the Great Bean Dynasty.
Her foresight was something Lu Yang, who only knew how to ingratiate himself with superiors and demean others, could not compare with.
Lu Yangxin thought this was the first time he'd heard of a throne being passed down through abdication and a Prime Minister succeeding through lineage; not to mention going back four hundred thousand years, even looking forward four hundred thousand years there was no such thing. The Great Bean Dynasty truly was making history.
"Your Majesty is a genius."

chapters.title: Chapter 864 - 863: Lu Yang, you lucky bastard...
chapters.content:
"So, Dad, are you planning to continue your incognito investigation, or are you coming back to be the Emperor?" Jiang Qun asked.
Emperor Xia reflected on his experiences of the past few days, which included either being screamed at by Lu Yang demanding the extermination of his family, or being dragged into a rebellion. He felt that it was safer to remain the Emperor.
"Let's go back. These old bones of mine can't take much more of this," he said.
Jiang Qun, hearing this, was overjoyed. He quickly gave a symbolic wipe of the throne and invited his father to sit down.
After returning to his original appearance, Emperor Xia seemed to have his energy significantly drained, panting with each step he took.
Even when he sat on the chair, he couldn't sit up straight and had to lean against the back of the chair for support.
"Father, are you alright?" Jiang Qun was startled. When he supported his father, he felt his father's arm was as dry as dead bones, devoid of vitality, as if the father who had just been joking with him was merely an illusion.
Emperor Xia took a couple of breaths, waved his hand dismissively, and managed a weak smile, "It's nothing serious. I just haven't been active for a long time and my body can't quite bear it anymore."
Despite what Emperor Xia said, his face was extremely pale, his eye sockets sunken, resembling someone on the brink of death, which made the Crown Prince's heart twist in pain.
His lifespan was already short, and he had forcibly drained his life force in order to enjoy himself in the past few days, worsening his condition.
"My son, I fear I don't have much longer," said Emperor Xia. "In this life, I can proudly claim to have lived up to the expectations of my ancestors, served the dawn people well, and upheld the nation. But I have limited energy and have not trained you and your siblings properly, which led your brothers to harbor evil intentions.
Handing over Great Xia to them would be a cause for concern, even if the ancestors support it from beyond. I just can't rest easy..."
Jiang Qun, hearing the implied message, said somewhat helplessly, "No, Dad, you've already had your fun once; why go through it two more times?"
The volume of Emperor Xia's voice immediately rose several notches, and he became spirited, "Hey, what's with you? Is being the Emperor that much of a grievance for you?"
"Enough, enough, get out of here," Emperor Xia said impatiently, waving his hand as if to shoo away flies, ushering the Crown Prince out.
"Alright then."
After the Crown Prince and Fairy Eternity left Daming Hall, Emperor Xia reverted to his feeble state, dried up like withered wood, with just a flicker of life left in him.
He rested on the throne he had occupied for most of his life, watching Jiang Qun's receding figure, an expression of helpless and bitter resignation on his face, his voice weak and breathless.
"My son, my body is truly on its last legs..."
"However, I really enjoyed these past few days. Thank you, Lu Yang..."
...
Xu Xin, Eunuch Li, and the Imperial Guards were stunned as they watched Lu Yang and the Crown Prince walk out of Daming Hall.
Those who went in were Lu Yang and Xia Tian; those who came out were Lu Yang and the Crown Prince. The identity of Xia Tian was all but revealed.
Lu Yang and the Crown Prince, suspected of conspiracy, walked out unharmed. To what extent was the Emperor's tolerance for his eldest son?!
In the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity let out a huge yawn.
"Tired out from playing, time for a sleep, Xiao Yangzi, I'm returning this body to you."
"Ah, what?"
Lu Yang, still not quite understanding what had happened, saw Fairy Eternity, dressed in the Emperor's robes, lie down and fall asleep, curling up serenely into dreamland. He, in turn, regained control of his physical form after a long absence.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, what's wrong?" Jiang Qun saw Lu Yang pause suddenly.
"It's nothing, nothing at all."
"Then let us part ways here," Jiang Qun said, bidding farewell to Lu Yang with a formal gesture.
"Goodbye."
As Lu Yang regained his physical body, his soul had greatly advanced from fighting the Invincible Nascent Soul in the Spiritual Space, and there should have been some misalignment between his soul and his body. To Lu Yang's surprise, however, he felt his soul and body were in perfect harmony.
This meant that Fairy Eternity had been aiding Lu Yang in cultivating his physical body all this time, synchronizing its growth pace with his soul.
"Fairies are indeed reliable," Lu Yang said cheerfully as he returned to the Meng Residence, pushed open his room door, and saw Ao Ling and the other two ladies staring at him, their eyes gleaming green as if they had spotted prey.
Lu Yang suddenly remembered that his room was still occupied by three ancient semi-immortals!
Fairy, how about you keep controlling my body? I can't handle this situation.
"Senior Brother is back?" Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi sharply noticed the change in Lu Yang's demeanor, deducing that Immortal Sister must have returned the body to Elder Brother Lu Yang.
"That was quick," Jin Caiwei said in surprise, looking at Lu Yang. The three of them had just been discussing which faction Lu Yang should join to get diplomatic immunity.
To be precise, it was Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi who were discussing, and she was eavesdropping.
Even more precisely, Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi were about to come to blows.
Now it seems there's no need for a fight, Lu Yang has returned unharmed, which clearly means there's no problem.
"Where's Xia Tian?" Jin Caiwei wondered why only one of them came back.
Lu Yang had no choice but to explain the whole story, emphasizing that Xia Tian was Emperor Xia, and their trip to the Imperial Palace was not about stealing the throne, but rather helping someone move.
"So it's Emperor Xia, I did wonder why there were several Transcendence Tribulation Stage individuals secretly following him. That explains it," Jiang Lianyi nodded, unfazed by Xia Tian's identity.
Ao Ling and Jin Caiwei didn't sense the presence of those in the Transcendence Tribulation Stage lurking in the shadows, only Jiang Lianyi could sense it. Her Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit Outline allowed her to sense beings weaker than herself.
At the same time, Meng Jingzhou emerged from a brief seclusion, and though it had only been seven days, he had gained much from it.
"What, Lu Yang reported the Fourth Prince for rebellion?" Meng Jingzhou inquired about the recent events upon leaving seclusion and immediately heard explosive news.
Meng Jingzhou was filled with regret for choosing to seclude himself at such a time; he missed out on all the excitement.
"The Fifth Prince's residence was also searched?" Meng Jingzhou listened with amusement. Although there was no evidence, his intuition told him that the issue with the Fifth Prince was probably related to Lu Yang as well.
"The throne was stolen by Lu Yang, and now he's accused of plotting a rebellion?" Although the incident regarding Lu Yang stealing the throne was kept confidential, the arrests were made by the Ministry of Punishments from the Meng Family, so confidentiality was not extended to them.
Meng Jingzhou was left dumbfounded by the news. Had he been in seclusion for seven days or seven years? So much had happened. Lu Yang really had some nerve.
"What, you're telling me our family hasn't even pulled any strings yet, and Lu Yang has safely returned?" Upon hearing so much about Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou couldn't help but seek him out.
Lu Yang lived right next to him. Meng Jingzhou pushed open Lu Yang's door and laughed heartily, "Old Lu, I hear you're thinking of staging a rebellion?"
Then he suddenly saw Lu Yang, surrounded by two incredibly beautiful women and a girl. His luck with women was enviable.
Meng Jingzhou was just about to be green with envy, his head still foggy from just finishing his seclusion, but now realization dawned on him, and his hot blood cooled off, recalling that Lu Yang was currently possessed by Fairy Eternity. He felt instantly consoled.
"Don't talk nonsense, that's not true. It's all rumors," Lu Yang quickly denied.
Meng Jingzhou instantly realized from the tone that it was indeed Lu Yang speaking!
"Lu Yang, you lucky dog..."
Lu Yang immediately kicked out, sending Meng Jingzhou flying out of the room, cutting off his words.
If the Qilin Immortal heard that, who knows what might happen.

chapters.title: Chapter 865 - 864 Immortal Peach
chapters.content:
Kicked by Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou returned to Lu Yang's room and finally got a clear look at the three women's faces, breaking out into a cold sweat in an instant.
He did not recognize Jin Caiwei, but Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi were both figures he had already met. Lu Yang, what have you done, to have invited these two formidable figures to our home?
"It is an honor for the three Elders to visit our Meng Residence. We failed to receive you from afar and hope for your understanding," said Meng Jingzhou respectfully. Although he did not recognize Jin Caiwei, her presence seemed not far behind that of Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi, certainly an Elder as well.
"Ah, it's the young Meng lad," Ao Ling recognized this cultivator who had opened up the realm of Nascent Soul Stage with distinct memory.
Originally, she thought that having twin Nascent Souls was the trend among cultivators nowadays. It wasn't until she left the Seek Dao Sect and visited the current Cultivation World that she discovered Meng Jingzhou was an exception.
"Meng Jingzhou pays respects to Elder Ao Ling, Elder Jiang Lianyi, and this younger Elder," he greeted.
The 'younger Elder' naturally referred to Jin Caiwei.
Jin Caiwei held the Meng Family in good regard. Her Qiongqi Clan often borrowed money from the Mengs to tide over numerous challenges and, most importantly, the interest rates were not high.
"I am Jin Caiwei of the Qiongqi Clan, who has slumbered since Ancient Times," she introduced herself.
Meng Jingzhou gasped, "I knew anyone associated with Lu Yang would have an extraordinary background; here comes another creature from Ancient Times."
And from the Qiongqi Clan, no less.
"Our presence here should not be publicized, especially not to your Meng Family," Ao Ling instructed, uninterested in causing trouble.
The three were capable of evading the Ministry of Punishments' searches, naturally including eluding Meng Jingzhou.
They had chosen not to hide their presence out of respect for Lu Yang, who was Meng Jingzhou's friend.
A couple of days later, the Meng Family received a tip that Emperor Xia's life was nearing its end; he had fallen into a coma, and the Imperial Palace was under strict guard, forbidding entry or exit. According to what Meng Jingzhou's father said, this rumor was likely true.
Lu Yang had not expected Emperor Xia's condition to deteriorate so drastically; he had been full of energy when they had parted just two days before. Just as Lu Yang was anxiously preparing to wake Fairy Eternity to see if she could devise a solution, an unexpected visitor arrived at the Meng Residence.
"Junior Brother Man, what brings you here?" Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou both went out to greet him and saw Man Gu standing at the gate, lost in thought and carrying a bundle.
Man Gu had never before seen such an imposing gate.
"Don't just stand there at the entrance, come in, come in," Lu Yang said, inviting Man Gu in with the same hospitality as the master of the house, pushing Meng Jingzhou aside.
It was Man Gu's first visit to the Meng Residence, and he found it somewhat embarrassing.
Upon seeing Lu Yang, Man Gu remembered all the rumors he had heard on the way here and looked up to Lu Yang in admiration.
"Brother Lu, you are so impressive. I heard you composed a poem on the spot at the Lotus Tower, hailed as the best poet of the Yuanxiao Festival!"
Being a Confucian Cultivator, Man Gu hadn't expected Lu Yang's proficiency in the Confucianism Path to be much greater than his own, particularly after hearing the poem "Green Jade Case on Yuanxiao," he felt Lu Yang was like a heavenly being!
Lu Yang laughed awkwardly, too embarrassed to admit he had copied the poem or that Fairy Eternity had helped him show off at the time.
Having heard that Man Gu had come, Meng Potian immediately ordered that spirit food be served as a courteous welcome.
"I am an old acquaintance of your Clan Leader; how has he been recently?" Meng Potian asked with a hearty laugh, devoid of any Elder's pretense, inquiring about the Barbarian tribe Clan Leader's well-being.
"The Clan Leader is doing well; I just saw him half a month ago," Man Gu answered with a simple smile, not quite accustomed to Meng Potian's enthusiastic hospitality.
"Junior Brother Man, have you returned home?"
"Yes, I just made a trip back. Half a month ago was our Ancient Barbarian Tribe's Ancestral Worship Day. I was rather reluctant to return, but the clan insisted that I must attend."
Meng Jingzhou nodded repeatedly, "I can understand, after all, you are from the Ancient Barbarian Tribe, you would have to go even if no one else did."
Man Gu shook his head, showing a rare expression of shyness, "It's not really for that reason, mainly because my Nascent Soul is the Nascent Soul of our ancestor spirits, isn't it? The Elders in my tribe insist on putting me on stage during ancestor worship ceremonies, summoning my Nascent Soul so that the tribespeople can worship it."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Meng Jingzhou imagined Man Gu sitting on the stage, with tens of thousands of barbarians bowing and singing to him below—it was more than anyone could stand.
"Isn't your Nascent Soul summoned randomly from your ancestors?"
"So the Elders decided on random worship. After all, they're all ancestors, it doesn't make a difference who we worship."
Lu Yang felt it was just like the Barbarian Tribe to be so adaptable without the curse laid down by Fairy Eternity. Their thinking was clearly more flexible and varied, which was a good thing.
"May I ask, Uncle Meng, are you very close with our Clan Leader?"
"Oh, has he not told you? Your Barbarian Tribe and our Meng Family have had a friendship that spans a hundred thousand years; we have been allies for generations."
"That long?" Man Gu was surprised. The Clan Leader had never mentioned this to him.
"Indeed, in the early days of the struggle for supremacy, your Barbarian ancestors followed the Jiang Family, serving as generals under the first Emperor Xia, Jiang Pingan. They were often routed by our Meng Family!"
Man Gu: "..."
"Of course, those are all tales of the olden days, long gone by now. Our Meng Family is no longer the same family that fought for supremacy back then; now we just want to earn money honestly."
"By the way, Junior Brother Man, what's in your package? It smells quite nice," said Lu Yang, sniffing the air. Man Gu's package was emitting a soothing fragrance, more enticing even than the Spirit Food on the dining table.
"I don't know either. Right after the ancestor worship ended and I returned to Seek Dao Sect, Eldest Senior Sister gave me this package to deliver to you in Imperial City. You'll know once you look at it. She also instructed me specifically not to open the package."
"Speaking of which, it's strange. The package had no scent when I left, but the fragrance began to emerge as I approached Imperial City."
"Here."
Knowing it was a task given by Eldest Senior Sister, Lu Yang took the package without even bothering to finish his meal, and hurried back to his room after bidding farewell to Father Meng and Meng Jingzhou.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, what's the matter? Why the rush?" In the room, Ao Ling and the three Ancient Semi-Immortals were studying the usage of the Dao Fruit Outline.
"Such a familiar scent." Jiang Lianyi's gaze drifted towards the package in Lu Yang's hands.
Lu Yang placed the package on the bed, unfolded it, and revealed a familiar wooden box. Upon opening the box, a delicate pink peach lay quietly inside.
It was the peach that filled the wooden box with its gentle fragrance.
"I knew it felt familiar. It turns out to be an Immortal Peach grown from the Heavenly Root!" Jiang Lianyi said with a smile, recognizing the origin of the peach.
Lu Yang remembered seeing this Immortal Peach before heading to Imperial City; it had been unripe and green at the time. Now, it appeared to have reached maturity.
"It's an Immortal Peach, and it's just recently ripened," recognized Ao Ling and Jin Caiwei as well.
All three women had eaten Immortal Peaches in Ancient Times, especially Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi, who consumed them frequently.
An Immortal Peach was something that only people from Ancient Times would recognize. At the end of Ancient Times, during the battle between the four Immortals and the shadowy figure behind them, the Heavenly Root hid in the Peach Blossom Secret Realm and never emerged again.
Therefore, people after the Ancient Times were not familiar with Immortal Peaches.

chapters.title: Chapter 866 - 865 Interception
chapters.content:
"Emperor Xia most needs this Immortal Peach right now; it must be delivered posthaste!"
Emperor Xia's situation is not optimistic; he may not live for many more days. It is precisely the right time to consume the Immortal Peach.
What Lu Yang could not understand was why Eldest Senior Sister did not directly have Man Gu deliver it to the Imperial Palace but instead asked him to do it.
Given the urgency of the situation, Lu Yang could not think of a reason and so prepared to set out immediately.
To be safe, Lu Yang also informed Father Meng about the Immortal Peach, hoping that the Meng Family would send someone to accompany him to the Imperial Palace.
The identities of Ao Ling and her two companions were special; if they took action, it would be difficult to explain why these three would help Lu Yang. It would be best if they could avoid getting involved.
"A treasure that transcends the threshold of lifespan and can further prolong it, does such a thing truly exist in the world?"
Meng Potian looked astonished, and despite the Meng Family's great wealth and power, even he had never heard of the existence of the Immortal Peach.
"Since Daoist Yun Zhi has spoken, it certainly can't be false."
"Let's go; I will personally accompany you to the Imperial Palace!"
Meng Potian knew that this matter was of great import. Although Lu Yang was unfamiliar with the current state of the Imperial City, he understood it well. With Emperor Xia's lifespan running out, many forces were becoming restless once again, each hoping to profit from the situation.
The existence of the Immortal Peach would certainly be regarded as a thorn in their side!
Not to mention that the Immortal Peach could prolong lifespan, which would attract the attention of many old monsters whose lifespan was not long.
Although the people now could not identify the Immortal Peach as a product of the Heavenly Root, Cultivators who had achieved success in cultivation could determine through the scent emitted by the Immortal Peach alone that it was something that could extend lifespan.
Meng Potian suspected that since Man Gu had brought the Immortal Peach into the Imperial City, from the city gate to the Meng Residence, the fragrance of the Immortal Peach might have already attracted the attention of those with ulterior motives.
Meng Potian tried to seal the Immortal Peach using various methods, but none could lock in its scent; even asking the transcendent ancestor in Meng Mansion Mountain to act was of no use.
Lu Yang and Meng Potian had no choice but to head to the Imperial City, carrying the fragrant Immortal Peach. Accompanying them were several Meng Family Cultivators from the Body Integration Realm, as well as one from the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
On the surface, the Imperial City appeared as bustling and splendid as ever, with Cultivators everywhere. But Meng Potian knew that this was only an illusion; in reality, various powers were extremely tense, ready with a taut bowstring, constantly watching for any movement from the Imperial Palace.
Everyone wanted to know who would ultimately inherit the throne, the Crown Prince or the Second Prince.
The Imperial City was divided into two by a river hundreds of feet wide, separating the South City and the North City. The Imperial Palace was located in the North City, while the Meng Residence was in the South City. To get from the Meng Residence to the Imperial Palace, one must cross the Jinsha River.
As Lu Yang and his party were crossing the bridge, a mighty procession came towards them, and the person leading it, riding a tall horse, stopped in front of them.
"Daoist Lu Yang, Uncle Meng, where are you two headed?"
The man on the horse dismounted and asked politely.
Lu Yang, wary, eyed the other party and quietly stepped back two paces, "That's no concern of Second Prince's."
The Second Prince's eyes narrowed slightly, his gaze shifting to the box on Lu Yang's back.
"If I'm not mistaken, the item Daoist Lu Yang is carrying should be capable of extending one's lifespan? Hand it to me, Lu Yang. Once I ascend the throne, I can grant you anything you desire!"
The Second Prince's eyes burned with fervor as he looked at the box Lu Yang was carrying, as if he was gazing at the physique of an exquisite beauty.
Among his supporters was a transcendent Cultivator named Cang Mingzi, whom Lu Yang had once encountered on a journey to the East Sea.
Cang Mingzi had informed the Second Prince that Lu Yang possessed something that could save Emperor Xia's life.
In the eyes of the Second Prince, what was this if not a supreme immortal object that could lead Emperor Xia to hand over the throne to him?
As long as he obtained the life-saving object and used it to save Emperor Xia, the emperor would surely pass the throne to him!
Meng Potian stepped in front of Lu Yang and said coldly, "Step aside. The emperor's life hangs by a thread, and every second counts. Don't waste time over such matters."
The Second Prince was reluctant to offend the Meng Family and the Seek Dao Sect, but he knew this was his only chance to seize the throne. According to news from the palace, Emperor Xia had already prepared to issue a decree to pass the throne to his elder brother; however, at this juncture, the emperor had fallen into a coma.
Once the emperor awoke and issued the decree, he would have no more chance at contention!
Success or failure hinged on this moment; he was all in!
```
In order to seize the throne, he had colluded with too many people and made too many exchanges of interests; if he were to give in at this time, the forces behind him would not agree.
"What if I refuse to yield!"
"Then scram!" When Meng Potian was young, he roamed the Cultivation World with Old Ma and Housekeeper Xu, originally possessing a bandit-like nature. It's just that after becoming the family head, his personality had become more restrained.
At this moment, he simply stopped pretending.
"All attack together!"
With an order from Meng Potian, the Elders of the Meng Family struck simultaneously, as the power of the Five Elements circulated, and Yin and Yang energies surged forth.
However, the Second Prince's side was not to be trifled with, as they also had several cultivators in the Body Integration Realm.
Boom!
The two sides commenced battle above the Jinsha River, the bridge collapsed with a thunderous crash, turning into boulders that splashed into the river with heavy plops.
Fortunately, the pedestrians crossing the bridge had sensed the tension between the two sides early on and had kept a safe distance, not daring to cross the bridge.
Facing the chaotic battle of the Body Integration Realm, Lu Yang couldn't be of help and had to hide to the side.
But he held an Immortal Peach, which was precisely the focus of the two sides' battle. Under the river's surface, a shadow of water locked onto Lu Yang, swiftly closing in.
The river boiled, a mist rising, and chains made of water vapor shot towards Lu Yang.
"Cang Mingzi, you've got some nerve!"
A loud shout came from above Lu Yang's head, the voice containing the true essence of a lion's roar which shattered the chains.
Cang Mingzi emerged from the water's surface, and upon seeing the person who destroyed the chains, his pupils shrank abruptly.
"Meng Kuang, when did you reach the Transcendance Tribulation Stage!"
Meng Kuang, Meng Jingzhou's grandfather, Daoist Buyu's friend, the great enemy of both the Left and Right Chancellors, and the previous family head of the Meng Family.
"Since when do I have to report to you when I reach the Transcendance Tribulation Stage?"
Meng Kuang grasped a large blade, tracing his palm along the edge of the blade, his blood flowing over it and quickly being absorbed. The blade turned a glaring red and wound around Meng Kuang's wrist as if becoming one with him.
"To flatter that younger Jiang, daring to steal from the juniors, have you no shame?"
Meng Kuang's crimson blade whipped up a maelstrom of blood and foul wind. Cang Mingzi's face changed drastically at the sight, he shouted in disbelief, "The Combat Blade Technique achieved Consummation? How is that possible?
The Combat Blade Technique demands nurturing through battles, insights and breakthroughs in wars; there hasn't been a major war in nearly a thousand years, where did you get the chance to practice the Combat Blade Technique?"
Meng Kuang laughed heartily and swung his blade at Cang Mingzi.
"Idiot, isn't a business war also a war? How many business battles has the Meng Family been through since I was the family head?"
"Look at this move, Combat Blade Technique: Endless Wealth!"
