Cang Mingzi turned into a watery figure, embodying the ideal of supreme goodness like water, overcoming the rigid with the soft. As a cultivator proficient in controlling water at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, he was a natural counter to blade and sword cultivators.
As Meng Kuang's blade came down, Cang Mingzi split into two, transforming into two separate bodies of water. The two bodies melded back together, leaving Cang Mingzi unharmed.
"How capable do you think you are, old ghost Meng Kuang? Don't assume that secretly reaching the Transcendance Tribulation Stage makes you my match!"
Meng Kuang chuckled, reaching behind to pull out a big cloth bag, filled to the brim with Top-grade Spirit Stones.
Cang Mingzi's face became extremely animated at the sight of the big cloth bag. He rushed to check his Storage Ring, only to find that all of his Top-grade Spirit Stones were gone!
"What kind of move is this!" Cang Mingzi cried out in desperation, for those were his Spirit Stones.
"I told you already, this is called Combat Blade Technique: Endless Wealth."
"Bullshit, there isn't such a move in the Combat Blade Technique."
"Business battles are just about turning your money into my money. Isn't it normal for me to realize such a technique from my business battles?"
```

chapters.title: Chapter 867 - 866 Great Yu's Calculation
chapters.content:
```
Having suffered a significant loss, Cang Mingzi dared not clash directly with Meng Kuang's moves again. Enduring a couple more would surely lead to bankruptcy.
Cang Mingzi dodged and weaved, trying to seize the opportunity to snatch the Immortal Peach from Lu Yang's hands.
But when it came to the experience of stealing, how could Cang Mingzi compare to Meng Kuang? With just a move of his fingers, Meng Kuang could predict Cang Mingzi's intentions and block the path ahead of time.
His actions anticipated, and not daring to take the heavy blows, Cang Mingzi quickly fell into a disadvantage.
In the center of the river, although Meng Potian had practiced for less than two thousand years and was not as experienced as the Elders of the Seek Dao Sect, his talents in both cultivation and combat were unparalleled. This was evident from Meng Jingzhou.
At the Body Integration Realm, if he didn't encounter a freak at the Half-Step Pass Tribulation Stage, there was no one who could match Meng Potian.
The masked people who made their moves on the Second Prince's side concealed their identities. Otherwise, if word got out, they would be finished.
"Kong Yuan, you, the Chief Secretary of the Governor's Mansion, have taken action?"
Meng Potian deduced his opponent's identity after a brief exchange. He was often the target of masked assailants, but fortunately, his superior cultivation level meant he was hardly troubled.
Having been ambushed and struck from behind so frequently, he had naturally developed a talent for guessing the identities of his attackers.
"Nonsense, who is Kong Yuan? I don't know him!" Kong Yuan denied vehemently, unable to acknowledge the truth.
Meng Potian sent Kong Yuan flying with a kick, from one side of the river to the other, making him spit out blood and lose his mask.
After rolling on the ground twice, Kong Yuan ended up at the feet of a crowd who were watching the battle, never expecting someone to land amongst them.
Kong Yuan inwardly cursed— he absolutely couldn't let anyone see his face!
"Die!"
It was fairly normal for bystanders to be impacted during a clash between two Body Integration Realm fighters.
Unexpectedly, someone in the group crouched down and punched Kong Yuan, dazing him with the blow.
"The public order in the Imperial City is really lacking," Mu Baiyi clicked his tongue and punched Kong Yuan again.
The Jiuyou Sect and the Yaoyang Sect were here to assess the Imperial City's business environment; having arrived only a few days ago, they had already encountered a battle among Body Integration Realm cultivators and even one who wanted to kill them.
Kong Yuan should have thought it through; could the spectators daring to watch at such a time be ordinary citizens?
"Who's next?"
"I'll go, I'll go."
The high ranks of both demonic sects volunteered one after another. Opportunities to retaliate against Dynasty officials weren't common.
Casualties were quite normal in a battle between Body Integration Realm cultivators.
"Lu Yang, you little rascal, hurry up and leave!"
Although Cang Mingzi was being suppressed by Meng Kuang, it was difficult for Meng Kuang to defeat him instantly. The most urgent matter was to deliver the Immortal Peach to the Imperial Palace quickly.
Meng Kuang grabbed Lu Yang by the collar, twisted his wrist, and flung Lu Yang straight across the river to the other bank—North City, where the Imperial Palace was located.
Lu Yang tumbled on the ground, then quickly pulled out the Sword Washing Pool and flew toward the direction of the Imperial Palace.
The high ranks of the two great demonic sects felt that with the Imperial City in such chaos, it would be more interesting to follow the center of turmoil, Lu Yang, and temporarily spared the unconscious Kong Yuan as they stealthily followed.
After flying over half of North City, Lu Yang suddenly felt the restless movement of the Invincible Nascent Soul trying to escape. He hurriedly pushed off forcefully and jumped to one side.
Boom!
A column of fire slammed down, hitting right where the Sword Washing Pool had been. If Lu Yang had been caught by that, he would have undoubtedly died.
"Oh, just a Nascent Soul youngster, and you managed to dodge my strike? It seems the Seek Dao Sect holds you in high regard, bestowing upon you a life-saving treasure."
```
From the midst of the soaring flames, a figure emerged slowly, handsome as jade with a black robe, seemingly a young master from some reclusive influential family, a frivolous smile playing on his lips.
"Who are you!" Lu Yang watched the figure in the flames with vigilance.
"Me? You may call me Young Master Yu."
Lu Yang's pupils shrank slightly, "The very General Yu who annihilated the remnants of the Great Qian army, utterly destroyed the Great Qian Dynasty, undefeated in a hundred battles, in a lifetime only defeated by the Nightmare Supreme and Wu Yao, then afterwards pledged allegiance to Wu Yao?!"
The Nightmare Supreme, what kind of person was he? He was a powerful Venerate who almost seized control of the world by confronting Wu Yao and the first Imperial Teacher, and losing to the Nightmare Supreme was definitely not shameful—on the contrary, it could even become capital for fame in later generations.
And since he was only defeated by the Nightmare Supreme and not killed, it strongly suggested that this General Yu might also be a Semi-Immortal!
"It seems you're somewhat knowledgeable, young one. When you die, I'll make sure to go easy on you," General Yu said with a smile. In his eyes, Lu Yang was already a dead man.
"How dare a Semi-Immortal from Great Yu show up in the Imperial City, aren't you afraid that the ancestor of the Jiang Family will make a move against you!"
If the Second Prince's seizing of the Immortal Peach was considered a domestic struggle, not worthy of the Jiang Family ancestor's intervention, then a Great Yu Semi-Immortal taking action in the Imperial City would certainly merit intervention!
Was General Yu not afraid of dying?
"Oh, it seems you do know quite a lot." General Yu truly gave Lu Yang a second glance this time. Knowing such a secret, that the Jiang Family ancestor was an Immortal, suggested that Lu Yang's status was really as prestigious as the rumors outside claimed—he was the one destined to be the next Sect Leader of the Seek Dao Sect.
But what of it? The Seek Dao Sect wasn't even worth his attention.
General Yu looked at Lu Yang with a smile that was not quite a smile. Perhaps because he regarded Lu Yang as good as dead, he was willing to speak more, "Yu State is a distance from the Imperial City, and the news has not yet reached here."
"We deliberately exposed our whereabouts in Yu State, to draw your Great Xia Dynasty to dispatch the Luoshui Guards there in support."
"But what you Great Xia could never guess was that we had also arranged for a Semi-Immortal in Yu State. He took action to seal off nearly half of Yu State, trapping the Luoshui Guards, the Yu State armed forces, the Prefectorial Governor of Yu State, other main officials, and tens of billions of Yu State citizens there."
Lu Yang's pupils dilated with shock, another Great Yu Semi-Immortal?
Lu Yang knew all too well the terror of a Semi-Immortal; although they only possessed a Dao Fruit Outline more than someone in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, it was an overwhelming advantage.
Take the second Imperial Teacher as an example, if he were to use his Causality Dao Fruit Outline, those in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage would not have the slightest ability to fight back!
Among the trapped cultivators, none could defeat a Semi-Immortal.
Resolving the crisis in Yu State smoothly required the intervention of an Immortal!
Sure enough, General Yu went on to say, "Jiang Pingan has already gone to Yu State to handle the matter, and he won't be able to return in less than half a day."
In the past, when Lu Yang encountered a Semi-Immortal within Great Xia's territories, Jiang Pingan should have been the one to intervene. However, each time Lu Yang was present, he successfully dealt with the Semi-Immortal, so there was no need for Jiang Pingan to step in.
But this time, Lu Yang was not in Yu State.
The cultivators of Great Yu had long been plotting for this day.
"Enough, what's the point of telling all this to a dead man?" General Yu lazily said, countless purple fireballs manifested behind him, their terrifying heat causing even space itself to twist.
His aim was not to seize the Immortal Peach, but to destroy it, to let Emperor Xia die in his sickbed!
Countless purple fireballs flew towards Lu Yang, setting the ground ablaze. General Yu, always cautious in his actions, knew that being hit by these fireballs would be lethal even for someone in the Body Integration Realm, let alone merely someone in the Nascent Soul Stage!
Suddenly, a strange, demonic wind blew in from all directions, carrying the scent of decay and death, and extinguished the terrifying purple fireballs.
"This Immortal Peach is an item coveted by my Heavenly Court; I'd like to see who dares to touch it!"
"Who is it!" General Yu sharply looked up only to be blinded by a swath of white brightness. Once his eyes adjusted, he saw an enormous white Qiongqi flapping its bony wings, its golden, radiant tiger eyes stark against the surrounding whiteness.
"One of the Four Imperial Protectors of the Heavenly Court, the North Pole Broad Fortune Great Emperor."

chapters.title: Chapter 868 - 867 Emperor of Great Wealth of the North Pole
chapters.content:
When Jin Caiwei first came to Great Xia, she planned to establish a cooperative relationship with the Seek Dao Sect. However, as she spent time at the Meng Family, Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi told her about the matters of the Heavenly Court, and she decided to join the Heavenly Court as well.
After all, joining the Heavenly Court was like becoming half a member of the Seek Dao Sect, which wasn't too far from her original intention.
The name "Beiji Guangcai Great Emperor" was coined by Jin Caiwei herself, embodying her beautiful wishes.
"Beiji Guangcai Great Emperor?" Jin Caiwei's appearance instantly captured the attention of everyone in the Imperial City.
"How has the Ancient Heavenly Court also come to the Imperial City?"
"Which Qiongqi from the Ancient Era is this? According to the records, the Qiongqi from the group of Semi-Immortals should be male."
"Can't find it." The crowd could not find the corresponding Ancient Semi-Immortal.
"Forget about these details. Judging from the title, this Great Emperor controls wealth. Do you think paying respects might bring us prosperity?"
"Seems reasonable, why not give it a try?"
...
"It's you celestial beings again?" General Yu's smile faded, and the roguish grin was no longer on his face.
"The actions Wu Youdao took in the Wild State failed because of your Heavenly Court. Now, does your Heavenly Court want to meddle again?"
"Meddle?" The white Qiongqi revealed a mocking smile.
"This Immortal Peach comes from the only pre-existing Spirit Root between heaven and earth. Consuming one carries boundless mysteries, and it's not as simple as merely extending one's lifespan."
"Ancient Immortals have eaten them before. This pre-existing Spirit Root is essentially an item of my Heavenly Court. It's just a pity it was lost during the celestial battles at the end of the Ancient Era."
"Now that the Immortal Peach has appeared in the world, we can certainly retrieve that pre-existing Spirit Root."
"You Great Yu Cultivators are blind to treasure, failing to recognize the divine item before you, even daring to attempt to destroy this Immortal Peach, truly ignorant to the extreme!"
"The only pre-existing Spirit Root between heaven and earth?" General Yu got scared by this title; just hearing the name made him aware of how extraordinary the Immortal Peach was.
Indeed, apart from the legendary elixirs of eternal life, only such celestial items could revive the dying Emperor Xia.
"Why bother speaking so much with a contemporary bumpkin like you? Seek Dao Sect kid, hand over the Immortal Peach to me!" A giant white tiger paw reached out towards Lu Yang, looking like a small mountain.
Lu Yang stood frozen in place, terrified by the ancient Qiongqi's fearsome coercion.
"First come, first served. This Immortal Peach rightfully belongs to our Great Yu!" General Yu released a flame spirit knife burning with spiritual essence, knocking aside Jin Caiwei's tiger paw.
General Yu realized something, Emperor Xia was protected by the State Destiny, not so easily killed, only waiting for his natural death was an option. His mission was to prevent the Immortal Peach from being delivered to the Imperial Palace, and whether it was to be destroyed or to become his, it made no difference.
With that in mind, it was then the rule of the rivers and lakes, he who has the bigger fist gets to own the treasures!
Countless rare spirit iron was smelted into metal sheets by fire, and numerous sheets flew out, attaching to General Yu's body, forming a suit of fully armed armor.
This was his attire during the campaigns at the end of the Great Qian period, when he commanded thousands of troops with high spirits, and had the credentials to contend for the world.
General Yu, holding a Fire-tip Spear, attacked Jin Caiwei!
"Ignorant!" The golden tiger eyes were ice-cold. The Qiongqi governed slaughter, and her father was a ruthless figure who made a name for himself with his kills during the Ancient Times. As the youngest daughter of the old Qiongqi, how could she be any weaker?
Roar—
The Qiongqi roared, flapped its bony wings as if countless tormented souls were wailing, shattering the space. General Yu treaded on the fragments of space and charged straight at Jin Caiwei!
The white Qiongqi opened its huge, bloodied maw and clamped down directly on the spearhead of the Fire-tip Spear, then violently twisted its head, flinging the spear and General Yu with it.
To General Yu's shock, a tiger's tooth mark was left on the Fire-tip Spear, which had accompanied him through many battles. Even when facing the Nightmare Supreme and Emperor Yu Wu Yao as enemies, it had never been scratched. He hadn't expected it to be damaged by a single bite from this ancient Qiongqi.
As two ancient characters fought fiercely, Lu Yang dared not interfere and hastily ran off while clutching the Immortal Peach.
"Damn, he's coming this way!" The senior members of the Jiuyou Sect and Yaoyang Sect, who were enjoying the spectacle, panicked as they saw Lu Yang running towards them, their souls nearly scattering from fright.
Being at the Body Integration Realm, they naturally ran faster than Lu Yang. So, for a better view, they had taken position in front of Lu Yang.
Now, with Lu Yang trying to leave the battlefield and head for the Imperial Palace, he naturally ran towards them.
But the problem was, the two Semi-Immortals in the sky didn't agree with Lu Yang withdrawing from the battle!
Even though they were powerful, the leaders of both sects would not dare to closely observe the battle between Semi-Immortals.
General Yu dared not clash head-on with Jin Caiwei again. He activated the Dao Fruit Outline, and a black and crimson flame appeared in the palm of his right hand, which made the Sect Leader of the Yaoyang Sect's eyelids twitch.
He sensed that the temperature of the flame in General Yu's hand was even higher than the surface of the sun.
It was surely a temperature that could scorch to death or severely burn anyone at the Body Integration Realm!
And in General Yu's left-hand palm appeared a suspended block of ice, rapidly cooling the surrounding temperature. Countless frosts condensed in the air, and the trees below were frozen into ice lumps that shattered when touched.
The extreme heat and bone-chilling cold were both simultaneously under General Yu's control. On either side of him, these two opposing forces remarkably did not interfere with each other, staying in peaceful coexistence.
Jin Caiwei immediately recognized General Yu's Dao Fruit Outline, "Mastering two extremes, it seems you have the Yin-Yang Dao Fruit Outline."
Despite not having experienced the Great Era conflicts, Jin Caiwei often heard her father recounting events from that time, like the Immortal Jiuchong's Yin-Yang Dao Fruit.
"If it were Immortal Jiuchong in his Semi-Immortal phase, I truly would be no match, but you… are far from enough!"
"Arrogant! Today, let me show you that ancient is not better than the present!"
The black and crimson flame and the mysterious ice flew towards Jin Caiwei, with the fire threatening to collapse the space, and the ice, although not reaching the Immortal Jiuchong's temperature that could cease time itself, slowed time and movement!
Jin Caiwei extended her tiger claw and gently pressed downward. The black and crimson flame and the mysterious ice felt pressure from above and below, being compressed into a plane. If viewed from the front, one could only see a black line with not even a sliver of height.
Initially, General Yu didn't take it seriously and continued to manipulate the direction of the flame and ice. But soon, he noticed something was off—the flames and ice could only move laterally, unable to move up or down as if they were confined to an invisible plane, having lost the ability to move vertically.
Even the dispersing extreme heat and cold could only be felt on this plane.
Time flowed normally once more.
In reality, being hit by the Plane Dao Fruit Outline meant one could only move in parallel, unable to even scale obstacles. The reason everyone could move freely as a plane when sneaking into the Imperial Palace earlier was due to Jin Caiwei's intentional control.
"What is this Dao Fruit Outline of yours!"
Naturally, Jin Caiwei would not answer such a foolish question. Instead of a reply, General Yu received a tiger's roar from Jin Caiwei.
The roar formed sound waves, like astonishing tidal waves, wrapping around endlessly. General Yu, barraged by the waves, was pinned in that spot, unable to move.
Jin Caiwei once again activated the Plane Dao Fruit Outline, aiming to flatten General Yu into a plane.
General Yu, knowing he absolutely couldn't be hit, bellowed, "Yin and Yang Swap!"
General Yu traded places with his shadow. The shadow turned into a flat plane, unable to move up or down, while he himself narrowly escaped, his soul shaken to its core.

chapters.title: Chapter 869 - 868: Funeral for the Heavens
chapters.content:
```
The battle between the two Semi-Immortals over the Immortal Peach made the conflict between the Second Prince's side and the Meng Family seem insignificant.
Meng Potian, stepping on a masked acquaintance, stared eagerly at the Iron Armored Divine Being and the ancient Qiongqi battling in the sky above the Imperial City, suddenly recalling Old Ma's assessment of Lu Yang.
"Your Meng Family could afford to buy half of the Imperial City, right? Lu Yang's luck could destroy half of the Imperial City."
Even if the Imperial City were built to be extremely strong, it couldn't possibly withstand the full-force battle of two Semi-Immortals.
Fortunately, these two Semi-Immortals hadn't reached the end with their Dao Fruit Outlines, otherwise the Imperial City would have been destroyed even faster.
"Inverted Heavenly Gang Formation, True Shadow Exchange!" General Yu pointed at Jin Caiwei and her shadow began to rise, gradually taking the form of Jin Caiwei, only it was an outline without any detail.
General Yu could not only use his own shadow to dodge fatal calamities but could also control other people's shadows to attack them.
"Troublesome!" Jin Caiwei frowned; she had heard from her father that Immortal Jiuchong often used this technique to exhaust his opponents when he was a Semi-Immortal. After the opponent overcame their own shadow, they would be nearly drained of strength, making it extremely difficult to deal with.
But that was for other people.
"Get back!" Jin Caiwei, employing the outline of the Plane Dao Fruit, flattened the rising shadow back into a plane, suppressing it for now. She would deal with her own shadow slowly after the battle was over.
Jin Caiwei patted her Storage Ring, and countless bone shards flew out. These bone shards were polished to extreme sharpness, capable of cutting through hair upon blowing.
"Go!"
The choice of bone shards was because at this level, most cultivators could control metal, and by using bone or other special materials as weapons, they could avoid being controlled.
Countless bone shards flew through the air, leaving startling gashes in space. General Yu parried with a flourish of his spear, but although there were many bone shards, he had faced even more of these kinds of razor-sharp flying dagger attacks, so this level was nothing to him.
However, as soon as the Fire-tip Spear touched a bone shard, the tip of the spear was chopped in half, frightening General Yu from no longer daring to resist and forcing him to flee and dodge.
How could there be bone shards so sharp in the world!
General Yu didn't know that these bone shards had already been pressed into planes, devoid of the concept of height.
A weapon that wanted to be sharp needed to have an edge as thin as possible, and the ultimate thinness is to become a plane without height.
Without the Immortal Artifacts coming into play, no matter how good your weapon material, it would be cut through by these bone shards.
"Still dawdling over stealing a peach."
Accompanied by the cry of a phoenix, a colorful phoenix soared across the sky, looking down on the two battling Semi-Immortals below.
All birds revere the phoenix, and among phoenixes, the colorful ones are the most revered. Naturally, the colorful phoenix was none other than Jiang Lianyi, one of the Four Imperial Protectors of the Heavenly Court.
"It's the Nanji Nirvana Great Emperor Jiang Lianyi!"
The entire Imperial City could see the battle between the Semi-Immortals, and Jiang Lianyi made her appearance in the full view of everyone. Anyone who cared even a little about the Demon Territory could recognize Jiang Lianyi.
"Two out of the Four Imperial Protectors appearing, this is a sign of turmoil."
"Speaking of which, there has never been an occasion when more than two of the Heavenly Court's Four Imperial Protectors appeared at the same time."
Compared to the less famous Jin Caiwei, Jiang Lianyi's presence was much more known.
Although, for cultivators, the existence of General Yu was also the stuff of legend, he paled in comparison to the famed Jiang Lianyi from Ancient Times.
The crowd gasped as three Semi-Immortals appeared in the sky above the Imperial Palace all at once. Since the founding of Great Xia, there had never been a battle of this scale, especially not within the Imperial City.
"Space, lock down." Jiang Lianyi immediately used the outline of the Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit as soon as she appeared, locking down the space around General Yu.
Jiang Lianyi could shatter space, which meant she was stronger than space itself, and thus could manipulate some of the power of space.
```
In Ancient Times, Jiang Lianyi had already compared strengths with an unascended Immortal Jiuchong, far more familiar with how to deal with the Yin-Yang Dao Fruit Outline than Jin Caiwei.
Attacking the Yin-Yang Dao Fruit Outline with Five Elements Spells was futile; if you attacked with fire, he would counter with water, negating any attack effect, and a better method was to use Body Cultivation or to directly attack with weapons, but the best way was to manipulate space and time.
General Yu was locked in place, several shards of bone piercing through his waist and cutting him in half.
Jin Caiwei pouted; it was dreadful that just as she gained the upper hand, Jiang Lianyi suddenly burst in and stole her thunder.
As the three Semi-Immortals battled fiercely, Lu Yang, exhausted to death, finally made it through most of Imperial City and finally saw the Imperial Palace.
...
Within the Imperial Palace, Emperor Xia, lying on the sickbed, had become skin and bones, his lips parched, with all kinds of spirit pills and precious treasures piled beside the bed that could extend one's lifespan just by their mere presence.
But for Emperor Xia, whose lifespan was exhausted, they were of no use.
His eyesight was hazy, as if he sensed the great battle of the three Semi-Immortals outside the palace, and felt Lu Yang rushing towards him with the life-saving Immortal item.
He struggled to turn his head, but now, he was so weak that even turning his head was impossible, and he could only move his eyeballs.
He knew that Lu Yang wanted to save him, but he also knew that he wouldn't last until then.
"I... I... still have so much to do..."
He had not yet spread education, had not reduced the cost of medical treatment, had not cleared the officialdom of corruption, had not exterminated the Demon Cultivators, had not eradicated the Ancient Cultivators...
Most importantly, he had not designated his successor.
...
However, at this moment, Lu Yangxin's heartbeat quickened; no, not only his, but all the citizens of Great Xia's hearts inexplicably accelerated, as if something bad was happening, touching the hearts of all.
A red glow shot up into the sky from within the Imperial Palace, the light ribbon-like, drifting in the air as if a lost person searching for their future direction.
Lu Yang showed a confused expression, not understanding what had happened.
Meng Potian and Meng Kuang saw this scene from afar, sharing the same sensation as Lu Yang, the difference being that they knew what had happened.
Emperor Xia's funeral ceremony commenced without naming a successor, and without Jiang Pingan to soothe the Power of National Fate, it went out of control and unbound.
If one wished to control the Power of National Fate, they would either have to wait for Jiang Pingan's return or for one of the princes to ascend the throne.
Neither of those methods was feasible at the moment.
Because an Immortal had appeared.
"Finally, I have waited for this opportunity."
A deep laugh echoed through the heavens, merely by the sound of which the clouds above Imperial City dispersed, and the Jinsha River that flowed through the city came to a halt.
The old man with gray hair walked through the air with his hands behind his back, arriving above the Imperial Palace, utterly indifferent to the shocked or angry glances from below. Instead, he gazed at the bewildered national fate with a smile, intoxicated by the sight.
Lu Yang and Jin Caiwei were very familiar with this gray-haired elder; they had just met him not long ago.
The Dean of Taixue Academy, Qi Xiuya.
But he had another, more resounding identity and name.
The first Imperial Teacher of Great Yu, Guan Shanhai.

chapters.title: Chapter 870 - 869: Guan Shanhai
chapters.content:
Lu Yang, seeing the Power of National Fate suspended in the air as if it had become masterless, recalled the knowledge about the Power of National Fate that Meng Jingzhou had previously shared with him.
The separation of the Power of National Fate from Emperor Xia's body could only mean one thing—Emperor Xia has passed away!
He was still a step too late!
Lu Yang immediately recognized the elderly man with the bearing of a ruler standing in the sky above the Imperial Palace as Qi Xiuya, the Dean of the Taixue Academy, who had the deepest historical scholarship he had seen.
"How could Dean Qi be here!"
Lu Yang remembered that Dean Qi was only of the Body Integration Realm in terms of Cultivation Level, which certainly wasn't enough to meddle with the Power of National Fate, the foundation of Great Xia!
Not just the Body Integration Realm, even those in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage wouldn't dare to touch such a thing!
"And this oppressive aura..."
Originally, Qi Xiuya's cultivation was reserved, like an ordinary old man, but perhaps because he finally got the Power of National Fate, he couldn't help releasing a bit of his pressure.
Just the pressure leaked from his emotional fluctuations alone covered the Imperial City and even the nearby eight cities!
Not even those in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage could achieve such an extent with full release of their oppressive aura.
"It's an Immortal!" Lu Yang was the first to make the judgment.
"Imperial Teacher, save me!" General Yu, seeing the Power of National Fate finally leaving Emperor Xia's body and Dean Qi making his final appearance to reap it, couldn't help but cry out for help.
He was being attacked jointly by Jin Caiwei and Jiang Lianyi, completely powerless to fight back.
"Imperial Teacher?!"
The only one whom General Yu would willingly call "Imperial Teacher" was the original Imperial Teacher, Guan Shanhai, who was both a teacher and a friend to Emperor Yu Wu Yao, and had jointly built the Great Yu Dynasty.
He was also one of only two Immortals in the Great Yu Dynasty.
The moment Lu Yang confirmed the identity of the Imperial Teacher, he roughly guessed Great Yu's scheme.
Guan Shanhai, in order to seize the Power of National Fate, took advantage of Emperor Xia's critical illness and the turmoil in Yu State to lure the Jiang Family's Ancient Ancestor to provide support. In doing so, he would be the only Immortal in the Imperial City and could do whatever he wanted.
An Immortal wanting to hide his identity could suppress his Cultivation Level, change his appearance, and start growing from the body of an infant. As he aged, he could gradually remove the seal on his cultivation.
Thus, every step of his growth would have traces to follow, and even if Great Xia wanted to investigate, they would not find anything.
It was unclear how long Guan Shanhai had lived in the Imperial City under a false name. Even the identity of Dean Qi had been used for over a thousand years.
With Dean Qi's students spread across the land, it was not without reason to see his students as sources of intelligence, like Ye Gu, who taught in the Meng Family's private school. From Ye Gu, he could obtain information about the Meng Family.
Lu Yang thought to himself that he knew there was something off about Dean Qi. How could an ordinary person with Cultivation Level in the Body Integration Realm have no grudges with his master?
"The Imperial Teacher of Great Yu?!" General Yu's call was loud enough for half of the Imperial City to hear clearly, causing utter shock and immediately plunging the city into chaos.
Although they did not know what the Power of National Fate was or the purpose of the Great Yu National Preceptor's visit, the appearance of an ancient Immortal in the Imperial City was an extremely dangerous signal!
Guan Shanhai ignored the panic-stricken expressions of the people in the Imperial City and the calls of General Yu. He walked on air, step by step approaching the crimson Power of National Fate.
As he got closer to the Power of National Fate, his appearance also changed, transforming into a middle-aged man with a goatee and sunken cheeks, gradually overlapping with the portraits of him in historical records.
The Power of National Fate, as if sensing Guan Shanhai's ill intent, swayed restlessly, sending out fluctuations strong enough to make even those in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage palpitate.
But Guan Shanhai simply smiled faintly and reached out to grasp the Power of National Fate, like a snake catcher seizing the snake's vital point, rendering the snake's twisting and turning futile.
"Jiang Pingan truly has some skills, managing to create something like the Power of National Fate."
The Power of National Fate was something Jiang Pingan had created after the founding of Great Xia. It belonged to Immortal creations; however, unlike the Mother-child River and the Twin River, the Power of National Fate was directly manufactured by Jiang Pingan using the authority of the Dao Fruit. It carried the wishes of Great Xia's tens of millions of people and was the foundation of Great Xia.
Since it was something Jiang Pingan had created after expending countless efforts, even Guan Shanhai couldn't acquire the Power of National Fate completely in a short time.
But he didn't need to obtain the Power of National Fate completely. What he valued was the connection between the Power of National Fate and the people—he could rely on this connection to transform Great Xia into Great Yu!
The moment he grasped the Power of National Fate, he had already begun to refine it.
Refining the Power of National Fate wasn't difficult, but it was time-consuming. During the process of refining, he slowly turned his head and looked at the jade general who had become flat and was sliced into countless pieces, as well as Jiang Lianyi and Jin Caiwei, who were on high alert.
"Jin Dao friend, it's been several days since we parted from the Taixue Academy, and here we meet again. I didn't expect it to be under these circumstances," Guan Shanhai said with a smile, showing no hint of aggression.
"Jiang Dao friend, I have long admired the grand name of the Phoenix Ancestor. Today, having met you, indeed, you are out of the ordinary. If it weren't for the fact that you have someone above you, I fear you would be an Immortal by now."
Despite Guan Shanhai's politeness and his willingness to consider Jiang Lianyi and Jin Caiwei as his peers given his status as an Immortal, it still provoked hostility from the two women.
Guan Shanhai acted as if he didn't notice the hostility in the eyes of the two women, and once more gave a respectful bow toward an empty space.
"And Ao Ling Dao friend, hiding here for such a long time, it's time for you to show yourself."
Ripples spread through space, and Ao Ling, with a grim face, stepped out from it, fixing her gaze on Guan Shanhai.
Even with her unparalleled talent for concealment, she couldn't hide from Immortal perception.
"Please release the jade general, my fellow Dao friends."
Guan Shanhai's tone was calm, as if discussing a trivial matter.
Ao Ling stared at Guan Shanhai for a moment, then slowly exhaled. The gap between an Immortal and a Semi-Immortal was all too clear to her. This was not an opponent they could defeat.
"Release the jade general."
Jin Caiwei obediently complied, undoing the Plane Dao Fruit Outline and letting the jade general revert to a three-dimensional shape.
However, the jade general was now just small fragments. To restore its original form, it was up to the jade general's own efforts.
"Guan here thanks the three Dao friends. I came to the Imperial City just for the Power of National Fate, yet I never thought I'd have the chance to meet the three wives of the Qilin Immortal. Truly, I am extremely fortunate." Guan Shanhai, as the head of the Taixue Academy, was not solely hiding his identity and gathering intelligence—he genuinely enjoyed studying history.
Especially ancient history.
"Three wives?"
Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi looked at each other in confusion—since when did their husband have three wives?
Guan Shanhai was also taken aback: "It was Jin Dao friend who told me, could it be a mistake?"
Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi simultaneously turned their heads, staring at Jin Caiwei.
Guan Shanhai did not dwell on this matter but continued to speak with a respectful gesture.
"May I trouble the three Dao friends to inform Guan about the whereabouts of the Qilin Immortal? There are some matters I would like to ask him about."
Ao Ling shook her head: "None of us know where our husband is."
Guan Shanhai narrowed his eyes, not believing the words of Ao Ling and the others, and his tone turned slightly unfriendly: "Guan believes he has been quite amiable towards the three Dao friends, I hope the three of you do not think Guan is easy to talk to!"
"Tell Guan the location of the Qilin Immortal, otherwise the three Dao friends may have to stay here today and wait for the Qilin Immortal to come and fetch you!"

chapters.title: Chapter 871 - 870 Guan Shanhai's Bizarre Tactics
chapters.content:
Unlike Wu Yao who was determined to leave the Cultivation World and venture into the outside world, Guan Shanhai poured countless efforts into establishing the Great Yu Dynasty.
But in the end, the Great Yu Dynasty collapsed, and it was even Wu Yao himself who personally sacrificed the dynasty just to leave the Cultivation World.
Since then, he and Wu Yao took different paths and had never seen each other again.
Although Wu Yao had managed to leave the Cultivation World as he wished, Guan Shanhai couldn't get over the destruction of Great Yu.
When the Great Yu Dynasty fell, the Qilin Immortal too had appeared, but Guan Shanhai was unclear about the role the Qilin Immortal played in the dynasty's demise. He must meet him to find out!
Previously, with only Jin Caiwei, he wasn't certain about her status in the eyes of the Qilin Immortal, and with Jiang Pingan alarmed by his move, he could forget about snatching away the Power of National Fate.
Now, with all three wives of the Qilin Immortal here, he didn't believe that capturing the three of them wouldn't make the Qilin Immortal show himself!
The perfect time, place, and harmony were all on his side.
"If you're not willing to talk, then you can all stay!"
Guan Shanhai shed his previously respectful demeanor, his expression cold and indifferent as if he were the supreme ruler with the power of life and death, regarding everyone before him as worthless as straw dogs.
Although he was reluctant to offend the power of the Heavenly Court, he absolutely needed to know the information about the Qilin Immortal.
Jin Caiwei repeated her old trick, sending out countless flattened bone shards that filled the sky, unavoidable.
Guan Shanhai walked unhurriedly towards Jin Caiwei, letting the bone shards hit him.
The bone shards that could hack General Yu to pieces couldn't cause even the slightest harm to Guan Shanhai.
"If I'm not mistaken, your Dao Fruit is of the spatial type, capable of removing the concept of 'height'."
"The idea of flattening the bone shards is nice, but unfortunately, you're unaware of the strength of an Immortal's Body."
Guan Shanhai didn't need to use his Dao Fruit; he could block all the bone shards just with the body of an Immortal.
An Immortal truly exists on a different level, while a Semi-Immortal hasn't completely transformed and still falls under the category of a mortal.
There are very few mortal measures qualified to harm an Immortal.
"Let's catch one first."
Guan Shanhai drew closer to Jin Caiwei, his steps appearing slow but actually each step utilized "Heaven and Earth in an Inch"; he approached like an imposing mountain, leaving Jin Caiwei too frightened to move.
"Don't even think about it!"
Ao Ling let out a light rebuke and transformed into a black True Dragon, using her indestructible horns to strike Guan Shanhai and actually sent him flying.
"Interesting, the reports collected from the East Sea said you could attain an Immortal's Body in a short period, indeed you've got some tricks."
Ao Ling was well prepared, as early as when Lu Yang planned to send the Immortal Peach to the Imperial Palace, she had Jiang Lianyi beat her up to rapidly elevate herself to an Immortal's Body.
Now, it seemed fortunate that she had been so well prepared.
In the face of a powerful Immortal enemy, the three women dared not be negligent and revealed their true forms: a white Qiongqi, a multicolored Immortal Phoenix, and a dark black True Dragon; their immense bodies were larger than the mountains of the Imperial City, blocking out the sun and sky as if ancient myths had come back to life.
Feeling the oppressive might of the Immortal beasts, the cultivators in the Imperial City below trembled like chaff, unable to stand firm.
"Heh, do you think having an Immortal's Body will be enough to protect the two of them?"
Guan Shanhai let out a light laugh, pulling out a corpse from his Storage Ring that nobody recognized, the only certainty being that in life, it was a Pass Tribulation Cultivator.
The body of the Pass Tribulation Cultivator, originally in its middle age, began to change shape as Guan Shanhai placed his hand on the corpse's face, transforming from a middle-aged man with only a few lines on his face to an old man full of deep wrinkles!
Ao Ling frowned, not understanding what Guan Shanhai was up to.
To everyone's surprise, the wrinkled old man suddenly opened his eyes, waking up!
Soon, someone below recognized the identity of the old man with a face full of wrinkles, their voices trembling, "He is... the second Imperial Teacher of Great Yu!"
The second Imperial Teacher of Great Yu was a major figure who influenced the course of Great Yu's history, and his portraits were widely circulated.
And he had once died at Seek Dao Sect.
"What kind of technique is this!" Jin Caiwei was astonished, the deceased had been resurrected, and after revival, they didn't even look like they did in death, not the same person at all.
"Master, where am I?" asked the second Imperial Teacher, looking around blankly at Guan Shanhai equally clueless about what had happened.
Guan Shanhai stroked his disciple's head with affection, without explaining too much, he pointed at Jin Caiwei and Jiang Lianyi, "Go and capture those two, you may hurt them, but you must not let them lose their lives."
"As you command!" Out of trust for his master, the second Imperial Teacher didn't hesitate, vanishing from sight under the watchful eyes of all present.
Everyone seemed to forget his existence, even Ao Ling and her companions were just warily watching Guan Shanhai, completely forgetting what had just happened.
Suddenly, Jin Caiwei felt a heavy blow to her back, a spirit knife plunged into it.
It was then that everyone remembered the existence of the second Imperial Teacher, recalling the events that had just unfolded!
Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi remembered what Lu Yang had once mentioned—that the second Imperial Teacher of Great Yu possessed the Dao Fruit Outline of Causality, able to erase his own causality; had he not encountered the exact counter in Sha Meless last time, other Semi-Immortals would have had difficulty dealing with him!
All three females had never seen Guan Shanhai use this technique before; it was a Dao Fruit that had not appeared even in Ancient Times, nor even an outline of one!
Jiang Lianyi released a five-colored divine light, enveloping Jin Caiwei, healing her wounds.
Guan Shanhai looked on with a smile, asking Ao Ling, who had a stern expression, "Now, what will you do?"
"How long can you maintain your Immortal's Body?"
Ao Ling's expression changed, indeed, she couldn't maintain the Immortal's Body forever, and Guan Shanhai's techniques were quite strange, incredibly hard to deal with; she couldn't even escape if she wanted to. It was a checkmate.
Seeing this scene from below, Lu Yang was very anxious, quickly rousing the slumbering Fairy Eternity.
"Fairy, wake up, there's big trouble!"
In the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity awoke from her vast and comfortable Imperial throne, grumbling with reluctance.
"What's the matter, waking up this Immortal, is the boring play finally over?"
"It's Emperor Xia, he's gone!"
Fairy Eternity yawned greatly, unsurprised by the news, "So the play is over then."
Lu Yang was stunned for a moment.
Suddenly, a hearty laugh echoed across the skies of Imperial City, the source of the voice flitting near and far, elusive; Guan Shanhai, who was about to take down the three females, stopped dead in his tracks.
"Guan my friend, how well have you refined the Power of National Fate?"
Guan Shanhai searched around for the owner of the voice; he was familiar with it, having heard it before, but he couldn't quite place where he had heard it!
Guan Shanhai looked knowingly, his gaze stretching from the north to the south of Imperial City, towards the location of the Meng Residence.
Above the Meng Residence, the image of a young man appeared with a smile on his face, looking at Guan Shanhai and even waving a hand as if to greet an old friend not seen in a long while.
Guan Shanhai's memory was dragged back a hundred thousand years, to when Great Yu had fallen amidst chaotic times, two great powers rising to vie for the world, one with the surname Jiang and the other Meng.
In the final battle for supremacy, the two foreswore clashing armies in favor of a duel to decide who would be the future emperor.
In that battle, Jiang Pingan ascended to immortality.
The man surnamed Meng likewise left a deep impression on Guan Shanhai.
"Meng Junzi!"

chapters.title: Chapter 872 - 871 Pretending
chapters.content:
Guan Shanhai's voice spread throughout the entire Imperial City, and everyone from the princes and high officials to the common people trembled upon hearing that name.
Even the children studying letters in private schools had heard the name "Meng Junzi".
The patriarch of the Meng Family, who once competed with the Jiang Family for the world, and although the Jiang Family ultimately won and established Great Xia, the Meng Family did not end up like the losers of previous dynastic struggles, being purged. On the contrary, they thrived and became the foremost influential family in Great Xia.
This was in part because the patriarch of the Jiang Family held onto old affections, but more importantly, it was due to the profound depths of the Meng Family's foundation.
The origins of the Meng Family could be traced back to the Great Yu Era, but at that time, the Meng Family was no more than an ordinary influential family. It was Meng Junzi, who became the head of the family at the end of the Great Yu Era, who really led the Meng Family to greatness and accumulated their rich foundation.
"Dao Friend Guan, harboring such heavy murderous intent isn't very good," said Meng Junzi, standing with his hands behind his back, exuding a poised and tranquil aura that dispersed the oppressive presence of the Immortal enveloping the Imperial City.
"You've really become an Immortal!" If before Guan Shanhai had been half in doubt, now he was certain that Meng Junzi had indeed become an Immortal, just like himself.
The appearance of Meng Junzi shocked everyone, including Meng Jingzhou.
Meng Jingzhou gawked at his ancestor standing above him, his mouth agape in astonishment.
No way, so the old patriarch has become an Immortal.
Man Gu was also quite shocked. He had only been in the Imperial City for an hour and had already encountered two Immortals. He knew that following Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou would enrich his experience.
Meng Junzi had only shown himself at the very beginning of Great Xia's establishment; since then, he had never again appeared. People said that after losing to Jiang Pingan, he grew disheartened and sealed himself away.
Guan Shanhai thought the same, Jiang Pingan and Meng Junzi, these two geniuses of later generations, were too dazzling to ignore. Otherwise, he wouldn't have sent students to teach at the Meng Family private school in his capacity as the headmaster of the Taixue Academy.
Originally, he had witnessed with his own eyes how Meng Junzi sealed himself and had his descendants bury him in the mountains of the Meng Residence.
It seems that the self-sealing was all a show for his benefit.
An Immortal need not seal himself away!
Guan Shanhai stared intently at Meng Junzi, trying to recall when exactly Meng Junzi had become an Immortal right under his nose and where the Immortal Ascension Tribulation had taken place.
Suddenly, he realized that Meng Junzi had become an Immortal ten thousand years ago.
"Back when Wu Yao and I both ascended to immortality during the nation-founding ceremony, you and Jiang Pingan did the same during your final battle, both becoming Immortals!"
"Who would have thought, for a hundred thousand years, you have never used the power of Dao Fruit, always pretending to be a Semi-Immortal. You really are patient, Meng Junzi, I truly underestimated you!"
With a slight smile, Meng Junzi replied, "You see, when fishing, one must always be patient. And look, hasn't today brought some rewards?"
Guan Shanhai, who was always cautious and would avoid fighting if possible, believed that as long as he avoided conflict, he would never be defeated. For this reason, he sent Jiang Pingan away. If he knew Meng Junzi had become an Immortal, he definitely wouldn't have appeared in the Imperial City.
Guan Shanhai, as if not hearing Meng Junzi's challenge, let out a cold laugh, "When I sent General Yu to intercept the Immortal Peach, you didn't intervene, watching passively as Emperor Xia faced his demise. You truly are heartless."
This was a statement meant to condemn Meng Junzi's heart. By bringing this up, Guan Shanhai intended to make it clear to everyone in the Imperial City that their so-called emperor was nothing more than a tool manipulated and calculated by Immortals, a revelation that could shake the emperor's standing in the hearts of the people!
However, Meng Junzi was not in the least bit anxious upon hearing this and remained in his leisurely manner, "How can you be so sure that Emperor Xia is truly dead?"
"Or even say, did Emperor Xia truly have issues with his lifespan?"
...
"What do you mean by acting? Emperor Xia hasn't died of old age; is there still time to send the Immortal Peach now?"
Fairy Eternity was still half asleep, continuing to yawn, eyes bleary: "Immortal Peach? Didn't Miss Yun mention she only found one, and the whereabouts of the Heavenly Root are unknown? Such a treasured item, Little Yang, you might as well have it, considering Emperor Xia's lifespan exhaustion is all an act."
"An act?"
Lu Yang was taken aback; he had thought that 'acting' referred to Emperor Xia's imperial funeral rites, but from what was said, even Emperor Xia's lifespan issues were a fabrication?
Upon hearing the heightened pitch in the Second-in-command's voice, Fairy Eternity finally became more alert and said, "If he was about to die, why would I have let him become the Prime Minister?"
"You knew from the beginning that Emperor Xia's lifespan was a pretense?"
"Not from the very start, it was during those three months when I served as the Acting Sect Master, getting ready for the twelve-millennium celebration of the Seek Dao Sect. Remember the meeting at the Imperial Palace with Emperor Xia? It was then that I realized he was faking it."
"But that was the first time you met him!"
This was something even Yun Zhi had not anticipated. Emperor Xia's ruse could fool Lu Yang, the whole world, and even Guan Shanhai, but not Fairy Eternity, who possessed the Eternity Dao Fruit and the power over life and death.
Lu Yang recalled something.
It was Eldest Senior Sister who first told him and the Fairy that Emperor Xia was nearing his end, asking the Fairy if there was any immortal item that could extend his life. Fairy Eternity suggested giving Emperor Xia the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit, thus making him the Fourth Housekeeper; after Eldest Senior Sister rejected this, the Fairy then mentioned the Immortal Peach.
Ever since the Fairy had met with Emperor Xia at the Imperial Palace, she no longer brought up the idea of making him the Fourth Housekeeper.
Not only did she not propose making Emperor Xia the Fourth Housekeeper, but after defeating the leaders of the Four Great Immortal Sects at the palace, she even suggested challenging Emperor Xia.
If Emperor Xia truly had little time left, Fairy Eternity wouldn't have done such a thing.
Lu Yang understood; right from the start, this whole scenario was a trap laid for Guan Shanhai.
No wonder Eldest Senior Sister didn't directly bring the Immortal Peach to the Imperial Palace but passed it to him through Man Gu.
Eldest Senior Sister had never intended to let Emperor Xia consume the Immortal Peach to extend his lifespan.
If Emperor Xia extended his lifespan, the Power of National Fate would remain with him, and Guan Shanhai would not have been likely to make his move.
The purpose of the Immortal Peach was to provoke Guan Shanhai into taking action, thus convincing him that Emperor Xia was indeed done for.
...
Guan Shanhai's expression was so gloomy it could drip water.
He had not anticipated everything was a sham.
He had been closely monitoring Emperor Xia's movements lately, observing him up close in the guise of Chancellor Qi, yet he failed to detect the emperor's deception.
As a naturally suspicious person, the recent changes in Imperial City indeed resembled the dying days of Emperor Xia: the emperor had the Crown Prince pretend to handle affairs to test his capability, then the Crown Prince's reluctance to inherit the throne, followed by Emperor Xia eliminating the Fourth and Fifth Princes, forcing the Crown Prince to ascend.
"Very well, very well. To think that Guan has spent a lifetime scheming against others, yet never imagined he'd be outwitted by you juniors!"

chapters.title: Chapter 873 - 872: The Great Yu National Preceptor's Dao Fruit
chapters.content:
"But do you really think you can take me down that easily!"
Even though he was being schemed against, Guan Shanhai wasn't flustered; he was not unwilling to fight, just not eager to engage in battle!
Moreover, Meng Junzi didn't even know what his Dao Fruit was.
To his surprise, what Meng Junzi said next made his heart skip a beat.
"If I'm not mistaken, Guan Dao You's Dao Fruit ability is assimilation, isn't it? It can completely transform one person into another. If that weren't the case, Guan Dao You wouldn't be able to restore Great Yu."
Meng Junzi and Jiang Pingan had been aware of Guan Shanhai's existence early on and noted his ambition to revive Great Yu.
Guan Shanhai's Dao Fruit was never recorded in any historical records. Reviving Great Yu was not as simple as just killing off the Jiang Family and taking their place—the evolution over a hundred thousand years meant that Great Yu and Great Xia were entirely different dynasties.
Both of them suspected that Guan Shanhai's Dao Fruit could help in reviving Great Yu and made many speculations about it.
When Meng Junzi then saw Guan Shanhai transform a corpse into the Second Imperial Teacher, he finally confirmed his conjecture.
Actually, Meng Junzi's guess was slightly off from the truth; Guan Shanhai had named his Dao Fruit "Imprinting Dao Fruit."
For instance, he could take a dead body at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage as a vessel and imprint the memory of the Second Imperial Teacher onto it as he remembered him.
This was more than just copying of memories; it could fully restore appearance, muscle memory, the outline of their Dao Fruit, instinctive reactions, and unique constitutions, nearly the same as resurrection!
The only issue was that he was unaware of the events that unfolded after the Second Imperial Teacher entered the Seek Dao Sect, hence the imprinted Second Imperial Teacher would lack the memories of his life prior to his death.
Using a living person as a vessel was even more effective. Imprinting on the dead meant only creating a body with memories, but imprinting on the living could completely alter a person's soul into that of another!
The Power of National Fate was linked to the people of Great Xia, and this was what Guan Shanhai was interested in.
In his mind, he remembered the early days of Great Yu, an era deemed by Great Xia as the "Prosperous Age of Wu Yao," in its entire splendor. He remembered every person, event, and object from that time—he recalled all three thousand years of that era.
He could use the Power of National Fate to imprint the people from the "Prosperous Age of Wu Yao" into the present day Great Xia, turning Great Xia's people into those from that age!
For example, he could use his Imprinting Dao Fruit to transform Lu Yang into a genius from the Prosperous Age of Wu Yao.
Only then could it be called the revival of Great Yu!
In fact, he could transform Great Xia into his vision of Great Yu without relying on the Power of National Fate, but this method would be slow, and Jiang Pingan would certainly intervene and cause disruptions, far less efficient than utilizing the Power of National Fate.
It was just that he hadn't yet begun to assimilate the Power of National Fate; ever since Meng Junzi appeared, he had been on constant alert, daring not to be distracted and continue the assimilation process.
A figure was anxiously directing an army to enter the Imperial City.
"Hurry, hurry, hurry, everyone get to your assigned positions quickly, deploy the grand formation! If there's the slightest mistake, be prepared for martial law!"
This was the Imperial City's Imperial Guard Army, stationed near the Imperial City. Now that the Imperial City was in trouble, although they couldn't influence the outcome of a battle between Immortals, they could deploy barriers to ensure the city wasn't affected by the battle.
The one commanding them was none other than Meng Jingzhou's third uncle, the former frontier general who guarded the Lock Demon Gate, known as the scholarly general Meng Poci.
Meng Poci looked up at the two conspicuous figures in the sky, clutching the transfer order he just received, and muttered softly.
"Bringing me from Lock Demon Gate to the Imperial City last year, could it have been for today's battle?"
The commander of the Imperial City's Imperial Guard Army wasn't Meng Poci. However, after Emperor Xia's feigned death and Guan Shanhai's appearance, Meng Poci suddenly received a telepathic message from Meng Junzi, instructing him to rush to the Imperial City's military camp to take control of the Imperial Guard Army and giving him a transfer order with the Jade Imperial Seal.
When he saw Meng Junzi, Meng Poci was dumbfounded; he didn't expect the old ancestor to appear at that time.
Without time for shock, he hastily rushed to the army camp outside the Imperial City.
The Great Xia military was filled with seasoned veterans, many of whom had more years of service and higher Cultivation Levels than Meng Poci, yet when it came to defensive formations, none could compare to him.
Guan Shanhai paid no attention to the commotion below; he didn't care what sort of reaction the Imperial City might have. His sole enemy from beginning to end was none other than Meng Junzi.
"Three friends from the Heavenly Court, I can handle matters here. What do you think?"
Meng Junzi spoke politely to Ao Ling and the other two, aware that they were actually on his side.
In a battle of Immortals, Ao Ling and his companions could not lend a hand, and with Ao Ling's time in the Immortal's Body drawing to a close, staying would only add obstacles for Meng Junzi. Understanding the situation, the trio wisely left the battlefield.
"It seems that a battle between us is inevitable," said Guan Shanhai with a smile that did not reach his eyes.
At the same moment, the Second Great Yu National Preceptor erased his own causality, vanished into thin air, and suddenly appeared behind Meng Junzi, raising a dagger forged from Immortal Stone, and ferociously stabbed towards the top of Meng Junzi's head!
Meng Junzi raised a hand and grabbed the wrist of the National Preceptor, applying a slight pressure and crushing it.
"The outline of the Dao Fruit of Causality is indeed troublesome to deal with, but that's for Semi-Immortals. To an Immortal, it's not a concern!"
The wrist of the Second Great Yu National Preceptor shattered, and along with it, the dagger in his hand fell. Meng Junzi reached out to pick up the spoils of war, this item could be considered an Immortal Treasure, quite a rarity.
Boom—
Without warning, the dagger exploded, releasing a toxic green smoke that spread around Meng Junzi.
This was a deadly poisonous fog, formed from the collective resentment of hundreds of millions of the deceased from the last period of Great Qian, surrounding and causing the poisoned person to self-destruct from within!
The Second Great Yu National Preceptor took the opportunity to flee far away, also leaving the battlefield.
He specialized in assassination and curses, but neither was effective against an Immortal; his real purpose in the previous attack was to set the dagger for self-detonation.
Meng Junzi heard innumerable wails around him, blaming the heavens for their injustice, for bringing war to the world, blaming the dynasty for its indifference, not caring about the lives of the people.
"Stop complaining, it's as if you're blaming me for this too."
Meng Junzi remained completely unaffected by the resentment, directly absorbing the poisonous fog until it was gone.
No matter how his opponents judged him, he had always acted justly and sat upright, with a clear conscience.
When Meng Junzi absorbed the fog, he noticed that behind Guan Shanhai stood five figures.
The Jade General, Nightmare Supreme, Master of All Laws, Wood Imprint Elder, and Emperor Yu Wu Yao from his Semi-Immortal period!
Five Semi-Immortals!
Except for the Jade General, the other four had been imprinted using the bodies of those in the Transcendence Tribulation Stage.
The Jade General was aware of the current situation, while the other four knew nothing about it.
Emperor Yu Wu Yao's expression changed dramatically. He remembered defeating Nightmare Supreme with his teacher and preparing to conquer the last state, and his teacher should also still be a Semi-Immortal.
But what about here? Nightmare Supreme was still alive, his teacher had ascended to immortality, and the huge city below did not belong to any place in his memory.
Considering his teacher's Imprinted Dao Fruit Outline, it was not hard to guess that he was an imprinted person.
"Teacher, what time is it now, and whom are you fighting against?"
Guan Shanhai frowned imperceptibly, finding the trouble with imprinted individuals - they were exactly like the real people, not under his control.

chapters.title: Chapter 874 - 873 Borrow
chapters.content:
```
Although Guan Shanhai and Wu Yao had a relationship that was both mentor and friend, and Wu Yao even called Guan Shanhai 'teacher', this did not mean that Wu Yao had absolute trust in Guan Shanhai, the same way the second Imperial Teacher did.
Wu Yao's curiosity outran everything else; he was curious about all unknown things, and his path of cultivation began from curiosity about the cultivation technique in the arms of a dead cultivator.
His cultivation level soared because he was curious about what it felt like to reach higher realms.
Driven by his curiosity, he established the Great Yu Dynasty, cultivated to an immortal, and even sacrificed the Great Yu Dynasty to find out what the outside world was like.
The Wu Yao replicated by Guan Shanhai had the exact same personality as the real Wu Yao; he wanted to know what had happened, why his real self wasn't there, and why he now had to fight.
Before Guan Shanhai could answer, they heard Nightmare Supreme retreating several steps with a look of utter shock, his voice quivering.
"Guan Shanhai, when did you, you, you become an immortal?!"
Nightmare Supreme's memory still lingered in the Great Qian Last Period of the world's struggle for supremacy, when he had defeated countless formidable enemies, including General Yu, and to establish a new dynasty, he still needed to defeat the rising star Wu Yao, as well as Wu Yao's mentor Guan Shanhai.
But the current problem is, if you, Guan Shanhai, have damn become an immortal, how am I supposed to establish a new dynasty?
Master of All Laws and Monk Woodyprint, seeing the three legendary figures—Guan Shanhai, Wu Yao, and Nightmare Supreme—all showed an expression of disbelief.
Watching his half-immortal replicas arguing noisily with different expressions, Guan Shanhai felt a wave of weariness; they were already providing entertainment before the fight even started.
Guan Shanhai sighed, knowing immortal battles were a matter of split-second decisions. With a mere thought, he stripped the four of their lives in their expressions of horror, swallowing up their Dao Fruit Outlines.
Although he couldn't control the thoughts of those he imprinted, he could control the Dao Fruit Outlines he imprinted.
The only problem was that people and Dao Fruit Outlines were tightly interlinked; he couldn't just imprint the Dao Fruit Outlines.
Thus, he obtained four Dao Fruit Outlines: Dreamland Dao Fruit Embryo, Swap Dao Fruit Embryo, Longevity Dao Fruit Embryo, and Monk Woodyprint's Rejuvenation Dao Fruit Embryo.
Guan Shanhai instantly accelerated his own time, increasing his speed to a level that even Meng Junzi's immortal senses could not react to—in the eyes of those below, it seemed as if he had vanished into thin air.
"Nine Revolutions Indestructible Golden Body."
Guan Shanhai activated the profound Buddhist skill, endured nine hardships, and molded an undying golden body, transforming into a golden-bodied Buddha.
He had used this Golden Body technique to pass through his Immortal Ascension Tribulation, and now that he had become an immortal, reactivating the Golden Body technique, one could imagine just how hard his Immortal's Body had become, saying it was eternally undying wouldn't be an overstatement.
In the Imperial City, only Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity were able to clearly see what Guan Shanhai did.
Fairy Eternity, looking at the ever-accelerating Guan Shanhai, said with a smile, "Quite a clever approach, using the young Master of All Laws' Longevity Dao Fruit Embryo to accelerate your own time and further fortify your body, making every single one of your movements powerful enough to rival that of an Immortal Artifact."
Guan Shanhai appeared behind Meng Junzi like a ghost, his five fingers coming together to form a golden Immortal Saber, aiming to decapitate Meng Junzi!
His hand was also imbued with the power of a curse, ensuring that even if Meng Junzi could reattach his head, it would still damage his vital energy.
However, to Guan Shanhai's surprise, Meng Junzi's head tilted lightly backwards, just managing to dodge the strike!
"How is this possible, how can you see my movements?"
```
Guan Shanhai couldn't help but feel astonished, his preemptive strike had unexpectedly missed.
"Great Compassion and Mercy Seal!"
"Overwhelming Heaven!"
"Boundless Yuan Magnet Immortal Technique!"
Eclipsing the sun, a Buddha's hand larger even than the Imperial City broke through layers of clouds and came crashing down. Carrying the might of Overwhelming Heaven, Guan Shanhai struck at Meng Junzi's chest with his palm. Two contrasting spirals of force, one positive and one negative, clamped around Meng Junzi, intending to twist his physical body.
With one move, Guan Shanhai had unleashed three supreme Immortal Methods, each powerful enough to crush a Semi-Immortal. Even Ao Ling would fare only slightly better, with her Immortal's Body being shattered, barely clinging to life. Had an Immortal been hit without any defense, they would have been spitting blood incessantly!
The only two weaknesses of these three Immortal Methods were their slow casting speed and attack speed, but with the acceleration of his own time, the two weaknesses were no longer an issue.
"Heaven and Earth Dharma Aspect, Sky Mending Technique, Creation Infinite."
What Guan Shanhai didn't expect was that Meng Junzi also managed to employ three supreme Immortal Methods in an extremely short amount of time.
Meng Junzi transformed into a colossal Heaven and Earth Dharma Aspect, his feet planted firmly on the ground, piercing the descending Buddha's hand, restoring light to the rebuilt Imperial City.
He also used the ancient Sky Mending Technique to block the might of Overwhelming Heaven, and with a Creation spell, neutralized the positive and negative twisting forces, effortlessly resolving the three-pronged attack.
"How is this possible, shouldn't you have the Borrowing Dao Fruit?"
In the late period of the Great Yu, he paid great attention to the affairs of Meng Junzi and Jiang Pingan, constantly observing with his powerful Immortal sense, and knew early on about the outlines of their Dao Fruits.
What Meng Junzi held was the Borrowing Dao Fruit Embryo, with its most common use being to borrow enemies' magic artifacts, Spirit Stones, and such, rendering the enemies unarmed while he was fully equipped, leaving no room for them to fight back.
However, the use of the Borrowing Dao Fruit Embryo had nothing to do with time, otherwise, he wouldn't have been so confident in this battle!
"Fairy, what's going on, can the Borrowing Dao Fruit also borrow time?" Lu Yang asked, unable to comprehend such high-level combat.
Unlike Guan Shanhai, who hadn't yet reacted, Fairy Eternity, who was worldly and experienced, saw some clues: "Interesting, Meng Junzi just now didn't borrow time per se, he simply sped himself up."
"This reminds me of an enemy Time Immortal encountered on the road to ascension, who held the Speed Dao Fruit Embryo, touted as the supreme speed in the world. When speed reaches a certain threshold, it starts to interact with time, hence, only one of them could ascend to Immortality."
"Could it be that in your era, someone also has the Speed Dao Fruit Embryo, and Meng Junzi's Borrowing Dao Fruit can borrow other people's Dao Fruit Embryos?"
"Do you remember the 'Borrowing Technique' divine ability of the Meng Family? When cultivators above the Unification Realm came to borrow money from the Meng Family, they had to leave a debt note and also lend one of their techniques to the Meng Family. This divine ability, never seen before by this Immortal, must be uniquely created by the Meng Family, perhaps evolved from the Borrowing Dao Fruit."
"That powerful?" Lu Yang was taken aback.
"Wait, if even the Dao Fruit Outline can be borrowed, then wouldn't it be possible to borrow lifespan?" Lu Yang suddenly realized.
Emperor Xia's exhaustion of lifespan that managed to deceive the Immortal national teacher suggested that not only had the national teacher never seen it, but it was also a divine ability at the level of 'Immortals'.
The Borrowing Dao Fruit fully met these two criteria.
"That should be the case."

chapters.title: Chapter 875 - 874: The 2nd Unforgettable Dao Fruit
chapters.content:
Guan Shanhai and Meng Junzi were fighting fervently when, in a corner of the Imperial City, a battle between Semi-Immortals began with Ao Ling and her two companions challenging the second Imperial Teacher who had manifested from the imprints.
After the second Imperial Teacher left the battlefield, Ao Ling and her two companions went directly to confront him.
Jin Caiwei was stabbed in a sneak attack by the second Imperial Teacher and she was intent on avenging this humiliation.
Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi feared that Jin Caiwei might suffer an accident, so they joined the battle as well. The second Imperial Teacher, having eradicated his own causality, was exceptionally elusive and difficult to fight.
Fairy Eternity noticed the commotion over there, and although she could see exactly where the second Imperial Teacher was, she chose not to inform the three women.
It was a good opportunity for the three women to gain experience by fighting against an Embryonic Causality Dao Fruit, especially with Fairy Eternity watching over them to ensure nothing went wrong.
General Yu thought about it and decided to lend a hand to the second Imperial Teacher as well.
On one side was a battle of Immortals, and on the other, five Semi-Immortals clashed. Either fight was a once-in-a-lifetime, breathtaking conflict. Even in the Ancient Times, when Semi-Immortals were common, battles of such caliber were rare. The Cultivators of the Imperial City wished they had eight eyes to watch both battles simultaneously.
They knew they would never have the chance to witness fights of this scale again in their lifetimes.
However, both battles were rather difficult to observe. On the side of the Immortals, Guan Shanhai and Meng Junzi moved so swiftly that they were virtually invisible to the observers.
As for the five Semi-Immortals, the second Imperial Teacher kept appearing and disappearing mysteriously. Whenever he vanished, memories of his existence faded, creating immense difficulty for the onlooking Cultivators of the Imperial City.
General Yu somewhat regretted deciding to help the second Imperial Teacher. Whenever the latter vanished, Ao Ling and her companions directed all their attacks at him, and he could barely withstand them.
...
Initially, Guan Shanhai thought that the Embryonic Longevity Dao Fruit alone would be sufficient to end the battle, but now it seemed he had underestimated Meng Junzi.
The two Immortals fought at high speeds, unleashing Divine Abilities of massive scale that interlaced and lit up the sky above the Imperial City in shades of blue and red, as if paint vats had been overturned.
Suddenly, due to a moment of negligence from Guan Shanhai, his reaction a beat too slow, Meng Junzi executed a Black Tiger Dig Heart strike, hitting Guan Shanhai squarely in the chest and leaving a huge gash in his Golden Body.
Meng Junzi practiced another form of Body Refinement, which was no less potent than Guan Shanhai's Nine Revolutions Indestructible Golden Body.
Guan Shanhai's face flushed red as he spat out a large mouthful of Immortal Blood. The blood landed on the Array Method deployed over the Imperial City which trembled and seemed barely able to withstand the power of the Immortal Blood.
Seeing this, Meng Poci realized that a few more such strikes might cause the Array Method to develop leaks from the aftermath. He hurriedly sent for all Transcendance Tribulation Stage Cultivators of the Imperial City to fortify the Array Method.
But Guan Shanhai quickly recovered, his chest wound healing at an astonishing speed, making it seem as if he had never been injured in the first place.
Meng Junzi raised an eyebrow, "The 'Immortal' trait of the Embryonic Longevity Dao Fruit, no, merely with the Embryonic Longevity Dao Fruit you shouldn't be able to recover this quickly. Let me guess, among the four people you created, there's one I do not recognize—his Dao Fruit is related to recovery, right?"
Naturally, Guan Shanhai would not respond to his enemy's query.
Lu Yang knew that Meng Junzi was referring to the Daoist Lord of the Wooden Imprint, a Cultivator from the Middle Period of Great Yu and a close friend of the Master of All Laws. Historical records indicated that the Daoist Lord of the Wooden Imprint was a Pass Tribulation Cultivator, but according to the Master of All Laws, he was actually a Semi-Immortal.
The Daoist Lord of the Wooden Imprint died in his sleep, and Lu Yang guessed that he had learned some of the secrets of the Fire Dynasty and was silenced by Ashy Bean.
"Wait, if the Daoist Lord of the Wooden Imprint's Embryonic Dao Fruit is related to recovery, wouldn't that conflict with the Master of All Laws' Embryonic Longevity Dao Fruit? How did they become friends then?" Lu Yang didn't understand.
Fairy Eternity explained proudly, "What's so hard to understand? The Daoist Lord of the Wooden Imprint's Dao Fruit Embryo should be of the Eternity type, stabilizing one's state for eternity. Ultimately, the superior Dao Fruits all come from my Eternity Dao Fruit."
"You think cultivating an Eternity Dao Fruit or an Immortal Dao Fruit is easy? Even without me, he wouldn't have achieved immortality."
"That Longevity Dao Fruit Embryo is the same, its difficulty so great that neither Immortal nor Time Immortal could become Immortals,"
"Neither can become Immortals, so naturally, they became friends."
However, Guan Shanhai threw out countless magic artifacts, not hurling them at Meng Junzi, but scattering them across various locations in the Imperial City sky.
Meng Junzi struck out at Guan Shanhai with extreme speed, only to find Guan Shanhai had vanished into thin air, replaced by magic artifacts appearing from seemingly nowhere.
The magic artifact shattered upon contact with Meng Junzi, breaking into countless pieces.
Guan Shanhai appeared behind Meng Junzi without any warning, attacking with a heaven-overturning force. Meng Junzi, caught unaware, was struck by Guan Shanhai and likewise spat blood.
Meng Junzi whipped his head around to look for Guan Shanhai and found that behind him there were only the magic artifacts previously thrown out by Guan Shanhai; Guan Shanhai had somehow moved to a very distant position.
Meng Junzi wiped the Immortal Blood from the corner of his mouth, revealing a sudden smile of realization, "I get it, you swapped places with the magic artifact."
One of the functions of the Swap Dao Fruit Embryo is to exchange positions with any of one's possessions.
Even if Meng Junzi smashed the magic artifact, it would be useless, for even shattered it was still Guan Shanhai's possession and could be used to swap positions.
Meng Junzi continued his attack as if nothing had happened, while Guan Shanhai once again swapped places with a magic artifact, moving to a far-off position, but Meng Junzi miraculously crossed space and caught up with Guan Shanhai.
This time, without the need for Fairy Eternity's explanation, Lu Yang realized on his own that Meng Junzi was borrowing the Embryonic Spatial Dao Fruit of his own ancestor, the Vast Sea Daoist Lord.
"Right, Fairy, since Senior Meng Junzi is borrowing a Dao Fruit, doesn't that mean he's like you, without the trait of being forgotten by mortals?"
Immortals wielding Dao Fruit powers are forgotten by the people, as it is with the Yingtian Immortal and the Four Immortals, and so too with Jiang Pingan's Dao Fruit. Only Fairy Eternity doesn't possess this trait.
Lu Yang felt that Borrowing Dao Fruits probably also lacks the trait of being forgotten by mortals.
Otherwise, Meng Junzi could simply borrow things and never return them.
Fairy Eternity hadn't thought about this before, but upon hearing Lu Yang's words, she began to ponder seriously, "Now that you mention it, it does seem to be the case."
Lu Yang added, "If we assume that Emperor Xia's lifespan was borrowed by Senior Meng Junzi, as a Dao Fruit power, it should be forgotten by the people, but in reality it isn't, everyone knows there was an issue with Emperor Xia's lifespan."
Suddenly, a familiar voice came from behind Lu Yang, "Oh, I didn't expect my Junior Brother to think of that layer too, it seems the Fairy Senior has indeed shared with you many things that your cultivation level should not know."
Yun Zhi stood quietly under an old tree in a simple white dress, as if time had frozen around her; she seemed both as if she had just arrived and as if she had always been there.
