The sunlight filtered through the scarce leaves, casting mottled shadows below, her silhouette appeared exquisitely detached.
"Eldest Senior Sister!"
Lu Yang exclaimed excitedly.
The moment he learned of the hoax surrounding Emperor Xia's death, Lu Yang realized that Eldest Senior Sister had long since arrived at the Imperial City.
This was a battle of Immortals; they wouldn't have allowed him to oversee it.
Nonetheless, seeing Eldest Senior Sister here was a delight.

chapters.title: Chapter 876 - 875: Meng Junzi Alone is Enough
chapters.content:
"Miss Yun, don't talk nonsense. What do you mean I told Little Yang things he shouldn't know? It is clear that Little Yang is the quick-witted one, figuring out these matters on his own!" Fairy Eternity certainly couldn't admit that she often had nothing better to do than to share with Lu Yang knowledge only an Immortal should know.
She didn't tell him; he realized it all by himself.
Lu Yang: "..."
Fairy, do you think I was able to figure out the abilities of the Dao Fruit or the special characteristics of an Immortal on my own?
Yun Zhi walked out from under the ancient tree, her plain white dress dazzling in the sunlight.
"Junior Brother, it seems you've been doing well in Imperial City."
When Man Gu arrived in Imperial City, Yun Zhi also reached the city in secret. While waiting to spring the trap on Guan Shanhai, she took the opportunity to inquire about Lu Yang's actions in the Imperial City.
She didn't expect that in just three short months, Lu Yang had led such an eventful life – battling the Geniuses of Imperial City, composing poems during the Shangyuan Festival, reporting the Fourth Prince's rebellion, meeting Ao Ling's three ladies, persuading the Fifth Prince's men to surrender, allowing Emperor Xia to be Prime Minister, and sneaking into the Imperial Palace at night to steal the throne...
Ordinary Geniuses would find it hard to achieve even one of these feats, yet Junior Brother accomplished them all.
Yun Zhi glanced at Ao Ling's three ladies, who were fighting in a corner of the Imperial City, feeling rather surprised. She didn't expect Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi to be here, and she certainly didn't foresee the appearance of another Semi-Immortal from the Ancient Heavenly Court.
"Eldest Senior Sister, I've been wronged! All these things were done by the Fairy using my body!" Lu Yang quickly protested his innocence. For the sake of his future, he was ready to sacrifice the Emperor in exchange for glory and wealth – he could not afford to have a heart of mercy!
"Eldest Senior Sister, you know me. I've always been low-profile and wouldn't do such things."
"Fairy used the authority of the Acting Sect Master to control only me, demanding my body. As a mere mortal, I had no power to resist. I beg Eldest Senior Sister for understanding!"
Fairy Eternity stiffened her neck: "What's wrong with using the authority of the Acting Sect Master? That's what Miss Yun agreed to previously."
"Then, Fairy Senior, do you still wish to continue as the Acting Sect Master?"
Yun Zhi remembered that she had promised Fairy Eternity would be the Acting Sect Master for a year, and many months were still left.
"I've had enough fun; I don't want to anymore."
Fairy Eternity had been enjoying herself these past few days and currently had no intention of continuing as the Acting Sect Master.
Lu Yang quickly flattered her: "Since ancient times, those in power have clung to their authority. The fact that the Fairy is not swayed by power and is willing to step down at her peak, making way for others, is remarkable. It is a fortune for Seek Dao Sect and a blessing for the world!"
Hearing the heartfelt praise from a loyal subject, Fairy Eternity laughed heartily.
"So, was it truly Senior Meng Junzi who borrowed Emperor Xia's lifespan?"
"Yes, Emperor Xia's lifespan was never an issue from the beginning."
"Meng Junzi and Jiang Pingan noticed quite early on that Guan Shanhai coveted the Power of National Fate and sought to restore Great Yu. However, Guan Shanhai is cautious and does not act rashly."
"Having an Immortal always eyeing the Power of National Fate is not a good thing. It requires constant vigilance, which is both worrisome and exhausting. Therefore, they concocted this event together."
"The Power of National Fate resides within each Emperor Xia. When one emperor dies, the power will transfer to the next. Guan Shanhai, even if able to deal with Jiang Pingan, would not dare harm an Emperor Xia endowed with the Power of National Fate, for an emperor protected by it could hold out until Jiang Pingan returns."
"Therefore, they first borrowed the lifespan of Emperor Xia, feigning that his time was running out, while also ensuring the Crown Prince would refuse the succession. Thus, once Emperor Xia died, the Power of National Fate would be unbound, prompting Guan Shanhai to take action, just like today."
Lu Yang pondered, "So, are you saying that all of the Crown Prince's prior actions were feigned, and that he actually wants to succeed the throne?"
"No, that is the only thing that wasn't feigned."
"..."
"The original plan was for Emperor Xia to feign death in a few more years, but your and Junior Brother Meng's trip to Imperial City made me change this idea, leading me to suggest they move the plan forward."
Meeting Lu Yang's puzzled gaze, Yun Zhi patiently explained.
"I told them that considering Junior Brother's luck, having you in the Imperial City would make it more likely for Guan Shanhai to make a move."
Lu Yang felt that Eldest Senior Sister misunderstood him; causing the Fourth Prince and Fifth Prince to fall, convincing Guan Shanhai that Emperor Xia was truly ill, was clearly the work of Fairy.
"Then, Eldest Senior Sister, you could have given me a heads-up, so I could be mentally prepared," Lu Yang said.
Lu Yang looked at Eldest Senior Sister somberly. He had always kept his lips sealed; even knowing the true situation of Emperor Xia, he wouldn't spill it.
Yun Zhi sighed, "Junior Brother, you certainly wouldn't let slip any information. I'm just worried that knowing the truth would attract too many Immortals and make it difficult to end things smoothly."
"..."
"Then, Eldest Senior Sister, are you also going to take action here?" Lu Yang asked.
Yun Zhi looked up at the fierce battle in the sky between the two Immortals: "Given the current state of the battle, Meng Junzi alone should suffice."
...
Meng Junzi and Guan Shanhai not only possessed Dao Fruits but could also use several Dao Fruit Embryos simultaneously. The effect of employing a Dao Fruit Embryo in the hands of a Semi-Immortal versus an Immortal was incomparable.
The two moved in different patterns, each gaining the upper hand in turn. Guan Shanhai, with the Longevity Dao Fruit Embryo and Rejuvenation Dao Fruit Embryo, could quickly recover from his injuries.
Meng Junzi, on the other hand, appeared to have no means of healing his wounds. His body was riddled with scars, and there was a particularly deep wound on his chest, deep enough to reveal the bone.
Seeing Meng Junzi's injured state, Guan Shanhai sneered, "I thought you had some tricks up your sleeve, young man. It seems you're nothing special. If it weren't for my concern about you stealing my Immortal Artifact, I would have used it to kill you long ago!"
Guan Shanhai could use Dreamland Dao Fruit Embryos to create several Immortal Treasures in his sleep, and after materializing these treasures, he could use the Swap Dao Fruit Embryo to exchange them for the Immortal Artifacts he desired!
However, considering Meng Junzi's way of fighting, anyone who fought him during his Semi-Immortal days would have their magic artifacts borrowed by him, which was tantamount to aiding the enemy and was undesirable.
Meng Junzi, unconcerned about his own injuries, just smiled nonchalantly and activated his Borrowing Dao Fruit.
"Seeing as you, Guan, are in such fine health, something seems to be missing, and it's not quite as appealing. How about I lend you these wounds of mine?" Meng Junzi suggested.
Guan Shanhai's complexion changed. Before he could react, he felt as though his entire body was under attack; he had a particularly deep wound on his chest, deep enough to reveal the bone!
In contrast, Meng Junzi's injuries were gone.
Meng Junzi looked at the battered Guan Shanhai and revealed a satisfied smile.
"Now you, Guan, look much better," Meng Junzi commented.
"Guan, shall we continue fighting?" he asked.
"Meng Junzi!" Guan Shanhai roared, using two types of Dao Fruit Embryos to heal his wounds.
But these wounds were originally inflicted by him, striking exceedingly hard, and now having appeared on his own body, they were not something that could be healed in an instant!
Unless he had the Longevity Dao Fruit or the Rejuvenation Dao Fruit.
"Why yell so loud? Further aggravating your wounds is not good," Meng Junzi said with his casual, unconcerned smile, once again utilizing his Borrowing Dao Fruit.
"I borrow strength from the past and the future."
As his words fell, two figures crossed time, arriving from the past and the future, fighting alongside Meng Junzi.

chapters.title: Chapter 877 - 876: The Gap in Experience
chapters.content:
The two shadows from the past and future were extremely vague, indistinguishable as male or female.
The Imperial City Cultivators were tremendously shocked by the series of actions from Meng Junzi.
"You can even lend your injuries to someone else? Can that be borrowed, too?!"
"Doesn't that mean Meng Junzi will never get hurt, inherently unbeatable from the outset!"
Some were excitedly pointing at the two hazy figures: "Look at those two figures, his past and future selves have both come, past, present, future, three in one!"
"This is defying the heavens!"
Initially, the Imperial City Cultivators wanted to watch the battle of the immortals to gain an understanding of Dao and improve their cultivation level, to break through their realms.
Looking at the situation, they should just honestly join the crowd and watch the battle; thinking about gaining enlightenment is absurd.
Lu Yang was also shocked by this scene; Meng Junzi's Borrowing Dao Fruit is invincible.
"Little Yang, you're thinking too dramatically. Those two figures aren't the real Meng Junzi; they're just a part of the power lent out by the past and future Meng Junzi."
Fairy Eternity, who had clashed with the Time Immortal not once or twice, knew about borrowing power from the past and future; the Time Immortal was the true expert in this regard.
"The two figures combined might as well be another complete Meng Junzi."
"Moreover, because the past and future Meng Junzi lent out a part of their power, those two points in time will be in a weakened state."
"Is it similar to Tao Yaoye's Feather Transformation Immortal Body?"
Lu Yang still thought that was quite exaggerated.
"Pretty much, otherwise why do you think such a body is crowned with the words 'Immortal Body'? This is Immortal Techniques."
"As for him lending his injuries to Guan Shanhai, it's not as formidable as it seems. If I'm not mistaken, what's borrowed must be returned, and with interest. After it's returned, Meng Junzi's injuries will be more severe."
"Miss Yun, am I right in my guess?"
"Fairy senior's wisdom is sharp as ever."
"Doesn't that mean the longer the battle drags on, the more disadvantageous it is for Senior Meng Junzi?" Now that Fairy Eternity put it that way, Lu Yang unexpectedly started to worry about Meng Junzi.
Yun Zhi shook her head: "Meng Junzi will not get hurt."
"Why?"
"Guan Shanhai will heal the injuries. Once the injuries are healed, there will be no problem of returning them."
Lu Yang: "..."
Fairy Eternity's intuition was always accurate. Moreover, having fought frequently during the Ancient Times, her combat experience was exceptionally rich; even if it was her first time seeing, she could spot the flaws in Meng Junzi's tactic at a glance.
But Guan Shanhai was different. Although the Great Qian Last Period was chaotic with more than one Semi-Immortal fighting for dominion, how could the number of Semi-Immortals back then compare with the flourishing Ancient Times? Their accumulated combat experience was incomparable.
Unable to see through this tactic, Guan Shanhai could only honestly help Meng Junzi heal.
...
Above the Imperial City, Guan Shanhai saw Meng Junzi battling shoulder to shoulder with his past and present selves and couldn't help but twitch at the corner of his eye.
He had been careless; this Borrowing Dao Fruit was much stronger than the Dao Fruit Outline, not even in the same concept.
It's a pity he never found an immortal's corpse; otherwise, he could've used the Imprinting Dao Fruit to imprint Wu Yao from the founding period of Great Yu.
Wu Yao from that period, unlike later, not preoccupied with exploring other worlds, would choose to help himself.
Guan Shanhai was simultaneously healing his injuries and dealing with the pincer attack from three Meng Junzis. Divided in focus, he quickly fell into a disadvantageous position.
He inwardly cursed his bad luck. If this continued, forget about seizing the Power of National Fate; he might not even leave here alive.
Guan Shanhai made an instant decision, no longer tussling with Meng Junzi. It was time to run now!
"Great Heaven Creation Palm!"
Guan Shanhai unleashed an Immortal Method, striking at Meng Junzi, who countered with another Immortal Method.
A massive explosion occurred once again in the skies above Imperial City, louder than thunder, as shockwaves spread from the center of the battlefield. Guan Shanhai took advantage of the momentum to attempt an escape.
To his dismay, the closer he got to the edge of Imperial City, the heavier he felt, as if he were carrying an Immortal mountain on his back, becoming so heavy that he could no longer fly.
He threw his magic artifact outside of Imperial City, trying to swap places with it, but ended up failing just the same.
Meng Junzi, as if he had anticipated that Guan Shanhai would flee, followed with a smiling face and also arrived at the edge of Imperial City.
"Friend Guan, since you're already here, why not stay as a guest out of the host's hospitality?"
"What kind of trick is this!" Guan Shanhai exclaimed in astonishment, not knowing when he had fallen for the trap.
A cold smirk appeared on Meng Junzi's lips, "Did you think I waited for you to assimilate a part of the Power of National Fate before making my move, just to prevent you from running away in the middle of the fight!"
"Although you have assimilated a part of the Power of National Fate, it is still just a part."
"Before you've completely refined the Power of National Fate, it will always be a burden to you."
"The Power of National Fate is the collective strength of the citizens of Great Xia; to leave Imperial City, your power would have to exceed that of all the citizens of Great Xia!"
"Friend Guan, do you think you possess such strength?"
Guan Shanhai's complexion shifted dramatically, never having imagined that the Power of National Fate would become a shackle for him.
"Kill!"
With a deathly glare, Guan Shanhai no longer had the assured demeanor he did before. Since he couldn't escape, he resolved to perish together with his foe!
"Chaos Rainbow!"
A nine-colored Immortal rainbow burst forth from Guan Shanhai's palm, exuding the intention of chaotic destruction. It seemed small, but if it were to strike Imperial City, the entire place would turn into nothingness!
He refused to believe that Meng Junzi would ignore the fate of Imperial City!
Meng Poci's expression changed drastically. No matter how powerful the Imperial Guard Army's array was, it would definitely not be able to withstand Guan Shanhai's resentful strike!
Normally, a situation like this would require Yun Zhi to step in to block it, but now, Meng Junzi had a better idea.
"Cultivator Jin Caiwei, may I borrow the outline of your Dao Fruit?"
Jin Caiwei, who was in battle, heard Meng Junzi call out. Although she did not know what he planned to do, she still lent him the Plane Dao Fruit Outline.
Meng Junzi, temporarily in possession of the Plane Dao Fruit Outline, immediately turned the falling nine-colored Immortal rainbow into a plane.
The planar nine-colored Immortal rainbow no longer resembled a rainbow but more like a nine-colored Immortal Saber. It struck Imperial City without causing an explosion,
but sliced through the grand array, cutting through the earth like tofu and drilling into the bottomless depths below.
"How laughable, I want to see how many times you can block this!" Despite just one move being neutralized, as long as he knew that Imperial City was Meng Junzi's weak point, Guan Shanhai was not afraid to clash with Meng Junzi.
But he soon lost his ability to laugh. From the cut opened by the nine-colored Immortal rainbow, a surge of Immortal light burst forth, violently striking at Guan Shanhai's face!
The Immortal light arrived so quickly that Guan Shanhai couldn't react in time, his right hand severed by the beam!
Guan Shanhai instantly realized where this attack had originated from. The nine-colored Immortal light had penetrated deep into the ground, and at its deepest point lay the world-sealing Immortal Array constructed in Ancient Times, which counterattacked anyone who dared to assault it!
Seeing that destroying Imperial City had failed, Guan Shanhai engaged in a bloody battle with Meng Junzi once more. He was completely frenzied, blood-drunk, and no longer bothered with healing, disregarding his bodily wounds, determined to take Meng Junzi down with him before his imminent death.
"Disintegrate!"
Ultimately, Guan Shanhai shouted loudly and detonated himself. Imperial City was also within the blast range, and he could not use any techniques to defuse this attack. Grinding his teeth, he took the blast head-on, leaving himself severely wounded.
Eldest Senior Sister, who had been looking up at the fight, spotted the clues. Guan Shanhai appeared to fight ferociously, but in reality, he was disconnecting from the Power of National Fate while battling, and once disconnected, he blew himself up to break free.
With such a level of self-detonation, Guan Shanhai's condition could only be worse than Meng Junzi's.
"Junior Brother, I need to take a leave."
Preventing Guan Shanhai from fleeing was indeed her ultimate purpose for coming to Imperial City.

chapters.title: Chapter 878 - 877: The Battle of the Imperial City Concludes
chapters.content:
"Damn Meng Junzi, had I known it would come to this, I should have killed you from the start!"
Deep in the mountains thousands upon thousands of miles outside of Imperial City, Guan Shanhai wore an expression of venomous hatred. He had been utterly defeated in the battle for Imperial City, his subordinates left behind in the city and Yu State, and the Power of National Fate he had longed for was discarded by his own hands.
Throughout his life he had faced countless battles, but he hadn't anticipated being outsmarted by two juniors!
Thinking of this, Guan Shanhai could no longer suppress his rage. With a violent stomp, he crushed the mountains beneath his feet, sending dust flying into the air.
"Meng Junzi, Jiang Pingan, you two wait for me. I swear, if this vengeance isn't repaid, I am not fit to be human!"
Although he had lost his subordinates, possessing the Imprinting Dao Fruit meant that he was never short of subordinates. Figures like the Jade General and the second Imperial Teacher could all be imprinted and used by him, allowing him to make a comeback in the blink of an eye.
"Now, I need to find a place to heal."
The power of his self-detonation was too great, and because he had not treated his wounds immediately, fleeing to this place after burning his Immortal Blood had added injury to injury. Even running both the Longevity Dao Fruit Embryo and the Rejuvenation Dao Fruit Embryo at the same time couldn't speed up his recovery.
"Elder Guan, why not come to Seek Dao Sect to heal?"
A cool voice rang out from behind Guan Shanhai, startling him into a cold sweat.
"Who's there!"
Guan Shanhai was shocked. He had been unaware, not expecting someone to approach him unnoticed!
He whirled around to see a woman in a white dress standing behind him, calmly observing him with a detached expression.
"Yun Zhi of Seek Dao Sect!"
Guan Shanhai remembered that Yun Zhi had once defeated the leaders of four Immortal Sects at the Five Great Immortal Sects' conference, deducing that she must have reached either the peak of Passing Tribulation or the realm of a Semi-Immortal.
Regardless of which, neither posed a threat to his schemes in Imperial City, so he hadn't bothered with her.
"What, just a mere Semi-Immortal and you think you can defeat me, heavily injured, to gain fame and rise to prominence? The younger generations are indeed arrogant!"
Yun Zhi didn't respond; she simply took a step forward.
In Guan Shanhai's eyes, filled with fear and despair, the reflection of a delicate palm grew closer, unavoidable.
...
"Is it finally over?"
A cup of tea's time after Guan Shanhai fled, the cultivators of Imperial City hesitantly asked themselves, swallowing hard.
"Was the battle that took place over the East Sea of the same magnitude?"
"Truly, the battles of Immortals are terrifying."
"Yes, that move by the Great Yu National Preceptor... what was that move again?"
"How did Meng Junzi and the Great Yu National Preceptor fight exactly? Who can remember?"
Although Meng Junzi's Borrowing Dao Fruit didn't have the characteristic to make Immortals forget, the Imprinting Dao Fruit did, which resulted in the entire battle process being affected, with no one recalling the exact moves.
Even the recording from the Recording Orb turned into a blank slate that couldn't be restored.
In a corner of Imperial City, the battle involving five Semi-Immortals also drew to a close.
There was no need to mention the Jade General. Both Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi were familiar with the fighting style of the Yin-Yang Dao Fruit Outline, making it easy to find countermeasures. The most challenging to deal with was the Causality Dao Fruit Outline used by the second Imperial Teacher.
Fortunately, in the end, the three women came up with a solution. They no longer actively attacked the second Imperial Teacher. Jin Caiwei transformed the surrounding space into six flat planes, sealing off the area. Anyone who attempted to break through the planes would be subjected to attacks from the three women.
Then, using the planes as blades, they began to slice through the space, gradually reducing it to the point where there was nowhere for the second Imperial Teacher to hide, thus deciding the outcome.
This was the inspiration Jiang Lianyi got through having her husband, the Four Immortals, seal off the entire Cultivation World to look for the murderer who killed Fairy Eternity, and indeed, it was extremely effective.
Thus, this astonishing and unconventional battle finally came to a close.
"Elder Mu, are you really sure you want to establish an industry in the Imperial City? This place doesn't seem very safe," Chi Sect Leader stood still, stunned. The higher one's cultivation level, the clearer they understood the sheer terror of the battle that had just taken place; it represented a fight at the very pinnacle of the cultivation path.
Every move held the power to destroy heavens and earth, a single technique could annihilate the Imperial City.
Who could have imagined that what began as a routine inspection would turn into a battle for the throne and subsequently a battle between Semi-Immortals and Immortals?
"You should look on the bright side; with Meng Junzi and Jiang Pingan, two immortals in the Imperial City, is there any place safer than here?"
"Well, when you put it that way, it seems to make sense."
…
"Are you Daoist Yun Zhi's junior brother?"
Meng Junzi, one of the main figures in the Immortals' battle, appeared in front of Lu Yang, observing him with great interest.
"Senior Meng," Lu Yang didn't expect Meng Junzi to come looking for him right after the Immortals' battle, which made him feel flattered and a bit overwhelmed.
"Such a solid foundation in cultivation; even in my Nascent Soul period, I was hardly better than this. Indeed, a young talent."
"Senior Meng, your injuries..."
Lu Yang watched with concern as Meng Junzi's body bore wounds in every possible spot, his eyes twitching at the severity of the injuries.
Self-Detonation of an Immortal, the aftermath of which was far beyond imagination, surpassed any celestial technique used by Guan Shanhai. That Meng Junzi was still standing here after withstanding it head-on was already very impressive.
Meng Junzi laughed heartily, "Hahaha, it's just the Self-Detonation of an Immortal, what harm could it possibly do to me?"
Fairy Eternity, on hearing these words, became agitated and sprang up from her throne ready to roll up her sleeves and give Meng Junzi a practice lesson, "Looking down on the Self-Detonation of an Immortal? Let this Immortal show you one!"
"Fairy, there's no need for that, Senior Meng Junzi is just joking,"
Lu Yang, frightened, quickly stopped Fairy Eternity and escorted her back to her throne.
Unaware of the bullet he had dodged, Meng Junzi continued to speak defiantly.
"These are but minor injuries to me, they'll heal in a few days. If you don't believe me, have Guan Shanhai self-detonate once more to test it."
…Senior, please spare a few words.
After the battle, Ao Ling and the other two also sought out Lu Yang.
Seeing Meng Junzi there as well, they were startled but still descended to say, "Elder Brother Lu Yang, we have succeeded in our mission and have captured these two men."
In their hands, they held the Jade General and the second Imperial Teacher.
Then they greeted Meng Junzi with a fist salute: "We have met Senior Meng Junzi."
Meng Junzi waved his hand, "Although I am an Immortal, the three of you are figures from Ancient Times after all. Talking about seniority can get too confusing, perhaps we should address each other as 'Daoist Friends' instead?"
Meng Junzi had heard from Yun Zhi before that Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi were one of their own.
He just didn't know why there was no mention of Jin Caiwei—was there some concern?
"Daoist Jin, thank you for lending me the use of your Dao Fruit Outline earlier. To be able to construct such a delicate Dao Fruit Outline, Daoist Jin truly possesses unparalleled genius."
"One cannot lend a Dao Fruit Outline for nothing; that would be against my principle. Seeing that Daoist Jin is from the Qiongqi Clan, what if I waive all debts between the Meng Family and the Qiongqi Clan, would that be acceptable?"
Jin Caiwei's eyes lit up upon hearing this; she had initially thought the lending of her Dao Fruit Outline was for naught but was pleasantly surprised by this unexpected reward.
This trip to the Imperial City, joining the Ancient Heavenly Court, witnessing the Immortals' battle, capturing two Semi-Immortals, and finally resolving the debts that had troubled the Qiongqi Clan for many years—truly, the gains were immense.

chapters.title: Chapter 879 - 878: The Resurrection of Emperor Xia
chapters.content:
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, then we shall take our leave," said the three ladies, Ao Ling, Jiang Lianyi, and Jin Caiwei.
Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi came to the Imperial City just for fun. Now that everything was over, there was no need to stay any longer.
As for Jin Caiwei, she had also completed her objectives in the Imperial City and there was no need for her to stay either.
"What about the Second Imperial Teacher and General Yu..."
Jin Caiwei was holding the flattened figures of the Second Imperial Teacher and General Yu, unsure of how to deal with them.
"Since these are the spoils of war for the three Cultivator friends, naturally they are at your disposal," said Meng Junzi, with no intention of snatching these two Semi-Immortals. He was always reasonable.
Moreover, with Yun Zhi capturing Guan Shanhai, the greatest spoils of war were already in hand; the minor details were insignificant.
"However, it's best to perform a Soul Search on the Second Imperial Teacher immediately; otherwise if he gets the chance, he could use the Outline of Dao Fruit related to Causality to easily escape," Meng Junzi kindly reminded.
"Okay." Even if Meng Junzi hadn't mentioned it, that was exactly what Ao Ling intended to do.
"By the way, Elder Jin, since your Dao Fruit Outline is of the spatial type, won't there be... conflicts with the Vast Sea Ancestral Master?" Lu Yang asked cautiously. He was worried that during the future contention for Immortality, if a conflict arose, he wouldn't know whom to help and it would be a difficult choice.
Jin Caiwei looked down at the kneeling Lu Yang, patted his stiff, nervous shoulders, and reassured, "Don't worry, there won't be any conflicts."
She revealed a smile, displaying two small tiger teeth, "After all, I can't become an Immortal with this little ability of mine."
"..."
Little Tiger added, "And becoming an Immortal is not such an easy task. It is not certain that Vast Sea has the qualifications to become an Immortal, your concerns are superfluous."
"Alright, it's time for us to go. Hope to see you again if fate allows."
Watching the three ladies leave, Meng Junzi couldn't help but turn back to Lu Yang and exclaimed, "How did you manage to become so close with those three?"
At first, when Meng Jingzhou heard that Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi had joined the Heavenly Court, he thought Yun Zhi had persuaded them.
However, after interacting with the trio, it seemed that Lu Yang had played a significant role.
This was his first time seeing a Junior Cultivator get along so well with a Semi-Immortal, especially an Ancient Semi-Immortal.
Of course, it was because of Fairy Eternity, Lu Yangxin thought, but Fairy Eternity's existence was a secret that he couldn't reveal to anyone.
Seeing that Lu Yang remained silent, Meng Junzi did not pry further into personal matters.
"If you can't say it, then don't. Who doesn't have secrets?"
"Come on, let me take you into the Imperial Palace."
...
"Who exactly is Lu Yang, and why do you address him as Elder Brother Lu Yang?" Jin Caiwei couldn't figure it out and finally couldn't help but ask while on the road.
Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi shared a secretive smile, choosing not to tell Little Tiger the reason.
This was a small act of revenge.
...
"The old ancestor really did become an Immortal," the Meng Family thought to themselves as they collected the remains of the Second Prince and his entourage. They returned home to celebrate with drinking, revelry, and toasting; nobody expected the legendary Semi-Immortal ancestor to suddenly ascend to Immortality.
To prevent Guan Shanhai from becoming aware and leaking information about Meng Junzi's ascension, up until now, only Jiang Pingan and Yun Zhi knew of Meng Junzi's Immortality.
Yun Zhi only found out because she sought out the Imperial Palace after her breakthrough, looking to test her own level, and then Jiang Pingan felt it wasn't quite right to lose alone and thought Meng Junzi should be involved as well.
It was then that Yun Zhi realized Meng Junzi had also become an Immortal.
Old Ma and Housekeeper Xu, as Meng Potian's sworn brothers, also joined the celebration, drinking merrily.
Meng Potian, drunk as a skunk, sought out his second brother and third brother, and started pouring wine down Old Ma's throat while embracing his neck.
"Old Ma, I think Lu Yang is not bad, huh?" His mind's sharp, his talent extraordinary. Although his luck is somewhat lacking, our Meng Family has immortals in charge. You see, even though this time things got really out of hand, wasn't it suppressed by our ancestors?"
"I think his luck is a minor issue."
Old Ma glanced at his elder brother who had drunk too much, thinking to himself that having an immortal meant nothing; you didn't know that kid brought back an Ancient Immortal the first time he went out on a mission, and had even encountered two immortals in battle at the East Sea.
Even though Old Ma could no longer remember the details of the battle between immortals at the East Sea, instinct told him that the two immortals who fought there were far stronger than the two in the Imperial City.
I still say the same thing, if you think our ancestor can cover Lu Yang, let him take my place in pulling the cart.
In the past two years, Old Ma had been diligently cultivating, not in the hopes of reaching the Transcendence Tribulation Stage to serve as a guardian for Meng Jingzhou, but to get to the Transcendence Tribulation Stage to ensure his survival in future battles.
...
Lu Yang entered the Imperial Palace once again, this time openly and legitimately.
The Imperial Guards initially wanted to stop him, but upon seeing Meng Junzi, they stepped aside obediently.
Although Meng Junzi's visit to the palace did not comply with the rules, such matters were not within the jurisdiction of those in the Body Integration Realm.
Meng Junzi led Lu Yang to the sleeping quarters, where Emperor Xia lay emaciated without breath, his body on a bed made of perennial ice, originally intended to prolong lifespan. Now it also served as a cooler to preserve Emperor Xia's body, killing two birds with one stone.
"Your Majesty—"
"Your Majesty, why did you leave so early—"
Kneeling on the ground, the consorts wept profusely, gasping for breath. It was unclear how much of their crying was real and how much was fake.
Eunuch Li wept bitterly as well.
There were no princes here since the Immortal War had started immediately after Emperor Xia's death. Who would dare to come to the palace at that time, except for these consorts who were nearby in the harem?
"Alright, alright, everyone get out; this fellow is not dead yet," Meng Junzi said as he pushed the door open, and with his immortal power, he promptly drove the consorts away.
The consorts, midway through their crying, found themselves outside without knowing why, pondering Meng Junzi's recent words in utter confusion.
The emperor is still alive in this state?
Meng Junzi activated the Dao Fruit, and a string of obscure runes emerged from his body, flowing into Emperor Xia's. This was the lifespan he had previously borrowed.
When Meng Junzi returned the borrowed lifespan, he even added a few more years to Emperor Xia's lifespan as interest.
Under Lu Yang's watchful eye, as the lifespan was reinstated into his body, Emperor Xia's shriveled form inflated like being pumped with air, visibly rounding out, and the wrinkles on his face smoothed away by the lifeforce, reverting to a middle-aged appearance, his true original look.
Emperor Xia opened his eyes and saw Meng Junzi and Lu Yang, exhaling a long breath of foul air.
It seems the matter was over, and there was no need for further pretense.
After Emperor Xia's resurrection, the Power of National Fate in Meng Junzi's hand also entered his body, signifying his restoration as the ruler of the nation.
"The younger generation of the Jiang Family pays respects to Elder Meng Junzi."
"That's enough. You've just had your lifespan restored and need to convalesce, so don't move," replied Meng Junzi.
"Yes, may I ask, Elder, has the battle ended?"
Meng Junzi smirked confidently, "It's just the Great Yu National Preceptor, naturally no match for me."
"Where is the Great Yu National Preceptor now, then?"
Meng Junzi's smile stiffened.

chapters.title: Chapter 880 - 879: Wang Gu's Sacred Grace, Utter Disrespect
chapters.content:
Meng Junzi looked at Emperor Xia sideways and couldn't stand the sight of him, "You didn't say a word when you died, so how come you talk so much now that you're alive?".
Before Meng Junzi could retort, he heard a loud clang as the door was pushed open.
A young man with a hoe over his shoulder walked in, his bearing lofty and majestic. Tied to the other end of the hoe was a person, swaying unsteadily.
"Haha, I've settled matters in Yu State. How's it going on your side, Junzi?"
Meng Junzi glared at the young man with the hoe, "Are you and your grandfather in cahoots, taking turns to interrogate me?"
"Get lost, showing off just because you won against a Semi-Immortal."
The hoe-toting young man burst into laughter when he saw how bruised and battered Meng Junzi was from the Immortal's self-detonation, and hurried over to show concern.
"Oh dear, Junzi, what happened to you? I remember you boasting that beating the Great Yu National Preceptor was a piece of cake for you."
Meng Junzi dismissed it with a wave of his hand, "Eh, it only looks severe, but actually, they're just minor injuries, not painful at all. Old Jiang, you're too gullible."
The hoe-toting young man poked Meng Junzi's wound, "Not painful?"
An Immortal's self-detonation could harm even the soul itself, so the poke made Meng Junzi almost cry out in pain.
But in front of Jiang Pingan, he couldn't lose face, so he swallowed the word "painful" and said with a contorted face, "Not painful."
"Really not painful?"
The hoe-toting young man poked him harder, causing Meng Junzi to grimace in agony and kick out at Jiang Pingan.
"Jiang Pingan, enough is enough!"
Jiang Pingan got kicked over but came walking back like nothing happened.
"You're the one who said it doesn't hurt."
The two Immortals glared at each other furiously.
Lu Yang crouched down and looked up at the face, having never seen a portrait, he didn't know which era's Semi-Immortal this was from Great Yu.
The Semi-Immortal showed no signs of life, and Lu Yang guessed that Jiang Pingan must not have held back when he arrived in Yu State and directly conducted a Soul Search to gather information as quickly as possible.
It was only then that the hoe-toting young man noticed Lu Yang's presence, "So you're Jixiang, Daoist Yun Zhi's Junior Brother Lu Yang, right?"
"This junior has seen Senior Jiang Pingan."
The hoe-toting young man was of course Jiang Pingan.
Jiang Pingan looked Lu Yang up and down, thinking that truly Yun Zhi's personally trained junior brother has an incredibly solid foundation, flawless even by his discerning eyes.
"Really a handsome talent. Would you be interested in marrying into my Jiang Family?"
"Our Jiang Family has seven young princesses, all breathtaking beauties. Especially the youngest, she's really pretty and her age and cultivation level are close to yours. She always listens to your stories and likes you a lot!"
Jiang Pingan was speaking of Emperor Xia's seventh daughter, the youngest princess of the Jiang Family.
Meng Junzi stretched out his arm to hold back Jiang Pingan, "Hey, hey, hey, don't snatch him, we Meng Family have already arranged with him, he's to marry into our Meng Family in the future."
Jiang Pingan and Meng Junzi both lit up when they saw Lu Yang.
This was the Lu Yang whom Yun Zhi had appraised as having the potential of an Immortal, and her evaluation wasn't the kind of flattery bestowed upon geniuses by the outside world. This meant there was a very high possibility that Lu Yang could become an Immortal in the future.
Why not win him over right now?
Feeling great pressure from the esteem of the two Immortals, Lu Yang didn't know how to respond.
Gently pushing the door open, the Eldest Senior Sister returned, dragging along Guan Shanhai, whom she had parted with not long before.
"I've captured him and brought him back."
"What are you two doing, sandwiching my Junior Brother between you?"
"Hahaha, nothing, nothing, just noting that the kid has a sturdy physique."
Guan Shanhai's left face was purple-red, and his left eye bloodshot. From Lu Yang's experience, he guessed that Guan Shanhai must have been hit by an external force, with the bloodshot eye resulting from the impact.
Guan Shanhai's six senses were sealed by Yun Zhi, leaving him unaware of his surroundings.
In the small room, a group of distinguished figures, each with extraordinary origins, gathered: Yun Zhi, who had never lost a battle; Fairy Eternity, the leader of the Five Ancient Immortals; Meng Junzi, who almost became the founding emperor; Jiang Pingan, who established Great Xia; Guan Shanhai, who sustained Great Yu for a hundred thousand years; Emperor Xia, who was hailed as a once-in-a-millennium emperor; and Lu Yang.
"How should we deal with Guan Shanhai?" Jiang Pingan asked. "Should we directly perform a Soul Search, or keep him locked up and torture him slowly, making him divulge information?"
"Lock him up in our Sect's Captive Peak, it's a good time for those from Great Yu to reunite."
Jiang Pingan and Meng Junzi were not pleased. They had struggled for so long and although they could not get a piece of the flesh, they could not bear the thought of not getting a drop of broth as well.
Although they were somewhat afraid of Yun Zhi, they still plucked up the courage to say, "That's not quite right. Your Captive Peak doesn't have an Immortal. How can you hold him there? I'd say it's better to lock him up in our Imperial City. With the two of us watching him, we guarantee nothing will go awry!"
"With me here, our Captive Peak can hold him," Yun Zhi said faintly, her confidence evident.
Actually, no one really wanted to perform a Soul Search directly.
A Soul Search would destroy Guan Shanhai's immortal soul.
That was an immortal soul. No one had ever used an immortal soul and an Immortal's Body for Refining. What kind of might would an Immortal Artifact with a Spirit Device, forged from these two things, possess?
An unparalleled peak Immortal Artifact never seen before in ancient times!
Even the Yingtian Immortal did not have such treatment when forging Immortal Artifacts. At most, he would break off a branch from the Time Immortal's body to use as material. The handle of the Sky Opening Axe came about that way.
Yun Zhi did not intend to monopolize, after all, Jiang Pingan and Meng Junzi had exerted great effort in catching Guan Shanhai; she had simply done the finishing work. Logically and morally, the two of them deserved to benefit as well.
But they couldn't have Guan Shanhai all to themselves.
While the three were at an impasse, Lu Yang slowly raised his hand, indicating he had a suggestion.
"Well, I have an idea."
"Since there's only one Guan Shanhai and he's hard to divide, why not just split his soul?"
Three Souls and Seven Spirits, ten parts in total, enough for the three of them to share.
The thought struck them that this was indeed a good solution.
Given Guan Shanhai's personality, he was unlikely to easily divulge information. Dividing his Three Souls and Seven Spirits would weaken his willpower, potentially leading him to reveal information under threats, temptations, and severe torture.
"What a great idea."
Meng Junzi and Jiang Pingan's impression of Lu Yang grew more favorable by the minute. Not only was his talent among the best, but his integrity also seemed impeccable.
After some negotiation, Jiang Pingan and Meng Junzi ended up with the Seven Spirits and the Immortal's Body, while Yun Zhi took the Three Souls, Dao Fruit, and Lu Yang.
"By the way, that youngster Meng Jingzhou won't be returning for now," Meng Junzi called out. He had decided to properly mentor this promising descendant. Among all his descendants, only Meng Jingzhou's talent came close to his own, and if mentored well, there was a chance he could surpass him in the future.
Previously he could not expose his identity and Cultivation Level, and thus couldn't offer guidance. Now, he feared nothing.
Lu Yang felt Old Meng was truly lucky, having an ancestral Immortal for a mentor. He, on the other hand... seemed to have an Immortal mentor as well.
Strange, why hadn't he felt it?
Man Gu decided to stay temporarily in the Imperial City. This was his first visit, and he had encountered an Immortal battle in less than an hour. Now that the Immortal battle was over, it only made sense to stay in the Imperial City for a while.
On the way back, Lu Yang took out a wooden box.
"Eldest Senior Sister, now that the affairs in the Imperial City are settled, I'm returning the Immortal Peach to you."
Yun Zhi shook her head, "This was originally meant for you."
There was only one Immortal Peach, and Lu Yang didn't want to enjoy it alone. This was a rare treasure not seen in the world since ancient times, and if he ate it, Eldest Senior Sister would never have the chance again.
"How about this, we split the Immortal Peach in half, half for each person?"
Yun Zhi knew exactly what Lu Yang was considering and felt somewhat embarrassed at the thought.
"Fine, let's each have half."
If need be, she would find an excuse in the future to acquire more Immortal Peaches, allowing her Junior Brother to have his fill.
Lu Yang and Yun Zhi divided the Immortal Peach, while Fairy Eternity in the Spiritual Space looked on, craving a taste.
According to unofficial history, before the second and third Bean Emperors ascended the throne, they had fortuitously obtained an Immortal Peach that could prolong life. They savored it leisurely above the clouds, while the emperor longed for a taste but could not partake in a slice, a true oversight of imperial grace, utterly unforgivable and rebellious.

chapters.title: Chapter 881 - 880: I Really Can't Continue with Captive Peak
chapters.content:
```
The Immortal Peach is indeed a product of the Heavenly Root, large and full, brimming with juice. Lu Yang took a bite, and the peach juice exploded in her mouth, sweet but not cloying, as if she could feel every drop dancing on her taste buds, awakening all her flavors.
With each chew, the fragrance of the peach filled her lips and mouth, deliciously sweet to the point of intoxication.
This was absolutely the tastiest peach Lu Yang had ever eaten.
Besides prolonging lifespan, the Immortal Peach could also purge impurities and refine one's Spirit Root. However, Lu Yang's body had already been tempered a thousand times over, all impurities long washed away, and his Sword Spirit Root had no more room for improvement; he was simply enjoying the half peach.
In contrast to Lu Yang, Yun Zhi was even more elegant as she savored the other half of the Immortal Peach and carefully saved the seed, planning to plant it when she returned.
Under the wistful gaze of Fairy Eternity, Eldest Senior Sister and Little Junior Brother made their way back to the sect successfully.
In recent years, since Lu Yang joined the Seek Dao Sect, Captive Peak had become increasingly lively.
Reflecting on the past, reminiscing about history, building the Great Yu Historical Museum, without a doubt, Captive Peak was the best choice.
At Captive Peak, one could meet cultivators from every era of the Middle to Late Period of Great Yu, who would personally recount the tales of those distant times.
Today, one of the most important figures of Great Yu arrived at Captive Peak, completing the story of the Early Period.
...
In the dim light of an oil lamp within Captive Peak, the child Grandmaster Tang Shengyi floated in mid-air, surrounded by one spent Spirit Stone after another, along with numerous residues of medicines.
After the Master of All Laws' attack on the Seek Dao Sect, the child Grandmaster vaguely sensed a great crisis looming in the future. In order to face the crisis, he began to cultivate even more earnestly.
Cultivation begins with the mind, and before this, he kept watch over Captive Peak, constantly reflecting upon his Mind State. Through conversations with the prisoners of Captive Peak, sharing insights into Cultivation, and listening to their past stories and the purposes of their Cultivation, the child Grandmaster's Mind State was polished to even greater clarity and transparency.
And now, he began his formal Cultivation.
Once the mind was settled, the Cultivation progress could be greatly accelerated, something many high-ranking cultivators were unaware of.
The child Grandmaster, in his desire to grow stronger quickly, exchanged Contribution Points and his pension for a vast quantity of Spirit Stones, precious medicines, and Spirit Pills. All these had now become his strength.
"What a pity, although I have no obstacles in my cultivation, I still have no clue about the Dao Fruit Outline," he lamented.
It's not only at the peak of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage that one begins to condense the Dao Fruit Outline. As soon as one reaches the stage, it's possible to start condensing; even after that, one can continue to cultivate and progress within the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. The two do not interfere with each other.
However, very few people start to condense the Dao Fruit Outline as soon as they reach the Transcendance Tribulation Stage and become a Semi-Immortal.
The child Grandmaster had always longed to condense the Dao Fruit Outline, but sadly, he had made no progress on this matter.
"Hmm? Xiao Yun and Little Lu have arrived?" The child Grandmaster sensed two figures at the entrance of Captive Peak. He landed and interrupted his cultivation, going to greet them with a hearty smile.
"Grandmaster, it's been a while. Senior Sister and I have come to visit you," Lu Yang greeted the child Grandmaster politely, making the grandmaster laugh heartily, clearly a child beloved by his elders.
"Grandmaster," Eldest Senior Sister nodded as a form of salute.
"Enough with the visiting; I guess you two are here to bring me a prisoner," the child Grandmaster said. Though he appeared like a child, his maturity was entirely different, with a clear mind.
"Not at all, we just thought that you might be encountering some difficulties in your cultivation, so we specially captured a top cultivator from Imperial City who could provide long-term guidance on your cultivation," Lu Yang explained.
When the prisoners of Captive Peak heard that Lu Yang had brought back someone else, they all stretched their necks to see, eager to know which distinguished person had been captured this time.
Famous individuals in Captive Peak, more or less, all had some relationship with Lu Yang.
The child Grandmaster waved it off: "There's no need for any top cultivator to guide me. There are plenty of Pass Tribulation Cultivators here in Captive Peak, and even three Semi-Immortals, which are enough."
"So tell me, who have you captured this time?"
There wasn't a storm the child Grandmaster hadn't seen. Even during the chaotic time of the Nine Disciples of the Dao Seeking Sect, he remained unscathed, each one of those troublesome youngsters tamed under his management.
Remember the time when Daoist Buyu and the others made a huge fuss in Imperial City? The children of Chief of Staff, the grandsons of the Right Chancellor, princes and grandsons, they were all once fooled by them. In the end, several Chiefs of Staff co-signed a petition, with the Left and Right Chancellors banding together, even alarming Emperor Xia at the time.
But what of it? In the end, it was still Tang Shengyi who came forward and settled everything.
"Seems like a Semi-Immortal," Lu Yang hesitated a bit, tactfully speaking, afraid that the title of Great Yu National Preceptor might scare Grandmaster, which would be quite unfilial.
```
"Oh, a Semi-Immortal," the child Grandmaster seemed unbothered. With three Semi-Immortals already confined within Captive Peak, what difference would one more make?
Seeing that the child Grandmaster was fairly resilient, Yun Zhi felt reassured and then tore open a spatial rift, extracting the prisoner's three souls.
The prisoner's three souls and seven spirits were separated, leaving him listless and spiritless, head hanging low.
"Who is this?" the child Grandmaster let out a soft gasp of recognition. It felt as though he had seen this voice before, as if from a portrait in some historical book.
He walked over, craned his neck to take a closer look, and just then, the prisoner suddenly looked up, locking eyes with the child Grandmaster!
The child Grandmaster was so startled he jumped back several steps, panting heavily, his soul still unsettled.
It wasn't the prisoner's sudden movement that frightened him, but the prisoner's appearance that did!
His trembling hand pointed at the prisoner's soul, his voice shaking.
"The Great Yu National Preceptor, Guan Shanhai?!"
This was a genuine Immortal!
It was one thing for Captive Peak to imprison Semi-Immortals, after all, they were only a step above him with a mere outline of a Dao Fruit, but an Immortal was different. That was a supreme realm entirely beyond the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. How many Immortals had there been since ancient times?
He, a mere Pass Tribulation Cultivator, how could he supervise an Immortal?
"The National Preceptor?!"
The Master of All Laws's eyes nearly popped out of his head, if a soul could have eyes, that is.
He never imagined that the unparalleled National Preceptor would also fall into the hands of the Seek Dao Sect.
"Guan Shanhai, you too have seen this day!" The Nightmare Supreme, upon seeing his former adversary reduced to a fellow inmate, could not hide his Schadenfreude. He was nearly dancing with joy.
The Venerable Thunder and other Great Yu Transcendance Tribulation cultivators watched the scene in disbelief,
Wu Youdao looked as if his soul had been scattered; he had thought that even if he became a lowly prisoner, there would always be a day they could leave as long as the National Preceptor was outside.
Now with hope shattered, the entire Great Yu had fallen and was imprisoned within Captive Peak.
In an instant, the order of the whole Captive Peak collapsed, and chaos reigned as everyone was shocked by the identity of the new inmate.
"Grandmaster, do not be afraid. Guan Shanhai now only has his three souls left, his power severely weakened, and he has been sealed by me. He absolutely will not cause trouble or escape," reassured Yun Zhi.
The child Grandmaster shook his head like a rattle drum, adamantly refusing.
He had never seen such big waves before.
He hurriedly took out a space talisman from his bosom and tore it open.
This was a talisman the Vast Sea Daoist Lord had given him, saying if there was any trouble, to use it to contact him and he would come.
After tearing the talisman, a gateway in space opened, and a figure slowly emerged, looking around tentatively.
Seeing this, the child Grandmaster rushed over to seek help.
"Ancestor, this Captive Peak is no place for me. It was fine to oversee a few Transcendance Tribulation cultivators and several Semi-Immortals, but now with an Immortal here, this exceeds my capabilities," he pleaded.
"Wouldn't it be better if you, Ancestor, were to watch over Captive Peak yourself?"
Daoist Xiantian looked down at the child Grandmaster clinging to his leg, then lifted his head to survey the inmates of Captive Peak.
He then hesitated and pointed to himself incredulously.
"Me, watch over Captive Peak?"
Wasn't that a bit too much to ask, considering his mid-stage Foundation Establishment cultivation level?

chapters.title: Chapter 882 - 881 Zhu Tian: Why are there more and more Immortals?
chapters.content:
Vast Sea Daoist Lord was instructing Daoist Xiantian in his cultivation, helping him smoothly break through from the early stage of Foundation Establishment to the mid-stage when a spatial gateway opened right in front of Vast Sea Daoist Lord.
And naturally, Daoist Xiantian was right opposite Vast Sea Daoist Lord.
So the moment the gateway opened, it directly transported Daoist Xiantian over.
Vast Sea Daoist Lord, sensing Yun Zhi on the other side of the spatial gate, didn't feel any danger and thus didn't interrupt the teleportation.
Daoist Xiantian saw Guan Shanhai bound and was so frightened that he almost jumped up.
Before, they had captured the National Preceptor of Great Yu of their era and had killed the second National Preceptor. Now, was it finally the turn of the first National Preceptor?
If this had happened during the Great Yu Era, even wiping out ten clans would not be punishment enough.
Then, Vast Sea Daoist Lord was about to step out from the spatial gate, but upon hearing the words of the child Grandmaster clinging to Daoist Xiantian's leg, prepared to retract his foot.
How could the child Grandmaster let Vast Sea Daoist Lord's wish come true? He pounced like a tiger and held onto the leg that was about to be pulled back, forcibly dragging Vast Sea Daoist Lord out of the spatial gateway.
"Vast Sea Ancestral Master, you're finally here! Captive Peak cannot do without you—"
Seeing Guan Shanhai, Vast Sea Daoist Lord's eyelids twitched. Goodness, Semi-Immortal status wasn't enough for you two siblings' bluster; this time you've directly escalated to an Immortal, eh?
Clearly, Meng Junzi hadn't told Vast Sea Daoist Lord what he was going to do when borrowing the outline of Vast Sea Daoist Lord's Dao Fruit.
Vast Sea Daoist Lord forcefully peeled the child Grandmaster's hands off and spoke amicably, "Little Tang, I think you are the most suitable for Captive Peak. Although it's rather difficult, this also represents the trust and trial from the Sect to you."
"I noticed you when you first entered the Sect and felt that your Dao heart was firm. I believed that you would achieve greatness in the future, and indeed, it has turned out just as I expected. You've advanced to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage in just two thousand years and have become a renowned powerhouse of the era."
"The Ancestral Master believes that as long as you undergo the trials of Captive Peak, you will surely rise to the next level, becoming a strong Semi-Immortal just like the Ancestral Master!"
The child Grandmaster rolled his eyes, not buying the nonsense from Vast Sea Daoist Lord.
He had originally come to Captive Peak seeking a quiet life. Who could have guessed that being in charge here would be more tiresome than being a Sect Leader?
"Grand Ancestor, you've been stuck as a Semi-Immortal without progress, haven't you? Why don't you interact more with the National Preceptor of Great Yu. Perhaps you might gain insights into cultivation and may even become an Immortal."
The two shared a smile, both seeing a firm refusal in each other's eyes.
Guan Shanhai was also shocked by Captive Peak. He only knew that the Master of All Laws had been captured by the Seek Dao Sect but hadn't expected to find Wu Youdao, who had been missing for so long, here.
Also present was his former adversary, the Nightmare Supreme, and the last Semi-Immortal of Great Yu, the Void Venerate.
Some of his previous confusions were now resolved, only the whereabouts of the long-lost second National Preceptor remained unknown.
"Ancestral Master, Grandmaster, you two take your time to talk; I'll go in and interrogate him first."
Yun Zhi dragged Guan Shanhai into the innermost room of Captive Peak.
Daoist Xiantian, meanwhile, was pestering Lu Yang, eager to know the details of how the National Preceptor of Great Yu was captured.
"Actually, the capture of the National Preceptor of Great Yu had nothing to do with me at all... "
...
"What, a Great Yu Semi-Immortal appeared in Yu State, and the old ancestor Jiang Pingan personally came out of seclusion to resolve it?!"
"Three of the Four Imperial Protectors of Heavenly Court appeared in Imperial City, and all of them are wives of the Qilin Immortal?"
"Imperial City saw the outbreak of a battle between two Immortals, with Great Yu's National Preceptor Guan Shanhai and Meng Family's elder ancestor Meng Junzi fighting fiercely in the sky!"
"Meng Junzi became an Immortal long ago?!"
"So it's Meng Family Immortal Clan!"
"Defeated by Meng Junzi, the National Preceptor of Great Yu self-detonated high above Imperial City, life and death uncertain?"
"Emperor Xia revived from death, living a second life!"
```
One heavy piece of news after another spread throughout the Cultivation World, each one shocking enough to stun cultivators, let alone the cascade of updates. Upon hearing these pieces of news, people are momentarily dazed, feeling as if they were transported to an ancient Great Era where celestial battles were incessant.
Great Xia Cultivators had thought theirs was an era without immortals, but the two Immortals from the East Sea battle clearly didn't belong to their age.
Who could have imagined that Great Xia itself harbored Immortals, and not just one, but two!
So what if the Demon Nation had ancient Semi-Immortals? They had Immortals on their side!
"Speaking of which, I didn't realize the Qilin Immortal had three wives. I thought he only had two," someone said with eyes brimming with envy for the Qilin Immortal's luck in love affairs, as Ao Ling and her two sisters were all peerless beauties.
Some were unsurprised, as if it was a given: "You just don't get it. That's an Immortal, a supreme being. What's having two or three wives to them? For all we know, the Qilin Immortal might be like the Yingtian Immortal, fond of beautiful women, and have married several wives."
"If you ask me, who knows which ancient beauty the Qilin Immortal might have had a fling with in secret."
"Great Yu really can't compare to our Great Xia. The Great Yu National Preceptor couldn't even defeat an underling of Old Ancestor Jiang."
"It's just a question whether the Great Yu National Preceptor is dead or alive. Attacking the Imperial City and then self-detonating was letting him off easy!"
"How did His Majesty manage to live a second life?"
"Supposedly, he stole something from the Heavenly Court called the Heavenly Root."
"Are there really such wondrous objects?"
...
In the Demon Territory, Zhu Tian, with a frown and troubled look on his face, received the news from the Imperial City.
"Wait, wasn't it agreed that a Semi-Immortal would be invincible in the mortal realm? How come Immortals are popping up one after another?"
Thinking this, Zhu Tian put more strength into his hands, planing the surface of the wood even more vigorously.
He would engage in some creative work when he was exceedingly bored.
He gently blew a breath, scattering the wood shavings to reveal the item in his hand: a palm-sized round platform with a notch in it.
Zhu Tian then picked up a wooden carving beside him, the statue depicting him dancing gracefully.
He placed the wooden statue into the notch on the round platform, and soothing music began to emanate from it as the statue twirled on its own.
...
When the Gold Clan Leader heard that the young ancestor had emerged and caused a stir in the Imperial City, she took leave from Daoist Buyu and hurried back to the Qiongqi Clan.
"What, our Qiongqi Clan doesn't have to pay off the debt anymore?" The Gold Clan Leader was extremely excited upon hearing the news, feeling as if they were transforming from a poor kid to a wealthy second generation.
The young ancestor was truly amazing; just a trip to the Imperial City had resolved the Qiongqi Clan's thorniest problem.
Jin Caiwei couldn't stop smiling as the Gold Clan Leader and the Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivators of the Qiongqi Clan praised her to high heaven.
She stood on high, boldly proclaiming, "Debts and such are trivial matters. Our Qiongqi Clan's goals have changed. We're not competing for eleventh or twelfth place anymore. We are now with the Heavenly Court, undoubtedly the strongest force in the strife of the Great Era. We are number one!"
The Gold Clan Leader, inspired by the young ancestor's words, was boiling with enthusiasm and quickly offered a strategy.
"Young ancestor, I've just learned a money-making method from Daoist Buyu, which our Qiongqi Clan could use to rise to power."
"Oh? What method?"
"Stocking up on rare goods! It involves storing very important items so that when the outside world wants to buy them, the price skyrockets. That's when we sell them off and naturally make a profit!"
After pondering for a moment, Jin Caiwei thought it was a good idea and wondered why they hadn't thought of it before, realizing that Gold Clan Leader really had learned something valuable from Daoist Buyu.
"So what are we planning to stock up on?"
"Candles."
```

chapters.title: Chapter 883 - 882: Full Force Explosion
chapters.content:
Jin Caiwei felt that by joining the Heavenly Court and becoming the Nan Ji Guang Cai Great Emperor as well as having her debts relieved, good things came one after another, marking an era of good fortune and prosperity without any taboos.
With a wave of her petite hand, she accepted the proposal of the Gold Clan Leader. "Good, then let's buy candles. It's about time our Qiongqi Clan made some money!"
...
At this moment, Lu Yang was unaware that the Qiongqi Clan and the Yaoyang Sect had, without prior agreement, both set their sights on the candle market.
He had been in seclusion in his abode for seven days, conserving his strength and adjusting his condition, fusing his essence, qi, and spirit into one and elevating them to their peak, while holding an elixir in his mouth that restored spiritual power.
He slowly opened his murderous eyes, and what came into view was a beautiful maiden of prime youth, who blinked her watery big eyes and tilted her head as she looked at him.
"Fairy, please step aside." In the spiritual space, Lu Yang helplessly pushed Fairy Eternity aside.
"Oh." Fairy Eternity obediently moved to one side, revealing the enemy of this battle—the Invincible Nascent Soul.
Lu Yang endured many trials during the Nascent Soul Stage, all for the purpose of defeating his own Nascent Soul!
Just as Fairy Eternity said, one cannot take shortcuts in cultivation, only step by step can one become the strongest.
Throughout the entire Nascent Soul Stage, aside from various events Lu Yang encountered such as the Supreme Nightmare, the Void Venerate, finding the Ancestral Master, provoking the Master of All Laws to attack his sect, his journey to the East Sea, his trip to the Imperial City… Lu Yang spent all his remaining time refining his techniques!
After conserving his essence and strength for seven days, he was in peak condition, and he could easily slay a Divine Transformation Stage Cultivator that appeared before his eyes with a casual sword strike!
"Come, battle!" Lu Yang shouted loudly, gathering his spiritual power to form the Green Peak Sword, the Dark Moon Sword, and the Seven Star Sword Set.
At the same time, nine gleaming swords were floating around the Invincible Nascent Soul, what Lu Yang could do, it could do as well.
"Go Little Yang, show it some colors!" Fairy Eternity clenched her powder fists, vigorously cheering for Lu Yang from the sidelines, while the Invincible Nascent Soul found itself without any support, making Lu Yang emerge as the victor in morale.
"The sword unleashes the dragon!" Holding the Green Peak Sword, Lu Yang filled the entire spiritual space with the sound of a dragon's roar emanating from the blade, and a black dragon formed of sword qi burst forth, baring teeth and waving claws, sweeping everything away.
This was Lu Yang observing and adopting the True Dragon Sword Qi that Ao Ling had condensed.
The True Dragon Sword Qi was also enshrouded with Three Flavored True Fire and Golden Bird True Flame, transforming into the black dragon's mane and whiskers.
Condensing sword qi into a detailed shape of a True Dragon was something that few cultivators in the Spirit Transformation Stage of the Sword Tower could accomplish.
The Invincible Nascent Soul let out a 'hehe-haha,' and from the Green Peak Sword, it too released a black dragon.
The two streams of True Dragon Sword Qi clashed together, and if a Divine Transformation Stage Cultivator were standing in the middle, they would be shredded to pieces by the fierce sword qi.
This was a true sword technique meant for killing enemies, which Lu Yang seldom used, but now, facing the Invincible Nascent Soul, there was no need for such restraint.
In the Imperial City, he had fought against the Invincible Nascent Soul countless times. He knew that if he did not employ his killer moves, once the Invincible Nascent Soul did, it would be him who would end up losing.
Immediately after that, a Golden Phoenix and a Skeleton Winged White Tiger flew out one after another.
Sword Qi turns into Dragon, Sword Qi turns into Phoenix, Sword Qi turns into Tiger—the three of the Four Imperial Protectors of the Heavenly Court Sect were now displayed in the form of sword qi, representing the pinnacle of Lu Yang's comprehension of swordsmanship during the Nascent Soul Stage.
"One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand, the Extinguishing Immortal Sword Array!"
The nine swords hung at the top of the spiritual space, turning into thousands of treasure swords, bursting forth with dazzling brilliance.
The Invincible Nascent Soul drove its nine swords into the ground, and the ground seemed to come alive, with countless swords bursting through the soil, matching the number of swords hovering overhead!
Swords fell from the sky like a torrential downpour, and from the ground they sprouted like bamboo shoots after a rain, their Sword Qi clamoring continuously.
Both Lu Yang and Invincible Nascent Soul were affected by the Extinguishing Immortal Sword Array, kneeling down facing each other, unable to move.
But even so, they could still attack!
"Village in the Palm!"
Lu Yang quickly formed a hand seal, and a palm the size of a village emerged from the ground, gripping Lu Yang in its grasp and smashing ferociously towards Invincible Nascent Soul.
The sword rain from the sky and ground fell on the clenched giant hand, only to be deflected away.
When Lu Yang was at the Golden Core Stage, he could already use this technique, limited only by his cultivation level, which didn't allow for a sufficiently large hand; now, having reached the late Nascent Soul Stage, this technique had accordingly grown from the size of a village to that of a township, with its power no less terrifying than Sword Qi Turns into Four Imperial Protectors!
Facing the descending colossal fist, a sixteen-foot-tall golden Buddha image suddenly appeared, blocking the path of the fist.
This was the strongest defensive skill mastered by Invincible Nascent Soul, but it still seemed somewhat lacking in front of the Village in the Palm.
The golden Buddha image shattered, leaving Invincible Nascent Soul naked beneath the descending fist.
Just now, Lu Yang had taken the initiative, reacting even quicker than Invincible Nascent Soul by employing the Village in the Palm, while Invincible Nascent Soul had only managed to delay time with the Sixteen-Foot Golden Body.
As the Sixteen-Foot Golden Body shattered, it too formed a seal and deployed the Village in the Palm!
The Village in the Palm used by Invincible Nascent Soul, having charged up for longer, was even mightier than Lu Yang's, and in a clash between the two, it was certain that Lu Yang would be the loser.
But at that moment, the technique of the Village in the Palm deployed by Lu Yang changed, the force became incredibly rhythmic, imbued with immense righteousness, no longer just brutally smashing with the fist.
Invincible Nascent Soul, trapped within the situation, couldn't see the whole picture, but Fairy Eternity, standing on the outside, understood the principle of this technique and clapped in delight.
"Little Yang has such a great idea, combining Village in the Palm with Arhat Fist, the power increased several folds compared to before!"
Moreover, Invincible Nascent Soul hesitated for a moment, as if unsure how to react.
Logically, after executing so many techniques in a row, Lu Yang's remaining Spiritual Power shouldn't have been sufficient to support two techniques at once.
Even if Lu Yang's body contained an Elixir that allowed him to slowly recover Spiritual Power, it wouldn't work, because in such a situation, the speed of recovery for both Lu Yang and Invincible Nascent Soul would be the same.
The two palms collided, and after a brief struggle, the Village in the Palm unleashed by Invincible Nascent Soul was overwhelmed and shattered by Lu Yang, disappearing.
Lu Yang's Village in the Palm had become transparent due to successively breaking Invincible Nascent Soul's Sixteen-Foot Golden Body and Village in the Palm, and only then could Invincible Nascent Soul clearly see what Lu Yang held in his giant hand and what he was doing.
Lu Yang's actions were no different from usual, but with one glance, Invincible Nascent Soul saw through Lu Yang's behavior.
Lu Yang was employing Lu Yang's Imitation Fist, which allowed him to regain Spiritual Power from his body more quickly!
Indeed, Invincible Nascent Soul's techniques were exquisitely executed, each move perfect, the transitions between techniques smooth, without any flaws.
But when it came to the stacking and imagination of techniques, Invincible Nascent Soul still fell short of Lu Yang!
Invincible Nascent Soul couldn't possibly think of such a fighting method!
With Invincible Nascent Soul's technique broken and Lu Yang in possession of a greater amount of Spiritual Power, the juxtaposition of their situations turned to Invincible Nascent Soul's disadvantage.
The hand opened, and Lu Yang leapt out from the Village in the Palm, throwing a punch that hit Invincible Nascent Soul's face with such force, it sent Invincible Nascent Soul flying backwards!

chapters.title: Chapter 884 - 883: Defeat the Invincible Nascent Soul
chapters.content:
```
"Damn, fighting oneself is really exhausting. Luckily, the Invincible Nascent Soul is not too bright." After a series of explosive moves, Lu Yang almost couldn't hold on.
To be precise, the Invincible Nascent Soul doesn't have a brain; it represents the theoretically strongest state of Lu Yang.
However, this theory is limited to techniques. Although it's highly adaptable, it still isn't as versatile as Lu Yang.
It was a method that Lu Yang thought up in the middle of the battle. No matter how adaptable the Invincible Nascent Soul could be, it wasn't as flexible and changeable as Lu Yang himself. The most obvious evidence was that the Invincible Nascent Soul froze for a moment upon witnessing this scene, unable to react in time.
Additionally, the theoretical strongest state was not the same as practical reality. The Invincible Nascent Soul could wield only the power it possessed, but Lu Yang was different; he could also draw upon his true form's strength!
Less adaptable than himself, less able to leverage strength than himself—those were the two major weaknesses of the Invincible Nascent Soul.
If Lu Yang still couldn't beat the Invincible Nascent Soul with this strategy, he wanted to simply resort to using Fairy Eternity's Imitation Fist and beat the Invincible Nascent Soul until it was utterly defeated.
After all, Fairy Eternity wouldn't lend her strength to the Invincible Nascent Soul, who couldn't use the Fairy Imitation Fist.
One weak move led to a series of setbacks. Having been struck by that punch, the Invincible Nascent Soul lost its initiative once again. It wanted to use Lu Yang's Imitation Fist to quickly recover its spiritual power, but Lu Yang didn't give it the chance.
Swordsmanship and magic skills used in unison, Lu Yang forced the Invincible Nascent Soul into continual retreat, its aura weakening by the second.
Boom—
Lu Yang struck the Invincible Nascent Soul again, sending it flying and breaking one of the great hall's pillars.
Lu Yang pressed his attack, but unexpectedly, the Invincible Nascent Soul, as if seeing its own defeat, took a step forward and vanished into thin air!
Lu Yang's pupils contracted, and in an instant, he realized what magic skill the Invincible Nascent Soul had used.
"Heaven and Earth in an Inch?!"
This was the first Spatial Divine Ability Lu Yang had learned, which could randomly teleport him to a cliff.
However, due to its strong randomness, Lu Yang, having other means to handle danger, would not use this ability if he could avoid it. After learning it, he had left it untouched.
To think that he hadn't used it himself yet, but the Invincible Nascent Soul had already employed this magic skill to flee.
The Invincible Nascent Soul didn't use it when it was previously subdued by Fairy Eternity because she was too powerful, and it didn't have the chance to execute the skill.
But Lu Yang wasn't very far off from the Invincible Nascent Soul in power, and during the fight, it was easy to give the Invincible Nascent Soul a chance to escape.
"Don't think you can get away like that! Heaven and Earth in an Inch!"
Although the location of the cliff was random, the Invincible Nascent Soul was ultimately a part of Lu Yang. Wherever the Invincible Nascent Soul would randomly go, so would Lu Yang.
Lu Yang's true form took a step forward and also disappeared from the Spiritual Space.
Now that the fight had left the body, there was no need to use his soul to battle anymore.
...
"Hm? Where is this?" After stepping forward, Lu Yang found himself surrounded by darkness, and looking up, he saw only a sliver of sky.
He was standing on a rock platform jutting out from a cliffside, with a cave entrance near the platform.
Intuition told Lu Yang that the Invincible Nascent Soul was hiding deep within the cave.
Using Three Flavored True Fire to light up the cave, he found the interior was covered with spider webs, and countless bats hung upside down from the ceiling which, startled by the True Fire, suddenly flew out en masse like a dark cloud.
In the depths of the cave stood a stone stele.
Lu Yang examined the stele closely. The inscription implied that its creator was a Cultivation Great Power who had retreated here to attempt a breakthrough to a higher level, but had failed and died. Before his death, he left a challenge, stating that anyone who could pass it would become his inheritor and receive all of his legacy.
Lu Yang read out the last line word by word: "My inheritor, if you receive my legacy, it means you possess wisdom, courage, and a sense of Tao. I trust that in the future, you will surely fulfill your master's lifelong wish and become a Nascent Soul Stage Cultivator..."
The stone stele's creator was only at the Golden Core Stage, and whatever arrangements he had made couldn't escape Lu Yang's Spiritual Sense. With a sweep of his Spiritual Sense, Lu Yang perceived the hidden inheritance beneath the stele: a cultivation technique, a Storage Ring whose contents were unknown, and a bag of Spirit Stones.
```
```
"It's actually an incomplete Cultivation Technique," Lu Yang was surprised and quickly read through the entire technique with his Spiritual Sense.
This truly was an incredible opportunity—if the Cultivation Technique could be completed, one could cultivate to the Divinity Transformation Stage!
Moreover, even if the Cultivation Technique were completed, it would only be the upper half of the technique. If the upper and lower parts of the technique could be combined, it would be enough to support cultivation to the Body Integration Realm!
Lu Yang quickly set aside thoughts of the Cultivation Technique inheritance. When he expanded his Spiritual Sense, he easily found the Invincible Nascent Soul hiding behind the stele.
The Invincible Nascent Soul also realized it had been discovered by Lu Yang and, transforming into a bolt of lightning, fled out of the cave.
"Don't run!"
Lu Yang followed closely behind, and the pair—man and infant—hugged the cliff as they dashed straight towards the narrow path between the peaks.
Just as Lu Yang was about to catch up with the Invincible Nascent Soul, he heard a scream—'Ahh!'—from above the cliff, as a herb collector with a basket on his back accidentally fell off the cliff.
Lu Yang gave up the chase of the Invincible Nascent Soul to catch the falling herb collector.
"That was close, lucky you ran into me. If you had fallen down like that, not even the tree branches growing out of the cliffside might have caught you."
