After saying goodbye to the bewildered herb collector, Lu Yang continued the pursuit of the Invincible Nascent Soul.
The Invincible Nascent Soul kept using 'Heaven and Earth in an Inch' to escape, and Lu Yang pursued with the same move. They fought in different crevices of the cliffs, occasionally encountering pools of blood in the valley bottoms that could awaken one's Bloodline, ownerless magic artifacts that could grow, and old men with only their Soul bodies remaining…
And each time Lu Yang was about to catch up with the Invincible Nascent Soul, he'd encounter a falling dragon person, a junior cultivator tumbling off the cliff, or a despised Princely Heir…
Lu Yang could only save them before continuing his pursuit of the Invincible Nascent Soul.
Fortunately, it wasn't a continuous series of cliff falls, and after five cliffs, he finally caught up with the Invincible Nascent Soul.
"Still trying to run!"
Without the support of elixirs, the Invincible Nascent Soul was already exhausted, while Lu Yang, constantly consuming elixirs, was vibrant and full of energy.
A huge palm descended as if the sky was collapsing, but Lu Yang was not frightened by this move. He decisively swung his sword, and his Sword Qi turned into a dragon, soaring into the sky, breaking through the seemingly strong but actually weak palm, pinning the Invincible Nascent Soul against the cliff face!
"You've lost."
With an indifferent expression, Lu Yang hovered in front of the Invincible Nascent Soul, pointing the tip of his Green Peak Sword at the little creature, the shining blade extremely intimidating.
The Invincible Nascent Soul hung its head in defeat and obediently flew into Lu Yang's Spiritual Space.
"Strange, why do I feel like I still can't control the Invincible Nascent Soul?"
Although he had won against the Invincible Nascent Soul and it had become obedient, Lu Yang still felt that something was off—as if the Invincible Nascent Soul was not fully obeying him.
Fairy Eternity pondered for a moment; this was something she had not encountered before. It shouldn't be the case.
"Oh—I understand now. It was I who defeated the Invincible Nascent Soul first, and you defeated it afterwards. If you want to fully control the Invincible Nascent Soul, you'll need to defeat me!"
Lu Yang: "..."
Are you doing this on purpose, Fairy?
Fairy Eternity, with a grin, moved closer to the iron-faced Lu Yang, awkwardly trying to appease him with a smile.
"Ah, Little Yang, don't be angry. How about this—you hit me once?"
Lu Yang looked at Fairy Eternity with suspicion and gently pushed her.
Fairy Eternity staggered back two steps, then dramatically collapsed onto the bed, covering her face and elongating her voice:
"Ah—I've lost."
That day, Lu Yang defeated the Invincible Nascent Soul and Fairy Eternity, achieving an unprecedented feat in history.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 885 - 884 Practice Practice
chapters.content:
After defeating the Invincible Nascent Soul and Fairy Eternity, Lu Yang felt an incredibly close connection with the Invincible Nascent Soul, far more than he could have imagined before.
"Finally got it done."
Lu Yang crouched at the bottom of a valley beneath an unknown cliff, eager to feel the changes brought by this victory.
"Come out."
When Lu Yang tried to control the Invincible Nascent Soul, it obediently flew out from the Spiritual Space without attacking him anymore.
"Go, move that stone over here."
The Invincible Nascent Soul flew over and easily lifted the giant stone weighing a thousand jins, moving it in front of Lu Yang.
"Now put it back."
The Invincible Nascent Soul obediently placed the giant stone back to its original position.
Lu Yang couldn't help but be moved to tears; other cultivators could control their nascent souls like this as soon as they reached the Nascent Soul Stage, but it took him until he was nearly at the Divinity Transformation Stage to control his nascent soul. It wasn't easy.
Defeating the Invincible Nascent Soul was a challenge, but the benefits after the battle were equally impressive.
The Invincible Nascent Soul was essentially another version of himself, doubling all his attacks.
The only problem was that his moves were too powerful, and the valley floor space was too small for him to fully unleash them.
"I should go back to the Sect and find someone to practice with."
Lu Yang left the valley bottom and looked for the nearest city, only to find that after continuous spatial leaps, he had already jumped into the neighboring state.
Eager to test the power of the Invincible Nascent Soul, he sped back to the Seek Dao Sect on the Sword Washing Pool and found Li Haoran on the Hundred Refinement Peak.
Old Meng and Man Gu were in the Imperial City, and he couldn't beat Tao Yaoye if she used her Feather Transformation Immortal Body. So, among his peers capable of being his match, only Li Haoran was left.
"Junior Brother Li, are you free? Let's spar, um, you are Junior Brother Li, right?" Lu Yang asked, not completely sure as he looked at the person in front of him clad in iron armor.
"It's me." A muffled voice came from inside the armor.
At this moment, Li Haoran was clad in fine iron armor, wrapping himself tight, leaving no part exposed, not even his eyes.
Li Haoran took off his helmet and repeated, "It's me."
"What's this, Junior Brother Li?"
Li Haoran chuckled and patted his armor: "Just forged this magic artifact, which I've named Combat Battle Armor. Once worn, it provides both offensive and defensive capabilities, and even a Divine Transformation Stage Cultivator would find it hard to penetrate its defenses."
During the battle with Master of All Laws, the Seek Dao Sect had used a peerless magic artifact, the armor of Ancestor Guiyuan, which could elevate someone from the Body Integration Realm to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. Inspired by this, Li Haoran spent more than a year to forge his own armor.
Although it wasn't as powerful as Ancestor Guiyuan's armor, capable of battling across different levels, it significantly enhanced Li Haoran's combat capabilities.
"That's perfect. I've had some gains in my recent cultivation. How about we practice together?" Lu Yang said with a smile; the timing couldn't be better.
Li Haoran was also confident in his Combat Battle Armor, considering himself no weaker than Lu Yang.
"Sure."
"This place is too cramped for a fight; let's go somewhere else."
They left the core area of the Seek Dao Sect and crossed the peripheral grasslands, landing amidst a range of steep mountains.
This area was also under the Seek Dao Sect's domain, with disciples often coming here to test moves of tremendous power.
During the flight, Lu Yang noticed that Li Haoran's flying speed had increased significantly after donning the Combat Battle Armor.
"Shall we begin?"
"Let's do this!"
Both had made progress in their cultivation and were eager to ascertain their current combat capabilities, which had to be validated through battle.
Lu Yang didn't dare underestimate Li Haoran. This was a Semi-Immortal who had attained the outline of the Reincarnation Dao Fruit, and for him, now at the Double Infant Stage, challenging someone above his level was excruciatingly difficult.
He took out the Green Peak Sword and eight other sharp swords, tossing them into the air, forming a Sword Array.
"Extinguishing Immortal Sword Array!"
Li Haoran felt an invisible force emanating from the Sword Array, forcing him to kneel. This invisible power was too overwhelming and domineering to resist.
"I've long heard that Elder Brother Lu Yang has a Sword Array that can force someone to kneel. Experiencing it firsthand today confirms its extraordinary nature. However, just this move isn't enough to take down your Junior Brother!"
Just as Li Haoran was about to kneel, his body suddenly disassembled into six parts: the head, torso, and limbs.
The Extinguishing Immortal Sword Array was an extremely powerful controlling skill that could force someone to kneel and even Meng Jingzhou couldn't withstand it.
But not being able to withstand it didn't mean there were no countermeasures.
Li Haoran's separated legs were parallel to the ground, indicating he was still in a kneeling position, but this didn't interfere with his ability to fight.
"True Fire Tornado!"
True Fire formed a tornado, with the wind aiding the fire, multiplying the power of the True Fire many times over. The entire mountainside turned into a sea of flames; wherever it passed, trees instantly turned to charcoal, and the ground became scorched and black.
Although Lu Yang could also control True Fire, he was not as adept as Li Haoran, a Fire Spirit Root cultivator.
Lu Yang, facing Li Haoran, dared not be careless, and Li Haoran was just the same, resorting to one of his trump cards from the get-go.
Although Li Haoran was considered an undefeated Nascent Soul genius in the outside world, he knew that the one who truly swept through the Nascent Soul Stage wasn't himself, but Elder Brother Lu Yang.
In the outside world, both the roles of Acting Sect Master and Young Sect Master were universally acknowledged as the number one genius.
But Li Haoran knew, these two identities were actually one and the same person; Elder Brother Lu Yang had only revealed half of his power in the outside world to become the number one genius. So, how terrifying must his true strength be!
"Sword Qi Turns into Tiger!"
The Sword Qi turned into a Qiongqi with bony wings, roaring forth, and it actually dispersed the True Fire Tornado directly.
"Heavenly Fire Descends!"
In an instant, the sky and earth changed colors, the sky turned to a crimson hue, and fire rain fell. The air was scorchingly dry, and a single breath felt as if it could burn one's throat.
Previously, Li Haoran was unable to perform this move, but now, with the Combat Battle Armor augmenting his power, and with Array Methods embedded within the armor to reduce magical pressure and casting speed, he could.
"One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand!"
The Green Peak Sword was thrust into the scorched earth, and countless Green Peak Swords sprang up like bamboo shoots after a rain, launching in unison, vowing to pierce the heavens!
This time it was both Lu Yang and the Invincible Nascent Soul performing simultaneously, doubling the number, a dense swarm of Green Peak Swords flew into the sky, forming a barrier. Not a single drop of heavenly fire could reach the ground.
The Invincible Nascent Soul could perform magic skills right from within the Dantian.
If a Divine Transformation Stage Cultivator were watching from the sidelines, they would be trembling with fear. Moving mountains, altering the heavens — this was not a battle of the Nascent Soul Stage; even cultivators of the Divine Transformation Stage would struggle to reach this level of power.
Suddenly, a shadow appeared behind Lu Yang, launching a brazen attack. It was another Combat Battle Armor!
The material used in the Combat Battle Armor was unknown, as it managed to evade the detection of Spiritual Sense.
With the descent of a great Buddha, Lu Yang exhibited his Sixteen-Foot Golden Body, dodging the sneak attack of the Combat Battle Armor.
He looked towards the parts of Li Haoran's body flying in the air, then at the Combat Battle Armor that had attacked him, and revealed a knowing smile.
"Junior Brother Li, the Combat Battle Armor contains your corpse, doesn't it?"
Li Haoran was capable of regenerating lost limbs and could use severed parts to piece together a new corpse to manipulate through the Corpse-Driving Spell for battle.
"Worthy of Elder Brother Lu Yang, to react so quickly," came Li Haoran's voice from the attacking Combat Battle Armor — it was indeed Li Haoran's corpse speaking.
Li Haoran felt that probably only Elder Brother Lu Yang could have realized this so quickly; any other person might not have even thought of this until the battle was over.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, you're too strong, don't blame me for fighting one against two."
Lu Yang revealed a deep smile, "How could I blame Junior Brother?"
The Invincible Nascent Soul flew out from the Dantian and unleashed a set of Arhat Fist on Li Haoran's corpse, denting the Combat Battle Armor.
"A Nascent Soul?"
Li Haoran always felt that Elder Brother Lu Yang's Nascent Soul was different from others, seemingly possessing extra Spirituality. It didn't appear to be controlled by Elder Brother Lu Yang; instead, the Nascent Soul seemed to be attacking on its own initiative.
"Huo Ying, appear!"
Li Haoran also brought out his Nascent Soul, which burned with flames and was known as Huo Ying.
Currently, Li Haoran needed to control both Huo Ying and his corpse to fight against the Invincible Nascent Soul, while the real him had to fight Lu Yang.
This required such a high demand on Spiritual Power that he couldn't precisely control both Huo Ying and his corpse.
However, the Invincible Nascent Soul seemed to need no control at all; each of its strikes landed precisely on vital points, even severing his connection with the corpse several times.
It was just like fighting another Elder Brother Lu Yang!
What on earth was going on with Elder Brother Lu Yang's Nascent Soul?!
"Junior Brother Li, try to handle this move, but be careful!"
Lu Yang shouted loudly as he and the Invincible Nascent Soul simultaneously performed a move that shattered the sky. A giant hand descended from above, mountains collapsed, and another giant hand burst forth from the ground!
"Huo Ying, come back!"
Startled, Li Haoran hastily recalled Huo Ying, unified with it, and transformed into a Fire Person.
In his Fire Person form, he used to be able to evade all attacks; it had been unbeatable, and even Meng Jingzhou couldn't land a hit on him.
But facing the conjoined force of both palms, there was no way for him to dodge.
This type of large-scale attack couldn't be escaped, not even by running out of its range.
Boom—
Both palms clapped together, flattening Li Haoran in his Fire Person form.
The skill they had performed was a Spatial Divine Ability, not simply two enormous palms joining. It was the collision of two miniature spaces, generating a force far beyond what a Nascent Soul Stage could withstand.
Lu Yang happily withdrew his hands.
Cooperating in battle with the Invincible Nascent Soul, the effect was surprisingly good.

chapters.title: Chapter 886 - 885: Losing Face
chapters.content:
"Senior Brother, your last few moves were really powerful," said Li Haoran as he slowly inflated back from his Fire Person form to his original shape.
He knew that at the last moment, Elder Brother Lu Yang had pulled his punches; otherwise, he would have been either dead or seriously injured.
Li Haoran remembered that during their trip to the East Sea, the gap between him and Elder Brother Lu Yang wasn't that big. But now, after a real fight with actual swords and spears, the gap had become vast.
During the battle, he had used several moves which he felt could at least put Elder Brother Lu Yang in a tough fight, if not defeat him.
But, the reality was quite the opposite, those moves were violently countered by Elder Brother Lu Yang.
Lu Yang slowly exhaled, as if reminiscing about his journey and said with a sigh, "My Nascent Soul has finally become obedient."
It was worth being bullied by the Invincible Nascent Soul all this way; now he was finally reaping the benefits. Any technique of his could now be doubled in power—it was too satisfying.
Li Haoran: "..."
So, Senior Brother, your Nascent Soul was out of control all this time?
"Junior Brother Li, you did quite well too. If it were any other cultivator at the Nascent Soul Stage, they wouldn't have been able to take even two of your moves." Lu Yang's comment was not flattery, but the truth.
Li Haoran smiled wryly and shook his head, "I'm still far behind you, Senior Brother."
After the battle, the two of them used the Tree Planting Spell, moved mountains and rocks, diverted rivers, and restored the destroyed forest to its original state before leaving the scene of the 'incident.'
Lu Yang returned to Sky Gate Mountain, where he saw Eldest Senior Sister sitting in the Emperor's Chair with a sheet of paper spread out on the table.
Curious, Lu Yang approached and saw that it was a Celestial Map filled with stars, and Eldest Senior Sister was occasionally circling a star.
"Eldest Senior Sister, are you studying the Celestial Map?"
"No, I am marking my Golden Core."
Yun Zhi looked up, took a lengthy glance at Lu Yang, a small smile briefly playing at the corners of her mouth before fading away, "So, you finally conquered your Nascent Soul?"
Lu Yang nodded, feeling a huge relief.
"Not bad, faster than Fairy Eternity."
"Eh?"
Lu Yang was completely baffled by Eldest Senior Sister's words.
"Does that mean Fairy Eternity hadn't conquered her Invincible Nascent Soul at my stage?"
"Fairy Eternity, would you care to explain?"
Fairy Eternity pouted, emerging from Lu Yang's body irritably and glaring at Yun Zhi.
"Miss Yun, you shouldn't spill the secrets!"
Yun Zhi pretended not to see Fairy Eternity's angry expression and spoke slowly, "The Invincible Nascent Soul represents the most powerful version of oneself: exquisite techniques, precise force, even the connections between moves are flawless."
"Even you, Fairy Eternity, would have had a hard time defeating the Invincible Nascent Soul, right?"
The moment Yun Zhi saw the Invincible Nascent Soul, she knew it represented a state of perfection that no one could easily defeat upon just entering the Nascent Soul Stage.
Fairy Eternity was no exception.
"So, Fairy, you've also been beaten by the Invincible Nascent Soul?" Lu Yang asked, delighted in her misfortune.
Fairy Eternity had always been patronizing, saying that he couldn't even defeat a mere Invincible Nascent Soul and that his cultivation was not yet sufficient.
But it turned out, it wasn't just him who had been beaten by the Invincible Nascent Soul—so had the founder.
"With Fairy Eternity's guidance, Junior Brother, you must have grown faster."
"Fairy Eternity, when you were at our stage, without any guidance, it took you longer to overcome the Invincible Nascent Soul, right?"
"For example, did you conquer the Invincible Nascent Soul only when you were about to break through to the Divinity Transformation Stage?"
Catching her secretly held secret, Fairy Eternity stomped her feet in frustration.
"Miss Yun, you did that on purpose, didn't you!"
That was also why Fairy Eternity always felt sheepish when bringing up the Invincible Nascent Soul; to conquer it, she spent her whole Nascent Soul Stage getting beaten.
It contradicted the grand image she wanted to maintain in front of Little Yang.
Fairy Eternity had been suppressing her realm from breaking through in order to defeat the Invincible Nascent Soul. After she defeated the Invincible Nascent Soul, she could no longer hold back her realm and broke through to the Divinity Transformation Stage in one fell swoop.
Therefore, she didn't know what could be achieved after defeating the Invincible Nascent Soul; everything was theoretical.
Yun Zhi spoke earnestly, "I'm not trying to point out your flaws, Fairy Eternity. It's just that you are the founder of the Invincible Nascent Soul. Letting Junior Brother understand your experiences will help him better understand the concept of the Invincible Nascent Soul. All of this is for Junior Brother."
"For Little Yang's benefit?" Fairy Eternity thought there was some merit to Miss Yun's words and, after a moment of conflict, decided not to pursue the matter of her past being exposed.
"Since you, Junior Brother, have defeated the Invincible Nascent Soul, you should meditate in peace and prepare for your breakthrough into the Divinity Transformation Stage," Yun Zhi pointed out the next step for Lu Yang, urging him not to wander around aimlessly.
"By the way, Eldest Senior Sister, since you've left Captive Peak, does that mean Guan Shanhai has been dealt with?"
Yun Zhi shook her head. "After all, he's an Immortal with a steadfast Dao heart. Even with only three souls left, he won't submit so easily. I've just come out for a break, and I'll have to go back soon to continue the battle."
...
Lu Yang was only short of accumulating enough spiritual essence to reach the pinnacle of the Nascent Soul Stage, a step that required time to grind.
A year and a half had passed, during which Lu Yang had been sitting in meditation on Sky Gate Mountain, occasionally borrowing some books from the Scripture Pavilion on breakthrough experiences written by his predecessors, unconcerned about the changing winds of the outside world.
However, there wasn't much to concern himself with. In the year and a half, there were no disturbances in the outside world, not even a battle at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
Finally, Lu Yang felt the abundant spiritual essence flowing within his body – a sign that he had reached the pinnacle of the Nascent Soul Stage.
If it were some Nascent Soul Stage old fossil, reaching this step would still require effort to break through the bottleneck.
But Lu Yang was different; he was only a thought away from the Spirit Transformation Stage.
The transition from the Nascent Soul Stage to the Spirit Transformation Stage was a significant hurdle that Cultivators needed to face. In the past, cultivation breakthroughs just required surpassing the bottleneck period, and the next realm would come naturally, not too dangerous.
Yet, breaking through to the Spirit Transformation Stage was different; it was when a Cultivator first directly faced Heavenly Tribulation. From that point on, every major breakthrough in realm would require facing the Heavenly Tribulation, which was extremely dangerous.
And Lu Yang was in even greater danger. He didn't know if the Yingtian Immortal was still alive, if he was paying attention to this place, and if the Heavenly Tribulation would be able to sense the ancient secrets he possessed.
"Don't be afraid, Little Yang. Any Heavenly Tribulation should show respect to this Immortal, and nothing will go wrong!" Fairy Eternity declared with full confidence, giving a thumbs-up and flashing a radiant smile.
If a person unaware of the situation saw Fairy Eternity's gesture, they would surely be greatly inspired to make a breakthrough.
Unfortunately, Lu Yang was in the know.
"There's no turning back at this stage. I must break through."
Lu Yang sighed, released the constraints upon himself, and engaged with the spiritual operations of heaven and earth, preparing to pass the Heavenly Tribulation.
Crack—
Dark clouds covered the summit of Sky Gate Mountain, and lightning flickered.
"Hey, look there, someone at Sky Gate Mountain is about to undergo Tribulation."
"That Thunder Tribulation doesn't seem very powerful. If it's the Thunder Tribulation for the Spirit Transformation Stage, it must be Junior Brother Lu Yang, right?"
"Elder Brother Lu Yang is about to break through the Nascent Soul Stage? What a swift pace of cultivation."
The disciples of the Dao Seeking Sect were curious to hear that Lu Yang was about to pass Tribulation. They gathered at the foot of Sky Gate Mountain to watch the process, and more and more people arrived.
"What kind of Thunder Tribulation is this?" a Junior Sister who wasn't familiar with tribulations inquired, concerned for Brother Lu Yang's safety.
"White Thunder Tribulation—it should be the Xuanyu Divine Thunder, ranking ninth among the Thunder Tribulations faced in the Spirit Transformation Stage," a Brother in the Void Refinement Stage explained.
"Ranked ninth in Thunder Tribulation, that's impressive."
Feeling the pressure above his head, Lu Yang secretly breathed a sigh of relief. It was only the ninth-ranked Xuanyu Divine Thunder; he should be able to cross over.
"Strange, isn't the direction of this Thunder Tribulation a little off?" The Brother at the Void Refinement Stage frowned, sensing something amiss.
Suddenly, a white bolt of lightning shot down from the sky, not aimed at Lu Yang, but at the disciples gathered at the foot of the mountain.
"Run! The target of the Xuanyu Divine Thunder is us!"
Someone shouted out loud, and without another thought, the crowd turned tail and ran for their lives.
They continued running to other mountains until the Xuanyu Divine Thunder ceased its attacks.
Witnessing this scene, Lu Yang's eyes twitched. Why did the Xuanyu Divine Thunder seem to be clearing the area?
According to reason, at the foot of Sky Gate Mountain, they were already beyond the range of an attack from a Thunder Tribulation faced when breaking out of the Nascent Soul Stage.
Moreover, the ninth-ranked Xuanyu Divine Thunder was just for clearing the area. With that thought, Lu Yang swallowed hard. What kind of Heavenly Tribulation would he be facing then?

chapters.title: Chapter 887 - 886: Invincible Divine Thunder
chapters.content:
"Fairy, do you know what's happening?" Lu Yang asked the Ancient Immortal, clearly anxious.
Fairy Eternity shook her head like a rattle-drum, "I don't know. I didn't go through the Heavenly Tribulation when I reached the Spirit Transformation stage."
Lu Yang remembered that during the Ancient Times, one didn't need to traverse the Heavenly Tribulation when breaking through from the Nascent Soul Stage to the Spirit Transformation Stage. It was only after the Yingtian Immortal ascended that such a requirement was added.
Damn Yingtian Immortal, can't you do something good?
According to the Yingtian Immortal's theory, subjecting Cultivators to the Heavenly Tribulation was a test of their steadfastness in the Dao. If one could withstand the tribulation, they would gain immense benefits.
Lu Yang looked up at the oppressive sky, where lightning flashed intermittently, hidden yet ready to strike, as though gathering strength.
Lu Yang felt whether he could survive the Heavenly Tribulation wasn't much related to the steadfastness of his Dao heart.
Mainly, it was a matter of whether his luck was strong enough.
...
"Strange, what kind of Heavenly Tribulation has Junior Brother Lu Yang brought upon himself?" a Void Refinement Stage Senior Brother pondered with a frown. He'd never heard of a Thunder Tribulation that started with Xuanyu Divine Thunder clearing the field.
They stood on other peaks far from Sky Gate Mountain, with the Xuanyu Divine Thunder appearing and disappearing around it, making it impossible for them to see clearly what was happening at the center of the tribulation.
"Even Eldest Senior Sister had never faced anything like this during her number one-ranked Three Pure Heavens Thunder Tribulation."
"An unprecedented Heavenly Tribulation, could it be that Junior Brother Lu Yang has drawn upon one that has never occurred before?"
"A brand new Heavenly Tribulation?"
"It's not necessarily new, it could also be a tribulation someone has faced before but didn't survive, failing to leave a record in history!"
Whichever the case, it was enough to indicate that the Heavenly Tribulation facing Lu Yang would be exceptionally terrifying!
"Look quickly, the real Thunder Tribulation has appeared!" Junior Brothers and Sisters shouted as they pointed towards Sky Gate Mountain.
"It really is an unseen Thunder Tribulation!" the Void Refinement Stage Senior Brother confirmed decisively. Even from so far away, they could feel the slight tingling of electricity in the air and the trembling of space, hardly able to imagine what Lu Yang at the center was experiencing.
"Is it an illusion, or does this feel even stronger than the Three Pure Heavens Thunder Tribulation?"
Eldest Senior Sister sensed the anomaly at Sky Gate Mountain, left Captive Peak, and stood at the summit of Elixir Cauldron Peak, gazing towards Sky Gate Mountain with a slight furrow of her brow.
...
Crack—
Azure-purple thunder descended, resplendent as the falling sun, too glaring to look at directly.
This was a Divine Thunder that had never appeared in history!
The moment the Divine Thunder appeared, Lu Yang's hair stood on end as he sensed extreme danger; this was definitely not something he could withstand alone!
"Invincible Nascent Soul!"
The Invincible Nascent Soul appeared with a serious Little Face, showing no intention of fleeing, and faced the Divine Thunder alongside Lu Yang!
Ordinary Cultivators would never dare to use their Nascent Soul to share the pressure of the Thunder Tribulation. Nascent Souls are fragile, and the slightest mishap could annihilate them within the tribulation. How then to transform the Nascent Soul into the primordial spirit?
But the Invincible Nascent Soul was different. Lu Yang had long experienced its might; sustaining half of the Thunder Tribulation's pressure wouldn't harm it.
Moreover, the fact that the Invincible Nascent Soul did not flee showed that it could withstand it!
Lu Yang had tested it; after defeating the Invincible Nascent Soul, it would still think to flee when in danger, but he could control the Invincible Nascent Soul not to run.
The azure-purple Divine Thunder split into two, striking Lu Yang and the Invincible Nascent Soul respectively. Lu Yang gritted his teeth, countering with the raw power of his physical body, suffering excruciating pain, his clothes shredding, and flesh tearing open. He felt as if his bones and blood were tingling, soaked in the electricity.
Boom— Boom— Boom—
The azure-purple Divine Thunder struck incessantly, enveloping the whole Sky Gate Mountain, shaking it slightly.
This was the might of heaven, not something any mountain could stand against.
"Strange, this Heavenly Tribulation looks like the Invincible Divine Thunder," Fairy Eternity muttered softly in the Spiritual Space.
Even if the muttering was very quiet, Lu Yang could still hear it clearly.
"What's called Invincible Divine Thunder?"
Taking advantage of the break between the thunders, Lu Yang quickly took an elixir to allow both himself and the Invincible Nascent Soul to recover rapidly.
"It's said that when Ying Tian Immortal created the Thunder Tribulation, he wanted to make a type that only cultivators with an Invincible Nascent Soul could overcome, and no one else would be able to. He asked Immortal for some advice."
"Fairy, what did you say at that time?"
"Immortal said the more powerful, the better."
Lu Yang: "..."
Fairy, could you leave me a way out?
No wonder this Thunder Tribulation has never appeared before; turns out it's specifically to strike those with Invincible Nascent Souls!
Ying Tian Immortal, if you have a problem with the Invincible Nascent Soul, take it up with Fairy Eternity. Why bully me - what kind of skill is that?
"So, what's the name of this Thunder Tribulation?"
"Ying Tian Immortal calls it 'Supreme Gold Pavilion Divine Thunder of the Opened Heavens.' At the time, Immortal said the name was too long to remember, and suggested calling it Invincible Divine Thunder instead, which was simple, pleasant to hear, and easy to pronounce."
After nine waves of Divine Thunder, Lu Yang was charred, spewing black smoke, and the Invincible Nascent Soul was also in bad shape, seriously wounded. Seeing this, Lu Yang hurriedly had the Invincible Nascent Soul enter the Dantian to rest.
The residual power of the Invincible Divine Thunder flowed over the surface of Lu Yang, slowly strengthening both soul and body.
...
"Nine times the Divine Thunder has descended; it should be over now, right?" Gu Junye said earnestly, among his peers he was the one most knowledgeable about Heavenly Tribulations.
Nine is the extreme number; the Thunder Tribulation would come only nine times, there'd be no tenth.
"It should be so... Wait, there's more Thunder Tribulation?" Just as a Senior Brother at the Refining the Void Stage was about to agree, he saw new Thunder Tribulations brewing above Sky Gate Mountain!
"How is that possible!"
"That's Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation!"
"Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation? Isn't that the kind of Thunder Tribulation you'd only encounter ascending from the Divinity Transformation Stage to the Void Refinement Stage, and it's ranked first among them!"
"Heaven knows what's going on."
Everyone fell silent, worried for Lu Yang's safety. Could someone at the Nascent Soul Stage pass the Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation?
...
The moment Lu Yang saw the Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation, his heart turned cold. He wondered if it was still possible to write a will.
Isn't this Thunder Tribulation a bit too much?
"Fairy, what should we do?"
"Uh, how about Immortal shows up to let the Heavenly Tribulation know to leave?" Fairy Eternity felt that maybe the Heavenly Tribulation didn't recognize her; if she showed herself, surely it would leave as a favor to her.
Lu Yang was a little troubled. The existence of Fairy Eternity was a secret, and he wasn't sure if the Xuanyu Divine Thunder could cover the traces of the Fairy's intervention. If Senior Brothers and Sisters saw Fairy Eternity, it wouldn't be good.
Feeling the Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation that had already locked onto him, Lu Yang suddenly said, "There's no need to trouble Fairy with this just yet. I have a plan that I can try here. If it doesn't work, then it's not too late for you to intervene, Fairy."
"What plan?"
Lu Yang gave no answer, only a smile.
...
Watching the Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation that seemed to carry the might to destroy worlds, Gu Junye and the others were filled with concern.
"Do you think Junior Brother Lu Yin can pass through it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 888 - 887: Inner Demon
chapters.content:
```
As soon as he sensed the targeting of the Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation, Lu Yang immediately employed the Causality Supernatural Power—Heaven Defying Name Change!
He was no longer "Lu Yang," but "Lu Yin."
This was an unparalleled Causality Supernatural Power, one that even Divine Transformation Stage Cultivators could not possibly learn. Lu Yang's talent was exceptional, and he had mastered this technique early on, finding it of use today!
"Heaven Defying Name Change, changing the name contrary to the Heavenly Tribulation, what a fitting name for this Divine Ability."
The Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation, which loomed over the top of Sky Gate Mountain within the dark clouds, suddenly became tractable, as it could no longer find its target for Pass Tribulation.
The azure Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation circled the summit of Sky Gate Mountain several times but could not find "Lu Yang."
Lu Yin saw that this approach was not the solution—they couldn't just keep stalling like this.
"Since Heaven Defying Name Change works on the Thunder Tribulation..."
Lu Yin slightly smiled, retracted the Causality Supernatural Power, and reverted to his original name.
Upon rediscovering Lu Yang, the Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation became exceedingly excited. It had been gathering strength as it searched for Lu Yang, and now that he had reappeared, it was ready to erupt with full force!
The azure light pulsed, bathing Sky Gate Mountain in a glare as bright as a midsummer noon, making it hard for onlookers to keep their eyes open.
Just as the Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation was about to strike Lu Yang, he once again performed the Heaven Defying Name Change and transformed back into "Lu Yin."
Having lost its target, the Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation, unable to retract the strike, had no choice but to bypass Lu Yin and hit the ground instead.
"As expected," Lu Yin breathed a sigh of relief, having found a safe method to pass the tribulation.
Generally speaking, no one would avoid the Thunder Tribulation. As the Yingtian Immortal once said, the Thunder Tribulation is both a trial and an opportunity, as being struck by it could strengthen oneself.
But that's assuming it doesn't kill you.
Lu Yin knew his frail body was no match for the Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation; the best approach was to dodge it.
Once "Lu Yin" changed back to "Lu Yang," the Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation descended once more. As it did, Lu Yang changed his name again, causing the Tribulation's attack to fail.
This was repeated nine times.
Nine is the ultimate number, and the Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation was limited to nine strikes; after the ninth time, it was considered a successful pass.
...
"Heavens, a Nascent Soul Stage Cultivator passed the Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation?!" Although they couldn't comprehend what Lu Yang had done, everyone could tell that the tribulation had been successfully passed, and cheers erupted throughout the Seek Dao Sect.
It was an unheard-of feat for a Nascent Soul Stage Cultivator to face, much less pass, the Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation!
Gu Junye stood with his hands behind his back, a smile on his lips, and a profound look in his eyes, reminiscent of the past: "Worthy of the Xuanyuan Sword Master, he indeed has a bit of the past's grace."
"What magic skill did Elder Brother Lu Yang just use, that the Thunder Tribulation wouldn't even strike him?" Even Li Haoran, who possessed the memories of Master Qin, could not understand what Lu Yang had done just then.
"Has it finally ended?"
"Why isn't Elder Brother Lu Yang moving at all, just floating in the sky?"
"The Xuanyu Divine Thunder around Sky Gate Mountain hasn't dissipated; the Heavenly Tribulation isn't over. Junior Brother Lu has fallen into the Heart Devil Tribulation!" a Void Refinement Stage Senior Brother quickly discerned.
Tao Yaoye, looking anxiously at Elder Brother Lu Yang, silently prayed, hoping for his safe return.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang has a firm Dao heart; nothing will happen to him."
Li Haoran then reminded, "Don't forget, Elder Brother Lu Yang is a disciple of our Sect Leader. Has anyone who apprenticed under the Sect Leader ever been trapped in the Heart Devil Tribulation?"
That was certainly true, but Tao Yaoye still worried about Lu Yang deeply.
...
"Where is this?"
Lu Yang's eyes were momentarily clouded with confusion, feeling his head not quite functioning; he couldn't remember what had happened before, nor why he was here.
Lu Yang slowly rose to his feet, adorned in a noble Imperial Robe woven with gold and silver threads, impervious to blades and fire, resistant to all kinds of magic.
Embroidered on the front of the robe was Fairy Eternity, and on the back, Eldest Senior Sister.
```
Lu Yang turned his head to find that the chair he had been sitting on was the Emperor's Chair, representing the supreme authority, a tribute from the Demon Territory, claimed to have been personally crafted by Venerate Zhu Tian.
Lu Yang looked around and realized he was in a palace, with memorials to the throne and the Jade Seal in front of him.
He flipped the Jade Seal over and saw it was inscribed with the words "Long live the Great Bean Dynasty".
Memories flooded back like a tide, and Lu Yang finally remembered his identity.
"I remember now, I am the Emperor of the Great Bean Dynasty."
The Emperor's personal eunuch approached Lu Yang with a tray, on which wooden plaques were neatly arranged.
"Your Majesty, whose plaque would you like to turn over tonight?" the personal eunuch Meng Jingzhou asked.
Lu Yang could hardly remember who was in his harem, so he casually flipped over one of the plaques.
"Yellow Bean."
He flipped another.
"Yun Zhi."
Then came Tao Yaoye, Lan Ting...
"Your Majesty, do you intend to bed them all tonight?" the personal eunuch Meng Jingzhou hesitantly asked.
"Summon them all, I would like to see them," Lu Yang commanded with a sweep of his hand and an air of unquestionable authority.
Soon enough, the women from Lu Yang's harem arrived one after another, a stunning gathering like birds of many colours.
"Little Yang, did you look for me tonight?" Yellow Bean asked, wearing a pale yellow dress that swayed light and airy with her movements, her eyes clear as lake water blinking at Lu Yang.
"Junior Brother, did you summon me?" Yun Zhi looked like a fairy straight out of a painting, clad in pure white attire, as pristine as plum blossoms under the first snow, her presence both cool and elegant, her movements graceful and the bells on her wrist jingling softly.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang..."
The peachy Tao Yaoye and the demure Lan Ting also arrived at the palace.
The four stunning beauties gathered around Lu Yang, each with their own style—some reserved, others bold, all with emotions in their eyes that were hard to define or express.
As the four women drew closer and closer to him, the sense of discord grew stronger and stronger, finally causing Lu Yang to recall his true memories.
"Wasn't I in the midst of passing through the Heavenly Tribulation? How did I end up here?"
"Wait, the Heavenly Tribulation? Is this the Heart Devil Tribulation?"
With that realization, Lu Yang was so scared that he sat down abruptly on the ground, retreating continuously while breaking out in a cold sweat, especially keeping as far away from Yellow Bean and Yun Zhi as possible.
He had not been so frightened even when he faced the Invincible Divine Thunder and the Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation.
"The books have mentioned, during the Heart Devil Tribulation, the Inner Demon will transform into the shape of what you fear most, or it may manifest as the environment you most desire, ensnaring you until you are unable to extricate yourself. Even if you realize it's the Heart Devil Tribulation, many people willingly continue to indulge and descend into depravity."
"And to pass the Heart Devil Tribulation, one must not only recognize it but also overcome the enemies within it."
Lu Yang glanced at Yellow Bean to his left and then at Yun Zhi to his right.
As if he could overcome this!
Just as Lu Yang was considering his next move, he heard a cracking sound. Looking up, he saw the space above him fracturing, the cracks quickly spreading throughout the entire space.
As the space shattered, Lu Yang came back to his senses and found himself in his Spiritual Space, facing Fairy Eternity who had rolled up her sleeves.
Fairy Eternity leaned in with concern, "Little Yang, are you alright? You fell into the Heart Devil Tribulation just now and seemed to be seeing something that made you keep laughing foolishly."
"...I almost wasn't."
"Eternity, you're finally alive," a hearty laugh echoed through the Spiritual Space.
How could there be a third person in the Spiritual Space? Lu Yang quickly turned around to see a figure appearing outside his Spiritual Space, resembling an emperor with a natural leadership aura.
Lu Yang had seen this face before.
Yingtian Immortal.

chapters.title: Chapter 889 - 888: Are You Sure That Was the Heart Devil Tribulation?
chapters.content:
"Immortal, you have finally come back to life," Yingtian Immortal said, with a natural imperial aura that lent an authoritativeness to his words, yet also a sense of the ethereal, like a deity stepping out of a tale.
Yingtian Immortal looked at Fairy Eternity, his thoughts a multitude: "As history cycles and time shifts, how many dynasties have risen and fallen, reduced to rubble and gravel?"
"The departed cannot be pursued, and bygone times cannot be shaped anew. How many have witnessed with their own eyes the great era when geniuses rose together, and dragons and serpents emerged from the lands? How many remember the age when the Five Immortals ruled the world, setting order under heaven?"
"Having foreseen your future through the vestiges of history, I knew this day would come, and here I have waited for your return, Immortal."
"Fellow Daoist, it has been a long time. Have you been well?"
Yingtian Immortal seemed to walk from the very end of the river of history, his presence exuding a profound sense of it.
His eyes were deep, as if piercing through all matters of the world, no secret could hide before him, and all changes were within his expectations.
Even the Qilin Immortal had not given Lu Yang such a feeling.
He wore a robe and boots, both white, and stood with his hands behind his back; he stepped forward, then with a clang, he bumped into the Spatial Barrier, his head tilting back abruptly.
"No, how is this kid's Spiritual Space so sturdy?"
Yingtian Immortal stood outside Lu Yang's Spiritual Space, tapping on the barrier in front of him, producing a dull thud.
He had intended to pass through the barrier into Lu Yang's Spiritual Space.
But who would have thought this kid's Spatial Barrier would be excessively robust? He couldn't break through.
Why does every encounter with the Immortal lead to accidents?
Yingtian Immortal awkwardly patted the barrier, calling out loudly, "So, can you two let me in?"
Lu Yang himself was unaware that his Spiritual Space was so robust; he wasn't sure if it was reinforced by Fairy Eternity or Eldest Senior Sister.
Lu Yang cracked open a gap, and Yingtian Immortal hurriedly squeezed in.
He cleared his throat twice; he had wanted to keep up appearances, but having been blocked outside already, trying to regain an imposing demeanor now seemed somewhat late.
"Are you sending out a thread of your divine thoughts, hidden within the Heavenly Tribulation?" Fairy Eternity disclosed that the Yingtian Immortal in front of them was not his true body, but rather a divine thought left behind countless years ago.
"Indeed."
Fairy Eternity's eyes narrowed slightly, her demeanor slightly hostile: "In that case, are you admitting that you arranged the Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation?"
Seeing Fairy Eternity's displeasure about the Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation, Yingtian Immortal hurried to explain, "It's true I arranged it, but that Thunder Tribulation wasn't lethal, really, Immortal, believe me."
"Really?"
"Truly, truly."
Seeing Fairy Eternity still appeared skeptical, Yingtian Immortal sighed, feeling obliged to further explain:
"Initially, the historical reflections revealed the silhouette of this young friend. It must have been him who called out your name, resurrecting you."
"And none of us were beside you, which shouldn't have been the case. It suggests, Immortal, that you did not encounter any of us."
"Had you found any one of us, we would have accompanied you to view the chessboard of history, instead of you going alone."
"Therefore, I deduced that something must have happened to us at that time, preventing us from contacting you."
"This led me to leave a thread of divine thought within the Heavenly Tribulation, as a precaution."
At this point, Yingtian Immortal hesitated before asking, "Er, before I proceed, let me first inquire, Immortal, have you met my true body?"
"I have not."
"That's good."
If he'd seen my original form, then wouldn't my 400,000 years in the Heavenly Tribulation have been in vain? How embarrassing would that be if it got out?
"At the time, you must have possessed this young friend's spiritual space, and you surely taught him how to condense the Invincible Elixir, which allowed these young friends to have an Invincible Nascent Soul during their Nascent Soul Stage."
"That's why I arranged the Supreme Haotian Golden Que Thunder. When the Heavenly Tribulation detects someone undergoing the tribulation with an Invincible Nascent Soul, this Thunder Tribulation will descend."
"However, just this method of detection isn't appropriate because the one undergoing tribulation might use other methods to get through the Thunder Tribulation, or perhaps they condensed their Invincible Elixir on their own."
Upon hearing this, Lu Yang carefully recalled the past, and it seemed that his Invincible Elixir indeed had nothing to do with Fairy Eternity; he first condensed the Invincible Elixir by himself before Fairy Eternity told him it was called the Invincible Elixir.
What Fairy Eternity did was just save him the trouble of figuring out how to use the Invincible Elixir by directly telling him how to use it.
"And then, I arranged the Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation, which is absolutely impossible for those in the Nascent Soul Stage to pass through. Should you, Immortal, reveal yourself, the Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation would automatically dissipate."
Yingtian Immortal, grinding his teeth, looked at Lu Yang and said, "Who would have thought? The lad actually managed to get through the Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation without relying on you!"
He was merely a lingering thought left behind by Ying Tian Immortal's original form, which after 400,000 years, had mostly depleted its power. His control over the Heavenly Tribulation was limited; otherwise, he would have already caused the Qian Heaven Thunder to strike.
The only strength he had left was barely enough to meet Fairy Eternity once; he had to use it wisely.
"Fortunately, when one transitions from the Nascent Soul Stage to the Spirit Transformation Stage, they still have to face the Heart Devil Tribulation. If this lad recognizes you, Immortal, you'll definitely become his inner demon."
"Sure enough, you appeared in his Heart Devil Tribulation. That's when I was certain you were inside this lad's body."
Lu Yang listened in complete astonishment, "Are you sure that was my inner demon?"
An inner demon is either something that instills fear or something one is willing to sink into helplessly.
Lu Yang felt that including Eldest Senior Sister and Fairy Eternity in his harem didn't fit with either of those possibilities.
"Of course, it was your inner demon," Ying Tian Immortal said calmly. "If you think back to the scene of the Heart Devil Tribulation, don't you feel afraid?"
When Lu Yang thought of his memories possibly being noticed by Eldest Senior Sister, he shuddered in fear.
Turns out this Heart Devil Tribulation isn't about recalling scenes that I'm afraid of but creating scenes that make me afraid!
Who has ever heard of a Heart Devil Tribulation like this!
Fairy Eternity sensed something was off, "Little Yang, you encountered me in your Heart Devil Tribulation, and it made you feel afraid. What happened during your tribulation?"
Dare Lu Yang say that he had enjoyed the favor of both Eldest Senior Sister and Fairy Eternity, embracing them left and right? He would have to be tired of living to divulge that.
He spoke tearfully, "In my Heart Devil Tribulation, Fairy, you changed completely, kept hitting me, and it felt so strange."
"But I saw you grinning foolishly the whole time?"
"You don't understand, Fairy. That was a forced smile, meant to keep you from worrying about me outside."
Seeing how pitiful Little Yang was, Fairy Eternity lovingly stroked Lu Yang's head, "Don't cry, don't cry, it's okay. How could I ever beat you?"
As Lu Yang kept crying, sobbing deeply, and seemed inconsolable, Fairy Eternity made a determined decision, ready to give up her original successor:
"How about this, from now on, let Miss Yun be the third Bean Emperor, and you can be the second."
This so frightened Lu Yang that he stopped crying immediately. How come his crying seemed to bring him closer and closer to realizing his inner demon?
Yingtian Immortal: "..."
No, Immortal, why does this feel so strange?

chapters.title: Chapter 890 - 889: The Origin of Ashy Bean
chapters.content:
"Are you Lu Yang?" Yingtian Immortal asked calmly.
"Yingtian Immortal senior, you know of me too?" Lu Yang was pleasantly surprised; he hadn't even introduced himself yet.
"I've been watching from the heavens when you tried to deceive the Thunder Tribulation by changing your name just now."
"..."
"To think that you've learned to defy fate at the Nascent Soul Stage, truly a talent to be reckoned with."
Lu Yang wasn't sure how to respond to that: whether to carry on with what Yingtian Immortal had said, or to correct him by saying that what he learned was not to defy fate, but to change his name.
Fortunately, Fairy Eternity stepped in to change the subject.
Fairy Eternity asked, "After the fall of this immortal, what happened then?"
As the thoughts of Yingtian Immortal persisted from ancient times to the present, he must know more than Ao Ling and Lianyi.
"After the four of us learned about your future demise, we took various measures to prevent it, such as Suiyue often using the Time Dao Fruit to foresee the future, and my true form splitting a part of itself to hide me within the Thunder Tribulation to observe your movements, while Jiuchong and Kirin sought the 'sixth Immortal'."
"Just the day before your incident, Time Immortal still foresaw your future, but he saw a future where nothing happened."
"On the day of the incident, about half an hour after I saw you enter the abode, your aura suddenly fluctuated intensely, and then completely disappeared—your physical body, soul, Dao Fruit, everything was gone, and all beings forgot about your existence."
Fairy Eternity frowned; she couldn't remember this part, which suggested that something was indeed amiss with her at the time.
"My true form and the other three noticed your abnormality and rushed to the North Star, sealing off the place."
"And soon, in a corner of the North Star, we found an unknown Immortal."
"No one knows how that Immortal was able to act within your abode to kill you silently without leaving any traces of battle, nor do we know how that Immortal escaped from right under my watch."
"A staggering celestial battle began shortly thereafter; the prowess of that Immortal exceeded our expectations, capable of holding their own against the four of us without falling behind."
"No, one could say that only with such strength, would it be possible to kill you."
"That Immortal did not fight us to the death; they kept fleeing throughout the battle, and indeed, they managed to escape."
"To prevent that Immortal from escaping, the four of us refined the stars into a continent and set up the Four Immortals' seal beneath it; only with your resurrection, Fairy Eternity, and the addition of our combined powers, could we break that seal."
It was all to force that Immortal to resurrect Fairy Eternity.
Clearly, that Immortal didn't fall for it, preferring to remain trapped within the boxed world rather than resurrect Fairy Eternity.
"The Immortal's unwillingness to resurrect you was anticipated, so we opted for the original method—the Power of Faith."
"Do you remember the Buddhism we fabricated? That was an experiment centered around the Power of Faith."
"Although you didn't pay much attention to Buddhism, Qinghe took it very seriously, as it is all about your story."
"Qinghe conducted thorough research on the Power of Faith, even surpassing the four of us."
"According to Qinghe's view, the Power of Faith could condense into a physical body, which is to say, your body, Fairy Eternity."
"To gather the Power of Faith, my true form and the other three established the Fire Dynasty."
"Ten thousand years after the establishment of the Fire Dynasty, the Imperial Shi Clan gave birth to a prodigy who, based on the insight into the Dao Fruit, attained Immortality and was given the Dao name 'Imperial Historian,' referred to by the people as 'Imperial Historian Immortal'."
"With the ability to perceive past, present, and future through the Dao Fruit, my true form requested him to observe the murder process, yet he saw nothing."
"Xiao Ling told me about it."
"Lu Yang, you've met Ao Ling? Then that saves trouble. She must have told you about 'Heavenly Court' and 'Underworld,' right?"
"It is about shaping my flesh with the faith of Heavenly Court and summoning the Eternity Dao Fruit with the belief system of the Underworld, or using the Underworld belief system to condense the Reincarnation Dao Fruit. With the power of the Reincarnation Dao Fruit, reversing life and death, resurrecting you."
"Hold on, are you saying the Underworld system can condense a Reincarnation Dao Fruit?" Fairy Eternity interrupted the Yingtian Immortal, Ao Ling had never mentioned this to her before.
"Ao Ling didn't tell you? Oh right, she fell into a deep sleep when the Fire Dynasty was established, about twenty thousand years ago. At that time, the Underworld was not yet fully developed, and the concept of Reincarnation Dao Fruit had not emerged, so it's normal for her not to know."
"Only in the end, the Underworld didn't manage to condense a Reincarnation Dao Fruit, they condensed an Initial Form of Reincarnation Dao Fruit instead."
Yingtian Immortal shook his head and sighed, regretting the decision to establish the Underworld on behalf of his true self, "It's this Initial Form of Reincarnation Dao Fruit that caused a big problem."
"Unable to resurrect the deceased?" Fairy Eternity asked curiously.
Yingtian Immortal continued to shake his head with a regretful expression, "The Initial Form of Reincarnation Dao Fruit indeed can resurrect the dead, and it did indeed resurrect you."
"But what was resurrected was not you in the Immortal stage, but you in the Semi-Immortal stage."
Lu Yang's pupils gradually narrowed, as he seemed to realize how Grey Bean came to be.
Fairy Eternity had two Semi-Immortal stages; one was during the Initial Form of Annihilation Dao Fruit, the other was during the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit.
"You resurrected Ashy Bean?!"
Yingtian Immortal looked at Lu Yang with confusion, "Who is Ashy Bean?"
Yingtian Immortal was not yet aware of Fairy Eternity's full name.
"Never mind, please continue, Senior Yingtian Immortal."
"Didn't you once achieve Semi-Immortality through the Initial Form of Annihilation Dao Fruit? Later on, Time Immortal persuaded you, saying that achieving immortality that way was not the strongest; it would be better to return to nature and attain immortality through the natural Dao."
"You cut yourself, stripped away the part of yourself that possessed the Initial Form of Annihilation Dao Fruit and killed it; then you returned to the Transcendence Tribulation Stage and re-condensed the Dao Fruit Outline."
"What the Underworld resurrected was, in fact, you who once killed yourself, the one who had the Initial Form of Annihilation Dao Fruit!"
Lu Yang began to understand how Grey Bean came about, but there were still some things he didn't quite grasp, and he cautiously raised his hand, "May I interrupt with a question?"
"Ask away."
Yingtian Immortal was quite friendly towards Lu Yang, the Junior Cultivator who resurrected the immortal.
"That Fairy who possessed the Initial Form of the Annihilation Dao Fruit, she's the same as the Heavenly Court Master of the Fire Dynasty, right?" Lu Yang wanted to confirm that these two were the same person first.
"Right."
"We've met her in the East Sea, and how should I put it... her personality is somewhat different from the current Fairy, very cold and aloof. Did something go wrong when you resurrected her?"
From the brief encounter in the East Sea, that Grey Bean acted decisively, was calm and collected, and coldly detached, completely different from the current Fairy Eternity.
Yingtian Immortal did not quite understand what Lu Yang meant.
"Isn't being cold and aloof quite normal?"
"That was her personality before."
"Ah?"

chapters.title: Chapter 891 - 890 The Heart of a Child
chapters.content:
Seeing Lu Yang's strong reaction, it was now Yingtian Immortal's turn to be surprised.
"You don't know? Fairy Eternity's personality was different from what it is now."
"I remember the time when Fairy Eternity defeated me and Kirin during the Foundation Establishment Stage with her Golden Core Realm and said with a cold face, 'So-called geniuses are no more than this.'
At that moment, I thought that attitude was incredibly cool, and I often tried to emulate that feeling."
Yingtian Immortal was drawn back to memories from over four hundred thousand years ago, in a bamboo forest, where he and Qilin Immortal lay defeated on the ground. Fairy Eternity stood in her green attire and bamboo hat, her demeanor indifferent and icy, her eyes full of contempt for all living beings.
He believed that was how a true master should look!
"Fairy Eternity challenged those beyond her level with an invincible might, forming the Invincible Elixir. Then, wielding the Invincible Elixir and Invincible Nascent Soul, she roamed the world unchallenged, defeating all challengers and earning a great reputation. Back then, everyone's legs would go soft at the sight of her."
Lu Yang imagined the scene described by Yingtian Immortal: Fairy Eternity challenging numerous Golden Core Stage cultivators while at the Foundation Establishment Stage, her coolness biting, and in full view of everyone, forming the Invincible Elixir, defeating her enemies, and striding away with pride.
Pretty cool indeed.
"Afterward, she cut herself with one strike, severing the Annihilation Dao Fruit Embryo from her body, heeding the advice of Time Immortal, and rediscovering her childlike innocence."
Yingtian Immortal looked up wistfully, "We four were all so envious to see that. Who would have thought that even after experiencing such a dramatic change in her tribe, she could return to the innocence of a child, revert to her original self, and become Immortal by seeking the most natural state? That's how she became who she is today."
A dramatic change in her tribe?
Lu Yang recalled the phrase. The Fairy had once mentioned that she was born in a small tribe, which was destroyed by the residual forces of a battle between a man and a beast. When she talked about this topic, the Fairy was clearly melancholic, and Lu Yang, considering her feelings, did not ask further.
From what Yingtian Immortal said, the Fairy's original personality was similar to her current one. It was only after the destruction of her tribe that she became detached.
That was to be expected, it would be odd if someone remained optimistic and cheerful after such a catastrophe.
Lu Yang understood that the original Fairy Eternity was naively romantic. After the destruction of her tribe, she became aloof and cold. After forming the outline of the Annihilation Dao Fruit, she let go of her past with the guidance of Time Immortal and reverted to her true self, achieving Immortal status.
"But are you sure, Yingtian Immortal senior, that when the Fairy beat you and Qilin Immortal at that time, she was cold-faced?"
Fairy, you were a mighty Golden Core Stage cultivator, yet you had an air of 'do not disturb'. Could you really have executed such a cross-level challenge?
The more Lu Yang thought about it, the stranger the scene seemed.
Fairy Eternity blushed listening to Yingtian Immortal recount her past, staring down and fidgeting with her big toe, too shy to see Lu Yang's current expression.
When Little Yang asked his question, she lifted her head bravely to look at Lu Yang, pouting and poking his arm.
"What does my expression have to do with it? They were the ones who provoked this Immortal first. With the opponents coming at me, why would I avoid the battle?"
"Besides, back then, Yingtian and Kirin were both capable of defeating Golden Core Stage cultivators while at the Foundation Establishment Stage. So when I fought the two of them at the Golden Core Stage, it was essentially a two-against-one scenario. If anything, I was at a disadvantage!"
Lu Yang: "..."
So you really think defeating them both is a matter of pride, Fairy.
Lu Yang still had one more question, "That's not right either. Didn't Grey Bean destroy the Fire Dynasty? Even the past Fairy wouldn't do such a thing."
Given the harshness of ancient struggles, it was rare for Fairy Eternity to have overcome Yingtian Immortal and Qilin Immortal without silencing them permanently.
Especially the Qilin Immortal, a naturally born and bred Kirin, whose value far surpassed that of any heavenly material or earthly treasure. Even so, Fairy Eternity had not dealt a killing blow.
Lu Yang figured that if it were Ashy Bean, he would have taken out both the Yingtian Immortal and the Qilin Immortal long ago.
Hearing this, the Yingtian Immortal also more or less understood that the "Ashy Bean" Lu Yang spoke of was none other than the Master of the Heavenly Court from the Fire Dynasty.
"Yes, that's the strange part."
"Although the previous Immortal Eternity was cold and indifferent, her actions were not extreme and she was always restrained. My true body and the other two from Suiyue also believed this, deeming that although the resurrected was in the stage of the Annihilation Dao Fruit Embryo, the problem wasn't significant."
"After resurrecting as the Master of the Heavenly Court, she couldn't remember her original name, the reason for which is unknown."
"The resurrected Immortal Eternity was on the verge of proving her Dao and becoming an Immortal, so after her resurrection, once she acquired a physical body, she quickly attracted the Immortal Ascension Tribulation and proved her Dao as an Immortal with the Annihilation Dao Fruit."
"But no one expected that after her ascension, she revealed her true nature, starting a mass slaughter and aiming to destroy the entire Fire Dynasty."
"At first, her strength was only average, but as she killed more and more people, her strength grew increasingly formidable."
"Although the power of the Master of the Heavenly Court was increasing, it wasn't yet to the extent that it couldn't be suppressed by a combined effort of my true body, Suiyue, Jiuchong, the Kirin, and the Left Historian Immortal from the Five Immortals."
At this point, the Yingtian Immortal paused, his tone growing even heavier, "But then, at that moment, Suiyue died."
Fairy Eternity and Lu Yang both remembered the damaged Firmament Tree beneath the Five Elements Sect, symbolizing that the Time Immortal had once been through a great battle.
"How did he die!" Fairy Eternity asked urgently.
The difficulty of killing Time Immortal was second only to her own. The Time Immortal wielded the Time Dao Fruit, which allowed him to reverse time and foresee the future. How could he have been killed?
The Yingtian Immortal shook his head, "I don't know. At that time, it was when the Master of the Heavenly Court was starting the rebellion. This thought of mine was also on the Heavenly Court Master's hit list. The situation was urgent, and I could only hide."
"I know very little about that battle."
"However, the one capable of killing the Time Immortal can only be the 'sixth Immortal' who has always remained hidden."
"After the death of Time Immortal, my true body and the other Immortals did not join forces again; each fought their own battles."
"And as you probably all know by now, the Fire Dynasty was overthrown."
"To prevent the Master of the Heavenly Court from finding my true body through me, I had to sever contact."
"To avoid the Master of the Heavenly Court, I used the Thunder Tribulation as a cover, never revealing myself again, hiding from causality. Only when a cultivator was passing the Thunder Tribulation could I, through the cultivator's Inner Demon, guess what changes had taken place in the outside world, all the way until today."
"Is Time really gone?" Fairy Eternity was still reluctant to believe this, as she herself had a way to resurrect, but the Time Immortal had no means of resurrection.
When the topic turned to this, the Yingtian Immortal seemed somewhat hesitant, "This might not necessarily be the case."
"As far as I know, after that battle, the Reincarnation Dao Fruit Outline that formed in the Underworld also disappeared. If Time possessed the Reincarnation Dao Fruit Outline, even if he fell, he could potentially be reborn through reincarnation and return in a completely new form."
"!!!"
Hearing this, both Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity were startled.
It seemed they did indeed know a cultivator who possessed the Reincarnation Dao Fruit Outline.

chapters.title: Chapter 892 - 891: Advancing to the Divinity Transformation Stage
chapters.content:
While the three were chatting, a door opened in the spiritual space. The woman, dressed in a white gown with golden threads running through the bells tied to her wrist, had an indifferent expression.
"Eldest Senior Sister, why have you come?" Lu Yang exclaimed with joy upon seeing the Eldest Senior Sister.
"I've been watching from the outside world and saw you were stuck in your Heart Demon Tribulation, so I came to check on you."
"Looking at you now, it seems you've encountered some trouble?"
The Eldest Senior Sister turned her gaze toward the only stranger present.
"Who are you?"
Ying Tian Immortal felt as if facing a formidable enemy, for it was his first encounter with an existence whose aura was stronger than his own.
Ying Tian Immortal's aura suddenly changed, becoming unfathomably deep, carrying the thick essence of history, as if he had crossed through the long river of time and the endless dust of the mortal world to arrive here.
He vibrated his arms, and his wide sleeves enfolded his forearms as he clasped them behind his back, staring directly into Yun Zhi's eyes.
"My name is Ying Tian Immortal. I have seen Daoist Yun Zhi during the Heavenly Tribulation."
"So it turns out to be a remnant thought of Ying Tian Immortal, one of the Five Ancient Immortals, hidden within the Heavenly Tribulation. Indeed, your methods have their merits."
Ying Tian Immortal was startled. Truly a master, she had pinpointed his origin on first meeting, hinting that he was merely a remnant thought with no right to sit on equal footing with her, suggesting that his true self should come instead.
"Daoist has praised me too highly. However, I did not expect that the future generations would produce such an exceptional figure as you. The younger generation truly inspires awe."
A sneer pulled at the corner of Ying Tian Immortal's heart. He intentionally emphasized that Yun Zhi was from a later generation, gaining the upper hand in terms of seniority, waiting to see how she would respond!
"Talent is negligible," said Yun Zhi, his tone nonchalant as if discussing a trivial matter.
Ying Tian Immortal: "..."
How am I to respond to this?
But he didn't have to consider this problem for long.
Under the watchful eyes of Lu Yang and the others, Ying Tian Immortal's form gradually faded, becoming so translucent that the objects behind him could be seen.
"Ying Tian, is this remnant thought of yours about to exhaust itself?"
Since he was about to disappear, there was no need to put on airs.
Ying Tian Immortal brought his two fingers together, pressed them against his temple, flicked them outwards, and said with a hearty laugh, "Then I shall take my leave. Although I do not know where my true self may be, I still hope you can find him."
Soon after, Ying Tian Immortal vanished as if he had never appeared.
Eldest Senior Sister conjured three Emperor's Chairs out of thin air, gesturing for Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity to take a seat, her movements as skilled as if she were in her own spiritual space.
"So what did you two do to summon a remnant thought of Ying Tian Immortal over here?"
Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity honestly recounted the process of passing the tribulation, from overcoming the Heart Demon Tribulation to the moment Ying Tian Immortal left, mentioning the Reincarnation Dao Fruit Outline.
Upon hearing Fairy Eternity's past experiences, Yun Zhi's eyes showed a hint of pity, well-concealed.
"So you two mean to say that Junior Brother Li is the reincarnation of Time Immortal?"
Eldest Senior Sister nodded, choosing to say no more.
"Then, what are your thoughts on Grey Immortal's transformation? Why is her personality different from the original fairy, and why does she want to overthrow the Fire Dynasty?"
Lu Yang analyzed, "Judging by Elder Ying Tian Immortal's description, the more people Ashy Bean kills, the stronger she becomes, to the point where any one of the Four Ancient Immortals couldn't defeat her."
"So, junior brother, you also think that the more people Grey Immortal kills, the stronger she becomes, and you attribute this to the characteristics of the Annihilation Dao Fruit?"
Lu Yang shook his head, "Whether it is a feature of the Annihilation Dao Fruit, I do not know, but she certainly does not become stronger by killing more people."
```
"If that were the case, she would have already started destroying the world in the 300,000 years since the Fire Dynasty fell."
```
"From her wanting to kill Ao Ling and her wanting to kill me, I tend to believe that she only wants to kill those who are aware of her existence, that is, those who know she exists."
```
"And since the people of the Fire Dynasty all knew of her, that's why she became stronger as she killed more."
```
Eldest Senior Sister was quite satisfied with Lu Yang's analytical process, not being confused by the surface information, "Correct, it is the same as what I had thought."
```
"It's just that I wonder why she is so eager to become stronger and why it differs from the usual cold demeanor of a fairy. I suspect it has to do with the Power of Faith."
```
"Go on?"
```
"Although I don't know much about the Power of Faith, some clues can be seen from the events concerning the Island Master of Penglai Island in the East Sea."
```
"The Power of Faith is a double-edged sword; it can make one stronger but can also control one's mind."
```
"The Immortal's Body of Grey Bean is formed by the Power of Faith, and surely it includes the faith of the Four Ancient Immortals."
```
"It is possible that the Four Ancient Immortals themselves didn't realize that their thoughts not only contained the resurrection of Fairy Eternity but also the hope that after the fairy's resurrection, they could join forces to kill the original murderer."
```
Even if Fairy Eternity is revived, there is a debt of life and death to be settled, a vengeance that cannot be left unavenged!
```
"Influenced by this train of thought, Grey Bean could have undergone another change atop the frosty fairy personality, becoming unscrupulous in her pursuit of strength."
```
"You're thinking along the same lines as I am, but there's another possibility that you, Junior Brother, have overlooked."
```
"What is it?"
```
"The thoughts about becoming stronger in the Power of Faith might not originate from the Four Ancient Immortals, but could also come from that murderer."
```
Lu Yang was shocked. Oh, how could he have forgotten this? Over the past hundred thousand years, the murderer just watched the Four Ancient Immortals resurrect Fairy Eternity, indifferent?
```
There must have been some action taken.
```
"Enough about this for now, Junior Brother, don't forget you're still in the middle of Passing Tribulation, with one final step left." Eldest Senior Sister stood up, making the three Emperor's Chairs vanish.
```
Reminded by Eldest Senior Sister, Lu Yang then remembered that his tribulation was not yet over.
```
The most critical part of bodily refinement and transformation hadn't even begun!
```
"Has Elder Brother Lu Yang's Heart Devil Tribulation not ended yet?" Tao Yaoye looked worriedly at Lu Yang, who was floating in the air in the distance.
```
"Hey, look, he moved, Elder Brother Lu Yang moved!" A Void Refinement Stage Senior Brother, with keen eyes, saw Lu Yang's finger move slightly, which meant that the Heart Devil Tribulation was finally over.
```
Sure enough, Lu Yang, who was flying atop Sky Gate Mountain, opened his eyes and his entire temperament was different.
```
The energy of the Supreme Heaven Golden Palace Thunder still lingered in Lu Yang's body, formerly suppressed by him, and now he planned to use this power for his bodily refinement.
```
Lu Yang released the suppression, allowing the thunder energy to flow through his body, strengthening every muscle and meridian.
```
Unlike the painful period of tribulation, the refinement process felt tingly and quite comfortable, with every pore in his body striving to open and absorb the external Spiritual Energy, transforming it into spiritual essence within him.
```
Spiritual Energy Pool, Spiritual Power, Spiritual Space, the resilience of meridians... his whole person was rejuvenated, a thorough transformation.
```
The results of the thunder refinement were surprisingly good, a refinement of Heavenly Tribulation more powerful than even the foremost-ranked Three Pure Thunder Tribulation, something no Divine Transformation Stage Cultivator had ever experienced.
```
Lu Yang looked inside his Dantian and saw the Nascent Soul start to develop cracks, then gradually disintegrate, releasing an even purer and stronger energy. A new form of energy began to coalesce, and eventually, a primordial spirit the size of Lu Yang himself took shape.
```
Thunder refinement, Nascent Soul to primordial spirit.
```
Lu Yang successfully advanced to the Divinity Transformation Stage!

chapters.title: Chapter 893 - 892: Changes in the Divinity Transformation Stage
chapters.content:
```
"Finally ascended to the Divinity Transformation Stage," Lu Yang let out a sigh of relief.
From the Nascent Soul Stage to the Divinity Transformation Stage, this was an earth-shattering change. Both status and strength had greatly improved compared to before.
Many cultivators at the Nascent Soul Stage were halted by the tribulation lightning, unable to make further progress.
In the eyes of the higher-ups, cultivators at the Golden Core and Nascent Soul Stages were talents who hadn't yet fully grown. Only those who had endured countless hardships without dying and had cultivated to the Divinity Transformation Stage could be considered fully grown talents.
At this stage, major forces would start teaching their disciples how to manage a sect, how to balance other powers, how to create alliances...
Wait, didn't I start managing the sect when I was at the Foundation Establishment Stage?
Although my status hasn't changed much, my strength has truly increased.
At the initial realm of Spiritual Transcendence, my combat power is comparable to cultivators in the early stage of the Integration Period, completely skipping the Void Refinement Stage!
Defeating opponents beyond one's rank, and moreover, jumping across two major realms, what a terrifying concept!
Take Elder Brother Dai Bufan in the early stage of Integration... oh, Elder Brother Dai has made a breakthrough, I can't beat him.
Consider Senior Brother Ji Hongwen in the early stage of Integration... seems like I can't beat him either.
At the initial realm of Spiritual Transcendence, my combat power is on par with Integration Period cultivators outside of our sect, but the condition is that the Integration Period cultivators don't use the power of rules!
In a First Class Sect, I would have enough stature to become an Elder.
"Junior Brother Lu, congratulations," someone said.
The thunder tribulation surrounding Sky Gate Mountain dissipated, and all the senior and junior brothers and sisters rushed to congratulate Lu Yang.
Lu Yang had faced thunder tribulation twice consecutively, which was unprecedented in the thirty-thousand-year history of the cultivation world, a feat that would definitely be recorded in history books, with a renown even more terrifying than that of Master of All Laws during the Great Yu Early Period.
"Junior Brother Lu, the first thunder tribulation you endured is unheard of, have you thought of a name for it?"
When cultivators encounter an unknown type of thunder tribulation during their tribulation, they have the absolute right to name it first.
Just like the person who initially called their constitution "Single Body Spiritual Root"—though the naming taste was ordinary, it became the official name; names like Pure Yang Spirit Root were considered aliases or colloquial terms.
Without a second thought, Lu Yang blurted out a name that Immortal Ying Tian had already decided on long ago, "Of course, it should be called the Supreme..."
In the spiritual space, Fairy Eternity, tugging at Lu Yang's sleeve, raised her little head, her large watery eyes looking up at him.
"Little Yang, wouldn't it be great to call it Invincible Divine Thunder?"
Lu Yang had never been looked at by Fairy Eternity this way before, and his heart instantly softened, heeding her suggestion.
"Of course, it should be called Invincible Divine Thunder."
