The senior brothers and sisters looked at each other with strange expressions, finding Junior Brother Lu's naming skills incredibly unique.
"Junior Brother Lu certainly has a distinct taste."
"No wonder you have achieved so much today, truly thinking unlike ordinary people."
"Good one, Invincible Divine Thunder," Fairy Eternity, seeing her effort pay off, immediately let go of Lu Yang's sleeve, raised her little hands and began to celebrate by bouncing and jumping around.
Lu Yang finally realized what a foolish thing he had just done and covered his head in anguish; why did he impulsively listen to Fairy Eternity's silly words.
"Xuanyuan Sword Master, you've done very well, I will catch up with you very soon," said Gu Junye with sparkling eyes, not so much looking at Lu Yang as at the Xuanyuan Sword Master from his past life, the leading swordsmanship figure who lived by the sword, was infatuated with sword art, and reached the pinnacle of swordsmanship.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, congratulations," Tao Yaoye, Man Gu, and Li Haoran congratulated him.
They were just slightly behind Lu Yang in terms of cultivation progress and would also soon face their tribulation.
Seeing Lu Yang's successful tribulation and his heroic demeanor filled them with confidence, wishing to quickly pass through their own tribulations and catch up to Lu Yang's pace.
Now, Lu Yang looked at Li Haoran with completely different eyes.
The reincarnation of Time Immortal, he had defeated Li Haoran back in the late Nascent Soul Stage, which practically amounted to defeating Time Immortal by rounding up, an utterly magnificent feat!
```
```
Every time he thought about it, Lu Yang couldn't help but smile from ear to ear.
After bidding farewell to the senior brothers and junior brothers who had kindly congratulated him, Lu Yang finally began to introspect and take stock of the gains brought by this breakthrough.
The most noticeable change was that his Spiritual Space had expanded tenfold.
If previously the Spiritual Space could accommodate a Daming Palace built by Fairy Eternity, now it could hold ten of those. Fairy Eternity could start constructing the Imperial Palace of the Great Bean Dynasty, with various domains such as the Chief of Staff's office, Yangxin Hall, and Shangqing Palace.
However, Fairy Eternity had no such plans for the moment; the vast expanse of Spiritual Space was blank, devoid of any structures.
Next was the primordial spirit. This had been promoted from the Nascent Soul, and if it left the body, it would be as tall as Lu Yang. It could depart from the body for long periods and over great distances to explore, surveil, or complete tasks, essentially acting as a clone.
Other Divine Transformation Stage Cultivators' primordial spirits couldn't achieve a clone-like effect, only those like Lu Yang's Invincible Nascent Soul, which had been subjugated and promoted through his own beating, could do so.
The primordial spirit, just like the Nascent Soul, obeyed Lu Yang's commands, sparing Lu Yang from the need to endure beatings from beginning to end, only being able to overcome them in the late stages of Spirit Transformation.
Lu Yang took a careful look at his primordial spirit and suddenly felt a pang of shock.
"Wait a minute, I remember that the Invincible Nascent Soul was nine-tenths similar to me. Why does it look less and less like me now?!"
Logically, the primordial spirit should look exactly like the cultivator. In the past, the Invincible Nascent Soul was nine-tenths similar to him, but now the primordial spirit only retained a little more than eight-tenths likeness.
Fairy Eternity, lying in the Spiritual Space while yawning, found Little Yang's concern to be foolish: "Isn't that normal? When I borrowed your body in the Imperial City, I also cultivated on your behalf."
Lu Yang slapped his forehead, right, how could he have forgotten about that.
"Fairy, how about you don't cultivate on my behalf from now on?"
Fairy Eternity considered Lu Yang's well-being: "How could that be? If I occupy your body for leisure, it wouldn't be right to let your cultivation fall behind, would it?"
Fairy, can your kindness be directed toward something proper?
Lu Yang continued to examine himself and found that his will seemed to be able to influence the spiritual essence in the surroundings.
"Is this the ability described in the texts, where Divine Transformation Stage can initially communicate with heaven and earth, manipulating spiritual essence?"
The ability to manipulate rules during the Body Integration Realm is an evolution of the Divine Transformation Stage's foundational communication with heaven and earth.
In a battle between two Divine Transformation Stage Cultivators, what's compared isn't just combat power, but also the degree to which they can communicate with heaven and earth.
Another change was in the Dantian, which had transformed into a Spiritual Energy Pool, used to store vast amounts of spiritual essence, eliminating the need to consume elixirs or absorb spiritual energy from heaven and earth while fighting, as was necessary in the Nascent Soul Stage.
"What a fragrant smell," Lu Yang's nose twitched as he caught a familiar scent.
"Here, Junior Brother, try the freshly ripe Immortal Peaches," Yun Zhi said, bringing over a basket of Immortal Peaches and placing them in front of Lu Yang.
Immortal Peaches also have the effect of solidifying the realm, which is especially suitable after a breakthrough.
"Eldest Senior Sister, did you find that Heavenly Root?" Lu Yang was quite surprised; he thought he would never taste a second Immortal Peach in his lifetime.
Yun Zhi shook her head: "I haven't found it. I just planted the peach pit left from the last Immortal Peach, and it happened to have ripened."
Now it was Fairy Eternity's turn to be puzzled: "Huh? It can work like that? I remember that the peach pit left by the Heavenly Root would only grow into an ordinary peach, wouldn't it?"
"I have my methods," Yun Zhi said calmly.
"Really?" Fairy Eternity remained unconvinced.
"Fairy Senior."
"What is it?"
"If you talk again, there won't be any peaches left for you."
Fairy Eternity immediately possessed Lu Yang: "Little Yang, save some for me."
```

chapters.title: Chapter 894 - 893: Good Things are Meant to be Shared
chapters.content:
```
Immortal Peaches were so rare that both Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity found them delicious; one can imagine how scrumptious they must be.
The scene where Lu Yang was grievously possessed by Fairy Eternity while the Eldest Senior Sister remained indifferent, even showing a trace of a smile, was terrifying.
"Fairy, don't eat them all. I want to let Junior Sister Tao and the others have a taste too," Lu Yang protested.
With a basket full of Immortal Peaches before him, Lu Yang couldn't bear to enjoy them alone.
"This Immortal has no intention of eating them all. I just wanted to taste one to remember the flavor," Fairy Eternity said as she wiped her mouth and returned the body to Lu Yang.
"Eldest Senior Sister, may I share these Immortal Peaches with the others?" he asked.
"These Immortal Peaches are yours. Whether you wish to eat them yourself or share them is up to you," the Eldest Senior Sister agreed happily.
It was a good thing that the Junior Brother was willing to share. She had picked these Immortal Peaches from the Secret Realm, and if the Junior Brother wanted more, she could just pick them again.
"After solidifying your realm, don't forget to continue writing the cultivation technique," Yun Zhi reminded.
Upon hearing this, Lu Yang immediately made a sour face. The pleasant mood from the breakthrough and eating peaches was gone.
Thinking about continuing the cultivation technique gave him a headache; now, he didn't know how many days he would have to stay in the Scripture Pavilion.
"Third Senior Sister, I have something great for you," Lu Yang said as he first sought out his fellow disciple Gan Tian, who was also residing on Sky Gate Mountain.
Gan Tian, as always, sat by the stream playing her zither with her eyes covered by a black cloth, seemingly in unity with nature.
She was in the process of comprehending the Unity of Heaven and Man.
"What a fragrant peach smell." Gan Tian sensed the aroma of the Immortal Peach from afar; she had tasted many strange fruits in the Demon Territory, but none compared to this.
"It is said to be the product of a Heavenly Root, a genuine Immortal Fruit."
Gan Tian was somewhat embarrassed, "Junior Brother, I didn't give you a celebratory gift for your breakthrough, and now you've brought a gift to your Senior Sister."
"How about this? Let me play 'Sunshine over White Snow' for you on my zither to help you communicate with heaven and earth, would that be okay?" she offered.
"Then, I would be most grateful, Senior Sister," he responded.
As Gan Tian's slender jade fingers gently brushed the zither strings, a faint fragrance seemed to permeate the air. Even the birdsong around fell silent to the melody. As she played "Sunshine over White Snow," the tune slowly meandered like a clear mountain stream trickling down, or like a warm and gentle spring breeze gracing one's face.
Lu Yang closed his eyes, his perception spreading involuntarily, feeling the rustling of grass in the forest, the shifts of nature. His initial vague sense of connection with the heaven and earth after his breakthrough into the Spirit Transformation Stage became clear, with real sensations of controlling the surrounding environment; his entire soul was elevated.
"Oh right, musical cultivation also has this effect. I'll have Zhu Tian play a piece for you too," Fairy Eternity remembered, thinking of Zhu Tian who was proficient in all kinds of musical performances.
"Where did these Immortal Peaches come from?" Gan Tian asked while holding an Immortal Peach.
"The Eldest Senior Sister said she grew them."
Gan Tian pondered. Grown by the Eldest Senior Sister?
She recalled the Eldest Senior Sister mentioning that the Secret Realm she stayed in was full of peach blossoms and peaches. Could there be a connection?
...
Task Hall.
Familiar with the place, Lu Yang walked to the deepest part, unobstructed by anyone.
Elder Brother Dai had said that Lu Yang could seek him out anytime.
"Elder Brother Dai, are you busy?" Lu Yang knocked and entered.
Dai Bufan involuntarily shivered at the sight of Lu Yang.
Even though he had watched the entire process of Lu Yang's breakthrough, and had just returned from Sky Gate Mountain not long ago, seeing Lu Yang in his own room always gave him an ominous feeling.
It was as if at any second, Lu Yang would start elaborating on something untoward he had done in the outside world.
From Transcendance Tribulation Stage to Immortal, it was a precedent.
```
Although he had not gone out this time, it did not mean there were no issues.
Dai Bufan watched Lu Yang warily, "You wouldn't have come over to tell me that you encountered an Immortal during your Heavenly Tribulation, would you?"
Lu Yang: "..."
Elder Brother Dai, did you gain the ability to foresee the future after your breakthrough to the Mid Integration Stage?
Lu Yang chuckled, pulling out an Immortal Peach from behind, "Elder Brother Dai, what are you talking about? How could I cause trouble every time? I just thought that managing the Task Hall is not easy for you, and I just so happen to have something good on hand, so I wanted to offer you a taste of something fresh."
"Is this the very Immortal Peach that is rumoured to extend one's lifespan?"
The information collected in Imperial City had once mentioned this Immortal Peach.
"Right."
Although he felt somewhat embarrassed to accept a gift from his junior brother, after much thought, Dai Bufan accepted the Immortal Peach, "If you need any information in the future, just come to me."
After Lu Yang left, Dai Bufan inspected the Immortal Peach for a moment, then left the Task Hall and went to an ancient tomb hidden in the depths of Seek Dao Sect, by a cliffside.
He came to the main chamber of the tomb, where a coffin black as ink stood.
In front of the coffin was an empty plate, where Dai Bufan placed the Immortal Peach. He then lit three incense sticks, offered three bows towards the coffin, and inserted them into a small incense burner.
"Master, remember to eat if you wake up."
This was the cultivation retreat of the Grand Elder. It was here that Lu Yang had first learned 'Heaven and Earth in an Inch.'
...
After giving Man Gu the Immortal Peach, Lu Yang went to see Tao Yaoye at Dust Free Peak.
Tao Yaoye held the Immortal Peach with great fondness. Her surname was Tao, and Elder Brother Lu had given her a precious Immortal Peach—was he hinting at something?
"Junior Sister Tao, the Immortal Peach has the effect of solidifying one's realm. If possible, I suggest you consume it after breaking through to the Divine Transformation Stage."
Tao Yaoye nodded obediently, making Lu Yang reflect for a moment. Among the female cultivators he knew, only Junior Sister Tao was obedient.
As for individuals like Fairy Eternity or the Eldest Senior Sister, when was it his turn to talk?
The last Immortal Peach Lu Yang decided to give to Li Haoran.
"Old Meng is following the Immortal in his cultivation, he must be living an enviable Immortal's life, with no lack of heavenly materials and earthly treasures. He won't miss this single bite."
"For me?" Li Haoran was deeply moved. He did not expect Elder Brother Lu to still remember him when such good fortune came.
He had thought Elder Brother Lu would only seek him out when he needed someone to practice with.
Lu Yang said earnestly, "Junior Brother Li, I am now a Cultivator in the Divine Transformation Stage. How could I forget about you when I come across such treasures?"
Li Haoran: "..."
You simply want to show off that you've reached the Divine Transformation Stage, right?
"Do you recognize the scent of the Immortal Peach? Doesn't it feel very familiar?" Lu Yang tried to awaken Li Haoran's past life.
The Five Ancient Immortals often ate Immortal Peaches, especially the Time Immortal and his peers who, after eating the food prepared by Fairy Eternity and then consuming Immortal Peaches, would surely consider it a delicacy of the mortal world, leaving a lasting impression.
If he could awaken the memories of the first life, it would be of great benefit, whether for the matters relating to the end of the Fire Dynasty or Li Haoran himself.
"A familiar feeling?" Li Haoran found himself confused by Lu Yang's question.
"Elder Brother Lu means Qin Haoran has eaten Immortal Peaches? How is that possible? If he had access to Immortal Peaches, he wouldn't have needed to take out a loan."
The capacity to extend one's lifespan without restrictions, such an item would be a hot commodity even at an auction for those in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
Lu Yang felt somewhat disheartened. Indeed, until now, Junior Brother Li hadn't even fully received Qin Haoran's memories, let alone those of the first life. He feared that even if Fairy Eternity herself were present in the flesh, he still wouldn't be able to recall the memories of his first life.

chapters.title: Chapter 895 - 894: The Uses of the Primordial Spirit
chapters.content:
After unsuccessfully attempting to awaken Li Haoran's first life memory, and taking the opportunity to repeatedly boast about his own advancement to the Spirit Transformation Stage, Lu Yang headed to the Scripture Pavilion with satisfaction.
Meanwhile, Li Haoran was forcefully hammering away at exotic metals, determined to catch up with Lu Yang's cultivation progress as soon as possible to prevent him from coming to boast in front of him again.
Not long ago, Lu Yang had visited the Scripture Pavilion to study various knowledge about Thunder Tribulation in preparation for passing it.
Regrettably, he didn't use any of the knowledge he learned when the time came to pass the tribulation.
As always, Lu Yang perused through the cultivation techniques, trying to draw inspiration from other methods to make them his own.
Most Divine Transformation Stage techniques focus on two aspects: one is how to utilize the full potential of the primordial spirit, such as Primordial Spirit Out of Body, Primordial Spirit Combat, and so on.
This was of little use to Lu Yang, as his primordial spirit was no different from a real person in flexibility; there was no need to deliberately cultivate further in this aspect.
The other focus was on how to effectively communicate with heaven and earth, a domain that Lu Yang had not been exposed to before and something every Divine Transformation Stage cultivator needed to do.
The more smoothly one communicates with heaven and earth, the easier it will be to advance to the Void Refinement Stage and the Body Integration Realm later on, and the easier it would be to establish rules subsequently.
The common methods for communicating with heaven and earth involve more interaction with nature, whether it be in the solitude of the mountains and forests or in bustling mortal realms; simply secluding oneself for cultivation wouldn't work.
Lu Yang clutched a stack of cultivation techniques, all carefully selected by him that might help him to further develop his own Divine Transformation level skills.
"This time, I won't let Eldest Senior Sister make any more changes no matter what!"
Lu Yang felt that as a Divine Transformation Stage cultivator capable of standing on his own, he should not rely on Eldest Senior Sister for everything.
It's just Divine Transformation Stage techniques, easily solved!
Divine Transformation Stage techniques were much more abstruse than those of the Nascent Soul Stage, and many cultivators who had just entered the Divine Transformation Stage needed to study several days just to understand one.
But Lu Yang was different; from the beginning of his cultivation journey, he had studied various techniques and had long since formed a system to understand them. Applying this system to any technique, he could get the gist of it.
Soon, Lu Yang was so exhausted that he lay sprawled across the desk.
"No good, there are still too many techniques." While understanding them posed no challenge, the vast amount of information contained in the techniques was enormous; after reading five books in a row, Lu Yang felt dizzy and sleepy.
"Why don't you try letting your primordial spirit help you read the techniques?" Fairy Eternity suggested.
"Can the primordial spirit be used for that?" When Lu Yang learned techniques, he had never seen any mention of such a use for the primordial spirit.
"This is none other than the Invincible Nascent Soul, how can it be on the same level as the primordial spirits of ordinary mortals?"
Lu Yang thought it wouldn't hurt to try and summoned his primordial spirit, which closely resembled himself, "Little Nascent, go find two reference Divine Transformation Stage techniques."
Not all techniques in use could serve as reference techniques, such as the Single Body Spiritual Root lineage which held no reference value—this was to test whether the primordial spirit had the ability to discern.
Quickly, the primordial spirit brought back a stack of techniques to Lu Yang, and upon inspection, they indeed were all techniques beneficial to him.
Lu Yang randomly selected a technique, "Take this, read it through."
The primordial spirit obediently sat down and concentrated, reading intently, analyzing the content and principles of the technique.
When the primordial spirit returned to Lu Yang's body, Lu Yang was amazed to find he had received all the learning content of his primordial spirit—but the downside was that he also received its fatigue.
"How about that, impressive isn't it?" Fairy Eternity gloated with pride; she had spent more than a month researching the uses of the primordial spirit and the more she researched, the more she found it to be extremely useful.
"Take advantage of it while you can," Fairy Eternity kindly reminded him. "Once you reach the Body Integration Realm and your Primordial Spirit unifies with you, you won't be able to use it anymore."
Back in her Nascent Soul Stage, she had taken quite a beating from the Invincible Nascent Soul. But once she reached the Divine Transformation Stage, she had her revenge.
"The primordial spirit can help you cultivate and help you learn, there are so many uses."
"It's indeed impressive," Lu Yang sincerely nodded. The time spent getting beaten up in the Nascent Soul Stage wasn't in vain, as his suffering finally paid off.
"Then go help me compile the Spirit Transformation stage of the 'Mind Seeing Method'," Lu Yang assigned his primordial spirit an important task that concerned his future destiny.
Lu Yang himself arranged three chairs against the wall, lied down on them, resting his arm under his head and crossing his legs, squinting his eyes to enjoy the quiet atmosphere of the Scripture Pavilion—utterly at ease.
"Right, Fairy, how did you manage to sever yourself with one strike, cutting off the Annihilation Dao Fruit Embryo?" Lu Yang asked curiously, feeling that Fairy Eternity was truly formidable, worthy of being the leader of the Five Ancient Immortals.
He had previously heard the Ying Tian Immortal praise Fairy Eternity's action, saying that none of the other four could compare to her, showcasing just how powerful Fairy Eternity really was, with no bluffing involved, truly deserving to be the leader of the Five Ancient Immortals and one of the great beauties of ancient times.
"Hmph, it was of course by splitting myself into a body at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage and a body that possessed the Annihilation Dao Fruit Outline, then using my tribulation body to sever the past!" Fairy Eternity lifted her chin slightly, clearly thinking her action at that time was extraordinary.
"Quick, tell me all about it—how did the battle go?" Lu Yang got excited. Fairy indeed lived up to her name, without a Dao Fruit Outline she could still beat her own self that had one.
"Well, this Immortal started by using the Playing Dead Technique, fell into a deep sleep, and then separated the Transcendance Tribulation Stage body from within. While the Annihilation Dao Fruit Embryo was playing dead, I cleanly, with a snap, finished her off!"
Lu Yang: "..."
How come the battle process isn't quite what I imagined?
Suddenly, Lu Yang shivered as if a great disaster was upon him. He opened his eyes sharply to see Eldest Senior Sister bending over to look at him, holding his primordial spirit in her hand.
"Junior Brother."
"Present!" Lu Yang jolted up to sit straight, holding his hands on his knees.
"Your primordial spirit just came to me, asking for help to continue writing your cultivation technique. Can you explain this?" Eldest Senior Sister spoke evenly, but the familiar Lu Yang already sensed trouble from her calm tone.
This doesn't look good!
Lu Yang glared at his primordial spirit, angry. I asked you to help me compile a cultivation technique, and you went looking for help from someone else!
"Uh, Eldest Senior Sister, if I say that it was all the primordial spirit's doing and had nothing to do with me, would you believe it?"
Eldest Senior Sister continued to look at Lu Yang calmly.
Lu Yang had no choice but to honestly explain that he had tasked his primordial spirit with learning and compiling a cultivation technique.
"An interesting primordial spirit, able to even learn cultivation technique on its own."
"However, Junior Brother, you must remember, the primordial spirit is there to assist you in learning the cultivation technique; you are the one in control."
"Yes!"
"Also, Immortal senior,"
"Present! Miss Yun, aren't you trying to say that you want this Immortal to supervise Little Yang? Don't worry, I guarantee it won't misuse the Primordial Spirit," Fairy Eternity said righteously, as if ready to sacrifice her own kin for justice.
"No, I mean you should stop helping Junior Brother with his cultivation. If this continues, I'm afraid his primordial spirit will change its nature."

chapters.title: Chapter 896 - 895 The Method of Communicating Heaven and Earth
chapters.content:
To tell the truth, Yun Zhi was shocked the first time she saw the primordial spirit. It looked eighty percent like Junior Brother Lu Yang and twenty percent like Fairy Eternity. Her first reaction was to think that Junior Brother had something going on with Fairy Eternity, such as a spiritual union of sorts.
Later, she realized that this was because Fairy Eternity had helped Junior Brother with his cultivation.
Even so, the appearance of the primordial spirit still gave her an odd feeling.
She felt that if Fairy Eternity continued to help Junior Brother with his cultivation, and the primordial spirit's appearance changed again, that odd feeling would only become stronger.
When in the Nascent Soul Stage it wasn't so conspicuous, since the Invincible Nascent Soul still looked quite young, and except for Lu Yang himself, others couldn't really tell whom the Invincible Nascent Soul resembled.
But it was different with the Divine Transformation Stage primordial spirit.
Considering this, Yun Zhi spoke out to prevent Fairy Eternity from further aiding Junior Brother's cultivation.
Of course, continuing the aid also seriously risked odd transformations.
Convinced by Eldest Senior Sister's earnest guidance, Lu Yang had no choice but to give up the idea of vengefully using the primordial spirit, instead treating it better and letting it help him learn cultivation techniques.
Lu Yang and his primordial spirit studying cultivation techniques together doubled the efficiency.
And doubled the exhaustion as well.
However, with Revival Pills at hand, even doubled levels of exhaustion were a minor issue.
These were special Revival Pills that refreshed the mind, complete with Elixir Patterns and Elixir Clouds, the finest among Revival Pills.
Lu Yang had made such immense contributions to the Seek Dao Sect that he had a vast number of contribution points to spend. He bought the top-quality Revival Pills in bulk, which was quite extravagant.
Considering the single taste of the Revival Pills and the potential for disgust if consumed over a long period, in front of Lu Yang were several small dishes with dips like broad bean paste, fermented tofu, chili sauce, and leek flower sauce... Whatever flavor he wanted, he could have.
If he ever wanted a dipping sauce that wasn't stored in his Identity Jade, he would simply send his primordial spirit to the shopping district to buy it, which was very convenient.
When the primordial spirit returned, it was stopped at the door for carrying food.
Going downstairs, Lu Yang realized his primordial spirit was holding a bunch of skewers, which was not in the instructions.
Needless to say, this was surely something the people from the Eternity Sect had given to the primordial spirit in an attempt to curry favor with him.
Lu Yang had stayed in the Scripture Pavilion the entire time, taking only three breaks.
The finest Revival Pills weren't magic; overuse would dilute their effectiveness, so Lu Yang had to slow down his learning progress and lie down in a chair to sleep.
The primordial spirit also had the fortune to rest alongside its master.
Fairy Eternity had also, rare as it was, not caused any ruckus in the Spiritual Space, providing Lu Yang with a quiet resting place.
In the blink of an eye, a month and a half had passed, and the fascinating principles of the Divinity Transformation Stage cultivation techniques had gathered in Lu Yang's mind. From ancient techniques to the present, he was like a mobile treasury of cultivation methods.
Lu Yang spent another half a month breaking down those principles, trying to integrate them with the "Mind Seeing Method" Nascent Soul chapter.
"I can write the cultivation technique now!"
In those two months, Lu Yang was like having a dialogue with cultivators from thirty thousand years past and future, discussing the meanings of techniques, and exploring the significance of cultivation, which brought him significant gains. He was rejuvenated from the inside out, and even his speech and manner were different from before.
Lu Yang revealed a confident smile. Indeed, the wisdom of his predecessors should not be underestimated; it gave him a lot of inspiration.
The primordial spirit set up the brush, ink, paper, and inkstone, grinding and handing over the brush. With brush in hand, Lu Yang wrote fluently as if divinely assisted in one go, thoroughly enjoying it. The understandings of those two months merged and flowed into the cultivation technique.
"It's perfectly accomplished!"
...
"Your cultivation technique needs to be completely rewritten," Yun Zhi said heartlessly and coolly.
"What?"
Seeing the astonished look on Lu Yang's face, Yun Zhi sighed and explained, "Junior Brother, it's commendable that you study others' techniques to assimilate their strengths, but you've forgotten the unique aspects of your own Divinity Transformation Stage."
"Special property, my primordial spirit?"
"Yes, the most important aspect of the Divine Transformation Stage Cultivation Technique is how it allows you to communicate with heaven and earth."
"Your technique includes things like worldly experiences, comprehending the vicissitudes of life, playing the zither by the brook, and so on. These methods are useful, but you can have even better ones."
"What are they?"
"Are you aware that at the brink of death, a cultivator's perceptive abilities can expand infinitely? Even ordinary people on the verge of death can perceive ghosts and other phenomena they couldn't before, let alone cultivators."
Lu Yang shuddered, "You mean to keep me in a near-death state?"
Yun Zhi shook her head, "That's too dangerous. From what I've observed, when your primordial spirit returns to your body, the sensations sync with you."
Lu Yang's eyes lit up, understanding Eldest Senior Sister's point, "Eldest Senior Sister, you mean to have my primordial spirit die in my place?"
"Not to die, but to keep your primordial spirit in a near-death state," Yun Zhi corrected him; there was a difference between the two.
Lu Yang nodded repeatedly, almost the same idea.
"Shall we give it a try?" Lu Yang said excitedly, summoning his primordial spirit and commanding it not to flee from any danger it might encounter.
Yun Zhi nodded lightly to signal that Lu Yang should step back, then aimed a palm strike at the primordial spirit that remained in its place.
If not for Lu Yang's command, the primordial spirit would have fled long ago.
Even before her hand reached the primordial spirit, it became dim as if it were under some immense pressure and extremely weakened.
Seeing this, Yun Zhi stopped her attack, signaling that Lu Yang could recall his primordial spirit.
Had she exerted any more force, the Junior Brother's primordial spirit would have collapsed.
The moment the primordial spirit returned, Lu Yang knelt on the ground, taking deep breaths, inheriting the spirit's sensations.
The palm strike had been terrifying; even if he had cultivated to the Divinity Transformation Stage, he would still feel like an ant facing a mountain—such was the insurmountable gap.
Lu Yang's consciousness blurred, the world spinning around him, his eyes rolled back, and he collapsed to the ground, eyes void of life.
At this moment, his perceptive abilities intensified limitlessly. He could hear the sound of spiritual essence traversing within his body, sense the movement of Spiritual Energy weaving through tree leaves, feel the solemnity of Sky Gate Mountain...
Even listening to Third Senior Sister play the zither had never been as clear.
As Lu Yang gradually regained consciousness, he realized this was the communication with heaven and earth he sought. If he were to undergo this process several more times, his perception of the world's changes would become even clearer.
Yun Zhi took a drop of water from her Identity Jade, carried it on a leaf, and fed it to Lu Yang.
The origin of this water was unknown, but after taking it, Lu Yang felt his consciousness become much clearer.
"How does it feel?"
"It works!" Lu Yang laughed.
A near-death state without danger—how many Divine Transformation Stage Cultivators would envy this.
The only downside was that it couldn't be done consecutively; his primordial spirit was severely damaged and needed time to recover quietly.
The strong would stop at nothing to become stronger; Lu Yang didn't mind sacrificing his primordial spirit in the slightest.
"As long as it works," Yun Zhi said, nodding as he had expected, "You need to incorporate this method into your technique. With this..."
"My technique is considered complete then?"
"With this, there's only sixty percent of your technique that needs modifying."
Lu Yang: "..."
Isn't that still a failing grade?

chapters.title: Chapter 897 - 896 Learning the Playing Dead Technique
chapters.content:
Considering that the remaining sixty percent of the cultivation technique was difficult to revise and not something that could be understood by the junior brother with just a couple of pointers—for it would complicate matters and potentially hinder Junior Brother Lu's growth—Yun Zhi felt it was simpler and more efficient to make the modifications herself.
"Leave the matter of the cultivation technique to me," she said.
Upon hearing that he did not need to modify the cultivation technique, Lu Yang quietly breathed a sigh of relief. Having the Eldest Senior Sister around was such a blessing, there wasn't even a need to worry about cultivation techniques.
Wait, didn't I resolve before to complete the cultivation technique on my own without needing the Eldest Senior Sister's help?
Lu Yang was conflicted for a moment but felt he shouldn't let down the Eldest Senior Sister's kind intentions. It was best not to bring it up again to avoid straining their sibling relationship. If others heard about it, they might think he wanted to establish his own sect.
"Little Yang, didn't you say you wanted to complete your cultivation technique by yourself? Why have you handed it over to Miss Yun?"
"..."
"Well, Little Yang, why aren't you speaking?"
If the Fairy keeps asking, she'll lose a key minister of the Great Bean Dynasty.
To divert Fairy Eternity's attention, Lu Yang quickly changed the subject, "By the way, Fairy, can one comprehend the universe by using the Playing Dead Technique?"
"Of course not, silly. The Playing Dead Technique causes one to enter a state of death—you'd simply die. Comprehending the universe requires entering a near-death state, which is a different matter altogether."
Fairy Eternity's eyes sparkled as she moved closer to Lu Yang, "Little Yang, are you interested in the Playing Dead Technique? Do you want to learn it?"
"The Playing Dead Technique is a magic skill that I take great pride in. If you learn it, I guarantee you won't regret it. Only those close to me are qualified to learn it."
"Look at Xiao Ling and Lianyi, although they're Outer Gate Disciples, they are deeply favored by me. I've made an exception and taught them the technique."
"Then there's Sha Meless. Even though he's an Inner Gate Servant Disciple, he lacks the fate with immortals, so I won't teach him!"
This was the first time Lu Yang had heard about Servant Disciples within the inner gate. Does our Immortal Lineage even need people to do odd jobs?
Lu Yang initially wanted to refuse. The Playing Dead Technique didn't suit the dashing image of a Sword Cultivator like himself, but he couldn't bring himself to reject the Fairy when he looked into her pleading eyes.
"Alright, I'll learn it."
"Come, call me 'teacher' and let me hear it," said Fairy Eternity, delighted. This was the first time Little Yang was learning a magic skill from her, making her his teacher as well.
If Little Yang were a second-generation Bean Emperor, then she would be considered the Emperor's Teacher.
To appear more like a teacher, Fairy Eternity specifically put on a set of dark, wide scholarly robes and held two books in her hand, looking quite erudite.
Lu Yang's brows twitched at the sight, but then he thought if he were to learn knowledge from Fairy Eternity, indeed, he should call her 'teacher.'
Thus, following the student's understanding, he cupped his hands and respectfully called out, "Teacher."
"You won't lose out as a disciple of mine. Back then, I was a teacher to the Barbarian tribe, and people respectfully addressed me as 'Barbarian Master'. By becoming my disciple, you're equivalent to being of the same generation as the Barbarians from Ancient Times, a very senior lineage."
...So now I'm not only Man Gu's Senior Brother but also his ancestor?
"Teacher, can we wait until the Eldest Senior Sister has finished revising the cultivation technique before learning the Playing Dead Technique?"
Lu Yang felt it was more reliable to have the Eldest Senior Sister overseeing the situation.
"Sure."
Having just become an Emperor's Teacher, Fairy Eternity was in high spirits and agreed to whatever Little Yang suggested.
About two hours later, the "Mind Seeing Method" Spirit Transformation chapter was handed to Lu Yang.
Lu Yang carefully read through it, feeling ashamed of his inferior version. The Eldest Senior Sister used precise wording and concise sentences, something he was far from capable of replicating.
He faintly understood that this wasn't a cultivation technique written out of thin air by the Eldest Senior Sister, but rather, she had painstakingly revised his inadequate work, following his train of thought—clearly a laborious task.
After running through a complete cycle of the technique, he felt a smooth flow without any obstruction, indicating that this technique was a perfect fit for him.
"Don't rush the matter of the cultivation technique, Junior Brother. You will be able to write one without my help someday," she said.
"I'll work hard!" Lu Yang's fighting spirit was high, and he swore that next time he would not let Eldest Senior Sister worry over his creation of cultivation techniques again!
"By the way, Eldest Senior Sister, Fairy is going to teach me the Playing Dead Technique soon."
"Playing Dead Technique?" Yun Zhi was also very interested in this magic skill. It had played a significant role in keeping Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi alive up to this point.
Previously, when Jiang Lianyi challenged herself, she relied on the Playing Dead Technique to tie with her, which could be called a divine skill.
Soon, Mr. Eternity began the lesson, and as a student, Lu Yang sat upright with a solemn demeanor, while Yun Zhi, with her legs up, drank tea and listened in.
"The so-called Playing Dead Technique is a supreme magic skill that I created, related to life and death, time, and causality. It is quite difficult to comprehend. Back then, Xiao Ling and Lianyi put in a lot of effort just to barely learn it."
"However, I believe that with your magic skill talent, Little Yang, plus my instruction, learning it should not be difficult."
"The Playing Dead Technique is a technique of deceiving the heavens, and to deceive the heavens, one must first deceive oneself."
"...One must have a heart seeking death, a heart like dead ashes, maintaining this mindset is the only way to deceive everyone and sever causality."
"...One must also retain a glimmer of life, which is key to reviving from death."
Speaking of her familiar knowledge, Fairy Eternity was spirited, gesticulating passionately, and both Lu Yang and Yun Zhi listened intently, greatly satisfying Fairy Eternity's heart as a teacher.
The only shortcoming was that Fairy Eternity's thoughts were very jumpy, and sometimes she veered to another point while speaking.
Fortunately, Lu Yang was not new to Mr. Eternity and had long been familiar with her way of speaking, so he could easily follow her train of thought and learn, saving a lot of trouble.
"How about it, Little Yang, have you learned it?"
"I could give it a try." Lu Yang felt that he had learned enough to give it a shot.
"Little Yang, you can do it!"
Lu Yang took a couple of deep breaths to calm his emotions and blocked out Fairy Eternity's loud cheering to fully immerse himself in the mindset of seeking death.
Following Mr. Eternity's guidance, he circulated the Profound Skill, silently reciting the incantation, and hid the glimmer of life within his heart that sought death.
Lu Yang felt his consciousness growing heavier and lacked even the strength to open his eyes, eventually darkness overtook his vision, and he lost consciousness.
"Does this count as a success?" Yun Zhi turned to ask Fairy Eternity.
The founder of the Playing Dead Technique, Fairy Eternity, scrutinized Lu Yang's 'dead' appearance carefully: "From the outside, it looks quite convincing. It's best to put him through a test of some sort."
"Such as?"
"For example, when Lianyi used the Playing Dead Technique, Xiao Ling woke her up with a torch. You could try something similar."
Yun Zhi raised her hand, and a golden flame appeared in her palm, radiating terrifying heat and a destructive aura. She hesitated over whether to scorch her Junior Brother or not.
But what if she ended up harming him?
As Yun Zhi wavered, a figure dashed towards her, seeking her out urgently.
"Eldest Senior Sister, it's terrible, Junior Brother Lu is dead!" Dai Bufan came running with an extinguished Soul Lamp; when the lamp is out, so is the life. Seeing that Lu Yang's Soul Lamp had gone out had scared him into urgently finding Yun Zhi to discuss what to do!
Then he saw Lu Yang lying lifeless on the ground, and Eldest Senior Sister holding the destructing golden flame, ready to reduce Lu Yang to ash.
"Eldest Senior Sister, what are you..."
Dai Bufan swallowed hard, feeling as though he had stumbled upon a murder scene, and began to stealthily retreat, preparing to run away.
Yun Zhi hesitated for a moment and then explained, "What if I told you, Junior Brother killed himself, would you believe me?"
Dai Bufan: "..."
You guess whether I believe it or not?

chapters.title: Chapter 898 - 897: Back from the Dead
chapters.content:
Eldest Senior Sister's words couldn't possibly be false.
"Of course, I believe that Junior Brother Lu committed suicide," Dai Bufan forced a smile, his legs trembling, never having felt death so close.
This looked like Eldest Senior Sister had accidentally killed Junior Brother Lu and was trying to destroy the corpse to eliminate evidence, and here I was, foolish enough to come over and express my concern for Lu Yang.
Had I lived long enough, considering the predicament I am in, it's difficult to even save myself!
Indeed, this Immortal Peach wasn't so easy to obtain; just moments after receiving it and owing Junior Brother Lu a favor, now I have to pay with my life. Could this be what they call the inevitability of causality?
"Then Eldest Senior Sister, please carry on with your work. If you need me, just call for me."
Dai Bufan stealthily retreated, taking advantage of Yun Zhi's distraction, and ran for his life as fast as he could without daring to look back.
"Wait, come back."
Yun Zhi couldn't let Dai Bufan escape; if she didn't clarify things now, it would be even harder to explain in the future.
Yun Zhi had a thought and pulled Dai Bufan back, even retracing his original path.
"Eldest Senior Sister, please have mercy, I really didn't see anything!" Dai Bufan, sensing danger, immediately knelt down and begged for mercy.
Yun Zhi covered her forehead in exasperation and explained, "Junior Brother truly isn't dead; he's just in a state of playing dead, but he played dead too well, fooling even the Soul Lamp."
Dai Bufan had never heard of such a magic skill, but as the saying goes, "The fish on the chopping block cannot choose but to accept its fate." He believed everything Yun Zhi said.
Fairy Eternity had sensed Dai Bufan's arrival quite early, and out of the need to prevent outsiders from knowing about her, she immediately hid herself.
Yun Zhi could have sensed Dai Bufan's arrival too, but at that time, she was conflicted about whether to burn Junior Brother, which momentarily distracted her.
If I had known about Junior Brother Dai's arrival, I would have definitely hidden Junior Brother's corpse... but why does that still seem not quite right?
Yun Zhi pondered, feeling like there was no correct way to handle the situation.
When Yun Zhi approached Lu Yang with the golden flame in hand, before the fire even touched him, Lu Yang sprang up as if resurrected, with a loud shout.
The Soul Lamp in Dai Bufan's hand reignited.
"It's really just playing dead?!"
Dai Bufan was shocked, never expecting such a miraculous magic skill that could even deceive the Soul Lamp. Was it a long-lost ancient skill, or one created by Eldest Senior Sister?
Dai Bufan secretly breathed a sigh of relief, it seemed he didn't have to die after all.
"Junior Brother Lu, are you alright?"
Lu Yang grimaced in pain; he had been sleeping deeply and suddenly felt his soul burning, which startled him awake.
By the time he came to, the burning sensation had vanished.
"No, no problem, Elder Brother Dai, what brings you here?"
Dai Bufan thought to himself that he came to be a funeral offering.
"You're really okay? Maybe you should take a look at your current state," Dai Bufan examined Lu Yang from top to bottom, his expression turning strange.
"My current state?" Lu Yang was puzzled, not understanding Elder Brother Dai's meaning. He looked down and discovered his body lying properly on the ground, while he himself was experiencing astral projection!
If Elder Brother Dai weren't there, Lu Yang would have really liked to ask Fairy Eternity what was going on.
"It's a minor issue, indeed nothing serious." Lu Yang waved his hand, indicating everything was under control.
Seeing that Lu Yang was mostly fine, Dai Bufan left, still somewhat suspicious.
Once Dai Bufan was gone, Lu Yang leaned back, attempting to merge with his physical body.
Unfortunately, he failed. After standing up, he was still in a state of astral projection.
"Fairy, can you come out and explain what's going on here?"
Fairy Eternity emerged from behind a large tree, praising Lu Yang's talent for magic skills, "Little Yang, you have started learning the basics!"
Lu Yang pointed to his own soul, and then pointed to the body on the ground, "Are you sure this is what you call basic?"
"Of course, what is the Playing Dead Technique? It's a technique that deceives the heavens. To deceive the universe, you must first deceive yourself."
"Your physical body is now in a deceived state, turned into a corpse!"
"If you don't believe me, have Miss Yun try the Corpse-Driving Spell, I guarantee it will move your body."
Lu Yang dared not say he didn't believe it.
"The way you are now, you could even swindle insurance and certainly make a fortune."
"So what you're experiencing is not astral projection but should be called wandering lost soul and wild ghost," Fairy Eternity corrected Lu Yang's misunderstanding with rather precise terms.
"Your learning progress is much faster than Xiao Ling and Lianyi's. When they first started learning, what they were practicing couldn't really be called the Playing Dead Technique but rather something like Pretending to Sleep. They were pretending so badly that I couldn't even tell they were pretending to be asleep."
Eldest Senior Sister, observing Lu Yang, nodded slightly, "I see. You fooled the Soul Lamp, fooled Dai Bufan, and even fooled your own body. It seems, Junior Brother, that you could deceive Pass Tribulation Cultivators."
Eldest Senior Sister could see that when Lu Yang performed the Playing Dead Technique, there was a faint trace of life force within his soul, a level of life force that even Transcendance Tribulation Cultivators couldn't see through.
"Fairy, don't praise me just yet. First, tell me how I should return to my original state," Lu Yang asked calmly, not getting carried away by Fairy Eternity's compliments.
"Simple, just possess yourself."
"Possess?"
Just as Lu Yang was about to ask whom he should possess, he looked down and saw his own body quietly lying on the ground.
"Of course, you're going to possess yourself," said Fairy Eternity as she circled Lu Yang's body, her tone as enthusiastic as if she were promoting slow-moving merchandise: "Look how well your soul fits with your body; it's as if they were made for each other. There will be no feeling of rejection when you possess your own body!"
Lu Yang: "..."
I admit your words make sense, Fairy, but could you please stop talking?
Although Lu Yang hadn't systematically learned how to possess a body, as someone who frequently ended up being possessed by Fairy Eternity, he had learned after going through it a couple of times.
He activated his Profound Skill and merged with his body, successfully possessing himself.
Fairy Eternity, with arms akimbo, said proudly, "Humph, now you know why I'm so adept at possessing you. It's all because of the practice I got while developing the Playing Dead Technique!"
Lu Yang wasn't very clear where the Fairy's pride was coming from.
"Is this how the Playing Dead Technique is performed?" Eldest Senior Sister murmured to herself, attempting to run her Profound Skill, sitting in the Emperor's Chair with no signs of life.
Just then, a spatial gate opened, and the Vast Sea Daoist Lord rushed in with a Soul Lamp, hurriedly checking the situation.
"Is Yun Zhi in trouble?"
The moment he arrived, he saw Yun Zhi sitting on the Emperor's Chair, with her life force dissipated, not a trace to be detected.
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord breathed a sigh of relief, "So, she was pretending to be dead."
Lu Yang, puzzled, "Grandmaster, you know about the Playing Dead Technique too?"
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord was confused, "What Playing Dead Technique?"
"Then how could you tell she was pretending to be dead?"
The Vast Sea Daoist Lord rolled his eyes, "She has no injuries anywhere on her body, hasn't been through any fight, nor does it seem like something went wrong while running a Cultivation Technique, if she's not pretending to be dead, could it be that you killed her?"

chapters.title: Chapter 899 - 898: The Invitation of Sword Tower
chapters.content:
Frankly, when Vast Sea Daoist Lord discovered that Yun Zhi's Soul Lamp had extinguished, he trembled in fear.
If even Yun Zhi had fallen, what level of enemy could this be?
Fortunately, when he arrived, he discovered that Yun Zhi was pretending to be dead.
"Thank goodness she was only playing dead."
Lu Yang also felt that Vast Sea Ancestral Master made sense, considering anyone able to silently obliterate Eldest Senior Sister would be an unimaginable existence, far beyond what one could fathom.
Wait a minute, silently obliterating Eldest Senior Sister... why does that sound so familiar?
He hastily asked Fairy Eternity, who was hiding in the Spiritual Space, "Fairy, you didn't happen to use the Playing Dead Technique back then and then get taken out by a sneak attack, did you?"
"That's impossible. My Playing Dead Technique was perfected back then, so why would I use it for no reason?"
"Moreover, I can't remember what happened during that time; my mind was a mess, something else must have occurred, unrelated to the Playing Dead Technique."
Lu Yang thought about it and agreed; the Playing Dead Technique didn't cause amnesia.
"Do you know how to wake her up from playing dead?" Although Vast Sea Daoist Lord knew Yun Zhi was pretending to be dead, he still felt anxious staring at Yun Zhi's body.
"From my experience with playing dead, if you attack Eldest Senior Sister and make her feel threatened, she'll wake up."
Vast Sea Daoist Lord fell silent for a moment, sensing the difficulty of the task.
He looked around at the people nearby, only Lu Yang was there.
Compared to others, it seemed more feasible if he did it himself.
Vast Sea Daoist Lord gritted his teeth: "I'll try!"
In his chest appeared a fruit, both hidden and apparent, shaped like an apple, its color indiscernible, frantically churning the embryonic Spatial Dao Fruit.
An endless force of space gathered in his palm, seemingly capable of tearing heaven and earth apart, destabilizing the entire space; Lu Yang, standing beside him, felt as if he was about to be torn to pieces just by looking!
Yun Zhi, seated on Emperor's Throne Mountain, slowly opened her eyes and glanced at Vast Sea Daoist Lord.
"Is she really awake?" Vast Sea Daoist Lord excitedly dispersed the space force in his hands.
His most powerful attack had actually threatened Yun Zhi; had he become so strong without realizing it?
"Eldest Senior Sister, how do you feel?" Lu Yang hurriedly stepped forward to ask.
Yun Zhi hesitated for a moment, then said, "I felt my clothes were about to be damaged, so I woke up. Do you know what's going on, Junior Brother?"
Vast Sea Daoist Lord: "..."
He cleared his throat twice, warning Lu Yang with his eyes not to speak of what just happened, then opened a portal through space and fled.
Another half month passed in a flash; Lu Yang had been diligently sitting in meditation and cultivating without the slightest slack.
"Junior Brother, you have a letter." Lu Yang looked up and was surprised to find it was Third Senior Sister looking for him.
"A letter?"
"Mmm, when I descended the mountain, I happened to run into a Junior Brother who originally came looking for you at Sky Gate Mountain," Yun Zhi told Lu Yang. "He said there was a letter from the Sword Tower for you. Since I was on my way, I took it."
"A letter from the Sword Tower?"
Lu Yang was somewhat curious. It seemed that he didn't have much interaction with the Sword Tower, but his master's generation had quite a bit to do with them.
The envelope had a sword piercing the heavens drawn on its front—a symbol of the Sword Tower. Every disciple of the Sword Tower bore this emblem on their chest, which was supposedly personally designed by the Sword Tower Supreme.
"Let me see, the letter says that the Sword Tower is going to hold the centennial Sword Festival and has invited all sword cultivators from across the world to participate."
"Ah, the Sword Festival. Given the timing, it should indeed be held around now."
The Sword Festival, a prestigious event that showcased the Sword Tower's status in swordsmanship, would be attended by sword cultivators from Great Xia, the East Sea, the Demon Territory, and Buddha Country. The excitement was sure to be extraordinary, and in the hearts of sword cultivators, it was an honor they must experience at least once in their lives.
"Just in time. The Dark Moon Sword can hardly keep up with my cultivation level anymore. It would be good to visit the Sword Tower; they probably sell swords there."
The Dark Moon Sword was forged using a sword array that belonged to the Qilin Immortal, a celestial-level array. However, the Qilin Immortal, whose mind had been scrambled by the Yingtian Immortal, crafted it with Immortal Gold, rendering the array's material quite ordinary.
Now that Lu Yang's cultivation had greatly surpassed it, if he wielded the Dark Moon Sword with full force, he feared he might break it.
Although he could have asked his Eldest Senior Sister to find him a sword, as a man born to this world, Lu Yang couldn't depend on his Eldest Senior Sister for everything.
He could request Li Haoran to forge a sharp sword with materials he gathered, but considering that Lu Yang often liked to show off his cultivation in front of Li Haoran, asking for his help now carried a tinge of embarrassment.
"Then let's make the trip and witness the sword cultivators from all over the world," Lu Yang said with glee.
Having been cultivating within the sect all this time had been exceptionally dull. Finally, he had a reason to go out.
There was still a month left until the Sword Festival. Time was not pressing; the Sword Tower was located in Shu State, a great distance from Seek Dao Sect, halfway across Great Xia. Flying there would take half a month—it was a bit early to leave now.
Lu Yang, worried about potential incidents along the way, preferred to go ahead of time.
Before departing, Lu Yang thoroughly checked his items—Revitalizing Pills, Great Recovery Pills, Green Peak Sword, Seven Star Sword Set, Spirit Stones, Fairy Eternity...
"All set, time to set off!"
Since the Sword Tower was too far from Seek Dao Sect for even those at the Spirit Transformation Stage to fly in one go, Lu Yang chose a slower flying boat that required less effort and was more comfortable.
On the flying boat, a young lady from some household clamored that she fancied Lu Yang's seat and was ready to offer him Spirit Stones to purchase his spot. Just then, a chivalrous young man stepped forward, criticizing the lady for being overbearing and bullying others with her status. When she found herself unable to out-argue the young man, she signaled her bodyguards to teach him a lesson.
Unexpectedly, the young man, though appearing weak in cultivation, was exceptionally strong in combat and easily defeated the two bodyguards with higher cultivation levels. He even spanked the haughty lady, causing her cheeks to burn red with shame and her glances toward the young man to change; no one had ever dared lay a hand on her before.
Soon after, the flying boat docked at a large city where the local government office arrested both the young lady and her two bodyguards on charges of disturbing the peace, and the young man on charges of indecent behavior.
Lu Yang also noticed both the young lady and the young man had arranged marriages; she was on the way to meet her betrothed, a man from an impoverished family she had never met, while he was on the way to meet his affianced, a sudden heiress he had never met before.
There were also two daoist characters on the flying boat, an old and a young one, both in ragged attire. The old daoist had a wine gourd at his waist and staggered as he walked, reeking of alcohol and possibly not having bathed for a long time; his scent was mingled with stench.
The young daoist, still with a youthful voice, had to jog to keep up with the old daoist's pace while calling him 'Master'. Fellow passengers looked at the odorous old daoist with disgust while covering their noses, but the old man seemed unconcerned with their stares and was quite content.
Eventually, a passenger unable to tolerate the old daoist's stench decided to 'educate' him, completely unaware that the seemingly unremarkable old man was an accomplished Unification-stage cultivator simply enjoying the mortal world. What was more unexpected was that the complaining passenger was also a Unification-stage cultivator, similarly enjoying the mortal coils.
It wasn't long before the two high-level cultivators began to fight.
Lu Yang approached the young daoist and mentioned that if he considered finding a new master, he could come to their Seek Dao Sect, where people valued hygiene greatly.
After the battle concluded, thinking that perhaps the airs of the cabin weren't auspicious, Lu Yang decided to pay extra for the luxury cabin.
Soon, there was tragic news from the luxury cabin; someone had been murdered at night. The other twelve passengers in the same cabin could provide alibis for one another, and no one knew who was responsible.
Lu Yang thought it best not to change cabins after all.

chapters.title: Chapter 900 - 899: Which Family's Young Lady Are You From?
chapters.content:
The child sitting next to Lu Yang perked up with a look of keen interest, "A murder case? I've solved a few tricky cases back in my hometown. I wonder if I'll be able to crack this one."
Considering it might not just be bad feng shui in this cabin but the entire flying ship, Lu Yang decided to disembark and fly to the Sword Tower. Consider the later ship ticket money down the drain.
However, there were a few accidents along the way, such as stumbling upon a secret realm that opens once every millennium, encountering a young lady from an influential family who was dissatisfied with an arranged marriage and used Lu Yang as a shield, and other minor incidents that turned a half-month journey into a month to reach the Sword Tower, arriving just in time.
Feeling the thick humidity of Shu State, Lu Yang couldn't help but remark, "Thank goodness I set off early, otherwise I wouldn't have made it in time for the Sword Inquiry Ceremony."
"...Is it possible that you wouldn't have encountered these issues if you had left a day later?" Fairy Eternity couldn't help but ask.
"Makes sense, I'll leave a day later when the Sword Tower holds the Sword Inquiry Ceremony again in a hundred years." Lu Yang was meticulous in his methods, understanding that to conduct an experiment, he needed to control variables, changing only one condition at a time.
The Sword Inquiry Ceremony is a major event of the Cultivation World, with many cultivators from beyond Great Xia attending. The officials of Shu State took this very seriously. If they could take this opportunity to convince some sword cultivators to stay in Shu State, it would be a splendid political achievement.
Ever since flying cars became popular, many sword cultivators have switched from flying with swords to flying with flying cars. Upon entering Shu State, Lu Yang saw many flying cars accompanying him.
Quite a few sword cultivators gave sidelong glances, even turning back to look at Lu Yang as they flew away.
After all, they hadn't seen anyone flying with a Sword-Washing Pond before, a novel sight indeed.
Lu Yang didn't mind the impolite actions of these sword cultivators, since the patent rights for the flying cars were in his hands. This meant that these sword cultivators had essentially paid him with Spirit Stones, considering them guests.
Towards guests, Lu Yang always had a good attitude, which was evident from the time he ran a barbecue restaurant.
"Let's go eat hotpot."
Once at the destination, there was no need to rush anymore. It was time to settle down and enjoy the local cuisine; otherwise, wouldn't the trip to Shu State be wasted?
This was a habit Lu Yang had learned from his Eldest Senior Sister.
Hotpot is ubiquitous in Shu State, each one claiming to be the authentic taste, an excellent flavor, and a reputed old-brand among the locals.
In the street full of hotpot restaurants, seeing a barbecue restaurant standing strong proves how delicious the barbarian tribe's recipe combined with the Three Flavored True Fire and Pure Yang True Fire is, carving out a path for itself here.
Tripe, beef slices, catfish, duck blood, and dried bean curd... ingredients in small dishes piled up on the table. Lu Yang added what he liked into the Nine Palaces grid, the spicy aroma wafting through the air.
"Hello, I see you've ordered so much; you might not be able to finish it all. Could I maybe have some?" A woman dressed casually stood in front of Lu Yang's table, her tone hesitant as she eagerly eyed the boiling hotpot.
Lu Yang looked up and saw he was being addressed by an extremely beautiful woman, her appearance second to none compared to Junior Sister Tao, and she had a great figure to boot, curvaceous in all the right places. The only issue was, he didn't know her.
Lu Yang initially wanted to say that he, as a cultivator, could finish all the food, but seeing the woman's pitiful look, his heart softened and he changed his mind at the last moment.
"Then sit down and join me."
Lu Yang signaled to the shop assistant, "Shopkeeper, another pair of chopsticks here, and one more dipping sauce, please!"
Lu Yang sighed with relief, glad that Old Meng wasn't here—his luck might have changed.
"Thank you, thank you so much," the breathtakingly beautiful woman thanked him profusely.
"Which family's young lady are you? Run away from home and forgotten your money?" Lu Yang asked with a smile. Although the woman seemed penniless, her clothes were quite costly, surely belonging to a well-off household. She must be a young lady from an influential family who sneaked out and forgot to bring money.
Lu Yang had encountered such people before, having once met a wealthy young lady disguised as a little beggar, covered in grime, sneaking onto a flying boat. She was discovered by the merchants, and a kind-hearted young man paid for her.
Seeing Lu Yang's misunderstanding, the woman hurriedly explained in panic, "Forgot to bring money? No, no, it's just that I forgot we need to use money outside. Where I come from, we don't use money at all."
"It seems your family has protected you well, not having to spend money on a regular basis," Lu Yang teased casually.
"We can eat now."
As soon as the woman heard they could eat, she imitated Lu Yang's movements and skillfully picked up a slice of beef covered in chili, dipped it into the oil, put it in her mouth, and showed an expression of bliss.
Seeing this, Lu Yang couldn't help but laugh, "You can't be serious, you've never eaten this before?"
He admitted that the hot pot in Shu State was delicious, but it wasn't to the extent of warranting such an exaggerated reaction.
The woman's cheeks turned red with the teasing, and she smiled sheepishly, "Indeed, I've never eaten anything like this before."
"I came out just to eat this; it's really delicious."
The woman clearly loved the hot pot, and the expression she showed made Lu Yang doubt for a moment whether they were even eating the same thing. Passersby saw the beautiful woman eating so joyfully, pleasing to the eye, and couldn't help but walk into the shop, making the already packed hot pot restaurant even more crowded.
The two of them ate heartily, finishing off with two bowls of ice jelly for dessert.
"Shop Assistant, check please, and bring two more hot pot base blocks."
"What are hot pot base blocks? Can you eat them?" the woman asked, puzzled.
Lu Yang shook his head and smiled, "You can't eat them directly, I'm buying a couple to take back for my Eldest Senior Sister to try."
The Eldest Senior Sister always liked to try local specialties whenever she came to a new place and would take some home if possible.
"I'm headed to the Sword Tower shortly, what do you plan to do, Miss?"
Lu Yang was somewhat concerned for the woman, unclear on how her family had protected her or how she had managed to get out. She seemed so naive and without common sense, and on top of that, she was so beautiful. Leaving her here alone, if something happened, Lu Yang would find it unbearable.
After thinking for a moment, the woman who indeed knew very little about the outside world, felt that Lu Yang seemed like a good person. With nothing urgent to attend to, she figured she might as well follow him and learn something about the wider world.
"May I come with you?" the woman asked tentatively.
"That's fine, but once the Sword Inquiry Festival is over, I'll have to take you home," Lu Yang replied, as he couldn't let the woman follow him around indefinitely.
In the Spiritual Space, he already had one silly charm, and he definitely couldn't add another.
"Then I thank you, fellow cultivator," the woman said earnestly.
"By the way, we've talked for so long but I still don't know your name, how should I address you? My name is Lu Yang." Lu Yang offered his own name, which was now widely recognized among the cultivators.
The woman did not show the surprise or shock Lu Yang expected, as if she had never heard his name, and introduced herself with a sweet smile:
"So you're Fellow Cultivator Lu Yang, I'm Yun Mengmeng."
"So you're Miss Yun... Wait a second, what did you say your name was?"

chapters.title: Chapter 901 - 900: Your Name is the Same as a Big Shot's
chapters.content:
"My name is Yun Mengmeng," Yun Mengmeng said, feeling that Lu Yang's reaction to her name was a bit strange, as if he had heard it somewhere before.
Really named Yun Mengmeng?
Isn't that the alias Eldest Senior Sister used when she pretended to be the Heavenly Court Sect Master?
Lu Yang looked closely at Miss Yun and thought to himself, your name is interesting; it coincides with the alias of our Eldest Senior Sister.
"Do you know me?" Yun Meng Meng asked hesitantly, feeling that the way Lu Yang was sizing her up didn't seem very benign.
"I don't know you, but I've heard your name before. It's the same as that of a very important person. If you use this name outside, you could easily cause some misunderstandings."
"What important person?" Yun Mengmeng said, wondering if her name was so common that it would be the same as some important figure's.
Lu Yang naturally couldn't say that your name is the same as our sect master's fake name. Currently, he is a disciple of the Dao Seeking Sect, not the Heavenly Court Young Sect Master.
"Around this time, there should be storytelling," said Lu Yang, engaging his senses and listening for the sound of storytelling amongst the noise nearby to locate a teahouse.
This street was full of hotpot restaurants; adjacent were snack streets, antique streets, and so on, where many teahouses could be found.
"Come on, I'll take you to listen to storytelling, and you'll find out," he said.
The two of them made their way to a teahouse, where Lu Yang ordered a pot of the best tea and a table full of pastries, treating Yun Mengmeng to storytelling.
"...it is said that during the battle at Hanshui City, two ancient supremes used dreams as their path, drawing the million residents of Hanshui City into a dreamscape to wage an epic battle worthy of the creation of heaven and earth."
"...But no one expected that someone would manage to enter the dream world created by the two supremes. That person strolled leisurely in the world of dreams, completely ignoring the might of the two supremes!"
"Upon seeing that person, the two supremes became like facing a formidable enemy, cold sweat covering their foreheads, and they asked with a hoarse voice, 'Who are you?!'"
"That person merely glanced at the two supremes, and they felt as if they had fallen into an icy cave, like outcasts peering into the vast sky."
"With a voice that had remained unchanged through the ages, that person introduced themselves: 'Heavenly Court Sect Master, Yun Mengmeng.'"
Murmurs of surprise rose up, not the first time the guests had heard this segment, but every time the arrival of the Heavenly Court Sect Master Yun Mengmeng was mentioned, one could sense the prestige spanning across countless ages.
"...Moving on to the battle at the East Sea, where an immortal emerged from the fog, every gesture exuding the immense power of heaven and earth, intent on slaying one of the Four Imperial Protectors of the Dragon Clan Ancestor."
"It was then that the Heavenly Court Sect Master appeared, and for the first time since ancient times, an immortal battle commenced. Both immortals clashed, and their combat was felt throughout the entire Cultivation World..."
"...After countless exchanges, the immortal who emerged from the fog was defeated. Sect Leader Yun pursued the victory, and both vanished from the world..."
Lu Yang passed the last piece of pastry on the plate to Yun Mengmeng: "That's the story. Your name is the same as the Heavenly Court Sect Master's."
Yun Mengmeng, who had been listening intently, wondered why others with the same name as hers were so powerful, yet she was so subpar.
Lu Yang sighed, "I suppose your family never thought you'd share a name with such a powerful ancient figure when they named you."
"Alright, alright, these are trivial matters. I will go with you to that Sword Tower, and once everything is taken care of, I'll take you to my good sister," Yun Mengmeng proposed.
"Good sister?"
Lu Yang thought to himself that he knew this young lady couldn't have simply run away from home so naively; she must have had a place to go.
Seeing that Yun Mengmeng had the strength of the Golden Core Stage and wasn't just a pretty face, her talent for cultivation was quite impressive.
Now that he had advanced to the early stages of Spirit Transformation, there were very few cultivators who could conceal their cultivation level from his eyes, unless they were at the Integration Period.
But which Integration Period cultivator would travel without money and freeload for food and drinks?
"Yes, my good sister is quite impressive, especially in a fight. She's very low-key, and not many people know about her strength. If she gives you a few pointers, you're sure to benefit immensely," Yun Mengmeng said, her expression filled with proud modesty as she spoke about her good sister.
"Especially good at fighting?"
"Absolutely, she's the most formidable one where we come from; no one can beat her."
Lu Yang didn't take Yun Mengmeng's words to heart, as how could her close friend be as formidable as Eldest Senior Sister?
Let alone Eldest Senior Sister, it would be impressive if your close friend could even compare to me.
Lu Yang and Yun Mengmeng strolled to the Sword Tower, eating and drinking leisurely along the way.
"Didn't your family use to feed you?" Lu Yang asked Yun Mengmeng with a strange look as she was still holding a skewer of grilled sweet potato noodles she had bought from the barbecue shop called 'Come Again'.
"Of course, we had food, and it tasted quite good too, like peaches and such, but eating too much of it can get a bit nauseating, plus the flavors were very light, not like here."
Lu Yang thought to himself if you're looking for rich flavors, then coming to Shu State is the right choice. If you find the flavors here light, then I could only invite an immortal to cook for you.
Lu Yang caught a glimpse of a towering immortal sword that soared into the clouds, planted in the ground, with its hilt obscured by the clouds, flickering in and out of view.
Upon closer inspection, he realized it wasn't an immense immortal sword but a wooden tower shaped like a sword.
It was indeed the Sword Tower.
Many sword cultivators headed towards the Sword Tower, a rare sight of sword cultivators gathering in one place on ordinary days.
There, Lu Yang saw exalted sword cultivators in white robes resembling snow, carrying spirit swords, along with Buddhist disciples holding Buddha beads and wearing wisdom swords at their waists, as well as various fully or partially transformed great demons who had also arrived here.
The sword was not an exclusive weapon of the human race; many from the Demon Race also favored using swords as their weapon.
Besides sword cultivators from the Demon Territory, the East Sea, and Buddha Country, Lu Yang also saw cultivators from the Extreme Northern Lands.
The Extreme Northern Lands were bitterly cold and sparsely populated, with no major powers like Penglai Island present. The cultivators there were mostly loose cultivators or depended on simple master-disciple lineages.
Many sword cultivators liked to go to the frigid Extreme Northern Lands to train their swordsmanship, hoping to attain a higher level in their art.
And the sword cultivators from the Extreme Northern Lands were naturally among the strong ones.
Lu Yang walked around the Sword Tower and soon found the destination of his trip—the Sword Shop.
Different types of swords were hung all over the walls of the Sword Shop: long swords, short swords, broad swords, narrow swords... a dazzling array.
The swords hanging there were all of fine quality, and even the disciples of the Sword Tower had to purchase from here.
But none caught Lu Yang's eye.
"The quality just isn't there," he remarked.
The sword he wanted needed to at least withstand the strength of a Body Integration Realm cultivator, so how could the swords hanging outside of a Sword Shop possess such quality?
"Who says the swords from our Sword Shop are of poor quality?" a displeased voice came from inside the shop, as a young man pushed aside the curtain and walked out, holding a big iron hammer in his hand.
The young man stopped in his tracks when he saw Lu Yang.
Lu Yang also recognized the young man.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang!"
"Junior Brother Mingtai."
It was Mingtai, a true disciple of the Sword Tower, the Sword Spirit, a Sword Tower Supreme.

chapters.title: Chapter 902 - 901 The Sword Spirit of the Green Peak Sword
chapters.content:
Compared to three years ago, Mingtai had become more mature in appearance, but the greatest change was in his eyes, which shone bright like the tips of two swords, revealing their sharpness.
"I heard that Elder Brother Lu Yang, you have passed the Invincible Divine Thunder that has never appeared before, as well as the Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation, which is the first in rank and encountered only upon breaking through to the Divinity Transformation Stage, becoming a Divinity Transformation Stage cultivator?"
Mingtai put down the heavy hammer, clasped his hands, and bowed respectfully. He was very happy to see Lu Yang.
Although people from the Sword Tower often bragged about their own swordsmanship talent, in his view, it was Elder Brother Lu Yang who truly possessed the most top-notch swordsmanship talent, and he was somewhat inferior.
When the time came for him to pass the tribulation, if he happened to face the Invincible Divine Thunder and the Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation, he was certain he wouldn't be able to pass.
"This is…" Mingtai's attention shifted to Yun Mengmeng, who had been standing by the side, quiet and not speaking.
"Her surname is Yun, a friend I made on the road, and she is currently traveling with me," Lu Yang explained.
"So, it's Miss Yun." Mingtai bowed politely and did not look down on Yun Mengmeng despite her lower cultivation level.
Yun Mengmeng felt that people outside were quite nice, and not as frightening as her grandmother had said, with a world full of sinister calculations. She was advised that once outside, she must keep a low profile, suppress her cultivation level, and not reveal her strength until meeting Xiao Zhi.
"Are you forging swords here?" Lu Yang noticed the heavy hammer Mingtai had just put down.
"It's a tradition left by the first Tower Master. He believed that sword cultivators could enhance their understanding of swordsmanship through the act of forging blades," Mingtai replied.
"Since then, every disciple of the Sword Tower has been required to learn the art of forging."
The first Tower Master was the Sword Tower Supreme, a genius who soared high and stopped only at Semi-Immortal, falling to the Immortal Ascension Tribulation.
Usually, Mingtai would address the Sword Tower Supreme as "Master," but the fact that she was the sword spirit of the Sword Tower Supreme's sword was a secret, known only to a few high-ranking members in the Sword Tower and kept completely confidential externally; thus, she could not call her that in front of Lu Yang.
Lu Yang was aware of Mingtai's origins, as he had been informed by Fairy Eternity.
"Is that so," Lu Yang murmured in understanding.
"Did Elder Brother Lu Yang come here to purchase a sword? The swords here are all forged by our Sword Tower disciples and probably won't catch Elder Brother Lu Yang's discerning eye."
"That's not necessarily the case…" In Mingtai's presence, Lu Yang felt embarrassed to say that the swords here were of too low quality for him.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang might as well try his luck at the Ask Sword Grand Ceremony. If there is a sword that resonates with you, it will naturally follow you," Mingtai suggested.
"The Ask Sword Grand Ceremony has such an event?" Lu Yang was surprised.
Although Lu Yang was a sword cultivator and the Ask Sword Grand Ceremony was the most important event for all sword cultivators, he had not paid much attention to it, only knowing that it was a tradition left by the Sword Tower Supreme, held once every hundred years.
"Our Sword Tower often forges swords, and among the past Tower Masters and Elders, there are always some who enjoy forging spirit swords, which occasionally possess spirituality."
