"After the Tower Masters and Elders' lifespans are exhausted, these swords become masterless. Forcing them upon sword cultivators who are not of compatible destiny would only draw the swords' discontent."
"Yet if they are sealed away indefinitely, the swords will gather dust, and their spirituality will eventually vanish."
"Our Sword Tower is reluctant to let spirit swords gather dust, so we opened the Sword Vault. If someone can resonate with a spirit sword, they can take it. It allows the spirit sword to shine in the hands of the right sword cultivator, but it's for personal use only, not for sale or transfer. And if the sword cultivator dies, the spirit sword must be returned to our Sword Tower."
"Your Sect is truly generous!" Lu Yang said sincerely, knowing how precious swords with spirituality were, and the Sword Tower's willingness to let outsiders use these swords impressed him greatly. The Sword Tower was indeed a sacred place for sword cultivators.
"It's just an unwillingness to let the spirit swords gather dust," said Mingtai, the sword spirit, who felt this most profoundly.
"Why don't we consider having Sword Tower cooperate with Seek Dao Sect?" Fairy Eternity suggested from within the Spiritual Space.
"Cooperation?"
"You see, the Sword Tower doesn't want the swords' spirituality to fade away, and our Seek Dao Sect has the ability to prevent that."
"Is the Fifth Elder that powerful?"
"Not that kid. To sustain the sword's spirituality, we either find it a master or we elevate the spirituality to a Sword Spirit, just like what our Sect's River Spirit did."
Hearing this, Lu Yang roughly understood Fairy Eternity's method, and the corner of his eye twitched, "So, Fairy, your idea is to refine the prisoners of Captive Peak into Sword Spirits and fuse them with the swords from the Sword Tower?"
"Yeah, it's a good idea, right?"
"No way." Lu Yang flatly rejected Fairy Eternity's proposal—this was not the behavior of a Righteous Sect.
Refining souls on a large scale, with sinister winds howling and ghosts wailing—it would look to outsiders as if the Seek Dao Sect was a demonic sect.
"And how would we resolve the issue of the Spirit Swords' ownership? Are we supposed to steal all these swords for the Seek Dao Sect? We're the leader of the Righteous Path; we can't engage in such behavior."
"It seems to be the case."
"What a pity. I was thinking about organizing a major Sword Spirit refining event and refining Guan Shanhai into your Green Peak Sword along the way. With a Sword Spirit, your sword would become a top-tier Immortal Artifact, something not even Yingtian Immortal could create."
"Wait a minute, it seems that in order for your Immortal Sword to have a Sword Spirit, we don't need to refine Guan Shanhai." Fairy Eternity came up with a brilliant idea that could take the quality of the Green Peak Sword to the next level.
"What do you mean?"
Fairy Eternity smiled mysteriously, "Little Yang, take out your Green Peak Sword."
Lu Yang obediently did as told, taking out the Green Peak Sword from his Identity Jade, still not understanding Fairy Eternity's intention.
Fairy Eternity flew out of the Spiritual Space, crawled up Lu Yang's arm, and with a whiz, dived into the Green Peak Sword.
"Now your Green Peak Sword is a top-tier Immortal Artifact with a Sword Spirit."
She had been staying in the Spiritual Space quite often; changing places wasn't so bad.
Fairy Eternity warned fiercely, "You can't put the Green Peak Sword back into your Identity Jade!"
"...All right."
Lu Yang casually swung the Green Peak Sword a couple of times, and although according to Fairy Eternity's theory, it was now the most powerful weapon in the world, Lu Yang didn't feel that way at all—it felt just the same as before.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, why did you suddenly take out your sword?" Mingtai was puzzled; just now, Elder Brother Lu Yang looked as if he was possessed, with a sudden urge to wave around the Green Peak Sword as if he was about to chop down a couple of people at random.
"It's nothing. Just letting it get some air."
"Oh." Mingtai could understand Lu Yang's approach; Sword Cultivators consider their sword as their beloved, so a little odd behavior was understandable.
"By the way, Fairy, is there something wrong with this girl called Yun Mengmeng?" Lu Yang always felt there was something off about Yun Mengmeng, but couldn't quite put his finger on it.
Fairy Eternity hummed with dissatisfaction, "You've been treating her to hotpot and storytelling snacks; what could be wrong?"
She had never been treated to such things.

chapters.title: Chapter 903 - 903: 902
chapters.content:
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, I have a few senior brothers and sisters who have been wanting to meet you. Are you available right now?"
"Sure, let's go meet them." Lu Yang replied with a smile, sheathing the Green Peak Sword carelessly and hanging it at his waist.
Previously, Lu Yang always tried not to take out the Green Peak Sword. As the Green Peak Sword was an Immortal Sword refined by Wu Yao, he was afraid that Great Yu Cultivators would recognize it and bring trouble upon him.
For instance, the previous attack on Seek Dao Sect by Master of All Laws originated from recognizing the Green Peak Sword, leading to the speculation that Seek Dao Sect had hidden a legacy left by Wu Yao.
Now, Lu Yang no longer had this concern, as all those who knew the origin of the Green Peak Sword were confined in Captive Peak—there was no one in the outside world who could recognize its value.
Yun Mengmeng gazed at the Green Peak Sword, displaying an expression as if deep in thought.
"Miss Yun, have you thought of something?" Lu Yang noticed Yun Mengmeng's unusual behavior.
"Do you remember the sister I mentioned to you before?"
"The exceptionally strong one?"
"Yes, she actually quite likes swords and even secretly practiced for a while, theoretically learning a lot. However, she never achieved anything noteworthy, didn't even make it past the threshold, and eventually gave up."
Lu Yang said with a smile, "Swordsmanship is like that, mere effort isn't enough to succeed. Talent and comprehension are indispensable. This means your sister's talent for swordsmanship is really quite ordinary."
"However, since your sister is interested in swordsmanship, I can give her some guidance."
"Not to sing my own praises, but I do have some talent in the way of the sword. Among the young generation in the Cultivation World, there shouldn't be many whose talent for swordsmanship is above mine."
Hearing Lu Yang say this, Mingtai also laughed, "Elder Brother Lu Yang is being modest. In the younger generation, I fear there's no one whose talent for swordsmanship is above yours."
"Only Young Master Lu, who's from the Ancient Era, might be comparable, but strictly speaking, he's not part of our young generation."
"That's wonderful." Yun Mengmeng felt happy for her good sister. According to her, she belonged to the young generation, so her talent would definitely not match Lu Yang's. It would be perfect to have Lu Yang teach her.
Xiao Zhi always brought back many gifts whenever she returned home. This time, finding a mentor for Xiao Zhi could also be seen as returning the favor.
The Sword Tower has a total of eighteen floors, with the first eight floors open to the public. Sword Cultivators participating in the Sword-Seeking Festival could choose a room to stay in for a few days here, with cultivation resources provided by the Sword Tower.
The ninth to the twelfth floors were reserved for the Sword Tower's Inner Sect Disciples and True Disciples for cultivation, belonging to the core of the Sword Tower, and outsiders were rarely allowed to ascend there. The twelfth floor was where Mingtai brought Lu Yang and Yun Mengmeng.
"Who are those two, and how can they go up there?"
Sword Cultivators exchanging swordsmanship insights on the eighth floor were astonished. Mingtai was dressed in the uniform of the Sword Tower, clearly an Inner Sect Disciple, but Lu Yang and Yun Mengmeng were obviously outsiders.
"Doesn't one of them look like Lu Yang?"
"He is Lu Yang? Yes, I've seen his portrait; that's definitely him!"
"I heard that when he was in the East Sea, he had already comprehended the way of the sword to the extent that all things could be swords, even using people as swords to execute the One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand technique!"
"At that time, he was only at the Nascent Soul Stage, right? Being able to use One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand at the Nascent Soul Stage is terrifying indeed."
Those participating in the Sword-Seeking Festival were all geniuses in their own right, with unparalleled swordsmanship, and a certain degree of pride. But when comparing their talent for swordsmanship with Lu Yang's, it was like child's play; they couldn't even muster the desire to compete.
Sitting in a corner, a Nameless Sword Cultivator's lips curled into a mysterious smile, "Lu Yang, huh? I wonder if he is worthy for me to test my sword against."
In another corner, another Nameless Sword Cultivator had been watching Lu Yang until he disappeared through the stairwell entrance: "He doesn't seem all that impressive."
The previous Nameless Sword Cultivator heard this and was displeased, "Hey, watch your words. Lu Yang is an opponent I've set my sights on. Are you saying that my test is very ordinary?"
The other nameless swordsman sneered, "So what if it is!"
The two nameless swordsmen glared fiercely at each other, their eyes locked in a deadly stare, their right hands silently gripping the hilts of their swords, clearly ready to draw and cross blades at a moment's disagreement.
Just then, an outer gate disciple of the Sword Tower arrived at the eighth floor with an elder of the Sword Tower and pointed at the two swordsmen sitting in the corner, "Elder, it's those two. They didn't even give their names when they signed in at the gate but sneaked into our Sword Tower!"
The elder looked down from on high, "So it was the two of you who entered without registering. Would you prefer I escort you out, or will you leave on your own?"
One of the nameless swordsmen hooked the corner of his mouth slightly, looking disdainfully at the elder, "If you want to force me out, then is this how the Sword Tower treats its guests? Do you know who I am..."
Without a word, the elder opened the window and tossed the two men out.
"Crazy, didn't say their names during registration, now it's too late to mention them."
...
"Senior Sister Xiao Mi, Senior Brother Yue... look who I've brought."
Mingtai brought Lu Yang and another person to a stone chamber on the twelfth floor, where six individuals were gathered—other than Mingtai himself, these were the six most gifted disciples of the Sword Tower.
"Greetings, fellow daoists. I am Lu Yang." Lu Yang, holding the Green Peak Sword upside down, cupped his fists in salute.
"Lu Yang, we have long admired your reputation." The six gentlemen of the Sword Tower stood up to salute him, their happiness at meeting Lu Yang evident, as their words of admiration were no mere courtesy.
"This is Miss Yun, who is currently accompanying me."
"We've had the pleasure of meeting Miss Yun."
"Hello, everyone." Yun Mengmeng stood demurely to the side, saying nothing. She knew very little of the outside world, and talking too much might lead to gaffes.
"Come, come, let me introduce you to Elder Brother Lu Yang. This is Senior Sister Mi Li, whom everyone likes to call Senior Sister Xiao Mi."
Lu Yang noticed that Senior Sister Xiao Mi's aura fluctuated wildly, rising and falling unpredictably, a sign she was in the Void Refinement Stage.
"This is Senior Brother Yue Chuan, the Tower Master's favored disciple of the left gate."
Yue Chuan acted like a lothario, openly embracing a woman in public, seemingly unaware of any impropriety.
"This is Senior Brother Li Tang, the Tower Master's favored disciple of the right gate."
Li Tang was quiet and reserved, cradling a sword, his long hair tied up in a high ponytail, merely nodding to Lu Yang without a word, embodying the temperament of a sword cultivator.
Yun Mengmeng, who had remained silent, couldn't help but ask, "What do 'favored disciple of the left gate' and 'favored disciple of the right gate' mean?"
"Originally, the Tower Master decided to take on only one disciple to be the favored one, but both senior brothers were outstanding and hard to choose between, so he took them both in."
"The Tower Master said after all, there are two doors in every gate, so it was quite normal to have two disciples."
"Senior Brother Li Tang is shy and doesn't like to talk. Please don't take it amiss, Elder Brother Lu Yang."
After Mingtai had introduced everyone, there was still no introduction of the woman in Yue Chuan's arms, which inevitably made Lu Yang curious.
"And who might this be?"
"Oh, I forgot to introduce her. She's a sword spirit cultivated by Senior Brother Yue Chuan, quite an incredible one indeed. Senior Brother Yue Chuan is enhancing communication with his sword spirit. Among the current generation of disciples in our sect, he is the only one with a sword spirit."

chapters.title: Chapter 904 - 903: Sword Inquiry Ceremony
chapters.content:
Lu Yang saw a genuine Sword Spirit for the first time, and it was nothing like the counterfeit spirit in the Green Peak Sword.
The Sword Spirit of Yue Chuan was undoubtedly of a high level, otherwise, Lu Yang would have been able to tell that something was odd.
Yue Chuan smiled, his face unable to conceal his pride, "When I first started cultivating, I was lucky enough to come across a sword with complete spirituality. By nurturing the sword with my heart, I gradually cultivated Ah Lan."
His Sword was named the Lanyan Sword, and the Sword Spirit named herself Ah Lan.
To deepen his bond with Ah Lan, he would cuddle and embrace her during the day, and at night, he would use sword-nourishing techniques to maintain her condition, making countless people jealous.
"Talking like nobody else has a Sword Spirit, Little Yang, bring out Immortal so they can feast their eyes!" Fairy Eternity couldn't stand seeing Lu Yang be outdone.
The Great Bean Dynasty was vast and sparsely populated, and as a pillar of the nation and the future Bean Emperor, Little Yang couldn't possibly be without a Sword that had a Spirit in it.
Fairy Eternity felt quite satisfied with her role as Empress, both acting as Little Yang's second Nascent Soul and as a Sword Spirit to make a show, there probably wasn't another Emperor in history who cared so much about their ministers.
"Don't, don't, don't, Fairy, please keep nourishing your body and spirit in the Green Peak Sword." Lu Yang hurriedly stopped Fairy Eternity; if she showed up, it would be a disaster. If someone asked him how he communicated with his Sword Spirit, the whole ruse would be exposed.
Senior Sister Xiao Mi and others enthusiastically discussed Swordsmanship with Lu Yang, feeling as if they had found a kindred spirit. After hearing Lu Yang's unique insights on Swordsmanship, they experienced a moment of enlightenment.
In the blink of an eye, a day had passed.
"Let's go, the Swordsmanship Meeting is about to start," said Xiao Mi, leading the group downstairs.
The venue for the Swordsmanship Meeting was set up next to the Sword Tower, a makeshift area close to the Sword Vault.
According to Mingtai, the Swordsmanship Meeting was structured like previous ones, divided into three stages: the Tower Master's speech, the Sword Inquiries, where contestants are not judged by their Cultivation Level, but by their pure understanding of Swordsmanship, and the third stage involved going to the Sword Vault and resonating with the Spirit Swords.
Sword Cultivators who came to participate in the Swordsmanship Meeting were mostly aiming for the second stage, the Sword Inquiries, as it was an opportunity to prove their understanding of Swordsmanship to swordsmen all over the world and represented absolute honor.
Daoist Buyu once won first place in a Swordsmanship Meeting and then swiftly progressed, defeating the Tower Master of the Sword Tower and earning the title of the foremost practitioner of Swordsmanship.
"Take my sword strike!"
"Kunlun Sword Technique!"
"Heaven and Earth Sword!"
"Peacock Display Sword Technique!"
Many Sword Cultivators took the opportunity of the brief period before the start of the Swordsmanship Meeting to exchange skills and spar in the venue.
Some displayed brilliant sword strikes that could rip through space, others exhibited Swordmanship like the spreading plumage of a peacock, embedding countless feints within their movements to hide the true strike, and there were even those like the octopus wielding eight swords, spinning around like a top, keeping everyone at bay.
Before, Lu Yang had only seen Sword Cultivators here and there and didn't think much of it, but now that the Swordsmanship Meeting had officially begun, with swordsmen from all over converging here, he was truly impressed, feeling overwhelming Sword Intent wash over him.
Apart from exceptions like Daoist Buyu, most Sword Cultivators were aloof and reticent, largely because they devoted themselves entirely to their swords and didn't share a common language with others.
Once at the Sword Tower, Sword Cultivators finally found like-minded individuals, gathering in small groups, most of whom had not known each other before, and after a brief conversation, they became friends.
This was another reason why the Swordsmanship Meeting garnered so much attention from Sword Cultivators.
```
Every sword cultivator has their unique "intent," and when these "intents" gathered together, without any deliberate guidance, they formed a formidable Sword Intent that dispersed the clouds in the sky without using the slightest bit of mystical power, leaving the skies clear and bright overhead.
Lu Yang, looking up at the glaring sun above, thought to himself, at least leave me a patch of cloud. In my previous life, even the drill instructor would take pity on us during military training, making sure to stand us at attention in a shaded area.
If the occasion were not inappropriate, Lu Yang would have wanted to use One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand to create some shade.
The Tower Master of the Sword Tower was giving a speech from the highest location, but Lu Yang did not hear what was being said because Mingtai kept transmitting messages to him, introducing a few sword cultivators he needed to pay special attention to.
"That man, dressed in green, tall and slender, is a sword cultivator from the Demon Territory named Duan Changqing; he is a bamboo that gained sentience and carved a section of his body into a bamboo sword to use as a weapon."
It's difficult for spiritual plants to gain sentience, but once they do, they possess talents favored by the heavens. The highest achievement among spiritual plants gaining sentience is the Time Immortal.
Even though she is now reincarnated as Li Haoran, she is still frequently on Su Yiren's mind.
"That androgynous-looking individual is Qiu Kun from the Chaos Tribe; it is said he is highly valued by an ancient ancestor of the Chaos Tribe in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage and has already been confirmed as the next Clan Leader of the Chaos Tribe."
Lu Yang took another look at Qiu Kun; he had encountered geniuses from the Chaos Tribe while in the Creation Ancient Land of the Demon Territory. But at the time, he was too busy fighting and didn't have the opportunity to note which tribe they were from.
This one named Qiu Kun was not the Chaos Tribe genius Lu Yang encountered at that time; he estimated that the other's age and realm were both higher than his, but he was unsure by how much.
The Chaos Tribe's gender is unfixed; they can change from male to female and often have an androgynous appearance, which makes people keep their distance respectfully.
When Qiu Kun felt Lu Yang's gaze, he turned his head to look at Lu Yang at the same moment that Lu Yang quickly corrected his own gaze back to the front.
"Qiu Kun, what's the matter?" asked a large black dog beside him.
This dog was a genius from the Celestial Dog Clan, with a sword in his mouth. During his youth, he practiced swordsmanship in his original shape, and though he could now take human form, he still preferred to wield a sword in his original form.
"I felt like someone was watching me, probably just my imagination."
"Maybe someone is guessing your gender again," the big black dog said with a strange laugh; it was common for demons in the Demon Territory to speculate about Qiu Kun's gender.
Qiu Kun glanced at the big black dog, "Shut it, you're drooling."
There's a serious problem with holding a sword in the mouth—it tends to cause drooling.
"That one is Xuanxuan from the Black Tortoise Clan of the East Sea. The Black Tortoise Clan is known for its defense, but he has abandoned defense in favor of absolute dedication to the sword. It's said that the shells of his clan members of the same age cannot withstand his sword."
Xuanxuan had dark skin, a burly figure, and carried a broad sword with the handle emblazoned with a small turtle, which he had drawn himself.
At the birthday banquet of the Old Dragon Emperor, Lu Yang had seen the Transcendance Tribulation Stage old Clan Leader of the Black Tortoise Clan but had not had the chance to meet the younger generation.
Seeing that the Tower Master of the Sword Tower was still speaking, Yun Mengmeng opened her oil paper umbrella and sneaked out two pieces of cake, quietly starting to eat them.

chapters.title: Chapter 905 - 904 Sword Heart
chapters.content:
After announcing the start of the second stage, the Tower Master of the Sword Tower continued, "Sword Cultivators are not just Cultivators who use swords as weapons. If that were the case, then who in the world wouldn't be a Sword Cultivator?"
Lu Yang silently nodded in agreement. What the Tower Master of the Sword Tower said was correct. Every Cultivator dreamed of becoming a Sword Immortal. It was just that after they tried using swords as their weapon, they realized it wasn't suitable for them and gave up.
"So does being a Sword Cultivator refer to someone with a talent for swordsmanship?" Not entirely, either."
"A true Sword Cultivator not only possesses swordmanship talent unreachable by ordinary people, but also nurtures a Sword Heart, which is your attitude towards your sword!"
"There's also something called a Sword Heart?" Lu Yang wondered, having never heard his master or Eldest Senior Sister mention it.
Lu Yang felt he really needed to attend more Sword Cultivator gatherings. It was rare to see his master even once a year, and after reaching the Foundation Establishment Stage, Eldest Senior Sister had not taught him any more sword techniques either. As for Fairy Eternity, there was no use even mentioning her, as she knew nothing about swordsmanship.
"Inquiry of the Sword is divided into two parts, Inquiry of the Sword in Heart and Inquiry of the Sword in Intent."
"This Inquiry of the Sword in Heart tests the Sword Heart."
After hearing the words of the Tower Master of the Sword Tower, Lu Yang felt somewhat uneasy. If it were a competition of Sword Intent, he wouldn't fear anyone, but he had just learned of this Sword Heart—what should he do?
An Array Method appeared beneath the feet of all the Sword Cultivators, shooting a beam of light upward that enveloped them.
"This is the Heart-Questioning Formation. Within this Array Method, all lies regarding the 'sword' are inadmissible."
It was one of the fundamental techniques of the Sword Tower, an Array Method unconsciously comprehended by the Sword Tower Supreme while meditating on swordsmanship, highly beneficial for understanding the Sword Heart.
Lu Yang felt that this Array Method had some similarities with his "Mind Seeing Method" in certain aspects, though this Method was even more profound.
The Heart-Questioning Formation could discern truth from falsehood but could not ask questions proactively. The Sword Tower had a total of twelve Elders and one Tower Master, who personally went into the field to test the Sword Cultivators of the world.
Among them, the most watched was the Tower Master of the Sword Tower, for his selection of Sword Cultivators, to some extent, represented his high regard for these individuals.
The Tower Master of the Sword Tower first approached Duan Changqing of the Green Bamboo Sect, "Duan Changqing, do you practice Emotional Swordsmanship or Ruthless Swordsmanship?"
"Ruthless Swordsmanship."
"Would you be sad if your sword broke?"
Duan Changqing said indifferently, "If the sword breaks, I'll just refine a new one. Why should I be sad?"
"Then do you love swordsmanship?"
"Of course, I do."
Red light, piercing to the eye, emerged from the Array Method beneath Duan Changqing's feet, signifying that he was lying.
The Tower Master of the Sword Tower spoke sternly, his eyes sharp as a sword as if trying to see through Duan Changqing, "You must tell the truth."
Unable to withstand the pressure from the Tower Master of the Sword Tower, Duan Changqing could only speak honestly, "I became a Sword Cultivator simply because Sword Cultivators wield great offensive power."
The Tower Master of the Sword Tower sighed. "Your sword is refined from a part of your own body, which certainly helps you wield it naturally. However, you have no emotional connection to swordsmanship, which will block your path ahead."
Then the Tower Master approached Yue Chuan, a disciple from the Guan Left Gate. Yue Chuan drew the Lanyan Sword, with its Sword Spirit, Ah Lan, nestled in his arms.
Yue Chuan understood without needing to ask whether he followed Emotional Swordsmanship or Ruthless Swordsmanship.
"Yue Chuan, can you achieve life and death unity with your sword?"
Looking at Ah Lan in his arms, Yue Chuan confidently said, "Yes!"
"Then what is the relationship between you and your sword?"
Without hesitation, Yue Chuan answered, "I will marry Ah Lan!"
The Tower Master held his forehead, asking Yue Chuan was merely a formality. How could he not know what his own top disciple was like?
Had it not been for the laws of Great Xia not recognizing Sword Spirits as marriageable entities, the two would have married long ago.
"Mingtai, are you able to achieve life and death unity with your sword?" The Tower Master spoke with a pleasant countenance; in terms of seniority, unless the Sword Tower Supreme were to come back to life, even digging up past Tower Masters, none could compare with Mingtai's rank.
"Yes!"
Mingtai held the Containing Light Sword, the personal sword of the Sword Tower Supreme and also his own true form. If anything happened to the Containing Light Sword, he wouldn't survive either.
"And what is your relationship with your sword?"
"We are one."
As soon as these words were spoken, there was a stir in the crowd. With no response from the great Formation, it meant Mingtai was telling the truth. Countless Sword Cultivators heard Mingtai's reply and felt inferior.
While their love for their swords was sincere, it fell short compared to Mingtai's.
"I've seen the Manager of the Tower," Lu Yang said as he quickly paid his respects upon seeing the Tower Master approaching.
The Tower Master of the Sword Tower was named Guan Yi.
"Are you Lu Yang? This is our first meeting," said the Tower Master of the Sword Tower with a smile upon seeing Lu Yang.
Despite his conflict with Daoist Buyu, that was a matter between their elders and had nothing to do with the younger generation.
As the Tower Master of the Sword Tower, his favorite sight was the growth of talented young sword cultivators.
As the renowned Lu Yang, the mention of his name by the Tower Master instantly attracted everyone's attention, "He indeed is Lu Yang."
"I wonder what Lu Yang's Sword Heart is like."
"With Mingtai ahead, no matter how excellent his Sword Heart is, it can't be better than Mingtai's, right?"
Manager of the Tower asked, "Your master practices the heartless Swordsmanship, what about you, Lu Yang? Do you practice the emotional Swordsmanship or the heartless Swordsmanship?"
Lu Yang hesitated for a moment, this was the first time he heard that Swordsmanship was divided into emotional and heartless.
"May I ask what emotional Swordsmanship and heartless Swordsmanship mean?"
"Your master didn't even tell you this?" The Manager of the Tower showed slight dissatisfaction toward Daoist Buyu, thinking him irresponsible.
"Sword Cultivators surely love their swords; it's just that there are different kinds of love."
"The so-called emotional Swordsmanship refers to treating a sword as a person, loving the sword as one loves a person. Everyone in our Sword Tower practices emotional Swordsmanship. Heartless Swordsmanship, on the other hand, means treating the sword as an object, simply loving the sword. The most famous representative is your master," explained the Tower Master.
After giving it some thought, even though the Green Peak Sword was a gift from the Eldest Senior Sister and he liked it very much, he ultimately treated the Green Peak Sword as an object and didn't have any special feelings for it.
"Then, what I practice should be heartless Swordsmanship," he concluded.
Upon hearing this, the Manager of the Tower was slightly displeased, thinking it was just as he expected, a talented young cultivator like Lu Yang was still taught to practice the heartless Swordsmanship by Old Buyu.
But then, a red light emerged from the Array Method under Lu Yang's feet.
"Hmm? Did you just lie?" The Manager of the Tower's face lit up with joy. Didn't this mean that Lu Yang was actually practicing the emotional Swordsmanship?
"I lied?" Lu Yang was also surprised. According to the definition given by the Manager of the Tower, he indeed practiced heartless Swordsmanship.
The Manager of the Tower gently and persuasively asked, "Do you like your sword?"
Lu Yang nodded; he indeed liked the Green Peak Sword.
"Do you treat your sword as a person?"
Lu Yang was about to shake his head when he suddenly realized where the misunderstanding lay—the Green Peak Sword did have a person inside it!
Lu Yang could only continue nodding.
The Manager of the Tower clapped his hands, drawing a conclusion for Lu Yang, "There you have it, you like your sword and treat it as a person. This is indeed emotional Swordsmanship!"
"Suppose, if your sword breaks or disappears, wouldn't you be sad, heartbroken, and cry your eyes out?"
Thinking about the scenario described by the Manager of the Tower, if Fairy Eternity disappeared, he seemed like he would indeed be very sad, probably cry too, so he could only nod again.
"See, you are not only practicing emotional Swordsmanship, but you have also reached the profound realm of imbuing your emotions into the sword!"
Fairy Eternity giggled inside the Green Peak Sword, not understanding why, but she just felt very happy with Little Yang's responses.
"Would you be willing to live and die with your sword?"
Within emotional Swordsmanship, a handful of Sword Cultivators with extreme feelings toward their swords held the belief that if the sword exists, the person exists; if the sword perishes, the person perishes. Cultivators like Yue Chuan and Mingtai from before had always revered this kind of extreme sentiment.
Upon hearing this question, Lu Yang looked puzzled and didn't know how to respond, "It's not about living and dying together; it's that even if I die, my sword won't."
Given the miraculous extent of the Eternity Dao Fruit, even if Fairy Eternity wanted to die, it would be difficult.
The Manager of the Tower greatly admired Lu Yang's answer, "Excellent, to protect your sword with your life, preferring to perish yourself rather than allowing any harm to come to your sword!"
The onlookers regarded Lu Yang with respect, for only Sword Cultivators could understand what his answer implied. This sentiment went even beyond the sword exists, the person exists; if the sword perishes, the person perishes.
"Deserving of being Lu Yang, just with this sentiment, which Sword Cultivator of today could compare?"
"I had thought he was just talented in Swordsmanship and felt nothing for his sword, but I was wrong!"
"No wonder he can perform One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand at the Nascent Soul Stage, one person becomes ten thousand. It's not only Swordsmanship talent; surely this profound sentiment for his sword plays a crucial role too!"
The Manager of the Tower asked the final question, "What's the relationship between you and your sword?"
Lu Yang felt it was a bit embarrassing to tell the truth, yet if he lied, the Array Method would detect it, so he had to answer truthfully, "The sword is my lord, and I am its servant."
The crowd was agog once again, the volume of their voices even louder than during Mingtai's moment, looking at Lu Yang with disbelief.
"To regard the sword as one's lord is to reach the legendary realm of Unity of Man and Sword, where the body follows the sword's movement!"
"Has anyone in history ever reached this step?"
Sword Cultivators are proud beings; however much they love their swords, they only ever place the sword on an equal footing with themselves, never above them.
To humbly submit to one's sword for the sake of Swordsmanship, what a Sword Heart that is!
The more the Manager of the Tower looked at Lu Yang, the more pleasing he found the young man. The sword as the master, the cultivator as the aide—this was a depth of emotional Swordsmanship not even the previous Sword Tower Supreme had achieved!

chapters.title: Chapter 906 - 905: Inquiry of the Sword in Intent
chapters.content:
Mingtai looked at Lu Yang with increasing admiration. His own Sword Heart was already extremely rare in the world, yet he hadn't expected Elder Brother Lu Yang's affection for the sword to surpass even his own.
Perhaps in all of history, including the mysterious Ancient Times, and even counting the Zither and Sword Venerable from those times, no one was quite like Elder Brother Lu Yang.
The only uncertainty was the Qilin Immortal. It was said that the Qilin Immortal wielded a sword, but it was unknown if he simply used the sword as a weapon or if he was a true sword cultivator.
If the Qilin Immortal indeed was a sword cultivator, it remained a question whether Elder Brother Lu Yang or the Qilin Immortal had the superior Sword Heart.
Anyone who had cultivated to become an immortal would have a unique understanding of swordsmanship and Sword Heart.
"This Sword Heart is surely peerless throughout the ages," someone muttered softly, and immediately many others echoed the sentiment.
"Lu Yang's Sword Heart is peerless throughout the ages!"
"The sword as the master and Lu Yang as the retainer, his Sword Heart is peerless throughout the ages!"
Even the Sword Tower Elder cast an appreciative glance at Lu Yang, feeling that just on the merit of his sword cultivation alone, he was worthy of eternal renown and an example for all future sword cultivators to follow.
Although the slogans differed, they were essentially similar, creating the momentum of a great thundering tide. Lu Yang, embarrassed, hung his head low and fidgeted with the tip of his shoe.
It felt as though everyone was proclaiming him to be a subject of Fairy Eternity.
Lu Yang now regretted attending the Inquiry of the Sword Grand Ceremony; there was no need to find an excuse to wander, as it was quite nice staying in the Seek Dao Sect.
Yun Mengmeng didn't understand much about swordsmanship, but from everyone's reaction, she could tell that Lu Yang's Sword Heart was indeed formidable and felt somewhat proud.
"Have found a good teacher for Xiao Zhi," she thought.
"Grandma was worried about me having accidents outside, but with my luck, how could anything go wrong?"
With Lu Yang, possessing the peerless Sword Heart of all ages, any other sword cultivator's response seemed pale and lackluster in comparison, completely incomparable to Lu Yang.
"You see, thanks to this immortal's help, Little Yang, your Sword Heart is so formidable," Lu Yang ignored the Sword Spirit's shameless self-aggrandizement.
"The Inquiry of the Sword in Heart has concluded. I believe everyone already knows whose Sword Heart is the most admirable without me saying," the Tower Master of the Sword Tower said with a smile. His gaze fell on Lu Yang, unintentionally revealing his wish to claim Lu Yang as his own disciple, if not for the fact that he couldn't defeat Daoist Buyu.
However, upon reflection, it was said that Yun Zhi treasured this junior brother dearly—seemingly even if he could defeat Daoist Buyu, he wouldn't be able to defeat Yun Zhi.
After all, it was quite fine for Lu Yang to stay at Seek Dao Sect.
"Now, we shall begin the Inquiry of the Sword in Intent."
The Inquiry of the Sword Grand Ceremony was held once every hundred years. If it were a one-on-one swordsmanship combat, inevitably the one with the longest time in cultivation would win, leaving no real meaning to the battle.
Therefore, the Sword Tower Supreme suggested compressing everyone's cultivation level to the same stage, to compete purely based on Sword Intent.
Lu Yang felt an overwhelming pressure descending, covering the entire area and pressing down everyone's realm, including his own, to the Golden Core Stage.
Then, the earth trembled as eighteen platforms emerged from the ground, encircling the Sword Tower.
"These eighteen platforms were forged by the first Tower Master," the Manager of the Tower explained. "You need only place a streak of Sword Qi on the arena, and the Sword Qi will evolve into a Sword Intent Silhouette, which you can control to battle."
"Is this the legendary Sword Intent Arena?" the sword cultivators marveled upon seeing the eighteen platforms, smooth as mirrors, gleaming with excitement.
This was a treasure left by the Sword Tower Supreme. If one were to practice on it over a long period, it could refine Sword Intent, making it even more sharp and fierce.
This was Lu Yang's first encounter with this object, and from the discussions of those around him, he had a rough understanding of the incredible significance of the Sword Intent Arena.
Lu Yang drew the second group in the lot and had to wait for the first group to finish before it was his turn.
Lu Yang remembered the cultivators Mingtai had introduced as key competitors, and within the first group was the previously introduced Xuanxuan of the Black Tortoise Clan.
Xuanxuan carried a black sword, heavy and broad, with a little turtle painted on the hilt, and his presence felt Earth-shaking with every step he took.
Xuanxuan's opponent was another Lu Yang had seen before: an octopus with tentacles coiled around eight swords.
"Wu'er, I didn't expect to encounter you here," Xuanxuan smiled, showing eight pearly white teeth.
Both he and the octopus were sword cultivators from the East Sea, and while they had heard of each other, they had never crossed swords.
"Xuanxuan, they all say my swordsmanship is not as good as yours. I've been unable to find an opportunity before, but today I will dispel the rumors!"
"What rumors? They are simply telling the truth. How could you possibly compare to me!"
Wu'er was the first to attack, his tentacles wrapping around eight swords and spinning wildly. The speed was so fast that it was impenetrable; nobody could reach his true body before the ceremony started.
With a loud shout, Xuanxuan put all his strength into lifting his thick, black greatsword and struck a blow at the octopus Wu'er.
Clang——
That strike would cause trouble for any sword cultivator, but upon reaching Wu'er, it was simply swept away by the rapid spinning of his eight swords.
"There really is some skill here." Xuanxuan became interested. Sword cultivators were known for their attack power, yet Wu'er did the opposite, focusing on defensive power.
"Isn't it just spinning in circles? Who can't do the same!" Xuanxuan returned to his original form, transforming into a Black Tortoise with a snake's body, flipping over so the raised part of his shell was against the ground.
His head retracted into the shell, biting the hilt of the sword with his mouth, and stabbed the ground with his tail, setting himself into rotation.
As the tail stabbed the ground with greater speed and force, Xuanxuan's rotation sped up until it was so fast that it was impossible to tell head from tail.
Using his tail to accelerate and change direction, Xuanxuan charged at Wu'er and knocked him over.
Wu'er also got angry; he had always been unbeatable with this move, and this was the first time he had been knocked down.
"You think I'm scared of you!"
The two members of the Sea Clan were like spinning tops on the platform, rotating and colliding. If one was sent flying, they would gather strength and slam back into the fray.
Lu Yang watched Xuanxuan and Wu'er admiringly, not expecting to witness the Combined Battle Method here.
However, these two from the Sea Clan were even more impressive, no need for unification, they could spin on their own, which was far more convenient.
Lu Yang saw that the two spinning tops could not decide a victor in a short time, so he circled around the Sword Tower, checking the other arenas.
"Xiaofeng, you, how could you be here!" one sword cultivator said in shock upon recognizing the face and name of his opponent.
The one called Xiaofeng smiled, though his smile was very stiff: "Brother Lin, I always said we would meet again. Don't think that by changing your name and identity, I couldn't find you. You would surely participate in this once-in-a-century Inquiry of the Sword event!"
"A blood feud can only be settled with blood. Today, let our battle on this platform decide life and death!"
...
"Eldest Senior Brother, I did not expect us to meet on the arena. Do you remember our agreement, that only the winner has the right to confess to Junior Sister!"
"Junior Brother, who Junior Sister likes is her business. Do not let the outcome between us decide her marriage!"
"Talk is cheap, let's battle!"
...
"Brother, twenty years ago, you took my Spirit Root and pushed me off a cliff. You never thought I'd still be alive, did you!"
"What does it matter if you are still alive? You are just a useless nobody without a Spirit Root, how could you possibly defeat me!"
"Heh heh, the phrase 'destroy and then establish', you probably will never understand it!"
Lu Yang: "..."
When you in the Sword Tower drew lots to choose opponents, you really didn't tamper with it, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 907 - 906: Tenacious Opponent
chapters.content:
Manager of the Tower was also lost in thought at this scene.
How could they possibly investigate the background of every Sword Cultivator? The Sword Tower didn't have an intelligence network like the Seek Dao Sect's Task Hall; they couldn't even begin to conduct such thorough investigations.
Besides, this situation had never occurred during previous Sword Inquiry Conventions.
Strange affair.
"Tower Master, I'm afraid this isn't a good sign. Should we prepare for something?" A certain Elder of the Sword Tower felt that this Sword Inquiry Convention was extraordinary and quietly transmitted his voice to the Tower Master.
Manager of the Tower nodded in agreement with the Elder's view. The events of this Sword Inquiry Convention had already exceeded the Sword Tower's capabilities, "Indeed, it's not a good omen. Let's inform the government office first, so they can send more people, lest we can't apprehend everyone when the time comes."
The Sword Tower was not one of the Five Great Immortal Sects and held no law enforcement authority.
...
The first group of competitions, aside from massive irreconcilable differences between individual Sword Cultivators, didn't have anything else noteworthy.
Xuanxuan and Wu'er's iron top competition attracted the attention of many Sword Cultivators. The two members of the Sea Clan clashed to the extreme. First, Wu'er activated his hidden bloodline, and an Illusory Shadow of his ancestor appeared overhead, granting him new strength and the upper hand.
Soon after, Xuanxuan activated his hidden bloodline, the Illusory Shadow of an ancestor appeared, turning the situation around and gaining the upper hand.
In the end, Xuanxuan, acting later, held the advantage and secured the victory.
With this, the first group's competition successfully drew to a close.
Since they were all incarnations of Sword Intent, even if one killed the opponent, at most it would just result in the collapse of Sword Intent, preventing any danger to life.
Of course, if there were to be any vendettas after the competition, that would be out of their control.
Compared to the first group, the second group of competitions was even more worth watching. In the second group, there were Mingtai and Lu Yang, two young and much-anticipated new stars of Swordsmanship; people had only heard rumors, this was the first time they would see them in action.
However, the most eye-catching was Yue Chuan; he stepped onto the stage directly with the Sword Spirit Ah Lan.
A Sword Spirit, being part of a sword, did not violate any rules.
Lu Yang did not allow the Immortal Sword Spirit Fairy Eternity to take the stage. If the Fairy were to join in, not to mention the Sword Cultivators participating in this Sword Inquiry Convention, even if all the Sword Cultivators from all previous conventions were bundled together, they wouldn't be enough for Fairy Eternity to fight alone.
Lu Yang believed in fighting honorably and squarely and not relying on those nebulous external powers.
Lu Yang's opponent was a Cultivator dressed in somewhat strange attire, pale-faced and seemingly unable to withstand a breeze, holding an Ice Sword with snowflake patterns etched onto its surface.
Mingtai had mentioned this person before; he was a Cultivator from the Extreme Northern Lands named Xue Shilou, somewhat famous in that region.
To be introduced by Mingtai meant he must possess exceptional skills. However, when compared to Lu Yang, he was undoubtedly far inferior.
"It's a shame for this Xue Shilou, encountering Lu Yang in the first match."
"No helping it, that's just bad luck there."
"It's uncertain how much of Lu Yang's strength he'll be able to force out."
"I hope the fight lasts a little longer, the more of Lu Yang's hidden cards are forced out, the better for us."
Hearing the soft discussions of the Sword Cultivators below the stage, Xue Shilou's eyes were full of determination. So what if Lu Yang had high Swordmanship Talent? He could make up for the gap with effort. Over his tens of years practicing swordsmanship, his tears, sweat, and scars were countless.
On this journey, he had faced so many powerful opponents, and many had said he couldn't win, yet he proved them all wrong in the end.
On the platform, within a moment's time, they exchanged dozens of moves. Xue Shilou lived up to his reputation as a Swordsmanship genius from the Extreme Northern Lands, tempered over the years, with a Sword Intent that carried a trace of severe cold and decisiveness.
This was Lu Yang's first time experiencing a fight as an incarnation of Sword Intent, and he found it quite novel.
After experiencing what it was like to fight as an incarnation of Sword Intent, it was time to get serious.
As Lu Yang's sword skills changed, Xue Shilou suddenly felt the pressure multiply. It was as if Lu Yang wasn't wielding a sword, but a great hammer capable of shaking heaven and earth. Each collision sent shockwaves up his wrist, making them tingle numb.
Could this be Lu Yang's true strength? Had everything before just been a warm-up?
Cold sweat broke out on Xue Shilou's forehead. Since they both used incarnations of Sword Intent, unrelated to cultivation level, it meant Lu Yang's Sword Intent was far superior to his.
Lu Yang's sword skills were both heavy and fast. He seemed to see through Xue Shilou's moves, aiming at his weaknesses with every strike, forcing Xue Shilou into a position where he could only defend, unable to attack.
The spectating Sword Cultivators also realized that Xue Shilou was merely resisting and that defeat was only a matter of time.
But none of them could figure out how, if they were in his shoes facing Lu Yang, they probably would end up with the same fate as Xue Shilou.
"Why not just concede?" Lu Yang suggested earnestly, wanting to finish the fight early so he could watch how others competed before their matches ended.
"No!" said Xue Shilou earnestly. Even though he was at a disadvantage, his eyes were resolute, not swayed by the overwhelming disparity in strength.
Lu Yang was taken aback for a moment, realizing his attitude was incorrect. As a Sword Cultivator, one should fight to the last moment. The notion of conceding was akin to slapping Xue Shilou in the face. "Sorry," Lu Yang said seriously, "As compensation, I will use my full strength to defeat you!"
Feeling Lu Yang's increasingly heavy and swift attacks, Xue Shilou was drenched in sweat, and his blood was almost boiling.
Was the gap between himself and a real Swordmanship Talent so vast? Was he truly going to stop here?
Xue Shilou's expression became distant for a moment as his memory was pulled back to his childhood.
...
In the midst of the heavy snowfall, Xue Shilou, holding a broken iron sword, stood on a wooden post as the north wind whistled past, the snowflakes hitting his face painfully.
"Master, I can't hold on much longer."
Xue Shilou gritted his teeth as he spoke, not daring to speak loudly for fear of swallowing the descending snowflakes.
His master, hunched over, leaning on a cane, seemed completely oblivious to Xue Shilou's teetering stance.
"Continue to endure, you must adapt to this environment, block this blizzard, and in the future, you will understand the significance of today's training."
...
"Master, had you foreseen today's events long ago?" Xue Shilou murmured to himself, Lu Yang's attack was strikingly similar to the blizzards of the Extreme Northern Lands.
He slowly reined in his sword skills, narrowing his defensive stance, adjusting his movements, and stood in a somewhat odd posture—it was the stance of Stance Sword Style.
He gradually recalled his master's teachings, every detail of practicing the sword, and how seemingly unrelated techniques at thmoment linked together to form a new move.
"Stance Sword Style!"
This was the sword style that could withstand the fierce blizzard, the one even his master had not completed!
"Slice."
Lu Yang softly uttered the word "slice" as his Sword Qi transformed into a full moon, piercing right through Stance Sword Style and knocking Xue Shilou to the edge of the arena, rendering him unconscious.
"Junior Brother Xue is unconscious, this is not good," a sword cultivator watching below said urgently upon seeing Xue Shilou pass out.
"Fellow daoist, what will happen now that Xue Shilou is unconscious?" someone asked.
The man sighed, "Xue Shilou is my junior brother; he was an orphan picked up by our master. At a very young age, he showed an astonishing swordmanship talent, and the master considered him his rightful successor."
"Just when the master thought he had taken in a good disciple, an accident happened. Junior Brother Xue fainted and upon losing consciousness, another consciousness took over his body. Under that condition, Junior Brother Xue became cruel and formidable, and it was during such a time that he broke our master's leg."
"Later, when Junior Brother Xue woke up, he remembered nothing, and neither I nor the master ever spoke of the incident."
"Master suspected that Junior Brother Xue had experienced some trauma before being found, resulting in his split personality."
Sure enough, after Xue Shilou lost consciousness, he somehow managed to stand up again, and his entire demeanor underwent a dramatic transformation.
"How could this trash faint again, it looks like I'll have to handle this," "Xue Shilou" said, looking at Lu Yang with a cruel smile on his lips.
"Slice."
As usual, Lu Yang softly uttered "slice," knocking the alternate persona of Xue Shilou unconscious as well.
Within the world of Xue Shilou's mind, there existed two versions of himself, one embodying light and the other darkness.
"So it was me who broke Master's leg?" the bright Xue Shilou cried out in anguish, "No, it was you, you're the one who hurt the master!"
The dark Xue Shilou snorted at this, "So what if I did? It's all because the Bloodline Power within you is too overpowering to control, which is why my personality was split from yours."
"Without me, you would have frozen to death before our master ever found you."
Seeing the bright Xue Shilou still crying, the dark Xue Shilou showed a look of frustrated concern.
"Crying, what's the use of crying? Will tears defeat your opponent?"
"Then what do you suggest we do!" the bright Xue Shilou shouted between sobs.
The dark Xue Shilou revealed a complicated smile, "Just now, you grasped the Stance Sword Style and ascended to a new level of realm, just a little help shy from being ready to handle your Bloodline Power."
"A little help?" the bright Xue Shilou was taken aback.
Without explaining further, the dark Xue Shilou stepped forward and embraced the bright Xue Shilou, his form slowly dissolving.
"We need to merge. I hope when I am gone, you will no longer be the crybaby who weeps at every difficulty."
"Little An!" the bright Xue Shilou shouted, desperately trying to grasp the other aspect of himself, but in the end, all he clutched was a patch of light.
In reality, the fallen Xue Shilou once again slowly rose to his feet, his gaze filled with sorrow and resolve. He slowly raised his sword, facing Lu Yang, as if speaking as one person, yet simultaneously as two voices in unison.
"Lu Yang, I will defeat you!"
"This aura, he possesses the legendary Bloodline of the Snow Emperor!" a sword cultivator from the Extreme Northern Lands exclaimed from below.
"Are you never done, slice!" Lu Yang roared angrily, striking out with his sword.
Xue Shilou fell from the arena.

chapters.title: Chapter 908 - 907: Use the Sword as the Body, the Body as the Sword
chapters.content:
"Finally got it done,"
For some reason, after fighting with Xue Shilou, Lu Yang felt inexplicably tired, as if he had fought three people.
Originally, Lu Yang wanted to finish the fight quickly and watch the battles of the other people in the second group.
Now, he just wanted to sit down and rest for a while.
"Right, Fairy, didn't someone in the audience just shout something about the Snow Emperor bloodline? Do you know what that is?"
Fairy Eternity shook her head, "I haven't heard of it. It's probably not anyone formidable. Didn't you just defeat his offspring?"
Lu Yang felt that Xue Shilou was quite challenging to fight. It was the first time he encountered an opponent at the same level who took three consecutive Chopping Techniques.
Oh, that's not quite accurate, either. It should be said it was the first time he encountered an opponent at the same level who took three consecutive Chopping Techniques.
After all, he had opponents like Master of All Laws, Yingtian Immortal, Qilin Immortal, and such. They would have no big problems taking three Chopping Techniques.
Lu Yang also felt embarrassed to ask the Sword Cultivator from the Extreme Northern Lands about the Snow Emperor bloodline.
From the reaction of the Sword Cultivator from the Extreme Northern Lands, it seemed that the Snow Emperor bloodline was quite terrifying, and might hold a high status in the hearts of the cultivators from the Extreme Northern Lands.
He had just defeated Xue Shilou, so asking what the Snow Emperor was and if it was formidable felt akin to rubbing salt into wounds—such a foolish act was not something even Fairy Eternity would do.
"Hey, why don't you just ask the Sword Cultivator from the Extreme Northern Lands? Then you will know what the Snow Emperor bloodline is," Fairy Eternity, as Lu Yang's golden finger, came up with a good plan to give him advice and help him strategize.
Lu Yang: "..."
"Congratulations on the win," Yun Mengmeng approached with a beaming smile to congratulate him.
"Easy peasy." In front of a Golden Core Cultivator, Lu Yang still had to put on an act, not showing any sign of weariness.
Seeing Lu Yang step down, the crowd voluntarily made way for him.
The three moves of the Chopping Technique were nothing more than the most basic sword skills of a Sword Cultivator, but in Lu Yang's hands, they seemed to have undergone a metamorphosis—far more potent than any they had seen.
Few could withstand even a single move.
Practicing the most basic sword skills to such a level of power, one could imagine how hard Lu Yang must have trained in private.
Not only was his Swordsmanship Talent exceptional, but his work ethic seemed to exceed others, too. How could they compete with that?
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, have you finished your fight too?" Mingtai came over to find Lu Yang after his own match concluded.
"I just finished fighting Xue Shilou from the Extreme Northern Lands. What about you?"
"I just finished fighting a big black dog from the Demon Territory," Mingtai recalled the recent fight, feeling restless and uncomfortable all over, wanting to take a shower.
"The big black dog was wielding a sword in its mouth and shaking saliva all over the place, even splashed it on me."
The attack power of the big black dog was average, but the mental shock it brought was tremendous. The Sword Cultivators from the Demon Territory knew what fighting with the big black dog entailed, and nobody wished to draw him as an opponent.
Luckily, the one with the misfortune was Mingtai.
After the second group's battles concluded, the third, fourth... up to the thirty-second group's battles all ended smoothly, leading to another round of chaos and re-drawing of lots.
Next, Lu Yang encountered a Female Cultivator disguised as a man, trying to prove that women too could become top Sword Cultivators.
"Chop."
He encountered a daughter who took her father's place in the Swordsmanship Tournament when he fell ill and couldn't leave his bed.
"Chop."
He encountered a Female Sword Cultivator who believed only the strong could become her husband and came to challenge the best.
"Mingtai, let's switch opponents."
"Ah, oh."
"Little Yang, Little Yang, I want to try going up there too after a while," Immortal Lu said.
Fairy Eternity watched as Yue Chuan and his wife, Sword Spirit Ah Lan, combined forces to become unbeatable, conquering all adversaries before finally falling to Lu Yang's hands.
Even though they were defeated, Fairy Eternity thought the cooperation between the sword cultivator and the sword spirit in battle was cool and wanted to try it for herself.
"Ah? Fairy, you're going to take action?"
Lu Yang thought to himself, do I need to get the Sword Tower Supreme and the Zither and Sword Venerable resurrected and tied up for your match?
"Oh dear, I won't reveal my face," said Fairy Eternity with a giggle, knowing she had to keep a low profile and not show herself in public.
"When the time comes, you just need to hold tight to the Green Peak Sword."
Lu Yang had no idea how Fairy Eternity planned to fight and was quite perplexed, but since it was a request from Fairy Eternity, he could only accept it.
"Lu Yang, fellow cultivator, I didn't expect to cross swords with you at the Sword Inquiry Ceremony."
This time, Lu Yang's opponent was Qiu Kun from the Chaos Tribe.
Lu Yang had watched Qiu Kun's battles several times; indeed, there was something unique about him. His fighting style emphasized the integration of Yin and Yang and the combination of hardness with softness. His sword skills transitioned extremely smoothly, leaving his opponents no chance to react.
"I also didn't anticipate that the Chaos Tribe would have a swordsmanship expert like you. It's truly regrettable that I didn't cross swords with you when I visited the Demon Territory."
This integration of Yin and Yang, this combination of hardness with softness, it was somewhat similar to the Dao Fruit of Immortal Jiuchong. Lu Yang felt it was better to adapt to this simpler version in advance, rather than suddenly facing the Yin and Yang torment from Immortal Jiuchong.
As soon as the fight began, the Green Peak Sword took Lu Yang by surprise, lunging straight at Qiu Kun and giving both Lu Yang and Qiu Kun a huge shock.
Lu Yang didn't expect this to be Fairy Eternity's way of fighting, and Qiu Kun didn't expect this to be Lu Yang's way of fighting either.
Qiu Kun was known for his unpredictable and surprising fighting style, but this time, to his astonishment, Lu Yang had seized the initiative.
"Indeed a tough opponent, disrupting my train of thought right from the beginning!"
"Right, only an opponent like this is challenging!"
"Lu Yang, let's fight!"
"Little Yang, let's charge!" the Sword Spirit in the Green Peak Sword shouted with a voice only Lu Yang could hear, frolicking like a runaway wild horse. If not for Lu Yang's tight grip, he might have been thrown off.
The Tower Manager watched Lu Yang with a serious expression and said to the Elders sitting on both sides.
"Young talents are frightening, haven't you noticed? The Green Peak Sword always moves first, and then Lu Yang follows."
"What does this mean? It means that Lu Yang has reached the legendary alternative realm of Unity of Man and Sword, where the thought reaches the Green Peak Sword first, and then the body!"
"The sword is the master, he is the servant; so that's what it means."
"Amazing indeed."
One of the Elders couldn't help but ask, "Let's put Lu Yang's matter aside for now. After Mingtai defeated that female sword cultivator, she has been clamoring to become Mingtai's wife. What should we do?"
Another Elder was anxious, "That's not possible! We cannot allow Mingtai to do something that would dishonor the Venerate!"
On the stage, Fairy Eternity grasped a new level of Unity of Man and Sword, controlling the Green Peak Sword to fling Lu Yang around, making him collide with Qiu Kun.
"Hey ya!"
With no other choice, Lu Yang had to wrap himself in Sword Qi and kick at Qiu Kun.
Qiu Kun, famous for his variable sword skills, couldn't have expected this kind of tactic, and again, each of Lu Yang's attacks took him by surprise, beyond his expectations.
"Is this the legendary embodiment of the sword, the body itself becoming the sword?"
"Chain Sword Qi Kick!"
Lu Yang shouted, his leg skills were also exceptional, and his feet tumbled rapidly, each kick charged with Sword Qi striking Qiu Kun's chest. The attack was like a fierce storm, leaving no time for reaction and directly kicking him off the stage!

chapters.title: Chapter 909 - 908: Swordsmanship Domain Embryo
chapters.content:
"What is this swordsmanship?"
A group of sword cultivators had witnessed the entire process of Lu Yang's fight with Qiu Kun and were all shocked as they crowded around to ask.
They had often seen people commanding swords, but it was the first time for them to see a sword commanding a person.
Lu Yang's sword intent dissipated, and his body coughed twice, having just been greatly tormented by Fairy Eternity, "I just created this sword technique; I haven't thought of a good name yet."
No sooner had he said this than an even greater sensation arose.
"To think it's a newly created sword technique, that's really formidable."
"I was wondering why the sword technique Lu Yang used just now seemed a bit rough and needed polishing. It turns out it was newly created!"
"To comprehend a sword technique on-the-fly with such power."
"Lu Yang, please give this sword technique a name."
Lu Yang was taken aback, suddenly being asked to name it was throwing him off; what should he call it?
"Then let's call it Bean Emperor Sword Technique."
After all, this sword technique wasn't truly his, it was used by Fairy Eternity, so it might as well bear her name. Lu Yang was adept at seeing things from other perspectives; if Fairy Eternity were to name it, she would certainly do the same.
"Dou Emperor Sword Technique? What a domineering name!"
"Uh, it's 'bean' as in tofu," Lu Yang further explained.
The crowd was slightly taken aback, Lu Yang might be exceptional in swordsmanship, but his naming skills were somewhat lacking.
"Little Yang, your naming skills need improvement, why not call it Eternity Sword Technique?" Fairy Eternity shook her head disapprovingly, noting that when it came to naming, it was up to herself, not to be expected from Little Yang.
The cultural gap between ministers and the emperor was evident in these little details.
Lu Yang: "..."
When had your naming skills become so impressive?
The name had been settled on, and it was too late to change it now.
The battle between Lu Yang and Qiu Kun was a semifinal match, and having defeated Qiu Kun, Lu Yang naturally moved on to the much-anticipated final.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, as expected it's just the two of us left in the end." Mingtai stood on the stage, holding his Containing Light Sword, exuding the air of a master of swordsmanship, completely hiding the disheveled state he had been in before around a certain female swordsman.
The Containing Light Sword was not only Mingtai's true form but also an Immortal Treasure personally forged by the Sword Tower Supreme, barely half a step away from being an Immortal Artifact, and could certainly be called an Immortal Sword.
In terms of quality, only Lu Yang's Green Peak Sword could confidently surpass it, even the Seven Star Sword Set couldn't compare to the Containing Light Sword.
"I thought as much," Lu Yang smiled, not surprised at all that Mingtai could stand until the end.
The Sword Spirit of the Sword Tower Supreme, and who was the Sword Tower Supreme? He was the strongest sword cultivator in history. A sword carried along in his battles would naturally give rise to an incredibly powerful Sword Spirit.
Mingtai and Lu Yang locked eyes, Mingtai feeling inexplicably vulnerable, as if Lu Yang could see right through him.
Both the sword cultivators below the stage and the higher-ups of the Sword Tower were watching the two intently, eager to know who was stronger and who was weaker.
The two talented sword cultivators both raised their Immortal Swords on the stage, with the gleaming tips pointing towards each other, their smiles slowly fading.
The sword cultivators below held their breath, watching carefully, feeling only a blur before them, and then heard the clang of steel as the two talents disappeared from their original spots, reappearing in the center of the stage.
It was not clear who made the first move, or perhaps they had both moved at the same time without prior agreement.
"Chop!"
Abandoning the usual probing, Lu Yang resolutely executed the Chopping Technique.
In the past, the Chopping Technique was always used last, as the decisive blow to determine victory, but Mingtai was clearly different from previous opponents.
"Vast Wave Sword Technique!"
Behind Mingtai appeared waves of Sword Qi that turned into a tsunami. Mist and sea breeze pervaded the stage, and as the Containing Light Sword swept through the air, it left behind countless illusory shadows.
The speed of the Containing Light Sword was pushed to the extreme, so fast that the shadows seemed to have an existence of their own.
```
"This is a sword technique created by the Sword Tower Supreme!"
Qiu Kun spoke in a grave tone, it was said that the Vast Wave Sword Technique had long been lost, and even the Sword Tower possessed only incomplete sword skills.
But looking at Mingtai's unbroken sequences, where did it resemble incomplete sword skills?
This was the complete Vast Wave Sword Technique!
"It's said that Mingtai received the inheritance of the Sword Tower Supreme, and this statement is indeed true,"
In the ten thousand years since the fall of the Sword Tower Supreme, the Sword Tower had produced countless swordsmanship talents, yet none had passed the trials of the Sword Tower Supreme to gain the inheritance. Ever since Mingtai appeared, there were rumors claiming that Mingtai had received the Supreme Inheritance of the Sword Tower.
But it was only a rumor, for Mingtai had never displayed the lost sword techniques of the Sword Tower Supreme.
Now, in his battle with Lu Yang, it seemed to confirm the truth of him obtaining the Sword Tower Supreme's inheritance.
"Chop!"
"Break!"
"Stab!"
Lu Yang was employing basic sword skills, for he had no choice, he too wanted to display dazzling sword techniques, but the problem was that no one taught him.
Even though they were basic sword skills, Mingtai dared not underestimate them. In Lu Yang's hands, those basic sword skills had long transformed into something unique, they shifted with Lu Yang's intentions, becoming infinitely variable.
Possibly, even Elder Brother Lu Yang didn't realize that the basic sword skills had already undergone a complete transformation; this was already the realm of creating one's own sword techniques.
The Green Peak Sword cleaved towards the heavens, splitting the boundless sea of Sword Qi, its sword light blazing and erupting like a volcano's mighty column of fire.
Mingtai flicked his wrist, switching sword skills, resembling a roc, a phoenix, a true dragon; momentarily, the stage seemed to be filled with innumerable ancient wild Demon Beast Illusory Shadows.
"This is the Demon Sword Technique created by the Sword Tower Supreme based on the traditional martial art of Imitation Fist!" Qiu Kun said with a solemn expression, even from below the stage, he could feel the terrifying nature of the Demon Sword Technique.
The Demon Sword Technique, also known as the Slaying Demon Sword Technique, was developed by the Sword Tower Supreme through battles with the great elders of the Demon Race, no one knows how many Demon Race elders died under this sword technique.
Mingtai tossed the Containing Light Sword upward, and it suddenly vanished. Neither the naked eye nor Spiritual Sense could detect its presence.
But as his opponent, Lu Yang knew that although the Containing Light Sword was invisible, it was still on the stage, still under Mingtai's control.
"That is the Containing Light Sword, invisible to the eye and elusive in action!"
All the Sword Cultivators were astonished; they had only heard the name of the Containing Light Sword, the Sword of the Sword Tower Supreme, but none had ever seen it.
Now, as Mingtai wielded the true power of the Containing Light Sword, they realized that what Mingtai was holding was indeed the Containing Light Sword!
With a spurt, Lu Yang sensed the danger, his body swayed, and he barely evaded the attack from the vanishing Containing Light Sword.
His body was already marked with many sword wounds, all inflicted by the Containing Light Sword, none were fatal, but if this continued, he would undoubtedly be the one to lose.
The Containing Light Sword was invisible and undetectable, Lu Yang was evading it by sensing the sharpness of the Sword Qi, but this method wasn't foolproof, there would always be omissions.
Moreover, he now had to contend with various demons shaped from the Sword Qi of the Containing Light Sword, which was quite tricky.
"Then it's time for me to get serious as well, One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand!"
Lu Yang planted the Green Peak Sword into the stage, countless Green Peak Swords spread from beneath his feet, while the sky darkened with myriad inverted Green Peak Swords.
"Is this... a Swordmanship Domain?!" The Sword Tower's higher-ups were shaken, their eyes wide, their faces incredulous, they all knew Lu Yang had mastered One Sword Becomes Ten Thousand, but they hadn't expected Lu Yang to have taken it a step further, evolving it into a Swordmanship Domain.
"No, it's still only an Embryo stage," said the Manager of the Tower calmly.
Even the Embryo stage of the Swordmanship Domain was impressive, something that cultivators in the Spirit Transformation Late Stage had a small chance of comprehending, and that under the premise of guidance.
Looking at Lu Yang, the Manager of the Tower even thought Buyu Ancestor barely showed Lu Yang much swordsmanship, and Lu Yang had developed it all by himself.
Probably the Swordmanship Domain Embryo as well.
"Was Old Buyu too lazy to teach Lu Yang, or did he feel he couldn't, worried about teaching the wrong way and that it'd be better for Lu Yang to comprehend it on his own?" the Manager of the Tower mused, observing Lu Yang within the Embryo of the Domain, feeling that even Daoist Buyu would only dare to point in a vague direction, for fear of leading astray.
Lu Yang's swordsmanship talent was so startling that it wouldn't be an exaggeration to call it the first throughout the ages.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 910 - 910: 909 Chapter: The Number One Sword Inquiry
chapters.content:
Lu Yang could not hear Tower Master's muttering, nor did he know that he was now displaying the embryonic form of his Swordsmanship Domain. He had only seen Invincible Nascent Soul do it and felt that he could do it as well.
After trying, he indeed found that he could.
Moreover, he could now simultaneously enact the Swordsmanship Domain Embryo on both the ground and in the sky.
Green Peak Swords rose from the ground, and Lu Yang's Sword Qi filled the entire space, sharpening his senses, and he could vaguely sense the location of the Containing Light Sword.
The higher-ups in the Sword Tower were so astonished to witness Lu Yang's Swordsmanship Domain Embryo, let alone the sword cultivators below.
The big black dog opened its mouth in shock, the drool-covered sword falling to the ground unnoticed.
Qiu Kun stared dumbfounded at the scene; her true Cultivation Level was at the Spirit Transformation Late Stage, barely touching the threshold of the Swordsmanship Domain, unable to even cast its embryo.
She had not expected Lu Yang to surpass her and display the Swordmanship Domain Embryo first.
"Lu Yang, I will definitely catch up to you!" Qiu Kun was not discouraged by the vast gap, her eyes even more resolute.
As a sword cultivator, one must never yield and strive for continuous progress.
"Here!"
Lu Yang's right hand suddenly lifted, and with a clang, it sounded as if something was sent flying.
Mingtai caught the Containing Light Sword, also taken aback that Lu Yang had grasped the Swordsmanship Domain Embryo.
He had accompanied the Sword Tower Supreme during the Immortal Ascension Tribulation and had been seriously injured during the Tribulation, losing most of his memory. It was only twenty years ago that he woke up, having to start all over again.
If not for that, he could have also displayed the Swordsmanship Domain Embryo.
The Containing Light Sword was still invisible, and Lu Yang could judge the Sword Skills from the movements of Mingtai's wrist. In the eyes of a true master of swordsmanship, the Containing Light Sword was no different from being visible.
This puzzled Lu Yang. Mingtai surely knew that he could predict the Sword Skills, so why would he still hold on to the Containing Light Sword?
Lu Yang allocated part of his focus, sending most of the Green Peak Swords to fight the Sword Qi Demon, facing Mingtai straightforwardly.
Mingtai once again employed the Vast Wave Sword Technique, unleashing waves of Sword Qi that surged towards Lu Yang, intending to shatter him like an unyielding rock.
Having learned a bit of the Stance Sword Technique's essence from Xue Shilou, Lu Yang remained immovable regardless of the attacks from all directions.
Xue Shilou below the stage was as if he had seen a ghost; he had just performed a few moves of the Stance Sword Technique, and Lu Yang was already imitating him?
Mingtai's figure was hidden within the sea of Sword Qi, facing the immovable Lu Yang, finding that sneak attacks from any direction were useless; he had to reveal himself for combat.
After no more than ten exchanges, Lu Yang's cheek was suddenly nicked.
Had he miscalculated his prediction?
That wasn't right.
"What's going on, didn't Lu Yang block the Containing Light Sword? How did he still get cut?"
"Is there another Containing Light Sword hidden, launching a sneak attack on Lu Yang?"
"Wasn't the Sword Tower Supreme known for using a single-handed sword?"
The sword cultivators below were abuzz with discussion, unable to understand how Lu Yang was injured.
Lu Yang momentarily created some distance and quickly grasped the reason: "So that's how it is, the Containing Light Sword can not only turn invisible but also control the length of the sword blade."
He could predict the location of the Containing Light Sword, but not its length!
"Worthy of being Elder Brother Lu Yang," Mingtai exclaimed in surprise, not expecting Elder Brother Lu Yang to so quickly see through another function of the Containing Light Sword.
Since he could not predict the length of the Containing Light Sword, Lu Yang realized that engaging Mingtai in close combat would only put him at a disadvantage.
Lu Yang's arm trembled violently, and a towering Sword Qi surged, turning into a waterfall. The white expanse was like a flood pouring down, rumbling with noise.
If he could not overcome in close combat, then he would extend the distance and fight with Sword Qi!
Mingtai anticipated that Lu Yang would do this, and with the Containing Light Sword in his possession, there would be no one at the same stage who could best him in close combat.
The Containing Light Sword buzzed, its Sword Qi reached the sky, as if it was the center of the world, with great stars and a great sun revolving around it.
The two distinct Sword Qis collided, unleashing terrifying power.
Upon collision, the Sword Qi shattered, the broken Sword Qi slicing their bodies. Paying no heed, as if they did not feel the pain, they swung their swords again, ferociously tearing through everything, utterly domineering.
The sword cultivators below pondered deeply, discerning that in both their hearts was a breath, a notion, the idea of being the strongest in their stage. Only with this momentum could sword cultivators cut through thorns, march courageously forward, and breakthrough one bottleneck after another!
This is the true meaning of Inquiry of the Sword in Intent!
Neither held back, each Sword Qi aiming to overpower the other, but each time they collided, it ended shattered.
The power of their Sword Qis was equally matched; no victor could be determined!
"Unity of Man and Sword!" Mingtai shouted loudly, merging with the Containing Light Sword, returning to his original form, and his Sword Qi's power surged once again.
"If that's the case…" Lu Yang seemed to have thought of something, preparing to make an attempt.
He abandoned using the Swordmanship Domain Embryo to fight the Sword Qi Demon, allowing it to rush at him, leaving him riddled with countless wounds.
Above and beneath, the Green Peak Swords trembled and flew out, transforming into sword light, resonating and merging with Lu Yang's charging Sword Qi.
The already extreme Sword Qi incredibly rose even further!
"This is... Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin!" The Manager of the Tower barely recognized the technique Lu Yang was using.
With his experience, he should have recognized it at a glance, but the problem was that Lu Yang's technique was so obscure, it didn't look like it was learned through proper channels at all!
The Manager of the Tower guessed correctly, Lu Yang had never learned Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin. He had seen it performed once by Daoist Buyu in a fight against the Ruthless Sect. Based on that memory and his own understanding of swordsmanship, he had improvised on the spot!
Of course, it was very different from the original Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin!
Lu Yang had no choice; he couldn't display Sword Qi Turns into Tiger, Sword Qi Turns into Phoenix, Sword Qi Turns into Dragon, or the Extinguishing Immortal Sword Array in public.
