Since that was the case, he could only try a new technique.
Their Sword Qis continued to expand, and the sword cultivators below could not tell which was stronger. They swallowed hard, staring intently at the stage without daring to blink, afraid of missing any detail.
The answer was revealed soon.
Boom!
Like the heavens tipping over, two Sword Qi dragons collided, erupting into a splendid sword rain, ringing loudly!
Both were blown away by the powerful energy from the Sword Qi collision.
Mingtai, like a kite with its string cut, plummeted outside the arena!
Lu Yang, as well, uncontrollably staggered backwards, continuously dissipating the shockwave's force, abruptly putting strength into his right arm, and with a loud shout, stabbed the Green Peak Sword into the ground, finally pinning himself to the stage!
The Manager of the Tower flew above the stage, his gaze sweeping over the crowd with seriousness, before finally resting on Lu Yang, showing a hint of approval, and declared loudly.
"Lu Yang's Sword Heart, apparent to heaven and earth, unprecedented."
"Lu Yang's Sword Intent, clear and pure, soaring into the clouds."
"In the Inquiry of the Sword segment, Lu Yang, first place!"
The sword cultivators below cheered. They had witnessed Lu Yang's strength from start to finish, all shouting "Lu Yang is number one," their voices thundering and echoing around the Sword Tower.
Lu Yang had a dazed look, swaying from side to side, the recent battle draining all his energy.
"You guys... while you have the time to shout that I'm number one... could someone come and give me a hand..."
Thud, he collapsed.

chapters.title: Chapter 911 - 910: Carrying a Small World with You
chapters.content:
Lu Yang woke up leisurely, to find himself lying on the ground. Yun Mengmeng was looking at him with concern.
"How long was I unconscious?" Lu Yang's mind was somewhat muddled, remembering only that he had fought until he was utterly exhausted and then lost consciousness.
"About ten breaths." Yun Mengmeng lived a carefree life and was never particularly sensitive to time.
"Lu Yang, take this elixir," the Sword Tower Elder hurried over as well, quickly taking out a high-quality elixir for Lu Yang to recover.
The elixir was refreshing as it dissolved in his mouth, and swallowing it made his whole body feel as cool and comfortable as if he were soaked in water.
Now clear-headed, Lu Yang was helped up by Yun Mengmeng, sat down in a meditative posture on the spot, circulated his cultivation technique to adjust his breathing frequency, and soon he was able to move freely.
His spiritual power was already comparable to someone in the Body Integration Realm, so it didn't take long to recover back to normal after being completely drained.
Mingtai, as the spirit of the Immortal Sword, also recovered quickly.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, I admire you," said Mingtai, coming over. In the battle just now, he had utilized all his trump cards, yet he still lost to Lu Yang, thoroughly convinced in defeat.
This was also the temperament of all Sword Cultivators, straightforward and simple: a win was a win, a loss was a loss, with no shame in admitting it.
"Not at all, it was just luck," Lu Yang said modestly. His final move, Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin, was merely an experiment with fifty-fifty odds of success or failure.
Many Sword Cultivators who watched the battle had some insights, and not wanting to waste time, they sat down right there to meditate.
Opportunities were precious, so the planned visit to the Sword Vault, which was supposed to start after the questioning with the sword session, had to be postponed. The Elders of the Sword Tower intervened, setting up Array Methods to prevent the Sword Cultivators from being disturbed by the outside world, allowing them to gain as many insights as possible.
While the Sword Cultivators were in closed-door cultivation, Lu Yang turned out to be the one with the most free time.
"Speaking of which, Mingtai's Containing Light Sword can turn invisible, but does my Green Peak Sword not have any special functions?"
Lu Yang examined the Green Peak Sword closely. The Containing Light Sword was just an Immortal Treasure, but his Green Peak Sword was a genuine Immortal Artifact, the personal sword of Wu Yao; logically, it shouldn't just be high in quality, but should also possess some unique functions.
"Of course, isn't it quite spacious inside this sword? Other swords don't have this kind of treatment," the Sword Spirit of the Green Peak Sword spoke.
"What do you mean... wait, Fairy, are you saying there's another space inside the Green Peak Sword?" Lu Yang caught on.
Fairy Eternity rolled her eyes, "Otherwise, where did you think I lived?"
Lu Yang thought to himself that since the Fairy was so powerful with Divine Abilities, he had assumed she was merely attached to the Green Peak Sword.
Turns out, she was living inside it.
"Wait, I'll pull you in," said Fairy Eternity.
Fairy Eternity thought Little Yang was a bit slow, not even knowing how to enter; it would be better for her to pull him in directly.
Lu Yang disappeared from the spot, without a trace, as the Green Peak Sword clattered to the ground.
"This is the inner space of the Green Peak Sword?" Lu Yang asked in surprise as he looked around in a circle.
"More precisely, this is a small world created by the Green Peak Sword," Fairy Eternity said with professional terminology.
Within the Green Peak Sword's small world, spiritual energy was abundant, mountains and rivers flowed, and the environment was pristine, secluded from the world, much like a hidden land of peace.
Lu Yang stood on a bamboo raft, floating along the river, as the mountains receded like slides in a slideshow.
The bamboo raft was something Fairy Eternity made out of boredom during her time as a Sword Spirit, for which she had cut down a large number of trees.
"How's that?" Fairy Eternity was quite pleased with herself, though it was unclear whether she was boasting about the little world or her handmade bamboo raft.
"That guy called Wu Yao had some skills, making the inside of the Green Peak Sword look decent," said Lu Yang.
"Has this little space always existed?" Lu Yang was surprised; he hadn't realized he had been underestimating the Green Peak Sword.
"Indeed, it has always been there, but it was sealed before. You couldn't enter it until your cultivation level reached a certain point, which is when the seal was opened and you could come in."
Lu Yang felt somewhat comforted. It wasn't that he had failed to recognize its value, but that the seal hadn't been unlocked: "When was the seal opened?"
"When you were in the Nascent Soul Stage."
"..."
Lu Yang looked at Fairy Eternity with eyes full of implicit meaning.
Feeling embarrassed under his gaze, Fairy Eternity offered an awkward smile, "Immortal here thought Little Yang knew about the space in the Green Peak Sword and simply couldn't be bothered to explore it."
"After all, aside from the beautiful scenery, there isn't much else here that's interesting."
Lu Yang thought about it and agreed; he didn't really need a small world of his own to carry around.
If he had had a personal little world in his previous life, every flower and grass here would be an elixir, and just taking one out would have brought a wealth of shock.
Otherwise, one might farm in the little world, where the abundance of spiritual energy would certainly mutate any seeds planted here, astonishing everyone when brought out into the outside world.
Unfortunately, he hadn't had a small world in his previous life. It was only after transmigrating to the cultivation world that he gained one, which then seemed somewhat superfluous.
After making a round within the Green Peak Sword, Lu Yang left the sword.
Half a day passed, and the sword cultivators ended their closed-door cultivation one after another, exchanging experiences and feeling greatly enlightened.
This Sword Fair was worth attending. Contemplating just once was better than years of swordsmanship enlightenment. The fight between Lu Yang and Mingtai had shown them the future path of swordsmanship.
Sword cultivators one after another approached Lu Yang and Mingtai to express their gratitude, among them Xue Shilou and Qiu Kun.
When the last sword cultivator finished his seclusion, the Tower Master announced the start of the third and final phase of the ceremony.
"You all must have heard that our Sword Vault stores the spirit swords left by the sages of the past. Once you enter the vault, if it is fated, a spirit sword will choose to follow and recognize you as its master, and our Sword Tower will not obstruct this."
"When your destiny with the sword is exhausted, our Sword Tower will naturally reclaim the spirit sword."
"If there is no such fate, please do not force it. I know some of you possess divine strength capable of forcibly pulling out the spirit swords."
"Should this provoke the anger of the spirit swords and an accident occurs, the Sword Tower will not be responsible."
The sword cultivators praised the Tower Master for his righteousness; even when other swordsmanship sects had spirit swords, they would rather wear out the spirit of the swords completely than allow outsiders to use them.
"If there are no objections, then follow me," said the Tower Manager.
Leading the way, the Tower Manager brought everyone down into the Sword Tower.
The sword cultivators were all nervous; recognizing spirit swords was a matter of destiny, which had nothing to do with realm or talent. History was full of such examples: an ordinary cultivator being recognized by a spirit sword with great origins, and thus becoming an extraordinary sword cultivator.
The Sword Vault was a huge hollow, as though someone had hollowed out a space underneath the Sword Tower with a sword—utterly without decoration, quite primitive, with only a top-grade Night Pearl at the top that had shone for ten thousand years, providing light for the Sword Vault.
All kinds of spirit swords were carelessly inserted all over the vault, some on the ground, some on the walls, which didn't indicate negligence from the Sword Tower, but rather that the spirit swords themselves preferred to be arranged in such a manner.
"Who knows how many spirit swords will find masters this time," remarked an elder.
The Tower Manager beside him said, "It might be none at all."
"Ah? Why?" The elder was puzzled.
Gazing at Mingtai entering the Sword Vault, the Tower Manager said solemnly, "Don't forget Mingtai's identity, the Venerate Sword. He is like an elder brother to all spirit swords. To him, the Sword Vault is akin to a harem."

chapters.title: Chapter 912 - 911: Please Advise, Junior Brother Mingtai
chapters.content:
```
Mingtai held a status like no other, as the Sword Tower Supreme's personal sword, all the spirit swords in the Sword Vault were his juniors.
However, there was no seniority among swords, that was a relationship invented by humans. Among spirit swords, there was only the strong and the weak, with the weak submitting to the strong.
From this perspective, Mingtai could be considered the eldest brother of all the spirit swords in the Sword Vault. If he wished, all the spirit swords would submit to Mingtai and follow him out of the Sword Vault.
Mingtai was also aware of his own status within the Sword Vault, akin to that of an emperor. If he were to go in, it would leave no opportunity for others.
Therefore, he considerately made his way to the back of the line, planning to enter last, to give everyone else a chance.
At the same time, he also stopped Lu Yang, "Elder Brother Lu Yang, do you want to go in last with me? There are some things I can't tell you, but I can assure you that if you take a liking to a particular sword, I have a way to make that sword follow you."
Lu Yang could probably guess where Mingtai's confidence stemmed from and, appreciating Mingtai's willingness to help, it would seem unkind of him to refuse the offer.
"Alright, then I'll thank Junior Brother Mingtai first."
Mingtai smiled. He wanted to show off a little in front of Lu Yang.
In light of Lu Yang's face, Yun Mengmeng also had the opportunity to visit the Sword Vault, and the Sword Tower had agreed that if Yun Mengmeng and a spirit sword were fated, she could also take one with her.
"This sword looks pretty nice." In a corner of the Sword Vault, Yun Mengmeng squatted down with interest to look at a finely made thin sword, its hilt adorned with many patterns and gems.
Only the hilt of the thin sword was exposed, with the blade buried in the soil.
She poked the sword without any reaction, which meant that she had no affinity with this sword.
"Come out and let me see what your blade looks like." Yun Mengmeng poked the thin sword again.
The thin sword communicated an unplesant thought, telling Yun Mengmeng, this little girl, to roll far away, and if she kept yammering, it would teach her a lesson.
Yun Mengmeng had never been cursed at like this before and felt somewhat displeased. She effortlessly pulled the thin sword out from the soil.
The thin sword was enraged and vibrated incessantly, trying to break free from Yun Mengmeng's grasp to teach this little girl a lesson!
"Stop shaking." Yun Mengmeng flicked the blade, causing the thin sword to buzz noisily.
The surrounding spirit swords, seeing Yun Mengmeng bullying the thin sword, seemed ready to emerge from the soil themselves.
Yun Mengmeng, sensing the disturbance, glared at them, and the nearby spirit swords didn't dare act rashly anymore.
The thin sword also realized that Yun Mengmeng had not pulled it out by sheer brute strength, but rather through the crushing force of her cultivation level. Its anger disappeared, frightened into stillness.
Yun Mengmeng found the blade had a bare surface that wasn't very appealing and lost interest, casually reinserting the thin sword into the ground.
"Was thinking of gifting you to Xiao Zhi as a present, but you're not good-looking, forget it."
Yun Mengmeng was not after quality when selecting a sword, as long as it looked nice.
"Sword brother, let's join forces from now on, and together we can surely reach the pinnacle of swordsmanship!" Someone was offering spirit swords big promises, trying to coax them out.
"If you follow me, I guarantee I can evolve you into a Sword Spirit."
"Look, our colors match quite well. We're naturally a pair, come on out."
There were also Sword Cultivators who were silent and reticent, simply sitting on the ground, trying to resonate with the spirit swords and move them with genuine effort.
But whether it was big promises or genuine emotion, all the spirit swords didn't budge; they ignored the Sword Cultivators completely.
"Why aren't you resonating with a sword?" Qiu Kun saw the big black dog squatting at the entrance like a watchdog.
Before the big black dog could answer, Qiu Kun saw it holding a sword slobbery in its mouth.
"That's fine, no need to explain, I understand."
```
Qiu Kun looked at the big black dog with a pitying gaze, "With this method, no Spirit Sword would choose the big black dog."
Qiu Kun entered the Sword Vault, using her Spiritual Sense to continuously communicate with the Spirit Swords, hoping one of them would follow her.
However, it was quite regrettable that the Spirit Swords all had their hearts set on following Elder Brother Mingtai and paid no heed to Qiu Kun.
She walked a large circle around the Sword Vault, and at last, a sword was moved by her sincerity, trembling continuously as it broke through the soil.
Holding the sword in her hands, Qiu Kun was overjoyed. The sword split into black and white hues in the middle, containing the Dao of Yin and Yang Chaos, which was most suitable for her.
Mingtai and Lu Yang stepped into the Sword Vault together.
For the ten thousand years since the Sword Tower Supreme's passing, Mingtai had always been in the Sword Vault, and he was all too familiar with it. He knew every single Spirit Sword stored here very well.
Just by standing there, many Spirit Swords became restless, eager to rush into his embrace, calling him "Elder Brother."
The other Sword Cultivators noticed the movement of the Spirit Swords, and surprised, they followed the direction to look toward the entrance of the Sword Vault.
"Mingtai has resonated with these swords?!"
The crowd was astonished; this was simply too outrageous. They had never heard of such a thing at any previous Swords Inquiry Ceremony.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, do you know how to choose the sword that you desire?" Mingtai asked.
"I would like to hear more about it."
Mingtai was an expert in this area, "The so-called desired sword is one that resonates with you."
"From what I see, Elder Brother, are you looking to wield another sword while still holding onto your current sword?"
Lu Yang nodded his head.
"In that case, the sword you choose must not only resonate with you but also with your current sword. Otherwise, your two swords may very well become contradictory."
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, you can try lifting your current sword, release your aura and the aura of your sword. If there is a sword that matches you, there will be some disturbance, and the one with the greatest response will be the one that resonates with you the most."
Lu Yang had no understanding of this area and could only follow the instructions.
He stood at the entrance of the Sword Vault, lifting the Green Peak Sword, as his aura of the Divinity Transformation Stage surged forth. The Green Peak Sword trembled slightly, rippling out Sword Qi like ripples on water.
"Resonate with the Green Peak Sword as well?" Fairy Eternity also listened seriously to Mingtai's theory.
"Now that I am a Sword Spirit, would the sword that Little Yang picks also need to resonate with me?"
Thinking this, Fairy Eternity also secretly released a thread of Immortal Charm.
This was an Immortal Charm that only Spirit Swords could sense, undetectable to Cultivators.
The Spirit Swords sensed Lu Yang's Sword Spirit Root, the presence of Immortal Swords, and the eternal power contained within the Sword Spirits of the Immortal Swords. These were the supreme existences that they aspired to!
Sword after sword within the Sword Vault trembled violently, extremely excited, and the entire Sword Vault shook as if there were an earthquake.
Mingtai was greatly astonished; he thought that an accident had caused the Sword Vault to become tumultuous. He tried desperately to issue commands to appease the Spirit Swords, but at that moment, the Spirit Swords completely ignored his commands!
The upper echelons of the Sword Tower witnessed this scene, more at a loss than ever, not knowing what had happened. Not even the Sword Tower Supreme himself should have provoked such a phenomenon!
Countless Spirit Swords broke free from the soil, either from the ground or the walls, leaving their original positions, lining up neatly in rows, and even the Chaos Yin-Yang Sword that Qiu Kun finally obtained flew out of her hands to join the lineup of Spirit Swords in the sky.
The Spirit Swords stood in formation, like an army ready for inspection by a general. Wherever Lu Yang's gaze fell, the Spirit Swords there stirred, thinking they had been chosen.
Lu Yang turned his head to look at Mingtai, feeling a bit embarrassed, "This is my first time, and I don't have any experience. I don't know which sword will resonate with me the most. Please, Junior Brother Mingtai, give me some advice."

chapters.title: Chapter 913 - 912: Descendant of the Immortal
chapters.content:
Mingtai's body shuddered, unable to utter a word.
Fairy Eternity was cautious in her actions, knowing that her existence was a secret not to be disclosed to others. She deliberately controlled it, merely spreading the Immortal Charm to each Spirit Sword, undetectable to Mingtai and the others.
However, she'd overlooked one thing: Mingtai could sense the changes in the Spirit Swords.
He sensed the Spirit Swords cheering and leaping for joy, wanting to submit to Lu Yang, who possessed a Sword Spirit Root, an Immortal Sword, and an Immortal Sword Spirit!
If they followed Lu Yang, perhaps they too could become Immortal Swords, birthing Sword Spirits of the Immortal Artifact Level!
For every Spirit Sword, this was an opportunity of a lifetime!
Disbelieving, Mingtai looked at Lu Yang. Lu Yang possessed a Sword Spirit of Immortal Artifact Level?!
How did he achieve that, had there ever been a Sword Spirit of such a level in history?
If not for his current human form, he would have desired to become Lu Yang's sword!
The Tower Master and others couldn't perceive the thoughts of the Sword Spirits as clearly as Mingtai could.
"How is this possible, why is Lu Yang so popular?"
They were utterly baffled; this was not something that could be explained merely by possessing a Sword Spirit Root.
When Daoist Buyu participated in the Sword Inquiry Ceremony, he only received recognition from a small number of Sword Spirits.
Daoist Buyu caused quite a stir back then, but compared to the current Lu Yang, it was nothing.
The other Sword Cultivators stood rooted to the spot, their gazes vacant as they looked at Lu Yang, who stood at the entrance, backed by light, appearing like a deity.
Despite their best efforts, they couldn't gain recognition from even a single Spirit Sword, yet Lu Yang merely stood there exuding his presence, which caused the Spirit Swords in the Sword Vault to swarm to him.
Xue Shilou was dumbstruck, blurting out a question, "Isn't sword selection supposed to be about fate?"
Did Lu Yang really have such a fate with every Spirit Sword in the Sword Vault?
Although it was Lu Yang's first visit to the Sword Vault for sword selection, seeing the multitude of Spirit Swords and Mingtai's reaction, he also knew something was amiss.
The current situation likely had little to do with him; it was the doing of the pretended Sword Spirit, Fairy Eternity.
Fairy Eternity, thrilled, said, "Little Yang, hurry and collect them all; we have a place for the souls of Captive Peak's prisoners!"
Fairy Eternity still remembered the prisoners from Captive Peak.
"Don't worry if your Identity Jade can't hold them all, we still have the small world of the Green Peak Sword, that should be enough."
Fairy Eternity had considered everything, even how to move the Spirit Swords.
Of course Fairy Eternity was happy; Little Yang was a pillar minister of the Great Bean Dynasty, these Spirit Swords laid out by little Yang would naturally become possessions of the Great Bean Dynasty.
Fairy Eternity was always cunning when it came to affairs of the Great Bean Dynasty.
Lu Yang: "…"
Fairy, you certainly are thorough, but have you considered the reaction of the Sword Tower?
As Lu Yang pondered which sword to choose as his, Mingtai suddenly exclaimed.
"That sword is reacting too?!"
Lu Yang came back to his senses and followed Mingtai's gaze, only to see a sword still embedded in the ground of the Sword Vault, incongruous with the others that were airborne.
However, that sword was trembling continuously, clearly reacting to Lu Yang as well.
"Is that sword very powerful?" Lu Yang asked, puzzled.
Mingtai's expression grew solemn: "I can control all the Spirit Swords in the vault, except for that one."
"That sword was not from the Sword Tower, but the Master... the first-generation Tower Master stumbled upon it. Its grade is not below my Containing Light Sword and it truly deserves to be called an Immortal Sword."
"The first-generation Tower Master, with his unrivaled swordsmanship, could never gain the recognition of that sword. With no other option, the first-generation Tower Master left the sword in the vault, hoping that one day someone destined would obtain it."
"This is also the origin of the Sword Vault,"
Mingtai looked at the Nameless Immortal Sword that kept trembling, trying to break through the soil, and slowly said, "However, a ten thousand years have passed, and that sword has always been lying there, unresponsive to the call of any sword cultivator, until Elder Brother Lu Yang's appearance."
Lu Yang was especially surprised when he heard that it was also an Immortal Sword.
"Eh, why does this sword look so familiar?"
Fairy Eternity gazed at the Nameless Immortal Sword that only revealed its hilt, and gradually, it began to overlap with a sword from her memory.
"I remember now, isn't this the Inheriting Shadow Sword of Liu Ningxuan?"
Lu Yang felt the name Liu Ningxuan sounded familiar.
All of a sudden, he remembered, Liu Ningxuan, unparalleled in swordsmanship talent, regarded as the greatest in ancient times, master of both the zither and sword, created the technique 'Unity of Man and Sword'. In a battle with Fairy Eternity, he had reached the zenith of its potential, merging with the sword, inseparable from it.
Now when people mention the strongest sword cultivator, they often bring up Liu Ningxuan along with the Sword Tower Supreme.
The Seven Star Sword Set he had obtained from the Creation Secret Realm was once used by Liu Ningxuan!
Thinking of this, Lu Yang immediately had an ominous premonition.
Just as he was about to ask Fairy Eternity more about the situation, he saw the Inheriting Shadow Sword soar into the sky with an intimidating aura, dispersing the neatly arranged Spirit Swords.
A figure drifted out from the Inheriting Shadow Sword, if not Liu Ningxuan, then who?
Liu Ningxuan, dressed in ancient attire, appeared before everyone in the form of an Immortal Sword Spirit, his eyes sweeping angrily over everyone before finally landing on Lu Yang with an unkind expression.
"It was you who released the aura of the Ying Tian Immortal just now!"
"...Ying Tian Immortal?" Lu Yang hadn't expected Liu Ningxuan to ask about this upon his arrival.
With a cold sneer, Liu Ningxuan's gaze grew colder: "Still trying to deceive me? Back then, Ying Tian Immortal forced me into unity of man and sword just to escape with my life, leaving me in this wretched half-dead state; how could I mistake his aura!"
Lu Yang understood then; Liu Ningxuan's memories had also been tampered with, the mastermind behind the scenes had altered his memories to the last battle with the Ying Tian Immortal.
Although Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi's memories were also erased, they had a deep connection with Fairy Eternity. Even if they completely forgot, the moment they saw Fairy Eternity, they felt something familiar.
The same went for Liu Ningxuan; he had a life-and-death feud with Fairy Eternity, how could he completely forget her.
For various reasons, he mistook Fairy Eternity's aura for that of the Ying Tian Immortal.
"If I'm not wrong, boy, you must be a descendant of Ying Tian Immortal."
Lu Yang felt that Liu Ningxuan was gravely misunderstanding him.
But to the bystanders, it didn't seem that way at all.
If Liu Ningxuan said Lu Yang was a descendant of Ying Tian Immortal, could there be any falsehood in it?
"No wonder Lu Yang is so powerful, he must have received the legacy of Ying Tian Immortal!"
"Immortal's disciple, terrifying indeed..."
The people from the Sword Tower nodded one after another, finding an explanation for all of Lu Yang's actions.
"No wonder Lu Yang can fight to a draw with Young Sect Master Lu, it turns out both of them are disciples of Immortals."
"Hmm, you, boy, are you a Sword Spirit turned human?" Liu Ningxuan noticed Mingtai next to Lu Yang, his intent to kill rising.
After being gravely injured by Fairy Eternity, in order to escape, he used the Unity of Man and Sword technique, which resulted in the Inheriting Shadow Sword becoming damaged and reduced to a broken sword.
He then fell into a deep slumber, during which the Inheriting Shadow Sword changed hands several times, passing through the hands of numerous master smiths and swordsmanship experts who recognized its extraordinary nature and gradually restored it, reviving him in the process.
By that time, it was already the Great Yu Era.
Now, Liu Ningxuan existed in the state of a Sword Spirit, allowing him to live until the present.
Unlike Mingtai, who was an Innate Sword Spirit, he was an Acquired Sword Spirit.
Innate Sword Spirits could transform into humans, but Acquired Sword Spirits could not, bound for life to the Inheriting Shadow Sword.
This was why he especially despised Innate Sword Spirits.

chapters.title: Chapter 914 - 913: Sword Tower Supreme
chapters.content:
"What did he just say, Mingtai is a Sword Spirit turned human?"
The sword cultivators couldn't believe their eyes, looking at Mingtai. Lu Yang was a descendant of Ying Tian Immortal, and Mingtai was a transformed Sword Spirit. No, with both of your identities so special, compared to you two, are we too ordinary?
Originally, the sword cultivators felt that the arrival of the Great Era was the time for them to shine.
But they soon realized that they were thoroughly defeated just in terms of identity.
Having special identities isn't necessarily a big problem—history is full of cultivators who through arduous cultivation defeated many enemies with special identities and became celebrated stories.
The problem was, even after their strenuous training, they still couldn't defeat Lu Yang and Mingtai.
What's there to fight for in this Great Era then?
The higher-ups within the Sword Tower had subtle changes in expression, not expecting that this ancient nameless Sword Spirit would reveal Mingtai's identity so directly. They didn't know whether this was a blessing or a curse.
Yun Mengmeng quietly approached Lu Yang, sensing something off about Liu Ningxuan's demeanor. The faint aura he emitted made her uncomfortable.
If Yun Mengmeng had spent more time in the outside world, she would know this as a killing intent.
Liu Ningxuan stared at Mingtai with a malicious and dangerous look, speaking slowly.
"How wonderful it is to be an Innate Sword Spirit that can turn human. Unlike me, I can only stay inside a sword."
Lu Yang's expression changed, and he moved in front of Mingtai: "What are you going to do!"
Seeing Lu Yang's action, Liu Ningxuan found it laughable: "Kid, don't think I'm afraid of you just because you've received Ying Tian Immortal's legacy."
"Let me guess, you've only received the inheritance of Ying Tian Immortal and seen his Illusory Shadows, but never met the real Ying Tian Immortal, right?"
Looking at Lu Yang's expression, Liu Ningxuan became even more certain of his guess: "Ying Tian Immortal hasn't shown himself for a long time. Perhaps he's already dead."
With Ying Tian Immortal's love for showing off, could he stay inactive for over a hundred thousand years? There must have been a problem.
Ying Tian Immortal and he had a life-and-death enmity; had he not been wary of Ying Tian Immortal still being alive, he would have killed Lu Yang!
More than ten thousand years ago, after the Inheriting Shadow Sword was acquired by the Sword Tower Supreme, Liu Ningxuan, worried that the Tower Master might see him inside the Inheriting Shadow Sword, chose to remain asleep.
Upon awakening, he first saw the descendant of his sworn enemy, followed by an Innate Sword Spirit turning into a human. If he didn't kill the two to vent his anger, it would be unjustifiable!
Liu Ningxuan manipulated the Inheriting Shadow Sword, releasing an invisible Sword Qi. It was blindingly brilliant and splendid, more dazzling than the top-grade Night Pearl on top of the Sword Vault. The sheer power made the entire Sword Vault tremble; even the Sword Tower above swayed from side to side, unable to withstand such Sword Qi!
The invisible Sword Qi locked onto Mingtai, intent on killing him in one fell swoop!
The sword cultivators, seeing this, trembled with fear, believing that even a typical Transcendance Tribulation Stage might not be able to withstand this blow!
"Protect Mingtai quickly!"
The Manager of the Tower cried out urgently, alongside the twelve Elders, they stood in front of Mingtai. Layers of runes began flowing from their swords.
Golden runes surged forth, containing some ultimate and powerful principle. They shone brightly as they formed the great array of Swordsmanship protective circle.
Boom!
The invisible Sword Qi descended, striking the protective circle. It surged and clashed violently with the array. After holding steady for three moments, both the Sword Qi and the array shattered!
"Ahh—"
The Manager of the Tower and others were sent flying by the shockwave of the Sword Qi, not knowing how many ribs were broken, as blood spilled from their mouths.
Liu Ningxuan sneered: "Is this the level you're at?"
"You should feel lucky that I haven't taken action for tens of thousands of years and have grown rusty. Otherwise, that strike just now would have been enough to kill all of you!"
"I wonder what you plan to use to defend against this time?"
Liu Ningxuan once again gathered an invisible Sword Qi, its power even greater than before!
The manager of the Tower and the others turned pale upon seeing this, having already exhausted all their strength to block that sword strike, how were they supposed to block it?
Just at that moment, the top-grade Night Pearl atop the Sword Vault burst into an unprecedented brilliance, and a graceful silhouette emerged from the nine-colored divine light.
"Who dares to harm Mingtai?"
Everyone watched the silhouette within the nine-colored divine light unblinkingly, wondering which venerable figure was revealing themselves.
Upon seeing that familiar silhouette, Mingtai's eyes lit up, and he couldn't help but cry out, "Master!"
Master?
Hearing Mingtai's address, the manager of the Tower also realized who she was.
"Sword Tower's unworthy disciple pays respect to the Venerate!"
The top-grade Night Pearl shattered, the nine-colored divine light disappeared, revealing the true form of the graceful silhouette, a woman of peerless beauty, appearing delicate and frail, like a young miss from a boudoir.
Very few people knew that the Supreme of the Sword Tower was actually a woman.
"The Supreme of the Sword Tower?" Liu Ningxuan's eyes narrowed slightly, remaining very calm; this certainly wasn't the true form of the Sword Tower Supreme.
As if not seeing Liu Ningxuan, the Sword Tower Supreme descended and tenderly stroked Mingtai's head.
"So, you really have embarked on the path of becoming human."
"Master!"
Mingtai hugged the Sword Tower Supreme tightly, weeping bitterly, as he never thought he'd see her again in this lifetime.
"Alright, alright, stop crying. Am I not fine right here?" the Sword Tower Supreme soothed in a gentle voice.
Then she turned her head to look at Liu Ningxuan in the sky, "Is he the one bullying you? Watch as your sister teaches him a lesson!"
Taking the Containing Light Sword, the Sword Tower Supreme flew up to confront Liu Ningxuan, causing the air itself to become tense.
Liu Ningxuan was not afraid of the Sword Tower Supreme either, and with a scornful laugh, he said, "You really have the nerve to say you're fine, currently nothing more than a soul remnant hidden inside the Night Pearl. I presume it was only during the Sword Tower's catastrophe that you would show yourself."
"How much of your original strength can this soul remnant exert?"
Failing to pass the Immortal Ascension Tribulation meant one could not survive, yet the Sword Tower Supreme having left behind a soul remnant was already turning the impossible into the possible.
"I had suspected this sword was the Inheriting Shadow Sword, but I lacked the proof, and there was no conclusive information from the Taixue Academy."
"Unexpectedly, though the world thought you had disappeared, it turns out you've lingered in the Inheriting Shadow Sword until now," he said.
The Sword Tower Supreme pointed her sword at Liu Ningxuan, her eyebrows knit together, "Dare to harm my Mingtai, it seems you are tired of living!"
Fairy Eternity was also observing the state of the Sword Tower Supreme, "Impressive indeed, to have left behind a soul remnant from the Immortal Ascension Tribulation. Could it be she is an Initial Form of the Immortal Soul Dao Fruit?"
Apart from the Initial Form of Eternity Dao Fruit, only the Initial Form of the Soul Dao Fruit could achieve this.
"Fairy, what is Liu Ningxuan's cultivation level?" Lu Yang asked stealthily.
"Pass Tribulation Peak."
"Just Pass Tribulation Peak?" Lu Yang thought to himself that he had assumed Liu Ningxuan was a Semi-Immortal.
Suddenly he realized something was amiss. When did I start thinking so lightly of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage?
"Back then, he and this Immortal both wanted to condense the Initial Form of the Annihilation Dao Fruit. He challenged me recklessly and ended up using Unity of Man and Sword to escape in the middle of our battle," Fairy Eternity said, huffing angrily.
"It's a pity he became a Sword Spirit. Sword Spirits cannot possess a Dao Fruit Outline—oh, except this Immortal."
"If he hadn't become a Sword Spirit, there would have been a chance for him to condense the Initial Form of the Annihilation Dao Fruit," she added.
Lu Yang hadn't expected Fairy Eternity to hold such a high opinion of Liu Ningxuan, but then again, without some ability, he wouldn't have dared to challenge Fairy Eternity.

chapters.title: Chapter 915 - 914 Who Are You!
chapters.content:
In the Sword Vault, Sword Qi roiled tumultuously, as the Supreme of the Sword Tower commanded tens of thousands of swords with a domineering presence, making Liu Ningxuan, merged as one with his sword, an unstoppable force.
Clang clang clang clang, in an instant, the sound of countless Spirit Swords colliding rang out, deafening, inadvertently forming a sonic attack that was life-threatening to even those merely watching the battle.
"Run!"
Qiu Kun yelled, not caring that his Chaos Yin-Yang Sword was left behind as he turned tail and ran.
Anyone daring to remain in the Sword Vault at that moment would die without knowing how!
Other Sword Cultivators also realized that things had taken a turn for the worse and scrambled to escape.
Now, the Sword Vault had become a battlefield for two great Sword Cultivators; it was no place for mere mortals to tread, and even the Manager of the Tower and others could only stand by helplessly watching the scene unfold.
Both Sword Cultivators were in a crippled state, with Liu Ningxuan having transformed into a Sword Spirit after the Unity of Man and Sword, no longer even human, to say nothing of the Supreme of the Sword Tower, whose true form had long since fallen, now merely a residual soul relying on the Outline of the Soul Dao Fruit.
But even in their weakened states, they were not beings that Integration Period Cultivators could interfere with, and even Pass Tribulation Cultivators would have to measure their own abilities before acting.
Liu Ningxuan was qualified to be an opponent of Fairy Eternity, worthy of possessing the Outline of the Annihilation Dao Fruit, and was hailed as the premier Sword Cultivator of ancient times.
The cultivation level of the Supreme of the Sword Tower was even higher; the fact that she could Cross the Immortal Tribulation meant that she had comprehended the Outline of the Soul Dao Fruit to its limits, putting her on the same level as Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi, with only Immortality above.
Setting aside the anomaly of Yun Zhi, she was hailed as the most powerful cultivator Great Xia had ever seen!
In a sense, the swordsmanship contest between the two could be considered part of the Sword Inquiry Convention.
This was the strongest Sword Inquiry Convention ever.
"Vast Wave Sword Technique."
Sword Qi surged violently, turning the entire Sword Vault into a sea of Sword Qi, as if the waters of the East Sea had been relocated here, bringing an overwhelming sense of weight and oppressive force. Moreover, countless Sword Qi Demons of the Sea Clan roamed the sword Qi sea, frantically tearing at Liu Ningxuan.
The Containing Light Sword vanished from sight, becoming the fiercest of the demons in the sea of Sword Qi, intent on severing Liu Ningxuan's Inheriting Shadow Sword.
"Silent Destruction Sword Technique!"
The Inheriting Shadow Sword was pitch-black, thick as ink, carrying the ultimate intent of destruction, as if it were the ominous source of dread itself.
This was the edge of the Outline of the Annihilation Dao Fruit that he had touched, extremely terrifying; with this move, he had once pierced through Xuan Wu, also at the pinnacle of the Pass Tribulation Stage.
The defense-oriented Xuan Wu was as fragile as paper before this move!
Xuanxuan believed that even if her own Pass Tribulation Stage ancestor were present, they would have to avoid the edge of this sword for fear of having their Barrier Door broken by a single strike.
Upon encountering this move, the Sea Clan's Sword Qi Demons were dispersed, reduced to unstructured Sword Qi, which were devoured clean by the aura of the Inheriting Shadow Sword before even reaching the sword itself!
Clang!
All the Sword Qi was devoured by the Inheriting Shadow Sword, the only exception being the Containing Light Sword, also an Immortal Sword, which clashed against the Inheriting Shadow Sword.
The collision of the two great Immortal Swords spanned ancient and modern times, causing chunks of earth to shake and the entire Sword Vault to teeter on the brink of collapse, shaking the very foundations of the Sword Tower and putting everyone at imminent risk of being crushed.
The two unrivaled Sword Cultivators, heedless of the consequences, employed their swordsmanship, both seeking to overwhelm the other with their prowess in the sword.
The two vast domains of swordsmanship opened up, yet neither was as grand and majestic as people had imagined.
The domain of swordsmanship of the Supreme of the Sword Tower was filled with ghostly shadows, all enemies she had slain, mimicked by the Outline of the Soul Dao Fruit, allowing them to be resurrected in her swordsmanship domain.
Liu Ningxuan's swordsmanship domain was like the edge of the world, a mix of black and red as the grand sun sank and the stars shattered, with all living beings stepping into the domain meeting mysterious deaths, as if subjected to a curse of inevitable death through causality.
Even with Lu Yang's swordsmanship talent, he could not comprehend the swordsmanship domains of these two, let alone other people.
There's no need to mention Fairy Eternity, who gleaned all her understanding of swordsmanship from Lu Yang.
The Swordsmanship Domain greatly expanded and swelled, scrubbing every inch of space. The space itself seemed unstable, continually developing cracks, as if it were about to shatter!
Boom—Boom—Boom—
Under the clash of Swordsmanship Domains, the Sword Tower above finally could not withstand such power and collapsed, turning into ruins that threatened to engulf the Sword Vault.
However, amid the impact of both individuals' Swordsmanship Domains, the ruins of the Sword Tower were directly blown apart, without affecting the two at all.
Both parties were panting heavily, staring intently at each other. They were the strongest swordsmen of their respective eras, having faced formidable opponents since their debut but never encountering an enemy to truly test their skill in Swordsmanship.
"Fairy, who will win between the two?" Lu Yang asked anxiously.
Although Fairy Eternity was not very familiar with Swordsmanship, she could still distinguish their strengths and weaknesses.
"Tsk, based on their style of fighting, I'm guessing it won't be resolved in a day or two. But, that Sword Tower girl has too weak a foundation and can't last that long."
"Ah?" Lu Yang began to worry about the Sword Tower Supreme on Mingtai's behalf.
Liu Ningxuan had also noticed this detail. Although he had become a Sword Spirit, unable to turn back into a human, his advantage lay in a stable foundation. He would not flame out like the Sword Tower Supreme, akin to a flickering candle in the wind which would soon extinguish.
Following that, Fairy Eternity added, "However, if there is intervention from a third party, they will quickly be able to deal with Liu Ningxuan."
"Third-party intervention?"
As Lu Yang wondered where this third party would come from, he saw a familiar figure soaring into the high sky, flying to the side of the Sword Tower Supreme.
"Fellow Daoist, let me help you."
"Yun Mengmeng?!"
"Miss Yun?"
Upon identifying the figure, Lu Yang was shocked. How did Yun Mengmeng, who tagged along with him for free meals, transform into a powerful ally capable of fighting shoulder to shoulder with the Sword Tower Supreme in the blink of an eye?
The Manager of the Tower and others also did not expect that someone closely related to Lu Yang would be so powerful.
"Her Golden Core Stage Cultivation Level is a disguise!" Lu Yang realized, feeling that Yun Mengmeng had been dishonest.
"Wait, Fairy, why didn't you tell me?" If he couldn't see through it, couldn't Fairy Eternity see that Yun Mengmeng's cultivation level was a disguise?
Lu Yang quickly recalled all their conversations along the way, hoping he hadn't said anything too offensive to Senior Yun Mengmeng.
The only potential issue seemed to be who was Yun Mengmeng's best sister, as he seemed to have promised to teach her swordsmanship.
Somehow, Lu Yang felt uneasy, as if something bad was about to happen.
"Immortal saw you were having fun with her; if I had told of her cultivation level, I feared you would be too restrained and spoil your mood," said Fairy Eternity while pulling a face and turning away, not wanting to deal with Lu Yang.
"Who are you!" Liu Ningxuan was also startled by the appearance of Yun Mengmeng. He and the Sword Tower Supreme were in a delicate balance, where any change could tip the scales of victory.
Yun Mengmeng was about to introduce herself, but upon reflection, she realized that there was already an Yun Mengmeng who was an Immortal. She herself was not an Immortal, so claiming that name now would disgrace it, wouldn't it?
"This lady's name is Yun Zhi."
Lu Yang's legs went weak from the shock, and he almost felt like kneeling.
This is a disaster; the Fairy has doomed me.

chapters.title: Chapter 916 - 915 Restraint
chapters.content:
```
"So it's Daoist Yun Zhi," Liu Ningxuan said warily, watching Yun Mengmeng closely. If she dared to interfere in their battle, she must be confident of success.
"Thank you, Daoist Yun Zhi, for the assistance. The Sword Tower will surely repay you generously!" declared the Sword Tower Supreme.
Liu Ningxuan and the Sword Tower Supreme were both ancient characters who had never heard of the name Yun Zhi.
Strangely enough, apart from the two of them, everyone else present had heard of Yun Zhi.
The top echelons of the Sword Tower looked at Yun Mengmeng with odd expressions.
They not only had heard of Yun Zhi but had also met her several times, and it was clear to them that this woman was not Yun Zhi.
The Manager of the Tower had a different opinion, "No, it's possible that she is Yun Zhi."
"How so?"
"Think about it, she calls herself Yun Zhi, and she's very familiar with Lu Yang. Plus, Yun Zhi is known for keeping a low profile and dislikes drawing attention to herself, so it's normal for her to disguise herself."
"That makes sense," they agreed.
After all, he was the Tower Master, thinking one step ahead of them all.
The sword cultivators who had come to attend the Sword Inquiry Ceremony had only heard of the name Yun Zhi but had not seen her face.
"Yun Zhi, I remember, is the Eldest Senior Sister of the Seek Dao Sect, though she has never openly demonstrated her strength, so it's hard to say how powerful she is."
"She shouldn't be a problem. I heard our Sect Leader say that Yun Zhi is at least at the Pass Tribulation stage, possibly even a Semi-Immortal, very strong," said a sword cultivator with an extraordinary background, knowing more secrets.
Only Lu Yang had a bitter expression. Miss Yun, I've treated you well, yet you're so cruelly setting me up.
"Heaven and Earth Sword!" Liu Ningxuan shouted, determined to strike first and eliminate Yun Mengmeng to restore the balance between him and the Sword Tower Supreme!
Yun Mengmeng felt the destructive Sword Intent within the Inheriting Shadow Sword but was too late to dodge. She was hit directly by the Heaven and Earth Sword, flying out and slamming into the wall of the Sword Vault.
"I thought you had some ability, but you're just a girl who has barely survived her tribulation," Liu Ningxuan laughed heartily, having been nervous for nothing, as she turned out to be unimpressive.
A mere Early Tribulation Stage, not enough to upset the balance.
"Daoist Yun Zhi!" exclaimed the Sword Tower Supreme in shock, barely into the fight and she seemed already defeated.
Lu Yang, however, was surprised by Yun Mengmeng's realm. Yun Mengmeng and the Eldest Senior Sister were sisters, which suggested they were not far apart in age.
Dai Bufan was of similar age to the Eldest Senior Sister and was only in the Mid Integration Stage, was Yun Mengmeng already at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage?
Such a talent in cultivation could be called terrifying.
"That scared me to death," Yun Mengmeng exclaimed as she crawled out from the wall, still shaken. She rarely fought others, let alone staked her life in combat. She had a smooth journey breaking through to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, and Liu Ningxuan's unexpected attack with the sword was indeed beyond her reaction.
"Not even a warning before the attack, I thought I was going to die," Yun Mengmeng said, still frightened but feeling the move was nothing to worry about.
Liu Ningxuan's brows furrowed. His sword was strong enough to pierce a member of the Black Tortoise Clan at the Early Tribulation Stage, so how come it didn't affect her at all?
He knew he couldn't have misjudged her level.
Something was off.
"Come again, this time I promise you won't hit me again," laughed Yun Mengmeng.
"Silent Destruction Sword Technique!"
Liu Ningxuan swung his sword fiercely once more at an even faster speed than before, and although Yun Mengmeng was prepared, she couldn't dodge in time.
The speed of this sword exceeded the reaction limit of the Early Tribulation Stage!
Boom!
Once again, Yun Mengmeng was hit and sent flying.
Liu Ningxuan watched her in disbelief, as she had, yet again, emerged unscathed!
"I refuse to believe this!" Just as Liu Ningxuan was ready for an even more powerful blast of Sword Qi, a surge of fierce Sword Qi came attacking him.
"Are you acting like I don't exist?" shouted the Sword Tower Supreme, seeing something mysterious about Yun Mengmeng, hope rising in her heart.
It seemed Yun Mengmeng was not as weak as she had first appeared.
```
"Soul Sword Domain!"
"Annihilation Sword Domain!"
The two great domains of swordsmanship appeared again, covering the heavens and the earth, as Yun Mengmeng rode a demon towards Liu Ningxuan to attack.
Liu Ningxuan sneered, "Foolish, any creature that steps into the Annihilation Sword Domain will be torn apart by the force of destruction, no exceptions!"
Indeed, the ferocious demon mount stepped one foot into the Annihilation Sword Domain and was instantly obliterated.
However, after dismounting from the demon, Yun Mengmeng kept rushing forward as if nothing had happened.
"This is impossible!"
She pushed out a palm gently.
"Cloud Falling Palm."
With a single palm strike, pristine white clouds emerged from behind Yun Mengmeng, rolling like the ocean's waves, soft enough to put someone to sleep.
The white clouds condensed into her palm, forming a palm print, and with a smack onto the hilt of the Inheriting Shadow Sword, it was sent tumbling through the air, spinning several times.
Those present couldn't understand why Yun Mengmeng was completely unaffected by the Annihilation Sword Domain, knowing that even the Sword Tower Supreme wouldn't dare to enter with his true form, only clashing domains instead.
Only Lu Yang probably understood.
"She has the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit!"
Yun Mengmeng's cultivation level is indeed at the Early Tribulation Stage, but it's possible to possess the Dao Fruit Outline at the Early Tribulation Stage!
She's not in the Tribulation Stage, but a Semi-Immortal!
"Unaffected by attacks, and unfazed by the Annihilation Sword Domain, her Dao Fruit must be related to defense, like Vajra, Immovable, or does she possess an Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit with an immortal nature?!"
Fairy Eternity's face broke into a smile.
"You guessed right, it's the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit."
Immortal, unchanged and unwavering, eternal, the very antithesis of annihilation!
The very idea of annihilation that Liu Ningxuan was proud of had no effect on Yun Mengmeng.
Unless Liu Ningxuan possessed the Initial Form of Annihilation Dao Fruit!
But a Sword Spirit would not possess the Initial Form of Annihilation Dao Fruit!
Lu Yang got it, no wonder Fairy Eternity said that the entrance of a third party could change the situation, this was purely a restraint on Liu Ningxuan.
"It's just that this girl's combat experience isn't great, her movements are clumsy, and limited by her cultivation level, her attack power is also insufficient."
How could the sword cultivators understand this? To them, Yun Mengmeng seemed possessed by a divine demon, akin to a Golden Body Arhat from legends, invulnerable to all laws, instantly realizing that Yun Zhi was truly formidable, managing to suppress Liu Ningxuan in a fight.
Yun Mengmeng stood at the forefront, no matter what sword technique Liu Ningxuan employed, Yun Mengmeng remained unharmed.
"Don't come near me!" As Yun Mengmeng attacked again, Liu Ningxuan, if not for his Sword Spirit Body, would have been sweating profusely.
The Sword Tower Supreme followed Yun Mengmeng's lead, raising the Containing Light Sword and shouting loudly.
"Break!"
Runes shimmered on the Containing Light Sword, merging into the blade, ringing sonorously as it cleaved downwards, carrying the might to sweep across all under heaven.
The Inheriting Shadow Sword was struck by the blow, acquiring a notch, and Liu Ningxuan's figure flickered, finally, his foundation was injured!
Just as the Sword Tower Supreme and Yun Mengmeng were about to collaborate to break the Inheriting Shadow Sword, the sky suddenly turned pitch black, shrouded by inauspiciousness.
A silhouette slowly appeared above the ruins of the Sword Vault, his face indifferent, holding a broken bowl in his hand. He tossed it into the sky, covering all the places of the Sword Tower.
Looking at the Containing Light Sword and the Inheriting Shadow Sword, he revealed a slight smile.
"Crafting an Immortal Sword just lacked some materials, so I'll just use you to make up for it."
Seeing that silhouette, Lu Yang's expression slightly changed.
Yingtian Immortal!

chapters.title: Chapter 917 - 916: The Bizarre Yingtian Immortal
chapters.content:
```
"Who is there!" the Sword Tower Supreme shouted, looking up at the immortal figure as if facing a formidable enemy.
The aura that the other party was freely emitting was even much stronger than her state before passing the Immortal Ascension Tribulation!
This was absolutely an Immortal, without a doubt!
Liu Ningxuan looked at that arrogant silhouette, and all sorts of unpleasant memories surged to his mind, slowly he spat out three words through gritted teeth.
"Ying Tian Immortal..."
He had heard clearly just now, Ying Tian Immortal wanted them to forge Immortal Swords, and if the Inheriting Shadow Sword was refined, could he still live?
You called for it earlier with your loose tongue, saying that Ying Tian Immortal probably had an accident.
Well, now the person has popped up.
"What, he is Ying Tian Immortal, one of the Four Ancient Immortals from the legends!"
Though Liu Ningxuan wasn't loud, after the arrival of Ying Tian Immortal, the entire area fell silent as a grave, and everybody heard his words loud and clear, and they were greatly shocked.
They could clearly feel the malice emanating from Ying Tian Immortal.
The comer is not good!
The Four Ancient Immortals, the most ancient of Immortals. Because the ages are so far apart, many legends are shrouded in a mythical hue, making the Four Ancient Immortals seem even more terrifying.
"Fairy, is that Ying Tian Immortal?" Lu Yang's brows were knit together with dark clouds, feeling that the temperament of Ying Tian Immortal amidst the Heavenly Tribulation was very different.
Fairy Eternity remained silent, seemingly deep in thought.
Lu Yang knew that the situation was completely out of control, and he hastily attempted to summon his Eldest Senior Sister, only to end in failure.
After Ying Tian Immortal made his appearance, he threw out a broken bowl that covered the Sword Tower, and Lu Yang felt that this bowl had cut off their connection with the outside world, preventing him from contacting his Eldest Senior Sister.
"Fairy, what is this bowl?"
Fairy Eternity frowned, trying to identify the origin of the broken bowl: "It looks like the Qiankun Cover forged by Ying Tian Immortal, but it feels cruder than the Qiankun Cover I remember. It's like it has been reforged. No one can escape from here, and no information can be sent out.
It can temporarily deceive the earth's veins from detection, creating the illusion that everything here is normal, probably because he's worried about those two from the Jiang Family and Meng Family discovering him."
Fairy Eternity also felt that something was off about Ying Tian Immortal and didn't rashly appear to meet him.
She seemed to have made some kind of decision and spoke earnestly, "Little Yang, don't worry, with this Fairy here, you won't have any trouble."
Hearing his name called by Liu Ningxuan, Ying Tian Immortal responded with mild interest: "Oh, interesting. I wouldn't have thought a mere Sword Spirit would recognize me."
Confusion flashed through Lu Yang's mind. Ying Tian Immortal didn't recognize Liu Ningxuan?
Lu Yang swiftly asked, "Fairy, the Ying Tian Immortal from the ancient times has never met Liu Ningxuan before?"
Fairy Eternity was just as puzzled. She wanted to use her immortal sense to take a closer look at Ying Tian Immortal but worried about being discovered, which could bring danger to Lu Yang: "Of course they've met, they have even fought many times."
Lu Yang was puzzled. "So, has Ying Tian Immortal lost his memory, or... is it that this isn't Ying Tian Immortal at all, but some entity that has taken over his body?"
This suddenly emerged Ying Tian Immortal was definitely very strange, exuding eeriness in every aspect.
Besides this, Lu Yang had another doubt.
It's been three hundred thousand years for the Great Qian Dynasty, and Ying Tian Immortal has never appeared; is this really his first time appearing?
If so, isn't that too coincidental?
If not, why has there been no news about previous appearances of Ying Tian Immortal...
Cold sweat broke out on Lu Yang's forehead; he hoped that this was Ying Tian Immortal's first appearance, otherwise, it would be really bad.
Ying Tian Immortal seemed completely oblivious to Liu Ningxuan and the Sword Tower Supreme's guard, casually saying, "Will you hand over those two swords voluntarily, or do I need to take them myself?"
"In your dreams!"
"Delusional thinking!"
Neither Liu Ningxuan nor the Sword Tower Supreme was going to hand over the Inheriting Shadow Sword or the Containing Light Sword, the former foundational to Liu Ningxuan and the latter vital to Mingtai's life.
Seeing their will to resist, Ying Tian Immortal didn't take it seriously but instead laughed heartily.
But this laughter did not dispel the chilling atmosphere and instead made the area even more sinister.
```
"Just like that, just like that, resisting is what makes it interesting."
Ying Tian Immortal glanced at the cultivators below, becoming even more delighted, "It seems my luck is good today. I sensed there were two swords here that could be used to forge an Immortal Sword. I didn't expect to find so many sword cultivators."
"It would be perfect to refine all of you into a single soul. Perhaps you might barely suffice as the sword spirit for my Immortal Sword!"
The Immortal Sword mentioned by Ying Tian Immortal wasn't like the Containing Light Sword which is an Immortal Treasure, but an Immortal Artifact of the same tier as the Green Peak Sword, which is the most standard Immortal Sword!
Otherwise, he wouldn't use two Immortal Treasures as raw materials!
The people below were despairing as if they were dead ashes; Ying Tian Immortal actually wanted to refine them all. How could they possibly live?
Many desperately tried to escape, but it was useless. How could a Qiankun Cover be broken by such minor cultivation levels?
Lu Yang's heart sank. The worst he feared had happened. Ying Tian Immortal intended to kill and silence them all, which explained why there was no information about him from ancient times to the present.
Wherever he appeared, it would become a land of death!
Especially during the Great Qian and Great Yu eras, it was common for cultivators to destroy entire cities. The few times that Ying Tian Immortal took action and mixed in, nobody could clearly identify his involvement!
In the Great Xia era, perhaps Ying Tian Immortal restrained himself a bit. Lu Yang suspected that some cases of sect extermination were not the work of demonic sects but that of Ying Tian Immortal!
And in places like the East Sea and Demon Territory, which have been fragmented for the past three hundred thousand years, even if someone was annihilated, no one would investigate thoroughly!
"Annihilation Sword Domain!"
"Soul Sword Domain!"
"Heaven and Earth Sword!"
"Vast Wave Sword Technique!"
The two pinnacle sword cultivators joined forces against the enemy, with fatal attacks as their opening moves!
They were facing an Immortal; if there was any reservation at this moment, they would be left without a place to bury their bodies!
"Cloud Falling Palm!"
Yun Mengmeng steeled herself and joined the fight.
Grandmother was right, the outside world was indeed dangerous, and her own strength was completely negligible in front of a true Great Power.
Facing the combined attack of the three, Ying Tian Immortal neither dodged nor hid. He just stood there, letting the attacks fall upon him. Immediately, dust and smoke rose, obscuring everything.
The crowd below, who were just fighting fiercely, saw the mighty combined force of the three and felt a flicker of hope for life.
However, as the dust settled, Ying Tian Immortal was unharmed!
"An Immortal Treasure Spirit, a half-Immortal's remnant soul, early stage of Passing Tribulation. You three think you can harm me?"
The Supreme of the Sword Tower gritted her teeth. If she were in her prime, she might have a slim chance to fight to the death with Ying Tian Immortal, but now as a mere remnant soul, it was wishful thinking to harm him.
"Again!"
The three joined forces once more, hoping to find a sliver of life.
Unexpectedly, Liu Ningxuan's Heaven and Earth Sword didn't strike at Ying Tian Immortal but at the Qiankun Cover.
Thud—
Like a stone dropped into a calm lake, ripples spread across the Qiankun Cover, absorbing Liu Ningxuan's sword strike.
"Trying to escape?"
Ying Tian Immortal took a large stride forward. Space contracted beneath his feet, and in one step, he reached Liu Ningxuan, grasping for the Inheriting Shadow Sword as if catching a chick.
"I happen to lack ancient memories, so let me see yours."
Ying Tian Immortal placed his hand over Liu Ningxuan's head. Accompanied by a scream from Liu Ningxuan, whose eyes rolled back as he lost consciousness, Ying Tian Immortal proceeded with the soul search.
When Liu Ningxuan woke up again, he would be mad and mindless, no longer himself.
Having obtained Liu Ningxuan's memories, Ying Tian Immortal suddenly realized, "So it is Liu Ningxuan, the top sword cultivator of ancient times, and also the sworn enemy of this body. He used Unity of Man and Sword to escape last time."
"How does that matter? Now aren't you caught in my hands?"

chapters.title: Chapter 918 - 917: Corpse Severing Method and Corpse Detachment Method
chapters.content:
After gaining Liu Ningxuan's memories, Yingtian Immortal's demeanor became radiant, causing the atmosphere around Sword Tower to feel less sinister.
Yingtian Immortal had been collecting information about ancient times, wishing to understand the predecessor of this body.
Unfortunately, the history of ancient times was too chaotic, like loose sand, and extremely difficult to collect.
With Liu Ningxuan's segment of ancient history, he managed to fill some of the void in his heart.
Suddenly, Yingtian Immortal felt two fierce attacks bursting forth at his back.
By the time he twisted his head, the two attacks were less than three inches from his brow!
"Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin!"
"Palm Thunder!"
While Yingtian Immortal was absorbed in extracting Liu Ningxuan's memories, Sword Tower Supreme and Yun Mengmeng took the opportunity to launch another joint attack.
It was thanks to Yingtian Immortal being distracted that they had the chance to gather their power for the assault.
Countless beams of Sword Qi emerged from all directions, drawn by Sword Tower Supreme and converging like a meteor shower that streaked across the sky, merging with the Containing Light Sword with an unstoppable sharpness.
The Soul Sword Domain spread out from beneath their feet, with various Sword Qi Demons integrating into the Containing Light Sword. Sword Tower Supreme's eyes revealed determination and resolve; this move was originally prepared for Liu Ningxuan, but now it had to be used against the more powerful Yingtian Immortal.
A dazzling light bloomed in Yun Mengmeng's palm, like thunder being born, accompanied by thunderous roars that were deafening, as she desperately compressed this force of thunder, continuously focusing it into one point.
Seeing this, Yingtian Immortal's head reared back, then he violently thrust it forward, using his forehead to send Sword Tower Supreme and Yun Mengmeng flying!
"Haha, not bad, you have some skill; it's not in vain that I purposely gave you an opening."
"He doesn't have the Tribulation Dao Fruit!" Fairy Eternity suddenly said.
"Why?"
"If he had the Tribulation Dao Fruit, Palm Thunder wouldn't dare to get close to him, yet he just now straightforwardly withstood the Palm Thunder's assault!"
"No Tribulation Dao Fruit, no memories of Ancient Times, and he just referred to 'this body'... Could it be that Yingtian Immortal has performed the 'Corpse Severing Method,' or perhaps the 'Corpse Detachment Method'?"
"Corpse Severing Method and Corpse Detachment?" Lu Yang heard these terms for the first time.
"I've used the Corpse Severing Method; it was when I killed the me who had the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit," said Fairy Eternity.
"The Corpse Detachment Method is leaving the flesh behind while the immortal soul transcends."
"While these methods can indeed make one stronger after being cast, the risk of failure is also very high. The consequence of failure is what you see before you: leaving behind an Immortal Corpse. When the Immortal Corpse is reborn, it forgets its former life and becomes a totally new entity."
"It's unclear which method Yingtian Immortal used to fail."
"However, the good news is that since this Immortal Corpse doesn't have the Tribulation Dao Fruit, it means Yingtian Immortal is not yet dead."
"If Yingtian Immortal were to perish, the Tribulation Dao Fruit would be transferred to this Immortal Corpse."
Lu Yang couldn't help asking, "Is it possible the Immortal Corpse developed spiritual intelligence?"
He felt that the Immortal Corpse developing spiritual intelligence also fit the current state of Yingtian Immortal.
Lu Yang remembered that Fairy Eternity had mentioned that Time Immortal's original body, the Firmament Tree, had once died, and after a prolonged period, a new Firmament Tree grew from the old one, bringing forth new spiritual intelligence—the Time Immortal.
Fairy Eternity shook her head: "It's not possible. The Immortal Corpse developing spiritual intelligence requires an extremely long period, and thirty thousand years is not enough."
Understanding the origins of the current Yingtian Immortal did not solve the predicament; Lu Yang and the others still faced an extremely dangerous situation.
When Sword Tower Supreme and Yun Mengmeng were defeated, and no one else was capable of stopping Yingtian Immortal, it would be the end for Lu Yang and the others.
"Shocking Fairy Sword!"
Suddenly, they heard Sword Tower Supreme exclaim sharply, using some technique that was even stronger than Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin by several measures!
"Don't!" shouted Mingtai. As the Sword Spirit of Sword Tower Supreme, he knew all too well what Shocking Fairy Sword meant—it was the ultimate sword that burned one's soul, and once used, even the last remnants of his master's soul would vanish!
Upon hearing Mingtai's call, Sword Tower Supreme shed tears, but she still resolutely thrust her sword towards Yingtian Immortal!
Yingtian Immortal was unimpressed, curious to see just how powerful this sword could be.
Amidst the splendid Sword Light, several drops of Immortal Blood fell from Yingtian Immortal's brow.
Sword Tower Supreme's sacrificial strike had finally caused harm to Yingtian Immortal.
And the remnant soul of the Sword Tower Supreme had become so thin that it was barely perceptible. With a clang, the Containing Light Sword fell to the ground.
He couldn't even hold onto the Containing Light Sword!
Yingtian Immortal, touching the Immortal Blood between his brows, veins bulging with rage, erupted in fury, "I originally wanted to play with you a bit longer before killing you, truly oblivious to kindness!"
Previously, Yingtian Immortal had been intentionally taking hits; if he were to strike earnestly, he could secure victory in an instant!
"You're seeking death!"
With a palm strike filled with rage from Yingtian Immortal, the winds surged, the colors of heaven and earth changed, and the pressure made it difficult for everyone to catch their breath.
Yun Mengmeng suddenly appeared, blocking in front of the Sword Tower Supreme.
Boom!
Yun Mengmeng was sent flying, but fortunately, she had the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit, which allowed her to recover from her injuries.
Yingtian Immortal gave a cold smile, realizing that Yun Mengmeng was not a simple early-stage Tribulation Cultivator; she possessed some kind of healing Dao Fruit Outline and was considered a Semi-Immortal.
But what of it if she is a Semi-Immortal?
"You wish to die together? Then I shall grant your wish!" Yingtian Immortal poised himself to cultivate his power once again.
This time, he would leave no survivors!
"Wait a moment, you can't kill them!" A voice suddenly resonated with a resolute tone.
"Who is it!"
Yingtian Immortal had not felt anyone penetrate the Qiankun Cover; was it someone inside?
His gaze quickly settled on Lu Yang.
Having accepted Liu Ningxuan's memories, Yingtian Immortal recognized Lu Yang.
The Junior Cultivator entitled to the body's legacy.
Seeing Lu Yang step forward, everyone suddenly remembered that Lu Yang had received Yingtian Immortal's inheritance. Perhaps due to this connection, they hoped Yingtian Immortal might spare them all.
"I have obtained Yingtian Immortal's inheritance. Don't you wish to know where I met Yingtian Immortal and got the inheritance?"
"If you kill both of them, I will not disclose the location of the inheritance to you!"
A cold smile appeared on Yingtian Immortal's lips as he instantly moved in front of Lu Yang, pressing down on his head.
"There's no need for you to say it; I can simply perform a Soul Search."
Lu Yang gazed firmly into Yingtian Immortal's eyes, ready to face death, "While obtaining the inheritance, Yingtian Immortal also laid down a prohibition in my mind. If you attempt the Soul-Searching Prohibition, it will activate on its own, destroying my Spiritual Space to ensure that the location of his Land of Inheritance remains unknown. If you don't believe me, you can well try!"
Yingtian Immortal wavered, uncertain of the truth.
He indeed desired to know the whereabouts of Yingtian Immortal.
"If you tell me the location of the inheritance, will the prohibition not activate?"
Lu Yang shook his head gently, "It would still activate, of course."
Yingtian Immortal grew furious, "You're toying with me!"
Lu Yang continued to shake his head, "Although I can't directly disclose it, I can hint at it through telling a story, thus bypassing the prohibition."
Yingtian Immortal's eyes brightened at this feasible solution, "Good, I won't kill the two of them, and I won't kill the rest. Tell me the story!"
"How do I know you will keep your word?"
Yingtian Immortal scoffed, "Kid, do you have a choice?"
Lu Yang clenched his teeth; he truly had no choice but to trust that Yingtian Immortal was a man of his word.
"You need to open the barrier, so they don't know what I am saying."
Yingtian Immortal saw Lu Yang's concern that after the story ended, he might kill all those who were informed. To make Lu Yang trust his promise, he casually created a barrier.
"Are you satisfied now?"
Lu Yang nodded and began to speak slowly, "This story starts in a place called the Fire Dynasty..."

chapters.title: Chapter 919 - 918 Driving the Tiger to Swallow the Wolf
chapters.content:
"The Fire Dynasty?" Yingtian Immortal frowned. He had never heard of this dynasty.
Lu Yang spoke unhurriedly, "In the Ancient Era, the Four Ancient Immortals transformed stars into continents, and then with Supreme Immortal Might, they gathered the Power of Faith to create the Fire Dynasty, the deserved Immortal Dynasty, whose power far surpassed that of the later Great Qian, Great Yu, and Great Xia."
"The Fire Dynasty also consisted of two major organizations, the Heavenly Court and the Underworld. The Heavenly Court managed affairs of the World of the Living, and the Underworld managed affairs of the Netherworld."
"The Heavenly Court was supreme, reigning over all, omnipotent. Affairs of the World of the Living, be it immortals or mortals, regardless of Cultivation Level, all must abide by the celestial laws and regulations."
"The master of the Heavenly Court was not any of the Four Ancient Immortals, but an exceptional Female Immortal from the Ancient Times who had died. She passed the Reincarnation Checkpoint, defied the great laws of life and death, used the Power of Faith to condense a Supreme Immortal Body, and came back to life, returning strongly as the master of the Heavenly Court."
"The master of the Heavenly Court came back to life? Interesting." Yingtian Immortal chuckled. At the same time, he pondered the hidden clues in the story told by Lu Yang about where the Land of Inheritance of Yingtian Immortal might be.
Could it be hinting that the Land of Inheritance is located at the juncture of Yin and Yang?
What places nowadays have something to do with Yin and Yang?
Lu Yang continued, "The master of the Heavenly Court possessed the power to destroy heaven and earth, which could erase all beings and return all to one. Even the likes of Yingtian Immortal had to bow down and admit defeat."
"...Suddenly one day, for some unknown reason, the master of the Heavenly Court decided to destroy the Heavenly Court, the Underworld, and the vast Fire Dynasty."
"The Four Ancient Immortals, along with Zuo Shi Fairy who had ascended during the era of the Fire Dynasty, a total of five Immortals, acted to stop her. But nobody expected that Time Immortal would suddenly die, and no one knew who was responsible."
"Without cooperation from the other four Immortals, each fought alone and ultimately could not defeat the master of the Heavenly Court."
"Even the Qilin Immortal, in order to protect the Dragon Clan Ancestor, engaged in battle with the master and was severely wounded."
"Yingtian Immortal fought against the master of the Heavenly Court..." At this point, Lu Yang paused.
"What was the outcome of the battle!" Yingtian Immortal hurriedly asked, feeling that this was the key information to the Land of Inheritance.
"Yes, what was the outcome indeed?" Lu Yang smiled slightly and deliberately countered with a question.
Only he could hear Fairy Eternity shouting in his ear:
"Little Yang, someone is coming!"
Seeing Lu Yang purposely holding back information, Yingtian Immortal felt underestimated and was about to make a move, but a sudden, inexplicable sense of crisis enveloped his heart.
He looked up sharply, to see a pitch-black pillar of light descending from the sky, carrying apocalyptic destructive power, piercing directly through the Qiankun Cover.
After piercing the Qiankun Cover, the pitch-black pillar of light showed no sign of stopping and continued to plummet down.
And directly beneath it were Yingtian Immortal and Lu Yang!
A smile of pleasure gradually appeared on Lu Yang's face. He looked disdainfully at Yingtian Immortal and whispered:
"Farewell, fool."
Yingtian Immortal intended to unleash his anger and kill Lu Yang, but he had no time to bother with such thoughts as the apocalyptic attack overhead came unexpectedly, and he had to defend with all his might!
"Little Yang, come in!" Fairy Eternity immediately pulled Lu Yang into the small world of the Green Peak Sword.
Boom!
The pitch-black pillar fell, destroying heaven and earth. Wherever it passed, all things perished, turning to nothingness, and hit Yingtian Immortal directly, smashing him deep into the earth. It was unknown how many thousand miles it pierced through, leaving a bottomless pit!
A golden helmet appeared above Yingtian Immortal's head. The helmet was penetrated, and its edges were scorched black. The terrifying power of annihilation kept spreading, eroding the golden helmet.
In a blink of an eye, the golden helmet turned into nothingness, disappearing from view.
This was an unexpected calamity that no one had foreseen. It was unclear where this fearsome attack came from or why it targeted Yingtian Immortal.
"Can Lu Yang survive such an attack..." A Sword Cultivator muttered to himself.
Everyone fell silent; this kind of attack could likely kill even someone at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, let alone Lu Yang, who was only at the Divinity Transformation Stage.
Yingtian Immortal gasped for breath as he flew out of the deep pit, his tiger-like eyes round with shock as he looked up and demanded, "Who are you!"
Above the Qiankun Cover, a figure shrouded in gray mist appeared, its face indiscernible, its voice cold and ruthless, like the lofty heavens arbitrarily deciding the fate of living beings.
"Those who know of my identity, die."
Yingtian Immortal, originally seething with rage, was taken aback for a moment, Who are you, when did I learn of you, if I knew who you were would I be asking?
A series of doubts bubbled up in his mind, none with an answer.
"Very well, very well, you think you're impressive just because you ambushed me once, I think you're seeking death!"
He was both shocked and enraged, shocked that had he not suddenly produced a golden helmet, he might have met an untimely end with that attack, and enraged that the other party was utterly unreasonable, attacking him without cause.
"Hundred Refinements Overlord Halberd!"
"Heaven Connecting Chain Armor!"
"Soul Severing Immortal Spear!"
Yingtian Immortal summoned one Immortal Artifact after another. Lacking Dao Fruit, he compensated for his own inadequacies with the quantity of artifacts. These were all meant to deal with the original Yingtian Immortal, but now they were equally suitable to fight this arrogant, mist-shrouded Immortal!
Watching Yingtian Immortal wrap himself tightly, Ashy Bean revealed a mocking smile.
"Foolish, laughable."
