Although Ashy Bean didn't know the exact relationship between this Yingtian Immortal and the real one, it didn't matter. Whoever knew of her existence had to die.
As for that little fellow who revealed her existence, she had no clue where he was hiding. She couldn't sense him at all, strange.
"Lu Yang!"
The Sword Cultivators and Yun Mengmeng urgently began to search for Lu Yang.
Lu Yang, hidden in the small world of the Green Peak Sword, let out a sigh of relief, and sat down on the ground, gasping for breath. He looked at Ashy Bean overpowering Yingtian Immortal outside and revealed a look of intense relief.
"At last, she has come."
"Indeed, she can't find this place."
Recalling the process of being targeted by Ashy Bean, Lu Yang roughly figured out the pattern behind Ashy Bean's pursuit.
He and Ao Ling had stayed inside the Dragon Ball for several days, and Ashy Bean had not made a move. As soon as he and Ao Ling left the Dragon Ball, it didn't take long for Ashy Bean to appear.
This indicated that being in a small world could block Ashy Bean's perception.
And his Green Peak Sword contained such a small world.
"Thank goodness for the Green Peak Sword."
If it weren't for the Green Peak Sword, he definitely wouldn't have survived that terrifying gray light beam.
If he were still outside now, who knows, Ashy Bean might have nonchalantly snuffed him out with a flick of her finger in the heat of battle.
In fact, he had no idea about the location of the Land of Inheritance; if he did, he'd have gone there already.
Lu Yang was merely looking for an excuse to get Yingtian Immortal to calm down and listen to his story about Ashy Bean at leisure.
After all, it would take Ashy Bean some time to arrive, and not only did he need to inform Yingtian Immortal about Ashy Bean, he also had to delay him for as long as possible.
Considering that Ashy Bean would kill anyone with knowledge of her, the content of Lu Yang's conversation with Yingtian Immortal absolutely could not be overheard by others.
"Yingtian Immortal, come on, you must hold on for as long as possible."
Lu Yang silently prayed for Yingtian Immortal.

chapters.title: Chapter 920 - 919: The Powerful Ashy Bean
chapters.content:
"To decide my life and death at will, do you really think you are invincible in this world,"
Yingtian Immortal had just spoken a few words to stand his ground when he was kicked flying by Yun Mengmeng. If it weren't for his fully armed Immortal Armor, that kick could have cost him half his life.
What immense strength!
Yingtian Immortal's face was filled with disbelief. The attack power was simply too preposterous; even wielding Immortal Soldiers, he did not possess such force.
Ashy Bean was not a talkative person. He did not seem inclined to answer Yingtian Immortal's persistent questioning of "Who are you?" and remained silent, continuously attacking.
Witnessing the battle between Yingtian Immortal and Ashy Bean, Yun Mengmeng was once again convinced that her Semi-Immortal cultivation level was not impressive in the outside world, and it was only within the Secret Realm that she could show off her might.
It could be a coincidence that a Yingtian Immortal appeared, but the emergence of Ashy Bean couldn't also be a chance occurrence.
This indicated that Immortals were as common as dust in the outside world.
The Sword Tower Supreme felt that leaving behind a remnant soul to protect the Sword Tower was somewhat superfluous.
How could the Sword Tower attract so many Immortals, and who would be capable of protecting it?
"Take my halberd!" Yingtian Immortal roared, swinging the Hundred Refinements Overlord Halberd. This was his prized Immortal Saber, with a weight comparable to a hundred thousand mountains. Any who were at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage would perish under its strike upon collision.
Suddenly, Ashy Bean condensed an Immortal Saber in his hand. Space collapsed, time became chaotic, but in reality, this was not a saber, but merely a beam of light carrying the essence of Ashy Bean's death and ending.
The Heavenly Saber destroyed everything. The Overlord Halberd gained a nick the instant it touched the Heavenly Saber.
Before Yingtian Immortal could react, Ashy Bean applied additional force to his wrist, channelling his will into the Immortal Saber, and cut the Overlord Halberd like slicing through hemp stalks. The halberd head clanged on the ground, creating a bottomless pit, and the earth trembled.
Seeing Ashy Bean poised to strike him with the Immortal Saber, Yingtian Immortal hurriedly positioned the halberd staff in front of him to block the attack in desperation.
Swish, swish.
With two slashes from Ashy Bean, the halberd staff was cut into three sections, making it difficult to even hold.
The Bodhi Wood of a hundred thousand years was like tofu when faced with the Immortal Saber.
"Three heads and six arms!"
Yingtian Immortal bellowed as lumps grew on his neck, two heads pushed forward, and two arms emerged from under his ribs and his back.
With three heads and six arms, he held six kinds of Immortal Artifacts: the Soul Severing Immortal Spear, the Purple Gourd, the Sea-Covering Immortal Seal... Each artifact consumed a large amount of Immortal Gold and was steeped in Immortal Blood, making them priceless treasures in the outside world, true Immortal Artifacts.
If Yun Mengmeng got her hands on one of those Immortal Artifacts, she wouldn't even need the Sword Tower Supreme's assistance to deal with Liu Ningxuan!
Facing Yingtian Immortal, who wielded six Immortal Artifacts, Ashy Bean remained unmoved, not even blinking, voluntarily dissolving the Immortal Saber and letting the intentions of death and ending return to his being. He ignited fierce crimson flames on his body, which seemed akin to the karmic fire of Buddhism and like the wailing of myriad ghosts!
Yingtian Immortal frowned, unable to determine the origin of the flame, but feeling a sense of grave danger.
This was a flame refined from the Annihilation Dao Fruit, the World-Ending Fire that destroyed the Fire Dynasty.
In terms of the power of flames, none could surpass this World-Ending Fire.
Regrettably, Yingtian Immortal was unaware of the power of the World-Ending Fire; had he known, he would have turned tail and fled long ago.
"Die for me!" Yingtian Immortal spat out a mouthful of Immortal Dao Essence Blood, causing the six magic artifacts to emit an increasingly terrifying potency.
Ashy Bean, engulfed in World-Ending Fire, watched as the Soul Severing Immortal Spear melted upon contact with her, turning into a lump of mishmashed Immortal Gold.
"How is this possible!" exclaimed Yingtian Immortal in shock. These were Immortal Artifacts, how could they be melted so quickly!
"Your refining skill is inferior to that of the true Yingtian Immortal, wasting Immortal Gold," Ashy Bean coldly stated. In the final years of the Fire Dynasty, she had clashed with a Yingtian Immortal wielding various Immortal Artifacts, who was much more challenging than the corporeal Yingtian Immortal before her now.
"Purple Gourd!"
As he opened the mouth of the gourd, a terrifying suction force, capable of warping space, attempted to draw Ashy Bean in. Anyone entering the Purple Gourd would turn to pus in moments.
Ashy Bean casually flicked a pulse of Silent Extermination Energy, and with a bang, the Purple Gourd exploded, shattering to pieces.
"Sea-Covering Immortal Seal!"
"Eight Diagrams Mirror!"
"..."
Yingtian Immortal pulled out one Immortal Artifact after another, but they were as good as toys before the incredibly powerful Ashy Bean, who could destroy them with ease!
Yingtian Immortal realized the huge gap between them and he even doubted he would be a match for his opponent even if he possessed the Tribulation Dao Fruit.
Flee!
He could cross millions of miles with a single step, and with one step he could flee to the ends of the earth.
However, Ashy Bean simply stamped her foot lightly, stepping on space once, and the rules of space instantly became chaotic, leaving Yingtian Immortal incapable of escaping despite whatever Immortal Methods he used.
"Such is your capability."
Ashy Bean stepped closer to Yingtian Immortal, and with a grip on his head amidst his horrified gaze, the World-Ending Fire burned inside Yingtian Immortal's body, from the inside out, from soul to flesh, leaving him burning until only a charred corpse remained.
In his dying moments, he finally guessed the meaning behind Ashy Bean's statement about "knowing her existence."
She is the Lord of Heavenly Court, as referred to by Lu Yang...
I was calculated by Lu Yang...
Ashy Bean casually tossed Yingtian Immortal's corpse aside, searching for Lu Yang's presence.
Suddenly, she felt the hair on her body stand on end, and the surrounding gray mist became unstable. She sensed that if she didn't run now, a catastrophe would befall her.
It was Yun Mengmeng, who claimed to be the Master of the Heavenly Court Sect!
This was indeed a trap!
Since the East Sea incident, she had been reluctant to make a move on Lu Yang or Ao Ling, fearing that Yun Mengmeng would use these two as bait to lure her!
Damn it, the very thing I was worried about has come true!
With that thought, Ashy Bean no longer cared about searching for Lu Yang; she turned tail and ran.
Seeing Ashy Bean fleeing in panic, Lu Yang knew that Eldest Senior Sister had acted.
"Phew, it's finally over."
Only now did Lu Yang dare to emerge from the Green Peak Sword, but he was very weak and barely able to walk steadily.
Although he had not suffered any injuries, talking to Yingtian Immortal, who harbored killing intent towards him, placed him under great mental stress as he feared that any small movement of his might arouse suspicion.
Even when Ashy Bean arrived, he dared not relax, always on edge.
Now that the situation was under control, the tension he had been holding released, and the accumulated fatigue surged to his heart, making him feel drowsy.
But he knew there was still one thing he hadn't done, and he could not sleep yet.
Seeing Lu Yang suddenly appear, everyone was overjoyed.
"Lu Yang, you are alright!" Yun Mengmeng had the highest cultivation level and ran the fastest, rushing over and hugging Lu Yang.
"Light, lighter, I'm about to have an issue," Lu Yang said through clenched teeth, nearly getting his bones crushed by Yun Mengmeng's hug.
"Oh, oh," Yun Mengmeng got so scared that she quickly let go.
"Master!" Amidst the cheers and laughter, Mingtai cried out tragically, drawing everyone's attention back to him.
The remains of the Sword Tower Supreme's soul became dimmer and almost transparent. If it weren't for her concern for Mingtai's safety causing her to cling to life after Yingtian Immortal showed up, she would have already vanished.
"Mingtai, your sister can't take care of you anymore. You must take care of yourself."
"Master—," Mingtai cried heart-wrenchingly. He had just reunited with his master after such difficulty, and now they were about to be separated forever.
The Sword Tower Supreme gently said, "Don't be sad, birth and death are natural. Having followed your sister for so many years, haven't you comprehended such a simple truth?"
She wanted to wipe away Mingtai's tears, but regretfully, she no longer even had the strength to touch a physical body.
Everyone fell silent, and the joy of having survived a deathly catastrophe dimmed considerably.
"Sword Tower Supreme predecessor, I have a method that might preserve your soul," Lu Yang said, supported by Yun Mengmeng as he approached Mingtai.
"What is it?"
"Abandon the Dao Fruit Outline and perform Unity of Man and Sword to become part of the Containing Light Sword."
The Sword Tower Supreme, who had been looking dim, began to brighten up at Lu Yang's suggestion.
Right, why hadn't she thought of this solution before?
If Liu Ningxuan could achieve the ultimate Unity of Man and Sword, there was no reason she couldn't do it.
The Sword Tower Supreme sat down cross-legged on the spot, constantly recalling the essence of Unity of Man and Sword, remembering Liu Ningxuan's state, and she vaguely understood how he had done it.
Soon, the Containing Light Sword trembled incessantly, merging with the Sword Tower Supreme's soul.
Unity of Man and Sword!
With the Containing Light Sword as a base, the almost transparent soul of the Sword Tower Supreme gradually became substantial.
"Master!" Mingtai cried tears of joy, hugging the Containing Light Sword and sobbing.
The Sword Tower Supreme gave a playful smile and teased Mingtai's nose, "Now, you are the master."
Seeing the last matter settled, Lu Yang finally let go of his worries and fell asleep on the spot, unmoved no matter how frantically Yun Mengmeng called out to him.
After who knows how long, Lu Yang was once again awoken by Yun Mengmeng's voice. He opened his eyes, groggy, and was met with that familiar and reassuring figure.
Eldest Senior Sister had arrived.
He vaguely saw Yun Mengmeng clinging to Eldest Senior Sister's clothing, anxiously shouting, "Xiao Zhi, please save Lu Yang! He's the Swordsmanship Master I just found for you; he can't be in trouble!"
The Lu Yang who had intended to wake up slipped back into a peaceful sleep.
Yun Mengmeng, in my next life I'm definitely not saving you.

chapters.title: Chapter 921 - 920 It seems that at first, I just wanted to buy a sword
chapters.content:
When Lu Yang woke up again and saw the familiar shade of the trees above him, he knew he had been carried back to Sky Gate Mountain by Eldest Senior Sister.
He was tired from cultivation, often lying under the tree shade, enjoying moments of tranquility.
Sky Gate Mountain was still reassuring.
He didn't know how long he had been unconscious.
Speaking of which, he seemed to have had a strange dream where Eldest Senior Sister became his disciple, and he taught her swordsmanship.
Thankfully, it was just a dream.
Thinking of this, Lu Yang breathed a sigh of relief, then turned his head and saw Eldest Senior Sister sitting beside him, quietly peeling an apple for him with an expressionless face that blended into the background as if she were part of a painting.
Lu Yang shivered and sat up abruptly.
"Eldest Senior Sister!"
Yun Zhi lifted her eyelids slightly and handed the peeled apple to Lu Yang, "You're awake?"
"During your time at the Sword Tower ruins, you suffered a huge mental shock and fell unconscious. I suggested you rest for a few days."
"Yes, yes!"
Lu Yang carefully took the apple, as if it were not an apple, but some sort of magic artifact that could explode at any moment.
"Sword Tower ruins?" Lu Yang noticed a strange term.
Yun Zhi looked at her junior brother with a strange expression. Was his brain not working well after just waking up? "After experiencing two grand battles in succession, the Sword Tower has been shattered to debris, you didn't think that place could still be referred to as the Sword Tower, did you?"
"The spirit swords in the Sword Vault also suffered heavy losses in the battle. To fully repair them all, I'm afraid it would take at least a hundred years."
Lu Yang shrank his neck, feeling somewhat sorry for the Sword Tower.
He had visited the Sword Tower, and now the Sword Tower had collapsed, and the spirit swords were gone.
"However, the good news is that the remnant soul of Sword Tower Supreme used the method you taught to survive, and everyone in the Sword Tower is very grateful to you."
For the Sword Tower, as long as the Sword Tower Supreme survived, the collapse of the tower and the loss of the spirit swords were minor issues.
"The Inheriting Shadow Sword was obtained by you during the Seek Dao Sect's Sword Inquiry Ceremony. When I left, the Sword Tower entrusted me to hand the Inherititing Shadow Sword over to you."
Yun Zhi flicked the small knife she was using to peel the apple. The knife blade was enveloped in a dark, slender sword shadow, and then the little knife elongated, gradually merging with the sword shadow, turning into a dark, shadowy sword – the Inheriting Shadow Sword.
After Yingtian Immortal obtained the Inheriting Shadow Sword, considering that it had not reached the level of an Immortal Artifact, he did not use it to fight Ashy Bean. During the battle, the Inheriting Shadow Sword was thrown far away by Yingtian Immortal, thus it narrowly escaped destruction.
Liu Ningxuan has died, and Lu Yang finally became the rightful owner of both the Inheriting Shadow Sword and the Seven Star Sword Set.
Having received the Inheriting Shadow Sword, Lu Yang remembered that his purpose in attending the Sword Inquiry Ceremony was to buy a suitable sword from the Sword Tower.
Everything that happened afterward was unexpected.
Lu Yang put away the Inheriting Shadow Sword, as his current state was not suitable for the sword to acknowledge him as its master.
"So, who will tell me, what's the deal with this corpse?"
Yun Zhi produced a charred corpse that was hardly recognizable as human from behind her.
Ashy Bean had been too ruthless, leaving Yingtian Immortal's corpse without any value for refining; it was not even sufficient for crafting a magic artifact, which was quite regrettable for Yun Zhi.
"The people from the Sword Tower said that this corpse belongs to Yingtian Immortal?"
"Hmm, according to the Fairy's analysis, the real Yingtian Immortal failed to use either the 'Corpse Severing Method' or the 'Corpse Detachment Method' properly, resulting in the separation of a corpse with its own will."
"Indeed, that's the case."
"Both methods are for gaining strength; I surmise that Yingtian Immortal risked these dangerous tactics to counter Ashy Bean... the Grey Immortal predecessor."
Yun Zhi nodded, this was as she had guessed. This certainly wasn't the real Yingtian Immortal.
If it had been the genuine Yingtian Immortal, he should have been able to hold on until she arrived, not die so quickly. This Yingtian Immortal lacked experience in fighting peers, and only knew how to overpower with cultivation level.
"Looking at the Yingtian Corpse, it seems he refined many Immortal Artifacts, probably to deal with the real Yingtian Immortal."
Yun Zhi felt a twinge of regret; during the battle, all the Immortal Artifacts had been burned into a mishmash of Immortal Gold by Ashy Bean. If they can't be separated, then they're just a lump of scrap metal.
Among those she knew, no one was yet able to separate the mishmash of Immortal Gold.
Yun Zhi saw the underlying issue—no one was protecting the law for Yingtian Immortal.
The risks of these two methods were considerable; it would make sense for Yingtian Immortal to have someone protect him. That way, even in failure, the Yingtian Corpse wouldn't have been able to leave.
Why didn't Immortal Jiuchong and Qilin Immortal look after Yingtian Immortal?
But there was no need to mention this, to avoid involving the Junior Brother too much.
Thinking of this, Yun Zhi felt powerless. Although she tried hard to prevent her Junior Brother from getting involved in Ancient Immortal affairs, he always managed to draw closer to such events when she wasn't paying attention.
The last time she felt this helpless was when teaching her Junior Brother magic skills.
"Speaking of which, I really owe my safe return this time to the Green Peak Sword you gave me, Eldest Senior Sister."
Lu Yang chuckled, the small world within the Green Peak Sword had saved his life.
"Eldest Senior Sister, I have a guess. Do you think that, to evade Ashy Bean's detection, Yingtian Immortal might have, like me, hidden in some small world?"
"That's possible, but there are simply too many small worlds, and finding the right one isn't easy, not to mention the many hidden small worlds that are yet to be discovered."
Moving small worlds like Dragon Balls and the Green Peak Sword are incredibly rare, but there are countless small worlds fixed in some space.
Small worlds are a type of Secret Realm, all created by cultivators. Since Ancient Times, countless Secret Realm small worlds have been created.
Not to mention, there are numerous undiscovered small worlds hidden within the cosmos overhead, left by cultivators who opened small worlds and left behind legacies without publicizing their locations, allowing future cultivators to find them slowly.
In their words, this is called fate.
"Ah, Lu Yang, you're awake?" A cheerful voice sounded behind Yun Zhi as Yun Mengmeng circled around her, holding a freshly woven flower crown in her hands, joyfully looking at Lu Yang.
"I didn't expect that you're the Junior Brother whom Xiao Zhi often mentions. We're really fated. If I knew you were from the Seek Dao Sect, I would have asked you for directions to it when we had hotpot."
Lu Yang thought to himself that he didn't even know your so-called straightforward good sister was the Eldest Senior Sister. If I had known you knew the Eldest Senior Sister, I would have eaten hotpot somewhere else.
Yun Mengmeng gently placed the woven flower crown on Lu Yang's head: "This is a blessing from our place, wishing you safety and peace."
Lu Yang was slightly moved. Although Yun Mengmeng had accidentally gotten him into trouble, it was unintentional. This girl's nature was genuinely good.
Then Yun Mengmeng said with a touch of emotion, "You really can sleep! If it weren't for the fact that you're Xiao Zhi's Junior Brother, your love for sleep is just like Xiao Zhi's; once asleep, nothing can wake you up."
"I even suggested to Xiao Zhi to take you as a master. Xiao Zhi hesitated and was reluctant. As the saying goes, the accomplished can be teachers. Although Xiao Zhi is older than you, her swordsmanship is indeed not as good as yours. Xiao Zhi is just too proud. In my opinion, what's there to be ashamed of?
When we played house as kids, Xiao Zhi often called me 'mom'..."
Lu Yang broke into a cold sweat, not daring to listen any further.
Yun Zhi quietly stood up, pressed her hand on Yun Mengmeng's shoulder, and smiled at her.
"Mengmeng, it's been a long time since we sisters met, and I had no idea you had already breakthrough to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage. Come on, let's find a place and practice together."

chapters.title: Chapter 922 - 921: Immortal Lineage Adds a New Member
chapters.content:
After Yun Mengmeng and Yun Zhi caught up with each other, Yun Mengmeng became significantly more well-behaved, although she still grumbled.
"It's still that problem, Xiao Zhi, you care too much about face. You should learn from me…"
Yun Zhi held her forehead, somewhat regretting having lured Yun Mengmeng out of the Secret Realm back then.
Yun Zhi returned to find Lu Yang, who was still conditioning his body, "Fairy senior, you are aware of Mengmeng's Initial Form of the Immortal Dao Fruit, I wonder if you could condescend to give her some guidance?"
An exceptionally beautiful figure slowly floated out of Lu Yang's body, her face brimming with pride and smugness.
After returning from the Sword Tower, Fairy Eternity had moved her home from the small world of the Green Peak Sword back into the Spiritual Space.
Seeing this, Yun Mengmeng was startled, "Lu Yang, how come your soul has turned into a woman?"
Lu Yang: "..."
Yun Zhi seriously introduced, "This is Ancient Immortal Yellow Bean senior, the possessor of the Eternity Dao Fruit, which is the ultimate form of your Dao Fruit Outline."
"At present, the fairy senior has not condensed a physical body and temporarily resides in the junior brother's Spiritual Space."
"Ancient Immortal?"
Yun Mengmeng was astonished. I knew there were many immortals in the outside world; Xiao Zhi said immortals were extremely rare, who was she kidding? Even the person who invites me for hot pot by the roadside has an immortal soul in their body.
"Yun Mengmeng pays respects to Senior Doudou."
Yun Mengmeng remembered the manners her grandmother taught her, as the outside world was different from the Secret Realm, where one had to show more respect to seniors.
Her gesture in paying respects was quite standard.
"Enough, enough, Immortal does not have so many formalities, rise." Fairy Eternity waved her hand, indicating that getting the message across was sufficient.
Fairy Eternity walked around Yun Mengmeng a couple of times. Disregarding the factor of Lu Yang being too good to this young girl, she was quite pleased with her.
"I didn't expect that there would still be people condensing the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit nowadays—good, very good. Immortal is very optimistic about you."
Although there were many cultivators who had condensed forms of the Undying and Immortal Dao Fruit during Ancient Times, their conduct wasn't decent enough to please Fairy Eternity.
Yun Mengmeng was just fine as she is.
Yun Mengmeng, hearing Fairy Eternity singing her praises, felt delightful. She had not expected herself to be so outstanding.
"From now on, you are the Third Boss of the Immortal Lineage," Fairy Eternity announced excitedly, adding another person to the Immortal Lineage.
"Ah, oh." Yun Mengmeng wasn't sure what the Immortal Lineage meant, but the name sounded quite impressive.
"By the way, would you like to join the Great Bean Dynasty founded by Immortal?"
"Immortal's Great Bean Dynasty has vast territories, the East Sea, Demon Territory, and Central Continent are all parts of the Great Bean Dynasty."
"Join… I guess?"
Fairy Eternity was prepared to find a government position for Yun Mengmeng and turned to ask Lu Yang, "Little Yang, do we have any vacant official positions left?"
Lu Yang put down the apple in his hand, his arms hidden in his sleeves, and bowed slightly, "Reporting to Your Majesty, apart from the position of Prime Minister, all other positions are vacant in the Great Bean Dynasty."
Fairy Eternity pondered, her head bowed showing an expression of great trouble, uttering a thoughtful "Hmm—".
"In that case, let's appoint you as the Chief of Staff of the Rites Department!"
Yun Mengmeng hesitated, unsure of how to respond. She recalled the descriptions of the dynasty from those odd and bizarre banquet stories she had read and managed to say, "Thank you for your royal grace."
Thus, both the Immortal Lineage and the Great Bean Dynasty gained a new Semi-Immortal.
Yun Zhi stood by silently, with only the faint twitching at the corner of her eyes.
"Then, Your Majesty…"
"Call me Chief Housekeeper."
"Chief Housekeeper, about my Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit…" Yun Mengmeng was not very adept at using her Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit and needed guidance from Fairy Eternity.
"Oh my, cultivating the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit is quite simple, you just need to eat and drink, live a carefree life, and this form of the Dao Fruit will slowly condense."
"Of course, while we cultivate we must not cause trouble for others, and we should also abide by the rules and laws, you'll learn this gradually later on."
Yun Mengmeng quickly nodded, taking Fairy Eternity's earnest teachings to heart.
The words of an Immortal surely contain profound meanings, to be analyzed word by word, sentence by sentence, there must be something to gain!
"Immortal will first introduce to you the members of our Immortal Lineage."
"I am the Chief Housekeeper."
"Little Yang is the Second-in-command, and since you have joined the Immortal Lineage and learned skills from Immortal, that makes Lu Yang your Senior Brother."
Yun Mengmeng always felt that something wasn't quite right. She clearly came to ask Xiao Zhi to become a disciple, so how did it turn out that she became the disciple instead?
And Lu Yang became her Senior Brother?
Was she possibly outwitted by Xiao Zhi?
With doubts in her heart, Yun Mengmeng said to Lu Yang, "Greetings, Senior Brother."
Lu Yang felt there were more and more powerful Junior Sisters exceeding him.
"You have two Senior Sisters above you, but they are not here right now, you'll meet them when the opportunity arises."
"Come on, Immortal will take you to meet the Fourth Housekeeper."
...
The three members of the Immortal Lineage arrived at the commercial street, where the encore barbecue shop headquarters was doing business as booming as ever.
Under the leadership of Immortal Eternity, the barbecue shop had allied with the Hot Pot Alliance, standing shoulder to shoulder against the traditional powers of the Food Stall Federation, and even seemed to be quietly outperforming the Food Stall Federation.
Even with the Food Stall Federation's profound legacy and being well-regarded, beloved by the disciples of the Seek Dao Sect, they struggled to hold on against the joint forces of the two major powers on the commercial street.
Now, the Food Stall Federation was considering whether to lower their heads and join the barbecue shop to stand together against the primary power, the Hundred Fragrance Building.
But as a long-standing power, they were too proud to do so.
"You mean to say that our encore barbecue shop here is the headquarters?" On the way, Yun Mengmeng heard Lu Yang talking about the encore barbecue shop.
When she was mooching food and drinks with Lu Yang in Shu State, Yun Mengmeng had already heard about this chain of barbecue shops throughout Great Xia.
She never expected that it was their Immortal Lineage's business.
"Hello, Second-in-command." Master Gao and Master Liu, who were grilling skewers, nodded and bowed to Lu Yang on his arrival.
Their situation wasn't very good, even precarious, as they risked having to change professions at any moment with the spread of the Automatic Barbecue Array.
"Call Sha Meless here," Lu Yang said indifferently.
Before long, Sha Meless rushed over from the slaughtering area and arranged for Lu Yang and others to sit in the elegant room at the barbecue shop, while Fairy Eternity also crawled out of the Spiritual Space, her Little Face serious.
"Sha Meless, Immortal has noted your diligence and earnestness in the past few years, fully committed to the barbecue business, and Immortal has seen all your hard work."
"Chief Housekeeper," Sha Meless was very moved, for his efforts had indeed borne fruit, winning the recognition of the Chief Housekeeper.
"Therefore, Immortal has decided to promote you from Third Boss to Fourth Housekeeper."
"Ah?"
Is this really a promotion? It doesn't quite feel like it.
Fairy Eternity pointed to Yun Mengmeng and said, "I declare that Yun Mengmeng joins the Immortal Lineage as the Third Boss.
"Immortal is very pleased with this girl, Yun Mengmeng, not only for capturing the true essence of Immortality but also for being a good sister to Miss Yun."
Sha Meless: "..."
How come the Immortal Lineage seems to be filled with nepotism?

chapters.title: Chapter 923 - 922 Essential Studies of the Immortal Lineage
chapters.content:
Sha Meless, as a product of the faith in the Eternity Sect, was known for his meticulous and shrewd mind, able to strictly control his expressions. For instance, when he encountered the great joy of being promoted to Fourth Housekeeper, he did not show much delight.
"Third Boss, greetings." Sha Meless bowed and nodded to Yun Mengmeng, his attitude respectful. The hierarchy of the Immortal Lineage was strict, and one must not overstep in the slightest.
Yun Zhi's good sister, it's only right that her status is higher than his own.
Now the Immortal Lineage had one Immortal, one Lu Yang who could defeat Li Haoran, and two Semi-Immortals.
In other words, the least combat strength within the four people of the Immortal Lineage was at the level of a Semi-Immortal, which could be described as strong and robust, teeming with talents, a rarity among forces in the world that could compare.
"It's rare that we of the Immortal Lineage have all gathered, so I'll teach you how to use the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit in combat."
Previously, when Fairy Eternity saw Yun Mengmeng taking hits constantly because she possessed the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit, it truly pained her heart—clearly, it was just formed and she didn't quite know how to use it.
Sha Meless: "..."
When Yun Mengmeng wasn't around, how many times had the three of them gathered together? Why hadn't the Chief Housekeeper taught him how to use the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit for combat then?
"Using the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit for combat creates quite a disturbance, we need to find a secluded place."
"How about inside my Green Peak Sword?" Lu Yang suggested, having a small world was indeed more convenient.
Otherwise, they would have to rent a top-level Secret Realm from the Sect, and he may not have enough Contribution Points for that.
"Let's go."
With the support of the Chief Housekeeper, Lu Yang took out the Green Peak Sword and invited the Third Boss and Fourth Housekeeper inside.
"What a large place." Yun Mengmeng entered the small world of the Green Peak Sword, spread her arms, spinning on the lawn in delight. This reminded her of her home where the environment was just as beautiful, and during the autumn, the fragrance of peaches lingered at the nose.
Sha Meless was startled by the scene; a sword containing a small world suggested that the Green Peak Sword wasn't of a low grade. At the very least, it was one of the Immortal Treasures, and possibly even one of the legendary Immortal Artifacts. Truly befitting of the Second-in-command, his family's foundation was solid; they couldn't afford such a sword even if they sold skewers for a lifetime.
"Ahem, class is starting." Fairy Eternity coughed pretentiously, and Yun Mengmeng and Sha Meless immediately squatted on the lawn, looking up eagerly at Fairy Eternity, their faces etched with a thirst for knowledge.
Different was that Yun Mengmeng had an innocent appearance, making the action pleasing to the eye, whereas Sha Meless, being old and frail, made it look rather peculiar.
Lu Yang felt like he probably didn't need to attend the lesson and walked away a few steps, taking out the Inheriting Shadow Sword and trying to imprint his mark on it to claim ownership.
Even though the Sword Spirit Liu Ningxuan was gone, the Inheriting Shadow Sword still had its spirituality, making gaining its allegiance no easy task.
Lu Yang thought for a moment, then planted the Inheriting Shadow Sword in the ground and took out the Seven Star Sword Set, positioning them around the Inheriting Shadow Sword in hopes they would persuade it.
The eight swords hummed and buzzed as if engaged in intense conversation. Connected by heart to the Seven Star Sword Set, Lu Yang could vaguely sense what they were saying.
'Inheriting Elder Brother, just follow Lu Yang. He has the Sword Washing Pool. Trust your little brother this once; just one bath in there and you're guaranteed to never forget that feeling!'
'What's so good about Liu Ningxuan? Just because he occupied your body, you can't forget him?'
'Liu Ningxuan is dead now, forget him. We as swords should always look forward.'
'Just surrender to Lu Yang.'
Whatever the Inheriting Shadow Sword said, Lu Yang couldn't sense, but judging by the vibrations diminishing from intense to slight, it seemed the persuasion was quite effective.
On the other side, Fairy Eternity acted as a teacher, expounding upon the Immortal True Teachings.
"Self-Detonation is the most fundamental skill of our Immortal Lineage, and it's mandatory learning."
"In the past, this Immortal conducted extensive research on how to maximize the power of self-detonation, not knowing how much suffering it would cause my opponents."
"Fortunately, their sacrifices were all worthwhile, as they helped me to continuously perfect the theory of self-detonation."
"Third Boss, I have noticed that during combat, you take hits the entire time with very few offensive moves, presumably because you haven't learned self-detonation yet."
Yun Mengmeng nodded in agreement, indeed, she had never considered self-detonation to be an offensive tactic; all her techniques came from her familial spells.
"Fourth Housekeeper, demonstrate it for her."
Upon hearing this, Sha Meless felt it was time to show his might as a senior.
He ran twenty li away, disassembled himself into his three souls and seven spirits, and with a loud boom, self-detonated half of his soul.
Yun Mengmeng observed the Fourth Housekeeper's self-detonation carefully. The half soul was particularly restless, inflating like a balloon, and in the blink of an eye, the balloon burst, terrifying soul power spilled out in all directions, and an area of more than ten li around was within the blast range.
After the self-detonation, Sha Meless's soul quickly restored itself to a whole soul again.
"So powerful!" Yun Mengmeng's eyes shone brightly, as if she had opened the door to a new world, and she immediately felt that her previous way of fighting was too conservative.
What is self-detonation? It's the greatest attack a cultivator can trigger when desperate, risking their lives. The fact that their Immortal Lineage could use it consecutively speaks volumes about its power.
Fairy Eternity pointed at the grinning, complacently smiling Sha Meless as he walked back and said, "Look, what just happened is a classic mistake, self-detonating and then standing still in one spot, immovable, and then restoring the soul."
"Can you guarantee that your opponent will be obliterated by the blast and won't take advantage of the gap while you're restoring your soul to attack you?"
"Then what should one do?"
"You must move rapidly along with the blast wave of the self-detonation, restoring your soul in the process of moving. In this way, by the time the blast wave ends and your soul is restored, you can seamlessly perform a second self-detonation, giving your opponent no time to breathe!"
"Also, don't stand on the ground while self-detonating; you should be flying in the sky. That's when the power of self-detonation is at its greatest."
"As for tactics like scattered self-detonation, those aren't techniques you can grasp at the moment."
"You two digest the lessons I've just taught first, and go practice in the distance. Strive to quickly master the basics of self-detonation."
"Yes!"
Yun Mengmeng excitedly went far away to self-detonate, then there was a booming sound, and the roar of the blast wave came sweeping in, and Lu Yang, who was clinging to the Inheriting Shadow Sword firmly planted in the ground, was blown parallel to the ground.
After the blast wave dissipated, Lu Yang saw that in the area of the explosion, a swath of forest had turned to charcoal, mountains had been reduced to powder, and rivers poured backwards into deep pits, quickly filling up a lake.
Yun Mengmeng's self-detonation of her physical body had a direct impact on reality.
"My little world!"
Lu Yang cried out in despair, the verdant little world he had just begun to enjoy had been visited only twice before it was reduced to ruins in the blink of an eye.
Clearly, Fairy Eternity had forgotten about the impact of self-detonation on reality and hurriedly consoled Lu Yang while looking for a remedy, "Er, a small issue, later this Immortal will teach them both the Tree Planting Spell."

chapters.title: Chapter 924 - 923 Unlucky Chamber of Commerce
chapters.content:
Yun Mengmeng and Sha Meless mutually self-detonated, the explosion was so loud that they didn't hear Lu Yang's desperate scream, blown up with delight.
Sha Meless felt that indeed, studying under the Chief Housekeeper was far more efficient than blindly researching on his own, a few words from the Chief Housekeeper had enlightened him, showing him the path ahead.
If only he had the guidance of the Chief Housekeeper earlier, there wouldn't have been a need to wage a war of attrition against Great Yu's second Imperial Teacher, he could have blasted him into a bloody mess right from the start.
Yun Mengmeng, by nature a playful character, found the fun in self-detonation very much to her taste, making her study with great enjoyment.
Boom——Boom——Boom——
The two Semi-Immortals gradually mastered the tricks of self-detonation, their continuous explosions made the small world tremble.
This blasting went on for five days.
During those five days, Lu Yang successfully used the Seven Star Sword Set to weaken the Inheriting Shadow Sword's resistance and imprinted his own mark on it, becoming its master.
Lu Yang casted his Wooden Avatar, letting it wield the Inheriting Shadow Sword while he held the Green Peak Sword, the two of them practiced their swordplay, moving in unison, familiarizing themselves with the feel of the Inheriting Shadow Sword.
Compared to the Third Boss and the Fourth Housekeeper, who were self-detonating fifty miles away, Lu Yang's sword dancing was particularly graceful.
Compared to the Dark Moon Sword, the Inheriting Shadow Sword was lighter and sharper, and its slight spirituality was very responsive, making it easy to handle.
"What a sword, what a sword," Lu Yang said with a beaming smile, as a Sword Cultivator, he had a great fondness for swords, especially ones like the Inheriting Shadow Sword that had a legendary quality.
Like the Green Peak Sword, the Inheriting Shadow Sword had been sealed layer by layer by the Eldest Senior Sister to prevent Lu Yang from becoming dependent on divine weapons; the current Inheriting Shadow Sword was just right for him.
The Third Boss and Fourth Housekeeper also returned having finished their learning, and dutifully planted trees and moved mountains to restore the small world to its original state.
Yun Mengmeng, who had been mischievous in the Secret Realm, often accidentally knocked over trees, so she had learned the Tree Planting Spell.
Sha Meless, possessing the memories of all members of the Eternity Sect, also knew the Tree Planting Spell.
The two of them were very easy to take care of, with no need for Fairy Eternity to teach them.
Cleaning up the small world took another half day. If they had simply tidied up, with their Cultivation Level, they could have finished quickly, but under the pressure of the Second-in-command's gaze, they had to carefully clean up one more time.
Seeing the small world restored to its former state, Lu Yang was satisfied to let the two go.
"Let's stop here for now, you're still at the beginner stage and can't self-detonate at will.
There's still a short interval between each self-detonation, and if you face an opponent with rich combat experience, you'll still be caught in a flaw," said Fairy Eternity, emphasizing that practice should be balanced, constant explosions were not the solution, nor would blasting oneself into foolishness do any good.
"Yes."
After leaving the Green Peak Sword small world, Sha Meless stayed at the barbecue shop, while Lu Yang and Yun Mengmeng left the barbecue shop.
It was now evening, the busiest time for the market streets, and Yun Mengmeng, smelling the delicious food scents wafting from the stalls, had her eyes light up.
Since Yun Mengmeng had no Contribution Points, Lu Yang had no choice but to accompany her as he did in Shu State, walking the streets and buying snacks.
Lu Yang and Yun Mengmeng walking on the street attracted a lot of attention—mainly because no one had ever seen Yun Mengmeng before, and her sudden appearance easily caught people's eyes.
"Old Lu, what are you doing here…" Meng Jingzhou came face-to-face with them, just as he was about to greet Lu Yang, he noticed a breathtakingly beautiful woman laughing and talking with him, exuding a sense of happiness.
Wait, why am I toiling in cultivation every day under the great ancestor's tutelage, while you get to hang around with beautiful women all day?
"Hey, Old Meng, you're back, have you reached Spirit Transformation too?" Lu Yang also saw Meng Jingzhou and casually greeted him.
Meng Jingzhou grinned proudly and said, "Spirit Transformation was a breeze. And who is this?"
"Yun Mengmeng, Eldest Senior Sister's good friend."
Meng Jingzhou was stunned for a moment—Yun Mengmeng? So Eldest Senior Sister, you've been using your good friend's name as an alias?
"Senior Brother, who is this?"
"Meng Jingzhou, my junior brother."
Meng Jingzhou froze again. What was Yun Mengmeng shouting? Calling him Senior Brother? What was their relationship?
Or could it be that this Yun Mengmeng wasn't even twenty years old?
Meng Jingzhou felt as though he had only been away for just over a year, yet everything seemed so strangely unfamiliar.
The three of them went to the food stall union and found a place to sit. They ordered a few signature dishes, with Meng Jingzhou treating them.
"I heard that the Sword Tower collapsed. That's got something to do with you, right?" Meng Jingzhou asked as he settled down.
"Don't talk nonsense. I went to the Sword Tower to attend the Sword Inquiry Ceremony. The collapse was caused by a conflict between immortals. What does it have to do with me?" Lu Yang felt he had a clear conscience.
Meng Jingzhou scoffed in disbelief at Lu Yang's tall tale; the outside world was buzzing with rumors of a battle between two immortals at the Sword Tower, and Lu Yang being the victor of the Sword Inquiry. Although the two events seemed unrelated, Meng Jingzhou could see at a glance that they were definitely connected to Lu Yang.
Meng Jingzhou's laughter was tinged with schadenfreude: "You have no idea how badly the Land Money Trade Association suffered this time."
"The Trade Association?" Lu Yang was puzzled. What did this have to do with the Trade Association?
"You don't know, do you? The Manager of the Tower had bought insurance for the Sword Tower from the Trade Association, a comprehensive policy at that."
"After the collapse of the Sword Tower, the association had to pay up honestly. The compensation was a devastating blow. I heard the head of the Shu State branch of the association has lost sleep and become thinner from worry."
"According to the rules, since the collapse of the Sword Tower was caused by human factors, the association will seek compensation from the person responsible after paying out. I'd like to see if they dare to come looking."
The Trade Association would have to be out of its mind to go after Ashy Bean.
"By the way, in the Sword Tower conflict—was it this Yun Mengmeng...Senior Sister involved?" Meng Jingzhou was somewhat unsure of how to address Yun Mengmeng.
"It was her."
Meng Jingzhou suddenly understood: "So she's the one who claimed to be Yun Zhi and got into a fight with Liu Ningxuan?"
"No wonder the word outside is now that Eldest Senior Sister is a Great Power at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, and some even speculate she's a Semi-Immortal."
The battle at the Sword Tower revealed a lot of information. By the time it had been through several iterations and reached Meng Jingzhou, the story had been distorted. It's true that asking the person directly involved was the only way to understand what happened at the Sword Tower.
When Lu Yang asked how Meng Jingzhou had been trained by Meng Junzi, Meng Jingzhou's eyes showed a look of terror, clearly not wishing to recall that miserable past.
After chatting with Meng Jingzhou for a while, Lu Yang and Yun Mengmeng returned to Sky Gate Mountain.
"You're back?" Yun Zhi was sitting on the Emperor's Chair, as if she had been waiting for the two.
"Eldest Senior Sister... were you waiting for us?" Lu Yang asked hesitantly.
Yun Zhi didn't reply, but instead brought up another matter: "Guan Shanhai has explained how Wu Yao sealed the sun, and he also told me how to break the seal."
"I'm planning to unseal one of the seals. Do you want to come and see?"
After more than a year of torture, Guan Shanhai could no longer endure the pressure and divulged some important information.
He felt that if he didn't share some crucial information, Yun Zhi was going to initiate a soul search.
Lu Yang's eyes lit up at the news. This was a spectacle that hadn't been witnessed in hundreds of thousands of years; of course, he wanted to see it.
"We're going!"
"I'll follow Senior Brother's lead," Yun Mengmeng added.

chapters.title: Chapter 925 - 924 Entering the Universe
chapters.content:
Unlike the sun that evolved from the Golden Crow in Ancient Times, the sun after Ancient Times is the representation of the Power of the Supreme Yang, possessing boundless might. Countless cultivators rely on the sun for their practice, otherwise, the Yaoyang Sect wouldn't have emerged.
During the Great Qian Period, the sun was sealed by the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord, the founding Emperor Qian, and claimed it as his own.
In the Great Yu Era, the founding Emperor Yu, Wu Yao, saw that the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord had sealed the sun, so he placed another seal on top of that one.
As a result, neither the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord nor Wu Yao could obtain the sun.
As Wu Yao was suspected of being replaced and sent to the outside world, Lu Yang originally thought that the second seal could never be unlocked again. However, Guan Shanhai possessed the method to unlock the second seal.
"According to Guan Shanhai, the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord sealed the sun to weaken the emission of Sun Power and Power of Taiyin, in order to have the citizens of the Great Qian Dynasty worship him," Yun Zhi explained.
"At that time, if a cultivator wanted to practice with the aid of the sun, they could only do so by worshiping the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord. After worshiping, a thread of the seal would be undone, projecting the Sun Power and Power of Taiyin onto the cultivator. After the worship ended, the seal would be reinstated."
"Hence, the legendary Mid-heaven Emperor Lord is said to have the ability to control the sun and the moon."
During the Great Qian Period, the Power of Faith was the main method of cultivation. Temples and idols were everywhere. To vie for the Power of Faith, they would resort to all sorts of means. As dynasties changed and methods of practice transformed, temples and idols all vanished in the river of history, becoming elusive.
"After Wu Yao ascended the throne, he attempted to reach the sun multiple times but was always blocked by the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord's seal, so he also set a seal, preventing the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord from approaching the sun," Yun Zhi continued.
"This resulted in the sun being doubly sealed, greatly diminishing the outward flow of Sun Power and Power of Taiyin."
This was a secret hidden in history, not recorded in any historical texts.
"Going to unlock the seal left by Wu Yao this time can release some of the Sun Power and Power of Taiyin, greatly benefiting cultivators who rely on these two types of power," Yun Zhi mentioned.
As Yun Zhi led Lu Yang and Yun Mengmeng flying towards the sun, she began to disclose the whole story.
"Is the sun really that sought after? Everyone's taking turns to snatch it," Yun Mengmeng asked, puzzled, since there was no sun in the Secret Realm, and she couldn't quite grasp the importance of the sun.
With his current Cultivation Level, Lu Yang was capable of traversing space, though not as casually as Eldest Senior Sister, needing to dedicate a considerable portion of his attention to face the various harsh conditions of outer space.
Yun Mengmeng, on the other hand, was not bothered by the adverse effects of space, but her habit of looking around and touching things greatly delayed their flight speed.
Helpless, Yun Zhi had to encase Lu Yang and Yun Mengmeng in two transparent shields, taking them along for the flight.
During the flight, Lu Yang saw many brilliant stars, too numerous to count. When encountering a star, Eldest Senior Sister didn't even think twice before charging at it. Lu Yang thought they were about to collide with a star, but to his surprise, the star turned out to be an Illusory Shadow.
Some were not Illusory Shadows, requiring Eldest Senior Sister to maneuver around them.
"Eh, is this star Miss Yun's Golden Core?" Fairy Eternity noticed something unusual, the star in front of them was indeed real, only it was not a relic from Ancient Times, but was filled by Yun Zhi's Golden Core.
"Is Xiao Zhi's Golden Core this big?" Yun Mengmeng was astonished. Why was her own Golden Core so small?
"That's just because it looks big, but in terms of power, it can't surpass my Invincible Elixir,"
"What is the Invincible Elixir?" Yun Mengmeng asked.
"The Invincible Elixir is a Golden Core that only the Immortal Lineage can form, and its power ranks first among First-Grade Golden Cores! Too bad, your cultivation level is too high now, you missed the chance to form the Invincible Elixir."
"That's so amazing." Yun Mengmeng's eyes shone with excitement, their Immortal Lineage was indeed powerful.
Although she had known that the numerous stars above were actually Eldest Senior Sister's Golden Cores, knowing was one thing, and witnessing with her own eyes was quite another.
Only by seeing with her own eyes could she understand how terrifying the Eldest Senior Sister's Golden Core was; if she stood upon it, she might even think the ground beneath her feet was flat.
And this was just one of many; the universe contained countless more of Eldest Senior Sister's Golden Cores.
The universe was dark and cold, sprawling and empty, silent to the point of terror. Lu Yang, situated within the universe, was imperceptible; even a cultivator, powerful in cultivation level, would still feel insignificant compared to the vastness of the cosmos…
"Coming to this murky place reminds me," said Fairy Eternity, interrupting Lu Yang's inner monologue. "Back then, the stars overseen by the Yingtian Immortal and the others were numerous, and the distances between stars were too far apart, making travel quite inconvenient.
They would frequently adjust the positions of the stars to shorten the distances or even establish spatial pathways between them."
After an indeterminate amount of time, Lu Yang saw a gigantic fireball. The ultimate high temperatures rampaged through the cosmos; if it weren't for the transparent cover Yun Zhi had placed over Lu Yang, the heat alone would have been enough to burn him to death.
Regarding the might of the sun, countless pioneers of the Yaoyang Sect had already tested it personally. Lu Yang could even see charred human figures circling around the sun.
When Yun Zhi, ignoring the high temperatures, wished to approach the sun further, a golden chain surrounding the sun blocked her path.
The golden chain shimmered with dazzling runes, so bright that they hurt the eyes, making the heat emanating from the sun even more terrifying. The dazzling runes seemed to contain all the principles of the world, and just a glance at them would cause a rush of knowledge to flood into one's mind, threatening to burst the spiritual space.
With Yun Zhi blocking in front, preventing the surge of knowledge from entering his mind, Lu Yang could freely observe these runes.
"Chief Housekeeper, what do these runes mean?" Yun Mengmeng, after looking for a long time without understanding, sought help from the all-knowing Boss.
Fairy Eternity truly knew everything and easily interpreted the meanings of the runes, analyzing to the Second-in-command and Third Boss, "Though there's no subject, from the context, these should all be Wu Yao cursing Mid-heaven Emperor Lord. Do you need me to read out how he's cursing him?"
Towards the end, Fairy Eternity hesitated for a moment, blushing, clearly too embarrassed to curse.
"No need, no need," Lu Yang quickly said.
"However, speaking of which, this sun is indeed a creation of Immortal Jiuchong. Even the Golden Crows of Ancient Times couldn't create a sun with this kind of power, not to mention that there's an equal amount of the Power of Taiyin contained within it."
Ao Ling had said that the sun and the moon of the Fire Dynasty were created by Immortal Jiuchong using Yin-Yang Dao Fruits; to save trouble, he directly made the sun and the moon as one.
He also considered that this would render sun coronas unusable and people would struggle to detect changes in time, affecting their lives, so he directly drew a clock face and hands on the sun, so everyone could see the time.
The time was approved by the Time Immortal, ensuring its accuracy.

chapters.title: Chapter 926 - 925: Unsealing the First Seal of the Sun
chapters.content:
```
Reading time by observing the sun was a privilege that only the citizens of the Fire Dynasty could enjoy. It was a delicate task that required regular maintenance. With the fall of the Fire Dynasty, the ability to display time on the sun also disappeared.
In the past, when Yun Zhi came to the sun, she was always stopped by the Immortal's Chain left by Wu Yao, but this time was different.
Yun Zhi flipped her palm, resonating with the Way, creating ripples in space. The space seemed to come alive, and Lu Yang and Yun Mengmeng could hear what sounded like the voice of the Great Way coming from the horizon, ethereal and clear, its meaning unknown.
An invisible power gathered in Yun Zhi's palm, gradually taking the shape of a long-handled key.
The key, sensing the existence of the Immortal's Chain, flew towards it on its own, resonating with it.
The Immortal's Chain trembled, and Wu Yao's voice erupted, his powerful tone unstoppable even by the vacuum of space, "I'll curse your *********"
It was a torrent of unimaginably foul swearing.
So foul that if Wu Yao dared show his face in front of Yun Zhi, he'd deserve a punch in the face before anything else.
If Yun Zhi had known that unlocking the seal would cause such a phenomenon, she would never have brought Lu Yang and Yun Mengmeng along.
Yun Mengmeng felt that these outsiders were really different, their swear words so varied and unique. Unlike her, who, in moments of frustration, could only say "You're just a bad peach."
Feeling that the swearing wouldn't cease any time soon, Yun Zhi had no choice but to add another layer of protection around Lu Yang and Yun Mengmeng, shielding the three members of the Immortal Lineage from hearing the noises here.
The swearing stopped, and the Immortal's Chain gradually dimmed and then completely vanished.
The sun's power, sealed for two hundred thousand years, erupted forth, its energy billowing and flames reaching the sky. The Sun True Fire leaped high, such that even cultivators at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage would be reduced to ashes if they faced this sun power.
Those pioneers of the Yaoyang Sect who surrounded the sun, despite having endured many trials by fire, ultimately could not survive the final challenge and were incinerated by the erupting sun power, leaving nothing behind.
As the sun's power spread, countless cultivators could feel its impact.
And the ones who felt it most deeply were those cultivators who specialized in the power of the sun. They could clearly sense the increase in the sun's power released, which became incredibly dense. Their cultivation techniques could even operate on their own, greedily absorbing this power, expanding their meridians, and nourishing their bodies.
Some cultivators even used this opportunity to break through, overcoming their bottlenecks and greatly increasing their realms.
Meng Jingzhou's body trembled, as if he could no longer control himself. Bucket after bucket of ice water transported from the depths of the Extreme Northern Lands doused him, finally suppressing the rising desire within him temporarily.
"What the hell is going on?!"
Meng Jingzhou could feel his Single Body Spiritual Root greedily absorbing the sun's power, causing his inner desires to grow increasingly stronger.
"Brother, stop absorbing it, I really can't take it anymore."
Meng Jingzhou wanted to cry but had no tears. Why had he never encountered such a bizarre situation when he was at home, and yet he encountered it as soon as he returned to the sect?
The sun's sudden release of infinite power, enriching the Single Body Spiritual Root—such an event had never been encountered by any of its previous holders. Why did it have to happen to him?
Indeed, the strengthening of his Spirit Root was an all-around enhancement for him, solidifying his realm in the Initial Stage of Spirit Transformation, increasing the capacity of the Spiritual Energy Pool formed by his Dantian, and bringing changes to his meridians, qi and blood, spiritual power, and primordial spirit.
"I don't need it, damn it!"
Meng Jingzhou hastily sat down to meditate, silently reciting the Buddhist Heart Method, viewing desire as a painted skeleton, beginning to emulate the demeanor of a high monk.
…
Wu Yao's seal only affected the power of the sun and not its temperature. Even with the seal undone, it would not make summers hotter or melt the glaciers in the Extreme Northern Lands.
"Fairy senior, can you sense Immortal Jiuchong here?" Yun Zhi asked, wondering if Immortal Jiuchong might be hiding inside the sun.
```
"Jiuchong, are you there?" Fairy Eternity shouted toward the sun.
Other than the chains left by the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord swaying, there was no response.
Fairy Eternity frowned; the chains of the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord blocked sound, making it impossible for her voice to get through.
"Since that's the case, then we will wait until we find the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord and let him unlock the first seal," Yun Zhi had anticipated this situation, she was merely trying her luck.
"By the way, Eldest Senior Sister, now that only the seal of the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord remains, wouldn't it be possible for cultivators to just pray to the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord and obtain all of the Sun Power?" Yun Zhi asked.
Yun Zhi shook her head, "It won't work. Perhaps the Power of Faith has been collected enough, or for some other reason, the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord is no longer absorbing the Power of Faith and has removed this method of obtaining Sun Power through prayer."
"Now the chains are merely sealing the sun."
Yun Mengmeng didn't speak throughout; she felt that the topics discussed by the Chief Housekeeper, Second-in-command, and Xiao Zhi were too profound, and she didn't understand at all.
Sure enough, there was a reason she could only be the Third Boss; her knowledge was too scarce.
Thinking this, Yun Mengmeng seemed to have found a goal to strive for in the future and excitedly asked Fairy Eternity, "Chief Housekeeper, if I study hard and try to improve, will I have the chance to become the Second-in-command?"
Fairy Eternity gave Yun Mengmeng a glance, "If you keep having such rebellious thoughts, you'll be demoted to Fourth Housekeeper."
"Oh."
...
After leaving Lu Yang and Yun Mengmeng at Sky Gate Mountain, Yun Zhi did not inform anyone and went alone to Imperial City to find Emperor Xia.
"You're saying you want to use a few death row prisoners as test subjects?" Emperor Xia looked at Yun Zhi in surprise, this was the first time Yun Zhi had made such a request to him.
"Just one to start with, to confirm a hypothesis."
Emperor Xia waved his hand magnanimously, issuing a decree to the Ministry of Punishments to pick a death row prisoner to hand over to Yun Zhi, and stated that from now on, whatever number of death row prisoners Yun Zhi wanted was fine.
Yun Zhi sealed the cultivation level of the prisoner and also made it impossible for them to speak. Then she took the prisoner out of Imperial City to a small hut on a mountain nearby.
Yun Zhi put the prisoner down and kindly gave him a lesson on history: "Do you know about the Fire Dynasty?"
She spoke for about fifteen minutes but didn't wait for the person she wanted to show up. Reluctantly, she left the confused prisoner in the hut and departed.
She hid her presence, waiting at the mountainside, at the foot of the mountain, and in a distant place; still, the person didn't come.
Half an hour went by, and when she returned to the hut again, it had a big hole blasted through it. Directly beneath the hole, the death row prisoner had been reduced to ash, the air reeking with the scent of death.
Yun Zhi went to the Ministry of Punishments to grab another death row prisoner. Following the same old method, she left him in the hut with a history lesson.
She waited in the hut for an hour but still no one showed, so Yun Zhi had no choice but to leave.
When Yun Zhi came back to the hut again, a second hole appeared, and the second prisoner was also dead.
"Even if I hide my presence, she can still sense that I'm hiding nearby?" Yun Zhi murmured softly to herself and casually took a third prisoner from the Ministry of Punishments.
To verify her hypothesis, she didn't change the method. After the history lesson, she hid in the shadows, where nothing stirred.
When she left the mountain and returned again, she found that the summit had been leveled, with the hut and the prisoner gone, leaving behind only a note.
"Will you ever stop?"

chapters.title: Chapter 927 - 927: 926
chapters.content:
Yun Zhi held the note left by Ashy Bean, lost in thought.
"The Grey Immortal slays those in the know so frequently, yet she has never laid a hand on Senior Brother Ao Ling or Junior Brother."
"It's easy to explain in the case of Senior Brother Ao Ling. When the Grey Immortal tried to kill him in the Fire Dynasty, the Dragon Pattern Bracelet blocked her attacks many times. Now with the bracelet fully charged and capable of spatial traversal, the Grey Immortal knows that whether it's a sneak attack or trapping Senior Brother Ao Ling, it would be extremely difficult."
"But why has she never made a move against Junior Brother?"
"Could it be that she knows if she were to act against Junior Brother, it would surely backfire on her?"
Yun Zhi pondered for a while and rejected this idea. If the Grey Immortal knew Junior Brother was so dangerous, she wouldn't have made a move at the Sword Tower.
"Is it because she inherited the luck of a past Fairy and instinctively avoided the worst option?"
"Back at the Sword Tower, if the Grey Immortal had decided to take out Junior Brother first and then the Ying Tian Corpse, it would have been her misfortune."
"That's it—the fact that she once was a past Fairy and possessing the Fairy's luck is nothing out of the ordinary."
To test her hypothesis, Yun Zhi created a secret little world next to the fourth condemned prisoner and hid within it.
In theory, Ashy Bean shouldn't have been able to sense Yun Zhi's presence, but throughout the time Yun Zhi was hidden in the small world, Ashy Bean never acted, not until Yun Zhi left the small world and went to a faraway place did Ashy Bean kill the prisoner.
"It is indeed a matter of luck," Yun Zhi concluded.
"It seems that to deal with the Grey Immortal, we can only rely on luck stronger than hers."
Yun Zhi stopped bothering Ashy Bean and left the hill.
...
The world only knew that the power of the sun had surged, but few understood the reason.
And the Yaoyang Sect was among those 'few.'
"The surge in Sun Power must be due to the breaking of one of the seals!" The top brass of the Yaoyang Sect were thrilled. This meant that the sun had recognized their recent efforts in developing the solar energy industry!
Certainly, a great person had indeed undone one of the sun's seals, but the question arises—why was the seal undone precisely when the solar energy industry was thriving?
There are no coincidences in this world; there is always a divine will at work.
"This is divine revelation, the sun is telling us to earnestly develop the solar energy industry!"
Although the investigation in the Imperial City hadn't gone smoothly and they had faced life-threatening dangers, under the persuasion of Mu Baiyi, the two sects reached an agreement to start producing solar energy products, beginning with the Imperial City.
Now, they have already produced solar lamps and solar water heaters, among other products, receiving wide acclaim.
"Looking back, the successful promotion of solar lamps was really thanks to someone mysteriously buying up a large batch of candles, leading to a market shortage. Many commoners, with a try-and-see attitude, bought our solar products," a high-ranking member of the Yaoyang Sect mused, feeling certain they were on the right path.
In the past, many perished in their daily attempts to reach the sun. Now, with the development of the solar energy industry, everything has improved.
"Moreover, the Jiuyou Sect is particularly serious about collaborating with us. They're thinking of ways to promote our products," remarked Chi Sect Leader. He found Mu Baiyi and Shi Huagu especially admirable and tireless in their study of marketing techniques, such as using Dream Mirage for advertising with great speed.
The sincere cooperation between the two demonic sects was something that could never have been imagined before.
'Could the undoing of the sun's seal have been the work of the Ancient Heavenly Court?' Chi Sect Leader suddenly harbored this thought.
There was no evidence, but this feeling had suddenly taken root in him.
Chi Sect Leader often felt fortunate that he had pledged allegiance to the Ancient Heavenly Court early on. With the help of the Ancient Heavenly Court, his influence in the Yaoyang Sect had grown day by day.
Now that the sun had lifted its first seal, it had greatly increased the strength of all Yaoyang Sect disciples. He even felt that he might attempt to reach the Transcendence Tribulation Stage and become a true powerhouse, free from the worries of life and death.
...
"You're from the same hometown as Eldest Senior Sister?" Third Senior Sister Gan Tian asked with great interest, circling around Yun Mengmeng. She was blindfolded with a black cloth, unable to see anything, yet she seemed to be scrutinizing Yun Mengmeng all the same.
She had been out seeking inspiration for her music and had just returned today to find that a newcomer had arrived on Sky Gate Mountain.
Only upon asking did she find out it was actually someone from the same hometown as Eldest Senior Sister.
Eldest Senior Sister rarely spoke of her hometown, and Gan Tian knew only that Eldest Senior Sister was born in a Secret Realm and had been brought out by their master. Beyond that, she knew nothing at all.
"Quick, tell me, where is the hometown of Eldest Senior Sister, what is it like?" Gan Tian asked, her tone far from the tranquility she exhibited while playing her instrument.
Lu Yang stood by, watching without interfering; he too was quite curious about Eldest Senior Sister's background.
Oh, except for the shameful past.
Yun Mengmeng shook her head vigorously and closed her mouth, which was eager to speak. Xiao Zhi had warned her not to talk about the Secret Realm, especially not to the Chief Housekeeper or the Second-in-command.
"Come on, Sister Mengmeng, just tell me," Lu Yang urged gently, but his coaxing left Yun Mengmeng quite tempted.
Fortunately, her will was strong, and she kept silent, much to the chagrin of Lu Yang and Gan Tian.
"Little Lu, I heard there was trouble at the Sword Tower, are you all right?" Suddenly, a concerned voice that had not been heard for a long time reached them, causing both Lu Yang and Gan Tian to start.
The master had returned!
It had been two years since they had last seen their master, hadn't it?
Previously, Daoist Buyu had been far away in the Demon Territory. He heard about the incident at the Sword Tower, heard that Lu Yang had held off Yingtian Immortal, dragging the fight out until both immortals were battling, and afterwards fell unconscious. He immediately rushed back.
He was already at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, his cultivation level incomparable to that of the past. Many who sought him could not find him, but his journey back was smooth.
The Gold Clan Leader was no longer with Daoist Buyu. With the proliferation of sun-powered lamps, the candles amassed by the Qiongqi Clan had become useless and could only be sold off cheaply, resulting in significant financial losses.
The Gold Clan Leader, aiming to recuperate the losses, had no choice but to temporarily give up following Daoist Buyu to study, and hurried back to the Qiongqi Clan to find a solution.
Daoist Buyu reached the mid-slope of Sky Gate Mountain, and even before seeing Lu Yang, he could sense Lu Yang lively and active on the mountain peak, which relieved him.
"Little Lu, I'm glad you're alright."
Daoist Buyu arrived at the summit and before he could remember to speak again, he was alarmed by a swift attack that came his way, causing him to dodge quickly.
"It was you who took Xiao Zhi away, and you still dare to show your face!" Yun Mengmeng couldn't contain her anger when she saw Daoist Buyu and pounced with a howl.
If it weren't for Daoist Buyu appearing and telling Xiao Zhi about the wonders of the outside world, she would not have left the Secret Realm, which caused her separation from Xiao Zhi for hundreds of years.
Bad apple!
Daoist Buyu was baffled, unclear about the situation. How could he be ambushed upon returning to his own territory?
Who had the audacity to set an ambush for him on Sky Gate Mountain?

chapters.title: Chapter 928 - 927: Seek Dao Sect Gains Another Transcendance Tribulation Stage Member
chapters.content:
Throughout history, those who left the Peach Blossom Secret Realm never returned, thinking back to when Xiao Zhi parted with Yun Mengmeng, she cried so heartbrokenly, believing it was an eternal farewell.
And the one who caused Xiao Zhi to leave the Peach Blossom Secret Realm was this guy named Ye Wanli!
Daoist Buyu had only met Yun Mengmeng once, and that was with a Yun Mengmeng who was less than ten years old. Since Yun Zhi didn't follow her back to the Secret Realm to visit her relatives, he didn't recognize Yun Mengmeng's identity at once.
When he carefully recalled what Yun Mengmeng had said upon their meeting, he finally realized who Yun Mengmeng was and suddenly understood.
"You're the little girl who cried so fiercely back then!"
"How dare you say that!"
Yun Mengmeng glared and exploded without a second word, catching Daoist Buyu completely off guard.
Even with rich combat experience, no cultivator could react promptly to a self-detonation attack.
Yun Mengmeng had just learned the Continuous Self-Detonation Technique from Fairy Eternity and used it on Daoist Buyu. The sky above Sky Gate Mountain was filled with continuous booming noises as Daoist Buyu was tossed around like a tattered kite in the shockwave.
Lu Yang felt somewhat relieved, glad that Yun Mengmeng had just learned how to use the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit from the fairy. If she hadn't learned it yet, it would have been difficult to sneak attack their master.
"Master has this tribulation in his fate," Lu Yang said nonchalantly, making excuses for himself not to help, like a fortune-telling blind man.
Gan Tian also agreed with her junior brother's point of view, "Since master is at the Pass Tribulation stage, undergoing a few human tribulations is within reason."
Gan Tian had a fruitful trip seeking melodic inspiration outside; she brought back a local specialty, a white melon with few seeds, crisp and sweet, full of water content. She cut the white melon into eight pieces using a string from her instrument and shared a piece with her junior brother, the two siblings enjoying it with relish.
The commotion at Sky Gate Mountain also attracted the Disciples of the Dao Seeking Sect, who pointed and speculated about the continuously exploding Daoist Buyu, curious about who was responsible.
"Amazing, our Dao Seeking Sect has such an expert?"
The disciples discussed animatedly, all wanting to know who this expert was.
Even if it were the Grandmaster from Captive Peak or Elder Tao from the Scripture Pavilion taking action, the effects wouldn't be this exaggerated.
Just then, Yun Zhi hurried back, watching Yun Mengmeng's frenzied self-detonation and Daoist Buyu like a candle in the wind, her eyes twitching.
"Alright, alright, Mengmeng, stop now, that's enough," she said.
Yun Zhi stood between the two, interrupting Yun Mengmeng's continuous self-detonation, allowing Daoist Buyu to finally cease maintaining his Sword Qi protective state.
Seeing that it was Xiao Zhi who came, Yun Mengmeng huffed and did not attack again, and Daoist Buyu also let out a sigh of relief. He really didn't know how to deal with Yun Mengmeng.
If he retaliated, indeed she had the moral high ground and their dispute was not trivial.
If he didn't retaliate, he couldn't withstand being bombed like this for long.
Suddenly, a peal of thunderous noise arose, causing Daoist Buyu to subconsciously think that Yun Mengmeng was about to self-detonate again.
Then he realized that the thunderous noise was coming from a far distance and felt very familiar.
"Thunder of Pass Tribulation, who is about to reach the Pass Tribulation stage?"
Daoist Buyu looked in the direction of the thunderous noise, squinting his eyes slightly. If his guess was correct, that place was the ravine, the site of his older brother's secluded cultivation.
"The Grand Elder is undergoing his tribulation!"
Lu Yang also realized, having visited the Grand Elder's place of secluded cultivation, it was all coffins.
Having secluded himself for over a year, the Grand Elder finally reached fruition.
The disciples of the Seek Dao Sect were drawn to the commotion made by the Grand Elder and rushed toward the canyon nearby to witness the process of Transcendence Tribulation.
Lu Yang and others also hurried over.
At that time, the sky above the canyon was pitch black as ink, the thunderous pressure looming like an abyss, unfathomable.
The Thunder Tribulation the Grand Elder faced, although not as intense as Daoist Buyu's, was also nearly the same, worthy of the title of a Half Step Pass Tribulation Cultivator.
Below the canyon, the coffin shook, and only the pit was left of the Immortal Peach laid in front of it. Suddenly, a pale hand stretched out of the coffin, gripping the edge of the lid, the veins on the back of the hand bulged.
With a bang, the coffin burst open, and the Grand Elder soared into the sky, arriving above the canyon, confronting the Thunder Tribulation head-on, showing no fear, his head lowered, snoring.
"The Grand Elder seems to be sleeping, is he alright?" Lu Yang asked, worried.
"It's fine, my brother practices the Dream Dao, and in his dreams, he is in his strongest state. Enemies in the real world appear in dreamland in different forms. In the dream, my brother fights the enemy, and his actions in the real world follow suit," Daoist Buyu explained, the memory of being schooled by the sleepwalking Grand Elder still vivid in his mind.
The Grand Elder's Pass Tribulation was a major event;; the Second Elder, Third Elder... even the Sixth Elder had come.
The child Grandmaster, Elder Tao, had also come.
Boom!
Nobody expected that the first wave of Thunder Tribulation would emerge from below the canyon, the thunder in the sky was just a decoy!
Sudden thunder roared from the ground, heading straight for the Grand Elder's face. With his eyes tightly shut, the Grand Elder slashed down with a hand, intending to meet the Thunder Tribulation with brute force!
Innumerable bolts of lightning, like tentacles, rose from below, entwining the Grand Elder, who shouted loudly as his muscles swelled. The image of an Arhat wielding a Vajra Pestle emerged, breaking free from the Thunder Tribulation's restraint;; Lu Yang watched, his heart pounding.
He saw clearly, the Grand Elder's skin split and flesh gaped open, wounds deep enough to expose bone. The Grand Elder, as if feeling no pain, relentlessly struck back at the Thunder Tribulation, completely disregarding his own injuries.
"When he's asleep, he's like this, only attacking, not defending, and unable to feel pain," Daoist Buyu explained again.
The Grand Elder, not knowing what he was dreaming about, had a fierce expression, resembling an Arhat exorcising demons from the murals.
"Let me tell you, I am the strongest zombie, having cultivated to the realm of the Drought Demon; you lot of Unformable Bones couldn't possibly be stronger than me!" the Grand Elder suddenly shouted.
