"Let me tell you, this graveyard is my territory, no one can think of taking it away!"
"Don't agree? Then let the fists do the talking!"
Lu Yang: "..."
Grand Elder, what exactly are you dreaming about?
When the Grand Elder repelled the ninety-ninth Thunder Tribulation, and the tribulations from both below the canyon and above dissipated, sunlight shining on the floating Grand Elder, battered and bruised like a war god, the Grand Elder slowly opened his eyes, his face solemn and stiff, as though relishing the sensation of becoming a Drought Demon.
"Hiss, that hurts!"
The pain that followed the Tribulation quickly pulled the Grand Elder back to reality. The power left by the Thunder Tribulation in his body continuously healed him, and only then did he realize that he had just undergone the Tribulation, and he had now become a Pass Tribulation Cultivator.
"Big brother, finally a Pass Tribulation Cultivator, congratulations," Daoist Buyu was the first to offer his congratulations, with Uncle Ba and others flying up to join in.
There was a joyous atmosphere throughout the Seek Dao Sect; adding a Pass Tribulation Cultivator was cause for celebration.
"Senior Brother, where did little Qin get this fondness for zombies and graves?" Elder Tao asked with a strange look at the child Grandmaster, suspecting his involvement in it.
The child Grandmaster coughed dryly, embarrassed to say that he used to scare the Grand Elder with zombie stories. He hadn't anticipated that it wouldn't scare him, but instead it piqued his interest.

chapters.title: Chapter 929 - 928: The Flaws of Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin
chapters.content:
```
The Grand Elder was evidently several notches more popular than Daoist Buyu; his advancement to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage was celebrated throughout the Seek Dao Sect, filling the place with jubilation.
Three days later, the festive atmosphere finally began to fade away.
"So this is the legendary Inheriting Shadow Sword," Daoist Buyu caressed the Inheriting Shadow Sword, unable to put it down. He really had a capable disciple. Back in the Sword Vault, he had tried to gain the acknowledgment of the Inheriting Shadow Sword but ended up failing and had to settle for the lesser Spirit Sword.
He was also envious of Lu Yang's Green Peak Sword, which came with its own mini-world.
Daoist Buyu's Spirit Sword was not an ordinary item either. It was a growth-type Spirit Treasure that could constantly ascend in grade as his cultivation level increased, growing alongside Daoist Buyu. And, as long as he was willing to invest the proper resources, it could potentially reach the First-Grade of "Immortal."
"It's said that before Liu Ningxuan even cultivated to the Semi-Immortal level, his sword already reached the level of the Immortal Sword. Truly remarkable," Daoist Buyu felt a pang of regret. Hearing that Liu Ningxuan had just died in the Sword Tower, it meant he had no chance to cross swords with this legendary figure in swordsmanship.
But then again, now that the Sword Tower Supreme is resurrected, he could have a match with the Sword Tower Supreme himself.
Not now, of course. His cultivation level isn't high enough, and his sword's quality isn't up to par either. He needed to become stronger.
"I heard that at the Grand Sword Fest, you unleashed the Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin?"
"Hmm."
Daoist Buyu looked at Lu Yang with satisfaction. He hadn't expected that without being taught, Lu Yang had already learned it.
"Come, show me once," he said.
Lu Yang spread out the Swordmanship Domain Embryo, and countless Green Peak Swords emerged from the ground and sky, as imposing as hell itself.
He lifted the real Green Peak Sword; then the Green Peak Swords stuck in the ground and sky burst free from their seals and merged with the real Green Peak Sword, causing the sword's might to surge by more than three feet!
"The Swordmanship Domain Embryo and Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin? Come, strike me with one sword," Daoist Buyu's eyes shone, eager to experience its power.
Without hesitation, Lu Yang shouted loudly, and the Sword Qi dragon roared forth, suddenly transforming back into the real Green Peak Sword, slashing towards Daoist Buyu!
Daoist Buyu, unhurriedly extended two fingers and lightly pinched the blade of the Green Peak Sword. The menacing Green Peak Sword suddenly fell quiet, unable to press down even the slightest bit!
"Indeed, it's the Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin. It seems you learned it by watching me perform it. Except, when I did it, I took a shortcut," Daoist Buyu recalled he had only performed the Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin once in front of Lu Yang, during his battle with the Ruthless Sect.
Just by watching once, Lu Yang had almost fully grasped the technique. He was truly an extraordinary talent in swordsmanship.
"A shortcut?"
"Sit down, I'll explain it to you slowly." On the top of Sky Gate Mountain, there were only Lu Yang and Daoist Buyu.
Yun Mengmeng and Gan Tian had no interest in swordsmanship. Gan Tian had found a scenic spot to play her zither, while Yun Mengmeng had wrapped up snacks bought from the cafeteria and was eating pastries while lying on a big rock in the river and listening to Gan Tian play.
The cafeteria's pastries could be used as weapons, but Yun Mengmeng wasn't vegetarian either. With the jaw strength of someone in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, eating the cafeteria's pastries was no different from eating regular pastries for her.
As for Yun Zhi, she claimed she wasn't interested in swordsmanship and had also gone to the riverside to listen to the zither.
"I heard that in your contest with Mingtai, it came down to a confrontation of Sword Qi in the end. Even after numerous exchanges, there was no clear superior, until you finally unleashed Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin and won the victory."
"This brings to light an issue: you and Mingtai were each projecting your Sword Qi to its limit, but it was the limit of the Sword Qi's condensed form, not your own limits. If it was your own limits, you should have been exhausted after projecting your Sword Qi just once."
"Your Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin involved collapsing the Sword Qi-formed Green Peak Swords back into Sword Qi, taking them back in, thereby raising the limit of your Sword Qi."
Lu Yang understood his master's meaning, meaning his Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin had increased its explosive power.
```
Immediately, Daoist Buyu's tone shifted, "However, this is not the true intent of 'Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin'."
'Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin' is about concentrating the power of different swords into one, thereby unleashing might that surpasses the limit."
Lu Yang recalled how the Sword Tower Supreme fought against the Ying Tian Corpse, merging all the Spirit Swords from the Sword Vault into the Containing Light Sword—just as what his master was explaining.
"Come, let your teacher show you how to grasp the true intent of 'Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin'."
'Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin' starts with resonating with the other swords. Your previous execution was missing this step, so I said it was a shortcut."
"Then, with the Green Peak Sword as the main focus, let the resonating sound of the other swords gradually align with the Green Peak Sword..."
"It would be best if the resonance occurred when the Green Peak Sword's momentum reaches its peak..."
"..."
Daoist Buyu's explanation was simple, but if it were someone else, like Fairy Eternity, they would undoubtedly be confused. Yet to Lu Yang, it was all too clear.
Lu Yang's eyes sparkled as he repeatedly pondered and speculated on the true meaning of 'Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin' in his mind.
"I'll give it a try."
Lu Yang took out the Inheriting Shadow Sword and Seven Star Sword Set in succession, which made Daoist Buyu's eyes especially envious.
Standing firm, ripples spread across the lawn beneath Lu Yang's feet as if sliced by sword Qi. The Inheriting Shadow Sword and the Seven Star Sword Set trembled continuously until their frequency matched the Green Peak Sword's, merging into it and becoming one.
"Ha!"
Lu Yang swung another sword at Daoist Buyu, a sword Qi like a waterfall cascading down. A silver streak flashed past and was once again caught between Daoist Buyu's fingers.
"Excellent!" Daoist Buyu laughed heartily, impressed that with just a little guidance, Lu Yang had grasped the true essence of 'Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin'!
He flicked his wrist, sending Lu Yang and the Green Peak Sword flying while his right hand was placed behind his back, rubbing his index and middle fingers together.
The power of that sword strike was beyond his expectations.
Lu Yang tumbled twice before steadying himself; the Inheriting Shadow Sword and Seven Star Sword Set had fallen out.
Daoist Buyu strode forward with a cheerful expression, "Well done! If you practice diligently, you will be able to skillfully execute 'Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin' … Little Lu?"
Daoist Buyu noticed Lu Yang standing in a daze, staring at the eight swords that had fallen to the ground, seemingly lost in thought.
After a while, Lu Yang came back to his senses only to ask, "Master, isn't executing 'Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin' a bit too ostentatious?"
Daoist Buyu nodded. 'Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin' was indeed a grand and impressive display, especially the resonating and aligning of swords—that aspect truly was ostentatious, which was why it was beloved by sword cultivators.
Then Lu Yang asked further, "But if the technique is ostentatious, doesn't it mean that the opponent will know you are about to use 'Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin,' giving them time to react?"
"That is indeed a flaw of 'Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin.'" It could allow an opponent to dodge or prepare their own attack.
An idea gradually emerged in Lu Yang's mind, "What if I hide the Inheriting Shadow Sword and Seven Star Sword Set within the Green Peak Sword's mini-world? When I execute 'Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin,' the nine swords would merge unseen; wouldn't the opponent be unaware that I've used 'Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin,' thus unprepared?"
Daoist Buyu did not respond but silently patted Lu Yang's shoulder.
"Remember, in the future, when you tell others about this move, say that you realized it on your own, and that it has nothing to do with your teacher."

chapters.title: Chapter 930 - 929: Tricks of Using the Sword
chapters.content:
Upon hearing Lu Yang's method, Daoist Buyu suddenly felt as if Lu Yang had already left his apprenticeship behind, and there was no need to teach him the shameless fighting techniques from the bottom of his chest.
He felt that Lu Yang could completely comprehend a set of shameless fighting techniques that would suit him better and be more comfortable for him to use.
Truly a case of the student surpassing the master.
With this Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin, it didn't matter whether Lu Yang was his disciple; in the eyes of outsiders, he was undoubtedly one of his disciples.
Lu Yang felt that his modified method was indeed very effective, not to mention the issue of Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin being too ostentatious had been resolved; just solving the problem of not being able to use the Seven Star Sword Set in front of others proved it was a good method.
After all, to outsiders, the Seven Star Sword Set belonged to Young Sect Master Lu, which had nothing to do with him, Lu Yang.
Having no opportunity to display the Seven Star Sword Set made Lu Yang feel he hadn't done justice to it.
This was a method that killed several birds with one stone.
Soon, Lu Yang hid the Inheriting Shadow Sword and the Seven Star Sword Set within the small world of the Green Peak Sword, and once again executed Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin.
Sure enough, nothing seemed amiss from the outside, and even Daoist Buyu had to give a thumbs up and call it a crafty move.
Being praised by his master, Lu Yang didn't become arrogant but instead buckled down to learn how to execute Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin even more skillfully. Daoist Buyu was nodding repeatedly on the sidelines, impressed by his young disciple's temperament, which was better than his own in his youth.
Had he thought of any cunning moves back then, he would have been off using them against others instead of continuing his cultivation.
Seven days went by, and Lu Yang could finally execute Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin with proficiency. With one swing, even Daoist Buyu couldn't tell if it was the Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin or a normal strike, let alone anyone else.
During these seven days, Yun Zhi, Yun Mengmeng, and Gan Tian came and went. Yun Mengmeng even squatted down to watch Lu Yang's cultivation for a while, but finding it boring, she went back to listening to music.
With good food, drinks, and music to listen to, her days were considerably comfortable, far more so than in the Secret Realm.
"If I had known, I would have left the Secret Realm and joined little Zhi earlier," Yun Mengmeng hummed along to the music with enthusiasm, her voice melodious and pleasant, which surprisingly matched the sweet tunes, impressing Gan Tian.
"Did you study singing?"
"Not at all, I'm just singing for fun."
Gan Tian was even more amazed, realizing this was pure talent.
"How about we play music together? I'll play the tunes, and you sing?"
Playing music and singing together would be greatly beneficial for her cultivation of the rhythm pathway, she just hadn't found the right person for it up till now.
"Sure," Yun Mengmeng happily agreed.
After his Divine Ability training was complete, Lu Yang was satisfied as he put away the Green Peak Sword, bid farewell to his master and excitedly went to find Meng Jingzhou.
"Old Meng, are you there? Come out and practice a bit," Lu Yang called out directly at the entrance to Meng Jingzhou's place.
Old Ma was guarding the entrance, completely failing to fulfill his duties as the Protector, allowing Lu Yang to shout loudly.
As Sun Power increased, Old Ma discovered that the dried grass he had been drying out tasted much better than before, and he had been busy drying grass lately.
Looking at the piles of dried grass, Old Ma felt a greater sense of accomplishment than being a Protector.
"What the hell are you yelling about?" Meng Jingzhou emerged soaking wet, having just climbed out of ice water.
To soothe his restless heart, Meng Jingzhou had been immersing himself in ice water to cool down.
"Just learned a couple of new moves, want to practice them with you," said Lu Yang with a smile.
"Oh, seems like you think you can fight now," Meng Jingzhou replied, suddenly intrigued, as he shook off his body, not suppressing his Yang Qi any longer. His terrifying aura of Yang Qi dried his clothes and hair instantly.
Having studied under the great ancestor for over a year, coupled with the dramatic increase in Sun Power and the strengthening of his Single Body Spiritual Root, his strength had advanced by leaps and bounds. To him, Lu Yang posed no threat at all.
"What have you learned?" Meng Jingzhou looked at Lu Yang with a side glance, sensing that this kid was up to no good.
"Just a couple of little sword tricks," Lu Yang said modestly.
Just as Lu Yang didn't believe a word of Meng Jingzhou's bluff, Meng Jingzhou didn't believe any of Lu Yang's talk either.
Old Ma, seeing that a fight was about to start, took the initiative to gather the drying grass, clearing space for the two of them.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou stood on the grass, the breeze blowing wave after wave across the lawn, causing their robes to flutter as well.
Meng Jingzhou roared loudly. His vigorous Yang Qi formed a unique aura, his fists one in front and one behind, as he steadied his stance, watching Lu Yang warily.
Lu Yang drew the Green Peak Sword from his waist, and the blade scraped the lip of the scabbard, making a sharp "zzt" sound.
Lu Yang steadily held up the Green Peak Sword, its tip pointing directly at Meng Jingzhou with not a hint of wavering, and he shouted sternly, "Meng Jingzhou, why don't you kneel upon seeing this genius!"
Meng Jingzhou flew into a rage, "I kneel to your grandpa..."
```
Before he could finish speaking, Meng Jingzhou suddenly fell to his knees with a thud, his face full of confusion.
Even Old Ma, who was eating hay, was stunned and couldn't understand what technique Lu Yang had used.
Lu Yang revealed a look of surprise: "Hey, I was just joking, Old Meng, why did you really kneel down? There's no need, no need."
Being forced to kneel, this feeling was all too familiar to Meng Jingzhou, damn it, it was the Extinguishing Immortal Sword Array.
The question was, when had Lu Yang deployed the Extinguishing Immortal Sword Array?
"How about it? Can't figure out how I did it?" Seeing Old Meng's confused face, Lu Yang couldn't help feeling very pleased with himself.
Meng Jingzhou honestly nodded, he truly wanted to know how Lu Yang did it.
"It's quite simple, actually. There's a small world within my Green Peak Sword, where I can deploy the Extinguishing Immortal Sword Array, and then execute the Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin. This way, whoever my sword points at must kneel."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
Is this what you call a sword trick?
He had indeed prepared himself for Lu Yang deploying the Extinguishing Immortal Sword Array, but no matter how much he prepared, he hadn't anticipated that the Extinguishing Immortal Sword Array had advanced to such a degree.
Who could defend against this?
Lu Yang stopped using the Extinguishing Immortal Sword Array, allowing Meng Jingzhou to stand up.
"Come on, let's start the real fight," Lu Yang said with a laugh, looking as if he held the winning ticket, making Meng Jingzhou grit his teeth in frustration. Do you really think I have no way to deal with you?
"Take this, Piercing Technique!"
Lu Yang bellowed, as his Green Peak Sword thrust forward, piercing the air and fast as lightning.
Meng Jingzhou's lips curled into a cold smile, the Piercing Technique was all he had, he seriously underestimated him. Originally, Meng Jingzhou intended to take it head-on, but suddenly he had an indescribable feeling that something wasn't right and instinctively avoided the sword.
A ravine appeared right where Meng Jingzhou was standing.
This was by no means the power of the Piercing Technique!
"This isn't the damn Piercing Technique at all!"
Meng Jingzhou suddenly remembered, when Lu Yang explained how to secretly deploy the Extinguishing Immortal Sword Array, he mentioned it was necessary to first deploy the Extinguishing Immortal Sword Array, then execute Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin.
So what if he only executed Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin?
Of course, that would work.
This sword had the appearance of the Piercing Technique, but in reality, it was Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin!
A venerable hand exuding ancient aura emerged behind Meng Jingzhou, the arm bent and shielded him.
There was a clang, the Green Peak Sword collided with the ancient hand, pierced through the hand's appearance, almost puncturing through it.
"The Dharma Aspect?" Lu Yang exclaimed in surprise, as the ancient hand was part of some Dharma Aspect.
It seems that while studying with Meng Junzi, Old Meng learned how to deploy the Dharma Aspect.
Lu Yang struck again with his sword, hitting the ancient hand once more.
To his surprise, this time the Green Peak Sword did not pierce through the ancient hand, it was just a normal sword skill.
Just when Meng Jingzhou prepared to retract the ancient hand, Lu Yang made the fourth strike, once again almost puncturing through the hand, startling Meng Jingzhou into not making any other moves.
Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin!
Meng Jingzhou, sweating on his forehead, vaguely realized the tactic of this rascal, Lu Yang.
There's no difference between Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin and an ordinary sword strike, you can't tell unless you cross swords.
And he dared not guess what the next move Lu Yang would execute; one wrong bet was a loss. All he could do was keep deploying the Dharma Aspect!
Lu Yang continued to thrust with his Green Peak Sword, an unending barrage with a few instances of Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin amidst numerous ordinary strikes.
Meng Jingzhou wasn't able to maintain the Dharma Aspect indefinitely, and eventually the ancient hand disintegrated, forcing him to admit defeat.
"Okay, okay, you win."
Meng Jingzhou looked at Lu Yang with annoyance: "Where did you learn such a dirty trick?"
Not just him, but anyone at the initial stage of Spirit Transformation couldn't cope with such a dirty trick.
Lu Yang straightened his clothes, and said earnestly, "My master said that I should claim I realized this technique on my own, and that it has nothing to do with him."
```

chapters.title: Chapter 931 - 930 The Most Formidable Ancestor of the Barbarian Tribe
chapters.content:
```
According to common sense, such an unscrupulous move would indeed seem like something Daoist Buyu would teach, but Meng Jingzhou always felt that Lu Yang wasn't telling the whole truth.
"Did the Sect Leader really say that?" Meng Jingzhou looked at Lu Yang with suspicion.
Lu Yang was quite dissatisfied with Meng Jingzhou's doubts, as he had clearly spoken the truth, "If I were to deceive you, may I be struck a few more times by lightning when I pass the Heavenly Tribulation."
Lu Yang felt that since he had already passed the first Qian Heavenly Tribulation of the Spirit Transformation Level as a Nascent Soul Stage cultivator, his own trials during the Divinity Transformation Stage would surely be a breeze, with no difficulty at all.
Meng Jingzhou rolled his eyes and was just about to say something when he saw Lu Yang suddenly disappear from in front of him without any warning, which gave him quite a fright.
"Where did he go? Did he really suffer retribution?"
…
In a desolate mountain range within Great Xia, three figures were moving and battling intensely, shifting mountains, turning the sky and earth upside down.
Boom—
The two weaker figures were blown away, piercing through mountains and plastering against the cliff walls of the mountain behind them.
"Senior Sister Lan Ting, are you alright?" Man Gu climbed out of the cliff face with a grimace, concernedly asking, since his thick skin and flesh meant he was not much harmed, but it may not be the same case for Senior Sister Lan Ting.
Lan Ting, wrapped in her sash, climbed out from another cliff, her sash having absorbed most of the attack, which meant her injuries weren't too severe.
"You two juniors, do you really think that just because you've reached the Initial Stage of Spirit Transformation, you can challenge this one who is in the Early Integration Stage?" The opponent looked at the two indifferently, emitting an aura of the Early Integration Stage.
Man Gu and Lan Ting were officially taking on an Integration Period Cultivator for the first time. With their combat strengths, they were indeed qualified to challenge someone in the Early Integration Stage, but that was under the assumption that the opponent did not employ [Rules].
At first, the two held the upper hand when working together, but once their opponent employed [Rules], the tide of the battle was turned, leaving them both in dire straits.
"It looks like we can't beat him, what should we do?"
After advancing to the Spirit Transformation Level, Man Gu went to the Task Hall to take on his first mission, which involved clues about the Ruthless Sect. Upon reaching the mission location, he happened to bump into Lan Ting who was also there to investigate.
By joining forces, they were actually able to follow the trail and find clues of the Ruthless Sect, leading them to the Ruthless Sect Elder they were now facing.
The only problem was that it appeared they were unable to defeat the Elder.
The Ruthless Sect Elder was right before their eyes. If they fled now, it would be difficult to find this Elder again in the future.
"Fight!" Lan Ting gritted her teeth.
Man Gu was resolute, if it was a fight they wanted, then a fight they would have. He sent a message to Lan Ting, "I need you to distract the Ruthless Sect Elder for a moment, Senior Sister Lan Ting. I have a method that might allow the power of the strongest ancestor of the Barbarian tribe to descend upon my primordial spirit and potentially change the situation."
"Alright!" Lan Ting chose to trust Man Gu and charged forward.
"Foolish juniors who know not of death." In the hand of the Ruthless Sect Elder was a Bone Knife with a handle composed of many small skulls, which emitted mournful wails when swung, an especially frightening specter.
Lan Ting didn't dare to face off against the Ruthless Sect Elder directly, her blue sash fluttering as she employed softness to overcome strength, wrapping around the Elder's arm and redirecting the trajectory of the blade!
With her movements light and graceful, Lan Ting resembled a fairy dancing in the Moon Palace, rendering the Ruthless Sect Elder's strength ineffective.
"I hereby establish the [Rule: The Bone Knife cuts through all]!"
An odd power coated the surface of the Bone Knife, swiftly reducing Lan Ting's troublesome sash to shreds, and without its interference, the Ruthless Sect Elder made a beeline cut for Lan Ting!
Man Gu brought out his primordial spirit, rubbed his hands vigorously and chanted, and with his ascension to the Spirit Transformation Level, he had solved the uncertainty that came with summoning the power of his ancestors during the Nascent Soul Stage.
"Blessings of the Immortals, I, Man Gu, respectfully welcome the strongest combat force of my Barbarian ancestors!"
The primordial spirit of Man Gu transformed, a dazzling milky white light flashed by, and a powerful force descended from the heavens, infusing into Man Gu's primordial spirit!
The ancestor of the Barbarian tribe looked up sharply, instantly moving in front of the Ruthless Sect Elder.
Clang—
The Barbarian ancestor, with sword in hand, blocked the Bone Knife that was supposed to cut through anything!
```
Lan Ting couldn't believe her eyes as she stared blankly at the barbarian ancestor who had saved her, "Elder Brother Lu Yang, when did you become a barbarian ancestor?"
Man Gu was also filled with shock, how had his primordial spirit suddenly become Elder Brother Lu Yang?
"Ah?" Lu Yang himself was confused, as dumbfounded as a monk who had reached an impasse. He was busy duping Meng Jingzhou, how had he arrived here in the blink of an eye?
As soon as he arrived, he saw Lan Ting in a crisis, so he had no choice but to fight first and ask questions later.
"Let's not worry about that for now, who is this on the opposite side?" Lu Yang asked, sensing that the murderous intent opposite him was not for a friendly spar.
"An elder of the Ruthless Sect!"
"Then let's deal with him first before discussing anything else!"
The Bone Knife, augmented by the [Rule], was exceptionally sharp, and could cut through anything.
But not the Green Peak Sword.
The Green Peak Sword, being an Immortal Sword, was not something that could be damaged by a mere Integration Period Cultivator using a rule.
"Kill!"
Lu Yang's eyes also revealed a killing intent. There was no need to hold back against the Ruthless Sect—it was fine as long as a single soul remained.
"Take my sword strike!"
The elder of the Ruthless Sect looked at Lu Yang's sword strike with disdain, mundane and unremarkable. Just with this kind of swordplay, you think you can harm me?
Crack—Pu Chi—
The Bone Knife was actually cut in two by this single strike, which, without much reduction in power, hit the Ruthless Sect elder!
A sword mark stretched from the Ruthless Sect elder's left shoulder to his right waist, blood pouring profusely!
Lu Yang was also surprised; the power of this sword strike exceeded his expectations.
Ever since he arrived here, he had felt an additional power that was not his own, making him several times stronger than even at his peak!
The elder of the Ruthless Sect was caught completely off guard by this turn of events. He wanted to pull back and use the [Rule] to heal, but Lu Yang, who had witnessed countless battles of high-level cultivators and even that of immortals, knew exactly what the Ruthless Sect elder was planning to do.
How could he possibly give him the chance!
Lu Yang quickly closed the gap with the Ruthless Sect elder, slashing with the same sword strike once more, shocking the elder who had no time to use his rule, and hurriedly mobilized his power to resist.
But this sword strike was unexpectedly ordinary.
Just when he thought it was all over, Lu Yang spat out the Three Flavored True Fire, directly onto his face!
"Ah!" The Three Flavored True Fire relentlessly burned his face, the pain making him scream and forcing him to divert power to suppress the True Fire.
Lu Yang continued to strike with his sword, with simple sword skills that hid the Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin, catching the Ruthless Sect elder completely off guard.
"Bloody Heaven Grudge!" the Ruthless Sect elder shouted in a low voice, as a boundless sea of blood appeared behind him, filled with numerous ghosts and beings writhing, pleading in the blood, countless arms stretching out, attempting to drag Lu Yang into the sea of blood!
Lu Yang pointed his sword at the Ruthless Sect elder and barked harshly, "Kneel!"
Inexplicably, the Ruthless Sect elder was unable to resist. He knelt down with a thud, breaking off his technique, and the towering sea of blood behind him vanished as well!
Swish—
A sword light, fast to the extreme, passed by, and an extremely fine line of blood appeared on the Ruthless Sect elder's neck.
Blood spurted out, the head flew off, and rolled to the ground, tumbling to a stop at Lu Yang's feet.
Lu Yang sheathed his sword, looking at Man Gu and Lan Ting.
"So, can someone explain what exactly happened?"

chapters.title: Chapter 932 - 931: The Seniority of Lu Yang
chapters.content:
Man Gu and Lan Ting were just preparing to help Lu Yang, but before they could make a move, they saw Lu Yang execute a series of flowing sword skills, decapitating the Ruthless Sect Elder.
Seeing the Ruthless Sect Elder's eyes widen with his head left staring at them, they still felt disoriented.
The two of them took turns explaining the cause and effect, and eventually, Lu Yang roughly understood what had happened.
"So, you mean to say, the two of you ran into a Ruthless Sect Elder you couldn't beat, and called me over?"
"What we summoned was the mightiest ancestor of our Barbarian Tribe at the Divinity Transformation Stage," corrected Man Gu.
At this point, Lu Yang helplessly held his forehead, recalling how he had previously spared no effort to learn the Playing Dead Technique, even going as far as to take Fairy Eternity as his master. Fairy Eternity had said becoming her apprentice would elevate his generation level, putting him on the same level as the Ancient Barbarian Tribe.
It seemed now that Fairy Eternity had indeed not deceived him.
What is the characteristic of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe? They are part of the human race that Fairy Eternity had cursed with a spell. From this perspective, he was truly a member of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe.
In fact, he was among the oldest and most genuine of the Ancient Barbarian Tribe members.
Man Gu's primordial spirit could call upon the power left in the world by the ancestors of the Barbarian Tribe. Since the Barbarian ancestors had become history and only a small part of their power lingered in the world, Man Gu's primordial spirit could only summon this small part of their strength.
Now that he, a true ancestor of the Barbarian Tribe, was still alive, the summoning had brought him directly.
"I had no idea, Brother Lu, that you were one of our Barbarian ancestors," asked Man Gu cautiously, holding Lu Yang in high regard.
Lan Ting also looked at Lu Yang in surprise, thinking that being with a disciple of the Dao Seeking Sect really broadened one's horizons.
Lu Yang: "..."
I just found out myself.
"Junior Sister Lan Ting, it's been a long time," Lu Yang said with a smile. The last time he had seen Lan Ting was when the Vast Sea Ancestral Master emerged after dealing with the Master of All Laws, and the great powers of cultivation came to pay their respects.
Lan Ting smiled. She was dressed in a green robe and skirt, and her hair, sticky on her face after the battle, had its own charm: "Even though we haven't seen each other for a long time, Brother Lu Yang's reputation has indeed reached me."
"Saving the Dragon Clan Ancestor in the East Sea, earning a favor from him, composing an unparalleled poem for Ye Mengyin in the Imperial City, reporting the Fourth Prince's rebellion, rescuing the Sword Tower Supreme and Senior Sister Yun Zhi in the Sword Tower, and holding off the Yingtian Immortal..."
Upon hearing the last part, Lu Yang broke out in a cold sweat. How did this story get out?
That's right, back then Yun Mengmeng was fighting the Ying Tian Corpse under the name of the Eldest Senior Sister; it's likely that afterward, both Yun Mengmeng and the Eldest Senior Sister were too lazy to clarify, making it seem to the world that he had stepped in to save the Eldest Senior Sister!
"They're all rumors," Lu Yang chuckled dryly, not daring to acknowledge these events, let alone the fact that some of them were done by Fairy Eternity possessing him.
But in the eyes of Lan Ting and Man Gu, this was just modesty, and their admiration for Lu Yang grew even more.
"By the way, after I came here, I felt an extra power in my body that wasn't my own. Do you know what's going on?" Otherwise, even with the fast and tricky moves and the Ruthless Sect Elder having been worn down once by Man Gu and Lan Ting, he wouldn't have been able to deal with the Ruthless Sect Elder so quickly.
Man Gu was quite surprised: "What a coincidence, I feel that my primordial spirit is inside Brother Lu."
"…Junior Brother Man, why don't you try undoing the call to the ancestor?"
"Oh, right, of course."
Man Gu ended the summoning of the ancestor, and Man Gu's primordial spirit floated out of Lu Yang's body and returned to Man Gu, leaving Lu Yang's strength back to its original state.
"This summoning of yours, why is it one-way?" Lu Yang still wanted to go back and continue to fool Old Meng.
Seeing that Lu Yang wouldn't be able to return for a while, Lan Ting's eyes lit up: "If Brother Lu Yang isn't in a hurry, why not visit our Laurel Fairy Palace? It would be a perfect opportunity for us to have an exchange and progress together."
At the moment, Lu Yang really had nothing urgent: "But isn't the Laurel Fairy Palace forbidden to men?"
```
"There are no such strict rules," Lan Ting said with a smile.
```
```
Lu Yang thought it over. Since they had extended such an invitation, wouldn't it be rude not to accept their kindness?
```
```
Moreover, he genuinely wanted to see what the legendary Laurel Fairy Palace was like.
```
```
"Then I'll have to trouble Junior Sister Lan Ting," he said.
```
```
Man Gu, looking at the two of them chatting and laughing so freely, couldn't help feeling a bit superfluous.
```
```
"Whose possession should the soul of this Ruthless Sect Elder be?" he wondered.
```
```
He and Lan Ting had taken on the mission at the same time, so which sect should the Elder's soul be delivered to?
```
```
"That's easy."
```
```
Lu Yang had seen how Jiang Pingan had divided Guan Shanhai's soul. He had watched and learned almost everything there was to know on the subject.
```
```
He applied a few drops of his own blood evenly on the sword blade and attached a few spell incantations. Then he pulled out the Ruthless Sect Elder's soul, which he had been hiding in his head, and without heeding the Elder's screams, he struck with his sword, slicing the three souls and seven spirits evenly; Lan Ting took the three souls, and Man Gu took the seven spirits.
```
```
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, don't you want any?" Lan Ting asked. After all, Lu Yang had put in the most effort.
```
```
Lu Yang waved his hand dismissively. He could use Fairy Eternity's contribution points at any time—he was wealthy and didn't bother over a soul, especially one from the Body Integration Realm, which wasn't worth much.
```
```
Lu Yang seemed to remember something and seriously reminded Man Gu, "Right, Junior Brother Man, when you go back, make sure to emphasize to Elder Brother Dai how much I helped. It's a good opportunity to improve the image he has of me."
```
```
"Okay."
```
```
"Junior Sister Lan Ting, let's go."
```
```
...
```
```
Dai Bufan was surprised to see that Man Gu had brought back the three souls of the Ruthless Sect Elder.
```
```
The mission had been for Man Gu to investigate the Ruthless Sect's leads, but he hadn't expected Man Gu to actually find a high-ranking member of the Ruthless Sect. It was an unexpected delight.
```
```
With the three souls of the Ruthless Sect Elder in hand, a Soul Search would surely catch several high-ranking members of the Ruthless Sect!
```
```
"I didn't expect Junior Brother Man to be able to slay someone at the Early Integration Stage when you're only at the Initial Stage of Spirit Transformation. Impressive indeed."
```
```
Man Gu chuckled but did not take the credit: "It was all due to Senior Sister Lan Ting and Elder Brother Lu Yang's efforts. I didn't exert much strength."
```
```
"What happened? Tell me more," Dai Bufan urged.
```
```
Man Gu described in detail how he and Lan Ting met, how they came across the clue that led to the Ruthless Sect Elder, and according to Lu Yang's instructions, he particularly emphasized how Lu Yang appeared at the crucial moment, saved Lan Ting, and beheaded the Ruthless Sect Elder, playing a pivotal role.
```
```
Dai Bufan found it amusing. How had Lu Yang suddenly become an ancestor of the Barbarian tribe?
```
```
"It seems Elder Brother Lu doesn't only bring surprises but can also do many good deeds. I didn't expect him to play such a crucial role in this affair," Dai Bufan said with a smile.
```
```
Previously, it wasn't that Lu Yang didn't do good deeds; it's just that his deeds tended to give Dai Bufan a huge shock, like suddenly founding the Heavenly Court Sect to infiltrate the demonic sect, or suddenly finding an innate Ancestral Master.
```
```
This time was different. This time Lu Yang just did the good deed without causing any shock.
```
```
"Is everything you're saying true?" Dai Bufan asked for confirmation once more.
```
```
Man Gu, naive and sincere, replied, "It's true. Elder Brother Lu Yang told me to say all this."
```
```
"?"

chapters.title: Chapter 933 - 932: Visiting Laurel Fairy Palace
chapters.content:
```
Between the Central Continent and the Extreme Northern Lands lies a continuous range of snow-capped mountains that stretch from east to west, where it's always heavily snowing and seldom sunny.
"This is the legendary Great Snow Mountain." Lu Yang stood at the foothill of the mountain, shielding his eyes as he looked upwards. Behind the swirling snowflakes, a towering, pure white mountain range lay quietly before him.
"It's not so much a legend as it is that the place is too remote; few people are willing to come here," Lan Ting said with a laugh.
It was an understatement—Laurel Fairy Palace was considered a semi-hermit Immortal Sect and rarely interacted with the outside world. External communications, such as seeking help from the Laurel Fairy Palace, issuing tasks, meetings among the Righteous Path, or Immortal Sect gatherings, all relied on messages relayed through the Communication Hall at the foot of the mountain.
However, there were cases where direct access to the Laurel Fairy Palace was possible without intermediaries, like when Lan Ting took Lu Yang up the mountain—an act commonly referred to in the public as using the "back door."
On both sides of the winding mountain path, one often saw small trees, translucent like jade, standing over a man's height, as exquisite as works of art.
"These are Laurel Trees?" It was Lu Yang's first encounter with living Laurel Trees, as he had only seen their branches and twigs in the outside world.
Laurel Trees only grew on Great Snow Mountain, unable to survive elsewhere, no matter what divine abilities were used to prolong their life.
"Yes, the Great Snow Mountain is full of Laurel Trees. Legend has it that thirty thousand years ago, Ancient Immortals battled, squeezing stars into continents, and the moon turned into what is now the Great Snow Mountain."
"Fairy, is that true?" Lu Yang asked for confirmation from the usually unresponsive Fairy Eternity.
"It should be. According to the soil composition from the base of the mountain, it really is the moon. Back then, Laurel Trees indeed grew on the moon. The Jade Rabbit often dug holes under the trees, and Immortal Jiuchong frequently visited the moon to capture Jade Rabbits for breeding.
Ying Tian Immortal often took the Sky Opening Axe to the moon to chop down Laurel Trees and bring them back to me for firewood to burn."
"Let me tell you, the food cooked with Laurel Tree wood has a unique fragrance that no other tree can replicate."
The two of them slowly ascended Great Snow Mountain, which stood thirty thousand meters tall and was the highest in the Cultivation World—insurmountable for average cultivators. Yet, for Lu Yang and Lan Ting, both Divine Transformation Stage Cultivators, climbing the mountain was as easy as walking on flat ground.
The closer they got to the summit, the more frequent the Laurel Trees appeared, and they became taller, with many surpassing ten meters.
As Lu Yang climbed onto a massive rocky platform, he saw a pristine white palace nestled among the mountains, stunningly beautiful, like something out of an Immortal Realm—the Laurel Fairy Palace that people spoke of but seldom visited.
Lan Ting led Lu Yang to the entrance of the palace. Two female disciples guarding the entrance became instinctively alert when they saw a man approaching, weapons in hand, blocking the entryway.
Just as Lan Ting was about to explain, the two female disciples got a clear look at Lu Yang's face and asked with a mix of hesitation and delight, "Could it be that you are Elder Brother Lu Yang from Seek Dao Sect?"
Lu Yang nodded, sensing something off about the way the two female disciples looked at him.
Lan Ting inwardly cursed her luck; she had only thought about inviting Lu Yang to the Laurel Fairy Palace to foster a closer relationship with him, but she had forgotten how popular he was at the Laurel Fairy Palace!
"Hasn't Young Master Meng from Imperial City come with you?" The two female disciples glanced around, hoping to catch a glimpse of the legendary ascetic who was known for his seriousness, distance from women, and devotion to the path of cultivation.
"He is currently at a critical point in his cultivation and could not come," Lu Yang replied.
This was true; Meng Jingzhou's current priority was to stay away from feminine allure, and a place like the Laurel Fairy Palace, brimming with beauties, was off-limits to him.
"That's how it is; please enter, Elder Brother," said the female disciples, granting him entry without requiring any further explanation from Lan Ting.
As Lan Ting previously mentioned, the palace's rules weren't as strict as one might think.
Of course, how strict they were depended on who the visitor was; someone like Daoist Buyu wouldn't have received such a warm welcome.
Lan Ting was beginning to regret taking Lu Yang to the Fairy Palace; she would have been better off inviting him to her own home.
But now that they were already at the entrance of the palace, it was too late for second thoughts.
```
Inside the Fairy Palace, everything was shrouded in silver-white, a vast expanse of white. The eaves and treetops each bore a thick layer of snow.
The Laurel Fairy Palace naturally had the ability to clear away the snow, but Chasing Moon True Person, the founder of the palace, believed that such an environment was conducive to the cultivation of the Power of Taiyin, and thus there was no need to raise a barrier to keep the heavy snow at bay.
"I'll take you to see Master first."
Lu Yang's expression was somewhat intriguing.
Lan Ting's Master was none other than Palace Master Luo Hongxia of the Laurel Fairy Palace, a figure from the same era as Daoist Buyu, a venerable elder held in high regard, but also someone who had been defeated by Lu Yang at the same realm.
It wasn't entirely accurate to say she had been defeated by Lu Yang; rather, it was more precise to say she was defeated by Lu Yang when he was possessed by Fairy Eternity, which left Luo Hongxia with a mouth full of leaves.
Fearing that the disciples of the Fairy Palace would discover Lu Yang's whereabouts, Lan Ting hurriedly pulled Lu Yang along to find her Master.
Regrettably, no matter how fast they moved, they couldn't run within the Fairy Palace. Along the way, they encountered several disciples of the Fairy Palace who all recognized the widely renowned Lu Yang.
Before they could even inquire, Lan Ting had already pulled Lu Yang far away.
"Master, guess who I brought with me!" Lan Ting arrived at the Palace Master's abode, asking excitedly.
"Lu Yang?" Luo Hongxia caught sight of Lu Yang and, remembering the past experience of being overpowered by him, wore an awkward expression.
"Junior Lu Yang pays his respects to Palace Master Luo," Lu Yang always behaved courteously in front of his elders, and only acted otherwise when possessed by Fairy Eternity.
"Master, I encountered an Elder from the Ruthless Sect while on a mission outside, and Elder Brother Lu Yang came to my rescue. I thought to invite him to our Fairy Palace as a guest, is that okay?"
As a disciple of the Palace Master, Lan Ting did have life-saving techniques. Even without Lu Yang stepping in, she wouldn't have been in mortal danger, but this didn't stop her from framing the story this way to others.
Palace Master Luo's eyes twitched slightly, as if to say, "You've already brought him before me to ask if it's okay, can I even say it isn't?"
Seeing Lan Ting's rare excitement, Palace Master Luo sighed inwardly, she had always warned to keep a distance from the disciples of the Seek Dao Sect, lest their thinking be influenced. Clearly, her good disciple had not taken her words to heart.
It's hard to keep a grown daughter at home.
She sighed inwardly, but with a calm exterior, she said, "Since he has a life-saving grace towards you, having him as a guest in our Fairy Palace wouldn't be breaking any rules."
With the approval of her Master, Lan Ting joyfully led Lu Yang out of the abode.
No sooner had they opened the great doors of the abode than they saw a multitude of Fairy Palace disciples huddled at the entrance, twittering like swallows, leaving Lu Yang dazzled.
"We finally get to see the legendary Elder Brother Lu Yang?"
"Don't push, don't push."
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, how long will you be staying at the Fairy Palace?"
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, can you tell us what the Dragon Clan Ancestor was like?"
The disciples of the Fairy Palace were very interested in Elder Brother Lu Yang, a man of many legends. The news of Lu Yang's arrival at the Fairy Palace had quickly spread, and everyone was blocking the door, eager to see how the real Lu Yang compared to the depictions of him.
Lu Yang, who had never seen so many beautiful female cultivators, was at a loss for a moment and showed a rare sign of embarrassment.

chapters.title: Chapter 934 - 933: The Fire of the Earth's Core
chapters.content:
Lu Yang had been through countless trials and tribulations, surviving battles among immortals on more than one occasion, but he had never encountered being surrounded by a group of female cultivators before.
Half the reason why Lu Yang was so popular was that his experiences were indeed legendary; it was rare for a cultivator to complete even one such feat in a lifetime, let alone so many.
The other half of the reason was Daoist Buyu's diligent promotion, using embellishments or even fabricating facts to craft Lu Yang into an image of perfection.
Even though everyone knew not to take Daoist Buyu's words at face value, the "Legend of the Dao Seeking Sect Starring Lu Yang" repeated in their ears had subconsciously merged the story's Lu Yang with the real one.
"Don't know what to do? Let this fairy handle it!" Fairy Eternity took charge with an air of a domineering big sister.
Lu Yang, of course, would not be fooled by Fairy Eternity's facade and calmly asked, "Fairy, have you encountered such a situation before?"
"Of course I have, what haven't I seen before?"
"Back when I created the Mother-child River, many female cultivators came to worship me, praying for the river's blessing, praying for me to grant them children; it's not too different from the current situation."
It's a far cry, okay!
Lu Yang was thankful that he hadn't rashly handed over control of his body to the fairy, or who knows what chaos might have ensued.
Not knowing what else to do, Lu Yang thought it wouldn't hurt to take out the Recording Orb to capture this scene. It was regrettable that Old Meng couldn't come to the Laurel Fairy Palace, but when they returned, letting him see the recording would make up for it somewhat.
Lu Yang felt he was quite thorough in looking after his good brother.
Although he couldn't rely on himself or Fairy Eternity, Lan Ting was indeed reliable.
"All right, everyone, calm down. Elder Brother Lu Yang will be staying at the Fairy Palace for some time, and there will be plenty of opportunities to interact with him in the days to come, so there's no need to crowd around and make things difficult for him!"
After Lan Ting persuaded them loudly for a while, the disciples of the Fairy Palace gradually left.
Lu Yang was baffled; wasn't he supposed to stay at the Fairy Palace for just a few days? How did it suddenly turn into an extended stay?
Lan Ting hastily clasped his hands in apology, "I'm sorry, I had to say it in the heat of the moment, or they wouldn't have left."
She raised her head to stealthily gauge Lu Yang's expression and said somewhat embarrassedly, "Would it be too much trouble to ask Elder Brother Lu Yang to stay a bit longer in the Fairy Palace? I've already said as much, and if you leave after just a couple of days, my credibility will be..."
"But don't worry, Elder Brother, our Fairy Palace is not lacking in cultivation resources. Whatever you need for your cultivation, I... we can provide."
As the conversation had come to this point, Lu Yang could only agree to stay.
After all, he was flexible about where he cultivated and wasn't picky about the location.
"I'll take you to where you'll be staying first." Seeing her ploy succeed, Lan Ting quickly said.
Soon, Lan Ting led Lu Yang to a connected complex of guesthouses; this was where Laurel Fairy Palace accommodated its guests. Each guesthouse courtyard had a Laurel Tree planted within it, and guests could see the treasure-like Laurel Trees just by stepping out the door or opening a window.
With no guests present, Lan Ting arranged for Lu Yang to stay in the first guesthouse.
The guesthouse had an ancient charm, with a thick layer of snow piled on the courtyard and roof tiles, adding a unique beauty.
The room even had a Gathering Spirit Array, which would suffice even for an Integration Period Cultivator.
The only downside was that the room was furnished with items like a bronze mirror and rouge that didn't match Lu Yang's gender... This was a guesthouse intended for female cultivators.
Laurel Fairy Palace had never considered the issue of accommodating male cultivators.
"I'll clean up right away!" Lan Ting said with embarrassment, she had only thought about inviting Lu Yang to the Fairy Palace but hadn't considered that there were no suitable guest rooms for him.
"It's okay, just leave them here," Lu Yang said, not wanting to trouble Lan Ting. The bronze mirrors and rouge could stay on the dressing table; he didn't need them anyway, and they weren't in the way, so there was no need to fuss about them.
It wasn't his first day staying in a place like a girl's boudoir. In the beginning, Fairy Eternity had occupied his Spiritual Space and decorated it in a cute and tender style. Compared to Fairy Eternity's boudoir, the guest rooms in the Fairy Palace were quite good.
It was only now that Fairy Eternity wanted to establish the Great Bean Dynasty and develop the Spiritual Space into more of a palace style. Otherwise, his Spiritual Space would still be cute and tender.
While talking, Lu Yang noticed that goose feather-sized snowflakes began to fall in his Spiritual Space, quickly covering the ground and even the throne with snow.
"Oh ho, it's snowing!" Fairy Eternity jumped off the throne and started rolling around in the snow, laughter filling the air.
Without asking, it was clear that Fairy Eternity was up to her tricks again, wanting to change the environment.
"Little Yang, come play with me," Fairy Eternity called from the ground, her legs kicking up, looking up at Lu Yang with an inviting gaze.
Lu Yang immediately declined without a second thought, "No, I still have to tour the Fairy Palace."
...
"This is the Elixir Brewing Chamber," Lan Ting led Lu Yang to the neighboring room, and he felt the continuous waves of heat emanating from the Elixir Brewing Chamber, which were surprisingly stable.
"Below this place is an earth's core fire. The Elixir Brewing Chamber draws the earth's core fire up to serve as the fire-eye, complemented by various True Fires to increase the temperature of the flames, bestowing them with various properties for refining pills," she explained.
"Legend has it that this is not a natural fire, but an Immortal Fire passed down from the Ancient Times that has been burning until now!" Lan Ting said with a longing expression, marveling at the strength of the Ancient Immortals to sustain a fire for three hundred thousand years.
In the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity was tossing a handful of snow upwards when she suddenly sensed something and exclaimed excitedly.
"Eh, isn't this the fire I left on the moon when I was barbecuing?"
"Back then, the Yingtian Immortal didn't want to move the Laurel Tree back and forth, so he proposed just setting up a bonfire on the moon to eat," she recalled.
"We were so indulged in the feast that Yingtian Immortal and the others were knocked out from overeating. It was me who carried them all back," Fairy Eternity boasted.
"Could it be that I was only focused on moving people and forgot to extinguish the fire?"
Fairy Eternity, quick to correct her mistakes, made a move as if to extinguish the Immortal Fire but was promptly stopped by Lu Yang.
"Your Majesty, it's truly heartwarming to see that you can admit and correct your mistakes, a rare sight for such a wise ruler throughout history. However, the people still need the Immortal Fire for daily life, so there's no need to extinguish it," he advised.
"Oh, then okay," Fairy Eternity was truly an enlightened ruler. Unlike many in history, she didn't become angry when her rash actions were stopped by her trusted subjects.
"To the right is the forbidden area, and I must ask Elder Brother Lu Yang never to approach it, lest there be risk to your life," Lan Ting pointed towards the right of the Elixir Brewing Chamber, to a luxuriously decorated palace with wooden pillars at its entrance over ten meters tall.
"What's that place?"
"The hot springs. There was surplus earth's core fire, and the predecessors who built the Fairy Palace also constructed these hot springs," she said.
Lan Ting then pointed to the left and added, "To the left is the Refinement Chamber, whose principle is similar to that of the Elixir Brewing Chamber, also utilizing the earth's core fire."
Preserving the earth's core fire for the Fairy Palace, allowing the Elixir Brewing Chamber, hot springs, and Refinement Chamber to continue to exist, was a great deed of merit. Lu Yang felt that if one could cultivate through the Power of Virtue, he would have already reached the Transcendance Tribulation Stage by relying on the Power of Virtue alone.

chapters.title: Chapter 935 - 934: The Thorough Zhui Yue Ancestor
chapters.content:
Lu Yang was somewhat surprised; he hadn't expected a place like Laurel Fairy Palace, which was full of female cultivators, to have a specialized Refinement Chamber. Generally speaking, few female cultivators were willing to engage in artifact refining.
After all, while pursuing their cultivation level, female cultivators also sought elegance and beauty. For example, Lu Yang had never seen a female cultivator swinging a hammer like Man Gu or had seen one whose body was as battered and worn as Li Haoran's.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, do you find it strange that we female cultivators refine artifacts?" Lan Ting noticed Lu Yang's unusual gaze and roughly guessed what he was thinking.
"Not at all, not at all," Lu Yang replied with an embarrassed smile.
"It's not surprising to think that way. Indeed, there are very few female cultivators who are Artifact Refiners in the outside world, but our Fairy Palace has its unique aspects."
"Unique aspects?"
"We have the Laurel Trees."
Seeing that Lu Yang was still confused, Lan Ting led him to a small grove, which was full of Laurel Trees that could fetch sky-high prices if sold outside.
Before they even entered the Laurel Forest, Lu Yang heard a series of dull thuds, like the collision of two heavy objects.
Then, he saw many disciples of the Immortal Palace taking turns to chop the Laurel Trees, all exhausted and gasping for breath, sweat flowing ceaselessly. It was hard to imagine that outside they all appeared as if they were fairies who did not subsist on grains.
Lu Yang noticed that when the disciples struck the Laurel Trees, a notch would appear on the tree, which would then heal quickly, as if the notch had never existed. The disciples had to keep chopping at the trees, tirelessly and without pause.
"What is this?"
"This is a tradition passed down by our founder, Chasing Moon True Person. It is said that in ancient times, Ying Tian Immortal often chopped at the Laurel Trees with an axe, though the reason is unclear. Chasing Moon True Person believed that every action of an Ancient Immortal had a profound meaning.
This must be some method of cultivation, so he advocated chopping at Laurel Trees with an axe as a form of training."
"Indeed, the Laurel Trees are very resistant to being chopped; if they cannot be cut through with one axe strike, the notches heal."
With an embarrassed smile, Lan Ting said, "We've all been swinging axes to split Laurel Trees, so the act of swinging a Refining Hammer doesn't seem vulgar to us anymore."
"As for the great strength needed for the Refining Hammer Technique, we developed it while chopping the Laurel Trees."
Just as Lu Yang was about to nod, it suddenly occurred to him that since chopping Laurel Trees was a tradition of the Laurel Fairy Palace, didn't that mean Lan Ting had chopped them as well?
If Lan Ting also chopped trees, was it logical for her to fight every day using her light and fluttering ribbons?
"Senior Sister Lan Ting, Elder Brother Lu Yang!"
The disciples, who were working hard at chopping trees, brightened up when they saw Lan Ting and Lu Yang walking together. They all put down their axes and approached Lu Yang.
But as they neared Lu Yang, they hesitated, not daring to come closer.
They had been chopping Laurel Trees for a long time and were covered in sweat. Approaching Lu Yang in such a state would surely be a breach of decorum, wouldn't it?
By the time they remembered they could use a Body Cleaning Spell, Lan Ting had already pulled Lu Yang away; they walked deeper into the Laurel Forest, stopping only when they reached a towering Laurel Tree that soared into the clouds.
Looking up, Lu Yang couldn't see the end of the tree, feeling tiny as dust at the foot of the Laurel Tree.
"This is the Laurel Tree Ancestor, which existed before the founding of our Fairy Palace. All the Laurel Trees on Great Snow Mountain are its descendants."
"After research by our preceding ancestors, the Tree Ancestor is very likely to be a Laurel Tree from the Ancient Times, its age extremely venerable."
"Fairy, can you tell the age of this tree?"
In the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity was busy building snowmen. Two snowmen stood side by side, with carrots for noses and branches for arms. Names were written on the snowmen, with the one on the left named Doudou, and the one on the right named Lu Yang.
Hearing Lu Yang calling her, she returned from her reverie to look at the outside world.
"What a tall laurel tree!" Even Fairy Eternity had never seen such a colossal laurel tree before.
"I once saw a laurel tree on the moon with a lifespan of two hundred thousand years, and it was not as tall as this one. This tree definitely exceeds two hundred thousand years. As for its exact age, either we cut down the tree to count the rings, or let Time Immortal come and ask the laurel tree itself."
Obviously, neither method was feasible.
"However, it is indeed likely to be a laurel tree from Ancient Times."
"How so?"
"Well, when I needed Yingtian Immortal to chop firewood for cooking, I reminded him that we should take responsibility for our actions. If he felled a laurel tree, don't forget to plant another one," she explained.
"Perhaps this one is among the many laurel trees originally planted by Yingtian Immortal."
"With the blessing of Yingtian Immortal, it's probably why it was lucky enough to survive until now."
The advanced environmental protection concept of Fairy Eternity deeply impressed Lu Yang.
As far as Lu Yang knew, no tree had lived for two hundred thousand years. The laurel Tree Ancestor in front of him, even if not planted during Ancient Times, must be one of the oldest trees, truly deserving of the name Tree Ancestor.
Exiting the Laurel Forest, they arrived at the other end of the woods where there was a very large courtyard. Lu Yang saw many disciples of the Fairy Palace diligently cultivating: their hands repeatedly piercing scalding hot iron sand, an elbow shattering a boulder of unknown material, carrying the weight of a small mountain while running...
Lu Yang felt this scene was all too familiar, as Old Meng practiced body refinement in the same way.
"What are they doing?"
"Body Refinement," Lan Ting answered earnestly.
"Ah?"
Lu Yang thought the method of cultivation in Laurel Fairy Palace was indeed completely different from those of female cultivators outside, even the disciples of the Seduction Sect, which was a super-grade sect, wouldn't be splitting firewood and practicing body refinement like this.
"There's a historical reason for that too."
"It was a thousand years after the establishment of the Fairy Palace. Great Xia was recuperating from its wars, the country was peaceful, and the people lived and worked in happiness and contentment. Chasing Moon True Person descended the mountain to travel."
"Then, at a bookstall, she stumbled upon several rather unconventional books.
While the stories varied, there was one common point amongst all of them: in each book, a fairy left the mountains for cultivation, accidentally got afflicted with a love poison, and the male protagonist had no choice but to administer an antidote, making the fairy one of the main female characters and starting a complex tangle of love and hate with the male protagonist."
"Initially, the male protagonist was a nobody, but as the story progressed, he grew stronger step by step until he was worthy of the fairy."
"Chasing Moon True Person felt that even though it was fiction, the content wasn't without merit and such scenarios were possible."
"When she returned, she added one more aspect to cultivation: body refinement. All disciples must practice body refinement."
"After body refinement, the constitution strengthens, greatly reducing the effects of being afflicted with the love poison and extending the time to find an antidote, sparing disciples from surrendering their bodies to just anyone."
"Indeed, the decision of Chasing Moon True Person proved correct. In the span of a hundred thousand years, quite a few predecessors who descended the mountain succumbed to the love poison. If they had not practiced body refinement, they would have ended up in bed with some unknown wild man."
"At the same time, Chasing Moon True Person also took into account how in the stories it's common for the male and female protagonists to fall in love, but the female protagonist's sect disagrees, creating obstacles, until the male protagonist gains success and then confronts the female protagonist's sect.
Consequently, she stipulated that if a disciple of our sect falls in love with a man, the sect shall not obstruct it."
Lu Yang: "..."
Your founding ancestor sure thought of everything.

chapters.title: Chapter 936 - 935: Having a Good Rest
chapters.content:
Lu Yang felt that this trip to the Laurel Fairy Palace had not been in vain; he had no idea that Disciple of the Immortal Palace were each skilled at swinging axes and practicing Body Refinement, the delicate figures hiding tremendous strength.
He had only sparred with Lan Ting a few times, each time stopping at light contact, unaware that Lan Ting was a cultivator of immense strength, skilled in body techniques.
He had not expected that the rules of the Fairy Palace were so open, indifferent to the matters of romance and love.
It seemed that Chasing Moon True Person was a predecessor with a long-term vision and an open mind.
Admirable.
"Speaking of which, I haven't really learned much about Body Refinement Realm."
Lu Yang recalled his cultivation experience, focusing mainly on swordsmanship and magic skills, with no involvement in Body Refinement.
"Our Immortal Lineage hardly needs Body Refinement Realm," said Fairy Eternity, "Once you have the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit, that will be much tougher than a Body Cultivator's physique."
"And even if you became a Body Cultivator, wouldn't the power of Self-Detonation be no different from that of an ordinary cultivator?"
Fairy Eternity clearly presented the pros and cons to Lu Yang.
"How about it? If you think your body isn't sturdy enough, I can give you an Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit right now," Fairy Eternity was eager to test, ready to implant the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit into Lu Yang's body the moment he nodded and said "okay".
"No thanks." Lu Yang refused; his goal was to become an Immortal, to be an existence on par with Eldest Senior Sister and Fairy Eternity. Getting an Initial Form of the Immortal Dao Fruit, what was that all about? That would make him a disgraceful Semi-Immortal like Li Haoran.
Seeing Lu Yang's refusal, Fairy Eternity felt a bit disappointed and muttered softly, "What's the big deal about giving you a Dao Fruit Outline? You're acting like such an outsider."
The Laurel Fairy Palace was vast, so large that Lan Ting and Lu Yang had spent the entire day and only visited a small portion.
"Then, Senior Brother, we'll meet again tomorrow," said Lan Ting, sending Lu Yang back to the door of his guest room courtyard with a sweet smile.
"See you tomorrow."
The night had fallen by then, with the sun above replaced by the moon, the Power of Taiyin far richer than before.
The night was when Disciple of the Immortal Palace held their most important cultivation sessions, and Lan Ting said goodbye to Lu Yang for this reason as well.
"The Power of Taiyin..."
Lu Yang looked at the moon; he didn't need Sun Power or Power of Taiyin for his cultivation, and he wasn't very sensitive to the changes of these two forces.
Just as Lu Yang was considering whether or not to recite "Shuidiao Getou", a petite Disciple of the Immortal Palace approached bashfully, as if a little embarrassed.
"Hello, Elder Brother Lu Yang," greeted the Disciple of the Immortal Palace politely.
"Who might you be?"
"My name is Bai Ye, a disciple of the Fairy Palace."
Bai Ye, somewhat shy, kept her head down and glanced up at Lu Yang, "Elder Brother Lu Yang, could you tell me about your experiences, like your trips to the Demon Territory and East Sea?"
She had never been to such distant places; when she heard storytelling about Lu Yang, she thought he was so formidable, having been everywhere, and experienced so many things. Now that she had finally met him in person, she wanted to listen to his stories at all costs.
"Don't you need to cultivate?" Lu Yang had thought that all Disciple of the Immortal Palace were like Lan Ting, seizing the time to cultivate.
"Missing one day of cultivation isn't a big deal." Bai Ye spoke cheekily, seeming to grow more relaxed around the amiable Lu Yang.
Lu Yang pondered for a moment, deciding that since he had nothing else to do, telling stories wouldn't hurt. He could just skip the parts he couldn't share, such as resurrecting Jiang Lianyi in the Demon Territory.
"Sure." Lu Yang gestured for them to sit down and began to tell his tales slowly.
"Let's see, where should I start? Oh yes, from the second time I went to the Task Hall for a mission; the objective was to eradicate a Tiger Demon..."
Lu Yang had a wealth of experience, and even after omitting secret details, his stories could not be finished in a single night.
Bai Ye listened with great enthusiasm, her eyes shining as she looked at Lu Yang with increasing admiration. It was hard to imagine that these were the experiences of a cultivator, perhaps even more than all of the disciples of Laurel Fairy Palace combined had ever encountered.
"Alright, let's stop here for today. If we keep going, it will be daylight," Lu Yang said with a smile. He had been talking all night, and now dawn was approaching. He couldn't just keep on going endlessly; otherwise, when would it ever end?
"Okay then," Bai Ye said, looking like she still wanted more. She wished to continue listening to the stories, but it was indeed too late to go on.
"Will you tell more stories tomorrow night, Elder Brother Lu Yang?" she asked.
"If you come to listen, I'll tell them," Lu Yang replied with a smile. He quite liked this little disciple from the Immortal Palace.
Overjoyed by his response, Bai Ye waved goodbye to Lu Yang as she walked away, "Then I'll see you tomorrow night, Elder Brother Lu Yang!"
Taking advantage of the fact that the sky had not fully brightened yet, Lu Yang returned to his room and sat on the Gathering Spirit Array, opening his mouth wide to devour spiritual energy for cultivation.
He had gained his cultivation level by seizing every minute and second to cultivate, a process that was incredibly arduous.
Meanwhile, he also returned to his spiritual space to meet with Fairy Eternity, making the most of his time.
"Fairy, come play in the snow!"
Fairy Eternity pouted, clearly displeased that Lu Yang had only now come to play with her, and lobbed a snowman inscribed with "Lu Yang" at him.
"Humph, took you long enough to come."
Before Lu Yang could clearly read the words on the snowman, he saw it flying towards him. He moved swiftly, his form so quick that an afterimage remained in his place.
Yet, he didn't dodge it.
Lu Yang wiped the snow off his face and said with an embarrassed smile, "Well, I'm not quite like you, Fairy. I haven't seen much of the world and, on my first visit to the Immortal Palace, I naturally had to take a good look around."
Hearing Lu Yang compliment her worldliness, the corners of Fairy Eternity's mouth couldn't help but rise: "What's so special about a mere Immortal Palace? Moreover, it's a palace without even a single immortal. Stick with me faithfully, and I guarantee I'll show you the creations of true immortals, far surpassing this place!"
"Indeed, indeed, I trust in Fairy's abilities," Lu Yang said.
"What shall we play?" he asked next.
Truth be told, Lu Yang wasn't just keeping Fairy Eternity company. It had been a long time since he had played in the snow, especially snow this thick, which he had only seen in his previous life, and back then, he hadn't been in the mood to play.
"Let's make snowmen. It's no fun with just one snowman," Fairy Eternity suggested, pointing at the solitary figure.
"Who shall we make?"
"There are only us two in the spiritual space, so of course, we have to make you!" she said, starting to roll snowballs right away.
Lu Yang joined in rolling snowballs.
...
"How was your rest last night, Elder Brother Lu Yang?" Lan Ting asked him early in the morning.
To himself, Lu Yang thought that he hadn't really rested at all last night. After telling stories, he then made snowmen and had a great time, but it had nothing to do with getting rest.
Now, the snowman called "Lu Yang" in his spiritual space was a masterpiece by him and Fairy Eternity
"I rested quite well," he lied.
"That's good," Lan Ting said, relieved. She was worried that some senior sisters or junior sisters had sought out Lu Yang last night, trying to form a closer relationship with him behind her back. It seemed her worries were unfounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 937 - 936 Do You Fairy Palace Need Twin River?
chapters.content:
Lu Yang was quite popular in the Laurel Fairy Palace. As Lan Ting escorted Lu Yang around for a tour, the disciples of the Fairy Palace also took their turns observing Lu Yang. It was common for a crowd of disciples to surround him every time they arrived at a new location, bombarding him with questions and treating him as if he were some kind of rare species.
Indeed, in the Laurel Fairy Palace, male cultivators were a rarity.
"Enough, enough, don't forget it's time for cultivation. Don't be distracted," a steady voice rang out, silencing the chattering disciples of the Fairy Palace, who promptly returned to their places and resumed their earnest practice.
A female cultivator with an indifferent expression walked over, wearing a black ring on her middle finger.
"Senior Sister Jinghong," Lan Ting greeted with a bow, and Lu Yang followed suit, bowing in a proper manner as well.
"Greetings, Senior Sister Jinghong," Lu Yang said.
After returning the greeting, Senior Sister Jinghong spoke, "I presume this must be the rumored Junior Brother Lu Yang."
"Junior Sister Lan Ting, if you are showing Junior Brother Lu Yang around the palace, please keep it low-key. The junior sisters' cultivation hearts are not firm enough, and seeing the talented Junior Brother Lu Yang, they could become overly excited, resulting in wasted efforts in today's practice."
"Understood," Lan Ting replied.
There were also disciples like Senior Sister Jinghong, who had no interest in Lu Yang.
Once they were out of Senior Sister Jinghong's sight, Lu Yang quietly asked, "Senior Sister Jinghong doesn't seem very welcoming of me, does she?"
With a giggling smile, Lan Ting said, "Senior Brother, you mustn't think Senior Sister Jinghong is heartless; she's like this with everyone."
"She is a disciple of the Third Elder, skilled in the Artifact Refining Technique, and entered the sect before I did. With a mid-stage of Transforming Spirit cultivation level, her cultivation talent may not be the best, but she is thorough in her work, composed in her demeanor, and deeply favored by the elders."
Lu Yang nodded, relieved that he hadn't done anything wrong to make the senior sister dislike him.
Meanwhile, Senior Sister Jinghong made sure no one was around before she secretly rubbed her ring, and sent a sliver of her consciousness into the space within the ring.
"Master, is this okay?" she asked.
The aged yet majestic voice echoed in the ring's space, "This will suffice."
"I feel that this Lu Yang is quite extraordinary, bearing great secrets. You should keep your distance from him and remember not to become overly entangled, to avoid creating causality. I worry that if you become too involved with him, he might detect my existence, prompting my premature entrance to the world, triggering a cataclysm for ages to come."
"Understood," she replied.
…
"This is the Scripture Pavilion. Would Senior Brother like to take a look inside?" Lan Ting asked, leading Lu Yang to a wooden building almost buried by heavy snow, seemingly at risk of collapsing under the weight at any moment.
Of course, the Scripture Pavilion that had stood for a hundred thousand years would not be toppled by mere snow.
"Let's take a look inside." As long as it didn't involve him creating a cultivation technique, Lu Yang enjoyed visiting places like the Scripture Pavilion.
The structure of the Fairy Palace's Scripture Pavilion was much the same as that of the Seek Dao Sect's, with the difference lying in the collected books.
Most of the techniques stored in the Fairy Palace's Scripture Pavilion were for female cultivators; there weren't many for male cultivators, and those few were mostly related to the collection of the Power of Taiyin.
"What's this? 'Immortal Maiden Tribulation'?" Lu Yang randomly pulled an ancient text off a shelf and flipped through a few pages, his expression becoming odd.
The content of this book didn't seem very appropriate, yet here it was, openly placed in the Scripture Pavilion?
In the Seek Dao Sect, the 'Dragon Phoenix Transformation' was still hidden away with utmost secrecy.
Furthermore, it seemed like this book had been perused quite frequently, judging by its appearance.
Fairy Eternity, using her Immortal Sense, took a quick scan and her face immediately turned red with embarrassment, stammering without being able to articulate her words, and could only spit out two in frustration.
"Obscene!"
With her cheeks slightly pink, Lan Ting coughed twice to ease the awkwardness: "This is an ancient text that Ancestor Zhui Yue brought back a hundred thousand years ago. The stories within are quite insightful, and it is placed in the Scripture Pavilion in the hope that future generations will heed the warnings from the tales, to prevent such occurrences from happening to themselves."
Apart from "Immortal Maiden Tribulation," Lu Yang noticed many other odd and curious names that seemed to be very similar to "Immortal Maiden Tribulation." He guessed they were all brought back by the Yingtian Ancestral Master.
There were also numerous places where books should have been that were empty, likely borrowed by the disciples of the Fairy Palace.
Anyway, the various actions of the Yingtian Ancestral Master indeed made the disciples of the Fairy Palace more vigilant and kept themselves pure. Lu Yang hadn't heard of any disciple from the Fairy Palace who went down the mountain and got involved with a rogue man.
"There are so many ancient texts here," Lu Yang said with a smile. He was most familiar with ancient texts, even more than with swordsmanship.
"Previously, the Fairy Palace didn't have so many ancient texts. They were bought from the Taixue Academy recently due to a demand," she explained.
"A demand?"
"Mm, Senior Brother, you should know that in ancient times, the Yingtian Immortal created the Mother-child River, right?"
Lu Yang showed a peculiar expression, wondering whether to say he knew or to say he didn't.
"Some disciples of the Fairy Palace aren't fond of love and romance, but do wish to have a child. Previously there was no way, but now that they have learned of the existence of the Mother-child River, they started trying all means to find the Mother-child River, including searching for clues in ancient texts," she said.
"Any results?" Lu Yang asked on behalf of Fairy Eternity.
