Lan Ting shook her head regretfully, "Nothing at all."
"Since you're well-versed in ancient knowledge, do you know where the Mother-child River might be?" she asked.
"I don't know."
Suddenly, Lu Yang remembered that although he didn't know where the Mother-child River was, he did know the location of the Twin River, right above Sky Gate Mountain.
"Eh, so they need the Twin River? Then we might as well move it over to them," Fairy Eternity offered generously. Since no one was drinking it on Sky Gate Mountain, it would be better to give it to a place like the Fairy Palace that needed it.
Lu Yang thought it over seriously. It seemed indeed possible to give the Twin River to the Fairy Palace without revealing anything.
"Actually, although I don't know where the Mother-child River is, I do know the location of the Twin River."
"Twin River?" Lan Ting had not heard about the Twin River.
Lu Yang pondered, finding it hard to explain the origin of the Twin River: "The Twin River, like the Mother-child River, was created by Yingtian Immortal. The difference is that women who consume the water from the Mother-child River can only have one child, while drinking water from the Twin River can result in twins."
"The extremely rare Twin Lotus is a product of the Twin River."
Lan Ting didn't expect that there was such an Immortal Object as the Twin River, and found the abilities of the immortals to be truly mysterious and unpredictable.
But why did Ying Tian Immortal create the Twin River?
"Where is this Twin River then?"
"Recently found in an Ancient Secret Realm, it's now in our Seek Dao Sect. If the Fairy Palace needs it, I can apply to the sect for some of the river water," Lu Yang proposed.
Lan Ting's face lit up with joy at the news, not expecting such a serendipitous discovery. If the Fairy Palace had the water of the Twin River, who knew how many Senior Sisters and Elders could have children.
"Then I must thank Senior Brother in advance. May I report this matter to my master?" she asked.
The matter of the Twin River was significant, and Lan Ting couldn't handle such a big issue alone.
"Of course, you can."
When Luo Hongxia learned that there existed such a wondrous Immortal Object as the Twin River, she too was overjoyed. The Fairy Palace needed such a thing the most. Consequently, the way she looked at Lu Yang changed, finding him more and more agreeable.
"Lu Yang, if the disciples of our Fairy Palace can conceive, then you will be a great benefactor!" she exclaimed.
Lu Yang: "..."
Somehow, this statement sounded rather strange.

chapters.title: Chapter 938 - 937 Mysterious Bai Ye
chapters.content:
"Our Fairy Palace can't just reap benefits for nothing, Lu Yang, tell us what your Seek Dao Sect needs!" Luo Hongxia inquired, now regarding Lu Yang as an outstandingly good child in the world.
If the Twin River is truly effective, it could make up for so many regrets of the people in the Fairy Palace.
Even if Lu Yang were to ask for Lan Ting, she would readily agree.
"Um, why don't you ask Eldest Senior Sister about this kind of thing?" Lu Yang had no idea what the Seek Dao Sect needed; that was something only Eldest Senior Sister would know.
"Right, right, right, I was being thoughtless." Luo Hongxia realized, although Lu Yang was famous throughout the land, he had not yet become a decision-maker for the Seek Dao Sect, and this matter should be communicated with Yun Zhi instead.
Upon considering this, Luo Hongxia calmed down. The issue was significant and could not be rushed. To exchange such an Immortal Object with the Seek Dao Sect, they needed to carefully consider what equivalent valuables their Fairy Palace had.
As the Sect Leader, Luo Hongxia had to consider far more than the average person.
Without confirmation of the Twin River's effectiveness, they should not broadcast it and end up with vain joy.
After sending Lu Yang off, Luo Hongxia paced in circles inside her Abode with her hands behind her back, her emotions hadn't fluctuated this wildly in a long time.
The last time her emotions surged this much was when she learned of Lan Ting's feelings for Lu Yang.
"To confirm whether the Twin River is effective, we need to find someone to test it."
"It's best to find someone with a higher Cultivation Level, in case they get into trouble and can't be saved."
Suddenly, Luo Hongxia thought of a person, left her own Abode, and quietly went to the Refinement Chamber to find the Third Elder Zhu Hong.
The Third Elder was a beauty with bronze skin, a member of a Barbarian tribe branch, who disliked complex formalities, often forging artifacts while only covering the vital parts with a few pieces of cloth.
The Third Elder, lifting her hammer into the air, asked in bewilderment, "Senior Sister, you came in such a hurry. Do you want me to forge a magic artifact urgently?"
"Old Three, haven't you always wanted a child? I can make you pregnant. Would you like to come with me to the Seek Dao Sect and give it a try?"
The Third Elder's mouth hung open, frozen in place, while her hammer, unnoticed, fell to the ground, creating a large pit.
Senior Sister, are you sure you're aware of what you're saying?
...
At Sky Gate Mountain, representatives from Laurel Fairy Palace arrived.
"So, Palace Master Luo's intention is to try the water from the Twin River?" Yun Zhi asked.
Initially, when she learned that Luo Hongxia was coming to visit, she found it strange. Junior Brother had only been to the Fairy Palace for two days. Could it be that he had already caused trouble and Luo Hongxia was now demanding that she bring Junior Brother back?
This speed of causing trouble would indeed break records.
Once Luo Hongxia explained the reason behind her visit, Yun Zhi finally understood the whole story.
It was about the Twin River.
"Is that possible?"
"Naturally, it is."
Since Junior Brother could disclose information about the Twin River to Luo Hongxia, it meant that Fairy had agreed to the matter.
The Twin River belonged to Fairy Eternity, and of course, Fairy could dispose of it as she wished.
Luo Hongxia and Elder Zhu Hong exchanged glances, both very pleased.
"It's possible, but how to consume the water from the Twin River and its prohibitions are still unknown. Please give us some time. Once we have figured it out, we will invite Elder Zhu Hong to try it."
Yun Zhi indeed did not know how to consume the water from the Twin River, how much to take, and what the prohibitions were - only Fairy Eternity knew about these matters. They had to wait for Lu Yang to return with Fairy Eternity to get a clear understanding.
However, such details couldn't be openly discussed; it could easily expose the existence of Fairy Eternity.
Or it might lead people to misunderstand that Junior Brother harbored Yingtian Immortal inside him.
"I see," Luo Hongxia and Elder Zhu Hong said upon hearing this, unavoidably showing a hint of disappointment.
Yun Zhi hurriedly added, "Although the method of consumption is not yet clear, please rest assured, the Twin River will indeed result in pregnancy, this much I can guarantee."
Despite the lack of any evidence, Yun Zhi's assurance seemed to have a kind of magical power that made people unconsciously convinced, and the two of them were clearly invigorated again.
It was just a matter of waiting a few more days, wasn't it? Their time to reach the Body Integration Realm was not that far off.
Watching their retreating figures, Yun Zhi always felt that Luo Hongxia and Zhu Hong were like a couple who had been infertile for years, and she herself was like the miraculously healing old doctor.
If Elder Zhu Hong really did get pregnant, it seemed quite fitting for her to give Yun Zhi a Miraculous Healing Brocade Banner.
Yun Zhi shook her head, tossing out the weird thoughts, feeling that her own thinking had become strange after frequently resolving issues with Fairy Eternity.
After the two left, Yun Mengmeng sneakily emerged from where Yun Zhi had been and threw herself onto Yun Zhi.
"There's something as fun as Twin River?" Yun Mengmeng's eyes shone with curiosity about Twin River.
And it inevitably made her think of the Mother-child River back home.
Yun Zhi gave Yun Mengmeng a glance and pried her arm from around her neck, warning, "You're forbidden from looking into Twin River."
Yun Mengmeng stuck out her tongue as a form of rebellion against Yun Zhi.
…
Lan Ting increasingly felt that Lu Yang was so impressive; he had solved the problem that had troubled their Fairy Palace for a hundred thousand years as soon as he arrived.
If she were with Lu Yang, she believed that not only would her master not hinder them, but would also wholeheartedly bless them.
When night fell and Lan Ting said goodbye to Lu Yang to cultivate, Bai Ye from the previous night came looking for Lu Yang again, this time carrying a small stool.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, I'm here to listen to the story."
Lu Yang couldn't help but smile, "You've skipped cultivating and sneaked out again. Where did we leave off yesterday?"
"You talked about how the three of you infiltrated the Eternity Sect headquarters and then reported its location. Seek Dao Sect and the Dynasty joined forces to eradicate the Eternity Sect."
Sitting on the small stool, Bai Ye's eyes lit up with excitement as she talked about the story.
The two sat under the courtyard's Laurel Tree, one telling the story and the other listening, and thus another evening passed.
After making a promise to return the next day, Bai Ye handed Lu Yang a paper bag with a giggly smile.
Upon Bai Ye's hint, Lu Yang opened the paper bag and found it filled with flower petals.
"What's this?"
"These are petals from the Laurel Tree, really tasty. Elder Brother Lu Yang, you can snack on them when you're free."
Laurel Tree petals? It was Lu Yang's first time hearing about it.
He picked one and put it in his mouth; the fragrant sweetness of the flower bloomed on his taste buds, a slight trace of Spiritual Energy mingled within the sweetness, turning directly into his spiritual essence without the need for refinement.
"No wonder you dare to sneak out and neglect your cultivation."
Eating Laurel Flower petals meant cultivating at the same time. Quite convenient.
Seeing that Lu Yang enjoyed the petals, Bai Ye grinned and said, "I don't have many Laurel Flower petals, but if you like them, Elder Brother, I'll save some for you later."
"That's a deal, then."
Having never eaten them before, Lu Yang didn't expect the Laurel Flower petals to be so delicious; he found himself getting more addicted the more he ate.
Considering Bai Ye's tone, it probably wasn't anything too precious.
If it were too valuable, he'd feel uncomfortable accepting it.
In the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity constructed a throne from snow and sat on it, staring at Bai Ye's figure, murmuring quietly to herself.
"Is this little girl a tree? She doesn't really seem like it to me."
"Little Yang is so simple, he can't see anything."

chapters.title: Chapter 939 - 938 Sinners' Hall
chapters.content:
```
Fairy Eternity observed Bai Ye for two nights, and could affirm that this little girl was related to the Laurel Tree Ancestor, presumably something akin to the consciousness of the Laurel Tree Ancestor.
It's suspected to be a laurel tree planted by the Yingtian Immortal; four hundred thousand years is enough time for spiritual wisdom to emerge.
For instance, before the Time Immortal became an immortal, they would often split off a clone to act separately; it's a similar principle.
However, Bai Ye is definitely not as simple as just being the Laurel Tree Ancestor, although Fairy Eternity has yet to analyze the situation.
"Little Yang is not clever enough, still needing this immortal to worry about him," Fairy Eternity shook her head happily, thinking that Lu Yang truly couldn't manage without her sage advice.
"But on second thought, this little girl doesn't have any ill intentions towards Little Yang, so there's no need for me to worry about her. So, do I still need to concern myself with what Bai Ye is?"
Fairy Eternity leaned on her throne of ice and snow, pondering for a while before quickly falling asleep due to the excessive mental effort.
...
Lu Yang felt that he had almost toured the entire Laurel Fairy Palace, yet it seemed like he had missed a place, leaving him with a sense of incompleteness, an emptiness in his heart.
"Right, Junior Sister Lan, is there a place similar to Captive Peak here?"
Lu Yang recalled that he had not yet visited the Captive Peak of the Laurel Fairy Palace.
"Ah?"
"Senior Brother, do you want to visit the Sinners' Hall?"
The Laurel Fairy Palace had enforcement authority, so naturally, there was a place akin to Captive Peak, called the Sinners' Hall.
Lan Ting hadn't expected Elder Brother Lu Yang to be so interested in the Sinners' Hall, and she, thinking such a place wasn't suitable for Lu Yang, had deliberately avoided taking him there.
"To broaden my horizons," said Lu Yang with a chuckle. He wanted to see what the disciplinary locations of other Immortal Sects looked like.
The Sinners' Hall wasn't a restricted area, and disciples of the Fairy Palace could enter and exit as they pleased.
Lan Ting led Lu Yang to a relatively small palace, too modest to be a place of confinement.
As they entered the palace, the candles on either side sensed their presence and flared to life with a whoosh, illuminating the corridor ahead.
"The prisoners are all below," Lan Ting said, indicating the passage that led underground.
The passage was eerily quiet, with only the echo of their footsteps, which also caused the candles on the sides of the underground corridor to light up.
Seeing Lu Yang's interest in the candles, Lan Ting explained with a smile, "It used to be that the candles in the Sinners' Hall were always lit, which I felt was a bit wasteful. So I designed an Array Method that extinguishes the candles normally, but they light up whenever they sense sound. It's very convenient."
"Because it helped the sect save on candles, I even got a thousand Contribution Points for it."
"Indeed, it's a clever design," Lu Yang nodded, not expecting that it was Lan Ting who had come up with the Array Method. He should have guessed that Lan Ting had a talent for this.
After all, Lan Ting was the first to propose the concept of the Automatic Skewer Formation.
"Did you patent it?"
"No, it feels quite troublesome." Unlike the Dao Seeking Sect, which has a matured patent application process, the semi-hermitage Laurel Fairy Palace was not interested in patents.
Lu Yang advised, "It's best to apply for one. Judging by time, there should be solar-powered lights emerging to replace candles. Voice-controlled solar-powered lights probably haven't appeared yet. If you patent this Array Method, you could make a considerable amount of Spirit Stones."
"Are you talking about the solar-powered lights that the solar energy technology developers are going to release?" Lan Ting had heard a bit about this emerging company on an assignment she had been on recently and they were often advertising through Dream Mirage.
"Production line sorted out already? Looks like they're moving fast," Lu Yang muttered to himself, then said, "Yes, those solar-powered lights."
```
"The rising industries present many business opportunities, which we can seize to make a profit. Although we cultivators should not be blinded by Spirit Stones, cultivation cannot proceed without them. With a patent in hand and a steady supply of Spirit Stones, future cultivation will be much easier."
"Alright." Even though Lan Ting was indifferent about patents, since it was Elder Brother Lu Yang who suggested it, it surely must be done.
Junior Sister Tao, you don't have such good treatment, do you?
While they talked, the two reached the end of the passageway, where they encountered a gatekeeper clad in a black robe.
The gatekeeper was bowing his head, apparently writing something.
"This is Elder Morran."
"Junior Lu Yang pays his respects to Elder Morran." Lu Yang said, bowing.
Elder Morran, noticing someone approaching, quickly covered what he was writing, "Oh, it's Daoist Buyu's little disciple. What offense did you commit to find yourself here?"
"Ah?"
Seeing Lu Yang's confusion, Elder Morran also became bewildered, "Aren't you mimicking your master, having committed offenses in the outside world and being captured by our Fairy Palace?"
Lan Ting hurriedly explained that Lu Yang was there to visit the Fairy Palace and was not like Daoist Buyu.
"Then I misunderstood; I thought that this was a tradition passed down from your Sect." With his duties, Elder Morran seldom left the Sinners' Hall and knew very little about the latest developments.
"Has my master visited the Sinners' Hall before?" Lu Yang asked cautiously, not expecting his master to have visited more places than he imagined, even such a secluded place as the Laurel Fairy Palace.
Elder Morran snorted coldly, "Which Immortal Sect's Sinners' Hall hasn't he visited?"
"If you want to take a look inside, let Martial Nephew Lan guide you. She's been here before and is very familiar with the place. I won't go in." Elder Morran disliked conversation and activity; the quiet environment of the Sinners' Hall suited her best.
Elder Morran's eyes grew colder as she watched their retreating figures.
"They shouldn't have seen what I was writing. If they had, they couldn't be allowed to leave!"
Elder Morran lowered his head and continued to write: The Morning Light Deity wrapped an arm around Chu Xian'er's slender waist, facing the besieging horde of gods and buddhas, immovable and resolute like a statue...
With the token given by Elder Morran, the two passed through the Great Formation and entered the true Sinners' Hall.
"Our Sinners' Hall serves the same purpose as your Captive Peak, to detain criminals caught outside. The criminals we detain range from at least the Foundation Establishment Stage to the Body Integration Realm."
When it came to having Body Integration Realm criminals in the Sinners' Hall, Lan Ting was quite proud. Disciples of the Immortal Palace only reached the Body Integration Realm at most. The difficulty of capturing criminals at this level during missions was immense.
Like the newly captured Ruthless Sect Elder, if it hadn't been for Lu Yang, Man Gu, and her, it would have been hard to capture him alive.
Lu Yang thought for a moment. It seemed that the criminals detained at Captive Peak were at least of the Body Integration Realm, with the highest being the Immortal, Guan Shanhai.
Disciples of Dao Seeking Sect also caught criminals during missions, but those who weren't at the Body Integration Realm were sent directly to the local government office. There was no need to take them back to Captive Peak.
The number of cells in Captive Peak was limited and needed to be conserved.
Lu Yang noticed that each prisoner's door listed their name, offenses, and remaining sentence. The shortest sentence belonged to a thief who would be released in a few days.
The Fairy Palace did not differentiate between male and female prisoners; otherwise, Daoist Buyu would not have been able to enter.
Captive Peak also had similar signs, stating the names and offenses of the prisoners. The only difference was that there were no sentences listed.
The prisoners in Captive Peak were either murderers or rebels; there were no remaining sentences to speak of. They might as well live out their lives honestly in Captive Peak.

chapters.title: Chapter 940 - 939: An Unexpected Acquaintance
chapters.content:
Lu Yang looked at each prisoner's crimes in the Sinners' Hall, and quickly something sparked his interest, "Possession attempt failed?"
This was quite a rare charge. Usually, it was possession accomplished, after all, high-level cultivators possessing low-level ones, the latter had no strength to resist, how could there possibly be a failure?
Lu Yang noticed that the detained prisoner who attempted possession wasn't of low realm either, at the late stage of Spirit Transformation.
Lan Ting explained, "This man had bad luck, he tried to possess a cultivator named Kong Hao."
Lu Yang had a strange look on his face, he, of course, recognized Kong Hao. He had fought with Kong Hao during the 120,000th anniversary celebration of the Seek Dao Sect, using the identity of Young Master Lu.
He also reported Kong Hao for borrowing the strength of a fierce beast in his body during the contest...
"Originally, Kong Hao's Cultivation Level wasn't as high as his, and nothing unexpected was supposed to happen, but unexpectedly, Kong Hao's Spiritual Space was inhabited by two Taozhu at the Pass Tribulation stage."
"...Two?" Lu Yang wondered. He remembered that Kong Hao only had one Taozhu, could it be that the Taozhu got pregnant? But that's not right, the other one cannot just be born at the Pass Tribulation stage.
"Yes, with two Taozhu at the Pass Tribulation stage inside Kong Hao's body, the possession naturally failed."
Lu Yang found that there was another person who also had a failed possession attempt.
"What's the situation with this one?"
"This person went to possess a Daoist named Long Huo.
There was a difference in their realms, which should have allowed for a successful possession, but according to his confession, just as the possession was about to succeed, Long Huo shouted things like 'I can't lose,' words with unclear meanings, and had a breakthrough on the spot, causing his Spiritual Power to surge and leading to the prisoner's possession attempt to fail."
"A Senior Sister happened to be passing by and brought back the prisoner. According to the prisoner, he had prepared many Heaven and Earth Treasures to nourish the body after his successful possession, which also counted as stolen goods, confirming his crime.
Strangely enough, when that Senior Sister went to the place the prisoner mentioned to find the stolen goods, she came up empty-handed, not knowing who took them away."
Lu Yang also had an impression of Long Huo, who was Old Meng's opponent during the 120,000th anniversary celebration of the Seek Dao Sect and was sent into a loop-de-loop by Old Meng.
"Fellow Daoist Lu Yang, I did not expect us to meet here," called an inmate from a cell.
"Xue Shilou, what are you doing here?" Lu Yang was surprised, not expecting to see an acquaintance in the Sinners' Hall.
It was indeed Xue Shilou from the Extreme Northern Lands, who was rumored to have some Snow Emperor Bloodline, whom Lu Yang had beaten and let a second personality take over, merged the first and second personalities, and came back several times.
Seeing the crime posted at the door—cross-border theft.
No need to ask, he must have come to Great Xia without going through the entry and exit procedures.
That made sense. The Laurel Fairy Palace was situated at the northernmost border of Great Xia, and just north of that were the Extreme Northern Lands. It was easy for someone to sneak across the border. Before encountering Xue Shilou, Lu Yang saw several prisoners charged with cross-border theft.
In addition to that, there were those who had stolen Laurel Trees, and they were also locked up here.
Xue Shilou spoke angrily, regretting his past actions, "I didn't expect there to be such a big difference in vigilance at each checkpoint of Great Xia, I was careless!"
The northern border of Great Xia was very long, and the Laurel Fairy Palace couldn't possibly cover it all.
It seems that when Xue Shilou entered Great Xia, he came through an area not under the Fairy Palace's jurisdiction. When he left, he just happened to enter the jurisdiction of the Fairy Palace by chance.
And the cultivators from the Extreme Northern Lands usually operated solo and rarely communicated with each other, resulting in slow intelligence transfer, naturally leaving no one to inform Xue Shilou that one must go through proper procedures when entering and leaving Great Xia.
"Fellow Daoist Lu Yang, there's also me," called another detained person nearby.
Lu Yang turned his head to look and was stunned for two seconds before he finally failed to remember who this person was.
"Who are you?"
"I'm Xuanyuan Tianhen!"
Lu Yang gave it some serious thought, and with such a distinctive name, he would definitely remember it if he had heard it before, which meant he genuinely didn't recognize him.
To avoid awkwardness, Lu Yang even specifically asked Fairy Eternity, "Fairy, do you know this person?"
Fairy Eternity pondered seriously for a moment, "That name sounds like it was given by Ying Tian Immortal."
Lu Yang confirmed it, he indeed did not recognize this person.
"I am the Senior Brother from Xue Shilou. We both participated in the Ask Sword Grand Ceremony together!" Xuanyuan Tianhen hastily added.
This time, Lu Yang had a bit of an impression. During the sword fight with Xue Shilou, there seemed to be someone claiming to be his Senior Brother, who kept shouting from below, yelling things like "Junior Brother Xue has fainted, this is bad" and "The combat power will surge."
Lu Yang suddenly realized and thought it was good that the two brothers were both caught crossing the border. It was nice to have company.
"Fellow Daoist Lu Yang, as a disciple of the Immortal Sect, could you speak with the Fairy Palace on our behalf and release us, two brothers? We promise we won't offend again!" Xuanyuan Tianhen pleaded.
Seeing Lu Yang's hesitant expression, Xuanyuan Tianhen quickly added, "Rest assured, Fellow Daoist Lu Yang, if we two can leave the Fairy Palace, we will definitely offer a generous gift!"
Upon hearing this, Lu Yang finally made up his mind and turned to Lan Ting, saying, "You heard them; they are trying to bribe for connections. Whatever additional punishment your Fairy Palace has in mind, go ahead and apply it."
Originally, he was considering whether Xuanyuan Tianhen's action counted as bribery. Now it was certain—it was indeed bribery.
"Senior Brother, rest assured, our Fairy Palace has always acted fairly."
In the midst of their conversation, Xue Shilou suddenly grew feverish and rolled around on the ground non-stop, giving Lu Yang quite a scare. He wanted to step forward and help, but Lan Ting stopped him.
"This is his Snow Emperor Bloodline gradually awakening. Do not disturb him."
Watching Xue Shilou in pain, rolling on the ground, Lan Ting sighed and explained the situation:
"Xue Shilou was imprisoned here for less than half a day before he suddenly became unconscious, intermittently vomiting blood, with his body severely weakened as if he could die at any moment. Elder Morran even thought he was trying to extort our Fairy Palace."
"Playing it safe, Elder Morran invited Elder Zhou Yulu, who is skilled in medical arts, to examine him. After the check-up, it was discovered that he possessed the Snow Emperor Bloodline, but his frail body couldn't withstand the bloodline awakening. If left unattended, he would certainly die."
"Our Fairy Palace's Sinners' Hall is a proper officially sanctioned prison, not some privately run dungeon. If someone died here, it would not sound good if word got out, and it could easily lead to misunderstandings. There was no choice but to suppress his gradually awakening Snow Emperor Bloodline while nourishing his body to allow for a gradual awakening."
Just thinking of the Fairy Palace spending Heaven and Earth Treasures to help Xue Shilou awaken his bloodline made Lan Ting feel sad for her own Sect's expenses.
"His current state is a normal reaction to the bloodline awakening. There's no need to intervene; he'll be fine after yelling a bit."
Lu Yang's eyes twitched, this Sinners' Hall seemed much more regular than their Captive Peak.
All they did in Captive Peak was use torture on prisoners or refine bodies and souls.
Help with healing and treatment? Unheard of.
But then again, Captive Peak wouldn't encounter a situation like Xue Shilou's; the prisoners were all in the Body Integration Realm. Coming across an opportunity to awaken a bloodline in the Body Integration Realm—wasn't that a bit too late?

chapters.title: Chapter 941 - 940: New Product in the Elixir Brewing Chamber
chapters.content:
Just as Lu Yang was contemplating the adventures that one might encounter in the Body Integration Realm, a chilly voice came through.
"Heh heh, since when has the Immortal Palace fallen to the point where men can enter at will?"
"Ah—," Xue Shilou writhed in pain on the ground, his screams echoing throughout the Sinners' Hall.
"In the past, under my leadership, the Immortal Palace was so glorious..."
"Ah—," Xue Shilou banged his head on the ground in pain, trying to distract himself.
"And now, under that lass Luo Hongxia's leadership, it has become like this..."
"Ah—," Xue Shilou scratched at his body; he was burning up, his entire body flushed red.
"Stop screaming!"
The chilly voice became furious, the good atmosphere completely ruined by Xue Shilou's screams.
If they were not in the Sinners' Hall, with one angry outburst, Xue Shilou certainly wouldn't dare to scream again.
Unfortunately, there was an array method sealing the realm in the Sinners' Hall; even if she possessed heaven-shocking magical power, she could not stop Xue Shilou's miserable screams.
Following the source of the voice, Lu Yang found the owner of the chilly voice, a woman with fair skin and an indifferent expression.
"Who is this?"
"Our Immortal Palace's previous Palace Master, Qu Ling. By seniority, I should address her as my grand-teacher," explained Lan Ting.
Lu Yang was greatly surprised; he hadn't expected that the Immortal Palace would have the former Palace Master locked up in the Sinners' Hall.
"Are you that Lu Yang who's been making waves in the outside world recently?" Although imprisoned in the Sinners' Hall and unable to contact the outside world, with new people joining the Sinners' Hall continuously, she could keep up to date with outside information.
"The Immortal Palace has really fallen, relying on the powerful, allowing men to enter the Immortal Palace, breaking the ancestral rules." Qu Ling sneered continuously, showing disdain for Lu Yang and the Seek Dao Sect behind him.
"Had I not been harmed by Luo Hongxia, how could I have ended in such a state, how could I have let the Immortal Palace fall to this!"
"How did you get caught up in this?" Lu Yang was even more curious, stepping back two paces to look at the plaque at the entrance of the cell.
Qu Ling, embezzlement, life imprisonment.
"In order to break through to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, our grand-teacher privately misused the sect's resources and was arrested by the master and others after the failure of her breakthrough came to light," Lan Ting explained.
"It was later discovered that she got involved in gray areas outside, misusing sect assets for gambling and so forth, committing many crimes. The person making the plaque was too lazy to write so much, so they just put the most important one."
"It's just that your teacher wanted to rise to power, taking the opportunity to eliminate dissidents. Victors become kings, losers are bandits; it has always been this way since ancient times."
Lu Yang showed a puzzled expression: "If this is how you feel, Senior, why did you stop me?"
He had thought that Qu Ling had some grievance to voice to him.
The Five Great Immortal Sects not only had the right to enforce the law but also the authority to supervise each other.
Qu Ling's lips curled, revealing a mysterious smile.
Lu Yang suddenly understood: "I get it, you think it looks cool, right?"
Qu Ling continued to smile, unsure of what she should do next.
Didn't Zhui Yue Ancestor's brought back books often contain this kind of plot? A mysterious person imprisoned in the jail stops the protagonist, then either scoffs or ridicules them, saying a few words that no one else understands, leaving the protagonist with unanswered questions as they leave, while the mysterious person smiles inscrutably in a dark corner of the cage.
The books never explained why the mysterious person needed to stop the protagonist.
Seeing Qu Ling like this, Lu Yang knew he had guessed correctly, satisfied, he left the Sinners' Hall with Lan Ting. Before leaving, he wanted to see what Elder Morran had written, but unfortunately, Elder Morran reacted too quickly and he saw nothing.
Leaving the Sinners' Hall, they suddenly heard an explosion not far away. A deafening boom was followed by flames reaching for the sky, as thick demonic energy permeated the air.
"Is that the Elixir Brewing Chamber? Let's go and take a look!"
The two of them didn't have time to think further and immediately dashed toward the Elixir Brewing Chamber!
Upon arrival, they spotted a gigantic white Demon Rabbit burrowing out of the Elixir Brewing Chamber, poking a large hole through the roof. The Demon Rabbit's eyes were blood-red as if it had gone mad. It kept grabbing roof tiles and stuffing them into its mouth, the crunching sounds were grating to the ears.
"You vile beast, cease your crazed behavior!" Lan Ting unleashed her azure ribbon, which extended and elongated indefinitely, like a serpent that ensnared the Demon Rabbit.
Although the Demon Rabbit seemed fierce, it was just at the Golden Core Stage and was no threat at all.
After being tied up, the Demon Rabbit lay on the ground, wiggling its body, stretching its head toward the roof tiles on the ground with incessant crunching sounds.
"Thank you, Senior Sister Lan, for your help!" A disciple from the Fairy Palace ran out from the Elixir Brewing Chamber. Lu Yang remembered his name was Qin Nan.
"What happened here?" Lan Ting landed and used her ribbon to block the Demon Rabbit's mouth, preventing it from chewing on the tiles anymore, as the sound was unbearable.
"I remember this Demon Rabbit was used for testing elixirs, right? How did it suddenly become so big?"
To test the efficacy of elixirs, the Laurel Fairy Palace raised many Demon Beasts. Unlike the Demon Race, these creatures lacked spiritual wisdom, making them ideal for clinical trials of elixirs.
Hearing the commotion, disciples from the Fairy Palace hurried over, concerned about Qin Nan's wellbeing.
Scratching the back of his head awkwardly, Qin Nan explained to everyone, "I was just testing the properties of the pill, but it failed."
"I suppose the proportions of the elixir were incorrect. It activated the Demon Rabbit's bloodline, causing it to grow in size and become uncontrollable."
"What did you feed it?"
"A Beautification Pill derivative, Beautification Mooncakes with osmanthus filling." Qin Nan produced a piece of mooncake from his bosom. The front was stamped with "Laurel Fairy Palace" and the back with the characters for "Beautification."
"Your Fairy Palace actually makes mooncakes?" Lu Yang asked in surprise.
He had never imagined a type of mooncake that combined the properties of traditional mooncakes, Beautification Pills, and floral cakes.
Lan Ting murmured softly, "Well, the Mid-Autumn Festival is coming up, and our Fairy Palace has a tradition of making mooncakes each year. The Elixir Brewing Chamber always seeks innovation, attempting to combine elixirs with mooncakes."
"However, based on the current situation, the research doesn't seem to be going smoothly."
The Mid-Autumn Festival was a tradition dating back to ancient times, a time when the moon had its phases. The full moon on the fifteenth day of the eighth lunar month was celebrated as Mid-Autumn Festival.
Ever since Immortal Jiuchong created this amalgam of the sun and moon, there were no longer any phases, just a perpetual full moon, yet the custom continued.
The Seek Dao Sect didn't celebrate Mid-Autumn Festival much, probably because the moon had special significance in the Laurel Fairy Palace, which caused the Palace to place great importance on the festival.
"How should we deal with this rabbit?" Lu Yang inquired, looking at the six-meter-long creature that kept writhing restlessly on the ground.
"Dissect it to see what caused the loss of control," a disciple from the Fairy Palace shouted from the sidelines.
"Look, the rabbit's eyes are red; it must have gone mad. It's hopeless."
"But aren't rabbit eyes naturally red?" a perplexed young disciple from the Fairy Palace questioned.
"Shut up, do you still want to eat the rabbit or not?"
The young disciple from the Fairy Palace was torn between telling the truth to save the rabbit and missing out on a delicious meal, or lying to doom the rabbit and ensure a tasty treat. Was this what the adult world was like, filled with lies and choices?
She pondered deeply, caught between ideals and reality, and eventually decided on how to handle the rabbit.
"Then let's roast and eat it."

chapters.title: Chapter 942 - 941 Tree Ancestor's Care
chapters.content:
The Laurel Fairy Palace is prudent in its actions and would never eat the demon rabbit on the pretext of dissection.
They would, of course, wait to determine whether the meat of the demon rabbit is toxic before consuming it.
Seeing how each disciple of the Immortal Palace volunteers eagerly for the task of dissecting the demon rabbit, washing pots, chopping vegetables, boiling water... they all seemed quite skilled, as if this wasn't their first time doing such a thing.
"Do you need a chef?" Fairy Eternity felt it was time to show off her skills herself, volunteered eagerly to sign up, and brought back the culinary arts of the Immortals.
Allowing Fairy Eternity to cook was out of the question, barbecuing on the moon... In Ancient Times, all four Immortals were poisoned unconscious; the Fairy had to carry them back home, which resulted in the Immortal Fire remaining on the moon. The disciples of the Fairy Palace have mortal bodies; they surely wouldn't be able to withstand such a toxic Immortal poison.
Saying no directly was not an option. Lu Yang was meticulous in thought, his mind working very fast; he quickly thought of how to respond. As the saying goes, it's better to divert than to block. Declining Fairy Eternity's suggestion might trigger her defiant nature; the best method was to find a chef that would satisfy the Fairy.
And this chef could be none other than himself.
"How could Your Majesty, a person of noble lineage, engage in such matters? Let this consort... This subject will do it." Lu Yang recently had been reading novels in the Scripture Pavilion of the Fairy Palace, especially palace-fighting novels; he almost misspoke without thinking.
"That works too." Fairy Eternity thought Lu Yang's suggestion was sensible. As an emperor, doing everything herself would lower her dignity; it was good to let Little Yang undertake the task.
"Can I go and barbecue later?" Lu Yang secretly sent a voice transmission to Lan Ting.
Lan Ting had experienced Lu Yang's cooking skills in Yanjiang County; they were exceptional, unmatched in flavor.
Now that Lu Yang had advanced to the Divinity Transformation Stage, his control over the heat and meat quality must have reached the "Subtlety" realm, and the flavor would surely be even better than before.
Moreover, it had been a long time since she had tasted Lu Yang's barbecue.
"I'll talk to the Senior Sister in charge of the cooking."
"Then let him try; I'd like to see what he's capable of!" The Senior Sister in charge of cooking responded displeased upon hearing this.
Lan Ting, delighted, conveyed the good news of securing a chance to cook to Lu Yang.
"The Senior Sister in charge of cooking agreed to let you try; she said she actually wants to witness your skills, Senior Brother."
"Did Senior Sister really say that?" Lu Yang looked skeptically at Lan Ting; although he didn't have the habit of eavesdropping, from the look on Lan Ting's face when she went to communicate, it seemed that the Senior Sister in charge of cooking was not too pleased.
"It's more or less what she meant."
"That's good then." Lu Yang was relieved, thinking he might have upset the Senior Sister in charge of cooking with his actions.
The efficiency of the Fairy Palace was extremely high; they had already figured out why the demon rabbit had suddenly grown so big while washing the pots.
"It's because the Beautification Pill reacted with the osmanthus." Qin Nan summarized.
"The Beautification Pill itself has the effect of causing growth; surprisingly, the freshly picked osmanthus flowers also have this effect. When combined, they caused the demon rabbit to swell in size."
"It also caused the demon rabbit to go mad," a certain Junior Sister added, which was a critical point.
"Ah right, it also caused the demon rabbit to go mad."
"But the good news is that the demon rabbit has digested all the medicinal properties; it's safe to eat, no toxins, and the meat is healthy."
It was good news that the demon rabbit could be eaten; not only could he show off his culinary skills, but Lu Yang also had a question: "Why does the Beautification Pill have the effect of causing growth?"
Weren't female cultivators using the Beautification Pill to make themselves look better?
Asking such a question showed that Lu Yang was a novice; all disciples of the Immortal Palace knew the answer.
Qin Nan explained, "This is the way it is: female cultivators often consume two types of elixirs, the Eternal Youth Elixir and the Beautification Pill. The Eternal Youth Elixir fixes your appearance, and the Beautification Pill changes your appearance."
"To change one's appearance, there are two directions: to increase or decrease in size."
"Some female cultivators have good talent and progress quickly in cultivation, reaching the Eternal Youth Realm while still a girl, which ceases any change in appearance."
"This leads to a problem: the body has not fully developed, and that's where the Beautification Pill comes into play."
Lu Yang suddenly realized that this was an area he had never touched on, and indeed there were many intricacies.
"Consuming elixirs is all trickery!" Fairy Eternity looked down with disdain upon such reprehensible practices.
As the chief among the top ten beauties of ancient times, she was qualified to speak in such a manner.
Unfortunately, her statement as the foremost of the ancient beauties failed to capture Lu Yang's attention; Lu Yang was earnestly learning about the knowledge related to the Beautification Pill.
Although it might not be necessary, learning a bit more was always beneficial.
Lu Yang looked at the demon rabbit that had been bled and cut and began to prepare the marinating base.
To save time, Lu Yang chose to use a quick marinating method, which would allow the flavors to penetrate rapidly.
"By the way, have you ever tried using laurel as firewood for barbecuing?" Lu Yang asked while grinding the base ingredients, admiring Fairy Eternity's approach to barbecuing.
"Using laurel as firewood?" Lan Ting paused, it was something she had never considered.
"Wait a moment, I'll ask the Tree Ancestor, if it agrees then it's fine."
"The Laurel Tree Ancestor has consciousness?" Lu Yang was amazed, he had thought the Laurel Tree Ancestor was simply a tall tree.
"It is conscious, but I have never heard it speak. Our master told us that the Tree Ancestor is the most crucial trump card of our Fairy Palace."
Seeing Lu Yang's interest, Lan Ting took him deep into the Laurel Forest again to meet the towering Tree Ancestor.
Lan Ting paid respects to the Laurel Tree Ancestor with three deep bows, performed an entire set of complex rituals, and then asked respectfully, "I wish to cut down a laurel tree to use as fuel, may the Tree Ancestor grant permission."
Rustle rustle rustle.
The massive branches swayed without wind, producing a rustling sound.
Lan Ting raised her head excitedly, "The Tree Ancestor agrees!"
Lu Yang never expected the Tree Ancestor to be so amenable; he too bowed three times to the Tree Ancestor.
With the Tree Ancestor's assent, they began searching for a suitable laurel tree. The laurel needed to fall with one strike—too thick, and it would be embarrassing if they couldn't cut it; too thin, and it wouldn't serve as proper firewood.
"This one seems about right." Lu Yang patted a laurel tree beside him that was about a palm's thickness.
"Isn't it too thick?" Lan Ting questioned, doubting she could cut through such a thick laurel tree.
"Let's try and see." Lu Yang took out the Green Peak Sword and tapped the laurel tree. He had never chopped down a laurel tree before; it was a whole new experience for him.
Inside the Green Peak Sword, the power of Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin coalesced. Lu Yang's gaze sharpened as he unified his hand and waist, pushed off with his right foot, twisted his body, transferring his full strength into the Green Peak Sword, and shouted mightily!
"Chop!"
Crack!
The sword struck into the tree, burying itself halfway through.
It did not sever the tree.
Lu Yang scratched his head, having hoped to show off in front of Lan Ting, but he had failed.
Just as he was about to say something to ease the embarrassment, Lan Ting pointed in surprise at the partially severed laurel tree.
"The laurel tree hasn't healed!"
This was unprecedented!
Seeing this, Lu Yang swung his sword again!
Crack—boom—
The laurel tree fell to the ground.
"Strange, did I chop too quickly for the laurel tree to heal in time?" Lu Yang carried the laurel tree, puzzled.
Fairy Eternity rolled her eyes. It wasn't a matter of the laurel tree not healing in time; clearly, the Laurel Tree Ancestor had intentionally controlled this particular laurel tree to not heal.
"Really taking good care of Little Yang."

chapters.title: Chapter 943 - 943: 942 Although rabbits are good, don't eat too much
chapters.content:
Barbecuing is a meticulous task, and by the time everyone was ready and Lu Yang and Lan Ting had returned with the laurel tree, it was already evening.
Lu Yang shouldering the laurel tree through the crowd was like a triumphant returning general, greatly admired, with exclamations of amazement rising and falling.
"Why carry back a laurel tree?"
"I heard it's to be used as firewood for the barbecue."
"Ah? Can laurel trees be used like that?"
"They must be, since they were able to cut it down, it means the Tree Ancestor agreed to it."
Lu Yang split the laurel tree from the middle, then chopped it into smaller segments, dried them with fire to remove moisture.
He then tossed these laurel wood segments into a large pit that had been dug in advance, set up a rack over the pit, and placed the marinated demon rabbit on it.
With a flick of his fingertips, Lu Yang sent the Three Flavored True Fire into the pit. The segments of laurel wood caught fire upon contact, and according to Fairy Eternity's experience, such aged laurel wood could burn all night, enough to roast the demon rabbit thoroughly.
As the segments of laurel wood burned, they released an intoxicating fragrance reminiscent of the laurel tree in bloom, transporting the Disciples of the Immortal Palace back to that season, utterly enchanting them.
As one of the founders of the "Come Back for Barbecue" establishment, Lu Yang's barbecue skills needed no further mention, being considered unparalleled in the modern age, with only Man Gu who mastered the Corpse-Driving Spell able to challenge him, competing in culinary skills that were second only to Fairy Eternity!
Lu Yang covered every inch of the demon rabbit's flesh with his Spiritual Sense, precisely controlling the heat of the Three Flavored True Fire, occasionally throwing a couple more laurel wood segments into the fire pit, creating a continuous crackling sound.
He ceaselessly brushed oil and turned the meat, ensuring that the skin, flesh, tendons, and bones reached a balance in taste and texture, with a hint of garlic and the freshness of spice permeating the meat.
Even the Automatic Barbecue Array had its limitations, and a demon rabbit of such immense size far exceeded the capability of the array, highlighting the value of experienced hands like Lu Yang's in such a situation.
Basking in the warmth emanating from the fire pit, mingled with the scents of osmanthus and roasting meat, the Disciples of the Immortal Palace enjoyed each other's company, their conversations full of laughter and joy.
Lan Ting sat next to Lu Yang, and without a word between them, she eventually dozed off until Lu Yang woke her.
"Junior Sister Lan, would you like to try some?"
Lan Ting opened her eyes to find the demon rabbit roasted to a golden color.
She tore off a piece of skin and flesh, and the juices beneath found an outlet, dripping down into the fire pit, sizzling as they fell.
Perfumed with the laurel wood's smoke, the meat had lost all trace of gaminess.
The outer layer was crisp and made a satisfying crunch with each bite, offering a delightful texture. The lean meat was chewy, releasing a richer flavor the more one chewed. The aroma of osmanthus tantalized the taste buds, and when paired with the dipping sauce of sesame oil, soybeans, and sesame seeds prepared by Lu Yang, Lan Ting was fully awakened by the deliciousness.
Lan Ting licked her fingertips, clearly wanting more.
Seeing the expression on Lan Ting's face, Lu Yang didn't need her to say anything to know that the demon rabbit was perfectly roasted.
"Everyone, it's ready to eat!"
"To the left is non-spicy, to the right is spicy, and the jar by the fire pit has the dipping sauce!"
The disciples of the Immortal Palace had been waiting for this moment. Surrounded by peers, there was no need to maintain the facade of an immortal; they swarmed forward to savor the long-coveted demon rabbit.
In the Cultivation World, where strength is revered, this principle was vividly displayed: those with higher cultivation levels rushed to the front, while those with lower levels had to wait their turn.
"It's so delicious!"
"I've never tasted barbecue this good before."
"I've been to the headquarters of the 'Come Back for Barbecue' store, but even their barbecue is not as delicious as Elder Brother Lu Yang's!"
Even the pickiest cook among the senior sisters had to admit that Lu Yang's barbecue skills were indeed superior to her own, far surpassing hers.
She was thoroughly defeated.
In civilian barbecue, cooking such a massive ingredient would normally result in a burnt exterior and an undercooked interior, but under Lu Yang's control, streamers of Three Flavored True Fire penetrated the demon rabbit's body, searing every inch of flesh just right.
Even Fairy Eternity couldn't stop praising Lu Yang's roasted demon rabbit.
"Little Yang really has some skill, letting the Three Flavored True Fire penetrate the demon rabbit, like bone-burrowing maggots, making even the bones crispy and fragrant, he has learned three parts of this immortal's capability already."
Although it was a compliment, Lu Yang always felt something was amiss.
Nobody noticed that the petite Bai Ye weaved through the crowd, tore off a piece of rabbit meat, and quietly left to sit on a branch of the Laurel Tree Ancestor, eating until her mouth was greasy.
"Eh, it smells so good when roasted with our Laurel Wood?"
…
That night, none of the disciples from the Fairy Palace practiced their cultivation, eating to their heart's content. Anyone who saw this scene wouldn't associate these merry and feasting disciples with those ethereal fairies aloof from the secular world.
Lu Yang was also delighted. As a chef, his favorite thing was when diners praised his food.
Even without explicit compliments, seeing the junior sisters enthusiastically sucking on the bones, he knew his barbecue was a success.
"Yawn—so sleepy—" Lu Yang let out a big yawn. He felt like being lazy today and decided not to practice cultivation but to sleep directly instead.
The disciples of the Fairy Palace were also yawning prodigiously, disregarding their image and falling asleep wherever they lay.
With their level of cultivation, they wouldn't freeze even if it snowed; they could sleep anywhere.
Had someone looked down from the sky, they would have noticed a huge pit in the center of the Fairy Palace, with burned-out laurel wood in the middle and countless disciples of the Fairy Palace lying around it.
As the moon transformed into the sun, Lu Yang felt the warm morning light on his face and struggled to move his eyelids, not especially eager to open his eyes. He hadn't slept this comfortably in a long time.
"Who covered me with a blanket?" Lu Yang felt a blanket over his body and wondered which kind person did it.
Was it Junior Sister Lan?
Lu Yang opened his eyes groggily and struggled to crawl out of the "blanket," looking at the senior sisters and brothers around him, his mind still a bit foggy.
"I have a feeling that something's off?" Lu Yang murmured to himself.
Suddenly, he dramatically realized the source of his discomfort.
"Why am I naked!"
Lu Yang raised his hand and his pupils dilated: "No… I've shrunk!"
What he thought was a blanket was actually his own clothes.
They just looked like a blanket because they were too loose after he had shrunk.
Lu Yang snapped to attention and looked at Lan Ting sleeping beside him.
In place of Lan Ting was a little girl around eight or nine years old.
Lan Ting had shrunk too!
Lu Yang looked around and saw that it wasn't just Lan Ting, everyone present had shrunk!
Elsewhere, Luo Hongxia and Elder Zhu Hong were returning from Seek Dao Sect, with Luo Hongxia kindly consoling Elder Zhu Hong.
"Junior Sister, don't be disappointed. Didn't Yun Zhi say she'll let you take it once she figures out Twin River?"
"You've been wanting a child for more than a day or two, so what's a little more waiting?"
Elder Zhu Hong nodded noncommittally, not saying much.
Seeing this, Luo Hongxia knew she had been talking in vain all this way.
The two landed and saw Lu Yang standing bare-bottomed in the cold wind, as well as a ground full of little girls.
They were stunned speechless.

chapters.title: Chapter 944 - 943: Truly Became Little Yang
chapters.content:
Luo Hongxia and Elder Zhu Hong stood rooted to the spot, at a loss for what to do.
Elder Zhu Hong admitted she liked children, but she had never imagined that the Fairy Palace would be filled with so many of them.
"Could someone have used a magic skill to reverse time, causing the Fairy Palace to return to the past?"
"That's not right; if we had gone back to the past, it wouldn't be like this."
The disciples of the Fairy Palace varied greatly in age, yet now all appeared as children — an occurrence time reversal could not explain.
What on earth had happened?
They had only left for three days, so how come the Fairy Palace felt so unfamiliar?
"Are you... Lu Yang?" Luo Hongxia asked hesitantly, being able to recognize Lu Yang's original appearance even in this child's form.
"Not right now," Lu Yang firmly denied, then quickly picked up the clothes from the ground and wrapped himself up.
"The real me is Lu Yang."
The person who was naked in the icy, snowy outdoors just a moment ago had nothing to do with him.
"What in the world is going on?"
"I don't know either. We just ate some roasted rabbit, then took a nap, and turned out like this," Lu Yang was innocent, just as confused as anyone else. How did he end up as a child when everything was fine before?
"Fairy, stop sleeping, wake up!" Lu Yang shook Fairy Eternity, who was lying on the bed of snow with her fingers interlaced across her chest.
Fairy Eternity looked extremely beautiful when asleep, so glorious that it made Lu Yang forget all about her various past actions and admit she was among the top ten beauties of the Ancient Times.
But now was not the time to admire how pretty Fairy Eternity was!
Fairy Eternity was even more deeply asleep than Lu Yang, equally unwilling to wake up.
When she woke up from her slumber, she instantly perked up at the sight of Lu Yang's youthful appearance.
"Ah, how have you become so small?"
Fairy Eternity sat up abruptly, gesturing to compare Lu Yang's height with her own, noting that the current Lu Yang only reached her waist.
"You've truly become Little Yang."
"That's why I've come to ask for the Fairy's diagnosis," Lu Yang sought help from Fairy Eternity.
"Oh dear, you're quite cute being so tiny," Fairy Eternity chuckled, squatting down to pat Lu Yang's head, showing no intention of dealing with the situation.
...
Outside, the disciples of the Immortal Palace were gradually awakening, and their high-pitched, childlike screams mingled with sobs, making Lu Yang feel as if he had wandered into a nursery, where he was the 'big kid' – not crying or fussing.
Luo Hongxia and Zhu Hong went from soothing one child to the next, their bodies not tired, but their hearts were exhausted.
Elder Zhu Hong felt that she didn't really need the water from the Twin River anymore.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, what is going on with us…" Lan Ting timidly wrapped her clothes around her body, even covering her head, leaving only half her face exposed.
Lu Yang held his forehead, Junior Sister Lan, don't look at me with that kind of gaze; it makes it seem like something happened between us last night.
Together we barely make up a legal adult; what could have happened?
Fortunately, the disciples of the Immortal Palace were not truly children. Often going on missions and handling major events, they calmed down after their initial shock upon waking.
Though they had indeed never seen a situation like this before.
The other Elders, hearing that something had occurred, all rushed over.
Only the disciples had partaken in eating the rabbit last night; the Elders, upholding their status, did not join the grand gathering.
"Junior Sister Yulu, can you see what's the matter?" Luo Hongxia called over Elder Zhou Yulu, who was most skilled in medical expertise. The bloodline issue of the Xue Shilou was something Elder Zhou Yulu had remedied.
Elder Zhou Yulu jumped as she saw the ground covered with children, but her composure as a doctor allowed her to settle down and resist the urge to record the scene with a Recording Orb, checking the pulse of each child.
"Poisoned? That doesn't seem right, could it be a tonic?"
"Could the problem have been with what we ate yesterday?" Luo Hongxia noticed only a skeleton remained on the rack, which had once held a demon rabbit.
"It shouldn't be, I checked the demon rabbit before we ate it, and there was no problem."
Despite saying this, Zhou Yulu still scraped off a small piece of meat from the skeleton and immersed her Immortal Sense into it, continuously analyzing.
"The meat indeed has no issue."
Lu Yang breathed a sigh of relief. As long as it wasn't his fault, it was fine.
Suddenly, Elder Zhou noticed the charred remains in the large pit, which appeared somewhat strange.
"Did someone split the laurel tree to use as firewood?"
She drew a piece of the char toward her and immersed her Immortal Sense into it to analyze the cause, eventually discovering the problem.
"The laurel tree has been tampered with. This tree had been altered with several substances that had the effect of shrinking."
"After burning, the laurel tree's fragrance covered other odors, and those who smelled it would be affected without realizing."
In fact, the rabbit meat that had been smoked with the laurel tree also retained some of these substances, but only on the surface layer of the meat; the flesh closer to the bone hadn't been smoked through.
Lu Yang's relieved breath was taken back. So, it was still related to me after all.
"Then, is there a problem with little Lan and the others?" Luo Hongxia was most concerned about this.
"There's no major issue. It's just that their bodies have shrunk. If left alone for a few days, they will return to normal," she answered.
"I guess by the time my antidote is developed, they will all have returned to normal."
"As long as it's nothing serious."
"Palace Master, the current problem is not with Junior Sister Lan and the others, but with the laurel tree," stated Elder Zhou, pointing to the skeleton of the demon rabbit. "This demon rabbit grew large because it ate mooncakes filled with osmanthus paste, and then we discovered that Zhang Guihua's laurel tree had issues, containing substances that make people grow larger."
"Now, we have discovered another laurel tree that has the effect of shrinking people."
"Who exactly has tampered with the laurel trees, and how many trees have been affected?"
Luo Hongxia looked grave. This was indeed a serious issue.
The Immortal Palace was protected by an Array Method; outsiders couldn't enter. This was the doing of someone from within the Immortal Palace!
"Fairy, do you know who did this?"
Fairy Eternity shook her head. "I do not know."
She was not someone who lacked self-restraint, using her Immortal Sense to observe everything that happened in the Immortal Palace all day long.
The laurel tree matter was important, but it wasn't the most pressing issue.
The most pressing issue at the moment was the children.
"Lu Yang, perhaps you should return to the guest room first?" suggested Luo Hongxia.
Lu Yang was the only male cultivator on the scene, and the Disciples of the Immortal Palace who had turned into children couldn't fit into their clothes. With Lu Yang present, they were too embarrassed to move, worried he might see something he shouldn't.
"Alright," Lu Yang agreed, understanding the principle that men and women should be treated differently.
However, it was clear some did not understand this principle, such as Fairy Eternity.
Inside the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity swung mini Lu Yang's arm around in circles, making a melodious sound as they rotated, filling the Spiritual Space with her laughter and jovial sounds.
Lu Yang was expressionless, looking at Fairy Eternity with dead fish eyes, like a toy being played with at her whim.
"Fairy, men and women should maintain a degree of separation, touching each other is inappropriate," Lu Yang kindly reminded her, attempting to improve his treatment.
Fairy Eternity squatted down and poked Lu Yang's forehead, finding the current Lu Yang particularly fun. Smiling, she said, "Why should a little thing like you care about the difference between men and women?"

chapters.title: Chapter 945 - 944 Kept secret, but not completely
chapters.content:
After Lu Yang transformed into a child, not only did his body size shrink, but his cultivation level was also sealed, rendering him indistinguishable from an ordinary child.
"There's no suitable clothing, ah." Lu Yang furrowed his brows in distress and circled the room draped in oversized garments that trailed on the floor. He didn't dare set foot in the courtyard in his current state.
The clothes he wore before hung on him like blankets, and he hadn't brought any children's clothing with him, so he was, rather embarrassingly, left without anything to wear.
Whether he had his cultivation level was insignificant, according to Elder Zhou Yulu's words. It would recover, but right now, finding some clothes he could wear was of the utmost importance.
"Where can I find some clothes, oh…"
As Lu Yang paced the room, he accidentally tripped over the hem of his garment that was dragging on the floor and rolled up in the cloth.
Lu Yang's head emerged with difficulty from the tangle of clothes, his eyes devoid of spirit.
Alright, cultivation level is quite important, too.
Disciples of the Immortal Palace all shared a similar quandary: who would bother to keep children's clothes on hand?
As for making clothes... Unfortunately, in the vast expanse of the Immortal Palace, not a single soul knew how to sew.
Though there was no shortage of people who could wield an axe to chop trees.
In principle, with the Elders of Seek Dao Sect, Vast Sea Daoist Lord, and Eldest Senior Sister, gathering the strength of many should surely lead to a way to revert back to his original form.
But that assumed he dared to return to Seek Dao Sect.
This would be a shameful past, one Old Meng could laugh about at his own expense for a lifetime.
Fortunately, every disciple of the Immortal Palace was reduced in size, and such embarrassing incidents could be mutually kept secret without fear of leaks.
The upper echelons of the Immortal Palace would also consider factors like face and would not leak the secret.
Lu Yang fixed his gaze on Fairy Eternity, his soft eyes gradually turning fierce.
If that's the case, then there was only one person who might leak the secret.
In order to deal with Fairy Eternity, he couldn't refrain from employing some unsavory tactics!
"Fairy, you absolutely must not let this matter slip, alright?"
With the reduction of his body size, Lu Yang's voice also became soft and childish, pleading in a milk-and-honey manner.
Fairy Eternity giggled as she tugged on Lu Yang's chubby little cheeks, which were surprisingly comfortable to the touch, then lifted him onto her lap and tousled his hair.
"Come on, say a few more sweet words for me to hear."
Lu Yang leaned back, looking up at Fairy Eternity's pretty face, and felt a wave of terror.
He was forced to flatter Fairy Eternity shamefully with sweet-talk to win her favor.
"Fairy, you are both beautiful and kind-hearted. Surely you would not disclose my circumstance, exposing me to ridicule."
Fairy Eternity, trying hard to keep a straight face, said, "Why would anyone laugh at you? Everyone feels great sympathy for you, Little Yang. You have such a dark view, you need to believe that everyone is good-hearted."
"Fairy, as a subject of the Great Bean Dynasty, if outsiders were to see me like this, wouldn't it tarnish the reputation of our Great Bean Dynasty?"
"Then I'll just tell Little Ling Lianyi and the others; they are all from our Great Bean Dynasty and won't harm the dynasty's reputation."
"Fairy~~ please~~" Lu Yang affectionately nuzzled Fairy Eternity's arm, deeply humiliated.
Fairy Eternity, seeing Lu Yang being so obedient, couldn't help but beam with joy.
"Alright then, I will keep this secret for you."
Lu Yang hurriedly expressed his gratitude, fearing Fairy Eternity might change her mind: "Thank you, your Grace, for your great kindness. Your servant Lu Yang will never forget this grace!"
```
Lu Yang breathed a sigh of relief. Although Fairy Eternity was unreliable in her actions, she would not break her promise. If she said she would not reveal any secrets, she definitely would not reveal any secrets.
He was safe now.
After being toyed with by Fairy Eternity for half a day, Lu Yang finally managed to handle her.
Lu Yang felt a bit tired, probably because he had been spinning around earlier. Without his cultivation level, indeed many things were inconvenient to do.
Propping himself on the edge of the stool, Lu Yang kicked his little leg up and sat on it, struggling to reach for the Spirit Fruit placed on the table. These fruits, prepared by the Fairy Palace for guests, were invaluable in the outside world and extremely precious.
If it were the Lu Yang from before, eating a Spirit Fruit would merely be for the sake of novelty, as his cultivation level was hardly helped by them anymore. But now, eating them could effectively restore his strength.
He habitually wiped the fruit peel with his hand, took a crisp bite, and eating such spiritual objects again after shrinking did feel different; the energy he had expended walking around the room quickly recovered.
"Being small isn't too bad," Lu Yang said with a smile, hugging the fruit. It was a rare experience and quite novel.
In the past, he would have finished a Spirit Fruit in a few bites, but now he couldn't finish one even if he gnawed on it.
...
A mysterious figure sped towards them, appearing above the Fairy Palace.
The Sect Protection Array of the Fairy Palace seemed innately permeable before the mysterious figure, as she passed directly through it without the array raising any alarm.
With a clear target, the mysterious figure headed straight for the first guest room where Lu Yang was staying, unnoticed by anyone.
Using some unknown Divine Immortal Technique, the door seemed like an illusion in front of her; she didn't need to open the door and went straight into the room.
Lu Yang finally sensed the unsolicited visitor and jerked his head up, his eyes filled with vigilance.
"Who's there!"
"Junior Brother, Elder Fairy, this Twin River..."
Lu Yang and the mysterious figure locked eyes, neither brother nor sister said a word, and time seemed to stop in that moment.
Yun Zhi blinked, staring at the childlike little face marked with wariness, holding a Spirit Fruit with a couple of bites taken out of it, and her eyelid twitched twice.
She had seen Elder Zhu Hong longing for the waters of Twin River, wanting a child, and thought it improper to keep waiting for Junior Brother to return, uncertain how long he would stay at the Fairy Palace.
Instead of waiting for Junior Brother, why not sneak into the Fairy Palace and ask about the Twin River?
She made it into the Fairy Palace alright, but what was the situation in front of her?
"Junior Brother, what's going on..." Yun Zhi said with a strange look on her face. Does this place really nurture people this way? Junior Brother was so much bigger before he left, and now he's turned into a tiny tot.
"I'm not Lu Yang!" Lu Yang hurried to deny, although denying in front of Eldest Senior Sister was futile. However, a symbolic concealment was still necessary; it was a matter of attitude.
"Nor am I Lu Yin!" Lu Yang added inexplicably.
At a critical moment, Fairy Eternity remembered her promise to keep Lu Yang's shrinking a secret. She had been contemplating how to tease Little Yang and hadn't noticed Miss Yun sneaking up close.
She had been careless.
No, this would mean she had not kept her promise, and spreading such news would tarnish her image!
She must keep Little Yang's secret!
In a panic, Fairy Eternity flew out of the Spiritual Space to make up for the oversight, her mind working at full speed to give a flustered explanation.
"Miss Yun, you must be mistaken, Little Yang has not shrunk. This is not Little Yang. The reason he looks a lot like Little Yang is because, well, this is the child of Little Yang and me!"
Yun Zhi: "..."
```

chapters.title: Chapter 946 - 945 Clothing
chapters.content:
Yun Zhi considered herself to be someone who remained unfazed in the face of issues, capable of analyzing problems calmly.
For instance, the horrifying Thunder Tribulation she encountered during her Pass Tribulation, the first time she exchanged blows with an Immortal, and when she discovered that Lu Yang possessed exceptional magical talent... Although some issues remained unresolved, at the very least, she maintained her composure.
After she listened to Fairy Eternity's words, her mind indeed struggled to cope.
Plop.
Lu Yang was so scared that he dropped the Spirit Fruit in his hand, and it rolled off to who knows where.
"I, I am Lu Yang."
Lu Yang hurried to reveal his true form; if he let Fairy Eternity continue, she might utter some earth-shattering statements.
At that time, if Eldest Senior Sister couldn't bear to lay a hand on the Fairy, then he would be the one out of luck!
...
In the guest room, Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity knelt side by side, earnestly listening to Yun Zhi's scolding.
With a ruler in hand, Yun Zhi paced back and forth in front of the two, who shivered from fear, not daring to make a move, not even daring to raise their heads, in case they received a strike from Yun Zhi's ruler.
"Senior Fairy, there are some things that one must not talk about carelessly; they could easily cause great chaos, do you understand?"
"I can understand that you want to protect Junior Brother's feelings, but you can't go too far. If outsiders were to hear this, they might think something happened between you and Junior Brother, tarnishing both of your reputations."
"I was wrong, I will never lie again," Fairy Eternity said with her head bowed, showing a sincere attitude. If it weren't for her limited cultural level, she might have even felt the impulse to write a letter of apology.
Seeing Fairy Eternity sincerely admitting her fault, Yun Zhi's emerging sense of alarm also subsided greatly.
It was enough to scare them a bit; she couldn't really beat them with the ruler.
Unfortunately, the Emperor's Chair was placed on Sky Gate Mountain, and she hadn't brought it with her, so Yun Zhi picked a random chair from the guest room to sit in front of them and listened to Lu Yang recount what happened.
"So you mean, the problem originated from the Laurel Tree, which caused Junior Brother to suffer misfortune while lighting it, shrinking your body?"
"Not just me, all the disciples of the Immortal Palace shrunk too."
Yun Zhi nodded, the matter was neither too big nor too small. As Elder Zhou Yulu had said, the shrinking and loss of Cultivation Level were temporary; as long as they stayed indoors during this period, it wouldn't create any problems.
Of course, it would be best if there wasn't someone like her who had sneaked into the Immortal Palace secretly.
"Eldest Senior Sister, do you have a way to help me revert to my original size?" Lu Yang looked at his all-capable Eldest Senior Sister with hope—the body of a child was really inconvenient, requiring him to jump onto chairs and stretch his hands to grab Spirit Fruits.
Yun Zhi didn't provide an answer and simply waved him over, "Come here, let me check."
"Oh."
Yun Zhi pinched Lu Yang's cheek and touched his little head, then shook her head in disappointment, dashing Lu Yang's hopes: "It won't work, I'm not skilled in the way of pharmacology; your situation can only recover with time."
Fairy Eternity showed a puzzled expression. Was this matter really that difficult?
She wasn't skilled in pharmacology either, but reverting Little Yang back to normal was quite easy for her, a mere trifle. However, once reverted, she wouldn't be able to knead Little Yang as casually as she could now.
Miss Yun had just taught her not to lie, so she must be telling the truth now, which proves she truly lacks the capability.
In this regard, it seemed Miss Yun indeed couldn't match up to her. Fairy Eternity thought delightedly, finding another aspect in which she surpassed Miss Yun besides intelligence.
"Don't you have suitable clothes?" Yun Zhi noticed that Lu Yang's clothes were abnormally loose.
"No."
"In that case, find me a piece of clothing, and I'll tailor it for you."
Lu Yang's face lit up with joy. "Eldest Senior Sister, you know how to tailor clothes too?"
"I learned it when I was young, but I haven't used the skill in a long time. I hope I haven't gotten rusty."
When Lu Yang went to look for clothes, he realized that other than the clothes he was wearing, all his other garments were stored in his identity token.
And right now, he had no mana to access his identity token.
Yun Zhi stepped in, retrieving a set of clothes from Lu Yang's identity token. This wasn't related to cultivation level; it was a privilege of the Acting Sect Master.
She carefully sized up Lu Yang, had a clothing design in mind, and with her finger acting as a blade, tailored the clothing to fit Lu Yang's current size.
Then she took out a sewing kit from her own identity token and began to make clothes for Lu Yang—cutting, sewing, designing patterns, handling pleats...
Yun Zhi moved smoothly, her actions not at all like someone who hadn't sewn in a long time as she claimed, and indeed, quite the opposite, Lu Yang had never seen anyone whose craftsmanship in this area surpassed that of Eldest Senior Sister.
"It's done."
With a flick of the garment, Yun Zhi finished a beautifully crafted set of clothes with a white base and blue edges, which Lu Yang accepted with extreme care as if it were a precious treasure.
After all, this was the first time he had received something hand-made by Eldest Senior Sister. Not to mention its practical value, the sentimental significance alone was exceptional.
"By the way, Fairy Senior, did you say that you wanted the people of the Fairy Palace to drink water from the Twin River?" Yun Zhi suddenly remembered the real purpose of their visit.
"Yes, didn't they say they wanted children? Drinking water from the Twin River is just what they need."
"Are there any particulars to be noted about drinking the river water, like how much one should drink at a time?"
"The things created by this Immortal aren't so finicky. Just drink a bowlful, and it won't matter if you drink more or even take a dive into the river. Drinking more won't result in four kids."
"Also, a person can only drink water from the Twin River once in their lifetime. Drinking it a second time will have no effect, and it will be no different from ordinary river water."
Yun Zhi nodded to herself. It seemed the Twin River and the Mother-child River were much alike in their use, differing only slightly in effect.
"Then, Junior Brother, take good care of yourself in the Fairy Palace. Whenever you want to come back to Seek Dao Sect, just return," Yun Zhi said as she stood up to say goodbye, acknowledging that despite some twists and turns, their goal was ultimately achieved.
After saying farewell to Eldest Senior Sister, Lu Yang asked Fairy Eternity to close her eyes and not to look at him.
"I'm going to change clothes."
"Don't worry, this Immortal won't peek," she replied.
Lu Yang rustled and fussed as he put on the clothes. They fit perfectly, and his whole demeanor was revitalized. Before, he had been wrapping himself up in clothes like a blanket, looking like a patient.
Not long after Lu Yang had changed his clothes, he heard a knock at the door from Lan Ting, "Elder Brother Lu Yang, are you there?"
"Come in."
Lan Ting entered, dressed in new clothes and holding another set while sporting a mischievous smile.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, the Elder just came down the mountain and bought clothes for everyone. However, he wasn't aware of your situation and bought only women's clothes. Perhaps you could make do... Eh, you already have clothes to wear?"
Lan Ting was surprised to see Lu Yang wearing fitting clothes and realized his plan had fallen through.
"Oh, right, I just happened to bring a child's clothing with me," Lu Yang replied with a chuckle, as he couldn't very well say that Eldest Senior Sister had just made him a new set of clothes on the spot.
Lan Ting looked at Lu Yang with a peculiar expression. Why would Elder Brother Lu Yang carry children's clothing with him?

chapters.title: Chapter 947 - 946: Three Suspects
chapters.content:
Lan Ting came to the guest room to deliver clothes. Although he had no use for the clothes himself, it wouldn't be polite to just send Lan Ting away immediately.
"Would Junior Sister Lan like to come in and sit for a while?"
"Sure." Lan Ting entered and noticed a half-eaten Spirit Fruit by the door.
"I didn't hold it steady just now, and it accidentally fell to the ground." Lu Yang picked up the Spirit Fruit, apologized, and continued to eat it after cleaning it off.
Both of them struggled to hop onto the chairs, and Lu Yang took the initiative to talk about the shrinking incident.
"Have you found out who poisoned the Laurel Tree?"
The culprit who caused his shrinkage, Lu Yang swore he would bring them to justice once caught!
"Not yet. The investigation revealed that a total of thirty-six Laurel Trees had been tampered with, with effects ranging from enlargement to shrinkage, involving trees of various ages. The ones used for mooncake filling and the one you chopped down were among them."
Lu Yang helplessly massaged his forehead. With the ample Laurel Trees all over the Fairy Palace, he picked one at random that was thriving. He hadn't expected it to be one that had been tampered with.
What luck.
The Fairy Palace also knew it was a matter of luck and unrelated to Lu Yang.
If this issue had been related to Lu Yang, then he might have to stay next to Xue Shilou for a while. However, the two could exchange insights on swordsmanship, which might not be such a bad thing after all.
