"There's also the Elixir Brewing Chamber inventory count. Dozens of precious herbal ingredients are missing, and some residues were found on those poisoned Laurel Trees."
"The Elixir Brewing Chamber inventory is counted every two months before heading down the mountain to purchase daily necessities. That's why the loss of ingredients went unnoticed until now."
"Could it really be someone from inside the Fairy Palace?"
The place where the ingredients were stored was certainly protected by layers of Array Methods. Only someone capable of passing through multiple Array Methods to steal the ingredients could be an Immortal or someone from inside the Fairy Palace.
"Master is investigating suspected individuals one by one, but so far, there's no progress."
"Moreover, Master can't figure out why the thief would want to experiment on the Laurel Trees and what their goal is."
Although Lan Ting would love to help Master solve this problem, unfortunately, she was just a child now and couldn't lend a hand.
"How many suspects are there now?" Lu Yang's body might have shrunk and he might have lost all his mana, but his mind was still sharp. Perhaps he could find some clues.
Lan Ting felt there was no harm in discussing such matters in detail with Elder Brother Lu Yang. Counting on her fingers, she said, "There are three in total: Elder Miao, who used to be in charge of the Elixir Brewing Chamber, Elder Mei who is currently in charge, and Elder Mei's senior apprentice, Senior Sister Bai."
"Only they know how to unlock the Great Formation and can freely enter and exit the Elixir Brewing Chamber's medicine warehouse."
"Actually, Elder Qu Ling, the former Sect Leader, also knows how to activate the Great Formation, but since she is currently imprisoned in Sinners' Hall, she can't be involved."
"Although it's unclear who stole the precious ingredients, the timeframe can be confirmed."
"How so?"
"There's a record every time the Great Formation is activated to enter the medicine warehouse: what time, who initiated the Great Formation, what ingredients they took."
"According to the tally, there were sixteen activations of the Great Formation within these two months: eight instances by Senior Sister Bai, six by Elder Mei, and two by Elder Miao."
"And an Array Method expert Elder conducted a detailed inspection of the medicine warehouse formation activation records, finding a total of seventeen activations of the Great Formation, which is one more than recorded!"
"This time, it must have been the thief who opened it!"
"Master conducted a detailed investigation into what those three did that day."
Lan Ting struggled to pull out two spirit fruits, one red and one blue, from the fruit plate in the middle of the table, to represent the suspects. Understanding the situation, Lu Yang handed over the half-eaten spirit fruit to Lan Ting, so she didn't have to struggle to pull out a third spirit fruit.
Lan Ting arranged the two whole spirit fruits and the half spirit fruit in a row.
She pushed the red spirit fruit forward, "Elder Miao is adept at the Cloning Technique, so skilled that her peers cannot discern the real from the fake."
"Originally, after her retirement, she wandered the lands seeking a breakthrough opportunity, but coincidentally, she returned to the sect a month and a half ago, allegedly because she had accumulated a huge debt and came back to borrow money. However, no one knows exactly how much spirit stone she owed or if she borrowed enough."
"On the day of the incident, Elder Miao was catching up with another retired elder and never left her abode."
Lan Ting pushed the blue spirit fruit forward a bit, "As the current manager of the Elixir Brewing Chamber, Elder Mei is always busy. On the day of the incident, she was no exception. She said she stayed in her room the whole time, pondering over new pill formulas and what this year's mooncake shapes would be like.
She only left the room twice to walk outside and seek inspiration, but nobody saw her outside the Elixir Brewing Chamber."
The remaining half spirit fruit naturally represented Senior Sister Bai: "That day, Senior Sister Bai was brewing elixirs, and three junior sisters saw her through the window paper of the Elixir Brewing Chamber."
"The elixir Senior Sister Bai was brewing is called the Nine-Heart Lotus Pill, which requires an entire day to refine and during which she cannot be distracted, not to mention leaving the pill furnace is out of the question."
"The Nine-Heart Lotus Pill is an elixir of considerable difficulty to brew, and even Senior Sister Bai only has a ten percent chance of success. That day, her condition was very good, and she managed to produce it, later showing off to several senior and junior sisters."
"In the process of investigation, another fact was uncovered; a week before the ingredients disappeared, Senior Sister Bai had a big argument with Elder Mei.
Senior Sister Bai had applied for three precious ingredients to refine elixirs and improve her pill brewing skills, but Elder Mei thought she wasn't skilled enough and that she would surely fail, so she didn't approve Senior Sister Bai's application."
"Coincidentally, these three precious ingredients are on the list of stolen elixirs."
After listening, Lu Yang revealed a thoughtful look, carefully realizing that all three had no alibis.
Elder Miao specializes in the Cloning Technique, which is hard to discern as true or false, and might have used another elder as an alibi.
Elder Mei claimed to have left the room and went outside in search of inspiration, but there were no eyewitnesses.
Senior Sister Bai couldn't afford to be distracted while brewing the elixir, but the three eyewitness junior sisters had only seen through the window paper; the figure they saw might not have been Senior Sister Bai.
Moreover, they all had motives for the crime.
Lu Yang bowed his head, his lips curling into a smile brimming with intriguing possibilities.
This is what is called 'darkness under the lamp,' isn't it?
"Elder Brother, have you thought of something?" Lan Ting saw Lu Yang like this and was sure he had discovered a clue!
"Little Lan, I know who the thief is."
"Although these three all seem suspicious, in fact, they are not. Since all three have records of entering the Medicine Warehouse, they could have taken the ingredients they wanted while accessing the warehouse; there was no need for a seventeenth entry into the Great Formation, leaving a trace!"
"The only explanation is that it was none of these three!"
"Junior Sister Lan, you just mentioned that as the former Palace Master, Qu Ling knew how to unlock the Medicine Warehouse Formation, doesn't that suggest that the current Palace Master would also know how to unlock the Great Formation?"
Lu Yang looked pained. Although the answer was unfortunate for Junior Sister Lan, it was the truth, the harsh reality Junior Sister Lan had to confront!
"Therefore, the answer is obvious, the perpetrator is just..."
Before Lu Yang could finish speaking, he heard Fairy Eternity in the Spiritual Space reveal through Immortal Sense an astonishing scene: "Eh, why is the little girl Bai Ye tampering with the Laurel Tree?"

chapters.title: Chapter 948 - 947: Simple Reasoning Often Only Requires Immortal Sense
chapters.content:
After absorbing the lesson that as Lu Yang, he had inquired about the culprit without knowing who it was himself, Fairy Eternity meticulously scanned the Fairy Palace with her Immortal Sense at all times, vowing to find the offender and restore her reputation.
Fortunately, she had finally found a clue.
"It's true — as long as I, Yellow Bean, take charge, there's no case that can't be cracked!"
"Who? Bai Ye?"
Lu Yang couldn't utter the words "Palace Master Luo" after being caught off guard by Fairy Eternity's sudden interjection.
"Next time, Fairy, can you tell us what you see earlier!" Lu Yang found it hard to believe that Fairy hadn't noticed any signs before Bai Ye drugged the laurel tree.
And even if it was Bai Ye, how did she break the Medicine Warehouse Formation?
"Isn't it about capturing the thief along with the loot? I just had my suspicions earlier. What if I wrongly accused that girl?" Fairy Eternity, after studying law for so long with Lu Yang, had developed a good legal mind.
"Senior Brother? Elder Brother Lu Yang?" Lan Ting realized Elder Brother Lu Yang had stopped analyzing halfway and suddenly fell silent, quite puzzled, waving her delicate little hand in front of Lu Yang until she finally snapped him back to attention.
Lu Yang realized he was in the middle of analyzing the case, and this wasn't the time to quarrel with Fairy Eternity.
"Come on, let Immortal take charge!" Fairy Eternity felt that since she had uncovered the truth, she should be the one to reveal the answer!
Lu Yang was no match for Immortal Fairy Eternity, who possessed him in an instant.
Fairy Eternity looked like she had just woken from a dream: "Ah, I'm here, I'm here, where did we leave off just now?"
"You were saying 'the perpetrator is indeed Luo…', and then you stopped talking."
Lan Ting gave Lu Yang an odd look but hid it very well.
Why does it feel like Senior Brother has transformed into someone else?
Having extensive experience in possessing others and impersonating Lu Yang in the Imperial City, Fairy Eternity now imitated Lu Yang to perfection, not even referring to herself as "Immortal" anymore.
"I was saying that the frail-looking Bai Ye is the perpetrator!"
Fairy Eternity said with conviction, "The perpetrator often returns to the scene of the crime. If I'm not wrong, she is currently at the twelfth row, thirtieth laurel tree in the Laurel Forest!"
Lan Ting was completely baffled, wondering how Elder Brother Lu Yang had deduced such an exact location — had she missed a step in his reasoning?
She really couldn't keep up with Elder Brother Lu Yang's thought process, could she?
And most importantly...
"Who is Bai Ye?"
She had never heard of such a person in the Fairy Palace.
"You don't know her? She comes here every night to listen to stories," said Fairy Eternity, her tone a bit resentful.
If it hadn't been for Bai Ye occupying Lu Yang's nighttime hours, Lu Yang could have spent the whole night playing snowball fights with her.
"She comes to your place every night to listen to stories?" Lan Ting was even more shocked. Who would forgo cultivation to secretly steal the chance to listen to stories at Senior Brother's side every night?
"Wait a minute, wait a minute. How come Junior Sister Lan Ting has never heard of Junior Sister Bai Ye?" Spiritual Space Lu Yang couldn't help but ask.
This made it seem as if he had been telling stories every night to someone who didn't exist, which was quite eerie.
"An avatar of the Laurel Tree Ancestor or something like that is probably a secret in the Fairy Palace; it's normal that the girl Lan Ting hasn't heard of her," Fairy Eternity revealed Bai Ye's identity nonchalantly, as if the Laurel Tree Ancestor were some trivial character not worth mentioning.
"Laurel Tree Ancestor?!" Lu Yang was taken aback.
He suddenly remembered that Bai Ye had given him a pack of laurel flowers to eat for fun. Could they have been plucked from her own body?
Fairy Eternity paid no mind to Lu Yang's surprise for the moment; she was the only person in the Fairy Palace who knew the truth and felt her intelligence had reached an extraordinary realm. She was determined to catch Bai Ye in one fell swoop.
"Never mind that for now. Let's go chase Bai Ye!"
Fairy Eternity waved her hand grandly, leading Lan Ting on a brisk run to Luo Hongxia's Abode.
Little Yang had lost all his powers and wouldn't be able to catch Bai Ye even if they found her; they needed Luo Hongxia, the former failure, to help.
However, come to think of it, even if Little Yang retained his realm, he still couldn't catch up to Bai Ye.
At this moment, Luo Hongxia was also contemplating in front of three Spirit Fruits, trying to figure out which one contained the stolen medicinal ingredients.
She heard a knock on the door, and when she opened it, there was no one there.
"Over here, here."
Luo Hongxia looked down and saw two tiny figures.
"Master, Elder Brother Lu Yang has deduced who the perpetrator is. It's a little girl named Bai Ye, about as tall as me, and she's in the Laurel Forest!"
"Who is Bai Ye?" Luo Hongxia had not heard this name before.
However, she quickly grew serious. Now was not the time to study who Bai Ye was. Since they had a lead on the culprit, capturing Bai Ye in the Laurel Forest was the most important thing!
"Let's go!"
Luo Hongxia soared into the air, only to realize two people were missing by her side. Looking down, she saw the two tiny figures running hard towards the Laurel Forest.
Luo Hongxia landed, scooped up one under each arm, and sped off again towards the Laurel Forest.
"Let's go!"
Luo Hongxia, carrying the two burdens, moved just as fast as usual. She also thoughtfully applied a transparent protective shield to them, to prevent the cold wind from rushing in and harming their bodies.
As she flew over the Laurel Forest, she indeed spotted a delicate figure pouring something at the base of a Laurel Tree, muttering under her breath.
"Thief, take this!"
Luo Hongxia dropped the two tiny figures and made her move without hesitation.
Due to the protective shield, they bounced a couple of times on the ground before landing safely, unscared.
The delicate figure, seeing Luo Hongxia attack, cursed softly at the untimely interruption, engrossed as she was in her experiments with the Laurel Tree and unalert to Luo Hongxia's approach.
Seemingly not intent on fighting, the delicate figure turned and ran, her speed so fast that she left an Illusory Shadow in place, and her true form was nowhere to be found in an instant.
Even with Luo Hongxia's keen eyes, she couldn't keep up with the delicate figure's tracks!
Luo Hongxia opened her Spiritual Sense to search, but found nothing.
She thought back to the fleeting glimpse of the figure's face and frowned deeply.
"An unfamiliar face, could it be an outsider?"
…
"That was close, almost caught by Little Luo," the delicate figure gasped for breath against the Laurel Tree Ancestor, still baffled how Luo Hongxia had found her.
It was as if she knew exactly where she was, her target crystal clear.
"Hehe, trying to run? Can you really escape?" A childish laugh came from behind the delicate figure, startling her into spinning around.
"Who's there!"
She was sure that with her Spiritual Sense open, she would have noticed anyone approaching her.
And how did the other person know she was here?
"Lu Yang?" the delicate figure exclaimed in surprise. Why was it Lu Yang?
"Bai Ye girl, come back with me and admit your mistake," Fairy Eternity said with a triumphant laugh. No matter how fast Bai Ye moved, could she be faster than her Immortal Sense?
Captured with the evidence, a great achievement!
The delicate figure snorted coldly, "I am not Bai Ye, I am Bai Ri."
In the Spiritual Space, Lu Yang vaguely remembered hearing this name somewhere and was suddenly startled.
"Bai Ri… Why do I remember that the founder of the Fairy Palace, Chasing Moon True Person, was called Bai Ri?"

chapters.title: Chapter 949 - 948 Chasing Moon True Person
chapters.content:
Chasing Moon True Person, Bai Ri, the founder of the Laurel Fairy Palace, was active from the last period of Great Qian to the beginning of the Great Xia period. Legend has it that she was gracefully enchanting, transcending ordinary beauty, resembling a fairy, which left countless heroes of the era intoxicated and obsessed.
Lu Yang pulled his attention back from his memory and looked through his spiritual space at the girl named "Bai Ri," who was said to be Bai Ye's younger self, about ten years old and not much taller than his current diminutive stature.
She was lovely, yes, but was there not quite a gap between that and "gracefully enchanting"?
"Aren't you the Laurel Tree Ancestor? How did you become Chasing Moon True Person?" Fairy Eternity wondered, feeling that there had always been more to Bai Ye than her being the Laurel Tree Ancestor. Now, this question confirmed there was an issue.
Bai Ri blinked in surprise: "How do you know about the Laurel Tree Ancestor?"
She was sure she hadn't told anyone about it.
"You first tell me what's going on with this body of yours." Fairy Eternity wasn't about to naively answer any question thrown at her; this was called an exchange of information.
"If you can catch me, I'll tell you," Bai Ri said, the corner of her mouth curving into a smirk. This little guy called Lu Yang was really interesting; no wonder Bai Ye looked for him every night to hear his stories.
As her voice fell, Bai Ri disappeared instantly into the vast snow, leaving no trace to follow. All that could be seen were the expansive laurel forests.
Given Bai Ri's high cultivation level, it would be impossible for Lu Yang to even touch the hem of her clothes, even if he were not a child, but at his full strength.
Unfortunately, the Lu Yang of now was not the real Lu Yang.
"Run away under my watch, will you!" Full of fighting spirit, Fairy Eternity, with her exquisite deductions, had already unmasked the true culprit, and only the final capture remained.
Fairy Eternity ran with determination, her little arms swinging, her gaze steady, and her target clear.
Huff—huff—
Fairy Eternity's breathing was exceedingly regular, containing some strange power that made Lu Yang extremely curious.
In the oldest of legends, the earliest stage of Qi Refiners was known to use a Breathing Technique, a method of cultivation that drew on a special way of breathing to produce incredible mysteries, truly beyond belief.
Lu Yang carefully examined his body's condition and was amazed to find that using the Breathing Technique could actually prevent the cold wind from penetrating his mouth and nose!
What a formidable Breathing Technique!
"He shouldn't be able to find me here," Bai Ri thought as she ran into a corner of the Fairy Palace, which was vast and sparsely populated, this corner even more so, being a place where decades could pass without anyone passing through. It was absolutely safe.
Bai Ri found that dealing with Lu Yang was somewhat troublesome; there was no deep hatred between them, giving her no good reason to harm him.
If she couldn't bring herself to strike, then running was the only option.
"How did he manage to find me before?"
"That's it—when I hid near the Tree Ancestor before, he must have noticed some connection between me and the Tree Ancestor; he went to try his luck there."
"Such a troublesome kid, no wonder he's experienced so much for his age."
Three hours later, a familiar voice reached her.
"Found you, stop running!"
Fairy Eternity was seen skiing on skis made from laurel trees, with a basket of spirit fruit on her back, snacking on the fruit for energy when tired from skiing.
From the laurel forest to the corner of the Fairy Palace, Fairy Eternity had skied for three hours!
Without the skis, it would have taken even longer!
```
Fairy Eternity, who had schemed through the ages, even knew that the shortest distance between two points was a straight line. To take the shortest route to find Bai Ri, she skied, overcoming obstacles along the way, and passed through the Elixir Brewing Chamber, Refinement Chamber, and hot springs among other places.
Her movements were graceful, and her skiing expert; one could tell she was a seasoned practitioner at a glance.
Along the way, she also encountered many eyewitnesses. However, the disciples of the Fairy Palace all thought that Lu Yang was simply skiing for pleasure, unaware that she was actually in pursuit of a criminal.
"No way, since when could you ski?"
"Hmph, I bet you didn't see that coming. I had foreseen today's event back in Ancient Times and preemptively practiced the art of skiing while in a mortal body," Fairy Eternity bragged without shame.
"How in the world did you find me!" Bai Ri was as shocked as if he had seen a ghost. Did he leave some scent on himself that allowed Lu Yang to track his location, or was it that anyone who heard a story told by Lu Yang ended up being marked by her?
Just as Bai Ri thought about continuing his escape, suddenly his legs gave out, rendering him powerless.
This is bad, night has fallen.
"Yawn... What brought me here today?" "Bai Ri," looking puzzled, sat on the ground, wondering why he was in a corner of the Fairy Palace where there was nothing of interest.
At the same time, he saw Fairy Eternity skiing towards him.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang!" "Bai Ri" waved excitedly at Fairy Eternity.
Fairy Eternity executed a beautiful turning stop, kicking up a wave of snow taller than a person, stopping in front of "Bai Ri."
"You're Bai Ye now, aren't you?"
"You know everything, Elder Brother Lu Yang?" Bai Ye's mouth opened wide, expressing her surprise.
Fairy Eternity laughed. She had witnessed the transformation from "Bai Ri" to "Bai Ye" with her own eyes and finally understood what was going on.
"Dual souls in a single body, alternating between Yin and Yang, with the dominant soul switching at the time of transition, am I right?"
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, you know so much," Bai Ye said, more surprised, feeling that Lu Yang knew even more than she did.
"Of course, who do you think I, I mean, who I am!"
"Little Ye, wait a moment, I want to talk to Elder Brother Lu Yang for a bit," Bai Ri momentarily took over control of the body.
Bai Ri sighed. With matters having progressed to this point, there was no sense in hiding any longer. It was better to tell Lu Yang everything, so he would stop persistently chasing after her.
"I really don't know what's up with you, knowing even about something like dual souls."
"Your guess is correct, I am me, Little Ye is Little Ye, we just share the same body. During the day, I use this body, while at night, it's her turn."
"Little Ye's true form is the Laurel Tree Ancestor. The Tree Ancestor has rooted itself in the Great Snow Mountain and cannot leave its territory or the mountain. Therefore, she has always longed for the world outside."
"She would often eavesdrop on the disciples of the Fairy Palace recounting their mission outside, and when she saw your story in the report from Lan Ting, she hoped to meet you in person one day."
"After the 'Legend of the Dao Sect' reached the Fairy Palace, Little Ye's desire to meet you intensified."
"As luck would have it, you arrived, and she would sneak over to your place every night to listen to stories—naturally, I was listening in as well."
"To tell the truth, I wasn't very keen on having you come to the Fairy Palace. Before Little Ye heard of you, she always listened to my stories about how I fought alongside Jiang Pingan and Meng Junzi, about how we established Great Xia."
"Since your arrival, all of Little Ye's attention has shifted onto you."
Bai Ri sighed again, his gaze at Lu Yang carrying an indescribable strangeness: "As much as I hate to admit it, your experiences over the past few years have indeed been far more outlandish than mine."
```

chapters.title: Chapter 950 - 949: Truthfully Explain
chapters.content:
Chasing Moon True Person would reflect on his life with a sense of fulfillment, having seen the Great Yu Late Period consumed by warlords carving out their territories, seen the demise of Great Yu and the ensuing struggle for dominance, lived through an era rife with Pass Tribulation battles and Semi-Immortal battles, crossed swords with Meng Junzi, aided Jiang Pingan in establishing Great Xia, and founded the Five Great Immortal Sects with several fellow Daoists.
These events would be passed down and adapted by later generations, turning into the popular storytelling saga "Tales of Great Xia Heroes."
But when compared to Lu Yang's experiences, they somehow seemed to fall short.
Lu Yang thought to himself that this was only the tip of the iceberg; he had only told the abridged version. He hadn't even spoken of reviving Fairy Eternity, the various insider details of battles between Half-Immortals and Immortals, meeting Ashy Bean, or overturning Great Xia to establish the Great Bean Dynasty.
"Don't drift too far off the topic. Just honestly tell us why you drugged the laurel tree," Fairy Eternity was quite dissatisfied with the adjectives Chasing Moon True Person used to describe Xiao Yang's experiences of these past years.
How could it be called outrageous, as it was clearly a life lived to the fullest. She quite admired Little Yang's life experiences, full of surprises and challenges.
Chasing Moon True Person had already planned to manifest himself and clarify the situation.
"To explain this matter, we have to start from the day Little Ye came into spiritual wisdom," he said.
"Little Ye's true form is known to the world as the Laurel Tree Ancestor, an ancient laurel tree that has survived to the present day, with a lifespan of at least three hundred thousand years. After periods of time's cleansing, it developed consciousness and later on, attained spiritual intellect and became a true being."
Fairy Eternity nodded, understanding that this was the process through which a Spiritual Plant gains spiritual wisdom—there are no shortcuts, only the passage of immense time.
If it really was an ancient laurel tree that survived until now, then it was indeed possible it belonged to the Ying Tian Immortal Seed.
"My name is Bai Ri, and Little Ye took my surname, Bai. She is fond of the Power of Taiyin and prefers to be active at night, so she named herself Bai Ye."
"Little Ye wasn't too fond of using the body of the Tree Ancestor, deeming it too boring to stand still all day, so I searched ancient texts and found the Spiritual Plant Clone Technique. This allowed her to split a physical form from the Tree Ancestor—one that is in its current form."
"Then, after a few hundred more years, an irregularity occurred in my cultivation, resulting in my physical form burning to ashes and my soul sustaining damage. The soul was so severely wounded that no Spirit Pills or miraculous medicines were of any help, and my condition was dire."
"Fortunately, the laurel tree is naturally Yin-natured, possessing the capability to nourish the soul, a quality that originally resided foremost within the scholar tree. As the Laurel Tree Ancestor, Little Ye's soul-nourishing ability was unmatched."
"She found out there was a problem with my cultivation and hurriedly transferred my soul into this clone. At the time, my mind was not clear; I had no idea what Little Ye was doing, feeling only warmth surrounding me, nourishing my soul. Instinctively, I accepted this strength."
"Nourishing the soul is usually a slow process, but the soul-nourishing power of the Laurel Tree Ancestor was so strong, and my own survival instinct so vehement, that the combination sped up the process exponentially. In the end, my soul intertwined too deeply with this clone, making it impossible to separate them."
"Although my soul had returned to its original state, I could no longer part with this clone."
"However, to have survived such a life-threatening crisis using this clone isn't so bad. Guarding the Laurel Fairy Palace, secretly watching the disciples grow, visiting the Scripture Pavilion to read every day—and I've also come to quite like the laurel tree."
Had Chasing Moon True Person not truly liked the laurel tree, he wouldn't have chosen to establish a Daoist practice ground in the harsh environment of Great Snow Mountain.
"Little Ye has become used to this clone and started mixing with me in using it, only leaving instinctive reactions in the true form of the Tree Ancestor."
"Later, we discovered that whoever's soul had greater strength would take the initiative of the body. It's an involuntary thing, neither of us could control."
"Little Ye's soul's strength varies with day and night; Sun Power weakens her soul power, causing the body to be under my control. She would either sleep in her true form or in this body until night comes, when the Power of Taiyin becomes abundant and Little Ye's soul power increases, making it her turn to use this body."
"This clone is strong, and constantly supplied with spiritual essence from the Tree Ancestor, its recovery power is also strong. There are only two unresolved issues—one being what I mentioned earlier, that the clone cannot leave the territory of the Tree Ancestor, and the other, that it doesn't quite suit my image."
Chasing Moon True Person sighed, recalling the good old days, "In my prime, I was incomparable in beauty, captivating the world, with countless people falling over themselves for my charm."
"But looking at Little Ye's clone, it's just too short, utterly lacking in allure, making me too embarrassed to meet anyone."
"I thought to myself if only this clone could grow taller, even if just during the daytime."
"Unfortunately, the form of this clone is hard to change, to alter its appearance one must find an alternative path."
"Essentially, this clone is a Laurel Tree, so I thought about whether I could come up with a potion that could make the Laurel Tree grow quickly."
"Then I took several herbs from the medicine store, brewed them into medicinal soups of different proportions, and poured them on the roots of the Laurel Tree to see which mixture could speed up its growth."
"You see, Great Snow Mountain is full of Laurel Trees, and I figured experimenting on a few wouldn't matter, who knew there would be those who pick petals to make Laurel Flower fillings and others who chop down the trees for barbecues."
Chasing Moon True Person was too ashamed to meet anyone, and naturally, his experiments on making the Laurel Tree grow taller were something he'd hide if he could.
But one can never count on luck to keep things under wraps.
Lu Yang listened quietly to the story, completely understanding Chasing Moon True Person's thoughts, as he too had been wishing to grow taller during the days he had been shrunk.
"Done confessing? Once you're done, come back with me to face your punishment," said Fairy Eternity, not swayed by Chasing Moon True Person's flowery rhetoric, clearly remembering that she was there to capture a criminal.
...
"Odd, where has that kid Lu Yang gone to?" murmured Luo Hongxia. The last time anyone saw Lu Yang, he was at a group of Disciple of the Immortal Palace taking a bath in a hot spring.
According to them, Lu Yang was last seen snowboarding with a basket of Spirit Fruits on his back, his face beaming with an excited smile, and then he was never seen again.
Nor could anyone find Bai Ye's whereabouts.
"Palace Master Luo, open up."
Luo Hongxia heard Lu Yang's voice, opened the door, and saw Lu Yang grinning from ear to ear, holding Bai Ye's hand as if afraid she'd run away.
"Palace Master Luo, I've captured the criminal!" Fairy Eternity raised the joined hands and handed Bai Ye over to Luo Hongxia.
"How did you capture her?" Luo Hongxia was astonished. She hadn't been able to catch Bai Ye; how had Lu Yang managed it?
"What's there to it? She even honestly confessed her entire deeds," at that moment, Fairy Eternity felt a sense of accomplishment, as if her mission was fulfilled and she could retire with honors.
"Tell me what happened?" Luo Hongxia asked eagerly.
"So here's what happened..." Fairy Eternity repeated the story as told by Chasing Moon True Person, leaving Luo Hongxia dumbfounded.
"In short, your ancestor Chasing Moon True Person, in his quest to grow taller, stole medicinal materials. I'm not too familiar with the sentencing guidelines, and you Immortal Palace folks are well-versed in the law, how many years should this warrant?"

chapters.title: Chapter 951 - 950: Ignorance of the Law is No Excuse for Breaking It
chapters.content:
"Wait, wait, wait, you're saying she is Chasing Moon True Person, the founder of our Fairy Palace?" Luo Hongxia covered her head, absorbing the flood of information coming in.
"Yes."
"And it was she who stole the herbs?"
"Yes."
"Then you spent an entire day, and finally caught her?"
"Yes."
Fairy Eternity nodded vigorously, her big watery eyes looking up at Luo Hongxia, shining as if they were illuminated.
"So what sentence is your Fairy Palace planning to give her?"
Luo Hongxia's mind couldn't keep up, the situation was developing too fast. How had Chasing Moon True Person, the esteemed ancestor, suddenly turned into a criminal facing sentencing?
Conflicted, puzzled, and perplexed... all these feelings were evident on Luo Hongxia's face.
Seeing Luo Hongxia so confused, Fairy Eternity, being perceptive, quickly figured out where the difficulty lay and said in an understanding tone:
"The principle of avoidance, right? I understand that. If Palace Master Luo feels it's difficult, you can imprison her in our Seek Dao Sect!"
In the Spiritual Space, Lu Yang, who was watching the commotion, suddenly coughed loudly.
"Fairy, that's really not a good idea," Lu Yang quickly dissuaded her.
"Is there a problem?" Fairy Eternity felt her idea was flawless.
"Fairy, you've forgotten, Chasing Moon True Person cannot be separated from this clone, and this clone cannot leave the territory of Bai Ye," Lu Yang reminded her.
Fairy Eternity had obviously thought of this issue beforehand: "Hey, I thought it was a big deal. Just move the Laurel Tree Ancestor to our Seek Dao Sect too. Our Sect has plenty of space."
Before Lu Yang could speak again, she anticipated his concern: "Oh, you're going to say that the Laurel Tree will die if it leaves the Great Snow Mountain, right? That's a minor issue. Just move the Great Snow Mountain to our Seek Dao Sect too. Our Sect has plenty of space."
In the blink of an eye, Fairy Eternity had already incorporated the Laurel Fairy Palace into the Seek Dao Sect.
"...I think the problem isn't whether our Sect has space or not."
Lu Yang was worried about Elder Brother Dai's heart and whether he himself would get beaten up upon returning.
He swore on his conscience, this really had nothing to do with him; it was all Fairy Eternity's doing.
"Are you going to arrest me?" Bai Ye asked.
With the arrival of nightfall, Bai Ye gained control of the body, while Chasing Moon True Person could only appear during the day.
In fact, it was Bai Ye who had carried Fairy Eternity over to Luo Hongxia's Abode.
From Fairy Eternity's account, Luo Hongxia had learned of Bai Ye's identity and suddenly realized she had been so shocked by the identities of Chasing Moon True Person and Bai Ye that she had forgotten her manners.
"I've seen the Tree Ancestor."
"Just call me Bai Ye."
"I've seen Tree Ancestor Bai Ye."
Bai Ye had not been appearing in public precisely because people were too reserved upon seeing her.
Lu Yang was great, even after learning her identity, he did not act reserved.
"If you want to see Ah Ri, you'll have to wait until morning."
Bai Ye turned her arm into wood and then it grew, extended, taking on the shape of a small stool. Then, with a chop of her left hand, she cut off the small stool, and her arm returned to its original form.
Lu Yang watched in amazement, so Bai Ye was the one who brought that small stool every night to my place, and it was actually created by her.
Sitting on the small stool, Bai Ye turned excitedly to Fairy Eternity: "Elder Brother Lu Yang, keep telling the story, you were about to talk about entering the Imperial City."
Telling stories wasn't Fairy Eternity's forte. Knowing this, she gracefully gave the body back to Lu Yang.
"After the trip to the East Sea, Old Meng dragged me to the Imperial City..."
Luo Hongxia was also very interested in Lu Yang's experiences, rather than waiting idly until dawn, she preferred to listen to Lu Yang's story.
"So, I exposed the Fourth Prince for rebellion, and he was locked up..."
"Later, the Third Prince got locked up too..."
"For stealing the throne, Emperor Xia and I almost ended up locked up as well..."
Listening to this, Luo Hongxia's eyelids twitched.
With Lu Yang telling stories, the night quickly passed by.
As the days and nights changed, the moon gradually ignited with flames, marking the arrival of early morning.
"Little Ye, let me borrow your body."
Although the appearance didn't change with the identity switch, the gaze of Chasing Moon True Person was clearly sharper and lacked the naivety and ignorance of Bai Ye.
"Greetings, Chasing Moon True Person."
Even though she already knew who she was facing was Chasing Moon True Person, Luo Hongxia still found it difficult to connect the otherworldly beauty in the portraits with this little figure.
"Little Luo, right? The formalities are rules set by Jiang Pingan and the others in their courts; we in the Fairy Palace do not need to follow so many rules."
"Yes."
"About you going into the medicine storehouse and stealing herbs..."
"How can it be called stealing? I founded this Fairy Palace, so naturally, the herbs are also mine."
"It's true that you founded the Fairy Palace, but as you passed on the title of Palace Master to True Person Jingchuan, you also transferred the ownership of the Fairy Palace. After him, it passed to the third and fourth Palace Masters... all the way down to my generation."
"So strictly speaking, all the property rights of everything in the Fairy Palace are with me. Your unauthorized use of the herbs could be seen as an unauthorized transfer of property rights, indeed constituting the crime of theft."
"I... I am the founder of the Fairy Palace!" declared Chasing Moon True Person, too weak to argue.
Fairy Eternity understood Chasing Moon True Person's implication and once again possessed Lu Yang: "You mean to say, according to the criminal law, humans over seventy-five years old can be exempt from prison, and cultivators are to refer to this regulation, right?"
"You don't look like someone who's a hundred thousand years old. You must have frozen yourself at some point. How old are you this year? Do you reach seventy-five thousand?"
"Stop, stop, I'll go to jail."
"Actually, you don't have to go to jail for your theft," Luo Hongxia kindly reminded.
"As long as you make restitution to the Fairy Palace and obtain its forgiveness, you could be sentenced with probation or even exempted from criminal punishment."
Chasing Moon True Person was overjoyed; I knew you were on my side, Little Luo.
Compensating the Fairy Palace and obtaining its forgiveness were both easy tasks.
"However, your action of drugging the Laurel Tree, causing serious hazardous consequences, constitutes the crime of releasing dangerous substances."
"Considering multiple offenses, you're unlikely to get probation," she added.
"I..." For the first time, Chasing Moon True Person faced the disadvantage of not understanding the law.
Fairy Eternity kindly reminded, "Ignorance of the law is no excuse."
Then Luo Hongxia turned to Fairy Eternity: "Lu Yang, although your intrusion into the hot spring doesn't constitute a crime, it disrupted public order, which is an administrative case, and you'll need to be detained for a few days."
Luo Hongxia had been looking for Lu Yang precisely for that reason.
"I was pursuing someone at the time."
"But the situation wasn't so urgent that you couldn't have gone around the hot spring."
"I..." Fairy Eternity found that knowing the law wasn't helpful, either.
Lu Yang held his forehead; he knew the matter would come to this—it's all part of experiencing life.
"Don't worry, Little Yang; how could I let you rot in jail? This matter has nothing to do with you," Fairy Eternity said with a sense of responsibility.
Lu Yang was surprised: "Fairy, what do you mean to do?"
"I'll possess you for a few days and serve the jail time for you."

chapters.title: Chapter 952 - 952: 951
chapters.content:
Lu Yang felt, does it make any difference which of us sits in prison? Fairy, if you take my place, wouldn't I still be in the spiritual space, as if confining you there meant I wasn't at the Sinners' Hall all the same?
Fairy Eternity's philosophy of one person committing the deed, one person bearing the responsibility, is indeed rare.
Though it's not very useful.
But it is indeed very precious.
"Do I also need to be locked up?" Bai Ye replaced Daoist Zhui Yue.
"When night falls, Tree Ancestor, you can just come out," Luo Hongxia said. Bai Ye hadn't done anything, so how could he be imprisoned?
"Oh, alright then." Bai Ye shrank back, handing control of the body over to Chasing Moon True Person.
"Tree Ancestor, don't go; there is another matter for which we need the Tree Ancestor's consent," Luo Hongxia called out to stop the Tree Ancestor.
"What's the matter?"
"Previously, we at the Immortal Palace did not know that you had spiritual wisdom and continued to cut down and sell laurel trees without seeking the Tree Ancestor's consent, for which we feel ashamed. These laurel trees are yours, and the spirit stones obtained from selling the laurel trees should rightfully belong to you.
Please inform us when you first gained spiritual wisdom so the Immortal Palace can calculate and return the spirit stones to you."
Bai Ye found Luo Hongxia's meaning a bit hard to grasp, but he roughly understood that they were intending to give him spirit stones.
"I have no use for spirit stones, keep them for yourselves, and with regards to cutting and selling the trees, just carry on as usual."
"The Tree Ancestor is benevolent and righteous," Luo Hongxia bowed in respect.
When the Great Snow Mountain Laurel Tree Ancestor acquired spiritual wisdom and became "human," ownership of the Great Snow Mountain Laurel Tree transferred to Bai Ye. At the time, the Immortal Palace was unaware of Bai Ye's existence, so the cutting and selling of laurel trees did not constitute a crime as there was no intent to commit a wrongful act.
Now that the Immortal Palace is aware of Bai Ye's existence, they cannot cut and sell laurel trees without Bai Ye's consent.
...
Sinners' Hall.
"Palace Master, what brings you here?" Elder Morran, clad in a lotus black dress, was quite surprised.
What surprised her even more was that Luo Hongxia had brought two children with her.
"You have children?"
As the custodian responsible for overseeing the Sinners' Hall, Elder Morran rarely had the chance to leave and was unaware of what was happening in the outside world.
She immediately fantasized about Luo Hongxia and Daoist Buyu having a secret romance, with Daoist Buyu having many enemies and being unable to publicly disclose their love, leading to their clandestine meetings and even having two children in secret.
With Daoist Buyu reaching the Transcendance Tribulation Stage and no longer fearing his enemies, Luo Hongxia finally dared to make their relationship public and began introducing the children to others...
Luo Hongxia's brow twitched, feeling that Junior Sister Morran's gaze was a bit odd.
Junior Sister Morran always had a vivid imagination; there was no telling what she was conjuring up in her mind now.
"There was a recent mishap where all the disciples of the Immortal Palace were reduced in size, and Lu Yang was no exception. This little one is Lu Yang."
"That's amazing?"
"So did Lu Yang come to visit the Sinners' Hall as well?"
"He's preparing to stay for five days."
Elder Morran was taken aback, then understood Luo Hongxia's implication.
"You're really planning to follow in your master's footsteps and take a turn in our Sinners' Hall, huh?"
Lu Yang: "..."
Elder Morran, you must have some misunderstanding about me.
"And who is this?"
"This person's identity is not convenient to reveal. All you need to know is she committed the crime of theft and, due to special circumstances, stays in the Sinners' Hall during the day and may move freely at night."
Chasing Moon True Person, concerned about appearances, didn't want others to know she had become a little girl and hoped Luo Hongxia would keep it secret.
"Nepotism?" Elder Morran, who had been guarding Sinners' Hall for a thousand years, saw such a free prisoner for the first time.
Luo Hongxia: "..."
How should I put this, in a certain sense, it indeed counts as nepotism.
Usually, it was Elder Morran's job to lock people up, but since Luo Hongxia had come in person, Elder Morran couldn't be bothered to do it himself, thinking this important task should rather be done by the Palace Master herself.
No sooner had they entered the inner part of Sinners' Hall than they heard Qu Ling's voice, full of resentment, "My good disciple, I never thought you'd dare come here!"
"How dare you imprison your master, such an act of great disrespect and rebellion!"
"Shut up," Chasing Moon True Person reprimanded displeasedly, "Even I have to come here for my mistakes, what are you in comparison!"
Under normal circumstances, if anyone dared to speak to Qu Ling like this, she would have been furious, but for some reason, when rebuked by this little one, she instinctively felt a sense of fear and dared not lash out.
"Who are you?" Qu Ling looked at Chasing Moon True Person with astonishment and uncertainty, not understanding why she would be afraid of this little girl.
"You don't deserve to know."
"You!"
Luo Hongxia cast a glance at Qu Ling: "Seeing as you are my master, I advise you to show some respect to this person, or you will regret it later."
Qu Ling snorted coldly and said no more.
"Are you... Fellow Daoist Lu Yang?" Xue Shilou rubbed his eyes, thinking his recent bloodline awakening was causing his vision to fail.
Just a few days ago, Fellow Daoist Lu Yang was over a meter tall, now he was barely a meter.
Lu Yang inwardly cursed, realizing this mishap; he wanted to keep his shrinkage a secret, but now Xue Shilou, a stranger, was in on it.
Fairy Eternity made an effort to maintain Lu Yang's dignity in front of a stranger: "Ahem, I am practicing the Cultivation Technique of Eternal Life, and I encountered a minor issue during my practice. There are a few days each year when I become smaller. The outside is too dangerous, the enemies too many, so I've sought refuge in Sinners' Hall for some peace."
"So that's why," Xue Shilou suddenly realized, "Fellow Daoist Lu Yang, you must be more careful when practicing; that technique sounds terribly perilous."
"Really?" Xuanyuan Tianhen looked skeptical.
"Of course it's true," said Fairy Eternity nonchalantly, striving to appear like a Ministry of Justice Official inspecting the prison environment at the prison, but Lu Yang's small stature failed to convey that impression, no matter his expression or pose.
The culprits who had been imprisoned in Sinners' Hall for theft and whom Lu Yang had seen before were released upon completing their sentences, which conveniently freed up space for Chasing Moon True Person to reside here.
Fairy Eternity took the cell next to Chasing Moon True Person.
After making up her bed, Fairy Eternity jumped onto it with glee, feeling a strange sense of familiarity.
"It feels like I do this in my Spiritual Space, too."
"Not quite the same, the bed in the Spiritual Space is more comfortable."
Fairy Eternity closed her eyes, her consciousness returning to the Spiritual Space.
"Little Yang, come have a snowball fight."
Lu Yang sighed: "Fairy, it's like there's no difference for you between being imprisoned or not."
Previously, the complaint was that the cultivators imprisoned in Sinners' Hall were of too low a level; now, there was no shortage of high levels, with even an Immortal being present.
...
"Master, Lu Yang disappeared after passing by the hot springs, could something have happened?" Lan Ting hadn't seen Lu Yang for a whole day and night and was so worried that she asked Luo Hongxia.
"...Not exactly trouble, it's just that he is now residing in Sinners' Hall."
"What? That's not trouble?" Lan Ting soon understood; it was because of the hot springs incident.
She trusted that Elder Brother Lu Yang had his reasons for doing so.
"If you wish to see him, you can visit Sinners' Hall," Luo Hongxia thought this disciple was hopeless and decided to leave her directly to the Seek Dao Sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 953 - 953: 952
chapters.content:
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, are you doing well?" Lan Ting visited Lu Yang in the Sinners' Hall, carrying a basket full of Spirit Fruit.
"I'm fine, thank you for your concern, Junior Sister Lan." Fairy Eternity said with a smile, noting that the basket contained several types of Spirit Fruit that all tasted very good, clearly showing that Lan Ting had put in a lot of effort.
"Would you like some, too?" Fairy Eternity offered a piece to Chasing Moon True Person, the fellow prisoner living in the next cell.
Chasing Moon True Person did not refuse, thanked him, and began eating.
Fairy Eternity picked out a fruit that looked beautiful but unfamiliar from the basket and offered it to Lan Ting: "You should have some too, Junior Sister Lan."
The Spirit Fruit in the basket was divided into three parts by Fairy Eternity.
Eating was about ambiance, and Fairy Eternity was not used to eating alone – good food was meant to be shared, which reminded her of dining with Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi during Ancient Times.
The three of them sat together in a harmonious atmosphere.
Lan Ting looked curiously at Chasing Moon True Person: "Are you the Bai Ye mentioned by Elder Brother?"
Indeed, it was a face she didn't recognize, but since he knew the secrets of the Array Method and could enter the medicine storage, did that mean the other party was an ancestor from the Immortal Palace?
Lan Ting had also asked her master about this person called Bai Ye, but it seemed the master was reluctant to elaborate.
Chasing Moon True Person felt embarrassed to reveal his true identity, so he temporarily borrowed the name Bai Ye: "Yes, I am Bai Ye."
Chasing Moon True Person silently apologized to Bai Ye, as this was her first time lying in her life.
"By the way, Fairy, could you give some pointers on how Junior Sister Lan should cultivate her Immortal body?" Lu Yang asked, feeling he owed Lan Ting as she had been taking good care of him ever since he arrived at the Immortal Palace.
"Are you talking about her Primordial Immortal Body?"
"Yes."
"Hmm, alright." Fairy Eternity was somewhat reluctant, but since it was a request from Lu Yang, she would fulfill it if she could.
"Junior Sister Lan, how is your cultivation of the Primordial Immortal Body going?"
Lan Ting gave a wry smile: "Not to hide it from Elder Brother Lu Yang, I am somewhat puzzled. I originally planned to cultivate my Golden Core, Nascent Soul, and primordial spirit toward the Pure Yin direction, but my Golden Core and primordial spirit seem to have minds of their own, constantly absorbing Pure Yang Power, causing the contained Pure Yang Power to become increasingly concentrated."
"I've even tried to cleanse my primordial spirit with Pure Yin forces, but to no avail."
The Cultivation Techniques of the Immortal Palace were all Yin Attribute, but her Golden Core, Nascent Soul, and primordial spirit were all developing toward Yang Attributes, which made many of her Cultivation methods and combat techniques learned from other Sects, leaving her anxious and insecure.
She had asked many elders and combed through ancient texts to no avail; the Primordial Immortal Body was too rare, with no cultivation methods left behind.
Actually, Chasing Moon True Person valued Lan Ting quite highly and had also secretly searched for cultivation methods of the Primordial Immortal Body, yet found none.
"You need not be troubled, Junior Sister Lan, this is just part of the cultivation process for the Primordial Immortal Body," Fairy Eternity advised earnestly.
"What is Primordial? It is the chaos before differentiation, the unity of Yin and Yang. Although your Golden Core and primordial spirit are of Yang Attributes, you are of a Pure Yin body."
"As long as you cultivate step by step to the Body Integration Realm, where the primordial spirit merges with the body, everything will naturally fall into place, and the Primordial Immortal Body will be perfected."
"It's best to use your primordial spirit to absorb more Sun Power; it will be advantageous when you reach the Body Integration Realm."
"Really?" Lan Ting's eyes lit up as she heard this, dispelling the gloom that had long lingered in her heart.
"This is what I saw in the Immortal's Notes," Fairy Eternity thought to herself that if you asked where the Immortal's Notes were, then she could only write you a copy right there and then.
Lan Ting had no reason to doubt Lu Yang's words; her previous question was merely an instinctual reaction.
Lan Ting chatted with Fairy Eternity and Chasing Moon True Person for a while longer, then left contentedly.
"It seems you have a good relationship with Junior Sister Lan," Chasing Moon True Person commented with a smile, feeling that although Lu Yang was somewhat odd and secretive, he was essentially good-natured. If there was a chance, it might be possible to bring them together.
Following that, another disciple from the Immortal Palace visited Lu Yang, carrying a basket of fruit.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, are you alright?"
Lu Yang recognized the original form of this person, but now that she had shrunk, it was rather difficult to recognize her.
He remembered her name was He Miao, from the Refinement Chamber.
"Sister He, I'm fine, thank you for still thinking of your elder brother." With Lu Yang's cues, Fairy Eternity handled the situation with ease.
"It's good to hear that elder brother is fine," He Miao said, her cheeks flushed with embarrassment as she looked at Fairy Eternity.
He Miao was somewhat shy and didn't dare to talk too much with Lu Yang, and she quickly left.
"It seems you have a good relationship with He Miao," Chasing Moon True Person commented with a smile that looked somewhat unnatural.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, are you alright?"
Another Immortal Palace disciple came to visit Lu Yang, carrying a basket of fruit.
"Thank you, Senior Sister An, for your concern. This prison is a tranquil place, perfect for self-cultivation and character development—an opportunity in its own right," Fairy Eternity replied more adeptly.
"You have a good relationship with An Qiuxia too," Chasing Moon True Person's smile seemed to be pasted on his face, somewhat strained.
Junior Sister Xia Tang, Junior Sister Huang Shan, Senior Sister Bu Lianxin... Fairy Eternity's room was filled with baskets of fruit.
In the past, with Lan Ting blocking the way, disciples of the Immortal Palace were too shy to approach Lu Yang.
Now, with Lu Yang in Sinners' Hall, they could naturally visit him, increasing their chances of contact.
Chasing Moon True Person: "..."
Did you read the storybooks I put in the Scripture Pavilion for nothing? Is this kid Lu Yang really that outstanding? He has a slightly better background, higher talent, higher cultivation level, more fortuitous encounters, a better personality, and knows a bit more. Besides that, he's not much different from other cultivators.
"Would you like some more to eat?" Fairy Eternity saw Chasing Moon True Person looking at her with a resentful gaze, thinking he was eyeing her basket of fruit.
"I can't eat any more."
"Alright then," Fairy Eternity continued to eat on her own.
Fairy Eternity was picky, none of these Spirit Fruits caught her fancy, but since she had nothing else to do and so many fruits were lying around, she ended up eating a few bites unconsciously.
The other prisoners looked towards Fairy Eternity with envy and jealousy in their eyes.
Is this kid here for a holiday in Sinners' Hall?
"Fellow Daoist Lu Yang, I have some questions regarding Swordsmanship Cultivation, could you give me some guidance?" another neighbor from Xue Shilou asked.
Fairy Eternity thought for a moment; she was experienced in dealing with female cultivators, but not so much with Swordsmanship Cultivation: "Little Yang, this one is for you."
Lu Yang lived up to his reputation as the foremost among his peers in swordsmanship. With just a few pointers, he enlightened Xue Shilou on problems that had troubled him for years, giving him a glimpse of the path ahead, filling him with joy.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, will you tell a story tonight?" Bai Ye's voice came from behind them.
In the midst of teaching Xue Shilou, day had turned to night, and now it was Bai Ye taking control of the body.
Since Lu Yang was here, there was no need for her to go out and play.
"I'll tell it."
"Strange, why does it feel like I wasn't this busy outside, but I've become busier after coming to Sinners' Hall?" Lu Yang muttered to himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 954 - 954: 953 Bai Ye Takes Initiative
chapters.content:
```
The Sinners' Hall, which used to be cold and desolate, had recently become abnormally bustling. Lan Ting saw this with her own eyes and felt anxious in her heart, but she was helpless.
She had no reason to stop the Senior Sisters and Junior Sisters. It was perfectly legitimate for them to visit a guest.
Although their intentions were not purely out of visitation.
Fortunately, in the evening, the Senior and Junior Sisters knew their limits and would not return to disturb Lu Yang's rest, allowing Lan Ting to breathe a sigh of relief.
Even though Lu Yang still couldn't rest at night.
...
"Master, this is the current situation with Lu Yang," the shrunken Startling Swan said to the black ancient ring in her hand.
Not knowing what her master was wary of, she dared not probe with Spiritual Sense and could only report Lu Yang's performance in the Immortal Palace through words.
The consciousness within the Black Ancient Ring pondered for a moment and issued an old and sonorous voice, "It seems that this child has a special physique, naturally possessing the ability to attract women. Perhaps what he will form in the Golden Core Stage is the Harem Golden Core!"
"You must keep your distance from him, do not be influenced by his physique. Those who can form the Harem Golden Core are often rejected by heaven and earth, and their end is usually tragic."
"As you command."
Startling Swan touched the Black Ancient Ring and felt especially at ease.
This ring, which she had obtained in a secret realm, contained an ancient and powerful being who seemed to know everything. It guided her cultivation, and following the direction of the being within the ring, she improved her physique, learned Artifact Refining Technique, advanced to the Divinity Transformation Stage, and achieved her current accomplishments.
Because of the being in the ring instructing her to conceal her skills, no one in the Immortal Palace knew her full capabilities.
...
"Elder Brother's experiences are truly fascinating," Bai Ye recalled the story narrated by Lu Yang over and over in her mind, feeling extremely regretful that she couldn't be there in person.
"It's a pity that I can't leave my Original Domain, or else I could join Elder Brother in adventuring through the world of martial arts."
Lu Yang thought to himself that if Bai Ye with her Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivation left the mountain, it wouldn't be adventuring through the martial arts world, but more like sweeping through it.
Like the Time Immortal, Bai Ye was equivalent to a Pass Tribulation Cultivator since the moment she gained Spiritual Wisdom.
"Right, I can take a mountain and leave," Bai Ye, influenced by Lu Yang's stories, began to think more ingeniously without realizing it.
After all, there were so many mountains in the Great Snow Mountain, taking one wouldn't matter much.
"Would carrying the mountain around be too ostentatious?" Lu Yang kindly pointed out what was wrong with this idea, although he also felt sorry for Bai Ye and wanted to take her out for a stroll.
The idea of the towering Laurel Tree Ancestor moving with a snow mountain was terrifying to even think about; anyone would run at the sight of it.
Struck by a novel idea, Bai Ye thought of a compromise, "I can take a mountain to your Seek Dao Sect."
Although she could not join Elder Brother Lu Yang on adventures, a change of scenery would be nice.
Lu Yang opened his mouth but found he had no argument against it.
In the Spiritual Space, Fairy Eternity nodded in satisfaction, thinking to herself that Little Yang was truly one with her.
"Little Yang deliberately suggested carrying the mountain to seem too conspicuous, thereby subconsciously guiding Bai Ye to propose moving the snow mountain to the Seek Dao Sect. This level of cunning is no less than mine," she thought.
"Fairy, don't talk nonsense. It was Bai Ye who actively proposed coming to the Seek Dao Sect," Lu Yang hurriedly clarified, as if he had tricked Bai Ye into coming to the Seek Dao Sect, which would be a huge misunderstanding if Eldest Senior Sister and Elder Brother Dai found out.
"Of course, we must say it was Bai Ye's own initiative," Fairy Eternity said with an expression that said, "I understand everything."
...
In the early morning, Chasing Moon True Person stared at Lu Yang with displeasure, "Lu Yang, you're on good terms with our disciples of the Immortal Palace, and that's fine, but now you want to deceive Little Ye away?"
```
He had only interacted with Lu Yang for a few days, and he was already thinking about moving mountains to the Seek Dao Sect; what would happen if he spent a long time with Lu Yang?
"Ah Ri, this was my own initiative, it has nothing to do with Elder Brother Lu Yang," Bai Ye hurriedly said.
"Besides, if I go to the Seek Dao Sect, won't you be able to go too?" Bai Ye can't leave the Original Domain, and neither can Chasing Moon True Person.
Chasing Moon True Person hesitated for a moment but didn't argue.
Although this felt a bit unfair to the Fairy Palace she had established, she did have the thought of changing places for a wander.
Truly Little Yang, knowing that as long as Bai Ye was coaxed, Bai Ri would obediently come to our Seek Dao Sect.
Fairy Eternity greatly praised Lu Yang's actions, and if it weren't for the fact that Lu Yang was already at a high-ranking position with nothing left to promote, she would have elevated his status no matter what.
"Little Yang, do you want to be the Bean Emperor right now?"
"?"
Lu Yang had no idea how Fairy Eternity suddenly came up with such a shocking thought.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, can I also ask you about problems with Swordsmanship?" called out Xuanyuan Tianhen from the next door's next door.
Yesterday, seeing Junior Brother Xue Shilou making great gains with Lu Yang, he also couldn't help himself.
"Sure, that's fine, but could you let Snow Daoist relay it?" Lu Yang kindly suggested, as Xue Shilou stood between the two, making Xuanyuan Tianhen's shouting too noisy.
"Senior Brother, would you ask Fellow Daoist Lu Yang, when I perform the Falling Wild Goose on Flat Sand, I always feel like there's something missing. What exactly is missing?"
Xue Shilou looked at his own Senior Brother with a strange expression: "I can answer that question."
Xuanyuan Tianhen looked at Xue Shilou skeptically, as if seeing him for the first time: "You can answer it? Then why didn't you say so before?"
"I thought you were intentionally displaying modesty."
"What modesty, that's just my level!" Xuanyuan Tianhen roared angrily.
"Keep it down, Senior Brother, you shouting like that, the whole Sinners' Hall now knows your Swordsmanship is subpar."
"What modesty, that's just my level." Xuanyuan Tianhen shouted again, this time in a quieter tone, audible only to Xue Shilou.
"You don't need to shout twice; I heard you clearly the first time," Xue Shilou said helplessly; he often felt like he was the real Senior Brother.
"No, I need to shout twice, or it doesn't sit right with me," Xuanyuan Tianhen said, as he always ensured his thoughts were clear and never compromised himself.
"Alright then."
Xue Shilou addressed each of Xuanyuan Tianhen's questions one by one, but that didn't mean he knew everything, occasionally still needing help with a tricky question from Lu Yang.
"Snow Daoist is embarrassed in front of Fellow Daoist Lu Yang," Xue Shilou said with a bit of embarrassment.
"It's okay, the exchange of Swordsmanship not only helps you and Xuanyuan Daoist, but it also greatly benefits my improvement," Lu Yang said.
Just as Xue Shilou was about to say something, his expression suddenly changed, his face covered in sweat as he rolled on the ground, howling in pain.
"So noisy," said Chasing Moon True Person from the next door's next door.
After thinking for a moment and feeling that nobody would notice her, she sneaked a move with the Dao Fruit Embryo, aiming at Xue Shilou, who immediately stopped crying out. Although he was still rolling on the ground, he showed a comfortable and joyful expression, clearly enjoying it.
Chasing Moon True Person's subtle action escaped everyone's notice, but not Fairy Eternity's.
"Making Xue Shilou feel that pain is a very pleasurable thing, giving him the emotion of joy, could it be the Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Embryo?"

chapters.title: Chapter 955 - 954: Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Embryo
chapters.content:
```
"Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Embryo? You mean one can use the Dao Fruit Embryo to influence feelings?"
Lu Yang watched as Xue Shilou next door writhed on the ground like a maggot, revealing an expression of blissful enjoyment, his look strange.
Who knows what kind of expression Xue Shilou will have when he wakes up.
He probably won't want to live anymore, right?
"Since you can't endure the pain, then accept it, savor the pain."
"For Snow Daoist to have understood such a Mind State in adversity, truly impressive."
"A model for our generation indeed."
The prisoners, seeing the state of Xue Shilou, all felt that his Mind State was extraordinary and that he would achieve great things in the future.
"Right, the Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Embryo can make one happy, angry, scared, and so on. Back in Ancient Times, there were several people who condensed the Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Embryo. I remember one called Joy Venerate, who danced the happiest, able to change others' emotions at will, like if he hit someone, that person would not only not be angry but also very happy."
"For instance, he could make anyone feel affection for him, regardless of gender."
"Or he could eliminate his own fear, allowing him to face any danger or peril with calm."
"Another example is that he could plunge his opponent into a state of sadness, making them lose the will to fight, or into a rage, losing their mind, with many uses for his power."
"What happened to him later?"
"Later, he got into a fight with Immortal Jiuchong. At that time, both were Semi-Immortals, roughly equal in strength, making it hard to determine the victor."
"Joy Venerate plunged Immortal Jiuchong into a state of sorrow, and he couldn't extricate himself."
"As you know, sorrow is often linked with anger. Immortal Jiuchong, trapped in sorrow, quickly became angry, veins bulging, eyes bloodshot. Under the explosion of emotion, with a couple of shouts, his strength surged, and he killed Joy Venerate."
"Oh, right, the one who established a Harem Golden Core was also about the Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Embryo. According to him, he realized 'love' from his harem, and then understood the 'Seven Emotions'."
"With the Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Embryo, even more female cultivators fell for him."
"You also know his end, the women who loved him too much couldn't bear to part with him, so they dismembered him, each getting a piece."
"I even took a distant look back then, all the female cultivators holding parts of his body, faces and bodies covered in blood, with sinister and maniacal grins on their faces, quite frightening."
Lu Yang shivered; such a scene was indeed terrifying. Fortunately, he wouldn't encounter such a thing.
While thinking this, Lu Yang casually picked up a Spirit Fruit from the fruit basket and began to eat.
"This tastes good, I'll buy ten pounds for Eldest Senior Sister to try when I go back."
What Lu Yang ate was an unrecognizable white Spirit Fruit, surprisingly delicious.
"You call this tasting good? Wait until the day I cultivate a new Immortal Fruit for you to try, now that's truly delicious."
Fairy Eternity scoffed at Lu Yang's lack of sophistication.
"...If my memory serves me correctly, wasn't the effect of the Immortal Fruit to prevent a corpse from rotting?" Lu Yang always felt like Immortal Fruit were meant to be eaten by the dead.
"Effect is effect, taste is taste; they are two separate matters." Immortal Fruit cultivated by Fairy Eternity herself, putting aside their effect, were naturally top-notch in taste.
"Just enjoy the benefits of following me. If this were in Ancient Times, only Immortals and Xiao Ling, among a few others, could have tasted it."
Lu Yang didn't reply, mainly because he wasn't sure if he was enjoying a benefit or enduring hardship.
Seeing that no one noticed him, Chasing Moon True Person cultivated in peace.
The key to advancing the Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Embryo is to observe all walks of life and comprehend the emotions of the mortal world.
The Sinners' Hall, filled with anger, sorrow, fear, and disgust, was the perfect place for cultivation.
```
```
Of course, there was joy as well.
Chasing Moon True Person opened his right eye and glanced at Lu Yang on the right side. The joy was right there.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, are you alright?"
Lu Yang, hearing someone else coming to visit, turned his head and plastered a commercial smile on his face: "I'm fine... Junior Sister Tao?!"
Lu Yang looked as if he had seen a ghost. How could Junior Sister Tao be here?
"It's me." Tao Yaoye said sweetly, holding a package.
"It's been a while since I've seen Elder Brother, you've gotten so small," Tao Yaoye squatted down and spoke to Lu Yang across the bars. The joy in her voice could pass through the bars.
"How come you're at the Fairy Palace, Junior Sister?" Lu Yang forced a smile, fearing Tao Yaoye might spread the news of his size change the moment she turned around.
Although everyone in the Sinners' Hall knew he had shrunk, they wouldn't be leaving anytime soon, so there was no rush.
But it was different with Junior Sister Tao. She might record his new appearance in a Dream Mirage the moment she turned around.
"I heard Elder Brother came to visit the Fairy Palace. I have long yearned for it, so I took this opportunity to tour the palace."
"I just didn't expect that you would have an accident, Elder Brother."
Tao Yaoye looked at Lu Yang, struggling to resist the urge to touch his small head.
Tao Yaoye, seeing through Lu Yang's worries, took the initiative to say: "But you can rest assured, Elder Brother, I won't tell anyone about you getting smaller."
"Then I must thank Junior Sister Tao." Lu Yang breathed a sigh of relief. Junior Sister Tao really was reliable.
Chasing Moon True Person secretly observed the changes in Lu Yang's emotions: "Indeed, quite dramatic."
"Elder Brother, why do you have so many fruit baskets here? Can you finish them all?" Tao Yaoye exclaimed, surprised at the numerous fruit baskets around Lu Yang.
Lu Yang gave a bitter smile. How could he possibly finish them all?
"If Elder Brother can't finish them, leaving them here would just take up space. It would be better for Junior Sister to take some. When I return to the sect, it can be considered as bringing gifts for Elder Brother and the junior brothers."
"Then I'll have to trouble Junior Sister."
Tao Yaoye smiled and accepted one basket after another: "Elder Brother's matters are my matters, not trouble at all."
Tao Yaoye opened the package, which contained a four-tiered lunchbox: "By the way, Elder Brother, I've been practicing my culinary skills lately. I made some extra food. I'm not sure if it suits your taste, but if you don't mind, you could try it."
"The food made by Junior Sister Tao is definitely a delicacy of the human world," Lu Yang said with a smile, thinking that at last he wouldn't have to eat spirit fruits like they were seeds.
After chatting for a while, Tao Yaoye took the initiative to say goodbye: "I have to attend to some matters, so I'll take my leave first. I'll come to see Elder Brother again tomorrow."
"Take care, Junior Sister." Lu Yang waved goodbye.
Even Lu Yang hadn't noticed that Tao Yaoye had hidden a Recording Orb in her sleeve, capturing his childlike appearance.
Tao Yaoye's culinary skills were indeed excellent, comparable even to those of a Spirit Chef at the Spirit Transformation Level. The meals were exquisitely matched and made from cherished ingredients, highly beneficial for cultivation.
Lu Yang ate while pondering a question.
"I've been at the Fairy Palace for several days now. Why did Junior Sister Tao only come now? Does it take that long to travel from the Seek Dao Sect to the Fairy Palace?"
"Or did Junior Sister Tao just hear about it from Man Gu?"
…
Tao Yaoye stepped out of the Sinners' Hall, raised her right hand to shield her eyes from the dazzling sunlight, and looked toward the person waiting at the entrance to the Sinners' Hall for her.
"I really didn't expect that you, Junior Sister Lan, would take the initiative to contact me and tell me about Senior Brother Lu's situation."
```

chapters.title: Chapter 956 - 955 Jointly Confronting the Enemy
chapters.content:
Man Gu only told Dai Bufan about Lu Yang visiting the Laurel Fairy Palace and did not inform anyone else.
Tao Yaoye came to the Fairy Palace in a hurry after receiving an urgent message from Lan Ting.
Being able to see Elder Brother Lu Yang so up close already made the trip worthwhile.
Lan Ting huffed coldly, "It's just because of a shortage of personnel."
With Lu Yang confined in Sinners' Hall, disciples of the Immortal Palace kept coming relentlessly to visit him. Lan Ting couldn't support it all alone and had to ask for Tao Yaoye's assistance.
"I didn't expect even Junior Sister Lan to become so small," said Tao Yaoye, who, as an adult, felt a natural sense of superiority and didn't bother arguing with the likes of a little one like Lan Ting.
Lan Ting spoke calmly, "There are benefits to being small. For example, I grew up with Senior Brother Lu as childhood sweethearts, an innocent romance. Such experiences, I presume, Junior Sister Tao, you might not be able to understand."
The two stared intently at each other, trying to find a crack in the other's expression.
Unfortunately, it was futile.
"Forget it, why should I compete with a little one like you? Tell me the current situation."
Lan Ting's brows did not relax, "It's not very optimistic. I don't know how many people in the Fairy Palace harbour hidden intentions towards Elder Brother Lu Yang. Anyway, there were quite a few who came under the guise of visiting him yesterday."
"And with this incident, once Elder Brother Lu Yang comes out, they'll still find excuses to visit him."
"Indeed, it's troublesome." There was already a Lan Ting competing for Elder Brother Lu Yang's attention, and if the potential competitors in the Immortal Palace made contact with him and became rivals, it would be even harder to compete.
"It seems that the issue at hand is how to stop them from entering Sinners' Hall to visit Elder Brother Lu Yang."
"How about we simply say Elder Brother Lu Yang is in seclusion and should not be disturbed?"
"That won't do. Once Elder Brother Lu Yang comes out, a simple question could reveal the lie. Moreover, if other people cannot visit Sinners' Hall because of this reason, it also means we can't go in."
It was a rare opportunity to interact with Lu Yang in a special place like Sinners' Hall. Visiting Lu Yang could increase their rapport. They could have conversations exclusive to them, share a laugh after talking—it was an opportunity neither was willing to give up easily.
They needed to find a solution that would work for everyone.
"Senior Sister Lan Ting, what are you doing standing here, and who is this..." a voice interrupted their thoughts.
Lan Ting turned her head and saw that it was He Miao from the Refinement Chamber.
"It's Junior Sister He Miao. Are you here to visit Elder Brother Lu Yang too? Let me introduce you, this is Tao Yaoye from the Seek Dao Sect, the one who developed the popular Dream Mirage."
Tao Yaoye raised her hand to stop Lan Ting's introduction, "The Dream Mirage wasn't solely my achievement. Elder Brother Lu Yang helped me a great deal. He really put a lot of thought into it, even coming up with the name 'Dream Mirage'."
"Nice to meet you, Senior Sister Tao." He Miao did not expect to meet the renowned Tao Yaoye, who seemed to have a special relationship with Elder Brother Lu Yang.
"I'm here for nothing else but to hear that Elder Brother Lu Yang has been placed in your Sinners' Hall, so I came to visit."
Tao Yaoye sighed, "I just visited Elder Brother Lu Yang and found his place filled with baskets of fruit. He barely has space to set foot; the amount of Spirit Fruit is too much for one person to eat, isn't it?"
"Moreover, Elder Brother Lu Yang receives the Fairy Palace's Senior Sisters and Junior Sisters all day, exhausting himself. There's a prisoner confined next to him who seems to be ill, writhing on the floor and chuckling creepily. I don't think he had much rest last night; he didn't look very energetic when I saw him this morning."
Following He Miao, more Disciples of the Immortal Palace arrived: An Qiuxia, Xia Tang, Huang Shan, Bu Lianxin...
Seeing that no one was entering Sinners' Hall and seeing Tao Yaoye and Lan Ting talking so intently at the entrance, they felt awkward about passing between them to go inside.
"Who is this person?"
"It's Tao Yaoye, the inventor of the Dream Mirage, Elder Brother Lu Yang's fellow sect member; she's come to visit him."
"She is Tao Yaoye?"
The inventor of the Dream Mirage, meaning a continuous flow of Spirit Stones into Tao Yaoye's pocket, her wealth was incomparable to her peers, and even those in the Body Integration Realm had few who could compare with her.
Knowing the identity of the inventor Tao Yaoye, and hearing about her unusual relationship with Elder Brother Lu Yang, the disciples of the Immortal Palace naturally felt inferior to Tao Yaoye.
"I saw that Senior Brother is really not doing well in the Sinners' Hall and was thinking of speaking to Palace Master Luo to see if we could stop visiting Elder Brother Lu Yang for now, which would be convenient for everyone."
"That's not acceptable!" Lan Ting quickly interjected, echoing the sentiments of the disciples of the Immortal Palace.
To directly prevent visits to Elder Brother Lu Yang, wouldn't that strip us of any reason to contact him?
Tao Yaoye observed Lan Ting with interest, "May I know on what grounds Junior Sister Lan is stopping me, is it because in the entire Immortal Palace, only you have the best relationship with him? Or is it because you have completed missions with him, and without regard for your own life, you've fought alongside him against the Rudder Master of the Eternity Sect?"
Lan Ting sighed, "I do not have any noteworthy identity to speak of, it's just that Elder Brother Lu Yang is, after all, the guest I invited, so it's my responsibility if something goes wrong."
"Yesterday, many Senior Sisters and Junior Sisters went to visit Elder Brother Lu Yang, disturbing his rest, and I didn't stop them; that was our Immortal Palace's fault, so I hope we can correct this mistake in time."
"Since Junior Sister Tao thinks that there were too many visitors for Elder Brother Lu Yang yesterday, why not reduce the number of visits from today?"
"Please oversee me, Junior Sister Tao."
Tao Yaoye stared at Lan Ting for a while, deciding whether to trust her or not; finally, she exhaled and said, "Very well, I'll trust you this one time."
Seeing that Tao Yaoye wouldn't complain to the master, Lan Ting and the other disciples of the Immortal Palace heaved a sigh of relief.
Lan Ting stood on a large rock, waving her hand to draw everyone's attention.
