"Fellow Senior Sisters and Junior Sisters, I'm sure you all heard the agreement I just made with Junior Sister Tao."
Everyone recognized Lan Ting's status; Lu Yang was invited by her, and she had shared life-and-death experiences with him; she also stopped Tao Yaoye from seeking out the Palace Master, so she could represent them in making an agreement with Tao Yaoye.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang already knows of our Immortal Palace's hospitality and manners, but the continuous visits have indeed inconvenienced him, and I bear the main responsibility."
"In order to let Elder Brother Lu Yang get proper rest, I think the best way is for all Senior Sisters and Junior Sisters to prepare meals, and I will bring the meals on behalf of everyone to visit Elder Brother Lu Yang."
"To make Elder Brother Lu Yang aware of everyone's kindness, I will inform him whose cooking the meals are from."
The crowd murmured amongst themselves, if they could make Elder Brother Lu Yang eat their cooking and leave a deep impression, that seemed like an acceptable solution.
Tao Yaoye frowned and stepped forward, "Elder Brother Lu Yang has a limited appetite, preparing too much food will go to waste, three meals a day is sufficient."
"Then how shall we choose who will cook, draw lots?"
Lan Ting quickly said, "We visit Elder Brother Lu Yang to ensure he can rest well and eat well."
"Since that's the case, might as well select based on cooking skills, whoever cooks the best can go visit Elder Brother Lu Yang and deliver the meals."
Lan Ting understood Tao Yaoye's suggestion, a cooking skills contest would prevent people from competing with her over the right to visit Elder Brother Lu Yang, turning into an internal struggle over who could cook the tastiest meals that would leave a deep impression on Elder Brother Lu Yang.

chapters.title: Chapter 957 - 957: 956 Out of Control
chapters.content:
Lu Yang found that these past few days had been noticeably more leisurely; only Tao Yaoye and Lan Ting came to deliver his meals, and no one else visited him.
This was what normal prison life should be like; the constant stream of visitors he had before was definitely not normal.
Although what was normal or not didn't really have much to do with him, as it was Fairy Eternity who was in prison.
Chasing Moon True Person observed Lu Yang secretly during the daytime, always feeling that Lu Yang seemed to be in a state of silly happiness most of the time, a pure joy that she had never encountered before.
Even if she used her Dao Fruit Outline to maintain a state of joy, she couldn't achieve such purity.
"Could this be the legendary heart of an innocent child?"
The heart of an innocent child was a state all cultivators pursued, but as far as Chasing Moon True Person was aware, no one had achieved it yet.
"What a strange kid."
"Eh, is my cultivation level coming back?" Lu Yang felt his cultivation level gradually rising, from Qi Refinement to Foundation Establishment... all the way to the Initial Stage of Spirit Transformation.
"Looks like my body will soon return to its original form," said Fairy Eternity, feeling somewhat regretful that Little Yang was finally going to grow up.
Sure enough, after half a day, white smoke emerged from Lu Yang's body, blocking the view. Lu Yang quickly took the opportunity to grab some appropriate clothes from his Identity Jade, finally returning to his original form.
"Phew, it's much more convenient to move around in my original form." Lu Yang jumped on the spot twice, cherishing his current state immensely.
Not to mention anything else, at the very least, he could now pick up a Spirit Fruit with one hand, unlike when he was in the form of a child and needed both hands to hold it.
"Now that I've returned to my original form, it means that all the sisters of the Fairy Palace should have changed back as well."
"Snow Daoist, I'll be taking my leave first," Lu Yang said, bidding farewell to Xue Shilou with cupped hands.
Five days had passed, and he could leave Sinners' Hall now.
Chasing Moon True Person watched Lu Yang's figure until he disappeared, as if enlightened.
To perfect the Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Embryo, it was most important to experience the myriad feelings of life, and observing Lu Yang these past few days had given her a great understanding of the emotion of joy.
She summoned the Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Embryo secretly; it looked like seven building blocks pieced together, starting to solidify.
"Pure joy... Strange, why do I feel that besides feeling joy, that kid Lu Yang also seems to like himself?"
Chasing Moon True Person furrowed her brows, unable to understand Lu Yang's state.
"Is it self-love? It doesn't quite seem like it."
"Pure joy... liking oneself..."
Chasing Moon True Person kept recalling her observations of Lu Yang over the past few days, finding them more and more incomprehensible the more she thought about them.
The Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Embryo in her palm trembled continuously, as if it was about to fall apart.
Chasing Moon True Person's complexion changed drastically: "This is bad..."
...
"Elder Morran, I will take my leave now," Lu Yang said as he bid farewell to Elder Morran, officially leaving Sinners' Hall.
Elder Morran was quite reluctant to see Lu Yang go; with the boy around, Sinners' Hall had been much livelier inside and out, providing her with plenty of inspiration for her creativity.
"I'm finally out," Lu Yang said, stretching his neck as he left Sinners' Hall. Without the suppression of the Array Method, he could now freely use the mana he had recovered.
"I should go find Junior Sister Tao first."
He had stayed in the first guest room, so Junior Sister Tao should be living next door.
It was a long way from Sinners' Hall to the guest rooms, and with no special ban on flying within the Fairy Palace, Lu Yang could only walk back to the guest rooms.
"By the way, Little Yang, you might run into a bit of trouble in a moment," Fairy Eternity suddenly reminded him.
"A little trouble?" Lu Yang didn't understand. This was Laurel Fairy Palace; what trouble could there be?
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, you've come out." A familiar voice sounded; Lu Yang turned his head and saw it was He Miao, who had visited him before.
"So it's Sister He Miao, thank you for your concern. It looks like you've also returned to normal, which is truly a cause for celebration..."
Before Lu Yang could finish his sentence, He Miao threw herself into his arms, her eyes watery as she gazed up at him.
"Sister He Miao, what danger have you encountered?" Lu Yang was taken aback by her actions.
"Senior Brother, I like you!"
"Ah?" Lu Yang was even more at a loss.
"Senior Brother, how about we descend the mountain together and wander the ends of the earth, exploring the mysteries of the world?"
"Hold on, hold on, Sister He Miao, please calm down for a moment," Lu Yang said, holding He Miao's shoulders, sensing that something was amiss.
"Isn't this a bit too impulsive? We should sit down and talk this over slowly..."
"Is it that you like someone else?"
"?"
"Senior Brother, you can only like me!" Behind He Miao, a jade vase flew out, emitting a soft beam of light from its mouth.
Lu Yang's hair stood on end; he had heard from Lan Ting that despite appearing gentle, this beam of light contained the effects of a fixation technique and absolutely must not be caught in its glow!
Lu Yang took a quick step back and sprung away, narrowly dodging the jade vase's assault and turned to run for his life.
"Senior Brother, you can't escape!" Beneath He Miao's feet, a leaf appeared, enlarging into what resembled a small boat, capable of gliding on the snow.
Never mind whether he could escape; he needed to run first and foremost.
He Miao's cultivation level was not as high as Lu Yang's, and even with the Fei Ye Leaf, she was much slower than Lu Yang, allowing him to breathe a sigh of relief.
All of a sudden, another figure appeared by chance, surprised to see Lu Yang racing towards them.
"Sister An Qiuxia, you should go check on Sister He Miao; something seems to have happened to her..."
"Forget about Sister He, Senior Brother, you're mine!"
An Qiuxia summoned a golden page that shimmered with light, and countless characters flew out, turning into ropes that shot towards Lu Yang.
Lu Yang, not daring to touch these ropes, hurriedly dodged and once again fled.
"Why run, stand still!" An Qiuxia called out sweetly, stepping onto the golden page and flying after Lu Yang.
With An Qiuxia in front and He Miao behind, Lu Yang had no choice but to escape to the left.
Soon after, Sister Xia Tang blocked his path, followed by Sisters Qing Feng, Ming Jing, Luo Luo... each displaying their divine abilities, all aiming to capture Lu Yang.
"What's going on here!" Lu Yang suddenly remembered the "little trouble" mentioned by Fairy Eternity.
This trouble didn't look small at all!
"Bai Ri that girl hasn't mastered her cultivation, the Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Embryo has lost control. As for the effects, it seems like all the cultivators in the Fairy Palace have developed a liking for you?"
"The Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Embryo even tried to control me, but my cultivation is high; a mere Dao Fruit Embryo dares not trouble me. However, these cultivators can't withstand it."
"Shouldn't we go find Senior Chasing Moon now to have her interrupt the use of the Dao Fruit Embryo?"
"Once the Dao Fruit Embryo goes out of control, it's not something that little girl Bai Ri can handle. But it's not a big problem; when night falls and Bai Ye appears, it will naturally interrupt the use of the Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Embryo."
Lu Yang looked back at the Fairy Palace sisters who seemed determined to tear him apart and felt a sense of despair.
"But it's only morning right now!"
...
"This is bad; the Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Embryo has gone out of control, intensifying everyone's possessiveness over that boy Lu Yang!" Chasing Moon True Person was sweating profusely as she persistently tried to gain control over the Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Embryo, but to no avail.

chapters.title: Chapter 958 - 957: Battle Royale
chapters.content:
"Practicing cultivation is never without risks, right? Once you embark on the path of cultivation, you're bound to encounter battles, Thunder Tribulations, falls, and the like."
"Even as a Semi-Immortal, you're not an exception. You might face failure when Crossing the Immortal Tribulation or lose control of the Dao Fruit Outline."
Fairy Eternity tries to argue, with all seriousness, that this is all normal.
"It's probably because Bai Ri grasped some emotion she shouldn't have, something beyond her understanding, and that's why the Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Outline went out of control."
"Look at you back in Wild State, complaining about your lack of luck in love affairs. Now look how good you have it, with so many people liking you."
"Speaking of which, the guy who formed a Harem Golden Core faced a similar situation before he died. You might as well consider yourself a mimic of an Ancient Semi-Immortal."
"But I didn't form a Harem Golden Core!" Lu Yang exclaimed in despair.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, stop right there!"
"Senior Brother, I like you!"
"How about we retire to the countryside together and stay by each other's side forever?"
Lu Yang didn't dare to stop for a step, knowing that if he slowed down even a bit, he'd be pinned down by numerous Senior Sisters and Junior Sisters – a fate most dire!
Lu Yang transmitted his voice to the girls behind him, trying to incite infighting: "I appreciate the feelings of all the Senior and Junior Sisters, but there's only one of me, and so many of you. Even if you catch me, how can you decide who gets to keep me?"
"Then we'll just have to split Senior Brother between us!"
"!"
Lu Yang gasped in horror. Why did this method sound so eerily familiar?
"Right, I can change my fate by renaming myself!" Lu Yang suddenly remembered he still had this trump card up his sleeve, the Causality Supernatural Power.
He released his Spiritual Sense to scan behind him and found that they hadn't slowed down in the slightest.
"Lu Yin, let's be together forever!"
"Senior Brother, alive or dead, you belong to me!"
"Fairy, why isn't it working?" Lu Yin hastily asked.
"Of course it won't work. Renaming yourself can only fool lower-level tribulations like the Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation. You've been locked onto by the Dao Fruit Outline, which is much higher-level than the Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation. You can't fool it."
"I suppose once you've cultivated to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, you might be able to deceive the Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Embryo with renaming."
"If I were at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage and still being chased, it should be me chasing them!"
"...No, wait, why would I chase them?"
Seeing that renaming himself was ineffective, Lu Yin had no choice but to change his name back.
In this critical situation, Lu Yang couldn't care less about the Immortal Palace's rule against flying. He stepped onto the Sword Washing Pool and took off,
and, surely, this had to fall under the "special circumstances" allowed by the Immortal Palace rules.
As a true Sword Cultivator, when Lu Yang stepped onto the Sword Washing Pool, his speed increased dramatically, and he quickly distanced himself from the pursuing crowd, leaving only a blurry figure in the vast snow.
Suddenly, attacks came from both the left and the right, all aimed to bind or restrain him. The Sword Washing Pool, having its own Spirituality, automatically raised its altitude, narrowly avoiding the assaults from both sides.
Two more Disciples of the Immortal Palace joined the pursuit of Lu Yang!
"No good, at this rate I'm bound to be caught eventually." Lu Yang realized that, despite flying quickly, he couldn't cope with so many people catching up and setting up blockades. An attack could appear unexpectedly, and with energy waning over time, a single slip could lead to capture.
Lu Yang urged the Sword Washing Pool to accelerate further, temporarily throwing off his pursuers, before he leaped down and burrowed into the ground.
"Tree Planting Spell!"
Two Lu Yangs emerged from underground, one the real Lu Yang, the other a Wooden Avatar dressed in leafy garments.
The primordial spirit flew out and entered the Wooden Avatar, so that he wouldn't have to distract himself controlling it.
Lu Yang had the Wooden Avatar change into identical clothes, then he put it on the Sword Washing Pool and sent it flying away quickly.
"There's Elder Brother Lu Yang!"
"Chase him!"
Lu Yang hid underground, watching the primordial spirit flee in embarrassment, deeply moved.
"You must not get caught."
No one chased after him, so Lu Yang's pressure plummeted, and he sighed in relief.
Even when he stopped, he could feel his heart pounding violently, scared out of his wits.
"Go to the Sinners' Hall... Forget it, can't count on Senior Chasing Moon, I have to find Palace Master Luo for help... The Body Integration Realm should be unaffected, right? It seemed like there was no one from the Body Integration Realm chasing me just now."
Lu Yang dared not bet on whether the Body Integration Realm was unaffected; if he walked into a trap, then the joke would be on him.
"Seems like I've arrived at the guest rooms." Lu Yang looked up at the ground and realized that, before he knew it, he had come to the place where he was staying.
"It's also good to go back and rest first."
Lu Yang emerged from the ground and did not dare to use his Spiritual Sense to explore, worried that the disciples of the Immortal Palace would detect him.
Lu Yang peeked here and there, walking close to the walls, where the eaves above allowed him to be more concealed.
Just as Lu Yang was about to open the door, the wooden door suddenly opened, and a cool, jade hand pulled Lu Yang inside, giving him a big scare.
Upon seeing the owner of the jade hand, Lu Yang breathed a sigh of relief, and clutching his chest with lingering fear, he said, "You scared me to death; turns out it's Junior Sister Lan."
"Senior Brother, are you all right? I saw just now that many people were chasing you," asked Lan Ting with concern.
"I'm fine, I used a little trick to deceive them away."
"It's good that Senior Brother is fine," Lan Ting said, a faint smile playing at the corners of her mouth as she quietly closed the room door.
Back in a familiar place, Lu Yang couldn't help but relax, saying casually with his back to Lan Ting, "I suspect it's the collapse of Senior Chasing Moon's Dao Fruit Outline that caused everyone in the Immortal Palace to fall for me..."
Lu Yang realized something was wrong abruptly—Lan Ting was also part of "everyone in the Immortal Palace," wasn't she?
And why was Lan Ting in his room?
Whoosh, Lan Ting flung out two strands of her blue dress ribbons, which like Flood Dragons, instantly coiled around Lu Yang.
"Junior Sister, you..." Lu Yang's expression changed slightly, he had been careless.
Lan Ting stretched out her slender jade hand, stroked Lu Yang's chest through his clothes, then with a light push, knocked Lu Yang onto the bed.
She lay on top of him, her warm and soft voice tingling in his ear, "Senior Brother, you belong to me."
"!"
Clang, the room door was kicked open, and Tao Yaoye, holding a red paper umbrella, stood at the entrance, furious, "Junior Sister Lan, how dare you run away!"
"So what if I ran away, first come first served!"
Tao Yaoye used the umbrella as a sword, thrusting it towards Lan Ting, who somehow produced an axe and blocked the red paper umbrella with it held across her chest.
The axe flowed smoothly in her hands, obviously well-practiced.
Lu Yang took advantage of the squabble between the two women to bounce up from the bed. As he was bound by the dress ribbons, he hopped out like a zombie.
"Senior Brother, where are you running to!" Lan Ting grabbed hold of Lu Yang, pulling him into her arms, and fought against Tao Yaoye single-handedly.
Tao Yaoye opened her red paper umbrella, unleashing her Illusionary Realm, making Lan Ting's eyes glazed over, entrapped in an illusion.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang is mine!" Tao Yaoye took the chance to snatch Lu Yang away.
"Don't even think about it!" Lan Ting easily broke the temporary illusion and used the ribbons to pull Lu Yang back.
Lu Yang was passed back and forth between the two women like an object.
The two women were evenly matched, and realizing that whoever held Lu Yang would be put at a disadvantage, they reluctantly set him aside for the time being.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang is mine!" A third figure appeared at the doorway and joined the fight.
"Senior Sister Jinghong?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 959 - 958 Sudden Appearance of the Invaders
chapters.content:
The existence of the black ancient ring listened to the description of Senior Sister Jinghong, her voice as unruffled as an ancient well.
"The disciples of the Immortal Palace are driven by the desires deep in their hearts to vie for Junior Brother Lu. It reminds me of a tragic incident from ancient times."
"Was it someone who caused the Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Embryo to spiral out of control, or does Junior Brother Lu have intricate ties with the Harem Golden Core, forming a connection with an ancient figure who helped him condense his Harem Golden Core, brewing the disaster we see today?"
"Since no Integration Period Cultivator has entered the fray for the struggle, it indicates that those cultivators differ greatly from Junior Brother Lu and harbor no desire for him."
"Disciple, regardless of how the situation unfolds, do not descend into battle. This person is far more dangerous than you can imagine."
"But Master, I... I also like Junior Brother Lu!" Senior Sister Jinghong realized her heart was pounding fiercely; the thought of Junior Brother Lu ignited an indescribable possessiveness within her, a longing to claim him for herself.
Indeed, Master instructed her not to associate with Junior Brother Lu, yet she had heard many of his stories; she had grown somewhat fond of him, and under today's inexplicable change, these feelings had intensified uncontrollably!
A nasal voice emanated from within the black ancient ring, "Hmm? Then you should quickly enter the small world of the ancient ring. I will suppress it for you... "
"Please allow your disciple this indulgence just once, Master!"
"..." The corner of the existence in the black ancient ring twitched.
...
"Junior Brother Lu Yang is mine!" Senior Sister Jinghong, wielding a pair of daggers, interjected herself between Lan Ting and Tao Yaoye, perfectly defusing their attacks.
"Who would have thought Senior Sister Jinghong has been concealing her strength all this time," Lan Ting noticed as soon as they clashed.
Not to boast, but in the Immortal Palace, where geniuses were as common as clouds, her talent was extremely formidable. With her initial stage of Spirit Transformation cultivation level, she could barely match the renowned combat prowess of a Mid-stage Transforming Spirit senior sister.
Yet Senior Sister Jinghong, who was not known for her combat prowess in her Mid-stage Transforming Spirit, stood equal to her in combat, signifying that Senior Sister Jinghong was definitely not as simple as she appeared to be on the surface.
"The strong shall only belong to the strong!" declared Senior Sister Jinghong, asserting her dominion and showing not a hint of retreat in a two-against-one battle.
True to her name, Jinghong moved like a startling swan. She navigated the cramped space with high-speed maneuvers that even a Kun Peng from the Kunpeng Clan using the Extreme Speed Technique could scarcely match.
The three of them were embroiled in combat, the scene growing more chaotic by the moment. Junior Brother Lu finally saw an opportunity to flee, shrinking himself down with the "Inch-shrinking Technique," but Lan Ting's dress straps, enhanced with some unknown magic skill, shrank in sync with him and remained firmly bound to him.
"Should I cut off the dress straps?" Junior Brother Lu noted that Lan Ting constantly used her dress straps as a weapon and was concerned that it might be her Life-bound Magical Treasure. If he rashly cut it, he might hurt her.
Fairy Eternity conveniently assured him, "Oh, don't worry about that, the real Life-bound Magical Treasure of Lan girl is the axe in her hand."
"What?" In an instant, Junior Brother Lu's impression of Lan Ting underwent a significant change.
Regardless, now was not the time for such considerations. As long as he wouldn't harm Junior Sister Lan Ting, that was all that mattered.
Junior Brother Lu drew his Green Peak Sword and effortlessly sliced open the dress straps, freeing himself from his bonds.
...
"Senior Sister, shouldn't we step in and stop this?" Elder Zhu Hong said, as she glanced at a Water Mirror in front of her, which reflected Junior Brother Lu bound up and his wooden avatar being pursued by countless disciples of the Immortal Palace.
Luo Hongxia received a voice transmission from Senior Chasing Moon and understood the full story.
She snorted coldly, "Why the rush? Let's wait until that boy Lu Yang is truly captured before we intervene."
"You didn't see her on the first day she was locked in the Sinners' Hall; the disciples delivering prison meals were endless. To the ignorant, it would seem as if our Immortal Palace was his harem."
"He needs to be frightened a bit, to deter him from recklessly starting a harem."
...
"Don't run, Junior Brother Lu Yang!" Lan Ting noticed that her dress straps had been cut by Junior Brother Lu and quickly set off to chase after him.
But Tao Yaoye and Senior Sister Jinghong would hardly give her the opportunity, jointly blocking her at the door.
"Fine, fine, fine, you've forced my hand!" Lan Ting had almost reached Junior Brother Lu's garment when her opportunity was thwarted by the two of them, and since Junior Brother Lu was not here, there was no longer any need to maintain her image.
The dress straps on the ground, severed into several pieces, reconnected seamlessly, as good as new, no different than before being damaged.
Lan Ting wrapped her skirt belt around the axe, and with a gentle sway, the axe spun with a whoosh, its power astonishing.
Lu Yang fled in a miserable state, not daring to stop for a moment. If Lan Ting and her two companions were to join forces, he was certain that escape would be impossible.
"The guest rooms aren't safe anymore, huh."
"Don't be afraid, Junior Brother. Senior Sister will protect you." A figure suddenly appeared and dragged Lu Yang away.
When Lu Yang looked up, it was actually Senior Sister Jinghong!
That shouldn't be right. Wasn't Senior Sister Jinghong still fighting in the guest rooms?
"What's fighting in the guest room is a clone she refined. Honestly, that girl's skill in refining avatars is quite impressive. It seems she has learned her artifact refining technique well."
"Junior Brother Lu, let's leave the Fairy Palace and wander the world together." Senior Sister Jinghong hugged Lu Yang tightly, her ample figure making it difficult for him to breathe.
As expected of one who studies artifact refining, her strength was surprisingly formidable, and Lu Yang struggled to break free.
Senior Chasing Moon, your sins are truly heinous!
Lu Yang had cursed Chasing Moon True Person several times in his heart.
It's one thing for your Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Embryo to be out of control, leading all Fairy Palace disciples to fancy you, but how did it turn into them all liking me?
"Shrink Inch, Earth Shrinking!"
Lu Yang instantly shrank and burrowed into the ground. However, Senior Sister Jinghong was no easy target; she seemed to use some magic skill that allowed her to burrow as well.
Moreover, she was burrowing faster than Lu Yang.
Unable to use his sword-flying ability underground, Lu Yang had no choice but to emerge and fly close to the ground.
He feared being discovered by other Fairy Palace disciples if he flew too high.
Senior Sister Jinghong took out a flying shuttle, personally refined by her, with a speed that was no less than Lu Yang's sword-flying.
"Someone has infiltrated the Fairy Palace." Fairy Eternity frowned.
"Ah? Who?" Fairy Eternity's abrupt statement caught Lu Yang off guard.
"Don't know who it is, but there are at least two from the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, and they don't seem to come with good intentions."
"How did they get in? What about the Sect Protection Array of the Fairy Palace?"
"They knew how to disarm the Sect Protection Array and bypassed the Fairy Palace's detection."
"So what do we do now, inform the Fairy Palace?" Compared to being chased by a bunch of Fairy Palace disciples, having unidentified Transcendance Tribulation Stage intruders in the Fairy Palace seemed a trivial matter.
"It's awkward to directly inform the Fairy Palace, as I'd have trouble explaining how I came to know about it. Fairy, tell me where they are?"
"They just passed through the Fairy Palace entrance."
"That's just perfect then."
Lu Yang made a turn with his Green Peak Sword beneath his feet and headed straight for the Fairy Palace entrance.
He was willing to bet that Luo Hongxia definitely knew about his situation and was observing this area; perhaps Chasing Moon True Person was doing the same. So with that in mind, he was going to lead the intruders into their line of sight!
Since the intruders used Invisibility Technique and couldn't be seen directly, even with Fairy Eternity pointing out their exact location, Lu Yang could only see a vast expanse of snow.
Using his Spiritual Sense, Lu Yang saw the relentless Senior Sister Jinghong throwing a rope. He swiftly turned around, causing the rope to miss and strike toward the vast expanse of snow.
"Just my luck."
A figure appeared, muttering as it shattered the rope. He had been well-hidden, but the sudden attack forced him to counter.
"Invaders!" Luo Hongxia rose up suddenly, realizing something was terribly wrong. Through the Water Mirror, she targeted the invader and shot out a column of green light!

chapters.title: Chapter 960 - 960: 959 Subduing Demons and Exorcisms
chapters.content:
Facing the cyan light column that Luo Hongxia had struck through the air, it was as if there was an invisible barrier in front of the invaders, blocking the attack.
"Seems we've been discovered, huh."
Another invader appeared, grinning broadly, and since they'd been found by the people of the Fairy Palace, there was no longer any need to hide.
The issue was not significant; after all, their original intention was to cause chaos -- it was merely a matter of starting their plan earlier than expected.
"Who are you!" Luo Hongxia rushed over, holding the Restraining Light Treasure Box, staring intently at the two people.
From the ease with which they had deflected her attacks, it was clear that both of them were at least at the Middle Tribulation Stage.
Sneaking into the Fairy Palace without a greeting indicated that they had malicious intentions.
"Senior Sister Jinghong, run fast!" Seeing that a fight was about to break out, Lu Yang pulled the still unresponsive Jinghong aside to a safe spot, ensuring she wouldn't be affected by the battle.
"Merely at the Body Integration Realm, and you deem yourself worthy of knowing our names — the cultivators of the future truly lack manners." The smiling invader slightly opened his eyes, gazing at Luo Hongxia with ominous red light flickering in his pupils.
Luo Hongxia trembled, feeling as if she was in a boundless hell, with the stench of blood and mountains of corpses assaulting her senses.
"Why must the two of you bully a junior? Wouldn't that seem demeaning?"
A silver-haired old woman suddenly appeared, standing in front of Luo Hongxia, and with a light tap of her cane, the illusion before Luo Hongxia's eyes vanished instantly.
"Patriarch Fang."
This person was one of the pillars of the Fairy Palace, the venerable Fang Ci, whose seniority was so great that even the Master Jiesha of the Hanging Temple would have to address her as a senior.
"As individuals at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, you two are certainly not nameless. Hiding your identities does not befit those who Pass Tribulation. Who exactly are you, and what business brings you to our Fairy Palace?"
"We are under the command of the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord, tasked with the duties of subduing demons and exorcising evil, and we have come to your palace to borrow the Tree Ancestor."
"You are the Demon-Subduing God Lord and the Demon-Removing God Lord?!"
The Great Qian Dynasty promotes the worship of incense, and everyone from Emperor Qian of Mid-heaven to various cultivators has some relationship with incense. By enjoying the benefits of incense worship, they assume the corresponding responsibilities.
For example, subduing demons and exorcising evil to protect the peace.
Like the Rivers and Mountains Monarch who appeared in the East Sea, known for waging battles far and wide and expanding territories, he was honored with the name due to the incense offerings of the lands and rivers.
Even though the Demon-Subduing God Lord and the Demon-Removing God Lord weren't as powerful as the Rivers and Mountains Monarch, they were still well-known Divine Monarchs of their time, also at the Middle Tribulation Stage.
"Borrow the Tree Ancestor?" Patriarch Fang chuckled coldly, sneaking into the Fairy Palace in such a stealthy manner hardly seemed like they had come to borrow anything.
"I'm afraid you will be disappointed. The Tree Ancestor cannot leave the Great Snow Mountain; it cannot be borrowed."
"No matter," smiled the Demon-Subduing God Lord. "Even the deceased Tree Ancestor has the power to strengthen the soul, which is good enough for us."
They did not choose to take the Tree Ancestor away during the early stages of the Great Qian, Great Yu, and Great Xia periods because the Tree Ancestor didn't live long enough back then, and the quality wasn't sufficient. But now, after three hundred thousand years, the Tree Ancestor must have become an Immortal Object, worthy of the Emperor.
In their eyes, the so-called Laurel Fairy Palace was nothing more than a sect tasked with guarding and caring for the Laurel Tree Ancestor.
"You're courting death!" Patriarch Fang became furious. The Laurel Tree Ancestor was the foundation of the Fairy Palace, and with Luo Hongxia reporting that it had developed Spiritual Wisdom, becoming a true being, how could she possibly allow any harm to come to it?
Her cane transformed into a jade dragon coiling high in the sky, its breath forming frost, intending to freeze the two Divine Monarchs into ice statues!
The Demon-Removing God Lord sighed, "The cultivators of later generations really don't know the immensity of heaven and earth, daring to make a move against us. Subdue the demon, show her some colors, and let her know what it means to respect the elders."
The Demon-Subduing God Lord was skilled at capturing and killing various demon beasts.
He transformed into a hundred-zhang giant, wielding a divine halberd, and smashed it towards the jade dragon. The jade dragon roared, spewing out frost that froze the Demon-Subduing God Lord into a massive ball of ice.
But the ice quickly shattered, and he struggled to swing his divine halberd, wrestling with the jade dragon.
"Late Tribulation Stage!" Patriarch Fang's heart sank as he determined the realm of the Demon-Subduing God Lord after their brief exchange. Judging from how the Demon-Removing God Lord had commanded the Demon-Subduing God Lord earlier, Patriarch Fang feared that the Demon-Removing God Lord's cultivation level was even higher than that of the Demon-Subduing God Lord!
Was it just that some are stronger even in the Late Tribulation Stage, or could it be... Semi-Immortal?
As the two great Transcendence Tribulation Stage cultivators clashed, the entire Great Snow Mountain quaked, and even the underground Sinners' Hall was unstable.
"Is it finally starting, and so soon too?" Qu Ling revealed a smile of triumph.
She had been sentenced to lifelong imprisonment, never to leave the Sinners' Hall. If she wanted to leave, she had to find another way.
She could gather news from outside through newly imprisoned criminals and likewise have those who were released after serving their sentence pass messages on.
For instance, just recently a prisoner who was released after serving his sentence for theft was told by her the method to break the Sect Protection Array. She instructed him to take this information to the top auction in the black market, preferably selling it to major powers like the Great Qian Dynasty, Heavenly Court Sect, Demon Nation, or Dragon Palace.
The condition for auctioning the method was to cause a great disturbance at the Fairy Palace, allowing her the opportunity to escape.
...
Patriarch Fang was only in the Middle Tribulation Stage and could not match the Demon-Subduing God Lord who was in the Late Tribulation Stage. The Divine Monarch danced with the giant halberd as if back in the era where he was invincible; with the halberd's descent, the force was enough to smash the jade dragon into two pieces!
Patriarch Fang hastily cast a magic skill to block the halberd, but how could a hastily conjured magic skill withstand the charged divine halberd?
But suddenly, a bitter sorrow arose from within the Demon-Subduing God Lord. Memories flooded his mind, and overcome with sadness, he could not muster any strength. The divine halberd clanked to the ground as he covered his face and wept bitterly.
"Why did that Demon-Removing kid get promoted while I'm still stuck here, simply because he bribed the higher-ups? And Rivers and Mountains Monarch, after I had finally resolved to bribe him, he promised to help me get promoted; why did he just die so abruptly... Wait, something's wrong, who's playing tricks?!"
A delicate figure hovered in the air, looking down at the Demon-Subduing God Lord with disdain.
"You come to my Fairy Palace, wanting to kill Little Ye, and you still have the face to ask who I am? Are all you old things so shameless?"
When the Demon-Subduing God Lord and the Demon-Removing God Lord saw that petite figure, fear spread uncontrollably in their hearts. A chill ran from their feet all the way to their crown, their bodies trembling uncontrollably, without the slightest thought of resistance.
Who was this delicate figure, and why did she seem to contain an endless amount of terrifying power that could crush them a thousand times over with just a thought?
It was as if they were facing the Emperor himself!
"Has Senior Chasing Moon finally finished with the Dao Fruit Outline?" Lu Yang breathed a sigh of relief. Finally, he wouldn't have to hide in the Fairy Palace like a rat dodging the street anymore.
Senior Sister Jinghong returned to her original appearance, her shyness making her quickly pull her hand away from Lu Yang's.
Thinking back on everything that had just happened made her cheeks burn hot, and she dared not look directly at Junior Brother Lu Yang.
To divert her attention, she secretly informed the Black Ancient Ring about everything happening now.
An ancient voice echoed from within the Black Ancient Ring, "If I had known that a Seven Emotions Dao Fruit could be used in this way, I would have formed one."
Fairy Eternity raised an eyebrow. Why was this girl called Jinghong talking to a ring; was there someone in the ring?

chapters.title: Chapter 961 - 960 Who Says It's 3 Against 1
chapters.content:
"Fairy, what's wrong?"
"Nothing much, it's just that little girl named Startling Swan was talking to her ring just now; there might be someone inside the ring."
Lu Yang's heart stirred, and he immediately felt a sense of camaraderie with Senior Sister Jinghong.
Presumably, the ring of Senior Sister Jinghong also housed a Great Cultivator with quite a background. When silent, all was well, but once it spoke, the sense of imposing presence would tumble down, chattering incessantly day by day, with no use during cultivation, it all depended on oneself.
"Fairy, did Senior Chasing Moon use the Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Embryo to make these two Divine Monarchs so scared?"
"Not a bad insight, you've got three parts of this immortal's skill." Immortal Fairy Eternity felt extremely gratified and didn't regret painstakingly teaching Lu Yang, which allowed him to have such discernment today.
"That girl Bai Ri is quite clever, she instilled the Fear of Seven Emotions in those two, so in the eyes of whatever Divine Monarchs they are, Bai Ri's image must have become equivalent to the person they fear the most."
"In ancient times, why didn't the Semi-Immortals who didn't master the Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Outline use this method?"
"Then, Fairy, do you know what they wanted Bai Ye for?"
"Hmm, the dead Laurel Tree only has the effect of strengthening the soul, so I guess someone needs to strengthen their soul."
"They seem to have a rather high status in the Great Qian Dynasty, probably for the Immortals of the Great Qian Dynasty."
...
"Who is this little girl?" Once the Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Embryo was no longer out of control, the Disciples of the Immortal Palace stopped chasing Lu Yang and instead turned their attention to the disturbance at the entrance of the Immortal Palace.
They thought Chasing Moon True Person was small and frail, perhaps another sister poisoned.
However, they quickly dismissed this possibility—the little girl seemed more powerful than Patriarch Fang, she must be some important figure.
"Who are you!" the two Divine Monarchs trembled like sieves, their overwhelming fear preventing them from thinking about anything else.
"You are not worthy to know." True Person Chasing Moon would, of course, not admit that this little one was her.
Patriarch Fang saw that Luo Hongxia looked surprised, and quietly sent a message, "Little Luo, do you recognize this senior?"
"It's our Ancestor Chasing Moon."
"What?!" Patriarch Fang exclaimed, she had seen Ancestor Chasing Moon before, who was gorgeously unparalleled then, radiantly beautiful, how could she have turned into a little one now; failing in cultivation practice didn't work like this, right?
"Don't ask for details, Ancestor Chasing Moon doesn't want me to tell."
"Oh."
Just as the two Divine Monarchs were about to surrender and admit defeat, suddenly a complex and magnificent gold talisman flashed between their brows, instantly clearing their minds.
"Something's wrong, we've been tricked!" the Divine Monarchs finally realized their previous state was nowhere near normal.
"Fortunately, we have the body-protection talismans bestowed by our lord."
"Just now you were made to show sorrow, and now you and I both feel fear, be careful, the Dao Fruit Outline the opponent grasps is related to emotions, it might be the Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Outline recorded in ancient texts!"
Having regained his normal state, the Demon-Removing God Lord immediately analyzed the situation and was not far off.
It was troublesome, matters of emotions were elusive; his mastery of the Vajra Dao Fruit Outline was not adept at contending with this kind of Dao Fruit Outline.
And they could not keep using talismans given by the Emperor; sooner or later, they would run out.
"The Cultivators of later generations have indeed produced a few capable ones."
```
The two Divine Monarchs, who had emerged from the chaotic era at the dawn of the Great Qian Dynasty, immediately thought of a way to alleviate the situation.
"Thus I have heard, the Vajra Ultimate Technique cannot be destroyed by anyone, yet it can destroy everything. Such is also the wisdom..."
The two Divine Monarchs chanted Buddhist scriptures at the same time, subduing the unruly mind and steadying their hearts. Although they could not completely resist the influence of the Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Embryo, they could significantly weaken it.
At the very least, they wouldn't be afraid to take action against Chasing Moon True Person.
"I will assist the senior!" Patriarch Fang feigned ignorance of Chasing Moon True Person's identity, referring to her as Senior, and came forward to support.
"Vajra Demon-Removing!" A golden glow appeared around the body of the Demon-Removing God Lord, with a red dot between his eyebrows, resembling an Arhat from the western Buddha Country—three heads and six arms, holding six Vajra Pestles, and with two faces—one kindly and the other fierce.
Chasing Moon True Person's arms transformed into a wooden longspear. Although it was made of wood, it was part of the Laurel Tree Ancestor, and there were few materials under the Heavens that could match its strength.
Accompanied by petals, the Laurel Fairy Longspear was thrown, piercing through the void and hitting the Demon-Removing God Lord's abdomen. The Demon-Removing God Lord extended his Vajra Hand and easily snapped the Laurel Fairy Longspear. There wasn't even a tiny scratch left on his abdomen.
"Temporarily strengthening her own Dao Fruit Embryo, indeed she is a Semi-Immortal," Chasing Moon True Person thought to herself. She was not skilled in offensive techniques and realized that she would have difficulty defeating him in the short term.
"Two against two, let's see what the cultivators of later generations are capable of!" The three faces of the Demon-Removing God Lord laughed simultaneously, exuding an indescribable eeriness.
"Who said it's two against two?" Chasing Moon True Person smiled faintly, making the Demon-Removing God Lord feel that something was off.
The Divine Halberd swept across, striking directly at the waist of the Demon-Removing God Lord.
"Demon-Subduing, what are you doing!" The Demon-Removing God Lord roared in anger, as the Demon-Subduing God Lord unexpectedly struck him. They were too close, so he had no time to react.
Luckily he was in a Vajra state; otherwise, the hit just now could have seriously injured him.
The Demon-Subduing God Lord's eyes were bloodshot and he was gasping for air as he looked at Demon-Removing God Lord. Only upon hearing the Demon-Removing God Lord scold him with a Buddhist chant did he sober up.
"I, I don't know... I just thought you looked quite unpleasant and wanted to strike you," the Demon-Subduing God Lord hurriedly explained.
"How about now, still think it's two against two?" Chasing Moon True Person sneered contemptuously. When fighting a Semi-Immortal with the Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Embryo, the more people involved, the easier it was for internal conflicts to arise due to emotional manipulation.
Even though the Demon-Subduing God Lord also recited the scriptures, he was not a Semi-Immortal, meaning his state of mind was not as resilient as the Demon-Removing God Lord's. As both recited Buddhist scriptures simultaneously, their ability to resist the Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Embryo was different.
"Three against one, that's all. Are you afraid of us?" The Demon-Removing God Lord had already given up hope of the Demon-Subduing God Lord's assistance, just hoping he wouldn't cause more trouble.
"Who said it's three against one?"
Before the words fell, the ground rolled tumultuously, and thick roots burst forth like countless tentacles—except these tentacles appeared to be made of white jade and lacked a sinister feel.
The countless roots entwined the Demon-Removing God Lord. He pounded at them with his fists, breaking the roots, but they were only halved and soon restored to their original state, continuing to entangle the Demon-Removing God Lord.
Behind Chasing Moon True Person, a figure exactly like hers appeared, and the two stood side by side, indistinguishable from one another.
"Little Ye, finally not sleeping?"
"I was woken up by the noise," Bai Ye grumbled dissatisfied.
She only liked to sleep during the day rather than having to, and would naturally take action if the Fairy Palace faced an enemy.
After all, she was the Fairy Palace's Transcendance Tribulation Stage technique.
"Laurel Tree Ancestor?!" The Demon-Removing God Lord hadn't expected the Laurel Tree Ancestor to have evolved to this extent. He thought the Tree Ancestor had only developed consciousness, but now it seemed a Soul had been born!
"Now, do you still say it's three against one?" Chasing Moon True Person asked from above, her eyes cold.
The Demon-Removing God Lord felt that he didn't really need the Laurel Tree Ancestor's assistance.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 962 - 961: The Unpredictable Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Embryo
chapters.content:
The Demon-Removing God Lord felt he had suffered the worst luck of eight lifetimes. The battle was completely against him, the Demon-Subduing God Lord on his side was unreliable and could turn on him at any moment, and he often had to recite Buddhist scriptures to adjust his mood.
On the other hand, there was a Semi-Immortal, an Immortal Tree with a born soul, and a Pass Tribulation Cultivator on the opposing side.
Even the Landscape Monarch would not necessarily be able to defeat them, let alone himself.
It's better to run.
The Demon-Removing God Lord felt the tree roots continually retracting, tightening more and more.
"I'll save you, and I hereby establish the rule: 'The body of the Laurel Tree Ancestor cannot be restored'!" The Demon-Subduing God Lord swung the Giant Halberd and exerted all his strength in a downward strike, but suddenly a tree root extended and collided with the halberd. The halberd broke off half of the root, but it immediately restored itself to its original state.
"How is that possible? I've established a rule."
The Demon-Removing God Lord couldn't help but curse in anger, "Idiot, the Tree Ancestor has reached the 'Immortal Object' level. How could a Pass Tribulation Cultivator's rule shake it!"
"I generously tried to save you, and you dare curse at me?!" The Demon-Subduing God Lord was equally furious, picking up the Divine Halberd and slamming it down on the Demon-Removing God Lord's head, causing his head to buzz.
"Let's set the record straight; I didn't use the Seven Emotions Dao Fruit Embryo just now," declared Chasing Moon True Person first.
"Nonsense, it was clearly you who pulled strings just now!" The Demon-Subduing God Lord hurriedly argued to clear his position.
No one could determine who was telling the truth.
The Demon-Removing God Lord could no longer concern himself with discerning truth from falsehood; his top priority was to escape quickly.
"Vajra Dharma Aspect!" The Demon-Removing God Lord shouted loudly, summoning the Vajra Dharma Aspect, a hundred zhang in height. While the roots were entangling the Dharma Aspect, he made a large hole in front of the Dharma Aspect's chest and hurried out.
"You think you can run away after coming to the Fairy Palace!"
At the very moment the Demon-Removing God Lord was about to leave the Fairy Palace's territory, countless roots shot up into the sky, rising straight up and forming an impenetrable wooden wall.
The Demon-Removing God Lord flew towards the right side, but the roots were always one step ahead, rising at an extremely fast speed.
The vast Fairy Palace was instantly surrounded by the roots.
The Laurel Tree Ancestor had been growing in the Great Snow Mountain since Ancient Times, and its roots were spread in every corner of the mountain. Not to mention enclosing the Fairy Palace situated in the Great Snow Mountain, even sealing off the entire mountain would not be difficult.
In theory, the Laurel Tree Ancestor was comparable to a Pass Tribulation Cultivator, but given its massive size, it could be equated to the still Transcendance Tribulation Stage Time Immortal and should not be treated like an ordinary Pass Tribulation Cultivator.
Its only weakness was that it could not leave the range of the Great Snow Mountain.
"Damn it, do they really think I am made of mud?"
The Demon-Removing God Lord, seeing that there was no escape, flew into a rage and decided to fight the Fairy Palace to the death. The Fairy Palace did not have any particularly strong offensive methods, and his Vajra Dao Fruit Outline was not afraid at all.
However, the Demon-Removing God Lord's momentum surged, then quickly his anger disappeared and his momentum dropped.
He became furious again, and his anger disappeared again.
Angry, then subsided.
"Fairy Palace, you've gone too far!" The Demon-Removing God Lord glared, feeling empty inside, his rage unable to come forth, which was unbearably uncomfortable.
Chasing Moon True Person sneered coldly, "Don't think that shouting a few times and getting angry will make your strength surge. I'm not giving you that chance."
She hadn't read through so many stories and novels for nothing.
"Demon-Subduing, go kill all the disciples of the Fairy Palace!" The Demon-Removing God Lord had a moment of quick wit. He didn't believe that the Fairy Palace side could remain indifferent to the slaughter of their disciples.
They would certainly divide their attention to deal with the Demon-Subduing True Monarch, and as a result, the pressure on himself would be greatly reduced.
"Dream on!"
Patriarch Fang took out a wooden box, opened it, and a beam of light enveloped the Demon-Subduing God Lord, who was just about to start a massacre. Without any control, the Demon-Subduing God Lord was drawn into the box.
"Restraining Light Treasure Box." The Demon-Removing God Lord sneered. He had heard of this famous Immortal Treasure, made from the horn of a mythical creature, which could suck people in and force them to fight, only releasing them after determining a winner or loser.
The Immortal Fairy had controlled Lu Yang's body and engaged in duels with four Immortal Sect Masters inside the Restraining Light Treasure Box, a glorious moment indeed.
The Demon-Removing God Lord knew his plan was successful. Surely one person had to enter the treasure box to be the opponent of the Demon-Subduing God Lord, and it must be a Pass Tribulation Cultivator. Anyone below that level was going in to die.
So, this must be the Transcendance Tribulation Stage of Patriarch Fang.
Little did he expect that Patriarch Fang was well-prepared, took out a bag of ants, and stuffed them into a wooden box.
The Demon-Subduing God Lord could only leave if he defeated this swarm of ants.
But the space within the wooden box was immense, beyond the full coverage of the Demon-Subduing God Lord's Spiritual Sense.
"I hope the Demon-Subduing God Lord can find all the ants."
Luo Hongxia's left eye twitched twice; she hadn't expected the Restraining Light Treasure Box to be used in this way.
There's a reason they're called Patriarch.
"One less opponent can only be a good thing!" The Demon-Removing God Lord said through gritted teeth, unwilling to admit that his plan had failed, and these younger-generation cultivators were really damn unscrupulous.
"For the cause of Demon-Removing and protecting the way!" The Demon-Removing God Lord used the power of incense, transforming into the same world-protecting Divine Monarch from thirty thousand years ago.
The Jade Dragon breathed out bitterly cold air to freeze the Demon-Removing God Lord; the Embryo of the Seven Emotions Dao Fruit disrupted his emotions making his attacks and defenses incoherent while the merciless roots lashed at him.
Boom!
The ice exploded, and the Demon-Removing God Lord slowly walked out, his lips curled into a proud and unrestrained smile.
"Come on, let's see how your attacks can hurt me!"
"You asked for it!" The Fairy Palace's side didn't hesitate and launched a second round of attacks.
Lu Yang, who was watching the battle from up close, noticed something wrong: "Doesn't the Demon-Removing God Lord seem slightly off, as if he's actually enjoying this?"
"Could it be that Senior Chasing Moon has tampered with him, making the Demon-Removing God Lord think that pain is pleasure?"
Lu Yang felt that the Dao Fruit Outline of Seven Emotions was truly terrifying, with unpredictable and unstoppable methods; one might not even know when they were affected.
Fortunately, Senior Chasing Moon was on their side.
Lu Yang suddenly looked up, sensing danger approaching, just as an attack splashed towards him and Startling Swan.
"Senior Sister, let's clasp hands!" Lu Yang shouted loudly, and Startling Swan instantly understood Lu Yang's intention. They both struck out with their palms, collided, and flew backward, avoiding the attack's range.
"Hmm, how come someone has sneaked into the Fairy Palace." Fairy Eternity furrowed her brow, as another person had just entered the Fairy Palace.
...
"Let them fight, the more intense, the better," a figure said, looking up at the Demon-Removing God Lord who was being beaten, laughing with a heh-heh.
The Demon-Subduing and Demon-Removing God Lord was just a distraction to catch the Fairy Palace's attention—this person was the real one intending to bring down the Tree Ancestor.
"Huh?"
Suddenly, the figure felt a burning sensation in his chest. He pulled out a token, one of the four, that was heating up.
He held the token, trembling with excitement.
"Is this...one of the Four Ancient Immortals nearby?!"
At that moment, he completely forgot about the Laurel Tree Ancestor's affair. Compared to the whereabouts of the Four Ancient Immortals, and compared to the Dao Fruit of the Four Ancient Immortals, what did the Laurel Tree Ancestor matter!
He kept moving, searching for the direction where the token felt hottest, and his gaze quickly settled on the pitch-black ring in the hands of Startling Swan.
The Ancient Immortal was inside that ring!
He lunged at Startling Swan, who was blissfully unaware; if Startling Swan took the hit, it would undoubtedly be fatal!
The presence within the Ancient Ring sighed, and seeing that things had come to this point, he had no choice but to make a move.
A vortex emerged from the Ancient Ring, drawing the attack into it.
The figure seized the opportunity to enter the Ancient Ring.
"Specter Monarch of the Great Qian Dynasty, paying my respects to Ying Tian Immortal."

chapters.title: Chapter 963 - 962 Venerable Ying Long
chapters.content:
"Specter Monarch of the Great Qian Dynasty, pays respect to Yingtian Immortal." The Specter Monarch entered the ancient ring, bowing with his head lowered.
In his hand, he held four tokens. As long as one of the Four Ancient Immortals was nearby, the tokens would react. When he entered the small world of the ancient ring, the token inscribed with "Ying Tian" became extremely hot.
The entity before him was the legendary Yingtian Immortal, known for setting the ancient order, controlling the power of Heavenly Tribulation, and being called the Ancestor of Refining!
Merely being gazed upon by it was enough to make one shiver, as if facing an Emperor Lord himself.
"You may look upon my immortal countenance."
With the permission from Yingtian Immortal, the Specter Monarch raised his head.
As he raised it, he saw what first appeared to be a golden wall with scale-like decorations. The gold wall moved, and the Specter Monarch suddenly realized that this was not any golden wall but the body of a golden True Dragon!
He lifted his head even higher, meeting the gaze of the golden dragon's head.
In the pure white space, the Golden Dragon coiled, its head slightly lowered, gazing at the Specter Monarch, expression unreadable.
The Golden Dragon, whose length was unknown but stretched many thousands of fathoms, was longer than any True Dragon the Specter Monarch had ever seen. Its entire body appeared as though it were cast from molten gold. With wings on its back and a majestic head, its imperial presence emitted a natural authority that not even the most skilled craftsman could replicate one-tenth of it.
The Specter Monarch still wore a smile, yet inwardly he thought the legends true that Yingtian Immortal was indeed the Venerable Ying Long of the East Sea.
The Golden Dragon exhaled white dragon breath from its nostrils, its ruthless eyes focused on the token in the Specter Monarch's hand. Its deep voice echoed through the entire ancient ring's small world, causing a buzzing in the Specter Monarch's ears.
"It seems your Great Qian indeed has some methods, able to trace my whereabouts."
"You attack the Startling Swan, forcing me to act. What do you seek from me?" Venerable Ying Long inquired, his tone questioning.
Once he acted, Lu Yang might notice the anomaly here and discover him.
"My lord wishes to gather the power of the Four Ancient Immortals to break the prison's seal and open the pathway to the outside world. I hope the Venerable Immortal might grant this."
The Mid-heaven Emperor Lord discovered that the seal of this six-sided world was arranged by the Four Ancient Immortals using the power of Dao Fruit. To break the world's prison seal, the Four Ancient Immortals needed to act, which led to the creation of the four tokens to locate and persuade the Four Ancient Immortals.
If he could bring Yingtian Immortal to their Great Qian, it would be a greater achievement than even felling the Laurel Tree Ancestor.
Moreover, the Laurel Tree Ancestor was here; he could be seen at any time, yet the opportunity to meet Yingtian Immortal might only come once.
"To break the seal, it is possible."
The Specter Monarch was overjoyed, not expecting the legendary Yingtian Immortal to be so amenable; he had prepared many arguments that now went unused: "Then…"
"But not now."
"May I ask when the Venerable Immortal can break the seal?"
"When the Sixth Immortal is killed."
The Specter Monarch did not understand whom Yingtian Immortal referred to as the Sixth Immortal. Was it the enemy from the battle of refining stars into a continent?
And who then was the Fifth Immortal?
"When exactly can this Sixth Immortal be found?"
"I do not know."
"You do not know?"
Specter Monarch was astonished. If one did not know the time, how long would they have to wait? Did the Emperor have to wait another 300,000 years, and did they all need to sleep for another 300,000 years?
"Not to mention that the Immortal is not yet resurrected and unable to break the seal. Let's particularly mention that the Sixth Immortal uses any means necessary to achieve his goals. In the past, when the spark was extinguished, all beings suffered severely, and it was his doing. If we break the world seal and let him escape, he will surely cause trouble in the future and harm the world.
Can you, the Great Qian, afford this responsibility?"
"The Venerable Immortal is merciful, but what do the lives of the common folk and we Cultivators have to do with each other?" Specter Monarch laughed. If they cared about the common folk, they wouldn't have let Great Qian fall and plunged the world into war and conflict.
"The lives of the common folk are resilient. Destroy a batch, and new ones will be born. Why should the Venerable Immortal worry about these people's lives?"
"This matter is very significant, and our lord also places great importance on it. I beseech the Venerable Immortal to move and talk with our lord, shall we?"
"What if I don't?"
"Then, please don't blame me, your junior, for being unreasonable."
"From the junior's view, the Venerable Immortal's state doesn't seem too good. I heard that the being that died in the Sword Tower was born from the Venerable Immortal's corpse. With your physical body gone, how many levels of your enormous cultivation can you still use?"
As he spoke, Specter Monarch's face still wore a smile, only this time it wasn't so pleasing. Instead, it became emotional, filled with strong derision.
Specter Monarch assessed the strength of the Ying Tian Corpse that appeared in the Sword Tower. The Ying Tian Corpse had a physical body but no Dao Fruit, barely qualifying as an Immortal, and was among the weakest of Immortals.
Since the Ying Tian Immortal's soul was separated from the body and hadn't killed the Ying Tian Corpse to take back the body, it meant that even overcoming the Ying Tian Corpse was uncertain, their strengths nearly equal.
Given this, he should stick with the initial plan—kill the Ying Tian Immortal and seize the Tribulation Dao Fruit.
"Clueless about life and death."
At the same time, Venerable Ying Long communicated through a voice transmission with Startling Swan, advising her not to enter the Ancient Ring before the matter was resolved.
"Then I must ask the Venerable Immortal to spare his life!"
Specter Monarch's brow bore a divine symbol, swiftly evolving into an emperor ruling the Nine Heavens, none other than the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord, of whom no portraits remained in history!
The emperor's eyes opened, seemingly able to crush the heavens, making one feel averse to resistance.
"Just a clone created by the Power of Incense and Fire, and you think it can revolt against heaven?" Venerable Ying Long scoffed. Had the true form of the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord come, he, in his current condition, indeed couldn't compete, but a mere clone trying to deal with him was sheer folly.
Mid-heaven Emperor Lord stretched out his hand and placed it atop Specter Monarch's head. Specter Monarch seemed to have anticipated this action from the lord's clone and didn't resist, allowing the clone to absorb him.
Venerable Ying Long raised an eyebrow, seemingly detecting some clues.
He sensed that the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord's clone absorbing Specter Monarch wasn't just about strengthening the clone; there must be something else.
"Nine Heavens Mysterious Thunder."
Above the sky of the Ancient Ring's small world, clouds gathered suddenly, with thunder flashing and booming. Each flash of lightning was enough to disperse the souls of Integration Period Cultivators, and there were millions of such lightning flashes!
Millions of lightning flashes continuously converged and fused, forming a crimson Mysterious Thunder, locked onto the causality of the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord's clone and decisively struck down.
Unexpectedly, the clone's head opened a massive black vortex, and the crimson Mysterious Thunder, upon falling, was devoured entirely by the black vortex, causing not the slightest disturbance.
"Devouring? Storing? Transferring?" Venerable Ying Long's mind flashed through various ideas, speculating what kind of Dao Fruit the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord truly possessed.
The second Mysterious Thunder fell, containing terrifying might and boundless radiance, still swallowed by the black vortex atop the clone's head as if no Thunder Tribulation had ever descended.
The Mid-heaven Emperor Lord's clone underwent the baptism of Thunder Tribulation without a scratch, not only unaffected by the Thunder Tribulation but also strolling leisurely and effortlessly through it.
"Interesting, the Immortals of later generations do have some skills."

chapters.title: Chapter 964 - 963: Silent Extermination Immortal, You Shall Not Deceive Me!
chapters.content:
"Earth disaster."
Venerable Ying Long's thoughts moved, and three stars fell from the Thunder Tribulation, smashing towards the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord's clone.
These were not real Thunder Tribulations, but rather stars that had evolved through the Tribulation Dao Fruit and were compressed.
The original stars were too large; a single one could occupy all space. Once compressed, it made it possible for three stars to attack the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord's clone at the same time. Moreover, their density was astonishingly high, making them incredibly hard and more powerful than the stars in their original form.
If it were the Demon-Removing God Lord fighting in the outside world who came, a single falling star could shatter his Vajra body, let alone three.
Around the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord's clone appeared swathes of black vortices. As the three stars fell, they exploded on the spot, shaking the ground and mountains of the Ancient Ring's small world. The black vortex carved a hole through the stars, and the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord walked out of the hole unharmed.
However, Venerable Ying Long had confirmed the nature of the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord's Dao Fruit.
"As expected, it's a devouring type of Dao Fruit."
If it were a transfer or space type of Dao Fruit, it wouldn't just carve a hole in the stars; it would make the stars disappear into thin air.
Transferring an entire star is much easier than transferring part of it.
"Venerable Immortal, how is it?" The Mid-heaven Emperor Lord's clone suddenly emitted the voice of the Specter Monarch, full of mockery and ridicule.
If he didn't know that the Emperor Lord's Dao Fruit could devour various kinds of Heavenly Tribulations, the Specter Monarch wouldn't be so confident.
"Dull and tedious. The Kirin would grow stronger after resisting my Heavenly Tribulation, such trivial devouring, what does it count for." Venerable Ying Long commented indifferently, unmoved.
"I hope you can still say that before your looming death."
Fire disaster, flood disaster, wind disaster, three world-ending calamities descended one after the other, mixed with various kinds of Thunder Tribulations, all of which were devoured by the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord's clone.
"Dare to approach me?" Venerable Ying Long extended a dragon claw, grabbing towards the Emperor Lord's clone.
Having lost his physical body, this was a pure soul attack, and the Specter Monarch hidden inside the Emperor Lord's clone definitely could not withstand it.
Compared to entangled competitions between Dao Fruits, directly attacking the Specter Monarch's soul was more convenient.
However, the moment the dragon claw touched the Emperor Lord's clone, a vortex appeared around him again, and it directly swallowed the dragon claw!
The Devouring Dao Fruit directly devoured the soul!
From the Devouring Dao Fruit's previous performance, its devouring speed should not have been so fast; a part of the soul should have been able to attack the Specter Monarch.
Unless the current Devouring Dao Fruit's speed at devouring souls was faster than devouring matter!
"Venerable Immortal, you might as well guess why my lord's clone wanted to devour me?" The Emperor Lord's clone transmitted the Specter Monarch's mocking laugh again.
The Specter Monarch's duty during the Great Qian Period was to manage ghosts, ensuring their orderly dissolution without disturbing the human world. This led to the outline of his Dao Fruit, although it was of the Soul Dao Fruit lineage, focusing on soul binding and soul consuming, rather than being generally related to souls.
After devouring the Specter Monarch, the Devouring Dao Fruit enhanced its speed in devouring souls.
Venerable Ying Long was completely unable to attack using his soul!
Dragon roars resounded through the sky as Venerable Ying Long and the Emperor Lord's clone's battle grew more terrifying, with chilling auras. The Emperor Lord's clone fought more fiercely as the battle went on, while Venerable Ying Long showed signs of fatigue, appearing as if he might fall at any moment.
"Venerable Immortal, it seems your abilities are not as fearsome as the legends suggest." The Specter Monarch laughed heartily, looking disdainfully at Venerable Ying Long, finding great pleasure in suppressing and even killing such an ancient figure.
"Is this the extent of your abilities, how mediocre!"
"Are you too weak, or is my lord's clone too strong?"
"Victors rise to power and losers are put to shame, I'll take the Tribulation Dao Fruit now!"
Just when the Specter Monarch thought the situation was under control, the Venerable Ying Long, who filled the sky, began to shrink rapidly, ultimately turning into a man who resembled an emperor and at the same time an otherworldly Immortal, with both distinct atmospheres harmoniously coexisting within him.
"So this is your true form, Venerable Immortal. Have you become smaller to facilitate your escape..."
The Specter Monarch spoke casually, continuing to mock, but before he could finish, he saw the Yingtian Immortal instantly move in front of the Emperor Lord's clone, so fast it was unimaginable, and grabbed the clone's neck.
```
"You, you have a physical body!" Specter Monarch looked incredulously at the real Yingtian Immortal, no longer speaking with the previous arrogance.
Yingtian Immortal coldly eyed the Specter Monarch hiding within the Emperor Lord's clone and said calmly, "Fool, since you know that I am the Ancestor of Refining, did you not think I could use Immortal Gold to craft a body for myself?"
Though saying this, in reality, he had only crafted part of his body from Immortal Gold, and many parts still lacked form.
But it was more than enough to deal with the Emperor Lord's clone.
"If it weren't for my concern that using a stronger Power of Heavenly Tribulation would shatter this Small World and bring about Silent Extermination, how could your mere clone's Devouring Dao Fruit devour my Heavenly Tribulation?"
"Remember, this is the tribulation of arrogance and hubris."
"You, you can't kill me, if you kill me, it means making an enemy of our Great Qian, and our lord will not spare you!" Specter Monarch panicked, realizing he had vastly underestimated the horror of Yingtian Immortal.
This was no existence he could scheme against!
"Enough chatter." Yingtian Immortal exerted force in his right hand, and the intensely condensed Thunder Tribulation appeared in his palm, instantly shattering the Emperor Lord's clone to pieces, giving Specter Monarch no chance to even scream.
...
"How odd, the third infiltrator was holding a plaque with 'Ying Tian' written on it, about to attack Jinghong girl, and then got sucked into the Ancient Ring."
Lu Yang's heart stirred, "Could it be that there are clues related to Senior Yingtian Immortal within the Ancient Ring?"
"And isn't there the soul of a senior within the Ancient Ring? Could that senior be in danger?"
"Little Yang should go and see what's happening."
Lu Yang hurried over to Senior Sister Jinghong's side. Upon hearing her master's warning, Senior Sister Jinghong realized that a fierce battle was unfolding within the Ancient Ring and was so scared that she was unable to speak clearly.
After all, she did not have the same close encounter with an Immortal Battle like Lu Yang.
"Fairy, this..."
"Simple, Immortal shall pull you both in."
Without a second word, Immortal Fairy Eternity pulled both Lu Yang and Jinghong into the Small World of the Ancient Ring.
The Small World of the Ancient Ring was in ruins, clearly having gone through a great battle. Lu Yang and Immortal Fairy Eternity seemed to sense something and both looked up at the sky at the same time.
In the sky, the Emperor Lord's clone was gradually turning to dust in the hands of Yingtian Immortal, drifting away with the wind.
"Yingtian Immortal!" Immortal Fairy Eternity pointed excitedly at Yingtian Immortal and laughed joyfully, thrilled to encounter a living being at last.
Lu Yang had not expected Yingtian Immortal to be here; he thought at most there would be some clues related to Yingtian Immortal.
"There are reinforcements!" Feeling the entrance of others into the Ancient Ring, Yingtian Immortal mistook them for the reinforcements of the Great Qian Dynasty.
He looked down and saw Immortal Fairy Eternity, his heart sinking. Indeed, he had unintentionally drawn in an unwanted enemy: "Silent Extermination Immortal!"
Fired up, Immortal Fairy Eternity flew into the air and waved at Yingtian Immortal, "What Silent Extermination Immortal, it's me, Immortal Eternity."
Yet Yingtian Immortal did not believe her at all, scolding sharply, "What Immortal Eternity, you are too contemptuous, Silent Extermination. You have deceived me once, do you really think you can deceive me a second time?"
He had not been using his full strength in battle, afraid the Small World would not endure, leading to the arrival of Silent Extermination Immortal. Now that Silent Extermination Immortal had arrived, there was no need for restraint.
The Small World was filled with the power of Heavenly Tribulation, with endless tribulations appearing, terrifying to the extreme.
"Why don't you believe me? Oh, right, I'll explode one for you."
Seeing that Yingtian Immortal did not believe her, Immortal Fairy Eternity came up with a sudden plan, and without hesitation, prepared to self-detonate to prove it.
Yingtian Immortal's complexion drastically changed, this self-detonation seemed genuine, and he quickly retracted the power of Heavenly Tribulation, saying, "Wait, me, uh no, I believe..."
Boom!
```

chapters.title: Chapter 965 - 964: Rumors in Later Generations Are Truly Despicable
chapters.content:
```
A terrifying Immortal Soul explosion occurred above the small world of the Ancient Ring. Although it was tremendously powerful, Fairy Eternity deliberately controlled it so that the blast was very small, small enough to only affect Yingtian Immortal and not reach Lu Yang and Senior Sister Jinghong above and below.
"Cough cough—cough cough—" Yingtian Immortal coughed violently, feeling as if his soul was about to fly out of his Immortal Gold body.
Just now, the clone of the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord had swallowed half of his soul for ages, and yet it wasn't as forceful as this single blast.
In a blink of an eye, Fairy Eternity's soul recovered as if nothing had happened, and she asked eagerly, "How about that, do you believe me now? If not, I can explode a few more times."
Yingtian Immortal, his expression dazed from the soul explosion, regained consciousness when he heard these words and hastily gestured to preclude another blast, afraid that if he spoke too slowly, she would detonate again, "No, no, no, I believe you, I believe you."
This definitely wasn't Silent Extermination Immortal; even if he wanted to imitate such a method of self-detonation, he couldn't.
"You really are Immortal..." Yingtian Immortal asked subconsciously, then quickly realized his words might cause Fairy Eternity to misunderstand and hurriedly corrected himself, "Immortal, you were actually revived during this time."
Having seen the future of Immortal Fairy through a temporal passage in Ancient Times, Yingtian Immortal had never known exactly when this future was; it turned out to be after four hundred thousand years.
Fairy Eternity, seeing her long-lost friend again, was also delighted, "I've been revived for several years now, and I've been looking for you four everywhere without success. Xiao Ling and Lianyi have no idea where you all went. Finally, I've run into one of you. Where have you all been these years?"
"Ah, that's a long story."
"If it's a long story, let's not talk about it for now. Come, come, I'll take you to meet the person who revived me."
...
Although Senior Sister Jinghong was not injured by the Immortal Soul explosion, she was awakened by it. Upon coming to her senses, she found herself in the small world of the Ancient Ring, with Junior Brother Lu Yang at her side, and her master conversing in the sky with a youthful fairy.
Senior Sister Jinghong felt a bit bewildered, "Why does it seem like the master is speaking differently than usual, and how did the master transform?"
"Hasn't he always been human?"
"How could the master be human, he said he is Venerable Ying Long...wait a second, Junior Brother Lu Yang, you know the master?" Senior Sister Jinghong instinctively explained, then suddenly realized, listening to Junior Brother Lu Yang's undisturbed tone, it sounded as though he had known the master for a long time.
Lu Yang: "..."
So you, Yingtian Immortal, have always interacted with Senior Sister Jinghong in your Ying Long form?
Lu Yang sighed, "By a fortunate coincidence, I've heard some stories about your master and, by chance, seen him a few times, although not in person."
"Stories about the master, like how he talked about proving his path through strength, splitting the heavens with his axe, controlling calamities, subjugating Suiyue, and suppressing Kirin?"
"Stories about the master, for example, how he carved mountains with his axe, forging a splendid path of light for the Human race, or how he used Yin and Yang as a ploy, comprehended the Great Dao, transcended deathly tribulations, and gambled with the Qilin Immortal only to return to his senses a century later?"
Lu Yang thought for a moment; these might correspond respectively to Yingtian Immortal's youthful days when he was poor and would block travelers to extort toll fees.
And the time he avoided Immortal Fairy's dinner invitations by playing Go with Qilin Immortal for a hundred years.
"Er, roughly speaking, yes."
"Let me tell you, it's all because Lu Yang called out my name that I was revived. I have high expectations for this young man, Lu Yang, who is now the Second Boss of my Immortal Lineage..."
Immortal Fairy descended with Yingtian Immortal to introduce Lu Yang.
"I've had the honor of meeting Yingtian Immortal," Lu Yang quickly said. Although according to Immortal Fairy's descriptions, Yingtian Immortal was an Immortal with a quirky mind and poor luck, but he was still one of the top powerhouses in the world and not to be taken lightly.
Especially as he was privy to quite a few pieces of his shameful past, he hoped Yingtian Immortal would repay with kindness and not hold grudges against a younger generation like him.
"Hahaha, young friend, no need to be so formal. We, the Four Immortals, can't thank you enough for reviving Immortal; it's I who should be paying my respects to you," said Yingtian Immortal. He gave a formal bow, observing the most authentic Ancient Times ritual, and stated earnestly, "Thank you, Lu Yang."
"Master, who is this?"
```
"This is the Immortal that master mentioned, resurrected in this era. I didn't expect that."
"I've seen Senior Immortal before."
"This is the apprentice I've taken, someone you should all recognize, Jinghong. Although her talents are average, she has a good nature. Under my guidance, having cleansed marrow and refined essence, she's transformed completely and can be considered one of the top geniuses of our time."
