"However, I feel standing out too much could attract unnecessary trouble, so I've advised her to keep a low profile, and that's why she has remained unknown to the world."
"You've taken an apprentice?" Fairy Eternity remembered that the Yingtian Immortal had not taken any apprentices before.
"Explaining the cause and effect of this matter would be quite bothersome now; let's not talk about it at the moment. First, I will deal with the Great Qian cultivators outside."
Yingtian Immortal hadn't forgotten that there were two Divine Monarchs outside tasked with vanquishing demons and spirits. Since they're from the Fire Dynasty, it's apparent they're of the same ilk as the Specter Monarch. With the Specter Monarch here, those two should also be left behind."
"Do you intend to leave the Ancient Ring's small world?"
"No need for that, I have my own methods," Yingtian Immortal Ao Ran said with a smile.
...
"These attacks from Fairy Palace are like tickling, not the slightest powerful! Is this all you've got?" Demon-Removing Divine Monarch laughed heartily to embolden himself, cursing inwardly at the Specter Monarch for not making a move. So much time had passed.
If this went on, the Great Xia cultivators might come to aid Fairy Palace.
Indeed, not one of them on his side was reliable.
Facing the combined effort of three from Fairy Palace, Demon-Removing Divine Monarch could only defend passively, but Fairy Palace didn't have an offensive technique powerful enough to break his defense, nor did he have the means to escape from Fairy Palace.
The battle became a stalemate.
Just as the Demon-Removing Divine Monarch was grumbling about the Specter Monarch's inaction, an explosion echoed from deep within Fairy Palace.
"It's done!" the Demon-Removing Divine Monarch thought joyfully, finally able to wrap things up.
But no, the explosion did not come from the Laurel Tree Ancestor!
A wisp of red-gold fire erupted from beneath the Elixir Brewing Chamber and, even under the sunlight, shone brilliantly.
The red-gold fire transformed into a long spear and charged directly at the Demon-Removing Divine Monarch, who felt a sense of crisis looming. He crossed his arms over his chest, but the red-gold spear disregarded the defense, piercing through his arms and chest.
Then the spear turned pliable, coiling into a cord of fire that bound the Demon-Removing Divine Monarch, its scorching flames searing his skin, bones, and soul, causing him to scream in agony.
"Is this the Immortal Fire passed down from Ancient Times?" Zhui Yue True Person was astonished, as nobody had been able to refine or move this pile of Immortal Fire, so how could it have launched an attack on its own this time?
"Has it developed feelings for Fairy Palace, striking out in times of life-and-death crisis for the palace?"
...
"Isn't this the Immortal Fire left from my barbecue, now you can use it too?"
"Of course, it's yours, Immortal. Ever since the person behind the scenes erased your existence, many of your possessions became unclaimed, including this Immortal Fire."
"Since Jinghong needed this strand of Immortal Fire for cultivation, I covertly refined it."
"Speaking of which, the Mother-child River also became unclaimed property. Yet for some reason, rumors spread that I created it and that I had impure motives, am lustful for life, fancy married women, and have impregnated countless ladies."
"If I ever find out where these rumors started, I'll make the culprit understand what Immortal wrath is!"
Yingtian Immortal couldn't contain his rage when this subject came up, as the image he had worked hard to cultivate throughout this era had been tarnished overnight; this grudge was as grievous as one that blocks one's path.
"Spreading rumors in future generations is indeed detestable," Fairy Eternity and Lu Yang shared the same enemy and were filled with righteous indignation.

chapters.title: Chapter 966 - 965: Ashy Bean's Aim
chapters.content:
Spreading rumors was a matter that could not be traced to the main culprit for the time being, so Yingtian Immortal set it aside for now, preparing to reveal what Fairy Eternity did not know.
"Startling Swan, step outside for a moment, if you were to hear what I'm about to discuss, it could put your life at risk," Yingtian Immortal warned.
"Yes, Master," Startling Swan was very obedient and left the Ancient Ring's small world.
"And Lu Yang, young friend, you should also leave..."
"You mean the matter of another me? Lu Yang already knows about it," Fairy Eternity felt there was no need for Lu Yang to leave.
Yingtian Immortal suddenly realized, "That's right, you should be aware, or else you wouldn't have been attacked twice by the Silent Extermination Immortal."
"Since you've already come into contact with Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi, and Lu Yang, young friend, is in the initial stage of Spirit Transformation, I presume you have already undergone the Thunder Tribulation and seen the Immortal Sense I left behind.
I assume you both already know what happened from the time you, Fairy Eternity, fell, until the establishment of the Fire Dynasty," Yingtian Immortal said.
"There is no need to discuss that part of the story then; let's start from the end of the Fire Dynasty period," he proposed.
"When we thought we had successfully resurrected you, we realized that the one brought back to life was not all of you but the version of you from the time when you had the outline of the Annihilation Dao Fruit.
Nevertheless, resurrection in any form was a good thing, so we didn't ponder on it too much and even shared many post-ascension matters with that version of you," Yingtian Immortal recounted.
"That version of you, just like the real you, was extraordinarily talented with remarkable cultivation speed. She soon passed the Immortal Ascension Tribulation and achieved the Annihilation Dao Fruit, choosing the title 'Silent Extermination Immortal' for herself," he continued.
"Our resurrection of you was also driven by a desire to use your power to overcome the hidden mastermind behind the scenes," Yingtian Immortal admitted.
"After clashing with the hidden mastermind, we discovered they were incredibly powerful, their combat strength not the slightest bit inferior to yours, almost as if they had reached the pinnacle of the 'Immortal' realm," he explained.
"According to my conjecture, that hidden mastermind's Dao Fruit is likely the Causality Dao Fruit, which is extremely troublesome," Yingtian Immortal theorized.
"It was this very idea of defeating the hidden mastermind that led the situation to become uncontrollable," he declared.
"The Silent Extermination Immortal believed that to defeat the hidden mastermind, one must reach the level beyond an Immortal, which is 'Transcendence'," he revealed.
Lu Yang remembered Fairy Eternity mentioning realms above that of an Immortal—these theoretical realms of "Transcendence" and "Omniscience" that no one had ever reached.
"To achieve Transcendence, one must sever all ties of causality; everyone who is aware of her existence would create causality with her," Yingtian Immortal disclosed.
Lu Yang nodded; Fairy Eternity had discussed similar content with him when he met the second Great Yu National Preceptor.
"Therefore, for the Silent Extermination Immortal to achieve Transcendence, she needed to kill everyone who knew of her existence, including everyone from the Fire Dynasty and us, the Four Immortals," Yingtian Immortal revealed the grim conclusion.
"At the onset of the battle, as the Silent Extermination Immortal had only recently ascended and her combat strength was not yet remarkable, but as she killed more and more people, her strength soared uncontrollably," he recalled.
"If the four of us, along with the Left Historian Immortal who, though not much of a fighter, was still an Immortal, joined forces, the Five Immortals together would have been enough to suppress the Silent Extermination Immortal," Yingtian Immortal claimed.
"You must have heard from my Immortal Sense that it was around that time when the Time Immortal was assassinated, and the only one capable of that was the hidden mastermind," Yingtian Immortal mentioned.
Lu Yang nodded; only a being like the hidden mastermind could assassinate the Time Immortal.
"I heard from the Immortal Sense of Yingtian Immortal that after the fall of Time Immortal, the remaining Four Immortals no longer joined forces against the enemy. Why was that?" Lu Yang asked, sensing an inconsistency in the story.
At that time, Lu Yang had found it quite strange, feeling as if something was missing.
"My Immortal Sense was not aware of the intermediary process, hence there are some inconsistencies in the story," Yingtian Immortal admitted.
"At that time, considering the possibility of the hidden mastermind's sneak attack, we designed an Array Method, the core of which was us, the Four Immortals," he elaborated.
"If any one of us were attacked by outsiders, the other three would be instantly transported to the scene to fight the enemy together."
At this point, Yingtian Immortal's voice grew even more somber, "But when Time Immortal was attacked, the array method did not activate."
"This means that the assailant of Time Immortal was none other than one of us three!"
"With the methods of the secret attackers, it's entirely possible that one of us had already been possessed before Time Immortal met with misfortune!"
Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity were both startled upon hearing this.
"Had we chosen to join forces against Silent Extermination Immortal at that time, we would have inevitably been ambushed by the secret attackers, and none of us would have survived!"
"Therefore, after realizing this issue, the Kirin, Jiuchong, and I no longer trusted each other, and even stopped meeting altogether, each fighting our own battles."
"Meanwhile, Silent Extermination Immortal has been looking for our whereabouts in order to advance to transcendence."
"Perhaps the moment she kills me, the Kirin, Jiuchong, and Ao Ling, and no one knows of her existence, will be when she achieves transcendence."
"Silent Extermination Immortal seems to be able to locate those who know of her existence through causality."
"We then discovered that as long as we hid inside a 'Small World' level space, Silent Extermination Immortal would not be able to find us."
"I remember Ao Ling was hiding inside the Dragon Ball, which has a Small World level space inside. As soon as Ao Ling left the Dragon Ball, Silent Extermination Immortal immediately found him."
The space of Lu Yang's Green Peak Sword is also of Small World level.
Most Small World level spaces are fixed in one place and cannot be moved, which are the top-level secret realms.
Objects like the Ancient Ring, Dragon Ball, and Green Peak Sword are all Immortal Artifacts, extremely rare.
"Hiding in the Small World, not only must the body hide in it, but also the Spiritual Sense must not be projected outside, lest Silent Extermination Immortal detects it."
"After I hid in a certain secret realm, I could only learn about the outside world through cultivators who entered the secret realm. However, secret realms are not always open, and the cultivators' knowledge is not comprehensive."
"So I refined this Ancient Ring that contains a Small World, allowing cultivators who stumbled into the secret realm to take the ring. I guided the cultivators in cultivation, and in return, they had to tell me everything they saw and heard."
"From that cultivator, I learned that a Nascent Soul cultivator had appeared in the outside world, with extraordinary combat power, a Nascent Soul capable of fighting on its own, and a tree tablet on their chest, which sounded very much like a cultivator you, Fairy Eternity, had nurtured."
"Moreover, through the time passage, although I couldn't see the appearance of the cultivator standing beside you, I felt the presence of a Firmament Tree Tablet on his chest."
"I thought you, Fairy Eternity, had been resurrected and went directly there."
"But upon arrival, I discovered that it was a trap set by Silent Extermination Immortal!"
"Silent Extermination Immortal was so powerful at that point that I stood no chance, and after a battle, I fled with severe injuries."
"I was so grievously wounded, however, that the Dao Charm of the Annihilation Dao Fruit wreaked havoc within me. In order to survive, I desperately performed the Corpse Detachment Method."
"The outcome was that while I was still severely injured, I managed to erase the Dao Charm of Annihilation, sparing my life, but the downside was that I lost my physical body. My body gained its own Spiritual Wisdom and sought to devour me."
"I had to run away and hide in the Ancient Ring's Small World to heal, while also searching for a suitable cultivator to continue informing me about the outside world."
"Three hundred thousand years passed, and the Ancient Ring came into the possession of this child, Startling Swan."

chapters.title: Chapter 967 - 966 I've Also Told Him Many Ancient Anecdotes
chapters.content:
"The last Cultivator who possessed the Ancient Ring perished in the Secret Realm, a place accessible only to those at the Foundation Establishment Stage. At that time, Startling Swan was merely at the early stage of Foundation Establishment, yet she displayed great prowess within the Secret Realm, and by a stroke of luck, she obtained me."
"I saw that Startling Swan had good character and was a talent worth molding. With some cultivation, she might someday advance to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, or even become Semi-Immortal, living longer, which would save me the trouble of frequently changing people."
"So I revealed my identity, expressing my hope to take her as a disciple, and whether she was willing. With such an opportunity, Startling Swan naturally wouldn't miss it and became my disciple."
Lu Yang thought to himself, when you say revealed your identity, do you mean your identity as Venerable Ying Long?
Of course, that was something he only dared to think, not to say out loud.
"Afterward, I helped Startling Swan with Immortal Power to cleanse her marrow and refine her essence, enhance her aptitude, change her Spirit Root, impart Immortal Techniques and Immortal Methods, and teach her the Art of Refining. When she went out on missions, I also helped her analyze the situation and guided her to think, allowing her to come up with the answers herself.
Worried that she might be too conspicuous and attract the attention of Silent Extermination Immortal, I advised her to keep a low profile and avoid trouble."
Lu Yang: "..."
Everyone has an Immortal helping them, so why is there such a big difference?
As the topic came up, Fairy Eternity grew enthusiastic: "Oh, then we're pretty much the same. After Lu Yang revived me, to repay him for my resurrection, I helped him..."
Fairy Eternity suddenly faltered. Little Yang had top-notch aptitude, not requiring any enhancement; as for Immortal Techniques and Immortal Methods, he did not learn them; regarding Artifact Refining Technique, I didn't know it myself. While he carried out missions, in order to cultivate Little Yang's independent thinking, I was mostly there to enjoy the show.
"Attracting trouble," Lu Yang helpfully reminded.
"Oh, right, I helped him attract trouble... Eh?"
Seeing that Fairy Eternity realized something, Lu Yang quickly added, "Fairy, you also taught me the Playing Dead Technique."
Yingtian Immortal nodded: "The technique of deceiving the heavens and defying fate, it seems Fairy Eternity truly values you."
"... These two descriptions are for the same magic skill?"
"Of course it's the same magic skill, it's just that Immortal Fairy's naming is more plain, while I prefer to add some decorative words, that's all."
Realizing he had digressed, Yingtian Immortal steered the conversation back: "Young friend Lu Yang has a unique approach to things, and carries the spirit of youth. I've heard many things about you from Startling Swan, and what really caught my attention was the incident when you were attacked by Silent Extermination Immortal in the East Sea."
"Not only did you survive that time, but when you encountered Silent Extermination Immortal later in the Sword Tower, you lived again, completely unharmed."
"To have come out unscathed both times, even I can't manage that, which led me to suspect that you might be a bait set by Silent Extermination Immortal."
"Although I also heard that during your advance to the Divinity Transformation Stage, you encountered the Qian Heaven Thunder Tribulation, which could either be fabricated by Silent Extermination Immortal or perhaps indicate that you are indeed the person I have been searching for."
"I'm not sure which is the case, so after you arrived at the Fairy Palace, I instructed Startling Swan to keep her distance from you."
"Judging from your actions in the Fairy Palace, I once suspected that you had cultivated a Harem Golden Core. I intended to continue observing to confirm your identity, but then this mishap occurred, and Fairy Immortality brought you directly to the Ancient Ring's Small World, which has actually made things easier."
"What's with this body of yours?" Fairy Eternity noticed that Yingtian Immortal's body wasn't made of flesh and blood, but an incomplete construct made of Immortal Gold, with only the arms and legs crafted from Immortal Gold material, while the rest was made from more common substances.
"That's because I lost my body. I'm not afraid when my corpse comes knocking, dealing with that fool is not a problem, it's just that I can't locate his position."
"What I truly fear is Silent Extermination Immortal showing up. I couldn't beat him even at my prime, let alone now when I am just a soul."
"To ensure self-protection, I crafted this body for myself. However, given my limited range of movement, I couldn't find enough Immortal Gold, so for the time being, I've had to make do with other materials."
"If my entire body was forged from Immortal Gold, I could almost return to my peak state," Lu Yang muttered.
"As for Immortal Gold... I remember after we killed your body, it left behind quite a bit of Immortal Gold. It's just that Ashy Bean mixed it all up, and now we can't tell them apart," said another.
Yingtian Immortal's eyes lit up, "That's not a problem. I can slowly refine it and eventually separate the Immortal Gold."
His dead body must have collected a massive amount of Immortal Gold to deal with him, enough for him to forge a complete body.
It turns out a corpse really is the most useful only after it's dead.
"Speaking of which, do you know what the deal is with the Heavenly Court? I heard that Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi have joined the Heavenly Court. Could it be that the Silent Extermination Immortal established it? But that doesn't make sense either. If the Silent Extermination Immortal established the Heavenly Court, how could Jiang Lianyi join?"
"Or did the Silent Extermination Immortal disguise herself as you, Fairy Eternity, and trick Jiang Lianyi into joining the Heavenly Court?"
"It doesn't seem like something the Kirin or Immortal Jiuchong would do; being so ostentatious would attract the attention of Silent Extermination Immortal."
Previously when Yingtian Immortal heard that the Ancient Heavenly Court had made a sudden appearance, his heart had clenched tight.
The mere thought of the Ancient Heavenly Court sounded like the handiwork of the Silent Extermination Immortal.
"Actually, the Heavenly Court was something I made up," Lu Yang said, scratching his head embarrassingly. He hadn't expected the Heavenly Court, which he initially created to deceive the Jiuyou Sect, to grow so big now.
"You made it up?" Yingtian Immortal was extremely shocked. He had always regarded the Ancient Heavenly Court as a formidable enemy, only to discover it was constructed by one of their own.
"Then who is Heavenly Venerate Dou?"
"That's me! My name is Yellow Bean," said Fairy Eternity proudly, clearly satisfied with her identity as Heavenly Venerate Dou.
"So your real name is Yellow Bean," Yingtian Immortal said with a laugh and tears, realizing only now that in his joy at Fairy Eternity's revival, he had completely forgotten to ask her name.
His name was Si Qi; the Qilin Immortal was called Shi He; Immortal Jiuchong was called Yinong; and the Time Immortal was called Sui Qi. Her name really didn't fit with the four of them.
"However, the name 'Heavenly Court' must not have simply come out of nowhere, Lu Yang my friend. You must have heard this name from somewhere." If it were a coincidence, it would be too fortuitous.
"Of course, I told him about how the four of us fabricated the story of the Heavenly Court together, each of us concocting different versions to fool posterity," she revealed.
"I see," Yingtian Immortal nodded in understanding. With this explanation, it all made sense.
"It's not just the Heavenly Court. When we're idle, I've also told him many ancient anecdotes, like how you four would eat my food then immediately fall asleep, how Ying Tian you would often lecture cultivators to maintain their stature, the Immortal Sword you helped the Kirin Immortal refine that would go limp upon touch.
Oh, and Lu Yang even found the book 'Immortal's Quotations.' That's a great book; I thought it was lost forever..."
Fairy Eternity talked excitedly, not noticing that with each story she told, Yingtian Immortal's expression changed a little more.
But Lu Yang noticed.
Yingtian Immortal, previously all smiles, now had a face so dark it looked like it could drip water.
He patted Lu Yang's shoulder with a smile, "I see that my young friend Lu Yang's cultivation still lacks a bit of experience. As a cultivator, the most important thing is cultivation. You must ascend to the Void Refinement Stage as soon as possible."
"Don't worry, with me around, when you ascend to the Void Refinement Stage and face the Thunder Tribulation, you will certainly be safe and sound."

chapters.title: Chapter 968 - 967 Fairy, Let's Not Have Fate in Our Next Life
chapters.content:
Although Ying Tian Immortal was smiling, Lu Yang couldn't feel a trace of warmth from his smile.
Lu Yang swallowed hard, realizing that he still couldn't escape this calamity.
Moreover, from the "Immortal's Quotations" found in the Twin River space, if he remembered correctly, it wasn't just the words of Ying Tian Immortal; it contained everything said by the Four Ancient Immortals…
Was this the test of a fairy? It seemed exceedingly difficult.
My destiny isn't strong enough, this life probably ends here.
Fairy, if we are fated, let's meet in the next life.
"There's no need to give him a backdoor favor." Immortal Fairy still cared a lot for Lu Yang, which deeply moved him, as if he had found a lifesaver.
"Didn't you say that the more powerful the Thunder Tribulation, the better the subsequent nourishing effects for the cultivator? Just set him up with the difficult trials."
Ying Tian Immortal nodded with a smile, his hands behind his back, "Naturally, naturally."
Lu Yang: "..."
Fairy, let's not be fated in the next life, I'm afraid I will end up under your hands in my next life too.
"Do you plan to stay in this Small World forever?"
"I'll stay here until Startling Swan completes her training," Ying Tian Immortal was thorough in his actions from beginning to end.
"Would you like to join us on a trip to Seek Dao Sect? Miss Yun probably wants to see you too."
"Who is Miss Yun?"
"Lu Yang's Eldest Senior Sister."
Ying Tian Immortal thought for a moment and felt that meeting her would be alright, "Sure."
"Oh right, I just exchanged hands with that Ghost Monarch from Great Qian, and he left behind these four tokens." Ying Tian Immortal pulled out four tokens from behind his waist. The tokens were hard in texture; not even the Emperor clone could survive the Thunder Tribulation, yet these tokens remained, showing their extraordinary origin.
The token engraved with the words "Ying Tian" in Ying Tian Immortal's hand was so hot it almost started burning.
However, Ying Tian Immortal had an arm of Immortal Gold, and this temperature felt no different from cool water to him.
The other three tokens were separately inscribed with the words "Suiyue," "Kirin," and "Jiuchong."
"He must have found me through this token. The closer this token gets to me, the hotter it gets; I haven't figured out the principle behind it yet."
"The other three tokens should function similarly. They are of no use to me, it would be better for Young Friend Lu Yang to keep them."
Lu Yang took the three tokens.
Seeing the conversation was about done, Immortal Fairy took Lu Yang out of the Ancient Ring Small World, arriving in the outside world.
Startling Swan was waiting outside, curious about what her master was discussing, but she couldn't inquire as it was against her master's orders. Seeing Lu Yang finally come out, she couldn't help but ask, "Junior Brother Lu Yang, you finally came out. What about that very beautiful fairy?"
Lu Yang tapped his temple, "In my mind."
"How is the battle situation now?"
"With Master using Immortal Fire to take action, the Demon-Removing Divine Monarch was quickly captured; the Demon-Subduing Divine Monarch has yet to emerge from the Restraining Light Treasure Box."
Lu Yang nodded; with things progressing to this stage, the battle situation was basically settled.
No further mishaps to fear, as they had two immortals on their side.
A little while later, the Demon-Removing Master from the Hanging Temple and Shangguan Yu of the Five Elements Sect received the message and rushed to assist the Immortal Palace, joining forces to subdue both the Demon-Subduing and Demon-Removing Divine Monarchs.
"With that level also daring to come to our Immortal Palace," Chasing Moon True Person said, flushed with triumph.
"Damn it, I knew we couldn't rely on the Specter Monarch!" the two Divine Monarchs couldn't hold back anymore and cursed loudly. The Specter Monarch, favored by the Emperor and in charge of commanding this operation, used them as bait while he took the credit for chopping down the trees.
And after everything was done, there was no sign of the Specter Monarch.
"Look on the bright side, maybe the Specter Monarch encountered an Immortal and is already dead," the Demon-Subduing God Lord maliciously speculated.
"Greetings to the seniors." Shangguan Yu bowed to Chasing Moon True Person and Bai Ye.
Master Jiesha was still practicing Silent Zen and could only clasp his hands to express his greetings.
"What seniors? I just have some connections with the Immortal Palace and happened to pass by and lend a hand when they were in trouble," Chasing Moon True Person could not admit his true identity.
"If the senior says so, then it must be true," Shangguan Yu smiled. She was quite happy to converse with Chasing Moon True Person; it made her feel younger.
"Hey, you youngster!"
Lan Ting and Tao Yaoye also hurried over.
"Senior Brother, you're here! You weren't here when we came earlier."
During the battle, the two of them searched everywhere for Lu Yang, but at that time, Lu Yang had entered the Small World of the Ancient Ring, so naturally, they couldn't find him.
"Junior Sister Lan, Junior Sister Tao, are you both alright?"
"We're fine, we're fine." Seeing Lu Yang, the two inevitably thought of the grand battle that had unfolded around him in the guest room, and their cheeks turned red with embarrassment.
"If the two Junior Sisters are feeling confused about what happened earlier, you needn't worry. As far as I know, it was an uncontrolled Dao Fruit Outline that sparked the subsequent events."
"Yes, yes, yes, it was all the Dao Fruit Outline's fault!" The two of them didn't bother with the actual reason, preferring to follow Lu Yang's lead and push the blame onto Chasing Moon True Person.
As for the truth, it didn't matter.
Later, Bai Ye also found Lu Yang and apologized, "Elder Brother Lu Yang, I'm sorry. I can't leave the Immortal Palace right now. Wait for me to deal with the Great Qian Cultivators and then I'll come find you at Seek Dao Sect to hang out."
"Alright, I'll wait for you at Seek Dao Sect," Lu Yang smiled. Among all the people he had met at the Immortal Palace, he found Bai Ye the easiest to communicate with.
Fortunately, at the start of the battle, most of the Disciples of the Immortal Palace had chased after Lu Yang's Wooden Avatar and were far from the battlefield, so they were not affected.
However, the buildings near the entrance of the Immortal Palace were all damaged in the fight. These buildings, having stood there for at least ten thousand years, some even from the day the Immortal Palace was established.
"As long as no one was hurt, it's fine," Chasing Moon True Person said, signaling that the Immortal Palace need not fret over such matters.
"Speaking of which, today is Mid-Autumn Festival," Chasing Moon True Person noticed a plate of mooncakes on the table and suddenly remembered that today was Mid-Autumn Festival. Due to her prolonged lifespan, she often lost track of time.
"Ah Ri, I won't be using this avatar today," Bai Ye said. She liked using this avatar but wasn't restricted to it alone; not using it meant none of the issues of reversing yin and yang or changing identities.
The great battle concluded, and the Immortal Palace was filled with jubilation. Originally planning to leave immediately, Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye decided to stay the night before departing.
"Senior Brother, have some mooncake," Lan Ting said cheerily, stuffing a mooncake into Lu Yang's mouth.
"Eat up, I've tasted it myself this time; it's not poisoned, and it won't make you bigger or smaller."
Lu Yang took a bite of the mooncake filled with laurel flower, finding it refreshingly unique.
"Junior Sister Tao, would you like some?" Lu Yang also handed Tao Yaoye a piece of mooncake.
As the snow fell thickly, the three of them lay on the snowy ground, gazing at the bright moon above and feeling that the years were peacefully passing by.
The next day, Lu Yang and Tao Yaoye set off, each carrying a package prepared by Lan Ting, filled with laurel flower-stuffed mooncakes and special Spirit Fruit from the Immortal Palace.
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, Junior Sister Tao, come visit our Immortal Palace whenever you have time," Lan Ting waved goodbye to the two.
"Definitely," Lu Yang turned around and shouted back, also waving his hand.
Lan Ting and Tao Yaoye didn't notice that Lu Yang's middle finger wore a black ancient ring.

chapters.title: Chapter 969 - 968: Elder Brother Dai, I've Also Brought Back a Hermit Expert
chapters.content:
Sky Gate Mountain peak.
"...I see Junior Brother Dai's complexion looks much better than it did a few years ago, is it because you're handling the Task Hall more and more skillfully?"
"Being skillful is one aspect, but the most important thing is that The Three Great Demon Sects have settled down quite a bit, no longer needing to exhaust our minds analyzing their intelligence. Speaking of which, I really have to thank Junior Brother Lu for that."
Dai Bufan took a sip of Enlightenment Tea, comfortably reclining in the Emperor's Chair, looking particularly contented.
If this were before, when would he have such leisure to come to Sky Gate Mountain to drink tea and chat with Eldest Senior Sister? He would've already been hunched over a desk organizing and analyzing intelligence, issuing tasks.
"Although Junior Brother's methods are unique, he often yields results beyond expectations, and Dai should have some feelings about this."
"Who knows what luck Junior Brother Lu has, something happens wherever he goes. I just heard that there was a scuffle at the Fairy Palace yesterday—they captured two cultivators from the Great Qian, one at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, one a Semi-Immortal."
Dai Bufan drained his cup of Enlightenment Tea and then nonchalantly poured himself another.
Back then, he would be startled upon hearing reports from Lu Yang about fights involving individuals at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage or those between Semi-Immortals.
Now that his spiritual resolve had been tested over time, battles involving those at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage or Semi-Immortals were no longer enough to disrupt his tranquility.
"It seems the cultivators of Great Qian can no longer restrain themselves."
"Eldest Senior Sister, I'm back." Lu Yang waved at Yun Zhi, his face brimming with a joyful smile.
"Elder Brother Dai is here too, huh."
Lu Yang was quite surprised to see Dai Bufan; he rarely saw Dai Bufan come to Sky Gate Mountain.
"You've returned from the Fairy Palace?" Yun Zhi signaled with her eyes for Lu Yang to sit down.
She had just been to the Fairy Palace a couple of days ago to feed Elder Zhu Hong a bowl of water from the Twin River, and she didn't expect that just two days later, the Fairy Palace would be attacked by cultivators from Great Qian. Fortunately, there were no casualties.
"Eldest Senior Sister, Elder Brother Dai, please try these mooncakes and Spirit Fruit; they're specialities of the Fairy Palace."
Lu Yang took out two packages from his Identity Jade, one contained mooncakes filled with Laurel Flower, and the other contained shrunken Spirit Fruit that he found delicious after trying.
"Junior Brother is thoughtful." Yun Zhi picked up a Spirit Fruit and started to nibble on it.
Having many interactions with the Fairy Palace, she had eaten her share of mooncakes and Spirit Fruit, but since they were a gesture from Junior Brother, they carried a different significance.
Dai Bufan, taking a piece of mooncake, ate it along with the Enlightenment Tea, "Mooncakes with Laurel Flower filling, huh? I really haven't eaten these in a while, Junior Brother Lu is considerate."
"Junior Brother Lu, did you acquire anything from your trip to the Laurel Fairy Palace?"
Lu Yang thought to himself that Elder Brother Dai truly had a divine insight; indeed, his trip to the Fairy Palace was worthwhile, and he had gained a lot.
"Just yesterday, the Demon-Subduing and Demon-Removing Divine Monarchs from the Great Qian Dynasty entered the Fairy Palace, aiming to sever the Laurel Tree Ancestor, with the Demon-Subduing Divine Monarch at the Late Tribulation Stage and the Demon-Removing Divine Monarch a Semi-Immortal.
However, the Fairy Palace was guarded by Patriarch Fang, the Laurel Tree Ancestor, and Chasing Moon True Person, who jointly repelled the attackers without causing any harm to the Fairy Palace."
Upon hearing this, Dai Bufan did not show much surprise but merely responded calmly, "Oh? Is the Semi-Immortal on the Fairy Palace's side indeed Chasing Moon True Person?"
The intelligence he had received indicated "suspected to be Chasing Moon True Person," but to Lu Yang, the identity was affirmed.
"Due to a fortunate coincidence, I came to know some truths."
"The Laurel Tree Ancestor has developed Spiritual Wisdom and become a true sentient being, named Bai Ye. Chasing Moon True Person encountered some difficulties in his cultivation and had no choice but to share a Laurel Avatar with Bai Ye—Chasing Moon uses it during the day, and Bai Ye uses it at night."
"Bai Ye enjoys listening to my stories. During my time at the Fairy Palace, she sought me out every night. As time passed, I became familiar with her."
"Ah, so that's how it is." Dai Bufan nodded thoughtfully, as if contemplating fate, and took another bite of mooncake together with Junior Brother Lu.
"Since Bai Ye and Chasing Moon True Person can't leave Great Snow Mountain, Bai Ye suggested moving one of the mountains to our Seek Dao Sect. That way, she and Chasing Moon True Person can come over too. It seems she plans to stay for a long time."
"Cough, cough, cough—" Dai Bufan choked on the mooncake and began to cough violently, thumping his chest.
"Elder Brother Dai, are you alright?" Lu Yang asked with concern.
Dai Bufan struggled to swallow the mooncake and gestured with his hand that he was fine, then looked at Lu Yang with an odd expression, "You mean to say, you've enticed both the Laurel Tree Ancestor and the founder of the Fairy Palace to our Seek Dao Sect?"
Lu Yang hastily cleared himself of the association, "It was Bai Ye's idea; it has nothing to do with me."
"It's definitely related to you, youngster." Dai Bufan knew not to take Lu Yang's words at face value.
Yun Zhi hadn't expected Bai Ye and Chasing Moon True Person to come to their Seek Dao Sect either.
"Is there anything else?" Dai Bufan spoke with annoyance. He thought he was mentally prepared, but Lu Yang's actions still managed to astonish him.
"Right, right, there's one more thing. I met a hidden expert in the Fairy Palace; his cultivation level is unfathomably deep. I've invited him to come back with me. Would you like to meet him, Elder Brother Dai?"
"A hidden expert?" Dai Bufan was puzzled. "Where?"
Lu Yang showed the black ancient ring on his right middle finger, "In this ancient ring that contains a small world of its own."
"Then, please, Junior Brother Lu, do the honors and introduce us," Dai Bufan said, recognizing that knowing the information about a reclusive expert was also part of gathering intelligence.
Yun Zhi raised an eyebrow, instinctively feeling that the "hidden expert" Junior Brother Lu mentioned was no ordinary being, and followed along with Lu Yang and Dai Bufan into the small world within the ancient ring.
Inside the ancient ring's small world, mist filled the air, limiting visibility. Even Dai Bufan's Spiritual Sense was of no use here; the mist seemed to have the ability to block it.
A massive figure flickered in the distance, indiscernible, its identity unknown, causing Dai Bufan to feel inexplicably anxious.
"Junior Brother Lu, where is the hidden expert you spoke of?" Dai Bufan asked in a low voice.
Lu Yang didn't speak but pointed above them.
Dai Bufan looked up and saw the huge figure, shrouded in mist, had at some point moved closer—a gargantuan and elongated form.
The surrounding mist parted on its own, revealing only the immense dragon's head, crafted as if from solid gold.
The dragon's head lowered, its glass-like eyes reflecting Dai Bufan's form.
Dai Bufan shuddered. The dragon's head wasn't releasing any intentional pressure, yet he could still sense a terrifying force emanating from it—an aura unique to those who have long held positions of power.
This reclusive expert was undoubtedly a significant figure.
"Junior Brother Lu, just who is this Great Power?"
"This is Venerable Ying Long, whom the East Sea Dragon Clan worships, who is also known, in another identity, as one of the Four Ancient Immortals—Yingtian Immortal—and controls the Power of Heavenly Tribulation. With Elder Yingtian Immortal here, Elder Brother Dai, your future heavenly tribulation will surely be safe."
The golden Immortal Dragon spoke in a human tongue, its language holy and ancient, echoing with the desolation of the olden times: "Descendant of later generations, are you the one who wished to meet me?"
Elder Brother Dai's eyes rolled back, and with a clatter, he fainted.
Yingtian Immortal, troubled, scratched his dragon scales with a claw, "Why are the cultivators of later generations so faint-hearted?"

chapters.title: Chapter 970 - 969: Later Generations, Do You Dare to Compete with Me?
chapters.content:
"Little Dai still needs to toughen up his courage." Fairy Eternity appeared, noting that although Junior Brother Dai's cultivation level was higher than Little Yang's, his courage was far less.
"Is this the Yingtian Immortal?" Yun Zhi eyed the Venerable Ying Long with a hint of curiosity. It seemed Junior Brother had really gained a lot from his visit to the Fairy Palace, even finding the Yingtian Immortal who had been missing for three hundred thousand years.
"Yes, the fairy and I happened to encounter Elder Yingtian Immortal in the Fairy Palace."
Venerable Ying Long landed, spewing mist, his dragon eyes reflecting Yun Zhi's expressionless face.
"Young one, are you the Eldest Senior Sister mentioned by Lu Yang?"
"Immortal Eternity speaks highly of you as well, hoping I would come to see you."
"It's but a gracious overestimation from the elder fairy."
"Overestimation or not, let me test it myself. Young one from the later generations, dare you compete with me?"
Yun Zhi clasped her fists in ancient courtesy, "Then please enlighten me, Elder Yingtian Immortal."
This was not part of the plan, Lu Yang quickly intervened, "Elder Yingtian Immortal, this might not be appropriate?"
Venerable Ying Long laughed heartily, "Rest assured, Lu Yang my friend, I never bully others by abusing my position. Since you are worried about your Eldest Senior Sister, I shall let her have three moves."
"That's not what I meant..."
"Enough, an immortal's word is immutable. Thus, it is settled!"
"Elder Yingtian Immortal is indeed noble." Yun Zhi spoke sincerely; she had never met anyone in battle who dared to give her three moves. Yingtian Immortal was the first.
Yingtian Immortal also loved battle, his dragon form coiling in the high heavens like a legendary Supreme Immortal King, "Young one of future generations, feel free to strike. I wish to see what abilities you possess!"
Suddenly, Fairy Eternity remembered something very important and loudly reminded, "Right, Yingtian, last time in the East Sea, it was Miss Yun who drove away another one of me!"
"Ah? Not this fellow daoist here..."
"Cloud Falling Palm."
Above the Small World, a perfectly white auspicious cloud appeared, which condensed and transformed into the form of a palm, descending rapidly. The palm was so large that one couldn't see its ends, even larger than Venerable Ying Long's body.
The cloud palm fell, shattering layers of space, and directly slapped Venerable Ying Long to the ground.
Yingtian Immortal felt that the palm contained countless worlds, its weight staggeringly immense, and the attack was aimed directly at the soul—he couldn't even dodge it!
Dai Bufan groggily woke up, his mind muddled, somewhat forgetting why he had awakened in the first place.
"Did I just see the legendary Yingtian Immortal? And he mentioned visiting our sect."
Dai Bufan remembered. He had seen a golden Immortal Dragon, majestic beyond words, the very Yingtian Immortal of many legends, the Ancestor of Refining.
"Where is Yingtian Immortal?"
Struggling to prop himself up, he saw Yun Zhi slap Venerable Ying Long to the ground, dust billowing, and vaguely saw the giant dragon writhing in pain on the ground.
"Forget it, I might as well go back to sleep."
Dai Bufan felt he might not have fully woken up yet, and he fell back to sleep.
"Primordial Formlessness."
Another palm strike turned Venerable Ying Long into a state like Yingtian Immortal, feeling his limbs of Immortal Gold tremble uncontrollably, as if they were not under his own command.
"Primordial Formlessness."
"Heaven Encircling Immortal Thunder! Immovable Immortal Thunder! Golden Palace Immortal Thunder!" Fellow Daoist Ying Tian gathered the Supreme Immortal Thunder, which transformed into layers of barriers. They shielded in front of him, the multiple Immortal Thunders interacting and changing, condensing into a Thunder Lightning Immortal Shield.
Then, with a loud strike, he was blown away by Yun Zhi, tossed a great distance before plunging headfirst into the world barrier of the Small World.
Fellow Daoist Ying Tian propped against the world barrier, pulled his head out with a popping sound, feeling his head buzzing.
First, the Immortal Fairy's self-detonation delivered a fierce blow, and then Yun Zhi's three moves sent him flying. Why had he been hit repeatedly these last two days, and by his own people at that?
In ancient times, whenever Immortal was around, he would inexplicably fail at acting impressive. Why was it still the same now?
Fellow Daoist Ying Tian walked over with a confident stride, his aura relaxed. "Hahaha, Fellow Daoist Yun truly has her ways, but as Immortals, we seek freedom and ease. Persistently proving strength could end up as disadvantageous. Our encounter should stop at exchanging insights. I see no need for us to vie for superiority, don't you think?"
"Fellow Daoist Ying Tian speaks sense."
Yun Zhi glanced at Dai Bufan, who lay sleeping on the ground. "Strange, during the battle just now, it seemed like Junior Brother Dai woke up?"
Seeing that Dai Bufan couldn't wake up anytime soon, she formed a hand seal, and Dai Bufan automatically flew out of the Ancient Ring Small World and back to the Task Hall. It was then that they started discussing important matters.
"Senior Fairy, Junior Brother, how did you find Fellow Daoist Ying Tian?"
Fellow Daoist Yun, no rush, let's sit down and talk slowly."
With a thought from Fellow Daoist Ying Tian, the ground morphed and grew four chairs connected to the floor.
The Ancient Ring Small World was meticulously refined by him and could freely change its shape.
"Yesterday's invaders of the Fairy Palace were not only the Demon-Removing Divine Monarch masquerading about, but another also sneaked into the Fairy Palace..."
After listening, Yun Zhi pondered for a while. "So that's it. The Mid-heaven Emperor Lord tried to open the world, and his clone possesses the ability to devour. From this, it can be deduced that he himself holds the Devouring Dao Fruit."
"Generally speaking, without a deep understanding of a Dao Fruit, one cannot make use of it. The Swap Dao Fruit and Imprinting Dao Fruit we acquired have been set aside unused for this very reason."
"From the actions of the Specter Monarch, it looks like he intends to directly take the Tribulation Dao Fruit. This means that the Great Qian side has a way to use the Tribulation Dao Fruit."
"Most likely, the Devouring Dao Fruit can disregard the understanding limitations and consume other Dao Fruits for its advantage."
"Probably because the soul of the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord can't control multiple Dao Fruits at the same time and needs the Laurel Tree Ancestor to strengthen his Immortal Soul."
"That's what I was thinking too." Fellow Daoist Ying Tian and Immortal Fairy nodded in agreement.
Lu Yang thought for a moment and pretended to understand as he nodded along.
"As for the source and use of these three Seeking Immortal Tokens, now that the Specter Monarch is dead, the Demon-Removing Divine Monarch should know something."
"I'll find an opportunity to inquire at the Fairy Palace, this shouldn't be difficult."
Having captured two significant figures from the Great Qian Dynasty, the Immortal Sect and the Dynasty will take this matter very seriously; perhaps the Fairy Palace will conduct a direct Soul Search to violently acquire all intelligence."
"The issue of someone among the Four Immortals being possessed by the hidden mastermind is indeed problematic."
"The hidden mastermind stays in the shadows, but now that one has been possessed, it's akin to moving from the dark to semi-light, which also presents an opportunity."
"Junior Brother, if you encounter the Qilin Immortal or the Jiuchong Immortal in the future, be extra careful."
"Okay, but Senior Sister, are you so sure that I will encounter the Qilin Immortal and the Jiuchong Immortal?" Lu Yang recalled that his Eldest Senior Sister had always advised him to keep away from Immortal conflicts. Why had she changed her approach now?
Answering Lu Yang was Yun Zhi's complex look. Lu Yang tactfully stopped asking further.
It seemed it really wasn't something he could stay away from just by wanting to.

chapters.title: Chapter 971 - 970: I Can Refine Any Immortal Artifact
chapters.content:
"I notice that Fellow Daoist Ying Tian's body is damaged. Do you perhaps need some Immortal Gold to complete it?"
Without Ying Tian Immortal needing to state it, Yun Zhi had already discerned his condition and what he was seeking.
"If so, then I thank Daoist Yun Zhi!" Ying Tian Immortal was overjoyed, as this was precisely what he needed at the moment.
"If there is any Immortal Artifact that you need, just tell me, and I can refine it."
"Currently, there is nothing I need. If I encounter something in the future, I hope Fellow Daoist Ying Tian will take care of it."
"Would you like to meet Xiao Ling and Lianyi?"
"The two junior sisters? It has indeed been a long time since I last saw them." Previously, Ying Tian Immortal had been wary that Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi were backed by Silent Extermination Immortal, so he dared not acknowledge them. Now that the misunderstanding was cleared, he naturally wanted to meet them.
"Fairy, do you know where they are?" Lu Yang wondered, remembering that Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi often drifted about, their locations uncertain.
"Right, I don't know where they are. How about we meet them later when we happen to encounter them?"
Yun Zhi shook her head helplessly and took out a yellow talisman: "I'm worried that Senior Ao Ling might be attacked by Grey Immortal, so I asked Vast Sea Ancestral Master to make a few Teleportation Talismans. You can use this talisman to find Senior Ao Ling."
"That would be wonderful, Miss Yun is reliable." Immortal Fairy beamed with joy; since Xiao Ling and Lianyi were often together, finding Xiao Ling would also lead to finding Lianyi.
"I see that this small world forbids teleportation, so you should leave the small world before teleporting," Yun Zhi reminded them further.
Ying Tian Immortal had not expected Yun Zhi to be so perceptive, He worried that Silent Extermination Immortal might use an unknown method to teleport directly into the Ancient Ring small world, so when refining the Ancient Ring, he had deliberately sealed the teleportation path.
After Yun Zhi departed, Lu Yang also left the Ancient Ring small world, put on the ancient ring that had fallen to the ground, activated the Teleportation Talisman, and teleported to Ao Ling's location.
Seeing the junior brother leave with two immortals, Yun Zhi went down the mountain and found Yun Mengmeng in the River Spirit surrounding the Seek Dao Sect.
Yun Mengmeng was lying in the river, letting the water carry her wherever it flowed.
This was her latest craft, the river in the Peach Blossom Secret Realm was an Immortal River, and Grandma forbade playing this way.
Yun Zhi fished Yun Mengmeng out of the river.
"Mengmeng, do you need any Immortal Artifacts refined?"
"Immortal Artifact?"
Yun Mengmeng thought about it, hearing from the Chief Housekeeper that their Immortal Lineage did not need weapons for battle, and if they didn't need weapon-type Immortal Artifacts...
"Any Immortal Artifact works?"
"Any Immortal Artifact works."
Upon hearing this, Yun Mengmeng's eyes lit up: "Can you refine a Treasure Basin? The kind where if you put a piece of cake in it, it turns into two pieces?"
"We can try."
Yun Zhi then found the Third Junior Sister, Gan Tian, lying under a tree, experiencing nature.
"Third Junior Sister, if you could have any Immortal Artifact refined, what would you want to be made?"
Gan Tian sat up, unsure what the Eldest Senior Sister meant by this question, but still leaned against the tree and thought hard.
As for the zither, she didn't particularly need one; her zither was a growing magic artifact, and she had used it since she was young, so there was no need to replace it.
"Is there such a thing as an Immortal Lamp that can grant any wish, like if you rub it twice, a deity appears and fulfills three wishes?"
"We can try."
After asking around, Yun Zhi wrote down everything that was needed on paper: "A Treasure Basin that duplicates objects, an Immortal Lamp that fulfills any wish upon rubbing, a coffin so comfortable you wouldn't want to leave, an artifact that teaches people how to love, an Immortal Mirror that can rank beauties..."
"These all seem like some peculiar items, but considering that Fellow Daoist Ying Tian is the Ancestor of Refining and can craft any magic artifact, it shouldn't be a problem."
...
Demon Territory, Great Demon Ancient Tomb.
Within the corridor, eight or nine members of the Demon Race congregated, cautiously walking without taking large steps.
"Big brother, can't we use our Spiritual Sense to scout around? It's so dark here, I can't see anything." A female member of the Demon Race nervously grasped her big brother's clothing.
"How many times have I told you, this is the ancient tomb of a Half Step Nascent Soul Stage great demon, filled with complex mechanisms, some of which are triggered by Spiritual Sense or a flash of light."
"Oh."
"Everyone, follow exactly where I stepped to avoid triggering any mechanisms," the leader of the Demon Race transmitted to the group through spiritual means.
After triggering two traps and engaging in several tough battles, the group finally reached the deepest part of the ancient tomb, a place no one had reached before.
"We've finally made it." The group breathed a sigh of relief, collapsing onto the ground.
The deepest parts of the tomb were lit by Night Pearls. The members saw Cultivation Technique Manuals, Elixirs, and Spirit Treasures scattered casually on the ground, their eyes gleaming with excitement.
"It's really generous, just as expected from a Half-Step Nascent Soul great demon."
"Thanks to Fellow Daoist Ao Lianyi and Jiang Ling for providing the map of the ancient tomb. Let's divide the loot as we agreed earlier, sixty-forty."
Their group had coincidentally met Ao Lianyi and Jiang Ling on the road, who had the map but not enough people and were worried about the dangers in the tomb, so they proposed to cooperate. They agreed to explore the tomb together, and upon success, divide the treasures sixty-forty.
Through contacts along the way, they learned that the two women came from extraordinary backgrounds, possessing a trace of Dragon and Phoenix Bloodlines—likely their ancestors belonged to the Dragon and Phoenix Tribes but were expelled due to their ancestors' mistakes, leaving Ao Lianyi and Jiang Ling quite destitute in this generation.
The leader checked the treasures of the tomb, finding most of the Elixirs had expired, turning into poison or waste. However, the Spirit Treasures and Cultivation Technique Manuals were still usable and of very high grade.
"Look at this one; this is actually a unique magic skill of the great demon!"
"And this one here, it's the tomb owner's experience with forming a golden core. Oh my, using his method, we have a one and a half percent chance of success!"
"What's this?" one of them noticed a sword hilt sticking out of the ground and curiously pulled it out.
"A broken sword and it's even rusted?"
As the rusted broken sword was pulled out, the tomb shook, the coffins vibrated continuously, making rattling noises, and a sinister laugh echoed throughout the tomb.
"Hehehe, who would have thought, after a hundred years, I, Heaven Centipede Taoist, would see the light of day again!"
"Old Green Ram, you sacrificed your life to seal me here and set up traps to stop anyone from entering. How is it that someone still broke in and pulled out the Array Eye?"
"Heaven Centipede Taoist?" The group's faces changed color; the Heaven Centipede Taoist was a known great demon a hundred years ago. With unmatched cultivation, no one could rival him, and he caused great suffering to the nearby tribes. Afterwards, an ancestor of the Green Ram Clan broke through to the Half Step Nascent Soul Stage and challenged the Heaven Centipede Taoist to a duel.
Since then, both had vanished.
It turned out he was sealed here.
A centipede with colorful markings crawled out of the coffin, its hundreds of legs moving rhythmically, sending chills down everyone's spine.
"It seems the Old Green Ram kicked the bucket, his Storage Ring shattered and his belongings fell out. Great, now that I am awake, not only do I have these little demons to replenish my Qi and Blood, but I also have the treasures of a Half Step Nascent Soul stage being. It seems destiny is in my favor!"
"It's our fault for giving you the map. You better leave quickly; we'll cover for you!" The two women stepped forward, their eyes filled with determination.
"Fellow Daoist Ao Lianyi!"
"Fellow Daoist Jiang Ling!"
The group cried loudly, "If we leave, we leave together!"
"Shut up, if you don't leave, we'll all die here!"
"Hehe, none of you are going to leave," laughed the Heaven Centipede Taoist dismissively, not taking this group of Consummation of Qi Refinement little demons seriously.
The group engaged in a fierce battle with the Heaven Centipede Taoist, who, out of amusement, did not kill them outright.
"Fellow Daoist Ao Lianyi!" the group shouted.
Seeing the Heaven Centipede Taoist's leg pierce through Ao Lianyi's chest, Ao Lianyi lay weakly in Jiang Ling's arms.
Ao Lianyi feebly extended her blood-covered hand to touch Jiang Ling's face, "Xiao Ling, let's be sisters again in our next life."
"Lianyi—" Jiang Ling cried out heart-wrenchingly.
"Heaven Centipede Taoist, I'll make you pay in blood!" Jiang Ling yelled furiously.
The Heaven Centipede Taoist remained unconcerned, but suddenly, his expression changed when he saw Jiang Ling's eyes turn golden like an ancient dragon awakening.
"A Bloodline awakening, you're of the Dragon Clan!" shouted the Heaven Centipede Taoist.
Suddenly, a door opened and Lu Yang walked out, looking around, seeing the lifeless Jiang Lianyi lying on the ground, the furious Ao Ling, the little demons who didn't know what had happened, and the Half Step Nascent Soul stage Heaven Centipede Taoist.
"Sorry, wrong place,"
Lu Yang quietly retreated.

chapters.title: Chapter 972 - 972: 971
chapters.content:
Lu Yang took a half step back, feeling that under these circumstances, it seemed too late to leave anymore, so he stepped forward again.
"Who are you!" The Heaven Centipede Taoist's expression drastically changed upon seeing Lu Yang able to establish a stable spatial channel. What level of power must this be?!
"He, he is Lu Yang!" Lu Yang's fame had spread far, even reaching the Demon Territory with his portraits.
The Heaven Centipede Taoist had been sealed for a hundred years and naturally did not recognize Lu Yang, but that did not prevent him from being frightened.
"You all should leave now. I'll handle things here." Lu Yang shooed away the Little Demons.
Noticing that the Little Demons' gazes were fixed on Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi, he added, "She can still be saved, I can save her. Go now."
Only then did the Little Demons hurriedly flee the ancient tomb.
"You two seniors, stop crying and sleeping, get up now," Lu Yang said helplessly.
If he had known earlier what had happened here, he would have come a teacup's time later no matter what.
Now it was too late to say anything.
Lu Yang cast a Verbal Spell and resurrected Ao Ling, who deftly climbed up from the ground, "Senior Brother, how did you come?"
Jiang Lianyi stopped crying, and the Phoenix Tribe aura was no longer deliberately revealed.
"I found an acquaintance and hoped you two would meet him."
Lu Yang raised his hand to show the Black Ancient Ring, "Right here."
"Which acquaintance?" Both women were very curious, as encountering an acquaintance in this era was not easy.
"It's the Yingtian Immortal," Lu Yang said directly, not beating around the bush.
"Is it Brother Ying Tian?!" The two women were greatly surprised and showed joyful expressions, thinking that Lu Yang had, at most, found someone like Little Qiongqi and not expecting it to be the Yingtian Immortal, who had a great relationship with their husband.
"But shouldn't we deal with this Golden Core stage giant centipede first?" Lu Yang's gaze fell on the Heaven Centipede Taoist.
"What did this centipede do?"
"We just happened to pass by this place, heard that this centipede had committed numerous misdeeds, and decided to take care of it while we were here," said Lu Yang.
Thinking to himself did you also casually recruit a group of Little Demons to set the mood? But considering the two were Junior Sisters, he did not expose them.
The Heaven Centipede Taoist shivered, and although he did not know the true identities of the three, he felt their oppressive aura.
Even the Mid-stage Nascent Soul old demons he had encountered over a hundred years ago did not have a strand of their terrifying aura.
And did he just mention the Yingtian Immortal?
Who was this, an Ancient Immortal playing games among humans?
What heavenly law had he violated to be pursued and blocked by three great experts upon his return?
I am a Half Step Nascent Soul, not a Semi-Immortal.
Had I known this, I might as well have continued sleeping in my coffin.
"Three of you..."
Lu Yang picked up a half-broken sword from the ground, infused it with a strand of Sword Qi, and casually threw it backward, piercing the Heaven Centipede Taoist's forehead. The Heaven Centipede Taoist grunted twice, then fell into the coffin neatly aligned.
The two women and Lu Yang entered the Ancient Ring, where they saw Yingtian Immortal standing by the seaside cliff with one hand behind his back and the other hanging naturally, his white robe fluttering in the sea breeze, the endless waves hitting the shore.
Yingtian Immortal turned his head, his gaze bearing the weight of ages, a glance spanning thirty thousand years, "Two Junior Sisters, long time no see. After thirty thousand years, is everything well?"
Seeing his demeanor, without needing to see his face, both women knew this was Yingtian Immortal and couldn't help but exclaim joyfully, "Brother Ying Tian!"
The three, separated for over thirty thousand years, now gathered in this small world, their joy indescribable in words.
"Brother Ying Tian, I didn't expect to find you here!"
"The two of you really do share a bond just like in ancient times, as close as real sisters."
"Brother Ying Tian, what exactly happened back then, and where have you been all these years?"
Yingtian Immortal looked up at the sky, "The events of that year are quite complicated. Sit, everyone sit down, I'll explain slowly."
He controlled the small world, and conjured up five chairs, inviting everyone to sit down and enjoy the sea breeze.
"So, here's what happened..."
Yingtian Immortal narrated the story, but he didn't get into the details about Ashy Bean, only mentioning that they encountered a formidable enemy, and had no choice but to hide.
Jiang Lianyi wasn't aware of the situation with Ashy Bean. If Yingtian Immortal had told her, she too would have been on the hit list.
"So many things happened, it seems like you, Brother Ying Tian, have also had a tough thirty thousand years."
Yingtian Immortal was hiding in the ancient ring's small world, seeking trustworthy cultivators to gather intelligence, waiting for Fairy Eternity's revival, which was by no means as easy as he made it sound.
"Hey, what hardships? Showing sainthood in front of others every day, it's not much different from the days of yore."
"And this person being possessed..."
The two women hesitated to complete the sentence. If Qilin Immortal were the one possessed, what would they do?
Yingtian Immortal fell silent, for he could hardly pound his chest and promise that Qilin Immortal was definitely not the one possessed.
If it truly was Qilin Immortal who had been possessed, and the two women trusted him, resulting in harm, what then?
"Never mind, never mind, Lu Yang and I will definitely find the one who's been possessed!" Fairy Eternity stepped forward to ease the atmosphere.
Lu Yang looked at Fairy Eternity as if he had seen a ghost.
Fairy, say what you will, but can you leave me out of this? Am I, with my frail body, really supposed to get involved with the mastermind behind the scenes?
"Exactly, I and Fairy will definitely find that person!"
Knowing Fairy Eternity meant well, Lu Yang went along with it.
The talents and luck of Lu Yang were something the two women had seen and could definitely rely on.
"Then we are in your debt, Immortal Sister and Elder Brother Lu Yang."
Yingtian Immortal then spoke about his encounters with Specter Monarch, meeting Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity, following Lu Yang to Seek Dao Sect, and meeting Yun Zhi.
When the two women heard Yingtian Immortal offer Yun Zhi three moves, they involuntarily sat up straight.
Leave it to Brother Ying Tian, even Immortal Sister in her heyday wouldn't dare let Yun Zhi take three moves.
"Cough, don't look at me like that, I truly didn't expect her to be so powerful," Yingtian Immortal said, feeling embarrassed and unable to meet the gazes of the two women.
"I just assumed she was at most on par with Qilin, who would have thought she could be so strong, she must be the master of Heavenly Court Sect, Yun Mengmeng now."
The two women looked at Yingtian Immortal with puffed cheeks, "When you usually battle your husband, you never gave him three moves."
"A slip of the tongue, a slip of the tongue," Yingtian Immortal apologized with a smile.
Yingtian Immortal quickly changed the subject, "Speaking of which, I heard that Zhu Tian has become the king in Demon Nation. I never expected he'd also be asleep until now. I always need some furniture for my small world, and he could make some."
Although Yingtian Immortal could alter the shape of the small world to create furniture, or ask Lu Yang to buy some from the outside world, in terms of comfort, it definitely couldn't compare to what Zhu Tian could make.
"Who would have thought Zhu Tian would be in this era? When I first heard Lianyi say that Zhu Tian was still around, I thought she was joking," Ao Ling laughed.
Zhu Tian, being controlled by Jiang Lianyi's Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit Outline, allowed Jiang Lianyi to sense his location. Jiang Lianyi calculated for a moment, "Zhu Tian is currently in the capital of Demon Nation, shall we go now?"
Fairy Eternity had shown herself before Zhu Tian, and Zhu Tian knew Lu Yang's real identity, so when they met Zhu Tian, there was no need for pretense.

chapters.title: Chapter 973 - 972: Sabotage
chapters.content:
Demon Territory, Demon City Imperial Palace.
Since the establishment of the Demon Nation, thousands of demons had come to serve, with both large and small Demon Race factions submitting, the Demon Territory experienced unprecedented unification.
Under the control of the outline of the Dao Fruit of the Survival of the Fittest, more than a dozen Transcendance Tribulations Demon Emperors submitted to Zhu Tian, and many great demons at the Integration Peak were cultivated by him, with hopes to Pass the Tribulation.
"Life is good now," Zhu Tian, lying on the Emperor's Chair and yawning comfortably, felt his thirty thousand years of sleep hadn't been in vain.
Could this kind of luxury have been enjoyed in Ancient Times?
The palace decorations were luxurious, surpassing even the Imperial Palace of Great Xia, exceeding in both artistic and practical aspects.
Zhu Tian personally designed the Demon City Imperial Palace, and the furniture inside was crafted by his own hands.
When he was just awakened and hadn't yet regained his full prowess, Zhu Tian would make furniture in his abode; after the palace was built, all were put to use.
In the vast palace, Zhu Tian was alone; he didn't need maids or eunuchs to serve him, nor did he require guards for protection.
Being a Semi-Immortal, and on his own territory, who could harm him?
"Zhu Tian, it seems like you're living comfortably." A voice tinged with mockery rang from behind, startling Zhu Tian so much that he nearly reverted to his original form.
Recognizing the arrivals, Zhu Tian quickly put on a smile, "It turns out to be Sister Lianyi, Sister Ling, and Brother Lu Yang."
"And Immortal as well."
Immortal Fairy emerged from Lu Yang's body.
"Right, right, right, and Sister Doudou." Zhu Tian dared not forget this great immortal, although Immortal Fairy had never disclosed her origins, that was not important – no Immortal was someone he could afford to provoke.
"What wind has blown you four over here?" Zhu Tian hurriedly got up to clear space, pouring tea and setting out seeds.
Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi had visited him more than once, while Lu Yang had not sought him out again since the founding ceremony of the Demon Nation.
He had often thought about sending Lu Yang a few beautifully enchanting Demon Race dancers to improve their relations, but he worried that directly sending them might look bad, so he put the idea on hold.
"There is an old friend who wishes to meet you; is it convenient for you, King Zhu?"
"Just call me Little Zhu." Zhu Tian nodded and bowed, where dared he say it was inconvenient?
"Here, King Zhu, please." Lu Yang displayed the Black Ancient Ring, whose immense suction force pulled everyone into the Small World.
Zhu Tian entered the Small World, which felt like a chaotic journey through time back to the Ancient Times; numerous familiar Semi-Immortals and beings at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage were attending a lecture, the white-robed Yingtian Immortal facing the crowd, speaking eloquently.
His words created phenomena of heaven and earth, with the Dao Sound gently rippling, and golden spring gushing from the ground, enlightening all beings.
Zhu Tian remembered this particular lecture; it was the first lecture after Yingtian Immortal became an Immortal; why would it appear here?
Could it be that this lecture was of immense significance, etched in history, becoming a reflective echo in this Small World?
Yingtian Immortal stepped down from the stage, lotuses blooming with every step he took, and everywhere he passed, the reflections of beings turned into white mist and consecutively disappeared.
This scene was not as Zhu Tian remembered it.
Could it be that Yingtian Immortal's cultivation level was profound enough to traverse the long river of history, and merely by a historical reflection, he could reappear in the human realm?
Yingtian Immortal slowly approached the stunned Zhu Tian, a smile filled with deep meaning appearing at the corner of his mouth.
"Zhu Tian, long time no see, all well?"
"Venerable Immortal, is it really you?!" Zhu Tian suddenly realized; the person in front of him was not some historical reflection but the truly genuine Yingtian Immortal!
Yingtian Immortal smiled and nodded: "Indeed, it is I."
Lu Yang clicked his tongue from the side, after all, it was Ying Tian Immortal. Zhu Tian, among the Semi-Immortals, listened to Ying Tian Immortal's lectures very seriously, and he was completely bamboozled. What would happen if it were someone else?
"I didn't expect you to choose hibernation, Zhu Tian. Thirty thousand years have passed in a blink, and the world has changed without a trace of the old friends. Seeing you today makes my journey worthwhile."
Zhu Tian's eyes brimmed with tears, "Yes, I've slept for thirty thousand years, yet still can't escape from you all.
Jiang Lianyi and Ao Ling making an entrance was one thing, but now even Ying Tian Immortal has popped up.
When I wasn't around, not a single Semi-Immortal showed up, but as soon as I established the Demon Nation, Semi-Immortals started popping up everywhere, and occasionally, even an Immortal would appear.
Now, there are more Immortals than in Ancient Times. Couldn't they give me, the foremost under the Immortals, a little room to play?
Looking at this situation, we might likely see Qilin Immortal coming up next.
Wait, aren't there rumors about the Great Era conflict?
Could it be that I've started the Great Era conflict?
Thinking this, Zhu Tian became excited inside, indeed he was the most special.
"Venerable Immortal, please have a seat." Zhu Tian pulled out several Emperor's Chairs that he had made in the last two years.
The crowd sat down one after another, and then Zhu Tian brought out an Emperor's Table, stocked with fruits and pastries, considering everything very thoroughly.
"Zhu Tian, you seem to be doing quite well in the Demon Territory, even establishing a Demon Nation," Ying Tian Immortal said with a smile.
"It's all thanks to the favor of my fellow Daoists," said Zhu Tian humbly, stating the truth.
It indeed was the favor of the Daoists, otherwise, Jiang Lianyi would have become the ruler of the Demon Nation.
"That's also your ability. In my view, your establishment of a Demon Nation and orchestrating the Demon Race's power was a wise decision."
"The Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit Outline basically becomes stronger as the controller passes more people. Lianyi is used to going solo and has never done this, while you didn't have the chance in Ancient Times."
In Ancient Times, there were Semi-Immortal transcending tribulations everywhere. Zhu Tian wanted to establish the Demon Nation, but aside from Qilin Immortal on top, several other Demonic Semi-Immortals were not in agreement.
"Nowadays, the Semi-Immortals are quite low-key due to various reasons, which has given you the chance to establish the Demon Nation. You should cherish this opportunity and properly ponder on the Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit Outline."
"Zhu Tian will remember the teachings of Venerable Immortal," Zhu Tian said, breaking out in a cold sweat. After awakening, he had been indulging in pleasures and indeed had neglected his cultivation.
Ying Tian Immortal stood up, paced around the group with his hands behind his back, and suddenly said, "Zhu Tian, what do you think of this Small World I crafted?"
Zhu Tian flattered, "Anything crafted by the Venerable Immortal must be excellent. This Small World is tranquil and elegant, utterly unoccupied, perfectly embodying the essence of an empty and bright spiritual platform..."
Lu Yang, however, had a different opinion, "The Small World is nice, but it feels a bit empty, not really suitable for living."
"The essence of an empty and bright spiritual platform is indeed a good theme, but Venerable Immortal has already reached this state; there's no need to emphasize it with a Small World. Maybe I should craft a set of furniture for you, Venerable Immortal, to adorn this Small World," Zhu Tian immediately changed his tone upon hearing this.
Ying Tian Immortal nodded, "That would be good."
The three exchanged smiles, creating a harmonious atmosphere.
Immortal Fairy Eternity perched on the Emperor's Chair, watching the three laugh for a while. She felt there was more to their conversation than met the eye and started to ponder deeply.
Suddenly, Immortal Fairy Eternity had an epiphany, pointing at Ying Tian Immortal and said,
"Oh~ I get it now, Ying Tian, you were too shy to directly ask Zhu Tian for furniture, so you had Little Yang act as a go-between!"
Ying Tian Immortal: "..."
Immortal, is this when you decide to be smart?

chapters.title: Chapter 974 - 974: 973rd Chapter: Can Your Seek Dao Sect Request Some Normal Immortal Artifacts?
chapters.content:
Every time this happened, the Yingtian Immortal would miss the once reticent Fairy Eternity dearly.
Back then, Fairy Eternity would see through everything without pointing it out, but now, Fairy Eternity might not necessarily see through everything, but would certainly point it out once she did.
It was far from the first time his thunder had been stolen, so Yingtian Immortal quickly reacted, using laughter to ease the awkwardness, "Haha, Eternity, you really have a way with jokes. I've been honest and straightforward all my life. When have I ever needed to be secretive?"
"Ah? Haven't you? Didn't you once cover up being captured by a female cultivator for... replenishment...?"
Lu Yang dashed forward in a few strides, covering Fairy Eternity's mouth. If he let the Fairy continue, she might not have an issue for exposing old secrets, but he and Zhu Tian, who were overhearing, would be in big trouble.
Moreover, I reluctantly became the Yingtian Immortal's supporter, hoping that he would spare my life when I encounter my Heavenly Tribulation. Now, it seems I am not going to survive.
Zhu Tian, sweating profusely at his side, thought, No, how did I end up in a life-or-death crisis while just talking?
I didn't do anything.
Fairy Eternity, being a soul body, couldn't be touched by Lu Yang, but seeing Little Yang come at her, making a motion to cover her mouth, Fairy Eternity cooperatively closed her mouth and stopped talking.
Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi saw this scene and covered their mouths to stifle their laughter.
Aside from Fairy Eternity's unintentional gaffe, the atmosphere in the Ancient Ring's small world was warm and harmonious.
It was rare for everyone, as ancients cultivators, to gather together and discuss the past of Ancient Times, and even Lu Yang's involvement did not feel out of place at all.
In fact, Lu Yang knew more about the Ancient Times than Zhu Tian did.
Of course, Lu Yang couldn't pretend to know everything. He had to pretend to forget all about the misfortunes of the Four Ancient Immortals; otherwise, he might invite disaster.
Two days and nights flew by. It would be exhausting for mortals to go without sleep, but those present were either Semi-Immortals or Immortals, and even the least among them, at the Divinity Transformation Stage, would not feel tired.
But just chatting on and on endlessly, there had to come an end at some point.
"Alright, it's hard for old friends to meet, I just came to see you, and it's good that you're doing well." The Yingtian Immortal took the initiative to end the chat.
"Then, Venerable Immortal, I will send the furniture your way once it's finished."
"There's no need to be so courteous."
"It's only proper."
After seeing off Lu Yang and others, Zhu Tian became even more determined to cling tightly to Lu Yang's coattails.
"During the chat, the Venerable Immortal kept calling Elder Brother Lu Yang 'friend', I have never seen anyone in the Ancient Times who could get the Venerable Immortal to address them so. It seems that Elder Brother Lu Yang is favored by the Venerable Immortal and is sure to accomplish great things in the future."
Although I myself have started the strife of a Great Era, destined to be the protagonist of this realm, I also know when to go with the flow and take sides when it's necessary.
"That said, how can my Imperial Palace allow just anyone to come and go as they please? Maybe I should get a couple of guards?"
Zhu Tian thought again, what level of guards could ever stop Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi?
...
"Elder Brother Lu Yang, then this is goodbye for now," said Ao Ling and the other lady as they bid farewell to Lu Yang, who, along with Fairy Eternity and the Yingtian Immortal, returned to the Seek Dao Sect.
The Yingtian Immortal saw the list Yun Zhi had prepared for the Immortal Artifacts and showed a particularly puzzled expression.
Logically speaking, if one comes to him for artifact crafting, shouldn't they be asking for weapons, and the more powerful the better?
```
What on earth are these absurd Immortal Artifacts listed on the paper?
Yingtian Immortal stared at the list for a long time, trying to find any normal Immortal Artifacts.
"A Treasure Basin that replicates anything at will, an Immortal Lantern that grants any wish upon friction, aren't the effects of these two too heaven-defying?"
"A coffin so comfortable that one wouldn't want to get up once inside should be Zhu Tian's job, I can only refine a coffin you wouldn't be able to get out of once you lie down!"
"And a magical artifact that teaches people how to fall in love, I've never been in love before, how should I refine that?"
"An Immortal Mirror that can rank beauties..."
Can you Seek Dao Sect come up with some normal Immortal Artifacts?
"You can't refine them?" Yun Zhi asked.
Yingtian Immortal covered his face. Although he didn't want to admit it, he indeed couldn't refine such things.
At the very least, let me refine a Sky Opening Axe from scratch.
"Then we shall contact Daoist friend again when we have a need for other Immortal Artifacts."
