"My artifact-refining skills are average; I am not as powerful as Daoist Yun Zhi imagines. Please, Daoist Yun Zhi, when you request Immortal Artifacts to be refined next time, let them all be weapon-related."
"I will try my best."
"There's another thing, the Fairy Palace directly performed a Soul Search on the Demon-Removing God Lord and obtained intelligence that matched our speculations; Mid-heaven Emperor Lord is a Devouring Dao Fruit, capable of devouring other Dao Fruits for his own use, but it requires an extremely high soul strength."
Lu Yang found it easy to teleport to the Demon Territory, but very difficult to return from there. Coupled with the time spent chatting with Zhu Tian, going back and forth took seven days.
In these seven days, both the Immortal Sect and the Dynasty paid close attention to the intel on the Demon-Removing God Lord.
"The method to dismantle the Fairy Palace's Sect Protection Array was leaked by the former Acting Sect Master Qu Ling. The Fairy Palace was filled with rage and has executed Qu Ling."
"As for the crafting method and principles of the four Seeking Immortal Tokens, the Demon-Removing God Lord wasn't informed. He has just ascended to a Semi-Immortal and hasn't had the chance to be privy to all of Great Qian's top-level intelligence.
He only knew that the Seeking Immortal Tokens are precious and that even the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord doesn't have many; only exceptionally powerful Great Qian Semi-Immortals are qualified to possess them, like the Specter Monarch and Landscape Monarch."
"Although the Landscape Monarch possesses a Dao Fruit Outline, it wasn't granted by the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord; on the contrary, he was once a contender for the Divine Position against the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord."
"So the Landscape Monarch is that powerful?" Lu Yang was surprised. During his time in the East Sea, the Landscape Monarch was first pitted against Ao Ling and then instantly killed by Ashy Bean, never getting a chance to show his capabilities, making Lu Yang believe all along that the Landscape Monarch couldn't even defeat Zhu Tian.
"According to the Demon-Removing God Lord's knowledge, there are two Immortals within the Great Qian forces. One is the well-known 'Mid-heaven Emperor Lord,' and the other is 'The Controller,' who is known by very few."
"The Great Qian Dynasty is grounded on faith and incense offering. This 'The Controller' is in charge of the sacrificial ceremonies in the Great Qian Dynasty, with a status only second to the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord."
"I see," Lu Yang nodded.
"The reason why the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord allowed the Great Qian Dynasty to be destroyed still stems from the flaws of the Power of Faith. The Power of Faith binds all cultivators who hold a Divine Position, including the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord himself, and it's not uncommon for them to be assimilated by the Power of Faith."
"Therefore, the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord decided to abandon the Great Qian Dynasty, remove the source of incense offering, and let the Great Qian Dynasty head towards destruction."
"Truly heartless." Lu Yang sighed. The destruction of the Great Qian Dynasty didn't happen overnight. It was likely that several generations, or even dozens of generations of commoners, would have to endure exploitation by officials and the suffering caused by wars among cultivators.
From praying to the Divine Positions to cursing and giving up, this is exactly what the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord and the others hoped for.
"Speaking of which, Wu Yao also destroyed by his own hands the dynasty that he established."
"The founders of the two great dynasties both personally destroyed their own dynasties. It's hard to tell if this is a coincidence or if fate decreed it to be so."
```

chapters.title: Chapter 975 - 974: Sharing Wealth and Woe Together
chapters.content:
After sending the averagely skilled Yingtian Immortal back to the Fairy Palace, Lu Yang's cultivation entered the right track as he dedicated himself to training.
An hour later, a treacherous scoundrel caused trouble, disrupting Lu Yang's cultivation plan.
"Old Lu, I heard you went to the Fairy Palace?"
"What do you think, envious, huh?" Lu Yang boasted with a snort, which irritated Meng Jingzhou to the point of itching teeth.
Since the power of the sun had increased, he had become more and more reluctant to approach women. For him, places like the Laurel Fairy Palace were essentially forbidden.
Meng Jingzhou hadn't expected Lu Yang to vanish before his eyes all of a sudden and only upon inquiring did he learn that Lu Yang had abandoned him to enjoy himself at the Fairy Palace.
Unable to bear seeing Lu Yang fall into such depravity, Meng Jingzhou scolded loudly, trying to awaken his indulged friend, "Envious, my ass. We cultivators should dedicate ourselves to cultivation. Wandering around and idling about like you do every day, you'll surely end up accomplishing nothing!"
"And what have you cultivated this past month?"
"Almost there. During the month you were away, I went to a secret realm that opens every three hundred years. Accidentally, I encountered Long Huo. From the slightest clues, I guessed that the spirit of the secret realm was indeed its master and foiled his possession plan. Though his realm was higher than mine, I naturally restrain soul bodies.
After challenging him beyond my level, I teamed up with Long Huo and captured him."
"Then I handed this soul over to the local government office for processing. While waiting for the local government to commend me, I discovered that they seemed extremely efficient, almost too eager to send me away. After some covert investigations, it turned out that the local government was involved in corruption and colluding with the Ruthless Sect.
Following the leads, I uncovered that the source was the Governor."
"Seeing his plot exposed, the Governor fled in a hurry that night. It began to rain heavily, and I chased him hundreds of miles through the rainy night. Along the way, I killed several dead soldiers sent by the Governor, disregarded the honey trap set by his people, and finally caught him at a city gate by dawn."
"I looked up only to realize that, unknowingly, I had chased the Governor all the way to Imperial City. After dealing with the Governor, I took the opportunity to go home for a meal and upon returning, I heard you had also returned from the Fairy Palace."
"...When did you actually cultivate this month?"
Meng Jingzhou seriously said, "At least I always had the intention to cultivate. It was just that mundane affairs kept getting in the way, leaving no opportunity to actually do so."
"I did too!" Lu Yang roared, infuriated—wasn't he also entangled in mundane affairs?
"You did nothing."
"Old Meng, let me tell you, you'd better speak politely to me. It's not too late to fawn over me now, for soon it'll be too late."
Meng Jingzhou scoffed at Lu Yang's statement, "Fawn over you? In your dreams."
"You don't know, but this time at the Fairy Palace, I met not only the Great Qian Cultivators, but also the Yingtian Immortal. When Yingtian Immortal saw me, he was very grateful. He patted my shoulder, encouraging me to cultivate well, saying he would definitely take good care of me when it's time for my Transcending Heavenly Tribulation."
"What?!" Meng Jingzhou was especially surprised, for in his absence, Lu Yang had indeed gained such an opportunity.
Cultivators dread nothing more than facing a Heavenly Tribulation. Even Qin Haoran, strong as he was, perished in such tribulation, reincarnated as Junior Brother Li. With Lu Yang having a connection like the Yingtian Immortal, wouldn't his future cultivation be unobstructed, soaring to the skies?
Meng Jingzhou diligently massaged Lu Yang's shoulders and head, his tone gentle, "Old Lu, ah no, Senior Brother Lu, I was a bit harsh earlier. Please forgive me, look at our relationship..."
Now a prominent figure in the Great Bean Dynasty, Lu Yang was not one to stoop to Meng Jingzhou's level, "Our relationship goes without saying. We share our fortunes and face our troubles together. Don't worry. When I meet the Yingtian Immortal Elder again, I will surely ask him to look after you as well."
Meng Jingzhou was deeply moved, "Good brother, truly righteous!"
"By the way, on my way back, I also heard that you went to the Fairy Palace, and several high-ranking members and disciples there got pregnant. Everyone's saying it was your doing. Do you know about this?"
"Bullshit!" Lu Yang became frantic, purely a rumor. What did this have to do with him? They got pregnant for drinking from the Twin River; what did he do except suggesting a few ideas to the Fairy Palace.
"...Wait, come to think of it, this actually does have something to do with me."
Upon hearing this, Meng Jingzhou's hands, which were massaging Lu Yang's shoulders, suddenly changed to gripping them, and he flung Lu Yang away in a fit of rage, glaring intensely.
"Well, Old Lu, I didn't expect I misjudged you, for you to do something so despicable! Show me what you've got, today I must teach you a good lesson!"
"No, I mean, I just suggested they drink from Twin River... "
A golden Swastika Fist Seal descended, ten feet in size, Lu Yang used his finger as a sword to sever the Fist Seal, "Damn it, Old Meng, you're pretending not to hear on purpose... "
"Lewd thief, take this!"
"Just in time for you to witness the supreme Pure Yang Dharma Aspect I learned from our ancestor!"
Slowly, behind Meng Jingzhou, a golden Dharma Aspect like a rising sun emerged, towering a hundred feet high, its features blurred, each movement imbued with an ancient aura, one hand holding a shield, the other a spear.
"Supreme Pure Yang Dharma Aspect?" Lu Yang had heard of Pure Yang Dharma Aspect, an aspect only possessable by a Pure Yang Immortal Body. It seemed Meng Junzi had tailored for Meng Jingzhou an even more extreme Dharma Aspect than the Pure Yang Dharma Aspect.
Boom!
The Dharma Aspect's arm fell, sending Lu Yang flying.
Lu Yang was certain now. This was definitely a more powerful Dharma Aspect than the Pure Yang Dharma Aspect, stronger than what Fairy Eternity had described.
"I'm not scared of you!" Lu Yang drew out his Green Peak Sword, employed the Extinguishing Immortal Sword Array, and aimed the sword tip at Meng Jingzhou.
Meng Jingzhou had anticipated this move, went on the offensive, and lunged at Lu Yang.
By doing so, even if he had to kneel, he could still tackle Lu Yang with the Dharma Aspect.
Lu Yang inwardly cursed Meng Jingzhou's slyness, changing his sword skill, "Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin!"
Inheriting Shadow Sword, Seven Star Sword Set, and Green Peak Sword merged, sword Qi surged, the supreme Pure Yang Dharma Aspect guarded with the shield while the other hand, holding the spear, attacked Lu Yang.
"Universe in Palm!"
A massive hand came down, capturing the Supreme Pure Yang Dharma Aspect. Meng Jingzhou seeing this, employed Three Heads and Six Arms, and the Dharma Aspect also transformed into Three Heads and Six Arms.
Six overlapping hands of the Dharma Aspect blocked this tremendously terrifying palm.
"Is that all you've got?"
"That's plenty to deal with you!"
The two tangled in combat, interchanging sword skills, magic skills, and Dharma Aspects rapidly.
Not far away, Yun Mengmeng sat on a tree branch, swinging her long legs, clearly in a good mood, occasionally picking up a chip from a paper bag and crunching away.
With her fingers covered in potato chip crumbs, she pointed at the battling Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, "Shouldn't we stop them from fighting like this?"
Yun Zhi sat next to Yun Mengmeng, also picked a chip, and slowly savored it in her mouth, "No need to stop them, they're always like this."
Yun Mengmeng then asked Gan Tian sitting on her left, "Do you want some chips?"
"No thanks, watching them like this, I'll play some music to boost their spirits."
Gan Tian placed the guqin on her lap, and a spirited musical piece rang out at the top of Sky Gate Mountain, making Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou fight even more fiercely.
Seeing Gan Tian's hands were occupied, Yun Mengmeng occasionally fed her a potato chip.

chapters.title: Chapter 976 - 975: Mid-stage of Transforming Spirit
chapters.content:
The melodious tunes not only served as a weapon but also provided auxiliary effects, boosting the power of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou as they fought to their hearts' content. Upon hearing the tune, their strength surged.
Originally, Meng Jingzhou could maintain his Dharma Aspect for only a short duration, but with the enhancement from the music, the existence of his Dharma Aspect in the world was significantly extended.
Lu Yang's Sword Qi and magic skills seemed inexhaustible, continuously emerging one after another.
Gan Tian brushed off the potato crumbs sticking to his lips: "The dried potatoes taste great but are a bit bland. Do you have any honey?"
"Yes, of course." Yun Mengmeng had nothing else in her storage ring, but she was well-stocked with seasonings, sesame oil, soy sauce, cumin, chili powder… everything one could need.
"Here, this is honey I brought from my hometown, brewed with peach blossoms. It's delicious."
Yun Mengmeng took out a small bottle of honey, poured it over the potato slices, sealed the paper bag, and shook it vigorously. The thick golden liquid smelt exceptionally sweet, and its contained spiritual essence was so rich that only those in the Body Integration Realm could digest it.
After finishing the honey-flavored potato slices, Gan Tian nodded contentedly, "Hmm, now it tastes right."
Yun Mengmeng licked the honey sticking to her fingertip: "So sweet, Xiao Zhi, do you want some?"
"No, thanks."
Yun Mengmeng looked at her friend in surprise: "You're this grown-up and still afraid of cavities?"
"It's just that I'm not used to eating something so sweet."
"I don't believe you."
"…"
While two fought, three spectated, creating a harmonious scene atop Sky Gate Mountain.
"How long is this going to last?" Lu Yang communicated with Meng Jingzhou telepathically.
"No idea."
It could be said that both had no weaknesses in their cultivation; their attacks were powerful, their bodies were robust, both unmatched at their level.
In terms of attack techniques, Lu Yang had the upper hand; in terms of physical strength, Meng Jingzhou was superior. Now, with Gan Tian's musical support, not only were their attack power and physical strength enhanced, but their wounds also healed at an astonishing rate.
Continuing like this, it was very hard to determine a winner.
And it was very tiring.
"You… you should concede…"
"It should be you conceding…"
"Dream on…"
By the end, the two were so exhausted that they were fighting feebly. Although they could still mobilize their spiritual essence, they were too tired to bother, and neither wanted to admit defeat, so they resorted to using their fists. Seeing that they couldn't keep going, Gan Tian kindly stopped playing the lute.
Without the musical enhancement, they no longer had the strength to support their bodies. They took a couple of steps toward each other and collapsed with a clang as their heads collided and they fell to the ground, immediately falling into a deep sleep.
Yun Zhi cast a magic spell nearby, lifting Lu Yang and sending him back to his abode, and delivering Meng Jingzhou back to his abode as well.
...
After Meng Jingzhou left, Lu Yang could finally continue his cultivation in peace.
In the blink of an eye, ten years had passed.
As promised, Bai Ye relocated a Great Snow Mountain to the Seek Dao Sect for permanent residence, and Chasing Moon True Person, sharing a body with Bai Ye, settled at the Seek Dao Sect as well.
Behind Sky Gate Mountain was the Great Snow Mountain, which made it convenient for Lu Yang to visit Bai Ye.
Others were unaware of Bai Ye's existence; they thought that the Fairy Palace was trying to transplant a Laurel Tree.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou had cultivated for too long and wanted to wander in the outside world, where they stumbled upon a serial murder case. After investigating the identities of six victims, they discovered that all six were escort masters who had escorted a shipment once. Following this clue, they locked down the last person, who was the seventh.
When the two arrived, the seventh person had already been assassinated. Using the symbols drawn with blood by the seventh person's fingers before dying, along with their powerful Spiritual Sense, they successfully found an encrypted ledger in a hidden room in the study.
Thereafter, an endless stream of people pursued and tried to kill Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou. Naturally, all were killed in self-defense. These dead soldiers were under a ban, making it impossible to search their souls. The two shifted their focus back to the encrypted ledger.
After decrypting the ledger, they discovered it recorded smuggling records between the Demon Nation and Great Xia, involving a significant Spirit Stone leak and wide-ranging interests.
Lu Yang analyzed that such a large-scale operation must be one of the Pass Tribulation great clans of the Demon Race now residing in the Demon City of the Demon Nation.
Disguised as loose cultivators, they infiltrated Demon City covertly and accidentally encountered Zhu Tian on an undercover visit. Zhu Tian pretended not to recognize them, and after a series of staged dramas, they finally confirmed that the Jiuying Clan was involved in the smuggling.
Pretending to provoke a confrontation, they caused an uproar at the Jiuying Clan, fighting from the Jiuying of the Foundation Establishment Stage up to forcing a Body Integration Realm great demon of the Jiuying Clan to take action. Seeing they were outmatched, the two pretended to flee, drawing out the Pass Tribulation elder of the Jiuying Clan from seclusion to pursue them.
At a critical moment, Zhu Tian intervened and controlled the Jiuying elder.
Following the trail, through confessions from the Jiuying Clan, they confirmed that the smuggling counterpart in Great Xia was Jing Yan Song from the Qin royal family. After the Great Xia Dynasty was informed, they cooperated in the arrest, bringing down the longstanding power of the Qin royalty and using the proceeds from smuggling to replenish the treasuries of both nations.
The case became the largest smuggling case since the founding of the Demon Nation and was also listed as a typical case by the Ministry of Punishments of Great Xia, to be passed down through the ages.
During the confrontation with the Body Integration Realm great demon of the Jiuying Clan, Lu Yang inadvertently obtained a torn map from the adversary's bosom. After researching ancient texts, he realized the map was the key to unlocking the legendary Yunxiao Secret Realm, which contained innumerable treasures. Only by collecting all nine pieces of the map could the Yunxiao Secret Realm be opened.
Lu Yang also discovered that the owners of the pieces could communicate through them. All nine pieces had owners, but they didn't trust each other enough to meet. Left with no other choice, Lu Yang had to request the Heavenly Strategy Sect to intervene. Using the piece of map, they calculated the locations of the other eight owners, whom they then sought out one by one.
Among these eight, the highest in cultivation was in the Body Integration Realm, and the lowest was in the Golden Core Stage.
After assembling the map pieces, they opened the Yunxiao Secret Realm. However, only cultivators in the Golden Core Stage could enter the Secret Realm. Lu Yang had to ask Vast Sea Daoist Lord to use the power of the Embryonic Spatial Dao Fruit to extend the entrance range, allowing all nine to enter.
The Yunxiao Secret Realm was actually a trap left by a Pass Tribulation Cultivator from the late stage of the Great Qian Dynasty. After discovering this, Vast Sea Daoist Lord and the Great Qian Cultivators confronted each other, ultimately capturing him. Regarding the treasures inside the Yunxiao Secret Realm, the most valuable turned out to be the Great Qian Cultivator himself.
Apart from these events and some minor mundane matters, nothing else happened during these ten years.
Atop Sky Gate Mountain, high-grade Spirit Stones formed a Qi Gathering Formation radiating outward from the center. Lu Yang brought his hands together, situated atop a lotus platform formed by nine Spirit Swords.
Lu Yang formed hand seals, adjusted his breath, and united his Essence, Qi, and Spirit as if they were a Spirit Sword piercing the heavens.
As Lu Yang's momentum climbed, the high-grade Spirit Stones rapidly depleted, turning into empty shells, transforming into a continuous stream of power that surged into Lu Yang's body.
His meridians expanded, his Dantian enlarged, and his primordial spirit became vividly lifelike... Transformative changes happened inside his body.
The momentum that reached its peak suddenly dropped, and Lu Yang breathed out a clear breath; his divine spirit and body were pure, long free from any acquired impurities.
He moved his body, which made creaking noises, and said, "Finally, I have reached Mid-stage of Transforming Spirit."

chapters.title: Chapter 977 - 976 Why Is It So Dark?
chapters.content:
"Finally reached the mid-stage of Spirit Transformation," Lu Yang sighed in the pitch darkness of his abode. As he opened his eyes, their bright pupils stood out in the dark space.
"Wait, why is it so dark?"
"Isn't it because Immortal thought it would be more atmospheric without the candles, so I blew them out?"
Now that solar-powered lamps had become widespread, hardly anyone used candles anymore. Lu Yang's abode was lit by mermaid candles, which he felt no need to replace just yet.
Lu Yang shook his head, resigned. With his current level of cultivation, whether or not the candles were lit didn't really matter—he could see clearly either way. Since Fairy Eternity wished to blow out the candles, he let her be.
Lu Yang stretched leisurely. It had taken him three full hours to break through to the mid-stage of Spirit Transformation. Now that his seclusion was over, he felt much more relaxed.
He then sat back down.
"I'll consolidate my realm."
His foundation was solid; he only needed to reinforce it slightly.
As his realm stabilized, Lu Yang pushed open the doors of his abode, only to see Yun Mengmeng with her back to him, facing the chessboard. After a long pause, she picked up a black piece and, with a click, placed it on the board, signaling the end of the game.
"Five in a row, I win," Yun Mengmeng cheered.
"Sister Mengmeng, Third Senior Sister, could you find another place to play chess?" Lu Yang asked helplessly. "Don't block my abode's entrance with your game. When I started my seclusion, you weren't here. When did you come over?"
Gan Tian explained with a smile, "Mengmeng said the feng shui here is good. Being close to your abode, she thought she might absorb some of your luck to help her win."
"How is my luck any good?" Lu Yang wondered. Was she referring to how he had been entangled with Fairy Eternity?
"Xiao Zhi said that demi-immortals and immortals are not as common in the outside world as I thought, and that you are lucky to have encountered them."
"See, I told you your luck is good," Yun Mengmeng said triumphantly, pointing at the chessboard. "Being near your abode and absorbing your luck, I won the first game."
Next to the chessboard was a plate of cookies filled with laurel flower petals, with the winner of each game earning one.
Knowing Yun Mengmeng's skill at chess, Lu Yang suspected Third Senior Sister had let her win on purpose.
Just having had a breakthrough and feeling elated, Lu Yang decided to go down the mountain to see how Old Meng and the others were doing with their cultivation.
Yun Mengmeng called after Lu Yang, still chewing on a cookie, "Oh right, Xiao Zhi said she's gone out to visit friends and probably won't be back today. Since you've had your breakthrough, Second-in-command, how about the three of us go celebrate at Hundred Fragrance Building tonight?"
"Sure," Lu Yang replied with a smile. Breaking through to the mid-stage of Spirit Transformation was indeed worth celebrating.
After Lu Yang left, the two women started the second game of chess.
"By the way, Mengmeng, why do you always call Junior Brother 'Second-in-command'?" Gan Tian asked, puzzled. Had Junior Brother and Mengmeng ever sworn to be siblings?
Yun Mengmeng gave a mysterious smile, "It's a secret."
...
Lu Yang found Meng Jingzhou's abode, but unfortunately, he was in seclusion.
Man Gu had been invited to a Nascent Soul level competition in another state to serve as a judge. As a cultivator of the Divinity Transformation Stage from Seek Dao Sect, his status was quite significant in the outside world, almost equivalent to that of a high-level cultivator.
"Junior Brother Li, what are you busy with... Oh, Senior Su is here too. Hello, Senior Su," Lu Yang hadn't expected Su Yiren to be there as well.
"Hmm, I figured Haoran was about to break through to the mid-stage of Spirit Transformation, so I came to protect him," Su Yiren said with a sweet smile as she peeled an apple for Li Haoran, slicing it into small, bite-sized pieces.
"There's no need for a protector when breaking through to the mid-stage of Spirit Transformation," Li Haoran muttered under his breath. Breaking through was a matter of course, probably taking less than half a day. Su Yiren's special trip made him feel somewhat embarrassed, especially saying it in front of a friend made it even worse.
```
Unlike cultivators typically facing a breakthrough who make all sorts of preparations, he was on the cusp of a breakthrough and still had the leisure to design a magic artifact for refining, not needing to make any preparations at all.
Or rather, his mind state for the most important part was already prepared.
Li Haoran's designs covered the entire Abode, underfoot and overhead. This was a magic artifact.
Lu Yang, who didn't understand much about refining, tilted his head and studied Li Haoran's designs for quite some time, yet couldn't figure out what exactly Li Haoran intended to refine. He could only discern a Sword Array on the blueprint.
"What is this you've drawn on the blueprint?"
"An automatic stir fry pot, this is the Water Sphere Formation, this is the Sword Array, this is the Rootless Fire Formation. As long as the ingredients are ready, this magic artifact can automatically wash, chop, and cook the food. The taste should be comparable to that made by a beginner-level Spirit Chef."
"This is great stuff," Lu Yang exclaimed in admiration. If such a magic artifact were to be crafted and then upgraded generation after generation, wouldn't it block the road for Fairy Eternity?
"No magic artifact can replace my culinary skills," Fairy Eternity said, looking down on Li Haoran's artifact.
"Right? Senior Brother Lu, you also think this is good stuff," Li Haoran very much trusted Lu Yang's taste.
Seeing Li Haoran's imminent breakthrough, Lu Yang did not show off his cultivation level on purpose, to avoid causing a gap in Li Haoran's mind state during his breakthrough.
"Once you break through, I'll treat you to a meal," Lu Yang bid farewell to Li Haoran and Su Yiren.
On his way to find Tao Yaoye, Lu Yang also ran into several disciples from the latest cohort, all of whom respectfully called him "Senior Brother." These junior brothers had a smooth time taking part in the sect entrance trial, which was overseen by Elder Brother Dai, and no accidents had occurred.
"It's a pity. When they were undergoing the entrance trial, Old Meng and I were in the Demon Nation and didn't get the chance to help Elder Brother Dai ease the pressure."
"Junior Sister Tao, are you there?" Lu Yang triggered the Array Method at the entrance of Tao Yaoye's Abode, which could notify its owner.
Tao Yaoye popped her head out, and seeing only Lu Yang alone, she smiled and pulled him into the Abode, "Senior Brother Lu, please come in."
Once inside the Abode, Lu Yang saw a pile of Spirit Stones stacked like a small mountain, with not even a single low-grade one, only mid- and high-grade Spirit Stones.
"Are all these yours?"
"This is just the income from selling Dream Mirage this quarter, it was just delivered, and I'm counting the amount of Spirit Stones."
Lu Yang silently clicked his tongue; Junior Sister Tao must have enough Spirit Stones to last even if she cultivated up to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage without running out.
"Rich lady, the day Senior Brother runs out of money, I might need Junior Sister Tao's financial aid."
"What are you talking about, Senior Brother? If you need Spirit Stones, I would have no objections to giving all of these to you."
"That wouldn't be right," Lu Yang quickly waved his hands, he was just joking.
After chatting with Tao Yaoye for a while, and with the sky darkening, Lu Yang headed to the Hundred Fragrance Building on the shopping street as agreed, where Yun Mengmeng and Gan Tian were waiting for him in a private room.
"Come on, let's celebrate the Second-in-command's successful breakthrough," Yun Mengmeng raised her glass, which contained freshly squeezed peach juice.
Gan Tian's glass had clear spring water.
Lu Yang's glass was filled with laurel flower tea.
Saying it was a celebration for Lu Yang was actually just Yun Mengmeng's excuse because she had a sweet tooth; eating alone was no fun, and the more people present, the merrier the meal at the Hundred Fragrance Building.
After the three of them had eaten, Lu Yang thanked Yun Mengmeng for the treat and returned to his Abode to sit and cultivate. The night passed.
"Finally reached the mid-stage of Transforming Spirit," he sighed in the darkness of the Abode. With Lu Yang's sigh, it marked the end of three hours of seclusion, signifying his breakthrough to the mid-stage of Transforming Spirit.
"Wait, why is it so dark... Hmm, haven't I said this before?"
```

chapters.title: Chapter 978 - 977: Time Reversal
chapters.content:
Lu Yang furrowed his brows, recalling yesterday's events: the end of his seclusion, consolidation of his foundation, and then encountering Yun Mengmeng and Gan Tian…
"What happened, why do I still appear as if I've just made a breakthrough but haven't consolidated my cultivation level?"
Lu Yang was certain that there was no deviation in his memory, but one's realm could not deceive others.
"Fairy, wake up," Lu Yang entered the Spiritual Space and pushed Fairy Eternity, which also did not align with his memories.
According to his memory, after his breakthrough to the mid-stage of Transforming Spirit, Fairy Eternity should have been awake.
"Yawning, why are you waking me up so early, Immortal? I haven't slept enough; without enough sleep, how can I defeat Miss Yun…" mumbled Fairy Eternity groggily as she got up from bed, only to go back to sleep.
"Fairy, something ominous has happened; the events of yesterday repeated themselves today," Lu Yang tirelessly tried waking Fairy Eternity again.
"What do you mean 'ominous'? You probably haven't woken up yet either; come sleep with me," Fairy Eternity grabbed Lu Yang, using him like a pillow, and continued sleeping.
With Fairy Eternity's cultivation level, there was truly no chance for Lu Yang to break free. Realizing he couldn't rely on the fairy for the time being, he had to step out and explore the issue on his own.
Lu Yang opened his Abode, and unlike his memory, Yun Mengmeng and Gan Tian did not appear.
"What is happening here? Right, after my breakthrough yesterday, I consolidated for a period of an hour before I encountered Sister Mengmeng and Third Sister playing chess. It was their first game, which means they haven't arrived yet."
Now was not the time to consolidate his realm, so Lu Yang released his Spiritual Sense and, finding Yun Mengmeng swinging on a swing at Maple Ridge, he hurriedly flew over.
Yun Mengmeng was quite surprised to see Lu Yang, and with a strong swing, she leaped off at the highest point: "Second-in-command, you finished your seclusion so quickly?"
"Sister Mengmeng, aren't you and Third Senior Sister planning to play Go at the entrance of my Abode, trying to use my luck to win?"
"Ah, how did you know, have you developed telepathy?"
Yun Mengmeng also didn't remember yesterday, Lu Yang thought to himself.
"It's nothing, I guessed," Lu Yang speculated, then bid Yun Mengmeng farewell and turned to leave.
Yun Mengmeng called out to Lu Yang, "Hey second-in-command, since you've broken through, why don't we go to the Hundred Fragrance Building tonight to celebrate?"
"No thanks, I have something tonight and might not be able to come back."
Seeing Lu Yang running farther away puzzled Yun Mengmeng: "Strange, why is the second-in-command in such a rush, it's as if he hasn't even had time to consolidate his realm."
Lu Yang decided to skip visiting Old Meng and Man Gu and raced towards Li Haoran's Abode.
"Junior Brother Li, open the door, I need to speak with you."
The grand doors of the Abode opened and Lu Yang strode in, greeting Su Yiren before finding Li Haoran, "Greetings, Senior Su."
Su Yiren was taken aback, wondering why Lu Yang showed no signs of surprise upon seeing her. Could he have preemptively perceived her with his Spiritual Sense?
That didn't make sense; how could she not have sensed being scanned by Spiritual Sense?
"Senior Brother Lu, what brings you here so urgently?" Li Haoran felt that Lu Yang was very frantic.
Lu Yang grabbed Li Haoran's shoulders, looking into his eyes, "Have you awakened memories from your past life?"
Li Haoran was bewildered, "Haven't I always had memories from my past life?"
"I mean, have you recalled which life's memories?"
"Still the fourth life."
"You don't have memories from the first three lives?"
"No, I've never been able to remember things from my first three lives."
Lu Yang frowned, this shouldn't be happening; could it be that this isn't a reversal of time, and the source isn't with Junior Brother Li?
Suddenly, Lu Yang seemed to remember something and asked again, "Do you have any plans to breakthrough soon?"
"I plan to enter seclusion to breakthrough in a month," Li Haoran honestly said, as there was nothing to hide.
Li Haoran noticed that Lu Yang's gaze was somehow strange. Could it be that Lu Yang had come to boast about his cultivation level again?
"So, are these full wall of blueprints for an automatic cooking pot?"
"You could tell?" Li Haoran was greatly surprised and looked at Lu Yang with new respect, as only a Great Grandmaster of Refining could discern the meaning of the blueprints. How did Senior Brother Lu see through it at a glance?
"Strange, my memory isn't mistaken..." Lu Yang muttered softly.
Lu Yang could not understand and decided to wake up Immortal Fairy again, as he had been troubled for a long time, and the fairy should have had enough sleep.
"Fairy, wake up, it seems like we are caught in a time loop."
"Time loop?" Immortal Fairy yawned, noticing herself holding Lu Yang, and immediately kicked Lu Yang off the bed in shock.
"How come you are in my bed?"
"...Wasn't it you who just hugged me?" Lu Yang said with a wronged face, as Immortal Fairy's kick was not light.
"Let's not talk about this, I encountered something strange."
Lu Yang thoroughly described the events of yesterday and today.
At the end, Lu Yang uncertainly added, "I shouldn't have cultivated the divine ability to foresee the future, should I?"
After the earlier events, Immortal Fairy awoke completely, rolled her eyes and said, "What wishful thinking. I also remember yesterday's events."
"Hearing this description, it really sounds like a time loop, rolling back one day. That's something only the Time Dao Fruit could achieve, even the Dao Fruit Outline couldn't have such great capability."
"You are protected by me, hence unaffected, but Third and Fourth Housekeeper, their cultivation isn't profound enough, and they are completely trapped in the reincarnation."
"Has Time Immortal come back to life?"
"Fairy, check if it was caused by Junior Brother Li."
"Let me see."
Immortal Fairy extended her Immortal Sense and examined Li Haoran thoroughly from inside out, including checking for magic artifacts similar to the Black Ancient Ring, all without Li Haoran and Su Yiren noticing.
"Strange, if Time Immortal were awake, there should be a reaction to my Immortal Sense."
"Stay close to this young man tonight, I need to observe him thoroughly."
"Alright."
In reality, Lu Yang said earnestly, "Junior Brother Li, as brothers, we haven't had a good exchange for a while. How about we share our cultivation experiences tonight? Senior Su is here as well."
Li Haoran hesitated and nodded, feeling that today's Lu Yang was somewhat odd.
The three of them indeed started discussing cultivation experiences in Li Haoran's abode and talked until late into the night. They were all spirited and gleaned benefits from the exchange.
Suddenly, Lu Yang's vision darkened, and he found himself back in his own abode, still in the posture of just having broken through to the mid-stage of Spirit Transformation, not yet having consolidated his cultivation level.
"Fairy, any discoveries?"
Lu Yang let out steam, which formed the appearance of Immortal Fairy on the opposite side.
Immortal Fairy crossed her arms and tilted her head with a frown, visibly puzzled, "It truly is time reversal, and it's not limited to our sect but is worldwide."
"But it doesn't seem to be caused by Chap Li. Could it be that he is merely a reincarnation of Time Immortal, but the Time Dao Fruit didn't reincarnate with him?"
"Where did the Time Dao Fruit go?"

chapters.title: Chapter 979 - 978: Congratulations
chapters.content:
"The Time Dao Fruit isn't on Junior Brother Li?"
Lu Yang found this matter not too difficult to understand. Reincarnation was unprecedented; nobody had ever encountered it, nor could anyone clarify what it was about. It was entirely possible that the Time Immortal was reincarnated as Li Haoran, yet the Time Dao Fruit was missing.
"Then who is using the Time Dao Fruit? I remember Eldest Senior Sister saying that even if someone obtained the Time Dao Fruit, they couldn't easily use it. One must have a profound understanding of the Dao Fruit to do so."
A feeling of unease vaguely rose within Lu Yang. Someone had obtained the Time Dao Fruit, but was this person friend or foe, and why were they continuously repeating this day?
Could it be that the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord got his hands on the Time Dao Fruit...
"That I do not know."
"Is there a way to find the user?"
"That's impossible unless you can observe every single action of every single thing in this world. When the next cycle of reincarnation happens, if someone's actions differ from the previous cycle, that person would be the user."
Lu Yang sighed; indeed, this was an impossible method.
After chatting a bit more, the conclusion was that there was no way to find out. Lu Yang decided to go out to change his mood.
Regardless, today was also the day he broke through to the mid-stage Transforming Spirit, which was something to celebrate.
Lu Yang pushed open the door of the Abode and saw Yun Mengmeng and Third Senior Sister setting up a chessboard and snacks at the entrance, so he greeted them.
"Sister Mengmeng, Third Senior Sister, good morning, I..."
Lu Yang's vision darkened, and once again, he was back to the state just after he had finished his closed-door cultivation at the Abode.
"..."
Lu Yang took a couple of deep breaths and tried to calm himself, "It hasn't even been a full hour, how has time reversed again?!"
Isn't it supposed to reverse time only once a day!
"It's likely that the Time Dao Fruit user encountered something, necessitating a return to this time node," he thought.
Lu Yang covered his face, feeling no inclination to celebrate his breakthrough to mid-stage Transforming Spirit anymore.
"However, it's unpredictable; perhaps the user found it amusing to reverse time several times. I heard that when the Time Immortal initially obtained the Time Dao Fruit, he was particularly excited, frequently causing time to reverse and then acting like he could predict the future."
"You heard?"
"Yes, I wasn't an immortal back then, so when time reversed, I didn't know. All this came from the tales of Immortal Jiuchong afterward."
"So immortals are not affected by the reversal of time?"
"Not entirely unaffected; the body will still return to the original time node. It's just that memories will be retained."
Lu Yang frowned: "Doesn't this mean that all immortals are aware that the Time Dao Fruit has appeared and they will all be seeking the Time Dao Fruit user?"
Fairy Eternity shrugged, "So what if they are? Could they possibly find them?"
Lu Yang still felt something was off. This Time Dao Fruit user was a bit too brazen. Did they have some sort of backup plan?
...
"The Time Dao Fruit has appeared?!" The middle-aged man on the celestial throne opened his eyes wide, a flash of brilliant light and surprise passing through them.
In thirty thousand years of being an immortal, this was the first time he'd seen a trace of the Time Dao Fruit.
"You all, quickly find the Time Dao Fruit for me!" The middle-aged man's voice was authoritative, like an Immortal King who reigned supreme and whose celestial might was inviolable.
Along the sides of the celestial throne, shadowy figures stirred, and one stood out, asking, "May I inquire, how shall we search for the Time Dao Fruit Outline?"
The Mid-heaven Emperor Lord thought about it and realized his own foolish delight. Indeed, the Time Dao Fruit had appeared, but who knew where it was.
"...Take the Seeking Immortal Token and wander around more often."
"As you command."
...
Inside the abode, Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity yawned listlessly, the joy of breaking through to the mid-stage of Spirit Transformation having been completely worn away by the repeated reincarnations.
"Fairy, how many times have we reincarnated?"
"This might be the seventh time."
In these seven reincarnations, Lu Yang had almost made a circuit around Sky Gate Mountain and had done everything there was to do, such as asking Tao Yaoye how many Spirit Stones she had made in this quarter before the end of the last reincarnation, so that in the next one he could go straight to her and tell her the amount of Spirit Stones.
Or upon learning in the previous reincarnation that Bai Ye had a taste for walnut pastries, he would bring a bag of them along the next time he visited.
"When will the user ever be done? Why hasn't it ended yet?"
"Wait, what time is it now?"
"Should be around 5 a.m. to 7 a.m."
Lu Yang abruptly stood up; the reincarnations had been happening at 3 a.m. to 5 a.m., but now it had already passed 5 a.m., the sky was bright, and the reincarnation still hadn't occurred.
"Has time finally returned to normal?"
Lu Yang pushed open the door of the abode, where a messy chessboard lay at the entrance. Yun Mengmeng and Third Senior Sister had played Go all day long and, agreeing to a rematch the next day, had not put the board away.
Lu Yang was certain that he had not entered another reincarnation.
Considering that in one previous experience, reincarnation had occurred one hour after the breakthrough to the mid-stage of Spirit Transformation, it was clear that the time of reincarnation was not set, so Lu Yang did not rush to feel happy.
Half a day passed, and still no reincarnation occurred, and Eldest Senior Sister also returned to the Seek Dao Sect.
"Eldest Senior Sister, you've finally come back."
"Yes, I have. The matter of the Time Reincarnation is not urgent. I will tell you about the things that have happened these few days later. You should first stabilize your realm." Yun Zhi noticed that Lu Yang, after his breakthrough, had not taken the time to consolidate his realm.
"Alright." Seeing Eldest Senior Sister, Lu Yang instantly felt much relieved. He didn't care whether there would be another reincarnation and went to stabilize his realm with peace of mind.
When Lu Yang opened his eyes again, Yun Zhi had already set up a table and chairs with tea at the entrance of the abode, while Yun Mengmeng's chessboard was nowhere to be seen.
"Have some tea." Yun Zhi gestured with her eyes, signaling Lu Yang to sit down.
Lu Yang sipped a small mouthful of tea; it was indeed superb Enlightenment Tea.
"It's also my fault, really. When reincarnation started, Meng Junzi and I were engaged in a debate. Neither of us was affected by the reversal of time, and neither realized that time had flowed backward. It was only after Jiang Pingan found us that we became aware of the issue."
"At the time, I suspected the problem might be on Junior Brother Li's side and wanted to come back to check, but then Immortal Fairy informed me through a puppet that the source was not with Junior Brother Li. That's why I didn't come back and instead went to search for the user of the Time Dao Fruit."
"A puppet?" Lu Yang wondered where this puppet had come from.
Wait, could it be the same puppet that had been bullying me since I began cultivating?
Is it possible to contact Eldest Senior Sister through that puppet?
"The three of us suspected that the user of the Time Dao Fruit had been forced to use it during a battle with someone. Unfortunately, we split up and none of us found any trace of an Immortal Battle."
"Now that the person has stopped using the Time Dao Fruit, the leads have been cut off, so I've come back."
"So that's what happened." Lu Yang breathed a sigh of relief, having thought that Eldest Senior Sister had encountered some trouble preventing her from coming back.
It's good that there's no trouble.
"Junior Brother."
"What is it?"
Lu Yang looked up and saw Eldest Senior Sister raising her tea cup, "Congratulations on advancing to the mid-stage of Spirit Transformation."

chapters.title: Chapter 980 - 979: Invitation
chapters.content:
The youth sprinted frantically through the torrential rain, with several corpses haphazardly strewn behind him, their blood blending with the rainwater and staining the ground red.
He pushed open the wooden door and, seeing his little sister unharmed, didn't care how muddy the ground was and sat down at the doorway, bursting into laughter.
As he laughed, he started to cry, then stood up and hugged his little sister tightly, as if she were a cherished treasure regained, unwilling to let go.
"Little sister, you're finally safe," he said.
The little sister, overwhelmed by the teenager's actions, wanted to say something but didn't know what to say, so she just gently patted his back.
Just as she tried to say some comforting words, she found that the teenager had already fallen asleep on her shoulder.
The youth had a very long dream.
In his dream, he saw his sister die before his eyes, and then the murderer killed him as well.
But he didn't actually die; instead, he returned to the day before the incident with his sister.
Thinking it was just a dream, he didn't think much about it, but when he realized the dream was turning into reality, he panicked. Everything was just as it had been the first time, with his sister dying before his eyes.
When he returned to the day before once again, he was eager to tell his sister everything he had experienced, but just as he was about to speak, everything faded to black, a relentless darkness engulfing him, and he returned to the starting point again.
He mustn't speak of the strange occurrences happening to him, a revelation he had somehow received.
To save his sister, he went through many reincarnations, relying on the knowledge he gained with each cycle to secretly manipulate events. Finally, on the seventh reincarnation, he defeated the murderer, and his sister survived.
He opened his eyes, lying on the bed. His muddy clothes had been removed by his sister, and she had also wiped his body clean. From another room came the sound of water, probably his sister washing his clothes.
The youth had never felt the bed to be such a warm place.
He lifted his right hand, scrutinizing his fingers as if he were examining the ceiling, remembering the seven reincarnations as if they were a dream.
The youth muttered to himself, his eyes showing a hint of confusion: "What on earth is going on?"
Even in the storybooks about cultivators, there was nothing like this.
...
The seven reincarnations were not the endpoint of the reincarnation event, but the starting point.
Since then, Lu Yang had encountered hundreds of reincarnations, both big and small.
This made Lu Yang feel more and more that it wasn't just the Time Dao Fruit user playing around, nor was it a battle.
Lu Yang's side had also never found any information about the Time Dao Fruit user.
According to Eldest Senior Sister, Jiang Pingan had used the Power of National Fate to observe the entire Great Xia in several reincarnations, trying to find something different from the previous cycles, but he hadn't found any useful clues.
Lu Yang had gone to the Fairy Palace to see the Yingtian Immortal, who also had no idea, only saying that probably the opportunity hadn't come yet, and if destined, they would eventually meet.
Lu Yang translated Yingtian Immortal's words for himself: I don't know how to find the Time Dao Fruit user either.
At the peak of Sky Gate Mountain, Lu Yang sheathed his Sword Qi, signaling the end of this training session.
Every time he trained, Lu Yang was on tenterhooks, afraid of encountering a time reversal and losing his progress for nothing.
Thanks to that unseen user, Lu Yang had already let six hundred hours of training results go to waste.
"Just consider it as refining my state of mind," Lu Yang consoled himself.
"Second-in-command, you have a letter," Mengmeng waved a tan envelope as she ran over.
"My letter?"
Lu Yang had received many letters, being famous not only for his high cultivation level and rich experience but also for his gentle nature. Many cultivators and mortals had written to him, some wanting to meet him, some requesting his autograph, some wishing to share insights, and even some sending outright confessions.
Lu Yang thought it was another admirer's letter, but upon opening it, he realized it was not.
"From Kaihuang Temple in Buddha Country?"
Lu Yang had no recollection of Kaihuang Temple, but after reading the letter, he suddenly realized.
"So they're inviting me to make a show of support."
"Make a show of support?" Yun Mengmeng was puzzled.
"In the letter, Kaihuang Temple mentioned that Master Shi Chan had discussed me during a sermon there. Coincidentally, they're holding the Buddha Bathing Festival and there's also a competition among cultivators. They hope I can grace them with my presence as a judge."
"Buddha Country practices a theocratic governance system, meaning that Kaihuang Temple is not just a temple but also manages the local city, much like our government offices."
"However, Kaihuang Temple is not a major temple and doesn't manage a significant city. Their asking me to come and lend my influence to make a good impression is very likely."
If it were a major city or a major temple, Lu Yang would certainly have some recollection of it.
"I see."
Although Yun Mengmeng didn't quite understand, she nodded anyway.
"So, are you going?"
Lu Yang put away the envelope, "Kaihuang Temple doesn't seem to have any ulterior motives, and since I've never been to Buddha Country, it would be good to visit."
Considering the reputation of his master and the second senior brother in Buddha Country, Lu Yang generally hesitated to go there, to avoid any man-made difficulties.
This time, being invited as a notable guest was a rare opportunity, so of course, he intended to go.
"Sister Mengmeng, do you want to go?"
"Is there anything tasty in Buddha Country?" Yun Mengmeng was most concerned about this.
Lu Yang recalled the specialities of Buddha Country, "Due to religious beliefs, there is basically no meat in Buddha Country, only vegetarian food, which is exceptional."
"Then never mind." Yun Mengmeng's interest in Buddha Country drastically reduced, "Just bring me some specialities from Buddha Country when you come back, Second-in-command."
"Agreed."
Immortal Fairy emerged, her face showing confusion as she recalled the traditions of Buddhism, "It's rather strange, when we five were creating Buddhism, I always advocated not to distinguish between vegetarian and non-vegetarian food.
Yingtian Immortal and the other four insisted that Buddhism should avoid meat and consume more vegetarian food, even saying that since I was the founder of Buddhism, I should follow the rules and make more vegetarian food later on. All four of them said this, so I had to agree to the dietary restrictions of Buddhism."
Lu Yang felt it might be because the toxicity of the vegetarian food you make is less than that of the meat dishes.
"So, Immortal, will you only make vegetarian food from now on?"
"Not at all. I'm the founder; I don't need to follow any rules."
"..."
Kaihuang Temple wasn't sure the envelope would reach the Seek Dao Sect, so they sent it many days in advance. There's still some time until the Buddha Bathing Festival, so Lu Yang could prepare slowly.
For example, by inviting a friend.
"Old Meng, do you fancy a trip to Buddha Country?" Lu Yang, with a mischievous grin, approached Meng Jingzhou, showing him the letter from Kaihuang Temple.
Meng Jingzhou silently took out a letter, also sent from Kaihuang Temple.
"You got one too?" Lu Yang was surprised.
Meng Jingzhou, slightly annoyed, gave Lu Yang a look, "As an Innate Buddhist, it's quite normal for me to be invited, right?"
Having resigned himself to the title of 'Innate Buddhist' spread by the outside world,
"So, are you going?" Lu Yang asked.
Hearing that Buddha Country was full of sandstorms and harsh environments, Meng Jingzhou thought there was nothing appealing about Buddha Country and hadn't planned to invite Lu Yang.
"Since you're going, I might as well make a trip too."

chapters.title: Chapter 981 - 980: Learned the Principle
chapters.content:
"Eldest Senior Sister, Junior Brother Meng and I would like to go to Buddha Country," Lu Yang, always honest, reported his plans before leaving.
"You want to go to Buddha Country?"
Yun Zhi took the letter sent from Kaihuang Temple, rather surprised.
She couldn't believe that their master and the second junior brother had such poor reputations in Buddha Country, yet the junior brother could still receive an invitation from a temple there; truly, it was not easy.
She always said that the junior brother was different from their master, having an excellent reputation outside, and was a very outstanding cultivator.
"Then go ahead, but remember to be careful of your safety."
"Do you want to visit Senior Brother Ye Zijin on the way to Buddha Country?" Lu Yang remembered that Senior Brother Ye Zijin often dealt with various temples and had a tough time mixing in Buddha Country.
As Yun Zhi carefully folded the letter and put it back into the envelope, she said, "From the irregular letters sent by your senior brother, it appears he has many enemies and is constantly busy. For safety's sake, it's better not to meet him and avoid drawing fire upon yourself."
Those who could stand against Ye Zijin were at least of the Body Integration Realm, no limit in number; even if Lu Yang was confident in his own cultivation level, he had no confidence in dealing with so many people and using Old Meng as bait in a critical moment would probably be futile.
Thinking of the second junior brother, whom she hadn't seen for a long time but often heard of through the diplomatic language from Buddha Country, Yun Zhi couldn't help but sigh.
"Speaking of which, all four of us learned different things from our master, but your second senior brother, unlike the others, learned only how to draw hatred from our master."
"Your third senior sister is much better; she learned the skill of music from our master. Although she caused some trouble in the Demon Territory, it was also to practice her skills."
"You haven't had much contact with our master, but your skill in swordsmanship is also partly derived from him."
Lu Yang nodded. Indeed, the theories of swordsmanship and the sword moves taught by their master were of great help to him, especially the recently mastered 'Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin,' which could be considered one of his trump cards.
Lu Yang was curious, "Then, Eldest Senior Sister, what did you learn from our master?"
He felt that the abilities of Eldest Senior Sister didn't seem to be related to their master. The master's proud swordsmanship was only theoretically learned by the eldest sister, and he had never seen her use hatred-drawing or music skills, so she probably didn't know them either.
"I learned reasoning."
This made Lu Yang even more curious, "What sort of reasoning?"
Yun Zhi, expressionless, said, "A disciple need not be inferior to the master, nor must the master be wiser than the disciple."
"..."
...
"Map of Buddha Country, Introduction to Buddhist teachings..." Lu Yang borrowed some books related to Buddha Country from the Scripture Pavilion, thinking they might be useful.
Buddha Country was relatively closed off, and he didn't know much about it.
"With Immortal Fairy, the founder of Buddhism here, why do you need an introduction to Buddhist teachings?" Fairy Eternity showed the usefulness of her ultimate knowledge at a critical moment, knowing everything.
Considering the identity of Fairy Eternity, Lu Yang decided to bring more Buddhist scriptures.
After leaving the Scripture Pavilion, Meng Jingzhou was waiting for Lu Yang at the door.
"Are you packed and ready to go?"
"Is True Monarch Ma not with you?" Usually, when going out, Meng Jingzhou would bring Old Ma along.
"It had gone back home to the East Sea to visit relatives ten days ago. If we wait for its return, we might miss the Buddha Bathing Festival."
"With our cultivation level, we can easily protect ourselves when we're out and about; we don't need Old Ma either," Meng Jingzhou said cheerfully. Although he had previously shown little interest in the Buddha Country, he was somewhat excited when it came time to set off.
"That's also true."
Outside, both of them barely qualified to establish a First Class Sect and could be considered a major power anywhere.
If they were in the Great Yu Dynasty, they could command wind and rain, and even Body Integration cultivators would have to address them as fellow daoists. They could become the lord of a city, control life and death within it, and turn the city into a state within the state. Commoners trembling upon seeing them would offer up their wives and daughters.
...
"Hello, I'm going to the Buddha Country," Lu Yang handed his identity proof to the government office at the border, waiting for approval.
The official verified Lu Yang's true form, ensuring he was not carrying any smuggled items, and then allowed him to pass smoothly.
"You may pass now."
"Thank you."
This was the border line between Great Xia and the Buddha Country. All cultivators and commoners had to pass through here to reach the Buddha Country.
Lu Yang noticed those lined up behind him waiting for inspection had various appearances: some wore dirty monks' robes and recited scriptures, others were enveloped in black robes showing only an eye with a scar, some had robust physiques carrying thick broadswords, and some hugged delicate wooden boxes and trembled.
Noticing Lu Yang's observation, some responded with a warm smile, others warned with their gaze, and some avoided eye contact, unwilling to look at Lu Yang directly.
It seemed they all had secrets.
Lu Yang easily identified their realms: commoner, Qi Refinement fourth stage, commoner, Qi Refinement second stage...
To avoid the embarrassment of a Great Power walking the earth unrecognized by him, Lu Yang specifically asked Fairy Eternity to check their realms, which matched what he had seen.
Lu Yang held his forehead, wishing they wouldn't all act like each carried a monumental secret, making him unnecessarily anxious.
The two smoothly crossed the border line and flew over a desolate desert. Accompanied by a dizzying sensation, they arrived in the sandy Buddha Country.
"Cough cough, I always knew Buddha Country had a lot of sand, but this is just too much," one commented.
As soon as they set foot in the Buddha Country, a fierce wind whipped up the sand, forcing them to maintain a layer of spiritual essence as a protective barrier just to move normally.
Although the sand blasting their faces wasn't harmful, it was still quite uncomfortable.
"Buddha Country has been established for three hundred thousand years; haven't they thought about planting trees?" Meng Jingzhou, annoyed by the sand, took a deep breath and blew out forcefully, fighting against the wind, clearing the sand in front of them.
A Spirit Transformation Great Power had an extraordinary lung capacity. Lu Yang guessed Old Meng could keep blowing like this for a quarter of an hour.
Unlike the frequently changing dynasties of the Central Continent, Buddha Country, situated on the Western Continent, was essentially founded at the same time as the Great Qian Dynasty, boasting a history of three hundred thousand years.
Buddha Country, established on the foundation of Buddhist faith, had a rather loose structure, unlike Great Xia where decrees were enforced uniformly across all cities; there was strong independence among the cities.
Lu Yang rolled his eyes, "Plant trees? The area of Buddha Country is as vast as Great Xia, covered in sand everywhere. Even if you had Pass Tribulation cultivators running around for a lifetime, they couldn't cover it all with trees. Even an order from the Western Temple wouldn't be effective."
The Western Temple, with its long history, was the largest temple and also the ruler of Buddha Country. For example, the official documents the Seek Dao Sect often received, requesting the return of Ye Zijin, were issued by the Western Temple.
"When the Four Ancient Immortals were shaping the continents, they probably pooled all the deserts from the stars here, along with those uninhabitable stars, bare and sterile, thus forming what is now the Buddha Country. It's already remarkable that it's inhabitable."

chapters.title: Chapter 982 - 981: It's quite difficult for ordinary people to be traders.
chapters.content:
"This Buddha Country has an abundance of Incense Power, huh? Even at the border, it's perceptible." As soon as they entered Buddha Country, Fairy Eternity sensed the thin Incense Power, which was distinctively different from places in Great Xia that lacked such power.
The presence of Incense Power even in the desolate and uninhabited border regions meant that the central part of Buddha Country was so filled with it that it overflowed to the borders.
"I remember Eldest Senior Sister mentioned that in Buddha Country, Incense Power lies unclaimed everywhere. It has been accumulated by devotees over three hundred thousand years. To obtain this Incense Power, monks have to make grand vows, and upon fulfilling them, they can acquire the power based on the magnitude of their vows, which they can then use to aid their cultivation," Lu Yang remarked.
Unlike the divine Incense Power in Great Qian, which sometimes binds people, the Incense Power in Buddha Country doesn't manifest such restraints. Of course, it's also much harder to obtain than in Great Qian.
"Old Lu, it looks like someone's being attacked by Demon Beasts over there," Meng Jingzhou sent a spiritual message to Lu Yang, who was currently spitting out sand and thus couldn't speak.
"Then stop blowing the damn sand and hurry up to save them," Lu Yang's consciousness left the Spiritual Space, and using his Spiritual Sense, he saw that it seemed to be a group of merchants being attacked by Demon Beasts. The situation looked quite grim.
In Buddha Country, each city was extremely far apart from one another, and the vast desert provided hiding spots for Demon Beasts. Every year, eminent monks would wander through Buddha Country to exterminate Demon Beasts. Unfortunately, their numbers were too great and they were too good at hiding to be completely eliminated.
...
"Forget the goods, saving our lives is what's important!"
"As if anyone here doesn't want to stay alive!"
"Old An, if worst comes to worst, you take the others and get out of here quickly. I'll cover the rear!"
"Nonsense, you are no match for these Sand Wolves!"
The camels, terrified by the bloodthirsty aura of the Sand Wolves, trembled. Some ran away with their loads, while others simply lay on the ground.
The merchants, well-versed in the ways of the world, each drew their curved blades in a desperate fight for survival. The Sand Wolves were ferocious, but the merchants were no match for these bloodthirsty creatures.
Sand Wolves were the last thing merchants wanted to encounter on their journeys, more often deadly than not, with only a slim chance of survival.
Suddenly, one Sand Wolf took advantage of a merchant's distraction and pounced fiercely, tackling Old An to the ground.
Old An fiercely resisted the Sand Wolf's claws with his curved knife, but the Sand Wolf was incredibly strong, and Old An quickly started to lose the struggle for control.
"Old An!"
Just as they fell into despair, a stern voice broke through like a thunderclap.
"Wicked beast, cease your arrogance!"
In the midst of the swirling sands, a figure soared in the sky, seeming like Buddha Himself, with His two fingers joined together and a halo that symbolized the Consummation of Buddhist practice at His back.
The halo suddenly dispersed, turning into countless Sword Qi, piercing precisely through the skulls of the Sand Wolves.
Another divine figure formed a Fist Seal with his hands, and the golden Swastika Fist Seal exploded forth, shattering the brains of the Sand Wolves.
Old An pushed the lifeless Sand Wolf off and quickly knelt to kowtow. "Thank you, Master, for your grace in saving our lives."
The others also came to their senses and knelt to express their gratitude to the two divine figures.
Lu Yang landed, smiling slightly. "Benefactors... there is no need for such formalities. My Junior Brother and I just happened to pass by and it was merely a matter of convenience. Please, rise."
At that moment, Meng Jingzhou also came over, shooting Lu Yang a glance: Your idea of a 'matter of convenience' is to extravagantly deploy countless Sword Qi?
Lu Yang returned Meng Jingzhou a look: Are you any better, using Arhat Fist against a group of Demon Beasts that have just entered the Qi Cultivation Stage?
Under the combined efforts of two great cultivators, they were lucky to slaughter the Sand Wolves to near extinction.
"Master..."
"Just call me Meng Jingzhou, and this is my junior brother, Lu Yang."
"Ah? You, You two are Buddhist Meng and Sword Immortal Lu?" Old An and the group of merchants had not expected that their saviors were the legendary figures Meng Jingzhou and Lu Yang, and they became excited.
These were legendary figures, and even in Great Xia, there weren't many who had seen them; to think they would encounter them in Buddha Country.
This must be the so-called fateful connection spoken of by Buddhism.
"Indeed, it is us." Meng Jingzhou kept a straight face, trying hard to maintain a detached demeanor, not wanting to let these merchants think that he was pleased by such a big reaction from them.
In the course of their conversation, Lu Yang learned that Old An was the leader of the merchants, named An Hu, and they had brought a consignment of solar lamps from Great Xia to see if there was a market for them in Buddha Country, never expecting to run into the Sand Wolves.
"Oh, you're also going to Kaihuang City? If Uncle An doesn't mind, could you perhaps take the two of us with you?"
Lu Yang thought to himself that good deeds indeed bring good rewards; what a coincidence this was.
"That would be great," An Hu and the others said joyfully upon hearing this. To travel with legendary figures would give them face among other merchants.
And with these two individuals with them, there would certainly be no danger along the way.
Then, on the way to Kaihuang City, An Hu and the others encountered the Sand Wolf King out for vengeance having reached the Consummation of Qi Refinement, the notorious bandits of the Foundation Establishment Stage of the desert, a Golden Core Stage Demon Monk who had fallen onto the Demon Path to prove his way through killing, and the Nascent Soul Stage Lady Whitebone, born from a pile of dead bodies and sucking the essence blood of humans every night.
"You ordinary people have it quite tough being merchants." Lu Yang remarked. The enemies they encountered on the road meant nothing to him and Old Meng, but for Old An and the others, they were calamities capable of wiping them out.
"...Actually, many merchants never encounter Sand Wolves in their lifetime."
As for the likes of the Sand Wolf King and the Desert's Three Thieves, those were even more far-fetched tales; the Demon Monk and Lady Whitebone were beings they had never even heard of.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou rode on camels, their first time riding them, which was rather fun.
Tied to both sides of the camels were the spoils of their journey: Sand Wolf pelts, the Sand Wolf King's pelt, the Desert's Three Thieves' Storage Rings, the Demon Monk's Golden Core, glittering white bones...
These items held no value for Lu Yang and the others; for example, the spirit stones in the Desert's Three Thieves' Storage Rings together didn't amount to as much as what Lu Yang earned in a single day, and inside the ring was a key to open a secret realm, which upon checking the books brought from the Scripture Pavilion, was found to be suitable for Foundation Establishment Stage practitioners—a place many of them sought to pick herbs and concoct elixirs to increase their chances of forming a golden core by twenty percent.
The Demon Monk had a human skin scroll that detailed the method for forming a false core, which was comparable to the early stage of a Golden Core, but made further advancement hopeless.
The two thought to give all these items to Old An and the others, but on second thought, given the dangerous environment in Buddha Country, there might be incidents of murder for loot, and Old An and his group might not be able to keep so many things. In the end, they decided to leave only the Sand Wolf pelts for Old An and his group.
"Are you two masters coming to Kaihuang City to attend the Buddha Bathing Festival?" Old An struck up a conversation along the way, finding after some contact that the two masters were as gentle and approachable as depicted in the storytelling, with no airs about them.
"Yes, we were invited by Kaihuang Temple to participate."
"That's wonderful." Old An and the others were very happy to hear this. With these two masters attending the Buddha Bathing Festival, it was sure to make the event even more lively.
"Speaking of which, we were not familiar with Kaihuang Temple before this. After receiving the invitation, we only then got to know of such a place."
Old An laughed: "It's normal for the two masters not to know about it. It might be because Kaihuang Temple has changed its name. The temple wasn't called this before."
"What was it called before?"
"Erli Village Temple."

chapters.title: Chapter 983 - 982: When in Rome, Do as the Romans Do
chapters.content:
With two cultivators at the Divinity Transformation Stage offering protection, Old An and his companions had returned to Kaihuang City unharmed and without experiencing any dangers.
Just as Kaihuang Temple was originally named Erli Village Temple, Kaihuang City used to be called Erli Village, originally just an inconspicuous little place. Through the efforts of several generations of abbots from Kaihuang Temple, especially Master Duanchen, Erli Village was eventually developed into the sizeable and well-organized city it is today.
Unlike the cities of Great Xia, which were built using blue bricks and stone, the cities of Buddha Country generally used thick earthen walls. Weathered by the elements, their edges had been smoothed by wind and sun, giving them the appearance of being on the verge of collapse.
In actuality, the earthen walls' interlayers were fortified with various array methods for stability and defense, ensuring that the city walls would stand for a thousand years.
An unnamed river flowed through Kaihuang City, providing the source of water for the entire city, and it was said to have been directed there by Master Duanchen as well.
Along the way, Lu Yang also saw many monks, with shaved heads and bare shoulders and arms, their skin dark and ruddy. As they walked, they perused scriptures, evidently devout believers, which made Lu Yang very concerned for their eyes.
Upon entering Kaihuang City, the differences from the cities of Great Xia became even more pronounced. There were beauties with blonde hair and blue eyes of exotic charm, with seductive figures and veils over their faces. There were ascetics with small monkeys perched on their shoulders. There were snake charmers who could make snakes dance by playing flutes.
And there were fishmongers who placed knives vertically on the cutting board and then pressed fishes against the upright blades, avoiding taking life.
"Finally, no more sand." Meng Jingzhou let out a sigh of relief. The pervasive sandstorm was too bothersome, but the city walls had a sand-blocking array method, which stopped the sand from entering and made things much more comfortable.
But Lu Yang's spiritual space was not so fortunate.
In the spiritual space, sand was everywhere, forming undulating hillocks. A female immortal in golden exotic attire hummed a song and danced gracefully, her bare feet pressing into the sandy ground, leaving a trail of small footprints.
"Fairy, can you reduce the amount of sand a bit?" Lu Yang shouted, straining his voice. He was too far from Fairy Eternity; she wouldn't hear him otherwise.
It was with great difficulty that they arrived in the city. Although there was no sand in reality, there was now sand in his spiritual space.
Fairy Eternity, twisting her waist, came up to Lu Yang, "This Immortal is just adapting to local customs. Look at you and the Meng Family Kid; you dress differently than the locals, and people have been staring at you continuously. If you look at me now, aren't I less conspicuous?"
Lu Yang had long noticed the peculiar glances from passersby. Just like monks from Buddha Country would attract attention in Great Xia, he and Old Meng stood out noticeably as they walked down the main streets of the city.
They'd wanted to find a place where each could change into Buddha Country attire, but an appropriate opportunity had not yet presented itself.
Lu Yang glanced at Fairy Eternity, who was still dancing, and his face turned red as he quickly lowered his gaze. It was hard for the fairy to not attract attention this way; he didn't even know where to look.
"Would the two masters care to come and sit at my humble abode?" Old An and his companions were very grateful to Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou and wanted to entertain the two. If not for their protection, they would have fallen prey to the sand wolves long ago.
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou declined Old An's kind offer, got directions to Kaihuang Temple, and set off to visit it.
"Brother, walk faster!"
As Lu Yang approached the corner, suddenly a young girl ran over and bumped into him while looking back at her brother.
Before she collided with him, Lu Yang used a magic skill to gently wrap the girl in a breeze, stabilizing her so that she neither bumped into anyone nor fell.
"I'm sorry, I'm so sorry." Realizing that she had nearly offended a cultivator, the girl quickly apologized.
Seeing this, the girl's brother hurried over, "Sorry, it was my fault for not looking after my sister properly."
"Be more careful when walking," Lu Yang said, not taking the matter to heart.
Looking at the retreating figures of Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, the young man's gaze carried a hint of vigilance, "People from Great Xia..."
"Strange, why was that kid so wary of us just now, and what's with the 'People from Great Xia' comment?" Although Lu Yang had walked a good distance away, his Spirit Transformation Level hearing was astonishingly acute, and he could clearly catch the youth's muttering as if spoken directly to him.
"Probably hasn't seen Great Xia Cultivators before, or maybe he was harmed by one?" Meng Jingzhou shrugged nonchalantly as he spoke, neither of them taking the youth seriously.
Lu Yang and his companion strolled leisurely through half of Kaihuang City, ambling and sightseeing, taking in the local customs and scenery of Buddha Country. By the time they reached Kaihuang Temple, it was already evening.
The Kaihuang Temple looked magnificent, with red walls and gray tiles, and the incense was burning vigorously. The cauldrons at the temple entrance were filled with incense ash, with only a few sticks left burning.
"Benefactors, the temple is closing to visitors now. Please come again tomorrow," the Young Monk politely barred them at the entrance.
Lu Yang handed over the letter sent to him by the Kaihuang Temple to the Young Monk, "Please tell Master Duanchen for me."
Master Duanchen was the abbot of Kaihuang Temple.
"Certainly."
Before long, a white-haired monk hurried out from Kaihuang Temple, bustling along while chiding the Young Monk's head, "I don't know Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou, and you still had the nerve to make me check the letter."
"Benefactor Lu, Benefactor Meng, I've long admired you. I am the monk Duanchen," greeted Master Duanchen with a smile brimming on his face and his hands pressed together. He had only hoped to try his luck, not really expecting Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou to come.
"So it's Master Duanchen," Lu Yang and his companion replied, mimicking Duanchen's gesture of pressing their hands together in return.
"Please come in, my fellow daoists," Master Duanchen gestured welcomingly, inviting them into the temple.
The monks following Master Duanchen all tried to push to the front to see what Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou looked like, with the shorter ones even standing on tiptoes.
"I didn't expect the benefactors to arrive so early. I apologize for any lack of hospitality on our part," said Master Duanchen. The Buddha Bathing Festival was still two months away, and he had thought that even if they were to come, it wouldn't be this soon.
However, this was a positive development. With their early arrival, Kaihuang Temple had more time to spread the news of Lu Yang and his companion's participation in the Buddha Bathing Festival. Surely, this would attract many more cultivators than expected, making the festival even more lively.
"No trouble at all, we were afraid of unexpected delays on the road, so we started our journey a bit earlier," they responded.
"You jest, benefactors. With your level of cultivation, you could easily establish a sect in Great Xia; what sort of accident could you possibly encounter?"
Lu Yang and Meng Jingzhou offered smiles in lieu of a response.
Lu Yang changed the subject, "I've heard that Kaihuang City was originally known as Erli Village and that it was your temple's continuous efforts that built this place into what it is now. Truly a remarkable feat of great merit."
Master Duanchen waved off the compliment, "It's not any great merit. It's just that one of the abbots was the illegitimate son of a high monk from Western Paradise Temple. That high monk wanted his son to live a better life, so he continuously supported our temple in secret, allowing us to achieve today's scale. It's all thanks to the blessings of those who came before us."
