He should be subordinated to Lu Yang, considering the Heavenly Court Young Sect Master's lineage.
But he was also Daoist Buyu's younger brother, which technically made him of a higher generation than Lu Yang.
"You flatter me too much, Clan Leader. It's too much for me to be addressed as a 'Daoist friend' or 'Senior.'"
"Young Sect Master, please, have a seat," the Gold Clan Leader finally stopped fussing over titles and warmly welcomed Lu Yang.
Since their Qiongqi Clan started handling the business of Recording Orbs, their days had finally improved, compensating for the loss they faced from monopolizing the candle industry. From this standpoint, Lu Yang was practically their clan's lifesaver.
"I've come to purchase some Demon Beast bodies to practice my culinary skills."
"Demon Beast corpse? That's easy, Young Sect Master, what kind of Demon Beast corpse do you need?" Since Jin Caiwei had made an appearance in the battle of Imperial City, the status of the Qiongqi Clan had dramatically risen too. Among the Demon Race, aside from the Dragon and Phoenix Clans and the Di Jiang Clan, the Qiongqi Clan had a high status and many channels.
"The more types, the better."
"Alright, give me a little time." Gold Clan Leader hastily bid farewell to Lu Yang and went out to instruct his subordinates to collect various types of Demon Beast corpses.
Not long after, the door was pushed open again, but it wasn't Gold Clan Leader who entered.
"Young Sect Master, how come you didn't notify me when you arrived in Demon City?" Little Qiongqi Jin Caiwei, upon hearing the report from Gold Clan Leader, put down what she was doing and rushed over directly.
Lu Yang smiled as he stood up and clasped his hands together. "Knowing Senior Jin is busy, I wouldn't dare to disturb you."
"Where's the talk? You are the Young Sect Master and our Qiongqi Clan's benefactor. If you come to see me, there's no disturbance at all."
"Have you received all the Spirit Stones I sent over?"
"I have, and that's way too many. I only offered a suggestion, it's not worth so many Spirit Stones." Given Lu Yang's current worth, not to mention those in Divinity Transformation Stage, even some in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage don't have as much wealth as Lu Yang.
For example, Daoist Buyu.
Soon Gold Clan Leader had delivered an endless stream of Demon Beast corpses—those that swam in water, crawled on land, or flew in the sky, with not one being of the same type, too much to fit in the Abode.
Lu Yang simply moved them all into the Green Blade Sword Small World.
Jin Caiwei had not yet visited the Green Blade Sword Small World and was curious about what Lu Yang intended to do, so she followed him in.
"Little Tiger, it's been a while." Upon entering the Green Blade Sword Small World, Immortal Fairy appeared, smiling as she tousled Jin Caiwei's head, messing up her hair.
"Immortal Sister!"
"So well-behaved."
"Little Yang, bring out this Kui Ox." Immortal Fairy pointed at a one-legged cow demon among the Demon Beast corpses.
"Alright."
Lu Yang lifted the Kui Ox out, and the piled-up Demon Beast corpses crashed down, but Lu Yang moved quickly, and they didn't hit him.
"The meat of the Demon Beasts has a different taste depending on the part." The Nine Star Spirit Chef was sharing her experience.
"That sounds a bit troublesome. Oh, Little Tiger, press this ox down with the Outline of Dao Fruit."
Jin Caiwei activated the Plane Dao Fruit Outline, pressing the Kui Ox into a sheet of paper.
"That makes it easier to explain," Immortal Fairy said as she drew circles on it, "This part is called 'tenderloin', this here is 'beef shank', this is 'beef shank', and this is called 'handle'…"
Lu Yang nodded and took note, earnestly learning.
Jin Caiwei was also learning on the side; it was her first time hearing this information, and she realized she had been far too casual about her food before.
"Have you remembered everything?"
"I have."
"Carve out these parts."
Lu Yang held the Inheriting Shadow Sword, facing the Kui Ox carcass as if it were a formidable enemy. The body structure of the Kui Ox was clear under his powerful Spiritual Sense, and as the sword light flashed, the skeleton collapsed and scattered into pieces, and the various parts were neatly arranged on a platter.
"Ha ha, turns out it's quite simple."
In the vast Green Blade Sword Small World, where Demon Beast corpses piled up like mountains and emanated an ominous aura, the Blood Clothes Swordsman walked among the corpses. Each swing of his blade brought another Demon Beast to the ground, brutally mutilated and unrecognizable from what they once were, leaving only scattered bones. The Blood Clothes Swordsman laughed maniacally…
According to the official "Dou Book·Emperor Chronicles," the Green Blade Sword's Small World, possessed by Emperor Dou Ling Lu Yang, was littered with carcasses and piled with skeletons.

chapters.title: Chapter 1093 - 1092: How Many Can Be Considered Cultivators with the Hundred Skills of Cultivation at Their Side
chapters.content:
In the kitchen, amidst a chaos of pots, pans, ladles, and basins scattered across the floor, along with food and medicinal herbs, Song Tianjing's dark circles under his eyes were pronounced; he had not slept for five days, completely engrossed in the "Complete Culinary Compendium," having completely lost track of time.
Of course, this also had to do with his inability to differentiate between dreams and reality.
Song Tianjing opened the window; the morning sunlight, though not too strong, still seemed harsh to his eyes.
"Damn, I was so absorbed in studying the recipes that I nearly forgot there's a Spirit Chef exam today!"
One had to become a Spirit Chef first in order to compete in the Spirit Chef competition—the exam was something he absolutely couldn't miss!
He didn't bother to tidy up the kitchen and dashed straight to the site of the Spirit Chef exam.
...
"Qian'er, the Clan Leader has already agreed to our marriage. He will soon come to propose to the Jade Rabbit Clan, and it will surely breed a Tribulation Crossing Demon Emperor!"
"Young Master Wu, you should give up on that idea. There's no possibility between us!" Qian'er, dressed in a white skirt and socks, her white hair shining, even the long ears atop her head were snow-white without a single blemish, extremely rare.
Young Master Wu, agitated upon hearing this, grabbed the wrist of the girl named Qian'er: "Qian'er, do you still not understand my feelings for you? I truly like you!"
"Let go of me!" Qian'er struggled, feeling repulsed by the contact with Young Master Wu.
"Qian'er, actually I..."
"Make way, make way!" Song Tianjing, looking disheveled and dirty, rushed to the registration desk. He had intended to bypass Young Master Wu and Qian'er, but with five days devoid of sleep, his sense of distance and direction were somewhat out of control, and he accidentally bumped into Young Master Wu.
"I'm so sorry, are you alright?"
"Are you blind to bump into me, do you know who I am? I am the Saint Heir of the Five Poison Clan!" Young Master Wu was furious to see Song Tianjing mess up his prospects, but Qian'er secretly breathed a sigh of relief, using the opportunity to escape from Young Master Wu.
Song Tianjing internally cursed his luck, as since coming to Demon City he had made a few acquaintances among the Cultivators of the Demon Race at the Foundation Establishment Stage. They all said the one person not to offend among the Foundation Establishment Stage was this retaliatory Saint Heir of the Five Poison Clan.
The girl standing next to Young Master Wu was someone he had met once before, Yu Qian'er of the Jade Rabbit Clan.
"My apologies, Saint Wu. It's almost time, I need to go and register. After the exam, I'll come to your door to formally apologize!"
Song Tianjing finally managed to sign up for the exam in the nick of time, just as the incense stick burned out.
Watching the anxious figure of Song Tianjing as he scrambled to register, a cold smile formed on the corner of Young Master Wu's mouth: "It seems he wants to become a Spirit Chef, just like you and me."
"I will let him understand the cost of offending me!"
"Wu, I warn you, you better not lay a hand on him!" Qian'er said anxiously. Although it was unintentional, Song Tianjing had indeed helped her out of a tight spot, and she could not just stand by and watch Young Master Wu trip him up.
Seeing Qian'er defending Song Tianjing stirred even more displeasure in Young Master Wu.
"Don't worry, Qian'er, he's just a fool; I'm not that trivial," Young Master Wu said with a benign smile, but inwardly he scoffed with contempt.
It was too late to argue; while Song Tianjing was registering, Young Master Wu used a poisoned needle and secretly poisoned him. The poison was mild, but it was timed to take effect right during the Spirit Chef exam—collapsing on the stove would certainly be an interesting scene.
Seeing the darkness around the kid's eyes, a clear sign of lack of sleep, if he fell asleep during the exam, nobody would think anything of it.
However, when the exam ended and he saw Song Tianjing emerge unscathed from the examination hall, sporting a two-star sleeve badge, he was astounded.
How could this be; the kid wasn't poisoned?!
"Young Master Wu, so you're still waiting here for me. I am truly sorry for before!" Song Tianjing, seeing that Young Master Wu was still there, hurried over to offer his sincere apologies.
"I don't know why, but before the registration I was all groggy, and after it ended, suddenly my mind was clear, and I performed exceptionally well while cooking. The examiner couldn't stop praising my dish."
Mr. Wu was startled. Absorbing poison as power, the characteristic of the Poison Immune Body?
What a joke, this kid has the very Poison Immune Body that restrains their Five Poison Clan?
Qian'er blinked her eyes; she wasn't foolish and guessed that since Mr. Wu was the kind to seek revenge for the smallest grievances, he must have poisoned Song Tianjing, yet it was easily neutralized by him.
Song Tianjing was unassuming in appearance, but he had quite a few secrets.
After Song Tianjing and Qian'er had left, Mr. Wu also revealed a two-star sleeve badge.
"The Spirit Chef Competition is tomorrow, and I personally will take action. I really want to see just how capable you are!"
...
"The Spirit Chef Competition is tomorrow, Little Lotus, aren't you participating?" Yun Mengmeng, as usual, bought a large quantity of Spirit Food to share with Little Lotus. These were all things she had tried and found delicious.
She'd share them again with the Second-in-command once she got home at night.
Yun Mengmeng felt sweet inside; sharing once could bring double the happiness, and sharing twice meant quadruple the joy!
"Unfortunately, I can't leave this place." Little Lotus sighed. Since the battle at the Western Paradise Temple, she had been restricted by Ashy Bean and couldn't leave the shop.
"What a pity. Our Second-in-command is joining the competition, and I wanted to introduce you to him."
"Your Second-in-command is also entering the competition?" Little Lotus frowned upon hearing this. Mengmeng had mentioned that the "Second-in-command" had reluctantly come to Demon City just because of her. Now, he even qualified to participate in the Spirit Chef Competition? Could that be called reluctant?
This Second-in-command even deceived such an innocent person as Mengmeng; he surely was not a good person!
...
The Qiongqi Clan has been eating well these days, under the guidance of a Nine Star Spirit Chef, supervision by the ancestor, and a Five Star Spirit Chef handling the knife. They had a variety of Demon Beasts to eat, never repeating a single day.
In the Green Blade Sword Small World, only white bones remained on the ground; all the meat was consumed by the Qiongqi Clan, and Lu Yang's cooking skills visibly improved before one's eyes.
"It's time to join the competition."
Lu Yang put on his sleeve badge, ready for departure. The badge had five black pentagrams, signifying his prestigious status as a Five Star Spirit Chef.
Lu Yang was considered, more or less, a Cultivator who possessed the Hundred Skills of Cultivation, even though this identity was secured through backdoors by the Taotie Clan.
After emerging from seclusion at the Qiongqi Clan, Yun Mengmeng waited at the clan's entrance, accompanying him to the competition.
Fairy Eternity had shown her skills twice, and Jin Caiwei unfortunately suffered food poisoning and couldn't accompany Lu Yang there.
"So many Spirit Chefs! There are way more than at the market." Yun Mengmeng had never seen so many Spirit Chefs in her life; she just wished she were a judge so she could taste all those delicious foods.
The competition registration site was crowded; the Spirit Chefs had varied appearances. Some Spirit Chefs shaved their heads clean and went shirtless, with two cleavers hanging around their necks; some carried a large pot on their back and a complete set of kitchenware at their waist; others, although they looked young, had fingers darkened and arms as withered as if petrified.
Compared to these people, Lu Yang and Yun Mengmeng looked too normal and seemed somewhat out of place.
"The Spirit Chef Competition is the grand event of the Spirit Chef World, once every ten years. The champion will receive a Red Sleeve Badge, representing that you are the best among your peers."
"The Spirit Chefs we saw at the market a few days ago were only a part of them; many more hadn't left their homes, sharpening their skills at the last minute."
"I see."
Including myself, Lu Yang added silently.

chapters.title: Chapter 1094 - 1093 Gathering Intelligence
chapters.content:
In the backstage of the Spirit Chef competition, Vice Alliance Hierarch Liu Xing anxiously waited for the Alliance Hierarch to arrive.
"The competition is about to begin, why hasn't the Alliance Hierarch come?"
Ever since arriving in Demon City, the Alliance Hierarch had disappeared without a trace, leaving most of the organizing work for the Spirit Chef examination and competition to Liu Xing himself.
"Liu Xing, what's the hurry? Haven't I arrived?" A hoary and hearty laugh sounded by Liu Xing's ear, followed by a cool breeze that transformed into a white-bearded elder—it was the Alliance Hierarch of the Spirit Chef Alliance, Daoist Ming Yuan.
Daoist Ming Yuan had an ordinary background from a small island in the East Sea; there wasn't much remarkable about his origins. However, after several strokes of fortune, he cultivated to the Body Integration Realm in the East Sea. Unlike other human cultivators, he didn't take over a large island to become an Island Master but chose to travel and exchange culinary arts with master chefs from renowned restaurants, rarely returning to the East Sea.
And it was precisely because of this conduct that he not only excelled in culinary skills but also had excellent relations with others, allowing him to become the Alliance Hierarch of the Spirit Chef Alliance smoothly.
"Alliance Hierarch, you've finally come. Where have you been all these days?" Seeing Daoist Ming Yuan was like finding his backbone, allowing Liu Xing to feel as if a massive weight had been lifted from his shoulders.
"I was handling some matters outside the city, a bit troublesome, but it's almost sort to out now. You've worked hard these days."
Liu Xing heaved a long sigh: "I don't mind the hard work, but I've heard that Jin Tan plans to launch a challenge for the position of Alliance Hierarch, to take your place!"
A flicker of surprise crossed Daoist Ming Yuan's eyes: "It's been three hundred years since Jin Tan lost to me, hasn't it? It seems like his culinary skills have improved considerably during these three hundred years."
"I don't know about his culinary progress, but I do know that he's concocted an exceptional dish. Its preparation is extremely difficult, necessitating the use of legendary ingredients from our alliance's food stores, which is why he has yet to challenge you."
"This is the first I've heard about it. So he sent someone to this competition, hoping to win the prize and get those ingredients?"
"Yes, apparently, he's been preparing for today for a full three hundred years."
The more Daoist Ming Yuan heard, the more he became bewildered: "Then why didn't he just exchange for them directly? We didn't know he needed the legendary ingredients for his exceptional dish—surely we wouldn't have stopped him if he had wanted to exchange?"
"Perhaps he assumed we knew?"
The two men exchanged glances.
"By the way, Alliance Hierarch, you know about Lu Yang, right?"
"Of course, I know him; wasn't it I who invited him?" Daoist Ming Yuan looked at Liu Xing as if he were looking at an idiot, thinking that without him as the Alliance Hierarch, the Spirit Chef Alliance would truly be beyond help.
"Oh right, it was you who invited him. You would never guess who he saw after I sent him to the hostel!" Liu Xing had been holding in the news for several days, and upon meeting the Alliance Hierarch, he couldn't contain it any longer.
"Who did he see?"
Liu Xing was about to say it when the order from Zhu Tian, in the form of the Survival Of The Fittest Dao Fruit Outline, forbidding him from speaking about the meeting, took effect. He couldn't reveal it, neither explicitly nor by implication.
"Who exactly he saw, I am not at liberty to say, but I saw many beautiful dancers at his door, all likely to be gifts to him!"
"You mean to say that Lu Yang is a lustful person, and that we should also try to bribe him with women's favors?"
Liu Xing had intended to hint at "Guess who sent the women to Lu Yang", but it turned into merely suggesting the scenario.
Under the influence of the Survival of the Fittest Dao Fruit Outline, Liu Xing couldn't speak; he could only nod vigorously.
Seeing Liu Xing nod, Daoist Ming Yuan hissed, "Could it be true that after Lu Yang's visit to the Laurel Fairy Palace, many fairies are truly pregnant? Not just rumors?"
...
"Look quickly, that's Golden Blade Master. He really came!" Golden Blade Master performs bone trimming for the cow demon daily in the market, throwing cows into the air and brandishing his blades, making the loudest noise. After several days of buzz, his reputation is the loudest in the market.
Golden Blade Master, bare-chested, has two golden blades hanging in front of his chest. The blade edges emit a fierce aura, likely stained with much demon beast blood. Among the Five Star Spirit Chefs skilled in handling ingredients, this fierce aura is particularly eye-catching; many Five Star Spirit Chefs consciously keep their distance from him.
"And that one, wearing a hood, is Poisonous Granny. Rumors say she practices Dual Cultivation of Elixir and Poison. On one hand, her medicinal food can heal any illness, but if she wants someone dead, it would only take her a word!"
"Look behind her, there are two cultivators. Judging by their attire, they seem to be from the Great Xia government office. It looks like she's leading them, could it be that she has now defected to the Dynasty?"
"She's also wearing handcuffs and shackles. Could it be she's engaged in weighted cultivation, and will take them off when the official competition begins, drastically increasing her strength?"
Lu Yang, listening from the side, couldn't help but comment, "No, doesn't it look more like she was captured by Great Xia and is taking part in the competition during her sentence?"
"As you say that, I remember, it seems I've heard she was arrested by Great Xia on suspicion of poisoning," a passerby began, then realized something was off.
"Hold on, who are you?"
The previous conversation had been as casual as between friends, the two of them talking as if they knew each other, and it had totally slipped his mind that he didn't recognize this person.
"Hello, my name is Lu Yunyang."
"Oh hello, hello, my name is Ma Bin... Still not right, who are you?"
"I'm here for the competition. I'm not familiar with these people, just thought I'd get to know some through you," Lu Yang indicated his Five Star sleeve badge, thinking about how he would write his article when he got back, coincidentally meeting someone who seemed to know everything.
Ma Bin rolled up his sleeve, showing his Five Star sleeve badge, and said disdainfully,
"As a fellow competitor, do you think I would reveal information to you?"
Lu Yang thought for a moment. It wasn't quite right to inquire about information directly without offering any benefit. He prepared to take out something to sweeten the deal.
Ma Bin caught a glimpse of Lu Yang's subtle move and sneered, "Don't think you can buy me with Spirit Stones. This is a sacred Spirit Chef competition; don't sully it with your measly Spirit Stones!"
Lu Yang hadn't planned on using Spirit Stones at all. He took out his Identity Jade, "Actually, I am Lu Yang from the Seek Dao Sect, here to write for the newspaper. If you help me find out who is competing, I'll put in a good word for you in the paper."
Ma Bin looked coldly at Lu Yang, straightened his lapel, and introduced himself formally,
"I'm Ma Bin, an Imperial Chef from the Imperial Kitchen of Great Xia, specializing in pastries and steam-cooking, as well as complex seasoning with various condiments. Born into the pastry Ma Family, I've been passionate about cooking since childhood, devouring all sorts of culinary texts. My culinary skills were initiated through the family's traditional recipes."
"As time went by, I not only inherited the family's pastry craft but also continuously learned new cooking techniques and trends, enhancing my culinary skills. After joining the Imperial Kitchen, I practiced my knife skills diligently until they were so mastered they seemed supernatural, earning the nickname 'The Knife of the Imperial Kitchen.'"
"I took leave to participate in this Spirit Chef contest with the goal of becoming a Golden Star Spirit Chef and to elevate my pastry Ma Family's fame within the Spirit Chef World. Just a few good words about me would do; preferably, mention our pastry Ma Family."
Lu Yang silently wrote down a line: Ma Bin, from the pastry Ma Family.

chapters.title: Chapter 1095 - 1094 [Immortal Chef's Successor] Lu Yunyang
chapters.content:
"Master Lu, please look at the cultivator standing in the corner with a smile that hides his eyes. His name is Xie Qi, and he is the hot favorite to win this culinary competition," Ma Bin, who handled the pastries for the Ma Family and cut vegetables for the Imperial Kitchen, introduced various spirit chefs to Lu Yang with great diligence.
Xie Qi had medicine pots tied around his waist and appeared to smile at everyone as if his eyes were never open. In the Spirit Chef World, Xie Qi's reputation was widespread. Even among Five Star Spirit Chefs, there were differences in rank. Other Five Star Spirit Chefs would look at him with flickering gazes, a sign of reverence towards a stronger opponent.
But Lu Yang didn't notice that other spirit chefs were also quietly keeping their distance from Ma Bin.
Ma Bin was also a top contender for the championship!
"Oh, is he that capable?"
"Xie Qi has an ability, whether it's from his cultivation technique or a natural gift, that allows him to mimic the movements of others."
"Moreover, his tongue is also extraordinary, extremely sensitive to the flavors of food. Even the tiniest flaw is magnified in his mouth."
"Anyone who competes in a culinary duel with him will find that he completely imitates their movements, tastes the finished dish, and then improves upon it."
"In this way, the dishes he makes are always one step ahead of his opponents!"
Lu Yang nodded, acknowledging that this was indeed a formidable opponent.
"Anything else?"
"There's also the female cultivator wearing an ice-blue dress; her name is An Tong. She has never been defeated either, but she relies on sheer strength. Although she was born without a sense of taste, her vision, touch, smell, and hearing are far superior to those of other cultivators at her level. She can create exquisite dishes using just her other four senses!"
Lu Yang had seen this woman among the people gathered by Jin Tan but didn't know her name: "So her name is An Tong."
Ma Bin introduced these spirit chefs one by one, not only those with Five Star rankings. The rest of the four groups of spirit chefs were also there, after all, the Cultivation Monthly only wrote about Five Star Spirit Chef competitions.
As the sound of a gong echoed, the Spirit Chef competition officially began. Five groups of spirit chefs started their contests simultaneously. As each renowned spirit chef entered, they elicited exclamations of surprise from the audience.
"Look quick, that's the 'Golden Blade Master' Duan Lang!"
"That's the 'Poisonous Granny'!"
"That's the 'Blade of the Imperial Kitchen,' Ma Bin!"
"That's 'Immortal Tongue' Xie Qi!"
"That's the 'Invincible' An Tong!"
Yun Mengmeng listened for a long time, getting frustrated at not hearing anyone call out the name of the Second-in-command, feeling that the audience truly lacked discernment. The Second-in-command was an Immortal Chef's Successor, far more formidable than any Golden Blade Master or Poisonous Granny.
"That, that's actually 'Immortal Chef's Successor' Lu Yunyang!" Yun Mengmeng, standing in the stands, suddenly pointed at Lu Yang, her expression one of disbelief.
However, her expression was somewhat exaggerated. Fortunately for her, the audience was captivated by Lu Yang's title and didn't pay much heed to Yun Mengmeng's expression.
"Immortal Chef's Successor, who dares to claim such a grand title?"
"Where, where?"
"What, you don't know him?" Yun Mengmeng was very surprised.
"Who is this person?" The audience, comprised of gourmands, racked their brains but still could not think of any spirit chef worthy of the heaven-defying title 'Immortal Chef's Successor.'
Yun Mengmeng whispered mysteriously, "Rumor has it that Lu Yunyang received cooking lessons from an immortal in his dreams and mastered techniques only known to immortals. His knife skills are unparalleled, his medicinal food beyond compare. He kept a low profile only because the immortal advised him to be patient for ten years, to temper his character."
"The ten years have passed, and his sharp sword can finally be unsheathed!"
"Really or not, why does this sound so fake?"
"This kid received the legacy of the Yingtian Immortal?"
Although Yun Mengmeng's tale was elaborate, the gourmands weren't fools; they didn't just believe everything she said.
In the Spirit Chef World, only taste is everything!
Clearly, Yun Mengmeng wasn't as naturally talented at lying as Lu Yang was.
The Spirit Chef competition consisted of three stages, testing knife skills, medicinal ingredients, and the dishes themselves. It was an elimination tournament, with only those passing the previous stage qualifying for the next.
The five competitions were held simultaneously, all testing the same content.
Song Tianjing's forehead broke out in a layer of cold sweat. The first challenge was said to be a test of knife skills, but it wasn't looking like it at all.
In the Two-Star Spirit Chef competition, all the Two-Star Spirit Chefs were confined to a Beast Fighting Arena. As cage after cage opened, countless Foundation Establishment Demon Beasts crawled out, baring their teeth and staring at these Spirit Chefs, seeing them as food.
"How come, you're not telling me you can't even beat a Demon Beast?" Master Wu watched Song Tianjing's scared appearance, a cold smile curling the corner of his mouth. It seemed that Song Tianjing was nothing special after all, and there would be no need to target him to eliminate him.
Master Wu and Yu Qian'er, both Two-Star Spirit Chefs, had come to participate in this grand event.
Yu Qian'er explained to Song Tianjing, "The Spirit Chef Alliance believes that as a qualified Spirit Chef, the first thing you must be able to do is overcome your ingredients. If you can't even defeat your ingredients, what qualifications do you have to process them?"
"So, the first challenge often tests how you overcome and handle a Demon Beast."
Yu Qian'er didn't linger after speaking and charged toward a Spirit Rhinoceros armored in plate mail. The more difficult the Spirit Beast you chose to handle, the higher the score you would receive in the final evaluation after the three challenges. This Spirit Rhinoceros ranked within the top ten among a certain type of Demon Beast and was a worthy opponent to challenge.
Song Tianjing's eyes twitched. He was very confident in his knife skills, but the problem was he had little combat experience, especially none against Demon Beasts.
What should I do? What should I do?
Song Tianjing inadvertently saw Yun Mengmeng in the audience stands, his heart jolted. Why were people from the Heavenly Court Sect here?
Could it be that the Young Sect Master had also come? Was he here to watch his performance?
If he performed too poorly, would the Young Sect Master have him eradicated?
The more Song Tianjing thought about it, the more likely it seemed. He decided to throw caution to the wind. Better to face a Demon Beast with courage than to be dispatched by the Young Sect Master. After all, he was at the Foundation Establishment Late Stage; he should be able to defeat at least one Demon Beast.
Song Tianjing chose a purple mink. The purple mink stood on its hind legs, its forepaws tucked into its fur, blinking its small eyes innocently.
Noticing Song Tianjing's choice, the Purple Sky Mink immediately bared its teeth and its eyes turned into a fierce red. Its claws scraped the ground, leaving behind a trail of marks.
The audience stands immediately stirred, their attention focused on the Two-Star Spirit Chef group.
"Who is that person? He actually chose the Purple Sky Mink!?"
"Isn't the Purple Sky Mink the strongest among these Demon Beasts?"
"Yes, it is the Beast King!"
The other Two-Star Spirit Chefs also noticed Song Tianjing's choice, and sneers and taunts were endless.
"The Purple Sky Mink carries the bloodline of an Ancient Demon, its ancestors included a Crossing Tribulation Demon Emperor. It moves as fast as lightning, and even Spiritual Sense can't catch it."
"More than that, its claws are exceptionally sharp, a mere scratch can sever a head. Did he choose it because he has a death wish?"
"Beast King Purple Sky Mink, even I wouldn't dare choose it as an opponent," laughed Master Wu uncontrollably.
Song Tianjing quietly reached into his chest, caressing the "Culinary Bible" to boost his courage.
However, just as he touched the Complete Culinary Compendium, the Purple Sky Mink, which had been ready to attack, suddenly seemed to sense something, its red eyes dissipated, and it lay prostrate on the ground.
That was the ever-present fear ingrained in their ancient bloodlines, a grand will that Demon Beasts could not contend with!
"What's wrong with the Purple Sky Mink?"
"Not right, not just the Purple Sky Mink, look at the other Demon Beasts!"
Exclamations of amazement were incessant from the audience stands, with some spectators so shocked that they stood up straight.
Every Demon Beast in the Beast Fighting Arena stretched their claws forward, prostrating themselves on the ground, bowing to Song Tianjing.
Yu Qian'er covered her mouth in shock, her beautiful eyes filled with boundless astonishment.
"Is it because of this 'Culinary Bible'?" Song Tianjing immediately thought of the key. The partial copy of his family's ancient "Complete Culinary Compendium" had never instilled fear in Demon Beasts. Could it be that only this original "Culinary Bible" had such power?!
This should please Young Master Lu, right?
The commotion around Song Tianjing was too great for Lu Yang to ignore even if he wanted to.
No, how could a book casually given away by a Fairy have such an effect? Why have I never been treated this way?!

chapters.title: Chapter 1096 - 1095: Knife Skills
chapters.content:
"A bunch of Foundation Establishment Little Demons kneeling before you, what's the point?" Immortal Fairy disdainfully said, finding Second-in-command truly lacking in ambition.
"Wait, wait for the day we find Qilin Immortal, then I shall let him kowtow to you, as you are the Eldest Senior Brother of Xiao Ling and Lianyi..."
"No no no, Fairy, what I meant was that Song Tianjing is less fortunate, how can he compare with me?"
"Is that what you meant?"
"Exactly!"
Lu Yang, in a bid to save his life, vigorously nodded.
"Then all right, it seems I misunderstood."
Lu Yang took a deep breath twice, discarded distracting thoughts, paid no attention to the activities on Song Tianjing's side, and stopped thinking about his doom. What he needed to do now was to focus on displaying his knife skills.
Other stages he could just experience lightly, but the first stage required his full effort.
As they say, there's no difference between knife and sword, often a Sword Cultivator's use of a knife is not inferior either; he, with his Sword Spirit Root and renowned as the premier Sword Cultivator of his level, could not lose face in this challenge!
The Five Star Spirit Chef Team was also in the Beast Fighting Arena where Divine Transformation Stage Demon Beasts broke free from their cages, wantonly unleashing their oppressive might.
Merely the oppressive force was enough to scare away some Spirit Chefs, preventing them from acting and causing their hands holding the knives to tremble.
But Lu Yang was certainly not among them!
Other Five Star Spirit Chefs had their own unique equipment; Lu Yang was different, as a simple kitchen knife was enough for him.
The competition for the Five Star Spirit Chef Team was slightly different from that of the Two Star Spirit Chef Team, as there was an additional requirement in the topic.
"Vice Alliance Hierarch Liu Xing just said that in knife skills, 'benevolence' must be reflected."
Lu Yang was still pondering what "Knife Skills" meant, while other Spirit Chefs had already formed their ideas and began slicing.
"Look quick, there's a small sun!" The audience noticed something unusual about the Five Star Spirit Chef Team.
"No, no, that's not a small sun, it's Golden Blade Master, it's his golden knife shaving so rapidly!"
Golden Blade Master took the lead, choosing a Fei Yi, which was a kind of snake from the Snake Clan, with six legs and four wings, ranking fifth among the Divine Transformation Demon Beasts!
Repeating his old trick, Golden Blade Master stomped his feet down, muscles bulging, suddenly throwing the Fei Yi into the sky.
"Bone Stripping Blade Technique!"
Two golden knives flew swiftly, resembling a great sun, leaving clean snake bones and falling white snake meat wherever the sunlight touched.
"The goodness in knife skills lies in not letting the Demon Beast feel pain, yielding matters," Golden Blade Master hung his golden knives in front of his chest and indifferently spoke, he landed first, followed by the white snake meat falling like rain into the plates.
In fact, Golden Blade Master also had the capability to defeat the first four ranked Demon Beasts; however, not being able to kill instantaneously, inducing pain in the Demon Beast, would not count as benevolent knife skills.
"Why is there such a dense mist over there?"
"Amidst the mist, there's a figure dancing beautifully, is it a fairy dancing?" The audience became excited again.
After the mist dissipated, it turned out not to be a fairy but Poisonous Granny dissecting a poisoned Nine-headed Lion.
Yun Mengmeng looked at the audience with a strange gaze; did these people have something wrong with their eyes, seeing both a small sun and a fairy dancing?
During the competition, Poisonous Granny temporarily didn't need to wear handcuffs and shackles, feeling much lighter.
She gave a sinister smile, choosing the Nine-headed Lion, which was one of the top three formidable beings.
Poisonous Granny let the Nine-headed Lion bite into her, tearing off a piece of flesh; poisonous blood flowed out, turning into a toxic mist upon contact with air, sending the Nine-headed Lion into a wonderful slumber.
"The goodness in knife skills is having the Demon Beast die in bliss!"
Apart from Lu Yang, there was one more person who did nothing from the beginning to the end, and that was Ma Bin.
"The goodness in knife skills, so that's what it means."
Ma Bin raised his hand and summoned Vice Alliance Hierarch Liu Xing.
"Do you need something?"
"I forfeit."
Liu Xing looked surprised, "You're giving up?"
"Yes, the essence of knife skills lies in not killing, only by forfeiting can I avoid killing!"
"Have you truly thought this through, is that your final answer?"
"Yes!" Ma Bin nodded.
"Alright, you may leave then."
"Have I passed the test?"
Liu Xing rolled his eyes, pointing at the spectator seats, "You've forfeited and still think you can pass the test, go sit in the spectator seats."
"…"
This wasn't right, wouldn't Vice Alliance Leader Liu reveal a meaningful smile, acknowledging that I had understood the purpose of the test and let me pass on my own?
How could my Imperial Kitchen's knife fame end like this?
Ma Bin was sent to the spectator seats, but the competition continued.
Finally, Lu Yang made a move; he slowly stood up, holding an ordinary kitchen knife, and strolled towards the Beast King Kui Niu.
The Kui Niu, sensing danger, knew instinctively from its bloodline that this enemy could kill it!
Lu Yang raised his knife and then lowered it, while the Kui Niu stood still, completely unharmed.
"What happened, what's going on?" The audience was extremely puzzled. Was he just intimidating the Kui Niu?
Is this the level of the Immortal Chef's successor?
"No, look what he's holding in his hand!" Ma Bin, possessing genuine skill, quickly noticed something unusual.
At some unknown point, Lu Yang held in his hand an extremely thin piece of paper, nearly transparent under the sunlight.
"Let me see." Liu Xing instantly moved closer, took the paper which felt weightless.
He unfolded it, and to his surprise, it was in the shape of the Kui Niu!
"You did this…"
"I split the Kui Niu down the middle, made another cut along the cross-section, and obtained this piece of beef paper."
"And the Kui Niu didn't even realize it had been cut, the wounds healed immediately."
Lu Yang tore off a small piece of the beef paper and chewed it, the flavor of Kui Niu meat filling his mouth.
"I think Ma Bin is right, the essence of knife skills truly lies in not killing. Vice Alliance Hierarch, would you like to try?"
The beef paper was so thin that a bit of sunlight was enough to cook it!
"No, your knife skills are superb, but the beef paper is too thin, not even enough for one dish. Despite demonstrating the essence of knife skills, you are not a qualified Spirit Chef." Liu Xing was very strict in terms of Spirit Chef standards.
"Why would that be difficult?" Lu Yang chuckled, knocked the Kui Niu out with the back of his knife, raised his knife again, and then had a piece of meat with a marbled pattern in his hand!
Liu Xing's pupils dilated, showing a disbelief expression.
Now he saw it clearly; to an untrained eye, it seemed like just one cut, but he saw Lu Yang make eighty-one cuts!
After knocking out the Kui Niu, Lu Yang made one cut to open its skin, extracted the beef shank, and after removing the beef shank, the Kui Niu's skin had just healed!
The Kui Niu, a Divinity Transformation Stage Demon Beast, had extremely strong healing abilities. By the time it awoke, the missing part had already regrown!
And the Kui Niu had no idea!
"If Vice Alliance Hierarch still thinks it's not enough food, I can find a few more Kui Nius. I can cut parts from them, and that should add up to a whole Kui Niu."
"You, you've passed." Vice Alliance Hierarch Liu said dazedly, this was more than just passing, it was a record-setting, an unprecedented knife technique in the sixty thousand year history of the Spirit Chef competition within the Five Star Spirit Chef Team!
"By the way, how many cuts did you make just now?" Vice Alliance Leader Liu suddenly asked before leaving.
Lu Yang smiled lightly, clasping his fists:
"A hundred and eight cuts, I am gratified."

chapters.title: Chapter 1097 - 1096: Identifying Ingredients
chapters.content:
"Who is that person? He's so powerful!"
"I remember someone just said he is the successor of the Immortal Cook?"
"Right, the Immortal Cook's successor, Lu Yunyang!"
"I recall now, earlier Lu Yunyang was standing with Ma Bin. At first, Ma Bin wasn't too friendly towards him, but then, as if he learned Lu Yunyang's identity, Ma Bin became quite courteous!" an audience member suddenly remembered the episode before the competition.
Ma Bin, seated in the audience stands, twitched at the corner of his eyes. What do you mean I wasn't too friendly to him at first? Don't spread rumors, I genuinely admire Fellow Daoist Lu Yang!
Ma Bin slightly narrowed his eyes, looking at the tall figure below, he muttered to himself, "So, he really is the Immortal Cook's successor..."
"Fellow Daoist Ma Bin, do you know his identity?" a foodie eagerly leaned over to ask.
Ma Bin revealed a profoundly meaningful smile, "Whether he is or isn't, it's not for me to say."
Ma Bin's ambiguous response, as though in possession of a certain secret, made everyone else more inclined to believe in Lu Yunyang's identity.
Intentionally boosting Lu Yunyang's reputation, Ma Bin expected that Lu Yunyang would add an extra line or two about him in the newspapers.
"It seems that what the little girl said was right; it could really be the Immortal Cook's successor."
"I feel the same."
Seeing more and more people acknowledging that Second-in-command was a quite remarkable person, Yun Mengmeng felt a sense of pride.
With Second-in-command working so hard in the competition below, she couldn't just sit around!
She stood up and moved to another location to continue promoting Second-in-command.
...
"This Lu Yunyang is one of my own, but how come I have no recollection at all when his knife skills are so exquisite?" Jin Tan, the Clan Leader of the Taotie Clan, noticed Lu Yang's actions and was very surprised.
Facing the Kui Ox, at the Spirit Transformation Late Stage just like himself, Lu Yang did not use his full strength, yet he effortlessly stripped a piece of meat from it without its awareness.
"If he wished, all the Demon Beasts here would be but a matter of a single cut for him."
This was the type of man their Taotie Clan should cultivate vigorously.
"No matter, as long as he is one of my own." Jin Tan revealed a smile of scheming success; his Spirit Chefs had performed conspicuously well in the first round, and they would soon shine in the second and third rounds, aiding him in obtaining the legendary ingredients.
"Old Meng, how does it matter that you've tried so hard to stop me for three hundred years? In the end, the seat of the Alliance Hierarch is mine!"
The knife-craft round ended quickly. The participants were all top-notch, and those who got eliminated were the Spirit Chefs who couldn't overcome the Demon Beasts.
Liu Xing continued to host the Five Star Spirit Chef Team challenges, and unlike the first round, this time significantly more Spirit Chefs set their sights on Lu Yunyang, marking him as a favorite to win the championship.
"This round tests your ability to discern ingredients."
Liu Xing set out five display cabinets, all covered by a red cloth. The red cloth was woven from some material that could block the investigation of Spiritual Sense.
"Inside these five display cabinets are five different ingredients. You need to identify the name of the ingredient. Only the first person to answer correctly will pass this round."
"However, if you answer incorrectly, you will be disqualified from the competition. Think carefully before you answer."
In other words, only five people would pass this round!
Realizing this, the whole place fell dead silent, with all the Spirit Chefs becoming nervous, uneasy, and even those who were somewhat confident in their knowledge began to doubt whether their skills were truly up to par.
Only Lu Yang yawned, indifferent to winning or losing, thinking about how to draft his article once he got back.
It's such a bother. If only he had brought Old Meng along, then he could concentrate on having fun and let him fret over this problem.
Before setting out, Lu Yang sought out Meng Jingzhou, who was deeply engrossed in pondering the profound meanings in the "Immortal's Quotations." Seeing Old Meng studying so intently, Lu Yang did not disturb him further.
Lu Yang's relaxed demeanor was seen by others as being brimming with confidence.
Liu Xing unveiled the first red cloth, revealing a leaf lying quietly within the display. The leaf was adorned with golden runes that flickered, primitive and rustic, a natural inscription.
"It looks familiar," Lu Yang muttered under his breath, feeling as if he had seen it somewhere before, and quite frequently at that.
Golden Blade Master sent a beam of Spiritual Energy into the sky, signaling his readiness to answer the question.
"It's the leaf of the great ginkgo tree!"
"Incorrect answer."
The first Spirit Chef was quickly eliminated, and it was none other than Golden Blade Master, who had performed so well in the knife skills challenge.
Seeing this scene, the Spirit Chefs who had been eager to try were like they had been doused with cold water, no one daring to buzz in.
However, as Golden Blade Master was eliminated, a beam of Spiritual Energy shot up immediately after.
[Immortal Tongue]Xie Bin.
"It's an Enlightenment Tree leaf, and furthermore, it's from an Enlightenment Tree that's five thousand years old."
"Correct answer."
The Spirit Chefs looked on with envy. It was indeed Xie Bin—he not only recognized it as an Enlightenment Tree leaf but knew it was five millenniums old.
"It's nothing more than us having a five-thousand-year-old Enlightenment Tree in our family," Xie Bin humbly stated, but whether that humility was genuine or just a boast remained uncertain.
"So it's an Enlightenment Tree leaf," Lu Yang realized, no wonder it looked so familiar. The Eldest Senior Sister often used Enlightenment Tree leaves to brew tea, only hers always came from an Enlightenment Tree King that had lived for a hundred thousand years.
It was the first time he saw such a young Enlightenment Tree leaf, so he didn't recognize it immediately.
"Now, for the second ingredient."
Liu Xing lifted the second red cloth to reveal a palm-sized, lush and juicy vine, whose radiating heat warped the space around it, which was very frightening.
Behind the vine, an Illusory Shadow flickered, seeming like a tiger, yet like a dragon.
The Spirit Chefs furrowed their brows, no immediate answer coming forth, as none of them had seen such a Spiritual Plant.
Lu Yang sent out a beam of spiritual essence with a smile. "This is Kirin Immortality Medicine. But it's not the mother plant, rather a sprout that separated from the ancient mother plant."
He was very familiar with this as the Seek Dao Sect's herb garden hosted a Kirin Immortality Medicine that had originated from Ancient Times.
On the day of the Qilin Immortal's grand wedding, Fairy Eternity accidentally interfered, leading to Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi competing in a culinary showdown, prompting the Yingtian Immortal to taste. The three immortals, unaware of the truth, blamed the Qilin Immortal for the chaos and gave him a beating. During that battle, a few drops of blood from the Qilin Immortal, which contained his life-creating powers, birthed the later generations' Kirin Immortality Medicine.
"Kirin Immortality Medicine?" Many Spirit Chefs looked at each other, many of them never having heard of this Immortal Elixir.
[Immortal Tongue]Xie Qi, [Invincible]An Tong, [Poisonous Granny], and others had heard of the Immortal Elixir but only by name and were unaware of its origins.
Lu Yang, hands clasped behind his back, strolled around, then slowly began to relay an ancient secret tale.
"In the ancient past, a dark force schemed, leading to a clash between the Dragon and Phoenix ancestors, where the Four Ancient Immortals debated the Dao. The Qilin Immortal stood alone against three and did not falter. In that battle, the Dao crumbled, stars extinguished, and a few drops of blood, infused with the Qilin Immortal's life-creating power spilled out, tearing through the void, piercing the sky, and a few fortunate Spiritual Plants blessed with the Immortal Blood transformed into Kirin Immortality Medicine!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1098 - 1097: My Words Are Evidence
chapters.content:
The hall fell completely silent, neither the Spirit Chefs participating in the competition, the audience seated on the platform, nor the high-ranking members of the Spirit Chef Alliance had ever heard of the origin of the Kirin Immortality Medicine.
Yet, Lu Yang spoke with such certainty, it did not seem fabricated.
Could it be that the Kirin Immortality Medicine really originated this way?
If what Lu Yang said was true, then it would be a significant discovery for the Spirit Chef World, the Alchemy World, and the Archaeology World!
"Lu Yunyang, you've passed," announced Liu Xing. Regardless of the actual origin of the Kirin Immortality Medicine, Lu Yang had recognized the origin of this ingredient.
Lu Yang returned to his seat, the center of attention.
Especially Xie Qi, who felt that Lu Yang would be his greatest rival on this journey!
This was good; a challenging competition would showcase his capabilities!
"Second-in-command, so when Yingtian Immortal and Qilin Immortal clashed, was there a hidden mastermind causing trouble?"
Fairy Eternity was well aware of the origin of the Kirin Immortality Medicine, but was indeed clueless about the background events.
Lu Yang sighed; the instigator who caused their fight was none other than you, Fairy, having sent Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi an Immortal Fruit, claiming it was a gift for the most beautiful of the Demon Race.
Of course, these kinds of thoughts were enough; there was no need to mention them to the Fairy.
As a vassal, one's duty was to gather intelligence for His Majesty, filter information, and ease His Majesty's worries.
"It was the senior Yingtian Immortal who told me. Originally the four of them were as close as brothers; the reason they fought was due to someone's interference. Looking back, they all regret fighting Qilin Immortal. The real enemy was someone else, but too powerful for them to defeat!"
"I believe only a schemer worthy of death could plot against the Four Ancient Immortals!" Lu Yang clenched his fists and said indignantly.
"We'll get rid of him sooner or later!" Immortal Fairy also clenched her fists and said.
With the Chief Housekeeper and Second-in-command united in enmity, surely there was nothing they couldn't accomplish!
Liu Xing revealed the third piece of cloth, which covered the meat of an unknown Demon Beast, its flesh clear and translucent, with layers of fat like crystal.
Lu Yang could feel that this Demon Beast was definitely a very tough opponent when alive.
"It's the hind leg meat of a Taotie," An Tong declared.
"Correct."
An Tong indeed lived up to her reputation as a Spirit Chef meticulously cultivated by the Taotie Clan; she could identify the origin of a Demon Beast at a glance.
"Now, let's reveal the fourth ingredient."
Only two spots were left, and the Spirit Chefs were eager, gearing up for a fight to claim one.
Liu Xing lifted the fourth cloth to reveal a fist-sized gray stone sphere, its surface smooth, seemingly unprocessed, naturally formed this way.
The stone still emitted continuous fluctuations of Spiritual Energy.
The Spirit Chefs fell silent, none able to provide an answer.
A smooth stone? It was impossible to even guess.
"Gray Golden Core?"
"Incorrect."
"Magnet?"
"Incorrect."
"Realgar?"
"Incorrect."
Eliminating three people in a row, the Spirit Chefs shivered in fear, not daring to make a sound.
"Doesn't anyone know?" Liu Xing scanned the crowd, observing everyone's expression.
Even prominent new stars like Xie Qi and An Tong among the Spirit Chefs didn't recognize what this stone sphere was.
"Isn't this a Star Core?" Lu Yang couldn't help but comment sarcastically. It's one thing for the Immortal Fairy to feed Four Immortals with Star Cores, but are you Spirit Chef Alliance members really considering this as an ingredient?
Too many Star Cores eaten?
"Correct!" Liu Xing hadn't expected that Lu Yang would recognize such a rare item, and his tone inevitably carried a hint of excitement.
"This object is the core of a planet, something that existed only in Ancient Times. However, during that era, there were many battles among Great Powers, causing stars to shatter, and occasionally, Star Cores were passed down."
"At first, our alliance didn't know what this was. After research and verification, we discovered that the Immortal Cooks once used Star Cores as ingredients to entertain friends. Following this clue, we found that if you scrape off the shards from the surface of the Star Core, grind them into a medicinal powder, and add it to the ingredients, it could elevate the freshness of the ingredients by a notch!"
Replicating the culinary arts of an Immortal Cook—this was an event significant enough to be recorded in the annals of the Spirit Chef Alliance!
Lu Yang twitched at the corner of his mouth. You guys replicated it wrong, it seems. The Fairy used an entire Star Core to feed the Four Immortals.
"Let's present the last ingredient."
The final piece of red cloth was lifted, revealing half of a golden apple. Even the flesh was golden, and the apple looked as if it had just been cut, with no signs of decay!
The aroma of the fruit wafted through the venue, lingering in everyone's mind.
"Damn, Immortal Fruit?" Lu Yang almost cursed out loud. The Spirit Chef Alliance has really outdone themselves this time, finding something even the Fairies thought no longer existed in the outside world.
Immortal Fruit was cultivated by the Immortal Fairy, and consuming it could preserve a corpse from decaying.
"Eternal Spirit Fruit!" Poisonous Granny shouted, though in reality, she didn't recognize it, but she was placed by Jin Tan, and this was the answer Jin Tan had told her.
"What Eternal Spirit Fruit..." Lu Yang thought. If you're clueless, better not to speak. However, Liu Xing's response was beyond Lu Yang's expectations.
Liu Xing waved his hand grandly and announced the result: "Correct! The second challenge ends here, and the four of you will advance to the third round..."
"Wait a minute, this isn't Eternal Spirit Fruit at all!"
Lu Yang stood up and spoke sternly, slightly displeased. Although the objects created by the Fairy were strange, they shouldn't be misidentified as something else.
"Lu Yunyang, what nonsense are you spouting!" Poisonous Granny became desperate, as this affected her chance to advance.
"It is said that during Ancient Times, the Venerate of Eternal Green planted an Eternal Life Spirit Medicine on the Eighth-grade Spiritual Vein on Yingzhou Island. This medicine bore golden fruits known as Eternal Spirit Fruits, whose fragrance was overflowing, and when picked, remained forever fresh!"
Liu Xing nodded secretly. This was also information controlled by the Spirit Chef Alliance. They had procured this half golden fruit millenniums ago; even today, it seemed as if it had just been picked, consistent with the traits of Eternal Spirit Fruit.
"Eternal Green Venerate?" Lu Yang had heard about it from Immortal Fairy, who even boasted about competing with Immortal Fairy for the position of Dao Fruit, only to be knocked down with two punches by the Fairy.
"You say this isn't Eternal Spirit Fruit, then what is it?"
"This is Immortal Fruit, cultivated by the Ancestor of Spirit Chef, used to feed Demon Beasts, ensuring their corpses remain undecayed, preserving the state of just being dead, keeping the taste forever fresh, and no mere Spirit Fruit deserves to describe such an Immortal Object!"
"Ridiculous, you say this is Immortal Fruit, what proof do you have?"
Lu Yang tore off his mask, revealing his true face, causing a stir among the crowd.
"Is that Lu Yang?"
"He's actually a Spirit Chef?"
Lu Yang looked towards Liu Xing and Daoist Ming Yuan, who stood at a higher place, and said earnestly, "I infiltrated the Eternity Sect, found the headquarters of the Eternity Sect, and only then did the Dynasty and Seek Dao Sect jointly annihilate the Eternity Sect."
"While I was undercover at the headquarters of the Eternity Sect, I saw the Immortal Fruit and learned about its origin from the confessions of subsequent masters.
"Afterward, I awakened Ao Ling, a senior, in the East Sea Dragon Pearl, and confirmed the origin of the Immortal Fruit with Senior Ao Ling."
"What I say is the proof!"
"If you don't believe me, feel free to invite Senior Ao Ling to come here and distinguish the truth!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1099 - 1098: Fish Not Fish
chapters.content:
Spirit Chef Alliance certainly didn't have the ability to invite Ao Ling over.
Who is Ao Ling? A Dragon Clan Ancestor, the strongest Semi-Immortal, second only in prestige within the Demon Race to the Qilin Immortal, far beyond what Zhu Tian could compare to.
Lu Yang was fortunate enough to awaken Ao Ling in the East Sea, earning the qualification to meet her. The Spirit Chef Alliance did not possess such capability.
Moreover, there was no need to have Ao Ling come to verify the authenticity, as Lu Yang's reputation and identity were enough to explain everything.
If Lu Yang said it was an Immortal Fruit, then it was an Immortal Fruit.
"Lu Yang was actually a Spirit Chef as well?" The audience had yet to recover from the revelation of Lu Yang's identity.
"Of course, have you forgotten? Sect Leader Qiu of the Five Elements Sect highly praised Lu Yang's cooking skills!"
"Wait, do you guys remember the battle at the Sword Tower?"
"The battle between Ying Tian Corpse and the Mysterious Immortal, of course I remember, what about it?"
"I know a Sword Cultivator who participated in the Grand Sword Ceremony, according to him, before the Mysterious Immortal appeared, Lu Yang had told the Ying Tian Corpse that he had received the teachings of the Yingtian Immortal!"
"Everything matches! Lu Yang is indeed the successor of the Immortal Cook!"
The audience excitedly discussed and finally believed Mengmeng's words. As the successor of the Immortal Cook, that identity alone gave him absolute authority in the Spirit Chef Alliance!
"See what I told you, I said he was the successor of the Immortal Cook!" Mengmeng was happy for Lu Yang as more people recognized the Second-in-command's capabilities.
"He is indeed Lu Yang, truly extraordinary." Daoist Ming Yuan looked at Lu Yang. His original intention in inviting Lu Yang was to promote the Spirit Chef Competition, but he hadn't expected Lu Yang to directly become a Spirit Chef.
What exactly was this half-piece of golden fruit? Liu Xing was also not sure and had to ask Daoist Ming Yuan; soon, Liu Xing returned and announced the final result.
"Poisonous Granny is eliminated, Xie Qi, Lu Yang, and An Tong advance to the last competition!"
Poisonous Granny hung her head dejectedly; she had guessed this would be the outcome as soon as Lu Yang appeared.
Two officers from Great Xia came, shackling her wrists and ankles, and escorted her back to Great Xia to continue her sentence.
"Wait a moment, brothers, can I watch the final competition?" Poisonous Granny pleaded. Despite her nickname, she too was a Spirit Chef who loved gourmet food; she insisted on seeing the pinnacle battle representing the Five Star Spirit Chefs!
The two officers from Great Xia conferred and thought that returning early would only lead to new tasks; there really was no need to rush back; they might as well stay and watch the competition before returning.
Although they didn't understand the Spirit Chef Competition, they also wanted to witness Lu Yang's legendary performance.
...
"Alliance Hierarch, it seems like most of the chefs entering the third round are Jin Tan's men." Liu Xing noticed that the situation was unfavorable for Daoist Ming Yuan and spoke with concern.
"Except for Fellow Daoist Lu Yang, who will win, the situations of the other four groups seem worrisome."
Jin Tan only needed to exchange four ingredients to create his ultimate dish.
"No matter, I see a promising young fellow in the Two Star Spirit Chef Team over there." Daoist Ming Yuan smiled, seemingly unconcerned about Jin Tan.
Everyone's attention was focused on the Five Star Spirit Chef Team, with very few noticing the competition within the Two Star Spirit Chef Team.
The Two Star Spirit Chef Team was the first to enter the third round with the dish "Fish but Not Fish".
Young Master Wu looked at the dazed Song Tianjing and secretly snickered.
Do you realize, boy, that the pufferfish you chose has been tainted with my Five Poisons? Even if you have a Poison Immune Body and aren't affected, can the judges withstand it?
Once the time comes, your reputation as a Spirit Chef will be utterly ruined, with no chance of redemption, and I will emerge victorious and win the beauty!
Blame yourself for offending this young master!
Song Tianjing indeed realized that his pufferfish had been poisoned by Young Master Wu, but his daze was not due to contemplating how to break out of this predicament but rather pondering whether this was a dream or reality.
The events in the dream were unfolding one by one; the previous experience seemed more like a premonition of the future rather than just a dream.
Could it be that revealing possession of the "Culinary Bible" would lead to being hunted by the Spirit Chef Alliance?
Even though in the future, he would evade the pursuit, obtain the entire inheritance of the Complete Culinary Compendium, defeat the leader of the Spirit Chef Alliance, and become the new leader, during the pursuit, Qian'er would tragically be poisoned, his younger brother would take a blade for him, the elder brother, who initially pursued him but was later swayed by him, lost an arm in the battle against the Spirit Chef Alliance, and although they escaped, his sworn brothers could not evade their fated doom...
"As long as I'm not being hunted by the Spirit Chef Alliance, I can avoid all these futures!"
"I need to rewrite the future!"
"A keen look indeed," Daoist Ming Yuan remarked.
Although he didn't understand why Song Tianjing wore a look that suggested he was ready to make a noble sacrifice.
The first recipe in the "Complete Culinary Compendium" is called Pearl Fish Soup, which primarily requires fish and Five Poisons; Master Wu's act of poisoning the fish actually aided Song Tianjing.
The second dish, Eight Treasure Chicken Duck Fish, required the fish bones from the Pearl Fish Soup as a starter to bring out the full flavor of the dish.
But now, he couldn't exactly follow the recipes for Eight Treasure Chicken Duck Fish, even resemblances might arouse suspicion!
By gaining the Forbidden Book, he had made himself an enemy of the Spirit Chef Alliance, a case of gaining some and losing some.
The Eight Treasure Chicken Duck Fish required thirty-six ingredients and had an extremely intricate and complex production process; he needed to boldly modify the recipe!
Oh ancestors of the Yangyuan Building, bless your descendants!
If the ancestors could use the incomplete "Complete Culinary Compendium" to recreate some dishes, then he could use the "Complete Culinary Compendium" to restore some dishes!
Why shouldn't modern people be as good as the ancients?
In the Spirit Chef Alliance, flame control skills are divided into five levels: Beginner, Proficient, Minor Achievement, Major Achievement, and Consummation.
As Song Tianjing's cultivation level advanced to the Foundation Establishment Late Stage, his skill in controlling flames underwent a transformation, reaching the Proficient level!
With one hand, Song Tianjing controlled the flames, making the fish soup thick and white, while with the other, he finely chopped the ingredients to better enhance the flavors!
When the last grain of sand in the hourglass fell, Song Tianjing finally completed the Three Treasure Chicken Duck Fish.
Master Wu was the second to last to finish; he had absolute confidence in his own abilities; Song Tianjing couldn't beat him!
He lifted the lid of the serving dish, revealing a dazzling light; as the light dissipated, what lay in front of the five judges were small golden ingots.
Some of the five judges were professional Spirit Chefs, some were gourmets, and others were ordinary people; they picked up a golden ingot, their eyes widening in amazement.
"It's a deep-fried dumpling!"
"No, it's more than just that; his dumpling wrapper isn't made of flour, it's made of fish skin!"
"The filling is a mix of squid bits and pork filling, the latter making up a small part serving as a binder!"
"Fish yet not fish; it truly is fish yet not fish!"
Master Wu, with a humble smile, introduced, "This is the Golden Fish Skin Dumpling I made!"
"Golden Fish Skin Dumplings, indeed quite impressive."
All five judges nodded in agreement; this was clearly a notch above the first three dishes!
Song Tianjing lifted his serving dish lid, revealing an entire old duck, though it lacked the luster of Master Wu's presentation.
"This is the Three Treasures Ruyi Soup I made."
Song Tianjing sliced the old duck open to reveal the old hen wrapped inside; the fragrance was compelling, tapping into the judges' cravings.
They hurriedly took a sip of the soup, their expressions turning to surprise; Master Wu smirked, guessing they had realized they were poisoned.
Yet, to Master Wu's astonishment, the judges, who had only sampled a bite from the first four dishes, began to sip one spoon after another, increasingly faster!
The judges closed their eyes, savoring the soup's impact and satisfaction.
They felt surrounded by the energetic presence of chicken, duck, and fish; even though the fish weren't visible, the fish's fragrance leisurely infused into the soup, spreading in their mouths, their blood turning as salty as the sea, countless fish swimming within!
The leading judge, the champion of the previous two-star Spirit Chef competition, nodded along with the four others. Not a word was needed to reach a unanimous decision.
He stood up to announce the result.
"I announce, the champion of the Two Star Spirit Chef Team is Song Tianjing!"
On the sleeve of Song Tianjing's arm, two black stars were covered by glaring gold!

chapters.title: Chapter 1100 - 199: Tofu Showdown!
chapters.content:
Due to Lu Yang's appearance, the Five Star Spirit Chef Team garnered much attention, with even those originally intending to watch the Seven Star Spirit Chef Team being lured over in significant numbers.
"Who would've thought that Lu Yang is a Spirit Chef with Immortal Chef's Successor's inheritance!" Xie Qi stared intensely at Lu Yang, mimicking his every move.
So what if he has received the Immortal Chef's inheritance? I will prove to the world that not only can I imitate the dishes of the Immortal Chef's Successor, but I can even improve upon them!
Xie Qi touched the vials and jars strapped to his waist, revealing a smile filled with deep meaning.
These were his secret weapons, containing spices he had collected from his travels across the Cultivation World, especially from Buddha Country.
The Spirit Chef World overlooked Buddha Country, even excluding it from their ranks, yet Xie Qi discovered that while Buddha Country's dishes were indescribably poor, or rather unpalatable, its spices were unmatched by any other place.
With the power of these spices, he could make any dish taste even better!
An Tong also longed to compete with Lu Yang on the same stage and see who the better chef was!
The "Invincible" An Tong, as the outside world called her, had never lost since her debut. Lu Yang would not be an exception!
As the center of attention, Lu Yang felt there was no need for everyone to keep looking at him this way.
He had only practiced his knife skills for a few days, followed Fairy Eternity in recognizing some odd Spiritual Plants, which he hadn't even used yet.
As for cooking, he was a complete novice—what could he rely on to win?
He might as well casually prepare something and let Xie Qi and An Tong fight over first place.
After all, he didn't care whether Jin Tan's side would win or not. This was an internal struggle of the Spirit Chef Alliance, and he was just an observer.
Liu Xing spread his arms wide, and the outermost walls of the examination area collapsed, revealing rows upon rows of ingredients—birds, beasts, Spirit Beans, Spirit Rice, everything one could wish for.
He announced the final challenge loud and clear, "For the Five Star Spirit Chef Team, the last challenge is to make a dish using tofu!"
Lu Yang: "..."
Lu Yang, clutching his forehead in pain, first thought of his early Cultivation days, when Eldest Senior Sister made him practice Swordsmanship with tofu. He had to chop as much tofu by day as he would then have to eat at meals, and at night, even his nightmares were haunted by Tofu Heavenly Venerate, to the point where he felt nauseated at the sight of tofu.
Do you Spirit Chefs even want positive coverage anymore?
"Little Yang, go for it! My recipe includes a Yin Yang Tofu. Let them see the level of Immortal cooking!" Fairy Eternity egged on.
Lu Yang's eye twitched as he had translated the entire Complete Culinary Compendium, resulting in his ability to remember the preparation method for every single dish listed.
The Imperial edict was inviolable—what right did a subject have to resist His Majesty's decree?
Lu Yang begrudgingly started making the Yin Yang Tofu.
As the name implied, Yin Yang Tofu consisted of tofu in two colors, black and white. To achieve this, one needed hundreds of black and white ingredients to create a composite sauce to dye the tofu.
Black foods like squid ink, soy sauce, and more.
White foods like salt, sugar, and more.
"Fairy, wouldn't this make it too salty?"
"Don't worry, just add some chili pepper at the end, it will balance out the saltiness!"
"This Yin Yang Tofu embodies the Yin Yang Path, it contains endless worlds, and its wonders are infinite. If you manage to comprehend this aspect, you will have entered the threshold of the Yin Yang Path..." Fairy Eternity rambled on and on, recounting her philosophy behind creating this dish.
Xie Qi kept pace with Lu Yang's actions, pouring hundreds of vials and jars together and mixing them thoroughly.
Watching the black and white mixture unwittingly react and bubble, Xie Qi began to doubt whether Lu Yang was truly an Immortal Chef's Successor.
But recalling all the rumors about Lu Yang, he gritted his teeth, believed, and continued to follow the recipe!
Staring at the ball-shaped slices of tofu doused in the sauce, Xie Qi's index finger twitched in anticipation.
Although the cooking process was inexplicably mysterious, the finished product smelled incredibly fragrant!
"Let me taste it and see what faults this tofu has."
Xie Qi took a spoonful and incredulously clutched his throat, making "uh-uh" sounds.
Two extreme flavors collided in his mouth. His taste sense, already far superior to a normal person's, was amplified to an unbearable degree by the effect. These flavors tormented him to an extent that life seemed worse than death.
Clang—
Xie Qi collapsed to the ground, foaming at the mouth and lost to unconsciousness.
Without employing a single soldier, Lu Yang had forced Xie Qi out of the competition. This could truly be called a masterstroke strategy, winning without fighting!
The final matchup came down to Lu Yang and An Tong.
"Time's up!" Liu Xing declared loudly.
"Considering Xie Qi's withdrawal due to unforeseen circumstances, after discussion by the alliance's higher-ups, we've decided to adopt a different method for this competition's evaluation!"
"We will switch to each side tasting the other's dishes and giving scores!"
Lu Yang presented the Yin Yang Tofu, drenched in brilliant red chili oil, while An Tong presented tofu in the shape of an orange.
"Now, let's begin the tasting."
Lu Yang examined An Tong's orange-shaped tofu, which was coated in a shell resembling a sugar glaze. With a gentle tap of his spoon, Lu Yang cracked the sugar shell, revealing the white and bouncy tofu inside.
Taking a spoonful of both sugar coating and tofu, Lu Yang tasted it. The originally bland tofu became enriched in flavor with the addition of an orange essence, and mixing in bamboo shoots gave the tofu a particularly crisp bite.
This flavor was leaps and bounds beyond Fairy Eternity's creations!
While Lu Yang savored An Tong's orange tofu, An Tong was also studying Lu Yang's Yin Yang Tofu.
As a child, a high fever had taken her sense of taste, but it had also led to an abnormal development of her vision, touch, smell, and hearing.
"The layer of red oil on this Yin Yang Tofu is visually striking without overpowering the tofu's fragrance. The black and white tofu has not only the aroma of tofu but also combines scents from the sea, the sky, and the earth."
She didn't even need to taste it to know that it was a superb tofu that completely overshadowed her own orange tofu!
It was a true masterpiece of tofu!
Although she lacked the sense of taste, An Tong still wanted to try a bite—out of respect for Lu Yang.
Just as Lu Yang was about to advise An Tong not to eat it, ready to concede defeat, he saw An Tong take a spoonful of the Yin Yang Tofu. Gripping her neck and wide-mouthed, she shouted an evaluation, louder than she ever had in her life.
"So spicy, so salty!!"
"How can it be this spicy!"
An Tong gulped down water, which finally lowered the temperature in her mouth a bit and allowed her to calm down, contemplating more deeply.
"Wait, do I now have a sense of taste?!"
"I—I have my sense of taste back?"
An Tong devoured the Yin Yang Tofu with tears dripping onto the plate, sobbing with a smile, "Delicious, it's really delicious…"
After a while, An Tong finally calmed her inner turmoil and bowed deeply to Lu Yang. "Fellow Daoist Lu Yang, you have won, I concede defeat voluntarily."
Though she was on Jin Tan's side, she had her own principles. Lu Yang had saved her sense of taste with his tofu—how could she be qualified to judge Lu Yang's Yin Yang Tofu?
Saying so, she left the stage without awaiting Lu Yang's reaction, leaving behind a bewildered Lu Yang.
Even as Liu Xing announced the results and Lu Yang's sleeve was adorned with five golden stars, denoting his status as the strongest among the Five Star Spirit Chefs, he hadn't snapped back to reality.
Wait, how did I just win with these skills?

chapters.title: Chapter 1101 - 1100 Why does this cook's cooking seem like a fight?
chapters.content:
All the Spirit Chefs looked toward the golden Star armband worn by Lu Yang, their eyes full of envy. This was the supreme honor that all Spirit Chefs dreamed of, yet compared to the status of Immortal Cook's Successor, the golden Star armband seemed somewhat dimmed.
It could be said that if Lu Yang hadn't obtained the golden Star armband, it would have diminished its value!
"Little Yang, be confident, you are a Spirit Chef personally taught by me, becoming number one is only natural." Fairy Eternity was quite pleased with herself, as Lu Yang won in the final round relying on her Yin Yang Tofu!
Though there were some twists and unexpected events, it was an undeniable fact that Lu Yang triumphed in the Five Star Spirit Chef Team.
After all five competitions had ended, Song Tianjing, the winner of the Two Star Spirit Chef Team, stepped onto the award platform under everyone's watchful eyes, and Yu Qian'er's eyes shone when she looked at Song Tianjing.
"Song Tianjing, what kind of ingredient would you like as a reward?" asked Daoist Ming Yuan.
Song Tianjing initially wanted Firmament Tree, as all three dishes in the Complete Culinary Compendium used it for firewood.
But since Firmament Tree wasn't exactly an ingredient, and it was unlikely that the Spirit Chef Alliance had it.
"Star Core, I want the Star Core."
"Oh, that's interesting," Daoist Ming Yuan handed a square wooden box to Song Tianjing, containing the Star Core inside.
"Lu Yang, what ingredient do you desire?" Daoist Ming Yuan's attitude towards Lu Yang was noticeably more gentle than towards the other winners.
"Immortal Fruit."
That embarrassing thing from Fairy Eternity had to be recovered.
Daoist Ming Yuan solemnly handed half of an Immortal Fruit to Lu Yang: "Our alliance failed to recognize the Immortal Object as a mere Spiritual Object, truly a shame. I hope this fruit will shine uniquely in your hands."
"It will!" Lu Yang responded with the same solemnity.
The winners of the other three groups were Jin Tan's men, and according to his orders, they obtained three legendary ingredients from Daoist Ming Yuan.
"Sir, mission accomplished!"
The three group winners knelt before Jin Tan, presenting the three legendary ingredients.
"Bodhi Glazed Fruit, Nine Revolutions Coiled Dragon Bamboo Shoot, Proverb Fish, we're just missing the one from the Five Star Spirit Chef Team..."
Jin Tan's eyes narrowed slightly, he hadn't expected Lu Yang to pull off a Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth, pretending to be a member of their team.
"Well, missing one doesn't matter!"
Jin Tan strode with the vigor of a tiger and dragon to confront Daoist Ming Yuan, pointing at his nose.
"Old Daoist Ming Yuan, I hereby challenge you for the position of Alliance Leader. Do you dare to accept the battle?"
He had been biding his time for three hundred years for this day, only he hadn't anticipated the unforeseen emergence of Lu Yang and Song Tianjing.
He was never one for elaborate schemes, but for the Alliance Leader's position, he had clashed wits and courage with Daoist Ming Yuan for three hundred years, unwilling to continue the fight. Now that they had fallen out, it was time to settle it once and for all!
The crowd that had dispersed started to get agitated.
"What, what, Jin Tan is issuing an Alliance Leader challenge?"
"I heard that he was terribly defeated by Daoist Ming Yuan three hundred years ago, he's surely well-prepared if he's come back today."
"There's excitement on the way!"
"Will Alliance Leader Ming Yuan accept the challenge?"
"He has to, rejecting it would undermine his authority as leader, and there would be no point in holding his position!"
Daoist Ming Yuan looked at Jin Tan's determined gaze, sighed and lowered his head: "You have finally taken this step, so be it, I will accept your challenge."
The crowd erupted in cheers, a duel between two Eighth Star Spirit Chefs, a scene many Spirit Chefs would never witness in their lifetimes!
"Second-in-command, I knew you would win!" Yun Mengmeng said excitedly, with the Chief Housekeeper himself giving pointers, how could it be otherwise?
Now, everyone was more excited than Lu Yang himself.
"Thank you," Lu Yang replied calmly, taking a bite of the half Immortal Fruit from four hundred thousand years ago.
Hmm, quite delicious, juicy and plump, as if just picked.
"Let's watch the competition before leaving," Lu Yang was also curious about what a battle between Eighth Star Spirit Chefs would look like.
The judging panel had been temporarily transformed into cooking stations, and two great Eighth Star Spirit Chefs stood facing each other, the atmosphere heavy.
With a gong sound, both chefs sprang into action.
Exorcising demons, chopping vegetables, extracting juice, seasoning the pot... The aroma quickly spread throughout the venue.
"Look, there's something behind them!" someone exclaimed.
