Ascending to the Immortal rank, he underwent a complete transformation.
Lu Yang was effervescent, and his body glowed, like a sun that was unspeakably sacred, making even the statues in temples pale in comparison to Lu Yang at this moment.
He was radiant and attracted the attention of everyone, becoming the focus of the entire Universe.
Lu Yang actively dispersed all Sword Qi, spread his arms wide, and an invisible force emanated from him, surging outward.
The final phase of the Immortal Ascension Tribulation, still brewing, was directly scattered by this force, unable to condense any further.
All was silent in the world.
Lu Yang let out a long breath, feeling a sense of consummation at this moment, looking down upon the world with detachment and transcendence.
Unlike temporarily becoming an Immortal with the aid of a body built from the faith of Buddha Country, back then his Spiritual Sense was weak, not strong enough to control the Immortal Body, and he needed the help of Fairy Eternity's Immortal Sense.
Now his Immortal Sense is complete, his Dao Fruit is consummated, no longer needing the strength of others, standing tall at the end of the Immortal Dao, achieving the goal that all Cultivators aspire to their entire lives—Immortalhood.
"Did Lu Yang... succeed?" Finally, someone broke the silence; it was people from other civilizations. They did not have a profound concept of immortality and were the first to awaken to this reality.
"He has become an Immortal! Lu Yang has become an Immortal!" A Cultivator shouted this fact, followed by a series of jubilant cries one after another.
Unlike other Immortals, Lu Yang's ascension process was live-streamed, watched by the entire universe, every move he made during his Tribulation touching the hearts of everyone.
Thus, as he gained success and fame, achieving the Immortal Fruit Position, the whole universe erupted in celebration and cheers, sharing the joy with Lu Yang.
The news of Lu Yang's Immortal Ascension immediately dominated headlines across major platforms, nobody had the mind to discuss anything else, all focused on talking about this fact, discussing just how formidable the Cultivation World is.
"Congratulations to Senior Brother Lu on becoming an Immortal!" Junior Brothers and Sisters came one after another to congratulate him, their faces brimming with radiant smiles, genuinely happy from the heart.
"Second-in-command, I knew you could do it!" Yun Mengmeng said she believed in Lu Yang, but in reality, when Lu Yang was facing his Tribulation, she was tightly clutching onto Yun Zhi's sleeve, terrified that something might go wrong.
"Congratulations." Qinghe said tersely. With only two words, it sounded without emotion, but having known her for so long, Lu Yang understood Qinghe's nature; she was truly happy, just shy to express her emotions.
"Not bad, you've finally become an Immortal." Yun Zhi remarked, revealing a rare smile that vanished in a blink, as if she had never smiled before.
"I still have to thank Eldest Senior Sister for nurturing me..."
Yun Zhi waved her hand dismissively: "There's no need for such formalities between you and me."
"My good disciple, don't forget your master now that you're an Immortal." Daoist Buyu cheekily drew close, feeling that the best two things he had done in his life were to take on Yun Zhi and Lu Yang as disciples.
With such accomplished disciples, he could just lay back for the rest of his life.
Lu Yang fell silent for a moment, remembering the words of his Eldest Senior Sister just now, feeling that their master-disciple relationship was so good there was no need for formality: "My Immortality is all thanks to my own effort."
Daoist Buyu: "..."
I recall you haven't had much interaction with your Second Senior Brother.
Ao Ling, Jiang Lianyi, Jin Caiwei, Zhu Tian, and others also arrived. Some offered verbal congratulations, while others presented generous gifts. The weight of the gift was not important; it was the thought that counted.
With Lu Yang's becoming an Immortal, the entire universe was celebrating, and the Seek Dao Sect was decorated with bright lights and colors, many times livelier than the New Year.
Seeing this, Yun Zhi's eyes twitched slightly, feeling relieved that her breakthrough didn't cause such a stir. Few people knew of her strength, otherwise she would have to face a situation like her Junior Brother with the whole Sect celebrating.
Although she was reluctant to leave the mortal world and did not wish to Harmonize, she felt out of place and uncomfortable in such lively environments, preferring to stay away from them.
The celebration continued for several days before the excitement finally began to subside, allowing Lu Yang to break free and do what he wanted.
Fairy Eternity floated out of Lu Yang's body and offered her individual congratulations, "Little Yang, congratulations on becoming an Immortal..."
"Fairy, let me help you restore your body."
"Ah?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1350 - 1349: Making Trouble
chapters.content:
After Lu Yang became an Immortal, he not only felt that his Immortal Sense had immensely expanded to envelop the universe, but the Trace Origin Dao Fruit had also become extremely powerful, able to affect other Immortals.
For instance, it healed Fairy Eternity's path injuries, restoring her to the state she was in when she fought Ashy Bean, giving her an Immortal Body.
"Ah? Wait..."
Fairy Eternity was stunned, and before she could react, she saw Lu Yang activating the Trace Origin Dao Fruit. The powerful rule force reversed the world, disregarded causality, and Fairy Eternity's slightly transparent soul gradually solidified, becoming flesh and blood, possessing temperature and touch.
Fairy Eternity felt inner turmoil, unable to control her emotions for a moment. The eternal aura spread around, and the plants at her feet were baptized by this eternal aura, transforming completely. Golden lines appeared on their leaves, signifying their transition from Spirit Grass to Immortal Herbs, which could grant longevity if consumed.
Her single drop of blood, a tear, were all objects of longevity that people pursued, incredibly precious.
Fairy Eternity was tearful yet tearless, preoccupied with being happy for Little Yang, never having expected that after Little Yang became Immortal, the Trace Origin Dao Fruit would have such capabilities.
I, the Immortal, do not wish to leave the comfortable Spiritual Space. I want to reside here forever.
Fairy Eternity was also secretly pleased, which indicated that Little Yang always had her in his mind.
But still, I don't want to leave!
"Fairy, congratulations!" Lu Yang excitedly embraced Fairy Eternity, causing her immense panic.
Every time Lu Yang thought of Fairy Eternity's tragic state after battling with Ashy Bean, his heart tightened with guilt, feeling it was due to his own weakness.
After becoming an Immortal, he could finally make up for past regrets, allowing the Fairy to regain her Immortal Body.
But as the Spiritual Space quietened down, Lu Yang felt somewhat unaccustomed, missing the noisy days of the past.
"The Chief Housekeeper has an Immortal Body now?" Qinghe, upon hearing the news, hurried over first, crying tears of joy. However, seeing the Chief Housekeeper's panicked expression while being embraced by Lu Yang, she felt as if the sky was falling.
Seeing that there were outsiders present, Fairy Eternity quickly pushed Lu Yang away.
Yun Mengmeng, Ao Ling, and others also rushed over upon hearing the news. Yun Mengmeng, curiously pinching Fairy Eternity's arm, found it icily soft.
"So this is what the Chief Housekeeper feels like."
"Stop, stop touching." Fairy Eternity hid beside Lu Yang, secretly poking his waist, mumbling softly, "It's all your fault, all your fault."
Making Lu Yang baffled.
"Has the senior Fairy recovered?" Yun Zhi showed a smile, its angle peculiar, visible only to Fairy Eternity, frustrating Fairy Eternity who turned her head pouting, unwilling to respond to Yun Zhi.
"I was just about to gather some people to celebrate the Junior Brother becoming an Immortal. Now that double happiness has arrived, we can also celebrate for the senior Fairy's recovery."
...
At the peak of Sky Gate Mountain, in front of the Soybean Dynasty Ancestor Temple, Immortal Energy swirled around, creating a peaceful and joyous atmosphere with constant laughter and chatter.
Yun Mengmeng showcased her skills while Qinghe assisted in the kitchen, bustling with activity, looking very lively.
"Why won't they let me be the main chef?" Now that she has regained her Immortal Body, Fairy Eternity planned to show off her skills, but was stopped by Lu Yang, puffing up with anger, seeing how Little Yang had grown bold after becoming an Immortal.
"Won't you persuade Little Yang, don't you want to taste my cuisine?" Fairy Eternity sought help from the Four Ancient Immortals, who each played deaf and dumb, hesitating without speaking.
Lu Yang gently soothed her: "Fairy, you are the star of today, finally having recovered your body, how could we let you toil so much?"
Fairy Eternity thought about it, realized it made sense, and decided not to do any work as advised.
The Four Ancient Immortals sighed in relief at this.
"In this world, only Little Friend Lu can persuade Fairy Eternity."
In Ancient Times, no matter how they tried to persuade, Fairy Eternity wouldn't listen and would do whatever she wanted, which scared them beyond measure.
"I think Little Friend Lu getting along with Fairy Eternity is quite good."
"Indeed, I support it."
Finally, someone could tame Fairy Eternity, and the Four Ancient Immortals were happy to see it happen.
"Even though we knew he would become an immortal, we didn't expect it to happen so fast." Jiang Pingan and Meng Junzi, who were invited, saw Lu Yang surrounded by people, chatting merrily, and marveled at how they had aged.
"Here come the buns!" Yun Mengmeng came out with a big steamer full of steaming buns, round and plump, their fragrance wafting from afar; Qinghe followed with a second steamer of buns.
Lu Yang couldn't wait to take a bite, and although he couldn't tell the filling, it was so delicious and oily that he couldn't help but smile with joy.
Every time he tasted Yun Mengmeng's cooking, Lu Yang inwardly lamented this was the consequence of self-learning and not following the Fairy's instructions.
The celebration banquet was of the highest standard, starting with Semi-Immortals, and eating buns might seem inappropriate, but those present were not particular about formalities.
Even the Yingtian Immortal didn't think there was anything wrong with eating buns at this occasion, as long as Fairy Eternity wasn't the chef, anything was fine.
Next to the buns was freshly squeezed peach juice from the Heavenly Root, which Jiang Pingan and Meng Junzi, after drinking, deemed extraordinary, ranking it among the top of all the Immortal products they had tasted.
Midway through the celebration, people started to encourage Lu Yang to say a few words.
Unable to refuse, Lu Yang reluctantly stepped up, holding peach juice and moving among the crowd, offering thanks to everyone.
"Qilin Immortal, I toast to you. Thanks to your trade with Wu Yao, I was exchanged here, and could start a new life. You are my lifesaver." After saying that, Lu Yang downed the peach juice in one go.
Qilin Immortal clinked his cup with Lu Yang's and also drank in one gulp: "No need to mention it, you revived the Fairy Eternity, we should be thanking you instead."
"Immortal Jiuchong, I salute you. If you hadn't intervened timely during my battle with The Controller in the Extreme Northern Lands, I might have perished there. I haven't formally thanked you, so thank you."
Immortal Jiuchong was a bit taken aback by Lu Yang's sincerity, and seeing him so flustered made everyone else laugh.
"Jiuchong, he's thanking you, say a few words." Yingtian Immortal teased from the side.
Immortal Jiuchong glared at Yingtian Immortal, and the laughter around grew even louder.
"Time Immortal, I salute you. The way you used the Power of Faith to mold an Immortal Body and Golden Body was truly unexpected. Considering all the shameful past I know about you, and you haven't troubled me, shows your magnanimity. It's no wonder you are the oldest of the four seniors, such dignity."
Time Immortal didn't react much, but Yingtian Immortal's face darkened upon hearing that.
"Ying Tian, Little Lu is pointing at you, always intentionally troubling others." Now it was Immortal Jiuchong's turn to tease, laughing loudly.
"Get lost, get lost, get lost." Yingtian Immortal, not one to be easily ridiculed, retorted, "I don't believe you didn't have ideas about fixing Little Lu; it's only after seeing how powerful Daoist Yun Zhi is that you all chickened out."
"That's called knowing the situation." Immortal Jiuchong said with pride.
"Yingtian Immortal, I toast to you, precisely because you assassinated the Fairy, possessed the real Yingtian Immortal, polluted the faith's source during Ashy Bean's revival, which led to all subsequent events."

chapters.title: Chapter 1351 - 1350: Little Friend Lu, Why Expose My Identity?
chapters.content:
"What?"
At first, when everyone heard Lu Yang speak, they thought they had heard wrong, as Lu Yang's tone was too calm, as if he was talking about something insignificant.
Even the Yingtian Immortal himself did not react, still maintaining a smile, as if his memory was still at the time when he and the Jiuchong Immortal were playfully bantering.
Yingtian Immortal looked at Lu Yang, his thoughts retracting, his smile gradually fading away, as if he had become a different person.
He shook his head and sighed, not understanding Lu Yang's behavior: "Little Friend Lu, why disclose my identity?"
"I intended to make amends with you, why do you stubbornly pursue me?"
"Yao Saint is dead, the great vengeance is avenged, the world is in peace, the Cultivation World is developing orderly, everything is on the right track, you have also become an immortal, enjoying the world, isn't this good?"
After possessing Yingtian Immortal and using Yingtian Immortal's identity to interact with Lu Yang, Immortal Eternity, Yun Zhi, Jiuchong Immortal, etc., he began to reminisce about the good times spent with close friends in ancient times. Furthermore, since Immortal Eternity could not achieve omniscience and no one in the world could threaten his identity, he chose to let go of his murderous heart and enjoy this period under the identity of Yingtian Immortal.
It was precisely because he was unwilling to entangle with people like Lu Yang that he released the fake identity of Yao Saint as bait, tricked everyone through a battle, and let the matter rest.
After the Cultivation World lifted the seal, he chose not to take action again for this reason.
However, he did not expect that Lu Yang would not appreciate his intentions and, under his watch, still saw through his identity.
"What? He is the mastermind?!" When people including Jiuchong Immortal heard Yingtian Immortal personally confirm, their pupils shrank sharply, and their minds were greatly shaken; they fundamentally did not want to believe this.
But the facts were before their eyes, they had to believe even if they did not want to.
The Qilin Immortal's eyes turned red immediately, a murderous intent surged like never before; he had the best relationship with Yingtian Immortal, and his guilt over these three hundred thousand years all stemmed from the mastermind!
"Ying Tian..." Including Immortal Eternity, the Four Ancient Immortals had never been so angry; he actually killed Yingtian Immortal and replaced him, interacting with them under the identity of Yingtian Immortal all this time!
The scene fell silent, the atmosphere oppressively heavy; no one showed any intention of making a move, only Lu Yang and the mastermind talked freely, as if no one else was present.
"When did you start suspecting me?" the mastermind asked, Lu Yang's challenge was too sudden; he had not anticipated it, nor had he noticed anything odd about Lu Yang beforehand.
"From the time I met you at Laurel Fairy Palace, when you spoke about the demise of the Time Immortal Senior at the end of the Fire Dynasty era, you yourself said that the assailant of Time Immortal Senior was one of the other three."
"I'm a straightforward person; I believe what people say, so you telling me to doubt you, naturally made me suspicious of you."
"Of course, it wasn't just you, I doubted all of the Four Ancient Immortals, considering Time Immortal Senior could have been possessed as well."
The mastermind's eyes narrowed slightly, not expecting that Lu Yang had begun to suspect him so early; he had initially thought that by actively revealing this information, he could clear himself of suspicion, but contrary to his expectations, Lu Yang did not fall for it but instead started suspecting everyone.
When Lu Yang suspected that someone among the Four Ancient Immortals might be possessed, and knowing that Li Haoran was a reincarnation, he realized that Li Haoran was in great danger.
Therefore, after returning from Laurel Fairy Palace, Lu Yang minimized his interactions with Li Haoran, pretending to simply be ordinary Senior Brothers, and no longer discussed Li Haoran's reincarnation, otherwise Lu Yang would have long asked Li Haoran to learn Artifact Refining Technique from Yingtian Immortal.
Even after realizing that Qilin Immortal was not the killer of Time Immortal, with Li Haoran around, Lu Yang still did not dismiss his suspicions of the Four Ancient Immortals.
However, which one the mastermind had possessed, Lu Yang still could not conclude.
Only after gaining some insights into the Reincarnation Dao Fruit Prototype did Lu Yang gradually confirm his suspect.
Life in reincarnation, things also reincarnate.
People of Reincarnation, their experiences will overlap somewhat with their previous lives.
It goes without saying that Li Haoran is skilled in Refining. Immortal Fairy Eternity once mentioned a shameful past of Yingtian Immortal. She said that when Yingtian Immortal was young, he easily won the affection of older female cultivators with higher Cultivation Levels, which corresponds with Li Haoran's experiences.
The manipulator behind the scenes does not understand the true meaning of Reincarnation, and simply thinks that people from the past and the future share similarities, so he suspects Gu Junye.
"Of course, these were all just suspicions until I was convinced of your identity, after the Consummation of the Trace Origin Dao Fruit."
"I used the Trace Origin Dao Fruit to clarify the history at the end of the Fire Dynasty, and finally confirmed that Yingtian Immortal was the one you possessed!"
When Lu Yang paid his respects to the Four Ancient Immortals, he secretly used the Trace Origin Dao Fruit to examine their experiences during the end of the Fire Dynasty. Time Immortal, Immortal Jiuchong, and Qilin Immortal showed nothing unusual, only Yingtian Immortal!
He saw the manipulator behind the scenes possessing Yingtian Immortal in the Underworld, Yingtian Immortal using the Reincarnation Dao Fruit Prototype to escape from death, the manipulator behind the scenes corrupting the Power of Faith, prompting Ashy Bean to pursue Transcendence at any cost!
The Trace Origin Dao Fruit can view one's past. This was tested by Lu Yang during the Interstellar Alliance.
"Didn't expect the Trace Origin Dao Fruit to be so miraculous," the manipulator behind the scenes raised an eyebrow. He mastered the Time Line Dao Fruit, which muddled that period of history, obscuring it from everyone.
Unexpectedly, the Trace Origin Dao Fruit pointed directly at the origin, bypassing the temporal interference and revealing the truth of events.
The manipulator behind the scenes burst into laughter, laughing at his own arrogance, being completely duped by a young boy, and never realizing that Lu Yang had been suspecting him all along.
Was it after possessing Yingtian Immortal, that a long period of peace made him too relaxed, or had he become lenient and unwilling to make a move?
The laughter of the manipulator behind the scenes carries a hint of anger, and the space itself vibrated violently, "It's merely because I found your experiences somewhat interesting that I didn't deal with you sooner, but instead, you have become a formidable opponent!"
"Little Friend Lu, have you thought about how you want to die!"
The crowd felt the strong aura surging from within the manipulator behind the scenes, their expressions changed dramatically, this aura was even more powerful than that of Yao Saint.
As Lu Yang speculated, the manipulator behind the scenes had never shown his true power.
Or rather, anyone who had seen his true power is already dead!
Lu Yang remained silent, throwing the peach juice in his cup onto the face of the manipulator behind the scenes, provoking him even more.
The crowd was eager to make a move, but this place is Seek Dao Sect, the Cultivation World, and if a fight breaks out here, the entire Cultivation World could be destroyed!
The manipulator behind the scenes has no such concerns about his power; he intends to unleash a massacre today, not only to kill Lu Yang but also everyone present, no one will escape!
"Transformation." Yun Zhi whispered softly.
Suddenly, the scene changes, Sky Gate Mountain beneath their feet vanishes, with only the endless starry sky and boundless darkness surrounding them!
The Cultivation World disappeared, and they have arrived in the universe!
"Wu Yao's Transformation Spell!" The manipulator behind the scenes immediately realized. Yun Zhi does not possess a Dao Fruit, this was a unique magic skill that Yun Zhi learned from Wu Yao after he entered Captive Peak.
Yun Zhi enjoys learning, and this action did not raise his suspicions; it turns out it was intended to be used here!
Did she exchange me with the outside world? No, if it were so, I wouldn't feel this way, the manipulator behind the scenes muttered to himself.
"It seems then, the entire Cultivation World has been exchanged to another place, what a clever move!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1352 - 1351: The War Begins
chapters.content:
"What's happening?" As the behind-the-scenes mastermind released a terrifying aura, all Cultivators sensed this breath and trembled from the depths of their hearts.
That breath vanished in a flash, as if it had never appeared, leaving them confused and continuing with their own affairs, not even noticing that the Cultivation World had already changed its position.
Only those who remained on Sky Gate Mountain were privy to this information.
"Where have Xiao Zhi and the others gone!" Yun Mengmeng was frantically pacing, everything had developed too quickly, and listening to the conversation between the Second-in-command and the behind-the-scenes mastermind was also hazy.
She could only be sure of one thing – that the atmosphere just a moment ago was very tense, as if a fight could break out at any time.
Ao Ling, Jiang Lianyi, Jin Caiwei, and others were also very anxious, wishing they could rush over and join the battle.
"Everyone, take a seat." The most composed Qinghe sighed, but her trembling hands betrayed her inner turmoil.
Faced with Lu Yang's sudden aggression and exposing the behind-the-scenes mastermind – who turned out to be one of their own – anyone would find it impossible to remain calm.
But this struggle was between Immortals; as Semi-Immortals, they couldn't intervene, and even spectating could potentially make them hostages.
They had no other choice but to wait.
"Believe in Lu Zhuguo. He is clearly prepared for this battle," Qinghe forced herself to calm down and recalled the entire sequence of events.
Obviously, this so-called victory celebration was just a ruse to gather all the Immortals to surround and capture the behind-the-scenes mastermind; calling these Semi-Immortals over was merely to make the celebration seem authentic.
If the celebration comprised only Immortals, the behind-the-scenes mastermind would surely have grown suspicious.
Now that the facade was torn, Immortals joined the battle, while the Semi-Immortals remained on Sky Gate Mountain.
...
Amidst the starry sky, a group of Immortals besieged the behind-the-scenes mastermind, resembling the universe's birth, with Chaotic Aura pervading and space shattering beyond count.
If there were any veteran Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivators nearby, they would have been torn into pieces by the spatial rifts, their Divine Souls extinguished.
This was the most powerful coalition battle in history, the fight against Yao Saint had only revealed a fraction of the behind-the-scenes mastermind's combat power.
In this level of battle, ordinary Immortals could hardly compete. Yun Zhi and Fairy Eternity joined forces, no longer hiding their true strength, each attack showcasing their unparalleled status throughout the ages!
"Be careful, don't treat him as an ordinary Immortal – he is of the Transcendence Realm!" Lu Yang shouted.
Upon learning the true Realm of the behind-the-scenes mastermind, everyone was shocked, their hearts burdened with mounting pressure, but soon their anger outweighed their fear of the Realm.
The behind-the-scenes mastermind's eyes were cold as ice, looking at Lu Yang as if looking at a dead person, a cruel smile appearing on the corner of his mouth: "Little Friend Lu, you seem to know quite a lot!"
The behind-the-scenes mastermind had not expected Lu Yang to even guess his Realm – he must have been inspired within the abode of the Immortal Fairy. He had always observed Lu Yang, yet had never detected anything amiss; such deep concealment.
"If only you'd willingly reveal your identity, that would be even better," Lu Yang replied with a smile, eliciting an increasingly cold and cruel demeanor from the behind-the-scenes mastermind.
Thunder Magma surged like the collapse of the heavens and the tsunami, rolling endlessly towards Lu Yang. No one recognized this kind of Thunder Tribulation, but everyone could feel the ultimate power it contained – even Yun Zhi didn't dare to take it lightly.
"Cloud Falling Palm."
The Star Cluster Cloud appeared, containing thousands of stars, shattering the Thunder Tribulation Magma; this was Yun Zhi's true power.
The behind-the-scenes mastermind focused on the Star Cluster Cloud; it contained not just thousands of stars but countless laws that Yun Zhi had comprehended.
"So this is your true power!" For the first time in his life, the behind-the-scenes mastermind felt pressure. With such power before Harmonization, what more if Harmonization was achieved?
Even someone as proud as he had to admit, Yun Zhi's talent was as strong as his; he had comprehended the Transcendence Realm, while Yun Zhi had comprehended the Harmonization Realm. It's just that Yun Zhi lost due to a flaw in her Dao heart, lacking a pure heart dedicated to seeking the Dao.
If Yun Zhi could, like him, abandon all worldly affairs, she would have long since reached the Harmonization Realm.
"Attacking recklessly, aren't you afraid of accelerating the Harmonization process?" The force behind the scenes shouted, aware of Yun Zhi's weakness and threatening her. Yun Zhi alone was manageable, but with many allies at her side, it became quite troublesome to defend against.
Greeting him was not a response from Yun Zhi, but the self-detonation of Immortal Fairy.
Boom——
Immortal Fairy had waited for this day for far too long and was determined to eliminate the hidden enemy right here!
Immortal Fairy's continuous self-detonations turned the nearby star systems into nothingness; facing the Transcendence Realm opponent behind the scenes, Immortal Fairy no longer concealed her strength. That she could fight Yun Zhi to a standstill was not mere words; she truly had the ability to do so.
Although she could not reach the Half-step All-Known Realm she once reached, her cultivation level remained extremely terrifying, with unrivaled techniques and pure strength symbolism. Even the force behind the scenes was injured by the explosion.
Qilin Immortal transformed in a flash, becoming a majestic Kirin, swallowing mountains and rivers with his spirit, full of ambition within the universe.
He successively landed a claw strike on Time Immortal, Immortal Jiuchong, Jiang Pingan, and Meng Junzi.
Time Immortal and Immortal Jiuchong both cried out their surrender at the same time, while Jiang Pingan and Meng Junzi, not understanding, nevertheless mimicked surrendering.
The aura of Qilin Immortal surged, becoming the strongest among the five individuals.
"Qilin Chant!"
The chant of the Qilin shattered the heavens, fully displaying the majesty of the King of Demons. His heart surged with anger, venting it all on the hidden enemy.
To possess his dearest brother and still call him 'brother', unforgivable! Death was the only option!
"Pointless." The force behind the scenes frowned. Did he think that just by being angry he could defeat him? If so, that was too cheap.
He extended a finger, as large as the celestial stars, penetrating the Qilin Immortal, who vomited blood incessantly. Immortal Blood scattered across the starry sky, with each drop capable of creating a being at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
"Trace Origin."
"Immortal."
Lu Yang and Immortal Fairy both acted at the same time, endowing everyone with the dual status of Trace Origin and Immortal, allowing them to instantly recover from any injury.
Qilin Immortal's wounds healed, and once again, he lunged at the force behind the scenes, with a bloodthirsty maw opening wide and an overpowering stench of blood, annoying the hidden enemy.
He took out a piece of raw Immortal Gold material, forging it into an unparalleled Immortal Artifact. The chains rattled as they bound the Qilin Immortal, leaving him roaring in vain, unable to break free.
Immortal Jiuchong transformed into Yin and Yang Qi, while Time Immortal held the Sky Opening Axe, imbued with the power of time, besieging the hidden enemy.
Facing the siege of everyone, the force behind the scenes did not show any signs of defeat. As the sole being of the Transcendence Realm, without revealing the All-Knowing Harmonization, who could be his match.
He feared no one, always possessing the ability to turn the tables!
After several exchanges, Lu Yang noticed the hidden enemy's moves were quite peculiar, seeming to involve either the Heavenly Tribulation or Refining, with no other techniques in sight.
Almost at the same time, the force behind the scenes realized this issue. He had been imitating Yingtian Immortal for too long, even his moves were those commonly used by Yingtian Immortal.
"Indeed, what Gu Junye said was right. Possession is no different than being trapped in this shell, unable to extricate oneself."
"Since there's no possibility of going back to what was, then why should I continue pretending to be Yingtian Immortal! Let you all witness the power of the Transcendence Realm!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1353 - 1352: Bizarre Tactics
chapters.content:
After possessing Yingtian Immortal, the mastermind behind the scenes mimicked every move of Yingtian Immortal, including his mental activities. Sometimes, he even forgot his own real identity, thinking he was the true Yingtian Immortal and enjoying the time spent with everyone.
However, when he remembered Gu Junye's words, he realized there was a major problem with his mindset.
For someone of his level, his Mind State should have been polished to Consummation and immune to such issues. He immediately chastised himself, changed his mentality, and freed himself from his subconscious.
"If the Tribulation Dao Fruit and Heavenly Tribulation Dao Fruit alone are not enough to handle it..." The shadowy mastermind's eyes revealed a trace of ruthlessness; his methods were far from limited to that.
Thunderous rumbles rose within him, his Qi and Blood surged skyward, his Life Force was vibrantly unbelievable, and the vitality within everyone resonated faintly with the life essence of the shadowy mastermind.
The dissemination of Life Force spread across the Star River, and any planet engulfed by this Life Force began the evolutionary process of life, birthing living beings!
"Burning Star Sky."
At the same time, the shadowy mastermind released endless black flames, which were the long-extinct True Flames of Life.
The True Flames of Life used Life Force as kindling, consuming the starry sky.
In an instant, the battlefield was covered in True Flames of Life, and the newly spawned living beings on the planets were scorched by fire, turning into nothingness.
He expanded the True Flames of Life by burning his own Life Force, dominating the battlefield, and drying up everyone's Life Force!
The vitality of individuals like Qilin Immortal was ignited, burning painfully, almost unbearably so. Immortals are known for their limitless lifespan, but the True Flames of Life countered precisely that; the more Life Force one had, the fiercer the burning, and even if one could not be completely burned out, one would be painfully tormented to death!
"Yin Yang Chess Game, Annihilation of All Things!"
In the Universe appeared nine Illusory Shadows of Immortal Jiuchong, their eyes like two suns, holding Stars in his grasp, before him unfolded a chessboard interlaced with black and white, capable of bestowing Yin Yang Attributes on all things, then using the opposite attributes to annihilate them.
However, when Immortal Jiuchong tried to attribute the True Flames of Life with Yin Yang Attributes, he found that the True Flames of Life did not fall within the Yin Yang category and could not be forcibly assigned Yin Yang Attributes.
"How is this possible!" Immortal Jiuchong couldn't believe what he was seeing. His technique had never been mistaken before, much less with something like flames, which are obviously of the "Yang" attribute!
What kind of tactic was this!
The group of Immortals was in such agony from the True Flames of Life that they had no heart to be distracted with fighting.
Among all present, only Yun Zhi, Fairy Eternity, and Lu Yang were not burned by the True Flames of Life.
The moment the True Flames of Life appeared, Lu Yang instinctively wrapped his body with Three Flavored True Fire, and the True Flames of Life, upon encountering the Three Flavored True Fire, naturally veered away.
Seeing this, the shadowy mastermind's brows furrowed slightly, but he swiftly understood the reason.
"Huo Zheng's natal flame, the Three Flavored True Fire, what a nuisance."
Huo Zheng was a close friend of his from ancient times. The Three Flavored True Fire was a natal flame created by Huo Zheng, his favorite creation, and the True Flames of Life he was using were also a creation of Huo Zheng. It was impossible for the two to harm each other.
Lu Yang continuously cast the Three Flavored True Fire, enveloping everyone in it, staving off the damage from the True Flames of Life.
"Well done, Daoist Lu! Extreme Speed!" Time Immortal exclaimed in admiration, applying the Extreme Speed State to everyone, increasing their speed manifold!
The group of Immortals relied on Extreme Speed to besiege the shadowy mastermind, but in his eyes, they barely managed to keep up with his own speed.
"Ridiculous!"
The shadowy mastermind wielded an Ice Whip, sweeping across armies, flinging everyone away, causing them to vomit blood ceaselessly.
Without "Trace Origin" and "Immortal," just this one move would have cut them in half!
But a wound suddenly appeared on the shadowy mastermind's waist as if hurt by the Ice Whip.
"The price for stopping by for a meal here is really steep." Meng Junzi hissed in pain as he transferred his own injury to the shadowy mastermind. The cost was that after some time, the injury would return to him doubled, but at this stage of the fight, he didn't care about that; first, he wanted to add some more injuries to the shadowy mastermind.
Jiang Pingan was also nodding his head. The two of them treated it as if they were attending an ordinary victory feast. Who would have thought that halfway through the meal, an Immortal Battle would suddenly erupt, and their opponent was an ancient monster from an unknown era, absurdly powerful.
"Immortal Fist Technique." Immortal Fairy Eternity appeared on the left side of the hidden mastermind, the Immortal Fist Technique was extremely fierce, containing rolling killing intent. Each strike could extinguish the Star River and collapse space. Even during the long Ancient Times, Immortal Fairy Eternity had never fully executed this set of Fist Techniques.
Even in her battle with Yao Saint, Immortal Fairy Eternity had never fought as ferociously as now. The Immortal Fist Technique contained hidden Dark Strength, which could penetrate blood, bone, and flesh, with power erupting inside the body.
Every punch on Yao Saint's body was equivalent to a Small World's Self-Detonation.
This power is extremely difficult to resolve; the Immortal Fist Technique originated from the Hundred Herbs Fist Technique, which Immortal Fairy Eternity had developed after comprehending and assimilating a myriad of herbs, creating this Fist Technique. The Hundred Herbs Fist Technique consists of hundreds of herbs, and each herb represents a distinct Fist Technique.
That is to say, the Immortal Fist Technique simultaneously contained hundreds of types of power, making it extremely difficult to dissolve.
However, this was not a problem for the hidden mastermind; he had a way to dissolve the force.
Just as the hidden mastermind prepared to resolve this power, Yun Zhi appeared on the left side of the hidden mastermind and surprisingly also executed the Immortal Fist Technique!
Immortal Fairy Eternity was somewhat astonished seeing this scene; she had only taught Yun Zhi the Immortal Fist Technique once, and Yun Zhi had already mastered it.
The two needed no words or eye contact for communication; their minds were in sync, and they knew each other's next move, cooperating seamlessly.
At that moment, the two strongest beings were executing the same technique as if they were one person, not giving their opponent a moment to breathe, and even the hidden mastermind found it difficult to defend.
"The strongest of the past and present acting together, you really think highly of me." The hidden mastermind laughed, although at a disadvantage, he remained calm and composed.
He let out a light shout, activating some unknown Profound Skill. He had a Vajra Body, making his body unbreakably hard, and even internal changes made it countless times tougher than the Immortal Golden Body, impervious to any force!
"Immortal Fist Technique!" Immortal Fairy Eternity and Yun Zhi joined forces again, but this time it wasn't so simple.
The moment their fists touched the hidden mastermind, the power contained within not only failed to injure him but was completely returned to them!
Spurt—
It was as if they had each hit themselves with their own punches, but fortunately, they were both able to neutralize the force of their Fist Techniques, avoiding serious injury.
The entire Star River transformed into a Yin Yang Tai Chi Diagram, with Immortal Jiuchong and the hidden mastermind standing at the positions of the central points, an endless surge of Immortal Fire and Profound Ice attacking the hidden mastermind. However, upon touching him, all these attacks were sent back the same way they came, striking Immortal Jiuchong.
"Damn it, any attack that lands on him rebounds!" Time Immortal cursed, laying down his Sky Opening Axe. He had intended to strike the hidden mastermind from behind with an axe, but seeing the situation, it was out of the question.
An endless Swordmanship Domain spread out, far more powerful than during Crossing the Immortal Tribulation. Lu Yang wielding the Green Peak Sword, with myriad Sword Qi Illusory Shadows condensing and following his every movement. As the first Sword Immortal in history, every shadow of the sword was powerful enough to sever the Star River, its Immortal might unfathomable!
The Sword Shadows simultaneously struck the hidden mastermind, still rebounding; myriad Sword Shadows shattered, reflecting Lu Yang's unyielding expression.
"Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin!"
Nine Immortal Swords unified into one, the Star River boiled, more terrifying than even Immortal Jiuchong's Immortal Fire and Profound Ice, hard to imagine such a technique being cast by a newly ascended Immortal.
Yet this sword, when facing the hidden mastermind's Immaculate Golden Body, was still insufficient; its power fully rebounded, and Lu Yang firmly received his own blow, severely wounded and spitting blood.
The hidden mastermind only responded with a nonchalant smile, treating it as if an adult faced a three-year-old child wielding a wooden sword. What could possibly be the reaction?
Unexpectedly, a Sword Qi appeared behind Lu Yang, splitting him in two with a slash that didn't diminish in strength, hitting the hidden mastermind.
This time, there was no rebound of force!
"Success!" With the strike landing, Lu Yang swiftly retreated.
The Lu Yang that was sliced in half turned into two pieces of wood. The hidden mastermind focused on the two pieces of wood, and a magic skill rose to his mind.
"Dao seeds in the void, hard to distinguish real from fake, it's the Clone Technique created by the Firmament Tree."
In this era, it's called the Tree Planting Spell.

chapters.title: Chapter 1354 - 1353: Pain Point
chapters.content:
"Firmament Tree, you really are a persistent soul." The mastermind grimaced, having been tricked by his old friend's move once again. It wasn't the first time Firmament Tree had thrown obstacles in his path.
Firmament Tree was his good friend in the Ancient Era, and after death, gave birth to Time Immortal.
As Immortal Fairy was condensing the outline of the Annihilation Dao Fruit, the mastermind saw that her nature was akin to his own, foreseeing that she would ultimately walk the same path as he did.
Yet at that time, Time Immortal advised Immortal Fairy not to let hatred dictate her life. The Annihilation Dao Fruit was not the right path. It was then Immortal Fairy let go of her hatred, cut off from her past self, and instead concentrated on developing the Eternity Dao Fruit. Thus the world lost one who had transcended, and the mastermind lost a Daoist companion.
Time Immortal had no recollection of the events of the Ancient Era, but deep within, a faint voice was screaming, warning that Immortal Fairy had taken the wrong path.
"How come there was no rebound?" Immortal Jiuchong was astonished, only then realizing that the sword in Lu Yang's hand was not his usual Green Peak Sword.
"It is my Taishang Sword," said Jiang Pingan. His combat strength was limited, and he could not participate directly in the battle, so he could only assist others. The Taishang Sword was perfect for Lu Yang to wield.
Having broken through the mastermind's Immaculate Golden Body, Yun Zhi and Immortal Fairy joined forces once again to confront the enemy, with Qilin Immortal, Time Immortal, and Immortal Jiuchong skimming the formation at the side.
Lu Yang's brow furrowed slightly; he had only wanted to try it out and had not expected the Taishang Sword to be so effective. He sent a message to Jiang Pingan: "Does the effect of the Taishang Sword only cause Dao Fruit to become ineffective?"
"By rights, yes, at least when it struck Daoist Yun Zhi, nothing happened to her," Jiang Pingan replied.
Lu Yang pondered. So, the mastermind's fearlessness of any attack and his ability to reflect any attack was a method of Dao Fruit?
Immortal Fairy had never mentioned such a Dao Fruit which meant that from Ancient Times to the present, there had never been an Immortal with this type of Dao Fruit.
Does that mean that this Dao Fruit appeared during the Ancient Era?
Wasn't the path of Dao Fruit created by the Fairy? There were Dao Fruits in the Ancient Era?
"That's it. He once buried an era, and in that era, Dao Fruits had appeared!" This sentence was not a mere inner monologue but was deliberately spoken aloud by Lu Yang.
The art of attack lies not only in the physical but in striking the heart!
Lu Yang suspected that the mastermind, obsessed with posing as Yingtian Immortal, was connected to his experiences in the Ancient Era.
Sure enough, upon hearing these words, the mastermind became visibly agitated. In his pursuit of transcendence, he had sacrificed too much and was not willing to revisit his past. Lu Yang's words undoubtedly evoked a painful memory for him!
Taking advantage of the mastermind's distraction, Yun Zhi and Immortal Fairy seized the moment, forming the Supreme Fist Seal, unleashing cataclysmic, unbridled power to assault the mastermind, while the other Immortals did not dare to intervene, fearsome of being affected by the fallout.
They were the paragons of their respective eras. If not for individual misfortunes, they would have already achieved Harmonization and Omniscience. Now allied, they could slay foes from the past, present, and future!
In an instant, radiance stretched for billions of miles, obscuring all vision. Space shattered, countless Small Worlds were born, not out of intention but due to the overwhelming energy unleashed by their combined might, capable of shaping the world.
In a pinnacle battle, even the slightest error could shift the tide of combat!
The Star River collapsed, Small Worlds perished, and the mastermind's body trembled continuously, the force of the twin Fairy Fist Technique erupting within him, layer upon layer, innumerable.
"Ah!" The mastermind let out an enraged shout, using his powerful Life Force to forcibly suppress the force of the Fist Technique.
"Boom——"
There was a Self-Detonation once again, more terrifying than any explosion in history. This time, it was not just Immortal Fairy who detonated, but also Yun Zhi.
Having been granted the "Immortal" blessing by Immortal Fairy, Yun Zhi could swiftly recover her body.
""
The mastermind indeed possessed formidable strength, and though Yun Zhi felt that self-detonation was unbecoming, there was no room for such concerns when facing the mastermind. Every combat technique had to be employed.
"Cloud Falling Palm."
The Star Cluster Cloud appeared once again, transforming into a giant palm seal that encompassed myriad rules and magic skills, any single one of which would be enough for a Crossing Tribulation Cultivator to ponder for a lifetime.
Space was constrained, nailing the mastermind in place in this world. When the palm struck down, all the laws receded.
Seeing that they couldn't avoid it, the mastermind simply stopped trying to dodge. There was not the slightest hint of fear in facing the Cloud Falling Palm.
Boom——
The heavens shattered and the earth split, the laws of the Dao chimed sonorously, bursting forth with Infinite Tribulation Light. This palm was even more powerful than the one at the beginning of the battle. The Qilin Immortal felt a chill in his heart; even at his strongest, it would be very difficult to find a way to survive this palm—it was a palm that could extinguish an Immortal.
However, the mastermind walked out from the Cloud Falling Palm without a scratch.
Yun Zhi frowned; at the moment her palm struck, she felt that the moment the laws of the Dao and the Infinite Tribulation Light touched the mastermind, they completely vanished without a trace.
Was it the reappearance of that previous unblemished Vajra constitution?
No, that wasn't quite right.
Yun Zhi's eyes were cold, her gaze filled with an imposing intent to kill. Her killing intent boiled over, and no matter what tricks the mastermind had, this time she was determined to obliterate them right then and there!
Space trembled, stars resonated in unison. Those stars that had been destroyed during the battle miraculously reborn, stuck together, and returned to their intact form—it was Yun Zhi using her magic skills to restore them all.
"Manipulating creation, moving stars to change constellations."
The stars turned into flames, burning fiercely. Their positions were rearranged, forming the Nine-layered Supreme Killing Formation. Yun Zhi liked stargazing and also enjoyed using stars to set up her formations, but there simply hadn't been an opportunity in the Cultivation World.
The killing formation prison activated, enveloping the mastermind. The killing formation turned into a purgatory, evolving into Infinite Divine Powers. The elements of earth-fire-fengshui were like the creation of a world, dazzling and scorching to the eyes.
The mastermind's Qi and Blood boiled, and the surrounding space twisted. Creating a new world, spawning countless stars across the sky, and using thunder as a bond to link the stars, constructing a peerless Great Formation to counter the killing formation.
Boom! The clash of the two great formations caused them to shatter. Time distorted, and the whole world lost its luster at this moment.
The Immortal Fairy Eternity closed in for the kill. Her backdrop was filled with frequent extraordinary phenomena: myriad beasts roared in unison, all nations came to attend court, humans were born from jade, and nine luminaries galloped across the sky... These were not the deliberate doing of the Immortal Fairy Eternity but the result of a battle on such a scale that the collision of both sides brought forth countless creations.
Each extraordinary creation could give rise to a powerful being, but at that moment, no one cared about such chances for creation. What they sought was the life of their opponent!
"Is this all you've got, Daoist Yun Zhi? It's not enough!" The mastermind laughed arrogantly. Fighting against two without losing any ground, he had the capital to be arrogant. "I had intended to matchmake both Daoist friends with Little Lu, but since you are seeking death, you can't blame me for what happens next!"
The golden bell tinkled as it collided. Yun Zhi struck again, every move she made exuded elegance, unworldly, as if a Heavenly Maiden had descended to the mortal plane.
The attack seemed elegant, but once it landed on the mastermind, he quickly lost his ability to laugh.
Yun Zhi's next move was always stronger than the last, an unusual way of attacking that was certainly no spur-of-the-moment breakthrough, but a return to the peak! Reclaiming the power that truly belonged to her!
"You're Harmonizing?!"
"Since you are Transcendent, naturally I must Harmonize," responded Yun Zhi coldly. This was the first time she had gone all out since she reached the Harmonization Realm!

chapters.title: Chapter 1355 - 1354 Harmonization
chapters.content:
Cultivation World.
Qinghe and others stood on top of Heaven's Gate Peak Mountain, anxiously waiting for the outcome of this battle.
"What's the situation now!" Jiang Lianyi paced back and forth in anxiety, unable to calm down for even a moment.
Qinghe noticed that, unlike the others, Yun Mengmeng was staring blankly at the sky.
"Mengmeng, what are you looking at?"
Yun Mengmeng raised her hand and pointed at the night sky: "Looking at the stars."
"What stars?" Qinghe was puzzled, and followed her gaze upwards, her pupils suddenly constricting.
The stars in the night sky were growing dim and extinguishing one by one, no longer able to illuminate the Star Domain.
...
As the cosmos collapsed and all laws fell silent, the Law Path intertwined, turning into a sky full of starlight, almost as if it was the end of the world; even Immortals found it difficult to interfere in this battle.
Facing an increasingly powerful Yun Zhi, the hidden antagonist felt a sudden surge of pressure. The enhancement brought by nearing the Harmonization Realm was too terrifying; without even achieving Harmonization, she already had the capability to fight on equal footing, so what would it be like if she truly harmonized?!
Yun Zhi seemed to have become the embodiment of heaven and earth, with every action reflecting the will of the cosmos. The great trend of the world stood with Yun Zhi, as did her destiny, immensely terrifying.
"How is this possible!" The hidden antagonist revealed an expression of disbelief.
Omniscience, Transcendence, Harmonization, these are the three parallel Realms above that of Immortals. Yun Zhi should only be his match at the Harmonization Realm. How could she emanate such a terrifying aura while merely on the brink of Harmonization?!
"Because the path you've taken is wrong!" Fairy Eternity took advantage of his distraction and threw a punch, landing on the hidden antagonist's face.
"The Transcendence method you achieved is not the Righteous Path but just a shortcut!"
"The true way of Transcendence involves continually comprehending the Dao Fruit, dispelling the qi mechanism, becoming a carrier of the rules, separating heaven from humans, and thereby cutting off Causality!" Fairy Eternity declared, causing the hidden antagonist's heart to tremble.
As the creator of the Dao Fruit system, Fairy Eternity not only saw the method to achieve the All-Knowing Realm but also the path to the Law of Transcendence.
To achieve the Law of Transcendence, killing is not necessary. One simply needs to carefully refine the Dao Fruit; the Transcendence Realm will naturally come to fruition without resorting to a path of thorough extermination!
"Shut up!" The hidden antagonist shouted in anger. To achieve Transcendence, he had long been subjected to boundless slaughters, turning even his close friends of yesteryear into souls under his blade; this was something he least wanted to dredge up. Now, Fairy Eternity was claiming his method was mistaken, how could he bear it!
"You're overly eager to pursue Realms, acting too hastily, doomed not to succeed!" Fairy Eternity said again. She saw her own reflection in the hidden antagonist, blindly obsessed with attaining ultimate Realms, falling into an inferior state.
In contrast, when she cut off her past self and achieved the Immortal Fairy title, her Mind State was serene, enjoying the pleasures brought by cultivation, and she could see many more roads clearly ahead.
She hadn't mentioned these things in Ancient Times because she believed that cultivation was endless. Blindly pursuing Realms would make one a slave to those Realms, with a problematic Mind State, how could one speak of Transcendence.
Fairy Eternity saw that after the Yingtian Immortal and the four others became immortal, they didn't seem to want to continue cultivating, and speaking of it would only create pressure for them.
Her achievement of Omniscience was not a deliberate pursuit, but rather a natural result. She herself hadn't even thought that she would achieve Omniscience.
The battle between the three had turned into the purest collision of the Law Path, with the hidden antagonist vomiting blood. Immortal Blood exploded in the cosmos, turning into a cloud of chaotic mist, causing space to collapse wherever it passed, creating black holes.
"Pff—"
Yun Zhi and Fairy Eternity were also severely injured, blood trickling from the corners of their mouths.
Time Immortal opened his Heavenly Eye, as the fight has dragged on to this point, casting uncertainty within him; he desired to glimpse the future of this battle.
With the opening and closing of the Heavenly Eye, the future was an endless chaos, where neither the mechanisms of Heaven nor causality could be discerned—not to mention clarifying the outcome of this battle, even the events of the next moment were completely obscured!
"Is there something wrong with Daoist Yun Zhi's body?" Qilin Immortal, with the keenest sight, furrowed his brow and said.
The battlefield of the three had been enveloped in radiant light and utmost darkness, and they could only judge which side was gaining the upper hand through changes in momentum.
Qilin Immortal noticed the color of Yun Zhi's body was changing; it was fading, as if a freshly painted picture was submerged in the clear river water, with the pigments dissolving in the water.
"Indeed." Prompted by Qilin Immortal's observation, the others also noticed the abnormality in Yun Zhi.
They had never seen such a transformation; it was almost as though… she was merging with the universe!
Thump—Thump—
A strange sound appeared in everyone's ears, like the beating of a heart, but the sound was fleeting. They extended their Immortal Sense, capturing nothing.
Only Lu Yang knew clearly that this was the heartbeat of Eldest Senior Sister; by merging her body with Dao and substituting her heart for the heavens, Eldest Senior Sister was gradually becoming "Heaven" itself.
The situation on the battlefield changed in an instant, Yun Zhi's aura surged repeatedly, eventually completely overshadowing the presence of the mastermind behind the scenes. The entire universe became her home ground, and all beings in the universe could sense her aura.
Yun Zhi closed her eyes, her perception extending infinitely. She sensed the mastermind before her, sensed Yun Mengmeng who was sitting on the mountains of Heaven's Gate Peak Mountain hugging her knees and watching the stars, and sensed the corners of the universe's wild edges—places still unexplored by the Cultivation World, abundant with Life Stars, the movements of these beings all within Yun Zhi's perception.
She raised her hand and gently clenched it into a fist; at this moment, she was the universe itself, manipulating the natural forces between heaven and earth at a mere thought. The stars transformed into a furnace, igniting the primordial fire of heaven and earth to refine the mastermind behind the scenes.
The mastermind behind the scenes bellowed, the star furnace exploded, the primordial fire of heaven and earth was extinguished. He possessed the Five Elements Dao Fruit; even the primordial fire of heaven and earth was within the range of the Five Elements, failing to hinder him!
As for the myriad stars, belonging to Earth Element and Gold Element, they were also within the scope of the Five Elements Dao Fruit!
In the next moment, Yun Zhi's aura disappeared, her body became even more transparent, like an ethereal and clear water figure.
If one looked with Immortal Sense, they could not feel Yun Zhi's existence at all!
The mastermind behind the scenes developed a sense of chilling dread, as if what he was facing was not a person, but the supreme Heaven, while he was a rebellious being daring to be the enemy of Heaven!
In the end, even the water figure vanished, leaving only a shadowy silhouette.
The silhouette's expression was unclear, yet it conveyed an extremely terrifying sense of indifference.
"Yun Luo."
The silhouette spoke, its voice even colder than Yun Zhi's usual tone, as a hand forged from the Law Path descended upon the mastermind behind the scenes. The mastermind spat out a great mouthful of blood, his face revealing an expression of disbelief, receiving the most grievous wound ever since the battle had begun!
His life force was terrifyingly vigorous, recovering in the blink of an eye as if he had not been injured at all.
He stared intently at the silhouette, his expression grave, certain now that Yun Zhi truly had attained Harmonization.
The gap between Harmonization and Transcendence should not be so vast. Could it be that he had really taken the wrong path?
…
"Ah, Xiao Zhi's star has gone out." Yun Mengmeng pointed to the last dimming star in the starry sky.
"Who is Xiao Zhi?" Qinghe, who was sitting by her side, asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1356 - 1355: Both of you stop talking!
chapters.content:
Yun Zhi's presence is rapidly vanishing. Those who merely heard of her name were first to lose their memory of her, followed by those who were less closely related, and finally, those irreplaceable in Yun Zhi's memory.
The first two types of people have completely forgotten Yun Zhi's existence; even the proof that she ever existed is disappearing, as natural forces are erasing the evidence and correcting the world.
Only the last type of people still remembers Yun Zhi's existence.
In exchange, Yun Zhi has gained a power the likes of which has never before been seen in the world.
At this moment, she is the very essence of heaven and earth, defeating the once-unbeatable mastermind behind the scenes with a single move!
The participating Immortal Gods are dazed, having already forgotten who it is that battles the mastermind.
Lu Yang clutches his head, relentlessly recalling his past with Eldest Senior Sister. Indeed, she has achieved Unification, yet true Unification isn't like this.
According to Eldest Senior Sister, the true state of Unification means becoming an impartial heaven and earth, where all beings are equal in her eyes, showing favor to none, and all her past will disappear from the world.
A person truly Unified would not fight against the mastermind, for that is not the act of an impartial Heaven!
Eldest Senior Sister can still battle the mastermind because she has only just achieved Unification, her Realm not yet stable, too entangled with the mortal world.
When she cuts all ties and vanishes from everyone's memory, that is when the Harmonization Realm is stable.
Fairy Eternity has also withdrawn from the battle, standing next to Lu Yang, recalling past events about Miss Yun together, trying to keep Yun Zhi in this state for as long as possible.
Moreover, she is no longer needed in the current battle, as Yun Zhi alone is sufficient.
The silhouette that Yun Zhi left in the world possesses boundless Dao, where the cycle of life and death is ongoing. Merging her Dao with the Immortal Fist Technique, she forms a new Fist Technique, intending to grind away at the mastermind, who is losing ground. Despite being severely injured, his Life Force is so strong that he rapidly recovers.
Lu Yang notices something is amiss, his brow furrowed as he continually recalls the tactics used by the mastermind throughout the battle, almost as if possessing multiple Dao Fruits. How did he do it?
"Miss Yun, kill him!" shouts Immortal Fairy, her voice so loud she wished the entire Universe could hear.
"As long as you can kill him, I'll never bring up the Mother-child River again!"
The silhouette slightly wavers, as if affected by these words.
Seeing a response, Immortal Fairy continues loudly: "I'll keep the secret that your Clone is the Puppet of Sky Gate Mountain too!"
"But you must keep my secrets, after all, The Controller even gave you hush money!"
"Senior Immortal Fairy, please stop talking!" the silhouette says, no longer as calm and indifferent as before, now with a trace of emotional fluctuation. She even thinks it might be nice just to remain Unified right now.
Seeing this, Immortal Fairy promptly pokes Lu Yang, who is engrossed in recalling every cherished moment with Eldest Senior Sister.
"This approach works, Little Yang, you say something too."
"Ah, what, what should I say?" Lu Yang is startled, as this wasn't part of the plan.
"Anything."
Caught off guard by Immortal Fairy, but also having to admit that this method is effective in prolonging Eldest Senior Sister's unstable state, Lu Yang grits his teeth and speaks.
"Eldest Senior Sister, when I first started Cultivation, you used boiling water for my bath, nearly scalding me to death!"
"Eldest Senior Sister, now that you're so powerful, once I become immortal, I'll stop Cultivating, and I'll depend on you to take care of me for the rest of my life!"
"Eldest Senior Sister, you're actually very lively on the inside, it's just not visible from the outside, right?"
"Eldest Senior Sister, you're very beautiful, the most beautiful person I've ever seen. When you smile, you're even more beautiful. You should smile more often!"
"Neither of you speak anymore!"
The shadowy figure's emotions fluctuated more and more violently, her attacks becoming extremely fierce, as if she was treating the manipulator behind the scenes as a composite of Immortal Fairy and Lu Yang, striking to kill with every move.
"It's not that I, as Heaven itself, am irrational, these aren't the words I have been shouting!" the manipulator behind the scenes pleaded his innocence. Isn't Heaven supposed to be just? Why was all the fury being vented on him?
Yun Zhi didn't care about that, summoning the power of heaven and earth, evolving endless runes, transforming into all kinds of Immortal Weapons and marching towards the manipulator behind the scenes.
The manipulator behind the scenes summoned Heavenly Thunder and Earth Fire, evolving ancient and ancient beings, and with the touch of Immortal Blood, clashed with the Immortal Weapons. Above him, a dark vortex spanned, devouring all attacks.
However, Yun Zhi's offensive was exceedingly fierce, the ancient beings quickly weakened, no match for the Immortal Weapons, and there were too many attacks for him to devour.
Lu Yang, seeing this familiar scene, finally realized why the manipulator behind the scenes could use so many Dao Fruits!
"He possesses the ability to Devour Dao Fruit!" Lu Yang loudly exclaimed, revealing the Lifebound Dao Fruit of the manipulator behind the scenes.
The manipulator behind the scenes had the same Devouring Dao Fruit as the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord, which explained everything.
The Mid-heaven Emperor Lord wanted to use the Devouring Dao Fruit to devour the Dao Fruits of the Four Ancient Immortals to gain the power to unlock the seal of the Cultivation World, but this was only his imagination, he never succeeded.
The manipulator behind the scenes was even more powerful, having devoured not just one kind of Dao Fruit in ancient times!
Dao Fruits have uniqueness, which implies that once the manipulator behind the scenes had solidified a Devouring Dao Fruit, the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord should not have been able to consolidate it.
But the issue is that the manipulator behind the scenes is not an Immortal, but of the Transcendence Realm.
Being Transcendent himself, along with the Devouring Dao Fruit, all the Dao Fruits that it had devoured transcended as well, not affecting those who would cultivate them later.
Otherwise, the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord trying to solidify a Devouring Dao Fruit, would have found a suppression from an existing Dao Fruit, and guessed that someone had already obtained the Devouring Dao Fruit, which is not in line with the concept of Transcendence.
Upon these words, the figure of the manipulator behind the scenes shook, and his aura actually began to destabilize!
Lu Yang's discovery undoubtedly exposed part of his foundation, the manipulator behind the scenes wanted to kill Lu Yang, but now he had trouble even defending himself, let alone executing Lu Yang!
However, the manipulator behind the scenes quickly felt joy in his heart, noticing an opportunity for victory, as Yun Zhi's movements became more hesitant, and her attack momentum weakened against him.
The memories of Lu Yang and Immortal Fairy about Yun Zhi were rapidly fading, soon they would forget Yun Zhi's existence!
"Daoist Yun Zhi, your Realm is finally starting to stabilize, isn't it?"
As Heaven itself, how could she attack the people under heaven? Thus, when the manipulator behind the scenes learned that Yun Zhi was Harmonizing with Heaven, he was only surprised, not in despair.
Lu Yang was also waiting for this moment!
He stepped forward boldly, drawing the Green Peak Sword, unleashing the 'Ten Thousand Swords Returning to Origin', as a majestic Sword Qi suppressed heaven and earth, and he struck toward Yun Zhi's direction with a sword strike.
"Trace Origin!"
Sword Qi spanned millions of miles, passing over the shadowy figure without causing any harm.
The shadowy figure gradually took form, becoming a spiritual water being, reconstructing bone and blood.
Within the rules of heaven and earth, the 'Trace Origin' Rule vibrated, pulling Yun Zhi back from the state of Harmonization.
Yun Zhi looked at the shocked manipulator behind the scenes, still with her indifferent demeanor, as if the Harmonization had nothing to do with her.
"Let's continue."

chapters.title: Chapter 1357 - 1356: Miscalculation
chapters.content:
The moment Yun Zhi was transformed from the heavens to human, the stars in the sky of the Cultivation World lit up one after another. The lost memories and the altered reality were also restored simultaneously. Those who knew Yun Zhi didn't realize that they had once forgotten her existence—it was as if nothing had ever happened.
Immortal Jiuchong and others also regained their memories, showing looks of shock. The sensation just now was too mystical; Yun Zhi was right before their eyes, yet the memories about her were forcefully erased without them noticing anything.
Is this the terrifying aspect of Harmonization?
Lu Yang's chest heaved from exhaustion, and he was gasping for breath. The move he had just made was not simple; his Essence, Qi, and Spirit had never been so intensely focused, and the consumption was extremely high.
But fortunately, the plan was successful, and he had pulled Eldest Senior Sister back from her Harmonized state.
Lu Yang's gathering of the Trace Origin Dao Fruit was for this very moment—to convene everyone under the prestige of the victory feast, to tear off the veil of the mastermind behind the scenes, to rely on Eldest Senior Sister's Harmonized state to kill the mastermind, and then to use the Trace Origin Dao Fruit to make Eldest Senior Sister fall from her state. Everything was proceeding according to plan.
Upon their next engagement, the mastermind behind the scenes discovered that Yun Zhi had become even stronger than before her Harmonization.
A long time ago, Yun Zhi had once undergone Harmonization, and she quickly left that state when she realized it wasn't the realm she desired. This time, with Lu Yang's help by her side, she could fight freely, no longer having to deliberately suppress herself. From Half-step Harmonization to full Harmonization, she truly experienced the profound mysteries of the Harmonization Realm.
Although she had fallen from the Harmonization Realm, she still retained some insights and the mysteries of that realm, making her use of the forces of heaven and earth even more adept and effortless.
The shadowy mastermind's body burst forth with blood blossoms, covered in wounds. He used his blood to cast spells, bringing forth crimson heavenly thunder, like Heaven bleeding.
He possessed both the Tribulation Dao Fruit and the Heavenly Tribulation Dao Fruit. Essentially, these two Dao Fruits were the same, with only their age and the nomenclature by their namers varying.
But both Dao Fruits were his, and on the path of the Thunder Law Heavenly Tribulation, he had left everyone else far behind!
He transformed into a body of lightning, merging with the heavens' thunder, omnipresent.
Lightning tore through the void, erupting with a terrifying presence, causing Qilin Immortal and others to recoil in shock, retreating far from the battlefield.
The battlefield boiled over, exploding into a bloodbath, collapsing even the spatial concepts of this star system, without any constraints of distance.
Yun Zhi's technique seemed tender, but it was domineering over heaven and earth, unmatched by anyone. Immortal Gold Immortal Devices were like paper mâché in the face of such technique, utterly useless in defense, a single palm strike was enough to doom an Immortal.
Thunderous Heavenly Tribulation spread across the world, dyed scarlet, filled with a terrifying atmosphere. The shadowy mastermind leaped through the lightning, now hidden, now visible.
Suddenly he appeared behind Yun Zhi, attempting a sneak attack, with the Five Elements Origin circulating in his palm, condensing into a Five Elements Soul-breaking Nail.
Yun Zhi, as though sensing something, dominated the nearby hundreds of star systems—her home ground. Every move of the shadowy mastermind was within her perceptual range.
She twisted her body, bathed in golden rosy light, unlike a mortal, and struck sideways at the Five Elements Soul-breaking Nail.
The Soul-breaking Nail shattered, and the shadowy mastermind, his attack failing, hid within the Heavenly Tribulation.
Yun Zhi brought her palms together, warping and distorting the space of this world. No matter where the shadowy mastermind hid, he could not escape this world, no Heavenly Tribulation could shield him!
"This is no longer Harmonization; it's beyond Harmonization," the Time Immortal sighed. Possibly throughout history, there has never been an existence as powerful as Yun Zhi, whose Cultivation path has reached its end.
The shadowy mastermind possessed Dao Fruits that rapidly healed and provided immense Life Force, but aside from the Eternity Dao Fruit, no type of Dao Fruit could withstand Yun Zhi's fierce attacks, and they all had moments of withering and weakening, unable to sustain her assault.
He was already showing signs of physical depletion, and one must know that even though he did not reach the Transcendence Realm through foul means, he was still in the Transcendence Realm, on a different level of life.
To imagine such a realm experiencing exhaustion was unimaginable.
If this continued, his situation would become very dire.
Suddenly, the shadowy mastermind discovered that Yun Zhi's offensive seemed to weaken. No, it wasn't weakening, but a hint of hesitation appeared in her method of attack, not as fluid as before.
The memories and affairs associated with Yun Zhi in the world are disappearing rapidly.
A subtle expression of being emotionally moved appeared on Yun Zhi's indifferent face; she felt that something was terribly wrong with her state, for she was about to undergo Harmonization with Heaven again.
"Eldest Senior Sister is attempting Harmonization once more!" A foreboding premonition surged in Lu Yang's heart. This was something that occurred only during Harmonization, yet Eldest Senior Sister was still at Half-step Harmonization and had not truly harmonized. So why was this happening?
Could it be that Eldest Senior Sister's two experiences with Harmonization have made it increasingly easier for her to enter that state?!
Lu Yang knew that things could not continue this way. Once again, he took action, merging his Essence, Qi, and Spirit as one, and wielded the Trace Origin Dao Fruit to unleash a resplendent sword strike.
But this time, the effect was minimal; the evidence of Yun Zhi's existence was still vanishing!
"What!" Lu Yang was shocked, as the ominous premonition in his heart became a reality; the situation with Eldest Senior Sister had spiraled out of control.
He felt Eldest Senior Sister gradually being drawn towards the Harmonization Realm. The Trace Origin rules represented by the Trace Origin Dao Fruit were pulling at her vigorously, but the force from the Harmonization Realm was too great and beyond the capability of his strength to contend with!
"Just as I expected!" The mastermind behind the scenes laughed uncontrollably; despite being severely injured, he had finally waited for this moment.
"I knew such a method couldn't work forever!"
A mere Dao Fruit was able to pull Yun Zhi down from Harmonization once—that could be attributed to Lu Yang's ability, but after all, there is an entire realm's difference. How could it be possible to continuously affect Harmonization? It is simply too presumptuous to not take Heaven into account.
Lu Yang was so anxious that he was sweating profusely. He realized there had been a flaw in his plan, and by thinking too simplistically, he had inadvertently pushed Eldest Senior Sister into the fire pit.
Initially, Yun Zhi was somewhat flustered, but now her heart was as calm as still water. This wasn't because she had thought of a solution, but rather, she was becoming ever closer to the state of "Heaven" and as "Heaven," one's Mind State would not ripple with disturbance.
"This is bad!" Those Immortals like Jiuchong who thought victory was within reach felt their hearts sink to the bottom, noticing that memories about Yun Zhi were disappearing, helplessly.
"What should we do, reverse time?" The Time Immortal anxiously suggested.
"It's no use," the Qilin Immortal shook his head. "Daoist Yun Zhi has too deep an understanding of Harmonization; even if time were reversed, she would still automatically enter the Harmonized state."
Seeing the dawn of victory, the mastermind behind the scenes couldn't help but rejoice. Once Yun Zhi entered Harmonization, she wouldn't attack him. And facing him were only the Immortal Fairy who hadn't reached the All-Knowing Realm and the other Immortals—they were no match for him!
Countless Eternal Laws converged around Immortal Fairy, gathering at the tip of her index finger, pointing at Yun Zhi.
"Stasis Unchanging!"
Yun Zhi, who was gradually approaching Harmonization, miraculously stopped in her tracks. All changes related to Yun Zhi also ceased simultaneously.
Yun Zhi rarely showed a look of astonishment.
"Phew, it worked." Immortal Fairy wiped the sweat from her forehead. Stasis Unchanging was easy to apply to others, but it was challenging to use on Yun Zhi.
This maneuver had been used on Zuo Shi Immortal, who sought to defy fate. The Eternity Dao Fruit not only allowed Immortal Fairy to maintain her current state but also enabled Yun Zhi to remain in hers.
Of course, her power alone wasn't enough; it had to be combined with Lu Yang's Trace Origin Dao Fruit. Only with the simultaneous exertion of both Dao Fruits could they stabilize Yun Zhi's realm.
"I told you I had a way," Immortal Fairy said with a chuckle toward Yun Zhi, seeking recognition for her achievement.
Hope dashed, the mastermind behind the scenes had bloodshot eyes and his murderous intent soared.
"Immortal Fairy!!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1358 - 1357: Timeline Alteration
chapters.content:
Above the sky of the Cultivation World, a star stood out exceedingly, with surrounding stars extinguishing one by one, yet only that star continued to hang in the night sky, dazzling and never fading.
Yun Mengmeng gazed dumbly at that star, feeling an inexplicable joy, and she burst into laughter.
Qinghe, Ao Ling, and others were at a loss; they were all anxiously awaiting the outcome of the battle. Why had Yun Mengmeng suddenly laughed? Did she sense something?
Boom——
As Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity exerted their force at the same time, Yun Zhi was finally able to attack unabashedly, not fearing the ascent into the Harmonization Realm.
After Lu Yang had exposed the Lifebound Dao Fruit, although it did not cause the mastermind behind the scenes to fall in Realm, it did have some impact, which made him unstable and at a disadvantage in his fight with Yun Zhi.
The murderous intent of the mastermind towards Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity soared, finding their faces detestable, wishing to tear them into ten thousand pieces.
With the universe at his back, Yun Zhi had access to boundless power. He simply could not sustain this kind of consumption. At this rate, death was certain for him.
The shadowy mastermind moved, traversing ten thousand miles, seeking to flee the battlefield.
However, for Yun Zhi, who had partial control over heaven and earth, this was nothing but wishful thinking.
Yun Zhi could even sense the position of the mastermind as he passed through to another space, almost at the exact same time reaching the other end of space.
Their battle had long since transcended the concept of space; the vast universe was their battlefield.
In an instant, numerous civilizations observed this battle, but they could not comprehend its scale. They thought the universe was collapsing, the disaster of world destruction, and wails filled the air.
The mastermind was beaten to a pulp, his injuries healing noticeably slower than before.
