He set his sights on the Qilin Immortal, thinking that if he could Devour the Survival of the Fittest Dao Fruit of the Qilin Immortal, there might still be a sliver of hope for survival.
The next moment, he appeared behind the Qilin Immortal. Yun Zhi noticed his action and, just as he was about to open the Devouring Swirl, Yun Zhi crushed it with a palm strike.
It was then that the group of Immortals noticed the combatants had come to their location.
The residual effects of the battle pushed everyone to an extremely distant position. Since Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity were fully occupied with pulling Yun Zhi and could not attend to the others, those who were injured could only heal themselves by their own means.
"That's right, Miss Yun, kill him!" Fairy Eternity was jumping lively; if she hadn't been channeling the Eternity Dao Fruit, she would have gone up to lend a hand herself.
The mastermind was wicked to the core; now, all matters traced back to the Ancient Times when he had secretly attempted to assassinate Fairy Eternity herself.
If the mastermind had not made his move, none of these things would have followed, and the Fire Dynasty would not have fallen.
The more miserably the mastermind was beaten, the happier Fairy Eternity was.
"Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth!" Facing the overpowering and invincible Yun Zhi, the mastermind activated the Devouring Dao Fruit, unveiling endless dark radiance.
This was the true Dao Fruit realized by the mastermind, having devoured six Dao Fruits, turning the Devouring Dao Fruit into something exceedingly dreadful. When compared to the Devouring Dao Fruit of the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord, who hadn't even consumed a single Dao Fruit, the former was merely an infant at the beginning of the path.
Yet Yun Zhi was like the Heaven and Earth Master, her position the center of the universe. The once proud Devouring Dao Fruit seemed unable to affect Yun Zhi.
The mastermind's form flickered, and dark lights congealed into vague figures, six in total, all formidable beings from Ancient Times who had dominated countless years and were also his friends.
These vague figures possessed their respective Dao Fruits, set up their ranks, besieged Yun Zhi, with an exceedingly terrifying aura, stronger than when they were alive.
The seven formed an unmatched Great Formation, splitting open the void, spinning Creation, and supporting a realm of a Small World, with the power to deceive the heavens, outside of the universe represented by Yun Zhi.
Yun Zhi stood at the pinnacle of the heavens, beneath her feet lay galaxies unfathomable, displaying supreme elegance as she shattered the small world realm of the mastermind behind the scenes, and the six black figures of light returned into the mastermind's body.
The mastermind was beaten to a bloody pulp, completely unrecognizable as a human being.
His pupils bloodshot, he couldn't just sit there and wait for death; he wanted to make a desperate fight: "Firmament Tree, your legacy has brought me so much trouble, now let me use your Dao Fruit!"
The Devouring Dao Fruit is not almighty and cannot guarantee proficiency in whatever is devoured.
After devouring, one can only assure the most basic usage—proficiency requires insight, like with the Heavenly Tribulation Dao Fruit or the Five Elements Dao Fruit, which are simple to start with and can be mastered with time.
But when it comes to time-related Dao Fruits, it heavily relies on talent, and even an abundance of time yields meager results.
And he had little talent for the time path, every use of the Time Line Dao Fruit took a great effort, and the time he could alter was limited, only able to modify events within a hundred years.
Utilizing the Time Line Dao Fruit required preparation; otherwise, only very minor changes could be made. Lu Yang's sudden move gave him no chance to react.
The current problem was exactly how to alter the timeline—to carefully consider which point in time to modify to change the course of the battle...
Before he could pinpoint the crucial moment, he was struck a heavy blow.
Bang—
Distracted, he was seized by Yun Zhi, who landed a blow that made him vomit blood profusely, his meridians were completely severed, he screamed in agony, blood oozing from his seven orifices, his vision blurred.
Damn it, no more thinking, a quick decision must be made!
With severe injuries, his time was running out.
The mastermind's gaze fell upon Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity; recalling this battle, if any one of the two had vanished, Yun Zhi would have achieved Harmonization long ago, and he wouldn't be in such a miserable state.
Thinking this, the mastermind revealed an epiphany-like smile.
Alteration was more than appropriate!
...
"Who would have thought, the mission Eternity Sect gave us was to infiltrate Seek Dao Sect."
On the way back from Yanjiang County, Lu Yang, Meng Jingzhou, and Man Gu were chatting and laughing; this mission was too simple for them.
"This Immortal Eternity is also quite formidable, able to resurrect just by calling the correct name, but who knows what his real name is."
"Everyone restrain a bit, what if we actually guess Immortal Eternity's name?" Lu Yang warned, it was still uncertain whether Immortal Eternity was friend or foe and Eternity Sect's claim of Immortal Eternity protecting the Human race was unilateral, not entirely reliable.
"How about this, from now on we refer to 'Immortal Eternity' as 'Fairy Eternity', so even if we say the right name, Immortal Eternity won't be resurrected." Lu Yang suggested proactively, and the other two agreed.
Old Ma drove the cart for a while and then stopped by the side of the road, the three got out to rest and continued discussing Fairy Eternity.
"I wonder why there is no record of Fairy Eternity's name in history."
"It could be because the name sounded unpleasant," analyzed Meng Jingzhou, "Think about it, during the Ancient Times, everyone had awe-inspiring titles and names. Before a battle, they'd declare their names to each other, and if Fairy Eternity started with 'I am Fairy Eternity, Li Dog Egg,' it'd be a loss of half the morale before the fight even began!"
"Fairy Eternity would surely erase such a shameful past!"
Lu Yang added with a laugh: "It could also be that the name was too cute, lacking deterrence, like 'Fairy Eternity Li Doudou' or something."

chapters.title: Chapter 1359 - 1358: What Happened in This Timeline?!
chapters.content:
After successfully modifying the past time node, the hidden mastermind's consciousness jumped to a new timeline.
Since the mastermind couldn't adeptly master the Time Line Dao Fruit, the version of him in this timeline was unaware that a timeline jump had already occurred.
It wasn't until time developed to a moment in sync with the progress of the old timeline that he acquired the memories from it, and the old timeline's memories took precedence, with the merging of old and new timeline memories requiring some time.
Upon arriving at the new timeline, the mastermind discovered that he was still battling Yun Zhi amongst the stars.
Was the Immortal Fairy present or not?
The mastermind quickly surveyed the scene, only to find the newly immortal Lu Yang and the dual immortals of Great Xia; there were no Four Ancient Immortals, no Fairy Eternity!
To be on the safe side, he even peeked into Lu Yang's Spiritual Space and found no sign of Fairy Eternity!
The mastermind was secretly delighted.
Success! He had finally arrived at a timeline where Fairy Eternity did not exist!
However, Lu Yang was really quite talented. Could it be that, even without Fairy Eternity's guidance, he still managed to become immortal?
Of course, even without Fairy Eternity, there was Yun Zhi's guidance; it would be difficult not to become immortal.
Yun Zhi keenly noticed that the mastermind's expression became dazed for a moment, as if he were delighted?
Yun Zhi was puzzled but wouldn't let go of this opportunity and boldly made a move, seriously injuring the mastermind.
"Cloud Falling Palm!"
"This power..." Having been hit by Cloud Falling Palm, the mastermind judged from its might that the battle had just begun and Yun Zhi was fighting with all her strength, gradually progressing towards Harmonization.
Not worthy of concern.
As the mastermind who had traversed from the old timeline, he had already seen the outcome of this battle; as long as he could delay until Yun Zhi reached Harmonization, no one in this world would be his rival.
Facing Yun Zhi's strong offensive, the mastermind nostalgically recalled the Vajra Dao Fruit, which could not only withstand all attacks but also reflect them back, truly an unsolvable force.
Unfortunately, in the old timeline, it had been countered by Lu Yang with the Taishang Sword.
The mastermind attempted to activate the Vajra Dao Fruit, and as expected, in this timeline, it was also countered by Lu Yang's Taishang Sword.
Lu Yang, watching the battle from below, frowned, feeling that something unknown had changed in the mastermind, who seemed a bit different from the person at the beginning of the battle.
Lu Yang's head throbbed painfully, tightening; a hazy silhouette of a woman appeared before his eyes, wearing a goose-yellow dress; familiar yet strange, never seen before. Such visions had occurred before he became immortal, and after becoming immortal, they became more frequent and intense.
"What have I forgotten?"
He felt a hollow in his heart, as if he had lost something very important.
Yun Zhi had checked on Lu Yang many times but could not find the cause, and had been worried for a long time.
However, this condition did not affect his Cultivation, and Lu Yang followed the steps to condense the Dao Fruit and cultivate to immortality.
The stars of the Cultivation World trembled, extinguishing one after another.
When the last star extinguished, Yun Zhi's figure dimmed and vanished, transformed into the cosmos, leaving only a shadow in her place, continuing the battle against the mastermind.
Even seeing this scene again, the mastermind still felt moved; such power to become the cosmos and suppress all Dao was indeed too strong. There would be no one from past to present who could rival Yun Zhi, himself included.
It's just a pity that this state wouldn't last for long.
Boom——
Taking advantage of the instability in her realm, Yun Zhi controlled the myriad laws of the Dao to suppress the mastermind.
Unfortunately, the mastermind was not so easily suppressed; his life force was tenacious, and even if shattered to pieces and his Divine Soul dissipated, he could still recover.
"Heh heh, Daoist Yun Zhi, is this the extent of your ability?" The manipulator behind the scenes laughed while spitting out blood, leading those unaware to think he was gaining the upper hand.
Yun Zhi had a strange feeling, as if she was very familiar with the Harmonization Realm; it felt like something she had experienced before.
At this moment, Lu Yang had no time to care about the faintly discernible figure in his mind; memories of the Eldest Senior Sister were quickly fading, a sign that the realm was about to stabilize!
Lu Yang decisively made his move; three thousand paths of Swordsmanship revolved around the Green Peak Sword, interweaving into an unattainable pinnacle for any Sword Cultivator.
"Future Sword Cultivators will probably find it hard to reach Little Friend Lu's achievements," Jiang Pingan sighed. Any Sword Cultivator who witnessed this scene would feel despair; this was an unsurpassable sword strike.
"Not to mention Sword Cultivators, even future Immortals might not measure up to his heights," Meng Junzi exclaimed in admiration, remembering Lu Yang's actions and cultivation experiences, couldn't help but praise him as a rare genius comparable to Yun Zhi, and there wouldn't be a second one.
"Trace Origin!"
Heavenly chains of the great Dao vibrated intensely, pulling Yun Zhi down from the Harmonization Realm.
"It worked!"
Lu Yang was overjoyed; heedless of Eldest Senior Sister's obstruction, he condensed the Trace Origin Dao Fruit just to stop Eldest Senior Sister from becoming Heaven.
He had not tested this before, and right after becoming Immortal, a battle broke out suddenly. Lu Yang was somewhat nervous about whether the Trace Origin Dao Fruit would be effective on Eldest Senior Sister, but to his surprise, the result was extraordinarily good.
Although her realm had dropped, Yun Zhi remained formidable, carrying the enlightenment and the profoundness of the Harmonization Realm as she once again attacked the hidden foe.
The manipulator behind the scenes was being beaten back, but still laughed, it should be just like this, it must be like this.
"Just a small trick. Do you think you can succeed a second time with the Trace Origin Dao Fruit?" The manipulator laughed through spitting blood, and his words gave rise to an ominous premonition in Lu Yang.
After the fall of her realm, the Eldest Senior Sister lost control and merged once again, leading to the loss of memories.
Seeing this, Lu Yang repeated his old tactic and once again executed the Trace Origin Sword Skill: "Trace Origin!"
As the man behind the scenes had said, the Trace Origin Dao Fruit was useless; the pulling force of the Harmonization Realm was too strong, and the Trace Origin Dao Fruit alone could not prevent the Eldest Senior Sister from merging!
"Damn, I oversimplified things!" Lu Yang reproached himself severely, and tears welled up in his eyes at the thought of Eldest Senior Sister soon becoming an unfeeling Heaven.
He was too arrogant, thinking that relying on the Trace Origin Dao Fruit would make everything alright, but reality harshly slapped him in the face.
"Is this path not viable?" Yun Zhi's eyes dimmed; her Junior Brother was trying hard to help her, but this kind of thing couldn't be resolved just by making an effort.
Yun Zhi steeled her heart; if she couldn't prevent the Harmonization, then she would kill the man with murderous intent towards her Junior Brother before the merging!
Yun Zhi's offensive grew even more ferocious as if gambling with her own life, the manipulator behind the scenes had never seen such a heavy killing intent from Yun Zhi.
"Daoist Yun Zhi, accept reality. So what if you have a heavy killing intent, before the Harmonization, you cannot solve me!" The man behind the scenes taunted mercilessly.
Lu Yang slapped himself fiercely twice, blood flowing without end, forcing himself to calm down.
There must be a way, there must be!
Got it, perhaps this method might work.
"Eldest Senior Sister, I have a way now!" Lu Yang shouted loudly, regardless of whether the method would work or not, shouting it out first to boost confidence.
Lu Yang took a step forward, and the world trembled; he frantically stimulated his second Dao Fruit—the Eternity Dao Fruit.
Countless rules representing eternity and immortality surrounded the tip of Lu Yang's sword, converging into a brand-new technique.
"Immutable Constancy!"
The Trace Origin Dao Fruit and the Eternity Dao Fruit exerted their power simultaneously, and the two great forces combined into one. They actually contended with the heavens and the earth, forcibly nailing Yun Zhi's realm in place, preventing her from moving forward even half a step!
The manipulator behind the scenes: "!!!"
What on earth happened on this timeline!?

chapters.title: Chapter 1360 - 1359: The Overlooked Talent of Lu Yang
chapters.content:
Upon seeing Lu Yang possess the Eternity Dao Fruit, the manipulator behind the scenes felt as if his head had been severely hammered by the Yellow Bell, casting his mind into chaos.
Suddenly, he realized a problem: on this new timeline, why did he end up fighting Yun Zhi?
On this timeline, there was no Fairy Eternity, and there were utterly no conflicts between him and Yun Zhi, so why did Yun Zhi treat him as if he were a mortal enemy?
What exactly had happened on this timeline?!
...
After obliterating the Eternity Sect, Yun Zhi captured the Immortal Eternity Sha Meless, discovering that he possessed the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit.
Yun Zhi saw that the potential of the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit was immense and, if one could condense it into a Dao Fruit, it would be hard to encounter an adversary among the Immortals.
However, at that time, as Lu Yang was merely at the Foundation Establishment Stage with a low level of cultivation, it was not the time to touch upon higher levels, and Yun Zhi did not share this thought with Lu Yang.
Subsequent experiences were similar to those of the old timeline; by the time Lu Yang possessed the Invincible Elixir and the Invincible Nascent Soul and traveled through the Demon Territory and the East Sea, he had not encountered Jiang Lianyi, Ao Ling, or Ashy Bean.
During the Divinity Transformation Tribulation, he also did not encounter the remnant thought of Yingtian Immortal.
Since Lu Yang did not resurrect Fairy Eternity and had not met the Four Ancient Immortals through the time channel, the Four Ancient Immortals did not leave the historical reflection of the Go game setup, so he was unaware of Fairy Eternity's death, had not established Buddhism as a backup plan, and Yingtian Immortal had no reason to leave a thought in the Heavenly Tribulation.
Without Buddhism, naturally, there was no Buddha Country, and at the end of the Fire Dynasty, the Time Immortal, after being ambushed by the manipulator behind the scenes, had nowhere to hide and ultimately died at his hands.
Although he did not encounter people from the ancient history, Lu Yang inevitably came across individuals like the sixth Emperor Yu Wu Youdao, the Void Venerate, Nightmare Supreme, and Great Yu's Tribulation Crossing Practitioner during his trials.
After experiencing so many accidents, Yun Zhi was not confident about letting Lu Yang go out alone, so to be on the safe side, she left a contingency plan on him.
The memories from both timelines gradually merged, allowing the manipulator behind the scenes to finally have a rough understanding of the experiences on this timeline.
In the old timeline, because Lu Yang revived Fairy Eternity, the manipulator behind the scenes paid a lot of attention to Lu Yang.
In the new timeline, Lu Yang did not revive Fairy Eternity, and the manipulator behind the scenes only considered him an interesting junior cultivator, not knowing much about his early experiences.
What really drew his attention to Lu Yang was when Lu Yang went to the Laurel Fairy Palace.
The manipulator behind the scenes took notice of Lu Yang, and Yun Zhi through her contingency plan also noticed "Yingtian Immortal".
The manipulator behind the scenes was forced to show up and converse with Yun Zhi and Lu Yang.
At that time, he was surprised to discover that Lu Yang actually had an Invincible Elixir, which made him suspect for a moment that Lu Yang had some connection with the Immortal Fairy.
As the conversation went deeper, he realized that Lu Yang's Invincible Elixir had no relationship with Immortal Fairy; it was just that the method of their golden core formation was similar, which relieved him.
It was from "Yingtian Immortal" that Lu Yang and Yun Zhi learned about the manipulator behind the scenes and the affairs of the Fire Dynasty.
While Lu Yang was crossing the Refining Void Tribulation, Yun Zhi asked "Yingtian Immortal" to take action to strengthen the Thunder Tribulation and stimulate Lu Yang's potential.
During his first trip to the Extreme Northern Lands, Lu Yang did not meet Immortal Jiuchong.
The opportunity for the second journey into the Extreme Northern Lands came when Xue Shilou passed the test and became the heir to the Snow Emperor; Lu Yang went to offer congratulations and met the mentally fragmented Immortal Jiuchong.
By the time Lu Yang reached the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, considering that Yun Mengmeng already possessed the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit, if Lu Yang also had the Initial Form, there could be competition in the future; Yun Zhi did not wish to see that happen, so she did not mention the matter of the Dao Fruit Outline.
Unexpectedly, Yun Mengmeng secretly taught Lu Yang the experience of condensing the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit; by the time Yun Zhi discovered this, it was already too late, and Lu Yang had condensed the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit.
At that time, Yun Zhi had not yet taught Lu Yang about the Dao Fruit, and Lu Yang did not know that similar types of Dao Fruit could only have one existing piece.
"Xiao Zhi, you always say that the Initial Form of Immortal Tao Fruit is very strong, right? If both of us have the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit, can't we make progress together and become stronger?"
"Are we in a competitive relationship? No, no, with Lu Yang Junior Brother being so formidable, he will definitely be the one to condense the Immortal Dao Fruit in the end."
As things developed to this stage, Yun Zhi could only persist with the mistake.
Later on, Lu Yang and Yun Mengmeng encountered Qinghe, who was running a restaurant, as well as Great Yu Cultivators who harbored lustful thoughts towards Qinghe.
This annoyed Ashy Bean, who in a fit of rage beat up the Great Yu Cultivators all the way to the Sun. The Mid-heaven Emperor Lord and The Controller, who liked to protect their own unreasonably, got involved and Ashy Bean ended up beating them up as well.
This matter caught Yun Zhi's attention. As the chief culprit behind the demise of the Fire Dynasty, it was imperative that Ashy Bean be executed.
It was then that Yun Zhi first used the power of Half-step Harmonization, extinguishing several Star Golden Cores.
"Ha, so the Star Golden Cores up above are yours. How much longer can you stay in the Mortal World?" Ashy Bean laughed even as death approached, revealing Yun Zhi's predicament.
Only then did Lu Yang realize that the situation of his Eldest Senior Sister was very dire; a day would come when the Harmonization would happen.
He proposed to abandon the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit and instead aggregate the Trace Origin Dao Fruit Prototype to extend the life of his Eldest Senior Sister, but she rejected the proposal fiercely.
This was the first disagreement between the two, and Lu Yang even became angry.
Neither gave way, and Lu Yang decided to delve into the Dual Tao Fruit System, possessing both the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit and the Trace Origin Dao Fruit Prototype simultaneously.
Few truly realized that Lu Yang's cultivation talent was actually terrifying. To reach the Transcendance Tribulation Stage in less than a century is something unheard of throughout history.
This was also reflected in his magic skills. The role of the Trace Origin Dao Fruit was to rectify the original form of magic skills, not to make him learn them.
Every magic skill that he learned — Three Flavored True Fire, Shrinking Ground Into Inches, Buddha Land in Palm... these were not within the realm of his capabilities, yet he learned them all. This was something even Yun Zhi found unbelievable.
This time, to save his Eldest Senior Sister, he pushed himself to the limit. Sleeplessly, he continued to have breakthroughs in understanding, studying the Dao Fruit theory, learning from the Harmonization system, revealing his genuine talent.
The three great realms beyond Immortality had all been explored by predecessors. What he could do was to innovate on the path of Dao Fruits.
Finally, he pioneered a slightly different path, which could accommodate two Dao Fruit Outlines simultaneously.
However, the soul of a cultivator is not sufficient to support two Dao Fruit Outlines. To devour other Dao Fruits, the Mid-heaven Emperor Lord needed to refine the Laurel Tree Ancestor to strengthen the soul. The hidden mastermind possesses multiple Dao Fruits because the first Dao Fruit he devoured was the Soul Dao Fruit.
With the assistance of the Laurel Tree Ancestor, Lu Yang came to possess both the Initial Form of Immortal Dao Fruit and the Trace Origin Dao Fruit Prototype.
In truth, Lu Yang had no intention to condense the Immortal Dao Fruit; he only wanted to use the Trace Origin Dao Fruit to save his Eldest Senior Sister's life.
To be frank, the Eldest Senior Sister surely would not agree. To ease her worries, Lu Yang created the Dual Tao Fruit System.
During the Immortal Ascension Tribulation, when Lu Yang was condensing the Trace Origin Dao Fruit, he found that the Immortal Dao Fruit was surprisingly easy to condense, much easier than he had imagined; it was hardly any trouble at all.
Upon careful perception, he discovered that it was the Invincible Primordial Spirit fused within his body that was helping him condense the Immortal Dao Fruit!
This was a fact known only to the Fairy Eternity. Fairy Eternity told Lu Yang that staying true to oneself was one of the reasons for condensing the Immortal Dao Fruit. The second, unspoken reason was, "The Immortal Dao Fruit is invincible, and so must the belief of its master be; only the will to be invincible can maintain its immortality."
Lu Yang thus effortlessly condensed the Immortal Dao Fruit.
Nobody expected that Lu Yang could really do it. Even the hidden mastermind was astonished, as during the Immortal Ascension Tribulation Lu Yang clearly stated he would only condense the Trace Origin Dao Fruit!
What it means to possess the Immortal Dao Fruit is that Lu Yang would ascend to Omniscience. With the talents Lu Yang displayed, and the great chain of Causality that followed wherever he went, the hidden mastermind believed that Lu Yang would definitely become Omniscient!
Before the remnants of the Immortal Tribulation had completely dissipated, the hidden mastermind decisively struck, aiming to kill Lu Yang in his cradle.
But the present was vastly different from the Ancient Times. With Yun Zhi beside him, Lu Yang was not in a state of defenselessness on the verge of achieving Omniscience.
Seeing the situation, Yun Zhi did not ask for reasons and resolutely took action. Anyone who harbors the intention of killing her Junior Brother shall die!
The clash between the two was unprecedented, creating a hole in the Wuling Continent and battling in the Universe!
Afterward, the will of the old timeline's hidden mastermind overlaid that of the new timeline's hidden mastermind.
Having gained a rough understanding of what had transpired in this timeline, the hidden mastermind suddenly realized that the reason the Immortal Eternity always referred to Lu Yang as "Immortal Lineage Second Boss", and why in front of the Time Immortal she praised Lu Yang as the strongest to come, might not merely be due to meritocracy; it was likely because Lu Yang was truly well-suited for the Immortal Dao Fruit, and his cultivation talent was extraordinary!
Whether it was he or the other Ancient Three Immortals, they had all been misled by Lu Yang. Anyone would think that since the Immortal Eternity is in Lu Yang's Spiritual Space, Lu Yang's achievements in cultivation could not be separated from the contributions of the Immortal Eternity.
But upon further thought, everything Lu Yang heard from the Immortal Eternity was a shameful past; he never learned anything useful. Even if he did learn, it was techniques like Playing Dead Technique, which were useless for cultivation and combat, or magic skills like Invert Yin and Yang, Devour the Sky and Swallow the Earth, which even Yun Zhi could teach!
When Lu Yang often spoke of relying on oneself for cultivation and refusing help from the Immortal Eternity, it was not just talk; he had always acted that way.
Otherwise, how could he be worthy of the Immortal Eternity?

chapters.title: Chapter 1361 - 1360: Omniscience
chapters.content:
Upon realizing the events transpiring in this timeline, the hidden mastermind finally acknowledged that it was a future far more terrifying than the old timeline!
The founder of the Dual Dao Fruit System, Lu Yang, was able to restrain Yun Zhi alone, preventing her from Harmonization!
Boom——
Yun Zhi struck again, no longer having any concerns after learning her Junior Brother could help her maintain her humanity.
At this moment, she wielded the mighty power of heaven and earth, her techniques were grand and unrestrained, not quite Harmonization yet surpassing it, she was invincible!
The body of the hidden mastermind was continuously pierced and reassembled, immortal blood scattered across the void, each droplet containing terrifying power, possessing a portion of the might of the Devouring Dao Fruit.
It was only a droplet of blood exploding, yet forces such as the Heavenly Tribulation and Five Elements unleashed, turning into chaos and destroying a star system.
If one at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage were to fortuitously obtain one droplet of this undying blood, they could potentially perceive the outline of a Dao Fruit!
He vomited blood profusely, one could imagine the immense power of this immortal blood!
Seeking to use blood to mask the heavens, the hidden mastermind drew upon the Blood Sacrifice Domain, a Secret Technique created in the Ancient Times, filled with the primitive and brutal rites of ancient sacrifices, its power unmatched.
This Secret Technique now solely belonged to him.
But Yun Zhi did not give him the chance; she clenched her right hand, grasping all the immortal blood within her fist, and with a pop, it exploded, leaving only wisp upon wisp of chaotic mist seeping through her fingers.
"Daoist Yun Zhi, there may have been some misunderstanding just now, we do not have to be so irreconcilable," said the hidden mastermind, feeling the urge to retreat as continuing the fight would certainly lead to his death.
"Misunderstanding? Was it also a misunderstanding when you harbored murderous intent towards Junior Brother?" Yun Zhi's expression was cold, and her attacks relentless, aiming straight for the hidden mastermind's vital points!
Yun Zhi did not care why the hidden mastermind tried to Possess the Yingtian Immortal, that was unrelated to her, but the murderous intent he felt at the end of the Immortal Ascension Tribulation was undeniable.
Had it not been for Junior Brother forming the Eternity Dao Fruit, he would have died there!
Never had Yun Zhi been so angry, otherwise, she wouldn't have commenced the battle with full strength without fully understanding the hidden mastermind's abilities.
Now you say it's a misunderstanding?
Better tell that to the dead.
Lu Yang, who was maintaining Yun Zhi's realm, had a dazed look on his face as images he had never seen before intermittently appeared in his mind, vague and unfamiliar.
Lu Yang turned his head; he always felt as if there should be someone standing beside him.
Lu Yang had thought that after becoming an Immortal, the bizarre symptoms of auditory and visual hallucinations would disappear, but they only grew worse.
What exactly was happening?
Lu Yang slowly closed his eyes, his consciousness beginning to expand uncontrollably.
He felt as if he was intangible, only a vast and hazy consciousness remained.
This hazy consciousness connected with the causality of the entire world, extending infinitely, like an enlightening epiphany, knowledge flowed into his mind, solving past puzzles, his horizon expanding immeasurably with no end in sight.
"Above Immortals are Transcendence and Omniscience; to attain the All-Knowing Realm there are three conditions: possessing a Cause and Effect Dao Fruit tainted with causality, being a human for two lifetimes, entangled in causality..."
Yun Zhi, who was in the midst of battle, paused; Junior Brother's two Dao Fruits were no longer tugging at her.
She whirled around to look at Lu Yang, only to see him with his eyes tightly closed, his aura fluttering uncertainly, unguarded, completely incongruous with someone in battle!
"Advancing to the All-Knowing Realm?" The hidden mastermind was startled at the sight; he was all too familiar with Lu Yang's condition, similar to what the Immortal Fairy had once experienced.
"How could he be advancing to the All-Knowing Realm just after becoming an Immortal?!"
Even the Immortal Fairy had to wait a long time after attaining the Immortal Fruit Position and be entangled in causality to reach that condition, yet Lu Yang's speed of advancement was defying the heavens.
Was it because his experiences in this timeline were sufficiently profound?
No, there was more to it than that.
"Could it be because I altered the timeline once?"
Upon this realization, it suddenly dawned on the hidden mastermind; altering the timeline was grand causality, as a Transcendent being, he did not accumulate causality, just as when he transferred the causality of killing the Time Immortal onto the Qilin Immortal.
Altering the timeline followed the same logic; the change was that Lu Yang had not revived the Immortal Fairy, mak
The mastermind behind the scenes was not frightened but delighted, believing that heaven does not seal off all exits. With Lu Yang completely unprepared, as long as Lu Yang was dealt with, Yun Zhi would harmonize with the ultimate power. By then, no one would be his match!
He took a palm strike from Yun Zhi and flew towards Lu Yang with the force.
"Not good!"
Yun Zhi saw through the mastermind's intention, hurriedly moved to intercept, and the heavens and earth shook, the universe quaked.
She arrived from the skies, fiercer than dragons and tigers, kicking the mastermind away with a single blow.
Without Lu Yang to stabilize Yun Zhi's realm, Yun Zhi was unclear how long she could avoid harmonizing with the ultimate power, she must resolve the mastermind before the harmonization occurs!
The mastermind manipulated the forces of creation, using the sun, moon, and stars as nodes to arrange a thirty-three-layered great formation.
Yun Zhi forcefully broke the formation, tearing the great formation apart with her hands.
The infinite power of heaven and earth compressed the mastermind, crushing his ribs through his viscera, blurring his flesh, as if he had crawled out from a pile of corpses!
Yun Zhi repelled the mastermind countless times, getting increasingly closer to harmonizing with the ultimate power, her moves becoming sluggish and not as sharp as before.
In fact, Yun Zhi should have harmonized with the ultimate power already, but she forcefully held back the process with a willpower so strong and irrational.
The stars in the cultivation world crumbled one after another, causing Yun Mengmeng to feel anxious.
"You won't harm my junior brother…" Yun Zhi's mind state became more serene and merciless, her tone weak and breathless.
Without Lu Yang's help, she was ultimately unable to resist the Harmonization Realm.
The mastermind seized the opportunity, breaking the blockade and approaching Lu Yang.
Jiang Pingan and Meng Junzi stood in front of Lu Yang.
"Get lost!" The mastermind shouted, completely disregarding the two, sending them flying thousands of miles away with a palm strike!
He was terrified, feeling that Lu Yang was on the brink of reaching the All-Knowing Realm, his own situation was extremely perilous!
"Great Five Elements Destruction Tribulation!"
The mighty tribulation descended, the origin force of the Great Five Elements twisted, manifesting as five different heavenly tribulations, aiming to annihilate Lu Yang!
As if an ancient tragedy was recurring, Lu Yang was on the verge of breaking through, completely unprepared, and was eradicated by the Five Elements Heavenly Tribulation, reduced to ashes, his soul scattered to the winds.
"I've succeeded! Hahahahaha!" Upon the brink of breakthrough, Lu Yang was obliterated by himself, the mastermind could no longer contain the joy within his heart, laughing wildly, echoing through the universe.
"Don't…"
Yun Zhi's heart plunged into the abyss. Though she was determined to vanquish her enemy, her most important attachment in this world had vanished, her realm uncontrollably ascending towards Harmonization.
All evidence of Yun Zhi's existence in the world began to be erased one by one, memories of her in people's minds also disappeared, and Yun Mengmeng, gazing at the stars, suddenly burst into tears.
"Strange, why am I crying?"
"Junior brother… Lu Yang…"
Even before harmonizing with the ultimate power, Yun Zhi constantly thought of Lu Yang.
As her words fell, Immortal Rule Runes appeared out of nowhere, interwoven together, forming the appearance of Lu Yang, as if he had been there all along and had never vanished.
Lu Yang opened his eyes, smiling at the Eldest Senior Sister who had only left a projection behind.
"What's the matter, Eldest Senior Sister."
Merely six simple words, resonating through the heavens, overpowering the laughter of the mastermind.
The laughter of the mastermind abruptly ceased.
In ancient times, utilizing his transcendence characteristic, the mastermind made the world forget the existence of Immortal Fairy, made the Four Ancient Immortals forget Immortal Fairy's name. But now is not ancient times, and Yun Zhi is not one of the Four Ancient Immortals.
History cycles in reincarnation, and similar events unfold time and again, but there are always deviations.
Those who hold the Eternity Dao Fruit, are immortal and undying, eternal and everlasting. By calling their name, they can be resurrected in the world.

chapters.title: Chapter 1362 - 1361: The Strongest in the Future
chapters.content:
As Lu Yang reappeared in the world, Yun Zhi, originally reduced to a mere projection, reverted to her true form, her realm stumbled and firmly settled at the Half-step Harmonization Realm.
"Eldest Senior Sister, did you need me for something?" Lu Yang chuckled lightly, appearing before Yun Zhi with an easy posture, incongruously calm amidst a battlefield strewn with shattered stars and spilled Immortal blood.
"You..." Yun Zhi was amazed, sensing in her Junior Brother a confidence like never before.
Lu Yang's gaze was bright and clear, heavy with the weight of a thousand pounds when it landed on the hidden mastermind, an unbearable burden.
"You… you've achieved Omniscience?!" The hidden mastermind's eyes widened in disbelief.
There was no hint of realm pressure coming from Lu Yang, but his penetrating gaze was more terrifying than any realm pressure could be.
He recalled the words spoken by Fairy Eternity before, and indeed, this was the most powerful being of the future.
"The hidden mastermind... or should I call you Fu Xu?"
"Considering you are the senior of us all, I should pay my respects."
As he spoke, Lu Yang indeed bowed with hands clasped in front of him, his gesture standard and serious: "Junior Lu Yang pays respects to the progenitor of the Qi Cultivation Realm, the original Primordial Immortal Body, senior Fu Xu."
Jiang Pingan and Meng Junzi, upon learning the true identity of the hidden mastermind, were both shocked; they had not imagined his origins to be so astonishing, traceable to the distant and unverifiable Ancient times, the founder of the Qi Cultivation Realm, implying he was also the creator of the entire Cultivation System.
Lu Yang rose with a smile, continuing to say: "The eight sages including the Firmament Tree, Shaohao, Emperor Shi, and Huo Zheng, were senior's friends, and they also created many realms including the Foundation Establishment Golden Pill based on senior's principles, protecting the Human race from harm by the Demon Race."
"Senior predicted the Dao Fruit System and selflessly shared the cultivation methods with the other sages."
"After that, senior also discovered the realm beyond Dao Fruit – Transcendence, as well as the method to reach the Transcendence Realm."
With every sentence Lu Yang spoke, the hidden mastermind's realm shook and uncontrollably dropped further.
Listening to Lu Yang revealing his true name, recounting ancient history, especially remembering that part of history he regretted most, he showed a pained expression and bellowed,
"Stop talking!"
Lu Yang ignored him and continued to help him recall the past.
"The Firmament Tree condensed the Time Line Dao Fruit, Shaohao condensed the Heavenly Tribulation Dao Fruit, Huo Zheng condensed the Five Elements Dao Fruit, Emperor Shi condensed the Soul Dao Fruit... senior Fu Xu, you condensed the Devouring Dao Fruit."
"To achieve Transcendence, you first devoured Emperor Shi and his Soul Dao Fruit, and then successively devoured the Dao Fruits of others."
"Stop talking!!!" The hidden mastermind roared hysterically, never before had he lost his composure like this.
Lu Yang, oblivious to his plea, responded in an equally loud voice: "Since the beginning, senior Fu Xu's concentration on Dao Fruit was for the purpose of devouring his friends to achieve Transcendence. Senior's single-minded pursuit of the Dao, I truly admire from the bottom of my heart!"
"Don't talk anymore..." As Lu Yang articulated Fu Xu's most sordid thoughts, Fu Xu stumbled backwards several steps; his once unbeatable aura faded away, like an old man without a spine, unable to straighten his back ever again.
After accomplishing Transcendence, he felt no joy but instead an immense emptiness, as all those acquaintances were no longer around.
He began to indulge in life crazily, experiencing different lives.
He was like a gust of wind; after blowing through, there was not a trace left in the world, forever unable to fill the void in his heart.
Therefore, he envied the friendship of the Five Ancient Immortals, and at the end of the Fire Dynasty era, he deliberately possessed the Yingtian Immortal to sow discord amongst the Four Ancient Immortals.
In the old timeline, after coming in contact with Fairy Eternity in the Laurel Fairy Palace, he was reminded of friendships from the Ancient Times, reined in his killer instinct, and wanted to continue living disguised as Yingtian Immortal.
However, the old timeline's Lu Yang shattered his little scheme; he had to come to the new timeline against his will in order to survive.
"Considering everything, I also have to thank senior Fu Xu for making it possible for me to achieve Omniscience."
After reaching the All-Knowing Realm, not only was he privy to the ancient and modern history of this timeline, but he was also crystal clear about events from the old timeline.
He knew that his old timeline self had resurrected Immortal Fairy Eternity, lived a life much richer than his own, enviable to others.
"Alright, I've just broken through to a new realm and was a bit overjoyed, so I spoke rather too much."
"After giving thanks, it's time to settle the scores between us," Lu Yang's expression turned cold, no longer the warm and scholarly demeanor from before.
Lu Yang stretched out a finger and pointed at Fu Xu's forehead across the void.
Fu Xu's body twitched uncontrollably as his endless life force rapidly drained away; he fell into the Heavenly Person Five Decays, aged instantly to a skeletal-like state, emitting waves of foul stench.
"Wait, you can't kill me! Otherwise, I'll modify the timeline back to the old one, and then all of you will disappear!" Fu Xu shouted, facing the brink of life and death, this was his last resort.
Lu Yang, as if hearing something extremely funny, couldn't help but laugh out loud.
He crouched down, grabbing the head of Fu Xu, who was pleading persistently, his pleas mixed with threats.
"Let's not even mention that you're not proficient in using the Time Line Dao Fruit, and can't use it in a short time."
"Even if you could use it, why do you think our timeline would disappear?"
"Wh-what..." Fu Xu was dumbfounded, what did this mean? The Firmament Tree had told him that there was only one timeline.
"It was Senior Firmament Tree who told you that there was only one timeline, right?" Lu Yang, having ample time, said slowly and deliberately.
"But has Senior Firmament Tree ever considered what would happen if someone undergoes Harmonization with their own body?"
"You did indeed create this timeline. Think carefully about the things that happened on this timeline. Eldest Senior Sister achieved Harmonization; although her realm fell, the fact that she once achieved Harmonization is enough. She used her body for Harmonization, solidifying this timeline."
"The same logic applies to the old timeline. There, Eldest Senior Sister also successfully achieved Harmonization in battle, solidifying the old timeline."
"Why do you think you could shake a timeline where a Harmonizer exists? Is it the shortcut to Transcendence that gave you confidence, or the Time Line Dao Fruit that you're not proficient with?"
Lu Yang looked at Fu Xu, whose expression had gone blank, like a clown.
"So you see, the new and old timelines coexist. When you use the Time Line Dao Fruit, it's merely your consciousness hopping back and forth between the two timelines."
"I bet in the old timeline, only your corpse remains."
"However, there is some good news to tell you?"
"What good news?" Hope rekindled in Fu Xu.
Lu Yang said with a smile: "Senior Firmament Tree and the others had a terrible death; they didn't even have a gravestone. When you die, I will erect a stele for you, so go in peace."
"No—"
Fu Xu let out a wail, like a deflating balloon, rapidly shriveling away into nothingness.
"Done and dusted."
Lu Yang dusted off his hands, having resolved a major trouble for his old timeline self, and he was in quite a good mood.
"Is it over?" Yun Zhi flew over and asked.
Lu Yang shook his head: "There's one last thing."
"What is it?"
"Resurrect Fairy Eternity."
"Resurrect Fairy Eternity?" Yun Zhi subconsciously repeated.
"Qilin Immortal and Wu Yao made a deal to swap me in to resurrect Fairy Eternity."
Lu Yang gave a mischievous smile towards Yun Zhi: "Fairy Eternity's resurrection is also related to you, Eldest Senior Sister."
"But resurrecting Fairy is a bit tricky," Lu Yang scratched his head, "I already possess the Eternity Dao Fruit, occupying the Immortal Rule, so her Eternity Dao Fruit can't be used."
"But it's just a small trouble after all. I just need to discard my own Eternity Dao Fruit to make room. Don't worry, I won't fall in realm."
Yun Zhi was taken aback and was just about to persuade her junior brother when she saw Lu Yang decisively discard the Eternity Dao Fruit, shouting loudly.
"Fairy Eternity Yellow Bean!"
The colors of heaven and earth changed, and immortal power converged overhead, eventually forming into a dazzling soul.
"Hmm, it feels like I've slept for a very long time. Who are you two?" The dazzling soul yawned and rubbed her eyes, seemingly still half asleep.
"Fairy, nice to meet you for the first time. My name is Lu Yang, and this is my Eldest Senior Sister, Yun Zhi."

chapters.title: Chapter 1363 - 1362: Grand Finale
chapters.content:
Old timeline.
"Strange, why has the mastermind behind the scenes suddenly stopped moving?" Lu Yang frowned, puzzled as he observed the mastermind, or rather, the mastermind's corpse.
The change came too abruptly and unexpectedly, creating an odd atmosphere on the battlefield. No one dared to make a move, worried that this might be a trick by the mastermind.
In the battle, Yun Zhi dominated, causing the mastermind to weaken progressively, his self-healing ability unable to keep up with the rate of his injuries, his aura dropping repeatedly.
It was clear to everyone that if nothing unexpected happened, Yun Zhi would soon achieve victory.
At this moment, the mastermind looked towards Lu Yang and Immortal Sister, revealing a strange smile, and then his breath ceased.
"Why did he suddenly die?"
Everyone was shocked, as this twist exceeded their expectations.
"Could it be that the mastermind thought he couldn't beat Daoist Yun Zhi, so he killed himself to end this with dignity?" Immortal Jiuchong pondered seriously, observing the mastermind's corpse with Immortal Sense.
At this point, everyone turned their gaze towards Immortal Sister, recalling her Playing Dead Technique.
"Go away, why are all of you staring at me?" Immortal Sister felt something was off about their gazes.
"It probably isn't the Playing Dead Technique." Lu Yang stepped forward to defend Immortal Sister, "Suicide also seems unlikely, it's not the mastermind's way of doing things."
"The mastermind acts cautiously, there's definitely a big issue here." Lu Yang frowned in thought, feeling like he was overlooking something.
Boom—
Lu Yang looked up and saw that Eldest Senior Sister didn't stop attacking due to the mastermind's ceased breath, and was still attacking the corpse.
Whether truly dead or playing dead, destroying the corpse was definitely not a mistake.
"Right, has the mastermind never used the Time Line Dao Fruit?" Lu Yang carefully recalled the battle, realizing that the mastermind had never altered the timeline from beginning to end.
Could his sudden death be related to changing the timeline?
Thinking this, Lu Yang activated the Trace Origin Dao Fruit, performing predict the future, his hands forming seals, and black river waters spread from underneath his feet.
This was the second time Time Immortal saw Lu Yang using this magic skill. Theoretically, predicting the future was taught to Immortal Sister by him, and Immortal Sister in turn taught it to Lu Yang, but in Lu Yang's hands, it somehow showed completely different effects.
And he always felt this magic skill should be familiar, as though he should know it, but he was sure he didn't.
Predicting the future itself was a magic skill extended from the Time Line Dao Fruit by Firmament Tree, specifically for checking timelines. As Lu Yang became an Immortal, he could finally perform this magic skill in its most complete form.
People gathered around, heads close together, watching the situation on another timeline.
"Hey, hey, hey, we're all Immortals, can't you use Immortal Sense to watch from a distance?"
"Immortal Sense isn't as clear as using eyes, come on, move a bit to that side, make some space for me."
In the black river waters, a completely different timeline was reflected.
The crowd saw a Lu Yang possessing dual Dao Fruits, saw Yun Zhi's Harmonization, Lu Yang's ascension to Omniscience, and him saving Yun Zhi back, as well as Lu Yang narrating the origins of the mastermind.
The more they watched, the stranger the expressions became on everyone's faces.
"Did the mastermind think he couldn't beat us, so he ran to another timeline to fight the Omniscient Lu Doyou?" Qilin Immortal's kirin whiskers trembled.
Was this him thinking he wasn't dying fast enough?
The crowd's look at Lu Yang changed completely; they had not expected Lu Yang's talent to be so terrifying, reaching the All-Knowing Realm in another timeline.
"Haha, I told you Little Yang is the strongest." Immortal Sister chuckled proudly, even more delighted than Lu Yang, her eyes sparkling with joy; her judgment of people had never been wrong.
"But Immortal Sister, what you said is about another timeline," Lu Yang corrected.
"Eh, don't worry about which timeline it is, just admit I'm right."
Lu Yang nodded sincerely; when had Immortal Sister ever been wrong? Whatever Immortal Sister said was always correct.
New timeline's Lu Yang, as if sensing something, crossed the timelines and locked gazes with everyone.
After ascending to Omniscience, he knew everything that happened in both timelines.
People were startled, yet only the old timeline's Lu Yang remained calm, best aware of his own abilities, especially enjoying seeing others surprised.
"Thank you for helping us clear this trouble."
"No need for thanks; if anything, I should be thanking you. If it wasn't for you pushing Fu Xu into a dead end, this timeline wouldn't have emerged."
"That's also true."
"...Can you be a bit more polite?"
"Why should I be polite to myself?"
The two Lu Yangs conversed joyously across the timelines.
"Eldest Senior Sister is looking for me; we'll chat later." The new timeline's Lu Yang waved to the crowd, taking a temporary leave. There's plenty of time in the future for chat, no rush."
"Anyway, the issue has been resolved." Lu Yang smiled, motioning for everyone to head home.
…
"How did the battle go?"
At Sky Gate Mountain, Ao Ling and Jiang Lianyi were on tenterhooks, feeling insecure, as the mastermind was the most formidable enemy they had ever encountered.
"We are back." Immortal Sister returned in triumph, her face brimming with a comforting smile.
"Chief Housekeeper, Second-in-command, Xiao Zhi!" Yun Mengmeng rushed over, hugging the three key figures of this battle.
"Sorry for worrying you." Yun Zhi's tone was softer compared to usual. The battle was unplanned, and Yun Mengmeng must have been very worried about them.
"Not at all, you guys are so amazing, I believed you would definitely succeed!" Yun Mengmeng said cheerfully, she always had unconditional trust in Xiao Zhi and the others.
"My Lord, was the body of that man not brought back?" Qinghe stood by, respectfully asking.
"No, the body was destroyed by Miss Yun so thoroughly that not even dregs were left."
Qinghe shook her head regretfully. As the mastermind assassin behind the attempt on the Lord's life, a thousand deaths weren't enough; she wanted to desecrate the corpse to ease her anger, but unfortunately, she didn't get the chance.
"Immortal Sister, hurry and tell us, what was the battle like?"
The celebration had just reached its midpoint when the battle erupted, but now with the battle over, the people continued the second half of the celebration.
"There's a lot to say." Fairy Eternity boasted proudly, if not for her intervention, Yun Zhi would have already achieved Harmonization.
"... I had long determined that Little Yang alone wasn't powerful enough, so at the critical moment, I decisively took action and together with Little Yang, we managed to hold back Miss Yun."
Caught up in the excitement, Fairy Eternity abandoned her buns, stood up and re-enacted the scene, feeling particularly cool about herself.
Yun Mengmeng, Qinghe, and Ao Ling were star-struck by the display, also thinking Fairy Eternity looked extraordinarily cool.
Lu Yang silently nibbled on his bun, having a bad premonition.
Suddenly, Yun Zhi sat between Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity, expressionless, pressing down on their shoulders.
"Eldest Senior Sister, is there something wrong?" Lu Yang whispered, inexplicably feeling guilty.
"I'm here to thank you. During the battle, you said a lot to stop me from Harmonization."
"Junior Brother, you said my smile was especially beautiful, is it like this?" Yun Zhi revealed a cold smile, stunningly frigid, scaring Lu Yang so much that his hands trembled, barely holding onto his bun.
"Now that Immortal Senior, you've recovered your Immortal Body, and Junior Brother has also become an immortal, perhaps we should spar."
"Yun, Miss Yun, what are you doing? I warn you, if I become Omniscient, you'll regret it!"
"It's unfair, Eldest Senior Sister, it was all Immortal's idea, not my intention at all!"
The Ancient Three Immortals and Great Xia's duo were drinking Immortal Wine nearby, not listening or looking, pretending they were unaware of the tragic scene unfolding by Lu Yang's side.
"Such great wine!" Meng Junzi took a sip, his eyes gleaming, the fragrance filled with Immortal Energy.
"A fine vintage from forty thousand years ago, a sole jar left in this vast world." Qilin Immortal laughed loudly, today was indeed worth celebrating with a drink.
"It's a pity Ying Tian is not here." Immortal Jiuchong sighed. The Four Ancient Immortals shared their blessings, but one fewer person at the gathering felt somewhat lacking.
"Ying Tian reincarnated only at the Body Integration Realm, as told by Daoist Lu, one needs to reach the Transcendance Tribulation Stage to awaken memories from the first life, it's useless to call him over now."
"No other way then, this fine wine is only for us brothers to drink." The immortals laughed brightly, they considered for Ying Tian Immortal, and it's not their fault if he couldn't enjoy the fortune.
...
Beneath the shade of trees, Lu Yang and Fairy Eternity lay side by side, wrapped in decorative bandages, a sort of medal from their battle with Yun Zhi, Lu Yang even bandaged one of his eyes.
"Hadn't it been for us holding back most of the Dao Fruit's power to maintain Miss Yun's Realm, how could we have let Miss Yun win?" Fairy Eternity said indignantly.
Yun Mengmeng, Qinghe, Xia He, and Bai Shuang, on the side, showered them with warm care, feeding them nourishing foods, taking meticulous attention.
Meng Jingzhou, having climbed to Sky Gate Mountain and seen this scene, nearly had his nose bent out of joint from irritation.
"Old Meng? What brings you here?" Lu Yang sat up and asked.
Meng Jingzhou looked at his good friend and asked solemnly, "You didn't invite me to the celebration, did you?"
"Ahahaha, that totally slipped my mind, I mean, weren't you in Imperial City as a fortune teller? It's too far, so I didn't call."
"I was at our sect at the time."
Lu Yang: "..."
Meng Jingzhou: "..."
The atmosphere was quite awkward for a moment, but fortunately, Meng Jingzhou didn't come to settle scores, changing the subject.
"Old Lu, you haven't been looking at the news recently, have you?"
"No."
Meng Jingzhou thought to himself, I knew it, enjoying life here beats being online.
"After you became an immortal, various civilizations have been paying great attention to you, posts and videos related to you have never decreased in popularity."
"Really." Lu Yang grinned, thinking it might be a good idea to search himself online.
"But there are also some bad rumors spreading."
"Bad rumors?"
"There are rumors saying you have a great influence on the Cultivation World, some negative practices in the Cultivation World are reportedly led by you."
"Nonsense, how is that related to me!" Lu Yang blustered, clearly irritated by the baseless rumors, having devoted his life to righteousness and diligently practicing cultivation, a model of the Righteous Path, Seek Dao Sect regards him as a role model.
Meng Jingzhou nodded sincerely, outraged, "Exactly, that's what I thought too, so I represented the newspaper to interview you. So, you think the ethos of the Cultivation World has nothing to do with you, right?"
"Of course, I've emphasized repeatedly, the ethos of the Cultivation World was crooked to begin with, it wasn't led astray by me. People say history is written by the victors, then why do I, the victor, still get falsely accused?" Lu Yang, the Sword Immortal, said so during the interview with reporter Meng Jingzhou, displaying extreme anger.

chapters.title: Chapter 1364 - 1364: Extra One
chapters.content:
Seek Dao Sect, Task Hall.
"In the storage ring, there lies the corpse of a double-headed evil flood dragon that sneaked into the outer domains and committed atrocities there." Tang Chuanwu and his sister Tang Qiaoqiao handed over a blood-stained storage ring.
The sibling duo appeared travel-weary, a hint of fatigue visible in their eyes, as the double-headed evil flood dragon was not so easy to deal with.
The Senior Sister on duty in the Task Hall examined the storage ring and confirmed it was indeed the wanted double-headed evil flood dragon. She then began to process the task completion and calculate the contribution points.
As the contribution points were being calculated, Tang Chuanwu looked around and noticed that there were far fewer people in the Task Hall today compared to usual.
"The double-headed evil flood dragon was actually slain? I heard many on the Heavenly Pride List attempted to handle it but failed."
"You aren't looking at who took care of it; those are the siblings Tang Chuanwu and Tang Qiaoqiao brought back by Senior Brother Lu from Buddha Country. It's said that Senior Brother Tang even received the true transmission from the Time Immortal. Such experiences are rare even in our Seek Dao Sect!"
Two newly joined disciples of the Seek Dao Sect excitedly discussed, thrilled to frequently encounter these legendary figures after joining the Sect.
"Senior Brother Tang just returned at this time; could it be specifically to observe Junior Brother Li's tribulation?"
"Which Junior Brother Li is undergoing the tribulation?" Tang Chuanwu's voice suddenly appeared, startling the two new disciples in front of him.
The legendary figure spoke up, causing them to stammer, "It's, it's Junior Brother Li Haoran, he's advancing to the Transcendence Tribulation Stage."
"Junior Brother Li Haoran?" Tang Chuanwu's eyes lit up, sweeping away his weariness.
He and his sister had received much care from Li Haoran; his sister's life-bound magical treasure was even refined by Li Haoran.
"Yes, many senior brothers and sisters who were outside have come back. For example, Senior Sister Tao who founded Dream Mirage Group, Prime Minister Senior Brother Man, and Senior Brother Meng who has always been fortune-telling at roadside stalls."
...
"Old Meng, you dare to come back!" On Sky Gate Mountain, upon seeing Meng Jingzhou, Lu Yang pounced on him, as how could a mere Semi-Immortal be a match for an Immortal; Meng Jingzhou was immediately pinned to the ground by Lu Yang.
"Misrepresenting facts, daring to ruin my reputation!"
With an expression of deep disappointment, Lu Yang accused Old Meng of taking over the news agency and maliciously editing interview content while he was recuperating, a crime deserving death.
By the time he learned of this, Meng Jingzhou had already disappeared to who knows where as Meng the Semi-Immortal.
He only returned this time because Li Haoran was about to undergo his tribulation.
No sooner had he returned than was he caught red-handed by Lu Yang.
"Tch, who forgot to invite me to the celebration banquet; you deserved your fate!"
"Junior Sister Tao, note this down: Lu Yang subdued Meng Jingzhou in one move," Lu Yang turned and told Tao Yaoye standing beside him.
"Junior Brother Man, note this down: Lu Yang later retaliated against the reporter," Meng Jingzhou turned and told Man Gu beside him.
Tao Yaoye and Man Gu happened to meet Meng Jingzhou at the sect entrance and came back together.
The two wrestled on the ground for a while before standing up, one a Semi-Immortal and one an Immortal, both unsullied by dust, avoiding the need to dust off their clothes.
"Junior Sister Tao, you're doing well in the outer domains, I heard you've become the owner of the largest film company in the universe now? And you've advanced to the Transcendence Tribulation Stage?" said Lu Yang with a smile. Those film companies and virtual movie corporations could hardly compete with Dream Mirage. Against these companies, Tao Yaoye demonstrated overwhelming dominance.
Truly, she is the undisputed interstellar tycoon.
Originally, she wanted to return to the sect for promotion." Tao Yaoye smiled sweetly, "Unfortunately, I couldn't suppress my realm and attracted a heavenly tribulation on the way back."
"Oh right, I have a script here, take a look," Lu Yang took out a small booklet from his identity jade pendant.
Tao Yaoye took it and flipped through it, her expression turning to surprise: "Is this about the affairs of those nine immortals from ancient times?"
Lu Yang nodded: "After all, those nine predecessors were the ones who established the cultivation realms for the human race; their deeds shouldn't be buried. See if you can make it into a film."
"Since it's Senior Brother Lu's request, of course, it's feasible," Tao Yaoye smiled and kept the script about the nine ancient immortals.
"Junior Sister Tao, if you're lacking good material recently, you could film Junior Brother Man; he's now the youngest Prime Minister in Great Xia," Lu Yang teased.
To become the Prime Minister of Great Xia, one's cultivation level must at least be at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, and Man Gu had obviously reached it.
But attaining the position of Prime Minister wasn't so simple. The political field of Great Xia also valued capability and experience; Man Gu became a Prime Minister at such a young age because of successive exceptions.
"Junior Brother Man, I heard your advancement path has been smooth sailing; apparently, anyone who stands in your way seems to mysteriously encounter trouble?" Tao Yaoye asked curiously, Man Gu's story was indeed legendary, and there were various rumors among the common folk.
No one from the Seek Dao Sect had ever held the position of Prime Minister before; the highest would be Prefectorial Governor, Man Gu was the first one.
Man Gu scratched his head sheepishly: "Senior Sister Tao jests; I advanced so quickly because the Emperor highly values me."
The political field of Great Xia indeed values experience, but they also cherish life. Facing someone like Man Gu, they hurriedly vacated their positions, which was a way to preserve life; what else could Emperor Xia do but promote Man Gu?
"Junior Brother Man, you don't have any thoughts of becoming the Emperor, do you?" Lu Yang suddenly asked.
"Not at all," Man Gu was puzzled why he would suddenly ask this; he is a loyal official of Great Xia.
"I thought so."
Now Emperor Xia sees Man Gu and gets scared, fearing that Man Gu might want to become Emperor, which would spell disaster for himself. Therefore, he recently visited Lu Yang, hoping to use Lu Yang to probe Man Gu's intentions.
Lu Yang thought Emperor Xia was overthinking, but still, a promise to Emperor Xia meant he had to ask.
As the four were chatting, they heard the sound of distant thunder.
"It must be Junior Brother Li undergoing his tribulation, let's go down the mountain and get a closer look."
...
Boom—Boom—
The sound of thunder was incessantly familiar to the ears of the disciples of the Seek Dao Sect.
"Senior Brother Li is advancing to the Transcendence Tribulation Stage!"
In recent years, many from the Seek Dao Sect have been advancing to the Transcendence Tribulation Stage. The disciples have grown very familiar with heavenly tribulations, being able to tell that it's a tribulation for the Transcendence Stage just from the sound of thunder.
At the summit of Refining Peak, Li Haoran merged with nature, achieving Unity of Heaven and Man, keeping himself in the best condition.
He has already awakened eight lifetimes of memories, just needs to ascend to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, then he can awaken the memories of his first lifetime!
"Come, tribulation!"
Li Haoran broke through the state of Unity of Heaven and Man, stood up, and roared to summon the Heavenly Tribulation!
Thunder roared, descending from the ninth heaven, representing the majesty of heaven and earth, striking at Li Haoran!
"I hope Haoran is alright," Su Yiren said anxiously, at such a critical moment in Li Haoran's life, it was natural for family members to be present.
"How could Junior Brother Li be in trouble, after all, he is..." Lu Yang tried to reassure Su Yiren, if a reincarnated Yingtian Immortal were to be struck dead by thunder, that would be really humorous.
But he stopped mid-sentence, suddenly recalling that Li Haoran's previous incarnation, Qin Haoran, died exactly this way; he couldn't bring himself to finish his comforting words.
Fortunately, Su Yiren and Qin Yanyan, the mother and daughter duo, were completely focused on Li Haoran undergoing his tribulation and did not notice Lu Yang's subtle reaction.
Li Haoran flipped his right hand, a cyan lotus petal appeared in his palm, split from one to two, and then into four, instantly transforming into a lotus flower positioned above his head, driving his Profound Skill to resist the Thunder Tribulation.
Lotus, Treasure Gourd, jade bottle, Buddha Platform, Qingluo Umbrella... Various magic artifacts flew out from his Identity Jade Pendant like magic tricks, all top-tier defensive treasures he had refined.
The crowd marveled; even those in the Transcendance Tribulation Stage found it hard to acquire such magic artifacts, only Li Haoran, the Artifact Refiner, could bring out these treasures.
The purple sea of thunder submerged Li Haoran, fiercely hot, causing even space to become tattered and worn, and in this vast sea of thunder, only Li Haoran's treasures emitted white light.
"Could it be that Senior Brother Li could safely pass the tribulation relying on magic artifacts?!" someone exclaimed softly, the effectiveness of these defensive treasures was heaven-defying, suggesting they might hold up till the end of the Heavenly Tribulation.
"Wait, why has Senior Brother Li put away his magic artifacts?"
Li Haoran, in a departure from his usual behavior, retracted his magic artifacts and instead opted to resist the Thunder Tribulation with his physical body.
Li Haoran recalled the tribulation passing experiences taught by Lu Yang, relying solely on magic artifacts was not wise, as it would not achieve the effect of cultivation through Heavenly Tribulation.
He abandoned his strengths and faced the Thunder Tribulation head-on!
Boom—
Li Haoran was struck by the Thunder Tribulation, his skin split and flesh burst, and his bones crackled loudly, audible even from a great distance.
The crowd's hearts tightened at this sight.
"Why has Senior Brother Li closed his eyes?"
The crowd was shocked; they had never heard of a cultivator daring to close their eyes during the tribulation!
Li Haoran closed his eyes and entered a profound state, the Thunder Tribulation not only struck his body but also posed a threat to his Divine Soul.
However, for Li Haoran, this was a beneficial affair, as the Thunder Tribulation acted like a key, viciously striking his Divine Soul and unlocking long-sealed memories.
The Reincarnation Dao Fruit Prototype, lurking unnoticed deep within his soul, began to stir, historical snippets from ancient times flashed through his mind like kites, gradually awakening the memories of his first lifetime.
The same Thunder Tribulation that enveloped him, split his skin and flesh, now felt incredibly dear to him.
Li Haoran ceased to resist the Thunder Tribulation, spread his arms wide, and allowed it to consume him.
The crowd was horrified; was he seeking death?
Only a few discerning individuals saw the signs; the Thunder Tribulation that flowed through Li Haoran's body refined his body and soul, but did not harm him at all. He had reached the pinnacle of control over the Thunder Tribulation, a feat only possible for those historic figures who had survived the tribulation, and only Li Haoran could achieve this!
He draped the sea of thunder over himself like a cape, his eyes emanating golden electric sparks, pointing toward the sky.
Just above him, the ongoing Heavenly Tribulation disappeared from inside out, exposing the clear blue sky.
All eyes were focused on Li Haoran, as if he had become the most dazzling entity between heaven and earth.
He surveyed the insignificant beings below him and slowly said, "I remember now, I am Ying..."
Boom—
Before he could finish his sentence, a sudden change occurred.
The dissipating Thunder Tribulation halted midway and even began to replenish its gaps.
The Heavenly Tribulation came anew, and suddenly three imposing figures appeared.
"What's happening!"
"Who are they?"
"That, those three are Immortal Jiuchong, Time Immortal, and Qilin Immortal!" someone shouted, recognizing the origins of those three figures.
"What, those three Ancient Immortals, why have they appeared?"
This was an unprecedented situation!
Seeing his three old friends, Li Haoran revealed a subtly meaningful smile, "You three..."
"Youngster, did you think you could pass the Thunder Tribulation so easily? We three seniors have come to test you!" Immortal Jiuchong said cheerfully, taking the lead in attacking.
The other two immortals also took action, they have been waiting for this day for a long time!
Li Haoran's expression changed drastically, these three rascals, have they no shame!
"Why have they suddenly started fighting?" the onlookers below were confused.
"Has he summoned the legendary Thunder Tribulation..." Gu Junye stood with his hands behind his back, smiling lightly as he watched the four immortals brawl.
"Do you know what's going on?" Daoist Xiantian was surprised; Gu Junye always seemed to know some ancient secrets unknown to others.
"This is the legendary test of Thunder Tribulation. Immortal Jiuchong and the other two immortals' strength is remembered by history, inscribed within the Heavenly Tribulation. Senior Brother Li's strength has summoned this test from the immortals; if he can pass this test, he will gain an extraordinary opportunity!"
Daoist Xiantian was still puzzled: "Then why doesn't the Thunder Tribulation feature the Yingtian Immortal?"
"Naturally, because Yingtian Immortal isn't as powerful as the legends claim," Gu Junye confidently declared.
